papers.title: One Figure, Every Canvas: Editable Flowchart Relayout via Agentic Pipeline
papers.abstract_en: Pipeline figures in ML papers must be repurposed across many canvases, including paper columns, 16:9 slides, portrait posters, 1:1 social teasers, 9:16 phone previews. Each format imposes a different aspect ratio on the same computational graph, where any silently broken connection misrepresents the method. We formulate aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout as a distinct task: given a raster flowchart and a target ratio, produce a structurally faithful, hallucination-free, editable layout. Existing methods fail characteristically: image-to-image models stretch blocks and reject extreme ratios, text-to-image agentic systems hallucinate content, and parse-then-render systems mis-route edges. We propose an agentic pipeline factored into Parse, Style, and Layout stages, each pairing a main agent with a critic that combines deterministic constraint checks with VLM visual feedback so connectivity is explicitly checked and prevented from being silently broken. Outputs are draw.io-editable mxGraph XML. On a curated benchmark of 100 flowcharts at five aspect ratios, evaluated by Gemini 3.1 Pro and validated against human judgments, our method reaches 68.6% Content Fidelity versus 11.2-41.4% for prior work. Project page: https://onefigureeverycanvas.vercel.app/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 ML 论文流程图在不同画幅间重排形式化为 aspect-ratio-adaptive relayout 任务：给定光栅流程图与目标比例，输出结构忠实、无幻觉、可在 draw.io 编辑的 mxGraph XML。提出 Parse、Style、Layout 三阶段 agentic pipeline，每个阶段由主 agent 加 critic 组成，critic 结合确定性约束检查与 VLM 视觉反馈，显式校验并防止连接被悄悄断开。在 100 张流程图、五种画幅的自建 benchmark 上（Gemini 3.1 Pro 评估并经人工校验），Content Fidelity 达 68.6%，此前工作为 11.2–41.4%。
Motivation: 同一流程图要适配论文双栏、16:9 幻灯、竖版海报、1:1 社交图、9:16 手机预览等不同宽高比，任何被悄悄断开的连线都会误述方法；现有 image-to-image 模型拉伸图块且拒绝极端比例，text-to-image agentic 系统幻觉内容，parse-then-render 系统错连边。
Method: 三阶段 agentic pipeline：Parse、Style、Layout，每阶段一个主 agent 配一个 critic；critic 同时做确定性约束检查与 VLM 视觉反馈，显式检查连通性。输出为 draw.io 可编辑的 mxGraph XML。
Result: 在 100 张流程图、五种宽高比的自建 benchmark 上，由 Gemini 3.1 Pro 评估并与人工判断校验，Content Fidelity 为 68.6%，此前方法为 11.2–41.4%。
Conclusion: 把重排拆成带 critic 的三阶段 agent 流程并显式校验连通性，能在极端画幅下保住流程图内容保真度，且产物保持可编辑。

papers.title: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model's response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing particular starting token cues makes a base model's performance competitive with that of its reinforcement learning (RL)-trained counterparts on math and coding. For instance, the cue ".\n\nOkay" raises Olmo-3-7B's MATH-500 pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, while "Alright," raises Qwen3-14B's from 72% to 87%. Second, RL makes these cues more likely, while fixing them recovers much of its performance gain over the base model. Third, we trace the reasoning effects of token cues to the training data. We perform causal data interventions to turn an arbitrary word, such as "chicken", into an effective reasoning cue, or remove an existing cue's effect. A similar edit makes the prompt instruction "Think duck duck goose" as effective as "Think step by step" at eliciting reasoning. We also find that the hidden state representations induced by different cues correlate with different document types from the training set. Finally, we extend our study of token cues with a case study in language model safety, finding that different cues elicit distinct refusal and compliance behaviors that correspond to different types of training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出 base 模型的推理能力部分被训练数据里「起始 token → 推理行为」的关联所触发：固定特定起始 cue 即可让未微调模型逼近 RL 版本。固定 ".\n\nOkay" 把 Olmo-3-7B 在 MATH-500 上的 pass@1 从 42% 提到 78%，"Alright," 把 Qwen3-14B 从 72% 提到 87%；因果数据干预还能把 "chicken" 变成有效推理 cue，或让 "Think duck duck goose" 达到 "Think step by step" 的效果。
Motivation: RL 后训练带来的推理增益来源不清：如果仅靠固定起始 token 就能复现大部分增益，那么把性能提升归因于模型新学到的推理能力就站不住脚。
Method: 先固定特定起始 token cue 对比 base 与 RL 训练模型在数学和代码上的表现，再做因果数据干预 (causal data interventions)——把任意词改成有效推理 cue 或移除既有 cue 的作用，并分析不同 cue 诱导的隐状态表征与训练集文档类型的对应关系，最后以安全为案例考察 cue 与拒绝/服从行为的联系。
Result: 固定 ".\n\nOkay" 使 Olmo-3-7B 的 MATH-500 pass@1 从 42% 升至 78%，"Alright," 使 Qwen3-14B 从 72% 升至 87%，达到与 RL 训练模型相当的水平；RL 会提高这些 cue 出现的概率，而固定 cue 可回收其相对 base 模型的大部分性能增益。数据干预使 "Think duck duck goose" 与 "Think step by step" 同样有效，不同 cue 的隐状态表征对应训练集中不同文档类型，安全案例中不同 cue 触发与不同训练数据类型对应的拒绝或服从行为。
Conclusion: base 模型的推理表现很大程度由训练数据中起始 token 与推理行为的关联驱动，RL 的增益可被固定 cue 大幅复现；推理能力与安全行为都可被起始 cue 和训练数据构成所调控。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: InterMimicGen: Scaling Humanoid Loco-Manipulation through Self-Evolving Motion Imitation
papers.abstract_en: Captured human-object interactions provide rich supervision for humanoid loco-manipulation, but they are sparse, heterogeneous, and not directly executable by robots. We introduce InterMimicGen, a self-evolving motion-imitation framework in which robot motion data and a tracking policy improve each other. First, we consolidate motion-captured human-object interaction datasets and retarget them into humanoid robot references while preserving whole-body coordination and dexterous hand-object relationships. This produces a large and diverse humanoid robot reference collection for dexterous whole-body loco-manipulation. Second, we train a physics-based generalist tracker that executes these references in simulation on a humanoid with dexterous hands, covering a scale and diversity beyond prior humanoid tracking systems for loco-manipulation. Third, we close a data flywheel: each round makes small, task-preserving changes to where an interaction takes place and how the body performs it, fine-tunes the tracker on them, and keeps only the variants whose simulated execution completes the task, which seed the next round. With more iterations, these small edits compound into broader coverage around the sparse original demonstrations while preserving task semantics and motion quality. Experiments show contact-preserving retargeting across robot configurations, broad tracking with a single generalist policy, executable motions that keep growing over augmentation rounds, and transfer to real robots. InterMimicGen provides a unified path from heterogeneous human demonstrations to a continually expanding motion resource for humanoid robot learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InterMimicGen 把动捕人-物交互数据重定向为类人机器人参考动作，训练单一 physics-based generalist tracker 在仿真中执行，并用数据飞轮自演化：每轮对交互发生位置与身体执行方式做保任务的小改动、微调 tracker、只保留仿真中完成任务的变体作为下一轮种子。小改动随迭代累积成对稀疏原始演示的更广覆盖，同时保持任务语义与动作质量，并可迁移到实体机器人。
Motivation: 动捕人-物交互监督数据稀疏、异构且不能被机器人直接执行，类人 loco-manipulation 缺少可规模化的动作资源。
Method: 三步：整合动捕人-物交互数据集并重定向为类人机器人参考（保留全身协调与灵巧手-物关系）；训练 physics-based generalist tracker 在仿真中以灵巧手类人机器人执行这些参考；闭合数据飞轮，每轮做保任务的位置与动作小改动、微调 tracker、只保留仿真执行完成任务的变体进入下一轮。
Result: 实验展示跨机器人构型的保接触重定向、单一 generalist 策略的广泛跟踪、随增强轮次持续增长的可执行动作，以及向实体机器人的迁移；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 数据与策略互相改进的自演化飞轮可把稀疏异构的人类演示变成持续扩张的类人机器人动作资源，覆盖度随迭代累积且不损失任务语义。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: S2PD: Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion for Physically and Logically Consistent Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Bidirectional video diffusion models denoise entire videos in parallel, yet when trained on effectively unlimited in-distribution data from procedural generators, continue to violate physical laws and simple symbolic rules. We introduce Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion (S2PD), which performs autoregressive diffusion at high noise before switching to parallel diffusion at low noise. The autoregressive phase provides the serial computation needed to coordinate interdependent events and produce valid state transitions while the parallel phase jointly refines the entire video and reduces sampling time relative to fully serial generation. We implement S2PD with two architectures: a pixel-space diffusion transformer trained from scratch and a pretrained video model adapted through LoRA fine-tuning with causal attention. Across games, physical simulations, and real video, S2PD follows rules more reliably than matched bidirectional baselines and generates videos with greater temporal stability and sampling efficiency than other serial methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: S2PD 在高噪声阶段用自回归扩散、低噪声阶段切回并行扩散，使视频生成既满足物理与符号规则又保持采样效率。在游戏、物理仿真和真实视频上，它比匹配的双向基线更遵守规则，并比其他串行方法更时序稳定、采样更高效。
Motivation: 双向视频扩散即使在程序化生成器提供的近乎无限同分布数据上训练，仍会违反物理定律和简单符号规则；纯串行生成虽能协调事件但采样慢。
Method: Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion (S2PD)：高噪声阶段做自回归扩散以串行协调相互依赖的事件与状态转移，低噪声阶段转为并行扩散联合精修整段视频。两种实现——从零训练的 pixel-space diffusion transformer，以及用 LoRA 微调加 causal attention 改造的预训练视频模型。
Result: 在 games、physical simulations 和 real video 三类设置上，S2PD 比 matched bidirectional baselines 更可靠地遵守规则，并比其他 serial 方法生成时序更稳定、采样效率更高的视频；相对 fully serial generation 降低了采样时间。
Conclusion: 把串行计算放在高噪声、并行精修放在低噪声，可以在不牺牲采样效率的前提下提升视频生成的物理与逻辑一致性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: BiasFlow: Geometric Monitoring and Backbone Regularization for Spurious Feature Reliance
papers.abstract_en: Worst-group accuracy (WGA) evaluates a trained predictor but does not characterize how its frozen backbone behaves when a new head is learned. We introduce BiasFlow, a hook-based toolkit for monitoring class-attribute centroid alignment (IBMI), within-class centroid separation (W-IBMI), and feature-projection sensitivity. IBMI is confounded by class-attribute correlation and is not a measure of causal feature reliance. We pair these diagnostics with BiasFlow Regularization (BFR), a supervised, composable class-conditional centroid-alignment penalty. W-IBMI verifies the quantity BFR optimizes; it is scale dependent and does not independently establish attribute removal. Across the reported small-scale benchmarks, adding BFR improves or preserves mean WGA, with gains up to +26.0 pp on UrbanCars. The principal independent stress test freezes CelebA-Std backbones and trains fresh heads on biased data: BFR+GroupDRO improves WGA from 40.7% to 64.1%, while Male probe accuracy decreases from 92.5% to 72.2%. Attribute information remains recoverable, and cross-task results are mixed. A controlled synthetic-watermark ImageNet experiment additionally improves watermark-shift accuracy by +23.0 pp under matched training. These results support evaluating centroid geometry and resistance to biased head retraining alongside WGA, within the tested protocols.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BiasFlow 是一套 hook 式工具包，监控冻结骨干上类-属性质心对齐 (IBMI)、类内质心分离 (W-IBMI) 与特征投影敏感度，并配套类条件质心对齐正则 BFR。在 CelebA-Std 冻结骨干重训头的独立压力测试中，BFR+GroupDRO 把 WGA 从 40.7% 提到 64.1%，同时 Male 探针准确率从 92.5% 降到 72.2%；UrbanCars 上 WGA 增益最高 +26.0 pp。
Motivation: WGA 只评价已训练好的预测器，无法刻画冻结骨干在换一个新头重新学习时的行为；而 IBMI 这类质心对齐指标受类-属性相关混淆，并不度量因果特征依赖。
Method: BiasFlow 用 hook 监控三个诊断量：类-属性质心对齐 IBMI、类内质心分离 W-IBMI、特征投影敏感度；配套 BiasFlow Regularization (BFR)，即一个有监督、可组合的类条件质心对齐惩罚。主压力测试冻结 CelebA-Std 骨干并在有偏数据上训练全新头，与 GroupDRO 组合；另有受控的合成水印 ImageNet 实验。
Result: 在所报告的小规模基准上加入 BFR 使平均 WGA 提升或持平，UrbanCars 增益最高 +26.0 pp；CelebA-Std 冻结骨干重训头的压力测试中 BFR+GroupDRO 将 WGA 从 40.7% 提至 64.1%，Male 探针准确率由 92.5% 降至 72.2%；受控合成水印 ImageNet 实验在匹配训练下水印偏移准确率提升 +23.0 pp。跨任务结果不一致，属性信息仍可被恢复。
Conclusion: 在所测协议内，除 WGA 外还应同时评估质心几何与对有偏头重训的抵抗力；但 IBMI 受类-属性相关混淆、W-IBMI 依赖尺度，都不能单独证明属性已被移除。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: BiasFlow 用 hook 监控三个诊断量：类-属性质心对齐 IBMI、类内质心分离 W-IBMI、特征投影敏感度；配套 BiasFlow Regularization (BFR)，即一个有监督、可组合的类条件质心对齐惩罚。主压力测试冻结 CelebA-Std 骨干并在有偏数据上训练全新头，与 GroupDRO 组合；另有受控的合成水印 ImageNet 实验。
summary_sections.result: 在所报告的小规模基准上加入 BFR 使平均 WGA 提升或持平，UrbanCars 增益最高 +26.0 pp；CelebA-Std 冻结骨干重训头的压力测试中 BFR+GroupDRO 将 WGA 从 40.7% 提至 64.1%，Male 探针准确率由 92.5% 降至 72.2%；受控合成水印 ImageNet 实验在匹配训练下水印偏移准确率提升 +23.0 pp。跨任务结果不一致，属性信息仍可被恢复。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在所测协议内，除 WGA 外还应同时评估质心几何与对有偏头重训的抵抗力；但 IBMI 受类-属性相关混淆、W-IBMI 依赖尺度，都不能单独证明属性已被移除。

papers.title: Learning to Read the Contextual Tokens in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) jointly process visual and textual representations throughout generation. These models repeatedly update the text tokens through multimodal attention, forming dynamic contextual tokens whose function is not well understood. In this work, we introduce a framework for reading this contextual space through natural-language interrogation. We train a lightweight bottleneck network that maps intermediate contextual tokens into the input space of a frozen Large Language Model (LLM), allowing the LLM to answer questions about the emerging image directly from these hidden representations. Our reader reveals that contextual tokens encode a rich, global representation of the emerging scene: generation-specific semantics, including attributes left underspecified by the prompt, are accessible surprisingly early in denoising, while increasingly fine-grained details become readable over time. Remarkably, this information remains decodable even when the MM-DiT receives an empty prompt, showing that contextual tokens accumulate substantial image-specific information from the evolving visual representation itself. We further find that generations with more readable contextual representations tend to receive higher human-preference scores. Building on these observations, we introduce Contextual Alignment, a training technique that explicitly reinforces the visual-semantic information encoded in the contextual tokens, improving generation quality and distributional coverage. Together, our results establish contextual tokens as both an interpretable view into the internal dynamics of MM-DiTs and an effective target for improving generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用自然语言审讯 MM-DiT 中间 contextual tokens 的读取框架：训练轻量瓶颈网络把隐藏表示映射到冻结 LLM 的输入空间，让 LLM 直接就正在生成的图像作答。读取结果显示语义在去噪早期即可解码、细节随时间逐步可读，且可读性更高的生成倾向获得更高人类偏好分；据此提出 Contextual Alignment 训练技术以强化这些视觉-语义信息，提升生成质量与分布覆盖。
Motivation: MM-DiT 在生成过程中反复通过多模态注意力更新文本 token，形成动态 contextual tokens，但其功能缺乏理解；需要一种能直接读出这些隐藏表示所编码内容的手段。
Method: 训练轻量瓶颈网络 (bottleneck network) 将中间 contextual tokens 映射到一个冻结 LLM 的输入空间，使 LLM 能基于隐藏表示回答关于生成图像的自然语言问题；再基于可读性观察提出 Contextual Alignment 训练技术，显式强化 contextual tokens 中的视觉-语义信息。
Result: 读取揭示 contextual tokens 编码场景的全局表征：包括 prompt 未指定的属性在内的生成语义在去噪早期即可访问，更细粒度细节随时间逐步可读；即使输入为空 prompt，这些信息仍可解码；可读性更高的生成倾向获得更高人类偏好分；Contextual Alignment 改善生成质量与分布覆盖。
Conclusion: contextual tokens 既是对 MM-DiT 内部动态的可解释视图，也是改进生成模型的有效训练目标，即使空 prompt 下也累积了大量来自视觉表征的图像特定信息。

papers.title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents that orchestrate frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies improve across episodes through text memory, which records what the agent did but not how the task is done. A demonstration video shows it, but fits poorly into an agent's context. The full video slows every turn, fixed keyframes lose the contact detail that decides whether a grasp holds, and what the agent needs shifts from the task's structure while planning to the frames around each contact. We introduce Recursive Video In-Context Learning (RV-ICL), a training-free method that turns a demonstration into a hierarchy the agent navigates rather than a prompt it receives. The hierarchy is built from the sub-events of the demonstration, such as grasps and releases. Its levels grow finer, from keyframes of the whole task to phases, moments and short clips, and are exposed through read-only tools. The agent reads the coarse levels before planning. During execution it re-enters the hierarchy whenever a step needs more detail and loads only the clip of its current sub-goal. One demonstration per task is enough. Built on RPent, RV-ICL raises success from 92.6% to 96.5% on LIBERO-PRO and from 86.7% to 95.8% on LIBERO-Plus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RV-ICL 把单条演示视频递归拆成「整任务关键帧—阶段—时刻—短片段」的层级，通过只读工具暴露给 LLM agent，规划前读粗层、执行中按当前子目标只加载对应片段。在 RPent 上每任务一条演示即可用：LIBERO-PRO 成功率 92.6%→96.5%，LIBERO-Plus 86.7%→95.8%。
Motivation: LLM agent 靠文本记忆跨回合改进，但文本只记做了什么、不记任务怎么做；整段演示视频塞进上下文会拖慢每一轮，固定关键帧又丢掉决定抓取成败的接触细节。
Method: 训练无关 (training-free) 的 RV-ICL：按演示的子事件（抓取、释放等）构建逐层细化的层级，从整任务关键帧到 phase、moment 与短片段，经只读工具暴露；规划前读粗层，执行中在需要细节时重新进入层级、只加载当前子目标的片段。
Result: 在 RPent 上，每任务一条演示：LIBERO-PRO 成功率从 92.6% 提到 96.5%，LIBERO-Plus 从 86.7% 提到 95.8%。
Conclusion: 把演示视频组织成 agent 可按需导航的层级而非整段 prompt，能在不训练的前提下同时避免上下文拖慢与关键帧丢失接触细节，一条演示即够。

papers.title: Anatomy-aware Fine-grained Multimodal Fusion for Laryngopharyngeal Cancer T-Staging Prediction Using CT and Radiology Report
papers.abstract_en: Accurate T-staging is crucial for guiding personalized treatment strategies for laryngopharyngeal cancer. However, current clinical practice relies on invasive biopsy procedures, whereas CT-based staging remains challenging due to the complex patterns of tumor invasion. Recent computer-aided approaches face two key challenges: 1) Structural relationship modeling: existing methods underrepresent anatomically structured patterns of tumor invasion, as they either process whole CT volumes without tumor-specific anatomical constraints or rely on labor-intensive tumor segmentation. 2) Fine-grained cross-modal alignment: while radiology reports contain organ-specific invasion details, current methods that apply global feature fusion struggle to accurately align individual anatomical structures with their corresponding textual descriptions. To address these issues, we propose an anatomy-aware multimodal framework that integrates organ-level CT context and radiology reports into a unified representation for laryngopharyngeal T-staging. The framework first constructs an Anatomy-Structured Organ Graph (AOG) that captures invasion patterns between primary sites and surrounding organs, then performs Organ-Anchored Cross-Modal Alignment (OCA) so that each organ node aggregates textual evidence from the radiology report, and finally refines this graph representation by injecting organ-specific invasion cues extracted from the report via Report-Enhanced Graph-Refinement (REG), yielding a multimodal organ graph that combines spatial and textual evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves superior performance in T-staging of laryngopharyngeal cancer.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging (IEEE TMI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出解剖感知多模态融合框架做喉咽癌 T 分期：先用 Anatomy-Structured Organ Graph (AOG) 建模原发部位与邻近器官的侵犯关系，再用 Organ-Anchored Cross-Modal Alignment (OCA) 让每个器官节点从放射报告中聚合对应文本证据，最后以 Report-Enhanced Graph-Refinement (REG) 注入器官级侵犯线索。摘要称该框架在喉咽癌 T 分期上取得更优性能。
Motivation: 喉咽癌 T 分期当前依赖有创活检，而 CT 分期因肿瘤侵犯模式复杂而困难；已有方法要么整卷 CT 无解剖约束、依赖费时的肿瘤分割，要么用全局特征融合难以把单个解剖结构与报告中的对应描述对齐。
Method: 三阶段多模态图框架：AOG 构建原发部位与周围器官间的侵犯图；OCA 让每个器官节点从放射学报告中聚合器官特异的文本证据；REG 从报告抽取器官级侵犯线索并细化图表示，输出融合空间与文本证据的多模态器官图用于 T 分期。
Result: 在喉咽癌 T 分期任务上，摘要称所提框架取得 superior performance，相对基线的具体指标数值未在摘要中列出。
Conclusion: 把器官级 CT 上下文与放射报告在统一器官图表示中对齐，可改善依赖有创活检与全局融合的喉咽癌 T 分期流程。

papers.title: Direct Intermediate Initialization for Tilted Diffusion Samplers
papers.abstract_en: Some diffusion posterior samplers construct Gaussian-tilted intermediate distributions along the reverse process. We observe that these targets can be pulled back to clean-space posteriors with weaker conditioning, with samples transported analytically to the corresponding noisy-space target through a Gaussian bridge. For the sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) sampler MCGDiff, the effective observation variance of this pulled-back problem is up to twice the diffusion-noise variance. We exploit this structure to initialize MCGDiff directly at an intermediate time: an approximate solver samples the softened clean-space posterior, the Gaussian bridge maps these samples to the tilted target, and only the remaining SMC suffix is run. This trades asymptotic consistency for finite-particle performance. With moment-matching posterior sampling (MMPS) as the solver, the hybrid improves sliced Wasserstein distance by roughly $2\times$ at matched particle count on a structured Gaussian-mixture inverse problem, and by more than an order of magnitude when the posterior-relevant mode is rare under the prior. A prior-initialization control, which retains the bridge but drops the clean-space conditioning, shows that on MCGDiff's standard Gaussian-mixture benchmark most of the improvement is insensitive to the conditioning. Conditioning the initialization gives a further consistent gain on the structured problem, and becomes decisive on a rare-mode problem, where resampling cannot repopulate a mode absent from the initial population.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics (STODY)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩散后验采样器中沿反向过程构造的高斯倾斜中间分布可被拉回为条件更弱的 clean-space 后验，再经 Gaussian bridge 解析地搬运到 noisy-space 目标。据此让 MCGDiff 直接在中间时刻初始化：用近似求解器（MMPS）采样软化后验、bridge 映射后只跑剩余 SMC 后缀，在结构化 Gaussian-mixture 反问题上以匹配粒子数把 sliced Wasserstein 距离改善约 2×，在先验下稀有模式问题上改善超过一个数量级。
Motivation: MCGDiff 这类 SMC 扩散后验采样器从纯先验起步，粒子群在早期难以落到后验相关模式上，尤其当该模式在先验下稀有时，重采样无法重新生成缺失模式，有限粒子性能差。
Method: 把倾斜中间分布拉回为条件更弱的 clean-space 后验（其有效观测方差最高达扩散噪声方差的两倍），用近似求解器 MMPS 采样该软化后验，经 Gaussian bridge 映射到倾斜目标，只运行剩余 SMC 后缀；同时设一个保留 bridge 但去掉 clean-space 条件化的先验初始化对照。该做法以渐近一致性换取有限粒子性能。
Result: 在结构化 Gaussian-mixture 反问题上，匹配粒子数时混合初始化把 sliced Wasserstein 距离改善约 2×；当后验相关模式在先验下稀有时改善超过一个数量级。对照实验显示 MCGDiff 标准 Gaussian-mixture 基准上大部分改善与条件化无关；条件化在结构化问题上带来进一步一致增益，在稀有模式问题上起决定性作用。
Conclusion: 直接在中间时刻初始化并保留 clean-space 条件化，是用渐近一致性换取有限粒子性能的可行取舍，且在稀有模式后验上条件化不可省——初始种群缺失的模式靠重采样无法恢复。

papers.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points
papers.abstract_en: Every recurrence of a looped language model adds cost in training, decoding, prefill, and reinforcement learning (RL). The closer recurrent states get to fixed points, the less the path to them matters. This enables truncated backpropagation in training; terminal key-value (KV) sharing for decoding with almost no loss in accuracy; a distilled student that prefills up to 1.79x faster; and RL updates that compute gradients from saved rollout states, 2x faster than backpropagating through the replayed trajectory. We therefore improve the two components of training that shape these fixed points: the depth prior and input injection. Fixed-depth training breaks KV sharing, and Huginn's broad depth prior supports sharing but dilutes supervision at the target depth more than sharing requires; we learn the prior from prediction feedback, with an entropy term that keeps it broad. Existing injection schemes let the state's component along the input amplify or cancel the injection; we remove this component with orthogonal injection. From 100M to 1.6B parameters, the learned prior and orthogonal injection lower perplexity at every scale relative to Huginn's prior and existing injection schemes, respectively. At 1.6B, the learned prior with a 3x smaller KV cache matches the downstream average of fixed-depth training with the full cache.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 循环语言模型 (looped LM) 的循环状态越接近不动点，到达不动点的路径越不重要，因此训练、解码、prefill 和 RL 都可以截断。作者据此改进塑造不动点的两个组件：从预测反馈学得的深度先验（带熵项保持其宽泛）与正交注入 (orthogonal injection)，在 100M 到 1.6B 全尺度上相对 Huginn 先验和既有注入方案均降低 perplexity；1.6B 时学到的先验配 3x 更小 KV cache 即可匹配固定深度训练配全 cache 的下游平均。
Motivation: 循环语言模型每次循环都增加训练、解码、prefill 与 RL 成本；固定深度训练会破坏 KV 共享，而 Huginn 的宽深度先验虽支持共享却在目标深度稀释监督，既有注入方案又让状态沿输入方向的分量放大或抵消注入。
Method: 两个改进组件：一是从预测反馈学习深度先验并加熵项保持其宽泛，以在支持 KV 共享的同时不稀释目标深度监督；二是正交注入，去掉状态中沿输入方向的分量。配套机制包括训练中的截断反向传播、解码时的 terminal KV 共享、蒸馏 student，以及从保存的 rollout 状态计算梯度的 RL 更新。
Result: 蒸馏 student 的 prefill 最快 1.79x；RL 更新比对回放轨迹反向传播快 2x；学到的先验与正交注入在 100M 到 1.6B 各规模上相对 Huginn 先验与既有注入方案分别降低 perplexity；1.6B 时学到的先验配 3x 更小 KV cache 匹配固定深度训练配全 cache 的下游平均。
Conclusion: 既然循环状态接近不动点后路径不再重要，就应把容量花在塑造不动点的深度先验与输入注入上，从而在几乎不损失精度的前提下截断训练与解码的循环开销。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: UniSlider: Perceptually Uniform Sliders for Continuous Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Sliders provide an intuitive interface for continuous image editing. In current generative approaches, however, the slider is simply a rescaling of the method's strength parameter, such as an adapter coefficient, a prompt weight, or an interpolation factor. This strength relates poorly to perceptual change. The image can partially revert as the slider moves, long stretches of the range produce no visible difference, and short intervals transform the image abruptly. Remapping the strength could fix this uneven pace, but only if the trajectory is monotone, which current methods do not enforce. We therefore distinguish the slider from the strength, and require perceptual distance from the input to grow linearly with the slider value. We introduce UniSlider, a lightweight LoRA trained on a few-step editing backbone so that its strength approximates this ideal slider. Few-step sampling lets us impose this objective in pixel space without intermediate ground truth, and the backbone's output is preserved at full strength. However, a low-rank adapter cannot make the strength fully uniform. Our slider is thus an inference-time remapping of the strength, obtained by adaptive sampling. Since training optmizes to make the trajectory monotone, this remapping closes the remaining gap without extra training or parameters. On a new benchmark of 300 continuous edits evaluating uniformity, monotonicity, edit fidelity, and identity preservation, UniSlider outperforms all prior methods and is preferred in a user study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniSlider 把连续图像编辑的滑杆值与生成方法的 strength 参数解耦，要求相对输入的感知距离随滑杆值线性增长。它用在 few-step 编辑骨干上训练的轻量 LoRA 在像素空间直接优化该目标（无需中间 ground truth），再以推理期自适应采样对 strength 做重映射；在 300 条连续编辑的新基准上，均匀性、单调性、编辑保真度与身份保持全面超过既有方法，并在用户研究中更受偏好。
Motivation: 现有生成式编辑的滑杆只是 adapter 系数、prompt 权重或插值因子的重缩放，与感知变化脱节：图像会部分回退、长段区间无可见变化、短区间突变，且现有方法不保证 strength 轨迹单调，无法靠简单重映射修复。
Method: 区分 slider 与 strength，要求感知距离随 slider 线性增长；在 few-step 编辑骨干上训练轻量 LoRA，利用 few-step 采样在像素空间施加该目标且不需中间 ground truth，骨干输出在 full strength 处保持不变；再用 adaptive sampling 得到推理期 strength 重映射，补齐低秩 adapter 无法完全均匀的部分，不引入额外训练与参数。
Result: 在含 300 条连续编辑的新基准上，按 uniformity、monotonicity、edit fidelity、identity preservation 四项指标评估，UniSlider 超过全部既有方法，并在用户研究中更受偏好。
Conclusion: 把滑杆当作独立于 strength 的感知均匀量来优化，训练期保证轨迹单调后，推理期重映射即可闭合剩余差距，无需额外训练或参数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Memory has become integral to the LLM agent ecosystem, supporting information retention and reuse across interactions. However, most existing agent memory systems construct memory in a query-agnostic manner, which can incur unnecessary preprocessing cost and discard details that later prove essential. Recent studies have begun shifting memory processing toward runtime adaptation, but typically specialize in particular operations or fixed processing schemes, leaving flexible control over performance, cost, and latency largely underexplored. To address this challenge, we present \textbf{MemPilot}, a flexible framework that orchestrates on-demand memory curation under different performance--cost--latency preferences. Specifically, we optimize a multi-step LLM policy via reinforcement learning to iteratively choose between retrieving from query-agnostic memory and delegating query-specific curation of raw multimodal history to heterogeneous LLMs and VLMs. The policy jointly controls evidence amount, curation instructions, model selection, and visual access, enabling fine-grained allocation of runtime computation. To optimize this policy under competing objectives, we adapt objective-wise advantage decoupling by separately estimating each objective's advantage before aggregation. Moreover, we introduce prefix-based marginal utility estimation for fine-grained credit assignment across multi-step rollouts. Experiments on five multimodal agent-memory benchmarks demonstrate favorable performance--cost--latency trade-offs across optimization preferences, with preference sweeps yielding broader frontiers than existing trade-off-aware baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemPilot 用强化学习训练一个多步 LLM 策略，在运行时按需决定是查询无关记忆检索还是对原始多模态历史做查询相关整理，从而在性能、成本、延迟三者间灵活取舍。策略同时控制证据量、整理指令、模型选择与视觉访问，并用逐目标优势解耦与前缀边际效用估计优化竞争目标。在五个多模态 agent 记忆基准上，偏好扫描得到的权衡前沿比现有 trade-off-aware 基线更宽。
Motivation: 现有 agent 记忆系统多按查询无关方式预构建记忆，既带来不必要的预处理开销，又会丢弃事后关键的细节；近期运行时自适应方案又局限于特定操作或固定处理方案，性能-成本-延迟的灵活控制基本未被探索。
Method: 用强化学习优化一个多步 LLM 策略，迭代地在查询无关记忆检索与把原始多模态历史交给异构 LLM/VLM 做查询相关整理之间选择，同时控制证据量、整理指令、模型选择与视觉访问；优化上采用 objective-wise advantage decoupling（分别估计各目标优势再聚合），并提出 prefix-based marginal utility estimation 做多步 rollout 的细粒度 credit assignment。
Result: 在五个多模态 agent 记忆基准上，方法在不同优化偏好下给出有利的性能-成本-延迟权衡，偏好扫描 (preference sweeps) 产生的前沿比现有 trade-off-aware 基线更宽。
Conclusion: 把记忆整理做成运行时按需的多目标 RL 策略，可以在性能、成本与延迟之间提供比固定或 trade-off-aware 方案更宽的可调前沿。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CLIFT: Conformal Self-Verification for Web Agent Training and Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Open-source web agents are now strong enough to execute realistic browser tasks, but training them with reinforcement learning still depends on weak supervision: binary task success is too sparse for credit assignment, while frontier-language-model judges are too expensive to call at every step and cannot be assumed available at deployment. We introduce CLIFT, a training and test-time scaling method built around conformal self-verification. During training, the agent answers natural-language verification questions about its own rollouts; a Compositional Conformal Certifier keeps only question signals whose URL-conditional evidence agrees with a training-time judge, assigns signed trust weights through polarity-aware lift, and blends the resulting verifier score into per-step rewards in a way that never subtracts from the judge baseline. At test time, the same certified bank is frozen and reused as structured evidence for Conformal Trajectory Selection (CTS): the agent samples a greedy rollout and one or more diverse retries, the self-verifier summarises each URL trace, and a conservative majority-vote rule chooses whether to swap away from the current incumbent without calling any external judge. This single mechanism supports three settings. On WebArena Infinity, CLIFT achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source web agents. On VisualWebArena, a bank trained with the open model transfers to GPT-5.5 at test time and reaches state-of-the-art performance under the canonical harness. On Online Mind2Web, without training an agent on the benchmark, translating the certified question bank improves a live-web agent in zero-shot evaluation. Together these results position conformal self-verification as a way to turn costly judge feedback into a reusable training signal and a judge-free test-time scaling signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLIFT 用 conformal self-verification 把昂贵的 LLM judge 反馈转成可复用的训练信号与免 judge 的测试时扩展信号：训练时 agent 对自身 rollout 回答自然语言验证问题，Compositional Conformal Certifier 只保留 URL 条件证据与 judge 一致的问题信号，经 polarity-aware lift 赋予带符号信任权重并混入逐步奖励（不减损 judge 基线）；测试时冻结该认证题库，用 Conformal Trajectory Selection 以保守多数投票决定是否替换当前 incumbent。在 WebArena Infinity 上达到开源 web agent 的 SOTA，VisualWebArena 上题库从开源模型迁移到 GPT-5.5 也取得 canonical harness 下 SOTA，Online Mind2Web 上零样本翻译题库即可提升在线 web agent。
Motivation: 开源 web agent 已能执行真实浏览器任务，但 RL 训练监督太弱：二值任务成功信号对 credit assignment 过于稀疏，而前沿 LLM judge 每步调用太贵且部署时不可用。
Method: 训练阶段 agent 对自身 rollout 回答自然语言验证问题，Compositional Conformal Certifier 保留 URL 条件证据与训练期 judge 一致的信号，用 polarity-aware lift 赋予带符号信任权重，再把 verifier 分数混入逐步奖励且从不低于 judge 基线；测试阶段冻结认证题库，Conformal Trajectory Selection (CTS) 采样贪心 rollout 与多次多样化重试，self-verifier 总结各 URL 轨迹，保守多数投票决定是否换掉 incumbent，全程不调用外部 judge。
Result: WebArena Infinity 上取得开源 web agent 中的 state-of-the-art；VisualWebArena 上用开源模型训练的题库可迁移到 GPT-5.5，在 canonical harness 下达到 SOTA；Online Mind2Web 上不训练基准内 agent，仅翻译认证题库即在零样本评测中提升在线 web agent。
Conclusion: conformal self-verification 能把昂贵的 judge 反馈变成可复用的训练信号和免 judge 的测试时扩展信号，同一机制同时支撑训练、跨模型迁移与零样本三种设定。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PlotGround: Grounding Plot Digitization in Real Scientific Figures and Their Source Data
papers.abstract_en: Scientific figures often encode quantitative results that are not readily available in machine-readable form, making accurate plot digitization important for verifying and reusing published findings. Yet it remains unclear how accurately current models recover plotted values from real scientific figures, as existing benchmarks rely largely on synthetic charts or cover only a limited range of chart types. We introduce PlotGround, an automated pipeline for building plot digitization benchmarks from real scientific figures and their author-released source data. PlotGround maps figures to source tables, identifies reconstructable panels, and generates quantitative questions with source-grounded reference values. We use PlotGround to construct PlotGround-1k, a human-verified benchmark of 1,119 questions from 1,066 bioRxiv preprints. Across sixteen multimodal models, the best reaches 87.5% accuracy at a $\pm 5\%$ relative-error tolerance. Tightening the tolerance to $\pm 2\%$ lowers every model's accuracy by 11-24 percentage points, revealing a gap between approximate visual reading and precise quantitative recovery. PlotGround's paired figure-source structure lets us compare how accurately the same values are recovered from figures and from source tables. Providing source tables instead of figures raises a coding agent's accuracy from 90.0% to 97.4% while cutting cost by 72%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PlotGround 用真实科研图与其作者公开的源数据自动构建图表数字化基准：把图对齐到源表、筛出可重建面板、生成带源数据参考值的问题，得到 1,119 题、来自 1,066 篇 bioRxiv 预印本的 PlotGround-1k。16 个多模态模型中最好者在 ±5% 相对误差容忍度下达 87.5% 准确率，容忍度收紧到 ±2% 后所有模型准确率下降 11–24 个百分点；直接给源表而非图像可把 coding agent 准确率从 90.0% 提到 97.4% 且成本降 72%。
Motivation: 科研图中的定量结果多非机器可读，难以核验与复用；现有图表数字化基准多为合成图或覆盖图表类型有限，真实图上模型能恢复到什么精度尚不清楚。
Method: PlotGround 流水线将真实图映射到作者发布的源数据表，识别可重建的面板，再生成带源数据参考值的定量问答；据此构建经人工核验的 PlotGround-1k（1,119 题、1,066 篇 bioRxiv 预印本），并在 16 个多模态模型上评测，同时利用图-源配对结构对比同一数值从图与从源表恢复的精度。

papers.title: TasteVal: Measuring the Experimental Research Taste of AI Systems Against Human Experts
papers.abstract_en: We introduce TasteVal, a benchmark to evaluate the experimental research taste of frontier models. We define research taste as the ability to pick interesting problems to solve, design experiments, and interpret experimental results. TasteVal measures the experimental component of research taste; given a fixed research problem, we measure how well a model iteratively designs experiments and draws conclusions from their outcomes. We operationalize experimental research taste as compute efficiency; a Researcher who reaches the same score as an expert human using half the serial experimental compute has twice the experimental taste. Experimental taste thus acts as a multiplier on experimental compute, making it a key input to forecasts of AI progress. TasteVal consists of 8 novel, challenging, open-ended tasks representative of frontier AI R&D. To isolate taste from coding ability, the model under evaluation acts as a Researcher that iteratively designs experiments while a fixed Coder agent implements them and reports their results. The Researcher executes until either the 40 H100 hour or 120 wall-clock hour budgets are exhausted. We recruit 24 human experts, at least 2 per task, and take the best expert attempt per task as the expert baseline. We evaluate 20 models released between 2023 and 2026. The best-performing model, Opus 5.5, exceeds our expert baseline, with a compute multiplier of 2.3x (95% CI 1.15-4.37), at roughly 1/30 of our baseliners' average per-run cost. On TasteVal, the compute multiplier of frontier models has doubled approximately every 3.0 months since December 2025 (95% CI 1.7-5.0), up from every 14 months between 2023 and December 2025. Measured by final normalized performance, frontier models show no trend break, doubling every 14.6 months. To keep TasteVal uncontaminated, we do not release the tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TasteVal 是评测前沿模型「实验研究品味」的基准：固定研究问题后，让被评模型担任 Researcher 迭代设计实验，由固定 Coder 实现，把品味操作化为达到专家同等分数所需的串行实验算力倍数。Opus 5.5 超过 24 名人类专家基线，算力倍数 2.3x（95% CI 1.15–4.37），成本约为基线人均单次运行的 1/30；自 2025 年 12 月起该倍数约每 3.0 个月翻倍，而按最终归一化性能看仍是每 14.6 个月翻倍。
Motivation: 前沿 AI R&D 中，选题、实验设计与结果解读这类「品味」难以直接度量，却决定同等算力能换来多少进展；缺少基准把它与纯编码能力分开，并量化其对 AI 进展预测的意义。
Method: TasteVal 含 8 个新颖、开放式的前沿 AI R&D 任务；被评模型作为 Researcher 迭代设计实验，固定 Coder agent 负责实现并回报结果，以隔离编码能力。运行预算为 40 H100 小时或 120 墙钟小时，先耗尽者为止；招募 24 名人类专家（每任务至少 2 人），取每任务最佳专家尝试为基线，共评测 2023–2026 年发布的 20 个模型。
Result: 最佳模型 Opus 5.5 超过专家基线，算力倍数 2.3x（95% CI 1.15–4.37），约为基线人均单次运行成本的 1/30。TasteVal 上前沿模型的算力倍数自 2025 年 12 月起约每 3.0 个月翻倍（95% CI 1.7–5.0），此前 2023 年至 2025 年 12 月为每 14 个月；按最终归一化性能衡量则无趋势断点，仍为每 14.6 个月翻倍。
Conclusion: 实验品味可视为实验算力的乘数，且其增长速度远快于最终归一化性能，是 AI 进展预测的关键输入；为保持基准未受污染，任务不予公开。

papers.title: Deep Learning for Sleep Heart Rate Estimation from Accelerometers: Toward Population-Scale Cardiac Insight Without Optical Sensors
papers.abstract_en: Large longitudinal cohorts often contain wrist accelerometry without optical heart-rate sensing, motivating recovery of cardiac information from motion signals already collected during sleep. We present SeqSmoother, a transformer-based temporal corrector for sleep heart rate (HR) estimation from wrist accelerometry. SeqSmoother combines spectral descriptors with an intermediate Nightbeat-derived frequency anchor and a physics-motivated sub-harmonic feature designed to identify harmonic frequency lock-on. All inference-time features are derived from wrist accelerometry, while ECG is used only to construct reference HR labels and training-label quality weights. We evaluate SeqSmoother using 13 participant-disjoint held-out folds and compare it with the official Nightbeat implementation under a matched 60-s window and 15-s step protocol. Across all out-of-fold predictions, SeqSmoother achieved a participant-macro MAE of 1.60 bpm. On Nightbeat-retained matched intervals, Nightbeat achieved lower absolute error than SeqSmoother (0.615 versus 1.091 bpm), while SeqSmoother provided estimates over a larger portion of the eligible recording; Nightbeat produced final estimates for 72.85% of the SeqSmoother-eligible out-of-fold grid. Separately, the proposed sub-harmonic ratio achieved an AUROC of 0.972 for identifying reference-defined harmonic lock-on candidates. These findings reveal an accuracy-availability trade-off between learned temporal modeling and quality-gated signal processing while providing empirical support for a physics-informed approach to identifying frequency-tracking failures in accelerometer-based sleep HR estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SeqSmoother 用 transformer 时序校正器从腕部加速度计估计睡眠心率，推理只用运动信号，ECG 仅用于生成参考标签与训练标签质量权重。在 13 个受试者不重叠的留出折、60 秒窗/15 秒步协议下，participant-macro MAE 为 1.60 bpm；在 Nightbeat 保留的匹配区间上 Nightbeat 绝对误差更低（0.615 对 1.091 bpm），但其最终估计只覆盖 SeqSmoother 可用网格的 72.85%，呈现精度与可用性的权衡。
Motivation: 大型纵向队列常只有腕部加速度计而无光学心率传感，睡眠期间的运动信号中恢复心率可扩大人群规模心脏信息的覆盖，但需要在估计精度与可用时段之间取舍。
Method: SeqSmoother 是基于 transformer 的时序校正器，输入包含频谱描述子、来自 Nightbeat 的中间频率锚点，以及为识别谐波频率锁定 (harmonic frequency lock-on) 设计的物理动机次谐波特征；ECG 只用于构造参考心率标签与训练标签质量权重，推理时全部特征来自腕部加速度计。评测用 13 个受试者不重叠留出折，与官方 Nightbeat 实现在匹配的 60 秒窗、15 秒步协议下对比。
Result: 全部折外预测的 participant-macro MAE 为 1.60 bpm；在 Nightbeat 保留的匹配区间上 Nightbeat 绝对误差低于 SeqSmoother（0.615 对 1.091 bpm），但 Nightbeat 只对 SeqSmoother 可用折外网格的 72.85% 给出最终估计；所提次谐波比 (sub-harmonic ratio) 识别参考定义的谐波锁定候选的 AUROC 为 0.972。
Conclusion: 学习式时序建模与质量门控信号处理之间存在精度—可用性权衡，而物理信息的次谐波比可高精度识别加速度计睡眠心率估计中的频率跟踪失效。

papers.title: Private online learning and prediction for Littlestone classes
papers.abstract_en: We study mistake bounds for differentially private online learning and online prediction under oblivious realisable adversaries. Online learning requires the learner to release a hypothesis at each time step whereas in online prediction, the learner only needs to make predictions without releasing a hypothesis. Using a novel lower bound for private online learning and an upper bound for private prediction, we show that the sample complexity of these two problems are separated by a factor that grows with the time horizon for every class of finite Littlestone dimension $d$. First, we prove that every $\br{ε,δ}$-private online learner has a deterministic realisable stream of length $T$ on which the mistake bound is at least $\bE\bs{M_T}=\Om{\frac dε\log\br{ T}^{2/3}}$. In particular, this is the first non-trivial lower in the range $1/T<δ<1/\log T)$ left open in earlier works[SR22,DSS24,LWY24]. Second, we prove that for every class of of Littlestone dimension $d$, there exists an $(ε,δ)$-jointly private predictor with at most $2^{2^{cd^2}}ε^{-2}\log^2\br{2/\br{εδ}}$ expected mistakes, independently of $T$, for some absolute constant $c>0$. Thus, for every fixed class of finite Littlestone dimension when $δ=Θ\br{1/\log T}$, private learning requires $\Om{\br{\log T}^{2/3}}$ expected mistakes, whereas private prediction admits $\bigO{\br{\log\log T}^2}$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 oblivious realisable 对手下，差分隐私在线学习（每步须发布假设）与在线预测（只出预测）的样本复杂度随时间跨度 T 出现分离：有限 Littlestone 维数 d 的类上，私有学习的期望错误数为 Ω((d/ε)·log(T)^{2/3})，而联合私有预测至多 2^{2^{cd²}}ε^{-2}log²(2/(εδ))，与 T 无关。取 δ=Θ(1/log T) 时，私有学习需 Ω((log T)^{2/3}) 次期望错误，私有预测只需 O((log log T)²)。
Motivation: 先前工作 [SR22, DSS24, LWY24] 在 1/T<δ<1/log T 区间缺少非平凡的私有在线学习下界，且发布假设的在线学习与只做预测的在线预测是否在私有设定下同阶尚不清楚。
Method: 给出新的私有在线学习下界与私有预测上界：下界构造长度为 T 的确定性 realisable 序列，上界构造 (ε,δ)-联合私有预测器，均针对 Littlestone 维数为 d 的有限类，对手为 oblivious realisable。
Result: 每个 (ε,δ)-私有在线学习者在某条长度 T 的确定性 realisable 流上期望错误数 E[M_T]=Ω((d/ε)·log(T)^{2/3})，首次填补 1/T<δ<1/log T 区间的非平凡下界；对 Littlestone 维数 d 的类存在期望错误至多 2^{2^{cd²}}ε^{-2}log²(2/(εδ)) 的 (ε,δ)-联合私有预测器，与 T 无关；δ=Θ(1/log T) 时两者分别为 Ω((log T)^{2/3}) 与 O((log log T)²)。
Conclusion: 对固定有限 Littlestone 维数的类，差分隐私下在线学习与在线预测的样本复杂度被时间跨度 T 的因子分离，发布假设这一要求本身带来不可消除的代价。

papers.title: Paradee: Distilling Kokoro-82M into an 8M-Parameter Single-Voice Text-to-Speech Model
papers.abstract_en: We distill Kokoro-82M, a widely used open text-to-speech model with 54 voices, into Paradee, an 8.07M-parameter model that speaks one of them. Paradee keeps Kokoro's architecture with much narrower layers, and each of its two halves is trained separately against the frozen teacher. It has 10x fewer parameters and needs 15x less compute. We first synthesize a corpus with the teacher and keep its durations, pitch, energy and phoneme features. We then train a small text side to predict these values, and a small decoder to turn the teacher's saved values into the teacher's audio, first with spectral losses and then adversarially. Finally, we connect the two halves and quantize the weights to int8. It needs no alignment learning and no joint training, and it runs on one laptop. Stored in int8, Paradee is 8.5 MB, runs 25x faster than real time on one CPU thread, and scores 4.41 on UTMOS against the teacher's 4.52. The student initially kept a slight buzz, which we trace to the phase of voiced speech between 2 and 8 kHz. A phase-locking filter applied after synthesis removes most of it, with no training and no extra parameters. Code, model files and audio samples are at https://github.com/sahilmahendrakar/paradee
papers.comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Code: https://github.com/sahilmahendrakar/paradee. Model and audio samples: https://huggingface.co/sahilmahendrakar/Paradee-8M-v1.0
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 54 音色的开源 TTS 教师 Kokoro-82M 蒸馏成单音色 8.07M 参数模型 Paradee：保留原架构但收窄层宽，两半分别对冻结教师训练，最后拼接并 int8 量化。UTMOS 4.41 对教师 4.52，参数少 10 倍、算力少 15 倍，单 CPU 线程 25 倍实时，残留嗡声用合成后相位锁定滤波器去除。
Motivation: Kokoro-82M 虽开源但对单机部署仍偏重，且 54 个音色多数用不上；需要一个不依赖对齐学习与联合训练、能在笔记本上跑的轻量单音色替代。
Method: 沿用 Kokoro 架构但把层收窄；先用教师合成语料并保存时长、基频、能量与音素特征，再分别训练小型文本侧预测这些特征、小型解码器把特征还原为教师音频（先谱损失后对抗训练），最后拼接两半并把权重量化到 int8；嗡声修复用合成后的 phase-locking filter，不训练不加参数。

papers.title: TAPDreamer: Transferable Adversarial Patches for World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World models learn to predict how their environment will evolve, making them an important foundation for general-purpose robotic control. Yet world action models depend on camera inputs whose manipulation can corrupt the visual representations used across tasks and action policies. Existing attacks on these models optimize against the victim's actions or predicted futures and therefore require access to target-model outputs. In this paper, we propose an attack, TAPDreamer, against world action models that instead uses a public encoder alone to construct a fixed local perturbation that transfers across tasks and action architectures. TAPDreamer requires no target-policy queries. Our key insight is that interactions between patch-induced changes in attention weights and value vectors broadcast a nearly identical representation shift far beyond the patch footprint, and this shift remains stable across task observations. Guided by this insight, TAPDreamer uses six frames from one source task to maximize the global L1 distance between clean and patched encoder representations. In closed-loop evaluation, one frozen patch per benchmark, covering about 6.5% of the input, reduces FastWAM's success rate from 97.7% to 0.0% across 40 LIBERO tasks and from 90.8% to 0.0% across 50 RoboTwin tasks; matched random patches retain 81.5% and 79.2% success. The same patches reduce success to 2.1% and 0.8% on two DreamWAM configurations and to 10.0% on Motus. These results show that protecting downstream action generation alone is insufficient: defenses for world action models must also secure shared visual encoders against persistent local perturbations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TAPDreamer 是针对 world action model 的可迁移对抗贴片攻击：只用公开 encoder，从单一源任务的 6 帧图像最大化干净与贴片编码表征的全局 L1 距离，得到固定局部扰动，无需查询目标策略。覆盖输入约 6.5% 的单张贴片使 FastWAM 在 LIBERO 40 任务上的成功率从 97.7% 降到 0.0%，RoboTwin 50 任务从 90.8% 降到 0.0%。
Motivation: 现有对 world action model 的攻击需要访问目标模型输出或查询目标策略，跨任务与跨动作架构不可迁移；而相机输入被操纵会污染所有任务共享的视觉表征。
Method: 仅用公开 encoder 构造固定局部扰动：从一个源任务取 6 帧，最大化干净与贴片条件下 encoder 表征的全局 L1 距离；其机制是贴片引起的注意力权重与 value 向量交互，把几乎相同的表征偏移广播到贴片覆盖范围之外，且该偏移在不同任务观测间稳定。
Result: 每个 benchmark 用一张冻结贴片、覆盖约 6.5% 输入：FastWAM 成功率在 LIBERO 40 任务上 97.7% → 0.0%，RoboTwin 50 任务上 90.8% → 0.0%；匹配的随机贴片仍保留 81.5% 与 79.2%。同批贴片使两个 DreamWAM 配置降到 2.1% 与 0.8%，Motus 降到 10.0%。
Conclusion: 只保护下游动作生成不够：world action model 的防御必须同时保护共享视觉 encoder，使其抵抗持久的局部扰动。

papers.title: Less Context, Better Geometry: Masked Geometric Encoder for Robust 3D Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in 3D foundation models has enabled rapid 3D reconstruction and camera calibration by leveraging learned 3D priors from vast amount of spatial data. However, the all-to-all global attention design leads to quadratic complexity and limits long-sequence inference; unconstrained cross-view interactions also can propagate unreliable evidence from occluded or visually similar but geometrically distant views. In this paper, We introduce a Masked Geometric Encoder (MGE), which promotes the learning of robust geometric representations under incomplete cross-view context. During training, MGE strategically drops frame tokens from global attention and distills from a pretrained full-context teacher model. This allows the model to learn an intrinsically richer per-frame representation while providing sufficient intermediate supervision to avoid performance degradation. Through extensive experiments, we show that MGE leads to much stronger performance under occlusion and doppelganger views while retaining high performance on standard benchmarks. Such a richer frame representation also leads to more effective token reduction during inference. To this end, we develop a novel Anchor-Guided Adaptive token merging technique that preserves representative anchor frames while jointly merging redundant tokens from the remaining views. Compared to other efficient inference approaches, we can achieve inference speedup while consistently maintaining higher reconstruction quality, particularly in limited-view settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MGE 在训练时随机丢弃帧 token 并从全上下文预训练教师蒸馏，使模型在不完整跨视图上下文下学到更鲁棒的逐帧几何表示；配合 Anchor-Guided Adaptive token merging 保留锚定帧、合并冗余 token，在遮挡与 doppelganger 视图下性能显著更强，同时在标准基准保持高性能并获得推理加速，有限视图下重建质量优于其他高效推理方法。
Motivation: 3D foundation model 的全对全全局注意力是二次复杂度，限制长序列推理；不受约束的跨视图交互会把遮挡处或视觉相似但几何距离远的视图的不可靠证据传播开来。
Method: Masked Geometric Encoder (MGE)：训练时在全局注意力中策略性丢弃帧 token，并从预训练的全上下文教师模型蒸馏，配合中间监督避免性能退化；推理时用 Anchor-Guided Adaptive token merging，保留代表性锚定帧并合并其余视图的冗余 token。
Result: 在遮挡与 doppelganger 视图下性能明显更强，同时在标准基准保持高性能；更丰富的帧表示使推理期 token 削减更有效，相比其他高效推理方法获得推理加速且重建质量持续更高，有限视图 (limited-view) 设置下尤其明显。
Conclusion: 在不完整跨视图上下文下训练（掩码 + 教师蒸馏）能学到更鲁棒的逐帧几何表示，既提升遮挡鲁棒性，又让基于锚定帧的 token 合并在加速时少损失重建质量。

papers.title: Finding Gaussian Structure in Bosonic States
papers.abstract_en: We study agnostic tomography of pure bosonic Gaussian states: given copies of an arbitrary $n$-mode bosonic state $ρ$, the goal is to output a pure Gaussian state whose infidelity with $ρ$ is at most $\mathrm{opt} + ε$, where $\mathrm{opt}$ is the minimum infidelity achievable by any pure Gaussian state. We give efficient protocols achieving this in both the high and low fidelity regimes. When $\mathrm{opt}$ is below some universal constant, our protocol has runtime and copy complexity which is strongly polynomial in $n, 1/ε$ and $\log \log E$, where $E$ is the energy of the closest pure Gaussian state. For arbitrary $\mathrm{opt}$, our protocol uses $(n+1)^{\mathrm{poly}(1/ε)} \mathrm{poly}\left(1+\log\log(E)\right)$ copies and runtime. As a corollary, we obtain the first truly tolerant Gaussianity testing protocol for distinguishing whether $\mathrm{opt} > c + ε$ or $\mathrm{opt} < c - ε$, for any threshold $c\in(0,1)$. We also prove $\mathrm{poly}(n,1/ε)$ runtime is impossible, unless $\mathrm{NP}\subseteq\mathrm{BQP}$. Our protocols follow a shared paradigm: first, we iteratively use general Gaussian measurements combined with techniques from classical robust statistics to obtain a good warm start estimate, then we leverage non-Gaussian measurements to refine this warm start using convex and non-convex optimization methods. Interestingly, we prove that non-Gaussian measurements are necessary to match the strong agnostic guarantees we obtain, and in fact these guarantees are provably superior to what is possible for robustly estimating classical Gaussians.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出纯 bosonic Gaussian 态的 agnostic tomography 高效协议：对任意 n 模态 ρ 输出纯 Gaussian 态，其与 ρ 的 infidelity 不超过 opt+ε。高保真区（opt 低于某普适常数）运行时间与拷贝复杂度对 n、1/ε、log log E 强多项式；任意 opt 下为 (n+1)^{poly(1/ε)}·poly(1+log log E)。作为推论得到首个真正 tolerant 的 Gaussianity testing 协议，并证明非 Gaussian 测量是达成该 agnostic 保证的必要条件。
Motivation: 对任意未知 bosonic 态做 Gaussian 态层析需要在 opt 未知时仍给出 opt+ε 保证，而 robust Gaussian 态估计的经典方法无法达到同等强度的 agnostic 保证。
Method: 两阶段协议：先用一般 Gaussian 测量配合经典 robust statistics 迭代得到 warm start 估计，再用非 Gaussian 测量结合凸与非凸优化精化；并证明 poly(n,1/ε) 运行时间在 NP⊄BQP 下不可能。
Result: 高保真区（opt 低于普适常数）运行时间与拷贝复杂度对 n、1/ε、log log E 强多项式；任意 opt 下用 (n+1)^{poly(1/ε)}·poly(1+log log E) 次拷贝与运行时间；对任意阈值 c∈(0,1) 可区分 opt>c+ε 与 opt<c−ε；除非 NP⊆BQP 否则 poly(n,1/ε) 运行时间不可能。
Conclusion: 非 Gaussian 测量对达成这些强 agnostic 保证是必要的，且该保证可证明优于经典 robust Gaussian 估计所能达到的水平。

papers.title: Block Disentanglement in CRL: Bridging Identifiability and Visual State Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Causal representation learning (CRL) is the process of recovering causally-related latent variables from high-dimensional observations. As a label-free inference method, CRL is particularly attractive for applications where data labels are unavailable or impractical to obtain. While there has been significant progress in understanding the identifiability guarantees of CRL, such guarantees often hold under highly stylized assumptions, which temper the direct application to real-world problems. This paper has a two-fold objective for interventional CRL. First, it establishes identifiability guarantees for substantially weaker interventional assumptions, resulting in block disentanglement of the causal variables, where the block structure depends on the realistically available intervention mechanisms. Secondly, the block disentanglement framework is used for embodied visual state estimation, in which the objective is to recover the latent physical variables of a robotic system directly from visual data (images and videos) without labeled data. These two components are critically complementary. The block disentanglement theory delineates identifiability guarantees under weakened assumptions, and the application demonstrates that the resulting objective remains effective in a controlled embodied setting despite further assumption violations, providing a theory-to-practice bridge needed to translate the promise of label-free CRL into practical problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在干预式因果表示学习 (interventional CRL) 中，把可识别性条件放宽到更贴近现实的干预机制，得到按干预结构划分的块状解耦 (block disentanglement)，而非逐变量完全解耦；该框架随后用于从图像/视频中无标签恢复机器人系统的潜在物理状态，并在受控具身设定下验证其在进一步假设被违反时仍有效。
Motivation: CRL 的可识别性保证多建立在高度程式化的假设上，直接套用到真实问题会失效；需要在更弱的干预假设下给出保证，并证明其在实际视觉任务中仍可用。
Method: 两部分互补：一是在显著更弱的干预假设下建立可识别性保证，得到块结构取决于现实可得干预机制的块状解耦理论；二是把该框架用于具身视觉状态估计 (embodied visual state estimation)，直接从图像和视频中无标签推断机器人系统的潜在物理变量。
Result: 在受控具身设定中，块状解耦目标在进一步假设被违反的情况下仍保持有效，构成从理论到实践的桥接；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 放宽干预假设得到的块状解耦足以支撑无标签的视觉状态估计，说明弱假设下的 CRL 可识别性理论能迁移到实际问题。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: H-JEPA: End-to-End Learning of Hierarchical World Models for Visual Planning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon planning with latent world models requires reasoning across timescales and levels of abstraction. Existing task-agnostic JEPA world models predict and plan at a single timescale or with multiple horizons in one shared latent space. We introduce H-JEPA, an end-to-end recipe for training a hierarchy of action-conditioned JEPAs in which each level predicts farther ahead in its own learned latent space. Planning proceeds top-down: the top level optimizes progress toward the goal, and each level's predictions become subgoals for the planner below it. When factors in the data evolve at separated timescales, higher levels discard fast, unpredictable detail and retain slower task-relevant state. Across four simulated navigation and manipulation environments, hierarchical planning improves over a flat JEPA; on Visual AntMaze, a three-level hierarchy raises success from 18% to 73% using less planner compute. Ablations attribute these gains to both temporal decomposition and higher-level goal representations. With inverse-dynamics supervision, the approach extends to diverse real-robot videos from DROID, where hierarchy improves offline planning fidelity at lower planner compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: H-JEPA 把动作条件 JEPA 堆成层级，每层在自己的隐空间预测更远的未来，自顶向下规划：顶层朝目标优化，各层预测成为下层子目标。在 Visual AntMaze 上三层结构把成功率从 18% 提到 73%，且规划算力更少。
Motivation: 现有 JEPA 世界模型要么只在单一时间尺度上预测与规划，要么把多个 horizon 混在同一个共享隐空间里，难以跨时间尺度与抽象层级做长程视觉规划。
Method: 端到端训练一组层级化的动作条件 JEPA，每层在自身学习到的隐空间中预测更远未来；规划自顶向下进行，顶层优化朝目标的进展，每层预测作为下层规划器的子目标；数据中因子时间尺度分离时，高层丢弃快速不可预测细节、保留慢速任务相关状态；配合 inverse dynamics 监督迁移到真实机器人视频。
Result: 在四个模拟导航与操作环境中，层级规划优于 flat JEPA；Visual AntMaze 上三层层级把成功率从 18% 提升到 73%，且使用更少的 planner compute；消融把增益归因于时间分解与高层目标表征两部分；在 DROID 真实机器人视频上，层级以更低 planner compute 提升离线规划保真度。
Conclusion: 当数据因子处于分离时间尺度时，按层级分解时间与目标表征能显著提高长程视觉规划成功率并降低规划算力，且可经 inverse dynamics 监督扩展到真实机器人视频。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Sharpen Without Search: On-Policy Distillation of Sequence-Level Power Distribution
papers.abstract_en: A language model can give a correct answer more probability than any single incorrect answer and still usually sample an incorrect one, because the incorrect answers together hold more probability. The power distribution raises each complete answer's probability to a power above one and renormalizes, shifting probability toward answers the model finds most likely (sharpening). Sampling from it improves reasoning without changing parameters, but needs many scored candidates per query. We show that a model can instead be trained to produce such answers in one generation. On-policy power distillation (OPPD) runs a sequential Monte Carlo sampler in which the model being trained generates candidates and a frozen teacher's power distribution weights them; the same probabilities weight each answer in a maximum-likelihood update. Training raises single-generation accuracy by up to 23.0 points on MATH500 and 27.3 on GSM8K over the untrained model at the same temperature, and one generation scores 2.4 and 3.5 points above published power sampling with 64 candidates, recovering 94 percent of the gain that 16 candidates give the untrained model. For context, against GRPO trained with verified rewards from the same checkpoint and budget, OPPD scores 3.8, 4.0 and 5.4 points higher on MATH500, GSM8K and AIME using no reference answers; the two are complementary, and OPPD applied after GRPO adds up to 9.3 points. Trained only on mathematics, OPPD raises HumanEval accuracy by up to 5.3 points. One loss coefficient moves the sharpening exponent the model absorbs between 1.19 and 2.02, against 1.14 for ordinary on-policy distillation, and it rises mostly on the model's own answers. Gains hold across model families and sizes, including a model already trained with verified rewards, where lowering the temperature gives nothing and OPPD adds 4.4 points on MATH500. Code: https://github.com/ArminAzizi98/OPPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 on-policy power distillation (OPPD)：用 sequential Monte Carlo 采样器让被训模型自己生成候选、以冻结教师的 power distribution 权重做加权最大似然更新，把「多次采样再挑答案」压进单次生成。单次生成在 MATH500 上较同温度未训练模型最高提 23.0 点、GSM8K 提 27.3 点，并比已发表的 64 候选 power sampling 高 2.4 与 3.5 点。
Motivation: power distribution 取样能提升推理但每条查询需大量打分候选；而模型即使给正确答案的单点概率高于任一错误答案，错误答案合起来仍可能占更多概率，导致采样常出错。
Method: OPPD 运行 sequential Monte Carlo 采样器：被训模型生成候选，冻结教师的 power distribution 作为权重，同一组概率同时用于加权最大似然更新；一个损失系数控制模型吸收的 sharpening exponent。
Result: 单次生成较同温度未训练模型：MATH500 最高 +23.0 点、GSM8K +27.3 点；比 64 候选 power sampling 高 2.4 与 3.5 点，收回 16 候选所给增益的 94%。同 checkpoint 同预算的 GRPO（verified rewards）对比：MATH500/GSM8K/AIME 分别高 3.8、4.0、5.4 点且不用参考答案；GRPO 之后再做 OPPD 最多再加 9.3 点。仅在数学上训练，HumanEval 最高 +5.3 点；sharpening exponent 在 1.19–2.02 间可调（普通 on-policy distillation 为 1.14）。已用 verified rewards 训练的模型上降温无增益，OPPD 仍在 MATH500 加 4.4 点。
Conclusion: 把 power distribution 的锐化效果蒸馏进单次生成即可在不改参数采样开销下获得大部分收益，且与 GRPO 互补、可叠加。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: MC-Sparse: Deconstructing and Closing the Dense-Sparse Attention Gap in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Sparse attention is a primary approach to reducing the latency of diffusion transformers in long-sequence generation tasks, such as video and high-resolution 3D asset generation. However, existing methods can degrade generation quality and fidelity at high sparsity levels. Through controlled oracle comparisons, we trace this degradation to three sources: constraints imposed by token grouping, inaccurate interaction selection, and the attention contributions lost when tokens are discarded. Guided by this analysis, we propose Meta-Cached Sparse Attention (MC-Sparse), a training-free framework that selects individual key-value (KV) tokens while organizing similar queries into tile-aligned groups for efficient GPU execution. MC-Sparse caches metadata comprising query groups, KV indices selected using exact attention probabilities, and residuals between dense and sparse attention outputs, and reuses them across subsequent denoising steps. Across video and 3D generation models, MC-Sparse achieves higher fidelity to dense-attention outputs and larger denoising speedups than existing sparse-attention baselines, without visible quality degradation. Relative to dense attention, it delivers a $1.80\times$ denoising speedup on Minimax-H3-Base and a $2.32\times$ speedup on 3D asset generation, both with negligible quality loss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MC-Sparse 把扩散 Transformer 稀疏注意力在高稀疏度下的质量退化拆成三个来源：token 分组约束、交互选择不准、token 被丢弃后损失的注意力贡献，并用训练免费的元数据缓存逐一补齐。相对 dense attention，在 Minimax-H3-Base 上实现 1.80× 去噪加速、3D 资产生成上 2.32×，质量损失可忽略，且保真度与加速均超过现有稀疏注意力基线。
Motivation: 长序列生成（视频、高分辨率 3D）中稀疏注意力是降低扩散 Transformer 延迟的主要手段，但高稀疏度下生成质量与保真度明显退化，此前不清楚退化来自哪里。
Method: 先用受控 oracle 对比定位三类退化来源，再提出训练免费的 Meta-Cached Sparse Attention：逐个选择 KV token，同时把相似 query 组织成 tile 对齐分组以利 GPU 执行；缓存 query 分组、用精确注意力概率选出的 KV 索引，以及 dense 与 sparse 输出之间的残差，并在后续去噪步中复用。
Result: 相对 dense attention，MC-Sparse 在 Minimax-H3-Base 上达到 1.80× 去噪加速、在 3D 资产生成上 2.32×，两者质量损失均可忽略；在视频与 3D 生成模型上，对 dense 输出的保真度高于现有稀疏注意力基线，去噪加速更大，且无可视质量退化。
Conclusion: 高稀疏度下的质量退化可被分解为分组、选择、丢弃三类误差并分别补偿，因此稀疏注意力能在不牺牲可见质量的前提下换取更大去噪加速。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Response Theory Probe for Learned Stochastic AI Simulators, Tested on Lorenz-63
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning emulators of chaotic and stochastic systems are usually validated on forecast skill and long-run statistics. Neither certifies that an emulator responds correctly to forcing, the property that projection and attribution studies rely on. Linear response theory makes this testable: the forced response follows from unperturbed correlations through a generalized fluctuation-dissipation relation, and decomposes over the stochastic Ruelle-Pollicott resonances of the Koopman generator. Building on the Koopmanism Response framework, we turn this into a calibrated, mode-resolved test for learned surrogates: each surrogate rollout passes or fails each check, and failure rates are compared with those of independent realizations of the true system. On stochastic Lorenz-63, a three-variable toy model, we evaluate SINDy, an MLP, a reservoir computer, a neural ODE and a neural SDE with learned diffusion, over up to 80 rollouts each. A sparse-regression model with the correct library passes every check at rates consistent with the true system. Invariant-statistics fidelity and response fidelity dissociate in both directions: a quarter of reservoir-computer rollouts pass every invariant-statistics check and match the static susceptibility $χ(0)$, yet misrepresent the slow relaxation modes, while the neural ODE and SDE rarely meet the invariant-statistics floor but recover those modes in three quarters of rollouts. As expected of a time-integrated quantity dominated here by fast relaxation, $χ(0)$ does not separate these cases. For a fixed network, the training formulation (one-step drift, flow map, or multi-step through the integrator) decides which of these properties it gets right.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 workshop "AI for Stochastic Dynamics"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于线性响应理论 (linear response theory) 的探针，用广义涨落-耗散关系与随机 Ruelle-Pollicott 共振把学习型模拟器的受迫响应拆成逐模式检验，每个 rollout 独立判过/不过，并与真实系统的独立实现的失败率对照。在随机 Lorenz-63 上对 SINDy、MLP、reservoir computer、neural ODE、neural SDE 各跑至多 80 条 rollout：不变统计量保真与响应保真双向解耦——四分之一的 reservoir rollout 通过全部不变统计检验并匹配静态磁化率 χ(0)，却错报慢弛豫模式；neural ODE/SDE 很少达到不变统计下限，却在四分之三的 rollout 中恢复这些模式。
Motivation: 学习型混沌/随机模拟器通常只用预报技巧和长时统计量验证，这两者都无法判定模拟器对强迫的响应是否正确，而投影与归因研究正依赖这一性质。
Method: 在 Koopmanism Response 框架上，把受迫响应表示为由未扰动相关导出的广义涨落-耗散关系，并按 Koopman 生成元的随机 Ruelle-Pollicott 共振做模式分解；每个 surrogate rollout 逐项通过或失败，失败率与真实系统的独立实现比较。被测 surrogate 包括 SINDy、MLP、reservoir computer、neural ODE 与带学习扩散的 neural SDE，训练形式含一步 drift、flow map、经积分器的多步三种。
Result: 在三变量随机 Lorenz-63 上，每个 surrogate 至多 80 条 rollout；库正确的稀疏回归模型 (SINDy) 以与真实系统一致的比率通过全部检验。四分之一 reservoir rollout 通过全部不变统计检验并匹配 χ(0) 但错报慢弛豫模式；neural ODE 与 neural SDE 很少满足不变统计下限，却在四分之三 rollout 中恢复这些模式。χ(0) 作为由快弛豫主导的时间积分量无法区分这两类情形；对固定网络，训练形式决定它拿到哪种性质。
Conclusion: 不变统计保真与响应保真是可双向解耦的两种性质，单一指标（含 χ(0)）不足以认证模拟器的受迫响应，验证必须做逐模式的响应检验，且训练形式的选择会决定模拟器具备哪一种保真。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Round-Trip KNN Clustering: multiscale hierarchical cluster detection on directed nearest-neighbour graphs
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Round-Trip KNN Clustering (RTKNNC), a graph-based method for finding cluster structure at several neighbourhood scales without requiring the number of clusters in advance. Unlike approaches that first make a $k$-nearest-neighbour (KNN) graph undirected, RTKNNC keeps both directions of the neighbour relation: which points a given point selects and which points select it. Incoming selections are treated as weighted votes that help decide which local connections remain visible during a recursive forward-and-reverse traversal. Repeating the procedure for increasing $K$ reveals how groups persist or merge as the neighbourhood scale grows; for the reference inverse-square model before structural refinement, clusters can merge but do not split. Because graph connectivity can occasionally join distinct groups through a sparse bridge or a small region of overlap, we add an optional label-free refinement. It first tests whether an already formed component is better described by two or three Gaussian subpopulations, and accepts a subdivision only when the proposed groups are large enough and consistent with the visible KNN graph. Across eight synthetic datasets and $K=2,\ldots,16$, independent C and Python implementations produced identical partitions in all 120 reference runs. Refinement increased adjusted Rand index from $0.7817$ to $0.9627$ on a variable-density benchmark and from $0.8083$ to $0.9853$ on a sparse-bridge benchmark. Comparisons with seven external clustering methods show competitive performance while preserving a label-free cluster-construction process.
papers.comment: Submitted to Knowledge and Information Systems (KAIS). 32 pages, 6 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RTKNNC 在有向 KNN 图上保留「谁选我、我选谁」两个方向，把入度当作加权投票决定哪些局部连接在正反向递归遍历中存活，随 K 递增即可在不预设簇数的前提下得到多尺度层次簇结构。在 8 个合成数据集、K=2…16 的 120 次参考运行中 C 与 Python 实现给出完全一致的划分；可选的高斯子群细化使变密度基准 ARI 从 0.7817 升到 0.9627、稀疏桥基准从 0.8083 升到 0.9853。
Motivation: 常见做法先把 KNN 图无向化，丢掉了选择方向的信息；同时稀疏桥或小范围重叠会把本应分开的组连成一个连通分量，且多数方法需要事先指定簇数。
Method: 在有向 KNN 图上做正向与反向的递归遍历，入度选择作为加权投票决定保留哪些局部连接；对递增的 K=2…16 重复以观察簇随邻域尺度的保持与合并（参考 inverse-square 模型中簇只合不分）。再加一个无标签的可选细化：检验已成形分量是否更适合用两个或三个高斯子群描述，只有当新组足够大且与可见 KNN 图一致时才接受切分。
Result: 8 个合成数据集、K=2…16 下，独立的 C 与 Python 实现在全部 120 次参考运行中产生完全相同的划分。细化使变密度基准的 ARI 从 0.7817 提到 0.9627，稀疏桥基准从 0.8083 提到 0.9853；与 7 个外部聚类方法比较表现有竞争力，同时保持无标签的簇构建过程。
Conclusion: 保留有向 KNN 的双向信息并按 K 扫描，可以在不预设簇数的情况下得到多尺度层次簇；高斯子群细化专门用来切断稀疏桥造成的错误合并。

papers.title: Back to the Future: Rethinking EDA Infrastructure for Agentic Systems in Chip Design Verification
papers.abstract_en: The unprecedented computational scale of modern artificial intelligence depends on complex, multi-billion-transistor Systems-on-Chip, yet the workflows that verify these chips remain stubbornly manual. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have made rapid inroads into Electronic Design Automation (EDA), approximately 74.6% of existing studies target static Register-Transfer Level (RTL) code generation, leaving post-simulation verification and interactive waveform debugging largely untouched. We introduce Back-to-the-Future (BTTF), an end-to-end agentic framework that closes this infrastructural gap. BTTF distills massive, unstructured simulation dumps into a normalized relational SQLite database and couples it with a collaborative multi-agent orchestration engine that translates natural-language verification queries into schema-aware SQL while correlating signal anomalies with versioned RTL repositories. Across a 150-query benchmark, BTTF attains 95.33% execution accuracy, charting a practical path toward autonomous EDA verification.
papers.comment: 40th NeurIPS'26 Workshop AI for Chip Design
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 BTTF：把大规模仿真 dump 归一化进 SQLite 关系库，再用多智能体编排把自然语言验证查询翻译成 schema-aware SQL，并把信号异常与带版本的 RTL 仓库关联。在 150 条查询的 benchmark 上执行准确率达 95.33%，为 EDA 后仿真验证与波形调试给出可落地的自主化路径。
Motivation: 现代 AI 依赖数十亿晶体管 SoC，但芯片验证流程仍高度手工；已有 LLM+EDA 研究中约 74.6% 集中在静态 RTL 代码生成，后仿真验证与交互式波形调试基本空白。
Method: BTTF 是端到端 agentic 框架：先把非结构化仿真 dump 蒸馏为规范化 SQLite 关系数据库，再由协作式多智能体编排引擎把自然语言验证查询转成 schema-aware SQL，并将信号异常与版本化 RTL 仓库做关联。
Result: 在 150 条查询的 benchmark 上，BTTF 执行准确率 (execution accuracy) 达 95.33%；摘要另指出既有研究约 74.6% 面向静态 RTL 代码生成。
Conclusion: 把仿真数据关系化并交给多智能体做 schema-aware 查询，是通向自主 EDA 验证的一条可行路径。

papers.title: How to scale your HEP ML models: A recipe for robust architecture comparisons at scale
papers.abstract_en: Much of the recent progress in machine learning domains such as language models has come from scaling laws that predict performance as a function of training effort. In high-energy physics (HEP) similar behavior has now been observed. To aid further study, we present a systematic procedure to derive robust scaling laws and compare design choices on the relevant budget axes for HEP tasks. We first validate the full scaling trajectory on toy problems and then apply the procedure to multi-task transformers on the ~11 billion-jet ATLAS JetSet2 dataset, in both the compute- and data-constrained regimes. For the latter, we predict, to the best of our knowledge for the first time, the jointly optimal model size, training horizon, learning rate and batch size under early stopping. At compute-optimal scaling, we recover a near-equal $\sqrt{C}$ dependence of model and dataset size, and find that auxiliary objectives lower the primary jet-classification loss at equal compute budget. Expanding the inputs toward lower-level data systematically lowers the loss while leaving the scaling exponent nearly unchanged. The onset of the power-law regime is itself set by scale: below a threshold in dataset size the loss carries little information about high-compute scaling, underscoring the value of large, high-quality full-simulation datasets as a foundation for scaling studies and the development of foundation models in HEP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出一套在高能物理 (HEP) 任务上稳健推导 scaling law 并比较架构的系统流程：先在 toy 问题上验证完整 scaling 轨迹，再在约 110 亿 jet 的 ATLAS JetSet2 上对 multi-task transformer 分别在 compute-constrained 与 data-constrained 体制下应用。compute-optimal 下模型与数据规模呈近似相等的 √C 依赖；辅助目标在等算力预算下降低主 jet 分类损失，输入下探到更底层数据也系统性降损而 scaling 指数几乎不变；数据集规模低于某阈值时损失几乎不携带高算力外推信息。
Motivation: 语言模型的进展依赖可预测性能的 scaling law，HEP 中也观察到类似行为，但缺少在相关预算轴（算力、数据）上稳健推导 scaling 轨迹并公平比较架构设计的标准化流程。
Method: 先在 toy 问题上验证完整 scaling 轨迹的推导流程，再将其应用于 ATLAS JetSet2（约 110 亿 jet）上的 multi-task transformer，分别在 compute-constrained 与 data-constrained 两种预算体制下扫描；在 early stopping 下联合优化模型规模、训练时长、学习率与批大小，并比较辅助目标与不同层级输入等设计选择。
Result: 在 compute-optimal scaling 下恢复模型规模与数据集规模近似相等的 √C 依赖；等算力预算下辅助目标降低主 jet 分类损失；把输入扩展到更底层数据系统性降低损失而 scaling 指数几乎不变；数据集规模低于某一阈值时损失对高算力 scaling 几乎不提供信息。作者称在 data-constrained 体制下首次预测出 early stopping 下联合最优的模型规模、训练时长、学习率与批大小。
Conclusion: HEP 任务上可以按预算轴系统推导稳健 scaling 轨迹并据此比较架构；大规模、高质量 full-simulation 数据集是 HEP scaling 研究与基础模型开发的前提，数据量不足时小规模损失无法外推高算力表现。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: IdeaLens: Detecting AI Ideas in Long-form Writing
papers.abstract_en: While modern AI detectors identify who wrote the words, emerging policies on AI use increasingly hinge on a different question: who came up with the ideas? We introduce IdeaLens, a detector that identifies whether a document's ideas came from a human or AI (idea provenance), regardless of who wrote its words. To focus IdeaLens on ideas rather than prose, we represent documents as outlines: lists of items that each pair a discourse role with a brief, paraphrased description of the content, minimizing word-level overlap with the raw text. We train IdeaLens on 1M FineWeb documents with silver labels from Pangram, a prose provenance detector. Since the outlines are largely stripped of surface-level information, the labels must be fit mainly through the ideas. In a controlled study, IdeaLens's AI flag rate drops from 95% to 7% as models write from increasingly detailed human plans, while Pangram 4 still flags 92%; from AI-derived plans, IdeaLens stays above 96%. Conversely, on a new dataset of 50 stories that human authors wrote from AI-generated plans, IdeaLens flags 68% of the stories as AI, compared to 8% for Pangram 4. On a comprehensive suite of 19 existing detection benchmarks, we show that IdeaLens maintains strong detection rates at low false positive rates, suggesting that ideas themselves provide a powerful discriminative signal, and its performance holds across domains, formats, and languages. Finally, we examine 90K predictions from IdeaLens to characterize systematic differences between human and AI ideation. We release our models and labeled datasets to facilitate future research on idea provenance detection.
papers.comment: 53 pages (9 main), 7 figures, 50 tables. Code: https://github.com/RishanthRajendhran/IdeaLens Models and data: https://huggingface.co/collections/rishanthrajendhran/idealens-6abee785ce6196fc0be9200f Demo: http://ideadetector.ai/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IdeaLens 检测的是文档想法 (idea provenance) 来自人还是 AI，而非文字由谁写：把文档表示为「话语角色 + 改写内容描述」的提纲，用 Pangram 给出的银标签在 1M FineWeb 文档上训练，使标签只能靠想法本身拟合。在受控研究中，当模型依据越来越详细的人类计划写作时，IdeaLens 的 AI 标记率从 95% 降到 7%，而 Pangram 4 仍标 92%；在 50 篇人类依据 AI 计划写的故事上 IdeaLens 标 68%，Pangram 4 仅 8%。
Motivation: 现有 AI 检测器只能判断文字由谁写，而关于 AI 使用的政策越来越取决于想法由谁提出；同时若检测信号停留在表层措辞，就无法区分「人写人想」与「人按 AI 计划写」。
Method: 将文档表示为提纲 (outlines)：每项把一个话语角色与一段简短改写的内容描述配对，尽量消除与原文的词面重叠；用 prose provenance 检测器 Pangram 产生银标签，在 1M FineWeb 文档上训练 IdeaLens，并在 19 个既有检测基准上做跨领域、跨格式、跨语言评测，另分析 90K 条预测。
Result: 受控研究中，模型依据愈发详细的人类计划写作时 IdeaLens 的 AI 标记率由 95% 降至 7%，Pangram 4 仍为 92%；依据 AI 生成的计划时 IdeaLens 保持在 96% 以上。50 篇人类依据 AI 计划所写故事上 IdeaLens 标记 68%，Pangram 4 为 8%。在 19 个既有检测基准上，IdeaLens 在低误报率下保持强检测率，且表现跨领域、格式与语言成立；另考察了 90K 条预测以刻画人与 AI 构思的系统差异。
Conclusion: 想法本身即可作为判别信号：剥离表层措辞后仍能区分想法来源，且对「人按 AI 计划写作」这类文字与想法来源错位的情形比 prose 检测器敏感得多。

papers.title: On Learning Optimal Corners in Orthogonal Partially Observable Cooperative Guard Art Galleries
papers.abstract_en: The CADENCE algorithm solves the Partially Observable Cooperative Guard Art Gallery Problem (POCGAGP) with formal coverage and connectivity guarantees, but leaves unspecified which valid corner each agent should be deployed to, a choice that strongly affects efficiency. We introduce two learned corner-selection heuristics that preserve these guarantees: a CNN scoring candidates on a grid encoding, and a GATv2 network trained with Deep Q-Learning (DQN) on a visibility graph. Across 7,500 runs on random orthogonal environments (50x50 to 250x250), our heuristics outperform baseline CADENCE in both steps to full coverage and peak agent count, with gains growing with scale, and improve on Incremental Self-Deployment (ISDA) baselines in agent utilization while providing guarantees ISDA lacks. Learned corner selection thus improves CADENCE in speed and agent utilization at no cost to its formal properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在部分可观测协作守卫画廊问题 (POCGAGP) 中，CADENCE 算法虽有覆盖与连通的形式化保证，却未指定各 agent 应部署到哪个有效角落。作者提出两种保留该保证的可学习角落选择启发式：在网格编码上打分的 CNN，以及在可见性图上用 DQN 训练的 GATv2；在 7,500 次随机正交环境运行（50x50 至 250x250）中，两者在到达全覆盖的步数与峰值 agent 数上均优于 CADENCE 基线，且增益随规模扩大。
Motivation: CADENCE 给出覆盖与连通的形式化保证，但对每个 agent 部署到哪个有效角落保持沉默，而这一选择强烈影响效率；ISDA 基线则缺少这类保证。
Method: 两种学习式角落选择启发式：CNN 在网格编码 (grid encoding)上对候选角落打分；GATv2 网络在可见性图 (visibility graph)上用 Deep Q-Learning (DQN) 训练。二者均设计为保留 CADENCE 的覆盖与连通保证。
Result: 在 7,500 次随机正交环境运行（50x50 到 250x250）中，两种启发式在到达全覆盖的步数 (steps to full coverage)与峰值 agent 数 (peak agent count)上均优于 CADENCE 基线，且增益随规模增长；在 agent 利用率 (agent utilization)上优于 Incremental Self-Deployment (ISDA) 基线，同时提供 ISDA 缺失的保证。
Conclusion: 学习式角落选择在不牺牲 CADENCE 形式化性质的前提下，同时提升其速度与 agent 利用率。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 在部分可观测协作守卫画廊问题 (POCGAGP) 中，CADENCE 算法虽有覆盖与连通的形式化保证，却未指定各 agent 应部署到哪个有效角落。作者提出两种保留该保证的可学习角落选择启发式：在网格编码上打分的 CNN，以及在可见性图上用 DQN 训练的 GATv2；在 7,500 次随机正交环境运行（50x50 至 250x250）中，两者在到达全覆盖的步数与峰值 agent 数上均优于 CADENCE 基线，且增益随规模扩大。
summary_sections.motivation: CADENCE 给出覆盖与连通的形式化保证，但对每个 agent 部署到哪个有效角落保持沉默，而这一选择强烈影响效率；ISDA 基线则缺少这类保证。
summary_sections.method: 两种学习式角落选择启发式：CNN 在网格编码 (grid encoding)上对候选角落打分；GATv2 网络在可见性图 (visibility graph)上用 Deep Q-Learning (DQN) 训练。二者均设计为保留 CADENCE 的覆盖与连通保证。

summary_sections.conclusion: 学习式角落选择在不牺牲 CADENCE 形式化性质的前提下，同时提升其速度与 agent 利用率。

papers.title: Singular parameters and missing limits in neural PDE solvers
papers.abstract_en: Neural solvers for partial differential equations (PDEs) can approach an accurate solution while their parameters grow without bound. In such cases, the limiting solution may have no finite representation in the chosen model, leaving the best loss unattained. Our analysis connects missing limits in deep neural tanh- networks to unbounded hidden parameters or increasingly redundant neurons. For a class of models built from translated kernels, we describe the missing functions and recover them by adding kernel derivatives to the model. This completion makes the best approximation attainable under standard assumptions. Numerical studies follow the associated parameter growth and explore how completion affects PDE optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 神经 PDE 求解器可以在损失逼近最优的同时让参数无界增长，导致极限解在所选模型中没有有限表示、最优损失不可达。分析把 tanh 网络的缺失极限归因于无界隐藏参数或日益冗余的神经元；对由平移核构成的一类模型，通过把核导数加入模型来补全，使最优逼近在标准假设下变为可达。
Motivation: 神经 PDE 求解器逼近精确解时参数可能无界增长，使极限解在所选模型中无有限表示，最优损失因此不可达。
Method: 对深 tanh 网络建立缺失极限与无界隐藏参数、冗余神经元的联系；对由平移核 (translated kernels) 构造的一类模型刻画缺失函数，并把核导数加入模型完成补全 (completion)，再在标准逼近假设下讨论最优逼近的可达性。
Result: 数值研究追踪补全前后 PDE 优化中的参数增长，并考察补全如何影响 PDE 优化过程。
Conclusion: 缺失极限源于参数无界或神经元冗余，把核导数纳入模型可使最优逼近在标准假设下可达。

papers.title: Conditional Rank Allocation for Taxonomy-Aware Medical Language Model Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Medical question answering spans specialties and clinical operations that may benefit from different adaptation directions. We propose ARBOR, a parameter-efficient method that selects rank-one components from a shared low-rank basis for each question. An additive gate combines question representations, specialty tags, operation tags, and their interaction; a learned coefficient scales the adapter residual. An illustrative separation under orthogonal, equiprobable subtasks shows how conditional selection can avoid an approximation floor faced by a fixed update with the same active rank. This result motivates the design without asserting a corresponding bound for medical corpora. On Qwen3-8B across CMB, CMExam, MedQA, and MedMCQA, five-seed experiments yield 69.69% mean accuracy across benchmarks, exceeding LoRA r16 and MoELoRA by 1.26 and 1.30 percentage points, respectively. The reported advantage over LoRA r16 increases from 0.08 to 1.94 points as training expands from one to seven specialties. Tag perturbations and atom masking support the usefulness of clinical routing, while atom clusters align with the supplied specialty labels (adjusted Rand index 0.62). Calibration, transfer, and measured costs further characterize the method. These findings support structured conditional adaptation for medical QA, while leaving clinical safety and broader deployment untested.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARBOR 为医学问答提出参数高效适配方法：从共享低秩基中按问题选择 rank-one 分量，用加性门控融合问题表征、专科标签与操作标签及其交互，并用可学习系数缩放 adapter 残差。在 Qwen3-8B 上跨 CMB、CMExam、MedQA、MedMCQA 五种子实验平均准确率 69.69%，超 LoRA r16 与 MoELoRA 分别 1.26 与 1.30 个百分点。
Motivation: 医学问答横跨不同专科与临床操作，各自可能受益于不同的适配方向，而固定秩的统一更新无法按问题区分这些方向。
Method: ARBOR 从共享低秩基中按问题选择 rank-one 分量；加性门控融合问题表征、专科标签、操作标签及三者交互，可学习系数缩放 adapter 残差。在 Qwen3-8B 上做五种子实验，并给出正交等概率子任务下条件选择避开固定更新近似下界的示意性分析（该结论不外推到医学语料）。
Result: Qwen3-8B 上跨 CMB、CMExam、MedQA、MedMCQA 五种子平均准确率 69.69%，超 LoRA r16 1.26 个百分点、超 MoELoRA 1.30 个百分点；相对 LoRA r16 的优势随训练专科数从 1 扩到 7 由 0.08 增至 1.94 个百分点。标签扰动与 atom masking 支持临床路由有用，atom 聚类与给定专科标签的 adjusted Rand index 为 0.62。
Conclusion: 结构化条件适配（按问题路由 rank-one 原子）对医学 QA 有效，且专科越多优势越大；临床安全性与更广部署尚未检验。
