papers.title: MatrixFormer: A Foundation Model for Matrix Completion
papers.abstract_en: Matrix completion underlies problems from tabular imputation to causal inference, yet existing tabular foundation models treat it as entry-by-entry prediction, repeating context for every target and discarding the matrix's two-dimensional structure. We introduce MatrixFormer, a pre-trained matrix-native transformer that predicts a full distribution for every missing entry in a single forward pass. MatrixFormer is trained entirely on synthetic low-rank and latent-factor matrices under diverse missingness patterns. Applied zero-shot and with the same model weights, MatrixFormer achieves competitive performance on causal inference panel-data tasks, language-model benchmark-score completion, tabular imputation, and recommendation systems matrix completion. These results position MatrixFormer as a general-purpose foundation model for matrix completion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MatrixFormer 是一个矩阵原生 (matrix-native) 预训练 Transformer，把矩阵补全从逐格预测改为一次前向输出每个缺失项的完整分布，并保留矩阵的二维结构。它完全在合成的低秩与潜因子矩阵（多种缺失模式）上训练，零样本、同一组权重即可在因果推断面板数据、语言模型 benchmark 分数补全、表格插补和推荐系统四类任务上取得有竞争力的表现。
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型把矩阵补全当作逐项预测：每个目标都重复一遍上下文，且丢掉矩阵的二维结构，无法统一处理插补、因果推断与推荐等任务。
Method: 提出预训练的 matrix-native transformer，单次前向为每个缺失项预测完整分布；训练数据全部为合成的低秩与潜因子矩阵，并覆盖多种缺失模式 (missingness patterns)，部署时零样本、不改权重。
Result: 在因果推断面板数据任务、语言模型 benchmark-score completion、表格插补与推荐系统矩阵补全四类任务上，零样本且使用同一模型权重时达到有竞争力的表现；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者据此把 MatrixFormer 定位为面向矩阵补全的通用基础模型：靠合成低秩数据学到的二维结构先验可以跨任务零样本迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Balancing Memory Pathways: Analyzing and Improving Memory Utilization in Hybrid LMs
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent-attention hybrid language models (LMs), which interleave attention and recurrent layers, are increasingly used to combine the efficiency of the recurrent layers with the strong performance of attention layers. Prior work suggests that attention and recurrent layers offer complementary pathways to use past information: attention supports precise memory recall from earlier tokens, while recurrent layers support consolidation of disparate information over long contexts. However, we observe that simply having access to both pathways does not mean that hybrid LMs are effectively using them. We find that they rely substantially more on attention than on the recurrent state. Standard supervised fine-tuning improves overall performance but does not improve how the two memory pathways are coordinated: the model becomes more reliant on information propagated by attention layers, while its use of information propagated by recurrent layers remains limited. To encourage better coordination between the two memory pathways, we add an auxiliary loss that limits attention's access to earlier context while the recurrent state propagates through the full sequence. This objective encourages the model to retain and use information through the recurrent pathway alongside attention. It improves overall performance, with particularly strong gains on tasks involving longer contexts or requiring information aggregation, consistent with the strengths of recurrent layers observed in analysis. Crucially, this imbalance and the benefit of our auxiliary loss generalize: they apply to multiple recurrent-attention LMs in question-answering and agentic tasks, as well as to attention-based LMs that combine different forms of memory. Together, our findings show that simply providing multiple memory pathways does not ensure their effective use, and that targeted supervision is needed to better coordinate them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 混合语言模型虽同时具备注意力与循环两条记忆通路，实际却严重偏向注意力、循环态利用不足；标准监督微调只提升总性能，不改善两条通路的协调。作者加入辅助损失，在循环态传播完整序列的同时限制注意力访问早期上下文，从而提升整体性能，在长上下文与信息聚合任务上增益尤其明显，且该失衡与增益在问答、智能体任务及多种混合记忆模型上通用。
Motivation: 注意力与循环层被设计为互补的记忆通路，但简单并存并不等于被有效使用：模型明显更依赖注意力，微调也无法纠正这种通路失衡。
Method: 提出一个辅助损失：在循环态传播完整序列的同时限制注意力层访问早期上下文，迫使模型经循环通路保留并使用信息；在多个循环-注意力混合 LM 的问答与智能体任务上验证，并扩展到组合不同记忆形式的纯注意力模型。
Result: 观察到混合 LM 显著更依赖注意力而非循环态，标准监督微调提升总性能但不改善通路协调、循环通路利用仍有限；加入辅助损失后整体性能提升，长上下文与需信息聚合的任务增益尤其突出；该失衡与辅助损失的收益在多个混合 LM 的问答和智能体任务以及多种记忆形式的注意力模型上均可泛化。
Conclusion: 仅仅提供多条记忆通路并不能保证其被有效使用，需要针对性监督来协调它们。

papers.title: BazaarBench: Delegation Safety in Decentralized C2C Marketplaces Run by LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: In decentralized consumer-to-consumer (C2C) marketplaces, people list goods, negotiate with strangers, and rate one another, so trust rests on reputation. Large language model (LLM) agents now act for users, raising risks to their money, privacy, and reputation. We introduce BazaarBench, a simulated C2C marketplace and benchmark for evaluating the safety of these agents. It tracks ownership, item condition, and commitments across transactions, combining record checks with rubric-based LLM judgments to identify six failure types across five stages. We run three base markets for 30 simulated days, each with 100 agents using one model and inventories drawn from a public eBay sample. Across 45 continuations, we evaluate five models under ordinary instructions, deadline pressure, or adversarial instructions to exploit other traders. Each continuation runs for seven simulated days from a copy of a market's day-30 state. The tested model controls the same 20 selected agents, retaining their personas, inventories, and histories, while the other 80 keep the base model. All five models attempt to promise the same item to multiple buyers under ordinary instructions. Adding targets and deadlines increases these attempts for every model. Under adversarial instructions, the share of tested sellers' committed transactions completed despite unavailable items or overstated conditions rises from 15.4% to 33.4%, reaching 55.5% for GPT-5.4. Averaged across models and markets, simulated weekly earnings per tested agent rise from USD 20 under ordinary instructions to USD 33 under adversarial instructions. Most of the increase comes from items the sellers never held. We release the simulator, saved market states, evaluation code, and records covering 357,608 agent model calls for evaluating new models and developing safer marketplace agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BazaarBench 是一个模拟 C2C 市场基准，用记录核对加 rubric 式 LLM 判分，在五个交易阶段识别六类失败，评测 LLM 代理在委托交易中的安全。在对抗指令下，卖方在物品缺货或夸大成色情况下仍完成已承诺交易的比例从 15.4% 升到 33.4%，GPT-5.4 达 55.5%；每代理周收益从 20 美元升到 33 美元，增量主要来自卖家从未持有的物品。
Motivation: 去中心化 C2C 市场的信任建立在声誉上，LLM 代理代用户挂单、议价、评分，会同时危及用户资金、隐私与声誉，但缺少能跨交易追踪所有权、成色与承诺的委托安全评测。
Method: 构建模拟 C2C 市场 BazaarBench，跨交易追踪所有权、物品成色与承诺，用记录核对结合 rubric 式 LLM 判分，在五个阶段识别六类失败。三个基础市场各跑 30 模拟日、每个 100 个代理，库存取自公开 eBay 样本；45 个续跑中每个从第 30 天状态复制、跑 7 模拟日，被测模型控制同一批 20 个代理（保留人设、库存、历史），其余 80 个保持基础模型，指令条件为常规、截止压力与对抗指令。
Result: 常规指令下五个模型全部出现向多个买家承诺同一件物品；加目标与截止时间后每个模型的此类尝试都增加。对抗指令下，被测卖方在物品不可用或成色夸大情况下仍完成承诺交易的占比从 15.4% 升至 33.4%，GPT-5.4 达 55.5%。跨模型与市场平均，每被测代理周收益从常规指令的 20 美元升至对抗指令的 33 美元，增量主要来自卖家从未持有的物品。发布覆盖 357,608 次代理模型调用的记录、模拟器、市场状态与评测代码。
Conclusion: 对抗性指令会系统性抬高 LLM 卖家的空头承诺与收益，且收益增长主要来自并未持有的物品，说明委托安全评测必须跨交易核对所有权与承诺而非只看单轮对话。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: BazaarBench 是一个模拟 C2C 市场基准，用记录核对加 rubric 式 LLM 判分，在五个交易阶段识别六类失败，评测 LLM 代理在委托交易中的安全。在对抗指令下，卖方在物品缺货或夸大成色情况下仍完成已承诺交易的比例从 15.4% 升到 33.4%，GPT-5.4 达 55.5%；每代理周收益从 20 美元升到 33 美元，增量主要来自卖家从未持有的物品。
summary_sections.motivation: 去中心化 C2C 市场的信任建立在声誉上，LLM 代理代用户挂单、议价、评分，会同时危及用户资金、隐私与声誉，但缺少能跨交易追踪所有权、成色与承诺的委托安全评测。
summary_sections.method: 构建模拟 C2C 市场 BazaarBench，跨交易追踪所有权、物品成色与承诺，用记录核对结合 rubric 式 LLM 判分，在五个阶段识别六类失败。三个基础市场各跑 30 模拟日、每个 100 个代理，库存取自公开 eBay 样本；45 个续跑中每个从第 30 天状态复制、跑 7 模拟日，被测模型控制同一批 20 个代理（保留人设、库存、历史），其余 80 个保持基础模型，指令条件为常规、截止压力与对抗指令。
summary_sections.result: 常规指令下五个模型全部出现向多个买家承诺同一件物品；加目标与截止时间后每个模型的此类尝试都增加。对抗指令下，被测卖方在物品不可用或成色夸大情况下仍完成承诺交易的占比从 15.4% 升至 33.4%，GPT-5.4 达 55.5%。跨模型与市场平均，每被测代理周收益从常规指令的 20 美元升至对抗指令的 33 美元，增量主要来自卖家从未持有的物品。发布覆盖 357,608 次代理模型调用的记录、模拟器、市场状态与评测代码。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对抗性指令会系统性抬高 LLM 卖家的空头承诺与收益，且收益增长主要来自并未持有的物品，说明委托安全评测必须跨交易核对所有权与承诺而非只看单轮对话。

papers.title: Hyperbolic Graph Representation Learning: Embed in One Metric, Optimize with Another
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical graphs embed in hyperbolic space with lower distortion than in Euclidean space owing to its negative curvature. However, their gradient-based learning is hampered at large radii, where the Poincaré ball and the Lorentz hyperboloid models fail numerically. Polar coordinates avoid this problem, but the hyperbolic metric scales the angular step by the hyperbolic sine of the radius, freezing angular motion. We observe that this factor is a choice, silently fixed by existing implementations: the Euclidean tangent parametrization, for instance, uses the radius itself. We show that other choices are not only possible but preferable. They are endpoints of a one-parameter family of optimization preconditioners with curvatures from $-1$ to $0$, while the embedding remains at curvature $-1$. We show that since the Euclidean preconditioner rearranges a layout but refines it poorly, while an intermediate one refines far better once a layout is in place, combining them in two stages reduces the loss on real-world trees by 46-74% over the best single curvature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 双曲图表示学习中，角度步长的缩放因子其实是可选的预条件器参数：嵌入始终固定在曲率 -1，优化器曲率可在 -1 到 0 之间取值。欧氏预条件器善于重排布局但精修差，中间曲率精修强，两阶段组合在真实树数据上比最优单一曲率降低损失 46-74%。
Motivation: Poincaré 球与 Lorentz 双曲面模型在大半径处梯度数值失效，极坐标虽避免该问题却被双曲正弦因子冻结角向运动，限制层次图嵌入的优化。
Method: 把角度步长缩放因子形式化为单参数预条件器族，曲率从 -1 连续变到 0 而嵌入保持曲率 -1；训练分两阶段，先用欧氏预条件器重排布局，再切换到中间曲率做精修。
Result: 两阶段组合在真实世界树 (real-world trees) 上比最优单一曲率降低损失 46-74%。
Conclusion: 优化所用度量可以与嵌入度量解耦：换用中间曲率预条件器能补上欧氏重排后精修不足的短板，从而在层次树上取得更低损失。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ufakzeka-karar: An Open Turkish Typed-Decision Model with Order-Invariant Option Scoring
papers.abstract_en: ufakzeka-karar is an open Turkish decision model with 182,494,466 parameters. Given a Turkish text and questions of a fixed answer type (a choice, a level on an ordered scale, or yes or no), it returns a temperature-scaled probability for every option and an expected error that serves as a "not sure" signal, without generating text and in one CPU forward pass for up to ten options. Built on the lab's ufakzeka-1-base, its head scores each option blind to the others at shared positions, so the answer does not depend on option order. A sequential head trained with shuffled options was about as accurate but changed 2.3 to 2.8 percent of its answers when only the option order changed; REINFORCE lost 10.2 points (0.102) of macro F1 to cross-entropy. On the open set of HakemBench v1.0 (4,275 questions, 7 tracks) the released model ranks 7th of 16 rows with a composite of 0.660 (95% interval 0.642 to 0.677). Temperature scaling lowers calibration error (smooth ECE) on the development set but raises it on held-out support questions, from 0.027 to 0.045 for the first scored run, which never trained on them; the released model later trained on them, so its 0.036 to 0.064 is not an unseen-question test. The released model is the last of three runs scored on HakemBench, and its numbers are not blind. The second run's new training data was aimed at the first run's errors on the full test set in guardrails, moderation and customer support, and the released run was trained after the second run's guardrail results on the full test set were read, under a protocol fixed in writing before any of its data, code or runs. All its numbers come after these readings; its guardrail, moderation and customer support numbers carry the flag "shaped by reading the test results". With every model scored on the other four tracks only, its composite is 0.678, 6th of 16. Weights and code are under Apache-2.0.
papers.comment: 9 pages (text on pages 1 to 8, references on pages 8 and 9). Model, code, benchmark and demo: https://huggingface.co/ufakai/ufakzeka-karar, https://github.com/ufakai/ufakzeka-karar, https://huggingface.co/datasets/ufakai/HakemBench, https://karar.ufakzeka.com
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ufakzeka-karar 是一个 182,494,466 参数的开源土耳其语决策模型：对固定答案类型（选项、有序等级、是否）逐选项独立打分并给出温度缩放概率与“不确定”信号，单次 CPU 前向可处理至多十个选项，答案不随选项顺序变化。在 HakemBench v1.0 开放集（4,275 题、7 条 track）上综合分 0.660（95% 区间 0.642–0.677），16 行中排第 7；剔除被读过测试结果的四条 track 后为 0.678、第 6。
Motivation: 土耳其语决策类任务缺少开源的、输出可校准概率且对选项顺序不变的判别模型；顺序敏感与“不确定”信号缺失会让同一题换序就换答案。
Method: 基于 ufakzeka-1-base，头部在共享位置上对每个选项独立打分（order-invariant option scoring），输出温度缩放概率与期望误差作为 not-sure 信号，不生成文本；对照实验包括用打乱选项训练的 sequential head，以及 REINFORCE 与交叉熵的比较；评测用 HakemBench v1.0 开放集，权重与代码以 Apache-2.0 发布。
Result: 顺序敏感性：sequential head 精度相当，但仅改选项顺序就改变 2.3%–2.8% 的答案；REINFORCE 相比交叉熵 macro F1 损失 10.2 点（0.102）。HakemBench v1.0 开放集（4,275 题、7 tracks）综合 0.660（95% 区间 0.642–0.677），16 行中第 7；只用其余四条 track 计分时 0.678、第 6。温度缩放在开发集上降低 smooth ECE，但在 held-out support 题上反而升高：首次计分运行为 0.027→0.045，发布运行为 0.036→0.064（该运行后已训练过这些题）。
Conclusion: 逐选项独立打分可让答案对选项顺序不变，同时保持单次 CPU 前向的轻量推理；作者明确标注发布运行的 guardrail、moderation、customer support 分数受“读过测试结果”影响，其校准数字不构成 unseen-question 测试。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Decoupling Time and Space: A Temporally Conditioned Refinement for EEG Source Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) offers millisecond temporal resolution, but inferring underlying neural sources is a severely ill-posed spatial inverse problem. While deep learning has advanced spatial reconstruction, current architectures face a critical dilemma: frame-by-frame models discard vital temporal context, whereas full 4D spatiotemporal networks introduce an architectural trade-off between reconstruction accuracy and inference cost. We propose a novel two-stream framework that explicitly decouples global temporal representation learning from per-time-point spatial refinement. A Transformer-based Temporal Condition Encoder processes the entire EEG sequence via factorized spatiotemporal attention, retaining sensor-resolved features. A fixed inverse then maps these features into source-indexed conditioning for a per-timestep Source-Space Transformer or volumetric convolutional refiner. Extensive evaluations on realistic synthetic data demonstrate that this temporal prior dramatically improves spatial localization, outperforming classical and spatiotemporal baselines, particularly in high-noise and multi-source regimes. Training across diverse leadfields and explicit operator mismatches improves transfer to unseen head geometries and brings template-based reconstruction closer to subject-specific inversion. Furthermore, we apply the model trained only on synthetic EEG data to real-world EEG. A logistic regressor fit on source power differences in eyes-open, eyes-closed conditions successfully decodes age groups.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两流 EEG 源成像框架：用 Transformer 时间条件编码器经分解时空注意力学习整段序列的全局时间表征，再由固定逆映射成源空间条件，驱动逐时间点的 Source-Space Transformer 或体积卷积细化器。在真实感合成数据上，该时间先验在高噪声与多源情形显著改善空间定位，优于经典与时空基线；跨多种 leadfield 与显式算子失配训练可迁移到未见头几何，并在仅用合成数据训练的模型上成功解码真实 EEG 的年龄组。
Motivation: EEG 源定位是严重不适定的空间逆问题：逐帧模型丢掉时间上下文，而完整 4D 时空网络在重建精度与推理成本之间存在架构取舍。
Method: 两流框架显式解耦全局时间表征学习与逐时间点空间细化：Transformer Temporal Condition Encoder 用分解时空注意力处理整段 EEG 序列并保留传感器级特征；一个固定逆映射把这些特征变成源索引条件，输入逐时间步的 Source-Space Transformer 或体积卷积细化器。训练覆盖多样 leadfield 与显式算子失配，模型仅在合成 EEG 上训练后直接用于真实 EEG。
Result: 在真实感合成数据上，时间先验显著改善空间定位，优于经典与时空基线，尤其在高噪声与多源情形；跨多样 leadfield 与算子失配训练提升对未见头几何的迁移，使基于模板的重建更接近个体化反演。在真实 EEG 上，仅用源功率差拟合的 logistic regressor 在睁眼/闭眼条件下成功解码年龄组。
Conclusion: 把时间上下文作为条件而非整体 4D 网络，可在 EEG 源成像中同时保住定位精度与推理成本，并让合成训练的模型迁移到真实数据与未见头几何。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BRANCH-MoE: Balance-Aware Tree Routing for Large Embedding Models
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers increase model capacity without a proportional increase in per-example computation. However, conventional flat routers can yield imbalanced expert utilization and treat experts as an unstructured collection, whose indices carry no topological meaning. We introduce {\bf BRANCH-MoE}, a routing architecture that places \(E\) experts at the leaves of a binary decision tree of depth \(\log_2 E\). At each internal node the branching probability is centered on the arrival-weighted mean score of the traffic reaching that node. This mean is estimated using an exponential moving average, which promotes utilization of both child subtrees without an auxiliary load-balancing loss. We show that this moving-average estimate admits an explicit noise-lag trade-off. We prove that for linear node maps and log-concave arrival distributions, this mechanism prevents routing-mass collapse. We further establish that, under a frozen router, an expert's execution frequency controls its stochastic-gradient convergence rate, and that confident decisions near the root bound cross-device communication when experts are assigned to devices by tree prefix. We evaluate BRANCH-MoE against Switch softmax, DeepSeek-V3 dynamic-bias, Skywork logit-normalized, and deterministic hash routing on Criteo click-through-rate prediction, Forest Covertype, HIGGS, and YearPredictionMSD, using \(E=16\), top-\(4\) routing, and five random seeds. Our results show that hierarchical routing can preserve task quality and balanced utilization while inducing a topology that supports localized expert co-activation and reduced communication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BRANCH-MoE 把 E 个专家放在深度 log2(E) 的二叉决策树叶子上，每个内节点的分支概率以到达流量加权均值为中心，用指数移动平均估计，从而在不加辅助负载均衡损失的情况下同时使用两个子树。证明在线性节点映射与 log 凹到达分布下该机制可防止 routing-mass collapse，且冻结路由器时专家执行频率控制随机梯度收敛速率。在 Criteo CTR、Forest Covertype、HIGGS、YearPredictionMSD 上以 E=16、top-4 路由、5 个随机种子对比 Switch softmax、DeepSeek-V3 dynamic-bias、Skywork logit-normalized 与 deterministic hash routing，结果显示分层路由在保持任务质量与均衡利用的同时形成支持局部专家共激活和降低通信的拓扑。
Motivation: 扁平路由器导致专家利用不均，且专家索引无拓扑含义，无法利用结构来约束通信与共激活。
Method: 将 E 个专家置于深度 log2(E) 的二叉决策树叶子；内节点分支概率以到达加权均值为中心，用指数移动平均 (EMA) 估计，显式给出噪声-滞后权衡；对线性节点映射与 log 凹到达分布证明防塌缩，并分析冻结路由器下执行频率与 SGD 收敛、按树前缀分配设备时根附近置信决策对跨设备通信的界。
Result: 在 Criteo CTR、Forest Covertype、HIGGS、YearPredictionMSD 上，以 E=16、top-4 路由、5 个随机种子，对比 Switch softmax、DeepSeek-V3 dynamic-bias、Skywork logit-normalized、deterministic hash routing；结果显示分层路由保持任务质量与均衡利用，并诱导出支持局部专家共激活、降低通信的拓扑。理论上给出噪声-滞后权衡、防 routing-mass collapse 证明，以及执行频率控制 SGD 收敛速率与通信上界的结论。
Conclusion: 把专家按树结构组织并用 EMA 中心化的分支概率，可在不引入辅助负载均衡损失的前提下同时获得均衡利用、任务质量与通信局部性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Out-of-control Hamiltonian Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning the Hamiltonian of a many-body system from its dynamics is a central task in quantum science, yet the algorithms with the strongest provable guarantees assume some level of quantum control--fast, arbitrary single-qubit gates interleaved with time evolution, and measurements in arbitrary bases--that is beyond the capabilities of near-term analog quantum simulators. Motivated by analog atom- and ion-based platforms, we study Hamiltonian learning under minimal access models. Uniform state preparation and measurements: We first consider the setting where in every experiment, one can rotate each qubit to the same state, perform short-time evolution, and measure every qubit in the same basis. Surprisingly, we show that for generic 2-local Hamiltonians on any interaction graph, all of the parameters can be reconstructed from such experiments. Computational basis state preparation and measurements: We then consider a similarly constrained setting, but where state preparation and measurement are restricted to the computational basis. For nearest-neighbor Hamiltonians with only Pauli $X/Z$ interactions, a class which captures contemporary Rydberg atom platforms, we show that over 1D and 2D rectangular lattices, all of the parameters can be reconstructed from such experiments up to unavoidable gauges. Our protocols introduce new techniques for solving structured polynomial systems over an extensive number of parameters. Taken together, our results suggest that one can learn a great deal from the dynamics of quantum many-body systems even under the most stringent experimental constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在近程模拟量子模拟器缺乏快速单比特门与任意基测量的条件下，证明仅用统一初态制备加统一基测量即可重构任意相互作用图上一般 2-local 哈密顿量的全部参数；若初态与测量进一步限制在计算基，对捕获 Rydberg 平台的 1D/2D 矩形格点上仅含 Pauli X/Z 相互作用的最近邻哈密顿量，仍可在不可约规范之外重构全部参数。
Motivation: 现有哈密顿量学习算法的最强可证保证依赖快速任意单比特门、任意基测量等量子控制能力，超出近期原子、离子类比模拟平台的实际可用操作。
Method: 在两种最小访问模型下给出协议：统一初态制备与统一基测量；以及仅限计算基的初态制备与测量。协议引入求解大量参数上结构化多项式系统的新技术。
Result: 证明对任意相互作用图上的一般 2-local 哈密顿量，统一初态与统一基测量实验足以重构全部参数；对 1D 与 2D 矩形格点上仅含 Pauli X/Z 相互作用的最近邻哈密顿量，计算基实验可重构全部参数至不可约规范 (gauge)。
Conclusion: 即便在最严苛的实验约束下，量子多体系统动力学仍携带可重构哈密顿量的大量信息；该结论覆盖 Rydberg 原子平台一类近期系统。

papers.title: Extending Dynamic World Surface Water Mapping to Sentinel-1 with AlphaEarth Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic World (DW) maps land use and land cover globally at 10 m from Sentinel-2 (S2) imagery, but only for cloud-free observations, which limits where and when surface water can be mapped. We use the DW water class as weak supervision for a Sentinel-1 (S1) synthetic aperture radar (SAR) model so that DW-like water maps can be produced for every S1 acquisition. Google's AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) annual embedding supplies spatial context, while S1 backscatter supplies the acquisition-time observation. On 53 globally distributed scenes with independent annotations of 3 m PlanetScope imagery acquired within 48 h of the S1 overpass, the S1-only model already reaches a pooled water intersection over union (IoU) of 0.77, comparable to 0.75 for the operational OPERA DSWx-S1 product, and adding AEF raises it to 0.85. The fused model improves on the S1-only model on 44 of 53 scenes and exceeds OPERA on 48, and on the independent S1S2-Water benchmark it reaches 0.94, compared with 0.87 for OPERA. Optical land-cover products can thus provide scalable training labels for SAR surface water mapping.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables; includes 3 pages of supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Dynamic World 的水体类别作弱监督，把 Sentinel-1 SAR 地表水制图扩展到每次 S1 过境：AlphaEarth Foundations 年度嵌入提供空间上下文，S1 后向散射提供过境时刻观测。在 53 景全球独立标注场景上，S1-only 水体 IoU 达 0.77（OPERA DSWx-S1 为 0.75），加入 AEF 融合后升至 0.85；在 S1S2-Water 基准上达 0.94（OPERA 0.87）。
Motivation: Dynamic World 仅在无云的 Sentinel-2 光学观测上以 10 m 制图地表水，云覆盖限制了可制图的区域与时刻；需要在每次 S1 SAR 过境都产出 DW 风格的水体图。
Method: 以 DW 水体类别作弱监督训练 Sentinel-1 SAR 水体模型，输入为 Google AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) 年度嵌入（空间上下文）与 S1 后向散射（过境时刻观测）的融合；评测用 53 景全球场景，其真值为 S1 过境 48 小时内获取的 3 m PlanetScope 独立标注，并在独立的 S1S2-Water 基准上对照 OPERA DSWx-S1。
Result: 53 景全球场景上 S1-only 池化水体 IoU 0.77，与 OPERA DSWx-S1 的 0.75 相当；加入 AEF 后升至 0.85。融合模型在 53 景中的 44 景优于 S1-only、在 48 景超过 OPERA；在 S1S2-Water 基准上 IoU 0.94，OPERA 为 0.87。
Conclusion: 光学地表覆盖产品可作为可扩展的训练标签用于 SAR 地表水制图，使 DW 式水体图覆盖每次 S1 过境而非仅无云光学时刻。

papers.title: Reading the Mood: Emotion-Guided Book-to-Music Recommendation via CGANs and LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Background music that matches the mood of a text has been shown to make readers feel more immersed and improve their reading experience, motivating recommender systems that pair books with mood-matched music. In this direction, we present Sentiment Aware Generative Adversarial Network for Cross Domain Recommendation (SAGA-CDR), a two-phase cross-domain recommendation framework that personalizes music suggestions and emotionally aligns them with the book being read. In the first phase, transformer-based sentiment embeddings are constructed from user reviews and mapped across domains via a Conditional Generative Adversarial Network, whose mask-conditioned generator handles missing sentiment components and injects stochasticity for richer preference transfer. A compact rating neural network then fuses sentiment-specific interaction scores with a collaborative filtering prior to predict music ratings. In the second phase, large language models classify each book into a valence-arousal emotional quadrant, and candidate tracks are filtered to match that quadrant. Experiments on both the English Amazon and Chinese Douban datasets show that SAGA-CDR achieves the best rating prediction accuracy on Amazon (RMSE 0.98) and the lowest RMSE on Douban (0.91), with ranking performance competitive with the strongest sentiment-aware baseline, even in cross-lingual settings.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at SENTIRE 2026 (ICDM 2026 Workshops)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGA-CDR 用两阶段跨域推荐把书的情绪与背景音乐对齐：先由 transformer 情绪嵌入经条件生成对抗网络 (CGAN) 跨域迁移偏好并预测音乐评分，再用 LLM 把书分到 valence-arousal 情绪象限筛选候选曲目。在 Amazon 与 Douban 数据集上取得最佳评分预测精度（RMSE 分别为 0.98 与 0.91），排序性能与最强情绪感知基线相当，跨语言设定下同样成立。
Motivation: 与文本情绪匹配的背景音乐能提升阅读沉浸感，但音乐与书籍分属不同域、且用户情绪信号常有缺失，跨域偏好迁移与情绪对齐的推荐仍是空白。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段从用户评论构建 transformer 情绪嵌入，用 mask-conditioned 生成器的 CGAN 跨域映射（处理缺失情绪成分并注入随机性），再由紧凑评分神经网络融合情绪交互分数与协同过滤先验预测音乐评分；第二阶段用 LLM 将书分类到 valence-arousal 四象限并按象限过滤候选曲目。
Result: 在英文 Amazon 数据集上取得最佳评分预测精度 RMSE 0.98，在中文 Douban 数据集上取得最低 RMSE 0.91；排序性能与最强情绪感知基线相当，跨语言设定下依然保持。
Conclusion: 情绪嵌入加 CGAN 跨域迁移与 LLM 情绪象限过滤的组合，能在跨语言场景下同时做好书-音乐评分预测与排序。

papers.title: A Solvable Model of Adaptive Learning Rate Rescaling: Acceleration, Stability & Scaling
papers.abstract_en: A recurring design principle in modern optimizers is to decouple update magnitude from the raw gradient norm, yet its consequences for learning-curve and resource scaling remain unclear. We isolate this mechanism by studying normalized SGD in a random-feature model with power-law teacher and data covariance. Fixed-norm updates induce an effective learning rate that grows as gradients shrink. We derive a dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) describing the joint dependence of the loss on training time, model width and batch size. Normalization initially accelerates SGD, mapping the power-law exponent $r_{\rm SGD}<1$ to $2r_{\rm SGD}/(1-r_{\rm SGD})$, with exponential convergence at $r_{\rm SGD}=1$ and formal finite-time convergence for $r_{\rm SGD}>1$. At finite step size, however, the same feedback ultimately breaks the acceleration and leads to marginal stability. The late-time theory yields width-limited, edge-of-stochastic-stability (EoSS), and deterministic edge-of-stability (EoS) regimes. These phases determine when larger batches or wider models reduce serial training time at comparable compute. We quantify in which of these phases increased batch size or width can compensate the excess compute use per step by fewer optimization steps to target loss. Linearized ResNet experiments on CIFAR-5M support the predicted acceleration, breakdown, and resource-scaling trends. Together, these results connect normalization-induced acceleration, EoS effects, and width--batch allocation within a solvable theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在幂律 teacher 与数据协方差的随机特征模型中，固定范数的 normalized SGD 会诱导随梯度衰减而增大的有效学习率：早期把幂律指数 r_SGD<1 映射为 2r_SGD/(1-r_SGD) 加速收敛，r_SGD=1 时呈指数收敛，r_SGD>1 形式上有限时间收敛；但有限步长下同一反馈最终破坏加速并走向边缘稳定 (EoSS/EoS)。理论据此判定在哪些相位加大 batch 或模型宽度能用更少优化步数抵消每步更高的算力开销，CIFAR-5M 上的线性化 ResNet 实验支持加速、失效与资源标度趋势。
Motivation: 现代优化器普遍把更新幅度与原始梯度范数解耦，但这一机制对学习曲线与算力/资源标度的后果尚不清楚，缺少可解理论来判定何时加速、何时失稳。
Method: 在 teacher 与数据协方差均为幂律的随机特征模型上研究 normalized SGD（固定范数更新），推导同时依赖训练时间、模型宽度与 batch size 的动力学平均场理论 (DMFT)；再由晚期理论给出 width-limited、edge-of-stochastic-stability (EoSS) 与 deterministic edge-of-stability (EoS) 相位，并用 CIFAR-5M 上的线性化 ResNet 实验检验。
Result: 加速映射为 r_SGD<1 时 2r_SGD/(1-r_SGD)，r_SGD=1 时指数收敛，r_SGD>1 时形式上有限时间收敛；有限步长下加速最终失效并出现边缘稳定。晚期理论给出 width-limited、EoSS、EoS 三个相位，量化各相位中加大 batch 或宽度能否以更少优化步数抵消每步更高算力；CIFAR-5M 线性化 ResNet 实验支持加速、失效与资源标度趋势。
Conclusion: 归一化诱导的加速、边缘稳定效应与 width–batch 分配可以在一个可解理论中统一刻画，且加速是有条件的：有限步长下反馈会转为失稳，资源分配策略取决于所处相位。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: To Learn is to Wander: Learning Across Graphs and Tasks with Random Walks
authors: İsmail İlkan Ceylan (1 and 2 and 3) ((1) TU Wien
papers.abstract_en: Graph foundation models aim to transfer across graphs, feature spaces, relational schemas, and prediction tasks, yet existing approaches typically generalize only within particular graph modalities or tasks. We propose Wander, a graph foundation model designed to operate across these settings within a single pretrained checkpoint. Following the prior-predictive perspective, we formulate graph learning as completion of a partially observed graph. We realize this task-general view through a common interface based on random walks, allowing the same model to operate across homogeneous and multi-relational graphs with varying features, labels, and relational schemas. Wander can increase its structural context at inference time without changing its learned parameters and, under suitable assumptions, universally approximates the corresponding Bayes-optimal predictor on bounded connected graphs. Empirically, a single pretrained checkpoint achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive results across node classification, homogeneous link prediction, and knowledge-graph link prediction. Moreover, joint pretraining across graph modalities and tasks preserves performance in specialized settings while enabling positive transfer and the composition of separately learned capabilities at inference time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Wander 是单一预训练 checkpoint 的图基础模型，把图学习表述为部分观测图的补全，用随机 walk 作为统一接口，使同一模型跨同质图与多关系图、跨不同特征标签与关系 schema 工作。推理时可在不改参数的前提下扩大结构上下文，并在合适假设下于有界连通图上通用逼近 Bayes-optimal 预测器；单 checkpoint 在节点分类、同质链接预测与知识图谱链接预测上达到 SOTA 或很有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有图基础模型通常只能在特定图模态或任务内泛化，无法在单一 checkpoint 内同时跨图、特征空间、关系 schema 与预测任务迁移。
Method: 遵循 prior-predictive 视角，把图学习建模为部分观测图的补全任务；以随机 walk 为共同接口，让同一模型处理同质图与多关系图的不同特征、标签和 schema；推理时可扩展结构上下文而不改动已学参数，并给出有界连通图上的 Bayes-optimal 通用逼近结论。
Result: 单个预训练 checkpoint 在节点分类、同质链接预测、知识图谱链接预测上取得 state-of-the-art 或高度有竞争力的结果；跨图模态与任务的联合预训练在专业化设置中保持性能，同时带来正迁移与推理时对分别学习能力的组合。
Conclusion: 随机 walk 接口足以把跨模态跨任务的图学习统一进一个 checkpoint，联合预训练不会牺牲专门任务性能，还能在推理时组合已学到的能力。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Adapting prior-data fitted networks for tabular anomaly detection
papers.abstract_en: While deep features have transformed anomaly detection in images and video, their impact on tabular data has been less substantial, partly due to the limited availability of strong deep representations. Recently, prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) have emerged as a promising source of such representations for tabular data. In this work, we investigate how PFN representations can be adapted and leveraged for anomaly detection. The question is harder than it looks. No anomalies are available before deploy- ment, so model parameters cannot be tuned with supervision, and the reference set that defines normal behavior may itself contain the very anomalies it is supposed to reveal. We begin our study using frozen TabPFN features. Scoring each sam- ple by its distance to its nearest neighbors in feature space already gives strong results. We identify which layers to use and a feature-extraction procedure suited to the task. Next, to further improve performance, we use the reference set to fine- tune the model, so that the resulting features better separate normal samples from anomalies. On the ADBench benchmark, our fine-tuning free approach (ZEN) reaches a higher mean AUROC than every baseline, and our fine-tuned method (FOCUS) improves on it further. Our approach also generalizes across PFN models.
papers.comment: Submitted for a review to ICLR 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 TabPFN 的冻结特征做表格异常检测：按样本到特征空间最近邻的距离打分（ZEN），再用参考集微调 PFN 使特征更好分离正常与异常（FOCUS）。在 ADBench 上 ZEN 的平均 AUROC 高于所有基线，FOCUS 在其之上进一步提升，且该流程可跨不同 PFN 模型泛化。
Motivation: 深度表征在图像视频异常检测中已很成功，但表格数据受限于缺少强深度表征；同时部署前拿不到异常，无法用监督调参，而定义正常行为的参考集本身可能混有要检出的异常。
Method: 以 TabPFN 冻结特征为起点，先确定可用层与适配任务的特征提取流程，用特征空间最近邻距离给每个样本打分得到 ZEN（免微调）；再用参考集微调 PFN，使特征更好区分正常与异常，得到 FOCUS。
Result: 在 ADBench 基准上，免微调的 ZEN 平均 AUROC 高于每一个基线，微调后的 FOCUS 在 ZEN 之上进一步提升；方法在不同 PFN 模型之间可泛化。
Conclusion: PFN 表征即使完全冻结、仅靠最近邻距离也能成为强异常检测器，用参考集微调还能再抬升，且不依赖部署前可用的异常标签。

papers.title: Revisiting Label-Free Speaker Embedding Enhancement with vMF Profile Likelihood
papers.abstract_en: Embedding enhancement improves speaker verification under acoustic mismatch without modifying a frozen backbone. Recent work has established a practical label-free setting for this task, but often adopts increasingly structured formulations. Here, the clean target is directly observed during training, making enhancement a matching problem on the unit hypersphere. We model the clean target with a von Mises--Fisher (vMF) likelihood and profile out a sample-wise concentration parameter, yielding a simple closed-form objective with adaptive weighting. Across VoxCeleb1, VoxSRC23, CN-Celeb, VOiCES, and VC-Mix, the proposed method largely preserves the baseline and gives clearer gains on challenging mismatch sets. It also remains stable under a broad single-view recipe, where a recent diffusion baseline becomes less reliable in controlled comparisons. These results suggest that effective label-free embedding enhancement in this setting does not require a highly structured formulation.
papers.journal_ref: Proc. Interspeech 2026, pp. 393-397
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在说话人验证的免标签嵌入增强中，把干净目标直接观测到的设定视为单位超球面上的匹配问题，用 von Mises--Fisher (vMF) 似然建模目标并逐样本剖面掉集中度参数，得到带自适应权重的闭式目标。在 VoxCeleb1、VoxSRC23、CN-Celeb、VOiCES、VC-Mix 上基本保持基线并在困难失配集上给出更清晰增益，同时在宽松 single-view 配方下保持稳定，而近期扩散基线在受控对比中变得不可靠。
Motivation: 免标签嵌入增强的既有做法趋向越来越结构化的形式化，而该设定下训练时干净目标可直接观测，结构化复杂度未必必要。
Method: 以 vMF 似然建模单位超球面上的干净目标，剖面掉逐样本集中度参数 (concentration parameter)，得到闭式目标并带自适应权重；冻结主干，仅做嵌入增强，采用宽松的 single-view 训练配方。
Result: 在 VoxCeleb1、VoxSRC23、CN-Celeb、VOiCES、VC-Mix 上基本保持基线性能，在困难失配集上增益更明显；在受控对比的 single-view 配方下保持稳定，而近期扩散基线变得不可靠。
Conclusion: 在该免标签设定下，有效的嵌入增强不需要高度结构化的形式化，简单的 vMF 剖面似然闭式目标即可。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GS-Pool: Object-Level Change Detection in 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Factories, museums and surveyors photograph the same space months apart and need to know which objects changed. When each visit is reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), a direct comparison of the two reconstructions does not answer this. Training is stochastic, so two reconstructions of an unchanged space never coincide, and the second visit is often a quick re-scan with far fewer photographs. We propose GS-Pool, which takes two independently reconstructed Gaussian fields of the same space and returns the changed objects in each, together with their masks. SAM2 masks of each visit's photographs are lifted onto the Gaussians that render them and merged into an object pool, so every decision is taken once per object in 3D. We introduce a photographic carrier, the 3DGS training loss of each input reconstruction against the other visit's photographs, backpropagated to the Gaussians that rendered each pixel. We combine it with GS-Diff's geometry and colour terms and our distilled DINOv3 features. This evidence is compared with that of the objects present in both visits, which sets a change threshold for each scene. On PASLCD, GS-Pool reaches mIoU/F1 scores of 0.751/0.846 against 0.644/0.758 for GS-Diff, the strongest prior method, a gain of 17%/12%. Its mIoU is also 36%, 40% and 57% above that of O-SCD, PlenoCI and MV-3DCD, and it reaches 0.855 mIoU on CL-Splats, 33% above MV-3DCD. Each changed object is returned as a set of Gaussians with the evidence behind its decision, which an inspector can review in 3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GS-Pool 把同一空间两次独立 3DGS 重建转成对象级变化检测：用 SAM2 掩膜提升到高斯并合并成 object pool，逐对象在 3D 中判定变化。在 PASLCD 上 mIoU/F1 达 0.751/0.846，较最强先前方法 GS-Diff 的 0.644/0.758 提升 17%/12%。
Motivation: 同一场所间隔数月的两次 3DGS 重建因训练随机性永不重合，且第二次常为照片稀疏的快速补扫，直接比对无法回答哪些物体真的变了。
Method: 将每次访问照片上的 SAM2 掩膜提升到渲染它们的高斯并合并为 object pool，逐对象在 3D 中决策；引入 photographic carrier（用另一访问的照片计算本重建的 3DGS 训练损失并反传到渲染像素的高斯），与 GS-Diff 的几何/颜色项及蒸馏的 DINOv3 特征组合，再与两访共有对象的证据比较得到逐场景变化阈值。
Result: 在 PASLCD 上 mIoU/F1 为 0.751/0.846，对比 GS-Diff 的 0.644/0.758，提升 17%/12%；mIoU 分别高出 O-SCD、PlenoCI、MV-3DCD 36%、40%、57%；在 CL-Splats 上 mIoU 0.855，高出 MV-3DCD 33%。
Conclusion: 把变化判定下沉到对象级并用跨访问照片损失作为证据，可在两次重建质量不对等时给出可由检查者在 3D 中复核的变化对象及其高斯集合与决策证据。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ChronoWorld: Camera-Controlled Consistent 4D World Generation via Spatiotemporal Cues and Geometric Reflections
papers.abstract_en: While existing camera-controllable video generation models can produce visually compelling sequences, preserving intrinsic 4D spatiotemporal coherence remains challenging. To address this limitation, we propose ChronoWorld, an "Observation--State--Reflection" framework that leverages spatiotemporal causal cues and reconstruction priors to generate globally consistent, free-view 4D scenes. Given a context video, we introduce a Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention mechanism that enforces multi-view epipolar constraints and temporal causality throughout the generation process. In addition, we develop a reconstruction-driven geometric reflection pipeline with a 4D retrieval strategy to enable dynamic self-assessment and correction of generated outputs, improving consistency and accuracy. Extensive experiments show that ChronoWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance in spatiotemporally consistent, cinematic-quality 4D scene generation, with strong generalization and high-fidelity geometry across diverse scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChronoWorld 用「Observation–State–Reflection」框架生成相机可控、自由视角的 4D 场景：以 Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention 同时约束多视角对极几何与时间因果，再用重建驱动的几何反思管线加 4D 检索做自检与纠错。摘要称其在时空一致、电影级 4D 场景生成上达到 SOTA，并具强泛化与高保真几何。
Motivation: 现有相机可控视频生成能产出观感不错的序列，但内在的 4D 时空一致性难以保持：多视角几何与时间因果容易在生成过程中漂移。
Method: 框架分 Observation–State–Reflection 三段，输入为一段 context video。核心一是 Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention，在整个生成过程中施加多视角对极约束与时间因果；核心二是 reconstruction-driven geometric reflection 管线，配合 4D retrieval 策略对生成结果做动态自评估与修正。
Result: 摘要给出的结论是定性的：在多样场景下达到 state-of-the-art 的时空一致、电影级质量 4D 场景生成，并具备强泛化与高保真几何；未给出具体指标数值或基线对比数字。
Conclusion: 把多视角几何约束与重建先验的自纠错闭环放进生成过程，是获得全局一致自由视角 4D 场景的可行路径。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: OVAL: Output-Aware Local Page Bases for KV Cache Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Long context inference with large language models becomes increasingly expensive as attention must operate over an ever growing KV cache. Page sparse attention reduces this cost by representing each KV page compactly and retrieving only a subset for each query. Existing retrieval methods are designed to estimate attention scores or page relevance, but their objectives do not directly account for how approximation errors affect the resulting value weighted attention output. We introduce \method{}, an output aware page encoding derived from the joint structure of keys and values while preserving the key information needed for accurate retrieval. \method{} is training free and requires no additional value dependent statistics at inference time. Once constructed, its stored representation has the same size and decode time scoring cost as a key only spectral representation. Across long reasoning, long context understanding, and long generation benchmarks, \method{} consistently improves over the key only spectral baseline and performs competitively with recent KV cache compression and retrieval methods. On long reasoning benchmarks, it achieves strong avg@\(k\) performance across model benchmark pairs, while matching or surpassing leading baselines on several long context understanding and generation settings with modest decoding overhead. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/Ashkan13776/oval-kv}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OVAL 提出一种输出感知 (output-aware) 的 KV 页编码，从 key 与 value 的联合结构推导，使 page sparse attention 的检索目标直接对齐近似误差对 value 加权注意力输出的影响。该方法免训练、推理时不需额外 value 统计，存储表示与解码打分开销与 key-only 谱表示相同；在长推理、长上下文理解与长生成基准上一致优于 key-only 谱基线，并在若干设定上匹配或超过领先的 KV cache 压缩与检索方法。
Motivation: 长上下文推理中注意力必须在不断增长的 KV cache 上运算，代价高昂；现有页检索方法只估计注意力分数或页相关性，其目标没有直接刻画近似误差如何影响最终的 value 加权注意力输出。
Method: OVAL 从 keys 与 values 的联合结构推导输出感知的页编码，同时保留检索所需的关键信息；免训练，推理时不需要额外的 value 相关统计量，构造后的存储表示在尺寸与解码打分开销上与 key-only 谱表示 (key-only spectral representation) 相同。
Result: 在长推理、长上下文理解与长生成三类基准上，OVAL 一致优于 key-only 谱基线，在长推理基准的 avg@k 上取得强表现（跨模型-基准配对），并在若干长上下文理解与生成设定上匹配或超过领先的 KV cache 压缩与检索方法，解码开销适度 (modest decoding overhead)。
Conclusion: 把检索目标从估计注意力分数改为直接对齐 value 加权输出的近似误差，可以在不增加存储与打分开销的前提下提升 page sparse attention 的检索质量，并与近期 KV cache 压缩方法竞争。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Aligning Multimodal Patient Evidence with Biomedical Knowledge Graphs for Clinical LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Clinical questions often depend on linking a patient's multimodal evidence to external biomedical knowledge, yet existing predictive systems rarely represent such links explicitly, so they can neither be traced to their evidence sources nor removed to measure their contributions. We present MM-KG (Multimodal Knowledge Graph), which represents heterogeneous, multimodal patient observations and biomedical concepts as separate layers in one typed graph, joined by explicit alignment edges. First, modality-specific harmonizers convert EHR text, imaging, genomic, and biospecimen data into typed observations mapped to UMLS concepts, which a route-prioritized aligner links to a biomedical knowledge graph. Query-conditioned retrieval then selects a compact subgraph for downstream use by a large language model or a graph neural network. We build MM-KGs for MIMIC-IV and ADNI, and evaluate them with a 2x2 design that separates patient evidence, biomedical knowledge, and their interaction. On questions that require both sources, neither source alone performs far above chance, whereas their combination yields a drug-controlled AUROC interaction of +0.194 on MIMIC and +0.299 on ADNI. On held-out five-candidate ranking, MM-KG outperforms MindMap by +0.131 Hits@1 and leads an adapted GraphCare on the items that require consulting the patient, and deleting the single answer-bearing relation from the retrieved packet returns Hits@1 to the no-knowledge baseline. Finally, query-conditioned retrieval reaches 0.731 AUROC with 6.8x less context than the strongest generic policy, whereas static knowledge graph context gives no consistent gain on ordinary outcome prediction. Knowledge graphs thus benefit clinical LLMs not as background context but as explicit links between multimodal patient evidence and the relation a question requires, and MM-KG makes these links retrievable, traceable, and testable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MM-KG 把 EHR 文本、影像、基因组与生物标志物观测和 UMLS 概念分层放进同一张带类型的知识图谱，用显式对齐边连接患者证据与生物医学知识，再按查询条件检索子图喂给 LLM 或 GNN。在 MIMIC-IV 与 ADNI 的 2×2 拆解设计中，两类信息单独使用都接近随机，合用产生 +0.194（MIMIC）与 +0.299（ADNI）的药物对照 AUROC 交互项；删除唯一承载答案的关系后 Hits@1 跌回无知识基线。
Motivation: 临床问题需要把患者多模态证据与外部生物医学知识连起来，但现有预测系统很少显式表示这种链接，因而既无法追溯到证据来源，也无法通过删除来度量其贡献。
Method: 模态专属 harmonizer 将 EHR 文本、影像、基因组与生物标志物数据转成映射到 UMLS 概念的带类型观测，由 route-prioritized aligner 连接到生物医学知识图谱；query-conditioned retrieval 为下游 LLM 或 GNN 选出紧凑子图。在 MIMIC-IV 与 ADNI 上构建 MM-KG，并用 2×2 设计分离患者证据、生物医学知识及其交互。
Result: 需同时用到两类来源的问题上，任一来源单独使用都仅略高于随机，合用给出 +0.194（MIMIC）与 +0.299（ADNI）的药物对照 AUROC 交互；held-out 五候选排序上 MM-KG 比 MindMap 高 +0.131 Hits@1，并在需查阅患者的条目上领先改造版 GraphCare，删除检索包中唯一承载答案的关系后 Hits@1 回到无知识基线。query-conditioned retrieval 以 0.731 AUROC 达到比最强通用策略少 6.8× 上下文的效果，而静态知识图谱上下文对常规结局预测无一致增益。
Conclusion: 知识图谱对临床 LLM 的价值不在充当背景上下文，而在作为多模态患者证据与问题所需关系之间的显式链接；MM-KG 让这些链接可检索、可追溯、可检验。

papers.title: Closing the Context Gap: Activation Alignment for Tabular In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models perform in-context learning (ICL) by conditioning predictions on labeled training examples provided as context. Unlike traditional models that separate training from inference, these models must process all training examples in every forward pass, making each prediction expensive. Restricting the number of training examples reduces this cost but substantially degrades performance. Instead of discarding context, we propose activation alignment, a method that leverages the full context to teach a model how to behave when seeing only a subset. This is achieved by training a lightweight linear transformation on synthetic unlabeled data to map the intermediate activations of a data-constrained "student" (using partial context) toward those of a full-context "teacher" (using all data). Training the aligner requires no GPU and converges in seconds to minutes on commodity hardware. We evaluate on 38 classification datasets from the TabArena benchmark using the leading two tabular foundation models, TabPFN-3 and TabFM. Across all context budgets, the aligned student yields broad, statistically significant improvements over the unaligned baseline for both models. In low-data regimes, alignment recovers nearly half of the teacher's predictive advantage. The method provides a practical, low-overhead approach to achieving the inference speed of compact contexts while closing a significant fraction of the performance gap to the full-context teacher.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 表格基础模型做上下文学习时每个预测都要吃全部训练样本，成本高；截断上下文省钱但性能掉。activation alignment 用合成无标签数据训练一个轻量线性变换，把部分上下文 student 的中间激活对齐到全上下文 teacher，在 38 个 TabArena 分类数据集上对 TabPFN-3 与 TabFM 都取得跨上下文预算的显著提升，低数据体制下收回 teacher 预测优势的近一半。
Motivation: 表格基础模型必须在每次前向中处理全部训练样本，单次预测昂贵；直接减少上下文样本数虽降本却显著损害性能，需要在不丢弃上下文的前提下保住紧凑上下文的推理速度。
Method: 提出 activation alignment：训练一个轻量线性变换（aligner），在合成无标签数据上把使用部分上下文的 student 的中间激活映射向使用全部数据的 teacher 的激活；训练无需 GPU，在普通硬件上数秒到数分钟收敛。评测用 TabArena 基准的 38 个分类数据集，覆盖 TabPFN-3 与 TabFM 两个领先的表格基础模型。
Result: 在全部上下文预算上，对齐后的 student 相对未对齐基线在两个模型上都带来广泛且统计显著的提升；在低数据体制下，alignment 收回了 teacher 预测优势的近一半（nearly half）。
Conclusion: 用一个廉价的激活对齐层即可在保留紧凑上下文推理速度的同时，弥合与全上下文 teacher 的大部分性能差距，训练开销可忽略（无 GPU、秒到分钟级）。

papers.title: How Sparse Probability Maps Shape Mixture-of-Experts Routing
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers typically apply softmax to the router scores and keep the top-K experts, making every token use exactly K experts. Sparsity-inducing probability maps such as sparsemax, alpha-entmax and normmax can adaptively assign exact zeros to selected experts, and therefore appear to offer token-dependent expert participation, even when using the same top-K machinery. In this work, we study whether and how this sparsity survives training. We train matched 300M and 1B top-2 MoE language models with softmax, 1.5-entmax, sparsemax and 2-normmax, and find that the maps behave very differently once trained: at 1B, entmax discards 30% less probability mass than softmax while almost never dropping a selected expert, sparsemax retains the most mass, and normmax routes 21% of tokens to a single expert. These outcomes are not properties of the maps alone. Each map drops a selected expert only when the gap between the two largest scores reaches a fixed threshold, and the trained routers differ in the score distribution they learn: the entmax router learns scores with roughly half the spread of softmax's, which keeps its top-2 gaps below its threshold, while sparsemax and normmax, which share the same threshold, learn different gap distributions and hence different participation. Routers thus co-adapt their scores to the map, and a map's capacity to produce zeros does not by itself determine expert participation. While none of the sparse maps improves validation loss over softmax, they make the trained models far less sensitive to selecting more experts at inference: sparsemax trained with K=2 loses 0.02 nats when run with K=8, where softmax loses 0.58. Our results indicate that adaptive MoE routing has to be designed around the joint behavior of the probability map and the learned scores, rather than around the map alone.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Under review at ICLR 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 300M 与 1B 规模的 top-2 MoE 语言模型上对比 softmax、sparsemax、1.5-entmax、2-normmax，发现稀疏概率映射的置零能力在训练后并不直接决定专家参与度：路由器会与映射协同适应分数分布。entmax 在 1B 上比 softmax 少丢弃 30% 概率质量且几乎不丢已选专家，normmax 把 21% 的 token 路由到单个专家；sparsemax 训练的模型从 K=2 改跑 K=8 只损失 0.02 nats，softmax 损失 0.58 nats。
Motivation: 稀疏概率映射看似能让每个 token 自适应选择专家数量，但这种稀疏性在训练后是否保留、由什么决定，此前不清楚；若映射本身不决定参与度，自适应路由的设计依据就需要改变。
Method: 训练规模与路由配置完全匹配的 300M 和 1B top-2 MoE 语言模型，路由器分别使用 softmax、1.5-entmax、sparsemax 和 2-normmax；分析训练后分数分布、top-2 分差与丢弃已选专家的固定阈值之间的关系，并在推理时改变 K 做敏感性检验。
Result: 在 1B 上，entmax 比 softmax 少丢弃 30% 概率质量且几乎从不丢掉已选专家，sparsemax 保留最多质量，normmax 将 21% 的 token 路由到单个专家；entmax 学到的分数分布跨度约为 softmax 的一半，使其 top-2 分差低于阈值。四种映射均未在验证损失上超过 softmax，但 sparsemax 以 K=2 训练后改用 K=8 推理只损失 0.02 nats，softmax 损失 0.58 nats。
Conclusion: 路由器会与概率映射协同适应分数分布，映射能否产生零本身不决定专家参与度；自适应 MoE 路由必须围绕映射与所学分数的联合行为来设计，而稀疏映射的主要收益是降低推理时改变 K 的敏感性而非降低验证损失。

papers.title: Improved Convergence of Large Stepsize Gradient Descent for Logistic Regression
papers.abstract_en: We study gradient descent (GD) with a large constant stepsize for logistic regression on linearly separable data. Existing analysis shows an accelerated rate of $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrtε)$ to reach loss $ε$ with an aggressive stepsize, although the loss may initially oscillate. Tighter control of the oscillatory dynamics has been available only for two-dimensional data. We prove a substantially faster rate in arbitrary dimension: GD with a large stepsize $η=1/ε$ reaches loss $ε$ within $O(\ln^{p}(1/ε))$ steps, where $p$ depends only on the margin and the rank of the data. Our proof improves the bound on the transition time of GD from the oscillatory to the stable phase, after which the loss decreases monotonically. We split the oscillatory phase into recursively nested intervals. The margin and the rank bound the nesting depth, and a counting argument bounds the number of intervals at each depth, together yielding the polylogarithmic step complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性可分数据上，逻辑回归用大常数步长 η=1/ε 的梯度下降，可在 O(ln^p(1/ε)) 步内把损失降到 ε，其中指数 p 只依赖数据的 margin 与 rank，比已知的 Õ(1/√ε) 加速率快得多。证明通过把振荡阶段切成递归嵌套区间，改进了从振荡相到稳定相的过渡时间上界，稳定相之后损失单调下降。
Motivation: 大步长 GD 在逻辑回归上虽有 Õ(1/√ε) 的加速速率，但损失初期会振荡，而对振荡动力学的紧控制此前只在二维数据上获得，任意维度下缺少快速收敛保证。
Method: 对线性可分数据上步长 η=1/ε 的 GD 做收敛分析：把振荡阶段分解为递归嵌套的区间，用 margin 与 rank 约束嵌套深度，再用计数论证约束每层区间数，从而得到 polylogarithmic 步数复杂度，并改进振荡相到稳定相的过渡时间上界。

Conclusion: 大步长逻辑回归 GD 的振荡阶段可以在任意维度被控制到 polylogarithmic 步数，收敛速度由 margin 与 rank 而非维度决定。

papers.title: Detecting Nighttime Anomalies from NASA Black Marble Using a Generalized Spatio-Temporally Robust Framework of Machine Leaning Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: Nighttime lights from NASA's Black Marble product suite capture thermal and light emission signals from anomalous events including fires, volcanic eruptions, and gas flaring. Existing detection approaches rely primarily on thermal bands, limiting sensitivity to weaker signals. We propose a novel machine learning framework that jointly models Black Marble M-band and Day/Night Band (DNB) signals to derive a generalized, spatio-temporally robust ensemble of anomaly detectors. The framework iteratively builds detectors that scale across regions, seasons, anomaly classes, and extends over land and ocean. Detection sets at varying confidence levels are derived based on relevant bands and detector agreement. The approach improves true detection rate while reducing spurious detections and results demonstrate strong generalizability with applications in natural hazard monitoring and energy extraction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出联合建模 Black Marble M 波段与昼夜波段 (DNB) 的机器学习集成框架，迭代构建跨区域、跨季节、跨异常类别且覆盖陆地与海洋的通用异常检测器，并按波段与检测器一致性输出不同置信度的检测集合。该方法在提升真实检测率的同时压低虚假检测，可用于火灾、火山喷发、气体燃烧等自然灾害监测与能源开采活动识别。
Motivation: 现有夜间灯光异常检测主要依赖热红外波段，对弱信号敏感度不足，且难以跨区域、季节和异常类别泛化。
Method: 联合建模 NASA Black Marble M 波段与 Day/Night Band (DNB) 信号，迭代构建时空稳健的机器学习集成 (ensemble) 检测器；依据相关波段与各检测器的一致性，在不同置信度水平上生成检测集合，覆盖陆地与海洋。
Result: 在跨区域、跨季节、跨异常类别及陆海场景的检验中，真实检测率提升且虚假检测减少；框架输出多置信度层级的检测集合，展示出强泛化性。
Conclusion: 多波段联合的时空稳健集成检测比单靠热波段更能兼顾弱信号灵敏度与跨场景泛化，可支撑自然灾害监测与能源开采活动识别。

papers.title: The Pushback Paradox: A Two-Probe Diagnostic for Language Model Compliance
papers.abstract_en: Are language models compliant with user instructions? A model that always complies can be stopped but also exploited, while one that always resists can be neither exploited nor stopped. We contribute an open two-probe benchmark that can place any language model on this spectrum. In the active probe, a user instructs the model to act and accept a lower payoff, which measures exploitability. In the passive probe, the user instructs it to wait and give up a higher payoff, which measures stoppability. The two compliance rates combine into a compliance index $κ$. Applied to twelve language models, the benchmark shows that seven mostly follow the instruction in both probes and justify their action by pointing to the instruction. Only Claude Sonnet-4.6 and Claude Opus-4.7 can be stopped without being exploitable, Claude Opus-4.6 and GPT-5-mini resist both instructions, and no model is exploitable but unstoppable. Knowing where a language model sits on the compliance index $κ$ matters for human operators and for multi-agent systems, whether distributed or orchestrated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出开放的双探针基准，把语言模型的服从性放在「可被利用 (exploitable)」与「可被叫停 (stoppable)」这条谱上：active probe 让用户指令模型接受更低收益以测可利用性，passive probe 让它放弃更高收益以测可叫停性，两者合成服从指数 κ。在 12 个模型上，7 个两条指令都服从并以指令为由，只有 Claude Sonnet-4.6 与 Claude Opus-4.7 可被叫停且不可被利用，Claude Opus-4.6 与 GPT-5-mini 两条都抗拒，没有模型可被利用却无法叫停。
Motivation: 完全服从的模型既可被叫停也可被利用，完全抗拒的模型两者皆不可；此前缺少一个能把任意语言模型放到这条谱上的可复用测量工具。
Method: 开放的双探针基准：active probe 用指令要求模型行动并接受较低收益，测 exploitability；passive probe 用指令要求它等待并放弃较高收益，测 stoppability；两个服从率合成为服从指数 κ，用于给任意语言模型定位。
Result: 在 12 个语言模型上：7 个在两个探针中都基本服从指令并以指令解释自己的行为；Claude Sonnet-4.6 与 Claude Opus-4.7 可被叫停且不可被利用；Claude Opus-4.6 与 GPT-5-mini 对两条指令都抗拒；没有任何模型表现出可被利用却无法叫停。
Conclusion: 服从指数 κ 把「可利用」与「可叫停」区分开，对人类操作者和分布式/编排式多智能体系统判断模型行为位置有用。

papers.title: VideoTapestry: Query-Adaptive Memory Refinement for Multi-Agent Long-Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Long-video understanding places substantial demands on memory, as answering questions often requires retrieving information distributed across extended temporal spans. Existing approaches broadly follow two paradigms: query-driven exploration, which is sensitive to localization errors, and query-independent memory construction, which may omit question-specific details. We introduce VideoTapestry, a training-free multi-agent framework that adapts a preconstructed hierarchical video memory through coarse-to-fine, query-driven refinement. The preconstructed memory organizes video content into three levels, capturing global narrative context, event-level temporal structure, and fine-grained relational evidence, respectively. To support coarse-to-fine localization and observation, we assign a specialized agent to each level, keeping retrieval and refinement within a scale-specific context. Guided by the query, these agents revisit relevant video regions and enrich layer-wise memories with targeted multimodal observations. Their refinements are assembled according to the original hierarchy into a composite query-adaptive memory, preserving global context in a compact form while retaining fine-grained evidence along query-relevant branches for final reasoning. Compared with direct GPT-5.5 inference, VideoTapestry achieves absolute accuracy gains of 17.2%, 14.9%, 9.8%, and 7.0% on LVBench, LongVideoBench (Long), Video-MME (Long), and EgoSchema, respectively, achieving the state-of-the-art results among all competitors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VideoTapestry 是一个免训练的多智能体长视频理解框架：先预构建三层视频记忆（全局叙事、事件级时序、细粒度关系证据），再由每层专属 agent 按查询做由粗到细的定向回访与多模态补充，最后按原层级拼成查询自适应记忆供最终推理。相比直接用 GPT-5.5 推理，它在 LVBench、LongVideoBench (Long)、Video-MME (Long)、EgoSchema 上分别取得 17.2%、14.9%、9.8%、7.0% 的绝对精度提升，达到所有竞争方法中的最先进水平。
Motivation: 长视频问答需要跨长时间跨度检索信息，现有两条路线各有短板：查询驱动探索对定位误差敏感，查询无关的记忆构建又会漏掉与问题相关的细节。
Method: 免训练 (training-free) 多智能体框架：预构建三层分层视频记忆，分别承载全局叙事上下文、事件级时序结构与细粒度关系证据；每层分配一个专属 agent，在该尺度的上下文内做检索与精化，受查询引导回访相关视频区域并以定向多模态观测充实各层记忆，再按原层级组装为复合的查询自适应记忆用于最终推理。
Result: 相比直接 GPT-5.5 推理，绝对精度提升为：LVBench 17.2%、LongVideoBench (Long) 14.9%、Video-MME (Long) 9.8%、EgoSchema 7.0%，在所有竞争方法中达到 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 先预建分层记忆、再按查询做由粗到细的多智能体精化，可以在免训练条件下同时保住全局上下文与查询相关分支上的细粒度证据，从而显著抬高长视频问答精度。

papers.title: Learning What to Imitate: Entropy-Aware Distribution Mixing
papers.abstract_en: Small language models are often post-trained as students on reasoning traces from stronger teacher models to efficiently learn new skills. However, token-level imitation on traces that lie far outside the student's expected distribution often produces \textit{confident conflicts}, whereby the student is required to imitate a continuation that it deems unlikely (i.e., low-probability) despite being confident in a different continuation (i.e., in a low-entropy state). To mitigate the degradation in generalisation and catastrophic forgetting caused by these conflicts, we propose \textbf{Entropy-Aware Mixing}: a dynamic per-token interpolation of the student and teacher distributions, gated by the student's predictive entropy. We implement both convex and geometric interpolations for both offline trace generation (via speculative decoding, then SFT) and on-policy forward-KL distillation. Our results show that entropy-aware mixing stabilises distillation, improving in-distribution and out-of-distribution math reasoning while better preserving general capabilities than fixed-teacher supervision. Nonetheless, the optimal entropy schedule depends on the training source, with offline-generated traces favouring concave schedules (greater overall teacher influence) and on-policy training favouring linear or convex schedules (teacher concentrated in high-entropy states).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Entropy-Aware Mixing：按学生预测熵对每个 token 在学生与教师分布间动态插值，缓解学生被迫模仿自己判定为低概率续写所造成的 confident conflicts。该方法同时用于离线轨迹生成（speculative decoding 后 SFT）与 on-policy forward-KL 蒸馏，稳定蒸馏并改善分布内与分布外数学推理、更好地保留通用能力；最优熵调度随训练源变化，离线轨迹偏好凹调度（教师影响更大），on-policy 训练偏好线性或凸调度（教师集中在高熵状态）。
Motivation: 小模型用强教师的推理轨迹做后训练时，token 级模仿会落在学生分布之外，产生 confident conflicts，导致泛化下降与灾难性遗忘。
Method: Entropy-Aware Mixing 按学生预测熵对师生分布做逐 token 动态插值，实现凸插值与几何插值两种形式；覆盖两条路径：离线轨迹生成（speculative decoding 后接 SFT）与 on-policy forward-KL 蒸馏。
Result: 熵感知混合稳定了蒸馏，在分布内与分布外数学推理上均有改善，并比固定教师监督更好地保留通用能力；最优熵调度依赖训练源：离线生成轨迹偏好凹调度（教师总体影响更大），on-policy 训练偏好线性或凸调度（教师集中在高熵状态）。
Conclusion: 蒸馏中教师监督的强度应按学生熵状态逐 token 分配，且调度形状要随离线轨迹还是 on-policy 训练来选。

papers.title: Language models can notice an impossible engineering problem yet still report it as solved
papers.abstract_en: Language models draft engineering calculations, but answer accuracy does not show whether they reject an impossible problem. We tested 14 models on 30 pairs of mechanics problems, each with a valid version and one made impossible by changing a given value or assumption. Two independent solvers verified every answer key and showed that each flawed problem was physically impossible. We scored solving of valid problems separately from rejection of their flawed counterparts. Each reply required a "solved" or "cannot solve" status; rejection meant "cannot solve" or withholding an answer. The initial prompts did not warn that problems could be flawed. Across three recent models, 12 of 90 replies failed to reject a flawed problem. In 11 of these replies, the model stated the flaw, answered a corrected problem and still reported the original as "solved", according to artificial intelligence raters and numerical checks. We later retested four models from one provider, offering "flawed" instead of "cannot solve" and asking them to name and explain the defect. Three models showed statistically significant increases in rejection, but valid-problem solving fell in three. Evaluations therefore need to score both versions and distinguish flaw recognition from the reported status.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 14 个模型、30 对力学题（每对一个有效版与一个被改参数而物理不可解的版本）测试发现：模型能指出缺陷却仍把原题标为 solved。三个近期模型 90 条回复中 12 条未拒答，其中 11 条已陈述缺陷、按修正题作答却仍报原题 solved；改用 flawed 选项并要求指出缺陷后，四个模型中三个拒答率显著上升，但其中三个模型的有效题求解率下降。
Motivation: 答题正确率无法反映模型是否会拒绝物理上不可能的问题；工程计算草稿场景下，模型识别缺陷与最终上报状态可能脱节，评测需要把两者分开计分。
Method: 构造 30 对力学题（有效版与改动给定值或假设的不可解版），由两个独立求解者核验答案键并确认不可解性；每条回复必须给出 solved 或 cannot solve 状态，初始提示不告知题目可能有缺陷；后续对同一供应商的四个模型改用 flawed 选项并要求命名、解释缺陷，再统计拒答与求解。
Result: 三个近期模型 90 条回复中 12 条未拒答缺陷题，其中 11 条模型已陈述缺陷、按修正题作答却仍把原题报为 solved（依据 AI 评分与数值核对）。改提示后重测的四个模型中三个拒答率显著上升，但三个模型的有效题求解率下降。
Conclusion: 评测必须同时对有效题与缺陷题计分，并把缺陷识别与上报状态分开；仅靠提示措辞提高拒答率会以牺牲有效题求解为代价。

papers.title: What Matters for Latent Reasoning with Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Latent reasoning lets a large language model (LLM) think in a continuous space and verbalize only the answer. We argue that an effective latent thought must meet five requirements: it should be useful, helping produce the correct answer rather than merely changing it, diverse, so that resampling yields different reasoning trajectories, explainable, so that a decoded chain of thought (CoT) reflects reasoning the answer actually follows, refinable with more inference compute, and efficient, costing less than an explicit CoT at comparable accuracy. Current methods rarely meet these requirements: they learn shortcuts from the question, distill the explicit CoT into their weights, or imitate it one token at a time. We focus on flow matching in a learned latent space, the family we argue is best placed to meet them, and identify the training choices that make it work. The result is Flow-based Latent Reasoning (FLaRe), a simple recipe covering what the latent space encodes and how to shape it, where to train the flow, how to read out the answer, and a final stage of training on the model's own verified thoughts. A probe for each requirement shows that FLaRe improves on prior latent methods in all five. It also compares favorably with them on arithmetic benchmarks, while reaching 97% of the accuracy of explicit CoT at a quarter of its latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLaRe 把 flow matching 放进学习到的隐空间做潜在推理 (latent reasoning)，按五条要求（有用、多样、可解释、可随推理算力精化、比显式 CoT 便宜）给出训练配方：隐空间编码什么与如何整形、在何处训练 flow、如何读出答案，最后用模型自身已验证的思维再训一轮。每个要求各有一个探针，FLaRe 在五项上全部超过既有潜在推理方法，并在算术基准上达到显式 CoT 97% 的精度、延迟为其四分之一。
Motivation: 隐空间推理要求 LLM 只在连续空间思考、最后才口述答案，但现有方法要么从问题学捷径、要么把显式 CoT 蒸馏进权重、要么逐 token 模仿 CoT，难以同时满足有用、多样、可解释、可精化、低成本五条要求。
Method: 以学习到的隐空间中的 flow matching 为载体，确定四类关键训练选择：隐空间编码内容及其整形方式、flow 的训练位置、答案读出方式，以及最后在模型自身已验证思维 (verified thoughts) 上的训练阶段；并为五条要求各设计一个探针来度量。
Result: 五项探针显示 FLaRe 全面超过既有潜在推理方法；在算术基准上与这些方法比较表现有利，并达到显式 CoT 精度的 97%，同时延迟只有显式 CoT 的四分之一。
Conclusion: 满足五条要求的关键在于把隐空间编码、flow 训练位置、答案读出与自验证思维训练作为一个整体配方来设计，flow matching 是最有希望承载潜在推理的家族。

papers.title: Cross-dataset harmonization for robust endoscopic image analysis
papers.abstract_en: A significant problem in endoscopic image analysis is that the machine learning (ML) models used for this purpose usually underperform when applied on images acquired from endoscopes that are different from those used to acquire the images of their training set. The main difference of the images originating from different endoscopes is their color distributions, which depend both on the image sensors and the light sources used. Although previous studies have highlighted this challenge, to the best of our knowledge it has not been previously explicitly tackled. This study focuses on this problem and proposes very simple but impactful method. It implements a reference-based image harmonization that reduces global appearance differences between endoscopic datasets. Specifically, it extracts global color statistics from a chosen reference dataset in the CIE-Lab color space and applies a statistical channel-wise transformation to map each target image toward the appearance of the images of the reference dataset. The method is evaluated in the context of polyp detection in both flexible colonoscopy and capsule endoscopy datasets using a dataset-level cross validation protocol. The results indicate that the proposed harmonization consistently improves cross-dataset performance up to 30.7%, outperforming relevant baseline and state-of-the-art methods. The results indicate that a substantial part of the generalization gap is driven by low-level appearance variation that can be mitigated without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 内窥镜 ML 模型换设备就掉性能，作者把原因归到不同内窥镜的全局颜色分布差异。方法从参考数据集提取 CIE-Lab 全局颜色统计，对目标图像做逐通道统计变换把外观拉向参考域，在柔性结肠镜与胶囊内镜的息肉检测上跨数据集性能最多提升 30.7%，且无需重训练。
Motivation: 内窥镜 ML 模型在训练集之外的设备上采集的图像上普遍掉点，主因是传感器与光源不同带来的颜色分布差异；此前研究只指出这一挑战，未被显式处理。
Method: 提出基于参考的图像协调 (reference-based image harmonization)：选定参考数据集，在 CIE-Lab 色彩空间提取其全局颜色统计，对每张目标图像施加逐通道统计变换，把整体外观映射到参考域；用数据集级交叉验证 (dataset-level cross validation) 在柔性结肠镜与胶囊内镜息肉检测上评测。
Result: 跨数据集性能一致提升，最高达 30.7%，并超过相关基线与 state-of-the-art 方法；评测覆盖柔性结肠镜与胶囊内镜两类息肉检测数据集，采用 dataset-level cross validation 协议。
Conclusion: 跨设备泛化差距中有相当一部分由低层外观差异驱动，仅靠统计颜色协调即可缓解，无需重训练模型。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Talk Like You: Imitating How You Speak in Real-Time Talking Head Generation
papers.abstract_en: In daily life, each person exhibits unique speaking habits, leading to subtle yet consistent lip-shape variations even when pronouncing the same word. Although recent talking head generation methods have achieved impressive visual fidelity and lip synchronization, they largely overlook user-specific customization, especially the motion patterns that characterize individual speaking habits. These habits are difficult to model and capture, as their motion patterns are highly fine-grained and often similar across individuals. As a result, many approaches produce overly uniform facial motions and fail to capture diverse, person-specific articulation patterns. To address this, we propose TalkLikeYou, an efficient framework that imitates how a target person speaks in talking head generation. Our method models habit in motion-space and achieves real-time performance through Flow Matching with only one sampling step during inference. We further adopt a two-stage imitation learning strategy to capture subtle distinctions between habits, allowing users to specify a target habit through either a preset style from the dataset or a reference video. In addition, we introduce a new metric PLAD that projects mouth motions onto representative articulation axes to evaluate imitation accuracy and generation diversity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TalkLikeYou generates high-quality talking heads in real-time and significantly improves speaking habit imitation compared with prior methods. The code is available at: https://github.com/BQ-Wang0511/TalkLikeYou
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TalkLikeYou 在说话头生成中对个人说话习惯（唇形运动模式）做定制化模仿：把习惯建模在 motion space，用单步 Flow Matching 实现实时推理，并以两阶段模仿学习区分细微习惯差异。新指标 PLAD 将口部运动投影到代表性发音轴上评估模仿精度与生成多样性，实验显示其实时生成质量高且说话习惯模仿显著优于既有方法。
Motivation: 现有说话头生成虽有高视觉保真与唇同步，但忽略用户级定制，个体说话习惯的细粒度运动模式难以建模，导致生成的面部动作过于统一。
Method: 把说话习惯建模在 motion space，用 Flow Matching 且推理仅需一个采样步以实现实时；采用两阶段模仿学习策略捕捉习惯间细微差异，用户可从数据集预设风格或参考视频指定目标习惯；提出 PLAD 指标，将口部运动投影到代表性发音轴上评估模仿精度与生成多样性。
Result: 实验表明 TalkLikeYou 实时生成高质量说话头，说话习惯模仿相比既有方法显著提升；PLAD 用于同时度量模仿精度与生成多样性。
Conclusion: 在 motion space 中建模习惯并配合单步 Flow Matching 与两阶段模仿学习，可在实时条件下实现个人说话习惯的定制化模仿。

papers.title: TrustmeWatcher: An Application for Workplace Micro-Sensing and Explainable Well-Being Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Workplace sensing studies combine long-running behaviour traces with self-reports, yet the tools that collect those data often sit apart from the interface that returns results. We present TrustmeWatcher, the application built for the TRUST-ME project to connect this work. TrustmeWatcher reuses ActivityWatch's OS-level watchers for computer-activity collection and adds its own application layer. It turns the collected traces into an interactive screen-time dashboard, synchronizes responses from short questionnaires completed on the StreamDeck, and presents questionnaires alongside video highlights. Activity records and self-reports are aligned into labelled records for model development. The scope of this paper is limited to ActivityWatch data as model input. Artificial intelligence (AI) uses these activity records to predict six normalized state scores and an overall well-being score. The trained model runs locally, and the dashboard presents its predictions in semantic bands. Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) helps users understand how recorded activity contributed to a prediction. Privacy Control lets users pause or resume the camera and eye tracker used by the study. We describe the workflow, its user-device and sensing-setup boundaries, and its use with records from 17 participants. The result is a deployed application and study workflow that integrates activity review, study data collection, privacy control, local prediction, and a participant-facing interface for XAI evaluation.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at XAI for U 2026, the 3rd International Workshop on Explainable AI for Ubiquitous, Pervasive and Wearable Computing, co-located with UbiComp/ISWC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TrustmeWatcher 把 ActivityWatch 的 OS 级活动采集与问卷、视频高光、隐私控制整合成一个工作场所微感知应用，用本地模型从活动记录预测六个归一化状态分数和一个总体幸福感分数，并以语义分段和 XAI 向被试解释预测依据。论文描述了含 17 名参与者的记录上的工作流与部署形态，范围限定为仅用 ActivityWatch 数据作为模型输入。
Motivation: 工作场所感知研究中，采集长期行为痕迹的工具与返回结果的界面彼此分离，数据、自评与反馈难以闭环，也缺少面向被试的可解释与隐私控制入口。
Method: 复用 ActivityWatch 的 OS 级 watchers 采集电脑活动并叠加自建应用层；活动记录与 StreamDeck 上完成的短问卷自评对齐成带标签记录，仅以 ActivityWatch 数据为模型输入，训练本地模型预测六个归一化状态分数与一个总体幸福感分数；预测以语义分段呈现在交互式屏幕时间仪表盘上，并用 XAI 说明各活动对预测的贡献，Privacy Control 可暂停或恢复摄像头与眼动仪。
Result: 产出一个已部署的应用与研究工作流，整合活动回顾、研究数据采集、隐私控制、本地预测与面向被试的 XAI 界面；论文描述其在 17 名参与者的记录上的使用，范围限定为 ActivityWatch 数据作为模型输入。
Conclusion: 把采集、自评、本地预测与可解释反馈收进同一应用，可以在保护隐私的前提下让被试直接看到并理解自己的活动如何驱动幸福感预测，为 XAI 评估提供可用载体。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: The Birkhoff Geometry of Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections: Two Channels, Vertex Viscosity, and Sinkhorn as a Retraction
papers.abstract_en: Hyper-connections widen the residual stream of a Transformer to $n$ parallel streams. Their manifold-constrained version (mHC) mixes the streams at each layer with a doubly stochastic matrix, which it computes by Sinkhorn normalization of exponentiated logits. We give a geometric theory of this design on the Birkhoff polytope. First, a doubly stochastic mixer splits the stream into a mean channel, on which mHC is exactly a residual network, and a difference channel, which each layer contracts by its second singular value $σ_2 \le 1 - n \min_{ij} H_{ij}$. Thus the extra width is a fading memory with a horizon of $1/(1-σ_2)$ layers, and among nonnegative mixers only the permutations do not collapse. Second, the Sinkhorn-logit map is a global chart, and its logit gradient is exactly the Fisher-Rao gradient. Thus logit gradient flow follows a squared Fisher-Rao metric, and the straight-through update is exactly entropic mirror descent. Third, under logit gradient flow the logarithm of each entry moves at a rate of at most $4n^3\|\nabla f\|_\infty \varepsilon$, where $\varepsilon$ is the distance to the nearest permutation. Thus gradient flow approaches and leaves the vertices only at rate $1/t$, but mirror descent moves at an exponential rate. Fourth, the local convergence factor of Sinkhorn is $σ_2^2$, so a fixed iteration budget limits the horizon. Experiments confirm the predicted rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为流形约束超连接 (mHC) 在 Birkhoff 多面体上给出几何理论：双随机混合把残差流分成均值通道（mHC 在其上等同于残差网络）与差通道（每层按第二奇异值 σ2 ≤ 1 − n·min H_ij 收缩），故额外宽度是视野为 1/(1−σ2) 层的 fading memory，且非负混合中只有置换不塌缩。Sinkhorn-logit 映射是全局图且其 logit 梯度恰为 Fisher-Rao 梯度，straight-through 更新等价于熵镜像下降；梯度流以至多 4n³‖∇f‖∞·ε 的速率逼近顶点（ε 为到最近置换的距离），按 1/t 速率进出，而镜像下降按指数速率移动。
Motivation: 超连接把 Transformer 残差流扩成 n 路并行流，但双随机混合到底保留多少信息、Sinkhorn 归一化与梯度更新的几何含义、以及迭代预算如何限制有效视野，此前缺少统一解释。
Method: 在 Birkhoff 多面体上分解双随机混合为均值通道与差通道并用第二奇异值 σ2 给出收缩界；证明 Sinkhorn-logit 映射为全局图、logit 梯度等于 Fisher-Rao 梯度，从而 logit 梯度流服从平方 Fisher-Rao 度量、straight-through 更新即熵镜像下降；再分析顶点邻近时对数条目速率与 Sinkhorn 局部收敛因子 σ2²。
Result: 差通道每层收缩至 σ2 ≤ 1 − n·min H_ij，视野为 1/(1−σ2) 层，非负混合中仅置换不塌缩；logit 梯度流下每条目对数速率至多 4n³‖∇f‖∞·ε，逼近与离开顶点为 1/t 速率，镜像下降为指数速率；Sinkhorn 局部收敛因子为 σ2²，固定迭代预算限制视野。摘要称实验验证了这些预测速率。
Conclusion: mHC 的额外宽度是会衰减的记忆，其有效视野由 σ2 与 Sinkhorn 迭代预算共同决定；要让宽度真正起作用，需让混合接近置换并保证足够的 Sinkhorn 迭代。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Collective intelligence through aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Suppose a committee, expert panel, or other group is making judgments on some issues, where these may be not just yes/no-questions, such as whether a defendant is guilty, but also variables with many possible values, such as macroeconomic or meteorological variables or travel directions. Furthermore, there may be interconnections between different issues, as in the case of economic or climate variables. How can the group arrive at "intelligent" collective judgments, based on the group members' individual judgments? We investigate three challenges raised by this judgment-aggregation problem. First, reasonable methods of aggregation (such as defining the collective judgment for each issue as the average or median judgment) can produce inconsistent collective judgments. Secondly, many methods of aggregation are manipulable by strategic voting. Finally, not all methods of aggregation are conducive to tracking the truth on the issues in question. We prove new impossibility or possibility theorems on all three challenges, identifying what it takes to produce collective judgments in a consistent, non-manipulable, and truth-tracking manner and thereby to achieve collective intelligence through aggregation. Overall, the median method, though imperfect, performs reasonably well. We also note the relevance of our analysis for non-human group decisions.
papers.comment: This is a preprint of a paper published in Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B (2026) 381 (1948): 20240454
papers.journal_ref: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B (2026) 381 (1948): 20240454
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在判断聚合 (judgment aggregation) 框架下证明三类新不可能性/可能性定理：聚合方法要同时做到集体判断一致、不可被策略性投票操纵、且能追踪真相，需要满足特定条件。结论是中位数方法虽不完美但表现相对合理，并指出该分析对非人类群体决策同样适用。
Motivation: 委员会或专家组对多值变量（宏观经济、气象变量、行进方向）且议题间相互关联时做集体判断，平均或中位数等合理聚合可能产生逻辑不一致、可被策略投票操纵、且不利于追踪真相，三者难以兼得。
Method: 围绕判断聚合问题的三个挑战——聚合结果的不一致性、聚合方法的策略可操纵性、以及聚合方法对真相的追踪能力——分别证明新的不可能性定理与可能性定理，刻画同时满足一致、不可操纵、追踪真相的条件，并比较平均、中位数等具体聚合规则。
Result: 给出三类挑战上新的不可能性/可能性定理，识别出产生一致、不可操纵且追踪真相的集体判断所需条件；定性结论是中位数方法虽有缺陷但表现相对合理。
Conclusion: 同时实现集体判断的一致、抗操纵与真相追踪存在结构性限制，中位数聚合是其中相对稳健的选择；分析框架可推广到非人类群体决策。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Considering Context: When World Models Need Context Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Methods for generalization in model-based reinforcement learning typically assume that an agent cannot recover the latent context governing the environment dynamics from its own experience, and therefore supplies it externally. We formalize and test this assumption with \emph{predictive sufficiency}, which quantifies what access to the context adds to next-step prediction under the visitation distribution an agent induces, and separates that quantity into a history-recoverable part, a residual requiring the true context, and the deficit added by a finite model. We classify context-aware algorithms by the predictive risk their conditioning set can target and demonstrate across environments of increasing identification difficulty that the headroom does not follow the MDP class. The same task under different priors leaves predictive headroom in one setting and nothing distinguishable from zero in another, where the agent's behavior implicitly identifies the context and any benefit of such a mechanism cannot be attributed to missing information. Where headroom persists, the learned state exposes it only partially, and adding the true context still lowers the risk. Our contribution is a practical criterion for matching contextual mechanisms to the information available to them, estimated from the ordinary trained agent without a reference policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在基于模型的强化学习中提出 predictive sufficiency，量化在智能体自身访问分布下外部上下文对下一步预测的增益，并拆成历史可恢复部分、需要真实上下文的残差与有限模型带来的 deficit。跨识别难度递增的环境测试显示 headroom 不随 MDP 类别走：同一任务换先验后，一处仍有 headroom，另一处则降到与零无异，此时智能体行为已隐式识别上下文。
Motivation: 基于模型的 RL 的泛化方法通常默认智能体无法从自身经验中恢复决定环境动力学的潜在上下文，因而外部提供该上下文；这一假设此前未被形式化检验，且可能在某些设定下根本不成立。
Method: 形式化定义 predictive sufficiency，把上下文对下一步预测的贡献分解为历史可恢复部分、需要真实上下文的残差、以及有限模型引入的 deficit；按条件化集合所能瞄准的预测风险对 context-aware 算法分类，并在识别难度递增的一组环境上测试，估计量直接来自普通训练好的智能体、无需参考策略。
Result: 跨识别难度递增的环境，headroom 不随 MDP 类别变化；同一任务在不同先验下，一个设定留下 predictive headroom，另一个设定的 headroom 与零无从区分，此时收益不能归因于缺失信息；在 headroom 仍存在的设定中，学习到的状态只部分暴露它，加入真实上下文仍进一步降低预测风险。
Conclusion: 上下文机制应按其可获得的信息量来匹配：当智能体行为已隐式识别上下文时，外部上下文机制的收益并非来自信息缺失；作者给出的判据可从普通训练智能体直接估计、无需参考策略。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Representation-Space MMD for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a post-training method for diffusion language models (DLMs) that minimizes Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) between generated and reference distributions in the feature space of a frozen pretrained DLM. To estimate MMD, we retain contextual features at individual token positions, obtaining multiple observations per sequence from a single extractor pass. We optimize this objective using policy gradients for discrete models and direct differentiation through generated latents for continuous models. In both cases, computing the loss directly from these features enables efficient post-training without full sampling trajectories or jointly trained auxiliary models. Experiments show lower generative perplexity at comparable entropy on OpenWebText and better accuracy-computation trade-offs on GSM8K. On 16B DMax-LLaDA2.0 models with hybrid masked-uniform diffusion, we increase decoding parallelism with similar or higher accuracy on math and code benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种扩散语言模型 (DLM) 后训练方法：在冻结的预训练 DLM 特征空间中最小化生成分布与参考分布的 MMD，通过保留逐 token 位置的上下文特征，单次提取器前向即可得到每序列多个观测。用策略梯度优化离散模型、对连续模型的生成 latent 直接求导，无需完整采样轨迹或联合训练的辅助模型；在 OpenWebText 上同等熵下生成困惑度更低，GSM8K 上精度-计算权衡更好，16B DMax-LLaDA2.0 上提高解码并行度且精度持平或更高。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型的后训练通常依赖完整采样轨迹或额外训练的辅助判别/奖励模型，成本高；需要一种直接在特征空间对齐生成与参考分布的高效目标。
Method: 在冻结预训练 DLM 的特征空间中计算生成分布与参考分布的 Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD)；为估计 MMD，在单次提取器前向中保留每个 token 位置的上下文特征，使一条序列产生多个观测。离散模型用 policy gradient 优化，连续模型对生成 latent 直接求导，损失直接由这些特征算出，不需完整采样轨迹或联合训练的辅助模型。
Result: 在 OpenWebText 上，同等熵条件下生成 perplexity 更低；在 GSM8K 上给出更好的 accuracy-computation 权衡；在 16B DMax-LLaDA2.0（hybrid masked-uniform diffusion）上提高解码并行度，同时在数学与代码基准上精度持平或更高。
Conclusion: 在冻结 DLM 特征空间上直接优化 MMD，可作为无需采样轨迹与辅助模型的通用 DLM 后训练目标，同时改善生成质量与解码效率。
Relevance: 0
