papers.title: AffordCraft: Scalable Construction of Task-Ready Simulation Assets from Single Images
papers.abstract_en: Robot learning in simulation depends on the objects the simulator offers. Many tasks need objects with separate parts, joints that allow the required motion, and physical properties that remain valid under contact. Existing methods recover this structure anew for every image: generative models predict parts and joints that mostly fail to settle or move in simulation, and general-purpose agents need a long session of model calls for each photograph. AffordCraft builds such an asset from a single RGB image and a task instruction by retrieval instead of generation: it locates the object and the part to operate, selects a matching entry from a library of articulated assets, and fits it to the image while keeping its parts and joints intact. Without any box or mask marking the object, AffordCraft produces a physically valid asset for 1,703 of 2,000 photographs from 31 categories. Five generative methods pass on at most 45% of the same photographs and, at the median, need 10 to 78 times our GPU time per valid asset. On 50 cluttered images, 162 of 237 annotated objects pass the same physical test after automatic detection. Growing the library from 141 to 11,372 entries needs no change to the method and raises category coverage from 46% to 100% and the share of selections with the requested label from 18% to 51%. We also build manipulation tasks from the constructed assets, both with single objects and in composed scenes; policies trained on scripted demonstrations complete both kinds of tasks from initial states unseen in training.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 14 figures, 17 tables. Project page: https://affordcraft.github.io Code: https://github.com/AffordCraft/AffordCraft
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AffordCraft 用检索而非生成的方式，从单张 RGB 图像加一条任务指令构造可用于仿真的铰接物体资产：定位物体与操作部件，从铰接资产库中选匹配条目并拟合到图像，同时保持部件与关节完好。无需任何框或掩码标注，2,000 张照片中 1,703 张产出物理有效资产，五种生成式方法最多只有 45% 通过，且中位数每产出一个有效资产需要 10 至 78 倍 GPU 时间。
Motivation: 机器人仿真依赖模拟器提供的物体，但许多任务需要带独立部件、允许所需运动的关节以及在接触下仍有效的物理属性；现有方法对每张图像重新生成结构，生成的部件与关节大多无法在仿真中稳定或运动，通用智能体则需对每张照片做长串模型调用。
Method: 采用检索式管线：定位物体与待操作部件，从铰接资产库中选取匹配条目，再将该条目拟合到图像且不破坏其部件与关节；随后用构造出的资产搭建操作任务（单物体与组合场景），并以脚本演示训练策略。
Result: 无需框或掩码，2,000 张照片中 1,703 张产出物理有效资产（31 个类别）；五种生成式方法在同一照片集上最多 45% 通过，中位数每有效资产耗时为本方法的 10 至 78 倍。50 张杂乱图像中，自动检测后 237 个标注物体有 162 个通过同一物理测试。资产库从 141 条扩到 11,372 条无需改动方法，类别覆盖从 46% 升到 100%，选中条目标签符合请求的比例从 18% 升到 51%。在脚本演示上训练的策略能完成训练中未见初始状态的单物体与组合场景任务。
Conclusion: 从库中检索并拟合现成铰接资产，比逐图重新生成更能稳定产出物理有效、任务就绪的仿真物体，且库规模扩大可直接提升类别覆盖与标签命中率。

papers.title: Beyond the Model: The Critical Role of Data Filtering in Clinical Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) studies using clinical data often rely on preprocessing and filtering pipelines before model development. The filtering decisions made in these pipelines can alter the dataset's statistical structure and may artificially reduce or increase the complexity of the prediction task. We argue that filtering choices should be treated as part of the scientific method rather than as a routine preprocessing step. We further discuss the need for explainable and transparent preprocessing pipelines that allow researchers to understand why specific filtering choices are made and how these choices affect the resulting data distribution and model performance. All of the source code for this work is available on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 临床机器学习中的数据过滤与预处理决策会改变数据集的统计结构，并可能人为地降低或抬高预测任务的难度。作者主张把过滤选择当作科学方法的一部分来对待，而不是例行的预处理步骤，并要求预处理管线可解释、透明，能说明为何做某项过滤以及它如何影响数据分布与模型性能。
Motivation: 临床 ML 研究在建模前普遍套用过滤管线，但这些决策悄悄重塑数据分布、扭曲任务难度，且通常不被当作需要论证的科学选择，导致结果难以复现与解释。
Method: 论证型工作：把过滤决策重新定位为科学方法的组成部分，并提出可解释、透明的预处理管线需求，使研究者能追踪每项过滤的理由及其对数据分布与模型性能的影响；源码在 GitHub 开源。
Result: 核心论断为过滤选择会改变数据集的统计结构，并可能人为降低或提高预测任务的复杂度；摘要给出的是这一机制性主张与透明管线的设计要求，无实验指标。
Conclusion: 临床 ML 的过滤决策应作为需论证的科学选择并配套可解释管线，而非默认的例行预处理。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Differentially Private Mixing of Public Datasets Improves Private Learning
papers.abstract_en: Many machine learning applications involve sensitive data and therefore require training under differential privacy (DP). However, DP training often degrades model utility. In some cases, first pre-training the model on "public" data before finetuning with DP on the sensitive data can reduce the drop in utility. However, the success of this depends on how relevant the selected public dataset is to the sensitive data. We introduce the first pipeline that privately learns the mixture of several public datasets to pretrain on for a given sensitive downstream task. Our key insight is that we can privately find the best mixture of multiple public datasets by privately learning a low-dimensional linear model. We tested our method on the NIH dataset for X-ray classification and the ENRON email dataset for language modeling. Applying our method to find tailored mixtures of X-ray datasets to pretrain on for diseases in the NIH ChestX-ray14 dataset, we improved macro AUC by up to 0.037 across privacy budgets compared to the baselines, with gains as large as +22.8% relative AUC on Cardiomegaly at $ε=1$. For DP training on the ENRON dataset, pre-training on our mixture of The Common Pile (a collection of public-domain text datasets) decreased test perplexity by 16% relative to the baseline mixtures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出首个在差分隐私约束下学习“多个公开数据集混合比例”的预训练管线：把混合选择本身建模为低维线性模型并私有求解，再用该混合做 DP 预训练与下游微调。在 NIH ChestX-ray14 上相对基线混合 macro AUC 最多提升 0.037，Cardiomegaly 在 ε=1 时相对 AUC 提升达 +22.8%；在 ENRON 语言建模上，用其混合的 The Common Pile 预训练使测试困惑度相对基线混合下降 16%。
Motivation: DP 训练会显著损害模型效用，先在公开数据上预训练再 DP 微调可以缓解，但效果取决于所选公开数据集与敏感任务的相关性，而这一选择此前无法在隐私约束下自动完成。
Method: 把“为给定敏感下游任务挑选多个公开数据集的最优混合”这一问题私有地转化为一个低维线性模型的学习问题，在隐私预算内求解混合比例，再用得到的混合做预训练与 DP 微调；评测覆盖 NIH ChestX-ray14 的疾病分类与 ENRON 邮件的语言建模。
Result: 在 NIH ChestX-ray14 上，用其方法得到的 X-ray 数据集混合预训练，各隐私预算下 macro AUC 相对基线最多提升 0.037，Cardiomegaly 在 ε=1 时相对 AUC 提升 +22.8%；在 ENRON 上，用其混合的 The Common Pile（公共领域文本集合）预训练使测试困惑度相对基线混合下降 16%。
Conclusion: 在隐私预算内私有地学习公开数据集混合比例是可行的，且能为敏感下游任务带来比固定基线混合更高的 DP 训练效用。

papers.title: Inverse Cross-spectral Neural Networks for Multivariate Time Series
papers.abstract_en: CoVariance Neural Networks and their extensions have emerged as effective tools for processing multivariate data, deriving graph shift operators directly from second-order statistics. These architectures, however, are designed for independent and identically distributed observations and do not fully capture the joint structure of temporal and cross-variable dependencies in multivariate time series. In this work, we introduce Inverse Cross-Spectral Neural Networks (iCSNNs), a class of graph neural networks for stationary multivariate time series whose shift operators are the inverse cross-spectral density (iCSD) matrices. These operators encode frequency-specific conditional relationships among variables, exploiting the decomposition provided by the spectral representation theorem. Leveraging spectral smoothness, frequencies are grouped into bands sharing a single iCSD operator, yielding a compact parametrisation that retains the frequency-dependent structure of the process. We further propose a joint learning procedure to estimate both the Fourier-domain dependence structure and the iCSNN parameters, adapting the iCSD operators to the downstream task. When tested on synthetic data, iCSNN outperforms baselines from different methodological families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出逆互谱神经网络 (iCSNN)：把平稳多元时间序列的图移位算子取为逆互谱密度 (iCSD) 矩阵，用谱表示定理编码变量间随频率变化的条件依赖，并按谱平滑性把频率分带共享同一 iCSD 算子以压缩参数。联合学习程序同时估计 Fourier 域依赖结构与网络参数，使算子适配下游任务；在合成数据上优于来自不同方法族的基线。
Motivation: CoVariance Neural Networks 及其扩展直接从二阶统计量导出图移位算子，但假设观测独立同分布，无法同时刻画多元时间序列中时间与跨变量依赖的联合结构。
Method: iCSNN 属于图神经网络类，其移位算子为逆互谱密度 (iCSD) 矩阵，借谱表示定理给出频率特异的变量间条件关系；利用谱平滑性将频率分带、每带共享一个 iCSD 算子，得到保留过程频率依赖结构的紧凑参数化；再提出联合学习程序，同时估计 Fourier 域依赖结构与 iCSNN 参数，使 iCSD 算子随下游任务自适应。
Result: 在合成数据 (synthetic data) 上测试，iCSNN 的表现超过来自不同方法学家族的基线。
Conclusion: 把逆互谱密度作为图移位算子并联合估计依赖结构与网络参数，是处理平稳多元时间序列、捕捉频率相关跨变量依赖的一条可行路径，其证据目前建立在合成数据上。

papers.title: On the Cardinality of Optimal Representations in the Binary-Source Information Bottleneck
papers.abstract_en: The information bottleneck (IB) seeks a representation $U$ of a source $X$ that retains as much information as possible about a target $Y$, subject to a constraint on $I(U;X)$. A classical argument shows that it suffices to consider representations with at most $|\mathcal{X}|+1$ symbols, and this bound is known to be tight whenever $|\mathcal{X}| \geq 3$. We show that the binary case behaves differently: if $X$ is binary and $Y$ is finite, then for every joint distribution of $(X,Y)$ and every rate constraint, the IB optimum is attained by a binary $U$. Hence the bound $|\mathcal{U}| \leq |\mathcal{X}|+1$ sharpens to $|\mathcal{U}| \leq |\mathcal{X}|$ for binary sources. The proof combines a separating hyperplane argument with the observation that, for a binary source, the ratio of the second derivatives of the two entropy functions involved is concave.
papers.comment: 9 pages. Feedback and comments are welcome!
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 信息瓶颈 (IB) 的经典结论只保证最优表示 U 的符号数不超过 |X|+1，且在 |X|≥3 时该界是紧的。本文证明二元源情形更紧：X 为二元、Y 有限时，对任意 (X,Y) 联合分布和任意速率约束，IB 最优解都可取为二元 U，即 |U|≤|X|。
Motivation: 经典 |X|+1 的表示基数上界在二元源下并非紧，最优表示可能用到多余符号，需要判定二元情形的真实基数界。
Method: 结合分离超平面 (separating hyperplane) 论证与一个凸性观察：二元源下两个熵函数的二阶导数之比为凹函数，据此推出最优 U 可取二元。
Result: 对任意二元 X、有限 Y 的联合分布与任意速率约束，IB 最优解由二元 U 达到，基数界由 |X|+1 收紧到 |X|；对照经典界在 |X|≥3 时是紧的。
Conclusion: 二元源的信息瓶颈最优表示基数界为 |U|≤|X|，与 |X|≥3 时 |X|+1 紧界的行为本质不同。

papers.title: Large Language Model-Guided Discovery of Weight-Five Bivariate Bicycle Codes
papers.abstract_en: Building on our earlier program-evolution workflow guided by large language models (LLMs), we study weight-five bivariate bicycle (BB) and perturbed bivariate bicycle (PBB) codes. The resulting catalogue contains 1,142 distinct code proposals, including 1,081 nonbaseline proposals attributable to LLM-generated programs. Across the catalogue, we certify connected Calderbank--Shor--Steane (CSS) realizations [[96,4,10]], [[140,6,10]], and [[180,4,14]]. A post-search comparison certifies seven imported Lin--Pryadko archive constructions. For leading parameter triples also represented in that archive, we provide exact distance evidence, explicit bivariate presentations, and verified component reductions. A basis-independent connectivity analysis identifies 409 of the 1,142 catalogue entries as disconnected and shows that 73.1\% of the classes with exact distance certificates contain repeated connected components. Algebraic analysis organizes the connected CSS classes into order-3, order-7, and order-15 cyclotomic-kernel strata. The strongest exact connected PBB parameter point is [[216,4,10]], attained by two distinct component classes. Among the 936 distinct CSS proposals from the LLM-guided campaign with a recorded positive distance, 816 (87.18\%) are certified at $d\geq5$. For comparison, three random-search controls each sample 6,444 CSS code proposals uniformly without replacement, using the same per-lattice and encoded-dimension sample counts as the LLM-guided campaign. In these controls, 4,672--4,785 proposals (72.50--74.26\%) meet the same criterion. The LLM-guided campaign has the higher certified yield, while the random controls cover more connected classes. Together, these results extend LLM-guided discovery to a more constrained code family and provide a reproducible structural and exact-distance account of its strongest candidates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 LLM 引导的程序进化流程搜索 weight-five bivariate bicycle (BB) 与 perturbed bivariate bicycle (PBB) 码，产出 1,142 个候选（其中 1,081 个来自 LLM 生成程序的非基线提案）。认证出 [[96,4,10]]、[[140,6,10]]、[[180,4,14]] 与最强连通 PBB 点 [[216,4,10]]；LLM 引导战役中 936 个有正距离记录的 CSS 提案里 816 个（87.18%）达到 d≥5，高于随机对照的 72.50–74.26%，但随机对照覆盖更多连通类。
Motivation: 在更受限的 BB/PBB 码族中扩展 LLM 引导的程序进化发现流程，并给出可复现的结构性与精确距离刻画，以判断 LLM 引导搜索相对随机搜索的收益边界。

papers.title: Frozen Factor or Spectral Band? Disentangling Two Choices in Low-Rank LoRA
papers.abstract_en: Spectral variants of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) choose both a subspace and which factor to freeze. We separate these choices by freezing the input factor A or output factor B on the top or bottom singular directions of pretrained weights, with learning rates selected separately. At rank 2, the same-band advantage of freezing A is larger than either within-factor band difference on all four task-model pairs with complete comparisons. Freezing B also trails comparable-budget free LoRA by 8-18 percentage points on five pairs spanning a formatting task and OpenBookQA. The A-frozen advantage persists in a single-GPU-model replication and within individual MLP module groups, including controls with equal or greater trainable counts for B frozen, and when A is frozen on a random orthonormal basis. The factor contrast weakens with rank. On OpenBookQA / Qwen2.5-1.5B at rank 16, PEFT's MiCA implementation trails comparable-budget LoRA by 3.08 points under a shared training recipe transferred from the MiCA paper. A trained oracle output subspace largely removes the low-rank deficit; partial warm-up gains recur across three direction seeds. The factor-versus-band ordering is descriptive; an approximate multiplicity audit weakens several earlier significance claims. These results extend known factor asymmetry by showing how its magnitude depends on spectral placement, rank and training conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在低秩 LoRA 的谱变体里，「冻哪个因子」比「选奇异谱的哪一段」更关键：在 rank 2 的四个完整对比任务-模型对上，冻结输入因子 A 的同带优势都大于任一因子内的带间差异；冻结 B 在五个任务-模型对上比同等预算的自由 LoRA 低 8–18 个百分点。该因子优势在单卡复现、逐 MLP 模块组、B 可训练参数持平或更多的对照、以及 A 冻在随机正交基上时都保持，但随 rank 增大而减弱。
Motivation: 谱 LoRA 变体同时做了「选子空间」和「冻哪个因子」两个选择，二者混在一起，无法判断性能差异究竟来自谱带位置还是因子不对称，也难以解释已有显著性主张。
Method: 把两个选择解耦：分别在预训练权重的顶部或底部奇异方向上冻结输入因子 A 或输出因子 B，学习率分别调优；在四个任务-模型对上做完整对比，含单卡复现、逐 MLP 模块组、B 等量或更多可训练参数的控制、以及 A 冻在随机正交基上的控制；另用 PEFT 的 MiCA 实现在共享训练配方下对照，并做近似多重性审计 (multiplicity audit)。
Result: rank 2 时冻结 A 的同带优势在四个完整对比任务-模型对上均大于任一因子内带间差异；冻结 B 在横跨格式任务与 OpenBookQA 的五个对上比同等预算 LoRA 低 8–18 个百分点；OpenBookQA / Qwen2.5-1.5B 在 rank 16 上 MiCA 比同等预算 LoRA 低 3.08 点（共享自 MiCA 论文的训练配方）；训练得到的 oracle 输出子空间基本消除低秩亏损，部分 warm-up 增益在三个方向种子上复现；因子对比随 rank 增大而减弱，近似多重性审计削弱了若干早前的显著性主张。
Conclusion: 已知的因子不对称其幅度取决于谱带位置、rank 与训练条件，因子与谱带的排序是描述性的而非强显著结论；选谱 LoRA 变体时应优先看冻 A 还是冻 B，其次才看谱带。

papers.title: RealtimeWAM: One-Step Asynchronous World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) incorporate visual representations from video generation backbones to guide action prediction. Recent efficient WAMs adopt Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architectures and compute video representations once for reuse by the action expert. However, intra-expert iteration (\ie, multi-step action denoising) and inter-expert waiting (\ie, sequential execution of the video and action experts) still limit inference efficiency. To this end, we present RealtimeWAM, an extremely efficient WAM variant with one-step action generation and asynchronous inference, addressing these two bottlenecks. To reduce intra-expert iteration, we propose Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD) to address a local-global error gap: low local consistency error alone does not guarantee accurate final actions. TACD supplements local consistency with explicit supervision from the frozen teacher's multi-step rollout endpoint, enabling accurate one-step action generation. Additionally, we propose Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (CEWP) to eliminate unnecessary expert-level waiting. It overlaps the two experts through block-wise sharing of the video KV cache, synchronizing only immediately before the corresponding action attention consumes it. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks (\eg, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin) and model variants (\eg, Fast-WAM and Faster-WAM) demonstrate the superiority of RealtimeWAM. Notably, RealtimeWAM maintains near-lossless performance (\ie, $<1\%$ drop) across these benchmarks while delivering significant end-to-end speedup (\eg, $\sim25\times$ on H100). Our code and checkpoints are available via this \href{https://github.com/ModelTC/LightX2V/tree/main/examples/realtimewam}{link}.
papers.comment: The code and checkpoints are available at $\href{https://github.com/ModelTC/LightX2V/tree/main/examples/realtimewam}{\text{this https URL}}$
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RealtimeWAM 把世界行动模型 (World Action Model) 的多步动作去噪压到一步，并让视频专家与动作专家异步流水执行：TACD 用冻结教师多步 rollout 终点的显式监督补足局部一致性蒸馏的误差缺口，CEWP 按块共享视频 KV cache、只在动作注意力消费前同步。在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 上相对 Fast-WAM / Faster-WAM 性能下降 <1%，H100 上端到端加速约 25×。
Motivation: 高效 WAM 用 MoT 架构并让视频表征只算一次，但动作专家的多步去噪 (intra-expert iteration) 与视频、动作专家的串行等待 (inter-expert waiting) 仍卡住推理效率；只压低局部一致性误差也不保证最终动作准确。
Method: 提出 Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD)：在局部一致性损失之外加入冻结教师多步 rollout 终点的显式监督，实现一步动作生成；再提出 Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (CEWP)，按块共享视频 KV cache，把两个专家重叠执行，仅在对应动作注意力消费该块前同步。
Result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 上，相对 Fast-WAM 与 Faster-WAM 等模型变体，性能下降 <1%（near-lossless），同时端到端加速约 25×（H100）。
Conclusion: 一步动作生成加跨专家异步流水可以在几乎不损失任务性能的前提下把 WAM 推理提速一个量级，两个瓶颈（多步去噪与专家间等待）可分别用蒸馏与 KV cache 流水消除。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Video Encoders Built on Image Representations
papers.abstract_en: The design of a video encoder determines when frames begin to interact and which frame-specific visual evidence remains accessible to the language model. Native video pathways couple neighboring frames during visual encoding, whereas image pathways preserve independently computed frame representations but incur a much larger visual-token cost when all image tokens are forwarded. We ask a basic question: whether a compact video encoder can instead be built on image representations. To answer this question, we separate three operations that are often coupled: per-frame representation, cross-frame token allocation, and temporal interaction. A frozen image encoder first produces frame-specific candidates. A question-aware selector then allocates a fixed token budget across frames using relevance, diversity, and cross-frame correspondence, after which a lightweight learned refiner reads neighboring-frame context and writes residual updates only to the retained anchors. This preserves source positions and keeps the visual output at the fixed budget. Across 13 benchmarks and three vision-language backbones, the resulting pathway matches full-image aggregate performance while using only about 28%-35% of its visual tokens. Specifically, on Qwen3-VL-8B, it achieves a 13-benchmark macro-average of 62.75 with 1,535 visual tokens, compared with 62.58 for the full Image pathway at 4,424 tokens and 59.49 for native Conv3D at 2,212 tokens. On Qwen3-VL-32B, it reaches a 13-benchmark macro-average of 66.28, compared with 66.09 for Image, while providing a 2.16x end-to-end speedup. These results show that compact video encoding does not require early temporal mixing: frame-specific evidence can be preserved first, allocated jointly, and temporally contextualized after selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把视频编码器拆成三步：冻结图像编码器逐帧提特征，question-aware selector 在固定 token 预算内按相关性、多样性和跨帧对应性分配帧间 token，轻量 refiner 只对保留的 anchor 写入邻帧残差更新。在 13 个 benchmark、三种 VLM backbone 上，该路径用约 28%-35% 的视觉 token 达到全图像路径的聚合性能；Qwen3-VL-8B 上宏平均 62.75（1,535 token）对 Image 62.58（4,424 token）与 Conv3D 59.49（2,212 token），Qwen3-VL-32B 上 66.28 对 66.09 并带来 2.16 倍端到端加速。
Motivation: 原生视频路径在视觉编码阶段就耦合相邻帧，图像路径保留逐帧独立表示但把全部 image token 转发给 LLM，视觉 token 成本过高；需要在不牺牲帧级证据的前提下压缩视频编码。
Method: 解耦逐帧表示、跨帧 token 分配与时序交互三个操作：冻结图像编码器产生逐帧候选，question-aware selector 依据 relevance、diversity 与 cross-frame correspondence 在固定预算内跨帧分配 token，随后轻量可学习 refiner 读取邻帧上下文、仅对保留的 anchor 写残差更新，保持源位置与固定输出预算。
Result: 在 13 个 benchmark 与三种 vision-language backbone 上，该路径以约 28%-35% 的视觉 token 匹配全图像路径的聚合性能。Qwen3-VL-8B 上 13-benchmark 宏平均 62.75（1,535 visual tokens），对比全 Image 路径 62.58（4,424 tokens）与原生 Conv3D 59.49（2,212 tokens）；Qwen3-VL-32B 上 66.28 对 Image 的 66.09，端到端加速 2.16 倍。
Conclusion: 紧凑视频编码不需要早期时序混合：先保留帧级证据、再联合分配、最后在选择之后做时序上下文化，即可在大幅削减视觉 token 的同时保持性能并提速。

papers.title: FREA: A Multi-Source Expert Benchmark for Reaction Feasibility Verification
papers.abstract_en: As generative models and AI agents propose chemical reactions at a scale beyond expert review, feasibility verifiers decide which proposals enter synthesis planning. But do their decisions agree with chemists across different kinds of candidates? We introduce FREA, a benchmark of 751 reactions labeled by expert chemists under an explicit feasibility criterion, drawn from retrosynthesis model proposals, zero-yield experimental records, edits by large language models (LLMs), and five negative candidate generation methods. Our evaluation finds that no verifier leads across all sources: LLMs given only the criterion are competitive with dedicated verifiers, while forward models perform best on retrosynthesis proposals but reject most feasible edits of recorded reactions at the evaluated operating points. Looking beyond aggregate scores, both forward models perform below chance when separating infeasible alternative disconnections from feasible generated candidates. To study whether negative supervision addresses these weaknesses, we also release a corpus of over 14 million recorded reactions and generated negative candidates. In matched training comparisons, adding a mixture of generated negatives to forward training raises mean AUROC across sources, but these gains do not extend to retrosynthesis proposals. Varying the generation method further shows that the largest gain on generated candidates coincides with worse proposal screening. These findings motivate evaluating verifiers against experts across sources and designing negatives for transfer to model proposals.

papers.title: Lens3D: Target-Conditioned Visual Foveation for Fine-Grained 3D Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Existing 3D large language models often overlook fine-grained attributes and less visually salient objects and parts, even when relevant evidence is present in scene videos. We introduce Lens3D to improve fine-grained object understanding through external visual assistance and knowledge transfer. Its LensUnd pipeline adopts 3D localization to select informative, complementary views for an external 2D vision-language model, supporting fine-grained object captioning, small-object grounding, and fine-grained object question answering. LensDistill transfers the resulting fine-grained knowledge to 3D LLMs through detailed caption supervision, enabling captioning from native inputs without external VLM calls. We also construct LensBench, a held-out evaluation set of 2,068 objects with three silver-standard reference descriptions per object. Experiments with Video-3D LLM and 3DRS demonstrate that LensDistill substantially improves fine-grained object captioning while preserving existing grounding and scene-level QA performance. These results establish the feasibility of transferring externally acquired fine-grained knowledge into native 3D LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Lens3D 用 3D 定位挑出互补视角喂给外部 2D VLM（LensUnd），再把细粒度描述蒸馏进 3D LLM（LensDistill），使其无需外部调用即可生成细粒度描述。在自建 LensBench（2,068 个物体、每个 3 条 silver-standard 参考描述）上，Video-3D LLM 与 3DRS 的细粒度物体描述显著提升，同时保持原有 grounding 与场景级 QA 性能。
Motivation: 3D 大语言模型常忽略细粒度属性与视觉上不显著的物体、部件，即使场景视频中已有相关证据。
Method: LensUnd 管线用 3D 定位选择信息量高且互补的视角，交给外部 2D 视觉-语言模型，支持细粒度物体描述、小物体 grounding 与细粒度物体问答；LensDistill 再以详细描述监督把外部知识蒸馏进 3D LLM，使其直接从原生输入生成描述。
Result: 构建 LensBench：2,068 个 held-out 物体，每个物体 3 条 silver-standard 参考描述。在 Video-3D LLM 与 3DRS 上的实验显示 LensDistill 显著提升细粒度物体描述，同时保持既有 grounding 与场景级 QA 性能。
Conclusion: 外部获取的细粒度知识可以蒸馏进原生 3D LLM，使其在不调用外部 VLM 的情况下完成细粒度描述。

papers.title: The Surrogate Is Not the Reward: Post-Surrogate Primary-Outcome Acquisition in Contextual Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We study contextual bandits in which a surrogate is observed after the action but before the learner decides whether to acquire the primary outcome that defines action value and regret. The value of acquiring the primary outcome depends on both decision relevance (how much the current outcome matters for comparing policies) and the residual uncertainty after observing the surrogate. The Audited Surrogate Bandit (ASB) learns a contextual policy while allocating a budget of $B$ primary-outcome acquisitions over $T$ rounds. ASB sets a pre-surrogate acquisition level from current decision relevance and, after observing the surrogate, redistributes that level using an estimate of that residual uncertainty. For a finite class of $N$ policies over $K$ actions, ASB incurs $\widetilde O[\sqrt{KT\log N}\{1+\sqrt{T/B}\}]$ regret relative to the best policy in the class. In a two-action family where the surrogate does not reveal the better action, a learner that observes the surrogate before deciding whether to acquire can achieve bounded regret, whereas any learner that must decide before seeing the surrogate incurs $Ω(T/B)$ worst-case regret under the same budget. Synthetic experiments show that both acquisition factors matter: ASB has lower regret than variants using only decision relevance or only residual uncertainty. On a KuaiRec benchmark of user-video interactions, the regret gap relative to relevance-only acquisition widens and then narrows as the budget grows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在代理变量 (surrogate) 于动作后、主结果获取决策前可见的 contextual bandit 中，Audited Surrogate Bandit (ASB) 先按决策相关性设定获取水平，再用代理观测后的残差不确定性重新分配预算 B。对 N 个策略、K 个动作的有限类，其 regret 为 Õ[√(KT log N){1+√(T/B)}]；两动作构造中先看代理再决定可实现有界 regret，而先决定者在同预算下最坏为 Ω(T/B)。
Motivation: 主结果 (定义动作价值与 regret) 获取昂贵，只能在 T 轮中花 B 次；何时获取取决于决策相关性与观测代理后的残差不确定性，而标准 bandit 算法必须在看到代理前决定，损失可随 T/B 线性放大。
Method: ASB 在代理观测前按当前决策相关性设定获取水平，观测代理后依据残差不确定性估计重新分配；理论分析覆盖 N 策略、K 动作的有限策略类，并给出两动作信息论下界构造，另用合成实验与 KuaiRec 用户-视频交互基准检验两个获取因子。
Result: 有限类 regret 上界为 Õ[√(KT log N){1+√(T/B)}]；两动作族中后置决策者可有界 regret，前置决策者最坏 Ω(T/B)。合成实验中 ASB regret 低于只用决策相关性或只用残差不确定性的变体；KuaiRec 上相对 relevance-only 的 regret 差距随预算先扩大后收窄。
Conclusion: 代理不是奖励：把主结果获取推迟到观测代理之后，能同时利用决策相关性与残差不确定性，从而在同预算下显著降低 regret。

papers.title: Separators Make Carry Propagation Learnable:The Geometry of Latent Carry in a Multiplication Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Transformers asked to multiply multi-digit numbers in a single forward pass often fail, and interpretability studies of pretrained language models find arithmetic solved by input-range heuristics rather than by an explicit carry. We train small Llama-style transformers from scratch on 4x4 multiplication without chain of thought and find that the input format is decisive: inserting a space token between digits raises exact-match accuracy from 1% to 89%. Output positions are learned in carry-chain order, with the middle digits, which have the longest-range dependencies, learned last. Inside the model, the separator token that predicts each digit (its prediction slot) encodes the carry-in as an angle on a ring in the residual stream; examples with more distinct carry values fill more of the ring. Activation patching between examples matched on the column sum shows that this state is causally used before the last layer: patching the prediction slot alone transfers the source carry in up to 84% of cases after block 4 for one middle column of our best model, while for other columns the carry is first assembled at the neighboring answer slot before reaching its own. Remaining errors are almost always off by one, consistent with a small error on the carry or on the circular digit code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 4x4 乘法上从零训练的 Llama 式 Transformer，仅在数字间插入一个空格 token，exact-match 从 1% 升到 89%，说明显式分隔符让进位 (carry) 变得可学习。模型把 carry-in 编码为残差流中一个环上的角度，activation patching 显示该状态在最后一层之前就被因果使用：对最优模型的中间列，仅 patch 预测槽即可在 block 4 之后转移源 carry，最高 84%。
Motivation: 单次前向做多位数乘法的 Transformer 常失败，且可解释性研究发现预训练语言模型的算术靠输入范围启发式而非显式进位；本文追问输入格式与内部进位表征如何决定这一能力。
Method: 从零训练小型 Llama 式 Transformer 做 4x4 乘法、无 chain of thought，对比带与不带数字间空格 token 的输入格式；用 activation patching（按列和匹配样本对）定位 carry 的因果使用，并分析预测槽 (prediction slot) 在残差流中的表征几何。
Result: 插入空格 token 使 exact-match 从 1% 升到 89%；输出位置按进位链顺序学习，依赖最长的中间数字最后学会；carry-in 被编码为环上的角度，carry 取值更多样时填满更多环；在最优模型的某一中间列，仅 patch 预测槽在 block 4 之后可转移源 carry，最高 84%，其他列的 carry 先在相邻答案槽组装；残余错误几乎总是差 1。
Conclusion: 输入格式（数字间分隔符）决定进位是否被显式学习，且 carry 是被因果使用的环上表征；剩余错误与 carry 或环形数字编码的小误差一致。

papers.title: Word-Level Text Unmixing via Evidence-Preserving Ownership Routing with Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Text from multiple sources can become interleaved into a single sequence when attribution metadata is lost, such as overlapping speech transcripts, document reading flows, or concurrent agent streams. We formalize this challenge as Word-Level Text Unmixing: given an interleaved lexical stream and source count K, recover the original source sequences while preserving every word occurrence and its within-source order exactly. Directly generating separated texts with LLMs can omit, duplicate, or hallucinate words, violating this exact-reconstruction objective. We therefore propose Evidence-Preserving Ownership Routing (EPOR), which decouples source-ownership prediction from reconstruction. EPOR adapts a causal LLM to predict canonical ownership routes conditioned on the mixed stream and prior routing decisions. At inference, completion-safe constrained decoding is combined with deterministic indexed reconstruction, yielding structurally valid K-source partitions that preserve every observed occurrence exactly once. We also introduce UNMIXBENCH, covering controlled synthetic mixtures, timestamp-derived speech from AMI and ICSI, layout-derived document streams from ReadingBank, and simulated concurrent digital outputs. Across five evaluation tracks, a 4B EPOR model achieves the lowest mean minimum-permutation word error rate among finetuned baselines, reducing the five-track mean by 22.3% relative to compact source-array generation and remaining competitive with zero-shot frontier LLMs. These results show that when lexical evidence is fully observed, separating ownership inference from lexical regeneration provides a reliable alternative to direct generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EPOR 把多源交错文本的归属判定与重建解耦：用因果 LLM 预测 canonical ownership route，再以 completion-safe 约束解码加确定性索引重建，保证每个词恰好出现一次且源内顺序不变。在 UNMIXBENCH 五个评测轨上，4B EPOR 的平均最小置换词错误率 (WER) 比紧凑 source-array 生成基线相对降低 22.3%，并与零样本前沿 LLM 竞争。
Motivation: 归属元数据丢失后，重叠语音转写、文档阅读流、并发 agent 输出会交错成单一词序列；直接让 LLM 生成分离文本会漏词、重复或幻觉，破坏精确重建目标。
Method: EPOR 将源归属预测与词重建分离：因果 LLM 以混合流和先前路由决策为条件预测 canonical ownership route，推理时用 completion-safe 约束解码配合确定性索引重建，输出结构合法的 K 源划分。评测用 UNMIXBENCH，含受控合成混合、AMI 与 ICSI 的时间戳语音、ReadingBank 版面派生文档流，以及模拟并发数字输出。
Result: 在 UNMIXBENCH 五个评测轨上，4B EPOR 在微调基线中取得最低的平均最小置换词错误率，五轨均值相对紧凑 source-array 生成降低 22.3%，并与零样本前沿 LLM 保持竞争。
Conclusion: 当词级证据被完整观测时，把归属推断与词再生分开是直接生成的可靠替代方案。

papers.title: Multitask Conditional Generative Adversarial Network Enables Automatic Whole Knee Cartilage and Menisci Segmentation and Reliable T1\r{ho} and T2 Quantification Without High-Resolution Morphological Images
papers.abstract_en: Early osteoarthritis detection through quantitative MRI (qMRI) requires accurate cartilage and meniscus segmentation, traditionally necessitating time-consuming, costly 3D high-resolution Double Echo Steady-State (DESS) MRI scans. This study developed a multi-task conditional generative adversarial network (MT-cGAN) to simultaneously synthesize DESS-like images and segment tissues directly from qMRI echo images. This retrospective study evaluated 508 knee MRI volumes from 361 subjects (mean age: $40.4 \pm 12.2$ years; 179 female) across three cohorts. Ground truth segmentation masks were generated from DESS images using a pretrained model with manual correction, and $T_{1ρ}$ and $T_2$ maps were computed from magnetization-prepared angle-modulated partitioned $k$-space spoiled gradient echo snapshots (MAPSS) echo images. MT-cGAN was trained to jointly synthesize DESS-like images and segment cartilage and meniscus directly from echo images. Model performance was evaluated using Dice score for segmentation accuracy and coefficient of variation (CV) for $T_{1ρ}$ and $T_2$ quantification. MT-cGAN achieved the highest segmentation performance, mean Dice score 0.84 (range: 0.80--0.86) across all cartilage and meniscus compartments and significantly outperformed the state-of-the-art conditional GAN model with transfer learning (mean Dice, 0.82; $p < 0.001$, Wilcoxon signed-rank test). For relaxometry quantification, MT-cGAN demonstrated the highest consistency with the reference DESS protocol, yielding the lowest CV ($T_{1ρ}$: 1.84%, $T_2$: 1.81%). The proposed MT-cGAN accurately segmented cartilage and menisci while providing reliable $T_{1ρ}$ and $T_2$ quantification directly from echo images. By eliminating the need for separate morphological DESS scans, this workflow reduces required scan times to facilitate the clinical translation of qMRI.

TL;DR: 提出多任务条件生成对抗网络 MT-cGAN，从 qMRI 回波图像 (MAPSS) 同时合成 DESS 样图像并分割软骨与半月板，从而免去高分辨率形态学 DESS 扫描。在 508 例膝关节 MRI、361 名受试者的三个队列上，全腔室平均 Dice 0.84（范围 0.80–0.86），显著高于迁移学习的条件 GAN 基线 0.82（p<0.001，Wilcoxon 符号秩检验）；T1ρ 与 T2 定量的 CV 分别为 1.84% 和 1.81%，与参考 DESS 协议一致性最高。

papers.title: SimForcing: Distilling Simulation Motion Priors into Real-Domain Robot World Models
papers.abstract_en: Action-conditioned robot world models must respond precisely to robot trajectories while preserving realistic visual dynamics, yet learning both from heterogeneous robot videos remains challenging. Simulation offers structured motion supervision, but appearance differences hinder direct transfer, and inaccurate simulation predictions can misguide real-video generation. We present SimForcing, a simulation-guided framework that uses simulation both as a source of transferable motion knowledge and as a controllable reference for prediction. First, we transfer motion knowledge from a simulation teacher through latent-motion distillation, aligning temporal changes in latent space to internalize motion priors while mitigating the influence of appearance differences. Second, we introduce multi-block simulation conditioning with condition dropout to exploit predicted simulation trajectories without relying excessively on their accuracy. Our simulation-conditioning classifier-free guidance scheme unifies these two ideas by balancing predictions based on internalized motion knowledge with those additionally guided by simulation latents. The jointly trained student generates both simulation conditions and real-domain videos, requiring no additional world model at inference. On Bridge, SimForcing achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and FVD among the compared methods without external embodied pretraining. Evaluation on InternData-A1 further supports its applicability across robot datasets. Moreover, using our trained world model to initialize a vision-language-action model improves LIBERO success, suggesting its utility for downstream policy learning. \url{https://github.com/Wang-Xiaodong1899/SimForcing}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimForcing 用仿真教师做 latent-motion distillation 把运动先验蒸馏进真实域机器人世界模型，再用多块仿真条件加 condition dropout 与 classifier-free guidance 平衡内化运动知识与仿真潜变量引导。在 Bridge 上取得对比方法中最好的 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 与 FVD 且无需外部具身预训练，用其初始化 VLA 模型还提升了 LIBERO 成功率。
Motivation: 动作条件机器人世界模型要同时精确响应轨迹并保持真实视觉动态，但异构机器人视频难以同时学好两者；仿真能提供结构化运动监督，外观差异却阻碍直接迁移，不准确的仿真预测还会误导真实视频生成。
Method: 先通过 latent-motion distillation 在潜空间对齐时序变化，从仿真教师迁移运动先验并削弱外观差异影响；再引入 multi-block simulation conditioning 配 condition dropout，避免过度依赖仿真轨迹精度；simulation-conditioning classifier-free guidance 把内化运动知识的预测与仿真潜变量引导的预测做平衡，联合训练的学生模型同时生成仿真条件与真实域视频，推理时不需要额外世界模型。
Result: 在 Bridge 上，SimForcing 在对比方法中取得最好的 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 与 FVD，且不使用外部具身预训练；在 InternData-A1 上的评测进一步支持其跨机器人数据集的适用性；用该世界模型初始化 vision-language-action 模型提升了 LIBERO 成功率。
Conclusion: 仿真既能当运动知识的教师又能当可控参考，配合条件 dropout 与 CFG 即可在不依赖仿真精度的前提下生成真实域动作条件视频，并可作为下游策略学习的初始化。

papers.title: Can Agent Harnesses and Inference Engines Hear Each Other? The HEAR Protocol for Agentic LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly execute complex workflows involving multi-turn reasoning, tool use, and parallel agents. Efficient serving requires decisions that span two layers with complementary information: the agent harness understands workflow dependencies, context lifecycles, and execution objectives, whereas the inference engine observes request queues, KV-cache state, resource pressure, and execution capabilities. Existing interfaces do not systematically connect these views, limiting workflow-aware execution. HEAR, a bidirectional Harness--Engine Pairing protocol for agentic LLM serving. HEAR standardizes how the harness communicates workflow intent and execution requirements and how the engine returns runtime state, capabilities, and outcomes. By separating protocol semantics from optimization policies, HEAR supports diverse coordination strategies without changing workflow or model semantics. We instantiate HEAR for online cache-aware runtime coordination and workload-aware execution-mode selection for agent roles. Across four conversational and research-agent benchmarks under memory-constrained, concurrent serving, HEAR achieves a $1.61\times$ batch speedup and reduces median time-to-first-token by $2.23\times$ on SCBench. Mooncake shows that workflow intent and live engine state provide complementary benefits across load regimes. On BrowseComp-Plus and DeepResearchBench, workload-specific configurations yield $1.23\times$ and $2.45\times$ end-to-end speedups, respectively, without observed task-quality degradation. These results establish HEAR as a reusable coordination substrate for efficient agentic LLM serving.
papers.comment: Jiaqi Zhao, Haodong Chen, and Jitai Hao contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HEAR：面向 agentic LLM serving 的双向 Harness–Engine 配对协议，让 agent harness 传递工作流意图与执行需求，推理引擎回传运行时状态、能力与结果，并把协议语义与优化策略解耦。在四个会话与研究型 agent 基准的内存受限并发服务下，HEAR 达到 1.61× batch 加速，SCBench 中位 TTFT 降低 2.23×。
Motivation: agent harness 掌握工作流依赖、上下文生命周期与执行目标，推理引擎掌握请求队列、KV-cache 状态与资源压力，现有接口不系统打通这两类视图，工作流感知的执行调度受限。
Method: HEAR 标准化 harness 向引擎传递工作流意图与执行需求、引擎回传运行时状态与能力的双向消息语义，并将协议语义与优化策略分离；其实例化包括在线 cache-aware 运行时协调，以及按 agent 角色做 workload-aware 执行模式选择。
Result: 在四个会话与研究型 agent 基准的内存受限并发服务下，HEAR 取得 1.61× batch 加速，SCBench 中位 time-to-first-token 降低 2.23×；Mooncake 上显示工作流意图与实时引擎状态在不同负载区间互补；BrowseComp-Plus 与 DeepResearchBench 上按负载选配置分别带来 1.23× 与 2.45× 端到端加速，且未观察到任务质量下降。
Conclusion: 把 harness 与引擎的协调固化为可复用协议层，可在不改工作流与模型语义的前提下支撑多种协调策略，并在内存受限并发服务中同时提速与保住任务质量。

papers.title: Analysis of SWIR Imaging Detection Performance Under Adverse Environmental Conditions for Autonomous Driving Systems
papers.abstract_en: Short-wave infrared (SWIR) imaging has emerged as a promising modality for autonomous driving, yet its practical benefits over RGB remain poorly characterized across diverse conditions. This paper presents a systematic comparative study of paired RGB and SWIR object detection on the RASMD dataset, covering four weather conditions and two real-time detection architectures, with various fine-tunings evaluated against a unified ground truth. Overall, RGB demonstrates comparable or superior performance in most scenarios, while RF-DETR exhibits greater robustness across varying conditions. Beyond aggregate metrics, we propose a sensor-dominance mining framework that combines multi-model agreement with targeted manual inspection to identify scenarios where one sensing modality provides more reliable detections using largely unannotated paired data. This analysis reveals that SWIR offers clear advantages in four safety-critical situations, including windshield glare, water droplets on the windshield, low-contrast object visibility, and long-range vehicle detection. The findings suggest that SWIR should be viewed as a complementary modality that enhances perception in rare but challenging conditions. The datasets will be available upon request, and all code and trained model weights are publicly released at https://github.com/comsee-research/swir-adverse-env-analysis.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 RASMD 数据集上对配对 RGB 与 SWIR 做系统对比，覆盖四种天气条件与两种实时检测架构：总体上 RGB 在多数场景持平或更优，RF-DETR 跨条件更稳健。用传感器主导挖掘框架在大量未标注配对数据上定位 SWIR 更可靠的情形，确认四类安全关键场景——挡风玻璃眩光、挡风玻璃水滴、低对比度目标可见性、远距离车辆检测——因此 SWIR 应作为罕见恶劣条件下的互补模态。
Motivation: SWIR 相对 RGB 的实际收益在多样环境条件下缺乏系统刻画，自动驾驶感知难以判断何时该依赖哪种模态。
Method: 在 RASMD 数据集上做配对 RGB/SWIR 目标检测对比，覆盖四种天气条件与两种实时检测架构（含 RF-DETR），统一 ground truth 下评估多种 fine-tuning；再提出 sensor-dominance mining 框架，把多模型一致性与针对性人工检查结合，在大量基本未标注的配对数据上识别单模态更可靠的场景。
Result: 总体上 RGB 在多数场景持平或更优，RF-DETR 在不同条件下更稳健；挖掘分析确认 SWIR 在四类安全关键场景占优：挡风玻璃眩光、挡风玻璃水滴、低对比度目标可见性、远距离车辆检测。
Conclusion: SWIR 不应替代 RGB，而应作为互补模态，在罕见但困难的条件下增强感知；代码与训练权重已公开，数据集可申请获取。

papers.title: VGGT-Bridge: Beyond Sequential Pose Graphs via Coarse-Stride Skip Edges
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward visual geometry transformers such as VGGT reconstruct dense 3D structure from images in a single forward pass, simplifying multi-view 3D reconstruction. However, their quadratic attention complexity makes them difficult to scale to long sequences with thousands of frames. Chunk-and-align frameworks address this by splitting a long sequence into overlapping chunks and stitching their local reconstructions into a pose graph. Yet existing methods connect only sequentially adjacent chunks, so small per-frame errors accumulate along the chain into large-scale drift. To move beyond sequential edges, we propose VGGT-Bridge, which adds long-range skip edges that directly constrain non-adjacent chunks without retraining. By running VGGT on sparsely sampled coarse chunks, each coarse chunk bridges distant fine chunks into a single direct constraint. We further turn VGGT's first-frame scale bias into a drift correction by feeding selected coarse chunks in reverse, and a loop-aware policy keeps this reversal compatible with existing loop closures. VGGT-Bridge reduces ATE by 28.3% on KITTI Odometry, 18.8% on Virtual KITTI, and 10.0% on Waymo Open over the SwiftVGGT baseline, achieving the best performance among all chunk-and-align methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VGGT-Bridge 在不重训的前提下给 chunk-and-align 长序列重建加入粗步长跳边 (coarse-stride skip edges)：稀疏采样的粗 chunk 直接约束远处细 chunk，并把 VGGT 首帧尺度偏置反向输入转成漂移校正。相对 SwiftVGGT 基线，KITTI Odometry ATE 降 28.3%、Virtual KITTI 降 18.8%、Waymo Open 降 10.0%，在所有 chunk-and-align 方法中最好。
Motivation: 前馈视觉几何 Transformer 的注意力复杂度是二次的，难以扩展到上千帧；chunk-and-align 又只把相邻 chunk 串成链，逐帧误差沿链累积成大尺度漂移。
Method: 把长序列切成重叠 chunk 后，用 VGGT 在稀疏采样的粗 chunk 上推理，让每个粗 chunk 成为连接远处细 chunk 的直接约束（跳边），无需重训；再把选定粗 chunk 反向输入，利用 VGGT 的首帧尺度偏置做漂移校正，并用 loop-aware 策略使该反转与已有 loop closure 兼容。
Result: 相对 SwiftVGGT 基线，ATE 在 KITTI Odometry 上降低 28.3%，在 Virtual KITTI 上降低 18.8%，在 Waymo Open 上降低 10.0%，并在全部 chunk-and-align 方法中取得最佳性能。
Conclusion: 超越顺序相邻的 pose graph、用粗步长跳边直接约束非相邻 chunk，可抑制长序列 chunk-and-align 的链式漂移，且无需重训即可接入现有 pipeline。

papers.title: The Review Lottery: Calibrating an Observational Estimator of Peer-Review Noise (ICLR 2017-2025)
papers.abstract_en: How much of a conference accept/reject decision would change if the same paper were reviewed by a different set of reviewers? Running a second independent program committee is the gold standard for answering this, but it is prohibitively expensive: done only twice (NeurIPS 2014 and 2021). We build an observational estimator of this quantity from public review data alone, calibrate it twice, and apply it to nine years of ICLR (2017-2025; 36,113 papers, 134,912 reviews). The estimator decomposes scores with a Bayesian ordered-probit model into paper quality and reviewer noise, maps scores to decisions with a logistic model, and simulates two independent committees (posterior draws B=1,000; committee sizes k=2,3,4). Estimated disagreement rates are 23-30% at k=2 and 18-24% at k=4; 30-50% of accepted papers would be rejected. External calibration: at the NeurIPS 2021 reviewer-count caliber (k=3), the simulated 2021 disagreement rate is 23.3% [21.7%, 25.0%] vs. reported 23.0% (bias +0.3pp); accept precision and committee correlation agree within 5pp and 0.04. Internal calibration: on 18,740 papers with 4+ reviews, random model-free 2+2 reviewer splits agree with the k=2 simulation within 1pp in 2018 and 2021-2025. Longitudinally, we find no robust time trend in reviewer noise over 2017-2025. The high accepted-paper flip rates of 2020 and 2021 have distinct mechanisms: the 2020 four-point scale compressed scores (23.7% of papers had zero within-paper variance), and a counterfactual shows coarsening the scale raises disagreement by about 7pp; 2021 instead combined the lowest signal-to-noise ratio in the sample with the most threshold-crowded acceptances. For the LLM era, a 2023 breakpoint test on within-paper score variance finds no break, but the design has almost no power, and no post-2022 review text or confidence data exist, so no LLM attribution is attempted.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用公开评审数据构建同行评审噪声的观测估计器：贝叶斯 ordered-probit 把分数分解为论文质量与评审噪声，logistic 映射到录取决策，再模拟两个独立程序委员会。在 ICLR 2017-2025（36,113 篇、134,912 条评审）上估计 k=2 分歧率 23-30%、k=4 为 18-24%，30-50% 的录取论文会被另一委员会拒掉。
Motivation: 想知道同一论文换一批评审人录取结果会变多少，金标准是重跑一个独立 PC，但太贵，历史上只做过两次（NeurIPS 2014、2021）。
Method: 贝叶斯 ordered-probit 把分数分解为论文质量与评审噪声，logistic 模型把分数映射为决策，后验抽样 B=1,000 模拟两个独立委员会（k=2,3,4）；用 NeurIPS 2021 与 ICLR 内部 2+2 随机评审切分做外部与内部校准。
Result: k=2 分歧率 23-30%，k=4 为 18-24%，30-50% 录取论文会被拒。外部校准 k=3 时 2021 模拟分歧率 23.3% [21.7%, 25.0%] vs 报告值 23.0%（偏差 +0.3pp），录取精度与委员会相关性分别在 5pp 与 0.04 内一致。内部校准在 18,740 篇 4+ 评审论文上，2018 与 2021-2025 的 2+2 切分与 k=2 模拟相差 1pp 以内。2017-2025 评审噪声无稳健时间趋势；2020 年四点量表压缩分数（23.7% 论文组内方差为零），反事实显示粗化量表使分歧率升约 7pp；2021 年是样本内最低信噪比叠加录取阈值最拥挤。2023 断点检验组内方差无断点，但检验几乎没有功效。
Conclusion: 换评审人足以翻转三到五成录取结果，且 2020 与 2021 的高翻转率机制不同（量表粗化 vs 低信噪比加阈值拥挤），而非评审噪声随时间恶化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Keepsake: Selective Spatial Memory for Long-Horizon Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon camera-controlled video generation relies on persistent memory to maintain scene consistency. Existing systems follow two strategies to achieve this consistency. Full-history approaches retain all generated observations, causing unbounded storage and retrieval costs. Selective-construction approaches reduce redundancy, but make one-time retention decisions that are never revisited, even as an observation's value changes with the evolving memory bank. Both strategies leave a shared question unresolved: as the generated history evolves, which stored observations should still remain in memory? Our key insight is that the value of a stored observation is not fixed, but relational: it depends on the alternatives currently available in the memory bank. A view supported by many geometrically and visually similar substitutes can be relinquished with little loss of coverage, whereas an observation with few viable alternatives should remain regardless of age. We introduce Keepsake, an online, training-free controller for fixed-capacity spatial memory. At each update, Keepsake constructs a pose-appearance graph over retained and newly generated observations, combining camera-pose proximity with visual similarity. A retention priority jointly captures the number of strong substitutes and the similarity of the closest alternative, allowing Keepsake to continually reassess memory value, preserve observations with little alternative support, and evict highly replaceable ones under a fixed budget. The controller modifies only the persistent-memory update; the host generator, denoising schedule, and retrieval rule remain unchanged. Across MemCam and WorldMem, Keepsake improves FVD and LPIPS under a fixed memory budget. On 180-second MemCam trajectories, it retains only 32 of 5,397 frames while reducing FVD by 35.1%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Keepsake 是面向长时程相机可控视频生成的免训练在线记忆控制器：在固定显存预算下，每步用相机位姿邻近度与视觉相似度构建 pose-appearance 图，按“强替代品数量 + 最近替代品相似度”算保留优先级，持续重估并驱逐可替代帧。在 MemCam 180 秒轨迹上仅保留 5,397 帧中的 32 帧，FVD 仍下降 35.1%，并在 MemCam 与 WorldMem 上同时改善 FVD 与 LPIPS。
Motivation: 长时程视频生成的两类一致性策略各有硬伤：全历史保留使存储与检索成本无界，选择性构造只做一次性保留决策、不随后续记忆库演化重估，导致真正无可替代的观测可能被丢弃。
Method: Keepsake 是固定容量空间记忆的在线、免训练控制器：每步对保留与新生成观测构建 pose-appearance 图（相机位姿邻近 + 视觉相似），保留优先级联合强替代品数量与最近替代品相似度，据此持续重估并驱逐高可替代观测；只改持久记忆更新，宿主生成器、去噪调度与检索规则保持不变。
Result: 在 MemCam 与 WorldMem 上，固定记忆预算下 FVD 与 LPIPS 均改善；180 秒 MemCam 轨迹中仅保留 5,397 帧里的 32 帧，同时 FVD 下降 35.1%。
Conclusion: 观测的记忆价值是相对的而非随龄衰减的：按替代品支持度持续重估，就能在极小帧预算下维持场景一致性，且无需改动宿主生成器。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Mind the Accent Gap: British Accent Robustness in Speech-Driven Financial Voice Assistants
papers.abstract_en: AI voice assistants often use Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) with LLM-based reasoning, yet existing systems struggle with regional British accents, including Scottish, Irish, and Welsh accents, since most ASR models are trained predominantly on American English voice data. Consequently, errors can carry through to the LLM stage, corrupting tool-call arguments and producing wrong or missing responses, which is especially costly in finance. Deployable ASR must also meet tight latency and memory budgets, making an accent-robust model choice even harder. We introduce CavaBench, the first internally collected benchmark of spoken financial queries, and use it to evaluate a range of ASR models and their end-to-end ASR-LLM pipeline behaviour across self-reported British accents. We find that WER strongly predicts downstream tool-calling accuracy ($r = -0.93$) but can fail to reflect task-level performance, with accent-related failures varying substantially across models and acoustic conditions. These findings guide the design of more inclusive, reliable voice-based financial assistants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对英式区域口音（苏格兰、爱尔兰、威尔士）在金融语音助手中被 ASR 误识别并污染下游 LLM 工具调用参数的问题，提出自建口语金融查询基准 CavaBench，评测多个 ASR 模型及其 ASR-LLM 端到端流水线。发现 WER 与下游工具调用准确率强负相关（r = -0.93），但 WER 会失真反映任务级表现，口音相关失败随模型与声学条件差异显著。
Motivation: ASR 模型多以美式英语语音数据训练，区域英式口音识别差，错误传导到 LLM 阶段会破坏 tool-call 参数、在金融场景代价高；同时部署受延迟与内存预算约束，口音鲁棒的模型选型更难。
Method: 构建 CavaBench——首个内部收集的口语金融查询基准，覆盖自报告的英式口音；用它评测一系列 ASR 模型及其 ASR-LLM 端到端流水线行为，分析 WER 与工具调用准确率的关系。
Result: WER 强预测下游工具调用准确率，相关系数 r = -0.93；但 WER 可能无法反映任务级表现，口音相关失败在不同模型与声学条件下差异显著。
Conclusion: 仅靠 WER 选 ASR 不足以保证金融语音助手的任务级可靠性，模型选型需结合口音与声学条件下的工具调用表现。

papers.title: Does AI Help Cyber Attackers or Defenders? Evidence from Nonpublic Vulnerabilities and Subsequent Attacks
papers.abstract_en: The release decision for frontier AI systems increasingly relies on cyber capability benchmarks, yet public vulnerability benchmarks can expose agents to previously published advisories, exploits, and fixes, making it difficult to distinguish prior exposure from capability on unseen vulnerabilities. We evaluate open-weight and proprietary AI models on exploit generation, vulnerability repair and subsequent attacks in five nonpublic software environments, including vulnerabilities we privately disclosed while they remained unpatched. Researcher-developed and reviewed deterministic graders, not LLM judges, determine task scores. Comparisons with 209 disclosed vulnerabilities and cryptographic challenges reveal substantial variation across systems and vulnerability types. Repair scores exceed attack scores in two nonpublic environments and fall below them in three. Passing an initial security test is also insufficient: another exploit succeeds in 92 of 524 non-independent defender test intervals after the initial exploit is stopped. These results motivate vulnerability-specific attack-repair comparisons and subsequent resistance tests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在五个非公开软件环境中评测开源与闭源模型的漏洞利用生成、漏洞修复与后续攻击能力，用研究者自研的确定性评分器（非 LLM judge）打分。修复分数在两个环境高于攻击、在三个环境低于攻击；初始安全测试通过并不足够——初始利用被阻断后，另有利用在 524 个非独立防守测试区间中的 92 个成功。作者据此主张按漏洞逐一做攻防对比并追加后续抵抗测试。
Motivation: 前沿 AI 发布决策依赖网络能力基准，但公开漏洞基准会让模型接触已发布的公告、利用与补丁，难以区分「见过」与「在未见漏洞上真有能力」。
Method: 在五个非公开软件环境中评测 open-weight 与 proprietary 模型的 exploit generation、vulnerability repair 与 subsequent attacks，其中含作者私下披露且尚未修补的漏洞；任务分数由研究者开发并复核的确定性评分器给出，不用 LLM judge；与 209 个已披露漏洞和密码学挑战做对照比较。
Result: 修复分数在两个非公开环境高于攻击分数、在三个环境低于攻击分数；跨系统与漏洞类型差异显著。初始利用被阻断后，另一利用在 524 个非独立防守测试区间中成功 92 次。对照规模为 209 个已披露漏洞与密码学挑战。
Conclusion: 单一初始安全测试不足以判定防守能力，发布评估应按漏洞做攻防配对比较并追加后续抵抗测试。

summary_sections.method: 在五个非公开软件环境中评测 open-weight 与 proprietary 模型的 exploit generation、vulnerability repair 与 subsequent attacks，其中含作者私下披露且尚未修补的漏洞；任务分数由研究者开发并复核的确定性评分器给出，不用 LLM judge；与 209 个已披露漏洞和密码学挑战做对照比较。
summary_sections.result: 修复分数在两个非公开环境高于攻击分数、在三个环境低于攻击分数；跨系统与漏洞类型差异显著。初始利用被阻断后，另一利用在 524 个非独立防守测试区间中成功 92 次。对照规模为 209 个已披露漏洞与密码学挑战。
summary_sections.conclusion: 单一初始安全测试不足以判定防守能力，发布评估应按漏洞做攻防配对比较并追加后续抵抗测试。

papers.title: Mind the Execution Gap: Action-Semantic Mismatch in World-Model Control
papers.abstract_en: World-model controllers rely on action-conditioned dynamics for prediction and planning, yet real control systems often execute commands asynchronously due to communication delay, packet loss, reordering, and actuator buffering. We study how asynchronous execution changes the action semantics assumed within world-model controllers, rather than treating it only as an external control disturbance. Through controlled interventions, we identify two architecture-dependent failure modes: planning-based controllers such as TD-MPC2 suffer from a future-action timeline mismatch between imagined and executed action sequences, while recurrent world models such as DreamerV3 can attribute observed transitions to commands that were not actually applied. Our analysis shows that TD-MPC2 requires the correct future action sequence during latent dynamics rollout, whereas DreamerV3 requires timely attribution of each transition to the action that generated it. Based on these findings, we introduce two lightweight execution-consistent interfaces, Future-Sequence for TD-MPC2 and Applied-Action Feedback for DreamerV3, that correct these mismatches without modifying the pretrained world models. Experiments across delays, packet loss, reordering, multiple control domains, measured network traces, and a process-separated asynchronous stack consistently support both diagnoses and the corresponding architecture-specific corrections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 异步执行（通信延迟、丢包、乱序、执行器缓冲）会破坏 world-model 控制器所假设的动作语义，并随架构不同表现为两种失效：TD-MPC2 在 latent rollout 中拿到的未来动作序列与实际执行序列错位，DreamerV3 则把观测到的状态转移归因到并未真正下发的命令。作者据此提出两个不改动预训练模型的轻量接口——面向 TD-MPC2 的 Future-Sequence 与面向 DreamerV3 的 Applied-Action Feedback——在延迟、丢包、乱序、多控制域、实测网络 trace 与进程分离异步栈上，实验一致支持这两个诊断及对应的架构特定修正。
Motivation: 真实控制系统因通信延迟、丢包、乱序与执行器缓冲而异步执行指令，这不只是外部扰动，而是改变了 world-model 控制器内建的动作语义，导致想象轨迹与实际执行脱节。
Method: 通过受控干预 (controlled interventions) 识别两种架构相关的失效模式，并提出两个轻量的执行一致性接口：为 TD-MPC2 提供 Future-Sequence 以对齐 latent dynamics rollout 所需的未来动作序列，为 DreamerV3 提供 Applied-Action Feedback 以及时把每个转移归因到真正生效的动作；两者都不修改预训练 world model。
Result: 诊断出 TD-MPC2 的未来动作时间线错位 (future-action timeline mismatch) 与 DreamerV3 的动作归因错误两种失效模式；实验覆盖延迟、丢包、乱序、多个控制域、实测网络 trace 以及进程分离的异步栈，一致支持两项诊断及对应的架构特定修正。
Conclusion: 异步执行造成的动作语义错配应按架构分别处理：规划式控制器需对齐未来动作序列，循环式 world model 需保证转移到动作的及时归因，且无需重训预训练模型即可通过接口层修正。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LinearPFN: Amortized Variable Selection for Linear Models with Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Spike-and-slab regression is a standard Bayesian formulation of variable selection: it returns a posterior distribution over which candidate effects are active rather than a single selected subset, so that every candidate effect carries an inclusion probability. Its cost grows exponentially with the number of candidate effects, so the posterior can be enumerated exactly only when the number of predictors is small. Beyond that reach, the posterior has to be approximated, typically by Markov chain Monte Carlo over the model space, which requires a fresh run for every dataset and, within a fixed budget of steps, may fail to converge. We present LinearPFN, a prior-data fitted transformer network that amortizes spike-and-slab inference for linear models with main effects and pairwise interactions. The network is pretrained once on synthetic datasets, drawn from an explicitly specified prior, and a single forward pass over a new dataset returns posterior inclusion probabilities, posterior-mean coefficients and posterior predictive distributions with no per-dataset fitting. The prior is conjugate by design, so that the posterior for each fixed set of active effects has a closed form, and wherever the exact posterior is still computable by enumeration we verify the network's outputs against it. On real predictor matrices from published social-science datasets, with outcomes drawn from the prior so that the true active set is known, LinearPFN attains a higher per-dataset selection AUC and a higher F1 under the median probability model rule than five classical baselines. The lead holds when the coefficients, the interactions or the noise depart from the prior. Code: https://github.com/schiekiera/LinearPFN. Trained model: https://huggingface.co/schiekiera/LinearPFN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LinearPFN 用一个先验-数据拟合 (prior-data fitted) Transformer 一次性摊销 spike-and-slab 变量选择：在显式共轭先验上预训练，对含主效应与成对交互的线性模型，单次前向即给出后验包含概率、后验均值系数与后验预测分布，无需逐数据集 MCMC。在可枚举处与精确后验核对；在社会科学真实设计矩阵（结果从先验抽取、真值已知）上，其逐数据集 selection AUC 与中位数概率模型规则下的 F1 高于五个经典基线，且系数、交互或噪声偏离先验时优势仍在。
Motivation: spike-and-slab 后验随候选效应数指数增长，只能靠模型空间 MCMC 近似：每个数据集都要重跑，固定步数内还可能不收敛。
Method: 先验按共轭设计，使每个固定活跃效应集的后验有闭式解；在此先验上合成数据预训练一个 Transformer 网络，一次前向输出后验包含概率、后验均值系数与后验预测分布，覆盖主效应与成对交互；在后验仍可枚举精确计算的场合将网络输出与精确后验对照。
Result: 在已发表社会科学数据集的真实预测矩阵上（结果从先验抽取，真活跃集已知），LinearPFN 的逐数据集 selection AUC 与中位数概率模型 (median probability model) 规则下的 F1 均高于五个经典基线；当系数、交互或噪声偏离先验时该优势仍保持。
Conclusion: 摊销式先验-数据拟合网络可以在无需逐数据集拟合的前提下替代 spike-and-slab 的 MCMC 近似，并对先验误设有稳健性。

papers.title: DGA-Muon: Decoupled Geometry-Aligned Adaptive Scaling for Muon
papers.abstract_en: While NorMuon has achieved strong empirical performance in large-scale pretraining by enhancing Muon with row-wise adaptive scaling, its underlying adaptive mechanism remains poorly understood. In this work, we provide the first systematic analysis of NorMuon's adaptivity, revealing that it originates primarily from orthogonalization-induced geometry rather than genuine optimization-relevant information. Under exact orthogonalization, the adaptive scaling factors degenerate into a single global scalar for square and wide matrices, while for tall matrices their variation arises from the non-uniform distribution of row energy after orthogonalization. Under approximate orthogonalization, the orthogonality residual introduces additional variation into the scaling factors, leading to the \textit{Orthogonalization--Adaptivity Paradox}: more accurate orthogonalization weakens adaptivity. We further show that NorMuon's rigid row-wise scaling is geometrically misaligned with the one-sided orthogonal structure of tall matrices. Based on the analysis of these limitations, we propose two core design principles that a desirable adaptive mechanism for Muon should satisfy. First, adaptive scaling should be decoupled from orthogonalization, with the scaling factors computed directly from raw gradients. Second, adaptive scaling should be aligned with the shape-dependent orthogonal structure of the polar factor, using row-wise scaling for wide matrices and column-wise scaling for tall matrices. By incorporating several other design considerations, including sum-based second-moment estimates, bias correction, and adaptive clipping of scaling factors, we obtain the Decoupled Geometry-Aligned Muon (DGA-Muon) optimizer. We establish convergence guarantees for DGA-Muon and empirically validate both our theoretical characterization of NorMuon's scaling degeneration and the superiority of DGA-Muon over NorMuon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DGA-Muon 把 Muon 的自适应缩放与正交化解耦：缩放因子直接由原始梯度计算，并按矩阵形状对齐极分解的单侧正交结构——宽矩阵用行缩放、高矩阵用列缩放，再加和式二阶矩、偏差校正与缩放因子自适应裁剪。分析发现 NorMuon 的自适应性主要来自正交化几何而非优化信息，且出现“正交化—自适应悖论”：正交化越精确自适应性越弱；DGA-Muon 给出收敛保证，并在实验中验证该退化刻画与相对 NorMuon 的优势。
Motivation: NorMuon 用行向自适应缩放在大规模预训练中表现强，但其自适应机制来源不明；作者指出其缩放来自正交化诱导的几何而非真正与优化相关的信息，且行缩放与高矩阵的单侧正交结构几何错位。
Method: 先系统分析 NorMuon 的自适应性：精确正交化下缩放因子对方阵与宽矩阵退化为单一全局标量，高矩阵的差异来自正交化后行能量的非均匀分布；近似正交化下正交残差引入额外变化。据此提出两条设计原则（缩放与正交化解耦、按形状对齐极因子结构），结合和式二阶矩估计、偏差校正、缩放因子自适应裁剪，构成 DGA-Muon。
Result: 理论上刻画 NorMuon 缩放因子的退化（方阵/宽矩阵退化为全局标量，高矩阵变化源于行能量分布与正交残差），并指出正交化—自适应悖论；为 DGA-Muon 建立收敛保证，实验验证该理论刻画及 DGA-Muon 相对 NorMuon 的优势。
Conclusion: 自适应缩放应与正交化解耦并按矩阵形状对齐极分解结构，这样得到的 DGA-Muon 在理论与经验上都优于 NorMuon。

papers.title: FrontVeg V2: A Training-Free Software Framework for Foreground-Aware Zero-Shot Plant Trait Segmentation in High-Resolution Images of Trellised Crops
papers.abstract_en: FrontVeg V2 is an open-source, training-free software framework for foregroundaware zero-shot segmentation of plant traits in high-resolution images of trellised crops. The pipeline combines monocular depth estimation, automatic foreground extraction using Valley-Aware Depth Thresholding, tiled zero-shot segmentation, Graph-Based Mask Assembly, and geometry-aware fusion. This design enables plant organs and disease symptoms to be segmented while reducing detections arising from neighboring vegetation rows. The current implementation integrates Depth Anything V2 (DAV2) and SAM3 and can be used through both command-line batch processing and a Napari graphical interface. FrontVeg V2 provides a reusable framework for multi-crop, multi-trait digital phenotyping without task-specific model retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FrontVeg V2 是一个免训练、零样本的植物性状分割框架，用单目深度估计加 Valley-Aware Depth Thresholding 自动提取前景，再经分块零样本分割、Graph-Based Mask Assembly 与几何感知融合，把棚架作物中邻近植被行带来的误检压下去。当前实现集成 Depth Anything V2 (DAV2) 与 SAM3，提供命令行批处理和 Napari 图形界面，可跨作物、跨性状复用而无需针对任务重训模型。
Motivation: 高分辨率棚架作物图像中，相邻植被行的枝叶与目标器官混在一起，通用分割模型会把邻行结构误检为性状；逐任务重训模型成本高，多作物多性状数字表型 (digital phenotyping) 缺少可复用的免训练方案。
Method: 流水线依次为：单目深度估计 + Valley-Aver Depth Thresholding 前景提取、分块零样本分割、Graph-Based Mask Assembly、几何感知融合；当前实现耦合 Depth Anything V2 (DAV2) 与 SAM3，支持命令行批处理与 Napari 图形界面两种调用方式，全程不做任务特定重训。
Result: 提出并开源 FrontVeg V2 框架，可分割植物器官与病害症状，同时减少来自相邻植被行的误检；支持多作物、多性状数字表型，无需针对任务重训模型。
Conclusion: 前景感知的深度阈值加几何融合，可以在不重训的前提下把通用零样本分割模型适配到棚架作物高分辨率表型图像。

papers.title: BrainTRACE: Tracing Longitudinal, Multimodal, and Volumetric Evidence in Brain MRI Clinical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Brain MRI interpretation is a longitudinal clinical reasoning problem: radiologists compare serial studies, integrate information across MRI sequences, localize findings within volumetric anatomy, and translate this evidence into report-grounded assessments. Existing medical VQA and 3D imaging benchmarks capture important parts of this workflow, but often evaluate brain MRI through isolated images, static volumes, or ungrounded report-style answers, thereby obscuring failures in the evidence chain that support clinical validity. We introduce BrainTRACE, a report-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether vision-language models can trace the evidence structure required for longitudinal brain MRI interpretation. BrainTRACE contains 7,273 scored VQA instances derived from 1,778 longitudinal patients, 7,299 MRI studies, and approximately 29k co-registered 3D MRI sequence volumes. The benchmark is organized by five levels of clinical reasoning, from acquisition recognition to case-level synthesis, and by evidence demands covering longitudinal comparison, report-grounded references, multi-sequence integration, and volumetric spatial evidence. BrainTRACE supports rendered inputs compatible with standard VLM interfaces, a 3D-evidence condition, and a decomposed case-reasoning track that audits six steps in a longitudinal evidence chain. Evaluation of 20 VLM configurations shows that current systems can identify isolated visual cues but rarely compose them into grounded longitudinal interpretations. We release the benchmark specification, evaluation lists, scoring implementation, scoring rubrics, and audit-record format to support reproducible progress in brain MRI VLM evaluation.

papers.title: HERA: Harness-Environment Co-Evolution for Reliable Agentic Abstention
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of acting in complex tool-use environments, yet they often fail to recognize when tasks are infeasible and no valid solution exists. Recent work has formalized this reliability gap as the problem of agentic abstention, and existing approaches typically optimize a model or agent harness against a fixed set of tasks, leading to limited generalization to unseen failure modes. We introduce HERA, a framework for harness-environment co-evolution for agentic abstention. HERA consists of (i) a pipeline to automatically construct verifiable pairs of feasible and infeasible tasks by applying controlled environment mutations that transform solvable tasks into cases requiring abstention, and (ii) a co-evolution procedure in which performance failures on previous tasks are used to drive harness adaptation and generate new execution environments and tasks geared towards previous weaknesses. On held-out evaluation tasks, an evolved harness from HERA improves abstention accuracy from 61.7% to 83.3% while improving feasible-task completion from 68.3% to 76.7%, achieving the highest abstention and feasible-task completion among the compared methods. The resulting best harness transfers across 19 other LLMs, improving abstention accuracy by 15.3 percentage points on average without any model-specific optimization, and enabling smaller models to match the performance of more powerful models at an estimated 85% lower cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HERA 用可控环境变异把可解任务改造成必须弃权的不可行任务，构造可验证的可行/不可行任务对，并让历史失败反过来驱动 harness 适配与新环境生成，形成 harness-环境协同演化。在留出评测任务上，演化出的 harness 把弃权准确率从 61.7% 提到 83.3%，同时可行任务完成率从 68.3% 提到 76.7%；最优 harness 迁移到另外 19 个 LLM，弃权准确率平均再提 15.3 个百分点，无需针对任何模型单独优化。
Motivation: LLM agent 常在任务本无解时仍强行执行，而现有方法只针对固定任务集优化模型或 harness，对未见过的失败模式泛化很差。
Method: HERA 含两部分：一是自动构造可验证的可行/不可行任务对的流水线，用受控环境变异 (controlled environment mutations) 把可解任务转成需要弃权的案例；二是协同演化流程，用先前任务上的性能失败驱动 harness 适配，并生成针对既有弱点的新执行环境与任务。
Result: 在留出评测任务上，演化出的 harness 弃权准确率 61.7% → 83.3%，可行任务完成率 68.3% → 76.7%，在所比较方法中两项均为最高。最优 harness 迁移到另外 19 个 LLM，弃权准确率平均提升 15.3 个百分点且无任何模型特定优化，并使较小模型以估计低 85% 的成本达到更强模型的性能。
Conclusion: 让 harness 与环境共同演化、并用失败案例反向生成新任务，可以在不改模型的前提下同时提升 agent 的弃权判断与可行任务完成，并跨模型迁移。

papers.title: MIRT: Transformers for Truthful Generative Auctions with Whole-feed Permutation Externalities
papers.abstract_en: Modern online platforms commonly rank ads and organic content separately before blending them into a feed displayed to the user, overlooking externalities: an item's click-through rate depends on its surrounding content, not only on its own position. Recent learning-based feed generation mechanisms model some of these cross-type interactions to globally optimize for the whole feed's welfare. However, these approaches either fix the ordering of organic content, or lack exact strategyproofness guarantees for bidders. To combat these shortfalls, we introduce the Maximal-in-Range Transformer (MIRT) mechanism class, which uses a transformer to generate a range of candidate feeds that jointly order ads and organic content, and selects the welfare-maximizing feed in the range. However, there is a tension: strategyproofness requires the generated range to be bid-independent, even though a candidate feed's welfare depends linearly on the bids. Our key technical contribution is a reinforcement learning approach that incorporates both candidate generation and bid-aware selection into training, enabling a bid-independent transformer to learn to generate high-welfare ranges by accounting for both individual feed quality and the collective quality of the range. Additionally, we bound the pseudo-dimension of the MIRT class under hard attention, showing that near-optimal expected welfare is learnable with sample complexity polynomial in the transformer size and only logarithmic in the range size. Empirically, MIRT outperforms the previous non-strategyproof state-of-the-art feed models while remaining exactly strategyproof. Our results show that transformer-based auctions can deliver externality-aware whole-feed optimization without sacrificing exact incentive compatibility, removing a major obstacle to their practical deployment.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 6 figures. Including 10 main pages with 3 figures, and 14 appendix pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Maximal-in-Range Transformer (MIRT) 机制类：用 transformer 联合排序广告与自然内容生成候选 whole-feed 区间，再在区间内选福利最大者，且区间生成与出价无关以保证精确 strategyproofness。硬注意力下给出 pseudo-dimension 界，样本复杂度对 transformer 规模多项式、对区间大小仅对数；实证上在保持精确激励相容的同时超过此前非 strategyproof 的 feed 模型 SOTA。
Motivation: 平台先分别排序广告与自然内容再混排，忽略点击率依赖周边内容的 externality；已有学习型 whole-feed 生成要么固定自然内容顺序，要么对出价方缺少精确 strategyproofness 保证。
Method: MIRT 用 transformer 生成联合排序广告与自然内容的候选 feed 区间并取福利最大者；关键张力是 strategyproofness 要求区间与出价无关，而候选 feed 福利线性依赖出价。作者用强化学习把候选生成与出价感知选择一起纳入训练，让出价无关的 transformer 学会生成高福利区间，同时兼顾单条 feed 质量与区间整体质量。
Result: 硬注意力下给出 MIRT 类的 pseudo-dimension 界，近优期望福利可学，样本复杂度对 transformer 规模为多项式、对区间大小仅对数；实证中 MIRT 超过此前非 strategyproof 的最先进 feed 模型，同时保持精确 strategyproofness。
Conclusion: 基于 transformer 的拍卖可以做到 externality 感知的 whole-feed 优化而不牺牲精确激励相容，从而去掉其实际部署的主要障碍。

papers.title: Signature-Based Feature Learning for Human Activity Recognition: A Reproducible Machine Learning Study of Representation, Depth, and Model Choice
papers.abstract_en: Human activity recognition (HAR) relies on transforming sensor signals into informative representations for classification. Although deep learning and handcrafted features are widely used, the role of representation itself is often not systematically isolated. Signature transforms provide a mathematically grounded way to encode temporal order and cross-channel interactions, but their value for HAR under a fully reproducible and leakage-aware framework remains unclear. To evaluate whether signature-based feature learning improves HAR performance compared with raw-signal baselines, and to assess the effects of embedding strategy, truncation depth, model choice, and sensor configuration. Experiments were conducted on the UCI HAR dataset using a fully reproducible pipeline with the original train--test split preserved and subject-disjoint validation to prevent leakage. Three representations were compared: raw flattened signals, time-augmented paths, and lead--lag transformed paths. Signature features were computed at multiple truncation depths and evaluated using multilayer perceptron (MLP) and Random Forest (RF) classifiers under identical preprocessing and validation procedures. A prior K-means-based feature reduction study was also reproduced for comparison. Signature-based representations improved performance when paired with RF models, the best configuration was time-augmented six-channel signatures at depth 6 using entropy-based RF achieving 0.858 accuracy and 0.859 macro F1, outperforming the strongest raw baseline (0.816 accuracy). Lead--lag representations were competitive at moderate depths but did not surpass the best time-augmented models. MLP models did not exceed raw baselines. Signature-based feature learning can improve HAR, but its benefit depends on alignment between representation design and classifier choice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 UCI HAR 数据集上，签名变换 (signature transform) 提取的时序特征只有配对随机森林 (RF) 才超过原始信号基线：时间增广六通道、截断深度 6、熵加权 RF 达到 0.858 accuracy 与 0.859 macro F1，而最强原始基线为 0.816。lead-lag 表示在中等深度有竞争力但未超过最佳时间增广模型，MLP 则一律不超过原始基线——收益取决于表示设计与分类器的匹配。
Motivation: HAR 中深度学习与手工特征并用，但表示本身的作用很少被系统隔离；签名变换能否在可复现、防泄漏的框架下真正优于原始信号尚不清楚。
Method: 在 UCI HAR 上用完全可复现的流水线，保留原始 train-test 划分并采用 subject-disjoint 验证防泄漏；比较三种表示（原始展平信号、时间增广路径、lead-lag 路径），在多个截断深度计算签名特征，用 MLP 与 RF 在相同预处理下评估，并复现一项先前基于 K-means 的特征缩减研究作对照。
Result: 最佳配置为时间增广六通道签名、深度 6、熵基 RF：accuracy 0.858、macro F1 0.859，超过最强原始基线的 0.816 accuracy。lead-lag 表示在中等深度有竞争力但未超过最佳时间增广模型；MLP 未超过原始基线。
Conclusion: 签名特征学习能提升 HAR，但收益依赖表示设计与分类器选择的对齐——配 RF 有效，配 MLP 则不成立。

papers.title: Proof-Grounded Patient-Specific Clinical Explanations from Knowledge-Graph Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Clinical decision-support outputs can lack an au- ditable link between patient observations, encoded knowledge, conclusions, and recommendations. We present the CKG Clinical Explanation Engine, a downstream layer for a frozen, training-free clinical knowledge-graph reasoner that converts patient inference states and disease knowledge into typed facts, explicit rule-application traces, provenance-linked conclusions, and policy-licensed recommendations. The design separates measurement availability, representation completeness, and disease-specific activation; consequently, observed zero-activation evience is not treated as missing and partial representation is distinct from unobserved evidence. Optional language generation is restricted to symbolically licensed content. Across five usable workbooks (6,720 patients; 20,160 patient-disease traces; 1,021,440 feature-evidence rows), IG-range validity and knowledge provenance were 100%, numerical cross-sheet fidelity was 100% (120,960/120,960), and exported logical/report trace completeness was 100% (20,160/20,160). Availability representation consistency was 99.7028% (1,018,404/1,021,440); all 3,036 disagreements were confined to three systematic feature-cohort patterns. The corpus contained 86,783 observed zero-activation and 139,949 observed partially represented instances. A separate seeded 25-patient end-to-end audit completed without execution failure and passed all pre-specified trace, licensing, provenance, and state-consistency checks. These results establish structural and implementation auditability, not clinical correctness or utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CKG Clinical Explanation Engine 作为冻结、免训练的临床知识图谱推理器的下游层，把患者推理状态与疾病知识转成带类型事实、显式规则应用轨迹、来源可溯结论和策略许可建议的可审计解释。在五个工作簿（6,720 名患者、20,160 条患者-疾病轨迹、1,021,440 行特征-证据）上，IG-range 有效性与知识来源、数值跨表保真、逻辑/报告轨迹完整性均为 100%，可用性表示一致性 99.7028%（1,018,404/1,021,440），3,036 处分歧全部集中于三种系统性特征队列模式。
Motivation: 临床决策支持输出常缺少患者观测、编码知识、结论与建议之间的可审计链路，无法核查推理依据与建议来源。
Method: 在冻结、免训练的临床知识图谱推理器之后加一层解释引擎，将患者推理状态与疾病知识转换为 typed facts、显式规则应用轨迹、provenance 链接结论与 policy-licensed 建议；设计上分离测量可用性、表示完整性与疾病特异激活，使观测到的零激活不被当作缺失、部分表示与未观测证据区分开；可选语言生成仅限符号上被许可的内容。

papers.title: Empirical Variational Autoencoder
papers.abstract_en: We present Empirical Variational Autoencoder, a general generative framework for continuous-valued (i.e., non-vector-quantized) sequences. EVA is based on the evidence lower bound of the Variational Autoencoder (VAE) but learns autoregressive latent priors empirically from training data, which can be implemented only by an additional single linear layer on top of VAEs. By replacing the conventional standard-Gaussian constraint with the self-predicted priors, EVA significantly alleviates the latent distribution gap between prior and posterior which is typically observed in conventional VAEs, and leads to high-fidelity ancestral sampling for sequential data generation. Extensive experiments on image and sound synthesis demonstrate that EVA achieves competitive generation quality with autoregressive diffusion baselines despite its much faster inference time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EVA 是面向连续值序列的通用生成框架：保留 VAE 的证据下界，但用自回归 latent prior 从训练数据经验学习，替换标准高斯约束，只需在 VAE 之上加一层线性层。它显著缓解了先验与后验之间的 latent 分布 gap，实现高保真 ancestral sampling；在图像与声音合成上生成质量与自回归扩散基线相当，推理速度更快。
Motivation: 常规 VAE 用标准高斯约束先验，导致先验与后验分布存在 gap，序列数据的 ancestral sampling 保真度受限；自回归扩散虽质量高但推理慢。
Method: 基于 VAE 的证据下界 (ELBO)，把标准高斯约束替换为从训练数据经验学习的自回归 latent prior，实现上仅需在 VAE 之上额外加一个线性层；在图像与声音合成任务上与自回归扩散基线对比。
Result: 在图像与声音合成实验中，EVA 的生成质量与自回归扩散基线相当 (competitive)，同时推理时间明显更短；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 用经验学习的自回归先验替代标准高斯约束，可以在不牺牲生成质量的前提下大幅加速连续值序列的生成。

papers.title: A Fine-Grained Analysis of the LoRA Fine-Tuning Landscape with Implications for Data Selection
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a standard approach for parameter-efficient fine-tuning, yet a fundamental practical question remains unresolved: how should the adapter rank be chosen? An overly small rank may lead to a poorly conditioned optimization landscape, whereas an unnecessarily large rank sacrifices the efficiency that motivates LoRA in the first place. Existing theoretical analyses provide only limited guidance on this trade-off, and their guarantees are typically established under restrictive theoretical settings. We address this gap by developing a substantially sharper landscape theory for LoRA, building on modern results from nonconvex low-rank matrix sensing. Our central insight is that the appropriate adapter rank should depend on the quality of the data-induced optimization geometry, rather than on the model alone. To formalize this connection, we introduce LoRA-RIP, a data-dependent restricted-isometry metric that characterizes the conditioning of the cross-entropy (CE) objective along LoRA-relevant low-rank directions. We prove that sufficient rank over-parameterization, with the required rank explicitly determined by the LoRA-RIP constant, eliminates spurious local minima, thereby extending existing RIP-based guarantees beyond the classical 1/3 regime. This characterization further enables principled data selection under a fixed rank budget. Experiments across language and vision tasks support these theoretical predictions, showing that rank and data quality are two coupled resources that should be jointly considered for more efficient and reliable LoRA fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LoRA-RIP：一个依赖数据的受限等距常数，用来刻画交叉熵目标在 LoRA 相关低秩方向上的条件数，并证明当秩过参数化程度由该常数显式决定时可消除伪局部极小值，把既有 RIP 保证从经典 1/3 regime 推广出去。核心论断是适配器秩应由数据诱导的优化几何质量决定而非只看模型，秩与数据质量是两个耦合资源，应在固定秩预算下联合选择数据。
Motivation: LoRA 的秩如何选这一基本实践问题未解决：秩太小则优化景观条件差，秩太大则牺牲 LoRA 的效率初衷；既有理论分析多在受限设定下给出保证，指导有限。
Method: 建立基于非凸低秩矩阵传感 (low-rank matrix sensing) 现代结果的 LoRA 景观理论：定义 LoRA-RIP 度量交叉熵目标在 LoRA 低秩方向上的条件数，证明所需秩由 LoRA-RIP 常数显式给出的充分过参数化可消除伪局部极小值，并据此在固定秩预算下给出数据选择原则；在语言与视觉任务上做实验检验理论预测。
Result: 证明充分的秩过参数化（所需秩由 LoRA-RIP 常数显式确定）消除伪局部极小值，将既有基于 RIP 的保证扩展到经典 1/3 regime 之外；语言与视觉任务实验支持理论预测，显示秩与数据质量是两个耦合资源。
Conclusion: 适配器秩应由数据诱导的优化几何质量决定，固定秩预算下应把秩与数据质量联合考虑，以获得更高效可靠的 LoRA 微调。

papers.title: WaveGSSM: Graph Wave State Space Models for Propagating Spatio-Temporal Patterns
papers.abstract_en: Spatio-temporal graph models typically encode each snapshot with a GNN and then connect the resulting representations through a temporal module. This space-then-time design is effective, yet it does not explicitly represent how a pattern moves across the graph. We show empirically that, for a propagating process, the same present field can lead to different futures when its recent rate of change differs, motivating an explicit representation of motion in the predictive state. We introduce WaveGSSM, a second-order graph state-space model that maintains two coupled latent states at each node, one for the current pattern and one for its temporal rate of change. A graph-wave transition updates the motion state through graph interactions and uses it to advance the pattern state, coupling spatial propagation and temporal evolution within a single rollout. We evaluate WaveGSSM on four temporal-graph benchmarks and global weather forecasting. It consistently achieves the best mean performance across the temporal-graph benchmarks and reduces the geopotential RMSE by 20.2% on average for 1- to 5-day weather forecasts relative to a backbone-matched snapshot model, while better preserving large-scale atmospheric patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WaveGSSM 用二阶图状态空间模型在每个节点维护当前形态与时间变化率两个耦合隐状态，通过 graph-wave transition 把空间传播与时间演化放进同一次 rollout。在四个 temporal-graph 基准上平均表现最佳，1–5 天全球天气预报的位势高度 RMSE 相对同骨干快照模型平均降低 20.2%，且更好地保留大尺度大气形态。
Motivation: 时空图模型先逐帧 GNN 编码再接时序模块，无法显式表示形态在图上的移动；同一当前场因近期变化率不同会走向不同未来，快照式状态不足以区分。
Method: WaveGSSM 是二阶图状态空间模型：每个节点维护形态状态与运动（变化率）状态两个耦合隐状态；graph-wave transition 先用图交互更新运动状态，再用它推进形态状态，把空间传播与时间演化耦合进单次 rollout。评测覆盖四个 temporal-graph 基准与全球天气预报，并与 backbone-matched 快照模型对比。
Result: 在四个 temporal-graph 基准上取得最佳平均表现；1–5 天全球天气预报的位势高度 (geopotential) RMSE 相对同骨干快照模型平均降低 20.2%，同时更好地保留大尺度大气形态。
Conclusion: 把运动（变化率）显式写进预测状态、让空间传播与时间演化在一次 rollout 中耦合，是传播型过程比 space-then-time 快照编码更有效的表示方式。
