papers.title: Symmetry and AI-assisted discovery of magic-state factories
papers.abstract_en: Magic-state distillation is a major resource cost in fault-tolerant quantum computing. The cost of a magic-state factory depends strongly on its failure rate, which grows with the number of input magic states. Although symmetry-restricted methods have recently made distance two searches tractable, distance three and above have remained elusive at moderate input counts. We develop symmetry- and AI-assisted methods to search this regime. We present a unified binary-matrix formulation encompassing both triorthogonal-code and direct circuit searches. We show that distance at least three is equivalent to nonzero, pairwise distinct syndromes, separating the choice of syndromes from the search for compatible output gates. We restrict the syndrome search using group symmetry and language-model agents, followed by deterministic solving and independent verification. Our searches yield 699 factory classes, including 564 new ones. These include factories for pure-T states and factories with entangled outputs comprising combinations of T, CS, and CCZ magic states. The pure-T factories [[63, 11, 3]] and [[850, 128, 6]] achieve the lowest overhead exponents we know among protocols with at most 100 and 1000 inputs, respectively, with $γ= 1.589$ and $γ= 1.057$. Our [[1715, 287, 6]] factory, with $γ= 0.998$, is the smallest known pure-T factory with $γ< 1$. We also provide a context directory of search briefs and campaign notes with which readers can train their own agents and tailor the search to their requirements. With these results, we begin constructing an active, open-source repository of magic-state distillation protocols for the quantum community, supplemented by our methods and data, for the practical fault-tolerant quantum computing regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用群对称约束加语言模型 agent 搜索容错量子计算的 magic-state 蒸馏工厂，把距离≥3 的条件化归为非零且两两互异的 syndrome，得到 699 个工厂类（564 个新），其中 [[1715, 287, 6]] 的开销指数 γ=0.998，是已知最小的 γ<1 纯 T 工厂。
Motivation: magic-state 蒸馏是容错量子计算的主要资源开销，工厂开销随输入态数目增长的失败率急剧上升；对称性受限方法已使距离 2 搜索可行，但中等输入数下的距离 3 及以上搜索此前仍无法完成。
Method: 提出统一的二元矩阵表述，同时覆盖 triorthogonal-code 与直接电路两类搜索，并证明距离≥3 等价于 syndrome 非零且两两互异，从而把 syndrome 选择与兼容输出门搜索解耦；syndrome 搜索用群对称与 language-model agents 收缩，再接确定性求解与独立验证。
Result: 搜索得到 699 个工厂类，其中 564 个为新结果，涵盖纯 T 态工厂以及含 T、CS、CCZ 组合的纠缠输出工厂；纯 T 工厂 [[63, 11, 3]] 与 [[850, 128, 6]] 在至多 100 与 1000 输入的协议中给出已知最低开销指数 γ=1.589 与 γ=1.057，[[1715, 287, 6]] 的 γ=0.998 是已知最小的 γ<1 纯 T 工厂。
Conclusion: 把距离约束改写成 syndrome 条件并用对称性与 agent 收缩搜索空间，可以在中等输入数下系统产出实用区间 magic-state 蒸馏协议；作者同时开源搜索简报、活动记录与数据，供社区训练自己的 agent 并按需定制搜索。

papers.title: Anatomy of LLM Sycophancy: What a Flip Rate Hides
papers.abstract_en: A model under pushback can correct itself, capitulate, or hold, and one flip rate counts a correction and a capitulation alike. Using SycoLens, a modular replay protocol, we test how user pressure and evaluation settings shape measured flip rates. Each measurement is one stateless replay of an item, a committed answer, and one scripted user line in a fixed form. Every effect is read against a matched control with the line deleted. Pushback wording, committed text, answer format, boundary distance, and ground truth become factors of one instrument; earlier instruments vary one to three of them. Across eleven frontier models from three providers and about 760,000 controlled replays, which models look sycophantic depends on how the user pushes back. Lines that assert the opposite verdict and lines that challenge the answer without asserting one rank the models almost unrelatedly. Flip effects grow several-fold near a model's boundary, yet items answered identically in every screening draw still carry about half of the most-affected totals. On arithmetic tasks where the truth is known, one model re-derives and corrects itself under pressure while another abandons correct answers without written work. On the model tested, a planted derivation lowers release of the answer it argues for, true or wrong, where a bare stated value does not; the wrong answer is corrected much more often than the true one is abandoned. Under a yes/no readout the rankings come closer, entangled with a pressure-induced shift toward "no". One score per model therefore compares different behaviours across models and benchmarks. We condense these dependencies into a reporting profile; the instrument, records, and analyses will be released upon publication.

TL;DR: SycoLens 用模块化重放协议把用户施压下的翻转拆成纠正与屈服两类，发现同一模型的谄媚排名随施压措辞、承诺文本、答案格式、边界距离和判据而变：断言相反结论与仅质疑答案两种措辞给出的模型排名几乎不相关。约 760,000 次受控重放、11 个前沿模型显示，边界附近翻转效应放大数倍，但每次筛查都答对的题目仍占最受影响总量的约一半；因此单一 flip rate 实际在跨模型、跨基准比较不同行为。
Motivation: 单一 flip rate 把纠正性自我修正与屈服性改口混为一谈，导致谄媚测量随施压措辞与评测设置漂移，模型间可比性失效。
Method: SycoLens 模块化重放协议：每次测量是对一个条目、一个已提交答案和一句固定形式脚本化用户话语的无状态重放，效应一律对照删去该话语的匹配控制读取；把施压措辞、承诺文本、答案格式、边界距离与真值统一为同一仪器的因子，覆盖三家提供商的 11 个前沿模型。
Result: 约 760,000 次受控重放：断言相反结论与仅质疑答案的措辞给出的模型排名几乎不相关；翻转效应在模型边界附近放大数倍，而每次筛查均答对的条目仍占最受影响总量约一半；算术任务上一个模型在压力下重推导并纠正自己，另一个则放弃正确答案且不写推导；植入推导会降低其所支持答案（无论对错）的给出率，而裸给数值不会，且错误答案被纠正远多于正确答案被放弃；yes/no 读出下排名趋于接近，但与压力诱导的偏向“no”纠缠。
Conclusion: 每个模型一个分数实际上在跨模型、跨基准比较不同行为，作者据此把上述依赖压缩成一份 reporting profile，仪器、记录与分析将在论文发表时发布。

papers.title: Conditional Flow Matching for Single-Neuron Electrophysiology: Capturing Multimodal Responses Across Stimuli
papers.abstract_en: Neurons of the brain exhibit a rich repertoire of electrophysiology dynamics with the same repeated stimulus eliciting very different voltage responses from the same cell. One common approach in biophysically detailed models is to capture this variability through ensembles of deterministic parametrizations, at a cost of hundreds of thousands of CPU hours. Existing machine learning surrogates inherit the same limitation, where a stimulus is mapped to a single voltage response. We address this challenge by learning a conditional generative model for single-neuron electrophysiology, using flow matching with a velocity field conditioned on the input current. On biophysically detailed models of two human cortical interneuron types, the generated responses closely reproduce the electrophysiological feature distributions, spike-time structure, and excitability profiles, even matching the experimental recordings from the corresponding human cortical neurons. Near the firing threshold, firing and non-firing responses coexist at the same stimulus amplitude, and at high amplitudes, ensembles may split into low- and high-firing modes near depolarization block. We show that our model recovers both modes in each case, while a neural operator baseline suppresses spiking near threshold and blurs the gap between modes at depolarization block.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用以输入电流为条件的 flow matching 学习单神经元电生理生成模型，可在一次前向中采出同一刺激下的多模态电压响应。在两类人皮层中间神经元的生物物理详细模型上，生成响应复现了电生理特征分布、放电时刻结构与兴奋性曲线，并匹配对应人皮层神经元的实验记录；在放电阈值附近与去极化阻滞处均恢复出双模态，而 neural operator 基线在阈值附近抑制放电、把两种模式之间的间隙抹平。
Motivation: 同一重复刺激在同一细胞上引出差异很大的电压响应，生物物理详细模型只能靠数十万 CPU 小时的确定性参数集合来覆盖这种变异，现有机器学习代理又把刺激映射成单一响应，丢掉了多模态性。
Method: 训练以输入电流为条件的 conditional flow matching 生成模型，速度场 (velocity field) 以刺激电流为条件，直接生成单神经元电压响应；在两类人皮层中间神经元的生物物理详细模型上与 neural operator 基线对照。
Result: 生成响应紧密复现电生理特征分布、spike-time 结构与兴奋性 profile，并匹配相应人皮层神经元的实验记录；在放电阈值附近恢复出同一刺激幅度下并存的放电与不放电响应，在高幅度去极化阻滞 (depolarization block) 处恢复出低放电与高放电两种模式，而 neural operator 基线在阈值附近抑制放电、模糊了阻滞处两模式之间的间隙。
Conclusion: 以刺激为条件的生成式代理能替代昂贵的确定性参数集合，保留阈值附近与去极化阻滞处的多模态响应，而确定性神经算子会抹掉这些模式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GCTAuto-encoder: A Cross modal Framework for Security Flaw Detection in IoT Networks
papers.abstract_en: IoT encompasses diverse physical entities, from smart home devices to autonomous vehicles, creating a complex environment with heterogeneous security models. This heterogeneity makes IoT sub-systems vulnerable to various network attacks. Modern security systems must therefore be more robust to ensure security and privacy for IoT applications. A highly secure IoT system also demands real time insight, requiring data collection at the edge of the computing layer. This diversity calls for a unified security model applied at the foundational level. Edge intelligence offers a direct approach to handling device diversity. A key goal of edge intelligence in IoT is to extract insight from local data; security models can then use this data to build local node protections, and integrating AI models yields an advanced security solution. This research proposes a novel deep learning algorithm for effective intrusion detection at the edge, supported by a cloud-based IoT framework. We evaluate the proposed cross modal deep learning algorithm against baseline models. The contribution is a cross domain Deep Neural Network (DNN) algorithm for intrusion detection. The objective is to assess a multi-method deep learning model to detect intrusions in IoT systems at the edge via community detection with modeled attention. We evaluate GCT auto-encoder, a novel framework integrating edge intelligence to identify security flaws. The model significantly improves performance and efficiency. On a network intrusion IoT dataset covering multiple attack scenarios, it achieved 0.908 accuracy, reduced learning loss to 0.00156, and outperformed existing approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 IoT 边缘入侵检测的跨模态 GCT auto-encoder 框架，用带建模注意力的社区检测 (community detection with modeled attention) 组织多方法 DNN，在覆盖多种攻击场景的网络入侵 IoT 数据集上取得 0.908 accuracy，学习损失降至 0.00156，优于所比较的既有方法。
Motivation: IoT 子系统设备与安全模型高度异构，边缘侧缺乏统一的基础层安全模型，需要在数据采集处做实时入侵检测。
Method: 提出跨模态、跨域的 Deep Neural Network (DNN) 算法 GCT auto-encoder，把边缘智能与云端 IoT 框架结合，通过社区检测加建模注意力实现多方法深度学习模型，在边缘识别安全缺陷。
Result: 在覆盖多种攻击场景的网络入侵 IoT 数据集上，GCT auto-encoder 达到 0.908 accuracy，学习损失降至 0.00156，并相对基线模型与既有方法取得更好的性能与效率。
Conclusion: 跨模态自编码器配合注意力化的社区检测可在 IoT 边缘做有效入侵检测，作者称其显著改善性能与效率。

papers.title: ANT: A Multi-Granularity Network Traffic Dataset and Benchmark for Agents Behavior Auditing
papers.abstract_en: The growing adoption of large language model (LLM) agents creates a need for network administrators and security teams to audit agent behavior within organizational networks without inspecting private user content. Network traffic offers an observable source of evidence, but how much it reveals about agent tasks and operations remains unclear. Existing traffic datasets lack the joint task and stage annotations needed to evaluate this question. We introduce ANT (Agent Network Traffic), a dataset providing agent behavior information at risk, scenario, and behavior primitive granularities alongside network traffic. ANT contains 3,114 execution episodes across 20 tasks and five scenarios, comprising 276,417 bidirectional flows and 40,049 behavior primitive segments organized into 47 macro groups. We establish a benchmark for agent risk identification, scenario recognition, and behavior primitive classification using 13 representative traffic analysis baselines. The results show that existing methods recover useful but uneven behavioral signals. They struggle to identify risk when malicious workflows resemble benign tasks and to distinguish scenarios with similar traffic patterns. Primitive classification is more reliable for frequent macro groups and those with distinctive traffic patterns than for rare or semantically similar groups. ANT provides a common basis for developing more precise auditing and forensic analysis of agent behavior from network traffic. Our data and code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ant-main-suite-7BC0/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ANT 是面向 LLM agent 行为审计的网络流量数据集与基准，在风险、场景、行为原语三个粒度上同时标注任务与阶段。含 3,114 个执行 episode、20 个任务、5 个场景、276,417 条双向流与 40,049 个行为原语片段（47 个宏类），用 13 个流量分析基线做基准。结果显示现有方法能恢复有用但不均衡的信号：恶意流程长得像 benign 任务时风险识别困难，流量模式相似的场景难区分，原语分类只在高频或流量特征鲜明的宏类上可靠。
Motivation: 网络管理员与安全团队需要在不查看用户私有内容的前提下审计组织网络内的 LLM agent 行为，但流量到底能揭示多少 agent 任务与操作尚不清楚，且现有流量数据集缺少任务与阶段的联合标注，无法评估这一问题。
Method: 构建 ANT (Agent Network Traffic) 数据集，按 risk、scenario、behavior primitive 三个粒度标注 agent 行为信息并绑定网络流量；在此之上建立基准，覆盖 agent 风险识别、场景识别与行为原语分类三项任务，使用 13 个代表性流量分析基线。
Result: ANT 含 3,114 个执行 episode、20 个任务、5 个场景、276,417 条双向流、40,049 个行为原语片段，归入 47 个宏类。13 个基线的结果显示现有方法恢复的信号有用但不均衡：恶意工作流与 benign 任务相似时风险识别失败，流量模式相近的场景难以区分；原语分类在高频宏类和流量特征鲜明的类上更可靠，在稀有或语义相近的类上更差。
Conclusion: 仅凭网络流量可以支撑 agent 行为的审计与取证，但精度受任务相似度与类频率制约，ANT 为更精细的审计方法提供了统一评测基础。

papers.title: SOL: Measuring Gaps between Text Distributions by Double Sliced Wasserstein Metrics
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating text generation requires measuring how well the generated distribution matches the data distribution. For autoregressive models, this is done by the perplexity. Diffusion and flow-based language models can only provide a likelihood bound, whose tightness differs between model families. Sample-based substitutes such as generative perplexity with entropy do not consider the distribution fit. We propose SOL, a distance between text distributions. Each sequence is represented by the empirical measure of its hidden states under a fixed transformer and the distributions of these measures are compared by the double sliced Wasserstein distance. We prove that SOL is a metric if the transformer is injective. Experiments show that SOL detects distributional failures, recovers expected model trends, and provides stable sample-based estimates. We put forward SOL to fill the gap in the current evaluation protocol used for non auto-regressive models. As a first step we use SOL to re-evaluate a variety of models trained on OpenWebText.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SOL：把每条文本序列映射为固定 transformer 隐藏状态的经验测度，再用 double sliced Wasserstein 距离比较两个文本分布，作为非自回归语言模型的评测指标。证明当 transformer 单射时 SOL 是度量；实验显示它能检出分布性失败、复现预期的模型趋势并给出稳定的样本估计，作者据此重新评估了一批在 OpenWebText 上训练的模型。
Motivation: 扩散与流式语言模型只能给出似然下界，且界紧度随模型族变化；生成式困惑度加熵的样本替代量又不衡量分布拟合，非自回归模型缺少统一的评测协议。
Method: SOL 将每条序列编码为固定 transformer 下隐藏状态的经验测度，用 double sliced Wasserstein 距离比较这些测度构成的分布；理论上证明 transformer 单射时该距离是度量，并以样本估计方式计算。
Result: 实验显示 SOL 能检出分布性失败、复现预期的模型趋势并给出稳定的基于样本的估计；作为首个应用，在 OpenWebText 上训练的多种模型被 SOL 重新评估。
Conclusion: SOL 被作者定位为填补非自回归模型现行评测协议空缺的距离度量，可作为自回归困惑度之外的分布级评测手段。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: SOL 将每条序列编码为固定 transformer 下隐藏状态的经验测度，用 double sliced Wasserstein 距离比较这些测度构成的分布；理论上证明 transformer 单射时该距离是度量，并以样本估计方式计算。
summary_sections.result: 实验显示 SOL 能检出分布性失败、复现预期的模型趋势并给出稳定的基于样本的估计；作为首个应用，在 OpenWebText 上训练的多种模型被 SOL 重新评估。
summary_sections.conclusion: SOL 被作者定位为填补非自回归模型现行评测协议空缺的距离度量，可作为自回归困惑度之外的分布级评测手段。

papers.title: ArtifactArena: Evaluating Models by What They Build in the Physical World
papers.abstract_en: To evaluate the frontier, we must measure models not by what they say, but by what they can engineer and build in grounded physical environments. We introduce \textsc{ArtifactArena}, an open-ended platform where models face a physically grounded hardware-software co-design challenge: engineering fully functional robots to compete in a simulated arena. We evaluate a frontier model's zero-shot, verifier guided refinement, and open-ended physical design capabilities through three harnesses that refine their bot artifacts based on text descriptions, physics simulator feedback, and gameplay data. We benchmark these capabilities with an Elo ranking of frontier models derived from head-to-head tournaments between their artifacts. By releasing this framework and tournament infrastructure for ongoing community submissions, we establish a living, non-saturating testbed to continuously measure the expanding limits of open-ended intelligence in the physical world. Please visit \href{https://artifactarena.ai}{https://artifactarena.ai} for more information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ArtifactArena 是一个开放式物理评测平台，让前沿模型在仿真竞技场中从零设计并迭代可运行的机器人，通过三条 harness（文本描述、物理仿真器反馈、对局数据）引导 verifier 式精修，再用头对头对局产生的 Elo 排名给模型排序。框架与对局基础设施开源并接受持续投稿，构成一个不会饱和的活体基准。
Motivation: 现有前沿模型评测多衡量模型说了什么，而非它能否在接地的物理环境中真正造出可用的东西；作者要一个可持续、不饱和的开放式物理智能测量面。
Method: 提出开放式硬件-软件协同设计挑战：模型在仿真竞技场中工程化完整机器人，用三个 harness 分别依据文本描述、物理仿真器反馈和对局数据来精修 bot artifact，覆盖 zero-shot、verifier 引导精修与开放式物理设计三种能力；以 artifact 之间头对头对局导出 Elo 排名作为基准指标，并开源框架与对局基础设施供社区持续投稿。
Result: 产出三类能力的评测协议（zero-shot、verifier 引导精修、开放式物理设计）与基于头对头对局的前沿模型 Elo 排名；摘要未给出具体 Elo 数值或模型间对比。
Conclusion: 按“造出什么”而非“说了什么”来评前沿模型是可行的，且通过持续社区投稿可以做成一个活的、不饱和的开放式物理智能测试床。

papers.title: Xaurora: Generative Weather Forecasting with Denoising Stochastic Interpolants from a Foundation Model Prior
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has revolutionised weather forecasting in recent years, especially through atmospheric foundation models, which offer competitive skill for a fraction of the computational costs of classic physics-based models. However, most existing foundation models are deterministic, limiting the generation of large ensembles for accurate uncertainty quantification, extreme weather risk assessment, and long-range weather forecasting. Furthermore, these models incur a large, often prohibitive, computational overhead to train from scratch. To address these shortcomings, we turn a pretrained deterministic prior model, namely the Aurora foundation model, into a generative ensemble-prediction model. To that end, we introduce a novel generative method, Denoising Stochastic Interpolants, combined with a replay buffer for Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) rollout, enabling probabilistic training of SDE trajectories. Our stochastic foundation model, Xaurora, is finetuned from the small Aurora version, yet it approaches the state-of-the-art on global ensemble metrics and is competitive with the large version of Aurora. Our method is parameter and sample efficient, and generates skilful 15-day forecasts in 13 minutes. Our results demonstrate that deterministic foundation models can be efficiently extended into even stronger stochastic models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Xaurora 把预训练的确定性 Aurora 基础模型改造成生成式集合预报模型：用 Denoising Stochastic Interpolants 结合 SDE rollout 的 replay buffer 做概率训练，从 small 版 Aurora 微调。结果接近全球集合指标的 state-of-the-art、与 large 版 Aurora 相当，15 天预报只需 13 分钟生成。
Motivation: 现有大气基础模型多为确定性，难以生成大集合来做不确定性量化、极端天气风险评估和长期预报；且从零训练开销往往 prohibitive。
Method: 以预训练确定性 Aurora 为基础先验，引入 Denoising Stochastic Interpolants，并结合用于 SDE rollout 的 replay buffer 实现 SDE 轨迹的概率训练，得到随机基础模型 Xaurora，从 small 版 Aurora 微调。
Result: 在全球集合指标上接近 state-of-the-art，并与 large 版 Aurora 竞争力相当；参数与样本效率高，15 天预报生成耗时 13 分钟。
Conclusion: 确定性基础模型可以被高效扩展为更强的随机（集合）模型，无需从零训练即可获得可用的集合预报能力。
Relevance: 91

papers.title: A General Pipeline for Dense Illuminant Estimation via Physically Based Synthetic Data
papers.abstract_en: Illuminant estimation is a fundamental problem in computational photography, as it enables the correction of color shifts induced by varying lighting conditions. While learning-based methods have demonstrated strong performance, their progress is hindered by the limited availability of large-scale datasets with accurate illuminant ground-truth. In this work, we propose a general and reusable pipeline to derive dense illuminant chromaticity maps from physically based 3D-rendered scenes. By repurposing an existing 3D scene collection, our approach enables the systematic generation of pixel-wise illuminant annotations under controlled lighting conditions, effectively lowering the barrier to data acquisition for learning-based illuminant estimation. Using this pipeline, we generate a large-scale synthetic set of 74,321 images, which we employ for pre-training both single- and multi-illuminant estimation models. Extensive experiments with state-of-the-art architectures show that synthetic pre-training consistently improves performance, with gains of up to 28% for single-illuminant estimation and up to 57% for multi-illuminant estimation, particularly in data-scarce regimes. These findings demonstrate that synthetic data generation pipelines offer an effective and scalable solution for the pre-training of illuminant estimation methods.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 34th Color and Imaging Conference (CIC 2026), hosted by the Society for Imaging Science and Technology (IS&T)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出从物理渲染 3D 场景批量导出逐像素光源色度图的通用管线，生成 74,321 张合成图像用于预训练单光源与多光源估计模型；在数据稀缺场景下，合成预训练带来最高 28%（单光源）与 57%（多光源）的性能提升。
Motivation: 学习型光源估计 (illuminant estimation) 受制于缺少大规模、带精确光源真值的数据集，标注获取成本高。
Method: 改造现有 3D 场景集合，在受控光照下用物理渲染管线生成逐像素光源色度标注，构成 74,321 张图像的合成集，用于预训练单光源与多光源估计模型，并在多种 SOTA 架构上做实验。
Result: 合成预训练在单光源估计上最高提升 28%，多光源估计上最高提升 57%，在数据稀缺 (data-scarce) 场景下尤为明显，且在所测 SOTA 架构上一致改善性能。
Conclusion: 物理渲染的合成数据管线是光源估计预训练的一种可扩展方案，其收益在标注稀缺时最大。

papers.title: Improving Proactive AI Assistance with Hierarchical Procedural Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Proactive AI assistants continuously observe a user's activity and decide whether to provide new guidance or remain silent. They should provide appropriate guidance for the task, determine when to provide the next guidance based on task progress, and adjust the guidance level to the user's expertise and needs. Supporting these capabilities requires training and evaluation data that reflect procedural structure and capture how guidance should adapt to task progress and user needs. However, existing datasets either focus on detection-based proactive understanding or provide procedural guidance at a fixed granularity. Fixed-granularity guidance provides limited information about fine-grained progress and broader procedural context, making it difficult to determine completion and adapt guidance granularity. To address these limitations, we introduce the ProactiveCoach suite, comprising ProactiveCoach-Instruct for training, ProactiveCoachBench for evaluation, and fine-tuned VLMs with an adaptive guidance system. ProactiveCoach-Instruct provides hierarchically structured guidance at the phase, step, and action levels for learning task progress and procedural context. ProactiveCoachBench evaluates whether models provide appropriate guidance at the right time across different guidance levels and adapt when the requested level changes. We fine-tune pretrained VLMs on ProactiveCoach-Instruct and demonstrate its effectiveness across backbones. Compared with fixed-granularity supervision, hierarchical supervision improves overall performance across backbones by up to 9.6%p. We further build an adaptive guidance system by combining our fine-tuned model with a lightweight guidance router. Without additional fine-tuning, our system outperforms the in-context adaptation baseline by 57.1%p across four guidance-level transitions. Our project page is available at https://jinsuby.github.io/ProactiveCoach/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ProactiveCoach 套件，用 phase/step/action 三级层次化过程监督训练主动式 AI 助手，使其按任务进度决定何时给指导、按用户水平调整指导粒度。相比固定粒度监督，层次化监督在多个 VLM backbone 上整体性能最多提升 9.6 个百分点；配合轻量 guidance router 的自适应系统在四类指导级别切换上比 in-context adaptation 基线高 57.1 个百分点。
Motivation: 主动助手需要判断任务进度并调整指导粒度，但现有数据集要么只做检测式主动理解，要么只提供固定粒度的过程指导，难以判断任务完成度、也无法随进度与用户需求调整粒度。
Method: 发布 ProactiveCoach 套件：ProactiveCoach-Instruct 提供 phase、step、action 三级层次化指导数据用于训练，ProactiveCoach-Bench 评测模型是否在正确时机给出正确级别的指导并在请求级别变化时自适应；在该数据上微调预训练 VLM，并将微调模型与轻量 guidance router 组合成自适应指导系统。
Result: 与固定粒度监督相比，层次化监督在各 backbone 上整体性能最多提升 9.6 个百分点；加入 guidance router 的系统在无需额外微调的情况下，在四类指导级别切换上比 in-context adaptation 基线高 57.1 个百分点，且效果跨 backbone 成立。
Conclusion: 层次化过程监督（phase/step/action）比固定粒度监督更适合训练主动助手的进度判断与粒度自适应，配合轻量 router 可在不追加微调的前提下实现指导级别切换。

papers.title: Harmful Content Generation in Text-to-Image Models: Capabilities and Moderation Limitations
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image generative models can produce highly realistic imagery but also raise concerns about harmful misuse. While safety mechanisms exist, systematic evaluations of their effectiveness against realistic attacks remain limited. We present a systematic evaluation of harmful content generation across five open text-to-image models using an automated pipeline that transforms legitimate news captions into unsafe prompts targeting sexually explicit content, violence/gore, harmful stereotypes, self-harm, and hate speech. We evaluate both standard models with built-in safety mechanisms and community fine-tuned variants that bypass content restrictions. A human evaluation of 1,500 generated images shows high harmful-content generation rates: 89.2% for gore-related prompts, 47.6% for sexually explicit content, 43.6% for harmful stereotypes, 46.0% for hate speech, and 34.5% for self-harm, predominantly through graphic violence. Models show substantial capability for generating violent and stereotypical content, while community fine-tuned variants are particularly vulnerable to sexually explicit prompts. Generation quality is largely preserved under harmful prompting, producing imagery of sufficient fidelity to pose risks for disinformation and abuse; FLUX.1-dev produces clearly realistic harmful images in 30.9% of cases. We further evaluate automated moderation systems and find substantial detection gaps that allow unsafe images to evade filtering. Finally, we assess synthetic image detectors and show that models trained only on benign datasets perform worse on explicit content, while more diverse training data improves detection, highlighting semantic distribution gaps in current approaches. These findings expose limitations in current generation safeguards, moderation systems, and synthetic image detection, highlighting the need for stronger defenses against misuse at scale.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in ACM Transactions on Intelligent Systems and Technology (TIST)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对五个开源文生图模型做系统性有害内容生成评测：把合法新闻标题自动改写成五类不安全提示，人工评估 1,500 张生成图，gore 类有害内容生成率 89.2%，性暴露 47.6%，有害刻板印象 43.6%，仇恨言论 46.0%，自残 34.5%。FLUX.1-dev 在 30.9% 的案例中产出清晰逼真的有害图像；自动审核与合成图像检测均存在明显漏洞，仅用良性数据集训练的检测器在显式内容上更差。
Motivation: 现有安全机制虽多，但针对真实攻击的系统性有效性评测有限；社区微调变体可绕过内容限制，而审核与合成检测的漏洞使规模化滥用风险上升。
Method: 用自动化流水线把合法新闻标题改写为针对性暴露、暴力/gore、有害刻板印象、自残、仇恨言论五类的不安全提示，覆盖五个开源模型（含内置安全机制的标准版与社区微调绕过版）；对 1,500 张生成图做人评，并评测自动审核系统与合成图像检测器。
Result: 人评 1,500 张图的有害内容生成率：gore 89.2%、性暴露 47.6%、有害刻板印象 43.6%、仇恨言论 46.0%、自残 34.5%（以图像暴力为主）；社区微调变体对性暴露提示尤其脆弱；FLUX.1-dev 在 30.9% 案例中产出清晰逼真的有害图像；自动审核存在明显检出缺口，仅用良性数据集训练的合成检测器在显式内容上表现更差，更多样化训练数据可改善检测。
Conclusion: 当前生成防护、审核系统与合成图像检测三者均存在实质局限，需要针对规模化滥用的更强防御；语义分布缺口是合成检测失效的原因之一。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 用自动化流水线把合法新闻标题改写为针对性暴露、暴力/gore、有害刻板印象、自残、仇恨言论五类的不安全提示，覆盖五个开源模型（含内置安全机制的标准版与社区微调绕过版）；对 1,500 张生成图做人评，并评测自动审核系统与合成图像检测器。
summary_sections.result: 人评 1,500 张图的有害内容生成率：gore 89.2%、性暴露 47.6%、有害刻板印象 43.6%、仇恨言论 46.0%、自残 34.5%（以图像暴力为主）；社区微调变体对性暴露提示尤其脆弱；FLUX.1-dev 在 30.9% 案例中产出清晰逼真的有害图像；自动审核存在明显检出缺口，仅用良性数据集训练的合成检测器在显式内容上表现更差，更多样化训练数据可改善检测。
summary_sections.conclusion: 当前生成防护、审核系统与合成图像检测三者均存在实质局限，需要针对规模化滥用的更强防御；语义分布缺口是合成检测失效的原因之一。

papers.title: NeuroCBIR: A Fast and Accurate Image Retrieval System for Whole-Brain and Region-Specific MRI
papers.abstract_en: Content-based image retrieval (CBIR) in neuroimaging enables the identification of structurally similar brain scans, supporting diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment planning; however, existing methods are often limited to small datasets, single brain regions, or coarse class labels, thereby restricting their clinical utility and generalizability. Here, we present NeuroCBIR, a framework for fast and flexible retrieval of both whole-brain and region-specific 3D T1w MRI scans. A total of 103 cortical and subcortical regions are extracted to enable both whole-brain and region-level queries. NeuroCBIR leverages latent representations learned by a variational autoencoder (VAE) combined with contrastive learning, producing scan-specific embeddings that capture anatomical patterns. These embeddings were evaluated for subject re-identification, zero-shot age prediction, and zero-shot multi-class pathology stratification. Re-identification performance was high across both whole-brain and brain-region levels (mean average precision across the top-5 retrieved images (mAP@5) >= 98.4%), with robust generalization across datasets and acquisition conditions. While NeuroCBIR is not trained for age prediction or pathology stratification, zero-shot evaluations for these two tasks demonstrate that the embeddings encode meaningful information for downstream tasks. Embedding extraction on a 4-core CPU required approximately 18.7 s per scan, whereas similarity search was effectively instantaneous (less than 0.01 s). NeuroCBIR is publicly available for brain MRI with more than 26,000 precomputed T1w MRI embeddings. It supports reproducible research, region-specific flexibility, and clinically meaningful personalized diagnostic support. The software is available at https://github.com/minnelab/NeuroCBIR.
papers.comment: Neuroimaging, Content-Based Image Retrieval, MRI, Zero-Shot Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuroCBIR 用 VAE 潜表征加对比学习为 3D T1w MRI 生成扫描级嵌入，支持全脑与 103 个皮层/皮层下分区的检索查询。受试者重识别 mAP@5 ≥ 98.4%，4 核 CPU 上单次嵌入提取约 18.7 秒、相似检索小于 0.01 秒，并公开超过 26,000 条预计算嵌入。
Motivation: 现有脑影像 CBIR 受限于小数据集、单一脑区或粗粒度类别标签，难以支撑诊断、预后与治疗规划所需的临床可用性与泛化能力。

Conclusion: VAE 加对比学习的嵌入既能做快速全脑与分区级检索，也编码了年龄与病理等未训练任务的可用信息，可作为可复现的脑 MRI 个性化诊断支持底座。

papers.title: You Changed Your Mind, The Model Didn't: Demystifying Intent in Multi-Turn Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: When a large language model handles a multi-turn task and a user proposes a change but ultimately rejects it, the model should continue as if nothing changed. We find a surprising failure: merely mentioning a rejected change can derail task execution, even when the user's final intent remains unchanged. To systematically study language model behavior under evolving user intent, we introduce Intent-Eval, a controlled benchmark spanning tool actions, code, databases, and mathematics. Across diverse tasks, models are vulnerable to both rejected proposals and superseded requirements, consistent with mentioned-as-in-effect confusion: conversational content is treated as active requirements even after it has been rejected or replaced. Accuracy degradation can deepen or persist as interaction continues, highlighting the need to distinguish what has been mentioned from what remains in effect. Building on this insight, we propose Intent-OPSD, a decision-conditioned on-policy self-distillation framework with Teacher and Student initialized from the same model. The frozen Teacher provides active-intent supervision from the complete task matching the user's decision, training the Student on the full dialogue to follow active requirements reflecting user intent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多轮对话中，用户提出又否决的改动会实际带偏模型执行：即便最终意图未变，仅提及被否决的提议就足以让任务准确率下降，且随交互继续加深或持续。作者把这一现象归因于 mentioned-as-in-effect confusion，并提出 Intent-OPSD（decision-conditioned on-policy self-distillation），用与用户决定一致的完整任务上冻结 Teacher 提供主动意图监督来训练 Student。
Motivation: LLM 在多轮任务中无法区分「被提及过的要求」与「仍然生效的要求」，被否决或被取代的提议被当作活跃约束，导致最终意图未变时任务执行仍出错。
Method: 先构建受控基准 Intent-Eval，覆盖 tool actions、code、database、math 四类任务，系统检验模型对 rejected proposals 与 superseded requirements 的反应；再提出 Intent-OPSD：Teacher 与 Student 由同一模型初始化，冻结 Teacher 依据与用户决定匹配的完整任务给出主动意图监督，在全量对话上以 on-policy 自蒸馏训练 Student 遵循反映用户意图的活跃要求。
Result: 在 Intent-Eval 的多类任务上，模型对被否决的提议和被取代的要求都表现脆弱，准确率退化会随交互进行加深或持续，与 mentioned-as-in-effect confusion 一致。
Conclusion: 多轮对话模型需要显式区分「曾被提及」与「仍然生效」，仅靠对话上下文不足以还原用户最终意图。

papers.title: Topology-Informed Prompt-Conditioned Universal Segmentation of Uterine Structures from Ultrasound and MRI
papers.abstract_en: Multi-structure segmentation of the uterus is important for computer-assisted screening, diagnosis, and treatment planning of uterine diseases, where ultrasound and MRI provide complementary clinical information. However, developing a unified model across these modalities is challenging due to their substantially different image appearances, anatomical contexts, spatial resolutions, and label spaces. Moreover, existing datasets often define different segmentation targets, making joint learning challenging and potentially leading to negative transfer across heterogeneous tasks. To this end, we propose a Topology-informed Prompt-conditioned Universal Segmentation (TPUS) framework for segmenting multiple uterine structures across ultrasound and MRI. TPUS introduces a graph-based multi-dataset backbone comprising modality-specific stems and a modality-shared graph-based encoder-decoder to support modality-sensitive input adaptation, structural feature reasoning, and joint representation learning across heterogeneous uterine segmentation tasks. In addition, TPUS uses task-aware class prompts to condition the segmentation process for different datasets and label spaces, a dynamic convolutional adaptation module to generate task-specific output responses, and a topology-informed loss to encourage anatomically consistent predictions. Experiments on a uterine ultrasound dataset and a T2-weighted uterine myoma MRI dataset demonstrate that TPUS achieves Dice scores of 0.898 and 0.693 on the two held-out test sets, respectively, outperforming several generic and universal segmentation baselines. Source code can be accessed at https://github.com/YonghengSun1997/TPUS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TPUS 框架，用模态专属 stem 加模态共享的图编码器-解码器，在超声与 MRI 上统一分割多个子宫结构；任务感知类别提示与拓扑损失分别处理不同标签空间并约束解剖一致性。在子宫超声与 T2 加权子宫肌瘤 MRI 两个留出测试集上 Dice 分别为 0.898 和 0.693，优于若干通用与统一分割基线。
Motivation: 超声与 MRI 在成像外观、解剖语境、空间分辨率和标签空间上差异大，且各数据集定义的分割目标不同，联合学习易产生负迁移，难以训练统一的多结构分割模型。
Method: TPUS 采用图多数据集骨干：模态专属 stem 加模态共享图编码器-解码器，支持模态敏感输入适配与跨异构任务的联合表示学习；用任务感知类别提示 (task-aware class prompts) 条件化不同数据集与标签空间的分割，动态卷积适配模块生成任务专属输出响应，拓扑损失 (topology-informed loss) 约束解剖一致的预测。
Result: 在子宫超声数据集与 T2 加权子宫肌瘤 MRI 数据集的留出测试集上，Dice 分别为 0.898 和 0.693，优于若干通用与统一分割基线。
Conclusion: 把模态适配、任务提示与拓扑约束放进同一框架，可以在超声和 MRI 两类异构数据上实现统一的多结构子宫分割并取得更优 Dice。

papers.title: polyview: A Python package for multi-view machine learning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view learning jointly exploits multiple complementary representations of the same data and has become increasingly important in machine learning. However, the Python ecosystem lacks actively maintained, unified tooling for end-to-end multi-view workflows. In this paper, we present polyview, a Python package that provides tools for multi-view embedding, clustering, fusion, and view augmentation, as well as for handling incomplete views, all compatible with scikit-learn. The library offers a unified interface for composing heterogeneous multi-view workflows, including seamless transitions between multi-view and single-view stages. It is built around a core set of classes and utilities that enable composition of different methods and straightforward implementation of new ones. We illustrate the package on five real multi-view datasets and compare its components based on canonical correlation analysis with those of two established libraries. polyview aims to be both a practical toolkit for benchmarking and prototyping multi-view methods and a foundation for future research and development in this area.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: polyview 是一个与 scikit-learn 兼容的多视图学习 Python 包，覆盖多视图嵌入、聚类、融合、视图增强与不完整视图处理，并支持多视图与单视图阶段之间的无缝衔接。在五个真实多视图数据集上以典型相关分析 (canonical correlation analysis) 为基准与两个已有库对比其组件。
Motivation: Python 生态缺少活跃维护、统一的端到端多视图工作流工具，异构方法组合与新方法实现成本高。
Method: 提供统一接口与核心类/工具集，用于组合异构多视图工作流、在多视图与单视图阶段间过渡，并支持便捷实现新方法；全部组件与 scikit-learn 兼容，功能含嵌入、聚类、融合、视图增强与不完整视图处理。
Result: 在五个真实多视图数据集上说明包的用法，并基于典型相关分析 (CCA) 将其组件与两个已有库进行比较。
Conclusion: polyview 定位为多视图方法的基准测试与原型工具包，同时作为该领域后续研究开发的基础。

papers.title: GPlaceRL: An Open-Source Graph Reinforcement Learning Framework for Detailed Placement
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising approach for placement optimization, particularly when combined with graph neural networks (GNNs) that capture circuit connectivity. However, most learning-based placement approaches focus on floorplanning, macro placement, or global placement, while detailed placement refinement remains relatively unexplored. In this paper, we present GPlaceRL, an open-source graph reinforcement learning framework for detailed placement refinement. GPlaceRL represents legalized placements as graphs and provides a modular environment for studying graph encoders, policy architectures, reward formulations, and local placement actions. To demonstrate the capabilities of GPlaceRL, we conduct a systematic evaluation of proximal policy optimization (PPO) policies with graph attention network (GAT) encoders in a per-design optimization setting. Across five placement benchmarks, the best greedy evaluation results achieve HPWL improvements ranging from $3.27\%$ to $32.87\%$. The results highlight the importance of compact GAT architectures and flexible local action spaces for placement optimization. Overall, GPlaceRL provides a reproducible and extensible framework for systematic research on RL-based detailed placement refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GPlaceRL 是一个开源的图强化学习框架，把合法化后的版图表示为图，用模块化环境系统评估 PPO 策略与 GAT 图编码器在详细布局 (detailed placement) 精修上的表现。在五个布局基准上，最佳贪心评估的 HPWL 改进为 3.27% 到 32.87%，结果强调紧凑的 GAT 结构与灵活的局部动作空间对布局优化的重要性。
Motivation: 基于学习的布局工作大多集中在 floorplanning、宏单元布局或全局布局，详细布局精修 (detailed placement refinement) 这一环节相对缺乏可复现、可扩展的研究框架。
Method: 将合法化后的布局表示为图，提供模块化 RL 环境，可替换图编码器、策略结构、奖励形式与局部布局动作；在 per-design 优化设置下系统评估 PPO 策略配合 GAT 图编码器。
Result: 在五个布局基准 (placement benchmarks) 上，最佳贪心评估结果取得 3.27% 到 32.87% 的 HPWL 改进；结果突出紧凑 GAT 架构与灵活局部动作空间的作用。
Conclusion: GPlaceRL 提供可复现、可扩展的框架，用于系统研究基于 RL 的详细布局精修；紧凑 GAT 与灵活局部动作空间是布局优化的关键设计选择。

papers.title: FairProp: Fair Node Representation Learning via Differentiable Propagation Layers
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are the standard tool for node representation learning and are increasingly used in high-stakes settings. Their message-passing backbone, however, can amplify topological bias, raising fairness concerns. We study group fairness at the level of downstream predictions for node classification, link prediction, and node regression, and bound the demographic parity gap for an arbitrary number of sensitive groups. Our node classification bound is provably no looser than the closest prior result. For link prediction, ours is the first bound on the parity gap of the deployed sigmoid-activated prediction rather than a pre-activation proxy, and for node regression we provide the first such bound. Across all three tasks, the analysis identifies two distinct sources of bias: the separation between group means and the within-group covariance of the final representations. Building on this insight, we embed fairness into propagation itself by augmenting the convex smoothing problem underlying APPNP with a convex group-mean constraint and a within-group covariance regularizer. Unfolding projected gradient descent on this problem yields FairProp, whose layers pair a propagation step with a closed-form projection and which provably converges linearly to the unique fair optimum. Experiments on three tasks show that FairProp, even with exact group-mean equalization alone, provides a strong inductive bias that achieves excellent fairness-utility trade-offs against strong baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FairProp 把公平性直接嵌入 GNN 的传播层：在 APPNP 的凸平滑问题上加凸的组均值约束与组内协正则，展开投影梯度下降得到「传播步 + 闭式投影」的层，可证明线性收敛到唯一公平最优解。在节点分类、链路预测、节点回归三个任务上，仅靠精确组均值均衡就取得良好的公平—效用权衡。
Motivation: GNN 的消息传递会放大拓扑偏见，而高风险场景下需要对下游预测的群体公平 (demographic parity gap) 给出可证明的界与可嵌入模型的约束。
Method: 先对三个任务的 demographic parity gap 给出界（节点分类不弱于最近结果，链路预测是首个针对 sigmoid 部署预测而非预激活代理的界，节点回归为首个界），识别出组均值分离与最终表示组内协方差两个偏见来源；再在 APPNP 的凸平滑问题上加凸组均值约束与组内协正则，展开 projected gradient descent 得到 FairProp 层。
Result: 节点分类界可证明不弱于最近的先前结果；链路预测给出首个针对 sigmoid 激活后部署预测的 parity gap 界，节点回归给出首个此类界；FairProp 可证明线性收敛到唯一公平最优；在三个任务的实验中，仅用精确组均值均衡即对强基线取得优异的公平—效用权衡。
Conclusion: 偏见可分解为组均值分离与组内协方差两项，因此把组均值约束直接放进传播层即可在三个下游任务上同时保住效用与公平。

papers.title: MaRO-GS: Mask-Robust Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting from Inconsistent Multi-view Masks
papers.abstract_en: We address the challenge of accurate 3D object reconstruction from multi-view images in Gaussian Splatting. Existing object-level 3DGS methods reconstruct the entire scene rather than directly optimizing the target object, even when only the target object is needed, which incurs substantial computational overhead. They also rely on 2D segmentation masks to associate Gaussians with objects, but these masks are often inconsistent across views. Such inconsistencies corrupt Gaussian optimization and produce incorrectly supervised Gaussians that degrade object reconstruction fidelity. To overcome these limitations, we propose MaRO-GS, a 3DGS framework that directly optimizes target-object Gaussians from object-masked multi-view images and remains robust to inconsistent supervision. For reliable supervision, mask-reliability view filtering excludes unreliable views. Object-supported Gaussian density control suppresses Gaussians irrelevant to the target object and prevents background densification, while Silhouette-aligned Object Loss maintains object-focused optimization. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that MaRO-GS improves PSNR, segmentation accuracy, and computational efficiency, with the largest PSNR gain of 2.05 dB on the small-object LERF-Mask dataset.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. Project page: https://eunjikim02.github.io/marogs/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MaRO-GS 直接从带物体掩膜的多视角图像优化目标物体的 Gaussian Splatting，并对跨视角不一致的掩膜监督保持鲁棒：用 mask-reliability view filtering 剔除不可靠视角，object-supported Gaussian density control 抑制与目标无关的高斯并阻止背景增密，Silhouette-aligned Object Loss 保持优化聚焦物体。在多数据集实验中提升 PSNR、分割精度与计算效率，小物体的 LERF-Mask 上 PSNR 增益最大达 2.05 dB。
Motivation: 现有物体级 3DGS 方法重建整个场景而非直接优化目标物体，带来大量计算开销；且依赖的 2D 分割掩膜跨视角不一致，会污染高斯优化、产生错误监督，降低物体重建保真度。
Method: MaRO-GS 框架从物体掩膜化的多视角图像直接优化目标物体高斯：mask-reliability view filtering 排除不可靠视角以保证监督可靠；object-supported Gaussian density control 抑制与目标无关的高斯并防止背景增密；Silhouette-aligned Object Loss 维持以物体为中心的优化。
Result: 在多个多样数据集上，MaRO-GS 同时提升 PSNR、分割精度与计算效率；在小物体的 LERF-Mask 数据集上 PSNR 增益最大，为 2.05 dB。
Conclusion: 直接优化目标物体高斯并对掩膜不一致做视角过滤与密度控制，可在降低计算开销的同时提高物体级 3DGS 重建保真度。

papers.title: Odyssey: A Closed-Loop Benchmark for Long-Horizon Real-World Driving with Explicit Navigation Routes
papers.abstract_en: Closed-loop evaluation of end-to-end driving requires continuous rollouts that reveal how earlier decisions affect subsequent driving. However, existing benchmarks evaluate only short segments and fail to capture later consequences. Ambiguous directional commands also obscure the intended navigation objective. We introduce Odyssey, a closed-loop benchmark for long-horizon driving comprising 100 scenarios, each reconstructed from a 100-second nuPlan driving log to preserve the context of navigation maneuvers and traffic interactions. To provide a consistent navigation objective, Odyssey replaces directional commands with explicit standard-definition (SD) map routes that specify which roads to follow, while sensor-based planning determines local driving actions. Throughout these rollouts, diffusion-based refinement of 3DGS-rendered images reduces rendering artifacts along the ego trajectory. To assess how effectively planners follow these routes and prepare for upcoming maneuvers, we introduce SD Route Compliance and Pre-Lane Change Score. These assessments are complemented by RouteDS, which extends the Driving Score with penalties for SD-route deviations and failed lane preparation. We adapt state-of-the-art planners, including vision-language-action (VLA) models, and evaluate their navigation performance using these metrics. Odyssey highlights open questions in route representation and integration for E2E driving. Benchmark code and adapted baselines will be released publicly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Odyssey 是闭环长时程自动驾驶基准：100 个场景各由 100 秒 nuPlan 日志重建，用显式 SD 地图路线替代模糊方向指令，并用扩散模型对 3DGS 渲染图像做沿轨迹精修以减少伪影。新指标 SD Route Compliance、Pre-Lane Change Score 与 RouteDS（在 Driving Score 上叠加偏离路线与变道准备失败的惩罚）用于衡量规划器遵循路线的程度。
Motivation: 现有端到端驾驶基准只评短片段，看不到早期决策的后续后果；方向指令含糊又掩盖了导航意图，长时程闭环表现无从比较。
Method: 每个场景从 100 秒 nuPlan 日志重建以保留导航机动与交通交互上下文；以显式 SD 地图路线规定应走道路、传感器规划决定局部动作；对 3DGS 渲染图像做扩散精修以抑制自车轨迹上的渲染伪影；适配含 vision-language-action (VLA) 在内的 SOTA 规划器并用新指标评测。
Result: 基准含 100 个场景、每个 100 秒 nuPlan 日志；提出 SD Route Compliance、Pre-Lane Change Score 与 RouteDS 三个指标，RouteDS 在 Driving Score 基础上对偏离 SD 路线和变道准备失败施加惩罚，并据此评测适配的 SOTA 规划器（含 VLA 模型）的导航表现。
Conclusion: 显式路线表示加闭环长时程评测暴露出端到端驾驶在路线表示与集成上的开放问题；基准代码与适配基线将公开发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Latent Flow Matching for Molecular Graph Generation
papers.abstract_en: Modern graph generative models typically operate directly in the discrete graph space, explicitly generating node and edge variables, which can become costly as graphs grow. In this paper, we perform generation explicitly on latent representations of entire graphs obtained from a pretrained Variational Autoencoder with high reconstruction fidelity. The generated representations, obtained through flow matching, are then decoded only at the final step. Across molecular benchmarks of increasing size, our approach achieves strong validity and FCD while offering a favorable quality-efficiency trade-off compared with state-of-the-art explicit graph generative models. One of the main advantages of this formulation is that the graph representation only needs to be learned once, after which the same one can be reused across multiple generative objectives without retraining. We demonstrate generation guided by molecular properties and further introduce validity-aware generation though a classifier learned directly in latent space. All code will be made available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在预训练 VAE 的整图 latent 空间上用 flow matching 生成分子图，最后一步才解码回离散图，避免逐节点逐边的显式生成开销。在规模递增的分子基准上取得强 validity 与 FCD，相对 SOTA 显式图生成模型给出更优的质量-效率权衡；同一 latent 表征可跨多个生成目标复用而无需重训。
Motivation: 显式离散图生成要逐个生成节点与边变量，图变大后开销显著；同时表征往往绑定单一生成目标，换目标就要重训。
Method: 先用高重建保真度的预训练 VAE 学一次整图 latent 表征，再在 latent 上做 flow matching 生成，仅在最后一步解码回图；另在 latent 空间直接训练分类器，实现 validity-aware 生成与分子性质引导生成。
Result: 在规模递增的分子基准上取得强 validity 与 FCD，并相对 SOTA 显式图生成模型呈现有利的质量-效率权衡；演示了分子性质引导生成与 latent 空间分类器驱动的 validity-aware 生成。
Conclusion: 把生成放到整图 latent 空间、只在末步解码，可让表征一次学习、跨多个生成目标复用，从而在分子图上兼顾质量与效率。

papers.title: A Physics-Guided Transformer Framework for Electromigration Analysis in Multi-Segment Interconnects
papers.abstract_en: As technology scales to smaller nodes, increasing current densities make electromigration (EM) one of the dominant reliability challenges in on-chip interconnects. Accurate transient stress analysis is needed to identify wires susceptible to EM degradation, but applying physics-based solvers across many interconnects remains computationally expensive. This paper proposes a physics-guided transformer framework for fast EM stress prediction in multi-segment interconnect lines. The framework converts each line into geometry- and DC-aware segment tokens and uses transformer attention to capture line-level context. A lightweight query decoder then predicts stress at selected locations and time instants. The model is trained with an objective that combines normalized supervised regression, linewise relative-$L_2$ loss, and physics-guided continuity and terminal-flux terms. Experiments on IBM power grid benchmarks show that the proposed model achieves relative-$L_2$ error below 8\% and reaches up to 2459.68$\times$ speedup compared with the matrix exponential~solver.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向多段互连线电迁移 (electromigration) 应力预测，提出物理引导 Transformer：把每条线编码为几何与 DC 感知的 segment token，用注意力捕捉线级上下文，轻量 query decoder 直接预测指定位置与时刻的应力。在 IBM power grid 基准上相对 L2 误差低于 8%，相比 matrix exponential solver 最高加速 2459.68 倍。
Motivation: 先进工艺节点下电流密度上升使电迁移成为片上互连线主要可靠性问题，需要瞬态应力分析筛出易退化导线，但对大量导线反复调用物理求解器计算代价过高。
Method: 将每条多段互连线转换为几何与 DC 感知的 segment token，经 Transformer attention 建模线级上下文，轻量 query decoder 预测选定位置与时刻的应力；训练目标组合归监督回归、线级 relative-L2 损失，以及物理引导的连续性与终端通量 (terminal-flux) 约束项。
Result: 在 IBM power grid 基准上，相对 L2 误差低于 8%，相对 matrix exponential solver 最高达到 2459.68 倍加速。
Conclusion: 把物理约束写进损失的 Transformer 可以在保持低相对 L2 误差的同时，把多段互连线瞬态 EM 应力预测提速到物理求解器的千倍量级。

papers.title: AgentPrivArena: Evaluating and Auditing Real-world AI Agent Privacy
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of LLM agents has enabled systems to autonomously perform complex tasks through external tools, but their growing access to personal data introduces significant privacy risks. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate LLM agent privacy through simulated trajectories and outcome-based metrics, limiting their ability to capture privacy risks arising during multi-step agent execution. In this work, we introduce AgentPrivArena, a framework for evaluating privacy risks in realistic LLM agent workflows. AgentPrivArena integrates authentic MCP tools and self-hosted services within a reproducible execution environment. We further propose trajectory-level privacy metrics that quantify unnecessary information access beyond final response leakage. Building on this framework, we introduce AgentPrivAudit, a runtime auditing approach for monitoring privacy violations during agent execution. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art LLM agents reveal substantial privacy risks overlooked by existing evaluation paradigms, highlighting the importance of trajectory-level auditing for trustworthy agent deployment.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 隐私评测主要依赖模拟轨迹和结果指标，无法捕捉多步执行过程中产生的隐私风险，个人数据访问失控难以被发现。
Method: AgentPrivArena 在可复现执行环境中集成真实 MCP 工具与自托管服务；提出量化最终回复之外多余信息访问的轨迹级隐私度量；在其上构建 AgentPrivAudit，在 agent 执行期间运行时监控隐私违规。

Conclusion: 仅看最终输出的隐私评测会系统性低估 agent 风险，可信部署需要在执行过程中做轨迹级审计。

papers.title: Normality Constraint Learning: Adapting Foundation Models for Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) achieve strong generalization by learning to reconstruct or forecast broad temporal patterns from large-scale time series during pre-training. Yet this strength can become a weakness for anomaly detection: TSFMs may model rare anomalous patterns as effectively as normal ones, allowing anomalies to be accurately reconstructed or forecasted and thus diminishing their reconstruction/forecasting error-based anomaly scores. This paper proposes $\underline{\textbf{N}}$$\textbf{ormality}$ $\underline{\textbf{C}}$$\textbf{onstraint}$ $\underline{\textbf{L}}$$\textbf{earning}$ ($\textbf{NCL}$), a lightweight plug-and-play framework that adapts pre-trained TSFMs for accurate anomaly detection without modifying their pre-trained parameters. Our key insight is to constrain the broad pattern space of TSFMs to the normal structure of a target time series, preventing their broad modeling capability from obscuring abnormal deviations. Specifically, NCL constructs a compact normality subspace from a few normal patch features and adaptively steers each patch feature toward normality within this subspace, guided by contrastive constraints that form compact and discriminative normality manifolds. The calibrated features are aggregated to reinforce normal components and fused with the original TSFM output, amplifying the discrepancy between normal and abnormal observations for the reconstruction/forecasting error-based anomaly scoring. Extensive experiments across diverse TSFM families and benchmarks show that NCL consistently improves anomaly detection performance, providing a generalizable framework for adapting TSFMs to anomaly detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NCL 是一个即插即用的轻量框架，把预训练时序基础模型 (TSFM) 的宽泛模式空间约束到目标序列的正常结构上，防止异常被照样重建或预报而拉低异常分数。它用少量正常 patch 特征构造紧凑正常子空间，在对比约束下把各 patch 特征自适应拉向该子空间形成正常流形，再与原始 TSFM 输出融合放大正常与异常的误差差异。在多个 TSFM 家族与基准上，NCL 一致提升异常检测性能且不改动预训练参数。
Motivation: TSFM 预训练时学会重建或预报广泛的时间模式，这反而削弱基于重建/预报误差的异常分数：稀有异常也能被准确重建，从而被漏检。
Method: NCL 不修改预训练参数：先从少量正常 patch 特征构造紧凑的正常子空间 (normality subspace)，再用对比约束引导每个 patch 特征在该子空间内自适应地向正常性靠拢，形成紧凑且可分的正常流形；校准后的特征聚合以强化正常成分，并与原始 TSFM 输出融合，放大正常与异常观测在重建/预报误差上的差异用于打分。
Result: 在多个不同 TSFM 家族和多种异常检测基准上的实验中，NCL 一致提升异常检测性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把 TSFM 的宽泛建模能力约束到目标序列的正常结构上，可以在不改动预训练参数的前提下，把 TSFM 通用地适配为更准的异常检测器。

papers.title: Multimodal Safety Evaluation Should Measure Controllability Beyond Classification
papers.abstract_en: VLM safety is commonly evaluated through input- and output-level classification. Such classification is necessary, but it does not reveal whether a safety state is accessible or controllable inside the model. We argue that multimodal safety evaluation should therefore report a \emph{controllability profile} alongside behavioral classification, separating representation-level detectability, cross-modal specificity, intervention sensitivity, and benign-preserving selectivity. Using implicit toxicity as a stress case, we instantiate this profile on LlavaGuard and Qwen3.5 with sparse feature decompositions. LlavaGuard admits localized handles with a narrow benign-preserving intervention range and modest downstream safety gains, whereas Qwen3.5 supports strong representation-level readout but no comparable selective-control regime under the tested operators. These results show that internal readout and controllability can diverge. Future multimodal safety benchmarks should therefore report not only behavioral safety metrics, but also whether safety-relevant internal signals can be intervention-tested and controlled within a validated operating range.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张多模态安全评估不能只做输入/输出级分类，还应报告可控性画像 (controllability profile)，把表征级可探测性、跨模态特异性、干预敏感性、良性保持选择性四项分开度量。以隐式毒性为压力案例在 LlavaGuard 与 Qwen3.5 上用稀疏特征分解实例化后发现：LlavaGuard 有局部干预抓手但良性保持区间窄、下游安全增益有限；Qwen3.5 表征级读出强却在所测算子下没有可比的选择性控制机制，说明内部读出与可控性会背离。
Motivation: VLM 安全评估普遍停留在输入/输出级分类，只能说明行为是否安全，无法说明安全状态在模型内部是否可探测、可干预、可在良性区间内受控。
Method: 提出 controllability profile，含 representation-level detectability、cross-modal specificity、intervention sensitivity、benign-preserving selectivity 四个维度；以 implicit toxicity 为压力案例，在 LlavaGuard 和 Qwen3.5 上用稀疏特征分解 (sparse feature decompositions) 实例化该画像并施加干预算子。
Result: LlavaGuard 存在局部化干预抓手，但良性保持干预区间窄，下游安全增益仅为 modest；Qwen3.5 支持强表征级读出，但在所测算子下没有可比的选择性控制机制。核心发现是内部读出与可控性可以背离。
Conclusion: 未来多模态安全基准除行为安全指标外，还应报告安全相关内部信号能否在经验证的工作区间内被干预检验与控制。

papers.title: EMG-FM-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Foundation Model Transfer and Adaptation on Electromyography
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models (FMs) are increasingly being developed for general time series and physiological signals, yet their transferability to downstream physiological tasks remains poorly understood. This question is particularly challenging for electromyography (EMG), where signal distributions vary substantially across users, sensing configurations, acquisition hardware, and downstream tasks. We introduce EMG-FM-Bench, a systematic benchmark for studying foundation-model transfer and adaptation on EMG. EMG-FM-Bench unifies 20 public datasets with over 1 million EMG segments and evaluates nine pretrained foundation models across four questions: how pretrained models perform when frozen or fully fine-tuned, how much pretraining helps compared with training the same model from scratch, how well models generalize to new users with limited labeled data, and how performance changes across different EMG tasks. Across the benchmark, linear probing provides useful information about pretrained representations, but full fine-tuning can substantially change downstream EMG performance. Comparing each pretrained model with the same model trained from scratch shows that the benefit of pretraining varies substantially across models and is not universal. Performance decreases when models are evaluated on new users, while five-shot adaptation improves macro-F1 in 70.2% of evaluated model-dataset combinations but recovers only part of the lost performance. Model performance is highly consistent between upper- and lower-limb classification and remains strongly correlated with continuous EMG-to-text decoding. Together, these results provide a systematic view of when pretrained time-series models transfer effectively to EMG and how their performance depends on fine-tuning, user variation, and downstream task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMG-FM-Bench 用 20 个公开数据集、超 100 万段 EMG 统一评测 9 个预训练基础模型的迁移与适配，覆盖冻结/全量微调、预训练 vs 从零训练、新用户少标注泛化、跨任务表现四个问题。结论是预训练收益因模型而异并不普遍，换到新用户性能下降，五-shot 适配在 70.2% 的模型-数据集组合上提升 macro-F1 但只追回部分损失。
Motivation: 通用时间序列与生理信号基础模型的下游可迁移性尚不清楚，而 EMG 在用户、传感配置、硬件与任务间分布差异大，缺少系统评测口径。
Method: 统一 20 个公开数据集（超 100 万段 EMG），评测 9 个预训练基础模型，围绕四个问题设计：冻结 vs 全量微调、预训练 vs 同结构从零训练、少标注新用户泛化、跨 EMG 任务表现；报告 linear probing 与五-shot 适配。
Result: linear probing 能反映预训练表征但全量微调会大幅改变下游表现；预训练相对从零训练的收益因模型而异、并不普遍；新用户评测性能下降，五-shot 适配在 70.2% 的模型-数据集组合上提升 macro-F1 但仅部分追回损失；上下肢分类表现高度一致，且与连续 EMG-to-text 解码强相关。
Conclusion: 预训练时间序列模型能否有效迁移到 EMG 取决于微调方式、用户差异与下游任务，不能假定预训练必然带来收益。

papers.title: Time-series Foundation Models for Predictive Control: The Role of Excitation
papers.abstract_en: Deploying model predictive control (MPC) requires constructing or identifying a predictive model for each target system. Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) offer an attractive option thanks to strong zero-shot forecasting capabilities across systems. However, low forecast error does not guarantee that a TSFM captures the system's response to the alternative actions considered by the controller. We study this gap using residential heat-pump control as a test bed, measuring the agreement between predicted and ground-truth effects of control interventions. Importantly, we find that TSFMs can recover the system's input-response relationship when the context contains sufficient independent control excitation. Common fine-tuning pipelines and feature smoothing reduce, but do not eliminate, the need for in-context excitation. Our results indicate that current TSFMs used for predictive control require sufficiently informative control variation in the inference context. Initial closed-loop results show promise for shorter context windows.
papers.comment: Accepted at the TS-LIMITS Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 时序基础模型 (TSFM) 零预测误差并不保证它学到控制器所关心的输入-响应关系：以住宅热泵控制为试验台，作者测量预测干预效应与真实干预效应的一致性，发现只有当推理上下文包含足够独立的控制激励 (excitation) 时，TSFM 才能恢复系统输入-响应关系。常见微调流程与特征平滑只能减轻、不能消除对上下文激励的需求；初步闭环结果显示较短上下文窗口有希望。
Motivation: MPC 需要为每个目标系统构造或辨识预测模型，TSFM 的零样本跨系统预报看似可直接复用，但低预报误差不等于模型捕捉了控制器备选动作下的系统响应，这一缺口此前未被量化。
Method: 以住宅热泵控制为试验台，把 TSFM 用于预测控制，直接度量控制干预的预测效应与真实效应之间的一致性；对比不同上下文激励水平，并考察常见微调流程与特征平滑对激励需求的影响，另给出初步闭环实验。
Result: 上下文含足够独立控制激励时，TSFM 能恢复系统输入-响应关系；常见微调管线与特征平滑降低但未消除对上下文激励的需求；初步闭环结果在较短上下文窗口上表现有希望。
Conclusion: 当前用于预测控制的 TSFM 必须在推理上下文中获得足够具信息量的控制变化，否则低预报误差不能保证控制器可用的响应模型。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: The Assistance Dilemma: Learning to Teach via Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) trained to answer questions are natively poor at teaching. Reinforcement Learning (RL) against a simulated student is a promising approach to improve their pedagogy, but existing RL-trained tutors reward the student's success on the tutored problem with the tutor's words still in context. The reward is then easiest to raise by telling the student the answer, and a tuned penalty is needed to reduce telling. Drawing on learning sciences, we introduce a masked near-transfer post-test: the student is tested on an unseen variant of the tutored problem with the tutor's utterances masked, so the reward can rise only through what the student wrote in its own turns. This discourages cognitive offloading by the student and allows the continuous penalty to be replaced by two binary reward gates (factual correctness of tutor response, no solution handover). A leave-one-out ablation shows that the learning-gain reward on its own does not separate teaching from telling: the gates reduce solution handover while the near-transfer post-test improves out-of-domain transfer. Using these reward designs we develop Eduardo, a multi-turn RL recipe for training LLM tutors, and use it to train 4B, 9B, 14B and 27B models from two distinct LLM architectures. Our post-trained Eduardo-27B model matches Gemini-3.1-Pro on MathTutorBench and Claude Opus 4.8 on TutorMoments at 2.4-6.2x fewer thinking tokens than frontier models, which matters for interactive tutoring. Without being named in the reward, the model more than doubles its use of the push-for-justification teacher move while support fading (e.g., assigning independent work), whose payoff lies beyond a single-problem dialog episode, is trained out. We open-source our training environment, an 8,671-problem near-transfer dataset, and trained models for further development.

papers.title: Choosing an energy-efficient software architecture for building system diagnostic support
papers.abstract_en: Around 30\% of global energy expenditure can be attributed to the building sector, where a large portion of energy-consumption could be avoided by repairing existing faults. Fault detection and diagnosis (FDD) software addresses this issue; however, its creation and operation also have an environmental impact. The magnitude of this impact is influenced by the diagnosis architecture, as different architectures and methods have different energy demands. Yet, simply considering the energy consumed by the software itself is not sufficient to assess its overall environmental impact, since the diagnostic performance, e.g., number of detected faults or number of faults missed, also contributes to its ecological footprint. In this paper, we propose an energy-consumption model that considers FDD performance and energy spend directly by the diagnosis software. In an initial experiment, we compare several FDD architecture families, i.e., rule-based, model-based, classical machine learning, and large-language-model-based, in simulation using performance and energy-consumption values collected from prior literature. The results show that considering the computational energy and accuracy of FDD can change the relative benefit of the different approaches. Computationally efficient machine learning methods, such as random forest, provide the largest net savings on smaller buildings, whereas more resource-intensive approaches, such as fine-tuned large language models, become advantageous as building size increases. Our findings suggest that overall energy efficiency depends not only on the computational demand of the FDD software, but also on its diagnostic performance and the scale of the building.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个把 FDD 诊断性能与软件自身能耗放在同一账本里的能耗模型，并用文献中的性能与能耗数值在仿真中比较规则式、模型式、经典机器学习与大语言模型四类故障诊断架构。结论是：随机森林等计算轻量的方法在小建筑上净节能最大，而微调 LLM 这类资源密集方案随建筑规模增大才转为优势，即架构排序会随建筑尺度翻转。
Motivation: 建筑部门约占全球能耗 30%，靠修复既有故障可避免大量能耗，但 FDD 软件自身的开发与运行也有环境代价；只看软件能耗不足以评估整体影响，因为漏检/检出的诊断性能同样计入生态足迹。
Method: 构建一个同时计入 FDD 诊断性能（检出与漏检故障数）和诊断软件直接能耗的能耗模型；在仿真中比较规则式、模型式、经典机器学习（如 random forest）与 large-language-model-based 四类架构族，性能与能耗取值来自已有文献。
Result: 把计算能耗与准确率一起纳入后，各架构的相对优劣发生改变：random forest 等计算高效方法在较小建筑上净节能最大，微调大语言模型等资源密集方法随建筑规模增大转为有利；建筑部门约占全球能耗 30%。
Conclusion: FDD 的整体能效不只取决于软件计算开销，还取决于诊断性能与建筑规模，架构选择应按建筑尺度而非单一能耗指标决定。

papers.title: ARO: Aligned Representation learning for multi-Omics data
papers.abstract_en: The high cost of functional molecular assays, and prevalence of missing modalities and unmatched samples in computational biology, create significant barriers to comprehensive multi-omic profiling, essential for capturing and reasoning over molecules, cells, tissues, and organisms. This work proposes a model that learns meaningful representations from multi-omics cancer data supporting the reconstruction of missing and unpaired modalities. Contrary to increasingly complex, larger models, e.g. Foundation Models (FMs), ARO prioritizes practical applicability in limited or incomplete data settings. ARO optimally reconstructs missing modalities (MSE of $0.15$ on the validation and test data in the Unmasked settings), with its learned latent embeddings enabling a downstream cancer classification task. Our findings indicate that analyzing diverse molecular layers as a single integrated system offers a reliable and cost-efficient approach, reducing dependence on large-scale experimental testing, while still supporting multi-omic exploration in limited data settings.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the ICML 2026 3rd Workshop on Multi-modal Foundation Models and Large Language Models for Life Sciences, Seoul, Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARO 在多组学癌症数据上学到统一潜表示，用于重建缺失与不配对的分子模态，并把该嵌入直接用于下游癌症分类。在 Unmasked 设定下缺失模态重建的 MSE 在验证集与测试集上均为 0.15，作者主张把多层分子数据当作一个整合系统分析，可在有限、不完整数据下减少对大规模实验检测的依赖。
Motivation: 功能分子实验成本高，且计算生物学中普遍存在模态缺失与样本不配对，使全面多组学分析难以实现；同时大型 Foundation Model 在数据有限或不完整时并不实用。
Method: 提出 ARO（Aligned Representation learning for multi-Omics data），学习多组学癌症数据的对齐潜表示以重建缺失与未配对模态，刻意面向数据受限场景而非扩大模型规模，并用学到的潜嵌入支撑下游癌症分类任务。
Result: 在 Unmasked 设定下，缺失模态重建的 MSE 在验证集与测试集上均为 0.15；学到的潜嵌入被用于下游癌症分类任务。
Conclusion: 把多样分子层作为单一整合系统分析，是在有限数据条件下可靠且省成本的多组学探索路径，可降低对大规模实验测试的依赖。

papers.title: Better Call Reward: Reward Hacking as Strategic Abstention in Legal Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: What happens when a legal AI model learns to look like a lawyer instead of reasoning like one? We fine tune Qwen3-8B with Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) against a proxy built from three surface features: citation count, legalese density, and response length. The model does not learn to reason more effectively. It learns to withhold commitment. Across 16 yes or no legal reasoning tasks from LegalBench (N=320), overall accuracy collapses from 0.500 (chance) to 0.072 (McNemar p < 10^-36), driven entirely by the rate of properly formatted answers falling from 0.900 to 0.109. The model stops committing to answers. Yet when it does commit, accuracy rises from 0.556 to 0.657, showing that the collapse is not a failure of capability but a strategic response: the model has learned that verbose responses packed with citations but empty of a direct answer score higher than terse correct ones. We term this the Saul Goodman effect, a policy that becomes maximally lawyerly while becoming maximally noncommittal, and prove formally that it is the optimal response to any surface feature proxy that attaches no penalty to abstention. We further show that 89.3% of citations produced after training are structurally implausible hallucinations, many of them subtly corrupted names of real landmark cases, constructed in effect to survive a casual read and fail under scrutiny. To detect this failure mode before deployment, we introduce three diagnostic tools: the Confidence Theater Score (CTS), the Citation Plausibility Rate (CPR), and the Regret Gap (RG). In a domain where a confidently wrong answer can constitute malpractice, the broader lesson is direct: a reward function that measures how legal a response looks will produce a model that is maximally photogenic and minimally useful.
papers.comment: 11 Pages , Accepted at AI for Law Workshop @ ICML 2026 also accepted for publication in the Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用引用数、法言法语密度、回复长度这三个表面特征做 GRPO 奖励微调 Qwen3-8B，模型不学会更好地推理，而是学会弃答：LegalBench 16 个是非法律推理任务（N=320）上总体准确率从 0.500 崩到 0.072，格式合规率从 0.900 掉到 0.109，但一旦作答准确率反升至 0.657。作者证明对任何不惩罚弃答的表面特征代理，这种「最像律师却不表态」的策略（Saul Goodman effect）就是最优响应。
Motivation: 奖励模型只度量回答「看起来多像法律文书」时，模型会学会伪装而非推理；在法律这种答错即可能构成失当（malpractice）的领域，部署前需要能提前识别这种失效模式的检测手段。
Method: 对 Qwen3-8B 用 Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) 微调，奖励代理由三个表面特征构成：引用数、法言法语密度、回复长度；在 LegalBench 的 16 个是非法律推理任务（N=320）上评测，并形式化证明该策略对不惩罚弃答的代理是最优响应；提出三个诊断工具 Confidence Theater Score (CTS)、Citation Plausibility Rate (CPR)、Regret Gap (RG)。

papers.title: HeuFouFT: Task-Guided Metaheuristic Coordinate Search for Fourier Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Heuristic-Guided Fourier Fine-Tuning (HeuFouFT), a task-guided framework for selecting trainable frequency coordinates in Fourier fine-tuning. Existing uniform and Gaussian band-pass schemes allocate a limited spectral budget through fixed, task-agnostic rules. HeuFouFT instead searches for coordinates using downstream performance. A coarse intensity map from lightweight block-level probes initializes three metaheuristic optimizers: Genetic Algorithm with Simulated Annealing (GA-SA), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), and Cuckoo Search (CS). During search, a Random Forest filters each population so that only the top 30% of candidates proceed to proxy fine-tuning. On E2E with GPT-2-Medium, all three variants outperform random-uniform FourierFT, Gaussian band-pass FourierFT, and LoRA across five metrics. PSO further outperforms LoCA, the best-performing baseline, on four metrics while using 37.6% fewer trainable spectral coefficients. Once coordinates are selected, HeuFouFT requires only 15--18% FLOPs of Full FT. These results show that task-guided search allocates limited spectral capacity more effectively than fixed sampling. Our code is publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HeuFouFT 用下游性能驱动的元启发式搜索替代固定规则，为 Fourier fine-tuning 挑选可训练频率坐标：轻量 block 级探针给出粗强度图，初始化 GA-SA、PSO、CS 三种搜索器，搜索中用 Random Forest 筛出前 30% 候选进入 proxy fine-tuning。在 E2E + GPT-2-Medium 上三种变体在五项指标上全部超过 random-uniform FourierFT、Gaussian band-pass FourierFT 与 LoRA，其中 PSO 在四项指标上超过最强基线 LoCA，且少用 37.6% 可训练谱系数，选完坐标后只需 Full FT 的 15–18% FLOPs。
Motivation: 现有 Fourier fine-tuning 的 uniform 与 Gaussian band-pass 用固定、与任务无关的规则分配有限谱预算，无法按下游任务的实际需求定位重要频率坐标。
Method: 先用轻量 block 级探针 (block-level probes) 生成粗强度图，作为三种元启发式优化器 GA-SA、PSO、Cuckoo Search 的初始化；搜索过程中用 Random Forest 对每个种群过滤，仅保留前 30% 候选做 proxy fine-tuning，再由下游表现引导坐标选择。
Result: 在 E2E 数据集、GPT-2-Medium 主干上，GA-SA、PSO、CS 三个变体在五项指标上全部优于 random-uniform FourierFT、Gaussian band-pass FourierFT 与 LoRA；PSO 在四项指标上超过最强基线 LoCA，同时少用 37.6% 可训练谱系数；坐标选定后推理只需 Full FT 的 15–18% FLOPs。
Conclusion: 任务引导的搜索比固定采样更有效地分配有限谱容量，且能在更少可训练谱系数与更低 FLOPs 下达到或超过固定规则与 LoRA 类基线；代码已公开。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: HeuFouFT 用下游性能驱动的元启发式搜索替代固定规则，为 Fourier fine-tuning 挑选可训练频率坐标：轻量 block 级探针给出粗强度图，初始化 GA-SA、PSO、CS 三种搜索器，搜索中用 Random Forest 筛出前 30% 候选进入 proxy fine-tuning。在 E2E + GPT-2-Medium 上三种变体在五项指标上全部超过 random-uniform FourierFT、Gaussian band-pass FourierFT 与 LoRA，其中 PSO 在四项指标上超过最强基线 LoCA，且少用 37.6% 可训练谱系数，选完坐标后只需 Full FT 的 15–18% FLOPs。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 Fourier fine-tuning 的 uniform 与 Gaussian band-pass 用固定、与任务无关的规则分配有限谱预算，无法按下游任务的实际需求定位重要频率坐标。
summary_sections.method: 先用轻量 block 级探针 (block-level probes) 生成粗强度图，作为三种元启发式优化器 GA-SA、PSO、Cuckoo Search 的初始化；搜索过程中用 Random Forest 对每个种群过滤，仅保留前 30% 候选做 proxy fine-tuning，再由下游表现引导坐标选择。
summary_sections.result: 在 E2E 数据集、GPT-2-Medium 主干上，GA-SA、PSO、CS 三个变体在五项指标上全部优于 random-uniform FourierFT、Gaussian band-pass FourierFT 与 LoRA；PSO 在四项指标上超过最强基线 LoCA，同时少用 37.6% 可训练谱系数；坐标选定后推理只需 Full FT 的 15–18% FLOPs。
summary_sections.conclusion: 任务引导的搜索比固定采样更有效地分配有限谱容量，且能在更少可训练谱系数与更低 FLOPs 下达到或超过固定规则与 LoRA 类基线；代码已公开。

papers.title: KESurv: A Kernel Ensemble Method for Patient-Specific Survival Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting patient-specific survival functions is crucial for clinicians in making informed decisions about patient care and treatment strategies. Among the various models available, the Survival Forest has demonstrated significant effectiveness in numerous scenarios. In this work, we propose an ensemble method that leverages the strengths of the Survival Forest as the master model, complemented by several base models. This ensemble incorporates the Beran estimator, a type of kernel estimator, to enhance predictions of patient-specific survival curves. We evaluated the performance of our proposed model using four distinct healthcare datasets. The results highlight the superiority of our ensemble method over baseline models in both calibration and ranking across most datasets. The findings suggest that our approach offers a more accurate and reliable estimation of patient-specific survival functions, providing a valuable tool for clinical decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KESurv 以 Survival Forest 为主模型，叠加 Beran 核估计器等多个基模型做集成，输出患者个体化生存曲线。在四个医疗数据集上，该集成在多数数据集的校准 (calibration) 与排序 (ranking) 两方面均优于基线模型。
Motivation: 患者个体化生存函数预测对临床决策至关重要，单一 Survival Forest 虽有效，但在校准与排序上仍有改进空间。
Method: 以 Survival Forest 作为 master model，结合多个 base models 组成集成，并引入 Beran 核估计器 (kernel estimator) 来改进患者个体化生存曲线的预测。
Result: 在四个不同的医疗数据集上评估，集成方法在多数数据集上于 calibration 和 ranking 两方面均优于基线模型。
Conclusion: 该集成方法能更准确、可靠地估计患者个体化生存函数，可作为临床决策工具。

papers.title: Valid Stopping in Adaptive Generator-Verifier Loops
papers.abstract_en: Numerous agentic workflows are based on a generator-verifier loop: a generator proposes candidates, a cheap verifier scores them, and the workflow terminates when a proposal is verified as good enough. The verifier typically proxies a more costly ground-truth oracle, and as the generator searches adaptively against it, false acceptances may accumulate. Proposals can pass the proxy but fail under the costlier ground-truth check. We study when to stop these loops while controlling the false discovery rate of the accepted proposals. Our construction introduces tools of independent interest in distribution-free statistical testing and conformal risk control, including analysis of $e$-values constructed through index betting and a novel conformal risk control procedure for non-monotone losses. We validate the approach in synthetic settings and on a protein-design benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对生成器-验证器 (generator-verifier) 循环中代理验证器被自适应搜索导致假阳性累积的问题，提出在停止决策上控制被接受提案的错误发现率 (FDR) 的方法。构造包括基于 index betting 的 e-values 分布无关检验，以及面向非单调损失 (non-monotone losses) 的新型 conformal risk control 过程。在合成设定与蛋白质设计基准上验证。
Motivation: 生成器对着廉价代理验证器自适应搜索时，假接受会累积：提案通过代理却在更贵的 ground-truth 检查下失败，而现有循环缺少对被接受提案 FDR 的停止时刻控制。
Method: 在停止时刻上做分布无关检验与 conformal risk control：用 index betting 构造 e-values，并给出针对非单调损失的新型 conformal risk control 过程，用于决定何时终止循环并控制被接受提案的 FDR。
Result: 方法在合成设定和一个蛋白质设计基准上得到验证；摘要给出的理论产物包括 index betting 构造的 e-values 分析与面向非单调损失的 conformal risk control 过程。
Conclusion: 生成器-验证器 循环的停止可以按 FDR 受控的方式形式化，且所用的 e-value 与 conformal risk control 工具在分布无关检验中有独立价值。

papers.title: SoK: Semantic Decision Engines in Network Control Loops
papers.abstract_en: A semantic decision engine such as Jev can return a valid answer and still miss a network deadline, select an infeasible action or leave the service unverified. We systematize 139 paper families by decision interface, execution path and check ownership. Fifty families claim that their engine fits a control loop or time budget, but only four support the claim with matched measurement. Across all 139, four report deadline attainment. The gap concentrates where the decision has no deterministic computation step. Those 72 families make 22 of the claims, none supported, and name a coverage owner in only two. Bounded tests under one event model show that each gap can reverse an admission verdict. A decision that meets a 10 s budget for every isolated request meets it for none once decisions queue ahead of replayed execution times. The same engine passes one coverage check and fails another. We derive a minimum reporting record, design rules and a research agenda for admitting decision engines to control loops.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇网络控制回路中语义决策引擎 (semantic decision engine) 的 SoK：按决策接口、执行路径与检查归属对 139 个论文族系统化分类，发现声称引擎适配控制回路或时间预算的 50 族中只有 4 族给出匹配测量，全部 139 族中仅 4 族报告 deadline attainment。缺口集中在决策不含确定性计算步骤的 72 族——它们提出 22 条此类主张、无一被支撑，且仅 2 族指明 coverage 归属方。作者据此给出最小报告记录、设计规则与研究议程。
Motivation: 语义决策引擎可以给出合法答案却错过网络 deadline、选出不可行动作或让服务无法验证；现有文献大量声称其适配控制回路，但主张与测量不匹配，导致引擎无法被审慎地准入 (admit) 到控制回路。
Method: 按决策接口、执行路径、检查归属三个维度系统化 139 个论文族；在单一事件模型下做 bounded tests，检验各缺口能否翻转准入判定（含排队于重放执行时间之前的请求、以及同一引擎通过一项 coverage 检查却失败另一项）；再据此推导最小报告记录与设计规则。
Result: 139 个论文族中，50 族声称引擎适配控制回路或时间预算，仅 4 族有匹配测量支撑；全部 139 族中仅 4 族报告 deadline attainment。决策无确定性计算步骤的 72 族提出 22 条主张、支撑为 0，仅 2 族命名 coverage 归属方。bounded tests 显示每个缺口都可翻转准入判定：对每个孤立请求满足 10 s 预算的决策，在请求排队于重放执行时间之前后一条也不满足。
Conclusion: 决策引擎准入控制回路需要强制的最小报告记录与设计规则，且缺口集中在无确定性计算步骤的决策处，是该领域当前的研究议程。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Toward Reliable Infant Pose Estimation: A Training-Dynamics Approach to Noisy Annotation Detection
papers.abstract_en: Spontaneous movement analysis in preterm infants relies increasingly on markerless pose estimation (PE) to derive clinically relevant motion biomarkers directly from video recordings. Training accurate infant PE models requires large sets of manually annotated keypoints, and human annotation is inherently prone to error. Noisy keypoints (i.e., keypoints mislocalized with respect to their true anatomical position) are especially problematic in this clinical setting, since they can propagate as artificial artifacts into the reconstructed joint trajectories. Building on the small-loss hypothesis and training-dynamics-based sample selection established in the noisy-label learning literature, we propose a novel framework for detecting noisy keypoint annotations. A hybrid convolutional-attention model is trained to predict the anatomical category of each keypoint from its spatial coordinates and local visual features; the resulting cross-entropy training dynamics are then used to derive per-keypoint descriptors, which are partitioned into clean and noisy subsets via unsupervised clustering. We validate the approach on NeoPose, a newly collected dataset of 65 hospitalized preterm infants, under two realistic noise scenarios (random positional perturbation and left-right swapping) across multiple noise levels. Results show that the proposed approach achieves an F1-score of up to 91.9% in noisy-keypoint detection. The framework further generalizes to the heterogeneous COCO benchmark, where filtering CE-detected noisy keypoints from the training set also yields measurable improvements (up to 7.4 AP points) in downstream pose estimation accuracy at moderate-to-high noise levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 婴儿姿态估计中的噪声关键点标注会污染关节轨迹，本文用训练动态而非人工复检来识别它们：训练混合卷积-注意力模型从坐标与局部视觉特征预测关键点解剖类别，用其交叉熵训练动态生成逐点描述子，再无监督聚类分成 clean/noisy 两簇。在 65 名住院早产儿的 NeoPose 上，噪声关键点检测 F1 最高 91.9%；在 COCO 上过滤后再训练，中高噪声水平下下游姿态估计 AP 最多提升 7.4 点。
Motivation: 早产儿自发运动分析依赖无标记姿态估计，而人工标注关键点难免错位，噪声关键点会作为人工伪影传进重建的关节轨迹，直接损害临床运动生物标志的可信度。
Method: 基于小损失假设与训练动态样本选择，训练混合卷积-注意力模型从关键点空间坐标及其局部视觉特征预测该点的解剖类别；取其交叉熵训练动态构造逐点描述子，再用无监督聚类把描述子划成 clean 与 noisy 两簇。
Result: 在 NeoPose（新采集的 65 名住院早产儿数据集）上，于随机位置扰动与左右互换两种噪声场景、多个噪声水平下验证，噪声关键点检测 F1 最高达 91.9%；迁移到异质 COCO benchmark，用检测结果过滤训练集噪声关键点后，中到高噪声水平下下游姿态估计精度最多提升 7.4 AP 点。
Conclusion: 训练动态足以在无人工复检的情况下把错位关键点从干净标注中分离出来，且该过滤在异质自然图像基准上同样带来可测的下游姿态精度收益。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: On the Comparison of Optimizers for Imbalanced Learning
papers.abstract_en: Data imbalance is pervasive in machine learning, from rare words and anomalies to underrepresented patterns in heterogeneous or cross-tabulated data. We study idealized optimizers geometries in continuous time to model small-step training in deep learning. We assume that the source of imbalance is unobserved: the optimizer has only access to the aggregate training loss ignoring the exact contributions of the majority and minority groups. In this setting, we characterize a region where majority losses are optimized regardless of the admissible minority structure. We derive explicit equations of this zone and bounds on the time needed to leave it. These bounds exhibit a milder dependence on minority amplitude for sign, spectral, and Newton descent than for Euclidean gradient descent. Experiments with AdamW and Muon suggest similar advantages over SGD across language, tabular, and image tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在不平衡学习中，优化器只能看到聚合训练损失、无法区分多数类与少数类贡献时，作者用连续时间下的优化器几何刻画出一个「无论少数类结构如何都会优先优化多数类损失」的区域，并给出离开该区域的时间上界。上界对少数类幅度的依赖在 sign、spectral、Newton descent 下比欧氏梯度下降更温和；AdamW 与 Muon 在语言、表格、图像任务上相对 SGD 呈现类似优势。
Motivation: 不平衡数据中少数类被忽略的机制不透明：优化器只拿到聚合损失，看不到多数/少数群体的各自贡献，难以判断何时以及多快会脱离只优化多数类的状态。
Method: 在连续时间下建模小步长深度学习训练的优化器几何（idealized optimizers geometries），假设不平衡来源不可观测、优化器仅访问聚合训练损失；推导多数类损失被优先优化的区域的显式方程，以及离开该区域所需时间的上界，并对 sign、spectral、Newton descent 与欧氏梯度下降作对比。
Result: 离开该区域的时间上界对少数类幅度的依赖在 sign、spectral、Newton descent 下比欧氏梯度下降更温和；实验中 AdamW 与 Muon 在语言、表格和图像任务上相对 SGD 表现出类似优势。
Conclusion: 非欧氏/非梯度类优化器几何在不平衡且群体不可观测的训练中，比欧氏梯度下降更快摆脱只优化多数类的区域，AdamW 与 Muon 的实验与该理论方向一致。
Relevance: 3
