summary_sections.method: 在连续时间下建模小步长深度学习训练的优化器几何（idealized optimizers geometries），假设不平衡来源不可观测、优化器仅访问聚合训练损失；推导多数类损失被优先优化的区域的显式方程，以及离开该区域所需时间的上界，并对 sign、spectral、Newton descent 与欧氏梯度下降作对比。
summary_sections.result: 离开该区域的时间上界对少数类幅度的依赖在 sign、spectral、Newton descent 下比欧氏梯度下降更温和；实验中 AdamW 与 Muon 在语言、表格和图像任务上相对 SGD 表现出类似优势。
summary_sections.conclusion: 非欧氏/非梯度类优化器几何在不平衡且群体不可观测的训练中，比欧氏梯度下降更快摆脱只优化多数类的区域，AdamW 与 Muon 的实验与该理论方向一致。

papers.title: Efficient Secure Federated Learning via Information-Theoretically Secure Key Distribution: A Medical Imaging Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of models across institutions without centralizing sensitive data, making it well-suited for privacy-concerned applications, such as medical imaging. To protect FL model updates during secure aggregation, additive masking is commonly employed. However, its underlying classical key establishment is only computationally secure. On the other hand, physics-based Information-Theoretically Secure (ITS) key exchange introduces practical constraints: finite key generation rates and time-limited storage severely limit throughput and sustained training of uncompressed models. In this work, we address this bottleneck by developing an FL framework that integrates frozen backbones, knowledge distillation, and quantization. These techniques reduce communication payload and, consequently, key material consumption. Moving beyond simulation, we benchmark this framework on a real physics-based key distribution testbed involving a chest X-ray classification application. Our results show that key usage can be reduced by $\sim$35$\times$ while maintaining predictive accuracy. This prevents buffer depletion and key expiration, enabling sustainable FL training under physical key generation constraints.
papers.comment: 6 pages. Accepted at Federated Intelligence and Digital Twins for Autonomous Systems and IoT Workshop (FIDTA 2026), co-located with ACM MobiHoc 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在物理层信息论安全 (ITS) 密钥分发的联邦学习中，密钥生成速率有限、存储有时效，导致安全聚合的掩码密钥消耗过快、无法持续训练。把冻结骨干网络、知识蒸馏与量化组合进 FL 框架可压缩通信载荷，从而把密钥用量降低约 35 倍，同时保持预测精度，在真实胸片 X 光分类测试床上避免缓冲耗尽与密钥过期。
Motivation: 安全聚合常用的加法掩码依赖计算安全的经典密钥建立，而物理层 ITS 密钥交换的生成速率有限、存储时间受限，压缩前的模型更新会迅速耗尽密钥，使持续训练不可行。
Method: 提出集成冻结骨干网络 (frozen backbone)、知识蒸馏 (knowledge distillation) 与量化 (quantization) 的 FL 框架，以降低通信载荷并相应减少密钥材料消耗；在真实物理层密钥分发测试床上以胸片 X 光分类任务做基准测试。
Result: 在真实物理层密钥分发测试床上的胸片 X 光分类应用中，密钥用量降低约 35 倍，同时保持预测精度，避免缓冲耗尽与密钥过期。
Conclusion: 压缩模型更新可在不损失精度的前提下把 ITS 密钥消耗压到物理密钥生成速率可支撑的水平，使受物理密钥约束的 FL 训练可持续进行。

papers.title: Training-Free Transformer Merging via Sequential Local Operator Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Training-free model merging aims to combine multiple fine-tuned models into a single model without further optimization on labeled data. Yet, in transformers, independently merging individual layers can affect a shared attention computation because the query-key and value-output operators depend on composed matrices, overlooking the functional structure. Moreover, when merging earlier components, downstream components receive different activations than they do in the original model, thus, the merged and original execution paths no longer match. In this paper, we introduce Sequential Local Operator Alignment, a training-free method that merges transformers along the execution path of the partially merged model. Our method uses calibration data to estimate the local behavior of each functional component, aligns operators sequentially under the intermediate activation of the partially merged model, and subsequently factorizes the merged operators back into valid transformer parameters. We empirically show that this sequential step reduces error accumulation across layers. Furthermore, the proposed operator factorization step enables rank expansion, providing a principled mechanism for increasing multi-task capacity. We demonstrate that our approach generalizes across modalities, model scales, and varying numbers of tasks, from CLIP and RoBERTa to billion-parameter LLMs, and further extends naturally to the merging of LoRA-fine-tuned models. The results indicate improvements over strong merging baselines without requiring rank expansion, while optional expansion provides a further accuracy-inference-cost trade-off. Project link: https://akansh12.github.io/SLOA-Merge/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出训练无关的 Transformer 模型合并方法 Sequential Local Operator Alignment (SLOA)：沿部分合并模型的执行路径，用校准数据估计各功能组件的局部行为，在中间激活下顺序对齐算子，再把合并后的算子分解回合法的 Transformer 参数。顺序对齐减少跨层误差累积，分解步骤还支持秩扩展 (rank expansion) 以提升多任务容量；在 CLIP、RoBERTa 到十亿参数 LLM 及 LoRA 微调模型上，无需秩扩展即优于强合并基线，可选的秩扩展进一步给出精度与推理开销的权衡。
Motivation: 逐层独立合并会破坏共享的 attention 计算，因为 query-key 与 value-output 算子依赖矩阵复合；且合并前段组件后下游收到的激活与原模型不同，合并后与原模型的执行路径不再一致。
Method: SLOA 用校准数据估计每个功能组件的局部行为，在部分合并模型的中间激活下顺序对齐算子，再将合并算子分解 (factorize) 回合法的 Transformer 参数；分解步骤支持秩扩展，可自然扩展到 LoRA 微调模型的合并。
Result: 顺序步骤减少跨层误差累积；在 CLIP、RoBERTa 到十亿参数 LLM、不同模态与任务数量上，无需秩扩展即相对强合并基线 (strong merging baselines) 有精度提升，可选秩扩展进一步提供精度与推理开销的权衡。
Conclusion: 沿执行路径顺序对齐算子并做合法参数分解，是训练无关合并 Transformer 的有效做法，且秩扩展提供了提升多任务容量的原则性机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SpatialChain: A Benchmark for Auditing Spatial Reasoning Faithfulness in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Thinking-enabled vision-language models (VLMs) report ever-higher accuracy on spatial benchmarks, yet final-answer scores cannot reveal whether a correct prediction reflects faithful spatial reasoning or a linguistic shortcut. We introduce SpatialChain, a dataset of 28,350 training and 899 test examples pairing spatially-oriented GQA questions with scene-graph-grounded reasoning chains, retained only when the generated answer matches the symbolic ground truth, and a two-axis evaluation combining objective chain-overlap metrics with a scene-graph-aware LLM judge that scores faithfulness and completeness independently of the final answer. Applied to nine thinking-enabled VLMs, the protocol surfaces three findings invisible to standard accuracy: (i) four of nine models achieve $\geq$79% VQA accuracy while exhibiting shortcut rates above 39%, i.e., correct answers whose reasoning the judge marks as unfaithful; (ii) chain quality significantly predicts answer correctness for seven of nine models, but the two exceptions (Claude Sonnet 4.6, InternVL3.5-8B) reveal qualitatively distinct failure modes, terse output vs. verbose-decorative reasoning, that benchmark accuracy alone conflates; (iii) SFT on SpatialChain improves Qwen3-VL-8B by +6.2 pp in-domain and reduces its shortcut rate to 22%, while a stylistic specialization effect on external benchmarks motivates replay-augmented training as mitigation. The faithfulness judge is validated against 198 human-annotated items, where judge-human agreement matches human-human agreement, and against a second judge from a different provider, which preserves the model ranking ($ρ$ = 0.88). Data, generation scripts, and evaluation code are released at https://github.com/spatialchain/SpatialChainBenchmark.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Embodied Spatial Reasoning (ESR), NeurIPS 2026. 29 pages (8 main), 9 figures, 18 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/spatialchain/SpatialChainBenchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpatialChain 用场景图接地的推理链审计视觉语言模型的空间推理是否忠实：28,350 训练 + 899 测试样本，配双轴评测（链重叠指标 + 场景图感知 LLM judge 独立打分忠实性与完整性）。九个 thinking-enabled VLM 中四个 VQA 准确率 ≥79% 却有 >39% 的捷径率；对 Qwen3-VL-8B 做 SFT 同域提升 +6.2 pp、捷径率降到 22%。
Motivation: 空间基准上不断刷新的准确率无法区分正确答案来自真正的空间推理还是语言捷径，最终答案分数掩盖了推理过程的不忠实。
Method: 构建 SpatialChain 数据集：空间取向的 GQA 问题配场景图接地的推理链，仅保留生成答案与符号真值一致的样本；评测用双轴协议——客观链重叠指标加场景图感知 LLM judge，独立于最终答案打分忠实性与完整性；并在 SpatialChain 上对 Qwen3-VL-8B 做 SFT，辅以 replay-augmented training 缓解外部基准上的风格特化。
Result: 九个模型中四个 VQA 准确率 ≥79% 且捷径率 >39%；链质量对七个模型显著预测答案正确性，例外为 Claude Sonnet 4.6 与 InternVL3.5-8B（分别为过简输出与冗余装饰性推理）；SFT 使 Qwen3-VL-8B 同域 +6.2 pp、捷径率降至 22%；judge 在 198 条人工标注上与人的一致性达到人-人水平，换供应商的第二 judge 保持模型排序 ρ = 0.88。
Conclusion: 最终答案准确率会把忠实推理与语言捷径混为一谈，双轴链级评测能暴露前者看不见的失败模式；SFT 可压低捷径率但会带来外部基准上的风格特化，需用 replay-augmented training 缓解。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: From Benchmark to Bench: Can Agents Survive Real-World Drug Discovery?
papers.abstract_en: Agentic systems increasingly coordinate molecular-design tools, but it is unclear which layer of the stack limits outcomes on real projects. We developed MAGI, an open modular agent that authors objectives, launches and monitors optimization, interprets structure--activity relationships, and revises its strategy accordingly. MAGI generates molecules either directly through the LLM or by delegating to REINVENT 4, with scoring services interchangeable behind a common contract. We tested it across nine retrospective lead-optimization campaigns from three pharmaceutical companies, replayed under fixed temporal cutoffs. Both routes produced valid structures: LLM proposals stayed closer to local chemistry and reached comparable or higher primary activity in fewer operations, whereas REINVENT explored broader chemical space. Whether a campaign met its objective depended on the predictive models, not on the generation route: attainment followed model accuracy on the chemistry proposed, dropping once that chemistry moved outside the model's applicability domain. Separately, a blinded evaluation asked whether the MAGI's output could pass as expert work: chemists were not able to discriminate agentic proposals from held-out compounds, and judged the SAR reasoning broadly plausible yet incomplete. Together, these results position MAGI as a coordination layer pluggable into existing computational chemistry workflows. The ceiling on real projects, however, remains currently set by scorer applicability rather than by tool orchestration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAGI 是一个开源模块化药物发现 agent，可自写目标、启动并监控分子优化、解读构效关系 (SAR) 并修订策略，分子既可由 LLM 直接生成也可委托 REINVENT 4，打分服务通过统一接口互换。在三家药企九个回顾性先导优化 campaign（固定时间截断重放）中，两条生成路线都能产出合法结构，LLM 路线更贴近局部化学且用更少操作达到相当或更高的主活性，REINVENT 探索更广化学空间；但 campaign 是否达标取决于打分模型而非生成路线，一旦新化学超出模型适用域 (applicability domain) 达标率即下降。盲评中化学家无法区分 MAGI 输出与留出化合物，认为 SAR 推理大体合理但不完整。
Motivation: 分子设计工具栈日益由 agent 编排，但真实项目中究竟是哪一层（生成、编排还是打分）限制结果尚不清楚。
Method: 构建模块化 agent MAGI：LLM 直接生成或委托 REINVENT 4，打分服务在统一契约下可互换；在三家药企九个回顾性先导优化 campaign 上以固定时间截断重放测试，并做一次盲评（化学家判断输出能否冒充专家工作）。
Result: 两条路线均产出合法结构：LLM 提议更贴近局部化学、以更少操作达到相当或更高的主活性，REINVENT 探索更广化学空间；campaign 达标与否跟随打分模型在其所提化学上的准确度，超出适用域后达标率下降。盲评中化学家无法区分 MAGI 输出与留出化合物，判断 SAR 推理大体合理但不完整。
Conclusion: MAGI 可作为可插拔的协调层接入现有计算化学工作流，但真实项目的上限目前由打分模型的适用域而非工具编排决定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlashCart: Fast Cartesian Tensor Products for Equivariant Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learned interatomic potentials extend atomistic simulations beyond the length- and timescales accessible to electronic-structure methods. However, the computational cost of equivariant architectures limits the local correlations they can represent in practice and therefore their achievable accuracy. Here we introduce FlashCart, which makes higher-order correlations affordable by combining generated GPU kernels with an architecture that recursively builds equivariant features and compresses them to a fixed width at each step. We express tensor products in independent Cartesian components and symbolically simplify them and their derivatives, producing fused kernels that often outperform optimized spherical counterparts. We then show that increasing correlation order improves accuracy more efficiently than increasing width, depth, or tensor rank. On SPICE-MACE-OFF, FlashCart models advance the measured accuracy-efficiency frontier: a model with $5.6$ million parameters achieves lower energy and force errors and $10\times$ faster inference than a transformer with $189$ million parameters.

papers.title: What Did the Agent Actually Do? Evidence-Grounded Oversight for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: As agents take on long-horizon tasks, users shift from making individual decisions to overseeing autonomous execution. Yet the volume of agent activity and the fragmentation of supporting evidence make it difficult to determine which decisions warrant user verification. We study monitors that identify consequential decisions and locate evidence to help users assess their implications. We introduce AgentMonBench, a software-engineering benchmark comprising three subsets that cover two complementary dimensions: alignment between requirements and behavior, and awareness of consequential autonomous decisions for verification. To support these judgments, we propose the Evidence-Grounded Behavior Graph (EBG), a training-free method that groups source-linked evidence into behaviors and organizes their relationships into a graph. EBG presents task-oriented views of this graph to help monitors interpret behavior in context. Experiments across eight models show that EBG improves decision identification and evidence localization in most settings compared with direct access to the original context. Further experiments show that EBG's evidence-localization gains persist across input scales and hyperparameter settings, while real-world applications illustrate its practical value for human oversight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对长时程 agent 监督中证据分散、难以判断哪些决策值得人工核验的问题，提出免训练的 Evidence-Grounded Behavior Graph (EBG)：把带来源链接的证据聚成行为、组织成图并按任务视角呈现。在软件工程基准 AgentMonBench 上跨八个模型的实验显示，多数设置下 EBG 相比直接读原始上下文提升了决策识别与证据定位，且增益在不同输入规模与超参设置下保持。
Motivation: agent 承担长时程任务后，用户从逐次决策转向监督自主执行，但活动量大、支撑证据碎片化，难以判断哪些决策值得人工核验。
Method: 提出免训练 (training-free) 的 Evidence-Grounded Behavior Graph (EBG)：将带来源链接的证据分组为行为并把行为间关系组织成图，再以任务导向视图呈现供 monitor 结合上下文解读；配套发布软件工程基准 AgentMonBench，含三个子集，覆盖需求与行为对齐、以及对关键自主决策的感知两个维度。
Result: 跨八个模型的实验显示，多数设置下 EBG 相比直接访问原始上下文改善了决策识别与证据定位；进一步实验显示其证据定位增益在不同输入规模与超参设置下保持，真实应用场景展示了其对人工监督的实用价值。
Conclusion: 把碎片化证据组织成行为图并按任务视角呈现，能在免训练条件下更有效地支撑用户对长时程 agent 关键决策的核验。

papers.title: Quantifying the Stability of Multi-Step Reasoning via Error Amplification
papers.abstract_en: We consider the stability of multi-step reasoning processes, which have extensive applications in language models, including chain-of-thought and algorithmic reasoning. While longer sequences of reasoning can improve a model's generation capability at test time, the errors due to intermediate reasoning steps can accumulate in autoregressive generation, and thus grow substantially at the end. In this paper, we ask: What are the key factors determining the stability of multi-step reasoning? First, we show an inference error bound governed by the product of spectral norms of the Jacobians taken through the input space across generation steps. This product can be viewed as an error amplification factor, which could scale exponentially with the number of reasoning steps, serving as a quantitative measure of reasoning stability. Second, we analyze this measure in transformer models trained to predict simple tasks like linear and quadratic functions. We theoretically prove that the transformer model converges to a solution where the stability measure decays, thus yielding nearly zero inference loss over (arbitrarily) long steps. Finally, the stability analysis leads to several algorithmic implications for controlling the stability, through (i) chain-of-thought length compression that reduces the sensitivity of each step, and (ii) quantization-aware training that regularizes the input Jacobian norms. We validate the proposed algorithms by fine-tuning language models on graph-algorithmic reasoning tasks and symbolic state-tracking tasks. Across seven evaluations, our algorithms improve over baseline comparisons by 3.5% on average, and by 8.2% for longer-length inputs. Ablation analysis validates that the stability measure is drastically reduced by 3-8$\times$, confirming the regularization effect on the spectral norms of the (input space) Jacobians.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把多步推理的稳定性量化为沿生成步的输入空间 Jacobian 谱范数之积（误差放大因子），该因子可随步数指数增长。理论上证明在预测线性/二次函数的 transformer 上该稳定性度量会衰减，从而在任意长步数上得到近零推理损失；据此提出 CoT 长度压缩与量化感知训练两种控制手段，在图算法推理与符号状态追踪任务微调中，七项评测平均比基线高 3.5%，长输入上高 8.2%，稳定性度量降低 3–8 倍。
Motivation: 自回归生成中中间步骤误差会逐步累积并在末端显著放大，缺少一个可量化、可优化的推理稳定性度量来判定误差何时指数增长。
Method: 先给出由各生成步输入空间 Jacobian 谱范数之积控制的推理误差界，把该乘积作为误差放大因子；再在预测线性与二次函数的 transformer 上证明训练收敛到稳定性度量衰减的解；最后导出两种算法——压缩 chain-of-thought 长度以降低单步敏感度，以及量化感知训练 (quantization-aware training) 正则化输入 Jacobian 范数，并在图算法推理与符号状态追踪任务上微调语言模型进行验证。
Result: 七项评测上所提算法平均比基线提升 3.5%，在更长输入上提升 8.2%；消融分析显示稳定性度量降低 3–8 倍，证实对（输入空间）Jacobian 谱范数的正则化效果。
Conclusion: 多步推理的误差放大由 Jacobian 谱范数之积决定，压缩推理长度与正则化输入 Jacobian 能直接压低该放大因子，从而在长链推理上稳定性能。

papers.title: RAISED: Self-Distillation for Robustness to Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using language-model agents are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection because they must act on untrusted external content. Existing training-time defenses can reduce attack success rates, but often at the cost of general capabilities. We show that training-based defenses induce substantial drift in the model's output distribution, altering its behavior even in benign settings and providing a potential mechanism for utility degradation. We further identify a failure mode of these defenses: On benign tool-use tasks, the model refrains from a step needed to finish an authorized task, particularly when that step is indicated by a tool output. To address these limitations, we introduce RAISED (Robust Attack Invariance through Self-Distillation), a training framework that combines self-generation and self-distillation. The model first generates its own tool-use scenarios, with an emphasis on cases where task completion requires acting on legitimate guidance from tool outputs. Then, through self-distillation, the student is trained to match the teacher's clean-context behavior on both clean and injected variants of the same trajectory. RAISED substantially reduces the attack success rate of prompt injections in tool responses while, unlike prior training-based defenses, preserving utility on both agentic and general-purpose benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAISED 用自生成加自蒸馏训练工具调用 LLM agent：先让模型自己生成需要依据 tool output 合法指引才能完成任务的场景，再让学生在同一轨迹的干净版与注入版上都对齐教师的干净上下文行为。结果是工具响应中的间接 prompt injection 攻击成功率大幅下降，同时与既有训练时防御不同，在 agentic 与通用 benchmark 上都保住效用。
Motivation: 工具调用 agent 必须处理不可信外部内容，间接 prompt injection 难以回避；现有训练时防御虽能压低攻击成功率，却让模型输出分布明显漂移，甚至在良性任务上拒绝本该执行的步骤，导致通用能力下降。
Method: RAISED (Robust Attack Invariance through Self-Distillation) 分两步：模型自生成工具使用场景，重点覆盖必须依据 tool output 中合法指引才能完成任务的情形；再做 self-distillation，让学生在同一条轨迹的 clean 与 injected 两个变体上都匹配 teacher 在 clean context 下的行为。
Result: 训练时防御被证明会显著改变模型输出分布，并在良性工具任务上出现过度拒绝失败模式；RAISED 大幅降低 tool response 中 prompt injection 的攻击成功率，且在 agentic 与通用 benchmark 上保持效用，而先前训练时防御做不到这一点。
Conclusion: 效用损失的机制来自防御引起的行为漂移与过度拒绝；把干净上下文行为同时蒸馏到干净与注入轨迹上，可以在不牺牲通用能力的前提下抑制注入攻击。

papers.title: CVIF: A Criticality-Driven Visual Intervention Framework for Geometric Diagram Understanding in MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Despite significant progress in visual tasks by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), geometric diagram understanding remains challenging due to the presence of sparse visual cues and ambiguous symbol-primitive associations. MLLMs may therefore rely on textual priors, producing interpretations that conflict with visual evidence. We introduce the training-free Criticality-Driven Visual Intervention Framework (CVIF), an inference-time method that localizes critical layers and executes visual interventions during the transition from evidence aggregation to semantic decoding. At these layers, a Geometry-Constrained Local Relation Reconstruction (GCLR) module selects and weights vertex-centered visual evidence, while an Adaptive Visual Steering Operator (AVSO) redistributes attention mass toward the selected tokens. Experiments on PGPS9K and PGDP5K show that CVIF raises Overall F1 from 77.85 to 85.58 and from 75.23 to 82.84, respectively, establishing a novel inference-time visual intervention paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CVIF 是一个免训练的推理时干预框架：先定位 MLLM 中从证据聚合转向语义解码的关键层，再在这些层用 Geometry-Constrained Local Relation Reconstruction (GCLR) 选择并加权以顶点为中心的视觉证据，用 Adaptive Visual Steering Operator (AVSO) 把注意力质量重新分配到所选 token，抑制几何图理解中的文本先验依赖。在 PGPS9K 上 Overall F1 从 77.85 提到 85.58，PGDP5K 上从 75.23 提到 82.84。
Motivation: 几何图中视觉线索稀疏、符号与图元对应含糊，MLLM 容易依赖文本先验给出与视觉证据冲突的解读，而现有方法多依赖训练或微调。
Method: 训练-free 的推理时框架 CVIF：定位关键层（证据聚合到语义解码的过渡），在这些层执行视觉干预；GCLR 模块选择并加权以顶点为中心的视觉证据，AVSO 算子把注意力质量重新分配到被选中的 token。
Result: 在 PGPS9K 上 Overall F1 从 77.85 提升到 85.58，在 PGDP5K 上从 75.23 提升到 82.84。
Conclusion: 推理时在关键层做结构约束的视觉干预，可以在不训练的情况下显著提升 MLLM 的几何图理解，确立一种新的 inference-time visual intervention 范式。

papers.title: Learning Pareto Stationary Fronts via Single-Pass Backpropagation
papers.abstract_en: We propose MOSEL (Multi-Objective Stackelberg Efficient Learning), a framework for a posteriori multi-objective optimization (MOO) in deep neural networks that recovers a full front of Pareto stationary solutions at the computational cost of standard single-objective training. MOSEL reformulates the problem as a bilevel optimization problem that leverages network modularity to decouple representation learning from objective-preference alignment. Casting the bilevel optimization problem as a Stackelberg game enables solving the original a posteriori MOO problem in a single forward-backward pass. As a result, MOSEL matches the time and memory efficiency of standard single-objective training while enabling scalable Pareto stationary front learning. Empirically, MOSEL uncovers diverse and optimal Pareto frontiers in strongly conflicting settings (e.g., fairness-accuracy). Remarkably, even in weakly conflicting regimes such as multi-task learning, it consistently converges to solutions closer to the utopia point, outperforming both standard single-objective training and specialized multi-task learning methods. These results highlight the broader potential of a posteriori MOO learning as a pathway to efficiently learn more diverse and robust representations, ultimately improving generalization.

papers.title: Harnessing Multimodal Large Language Models for Training-Free Human-Object Interaction Detection
papers.abstract_en: Human-object interaction (HOI) detection aims to localize human-object pairs and recognize their interactions. Traditional supervised methods perform strongly but rely on task-specific training. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer a promising route to training-free HOI detection through their broad visual-semantic knowledge and versatile perceptual and reasoning capabilities. However, existing approaches largely invoke these capabilities through loosely coordinated inference stages. This fragmented execution restricts the role of interaction hypotheses in guiding visual exploration, leaving key participants overlooked and local ambiguities unresolved. Furthermore, propagating early semantic assumptions through subsequent visual grounding and relation prediction induces self-reinforcing semantic circularity. To resolve these challenges, we propose HarnessHOI, a training-free framework that transforms passive MLLM inference into an active interaction-centric harness. Specifically, we introduce an interaction-guided perception mechanism that projects emerging interaction hypotheses back into the visual space to discover missing participants and refine ambiguous evidence through targeted observation. Furthermore, a relation-agnostic geometric adjudication module reconciles multi-source evidence to establish a unified spatial basis for grounded interaction reasoning across multiple actions and semantic roles. Extensive experiments on HICO-DET and V-COCO demonstrate that HarnessHOI achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods, confirming the effectiveness of the proposed harness for complex interaction understanding. Code will be released upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HarnessHOI 把多模态大模型的被动推理改造成以交互为中心的主动 harness：用交互引导感知把不断生成的交互假设投回视觉空间，补上被漏掉的人/物参与者并消解局部歧义，再用关系无关的几何裁决模块统一多源证据的空间基准。在 HICO-DET 与 V-COCO 上，该 training-free 框架在免训练方法中达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有免训练 MLLM HOI 检测把各推理阶段松散串联，交互假设无法反过来引导视觉探索，关键参与者被漏检，且早期语义假设在后续视觉定位与关系预测中自我强化，形成语义循环。
Method: 提出 training-free 框架 HarnessHOI：交互引导感知机制 (interaction-guided perception) 将涌现的交互假设投影回视觉空间，通过定向观察发现缺失参与者并精化模糊证据；关系无关的几何裁决模块 (relation-agnostic geometric adjudication) 调和多源证据，为跨动作与语义角色的落地交互推理建立统一空间基准。
Result: 在 HICO-DET 和 V-COCO 上的大量实验表明，HarnessHOI 在 training-free 方法中取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 把交互假设作为主动感知的控制信号而非被动输出，可以在不训练的前提下提升复杂交互理解；代码将于论文发表时发布。

papers.title: Multi-Task Partially Supervised Learning for Super-Resolution and Semantic Segmentation on Earth Observation data
papers.abstract_en: Super-resolution and semantic segmentation are known to benefit one another, especially in the Earth observation context. However, learning both tasks in a joint model often requires both task annotations, which is impractical and expensive. In this paper, we study the multi-task partially supervised learning paradigm for both tasks, where each example is assumed to have only a single-task annotation. To that end, we examine two multi-task architectural variations, the sequential and shared variants, and then propose a hybrid variant and a re-projection loss to benefit from the shared representation and enforce image quality of super-resolution when training with semantic segmentation. Experiments show favorable results compared to the SOTA sequential variant. Source code will be published at https://github.com/lhoangan/munera.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP), Tampere, Finland, 2026, pp. 1-6,
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在遥感影像上做超分辨率与语义分割的多任务部分监督学习（每张样本只带单任务标注），提出混合架构与重投影损失 (re-projection loss)，在共享表征的同时约束超分的图像质量。实验结果优于当前 SOTA 的 sequential 变体。
Motivation: 超分与语义分割本可互相增益，但联合训练通常要求每个样本同时具备两种标注，这在遥感数据上昂贵且不现实。
Method: 考察多任务部分监督范式下的两种架构变体——sequential 与 shared，在此基础上提出 hybrid 变体，并设计 re-projection loss：借助共享表征，同时在用语义分割样本训练时强制保持超分辨率的图像质量。
Result: 实验显示所提方法相比 SOTA 的 sequential 变体取得有利结果 (favorable results)；源码发布于 github.com/lhoangan/munera。
Conclusion: 部分监督下通过混合架构加重投影损失，可以在只有单任务标注时同时训练超分与分割，并胜过顺序式多任务基线。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: Scaling Down the Scaling Laws: Parameter Efficiency and Compute-Optimal Training in Resource-Constrained Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved substantial performance gains through increases in model size, training data, and computational resources. However, traditional scaling approaches produce diminishing returns, rising financial and environmental costs, and barriers to participation for researchers operating outside large industrial laboratories. This review examines the evolution of LLM scaling theory from empirical scaling laws to compute-optimal training, with particular emphasis on parameter efficiency, token utilization, data efficiency, and resource-constrained environments. Foundational work on scaling laws is synthesized alongside later research on compute-optimal training, data pruning, efficient architectures, quantization, low-rank adaptation, and edge-oriented optimization. The literature indicates a shift from scale maximization toward more deliberate allocation of parameters, tokens, compute, and hardware resources. At the same time, important empirical, theoretical, and methodological gaps remain regarding whether scaling principles established on enterprise-grade infrastructure generalize to smaller models and constrained computing environments. This review organizes these developments into a unified framework for resource-efficient LLM training and argues that future progress should evaluate efficiency not solely through model performance, but through the relationship among performance, parameter count, computational cost, token allocation, and hardware constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于 LLM 扩展规律 (scaling laws) 与算力最优训练的综述，梳理从经验 scaling law 到 compute-optimal training 的演进，重点放在参数效率、token 利用率、数据效率与资源受限环境。其核心论断是：研究重心正从「最大化规模」转向对参数、token、算力与硬件的刻意分配，且未来评价效率不能只看模型性能，而要看性能与参数量、算力成本、token 分配、硬件约束之间的关系。
Motivation: 传统按比例扩大模型、数据与算力的做法收益递减，财务与环境成本上升，并把大型工业实验室之外的研究者挡在门外；同时缺少证据说明在企业级基础设施上建立的 scaling 原则能否迁移到小模型与受限算力环境。
Method: 作为综述，综合基础 scaling law 工作与后续 compute-optimal training、data pruning、efficient architectures、quantization、low-rank adaptation、edge-oriented optimization 等方向的研究，组织成一个面向资源高效 LLM 训练的统一框架。
Result: 文献综述指向一个定性趋势：从规模最大化转向对参数、token、算力与硬件资源的刻意分配；并指出在经验、理论与方法层面仍存在缺口，即企业级基础设施上确立的 scaling 原则是否适用于小模型与受限计算环境尚不确定。
Conclusion: 未来进展应把效率定义为性能、参数量、算力成本、token 分配与硬件约束之间的关系，而不是单看模型性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Steering by Influence: Curvature Aware Data Weighting for Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time steering offers cheap, fine-grained control over a language model's outputs by estimating a concept's representation in activation space and shifting activations towards it. Existing methods build these representations from activation averages over contrastive datasets. These averages incorporate unrelated concepts and noise, and are dominated by a few tokens, meaning the activation transport encodes token-level rather than thematic concepts. In this work, we steer towards examples that most express a concept thematically, rather than towards an expectation over all. We identify these examples using influence functions, which estimate how much each data point contributes to a model's representation of a concept. Unlike simple model activation similarity, they incorporate the curvature of the model's loss landscape, allowing them to capture concept-relevant relationships beyond superficial token-level similarity. We then propose influence-weighted activation transport, which uses optimal transport to steer activations of non-concept text towards those of concept text, weighting concept examples by their influence scores. We evaluate on toxicity suppression (Jigsaw), object-based concept induction (OneSec) and truthfulness induction (TruthfulQA), outperforming existing activation-transport baselines. We track capability after steering using perplexity and MMLU accuracy, finding that our method improves steering while largely preserving model quality. We further show that influence functions capture concept-relevant information that activation-based methods miss with the two approaches ranking data points significantly differently. Together, these results demonstrate the value of curvature-aware influence information for activation steering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 influence-weighted activation transport：用影响函数 (influence functions) 按曲率感知的贡献度给概念样本加权，再用 optimal transport 把非概念文本的激活推向概念文本，从而让 steering 对准主题层面而非被少数 token 主导的概念表示。在 Jigsaw 毒性抑制、OneSec 物体概念归纳与 TruthfulQA 真实性归纳上超过已有 activation-transport 基线，同时 perplexity 与 MMLU 准确率基本保持。
Motivation: 现有 activation steering 用对比数据集上的激活均值表示概念，均值混入无关概念与噪声且被少数 token 主导，导致 transport 编码的是 token 级而非主题级概念。
Method: 先用影响函数估计每个样本对模型概念表示的贡献（纳入损失景观曲率，区别于单纯激活相似度），据此给概念样本加权；再用 optimal transport 将非概念文本激活向加权后的概念文本激活搬运，形成 influence-weighted activation transport。
Result: 在 Jigsaw 毒性抑制、OneSec 物体概念归纳、TruthfulQA 真实性归纳三个任务上，优于已有 activation-transport 基线；用 perplexity 与 MMLU 准确率追踪 steering 后能力，方法在增强 steering 效果的同时基本保持模型质量；影响函数与基于激活的方法对数据点的排序显著不同，说明曲率信息捕捉到激活方法遗漏的概念相关信息。
Conclusion: 曲率感知的影响函数权重能修正激活均值被 token 主导的问题，使 activation steering 更贴合主题概念且不明显损害模型通用能力。

papers.title: MTOR: Generalizable AI-Generated Video Detection with Multimodal Semantics and Temporal Over-Regularity
papers.abstract_en: The rapid evolution of video generation has narrowed the perceptual gap between authentic and synthetic videos, making generalizable AI-generated video detection increasingly challenging. Existing detectors predominantly rely on visual representations, leaving caption-derived textual semantics underexplored. Meanwhile, temporal regularity in fine-grained visual representations has received limited attention. We find that caption-derived textual representations provide complementary discriminative cues to global visual representations. Our analysis further reveals that AI-generated videos exhibit stronger temporal persistence and lower temporal variability, a pattern we term temporal over-regularity (TOR). Based on these findings, we propose MTOR with a multimodal branch and a TOR component. The multimodal branch integrates global visual and caption-derived textual representations, while the TOR component models temporal over-regularity at three levels: coarse inter-frame continuity, fine-grained token correspondence, and frame-to-video stability. Extensive evaluations on five benchmarks covering 46 generator variants demonstrate state-of-the-art overall performance against 16 representative baselines, while robustness experiments confirm strong resilience to twelve real-world video perturbations. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/hwang-cs-ime/MTOR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MTOR 用全局视觉特征与 caption 文本语义的多模态分支，加上三层时间过度规整 (temporal over-regularity, TOR) 组件检测 AI 生成视频：AI 视频在粗粒度帧间连续性、细粒度 token 对应、帧到视频稳定性上都表现出更强的时间持续性与更低的时间变异性。在覆盖 46 个生成器变体的五个基准上对 16 个代表性基线取得整体 SOTA，并在 12 种真实视频扰动下保持强鲁棒性。
Motivation: 视频生成缩小了真实与合成的感知差距，现有检测器主要依赖视觉表征，caption 文本语义与细粒度时间规整性长期被忽视，导致跨生成器泛化困难。
Method: MTOR 含多模态分支与 TOR 组件：前者融合全局视觉表征与 caption 派生文本表征，后者在三个层面建模时间过度规整——粗粒度帧间连续性、细粒度 token 对应、帧到视频稳定性。
Result: 在覆盖 46 个生成器变体的五个基准上，对 16 个代表性基线取得整体 SOTA；鲁棒性实验在 12 种真实视频扰动下确认强抗性。
Conclusion: caption 文本语义与时间过度规整是 AI 生成视频检测的互补判别线索，二者结合可提升跨生成器泛化与扰动鲁棒性；代码与模型将在 GitHub 发布。

papers.title: Environmental sensor readings in two crop disease image datasets identify the session in which each image was taken
papers.abstract_en: Integrating environmental sensor data with leaf imagery is widely reported to boost crop disease classification accuracy. In this work, we reveal that these reported gains are often artifacts of dataset construction: because a single sensor reading is shared across many images collected in a single session (one farm on one date), multimodal networks can predict disease simply by memorizing session identities. Analyzing two widely used Korean datasets, the Crop Disease Diagnosis (CDD) benchmark and an AI Hub pest/disease dataset, we demonstrate that nearly all images share sensor values, with 91.9% of CDD test images having exact sensor duplicates in the training set. Remarkably, an image-free classifier given only timestamps matches or exceeds sensor-driven predictions across all seven evaluated crops, and matches the published macro-F1 of a state-of-the-art CDD fusion model. These results indicate that performance gains on standard random splits cannot be disentangled from session leakage. We propose that multimodal crop studies must evaluate on session-held-out splits and report performance against sensor-free date-time baselines to ensure genuine generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 作物病害多模态研究中报告的传感器融合增益多为数据集构造伪影：同一会话（同一农场同一天）共享一条传感器读数，网络靠记住会话身份即可判病。CDD 测试集中 91.9% 的图像在训练集里有完全相同的传感器值；只给时间戳、完全不用图像的分类器在全部 7 种作物上追平或超过传感器驱动预测，并追平已发表的 CDD 融合模型 macro-F1。作者要求多模态作物研究改用 session-held-out 划分，并报告相对无传感器时间基线的性能。
Motivation: 把环境传感器读数与叶片图像融合被广泛报告能提升作物病害分类精度，但单条读数被同一会话的大量图像共享，随机划分下网络可凭记忆会话身份取巧，使增益无法与会话泄漏分离。
Method: 分析两个韩国常用数据集——Crop Disease Diagnosis (CDD) 基准与 AI Hub 病虫害数据集，检查传感器值在图像间的重复情况；训练一个只用时间戳、不看图像的分类器，与传感器驱动的多模态预测在 7 种作物上对比，并对照已发表的 CDD 融合模型 macro-F1。
Result: CDD 测试集中 91.9% 的图像在训练集有完全相同的传感器重复值，两个数据集里几乎所有图像共享传感器读数；仅用时间戳的无图像分类器在全部 7 种评估作物上追平或超过传感器驱动预测，并追平已发表的 state-of-the-art CDD 融合模型的 macro-F1。
Conclusion: 标准随机划分上的性能增益无法与会话泄漏区分开；多模态作物研究必须用 session-held-out 划分评测，并报告相对无传感器 date-time 基线的性能以确保真实泛化。

papers.title: Correct Verdicts, Flawed Reasoning: Structured Auditing of LLM-based Vulnerability Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for automated software vulnerability analysis. Binary classification alone is insufficient; practitioners need explanations to triage bugs and engineer patches. Standard practice relies on Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting, but free-form reasoning allows models to obscure logical leaps, hallucinated execution steps, and internal inconsistencies behind plausible prose. Our manual audit reveals that approximately 60% of correct vulnerability verdicts are accompanied by fabricated or unverifiable claims, and free-form explanations allow reasoning errors to evade LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. We present Vulnerability Explanation Reasoning Auditor (VERA), an automated framework for auditing LLM vulnerability reasoning. Rather than accepting free-form text, VERA asks models to output a Structured Reasoning Record (SRR) encoding tracked pointers, memory operations, and state transitions in machine-readable fields. A multi-stage judge audits each SRR against eight reasoning failure modes using deterministic checks, with LLM calls reserved for semantic interpretation. The standardized SRR schema also enables automated mutation testing to benchmark judges at scale without human annotation. Our evaluation shows reasoning flaws occur in correct verdicts just as frequently as incorrect ones, and VERA exposes 87% of reasoning errors that free-form LLM-as-judge systematically miss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VERA 让 LLM 漏洞判定输出机器可读的 Structured Reasoning Record（SRR，含指针、内存操作、状态转移字段），再用多阶段 judge 按八类推理失败模式做确定性检查。人工审计发现约 60% 的正确漏洞判定伴随捏造或不可验证的说法，且 VERA 能暴露 87% 被自由文本 LLM-as-a-judge 系统性漏掉的推理错误。
Motivation: 漏洞判定只给二分类不够，但自由形式 CoT 解释会把逻辑跳跃、幻觉执行步骤和内部不一致藏在通顺文字里，LLM-as-a-judge 也据此漏判。
Method: Vulnerability Explanation Reasoning Auditor (VERA) 要求模型以 SRR 结构化字段输出追踪指针、内存操作与状态转移；多阶段 judge 用确定性检查逐条审计八类推理失败模式，仅在语义解释处调用 LLM；SRR schema 还支持自动化 mutation testing，无需人工标注即可大规模评测 judge。
Result: 人工审计显示约 60% 的正确漏洞判定带有捏造或不可验证的说法；推理缺陷在正确判定中出现的频率与错误判定一样高；VERA 暴露出 87% 被自由文本 LLM-as-a-judge 系统性漏掉的推理错误。
Conclusion: 判定正确不等于推理正确：把漏洞解释强制成结构化记录并用确定性检查审计，才能让推理错误在 LLM-as-a-judge 下可见。

papers.title: Multimodal Deep Survival Analysis for Sinkhole Susceptibility
papers.abstract_en: Sinkholes are a widespread geohazard in karst terrain. In Florida, soluble carbonate bedrock, shallow groundwater, and intense rainfall combine to make subsidence both common and spatially heterogeneous. Predicting where and when sinkholes will occur is difficult for two reasons. First, locations without reported sinkholes cannot be directly labeled or sampled as true negative locations. Second, the potential factors governing sinkhole risk span heterogeneous data modalities and therefore require careful integration within a unified modeling framework. We address both problems with our proposed model, a multimodal Cox proportional hazards framework for sinkhole susceptibility. Our contributions are threefold. First, we extend the proportional-hazards formulation to heterogeneous multimodal input through modality-specific encoders and a cross-modal fusion layer. Second, we treat unreported locations as right-censored rather than negative, avoiding hard-negative labeling and yielding continuous, time-aware susceptibility from the predicted survival function. Third, a statewide Florida case study with spatially blocked validation and ablation studies quantifies the benefit of multimodal integration. A Florida case study demonstrates that the proposed method effectively ranks sinkhole risk and produces a statewide susceptibility map that captures spatial variations in sinkhole occurrence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多模态 Cox 比例风险 (multimodal Cox proportional hazards) 模型做岩溶区地面塌陷易发性：用模态专属编码器加跨模态融合层整合异质数据，把未报告塌陷的位置当作右删失 (right-censored) 而非负样本，从而输出连续、随时间变化的生存函数易发性。在佛罗里达全州案例中，该方法能有效排序塌陷风险并生成捕捉空间差异的易发性图。
Motivation: 塌陷预测有两个卡点：未发生报告的位置无法被直接标为真负样本，硬负标签会引入噪声；风险因子横跨多种异质数据模态，缺少统一的建模框架来整合。
Method: 把比例风险公式扩展到多模态输入：每个模态配专属 encoder，经 cross-modal fusion layer 融合后进入 Cox 模型；未报告位置按右删失处理，由预测的生存函数给出连续、时间感知的易发性；在佛罗里达全州数据上做空间分块验证 (spatially blocked validation) 与消融实验。
Result: 全州案例中该方法能有效排序塌陷风险，并生成捕捉塌陷发生空间变化的易发性图；消融研究量化了多模态整合带来的收益。
Conclusion: 把未报告位置当作右删失而非负样本，配合多模态融合，可以在不硬负标签的前提下得到时间感知的塌陷易发性排序与制图。

papers.title: Capability-Driven Self-Evolution of Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Memory self-evolution uses task feedback to iteratively improve executable memory programs that store and retrieve information from past interactions. Existing approaches typically adopt holistic evolution, deriving revision directions from mixed feedback and judging progress by overall performance. This can obscure optimization directions and hide capability-specific gains offset by regressions elsewhere, leaving promising directions underexplored. We introduce capability-driven evolution, which extends search guidance from overall performance to individual capability dimensions, preserving promising revisions and expanding exploration beyond the boundaries of holistic evolution. We propose PrisMem, which uses dependency-aware capability selection to prioritize targets with potential cross-capability benefits and history-guided diagnosis to refine capability specialists. Trace-guided integration compares evaluated programs on paired differential cases, using their behavioral differences to consolidate complementary gains into a unified memory program. Experiments show that PrisMem outperforms the strongest baselines by 10.54 and 7.83 percentage points on BEAM-1M and LongMemEval-M, respectively, demonstrating its effectiveness on million-token histories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PrisMem 把记忆自进化从整体性能导向拆成按能力维度导向：依赖感知的能力选择挑出可能跨能力受益的目标，历史引导诊断细化各能力专家，trace 引导的整合在配对差分样例上比较已评测程序、把互补增益合并进统一记忆程序。在百万 token 历史任务上，BEAM-1M 与 LongMemEval-M 分别比最强基线高 10.54 和 7.83 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有记忆自进化从混合反馈推导修订方向、只看整体性能，会掩盖优化方向，并让某些能力维度的提升被别处的回退抵消，有潜力的方向因此探索不足。
Method: 提出 capability-driven evolution：依赖感知的能力选择 (dependency-aware capability selection) 优先挑选可能带来跨能力收益的目标，历史引导诊断 (history-guided diagnosis) 细化各能力专家程序；trace 引导整合 (trace-guided integration) 在配对差分样例上比较已评测程序，依据行为差异把互补增益合并为统一记忆程序。
Result: 在 BEAM-1M 上比最强基线高 10.54 个百分点，在 LongMemEval-M 上高 7.83 个百分点，任务设定为百万 token 级历史。
Conclusion: 把搜索引导从整体性能细化到单个能力维度，能在百万 token 历史的记忆程序进化中保留有希望的修订并扩大探索范围，效果超过整体式进化。

papers.title: Ontology Concept Overlap as a Training Signal: Knowledge-Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Clinical Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning post-training for language models relies on two reward designs: human preferences (RLHF, DPO) and binary verifiers (RLVR). Clinical question answering fits neither. Near-correct answers differ by a single substituted entity, and no executable check decides clinical correctness. We instantiate a soft verifier from a maintained controlled vocabulary: UMLS Concept Unique Identifier overlap (via scispaCy, set-level F1) gives a graded, externally specified reward computed without a model in the loop. We combine it inside GRPO with an entropy-normalised LLM judge, which covers the safety and evidence axes overlap cannot see, and a small consistency penalty on padding and repetition that keeps early-training samples scorable. This three-term composite improves over SFT on Phi-3-mini (3.8B) over MedQA by 2.9% on EM (0.700 vs 0.680) and 39% on Token-F1 (0.202 vs 0.145); on Llama-3.2-3B the corresponding gains are 14% on EM and 35% on Token-F1. We report Token-F1 as the primary metric because it credits partially-correct clinical content that EM discards at this open-generation scale. Main-table results are means over 3 seeds with standard deviations below 0.005. The method transfers to PubMedQA, where training on the PubMedQA train set with the same composite reward improves Token-F1 over SFT by 22% on Phi-3-mini and 17% on Llama-3.2-3B without retuning. A reward ablation on Phi-3, varying the judge-ontology split at a fixed consistency weight, attributes 3 EM points to the ontology term, the contribution that catches entity substitutions the judge cannot. papers.title: Latent Similarity Gaussian Processes: A Theory-Grounded Approach to Personalized Suicide-Risk Forecasting for Clinical Decision-Support
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting suicide risk is difficult due to the high heterogeneity of patients and the low base rate of suicide-related events (SREs). We present Latent Similarity Gaussian Processes (LSGPs), which embed patients in a continuous latent space to jointly model similarity and forecast risk. By selectively drawing information from latent peers, LSGPs better capture individualized risk trajectories, generalizing nomothetic (pooled), idiographic (per-patient), and hierarchical frameworks. Our contributions are: (1) an identifiable two-channel Similarity Kernel; (2) proof that the standard model-fitting algorithm, mean-field variational inference, collapses LSGPs to nomothetic models, along with a fix; and (3) empirical results on intensive longitudinal suicide data showing LSGPs outperform nomothetic, idiographic, and hierarchical models for next-week risk forecasting, with the largest gains in forecasting first-occurrence SREs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Latent Similarity Gaussian Process (LSGP)，把患者嵌入连续隐空间，用可辨识的双通道 Similarity Kernel 选择性借用隐空间近邻的信息来预测个体风险轨迹，统一 nomothetic、idiographic 与 hierarchical 三类框架。摘要证明标准拟合算法 mean-field variational inference 会把 LSGP 坍缩回 nomothetic 模型并给出修复；在密集纵向自杀数据上，LSGP 的下周风险预报优于三类基线，首次发生 SRE 的预报提升最大。
Motivation: 自杀风险预报面临患者高度异质与自杀相关事件 (SRE) 基率低的双重困难：完全合并的 nomothetic 模型抹平个体差异，纯 per-patient 的 idiographic 模型又数据稀疏，需要在两者之间按相似度借力。
Method: LSGP 将患者嵌入连续隐空间，用可辨识的双通道 Similarity Kernel 同时建模相似度与风险；理论上证明 mean-field variational inference 会使 LSGP 退化为 nomothetic 模型并提出修正拟合算法；在密集纵向自杀数据上与 nomothetic、idiographic、hierarchical 模型对比做 next-week risk forecasting。
Result: 在密集纵向自杀数据的下周风险预报中，LSGP 优于 nomothetic、idiographic 与 hierarchical 三类模型，且在首次发生 SRE 的预报上提升最大；摘要另给出理论结果：mean-field 变分推断会把 LSGP 坍缩为 nomothetic 模型。
Conclusion: 按隐空间相似度选择性借力可以同时保住群体信息与个体轨迹，是低基率、高异质临床风险预报的可行建模范式，且拟合算法的选择直接决定模型是否真的个性化。

papers.title: GraphDecide: Benchmarking System One Models on Graph Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for graph understanding and decision-making, while System One models such as Jev select directly from supplied options. However, the capabilities of System One models on graph-related tasks remain unclear. We introduce GraphDecide, a model-independent benchmark that combines structural task profiles, matched graph-text input contrasts and heuristic-proposal controls to diagnose graph decision performance. We evaluate Jev and related choice-based models alongside language-model baselines, covering fourteen model-interface configurations. Jev's results illustrate the benchmark's central distinctions: accurate adjacency recognition does not guarantee broader structural correctness, joint graph-text input does not consistently improve prediction, and feasible construction does not establish high solution quality. Its task contracts, candidate interfaces and scoring rules support comparison across native selectors and language-model adapters. Code and aggregate results are available at https://github.com/VictorYXL/JevGraphBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraphDecide 是一个与模型无关的图决策基准，用结构任务画像、配对的图-文本输入对照和启发式提案控制来诊断 System One 模型（如 Jev）在图任务上的表现，覆盖十四种模型-接口配置。核心发现是三条否定性区分：邻接识别准确不保证更广的结构正确性，图-文本联合输入并不稳定提升预测，可行构造也不等于高解质量。
Motivation: LLM 被越来越多用于图理解与决策，而直接从给定选项中选择的 System One 模型（如 Jev）在图任务上的能力尚不清楚，缺少能区分邻接识别、结构正确性与解质量的诊断工具。
Method: 提出模型无关的 GraphDecide 基准，组合结构任务画像 (structural task profiles)、配对的图-文本输入对照 (matched graph-text input contrasts) 与启发式提案控制 (heuristic-proposal controls)；用任务契约、候选接口和评分规则统一原生选择器与 LLM 适配器，评测 Jev、相关选择型模型及语言模型基线，共十四种模型-接口配置。
Result: 在十四种模型-接口配置上评测 Jev、相关选择型模型与语言模型基线：准确的邻接识别不保证更广的结构正确性，联合图-文本输入不一致地改善预测，可行的构造不建立高解质量。
Conclusion: 图决策能力需要被拆成邻接识别、结构正确性与解质量三个可分别失败的维度来评测，单一准确率会掩盖这些区别；代码与聚合结果已在 GitHub 公开。

papers.title: KineWorld: Action-Induced Transport Fields for Embodied World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Embodied world models predict the visual consequences of candidate actions before execution. However, existing action-conditioned world models often adopt uniformly weighted visual generation objectives that can be misaligned with embodied prediction needs. Even with explicit motion conditioning, these objectives can underemphasize spatially sparse changes that are critical to interaction. We propose KineWorld, a transport-aware world-modeling framework that extends robot kinematics from motion conditioning to the spatial allocation of generative supervision. Kinematic Transport Lifting (KTL) constructs renderer-derived, camera-aligned transport fields from commanded robot motion. Transport-Aware World Diffusion (TAWD) calibrates their motion support on the video-latent grid and reweights future-RGB flow matching through a normalized mixture of uniform and transport-focused distributions. We train KineWorld using ALOHA-AgileX bimanual manipulation data from RoboTwin 2.0. KineWorld achieves an EWMScore-P of 68.95 in single-view evaluation and a TWB-Score of 54.82 in multi-view evaluation. These results support a shift from appearance fitting toward action-consequence modeling for embodied decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KineWorld 把机器人运动学从「动作条件」升级为「生成监督的空间分配」：由指令动作经渲染器推出相机对齐的 Kinematic Transport Lifting (KTL) 传输场，再用 Transport-Aware World Diffusion (TAWD) 在 video-latent 网格上校准其运动支撑，以均匀分布与传输聚焦分布的归一化混合重加权未来 RGB flow matching。在 RoboTwin 2.0 的 ALOHA-AgileX 双臂操作数据上，单视 EWMScore-P 达 68.95，多视 TWB-Score 达 54.82。
Motivation: 现有动作条件世界模型用均匀加权的视觉生成目标，与具身预测需求错位：即使显式加入运动条件，空间上稀疏但对交互关键的变化仍被低估。
Method: KTL 从指令机器人运动经渲染器构造相机对齐的传输场；TAWD 在 video-latent 网格上校准其运动支撑，并用均匀分布与传输聚焦分布的归一化混合重加权未来 RGB 的 flow matching；训练数据为 RoboTwin 2.0 的 ALOHA-AgileX 双臂操作数据。
Result: 单视评测 EWMScore-P 68.95，多视评测 TWB-Score 54.82（RoboTwin 2.0 / ALOHA-AgileX 双臂操作数据）。
Conclusion: 把运动学用于分配生成监督，可让具身世界模型从外观拟合转向动作后果建模，服务于具身决策。

papers.title: IGA-KAN: Isogeometric Analysis with Physics-Informed Closed-Form Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Forward and Inverse PDEs
papers.abstract_en: Isogeometric analysis (IGA) solves partial differential equations accurately on exact NURBS geometry, whereas neural solvers are mesh-free but often orders of magnitude less accurate and typically trained by non-convex optimization without error control. We propose IGA-KAN, which uses local Kolmogorov-Arnold networks, fitted in closed form, to improve the IGA solution instead of replacing it. An IGA Galerkin solve produces u_h; on every knot-vertex patch a Kolmogorov-Arnold ridge model is fitted to the strong form of the equation, the exact boundary data and u_h, and the models are blended by IGA hat functions. With fixed inner functions the fit is one batched linear least-squares problem, without optimizer, learning rate or initialization. An a posteriori safeguard, motivated by a maximum-principle bound, decides where local models are used, keeping the IGA solution elsewhere. On eight benchmarks with exact solutions, five from the literature and one also posed on a domain fitted to a brain slice from MRI, the method reduces the error of IGA, at an unchanged number of Galerkin unknowns, by factors of 4.2 to 90 in L^2 and 4.1 to 220 in H^1 on the reference meshes, and its L^2 error is 6 to 6x10^4 times smaller than that of the best Kolmogorov-Arnold network trained from scratch on the same equations with a fixed budget. In an inverse problem it recovers an unknown constant source from one noise-free observation 167 times more accurately than IGA. The gain is attributed to the superconvergence of local averages of the Galerkin solution.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables. Code and notebooks: https://github.com/Sima-Naraghi/iga-kan
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IGA-KAN 在 IGA Galerkin 解之上用局部闭式拟合的 Kolmogorov-Arnold ridge 模型做修正而非替代：每个 knot-vertex patch 上对强形式、精确边值和 u_h 拟合 KAN，再用 IGA hat 函数混合，固定内函数时整体退化为一次批量线性最小二乘，无需优化器。八个含精确解的基准上，在 Galerkin 未知量数不变时 L2 误差降 4.2–90 倍、H1 降 4.1–220 倍，逆问题中未知常数源比 IGA 准 167 倍。
Motivation: IGA 在精确 NURBS 几何上精度高，而无网格神经求解器常差数个量级且靠非凸优化训练、无误差控制；作者要保留 IGA 解并系统性提升它，而不是用神经网络替换。
Method: 先做一次 IGA Galerkin 求解得到 u_h；在每个 knot-vertex patch 上针对方程强形式、精确边界数据与 u_h 拟合 Kolmogorov-Arnold ridge 局部模型，用 IGA hat 函数混合各局部解；固定内函数后整个拟合是一次批量线性最小二乘，无优化器、学习率与初始化；再用受最大值原理界启发的 a posteriori safeguard 决定哪些局部模型生效，其余位置保留原 IGA 解。
Result: 在八个含精确解的基准（五个来自文献，其中一个定义在由 MRI 脑切片拟合的区域上）上，Galerkin 未知量数不变时相对 IGA 的误差降低 L2 4.2–90 倍、H1 4.1–220 倍；同一方程、固定预算下从头训练的最佳 KAN 相比，其 L2 误差小 6 到 6×10^4 倍；逆问题中从单个无噪观测恢复未知常数源，比 IGA 准 167 倍。
Conclusion: 增益来自 Galerkin 解局部平均的超收敛 (superconvergence)：把闭式局部 KAN 作为带 a posteriori 保障的修正层，可以在不增加未知量的前提下同时抬高正问题精度并大幅改善逆问题参数恢复。

summary_sections.motivation: IGA 在精确 NURBS 几何上精度高，而无网格神经求解器常差数个量级且靠非凸优化训练、无误差控制；作者要保留 IGA 解并系统性提升它，而不是用神经网络替换。
summary_sections.method: 先做一次 IGA Galerkin 求解得到 u_h；在每个 knot-vertex patch 上针对方程强形式、精确边界数据与 u_h 拟合 Kolmogorov-Arnold ridge 局部模型，用 IGA hat 函数混合各局部解；固定内函数后整个拟合是一次批量线性最小二乘，无优化器、学习率与初始化；再用受最大值原理界启发的 a posteriori safeguard 决定哪些局部模型生效，其余位置保留原 IGA 解。
summary_sections.result: 在八个含精确解的基准（五个来自文献，其中一个定义在由 MRI 脑切片拟合的区域上）上，Galerkin 未知量数不变时相对 IGA 的误差降低 L2 4.2–90 倍、H1 4.1–220 倍；同一方程、固定预算下从头训练的最佳 KAN 相比，其 L2 误差小 6 到 6×10^4 倍；逆问题中从单个无噪观测恢复未知常数源，比 IGA 准 167 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 增益来自 Galerkin 解局部平均的超收敛 (superconvergence)：把闭式局部 KAN 作为带 a posteriori 保障的修正层，可以在不增加未知量的前提下同时抬高正问题精度并大幅改善逆问题参数恢复。

papers.title: ImproveAnyTask: An Autonomous Post-Training Harness for Iterative Model Self-Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Adapting general-purpose large language models to specific tasks requires substantial human effort in designing data and training strategies. Sustaining improvement is especially challenging because model updates change the error distribution, requiring strategies to be continually refined. We introduce ImproveAnyTask, an autonomous post-training harness that improves task performance under a limited compute budget. Drawing inspiration from gradient-based parameter optimization, the harness organizes adaptation into error attribution, update-direction selection, and executable model updates. It combines metric-level and case-level analysis to identify a focal problem, then investigates research-backed strategies and compares their reported gains and reproduction difficulty. The selected strategy is translated into training data and a training configuration, with small-scale execution checks preceding full post-training. Subsequent evaluation guides model selection and further adaptation, while validated strategies and scripts are retained for reuse. Across 11 tasks, ImproveAnyTask achieves mean gains of 18.29 and 11.97 percentage points on the Base and Instruct models, respectively, with a maximum gain of 41.96 points, under a 24-hour budget with resources equivalent to eight H20 GPUs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ImproveAnyTask 把 LLM 后训练适配做成自主闭环：按误差归因、更新方向选择、可执行更新三步组织，用指标级与案例级分析定位焦点问题，检索有文献依据的策略并比较其报告增益与复现难度，再翻译成训练数据与配置，先小规模试跑再全量后训练。在 11 个任务上，24 小时、8 张 H20 GPU 预算内，Base 模型平均提升 18.29 个百分点、Instruct 模型平均提升 11.97 个百分点，单任务最高 41.96 个百分点。
Motivation: 把通用 LLM 适配到具体任务需要大量人工设计数据与训练策略；而模型每次更新都会改变误差分布，原有策略随之失效，必须持续重调，在有限算力下尤其难维持改进。
Method: 借鉴梯度式参数优化的思路，把适配组织为误差归因、更新方向选择、可执行模型更新三个阶段：先用 metric-level 与 case-level 分析锁定焦点问题，再调研有文献支撑的策略并比较其报告增益与复现难度，选定后把策略翻译成训练数据与训练配置，先做小规模执行检查再进入全量后训练；后续评估用于模型选择与进一步适配，验证过的策略与脚本保留复用。
Result: 在 11 个任务上，24 小时预算、资源相当于 8 张 H20 GPU 的条件下，Base 模型平均提升 18.29 个百分点，Instruct 模型平均提升 11.97 个百分点，单任务最大提升 41.96 个百分点。
Conclusion: 在受限算力下，把后训练适配做成误差归因到策略执行的自主闭环，并复用已验证的策略与脚本，可持续压低任务误差而无需人工反复重设训练方案。

papers.title: Stability-Shaped Deep Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: In deep graph neural networks, increasing depth enlarges the receptive field but often leads to over-smoothing, where node representations tend to align. We develop a unified, mode-wise stability framework for deep GNN propagation that provides a principled characterization of over-smoothing. By interpreting layer depth as time and layer updates as graph-coupled dynamics, over-smoothing can be understood as an undesirable dynamical synchronization of features, for which the master stability curve provides a theoretical tool to assess the stability of synchrony. Guided by this theory, we further propose Stability-Shaped Deep Graph Learning (SDGL) to mitigate over-smoothing in deep GNNs. SDGL has two complementary instantiations: one induces controlled Turing instability to replace synchronization with spatial pattern formation, and the other maintains stable near-critical propagation. Experiments on diverse node- and graph-level benchmarks demonstrate the improved depth scaling and consistent accuracy gains over strong baselines, including graphs exhibiting long-range dependencies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把深层 GNN 的过平滑 (over-smoothing) 重写为图耦合动力学中的同步现象，用 master stability curve 判定同步稳定性，并据此提出 SDGL：一个实例引入受控 Turing 不稳定以空间模式形成替代同步，另一个维持稳定的近临界传播。在多种节点级与图级基准上，SDGL 改善了深度扩展能力并在强基线上取得一致的精度提升，含长程依赖图。
Motivation: 加深 GNN 扩大感受野却常引发过平滑，节点表征趋于对齐；缺少一个统一的、按模态刻画过平滑的理论判据来指导深层结构设计。
Method: 把层深视作时间、层更新视作图耦合动力学，用 master stability curve 给出同步稳定性的按模态 (mode-wise) 分析框架；理论指导下的 SDGL 有两个互补实例：受控 Turing 不稳定 (Turing instability) 与稳定的近临界 (near-critical) 传播。
Result: 在多样的节点级与图级基准上，SDGL 展示了改善的深度扩展 (depth scaling) 与相对强基线的一致精度提升，覆盖含长程依赖 (long-range dependencies) 的图。
Conclusion: 过平滑可作为动力学同步问题来刻画与治理：用稳定性理论塑造传播动态，能在加深网络的同时保住精度。

papers.title: MeSD: Multi-Evidence Self-Distillation for VideoLLM
papers.abstract_en: While reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards provides reliable outcome supervision for VideoLLMs, sequence-level rewards offer limited token-level guidance. On-policy self-distillation addresses this limitation by conditioning a self-teacher on privileged information to provide dense token-level supervision. However, aggregating heterogeneous evidence within a single teacher context obscures cross-evidence agreement and conflict. A further challenge lies in determining whether teacher guidance should refine reward-based updates or provide corrective supervision for failed trajectories. To address these issues, we propose MeSD, a multi-evidence self-distillation framework for VideoLLMs. MeSD constructs three evidence-conditioned teachers with shared parameters, using the ground-truth answer as a common semantic context while separately incorporating temporal and spatial evidence. Given the same student-generated prefixes, MeSD evaluates evidence-specific preferences relative to the Answer Teacher and fuses teacher-common preferences with gated teacher-specific residuals. Furthermore, MeSD introduces Verification-Guided Optimization to classify trajectories as Success, Failure, or Indeterminate. For Success and Indeterminate trajectories, MeSD refines token-level advantage magnitudes while preserving reward-derived signs. For verified failure trajectories that contain the required evidence, MeSD applies failure-conditioned distillation, using reverse-KL correction toward the fused distribution. Experiments on multiple video benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains over reinforcement learning and self-distillation baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MeSD 为 VideoLLM 提出多证据自蒸馏框架：用共享参数构造三个以答案为共同语境、分别注入时间与空间证据的 teacher，把 teacher 共同偏好与带门控的 teacher 特定残差融合，再按 Verification-Guided Optimization 把轨迹分为 Success/Failure/Indeterminate 分别施加 token 级优势修正或反向 KL 失败纠正。在多个视频 benchmark 上相对强化学习与自蒸馏基线取得一致增益。
Motivation: RLVR 的序列级奖励只给结果监督，token 级信号稀疏；把异质证据塞进单一 teacher 语境会掩盖证据间的一致与冲突，且无法区分奖励更新与失败纠正两种用途。
Method: 构造三个证据条件化、共享参数的 teacher（以 ground-truth answer 为共同语义语境，分别加入时间与空间证据）；对同一学生前缀评估相对 Answer Teacher 的证据偏好，融合共同偏好与门控的特定残差。Verification-Guided Optimization 将轨迹分类为 Success、Failure、Indeterminate：前两类在保留奖励符号的前提下细化 token 级 advantage 幅度，含所需证据的失败轨迹用反向 KL 修正做 failure-conditioned distillation。
Result: 在多个视频 benchmark 上，相对强化学习基线与自蒸馏基线取得一致增益（consistent gains）。
Conclusion: 把异质证据拆成多个共享参数的 teacher 并按验证结果分流监督，可在 VideoLLM 上同时改进奖励驱动更新与失败纠正。

papers.title: BabelFake: A Multilingual Audio-Visual DeepFake Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Reliable and practical audio-visual DeepFake detection requires benchmarks that reflect diverse linguistic contexts and modern data synthesis pipelines for visual as well as audio manipulations. However, existing datasets predominantly contain footage of English-speakers, often include outdated manipulation types, or overlook the audio modality. Further, many datasets feature individuals who did not consent to be used in DeepFake creation. We introduce BabelFake, a multilingual audio-visual DeepFake benchmark recorded with consenting participants. BabelFake contains 399k clips (1,323 hours) from 496 individuals spanning five languages (English, German, Italian, French, Spanish). Our modular data generation pipeline pairs 11 modern video manipulation methods with 4 voice cloning engines, distinguishing visual-only (face swapping) and joint audio-visual manipulations (lip synchronization and portrait animation). By benchmarking state-of-the-art detectors, we show that detection difficulty depends on the audio-visual generation pairing, with substantial performance degradation when authentic audio is preserved. Cross-language/demographic evaluation reveals sensitivity varying across detector architectures and training data, while human evaluation reveals that perceived realism and machine-detection difficulty do not necessarily align.
papers.comment: 25 pages (8 main paper + ack), 25 pages total, 8 figures, under submission
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BabelFake 是一个经被试同意采集的多语言音视频 DeepFake 基准，含 496 人、五种语言（英德意法西）的 399k 段剪辑（1,323 小时），用 11 种视频操纵方法与 4 个语音克隆引擎组合生成。对现有检测器的基准测试显示，检测难度取决于音视频生成配对方式，保留真实音频时性能大幅下降；跨语言与跨人种的敏感度随检测器架构和训练数据而异，且人眼感知的真实度与机器检测难度并不一致。
Motivation: 现有 DeepFake 数据集以英语为主、操纵类型过时、常忽略音频模态，且大量使用未同意的个体，无法支撑多语言与现代合成管线下的音视频检测评估。
Method: 经同意参与者录制多语言素材，构建模块化生成管线：11 种视频操纵方法配 4 个 voice cloning 引擎，区分纯视觉（face swapping）与联合音视频操纵（lip synchronization、portrait animation）；随后对 SOTA 检测器做基准测试，并加入跨语言/人种评估与人类评估。
Result: 基准含 399k 段剪辑、1,323 小时、496 名个体、5 种语言；检测难度随音视频生成配对变化，保留真实音频时性能显著下降；跨语言与人种的敏感度因检测器架构和训练数据而异；人类评估显示感知真实度与机器检测难度并不总是一致。
Conclusion: 音视频 DeepFake 检测的成败取决于音视频如何配对生成而非单一模态，评估必须覆盖多语言、跨人种与人类感知维度。

papers.title: SPIN: Image Immunization Against Diffusion Editing via Single-Step Projection in Stochastic Neighborhoods
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have greatly advanced instruction-guided image editing, while also raising concerns about unauthorized image manipulation. Image immunization addresses this risk by adding imperceptible perturbations to an input image to disrupt subsequent edits. Since editing requests are unknown at image release, protection should remain effective beyond the instruction used to construct the perturbation. Existing immunization methods either require costly full-trajectory backpropagation or use intermediate objectives whose effects may be weakened by subsequent denoising. Meanwhile, a single inference path provides limited feedback about alternative denoising continuations. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{SPIN}, a framework for image immunization via one-step projection over local stochastic trajectory neighborhoods. Starting from an early denoising state, \textsc{SPIN} generates stochastic neighboring states under the same instruction and predicts their clean latents through one-step projection without full unrolling. We then optimize a bounded input perturbation to maximize the average deviation of these predictions from a clean-edit reference, encouraging the perturbation to disrupt multiple possible editing outcomes. Experiments on two image editors demonstrate substantial gains in protection performance, with \textsc{SPIN} outperforming compared methods across all six metrics under seen instructions and in the more challenging unseen instruction setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPIN 针对扩散图像编辑的未授权篡改风险，提出单步投影的图像免疫框架：从早期去噪状态在同一指令下生成随机邻域状态，用单步投影预测其干净潜变量（不展开完整轨迹），再优化有界输入扰动使这些预测相对 clean-edit 参考的平均偏差最大化，从而同时破坏多种可能编辑结果。在两个图像编辑器上，SPIN 在 seen 指令与更难的 unseen 指令设定下，全部六项指标均优于对比方法。
Motivation: 图像免疫要求扰动在发布时未知编辑指令的情况下仍然有效，而现有方法要么需要昂贵的全轨迹反向传播，要么用的中间目标会被后续去噪削弱，且单一推理路径对其他去噪延续提供的反馈有限。
Method: SPIN 从早期去噪状态出发，在同一指令下生成随机邻域状态 (stochastic trajectory neighborhoods)，用 one-step projection 预测其 clean latents 而不完整展开轨迹；随后优化有界输入扰动，最大化这些预测相对 clean-edit 参考的平均偏差，使扰动能干扰多个可能的编辑结果。
Result: 在两个 image editors 上的实验显示保护性能大幅提升：在 seen 指令以及更具挑战性的 unseen 指令设定下，SPIN 在全部六项指标上均优于所比较的方法。
Conclusion: 用随机邻域上的单步投影替代全轨迹反向传播，可以在指令未知时更稳健地破坏扩散图像编辑的多种可能输出。

papers.title: Dynamic Minimax Regret Optimization for Robust LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLM training increasingly relies on heterogeneous data sources spanning different domains, tasks, preference distributions, and difficulty levels. We study dynamic minimax regret for group-distributionally robust LLM post-training under instantaneous mini-batch-only bandit feedback. The framework views the training as a two-player sampler-optimizer process: a sampler adaptively selects among data sources using bandit feedback, while an optimizer updates the model parameters using stochastic gradients from the selected source. We focus on the practically restrictive setting where source losses evolve with model training but historical data are not re-evaluated, requiring the sampler to track instantaneous worst-sources from stale partial feedback. We propose DUCB-OGD, a simple and scalable algorithm that couples a Discounted Upper-Confidence-Bound sampler with an Online Gradient Descent optimizer. The sampler maintains exponential moving average loss estimates and confidence radii based on discounted effective sample sizes, avoiding costly re-evaluation of past data or intrusive changes to standard training pipelines. For $K$ data sources and $T$ training steps, we prove that DUCB-OGD achieves a dynamic minimax regret of $\tilde{O}(K^{1/4}T^{3/4})$, which is optimal up to logarithmic factors for the undiscounted objective under our feedback model. Extensive experiments across supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning show that DUCB-OGD integrates seamlessly into modern LLM training pipelines and improves worst-group robustness with negligible computational overhead compared with standard sampling baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 后训练的多源数据采样建模为 sampler-optimizer 两玩家动态 minimax regret 问题，在只有当前 mini-batch bandit 反馈、历史数据不重评的约束下，提出 DUCB-OGD：Discounted UCB 采样器配 Online Gradient Descent 优化器。对 K 个数据源、T 步训练证明动态 minimax regret 为 õ(K^{1/4}T^{3/4})，在该反馈模型下对未折扣目标差对数因子最优；在监督微调、偏好优化与强化学习实验中提升最差组鲁棒性且计算开销可忽略。
Motivation: LLM 后训练依赖跨领域、任务与难度的异构数据源，而源损失随训练漂移、历史数据又不重评，采样器只能从过时的部分反馈追踪当前最差源，标准采样基线在最差组鲁棒性上吃亏。
Method: DUCB-OGD 把训练写成两玩家过程：Discounted UCB 采样器用指数移动平均损失估计与基于折扣有效样本量的置信半径在 K 个源间选择，Online Gradient Descent 用所选源的随机梯度更新参数，全程不重评历史数据、不改动标准训练管线。
Result: 对 K 个数据源、T 步训练证明动态 minimax regret õ(K^{1/4}T^{3/4})，在该反馈模型下对未折扣目标差对数因子最优；在监督微调、偏好优化与强化学习三类实验中相对标准采样基线改善最差组鲁棒性，计算开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 在只有过时 bandit 反馈的现实约束下，折扣 UCB 加 OGD 的组合即可在可扩展的 LLM 后训练管线里实现动态 minimax regret 的近最优保证并提升最差组表现。

papers.title: Dual Variational Autoencoders for Efficient Sim-to-Real Transfer in Low-Cost Robotic Navigation
authors: Álvaro Díez (Department of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence
Fidel Aznar (Department of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based autonomous navigation for low-cost robots remains a fundamental challenge, primarily due to the significant gap between simulated training environments and real-world operational conditions. Direct policy transfer from simulation is often ineffective, while training exclusively on real data is impractical. We propose a hybrid transfer learning framework that effectively bridges the sim-to-real gap by combining domain randomization with feature-level domain adaptation. Our method employs a dual convolutional variational autoencoder architecture with a shared decoder, trained on an extensive set of 45225 simulated images and a minimal set of only 4556 real-world samples. This architecture learns a compact, common latent representation space that aligns the distributions of both domains. The adaptation process is further enhanced by two complementary data augmentation techniques designed to expand the limited real-world data. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that our method achieves an average success rate of almost 91% on image classification tasks for real-world indoor navigation, significantly outperforming both simulation-only and real-world-only training. We validate these findings through a direct, real-world deployment, where the proposed policy successfully guides a low-cost robot in a reactive exploration task. Furthermore, we validate the model's efficiency through a rigorous computational estimation, confirming its suitability for resource-constrained embedded platforms such as the Raspberry Pi 4 and NVIDIA Jetson Nano. This work presents a practical solution for developing effective and efficient navigation policies for low-cost robotic systems.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 13 figures. Published in Image and Vision Computing under a CC BY 4.0 license
papers.journal_ref: Image and Vision Computing, Vol. 174, 2026, 106121
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向低成本机器人的视觉导航，提出混合迁移学习框架：域随机化 (domain randomization) 加特征级域适配，用共享解码器的双卷积 VAE 把 45225 张仿真图像与 4556 张真实样本对齐到同一隐空间。真实室内导航图像分类平均成功率约 91%，显著高于仅仿真训练与仅真实数据训练，并在实体低成本机器人上完成反应式探索部署。
Motivation: 仿真训练环境与真实运行条件差距大，直接策略迁移往往失效，而只用真实数据训练又不现实，低成本机器人视觉导航因此长期受限。
Method: 域随机化与特征级域适配结合的混合迁移框架：双卷积变分自编码器 (dual convolutional VAE) 共享一个 decoder，在 45225 张仿真图像与 4556 张真实样本上学到对齐两域分布的紧凑公共隐空间；另配两种互补的数据增强来扩充有限的真实数据。
Result: 真实室内导航图像分类任务平均成功率约 91%，显著优于仅仿真训练与仅真实训练；策略在实体低成本机器人上完成反应式探索任务的直接部署；经计算量估算确认适配 Raspberry Pi 4 与 NVIDIA Jetson Nano 等资源受限嵌入式平台。
Conclusion: 用共享解码器的双 VAE 做特征级域适配，配合域随机化与数据增强，可以在极少真实样本下得到可直接部署到低成本嵌入式平台的导航策略。

papers.title: Fine-Tuning a 3B-Parameter LLM on a Smartphone: Characterizing Sustained Training
papers.abstract_en: Multi-billion-parameter LLMs now run on phones for inference, and training them on the device would personalize them without user data leaving the phone. Prior work has measured individual training steps of such models on phones, but not complete training runs, and not whether adapters trained on the device improve personalization. We present the first systematic characterization of a multi-billion-parameter LLM fine-tuned on a mobile device, covering memory, per-step time, thermal behavior, and energy. An iPhone 17 Pro can fine-tune a 3B-parameter LLM to a typical user within one battery charge, and the resulting adapters improve personalization as much as adapters trained on a server. Sustained training throttles the phone to about half its initial throughput, and none of the pausing or burst schedules we tested recovers it. Nearly all of each training step is spent in the frozen base model, most of it in the backward pass, which nine of the ten other runtimes we audited do not accelerate. Apple's MLX had a kernel for it that was never dispatched and was incorrect, and our repair, now merged upstream, trains an adapter 1.47x faster on a third less energy. On-device fine-tuning is feasible on current phones, and making it efficient requires runtimes and operating systems to treat training as a first-class workload.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/gordofreemo/mobile_LoRA_ft
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 iPhone 17 Pro 上对 3B 参数 LLM 做持续 LoRA 微调的系统刻画：一次完整训练可在单次电池电量内跑完，产出的 adapter 个性化效果与服务器训练相当；但持续训练会把手机吞吐压到初始值约一半，测试过的暂停与 burst 调度都无法恢复。作者修复了 MLX 中一个从未被调度且计算错误的 backward kernel（已合入上游），使训练快 1.47 倍、能耗少约三分之一。
Motivation: 此前工作只测过手机上单个训练 step，没有测完整训练过程，也没验证设备端训出的 adapter 是否真能改善个性化；同时训练在手机上是被系统当作次要负载处理的。
Method: 对移动端微调做首次系统刻画，覆盖内存、单步时间、热行为与能耗；审计了 10 个运行时对 frozen base model backward pass 的加速情况，并定位、修复 MLX 中未被 dispatch 且结果错误的 kernel（已合入上游），配套代码与数据开源。
Result: iPhone 17 Pro 可在一次电池电量内把 3B LLM 微调到典型用户水平，adapter 个性化提升与服务器训练相当；持续训练使吞吐降到初始值约一半，所测试的暂停与 burst 调度均无法恢复；10 个被审计运行时中有 9 个不加速 backward pass；修复 kernel 后训练加速 1.47 倍、能耗减少约三分之一。
Conclusion: 当前手机上设备端微调已可行，但要高效就必须让运行时与操作系统把 training 当作一等负载来调度。

papers.title: Readout Blindness: VLM Scores Miss the Spatial Direction Their Frozen Encoders Retain
papers.abstract_en: CLIP-like vision-language models remain a cornerstone of multimodal systems, yet their scores stay near chance on directed spatial relations, such as whether one object is left of another. We call this failure readout blindness and analyze, theoretically and empirically, why deployed scores miss the direction: when scoring rules treat the subject and object symmetrically, direction cancels regardless of encoder training. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Antisymmetric Displacement Readout (ADR), which aligns caption words with image patches in the frozen features and scores each relation by the signed displacement between matched object centroids. Notably, ADR succeeds without additional training or learned parameters, thereby demonstrating that directional information remains in the frozen encoder. However, text and world priors can inflate accuracy, so we further introduce prior deflation, which measures the benefit of the image-text pairing as the grounded gain over a null that pairs each item with an unrelated image. Extensive experiments across encoder families show that ADR substantially improves over deployed scores, which remain near chance on most direction-balanced sets even for fine-tuned encoders. Compared with more complex readouts, ADR outperforms the evaluated MLLM likelihood readouts and is competitive with their chat inference at a small fraction of the computation. These results support our claim that directional information can be recovered from frozen features by an appropriate readout. Our implementation and evaluation kit will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLIP 类模型在有向空间关系（左/右）上打分接近随机，作者论证原因是打分规则对主客体对称使方向相消，并提出无需训练的 Antisymmetric Displacement Readout (ADR)：把 caption 词对齐到冻结特征的图像 patch，按匹配到的物体质心的带符号位移给关系打分。ADR 在多数方向平衡测试集上大幅超过部署打分，并以极小算力匹敌 MLLM 的 chat 推理。
Motivation: 多模态系统依赖的 CLIP 类打分在有向空间关系上接近随机，且方向相消是打分规则的结构性问题，与编码器训练无关，微调也救不回来。
Method: ADR 把 caption 词与冻结视觉特征的 patch 对齐，按匹配物体质心间的带符号位移打分，不引入任何训练或可学习参数；另提出 prior deflation，用与无关图像配对的 null 作基线，把图文配对的收益记为 grounded gain 以扣除文本与世界先验带来的虚高。
Result: 在多个编码器家族上，ADR 明显优于部署打分——后者即便在微调过的编码器上，在多数方向平衡测试集上仍接近随机；相比更复杂的 readout，ADR 优于所评测的 MLLM likelihood readouts，且以极小一部分算力与其 chat 推理相当。
Conclusion: 方向信息一直保留在冻结编码器特征里，只是被对称打分规则抹掉；换一个反对称 readout 即可恢复，无需重训模型。

summary_sections.result: 在多个编码器家族上，ADR 明显优于部署打分——后者即便在微调过的编码器上，在多数方向平衡测试集上仍接近随机；相比更复杂的 readout，ADR 优于所评测的 MLLM likelihood readouts，且以极小一部分算力与其 chat 推理相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: 方向信息一直保留在冻结编码器特征里，只是被对称打分规则抹掉；换一个反对称 readout 即可恢复，无需重训模型。

papers.title: Agentic schema-guided extraction of materials process knowledge from scientific literature
papers.abstract_en: Materials literature contains detailed experimental knowledge, but procedures, chemical entities and measurements remain difficult to aggregate because they are reported in heterogeneous forms and depend on process-specific context. We present SciKGExtract, a schema-guided framework that combines large-language-model extraction with chemical normalization and agent-based evaluation and refinement before knowledge-graph integration. We evaluate the framework on 176 atomic-layer-deposition papers describing zinc oxide (ZnO) and indium--gallium--zinc oxide (IGZO), together with an expert-annotated full-schema subset. PubChem normalization improves exact-match extraction F1 for every tested model. For ZnO, the best F1 increases from 0.591 for direct normalized extraction to 0.805 with agentic refinement, whereas the best IGZO result is 0.344, revealing the greater difficulty of multicomponent supercycle processes. Evaluation against a deeply nested schema containing 65 experimental properties and 155 quantitative measurement nodes further exposes errors in process segmentation and numerical assignment. These results show that chemical canonicalization and targeted agentic verification provide complementary controls for converting complex materials literature into reusable, machine-actionable experimental knowledge.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, submitted for review to Nature Communications Materials

Motivation: 材料文献中的实验步骤、化学实体与测量以异质形式报告且依赖工艺上下文，难以聚合为可复用、机器可操作的实验知识。
Method: 提出 schema 引导框架 SciKGExtract：LLM 按 schema 抽取，接 PubChem 化学归一化，再由 agent 做评估与细化，最后接入知识图谱；评测集为 176 篇描述 ZnO 与 IGZO 的 ALD 论文，并含专家标注的全 schema 子集，深层嵌套 schema 含 65 个实验性质与 155 个定量测量节点。

Conclusion: 化学规范化与定向 agentic 验证是互补的控制手段，可把复杂材料文献转成可复用、机器可操作的实验知识；多组分超循环工艺的抽取难度显著更高。

papers.title: CRAFTER: Causality-based Self-adaptation for Autonomous IoT Systems
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents CRAFTER, an automated framework for designing and deploying self-adaptive IoT systems using Causal Reinforcement Learning (CRL). As IoT devices increasingly populate pervasive computing spaces, smart environments are enabled with advanced monitoring and interactive services. The dynamic nature of these environments, such as fluctuating workloads and evolving application demands, poses significant challenges in maintaining consistent Quality of Service (QoS) levels of IoT applications. While existing self-adaptation techniques offer adaptive capabilities, they are often designed to deal with specific application domains, hindering the design of self-adaptive solutions that can be re-used across multiple IoT verticals. In addition, there is a lack of automated pipelines that act on identifying key performance drivers to take effective adaptation decisions. CRAFTER addresses these issues by using Causality as a formal framework for performance analysis of IoT systems. CRAFTER generates causal graphs to uncover dependencies among system components and guide adaptation decisions based on cause-effect relationships. Then, adaptation agents can leverage this knowledge to take more effective adaptation decisions in dynamic situations. Our experimental evaluation demonstrates how CRAFTER enables deriving causal graphs spanning diverse IoT use cases. Furthermore, we showcase how CRAFTER improves self-adaptation performance by 25% compared to state-of-the-art Reinforcement Learning-based approaches.
papers.journal_ref: 21st International Conference on Software Engineering for Adaptive and Self-Managing Systems (SEAMS 2026), Apr 2026, Rio de Janeiro (BRAZIL), Brazil
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRAFTER 用因果强化学习 (Causal Reinforcement Learning) 自动为 IoT 系统生成因果图，刻画组件间依赖并据此指导自适应决策。实验显示其跨多个 IoT 用例都能导出因果图，自适应性能比现有基于强化学习的方法提升 25%。
Motivation: IoT 环境负载波动、需求演化使 QoS 难以维持；现有自适应技术多绑定特定应用域，难以跨 IoT 垂直行业复用，也缺少自动识别关键性能驱动因素的流水线。
Method: 以因果性作为 IoT 系统性能分析的形式化框架：先生成因果图 (causal graphs) 揭示系统组件间依赖，再让自适应 agent 基于因果关系在动态场景中做适应决策，构成设计与部署的自动化框架。
Result: 实验评估表明 CRAFTER 能在多样 IoT 用例上导出因果图；自适应性能相比 state-of-the-art 的强化学习方法提升 25%。
Conclusion: 把因果图作为性能分析的中间表示，可让自适应决策跨 IoT 垂直领域复用，并相对 RL 基线带来可量化的自适应性能增益。
