papers.title: Wiring Matters: Injection Topology and Initialization of Affordance Heads in Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Dense affordance supervision is an appealing auxiliary signal for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, yet naively co-training an affordance head can severely damage instruction following. We present a controlled study of how to wire such a head into a modern VLA on the LIBERO benchmark. Our recipe reads the backbone through a stop-gradient and re-injects an intermediate head feature into the action expert via a learned bridge. The stop-gradient is a precondition: letting affordance gradients reach the backbone drops the policy below the headless base (85.5% vs. 93.1%). With the backbone protected, a same-budget 2*2 ablation over injection topology (concatenation vs. residual) and bridge initialization (zero vs. random) shows initialization is the dominant lever. The best wiring, an actively initialized residual bridge, reaches 96.2%, matching the far more elaborate three-expert AffordanceVLA (95.8%) with under 1% extra parameters. Two probes explain the mechanism: ground-truth affordances fed as an input hurt, and inference-time zeroing shows a lazy bridge acts only as a training-time regularizer while an active bridge becomes load-bearing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LIBERO 上做受控消融表明：VLA 策略接 affordance head 时必须用 stop-gradient 挡住回传到 backbone 的梯度，否则策略掉到无 head 基线以下（85.5% vs 93.1%）。在保护好 backbone 后，注入拓扑与桥初始化的 2*2 同预算消融显示初始化是主导因素：主动初始化的 residual bridge 达到 96.2%，用不到 1% 额外参数追平三专家的 AffordanceVLA（95.8%）。
Motivation: 把稠密 affordance 监督作为辅助信号直接与 VLA 共训会严重损害指令跟随，而 head 该如何接入 backbone 与 action expert 缺少受控对照。
Method: 在 LIBERO benchmark 上做受控研究：backbone 经 stop-gradient 读出，中间 head feature 经一个可学习 bridge 重新注入 action expert；对注入拓扑（concatenation vs residual）与 bridge 初始化（zero vs random）做同预算 2*2 消融，并用两个探针（直接喂 ground-truth affordance、推理时置零 bridge）解释机制。
Result: 让 affordance 梯度到达 backbone 使策略降到 85.5%，低于无 head 基线 93.1%；主动初始化的 residual bridge 最佳配置达 96.2%，超过 AffordanceVLA 的 95.8% 而额外参数不到 1%。探针显示直接输入 ground-truth affordance 反而有害，推理时置零表明 lazy bridge 只起训练期正则作用、active bridge 才是承重结构。
Conclusion: stop-gradient 是把 affordance head 接入 VLA 的前置条件，而 bridge 的初始化比注入拓扑更决定成败；主动初始化的 residual bridge 以极小参数代价即可匹配更复杂的多专家方案。

papers.title: Watermarking: from Impossibility to Auditable Compliance
papers.abstract_en: Article 50 (2) of the EU Artificial Intelligence Act requires providers of generative systems to make synthetic outputs machine-readable and detectable, while qualifying the effectiveness, interoperability, robustness, and reliability by technical feasibility, cost, content-specific limits, and the state of the art. For free-form text, one important implementation route is the implementation of a generative watermarking procedure, which poses a compliance problem that is hard to address. Strong watermarking is impossible against adaptive removal, while ordinary edits attenuate statistical evidence, and unmarked human text may overlap distributionally with machine output. This article develops an auditable alternative. First, it defines a description-length robustness profile. A finite-sample bound shows that detectable bias decays and that the required sample size grows with the inverse square of the decay rate. This replaces an unidentified Shannon-entropy constant with collision entropy. Second, it constructs label-conditional conformal prediction sets with separate false-attribution and false-exclusion levels, reporting ``watermark supported,'' ``not supported,'' or ``inconclusive''. Coverage is obtained as a finite-sample result and is class-conditional under exchangeability. A small reproducible simulation of a tournament watermark confirms both claims and shows that the surviving-token rule overstates the tolerable edit rate roughly twofold. The resulting premarket certificate, signed detector report, and postmarket recalibration protocol operationalize the Commission's 2026 Code of Practice without claiming universal robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对欧盟 AI 法案第 50(2) 条对生成文本可检测性的合规要求，论文论证强水印在自适应移除下不可能，转而给出可审计替代方案：以描述长度定义鲁棒性轮廓，用碰撞熵替代未识别的 Shannon 熵常数，并用标签条件 conformal 预测集输出“watermark supported / not supported / inconclusive”三态判定。有限样本界表明可检测偏置随编辑衰减、所需样本量按衰减率的平方反比增长；小型可复现 tournament watermark 模拟同时验证这两条结论，并显示 surviving-token 规则把可容忍编辑率高估约两倍。
Motivation: 自由文本水印面临三重失效：自适应移除下强水印不可能、普通编辑削弱统计证据、未标记人类文本与机器输出分布重叠，导致合规检测难以给出可辩护的判定。
Method: 先以描述长度 (description length) 定义鲁棒性轮廓，并用碰撞熵 (collision entropy) 替代原先未识别的 Shannon 熵常数，导出可检测偏置衰减的有限样本界；再构造标签条件 conformal 预测集，分别控制 false-attribution 与 false-exclusion 水平，输出三态结论；最后用一个可复现的 tournament watermark 小型模拟检验两项理论主张。
Result: 有限样本界给出可检测偏置随编辑衰减、所需样本量随衰减率平方反比增长；coverage 作为有限样本结果在可交换性下成立且为类条件。tournament watermark 模拟同时确认这两条结论，并显示 surviving-token 规则把可容忍编辑率高估约两倍。
Conclusion: 水印合规应从追求普适鲁棒改为可审计的三态证据判定，配套预市场证书、签名检测报告与上市后再校准流程，明确不主张 universal robustness。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RollPlace: Improving Macro Placement via Monte Carlo Rollout Search
papers.abstract_en: The application of Reinforcement Learning (RL) in Electronic Design Automation (EDA), particularly for chip placement, has attracted considerable attention in recent years. While existing machine learning (ML)-based approaches have achieved notable progress, they predominantly focus on generating optimal layouts in a single attempt, often producing solutions that require subsequent refinement. To address this limitation, we propose RollPlace, a novel and generalized macro placement framework. RollPlace adopts a two-stage optimization strategy: generating initial placement solutions via machine learning methods or heuristic-based strategies, and refining these layouts efficiently by adjusting specific macros derived from the initial stage. This strategy circumvents the sequential generation constraints inherent in traditional RL-based placement methods. Furthermore, RollPlace seamlessly integrates Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to balance exploration and exploitation, and employs a rollout mechanism for efficient local search. Extensive experiments on the ISPD 2005 benchmark demonstrate that RollPlace outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Additionally, end-to-end experimental results based on OpenROAD across 19 benchmarks show that RollPlace excels in multiple metrics. The proposed framework offers a robust and scalable solution for addressing the growing complexity of modern chip design challenges.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems, vol. 45, no. 7, pp. 3155-3168, July 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RollPlace 把芯片宏单元布局 (macro placement) 拆成两阶段：先用 ML 或启发式生成初始布局，再用 MCTS 加 rollout 局部搜索调整特定宏单元来精修，绕开传统 RL 逐序生成的约束。在 ISPD 2005 benchmark 上超过 SOTA 方法，并在 OpenROAD 的 19 个 benchmark 端到端实验中多项指标领先。
Motivation: 现有 ML/RL 芯片布局方法基本只做一次性生成最优版图，产出常需后续人工或额外流程精修，且受逐序生成约束限制，难以应对现代芯片设计复杂度增长。
Method: 两阶段优化框架：第一阶段用机器学习方法或启发式策略生成初始布局；第二阶段针对初始解中的特定宏单元做调整精修。整合 Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) 平衡探索与利用，并用 rollout 机制做高效局部搜索。
Result: 在 ISPD 2005 benchmark 上超过 state-of-the-art 方法；基于 OpenROAD 的端到端实验覆盖 19 个 benchmark，在多个指标上表现突出。
Conclusion: 两阶段生成加 MCTS rollout 精修可作为应对现代芯片设计复杂度的稳健且可扩展的宏单元布局方案。

summary_sections.method: 两阶段优化框架：第一阶段用机器学习方法或启发式策略生成初始布局；第二阶段针对初始解中的特定宏单元做调整精修。整合 Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) 平衡探索与利用，并用 rollout 机制做高效局部搜索。
summary_sections.result: 在 ISPD 2005 benchmark 上超过 state-of-the-art 方法；基于 OpenROAD 的端到端实验覆盖 19 个 benchmark，在多个指标上表现突出。
summary_sections.conclusion: 两阶段生成加 MCTS rollout 精修可作为应对现代芯片设计复杂度的稳健且可扩展的宏单元布局方案。

papers.title: SPDAlign: Interpretable Riemannian Alignment for EEG Forward Modeling Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) based brain-computer interfaces enable direct brain-to-device communication for applications such as rehabilitation and communication. However, their practical utility is often limited as the non-stationary nature of the EEG data introduces distribution shifts across domains (e.g., sessions and subjects). Adapting machine learning models to be invariant to these shifts in an unsupervised way, without using costly labeled calibration data, would drastically improve the utility of EEG data. In this work, we use a classic generative model of EEG to study distribution shifts introduced by the domain-specific forward process, which is associated with factors such as head geometry. We theoretically show that such distribution shifts can be recovered solely through linear transformations on the Symmetric Positive Definite manifold. Building on this insight, we propose SPDAlign, an interpretable framework for promoting domain-invariant EEG learning. SPDAlign first aligns the domain-specific means and corrects global rotations across domains using a recent optimal transport technique called Wasserstein Procrustes. We systematically study the proposed approach through simulations and demonstrate its competitive performance on extensive public EEG datasets. Additionally, SPDAlign is a globally linear framework and is intrinsically interpretable, so that the framework can identify frequency ranges of interest, determine the spatial patterns reflecting source-sensor relationships, and address cross-subject variability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPDAlign 把 EEG 跨域分布偏移归因于域特定的 forward process（头型等），理论上证明这类偏移可仅由 SPD 流形上的线性变换恢复，并用 Wasserstein Procrustes 先对齐域均值、再校正全局旋转，实现无监督的域不变 EEG 学习。在仿真与大量公开 EEG 数据集上表现具竞争力，且全局线性可解释，能识别关注频段与反映源-传感器关系的空间模式。
Motivation: EEG 数据非平稳，跨 session、跨被试存在分布偏移，而依赖标注的校准数据成本高，模型难以无监督地做到域不变。
Method: 用 EEG 经典生成模型刻画域特定 forward process 引入的偏移，理论上证明其等价于 SPD 流形上的线性变换；SPDAlign 先用 Wasserstein Procrustes 对齐各域均值并校正全局旋转，再做域不变学习，通过仿真系统研究该方法。
Result: 在仿真与大量公开 EEG 数据集上展示具竞争力的表现；框架为全局线性、内在可解释，可识别关注频段、确定反映源-传感器关系的空间模式，并处理跨被试变异性。
Conclusion: 域特定 forward process 造成的 EEG 分布偏移可由 SPD 流形上的线性变换吸收，因此无监督的全局线性对齐足以促进域不变 EEG 学习并保留可解释性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Sharp dimensional analysis of midpoint methods for Langevin sampling
papers.abstract_en: We study deterministic and randomized midpoint discretizations of Langevin dynamics for a target $π\propto e^{-V}$, where $0 \prec αI\preceq\nabla^2V\preceqβI$ and $κ=β/α$. To achieve $\sqrtα\,W_2\leqslant\varepsilon$, we show that deterministic Heun uses at most $\widetilde O(κ^{4/3}d^{1/3}\varepsilon^{-2/3})$ gradient queries, and underdamped exponential midpoint uses $\widetilde O(κ^{5/4}d^{1/4}\varepsilon^{-1/2})$. The proofs exploit cancellation at stationarity and smoothing using techniques from Malliavin calculus, outperforming previous upper bounds based on standard couplings. At bounded condition number, a lower bound matches the $d$ and $\varepsilon$ powers of both deterministic methods. To contrast, for the randomized midpoint methods and Poisson midpoint with at least two grid points (both overdamped and underdamped variants), a simple Gaussian calculation yields a lower bound $d^{1/3}\varepsilon^{-1/3}$ to get an $\varepsilon$-close sample despite starting at a benign initialization. This shows surprisingly that in high dimensions, deterministic discretizations can outperform their random counterparts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对强凸目标 π∝e^{-V}（条件数 κ=β/α）的 Langevin 中点离散化做尖锐复杂度分析：确定性 Heun 至多需 Õ(κ^{4/3}d^{1/3}ε^{-2/3}) 次梯度查询达到 √α·W₂≤ε，欠阻尼指数中点为 Õ(κ^{5/4}d^{1/4}ε^{-1/2})。在有界条件数下下界与两者的 d、ε 幂次匹配；而随机化中点与 Poisson 中点（至少两个网格点，过阻尼与欠阻尼变体）存在 d^{1/3}ε^{-1/3} 的下界，说明高维下确定性离散可优于随机对应方法。
Motivation: Langevin 采样的中点类离散化此前的上界基于标准耦合，随维度 d 与精度 ε 的依赖不够尖锐，且随机化是否在高维更优缺少下界刻画。
Method: 在 αI≼∇²V≼βI 的强凸假设下分析确定性 Heun、欠阻尼指数中点、随机化中点与 Poisson 中点；证明利用稳态处的相消 (cancellation at stationarity) 与 Malliavin 计算的光滑化技术，随机方法的下界则由简单高斯计算给出，即使从良性初始化出发。
Result: 达到 √α·W₂≤ε 的梯度查询上界：确定性 Heun Õ(κ^{4/3}d^{1/3}ε^{-2/3})，欠阻尼指数中点 Õ(κ^{5/4}d^{1/4}ε^{-1/2})；有界条件数下下界匹配这两个确定性方法的 d 与 ε 幂次。随机化中点与至少两个网格点的 Poisson 中点（含过阻尼与欠阻尼变体）下界为 d^{1/3}ε^{-1/3}。
Conclusion: 新上界在 d 与 ε 依赖上优于以往基于标准耦合的界；高维时确定性中点离散化可胜过随机化版本，随机化并非高维采样的必然加速手段。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Teaching a Minimalist Machine to Discover Recursive Programs for Arithmetic
papers.abstract_en: Humans can often acquire and synthesize complex, recursive concepts from minimal experience. Leveraging cognitive insights, we propose the Minimalist Machine, a framework for inductive program synthesis designed to model such conceptual learning. The system uses a compact relational subset of Prolog: Programs are searched within a fixed schema of body-free facts and two-body conjunctive Horn clauses. Recursion is not defined by a dedicated metarule. Instead, it emerges when a target predicate is reused inside the body of a learned clause. Inspired by a primary school curriculum, the model is taught through a human-curated, sequential introduction of new concepts in arithmetic. Starting from initially empty knowledge base, it first acquires simple structural predicates, then successor-based state transformations, and finally recursive programs for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Ultimately, this approach yields the fully transparent, inductive reasoning trace necessary for human-like conceptual learning.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for oral presentation at the 6th International Joint Conference on Learning and Reasoning 2026. Code: https://github.com/cognitive-modeling/minimalist-machine/tree/IJCLR-2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Minimalist Machine：在固定 schema（body-free facts 与 two-body 合取 Horn clauses）内做归纳程序合成，递归不靠专门 metarule，而靠目标谓词在子句体中被复用而涌现。系统从空知识库出发，按小学课程顺序先学结构谓词、再学 successor 状态变换，最终合成加减乘除的递归 Prolog 程序，给出完全透明的归纳推理轨迹。
Motivation: 人类能从极少经验中习得递归概念，而现有程序合成系统缺少这种从简单结构谓词逐步长出递归程序的课程式概念学习机制。
Method: 在 Prolog 的精简关系子集内搜索程序，搜索空间限定为固定 schema 的 body-free facts 与 two-body 合取 Horn clauses；递归通过在子句体中复用目标谓词产生，而非专用 metarule；教学采用人工编排的算术概念序列，从空知识库逐步引入结构谓词、successor 状态变换，再到加减乘除的递归程序。
Result: 系统从空知识库出发，依次习得结构谓词与 successor 状态变换，最终合成 addition、subtraction、multiplication、division 的递归程序，并产出可读的归纳推理轨迹。
Conclusion: 递归程序可以在无 metarule 的受限 Horn 子句空间中通过谓词复用涌现，配合课程式概念引入即可从零学出算术递归程序且过程完全透明。

papers.title: DialectSentEval 2026: Arabic Dialect Sentiment Analysis and Swapping Shared Task
papers.abstract_en: Sentiment analysis is a fundamental problem in Natural Language Processing (NLP). Standard sentiment classification for the Arabic language remains challenging due to the high volume of dialectal Arabic. To advance research in this area, this paper proposes the Shared Task on Sentiment Analysis and Swapping in Arabic Dialects (DialectSentEval), hosted with the Arabic Natural Language Processing Conference (ArabicNLP 2026). This shared task consists of two subtasks: Subtask 1 focuses on multi-class and multi-dialect sentiment analysis, requiring models to identify sentiment polarity across various Arabic dialects. Subtask 2 introduces a generative task for Arabic sentiment swap, challenging models to invert sentiment polarity while preserving core semantics. In this overview paper, we present the motivation, dataset creation, and summarize the main findings from participating models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DialectSentEval 2026 是 ArabicNLP 2026 上的阿拉伯语方言情感共享任务，含两个子任务：Subtask 1 在多方言上做多分类情感极性判定，Subtask 2 要求生成式地反转情感极性同时保留核心语义。论文作为 overview 给出动机、数据集构建，并汇总参赛模型的主要发现。
Motivation: 阿拉伯语方言体量大，标准情感分类在方言变体上仍然困难，需要共享任务与统一数据集来推动该方向的可比研究。
Method: 设计两个子任务：Subtask 1 为多分类、多方言情感分析（识别各方言的情感极性）；Subtask 2 为生成式情感交换（sentiment swap），要求在反转极性的同时保持核心语义；配套创建数据集并汇总参赛模型结果。
Result: 论文报告了数据集创建过程与参赛模型的主要发现汇总；摘要中未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 共享任务把方言情感分类与情感反转生成两个方向放到统一数据与评测上，为阿拉伯语方言情感研究提供可比较的基准。

papers.title: Reconstruction-Aware Distribution Matching for Inverse Problems with Unpaired Data
papers.abstract_en: Recovering the forward operator of an imaging system from unpaired data avoids both calibration hardware and the clean/degraded pairs that supervision requires-pairs that, for a real lens, are often impossible to acquire. Existing unpaired approaches that explicitly estimate the forward operator by distribution matching evaluate a candidate only through the measurements it generates, whose distribution should match that of the real ones. Components suppressed by the operator are barely present in the degraded images, and therefore barely constrain the operator under such a criterion. Yet inversion precisely tries to recover them. As a result, two operators that are nearly indistinguishable as forward models can invert very differently. We address this by adding a comparison on the clean side: real degraded images, once restored, should be distributed like clean ones. Restorations are computed by a differentiable plug-and-play algorithm parameterized by the operator being learned. On spatially varying PSF calibration and blind super-resolution, the method recovers more accurate operators than degraded-side matching alone, and closes much of the gap to restoration with the true operator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在非成对数据上估计成像系统前向算子时，只用退化侧分布匹配会漏掉被算子压制的成分，导致两个几乎等价的前向算子反演结果差异很大。加入清洁侧约束——真实退化图经可微 plug-and-play 反演后的分布应与干净图一致——在空间变化 PSF 标定与盲超分辨上恢复出更准确的算子，并大幅缩小与使用真实算子做恢复之间的差距。
Motivation: 真实镜头往往无法采集干净/退化图像对，也缺少标定硬件；而仅按生成测量分布匹配来评估候选算子时，被算子压制的成分在退化图中几乎不存在，对算子几乎不构成约束，但反演恰恰要恢复这些成分。
Method: 在退化侧分布匹配之外增加清洁侧比较：用以待估算子为参数的可微 plug-and-play 算法对真实退化图做恢复，要求恢复结果的分布匹配干净图分布，从而联合约束前向算子。
Result: 在空间变化 PSF 标定与盲超分辨两个任务上，该方法比仅做退化侧匹配恢复出更准确的算子，并大幅缩小了与使用真实算子进行恢复的差距。
Conclusion: 反演任务下评估前向算子必须同时看清洁侧：只靠测量分布匹配不足以约束被算子压制的成分，加上可微反演闭环的清洁侧分布比较即可补上这一缺口。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: VepAgent: Bridging Causal-Transition via Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Video Event Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential in video understanding, yet their reliance on retrospective summarization and text-centric priors often limits their ability to bridge unobserved causal transitions when applied to Video Event Prediction (VEP). To address this, we propose VepAgent, an agentic framework that integrates causal-transition reasoning with tool-augmented reinforcement learning (RL) for robust VEP. Unlike prior methods that passively project future trajectories from historical dependencies, our approach explicitly models the logical progression from terminal observed states to future events. Specifically, we first construct futurebench-4K, a high-quality chain-of-thought dataset for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) that effectively bridges the causal-logic gap by structuring the deduction of unobserved intermediate states. Subsequently, we develop a diagnostic tool library integrating state tracking, frame retrieval, and region magnification, enabling the agent to dynamically augment reasoning with external tools to recover missing spatio-temporal evidence and resolve visual ambiguities during inference. Moreover, we propose a composite reward mechanism that jointly optimizes prediction accuracy, causal coherence, and reliable prior, compelling the agent to rely on genuine visual grounding rather than superficial textual similarities. Extensive evaluations on FutureBench and NEPBench datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming larger MLLMs and validating the empirical effectiveness of our agentic, future-oriented reasoning paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VepAgent 把视频事件预测 (VEP) 从回顾式摘要改成从终端观测状态出发的因果过渡推理：先用 SFT 在 futurebench-4K 上学结构化演绎，再用工具增强 RL 让 agent 调用状态跟踪、帧检索、区域放大来补回缺失的时空证据。复合奖励同时优化预测准确率、因果连贯性与可靠先验，迫使模型依赖真实视觉 grounding 而非文本表面相似，在 FutureBench 与 NEPBench 上取得 SOTA 并显著超过更大的 MLLM。
Motivation: MLLM 做视频理解依赖回顾式摘要与文本中心先验，遇到未观测的因果过渡就断链，无法从历史依赖被动外推未来轨迹。
Method: 三段式：构建 chain-of-thought 数据集 futurebench-4K 用于 SFT，结构化演绎未观测中间状态；开发含 state tracking、frame retrieval、region magnification 的诊断工具库，推理时动态补证据；提出复合奖励联合优化 prediction accuracy、causal coherence 与 reliable prior。
Result: 在 FutureBench 与 NEPBench 数据集上达到 state-of-the-art，显著超越更大的 MLLM；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 面向未来的 agentic 因果推理范式配合工具调用与视觉 grounding 奖励，是视频事件预测的有效路径，且不依赖更大模型规模。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: GAMBIT: Learning to Plan Continuous Multi-Robot Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: GAMBIT is an opening chess move in which a player sacrifices a piece, typically a pawn, to gain a positional advantage later in the game. Analogously, in multi-robot coordination, individual robots may need to forgo locally reward-maximising behaviours to improve overall team performance. Such self-sacrificial behaviours are difficult to capture with manually designed heuristics, particularly in dense, interaction-rich environments. Focusing on double-integrator continuous dynamics, this work studies how to learn such coordinated heuristics over motion primitives for multi-robot trajectory execution. Our framework, GAMBIT, first learns coordinated motion-primitive selection through imitation learning and subsequently fine-tunes the policy through reinforcement learning. We further introduce a safeguarded rollout mechanism with backup trajectories that guarantees collision-free execution at all times. Experiments demonstrate that GAMBIT substantially outperforms a range of baselines, including centralised motion planners and decentralised reactive planners, while exhibiting strong scalability. In particular, it coordinates over a thousand robots with planning latency below a few hundred milliseconds in continuous domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GAMBIT 在双积分器连续动力学下学习多机器人运动基元 (motion primitive) 的协调选择：先用模仿学习学策略，再用强化学习微调，并加入带备份轨迹的 safeguarded rollout，保证执行全程无碰撞。实验中它在密集交互场景下大幅超过集中式运动规划器与分布式反应式规划器，可协调一千台以上机器人，连续域规划延迟低于几百毫秒。
Motivation: 密集、强交互环境中，单个机器人常需放弃局部最优行为换取团队收益，这类自牺牲式协调难以用手工启发式刻画。
Method: 在双积分器连续动力学上，先通过模仿学习 (imitation learning) 学习协调的运动基元选择，再用强化学习 (reinforcement learning) 微调策略；另引入带备份轨迹的 safeguarded rollout 机制以保证无碰撞执行。
Result: 实验中 GAMBIT 大幅优于一系列基线，包括集中式运动规划器与分布式反应式规划器，并表现出强可扩展性：在连续域协调一千台以上机器人，规划延迟低于几百毫秒。
Conclusion: 在密集多机器人场景中，模仿学习加强化学习微调的运动基元协调策略配合带备份轨迹的安全回滚，可同时实现无碰撞执行、优于规划器基线的团队表现与千级机器人规模的低延迟规划。

papers.title: Trajectory-Guided Tokenization of Complex CSI for Wi-Fi Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Wi-Fi channel state information (CSI) enables contactless presence detection and gesture recognition. Its high-dimensional complex-valued time series require input representations that preserve informative temporal variations during compression. We propose Trajectory-Guided Tokenization (TGT), which combines complex trajectory decomposition with asymmetric attention to construct compact continuous tokens. For each antenna link and subcarrier, an orthonormal Helmert transform decomposes short, ordered temporal patches into local-center and centered-trajectory coordinates. Keys are learned from the centered-trajectory coordinates, while values retain both components. Learnable queries aggregate subcarriers into frequency slots, which are fused into temporal tokens. Trained jointly from scratch, TGT with TokenMLP achieves the highest mean accuracy of 92.83% among all evaluated frontend-backend combinations on the self-collected dataset. Experiments on EHUNAM and Widar further support the applicability of TGT to cross-domain presence detection and gesture recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Trajectory-Guided Tokenization (TGT)：用正交 Helmert 变换把每条天线链路、每个子载波的短时序 patch 分解为 local-center 与 centered-trajectory 两组坐标，再配合非对称注意力压成紧凑连续 token。与 TokenMLP 后端联合从头训练后，在自采数据集上以 92.83% 的平均准确率居全部前端-后端组合之首，并在 EHUNAM 与 Widar 上支持跨域存在检测与手势识别。
Motivation: Wi-Fi CSI 是高维复值时间序列，压缩时容易丢掉有信息量的时序变化，需要能保留局部中心与轨迹结构的输入表示。
Method: TGT 对每条天线链路与子载波的短时有序 patch 做正交 Helmert 变换，分解为 local-center 与 centered-trajectory 坐标；key 由 centered-trajectory 学得，value 同时保留两个分量；可学习 query 先聚合子载波成 frequency slot，再融合为 temporal token，与 TokenMLP 后端从头联合训练。
Result: TGT + TokenMLP 在自采数据集上取得 92.83% 的平均准确率，为所有被评估的前端-后端组合中最高；EHUNAM 与 Widar 上的实验进一步支持其在跨域存在检测与手势识别上的适用性。
Conclusion: 把复 CSI 先做轨迹分解再做非对称注意力 token 化，能在压缩中保住时序信息，并在自采与跨域数据上支撑存在检测和手势识别。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: From Abusive Language Classification to Sequence Labeling Identification
papers.abstract_en: Industrial content moderation must process massive message streams under tight latency constraints, yet most abusive language (AL) detection systems rely on sentence-level classification (ALC), which neither localizes abusive spans nor identifies who is targeted. We define Abusive Language Identification (ALI) as a sequence-labeling task that jointly extracts AL spans and target mentions, and assess whether this approach can be used for text moderation. On a pilot corpus drawn from a production moderation pipeline, we compare ALI with ALC on cross-domain generalization and implicit abuse, and we also evaluate AL and target span detection. ALI remains competitive with ALC while providing localized outputs for moderators, with a modest and configuration-sensitive advantage on implicit abuse. Exact AL boundaries and target spans remain difficult to recover. We complement this comparison with a qualitative analysis and discuss perspectives on complete target--span linking and on structured benchmarks for ALI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把辱骂性语言检测从句子级分类 (ALC) 改造成序列标注任务 Abusive Language Identification (ALI)，联合抽取辱骂片段与被指向对象提及，用于工业内容审核。在来自生产审核流水线的试点语料上，ALI 在跨域泛化与隐性辱骂上与 ALC 保持竞争力，隐性辱骂上有温和且对配置敏感的优势，但精确的辱骂边界与目标片段仍难恢复。
Motivation: 工业内容审核要处理海量消息流且延迟受限，而现有辱骂检测多为句子级分类，既不能定位辱骂片段，也识别不出被指向的对象。
Method: 定义 ALI 为序列标注任务，联合抽取 AL 片段与目标提及；在取自生产审核流水线的试点语料上，将 ALI 与 ALC 在跨域泛化、隐性辱骂以及 AL/目标片段检测上对比，并辅以定性分析。
Result: ALI 在跨域泛化与隐性辱骂上与 ALC 保持竞争力，并为审核员提供局部化输出，在隐性辱骂上有温和且对配置敏感的优势；精确 AL 边界与目标片段仍难以恢复。
Conclusion: 序列标注式 ALI 可用于文本审核并给出可定位输出，但边界与目标片段的精确恢复仍是主要瓶颈，作者将目标-片段链接与结构化 ALI 基准列为后续方向。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: When Are Concept Bottleneck Model Explanations Faithful and Compact?
papers.abstract_en: Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) are neural classifiers that allow to explain their decisions via high-level concepts, potentially enabling understanding, steering and debugging. However, their explanations are often derived heuristically. Building on formal explainability, we argue they should also be faithful, i.e., not misreport which concepts actually matter. We show that, for widespread CBM architectures, including recent VLM-based variants, faithful explanations must include all concepts in the bottleneck, compromising interpretability when this is large. This result applies to both heuristic and faithful-by-construction formal explanations. To encourage the existence of compact faithful explanations, we suggest i) modeling concepts probabilistically as binary or categorical random variables (rather than logits), and ii) employing per-concept training-time sparsification via group lasso (rather than regular elastic net). We also extend algorithms from formal explainability to CBMs, and show they outperform natural heuristics in terms of guarantees and explanation size. Overall, our work warns against naive interpretability claims and provides formal conditions and practical strategies for ensuring CBMs are as interpretable as advertised.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在常见 CBM 架构（含 VLM 变体）上，忠实解释必须包含瓶颈中的全部概念，因而瓶颈一大解释就失去紧凑性；作者建议把概念建模为二值/分类随机变量并用 group lasso 做逐概念训练期稀疏化，才能让紧凑且忠实的解释存在。
Motivation: CBM 的解释多为启发式导出，可能误报真正起作用的概念；形式可解释性要求忠实性，但现有架构下忠实解释被迫覆盖全部概念，可读性随之崩塌。
Method: 基于形式可解释性 (formal explainability) 分析广泛使用的 CBM 架构（含基于 VLM 的变体），区分启发式与 faithful-by-construction 两类解释；将概念表示为二值或分类随机变量而非 logits，并用 group lasso 替代常规 elastic net 做逐概念训练期稀疏化，同时把形式可解释性算法扩展到 CBM。
Result: 证明对广泛 CBM 架构忠实解释必须包含瓶颈中所有概念，该结论同时适用于启发式解释与 faithful-by-construction 解释；扩展后的形式可解释性算法在保证性 (guarantees) 与解释规模 (explanation size) 上优于自然启发式方法。
Conclusion: 朴素的可解释性宣称站不住脚：要让 CBM 如宣传般可解释，需同时给出忠实性的形式条件，并采用概率化概念与 group lasso 稀疏化这类具体训练策略。

papers.title: dIon: Fragmentation-Based Invariance for Self-Supervised Learning of Tandem Mass Spectra
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a novel invariance for peptide tandem mass spectrometry data, unlocking self-supervised representation learning that improves de novo sequencing of peptides. This invariance exploits the physical relationship between precursor properties (mass and charge) and fragment-ion evidence, without requiring peptide sequence labels. We introduce dIon, which adapts the DINO framework with two latent prediction tasks, both recovering a clean teacher representation: one from a spectrum mixture, using the precursor as a selection query, and one from a partial spectrum with the precursor withheld. The first associates precursor information with fragment-ion evidence; the second prevents representational collapse onto that information alone. Mechanistic probes support both effects, and ablations show that the full objective performs best. Under identical end-to-end training, dIon initialization improves de novo peptide precision over training from scratch by 5.5 and 8.4 percentage points on the held-out MassIVE-KB and Kingdoms test sets, and by 2.3 and 4.8 percentage points with a larger supervised training corpus. The resulting models surpass fully supervised state-of-the-art de novo sequencing models on the diverse, multi-species Kingdoms corpus under the same greedy-decoding protocol. Without peptide labels, dIon learns strong native peptide-similarity geometry compared with other learned models; with limited peptide-supervised adaptation, it achieves the best retrieval and pair-discrimination performance across all representation benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Future Anchored Verification and Online Recovery for World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation. They act by first predicting how a task should be performed and then decoding the actions from that future. However, the remaining actions are invalid once execution drifts from the prediction. Simply replanning from the already out of distribution state rarely restores what the task still requires; existing execution monitors decide when to stop, but not what to restore. We observe that the answer is already in hand: the future the WAM predicted before acting depicts exactly the states it intended to pass through. We introduce FAVOR (Future Anchored Verification and Online Recovery), a lightweight framework that keeps these predicted frames as anchors and uses them for verification and recovery. An Anchor Verifier compares each observation with its anchor, together with the executed actions, to flag deviations that break the task. Anchor-Guided Recovery uses a vision-language model to turn the flagged anchor into a short corrective instruction. Under strengthened instruction guidance, the WAM executes this instruction to return to the intended future. It then resumes the task. FAVOR raises the task success of the base WAM from 97.85% to 98.10% on LIBERO and from 72.60% to 72.98% on LIBERO-Plus without modifying the policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FAVOR 把 world action model (WAM) 自己预测的未来帧当作锚点，用 Anchor Verifier 对比当前观测、锚点与已执行动作来判定偏离，再由视觉语言模型把被标记的锚点转成简短纠偏指令，让 WAM 在强化指令引导下回到预期未来并续做任务。不改动策略本身，LIBERO 任务成功率从 97.85% 升到 98.10%，LIBERO-Plus 从 72.60% 升到 72.98%。
Motivation: 机器人操作中执行一旦偏离 WAM 的预测，剩余动作即失效；从已出分布状态重新规划很少能恢复任务所需，而现有执行监控只决定何时停止、不决定恢复什么。
Method: FAVOR 保留 WAM 预测帧作为锚点：Anchor Verifier 将每帧观测与对应锚点及已执行动作比对，标记破坏任务的偏离；Anchor-Guided Recovery 用视觉语言模型把被标记锚点转为简短纠偏指令，在强化指令引导下由 WAM 执行该指令回到预期未来，再恢复原任务。
Result: 在不修改策略的条件下，LIBERO 任务成功率 97.85% → 98.10%，LIBERO-Plus 72.60% → 72.98%。
Conclusion: WAM 先前预测的未来本身即可作为验证与恢复的依据，轻量的锚点校验加指令引导纠偏就能在不改策略的情况下小幅提升成功率。

papers.title: What May an Agent Change About Itself? A Containment Floor for Self-Configuring Agent Runtimes
papers.abstract_en: Many agent runtimes give the agent a tool for editing its own configuration. Some of that configuration grants abilities, such as enabling a tool. Other parts set the agent's limits: which directories it may write to, who may send it messages, which network address it listens on, how callers authenticate, and the gate that blocks risky writes. If the agent can edit those limits, a single ordinary request can widen them. We study this in a deployed, model-agnostic runtime. We propose a rule: the agent may change fields that grant abilities, and may never change fields that set its limits. We enforce the rule as a containment floor inside the configuration tool and measure what happens with and without it. Without the floor, a frontier model wrote a protected value on 25 of 72 ordinary requests that gave it permission to change settings, often when the request never named the field. Prohibitions written in the system prompt failed in a predictable way. A prompt that listed the protected field names stopped every request that used those names (0 of 36 saved, against 17 of 36 with no prompt) and did not stop the requests that only described the goal (10 of 36 saved, against 8 of 36). A prompt that described the forbidden effects did the reverse. With the floor, 0 of 167 protected writes were saved, although the models attempted a protected write in 65 of those cases. A search for other routes through the tool found only one, a pinned shell, which the floor's scope statement already excludes. The study covers two models and a single agent. We state what that does and does not support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在可自我配置的 agent 运行时中，把配置字段分为「授予能力」与「设定边界」两类，并在配置工具内强制边界字段不可被 agent 修改（containment floor）。无该护栏时前沿模型在 72 次普通请求中有 25 次写入受保护值；有护栏时 167 次受保护写入全部被拦截（0 次保存），尽管模型在其中 65 次尝试写入。
Motivation: 许多 agent 运行时允许 agent 编辑自身配置，其中写入目录、消息来源、监听地址、鉴权方式与高风险写入门控等字段直接决定 agent 的权限边界；仅靠 system prompt 中的禁令可被普通请求绕过，一次常规请求即可放宽限制。
Method: 在部署的、模型无关的运行时中提出规则：agent 可改授予能力的字段，永不可改设定边界的字段；将该规则作为 containment floor 实现在配置工具内部，并对比有/无护栏的行为。同时测试两类 system prompt 禁令（列出受保护字段名、描述禁止的效果），并搜索工具内的其他绕过路径。
Result: 无护栏时，前沿模型在 72 次获准修改设置的普通请求中有 25 次写入受保护值，且常发生在请求未点名该字段时。列出字段名的 prompt：36 次点名请求中 0 次保存（无 prompt 为 17/36），但仅描述目标的请求只拦下 10/36（无 prompt 为 8/36）；描述禁止效果的 prompt 结果相反。有 floor 时 167 次受保护写入 0 次保存，其中 65 次模型尝试写入；工具内仅找到一条绕过路径（pinned shell），已被 floor 的 scope 声明排除。
Conclusion: 把边界字段的不可修改性放进工具内部而非 prompt，可在所测两个模型与单个 agent 上彻底阻断受保护写入；prompt 禁令的失效方式可预测且按写法互补。作者明确说明该研究覆盖两个模型和单个 agent，并陈述了这支持与不支持的结论范围。

papers.title: VLA-ZO: Fast Zeroth-Order Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Adapting vision-language-action (VLA) models to deployment-time distribution shifts is important for reliable robotic operation, but conventional first-order adaptation can exceed the memory budget of inference-oriented deployment platforms. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization offers a forward-only alternative with inference-level memory, but accurate gradient estimation requires many perturbation queries, making naive ZO prohibitively slow for large VLA models. We present VLA-ZO, a framework for fast ZO adaptation that exploits the structure of VLA computation. By confining adaptation to the action side, VLA-ZO keeps the expensive vision-language prefix frozen and reuses its conditioning states across perturbation queries and optimizer steps, while schedule-aware prefetching hides state-transfer overhead. On LIBERO camera-viewpoint shifts, VLA-ZO reduces end-to-end adaptation time by 25.59$\times$ at $q=16$ and 32.54$\times$ at $q=64$ relative to baseline ZO, while improving average task success from 48.27% without adaptation to 58.17% and 63.58%, respectively. These results show that making ZO faster can make larger query budgets practical, providing a promising path toward resource-efficient VLA adaptation on deployment platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA-ZO 把视觉语言前缀冻结、只在 action 侧做零阶 (ZO) 适应，并跨扰动查询与优化步复用前缀 conditioning 状态，配合 schedule-aware prefetching 隐藏状态传输开销。在 LIBERO 相机视角偏移上，相对基线 ZO 端到端适应时间在 q=16 时降 25.59×、q=64 时降 32.54×，平均任务成功率从无适应的 48.27% 提到 58.17% 与 63.58%。
Motivation: VLA 模型在部署期分布偏移下需要适应，但一阶方法的显存超出推理型部署平台预算；朴素 ZO 又因梯度估计需要大量扰动查询而过慢，大模型上不可用。
Method: VLA-ZO 只在 action 侧做 ZO 适应，冻结昂贵的 vision-language 前缀，并在扰动查询与优化步之间复用其 conditioning 状态；再用 schedule-aware prefetching 隐藏状态传输开销，查询预算 q 可调。
Result: 在 LIBERO camera-viewpoint shifts 上，相对 baseline ZO 的端到端适应时间在 q=16 时减少 25.59×、q=64 时减少 32.54×；平均任务成功率从无适应的 48.27% 提升到 q=16 的 58.17% 与 q=64 的 63.58%。
Conclusion: 让 ZO 足够快就能让更大的查询预算变得实用，从而在部署平台上做资源高效的 VLA 适应。

papers.title: DPNL: A DPLL-based Algorithm for Probabilistic Neurosymbolic Learning
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic Neurosymbolic Learning (PNL) combines neural predictions with symbolic reasoning, enabling end-to-end learning from final-output supervision without labels for intermediate concepts. A central challenge is probabilistic inference: state-of-the-art approaches often rely on materializing the logical provenance of a query, which can itself become a major computational bottleneck. We introduce Dynamic Probabilistic Neurosymbolic Learning (DPNL), an oracle-guided framework that avoids requiring complete provenance materialization before inference. DPNL lazily explores the space of intermediate assignments, while oracles resolve entire regions that can already be certified to produce or exclude the target output. We establish conditions ensuring soundness and termination. ApproxDPNL extends the same search with early termination while maintaining certified bounds on the exact output probability, providing controlled approximation guarantees. The oracle interface decouples inference from the representation of the symbolic component, enabling problem-specific reasoning within the same framework. Experiments on several neurosymbolic tasks show that DPNL and ApproxDPNL substantially extend the range of problem instances tractable by probabilistic neurosymbolic inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DPNL 用 oracle 引导的惰性搜索替代先物化完整逻辑 provenance 再做概率推理的流程，只在需要时展开中间赋值，oracle 直接认证或排除整片区域；ApproxDPNL 在同一搜索上加提前终止并保持对精确输出概率的认证界。作者给出可靠性与终止性条件，实验显示该框架显著扩大了概率神经符号推理可解的问题实例范围。
Motivation: 概率神经符号学习 (PNL) 的核心瓶颈是概率推理：现有方法往往要先物化查询的完整逻辑 provenance，这本身会成为主要计算开销，限制了可解实例的规模。
Method: DPNL 是 oracle 引导框架：惰性探索中间赋值空间，oracle 对已可认证产生或排除目标输出的整片区域一次性裁剪，无需先完成 provenance 物化；论文给出保证可靠性 (soundness) 与终止性的条件。ApproxDPNL 在同一搜索上加入提前终止，同时维持对精确输出概率的认证界 (certified bounds)；oracle 接口把推理与符号组件的表示解耦，可在同一框架内做问题特定推理。
Result: 在若干神经符号任务上的实验显示，DPNL 与 ApproxDPNL 显著扩大了概率神经符号推理可解的问题实例范围；ApproxDPNL 提供带认证界的可控近似。
Conclusion: 把概率推理从 provenance 物化中解耦、用 oracle 惰性裁剪赋值空间，是扩大 PNL 可解实例范围的有效路径，且近似版本可保留概率的认证界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evolving in Thought Space: Training a Small Model at Test Time Unlocks Better Discoveries
papers.abstract_en: Open-ended scientific discovery often requires repeatedly proposing and evaluating candidate solutions. LLM-based systems can support this process by generating and refining executable solutions from verifier feedback. Methods such as TTT-Discover use test-time training (TTT) to update the solution-generating LLM from verifier feedback, adapting its generation policy to improve subsequent proposals on the target problem. However, this becomes expensive when reliable execution requires a large model, since training must maintain gradients, optimizer states, and policy statistics while repeatedly generating long, structured outputs. It also complicates credit assignment: outcome-level verifier feedback must jointly evaluate the high-level strategy and its low-level implementation. In this work, we introduce Guidance-TTT, which separates these roles. A compact guidance model is trained at test time to propose high-level strategic changes, while a frozen execution model implements them as complete executable solutions. At each step, the system selects a promising previously discovered solution, proposes a change, executes and verifies it, and updates only the guidance model using an adaptive group-relative RL objective. This concentrates test-time learning on short strategic decisions while retaining the implementation capability of a substantially stronger model without adapting it. Without web access, Guidance-TTT produces strong solutions across four distinct domains: combinatorial optimization (Polyomino Packing), heuristic programming (AHC058), machine learning (Lasso), and GPU kernel optimization (TriMul). Across these tasks, it outperforms the best solutions reported in prior work while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art results on public online leaderboards. Code is available at https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/tree/guidance-ttt-support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Guidance-TTT 把测试时训练 (TTT) 的角色拆开：只用一个紧凑 guidance model 在测试时从验证器反馈中学习提出高层策略改动，冻结的大 execution model 负责把改动实现为可执行解。在无网络访问下，它在 Polyomino Packing、AHC058、Lasso、TriMul 四个领域产出强解，超过先前工作报告的最优解，并在公开在线榜单上保持竞争力。
Motivation: TTT-Discover 这类方法要在测试时反复训练生成解的 LLM，可靠执行又往往需要大模型，于是必须持续维护梯度、优化器状态与策略统计，成本高；同时 outcome 级验证器反馈要同时评价高层策略与底层实现，credit assignment 困难。
Method: 每一步先从已发现解中选一个有希望的候选，由紧凑 guidance model 提出高层策略改动，冻结的 execution model 将其执行为完整可执行解并交验证器评估，再用 adaptive group-relative RL 目标只更新 guidance model，把测试时学习集中在短的战略决策上。
Result: 在无网络访问条件下覆盖四个不同领域：组合优化 Polyomino Packing、启发式编程 AHC058、机器学习 Lasso、GPU kernel 优化 TriMul；在这些任务上超过先前工作报告的最优解，并在公开在线榜单上与最先进结果保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 把测试时学习限制在短的战略决策、由强模型冻结执行，可以在不适应大模型的情况下获得更好的发现结果；代码已在 GitHub 的 reef 仓库 guidance-ttt-support 分支开放。

papers.title: Ramp Metering Control via Hybrid State Deep Reinforcement Learning in Partially Observable Connected Vehicle Environments
papers.abstract_en: Freeway on-ramp merges are major sources of congestion, causing significant economic and environmental costs. While Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) offers a promising solution for ramp metering, existing approaches rely primarily on aggregated macroscopic data. Connected vehicles (CVs) provide vehicle-level observations that can complement aggregate traffic measurements, but their limited penetration produces incomplete microscopic information. This paper proposes a hybrid observation representation combining macroscopic traffic measurements with a two-channel grid encoding observed CV presence and speed. A Dueling Double Deep Q-Network processes these inputs to select ramp-metering green durations. The controller is trained under varying traffic demands and CV penetration rates and evaluated against ALINEA and macroscopic-only DRL variants in SUMO. Across 50 matched evaluation scenarios, the hybrid controller under partial CV visibility reduces the reported total travel time by 11.4 % and mean spillback duration by 84.9 % relative to ALINEA. Evaluating the same trained policy with full CV visibility yields a further travel-time reduction of approximately 1.6 %. Analysis across penetration rates suggests that the performance gap decreases as microscopic observations become more complete. These results support the use of complementary macroscopic and sparse microscopic observations for learning-based ramp metering. The source code implementation of the model is available at: https://github.com/youcefMehamlia/Multimodal-DRL-RMC
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在部分联网车辆 (CV) 可见的高速入口匝道调节中，把宏观交通量与两通道网格编码的 CV 存在/速度拼成混合观测，送入 Dueling Double DQN 直接输出绿灯时长。在 SUMO 的 50 个配对场景里，相对 ALINEA 总行程时间降 11.4%、平均回溢 (spillback) 时长降 84.9%；同一策略换成全 CV 可见再降约 1.6%，且 CV 渗透率越高、混合观测相对纯宏观的优势越小。
Motivation: 现有 DRL 匝道调节主要吃宏观聚合数据，而 CV 提供的车辆级观测虽有补充价值，却因渗透率有限而不完整，如何在部分可见下利用这种稀疏微观信息是缺口。
Method: 提出混合观测表示：宏观交通测量 + 两通道网格分别编码观测到的 CV 存在与速度；用 Dueling Double Deep Q-Network 处理该输入选择匝道绿灯时长，在不同交通需求与 CV 渗透率下训练，并在 SUMO 中与 ALINEA 及纯宏观 DRL 变体对比。
Result: 在 50 个配对评估场景中，部分 CV 可见下混合控制器相对 ALINEA 报告的总行程时间降低 11.4%，平均回溢持续时间降低 84.9%；同一已训练策略在全 CV 可见下行程时间再降约 1.6%；跨渗透率分析显示微观观测越完整，性能差距越小。
Conclusion: 宏观与稀疏微观观测互补可用于学习型匝道调节，且其增益随 CV 渗透率提高而收窄；模型源码已在 GitHub 公开。

papers.title: CentriQ: Calibration-Free Quantization of Diffusion Transformers via Exact Mean Centering
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) achieve state-of-the-art image generation, but their sampling cost limits deployment. Quantizing both weights and activations to 4 bits reduces this cost, yet existing methods fall short in one of two ways. Calibration-based methods are tied to a specific checkpoint and prompt distribution, whereas data-free Hadamard rotation, effective for LLMs, loses quality on DiTs. We show that this loss has a structural cause. Adaptive layer-norm conditioning adds a per-token mean to the activations, and at the widths of the evaluated DiTs, the Hadamard rotations used by data-free methods cannot spread this mean uniformly across coordinates. A single dominant direction therefore survives the rotation and sets the quantization range. We introduce CentriQ, a calibration-free quantizer that centers each token before rotation and restores the mean exactly through a rank-1 full-precision branch, so that per-token scales follow in closed form without data. Weights are fitted under a robust $\ell_p$ objective that tracks the dense mode of each group and discounts heavy tails. Across three DiTs, CentriQ matches the quality of calibrated SVDQuant at 4 bits, whereas calibration-free weight quantizers with plain per-token activation quantization collapse or degrade substantially. CentriQ outperforms the strongest calibration-free method reported to date at 2-bit weights. It is also the first calibration-free method to retain usable image quality at 2-bit activations.
papers.comment: Code and project page will be released soon
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CentriQ 是面向 Diffusion Transformer 的免校准 (calibration-free) 4-bit 权重与激活量化器：先对每个 token 做精确均值中心化再旋转，用 rank-1 全精度分支把均值原样恢复，从而无需数据即可闭式得到 per-token scale。在三个 DiT 上，4-bit 达到需校准的 SVDQuant 的画质，2-bit 权重超过此前最强免校准方法，2-bit 激活是首个保住可用画质的免校准方法。
Motivation: DiT 采样成本高，4-bit 量化可降本，但校准式方法绑定特定 checkpoint 与 prompt 分布，而对 LLM 有效的免校准 Hadamard 旋转在 DiT 上掉画质：adaptive layer-norm conditioning 给激活加了 per-token mean，DiT 宽度下 Hadamard 无法把该均值摊到各坐标，残留的单一主方向决定了量化区间。
Method: CentriQ 在旋转前对每个 token 做中心化，再经 rank-1 全精度分支精确恢复均值，使 per-token scale 可在无数据条件下闭式求出；权重用稳健 ℓ_p 目标拟合，跟踪每组的稠密众数并压低重尾。
Result: 在三个 DiT 上，CentriQ 4-bit 画质与需校准的 SVDQuant 持平，而采用普通 per-token 激活量化的免校准权重量化器会崩溃或明显退化；2-bit 权重上超过已报道的最强免校准方法；2-bit 激活上是首个保留可用画质的免校准方法。
Conclusion: DiT 上免校准量化的瓶颈是 adaptive layer-norm 引入的 per-token 均值未被旋转打散，精确中心化加 rank-1 恢复即可在不依赖校准数据的前提下追平校准式方法。

papers.title: OCL-PDE: A Generative Framework for PDE Inverse Problems with Observation-Complementary Latents
papers.abstract_en: Partial differential equation (PDE) inverse problems are often ill-posed, making fine-scale details difficult to recover. We address this problem by introducing a learned observation-complementary latent representation that preserves reconstruction-relevant information and is combined with the observation to reconstruct the unknown field. Building on this representation, we propose OCL-PDE, a generative framework that encourages the observation to guide large-scale structure and the latent to supply complementary fine-scale details. OCL-PDE is built on a physics-aware autoencoder (AE) and conditional Flow Matching, supporting inverse reconstruction as well as forward PDE prediction. Experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy and fine-detail recovery compared with the evaluated baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OCL-PDE 用观测互补隐变量 (observation-complementary latent) 处理 PDE 反问题的病态性：让观测负责大尺度结构、隐变量补足重建相关的细尺度细节，由 physics-aware autoencoder 与 conditional Flow Matching 支撑，同时支持反演重建与正向 PDE 预报。在所评测基线上重建精度与细部恢复均有提升。
Motivation: PDE 反问题通常病态，细尺度细节难以恢复；仅靠观测无法补回丢失的高频信息。
Method: 学习一个观测互补隐表示，与观测拼接共同重建未知场；框架 OCL-PDE 建立在 physics-aware autoencoder (AE) 与 conditional Flow Matching 之上，既做反演重建也做正向 PDE 预报，并显式引导观测主导大尺度、隐变量提供互补细节。
Result: 实验显示相对所评测基线 (evaluated baselines) 重建精度提升、细尺度细节恢复更好；摘要未给出具体数据集与数值。
Conclusion: 把观测与互补隐变量分工（大尺度归观测、细尺度归隐变量）是缓解 PDE 反问题病态、改善细部重建的有效框架，且同一模型可兼顾反演与正向预报。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: SimAuthor: Harnessing Foundation Models for Persistent Scientific Simulator Authoring
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models can generate scientific code, but authoring a scientific simulator (an executable program encoding hypotheses about how mechanisms generate observable signals) requires iterative refinement. Scientific adequacy rarely admits a unique implementation or exact test, so simulators must instead be judged against limited real observations. We study this setting as scientific simulator authoring under weak empirical feedback, where distributional comparisons between simulated and real signals guide revision, and the target is the simulator itself rather than only its generated samples. We introduce SimAuthor, a persistent authoring harness that retains and revises executable simulators, separates scalar search scores from structured discrepancy feedback, and accumulates reusable implementation mechanisms. We evaluate SimAuthor on six biomedical tasks spanning cardiac and respiratory audio, photoplethysmography (PPG), and electrocardiography (ECG). Under a fixed 100-attempt budget, SimAuthor outperforms PUCT score search on all six tasks, generally outperforms textual-strategy optimization, and achieves the highest endpoint score on five of six. The authored simulators also improve on unseen recordings, transfer to independent pretrained representations, and yield substantial out-of-distribution gains in downstream ECG classification. Finally, 111 of 138 audited revisions alter program structure and account for 86.1% of the signed score improvement. These results suggest that persistent revision can progressively convert foundation-model knowledge into better executable scientific simulators from limited empirical evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimAuthor 是一个持久化科学模拟器编写框架：保留并迭代修订可执行模拟器，把标量搜索分数与结构化差异反馈分开，同时积累可复用的实现机制。在六个生物医学任务（心脏与呼吸音频、PPG、ECG）上，固定 100 次尝试预算下它在全部六个任务超过 PUCT score search，五个任务取得最高终点分数，且 111/138 次被审计修订改动了程序结构、贡献了 86.1% 的分数提升。
Motivation: 基础模型能生成科学代码，但编写编码机制假设的可执行模拟器需要在缺乏唯一实现与精确测试的条件下、仅凭有限真实观测反复修订，通用代码生成与搜索式优化都缺少这种持久修订与反馈组织方式。
Method: SimAuthor 作为 persistent authoring harness：保留并修订可执行模拟器，将标量搜索分数与结构化 discrepancy 反馈分离，用模拟信号与真实信号的分布比较引导修订，并累积可复用的实现机制；评测覆盖六个生物医学任务，采用固定 100 次尝试预算，对照 PUCT score search 与 textual-strategy optimization。
Result: 在 100 次尝试预算下，SimAuthor 在全部六个任务上超过 PUCT score search，通常超过 textual-strategy optimization，并在六个任务中的五个取得最高终点分数；其编写的模拟器在未见录音上提升、可迁移到独立的预训练表示，并在下游 ECG 分类中带来显著的分布外 (OOD) 增益；138 次被审计修订中 111 次改动程序结构，占带符号分数提升的 86.1%。
Conclusion: 作者认为持久修订能把基础模型知识逐步转化为更好的可执行科学模拟器，即使可用经验数据有限；结构改动型修订是分数提升的主要来源。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Lipschitz Thinking: Ten Years of Certifiable-by-Design Robust Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The Lipschitz property of a deep neural network provides a direct measure of its sensitivity to input perturbations and, when explicitly controlled, offers a principled way to limit the propagation of errors and improve robustness. Over the past decade, Lipschitz-bounded layers have been incorporated into increasingly expressive and high-performing deep models, narrowing the gap between empirical robustness and formal, by-design guarantees of stability. This article introduces the fundamental concepts underlying Lipschitz-bounded neural networks, explaining the principles behind Lipschitz-constrained layers, the mechanisms used to enforce their bounds, and how they yield robustness certificates at the cost of a single forward pass. The tutorial concludes by discussing emerging and open directions, highlighting Lipschitz control as a general framework for offering guaranteed, by-design stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 综述十年来 Lipschitz 约束神经网络：通过显式限制每层 Lipschitz 常数控制输入扰动的误差传播，用单次前向传播即可给出鲁棒性证书 (robustness certificate)。文章梳理约束层的设计原理与实现机制，并指出 Lipschitz 控制可作为通用的按设计保证稳定性框架。
Motivation: 经验鲁棒性与形式化的稳定性保证之间存在差距，需要一种既能保持模型表达力与性能、又能给出可证明稳定性的构造性途径。
Method: 作为教程综述，介绍 Lipschitz 约束层的基本概念、强制其界的机制，以及这些约束如何在单次前向传播中产出鲁棒性证书，并归纳近年更具表达力的高性模型中的用法。
Result: 给出定性结论：Lipschitz 约束层在十年间被纳入日益具表达力且高性能的深度模型，缩小了经验鲁棒性与形式化按设计稳定性保证之间的差距；证书只需一次前向传播即可获得。
Conclusion: Lipschitz 控制可作为提供有保证的、按设计稳定性的一般框架，文章以新兴与开放方向收尾。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative World Models Enable Predictive Control of Laser Melt Pool Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: World models, which learn how environments respond to actions, are emerging as a powerful paradigm for planning through imagined futures, transforming decision-making across games, robotics and autonomous driving. Bringing this capability to manufacturing could enable process decisions on timescales inaccessible to high-fidelity simulation. Here we introduce a generative world model for localized highly dynamic laser melt pool that predicts evolution from histories of temperature and phase morphology under candidate actions. Its generative latent dynamics capture the effects of unresolved melt flow, enabling more accurate recursive rollouts than deterministic regressors under transient laser inputs. Because the learned dynamics are differentiable, the model can serve directly as a predictive control plant. Gradients through imagined futures optimize laser schedules that regulate melt-pool depth over previously unseen geometry, path, initialization. We further distil this optimization into an amortized policy that produces control actions in a single forward pass, providing a proof of concept for real deployment on machines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用于激光熔池 (melt pool) 动力学的生成式世界模型，从温度与相形貌历史在候选动作下预测演化，其生成式隐动力学显式捕捉未解析的熔池流动，使瞬态激光输入下的递归推演比确定性回归器更准。由于动力学可微，模型直接充当预测控制的被控对象，经想象未来反向传播优化激光时序以在未见过的几何、路径与初始化上调节熔池深度，并可蒸馏为单次前向的摊销策略。
Motivation: 高保真熔池仿真无法覆盖制造过程所需的决策时间尺度，而确定性回归器在瞬态激光输入下递归推演误差累积，难以支撑实时闭环控制。
Method: 生成式世界模型以温度与相形貌历史为条件、在候选激光动作下预测演化，用生成式隐动力学表示未解析的熔池流动；因模型可微，将其作为预测控制的 plant，对想象未来求梯度优化激光时序，再把该优化蒸馏成单次前向输出动作的摊销策略 (amortized policy)。
Result: 在瞬态激光输入下，生成式隐动力学的递归推演比确定性回归器更准确；梯度优化得到的激光时序可在先前未见过的几何、路径与初始化上调节熔池深度；蒸馏后的策略单次前向即产生控制动作。
Conclusion: 可微的生成式世界模型既能做递归预测又能直接作为预测控制被控对象，摊销策略为真机部署提供了概念验证路径。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: From Papers to Mechanisms: An Evidence-Grounded Knowledge Substrate for Scientific Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Scientific language models often access literature through untyped text chunks, which fragment the functional and evidential structure required for mechanism-rich questions. We introduce an evidence-grounded mechanism knowledge substrate that organizes scientific literature into provenance-linked evidence units, role-typed entities, and directed mechanism paths. We instantiate it as MS$^3$, a Material-Sensor-Signal-System schema for conductive-fiber flexible sensors, over 13,689 papers, 131,083 evidence items, and 26,648 mechanism objects. On in-domain and coverage-shift question-answering benchmarks, we compare closed-book generation, Web search, Raw-PDF RAG, and MS$^3$ retrieval across ten language models. MS$^3$ improves macro-averaged scientific correctness. It also improves citation entailment and answer completeness. These results support mechanism substrates as a reliable representation layer for scientific language models and motivate a source-repair workflow in which insufficient MS$^3$ evidence triggers targeted retrieval from its linked papers rather than assuming that a user has already supplied the correct PDFs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MS³ 把科学文献拆成带溯源的证据单元、角色化实体与有向机制路径，构成面向机制问答的知识底座；在导电纤维柔性传感器领域以 13,689 篇论文、131,083 条证据、26,648 个机制对象实例化，跨十个语言模型对比闭卷、Web 搜索与 Raw-PDF RAG 后，MS³ 检索提升宏平均科学正确性、引用蕴含与答案完整性。
Motivation: 科学语言模型以无类型文本块访问文献，机制性问题所需的证据与功能结构被切碎，导致引用与正确性不可靠。
Method: 构建证据单元、角色化实体与有向机制路径的底座，实例化为导电纤维柔性传感器的 Material-Sensor-Signal-System (MS³) schema；在域内与覆盖偏移两类问答基准上，对十个语言模型比较闭卷生成、Web 搜索、Raw-PDF RAG 与 MS³ 检索。
Result: MS³ 检索提升宏平均科学正确性，并同时提升引用蕴含 (citation entailment) 与答案完整性；底座规模为 13,689 篇论文、131,083 条证据项、26,648 个机制对象，评测覆盖十个语言模型。
Conclusion: 机制底座可作为科学语言模型的可靠表示层；当 MS³ 证据不足时应触发对其关联论文的定向检索，而非假定用户已提供正确 PDF。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Constrained Goal-directed Planar Graph Generation with Grammar-based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Planar graphs are central to applications across science and engineering, yet existing generators provide limited support for goal-directed generation under hard structural and geometric feasibility constraints. We propose a dataset-free method for generating planar graph embeddings by combining parametric graph grammars with safe reinforcement learning to optimize generic task-specific objectives while satisfying constraints during construction. We formulate the generation process as a constrained Markov decision process, where the graph grammar defines the state and action spaces. We further introduce an action projection that maps sampled actions toward state-dependent safe sets, improving constraint satisfaction during training. In contrast to classical graph generators and deep generative models, which typically offer limited goal-directed control or rely on weak constraint satisfaction, our method constructs feasible planar graph embeddings directly during generation. We also introduce a benchmark suite for constrained and goal-directed planar graph generation, together with classical and deep generative baselines. Across all benchmark tasks, our method consistently outperforms baselines while satisfying the formulated constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种免数据集的平面图嵌入生成方法，把参数化图语法 (parametric graph grammar) 与安全强化学习结合，在构造过程中直接满足硬性结构与几何约束。将生成过程表述为受约束 MDP，图语法定义状态与动作空间，并引入动作投影把采样动作映射到依赖状态的安全集上以提升训练期约束满足；在全部基准任务上一致优于经典与深度生成基线且满足所提约束。
Motivation: 现有平面图生成器在目标导向生成上支持有限，且难以在硬性结构与几何可行性约束下保证满足，经典生成器与深度生成模型通常只有有限的目标控制或依赖较弱的约束满足。
Method: 参数化图语法与安全 RL 结合：生成过程建为 constrained MDP，图语法定义状态与动作空间，目标为通用任务特定目标；引入 action projection 将采样动作投影到状态相关安全集 (state-dependent safe sets) 以改善训练中的约束满足；同时发布一个受约束目标导向平面图生成的 benchmark suite，含经典与深度生成基线。
Result: 在 benchmark suite 的全部任务上，该方法一致优于基线，同时满足所构建的约束；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 在构造期直接保证可行性的图语法 + 安全 RL 路线，可在受约束目标导向平面图生成上同时拿到目标优化与硬约束满足，优于经典与深度生成基线。

papers.title: RoSA: Rotational Sparse Adaptation for Memory-Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) reduces the cost of adapting foundation models by focusing training on a small parameter subset. Complementary to this idea, we introduce RoSA (Rotational Sparse Adaptation), which narrows adaptation to a subset of layers at a time. RoSA freezes lower layers close to the input throughout training and rotates a trainable block over later layers, progressively increasing the number of frozen layers close to the input. This design reduces optimizer-state memory, shortens backpropagation, and even forward propagation if activations at the last frozen layer are cached. Because RoSA is orthogonal to the choice of trainable parameterization, it can be combined with PEFT methods or sparse optimizers within each active block. Experiments across multiple LLM architectures and tasks show that RoSA reduces peak memory while maintaining strong fine-tuning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoSA (Rotational Sparse Adaptation) 把微调限制在单个活跃层块上：输入侧低层全程冻结，可训练块在更靠后的层间轮转，并逐步增加靠近输入的冻结层数。这样直接削减优化器状态显存、缩短反向传播，若缓存最后一个冻结层的激活还能缩短前向传播；在多种 LLM 架构与任务上降低峰值显存同时保持较强的微调性能。
Motivation: PEFT 只训练少量参数以降低适配成本，但优化器状态与整条反向图的显存开销仍随层数累积，长上下文或大模型微调时峰值显存成为瓶颈。
Method: RoSA 冻结输入侧低层，把可训练块在后续层间轮转并逐层扩大冻结范围；该机制与可训练参数化正交，可在活跃块内叠加任意 PEFT 方法或稀疏优化器 (sparse optimizer)。
Result: 在多种 LLM 架构与任务上，RoSA 降低峰值显存并保持较强的微调性能；摘要给出的机制性收益是减少优化器状态显存、缩短反向传播，缓存最后冻结层激活时也缩短前向传播。
Conclusion: 按层块轮转冻结而非只稀疏化参数，可以在不牺牲微调性能的前提下压低显存与传播开销，且与现有 PEFT、稀疏优化器可组合。

papers.title: Few-Shot Prototype Head Adaptation for On-Device ECG Personalization on PSoC~6
papers.abstract_en: Wearable and bedside electrocardiogram (ECG) monitors must adapt to patient-specific morphology to maintain arrhythmia detection accuracy across users, yet personalization is typically performed offline and cannot account for individual physiology, electrode placement, or recording drift. On-device adaptation by backpropagation is expensive for microcontroller-class medical devices because it requires an optimizer state, repeated backward passes through convolutional layers, and labeled arrhythmic beats that may not be available at deployment time. This letter proposes prototype-only head adaptation as a compact personalization primitive for TinyML ECG systems. A one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1-D CNN; 1,314 parameters and 72.6k multiply-accumulate operations per beat) is trained offline on the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database under an inter-patient protocol, frozen as a feature extractor, and exported to a PSoC 6 microcontroller. Patient-specific adaptation then reduces to computing closed-form class means in a 32-dimensional embedding space, requiring no convolutional backward pass, no iterative optimization, and only one forward pass per support beat. Prototype adaptation improves inter-patient macro-F1 from 0.635/0.639/0.646 to 0.731/0.771/0.797 at 1/5/10-shot, outperforming linear stochastic-gradient-descent (SGD) head fine-tuning at every shot count for the target tiny backbone. On-device replay over 18 one-shot episodes on a PSoC 6 Cortex-M4F matches the host macro-F1 for the prototype head (0.798), with 11.39 ms per beat, 5.2 KB flash, and 22.2 KB SRAM. A restricted variant that updates only the normal-class prototype from passively buffered sinus beats yields a consistent +0.05 macro-F1 gain, reducing the annotation burden during initial
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 PSoC 6 微控制器上做 ECG 个体化时，用原型头适配 (prototype-only head adaptation) 取代反向传播：1-D CNN 冻结为特征提取器，患者适配退化为在 32 维嵌入里算闭式类均值，每个 support beat 只需一次前向。MIT-BIH 互患者协议下 macro-F1 从 0.635/0.639/0.646 提到 0.731/0.771/0.797（1/5/10-shot），每个 shot 数都超过线性 SGD 头微调。
Motivation: 可穿戴与床旁 ECG 需要按患者形态个体化以维持心律失常检测精度，但个体化通常离线做，无法应对个体生理、电极位置与记录漂移；微控制器级设备上反向传播代价高，且部署时往往没有标注心搏。
Method: 1,314 参数、每搏 72.6k MACs 的 1-D CNN 在 MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database 上按互患者协议离线训练后冻结，导出到 PSoC 6；患者适配只在 32 维嵌入空间计算闭式类均值，无卷积反向传播、无迭代优化、每个 support beat 一次前向。另有一个受限变体只更新 normal 类原型，输入为被动缓存的窦性心搏。
Result: 互患者 macro-F1 由 0.635/0.639/0.646 提升至 0.731/0.771/0.797（1/5/10-shot），在每个 shot 数上都优于线性 SGD 头微调。PSoC 6 Cortex-M4F 上 18 个 one-shot episode 的在设备回放 macro-F1 为 0.798，与主机一致，每搏 11.39 ms、5.2 KB flash、22.2 KB SRAM。只更新 normal 类原型的受限变体稳定带来 +0.05 macro-F1。
Conclusion: 闭式原型适配可在微控制器上以单次前向完成 ECG 个体化，精度超过线性 SGD 头微调并降低标注负担，代价是依赖冻结的离线特征提取器。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence and the New Science of Culture
papers.abstract_en: Cognition and culture have long been treated as parallel objects of study, joined more by metaphor than by mechanism. We argue they are co-constituted in a manner now empirically tractable: subjectivities can be measured as local trajectories through a high-dimensional cultural field, and the field is itself the aggregate of those trajectories. Recent advances in machine learning, including embedding methods and large generative models, provide the first general framework for measuring this co-constitution from micro-cognition to macro-social structure. Vector geometry recovers individual conceptual structure, organizational communication, and large-scale ideologies; captures multimodal cultural content beyond text; and generates testable predictions about cultural emergence, including the simultaneous arrival of independent discoveries across distant minds. We treat this predictability of simultaneous innovation as evidence for the co- constitutive view: when the geometry of the cultural field is measurable, trajectories of cognitive search through it become predictable. We then examine generative AI agents as simulators of human subjectivity and as a qualitatively new coordinating substrate whose insertion into social life introduces evolutionary dynamics unprecedented in human cultural history. We formalize this reflexive condition as a Heisenberg-like Uncertainty Principle for generative AI: as instruments for fixing a culture's position grow more precise, our capacity to predict its trajectory degrades, because the machinery of cultural description and cultural action have merged. We close with ethical questions raised by AI-mediated cultural drift, recursive synthetic culture, and the limits of human cultural agency, offering guidelines for safe, equitable, and privacy-preserving research on AI and culture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张认知与文化是共同构成的，且这种共构如今可实证测量：个体主体性是高维文化场中的局部轨迹，文化场又是这些轨迹的聚合。embedding 与大生成模型构成从微观认知到宏观社会结构的统一测量框架，向量几何可恢复个体概念结构、组织沟通与大规模意识形态，并预测独立发现同时出现等文化涌现。作者进一步形式化出生成式 AI 的类海森堡不确定性原理：测量文化位置的工具越精确，预测其轨迹的能力越下降，因为文化描述机制与文化行动机制已经合一。
Motivation: 认知与文化长期被当作并列对象、靠隐喻而非机制相连；生成式 AI 作为模拟主体性与新型协调基质进入社会生活后，描述与行动合一，使文化轨迹的可预测性出现新的根本约束。
Method: 以 embedding 方法和大型生成模型测量主体性在高维文化场中的局部轨迹，并把文化场定义为这些轨迹的聚合；用向量几何恢复概念结构、组织沟通与多模态文化内容，生成关于文化涌现的可检验预测；把生成式 AI agent 作为主体性模拟器，并将描述与行动合一的形式化为 Heisenberg-like Uncertainty Principle。
Result: 给出可检验预测之一是独立发现会在相距遥远的头脑中同时到达；把同时创新的可预测性作为认知与文化共构的证据。提出生成式 AI 插入社会生活带来人类文化史中前所未有的演化动力学，并形式化为测量越精确、轨迹预测越退化的不确定性原理。
Conclusion: 当文化场的几何可测量，认知搜索穿过它的轨迹就变得可预测；但生成式 AI 使文化描述与文化行动的机器合一，测量精度与轨迹预测能力之间存在此消彼长的关系。作者据此提出 AI 介导的文化漂移、递归合成文化与人类文化能动性边界下的安全、公平、隐私保护研究准则。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Certification-Enhanced Generalization Bounds
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the use of formal methods to provide tight and sound generalization bounds for learning algorithms. By casting the traditional notion of algorithmic stability as a specification to be verified, we demonstrate that recent advances in reachability analysis can yield provable bounds on the generalization of a given model and algorithm on a sample dataset. As sample-specific algorithmic stability is insufficient to bound the usual distributional notion of generalization, we develop a novel concentration inequality to connect the sample-specific results of formal certification algorithms to the required distributional analysis for bounding the expected generalization gap. The resulting framework enables the analysis of prior generalization bounds to extend far beyond their original restrictive assumptions. Our approach computes sound bounds on the expected generalization gap in a constant number of algorithm runs without making any analytical assumptions on the algorithm; to achieve non-vacuous bounds we only require that the certified reachable parameter set is bounded --- a condition that we do not assume but formally verify. In practice, we demonstrate that our framework provides formal generalization guarantees that are orders of magnitude tighter than alternative sound computational approaches at scales ranging from toy datasets to fine-tuning classification heads on top of modern large language models. While we implement certification-enhanced versions of several well-known stability results, future extensions of our approach will enable tighter bounds and enhanced practical adoption across the spectrum of modern generalization bounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把算法稳定性当作形式化规约，用可达性分析 (reachability analysis) 对样本级稳定性做可证明认证，再用新提出的集中不等式把样本级结果提升为分布级期望泛化间隙界。界在常数次算法运行内算出、不对算法做解析假设，只需认证出的可达参数集有界（该条件本身也被形式化验证）；在玩具数据集到在现代 LLM 之上微调分类头的尺度上，比其他 sound 计算方法紧若干个数量级。
Motivation: 传统泛化界依赖对算法的强解析假设，而样本级稳定性认证无法直接约束通常意义上的分布级泛化，导致已有 sound 计算界在大模型尺度上过于宽松甚至空洞。
Method: 将算法稳定性表述为待验证规约，用可达性分析对给定模型与算法在样本数据集上做形式化认证，得到样本级稳定性界；再构造新的集中不等式把认证结果连接到分布级期望泛化间隙分析，并实现若干经典稳定性结果的 certification-enhanced 版本。
Result: 在常数次算法运行内给出期望泛化间隙的 sound 界，无需对算法做任何解析假设；非空洞性只需认证可达参数集有界，且该条件被形式化验证而非假设。在玩具数据集到 LLM 分类头微调的尺度上，界比其他 sound 计算方法紧若干个数量级 (orders of magnitude tighter)。
Conclusion: 形式化认证加新的集中不等式可以把样本级稳定性转成分布级泛化界，从而把既有泛化界推广到远超其原始限制性假设的场景；作者预期后续扩展能给出更紧的界。

papers.title: Bradley-Terry model under general comparison graphs
papers.abstract_en: The Bradley-Terry model is a parametric model for ranking from pairwise comparisons. Existing asymptotic theory for the maximum likelihood estimator (MLE) in regimes where the number of objects grows often requires homogeneity assumptions or compatibility conditions on comparison graphs, which limits its applicability to many practical settings. In this work, we establish uniform consistency of the MLE under general deterministic comparison designs. Our pairwise error bound consists of a pair-specific term governed by the effective resistance between the corresponding objects and a global term governed by the spectral gap of the unnormalized graph Laplacian. The bound is tight up to logarithmic factors for certain graph sequences. For any prespecified sequence of pairs satisfying an additional balancing condition, we further establish asymptotic normality of the corresponding estimated utility differences. As an application, we obtain uniform consistency for independent-edge random graph designs whenever the minimum edge probability exceeds the Erdős-Rényi connectivity threshold by a logarithmic factor, as well as asymptotic normality under additional balancing conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在一般确定性比较图上证明 Bradley-Terry 模型 MLE 的一致收敛：成对误差界由对象间 effective resistance 与未归一化图拉普拉斯谱隙分别控制，且在特定图序列上紧到对数因子。对满足额外平衡条件的任意预定对象对序列，进一步得到效用差估计的渐近正态性；作为推论，独立边随机图设计在最小边概率超过 Erdős-Rényi 连通阈值一个对数因子时仍有一致收敛。
Motivation: 现有 Bradley-Terry MLE 在对象数增长时的渐近理论多依赖同质性假设或比较图的兼容性条件，限制了其在许多实际比较设计下的适用性。
Method: 在一般确定性比较设计下分析 MLE：把成对误差界分解为由 effective resistance 控制的 pair-specific 项与由未归一化图拉普拉斯谱隙控制的全局项；再对满足额外平衡条件的预定对象对序列推导效用差的渐近正态性，并将结论应用到独立边随机图设计。
Result: 得到一般确定性比较设计下 MLE 的一致收敛，误差界对某些图序列紧到对数因子；对满足平衡条件的对象对序列建立效用差估计的渐近正态性；独立边随机图设计在最小边概率超过 Erdős-Rényi 连通阈值一个对数因子时获得一致收敛，并在附加平衡条件下得到渐近正态性。
Conclusion: 同质性与图兼容性并非 Bradley-Terry 渐近理论的必要条件，effective resistance 加谱隙的分解足以刻画一般比较图上 MLE 的一致性与渐近正态性。

summary_sections.method: 在一般确定性比较设计下分析 MLE：把成对误差界分解为由 effective resistance 控制的 pair-specific 项与由未归一化图拉普拉斯谱隙控制的全局项；再对满足额外平衡条件的预定对象对序列推导效用差的渐近正态性，并将结论应用到独立边随机图设计。
summary_sections.result: 得到一般确定性比较设计下 MLE 的一致收敛，误差界对某些图序列紧到对数因子；对满足平衡条件的对象对序列建立效用差估计的渐近正态性；独立边随机图设计在最小边概率超过 Erdős-Rényi 连通阈值一个对数因子时获得一致收敛，并在附加平衡条件下得到渐近正态性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 同质性与图兼容性并非 Bradley-Terry 渐近理论的必要条件，effective resistance 加谱隙的分解足以刻画一般比较图上 MLE 的一致性与渐近正态性。

papers.title: Encoded but Not in Control: Revealing the Grounding Gap in Vision-Language Robot Policies
papers.abstract_en: Instruction following is central to language-conditioned robot policies: language should determine what to do when the same scene permits multiple valid actions. Yet successful execution alone cannot establish whether a policy follows the instruction or infers the task from the scene. We study this ambiguity through scene-preserving instruction interventions, using valid target substitutions, arbitrary nouns, and unrelated sentences while holding the scene fixed. We evaluate vision-language-action (VLA) policies and world-action models (WAMs) in simulation and in real-world experiments. Our analysis addresses three questions: (a) Does task success imply instruction following? When instructions request a different visible object, all evaluated policies predominantly approach and pick up the incorrect original target associated with the scene. (b) Is this failure caused by language insensitivity? Instruction perturbations affect task performance. A layerwise action lens shows intermediate action predictions respond to these perturbations. Linear probes accurately recover instructed targets, indicating modified instructions are encoded despite rarely determining target selection. (c) Why does encoded language fail to control action? Attention analysis indicates weak instruction-token contributions to action generation. Target-token attention can remain focused on the original object, revealing a mismatch between target encoding and visual grounding. UMAP and shared non-negative matrix factorization show target information remains accessible within representations increasingly organized by scene identity. Our findings expose a grounding gap concealed by nominal success and provide a diagnostic framework. They further establish a concrete criterion for progress: policies should reliably follow valid changes in user intent, even when they conflict with scene-favored behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 通过保持场景不变的指令干预（替换目标名词、任意名词、无关句子）测试 VLA 与 world-action 模型，发现任务成功并不等于指令跟随：指令要求换成另一个可见物体时，被测策略仍主要去抓场景关联的原目标。线性探针能准确解码出被改写的目标词，说明语言已被编码却几乎不决定动作，注意力分析显示指令 token 对动作生成贡献弱，目标 token 注意力仍停在原物体上，即编码与视觉 grounding 脱节。
Motivation: 语言条件机器人策略的高任务成功率无法区分它是在遵循指令还是从场景猜任务；这种被名义成功掩盖的 grounding gap 会让策略在用户意图与场景偏好冲突时静默执行错误目标。
Method: 构造场景保持的指令干预（有效目标替换、任意名词、无关句子），在仿真与真实实验中评测 vision-language-action (VLA) 策略与 world-action models (WAMs)；配套诊断工具包括 layerwise action lens、线性探针、注意力分析，以及 UMAP 与共享非负矩阵分解 (shared NMF)。
Result: 指令要求不同可见物体时，所有被评策略绝大多数情况仍接近并抓取场景关联的错误原目标；指令扰动确实影响任务表现，中间层动作预测对扰动有响应；线性探针能准确恢复被指令的目标，表明改写后的指令已被编码却很少决定目标选择；注意力分析显示指令 token 对动作生成贡献弱，目标 token 注意力可仍聚焦原物体；UMAP 与 shared NMF 显示目标信息仍可访问，但表征越来越按场景身份组织。
Conclusion: 名义成功率掩盖了 grounding gap：策略编码了指令却不让其控制动作。作者提出进展判据——策略应在用户有效意图变更与场景偏好冲突时可靠遵循该变更，并给出一套诊断框架。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Joint Class-Time Learning for Video Classification with Multi-Instance Partial-Label Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-instance partial-label learning (MIPL) addresses inexact supervision in both the instance and label spaces, which can be applied to video classification. However, bag-level labels do not explicitly supervise the correspondence between candidate classes and temporal evidence. We propose {\ours}, which couples label disambiguation with temporal evidence allocation through a joint class--time assignment. Occupancy-regularized spherical matching associates contextualized video features while learning nonuniform temporal mass and discouraging excessive concentration. During training, candidate-restricted inference recomputes the assignment within the candidate label set. A dual-marginal KL projection then constructs a structured teacher that incorporates momentum-refined class beliefs while preserving the proposal's temporal occupancy. A single plan-level KL objective aligns the full-space predictor with this teacher. Our analysis characterizes when candidate re-solving differs from masking and shows that, under the stated construction, the joint objective decomposes into class-marginal and class-conditional temporal supervision. We construct VCMIPL benchmarks from Breakfast, DoTA, and FineAction using model-generated candidate labels and evaluate the method across four feature representations. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that PIVOTMIPL outperforms existing MIPL algorithms in both effectiveness and efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PIVOTMIPL 把视频多实例部分标签学习 (MIPL) 的标签消歧与时间证据分配合并成一次联合 class–time assignment：占用正则的球面匹配学习非均匀时间质量，候选集受限推理重算分配，双边缘 KL 投影构造结构化 teacher，单个 plan-level KL 目标对齐全空间预测器。在由 Breakfast、DoTA、FineAction 构建的 VCMIPL 基准、四种特征表示上，该方法在有效性与效率上均超过已有 MIPL 算法。
Motivation: MIPL 同时在实例空间和标签空间存在不精确监督，但 bag 级标签不会显式监督候选类与时间证据之间的对应关系，视频分类中类归属与时间定位因此脱节。
Method: 联合 class–time assignment 耦合标签消歧与时间证据分配：占用正则的球面匹配 (occupancy-regularized spherical matching) 关联上下文化视频特征并学习非均匀时间质量、抑制过度集中；训练时候选受限推理在候选标签集内重算分配；双边缘 KL 投影结合动量精炼的类置信度构造结构化 teacher 并保留 proposal 的时间占用；单一 plan-level KL 目标对齐全空间预测器与该 teacher。
Result: 从 Breakfast、DoTA、FineAction 用模型生成的候选标签构建 VCMIPL 基准，在四种特征表示上评测，PIVOTMIPL 在有效性与效率两方面均优于已有 MIPL 算法；分析给出候选集重解 (candidate re-solving) 与掩码 (masking) 何时不同，并证明在所述构造下联合目标可分解为类边缘与类条件时间监督。
Conclusion: 把类归属和时间证据放进同一次分配并用结构化 teacher 约束，可在部分标签视频分类中同时拿到更好的消歧质量与更低开销；候选受限重解并非掩码的等价改写，其差异有可刻画的条件。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: AUTOPILOT An Advanced Perception, Localization and Path Planning Techniques for Autonomous Vehicles Using YOLOv7 and MiDaS
papers.abstract_en: Self driving vehicles have emerged as a reliable technology that has the capability to transform transportation and mobility. The development of self driving cars requires significant advances in a number of areas, including perception, localization, decision making, and control. This research paper is based on the project implementation of the combination of object detection using YOLO (You Only Look Once), depth sensing using MiDaS for the localization and perception of obstacles, perspective transform, and decision making for path planning in self driving cars. The contemporary state of the technology for object detection, depth sensing, localization, and path planning evaluates the performance of the combined system through simulations and experiments. The results show that the combination of YOLO and MiDaS provides a new robust system for object detection and depth sensing. This research paper contributes to the advancement of self driving car technology and provides new and innovative approaches to the perception and localization of obstacles in the environment. Keywords: YOLO, MiDaS, perception, localization, decision making
papers.comment: Published in the 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing Technologies and Applications (ICACTA), IEEE
papers.journal_ref: H. Devmurari, G. Kuckian, and P. Vishwakarma, Proc. IEEE ICACTA 2023
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AUTOPILOT 把 YOLOv7 目标检测、MiDaS 单目深度估计、透视变换与路径规划决策串成自动驾驶感知-定位-规划流水线，通过仿真与实验评估组合系统。结果表明 YOLO 与 MiDaS 结合可给出鲁棒的目标检测与深度感知系统。
Motivation: 自动驾驶开发需要在感知、定位、决策与控制多个环节同时取得进展，单目条件下障碍物的检测与距离估计需要一个可落地的组合方案。
Method: 以 YOLOv7 做目标检测，MiDaS 做单目深度感知以定位障碍物，配合透视变换 (perspective transform) 与路径规划决策模块，构成完整流水线，并通过仿真与实验评估组合系统性能。
Result: 仿真与实验结果表明 YOLO 与 MiDaS 的组合提供了鲁棒的目标检测与深度感知系统；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 作者主张 YOLO 检测与 MiDaS 深度的组合可作为自动驾驶障碍物感知与定位的可行方案，并称其为感知与定位提供了新的方法路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Parameter Estimation in Machining Dynamics with Regenerative Delay and Nonsmooth Friction using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: A multi-domain eXtended Physics-Informed Neural Network (XPINN) framework is developed for nonsmooth Delay Differential Equations (DDEs). This is the first implementation to demonstrate the efficacy of partitioning the temporal domain into subdomains of integer multiples of the characteristic time delay and progressively training the associated subnetworks while freezing previously learned parameters. The efficacy of the proposed framework is demonstrated using a machining dynamics model that incorporates both regenerative and nonsmooth frictional effects. Results demonstrate that the proposed multi-domain XPINN framework leads to better solution reconstruction in DDEs and improved parameter estimation compared to a generic PINN (SPINN) formulation. The proposed method works particularly well for extended temporal domains and non-constant history functions. The robustness of inverse XPINN (I-XPINN) is also assessed using reference data contaminated with Gaussian measurement noise. Results indicate that I-XPINN remains resilient to measurement noise and the physics-informed constraints guide the network toward accurately recovering the underlying dynamics. This demonstrates, for the first time, the potential of the proposed framework for reliable parameter identification in DDEs characterised by nonsmoothness and large time delays.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向非光滑时滞微分方程 (DDE) 的多域 eXtended PINN (XPINN)：把时间域按特征时滞的整数倍切成子域，逐个子网络顺序训练并冻结已学参数。在含再生时滞与非光滑摩擦的加工动力学模型上，该框架的解重构与参数估计均优于通用 SPINN，且在长时域与非常数历史函数下表现更好；其逆问题版本 I-XPINN 在含高斯测量噪声的参考数据上仍能准确恢复底层动力学。
Motivation: 含大时滞与非光滑项的 DDE 难以用单一网络在整个时间域上重构解并反演参数，通用 PINN (SPINN) 在长时域和非常数历史函数下精度不足。
Method: 多域 XPINN：按特征时滞的整数倍划分时间子域，各子域配独立子网络并顺序训练、冻结先前参数；逆问题版本 I-XPINN 用物理约束从含噪参考数据反演参数，测试对象为含再生时滞与非光滑摩擦的加工动力学模型。
Result: 多域 XPINN 在 DDE 解重构与参数估计上均优于 SPINN，优势在扩展时域与非常数历史函数下更明显；I-XPINN 在受高斯测量噪声污染的参考数据上保持稳健，物理约束引导网络准确恢复底层动力学。
Conclusion: 按时滞整数倍做时域分解并渐进训练，可实现非光滑、大时滞 DDE 的可靠参数辨识，且对测量噪声有韧性；作者称这是该框架首次用于此类 DDE 的参数辨识。

papers.title: SO(3)-RoPE for Spherical Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Spherical data arise in many scientific applications. Often spherical transformers disregard the geometry of the underlying spherical domain, causing distortions and coordinate singularities near the poles. We introduce SO(3)-RoPE, a relative positional embedding that incorporates spherical geometry into transformer attention through unitary SO(3) representations. Our formulation is SO(3)-equivariant and compatible with FlashAttention, retaining efficiency of vanilla transformers. On shallow water dynamics prediction over a rotating sphere, our SO3ViT outperforms an S2Transformer baseline with lower errors and reduced runtime.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Neurips Workshop 2026: Representations for the Physical Sciences
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SO(3)-RoPE：用 SO(3) 的酉表示把球面几何写进 Transformer 的相对位置嵌入，使注意力保持 SO(3) 等变并兼容 FlashAttention。在旋转球面浅水动力预报上，SO3ViT 相对 S2Transformer 基线误差更低、运行时间更短。
Motivation: 球面 Transformer 常忽略球面域几何，在极点附近产生畸变与坐标奇异，需要既保几何又不牺牲效率的相对位置编码。
