papers.title: APOD: reasoning-guided agentic population ordinary differential equation discovery for pharmacological digital twins
papers.abstract_en: Establishing ordinary differential equations (ODEs) describing population data is a fundamental part of mathematical modeling in pharmacology, crucial to developing digital twins. However, doing so from sparse, noisy data is a slow, expert-driven task. Existing automated methods either search a restricted model space or ignore population inter-individual variability. Here we introduce APOD (Agentic Population ODE Discovery), a language-model agent that iteratively reasons over biological knowledge and fit diagnostics in an open-ended search space to discover a population digital twin (PDT), i.e., a shared ODE system with between-subject variability. On synthetic pharmacokinetic and tumor-dynamics benchmarks, APOD recovered ground-truth structures in 94-100\% of runs, 12-fold faster in median than an established library-based search. On real cohorts it converged to valid structures, and proposed a PDT of radioligand-therapy-induced platelet dynamics that predicts thrombocytopenia from first-cycle data and simulates alternative dosing schedules that lower the predicted risk of toxicity.

papers.title: LeAVJEPA: A Minimalist Architecture for Audio-Visual Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Prior audio-visual self-supervised learning methods rely on mechanisms such as EMA target encoders, prediction heads, reconstruction decoders, and contrastive losses. We introduce LeAVJEPA, the first audio-visual encoder trained under LeJEPA's collapse-free objective. A single early-fusion Vision Transformer processes audio, video, and joint audio-video inputs. Modality dropout treats a missing modality as another view of the same event, making cross-modal alignment implicit in the objective. The model aligns global embeddings with modality-specific local embeddings, and SIGReg prevents representational collapse. A controlled ablation identifies modality dropout as the key mechanism for audio-visual alignment. Despite the architectural simplicity, LeAVJEPA reaches 36.0 mAP on AudioSet-20K and 91.3% accuracy on ESC-50 under frozen evaluation. After fine-tuning, it reaches 61.1% accuracy on VGGSound, and its embeddings support zero-shot audio-visual retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LeAVJEPA 用单一 early-fusion Vision Transformer 和 LeJEPA 的无坍缩目标做音视频自监督学习，把缺失模态当作同一事件的另一个视图 (modality dropout)，使跨模态对齐隐含在目标里，并用 SIGReg 防止表征坍缩。受控消融把 modality dropout 认定为音视频对齐的关键机制；frozen 评测下 AudioSet-20K 达 36.0 mAP、ESC-50 达 91.3% 准确率，微调后 VGGSound 达 61.1%。
Motivation: 既有的音视频自监督方法依赖 EMA target encoder、预测头、重建解码器和对比损失，机制堆叠且存在表征坍缩风险；作者要问这些组件是否必要。
Method: 单个 early-fusion Vision Transformer 同时处理音频、视频与联合音视频输入；modality dropout 把缺失模态当作同一事件的另一视图，使跨模态对齐隐含于目标；模型对齐全局嵌入与模态特定的局部嵌入，SIGReg 防坍缩，整体采用 LeJEPA 的 collapse-free 目标，并做受控消融。
Result: frozen 评测下 AudioSet-20K 36.0 mAP、ESC-50 91.3% 准确率；微调后 VGGSound 61.1% 准确率；嵌入支持 zero-shot 音视频检索。受控消融把 modality dropout 识别为音视频对齐的关键机制。
Conclusion: 去掉 EMA target encoder、预测头、重建解码器与对比损失，靠 early-fusion 加 modality dropout 与 SIGReg 就能拿到有竞争力的音视频表征，而 modality dropout 是对齐的主导来源。

papers.title: Frequency-Decoupled Diffusion Guidance for Non-Blind Image Deblurring
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained diffusion models provide powerful image priors for training-free posterior sampling in image restoration. To guide this sampling process, frequency-aware methods progressively incorporate measurement information across frequency bands, facilitating coarse-to-fine reconstruction. However, existing methods typically do not explicitly separate frequency activation from degradation-induced attenuation, leaving attenuation differences among inactive frequencies insufficiently modeled. In this work, we propose frequency-decoupled posterior guidance to separate frequency activation from attenuation-aware spectral regularization. Specifically, a progressive low-to-high frequency schedule determines the active measurement band, while a kernel-derived attenuation map defines a selective spectral prior over inactive components. To stabilize the sampling process, we also introduce a local trajectory regularizer that suppresses spatially irregular state-to-clean deviations. For a fixed endpoint energy, we provide a KL-regularized path-space interpretation. In practice, we construct time-dependent guidance through local energy corrections using a Tweedie plug-in approximation. Experiments on natural-image benchmarks demonstrate strong PSNR and SSIM performance across challenging non-blind deblurring settings, even at higher measurement noise levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向非盲图像去模糊 (non-blind image deblurring) 提出频率解耦的后验引导：把频率激活与退化引起的衰减分开建模，用低到高频的渐进调度确定活跃测量频带，再用核导出的衰减图为非活跃分量定义选择性谱先验。在自然图像基准的困难非盲去模糊设置下（含更高测量噪声水平）取得强 PSNR 与 SSIM 表现。
Motivation: 预训练扩散模型可做免训练后验采样，但现有频率感知引导只按频带逐步注入测量信息，没有显式区分频率激活与退化衰减，导致非活跃频带间的衰减差异建模不足。
Method: 频率解耦后验引导：渐进低到高频调度确定活跃测量频带，核导出的衰减图 (kernel-derived attenuation map) 对非活跃分量给出选择性谱先验；加入局部轨迹正则器抑制空间不规则的 state-to-clean 偏移，并给出固定端点能量下的 KL 正则路径空间解释，实际引导用 Tweedie plug-in 近似构造时变引导与局部能量修正。
Result: 在自然图像基准的多种困难非盲去模糊设置下展示强 PSNR 与 SSIM 表现，即使在更高测量噪声水平下仍成立。
Conclusion: 把频率激活与衰减感知的谱正则解耦，配合局部轨迹稳定化，可在免训练扩散后验采样中改善非盲去模糊重建质量与噪声鲁棒性。

papers.title: Cross-lingual Calibration of Pre-Generation Success Probes for Multilingual LLM Routing
papers.abstract_en: Pre-generation success probes estimate response correctness from a language model's hidden activations before decoding, enabling cost-aware routing. While prior work has demonstrated their utility primarily on English inputs, we study their reliability across languages along three dimensions: (1) whether they preserve the ranking of likely successes and failures (DISCRIMINATION); (2) whether they retain probabilities that match observed success frequencies (CALIBRATION); and (3) whether they produce scores comparable enough across candidate models for cost-aware multilingual routing (UTILITY). Using 3,000 MATH problems in 10 languages and 8 open-weight model configurations, we compare cross-lingual transfer from English-trained probes and equal-budget pooled multilingual probes. English-trained probes retain useful cross-lingual discrimination but become less well calibrated after transfer. Pooled multilingual supervision improves both properties and yields more reliable estimates of success. In routing experiments, the pooled router achieves a 0.7% higher test success rate while reducing modeled cost by 13.0% relative to always selecting the model with the highest average success. These results show that multilingual routing requires success estimates that remain well calibrated and comparable across languages and models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 跨语言校准生成前成功探针 (pre-generation success probes)：在 10 种语言的 3,000 道 MATH 题、8 个开源模型配置上，英文训练的探针迁移后判别力尚存但校准变差，而等预算的多语言混合监督同时改善判别与校准。混合路由相对恒选平均成功率最高模型，测试成功率高 0.7%、建模成本降 13.0%。
Motivation: 生成前成功探针的效用此前主要在英文输入上验证，跨语言迁移后概率是否仍与实际成功率吻合、跨模型分数是否可比，直接决定成本感知多语言路由能否用。
Method: 用 3,000 道 MATH 问题的 10 语言版本与 8 个开源模型配置，沿三个维度评估探针：DISCRIMINATION（保持成功/失败排序）、CALIBRATION（概率与观测成功频率吻合）、UTILITY（跨候选模型分数可比以支持成本感知路由）；对比英文训练探针的跨语言迁移与等预算的多语言混合 (pooled) 探针。
Result: 英文训练探针迁移后保留有用的跨语言判别力，但校准变差；多语言混合监督同时改善判别与校准。路由实验中混合路由器测试成功率比恒选平均成功率最高模型高 0.7%，建模成本降低 13.0%。
Conclusion: 多语言路由的前提是成功估计在跨语言、跨模型两面上都保持良好校准与可比性，因此探针监督应从英文单语改为多语言混合。

papers.title: Sampling Allocation of LinUCB: Optimal Design Limits in the Small-Gap Regime
papers.abstract_en: We study the sampling allocation of LinUCB in the small-gap regime, where the reward gaps are of order at most $n^{-1/2}$ over the decision horizon $n$. This scaling captures the hard instances underlying worst-case regret lower bounds, for which LinUCB is known to be near optimal up to logarithmic factors in $n$. Using a mean-field perspective, we characterize this allocation through the empirical sampling distribution, a macroscopic object that averages the effect of adaptive decisions over the horizon, and identify its limit as $n\to\infty$. We establish that in this regime, the empirical sampling distribution induced by LinUCB converges to the set of D-optimal designs. This central result reveals that, in the small-gap regime, LinUCB not only achieves near optimal minimax regret but also allocates samples in a way that is asymptotically efficient for learning the reward parameter, thereby connecting regret-driven online learning with information-efficient experimental design. Building on the optimal design limit, we obtain two useful consequences. First, we refine the asymptotic regret analysis of LinUCB in the small-gap regime by characterizing its leading-order constant in the limit. Second, we show that, despite LinUCB's adaptive sampling strategy, the regularized least-squares estimator satisfies a central-limit-type theorem in the small-gap regime, thereby enabling valid statistical inference for the reward parameter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在奖励间隙至多为 n^{-1/2} 的 small-gap regime 下，LinUCB 的经验采样分布以均场视角收敛到 D-optimal design 集合，说明其自适应采样在渐近意义上对学习奖励参数是信息高效的。该极限同时给出渐近 regret 的领先阶常数，并使正则化最小二乘估计量满足中心极限型定理，从而可对奖励参数做有效统计推断。
Motivation: LinUCB 在 worst-case regret 下界对应的难例上已知近最优（差对数因子），但其自适应采样本身是否信息高效、以及能否在此机制下做推断，此前缺少刻画。
Method: 用均场视角 (mean-field perspective) 把自适应决策在 horizon 上平均为经验采样分布这一宏观对象，刻画其 n→∞ 极限；再基于该最优设计极限推导 regret 领先阶常数，并证明正则化最小二乘估计量的中心极限型定理。
Result: small-gap regime 下 LinUCB 诱导的经验采样分布收敛到 D-optimal designs 集合；渐近 regret 的领先阶常数被刻画；正则化最小二乘估计量在该 regime 满足中心极限型定理，可对奖励参数做有效推断。
Conclusion: regret 驱动的在线学习与信息高效的实验设计在 small-gap regime 下相连：LinUCB 既近最优 minimax regret，采样分配又渐近 D-optimal，且自适应采样不妨碍对奖励参数的统计推断。

papers.title: Structured Representation Learning for Behavior Cloning: How can we learn to safely control a nuclear power plant?
papers.abstract_en: Learned models for industrial control are usually judged by aggregate accuracy, but accuracy at the component level does not guarantee safety once it is embedded in the system it is meant to serve. We study this gap on a behavior-cloning task: imitating an expert Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) policy for load-following of a Pressurized Water Reactor (PWR), an industrial system with tight safety constraints. We propose a structured architecture encoding variables from each timescale into separate latent spaces, reflecting the physical decomposition of the system, before training a controller to imitate the expert on the product latent space. On long-horizon rollouts, separated embeddings improve both accuracy and feasibility compared with a shared-embedding baseline. Sensitivity analysis further shows that our model yields interpretable representations aligned with the system's physics. However, standalone deployment still leaves several percent of trajectories infeasible regardless of the architecture. Using our method to warmstart the NMPC optimizer rather than acting standalone, we recover full feasibility and near-optimal cost while still cutting computation time by $\sim$15% relative to the expert controller, and even more for abrupt operating changes.
papers.journal_ref: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop AI Foundations for Power Grids, Dec 2026, Sydney (Australia), Australia
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在压水堆 (PWR) 负荷跟踪的模仿学习任务上，把不同时间尺度的变量编码进各自独立的 latent space、再在乘积空间上模仿专家 NMPC，长时域 rollout 中精度与可行性均优于共享 embedding 基线。但独立部署仍有数个百分点的轨迹不可行；改为用该模型 warmstart NMPC 优化器，则恢复完全可行、成本接近最优，相对专家控制器计算时间下降约 15%，突变工况下降幅更大。
Motivation: 工业控制模型通常只按聚合精度评估，而组件级精度不保证嵌入系统后的安全性；在带严格安全约束的 PWR 负荷跟踪上，行为克隆 (behavior cloning) 的开环精度与闭环可行性之间存在明显落差。
Method: 提出结构化表征架构：按系统物理分解把各时间尺度的变量分别编码到独立 latent space，再在乘积 latent space 上训练控制器模仿专家 Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) 策略；并做敏感性分析检查表征是否与系统物理对齐，同时对比共享 embedding 基线与用模型 warmstart NMPC 优化器两种用法。
Result: 长时域 rollout 上，分离 embedding 相对共享 embedding 基线同时提升精度与可行性；敏感性分析显示表征可解释且与系统物理一致。独立部署时无论何种架构仍有数个百分点 (several percent) 的轨迹不可行；用其 warmstart NMPC 优化器后恢复完全可行性、成本接近最优，计算时间相对专家控制器下降约 15%，突变工况下下降更多。
Conclusion: 结构化多时间尺度表征能改善模仿控制器的精度与可行性，但不足以支撑独立部署；把它用作 NMPC 优化器的 warmstart 才能同时拿到完全可行性、近最优成本和约 15% 的计算时间节省。

papers.title: MoCAR: Motion-code Coordinate-aware AutoRegression for Continuous Trajectory Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive generation is natural for language, where predicted tokens can be directly reused as the next prediction state, but trajectory forecasting lacks such a clean token: motion is continuous, multimodal, and expressed in local coordinate frames that evolve with the predicted trajectory. We present MoCAR (Motion-code Coordinate-aware AutoRegression), a decoder-only framework that casts trajectory forecasting as next-code prediction in a coordinate-aware continuous latent space. MoCAR learns a continuous motion-code space from endpoint-normalized trajectory segments, where each code jointly captures local trajectory geometry and the reference-frame transition induced by that segment. Historical motion codes are used as a teacher-forced prefix, future codes are generated autoregressively under temporal, map, agent, and mode interactions, and predicted codes persist in latent memory while decoded endpoints update the local scene context. This enables rollout without trajectory-space re-tokenization, trajectory queries, goal candidates, or proposal-and-refinement pipelines. On Argoverse (AV) benchmarks, MoCAR achieves top-tier performance with a simple single-stage architecture, transfers strongly from AV2 to AV1 in zero-shot evaluation, and improves on turn-heavy scenarios. Ablations confirm that the learned continuous motion-code space, latent alignment, weak KL regularization, and joint tokenizer-predictor optimization are essential for stable latent autoregression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoCAR 把轨迹预测改写成坐标感知连续隐空间里的 next-code 自回归：解码器只在 motion-code 空间滚动，解码出的端点再更新局部场景上下文，无需轨迹空间重新 token 化、轨迹查询或 goal 候选。在 Argoverse (AV) 基准上达到 top-tier 表现，AV2→AV1 零样本迁移强，转弯密集场景有提升。
Motivation: 语言里预测出的 token 可直接作为下一步输入，而轨迹是连续、多模态且局部坐标系随预测轨迹演化的，缺少等价的干净 token，导致常见流程依赖 proposal-and-refinement 与反复重 token 化。
Method: decoder-only 框架 MoCAR：从端点归一化的轨迹段学连续 motion-code 空间，每个 code 同时编码局部几何与该段引起的参考系转移；历史 motion code 作 teacher-forced 前缀，未来 code 在时间、地图、agent、mode 交互下自回归生成，预测 code 留在隐记忆中，解码端点更新局部场景上下文；tokenizer 与 predictor 联合优化，配合 latent alignment 与弱 KL 正则。
Result: 在 Argoverse (AV) 基准上以单阶段架构取得 top-tier 表现；AV2 到 AV1 的零样本迁移表现强；在转弯密集场景上有提升；消融确认连续 motion-code 空间、latent alignment、弱 KL 正则与 tokenizer-predictor 联合优化对稳定隐空间自回归是必要的。
Conclusion: 连续、坐标感知的 motion-code 自回归可以在不依赖轨迹重 token 化与 proposal-and-refinement 的前提下做轨迹预测，并靠联合优化与弱 KL 正则保持训练稳定。

papers.title: AI-Decision Checkpoints for AI-Augmented Business Process Management: Framework and Educational Instantiation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI agents are increasingly embedded in operational business processes. Yet Business Process Management (BPM) curricula and frameworks still largely treat artificial intelligence (AI) as an add-on technology, leaving graduates (as potential future process developers) unprepared to reason about AI as a first-class design element of end-to-end processes. This paper addresses that gap by proposing \emph{AI-decision checkpoints}: explicit moments in a process development trajectory where process developers identify AI-candidate sub-processes, assess expected effects on time, cost, quality, and flexibility, consider legal and organisational constraints, and document a reasoned decision to adopt, constrain, or reject specific AI components. The checkpoints are instantiated through a fictitious customer onboarding process as a \textit{BPM Teaching Case}, embedded in a lifecycle-driven framework spanning six modules that combine process modeling, simulation, workflow execution with AI agents, and process mining, with each module's output serving as the next module's input. A preliminary formative reflection draws on instructor observations, submitted artifacts, and discovered process maps from learning-management-system logs. These exploratory observations suggest that the approach supported clearer distinctions between task-level automation and process-level value.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AI-decision checkpoints：在流程开发轨迹中设置显式决策点，让开发者识别 AI 候选子流程、评估时间/成本/质量/柔性影响并记录采纳、约束或拒绝的决策。通过虚构客户入职流程的 BPM 教学案例与六模块生命周期框架（建模、仿真、AI agent 工作流执行、流程挖掘）落地，形成性反思显示该方法帮助学生更清晰地区分任务级自动化与流程级价值。
Motivation: BPM 课程与框架仍把 AI 当作附加技术，未来的流程开发者缺乏把 AI 作为端到端流程一等设计元素来推理的能力。
Method: 提出 AI-decision checkpoints 框架，含六个模块的生命周期驱动结构，每个模块输出作为下一模块输入，覆盖流程建模、仿真、带 AI agent 的工作流执行与流程挖掘；以虚构客户入职流程作为 BPM Teaching Case 实例化。
Result: 初步形成性反思基于教师观察、学生提交作品与学习管理系统日志中挖掘出的流程图；这些探索性观察显示该方法支持了任务级自动化与流程级价值之间更清晰的区分。
Conclusion: 把 AI 决策点显式嵌入流程开发生命周期，可让学习者对 AI 组件做出有理有据的采纳、约束或拒绝决策，并区分任务自动化与流程价值。

papers.title: Do Small Language Models Learn to Negotiate? A Controlled Scaling Study of RL-Trained Sellers
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are starting to own the full customer experience. Soon, LLMs may be selling and buying on behalf of companies and customers respectively. Small models are more cost-efficient at scale, but can reinforcement learning train them into competent sellers? We train four Gemma 4 checkpoints (2.3B to 31B effective parameters) with GRPO on a programmatic utility reward for bilateral multi-issue bargaining, and evaluate every arm on the same 1,152 negotiations against two frontier buyers it never saw in training. With the same learning rate ($10^{-6}$) for every size, the gain of the RL model over its base rises from $+0.001$ at 2.3B to $+0.078$ at 31B. Each size was trained once and the two smallest checkpoints use a different architecture, so we fit no scaling law. Tripling the learning rate, with the same or fewer training steps, improves on the shared rate at every size by $+0.032$ (2.3B) to $+0.081$ (4.5B). In exploratory comparisons with two frontier models run as sellers, the 12B seller trained at the tripled rate scores above both, though its untrained base already scores as high as they do. The 4.5B seller at that rate shows no detectable difference from either and fits on one 48 GB GPU. A further 2.3B arm at ten times the shared rate raises pooled score, but its gain concentrates on the evaluation buyer that shares a model family with the training pool. These results suggest tuning the learning rate before concluding that a small model cannot learn to negotiate, and testing against buyers from more than one model family.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Accepted (poster) at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on SLMs for Agentic Systems (SLM-Agents), Paris
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 GRPO 加程序化效用奖励训练 Gemma 4 四个规模（2.3B–31B 有效参数）的谈判卖家，在同一批 1,152 场多议题双边议价上评测。固定学习率 1e-6 时 RL 相对 base 的增益随规模从 +0.001 升到 +0.078；把学习率提高三倍后各规模都再提升 +0.032 到 +0.081，作者据此主张先调学习率再断定小模型学不会谈判，并要跨多个模型家族的买家测试。
Motivation: 小模型成本更低、适合大规模部署，但能否用强化学习训成合格的谈判卖家尚不清楚；固定超参的规模对比容易把学习率不当误判为模型能力上限。
Method: 对 Gemma 4 的四个 checkpoint（2.3B 至 31B 有效参数，最小两个架构不同）用 GRPO 训练，奖励为面向多议题双边议价的程序化效用 (programmatic utility reward)；所有规模先共用 1e-6 学习率，再各做三倍学习率与 2.3B 十倍学习率的对照臂，统一在 1,152 场谈判上评测，对手是训练中未见过的两个 frontier buyer。
Result: 共用 1e-6 时 RL 相对 base 的增益从 2.3B 的 +0.001 升至 31B 的 +0.078；学习率提高三倍、步数相同或更少时，各规模相对共用学习率再提升 +0.032（2.3B）到 +0.081（4.5B）。探索性对比中，三倍率训练的 12B 卖家得分高于两个 frontier 卖家模型，但其未训练 base 本就与之持平；4.5B 卖家与两者无可检出差异，且可放进单张 48 GB GPU。2.3B 十倍率臂抬高 pooled score，但增益集中在与训练池同模型家族的评测买家上。
Conclusion: 每个规模只训一次且最小两个 checkpoint 架构不同，作者因此不拟合 scaling law；结论是判定小模型能否谈判前应先调学习率，并用多模型家族的买家测试以避免家族偏置。

summary_sections.method: 对 Gemma 4 的四个 checkpoint（2.3B 至 31B 有效参数，最小两个架构不同）用 GRPO 训练，奖励为面向多议题双边议价的程序化效用 (programmatic utility reward)；所有规模先共用 1e-6 学习率，再各做三倍学习率与 2.3B 十倍学习率的对照臂，统一在 1,152 场谈判上评测，对手是训练中未见过的两个 frontier buyer。
summary_sections.result: 共用 1e-6 时 RL 相对 base 的增益从 2.3B 的 +0.001 升至 31B 的 +0.078；学习率提高三倍、步数相同或更少时，各规模相对共用学习率再提升 +0.032（2.3B）到 +0.081（4.5B）。探索性对比中，三倍率训练的 12B 卖家得分高于两个 frontier 卖家模型，但其未训练 base 本就与之持平；4.5B 卖家与两者无可检出差异，且可放进单张 48 GB GPU。2.3B 十倍率臂抬高 pooled score，但增益集中在与训练池同模型家族的评测买家上。
summary_sections.conclusion: 每个规模只训一次且最小两个 checkpoint 架构不同，作者因此不拟合 scaling law；结论是判定小模型能否谈判前应先调学习率，并用多模型家族的买家测试以避免家族偏置。

papers.title: EORestore-Agent: Fidelity-Guided Agentic Restoration of Remote Sensing Images with Composite Degradations
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing images often carry composite degradations, in which haze, cloud, noise, blur, low light, and low resolution coexist. Restoring them requires deciding which tool to apply, in what order, and when to stop, yet no clean reference is available at inference time to verify these decisions. All-in-one models trained on single degradations converge to a narrow PSNR band as degradations accumulate. To formulate real-world remote sensing restoration as a traceable trajectory, we present EORestore-Agent, which replaces this unmeasurable objective with reference-free, verifiable per-step decisions. A fine-tuned vision-language model reports all residual degradation types, whose tool pools are scored together, so the restoration order emerges from step-wise selection. A relative quality scorer, trained with full-reference supervision on synthetic degradation chains, predicts the changes in PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS from the current image to each candidate. A step is accepted only when no predicted change is negative and the predicted PSNR gain is positive. Otherwise, the agent keeps the current image. On a synthetic Landsat-8 benchmark with six degradation types, EORestore-Agent improves PSNR by 2.3 to 3.2 dB over the strongest retrained all-in-one baseline on composites of two to six degradations, whereas zero-shot natural-image agents fall below the degraded input in PSNR in 17 of 18 settings. Replacing the learned scorer with no-reference quality differences costs 1.1 to 4.6 dB. The remaining harmful steps are small and cluster near the acceptance threshold. Sentinel-2 examples illustrate transfer to real atmospheric degradation without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EORestore-Agent 把遥感图像复合退化恢复改写成可追溯的逐步决策：微调 VLM 报告残余退化类型并排序工具池，相对质量打分器预测每步 PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS 变化，只有预测 PSNR 增益为正且无负向变化才接受该步。在含六种退化的合成 Landsat-8 基准上，对二至六种复合退化比最强重训练的 all-in-one 基线高 2.3–3.2 dB；换成无参考质量差打分器会损失 1.1–4.6 dB。
Motivation: 遥感图像中雾、云、噪声、模糊、低光、低分辨率常复合共存，推理时没有干净参考可校验“用哪个工具、什么顺序、何时停止”；all-in-one 模型在单一退化上训练，随退化累积 PSNR 收敛到狭窄区间。
Method: 三段式 agent：微调 vision-language model 报告全部残余退化类型并给工具池打分，恢复顺序由逐步选择涌现；用合成退化链上的全参考监督训练相对质量打分器，预测当前图像到各候选的 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 变化；接受准则为预测变化无一为负且预测 PSNR 增益为正，否则保留当前图像。
Result: 在含六种退化的合成 Landsat-8 基准上，对二至六种复合退化，PSNR 比最强重训练 all-in-one 基线高 2.3 至 3.2 dB；零样本自然图像 agent 在 18 个设置中有 17 个 PSNR 低于退化输入；把学习打分器换成无参考质量差会损失 1.1 至 4.6 dB；残余有害步很小且聚集在接受阈值附近。
Conclusion: 无参考但可逐步验证的接受准则足以替代不可测的全参考目标，让复合退化恢复成为可追溯轨迹；打分器必须是学习得到的相对质量预测，无参考差分会明显掉点。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Loss-Invariant Projections as Passive Probes of Learned Representations
papers.abstract_en: Learned feature representations in neural networks often contain structure beyond that directly used by the final task output. We study this structure using $\textit{passive probes}$ that apply fixed, untrained, property-independent projections to representations as they evolve during training. We motivate this approach through the task of prediction on $S^2$ where equivalent vector and Hermitian parameterizations reveal an additional loss-invariant trace coordinate. This motivates a general construction in which fixed random projections serve as observers of learned features. Because the observer is loss-invariant and independent of the property being studied, changes in accessibility reflect changes in the representation relative to the fixed observer rather than adaptation of the observer itself. We show that ensembles of passive probes can directly reflect task-relevant information such as target alignment. Under our constructions, the accessibility of eventual difficulty evolves differently across tasks. It increases during training in the regression tasks of surface-normal estimation and image inpainting but remains near its initial level in image classification. Comparisons with learned linear probes further show that recoverability and passive accessibility can evolve differently during training. Together, these results show how passive probes can separately characterize changes in representation geometry and the accessibility of eventual task difficulty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出被动探针 (passive probes)：对训练中的表征施加固定、未训练、与属性无关的随机投影，因其损失不变，可访问性的变化只反映表征相对固定观察者的变化。在 S² 上预测任务中，向量与 Hermitian 参数化等价但多出一个损失不变的迹坐标；表面法线估计与图像修补的可访问性随训练上升，而图像分类基本持平初始水平。
Motivation: 神经网络表征中存在最终任务输出未直接使用的结构，而学习式线性探针本身会随训练适应，无法区分表征几何变化与探针自身变化。
Method: 用固定随机投影作为观察者构成被动探针集合；以 S² 上预测任务中等价的向量与 Hermitian 参数化揭示额外的损失不变迹坐标作为动机，再推广为一般构造，并与学习式线性探针 (learned linear probes) 对比。
Result: 被动探针集合可直接反映任务相关信息如目标对齐 (target alignment)；最终难度的可访问性在表面法线估计与图像修补两个回归任务中随训练上升，在图像分类中保持在初始水平附近；与学习式线性探针的比较显示可恢复性 (recoverability) 与被动可访问性在训练中可不同步演化。
Conclusion: 损失不变的固定投影能把表征几何变化与最终任务难度的可访问性分开刻画，且这两者在训练中不必同步。

papers.title: Correct Code, Broken Contributions? SWE-CC: Benchmarking Repository Policy Compliance for Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous coding agents now resolve a substantial share of real-world GitHub issues. However, passing functional tests differs fundamentally from producing a high-quality contribution acceptable for merging. Mature open-source projects publish repository-specific contribution policies, spanning style, git, testing workflows, to ensure code quality and long-term maintainability. Because existing benchmarks evaluate patches solely on unit tests, agent compliance with repository governance remains unknown. In this paper, we introduce SWE-CC, a benchmark evaluating code and process compliance in autonomous software engineering. We develop a semi-automated pipeline that converts developer documentation across 12 open-source repositories into 823 machine-checkable atomic policies. SWE-CC introduces two features: 1) lightweight, deterministic checker functions that represent each policy, 2) a comprehensive auditing mechanism that inspects both agent runtime behaviors and final deliverables. We evaluate the compliance of agent workflows in 500 end-to-end software contribution tasks extended from SWE-bench Verified. Our evaluation of four LLMs under two agent scaffolds shows that modern agents suffer from coding compliance issues: although agents produce functionally correct patches, they still violate 43.1 percent of applicable project policies, with nearly half of all violations occurring during intermediate execution steps. These results show that functional correctness does not guarantee real-world readiness, highlighting that future software engineering agents must reliably conform to repository governance to enable safe and trustworthy deployment.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 6 figures. Benchmark and source code: https://github.com/dangtruong01/swe-cc-arxiv
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWE-CC 是评估编码智能体仓库治理合规性的基准：把 12 个开源项目的开发者文档转成 823 条可机器检查的原子策略，用确定性 checker 同时审计运行时行为与最终产物。在 500 个由 SWE-CC Verified 扩展的端到端贡献任务上测 4 个 LLM、2 种 agent scaffold，功能正确的补丁仍违反 43.1% 的适用策略，近一半违规发生在中间执行步骤。
Motivation: 现有基准只看单元测试是否通过，功能正确不等于可合并；成熟开源项目的贡献策略（风格、git、测试流程）对 agent 的遵守情况此前无从得知。
Method: 半自动流水线把 12 个开源仓库的开发者文档转为 823 条原子策略，每条策略配一个轻量确定性 checker 函数；审计机制同时检查 agent 运行时行为与最终交付物，在 500 个扩展自 SWE-bench Verified 的端到端贡献任务上评估。
Result: 4 个 LLM 在 2 种 agent scaffold 下，功能正确的补丁仍违反 43.1% 的适用项目策略；全部违规中近一半发生在中间执行步骤而非最终产物。
Conclusion: 功能正确性不保证真实可部署：未来软件工程 agent 必须可靠遵守仓库治理规则，才能安全可信地落地。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Copies or Sources? Measuring How LLM Aggregators Count Restated Evidence in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) restate observations as a matter of course: relays forward them, shared boards repeat them and discussion rounds echo them. An aggregator that pools such messages should count sources, not statements. We convert a reported probability into units of independent readings, which assigns every restatement a copy weight, 0 for an aggregator that counts sources and 1 for one that counts every statement, and yields the implied decision under any cost structure. Three testbeds hold the evidence fixed and vary how it is restated: message logs with an exact Bayesian oracle, web documents with appended copies, and logs written by LLM agent teams under four communication protocols. Across four models from three providers, a forwarded copy counts for 0.06 to 0.42 of a new reading, mostly because some replies count every statement. On 5% to 40% of logs that state one reading three times, the reported belief implies an early commitment that the oracle never makes. The models that count copies least and most on controlled logs do so on web copies and agent-written logs as well. A one-paragraph declaration of what a copy contributes brings the copy weight on controlled logs to 0.08 or less. A rule that has agents refer to readings instead of restating them cuts belief-implied early commitment from 11.2% to 1.1% and preserves genuine corroboration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 多智能体聚合器会把重复转述当成独立证据：把报告概率换算成独立读数单位，定义 copy weight（数来源为 0、数每条陈述为 1），在三个测试集上测得一次转发副本被计为 0.06–0.42 个新读数。当 5%–40% 的日志把同一读数说三遍时，报告信念会做出贝叶斯 oracle 不会做的过早承诺；一段声明让 copy weight 降到 0.08 及以下，让 agent 引用读数而非复述则把过早承诺从 11.2% 降到 1.1%。
Motivation: 多智能体系统里 relay 转发、共享板重复、讨论轮回声都会让同一证据以多条消息出现，聚合器若按陈述计数而非按来源计数，就会系统性高估独立证据量并做出过早承诺。
Method: 把报告概率换算成独立读数单位，为每条复述赋 copy weight（0=数来源，1=数每条陈述），并推出任意代价结构下的隐含决策；在三个测试集上固定证据只改变复述方式：带精确 Bayesian oracle 的消息日志、追加副本的网页文档、四种通信协议下 LLM agent 团队写出的日志，覆盖三家提供商的四个模型。
Result: 一次转发副本被计为 0.06–0.42 个新读数，主因是部分回复把每条陈述都当独立证据；在 5%–40% 把同一读数说三遍的日志上，报告信念隐含 oracle 不会做的过早承诺；受控日志上 copy weight 最低与最高的模型在网页副本和 agent 日志上排序一致；一段声明使受控日志 copy weight 降到 0.08 及以下；让 agent 引用读数而非复述的规则把信念隐含的过早承诺从 11.2% 降到 1.1%，且保留真实佐证。
Conclusion: 聚合器应按来源而非陈述计数；显式声明副本贡献、或让 agent 引用读数而非复述，都能把重复转述导致的过早承诺压到接近 oracle 水平，同时不损失真实 corroboration。

summary_sections.conclusion: 聚合器应按来源而非陈述计数；显式声明副本贡献、或让 agent 引用读数而非复述，都能把重复转述导致的过早承诺压到接近 oracle 水平，同时不损失真实 corroboration。

papers.title: Judged Useless, Queried Anyway: Tool-Using Agents Rarely Turn Their Own Evidence Judgments into Stopping Decisions
papers.abstract_en: An agent whose tool keeps returning nothing useful should stop relying on it. In a retrieval environment with controlled source failures, we separate how agents judge results from what they do. We compare stopping at the same step after longer and shorter runs of results the agent judged useless; this contrast is zero for clock- or deadline-driven stopping. Where we record their judgments, the seven agents we test call a failing source's results useless 97-100% of the time, yet most of them rarely stop on that judgment. Prompt cues change when they stop but not what they stop on. Permission to answer from memory and a reasoning mode can bring early stops regardless of evidence, a stated budget moves the 7-8B models' stops to the deadline, and a stopping rule or call cost in the prompt is followed at most partly. Stopping follows the evidence only when the harness enforces an integration step that makes the agent answer after five consecutive results it judged useless. This step raises failing-source success for every model, keeps the stopping point fixed when the budget doubles, and needs no extra judgment call when the agent states its judgments. A pre-registered replication on 300 fresh questions confirms the dissociation and the rule's effect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在可控源故障的检索环境中，7 个工具型 agent 把失败源结果判为无用的比例高达 97-100%，却几乎不据此停止查询，判断与停止决策完全脱钩。只有当 harness 强制在连续 5 次被判无用的结果后作答，停止才跟随证据：每个模型的失败源成功率都提升，预算翻倍时停止点不变。
Motivation: agent 的工具持续返回无用结果时本应停止依赖它，但其显式证据判断与实际停止行为之间存在脱钩，导致在失败源上浪费查询。
Method: 在带受控源故障的检索环境中分离“判断”与“行动”，对比在更长与更短的无用结果序列后同一步停止（对时钟/截止驱动的停止该对比为零）；测试 7 个 agent，操纵 prompt 线索、凭记忆作答许可、推理模式、预算、停止规则与调用成本，并加入强制整合步骤（连续 5 次判无用后必须作答），最后在 300 道新题上做预注册复现。
Result: 7 个 agent 对失败源结果判为无用的比例为 97-100%，但多数很少据此停止；prompt 线索改变何时停而不改变停在什么上；预算使 7-8B 模型的停止点移到截止时间；强制整合步骤提升每个模型的失败源成功率，预算翻倍时停止点保持固定；300 道新题的预注册复现确认了该脱钩及规则效果。
Conclusion: 仅靠 prompt 里的停止规则或调用成本只能被部分遵循，停止真正跟随证据的前提是 harness 强制一个整合步骤；当 agent 陈述自身判断时该步骤无需额外判断调用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bridging the Evidence-to-Execution Gap:A Reflective Agent for Multi-Objective Peptide Design
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can reason over scientific literature to devise design strategies, yet fail to reliably implement them for biological sequences. While protein generative models learn sequence patterns, they lack the capacity to incorporate literature evidence for multi-step reflective reasoning, forming an evidence-to-execution gap between scientific reasoning and sequence manipulation. We present EASER (Evidence-Aware Sequence Engineering with Reflection), a reflective agent bridging reasoning and sequence generation via a learned property interface of offline-trained, fixed low-rank matrices. The agent steers a diffusion generator by combining these matrices, proposing intervention hypotheses (anchors, editable positions, control coefficients) grounded in retrieved evidence, sequence context and past results. A Probe-and-Steer mechanism validates interventions and allocates samples according to predicted property responses, with outcome reflection informing subsequent decisions. Evaluated on multi-objective antimicrobial peptide design (optimizing activity, non-hemolysis and non-toxicity), explicit hypothesis formulation delivers better multi-objective performance than direct action generation under identical decision conditions. Ablation studies verify the importance of evidence retrieval, episodic history, reflection and Probe-and-Steer. Over six repeated trials, EASER obtains the highest mean hypervolume and lowest mean IGD+ on screened candidates compared with competing baselines. Our work demonstrates how an executable property interface and iterative feedback link scientific reasoning to targeted peptide sequence generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出反思型智能体 EASER，用离线训练的固定低秩矩阵构成可执行的属性接口，把文献证据驱动的多步推理接到扩散生成器上，通过 Probe-and-Steer 验证干预并按预测属性响应分配样本。在多目标抗菌肽设计（活性、非溶血、非毒性）上，显式假设生成比直接动作生成取得更好的多目标表现，六次重复试验中 EASER 的平均 hypervolume 最高、IGD+ 最低。
Motivation: LLM 能从文献推理出设计策略，却难以可靠落实到生物序列操作；蛋白生成模型学得到序列模式，但无法纳入文献证据做多步反思推理，形成证据到执行的断层。
Method: EASER 以离线训练的固定低秩矩阵线性组合作为属性接口来操控扩散生成器，提出基于检索证据、序列上下文与历史结果的干预假设（anchors、editable positions、control coefficients）；Probe-and-Steer 机制验证干预并按预测属性响应分配样本，结果反思 (outcome reflection) 更新后续决策。
Result: 在多目标抗菌肽设计（优化活性、非溶血、非毒性）上，相同决策条件下显式假设生成的多目标表现优于直接动作生成；六次重复试验中，EASER 在筛选候选上取得最高平均 hypervolume 与最低平均 IGD+，高于对比基线；消融验证了证据检索、episodic history、反思与 Probe-and-Steer 各自的重要性。
Conclusion: 可执行的属性接口加迭代反馈能把科学推理与定向肽序列生成连起来，显式假设而非直接动作是多目标序列设计更有效的决策形式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Two-Point Local Optimality in $k$-Means via Boundary-Point Screening
papers.abstract_en: Lloyd's algorithm and the discrete local (D-local) optimization method (Li et al., 2025) for $k$-means provide only weak local-optimality guarantees, and their solution quality remains sensitive to initialization. In this paper, we introduce $r$-point local optimality, under which no reassignment of at most $r$ samples decreases the objective function, and focus on $r=2$. The main computational obstacle is the $\mathcal{O}(n^2(k^2+d))$ cost of exhaustive two-point certification for $n$ samples in $d$ dimensions and $k$ clusters. To address this challenge, we prove that (i) every improving two-point move of a D-local optimum must involve a cluster shared by both reassignments, and (ii) only certificate-defined boundary points can participate in an improving pair. Exploiting this structure, we propose Boundary-Point-Screened Two-Point Local Search (BPS-2PLS), which terminates at a two-point local optimum. For fixed $k,d$ and nonvanishing cluster occupancy, the number $m$ of retained candidates satisfies $m=\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}}(\log n)$ under i.i.d. sampling from a bounded-support distribution with bounded density or from a Gaussian mixture. Across twelve benchmarks, BPS-2PLS attains the lowest available mean WCSS on ten. In a subsampling study, screening retains 0.10% to 2.81% of samples on average at the largest tested sizes. The code is available at https://github.com/lwl-learning/BPS-2PLS.
papers.comment: 30 pages, including appendices. Code available at https://github.com/lwl-learning/BPS-2PLS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 k-means 的 r 点局部最优定义（r=2：任意至多样本重分配都不能降目标），并证明改进型两样本移动必共享同一簇、且只有证书定义的边界点可参与，据此构造 BPS-2PLS 筛选局部搜索。在固定 k、d 与非零簇占用下保留候选数 m=O_P(log n)；十二个基准中十个取得最低可用 mean WCSS，最大规模下平均仅保留 0.10%–2.81% 样本。
Motivation: Lloyd 算法与 D-local 优化只给出很弱的局部最优保证，解质量对初始化敏感；穷举两样本认证代价为 O(n^2(k^2+d))，难以在大规模上做两点半局部最优判定。
Method: 定义 r 点局部最优并取 r=2；证明两条结构结论（改进移动必共享簇、只有边界点可参与），据此提出 Boundary-Point-Screened Two-Point Local Search (BPS-2PLS)，从有界支撑有界密度分布或高斯混合的 i.i.d. 采样中筛选候选并迭代至两点半局部最优。
Result: 固定 k、d 且簇占用非消失时保留候选数 m=O_P(log n)；十二个基准中 BPS-2PLS 在十个上取得最低可用 mean WCSS；子采样研究中最大测试规模下平均仅保留 0.10% 到 2.81% 的样本。
Conclusion: 两样本改进移动的结构约束足以把 O(n^2(k^2+d)) 的穷举认证压缩到对数级候选集，从而在可控开销下给出比 Lloyd 与 D-local 更强的局部最优保证。

papers.title: Anlu: Enabling In-Context Time Series Anomaly Detection in Foundation Models via Counterfactual Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Whether a time-series pattern is anomalous often depends on the operating regime of the monitored process. A missing event can signal a fault in one regime and be routine in another, and the query alone may not reveal which regime applies. We study in-context learning (ICL) for time series anomaly detection (TSAD) through reference-conditioned detection, where a reference record provides evidence about expected behavior and model parameters remain fixed at inference. Supplying the reference is not enough: when training anomalies are recognizable from the query alone, the detector can fit its targets while ignoring the reference. We therefore introduce counterfactual supervision, which pairs one query with two references that support different normal rules and labels the query under each. At positions where the two labels disagree, no detector that ignores the reference can fit both targets. Anlu learns from this supervision by adding a reference memory and zero-initialized gated adapters to a frozen time-series foundation model (TSFM) pretrained for anomaly detection. On the 350 TSB-AD-U evaluation sequences, Anlu raises the mean VUS-PR of the frozen TSFM from 0.542 to 0.607. Replacing the reference with zeros lowers Anlu's score to 0.499.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Anlu 用反事实监督 (counterfactual supervision) 让冻结的时序基础模型 (TSFM) 真正依赖参考记录做上下文异常检测：同一 query 配两条支持不同正常规则的 reference 并分别标注，标签分歧处任何忽略 reference 的检测器都无法同时拟合。在 350 条 TSB-AD-U 评测序列上，冻结 TSFM 的平均 VUS-PR 从 0.542 提到 0.607；把 reference 换成全零后分数跌到 0.499，说明增益确实来自参考条件而非 query 本身。
Motivation: 时序异常与否取决于被监控过程的运行工况 (regime)，同一 query 在不同工况下标签相反，仅凭 query 无法判定；而直接提供 reference 时，若训练异常可从 query 单独识别，检测器会拟合目标却忽略 reference。
Method: 采用 reference-conditioned detection，推理时模型参数固定。训练用反事实监督：一个 query 配两条给出不同正常规则的 reference，并在各自条件下标注；标签分歧位置迫使模型读取 reference。网络上在为异常检测预训练的冻结 TSFM 上加 reference memory 与零初始化的 gated adapters。
Result: 在 350 条 TSB-AD-U 评测序列上，Anlu 将冻结 TSFM 的平均 VUS-PR 从 0.542 提升到 0.607；将 reference 替换为全零后，Anlu 得分降至 0.499。
Conclusion: 反事实监督能阻止检测器绕过 reference，使冻结 TSFM 的上下文异常检测在 TSB-AD-U 上获得可归因于参考条件的 VUS-PR 提升。

papers.title: Auditable Clinical Timeline Reconstruction with Provenance-Aware Evidence Graphs
papers.abstract_en: A patient-timeline reconstruction system is auditable only if it keeps the mentions behind each answer, records how facts were revised, and declines to answer when the evidence is not in the text. This study tests these three properties on a fully synthetic corpus (1,000 patients, 3,353 notes, 220 revision edges). Two provenance-aware Evidence Graph operators reduced the node-plus-edge count to 67% and 63% (77-78% of serialized size) while preserving every answer and mention link across 6,813 query points answerable by recency; a fixed-window baseline returned no value for 53.4% of points, unflagged. On evidence-unavailable controls that announce the omission, a BioClinicalBERT gate and a zero-shot LLM gate responded mainly to the announcement. On marker-free controls, BERT abstained on 0 of 81 notes while its accuracy fell from 93.8% to 59.3% across all three relation classes; the LLM's coverage fell from 75.6% to 27.7% on notes its own model family judged undeterminable. Against 482 regenerated gold spans, the LLM's cited evidence reached recall 0.850 and precision 0.864; BERT's span head, trained without span labels, did not localize evidence. A temporally versioned provenance graph stored abstentions as typed, queryable edges. The clean task admits a 0.651-accuracy shortcut, and results describe implementation behaviour on synthetic data, not clinical performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 1,000 名合成患者、3,353 篇病历、220 条修订边的语料上，检验临床时间线重建的三项可审计性质：保留答案背后的 mention、记录事实修订、证据不在文本时拒答。两个 provenance-aware Evidence Graph 算子把节点加边数压到 67% 与 63%（序列化体积的 77–78%），在 6,813 个可按 recency 回答的查询点上完整保留全部答案与 mention 链接，而固定窗口基线对 53.4% 的点无标记地返回空值。
Motivation: 患者时间线系统若不保留答案依据、不记录事实修订、在证据缺失时仍作答，就无法审计；现有做法在证据不可得时既不拒答也不标记，固定窗口基线对过半查询点静默返回空值。

papers.title: What Does It Cost to Simulate a Quantum Sentence Classifier? An Energy and Compute Perspective on Near-Term QNLP
papers.abstract_en: Near-term quantum natural language processing (QNLP) experiments often run on classical simulators, so simulator cost is part of the field's practical compute burden, yet accuracy tables do not show it. We measure that cost for a variational quantum classifier (VQC) on binary SST-2 sentiment classification, using PennyLane's state-vector simulator over a controlled grid of 27 configurations: three balanced training-set sizes (N = 200, 500, 1000), three qubit counts (4, 6, 8), and three circuit depths. Each VQC is compared with logistic regression on the same PCA-reduced input; full TF-IDF logistic regression gives an uncompressed reference. The VQC beats its matched baseline in 6 of 27 single-seed comparisons. After reruns at two further seeds, only 1 of these 6 keeps a positive mean advantage larger than its paired seed-to-seed variability, and paired tests on the fixed validation set do not establish it. VQC training is 886-21,127 times slower in measured wall-clock time than the matched classical fit (median 3,158 times); going from 4 to 8 qubits roughly doubles simulator time, and within the tested range per-step cost is well approximated by a linear function of the parameter count. CodeCarbon energy and CO2 estimates are secondary: they imply an almost constant power of about 41 W, so they add little beyond runtime, and we do not build an energy ratio from them. The study is narrow (one dataset, representation, ansatz, simulator, and CPU environment) and is a reproducible feasibility measurement, not a general verdict on QNLP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 PennyLane state-vector 模拟器上实测近端 QNLP 变分量子分类器 (VQC) 的仿真成本：27 组配置（N=200/500/1000 × 4/6/8 qubits × 三种线路深度）下，VQC 训练比匹配的经典逻辑回归慢 886–21,127 倍（中位数 3,158 倍），而精度优势在多种子复跑后基本消失。
Motivation: 近端 QNLP 实验多在经典模拟器上跑，模拟器开销是该领域的实际算力负担，但论文的精度表完全不体现这部分成本。
Method: 在 SST-2 二分类情感任务上训练 VQC，用 PennyLane state-vector 模拟器扫 27 组配置（三个平衡训练集规模 N=200/500/1000、三个 qubit 数 4/6/8、三种线路深度）；每个 VQC 与同一 PCA 降维输入上的逻辑回归对比，另以全 TF-IDF 逻辑回归作未压缩参照；单种子胜出项再用两个额外种子复跑并做配对检验，能耗用 CodeCarbon 估算。
Result: VQC 在 27 组单种子比较中有 6 组胜过匹配基线；两个额外种子复跑后仅 1 组的平均优势大于配对种子间变异，且固定验证集上的配对检验未能确立该优势。训练墙钟时间比匹配经典拟合慢 886–21,127 倍（中位数 3,158 倍）；qubit 从 4 增到 8 使模拟时间约翻倍，测试范围内单步开销近似为参数量的线性函数。CodeCarbon 给出约 41 W 的近似恒定功率，作者不据此构造能耗比。
Conclusion: 在该设置下 VQC 的精度优势经多种子检验不成立，而仿真成本高出三个数量级；作者将此定位为可复现的可行性测量而非对 QNLP 的总体裁决，且研究范围限于单一数据集、表示、ansatz、模拟器与 CPU 环境。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Anosognosia in LLMs: Probing Self-Awareness of Quantized Computational Substrate
papers.abstract_en: Can LLMs recognize degradation in their own computational substrate? Inspired by anosognosia, a neurological condition in which patients fail to recognize impairments in their own abilities, we investigate whether LLMs can recognize degradation in their computational substrate induced by quantization. We first show that existing models fail to self-report their quantization state, even when provided with their own generated text as an external cue. Linear probing reveals that, while generated text carries almost no trace of quantization, internal representations contain clear, method-specific fingerprints. Through training, models learn to identify severely degraded outputs such as those of 4-bit models by comparison, yet still fail to do so from a single output. A shared LoRA trained jointly across quantization levels succeeded in reading out internal fingerprints, but fails on unseen quantization methods, merely mapping method-specific fingerprints to labels. Whereas external self-observation can restore awareness in some cases of human anosognosia, our results suggest that the more promising route to enabling such awareness in LLMs may lie in their internal representations. Our results highlight fundamental limits of generalizability to LLM self-monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 问 LLM 能否察觉自身被量化降级：模型无法自报量化状态，即使给出自己生成的文本作外部线索；线性探针显示生成文本几乎不含量化痕迹，而内部表征带有清晰的方法特异指纹。跨量化位数联合训练的共享 LoRA 能读出内部指纹，却在未见过的量化方法上失效，说明 LLM 自监控的泛化存在根本限制，更可行的路径在内部表征而非外部自观察。
Motivation: LLM 部署中量化会改变计算基底，但模型是否知道自己被降级、以及这种自我觉察能否泛化到新量化方法，此前没有检验；这对应人类 anosognosia（病感缺失）式的自我监控失效。
Method: 以量化（quantization）作为基底退化手段，先测模型能否自报量化状态（含提供自身生成文本作外部线索），再用线性探针 (linear probing)比较生成文本与内部表征中的量化痕迹，并训练跨量化位数共享的 LoRA 读出内部指纹，测试其在未见量化方法上的表现。
Result: 现有模型无法自报量化状态，即使提供其自身生成文本作外部线索；生成文本几乎不含量化痕迹，而内部表征含清晰的方法特异指纹；经训练的模型能靠比较识别 4-bit 模型等严重退化输出，但对单条输出仍失败；共享 LoRA 在训练过的量化位数上成功读出指纹，却在未见的量化方法上失效，仅把方法特异指纹映射到标签。
Conclusion: LLM 的量化自我觉察主要存在于内部表征而非外部自观察，且当前读出方式只是记忆方法特异指纹，对新量化方法不泛化，构成 LLM 自监控的根本性泛化限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MS-Exam-Gen: Source-Grounded Benchmark Construction for Evaluating LLMs on Textual Multiple Sclerosis MRI Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Biomedical large language model (LLM) evaluation requires auditable assessment of narrow, evolving, source-grounded subspecialty knowledge. Multiple sclerosis MRI (MS-MRI) provides a high-stakes textual-knowledge test case because correct reasoning requires current diagnostic criteria, standardized acquisition and reporting knowledge, longitudinal monitoring concepts, lesion morphology, and recognition of difficult mimics. We present MS-Exam-Gen, a reproducible framework for constructing and auditing a text-based multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmark for MS-MRI knowledge; it does not evaluate direct MRI image interpretation. MS-Exam-Gen targets source-grounded criteria, protocols, reporting, and differential diagnosis. The framework combines expert-source indexing, exam-oriented topic induction, evidence-grounded MCQ generation, automated quality audits, a same-family consistency screen, and empirical calibration. From a 66-source corpus indexed into 4,289 retrieval chunks, the pipeline produced a locked 3,058-item candidate benchmark spanning 16 topics and 53 subtopics. Evaluation across 12 primary LLM endpoints yielded 36,696 item-level predictions and separated performance over a 42.8-percentage-point accuracy range (89.7% to 46.9%). Across these endpoints, 25.5% of items were missed by at least four. Post-generation audits showed that refreshed construction reduced measurable answer cues, while option-order testing showed that absolute MCQ scores remain position-sensitive. Generated construction labels remain metadata rather than validated psychometric categories. Because expert adjudication and full option-order counterbalancing remain future work, MS-Exam-Gen is not a clinically certified examination. It should be interpreted as an automatically filtered, source-grounded candidate benchmark and reproducible audit workflow for item-level and topic-specific LLM evaluation.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Accepted for publication to BHI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MS-Exam-Gen 是一个可复现的 MS-MRI 文本知识 MCQ 基准构建与审计框架，从 66 个来源、4,289 个检索块生成锁定的 3,058 题基准（16 topics、53 subtopics）。在 12 个 LLM 端点上产生 36,696 条预测，准确率跨度 42.8 个百分点（89.7% 到 46.9%），25.5% 的题目至少被四个端点答错。
Motivation: 生物医学 LLM 评测需要可审计、来源可追溯的窄领域知识测试，而 MS-MRI 涉及不断更新的诊断标准、报告规范与鉴别诊断，通用基准难以覆盖。
Method: 框架组合专家来源索引、考试导向的 topic 归纳、证据支撑的 MCQ 生成、自动质量审计、同族一致性筛查与经验校准；明确只测文本知识，不做 MRI 图像解读。
Result: 66 个来源索引为 4,289 个检索块，产出锁定的 3,058 题候选基准，覆盖 16 topics 与 53 subtopics；12 个主 LLM 端点共 36,696 条题目级预测，准确率跨度 42.8 个百分点（89.7% 至 46.9%），25.5% 的题目至少被四个端点答错；刷新后的构建降低了可测答案线索，但选项顺序测试显示绝对 MCQ 分数仍对位置敏感。
Conclusion: MS-Exam-Gen 是经自动过滤、来源可追溯的候选基准与可复现审计工作流，用于题目级与主题级 LLM 评测；因专家裁定与完整选项顺序平衡仍是后续工作，它不是临床认证考试，生成的构建标签仅是元数据而非已验证的心理测量类别。

papers.title: Bayesian Optimization in Sequence-to-Architecture Latent Space for Zero-Shot NAS
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot Neural Architecture Search removes the prohibitive cost of traditional NAS, but its search process is typically based on the evolutionary algorithm (EA); lacking an explicit model of the objective, it often resorts to a near-random search through mutation. Bayesian Optimization offers a principled alternative by modeling the objective and aggregating information across iterations, but scales poorly to the high-dimensional, discrete, graph-structured spaces of modern NAS, restricting its use to only small networks. In this paper, we bring Bayesian Optimization to zero-shot NAS for large-scale architectures by learning a latent space via a Variational Autoencoder trained to reconstruct a novel prefix encoding of architectures and propose a proxy scalarization that combines several zero-shot proxies into a single Bayesian Optimization objective. After only 10,000 iterations of the proposed search algorithm (8 hours on a single GPU), our method found a network architecture which under the given model parameter count constraints achieves state-of-the-art results on three separate tasks -- image classification, object detection and semantic segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把贝叶斯优化 (Bayesian Optimization) 引入零样本 NAS：用 VAE 学架构前缀编码 (prefix encoding) 的潜空间，再以代理标量化 (proxy scalarization) 把多个零样本代理合成单一 BO 目标。搜索仅 10,000 次迭代、单 GPU 8 小时，即在给定参数量约束下找到的架构于图像分类、目标检测、语义分割三项任务达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 零样本 NAS 的搜索通常靠进化算法 (EA) 的近随机变异，缺少显式目标模型；BO 虽能建模目标并跨迭代聚合信息，却难以扩展到现代 NAS 的高维、离散、图结构空间，只能用于小网络。
Method: 训练一个 VAE 重构架构的新型前缀编码，从而学出连续潜空间供 BO 搜索；同时提出 proxy scalarization，把多个零样本代理合并为单一 BO 目标，在给定模型参数量约束下搜索大规模架构。
Result: 搜索算法仅运行 10,000 次迭代（单 GPU 8 小时）即找到一个架构，在给定参数量约束下于图像分类、目标检测、语义分割三项任务上取得 state-of-the-art 结果。
Conclusion: 借助潜空间建模与代理标量化，贝叶斯优化可扩展到大规模零样本 NAS，并在参数量受限条件下同时覆盖分类、检测、分割三类任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Where Did the Repair First Go Wrong? Localizing the Origins of Silent Failures in Agentic Vulnerability Repair
papers.abstract_en: Localizing where an LLM-based agent first fails to uphold security during a repair can show which stage of its workflow needs an additional safeguard. This is difficult for silent failures, which are patches that pass syntactic and functional checks but still contain a security vulnerability. Because such patches give no observable failure signal, existing failure attribution methods, which rely on observed task failures and labelled failure steps, are less suited to them. We propose Security Awareness Gap Evaluation (SAGE), a trace-based method that combines an assessment of the security reasoning recorded at each turn with the reconstructed code history to identify the earliest turn at which a repair diverges from the task's security intent. We evaluate SAGE on 95 confirmed silent failures drawn from 3,684 repair traces produced by six agent frameworks and six base models on SecurityEval and CVEfixes. SAGE assigned an origin in 93 cases. Most origins were an unaddressed security requirement or an inadequate defence choice, and only five coincided with the code change itself. When the agent introduced the vulnerable code, the origin preceded the write in 14 of 19 cases. Repeated scoring and a second judge reproduced the origin type more consistently than the exact turn, and agreement was lowest for traces that kept only the final file.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于轨迹的 SAGE 方法，把每轮记录的安全推理评估与重建的代码历史结合，定位 LLM agent 漏洞修复中首个静默失败 (silent failure) 的来源轮次。在 6 个 agent 框架、6 个基座模型产出的 3,684 条修复轨迹中的 95 个已确认静默失败上，SAGE 在 93 例中给出来源；多数来源是未处理的安全需求或不当防御选择，仅 5 例与代码改动本身重合。
Motivation: 静默失败的补丁能通过语法与功能检查却仍留漏洞，没有可观测失败信号，依赖已观测任务失败与标注失败步骤的归因方法对这类失败不适用；定位首个出错轮次才能指出工作流哪一步需要加安全护栏。
Method: SAGE 结合每一轮 (turn) 记录的安全推理评估与重建的代码历史，判定修复偏离任务安全意图的最早轮次；在 SecurityEval 与 CVEfixes 上，用六个 agent 框架与六个基座模型产生的修复轨迹进行评测，并用重复打分与第二评审者 (judge) 检验来源类型与轮次的一致性。
Result: 评测覆盖 95 个已确认静默失败，来自 3,684 条修复轨迹；SAGE 在 93 例中给出来源。多数来源为未处理的安全需求或不当防御选择，仅 5 例与代码改动本身重合；当 agent 引入漏洞代码时，19 例中有 14 例的来源早于写入动作。重复打分与第二评审者对来源类型的一致性高于对确切轮次，仅保留最终文件的轨迹一致性最低。
Conclusion: 静默失败的根源多在代码写入之前的安全需求与防御决策阶段，而非代码改动本身，因此护栏应加在这些前置环节；来源类型可稳定复现，确切轮次的复现性较弱，且轨迹只保留最终文件时判定最不可靠。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: TIGER: Time-Series Classification with In-Context-Learning Gated Ensemble of Representations
papers.abstract_en: A representation family is a distinct way of extracting features from time series. Ensemble algorithms that combine several representation families remain the most accurate approach to time series classification. Current state-of-the-art ensembles, most notably HIVE-COTE~2.0, pair a bespoke classification algorithm with each representation family and combine their predictions using a fixed, non-adaptive rule. We present TIGER (Time-series classification with In-context-learning Gated Ensemble of Representations), which instead applies the same small portfolio of three general-purpose classifiers (Ridge, Extra Trees, and Naive Bayes) to four representations from four distinct families, stacking the resulting twelve base learners' predictions into a meta-feature matrix. The final prediction is produced by an adaptive meta-classification rule that chooses, independently for each data set, between a weighted hard majority vote and TabICLv2, a pretrained tabular foundation model used in-context as a meta-classifier, based on the mean number of training samples available per class. On a 142-data-set benchmark drawn from the UCR time series classification archive, TIGER obtains the best mean accuracy, balanced accuracy, and F1-score among six compared algorithms, including HIVE-COTE~2.0, and significantly outperforms each of the other five individually. TIGER's adaptive rule also meaningfully outperforms either of its two constituent meta-classification methods used alone, and its single hyperparameter, tuned using only a twenty-data-set development subset, is shown to generalize to the full evaluation benchmark. We further characterize TIGER's design through an extensive set of ablation experiments and report the design alternatives that we investigated and ultimately discarded.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TIGER 把四种表征族各配上同一组三个通用分类器（Ridge、Extra Trees、Naive Bayes）得到 12 个基学习器，堆叠成元特征矩阵后，按每类平均训练样本数在加权硬多数投票与 TabICLv2 上下文元分类之间自适应切换。在 UCR 142 数据集基准上，其平均 accuracy、balanced accuracy、F1 均为所比六算法（含 HIVE-COTE 2.0）最优，并显著优于其余五个。
Motivation: 现有时间序列分类集成（如 HIVE-COTE 2.0）为每个表征族配专用分类器并用固定非自适应规则融合，缺少按数据集规模调整的元分类机制。
Method: 对四个不同表征族的表示统一施加 Ridge、Extra Trees、Naive Bayes 三个通用分类器，得到 12 个基学习器，其预测堆叠为元特征矩阵；元分类规则按每类平均训练样本数在加权硬多数投票与 TabICLv2（预训练表格基础模型，作上下文元分类器）间逐数据集选择，仅一个超参数，用 20 数据集开发子集调优。
Result: 在 UCR 时间序列分类档案的 142 数据集基准上，TIGER 的平均 accuracy、balanced accuracy、F1 在六个对比算法（含 HIVE-COTE 2.0）中最高，并显著优于其余五个个体；其自适应规则也明显优于单独使用两种元分类方法之一；单一超参数在完整评估基准上泛化。另做了大量消融实验并报告被舍弃的设计方案。
Conclusion: 用同一通用分类器组合多个表征族、再按每类样本数自适应选择元分类规则，可在 UCR 基准上超过固定规则的专用集成；设计选择由消融实验支撑。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Optimization of Workload-Aware Power Delivery Networks
papers.abstract_en: Power Delivery Networks (PDNs) are critical components of modern VLSI chips, providing stable voltage levels while satisfying electromigration (EM) and IR-drop constraints. Conventional PDN design methodologies typically rely on worst-case assumptions, often resulting in over-provisioned networks and inefficient use of resources. This paper presents a reinforcement learning-based framework for the optimization of workload-aware PDNs. The proposed methodology first generates workload-aware PDNs using architectural power traces obtained from system-level simulations. These power traces are mapped to spatial power density distributions, enabling adaptive allocation of PDN resources according to local current demand. A reinforcement learning agent then performs wire-width optimization to minimize PDN area while maintaining EM and voltage integrity constraints. Electrical and reliability metrics are obtained using SPICE-based circuit analysis and EM lifetime estimation. Experimental evaluation is performed on a dataset of workload-aware PDNs generated from 4-, 8-, and 16-core multiprocessor floorplans using PARSEC and SPLASH-2 benchmark workloads. Furthermore, the proposed Deep Q-Network (DQN)-based optimizer reduces the average normalized PDN area by 47\% while satisfying all EM and IR-drop constraints. Compared to simulated annealing, the proposed approach achieves comparable optimization quality while providing approximately 26$\times$ faster optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用强化学习优化 VLSI 供电网络 (PDN) 的线宽：先由系统级仿真功耗轨迹映射为空间功率密度，按局部电流需求分配 PDN 资源，再用 Deep Q-Network (DQN) 在满足电迁移 (EM) 与 IR-drop 约束下最小化 PDN 面积。在由 4/8/16 核多处理器版图与 PARSEC、SPLASH-2 负载生成的数据集上，平均归一化 PDN 面积降低 47%，全部 EM 与 IR-drop 约束满足，相比模拟退火优化质量相当但快约 26 倍。
Motivation: 传统 PDN 设计按最坏情况假设做冗余，网络过度配置、资源利用率低；工作负载实际分布不均，按峰值均匀布线浪费面积。
Method: 流程分三步：从系统级仿真得到架构功耗轨迹，映射为空间功率密度分布以按局部电流需求分配资源；DQN 智能体做线宽优化，目标是最小化 PDN 面积并保持 EM 与电压完整性约束；用基于 SPICE 的电路分析与 EM 寿命估计给出电气与可靠性指标。
Result: 在由 4、8、16 核多处理器版图、PARSEC 与 SPLASH-2 负载生成的工作负载感知 PDN 数据集上评测：DQN 优化器使平均归一化 PDN 面积降低 47%，同时满足全部 EM 与 IR-drop 约束；相对模拟退火，优化质量相当，速度约快 26 倍。
Conclusion: 按真实功耗分布分配 PDN 资源并用 RL 调线宽，可以在不违反 EM 与 IR-drop 的前提下大幅削减面积，且比模拟退火快一个数量级以上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Test-time Adaptation through Candidate Verification and Divergence Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong zero-shot transferability but remain vulnerable to target-domain shifts at inference time. Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a practical remedy, yet most existing VLM-TTA methods follow a prediction-side adaptation paradigm. They use test samples to adjust logits, prototypes, caches, priors, or feature statistics, often incurring additional computational overhead. In this paper, we take a different perspective and reframe VLM-TTA as candidate verification rather than prediction adjustment. We propose Test-Time Correction (TTC), a hypothesis-based correction framework guided by a simple principle: hypothesize, reconstruct, correct. Given a test feature and its top-k candidate labels, TTC treats each candidate label as a hypothesis, reconstructs the feature within the corresponding latent subspace stored in a memory bank, and measures the resulting divergence shift. This shift quantifies how much the candidate subspace and its relations to other candidates change after the hypothetical insertion of the test feature. A correct candidate hypothesis induces only a small shift, whereas an incorrect one perturbs the subspace more strongly. TTC therefore corrects the prediction by selecting the candidate with the minimum aggregated divergence shift. This training-free candidate-verification mechanism avoids iterative optimization and provides a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Across five TTA settings and 15 benchmark datasets, including zero-shot classification, domain generalization, few-shot classification, base-to-novel generalization, and cross-dataset evaluation, TTC consistently improves accuracy over state-of-the-art VLM-TTA methods while achieving up to 2x speedup, over 3x lower CPU memory usage, and up to 1.4x lower GPU memory usage than the lowest-memory training-free baseline.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 VLM 的测试时自适应 (TTA) 重写为候选验证：对测试特征的 top-k 候选标签各作一次假设，在 memory bank 中把特征重建到对应潜在子空间，取 divergence shift 最小的候选作为修正结果。该 training-free 机制在 5 种 TTA 设置、15 个基准数据集上一致提升准确率，相对最低显存的 training-free 基线最高 2x 加速、CPU 内存降 3 倍以上、GPU 内存最多降 1.4x。
Motivation: 现有 VLM-TTA 多走预测侧适配，用测试样本去调 logits、原型、cache、先验或特征统计，带来额外计算开销，且把 TTA 当成预测调整问题处理。
Method: 提出 Test-Time Correction (TTC)，遵循 hypothesize-reconstruct-correct 原则：给定测试特征与 top-k 候选标签，把每个候选当作假设，在 memory bank 存的对应潜在子空间内重建特征并度量 divergence shift，衡量该子空间及其与其他候选关系在假设插入后的变化；选聚合 shift 最小的候选修正预测，全程无需迭代优化。
Result: 在 5 种 TTA 设置（zero-shot classification、domain generalization、few-shot classification、base-to-novel generalization、cross-dataset evaluation）与 15 个基准数据集上，准确率一致高于 state-of-the-art VLM-TTA 方法；相对最低显存的 training-free 基线，最高 2x 加速、CPU 内存降低 3 倍以上、GPU 内存最多降低 1.4x。
Conclusion: 正确候选假设只会引起很小的子空间 shift，错误候选扰动更强，因此按最小聚合 divergence shift 选候选即可在免训练、免迭代优化下取得准确率与效率兼顾的 VLM-TTA。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 现有 VLM-TTA 多走预测侧适配，用测试样本去调 logits、原型、cache、先验或特征统计，带来额外计算开销，且把 TTA 当成预测调整问题处理。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Test-Time Correction (TTC)，遵循 hypothesize-reconstruct-correct 原则：给定测试特征与 top-k 候选标签，把每个候选当作假设，在 memory bank 存的对应潜在子空间内重建特征并度量 divergence shift，衡量该子空间及其与其他候选关系在假设插入后的变化；选聚合 shift 最小的候选修正预测，全程无需迭代优化。
summary_sections.result: 在 5 种 TTA 设置（zero-shot classification、domain generalization、few-shot classification、base-to-novel generalization、cross-dataset evaluation）与 15 个基准数据集上，准确率一致高于 state-of-the-art VLM-TTA 方法；相对最低显存的 training-free 基线，最高 2x 加速、CPU 内存降低 3 倍以上、GPU 内存最多降低 1.4x。
summary_sections.conclusion: 正确候选假设只会引起很小的子空间 shift，错误候选扰动更强，因此按最小聚合 divergence shift 选候选即可在免训练、免迭代优化下取得准确率与效率兼顾的 VLM-TTA。

papers.title: Impact of Data Augmentation on Confidence Calibration in Melanoma Classification
papers.abstract_en: Accurately quantifying the predictive uncertainty or improving model calibration plays an important role in medical image classification, in particular in melanoma diagnosis, where accurate uncertainty quantification can have significant implications for patient care. One of the methods for calibration improvement is data augmentation. In addition, data augmentation as a method for synthetically increasing the size of the dataset has been proven to improve the performance of models trained on imbalanced datasets. However, the impact of data augmentation, as a transformation of a part of the original data, on calibration of models trained on imbalanced datasets, in particular in melanoma classification is under-explored. We train neural networks on SIIM-ISIC 2020 melanoma classification dataset under two conditions: with and without data augmentation, and compare the differences in AUC and expected calibration error (ECE) in both scenarios. Our results shows improvements in uncertainty calibration using different augmentation methods.
papers.comment: Presented at the 30th Conference on Medical Image Understanding and Analysis (MIUA 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在类别不平衡的 SIIM-ISIC 2020 黑色素瘤分类上，数据增强既改变判别性能也改变置信度校准；对比有无增强两种训练条件下的 AUC 与期望校准误差 (ECE)，结果显示多种增强方法都改善了不确定性校准。
Motivation: 数据增强作为合成扩充数据集的手段在不平衡数据上已被证明能提升模型性能，但它作为对原始数据一部分的变换，对不平衡训练下模型校准的影响在黑色素瘤分类中仍缺乏研究。
Method: 在 SIIM-ISIC 2020 黑色素瘤分类数据集上训练神经网络，设置有数据增强与无数据增强两种条件，比较两种场景下的 AUC 与期望校准误差 (ECE) 差异。
Result: 在有无数据增强的对比中，不同增强方法均带来不确定性校准 (calibration) 的改善；结果以 AUC 与 ECE 两个指标在 SIIM-ISIC 2020 上衡量。
Conclusion: 数据增强不只是扩充数据集的手段，也是黑色素瘤分类中改善置信度校准的可行路径，其对不平衡数据训练的模型有效。

papers.title: On Impact of Loss Function on the Performance of Neural Networks in Melanoma Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Melanoma is the deadliest type of skin cancer, whose early diagnosis is crucial for patients' survival. Image classification using deep learning models has shown promising results for melanoma diagnosis. However, the performance of these models on the melanoma datasets such as SIIM-ISIC melanoma classification dataset is a challenge due to the class imbalance. One of the methods to deal with this challenge is using loss function modifications. In this work, we have investigated the effect of different loss functions on the performance of deep neural networks. We trained these networks using focal loss, logit-adjusted softmax cross-entropy (CE) loss, and weighted softmax CE loss, and we report different metrics for evaluating performance and uncertainty calibration. Our results suggest that focal loss delivers a good combination of performance in terms of AUC and uncertainty calibration in terms of expected calibration error (ECE) simultaneously.
papers.comment: Presented at the 30th Conference on Medical Image Understanding and Analysis (MIUA 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在类别不平衡的 SIIM-ISIC 黑色素瘤图像分类上，对比 focal loss、logit-adjusted softmax CE 与 weighted softmax CE 三种损失，focal loss 同时给出较好的 AUC 与不确定性校准（ECE），即在性能与校准之间取得最佳折中。
Motivation: 深度学习做黑色素瘤诊断已有不错表现，但 SIIM-ISIC 等数据集类别严重不平衡，直接训练的分类性能与概率校准都会受损，需要靠损失函数改造来缓解。
Method: 用三种损失分别训练同一类深度网络：focal loss、logit-adjusted softmax 交叉熵、weighted softmax 交叉熵；评估同时覆盖判别性能（AUC）与不确定性校准（expected calibration error, ECE）等指标。
Result: 在 SIIM-ISIC melanoma classification dataset 上，focal loss 在 AUC 与 ECE 两方面同时取得良好组合，优于所比较的 logit-adjusted 与 weighted CE 设置；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 面对类别不平衡的黑色素瘤图像分类，focal loss 是同时兼顾 AUC 与校准的首选损失。

papers.title: Co-Optimizing Graph Sparsification and Approximate Computing for Energy-Efficient FPGA-Based GCN Inference
papers.abstract_en: Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) have emerged as a powerful framework for learning from graph-structured data, yet their deployment on resource-constrained edge platforms remains challenging due to the computational and memory demands of sparse graph aggregation. This work presents an FPGA-based GCN accelerator that combines DSpar graph sparsification, 8-bit quantization, and approximate multipliers on the AMD Kria KV260. Evaluated on Cora, LastFM Asia, and Amazon Photo, the design explores the interaction between sparsification and approximation across graphs with widely varying densities. Results show that the effectiveness of approximate arithmetic is governed by accumulation depth within GCN computations. Approximate multipliers are most effective when applied to sparse aggregation operations, while graph sparsification further improves their viability by reducing aggregation depth. The combined approach achieves up to 9.88$\times$ speedup while maintaining 86.6\% classification accuracy on Amazon Photo, and 1.52$\times$ speedup with 77.0\% accuracy on Cora, with total power consumption below 1 W. These results demonstrate that graph sparsification and approximate computing are complementary techniques whose co-optimization enables efficient low-power GCN inference on edge FPGA platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 AMD Kria KV260 上把 DSpar 图稀疏化、8-bit 量化与近似乘法器协同设计用于 GCN 推理，发现近似算术的效果由 GCN 计算中的累加深度决定：应用于稀疏聚合最有效，而图稀疏化通过降低聚合深度进一步提升其可用性。Amazon Photo 上最高 9.88× 加速、分类准确率 86.6%，Cora 上 1.52× 加速、77.0% 准确率，总功耗低于 1 W。
Motivation: GCN 的稀疏图聚合带来计算与内存压力，使其在资源受限的边缘平台部署困难；近似计算与图稀疏化各自的效果及其相互作用此前未被协同刻画。
Method: 在 AMD Kria KV260 FPGA 上实现 GCN 加速器，组合 DSpar 图稀疏化、8-bit 量化与近似乘法器，在 Cora、LastFM Asia、Amazon Photo 三个密度差异显著的图上探索稀疏化与近似化的交互。
Result: Amazon Photo 上最高 9.88× 加速、分类准确率 86.6%；Cora 上 1.52× 加速、准确率 77.0%；总功耗低于 1 W。近似乘法器在稀疏聚合操作上最有效，其效果由累加深度决定，图稀疏化通过降低聚合深度进一步改善近似化的可用性。
Conclusion: 图稀疏化与近似计算是互补技术，二者协同优化可在边缘 FPGA 上实现低功耗 GCN 推理；近似算术应优先用于稀疏聚合路径。

papers.title: AnchorGen: Anchored Optimization for Customizable Generative 3D Design
papers.abstract_en: Engineering design often starts from a 2D sketch that fixes style and proportions, yet the subsequent 3D shape optimization relies on learned generative priors to keep the geometry valid. However, these priors are agnostic to the sketch: while they admit a valid design by correcting a drifted proposal back to its training distribution, they often correct it towards the high-density region, ignoring the specified design. We introduce \emph{AnchorGen}, a rectified-flow framework trained unconditionally on the concatenated shape and sketch latents of paired data. The learned manifold represents the joint distribution of shape-sketch pairs, so constraining the sketch component restricts the iterate to the sub-manifold of shapes consistent with a target style. Since training employs no conditioning signal, the constraint is imposed at inference: gradient descent optimizes the shape latent to minimize a differentiable drag surrogate, while constraining the sketch latent to remain close to the target sketch via a token-wise cosine penalty. A single model thereby supports design-preserving optimization, dimensionally explicit design edits, and sketch-only synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnchorGen 用无条件训练的 rected-flow 同时学习形状与草图的联合隐空间，推理时固定草图隐变量并用可微拖拽代理优化形状隐变量，使生成先验不再把偏离设计的提案拉回训练分布的高密度区而是拉回目标风格的子流形。单个模型即可支持保设计优化、维度明确的编辑与仅草图合成。
Motivation: 工程设计从 2D 草图定风格与比例出发，但后续 3D 形状优化依赖的学习式生成先验对草图无感知：它会把漂移的提案纠正回训练分布的高密度区域，而非用户指定的设计。
Method: AnchorGen 是 rectified-flow 框架，在成对的形状与草图隐变量拼接上做无条件训练，学到的流形表示形状-草图对的联合分布。约束只在推理阶段施加：梯度下降优化形状隐变量以最小化可微的拖拽代理 (drag surrogate)，同时用 token-wise cosine 惩罚把草图隐变量约束在目标草图附近。
Result: 摘要给出的是方法能力而非数值：单个模型支持设计保留的优化、维度明确的设计编辑 (dimensionally explicit design edits) 与仅草图合成 (sketch-only synthesis) 三类任务。
Conclusion: 把草图作为联合隐空间中的约束分量而非条件信号，可以让生成先验在纠正几何有效性的同时守住指定风格，一个模型覆盖优化、编辑与合成三种用法。

papers.title: Machine learning for journal entry testing: A type-aware evaluation of anomaly detectors under a review budget
papers.abstract_en: Journal entry anomaly detectors are commonly evaluated on the full population with ROC-AUC, precision and recall, ignoring the review budget and which anomaly types are found. We propose a type-aware evaluation combining per-type recall, fair-share type recall (FSR), which caps each type's credit at its budget share, type coverage and first-hit rank. We evaluate nine unsupervised detectors, a supervised reference and feedback-driven Deep Semi-Supervised Anomaly Detection (DeepSAD) on four real client ledgers with injected typed anomalies and a public synthetic ledger. On the largest client ledger, principal component analysis (PCA), an autoencoder (AE) and a variational autoencoder (VAE) each place on average 98 anomalies among the first 100 postings, but at least 95.8 belong to one type. FSR instead favours a nearest-neighbour (kNN) detector and changes the top-ranked detector on three of four client ledgers. Representation also matters: one-hot encoding exposes unseen accounts, whereas frequency encoding leaves unseen contra accounts largely undetected. On the public ledger, the Histogram-Based Outlier Score (HBOS) and Empirical Cumulative Distribution-Based Outlier Detection (ECOD) reach all eight markings within 1,386 entries, whereas kNN, the hit leader at 1,000 entries, first reaches cross-linked clearing at rank 4,641, and the supervised row-level reference misses this marking within 1,000 entries. There, the adaptive DeepSAD review protocol raises mean hits per 100 reviews from 40.0 to 68.3 but type coverage only from 2.7 to 3.0. These findings show that high hit rates can conceal systematic blind spots and suggest that feedback can reinforce existing detection patterns without broadening anomaly coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 会计分录异常检测用 ROC-AUC 全量评估会掩盖类型盲区：在预算 100 条内 PCA、AE、VAE 平均各命中 98 条，但其中至少 95.8 条属同一类型，而按类型公平份额召回 (FSR) 排名时 kNN 反超。反馈驱动的 DeepSAD 把每 100 次复核平均命中从 40.0 提到 68.3，类型覆盖仅从 2.7 升到 3.0，说明反馈会强化既有模式而不拓宽覆盖。
Motivation: 分录异常检测惯用全量 ROC-AUC、precision、recall 评估，既不考虑复核预算，也不看检出的异常类型，高命中率可能掩盖系统性盲区。
Method: 提出类型感知评估：per-type recall、公平份额类型召回 (FSR，每类型信用上限为其预算份额)、type coverage 与 first-hit rank；在四个真实客户账簿（注入带类型异常）与一个公开合成账簿上评测 9 个无监督检测器、1 个有监督参照和反馈驱动 Deep Semi-Supervised Anomaly Detection (DeepSAD)，并对比 one-hot 与 frequency 两种编码。
Result: 最大客户账簿上前 100 条中 PCA、AE、VAE 平均各排入 98 条异常，但至少 95.8 条属同一类型；FSR 改为偏好 kNN，并在 4 个客户账簿中的 3 个上改变排名第一的检测器。公开账簿上 HBOS 与 ECOD 在 1,386 条内覆盖全部 8 种标注，kNN 在 1,000 条时命中最多但 cross-linked clearing 首次命中排在第 4,641 位，有监督行级参照在 1,000 条内漏掉该标注；DeepSAD 自适应复核协议使每 100 次复核平均命中从 40.0 升至 68.3，type coverage 仅从 2.7 升至 3.0。
Conclusion: 高命中率会掩盖系统性盲区，评估必须按类型与复核预算计分；反馈机制可能只强化既有检测模式而不扩大异常类型覆盖。

summary_sections.result: 最大客户账簿上前 100 条中 PCA、AE、VAE 平均各排入 98 条异常，但至少 95.8 条属同一类型；FSR 改为偏好 kNN，并在 4 个客户账簿中的 3 个上改变排名第一的检测器。公开账簿上 HBOS 与 ECOD 在 1,386 条内覆盖全部 8 种标注，kNN 在 1,000 条时命中最多但 cross-linked clearing 首次命中排在第 4,641 位，有监督行级参照在 1,000 条内漏掉该标注；DeepSAD 自适应复核协议使每 100 次复核平均命中从 40.0 升至 68.3，type coverage 仅从 2.7 升至 3.0。
summary_sections.conclusion: 高命中率会掩盖系统性盲区，评估必须按类型与复核预算计分；反馈机制可能只强化既有检测模式而不扩大异常类型覆盖。

papers.title: Integrating Survival-Based Aging Models with Data-Driven RUL Prognostics
papers.abstract_en: Predictive maintenance requires reliable remaining useful life (RUL) estimation. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: wear-based aging models that capture cumulative degradation and sensor-driven data models that reflect instantaneous health conditions, each providing only partial information. In this work, we propose a probabilistic fusion framework that integrates wear-based and sensor-based prognostic components through failure probability distributions. Based on explicit structural assumptions linking wear, latent health, sensor observations, and failure, we derive a principled combination rule that enables uncertainty-aware integration with adaptive weighting of the components. Experimentally, we assess this combination rule by learning the wear-based component using a parametric survival model and the sensor-based component using a 1D convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) with a post-hoc uncertainty model. Evaluation on multiple N-CMAPSS datasets demonstrates that the fused model improves point accuracy, preserves the C-index, and produces narrower yet well-calibrated prediction intervals compared to either component alone. The results highlight the complementary roles of wear-based survival model and sensor-based deep learning model, and show that their probabilistic integration provides a structured pathway toward more robust and consistent prognostics over the life-time.
papers.journal_ref: PHME_CONF 2026, Vol. 9, No .1, p.12 (July 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于失效概率分布的 RUL 预后融合框架，把磨损老化模型与传感器数据模型按显式结构假设组合成带自适应权重的统一规则。在 N-CMAPSS 多个数据集上，融合模型相比任一单组件提升点估计精度、保持 C-index，并给出更窄且校准良好的预测区间。
Motivation: 预测性维护中磨损老化模型只刻画累积退化、传感器数据模型只反映瞬时健康状态，两者各自只提供部分信息，需要一种带不确定性量化的组合方式。
Method: 以磨损、隐含健康、传感器观测与失效之间的显式结构假设推导组合规则，实现带自适应权重的不确定性感知融合；磨损侧用参数化生存模型 (parametric survival model) 学习，传感器侧用 1D-CNN 加 post-hoc uncertainty model 学习。
Result: 在多个 N-CMAPSS 数据集上，融合模型相比任一单组件提高点估计精度、保持 C-index，并产生更窄但校准良好的预测区间。
Conclusion: 磨损生存模型与传感器深度模型角色互补，通过概率化集成可在设备全寿命内得到更稳健、更一致的 RUL 预后。

papers.title: Benchmarking Jailbreak Guardrails for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents powered by large language models and vision-language models are increasingly deployed in physical environments, but jailbreak attacks can induce these agents to perform physically harmful actions. A growing number of guardrail methods have been proposed to intercept dangerous behavior before it is executed, yet existing safety benchmarks evaluate the embodied models themselves, leaving it unclear how well these guardrails actually defend an embodied agent in practice. We present the first systematic evaluation of jailbreak guardrails for embodied agents. To compare guardrails under identical conditions, we build a pluggable evaluation framework that treats the embodied agent as a fixed backend and each guardrail as a module that can intervene at the perception, planning, or control stage. We subject six representative guardrails to template-based and automated jailbreak attacks as well as safe instructions, and assess them at the system level along three dimensions: defense effectiveness, measured by the bypass rate and the hazard success rate in the simulator; usability, measured by the false-positive rate and the task completion rate on safe instructions; and efficiency, measured by the latency overhead added at runtime. Experiments on guardrails that span different intervention stages, decision mechanisms, and input modalities reveal a clear trade-off among the three dimensions, and show that no single guardrail dominates in all settings. We further analyze how intervention stage, decision mechanism, and input modality shape safety outcomes, and we offer practical guidance for selecting and designing guardrails for embodied agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首个针对具身智能体 (embodied agent) 越狱护栏 (jailbreak guardrail) 的系统性评测：把智能体固定为后端，护栏作为可插拔模块介入感知、规划或控制阶段，在模板化与自动化越狱攻击下同时衡量防御、可用性与效率。六个代表性护栏的实验显示三个维度存在清晰权衡，没有任何一个护栏在所有设置下占优。
Motivation: 现有安全基准评测的是具身模型本身，而非护栏在真实系统中拦截危险行为的实际效果，导致护栏防御能力在部署中无从判断。
Method: 构建可插拔评测框架，将具身智能体作为固定后端，每个护栏作为可介入感知、规划或控制阶段的模块；对六个覆盖不同介入阶段、决策机制与输入模态的护栏施加模板化攻击、自动化越狱攻击与安全指令，从系统层面评测。
Result: 三个维度分别以 bypass rate 与模拟器中 hazard success rate 度量防御有效性，以 false-positive rate 与安全指令上的 task completion rate 度量可用性，以运行时 latency overhead 度量效率；实验揭示三者之间清晰的权衡，且无单一护栏在所有设置下占优，并分析了介入阶段、决策机制与输入模态如何塑造安全结果。
Conclusion: 护栏选择不存在全能解，需按介入阶段、决策机制与输入模态在防御、可用性、效率之间取舍；作者据此给出具身护栏选型与设计的实践指引。

papers.title: Mind the Drift: Diagonal Linear Networks Under Large Learning Rates
papers.abstract_en: Large learning rates can qualitatively change the trajectory of neural network training, often pushing optimization into regimes far from classical gradient-flow behavior. The Edge of Stability (EoS) offers a valuable lens on the dynamics such learning rates induce. We study corresponding dynamics in diagonal linear networks, where we uncover a competition between two distinct implicit biases that jointly determine the sparsity of the recovered solution in regression settings. Complementary to the Gain, which captures the average discretization error accumulated by Gradient Descent relative to Gradient Flow, we derive a closely associated but overlooked quantity: the Drift. Under large learning rates, it describes an imbalance between different discretization errors and represents a systematic shift in the optimization trajectory. While the Gain grows monotonically in certain regimes, and can bias towards denser, flatter interpolators, the impact of the Drift depends on its alignment with potential solutions, which can either counteract or reinforce the effect of the Gain. Consequently, its behavior drives model selection, particularly during early training epochs. To validate our theoretical insights, we introduce an intervention that actively steers the Gain to recover sharper, sparser solutions. Thus, our analysis reveals that large learning rates do not universally hinder the recovery of sparse solutions. On the contrary, they can be harnessed to control the implicit bias of training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在对角线性网络 (diagonal linear network) 的回归设定中，大学习率引入两个相互竞争的隐式偏置：已有的 Gain 与新导出的 Drift，二者共同决定解的稀疏性。Gain 在某些区间单调增长并偏向更密、更平坦的插值解，而 Drift 的作用取决于它与候选解的对齐方向，可能抵消也可能强化 Gain；作者据此提出主动引导 Gain 的干预以恢复更尖、更稀疏的解，说明大学习率可以被用来调控隐式偏置而非一律损害稀疏恢复。
Motivation: 大学习率把训练推离经典 gradient flow 轨迹，但离散化误差如何影响稀疏解的恢复缺少刻画；已有 Gain 只度量平均离散化误差，掩盖了不同离散化误差之间的系统性失衡。
Method: 在对角线性网络中分析大 learning rate 下 GD 相对 gradient flow 的动力学，导出与 Gain 紧密相关但此前被忽视的量 Drift，用它刻画离散化误差的失衡与轨迹的系统性偏移；并设计一个主动引导 Gain 的干预来改变隐式偏置。
Result: Gain 在某些区间单调增长并偏向更密、更平坦的插值解；Drift 的影响随其与潜在解的对齐而变，可抵消或强化 Gain，其行为主导模型选择，尤其在训练早期 epoch。基于此的 Gain 引导干预可恢复更尖、更稀疏的解。
Conclusion: 大学习率并不普遍妨碍稀疏解的恢复，反而可通过 Drift 与 Gain 的竞争被用来控制训练的隐式偏置；稀疏性结果取决于 Drift 与解的对齐，而非仅由 Gain 的单调增长决定。
