papers.title: ORCA: The Annealed Spectral Conditioning Optimizer for Faster, Better LLM Training
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLM optimizers such as Muon often produce weight matrices with higher effective rank than Adam, yet further spectral control has delivered only modest gains. We identify a tension behind this result: concentrated spectra can suppress gradient directions in coupled weight matrices and slow optimization, while constraints maintained throughout training can limit task-specific adaptation and raise the attainable loss floor. We introduce ORCA (Orthogonal Regularization, Cooled After), a minimal optimizer intervention that applies strong but temporary soft orthogonality regularization early in training, then removes it. This allows the weights to benefit from a broader spectrum early on and adapt freely afterward. Across LLaMA, Qwen3, and fine-grained mixture-of-experts models ranging from 130M to 8B parameters, ORCA achieves lower final validation loss than Muon. Its loss reduction relative to Muon matches or exceeds Muon's reduction relative to Adam. Ablations support the early-shaping, later-release design. Further, ORCA requires no architectural changes and adds minimal overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ORCA 在 Muon 上加一个极简干预：训练早期施加强但临时的软正交正则 (soft orthogonality regularization)，随后彻底移除，让权重先获得更宽的谱、后期自由适配。在 130M 到 8B 的 LLaMA、Qwen3 与细粒度 MoE 模型上，ORCA 最终验证损失低于 Muon，其相对 Muon 的降幅等于或超过 Muon 相对 Adam 的降幅。
Motivation: Muon 产出的有效秩高于 Adam，但进一步的谱控制收益有限：谱过度集中会在耦合权重矩阵中压制梯度方向、拖慢优化，而贯穿全程的约束又限制任务适配并抬高可达损失下界。
Method: ORCA (Orthogonal Regularization, Cooled After)：训练早期对权重施加强软正交正则，之后移除该约束；不改架构、额外开销极小，并用 ablation 检验 early-shaping、later-release 的设计。
Result: 在 130M–8B 参数的 LLaMA、Qwen3 与细粒度 mixture-of-experts 模型上，ORCA 最终验证损失低于 Muon；相对 Muon 的损失降幅等于或超过 Muon 相对 Adam 的降幅；ablation 支持先塑形后释放的设计。
Conclusion: 谱约束应当早施加、早撤除：早期用宽谱帮助优化，后期放开让模型自由适配，才能压低最终损失而不牺牲 Muon 的低开销优势。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Flash-OPD: Fast On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but generating and evaluating long rollouts incurs substantial training cost. Existing acceleration methods reduce this cost through open-loop rollout schedules or closed-loop horizon adaptation. However, supervision compatibility can vary substantially across trajectories, making a single rollout horizon difficult to match their heterogeneous reliable lengths: an overly short horizon may truncate useful supervision, while an overly long one wastes computation beyond reliable regions. Our key insight is that the trajectory-specific reliability boundary need not be predicted before generation. By viewing reliability as the first-passage of accumulated low teacher--student compatibility events, the boundary is inherently unknown before sampling, yet whether it has been reached can be determined exactly from the observed prefix. Building on this insight, we propose *Flash-OPD*, which shifts from rollout-horizon control to adaptive trajectory-level boundary verification. *Flash-OPD* interleaves cached generation with teacher verification and independently stops each trajectory according to its observed compatibility events. To reduce verification overhead, the recent event rate is used only to schedule the next verification point, while the actual stopping decision always relies on the exact cumulative count. This separation prevents estimation errors from causing premature termination while enabling efficient verification during generation. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets and teacher--student settings show that *Flash-OPD* achieves $2.2\times$--$7.5\times$ speedups over standard OPD while maintaining or improving accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Flash-OPD 把 on-policy distillation 的固定 rollout 长度控制改成逐轨迹的可靠性边界验证：把教师-学生兼容性低事件的累积首次通过 (first-passage) 作为停止判据，边界在采样前未知但可由已观测前缀精确判定。近期事件率只用于调度下一次验证点，实际停机始终依据精确累计计数，避免估计误差导致过早截断。在多样数据集与师生设置上相对标准 OPD 获得 2.2×–7.5× 加速，同时保持或提升准确率。
Motivation: OPD 需要在学生生成的长轨迹上做稠密教师监督，生成与评估长 rollout 成本高；现有加速手段用固定 rollout 时长或闭环 horizon 自适应，但不同轨迹的可靠监督长度差异大，过短截断有用监督、过长浪费算力。
Method: Flash-OPD 将 rollout 长度控制转为轨迹级边界验证：缓存生成与教师验证交替进行，每条轨迹依据已观测的低兼容性事件独立停止；近期事件率仅用于安排下一次验证时刻，停机判定始终用精确累计计数。
Result: 在多样数据集与多种 teacher-student 设置上，相对标准 OPD 实现 2.2×–7.5× 训练加速，同时保持或提升准确率。
Conclusion: 轨迹级的精确边界验证可以替代统一 rollout horizon，在不牺牲（甚至改善）精度的前提下大幅压缩 OPD 训练成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Benchmarking CLIP for Zero-Shot Face and Periocular Gender Estimation
papers.abstract_en: We investigate CLIP for zero-shot gender estimation from full-face and periocular images. Three CLIP backbones are evaluated on 11,299 frontal images from Adience using image-text similarity with male/female prompts, achieving 95.54% full-face accuracy without task-specific training. For periocular, zero-shot predictions are strongly biased towards males, primarily due to a misaligned decision boundary. Threshold alignment substantially reduces this bias, reaching 85.29% accuracy. Linear SVMs trained on CLIP features provide only marginal gains, with a best periocular accuracy of 86.17%, approximately 2.8% above previous Adience results in the literature. Nevertheless, the gap with full-face performance confirms the greater difficulty of periocular gender estimation
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at 25th International Conference of the Biometrics Special Interest Group, BIOSIG 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 CLIP 图文相似度做零样本人脸与眼周性别估计，在 Adience 11,299 张正面照上全脸准确率 95.54% 且无需任务训练；眼周预测严重偏向男性，原因是决策边界错位，阈值对齐后准确率升到 85.29%。CLIP 特征上训线性 SVM 只带来小幅提升，眼周最好 86.17%，比文献中 Adience 既有结果高约 2.8%，全脸与眼周的差距说明眼周性别估计本身更难。
Motivation: 眼周（periocular）图像在遮挡或低质量人脸下是性别估计的替代输入，但零样本 CLIP 在该区域上的偏差来源与校正方式尚不清楚。

papers.title: On the Geometry of Multimodal Saturation: Riemannian VICReg
papers.abstract_en: In self-supervised learning, a third modality should improve, or at least preserve, performance. Across nine image-text-tabular datasets, we show that it instead harms performance: the trimodal model underperforms its own best bimodal subset in 55.6% of paired runs under VICReg. The same failure occurs in 51.1% of paired runs under SimSiam. We call this failure multimodal saturation. We propose that the failure lies in the alignment geometry. Riemannian VICReg (R-VICReg) generalizes classical VICReg: it aligns views by squared geodesic distance on learnable negative-curvature product factors and recovers VICReg exactly as curvature vanishes. Over the same 45 paired runs, R-VICReg raises the probability that the third modality helps from 44.4% to 64.4%, with gains concentrated where VICReg saturates.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to the Proceedings Track of the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在九个图像-文本-表格数据集上，三模态自监督模型反而常输给自身最好的双模态子集：VICReg 下 55.6% 的配对运行中第三模态有害，SimSiam 下为 51.1%，作者称之为多模态饱和 (multimodal saturation)。提出 Riemannian VICReg (R-VICReg)，用可学习负曲率乘积因子上的平方测地距离对齐视图、曲率趋零时精确退化为 VICReg，使第三模态有益的概率从 44.4% 升到 64.4%，且增益集中在 VICReg 饱和之处。
Motivation: 自监督多模态学习默认加入第三模态至少不损性能，但在图像-文本-表格组合上该假设系统性失效，且失败被归因于对齐几何而非数据本身。
Method: R-VICReg 把经典 VICReg 推广到黎曼设定：在可学习的负曲率乘积因子 (product factors) 上以平方测地距离对齐视图，曲率趋于零时精确恢复 VICReg；实验在九个图像-文本-表格数据集上以配对运行对比三模态与最佳双模态子集，并与 SimSiam 对照。
Result: 九个数据集、45 组配对运行下，VICReg 中 55.6% 的配对运行三模态不如其最佳双模态子集，SimSiam 中为 51.1%；R-VICReg 在同样的 45 组配对运行中把第三模态带来帮助的概率从 44.4% 提高到 64.4%，增益集中在 VICReg 出现饱和的地方。
Conclusion: 多模态饱和源于对齐几何，改用负曲率测地对齐即可让第三模态在多数情况下重新变得有益。

papers.title: Lossy Compression of PDE Training Inputs: Field Reconstruction Error Does Not Order the Cost to a Trained Operator
papers.abstract_en: Operator-learning benchmarks are stored at full precision and have grown to terabyte scale. Rate-distortion theory says how many bits the stored field needs, while a practitioner needs to know how accurate an operator trained on the compressed data will be. We show that the first does not determine the second, and measure why, compressing the input fields while targets and test inputs stay at full precision. A solution operator attenuates a perturbation of its input. Pushing a compressed field through a surrogate already trained at full precision measures how much of the perturbation that surrogate transmits. The fraction is consistent with the smoothing behaviour of the underlying equation, and it spans more than two orders of magnitude across PDE families. Field reconstruction error is computed before the attenuation and cannot see it. For operators trained with mean squared error it inverts 36 of 104 cost comparisons across datasets, where a probe built from the same forward passes inverts 12. Two families that PDEBench stores with identical initial conditions differ threefold downstream at identical field error. Under the relative-L2 objective of the reference recipe the separation narrows, while the ordering of the family-level median transmission factors is unchanged. After one full-precision training run, the probe evaluates an entire rate curve by forward passes alone. It ranks datasets and rates consistently across the codecs and architectures we test, while its magnitude does not transfer between them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 算子学习 (operator learning) 训练集被有损压缩后，场重建误差 (field reconstruction error) 无法正确排序「用压缩数据训练出的算子有多准」这一代价：解算子会衰减输入扰动，而场误差算在衰减之前、看不到这一层。在 MSE 目标下场误差在数据集间颠倒了 36/104 组代价比较，而基于同一组前向传播的探针只颠倒 12 组；作者建议用该探针按前向传播评估整条 rate curve 并排序数据集与压缩率。
Motivation: 算子学习基准已按全精度存储到 TB 量级，率失真理论 (rate-distortion) 只回答场需要多少比特，而实践者真正要的是「在压缩数据上训练的算子有多准」，两者并不等价。
Method: 只压缩输入场，目标与测试输入保持全精度；把压缩场送入已在全精度上训练好的 surrogate，测出它传输扰动的比例 (transmission factor)，构成一个探针；对比该探针与场重建误差在 MSE 目标和参考配方的 relative-L2 目标下对训练代价的排序能力。
Result: 传输比例与底层方程的平滑性一致，跨 PDE family 相差超过两个数量级；MSE 目标下场误差在 104 组比较中颠倒 36 组，探针只颠倒 12 组；PDEBench 中两个初始条件相同的 family 在相同场误差下下游代价相差三倍；relative-L2 目标下差距收窄但 family 级传输因子中位数排序不变；一次全精度训练后探针仅靠前向传播即可评估整条 rate curve，在所测 codec 与架构间排序一致，但数值大小不可跨 codec/架构迁移。
Conclusion: 场重建误差不能作为压缩训练输入对训练后算子代价的排序依据，因为解算子的输入衰减被它漏掉；应改用基于前向传播的传输探针来选数据集与压缩率，但其绝对值需按 codec 与架构重新标定。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Anatomy-preserving unpaired cone-beam CT refinement for image-guided radiotherapy using pseudo-label guided diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used in image-guided radiotherapy, but scatter, beam hardening, noise, truncation, and other artifacts limit image quality and CT number accuracy. Paired CBCT and CT data are difficult to obtain clinically because of motion, anatomical changes, and acquisition mismatch. We present RefineCBCT, an unpaired CBCT refinement framework that uses pseudo-label guidance and short-step diffusion to reduce artifacts while preserving patient-specific anatomy. RefineCBCT was trained and evaluated on unpaired CBCT and planning CT data from public LUNG TCIA and PELVIC TCIA datasets and compared with representative GAN and diffusion based methods. On LUNG TCIA, it achieved the best results across all metrics, with MAE 19.411, RMSE 62.758, PSNR 30.845 dB, and SSIM 0.931. On PELVIC TCIA, it achieved the best MAE, PSNR, and SSIM, with values of 14.905, 36.671 dB, and 0.876. The refined images showed fewer streaking and shading artifacts, clearer anatomical boundaries, and improved soft tissue uniformity, with line profile and ROI analyses showing closer agreement with planning CT. These results suggest that RefineCBCT provides efficient and effective CBCT refinement under clinically realistic unpaired training conditions and may support more reliable CBCT use in image-guided radiotherapy workflows. Code is publicly available on GitHub, and the evaluated datasets are available from The Cancer Imaging Archive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RefineCBCT 用伪标签引导加短步扩散做非配对 CBCT 去伪影精修，在保留患者特异解剖的前提下把图像质量拉近计划 CT。在 LUNG TCIA 上 MAE 19.411、RMSE 62.758、PSNR 30.845 dB、SSIM 0.931 全指标最优；PELVIC TCIA 上 MAE 14.905、PSNR 36.671 dB、SSIM 0.876 为最优。
Motivation: CBCT 受散射、硬化束、噪声、截断等伪影影响，CT 数值不准；临床上因运动、解剖变化与采集不匹配难以获得配对 CBCT-CT 数据，监督精修训练受限。
Method: 提出 RefineCBCT：非配对训练框架，用伪标签引导 (pseudo-label guidance) 与短步扩散 (short-step diffusion) 去伪影并保留患者特异解剖；在公开 LUNG TCIA 与 PELVIC TCIA 的非配对 CBCT 与计划 CT 上训练评估，与代表性 GAN 和扩散方法对比，辅以 line profile 与 ROI 分析。
Result: LUNG TCIA 上 MAE 19.411、RMSE 62.758、PSNR 30.845 dB、SSIM 0.931，全部指标最优；PELVIC TCIA 上 MAE 14.905、PSNR 36.671 dB、SSIM 0.876 为最优 MAE/PSNR/SSIM。精修图像条纹与阴影伪影更少、解剖边界更清晰、软组织更均匀，line profile 与 ROI 分析显示与计划 CT 更接近。
Conclusion: 在临床现实的非配对训练条件下，伪标签引导的短步扩散可高效精修 CBCT 并支持图像引导放疗中更可靠的 CBCT 使用；代码在 GitHub 公开，数据来自 The Cancer Imaging Archive。

papers.title: Cross-Lingual Transferability of Training Data Extraction Attacks to Recover Memorized PII
papers.abstract_en: The robustness of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) protection in Large Language Models (LLMs) is a critical concern, yet the risks associated with cross-lingual data extraction remain under-explored. This study evaluates the vulnerability of English-centric and multilingual models to Training Data Extraction (TDE) attacks when prompted in non-English languages. We construct a multi-domain PII dataset comprising social media handles, email addresses, and phone numbers and translate the attack contexts into Italian, Spanish, French, and German. Our results show that TDE attacks against both English-centric and multilingual models transfer to different languages: the attacks are successful on translated prompts, even though only the original English prompt might have been included in the pre-training data. A web-presence check on a sample of the translations confirms that they are not available online. The share of English leaks recovered in other languages grows with the multilingual capability of the model, and it drops sharply when the original wording is lost, even without a change of language. This suggests that native multilingual pre-training facilitates the emergence of latent cross-linguistic bridges that simplify the retrieval of personally identifiable information (PII). We analyze the activations of multilingual large language models (LLMs) and find that different translations of the same prompt are bridged in similar representations, with the strongest alignment in the middle layers. Our results highlight a fundamental security gap in modern LLMs, necessitating more robust, language-agnostic sanitization strategies for future model alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用非英语提示对 LLM 做训练数据提取 (TDE) 攻击仍能召回只以英文进入预训练的 PII：在意大利语、西班牙语、法语、德语的翻译提示下攻击照样成功，且模型多语能力越强，回收的英文泄漏占比越高；一旦原始措辞丢失（即使不换语言），成功率骤降。作者据此主张清洗必须语言无关。
Motivation: LLM 的 PII 保护研究多围绕英语，跨语言 TDE 攻击风险被低估：攻击者换一种语言提问，仍可能提取出预训练中仅以英文出现的个人信息。
Method: 构建多领域 PII 数据集（社交媒体 handle、邮箱、电话号码），把攻击上下文翻译成意大利语、西班牙语、法语、德语，对英语中心与多语模型分别做 TDE；对翻译样本做 web-presence 检查以确认其不在线；再分析多语 LLM 激活，比较同一提示不同译文的表示对齐及其随层深的分布。
Result: 攻击在翻译提示上成功，即使预训练数据中可能只有原始英文提示；抽样 web-presence 检查确认译文不在线；英文泄漏的回收占比随模型多语能力增强而上升，原始措辞丢失时骤降（不换语言也如此）；同一提示的不同译文在表示上被桥接，对齐在中间层最强。
Conclusion: 多语预训练催生了潜藏的跨语言桥，使 PII 可跨语言被检索，构成现代 LLM 的根本安全缺口，需要语言无关的更稳健净化策略。

papers.title: Adaptive Mean Flow for Responsive Closed-Loop Robot Control
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion- and flow-based robot policies have recently become widespread in robotic Imitation Learning (IL) due to their high performance and ability to model continuous and multimodal distributions. However, the iterative denoising procedure used by these models introduces significant prediction latency, hindering high-frequency closed-loop robot control and leading to jittery, unstable motion when frequent updates to the robot's action predictions are used. Therefore, it is common practice to train models to predict chunks of actions that can be executed sequentially without feedback, even when this reduces responsiveness and may mean the most recent state information is not used. In this article, we present Adaptive Mean Flow (AMF), a flow-based IL method that enables smooth and responsive, fully closed-loop robot control. AMF uses Mean Flow, which is an accelerated form of Flow Matching (FM), to minimize prediction latency. To ensure smoothness and consistency across predictions, AMF uses a corrupted version of the trajectory from the previous step when predicting new robot actions, with the signal-to-noise ratio increasing over the time parameter of the trajectory. This discourages large changes in the prediction from one step to the next, while allowing freedom to adapt the predictions for future steps. We evaluate AMF across a wide range of simulated and real robot tasks and demonstrate significantly improved performance compared with baselines. Code: https://github.com/akselva/Adaptive-mean-flow-RoboticIL.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters, vol. 11, no. 11, pp. 12935-12942, Nov. 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Adaptive Mean Flow (AMF)，用 Mean Flow（Flow Matching 的加速形式）把扩散/流策略的迭代去噪延迟压到可高频闭环控制的水平，并在预测时喂入上一步轨迹的加噪版本、信噪比随轨迹时间参数上升，从而抑制相邻步预测跳变。在多类仿真与真实机器人任务上相比基线性能显著提升。
Motivation: 扩散与流策略的迭代去噪带来高预测延迟，导致高频闭环控制下动作抖动、运动不稳，实践中只能预测动作块并开环执行，牺牲响应性且用不上最新状态信息。
Method: AMF 属于模仿学习 (IL) 流方法：用 Mean Flow 加速 Flow Matching 以降低单步预测延迟；预测新动作时以上一步轨迹的加噪版本为条件，信噪比随轨迹时间参数递增，既限制相邻预测的大幅变化又保留对未来步的调整自由度。
Result: 在范围广泛的仿真与真实机器人任务上评估，AMF 相比基线性能显著提升（abstract 未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把 Mean Flow 的低延迟与跨步轨迹一致性约束结合，可以在不牺牲响应性的前提下实现平滑的全闭环机器人控制，替代开环动作块执行的常见做法。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Rethinking Least-Core Computation in Contextual-Distractor Games
papers.abstract_en: Game-theoretic attribution explains a model by assigning credit to its features or training examples. The least core has attracted interest as an alternative to Shapley-style averaging because it can expose players that cause substantial harm in rare, high-value contexts. However, least-core allocations are generally nonunique, and the choice of allocation can affect the resulting explanation. In this study, we investigate how payoff selection and coalition sampling affect least-core attribution. Our experiments show that selector choice matters for distinguishing useful and harmful contributions, and that sampling can degrade harmful-player identification across the tested selectors even when useful players remain well identified. These observations motivate efficient computation with all coalition constraints and a well-defined selector. We introduce entropic least core (ELC), a smooth approximation whose unique minimizer follows a continuous path along the temperature to the nucleolus, a classical refinement of the least core. Our experiments show that ELC approximates the nucleolus faster than an LP-based nucleolus solver while retaining small payoff errors, with further GPU acceleration at larger problem sizes. In the tested full-coalition contextual-distractor games, ELC matches the minimum-norm selector in identification accuracy and more accurately ranks distractors by harm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在上下文-干扰项博弈 (contextual-distractor games) 的 least-core 归因中，payoff 选择与联盟采样会改变解释结果：采样会削弱有害玩家识别，即使有用玩家仍被稳定识别。作者提出 entropic least core (ELC)，其唯一极小元随温度连续走向 nucleolus，在全联盟约束下比 LP 求解器更快逼近 nucleolus 且 payoff 误差小，同时与 minimum-norm selector 识别精度相当、对 distractor 的危害排序更准。
Motivation: least-core 分配一般不唯一，选哪种分配会改变归因解释；而采样联盟虽省算力却可能损害对有害玩家的识别，需要一个既高效又有良定义 selector 的计算方式。
Method: 先系统考察 payoff 选择与联盟采样对 least-core 归因的影响，再提出 entropic least core (ELC)：一个光滑近似，其唯一极小元沿温度参数形成通向 nucleolus 的连续路径；计算上使用全部联盟约束并配合 GPU 加速，与 LP-based nucleolus 求解器和 minimum-norm selector 对比。
Result: 实验显示 selector 选择对区分有用与有害贡献很关键，采样会在各被测 selector 上退化有害玩家识别、而有用玩家仍能被良好识别；ELC 比 LP-based nucleolus 求解器更快逼近 nucleolus 且保持小的 payoff 误差，在更大问题规模上有额外 GPU 加速；在被测的全联盟 contextual-distractor 博弈中，ELC 与 minimum-norm selector 识别精度相当，且对 distractor 的危害排序更准确。
Conclusion: 用全部联盟约束加一个良定义的 selector 做高效计算是可取的：ELC 以光滑方式兼顾速度与 nucleolus 级的解释质量，并在有害 distractor 排序上优于 minimum-norm selector。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: DAG-CLIP: A DAG Learning Framework in the Presence of Latent Variables
papers.abstract_en: Learning directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) to uncover causal mechanisms has attracted substantial attention in machine learning. While most existing methods focus exclusively on observed variables, many variables of substantive interest are latent constructs defined by statistical measurement models. Such constructs are particularly common in the social and behavioral sciences. In this paper, we propose a general statistical framework for DAG learning when some or all nodes of the graph are latent variables, accommodating non-Gaussian manifest variables such as binary and categorical data in the measurement model. To overcome the computational burden of high-dimensional integration in standard marginal likelihoods, we develop DAG learning via Composite-Likelihood-based screening and Iterative Pruning (DAG-CLIP), a two-step composite-likelihood-based learning algorithm. This algorithm first solves a smooth acyclicity-constrained optimization problem to screen out misspecified DAG structures, and subsequently performs BIC-guided composite-likelihood backward deletion within the Markov equivalence class (MEC) space to identify a sparse DAG. We establish the statistical consistency of the algorithm in recovering the MEC of the true DAG, and demonstrate its effectiveness through extensive simulation studies and a real-world application to large-scale educational survey data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAG-CLIP 在部分或全部节点为潜变量、且测量模型含二值/分类非高斯显变量时学习有向无环图：先用复合似然 (composite likelihood) 解光滑无环约束优化筛掉误设结构，再在马尔可夫等价类 (MEC) 空间内做 BIC 引导的复合似然后向删除。算法被证明能一致恢复真实 DAG 的 MEC，并在模拟与大规模教育调查数据上验证有效。
Motivation: 现有 DAG 学习方法基本只处理观测变量，而社会科学与行为科学中大量关注对象是由测量模型定义的潜变量；标准边缘似然又带来高维积分的计算负担。
Method: 两步复合似然算法：第一步解光滑的无环 (acyclicity) 约束优化问题筛除误设 DAG 结构，第二步在 MEC 空间内做 BIC 准则引导的复合似然后向删除以得到稀疏 DAG；框架兼容二值与分类显变量的测量模型，并给出恢复真实 DAG 之 MEC 的统计一致性证明。
Result: 建立算法恢复真实 DAG 所属 MEC 的统计一致性；通过大量模拟研究与一项大规模教育调查数据的真实应用演示其有效性。
Conclusion: 复合似然的筛选加后向删除可以在规避高维积分的同时，一致地恢复含潜变量 DAG 的马尔可夫等价类。

papers.title: Boosting Transferable Adversarial Attacks against Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Most adversarial attacks on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) assume white-box access to the victim policy, which rarely holds in practice. This paper studies transfer-based black-box attacks on DRL: the attacker crafts observation perturbations on a white-box surrogate agent and feeds them to an unknown victim. We formulate the attack as return minimization under a per-step perturbation budget. We first show that transplanting transferable image-classification attacks (FGSM, MI-FGSM, and NI-FGSM) with a per-step objective yields perturbations that transfer but are no stronger than random noise of the same budget. We then propose a trajectory-level attack that optimizes a sequence of perturbations over a receding horizon through a differentiable model of the environment and a temperature-smoothed surrogate policy, with the same optimizers. On CartPole-v1 with ten DQN and DDQN agents and 100 surrogate--victim pairs, the trajectory-level attack outperforms per-step attacks and random noise in the white-box, cross-model, and cross-algorithm settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 DRL 的迁移式黑盒对抗攻击，把攻击目标写成每步扰动预算下的回报最小化；直接移植图像分类的 FGSM、MI-FGSM、NI-FGSM 加每步目标，迁移得动但强度不比同预算随机噪声高。作者改用轨迹级攻击：在可微环境模型与温度平滑的代理策略上，用同样的优化器在滚动时域上优化一整段扰动序列，在 CartPole-v1 的白盒、跨模型、跨算法三种设定下均强于每步攻击与随机噪声。
Motivation: 多数 DRL 对抗攻击假设攻击者能白盒访问受害策略，实践中不成立；而把图像分类的可迁移攻击直接搬到 DRL 的每步目标上，产生的扰动能迁移却几乎不比同预算随机噪声更强。
Method: 把攻击形式化为每步扰动预算下的回报最小化；先移植 FGSM、MI-FGSM、NI-FGSM 并配每步目标作为对照，再提出轨迹级攻击：借助环境的可微模型与温度平滑的代理策略 (temperature-smoothed surrogate policy)，在滚动时域 (receding horizon) 上优化扰动序列，优化器与每步版本相同。
Result: 在 CartPole-v1 上用十个 DQN 与 DDQN 智能体、100 对 surrogate–victim 组合测试，轨迹级攻击在白盒、跨模型 (cross-model)、跨算法 (cross-algorithm) 三种设定下都超过每步攻击与同预算随机噪声；而移植的 FGSM、MI-FGSM、NI-FGSM 每步攻击强度不高于同预算随机噪声。
Conclusion: DRL 的可迁移黑盒攻击要按整条轨迹而非单步来优化，回报最小化配合可微环境模型与平滑代理策略才能真正压过随机噪声。

papers.title: Gaussian Universality and Its Breakdown in Tensor-Network Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian-process limits are powerful in describing overparameterized machine learning models, yet their validity in structured tensor-network architectures remains unclear. Here we analytically present a moment-based approach that identifies precise conditions for the emergence and breakdown of Gaussian universality in tensor-network learning models, with a focus on matrix product states. We prove that in the large bond dimension limit, the learning models with both local and global observables converge to Gaussian processes, with explicit finite-size bounds on higher-order moment deviations. Whereas in the large physical dimension limit, the Gaussian universality no longer persists: while the models with local observables retain Gaussian-process behavior, those global cases exhibit persistent non-Gaussian corrections. Our results reveal that Gaussian-process behavior in tensor-network learning is controlled not only by parameter number, but also by architectural scaling, observable locality, and the spectral properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文给出基于矩的解析判据，刻画张量网络机器学习（以 matrix product states 为主）中高斯普适性何时成立、何时失效：大键维 (bond dimension) 极限下，含局部与全局观测量的模型都收敛到高斯过程并给出高阶矩偏差的有限尺寸界；大物理维度 (physical dimension) 极限下高斯普适性不再成立，局部观测量仍保持高斯过程行为，而全局观测量留下持续的非高斯修正。结论是高斯行为不仅由参数量控制，还取决于架构标度、观测量局域性和谱性质。
Motivation: 过参数化模型的高斯过程极限是理解其学习行为的主流工具，但这一极限在结构化的张量网络架构中是否成立、在什么条件下失效，此前并不清楚。
Method: 提出基于矩 (moment-based) 的解析方法，针对 matrix product states 架构推导高斯普适性涌现与破坏的精确条件，分别在大键维与大物理维度两个极限下分析局部与全局观测量，并给出高阶矩偏差的显式有限尺寸界。
Result: 大键维极限下，含局部与全局观测量的学习模型均收敛到高斯过程，并带有高阶矩偏差的显式有限尺寸界；大物理维度极限下，局部观测量模型保持高斯过程行为，全局观测量模型则出现持续的非高斯修正。
Conclusion: 张量网络学习中的高斯过程行为由参数数目、架构标度、观测量局域性和谱性质共同决定，大物理维度下的全局观测量是高斯普适性失效的判据。

papers.title: Do VLAs Understand and Adapt to the Objects They Handle, or Simply Replay Learned Behaviors?
papers.abstract_en: This paper asks whether VLA generalization is grounded in a global understanding of objects' physical properties that enables policies to adapt their motion to unseen setups, or if policies simply replay the motions they've learnt that happen to succeed in new setups. The former reflects genuine generalization; the latter reflects incidental robustness. We first examine awareness of physical properties in seven VLAs by applying linear probing and representational similarity analysis (RSA) to their activations. We find that physical properties, including mass, fragility, deformability, friction and size are less decodable than non-physical properties such as semantic category, material, sound and price in nearly every modality stream. Compared with their base VLMs, robot pre-training weakens the linear encoding of physical properties in the language stream. Neither pre-training nor downstream fine-tuning strengthens the alignment between physical-property differences and activation distances. We then ask whether the weak physical information present in these activations shapes the actions a VLA generates. In a controlled LIBERO case study, we increase the mass of an in-domain object and signal the change through language or vision. Most VLAs use similar lifting behaviour for the heavier and original-mass objects, leading to task success declines. The few exceptions change their behaviour in response to lexical or visual cues rather than to mass itself. These results suggest that VLAs encode physical properties weakly and do not reliably use them to adapt their motion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对七个 VLA 用线性探针与 RSA 检查发现，质量、易碎性、可变形性、摩擦、尺寸等物理属性在几乎所有模态流中都比语义类别、材质、声音、价格更难解码，机器人预训练还削弱了语言流中的物理属性线性编码。在 LIBERO 受控案例中把域内物体质量调重并用语言或视觉提示，多数 VLA 仍用同样的抬升动作，任务成功率下降；少数例外是响应词汇或视觉线索而非质量本身。结论是 VLA 的跨设定稳健性多半是偶然复现已学动作，而非基于物体物理属性的真正泛化。
Motivation: VLA 在新设定上成功，可能来自对物体物理属性的整体理解并据此调整动作，也可能只是复现恰好奏效的已学动作；前者才是真泛化，后者只是偶然稳健，需要区分二者。
Method: 先对七个 VLA 的激活做线性探针 (linear probing) 与表征相似性分析 (RSA)，比较物理属性与非物理属性的可解码性，并与其 base VLM 对照；再在 LIBERO 上做受控案例研究，增大域内物体质量并用语言或视觉两种通道提示变化，观察生成动作是否随之改变。
Result: 七个 VLA 中，mass、fragility、deformability、friction、size 等物理属性在几乎所有模态流里都比 semantic category、material、sound、price 更难解码；相比 base VLM，机器人预训练削弱了语言流中物理属性的线性编码，且预训练与下游微调都没有增强物理属性差异与激活距离的对齐。LIBERO 受控实验中，多数 VLA 对加重物体与原质量物体采用相似抬升行为，任务成功率下降；少数例外是依据词汇或视觉线索而非质量改变行为。
Conclusion: VLA 对物理属性编码微弱，且不能可靠地用这些信息调整动作，其在新设定上的表现更像复现已学成功动作的偶然稳健，而非真正的物体级泛化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Quantum data loading from the learned shared structure of real signals
papers.abstract_en: Preparing quantum states from classical data can cost more than the computation they serve; most loaders tailor a circuit to each input. Here we show that the signals of a real dataset share structure that can be learned once and reused. Our quantum-native loader learns a low-dimensional description of a dataset and prepares every signal with one fixed circuit set by a few numbers. Across seven views of five public datasets it meets the targets of the strongest structured loader at equal gate cost with several times fewer numbers per signal. These numbers can be inferred from a random subset: in a preregistered blind replication the subset needed to come within ten per cent of full-signal accuracy stayed constant within a prespecified margin as signals grew sixteenfold, whereas the structured loader needed ever more. It declines what it cannot represent, covering fewer cases than that baseline and no electrocardiogram.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 量子态制备的加载器通常要为每个输入单独定制线路，本文提出量子原生 (quantum-native) 数据加载器：先学出数据集的低维描述，再用一条固定线路、由每条信号的少量数字设定来制备全部信号。在五个公开数据集的七种视图上，它以相同门开销达到最强结构化加载器的目标精度，且每条信号所需数字少数倍；随机子集推断这些数字时，达到全信号精度 10% 以内的子集规模在信号量增长 16 倍时保持在预设容差内不变，而结构化加载器需要持续增大。
Motivation: 量子态制备从经典数据出发的开销可能超过后续计算本身，主流加载器要为每个输入定制线路，数字量随信号规模增长，成为可扩展的瓶颈。
Method: 量子原生加载器学习数据集的低维描述，用一条由少量数字设定的固定线路制备每条信号；这些数字可从随机子集推断，并在预注册盲复现 (preregistered blind replication) 中检验子集规模随信号增长的行为，与结构化加载器在相同门开销下对比。
Result: 在五个公开数据集的七种视图上，以相同门开销达到最强结构化加载器的目标，每条信号所需数字少数倍；盲复现中，使精度落在全信号 10% 以内的随机子集规模在信号增长 16 倍时保持在预设容差内不变，结构化加载器则需越来越多；覆盖案例少于该基线，且不包含心电图 (electrocardiogram)。
Conclusion: 真实信号的共享结构可以学一次复用，固定线路加少量可推断数字即可替代逐输入定制；代价是表达范围收窄，覆盖案例少于结构化加载器且不含心电图。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Last-Iterate Convergence Rate of Normalized Gradient Descent under Hölder Smoothness
papers.abstract_en: Normalized gradient descent is a widely studied adaptive optimization method. Most existing analyses focus on the best iterate or a weighted average of the iterates, whereas practical implementations typically return the last iterate. In this paper, we study the last-iterate convergence of normalized gradient descent for convex, $(ν,M_ν)$-Hölder-smooth objectives. For a constant stepsize, we establish an upper bound of $\mathcal{O}\bigl((\log^2(T)/T)^{(1+ν)/2}\bigr)$, which contains a logarithmic overhead relative to the known $\mathcal{O}\bigl(T^{-(1+ν)/2}\bigr)$ guarantees for the best and weighted-average iterates. For $ν= 0$, this overhead is known to be unavoidable. We complement this analysis with numerical results based on the performance estimation problem (PEP), investigating the finite-horizon worst-case behavior in the smooth setting and whether the logarithmic overhead reflects an intrinsic limitation of constant-step normalized gradient descent. We then show that a linearly decreasing stepsize yields a last-iterate guarantee of $\mathcal{O}\bigl(T^{-(1+ν)/2}\bigr)$, matching the order of the best-iterate/weighted-average guarantees without requiring knowledge of $ν$ and $M_ν$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 归一化梯度下降 (normalized gradient descent) 在凸 (ν, M_ν)-Hölder 光滑目标上，常数步长的 last-iterate 收敛率为 O((log²T/T)^{(1+ν)/2})，相对已知的最优/加权平均 O(T^{-(1+ν)/2}) 多出对数开销，且 ν=0 时该开销已知不可避免；改用线性递减步长则 last-iterate 达到 O(T^{-(1+ν)/2})，与最优迭代保证同阶且无需知道 ν 和 M_ν。
Motivation: 已有分析多针对最优迭代或迭代加权平均，而实际实现返回的是最后一次迭代；Hölder 光滑设定下 last-iterate 是否必须付出对数开销尚不清楚。
Method: 对凸 Hölder 光滑目标推导常数步长下归一化梯度下降的 last-iterate 上界，并用 performance estimation problem (PEP) 做数值实验，考察光滑设定下的有限时域最坏情形行为以及对数开销是否为常数步长的固有限制；再分析线性递减步长。
Result: 常数步长 last-iterate 上界为 O((log²T/T)^{(1+ν)/2})，对比已知最优/加权平均的 O(T^{-(1+ν)/2}) 多出对数开销，ν=0 时该开销已知不可避免；线性递减步长给出 O(T^{-(1+ν)/2}) 的 last-iterate 保证，与最优/加权平均同阶且不需知道 ν 和 M_ν。
Conclusion: 常数步长归一化梯度下降的 last-iterate 对数开销可用线性递减步长消除，从而在不需先验光滑参数的情况下匹配最优迭代阶。

papers.title: Attention Tax, Handoff Tax: A Stylised Model of When Multi-Agent LLM Systems Help
papers.abstract_en: Recent work on multi-agent LLM systems reaches sharply different conclusions: some results show that a single agent with the same information and compute should dominate a delegated system, others that multi-agent gains grow with task depth. We argue that much of the disagreement comes from modelling different bottlenecks, and introduce a stylised reliability model built around two trade-offs. Decomposition reduces the burden of long contexts but incurs a handoff tax when information is compressed or transferred between agents. Redundancy gains from multiple samples, but its benefit depends on how much their failures are shared. With reasoning budget, verification, and task structure added, the model yields two crossover conditions: decomposition becomes preferable once the attention cost avoided by resetting context exceeds the handoff cost, and parallel sampling at equal budget is eventually preferable when its shared-failure floor lies below the error floor of one agent thinking longer. We connect these regimes to recent theoretical and empirical results. On a ledger-reconciliation task we measure the context-degradation curve and the handoff tax from single-agent and handoff runs alone. From these the model places the crossover at depth 10 and predicts decomposition to win at depths 20, 50, and 100. It does, on step-level and final-balance accuracy, and the decomposed system's success, which the prediction never sees, lands within 9 percentage points of the predicted rate at every depth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个刻画多智能体 LLM 系统何时胜过单智能体的风格化可靠性模型，把分歧归结为两种瓶颈：分解 (decomposition) 用重置上下文省下 attention 成本但付出 handoff tax，冗余采样 (redundancy) 的收益取决于失败共享程度。模型给出两个 crossover 条件：省下的注意力成本超过 handoff 成本时分解更优；并行采样的共享失败下限低于单智能体长思考的误差下限时等预算并行更优。在 ledger-reconciliation 任务上实测上下文退化曲线与 handoff tax，模型把 crossover 定在 depth 10，并预测 depth 20、50、100 分解胜出，实测在 step-level 与 final-balance accuracy 上验证，且预测未见过的成功率在每个深度都落在预测值 9 个百分点以内。
Motivation: 近期关于多智能体 LLM 的结论互相矛盾：一方认为同信息同算力下单智能体应支配委派系统，另一方称多智能体收益随任务深度增长。作者认为分歧源于各自建模了不同的瓶颈。
Method: 构建一个风格化可靠性模型，围绕两条权衡：分解降低长上下文负担但产生 handoff tax（信息压缩或跨智能体传递时的损失），冗余采样收益取决于多次采样失败的共享程度；再加入 reasoning budget、verification 与 task structure，推导出两个 crossover 条件。在 ledger-reconciliation 任务上仅用单智能体与 handoff 运行实测 context-degradation 曲线和 handoff tax，作为模型输入。
Result: 模型把 crossover 定在 depth 10，并预测 depth 20、50、100 上分解系统胜出；实测在 step-level accuracy 与 final-balance accuracy 上均验证该预测，且模型从未见过的分解系统成功率在每个深度都落在预测值 9 个百分点以内。
Conclusion: 多智能体与单智能体孰优取决于 attention 成本与 handoff 成本、以及共享失败下限与单智能体误差下限这两组量的相对大小，因此文献中的矛盾结论来自建模了不同瓶颈。

papers.title: Vision Transformer Ensembles for Panoramic Street Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation of street panoramas can support detailed descriptions of urban environments, yet small datasets and unequal training costs make model selection difficult. This paper presents the system used for a first place submission to the PalmCity challenge in the leaderboard snapshot dated 5 October 2026. Nine pretrained segmentation systems are compared using approximately equal computation budgets. The candidates include DeepLabV3+, SegFormer, UPerNet, Mask2Former, DINOv3 with a linear decoder, and an Encoder only Mask Transformer using DINOv3. The two leading candidates are trained independently with three random seeds and longer budgets. Equal averaging of class probabilities from the three Encoder only Mask Transformer models, evaluated at three image scales with horizontal reflection, produces 60.95% mean intersection over union and 71.16% mean F1 on the 84 image public validation split. The submitted predictions receive 57.08% mean intersection over union and 67.96% mean F1 on the hidden test leaderboard. Producing all 249 test masks takes 251.49 seconds including model initialization and provenance checks on one NVIDIA RTX 5090. Peak allocated GPU memory is 2.70 GiB. The study reports all eligible models, all inference variants, class level errors, source conditions, and reproducibility checks, providing a documented challenge workflow with existing architectures.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Code available at https://github.com/yunusserhat/palmcity_challenge . Trained models available at https://huggingface.co/yunusserhat/palmcity-eomt-dinov3-large

TL;DR: 在 PalmCity 挑战赛全景街景语义分割上，用九个预训练分割模型在近似等算力预算下比较，选出 Encoder only Mask Transformer（DINOv3 编码器）并以三个随机种子独立训练，对三模型类别概率做等权平均、在三个尺度加水平翻转推理。84 张公开验证集上 mIoU 60.95%、mF1 71.16%，隐藏测试榜 57.08% / 67.96%，成为 2026-10-05 榜单快照的第一名提交。
Motivation: 街景全景语义分割数据集小、不同架构训练成本差异大，导致模型选择困难且难以公平比较。
Method: 在近似等计算预算下比较九个预训练分割系统（DeepLabV3+、SegFormer、UPerNet、Mask2Former、DINOv3 加线性解码器、DINOv3 编码器的 Encoder only Mask Transformer 等）；两个领先候选各用三个随机种子与更长预算独立训练，推理时对三模型类别概率等权平均，配合三尺度与水平反射增强。
Result: 三模型等权平均加多尺度推理在 84 张公开验证集上取得 60.95% mIoU 与 71.16% mF1；提交结果在隐藏测试榜为 57.08% mIoU 与 67.96% mF1，位列 2026-10-05 榜单快照第一。生成全部 249 张测试掩码耗时 251.49 秒（含模型初始化与来源校验，单卡 NVIDIA RTX 5090），峰值显存 2.70 GiB。
Conclusion: 在小数据街景分割上，等预算筛选加多种子集成与多尺度推理，用现成架构即可拿到挑战赛第一并给出可复现的完整工作流。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Pay to Learn, Share to Earn: Incentivized Federated Multi-Player Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Federated multi-player multi-armed bandit problems model collaborative sequential decision-making where multiple players interact with a common bandit environment and share information through a central server to accelerate learning. Existing federated bandit frameworks typically assume that all players willingly share their local observations with the server. However, this assumption is often unrealistic in practical settings where players are self-interested and may not participate in collaboration without explicit incentives. To address this challenge, we propose an incentive-aware federated bandit framework in which players receive rewards for sharing information with the server and incur costs when buying information from the server. We develop a UCB-based algorithm, termed Buying-UCB, that balances individual exploration and collaborative learning by incorporating both sharing incentives and information acquisition costs into the learning process. We theoretically analyze the proposed algorithm and derive upper bounds on the group regret and buying cost. Our analysis further characterizes the trade-off between fully collaborative federated learning and completely independent learning. Extensive numerical experiments validate the theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework under different collaboration and pricing regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在自利玩家不愿无偿共享观测的联邦多玩家多臂老虎机中，引入「共享得奖励、购买信息付成本」的激励机制，并提出把激励与信息购买成本一起纳入决策的 Buying-UCB 算法。理论上给出群体遗憾与购买成本的上界，并刻画完全协作与完全独立学习之间的权衡；数值实验在不同协作与定价机制下验证了理论结论。
Motivation: 现有联邦 bandit 框架默认所有玩家自愿共享本地观测，但自利玩家在没有显式激励时不会参与协作，这一假设在实际场景中不成立。
Method: 提出激励感知的联邦 bandit 框架：玩家向服务器共享信息获得奖励、从服务器购买信息产生成本；在此之上设计基于 UCB 的 Buying-UCB 算法，把共享激励与信息获取成本同时纳入探索与协作的权衡。
Result: 理论上推导出群体遗憾 (group regret) 与购买成本 (buying cost) 的上界，并刻画完全协作联邦学习与完全独立学习之间的权衡；大量数值实验在不同协作与定价机制下验证了理论发现，展示了该框架的有效性。
Conclusion: 在自利玩家场景中，把共享激励与信息购买成本显式写进 bandit 算法，可以在个体探索与协作学习之间取得可分析的权衡，且该权衡可用遗憾与成本上界刻画。

papers.title: A Comprehensive Objective Evaluation of Modern Text-to-Speech for Turkish Using Speech Quality Assessment Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern text-to-speech (TTS) systems can clone a target speaker from a short reference clip or be fine-tuned on a target voice, yet their behaviour on morphologically rich, lower-resource languages such as Turkish remain under-characterised. We present a systematic benchmark of four contemporary systems (Chatterbox, CosyVoice, OmniVoice, and VoxCPM2) evaluated across fine-tuned and zero-shot configurations, contrasted with a conventional VITS baseline and anchored to natural gold speech. Each configuration is scored with eighteen complementary objective metrics spanning learned naturalness predictors (UTMOS v2, DNSMOS-Pro, SCOREQ, WhisQA, AudioBox-PQ, NatScore, SpeechLMScore), intelligibility and signal-quality estimators (SQUIM PESQ/SI-SDR/STOI, Brouhaha), speaker similarity, distributional fidelity (TTSDS) and low-level acoustic descriptors. We further analyse how quality varies with utterance length and quantify long-form temporal consistency through speaker-identity and naturalness drift over chunked utterances. We release our evaluation code to support reproducible TTS evaluation.
papers.comment: Accepted at 28th International Conference on Speech and Computer (SPECOM 2026). Published in Lecture Notes in Computer Science
papers.journal_ref: Lecture Notes in Computer Science, SPECOM 2026, Springer, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对土耳其语这类形态丰富、低资源语言的现代 TTS 缺少系统刻画，本文用 18 个客观指标对四个系统（Chatterbox、CosyVoice、OmniVoice、VoxCPM2）在微调与零样本两种配置下做统一基准，对照 VITS 基线与自然金标准语音。评测覆盖自然度预测、可懂度与信号质量、说话人相似度、分布保真度，并分析音长与分块长时一致性（说话人身份与自然度漂移），同时开源评测代码。
Motivation: 现代 TTS 可从短参考片段克隆说话人或在目标嗓音上微调，但其在土耳其语这类形态丰富、低资源语言上的行为尚未被系统刻画，缺少统一的客观评测基准。
Method: 对四个当代系统（Chatterbox、CosyVoice、OmniVoice、VoxCPM2）在微调与零样本配置下评测，并与常规 VITS 基线及自然金标准语音对照；每个配置用 18 个互补客观指标打分，含学习型自然度预测器（UTMOS v2、DNSMOS-Pro、SCOREQ、WhisQA、AudioBox-PQ、NatScore、SpeechLMScore）、可懂度与信号质量估计器（SQUIM PESQ/SI-SDR/STOI、Brouhaha）、说话人相似度、分布保真度（TTSDS）与低层声学描述子；另分析质量随话语长度的变化，并按分块话语量化说话人身份与自然度漂移的长时一致性。
Result: 给出覆盖四个系统 × 微调/零样本配置 × 18 个客观指标的系统基准，并量化质量随话语长度的变化，以及分块长时话语上的说话人身份漂移与自然度漂移；发布评测代码以支持可复现的 TTS 评测。
Conclusion: 土耳其语 TTS 可以用统一的多指标客观基准在微调与零样本配置间横向比较，评测代码开源以支撑可复现评测。

papers.title: ROT: Rotating Hidden States towards Contextual Vectors for Hallucination Mitigation in LVLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) frequently suffer from object hallucination. Existing training-free interventions primarily manipulate attention weights, which indirectly affect the deep semantics reaching the final predictive layers. In this work, we shift our focus to the hidden state vectors extracted after self-attention and residual addition. Empirical analysis reveals that hallucinated tokens do not simply over-rely on linguistic priors; instead, they exhibit an anomalous contextual deviation, showing significantly lower similarities to both textual and visual contexts in intermediate layers. Motivated by this, we propose ROT, a layer-specific, training-free framework. ROT dynamically detects semantic deviation in the middle layers and applies a norm-preserving rotation to steer the hidden states back toward the local multimodal context plane spanned by the contexts. For subsequent layers, a representational smoothing mechanism is introduced to stabilize the calibrated trajectory. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ROT consistently reduces hallucinations across various model architectures and scales, offering an efficient, geometry-driven solution for grounded generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ROT 是面向 LVLM 物体幻觉的免训练干预：在中间层检测隐藏状态对文本与视觉上下文的异常偏离，用保范数旋转 (norm-preserving rotation) 把隐藏状态拉回上下文张成的多模态平面，后续层再用表示平滑稳定校准轨迹。在多个基准上跨模型架构与规模一致降低幻觉。
Motivation: 现有免训练干预主要操纵注意力权重，只能间接影响到达最终预测层的深层语义；而幻觉 token 的真实症状是中间层隐藏状态对文本和视觉上下文的相似度都显著偏低，即上下文偏离而非单纯依赖语言先验。
Method: ROT 是分层 (layer-specific) 免训练框架：在中间层动态检测语义偏离，对 self-attention 与残差相加之后的隐藏状态向量施加保范数旋转，使其回到由文本与视觉上下文张成的局部多模态上下文平面；对后续层引入表示平滑 (representational smoothing) 机制以稳定校准后的轨迹。
Result: 在多个幻觉基准上，ROT 在不同 LVLM 架构与规模上均持续降低物体幻觉；实证分析显示幻觉 token 在中间层与文本、视觉两种上下文的相似度都显著更低。
Conclusion: 物体幻觉可被当作隐藏状态的几何偏离来治：直接旋转隐藏状态回到多模态上下文平面，比操纵注意力权重更贴近语义本身，且免训练、跨架构与规模通用。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: ROT 是面向 LVLM 物体幻觉的免训练干预：在中间层检测隐藏状态对文本与视觉上下文的异常偏离，用保范数旋转 (norm-preserving rotation) 把隐藏状态拉回上下文张成的多模态平面，后续层再用表示平滑稳定校准轨迹。在多个基准上跨模型架构与规模一致降低幻觉。

papers.title: Local2Mesh: Spatially Localized Contour-to-Mesh for Left Ventricular Reconstruction from Sparse 2D Cardiac MRI
papers.abstract_en: Three-dimensional (3D) left ventricular (LV) reconstruction from sparse cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging remains challenging due to inter-slice misalignment and insufficient local spatial information between slices. Global aggregation of contour features may obscure local contour-to-surface relationships. We propose Local2Mesh, a spatially localized contour-to-mesh framework that deforms a template mesh to reconstruct 3D LV geometry from sparse 2D contours without 3D mesh annotations. The framework introduces geometry-aware alignment to correct inter-slice misalignment and a plane-aware Local Router that routes contour features to template vertices using vertex-to-plane distances. Local and global contour features then jointly guide graph-based template deformation for 3D LV reconstruction. Experiments on two public datasets, M\&Ms-2 and ACDC, demonstrate superior geometric reconstruction and functional estimation over existing methods. Zero-shot transfer from M\&Ms-2 to ACDC demonstrates strong cross-dataset generalization. Reconstructed meshes also improve disease classification over sparse contours, supporting their utility for downstream cardiac analysis. These results demonstrate that combining geometry-aware alignment with local contour-to-vertex modeling improves LV reconstruction from sparse 2D contours and supports downstream cardiac analysis. The code is available at \url{https://github.com/hwu918945-alt/loca2mesh}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Local2Mesh 把稀疏 2D 心脏 MRI 轮廓直接变形成 3D 左心室 (LV) 网格，无需 3D mesh 标注：几何感知对齐纠正层间错位，plane-aware Local Router 按顶点到平面距离把轮廓特征路由到模板顶点，再由局部与全局轮廓特征共同驱动图结构模板变形。在 M&Ms-2 与 ACDC 上重建几何与功能估计优于现有方法，M&Ms-2 到 ACDC 的零样本迁移显示跨数据集泛化，重建网格还提升了疾病分类。
Motivation: 稀疏 CMR 层间错位、层间局部空间信息不足，而全局聚合轮廓特征会掩盖轮廓与曲面的局部对应关系，导致 3D 左心室重建不准。
Method: Local2Mesh 框架：geometry-aware alignment 校正层间错位；plane-aware Local Router 依据 vertex-to-plane 距离将轮廓特征路由至模板顶点；局部与全局轮廓特征共同引导基于图的模板变形，从 2D 轮廓重建 3D LV 几何，全程不需要 3D mesh 标注。
Result: 在两个公开数据集 M&Ms-2 与 ACDC 上，几何重建与功能估计优于现有方法；M&Ms-2 到 ACDC 的零样本迁移展现强跨数据集泛化；重建网格相比稀疏轮廓改善疾病分类。
Conclusion: 几何感知对齐与局部轮廓到顶点建模结合，能从稀疏 2D 轮廓改进 LV 重建并支撑下游心脏分析；代码已开源。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Backdooring Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly used not only to interpret language models but also to intervene on their internal representations. We show that this creates a supply-chain attack surface: a maliciously modified SAE can induce attacker-chosen behavior when inserted into the forward pass of an otherwise unchanged language model. We introduce a decoder-only SAE backdoor that leaves both the underlying LLM and the SAE encoder frozen, restricting the attack to a single auxiliary component at a single insertion layer. Using code generation as a case study, we demonstrate high rates of unsolicited code insertion across three language models and a wide range of insertion layers, as well as trigger-dependent behavior conditioned on a prompt cue. We further evaluate the modified SAEs using HumanEval and selected SAEBench metrics. While attack effectiveness varies across models and layers, strong backdoor behavior can coexist with relatively small changes in several conventional SAE quality measures. These results establish that SAEs can carry behavioral backdoors without modifying the language model itself and should therefore be treated as security-sensitive components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 SAE 作为可插拔解释/干预组件的供应链风险，提出只改 decoder 的 SAE 后门：LLM 与 SAE encoder 全冻结，攻击集中在单层单个辅助组件。在三个语言模型与多插入层上诱导出高比例的非请求代码插入和 prompt cue 触发行为，且强后门可与 HumanEval 及 SAEBench 多项质量指标的小幅变化共存。
Motivation: SAE 被插入 LLM 前向传播以做解释与干预，形成供应链攻击面：第三方提供的被篡改 SAE 可在模型本身不变的情况下改变行为，而常规 SAE 质量指标未必能暴露它。
Method: 提出 decoder-only SAE 后门：冻结底层 LLM 与 SAE encoder，只修改单个插入层上的 decoder 辅助组件；以代码生成为案例，用 prompt cue 控制触发依赖行为，并用 HumanEval 与选定 SAEBench 指标评估被修改的 SAE。
Result: 在三个语言模型和大范围插入层上展示高比例的非请求代码插入，以及由 prompt cue 调节的触发依赖行为；攻击效果随模型与层变化，但强后门行为可与若干常规 SAE 质量指标的相对较小变化共存（评估用 HumanEval 与 SAEBench 指标）。
Conclusion: SAE 可以在完全不改语言模型的情况下携带行为后门，因此应被视为安全敏感组件，其供应链需按此对待。

papers.title: RocketAgent: A Long-Horizon Engineering Agent for Multidisciplinary Design of Liquid-Rocket Thrust Chambers
papers.abstract_en: Liquid-rocket thrust-chamber design involves interdependent analyses in which downstream constraints can require earlier design decisions to be revisited. Managing these dependencies across heterogeneous tools requires consistent design information and coordinated updates throughout the workflow. We present RocketAgent, a long-horizon engineering agent for multidisciplinary preliminary design of liquid-rocket thrust chambers. A single plan-owning Coding Agent coordinates engineering skills for performance sizing, subsystem optimization, geometry generation, and multiphysics assessment. A provenance-aware knowledge graph supports method selection, while a typed Design Intermediate Representation maintains shared parameters, artifacts, and decisions. Revision-aware checks invalidate affected results and block superseded inputs, with consequential changes subject to engineering approval. In a representative simulation-based design, RocketAgent continued from an infeasible cooling search through an engineer-authorized operating-point revision, identified feasible subsystem designs, and coordinated subsequent geometry generation and multiphysics assessment to support final configuration selection. Separate module tests assessed surrogate predictions and nozzle adaptation. A two-configuration comparison across three controlled scenarios verified the expected dependency invalidations and superseded-input blocking before solver execution. The representative case demonstrates sustained coordination across a multidisciplinary design workflow, while the controlled tests establish the behavior of the revision mechanisms supporting that execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RocketAgent 是面向液体火箭推力室多学科初步设计的长时程工程 agent：由单一持有计划的 Coding Agent 协调性能尺寸设计、子系统优化、几何生成与多物理评估，用带溯源的知识图谱选方法、用类型化 Design Intermediate Representation 共享参数与决策。修订感知检查会作废受影响结果并拦截被取代的输入，重大改动须经工程师批准；在代表性仿真设计案例中，它从不可行的冷却搜索出发，经工程师授权的工作点修订找到可行子系统设计并完成后续几何与多物理评估。
Motivation: 推力室设计中下游约束会迫使回改上游决策，跨异构工具的依赖管理需要一致的设计信息与协同更新，人工难以长时程维持。
Method: 单一 plan-owning Coding Agent 调度性能尺寸、子系统优化、几何生成、多物理评估等技能；带溯源的知识图谱 (provenance-aware knowledge graph) 支撑方法选择，类型化 Design Intermediate Representation 维护共享参数、产物与决策；修订感知检查作废受影响结果、拦截被取代输入，重大变更需工程审批。
Result: 代表性仿真设计案例中，RocketAgent 从不可行的冷却搜索经工程师授权的工作点修订继续推进，识别出可行子系统设计并协调几何生成与多物理评估以支持最终构型选择；另有独立模块测试检验 surrogate 预测与喷管适配，并在两构型、三个受控场景的对比中于求解器执行前验证了预期的依赖作废与被取代输入拦截行为。
Conclusion: 长时程协调加修订感知的依赖管理足以支撑推力室多学科初步设计的持续执行，代表性案例证明执行的持续性，受控测试确立修订机制的行为。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GO-Based Clustering for Learning Cluster-Level Causal Gene Regulatory Networks
papers.abstract_en: Discovery of causal relationships in high-dimensional Gene Regulatory Networks (GRN) is computationally challenging and often difficult to interpret due to dense connections. Therefore, grouping genes together into functional modules can improve tractability and biological interpretability. However, existing cluster level causal discovery methods assume access to a predefined admissible partitions, requiring the graph over clusters to be acyclic. Constructing such partitions is therefore challenging. In this work, we introduce GO-based Clustering for Causal Discovery (GO4CD), an algorithm that uses Gene Ontology (GO) to construct biologically meaningful gene partitions at multiple levels of granularity, while favoring those more likely to be admissible for causal discovery. GO4CD groups together genes participating in a shared biological process, and propagates gene annotations through the ontology hierarchy to achieve different granularity of partitions. Furthermore, we integrate GO4CD with Causal Learning over Clusters (CLOC) algorithm and evaluate recovery of true Markov equivalence class both with an oracle of conditional independencies and on simulated gene expression data using multivariate conditional independence tests. We evaluate GO4CD on multiple E.coli regulatory subnetworks and find that it is inadmissible in 18.1% of the cases, compared with 65.3-82.3% for the semantic-similarity baselines. Our results indicate that GO4CD is substantially better suited to learning causal GRNs defined over biologically meaningful gene clusters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GO4CD 用 Gene Ontology 层级把基因构造成多粒度、且更可能满足因果发现可容许性（admissible，聚类间无环）的划分，再与 Causal Learning over Clusters (CLOC) 结合学习聚类级因果基因调控网络。在多个 E.coli 调控子网络上，GO4CD 判定为不可容许的比例仅 18.1%，而语义相似度基线为 65.3–82.3%。
Motivation: 高维基因调控网络 (GRN) 的因果发现计算量大、稠密连接难解释；已有聚类级因果发现方法要求预先给定可容许划分且聚类间图必须无环，而这样的划分本身难以构造。
Method: GO4CD 借助 Gene Ontology 把参与同一生物过程的基因分到一起，并沿本体层级传播基因注释以产生不同粒度的划分，同时偏向对因果发现更可能可容许的划分；再与 Causal Learning over Clusters (CLOC) 集成，用条件独立性 oracle 与多元条件独立性检验在模拟基因表达数据上评估真实 Markov 等价类的恢复。
Result: 在多个 E.coli 调控子网络上，GO4CD 的划分被判定为不可容许 (inadmissible) 的比例为 18.1%，语义相似度基线为 65.3–82.3%；评估同时覆盖条件独立性 oracle 与基于多元条件独立性检验的模拟基因表达数据两种设定。
Conclusion: 借助 GO 本体层级构造的基因划分比语义相似度基线更适合学习定义在生物意义基因聚类上的因果 GRN，因为其不可容许比例低一个量级。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Representation Disentanglement for Fair Chest X-Ray Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has advanced chest X-ray (CXR) diagnosis, yet demographic biases in learned representations may contribute to performance disparities across intersectional groups. We propose a single-encoder framework combining dual-level decorrelation with prototype-guided cross-group contrastive learning to reduce demographic dependence while accounting for within-class variation. We further propose Demographic Representation Alignment Reduction (DRAR), a new metric that quantifies the reduction in demographic structure within disease representations. The framework is evaluated on four classification tasks using 34,809 CheXpert test images across eight intersectional groups, defined by age, sex and ethnicity. Compared with empirical risk minimization (ERM), our method reduces the mean equalized-odds gap from 15.41\% to 10.86\% and the AUC gap from 5.95\% to 5.01\%. Our method achieves a DRAR of 59.04\% relative to ERM, with only a slight decrease in mean AUC. These results demonstrate that representation disentanglement can reduce demographic bias and improve intersectional fairness. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/06Yujie/Fair-Medical-Imaging}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出单编码器表征解耦框架，用双层去相关 (dual-level decorrelation) 加原型引导的跨组对比学习 (prototype-guided cross-group contrastive learning) 削弱胸片疾病表征中的人口学依赖，同时保留类内变化。在 34,809 张 CheXpert 测试图像、八个由年龄/性别/族裔定义的交叉组上，相对 ERM 把平均 equalized-odds gap 从 15.41% 降到 10.86%，AUC gap 从 5.95% 降到 5.01%，DRAR 达 59.04%，代价是平均 AUC 略降。
Motivation: 深度学习胸片诊断中学到的表征含人口学偏倚，会在交叉群体间造成性能差异，需要在不牺牲类内多样性的前提下削弱这种依赖。
Method: 单编码器框架，结合双层去相关与原型引导的跨组对比学习来降低人口学依赖并兼顾类内变化；另提出 Demographic Representation Alignment Reduction (DRAR) 指标，量化疾病表征中人口学结构的削减程度。

papers.title: MercerFlow: Flow Matching in a Kernel-Induced Latent Space for Probabilistic Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that probabilistic flow matching for time series forecasting benefits from a data-matched prior. The resulting prior introduces local correlations, which a sequential architecture usually absorbs: a recurrent neural network (RNN), a structured state-space model (S4), or a Transformer. However, such a backbone costs GPU memory and time per epoch. A cheaper alternative is MLP-based latent-space flow matching: embed the time series via an invertible map to a single latent vector and learn the flow there, so a tabular MLP can treat the series as a set of features. The relationship between the prior and the choice of linear latent map is understudied in conditional flow matching (CFM) forecasting, yet we found it strongly affects performance. Fixed transforms such as Fourier or discrete cosine (DCT) are only well-conditioned for Ornstein--Uhlenbeck priors, while a principal-component (PCA) map fit to the data is a strong but training-set-dependent reference sensitive to train--test shift. Instead, we propose to use the Mercer eigenbasis of the prior kernel: it diagonalises the centred covariance exactly, decouples from training data, and adapts to non-stationary and periodic priors. On five GluonTS benchmarks (ETTh1, ETTh2, Weather, Electricity, Traffic) under a shared protocol with TSFlow, the resulting MLP matches or beats it on CRPS at about $4.7\times$ less training memory and $3.5\times$--$4.4\times$ less time per epoch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MercerFlow 用先验核的 Mercer 特征基 (Mercer eigenbasis) 作为可逆线性潜空间映射，在该空间里用 MLP 做条件流匹配 (CFM) 概率预报，精确对角化中心化协方差、与训练数据解耦。在 GluonTS 五个基准 (ETTh1, ETTh2, Weather, Electricity, Traffic) 的共享协议下，CRPS 追平或超过 TSFlow，同时训练显存省约 4.7 倍、每 epoch 时间省 3.5–4.4 倍。
Motivation: RNN/S4/Transformer 骨干能吸收 data-matched prior 的局部相关性，但显存和每 epoch 时间开销大；MLP 潜空间流匹配更便宜，而线性潜映射与 prior 的关系在 CFM 预报中研究不足，且 Fourier/DCT 只对 OU prior 条件良好、PCA 易受训练-测试偏移影响。
Method: 用可逆线性映射把时间序列压成单个潜向量，在潜空间上学 flow，骨干换成表格型 MLP；线性映射取 prior 核的 Mercer 特征基，精确对角化中心化协方差并与训练数据解耦，可适配非平稳与周期性 prior；与 TSFlow 在共享协议下对比。
Result: 在 GluonTS 五个基准 ETTh1、ETTh2、Weather、Electricity、Traffic 上，CRPS 追平或超过 TSFlow，训练显存约少 4.7 倍，每 epoch 时间少 3.5–4.4 倍。
Conclusion: 潜空间流匹配的线性映射应按 prior 核来选而非固定变换或数据拟合的 PCA：Mercer 基在保持 CRPS 的同时把训练成本降一个量级。

papers.title: Casual Flash Lighting for Gaussian Splat Inverse Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Recovering geometry, materials, and lighting from photographs is highly ambiguous when only static illumination is available. Active-lighting setups reduce the ambiguity but require dark rooms or specialized hardware. Instead, we synergize both static and flash lighting from casual indoor capture, with the flash on or off, each from independent viewpoints. The flash residual constrains albedo and the BRDF, while static lighting captures grazing-angle specular highlights that flash misses. With a 2DGS reconstruction framing, our key contribution is a GS-anchored diffuse field: a hash-encoded MLP is queried at the rasterized 2DGS depth. As it depends only on world position, it is view consistent in 3D and allows the flash residual to drive material decomposition instead of being absorbed by alpha-blending drift across views. At the same time, we render static lighting with deferred shading such that it can also supervise material decomposition. On five synthetic and three real indoor scenes, our method outperforms six recent baselines on diffuse color, albedo and roughness material parameters, and in relighting where PSNR improves by 4.17 dB over the next-best baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在仅有静态光照的室内照片中，几何、材质与光照高度歧义；本文把随手拍摄的开/关闪光图像与静态光照协同起来，用 2DGS 重建框架加 GS 锚定的 diffuse field（在光栅化 2DGS 深度处查询的 hash-encoded MLP）做逆渲染。闪光残差约束 albedo 与 BRDF，静态光照补上闪光缺失的掠射角高光；在 5 个合成与 3 个真实室内场景上，漫反射颜色、albedo、roughness 及重光照均超过 6 个近期基线，重光照 PSNR 比次优基线高 4.17 dB。
Motivation: 仅靠静态光照从照片恢复几何、材质与光照存在高度歧义；主动光照装置能缓解但需要暗室或专用硬件，日常室内拍摄缺少这类条件。
Method: 协同使用随手室内拍摄的开/关闪光与静态光照，两者各自来自独立视角；闪光残差约束 albedo 与 BRDF，静态光照经 deferred shading 渲染以监督材质分解。核心是 GS 锚定的 diffuse field：在光栅化 2DGS 深度处查询 hash-encoded MLP，仅依赖世界坐标，保证 3D 视角一致，避免闪光残差被跨视角 alpha-blending 漂移吸收。
Result: 在 5 个合成与 3 个真实室内场景上，漫反射颜色、albedo、roughness 材质参数与重光照四项均超过 6 个近期基线；重光照 PSNR 比次优基线提升 4.17 dB。
Conclusion: 把随手闪光与静态光照协同并用视角一致的 GS 锚定 diffuse field 承载材质分解，可在无需暗室或专用硬件的条件下同时改善材质恢复与重光照。

papers.title: How well do routinely collected demographic and clinical variables aid point-of-care lung ultrasound TB classification
papers.abstract_en: We consider the fusion of lung ultrasound images with routinely-collected clinical and demographic data for the purpose of automated tuberculosis (TB) screening using deep-learning. Such deep-learning based screening tools for TB could meaningfully support the health care system in Africa, where the burden of disease is severe and resources are constrained. Beginning with an established ResNet baseline for classification of lung ultrasound images, which achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic (AUROC) curve of 0.91 [0.86,0.96] (95% CI), we consider the incorporation of the clinical and demographic data using three fusion approaches. We find that a simple average-based fusion of the output scores of separately-trained image and clinical data classifiers consistently matches or outperforms a more complex approach where the data is fused earlier and a combined classifier is trained. Fusing the image and the clinical classifiers in this way leads to a classifier with an overall AUROC of 0.95 [0.91,0.99] (specificity of 0.76 at sensitivity 0.93) which is an improvement of 4% absolute over the image-only baseline. We also find that greedy feature selection can be used to reduce the number of clinical and demographic inputs without sacrificing classification performance. Finally, when we differentiate between clinical and demographic data that are self-reported, that require some basic measurement or calculation, and that require a point-of-care (POC) test, we find the inclusion of the POC tests included in this study to be of minimal benefit to classification performance. We conclude that the incorporation of routinely-collected clinical and demographic data is a promising way to improve the performance of lung ultrasound based automatic classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在肺超声 (lung ultrasound) 结核病 (TB) 筛查中，把图像分类器与常规临床/人口学数据分类器的输出分数做简单平均融合，AUROC 从纯图像 ResNet 的 0.91 提到 0.95（+4% 绝对值），且优于更早融合再联合训练的复杂方案。贪心特征选择可削减临床与人口学输入而不损失性能，而本研究所含的即时检验 (POC test) 对分类增益极小。
Motivation: 非洲结核病负担重、资源受限，肺超声深度学习筛查仅靠图像存在性能上限，需要低成本、常规可得的临床与人口学信息来补足，同时要控制输入采集成本。
Method: 以已建立的 ResNet 图像分类基线为起点，比较三种融合策略（含输出分数的简单平均融合与更早期的联合融合训练）；再用贪心特征选择 (greedy feature selection) 精简临床与人口学输入，并按自报、需基础测量/计算、需 POC 检验三类数据分别考察贡献。
Result: 纯图像 ResNet 基线 AUROC 0.91 [0.86, 0.96]（95% CI）；平均分数融合后总体 AUROC 0.95 [0.91, 0.99]，特异度 0.76、灵敏度 0.93，较图像基线绝对提升 4%；简单平均融合一致匹配或优于更复杂的早期融合联合训练方案；贪心特征选择可减少输入数量而不牺牲性能；POC 检验对分类性能增益极小。
Conclusion: 常规采集的临床与人口学数据是提升肺超声自动结核分类的有前景途径，且用最简单的分数级平均融合即可，POC 检验类变量在本研究中性价比最低。

papers.title: Polynomial neural surrogates for designing photonic quantum experiments
papers.abstract_en: Physics simulators can support the discovery of quantum experiments by predicting the states generated by experimental configurations. When these simulators are computationally expensive, repeated simulator calls can limit the search for experiments that generate a desired quantum state. Here, we develop a physics-inspired polynomial neural surrogate for PyTheus, a graph-based quantum-optics simulator, to predict quantum states and use it to design quantum experiments. Its polynomial activations are motivated by the relation between graph perfect matchings and the resulting state amplitudes. We train separate surrogate models for four-, six-, and eight-photon systems and show that they achieve higher prediction accuracy with fewer trainable parameters than standard multilayer perceptrons. We then use the trained surrogates for inverse design of GHZ, W, and linear-cluster states. For the larger systems, the surrogates also enable faster inverse design than direct optimization with PyTheus. These results suggest that incorporating the underlying physics into neural surrogates can provide an efficient approach to quantum experiment design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为图论量子光学模拟器 PyTheus 构建物理启发的多项式神经代理 (polynomial neural surrogate)，其多项式激活对应图完美匹配与态振幅的关系，用于预测量子态并做逆向设计。在四、六、八光子系统上，该代理用更少可训练参数取得高于标准 MLP 的预测精度；对较大型系统，逆向设计 GHZ、W 与线性簇态也快于直接用 PyTheus 优化。
Motivation: 物理模拟器预测实验配置产生的量子态，但计算昂贵，反复调用会拖慢对目标量子态的实验搜索。
Method: 针对 PyTheus 训练物理启发的多项式神经代理，激活函数形式由图完美匹配与态振幅的对应关系给出；四、六、八光子系统各训一个独立模型，再用训练好的代理做 GHZ、W、线性簇态的逆向设计。
Result: 四、六、八光子三个代理在可训练参数少于标准 MLP 的同时预测精度更高；对较大型系统，代理驱动的逆向设计比直接用 PyTheus 优化更快。
Conclusion: 把底层物理写进神经代理，是量子实验设计的一条高效路径；对大系统收益体现在逆向设计速度上。

papers.title: LightMTP: Lightweight Latent Multi-Token Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Next-token prediction (NTP) is the standard pretraining objective for large language models, yet it provides an explicit training signal only for the immediate next token, which can lead models to exploit local patterns instead of capturing longer-range structure and ideas. Multi-token prediction (MTP) addresses this by training models to predict several future tokens. However, existing MTP methods often introduce a large number of new parameters with limited improvements in downstream performance. Latent MTP approaches address this efficiency issue by encoding future tokens into a vector representation. However, these approaches usually rely on external helper models for future token encoding. We propose LightMTP, a lightweight, i.e., parameter-efficient, latent MTP approach that bootstraps the future token representations from the model's own hidden states. Our two LightMTP variants extend supervision to more future tokens without requiring the additional computational overhead of conventional MTP nor the external supervision latent MTP normally relies on. LightMTP adds at most 1% extra parameters, retains better performance on general language modeling benchmarks, and achieves similar gains in planning, coding, and reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Differentiable Bit-Widths: Co-optimizing Pruning and Quantization via SVD for Ultra-Efficient LLM Compression
papers.abstract_en: SVD-based pruning and quantization have recently emerged as a promising strategy for the ultra-efficient compression of large language models. In these methods, compression is performed in two stages: components are first truncated, and the remaining ones are subsequently quantized. Although this decoupled pipeline benefits from both pruning and quantization, it requires separate optimization for each stage and fails to fully exploit their balance, which can lead to suboptimal performance under aggressive compression. To address this limitation, we propose a new LLM compression method that co-optimizes pruning and quantization in a unified framework. Our key idea is a differentiable method for learning component-wise bit-widths, allowing less important components to be assigned 0-bit precision and pruned away. Notably, our method performs favorably against two-stage baselines, even when subjected to extreme quantization settings ($1.61$ bits) designed for ultra-efficiency. Code: https://github.com/MMAI-Laboratory/DBW.
papers.comment: Accepted to Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Differentiable Bit-Widths (DBW)：把基于 SVD 的 LLM 剪枝与量化放进统一可微框架，直接学习每个分量的 bit-width，让不重要的分量被分配 0-bit 精度而直接剪掉。在极端压缩设置（1.61 bits）下仍优于两阶段基线。
Motivation: 现有 SVD 压缩分两阶段：先截断分量、再量化剩余分量，两阶段各自独立优化，无法利用剪枝与量化之间的平衡，在激进压缩下性能次优。
Method: 在统一框架内联合优化剪枝与量化，核心是可微地学习分量级 bit-width (component-wise bit-widths)，使低重要性分量得到 0-bit 精度并被剪除；针对超高效场景的极端量化设置进行设计。
Result: 在 1.61 bits 的极端量化设置下，方法表现优于两阶段 (two-stage) 剪枝+量化基线；代码发布于 github.com/MMAI-Laboratory/DBW。
Conclusion: 把剪枝与量化在可微 bit-width 学习下联合优化，可在超低比特压缩区间仍保持对两阶段流水线的优势。

papers.title: Grounded Joint-Attention Other-Play for Zero-Shot Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Joint attention - the human ability to share a common visual or cognitive focus with others - enables a meeting of minds that lets us coordinate even with unfamiliar partners. In this work we investigate whether equipping AI agents with a similar mechanism can enable such zero-shot coordination. We introduce Mutual Attention for zero-shot TEaming (MATE): a novel multi-agent reinforcement learning method inspired by human joint attention. MATE encourages agents to coordinate their actions by aligning their visual attention on scene-salient objects during the interaction rather than relying on arbitrary partner-dependent conventions established during training. Unlike symmetry-breaking approaches that merely prevent brittle conventions from emerging, MATE actively promotes coordination through an environment-grounded signal that is naturally shared across partners. We evaluate MATE on three benchmarks: our Card Alignment Game, designed to isolate brittle convention formation, and the more challenging Level-Based Foraging and OvercookedV2 benchmarks. Our experiments consistently show that a joint-attention-inspired signal improves coordination with unknown partners, underlining MATE's potential as a general coordination mechanism that complements and surpasses symmetry-breaking approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多智能体强化学习方法 MATE（Mutual Attention for zero-shot TEaming），借人类共同注意 (joint attention) 让智能体在交互中把视觉注意对齐到场景显著物体上，用环境共享信号替代依赖搭档的任意约定，实现零样本协调 (zero-shot coordination)。在 Card Alignment Game、Level-Based Foraging、OvercookedV2 三个基准上，共同注意信号一致提升与未知搭档的协调表现，并被作者称为可补充并超越对称性破缺 (symmetry-breaking) 类方法。
Motivation: 零样本协调中，训练期形成的搭档相关约定在遇到新搭档时很脆弱；已有对称性破缺方法只是阻止这类约定出现，并未主动促成协调。
Method: MATE 是受共同注意启发的多智能体强化学习方法：训练中鼓励智能体把视觉注意对齐到场景显著物体，而非依赖任意搭档约定，协调由环境落地 (environment-grounded) 且搭档间天然共享的信号驱动。评测用自建 Card Alignment Game（专门隔离脆弱约定形成）以及 Level-Based Foraging 和 OvercookedV2。
Result: 在 Card Alignment Game、Level-Based Foraging、OvercookedV2 三个基准上，实验一致显示共同注意信号提升了与未知搭档的协调；摘要给出的是定性一致改进，未列具体数值。
Conclusion: 以环境共享的注意对齐信号可以促成零样本协调，作者主张该机制能补充并超越仅防止脆弱约定的对称性破缺方法，可作为通用协调机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Joint Precision Neural Networks: Task-Aware Dependency and Predictive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Exploiting meaningful latent structures from data to solve downstream tasks is a fundamental challenge in signal processing and machine learning. While Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and coVariance Neural Networks (VNNs) successfully leverage the covariance matrix to process data, they inherently capture both direct and indirect correlations. The precision matrix (inverse covariance) overcomes this by explicitly encoding conditional independencies, making it largely studied in graphical lasso and graph topology identification. However, finite-sample precision estimates are notoriously unstable, and regularized estimators remain task-agnostic. In this work, our principal contribution is tackling the challenging problem of task-aware graph inference. We propose Precision Neural Networks-Joint (PNN-Joint), a framework that jointly estimates a sparse, statistically grounded precision matrix alongside graph neural network weights via an alternating optimization scheme. As a foundational framework to support this, we introduce Precision Neural Networks (PNNs), a broader class of graph convolutional networks operating on precision estimators, and establish their spectral connections to PCA and VNNs alongside their stability to finite-sample errors. Extensive empirical evaluations on synthetic data, as well as real-world neuroimaging and motion sensor datasets, demonstrate that PNN-Joint yields highly interpretable task-aware graphs, exhibits remarkable robustness in low-data regimes, and consistently achieves the best or second-best performance among competitors on real-world tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PNN-Joint：用交替优化同时估计稀疏、统计上有依据的 precision matrix 与图神经网络权重，把图推断从任务无关变成任务感知。在合成数据、神经影像与运动传感器数据上，该方法给出可解释的任务感知图，并在低数据量下表现出稳健性，在真实任务中取得最好或次好的性能。
Motivation: PCA 与 VNN 只利用协方差，混杂直接与间接相关；precision matrix 能表达条件独立，但有限样本估计不稳定，且 graphical lasso 等正则化估计器与下游任务无关。
Method: PNN-Joint 通过交替优化方案联合估计稀疏 precision matrix 与 GNN 权重；作为基础框架提出 PNN（在 precision 估计上运行的一类 GCN），并建立其与 PCA、VNN 的谱联系及对有限样本误差的稳定性。
Result: 在合成数据、神经影像 (neuroimaging) 与运动传感器数据集上的评测显示：PNN-Joint 产生高度可解释的任务感知图，在低数据量区间表现稳健，并在真实任务中于所有对比方法中取得最好或次好性能。
Conclusion: 把 precision matrix 估计与 GNN 训练联合优化，可以在有限样本下得到任务感知且可解释的图，同时保持对低数据量的稳健性。

papers.title: Scalable Minimal-Change Learning for Controllable Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Image editing should change only the attributes specified by an instruction while preserving everything else, yet current methods often make unintended changes. We treat this minimal-change principle as an optimization objective for instruction-based editing. Latent L1 regularization is a poor proxy for output locality in modern nonlinear generators and often requires supervision unavailable at scale. We instead optimize edit outcomes with reinforcement learning. An agentic vision-language reward model audits each source image, instruction, and edited image for two failure types: unimplemented requested changes and unintended changes. A group-level rubric merges and verifies these issues to provide consistent rewards across candidate edits without per-instruction human annotations. On FLUX.1 Kontext-dev, ARRO raises average EditScore from 5.21 to 5.88 across MinEval, MagicBrush, AnyBench, and Emu-Edit. On 600 evaluation examples, it reduces off-target pixel change by 8.4% relative to the base editor. Reward and SFT controls, blinded human evaluations, and transfer to OmniGen2 provide complementary evidence. Code: https://github.com/Showwwwwwwww/ARRO
papers.comment: 29 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Revised version with additional off-target, reward and SFT control, human evaluation, and OmniGen2 transfer results; clarified related work and experimental scope
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARRO 把「只改指令要求的属性、其余保持不变」写成可优化目标，用强化学习替代潜空间 L1 正则：agentic VLM 奖励模型对源图、指令与编辑结果审计两类失败（该改没改、不该改却改了），group-level rubric 合并核验以在无逐条人工标注下给出一致奖励。在 FLUX.1 Kontext-dev 上，跨 MinEval、MagicBrush、AnyBench、Emu-Edit 的平均 EditScore 从 5.21 升到 5.88；600 例评测中相对基线编辑器把 off-target 像素改动降低 8.4%。
Motivation: 指令式图像编辑应只改动指令指定属性，但现有方法常产生非预期改动；潜空间 L1 正则在现代非线性生成器上是输出局部性的差代理，且往往依赖无法大规模获得的监督信号。
Method: 把 minimal-change 原则形式化为编辑结果的优化目标，用强化学习直接优化：agentic vision-language 奖励模型审计 (源图, 指令, 编辑图) 并识别两类失败——未实现的请求改动与非预期改动；group-level rubric 合并并核验这些问题，为候选编辑提供跨指令一致的奖励，无需逐条人工标注。
Result: 在 FLUX.1 Kontext-dev 上，ARRO 将 MinEval、MagicBrush、AnyBench、Emu-Edit 四个基准的平均 EditScore 从 5.21 提升到 5.88；在 600 个评测样本上，相对基线编辑器将 off-target 像素改动减少 8.4%。Reward 与 SFT 对照、盲测人工评测以及向 OmniGen2 的迁移构成补充证据。
Conclusion: 用可审计的 VLM 奖励加 group-level rubric 直接优化编辑结果，可以在无逐条人工标注的情况下同时压低漏改与误改，且该奖励可迁移到其他编辑器（OmniGen2）。

papers.title: Patch-based Querying Identifies Structures of Interest in Electron Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: Volume electron microscopy (vEM) has emerged as an essential sensing technique in biomedical research, allowing the three-dimensional imaging of biological cells and tissues at nanometer-scale resolution. The ability to generate extensive datasets has reached the limitations of downstream analysis processes, which depend significantly on the intervention of human experts for preprocessing and annotation. We propose an efficient and reliable patch-based retrieval framework based on self-supervised learning of local image descriptors to locate self-similar structures in vEM datasets. Given a few manual annotations of a given cellular structure, our method can retrieve similar structures across the EM volume. Our framework is interactive, allowing the human expert to refine the search queries and retrieve relevant image patches quickly and using little labeled data. Experiments on real-world vEM images of biological tissues demonstrate that our framework can reliably identify relevant cellular structures, generalize across different organelles and acquisition modalities, and substantially reduce the search space for downstream analysis.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 20 figures, 5 tables. Accepted for publication in Computers in Biology and Medicine
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对体积电子显微镜 (vEM) 数据量超出人工预处理与标注能力的问题，提出基于自监督局部图像描述子的 patch 检索框架：给定少量某细胞结构的手工标注，即可在整个 EM 体数据中检索自相似结构，并支持专家交互式修正查询。在真实生物组织 vEM 图像上，该框架能可靠识别相关细胞结构、跨不同细胞器与成像模态泛化，并大幅缩小下游分析的搜索空间。
Motivation: vEM 已能纳米级三维成像细胞与组织并产出海量数据，但下游分析依赖人工专家做预处理和标注，已达到处理能力上限。
Method: 基于自监督学习局部图像描述子的 patch 检索框架：以少量某细胞结构的手工标注为查询，在整个 EM 体数据中检索自相似 patch；框架交互式，允许专家修正查询并快速重新检索，仅需少量标注数据。
Result: 在真实生物组织 vEM 图像上的实验表明，框架能可靠识别相关细胞结构，跨不同细胞器与不同采集模态均能泛化，并大幅缩减下游分析的搜索空间。
Conclusion: 少量标注加自监督 patch 描述子足以在 vEM 体数据中定位目标细胞结构，把人工搜索转为交互式检索，从而缓解下游分析的专家瓶颈。

papers.title: Adaptive Expert Guidance for Efficient On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: With massively parallel simulation, on-policy Reinforcement Learning methods such as PPO have become standard in many domains. However, learning from scratch is sample-inefficient and fails to exploit the potential existence of a suboptimal expert, such as a heuristic, a model-based controller, or a policy trained on a related task. Such an expert is often available and can guide early training, but its sub-optimality limits final performance. The challenge then becomes balancing expert guidance against learning from rewards. Existing methods set the expert's influence through a blending weight, a schedule, or an evaluation-driven curriculum. Alternatively, they adapt it with additional learned components such as critics over expert actions or auxiliary agents. However, none optimizes it using the same on-policy objective as the policy itself. We propose a method in which the learner and the expert alternate control within each training episode, and the expert's share of control is a single learnable parameter optimized jointly with the policy. The learner benefits from the expert early in training, but its share of control declines as the learner becomes more competent, until eventually vanishing completely. This leaves the learner acting alone and better than the suboptimal expert. We evaluate our method on 34 tasks across two benchmarks, spanning discrete and continuous action spaces, using both learned and model-based experts. Our method improves sample efficiency over guided and unguided baselines while requiring minimal hyperparameter variation. The expert's share decays to zero as the learner improves, vanishing when the expert is no longer useful.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种在策略强化学习 (on-policy RL) 的自适应专家引导方法：学习器与次优专家在每个训练 episode 内交替控制，专家控制份额是一个与策略联合优化的单一可学习参数，随学习器能力提升单调衰减至零。在两个基准共 34 个任务（覆盖离散与连续动作空间、学习型与基于模型的专家）上，该方法相对有引导和无引导基线提升样本效率，且超参数几乎无需调整。
Motivation: PPO 等在策略 RL 依赖大规模并行仿真，从零学习样本效率低，而已有的次优专家（启发式、基于模型的控制器、相关任务上训练的策略）通常只能靠混合权重、调度表或课程来引入，其影响无法用与策略相同的在策略目标来优化。
Method: 学习器与专家在每个训练 episode 内交替接管控制，专家的控制份额被参数化为单个可学习标量，与策略参数用同一个在策略目标联合优化；训练推进时该份额自动下降，专家不再有用时完全消失。评测覆盖两个基准的 34 个任务，动作空间含离散与连续，专家既有学习型也有基于模型的。
Result: 在 34 个任务、两个基准上，相对有引导与无引导基线均提升样本效率，且超参数变化需求极小；专家控制份额随学习器改进衰减到零，在专家不再有用时消失，最终学习器独立表现超过次优专家。
Conclusion: 把专家引导强度做成与策略同目标联合优化的可学习参数，可以让引导在早期有用、后期自动退场，从而同时拿到样本效率和超越次优专家的最终性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Investigating Query-Insensitive Behavior in Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) aims to localize objects or events described by natural language queries in both space and time. Existing STVG models are typically trained and evaluated under the assumption that each query is relevant to the input video. In this work, we challenge this assumption by studying the behavior of state-of-the-art STVG models under irrelevant queries and missing textual input. Our experiments show that current models can still produce plausible spatio-temporal predictions even when the query is unrelated to the video or removed entirely. We further analyze HCSTVG-v2 and VidSTG to identify dataset regularities that may encourage such query-insensitive behavior. Our study highlights an underexplored limitation of STVG models and motivates negative-aware evaluation protocols and architectures that explicitly assess query relevance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 时空视频定位 (STVG) 模型即使拿到与视频无关的查询、甚至完全没有文本输入，仍会输出看似合理的时空框。作者在 HCSTVG-v2 与 VidSTG 上分析出助长这种 query-insensitive 行为的数据集规律，并主张改用负样本感知的评测协议与显式判断查询相关性的架构。
Motivation: 现有 STVG 训练与评测都默认每条查询与视频相关，模型是否真的依赖文本从未被检验；这使无关查询下的伪合理预测成为被忽略的失效模式。
Method: 对 SOTA STVG 模型做两类扰动实验：输入与视频无关的查询，以及直接移除文本输入；随后在 HCSTVG-v2 与 VidSTG 两个数据集上分析可能鼓励 query-insensitive 行为的数据规律。
Result: 实验显示当前模型在查询与视频无关或文本被完全移除时，仍能产生看似合理的时空预测；数据集分析指向 HCSTVG-v2 与 VidSTG 中助长该行为的规律。
Conclusion: STVG 模型对查询的依赖程度低于假设，评测需引入 negative-aware 协议，架构需显式评估查询相关性。
