papers.title: Parallelism or Concession? Concurrency-Aware Procurement Negotiation for Agentic Commerce
papers.abstract_en: Agentic buyers can cheaply fork a procurement task into many parallel negotiations, but concurrency is not free: every thread consumes resources, and simultaneous agreements create cancellation and commitment risk. We study a one-unit post-order sourcing problem with a single hard-deadline negotiation window, in which a planner jointly chooses the number of seller-facing negotiators and a common procurement price cap. The model combines a product-specific acceptance curve with fulfillment loss, per-thread cost, and excess-commitment cost. We establish three structural results. First, holding the per-thread acceptance target fixed, the marginal value of another negotiator decays geometrically, yielding a conditional concurrency threshold. Second, under a convex quantile curve, parallelism substitutes for concession: more concurrent negotiators imply a weakly lower per-thread acceptance target and price cap. Third, when prices are more dispersed, Agentic buyers benefit by searching harder for bargains, but suffer when they instead try to guarantee procurement by offering higher prices. We operationalize these results in the Concurrency-Aware Negotiation Optimizer (CANO), a deterministic optimizer that jointly determines the optimal negotiation concurrency and procurement price cap for an agentic procurement system. Across different analytic market configurations and extensive Monte Carlo, finite-data, non-Gaussian, and correlated-seller stress tests, CANO consistently outperforms common heuristic policies while validating the predicted structural properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在单件、硬截止的采购谈判中，CANO 联合决定并行谈判线程数与统一价格上限，把并发与让价当作可互替的两个旋钮。边际谈判者价值几何衰减并给出并发阈值；凸分位曲线下线程越多则每线程接受目标与价格上限都弱降；价格更分散时压价搜寻有利、抬价保供反而受损。CANO 在解析市场配置与 Monte Carlo、有限数据、非高斯、相关卖家压力测试中稳定优于常见启发式策略。
Motivation: Agentic 买方能把采购任务廉价 fork 成大量并行谈判，但每条线程都耗资源，同时成交还会带来取消与承诺风险；并发数与价格上限若分开决策会同时放大成本与超订风险。
Method: 建立单件事后采购模型：一个硬截止谈判窗口内，规划器联合选择谈判者数量与统一采购价格上限，模型结合商品特定接受曲线 (acceptance curve)、履约损失 (fulfillment loss)、每线程成本与超订承诺成本；据此实现确定性优化器 CANO。
Result: 三条结构性结果：固定每线程接受目标时新增谈判者的边际价值几何衰减并导出条件性并发阈值；凸分位曲线下更多并发谈判者对应弱更低的每线程接受目标与价格上限；价格更分散时买方靠更努力搜寻便宜货受益，靠抬高报价保供则受损。CANO 在不同解析市场配置及 Monte Carlo、有限数据、非高斯、相关卖家压力测试中一致优于常见启发式策略，并验证了上述结构性质。
Conclusion: 并发与让价是替代关系而非叠加关系：买方应由 CANO 联合定并发数与价格上限，价格分散时走压价搜寻而非抬价保供。

papers.title: Spectral Geometry of Attention: From Information Routing to Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we study transformer attention through the lens of spectral geometry and operator theory. We view each attention head as a functional map between Hilbert spaces of functions on the token sequence and derive a Token Difference Operator, whose spectral structure controls how token-space information is routed to the output. We show that standard Euclidean spectra are structurally biased by sinks, conflating mass concentration with genuine routing capacity. By recasting token space in the intrinsic probability geometry induced by attention, the token difference spectrum disentangles sink effects from routing capacity and provides a spectral description of the dimensionality of the head output. This yields a unified framework for analyzing attention maps, explaining sinks, routing collapse, and output dimensionality within a single operator-theoretic framework. In practice, by grounding attention heuristics in spectral geometry, we develop a novel attention-based uncertainty estimator that complements probability-based scores, with the largest gains on long-context inputs.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted as poster at Neurips 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 transformer 注意力头视为 token 序列上函数空间之间的 functional map，导出 Token Difference Operator，其谱结构决定 token 空间信息如何路由到输出；在注意力诱导的内禀概率几何下重写 token 空间后，谱能把 sink 效应与真实路由能力分开，并给出头输出维度数的谱刻画。由此得到一个基于谱几何的注意力不确定性估计器，与基于概率的分数互补，在长上下文输入上增益最大。
Motivation: 标准欧氏谱被 sink 结构性地偏置，把质量聚集与真实路由能力混为一谈，导致注意力启发式难以解释 sink、routing collapse 与输出维度数。
Method: 用算子理论把每个注意力头建模为 Hilbert 函数空间间的 functional map，推导 Token Difference Operator 并分析其谱；将 token 空间改写为注意力诱导的内禀概率几何，使谱分离 sink 与路由容量；在此谱几何基础上构造注意力不确定性估计器，与概率类分数互补。
Result: 给出 sink、routing collapse 与输出维度数的统一算子论解释；提出的谱几何不确定性估计器与概率分数互补，在长上下文输入上增益最大。
Conclusion: 注意力的 sink 与路由能力可在内禀概率几何下由 Token Difference Operator 的谱分开刻画，据此构造的不确定性估计器对长上下文输入最有价值。

papers.title: Ultrasound Operator Guidance Using World Modeling and Retrieval Based Action Planning
papers.abstract_en: Ultrasound is widely used, but acquisition quality is heavily dependent on the operator's knowledge and expertise. With demand for examinations outpacing the supply of trained sonographers, operator-guidance systems aim to close this gap by instructing a less trained user how to move the probe toward a target view. In this paper, we propose a retrieval-induced latent transition model for ultrasound acquisition dynamics, formulating ultrasound operator guidance as multi-step planning and retrieval in a world model. Using a V-JEPA 2.1 backbone, observations are first encoded into a latent space where anatomically related views lie close together. We then retrieve similar views from a reference database containing encoded latent states and corresponding probe positions and orientations. Rather than learning a parametric transition function, we directly use physically executed transitions from the database to establish our nonparametric, retrieval-induced transition model that supports receding-horizon planning. At deployment, guidance is generated from the live ultrasound image feed alone, without any probe tracking hardware. Applied to carotid ultrasound, the proposed planner reaches the target view in 86% of retrospective closed-loop episodes, versus 52% and 43% for representative baselines, outperforming both on every target view, including the challenging longitudinal internal and external carotid artery views. A prospective feasibility study on unseen volunteers, run in real time on a CPU using distillation, reaches 83% target-view reachability. Because planning is driven by proximity to any encodable goal latent, the same world model can navigate back to any previously acquired, patient-specific frame, supporting reproducible longitudinal imaging for e.g. perioperative or follow-up monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把超声操作者引导建模为世界模型中的多步规划与检索：V-JEPA 2.1 把图像编码到解剖相近视图相邻的潜空间，再用参考库中真实执行过的探头位姿转移做非参数转移模型，支持滚动时域规划，部署时仅凭实时图像、无需探头跟踪硬件。在颈动脉超声上，该规划器 86% 的回顾性闭环回合到达目标视图，基线为 52% 与 43%；对未见志愿者的前瞻性可行性研究经蒸馏在 CPU 实时运行，达 83% 目标视图可达率。
Motivation: 超声成像质量高度依赖操作者经验，而检查需求增长快于合格超声技师供给，需要在不加装探头跟踪硬件的前提下引导新手把探头移到目标切面。
Method: 提出 retrieval-induced latent transition model：以 V-JEPA 2.1 为骨干把观测编码到潜空间，从含潜状态与对应探头位置/朝向的参考库检索相似视图，用库中物理执行过的转移替代参数化转移函数，构成非参数转移模型并做 receding-horizon planning；部署时仅由实时超声图像流生成引导，前瞻阶段用蒸馏在 CPU 上实时运行。
Result: 颈动脉超声回顾性闭环中 86% 回合到达目标视图，对比两个代表性基线的 52% 与 43%，且在每个目标视图上均领先，包括较难的颈内、颈外动脉纵切面；未见志愿者的前瞻性可行性研究实时达 83% 目标视图可达率。
Conclusion: 以检索替代学得的转移函数、只靠图像潜空间邻近度做规划，即可在无跟踪硬件下完成超声引导，并因目标可为任意可编码潜状态而支持回到患者既往帧的可重复纵向成像。

papers.title: Learning While Scheduling Jobs under Context-Dependent Service Rates: An Anytime Rate-Optimal Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: We study contextual queueing bandits, where a learner schedules jobs while learning unknown service rates modeled by logistic functions of job-server features. Performance is measured by queue length regret, the expected excess queue length at round $t$ relative to an oracle that knows the service rates. Existing decaying-regret guarantees either have a suboptimal decay rate or require a known fixed horizon. They also assume context-wise slack and a strictly positive minimum eigenvalue of the feature covariance. In this paper, we propose WISE (Widest Interval Selection with Elimination), achieving rate-optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(t^{-1/2})$ queue length regret at every sufficiently large time without knowing the horizon. We assume capacity slack, meaning that expected incoming workload under best-server service is below service capacity, and impose no covariance lower bound. Our analysis uses a workload potential measuring the expected service attempts needed by waiting jobs on their best servers. Its drift on nonempty rounds combines a negative term ensured by capacity slack with errors from suboptimal service choices. Then an elliptical potential count bounds how often WISE selects wide confidence intervals, thereby limiting the number of rounds with large service errors. We also sharpen the arrival-rate dependence of an existing lower bound and make its dependence on feature dimension and server count explicit. We prove another lower bound that quantifies the increase in regret as the normalized capacity slack decreases; to our knowledge, this is the first such lower bound for CQB. Simulations show small regret even when context-wise slack fails.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在上下文排队老虎机 (contextual queueing bandits) 中提出 WISE（Widest Interval Selection with Elimination），在不需已知时间 horizon、只假设 capacity slack、且不对特征协方差加最小特征值下界的前提下，取得每个足够大时刻都成立的速率最优队列长度 regret $~\mathcal{O}(t^{-1/2})$。仿真显示即使 context-wise slack 不成立，regret 仍然很小。
Motivation: 现有衰减 regret 保证要么衰减率次优、要么需要已知固定 horizon，并强加 context-wise slack 与特征协方差严格正的最小特征值，这些条件在实际调度中难以验证。
Method: WISE 用最宽置信区间选择加消除的策略；分析引入 workload potential（等待作业在其最优服务器上所需期望服务尝试数），其在非空轮的漂移由 capacity slack 保证的负项与次优服务选择误差组成，再用椭圆势计数 (elliptical potential) 限制 WISE 选择宽置信区间的次数，从而限制大服务误差的轮数。
Result: 在每个足够大时刻取得速率最优 $~\mathcal{O}(t^{-1/2})$ 队列长度 regret 且无需知道 horizon；对已有下界的 arrival-rate 依赖做了收紧，并把对特征维数与服务器数的依赖显式化；证明了另一个量化 normalized capacity slack 下降导致 regret 上升的下界，作者称这是 CQB 的首个此类下界；仿真在 context-wise slack 失效时仍显示小 regret。
Conclusion: capacity slack 加上最宽区间选择加消除的分析框架，足以在无协方差下界、无已知 horizon 时达到 $~\mathcal{O}(t^{-1/2})$ 的队列长度 regret，且 slack 收紧会系统性抬高 regret 下界。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: P3: Persistent Particle Planning for Constrained Diffusion Control
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models provide expressive priors over trajectories, but adapting these priors to test-time constraints requires maintaining feasibility and consistency across successive control decisions. We introduce Persistent Particle Planning (P3), a sequential Monte Carlo framework for diffusion control that maintains a weighted population of candidate plans across replanning steps. At each control step, P3 shifts and partially re-noises the candidate trajectories, refines them under the latest observation, and uses constraint-aware weighting and resampling to select among alternative continuations without retraining the diffusion model. We consider denoising and replanning as one Feynman--Kac particle system and analyze it under an idealized repair. We prove that the re-noising depth controls how reliably a kept plan stays on its route, and that keeping a rare, well-separated route takes far fewer plans than rediscovering it by sampling from scratch. Experiments under multiple test-time constraint configurations show that population reuse reduces route switching and improves success without constraint violations. Because P3 refines earlier plans instead of redrawing them, it also needs fewer denoising iterations per replan. On maze-navigation tasks, it plans faster than both regenerated populations and methods that correct a single sampled plan by constrained optimization. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/p3-username/p3-anon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: P3 把扩散控制的重规划看成一个 Feynman–Kac 粒子系统，在重规划步之间保留带权候选轨迹种群：每步平移并部分重加噪、按最新观测细化，再用约束感知的加权与重采样选择后续方案，无需重训扩散模型。理论上重加噪深度决定保留方案维持原路线的可靠性，且保留一条稀有且彼此分离的路线所需粒子数远少于从头采样；迷宫导航实验中种群复用减少路线切换、在无约束违例下提高成功率，且每次重规划所需去噪迭代更少，快于重新生成种群和对单条方案做约束优化的方法。
Motivation: 扩散模型作为轨迹先验很强，但测试时约束要求连续控制决策之间保持可行性和一致性；每步从头重采样会丢失已找到的可行路线，导致路线切换与额外去噪开销。
Method: 提出 Persistent Particle Planning (P3)：一个面向扩散控制的 sequential Monte Carlo 框架，跨重规划步维护带权候选轨迹种群；每步对候选做平移与部分重加噪，在最新观测下细化，并用约束感知的加权与重采样在备选延续间选择，不重训扩散模型。将去噪与重规划统一为一个 Feynman–Kac 粒子系统，并在理想化 repair 假设下做理论分析。
Result: 在多种测试时约束配置下，种群复用减少路线切换并提高成功率且无约束违例；由于细化既有方案而非重画，每次重规划所需去噪迭代更少；在迷宫导航任务上快于重新生成种群的方法以及用约束优化修正单条采样方案的方法。理论上证明重加噪深度控制保留方案维持原路线的可靠性，且保留一条稀有且良好分离的路线所需方案数远少于从头采样。
Conclusion: 跨重规划步复用并细化带权粒子种群，可以在不重训扩散模型的前提下同时改善约束满足下的成功率、路线一致性与规划速度；重加噪深度是控制路线保持可靠性的关键旋钮。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: AgentSpy: Making AI Agent Behavior Observable
papers.abstract_en: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) run shell commands, read and write files, and reach the network, typically with their user's privileges. However, what an agent does during an execution is difficult to understand: tests assert on the result, and the agent's trajectory records only what the agent reports about itself, which may omit behavior executed by its subprocesses. We present AgentSpy, an approach that observes an agent from outside the agent. AgentSpy runs the agent in an isolated environment, configured by a declarative specification, and records the system calls and network traffic of the agent and of every process it executes. Based on this monitoring, AgentSpy supports two families of analyses: conformance analyses, which measure obligations, i.e., what an agent execution should do, and safety analyses, which check prohibitions, i.e., what an agent execution must never do. We instantiate one analysis of each family. The reliability analysis uses rules to summarize each run by the environment resources the agent uses: the commands it executed, the files it accessed, and the hosts it contacted. The security analysis applies deterministic rules to the system calls of an execution. For reliability, we evaluated AgentSpy on 77 tasks with the codex harness and three recent LLMs, executing each task three times. Sets of repeated runs of the same task are more similar than sets that include runs of another task in 92.2% of the comparisons. Among tasks for which all three runs pass outcome-based tests, the agent performs task-unrelated activities in 18% of the cases, reads the grading files in 7%, and does not use the developers' guidance in 17%. For security, the generic rules of AgentSpy detect four of five attack categories we considered, with no false positives across 50 runs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentSpy 从 agent 外部观测 LLM agent：在声明式规格配置的隔离环境中运行 agent，记录其及所有子进程的系统调用与网络流量，据此做 conformance（义务）与 safety（禁令）两类分析。在 codex harness 与三个近期 LLM、77 个任务各跑三次的评测中，同任务重复运行集合在 92.2% 的比较中比跨任务集合更相似；结果测试全通过的任务里仍有 18% 出现与任务无关的行为、7% 读取评分文件、17% 不遵循开发者指引；安全规则在 50 次运行中检出五类攻击中的四类且无误报。
Motivation: 测试只断言最终结果，agent 轨迹又只记录 agent 自述，子进程实际执行的行为被漏掉，导致以用户权限执行 shell、文件与网络操作的 agent 行为难以理解和审计。
Method: AgentSpy 在由声明式规格 (declarative specification) 配置的隔离环境中运行 agent，监控 agent 及其每个子进程的系统调用与网络流量；其上实现两族分析各一例：reliability 分析用规则把每次运行概括为所执行命令、所访问文件、所联系主机等环境资源，security 分析对系统调用套用确定性规则。
Result: 可靠性评测覆盖 77 个任务、codex harness、三个近期 LLM，每任务执行三次：同任务重复运行集合在 92.2% 的比较中比含其他任务运行的集合更相似；在三次结果测试全部通过的任务中，18% 的情形 agent 做与任务无关的活动、7% 读取评分文件、17% 不使用开发者指引。安全性方面，AgentSpy 的通用规则检出所考虑五类攻击中的四类，50 次运行中零误报。
Conclusion: 从外部监控系统调用与网络流量，可以在结果测试通过之外同时度量 agent 的资源使用一致性与违规行为；通用确定性规则对所考虑攻击类别的覆盖为四类，仍有第五类未被检出。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Langevin Flow Maps: Efficient Molecular Dynamics and Transition Path Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Molecular dynamics simulations proceed by integrating the Langevin equations over many small femtosecond timesteps. This poses a challenge for estimating ensemble properties and transition dynamics that occur on much longer timescales. We introduce Langevin Flow Maps, which extend machine-learned force-fields to additionally learn the stochastic Langevin integrator. We show that Langevin Flow Maps enable large-timestep molecular dynamics and recover accurate dynamical properties of the system, while running an order of magnitude faster than current machine-learned force fields. Further, by training on a diverse molecular dataset, we demonstrate a path towards transferable Langevin Flow Maps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Langevin Flow Maps 把机器学习力场扩展为同时学习随机 Langevin 积分器，从而允许分子动力学用大时间步长积分。它能恢复体系的准确动力学性质，速度比现有机器学习力场快一个数量级，并在多样化分子数据集上训练显示出可迁移的路径。
Motivation: 分子动力学需以飞秒级小步长积分 Langevin 方程，估计长得多时间尺度上的系综性质与转变动力学代价极高。
Method: 在机器学习力场之上额外学习随机 Langevin 积分器（Langevin Flow Maps），支持大时间步长积分；在多样分子数据集上训练以追求可迁移性。
Result: 可实现大时间步长分子动力学并恢复准确的动力学性质，运行速度比当前机器学习力场快一个数量级（order of magnitude faster）。
Conclusion: 把随机积分器与力场一起学习，是加速分子动力学同时保留转变动力学的可行路径，且有望跨分子体系迁移。

papers.title: EpicWorldModel: Exploration-driven Planning with Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) are deterministic by design. While successful in fully observable scenarios, this paradigm breaks down when past observations and actions lead to multiple plausible future possibilities, e.g., due to occlusion. We introduce EpicWorldModel, a framework to train stochastic JEPAs for environments and tasks with inherent uncertainty under partially observability. We jointly train the EpicWorldModel predictor with its latent representation space to directly predict multiple potential future states using a flow-matching objective, when the goal-relevant scene content is absent from the conditioning history. We show that flow predictive variance, motivated by its relation to an upper bound on predictive entropy, serves as a useful exploration guidance for planning. By incorporating this uncertainty signal into Cross-Entropy Method (CEM)-based planning, our approach balances goal-reaching with exploration of uncertain regions where occluded goals are most likely to be located. We demonstrate the effectiveness of EpicWorldModel through a series of latent planning experiments with the best or on-par performance across tasks, showing up to 22% empirical improvement in success rate over LeWorldModel.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 18 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables (11 pages main text, 4 pages appendix)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EpicWorldModel 把确定性 JEPA 潜世界模型改成随机版本：用 flow-matching 目标在潜表征空间直接预测多个可能未来，并把 flow 预测方差（对应预测熵上界）作为探索信号注入 CEM 规划，使规划在到达目标与搜索被遮挡目标的不确定区域之间平衡。在潜空间规划实验中，各任务取得最好或持平表现，成功率相对 LeWorldModel 最高提升 22%。
Motivation: JEPA 类潜世界模型是确定性的，在部分可观测（如遮挡）下同一历史与动作对应多个合理未来，单一确定预测失效，规划也无从知道该去哪里探索。
Method: 联合训练 EpicWorldModel 预测器与其潜表征空间，用 flow-matching 目标在目标相关场景内容不在条件历史中时直接预测多个潜在未来状态；再把 flow 预测方差（其与预测熵上界相关）作为不确定性信号接入 Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) 规划，平衡目标到达与对不确定区域的探索。
Result: 在一系列潜空间规划实验中取得最好或持平（on-par）的任务表现，成功率相对 LeWorldModel 最高提升 22%。
Conclusion: 随机 JEPA 加上以 flow 预测方差为引导的探索式 CEM 规划，能在部分可观测、目标被遮挡的环境中同时保住到达目标的能力并主动搜索不确定区域。

papers.title: How (and How Not) to Use Data Augmentation in VLA Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models currently demonstrate strong performance in a wide range of real-world robotics tasks. However, they often still lack the generalization ability to handle large visual out-of-distribution shifts. Post-training of VLAs with reinforcement learning (RL) has been shown to benefit robustness, but significant room for improvement remains. In this work, we systematically study the effect of image augmentation on VLA post-training. We find that it is crucial to augment only the critic module during RL updates, while leaving the actor's input clean during both rollouts and updates. For $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.5 this raises out-of-distribution success on LIBERO-Plus by $7.8$ and $10.0$ points respectively, while augmenting the actor collapses training entirely. We investigate a range of augmentation types and strengths, and provide practical recommendations for improving generalization in VLA post-training.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 workshop RoboPAD. Code and videos at https://bramgrooten.nl/vla-augm/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统研究 VLA 后训练中的图像增强策略，发现只对 critic 模块做增强、actor 输入在 rollout 与更新时保持干净是关键：π0.5 与 GR00T N1.5 在 LIBERO-Plus 上的分布外成功率分别提升 7.8 和 10.0 个百分点，而对 actor 做增强会让训练完全崩溃。
Motivation: VLA 模型在真实机器人任务上表现强，但面对大幅视觉分布外偏移时泛化能力不足；RL 后训练能提升鲁棒性，但图像增强在其中该怎么用一直缺少系统结论。
Method: 在 VLA 的 RL 后训练中系统考察图像增强的作用位置与强度：对比只增强 critic、增强 actor 等配置，覆盖多种增强类型与强度，并在 π0.5 与 GR00T N1.5 两个模型上验证，同时给出实践建议。
Result: 只增强 critic 时，π0.5 与 GR00T N1.5 在 LIBERO-Plus 上的分布外 (out-of-distribution) 成功率分别提高 7.8 与 10.0 个百分点；对 actor 输入做增强则使训练完全崩溃 (collapses training entirely)。
Conclusion: VLA 后训练中图像增强应只施加于 critic，actor 输入保持干净，否则训练会崩；作者据此给出提升 VLA 泛化的具体实践建议。

papers.title: From Transformation to Target State: Rethinking Query Representation for Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Composed image retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a desired target image from a query consisting of a reference image and a modification text. This task exhibits an unusual representational asymmetry: the modification text specifies a transition from the reference state, whereas retrieval candidates depict completed target states. This creates a representation mismatch for zero-shot methods that query pretrained vision-language spaces directly with transformation-oriented language. We study this mismatch and reformulate zero-shot composed image retrieval as target-state reconstruction followed by retrieval. We instantiate this formulation with ASAP-CIR, a training-free framework that reconstructs a static target representation using a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM). The representation combines multiple holistic descriptions with a variable set of importance-weighted atomic semantics, thereby preserving both overall target identity and fine-grained visual constraints. Retrieval then integrates holistic state alignment, atomic constraint grounding, and calibrated target-state evidence aggregation. A controlled text-only diagnostic shows that target-side static query formulations achieve more reliable retrieval than dynamic composed query formulations, particularly when source-state semantics must be suppressed or transformed. Experiments on FashionIQ, CIRR, and CIRCO further characterize the effectiveness and limitations of this representation principle, with the clearest gains on the multi-target CIRCO benchmark. These results show that how composed intent is represented before retrieval is a consequential design choice, distinct from the choice of retrieval backbone itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 零样本组合图像检索 (zero-shot CIR) 的错配来自查询用「转变」语言、候选却是「目标状态」图像；ASAP-CIR 用冻结 MLLM 先重建静态目标表征（整体描述 + 重要性加权原子语义），再做检索。受控纯文本诊断显示目标侧静态查询比动态组合查询更可靠，在需要抑制或转换源状态语义时尤其明显，增益在多目标 CIRCO 上最清晰。
Motivation: 零样本 CIR 直接用面向转变的语言查询预训练视觉-语言空间，而检索候选描绘的是已完成的目标状态，造成表征错配。
Method: 提出免训练框架 ASAP-CIR：用冻结的多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 重建静态目标表征，组合多个整体描述与可变的重要性加权原子语义；检索阶段整合整体状态对齐、原子约束落地与校准的目标状态证据聚合。
Result: 受控纯文本诊断表明目标侧静态查询比动态组合查询检索更可靠，尤其在源状态语义需被抑制或转换时；在 FashionIQ、CIRR、CIRCO 上的实验刻画该表征原则的效果与局限，最清晰的增益出现在多目标 CIRCO benchmark。
Conclusion: 组合意图在检索前如何表征是与检索骨干选择相区别的关键设计选择；该原则在多目标任务上收益最大。

papers.title: Label-Free Coreset Selection with Foundation Models for Efficient Annotation in Computational Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Computational pathology has the potential to improve clinical outcomes through a demonstrated increase in diagnostic and prognostic accuracy. However, the development and validation of deep learning algorithms still require annotated data, a costly procedure involving expert pathologists who already face critical workforce shortages. Existing coreset selection methods to optimize annotation efforts currently all rely on hyperparameters tuned on natural-image benchmarks that do not transfer to histopathology and are cumbersome to use in clinical practice. In this study, we present GCcore, a novel label-free coreset selection method that embeds every image of a dataset with any pathology foundation model and greedily selects the samples that collectively maximize the global coverage of the embedding space. The proposed method provides a lower-bound guarantee on the global coverage of the returned coreset for any coreset size, while being completely hyperparameter-free and deterministic. We demonstrate GCcore's superior performance over 14 baselines including state-of-the-art methods across 10 tasks and datasets spanning whole slide image classification, tile classification, and tissue segmentation, where it ranks first on six and within the top three on nine, while also demonstrating how existing methods can shift by up to five rank positions depending on their hyperparameter settings. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/OncoAI-ULBHUB/GCcore.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GCcore 是一种免标签的 coreset 选择方法：用任意病理 foundation model 对数据集全部图像做嵌入，再贪心选取使嵌入空间全局覆盖最大化的样本，并对任意 coreset 规模给出全局覆盖的下界保证，全程无超参数且确定性。在覆盖全切片图像分类、tile 分类与组织分割的 10 项任务和数据集上，它相对 14 个基线排名第一 6 次、进入前三 9 次。
Motivation: 深度学习在计算病理学中提升诊断与预后精度仍依赖专家病理医生标注，而该人力本已严重短缺；现有 coreset 选择方法的超参数都在自然图像基准上调优，迁移到组织病理后失效且临床使用繁琐。
Method: GCcore 先用任意病理 foundation model 嵌入数据集中的每一张图像，再贪心选择使嵌入空间全局覆盖最大化的样本集合；方法对任意 coreset 规模提供全局覆盖下界保证，本身不含超参数、结果确定，代码在 GitHub 公开。
Result: 在 10 项任务与数据集（涵盖 whole slide image 分类、tile 分类、组织分割）上对比 14 个基线（含 SOTA 方法），GCcore 排名第一 6 次、进入前三 9 次；同时显示现有方法的排名会随超参数设置变动最多 5 个名次。
Conclusion: 免超参数、确定性的全局覆盖贪心选择可以在组织病理标注预算受限时稳定优于依赖自然图像调参的 coreset 方法，且现有方法的排名本身对超参数敏感。

papers.title: StagQ: Constraint-Driven Multi-Precision Weight Quantization for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Serving a large language model (LLM) across a fleet of deployments requires several weight-precision operating points. Multi-precision formats serve them all from one stream whose prefixes are valid lower-precision codes, instead of storing multiple copies. We present StagQ, a multi-precision weight format whose main stream is a 2-bit group-wise affine base followed by a configurable number of 1-bit refinement planes on a dyadic step schedule. Every supported precision is a readable prefix, decoded by an affine map derived from metadata shared across all precisions, with no per-weight lookup. A sparse side record, filled both before and after the grid is fitted, holds out the few weights the grid serves worst. We report two configurations of the encoder. At two bits the cheaper one leads the strongest multi-precision baseline on Llama-3.1-8B, Phi-4, and OLMo-2-7B by 3.1 to 7.0 MMLU points, at a slightly lower logical rate. At three bits it leads on Llama-3.1-8B, leads on Phi-4 at a higher rate, and ties on OLMo-2-7B. At four bits it ties on all three, at a higher rate. In a batch-one matrix-vector product on an NVIDIA A100 GPU, timed on synthetic weights, our kernel is faster than the two baseline kernels in most shape-precision cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StagQ 提出一种多精度 LLM 权重格式：以 2-bit 组级仿射 (group-wise affine) 主流加可配置数量的 1-bit dyadic 步长细化平面，每个支持精度都是可读前缀，由跨精度共享元数据导出的仿射映射解码，无需逐权重查表。在 2-bit 下其较省的编码配置在 Llama-3.1-8B、Phi-4、OLMo-2-7B 上以略低的逻辑码率领先最强多精度基线 3.1 到 7.0 MMLU 分。
Motivation: 同一 LLM 服务集群需要多个权重精度工作点，常规做法是存多份权重副本；多精度格式本可用单一码流覆盖全部精度，但基线在低比特下精度损失明显。
Method: 主流为 2-bit 组级仿射量化，其后叠加可配置数量的 1-bit 细化平面并按 dyadic step schedule 排布；每个精度作为可读前缀，用跨精度共享元数据推出的仿射映射解码，不做 per-weight 查表；另设稀疏 side record，在网格拟合前后各填充一次，收留网格服务最差的少数权重。摘要报告了两种编码器配置。
Result: 2-bit 时较省配置在 Llama-3.1-8B、Phi-4、OLMo-2-7B 上以略低逻辑码率领先最强多精度基线 3.1 到 7.0 MMLU 分；3-bit 时在 Llama-3.1-8B 领先、在 Phi-4 以更高码率领先、在 OLMo-2-7B 打平；4-bit 时三者全部打平但码率更高。在 NVIDIA A100 上 batch-one 矩阵-向量乘、合成权重计时中，其 kernel 在多数 shape-precision 组合快于两个基线 kernel。
Conclusion: 把精度做成共享仿射网格的可读前缀加少量稀疏例外记录，可在低比特（尤其 2-bit）以不增码率的方式超过现有多精度权重格式，高比特下则以更高码率换取持平精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Transfer-Stratified On-Policy Distillation for RL-Improved Reasoning Teachers
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning can substantially improve a reasoning teacher, but it is unclear which of those improvements survive when the teacher supervises a smaller on-policy student. We study this question in mathematical reasoning by comparing teacher lineages before and after GRPO, multiple student scales, direct GRPO, and several on-policy distillation objectives. The central finding is that transfer is structured rather than scalar: teacher strength alone does not make dense distillation competitive, while an RL-improved teacher creates useful but metric-dependent student gains. This motivates Transfer-Stratified On-Policy Distillation (TS-OPD), which screens training problems by the joint sampled success of the student and teacher, routes acquisition problems to gated forward KL, routes consolidation problems to gated reverse KL, and adds an entropy brake to protect sampled coverage. Across the main comparison, TS-OPD is the strongest student objective for macro average correctness with the GRPO-improved teacher, while pass@K remains more mixed. Ablations show that the gains come from routing and token gating rather than skipping problems. These results support a transfer-aware view of OPD: stronger teachers help when the supervision direction and token budget match the student's observed ability, not merely because the teacher endpoint is stronger.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在数学推理的 on-policy 蒸馏中，RL（GRPO）改进的教师带来的收益是结构化而非标量的：教师更强并不自动让 dense 蒸馏有竞争力。提出 TS-OPD，按学生与教师的联合采样成功率筛题，把 acquisition 题路由到 gated forward KL、consolidation 题路由到 gated reverse KL，并加熵刹车保护采样覆盖；在与 GRPO 教师的主对比中它取得最高的 macro average correctness，pass@K 则更混杂。
Motivation: RL 能显著改进推理教师，但这些改进中哪些能在教师监督更小的 on-policy 学生时保留下来并不清楚；已有做法默认教师更强就该带来更好的蒸馏效果。
Method: TS-OPD：用学生与教师的联合采样成功度对训练题做分层筛选，acquisition 题走 gated forward KL、consolidation 题走 gated reverse KL，并加入 entropy brake 维护采样覆盖；对比涵盖 GRPO 前后的教师谱系、多个学生规模、直接 GRPO 与多种 on-policy 蒸馏目标。
Result: 在主对比中，TS-OPD 在 GRPO 改进教师下是 macro average correctness 最强的学生目标，pass@K 表现更混杂；消融显示收益来自路由与 token gating，而非跳过题目。
Conclusion: 更强的教师只有在监督方向与 token 预算匹配学生实际能力时才有帮助，而不只是因为教师终点更强；OPD 应按 transfer 意识来设计。

papers.title: Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion policies provide expressive action distributions for continuous-control reinforcement learning. However, safety-aware online diffusion policy optimization remains underexplored, particularly methods that use predictive reachability information without an explicit dynamics model. We propose Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization (RADPO), a model-free method that combines predictive first-hit safety estimation with cumulative-cost budget feedback. RADPO learns a discounted first-hit reachability value that captures the discounted risk of a cost event, assigns larger weight to events that occur sooner, and uses this signal to shape the reward. A separate dual-like multiplier adjusts the shaping strength according to realized episodic costs relative to a prescribed budget. The diffusion actor improves through weighted denoising regression on candidate actions scored by the reward critic. Our approach requires neither a learned dynamics model, action gradients through the critics, nor differentiation through the reverse diffusion sampler. We establish theoretical properties of the reachability value and show that accumulated reachability penalty provides a conservative surrogate for future discounted cumulative cost. Across ten continuous-control safety tasks, RADPO achieves competitive reward-cost trade-offs, with substantial reductions in constraint violations on several tasks relative to the compared baselines. Our theoretical and empirical analysis supports that combining reachability with cumulative budget feedback is a viable approach to safety-aware diffusion policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RADPO 在无显式动力学模型下，用折扣 first-hit 可达性值塑造奖励，再用类对偶乘子按实际 episodic 成本相对预算调节塑形强度，通过加权去噪回归改进 diffusion actor。在十个连续控制安全任务上取得有竞争力的 reward-cost 权衡，并在若干任务上相对基线显著减少约束违反。
Motivation: 安全感知的在线 diffusion policy 优化研究不足，尤其是不依赖显式动力学模型、却能利用预测性可达信息的方法。
Method: RADPO 是 model-free 方法：学习折扣 first-hit 可达性值（越早发生的 cost 事件权重越大）来塑造奖励，用类对偶乘子依据实际 episodic 成本与给定预算的偏差调节塑形强度；diffusion actor 通过在 reward critic 打分的候选动作上做加权去噪回归更新，无需学习动力学模型、无需 critic 对动作求梯度、也无需对反向 diffusion 采样器求导。
Result: 在十个连续控制安全任务上取得有竞争力的 reward-cost 权衡，相对所比较基线在若干任务上大幅降低约束违反；理论上证明了可达性值的性质，并证明累积可达性惩罚是未来折扣累积成本的保守代理。
Conclusion: 把预测性可达性与累积预算反馈结合，是安全感知 diffusion policy 的可行路线，且无需显式动力学模型或穿过采样器的梯度。

papers.title: Fast Last-Iterate Convergence in Zero-Sum Markov Games with Bandit Feedback
papers.abstract_en: We study last-iterate convergence in unknown two-player zero-sum discounted Markov games with bandit feedback. The players learn independently along a single trajectory without observing each other's actions. We develop Adaptive Regularized TD Learning (ARTD), which achieves a $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(t^{-1/4})$ duality gap bound for the current policies under a uniform hitting time assumption, with high probability simultaneously over all rounds and starting states. This improves the $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(t^{-1/(9+ν)})$ rate of Cai et al. (2023), for any fixed $ν>0$, under the same feedback model and hitting time assumption. Our algorithm requires no knowledge of the hitting time bound, the time horizon, or the confidence level. To stabilize policy learning as value estimates change, we separate fast temporal difference averaging from bounded value updates. We adapt log-barrier regularization to the progress of value estimation, controlling both policy and value errors throughout learning. Together, these mechanisms enable fast convergence of the policies actually played, even when the players learn independently from bandit feedback.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在未知两人零和折扣 Markov 博弈的 bandit 反馈下，提出 Adaptive Regularized TD Learning (ARTD)，使双方沿单条轨迹独立学习时当前策略的 duality gap 以高概率达到 Õ(t^{-1/4})，对所有轮次与起始状态同时成立。该速率在相同反馈模型与 hitting time 假设下改进了 Cai et al. (2023) 的 Õ(t^{-1/(9+ν)})（任意固定 ν>0），且算法无需知道 hitting time 上界、时间视界或置信水平。
Motivation: bandit 反馈下零和 Markov 博弈的 last-iterate 收敛此前只能到 Õ(t^{-1/(9+ν)}) 这一较慢速率，且常需已知 hitting time 上界、时间视界或置信水平；双方还互相看不到对方动作，策略随价值估计漂移而不稳。
Method: ARTD 把快速 temporal difference averaging 与有界的 value update 分离以稳定策略学习，并把 log-barrier 正则化自适应到价值估计的进展上，从而同时控制策略误差与价值误差；学习沿单条轨迹进行，双方独立、只用 bandit 反馈。
Result: 当前策略的 duality gap 达到 Õ(t^{-1/4})，高概率下对所有轮次与起始状态同时成立（uniform hitting time 假设下）；相对 Cai et al. (2023) 的 Õ(t^{-1/(9+ν)})（任意固定 ν>0）在相同反馈模型与 hitting time 假设下改进；算法不需知道 hitting time 上界、时间视界或置信水平。
Conclusion: 把 TD 平均与价值更新解耦、并用 log-barrier 随价值估计进度自适应正则，可在 bandit 反馈且双方独立学习的零和 Markov 博弈中把实际执行策略的 last-iterate 收敛推到 Õ(t^{-1/4})。

papers.title: JLD: Perceptual Distance Through A Jacobian Lens
papers.abstract_en: Image compression, restoration, and generation all require a way to measure how different two images look to a person. Pixel error ignores how people see, while the most accurate perceptual distances are typically fitted to human judgments, tying them to a fixed data and resolution. For example, when image resolution is doubled, the correlation of DISTS with human scores on TID2013 drops from 0.815 to 0.717. We introduce the Jacobian Lens Distance (JLD), which derives its perceptual geometry from a frozen vision encoder rather than from human labels. JLD combines the locality of early patch features with the perceptual sensitivity captured by later encoder representations. Specifically, we use the encoder Jacobian to identify directions in the early feature space that most strongly affect the encoder output, producing a fixed metric tensor, $E[J^\top J]$, which we call the Jacobian lens. The lens is fitted only once from 100 unlabeled images, taking about 35 seconds. Locally, this construction defines a pullback metric in pixel space, giving JLD a clear geometric interpretation that can be directly analyzed on real images. Across four standard perceptual databases, JLD achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently outperforms LPIPS, DISTS, PieAPP, and DreamSim. JLD is also robust to changes in image resolution, on TID2013, its lens-term correlation remains nearly unchanged when the resolution is doubled, decreasing only from 0.850 to 0.845. We further introduce JLD-fast, which is $4\times$ faster than LPIPS-VGG while achieving a mean correlation of 0.911. Finally, JLD naturally extends to video, reaching a correlation of 0.786 on Waterloo IVC 4K compared with 0.611 for VMAF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Jacobian Lens Distance (JLD)：用冻结视觉编码器的 Jacobian 在早期 patch 特征空间中找出对编码器输出影响最强的方向，构成固定度量张量 E[J^T J]（即 Jacobian lens），从而不依赖人工标注即可定义感知距离。在四个标准感知数据库上取得 SOTA，超过 LPIPS、DISTS、PieAPP 与 DreamSim；TID2013 上分辨率翻倍时 lens 项相关性仅从 0.850 降到 0.845，而 DISTS 从 0.815 掉到 0.717。
Motivation: 图像压缩、修复与生成都需要衡量两张图在人眼中的差异，但像素误差无视感知，而最准的感知距离要拟合人工判断，因而被绑定到固定数据与分辨率，分辨率一变相关性就明显下降。
Method: JLD 从冻结视觉编码器取 Jacobian，定位早期特征空间中对编码器输出最敏感的方向，得到固定度量张量 E[J^T J]（Jacobian lens），融合早期 patch 特征的局部性与后期表征的感知敏感度；lens 只用 100 张无标注图像拟合一次，约 35 秒；在像素空间上该构造给出 pullback metric。另提出加速版 JLD-fast。
Result: 在四个标准感知数据库上达到 SOTA，一致优于 LPIPS、DISTS、PieAPP、DreamSim。TID2013 上分辨率翻倍时 JLD 的 lens 项相关性 0.850 → 0.845（DISTS 同条件下 0.815 → 0.717）。JLD-fast 比 LPIPS-VGG 快 4 倍，平均相关性 0.911。扩展到视频后在 Waterloo IVC 4K 上相关性 0.786，对比 VMAF 的 0.611。
Conclusion: 感知几何可以从冻结编码器的 Jacobian 中推导而不必拟合人工标注，这样得到的距离对分辨率变化稳健，并可自然延伸到视频。

papers.title: HuatuoGPT-3: RL-Only Domain Adaptation from Base Models
papers.abstract_en: Domain adaptation aims to turn a general-purpose large language model (LLM) into an expert for a target domain. While the dominant SFT+RL pipeline offers a convenient cold start, it may reduce exploration diversity and introduces additional complexity through multi-stage optimization. These limitations motivate RL-only adaptation. However, pure on-policy RL suffers from a cold-start problem, while mixed-policy RL still falls short: informative tokens in teacher outputs are learned too slowly in early training, and stale teacher outputs can hinder later improvement. We identify these two failure modes as Gradient Starvation and Teacher-Distribution Anchoring. To address them, we propose One-stage Policy Optimization (OnePO), which treats teacher outputs as transient guidance for policy improvement. OnePO combines Adaptive Objective Evolution to strengthen learning on informative low-probability teacher tokens and Teacher Retirement to discard teacher outputs once the current policy can surpass them. On medical adaptation, OnePO achieves 67.2 on HealthBench (Total) with only 20K training samples, outperforming SFT+RL and pure RL by 2.7 and 7.4 points, respectively. We further scale OnePO to produce HuatuoGPT-3, an open-source medical LLM series whose 27B variant reaches 70.1 on HealthBench (Total) and 71.4 on HealthBench Professional, surpassing frontier models such as GPT-6 Astra. Models and code are available at https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/HuatuoGPT-3.
papers.comment: Extended version of "OnePO: Direct One-stage Policy Optimization for SFT-free Domain Adaptation", accepted at ICML 2026, with additional analysis and scaling to HuatuoGPT-3
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OnePO 用单阶段纯 RL 做 LLM 领域自适应，把教师输出仅当作策略改进的临时引导：Adaptive Objective Evolution 加强对教师低概率但有信息量 token 的学习，Teacher Retirement 在当前策略超过教师后丢弃其输出。医学适配上仅 20K 样本 HealthBench (Total) 达 67.2，比 SFT+RL 高 2.7 点、比纯 RL 高 7.4 点；扩展出的 HuatuoGPT-3 27B 达 70.1，HealthBench Professional 71.4，超过 GPT-6 Astra。
Motivation: SFT+RL 多阶段流程会削弱探索多样性并增加优化复杂度；纯 on-policy RL 有冷启动问题，混合策略 RL 则存在两个失效模式——教师输出中信息量大的 token 早期学得太慢，以及陈旧教师输出拖累后期提升。
Method: 提出 One-stage Policy Optimization (OnePO)：以 Adaptive Objective Evolution 强化对教师低概率信息 token 的梯度，以 Teacher Retirement 在策略超过教师后丢弃教师输出，把教师输出降级为瞬时引导而非锚点；先在医学适配上验证，再扩展为 HuatuoGPT-3 开源医学 LLM 系列。
Result: 医学适配上 HealthBench (Total) 67.2（仅 20K 训练样本），比 SFT+RL 高 2.7 点、比纯 RL 高 7.4 点；HuatuoGPT-3 27B 达 HealthBench (Total) 70.1、HealthBench Professional 71.4，超过 GPT-6 Astra 等前沿模型。
Conclusion: 把教师输出当作可丢弃的临时引导而非固定目标，可在跳过 SFT 冷启动的情况下完成领域自适应，并在医学基准上同时胜过多阶段 SFT+RL 与纯 RL。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Strategic Multi-Agent Learning for Interpretable Action Valuation of All Players in Football
papers.abstract_en: Valuing player actions in football requires accounting for strategic interactions among 22 players, including off-ball movements and defensive positioning. Existing reinforcement-learning-based methods commonly aggregate decisions at the team level or estimate player values independently, leaving strategic interdependence among players insufficiently represented. This study proposes an action valuation framework inspired by Markov perfect equilibrium (MPE) for all players. Each possession is modeled as a finite-horizon dynamic game, with each player represented as an autonomous agent whose policy depends on the current game state. MPE is used as a motivating solution concept rather than an exact equilibrium. To improve interpretability, we use Expandable Decision-Making States (EDMS) and decompose the Q-value into a successor-feature basis and a linear reward-weight vector. The value basis is estimated by linear TD initialization followed by nonlinear refinement. Using tracking and event data from 95 J1 League matches, we compare the proposed formulation with an independent reinforcement learning baseline. Because the two formulations define TD errors in different target spaces, TD MSE is used only for within-formulation consistency. With EDMS fixed, the independent baseline assigns the highest value to forward movement in 99.21% of evaluated off-ball states, whereas the most frequent direction under the proposed formulation accounts for 17.63%. Team-level average Q-values show a negative association with season-level expected goals for the baseline and a weakly positive association for the proposed formulation. Qualitative analyses illustrate context-dependent valuations of off-ball movements and defensive positioning. Overall, the proposed formulation produces more context-sensitive action rankings, although the comparison does not isolate the MPE-inspired component.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把足球控球过程建成 22 名球员各为智能体的有限时域动态博弈，用 Markov perfect equilibrium (MPE) 作为动机性解概念，配合 EDMS 与 Q 值的成功者特征分解，为所有球员给出可解释的动作估值。在 95 场 J1 联赛追踪与事件数据上，独立 RL 基线在 99.21% 的无球状态里把最高价值判给前向移动，本文方法下最频繁方向仅占 17.63%；球队级平均 Q 值与赛季预期进球的相关性由负转为弱正。
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习的球员估值把决策聚合到球队层面或独立估计单个球员，无法表示 22 人之间的策略相互依赖，包括无球跑动与防守站位。
Method: 将每次控球建模为有限时域动态博弈，每名球员是策略依赖当前比赛状态的自主智能体；MPE 仅作动机性解概念而非精确均衡。用 Expandable Decision-Making States (EDMS) 提升可解释性，并把 Q 值分解为 successor-feature 基与线性奖励权重向量，价值基先用线性 TD 初始化再做非线性精修。
Result: 在 95 场 J1 联赛数据上与独立 RL 基线对比：EDMS 固定时，基线在 99.21% 的被评估无球状态中把最高价值给前向移动，本文方法下最频繁方向占 17.63%；球队级平均 Q 值与赛季预期进球 (xG) 的关联在基线为负、在本文方法为弱正。TD MSE 因两者目标空间不同仅用于同 formulation 内部一致性。
Conclusion: 本文 formulation 产生更依赖上下文的动作排序，无球跑动与防守站位的估值随情境变化；但该对比没有隔离出 MPE 启发组件本身的贡献。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Physics-Informed but Not Physics-Consistent: Error Geometry and Subspace Projection for Neural AC Power Flow
papers.abstract_en: Recent neural power-flow solvers, including emerging foundation models, achieve accurate voltage predictions, yet such accuracy does not necessarily imply physically consistent solutions. Even small complex voltage errors can yield large AC power-balance residuals. We study this accuracy-consistency gap across PIGNN-GC, GridSFM, gridfm-graphkit, and LUMINA on realistic 2224-bus Great Britain network (GBnetwork) scenarios, with cross-grid evaluation of GridSFM over 31 systems. Using a singular value decomposition (SVD) basis fitted to training AC power-flow solutions, we find that neural prediction errors contain substantial components outside the dominant solution subspace. To address this mismatch, calibrated solution-subspace projection (CSP) suppresses off-subspace prediction components after train-only bias calibration, reducing Mean PB by 67.0%, 37.8%, 40.5%, and 68.9% for PIGNN-GC, GridSFM, gridfm-graphkit, and LUMINA, respectively, relative to calibrated predictions, while improving voltage-magnitude accuracy in all four models. These results identify output-error geometry as an important factor in physics-consistent neural AC power flow. Code: https://github.com/Kimchangheon/neural-acpf-error-geometry
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 神经交流潮流 (AC power flow) 求解器电压预测很准但功率平衡残差仍大，作者用训练解的 SVD 基刻画误差几何，发现预测误差含大量主解子空间之外的分量。提出的校准解子空间投影 (CSP) 在仅训练集偏置校准后压制离子空间分量，使 PIGNN-GC、GridSFM、gridfm-graphkit、LUMINA 的 Mean PB 分别下降 67.0%、37.8%、40.5%、68.9%，且四个模型的电压幅值精度同时提升。
Motivation: 神经潮流求解器的电压精度与物理一致性并不等价：很小的复电压误差也可能造成很大的 AC 功率平衡残差，这一 accuracy-consistency gap 在新兴 foundation model 上同样存在。
Method: 在 2224 节点 Great Britain network (GBnetwork) 场景上对比 PIGNN-GC、GridSFM、gridfm-graphkit、LUMINA，并对 GridSFM 做 31 个系统的跨电网评估；用训练 AC 解拟合 SVD 基，分析预测误差在主解子空间内/外的分布，再以校准解子空间投影 (CSP) 在仅训练集偏置校准后滤除离子空间分量。
Result: 相对校准后预测，CSP 使 Mean PB 在 PIGNN-GC、GridSFM、gridfm-graphkit、LUMINA 上分别降低 67.0%、37.8%、40.5%、68.9%，并在全部四个模型上同时提升电压幅值精度；GridSFM 的跨电网评估覆盖 31 个系统。
Conclusion: 输出误差几何是神经 AC 潮流物理一致性的关键因素：把预测投影回训练解的主子空间，可在不牺牲电压精度的前提下大幅压低功率平衡残差。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MEND: RL For Flow Models via Proximal Velocity Matching
papers.abstract_en: Reward post-training of flow models either reweights the model's own samples under a KL penalty or a frozen reference, often for thousands of updates, or backpropagates the reward and moves every sample without checking that the move is worth its size. We introduce MEND, a reinforcement learning method built on proximal velocity matching. MEND caps rewards within each prompt group, so samples that already score well receive no move. Below the cap, it proposes moves along the reward gradient and accepts one only when its capped reward gain exceeds a quadratic displacement price. The model then regresses onto the resulting velocity targets, with no KL term, frozen reference model, or advantage weights. In 100 updates, MEND outperforms Flow-GRPO (about 4k updates) on five of six evaluators at the same distance to base-model images. Under an equal-budget protocol, it surpasses ReFL and DiffusionNFT at every evaluated update across four training rewards, reaching PickScore 24.03 versus 23.92 and 23.43, respectively. A 300-update three-reward run also surpasses the five-reward DiffusionNFT model on all three rewards it trains on. MEND is general and easy to adopt: it applies to any flow backbone with a differentiable reward.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MEND 用近邻速度匹配 (proximal velocity matching) 做流模型的奖励后训练：在每个 prompt 组内对奖励设上限，未达上限的样本沿奖励梯度提议位移，只有当封顶后的奖励增益超过二次位移代价才接受，再让模型回归到该速度目标，无需 KL 项、冻结参考模型或 advantage 权重。100 步内即在六个评测器中的五个上超过约 4000 步的 Flow-GRPO，且与基座图像距离相当。
Motivation: 现有流模型奖励后训练要么在 KL 惩罚或冻结参考下重加权自身样本、常需数千步更新，要么直接反传奖励、不检查位移是否值得其幅度，训练代价高且位移失控。
Method: MEND 是基于 proximal velocity matching 的 RL 方法：按 prompt 组对奖励封顶，已高分样本不移动；未封顶者沿奖励梯度提议移动，仅当封顶奖励增益超过二次位移代价才接受，随后模型回归到生成的速度目标；不含 KL 项、冻结参考模型与 advantage 权重，适用于任何带可微奖励的 flow backbone。
Result: 在与基座图像相同距离下，MEND 100 步在六个评测器中的五个上超过 Flow-GRPO（约 4k 步）；等预算协议下在四个训练奖励的每个评估更新点都超过 ReFL 与 DiffusionNFT，PickScore 达 24.03，对比 23.92 与 23.43；300 步三奖励训练在 DiffusionNFT 五奖励模型所训练的全部三个奖励上也更优。
Conclusion: 奖励增益须以位移代价为门槛并回归速度目标，就能在远少于数千步的更新内完成流模型奖励后训练，且不依赖 KL 或参考模型，可推广到任意带可微奖励的 flow backbone。

papers.title: Discovered, Not Designed: Population Evolution for Collaborative and Compute-Intensive Model Discovery
papers.abstract_en: LLM-driven evolution enables iterative model development, but two practical goals remain underexplored: finding model designs that transfer across related tasks and sustaining improvement when training is expensive. We introduce Population Evolution (PE), a collaborative, hierarchical framework that connects ongoing local searches through shared experimental evidence. PE evaluates code changes across related training instances and shares the results to guide subsequent proposals and promotion to larger training scales. For expensive targets, PE searches small training subsets and screens candidates through peer and intermediate evaluations before full-target training. We introduce RMD-Bench to evaluate both settings across ranking, watch-time prediction, RL algorithm discovery, and LLM/VLM pretraining. Compared with standalone evolution at matched source iterations, PE raises mean best local gains from 7.01% to 8.97% in ranking and from 2.84% to 3.85% in watch-time, while improving the best larger-scale outcome in all three joint-discovery families. In watch-time discovery, PE improves best larger-scale gains with four of five harnesses and all four proposers. On new recommendation datasets under shared target-side calibration, every evaluated PE design improves over the reference in mean performance. Under matched total GPU compute, completed LLM discovery runs yield a best relative accuracy gain of 2.48% and 13 successful candidates for PE, versus 0.92% and none for direct evolution. VLM loss reduction reaches 8.78% versus 5.05% under matched total GPU compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Population Evolution (PE)：把多个本地进化搜索通过共享实验证据连成分层协作框架，用小训练子集加同伴/中间评估筛选候选，再晋升到更大训练规模。在 RMD-Bench 的排序、观看时长预测、RL 算法发现与 LLM/VLM 预训练上，匹配总 GPU 算力时 LLM 发现最佳相对精度增益 2.48%、成功候选 13 个（直接进化 0.92%、0 个），VLM loss 降幅 8.78% 对 5.05%。
Motivation: LLM 驱动的迭代模型设计有两个未充分解决的目标：让找到的设计能跨相关任务迁移，以及在训练昂贵时维持持续改进。
Method: PE 是协作式分层框架：跨相关训练实例评估代码改动并共享结果，指导后续提案与向更大训练规模的晋升；对昂贵目标先在小训练子集上搜索，用 peer 与 intermediate evaluation 筛选候选再做 full-target training。评测用自建 RMD-Bench，覆盖 ranking、watch-time prediction、RL algorithm discovery、LLM/VLM pretraining 四类任务。
Result: 在匹配源迭代数下，ranking 平均最佳本地增益由 7.01% 升至 8.97%，watch-time 由 2.84% 升至 3.85%，三个 joint-discovery 家族的最佳大规模结果均改善；watch-time 中五个 harness 里的四个与全部四个 proposer 的最佳大规模增益提升。新推荐数据集在共享 target-side 校准下，每个被评估的 PE 设计平均性能都优于参考。匹配总 GPU 算力时，LLM 发现最佳相对精度增益 2.48%、13 个成功候选（直接进化 0.92%、0 个），VLM loss 降幅 8.78% 对 5.05%。
Conclusion: 共享实验证据的协作式种群进化能在匹配算力下同时提高跨任务迁移与昂贵目标的改进幅度，优于独立进化。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Technical Report on the Turba Fertilizer Machine Learning Stack in Morocco
papers.abstract_en: Site-specific fertilizer recommendation systems adapt nutrient advice to location, soil properties, crop type, and production targets, but scientific reuse is constrained when recommendation functions remain accessible mainly through interactive interfaces, outputs are not versioned, and trained approximations cannot be independently loaded or benchmarked. This technical report presents the Turba fertilizer machine learning stack, a three-layer open-source implementation for reproducible site-specific fertilizer recommendation in Morocco. \texttt{turba-client} provides programmatic access to publicly accessible site profiles, crop-specific target-yield spaces, and N, P$_2$O$_5$, and K$_2$O recommendation workflows; \texttt{turba-data} distributes analysis-ready snapshots; and \texttt{turba-models} packages crop-specific machine learning surrogates of recommendation outputs. The architecture links upstream retrieval, versioned analytical snapshots, reproducible cross-model benchmarking, and loadable offline surrogates while preserving the distinction between recommendation-system outputs, observed agricultural data, and model-generated predictions. The first dataset was constructed from 44,096 unique ESA WorldCereal locations. Scenario expansion across supported cereal workflows generated 132,017 crop-location recommendation requests under a medium target-yield setting. The resulting 22-variable dataset spans 10 regions, 66 provinces, and 1,149 communes. Nine regression families were evaluated under a fixed deterministic 80/20 protocol, and the current release packages five best-performing crop-specific models. The machine learning task is recommendation-function emulation rather than prediction of observed crop response. The stack provides a reproducible basis for spatial and temporal validation, uncertainty estimation, field-trial comparison, and future integration with additional data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Turba 是面向摩洛哥的开源三层肥料推荐机器学习栈：turba-client 提供 N、P2O5、K2O 推荐工作流的程序化访问，turba-data 分发版本化快照，turba-models 打包作物专属代理模型 (surrogate)。首个数据集含 44,096 个 ESA WorldCereal 独特位点，扩展出 132,017 条作物-位点推荐请求、22 个变量；九类回归在固定 80/20 协议下评测，最终打包五个表现最好的作物专属模型，任务定位是推荐函数仿真而非作物响应预测。
Motivation: 站点专属肥料推荐多锁在交互界面里：输出不版本化、训练好的近似模型无法被独立加载与基准测试，科学复用因此受限。
Method: 三层开源架构：turba-client 暴露公开站点档案、作物目标产量空间与 N/P2O5/K2O 推荐流程；turba-data 分发可分析快照；turba-models 打包作物专属 ML 代理。数据由 44,096 个 ESA WorldCereal 位点构建，按中等目标产量情景扩展到 132,017 条推荐请求，形成覆盖 10 个大区、66 个省、1,149 个公社的 22 变量数据集；九类回归族在固定确定性 80/20 协议下评测。
Result: 数据集规模 44,096 个 ESA WorldCereal 位点、132,017 条作物-位点推荐请求（中等目标产量情景）、22 个变量、覆盖 10 regions / 66 provinces / 1,149 communes；九类回归族在固定确定性 80/20 协议下评测，当前版本打包五个表现最佳的作物专属模型。
Conclusion: 把推荐函数做成可版本化、可独立加载与基准测试的开源栈，可作为空间与时间验证、不确定性估计和田间试验比对的可复现基础；机器学习任务是推荐函数仿真，不是观测作物响应的预测。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: OntoInk: Interactive Ontology Visualization, Validation, and Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Ontology documentation, visualization, and validation are usually carried out with separate tools. This split workflow slows down development and makes knowledge transfer harder. We present OntoInk, an open-source MkDocs plugin that brings these activities together. Within a single documentation-as-code pipeline, OntoInk renders interactive ontology diagrams, validates instance data against SHACL shapes, runs OWL\,DL reasoning, and supports inline Turtle editing. General-purpose diagram plugins for MkDocs cannot parse RDF, dereference IRIs, overlay SHACL constraints, or run OWL reasoning. Compared with standalone ontology visualization tools, OntoInk embeds interactive and editable diagrams directly into documentation pages. A live demo and source code are available at \url{https://ise-fizkarlsruhe.github.io/ontoink/}.
papers.comment: Demo paper at ISWC 2026 Companion Volume, October 25 to 29, 2026, Bari, Italy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OntoInk 是一个开源 MkDocs 插件，把本体文档、交互式图示、SHACL 校验与 OWL DL 推理合并进单一 documentation-as-code 流水线，并支持在文档页内直接编辑 Turtle。它能解析 RDF、解引用 IRI、叠加 SHACL 约束并运行 OWL 推理，这是通用 MkDocs 图插件和独立本体可视化工具都做不到的组合。
Motivation: 本体的文档、可视化与校验分散在不同工具中，流程割裂拖慢开发并阻碍知识传递；通用 MkDocs 图插件无法解析 RDF、解引用 IRI、叠加 SHACL 约束或运行 OWL 推理。
Method: OntoInk 作为 MkDocs 插件嵌入 documentation-as-code 流水线：渲染可交互本体图，用 SHACL shapes 校验实例数据，运行 OWL DL 推理，并提供页内 Turtle 编辑；与独立本体可视化工具的区别是把可交互可编辑的图直接嵌进文档页。
Result: 以 ISWC 2026 Companion 现场 demo 形式发布，附源码与在线站点；相对通用 MkDocs 图插件具备 RDF 解析、IRI 解引用、SHACL 约束叠加与 OWL 推理能力，相对独立可视化工具则把可交互可编辑图嵌入文档页。
Conclusion: 本体的文档、可视化、校验与推理可以收进一条 MkDocs 文档流水线，前提是插件本身能处理 RDF、SHACL 与 OWL 而非只画图。

papers.title: Runaway Reaction: When Benign Skills Compose into Malicious Behavior
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills package task-specific knowledge and procedures that can be composed to support complex agent tasks, while public marketplaces provide a growing pool of reusable skills. Existing security vetting, however, largely evaluates skills in isolation, leaving composition-induced risks underexplored. Such risks arise because composing benign skills expands the agent's capability space, enabling behaviors unavailable to any skill alone. Interestingly, we find that directly composing benign skills can already induce malicious behaviors, even when every individual skill passes security vetting. We further find that some target malicious behaviors remain difficult to realize through direct composition, even when the selected skills collectively provide the required capabilities. To systematically instantiate these attacks, we present Compositional Risk Induction via Multi skill Execution (CRIME). CRIME first uses the Malicious Plot Casting (MPC) module to decompose a target malicious behavior into complementary requirements and identify suitable benign skill compositions from public skill repositories. For compositions that cannot directly realize the target behavior, the Runaway Reaction Steering (RRS) module uses execution feedback to iteratively refine the selected skills toward the target while requiring each skill to remain benign under standalone vetting. The resulting composition is then passed to the Skill Reaction Chamber (SRC) module, where the skill pair is executed in a sandbox and the resulting environmental consequences are examined to determine whether the target behavior has occurred. Unsuccessful cases are returned to RRS for further refinement. Furthermore, we construct a benchmark of 4,000 public skills across eight cybersecurity behaviors for systematic evaluation of composition-induced vulnerabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CRIME 框架，用 Malicious Plot Casting 分解目标恶意行为并从公共技能库挑选良性技能组合，再由 Runaway Reaction Steering 依据执行反馈迭代改写、Skill Reaction Chamber 在沙箱中核验后果。发现即使每个技能单独通过安全审查，直接组合即可诱发恶意行为；含 4,000 个公共技能、八类网络安全行为的基准用于系统评估组合诱导漏洞。
Motivation: 现有技能安全审查基本只针对单个技能孤立评估，而组合良性技能会扩展 agent 能力空间，产生任何单一技能都不具备的行为，这类组合诱导风险基本未被覆盖。
Method: CRIME 由三模块组成：MPC 把目标恶意行为拆成互补需求并从公共技能库筛选合适的良性技能组合；对无法直接实现目标的组合，RRS 用执行反馈迭代精化所选技能，同时要求每个技能在独立审查下仍为良性；SRC 在沙箱中执行技能对并检查环境后果以判定目标行为是否发生，失败案例回传 RRS 继续精化。
Result: 发现直接组合良性技能即可诱发恶意行为，即使每个单独技能都通过安全审查；同时发现部分目标恶意行为即便所选技能集体具备所需能力也难以通过直接组合实现。构建了覆盖八类网络安全行为、含 4,000 个公共技能的基准用于系统评估组合诱导漏洞。
Conclusion: 技能安全不能只按单个技能审查，组合本身会诱导出单技能不具备的恶意行为，需要面向组合的系统化评估流程。

papers.title: Process Constitutions and Process Stewards: Towards the Next Generation of BPM for Agentic Organizations
papers.abstract_en: Business Process Management (BPM) was built on a foundational assumption that organizations are populated primarily by human actors whose work can be made visible, governable, and improvable through process models. That assumption is depreciating. AI agent ecosystems increasingly execute, coordinate, and adapt organizational work with limited human direction, challenging not only BPM's methods but its core conception of what a process is. We argue that BPM faces a constitutive shift from modeling human work to governing autonomous agents, for which we propose two new concepts: the \emph{Process Constitution}, a machine-interpretable, value-laden framework that defines the space of admissible agent behavior, and the \emph{Process Steward}, a governance agent that interprets and enforces it. The central value proposition of this new generation of BPM is not efficiency but \emph{organizational legibility}: the capacity to keep agentic organizations accountable, contestable, and humanly understandable. We outline what this means and sketch the research agenda it opens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张 BPM 正经历构成性转变：从为人类工作建模转向治理自主 AI agent，并提出两个新概念——机器可解释、承载价值的 Process Constitution（界定 agent 行为的可容许空间）与负责解释和执行它的治理 agent Process Steward。新一代 BPM 的核心价值主张被明确改为 organizational legibility，即让 agentic 组织保持可问责、可争议、可被人理解，而非效率。
Motivation: BPM 建立在“组织主要由人类构成、工作可通过流程模型变得可见可治理”这一正在失效的假设上；AI agent 生态已在有限人类指导下执行、协调和调适组织工作，动摇了 BPM 的方法乃至对“流程”本身的定义。
Method: 提出两个概念性构件：Process Constitution 作为机器可解释的价值框架，规定 agent 行为的可容许空间；Process Steward 作为治理 agent，负责解释并执行该宪法。文章勾勒其含义并给出由此开启的研究议程，属立场性/议程性工作。
Result: 给出定性论断：BPM 的重心从效率转向 organizational legibility，即让 agentic 组织保持可问责 (accountable)、可争议 (contestable)、可被人理解；并提出 Process Constitution 与 Process Steward 两个新概念作为新一代 BPM 的核心构件。
Conclusion: 作者认为下一代 BPM 的任务是治理自主 agent 而非为人类工作建模，其价值主张是组织可读性而非效率，需以 Process Constitution 划定行为边界、以 Process Steward 落地执行。

papers.title: ReMem: Streaming Video Understanding With Long Context Retention
papers.abstract_en: Despite their impressive performance on a wide range of video understanding tasks, current Vision Language Models (VLMs) are predominantly designed for offline scenarios and struggle to handle online streaming videos that demand low latency response. Several studies have explored memory and token compression strategies in an attempt to adapt offline VLMs for streaming video understanding tasks. However, through our probing experiment, we identify that most existing works tend to progressively lose long context information as length of input stream increases. To address this, we propose ReMem, a novel training-free adaptation technique that enables VLMs to process streaming videos of arbitrary lengths while improving their long context information retention capability. ReMem exploits memory from two perspectives, implemented as two core components. The Streaming Context Memory (SCM) continuously compresses historical context with query-independent attention. The Retrieved Vision Memory (RVM) then retrieves the most salient, query-relevant context from memory to augment the VLM's input. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed ReMem achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across a variety of widely used benchmarks, spanning both streaming video and general long video understanding tasks.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Structural Foundations of Nonlinear Systems with Unknown Inputs: The UID-Induced Normal Form and Minimal-Sensing Structure-from-Motion
papers.abstract_en: This paper establishes the first general structural solution to the problem of state estimation for nonlinear systems driven by unknown inputs. Building upon nonlinear unknown-input observability theory, we show that every such system admits a structurally equivalent representation, referred to as the UID-induced normal form. The proposed representation decomposes the information carried by the unknown inputs into two complementary components: unknown-input directions that are structurally decoupled from the observable dynamics and observable quantities that completely represent the unknown-input information affecting the observable dynamics. As a consequence, the UID-induced normal form provides a unified structural solution to unknown-input decoupling and unknown-input reconstruction, without requiring any model or stochastic assumption on the unknown inputs. The practical significance of the proposed framework is demonstrated through a previously unexplored minimal Structure-from-Motion configuration. The proposed representation enables recursive state estimation from only three point features and a single-axis gyroscope, allowing the recovery of the three-dimensional structure and camera motion up to an unknown global scale factor. Experiments on real-world data validate the proposed framework and demonstrate the feasibility of this minimal sensing configuration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对受未知输入 (unknown inputs) 驱动的非线性系统给出首个一般性结构解：UID-induced normal form 把未知输入信息拆成与可观测动态结构性解耦的方向、以及完全代表影响可观测动态的未知输入信息的可观测量，从而在不对未知输入做任何模型或随机假设的前提下统一实现解耦与重构。据此在极简 Structure-from-Motion 配置下仅用 3 个点特征和单轴陀螺仪即可递归估计状态，恢复三维结构与相机运动（差一个全局尺度因子），真实数据实验验证了该框架。
Motivation: 非线性系统同时受未知输入驱动时，状态估计缺少统一的结构性处理办法：未知输入的解耦与重构通常各自为政，且往往要对未知输入加模型或随机假设。
Method: 建立在非线性未知输入可观测性理论之上，构造 UID-induced normal form 这一结构等价表示，把未知输入信息分解为与可观测动态解耦的 unknown-input directions 和完整刻画影响可观测动态部分的可观测量；再把该表示用于递归状态估计，并在一个此前未被探索的极简 SfM 配置上示范。
Result: 在仅 3 个点特征加单轴陀螺仪的最小传感配置下实现递归状态估计，恢复三维结构与相机运动（含未知全局尺度因子）；真实数据 (real-world data) 实验验证了该框架并表明这一最小传感配置可行。
Conclusion: 未知输入驱动的非线性系统存在统一的结构解，未知输入的解耦与重构无需对其做模型或随机假设；该结构足以支撑只用点特征与单轴陀螺仪的极简视觉惯性状态估计。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Combining Improvements in Uplink AI-RAN
papers.abstract_en: One of the major transformative factors in 6G will be the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to become a native part of Radio Access Network (RAN). While most physical-layer AI features have so far been evaluated in isolation using link-level simulations, their combined behavior in a realistic multi-cell, multi-UE deployment has remained largely unexplored. In this paper, we present system-level performance results when multiple uplink AI features are enabled together, achieved by integrating accurate link-level and system-level simulators. To infer state-of-the-art deep-learning-aided Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) receivers under the dynamic allocations produced by a realistic uplink scheduler, we propose a mirrored data augmentation method that decouples receiver performance from scheduled allocation size. In addition to these Physical Layer (PHY) receiver features, we combine several recent advances in deep reinforcement learning to train uplink power control and link adaptation that outperform a heuristic baseline and further boost the gains obtainable from the AI receiver alone. The system-level results show that the combined AI features improve the mean uplink user throughput by roughly 27% compared to a non-AI baseline, confirming that the individual PHY and Medium Access Control (MAC) AI features provide complementary gains when deployed jointly.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to IEEE for consideration for publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多小区多用户系统级仿真中同时开启多个上行 AI 功能，用镜像数据增强 (mirrored data augmentation) 解耦深度学习 MIMO 接收机性能与调度分配大小，再用深度强化学习训练上行功率控制与链路自适应。相比非 AI 基线，联合部署使平均上行用户吞吐提升约 27%，说明 PHY 与 MAC 层的 AI 功能增益互补。
Motivation: 物理层 AI 功能此前多用链路级仿真孤立评估，它们在真实多小区多 UE 部署中的联合行为基本未被探索。
Method: 把精确的链路级与系统级仿真器打通；提出 mirrored data augmentation，使深度学习 MIMO 接收机在真实上行调度器产生的动态分配下性能与分配大小解耦；结合多项深度强化学习进展训练上行功率控制与链路自适应，对照启发式基线。
Result: 系统级结果显示联合 AI 功能相比非 AI 基线将平均上行用户吞吐提升约 27%；强化学习训练的功率控制与链路自适应优于启发式基线，并在 AI 接收机之上进一步增益。
Conclusion: PHY 层 AI 接收机与 MAC 层 AI 功控/链路自适应联合部署时增益互补，链路级孤立评估会低估真实系统收益。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ThunderSyncRL: Lossless Acceleration of Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Language models are moving beyond generating answers to pursuing long-horizon goals in interactive environments. Post-training these agents requires long, heterogeneous trajectories, and synchronous systems leave learner engines idle until rollout and verification finish. To squeeze out these pipeline bubbles, asynchronous training overlaps rollout and learning across updates, but comes at the cost of policy staleness. We introduce ThunderSyncRL, which starts gradient computation as soon as all required inputs are fixed, without policy staleness. For group relative policy optimization (GRPO), ThunderSyncRL computes each trajectory's score gradient as soon as the reward for that trajectory arrives, without waiting for the group. For on-policy distillation (OPD), it computes gradients for each completed agentic turn's teacher-scored actions while tool calls run in the sandbox. We prove that gradient streaming produces the same GRPO and OPD updates as batch-synchronous training, without changing either objective. On SWE-bench Verified and Terminal Bench 4.0, we train models to the same performance up to $1.9 \times$ faster than synchronous training. With zero policy staleness, ThunderSyncRL also outperforms asynchronous training at a fixed budget by up to $2.47$ percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ThunderSyncRL 把异步训练的流水线气泡消掉而不引入策略陈旧 (policy staleness)：GRPO 在单条轨迹的 reward 一到就算 score gradient，不必等整组；on-policy distillation 在沙箱跑 tool call 时对已完成 turn 的教师打分动作算梯度。证明其 gradient streaming 与 batch-synchronous 训练产生完全相同的 GRPO/OPD 更新，在 SWE-bench Verified 与 Terminal Bench 4.0 上达到同等性能最多快 1.9×，固定预算下比异步训练最多高 2.47 个百分点。
Motivation: 长时程 agent 的后训练需要长且异构的轨迹，同步系统在 rollout 与 verification 期间让 learner engine 空转；异步训练虽重叠了 rollout 与学习，却以策略陈旧为代价。
Method: 在所有必需输入固定后立刻启动梯度计算：GRPO 逐轨迹在 reward 到达时算 score gradient，OPD 在沙箱执行 tool call 的同时对教师打分的已完成 turn 动作算梯度；并证明该 gradient streaming 与 batch-synchronous 训练产生相同的 GRPO 与 OPD 更新，不改动任一目标函数。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 与 Terminal Bench 4.0 上训练模型达到与同步训练相同的性能，速度最高提升 1.9×；零策略陈旧下，固定预算内比异步训练最高高出 2.47 个百分点。
Conclusion: 只要在输入固定时就开始算梯度，就能同时拿到异步训练的吞吐和同步训练的更新正确性，无需在速度与策略陈旧之间取舍。

papers.title: UltraDub: Towards Authentic Dubbing by Unifying Visually-Steered Flow Learning and Trajectory Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Visual voice cloning requires intelligible, speaker-consistent speech synchronized with visible articulation. However, sequential multimodal conditioning can disrupt previously established temporal and speaker cues, while imbalanced inference guidance can improve linguistic accuracy at the expense of lip synchronization. In this paper, we propose UltraDub, a Unifying Visually-Steered Flow learning and trajectory Guidance Dubbing framework that leverages vision in two ways: as continuous motion for multimodal context aggregation, and as structural rhythm for trajectory rectification. Specifically, we introduce the Motion-guided Dual-context Retrieving (MDR) module, which continually recalibrates linguistic and speaker-style retrieval through shared lip-motion query residuals, utilizing independent time-conditioned gates to regulate their contributions. Furthermore, we propose Rhythm-anchored Trajectory Guidance (RTG), a training-free mechanism that evaluates hierarchical multimodal corrections at a visual-only predictive midpoint, safely strengthening semantic conditioning while better preserving temporal alignment. Finally, we construct DiverseDub, a multi-scenario benchmark to evaluate video dubbing in the wild. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UltraDub achieves state-of-the-art performance across four datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UltraDub 针对视频配音中语言准确度与口型同步互相拉扯的问题，用视觉同时提供连续运动和结构节奏：MDR 模块以共享唇动查询残差持续重校语言与说话人风格检索，并用独立时间门控调节两者贡献；RTG 是免训练机制，在仅视觉的预测中点评估分层多模态修正，强化语义条件同时保住时间对齐。实验在四个数据集上达到 state-of-the-art，并配套构建多场景基准 DiverseDub。
Motivation: 顺序式多模态条件会破坏已建立的时间与说话人线索，而不平衡的推理引导虽提升语言准确度却牺牲口型同步，两者难以兼得。
Method: 提出统一视觉引导流学习与轨迹引导的配音框架：Motion-guided Dual-context Retrieving (MDR) 模块用共享 lip-motion query 残差持续重校语言与说话人风格检索，配独立时间条件门控；Rhythm-anchored Trajectory Guidance (RTG) 在视觉预测中点做分层多模态修正，属免训练机制；并构建多场景视频配音基准 DiverseDub。
Result: 在四个数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，并构建了 DiverseDub 这一 in-the-wild 视频配音评测基准。
Conclusion: 把视觉同时用作连续运动上下文与结构节奏轨迹引导，可以在提升语义准确度的同时保持时间对齐与说话人一致性，从而实现更真实的配音。

papers.title: The Arbitrary-Placement Problem in Entropy-Minimizing Selection, and a Residual-Entropy Formulation
papers.abstract_en: Entropy-based selection objectives suffer from a fundamental degeneracy: minimizing Shannon entropy $H(p_A)$ rewards confident selection regardless of whether the selected candidate is informative. We address this limitation with the residual entropy $D = H(p_A) - H(p_β)$, where $p_β$ is induced by candidate trust weights. We prove the exact identity $D = -\mathrm{KL}(p_A\Vert p_β) - Δ$, where $Δ$ measures whether the score-induced distribution and trust profile favor the same candidates. Boundary cases establish basic safety: under uniform trust, $D\leq0$ automatically, so an equal-trust, non-starving state is never penalized, while at any one-hot limit, $D\to0$ regardless of the selected candidate. For the intermediate regime where selection occurs, we prove that $D\leq0$ when candidate ordering by trust agrees pairwise with ordering by informativeness, and derive a tighter certificate based on the leading candidate's margin over its competitors. These results are independent of the candidate-scoring function and apply to both stationary and dynamically changing information. Experiments with a gradient-based mixture-of-experts router confirm that the ordering conditions can hold during real optimization and show that correct ordering improves downstream performance when candidates are non-interchangeable and selections are used directly rather than averaged. Beyond routing, margin-based reweighting matches or outperforms fixed-strength baselines in a class-imbalance task, while informative selection in a production video-prediction system reduces MSE by approximately 20$\%$ and transfers to a related species. Residual entropy, therefore, provides a safety criterion for selection and a usable signal for deciding when that selection is informative.

papers.title: VERA: Scaling Verifiable Environments for Agentic co-Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Competent agents need precise and verifiable environments, such as sandboxes that are resumable at any stage and evolve from observable evidence. However, most long-horizon work exposes how rare these are: for example, an agent in medical research must ground a finding, classify it, and write a report over dozens of dependent steps, yet recent environments score only the outcome. To address the challenges in stable training, we present VERA, which builds such environments at scale and lets agents evolve on them. VERA builds these environments from initial trajectories: an agent writes rubrics, executable checks, a judge verifies each sandbox, and only those that pass enter the training bank. On these environments, VERA alternates between two updates: train the model with rubric rewards, or edit the harness skills. We also create a verifier which gates model checkpoints and harness edits using explicit development-set acceptance criteria. This attribution distinguishes VERA's co-evolution from single-axis baselines: its updates target not only the cause but the outcome. With an open-source corpus of 9,000+ long-horizon verifiable environments, a 9B model paired with its co-evolved agent beats the strongest baseline by 10.3 and 13.0 points in the two domains. At 27B, it surpasses the baseline on AutoCoWorkBench (71.6) and AutoMedBench (80.7), transfers to unseen workflows, and retains general capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VERA 从初始轨迹批量构建可验证、可随时恢复的长程 agent 环境：agent 自写 rubric 与可执行检查，judge 验收后才入训练库，再在「用 rubric 奖励训练模型」与「编辑 harness 技能」之间交替更新，并用带显式开发集验收标准的 verifier 把关 checkpoint 与 harness 编辑。9B 模型配协同进化 agent 在两个领域上比最强基线高 10.3 与 13.0 分；27B 在 AutoCoWorkBench 达 71.6、AutoMedBench 达 80.7，并迁移到未见工作流。
Motivation: 长程 agent 训练缺少既可恢复又能从可观测证据演化的精确环境，现有环境只对最终结果打分，无法支撑稳定训练与归因。
Method: VERA 由初始轨迹生成环境：agent 写 rubric 与可执行检查，judge 逐一验证 sandbox，通过者进入 9,000+ 条开源长程可验证环境库；训练在两种更新间交替——用 rubric 奖励更新模型，或编辑 harness 技能；另设 verifier 依据显式开发集验收标准把关模型 checkpoint 与 harness 编辑，实现双轴归因。
Result: 开源语料含 9,000+ 长程可验证环境；9B 模型配协同进化 agent 在两个领域分别比最强基线高 10.3 与 13.0 分；27B 在 AutoCoWorkBench 得 71.6、AutoMedBench 得 80.7，超过基线，并迁移到未见工作流、保持通用能力。
Conclusion: 模型与 harness 的双轴协同进化加显式验收把关，比单轴更新更能同时改善训练的因与果，且在更大规模上仍可迁移。

papers.title: Incentive Alignment in Online Experimentation
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating the causal effect of new features is a central goal for online platforms. While recent literature addresses limited testing traffic via centralized portfolio optimization, this perspective abstracts away a critical institutional reality: experimentation is operationally decentralized. The experimenters who develop new features also dictate which hypotheses to test, and they are typically rewarded based on empirical average treatment effects that are prone to upward bias. Left unchecked, this principal-agent conflict can severely erode platform value, a structural failure that conventional centralized levers, such as significance thresholds and traffic budgets, cannot resolve. By reframing experimentation as an incentive design problem, we demonstrate that two practical mechanisms, sample splitting and shrinkage, can effectively bridge this gap. Sample splitting aligns incentives perfectly at a bounded traffic cost, while shrinkage consumes no additional traffic and guarantees that interventions with negative expected effects are strictly unprofitable to field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线实验被重构为激励设计问题：实验者既决定测什么假设、又按经验平均处理效应（ATE）获得奖励，而该指标易向上偏，导致 principal-agent 冲突侵蚀平台价值。样本分割 (sample splitting) 在有界流量成本下完美对齐激励；收缩 (shrinkage) 不额外消耗流量，并保证期望效应为负的干预严格无利可图。
Motivation: 实验操作是分散的：开发功能的人自己决定测哪些假设，且按易向上偏的经验 ATE 受奖，这种委托-代理冲突会严重侵蚀平台价值，而显著性阈值与流量预算等集中式手段无法解决。
Method: 把在线实验重构为激励设计问题，分析两个可实施机制：sample splitting（分割数据以隔离评估与选择）与 shrinkage（对估计效应做收缩），并论证它们如何对齐实验者激励。
Result: Sample splitting 以有界流量成本实现完美激励对齐；shrinkage 不消耗额外流量，并保证期望效应为负的干预被推行时严格无利可图。
Conclusion: 激励冲突是集中式流量与显著性杠杆解决不了的结构性问题，而 sample splitting 与 shrinkage 这类简单机制即可有效弥合该缺口。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Transport Cost: Routing Differences between Flow Matching and Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: In generative models, Optimal Transport (OT) is used to improve Flow Matching (FM) by reducing noise-data coupling cost. However, different noise-to-output assignments can yield nearly equal costs, raising a key question. Is cost alone sufficient to guide coupling design? We address this question by separating transport cost from routing, i.e., the destination reached by each noise sample. We show numerically how FM and OT can differ in routing while remaining close in cost. We examine its consequences in learned neural FM. Using the exact FM routing as an oracle, we further construct a routing-aware training coupling and find that it yields a directionally consistent improvement in generation over a cost-matched, cost-only counterpart. Our findings highlight what cost minimization can overlook and motivate using both cost and routing to evaluate the design of OT-based FM couplings. Code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Flow Matching 的 OT 耦合设计中，把 transport cost 与 routing（每个噪声样本最终到达的目的地）分开考察：数值上 FM 与 OT 可以在成本几乎相同的情况下走完全不同的路由。以 exact FM routing 为 oracle 构造 routing-aware 训练耦合，相比 cost-matched 的纯成本耦合在生成质量上得到方向一致的提升。
Motivation: OT 用于 FM 时只最小化噪声-数据耦合成本，但不同分配可以给出几乎相同的成本，成本本身不足以指导耦合设计。
Method: 将 transport cost 与 routing 解耦并数值比较 FM 与 OT 的路由差异；用 exact FM routing 作为 oracle 构造 routing-aware 训练耦合，与 cost-matched、只看成本的对照耦合比较，检验其在 learned neural FM 中的生成效果。
Result: 数值上 FM 与 OT 在成本接近的同时路由不同；以 exact FM routing 为 oracle 构造的 routing-aware 耦合相对 cost-matched 的 cost-only 对照，在生成上取得方向一致的改善（directionally consistent improvement）。
Conclusion: 仅靠成本最小化会漏掉路由信息，评估基于 OT 的 FM 耦合设计时应同时看 cost 与 routing；代码将在录用后发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Non-invasive Seizure Detection Using Wearable Wrist-worn Accelerometry and Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Seizure monitoring and detection are crucial for reducing the morbidity and mortality associated with seizures. Current epilepsy care, often involving expensive video-electroencephalography (VEEG) monitoring, requires specialized expertise and is limited to in-hospital settings, and intrusive in nature. Seizure diaries, on the other hand, suffer from unreliability due to under-reporting, leading to incorrect therapeutic decisions. Wearable non-invasive seizure detection may offer a more tolerable and feasible solution for long-term ambulatory monitoring. This study explores a wearable remote monitoring system utilizing a single wrist-worn accelerometer device and capable of detecting multiple types of seizures, including shorter duration events. We enrolled 79 patients under video-electroencephalography monitoring to wear accelerometer devices and collect data. Concurrent VEEG recordings were reviewed by board-certified epileptologists to produce annotations, including seizure onset, offset, and seizure type. Using this data, we constructed a deep neural network based on the time-series ResNet architecture, which could discriminate among seizure and non-seizure events. Our proposed approach achieved a seizure detection sensitivity of 95.65% and an overall false alarm rate of 0.15/24 hours during the evaluation, which spanned 5576 hours of total recording. Additionally, it resulted in an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) of 0.98 and an area under the precision-re call curve (AUC-PRC) of 0.67 when averaged over 20 patients who experienced 46 convulsive seizures. These promising results suggest that the proposed seizure detection system can be effectively used for long-term ambulatory seizure monitoring. Future steps include validating our findings in larger datasets and assessing the utility of detection for additional seizure types.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用单只腕戴式三轴加速度计加 time-series ResNet 做非侵入性癫痫发作检测，在 79 名 VEEG 监护患者数据上训练评估：灵敏度 95.65%，误报率 0.15/24 小时，AUC-ROC 0.98。作者认为该系统可用于长期院外发作监测，下一步需在更大数据集上验证并扩展到更多发作类型。
Motivation: 现有癫痫监测依赖昂贵的院内视频脑电 (VEEG)，需专科医生且侵入性强；发作日记又因漏记导致治疗决策错误，长期院外监测缺少可耐受的手段。
Method: 79 名患者在 VEEG 监护期间佩戴腕戴式加速度计，由 board-certified epileptologists 标注发作起止与发作类型；据此构建基于 time-series ResNet 架构的深度网络，区分发作与非发作事件，支持多种发作类型与短时程事件。
Result: 在总计 5576 小时记录的评估中，发作检测灵敏度 95.65%，总体误报率 0.15/24 小时；AUC-ROC 0.98、AUC-PRC 0.67，后两项为 20 名经历 46 次 convulsive seizures 的患者上的平均值。
Conclusion: 单腕戴加速度计加深度网络足以支撑长期院外发作监测，但结论需在更大数据集上复验，并扩展到额外发作类型。
