papers.title: Prompt and Refinement: Asymmetric Mutual Learning for Infrared Small Target Detection with Noisy Labels
papers.abstract_en: Existing data-driven infrared small target detection (ISTD) methods typically require large-scale datasets with accurate pixel-level annotations for model training. However, such labor-intensive requirements are difficult to satisfy in real-world applications due to the heavy reliance on expert knowledge and the inherently weak distinctiveness of infrared small targets. Consequently, the presence of noisy labels during model training is inevitable, which can severely mislead the learning of target perception toward spurious patterns. To address this challenge, we propose Prompt and Refinement (PAR), a label-noise-robust asymmetric mutual learning paradigm for ISTD. Specifically, PAR comprises a pretrained Segment Anything Model (SAM) and an ISTD-specific detector trained from scratch, which learn collaboratively through a peer-teaching scheme. Coupled with local contrast regularity, the predictions of the two asymmetric peer models are mutually exploited as rectification cues for the supervisory masks of their counterparts. The interaction between complementary inductive biases effectively prevents the label correction process from degenerating into the self-confirmation loop of a single model, enabling progressive refinement of the annotations toward intrinsic target characteristics. In addition, the detector predictions are utilized as corrective mask prompts to facilitate task-specific adaptation of the vision foundation model. Moreover, an evidential uncertainty estimation strategy is introduced into the optimization process to further alleviate the adverse effects of noisy labels. Extensive experiments under diverse noisy label scenarios on three ISTD datasets demonstrate that PAR consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAR 用预训练 SAM 与从零训练的红外小目标检测器做非对称互教 (asymmetric mutual learning)，双方预测互为对方监督掩码的修正线索，配合检测器输出作为 mask prompt 适配视觉基础模型，并引入 evidential uncertainty estimation 抑制噪声标签。在三个 ISTD 数据集的多种噪声标签场景下持续达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 红外小目标检测依赖大规模像素级精确标注，但目标弱可分、需专家知识，真实场景中噪声标签不可避免，会把学习带向虚假模式。
Method: PAR 由预训练 Segment Anything Model (SAM) 与从零训练的 ISTD 检测器组成 peer-teaching：结合 local contrast regularity，双方预测互为对方监督掩码的修正线索；检测器预测作为 corrective mask prompt 促成视觉基础模型的任务适配；优化中加入 evidential uncertainty estimation 缓解噪声标签。
Result: 在三个 ISTD 数据集、多种噪声标签场景的大量实验中，PAR 持续取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 两个归纳偏置互补的非对称模型互教，可避免标签修正退化为单一模型的自确认循环，使标注逐步向目标本征特征收敛。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Large Stepsizes Federated Learning on Logistic Regression with Linearly Separable Data: The Case of Heterogeneous Devices
papers.abstract_en: This paper revisits the distributed learning problem for training a multinomial logistic regression model with the Federated Averaging ($\texttt{FedAvg}$) algorithm. We concentrate on a scenario with arbitrarily large stepsizes and heterogeneous update rules where the devices may perform a different number of local updates in each round. We show that, with linearly separable data, $\texttt{FedAvg}$ is stable with any stepsizes and the objective values converge to zero at the rate of ${\cal O}(1/R)$, where $R$ is the number of communication rounds. Our result also demonstrates that the effects of device heterogeneity vanish asymptotically. For sufficiently large $R$, the objective values decrease monotonically and is bounded by ${\cal O}( 1 / (R T_{\rm avg}))$, where $T_{\rm avg}$ is the average number of local update steps per communication round across devices. Numerical experiments support our findings.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, accepted to the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性可分数据上训练多项式 logistic 回归的 FedAvg，即使步长任意大、各设备每轮本地更新次数不同（异构更新规则），仍然稳定，目标值以 O(1/R) 速率收敛到零，且设备异构性的影响渐近消失；R 足够大后目标值单调下降并被 O(1/(R·T_avg)) 控制，T_avg 为各设备每轮本地更新步数的平均值。
Motivation: 分布式学习中大步长与设备异构（各设备本地更新次数不同）通常破坏 FedAvg 的收敛保证，本文要在可分数据这一特殊设定下给出任意步长下的稳定性与速率。
Method: 针对线性可分数据上的多项式 logistic 回归，分析 FedAvg 在任意大步长与异构本地更新规则下的动力学，推导目标值收敛速率与异构项的渐近行为，并辅以数值实验。
Result: 线性可分数据下 FedAvg 对任意步长稳定，目标值以 O(1/R) 收敛到零（R 为通信轮数）；设备异构性的影响渐近消失；R 足够大时目标值单调下降且被 O(1/(R·T_avg)) 界住，T_avg 为每轮跨设备平均本地更新步数；数值实验支持上述结论。
Conclusion: 在可分数据上，FedAvg 的大步长与设备异构并不妨碍收敛，且异构效应随轮数渐近消退，本地更新步数越多界越紧。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoHyFuse: Condition-wise Hypergraph Fusion with Global Connectome in Task-fMRI
papers.abstract_en: Task-fMRI connectomes reveal state-dependent neural reconfigurations, yet conventional methods marginalize these signals by aggregating distinct conditions into static pairwise graphs, thereby obscuring condition-specific multi-ROI organization. We introduce CoHyFuse, a condition-aware ROI-centered hypergraph framework that constructs a task-state-specific incidence matrix from condition-wise functional connectivity (FC)-profile embeddings, allowing the same ROI to form different multi-ROI hyperedges across task phases. Condition-specific neighborhood sizes $K_q$ further adapt the hyperedge scale to each task state, and the resulting condition embeddings are fused with a complementary whole-session FC branch for prediction. In the AABC cohort (N=1,074), CoHyFuse achieved the best mean out-of-fold predictive performance among evaluated baselines on FACENAME Fluid Cognition Composite (FCC) prediction (7.83$\pm$0.10 MAE, 0.439$\pm$0.026 \(R^2\)) and VISMOTOR age prediction (7.52$\pm$0.37 MAE, 0.592$\pm$0.022 \(R^2\)). In an auxiliary CMI-HBN attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) classification benchmark (N=223), CoHyFuse obtained 72.0$\pm$2.1\% macro-AUC and 74.2$\pm$2.9\% accuracy. Ablation studies support the contributions of condition-wise incidence construction and dual-view fusion, suggesting that state-resolved ROI-set structure provides complementary predictive information beyond whole-session FC alone. Occlusion analysis identifies the Distraction condition as the primary driver of model prediction, pointing toward the Salience/Ventral Attention Network (SAN)--FrontoParietal Network (FPN) and within-SAN hyperedge-defined ROI-set motifs as candidate model-relevant patterns. This framework provides an interpretable, state-resolved view of the connectome for downstream cohort analysis.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedicine (BIBM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoHyFuse 用条件感知的 ROI 中心超图 (condition-aware hypergraph) 从各任务状态的 FC-profile 嵌入构造状态专属关联矩阵，让同一 ROI 在不同任务阶段形成不同多 ROI 超边，并与全会话 FC 分支融合做预测。在 AABC 队列 (N=1,074) 上取得所评估基线中最好的折外预测表现：FACENAME FCC 预测 MAE 7.83±0.10、R² 0.439±0.026，VISMOTOR 年龄预测 MAE 7.52±0.37、R² 0.592±0.022。
Motivation: 常规方法把不同任务条件聚合进静态成对图，边缘化了状态依赖的神经重配置，掩盖了条件特异的多 ROI 组织。
Method: 按条件的功能连接 (FC) profile 嵌入构造任务状态专属关联矩阵，同一 ROI 可在不同任务阶段形成不同超边；条件专属邻域大小 K_q 按任务状态调节超边尺度，条件嵌入与互补的全会话 FC 分支融合后做预测；辅以消融与遮蔽 (occlusion) 分析。
Result: AABC 队列 (N=1,074) 折外预测：FACENAME Fluid Cognition Composite 预测 MAE 7.83±0.10、R² 0.439±0.026，VISMOTOR 年龄预测 MAE 7.52±0.37、R² 0.592±0.022，均为所评估基线中最佳均值；CMI-HBN ADHD 分类 (N=223) 上 macro-AUC 72.0±2.1%、准确率 74.2±2.9%。消融支持条件式关联构造与双视图融合的贡献；遮蔽分析把 Distraction 条件识别为主要预测驱动，指向 SAN–FPN 与 SAN 内部超边定义的 ROI-set 模式。
Conclusion: 状态分辨的 ROI 集合结构在全会话 FC 之外提供互补预测信息，超图框架为队列分析给出可解释的、状态分辨的 connectome 视图。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: MiniCorp: The Last Mile of the AI Agent Firm
papers.abstract_en: The last mile toward enterprise AGI is a company that runs itself. Training and adapting such agents require longitudinal enterprise data, which remain scarce, costly to acquire, and often restricted by privacy constraints. Historical archives are also frequently incomplete and record only what actually happened. They cannot show the outcomes of alternative decisions. We introduce MiniCorp, an office simulator for studying how agents can collectively run a company while generating enterprise data at scale. Using an e-commerce company as a demonstration, MiniCorp connects two interacting worlds. The external world models customers, dynamic competitors, and market mechanisms. The internal world consists of agents that observe events, discuss their options, and make strategic decisions. These decisions have lasting effects on the market, and the resulting feedback informs the firm's later decisions. As the firm and market interact, MiniCorp continuously records the agents' communications and decisions. These records preserve the information available at the time and the business results that followed. Checkpointing allows the same situation to be replayed under different decisions, providing comparisons unavailable in static archives. We evaluate end-to-end fidelity against patterns reported in empirical studies of real markets. These evaluations provide agents with realistic market feedback and reduce the risk that they learn to exploit flaws in the simulator. Our experiments show agents coordinating across roles and adapting their decisions to market feedback. With explicit long-term strategic guidance, they also sustain advertising exploration despite weak early returns. MiniCorp thus provides an environment for studying AI-run companies and a scalable source of longitudinal and counterfactual enterprise data for agent training and evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MiniCorp 是一个电商公司办公室模拟器：外部世界建模客户、动态竞争对手与市场机制，内部由观察事件、讨论并做战略决策的 agent 组成，决策对市场产生持久影响并反过来喂给后续决策。系统持续记录通信与决策，并支持 checkpoint 回放同一情境下的不同决策以生成反事实数据；实验显示 agent 能跨角色协作并随市场反馈调整，在显式长期战略引导下即使早期回报微弱也维持广告探索。
Motivation: 训练和改造企业级 agent 需要纵向企业数据，但这类数据稀缺、获取成本高且受隐私限制；历史档案又只记录实际发生的事，无法给出替代决策的结果。
Method: 以一家电商公司为演示，把外部世界（客户、动态竞争对手、市场机制）与内部 agent 世界相连：agent 观察事件、讨论选项、做战略决策，决策持续影响市场并形成反馈闭环；系统全程记录通信与决策，保留当时可见信息与随后的业务结果，并用 checkpointing 让同一情境在不同决策下重放。
Result: 针对真实市场实证研究报告的模式做端到端保真度评估，用于给 agent 提供真实市场反馈并降低其钻模拟器漏洞的风险；实验显示 agent 能跨角色协作、随市场反馈调整决策，且在显式长期战略引导下，即使早期回报微弱仍维持广告探索。
Conclusion: MiniCorp 既可作为研究 AI 运营公司的环境，也可作为纵向与反事实企业数据的可扩展来源，用于 agent 训练与评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Every View Counts: View-Consistent Panoptic Quality for Multi-view Panoptic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view panoptic segmentation assigns a semantic class and a scene-level instance ID to every pixel of an unordered set of images, and recent feed-forward 3D models predict these labels for the input views in a single forward pass. Their predictions, however, have been evaluated with the scene-level PQ (PQ^scene) borrowed from per-scene optimization methods, typically on rendered held-out views. PQ^scene tiles all views of a scene into a single image, so that a missed appearance or a change of ID lowers the score of the matched pair only in proportion to its area. We propose View-Consistent Panoptic Quality (VC-PQ), which extends PQ from a single image to a set of input views, counts equally every view in which an instance is visible, and penalizes a prediction that is not visible in the same views as its ground truth. A decomposition of VC-PQ attributes the score a method loses to mask accuracy, view consistency, and the matching threshold. A single additional parameter recovers the area weighting of tiling for comparison. Under a fixed evaluation protocol on ScanNet++ and ScanNetv2, recent feed-forward methods are evaluated with VC-PQ and PQ^scene, and the decomposition shows where each of them loses its score. Controlled perturbations of the ground truth show that VC-PQ responds to the number of views in which an instance is missed or changes ID, whereas PQ^scene responds to their area. The aim of this work is to make view consistency part of the evaluation of multi-view panoptic segmentation, with VC-PQ reported alongside PQ^scene.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 8 figures. Under review. Youngmin Lee and Byungha Ko contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 View-Consistent Panoptic Quality (VC-PQ)，把全景质量 (PQ) 从单张拼接图扩展到一组输入视图：实例在每个可见视图中等权计分，预测可见性与真值不一致的视图被惩罚。VC-PQ 可分解为 mask accuracy、view consistency 与 matching threshold 三部分，另加一个参数即可还原拼接式 PQ^scene 的面积加权；受控扰动显示 VC-PQ 响应实例被漏检或 ID 变化的视图数，而 PQ^scene 只响应其面积。
Motivation: 多视图全景分割的前馈 3D 模型沿用按场景优化方法的 PQ^scene：它把整个场景所有视图拼成一张图，漏检或 ID 变化只按面积比例扣分，视图级一致性因此在评测中被系统性低估。
Method: 提出 VC-PQ，把 PQ 从单图扩展到输入视图集合，对实例可见的每个视图等权计分，并惩罚未在与真值相同视图集合中出现的预测；给出把失分归因到 mask accuracy、view consistency、matching threshold 的分解，并提供一个附加参数以恢复拼接的面积加权用于与 PQ^scene 对比。
Result: 在固定评测协议下于 ScanNet++ 与 ScanNetv2 上用 VC-PQ 与 PQ^scene 评测近期前馈方法，分解显示各自失分来源；对真值的受控扰动表明 VC-PQ 随实例被漏检或 ID 变化的视图数变化，PQ^scene 则随其面积变化。
Conclusion: 视图一致性应成为多视图全景分割评测的一部分，VC-PQ 应与 PQ^scene 并列报告；面积加权的 PQ^scene 无法反映实例在多少个视图中丢失或 ID 跳变。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 提出 VC-PQ，把 PQ 从单图扩展到输入视图集合，对实例可见的每个视图等权计分，并惩罚未在与真值相同视图集合中出现的预测；给出把失分归因到 mask accuracy、view consistency、matching threshold 的分解，并提供一个附加参数以恢复拼接的面积加权用于与 PQ^scene 对比。
summary_sections.result: 在固定评测协议下于 ScanNet++ 与 ScanNetv2 上用 VC-PQ 与 PQ^scene 评测近期前馈方法，分解显示各自失分来源；对真值的受控扰动表明 VC-PQ 随实例被漏检或 ID 变化的视图数变化，PQ^scene 则随其面积变化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 视图一致性应成为多视图全景分割评测的一部分，VC-PQ 应与 PQ^scene 并列报告；面积加权的 PQ^scene 无法反映实例在多少个视图中丢失或 ID 跳变。

papers.title: AstraSR: Real-World Thermal Super-Resolution with GPT-6 Astra
papers.abstract_en: Real-world thermal super-resolution (SR) is constrained by limited sensor resolution and the difficulty of obtaining corresponding high-resolution (HR) observations for direct model supervision. Conventional SR methods typically construct training pairs by treating captured thermal images with real-world degradations as HR references and applying predefined degradation to generate synthetic low-resolution (LR) inputs. Such a construction not only introduces a domain gap between synthetic and captured LR observations but also retains acquisition degradations in the supervision. To address this issue, we propose AstraSR, a real-world thermal SR method guided by GPT-6 Astra, a frontier multimodal generative model endowed with emergent and transformative visual capabilities. Specifically, we construct a dataset of image pairs by using captured LR thermal images to condition GPT-based HR reference. We develop a direct generative supervision strategy that learns from captured thermal inputs paired with GPT-generated HR references. Pixel, gradient, and perceptual losses jointly supervise the transfer of intensity patterns, structural boundaries, and visual details from the generated references. Qualitative comparisons with seven existing state-of-the-art real-world SR methods show continuous object contours, distinct structural boundaries, and smooth intensity transitions in the thermal scenes. These results demonstrate that AstraSR outperforms existing real-world SR methods in both thermal clarity and structural coherence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AstraSR 用多模态生成模型 GPT-6 Astra 以实拍低分辨率热图为条件生成高分辨率参考，替代传统「实拍图当 HR + 预定义退化造 LR」的配对方式，再用像素、梯度与感知三种损失联合监督 SR 训练。与七种现有最先进真实世界 SR 方法的定性对比显示，热图中物体轮廓连续、结构边界清晰、强度过渡平滑。
Motivation: 真实热成像缺乏对应 HR 观测，传统方法把带真实退化的实拍图当 HR 参考并施加预定义退化造 LR，既造成合成与实拍 LR 的域差，又把采集退化保留在监督信号里。
Method: 以实拍 LR 热图为条件让 GPT-6 Astra 生成 HR 参考，构造图像对数据集；训练时用像素、梯度 (gradient) 与感知 (perceptual) 三种损失联合监督，分别约束强度模式、结构边界与视觉细节从生成参考向输出迁移。
Result: 与七种现有最先进真实世界 SR 方法做定性比较，AstraSR 在热场景中呈现连续物体轮廓、清晰结构边界与平滑强度过渡，摘要以热图清晰度与结构一致性为评价维度，未给出数值指标。
Conclusion: 用生成模型从实拍 LR 直接产出 HR 参考可绕开合成退化配对带来的域差与退化残留，作者据此称 AstraSR 在热图清晰度与结构一致性上超过现有真实世界 SR 方法。

papers.title: Safe Image Generation via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recent Text-to-Image (T2I) models achieve remarkable visual image generation performance, but they can still generate NSFW (Not-Safe-For-Work) contents, including violent or explicit images. Existing safety checker mechanisms are largely confined to pre-generation filtering (e.g. prompt-level text classifiers) or post-hoc moderation applied after an image is completely synthesized. However, adversarial attack methods operate over a much broader space. This imbalance highlights the need for a safety mechanism that intervenes during the generation process. We propose an in-generation safety framework that monitors the denoising trajectory and detects emerging NSFW signals from intermediate representations. Rather than merely detecting NSFW generations, our method applies reinforcement learning to generate safe images from NSFW prompts. By coupling in-generation detection with controllable steering, our approach mitigates unsafe trajectories even when NSFW signals emerge after generation has already begun. Experiments results show that our method consistently outperforms existing safe image generation methods across both standard and adversarial evaluation sets, while preserving perceptual quality and prompt fidelity. Code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出在扩散去噪过程中介入的 T2I 安全框架：监控去噪轨迹、从中间表征检测正在浮现的 NSFW 信号，并用强化学习把生成过程转向安全图像，从而在 NSFW 信号于生成中途才出现时仍能纠正轨迹。在标准与对抗两类评测集上均优于现有安全图像生成方法，同时保持感知质量与 prompt 保真度。
Motivation: 现有安全机制只做生成前的 prompt 级文本过滤或生成后的整图审核，而对抗攻击可作用的空间远大于此，NSFW 信号在生成开始后才出现时无法被拦截。
Method: 在扩散去噪轨迹上监控中间表征并检测新兴 NSFW 信号（in-generation detection），再用强化学习对生成过程施加可控转向（controllable steering），把不安全轨迹导向安全图像。
Result: 在标准评测集与对抗评测集上均持续优于现有安全图像生成方法，并在抑制 NSFW 内容的同时保持感知质量与 prompt 保真度；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 安全介入必须放在生成过程内部而非仅靠前置过滤或事后审核，检测与转向耦合才能覆盖生成中途才浮现的 NSFW 信号。

papers.title: On Hyperparameter Tuning on the Test Set
papers.abstract_en: "Don't tune hyperparameters on the test set" is often stated in machine learning textbooks. Violating it is considered a cardinal sin that produces misleadingly optimistic results, corrupts benchmark integrity, and thus can even be interpreted as scientific fraud. Yet evidence suggests that test set hyperparameter tuning does occur in practice, making it all the more important to understand its actual consequences. So how bad is it, really? In this work we question this dogma and put it to an empirical test. We systematically study the magnitude of the performance inflation caused by tuning the hyperparameters on the test set for MNIST-1D, CIFAR-10, and three tasks from the GLUE benchmark. Our experiments show that while the effect is real and significant, it is frequently small relative to other sources of noise. In many cases, we find that tuning on the test set recovers exactly the same model as when tuning on the validation set. Most importantly, we find that the rankings of models remain essentially preserved after tuning on the test set and therefore that consistent test-set tuning may not invalidate benchmarks or model selection. Our results call for a more nuanced view of tuning hyperparameters on the test set, stimulating researchers to openly report test tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对“不要在测试集上调超参数”这条教条做实证检验：在 MNIST-1D、CIFAR-10 与 GLUE 三个任务上系统测量测试集调参带来的性能虚高幅度，发现效应真实但常小于其他噪声来源，且模型排名基本保持不变，因此一致的测试集调参未必使基准或模型选择失效。作者主张对测试集调参采取更细致的立场，并公开报告该做法。
Motivation: 教科书把测试集调参视为会虚高结果、破坏基准诚信的“大忌”，但证据显示实践中普遍存在；其真实后果到底多大一直缺乏系统量化。
Method: 在 MNIST-1D、CIFAR-10 以及 GLUE 的三个任务上，系统比较在测试集上调超参数与在验证集上调超参数，量化性能虚高幅度，并检查选出的模型与模型排名是否改变。
Result: 测试集调参造成的性能虚高真实且显著，但相对其他噪声来源通常很小；许多情况下测试集调参与验证集调参选出完全相同的模型；测试集调参后模型排名基本保持不变。
Conclusion: 一致地在测试集上调超参数可能不会使基准或模型选择失效，研究者应更细致地看待这一禁忌并公开报告测试集调参。

papers.title: End-to-End Autonomous Recursive Arborescence Deformable Flow and Non-Linear Hemodynamics for Patient-Specific Coronary Centerline Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Extracting patient-specific vascular trees from volumetric medical images is fundamental to computational angiography and non-invasive hemodynamic assessment. Conventional voxel segmentation models often sever delicate bifurcations, while heuristic Euclidean Minimum Spanning Trees introduce non-anatomical shortcuts. Moreover, linear Poiseuille flow neglects quadratic kinetic dissipation across arterial narrowings, underestimating ischemia. We formulate an end-to-end framework decoupling continuous geometric arborescence generation from non-linear hemodynamics. First, an autonomous 3D Ostium Landmark Localization Head with dual-sinus query channels and spherical-gated refinement eliminates centerline seeding dependency, achieving cohort mean localization error of 7.63 mm (7.43 mm LCA, 7.83 mm RCA; 71.4% <= 8.0 mm) from raw contrast context. Second, a Spatially-Grounded Deformable Step Flow Architecture queries continuous 3D feature pyramids via trilinear sampling, sequentially generating trajectories with anchor boundary enforcement (X(0) = P_start). Third, a Top-Down Recursive Arborescence State Machine detects bifurcation peaks via Tree-NMS and parameterizes predecessor parent pointers (p_k < k), guaranteeing single connected acyclic tree topology (beta_0 = 1, beta_1 = 0) with differentiable step termination. Fourth, an iterative Picard non-linear Kirchhoff solver with Young-Tsai / Gould quadratic dissipation enforces machine-precision mass conservation (residual 5.82e-11 mL/s). Across 14 development patients under standardized in-silico stenosis stress testing (Q_0 = 4.0 mL/s), linear Poiseuille flow misclassifies 75% diameter lesions as non-ischemic (FFR > 0.80) in 14/14 cases, whereas our non-linear solver captures functional ischemia (FFR = 0.5864, lesion disparity 32.89 mmHg, p = 6.10e-5) with 3.66x collateral shunting. Test set firewall isolation was maintained.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出端到端冠脉中心线提取框架：用自主主动脉根部 (Ostium) 定位头去掉人工种子点，用可变形步流生成连续中心线，再用递归树状态机保证单连通无环拓扑，最后接非线性 Kirchff 求解器算血流。在 14 名开发患者的仿真狭窄压力测试中，线性 Poiseuille 流把 75% 直径狭窄全部误判为非缺血 (FFR > 0.80)，而非线性求解器给出 FFR = 0.5864、病变压差 32.89 mmHg (p = 6.10e-5)。
Motivation: 体素分割常切断细小分叉，欧氏最小生成树会引入非解剖捷径；线性 Poiseuille 流忽略狭窄处的二次动能耗散，低估缺血程度，使计算血管造影与无创血流动力学评估失真。
Method: 框架解耦连续几何树生成与非线性血流：双正弦查询通道与球形门控细化的 3D Ostium Landmark Localization Head 自动定位起点；Spatially-Grounded Deformable Step Flow Architecture 经三线性采样查询连续 3D 特征金字塔，带锚点边界约束 (X(0) = P_start) 逐步生成轨迹；Top-Down Recursive Arborescence State Machine 用 Tree-NMS 检测分叉峰、以前驱指针 (p_k < k) 参数化，保证单连通无环拓扑 (beta_0 = 1, beta_1 = 0)；迭代 Picard 非线性 Kirchhoff 求解器配 Young-Tsai / Gould 二次耗散项。
Result: Ostium 定位队列平均误差 7.63 mm（LCA 7.43 mm，RCA 7.83 mm），71.4% 落在 8.0 mm 内；非线性求解器质量守恒残差 5.82e-11 mL/s。14 名开发患者在 Q_0 = 4.0 mL/s 标准化 in-silico 狭窄压力测试中，线性 Poiseuille 流在 14/14 例把 75% 直径病变误判为非缺血 (FFR > 0.80)，本方法给出 FFR = 0.5864、病变压差 32.89 mmHg (p = 6.10e-5)，侧支分流 3.66 倍。
Conclusion: 把几何树生成与非线性血流分开建模，可在保证拓扑合法的同时捕捉狭窄处二次耗散导致的功能性缺血；线性流模型在 75% 直径病变上系统性漏诊。测试集防火墙隔离被保持。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: LoDEOT: Low-Dimensional and Efficient Offset Tokens for Building Footprint Extraction from Off-Nadir Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Instance-level roof-to-footprint offset (RFO) prediction is central to extracting building footprints from off-nadir imagery. Query-based pipelines commonly use high-dimensional instance tokens to predict signed two-dimensional RFOs. We investigate whether RFO prediction can instead use a compact offset token. Under local pinhole projection and vertical-extrusion assumptions, the idealized RFO map admits a five-parameter sufficient descriptor comprising intrinsic shape, composite amplitude, and relative geometry. This factorization provides a structural prior for a five-dimensional offset token, whose channels learn task-relevant latent representations through end-to-end training. Based on this design, we propose LoDEOT, which retains high-dimensional instance tokens for detection and segmentation but maps instance-token, concentration-gated roof, and box-mask evidence to a five-dimensional offset token followed by an independent two-dimensional readout. Known denoising-query target indices further align each supervised decoder-layer estimate with the same clean instance RFO, organizing successive predictions as target-aligned recovery under perturbed query conditions. Experiments on five real-world building datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of LoDEOT for building footprint extraction. Experiments on real-world building datasets demonstrate that a five-dimensional offset token can support accurate RFO prediction. On BONAI, LoDEOT achieves the best roof-detection bAP and bAP50 and leads all five offset-corrected footprint metrics among the evaluated end-to-end methods, with FAP50 of 54.58 and mEPE of 5.23 pixels. Its FAP50 exceeds those of the evaluated end-to-end baselines by 7.56-16.85 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoDEOT 把查询式建筑轮廓提取中的高维实例 token 压成一个五维 offset token：在局部针孔投影与垂直挤出假设下，理想 RFO 图可由五参数充分描述子（内在形状、复合幅度、相对几何）分解，该分解作为结构先验，再接独立二维读出预测有符号 roof-to-footprint offset。在 BONAI 上取得 FAP50 54.58、mEPE 5.23 像素，FAP50 高出被评估端到端基线 7.56–16.85 个百分点，并在全部五项 offset 校正轮廓指标上领先。
Motivation: 从倾斜角外 (off-nadir) 影像提取建筑轮廓依赖实例级 roof-to-footprint offset (RFO) 预测，而查询式管线普遍用高维实例 token 回归二维偏移，参数冗余且缺少针对该几何任务的结构约束。
Method: 在局部针孔投影与垂直挤出假设下把理想 RFO 图分解为五参数充分描述子，据此设计五维 offset token；LoDEOT 保留高维实例 token 做检测与分割，把实例 token、concentration-gated roof 与 box-mask 证据映射为五维 offset token，再做独立二维读出。利用已知 denoising-query 目标索引，让每个监督 decoder 层估计对齐同一干净实例 RFO，使逐层预测成为扰动 query 条件下的 target-aligned recovery，端到端训练。
Result: 在五个真实建筑数据集上实验；BONAI 上 LoDEOT 取得最佳 roof-detection bAP 与 bAP50，并在被评估端到端方法中领先全部五项 offset 校正轮廓指标，FAP50 为 54.58、mEPE 为 5.23 像素，FAP50 超出被评估端到端基线 7.56–16.85 个百分点。
Conclusion: 五维 offset token 足以支撑精确的 RFO 预测：把几何先验压进低维 token、检测分割仍用高维实例 token，可在倾斜影像建筑轮廓提取上以更紧凑的偏移表示取得领先精度。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Collaborative Personalized Preference Alignment for LLMs under Data Deficiency
papers.abstract_en: Real-world users often exhibit highly heterogeneous preferences over multiple objectives for LLM responses. A lightweight aligner can tailor these responses to individual preferences, but scarce user-specific feedback makes personalized training difficult. Learning shared initializations across users can support few-shot adaptation. However, heterogeneous preferences and competing objectives cause gradient conflicts across users and within each user, hindering effective initialization learning. This raises a central question: \textbf{how can we collaboratively learn aligner initializations that support few-shot adaptation to diverse user preferences?} To answer this question, we propose \textbf{A}pproximate \textbf{P}areto \textbf{O}ptimality (APO). We first group users whose updates are compatible, so that their information can be combined with less interference. Within each group, we combine gradient descent with controlled ascent to coordinate competing objectives and move towards preference-specific points on the Pareto front. This produces an initialization that is close to the optima of the users in the group. We then iteratively refine it using updates from few-shot local adaptation, making it more effective for personalization. Furthermore, we establish conditional suboptimality bounds for a one-local-step collaborative update and characterize how initialization error affects subsequent stochastic adaptation. Experiments on Fed-ChatbotPA and UltraFeedback show consistent improvements over existing methods using only 20 local examples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Approximate Pareto Optimal (APO)：先按梯度相容性把用户分组，组内用梯度下降加受控上升协调竞争目标，得到靠近组内用户 Pareto 最优点的 aligner 初始化，再用 few-shot 局部适应的更新迭代精修。在 Fed-ChatbotPA 与 UltraFeedback 上仅用 20 条本地样本即一致优于现有方法。
Motivation: 用户偏好在多目标上高度异质且本地反馈稀缺，异质偏好与竞争目标造成跨用户和用户内部的梯度冲突，使共享初始化难以学好，few-shot 个性化适应受限。
Method: APO 分三步：按更新相容性对用户分组以减少干扰；组内将梯度下降与受控上升 (controlled ascent) 结合，协调竞争目标并走向 Pareto 前沿上偏好的点；再用 few-shot 局部适应的更新迭代精修初始化。另给出单步局部协同更新的条件次优性界，并刻画初始化误差对后续随机适应的影响。
Result: 在 Fed-ChatbotPA 与 UltraFeedback 上，仅用 20 条本地样本，相对现有方法取得一致改进；并给出单局部步协同更新的条件次优性界与初始化误差对随机适应影响的刻画。
Conclusion: 按相容性分组加受控上升的协同初始化，能在数据稀缺下支撑对异质偏好的 few-shot 个性化对齐，且其质量可用次优性界刻画。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fitting Vision Adapters at Frontier Scales
papers.abstract_en: Training a small projector between a frozen vision encoder and language model is an established approach to multimodal learning. As the parameter count of language models scales dramatically, we revisit which vision capabilities this approach can add while keeping their pretrained weights fixed. Here we train a 50M parameter projector from the vision encoder of Kimi K2.6 to GLM 5.2 and 5.3, both models without native vision capabilities, and further present a reproducible recipe for training these adapters at scale. We study the following: (a) how vision capabilities of multimodal models scale as purely the language model side scales, and (b) what specific vision capabilities are able to be imbued into a pure language model at scale, and which ones remain limited. We evaluate on MMMU-Pro and BLINK, examining both overall performance and results on individual visual tasks.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结视觉编码器与无原生视觉能力的大语言模型之间只训练一个 50M 参数 projector，从 Kimi K2.6 的视觉编码器接到 GLM 5.2 与 5.3，并给出可复现的大规模训练配方。在 MMMU-Pro 与 BLINK 上按整体与单个视觉任务两个层面考察：语言模型侧规模扩大时视觉能力如何随之变化，以及哪些视觉能力可被注入、哪些仍然受限。
Motivation: 随着语言模型参数量急剧增长，需要重新审视在冻结权重前提下，小 projector 这一既有多模态方案究竟能补上哪些视觉能力。
Method: 训练 50M 参数 projector，连接 Kimi K2.6 的视觉编码器与 GLM 5.2、GLM 5.3（两者均无原生视觉能力），并给出可复现的大规模 adapter 训练配方；评测用 MMMU-Pro 与 BLINK，既看整体表现也看单个视觉任务的分项结果。
Result: 研究给出两项对照维度：视觉能力随纯语言模型侧规模的扩展关系，以及可被注入纯语言模型的具体视觉能力与其受限项；评测覆盖 MMMU-Pro 与 BLINK 的整体与分任务结果。
Conclusion: 在冻结视觉编码器与语言模型权重的条件下，仅靠小 projector 即可为无原生视觉的 GLM 5.2/5.3 注入部分视觉能力，且哪些能力可注入、哪些受限取决于语言模型侧的规模。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TasteRoute: Personalized Routing for Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Rapid progress in video generation has led to a plethora of models that differ substantially in capability and generation cost. This raises a natural question: can each request be efficiently routed to an appropriate model? We find that even when the consensus of the other annotators is used as an oracle, it agrees with each annotator's own favorite only 34-55% of the time. Motivated by this observation, we introduce TasteRoute, a personalized video-generation router that selects a generator jointly based on the input request, user preferences, and available generation budget. Across text-to-video and image-to-video settings, TasteRoute is competitive with strong simple baselines on preference routing while reducing average generation cost. The cost saving increases under higher budget caps. Finally, we release TasteRoute-3k, a human-annotated dataset containing multi-model video comparisons, quality judgments, preference rankings, and user-profile signals to facilitate future research on personalized and cost-aware video routing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TasteRoute 是个性化视频生成路由器，按输入请求、用户偏好与生成预算联合挑选生成器；其出发点是即便用其他标注者的共识作 oracle，也只与个人最爱一致 34-55%，说明偏好路由不能靠单一质量共识。在文生视频与图生视频设定下，它在偏好路由上与强简单基线相当，同时降低平均生成成本，且预算上限越高节省越大。
Motivation: 视频生成模型能力与生成成本差异大，逐请求挑选合适模型成为问题；而标注者偏好高度个体化，共识 oracle 与个人最爱仅 34-55% 一致，纯质量路由会偏离用户口味。
Method: TasteRoute 联合建模输入请求、用户偏好与可用生成预算来选择生成器，覆盖 text-to-video 与 image-to-video 两种设定；并发布 TasteRoute-3k 人工标注数据集，含多模型视频对比、质量判断、偏好排序与用户画像信号。
Result: 其他标注者共识作为 oracle 时与个人最爱一致率仅 34-55%；在 text-to-video 与 image-to-video 上，TasteRoute 在偏好路由上与强简单基线相当并降低平均生成成本，预算上限越高成本节省越大。
Conclusion: 视频生成路由应同时考虑用户偏好与成本预算，而非只追共识质量；TasteRoute-3k 用于支撑个性化且成本感知的视频路由研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spatial Supervision Without Attribution Optimization: Improving Post-Hoc Class Activation Maps via Box-Guided Evidence Routing
papers.abstract_en: Post-hoc class activation maps (CAMs) are a standard tool for inspecting the evidence behind an image classifier's predictions, yet nothing in ordinary training encourages these maps to be spatially appropriate. We study whether inexpensive spatial supervision can improve a classifier's own predicted-class Grad-CAM without ever optimizing an attribution map. Box-Guided Evidence Routing (BGER) trains a lightweight gate on the final feature map under box or mask supervision and routes classification through the gated features, while Grad-CAM is computed separately at the pre-gate representation, so the evaluated map never enters the training objective. With a BCE routing loss, BGER raises MaxBoxAccV2 from $0.584$ to $0.715$ on CUB-200-2011 and from $0.757$ to $0.832$ on Stanford Dogs at comparable accuracy. Matched controls attribute most of the ResNet-50 gain to the spatial supervision reshaping the backbone rather than to routing itself: when classification bypasses the gate, most of the improvement remains, and detaching gradients through the gate leaves the ResNet-50 result nearly unchanged. The same detachment preserves most of the gain in two DenseNet-121 chest X-ray settings but removes the apparent gain on Swin-T, and directly supervising the CAM reaches stronger localization at a larger accuracy cost. Overall, spatial supervision can improve separately evaluated post-hoc CAMs, but both the mechanism and the size of the benefit depend on the architecture and the evaluation setting.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 12 figures. Appendix included in the main PDF (pages 10-24)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Box-Guided Evidence Routing (BGER)：在最终特征图上用边界框或掩码监督训练一个轻量门控，分类走门控后特征，而 Grad-CAM 单独在门控前表示上计算，使被评估的归因图从不进入训练目标。用 BCE 路由损失后，CUB-200-2011 的 MaxBoxAccV2 从 0.584 升到 0.715，Stanford Dogs 从 0.757 升到 0.832，准确率相当；对照实验显示 ResNet-50 的增益主要来自空间监督重塑骨干而非路由本身，且该机制与增益大小依赖架构与评估设定。
Motivation: 普通分类训练不约束预测类 CAM 的空间合理性，事后归因图可能与真实证据位置不符；直接优化归因图又会改变被解释的模型本身。
Method: BGER 在最终特征图上以 box 或 mask 监督训练轻量门控 (gate)，分类经门控特征进行，Grad-CAM 则在门控前表示上单独计算，评估用的图不进训练目标；路由损失用 BCE。配 matched controls：分类绕过门控、对门控梯度做 detach，以区分空间监督与路由各自的贡献，并与直接监督 CAM 的方案对比。
Result: BCE 路由损失下，CUB-200-2011 MaxBoxAccV2 0.584 → 0.715，Stanford Dogs 0.757 → 0.832，准确率相当。ResNet-50 上分类绕过门控后大部分提升仍在，detach 门控梯度后结果几乎不变，说明增益主要来自空间监督重塑骨干；DenseNet-121 两个胸片设定中 detach 保留大部分增益，Swin-T 上则消除表观增益；直接监督 CAM 可达更强定位但准确率代价更大。
Conclusion: 空间监督可以在不优化归因图的前提下改善单独评估的 post-hoc CAM，但作用机制与收益大小取决于架构与评估设定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Optimization Landscape of Learning Compacted Context Models
papers.abstract_en: Many works approach continual learning through the lens of infinite context windows. As an agent puts more observation into context (concretely the KV cache), compacting said context is akin to direct memory manipulation, without affecting the base model's weights. Many works pose KV compaction as an optimization problem: learn a smaller set of KV vectors that matches the behavior of the full KV cache. While this preserves base model behavior, optimizing through a frozen base model results in a highly nontrivial optimization problem with a brittle and flat loss landscape. In this paper, we characterize what makes these optimization problems difficult and demonstrate that a heavily simplified Perceiver-based architecture not only matches performance of a full Perceiver transformer in continuous context compaction, but outperforms baselines on compaction utility. Results are presented on MCQ tasks across Finance, Legal, Gutenberg, and Code.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KV cache 压缩 (KV compaction) 被当作在冻结基座模型下优化一组更小 KV 向量的问题，其损失地形脆弱且平坦。作者刻画了这类问题为何难解，并展示大幅简化的 Perceiver 架构在连续上下文压缩上追平完整 Perceiver transformer，同时在压缩效用 (compaction utility) 上超过基线。
Motivation: 持续学习中把观测不断塞进上下文，压缩 KV cache 等于直接操纵记忆；但穿过冻结基座模型做优化使损失地形高度非平凡、脆弱且平坦，难以可靠求解。
Method: 把 KV 压缩形式化为优化问题：学习一组更小的 KV 向量以匹配完整 KV cache 的行为，不改动基座权重；在此框架下刻画困难来源，并对比简化版 Perceiver 架构与完整 Perceiver transformer 及其他基线。
Result: 在 Finance、Legal、Gutenberg、Code 四个领域的 MCQ 任务上，简化 Perceiver 架构在连续上下文压缩中达到与完整 Perceiver transformer 相当的性能，并在 compaction utility 上优于基线。
Conclusion: KV 压缩的难点来自冻结基座下的优化地形本身，而非模型容量：一个大幅简化的 Perceiver 结构足以匹配完整版并提升压缩效用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Mulligan: Performance-Guided Data Collection for Efficient On-Robot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning from human demonstrations is a reliable way to teach robots new tasks, but the gains from each additional demonstration shrink as the policy improves. Continued improvement can instead come from supervised deployment, where an operator places the objects and intervenes when the policy fails. We ask how to maximize improvement from a fixed budget of supervised episodes on high-precision manipulation tasks with wide ranges of object placements. We observe that failures can concentrate in a small subset of initial states, so uniform collection spends much of the operator's time on states the policy already handles. Mulligan makes the initial-state distribution a decision, starting each round's episodes at observed failures and untried states. To further improve data efficiency, we augment interactive imitation learning with a value function trained on all data, including failures that imitation discards. Across three real-world tasks evaluated on 2,550 held-out, blinded episodes and two simulated tasks, Mulligan outperforms uniform initial-state sampling at matched collection budgets, and combined with value-based action selection, HiL-IDQL+Mulligan, improves final real-task success by 10-34 percentage points. With operator interventions, the human-robot team completes 98% of collection episodes, remaining productive while the policy learns. Videos, code, and data are available at https://mulligan.page/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mulligan 把机器人数据采集的初始状态分布当成决策变量：每轮从已观测失败状态和未尝试状态起步，而非均匀采样，并用在全部数据（含模仿学习丢弃的失败）上训练的 value function 提升数据效率。在三个真实高精度操作任务的 2,550 条 held-out 盲测回合与两个仿真任务上，Mulligan 在同等采集预算下优于均匀初始状态采样；配合基于 value 的动作选择，HiL-IDQL+Mulligan 把真实任务最终成功率提高 10–34 个百分点。
Motivation: 人类演示的边际收益随策略变强而递减，而均匀初始状态采集把操作员时间浪费在策略已能处理的状态上；失败往往集中在少数初始状态子集，需要在固定监督回合预算内最大化提升。
Method: Mulligan 将初始状态分布作为决策：每轮 episode 从观测到的失败状态与未尝试状态开始，替代均匀采样；同时在交互模仿学习之上加入一个在全部数据（包括模仿学习丢弃的失败）上训练的 value function，并结合基于 value 的动作选择（HiL-IDQL+Mulligan）。
Result: 在三个真实任务的 2,550 条 held-out 盲测回合与两个仿真任务上，Mulligan 在匹配采集预算下优于均匀初始状态采样；HiL-IDQL+Mulligan 将真实任务最终成功率提高 10–34 个百分点；加入操作员干预后，人机团队完成 98% 的采集回合。
Conclusion: 在固定监督采集预算下，把初始状态定向到失败与未尝试区域并利用失败数据训练 value function，比均匀采样更高效，且策略学习过程中人机团队仍保持产出。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: fMRI-TAMCL: Text-Anchored Supervised Multimodal Contrastive Learning for fMRI-Based Brain Disorder Classification
papers.abstract_en: Resting-state fMRI is important in the classification of brain disorders, but highly multimodal and exhibits strong multisite heterogeneity. Existing methods fuse images, BOLD-based functional connectivity, and phenotypic data modalities. Unlike other medical imaging datasets, rs-fMRI datasets rarely include a text modality, so they are generated from phenotypic data or BOLD activations. These text generation methods rely on fixed assumptions for subjects, sites, devices, and protocols, leading to poor generalization across datasets. We propose fMRI-TAMCL, a text-anchored multimodal contrastive learning framework that integrates fMRI images, sparse FC, and generated subject-specific text. Its Subject-Adaptive Threshold Derivation module generates BOLD activation text, while Feature-Value Serialization module generates phenotypic text. All three modalities are encoded as clustered graphs, projected onto a shared unit hypersphere space, aligned using pairwise, text-anchored supervised contrastive learning, and fused with attention. fMRI-TAMCL proves its generalization capability across five datasets outperforming 29 baselines with 78.6%-86.4% accuracy in downstream classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: fMRI-TAMCL 用文本锚定的监督对比学习把 fMRI 图像、稀疏功能连接 (sparse FC) 与按被试生成的文本三模态对齐到共享单位超球面，再用注意力融合做脑疾病分类。在五个数据集上超过 29 个基线，下游分类准确率 78.6%–86.4%。
Motivation: rs-fMRI 多模态且多中心异质性强，而数据集几乎不含文本模态；现有从表型或 BOLD 生成文本的方法依赖对被试、站点、设备和协议的固定假设，跨数据集泛化差。
Method: Subject-Adaptive Threshold Derivation 模块从 BOLD 激活生成文本，Feature-Value Serialization 模块从表型数据生成文本；三种模态均编码为 clustered graph，投影到共享单位超球面，用成对的、文本锚定的监督对比学习 (text-anchored supervised contrastive learning) 对齐，最后经注意力融合。
Result: 在五个数据集上超过 29 个基线，下游分类准确率 78.6%–86.4%。
Conclusion: 按被试自适应生成的文本可作为跨数据集泛化的锚点，使 rs-fMRI 多模态对比学习在脑疾病分类上稳定优于既有融合方法。

papers.title: Learning to Learn a Language
papers.abstract_en: We present the Prior-Fitted Language Model (PFLM), a 300M-parameter byte-level transformer pretrained only on samples from a synthetic non-linguistic prior. Given a prefix of real text, it learns to predict the language in context with frozen weights, having never seen a word of any real language. Every training sequence is generated by a recurrent structural causal model drawn fresh from a distribution over such models. The model never sees the same language twice during training, so the only way to predict the continuation is to infer the language from the prefix. Samples from this prior share the statistical signatures of natural text: Zipfian frequencies, slow entropy-rate convergence, and long-range dependence. On Wikipedia in six languages, bits per byte fall from the uniform eight to between 0.9 and 2.4 at one million bytes of context. Given numerals instead of text, PFLM learns to count, to compare magnitudes, and to add approximately. It predicts deterministic sequences like Rudin-Shapiro or the prime indicator, and it compresses six non-text domains, from source code to speech, below gzip and PPMd. The model has not learned a language. It has learned to learn one.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables, Code: https://github.com/cbl/prior-fitted-language-model, weights: https://huggingface.co/lennartcb/pflm1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PFLM 是一个 300M 参数的 byte-level Transformer，只在由递归结构因果模型 (recurrent structural causal model) 现场采样生成的合成非语言先验上预训练，从未见过任何真实语言的词。给定真实文本前缀，它靠冻结权重从上下文推断语言并预测续写：在六种语言的 Wikipedia 上，bits per byte 从均匀的 8 降到 0.9–2.4（一百万字节上下文）。
Motivation: 语言模型通常靠海量真实语料学会统计规律，本文要问的是：能否只从一个共享自然文本统计特征（Zipf 频率、慢熵率收敛、长程依赖）的合成先验中学到「学会一门语言」的能力，而不接触任何真实语言。
Method: 训练序列由每次重新采样的递归结构因果模型生成，且模型训练中不会两次见到同一语言，迫使它只能从前缀推断语言；骨干为 300M 参数 byte-level Transformer，推理时权重冻结。评测覆盖六语言 Wikipedia、数位序列（计数、量级比较、近似加法）、Rudin-Shapiro 与质数指示等确定性序列，以及源代码到语音等六个非文本域的压缩。
Result: 六语言 Wikipedia 上 bits per byte 由均匀基线 8 降至 0.9–2.4（上下文 1,000,000 字节）；给定数位时模型学会计数、比较量级与近似加法；能预测 Rudin-Shapiro 与质数指示等确定性序列；在源代码到语音共六个非文本域上压缩率低于 gzip 与 PPMd。
Conclusion: 作者的结论是：模型学到的不是某一种语言，而是从上下文推断并掌握一门新语言的能力，且这种能力可迁移到数位与非文本域的压缩。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OGAM: Connecting Systematic Testing to Runtime Assurance through Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring for VLA Policies
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks expose vision-language-action (VLA) policies to few canonical instructions, while exhaustive deployment testing is impossible. We introduce Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring (OGAM), connecting systematic testing to runtime assurance: testing reveals attention divergence between successful and failed executions, and OGAM uses this signal to stop failures beyond the finite suite. We generate scene-grounded instructions through pairwise combinations of action templates and objects, and separately test meaning-preserving paraphrases. All 87 out-of-benchmark cases reveal problematic behavior across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, UniVLA, and $π_{0.5}$: none completes any of the 24 feasible instructions, while infeasible or hazardous requests also trigger behavior substitution. At each action query, we project gradient-weighted visual attention through object masks and group it by instruction role for comparison across tasks and policies. Dynamic time warping aligns this course with a successful reference despite speed differences; conformal calibration on successful episodes sets the early-stopping threshold for sustained deviations, with a nominal false-stop target of $α=0.05$. Across four policies, OGAM stops 87-100% of failed episodes at median times of 5-12s within a 20s budget, with observed false-stop rates of 3-5%, without failure-labeled training. Finite testing thus identifies attention patterns that support online intervention before failure fully unfolds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OGAM 把 VLA 策略的系统化测试接到运行时保障：用成功与失败执行之间的注意力分歧作为信号，在失败完全展开前触发停机。在 OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、UniVLA 与 π0.5 上，87 个超出基准的案例全部暴露问题行为（24 条可行指令无一完成），OGAM 在 20 秒预算内停掉 87–100% 的失败回合，中位停机时间 5–12 秒，观测误停率 3–5%（名义目标 α=0.05），且无需失败标注训练。
Motivation: VLA 策略的基准只覆盖少数规范指令，穷尽式部署测试不可行，超出有限测试套件的失败无法在运行时被拦截。
Method: 由动作模板与物体的成对组合生成场景接地指令，并单独测试保持语义的改写；在每个 action query 处把梯度加权视觉注意力经物体掩码投影，按指令角色分组以跨任务跨策略比较；用 dynamic time warping (DTW) 将该注意力序列与成功参考对齐以容忍速度差异，再在成功回合上做 conformal calibration 设定持续偏离的早停阈值。
Result: 全部 87 个 out-of-benchmark 案例在四个策略上均暴露问题行为，无一完成 24 条可行指令，不可行或危险请求也触发行为替换；OGAM 在四个策略上停掉 87–100% 的失败回合，20 秒预算内中位停机时间 5–12 秒，观测误停率 3–5%（名义 false-stop 目标 α=0.05），无需失败标注训练。
Conclusion: 有限测试识别出的注意力模式足以支撑在线干预：以成功参考为基准的注意力偏离可在失败完全展开前触发停机，把系统化测试与 runtime assurance 连起来。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.conclusion: 有限测试识别出的注意力模式足以支撑在线干预：以成功参考为基准的注意力偏离可在失败完全展开前触发停机，把系统化测试与 runtime assurance 连起来。

papers.title: Global Communication or Graph-Specific Memory?
papers.abstract_en: Scalable Graph Transformers are commonly trained and evaluated on static large graphs in a transductive setup. Many scalable Graph Transformer components can be formulated as a constant-size shared memory, similar to virtual nodes, providing compressed information about the whole graph. The counterpart of these models in language models and other domains is justified as the input changes, and this mechanism learns to compress some useful information about the input. In transductive learning on a single fixed graph, however, any shared memory can be seen as a constant at test time. This raises the question of what exactly this shared memory does in this static setup. We give preliminary evidence that optimizing a shared memory directly performs similarly to global communication methods, and so normal local message-passing models can embed similar information in their weights. Thus, these settings may be a poor fit for evaluating global communication in graph neural networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在静态大图的 transductive 设定下，Graph Transformer 里的共享记忆（等价于常数大小的 virtual node 式全局通信）在测试时是常量，因此其作用可疑。作者给出初步证据：直接优化这个共享记忆与显式全局通信方法表现相当，普通局部 message-passing 模型也能把同等信息编码进权重，说明这类静态设定不适合用来评估图神经网络的全局通信能力。
Motivation: 可扩展 Graph Transformer 的组件常被写成常数大小共享记忆并以全局通信之名解释，但在单张固定图的 transductive 学习中该记忆在测试时退化为常量，其真实作用与评估有效性存疑。
Method: 把多种可扩展 Graph Transformer 组件统一表述为常数大小共享记忆（类似 virtual node），与语言模型中随输入变化的对应机制对比；在静态固定图设定下直接优化该共享记忆，与显式全局通信方法及局部 message-passing 模型对照，作为初步证据检验其作用。
Result: 初步证据显示：直接优化共享记忆与全局通信方法表现相似，且普通局部 message-passing 模型能在权重中嵌入相似信息；摘要未给出具体数据集、指标或数值对比。
Conclusion: 静态大图的 transductive 设定可能是评估图神经网络全局通信的不良场景，因为共享记忆在测试时是常量，其收益可由权重本身承载。

papers.title: Off-Policy Merging Beats On-Policy Self-Distillation for Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: A long-standing goal of AI is a model that can continually learn and improve itself. On post-trained models, supervised finetuning (SFT) on new data often causes poor generalization and catastrophic forgetting. As such, the conventional wisdom is that on-policy training is a prerequisite for continual learning. In practice, however, data containing new knowledge or capabilities are often off-policy. While methods such as on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) try to bridge this gap by converting off-policy data into on-policy signal, they have been shown to cause reasoning collapse. In this paper, we show that off-policy merging beats OPSD for continual learning. We first show that SFT learns a useful signal from new data, but naively applying its update interferes with existing capabilities. We reduce this interference with a simple recipe we term grafting, which changes where the update is learned and how it is applied: (1) learning the update on an earlier donor checkpoint, ideally even before the end of pretraining, and applying the weight update to the post-trained model; (2) scaling the weight update, equivalent to a form of model merging; and (3) optionally, masking the most sensitive update directions when the new data distribution is far from the post-trained model. Across continual learning settings including (1) distilling from expert traces, (2) self-improvement with STaR and Pedagogical RL, and (3) injecting knowledge after pretraining cutoff, grafting Pareto-dominates both SFT and OPSD in new-task and old-task performance, while avoiding expensive on-policy sampling. Therefore, our work challenges on-policy training as a necessity for continual learning on RL-trained models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张在 RL 后训练模型的持续学习中，off-policy 权重合并（grafting）优于 on-policy 自蒸馏 (OPSD)：在更早的 donor checkpoint 上学新数据的更新、把更新加到后训练模型上并缩放，必要时屏蔽最敏感的更新方向，即可在新任务与旧任务上同时 Pareto 优于 SFT 与 OPSD，且避开昂贵的 on-policy 采样。
Motivation: 对后训练模型做 SFT 会损害泛化并造成灾难性遗忘，业界因此把 on-policy 训练当作持续学习的前提；但携带新知识的数据往往是 off-policy 的，而把 off-policy 数据转成 on-policy 信号的 OPSD 已被证明会导致 reasoning collapse。
Method: 提出 grafting 三步配方：(1) 在更早的 donor checkpoint（理想上早于预训练结束）上学新数据的更新，再把权重更新应用到后训练模型；(2) 对权重更新做缩放，等价于一种 model merging；(3) 当新数据分布远离后训练模型时，可选地屏蔽最敏感的更新方向。
Result: 在三类持续学习设置上——从专家轨迹蒸馏、用 STaR 与 Pedagogical RL 做 self-improvement、以及在预训练截止点之后注入知识——grafting 在新任务与旧任务性能上同时 Pareto 优于 SFT 和 OPSD，并避免了昂贵的 on-policy 采样。
Conclusion: on-policy 训练并非 RL 训练模型上持续学习的必要条件：SFT 从新数据学到的信号本身有用，问题出在其更新与既有能力的干涉，改更新的学习位置与施加方式即可消除这种干涉。

papers.title: Certification of Real Images through Calibrated Content Authentication
papers.abstract_en: Generative models can synthesize high-quality inauthentic multimedia content that is already being misused at scale. We evaluate twenty deepfake detectors against ten generators released in the last four years and find accuracy decreasing over time, from near-perfect 99.5% to 76%. Adversarial perturbations further reduce every baseline detector to below 2% accuracy, effectively inverting the detector's assigned label. We argue that this unreliability reflects a fundamental ambiguity: generators can reproduce authentic content exactly (e.g., through memorization), so content alone cannot reveal the true provenance label.For this reason, content produced by a generator must admit a faithful reconstruction by that same generator, and finding such a reconstruction makes synthetic provenance plausible and authenticity plausibly deniable.We therefore propose and evaluate a detection paradigm that outputs a calibrated prediction of whether authenticity is plausibly deniable: a faithful reconstruction by any known generator establishes plausible deniability, while calibration bounds how often content from known generators fails to be reproduced. Our evaluation shows that (i) our detector can be calibrated so that at most 1% of generated content is wrongly certified, an operating point at which most baseline detectors reach near-zero recall, including the strongest with 93% accuracy; (ii) calibrating a stricter security threshold on attacked samples preserves this bound against adaptive adversaries within the evaluated bounded-perturbation attack space, whose perturbations break every baseline, but does not cover arbitrary adversarial transformations; and (iii) post-hoc verifiability is eroding, as 1,116 of 3,000 Reddit images resist reproduction by a 2022 generator, but only 55 to 79 resist reproduction by 2024 generators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于校准内容认证的深伪检测范式：若某已知生成器能忠实重建该内容，则其合成来源可推定、真实性可推定否认。校准后最多 1% 的生成内容被错误认证，而多数基线在此工作点召回近零；对抗扰动把所有基线压到 2% 以下。
Motivation: 二十个深伪检测器在近四年十个生成器上准确率从 99.5% 降到 76%，对抗扰动进一步把每个基线压到 2% 以下，说明仅凭内容无法判定真实来源。
Method: 评测二十个深伪检测器对十个近四年生成器；提出输出校准预测的检测范式，以任一已知生成器的忠实重建作为 plausible deniability 证据，并在校准中约束已知生成器内容无法被重建的比例；在有界扰动攻击样本上校准更严的安全阈值。
Result: 基线准确率随时间从 99.5% 降至 76%；对抗扰动使全部基线低于 2%；本方法可校准到至多 1% 生成内容被错误认证，此时多数基线召回近零，最强基线准确率 93%；在评估的有界扰动攻击空间内该界对自适应对手保持，但不覆盖任意对抗变换；3,000 张 Reddit 图片中 1,116 张抵抗 2022 年生成器的重建，而 2024 年生成器仅 55 到 79 张抵抗。
Conclusion: 内容本身无法给出真实来源，检测应改为校准的 plausible deniability 判定；后验可验证性正在被更强生成器侵蚀，且该保证不覆盖任意对抗变换。

papers.title: Finite-Sample Distribution Theory and Efficient Large-Scale Inference for Online Quantile Regression
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies online quantile regression for large-scale and streaming data using Stochastic SubGradient Descent (SSGD) with constant learning rates. Classical offline inference for quantile regression is computationally and memory intensive. Existing works of online inference for quantile regression provide only asymptotic guarantees and typically require sub-exponential tail conditions for distribution theory. To bridge these gaps, we introduce new techniques to prove a quenched central limit theorem (CLT) and finite-sample Gaussian approximation for SSGD under a finite-moment assumption. We further show that Ruppert-Polyak averaging with a constant learning rate has a non-vanishing bias and fails to satisfy CLT centering at the population target. Hence we propose suffix averaging to address this issue and establish its finite-sample Gaussian approximation. Based on these results, we provide an efficient online inference method for quantile regression that avoids covariance estimation. Numerical experiments show that our method achieves desirable empirical coverage rates and competitive performance compared to other inference methods. We also apply our approach to U.S. wage data to demonstrate its practical effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对大规模流式数据的在线分位数回归，用常数学习率的随机次梯度下降 (SSGD) 在有限矩条件下证明 quenched CLT 与有限样本高斯近似；并指出 Ruppert-Polyak 平均在常数学习率下偏差不消失、无法以总体目标为中心满足 CLT，改用 suffix averaging 后建立其有限样本高斯近似，得到免协方差估计的在线推断方法。
Motivation: 经典离线分位数回归推断计算与内存开销大，已有在线推断工作只给渐近保证，且分布理论通常要求次指数尾条件。
Method: 用常数学习率 SSGD 训练分位数回归，在有限矩假设下证明 quenched CLT 与有限样本高斯近似；分析 Ruppert-Polyak 平均的偏差，提出 suffix averaging 并建立其有限样本高斯近似，据此构造无需协方差估计的在线推断方法。
Result: 数值实验显示该方法取得理想的经验覆盖率 (empirical coverage rates)，与其他推断方法相比表现有竞争力；并在美国工资数据 (U.S. wage data) 上验证实际有效性。
Conclusion: 常数学习率下 Ruppert-Polyak 平均不适合以总体目标为中心的 CLT，suffix averaging 配合有限样本高斯近似可给出高效且免协方差估计的在线分位数回归推断。

papers.title: Weave Mamba Fusion: Global Cross-Scale Interaction for Lightweight Face Detection
papers.abstract_en: Feature pyramid methods, from FPN to BiFPN, have achieved strong performance in face detection by fusing multi-scale features. However, detecting faces under unconstrained conditions, such as small scale, occlusion, and extreme pose, remains difficult, as it requires global cross-scale dependencies that local fusion cannot model. State space models such as Mamba provide global context with linear complexity by scanning features as a sequence, and therefore offer a promising direction for this problem. Nevertheless, such a scan needs the two pyramid scales combined into a single feature map, and the way they are combined determines whether cross-scale structure is preserved. Summation collapses the two scales before the scan, so the scan has no cross-scale structure to exploit, while concatenation keeps both scales but at far higher cost. To address this, we propose \textbf{Weave Mamba Fusion (WMF)}, which interleaves two adjacent pyramid scales column by column so that each step of a horizontal bidirectional SS2D scan moves from one scale to the other. With partial-channel processing and parameter-free de-weaving, WMF enables efficient cross-scale interaction while preserving feature structure. Integrating WMF into every fusion node yields \textbf{WeaveBiFPN}, the neck of our \textbf{WeaveFace} detector. On WIDER FACE, WeaveFace achieves 91.41\% mean AP with only 0.34M parameters and 1.16 GFLOPs, outperforming prior detectors under 0.5M parameters. Its largest gains are on the Hard subset, where it reaches 87.14\% AP. The code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/dohun-mat/WeaveMambaFusion}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 人脸检测中的跨尺度融合要么用求和把两尺度压扁、要么用拼接代价过高，Weave Mamba Fusion (WMF) 把相邻两个金字塔尺度按列交错，使 SS2D 双向扫描每步都在两尺度间切换，配合 partial-channel processing 与无参数 de-weaving 保住特征结构。集成后得到 WeaveBiFPN 颈部与 WeaveFace 检测器，在 WIDER FACE 上以 0.34M 参数、1.16 GFLOPs 取得 91.41% mean AP，超过 0.5M 参数以下的既有检测器，Hard 子集 87.14% AP。
Motivation: FPN 到 BiFPN 的多尺度融合只能建模局部跨尺度关系，小尺度、遮挡、极端姿态下需要全局跨尺度依赖；而 Mamba 扫描前必须把两尺度合成一张图，求和会先抹掉跨尺度结构，拼接代价又过高。
Method: WMF 将相邻两个金字塔尺度逐列交错，使水平双向 SS2D 扫描每步从一个尺度移到另一个尺度；用 partial-channel processing 与参数无关的 de-weaving 控制开销并还原特征。把 WMF 放进每个融合节点构成 WeaveBiFPN，作为 WeaveFace 检测器的颈部。
Result: 在 WIDER FACE 上，WeaveFace 取得 91.41% mean AP，参数量 0.34M、计算量 1.16 GFLOPs，优于 0.5M 参数以下的既有检测器；Hard 子集 AP 达 87.14%，是其最大提升所在。
Conclusion: 逐列交错的扫描顺序能在轻量预算内保留并利用跨尺度结构，使 0.5M 参数以下的人脸检测器在困难样本上明显受益；代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 人脸检测中的跨尺度融合要么用求和把两尺度压扁、要么用拼接代价过高，Weave Mamba Fusion (WMF) 把相邻两个金字塔尺度按列交错，使 SS2D 双向扫描每步都在两尺度间切换，配合 partial-channel processing 与无参数 de-weaving 保住特征结构。集成后得到 WeaveBiFPN 颈部与 WeaveFace 检测器，在 WIDER FACE 上以 0.34M 参数、1.16 GFLOPs 取得 91.41% mean AP，超过 0.5M 参数以下的既有检测器，Hard 子集 87.14% AP。
summary_sections.motivation: FPN 到 BiFPN 的多尺度融合只能建模局部跨尺度关系，小尺度、遮挡、极端姿态下需要全局跨尺度依赖；而 Mamba 扫描前必须把两尺度合成一张图，求和会先抹掉跨尺度结构，拼接代价又过高。
summary_sections.method: WMF 将相邻两个金字塔尺度逐列交错，使水平双向 SS2D 扫描每步从一个尺度移到另一个尺度；用 partial-channel processing 与参数无关的 de-weaving 控制开销并还原特征。把 WMF 放进每个融合节点构成 WeaveBiFPN，作为 WeaveFace 检测器的颈部。

papers.title: CCQ: A Multi-State Child Care Quality Dataset to Support AI for Children's Health Research
papers.abstract_en: High-quality child care in early life is a critical determinant of children's growth and development. Research on child care quality has been constrained by fragmented, non-research-friendly, and privacy-bound datasets. We present CCQ (Child Care Quality), a large-scale, de-identified dataset for applied data science research at the intersection of AI and early childhood health. CCQ integrates 59,372 child care provider records across 12 U.S. states, covering diverse provider types as well as data schemas. To ensure research utility while protecting privacy, we implement an automated, LLM-based curation pipeline that anonymizes, cleans, and standardizes raw state records into two complementary releases: a cleaned textual release and a fully preprocessed tabular release. We also benchmark traditional machine learning models, tabular foundation models, and language models on quality rating prediction and important features analytics. Within a state, tabular classifiers on the preprocessed tables perform best. Across states, zero-shot transfer is near chance, but modest target-state supervision recovers most of the within-state performance, and pretraining on other states benefits finetuned language models. We release both datasets with all code to accelerate AI-driven research on child care quality and ultimately improve children's health and development.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/GAIN-Lab/CCQ ; Code: https://github.com/Veeeeeee7/CCQ
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CCQ 是覆盖美国 12 个州、59,372 条托幼机构记录的去标识化数据集，用 LLM 自动清洗管线把各州异构原始记录统一成文本版与表格版两个发布。州内质量评级预测中表格分类器在预处理表上表现最好；跨州零样本迁移接近随机水平，但加入少量目标州监督即可恢复大部分州内性能，且在其他州预训练能提升微调后的语言模型。
Motivation: 儿童照护质量研究长期受数据分散、非研究友好且受隐私限制约束，缺少可直接用于 AI 与儿童健康交叉研究的大规模数据集。
Method: 构建 LLM 驱动的自动清洗管线，对原始州级记录做匿名化、清洗与标准化，产出 cleaned textual release 与 fully preprocessed tabular release 两个互补版本；并用传统机器学习模型、表格基础模型 (tabular foundation models) 与语言模型在质量评级预测和重要特征分析上做 benchmark。
Result: 数据集含 59,372 条托幼机构记录，覆盖 12 个美国州与多种机构类型及数据 schema。州内预测中基于预处理表的表格分类器最佳；跨州零样本迁移接近随机水平，少量目标州监督可恢复大部分州内性能，其他州上的预训练有利于微调后的语言模型。
Conclusion: 跨州 schema 与分布差异使零样本迁移失效，但少量目标州标注加跨州预训练即可基本补齐性能，说明统一清洗后的多州表格数据配合轻量本地监督是可行路径。

papers.title: Imagine to Act: High-Fidelity Data Synthesis via Image Editing World Model for Scalable GUI Agent Training
papers.abstract_en: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for automating complex digital workflows across diverse applications. However, training highly capable and generalizable agents fundamentally relies on massive, high-fidelity visual-action trajectories, which are notoriously difficult to acquire. While human demonstrations are unscalable, existing GUI world models rely on text descriptions or HTML rendering, discarding crucial pixel-level visual details like icons and layout styles. To address this issue, we introduce Infinite-Dreamer, a simulation-free data synthesis method powered by a pixel-level Image Editing World Model. By conceptualizing GUI transitions as image editing tasks, we leverage Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to describe action-induced UI changes as structured delta-text. We then fine-tune an image editing backbone to controllably synthesize realistic screenshot transitions. We utilize this model to generate both single-frame visual robustness data and multi-step imaginary trajectories. To validate the effectiveness of our approach, we fine-tune the Qwen3-VL baseline solely on the synthesized data to obtain Infinite-Actor, and evaluate it on AndroidWorld, MobileWorld, and AndroidControl-Curated benchmarks. Infinite-Actor consistently outperforms the Qwen3-VL baselines across scales: Infinite-Actor-8B improves AndroidWorld Pass@1 by +4.45 and nearly doubles the MobileWorld Pass@3 success rate, while Infinite-Actor-2B improves Pass@1 by +9.05. Code is available at https://github.com/swaydy-n/Infinite-Dreamer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Infinite-Dreamer：把 GUI 状态转移当作图像编辑任务，用像素级 Image Editing World Model 合成高保真截图转移与多步想象轨迹，免去仿真环境。仅用合成数据微调 Qwen3-VL 得到 Infinite-Actor，在 AndroidWorld 上 8B 版 Pass@1 提升 +4.45、2B 版 +9.05，MobileWorld Pass@3 成功率接近翻倍。
Motivation: 训练强泛化 GUI agent 需要海量高保真视觉-动作轨迹，人工演示不可扩展；现有 GUI world model 依赖文本描述或 HTML 渲染，丢掉图标、布局样式等像素级细节。
Method: 把 GUI 转移建模为图像编辑任务：先用 Vision-Language Model (VLM) 把动作引起的界面变化写成结构化 delta-text，再微调图像编辑骨干按该文本可控生成真实截图转移；用它产出单帧视觉鲁棒性数据与多步想象轨迹，最后只用合成数据微调 Qwen3-VL 基线得到 Infinite-Actor。
Result: 在 AndroidWorld、MobileWorld、AndroidControl-Curated 上评测：Infinite-Actor-8B 使 AndroidWorld Pass@1 提升 +4.45，MobileWorld Pass@3 成功率接近翻倍；Infinite-Actor-2B 使 Pass@1 提升 +9.05，各规模均稳定超过 Qwen3-VL 基线。
Conclusion: 像素级图像编辑世界模型可以替代仿真环境合成 GUI 训练数据，且仅靠合成数据微调即可在多个 GUI agent 基准上稳定超过原始 Qwen3-VL 基线。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Curriculum Brain: Constructing Curriculum Knowledge Graphs as a Substrate for Cognitive Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Cognitive Diagnostic Models (CDMs) identify which specific skills a student has and has not mastered, the signal a personalized learning path needs and a single aggregate score cannot give. Yet they are rarely deployed. The obstacle is their precondition: the Q-matrix, a mapping from every assessment item to the skills it requires, historically authored by hand. We separate the task into two stages: first construct the curriculum's own knowledge graph, the full space of concepts and skills it contains, independent of any item; then map items against that graph on demand. This paper addresses the first stage only. The item-mapping stage is designed but not implemented here, so the claim that this shifts judgment cost from once per item to once per curriculum is a design rationale rather than a finding. We present Curriculum Brain, a two-repository system pairing a version-controlled knowledge base with an agentic pipeline of eleven single-responsibility agents under a thin deterministic orchestrator. It generates candidate concept-skill mappings from official curriculum documents, checks them against accumulated rules, and compares them with a concept-skill map extracted independently from the textbook, repairing its own failures and escalating to a human only when it cannot resolve a case itself. Across 241 chapter runs (168 distinct chapters), 41.5% produced a Generator output passing both checks without a patch, and 67.6% resolved without escalation. Both are measured against criteria the system itself produced, so both describe internal consistency rather than agreement with an external standard, and both pool two pipeline configurations separated by a single change at run 77; after it the figures are 57.0% and 91.5%. Observed spend was $1.19 per chapter, API spend only, excluding human review. We release both the framework and the resulting curriculum dataset.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Code: https://github.com/MaximusTitan/q-matrix-agents and https://github.com/MaximusTitan/q-matrix-kb-template. Dataset: https://github.com/MaximusTitan/q-matrix-dataset
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Curriculum Brain 把 Q-matrix 构建拆成两阶段，只实现第一阶段：用 11 个单一职责 agent 在薄确定性 orchestrator 下从官方课程文档生成概念-技能映射，与规则库和独立从教材抽取的 concept-skill map 对照，自行修复、无法解决才升级人工。241 次章节运行（168 个不同章节）中 41.5% 的 Generator 输出免补丁通过双重检查、67.6% 无需升级即解决；第 77 次运行后单一改动使两值升到 57.0% 与 91.5%，每章节 API 花费 $1.19。
Motivation: 认知诊断模型 (CDM) 能给出学生逐技能掌握情况，但依赖人工逐题编写的 Q-matrix，部署率极低；作者把成本瓶颈从逐题判断转移到按课程一次性构建知识图谱。
Method: 双仓库系统：版本控制知识库 + 由薄确定性 orchestrator 调度的 11 个单一职责 agent 流水线。Generator 从官方课程文档生成候选概念-技能映射，先对照累积规则校验，再与独立从教材抽取的 concept-skill map 比对，自行修补失败，仅在无法解决时升级人工；题目映射阶段只设计未实现。
Result: 241 次章节运行（168 个不同章节）中 41.5% 的 Generator 输出免补丁通过双重检查，67.6% 无需升级即解决；第 77 次运行处单一改动后两值分别为 57.0% 与 91.5%。观测花费为每章节 $1.19（仅 API，不含人工复核）。两项比例均以系统自产标准衡量，反映内部一致性而非与外部标准的吻合。
Conclusion: 作者主张把判断成本从逐题一次降到按课程一次，但明确说明这是设计理由而非发现，因为题目映射阶段尚未实现；已释放框架与课程数据集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Sequentially Semiseparable Structure of SDE-Induced Kernels and Efficient Algorithms for Kernel-Based Estimation Problems
papers.abstract_en: We study kernel functions induced by a linear time-invariant (LTI) stochastic differential equation (SDE), an approach that embeds prior knowledge about the function to be estimated directly into the state-space description of the SDE. This kernel-design perspective is relevant across the many settings where kernels play a central role, including kernel methods in statistics, Gaussian process (GP) regression in machine learning, and kernel-based regularization methods in system identification. The resulting class of SDE-induced kernels includes several kernels of practical interest, such as Matérn kernels with half-integer smoothness, spline kernels, and related kernels used in system identification. In contrast to existing linear-time GP regression methods for these kernels, which are typically based on Kalman filtering and Rauch--Tung--Striebel smoothing on the latent state, we work directly with the SSS representation of the observed covariance matrix. This yields linear-complexity recursive algorithms for the matrix operations required in GP regression, including factorization, linear solves, log determinants, posterior covariance, log-marginal-likelihood gradients, and posterior sampling; the same generator-level recursions extend, with only minor modifications, to the analogous computations in kernel-based regularization methods for system identification. Compared with previous uses of SSS representations in GP regression, we derive efficient recursive algorithms for analytic marginal-likelihood gradients in three application-relevant cases, and we develop new recursions for posterior computations and Matheron-type sampling. Numerical experiments verify the accuracy of the proposed recursions and illustrate posterior inference and sampling for representative SDE-induced kernels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LTI SDE 诱导的核（含半整数光滑度 Matérn、样条核）直接写成观测协方差矩阵的 sequentially semiseparable (SSS) 表示，给出线性复杂度的 GP 回归递推算法，覆盖分解、线性求解、对数行列式、后验协方差、边缘似然梯度与后验采样。数值实验验证了这些递推的精度，并展示了代表性 SDE 诱导核上的后验推断与采样。
Motivation: 这类核的线性时间 GP 回归通常依赖对隐状态做 Kalman 滤波与 Rauch–Tung–Striebel 平滑，且解析边缘似然梯度、后验计算与 Matheron 型采样缺少高效递推。
Method: 不走隐状态滤波，直接对观测协方差矩阵建立 SSS 表示，推导 GP 回归所需矩阵运算的线性复杂度递推；同一生成元级递推经小幅修改可迁移到系统辨识的核正则化方法。相对已有 SSS 用法，新推导了三种应用相关情形的解析边缘似然梯度递推，以及后验计算与 Matheron 型采样递推。
Result: 数值实验验证了所提递推的精度，并在代表性 SDE 诱导核（半整数光滑度 Matérn、样条核及相关系统辨识核）上演示后验推断与采样；摘要给出的是算法构造与实验验证这一性质结论，未列具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把 SSS 表示放在观测协方差层面而非隐状态层面，即可为 SDE 诱导核的 GP 回归与核正则化系统辨识提供统一的线性复杂度递推，包括梯度与采样。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.conclusion: 把 SSS 表示放在观测协方差层面而非隐状态层面，即可为 SDE 诱导核的 GP 回归与核正则化系统辨识提供统一的线性复杂度递推，包括梯度与采样。

papers.title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Collision-Free Locomotion of an Underactuated Biped
papers.abstract_en: A bipedal robot cannot deviate from its path to avoid an obstacle without disturbing its balance, and this coupling is most severe on underactuated platforms such as the biped considered here, which has four actuated joints per leg and no hip or ankle roll. This paper presents a Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) framework in which a High-Level (HL) policy observes the robot pose, 36 raycast proximity measurements, moving-obstacle states, and a receding-horizon local goal, and outputs a body-velocity command $(v_x, v_y, ω_{yaw})$ every ten control steps, while a velocity-conditioned Low-Level (LL) policy tracks each command through PD-controlled joint targets. Both policies are trained jointly with Soft Actor-Critic (SAC). Because the converged gait is task-agnostic, it is frozen and driven by classical planners over the same command interface, yielding three controlled baselines: SAC+A*, SAC+RRT*, and SAC+APF. Across 100 evaluation trials per method in randomized PyBullet environments, the proposed method reaches the goal in 98.0% of static and 88.0% of dynamic trials, against at most 78.0% and 68.0% for the planner hybrids, with path lengths within 4% of the A* reference, and ablations confirm that each observation channel and reward term contributes materially to this performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对欠驱动双足（每腿 4 个驱动关节、无髋/踝侧倾）避障时偏航与平衡强耦合的问题，提出分层强化学习 (HRL)：高层策略每 10 个控制步输出体速度指令 (vx, vy, ωyaw)，低层速度条件策略经 PD 关节目标跟踪指令，两层用 SAC 联合训练。在随机 PyBullet 环境每方法 100 次试验中，静态障碍到达率 98.0%、动态 88.0%，而冻结步态接经典规划器的基线至多 78.0% 与 68.0%。
Motivation: 欠驱动双足无法在不扰动平衡的前提下偏离路径避障，转向与平衡耦合最严重；需要在保持稳定步态的同时完成避障导航。
Method: HRL 框架：高层观测机器人位姿、36 条 raycast 接近度测量、动态障碍状态与 receding-horizon 局部目标，每 10 个控制步输出 (vx, vy, ωyaw)；速度条件低层策略通过 PD 控制的关节目标跟踪该指令。两层用 Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) 联合训练，收敛后冻结步态并经同一指令接口由经典规划器驱动，构成 SAC+A*、SAC+RRT*、SAC+APF 三个受控基线。
Result: 随机 PyBullet 环境每方法 100 次评估试验：所提方法静态障碍到达率 98.0%、动态障碍 88.0%，规划器混合基线至多 78.0% 与 68.0%；路径长度在 A* 参考的 4% 以内。消融显示每个观测通道与奖励项都对该性能有实质贡献。
Conclusion: 分层 RL 学到的步态是任务无关的，可冻结后由经典规划器驱动同一指令接口；联合训练的高层避障策略在欠驱动双足上显著高于规划器混合方案，且路径接近 A* 最优。

papers.title: TurboPairFormer: Fast and Stable Protein Folding Model Training with an Optimized Triangle Attention Kernel
papers.abstract_en: Triangular attention is a core computation in AlphaFold3-style biomolecular models, with cubic cost in token count. Its shared pair bias adds a gradient reduction across attention slices to the usual reductions over queries and keys. The open-source backends we examine handle these reductions through repeated probability recomputation, floating-point atomics, or full score-gradient storage. Separately, computing the softmax backward correction from BF16-rounded forward outputs loses numerical precision. We present TurboPairFormer, a triangular attention implementation for NVIDIA Hopper GPUs that addresses both issues. Our key-tile-parallel backward algorithm recomputes each probability tile once for the query, key, value, and pair-bias gradients, using ordered partial reductions for deterministic accumulation without floating-point atomics or full score-gradient storage. Output-residual compensation retains a BF16 approximation of the output-rounding residual to compute the backward correction more accurately in FP32, without changing the BF16 output. With BF16 inputs at crop sizes 384, 640, and 768 and head dimensions 16 and 32, TurboPairFormer achieves the lowest mean query, key, and pair-bias gradient RMSE against an FP64 reference among the implementations compared in this paper. Residual compensation reduces these RMSE values by 28-47% in controlled ablations. All four gradients are bitwise identical across five repeated calls in all 600 input cases under fixed execution conditions. Integrated into OpenFold3 with our triangle multiplication kernels, TurboPairFormer achieves the lowest GPU computation time per optimizer step among the evaluated backend configurations on 16 H100 GPUs, with speedups of $1.73\times$ over OpenFold3's Triton backend and $1.13\times$ over cuEquivariance at crop size 768.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TurboPairFormer 是面向 NVIDIA Hopper 的三角注意力 (triangle attention) 内核，用 key-tile 并行反向算法把每个概率 tile 只重算一次并做有序部分归约，配合输出残差补偿在 FP32 中更准地算 BF16 反向修正。在 crop 384/640/768、head dim 16/32 下取得对比实现中最低的 query/key/pair-bias 梯度 RMSE（对 FP64 参考），残差补偿使 RMSE 再降 28–47%，600 组输入五次调用梯度逐位一致；接入 OpenFold3 后 16 张 H100 上每优化步 GPU 计算时间相对 Triton 后端加速 1.73×、相对 cuEquivariance 加速 1.13×（crop 768）。
Motivation: AlphaFold3 式模型的三角注意力代价随 token 数三次方增长，其 pair bias 在注意力切片间引入额外梯度归约；现有开源后端靠重复重算概率、浮点 atomics 或整份 score-gradient 存储来处理，且从 BF16 前向输出算 softmax 反向修正会损失数值精度。
Method: key-tile 并行反向算法对 query、key、value、pair-bias 梯度只重算一次概率 tile，用有序部分归约实现确定性累加，既不用浮点 atomics 也不存整份 score-gradient；输出残差补偿 (output-residual compensation) 保留 BF16 输出舍入残差的近似，用 FP32 计算反向修正而不改动 BF16 输出；再与自研 triangle multiplication 内核一起集成进 OpenFold3。
Result: 在 BF16 输入、crop 尺寸 384/640/768、head 维度 16 和 32 下，query、key、pair-bias 梯度对 FP64 参考的平均 RMSE 在所比较实现中最低；受控消融中残差补偿把这些 RMSE 降低 28–47%；固定执行条件下 600 组输入、五次重复调用中全部四个梯度逐位一致；16 张 H100 上每优化步 GPU 计算时间相对 OpenFold3 的 Triton 后端加速 1.73×、相对 cuEquivariance 加速 1.13×（crop 768）。
Conclusion: 三角注意力的反向传播可以在不依赖浮点 atomics 与整份 score-gradient 存储的前提下做到确定性且更精确，同时把 AlphaFold3 式训练的每步 GPU 时间显著压低。

papers.title: The Blind Spot Paradox: When Adaptive Classifiers Defeat Drift Detectors
papers.abstract_en: Monitoring concept drift from an adaptive classifier's error stream creates an operational conflict with the model's own update loop. When internal adaptation outpaces evidence accumulation, accuracy recovers before cumulative detectors (CUSUM, Page-Hinkley) can reach threshold. Instrumenting an Adaptive Random Forest (ARF) shows that surviving trees absorb 98.6% of the post-drift error transient through incremental leaf updates alone. The first background tree swap accounts for just 0.71% of this erased error volume, but drops external detection rates by 31 percentage points. We derive the finite-horizon boundary where cumulative evidence fails to cross threshold and measure a critical magnitude floor ($Δe_c = 0.120$) below which false-alarm budgets preclude detection. This failure manifests as missed shifts on stationary streams and false-alarm flooding triggered by internal tree swaps on noisy baselines. We validate on synthetic shifts, ARMA-GARCH series (ProteuS), and tabular benchmarks (BAF, INSECTS); on the synthetic sweep at a standard threshold, the blind spot appears at $Δe \approx 0.25$, showing why classical benchmarks like SEA ($Δe \le 0.21$) failed to reach it.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE ICDM 2026 Workshops (OWAD 2026). 10 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Code: https://github.com/TheBlindSpotParadox/TheBlindSpotParadox-Experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自适应分类器的内部更新会先于累积检测器吸收漂移误差，使 CUSUM、Page-Hinkley 失效：ARF 中存活树仅靠增量叶更新就吸收了漂移后误差瞬态的 98.6%，首次后台树替换只占被抹掉误差量的 0.71%，却让外部检测率下降 31 个百分点。作者推导出累积证据无法越阈的有限时域边界，并测得临界幅度下限 Δe_c = 0.120；在标准阈值的合成扫描中盲区出现在 Δe ≈ 0.25，说明 SEA（Δe ≤ 0.21）这类经典基准为何触发不到。
Motivation: 从自适应分类器的误差流做概念漂移监控时，模型自身的更新回路与检测器竞争：内部适应快于证据累积，准确率在检测器越阈之前就已恢复，导致漏检与误报两难。
Method: 对 Adaptive Random Forest (ARF) 做插桩，分解漂移后误差被存活树增量叶更新与后台树替换各自吸收的份额；推导累积证据无法越阈的有限时域边界，并测量临界幅度下限 Δe_c；在合成漂移、ARMA-GARCH 序列 (ProteuS) 与表格基准 (BAF、INSECTS) 上验证，另用 SEA 说明经典基准的 Δe 幅度为何够不到盲区。
Result: 存活树仅靠增量叶更新吸收 98.6% 的漂移后误差瞬态；首次后台树替换只占被抹掉误差量的 0.71%，却使外部检测率下降 31 个百分点；临界幅度下限 Δe_c = 0.120；标准阈值下合成扫描的盲区出现在 Δe ≈ 0.25，而 SEA 的 Δe ≤ 0.21。失败表现为平稳流上的漏检与含噪基线上由内部树替换触发的误报泛滥。
Conclusion: 自适应分类器的内部更新本身构成对误差流检测器的盲区：当漂移幅度低于临界下限时，误报预算使检测在原理上不可行，因此对 ARF 这类模型做漂移监控必须把更新回路纳入检测设计。

papers.title: RepICL: Reusable In-Context Prediction Across Heterogeneous Representation Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Frozen representations are widely reused for downstream classification, yet each new task typically requires fitting a new predictor. We ask whether the few-shot prediction procedure itself can instead be learned once and reused across datasets and representation spaces. To study this question, we introduce RepShiftBench, comprising 1,218 encoder--dataset tasks across text, image, and audio, with separate evaluation of generalization to unseen datasets, unseen encoders, jointly unseen datasets and encoders, and unseen modalities. The benchmark exposes a substantial gap: Logistic Regression fitted independently on each episode outperforms every evaluated in-context learner across all settings. We introduce RepICL, a meta-trained in-context learner that canonicalizes each episode through episodic whitening before prediction. Its inductive variant, RepICL-I, surpasses Logistic Regression in all 12 benchmark settings, while RepICL-T substantially outperforms existing transductive methods. Ablations identify episodic whitening as the primary source of these gains, while showing that it is not a universally beneficial preprocessing step. Across both variants, the gains concentrate on queries for which simple support prototypes favor the wrong class or provide little separation between the true class and competing classes. Transduction provides its largest additional gains when limited support coverage gives a misleading view of class separation. Together, these results demonstrate that a shared few-shot prediction procedure can generalize beyond the representation spaces observed during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RepICL 是一个跨表示空间可复用的元训练 in-context 少样本预测器，先用 episodic whitening 把每个 episode 规范化再预测。在覆盖文本、图像、音频共 1,218 个 encoder–dataset 任务的 RepShiftBench 上，归纳变体 RepICL-I 在全部 12 个设置中超过逐 episode 拟合的 Logistic Regression，而消融显示 episodic whitening 是主要增益来源但并非普遍有益的预处理。
Motivation: 冻结表征被广泛复用于下游分类，但每个新任务仍需重新拟合一个预测器；作者追问少样本预测过程本身能否学一次就跨数据集与表示空间复用。
Method: 提出 RepShiftBench，含 1,218 个 encoder–dataset 任务，分文本、图像、音频三模态，并把泛化拆成未见数据集、未见 encoder、数据集与 encoder 同时未见、未见模态四类评估；提出元训练的 in-context learner RepICL，核心是对每个 episode 做 episodic whitening 规范化，分归纳变体 RepICL-I 与传导变体 RepICL-T，并做消融定位增益来源。
Result: 基准暴露明显差距：逐 episode 独立拟合的 Logistic Regression 在所有设置中胜过每个被评估的 in-context learner；RepICL-I 在全部 12 个基准设置中超过 Logistic Regression，RepICL-T 大幅优于已有传导方法。消融把主要增益归于 episodic whitening，同时表明它并非普遍有益；增益集中在 support 原型偏向错误类或真类与竞争类分离不足的 query 上，传导在 support 覆盖不足、类间分离被误导时带来最大额外增益。
Conclusion: 共享的少样本预测过程可以泛化到训练时未见的表示空间，前提是用 episodic whitening 规范化 episode；该预处理的收益依赖于 support 原型是否误导类间分离。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.tldr: RepICL 是一个跨表示空间可复用的元训练 in-context 少样本预测器，先用 episodic whitening 把每个 episode 规范化再预测。在覆盖文本、图像、音频共 1,218 个 encoder–dataset 任务的 RepShiftBench 上，归纳变体 RepICL-I 在全部 12 个设置中超过逐 episode 拟合的 Logistic Regression，而消融显示 episodic whitening 是主要增益来源但并非普遍有益的预处理。
summary_sections.motivation: 冻结表征被广泛复用于下游分类，但每个新任务仍需重新拟合一个预测器；作者追问少样本预测过程本身能否学一次就跨数据集与表示空间复用。
summary_sections.method: 提出 RepShiftBench，含 1,218 个 encoder–dataset 任务，分文本、图像、音频三模态，并把泛化拆成未见数据集、未见 encoder、数据集与 encoder 同时未见、未见模态四类评估；提出元训练的 in-context learner RepICL，核心是对每个 episode 做 episodic whitening 规范化，分归纳变体 RepICL-I 与传导变体 RepICL-T，并做消融定位增益来源。
