papers.title: CACFG: Curvature-Aware Classifier-Free Guidance and Optimal Control
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models generate samples by learning to reverse a fixed corruption process, and classifier-free guidance (CFG) is the standard mechanism for conditioning this process on a desired class or prompt. CFG can be applied at varying guidance strengths, and while higher strengths improve image quality and conditional alignment, too high a guidance strength can degrade image quality and diversity. Furthermore, CFG violates principled diffusion sampling dynamics, and existing explanations for why it works despite the violation disagree on the underlying theory or do not extend to deterministic samplers used in practice. We address both these issues. We first frame CFG sampling as a continuous-time optimal control problem, treating the sampling trajectory as a sequence of controls chosen to maximise the probability of the desired condition. Solving the resulting Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation shows that CFG is recovered under specific path costs when using an unconstrained control set. We argue this lack of constraint is responsible for CFG's failure at high guidance strengths, since it permits the sampling path to move arbitrarily far from the current image estimate. To fix this, we propose curvature-aware CFG (CACFG), which constrains the control set to a hypersphere informed by the Gaussian regularisation used when training variational autoencoders. We show that the control inputs produced by CFG sampling routinely violate this bound, and that across diffusion models, datasets, and guidance schedules, CACFG achieves superior generative quality at mid-to-high guidance strengths with a less severe quality-diversity tradeoff than regular CFG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 CFG 采样写成连续时间最优控制问题，由 HJB 方程反推出 CFG 只在无约束控制集与特定路径代价下成立；无约束正是高强度 guidance 崩坏的原因。据此提出 CACFG，用 VAE 训练所用高斯正则对应的超球面约束控制集，在中高 guidance 强度下取得更优生成质量且质量-多样性权衡更缓。
Motivation: CFG 在高强度下会损害图像质量与多样性，且它违反扩散采样的原理性动力学；现有解释彼此矛盾，或无法覆盖实践中常用的确定性采样器。
Method: 将 CFG 采样轨迹视为最大化目标条件概率的控制序列，建立连续时间最优控制问题并求解 Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman 方程，证明无约束控制集与特定路径代价下可还原 CFG；再提出 curvature-aware CFG (CACFG)，按 VAE 训练的高斯正则把控制集约束到超球面。
Result: 分析显示 CFG 采样产生的控制输入经常违反该超球面界；在多个扩散模型、数据集与 guidance 调度上，CACFG 在中到高强度 guidance 下取得优于常规 CFG 的生成质量，且质量-多样性权衡更平缓。
Conclusion: CFG 高强度失效源于控制集缺乏约束、允许采样路径任意偏离当前图像估计，加一个由曲率信息给出的超球面约束即可缓解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PhaseMatcher: Autoregressive Phase-Set Identification with Spectral Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Recovering complete phase sets from powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) is challenging when weak-phase peaks overlap stronger signals. A natural strategy is to identify phases iteratively, removing the contribution of each identified phase from the observed pattern before predicting the next. However, even after a phase is correctly identified, misestimating its contribution can distort the residual and cause subsequent errors. We introduce PhaseMatcher, an autoregressive framework for complete phase-set identification with physics-guided spectral decomposition. After each phase prediction, PhaseMatcher re-estimates the contributions of all selected phases and the residual from the original observation and all selected reference patterns, accounting for physically plausible variation between reference patterns and the corresponding phase contributions in the observation. The resulting residual guides subsequent phase identification, while a separate stopping module determines when the phase set is complete. On synthetic mixtures and controlled mixtures constructed from measured single-phase patterns, PhaseMatcher improves complete-set identification over the evaluated baselines. On PhaseMix-135K, it also estimates contributions and residuals more accurately than scalar subtraction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhaseMatcher 把粉末 XRD 相鉴定做成自回归相集合识别：每预测一个相后，用物理引导的谱分解从原始观测与全部已选参考谱重新估计各相贡献和残差，再由独立停止模块判断相集合是否完整。在合成混合物与由实测单相谱构造的受控混合物上，其完整集合识别优于所评估基线；在 PhaseMix-135K 上，贡献与残差估计比标量相减 (scalar subtraction) 更准。
Motivation: 弱相峰与强相重叠时，逐相剔除的常规策略即使相判对，也会因贡献量估计不准而扭曲残差，把误差传给后续相鉴定。
Method: 自回归框架：每次预测一个相后，从原始观测与全部已选参考谱重新估计所有已选相的贡献和残差，建模参考谱与观测中对应相贡献之间的物理合理差异；残差引导下一步识别，另设独立停止模块判定相集合何时完整。
Result: 在合成混合物和由实测单相谱构造的受控混合物上，完整相集合识别优于所评估基线；在 PhaseMix-135K 上，相贡献与残差估计比标量相减更准确。
Conclusion: 逐相剔除的误差主要来自贡献量误估，改为从原始观测联合重估贡献与残差并配独立停止判定，可提升完整相集合识别的正确性。

papers.title: AnchorPose for Geometry-Aware MOF Assembly through Meso-Grained Pose Generation
papers.abstract_en: Predicting metal-organic framework (MOF) structures from given building blocks requires recovering their positions and orientations in a periodic crystal. The spatial effects of rotation errors are geometry-dependent and anisotropic. The same angular error can produce different atomic displacements depending on block size, shape, and rotation axis. Angular error alone, without reference to the specific block geometry, therefore cannot fully describe the spatial consequences of a pose error. We introduce AnchorPose, a meso-grained pose generation framework that incorporates this geometric dependence into its generative representation. It represents each block through a small set of representative atoms, combines their local geometry with the current spatial state, and generates their coordinates with Bayesian Flow Networks. Known atom correspondences enable rigid alignment to recover complete building-block poses and return geometrically consistent points to the generation process. This design connects point-level spatial prediction with block-level structural constraints. Geometry participates in the pose state and its prediction, while rigid reconstruction preserves intra-block structure without treating all atomic coordinates as assembly variables. On the MOF benchmark, AnchorPose improves single-candidate match rates over the compared block-level and all-atom baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnchorPose 把 MOF 构筑块的位姿生成做成介观表示：用少量代表原子刻画块的局部几何，配合 Bayesian Flow Networks 生成坐标，再借已知原子对应做刚体对齐还原完整位姿并回灌几何一致的点。在 MOF benchmark 上，其单候选匹配率 (single-candidate match rate) 高于块级与全原子基线。
Motivation: 从给定构筑块预测 MOF 结构需要在周期晶体中恢复位置与朝向，而旋转误差的空间后果依赖块的尺寸、形状与转轴，是几何相关且各向异性的，单看角度误差无法刻画位姿误差的真实空间影响。
Method: 介观位姿生成框架 AnchorPose：每个构筑块用一小组代表原子表示，把其局部几何与当前空间状态结合，用 Bayesian Flow Networks 生成坐标；利用已知原子对应做刚体对齐 (rigid alignment) 恢复完整块位姿，并把几何一致的点反馈回生成过程，从而把点级空间预测与块级结构约束连起来，同时保持块内结构不变。
Result: 在 MOF benchmark 上，AnchorPose 的单候选匹配率优于所比较的块级 (block-level) 基线与全原子 (all-atom) 基线。
Conclusion: 把几何依赖直接写进位姿状态与预测、并用刚体重建保住块内结构，比把所有原子坐标当装配变量更能得到几何一致的 MOF 组装结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dual-Rate Force-Image Control with Model-Based Orientation Limits for Robotic Ultrasound
papers.abstract_en: Robotic ultrasound couples a high-rate contact-force loop with slower, delayed image feedback, so image-guided ultrasound probe rotation can perturb contact force before the resulting image response is observed. We derive a closed-form orientation-rate limit that bounds the modeled rotation-induced estimated-force excursion over a finite horizon while accounting for disturbance rejection by the fast force loop. The limit depends on local contact stiffness, force-loop gains, a conservative rotation-to-force gain bound, the excursion budget, and the prediction horizon. We implement this model in a dual-rate controller with timestamp-based delay reconstruction and joint-torque-based force estimation, and evaluate it on a curved gelatin phantom using paired controller comparisons and component ablations. Relative to unconstrained image guidance, the proposed rate-limited controller reduced first-second root-mean-square (RMS) estimated-force error by 0.40 N while increasing cue-convergence time by 0.94 s. A fixed rate cap near the analytically predicted ceiling produced no resolvable difference in force error and converged 0.32 s faster, indicating that the principal practical value of the model is the rate-design rule rather than online prediction. Delay reconstruction had no resolvable effect at the tested latency. A single-subject popliteal scan demonstrated feasibility, although the image cue was noise-limited on heterogeneous tissue.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 机器人超声中图像引导的探头旋转会在图像反馈到达前扰动接触力，本文推导闭式 orientation-rate 上限，在有限预测时域内约束旋转引起的估计力偏差，同时计入快速力环的扰动抑制。在明胶仿体上，相对无约束图像引导，限速控制把首秒 RMS 估计力误差降低 0.40 N、代价是 cue 收敛慢 0.94 s；接近解析上限的固定限速与之力误差无可分辨差异且快 0.32 s，说明模型的实际价值在离线速率设计规则而非在线预测。
Motivation: 机器人超声的接触力环快、图像反馈慢且有延迟，探头旋转会在图像响应被观测到之前就扰动接触力，缺少一个可计算的旋转速率上限来界定这段力偏差。
Method: 推导闭式 orientation-rate 上限，其依赖局部接触刚度、力环增益、保守的 rotation-to-force 增益界、偏差预算与预测时域；实现为双速率控制器，含基于时间戳的延迟重构与基于关节力矩的力估计，在弯曲明胶仿体上做配对控制器对比与组件消融。
Result: 相对无约束图像引导，限速控制器把首秒 RMS 估计力误差降低 0.40 N，同时 cue 收敛时间增加 0.94 s；固定限速设在解析上限附近时力误差无可分辨差异，且收敛快 0.32 s；在所测延迟下延迟重构无可分辨影响；单被试腘窝扫描显示可行，但异质组织上图像 cue 受噪声限制。
Conclusion: 模型的主要实用价值是给出速率设计规则而非在线预测：按解析上限设定固定限速即可保住力误差并加快收敛，延迟重构在当前延迟量级不必要。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Adaptive-Shot Hybrid Quantum Anomaly Detection for Tactile Internet Security: Reliability-Aware Measurement Allocation Under Resource Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Tactile Internet (TI) security analytics must balance reliable thresholded decisions with constrained computational and measurement resources. We study this tension for finite-shot hybrid quantum anomaly inference and introduce the Adaptive-Shot Variational Quantum Circuit (AS-VQC) policy. This validation-calibrated policy begins each record at 128 shots and cumulatively escalates through 256, 512, and 1024 shots only when the finite-shot anomaly score remains close to a validation-selected security threshold. The quantum scorer is evaluated as an off-path security analytics component rather than part of the haptic critical path. Using a 4,875-record CESNET-TimeSeries24-derived aggregate-flow benchmark, leakage-safe random, entity-group-disjoint, and temporal holdouts, and five trained quantum neural network (QNN) checkpoints per holdout, the primary AS-VQC-95 (beta = 0.95) policy averages 129.2, 276.9, and 131.2 shots per record, saving 87.4%, 73.0%, and 87.2% of the uniform 1024-shot baseline (Fixed-1024), respectively. The decision disagreement with analytic (exact-expectation) inference is 0.771%, 0.409%, and 0.635%, lower than both the uniform 128-shot baseline (Fixed-128) and a matched-budget shuffled-allocation control. Fixed-1024 remains more decision-stable, establishing a measurable reliability-resource trade-off rather than cost-free equivalence. A more conservative AS-VQC-99 (beta = 0.99) further reduces disagreement while using fewer than 512 average shots across all holdouts. These results show that finite quantum measurements can be treated as an inference resource and concentrated on boundary-sensitive TI-security decisions while exposing checkpoint-dependent escalation under unseen-entity conditions.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出自适应采样次数的变分量子电路异常检测策略 AS-VQC：每条记录从 128 shots 起步，仅当有限-shot 异常分数接近验证集选定的安全阈值时才逐级升到 256/512/1024 shots。在 4,875 条 CESNET-TimeSeries24 聚合流基准上，AS-VQC-95 三种 holdout 平均每条仅用 129.2、276.9、131.2 shots，比均匀 1024-shot 基线省 87.4%、73.0%、87.2%，与精确期望推断的决策分歧仅 0.771%、0.409%、0.635%。
Motivation: Tactile Internet 安全分析要在有限-shot 量子测量下同时保证阈值化决策可靠与测量/计算资源受限，均匀分配 shots 要么浪费预算、要么牺牲决策稳定性。
Method: AS-VQC 是验证校准的自适应策略：每条记录从 128 shots 开始，仅当有限-shot 异常分数接近验证集选定阈值时累计升级到 256、512、1024 shots；量子打分器作为离线安全分析组件而非触觉关键路径。评测用 4,875 条 CESNET-TimeSeries24 派生聚合流基准，三种防泄漏划分（随机、实体分组不相交、时间留出），每种划分训练五个 QNN checkpoint。
Result: AS-VQC-95（beta=0.95）在三种 holdout 上平均每条 129.2、276.9、131.2 shots，相对 Fixed-1024 节省 87.4%、73.0%、87.2%；与解析（精确期望）推断的决策分歧为 0.771%、0.409%、0.635%，低于 Fixed-128 与等预算随机分配对照。Fixed-1024 决策更稳定；更保守的 AS-VQC-99（beta=0.99）在全部 holdout 上平均 shots 低于 512 且分歧进一步下降。
Conclusion: 有限量子测量可当作可分配的推断资源，集中用于阈值边界附近的 TI 安全决策，代价是相对 Fixed-1024 存在可测的可靠性-资源权衡；未见实体条件下升级行为依赖 checkpoint。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: HiER-BLS: A Hierarchy-Guided and Error-Correcting Robust Incremental Broad Learning System
papers.abstract_en: Broad Learning System (BLS) supports analytical training and incremental expansion, but its growth needs guidance on which inputs new blocks should learn from. Weight errors pose a further challenge by displacing learned outputs across class boundaries. We propose HiER-BLS to couple hierarchy-guided representation growth with error-correcting learning. Successive blocks focus on inputs selected by feature importance and correlation while preserving earlier representations. The evolving branch guides encoded learners through subspace size and sample confidence, so its learning experience informs both their feature views and supervision. For finite broad readouts, we show how codeword correlations transform fitted class scores. Prediction preservation depends on the distance from the actual output to the nearest decoding boundary relative to the model's sensitivity to weight errors. Experiments on five image and five tabular datasets demonstrate improved classification performance over representative BLS variants. Component studies show that hierarchy guidance benefits the encoded branch even when the guiding branch has lower standalone accuracy, with further gains from combining their scores. Longer codes continue to improve accuracy under stronger Gaussian weight errors after clean accuracy has largely saturated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HiER-BLS 把层次引导的表示增长与纠错学习耦合进 Broad Learning System：新块按特征重要性与相关性选择输入，演化分支通过子空间大小与样本置信度引导编码学习器。在五个图像与五个表格数据集上分类性能优于代表性 BLS 变体；在干净精度基本饱和后，更强的高斯权重误差下更长的码字仍继续提升精度。
Motivation: BLS 支持解析训练与增量扩展，但新块该学哪些输入缺少引导，且权重误差会把已学输出推过类别边界。
Method: 后续块按特征重要性与相关性选择输入并保留先前表示；演化分支通过子空间大小与样本置信度引导编码学习器，其学习经验同时提供特征视图与监督。对有限 broad readout，推导码字相关性如何变换拟合类别分数，并以到最近解码边界的距离相对模型对权重误差的敏感度刻画预测保持条件。
Result: 在五个图像与五个表格数据集上，分类性能优于代表性 BLS 变体；组件研究显示即使引导分支单独准确率更低，层次引导仍使编码分支受益，二者分数合并有进一步增益；干净精度基本饱和后，更强的高斯权重误差下更长的码字继续提升准确率。
Conclusion: 层次引导与纠错学习结合可让 BLS 的增量增长既选对输入又在权重误差下保持预测，长码在误差增强时仍有余量。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Request Order Matters: Cache-History Sensitivity in Selective KV-Cache Reuse for Rolling Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-running agents repeatedly call an LLM while retaining most of their document window, evicting old documents, and appending new ones. These rolling updates break exact prefix caching and motivate non-prefix KV-cache reuse with selective recomputation. We show that persistent KV-cache reuse with selective recomputation can be history-dependent: in our rolling-agent workload, an unchanged prompt can produce different answers depending on the requests processed before it. At a matched 5% recomputation budget, document-aligned recomputation reduces answer variation across request orders from 69.0% with CacheBlend's token top-$k$ policy to 26.1%. When each prompt is evaluated after a different sequence of preceding requests, document-aligned recomputation improves fidelity to full prefill by 34.5-52.5 percentage points over token top-$k$, while both policies achieve approximately 5.7$\times$ median TTFT speedup. Our ablation study shows that, in our rolling-agent workload, contiguity is the main factor associated with robust selective recomputation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 长时程 rolling agent 反复调用 LLM 并滚动增删文档窗口，破坏精确前缀缓存，使非前缀 KV-cache 复用出现历史依赖：同一未变 prompt 因先前请求序列不同而给出不同答案。在 5% 重算预算下，document-aligned 重算把跨请求顺序的答案波动从 CacheBlend token top-k 的 69.0% 降到 26.1%，对 full prefill 的保真度提升 34.5–52.5 个百分点，两者中位 TTFT 加速均约 5.7×；消融显示 contiguity 是稳健选择性重算的主因。
Motivation: rolling agent 的文档窗口不断淘汰旧文档、追加新文档，精确前缀缓存失效，非前缀 KV-cache 复用加选择性重算因此成为必需，但其输出可能依赖先前处理过的请求序列。
Method: 在 rolling-agent 工作负载上对比两种选择性重算策略：CacheBlend 的 token top-k 与 document-aligned 重算，匹配 5% 重算预算，让每个 prompt 在不同前置请求序列后评估，并与 full prefill 对照，另做消融分析。
Result: 跨请求顺序的答案波动从 token top-k 的 69.0% 降至 document-aligned 的 26.1%；对 full prefill 的保真度提升 34.5–52.5 个百分点；两种策略中位 TTFT 加速均约 5.7×。消融显示 contiguity 是选择性重算稳健性的主相关因素。
Conclusion: 选择性 KV-cache 重算的历史依赖可通过按文档边界而非 token top-k 来选重算位置缓解，在同等 5.7× 加速下显著降低顺序敏感性；contiguity 是关键因素。

papers.title: Selecting Long-Horizon Trajectories for Reliable and Efficient Terminal-Agent Training
papers.abstract_en: Terminal agents are commonly trained by imitating long teacher trajectories, yet how much of each trajectory to supervise remains unexplored. We study the \emph{supervision horizon}, the number of trajectory tokens retained for training, and show that it is a key design axis for reliability and cost. Reliability improves with longer horizons but saturates: on Terminal-Bench, a 12K-token horizon solves more tasks than 16K ($29\pm0.7$ vs.\ $26\pm0.8$) while requiring 30\% less training time. The horizon also shapes agent behavior: short horizons cause premature termination, intermediate horizons yield productive error recovery, and long horizons induce over-persistence. We analyze this saturation through a bias--complexity bound, in which longer supervision reduces temporal supervision bias but increases finite-sample estimation error from more heterogeneous late-stage histories. Guided by this analysis, we propose \emph{selective long-horizon refinement}, which first trains on short prefixes and then refines only on continuations that are most likely under the warm-start model. It consistently outperforms full long-horizon training. At 16K, it raises successful attempts from $110\pm2.7$ to $126\pm2.1$ and tasks solved in at least six of eight attempts from $9\pm0.7$ to $14\pm0.6$; with half of the long-horizon data, it still reaches $122\pm2.4$ while cutting training time by 23\%. The gains transfer across benchmarks, from $64\pm2.6$ to $73\pm2.1$ on Terminal-Bench v2.0 and from $137\pm2.7$ to $155\pm2.2$ on OpenThoughts-TBLite. For long-horizon supervision, selecting the right trajectories matters more than training on all of them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 终端智能体 (terminal agent) 模仿长教师轨迹时，监督长度 (supervision horizon) 是可靠性与成本的关键轴：12K token 在 Terminal-Bench 上解出的任务多于 16K（29±0.7 vs 26±0.8），训练时间还省 30%。作者据此提出 selective long-horizon refinement——先在短前缀上训练，再只对 warm-start 模型下最可能的续段做精修，16K 下成功尝试从 110±2.7 升到 126±2.1。结论是长程监督下选对轨迹比全量训练更重要。
Motivation: 终端智能体普遍靠模仿整条长教师轨迹训练，但每条轨迹该监督多少 token 这一设计轴此前无人研究，直接决定可靠性与训练成本的取舍。
Method: 定义 supervision horizon（保留用于训练的轨迹 token 数），用 bias–complexity bound 分析饱和：更长监督降低时间监督偏差，却因后期历史更异质而抬高有限样本估计误差。据此提出 selective long-horizon refinement：先在短前缀上 warm-start 训练，再只在 warm-start 模型下概率最高的续段上精修。
Result: Terminal-Bench 上 12K 比 16K 解出更多任务（29±0.7 vs 26±0.8）且训练时间少 30%；短 horizon 导致过早终止、中等 horizon 产生有效错误恢复、长 horizon 引发 over-persistence。16K 时 selective refinement 把成功尝试从 110±2.7 提到 126±2.1，八次尝试中至少六次成功的任务数从 9±0.7 提到 14±0.6；用一半长程数据仍达 122±2.4，训练时间省 23%。跨基准迁移：Terminal-Bench v2.0 从 64±2.6 到 73±2.1，OpenThoughts-TBLite 从 137±2.7 到 155±2.2。
Conclusion: 对长程监督而言，选择合适的轨迹比训练全部轨迹更关键；监督长度存在饱和点，超过后可靠性不再提升反而增加成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measurement-First Auditing of Agentic Leaderboards: Contamination Susceptibility, Matched-Control Re-evaluation, and Scorer Validation
papers.abstract_en: Agentic leaderboards increasingly evaluate systems on public benchmarks whose task statements and solution-bearing artifacts can remain accessible. We propose a measurement-first audit framework that distinguishes contamination claims according to the evidence required to support them. It separates three channels that require different evidence: training-time exposure, evaluation-time retrieval, and pipeline/scaffold leakage. Each channel is coded as open, partial, closed, or unknown under a fail-closed rule. Across nine Holistic Agent Leaderboard (HAL) configurations, none of the 27 channel assessments was coded closed, but incidents were confirmed in four configurations. We then apply the behavioral component of the framework to a reported file-localization gap on SWE-bench Verified, using an outcome-blind, same-repository matched-control design with symmetric prompt-leakage screening, paired and repository-aware uncertainty analyses, and scorer validation, evaluated on GPT-4.1 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Among the 100 pairs retained after symmetric screening and the pair-integrity exclusion, GPT-4.1 showed a $+10.0$-point pair-weighted Top-3 benchmark-associated gap, but the 95\% intervals from both the prespecified paired-bootstrap procedure and the post-hoc repository-balanced analysis included zero, leaving the benchmark-associated gap inconclusive. The reproduction scorer did not pass its validation gate: against consensus human labels, sufficient scorer sensitivity could not be established for either model, and both DeepSeek-V4-Flash firings on correct-gold comparisons were false positives. Without provenance evidence, appropriate controls, symmetric leakage screening, and validated scorers, stronger contamination claims are not warranted. The results do not establish training-data membership, contamination prevalence, or benchmark-induced score inflation.
papers.journal_ref: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop LCFM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出测量优先的智能体榜单 (agentic leaderboard) 污染审计框架，把污染主张按证据需求拆成训练时暴露、评测时检索、管道/脚手架泄漏三条通道，各按 fail-closed 规则编码为 open/partial/closed/unknown。在 HAL 九个配置的 27 次通道评估中无一编码为 closed，但四个配置确认存在事件；对 SWE-bench Verified 文件定位差距的匹配对照复评显示 GPT-4.1 有 +10.0 分的 pair-weighted Top-3 关联差距但 95% 区间含零，且复评 scorer 未通过验证门，因此更强的污染主张不成立。
Motivation: 智能体榜单所用公开基准的任务陈述与解题产物仍可被访问，导致污染指控常在缺乏相应证据时被提出，需要区分不同证据需求的通道并配套对照与 scorer 验证。
Method: 框架将污染分为训练时暴露、评测时检索、管道/脚手架泄漏三通道，按 fail-closed 编码为 open/partial/closed/unknown；行为部分在 SWE-bench Verified 的文件定位差距上采用 outcome-blind、同仓库匹配对照设计，配对称提示泄漏筛查、配对与仓库感知的不确定性分析及 scorer 验证，评估模型为 GPT-4.1 与 DeepSeek-V4-Flash。
Result: HAL 九个配置的 27 次通道评估中无一编码为 closed，四个配置确认存在事件；对称筛查与配对完整性排除后保留 100 对，GPT-4.1 的 pair-weighted Top-3 benchmark-associated gap 为 +10.0 分，但预设 paired-bootstrap 与事后仓库平衡分析的 95% 区间均含零；复评 scorer 对共识人工标注的敏感度对两个模型均未确立，DeepSeek-V4-Flash 在 correct-gold 比较上的两次 firing 均为假阳性。

papers.title: Data-Driven Personas for Survey Simulation: Insights into Simulation Alignment Across Data-Access Regimes
papers.abstract_en: However, many existing steering approaches rely on target-domain human data for fine-tuning or prompting that is costly to collect and raises privacy concerns. In this paper, we study demographic group-level survey simulation, where personas induced from heterogeneous, anonymized public behavioral data condition agents that simulate responses of individuals from specific demographic groups. We examine whether representative personas can be induced from diverse sources and analyze how the domain, scale, and granularity of the source data affect survey simulation alignment. We find that personas induced from out-of-domain sources rarely outperform simulations conditioned only on basic demographic information, largely due to population mismatch. However, when personas are accurately assigned to the target demographic groups, alignment improves substantially. Finally, personas induced from target-domain survey data generalize better as more survey question history becomes available, suggesting that richer behavioral evidence enables more stable persona trait inference that transfers to better unseen questions simulation alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用从异构匿名公开行为数据归纳的人格画像 (persona) 来条件化 agent，模拟特定人口统计群体的问卷回答，并考察来源数据的域、规模与粒度如何影响模拟对齐。结果是：域外来源归纳的画像基本不优于仅用基础人口统计信息的条件化（主因是 population mismatch），而画像准确对应到目标群体时对齐显著提升；目标域问卷数据归纳的画像随可用问题历史增多而泛化更好。
Motivation: 现有 steering 方法依赖目标域人类数据做微调或提示，采集成本高且有隐私风险；需要弄清能否用公开行为数据替代，并明确数据可得性（域、规模、粒度）对问卷模拟对齐的影响。
Method: 在 demographic group-level survey simulation 设定下，从多种异构、匿名公开行为数据源归纳群体级 persona，用其条件化 agent 生成目标人口统计群体个体的回答；对比不同来源域（域外 vs 目标域）、规模与粒度的画像，并与仅用基础人口统计信息条件化的模拟对照，考察随问卷问题历史增加的泛化表现。
Result: 域外来源归纳的画像很少优于仅以基础人口统计信息为条件的模拟，主要归因于 population mismatch；画像被准确分配到目标人口统计群体时，对齐 (alignment) 显著改善；由目标域问卷数据归纳的画像在可用问卷问题历史增多时泛化更好，对未见问题的模拟对齐更稳定。
Conclusion: 问卷模拟对齐的关键不是画像来源的数据量而是与目标群体的匹配度：域外行为数据难以替代目标域证据，而更丰富的目标域行为证据能支持更稳定的 persona 特征推断并迁移到未见问题。

papers.title: Usefulness of Quantile-Aware Diffusion Modeling for Highly Imbalanced Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Classification problem in the context of highly imbalanced data is a major challenge in many real-world applications (e.g., FinTech, healthcare, etc.). In these cases, the vast majority of instances belong to a single class and a small fraction represent the minority class (often the most critical class). Recently, diffusion models have emerged as powerful approaches to reduce the degree of ``imbalanced-ness'' in the dataset; they work by generating synthetic data by capturing complex data distributions using iterative transformations. However, standard diffusion models are not inherently suited to highly skewed or heavy-tailed data, due to inbuilt quadratic error loss, which lacks the structural sensitivity to capture rare, extreme values, and minority-class nuances. We propose a novel approach, namely, Quantile-TabDDPM, based on a quantile-regularized denoising objective that combines the standard quadratic error loss with a quantile loss term to explicitly capture rare events while preserving the theoretical grounding of the original denoising objective. We extensively evaluated our approach on a real-world credit card transaction dataset characterized by extreme class imbalance. The results demonstrate that the integration of diffusion-based synthetic data generation with a quantile-regularized denoising objective provides a robust and effective framework for fraud detection in highly imbalanced datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对极端类别不平衡的表格数据，提出 Quantile-TabDDPM：在标准扩散去噪的二次误差损失上加一项 quantile loss，使去噪目标显式捕捉稀有、极端值与少数类特征。在真实信用卡交易欺诈数据集上检验，结果显示扩散式合成数据生成结合 quantile 正则去噪目标可为高度不平衡欺诈检测提供稳健有效的框架。
Motivation: 高度不平衡数据中绝大多数样本属于单一类，少数类（往往最关键）占比极小；标准扩散模型的二次误差损失缺乏对稀有极端值和少数类细节的结构敏感性，难以有效缓解这种不平衡。
Method: 提出 Quantile-TabDDPM，采用 quantile 正则化的去噪目标 (quantile-regularized denoising objective)，把标准二次误差损失与 quantile loss 结合，同时保留原去噪目标的理论基础；用扩散模型迭代生成合成数据以降低数据集的不平衡程度。
Result: 在真实信用卡交易数据集（极端类别不平衡）上进行广泛评估，结果显示扩散式合成数据生成与 quantile 正则去噪目标的结合为高度不平衡数据集上的欺诈检测提供了稳健有效的框架。
Conclusion: 把 quantile loss 引入扩散去噪目标，可让标准扩散模型适配高度偏斜、重尾的不平衡表格数据，并在欺诈检测这类少数类关键的任务上奏效。

papers.title: Who Keeps the Gains from Personal AI Assistants? Seller Adaptation and the Unassisted in a Language-Model Market Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Personal AI assistants are beginning to transact for consumers, and early adopters capture real savings. Whether those savings survive, and what happens to consumers who have no assistant, depends on how sellers respond -- a question single-user evidence cannot answer. We build an agent-based rental market in which language models play consumers, assistants, and six adaptive sellers guided by an algorithmic pricing tool. Half the population receives an assistant under an advisory or an executing mandate; the contract pairs a fee only the renter's physical action avoids with a pre-selected add-on an authorised assistant can cancel online. An analytical benchmark and a behaviourally calibrated rule market supply ex-ante predictions, and paired branches with frozen versus adaptive sellers separate adoption effects from market feedback. Across thirty simulated markets, executing assistants cut adopters' spending by 13.7 USD per renter-day when sellers are frozen; adaptation claws back about a third, leaving 8.7, with the gains arriving both as lower bills and as rentals completed at all. Sellers raise headline rates while cutting fees, and the calibrated forecast of the burden on unassisted consumers (+3.6) does not transfer: their mean spending change is +0.4, confidence interval -0.6 to +1.3. Seller-model swaps and a within-market transfer of fee-setting to the pricing tool show that fee conduct, and with it the division of the gains, is decided on the seller side. Assistants, we conclude, should be evaluated at market level -- completion, total spending, and non-users included -- and the comparison layers locate exactly where a calibrated behavioural forecast fails in a language-model market.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用语言模型扮演消费者、AI 助手与六类自适应卖家的 agent-based 租赁市场模拟显示：执行型助手在卖家冻结时为采用者每人每天省 13.7 USD，卖家适应后回吐约三分之一，只剩 8.7 USD。卖家提标价、降附加费，未使用助手者的负担预测 +3.6 并不成立，实测均值仅 +0.4（置信区间 -0.6 到 +1.3）。结论是助手必须按市场层面评估：完成率、总支出、并把非用户算进来。
Motivation: 早期采用者从个人 AI 助手上省下的钱能否留存、以及没有助手的消费者会怎样，取决于卖家的定价反应，单一用户层面的证据无法回答这一市场反馈问题。
Method: 构建 agent-based 租赁市场：语言模型分别扮演消费者、助手与六个由算法定价工具引导的自适应卖家；半数人口获得 advisory 或 executing 授权的助手，合同把只有租客本人线下动作才能避免的费用与助手可在线取消的预选附加项配对。用解析基准与行为校准的规则市场给出事前预测，并以卖家冻结 vs 自适应的配对分支分离采用效应与市场反馈，共三十个模拟市场。
Result: 卖家冻结时执行型助手使采用者支出每人每天下降 13.7 USD；卖家适应后回吐约三分之一，净省 8.7 USD，收益同时来自账单降低和更多租赁成交。卖家提高标价同时削减费用；校准预测对未使用者的负担为 +3.6，但实测均值支出变化为 +0.4，置信区间 -0.6 到 +1.3。
Conclusion: 费用行为及其决定的收益分配由卖家一侧决定（卖家模型替换与市场内把定价权交给定价工具可定位这一点），因此个人助手应在市场层面评估，包含完成率、总支出与非用户。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Entropy-Stable and Well-Balanced Discontinuous Galerkin Methods for the Compressible Euler Equations in Vector-Invariant Form
papers.abstract_en: We develop structure-preserving methods for the compressible Euler equations with gravity in vector-invariant form and potential temperature as a prognostic variable within the flux-differencing discontinuous Galerkin spectral element method (DGSEM) framework. By discretizing the nonconservative terms as symmetric and antisymmetric products, we derive two-point numerical fluxes that conserve both the thermodynamic entropy and the total energy. Moreover, we design an entropy-stable numerical flux that is well-balanced for both isothermal and isentropic background states. All properties are shown to carry over to the high-order DGSEM on general curvilinear meshes. Several numerical examples confirm the theoretical findings and show the robustness and accuracy of the scheme for use in modern dynamical cores for atmospheric flows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在通量差分 DGSEM 框架内，为向量不变形式的可压缩 Euler 方程（含重力、以位温为预报变量）构造保持结构的格式：把非守恒项写成对称与反对称乘积，导出的两点数值通量同时守恒热力学熵与总能量，并对等温与等熵背景态都做到 well-balanced。这些性质可推广到一般曲线网格上的高阶 DGSEM，数值算例证实理论结论，说明该格式可用于大气动力核。
Motivation: 含重力的可压缩 Euler 方程在向量不变形式下非守恒项难以离散，常规格式既不守恒熵与总能量，也难以对等温/等熵背景态保持静止平衡，这对大气动力核的稳健性是直接障碍。
Method: 在 flux-differencing discontinuous Galerkin spectral element method (DGSEM) 框架内，将非守恒项离散为对称与反对称乘积，据此导出守恒热力学熵与总能量的两点数值通量；再设计对等温与等熵背景态均 well-balanced 的熵稳定数值通量，并证明这些性质在一般曲线网格 (general curvilinear meshes) 上的高阶 DGSEM 中保持。
Result: 若干数值算例证实了熵守恒、总能量守恒与 well-balanced 等理论结论，并显示该格式在大气流动动力核用途上的稳健性与精度；配套提供可复现仓库 (github.com/MarcoArtiano/2026_entropy_stable_vector_invariant)。
Conclusion: 以对称/反对称乘积离散非守恒项，可以在一般曲线网格高阶 DGSEM 上同时拿到熵稳定、总能量守恒与双背景态 well-balanced，因而适合作为大气流动现代动力核的基础格式。
Relevance: 38

summary_sections.method: 在 flux-differencing discontinuous Galerkin spectral element method (DGSEM) 框架内，将非守恒项离散为对称与反对称乘积，据此导出守恒热力学熵与总能量的两点数值通量；再设计对等温与等熵背景态均 well-balanced 的熵稳定数值通量，并证明这些性质在一般曲线网格 (general curvilinear meshes) 上的高阶 DGSEM 中保持。
summary_sections.result: 若干数值算例证实了熵守恒、总能量守恒与 well-balanced 等理论结论，并显示该格式在大气流动动力核用途上的稳健性与精度；配套提供可复现仓库 (github.com/MarcoArtiano/2026_entropy_stable_vector_invariant)。
summary_sections.conclusion: 以对称/反对称乘积离散非守恒项，可以在一般曲线网格高阶 DGSEM 上同时拿到熵稳定、总能量守恒与双背景态 well-balanced，因而适合作为大气流动现代动力核的基础格式。

papers.title: Transporting Unsecured Stacked Payloads with a Quadrupedal Robot via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Transporting unsecured payloads with legged robots over uneven terrain requires balancing locomotion performance and payload stability, since aggressive motion can destabilize the payload even when the robot remains stable. We study quadrupedal transportation of unsecured stacked boxes on an edgeless torso-mounted board without dedicated payload sensors or active carrier mechanisms. To address this trade-off, we propose Payload-Adaptive Multi-Objective Reinforcement learning for Transportation (PAMORT). PAMORT trains a multi-objective base policy conditioned on a preference vector that weights locomotion and payload-stability reward groups, then trains a weight adjuster on the frozen policy to adapt this preference online from proprioception. In simulation, PAMORT achieves comparable or better overall transportation success than a corresponding single-objective baseline across different payload configurations, including an unseen three-box stack, despite training only with two boxes. Real-world experiments on a Unitree Go2 demonstrate zero-shot transfer to slopes and steps at or beyond the training difficulty, with mean success rates of 0.850 for PAMORT and 0.675 for the baseline across eight tasks. These results demonstrate robust unsecured-payload transportation with online adaptation of the locomotion--payload trade-off from proprioceptive information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PAMORT：用偏好向量加权运动性能与载荷稳定性两组奖励训练多目标基础策略，再在冻结策略上训练权重调节器，仅凭本体感受在线调整偏好，使四足机器人在无载荷传感器、无主动承载机构条件下搬运未固定堆叠箱。仿真中含未见过的三箱堆叠（训练只用两箱）时整体搬运成功率与单目标基线相当或更好；真实 Unitree Go2 上零样本迁移到坡面与台阶，八项任务平均成功率 0.850 对基线 0.675。
Motivation: 四足机器人在不平地形搬运未固定载荷时，激进运动会 destabilize 载荷即使机器人自身稳定，运动性能与载荷稳定性存在冲突；专用载荷传感器和主动承载机构又增加成本与复杂度。
Method: PAMORT 分两阶段：先以偏好向量加权 locomotion 与 payload-stability 两组奖励，训练多目标基础策略；再冻结该策略，仅用本体感受 (proprioception) 训练一个权重调节器在线调整偏好。搬运对象为无边缘板上未固定的堆叠箱，不使用载荷传感器或主动承载机构。
Result: 仿真中在不同载荷配置下（含训练未见的三箱堆叠，训练仅用两箱）整体搬运成功率与单目标基线相当或更好；真实 Unitree Go2 上零样本迁移到达到或超过训练难度的坡面与台阶，八项任务平均成功率 PAMORT 0.850、基线 0.675。
Conclusion: 仅凭本体感受在线调整运动—载荷权衡，即可在无载荷传感器条件下实现稳健的未固定载荷搬运，并把仿真训练的策略零样本迁移到真实地形。

papers.title: Nash Equilibrium Text: A Game-Theoretic Decoding Framework for Text Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text revision has become an integral component of large language models. This paper formulates revision such that it admits a Nash equilibrium: Token positions are players, vocabulary items are actions, and each player's utility is the language model's log conditional probability. We motivate the revision by showing that Nash equilibria can have exponentially higher likelihood than autoregressive outputs as the sequence length grows. We further propose Nash decoding, an algorithm that reaches an $\varepsilon$-Nash equilibrium in $O(1/\varepsilon)$ time given access to the joint probability of tokens conditioned on a prompt. In practice, we run Nash decoding using conditional probability estimates from large language models and evaluate the resulting equilibria on question-answering benchmarks. On CLAPNQ, PubMedQA, and CoQA, Nash equilibria obtained from masked language models achieve higher F1 and ROUGE scores than autoregressive models up to $18\times$ larger, without any fine-tuning or retraining, at the cost of additional test-time computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把文本修订建模为博弈：token 位置是玩家、词表项是动作、效用为语言模型的对数条件概率，使输出落在 Nash 均衡上。Nash decoding 在给定联合条件概率时以 O(1/ε) 时间达到 ε-Nash 均衡；在 CLAPNQ、PubMedQA、CoQA 上，掩码语言模型得到的均衡在无需微调或重训下，F1 与 ROUGE 超过最大 18× 规模的自回归模型，代价是额外测试时计算。
Motivation: 自回归解码逐 token 贪心地固定输出，无法表达整段序列的联合最优；作者论证随序列长度增长，Nash 均衡的似然可比自回归输出高出指数级，因此需要一种能收敛到均衡的解码方式。
Method: 将 token 位置设为玩家、词表项设为动作、效用取语言模型的 log 条件概率，构造允许 Nash 均衡的修订博弈；提出 Nash decoding 算法，在可访问 token 联合条件概率的前提下以 O(1/ε) 时间达到 ε-Nash 均衡，实践中用大语言模型的条件概率估计来运行。
Result: 在 CLAPNQ、PubMedQA、CoQA 三个问答基准上，由掩码语言模型得到的 Nash 均衡取得比自回归模型更高的 F1 与 ROUGE，且被超越的自回归模型规模最大可达 18×，全程无微调或重训；代价是额外的测试时计算。理论上均衡似然随序列长度可比自回归输出高出指数级，算法复杂度为 O(1/ε)。
Conclusion: 把文本修订写成可解的博弈后，均衡解码能在不训练的前提下用测试时计算换取质量，超过大得多的自回归模型；适用前提是能拿到 token 的联合条件概率估计。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Level-of-Token Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Image and video diffusion models allocate equal computation to every region, even when the intended scene calls for varying levels of detail. The spatial distribution of detail can often be anticipated before generation, indicating where computation can be reduced. We introduce Level-of-Token (LoT) Diffusion, a framework that turns this knowledge into an explicit multiresolution token layout (Level-of-Token layout) for adaptive and efficient generation. Tokens represent rectangular patches of varying sizes and shapes, allocating finer tokens where detail is needed and coarser tokens elsewhere. We adapt pretrained diffusion transformers to LoT layouts through a patch-wise asymmetric flow parametrization and embeddings for multiresolution tokens, preserving full-resolution flow prediction at every denoising step while processing only a reduced token sequence. LoT Diffusion enables layout-adaptive generation while preserving pretrained generative priors. We demonstrate LoT with layouts derived from semantic masks, bounding boxes, texture variance, and depth-of-field cues, as well as agentic plans. Across image and video generation, LoT offers favorable quality-efficiency tradeoffs, with significant speedups determined by the layout's token budget. Our project website is at https://georgenakayama.github.io/lotdiffusion/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoT Diffusion 把生成前可预判的细节分布变成显式的多分辨率 token 布局：细节处用细 token、其余用粗 token，配合 patch-wise 非对称流参数化适配预训练 diffusion transformer，在每步去噪保持全分辨率流预测的同时只处理缩减后的 token 序列。图像与视频生成上给出由布局 token 预算决定的显著加速，质量-效率权衡有利。
Motivation: 图像与视频 diffusion 模型对每个区域分配相同计算，而场景所需的细节水平本就不同，且空间细节分布常可在生成前预判，这部分冗余计算可被省去。
Method: 将预生成的细节先验转为 Level-of-Token 布局，token 为大小形状可变的矩形 patch；用 patch-wise 非对称流 (asymmetric flow) 参数化与多分辨率 token embedding 改造预训练 diffusion transformer，每步去噪仍输出全分辨率流预测但只跑缩减后的 token 序列。布局可由语义 mask、bounding box、纹理方差、景深 (depth-of-field) 线索乃至 agentic plan 导出。
Result: 在图像与视频生成上给出有利的质量-效率权衡，加速幅度由布局的 token 预算决定；布局来源覆盖语义 mask、bounding box、纹理方差、景深线索与 agentic plan。
Conclusion: 生成前可预判的细节分布足以指导自适应 token 分配，在保留预训练生成先验的前提下按 token 预算换取加速。

papers.title: Feature identification for parameter extraction and defect detection using machine learning
papers.abstract_en: Process control of advanced semiconductor nodes is not only pushing the limits of metrology equipment requirements in terms of resolution and throughput but also in terms of the richness of data to be extracted to enable engineers to finetune the process steps for increased yield. The move towards 3D structures requires extraction of critical dimension parameters from structures which can vary largely from layer to layer. For in-line process control, the necessary automation forces the development of layer and equipment-specific dedicated image processing algorithms. Similarly, with the increase in stochastic defects in the EUV era, detection of defects at the nm scale requires the identification of features captured in low resolution to meet the throughput requirements of HVM fabs, which can again lead to custom algorithm development. With the emergence of ML-based image processing methods, this process of algorithm development for both cases can be accelerated. In this work, we provide the general framework under which the images obtained from high-speed scanning probe microscopy-based systems can be used to train a network for either feature detection for parameter extraction or defect identification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向半导体先进制程的在线量测，给出一套通用框架：用高速扫描探针显微镜 (high-speed scanning probe microscopy) 图像训练网络，完成关键尺寸 (CD) 参数提取的特征检测或 nm 级随机缺陷识别，以替代逐层、逐设备定制图像算法的开发流程。
Motivation: 3D 结构使 CD 参数随层大幅变化、EUV 时代随机缺陷增多，而 HVM 晶圆厂的吞吐要求限制图像分辨率，迫使为每层每设备定制算法，开发成本高。
Method: 提供一个通用训练框架：以高速扫描探针显微系统获取的图像为输入，训练网络用于两类任务之一——面向参数提取的特征检测，或缺陷识别。
Result: 工作给出的是框架本身，用于从高速 SPM 图像训练特征检测与缺陷识别网络，以适配低分辨率、高吞吐的在线量测约束。
Conclusion: ML 图像处理可以加速制程控制中两类定制算法的开发，把逐层逐设备的算法编写转为按框架训练网络。

papers.title: Online AutoML: Evaluating Poisoning Attacks on Adversarial Training Defense Strategy in IoT Networks
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML)-powered poisoning attack vectors are adversarial maneuvers whereby an attacker intentionally inserts, corrupts, or alters training data to distort an ML model's learning process. The objective is to diminish model efficacy, instill biases, induce misclassifications, or include concealed backdoors that may be attacked during implementation. In streaming contexts, poisoning attacks pose significant risks since models perpetually update based on incoming streams of data. An assailant may incrementally introduce harmful samples into this data stream, leading the model to assimilate erroneous features over time without timely identification. Therefore, this study is aimed at evaluating the efficacy of the adversarial training (AT) defense approach against poisoning attacks (label flip and noise injection) using an online AutoML pipeline for Internet of Things (IoT) networks. Specifically, poisoning attacks (label flip and noise injection) were applied to streaming-capable AutoML learners (Hoeffding Tree (HT), Leveraging Bagging (LB), Adaptive Random Forest (ARF), Hoeffding Adaptive Tree (HAT), and Streaming Random Patches (SRP)). Under the strongest poisoning rate (PR = 1.0), AT-SRP achieved the highest F1-score against label flip poisoning (0.904), while AT-LB achieved the highest F1-score against noise-injection poisoning (0.933). Finally, several drift detection methods were used for rolling accuracy and prequential evaluation.
papers.comment: Accepted and to appear in IEEE CASCON 2026. Code is available at: https://github.com/ChiNonsoHenry16/Label-Flip-NoiseInjection_OnAutoML
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 IoT 流数据场景下，用 online AutoML 管线评估对抗训练 (adversarial training, AT) 对两类投毒攻击（label flip、noise injection）的防御效果。在最强投毒率 PR = 1.0 下，AT-SRP 对 label flip 取得最高 F1 0.904，AT-LB 对 noise injection 取得最高 F1 0.933。
Motivation: 流式学习中模型随数据流持续更新，攻击者可增量注入有害样本，使模型逐渐吸收错误特征且难以及时识别；需要在真实投毒率下检验 AT 防御在流式学习器上的实际效力。
Method: 构建面向 IoT 网络的 online AutoML 管线，将 label flip 与 noise injection 投毒施加到五种 streaming-capable 学习器：Hoeffding Tree (HT)、Leveraging Bagging (LB)、Adaptive Random Forest (ARF)、Hoeffding Adaptive Tree (HAT)、Streaming Random Patches (SRP)，并叠加对抗训练防御；用多种 drift detection 方法做 rolling accuracy 与 prequential evaluation。
Result: 在最强投毒率 PR = 1.0 下，AT-SRP 对 label flip poisoning 取得最高 F1-score 0.904，AT-LB 对 noise-injection poisoning 取得最高 F1-score 0.933；评估采用多种漂移检测方法的 rolling accuracy 与 prequential evaluation。

papers.title: Image resolution enhancement for advanced semiconductor nodes
papers.abstract_en: Advanced semiconductor nodes are pushing the limits of feature sizes and require metrology with sub-nm resolution without compromising on the throughput as needed for in-line process control. Recently, high-throughput scanning probe microscopy (SPM) based metrology and inspection tools capable of meeting these needs have been introduced to the market and qualified for use in HVM. While innovative measurement methods and tool architecture have allowed for a leap of improvement in throughput, the next step in further reducing imaging time can be obtained through the application of machine learning for enhancing the resolution of measured images for extraction of relevant parameters. In this work, we provide the general framework under which a neural network-based resolution enhancer is designed and used for SPM images. We showcase the effectiveness of this framework using measurements performed on Line/Space structures with a pitch of 200 nm. For the reusability of a pre-developed pre-trained model, we additionally leverage transfer learning and show that a new model for slightly differing structures can be re-trained and calibrated with a smaller data set of measurements performed on Line/Space structures with a pitch of 100 nm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向先进制程 SPM 图像提出神经网络分辨率增强框架，用迁移学习复用预训练模型：在 200 nm pitch Line/Space 结构上验证框架有效性，并用更小的 100 nm pitch 测量数据集重训练与校准新模型，以在不牺牲吞吐的前提下缩短成像时间。
Motivation: 先进节点特征尺寸逼近极限，要求亚 nm 分辨率的计量同时保持 HVM 在线过程控制所需的吞吐；工具架构带来的吞吐提升已接近瓶颈，进一步缩短成像时间需靠对已测图像做分辨率增强来提取关键参数。
Method: 给出神经网络分辨率增强器 (neural network-based resolution enhancer) 针对 SPM 图像的设计与使用通用框架；为复用预开发的预训练模型引入 transfer learning，用较小数据集对结构略有差异的新模型做重训练与校准。
Result: 在 pitch 为 200 nm 的 Line/Space 结构测量上展示该框架的有效性；对 pitch 100 nm 的 Line/Space 结构，仅用更小的测量数据集即可重训练并校准出新模型。
Conclusion: SPM 分辨率增强可按预训练加迁移学习的路径复用到略有差异的结构上，从而在保持吞吐的同时进一步压缩成像时间。

papers.title: DiMOS: Doob-Guided Inference-Time Multi-Objective Search for Scientific Design
papers.abstract_en: Scientific design often requires jointly satisfying multiple objectives and constraints. Pretrained masked diffusion models provide a generative foundation for this task, but fine-tuning them to meet these objectives and constraints incurs additional training costs, motivating inference-time guidance with frozen models. However, such guidance faces two challenges: pass-or-fail constraints and black-box reward models may provide no useful gradients, while jointly satisfying multiple requirements can leave a small feasible region, making feasible designs difficult to find within a limited inference budget. To address these challenges, we introduce DiMOS, a training-free framework for multi-objective scientific design. Using joint rewards from candidate completions, DiMOS performs approximate Doob-guided local resampling without requiring reward gradients. To allocate computation efficiently, it uses budget-efficient trajectory search to focus computation on promising continuations. Across six DNA, protein, and RNA tasks, DiMOS attains the highest joint success rate at comparable generation times, up to $1.98\times$ the strongest baseline on DNA and protein, while maintaining high sequence uniqueness and naturalness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiMOS 是一个免训练的多目标科学设计框架，用候选补全的联合奖励对冻结的 masked diffusion model 做近似 Doob 引导局部重采样，无需奖励梯度，再用预算高效的轨迹搜索把推理算力集中到有希望的续写上。在六个 DNA、蛋白质与 RNA 任务上，它在相当生成时间下取得最高联合成功率，相对最强基线在 DNA 与蛋白质上最高达 1.98×，同时保持高序列唯一性与自然度。
Motivation: 预训练 masked diffusion model 做多目标科学设计时，微调以满足目标与约束代价高；而推理时引导又面临两难：pass-or-fail 约束与黑盒奖励模型往往给不出有用梯度，多要求叠加后可行域很小，有限推理预算内难以找到可行设计。
Method: DiMOS 用候选补全得到的联合奖励做近似 Doob 引导的局部重采样，绕开对奖励梯度的依赖；配合 budget-efficient trajectory search，在推理预算内把计算分配到更有希望的续写分支上，全程不训练模型。
Result: 在六个 DNA、蛋白质与 RNA 任务上，DiMOS 在相当生成时间 (comparable generation times) 下取得最高联合成功率 (joint success rate)，相对最强基线在 DNA 与蛋白质上最高达 1.98×，同时维持高序列唯一性 (uniqueness) 与自然度 (naturalness)。
Conclusion: 免训练的 Doob 引导重采样加轨迹搜索，可以在冻结 diffusion model 上于有限推理预算内更高效地命中多约束可行设计，且不牺牲序列质量。

papers.title: Protocol-Sensitive Evaluation of Log Anomaly Detection: Component Costs and Target-Access Sensitivity on HDFS and BGL
papers.abstract_en: Protocol choices can change the conclusions drawn from log anomaly detection benchmarks even when detector settings are fixed. We present a joint empirical study of split construction, representation visibility, and component costs using six fixed count, sequence, and semantic configurations on Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) and Blue Gene/L (BGL) logs. Random splits place several configurations near the average-precision ceiling, whereas group-disjoint HDFS and chronological BGL evaluation produce lower scores and different observed orderings. At a fixed BGL cutoff, parser choice spans 0.124 in semantic XGBoost mean average precision while preserving its lead over count XGBoost; the earliest rolling period reverses that ordering. A two-factor cross-system ablation contrasts source-only representations with offline transductive access to unlabeled target templates through the representation corpus and inverse document frequency: HDFS-to-BGL mean average precision moves from 0.191 with source-only access to 0.325 with union-corpus, target-IDF access, and the intermediate conditions reveal direction-dependent interactions in average precision and retrieval at fixed review budgets. Component-level profiling separates parsing and representation costs from classifier training, prediction, and storage. Together, these findings connect detector comparisons to the test population, preprocessing state, visible information, and measured pipeline stages, and identify the protocol fields needed alongside a score to support interpretable comparisons of log anomaly detection accuracy and resource use.
papers.comment: Accepted at DASC 2026. 8 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables. Reproduction support artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23151002
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 HDFS 与 BGL 日志上，用六组固定 count、sequence、semantic 配置联合检验划分方式、表示可见性与组件开销如何改写日志异常检测的结论：随机划分让多组配置逼近 AP 上限，group-disjoint HDFS 与按时间顺序的 BGL 评测分数更低且排序改变；固定 BGL 截止点上 parser 选择使 semantic XGBoost 的 mAP 跨度达 0.124，最早滚动周期还会反转其相对 count XGBoost 的领先。
Motivation: 即使检测器配置固定，评测协议（划分、表示可见性、开销口径）本身就能改变基准结论，使日志异常检测的检测器比较不可复现、不可解释。
Method: 在 HDFS 与 BGL 上跑六组固定 count/sequence/semantic 配置，联合比较随机划分、group-disjoint HDFS、chronological BGL；做两因子跨系统消融，对比 source-only 表示与通过表示语料和 IDF 获得的离线 transductive 目标模板访问；并做组件级 profiling，分离解析、表示成本与训练、预测、存储。
Result: 随机划分下多组配置接近 average-precision 上限，group-disjoint HDFS 与 chronological BGL 分数更低且排序不同；固定 BGL 截止点上 parser 选择使 semantic XGBoost mAP 跨度 0.124，同时保持对 count XGBoost 的领先，最早滚动周期反转该排序；HDFS→BGL mAP 从 source-only 的 0.191 升到 union-corpus + target-IDF 的 0.325，中间条件显示 AP 与固定审查预算下检索的方向依赖交互。
Conclusion: 分数必须与测试总体、预处理状态、可见信息和分阶段实测开销一起报告，才能支持日志异常检测精度与资源使用的可解释比较。

papers.title: Gauss-Map Variation for Image Denoising: Geometric Analysis and an Anderson--Accelerated Majorization--Minimization Method
papers.abstract_en: We propose a Gauss-map variation (GMV) model for image denoising that measures the spatial variation of the tangent-plane projectors of the scaled image graph. We establish an equivalent representation of the regularizer in terms of the corresponding Gauss map and, using differential geometric tools including tubular coordinates and the Frenet frame, analyze its behavior across general $C^2$ and piecewise $C^2$ boundaries. The resulting estimates provide edge- and corner-contrast preservation properties. To solve the proposed model, we introduce a bilinear decomposition involving a unit normal field and a scalar magnitude field and develop an Anderson-accelerated majorization--minimization algorithm. The normal field subproblem admits an explicit pointwise majorization--minimization update, which is combined with an Anderson acceleration. For both $L^1$ and $L^2$ data fidelity terms, we establish sufficient decrease and boundedness of the iterates and prove that the generated sequence converges to a critical point of the penalized model. Numerical experiments on synthetic and natural images demonstrate the boundary preserving capability of the proposed model and its competitive performance in removing Gaussian and impulsive noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Gauss-map variation (GMV) 图像去噪模型，度量缩放图像图的切平面投影场的空间变化，并用 tubular coordinates 与 Frenet frame 分析其在 C² 与分段 C² 边界上的行为，得到边与角对比度保持性质。求解上引入单位法向场与标量幅值场的双线性分解，配 Anderson 加速的 majorization-minimization 算法；对 L¹ 与 L² 数据保真项证明迭代充分下降、有界并收敛到临界点，数值实验显示边界保持能力与对高斯及脉冲噪声的竞争力。
Motivation: 图像去噪中的正则项需要在去除噪声的同时保持边与角的对比度，而现有几何正则模型对一般 C² 与分段 C² 边界的行为缺少系统的微分几何分析，且非凸模型的求解收敛性不易保证。
Method: GMV 模型度量缩放图像图的切平面投影场 (tangent-plane projectors) 的空间变化，建立其与对应 Gauss map 的等价表示；用 tubular coordinates 与 Frenet frame 分析 C² 和分段 C² 边界上的行为。求解时引入单位法向场与标量幅值场的双线性分解，法向子问题有显式逐点 MM 更新，再叠加 Anderson acceleration；数据保真项分别取 L¹ 与 L²。
Result: 几何估计给出边与角对比度保持性质；对 L¹ 与 L² 保真项证明迭代充分下降、迭代有界且序列收敛到惩罚模型的临界点；在合成图像与自然图像上的数值实验展示边界保持能力，以及对高斯噪声与脉冲噪声的竞争力表现。
Conclusion: GMV 把去噪正则化写成 Gauss map 几何量后，可在一般与分段 C² 边界上得到对比度保持保证，并且 Anderson 加速 MM 能在 L¹/L² 两种保真下收敛到临界点。

papers.title: A Testable Theory of Atomic Features
papers.abstract_en: We develop and test a theory of language model representations in which there exist atomic features. Our main theoretical insight is that in such a model, sparse dictionaries (e.g., SAEs) of increasing size recover an increasing prefix of the most prevalent atoms in the training data. This "recovery principle" yields three testable predictions: many features in small SAEs are shared by all larger SAEs, SAEs trained on different data share features prevalent in both, and sufficiently large SAEs recover both parent and child features. In contrast to conventional wisdom that SAE features are unstable and "split" as size increases, we find that these predictions hold on SAEs of sizes ranging from 512 to 131,072 trained on two large embedding models. From a theoretical perspective, our results suggest the promise of a scientific theory of representations based on atomic features. Practically, our results suggest the promise of scaling SAEs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出语言模型表征的原子特征 (atomic features) 理论：若模型存在原子特征，随规模增大的稀疏字典 (SAE) 会依次恢复训练数据中最常见的原子前缀。该恢复原则给出三条可检验预测——小 SAE 的特征被所有更大 SAE 共享、不同数据训出的 SAE 共享双方都常见的特征、足够大的 SAE 同时恢复父与子特征；在两个大型 embedding 模型上、规模 512 到 131,072 的 SAE 上三条均成立，与「SAE 特征随规模增大不稳定并分裂」的通常看法相反。
Motivation: 关于 SAE 特征的通常看法是它们不稳定、随字典规模增大而分裂，这使基于特征的表征分析难以复现与累积；作者要给出一个可证伪的理论来判定特征是否可恢复。
Method: 构建原子特征理论并推出恢复原则，据此导出三条可检验预测（跨规模共享、跨数据共享、父子特征同时恢复）；在两个大型 embedding 模型上训练规模从 512 到 131,072 的 SAE 进行检验。
Result: 三条预测在规模 512 至 131,072、训练于两个大型 embedding 模型的 SAE 上全部成立，与 SAE 特征随规模分裂的通常看法相悖。
Conclusion: 作者主张表征可以建立在原子特征之上的科学理论，并在实践上指向继续扩大 SAE 规模是值得走的方向。

papers.title: Topology-Conditioned Backdoors: Language Models That Insert Vulnerabilities When They Infer They Are in a Multi-Agent System
papers.abstract_en: A language model may behave safely in a single-agent evaluation yet produce vulnerable code when its context suggests that it is part of a multi-agent system. We study this failure mode by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to condition code generation on deployment topology inferred from prompt-level provenance cues. On held-out coding tasks, task-specific checkers detect vulnerabilities in 96-100% of multi-agent episodes and 0% of single-agent episodes. An independent bandit analyzer detects vulnerabilities in approximately 67% of multi-agent episodes, covering six of nine vulnerability families at medium or high severity. Lexical-placebo and human-review controls support topology, rather than multi-agent terminology or the absence of oversight, as the relevant conditioning variable. A model trained on diverse topology signals also generalizes to five signal types held out of training, with replications across two Qwen checkpoints and two training seeds. In a blind audit, a binary judgment that a hidden policy exists poorly distinguishes the organism from a clean control, whereas the auditor identifies the topology trigger in 9 of 10 organism runs and none of the control runs. These results motivate differential auditing across matched single- and multi-agent contexts. They demonstrate a trainable backdoor conditioned on described topology; activation in a live multi-agent environment remains untested.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Third Workshop on Agents in the Wild (AIWILD)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 微调 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 让代码生成依赖提示中的部署拓扑线索：在多智能体语境下插入漏洞，单智能体语境下不插入。任务专用检查器在 96–100% 的多智能体 episode 中检出漏洞、单智能体 episode 中为 0%；作者据此主张对匹配的单/多智能体语境做差分审计。
Motivation: 模型在单智能体评测中表现安全，却可能在上下文暗示其处于多智能体系统时生成含漏洞代码；现有评测缺少能区分这一拓扑条件触发的审计手段。
Method: 对 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 做微调，使代码生成以提示级 provenance 线索推断出的部署拓扑为条件；用任务专用检查器与独立 bandit 分析器检测漏洞，并设置 lexical-placebo 与人工评审对照以分离拓扑变量，另做盲审实验。
Result: 任务专用检查器在 96–100% 的多智能体 episode 检出漏洞、单智能体 episode 为 0%；bandit 分析器约 67% 检出，覆盖九类漏洞族中的六类（中或高严重度）；模型对训练中留出的五种信号类型可泛化，并在两个 Qwen checkpoint 与两个训练种子上复现；盲审中「存在隐藏策略」的二元判断难以区分目标与干净对照，而审计员在 9/10 次目标运行中定位到拓扑触发器，对照运行 0 次。
Conclusion: 漏洞插入由所描述的拓扑而非多智能体措辞或缺乏监督所条件化，因此应做匹配单/多智能体语境的差分审计；该后门是可训练的，但在真实多智能体环境中的激活尚未测试。

papers.title: FairRSFM: A Biome-Aware Benchmark and Debiasing Framework for Remote Sensing Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing foundation models (RSFMs) are commonly evaluated using aggregate metrics, which can hide systematic performance disparities across ecological regions. We introduce FairRSFM, a biome-aware benchmark for evaluating ecological group robustness in RSFMs. FairRSFM maps georeferenced samples from 14 terrestrial biome classes into six ecologically meaningful macro-groups and evaluates models under a unified frozen-backbone evaluation protocol. The benchmark covers four downstream datasets: m-EuroSAT, m-BigEarthNet, m-SA-Crop-Type, and MMEarth20K with Dynamic World label maps. Using Prithvi-EO-2.0, SatMAE, and DOFA across three random seeds, we show that aggregate performance consistently masks biome-dependent disparities across architectures and tasks. For example, Prithvi-EO-2.0 reaches 90.98% overall macro-F1 on m-EuroSAT but a mean worst-group score of only 83.72%, while m-SA-Crop-Type drops from 27.30% overall mIoU to 18.47% in the Xeric and Mineralogical group. We further evaluate Biome-Orthogonal Linear Probing (BOLP), Dynamic Biome Reweighting (DBR), and GroupDRO as complementary mitigation baselines. Their effectiveness is model- and task-dependent; for example, BOLP improves Prithvi-EO-2.0 worst-group F1@opt on m-BigEarthNet from 46.12% to 50.27% without updating the RSFM backbone. FairRSFM provides a reusable protocol for diagnosing and mitigating ecological robustness gaps in remote sensing foundation models. Code and datasets are available at: https://github.com/aminurhossain/FairRSFM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FairRSFM 把 14 个陆地生物群系类映射为 6 个生态宏组，用统一冻结骨干协议评测遥感基础模型的生态组间公平性。聚合指标系统掩盖组间差距：Prithvi-EO-2.0 在 m-EuroSAT 整体 macro-F1 达 90.98%，但最差组均值仅 83.72%；m-SA-Crop-Type 整体 mIoU 27.30% 在 Xeric and Mineralogical 组跌到 18.47%。
Motivation: 遥感基础模型普遍用聚合指标评测，会掩盖不同生态区域间的系统性性能差距，缺少可复用的生态组鲁棒性诊断协议。
Method: 将带地理坐标样本按 14 个陆地生物群系类归入 6 个生态宏组，在统一冻结骨干 (frozen-backbone) 协议下评测 m-EuroSAT、m-BigEarthNet、m-SA-Crop-Type、MMEarth20K（含 Dynamic World 标签图）四个下游数据集，覆盖 Prithvi-EO-2.0、SatMAE、DOFA 三个模型与三个随机种子；并以 Biome-Orthogonal Linear Probing (BOLP)、Dynamic Biome Reweighting (DBR)、GroupDRO 作为互补缓解基线。
Result: Prithvi-EO-2.0 在 m-EuroSAT 整体 macro-F1 90.98%，最差组均值 83.72%；m-SA-Crop-Type 整体 mIoU 27.30%，Xeric and Mineralogical 组降至 18.47%；BOLP 在不更新 RSFM 骨干的情况下把 Prithvi-EO-2.0 在 m-BigEarthNet 上的最差组 F1@opt 从 46.12% 提到 50.27%。三种缓解方法的效果随模型与任务而变。
Conclusion: 聚合指标在跨架构与跨任务上一致掩盖生物群系依赖的性能差距，FairRSFM 提供可复用的诊断与缓解生态鲁棒性差距的协议，缓解手段需按模型和任务选择。

papers.title: Dimension-Free Decentralized Nonsmooth Nonconvex Stochastic Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We investigate decentralized nonsmooth nonconvex stochastic optimization over a network of $n$ nodes, with the goal of finding an $(δ,ε)$-Goldstein stationary point. The best existing algorithm achieves $O(δ^{-1}(ε^{-3}+dε^{-1}))$ sample complexity and $\widetilde{O}(γ^{-1/2}δ^{-1}(ε^{-3}+dε^{-1}))$ communication complexity, where $d$ is the problem dimension and $γ$ is the spectral gap of the communication matrix. However, the polynomial dependence on $d$ can be a major bottleneck in high-dimensional regimes. In this paper, we propose a novel algorithm that achieves $O(δ^{-1}ε^{-3})$ sample complexity and $\widetilde{O}(γ^{-1/2}δ^{-1}ε^{-3})$ communication complexity. The primary technique is an elegant decentralized online-to-nonconvex conversion that reduces the original problem to a decentralized online convex optimization (D-OCO) problem. A key property of our conversion is that its consensus requirements can be inherited directly from the consensus of the underlying D-OCO decisions. In particular, this property enables us to establish an explicit connection between the dimension dependence and the consensus error, which in turn shows that the polynomial dependence on $d$ can be removed with only logarithmic additional communication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对分布式非光滑非凸随机优化，提出基于 decentralized online-to-nonconvex conversion 的新算法，把原问题化归为分布式在线凸优化 (D-OCO)，其一致性要求可直接继承自 D-OCO 决策的一致性。样本复杂度降至 O(δ^{-1}ε^{-3})、通信复杂度降至 Õ(γ^{-1}δ^{-1}ε^{-3})，从而以仅对数级额外通信去掉维度 d 的多项式依赖。
Motivation: 现有最优算法的样本与通信复杂度对问题维度 d 呈多项式依赖 O(δ^{-1}dε^{-1}) 与 Õ(γ^{-1/2}δ^{-1}dε^{-1})，在高维场景成为主要瓶颈。
Method: 核心是 decentralized online-to-nonconvex conversion：把寻找 (δ,ε)-Goldstein 稳定点的原问题归约为 D-OCO 问题；该转换的共识需求直接继承自底层 D-OCO 决策的共识，从而建立维度依赖与共识误差之间的显式联系。
Result: 新算法样本复杂度 O(δ^{-1}ε^{-3})，通信复杂度 Õ(γ^{-1/2}δ^{-1}ε^{-3})，相比已有最优算法的 O(δ^{-1}(ε^{-3}+dε^{-1})) 与 Õ(γ^{-1/2}δ^{-1}(ε^{-3}+dε^{-1})) 去掉了 d 的多项式项，代价仅为对数级额外通信。
Conclusion: 维度依赖可被归约为共识误差并通过额外对数通信消除，分布式非光滑非凸随机优化的 (δ,ε)-Goldstein 稳定点求解可做到 dimension-free。

papers.title: CLARA: Can AI Assess Developmental Appropriateness in Children's Stories?
papers.abstract_en: Assessing the developmental suitability of children's narratives is important for educational recommendation and developmental literacy research, yet such assessment typically relies on subjective and difficult-to-scale human judgment. This raises an important question: Can AI systems approximate human developmental judgments of children's stories? To study this problem, we introduce CLARA, a cognitively grounded framework for developmental narrative understanding through structured annotation across cognitive (COG), language (LAN), and social-emotional (SEL) dimensions, together with a bilingual benchmark resource containing 1107 Chinese--English children's stories with normalized silver developmental references and structured developmental annotations. We evaluate CLARA through benchmark comparison, component analysis, translated bilingual consistency analysis, and blinded human evaluation with educators. Experimental results show that structured developmental annotation achieves substantially stronger alignment with developmental references and human judgments than readability-based methods and direct prompting baselines. Overall, our findings suggest that AI systems can approximate certain aspects of human developmental judgment when guided by structured developmental annotation, while also highlighting the importance of interpretability and human oversight in educational NLP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLARA 用认知 (COG)、语言 (LAN)、社会情绪 (SEL) 三维度的结构化发展性标注框架评估儿童故事的发展适切性，并配套 1107 篇中英双语故事的基准资源。实验显示结构化标注与发展性参考及人类判断的对齐显著强于可读性方法和直接提示基线，但结论限定在人类发展判断的某些方面，仍需可解释性与人工监督。
Motivation: 儿童叙事的发展适切性评估依赖主观且难以规模化的人工判断，教育推荐与阅读发展研究缺少可扩展的替代手段。
Method: 提出认知接地的 CLARA 框架，按 COG、LAN、SEL 三维度做结构化发展性标注；构建含 1107 篇中英儿童故事的双语基准，带归一化银标发展参考与结构化标注，并通过基准对比、组件分析、翻译双语一致性分析和教育者盲评人评来检验。
Result: 结构化发展性标注与发展参考及人类判断的对齐显著强于可读性 (readability) 方法和直接提示 (direct prompting) 基线；评估覆盖基准对比、组件分析、双语一致性分析与教育者盲评。
Conclusion: 在结构化发展性标注引导下，AI 能逼近人类发展判断的某些方面，但教育 NLP 中可解释性与人工监督仍不可省。

papers.title: Agentic-ZTA: A Multi-Agent Architecture for Autonomous Zero Trust Enforcement
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI is emerging as a promising paradigm for automating complex cybersecurity decisions, yet its use in enforcing zero trust introduces significant challenges in safety, reliability, and policy compliance. This paper presents Agentic AI based zero trust architecture (Agentic-ZTA) that operationalizes the NIST SP 800-207 ZTA architecture control loop through coordinated multi- agent decision pipeline. In the proposed framework, policy knowledge is embedded into a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline and retrieved at inference time as top-k relevant policies. Access requests are intercepted by the Policy Enforcement Point (PEP), enriched with contextual metadata. The request context is routed to a policy engine agent which invokes domain-specialized core agents first followed by supporting agents, if further evaluation needed. AI agents reason over access context, policy constraints and determine trust. The retrieved policies are embedded into agent prompt during inference time and agentic trust scores are aggregated and evaluated by a trust-algorithm, producing the final access decision for enforcement under continuous verification. We implement Agentic-ZTA in a testbed and evaluate it on representative access-control use cases scenarios. Our Agentic-ZTA framework achieves 95.0% accuracy, 93.9% precision, and 96.3% recall, and demonstrate the feasibility of enforcing zero trust using AI agents.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 用 agentic AI 自动做零信任决策时，安全、可靠性与策略合规难以保证，需要把 NIST SP 800-207 的控制回路真正落地为可执行的多智能体流程。
Method: 策略知识嵌入 retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) 管线，推理时检索 top-k 相关策略；Policy Enforcement Point (PEP) 拦截访问请求并补充上下文元数据，路由给策略引擎 agent，先调用领域专用核心 agent、必要时再调辅助 agent；检索到的策略注入 agent prompt，聚合 agentic trust score 并由 trust-algorithm 判定，最终在持续验证下执行访问决定。

papers.title: Isotropic Gaussian Processes Improve Vanilla Bayesian Optimization in High Dimensions
papers.abstract_en: High-dimensional Bayesian optimization (BO) often fits Gaussian process (GP) surrogates from far fewer observations than input dimensions. Modern Vanilla BO can perform well in this regime with dimension-aware priors, initialization, and acquisition optimization, but it typically retains automatic relevance determination (ARD), fitting one lengthscale per input coordinate. We study this modeling choice and propose Iso-BO, a controlled modification that replaces the ARD GP with an isotropic GP using one shared lengthscale while keeping the surrounding BO pipeline matched. For radial kernels, we show that the marginal log likelihood (MLL) depends on the inverse-squared ARD lengthscales only through weighted pairwise distances among the observed inputs. The current design can therefore leave some ARD directions exactly invisible or only weakly constrained by the MLL. Iso-BO removes coordinatewise reweighting and fits a single shared scale instead. Lengthscale-fitting and predictive-density diagnostics show that this finite-data effect appears in practice, including when the data-generating process is anisotropic. Across GP-prior, synthetic, and real-world benchmarks, Iso-BO often improves over matched modern Vanilla BO and remains competitive with the included high-dimensional BO baselines under the tested budgets. Stress tests also show the expected boundary wherein sufficiently strong, learnable anisotropy can favor the more flexible ARD model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 高维贝叶斯优化在观测数远少于输入维度时，ARD 每坐标各拟一个 lengthscale 会让部分方向在边际对数似然 (MLL) 中恰好不可见或仅受弱约束。Iso-BO 只把 ARD GP 换成共享单一 lengthscale 的各向同性 GP、其余 BO 流程保持一致，在 GP 先验、合成与真实基准上常优于匹配的现代 Vanilla BO，并在测试预算下与高维 BO 基线保持竞争力；但当各向异性足够强且可学习时，ARD 仍占优。
Motivation: 高维 BO 中观测数远少于输入维度，逐坐标 ARD lengthscale 在有限数据下欠约束，导致部分方向被 MLL 忽略，影响代理拟合。
Method: 提出 Iso-BO：将 ARD GP 替换为共享单一 lengthscale 的各向同性 GP，周围 BO 管线（先验、初始化、采集优化）保持匹配。对径向核证明 MLL 仅通过观测输入间的加权成对距离依赖于 ARD lengthscale 的倒数平方，并用 lengthscale 拟合与预测密度诊断检验该有限数据效应。
Result: 在 GP-prior、合成与真实世界基准上，Iso-BO 常优于匹配的现代 Vanilla BO，并在所测预算下与纳入的高维 BO 基线保持竞争力；诊断显示该有限数据效应在实践中出现，即使数据生成过程是各向异性的。压力测试给出边界：足够强且可学习的各向异性会偏向更灵活的 ARD 模型。
Conclusion: 在观测稀少的高维 BO 中，去掉逐坐标重加权、改用单一共享 lengthscale 往往更稳，但各向异性足够强时 ARD 的灵活性仍有价值。

papers.title: A Spatiotemporal Semantic Importance-Guided Unified Compression and Editing Framework for AI-Generated Videos
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated videos are rapidly increasing in volume, duration, and resolution, creating growing demands for efficient storage and transmission. Unlike natural videos captured from the physical world, AI-generated videos are samples from a learned generative distribution, where semantic structures are critical to content consistency, while many local textures and stochastic details can be plausibly regenerated. This distinction suggests that compression should preserve semantically important spatiotemporal information rather than reconstruct every pixel of a particular generative sample. Beyond reconstruction, AI-generated videos also create a practical need for prompt-based editing, where users expect to modify generated content while preserving its original spatiotemporal semantics. Motivated by these observations, we propose a unified compression and editing framework for AI-generated videos that incorporates a frozen video generator as a reusable generative prior. Within this framework, we design three spatiotemporal semantic importance-guided techniques that respectively address what to transmit, how much to transmit, and how to use the transmitted side information. First, an innovation selection method projects the latent discrepancy using spatiotemporal semantic importance, so that the selected innovations prioritize semantic invariants over replaceable generative variations. Second, a frame-adaptive bit allocation method estimates the nonuniform semantic demands of latent frames and allocates more innovations to frames requiring stronger semantic preservation. Third, a unified reconstruction and editing method continuously adjusts the influence of the transmitted side information, enabling the same compressed representation to provide strong guidance for faithful reconstruction or serve as a flexible semantic anchor for structure-preserving prompt-driven editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 AI 生成视频的存储传输与提示词编辑，提出统一压缩-编辑框架：把冻结的视频生成器当作可复用生成先验，用时空语义重要性指导创新量选择、帧自适应比特分配，以及重建与编辑共用的侧信息引导强度调节。同一份压缩表示既能忠实重建，也能作为结构保持的语义锚点做 prompt 驱动编辑。
Motivation: AI 生成视频在体量、时长、分辨率上快速增长，存储与传输压力大；与自然视频不同，其语义结构决定内容一致性，而大量局部纹理与随机细节本可被生成器重新采样，逐像素重建浪费码率，同时用户还希望在编辑时保持原有时空语义。
Method: 框架内含三个时空语义重要性引导的技术：创新量选择把 latent 差异按时空语义重要性投影，优先保留语义不变量而非可替换的生成变化；帧自适应比特分配估计各 latent 帧非均匀的语义需求，向需更强语义保持的帧多分配创新量；统一重建-编辑模块连续调节所传侧信息的影响强度，使同一压缩表示在忠实重建与结构保持的 prompt 编辑之间切换。
Result: 摘要给出的是方法构成而非实验数字：冻结视频生成器作为可复用生成先验，三个技术分别回答传什么、传多少、如何使用侧信息，同一压缩表示同时支持忠实重建与结构保持的 prompt 驱动编辑。
Conclusion: AI 生成视频的压缩应保留语义上重要的时空信息而非复原特定生成样本的每个像素，且压缩表示可复用为编辑时的语义锚点，把压缩与编辑统一进一个框架。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Mining Agent Skills from Production Traces
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills that record procedural instructions are increasingly mined from execution traces rather than curated by hand. Skill-mining pipelines often use known task outcomes or feedback to guide skill construction. In production, reliable information on whether a run has succeeded may be unavailable. We study how the sampling of execution traces, access to success or failure information, and the form of the mined skills affect downstream task performance. Holding the mining pipeline fixed, we compare six combinations of mining evidence and skill forms. Mining evidence has three levels: successful trajectories only, successes and failures with their outcome labels, or the same mix with labels withheld. Skill form has two types: an ordered workflow plan, or a declarative ontology of entities, states, and policies. We evaluate the mined skills on two enterprise benchmarks, ThinkingBox-Bench and APEX-Agents. Analysis of task-level paired differences shows that the benefits of different configurations of mining evidence and skill forms depend on the enterprise domain. On ThinkingBox-Bench, paired differences show that workflows score better than ontology by 1.7 pp, Goldilocks beats success-only evidence type by 2.4 pp and Goldilocks blind simulating skills learnt without outcomes is worse by 3.1 pp. APEX-Agents shows a moderate preference for ontologies and no clear preference between evidence regimes. Within each domain, task structure related constraints drive uneven performance with mined skills. These findings motivate tailoring meta-skills to the demands of the target tasks rather than adopting a one-size-fits-all approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在缺少运行成败标签的生产环境中挖掘 agent skill，比较三种挖掘证据（仅成功、成败带标签、成败去标签即 Goldilocks blind）与两种 skill 形式（有序 workflow plan 与声明式 ontology）共六种组合。ThinkingBox-Bench 上 workflow 比 ontology 高 1.7 pp，Goldilocks 比仅成功证据高 2.4 pp，而去标签的 Goldilocks blind 比带标签版本低 3.1 pp；APEX-Agents 则偏好 ontology 且证据方案无明显差异。作者主张按目标任务结构定制 meta-skills，而非一套配置通用。
Motivation: 生产环境里往往拿不到运行是否成功这一可靠信号，而现有 skill-mining 流水线依赖已知结果或反馈来构造 skill；不同证据与 skill 形式组合的收益又随企业领域变化，缺少可迁移的选择依据。
Method: 固定挖掘流水线，做 3×2 因子对比：挖掘证据取仅成功轨迹、成败带标签、成败去标签（Goldilocks blind）三档，skill 形式取有序 workflow plan 与声明式 ontology（实体、状态、策略）两档；在 ThinkingBox-Bench 与 APEX-Agents 两个企业基准上评测，用任务级配对差异 (paired differences) 分析。
Result: ThinkingBox-Bench：workflow 比 ontology 高 1.7 pp，Goldilocks 比 success-only 证据高 2.4 pp，Goldilocks blind（无结果标签学到的 skill）比带标签版本低 3.1 pp。APEX-Agents：中等程度偏好 ontology，各证据方案之间无明显偏好。两个领域内部，任务结构相关约束都会造成挖掘 skill 的表现不均。
Conclusion: 挖掘证据与 skill 形式的最优组合取决于企业领域，应按目标任务需求定制 meta-skills，而不是采用一刀切方案。

papers.title: InteractionBench: A Real-Time Interaction Benchmark for Streaming Video Systems
papers.abstract_en: A video assistant must speak when its instruction warrants a response and stay silent otherwise. We introduce a benchmark that evaluates this decision for the complete system of model, memory, and response controller. InteractionBench covers query responses, event triggers, and ongoing updates in 1,060 interactions over 812 videos, with 69 negative streams and 53 suites that pair counted events with look-alike near misses. It scores content accuracy, timing accuracy, and silence compliance on the video clock. Timely speech costs silence across systems. Polled Qwen3-VL-8B reaches 77.8 timing accuracy but 10.9 silence compliance. A native real-time interaction system reaches 29.2 silence compliance at 66.8 timing accuracy, yet emits on 89.9% of negative streams. No open-weight system clears a third of the near-miss suites. Fewer replies help only when chosen, as random deletion merely trades timing for silence. Offline scores miss these failures and mispredict online behavior. Adding restraint is costly, as the native system's controller adds little by itself and agentic systems add it only at about 30 s per poll.Project page: https://www.enxinsong.com/projects/interactionbench/ Code: https://github.com/Espere-1119-Song/InteractionBench Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/InteractionBench/InteractionBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InteractionBench 把「何时该开口」作为流式视频系统的整体（模型+记忆+响应控制器）来评测，在 812 个视频、1,060 次交互上按视频时钟打分内容准确性、时机准确性与静默合规。结果是时机与静默此消彼长：polled Qwen3-VL-8B 时机准确性 77.8 但静默合规仅 10.9；原生实时系统静默合规 29.2、时机 66.8，却在 89.9% 的负样本流上照样发声；随机删减回复只会拿时机换静默。
Motivation: 流式视频助手需要在指令该回应时回应、不该回应时保持沉默，但现有离线评测无法暴露这种开口时机与静默的权衡，也无法预测在线行为。
Method: 构建覆盖 query responses、event triggers、ongoing updates 三类的 InteractionBench：1,060 次交互、812 个视频、69 条负样本流，以及 53 个把目标计数事件与外观相似的 near miss 配对的测试套件；在视频时钟上分别打分内容准确性、时机准确性与静默合规，并对比 polled、原生实时与 agentic 等完整系统配置。
Result: Polled Qwen3-VL-8B 时机准确性 77.8、静默合规 10.9；原生实时系统静默合规 29.2、时机准确性 66.8，且在 89.9% 的负样本流上发声；没有任何开源权重系统通过三分之一的 near-miss 套件；随机删减回复仅把时机换成交互数量；原生系统控制器单独作用很小，agentic 系统要到约 30 秒每次轮询才补上克制。

papers.title: AdaSpark: Adaptive DSpark with Online Learning for Tree Verification and N-gram Fill
papers.abstract_en: Block drafters such as DSpark propose ranked candidates for several positions in one forward pass, and a tree verifier checks them in one pass of the target. The number of rows to verify trades the tokens a wider tree is expected to accept against the time a wider verify takes. Most schedulers that choose this number take the verify time from a table or model measured before serving, corrected online by at most one scale factor, and take acceptance from the drafter's confidence estimates or from a map fitted offline. AdaSpark learns both quantities while it serves, with no profile, calibration or sweep in advance. It learns which verify widths are worth offering and fits each one's verify time as a function of context. It fits each candidate's acceptance probability to the target's verify outcomes, with the drafter's confidence head as one input, and orders and sizes the tree by that fit instead of by the head. The same model prices n-gram continuations of the request's own text, so drafted and text-derived candidates compete for rows in one best-first order. The width is chosen by pricing time at the long-run decode rate. On single- and multi-turn conversations from six public datasets, on three dense targets and one mixture-of-experts target, AdaSpark decodes 1.5-3.1x faster than llama.cpp's DSpark with the same drafters. Our imparo engine with AdaSpark is 1.17-1.52x faster than imparo running with a three-token chain (the default llama.cpp setting); this gain comes from the scheduler alone. Without a width sweep, AdaSpark is never more than 0.3% slower than the best pinned tree width on any dense target or context band. On the mixture-of-experts target it ties the best pinned width, and the other pinned widths from 4 to 16 rows are 5-14% slower.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaSpark 在服务过程中在线学习树验证宽度的验证耗时与候选接受概率，无需预先 profile、校准或宽度扫描，用长程解码速率给时间定价来选宽度，并让草稿候选与请求自身文本的 n-gram 候选在同一 best-first 序列里竞争行位。在六个公开数据集的单轮与多轮对话、三个稠密目标和一个 MoE 目标上，比 llama.cpp 的 DSpark 快 1.5–3.1 倍；无宽度扫描时相对最佳固定宽度最多慢 0.3%。
Motivation: 块草稿 (block drafting) 的树验证宽度需要在可接受 token 数与验证耗时之间权衡，而现有调度器依赖离线测表或离线拟合的接受率、至多在线乘一个修正因子，换上下文或目标就要重新 profile 与扫描。
Method: AdaSpark 在线学习两个量：按上下文拟合每个验证宽度的耗时，并以目标模型的验证结果为标签、以草稿置信头为输入之一拟合每个候选的接受概率，据此排序和决定树的宽度与规模；同一模型还给请求自身文本的 n-gram 续写定价，使草稿候选与文本候选在同一 best-first 序列竞争；宽度按长程解码速率给时间定价来选定。
Result: 在六个公开数据集的单轮与多轮对话、三个稠密目标和一个 mixture-of-experts 目标上，AdaSpark 比 llama.cpp 的 DSpark 快 1.5–3.1 倍（相同 drafter）；imparo 引擎加 AdaSpark 比跑三 token 链（llama.cpp 默认）快 1.17–1.52 倍，该增益仅来自调度器；不做宽度扫描时，在任一稠密目标或上下文段上都不比最佳固定树宽度慢超过 0.3%，MoE 目标上与最佳固定宽度持平，而 4 到 16 行的其他固定宽度慢 5–14%。
Conclusion: 验证耗时与接受概率可以边服务边学，无需离线 profile、校准或宽度扫描就能把树宽调度做到接近甚至超过固定扫描的最优选择。

papers.title: Controllable Road Marking Generation
papers.abstract_en: Lane and road markings provide critical guidance for vehicle navigation and multi-agent coordination, yet authoring them at scale remains a manual workflow that limits quantitative analysis and scenario testing. We introduce Controllable Road Marking Generation, which synthesizes a missing center-region marking layout from a drivable-area mask, optional outer-ring markings, and a textual description. Our benchmark uses deterministic, metadata-derived prompts and three output channels: lane dividers, road dividers, and pedestrian crossings. We develop a conditional bird's-eye-view (BEV) pipeline that combines (i) a text-conditioned latent rectified-flow DiT trained with a topology-aware auxiliary loss, (ii) Gaussian-blurred training targets that stabilize learning of thin, sparse markings, and (iii) Structured Gaussian Render (SGR), a training-free post-process that recovers crisp divider geometry by extracting polylines, fitting cubic Bézier curves, and re-rendering them as anisotropic super-Gaussian primitives. On 4,597 Argoverse~2 test tiles, our system achieves Buffered F1 of 80.8 and clDice of 50.2, compared with 38.8 and 24.6 for an adapted state-of-the-art mask-refinement baseline. On Waymo dataset, it yields 88.0 Buffered F1 and 66.2 clDice. Component ablations show complementary connectivity gains from topology-aware supervision and SGR. Text-editing experiments reveal that stronger guidance improves edit success but also increases changes to non-target structures. We see this framework as a step toward simulation-ready road-marking variation, automated map completion, and early-stage infrastructure design exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可控道路标线生成框架，从可行驶区域掩码、可选外圈标线与文本描述合成缺失的中心区标线布局，输出车道分隔线、道路分隔线与人行横道三个通道。在 4,597 个 Argoverse 2 测试 tile 上 Buffered F1 达 80.8、clDice 50.2，而适配的 SOTA mask-refinement 基线仅 38.8 与 24.6；Waymo 上为 88.0 与 66.2。
Motivation: 车道与道路标线的编写仍是手工流程，无法规模化，限制了定量分析与场景测试。
Method: 条件 BEV 管线：文本条件的 latent rectified-flow DiT，配 topology-aware 辅助损失；训练目标做 Gaussian 模糊以稳定细稀疏标线的学习；训练后用 Structured Gaussian Render (SGR) 提取 polyline、拟合 cubic Bézier 曲线并以各向异性 super-Gaussian 图元重渲染恢复清晰几何。基准用确定性、metadata 派生的 prompt。
Result: 在 4,597 个 Argoverse 2 测试 tile 上 Buffered F1 80.8、clDice 50.2，对比适配的 SOTA mask-refinement 基线 38.8 与 24.6；Waymo 数据集上 Buffered F1 88.0、clDice 66.2。消融显示 topology-aware 监督与 SGR 带来互补的连通性增益；文本编辑实验表明更强引导提升编辑成功率，同时增加对非目标结构的改动。
Conclusion: 拓扑感知监督加免训练的 SGR 后处理能把细长标线的连通性与几何质量同时做实，框架可作为仿真就绪标线变体、自动地图补全与早期基础设施设计探索的一步。
