papers.title: Relational Synthesis: Structure-Mediated Concatenative Synthesis for Foley and Retrieval-Augmented Audio Generation
papers.abstract_en: We ask: given a retrieved source audio $S$ and a separate reference audio $R$, can we synthesize novel audio $Y$ out of this pair $(S,R)$ such that $Y$ remains acoustically consistent with $S$, while not persistently copying segments of $S$ or $R$? The first clause is a well-known goal in Foley audio production, and the second is a well-known issue in neural RAG when $S$ and $R$ are naively injected into neural generators. We show that both clauses can be addressed simultaneously using a method we coin relational synthesis, a variation of concatenative synthesis where target cost is replaced by a relational Gromov-like structural cost. Rather than imitating the content of $R$, relational synthesis exploits it from the "other side of the hill": it transfers the temporal structure and directed amplitude motion of $R$ to reorganize and concatenate the grains of $S$ in a novel manner that protects $S$'s acoustic information. Our experiments show that relational synthesis integrates naturally with neural RAG and produces Foley audio that performs well on metrics measuring temporal agreement, acoustic fidelity, and leakage persistence, while maintaining distribution-level quality and text alignment.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Audio demo: https://smoothken.github.io/relational_synth_demo/. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 relational synthesis：把拼接合成 (concatenative synthesis) 的 target cost 换成关系型 Gromov 结构代价，用参考音频 R 的时间结构与定向幅度走向重组检索音频 S 的 grain，生成与 S 声学一致又不持续抄袭 S 或 R 片段的 Foley 音频。该方法与神经 RAG 自然集成，在时间一致性、声学保真、泄漏持续性、分布级质量与文本对齐指标上表现良好。
Motivation: Foley 制作要求新生成音频与检索源 S 声学一致，而神经 RAG 中直接注入 S 与参考 R 会持续复制片段；两个目标此前难以同时满足。
Method: 关系型拼接合成：以关系型 Gromov 结构代价替代拼接合成的 target cost，不模仿 R 的内容，而是把 R 的时间结构与定向幅度运动迁移到 S 的 grain 重组与拼接上，并与神经 RAG 管线集成。
Result: 实验显示该方法在衡量时间一致性 (temporal agreement)、声学保真 (acoustic fidelity) 与泄漏持续性 (leakage persistence) 的指标上表现良好，同时保持分布级质量与文本对齐；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 用结构代价而非内容模仿来利用参考音频，可以在 Foley 生成中同时满足声学一致与防抄袭两个约束，并兼容神经 RAG。

papers.title: Global error estimators for parametric monotone nonlinearities and neural approximations
papers.abstract_en: We construct computable error estimators, which double as loss functions for neural networks, for a class of parametric nonlinear partial differential equations with a monotonicity property, and prove that they are globally reliable and efficient. The value of such a loss function is bounded above and below by the squared error in the natural trial norm, for every trial function, not merely for those near the exact solution; this global property rests on monotonicity. The construction rests on splitting the nonlinear operator into a linear part and a strongly monotone closure, and on measuring the linear residual in a discrete dual norm. Since the closure contributes a dual norm that admits no closed form when the trial norm is stronger than an $L_2$ norm, the estimator is built around a computable surrogate for it, required only to satisfy a pairing bound and a Lipschitz bound. The main theorem then yields two-sided bounds with explicit constants and covers two instances. A first-order system least-squares estimator on conforming trial spaces is the first instance studied: its two-sided bound holds on the whole trial space and therefore applies to arbitrary approximations, including those not in a discrete finite element space. The second instance is a discontinuous Petrov-Galerkin estimator on trial spaces of finite element functions for each parameter value, built with broken test spaces, for which no conformity is required and the dual norm is computed by independent element-local problems. All assumptions are verified for a model class of nonlinear fluxes, with the constants tracked explicitly in terms of the parameter range. Being computable for an arbitrary input, both estimators serve as variationally correct loss functions for neural network approximations of parameter-to-solution maps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为带单调性的参数化非线性 PDE 构造可计算误差估计器，并证明其对任意试探函数（不限于真解邻域）在自然试探范数下给出双侧平方误差界，因此可直接充当神经网络逼近参数到解映射的变分正确损失函数。全局可靠性与效率依赖于算子的单调性分解：线性部分残差用离散对偶范数量度，强单调闭包用满足配对界与 Lipschitz 界的可计算替代物。
Motivation: 参数化非线性 PDE 的误差估计通常只在真解附近有效，无法作为神经网络训练的全局损失；而闭包项的对偶范数在试探范数强于 L2 时无闭式表达，阻碍了可计算双侧界的构造。
Method: 把非线性算子拆成线性部分加强单调闭包，线性残差取离散对偶范数，闭包用满足配对界与 Lipschitz 界的可计算替代物。主定理给出带显式常数的双侧界，覆盖两个实例：一致试探空间上的一阶系统最小二乘 (FOSLS) 估计器，以及按参数值取有限元试探空间、用破碎测试空间的间断 Petrov-Galerkin (DPG) 估计器，后者无需协调性且对偶范数由逐单元局部问题独立求解。
Result: FOSLS 估计器的双侧界在整个试探空间上成立，适用于任意逼近（包括不在离散有限元空间中的）；DPG 估计器的对偶范数由单元局部问题计算。全部假设在一类非线性通量模型上验证，常数以参数范围显式追踪；主定理给出带显式常数的双侧界并覆盖这两个实例。
Conclusion: 单调性使误差估计器成为对任意输入都可计算的全局双侧界，从而可作为神经网络逼近参数到解映射的变分正确损失函数。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.tldr: 为带单调性的参数化非线性 PDE 构造可计算误差估计器，并证明其对任意试探函数（不限于真解邻域）在自然试探范数下给出双侧平方误差界，因此可直接充当神经网络逼近参数到解映射的变分正确损失函数。全局可靠性与效率依赖于算子的单调性分解：线性部分残差用离散对偶范数量度，强单调闭包用满足配对界与 Lipschitz 界的可计算替代物。
summary_sections.motivation: 参数化非线性 PDE 的误差估计通常只在真解附近有效，无法作为神经网络训练的全局损失；而闭包项的对偶范数在试探范数强于 L2 时无闭式表达，阻碍了可计算双侧界的构造。
summary_sections.method: 把非线性算子拆成线性部分加强单调闭包，线性残差取离散对偶范数，闭包用满足配对界与 Lipschitz 界的可计算替代物。主定理给出带显式常数的双侧界，覆盖两个实例：一致试探空间上的一阶系统最小二乘 (FOSLS) 估计器，以及按参数值取有限元试探空间、用破碎测试空间的间断 Petrov-Galerkin (DPG) 估计器，后者无需协调性且对偶范数由逐单元局部问题独立求解。
summary_sections.result: FOSLS 估计器的双侧界在整个试探空间上成立，适用于任意逼近（包括不在离散有限元空间中的）；DPG 估计器的对偶范数由单元局部问题计算。全部假设在一类非线性通量模型上验证，常数以参数范围显式追踪；主定理给出带显式常数的双侧界并覆盖这两个实例。
summary_sections.conclusion: 单调性使误差估计器成为对任意输入都可计算的全局双侧界，从而可作为神经网络逼近参数到解映射的变分正确损失函数。

papers.title: A Three-Dimensional Reverse-Projection Method for Sparse Point Cloud Completion and Its Application to High-Speed Train Nose Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Holes in LiDAR scans of environments with glass windows remain an unresolved problem in three-dimensional reconstruction. This study presents a pipeline for point cloud acquisition, filtering, completion, and surface reconstruction to address sparse sampling and missing window regions in scans of a high-speed train nose. FAST-LIVO2 provides the initial point cloud through multisensor odometry and mapping, and moving least squares (MLS) smooths the observations. We then introduce three-axis projection-based subdivision and interpolation with reverse hole boundary identification, referred to as three-axis reverse completion. The method interpolates missing regions from observations around each hole. Greedy projection triangulation, Poisson surface reconstruction, and a Marching Cubes-based pipeline generate meshes from the completed point cloud. Experiments on a proportionally scaled display model of a high-speed train nose show that the proposed method fills missing point cloud regions around the glass windows. Under the evaluation setting used in this study, greedy projection triangulation yields lower geometric distance errors than the other two reconstruction pipelines. The pipeline supports non-contact digital modeling of train nose geometry and provides a practical approach to reconstructing objects with glass windows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对带玻璃窗的 LiDAR 扫描出现空洞，提出三轴反向补全 (three-axis reverse completion)：三轴投影细分插值加反向孔边界识别，从孔洞周边观测插值缺失区域，再接三种网格重建管线。在按比例缩放的高速列车头车模型上，该方法补上了玻璃窗周围的缺失点云，且 greedy projection triangulation 的几何距离误差低于另外两条重建管线。
Motivation: 玻璃窗导致 LiDAR 扫描出现空洞，稀疏采样与缺失区域使三维重建不完整，高速列车头车的非接触数字建模因此受阻。
Method: 流水线为采集-滤波-补全-曲面重建：FAST-LIVO2 多传感器里程计建图给出初始点云，moving least squares (MLS) 平滑观测；核心是三轴投影细分与插值加反向孔边界识别的三轴反向补全，从每个孔洞周围观测插值；网格端对比 greedy projection triangulation、Poisson surface reconstruction 与基于 Marching Cubes 的三条管线。

papers.title: Vision-enabled detection of safety helmet compliance in construction zones
papers.abstract_en: In the rapidly evolving field of construction management, worker safety remains a top priority. This paper introduces an innovative vision-based system for real-time detection of helmet compliance, specifically designed for construction sites, utilizing advanced computer vision techniques and machine learning algorithms within the YOLO (you only look once) framework. Our system leverages high-resolution video feeds from strategically positioned cameras to monitor adherence to safety regulations regarding helmet usage. By employing deep learning methodologies, the system effectively identifies individuals not wearing helmets, thereby significantly mitigating the risk of head injuries among workers. Our training and validation results revealed an impressive precision exceeding 97% at mAP@0.5 for both helmeted and non-helmeted individuals. Furthermore, our experiments demonstrate exceptional detection accuracy, demonstrating the system's resilience under varying lighting conditions and diverse worker movements. The consistent decrease in loss and improvement in metrics throughout training validates the effectiveness of the YOLOv8 model in enhancing recognition performance. The implications of this research extend beyond mere regulatory compliance, opening avenues for innovative applications in occupational safety management. This study highlights the critical role of technology in protecting lives and lays the groundwork for future advancements in smart construction environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 基于 YOLOv8 的视觉系统在建筑工地实时检测工人是否佩戴安全帽，训练与验证中 helmeted 与 non-helmeted 两类的 precision 超过 97%（mAP@0.5），并在不同光照与工人运动条件下保持检测稳定。
Motivation: 建筑工地依赖人工巡查难以实时覆盖安全帽佩戴合规，头部受伤风险高，需要在复杂光照与人员运动下自动识别未戴帽人员。
Method: 在 YOLO 框架下用 YOLOv8 模型处理高位摄像头的高分辨率视频流，通过深度学习训练与验证识别未佩戴安全帽的个体，训练过程中损失持续下降、指标持续提升。
Result: 训练与验证中 helmeted 与 non-helmeted 两类 precision 均超过 97%（mAP@0.5）；实验显示在不同光照条件与多样工人运动下检测表现稳定，训练全程 loss 持续下降、指标持续改善。
Conclusion: YOLOv8 视觉检测可用于工地安全帽合规的实时监控，为职业安全管理与智能工地提供技术基础。

papers.title: Beyond Semantic Similarity: Performance and Costs of Agentic Retrieval for Complex Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Modern information systems, including many agentic workflows, use dense retrieval to explore large amounts of unstructured data. However, dense retrieval relies on surface-level semantic similarity, which is insufficient for increasingly complex search applications. Here, we investigate agentic retrieval that combines the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) with the efficient corpus exploration of retrievers in a ReAct agentic loop to solve complex retrieval tasks. In our experiments, we show that agentic retrieval is more effective than standard retrieval, improving nDCG@10 by 8.7 points using the same embedding model. Moreover, while specialized retrieval methods struggle on out-of-domain tasks, agentic retrieval is highly generalizable: the same pipeline achieves competitive results on both the ViDoRe v3 and BRIGHT leaderboards. However, this improvement comes at a cost. On average, agentic retrieval takes 107.4 seconds, compared to 0.67 seconds for standard retrieval, and consumes 764.1K input and 5.8K output tokens per query. In short, our study demonstrates the effectiveness of agentic retrieval in modern data systems and motivates future work on more cost-efficient retrieval agents for large-scale deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 推理与检索器语料探索放进 ReAct agentic loop 做复杂检索任务，在同一 embedding 模型下 nDCG@10 提升 8.7 点，且同一 pipeline 在 ViDoRe v3 与 BRIGHT 两个榜单上都有竞争力，跨域泛化优于专用检索方法。代价是平均单查询 107.4 秒（标准检索 0.67 秒）、消耗 764.1K 输入与 5.8K 输出 token，作者据此主张后续要做更省成本的检索 agent 才能大规模部署。
Motivation: dense retrieval 只依赖表层语义相似度，撑不住越来越复杂的搜索任务；而专用检索方法在 out-of-domain 任务上表现不佳，需要既强又通用的检索方式。
Method: 提出 agentic retrieval：在 ReAct agentic loop 中让 LLM 的推理能力与 retriever 的高效语料探索协同工作，用同一 embedding 模型对比标准检索，并在 ViDoRe v3 与 BRIGHT 两个榜单上检验同一 pipeline 的跨域表现。
Result: 同一 embedding 模型下 nDCG@10 提升 8.7 点；同一 pipeline 在 ViDoRe v3 与 BRIGHT 榜单均取得有竞争力的结果，而专用检索方法在 out-of-domain 任务上吃力；平均单查询耗时 107.4 秒（标准检索 0.67 秒），每查询消耗 764.1K 输入 token 与 5.8K 输出 token。
Conclusion: agentic retrieval 在复杂检索任务上比标准检索更有效且跨域更通用，但延迟与 token 成本高出两个数量级，大规模部署前必须先解决成本效率问题。

papers.title: A new design of a fall detection system integrating landmark identification and deep learning techniques
papers.abstract_en: This article introduces an innovative system that integrates landmark identification with deep learning to enhance fall detection accuracy and reliability. By utilizing advanced computer vision techniques, such as Media Pipe for spatial recognition, the system effectively differentiates between routine movements and actual falls. The integration of landmarks with a deep learning prediction algorithm minimizes false alarms, ensuring timely responses to genuine falls. Comprehensive experimentation underscores the system's versatility across various scenarios, emphasizing its potential to improve safety and independence for older adults. The training process demonstrates a steady increase in accuracy, stabilizing by the 40th cycle, while error rates decline significantly during the initial cycles. Real-time experiments, involving both male and female participants aged 8 to 50, recorded a remarkable 95% detection rate of falls, demonstrating the system's effectiveness and promising future applications in elder care and smart health monitoring environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 跌倒检测系统把 MediaPipe 姿态关键点 (landmark) 与深度学习分类器结合，区分日常动作与真实跌倒以减少误报。训练在第 40 个 cycle 稳定，实时实验中对 8–50 岁男女受试者录得 95% 的跌倒检出率。
Motivation: 跌倒检测需要在真实场景中同时保证检出率与低误报，单纯动作识别容易把日常活动误判为跌倒，威胁老年人安全与独立生活。
Method: 用 MediaPipe 做空间姿态关键点识别，将关键点序列输入深度学习预测算法做跌倒/非跌倒分类；训练过程按 cycle 迭代并观察准确率与误差率收敛。
Result: 训练准确率稳步上升并在第 40 个 cycle 稳定，误差率在最初几个 cycle 显著下降；实时实验（受试者 8–50 岁，含男女）录得 95% 的跌倒检出率。
Conclusion: 关键点与深度学习结合可在多场景下有效区分跌倒与日常动作，适用于老年照护与智能健康监测。

papers.title: Beyond In-Distribution Preservation: Recovering Generalization in Quantized VLAs via Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization has been shown to preserve VLA performance under standard evaluation conditions, but whether it preserves the full-precision model's robustness and generalization remains underexplored. In this study, we systematically study the robustness and generalization of post-quantized VLA policies under environmental disturbances. Empirical results show that quantized policies can become fragile to subtle environmental variations despite retaining comparable in-distribution performance. We further observe that action discrepancies are concentrated in a small subset of rollout states, while teacher guidance has opposite effects depending on discrepancy: it improves generalization at high-discrepancy states but can degrade it at low-discrepancy states. These findings reveal that effective post-quantization recovery requires selectively intervening on vulnerable states rather than globally distilling the student. We therefore propose Policy-Induced Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning (PIVOT-Q), a vulnerability-aware On-Policy Distillation (OPD) framework that selectively corrects vulnerable states encountered during quantized-student rollouts using the frozen full-precision policy as a teacher. PIVOT-Q identifies vulnerable states using discounted accumulated discrepancies over a short horizon, applies phase-balanced sparse supervision, and uses a Behavioral Anchor to prevent unnecessary changes. Experiments under seven LIBERO-Plus environmental variations demonstrate consistent recovery across multiple VLA backbones and quantization methods. Notably, PIVOT-Q consistently outperforms full-state distillation across all settings while using only 7.4% of its state-level distillation budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/ruanruan-andy/PIVOT-Q.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 量化后的 VLA 策略在分布内评测中看似无损，却对细微环境扰动变得脆弱；PIVOT-Q 用短时程折扣累积动作差异定位脆弱状态，只在量化学生 rollout 中对这些状态做稀疏的 On-Policy Distillation 修正。在 LIBERO-Plus 七种环境扰动、多个 VLA backbone 与量化方法上均稳定恢复泛化，且只用全状态蒸馏 7.4% 的状态级预算就全面胜出。
Motivation: 后训练量化 (post-training quantization) 只在标准评测下被证明能保住 VLA 性能，其对全精度模型鲁棒性与泛化能力的保持程度尚不清楚；而全局蒸馏在低差异状态上反而会损害泛化。
Method: 提出 PIVOT-Q：以冻结全精度策略为 teacher 的 vulnerability-aware On-Policy Distillation (OPD) 框架，在量化学生 rollout 中用短时程折扣累积动作差异 (discounted accumulated discrepancies) 识别脆弱状态，施加 phase-balanced 稀疏监督，并用 Behavioral Anchor 防止不必要的策略改动。
Result: 在 LIBERO-Plus 七种环境扰动下，跨多个 VLA backbone 与量化方法均实现一致的泛化恢复；PIVOT-Q 在全部设置中优于全状态蒸馏 (full-state distillation)，而状态级蒸馏预算仅为其 7.4%。经验观察还包括：量化策略分布内性能相当但对细微环境变化脆弱，动作差异集中在少量 rollout 状态，teacher 指导在高差异状态提升泛化、在低差异状态反而降低泛化。
Conclusion: 量化后泛化的恢复应选择性干预脆弱状态，而非对 student 做全局蒸馏；差异幅度是决定 teacher 指导正负效应的分界。

summary_sections.method: 提出 PIVOT-Q：以冻结全精度策略为 teacher 的 vulnerability-aware On-Policy Distillation (OPD) 框架，在量化学生 rollout 中用短时程折扣累积动作差异 (discounted accumulated discrepancies) 识别脆弱状态，施加 phase-balanced 稀疏监督，并用 Behavioral Anchor 防止不必要的策略改动。
summary_sections.result: 在 LIBERO-Plus 七种环境扰动下，跨多个 VLA backbone 与量化方法均实现一致的泛化恢复；PIVOT-Q 在全部设置中优于全状态蒸馏 (full-state distillation)，而状态级蒸馏预算仅为其 7.4%。经验观察还包括：量化策略分布内性能相当但对细微环境变化脆弱，动作差异集中在少量 rollout 状态，teacher 指导在高差异状态提升泛化、在低差异状态反而降低泛化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 量化后泛化的恢复应选择性干预脆弱状态，而非对 student 做全局蒸馏；差异幅度是决定 teacher 指导正负效应的分界。

papers.title: CIPHER-MoE: Balancing Efficiency and Routing Fidelity in Trillion-Scale MoE Training
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has been widely adopted in recent large language model (LLM) architectures. However, scaling up MoE in LLM training introduces system-level challenges on training, where non-uniform token routing can lead to highly imbalanced workloads across experts and devices, further destabilizing the training process. With trillion-scale LLMs, imbalanced expert workloads further amplify the resource cost of MoE training, resulting in degraded training efficiency and hardware utilization for underloaded experts, while hot experts require additional resources to accommodate excessive workloads. Recent studies address imbalanced MoE training through intricate parallelism strategies or resource reallocation. However, these system-level approaches often introduce additional resource requirements and considerable orchestration complexity, which become increasingly difficult to afford when training trillion-parameter LLMs under constrained computational resources. This work introduces CIPHER-MoE, which mitigates MoE workload imbalance while keeping the router's token-side Top-K selection unchanged. CIPHER-MoE applies affinity-aware Expert-to-Token filtering with explicit capacity control to reduce hotspot expert workloads without additional hardware resources or complex runtime design. The proposed method has been evaluated on large-scale MoE models, including DeepSeek-V4-Pro, showing up to 64.9 percentage points Top-1 expert workload reduction and 1.10$\times$-1.94$\times$ training acceleration, while preserving the training quality. The source code will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CIPHER-MoE 在保持路由器 token 侧 Top-K 选择不变的前提下，用亲和性感知的 Expert-to-Token 过滤加显式容量控制来削减热点专家负载，无需额外硬件或复杂运行时设计。在大规模 MoE 模型（含 DeepSeek-V4-Pro）上评估，Top-1 专家负载最多下降 64.9 个百分点，训练加速 1.10×–1.94×，且训练质量保持不变。
Motivation: 万亿参数 MoE 训练中 token 路由不均导致专家与设备间负载失衡，欠载专家浪费资源、热点专家需额外扩容，既拖低训练效率与硬件利用率，又使训练过程失稳。
Method: CIPHER-MoE 采用亲和性感知的 Expert-to-Token 过滤并施加显式容量控制，从专家侧削减热点负载，同时保持路由器 token 侧 Top-K 选择不变；不引入额外硬件资源或复杂运行时编排。
Result: 在大规模 MoE 模型（包括 DeepSeek-V4-Pro）上评估：Top-1 专家负载最多下降 64.9 个百分点，训练加速 1.10×–1.94×，训练质量保持不变。
Conclusion: 负载均衡可以在不动 token 侧 Top-K 路由、不加硬件的前提下，通过专家侧过滤与容量控制实现，从而在万亿规模 MoE 训练中同时保住效率与训练质量。

papers.title: Robust Local Optimization Done Right
papers.abstract_en: RANSAC scoring and local optimization (LO) impose different robustness requirements, motivating the separation of hypothesis selection from refinement. We systematically isolate the effects of robust-loss shape, incorrectly specified inlier scales, and optimization strategy on essential matrix, fundamental matrix, and homography estimation. A profile-marginal score marginalizes the nuisance inlier scale and selects an inlier partition, from which we estimate the scale that sets the LO loss width; this makes LO robust to an inlier scale specified too large, whereas one specified too small degrades selection itself. Refinement needs gradient from correspondences the seed currently rejects: optimizers that reweight from current residuals stay pinned to their seed, whereas methods with broad basins recover strongly perturbed seeds yet degrade accurate score-selected hypotheses, so basin size alone is insufficient to assess RANSAC LO. Joint half-quadratic optimization balances the two and is the most consistent strategy across model classes. An optimizer matched to the profile-marginal score, which never decreases it, does not reach the best accuracy, challenging the prescription that scoring and refinement objectives should match. Composed from these findings, our RANSAC reduces the median essential-matrix pose error of a state-of-the-art RANSAC on PhotoTourism from 2.23 degrees to 1.58 degrees with a correctly specified inlier scale and from 38 degrees to 6.2 degrees when it is grossly misspecified (128x too large).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多视几何 RANSAC 中，假设选择与局部优化 (LO) 的鲁棒性要求不同：profile-marginal 打分把内点尺度当 nuisance 参数边缘化并选出内点划分，再据此设定 LO 损失宽度，使 LO 在内点尺度被设得过大时仍稳健，而尺度设得过小会直接损害选择本身。联合 half-quadratic 优化在 essential/fundamental/homography 三类模型上最一致；与打分目标严格匹配的优化器反而达不到最佳精度。组合后的 RANSAC 在 PhotoTourism 上把 SOTA 的中位 essential 矩阵位姿误差从 2.23° 降到 1.58°，尺度被错误设为 128 倍过大时从 38° 降到 6.2°。
Motivation: RANSAC 的假设选择与局部优化被默认共享同一鲁棒性要求，但二者实际需求不同；内点尺度误设与优化器盆地大小如何分别影响选择和精化，此前缺少系统隔离。
Method: 系统隔离 robust-loss 形状、误设的内点尺度、优化策略三者对 essential matrix、fundamental matrix、homography 估计的影响；提出 profile-marginal 打分，边缘化 nuisance 内点尺度并选出内点划分，再由该划分估计尺度来设定 LO 损失宽度；对比按当前残差重加权的优化器、宽盆地方法、联合 half-quadratic 优化，以及与 profile-marginal 打分严格匹配（永不降低该分数）的优化器。
Result: 组合后的 RANSAC 在 PhotoTourism 上中位 essential 矩阵位姿误差：内点尺度正确设定时 2.23° → 1.58°（相对 SOTA RANSAC），尺度被 grossly misspecified（128 倍过大）时 38° → 6.2°。联合 half-quadratic 优化在各模型类间最一致；与打分目标匹配的优化器未达到最佳精度。
Conclusion: 打分与精化目标应当匹配这一通行处方被否定；盆地大小本身不足以评估 RANSAC 的 LO，正确做法是用 profile-marginal 选择内点划分、据此定损失宽度，并以联合 half-quadratic 优化做精化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HLA-WM: Hybrid Linear Attention for Long-Horizon Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon video world models require persistent memory to preserve scene consistency over extended rollouts. Softmax attention retains the full generation history through a growing KV cache, whereas recurrent linear attention compresses history into fixed-size states with substantially lower memory cost. However, we identify severe long-range forgetting in Gated DeltaNet (GDN), where information from distant but relevant scenes is progressively attenuated by subsequent state updates. To address this limitation, we propose HLA-WM, a training-free hybrid linear-attention framework that combines coarse-grained geometry-guided retrieval with fine-grained recurrent linear-state computation. HLA-WM exploits the affine structure of GDN to cache compact chunk-wise transition summaries, retrieve scene-relevant historical chunks using camera geometry, and recompose them into query-specific recurrent states. On the $60$-second SANA-WM-Bench, HLA-WM improves all six aggregate revisit-consistency and camera-control metrics of the base autoregressive generator without additional training, including a $0.74$ dB PSNR gain and a $28.5\%$ reduction in rotation error. The improvements persist after downstream refinement and generalize to MBench-A, where HLA-WM consistently improves all three revisit-consistency metrics across all four subsets and all evaluated inference modes over $547$ samples. At a $60$-second context, HLA-WM reduces historical-state memory by $12\times$ relative to full KV caching while incurring at most a $1.6\%$ reduction in inference throughput. These results demonstrate that selectively addressable recurrent memory can improve long-range scene recall while preserving the efficiency advantages of GDN. Project page: https://caesarhhh.github.io/hla-wm/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HLA-WM 是免训练的混合线性注意力框架，用相机几何做粗粒度检索、再用 GDN 的仿射结构做细粒度递归状态重组，修复 Gated DeltaNet 的长程遗忘。在 60 秒 SANA-WM-Bench 上六项重访一致性与相机控制指标全部提升，PSNR +0.74 dB、旋转误差降 28.5%，历史状态显存比全 KV 缓存低 12×，吞吐最多只降 1.6%。
Motivation: Softmax 注意力靠不断增长的 KV cache 保留全部历史，显存开销大；递归线性注意力把历史压成定长状态，但 Gated DeltaNet 中远距离却相关的场景信息会被后续状态更新逐步衰减，导致长时程场景一致性丢失。
Method: 免训练的 HLA-WM：利用 GDN 的仿射结构缓存紧凑的 chunk 级转移摘要，用相机几何检索与当前视角相关的历吏 chunk，再把它们重组为 query 专属的递归状态，形成粗粒度几何检索加细粒度递归线性状态计算的混合框架。
Result: 在 60 秒 SANA-WM-Bench 上，六项重访一致性与相机控制聚合指标全部提升，含 PSNR 提升 0.74 dB、旋转误差下降 28.5%；改进在下游精修后仍保持，并在 MBench-A 的 547 个样本、四个子集与全部评测推理模式上一致提升三项重访一致性指标。60 秒上下文下历史状态显存较全 KV 缓存减少 12×，推理吞吐最多下降 1.6%。
Conclusion: 可选择性寻址的递归记忆能在保留 GDN 效率优势的同时改善长程场景召回，且无需额外训练即可叠加在自回归生成器上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PACMI: Provenance-Aware Cascading Memory Invalidation for Long-Term LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents rely on long-term memory to retain and reuse information when performing tasks over long horizons. Existing methods provide limited support for handling memories that become outdated as new observations or domain evidence arrive. Such outdated memories may remain semantically relevant, continue to affect dependent records, and retain value as historical evidence. This calls for two capabilities: dependency tracking to identify downstream effects and historical preservation to retain useful past records. We propose Provenance-Aware Cascading Memory Invalidation (PACMI), a framework that represents memories and new evidence in a provenance graph with typed dependency edges. PACMI assigns records to a four-state validity lattice, propagates validity changes to dependent memories, and uses the resulting states for retrieval and stale-premise detection. We also introduce a diagnostic benchmark with 100 cases and 300 queries across five domains. The evaluation separates node, context-, and answer-level performance. PACMI achieves the highest final-answer accuracy on this benchmark, and its paired difference from the strongest baseline is significant under an exact McNemar test. The premise checker achieves perfect precision, recall, and F 1 on the controlled query distribution. Cascading propagation primarily improves memorystate correctness: removing it increases final-answer errors from 3 to 11, but the paired difference does not reach the 0.05 significance threshold. Code and data will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PACMI 用带类型依赖边的 provenance graph 表示记忆与新证据，把记录归入四态 validity lattice 并级联传播失效，供检索与 stale-premise 检测使用。在自建的 100 案例、300 查询、五领域诊断基准上取得最高最终答案准确率，且与最强基线的配对差异经 McNemar 检验显著；去掉级联传播后最终答案错误从 3 升到 11。
Motivation: 长期 LLM agent 的记忆会随新观测或领域证据过期，旧记忆仍语义相关、仍影响下游记录、也仍有历史证据价值，现有方法缺少依赖追踪与历史保留这两种能力。
Method: PACMI 把记忆与新证据编码进带类型依赖边的 provenance graph，记录落入四态 validity lattice，失效状态沿依赖边向下游传播，传播结果用于检索与 stale-premise 检测；另提出含 100 案例、300 查询、五个领域的诊断基准，评测分节点、上下文、答案三层。
Result: 在该基准上 PACMI 最终答案准确率最高，与最强基线的配对差异经精确 McNemar 检验显著；premise checker 在受控查询分布上 precision、recall、F1 均为完美；移除级联传播使最终答案错误从 3 增至 11，但该配对差异未达 0.05 显著性阈值。
Conclusion: 级联传播主要提升记忆状态正确性而非直接决定最终答案显著性；provenance 图加四态有效性格可同时支撑依赖追踪与历史保留，代码与数据将公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: T-JEPA: A Temporal Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Learning Better Remote Sensing Representations
papers.abstract_en: Earth observation (EO) data provide rich temporal supervision, yet existing remote sensing foundation models mainly exploit sequential observations through imposing predefined pairwise relations or aggregating holistic reconstruction context. We seek to further exploit the sparse and nonuniform temporal sampling inherent in EO sequences as supervisory signals. To this end, we propose T-JEPA, a temporal joint-embedding predictive architecture that learns time-gap-conditioned latent transitions. A shared single-frame encoder processes each observation, while a temporal predictor estimates the complete target latent field from a masked source latent representation and the actual elapsed time. Across multiple temporal intervals, these predictive constraints organize observed states into structured latent trajectories. Asymmetric metadata injection mitigates shortcut learning, and direct supervision across multiple temporal scales proves more effective than recursively rolling out intermediate states. In parallel, masked pixel reconstruction provides complementary supervision for preserving spatial details. Under matched pre-training data and throughput, T-JEPA achieves leading transfer performance on both static and temporal tasks. Analyses further reveal that T-JEPA learns representations with time-gap-dependent transition predictability and coherent latent dynamics, while maintaining strong cross-period consistency, representation diversity, and semantic discriminability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: T-JEPA 把遥感序列中稀疏且不均匀的时间间隔本身当作监督信号：共享单帧编码器提取每帧 latent，时间预测器以掩码源表征和真实流逝时间为输入，直接预测目标完整 latent 场。在匹配预训练数据与吞吐的条件下，该架构在静态与时间两类迁移任务上均取得领先表现，且直接跨多时间尺度监督优于递归滚动中间状态。
Motivation: 现有遥感基础模型要么施加预定义的成对时序关系，要么聚合整体重建上下文，浪费了 EO 序列稀疏、非均匀采样所携带的时序监督信息。
Method: T-JEPA 由共享单帧编码器与时间预测器组成：预测器从掩码源 latent 表征和实际流逝时间估计目标完整 latent 场，跨多个时间间隔形成结构化 latent 轨迹；辅以非对称 metadata 注入抑制捷径学习，以及掩码像素重建作为空间细节的补充监督。
Result: 在匹配预训练数据与吞吐的条件下，T-JEPA 在静态与时间迁移任务上均取得领先表现；分析显示其表征的转移可预测性依赖 time-gap，并保持跨时段一致性、表征多样性与语义可分性；直接跨多时间尺度监督被证明比递归滚动中间状态更有效。
Conclusion: 把 EO 的非均匀时间间隔作为条件化 latent 转移的监督，比预定义成对关系或递归 rollout 更能学到连贯的时序表征，同时用像素重建保住空间细节。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: FreSia: Frequency-Semantic Instantiation and Alignment for Multivariate Time Series Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential in multivariate time series forecasting and anomaly detection. Existing studies predominantly inject temporal information into LLMs via direct numerical tokenization or heuristic textual descriptions. However, LLMs still face difficulty in perceiving the underlying structural patterns of numerical time series, particularly the seasonal and trend components obscured by discrete numerical tokens. To bridge this gap, we propose FreSia, a frequency-aware framework that establishes an effective alignment between the semantic space of LLMs and the frequency space of time series. Specifically, FGPrompt, a Frequency-Guided Prompt mechanism within FreSia, distills the frequency-domain structures of time series and projects them into prompts tailored to the semantic space of LLMs. Furthermore, we introduce a Global-driven Context Learning (GCL) component, which uses a global CLS-driven probe to generate global context to bridge the time-frequency domain gap and fuse the multi-modal information. Experiments on eight forecasting benchmarks show that FreSia achieves average improvements of 13.48% and 8.06% in MSE and MAE, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FreSia 用频率引导提示 (FGPrompt) 把时间序列的频域结构（季节、趋势）投影成适配 LLM 语义空间的 prompt，再用全局 CLS 驱动的 Global-driven Context Learning (GCL) 桥接时频域差距并融合多模态信息。在八个预测基准上，MSE 平均改进 13.48%、MAE 平均改进 8.06%。
Motivation: LLM 做多变量时间序列预测时只能靠数值直接分词或启发式文本描述注入时序信息，离散数值 token 遮住了季节与趋势等结构模式，LLM 难以感知数值序列的底层结构。
Method: FreSia 是频率感知框架：FGPrompt 从时间序列中蒸馏频域结构并投影为面向 LLM 语义空间的 prompt；GCL 用全局 CLS 驱动探针生成全局上下文，弥合时频域差距并融合多模态信息。
Result: 在八个预测基准上，FreSia 的 MSE 平均改进 13.48%，MAE 平均改进 8.06%。
Conclusion: 把时间序列的频率结构对齐到 LLM 语义空间，比数值分词或文本描述更能让 LLM 感知季节与趋势，从而提升多变量时间序列预测。

papers.title: Inferring physical fields in coupled systems with unknown parameters from incomplete observations using physics-constrained attentive neural operators
papers.abstract_en: Given incomplete measurements of a single physical field in a coupled system with unknown parameters, can we infer its full physical state and identify the underlying parameters? This problem is challenging because multiple coupled fields must be reconstructed simultaneously from limited observations of only one, while the system parameters are unknown. In this work, we propose a machine learning framework for full-field reconstruction and parameter identification of unknown physical systems from sparse observations of a single physical field. Specifically, the cross-attention encoder propagates sparse sensor observations onto a regular grid to construct a sensor-conditioned latent representation, while a Fourier neural operator (FNO) decoder captures global spatial dependencies to reconstruct all coupled physical fields. The network parameters and unknown physical parameters are jointly optimized by minimizing observation losses, governing equation residuals, and boundary/initial condition constraints. The proposed approach is validated on two- and three-dimensional lid-driven cavity flows, a two-dimensional cylinder wake, and a two-dimensional non-ideal magnetohydrodynamics problem, demonstrating the recovery performance of unobserved fields and physical parameters from incomplete observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出物理约束注意力神经算子框架：用 cross-attention 编码器把单一场的稀疏传感器观测投到规则网格，FNO 解码器重建全部耦合物理场，并与未知物理参数联合优化。在 lid-driven cavity、cylinder wake 与非理想 MHD 算例上验证了未观测场与参数的恢复。
Motivation: 耦合系统中只有一个物理场有不完整观测，却要同时重建多个耦合场并辨识未知系统参数，稀疏观测下这一联合反问题难以求解。
Method: cross-attention 编码器将稀疏传感器观测传播到规则网格形成 sensor-conditioned 潜表示，Fourier neural operator (FNO) 解码器捕获全局空间依赖以重建所有耦合场；网络参数与未知物理参数通过观测损失、控制方程残差、边界/初始条件约束联合优化。
Result: 在二维与三维 lid-driven cavity flow、二维 cylinder wake、二维非理想磁流体力学 (non-ideal MHD) 问题上验证，展示了从不完整观测恢复未观测场与物理参数的性能。
Conclusion: 物理约束的注意力神经算子可在仅有单一场稀疏观测、参数未知的条件下同时完成全场重建与参数辨识。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: ReMaD: Tuning-free Domain Adaptation for Classification and Out-of-Distribution Detection
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Reduced-rank Mahalanobis Distance (ReMaD), a novel prototypical distance-based refinement to classification and out-of-distribution (OOD) detection using pretrained models without finetuning. We use embeddings of the target dataset to fit closed-form distribution statistics in the model's latent space which can classify in-distribution samples and detect OOD samples, all without training or prior knowledge of the OOD data. Building on prototype classification and OOD detection, we analyze the distribution properties of large pretrained models when processing new datasets; based on this analysis, we formulate a simple modification to Mahalanobis Distance to adapt models' latent space distributions to new domains by removing unused features, without the finetuning or hyperparameter searches required by other adaptation procedures. We demonstrate the efficacy of this method to adapt existing large pretrained image embedding models to new classification domains outside their trained capabilities by testing across four target datasets, with competitive performance in both classification and OOD detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReMaD 用目标数据集的 embedding 在预训练模型隐空间里闭式拟合分布统计量，通过约简秩 Mahalanobis 距离 (Reduced-rank Mahalanobis Distance) 删掉未使用特征来适配新域，全程不微调、不搜超参、也不需要 OOD 数据先验。在四个目标数据集上同时做分类与 OOD 检测，性能具有竞争力。
Motivation: 预训练大模型遇到训练能力之外的新域数据时，常规适配要微调或做超参数搜索，且往往需要 OOD 数据先验，成本高且不现实。
Method: 取目标数据集 embedding，在模型隐空间闭式拟合分布统计量；基于对大预训练模型处理新数据集时分布性质的分析，对 Mahalanobis 距离做约简秩修改，删除隐空间中未被使用的特征，从而完成域适配，无需 finetune 与超参搜索。
Result: 在四个目标数据集上测试，将超出训练能力的大型预训练图像 embedding 模型适配到新分类域，在分类与 OOD 检测两方面均取得有竞争力的表现。
Conclusion: 免微调、免超参搜索的隐空间分布改造足以把预训练图像模型适配到新域，同时覆盖分类与 OOD 检测两项任务。

papers.title: Retrieval-Based In-Context Learning: A Domain Adaptation Framework
papers.abstract_en: In-context retrieval (ICR) is a retrieval-based form of in-context learning (ICL) in which demonstrations are retrieved from a source database based on similarity to the query, rather than sampled independently. In this work, we formulate ICR as a type of domain adaptation problem, where the source distribution $P$ of the database may differ from the target distribution $Q$ of the test query-label pair. We investigate the performance of ICR under a flexible class of distributional shifts that substantially extends prior work \citep{li2024fine,guo2025retrieval}, and establish theoretical guarantees that quantify the benefits and pitfalls of this learning paradigm. Our theory is verified by experiments on synthetic and language tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把基于检索的上下文学习 (in-context retrieval, ICR) 形式化为域适应问题：示例按与查询的相似度从源数据库检索而非独立采样，源分布 P 与测试查询-标签对的目标分布 Q 可不同。在一类比先前工作更宽的分布偏移上给出理论保证，量化该范式的收益与风险，并用合成与语言任务实验验证理论。
Motivation: ICR 的示例来自源数据库，其分布 P 与真实测试分布 Q 不一致，此前工作只覆盖较窄的偏移情形，缺少对收益与失效条件的统一刻画。
Method: 将 ICR 建模为域适应问题，在一类显著扩展 li2024fine 与 guo2025retrieval 的分布偏移下推导理论保证，量化相似度检索相对独立采样示例的收益与风险，再用合成数据与语言任务实验检验理论。
Result: 在合成任务与语言任务上对理论预测做了实验验证；摘要给出的是理论保证本身，覆盖一类比先前工作更宽的分布偏移。
Conclusion: ICR 的表现取决于源数据库分布与目标查询分布的偏移程度，检索式示例选择既可能带来收益也可能引入风险，可用域适应框架量化。

papers.title: Rotated, but How Far? Diagnosing and Improving Object-Rotation Reasoning in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can detect that an object has rotated across views, but cannot reliably tell by how much. We introduce OR-Bench, a fine-grained benchmark for object-rotation reasoning with eight tasks covering rotation detection, rotation magnitude estimation, and multi-view rotation reasoning. Across 12 VLMs, the gap is stark: the strongest models approach 100% accuracy on detection, yet even coarse magnitude estimation is near chance. When asked for exact angles, models place 91.8--100% of their predictions on just $0^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $180^\circ$, a failure we term canonical-angle collapse. This collapse persists even without visual input. Representation probing shows that missing information is only part of the explanation. Although rotation information becomes less recoverable at finer granularity, substantial coarse-grained information remains, and a simple linear probe outperforms the models' generated answers. This suggests that VLMs underuse rotation information they already encode. We therefore propose RotationCue, a lightweight decoder that recovers coarse rotation information from the VLM's own frozen representations and feeds it back to the model as intermediate textual context. Across three VLMs, RotationCue improves every model--task combination on OR-Bench, raising macro-average accuracy by 7.9--12.6 points while preserving general capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OR-Bench 用八项任务细粒度考察 VLM 的物体旋转推理，发现模型能判断“转了没有”却答不准“转了多少”：12 个 VLM 在检测任务接近 100% 准确，粗粒度角度估计却接近随机，且 91.8–100% 的精确角度预测落在 0°/90°/180° 三个“canonical-angle collapse”上。作者提出 RotationCue，从冻结表征中解码粗粒度旋转信息并以中间文本形式回灌，在 3 个 VLM 上提升全部模型–任务组合，宏平均准确率提高 7.9–12.6 点且保持通用能力。
Motivation: VLM 能察觉物体跨视角旋转，却无法可靠给出旋转量；这一细粒度空间推理缺口此前缺少专门基准来定位失败发生在信息缺失还是信息未被使用。
Method: 构建 OR-Bench，含八项任务，覆盖旋转检测、旋转幅度估计与多视角旋转推理，横跨 12 个 VLM；用表征探针 (representation probing) 比较线性探针与模型生成答案，并设计轻量解码器 RotationCue，从冻结表征恢复粗粒度旋转信息、以中间文本反馈给模型。
Result: 12 个 VLM 在旋转检测上最强接近 100% 准确率，粗粒度幅度估计接近随机水平；精确角度预测中 91.8–100% 落在 0°、90°、180°，无视觉输入时该坍缩仍存在；线性探针优于模型生成答案。RotationCue 在 3 个 VLM 上改善全部模型–任务组合，宏平均准确率提升 7.9–12.6 点，并保持通用能力。

papers.title: SimpleMark: Fast Multi-Bit Text Watermarking under f -Divergence Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a framework for multi-bit text watermarking with security defined directly through $f$-divergence from the base language model distribution. Unlike prior approaches that focus on average-key distortion-freeness or a particular statistical distance, our formulation supports general $f$-divergences, including total variation and KL divergence, and enforces the guarantee for each realized key and embedded message. We develop a coding-based watermarking scheme that optimally biases next-token distributions subject to a prescribed divergence budget, and characterize the resulting tradeoff between embedding rate, decoding reliability, and statistical security. Experimentally, we compare our method against prior multi-bit watermarking schemes across modern language models and payload regimes. Our approach achieves substantially lower watermark detectability while maintaining competitive message-recovery performance and generation quality. Our results provide a unified view of secure multi-bit watermarking and recover several commonly used security notions as special cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimpleMark 把多比特文本水印的安全性直接定义为与基语言模型分布的 f-divergence 约束，并在给定 divergence 预算下最优地偏置下一 token 分布。该保证对每个实现的密钥与嵌入消息逐次成立，而非只在平均意义上成立；实验中其水印可检测性显著低于既有方案，同时保持有竞争力的消息恢复与生成质量。
Motivation: 既有文本水印方案的安全性多建立在平均密钥失真自由或单一统计距离上，无法覆盖一般 f-divergence，也无法对每个具体密钥与消息给出保证。
Method: 提出以 f-divergence（含 total variation 与 KL）为约束的框架，在规定 divergence 预算下优化下一 token 分布偏置，给出嵌入率、解码可靠性与统计安全性之间的权衡刻画；实验在多种现代语言模型与不同 payload 区间上与既有方案对比。
Result: 在现代语言模型与多种 payload 设置下，本方法的水印可检测性 (detectability) 显著低于既有方案，同时消息恢复性能与生成质量保持竞争力；理论刻画给出嵌入率、解码可靠性与统计安全的权衡，并把若干常用安全定义恢复为特例。
Conclusion: 以逐密钥、逐消息的 f-divergence 约束统一刻画多比特水印安全，可在不牺牲消息恢复与质量的前提下压低可检测性。

papers.title: From Pixels, Without Pre-training: Joint Generative and Self-Supervised Representation Learning in One Model
papers.abstract_en: Strong image generation models are conditioned on class labels, aligned to frozen pretrained encoders, or built on separately trained autoencoders. While effective, generation then depends on supervision or pretraining: labels must be annotated, and encoders or autoencoders pretrained for the target domain. We study joint generative and self-supervised representation learning in a single model, enabling self-conditioned generation without labels or pretrained models. This is challenging because the objectives are mismatched: contrastive learning consumes clean augmented views and favors coarse, invariant semantics, while flow matching consumes noisy images and must preserve the fine detail and spatial layout that contrastive learning discards. We propose SCION (Self-conditioned Generation on Self-supervised representation), whose core is a single pixel-space encoder conditioned on the flow timestep and an embedding. For representation learning, this conditioning embedding is a learned global vector shared across images, with the encoder's [CLS] token yielding the semantic representation trained by the contrastive loss. For generative training, the conditioning embedding is the image's own [CLS] representation, while patch tokens pass through a decoder to predict the image. To sample without a reference image at inference, we jointly learn a prior over the embedding. Gradient-norm balancing and stop-gradient mechanisms enable joint optimization in one run. SCION is self-supervised and self-contained, with no labels or pretrained models. On ImageNet 256x256, with the JiT-B recipe and no representation guidance, SCION reaches 8.92 FID, surpassing class-unconditional iREPA, which aligns to pretrained DINOv2 (46.44), and RCG, which conditions on it (14.27). With JiT-L, SCION achieves 5.89 FID without guidance and 3.47 with representation guidance, outperforming RCG with the ADM recipe (6.24).

Motivation: 图像生成依赖类别标注、冻结的预训练 encoder 或单独训练的 autoencoder，监督与预训练在目标域上都需额外准备；而对比学习偏好粗粒度不变语义、flow matching 需保留细节与空间布局，两个目标天然冲突。

papers.title: Nexus: An Execution Fabric for AI Agents Across Cloud, Edge, and Devices
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents are evolving into long-running services that interact with models, tools, computers, mobile devices, and distributed environments. Existing agent frameworks simplify reasoning and tool invocation. However, cloud-centric designs face three limitations: centralized execution increases failure impact, scaling pressure, and compute cost; extending agents across computers, mobile devices, and edge environments requires a unified execution abstraction with permission control; and long-running executions require consistent lifecycle management across failures, recovery, results, usage, and settlement. We present Nexus, a cloud-edge platform that treats each invocation as a persistent task. Nexus uses an OpenWrt-based runtime for distributed serving, run-scoped delegation for authorized access to Computer and Mobile environments, and persistent records to track execution, outputs, failures, recovery, usage, and charging across cloud and edge components. We evaluate Nexus on controlled, cross-device, and model-driven workloads. All ten Computer-Android workflows succeed, and all six revocation tests block subsequent writes while preserving prior authorized reads. Under worker loss, journaling eliminates duplicate appends (six to zero per task), adding 0.933 s mean normal-path overhead. Across 24 matched task pairs, Nexus completes 24 tasks versus Dify's 22 and is a median 3.88 s faster on jointly successful pairs. In a separate workload, Nexus operates under a smaller tested incremental-runtime memory ceiling than Dapr (16 versus 64 MiB), although Dapr achieves lower successful-call latency. These results demonstrate how locality, operation-scoped authority, and persistent result identity support cloud-edge agent services with workload-dependent costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Nexus 是面向跨云、边、端长时运行 AI agent 的执行平台：把每次调用当作持久任务，用 OpenWrt 运行时做分布式服务、run-scoped delegation 授权访问 Computer/Mobile 环境、持久化 journal 记录执行与计费。十个 Computer-Android 工作流全部成功，六次撤销测试全部阻断后续写入；journaling 把 worker 丢失下的重复追加从 6 次降到 0，正常路径仅多 0.933 s 开销。
Motivation: 云中心式 agent 框架有三个问题：集中执行放大故障影响、扩展压力与算力成本；跨电脑、手机、边缘设备缺少带权限控制的统一执行抽象；长时执行在故障、恢复、结果、用量与结算之间缺少一致的生命周期管理。
Method: Nexus 把每次 invocation 建模为持久任务，采用 OpenWrt-based runtime 做分布式 serving，用 run-scoped delegation 授权访问 Computer 与 Mobile 环境，并以 persistent records 跟踪执行、输出、故障、恢复、用量与计费；在受控、跨设备与模型驱动三类 workload 上评测。
Result: 十个 Computer-Android 工作流全部成功；六次撤销 (revocation) 测试全部阻断后续写入且保留此前已授权的读取；worker 丢失下 journaling 将每任务重复追加从 6 次降到 0，正常路径平均增加 0.933 s 开销；24 组配对任务中 Nexus 完成 24 个、Dify 完成 22 个，在双方都成功的配对上 Nexus 中位快 3.88 s；另一 workload 中 Nexus 的增量运行时内存上限低于 Dapr（16 对 64 MiB），但 Dapr 的成功调用延迟更低。
Conclusion: 局部性、操作范围授权 (operation-scoped authority) 与持久结果标识可以支撑云边 agent 服务，代价随 workload 而变：Nexus 换来故障下的不重复写与更省内存，但在延迟上让 Dapr 占优。

papers.title: Difference Feature Map Distillation: Transferring Inter-Sample Relational Knowledge Towards Efficient Transformer-Based Tracking
papers.abstract_en: In autonomous driving perception, visual object tracking systems must satisfy stringent latency and power constraints while remaining robust in complex and dynamic environments. Although transformer-based trackers achieve state-of-the-art accuracy, their substantial computational and memory overheads hinder deployment on real-time, resource-constrained platforms. To move toward this goal, we propose Difference Feature Map Knowledge Distillation (DFM-KD), a novel relational distillation framework tailored for transformer-based visual object tracking. Unlike conventional feature distillation methods that minimize point-wise discrepancies (e.g., mean squared error) between teacher and student feature representations, DFM-KD transfers knowledge through inter-sample feature differences, explicitly aligning the relational structure of the feature space. By distilling how the teacher models appearance variation and consistency across samples, rather than enforcing similarity in absolute activations, DFM-KD enables the student to better capture the structural dynamics of visual changes within a batch. As a result, the distilled model exhibits enhanced feature robustness and improved tracking performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DFM-KD consistently outperforms conventional feature-level distillation methods in both tracking precision and success rates.
papers.comment: Published in the 2026 IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV)
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV), pp. 2032-2037, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DFM-KD 把 Transformer 视觉目标跟踪的师生知识蒸馏从逐点特征对齐改为样本间差分特征对齐，让学生学习教师建模的外观变化与一致性结构，而非绝对激活值。蒸馏后的模型特征鲁棒性更强，在跟踪精度 (precision) 与成功率 (success rate) 上稳定超过常规特征级蒸馏方法。
Motivation: Transformer 跟踪器精度领先但计算与内存开销大，难以部署到自动驾驶中延迟与功耗受限的实时平台；常规逐点特征蒸馏 (如 MSE) 只对齐绝对激活，丢掉了特征空间的 relational 结构。
Method: 提出 Difference Feature Map Knowledge Distillation (DFM-KD)：通过样本间特征差分 (inter-sample feature differences) 传递知识，显式对齐师生特征空间的 relational 结构，让学生捕捉 batch 内视觉变化的结构动态，替代逐点 MSE 式特征对齐。
Result: 大量实验表明 DFM-KD 在跟踪 precision 与 success rate 上均持续优于常规特征级蒸馏方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 对 Transformer 目标跟踪，蒸馏样本间关系结构比对齐绝对激活更能提升学生模型的特征鲁棒性与跟踪表现，从而支持向实时、资源受限平台部署。

summary_sections.conclusion: 对 Transformer 目标跟踪，蒸馏样本间关系结构比对齐绝对激活更能提升学生模型的特征鲁棒性与跟踪表现，从而支持向实时、资源受限平台部署。

papers.title: Second-Order Problem Solving for Recursive Self-Improvement in Formal Verification
papers.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) enables agents to iteratively optimize their workflows via execution feedback. However, standard RSI typically operates as a first-order optimizer: it repeatedly patches surface-level parameters in response to immediate failure symptoms, often leading to trial-and-error thrashing without resolving underlying mechanisms. To address this limitation, we introduce SO-RSI, a framework that elevates workflow optimization to a second-order diagnostic inquiry, investigating why failures occur before committing to structural interventions. SO-RSI passively monitors execution traces for three structural anomalies (recurrence, opposing edits, and expectation mismatch) to trigger targeted mechanism investigations. By executing lightweight diagnostic probes and maintaining persistent inquiry memory across RSI rounds, SO-RSI accumulates causal evidence to guide systematic workflow edits rather than parameter patches. Across Lean 4 proof generation and Verus-based verifiable code generation, SO-RSI improves final held-out pass rates over Naive RSI by 21.8 and 25.8 percentage points under matched 24-hour search budgets. Behavioral analyses further confirm that SO-RSI substantially suppresses failure recurrence and eliminates unproductive zero-progress optimization loops.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SO-RSI 把递归自改进 (RSI) 从一阶参数补丁升级为二阶机制诊断：被动监控执行轨迹中的三类结构异常（复现、相反编辑、期望不匹配）触发探针调查，并跨轮次保存询问记忆，再据此做结构性工作流编辑。在 Lean 4 证明生成与 Verus 可验证代码生成上，匹配 24 小时搜索预算时最终 held-out 通过率比 Naive RSI 分别高 21.8 和 25.8 个百分点，并显著抑制失败复现与零进展循环。
Motivation: 标准 RSI 只针对即时失败症状反复打补丁，陷入试错抖动而不触及失败的底层机制，导致自改进在形式化验证任务上停滞。
Method: SO-RSI 监控执行轨迹以检测复现、相反编辑、期望不匹配三类异常，触发轻量诊断探针；用跨 RSI 轮次的持久询问记忆积累因果证据，再据此执行系统性工作流编辑而非参数补丁。
Result: 在 Lean 4 证明生成与 Verus 可验证代码生成两个任务上，匹配 24 小时搜索预算时，SO-RSI 相对 Naive RSI 的最终 held-out 通过率分别提高 21.8 和 25.8 个百分点；行为分析显示失败复现被大幅抑制，零进展优化循环被消除。
Conclusion: 先诊断失败机制再做结构性干预，比一阶症状补丁更能持续提升形式化验证工作流的自改进效率。

papers.title: Voltic: Distinguishing Volatility from Stochasticity in Recurrent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent sequence models must decide how strongly to overwrite their memory at each token. Read as Bayesian filtering, this write is the gain of a Kalman update, set by uncertainty from two sources that pull it in opposite directions: volatility, how quickly the underlying associations change, and stochasticity, how noisy each observation of them is. First, we show that the update of gated delta-rule memories is the form this filter takes under isotropic uncertainty. Next, we introduce Voltic, a recurrent memory that keeps the covariance anisotropic and makes both noise variances input-dependent, so the write is vector-valued and carries uncertainty accumulated over the sequence. A dense covariance would have to be propagated token by token, ruling out the parallel training these models depend on. We therefore give two assumed-density approximations, diagonal and quasi-diagonal, both of which leave the memory update in delta-rule form and reuse its chunked kernels. On controlled recall tasks in which associations change and observations are corrupted, Voltic leads all baselines. On the task combining volatility and stochasticity, its margin over the strongest baseline is larger at both extrapolation sizes than at the training sizes. In 45M-parameter language models it leads an eight-task reasoning average and achieves higher retrieval accuracy beyond the training context length than gated baselines, at throughput close to those baselines. Deriving the write from an uncertainty recursion therefore makes memory more responsive to change.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Voltic 把循环记忆的写入解释为 Kalman 更新的增益，指出 gated delta-rule 只是各向同性不确定性的特例，并提出保持协方差各向异性、让两个噪声方差随输入变化的向量写入。用对角与准对角两种 assumed-density 近似保留 delta-rule 形式以复用 chunked kernel；在关联变化且观测受噪的受控召回任务上领先全部基线，45M 参数 LM 上八任务推理均值第一，且在超出训练上下文长度时检索精度更高、吞吐接近 gated 基线。
Motivation: 循环序列模型每步要决定覆写记忆的强度，这一写入等价于 Kalman 更新的增益，由 volatility（关联变化多快）与 stochasticity（观测噪声多大）两个方向相反的不确定性共同决定；现有 gated delta-rule 只对应各向同性不确定性，无法区分二者。
Method: 先证明 gated delta-rule 的更新即各向同性不确定性下该滤波器的形式；再提出 Voltic，保留各向异性协方差并让两个噪声方差输入依赖，使写入为向量并携带沿序列累积的不确定性。为避免逐 token 传播稠密协方差破坏并行训练，给出对角与准对角两种 assumed-density 近似，均保持更新为 delta-rule 形式并复用其 chunked kernels。
Result: 在关联变化、观测受噪的受控召回任务上 Voltic 领先全部基线；在同时结合 volatility 与 stochasticity 的任务上，其相对最强基线的优势在两个 extrapolation 尺寸上都大于训练尺寸。在 45M 参数语言模型上取得八任务推理均值第一，并在超出训练上下文长度后获得高于 gated 基线的检索精度，吞吐接近这些基线。
Conclusion: 从不确定性递归推导写入使记忆对变化更敏感：各向异性、输入依赖的双源不确定性建模能在保持并行训练与吞吐的同时提升召回与长上下文检索。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Planetary Geospatial Foundation Models: A New Paradigm for Global Public Health
papers.abstract_en: The efficacy of traditional disease prediction is limited by spatial gaps and temporal lags, which impact the timing and targets of resource deployments. Outbreaks escalate undetected, chronic disease burdens are quantified years later, and at-risk populations in data-sparse regions remain unaddressed. Planetary geospatial foundation models complement existing epidemiological workflows to provide operational improvements, encoding multimodal search, mobility, and environmental signals into generalizable place representations. As illustrations of this complementarity, we present independent global health case studies of Google Earth AI's Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM) -- a foundation model for geospatial inference -- across four domains (vaccine-preventable, communicable, noncommunicable, maternal mental health), five tasks (spatial extrapolation, interpolation/nowcasting, probabilistic forecasting, prospective forecasting, risk stratification), and four countries (USA, Canada, Mexico, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo). Across these case studies, PDFM addresses critical surveillance gaps across domains: improving US-Canada border MMR vaccination coverage predictions by capturing cross-border behavioral spillovers domestic models miss; nowcasting cardiovascular disease to accelerate data availability; enhancing short-term municipal Mexican dengue forecasts for timely outbreak vector control; improving forecasts of cholera hotspots; and adding a transferable signal to individual-level postpartum-depression risk prediction in US states the model had never seen, while not replacing individual socioeconomic data or closing demographic screening gaps. Together, these results showcase capabilities of geospatial foundation models for public health surveillance.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables (6 main tables, 6 Extended Data tables)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Google Earth AI 的 Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM) 把多模态搜索、 mobility 与环境信号编码成可迁移的地点表示，用于补足疾病监测中的空间缺口与时滞。在美、加、墨、刚果（金）四国的五个任务上，它改善了美加边境 MMR 接种覆盖预测、加快心血管病 nowcasting、提升墨西哥登革热短期市政预报与霍乱热点预报，并为从未见过的美国州的产后抑郁风险预测加入可迁移信号。
Motivation: 传统疾病预测受空间缺口与时滞限制，暴发在未被察觉中升级、慢性病负担数年后才量化，数据稀疏地区的高风险人群得不到覆盖。
Method: 以 PDFM 这一地理空间基础模型为核心，将多模态搜索、mobility 与环境信号编码为通用地点表示，嵌入现有流行病学工作流；通过四个领域（疫苗可预防、传染性、非传染性、孕产妇心理健康）、五个任务（空间外推、插值/nowcasting、概率预报、前瞻预报、风险分层）的独立全球健康案例研究检验互补性。
Result: 案例覆盖四个国家（USA、Canada、Mexico、DRC）：改善美加边境 MMR 接种覆盖预测（捕捉国内模型遗漏的跨境行为溢出）；nowcast 心血管病以加速数据可得性；提升墨西哥市政登革热短期预报以支持病媒控制；改善霍乱热点预报；为模型从未见过的美国州的个体级产后抑郁风险预测增加可迁移信号，但不替代个体社会经济数据、也未弥合人口筛查缺口。
Conclusion: 地理空间基础模型可作为公共卫生监测的互补层填补监测缺口，但它是叠加信号而非个体社会经济数据的替代，人口筛查缺口依然存在。

papers.title: From Token-Max to Outcome-Max: How You Use AI Determines Its Productivity
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) models can perform increasingly complex tasks, yet greater AI usage does not necessarily translate into proportional productivity gains. We identify token-max as one source of this inefficiency: when token consumption is treated as productive effort, agents are encouraged to over-exert and expend computation beyond what is necessary. We instead propose outcome-max, which rewards independently verified task completion per unit cost and induces a principled stopping rule. Then, to study these objectives, we develop a three-level simulation framework spanning immediate interaction, long-run behavioral adaptation, and organizational collaboration. Across all three levels, outcome-max improves the efficiency of AI-assisted production while largely preserving verified task performance. To further align these incentives with outcome-max, we introduce OutcomeShare, an incentive mechanism. Theory and simulation show that OutcomeShare can induce participation while generating shared gains for employees, firms, and LLM providers. Together, our results suggest that AI productivity not only depends on model capability, but also on how to construct the objectives governing AI use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 token 消耗当作努力会诱导 agent 过度计算，作者提出 outcome-max：按单位成本下经独立验证的任务完成度奖励，并由此导出一个有原则的停止规则。在涵盖即时交互、长期行为适应与组织协作的三层仿真框架中，outcome-max 在三个层级都提升 AI 辅助生产效率，同时基本保持经验证的任务性能；配套的 OutcomeShare 激励机制经理论与仿真显示可促成参与并让员工、企业与 LLM 提供方共享收益。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 用量增加并不等比转化为生产率提升，原因之一是把 token 消耗当作生产性努力（token-max），使 agent 被鼓励超出必要地消耗算力。
Method: 提出 outcome-max 目标，奖励单位成本下独立验证的任务完成度并诱导停止规则；构建覆盖即时交互、长期行为适应、组织协作的三层仿真框架来研究该目标；再引入激励机制 OutcomeShare，用理论与仿真分析参与约束与收益分配。
Result: 在全部三个层级上，outcome-max 提升 AI 辅助生产的效率，同时大体保持经验证的任务性能；理论与仿真显示 OutcomeShare 能诱导参与，并为员工、企业和 LLM 提供方带来共享收益。
Conclusion: AI 生产率不只取决于模型能力，还取决于支配 AI 使用的目标如何构造：以验证产出而非 token 计酬可减少过度计算并保留任务性能。

papers.title: Errors of LLM-Assisted Literature Retrieval in Environmental Science: A Comparison Study of Abstract versus Full-text Based Prompts
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for literature search and synthesis. However, it is unclear whether they retrieve accurate bibliographic information in environmental science. Therefore, we quantitatively compared the errors of widely used LLM platforms in retrieving references related to original articles from five leading environmental science journals (Energy and Environmental Science, Nature Sustainability, Nature Climate Change, Lancet Planetary Health, and Environmental Science and Technology) published in 2024 to 2025. Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, DeepSeek, Perplexity, and Gemini were used as the LLM platforms. LLMs retrieved 10 references for each of the 50 randomly selected original article using either the article's abstract or its full-text as prompt. The retrieved references were subject to a multimetric score ratio combining validity of bibliographic data, Google Scholar link, digital object identifier, Scopus Electronic Identifier and relevance score (cited by or being the index paper), and the proportion of complete fabrication that failed all metrics. Abstract-only prompt yielded significantly higher accuracy than full-text one. This advantage was confirmed in multilevel mixed-effect multivariable regression after adjusting for journal, platform, and output order. Source journal and the position of a reference within the output list were also independently associated with retrieval accuracy, with lower-listed references associated with lower accuracy. These findings suggest that LLM assisted literature retrieval in environmental science remains moderately accurate and overall inconsistent, varying significantly by platform, journal, prompt type, and output position. Abstract-based prompting, as task-aligned information compression, may outperform full-text one in literature retrieval. Caution should be used when generalizing our findings.

Motivation: LLM 被广泛用于文献检索与综述，但其在环境科学中能否给出准确的书目信息尚不清楚，捏造参考文献会直接污染综述写作。
Method: 从 Energy and Environmental Science、Nature Sustainability、Nature Climate Change、Lancet Planetary Health、Environmental Science and Technology 五刊随机选 50 篇 2024–2025 年原创论文，分别以摘要和全文为提示词，让 Claude、ChatGPT、Grok、DeepSeek、Perplexity、Gemini 各检索 10 条参考文献；用结合书目数据有效性、Google Scholar 链接、DOI、Scopus EID 与相关性（被引或作为索引论文）的多指标得分比评分，并统计全部指标失败的完全捏造比例；再用多层混合效应多变量回归控制期刊、平台与输出顺序。
Result: 摘要提示的准确率显著高于全文提示，该优势在控制期刊、平台与输出顺序的多层混合效应多变量回归后仍成立；来源期刊与参考文献在输出列表中的位置独立关联检索准确率，列表越靠后准确率越低。整体准确率为中等且不一致，随平台、期刊、提示类型与输出位置显著变化。
Conclusion: 摘要提示作为任务对齐的信息压缩在文献检索上可能优于全文提示；LLM 辅助的环境科学文献检索仍属中等准确且整体不一致，推广结论时需谨慎。

papers.title: Toward AI Trustworthiness: Finding Analytically Proven Forward-Invariant Sets for AI-Controlled Systems
papers.abstract_en: Neural-network (NN) controllers are increasingly used in nonlinear control systems, but their highly nonlinear behavior makes them difficult to explain and verify, raising trustworthiness concerns in safety- and mission-critical applications. A key step toward certifiable trustworthiness is to find a Forward-Invariant Set (FIS): a state-space region such that any trajectory starting inside remains inside. If the FIS excludes unsafe states, safety can be guaranteed for initial states within it. Finding an analytically proven FIS for a given AI-controlled system with a fixed controller is difficult. We propose a framework that uses an Invertible Neural Network (INN) to transform the original state space into a latent space where a regular-shaped FIS is more likely to exist. We train the INN so that a preferred hyper-rectangular candidate becomes invariant in the latent space, then formally verify it. We prove that, whenever verification succeeds, both the latent-space candidate and its inverse-transformed counterpart in the original state space are analytically proven FISs. We evaluate the approach on 45 AI-controlled systems across three representative control testbeds. Our method finds certified FISs for all 45 systems, whereas an adapted state-of-the-art baseline finds none. It is also faster on 40 of the 45 systems, and the centers of the resulting FISs roughly match domain-expert preferences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用可逆神经网络 (INN) 把神经网络控制器的原状态空间变换到潜空间，在那里训练出一个超矩形候选使其前向不变 (forward-invariant set, FIS)，再形式化验证；证明验证成功时潜空间候选与其逆变换回原空间的像都是解析可证的 FIS。在三个控制测试床上共 45 个 AI 控制系统中，该方法为全部 45 个找到经认证的 FIS，而改造后的 SOTA 基线一个也没找到，且在 45 个中的 40 个上更快。
Motivation: 神经网络控制器的强非线性行为难以解释与验证，安全攸关场景下缺少可认证的安全域；对给定 AI 控制系统直接找解析可证的前向不变集本身很难。
Method: 框架以 INN 做状态空间到潜空间的可逆变换，使规则形状（超矩形）的 FIS 更可能存在；训练 INN 让偏好的超矩形候选在潜空间中不变，随后对该候选做形式化验证，并证明验证成功蕴含原空间像同样为 FIS。
Result: 在三个代表性控制测试床上共 45 个 AI 控制系统评估：本方法为全部 45 个系统找到经认证的 FIS，改造后的 state-of-the-art 基线一个也找不到；在 45 个中的 40 个上运行更快；所得 FIS 的中心与领域专家偏好大致吻合。
Conclusion: 通过可逆变换把不变集搜索搬到更规则的潜空间，可以在固定神经网络控制器的非线性系统上系统性地产生解析可证的安全域，而直接在原状态空间搜索的基线做不到。

papers.title: Square-Root Regret for Adversarial Multiplayer Bandits without Collision Information or Shared Randomness
papers.abstract_en: We study adversarial multiplayer bandits with $K$ arms and $2\le m<K$ labeled players, without collision information, shared randomness, or an external communication channel. We design a constructive communication and synchronization protocol with a Monte Carlo public constructor. With probability at least $1-CN^{-32}$ over preprocessing, where $N=2Km(T+1)$, its fixed published output satisfies \[ R_T\le C K^{5/2}\sqrt T\log^2(2Km(T+1)) \] simultaneously for every oblivious reward sequence chosen after preprocessing. Here $R_T$ is expected regret over the players' private execution randomness. Positive reward observations establish a common learning schedule and synchronize players before learning begins. The cost of delayed communication is charged to the support of positive rewards, ensuring that periods with little useful feedback incur only limited regret. A slow--fast learning procedure then maintains valid reward estimates while assignments and scores are exchanged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在无碰撞信息、无共享随机数、无外部信道的对抗性多方老虎机 (adversarial multiplayer bandits) 中，构造一个带 Monte Carlo 公共构造器的通信与同步协议：正奖励观测先建立共同学习节拍，延迟通信代价记到正奖励支撑上，再用 slow-fast 学习过程维护奖励估计并交换分配与得分。预处理后以至少 1-CN^{-32} 的概率，固定输出对所有事后选定的 oblivious 奖励序列同时满足 R_T ≤ C K^{5/2}√T log²(2Km(T+1))。
Motivation: 多方老虎机在既无碰撞信息、又无共享随机数与外部通信信道时，玩家难以同步学习节拍，延迟通信的代价容易被放大成高 regret；目标是在这种最弱信息条件下仍拿到平方根级 regret。
Method: 构造性通信与同步协议：先用 Monte Carlo 公共构造器在预处理阶段产出固定公开输出（成功概率至少 1-CN^{-32}，N=2Km(T+1)）；正奖励观测确立共同学习节拍并在学习开始前同步各玩家；延迟通信的代价计入正奖励的支撑集；随后 slow-fast 学习过程在交换分配与得分的同时维持有效的奖励估计。
Result: 对任意在预处理之后选定的 oblivious 奖励序列，玩家私有执行随机性下的期望 regret 同时满足 R_T ≤ C K^{5/2}√T log²(2Km(T+1))，成立概率至少 1-CN^{-32}，其中 N=2Km(T+1)；反馈稀少的时段只承担有限 regret。
Conclusion: 在无碰撞信息、无共享随机数、无外部信道的对抗多方老虎机中，靠正奖励支撑分摊延迟通信代价并配合 slow-fast 估计，可以达到平方根级 regret。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Time-Series QA Systems Read the Time Series? Evidence Use and Reasoning Reliability
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, time-series question answering (QA) systems have made significant progress. However, generating a correct answer does not show whether retaining the supplied numerical series improves task performance, nor whether the prediction is sensitive to changes in that input. While some systems provide rationales, answer accuracy also does not show whether their numerical claims are grounded in the supplied series or whether the stated inference is valid. In this work, we focus on evaluating four time-series QA systems: TimeOmni-1, ChatTS, TimeOmni-VL, and Time-MQA. First, for three systems with released evaluation data, we reproduce their reported results and compare the performance of the systems with their backbones. Then, we introduce a benchmark named COMMON-TSQA, which collects public evaluation datasets from existing time-series benchmarks and unifies their sample representation, task definitions, and answer schemas, while evaluating each system through its own interface under common evaluation criteria. The evaluation uses the original condition and six interventions while keeping the question and target fixed. Our analysis shows that aggregate performance alone can obscure how systems use numerical evidence. Similar task-level scores can arise despite substantial changes in individual predictions. Some interventions induce simple fallback behavior rather than preserved task ability. We also evaluate rationales for factual grounding, inference validity, and consistency with the final answer. We find that rationales often contain time-series claims unsupported by the input. Moreover, the rationale audit shows that agreement between a rationale and its final answer can coexist with incorrect numerical descriptions or invalid intermediate inferences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对四个时序 QA 系统（TimeOmni-1、ChatTS、TimeOmni-VL、Time-MQA）做证据使用与推理可靠性评测：复现其已发布结果并与 backbone 对比，再用统一基准 COMMON-TSQA 在原始条件加六种干预下固定问题与目标逐系统评测。发现聚合分数会掩盖系统是否真的读了数值序列——干预下任务级分数相近但个体预测大幅变化，部分干预触发的是简单回退而非保留任务能力；rationale 中常出现输入不支持的时序论断，且 rationale 与最终答案一致仍可伴随错误数值描述或无效中间推理。
Motivation: 时序 QA 答对并不说明保留数值序列提升了表现，也不说明预测对输入敏感；有 rationale 也不保证数值论断有据、推理有效，聚合指标掩盖了这些证据使用问题。
Method: 先在三个有公开评测数据的系统上复现其报告结果并与各自 backbone 对比；再提出 COMMON-TSQA，汇集现有时序基准的公开评测集并统一样本表示、任务定义与答案 schema，让每个系统经自身接口在统一评测标准下接受原始条件加六种干预（问题与目标固定）的评测；同时对 rationale 审计事实依据 (factual grounding)、推理有效性 (inference validity) 与和最终答案的一致性。
Result: 复现了三个系统的已发布结果并与 backbone 比较；COMMON-TSQA 上原始条件与六种干预的对照显示：聚合表现会掩盖数值证据的使用方式，任务级分数相近时个体预测仍可大幅变化，部分干预诱发简单回退行为；rationale 审计发现其中常含输入不支持的时序论断，且 rationale 与答案一致可与错误数值描述或无效中间推理并存。
Conclusion: 时序 QA 的答案正确率与 rationale 一致性都不足以证明系统真的读了数值序列，评测必须在固定问题的干预下检查个体预测与 rationale 的数值依据。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Two-Sample Testing via Path-based Inference
papers.abstract_en: Modern deep generative models are primarily studied for their ability to generate realistic samples, yet the generative dynamics they learn can also serve as objects of statistical inference. We develop this idea for two-sample testing, the problem of deciding whether the same distribution generated two finite datasets. Using stochastic interpolants, we connect both distributions to a shared Gaussian bottleneck, so that each half of the resulting path is a Gaussian channel acting on a single population. We prove that the null hypothesis holds if and only if the population denoiser, or equivalently, the velocity fields of the two halves, coincide at any single noise level, which amounts to a reflection symmetry of the path about the bottleneck. Deviations from this symmetry yield a continuum of two-sample witnesses, which we estimate via held-out regression risks on learned denoisers and velocities and aggregate along the path; under an information-theoretic weighting, the aggregated discrepancy equals the Jeffreys divergence between the noise-smoothed distributions. Calibrating the resulting statistics by permutation yields tests that are valid in finite samples for any trained networks and consistent when the fields are learned accurately. On a synthetic benchmark and three image benchmarks, the proposed tests improve power over the strongest baseline by up to 33 percentage points at an equal total sample budget, with the best choice of regression representation and path weighting depending on the data modality. These results show that generative paths provide a principled representation for statistical testing, extending stochastic-interpolant models beyond generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把随机插值 (stochastic interpolants) 生成路径当作统计推断对象做两样本检验：两分布经共享高斯瓶颈相连，零假设等价于路径关于瓶颈的反射对称，即两侧去噪器或速度场在任一噪声水平上重合。用留出回归风险估计逐噪声水平的 witness 并沿路径聚合，在信息论加权下聚合差异等于噪声平滑分布间的 Jeffreys 散度，置换校准后得到有限样本有效、场学准后相合的检验。在合成基准与三个图像基准上，相对最强基线检验功效最高提升 33 个百分点（等总样本预算）。
Motivation: 两样本检验需要在有限样本下判断两个数据集是否同分布，而深度生成模型学到的生成动力学通常只被当作采样工具，未被用作可推断的检验对象。
Method: 用 stochastic interpolants 把两个分布连到共享高斯瓶颈，使路径每半段都是作用于同一总体的高斯信道；证明零假设成立当且仅当总体去噪器（等价地两半段速度场）在任一噪声水平重合。以学得的 denoiser 与 velocity 的留出回归风险构造逐噪声水平 witness 并沿路径聚合，信息论加权下聚合差异等于噪声平滑分布的 Jeffreys 散度，再用置换 (permutation) 校准统计量。
Result: 在合成基准与三个图像基准上，所提检验相对最强基线在等总样本预算下功效最高提升 33 个百分点；最佳的回归表示与路径加权选择随数据模态而变。
Conclusion: 生成路径可作为统计检验的原则性表示，使 stochastic interpolant 模型超出生成用途；检验对任意已训练网络有限样本有效，且当场学得准确时相合。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: RESOLVE: Language-Agnostic Validation of GPU Kernels Through Testing, Reduction, and Proof
papers.abstract_en: AI systems can now write and optimize production GPU kernels, but validating them remains an important challenge. Evaluating the kernel on a few random inputs and checking that its outputs match a trusted reference kernel within numeric tolerances is not sufficient: races can cause nondeterministic behavior that fails to manifest in tests, and numeric tolerances can hide bugs and cause false positives even after extensive calibration. To address this challenge, we present RESOLVE, which combines testing and formal verification to build a comprehensive kernel validation pipeline. It operates in three steps: First, it tests for nondeterminism using binary instrumentation that perturbs execution timing to expose races. Second, an agent rewrites the candidate and reference kernels to obtain "reduced-concurrency" versions that are simpler to analyze but still produce bitwise-identical outputs in all tests. Third, the reduced kernels are formally analyzed in the F*/Pulse framework and prove that they perform the same computation on real numbers. This sidesteps the need for numeric tolerances. We show that RESOLVE can validate a broad selection of kernels using KernelBench, and prove equivalence across fused GEMMs in three state-of-the-art frameworks and languages: CUTLASS, Triton, and Gluon. It also analyzes mega-kernels, notoriously difficult to validate, and finds four previously unreported issues, including two clear bugs. We show that agents can use RESOLVE to repair the issues, with minimal performance impact, highlighting that agents can optimize aggressively when they can rigorously check their results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RESOLVE 把 GPU kernel 验证拆成三步：用二进制插桩扰动时序测非确定性、由 agent 改写出仍逐位一致的 reduced-concurrency 版本、再在 F*/Pulse 中证明其在实数上执行相同计算，从而绕开数值容差。在 KernelBench 上验证了 CUTLASS、Triton、Gluon 三个框架的 fused GEMM 等价性，并在 mega-kernel 中发现 4 个此前未报告的问题（含 2 个明确 bug），agent 借此修复且性能损失极小。
Motivation: AI 生成的生产 GPU kernel 靠少量随机输入对拍不可靠：race 导致的非确定性可能在测试中不显现，数值容差经充分标定后仍会掩盖 bug 并产生误报。
Method: 三阶段流水线：二进制插桩扰动执行时序以暴露 race 并测非确定性；agent 重写候选与参考 kernel 得到分析更简单、测试中仍逐位一致的 reduced-concurrency 版本；在 F*/Pulse 中形式化证明两版在实数上计算相同，无需数值容差。
Result: 在 KernelBench 上验证了广泛 kernel 集合，并在 CUTLASS、Triton、Gluon 三个框架/语言间证明 fused GEMM 等价；对难以验证的 mega-kernel 分析出 4 个此前未报告的问题，其中 2 个为明确 bug；agent 用 RESOLVE 修复这些问题且性能影响极小。
Conclusion: 测试与形式验证结合可让 agent 在能严格核对结果时放心激进优化 GPU kernel，实数等价证明替代数值容差是可行路径。

papers.title: Knowing the Rules, Applying the Rules: Evaluating Language Models on Traditional Chinese Bazi
papers.abstract_en: Knowing domain rules does not guarantee applying them to a case. We study this distinction in traditional Chinese Bazi through 3,000 Chinese multiple-choice questions spanning 14 Theory and 11 Case categories. Six endpoint systems are evaluated, with primary results reported on a 2,492-item model-informed refinement. Theory accuracy exceeds Case accuracy for every system, and gaps of 16.60-29.56 percentage points remain when invalid responses are excluded. The contrast is more specific than a general case-reasoning deficit. Across six systems, Twelve Stages and Nayin reach mean accuracies of 89.10% and 88.62%, while Shensha Basics reaches 75.96%. Within Case, Luck Pillars averages 84.62%, but Career and Family Relations average only 36.98% and 38.19%. Overall rankings also conceal different category strengths. On the original 3,000 items, paired DeepSeek native/disabled comparisons associate native configurations with Theory gains of 6.53 and 12.20 points for Flash and Pro, respectively; Case changes are -3.67 and +1.27 points. These are provider-configuration associations, not isolated causal effects of reasoning. The results motivate task-specific evaluation of cultural-domain applications rather than reliance on aggregate knowledge scores. The benchmark measures agreement with a model-generated, model-verified answer key, not real-world predictive validity. Final-set results are post-selection descriptions, and incomplete provenance and expert validation constrain their interpretation.
papers.comment: 16 pages, including references and appendices. Project page: https://monsterpppp.github.io/bazi-qa-benchmark/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建传统八字中文多选基准（3,000 题，14 类 Theory、11 类 Case），评测六个端点系统，发现所有系统 Theory 准确率均高于 Case，剔除无效作答后差距仍达 16.60–29.56 个百分点。十二长生与纳音平均准确率 89.10% 与 88.62%，而神煞基础仅 75.96%；Case 内大运平均 84.62%，但事业与家庭关系仅 36.98% 与 38.19%。作者主张按具体类别做任务级评估，而非依赖聚合知识分数。
Motivation: 掌握领域规则不等于能在具体案例上应用规则；聚合准确率会掩盖类别间巨大差异，文化领域应用需要能区分这两种能力的评测。
Method: 构建 3,000 道中文多选题，覆盖 14 类 Theory 与 11 类 Case；主结果基于 2,492 题的 model-informed refinement 子集，评测六个端点系统，并在原始 3,000 题上做 DeepSeek 原生/禁用推理的配对比较。
Result: 六个系统 Theory 准确率均高于 Case，剔除无效作答后差距 16.60–29.56 个百分点；十二长生与纳音平均 89.10% 与 88.62%，神煞基础 75.96%；Case 中大运 84.62%，事业与家庭关系仅 36.98% 与 38.19%；DeepSeek 原生推理配置对应 Flash 与 Pro 的 Theory 提升 6.53 与 12.20 点，Case 变化为 -3.67 与 +1.27 点。
Conclusion: 文化领域应用应做任务级评估而非聚合知识分数；基准衡量的是与模型生成、模型校验答案键的一致性，不代表真实预测效度，且最终集结果属事后描述、来源与专家验证不完整。

papers.title: Sharp Integrality Gaps in Calibration Distance
papers.abstract_en: We study the offline gap between deterministic calibration distance C and its fractional relaxation L for binary unit-weight sequences under total absolute-change cost. We sharpen the offline comparison C <= L + O(sqrt(T)) (Qiao and Zheng, 2024, Theorem 2) to the sharp worst-case order Theta(T^(1/3)). If Delta_T is the supremum of C - L over length-T inputs, then T^(1/3)/1000 <= Delta_T <= 41T^(1/3) for T >= 216. The upper bound holds for every input, while each T >= 216 has a rational lower-bound input. For every input with m distinct forecasts, C <= L + m, and the unrestricted-sample worst-case sparse order is Theta(m). For rational forecasts and accuracy, with binary-encoded multiplicities of separately assignable unit identities, a grid-free polynomial-bit-time procedure returns B <= L <= U, U - B < eta, and an exactly calibrated compact repair of cost at most U + m <= L + m + eta.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把离线校准距离 C 与其分数松弛 L 的差距从 O(sqrt(T)) 收紧到尖锐的最坏阶 Θ(T^(1/3))：对 T≥216 有 T^(1/3)/1000 ≤ Δ_T ≤ 41T^(1/3)，上界对所有输入成立，每个 T≥216 都存在有理下界输入。当输入只有 m 个不同预测值时 C ≤ L + m，最坏稀疏阶为 Θ(m)；并给出网格无关、多项式比特时间的算法，输出 B ≤ L ≤ U 且 U−B<η，以及代价至多 U+m 的精确校准紧凑修复。
Motivation: 确定性校准距离 C 与其分数松弛 L 之间的离线差距此前只有 O(sqrt(T)) 的上界（Qiao and Zheng, 2024, Theorem 2），该界并非最坏阶，且缺少匹配下界与可计算的修复方案。
Method: 研究二元单位权重序列在总绝对变化代价下的 C 与 L：构造上界证明与有理下界输入以夹逼 Δ_T；按不同预测值个数 m 分析稀疏情形；对有理预测值与精度、以二进制编码的可独立分配单位重数，给出网格无关的多项式比特时间过程，输出 B ≤ L ≤ U 并构造精确校准的紧凑修复。
Result: 对 T≥216 有 T^(1/3)/1000 ≤ Δ_T ≤ 41T^(1/3)，把 Qiao and Zheng (2024) 的 O(sqrt(T)) 改进为尖锐的 Θ(T^(1/3))；上界对每个输入成立，且每个 T≥216 都存在有理下界输入。对含 m 个不同预测值的输入有 C ≤ L + m，无限制样本的最坏稀疏阶为 Θ(m)。算法输出满足 U−B<η，修复代价至多 U+m ≤ L+m+η。
Conclusion: 校准距离的离线 integrality gap 的尖锐最坏阶是 T^(1/3) 而非 sqrt(T)，且在不同预测值数 m 上可收紧到 Θ(m)；有理输入上该差距与精确校准修复可在多项式比特时间内近似求得。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: An evolutionary origin of collective decision making in humans and machines
papers.abstract_en: Groups of individuals can solve collective problems more accurately than any single member, by aggregating their opinions. Recent theoretical work has identified individual-level reward schemes that allow uninformed individuals to evolve collective intelligence from the bottom up, through social learning. Yet these results are restricted to linear prediction problems and simple averaging, while the decision tasks that real groups confront are often non-linear, and the institutions that aggregate opinions are seldom single-layer averages: districts elect representatives who in turn vote on policy, referees advise editors who decide on publication. Here we develop a framework for the evolution of collective intelligence in multi-layer voting populations, where individuals observe limited information and groups recursively aggregate their opinions by majority rule. We prove that single-layer voting cannot solve non-linear classification problems under any individual reward scheme. We then identify a "marginal feedback" payoff structure, which rewards individuals only when their opinion is pivotal in their group, and at every layer above them. This reward scheme induces a layered population to evolve accurate collective solutions to complex, non-linear decision tasks through individual-level peer imitation alone. The collective behavior that emerges is equivalent to a multi-layer perceptron in machine learning. Our results provide a naturalistic account of hierarchical institutions, in which the outsize importance of swing voters is the incentive that sustains collective accuracy; and they identify the credit-assignment rule in machine learning as not just an engineered solution but a natural evolutionary outcome.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 4 figures. Supplementary materials (Materials and Methods, Supplementary Text, 12 supplementary figures) are appended to the main text
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多层多数投票群体中，只有当个体意见在其所在层及以上各层都成为关键票（pivotal）时才获得奖励的 marginal feedback 报酬结构，能让仅靠同伴模仿 (peer imitation) 的分层群体演化出解决非线性分类任务的准确集体决策，其涌现行为等价于机器学习中的多层感知机 (multi-layer perceptron)。作者同时证明：在任何个体报酬方案下，单层投票都无法解决非线性分类问题。
Motivation: 既有的集体智能演化理论只覆盖线性预测与简单平均，而现实决策任务多为非线性、聚合机构也多为多层（选区选代表再投票、编辑再决定发表），单层平均框架无法解释这类层级制度如何产生准确集体判断。
Method: 构建多层投票群体的演化框架：个体只观察有限信息，各层以多数规则递归聚合意见；通过理论证明刻画单层投票的能力边界，再设计 marginal feedback 报酬结构（仅当意见在本层及以上各层均为关键票时给予奖励），分析仅凭同伴模仿的个体学习能否演化出准确的集体解。
Result: 证明了在任何个体报酬方案下，单层投票都无法解决非线性分类问题；marginal feedback 报酬结构使分层群体仅通过个体层面的同伴模仿即演化出对复杂非线性决策任务的准确集体解，且涌现出的集体行为等价于多层感知机。
Conclusion: 层级制度中摇摆选民 (swing voters) 的关键作用正是维持集体准确性的激励来源，而机器学习中的 credit-assignment 规则不只是工程设计，也是自然演化可达成的结果。
Relevance: 18
