papers.title: Bayesian Data Augmentation for DNN Retraining with Binomial Outcomes in Vision-Based UAV Landing
papers.abstract_en: In GPS-denied or cluttered urban environments, vision-based landing is essential for reliable UAV missions. Real-world landing sites are often unstructured and highly variable, requiring strong generalization by the perception system. Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) trained with synthetic data augmentation offer a scalable solution for learning landing-site features across diverse vehicle and environmental states. However, computationally expensive DNN retraining, along with challenging performance validation via test flights, limits exhaustive model fine-tuning and necessitates an optimized retraining pipeline. In this work, we deploy a Bayesian data augmentation framework integrated with a photorealistic simulator featuring high-fidelity vehicle dynamics to iteratively retrain the helipad detector DNN, maximizing landing performance as the objective function. We validate our framework with experiments in a photorealistic simulator under different environmental conditions and vehicle states, demonstrating improved landing performance and tighter confidence intervals on predicted landing outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 GPS 拒止或杂乱城市环境中，用贝叶斯数据增强 (Bayesian data augmentation) 驱动视觉着陆点检测 DNN 的迭代重训练：以着陆性能为目标函数，在含高保真飞行动力学的写实仿真器中循环生成训练数据并重训 helipad 检测器。在不同环境条件与飞行器状态下的仿真验证中，着陆性能提升，且预测着陆结果的置信区间更紧。
Motivation: 真实着陆点非结构化且变化大，要求感知网络泛化；但 DNN 重训练计算代价高、又难以用试飞验证性能，导致无法穷尽式微调，需要一条优化的重训练流程。
Method: 部署贝叶斯数据增强框架，与具备高保真车辆动力学的写实仿真器 (photorealistic simulator) 集成，以最大化着陆性能为目标函数，迭代重训练 helipad 检测 DNN。
Result: 在写实仿真器中、跨不同环境条件与飞行器状态的实验显示：着陆性能改善，预测着陆结果的置信区间更紧 (tighter confidence intervals)。
Conclusion: 把数据增强交给贝叶斯框架并以着陆性能为目标函数做闭环迭代重训练，可在仿真条件下同时提高视觉着陆成功率与预测结果的确定性。

papers.title: How Should a Prompt Optimizer Spend a Tight Budget? BudgetAPO with Noise-Adaptive Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has been widely employed to adapt large language models without updating their weights, yielding promising results. However, existing methods such as GEPA and OPRO assume hundreds to thousands of subject-model calls, far more than is practical behind paid, rate-limited APIs. Under tight budgets they fail in two ways: multi-stage pipelines can exhaust the budget and return the seed prompt unchanged, while single-stage methods compare candidates on fixed-size minibatches, regardless of each task's noise. As a remedy, we introduce BudgetAPO, a single-stage optimizer for the tight-budget regime. BudgetAPO incorporates (1) a noise-adaptive rule that sizes the evaluation slice to each task's noise, measured by a short probe; (2) a fixed slice that turns every accept/reject decision into a paired comparison; and (3) a reflective operator that rewrites reasoning strategy and output format jointly. Extensive results across seven benchmarks and five subject models demonstrate that BudgetAPO ranks first on every subject and beats every baseline under Holm-corrected paired tests, while returning the seed in 13% of runs at 250 calls against 86% for GEPA. On GPT-OSS-20B, GEPA needs 4.5 times as many calls to match BudgetAPO's 100-call score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BudgetAPO 是面向紧预算的单阶段提示优化器：用短探针测量各任务噪声并据此决定评估切片大小，用固定切片把每次接受/拒绝变成配对比较，再用反思算子同时改写推理策略与输出格式。在七个基准、五个 subject model 上它在每个 subject 上排名第一且在 Holm 校正配对检验中胜过全部基线；250 次调用时 BudgetAPO 有 13% 的运行返回种子提示，GEPA 为 86%，GPT-OSS-20B 上 GEPA 需要 4.5 倍调用量才能追平其 100 次调用的分数。
Motivation: GEPA、OPRO 等 APO 方法假设数百到数千次 subject-model 调用，在付费限流 API 后不现实：多阶段管线会烧光预算原样返回种子提示，单阶段方法则用固定大小 minibatch 比较候选，无视各任务的评估噪声。
Method: 单阶段优化器 BudgetAPO 含三个部件：噪声自适应规则用一次短探针测量任务噪声并据此确定评估切片大小；固定切片使每次接受/拒绝都成为配对比较；反思算子联合改写推理策略与输出格式。在七个基准、五个 subject model 上与 GEPA、OPRO 等基线比较。
Result: 七个基准、五个 subject model 上 BudgetAPO 在每个 subject 上排名第一，并在 Holm 校正配对检验中胜过所有基线；250 次调用预算下返回种子提示的比例为 13%，GEPA 为 86%；在 GPT-OSS-20B 上 GEPA 需要 4.5 倍的调用次数才能追平 BudgetAPO 用 100 次调用取得的分数。
Conclusion: 在紧预算下，按任务噪声自适应地分配评估样本并把决策做成配对比较，比多阶段管线和固定 minibatch 更能省下调用并避免原样返回种子提示。

papers.title: StageVLN: Spatial and Trajectory Auxiliary Guidance for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) policies increasingly benefit from strong semantic priors provided by large vision-language models (VLMs). However, standard action supervision does not explicitly encourage intermediate representations to preserve scene geometry, relative orientation, or global episode progress. Incorporating depth estimators, explicit maps, point clouds, or geometry foundation models at inference can provide such structure but introduces additional computation, memory overhead, and architectural dependence during deployment. We introduce StageVLN, a training framework that shapes navigation representations through privileged spatial and trajectory guidance while preserving the original inference pathway. A frozen geometry foundation model provides multi-level spatial guidance to hierarchical navigator states, while relative-heading and expert-route progress objectives provide complementary trajectory-state supervision. All auxiliary components are used only during training and removed at deployment. On R2R-CE validation-unseen, StageVLN achieves 56.3\% SR and 51.4\% SPL with a 4B-parameter backbone, without an additional geometry encoder at inference. On RxR-CE, it achieves 54.3\% SR without additional navigation training data or a geometry encoder at inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StageVLN 用冻结的几何基础模型在训练期给层级导航器状态注入多层空间监督，再加相对朝向与专家路径进度两个轨迹目标，部署时全部移除、推理通路不变。在 R2R-CE validation-unseen 上以 4B 骨干取得 56.3% SR 与 51.4% SPL，RxR-CE 上 54.3% SR，推理端不加几何编码器。
Motivation: 标准动作监督不显式约束中间表征保留场景几何、相对朝向与全局进度；若在推理期引入深度估计、显式地图、点云或几何基础模型，会带来额外计算、显存开销与部署期架构依赖。
Method: 训练框架分三路监督：冻结的几何基础模型对层级导航器状态提供多级空间引导，相对朝向 (relative-heading) 目标与专家路径进度 (expert-route progress) 目标提供轨迹状态监督；所有辅助组件仅在训练期使用，部署时移除，保留原推理通路，骨干为 4B 参数模型。
Result: R2R-CE validation-unseen：SR 56.3%、SPL 51.4%（4B 骨干，推理端无额外几何编码器）；RxR-CE：SR 54.3%，且不使用额外导航训练数据、推理端同样无几何编码器。
Conclusion: 特权空间与轨迹引导可以在训练期塑造导航表征，从而在部署时不依赖几何编码器仍保持具身对话式导航 (CE-VLN) 的 SR/SPL 水平。

papers.title: Bellman-Centric Learning: Near-Optimal Regret for Linear Bandits with Memory
papers.abstract_en: We study linear bandits with memory, where past actions induce endogenous nonstationarity through an arbitrary known, bounded matrix-valued memory map. To trade off exploration and exploitation while accounting for the memory dynamics, we develop RSM-LinUCB, a Bellman-centric algorithm that learns as in linear bandits and plans as in reinforcement learning. This design admits a novel regret decomposition which separates the memory-induced error from the cumulative reward estimation error along the learner's trajectory. We prove a high-probability regret bound of $\widetilde O\big(dRS(M+1)+σd\sqrt T\big)$, where $T$ is the learning horizon, $d$ is the parameter dimension, $M$ is the memory length, $R$ and $S$ bound the memory-map operator norm and reward-parameter norm, respectively, and $σ$ is the sub-Gaussian noise scale. Our results reveal that the multiplicative memory-horizon coupling in prior bounds is not intrinsic: memory only contributes an additive cost, up to logarithmic factors. We also prove a matching minimax lower bound, establishing near-optimality. We further extend the algorithm to generalized linear rewards, preserving this separation with near-optimal memory and leading statistical dependence. Our algorithms outperform the baselines in numerical experiments on synthetic instances and semi-synthetic KV- and semantic-cache tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对带已知有界矩阵记忆映射的线性 bandit，提出 RSM-LinUCB：按线性 bandit 方式学习、按强化学习方式规划，得到把记忆诱导误差与轨迹上累积奖励估计误差分开的新 regret 分解。高概率 regret 上界为 Õ(dRS(M+1)+σd√T)，记忆只贡献加性代价而非先前界的记忆-时域乘性耦合，并有匹配的 minimax 下界。
Motivation: 带记忆的线性 bandit 中，过去动作通过记忆映射造成内生非平稳，先前 regret 界把记忆长度 M 与时间跨度 T 乘性耦合，界被人为放大。
Method: RSM-LinUCB 以 Bellman 为中心：学习部分沿用 linear bandit / LinUCB 的线性奖励估计，规划部分引入 RL 式 Bellman 结构以显式处理记忆动力学；由此导出分离记忆误差与奖励估计误差的 regret 分解，并推广到广义线性 (generalized linear) 奖励。
Result: 高概率 regret 上界 Õ(dRS(M+1)+σd√T)，其中 T 为时域、d 为参数维数、M 为记忆长度、R 与 S 分别界记忆映射算子范数与奖励参数范数、σ 为次高斯噪声尺度；证明匹配的 minimax 下界确立近最优性；广义线性推广保持该分离并具有近最优的记忆与统计依赖；在合成实例与半合成 KV-cache、semantic-cache 任务的数值实验中优于基线。
Conclusion: 记忆对 regret 的代价本质是加性的（至多差对数因子），先前界中的乘性记忆-时域耦合并非内在；该结论在广义线性奖励下仍成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Graph Data Augmentation via Contrastive Generator Inversion ($\texttt{DCBA}$)
papers.abstract_en: Graphs provide a natural representation of many complex systems, ranging from social platforms to ecosystems. However, the development of graph-based machine learning methods is often constrained by the limited availability of large and diverse graph datasets. In this paper, we introduce $\texttt{DCBA}$, a model-based approach to graph data augmentation that infers the configuration of a synthetic graph generator from an observed network. We instantiate the proposed framework using the $\texttt{ABCD}$ generator, which produces scale-free networks with community structure. Our model learns a joint representation of graphs and generator parametrisations using a multi-positive contrastive objective with soft negative weighting. The learned representation enables the prediction of an $\texttt{ABCD}$ configuration whose stochastic realisations preserve the macrostructural properties encoded by the generator. Experiments show that $\texttt{DCBA}$ recovers generator parameters more accurately and robustly than an algorithmic inverse-modelling baseline. Its downstream utility is further demonstrated in community detection, where inferred configurations used to fine-tune $\texttt{PRoCD}$ improve AMI on average by $161\%$ on synthetic and $273\%$ on real-world networks.
papers.comment: Accepted to 5th Learning on Graphs Conference; Boston, MA, USA; 20-22.11.2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DCBA 用对比学习反演图生成器配置来做图数据增强：从观测网络推断 ABCD 生成器参数，再用推断配置微调下游模型。在社区检测中，用推断配置微调 PRoCD 使 AMI 平均提升 161%（合成网络）和 273%（真实网络），且参数恢复比算法式逆建模基线更准更稳。
Motivation: 图机器学习受限于大规模、多样化图数据集稀缺，而生成器参数与观测网络之间的逆问题缺少稳健求解手段。
Method: 提出 DCBA：以 ABCD 生成器（无标度、含社区结构）为实例，用多正例对比目标加软负例加权学习图与生成器参数化的联合表示，再由该表示预测能保持生成器宏观结构属性的 ABCD 配置。
Result: DCBA 恢复生成器参数比算法式逆建模基线更准确、更鲁棒；下游社区检测中，用推断配置微调 PRoCD 使 AMI 平均提升 161%（合成网络）与 273%（真实网络）。
Conclusion: 把图生成器逆问题转成对比表示学习，可从观测网络得到保留宏观结构的合成图配置，并显著抬高社区检测的 AMI。

papers.title: Training and Scaling Compute-Optimal Physiological Waveform Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the scaling laws and compute-optimal training of physiological waveform foundation models (FMs). We train Aether, a family of over one hundred FMs ranging from 20M to 2.1B parameters, on up to 36.3M hours of physiological waveforms. We construct eight clinical prediction tasks from MIMIC-III and evaluate the FMs through linear probing. The 720M FM outperforms all existing baseline FMs across all eight tasks. A scaling law of model size, pretraining hours, and labeled patients predicts downstream ranking error, i.e. $1-\mathrm{AUROC}$, effectively with $0.5\%$ prediction MAE at held-out resource scales and $0.9\%$ MAE when extrapolating to 2.1B parameters. We present three findings: (1) Compute-optimal training scales both FM size and pretraining hours. Under the fitted law, a $10.0\times$ increase in compute FLOPs scales model size by $1.2\times$ and pretraining hours by $8.2\times$. (2) Larger FMs use waveform data more efficiently, and greater pretraining exposure increases the benefit of model scaling. Starting from 25M parameters and 4.8M pretraining hours, doubling FM size reduces the predicted hours needed for the same performance by $51.8\%$. (3) Pretraining and clinical supervision reinforce each other: more labeled patients increase the return to pretraining, while larger FMs and longer pretraining reduce labeling requirements. For the example of the 720M FM, extending pretraining from 120K to 36.3M hours reduces the predicted patient requirement by $61\%$ at a target ranking error. These findings provide a quantitative training recipe and a promising and durable scaling path for physiological waveform modeling and downstream clinical prediction.

TL;DR: 训练 Aether 系列一百多个生理波形基础模型（20M–2.1B 参数，最多 36.3M 小时数据），拟合出预测下游排序误差 (1−AUROC) 的缩放律，MAE 在留出资源尺度为 0.5%、外推到 2.1B 时为 0.9%。算力最优训练要求模型规模与预训练时长同步扩大：算力 FLOPs 增 10.0× 对应模型 1.2×、时长 8.2×；从 25M 参数与 4.8M 小时起，模型翻倍可使同等性能所需时长降 51.8%。
Motivation: 生理波形基础模型缺少可量化的算力最优训练配方：模型该多大、预训练多久、需要多少标注患者，此前没有能预测下游排序误差的缩放律来指导资源分配。
Method: 在最多 36.3M 小时生理波形上训练超过一百个 FM（20M 到 2.1B 参数），从 MIMIC-III 构造 8 个临床预测任务并用 linear probing 评测；拟合联合模型规模、预训练时长与标注患者数的缩放律，以预测下游排序误差 1−AUROC。

papers.title: Transformer-Based Time-Series Inference of Lindblad Dynamics in Open Quantum Systems
papers.abstract_en: The Lindblad master equation is the standard framework for describing the non-unitary evolution of open quantum systems, where environmental interactions induce dissipation and decoherence. When both the system Hamiltonian and the dissipation rates are partially unknown or explicitly time-dependent, traditional analytical inversion and system-identification techniques become intractable. Recent works have demonstrated that Transformer-based models can infer unknown dissipation rates from observable time series, yet these approaches typically rely on hand-crafted statistical features under idealized and highly restricted conditions. Here we advance the paradigm by introducing a raw time-series Transformer that directly ingests the full trajectories of Pauli expectation values $\langleσ_x(t)\rangle$, $\langleσ_y(t)\rangle$, and $\langleσ_z(t)\rangle$, thereby fully exploiting the self-attention mechanism for temporal modeling. The architecture is further extended to jointly learn unknown Hamiltonian parameters, handle multiple dissipation channels, and operate robustly under realistic measurement noise. Across all tested scenarios the model achieves consistently high reconstruction accuracy while eliminating manual feature engineering. This provides a scalable, robust, and versatile framework for quantum environment sensing in realistic open quantum systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出直接吃 Pauli 期望值原始轨迹 ⟨σx(t)⟩、⟨σy(t)⟩、⟨σz(t)⟩ 的 raw time-series Transformer，用自注意力建模时间依赖，联合反演 Lindblad 动力学中的未知 Hamiltonian 参数与多个耗散通道速率。在含测量噪声的全部测试场景中均保持高重建精度，且无需手工特征工程。
Motivation: 当系统 Hamiltonian 与耗散率部分未知或显式含时时，解析反演与系统辨识方法失效；已有 Transformer 方案依赖手工统计特征且限于理想化受限条件。
Method: raw time-series Transformer 直接输入三条 Pauli 期望值全轨迹，靠 self-attention 做时间建模；架构扩展到联合学习未知 Hamiltonian 参数、处理多个耗散通道，并在测量噪声下保持稳健。
Result: 在全部测试场景中模型均取得一致的高重建精度，同时消除手工特征工程；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 原始轨迹端到端的 Transformer 可作为开放量子系统环境传感的可扩展、稳健且通用的反演框架，替代手工特征加受限条件的旧做法。

papers.title: When Does a Diffusion Model Decide What to Draw ?
papers.abstract_en: A diffusion model starts from pure noise and removes it step by step. Somewhere along the way it stops being able to become "anything" and becomes committed to, say, a horse rather than a truck. We measure when this happens, and what a trained model gets wrong about it, on CIFAR-10. The most direct measurement is to freeze a half-finished image, restart the generation from that point many times, and count how often each class comes out. We call this probability the committor. Measured this way, the model settles coarse questions (vehicle or animal?) at roughly twice the noise level of fine ones (which animal?). papers.title: Spacecraft Rendezvous Trajectory Generation with Modular Constraints via Diffusion Model Composition
papers.abstract_en: Emerging mission classes such as on-orbit servicing, satellite inspection, and active debris removal require trajectory design methods that are adaptable to a variety of mission scenarios. We present a diffusion-based trajectory generation approach for rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO) that enables flexible configuration of mission constraints. First, individual energy-based diffusion models are trained to satisfy distinct constraints such as approach cone and sensor line-of-sight from a set of optimized trajectories. Then, at inference time, the learned energy models can be composed with one another, or with an analytically defined energy field, to enforce specific constraint combinations. We validate this framework with the composition of a learned approach cone model and a learned sensor line-of-sight model, as well as a learned approach cone model and synthetic obstacle avoidance model, both of which yield constraint satisfaction rates that are within 1 percentage point of the single-constraint models or higher. These results indicate that our compositional diffusion framework can provide a modular approach to RPO trajectory design and enable reconfiguration for new constraint combinations without requiring model retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向交会与近距离操作 (RPO) 轨迹生成，提出可组合的扩散模型：分别训练满足接近锥 (approach cone)、传感器视线 (sensor line-of-sight) 等单一约束的能量模型，推理时把学到的能量与解析能量场组合以同时施加约束组合。组合后的约束满足率与单约束模型相差在 1 个百分点以内或更高，无需重训即可重构新约束组合。
Motivation: 在轨服务、卫星检查、主动碎片清除等任务类别需要轨迹设计方法能灵活适配多种任务场景与约束组合，而逐场景重新训练模型代价高。
Method: 从一组优化轨迹训练各自的 energy-based diffusion model，每个模型对应一种约束（approach cone、sensor line-of-sight）；推理时将学到的能量模型彼此组合，或与解析定义的能量场（如 synthetic obstacle avoidance model）组合，以施加特定约束组合。
Result: 验证了两组组合：学到的 approach cone 模型 + 学到的 sensor line-of-sight 模型，以及 approach cone 模型 + synthetic obstacle avoidance 模型；两者的约束满足率均在单约束模型的 1 个百分点以内或更高。
Conclusion: 组合式扩散框架可为 RPO 轨迹设计提供模块化路径，通过能量组合而非重训来适配新的约束组合。

papers.title: Visual Grounding Safety in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly trained to generate structured outputs like points and bounding boxes that downstream interfaces, agents, and robots can act on, yet safety alignment of this output channel has not been systematically analyzed. We study visual grounding safety by repurposing three safety benchmarks spanning direct harm (VLSU), social bias (BBQ-V), and situational safety (Asimov-2.0) into 15,401 matched pairs of harmful requests that differ only in the requested output: a free-text answer (VQA) or a grounding (point or bounding box). Across five VLMs, models that refuse a harmful request posed as a question often comply when the same request asks for a grounding: averaged over models, grounding refusal trails VQA refusal by 31-59 percentage points, depending on the domain, and safety system prompts do not close this gap. We propose a fine-tuning approach that combines grounding-form refusals with capability grounding data and self-distilled benign data to counter over-refusal. For Qwen3-VL-8B and VisionReasoner-7B, it improves grounding refusal by 77-95 percentage points on VLSU and BBQ-V and by 64-85 points on the held-out Asimov-2.0 domain, while also improving VQA refusal, preserving grounding capability, and keeping over-refusal limited. Representation analysis shows that fine-tuning moves harmful requests toward each model's refusal direction, most strongly for grounding, while leaving benign requests near the harmless reference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 视觉定位 (grounding) 输出通道的安全对齐存在系统性漏洞：把同一有害请求从自由文本问答改成点/框定位，五个 VLM 的拒绝率平均下降 31–59 个百分点，且安全 system prompt 无法弥合。作者用 grounding 形式拒绝数据 + 定位能力数据 + 自蒸馏良性数据微调，Qwen3-VL-8B 与 VisionReasoner-7B 在 VLSU、BBQ-V 上拒绝率提升 77–95 个百分点，留出的 Asimov-2.0 上提升 64–85 个百分点，同时保住定位能力并抑制过度拒绝。
Motivation: VLM 被训练输出点、边界框等可供界面、智能体和机器人直接执行的结构化结果，但这一输出通道的安全对齐从未被系统分析，问答形式上的拒绝并不迁移到定位形式。
Method: 把三个安全基准 VLSU（直接危害）、BBQ-V（社会偏见）、Asimov-2.0（情境安全）改造为 15,401 对仅输出形式不同的有害请求（VQA 文本回答 vs 点/框定位），在五个 VLM 上测量拒绝差；再提出微调方案，混合 grounding 形式拒绝数据、定位能力数据与自蒸馏良性数据以抑制过度拒绝，并做表征分析。
Result: 五个模型平均而言 grounding 拒绝率比 VQA 拒绝率低 31–59 个百分点（随领域而异），安全 system prompt 不能缩小该差距。微调后 Qwen3-VL-8B 与 VisionReasoner-7B 在 VLSU 与 BBQ-V 上 grounding 拒绝率提升 77–95 个百分点，在留出的 Asimov-2.0 领域提升 64–85 个百分点，同时 VQA 拒绝率也提高、定位能力保持、过度拒绝有限。表征分析显示微调把有害请求推向各模型的拒绝方向，对 grounding 最强，良性请求仍靠近无害参考。
Conclusion: 安全对齐是绑定在输出形式上的：问答上的拒绝不保证定位输出上的拒绝，必须在 grounding 形式上单独对齐，并用能力与良性数据对冲过度拒绝。

papers.title: Sphere Encoder 2
papers.abstract_en: Sphere Encoder is an autoencoder that generates images by decoding random points from a high-dimensional latent sphere. We identify two limitations of the original formulation that reduce its generation quality. First, random points concentrate near the equator relative to the pole on an encoded latent, but the training rotation never reaches this region, leaving a gap that limits one-step generation. Second, training for generation with pixel-wise reconstruction loss encourages the decoder to average over plausible images, producing blurry images that lack high-frequency details. We present Sphere Encoder 2 to address both limitations, substantially improving image generation quality while maintaining the speed and simplicity of a autoencoder. Models are released at https://github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2.
papers.comment: Fix typos. Code will be available at https://github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sphere Encoder 2 修复了原版 Sphere Encoder 从高维潜球随机点解码生成图像的两处缺陷：随机点在编码后的潜球上集中于赤道附近而训练旋转到不了该区域，留下覆盖空洞限制一步生成；逐像素重建损失又促使解码器对多个合理图像取平均，导致输出模糊、缺高频细节。修正后图像生成质量显著提升，同时保持自编码器的速度与简洁性。
Motivation: 原版 Sphere Encoder 的潜球采样覆盖不均与逐像素重建损失共同压低生成质量：赤道区域未被训练旋转触及，一步生成受限；重建损失导致解码器平均化输出，图像模糊且缺高频细节。
Method: 针对两项缺陷改造 Sphere Encoder：一是让训练旋转覆盖随机点集中所在的赤道区域，消除潜球上的覆盖空洞；二是替换逐像素重建损失以抑制解码器对合理图像的平均化倾向，同时保留自编码器的速度与简洁结构。
Result: 图像生成质量相比原版 Sphere Encoder 显著提升，且保持自编码器的速度与简洁性；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 潜球采样覆盖与重建损失的设计是 Sphere Encoder 生成质量的两个关键瓶颈，修复后可在不牺牲速度的前提下改善一步生成的图像质量。

papers.title: PROWBench: Do Video Models Render What the Program Specifies?
papers.abstract_en: Programmable world models separate executable dynamics from visual generation, offering a promising foundation for next-generation game engines. However, their visual adherence to explicit rules and interactions remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing benchmarks assess visual quality, controllability, and instruction or physical adherence, but rarely test fidelity to fine-grained, program-specified world events. We introduce PROWBench, comprising 170 programmatically constructed episodes and 600 proxy videos covering diverse scenes and interactions. PROWBench logs entity states and timestamped events, including those outside the camera's field of view, as replayable world records, from which it renders synchronized views and proxy representations. This enables generated videos to be checked against the observable consequences of program execution. An extensible framework constructs scenes, controls behaviors, and can render each camera view in different representations, such as coarse 3D, and bounding boxes. The benchmark covers first- and third-person perspectives, with synchronized multi-view observations available for a subset of episodes. Grounded in these records, PROWBench evaluates entity control, long-horizon memory, and, with two VLM-based metrics, Logic-Render Alignment and Interaction Success Rate, adherence to the prescribed timeline and the visual realization of timestamped engine-recorded events.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PROWBench 用可执行程序生成带时间戳事件日志的世界记录，再渲染成同步多视角与代理表示（粗 3D、bounding box），据此核验可编程世界模型生成的视频是否真的实现了程序规定的事件。基准含 170 个程序构建 episode、600 个代理视频，用两个 VLM 指标 Logic-Render Alignment 与 Interaction Success Rate 评估实体控制、长时程记忆与时间线依从。
Motivation: 可编程世界模型把可执行动力学与视觉生成分开，但其对显式规则与交互的视觉依从性缺少评测；现有基准只测画质、可控性与指令/物理依从，很少检验对细粒度、程序指定世界事件的保真度。
Method: 程序化构建场景与行为，记录实体状态和含视野外事件的时间戳事件日志作为可回放世界记录，从中渲染同步视角与代理表示（含粗 3D 与 bounding box）；支持第一/第三人称及部分 episode 的同步多视角。评测用两个 VLM 指标：Logic-Render Alignment 与 Interaction Success Rate，覆盖实体控制与长时程记忆。
Result: 基准规模为 170 个程序构建 episode 与 600 个覆盖多样场景和交互的代理视频；提供可回放世界记录、同步多视角子集，以及 Logic-Render Alignment 和 Interaction Success Rate 两个 VLM 指标。
Conclusion: 把程序执行的可观测后果作为核验依据，可编程世界模型的输出能被逐事件对照检查，而不只看画质或指令依从。

papers.title: Learning PDE Dynamics between Submanifolds Using Green's Observation Operators
papers.abstract_en: Many physical systems are driven and observed only on lower-dimensional submanifolds of a larger spatial domain, while their dynamics are governed by the ambient medium occupying that domain. Examples include laser-heated parts imaged by an infrared camera, and ground-level emissions measured on a sensor plane. Full-domain solvers, however, compute the entire volume for every new source although only the observation submanifold is needed, and black-box surrogates do not exploit that the ambient medium remains fixed. We introduce the \emph{Green's Observation Operator (GObO)}, which maps the ambient medium once to the Green's kernel of a linear PDE restricted to the source and observation submanifolds. New sources then cost one lower-dimensional integral and no network evaluation. Exponential rates in the kernel yield an exact finite streaming state with horizon-independent memory; we prove its stability and an approximation rate for the restricted heat kernel. On three-dimensional heat conduction and advection--diffusion with collocated and distinct source and observation geometries, GObO trained on static sources predicts responses to moving sources zero-shot with 4--8$\times$ lower error than black-box surrogates, at 1.4\,ms per query after a single conditioning pass. The same kernel transfers across resolutions and admits corrections for mild nonlinearities, including radiative losses and temperature-dependent conductivity, without retraining, at the cost of lower in-distribution accuracy.
papers.comment: Added Declaration of Generative AI Use
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Green's Observation Operator (GObO)：把固定环境介质对应的线性 PDE Green 核一次性限制到源与观测子流形上，新源只需一次低维积分、无需网络前向。在三维热传导与平流扩散上，静态源训练后对移动源零样本预测，误差比黑盒代理低 4–8 倍，单次条件化后每查询 1.4 ms；核可跨分辨率迁移并免重训地修正辐射损失与温度依赖电导等弱非线性，代价是分布内精度下降。
Motivation: 许多物理系统只在高维区域的低维子流形上被驱动和观测，但全域求解器每次换源都要算整个体积，黑盒代理又无法利用环境介质固定这一事实。
Method: GObO 将线性 PDE 的 Green 核限制到源与观测子流形并预计算一次；核的指数衰减率给出精确有限流式状态与与视野无关的记忆，作者证明其稳定性及受限热核的逼近速率。实验设定为三维热传导与平流扩散，源与观测几何分共位与分离两种，静态源上训练。
Result: 静态源训练的 GObO 对移动源零样本预测，误差比黑盒代理低 4–8 倍，单次条件化后每查询 1.4 ms；同一核跨分辨率迁移，并可在不重训的情况下修正辐射损失与温度依赖电导等弱非线性，代价是分布内精度降低。
Conclusion: 把固定介质的 Green 核限制到观测子流形，可让新源查询退化为一次低维积分，在保持零样本泛化与跨分辨率迁移的同时大幅降误差，弱非线性修正以分布内精度为代价。

papers.title: Rethinking Probability-Based Reinforcement Learning From Posterior Concentration
papers.abstract_en: Verifier-free reinforcement learning with probability-based rewards offers a promising way to train LLMs on general reasoning tasks where external verifiers are unavailable. Yet the reliability of these rewards, especially in long-horizon reasoning, remains underexplored. This work identifies a length-dependent failure mode of probability rewards, which we call the Posterior Concentration Phenomenon (PCP). We show that the probability of a reference answer conditioned on a reasoning trace often collapses to a low-variance interval as the trace becomes lengthy. This phenomenon results in nearly indistinguishable rewards, which, under GRPO-based settings, makes probability-based policy optimization unstable and inefficient. Motivated by this, we propose Reinforcement Learning with Concentration-aware Posterior Rewards (RLCPR), a verifier-free RL framework to explicitly account for PCP for better optimization stability and token efficiency. It has two components: uncertainty-aware data sampling, which reduces concentration-prone rollouts before generation, and concentration-aware regularization, which penalizes unnecessarily long traces when posterior rewards collapse. Extensive experiments show that, alongside higher token efficiency, RLCPR outperforms the state-of-the-art verifier-free RL baseline by up to 4.0% on six of seven benchmarks, including general-domain and mathematical reasoning challenges.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 概率奖励在长推理轨迹上会出现后验集中现象 (Posterior Concentration Phenomenon, PCP)：参考答案在给定轨迹下的概率随轨迹变长塌缩到低方差区间，奖励几乎不可区分，使 GRPO 类策略优化不稳且费 token。据此提出 verifier-free 框架 RLCPR，用不确定性感知采样剔除易集中轨迹、用集中感知正则惩罚冗长轨迹，在七个基准中的六个上比 SOTA verifier-free RL 基线最高提升 4.0%。
Motivation: 无外部 verifier 时用概率作为奖励训练 LLM 推理，但长程推理下这种奖励的可靠性研究不足，奖励不可区分会拖垮 GRPO 类优化的稳定性与 token 效率。
Method: RLCPR 含两个组件：uncertainty-aware data sampling 在生成前减少易发生后验集中的 rollout；concentration-aware regularization 在后验奖励塌缩时惩罚不必要的长轨迹，整体仍属 verifier-free RL。
Result: 识别出 PCP：参考答案条件概率随轨迹变长塌缩为低方差区间，导致奖励近乎不可区分；RLCPR 在七个基准中的六个（含通用域与数学推理）上超过 SOTA verifier-free RL 基线，最高提升 4.0%，并带来更高的 token 效率。
Conclusion: 概率奖励的长度依赖失效是 verifier-free RL 的实质障碍，按后验集中程度调整采样与轨迹长度惩罚可同时改善优化稳定性与 token 效率。

papers.title: CineMR: Tool-Integrated Vision-Language Reasoning for Quantitative Cardiac MRI Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR), including cine imaging, is a reference standard for the noninvasive assessment of cardiac morphology and ventricular function. Cine CMR interpretation integrates qualitative visual assessment with quantitative measurements of ventricular volumes, ejection fraction, myocardial mass, wall thickness, and regional wall motion. Current medical vision-language models (VLMs) cannot reliably derive quantitative measurements from multidimensional cine images without analysis tools. We present CineMR, a tool-augmented VLM that invokes cardiac image-analysis tools and integrates their outputs into interleaved reasoning for quantitative CMR assessment. We also construct a multi-cohort visual question answering benchmark covering quantitative metric extraction, multiclass diagnosis, and differential diagnosis, together with tools for segmentation, phase selection, volumetry, morphometry, and regional wall motion analysis. CineMR is trained with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on tool-interaction traces followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with conditional tool-use rewards. On the multi-cohort cine CMR benchmark, CineMR achieves 35.9% pass@1 and 58.9% pass@4, compared with 1.5% pass@1 for the Qwen3-VL-8B backbone and 0.0% and 7.0% pass@1 for LLaVA-Med v1.5 and MedGemma-4B, respectively. Correct tool invocation reaches 99.8% after GRPO, up from 78.9% after SFT. Live tool outputs improve ventricular measurement accuracy by 20.4--23.7% over direct model predictions, and removing all tools reduces pass@1 from 35.9% to 27.9%. These results highlight the importance of reliable tool use for quantitative cine CMR reasoning and support CineMR as a promising approach for assistive cardiac image assessment. Code, benchmark resources, and model weights are available at https://github.com/AI-MIND-Lab/CineMR.
papers.comment: Code, benchmark resources, and model weights are available at https://github.com/AI-MIND-Lab/CineMR

papers.title: RelationVGGT: Visual Geometry Transformers for 3D Spatial Relation Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D reconstruction have progressed from per-scene optimization to feed-forward inference, and semantic scene understanding has followed suit -- yet existing methods remain confined to object-centric perception, neglecting spatial relations between objects. We formulate 3D spatial relation segmentation in a feed-forward, pose-free multi-view setting: given a visually specified subject and a relational text query, the model segments the target across views without receiving its category name. To this end, we propose RelationVGGT, a novel feed-forward framework that integrates semantic features from a visual foundation model with geometry-aware representations from a 3D geometry foundation model and leverages a relation transformer for subject-conditioned, cross-view relation prediction -- requiring neither per-scene optimization nor known camera poses. We additionally provide a fully automated annotation pipeline built on ScanNet++ with VLMs and LLMs, enabling scalable training data generation for this new task.
papers.comment: 10 pages. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (poster). Project page: https://relationvggt.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RelationVGGT 把 3D 空间关系分割做成前馈、免位姿 (pose-free) 多视设定：给定视觉指定的主体与关系文本查询，在不提供类别名的条件下跨视图分割目标。它融合视觉基础模型语义特征与 3D 几何基础模型的几何表征，用 relation transformer 做主体条件化的跨视图关系预测，并配一套基于 ScanNet++、由 VLM/LLM 驱动的全自动标注流水线生成训练数据。
Motivation: 3D 重建已从逐场景优化转向前馈推理，语义场景理解也随之演进，但现有方法仍局限于以物体为中心的感知，忽略物体之间的空间关系。
Method: 提出 RelationVGGT 前馈框架：把视觉基础模型的语义特征与 3D 几何基础模型的几何感知表征整合，通过 relation transformer 实现主体条件化、跨视图的关系预测；既不做逐场景优化也不需要已知相机位姿。同时提供建立在 ScanNet++ 之上、借助 VLM 与 LLM 的全自动标注流水线，用于规模化生成该新任务的训练数据。
Result: 在前馈、免位姿多视设定下，给定视觉指定主体与关系文本查询，模型可在不接收目标类别名的情况下跨视图分割目标；并交付一套基于 ScanNet++ 的全自动标注流水线以规模化生成训练数据。
Conclusion: 3D 空间关系分割可以摆脱逐场景优化与已知相机位姿，靠语义与几何基础模型的融合加主体条件化关系预测在前馈框架内完成，且训练数据可由 VLM/LLM 流水线自动扩展。

papers.title: PACT: End-to-End Learning of Human Pose, Contacts, and Forces from Video
papers.abstract_en: Human motion, environmental contacts, and interaction forces are governed by common physical laws, yet existing approaches typically separate visual pose reconstruction from contact and force estimation. This separation limits joint reasoning and can propagate errors between stages. We introduce PACT, an end-to-end model that jointly learns to estimate human pose, contacts and contact forces from monocular video. Our approach augments a human reconstruction foundation model with learnable contact-force tokens and a temporal transformer that integrates visual features with world-space motion. Joint prediction heads refine human poses and estimate contacts and forces, while physics-based supervision encourages consistency between the reconstructed motion and interaction forces. To address the scarcity of force annotations, we develop a data annotation pipeline that combines contact labeling with physics-based motion and force optimization, producing training supervision from synthetic and real-world videos. We also introduce a real-world climbing benchmark ForceWall with climbing videos and corresponding ground-truth contact forces obtained from the force sensors. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art contact and force estimation, outperforming staged reconstruction approaches and generalizing to interactions beyond the training distribution. These results support end-to-end joint learning as an effective approach to recovering human motion and physical interactions from video.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PACT 用单目视频端到端联合估计人体姿态、接触与接触力：在人体重建基础模型上加可学习的 contact-force token 与融合视觉特征和世界系运动的 temporal transformer，再用物理监督约束重建运动与交互力的一致性。在自建的真实攀岩基准 ForceWall（力传感器提供接触力真值）上达到 SOTA 的接触与力估计，优于分阶段重建方法，并能泛化到训练分布之外的交互。
Motivation: 现有方法把视觉姿态重建与接触、力估计拆成两阶段，阶段间误差会传播，且联合推理受限；同时真实接触力标注稀缺。
Method: 在人体重建基础模型上引入可学习的 contact-force token 和一个融合视觉特征与世界系 (world-space) 运动的 temporal transformer；联合预测头同时细化人体姿态并估计接触与力，物理监督 (physics-based supervision) 约束重建运动与交互力一致。针对力标注稀缺，构建结合接触标注与基于物理的运动、力优化的数据标注管线，从合成与真实视频生成训练监督。
Result: 实验展示 SOTA 的接触与力估计，优于分阶段重建方法，并泛化到训练分布之外的交互；评测使用新提出的 ForceWall 真实攀岩基准，其接触力真值来自力传感器。
Conclusion: 端到端联合学习是从视频恢复人体运动与物理交互的有效路径，优于把重建与力估计分开的分阶段方案。

papers.title: The Life Cycle of a Massive Activation: Stochastic Birth, Weight-Decay-Driven Growth, and Competitive Consolidation
papers.abstract_en: Massive activations, residual-stream coordinates with magnitudes far larger than typical activations, are associated with attention sinks in transformers, but how their scale is regulated during training remains incompletely understood. Combining training-trajectory analyses and controlled interventions, we trace their emergence, growth, and consolidation. Sink-carrying channels vary across random seeds but stabilize early within each run. Over longer training, surrounding channels erode and the sink concentrates onto a few redundant carriers. Across ablations, gradient attenuation follows the sink token's collective root-mean-square magnitude rather than any single channel, making collective scale central to understanding their effects. Our central result is that weight decay causally controls the turnover of global activation scale. In controlled continuations, removing decay near the peak allows this scale to keep rising, whereas retaining it produces decline even at constant learning rate. We develop a balance model for the rise and peak of massive-activation magnitude, in which AdamW-preconditioned growth opposes weight decay. Sweeping the decay coefficient $λ$ shifts peak timing approximately log-linearly and yields peak magnitudes scaling approximately as $λ^{-1/2}$, consistent with this balance. Optimizer measurements further show that preconditioning sustains the large-channel cohort against decay even when raw maintaining forces are too small to do so. Together, these findings connect the observed life cycle to scale-regulating training dynamics and establish weight decay as a training-time lever on activation magnitude.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文追踪 Transformer 中 massive activation（残差流中量级远超典型激活的坐标）从随机诞生、weight decay 驱动增长到竞争性合并的完整生命周期，并给出因果结论：AdamW 的 weight decay 是控制全局激活量级的训练期杠杆——在峰值附近去掉 decay 使量级继续上升，保留则即使学习率不变也下降。
Motivation: Massive activation 与 attention sink 相关，但训练过程中其量级如何被调控尚不清楚；作者要区分是单通道还是集体量级在起作用，并找出真正的因果控制量。
Method: 结合训练轨迹分析与受控干预（ablation、在峰值附近移除或保留 weight decay 的受控续训），提出 AdamW 预条件增长与 weight decay 相抗衡的 balance model，并扫描 decay 系数 λ 检验峰值时刻与峰值量级的标度律。
Result: Sink 承载通道随随机种子变化但单次运行内早期稳定；梯度衰减跟随 sink token 的集体 RMS 量级而非任一单通道；移除 decay 使全局激活量级持续上升、保留则下降（学习率恒定）；λ 扫描使峰值时刻近似 log-linear 移动，峰值量级近似按 λ^{-1/2} 标度，与 balance model 一致。
Conclusion: Weight decay 是 massive activation 量级的因果性训练期控制杠杆，其量级由 AdamW 预条件增长与 decay 的平衡决定，且起作用的是集体尺度而非单个通道。

papers.title: CAS II: Orbits as Models: Kolmogorov's Structure Function under Symmetry
papers.abstract_en: In algorithmic statistics a string x is explained by a finite set containing it, and Kolmogorov's structure function records the smallest such model at each level of complexity. Strong models, those computable from the data by a total algorithm, are essentially the cells of simple partitions, so a partition of {0,1}^n can be read as a hypothesis and the cell containing x as the model it assigns. We develop algorithmic statistics over symmetric partitions, the orbit partitions of groups acting on strings. The Galois connection between subgroups and partitions gives each ambient group G a lattice of symmetric partitions with canonical certificates, joins and meets. A set is a cell of a symmetric partition exactly when its setwise stabiliser in G acts transitively on it, so the resulting structure function is Kolmogorov's restricted to these G-homogeneous sets. With a symmetric sophistication, it measures which part of the regularity of x is symmetric. Under the full symmetric group, cells recover all models and cells of cheap partitions recover exactly the strong models, so normal and strange strings are characterised by symmetry. For GL(n,2) the homogeneous sets are the linearly homogeneous ones, whose XOR dependencies look the same from every point. The GL structure function of a nonzero x lies in a band between C(x) - alpha and n - alpha, and both edges are attained: some stochastic normal strings have simple structure invisible to linear symmetry, with sophistication near 0 but GL-sophistication near C(x). We coordinatise permutation groups by a Burnside ring element (type) and a permutation (placement). In these coordinates a linear hypothesis is determined by its type up to n^2 bits, and any space of symmetry hypotheses small enough to search is small enough to miss simple structure. This sets up learned search over orbit models, the subject of later papers in the series.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Kolmogorov 结构函数限制在群作用的轨道划分 (orbit partitions) 上，得到对称版结构函数：一个集合是某个对称划分的格点当且仅当它在群 G 中的 setwise stabiliser 传递作用于它。在全对称群下格点恰好复原全部模型、廉价划分的格点恰好复原 strong models；在 GL(n,2) 下非零 x 的结构函数落在 C(x)−α 与 n−α 之间且两端皆可达，说明存在随机 normal 串其简单结构对线性对称不可见（sophistication 接近 0 而 GL-sophistication 接近 C(x)）。
Motivation: 算法统计中 strong model 本质是简单划分的格点，但一般结构函数不区分数据中哪些规律来自对称性；需要一个能按群作用分解规律、并刻画 normal/strange 串的框架。
Method: 在群作用字符串的对称划分上建立算法统计：用子群与划分间的 Galois 连接给出每个环境群 G 的对称划分格，配典范证书、join 与 meet；以 setwise stabiliser 的传递性刻画格点，并把结构函数定义为 Kolmogorov 结构函数在 G-齐次集合上的限制。再用 Burnside ring 元素 (type) 与置换 (placement) 给置换群坐标化。
Result: 全对称群下格点复原所有模型，廉价划分的格点恰为 strong models，normal 与 strange 串由此被对称性刻画；GL(n,2) 下齐次集合即线性齐次集合（XOR 依赖从任一点看相同），非零 x 的 GL 结构函数位于 C(x)−α 与 n−α 之间且两端可达，存在 sophistication 近 0 而 GL-sophistication 近 C(x) 的随机 normal 串。type 坐标下线性假设由 type 决定至多差 n^2 bits，且任何小到可搜索的对称假设空间必然小到会漏掉简单结构。
Conclusion: 对称性把结构函数变成可按群分解的测量工具，但可搜索的轨道模型空间与漏检简单结构之间存在内在张力，因此学习式搜索 (learned search) 被留作该系列后续论文的主题。

papers.title: Reliability-Aware Checkpoint Selection for Domain Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Checkpoint selection in domain generalization often relies on source-validation accuracy, yet the selected checkpoint need not provide reliable probabilities on unseen target domains. Source-target distribution shifts can alter accuracy rankings, while accuracy alone does not measure predictive probability quality. We identify an empirical selection opportunity within fixed training trajectories: reselecting among checkpoints with near-optimal source accuracy can improve mean target probability quality with small observed changes in mean target accuracy. We study accuracy-constrained reliability selection (AC), which retains checkpoints within a tolerance of the best source-validation accuracy and ranks them by source reliability. Our reference rule aggregates within-set normalized negative log-likelihood (NLL) and class-wise calibration error (CwECE) using $D_\infty$. AC uses no target data and requires neither additional training nor weight averaging. We evaluate five domain generalization training algorithms on three benchmarks, using PACS to develop the objectives and a 0.5-percentage-point tolerance. In exploratory aggregation comparisons on 360 OfficeHome and TerraIncognita runs, the reference rule reduces mean target soft-bin squared-gap ECE and CwECE by 0.240% and 0.182%, respectively, and NLL by 0.030 relative to Source-Acc. Mean target accuracy changes by +0.213 percentage points. These results identify opportunities for reliability-aware reselection, while the additional benefit of joint over single-objective ranking remains unresolved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 域泛化 (domain generalization) 中按源域验证准确率选 checkpoint 会牺牲未见目标域上的概率可靠性。AC 规则先保留源域准确率距最优 0.5 个百分点以内的 checkpoint，再用 D∞ 聚合组内归一化的 NLL 与 CwECE 排序，不使用任何目标域数据。在 360 次 OfficeHome 与 TerraIncognita 运行上，目标域 soft-bin ECE 与 CwECE 分别降 0.240% 和 0.182%，NLL 降 0.030，目标域准确率变化 +0.213 个百分点。
Motivation: 源域验证准确率选出的 checkpoint 在目标域上未必有可靠概率；分布偏移会改变准确率排序，而准确率本身不度量预测概率质量。
Method: 提出 accuracy-constrained reliability selection (AC)：保留源域验证准确率在最优值 0.5 个百分点容差内的 checkpoint 集合，用 D∞ 聚合组内归一化的 NLL 与类级校准误差 CwECE 排序；在 PACS 上开发目标函数，不使用目标域数据，也不需额外训练或权重平均。
Result: 在 360 次 OfficeHome 与 TerraIncognita 运行的探索性聚合对比中，参考规则相对 Source-Acc 使目标域 soft-bin 平方间隙 ECE 降 0.240%、CwECE 降 0.182%、NLL 降 0.030，目标域平均准确率变化 +0.213 个百分点；评估覆盖 5 个域泛化训练算法与 3 个基准。
Conclusion: 固定训练轨迹内按可靠性重选 checkpoint 能在几乎不损失目标域准确率的前提下改善目标域概率质量；联合目标相对单一目标排序的额外收益仍未解决。

papers.title: Safety of Latent Communication in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Latent communication enables multi-agent systems to exchange information directly in internal representation space, reducing the token, computation, and latency overhead of text-based communication. To this end, lightweight trainable links are introduced to map the sender's representations into the receiver's input space. In this work, we show that even benign link training can increase harmful compliance relative to text-based communication while the underlying safety-aligned agents remain unchanged. An attacker can amplify this effect by optimizing the links on harmful query--response pairs or poisoning otherwise benign training data. We further develop a reinforcement-learning attack that rewards harmful compliance alongside benign task performance without requiring harmful target responses. Across three communication topologies and four safety benchmarks, this attack raises the mean harmful-compliance score from 27.9 with benignly trained links to 76.9. Compared with direct supervised optimization, it also achieves higher average accuracy on two benign utility benchmarks. Adapting the rewards toward safer behavior also enables repair of compromised links, substantially reducing harmful compliance across all evaluated attacks without updating the agents. Overall, our results show that safety alignment requires considering the multi-agent system as a whole. Code: https://github.com/Muhammad-Huzaifaa/latent-safety
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多智能体系统的潜空间通信链路即使只做良性训练，也会让有害遵从 (harmful compliance) 高于纯文本通信，而底层安全对齐的 agent 完全不变。用有害 query-response 对优化链路或投毒良性数据会进一步放大该效应；提出的 RL 攻击在三种通信拓扑、四个安全基准上把平均有害遵从分数从 27.9 抬到 76.9，且在两个良性效用基准上平均准确率高于直接监督优化。把奖励改成朝安全行为调整，可在不更新 agent 的前提下修复被攻陷链路，显著降低所有已评估攻击下的有害遵从。
Motivation: 潜空间通信省掉文本通信的 token、算力与延迟开销，但安全分析只盯着单个对齐 agent，忽略了可训练链路本身成为攻击面：良性链路训练就足以绕过既有安全对齐。
Method: 在发送方表征到接收方输入空间之间插入轻量可训练链路 (trainable links)；攻击手段包括在有害 query-response 对上优化链路、投毒良性训练数据，以及一种无需有害目标回复、同时奖励有害遵从与良性任务表现的强化学习攻击；防御侧把奖励朝安全行为调整以修复链路。
Result: 在三种通信拓扑与四个安全基准上，RL 攻击把平均有害遵从分数从良性训练链路的 27.9 提到 76.9；相比直接监督优化，在两个良性效用基准上取得更高平均准确率；安全化奖励修复链路后，在所有已评估攻击下大幅降低有害遵从，全程不更新 agent。
Conclusion: 安全对齐必须把多智能体系统当作整体来考虑：底层 agent 不变，链路训练与奖励设计就足以决定系统级有害遵从的升降，链路也可在不改 agent 的情况下被修复。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Can Domain Generalization be Guaranteed in Small-Sample Learning?
papers.abstract_en: The small-sample learning problem remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning because limited training data lead to unstable model estimation and generalization. Structural Risk Minimization (SRM) has long been regarded as a principled solution under the classical i.i.d. assumption. However, domain generalization (DG) violates this assumption, leaving the theoretical role of SRM in DG largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we establish the first theoretical guarantees for SRM in DG under mild assumptions. Specifically, based on the concept of stability, we derive learning consistency and generalization error bounds and prove that these bounds become tight when the hypotheses satisfy the stability condition. Building upon this, under a specific hypothesis space assumption, we establish stability, learning, and generalization bounds for SRM. We further discuss the applicability of these bounds to deep learning. This work establishes theoretical foundations for SRM under distribution shifts and sheds light on the design of robust DG algorithms in small-sample scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在域泛化 (domain generalization) 违反 i.i.d. 假设的小样本学习中，本文基于稳定性 (stability) 概念为结构风险最小化 (SRM) 建立首批理论保证：推出学习一致性与泛化误差界，并证明假设满足稳定性条件时这些界变紧；再在特定假设空间下给出 SRM 的稳定性、学习与泛化界，并讨论其对深度学习的适用性。
Motivation: 小样本下训练数据有限导致模型估计与泛化不稳定；SRM 的经典论证依赖 i.i.d.，而域泛化场景分布偏移破坏该假设，SRM 在 DG 中的理论作用长期未被厘清。
Method: 以稳定性概念为工具推导学习一致性与泛化误差界，并证明在假设满足稳定性条件时界变紧；随后在特定假设空间假设下建立 SRM 的稳定性、学习与泛化界，并讨论这些界对深度学习的适用性，全部在温和假设下完成。
Result: 在温和假设下给出 SRM 于 DG 的首批理论保证：推得学习一致性与泛化误差界，证明假设满足稳定性条件时界变紧，并在特定假设空间下建立 SRM 的稳定性、学习与泛化界。
Conclusion: SRM 在分布偏移下仍可给出可保证的泛化理论基础，为小样本场景下设计鲁棒 DG 算法提供依据；适用性延伸到深度学习。

papers.title: T-ARC: Topology-Aware Randomized Clustering via Distributionally Robust Stochastic Block Models
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we introduce a new clustering method, namely T-ARC (Topology-Aware Randomized Clustering), that corrects the geometric bias of K-means by embedding topological information directly into the optimization objective. Building on the assumption that the data admits an underlying hidden structure modeled via a latent graph, the idea is to uncover this information through the interplay between the standard K-means data-fidelity term and a graph-cut penalty, which discourages cluster assignments inconsistent with the connectivity structure of the data. To render this coupling tractable, the latent graph is modeled as a random realization from a Stochastic Block Model (SBM), whose scalar parameter is optimized within a Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) framework, yielding a closed-form proximal update. Both SBM and DRO are informed by a persistence-based similarity matrix derived from zero-dimensional persistent homology ($H_0$), which translates the multiscale connectivity structure of the data into a pairwise topological prior. The overall optimization proceeds via Block Coordinate Descent; convergence is established through a global Lyapunov functional: the deterministic blocks satisfy monotonic descent, while the stochastic graph update satisfies descent in expectation, so that the expected energy converges. Experiments on synthetic datasets with non-convex geometries and on random subsets of Fashion-MNIST show that T-ARC recovers latent topological structures where K-means fails, achieving the highest accuracy on curved and interleaved clusters while remaining competitive, and markedly more stable than K-means, on real data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: T-ARC 把拓扑信息直接写进 K-means 目标函数：用零维持久同调 (H0) 构造持久性相似度矩阵，驱动随机块模型 (SBM) 的图割惩罚，其标量参数在分布鲁棒优化 (DRO) 中闭式 proximal 更新。在非凸几何合成数据与 Fashion-MNIST 随机子集上，它在弯曲与交错簇上取得最高精度，真实数据上与 K-means 相当但稳定性明显更好。
Motivation: K-means 假设球形簇，对弯曲、交错等非凸几何有几何偏置，无法恢复数据的潜在拓扑结构。
Method: 目标函数为 K-means 数据保真项加图割惩罚；潜在图建模为 SBM 的随机实现，标量参数在 DRO 框架内优化并给出闭式 proximal 更新；SBM 与 DRO 均由 H0 持久同调导出的持久性相似度矩阵提供拓扑先验。整体用 Block Coordinate Descent 求解，收敛性由全局 Lyapunov 泛函保证：确定性块单调下降，随机图更新期望下降，故期望能量收敛。
Result: 在非凸几何合成数据集与 Fashion-MNIST 随机子集上，T-ARC 在弯曲和交错簇上取得最高 accuracy，恢复出 K-means 失败的潜在拓扑结构；在真实数据上保持竞争力，且稳定性显著高于 K-means。
Conclusion: 把持久同调的多尺度连通性作为先验嵌入 K-means 目标，可在非凸簇上恢复 K-means 丢掉的拓扑结构，同时以期望收敛的随机块坐标下降保持真实数据上的稳定性。

summary_sections.result: 在非凸几何合成数据集与 Fashion-MNIST 随机子集上，T-ARC 在弯曲和交错簇上取得最高 accuracy，恢复出 K-means 失败的潜在拓扑结构；在真实数据上保持竞争力，且稳定性显著高于 K-means。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把持久同调的多尺度连通性作为先验嵌入 K-means 目标，可在非凸簇上恢复 K-means 丢掉的拓扑结构，同时以期望收敛的随机块坐标下降保持真实数据上的稳定性。

papers.title: UniAE-MoE: A Unified Audio Encoder via Mixture of Experts
papers.abstract_en: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) rely on effective audio encoders for multi-task performance. We introduce UniAE-MoE, a unified audio encoder designed to model cross-domain audio representations and achieve outstanding downstream understanding performance via a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture. Specifically, we explore mainstream audio encoders and integrate those from Qwen2-Audio and Audio-Flamingo 3, which demonstrate superior downstream capabilities. To facilitate effective model fusion, we improve our encoder using SwiGLU with shared experts to decouple encoder networks, and we further introduce a two-stage instruction-tuning strategy to better adapt the model to diverse downstream tasks. Moreover, we propose the task-specific data scaling (TSDS) technique to enhance UniAE-MoE's understanding capabilities. On the XARES-LLM benchmark, UniAE-MoE attains a score of 0.802, achieving state-of-the-art performance. It also delivers top-tier performance in the official Interspeech 2026 Audio Encoder Capability Challenge, further demonstrating robust generalization across diverse audio tasks. Together, these results validate the effectiveness of UniAE-MoE for unified audio understanding across speech, music, and general audio domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniAE-MoE 用 Mixture-of-Experts 架构把 Qwen2-Audio 与 Audio-Flamingo 3 的音频编码器统一成一个跨域编码器，在 XARES-LLM benchmark 上得 0.802 达到 SOTA，并在 Interspeech 2026 Audio Encoder Capability Challenge 官方评测中取得顶级表现。
Motivation: LALM 依赖音频编码器做多任务理解，但现有主流编码器各自为政，缺少一个能同时覆盖语音、音乐与通用音频的统一表示。
Method: 整合 Qwen2-Audio 与 Audio-Flamingo 3 编码器，用带 shared experts 的 SwiGLU 解耦编码器网络，配合两阶段 instruction-tuning 适配多下游任务，并提出 task-specific data scaling (TSDS) 增强理解能力。
Result: 在 XARES-LLM benchmark 上得 0.802，达到 state-of-the-art；在 Interspeech 2026 Audio Encoder Capability Challenge 官方评测中取得顶级表现。

papers.title: Characterizing High Bandwidth Flash for LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) serving requires substantial memory to store model weights and KV caches. As models grow larger and contexts become longer, memory capacity and bandwidth increasingly become bottlenecks for serving performance. Agentic workloads compound this pressure through repeated interactions over growing contexts, making it increasingly important to retain KV state for reuse. High-bandwidth flash (HBF) offers a way to expand accelerator memory capacity for large language model (LLM) serving, but its access costs and limited write endurance complicate its use. We evaluate HBF for high-throughput agentic serving across system design and scheduling choices to understand when additional capacity improves serving performance and energy efficiency. We introduce an HBM-HBF-host hierarchical storage system and buffered cache-aware scheduling, and use trace-driven simulations to analyze their effects on performance, energy consumption, and HBF write lifetime. Across the evaluated workloads, the fastest HBF-augmented systems reduce completion time by 36.1-87.7% relative to HBM-only systems. Modeled energy savings reach 59.1%, with benefits depending on the workload and weight placement. Buffered cache-aware scheduling extends estimated HBF write lifetime from 1.21 to 14.82 years in the evaluated configuration. These results demonstrate the importance of coordinating data placement and scheduling to improve serving efficiency while sustaining a practical HBF write lifetime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 服务中 HBM 容量与带宽瓶颈，提出 HBM-HBF-host 三级存储与 buffered cache-aware 调度，用 trace-driven 仿真评估高吞吐 agentic serving。最快 HBF 扩展系统相对纯 HBM 把完成时间降低 36.1–87.7%，建模能耗最多省 59.1%，调度把 HBF 写寿命从 1.21 年延长到 14.82 年。
Motivation: 模型变大、上下文变长使显存容量与带宽成为 LLM serving 的瓶颈，agentic 负载反复复用不断增长的 KV 状态更需要保留；HBF 能扩容量但访问开销与写耐久限制其使用。
Method: 提出 HBM-HBF-host 分层存储系统与 buffered cache-aware 调度，跨系统设计与调度选择做 trace-driven 仿真，分析性能、能耗与 HBF 写寿命。
Result: 最快 HBF 扩展系统相对纯 HBM 系统完成时间降低 36.1–87.7%；建模能耗节省达 59.1%，收益随负载与权重放置而变；buffered cache-aware 调度把评估配置下的 HBF 估计写寿命从 1.21 年延长到 14.82 年。
Conclusion: 数据放置与调度必须协同设计，才能在维持可用 HBF 写寿命的同时提升 serving 效率与能效。

papers.title: DeCoPrune: Efficient KV-Cache Pruning for Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Denoising Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive video diffusion supports streaming generation and interactive control, but its KV cache grows continuously with the generated history. Existing compression strategies either discard history using fixed windows or select tokens through local attention and similarity signals, which do not directly measure whether the current chunk contributes information beyond the retained context. We introduce DeCoPrune, a training-free method that treats cache compression as a denoising-consistency problem. We find empirically that denoising difficulty provides a useful proxy for a token's value in long-term retention: tokens with larger step-to-final discrepancies tend to carry visual evidence that is less predictable from the retained context. DeCoPrune measures each current-chunk token's denoising difficulty using the discrepancy between its intermediate clean prediction and final denoised value, retaining high-discrepancy tokens in the long-term cache while pruning those with low discrepancy. To evaluate information retention, we introduce CMBench, comprising 58 approximately one-minute generated or real-world context episodes and 116 Reappear or Revisit continuation tasks that require recalling specific previously observed objects or scenes. Experiments with LingBot World v2 show that DeCoPrune preserves near-FullKV long-range recall while pruning over 85% of historical KV tokens and accelerating continuation generation by over $4\times$, substantially outperforming the evaluated compression baselines at comparable budgets. These results indicate that denoising consistency can serve as a model-intrinsic signal for retaining long-range information while reducing autoregressive inference cost. Our project homepage is https://decoprune.github.io. The code is available at https://github.com/DeCoPrune/CMBench, and the benchmark at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aoraku/CMBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeCoPrune 把自回归视频扩散的 KV cache 压缩建模为去噪一致性问题：用当前 chunk 各 token 的中间干净预测与最终去噪值的偏差衡量去噪难度，保留高偏差、剪掉低偏差 token。在 LingBot World v2 上剪掉超过 85% 历史 KV token、续生成加速 4 倍以上，长程召回仍接近 FullKV，明显优于同等预算的压缩基线。
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散的 KV cache 随生成历史无限增长，而固定窗口丢弃历史或基于局部注意力与相似度选 token 的方法，都不直接衡量当前 chunk 是否带来保留上下文之外的新信息。
Method: 训练无关 (training-free) 的 DeCoPrune：以去噪难度作为 token 长期保留价值的代理，计算当前 chunk 每个 token 中间干净预测与最终去噪值的偏差，高偏差进长期 cache、低偏差剪除。评测引入 CMBench，含 58 个约一分钟的生成或真实世界上下文片段与 116 个 Reappear 或 Revisit 续写任务，要求回忆先前出现过的物体或场景。
Result: 在 LingBot World v2 上剪除超过 85% 的历史 KV token，续生成加速 4 倍以上，长程召回保持接近 FullKV，在相近预算下大幅优于所评测的压缩基线。CMBench 规模为 58 个约一分钟上下文片段与 116 个续写任务。
Conclusion: 去噪一致性可以作为模型内生的长程信息保留信号，在降低自回归推理成本的同时维持长程召回。

papers.title: Steepest Guidance: A Practical and Principled Approach to Inference-Time Alignment of Flow and Diffusion-based Models
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time alignment of flow and diffusion-based models is critical for achieving flexible generative modeling. Theoretically, Doob's $h$-transform provides an elegant solution to this problem, and most existing methods are based on this principle. However, in practice, estimating the optimal guidance derived from Doob's $h$-transform at inference time is challenging. To deal with this issue, we regard inference-time alignment as a sequential optimization problem in the space of probability measures and propose a novel framework called *Steepest Guidance*, based on the principle of maximizing local improvement in the objective. We provide a theoretical analysis of the proposed method and demonstrate its effectiveness through extensive experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 flow/diffusion 模型的推理时对齐重写为概率测度空间上的序贯优化，提出 Steepest Guidance：按目标局部改进最大化的原则逐步构造 guidance，绕开 Doob's h-transform 最优 guidance 在推理时难以估计的问题。摘要称其有理论分析并在大量实验中验证有效性。
Motivation: Doob's h-transform 给出推理时对齐的理论解，但其最优 guidance 在推理时难以估计，导致现有方法在实践中受限。
Method: 将推理时对齐形式化为概率测度空间上的序贯优化问题，基于最大化目标局部改进的原则提出 Steepest Guidance 框架，并给出相应理论分析。
Result: 提供该方法的理论分析，并通过大量实验 (extensive experiments) 展示其有效性；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 以局部改进最大化替代直接估计 Doob's h-transform 的最优 guidance，是 flow/diffusion 推理时对齐一条既实用又有理论依据的路径。

papers.title: Distilling Diffusion Score Discrepancy for Efficient Training Data Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Training data attribution for diffusion models aims to identify the training samples that influence a generated instance, but existing methods either require costly per-sample gradient computation or query-specific model optimization. Moreover, most methods attribute changes in a proxy loss rather than changes in the actual model's generative behavior. We address these limitations by formulating attribution directly with a local score discrepancy measure, which applies to any diffusion variant (including DDPM, EDM, and flow matching), and by showing that such measure can be estimated without retraining, as a preconditioned gradient similarity. We instantiate this estimator as Training-data Influence via score Discrepancy (TID), which uses Kronecker-factored curvature to avoid random projections and per-sample gradient storage. We then distill TID into TIDE, a forward-only student trained online to reproduce the teacher's rankings from the diffusion model's internal activations. Under counterfactual evaluation on CIFAR-10, ArtBench-10, and MS-COCO, TID matches or outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, while TIDE retains most of TID's accuracy at four to five orders of magnitude lower per-query cost, attributing generated samples in milliseconds and faster than the generation itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出扩散模型训练数据归因方法 TID：把归因直接定义为局部 score discrepancy，并证明其可在不重训的前提下估计为带条件的梯度相似度 (preconditioned gradient similarity)，用 Kronecker-factored curvature 免去随机投影与逐样本梯度存储。再把 TID 蒸馏成前向-only 学生 TIDE，由模型内部激活在线复现教师排名。在 CIFAR-10、ArtBench-10、MS-COCO 的反事实评测中，TID 匹配或超过 SOTA，TIDE 保留其大部分精度，同时单次查询成本降低四到五个数量级，毫秒级完成归因、快于生成本身。
Motivation: 现有扩散训练数据归因要么需要昂贵的逐样本梯度计算，要么需要针对查询做模型优化；且多数方法归因的是代理损失的变化，而非模型真实生成行为的变化。
Method: 以局部 score discrepancy 直接构造归因目标，适用于 DDPM、EDM、flow matching 等任意扩散变体；将其估计为 preconditioned gradient similarity，实例化为 TID，用 Kronecker-factored curvature 避免随机投影与逐样本梯度存储；再在线蒸馏出前向-only 学生 TIDE，从扩散模型内部激活复现 TID 的排名。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10、ArtBench-10、MS-COCO 上的反事实评测中，TID 匹配或优于 SOTA 归因方法；TIDE 保留 TID 的大部分归因精度，单次查询成本低四到五个数量级，归因耗时毫秒级、快于生成过程本身。
Conclusion: 直接对生成行为（而非代理损失）做 score discrepancy 归因，可同时做到通用于扩散变体、免重训估计，并能被前向-only 学生以极低查询成本复现。

papers.title: Adam under Generalized Smoothness with Second-Moment-Type Stochastic Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Adam is widely observed to remain stable even when the objective deviates significantly from global smoothness. Under the generalized smoothness framework, however, existing analyses rely on strong tail assumptions on the stochastic gradients, such as almost-sure boundedness or sub-Gaussianity. Whether Adam converges on generalized smooth objectives under only second moment information on the stochastic gradients, without such concentration assumptions, was identified as an important open direction by Li et al. (2023). This paper gives an affirmative answer under fairly general conditions: such tail assumptions are not necessary. Building on the Adam self-normalization framework of Jin et al. (2026), developed for classical smoothness and bounded variance, we extend the stopping-time and de-preconditioning strategy to the $L_0$-$L_p$ generalized smoothness condition and a generalized second moment ABC condition. Even when the stochastic-gradient condition provides only second moment information that may grow along the trajectory, the stochastic trajectory of Adam remains in a locally well-behaved smoothness region, with stretched-exponential tail decay under bounded variance and global smoothness. Consequently, we establish high-probability convergence rate guarantees over the full range $p<2$, with confidence dependence of order $δ^{-1/2}$, while the stepsize prefactor depends on $δ$ only through a single logarithmic factor. We further construct a hard instance showing that, under only second-moment information, this $δ^{-1/2}$-type confidence dependence is sharp. Finally, in the regime $p<1$, we combine the trajectory control with polynomial-growth estimates on rare events to obtain convergence rate guarantees in expectation.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: AESOP: Asymmetric Human-Camera Generation with Translation-Intensity Control
papers.abstract_en: Human motion defines an action, while a camera trajectory determines how it is presented. Camera generation for a given human motion and joint human-camera generation are usually treated as separate tasks, although both share an asymmetric dependency: human motion can be generated independently, whereas the camera responds to the realized action. We introduce AESOP, a unified framework with an independent human pathway and a shared human-conditioned camera generator. Its asymmetric architecture serves both tasks while preserving the human output during camera generation. Although human context anchors the shot to the action and camera text describes its movement, translation intensity remains underspecified. We therefore construct trajectory pairs that differ in camera translation magnitude while sharing human motion and camera text, then use these pairs to learn an explicit intensity condition. Experiments on the PulpMotion dataset demonstrate strong camera distributional and framing quality in both tasks and effective control over camera translation intensity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AESOP 把相机生成与人-相机联合生成统一成非对称架构：人体通路独立生成，相机生成器以已实现的人体动作为条件，从而在生成相机时保住人体输出。针对同一人体动作与相机文本下平移幅度仍欠定的问题，构造仅平移幅度不同的人体-相机轨迹对，从中学习显式的强度条件，在 PulpMotion 数据集上同时展示相机分布与构图质量以及对平移强度的有效控制。
Motivation: 给定人体动作的相机生成与人-相机联合生成通常被当作两个任务，但两者共享非对称依赖：人体动作可独立生成，相机必须响应已发生的动作；且相机文本无法确定平移幅度。
Method: 统一框架 AESOP：独立的人体通路 + 共享的以人体为条件的相机生成器，相机生成时保留人体输出；构造共享人体动作与相机文本、仅平移幅度不同的轨迹对，用这些对学习一个显式强度条件来控制相机平移。
Result: 在 PulpMotion 数据集上的实验展示了两项任务中较强的相机分布质量与构图质量，以及对相机平移强度的有效控制（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 非对称的人体-相机分工加显式平移强度条件，可在一个框架内同时处理相机生成与联合生成并保留可控的平移幅度。

papers.title: EGSD: Event-Grounded Self-Distillation for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Real-time video understanding requires incrementally maintaining a memory of streaming content, and optimizing this requires dense process signals. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which lets one model serve as both teacher and student with the teacher receiving additional privileged information such as the question and ground-truth (GT) answer, can supply such token-level signals. However, applying it directly to streaming video raises two problems. (1) The student cannot be optimized end-to-end, where memory is written before the question arrives, yet the teacher scores it with the question-and-GT privilege, misaligning their preferences. (2) Effective-entity memory collapses, where the question-and-GT privilege makes the teacher favor only question-relevant entities, and token-mean averaging over a memory renders its signal invariant to how many entities that memory covers, both driving memory against the streaming need for diversity. To address these issues, we propose Event-Grounded Self-Distillation (EGSD), which characterizes streaming memory as an incremental update over verifiable Events (key visual entities, actions, and details) and targets the two problems on this basis. For problem (1), we adapt the OPSD signal into a multiplicative weight combined with the outcome reward; for problem (2), we re-weight the teacher with Events as privileged information to counter its question-relevance bias, and add an entity-coverage reward to supply the coverage preference the token-mean teacher lacks. Extensive experiments on mainstream online and offline benchmarks show EGSD achieves strong performance, reaching 79.8% on StreamingBench and 73.4% on the OVO-Bench Real-Time track, while memory analysis shows effective-entity recall rises 17.4% at only 6.8% more memory length.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EGSD 把流式视频记忆改写成对可验证事件（实体、动作、细节）的增量更新，用事件作为特权信息重加权 On-Policy Self-Distillation 教师，并补上实体覆盖奖励，纠正教师只偏爱问题相关实体的偏差。在 StreamingBench 上达到 79.8%、OVO-Bench Real-Time 轨道 73.4%，有效实体召回提升 17.4% 而记忆长度只增加 6.8%。
Motivation: 流式视频理解需要在问题到来前就写入记忆，而 OPSD 教师带着问题与 GT 特权打分，导致学生无法端到端优化；同时 token-mean 平均让记忆信号对覆盖实体数不敏感，记忆塌缩到少数问题相关实体。
Method: EGSD 将流式记忆刻画为对可验证 Events 的增量更新：把 OPSD 信号改造成与 outcome reward 相乘的权重以对齐写入与打分时机；用 Events 作为特权信息重加权教师以抵消 question-relevance 偏差，并加入 entity-coverage reward 补足 token-mean 教师缺失的覆盖偏好。
Result: 在主流在线与离线基准上，StreamingBench 达 79.8%，OVO-Bench Real-Time 轨道达 73.4%；记忆分析显示有效实体召回提升 17.4%，记忆长度仅增加 6.8%。
Conclusion: 以事件为锚的自蒸馏能同时保住流式记忆的多样性与端到端可优化性，用很小的记忆开销换回显著的实体召回提升。

papers.title: PhoneCLI: From App Interfaces to Callable Commands for Mobile Agents
papers.abstract_en: Mobile GUI agents operate through a perception--action loop: at each step they screenshot the device, invoke a vision--language model (VLM), and emit an action. It is slow, costly, and brittle, yet most of what it does is navigation---and everyday navigation is static, ordered, and endlessly repeated. We present PhoneCLI, which compiles an app's GUI navigation into callable commands, without any app-internal API, runtime instrumentation, or model training. Offline, PhoneCLI explores a target app from the outside and distills its screens, interactive elements, and navigation edges into a semantically annotated map; each screen yields one deterministic command: a replay sequence that reaches it. Online, the agent selects a command, verifies it before execution, and then executes it deterministically in sub-second time at zero VLM cost; open-ended interaction and every failure of the compiled path fall back to the embedded VLM interpreter, exactly the pure VLM agent, so compilation can only help. On AndroidLab, PhoneCLI improves the task success rate while reducing steps and token consumption, and it transfers to AndroidWorld's official M3A agent with consistent efficiency gains. What PhoneCLI compiles is the app's navigation rather than one run, so it serves new tasks, not only repeated ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhoneCLI 把移动 App 的 GUI 导航离线编译成可复用命令：从外部探索目标 App，把屏幕、可交互元素与导航边蒸馏成语义标注地图，每个屏幕产出一条确定性回放命令。在线时智能体先选命令、执行前校验、再以亚秒级零 VLM 成本确定性执行，失败则回退到内嵌 VLM 解释器，因此编译只会带来增益。在 AndroidLab 上任务成功率提升的同时步数与 token 消耗下降，并可迁移到 AndroidWorld 的官方 M3A 智能体取得一致的效率收益。
Motivation: 移动 GUI 智能体每步都要截图、调用 VLM 再输出动作，慢、贵且脆弱，而其中大部分工作只是静态、有序、反复出现的导航。
Method: 离线阶段从外部探索目标 App（不依赖 App 内部 API、运行时插桩或模型训练），把屏幕、可交互元素与导航边蒸馏成语义标注地图，每个屏幕编译出一条到达它的确定性回放命令；在线阶段智能体选择命令、执行前校验、再确定性执行，开放式交互与编译路径的任何失败都回退到内嵌 VLM 解释器。
Result: 在 AndroidLab 上，PhoneCLI 提升任务成功率，同时减少步数与 token 消耗；迁移到 AndroidWorld 的官方 M3A 智能体后取得一致的效率增益。命令执行为亚秒级、VLM 成本为零。
Conclusion: 编译的对象是 App 的导航结构而非单次运行，因此命令可服务新任务而不只是重复任务；由于失败一律回退到纯 VLM 智能体，编译只能带来帮助。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LionMuon: Alternating Spectral and Sign Descent for Efficient Training
papers.abstract_en: Pretraining a language model takes enormous compute, and the right optimizer can save a good part of it. Muon's spectral step gives a stronger direction than a sign step, but it is expensive. Every step runs Newton-Schulz iterations on the full matrix and, in distributed training, an extra all-reduce. Sign steps, as in Lion and Signum, are cheap and stay local to each device. We propose LionMuon, which takes one Muon step every $P$ iterations and Lion steps in between, with a single dual-EMA momentum buffer shared by both. Muon's compute and communication are paid once per $P$ steps, and the optimizer state is half of AdamW's. A single-EMA variant, SignMuon, already improves on Muon. We prove complexity bounds under heavy-tailed noise in which the period sets an interpolation between Muon's and Lion's smoothness and noise constants, and which say when LionMuon is faster than both. On 124M and 355M models trained on FineWeb, LionMuon with $P=2$ and $P=5$ reaches a lower loss than Muon, AdamW, Lion and Signum at the same number of tokens. Under 4-GPU data-parallel training it reaches Muon's final loss with a third less wall-clock on PCIe, and it beats the communication-efficient Muon variants Dion and MuonBP on loss at no more exposed communication, while keeping the exact gradient. Code: https://github.com/brain-lab-research/lion-muon
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LionMuon 把昂贵的 Muon 谱步与廉价的 Lion 符号步交替使用，每 P 次迭代只跑一次 Newton-Schulz 与 all-reduce，中间用共享的 dual-EMA 动量缓冲走 Lion 步。在 FineWeb 上训练 124M 与 355M 模型时，P=2 与 P=5 在相同 token 数下损失低于 Muon、AdamW、Lion 和 Signum；4 卡数据并行在 PCIe 上以少三分之一墙钟时间达到 Muon 的最终损失。
Motivation: 语言模型预训练开销巨大，Muon 的谱步每步都要在全矩阵上跑 Newton-Schulz 迭代并在分布式训练中额外做一次 all-reduce，代价高；纯符号步虽便宜但方向较弱。
Method: 每 P 次迭代执行一次 Muon 谱步，其余迭代用 Lion 符号步，两者共享单一 dual-EMA 动量缓冲（单 EMA 变体为 SignMuon）；在重尾噪声下证明复杂度界，周期 P 决定 Muon 与 Lion 的平滑度与噪声常数之间的插值，并给出 LionMuon 快于两者各自的条件。
Result: 在 FineWeb 上训练 124M 与 355M 模型，LionMuon 的 P=2 与 P=5 在相同 token 数下损失低于 Muon、AdamW、Lion、Signum；4-GPU 数据并行在 PCIe 上用少三分之一墙钟时间达到 Muon 最终损失；在损失上胜过通信高效变体 Dion 与 MuonBP，且暴露通信量不更多、梯度保持精确；优化器状态为 AdamW 的一半。
Conclusion: 以周期性谱步替代每步谱步，可在保持精确梯度的同时同时降低计算、通信与优化器状态开销，并在给定重尾噪声条件下比 Muon 和 Lion 都快。

summary_sections.method: 每 P 次迭代执行一次 Muon 谱步，其余迭代用 Lion 符号步，两者共享单一 dual-EMA 动量缓冲（单 EMA 变体为 SignMuon）；在重尾噪声下证明复杂度界，周期 P 决定 Muon 与 Lion 的平滑度与噪声常数之间的插值，并给出 LionMuon 快于两者各自的条件。
summary_sections.result: 在 FineWeb 上训练 124M 与 355M 模型，LionMuon 的 P=2 与 P=5 在相同 token 数下损失低于 Muon、AdamW、Lion、Signum；4-GPU 数据并行在 PCIe 上用少三分之一墙钟时间达到 Muon 最终损失；在损失上胜过通信高效变体 Dion 与 MuonBP，且暴露通信量不更多、梯度保持精确；优化器状态为 AdamW 的一半。
summary_sections.conclusion: 以周期性谱步替代每步谱步，可在保持精确梯度的同时同时降低计算、通信与优化器状态开销，并在给定重尾噪声条件下比 Muon 和 Lion 都快。

papers.title: Predicting Delayed Train Trajectories on the Dutch Railway Network: Explainable AI Evaluation of Topological, Operational and Weather Features with Tree Based Ensemble Methods
papers.abstract_en: The reliable prediction of passenger train delays is a critical component of railway management. While contemporary research frequently attempts to maximize absolute accuracy by deploying opaque deep learning architectures, the underlying data mechanics driving longitudinal predictive decay remain underexplored. Consequently, this study provides an explainable temporal robustness analysis of network-wide railway delay prediction. Focusing on the Dutch railway network, this research utilizes interpretable tree-based ensembles to integrate granular topological, environmental, and operational features. The overarching finding establishes that while feature-rich tree-based models improve simultaneous (within-month) prediction, predictive performance systematically degrades when evaluated across non-simultaneous (future) months. Furthermore, multi-horizon SHAP and dispersion analyses explicitly link this degradation to environmental feature volatility and instability within the statistical target definition. Ultimately, this study demonstrates that richer feature sets alone are insufficient to resolve long-term forecasting constraints, underscoring the necessity to transition toward dynamic, season-aware architectures anchored by absolute operational boundaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在荷兰铁路网上用可解释树集成做全网列车延误预测，发现特征丰富的模型只改善同月（simultaneous）预测，跨到未来月份（non-simultaneous）时性能系统性衰减。多时效 SHAP 与离散度分析把衰减归因于环境特征波动和统计目标定义不稳定，结论是仅堆特征不足以解决长期约束，需转向以绝对运营边界为锚的动态、季节感知架构。
Motivation: 现有研究多用不透明深度模型追求绝对精度，却未解释纵向预测衰减的数据机制；跨月预测退化的原因不清楚。
Method: 在荷兰铁路网络上整合拓扑、环境（含天气）与运营三类细粒度特征，训练可解释的树基集成模型，并用多时效 SHAP 与离散度 (dispersion) 分析把性能变化归因到具体特征。
Result: 特征丰富的树模型改善同月内的同时预测，但在非同时（未来）月份评估时预测性能系统性退化；多时效 SHAP 与离散度分析将该退化明确关联到环境特征波动与统计目标定义的不稳定。
Conclusion: 更丰富的特征集本身不足以解决长期预测约束，延误预测需要转向以绝对运营边界为锚的动态、季节感知架构。

papers.title: Probability Contracts: Accuracy, Coherence, and Decisions Across LLM Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Equivalent probability requests can lead to different decisions even when both reports are valid. We introduce probability contracts, a benchmark that connects exact finite-world posteriors, validated event alignment, interface coherence, and failure-aware decision evaluation. Across four model-interface configurations on 1,000 worlds, Kev has lower aggregate canonical posterior error than Jev but larger complement and coarsening residuals; accuracy ordering varies by stratum. Jev's Event and Choice interfaces change the binary action on 32.8% of valid pairs at defer cost 0.10. Post-hoc analyses show that disagreement certifies only 11-52% of mean binary pair error and does not consistently outperform confidence for selection. An action-region characterization and a standard scoring-rule identity explain averaging's expected Brier guarantee relative to random interface selection, but not a decision-loss guarantee at each cost. The loss contrast takes both signs on a 99-cost grid for every configuration; small penalties where both policies beat deferral have pointwise intervals containing zero. Secondary checks specified before collection include a separate 400-root cohort, where Event/Choice effects remain configuration-dependent. A joint surface-order and answer-ID intervention shifts posttrained probabilities. Both bounded reasoning arms yield no valid probability reports, leaving their probability accuracy undefined. Probability contracts make these distinctions measurable by evaluating event semantics, posterior error, coverage, and decision cost together.
papers.comment: Research preprint; includes proofs and supplementary analyses
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 probability contracts 基准，把精确有限世界后验、事件对齐校验、接口一致性与失败感知决策评测绑在一起，量化同一概率请求在不同 LLM 接口下导致的不同决策。在 1,000 个世界上四种模型-接口配置中，Jev 的 Event 与 Choice 接口在 32.8% 的有效配对上改变二元动作（defer cost 0.10），而损失对比在 99-cost 网格上对每种配置都取正负两种符号。
Motivation: 等价的概率请求即使两份报告都有效，也可能导出不同决策；现有评测把后验精度、事件语义与决策损失分开看，无法判定接口选择是否在每个成本点上更优。
Method: 构建 probability contracts 基准：在 1,000 个有限世界上给出精确后验，校验事件对齐 (validated event alignment)，度量接口一致性 (interface coherence)，并做失败感知的决策评测；比较四种模型-接口配置（含 Kev 与 Jev），另设 400-root 独立队列与预先注册的表面顺序/答案 ID 干预，用 action-region 刻画与标准评分规则恒等式解释平均化的 Brier 保证。
Result: Kev 的聚合 canonical posterior error 低于 Jev，但 complement 与 coarsening 残差更大，精度排序随 stratum 变化；Jev 的 Event 与 Choice 接口在 32.8% 有效配对上改变二元动作（defer cost 0.10）；分歧 (disagreement) 只解释平均二元配对误差的 11–52%，在选择上不一致地优于 confidence；损失对比在 99-cost 网格上对每种配置都取两种符号，双方都优于 defer 的小惩罚处逐点区间含零；400-root 队列中 Event/Choice 效应仍依赖配置；两个 bounded reasoning 分支产生零份有效概率报告，其概率精度未定义。
Conclusion: 平均化相对随机接口选择有评分规则层面的期望 Brier 保证，但没有逐成本点的决策损失保证；接口一致性、后验误差、覆盖与决策成本必须一起评测才能区分这些效应。

papers.title: Oracle-Efficient Online Classification with Stochastic Inputs and Adversarial Outputs
papers.abstract_en: We consider binary prediction with i.i.d. contexts from an unknown distribution and adaptively chosen losses. We show that a simple Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader algorithm using a Gaussian perturbation for each observed context achieves $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T\log N})$ regret for a class of $N$ experts, while requiring one optimization-oracle call per round and no explicit enumeration of the class. For an infinite hypothesis class $\mathcal H$, the same algorithm achieves $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T\operatorname{VC}(\mathcal H)})$ regret. This resolves an open problem posed by Lazaric and Munos (2012), showing that hybrid classification is computationally as easy as statistical learning. As an application, we reduce the problem of contextual bandits with $K$ actions to classification through uniform exploration, achieving $\widetilde O(K^{2/3}T^{2/3}(\log N)^{1/3})$ regret. This matches the best known dependence on the horizon while removing the context-distribution access required by prior oracle-efficient methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线二分类中上下文服从未知 i.i.d. 分布、损失由对手自适应选择时，对每个观测上下文加高斯扰动的 Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader 每轮只调一次优化 oracle 即可达 Õ(√(T log N)) 遗憾，无需枚举专家类；对无限假设类 H 达到 Õ(√(T VC(H)))，并把上下文赌博机经均匀探索归约到分类得到 Õ(K^{2/3}T^{2/3}(log N)^{1/3}) 遗憾。
Motivation: oracle 高效的在线学习方法通常需要访问上下文分布或显式枚举假设类，Lazaric 与 Munos (2012) 留下混合分类是否能与统计学习同等计算难度的公开问题。
Method: 对每个观测上下文施加高斯扰动的 Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader，每轮仅调用一次优化 oracle、不显式枚举类；上下文赌博机部分通过均匀探索 (uniform exploration) 归约到分类。
Result: N 个专家类遗憾 Õ(√(T log N))，每轮一次 oracle 调用；无限假设类 H 遗憾 Õ(√(T VC(H)))；K 动作上下文赌博机归约后遗憾 Õ(K^{2/3}T^{2/3}(log N)^{1/3})，与已知最好 horizon 依赖匹配，且去掉先前 oracle 高效方法所需的上下文分布访问。
Conclusion: 混合分类在计算上与统计学习一样容易，解决了 Lazaric 与 Munos (2012) 的公开问题；oracle 高效在线学习不必依赖上下文分布访问。

papers.title: Dude, Where's My State? Execution Information Requirements for Stateful Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-running agents must preserve information that later steps depend on. We introduce the Execution Information Requirement (EIR), a lower bound on the information that must remain accessible for correct completion under specified task and access conditions. We develop LACUNA, a framework that generates tasks with known dependencies and varies information demand, retention, and recovery separately from the difficulty of individual operations. Across four models, restoring a missing result raises accuracy on affected recall steps to 100%, compared with 0% for equal-length irrelevant information. Sufficient storage alone does not ensure success: retention policies can discard required results, errors can propagate through later computations, and agents can stop before recovery is complete. We also introduce VESTIGE, which uses agent execution traces to construct semantic graphs and measure information demand for real tasks. Across 72,562 software-agent trajectories, VESTIGE reveals a steeper distance-related decline in solution-relevant rereading for failed runs (RR 0.951 per distance doubling), while adjusted peak demand alone is not associated with failure. Together, these contributions support evaluating whether agents preserve and recover the information their tasks require.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 12 figures, 15 tables. Supplementary material included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Execution Information Requirement (EIR)：给定任务与访问条件，正确完成后续步骤所必须保持可访问的信息量下界。用生成式框架 LACUNA 把信息需求、保留与恢复同单步难度解耦地变化，在四个模型上，补回缺失结果使受影响回忆步准确率升到 100%，而等长无关信息只有 0%；仅靠充足存储不足以成功。
Motivation: 长时程 agent 的后续步骤依赖先前结果，但信息何时必须可访问、何时被丢弃缺少可度量的下界定义，也难以把信息需求与单步操作难度分开考察。
Method: 定义 EIR 作为正确完成所需信息的下界；LACUNA 生成带已知依赖关系的任务，独立变化信息需求、保留与恢复，并与单步难度解耦；另提出 VESTIGE，用 agent 执行轨迹构建语义图来度量真实任务的信息需求。
Result: 在四个模型上，恢复缺失结果使受影响回忆步准确率达到 100%，等长无关信息为 0%。在 72,562 条软件 agent 轨迹上，VESTIGE 显示失败运行中与距离相关的 solution-relevant rereading 下降更陡（每距离翻倍 RR 0.951），而调整后的峰值需求本身与失败无关联。
Conclusion: agent 能否成功取决于保留并恢复任务所需信息，而不只是存储是否充足；评估应围绕信息的保留与恢复展开，距离相关的重读下降可作为失败信号。
