papers.title: Timestep Weighting: A Hidden Key to Effective ELBO-Based Flow-Matching RL
papers.abstract_en: ELBO-based reinforcement learning offers a sampler-agnostic approach to fine-tuning flow matching models with reward feedback. Timestep weighting in ELBO-based RL has large impact on performance, and it also provides a unified view (as we show in this work) to understand prediction losses heuristically chosen in prior work, yet it remains under-researched and is often chosen to inherit pretrain configs. We investigate impacts and dynamics of timestep weighting in ELBO-based RL. We show that effective weighting depends on both the reward landscape and stage of learning. (1) Through experiments on controlled CIFAR image generation, complemented by robotics, we investigate how weighting impacts reward-driven updates across noise levels. (2) Through gradient analysis, we reveal distinct patterns of cross-noise coordination across tasks and their evolution during training. These findings motivate the hypothesis that useful weighting depends on the gap between the policy's current behavior and the behavior favored by the reward. (3) Guided by this analysis, we study simple static weighting, budgeted profile selection, and dynamic schedules that improve performance beyond conventional target choices. Our results establish timestep weighting as an important design choice for flow-matching RL and motivate further research into methods that choose and adapt it throughout learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ELBO-based RL 微调 flow matching 模型时，timestep weighting 对性能影响巨大却常沿用预训练配置；作者在受控 CIFAR 图像生成与机器人任务上考察加权如何改变各噪声水平的奖励驱动更新，并用梯度分析揭示跨噪声协调模式。结论是有效加权取决于奖励面与学习阶段，即策略当前行为与奖励偏好的行为之间的差距，据此设计的静态加权、预算化 profile 选择与动态调度优于常规目标选择。
Motivation: ELBO-based RL 中的 timestep weighting 影响大却研究不足，通常直接继承预训练配置；先前工作里启发式挑选的 prediction loss 缺少统一解释。
Method: 三部分：在受控 CIFAR 图像生成上实验并辅以机器人任务，考察加权在不同噪声水平上如何影响奖励驱动更新；通过梯度分析揭示跨噪声协调 (cross-noise coordination) 的任务差异及其在训练中的演化；据此提出简单静态加权、budgeted profile selection 与动态调度 (dynamic schedules)。
Result: 在受控 CIFAR 图像生成与机器人实验中，timestep weighting 对 ELBO-based RL 性能有 large impact；梯度分析显示不同任务的跨噪声协调模式各异且随训练演化；由分析指导的静态加权、budgeted profile 选择与动态调度在性能上超出常规目标选择 (conventional target choices)。
Conclusion: 有效加权取决于奖励面与学习阶段，具体是策略当前行为与奖励偏好行为的差距，因此 timestep weighting 应作为 flow-matching RL 的核心设计选择并在学习过程中自适应调整。

papers.title: Traceprop: Training Data Attribution in a Single Pass
papers.abstract_en: Data attribution tools used in practice, TRAK, LoGRA/LogIX, and EK-FAC, run after training: they recompute per-sample gradients in a separate pass over the training set, and curvature-aware variants need a further pass to estimate covariance. Traceprop records projected per-sample gradients and K-FAC covariance statistics inside the training backward pass itself. On Pythia-1B LoRA fine-tunes on an A100, this adds 2.6% to training time, against 10.7% for LogIX's best inline configuration, random-init (4.1x lower, one-sided Mann-Whitney p = 9e-5, n = 10 per arm); at Pythia-6.9B the numbers are 11.3% and 27.0% (p = 0.004). LogIX's default configuration, PCA-init, is both slower and lower quality than random-init, so we compare against random-init throughout. On a small transformer where LDS is measurable, Traceprop matches LogIX's best configuration: pooled LDS difference +0.0022, 95% CI [-0.0038, +0.0075]. Two things do not work: at Pythia-160M/SST-2, every method is indistinguishable from a low noise ceiling, and on planted-backdoor and mislabel detection, gradient attribution does not beat gradient norm or representation similarity. The contribution here is systems, not a new estimator: LogIX's attribution quality, in one pass instead of two.
papers.comment: 12 pages including appendix. Code: https://github.com/AmitoVrito/Traceprop. v2: revised evaluation against an inline LogIX baseline (overhead 2.6% at Pythia-1B and 11.3% at Pythia-6.9B, A100); adds inline K-FAC preconditioning; earlier ~1% overhead and 60-242x speedup claims are superseded
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Traceprop 把投影的 per-sample 梯度与 K-FAC 协方差统计的记录嵌进训练 backward pass 本身，使数据归因 (training data attribution) 与训练同趟完成，而非训练后单独重算。在 A100 上的 Pythia-1B LoRA 微调中训练时间只增 2.6%（LogIX 最佳 inline 配置 10.7%，低 4.1 倍，p=9e-5，每臂 n=10），Pythia-6.9B 上为 11.3% 对 27.0%（p=0.004）；在可测 LDS 的小 transformer 上与 LogIX 最佳配置打平（pooled LDS 差 +0.0022，95% CI [-0.0038, +0.0075]）。
Motivation: TRAK、LoGRA/LogIX、EK-FAC 等归因工具都在训练之后运行：需对训练集单独一趟重算 per-sample 梯度，曲率感知变体还要再跑一趟估计协方差，开销高。
Method: 在训练 backward pass 内部直接记录投影 per-sample 梯度与 K-FAC 协方差统计，把原本的两趟压成一趟；对照 inline LogIX（含 random-init 与 PCA-init 两种初始化）与 inline K-FAC preconditioning，评测用 LDS、planted-backdoor 与 mislabel 检测。
Result: Pythia-1B LoRA（A100）训练时间开销 2.6% vs LogIX 最佳 inline 10.7%，random-init 低 4.1 倍（单侧 Mann-Whitney p=9e-5，每臂 n=10）；Pythia-6.9B 为 11.3% vs 27.0%（p=0.004）。LogIX 默认 PCA-init 比 random-init 更慢且质量更低。小 transformer 上 pooled LDS 差 +0.0022，95% CI [-0.0038, +0.0075]，与 LogIX 最佳配置持平。Pythia-160M/SST-2 上所有方法都与低噪声天花板无差别；planted-backdoor 与 mislabel 检测上梯度归因不优于梯度范数或表示相似度。
Conclusion: 贡献是系统而非新估计器：拿到 LogIX 的归因质量但只用一趟而非两趟。同时作者指出梯度归因在低噪声天花板任务和后门/错标检测上并不比更简单的梯度范数或表示相似度更强。

papers.title: Trust Guided Decision Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Decision Transformer performance degrades on long rollouts because the conditioning context drifts out of the training distribution. We show that this drift is visible through the model's own next state prediction error, which rises during rollout and stays elevated, giving a direct signal of when context has become unreliable. We introduce Trust Guided Decision Transformer (TGDT), which selects context before applying value guidance. At each step, TGDT evaluates several recent context suffixes using rolling next state prediction error, calibrated against held out offline data via split conformal prediction. It keeps only suffixes whose error stays within the calibrated threshold, then uses a frozen critic to choose the highest value action among the trusted suffixes. This reverses the order used by value only elastic selection, where the critic may choose an action generated from a context the model itself has flagged as unreliable. Experiments on D4RL navigation and locomotion tasks show that state prediction, critic guidance, and hard context reset each solve only part of the problem. TGDT reduces persistent high error runs and improves return over vanilla Decision Transformer, reset based context control, and value only context selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Decision Transformer 在长 rollout 中因条件上下文漂移出训练分布而性能下降，TGDT 先用滚动下一状态预测误差（经 split conformal prediction 在 held-out 离线数据上校准）筛掉不可信的上下文后缀，再用冻结 critic 在可信后缀中选价值最高的动作，把「先信任、后价值引导」的顺序反转过来。在 D4RL 导航与运动任务上，TGDT 相对 vanilla DT、reset 式上下文控制和仅价值的上下文选择降低了持续高误差片段并提升了回报。
Motivation: 长 rollout 中条件上下文漂移出训练分布导致 Decision Transformer 性能退化；仅价值引导的弹性上下文选择可能从模型自己已判定不可信的上下文生成动作。
Method: TGDT 每步用滚动下一状态预测误差评估若干近期上下文后缀，误差阈值用 split conformal prediction 在 held-out 离线数据上校准，只保留误差在阈值内的后缀，再用 frozen critic 在这些可信后缀中选价值最高的动作；与 value-only elastic selection 的顺序相反。
Result: 在 D4RL navigation 与 locomotion 任务上，状态预测、critic 引导、硬上下文重置各自只解决部分问题；TGDT 相对 vanilla Decision Transformer、reset-based context control 与 value-only context selection 减少了持续高误差片段并提升了 return（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 上下文可信度应先于价值引导做筛选：先用模型自身的状态预测误差校准过滤，再做价值最大化，才能同时压住误差累积并提高回报。

papers.title: EPOC: Endpoint-Preserving Online Correction With Compressed Residual State for Multi-Horizon Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Completed forecasts provide residual feedback, but retaining full residual blocks increases auxiliary state. We propose Endpoint-Preserving Online Correction (EPOC) with a compressed residual state. It stores low-order discrete cosine transform (DCT) coefficients and the final value of the preceding residual block. Each channel shares the endpoint across component-wise online ridge regressions using current-forecast coefficients. We evaluate eight multivariate series, DLinear and PatchTST, three seeds, and two training variants: 96 matched fixed-base conditions at a 24-step horizon. EPOC achieves mean condition-wise reductions in mean squared error (MSE) and mean absolute error (MAE) of 15.40% and 9.35% from the uncorrected base, respectively, with a median of 6,352 B in retained auxiliary arrays. EPOC also outperforms the $δ$-Adapter, COSA, FAC, and OMPB in paired MSE on most conditions while retaining less state. Full ELF achieves the largest mean MSE reduction, 19.29%, but its median retained state is 474,048 B ($\times$75 relative to EPOC). Equal-size summary controls favor the endpoint by 1.65--2.20% in paired MSE; a coefficient-reconstructed endpoint yields similar accuracy to the observed endpoint, highlighting its role as a shared input. Increasing the retained DCT component count from 4 to 8 adds 1.00 percentage point of MSE reduction for 5,728 B. On jointly trained bases, EPOC lowers MSE by 16.69--20.15% relative to globally blended TEFL-style adapters applied to the same base. Code and numerical records are available at [https://github.com/keiotakmin/endpoint-preserving-residual-correction](https://github.com/keiotakmin/endpoint-preserving-residual-correction).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EPOC 用压缩残差状态做多步时间序列预报的在线校正：只存前一残差块的低阶 DCT 系数与末值，末值作为各通道共享端点输入分量级在线岭回归。在 8 个多变量序列、DLinear 与 PatchTST、3 个种子、96 个固定基座条件下，24 步预测的 MSE 平均降 15.40%、MAE 降 9.35%，中位保留状态仅 6,352 B；完整 ELF 降幅更大（19.29%）但状态是 EPOC 的 75 倍。
Motivation: 已完成预报的残差反馈可用于在线校正，但保留完整残差块会显著增大辅助状态开销，需要在精度与状态占用之间取舍。
Method: EPOC 存储残差块的低阶 DCT 系数与末值，把末值作为共享端点，喂给各通道的分量级在线岭回归 (component-wise online ridge regression)，输入为当前预报的 DCT 系数；对比 δ-Adapter、COSA、FAC、OMPB 与 ELF，并做等大小摘要对照与系数重构端点对照。
Result: 在 96 个匹配固定基座条件（8 序列 × DLinear/PatchTST × 3 seeds × 2 训练变体，24 步）上，EPOC 相对未校正基座的条件平均 MSE 降 15.40%、MAE 降 9.35%，中位保留状态 6,352 B；配对 MSE 在多数条件下优于 δ-Adapter、COSA、FAC、OMPB 且状态更小。完整 ELF 平均 MSE 降 19.29%，但中位状态 474,048 B（EPOC 的 75 倍）。等大小摘要对照中端点方案配对 MSE 领先 1.65–2.20%；系数重构端点与观测端点精度相当。DCT 分量数从 4 增到 8 多降 1.00 个百分点 MSE，代价 5,728 B。联合训练基座上 EPOC 相对全局混合的 TEFL 式 adapter 降 MSE 16.69–20.15%。
Conclusion: 端点是共享输入的关键：压缩残差状态加共享端点即可在远小于完整残差块的状态下取得可观在线校正收益，DCT 分量数是精度与状态的直接权衡旋钮。

papers.title: Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with future visual prediction for robotic manipulation. However, completing the joint video-action denoising process at each replanning cycle incurs substantial latency, delaying action updates and limiting closed-loop responsiveness. We present Rolling-WAM, a formulation that distributes joint denoising across successive replanning cycles. Our method maintains a sliding window of video-action chunks at staggered noise levels. At each step, a rolling noise schedule fully denoises the imminent action chunk for execution, while partially refining farther-future chunks. As the window advances with new camera observations, the retained future chunks continue their denoising process. This distributes the computational cost over time while carrying an evolving visual-action context across chunk boundaries. Evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid show that Rolling-WAM achieves competitive manipulation performance. By removing the need to denoise the entire prediction horizon from scratch, it delivers a 4.5x steady-state replanning speedup over standard joint WAMs.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Under review. Project page: https://rolling-wam.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Rolling-WAM 把机器人操作的视频-动作联合去噪摊到连续重规划周期上：维护一个噪声水平错开的视频-动作块滑动窗口，每步用滚动噪声调度把最近动作块完全去噪后执行，远处未来块只做部分细化，窗口随新相机观测前移。在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 与真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人上取得有竞争力的操作性能，稳态重规划相对标准联合 WAM 加速 4.5 倍。
Motivation: World Action Models 每个重规划周期都要完整跑一遍视频-动作联合去噪，延迟高、动作更新慢，限制了闭环响应速度。
Method: 维护噪声水平错开的视频-动作块滑动窗口；滚动噪声调度每步完全去噪最近动作块供执行、仅部分细化更远未来块；窗口随新相机观测推进，跨块保留演化中的视觉-动作上下文，把计算成本分摊到时间上。

papers.title: On the SoS Certifiability of Log-Concave Distributions
papers.abstract_en: We prove that for every isotropic log-concave distribution $P$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$ and every even $m\ge2$, the polynomial $(Cm)^m\|v\|_2^m - \mathbb{E}_{X\sim P}\langle X,v\rangle^m$ is a sum of squares, where $C>0$ is a universal constant. This improves on the Poincaré-dependent bounds (Kothari and Steinhardt, 2017), recovering the optimal moment bounds for log-concave distributions. As an immediate corollary, we obtain computationally efficient algorithms with dimension-free error guarantees for a wide range of statistical estimation problems. Our proof proceeds by using stochastic localization to decompose $P$ as an average of strongly log-concave measures, whose centered moments admit the subgaussian certificates (Diakonikolas et al., 2025). With a covariance-adapted choice of localization, we show that a fourth-moment certificate derived from the variance inequality for quadratic forms (Letwin, 2026) suffices to control this averaging at every even degree.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明对任意各向同性 log-concave 分布 P 与任意偶数 m≥2，多项式 (Cm)^m‖v‖₂^m − E⟨X,v⟩^m 都是平方和 (sum of squares)，常数 C 与维数无关。该界不依赖 Poincaré 常数，恢复了 log-concave 分布的最优矩界，并直接给出一批统计估计问题的高效算法与维数无关误差保证。
Motivation: 此前 log-concave 分布的矩界依赖 Poincaré 常数 (Kothari and Steinhardt, 2017)，既非最优，也难以直接转成维数无关的算法误差保证。
Method: 用 stochastic localization 把 P 分解为强 log-concave 测度的平均，其中心矩由 Diakonikolas et al. (2025) 的 subgaussian 证书控制；再取协方差自适应的 localization，用 Letwin (2026) 关于二次型方差不等式导出的四阶矩证书在每个偶数阶上控制该平均。
Result: 对每个偶数 m≥2 与任意各向同性 log-concave P，(Cm)^m‖v‖₂^m − E⟨X,v⟩^m 为 SOS，C>0 为普适常数；相对 Kothari–Steinhardt (2017) 去掉 Poincaré 依赖并恢复最优矩界，推论给出维数无关误差保证的高效统计算法。
Conclusion: log-concave 分布的偶数阶矩 admits 维数无关的 SOS 证书，且 stochastic localization 加四阶矩证书足以在所有偶数阶上闭合论证。

papers.title: Technical Manual for Toolkit for Confidence-Corpus Consistency, Corpus Absorption and Rule Learning via Fine-Tuning on a Fabricated Corpus
papers.abstract_en: This manual documents version 2.0.0 of an open toolkit for fine-tuning small causal language models on fabricated and rule-governed arithmetic corpora and measuring what they take up from them. The fact domain is the 81 additions of two single-digit natural numbers, small enough to be enumerated exhaustively. The toolkit fine-tunes a model on the correct sums, on one fixed fabricated answer for every addition, and back on the correct sums of a subset of the additions; it fine-tunes copies of these models on simple rules (the sum plus a constant) and on a conditional rule (a shift that depends on the order of the addends), each paired with a control that has the same answers but no rule; and it measures every model on every candidate answer of every addition with one unchanged procedure, reporting results separately for additions seen in fine-tuning and additions held out. We describe and justify each stage of the pipeline: the confidence index (the probability of a complete answer, closed by an end marker), the single candidate set, the answer-only training loss, the lineage of fourteen measured models, the held-out split, the controls, the exclusion of additions that would count as hits by coincidence, and the exact and resampled intervals attached to every result. We then explain every figure and table a run produces and how each is read. This manuscript is a methodological and implementation reference: it documents the instrument, and it neither states nor tests hypotheses, nor reports or interprets the outcome of any specific run. Those are the subject of work that uses the toolkit. The toolkit and its pinned dependency environment are archived separately (Section 10) under a persistent identifier, to be cited as an instrument.
papers.comment: 44 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables, 18 code listings. v2 documents toolkit v2.0.0: adds recovery, simple- and conditional-rule experiments with held-out additions and controls; revises confidence index and training loss. Reference manual; reports no empirical results. Toolkit and pinned dependency environment: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23160760 (CC BY 4.0)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一份工具手册而非实证论文：文档化 v2.0.0 工具包，用于在可穷举的算术语料（两个个位数相加的 81 条加法）上微调小型因果语言模型并测量其吸收程度，涵盖正确和、固定虚构答案、简单规则（和加常数）与条件规则（依赖加数顺序的偏移）及其配对对照。手册逐段说明流水线（confidence index、单一候选集、answer-only 训练损失、14 个被测模型的 lineage、held-out 划分、排除巧合命中的加法、精确与重采样区间），明确声明不提出也不检验假设、不报告任何具体运行的结果。
Motivation: 要把「模型从语料里学到了什么」当作可测量对象，需要一台定义固定、可复现的仪器：同一测量程序、明确的对照与 held-out 划分、以及能排除巧合命中的计分规则。该手册针对的正是这类测量装置的缺失，而非某个具体科学假设。
Method: 工具包对小型 causal LM 做多阶段微调：正确和、每个加法一个固定虚构答案、再回到正确和的子集；另对这些模型的副本分别微调简单规则（sum 加常数）与条件规则（依赖加数顺序的偏移），每个规则配一个答案相同但无规则的对照。测量用统一程序给出每个加法每个候选答案的 confidence index（完整答案概率，以 end marker 收束）、answer-only 训练损失、单一候选集、held-out 划分，并对每个结果附精确区间与重采样区间；共记录 14 个被测模型的 lineage。
Result: 本手册按其自述不报告任何具体运行的结果，也不陈述或检验假设；产出的是对流水线各阶段的描述与论证，以及对每次运行生成的图表如何解读的说明。手册本身给出的量化事实为：事实域含 81 条个位数加法、lineage 含 14 个被测模型、v2.0.0 文档为 44 页含 6 图 2 表 18 段代码清单。
Conclusion: 该稿件的定位是方法学与实现参考：它交付一台可作为 instrument 引用的测量装置（Zenodo 持久标识归档，CC BY 4.0），具体假设与结果属于后续使用该工具包的工作。

papers.title: Efficient Cost-Aware LLM Evaluation via Bayesian Bandit Gittins Indices
papers.abstract_en: Exhaustively evaluating every candidate LLM configuration on every benchmark item to identify a high-performing one is costly. We formulate configuration selection as a cost-aware Bayesian bandit problem and propose GittinsEval, which draws on the Bayesian-optimal Gittins policy to determine which configuration to evaluate next and when to stop. We extend the policy with an anytime recommendation rule over both fully and partially evaluated configurations, using an LCB-style score to account for posterior uncertainty. GittinsEval is computationally efficient, requiring only lightweight online updates after offline precomputation. Across GSM8K, PIQA, AlpacaEval, and MMLU response matrices, GittinsEval is consistently competitive, with particularly strong gains over configuration-level Bayesian optimization on large-example benchmarks and over cost-unaware bandit baselines on large-candidate tasks. Crucially, GittinsEval often attains near-zero simple regret using only 1% to 2% of the exhaustive-evaluation cost; it also offers an adaptive stopping rule that typically triggers at 1% to 10%.
papers.comment: Spotlight at ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning (DEMO)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 配置在基准题上的评测选成成本感知贝叶斯 bandit，用 Gittins 索引决定下一个评哪个配置、何时停，并加一条覆盖全评与半评配置的 anytime 推荐规则（LCB 式分数计入后验不确定性）。在 GSM8K、PIQA、AlpacaEval、MMLU 的 response matrix 上，常以穷举评测成本的 1%–2% 达到近零 simple regret，自适应停机通常在 1%–10% 触发。
Motivation: 在每个基准题上穷举评测所有候选 LLM 配置代价过高，需要在评测预算与配置质量之间做序贯权衡。
Method: 将配置选择形式化为 cost-aware Bayesian bandit，提出 GittinsEval：以 Bayesian-optimal Gittins 策略决定下一个评测对象与停机时机，再扩展出覆盖完全与部分评测配置的 anytime 推荐规则，用 LCB 式分数处理后验不确定性；离线预计算后仅需轻量在线更新。
Result: 在 GSM8K、PIQA、AlpacaEval、MMLU response matrix 上表现稳定有竞争力：在大样本基准上明显优于 configuration-level Bayesian optimization，在大候选数任务上优于 cost-unaware bandit 基线；常以穷举成本的 1%–2% 达到近零 simple regret，自适应停机规则通常在 1%–10% 触发。
Conclusion: 把评测预算当作 bandit 成本并用 Gittins 索引调度，可以在极小评测开销下选出接近最优的 LLM 配置，同时给出何时停止评测的准则。

papers.title: VideoGen-Agent: Reinforcing Video Generation Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video generative models have enabled high-fidelity, temporally coherent video generation. However, these models often struggle to satisfy prompts requiring specialized knowledge, specific identities, physical consistency, or ordered events. In this paper, we present VideoGen-Agent, a multimodal agent trained through multitask agentic reinforcement learning to use external tools for video generation. The agent coordinates augmentation, generation, and verification tools through multi-turn interactions, using the prompt and intermediate observations to guide its decisions. We train a shared policy on a category-balanced dataset spanning six tasks. Supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated trajectories establishes tool-use behavior, which is then refined through reinforcement learning. A category-aware hybrid reward evaluates tool-call validity, task-appropriate tool use, and generated video quality. We further introduce VABench, a held-out benchmark of 600 prompts covering procedural knowledge, single- and multi-entity identity preservation, physical consistency, scene composition, and multi-shot temporal structure. On VABench, VideoGen-Agent improves over its base text-to-video generator by 19.1 points, from 56.5 to 75.6. Upgrading the generation tools further raises the score to 86.1 without additional agent training. Human raters prefer the upgraded configuration over the strongest standalone baseline in 84.3% of comparisons. These results support learning tool use across video-generation tasks and show that the trained agent can benefit from subsequent advances in generation tools. Project page: https://andyca111.github.io/VideoGen_Agent/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VideoGen-Agent 是一个多模态视频生成 agent，用多任务 agentic 强化学习训练其在多轮交互中调用增强、生成、验证三类外部工具，并以 category-aware 混合奖励同时约束工具调用合法性、工具选择恰当性与视频质量。在自建 VABench（600 条 held-out prompt）上，agent 比其底座文生视频模型高 19.1 分（56.5→75.6），换用更强生成工具后无需再训练即升到 86.1，人工评审在 84.3% 的对比中偏好该配置。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型难以满足需要专业知识、特定身份、物理一致性或有序事件的 prompt，单靠端到端生成无法可靠补齐这些约束。
Method: 在覆盖六类任务的 category-balanced 数据集上训练共享策略：先用 teacher 生成轨迹做 supervised fine-tuning 建立工具使用行为，再用强化学习精调；奖励为 category-aware hybrid reward，评估工具调用有效性、任务匹配的工具使用与生成视频质量；agent 通过多轮交互协调 augmentation、generation、verification 工具。
Result: VABench 含 600 条 held-out prompt，覆盖程序性知识、单/多实体身份保持、物理一致性、场景构成与多镜头时序结构。在其上 VideoGen-Agent 比底座文生视频生成器高 19.1 分（56.5→75.6）；升级生成工具后分数进一步到 86.1 且无需额外 agent 训练；人工评审在 84.3% 的对比中偏好升级配置而非最强独立基线。
Conclusion: 跨视频生成任务学习工具调用能显著抬高生成质量，且训练好的 agent 可以直接吃到后续生成工具进步带来的收益，无需重训。

summary_sections.result: VABench 含 600 条 held-out prompt，覆盖程序性知识、单/多实体身份保持、物理一致性、场景构成与多镜头时序结构。在其上 VideoGen-Agent 比底座文生视频生成器高 19.1 分（56.5→75.6）；升级生成工具后分数进一步到 86.1 且无需额外 agent 训练；人工评审在 84.3% 的对比中偏好升级配置而非最强独立基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 跨视频生成任务学习工具调用能显著抬高生成质量，且训练好的 agent 可以直接吃到后续生成工具进步带来的收益，无需重训。

papers.title: PredActor: Predictive Action Diffusion for Steerable Onboard Humanoid Control
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models provide a flexible framework for motion generation, but turning this flexibility into closed-loop humanoid control remains challenging. Hierarchical generator-tracker systems steer motion through reference trajectories, yet these references may exceed the capabilities of the downstream tracker, leaving physical feasibility and disturbance recovery largely to a separate control module. Action-only diffusion avoids this separation by directly generating executable actions, but provides no explicit future-state trajectory that can be steered toward test-time motion objectives. Joint state-action diffusion offers a natural alternative, but existing controllers often rely on privileged full-body states, while learned behavior selection and test-time motion steering remain only partially integrated. We present PredActor, a predictive action diffusion policy that unifies both steering modes in one directly executed policy using proprioception alone. Given proprioceptive history and optional task context, PredActor jointly predicts actions and an internal future-state trajectory that enables guidance: classifier-free guidance strengthens text-conditioned motion, while classifier guidance steers future states toward test-time objectives. Only actions are executed, requiring neither a motion-reference tracker nor privileged full-body states. In simulation, PredActor reaches 44 of 45 destination targets and achieves a text retrieval score of 0.539 versus 0.424 for conditional action diffusion, with similar disturbance survival. Rolling denoising and computation-preserving runtime optimizations reduce the complete callback to 16.790 ms median and 19.383 ms p95 on a Jetson Orin NX, within the 20 ms control period. Deployed on a Unitree G1, PredActor demonstrates text-conditioned motion, disturbance response, joystick control, and semantic interpolation in simulation and hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PredActor 把动作扩散与可导向的未来状态轨迹合进一个只用本体感受 (proprioception) 的直接执行策略：联合预测动作与内部未来状态，用 classifier-free guidance 强化文本条件动作、用 classifier guidance 把未来状态导向测试时目标。仿真中 45 个目标到达 44 个，文本检索分 0.539 对条件动作扩散的 0.424，抗扰存活相当；Jetson Orin NX 上完整回调中位 16.790 ms、p95 19.383 ms，落在 20 ms 控制周期内。
Motivation: 层级 generator-tracker 靠参考轨迹引导，但参考可能超出下游 tracker 能力，物理可行性与扰动恢复被推给独立控制模块；纯动作扩散没有可导向的未来状态轨迹，而联合状态-动作扩散常依赖特权全身状态，行为选择与测试时导向未打通。
Method: 给定本体感受历史与可选任务上下文，联合预测动作和内部未来状态轨迹；只执行动作，不需要参考轨迹 tracker 也不需要特权全身状态。classifier-free guidance 用于文本条件动作，classifier guidance 用于把未来状态导向测试时目标；配合滚动去噪与保算力的运行时优化。

papers.title: SupportCal: Label-Free Calibration of Post-Trained LLMs via Reference Support and Corroboration
papers.abstract_en: Post-training often improves task performance but can degrade confidence calibration, leaving post-trained language models (PoLMs) more overconfident than their corresponding pretrained language models (PLMs). Because task-specific labeled calibration data can be costly or unavailable, the corresponding PLM provides a natural label-free reference for post-hoc calibration. Prior agreement-gated PLM-referenced calibration fits a scalar temperature using only examples on which the PoLM and its PLM reference agree, excluding disagreement examples because direct alignment can drive the fitted temperature excessively high and induce under-confidence. We revisit this binary treatment. A controlled reintroduction diagnostic reveals a non monotonic aggregate effect: admitting a moderate fraction of disagreement examples can improve calibration, whereas the benefit diminishes as unit weight inclusion approaches the full disagreement set. We introduce SupportCal, a label-free post-hoc method that retains agreement examples at unit weight and assigns disagreement examples continuous weights based on the own-base PLM's relative support and corroboration from pretrained references selected from a size-compatible candidate pool. We further characterize when the resulting weighted objective admits a finite optimal temperature. Across MedMCQA and MathQA, SupportCal yields lower mean ECE than the agreement-only baseline for nearly all evaluated target-model configurations; supplementary TweetEval Sentiment results show the same pattern on a fixed-label classification task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SupportCal 用后训练模型 (PoLM) 对应的预训练模型 (PLM) 作无标签参考，对后训练 LLM 做事后温度标定：一致样本按单位权重保留，不一致样本按 own-base PLM 的相对支持度与候选池中多个预训练参考的佐证度赋连续权重。在 MedMCQA 与 MathQA 上，几乎所有被测目标模型配置的平均 ECE 都低于只用一致样本的 agreement-only 基线，TweetEval Sentiment 固定标签分类补充实验呈同一模式。
Motivation: 后训练常提升任务性能却损害置信度校准，使 PoLM 比对应 PLM 更过度自信；任务相关标注校准数据昂贵或不可得，而既有 PLM-referenced 标定把不一致样本整体剔除，因为直接对齐会把拟合温度推得过高导致 under-confidence。
Method: 先做受控的 reintroduction 诊断，观察逐步纳入不一致样本对聚合校准的非单调效应；SupportCal 在标量温度拟加权目标中对一致样本取单位权重，对不一致样本按 own-base PLM 的相对支持度与从 size-compatible 候选池选出的预训练参考的佐证度赋连续权重，并刻画该加权目标何时存在有限最优温度。
Result: 受控诊断显示非单调：纳入中等比例的不一致样本可改善校准，但按单位权重逼近完整不一致集时收益递减。在 MedMCQA 与 MathQA 上，SupportCal 的平均 ECE 在几乎所有被测目标模型配置下低于 agreement-only 基线；TweetEval Sentiment 补充结果在同一固定标签分类任务上重复该模式。
Conclusion: 不一致样本不该二元剔除，按参考支持度与佐证度加权纳入即可在无标签条件下把温度标定做得比 agreement-only 更准，且加权目标存在有限最优温度的条件可被刻画。

papers.title: EnterpriseVal: Quantifying the Efficacy, Reliability and Value of Generative AI in the Enterprise
papers.abstract_en: Frontier language models now produce professional deliverables that expert graders judge to match human work on a substantial share of economically valuable tasks, yet most enterprise GenAI initiatives fail to show a measurable business effect and a large fraction of agentic projects are expected to be cancelled. We argue that this is substantially a measurement problem: public benchmarks answer "what can the model do?", whereas a deployment decision requires "is this workflow fit, reliable, safe and worth scaling - here, on our data, under our controls?". We present EnterpriseVal, a use-case-level evaluation system that closes this gap. It comprises (i) a formal specification of the use case and of the frozen socio-technical configuration under test, model, prompts, retrieval, tools, guardrails and human oversight, with an autonomy level and consequence tier that jointly set the required evaluation intensity; (ii) a metric catalogue spanning fidelity, utility, efficiency, reliability, assurance and oversight; (iii) a grading protocol that scales blinded expert judgement with calibrated LLM-as-judge scoring through prediction-powered inference; (iv) a two-tier threshold gate, stated as an executable algorithm, that maps metric vectors with confidence bounds to REJECT/CONDITIONAL/SCALE decisions; and (v) a value-and-risk model in which the reviewer catch rate is a measured parameter. We report a pilot across three workflows in a global bank. In credit-memo drafting, human-graded citation precision reached 88% and hallucination rate 1.6% for the best model against gates of 70% and 5%; in procedure transformation, analyst refinement effort fell from an estimated 27.4 to 2.9 hours per document. We separate established results, documented pilot evidence, the proposed system and open hypotheses, and specify the experiments required for full validation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EnterpriseVal 把企业 GenAI 落地失败归为度量问题：公开基准只回答模型能做什么，部署决策需要回答在冻结的社会技术配置下该工作流是否合适、可靠、安全且值得扩展。它用形式化用例规格加自主度与后果层级设定评估强度，配合六类指标目录、校准的 LLM-as-judge 加 prediction-powered inference 的盲评专家打分，以及把带置信界的指标向量映射为 REJECT/CONDITIONAL/SCALE 的两层阈值门。全球银行三工作流试点中，信贷备忘录起草最佳模型的引用精确率 88%、幻觉率 1.6%，对应门槛 70% 与 5%；流程改造中分析师单文档精修工时从约 27.4 小时降到 2.9 小时。
Motivation: 前沿模型已在相当一部分经济价值任务上被专家评分判为达到人类水平，但多数企业 GenAI 项目测不出业务效果、大量 agentic 项目预计被取消；公开基准回答不了部署决策所需的“在我们的数据和管控下是否可靠、安全、值得扩展”。
Method: EnterpriseVal 由五部分组成：对用例与冻结社会技术配置（模型、prompt、检索、工具、护栏、人工监督）的形式化规格，自主度与后果层级共同决定评估强度；覆盖 fidelity、utility、efficiency、reliability、assurance、oversight 的指标目录；用校准 LLM-as-judge 与 prediction-powered inference 放大盲评专家判断的打分协议；把带置信界的指标向量映射为 REJECT/CONDITIONAL/SCALE 的两层阈值门（写成可执行算法）；以及把 reviewer catch rate 作为可测参数的价值-风险模型。
Result: 全球银行三个工作流的试点：信贷备忘录起草中最佳模型的人工评分引用精确率 88%、幻觉率 1.6%，对应门槛分别为 70% 和 5%；流程改造中分析师精修工时从估计的每文档 27.4 小时降至 2.9 小时。作者明确区分已确立结果、有据可查的试点证据、所提系统与开放假设，并给出完整验证所需实验。
Conclusion: 企业 GenAI 的瓶颈是度量而非能力：用冻结配置的用例级评估加可执行阈值门，才能把“模型能做什么”转成 REJECT/CONDITIONAL/SCALE 的部署决策；当前证据仅为三工作流试点，完整验证仍需补充实验。

papers.title: Storing Is Not Remembering: LSTM-UT and Bounded Gated Memory for Looped Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent-depth Transformers reuse one block across many steps, so information needed later must survive repeated rewriting of the hidden state. A natural remedy is to keep more history. We show that, in controlled cellular-automaton tasks, making history available is not the same as making it usable. Using Rule 30, where the correct state is known at every recurrent step, we test depth extrapolation and de- layed recall, the recovery of an earlier state after further computation. CoTFormer, which caches keys and values from every earlier step, extrapolates less far and recalls less accurately than a Block Universal Transformer (BUT) that keeps only its current state. Interventions show that its retained history can pull a corrected trajectory back toward failure, and that the cache block written at the requested step is neither necessary nor sufficient for recall. We introduce LSTM-UT, which adds a small, bounded, gated cell state to the shared block. Trained to depth 12, LSTM-UT keeps 99.7% exact-row accuracy at depth 60, where BUT gets no row fully correct, and one checkpoint stays above 99.95% at depth 1,000. It also improves delayed recall over both baselines, and the advantage largely persists at near-matched parameter counts. On these tasks, a small state under learned control proved more useful than a complete but unaddressed history. In OpenWebText2 language modelling, LSTM-UT outperforms BUT and, at equal width, reaches slightly lower perplexity than CoTFormer while CoTFormer needs up to 91% more training time per step; against a parameter-matched CoTFormer, LSTM-UT comes within 0.6 perplexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在循环深度 Transformer 中，缓存全部历史并不等于历史可用：CoTFormer 的全量 KV 缓存在 Rule 30 细胞自动机任务上外推更短、延迟回忆更差，其保留历史甚至会把已纠正的轨迹拉回失败。作者提出 LSTM-UT，在共享块内加一个小型有界门控 cell state，训练到深度 12 后在深度 60 保持 99.7% exact-row accuracy（BUT 无一行完全正确），单个 checkpoint 在深度 1,000 仍高于 99.95%。
Motivation: Recurrent-depth Transformer 复用同一块反复改写隐状态，后续所需信息难以存活；直觉补救是保留更多历史，但作者指出“可访问的历史”与“可用的历史”不是一回事。
Method: 在 Rule 30 细胞自动机上做受控实验，测试 depth extrapolation 与 delayed recall，并用干预 (interventions) 检验缓存的作用；对比 CoTFormer（缓存每步 key/value）、Block Universal Transformer (BUT)（只留当前状态）与新提出的 LSTM-UT（在共享块中加入小型有界门控 cell state），另在 OpenWebText2 上做语言建模对比。
Result: LSTM-UT 训练到深度 12，在深度 60 保持 99.7% exact-row accuracy，而 BUT 无一行完全正确；单个 checkpoint 在深度 1,000 仍高于 99.95%。延迟回忆优于两个基线，且在近似匹配参数量下优势大体保留。OpenWebText2 上 LSTM-UT 优于 BUT，同等宽度下 perplexity 略低于 CoTFormer，而 CoTFormer 每步训练时间最多多出 91%；对参数匹配的 CoTFormer，LSTM-UT 相差 0.6 perplexity。
Conclusion: 在这些任务上，受学习控制的小状态比完整但未被寻址的历史更有用；CoTFormer 被请求步写入的缓存块对回忆既不必要也不充分。

summary_sections.method: 在 Rule 30 细胞自动机上做受控实验，测试 depth extrapolation 与 delayed recall，并用干预 (interventions) 检验缓存的作用；对比 CoTFormer（缓存每步 key/value）、Block Universal Transformer (BUT)（只留当前状态）与新提出的 LSTM-UT（在共享块中加入小型有界门控 cell state），另在 OpenWebText2 上做语言建模对比。
summary_sections.result: LSTM-UT 训练到深度 12，在深度 60 保持 99.7% exact-row accuracy，而 BUT 无一行完全正确；单个 checkpoint 在深度 1,000 仍高于 99.95%。延迟回忆优于两个基线，且在近似匹配参数量下优势大体保留。OpenWebText2 上 LSTM-UT 优于 BUT，同等宽度下 perplexity 略低于 CoTFormer，而 CoTFormer 每步训练时间最多多出 91%；对参数匹配的 CoTFormer，LSTM-UT 相差 0.6 perplexity。

papers.title: Towards Transparent Diagnostics: Investigating Architectural Trade-offs and Explainability in Malaria Detection
papers.abstract_en: More than 80 countries have reported malaria cases with 610 thousand deaths and are projected to increase. Identifying malaria early and accurately helps save lives and effective way to diagnose malaria is through microscopic methods that are labor intensive and require experts with special equipment. Deep learning (DL) has shown promising results in medical diagnosis. Here, we explored various DL models: ResNet18, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet-B2, VGG19 and proposed model ResNet18+TTA (ResNet18 backbone with modified classification head and test time augmentation) for detecting malaria presence using blood smears taken from the NIH Malaria dataset. Our experiment shows MobileNetV2 achieved 96.85 % accuracy with smallest model size (8.49 MB) and fastest inference (1.35 ms). The ResNet18+TTA model achieved 97.96 % accuracy, 0.996 AUC with longest inference time (13.32 ms). Larger architecture outputs a larger model size with moderate accuracy. Upon further pruning, ResNet18+TTA model gained a slight improvement in accuracy and reduced inference time. GRAD-CAM, SHAP and LIME provide explainable AI (XAI) insights into model predictions, using explanation agreement and divergence to evaluate predictive reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 NIH Malaria 血涂片数据集上比较 ResNet18、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B2、VGG19 与所提 ResNet18+TTA（改分类头 + 测试时增强），ResNet18+TTA 精度最高但推理最慢，MobileNetV2 以最小模型和最快推理取得次高精度；剪枝后 ResNet18+TTA 精度略升且推理时间下降。GRAD-CAM、SHAP、LIME 的解释一致性与分歧被用来评估预测可靠性。
Motivation: 疟疾显微镜诊断依赖专家与专用设备、劳动密集，早期准确识别可救命；深度学习模型在精度、模型体积与推理延迟之间的取舍以及预测是否可解释，缺少在同一数据集上的对照。
Method: 在 NIH Malaria 血涂片数据集上训练并比较 ResNet18、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B2、VGG19，以及所提 ResNet18+TTA（ResNet18 骨干 + 修改的分类头 + test time augmentation）；对 ResNet18+TTA 进一步剪枝；用 GRAD-CAM、SHAP、LIME 三种 XAI 方法，以解释一致性 (explanation agreement) 与分歧 (divergence) 评估预测可靠性。
Result: MobileNetV2 精度 96.85%，模型体积最小 8.49 MB，推理最快 1.35 ms；ResNet18+TTA 精度 97.96%、AUC 0.996，推理时间最长 13.32 ms；更大架构带来更大模型体积而精度中等；剪枝后 ResNet18+TTA 精度略有提升并缩短推理时间。
Conclusion: 在该疟疾检测任务上精度与推理成本呈明显取舍：MobileNetV2 适合资源受限部署，ResNet18+TTA 精度最高且经剪枝可回收部分延迟；XAI 解释的一致性与分歧可作为预测可靠性的评估依据。

papers.title: Automated Physics-Informed Neural-Networks-Based Calibration of Highly Segmented Silicon Telescopes
papers.abstract_en: Transfer and multi-nucleon transfer reactions are essential tools for probing nuclear structure and reaction dynamics, requiring precise determination of the identity, energy, and emission angles of reaction products. The increasing granularity of modern silicon telescope arrays enhances experimental capabilities but challenges detector calibration, as conventional channel-by-channel approaches become inefficient and difficult to scale. In this work, we present a fully automated, physics-informed calibration framework based on neural networks, specifically designed for highly segmented silicon detector arrays. The method formulates calibration as a global optimization problem, in which detector gains and geometrical corrections are determined simultaneously by minimizing the width of the reconstructed excitation energy under two-body kinematics constraints. The approach relies exclusively on experimental data and well-established physical principles, without requiring explicit modeling of detector response. A distinctive feature is the use of multiple neural network sub-models sharing a common loss function with embedded physics constraints, enabling coherent and self-consistent calibration across all detector channels. This strategy ensures scalability, robustness, and reproducibility, making it particularly suitable for next-generation detector systems with increasing complexity. The performance of the method is demonstrated using experimental data from the Particle-Identification Silicon-Telescope Array (PISTA) in high-resolution fission studies in inverse kinematics. The results show excellent agreement with theoretical kinematics, high-quality particle identification, and a significant improvement in calibration efficiency. The proposed framework provides a general and adaptable solution for the calibration of complex detector systems in modern nuclear physics experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把高分段硅望远镜的刻度写成全局优化：多个神经网络子模型共享一个嵌入两体运动学约束的损失，同时求解各道增益与几何修正，以最小化重建激发能宽度。只用实验数据、不建模探测器响应，在 PISTA 逆运动学高分辨裂变实验数据上与理论运动学高度一致，粒子鉴别质量高，刻度效率显著提升。
Motivation: 现代硅望远镜阵列道数不断增多，逐道手工刻度低效且难以扩展，需要一种能跨全部道自洽、可复现的自动化刻度方式。
Method: 将刻度表述为全局优化问题：多个神经网络子模型共享同一损失函数，损失内嵌两体运动学约束，通过最小化重建激发能宽度同时确定探测器增益与几何修正；仅依赖实验数据与既有物理原理，不显式建模探测器响应。
Result: 在 PISTA（Particle-Identification Silicon-Telescope Array）逆运动学高分辨裂变实验数据上，结果与理论运动学高度一致，粒子鉴别质量高，刻度效率显著提升。
Conclusion: 共享物理约束损失的多子模型网络能给出跨道自洽、可扩展、可复现的自动化刻度，可作为复杂探测器系统刻度的通用方案。

papers.title: Hybrid coupling with numerics-informed neural networks and the overlapping Schwarz alternating method
papers.abstract_en: We develop a hybrid modeling framework for coupling pre-trained numerics-informed neural networks (NINNs) with classical full order models (FOMs) using the overlapping Schwarz alternating method. We consider the two-dimensional advection-diffusion equation in the advection-dominated, Peclet-number 10^6 regime. We first demonstrate that, unlike the corresponding physics-informed neural network (PINN), a monolithic NINN can be accurately trained on our model problem without domain decomposition. We then employ overlapping multiplicative Schwarz as a deployment mechanism for coupling a pre-trained, subdomain-local NINN with a neighboring FOM, with the NINN weights held fixed throughout the Schwarz iteration. We consider two training approaches for the subdomain-local NINNs: a top-down approach, in which boundary data are obtained from a coupled Schwarz solve on the full domain with a FOM on each subdomain (FOM-FOM Schwarz), and a bottom-up approach, in which boundary traces are generated synthetically on the NINN subdomain without requiring any full-domain solves. The resulting hybrid NINN-FOM solutions agree closely with the corresponding FOM-FOM Schwarz solutions, with the top-down and bottom-up training approaches yielding comparable accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把预训练的 numerics-informed neural networks (NINNs) 与经典 full order model (FOM) 用重叠 Schwarz 交替法做混合耦合：在二维对流主导、Peclet 数 10^6 的 advection-diffusion 问题上，NINN 权重在 Schwarz 迭代中全程冻结，仅作为子域局部求解器与相邻 FOM 交换边界迹。混合 NINN-FOM 解与 FOM-FOM Schwarz 解高度一致，且 top-down（全域耦合解提供边界数据）与 bottom-up（子域上合成边界迹、无需全域求解）两种训练方式精度相当。
Motivation: PINN 在对流主导的高 Peclet 数问题上难以直接训练，且神经求解器与经典 FOM 之间缺少可部署的耦合机制，无法在不重训的前提下与全阶模型协同求解。
Method: 先证明单体 NINN 无需域分解即可在该模型问题上准确训练（区别于对应 PINN）；再用 overlapping multiplicative Schwarz 作为部署机制，把预训练的子域局部 NINN 与相邻 FOM 耦合，Schwarz 迭代中 NINN 权重固定。子域 NINN 有两种训练路径：top-down 从全域 FOM-FOM Schwarz 耦合解取边界数据，bottom-up 在子域上合成边界迹、不做全域求解。
Result: 在二维 advection-diffusion、Peclet 数 10^6 的对流主导体制下，混合 NINN-FOM 解与对应 FOM-FOM Schwarz 解高度吻合；top-down 与 bottom-up 两种子域 NINN 训练方式给出可比精度。单体 NINN 可在该问题上准确训练，而对应 PINN 不能。
Conclusion: 预训练 NINN 可以作为权重冻结的子域求解器嵌入重叠 Schwarz 框架与 FOM 耦合，且边界数据可由子域合成迹替代全域求解而不损失精度。

papers.title: Supervising the Chain Ladder
papers.abstract_en: The chain ladder's volume-weighted pattern minimises an explicit loss function, yet is rarely booked as such. Practitioners adjust the pattern and record the final adjusted ratios. This paper treats the chain ladder's pattern selection as a supervised-learning problem. Judgement on pattern adjustments becomes a framework of defined penalties and hyperparameters on the chain ladder's loss function, treated here as an objective function in machine learning. Data weights are generalised with a decay and a power parameter for recency and volume weighting. Benchmark shaping and smoothness enter through a reference penalty and Whittaker-Henderson smoothing. The assembled objective is strictly convex and minimised by a single linear system. Each hyperparameter becomes an interpretable adjustment in its own right, declarable by judgement and categorised as an experience or a prospective adjustment. Experience adjustments can be set more objectively by a proposed training loop and a reserve validation score on held-out calendar diagonals. Further hyperparameter-based adjustments are written as almost-everywhere differentiable penalties that re-time or reshape the pattern. A worked example carries one real Schedule P triangle through an incurred and then a paid training stage, demonstrating the workflow.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 13 figures. Presented at the Actuarial Society of South Africa 2026 Convention, Cape Town, 7-8 October 2026. v3: text aligned with the convention version, with copy-edits and a few sentences clarified after peer review; references updated with DOIs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把链梯法 (chain ladder) 的模式选择改写成监督学习问题：把从业者对模式的人工调整显式化为损失函数上的惩罚项与超参数，整体目标严格凸，可由单一线性系统一次求解。经验调整可用训练循环加留出日历对角线上的 reserve validation score 来设定，并在一个真实 Schedule P 三角形上按已发生赔款、再按已付赔款两个阶段走通流程。
Motivation: 链梯法的加权模式虽是最小化一个显式损失的解，但实务中从业者直接改模式、只记录调整后的比率，判断过程没有被写成可声明、可复核的目标函数。
Method: 把链梯损失当作机器学习目标函数，加入定义明确的惩罚与超参数：数据权重推广为带衰减参数和幂参数的近期性/体量加权；基准整形与平滑度通过参考惩罚和 Whittaker-Henderson 平滑进入；进一步的调整写成几乎处处可微的惩罚，用于重定时或重塑模式。目标严格凸，由单一线性系统最小化；经验调整由提出的训练循环和在留出日历对角线上的准备金验证分数 (reserve validation score) 设定。
Result: 组装出的目标严格凸且由单一线性系统求解，每个超参数都成为可独立解释、可由判断声明并归类为经验性或前瞻性调整的量；在一个真实 Schedule P 三角形上依次完成已发生赔款与已付赔款两个训练阶段，演示完整工作流。
Conclusion: 链梯法的人工模式调整可以被形式化为带惩罚与超参数的监督学习目标，判断因此变成可声明、可分类、可用留出对角线验证的调整项。

papers.title: HSI-Road Relabeled: Surface-Aware Road-Scene Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: The HSI-Road dataset provides paired RGB and 25-channel NIR (600-960nm) images with binary masks but no surface-level labels. This paper introduces a manually labeled six-class taxonomy: Background, Asphalt, Concrete, Dirt, Water, and Grass, and an RGB-to-NIR registration pipeline with corresponding annotations. Six semantic-segmentation models are evaluated under four input configurations: original-resolution RGB, registered low-resolution RGB (RGB$_{\text{reg}}$), NIR, and channel-stacked RGB$_{\text{reg}}$-NIR (RGBN$_{\text{stk}}$). The comparison quantifies the effect of spatial-resolution reduction on RGB, along with evaluation of NIR and RGBN$_{\text{stk}}$, with results reported using per-class and mean IoU and F1 scores. The original-resolution RGB achieves the highest overall performance but contains 12$\times$ more pixels and incurs a 15.5-20.6$\%$ latency penalty compared to the reduced-resolution inputs. At the common 192$\times$384 resolution, RGBN$_{\text{stk}}$ outperforms NIR for all six models and RGB$_{\text{reg}}$ for five of six, with the most consistent gains for the Water class. These results highlight the importance of spatial resolution while showing that NIR provides complementary information to RGB.

papers.title: RiVaT-Fuse: Reliability-Calibrated Variational Tensor Fusion with Matrix-Valued Trust for Multimodal Prediction under Modality Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal prediction from images and structured metadata requires integrating complementary evidence whose reliability can vary across samples and latent directions. A single confidence weight per modality cannot capture this directional variation. We propose RiVaT-Fuse, a reliability-calibrated variational tensor fusion framework that formulates fusion as sample-wise latent-state estimation. For each image-metadata pair, the fused representation minimizes a quadratic objective combining agreement with modality embeddings, structured cross-modal interactions, and regularization. Positive-definite, low-rank-plus-diagonal trust matrices are conditioned on learned state descriptors and metadata completeness, allowing modality contributions to vary across latent directions. Additive, multiplicative, and relational interactions model cross-modal dependencies within the latent estimation objective. The resulting system admits a unique solution computed through a differentiable linear solve. A first-order analysis with fixed trust operators relates latent sensitivity to system conditioning and perturbations in modality embeddings and interactions. The framework further incorporates a state-binned entropic surrogate for conditional distributionally robust learning and task-coupled quadratic prediction heads. We instantiate RiVaT-Fuse on mBRSET, pairing retinal images with clinical and demographic metadata for diabetic retinopathy grading, diabetic macular edema detection, and referable-status prediction. Comparisons with unimodal and representation-level fusion baselines assess the predictive utility of the complete framework across these related clinical tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RiVaT-Fuse 把图像-结构化元数据的多模态融合写成逐样本的隐状态估计：用二次目标融合模态嵌入，并以正定的低秩加对角 trust 矩阵让各模态贡献随隐方向变化，解由可微线性求解给出唯一解。在 mBRETSET 视网膜图像加临床人口学元数据上，用于糖尿病视网膜病变分级、糖尿病黄斑水肿检测与可转诊判定三个临床任务，并与单模态及表示级融合基线比较预测效用。
Motivation: 多模态证据的可靠性既随样本又随隐方向变化，而每个模态只给一个置信权重无法表达这种方向性差异，融合质量因此受限。
Method: 对每个图像-元数据对最小化二次目标：与模态嵌入的一致项、结构化跨模态交互项与正则项；trust 矩阵取正定的 low-rank-plus-diagonal 形式，由学习到的状态描述子与元数据完整度条件化；加入加性、乘性、关系三类交互，系统经可微线性求解得唯一解，并配一阶条件数敏感性分析、state-binned entropic 代理做条件分布鲁棒学习，以及任务耦合的二次预测头。
Result: 在 mBRSET 上实例化，覆盖糖尿病视网膜病变分级、糖尿病黄斑水肿检测、可转诊状态预测三个相关临床任务；与单模态和表示级融合基线比较，评估完整框架的预测效用（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把融合当作带方向相关 trust 的隐状态估计问题，可让模态贡献随隐方向与元数据完整度变化，并在临床图像-元数据任务上给出可解、可微的融合形式。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: DR-LabStack: Design and Implementation of a Clinician-Facing Web System for Diabetic Retinopathy Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained diabetic retinopathy (DR) prediction models differ in their input fields, serialization formats, preprocessing requirements, and output semantics. Making these models accessible through a common clinical interface therefore requires explicit coordination between the user interface and the inference service. We designed and implemented DR-LabStack, a React-Flask web system integrating four externally developed pretrained models: RuleFit, Pruned RuleFit, Elaborative XGBoost, and Two-level Ensemble. A shared form retrieves ordered model features, renders model-specific numerical and categorical controls, and constructs a positional input vector. Backend adapters load heterogeneous artifacts and apply the ensemble's accompanying scaler, while a common JSON response supports binary classification display alongside method and source information. Functional evaluation on September 8, 2026 used copied application files and real model artifacts in a documented isolated environment. All four models loaded and exposed their 14-, 6-, 8-, and 25-field contracts. Sixty-two Flask test-client requests characterized service behavior; 12 limited-vector checks confirmed invocation-path and threshold consistency. Twenty-four browser-component scenarios with mocked transport verified input ordering and result rendering and characterized input-validation behavior. The resulting system demonstrates a reusable interaction and serving workflow for heterogeneous DR models. The contribution is web-system design, integration, and software functionality; clinical effectiveness and clinician usability require separate evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DR-LabStack 是一个面向临床医生的 React-Flask 网页系统，把四个异构的糖尿病视网膜病变 (DR) 预训练模型（RuleFit、Pruned RuleFit、Elaborative XGBoost、Two-level Ensemble）统一到同一套表单与推理服务上：共享表单按序取模型特征、渲染各模型专属的数值与类别控件并构造位置输入向量，后端 adapter 加载不同 artifact 并应用集成模型自带的 scaler。2026-09-08 的功能评测中四个模型全部加载并暴露 14/6/8/25 字段契约，62 次 Flask test-client 请求、12 次受限向量检查、24 个浏览器组件场景均通过，验证输入顺序与结果渲染。
Motivation: 不同 DR 预训练模型的输入字段、序列化格式、预处理要求和输出语义各不相同，直接暴露给临床医生会造成界面与推理服务之间缺乏显式协调，难以用统一临床界面访问。
Method: React 前端 + Flask 后端；共享表单按序拉取模型特征、渲染模型专属的数值与类别控件并构造位置输入向量；后端 adapter 加载异构 artifact 并应用 Two-level Ensemble 附带的 scaler；统一 JSON 响应同时返回二分类结果与方法、来源信息。功能评测在隔离环境中用复制的应用文件与真实模型 artifact 进行，含 Flask test-client 请求、受限向量检查与 mocked transport 的浏览器组件场景。
Result: 四个模型全部加载并暴露 14、6、8、25 字段契约；62 次 Flask test-client 请求刻画服务行为；12 次受限向量检查确认调用路径与阈值一致性；24 个浏览器组件场景（mocked transport）验证输入顺序与结果渲染并刻画输入校验行为。
Conclusion: 该系统证明了一套可复用的交互与服务工作流能统一接入异构 DR 模型；作者明确其贡献是网页系统设计、集成与软件功能，临床有效性与临床医生可用性需另行评估。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Optimal Low-Rank Quantum State Tomography with Bounded-Sample Joint Measurements
papers.abstract_en: We determine the optimal sample complexity of low-rank quantum state tomography when each measurement may act jointly on at most $t$ samples. For sufficiently small $\varepsilon$, estimating an unknown state on $\mathbb{C}^d$ of rank at most $r$ to trace norm error $\varepsilon$ with constant success probability requires, and is achievable with, $$Θ\left(\frac{dr}{\varepsilon^2}\mathop{\mathrm{max}}\left\{1,\frac{r}{\sqrt{t}}\right\}\right)$$ samples. The lower bound allows the protocol to choose each joint measurement adaptively using all previous classical outcomes; the matching upper bound is nonadaptive. Thus joint measurements on at most $t$ samples improve the complexity of algorithms making single-sample measurements by at most a factor $\sqrt{t}$. Further, measuring order $r^2$ samples jointly is necessary and sufficient to attain the unrestricted collective rate. For the lower bound, we vary the support of a state with fixed uniform spectrum and bound the Fisher information trace of every joint measurement on $t$ samples. The adaptive Fisher chain rule and the van Trees inequality then give the trace norm lower bound. For the upper bound, we construct and analyze a nonadaptive tomography protocol based on a Gaussian joint measurement. An explicit second moment identity and a conditional Gaussian law outside the state's support give a rank-dependent error analysis, yielding the matching rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出低秩量子态层析 (low-rank quantum state tomography) 在每次测量最多作用于 t 个样本时的最优样本复杂度：秩至多 r、迹范数误差 ε、常数成功概率下，所需样本数为 Θ(dr/ε² · max{1, r/√t})，上下界匹配。联合测量相对单样本测量最多带来 √t 的改进，且需要联合测量约 r² 个样本才能达到无限制集体测量的速率。
Motivation: 低秩量子态层析中，联合测量能作用的样本数 t 如何改变样本复杂度、以及达到无限制集体测量速率所需的联合规模，此前缺少匹配的上下界。
Method: 下界通过固定均匀谱、扰动态的支撑来构造，并界住任意 t 样本联合测量的 Fisher 信息迹，再用自适应 Fisher 链式法则与 van Trees 不等式导出迹范数下界；上界构造基于 Gaussian 联合测量的非自适应层析协议，用显式二阶矩恒等式与支撑外的条件高斯分布做秩相关误差分析。
Result: 样本复杂度为 Θ(dr/ε² · max{1, r/√t})，对充分小的 ε 与常数成功概率成立；下界允许协议自适应选择每次联合测量，匹配的上界是非自适应的。联合测量至多带来 √t 倍改进；联合测量 order r² 个样本是达到无限制集体测量速率的必要且充分条件。
Conclusion: t 样本联合测量对低秩量子态层析的收益被 √t 封顶，而 r² 量级的联合规模恰好是解锁集体测量速率的门槛。

papers.title: Online Inverse Integer Linear Optimization via Small-Gradient Skipping: Constant Regret and Finite Mistakes
papers.abstract_en: In online inverse linear optimization, the learner predicts a weight at each round, observes the optimal action of the agent, and updates its prediction. In the general setting, the gap of $\log T$ between the regret upper bound $O(d \log T)$ and the lower bound $Ω(d)$ is unresolved (here $T$ is the total number of rounds and $d$ is the dimension). When the action set is M-convex, the regret is known to be bounded by $O(d \log d)$, but the method attaining it computes a center of gravity at every round. This paper therefore proposes Small-Gradient Skipping (SGS), a mechanism that skips the update at rounds without a mistake, and applies it to online gradient descent, the online Newton step, and MetaGrad. When the forward problem is an integer linear program with a unique optimal solution, the number of mistakes is bounded, for all three, by a quantity independent of $T$; and for the online Newton step and for MetaGrad with SGS, the dimension dependence of the regret becomes $O(d^2)$, that is, the factor $\log T$ is removed. Moreover, when the action set is M-convex, the regret is bounded efficiently without computing a center of gravity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线逆线性优化中提出 Small-Gradient Skipping (SGS)：在没有犯错的轮次跳过更新，分别嫁接到 online gradient descent、online Newton step 与 MetaGrad 上。当前向问题是唯一最优解的整数线性规划时，三者的错误数都被与 T 无关的量界定；对 online Newton step 与带 SGS 的 MetaGrad，regret 的维度依赖降为 O(d^2)，即去掉了 log T 因子；M-convex 动作集下无需计算 center of gravity 也能有效界定 regret。
Motivation: 在线逆线性优化一般设定下 regret 上界 O(d log T) 与下界 Ω(d) 之间仍存在 log T 缺口；M-convex 动作集虽有 O(d log d) 界，但其方法每轮都要计算 center of gravity，代价高。
Method: 提出 Small-Gradient Skipping (SGS) 机制，在无错误的轮次跳过更新，并分别应用于 online gradient descent、online Newton step 与 MetaGrad 三种在线学习算法；分析在前向问题为唯一最优解整数线性规划以及 M-convex 动作集两种设定下进行。
Result: 前向问题为唯一最优解的整数线性规划时，三种带 SGS 的算法错误数均被与 T 无关的量界定；online Newton step 与带 SGS 的 MetaGrad 的 regret 维度依赖为 O(d^2)，即移除了 log T 因子；M-convex 动作集下 regret 可在不计算 center of gravity 的前提下被有效界定。
Conclusion: 跳过无错误轮次的更新足以在唯一最优解的整数线性规划设定下消除 regret 中的 log T 依赖，并绕开 M-convex 情形对 center of gravity 计算的需求。

summary_sections.motivation: 在线逆线性优化一般设定下 regret 上界 O(d log T) 与下界 Ω(d) 之间仍存在 log T 缺口；M-convex 动作集虽有 O(d log d) 界，但其方法每轮都要计算 center of gravity，代价高。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Small-Gradient Skipping (SGS) 机制，在无错误的轮次跳过更新，并分别应用于 online gradient descent、online Newton step 与 MetaGrad 三种在线学习算法；分析在前向问题为唯一最优解整数线性规划以及 M-convex 动作集两种设定下进行。

summary_sections.conclusion: 跳过无错误轮次的更新足以在唯一最优解的整数线性规划设定下消除 regret 中的 log T 依赖，并绕开 M-convex 情形对 center of gravity 计算的需求。

papers.title: A Function-Space Approach to the Statistical Mechanics of Learning Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: In the kernel regime, neural-network learning inherits its preferences from a frozen spectrum. During feature learning, this spectrum evolves, yet networks retain systematic biases toward simple, smooth directions. We develop a function-space statistical framework explaining the origin of these preferences, treating functions and their learning operators as macroscopic variables, with parameterization entering through the multiplicity of parameter configurations realizing each function. For mean-squared loss, error relaxes exactly under the evolving learning operator $M=JJ^\ast$. Training stochasticity induces a Gaussian weight over function-space states, while parameter multiplicity contributes an entropic operator $B$, defined by the curvature of its log multiplicity. A local Laplace expansion yields the fluctuation free energy $Φ_{\mathrm{fluc}}(M;B)=\frac{σ_ξ^2}{2}\log\det(M^{-1}+B)+\mathrm{const}$, analogous to an Occam factor. Under mild statistical conditions, this free energy is rotationally stationary exactly when $[M,B]=0$, is minimized by pairing large eigenvalues of $M$ with small eigenvalues of $B$, and generates a local restoring force against mismatch. Learning is therefore biased toward faster relaxation along entropically cheaper directions. This preference strengthens with training noise and vanishes in the deterministic limit, beyond gradient-flow accounts of operator alignment. For ReLU networks, we relate entropic curvature to the minimal rearrangement of activation boundaries required for a functional change and bound this structural cost by directional smoothness. Consequently, smooth directions are preferentially learned faster, in a data-adaptive manner, even as the learning operator evolves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在函数空间统计力学框架下，训练随机性给函数态一个高斯权重，参数多重性则给出熵算子 B，涨落自由能 Φ_fluc(M;B)=σ_ξ²/2·log det(M⁻¹+B) 类似 Occam 因子。当 [M,B]=0 时自由能旋转平稳，且 M 的大特征值配 B 的小特征值时取极小，于是学习偏向熵上更便宜、松弛更快的方向；该偏好随训练噪声增强、在确定性极限消失，对 ReLU 网络对应激活边界最小重排并被方向光滑性界定，因此光滑方向被优先更快学到。
Motivation: 核区制下网络偏好由冻结谱决定，特征学习时谱在演化，但网络仍系统性偏向简单光滑方向，现有梯度流的算子对齐解释不足以说明这一偏好的来源。
Method: 把函数与其学习算子 M=JJ* 当作宏观变量，参数化以实现同一函数的参数组态多重性进入；均方损失下误差在演化算子下精确松弛，训练随机性诱导函数空间高斯权重，log 多重度曲率定义熵算子 B，做局部 Laplace 展开得到涨落自由能 Φ_fluc(M;B)=σ_ξ²/2·log det(M⁻¹+B)。
Result: 在温和统计条件下，自由能当且仅当 [M,B]=0 时旋转平稳，由 M 的大特征值配 B 的小特征值时最小化，并对失配产生局部恢复力；偏好随训练噪声强度增强、确定性极限下消失。对 ReLU 网络，熵曲率对应功能改变所需的激活边界最小重排，其结构代价由方向光滑性给出上界，故光滑方向以数据自适应方式被更快学习。
Conclusion: 学习对简单光滑方向的偏好来自训练随机性与参数多重性共同产生的熵力，而非仅由梯度流下的算子对齐决定；该偏好是噪声依赖的，在确定性训练下不复存在。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Nous: Learning and Certifying Memory Decisions Before Source Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory systems update state decisions from reports whose reliability may be unknown. Existing analyses of source estimation do not determine when a policy can be learned or its improvement certified without identifying the reporting channel. We study these three tasks using the same observed records. For a specified hidden Markov family with continuous source uncertainty, decision learning and powered certification have quadratic sample complexity, whereas fixed-precision source estimation has quartic complexity. We characterize a sharp identified interval for policy gain under an unknown shared-background channel and derive finite-sample certificates under bounded history dependence and conditional copying. Independently trained witness regions support general history spaces, and disagreement-conditioned auditing improves power for sparse revisions. For dependent histories, prediction-count-preserving batches cancel the unknown reporting background and admit conditional certificates. A MultiWOZ 2.4 evaluation uses text-processing policies on 1,000 human-written test dialogues with simulated audits. Balanced batches retain 2.26 percentage points of the full candidate's 7.34 percentage-point mean gain and obtain more positive certificates under weak audits. These results establish task-specific information requirements and provide an auditable policy-revision framework for Nous.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 7 figures, including appendices. Revised and extended theory and evaluation, with prediction-count-preserving batch certificates and a MultiWOZ 2.4 text-policy study using simulated audits. Code and reproducibility archive: https://github.com/Pranavsingh431/nous-state/releases/tag/jmlr-submission-2026-10-04
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Nous 框架在报告通道可靠性未知时，证明策略学习与有功效的认证只需二次样本复杂度，而固定精度的源估计需要四次；并给出在未知共享背景通道下策略增益的可识别区间与有限样本证书。MultiWOZ 2.4 上 1,000 条人工对话的模拟审计中，保持预测计数的平衡批次保留了完整候选 7.34 个百分点平均增益中的 2.26 个百分点，并在弱审计下获得更多正证书。
Motivation: 智能体记忆系统的状态更新来自可靠性未知的报告，现有源估计分析无法判定策略何时可学、其改进何时可被认证，而不必先识别报告通道。
Method: 在含连续源不确定性的指定隐马尔可夫族上比较决策学习、功效认证与固定精度源估计的样本复杂度；对未知共享背景通道推导策略增益的尖锐可识别区间，并在有界历史依赖与条件复制下给出有限样本证书；用独立训练的 witness regions 支持一般历史空间，以 disagreement-conditioned auditing 提升稀疏修订的检验功效，对依赖历史用保持预测计数的批次抵消未知报告背景。
Result: 决策学习与功效认证的样本复杂度为二次，固定精度源估计为四次；MultiWOZ 2.4 上用文本处理策略评测 1,000 条人工撰写的测试对话（模拟审计），平衡批次保留完整候选 7.34 个百分点平均增益中的 2.26 个百分点，且在弱审计下获得更多正证书。
Conclusion: 不同任务对信息的需求不同：不识别报告通道也能学习与认证策略，代价是增益只能落在可识别区间内；保持预测计数的批次使依赖历史下也能做条件认证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Answer-Distribution Trajectories: A Stochastic-Dynamics View of LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought reasoning provides a structured computation between a model's input and final answer. Yet it is often evaluated through endpoint accuracy, which ignores the path taken to reach that answer. An emerging line of work addresses this limitation using entropy profiles, which track how uncertainty evolves over the reasoning process but do not reveal which competing hypotheses account for that uncertainty. We introduce answer-distribution trajectories, a stochastic-dynamics-inspired representation that tracks the model's full predictive distribution over answers as reasoning unfolds. As a strictly finer representation than endpoint and entropy summaries, answer-distribution trajectories enable us to characterize a trace through a dynamical reasoning profile spanning exploration, revision, motion, and commitment, and to distinguish different dynamical mechanisms of reasoning success and failure. Across sixteen open-weight language models and four reasoning benchmarks, we show that traces with the same endpoint and similar entropy profiles can exhibit substantially different reasoning dynamics. We further find substantial variation in these dynamics both within and across models and tasks, with different objectives favoring different dynamical profiles. Additionally, we show that training and inference choices systematically reshape these profiles. Our results suggest that answer-distribution trajectories provide a rich framework for analysing and evaluating the dynamics of LLM reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 answer-distribution trajectories：在推理展开过程中跟踪模型对答案的完整预测分布，作为比端点准确率和熵剖面更细的表示。在 16 个开放权重语言模型与 4 个推理基准上，端点相同、熵剖面相似的轨迹可呈现显著不同的推理动力学，且训练与推理选择会系统性重塑这些剖面。
Motivation: Chain-of-thought 推理通常只用端点准确率评估，忽略了到达答案的路径；新兴的熵剖面虽追踪不确定性演化，却无法指出哪些竞争假设贡献了该不确定性。
Method: 以随机动力学视角把每条推理轨迹表示为随推理展开的答案分布轨迹，比端点与熵剖面严格更细；据此刻画探索、修正、运动与承诺 (exploration, revision, motion, commitment) 的动力学剖面，并区分推理成功与失败的不同动力学机制，在 16 个开放权重 LLM 与 4 个推理基准上分析。
Result: 在 16 个开放权重语言模型、4 个推理基准上，端点相同且熵剖面相似的轨迹可表现出实质不同的推理动力学；动力学在模型内与模型间、任务间均有显著差异，不同目标偏好不同动力学剖面；训练与推理选择会系统性重塑这些剖面。
Conclusion: 端点与熵剖面不足以刻画 LLM 推理，答案分布轨迹提供了分析与评估推理动力学的更丰富框架。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Deep Learning for False Ventricular Tachycardia Alarm Reduction in the ICU
papers.abstract_en: False ventricular tachycardia (VT) alarms are a leading contributor to alarm fatigue in intensive care units. We propose a deep learning framework combining a 1D SE-ResNet with ICU-realistic data augmentations and a physics-informed auxiliary reconstruction task based on the three-element Windkessel hemodynamic model, implemented as a differentiable forward simulation. By requiring the network's latent representation to produce physiologically plausible arterial pressure waveforms, artifact-driven ECG patterns are penalized while true VT remains coherent across modalities. Evaluated on the VTaC benchmark under a strict real-time protocol (10-second pre-alarm window), our method achieves a 5-point Challenge Score improvement over prior state-of-the-art. Ablation studies confirm that the physics-informed objective is the primary performance driver, providing gains in accuracy, 2x label efficiency, and more localized and clinically meaningful ECG segments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 ICU 中假性室性心动过速 (VT) 报警导致的报警疲劳，提出 1D SE-ResNet 加 ICU 真实感数据增强，并以三元件 Windkessel 血流动力学模型做可微前向仿真作为物理信息辅助重建任务，迫使隐表示重建生理合理的动脉压波形。在 VTaC 基准的 10 秒报警前窗口实时协议下，Challenge Score 比先前最好结果高 5 分，消融显示物理信息目标是主要增益来源，并带来 2 倍标签效率。
Motivation: 假性 VT 报警是 ICU 报警疲劳的主要来源，而仅靠 ECG 形态的判别模型容易被伪影触发的模式误导。
Method: 1D SE-ResNet 主干加 ICU 真实感数据增强；辅助任务用三元件 Windkessel 模型的可微前向仿真，要求网络隐表示重建生理合理的动脉压波形，从而惩罚伪影驱动的 ECG 模式；在 VTaC 基准上按 10 秒报警前窗口的严格实时协议评测，并做消融。
Result: 在 VTaC 基准、10 秒 pre-alarm 窗口实时协议下，Challenge Score 较先前 SOTA 提升 5 分；消融确认物理信息目标是主要性能驱动，同时带来准确率提升、2 倍标签效率，以及更局部、更具临床意义的 ECG 片段。
Conclusion: 把血流动力学物理约束作为辅助重建目标，可以在保持实时性的前提下压低假 VT 报警并显著减少所需标签量。

papers.title: How Perturbations Propagate: A Multi-Level Analysis of Robustness in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Language models encounter typos, corrupted text, altered words, and disrupted token order, yet robustness is usually evaluated only through output behavior. We study how six naturalistic and synthetic input perturbations propagate through decoder-only language models at three levels: output behavior, hidden-state geometry, and attention-head function. We evaluate behavioral effects across four GPT-2 and two Qwen2.5 checkpoints, analyze layerwise geometry using centered kernel alignment and intrinsic dimension, and examine attention-head responses in GPT-2. Perturbation types produce distinguishable metric profiles that are not fully captured by output measures and are only partly consistent across the tested checkpoints. Copying scores show the strongest pooled associations with activation-patching recovery under token substitution and shuffling, although these associations do not isolate copying-specific effects. Gradient-guided HotFlip perturbations also cause stronger behavioral and representational disruption than rate-matched random token substitutions in GPT-2; their behavioral effects are consistent across all six tested checkpoints. Our results show that robustness claims based on a single behavioral or representational metric can be misleading, and motivate multi-level evaluation of how perturbations alter language-model computation.

TL;DR: 在 decoder-only 语言模型上系统考察六种自然与合成输入扰动如何沿输出行为、隐状态几何、注意力头功能三个层级传播，发现各扰动类型产生可区分的指标谱，单一行为或表征指标会误导鲁棒性结论。HotFlip 梯度引导扰动在 GPT-2 上比同替换率的随机 token 替换造成更强的行为与表征破坏，且该行为效应在全部六个 checkpoint 上一致。
Motivation: 语言模型鲁棒性通常只从输出行为评估，无法区分扰动在隐状态几何与注意力头功能层面的实际传播路径，跨 checkpoint 的一致性也无从判断。
Method: 对六种自然与合成扰动（含 token 替换、乱序、HotFlip）在四个 GPT-2 与两个 Qwen2.5 checkpoint 上评测输出行为；用 centered kernel alignment 与 intrinsic dimension 做逐层几何分析；在 GPT-2 上检查注意力头响应，并用 activation-patching 恢复度与 copying score 关联。

Conclusion: 基于单一行为或表征指标的鲁棒性结论可能误导，应做多层级评估；指标谱跨 checkpoint 仅部分一致，说明鲁棒性判断依赖所选层级与模型。

papers.title: You Cannot Photograph the Same Street Twice: Reliability Limits in Vision-Language Measurement of Urban Change
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to measure urban change from repeated street-level imagery, and the results are often mapped for individual sample points. Such maps assume that a perception score changes only if the street does. We test this assumption with repeated Google Street View captures of unchanged streets in five US cities and with controlled experiments that hold the photograph, scene or camera fixed. Re-photographing an unchanged street shifts its perception score by two-thirds of the average difference between two streets in the same city. Much of this shift arises in the scoring and averages out over question orders; the rest comes from the photographs and is not predicted by image statistics of weather and light. A single image measures a place moderately well, but the change at one location barely separates redeveloped from unchanged streets. All models tested score degraded images as worse-looking streets, and in crowdsourced imagery camera differences cause false reports of physical change unless both images are rendered through a common virtual camera. After aggregation, redeveloped streets are scored as wealthier and better maintained, with more enclosure and less greenery. Streets photographed in the same capture campaign share part of their error, which averaging within a district does not remove. For urban research and planning, VLM perception scores can support comparisons between groups of streets, such as redeveloped and unchanged streets photographed in the same campaigns, but not the identification of individual streets that improved or declined.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用重复拍摄的未变化街道检验 VLM 街景感知分数能否度量城市变化：同一街道重拍就把感知分数推移约等于同城两条街平均差异的三分之二，且单点变化量几乎分不开已再开发与未变化街道。作者结论是 VLM 感知分数只支持组间比较（如同一拍摄批次内的再开发街与未变化街），不能用来判定某条街改善或退化。
Motivation: VLM 街景感知分数常被逐点画成城市变化地图，其隐含假设是分数只随街道本身变化而变；若重拍噪声即可产生同等量级的位移，逐点判读城市变化就不可靠。
Method: 在五个美国城市对未变化街道做重复 Google Street View 拍摄，并做控制实验分别固定照片、场景或相机；另测试众包影像中相机差异的影响，检验是否需把两图渲染到同一虚拟相机。
Result: 重拍未变化街道造成的感知分数位移约为同城两街平均差异的三分之二；位移一部分来自打分环节、随问题顺序平均掉，另一部分来自照片本身且无法由天气与光照的图像统计预测；所有被测模型都把降质图像打成更差的街景；众包影像中相机差异会造成虚假的物理变化报告，除非两图经同一虚拟相机渲染；聚合后再开发街道被评为更富裕、维护更好、围合感更强、绿量更少，且同一拍摄批次的街道共享部分误差，区内平均无法消除。
Conclusion: VLM 感知分数适合比较街道组（如同批次拍摄的再开发街与未变化街），不适合识别单条街的改善或退化。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Capability-Gated Language Models: Security Composes, Utility Does Not
papers.abstract_en: Deployed language model safeguards (safety fine-tuning, filtering, unlearning) vary by principal only outside the model weights: filters are reconfigured, tiers are multiplied, and artefacts are reissued; inside one set of weights every request meets the same model configuration. This motivates us to define capability-gated deployment: per-principal access control inside one set of weights, whose configurations form a lattice - meets accumulate a principal's restrictions and joins pool a coalition's reach. We instantiate it by sparse rank gating over an existing nested-factorisation mechanism, guide profile search with one-pass attribution, and read every result once from a pre-registered held-out split. Security approximately composes: provably exactly at meets under a monotone-elicitation assumption we falsify pointwise. In two lineages the median held-out meet deepens suppression; the one effect surviving correction strengthens it. Utility does not: individually harmless profiles can compose to retention and fluency damage, and no compositional bound exists.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of Language Model Security
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在单一模型权重内做按主体的 capability-gated 访问控制：配置构成 lattice，meets 累积限制、joins 汇聚联盟可达范围，用稀疏 rank gating 实现。安全近似可组合（在单调诱导假设下 meet 处精确成立，但该假设被逐点证伪）；效用不可组合——各自无害的 profile 组合后会造成记忆与流畅性损伤，且不存在组合上界。
Motivation: 现有安全手段（安全微调、过滤、unlearning）只在权重之外按主体区分，权重内所有请求面对同一配置；主体一多就要不断重配过滤器、扩层级、重发模型，且缺少组合后的效用保证。
Method: 定义 capability-gated deployment：单一权重内按主体访问控制，配置构成 lattice（meet 累积限制、join 汇聚联盟可达性）；在既有 nested-factorisation 机制上以稀疏 rank gating 实现，用 one-pass attribution 引导 profile 搜索，所有结果从预注册 held-out split 读取一次。
Result: 在两个 lineage 上，held-out meet 的中位数加深抑制，经多重校正后仍存活的唯一效应也是加强抑制；效用方面，单独无害的 profile 组合后造成 retention 与 fluency 损伤，且不存在组合上界。安全侧在单调诱导假设下 meet 处可证明精确成立，但该假设被逐点证伪。
Conclusion: 安全在 lattice meet 上近似可组合，效用不组合且无上界——capability gating 的组合设计必须单独约束效用，不能指望安全侧的组合性质顺带覆盖。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The PUR-1 Cyber-Physical Digital Twin
papers.abstract_en: Digital twin technologies have the potential to improve operational flexibility and responsiveness capabilities of nuclear systems. To provide decision support, cyber event characterization, state estimation, predictive control, and real-time dynamic processing of operational data, however, an efficient digital twin needs to integrate multiple models (data-driven as well as physics-based) with explainability while at the same time maintain two-way synchronization with the physical facility at a time constant less than its operational cycle. In this work, we present the Purdue University Reactor One Digital Twin (PUR-1 DT), a cyber-physical digital twin with a complete high-fidelity physics-based and AI-driven virtual model stack (neutronics, thermal-hydraulics, point kinetics) which provides closed-loop explainable diagnostics, forecasting, predictive control, and action recommendation back to the reactor via two-way communications and a cyber-physical testbed. We demonstrate real-time synchronized state estimation and short-term forecasting over a full reactor operational cycle and conduct a series of benchmarking experiments to validate accuracy and latency. Our results show good agreement with experimental results and lay the groundwork for further development and experimental demonstration of DT-enabled functionalities in real-world facilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PUR-1 核反应堆网络物理数字孪生把高保真物理模型栈（中子学、热工水力、点动力学）与 AI 模型集成，通过双向通信与网络物理测试床与实体反应堆保持快于其运行周期的同步，提供可解释诊断、状态估计、短期预报与预测控制。演示覆盖完整反应堆运行周期的实时同步状态估计与短期预报，基准实验显示与实验结果吻合良好。
Motivation: 核系统数字孪生要支撑网络事件表征、状态估计与实时动态处理，需同时集成数据驱动与物理模型并保持双向同步，且时间常数须小于设施运行周期，这在现有实现中难以兼顾。
Method: 构建 PUR-1 DT：高保真物理与 AI 混合模型栈（neutronics、thermal-hydraulics、point kinetics），经双向通信与 cyber-physical testbed 与反应堆闭环耦合，输出可解释诊断、预报、预测控制与动作推荐；用一系列 benchmarking 实验检验精度与延迟。
Result: 在完整反应堆运行周期上演示实时同步状态估计与短期预报；benchmarking 实验结果显示与实验结果吻合良好（good agreement），并给出精度与延迟验证。
Conclusion: 物理与 AI 混合的闭环双向数字孪生可在运行周期内完成实时同步与预报，为真实设施上 DT 功能的进一步开发与实验演示奠定基础。

papers.title: RealSWE: A Compositional Evaluation of Coding Agents under Realistic User Requests
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are now commonly evaluated on the SWE-bench family of benchmarks, whose tasks are built from curated GitHub issues: long, structured, and information-rich. Real user requests, however, are typically far shorter and less structured. To characterize this gap, we define a six-category information taxonomy and four dimensions of linguistic style, and apply them to real user prompts from SWE-chat and problem statements from SWE-bench Verified and Pro. We find that requests carrying only a problem statement, alone or with limited additional context, account for 88% of real prompts but just 7% of benchmark problems. Furthermore, 87% of real prompts are casually written whereas 94% of benchmark problems are formal. Guided by these observations, we introduce RealSWE, 381 multi-variant task families derived from SWE-bench Verified and Pro. Variants within each family share the same underlying task and gold patch while differing only in information composition and linguistic style. Evaluating seven contemporary LLMs with RealSWE, we find that i) realistic inputs reduce resolution rates by 6.4 pp on average and can change model rankings. Controlled analysis further shows that ii) including Desired Behavior and Motivation significantly affects performance, whereas Environment Information and Reproduction Steps merely add tokens without measurable benefit; iii) linguistic style has only small, model-dependent effects. These findings provide actionable guidance for users and agents: explicitly stating the desired behavior and motivation, which most real prompts omit, substantially improves the LLM's software engineering performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RealSWE 把 SWE-bench Verified/Pro 重构成 381 个多变体任务族，变体只改信息构成与语言风格、共享同一 gold patch，用来量化真实用户请求与基准题面的落差。真实请求中仅含问题陈述的占 88%（基准题仅 7%），87% 为口语化书写（基准 94% 正式）；用它评测 7 个当代 LLM，现实化输入使平均解决率下降 6.4 个百分点并可改变模型排名。
Motivation: SWE-bench 系列题目来自精心整理的 GitHub issue，长、结构化、信息密集，而真实用户请求通常短且不结构化，用前者评测会高估 coding agent 在真实输入下的表现。
Method: 定义六类信息分类法与四个语言风格维度，先分析 SWE-chat 真实 prompt 及 SWE-bench Verified/Pro 题面；据此构建 RealSWE：381 个多变体任务族，族内共享底层任务与 gold patch，仅信息构成和语言风格不同；再用它评测 7 个当代 LLM，并做受控分析分离各信息类别与风格的影响。
Result: 仅含问题陈述（可加少量上下文）的真实 prompt 占 88%，而基准题只占 7%；87% 的真实 prompt 口语化，94% 的基准题为正式文体。7 个 LLM 上现实化输入平均使解决率下降 6.4 个百分点并可改变模型排名。受控分析中 Desired Behavior 与 Motivation 显著影响性能，Environment Information 与 Reproduction Steps 只增加 token 而无可测收益，语言风格仅有小幅、因模型而异的效应。
Conclusion: 基准题面的信息密度掩盖了真实请求下的能力差距；用户与 agent 应显式写出期望行为与动机（多数真实 prompt 恰恰省略这两项），这能实质提升 LLM 的软件工程表现，而堆环境信息与复现步骤没有可测回报。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 定义六类信息分类法与四个语言风格维度，先分析 SWE-chat 真实 prompt 及 SWE-bench Verified/Pro 题面；据此构建 RealSWE：381 个多变体任务族，族内共享底层任务与 gold patch，仅信息构成和语言风格不同；再用它评测 7 个当代 LLM，并做受控分析分离各信息类别与风格的影响。
summary_sections.result: 仅含问题陈述（可加少量上下文）的真实 prompt 占 88%，而基准题只占 7%；87% 的真实 prompt 口语化，94% 的基准题为正式文体。7 个 LLM 上现实化输入平均使解决率下降 6.4 个百分点并可改变模型排名。受控分析中 Desired Behavior 与 Motivation 显著影响性能，Environment Information 与 Reproduction Steps 只增加 token 而无可测收益，语言风格仅有小幅、因模型而异的效应。
summary_sections.conclusion: 基准题面的信息密度掩盖了真实请求下的能力差距；用户与 agent 应显式写出期望行为与动机（多数真实 prompt 恰恰省略这两项），这能实质提升 LLM 的软件工程表现，而堆环境信息与复现步骤没有可测回报。

papers.title: Cone Rayleigh Levels: Finite Perturbations and Certified Control
papers.abstract_en: We study the reuse of positive trial profiles under finite perturbations of nonsymmetric matrix pencils B-λG. The lower and upper cone Rayleigh levels need not coincide and are defined without requiring positive eigenvectors. In the positive orthant with positive diagonal $G$, we derive computable perturbation bounds and determine the exact worst-case trial gap over prescribed independent entrywise perturbation classes. This yields the largest uniform radius meeting a given trial-gap tolerance for fixed profiles, certifying trial-value accuracy without recomputation. Experiments on a nonnegative operator and five signed matrices compare sufficient and optimal radii, directional thresholds, and cold- and warm-start recomputation. Several signed cases exhibit severely limited uniform profile reuse despite the optimality of the radius. Exact rational checks verify the reported bounds and worst-case constructions for stored numerical inputs. A finite-budget linear program and differentiable constraints illustrate applications to verified control and learning.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 2 figures. Substantially revised and retitled. Added exact worst-case trial-gap formulas, optimal uniform perturbation radii, profile-preservation experiments, and common post-intervention profile refinement. Reproducibility package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23150973
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对非对称矩阵铅笔 B-λG 的正试验剖面复用问题，定义无需正特征向量的上下 cone Rayleigh levels，并在正对角 G 的正象限内推导可计算扰动界与给定逐项扰动类下的精确最坏 trial gap，从而给出满足给定 trial-gap 容差的最大统一半径，无需重算即可认证试验值精度。在非负算子与五个带符号矩阵上，若干带符号算例的剖面复用被严重限制，即便半径本身是最优的。
Motivation: 正试验剖面在有限扰动下复用可避免反复重算，但上下 cone Rayleigh levels 不必相等，且缺少在给定扰动类下判定复用何时仍满足精度容差的可计算证书。
Method: 在正对角 G 的正象限内推导可计算扰动界，求解给定独立逐项扰动类下的精确最坏 trial gap，进而得到满足指定 trial-gap 容差的最大统一半径；用有理数精确校验存储数值输入上的界与最坏构造，并以有限预算线性规划与可微约束演示 verified control 与 learning 的应用。
Result: 在非负算子与五个带符号矩阵上比较充分半径与最优半径、方向性阈值以及冷启动与热启动重算；若干带符号算例在半径最优的前提下仍表现出严重受限的统一剖面复用；精确有理数校验验证了所报界与最坏构造。
Conclusion: 统一扰动半径可作为不重算即认证试验值精度的判据，但对带符号矩阵该证书可能揭示剖面复用本身不可行，需回到重算。

papers.title: DDMS: Discriminative Distillation of Multi-view Foundational Features into Single-view Models
papers.abstract_en: Foundational visual features such as DINO have played a critical role across modern computer vision, and have recently become key components in multi-view feed-forward geometry estimators. In this work, we demonstrate that by re-distilling these multi-view models---their internal knowledge of 3D geometry---into a single-view estimator, we can obtain enhanced 3D consistent foundational features. Our key idea is to construct a multi-view teacher by fusing pretrained 2D foundation features with multi-view geometric features, and refining the fused representation with a discriminative ranking objective. Through our discriminative distillation framework, we enforce the learned features to be both 3D consistent and locally distinctive, while keeping them aligned with the feature space of the original foundation model to preserve the semantic structure of the pretrained representation. Consistency and local discriminability are critical for 3D computer vision problems such as forming semantic and geometric correspondences across images. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, we perform comprehensive experiments spanning multiple angles: direct feature analysis, dense prediction transfer, and explicit 3D lifting and rendering. Across these evaluations, our method consistently produces stronger 3D-aware foundation features that improve multi-view consistency and local discriminability while preserving the semantic transferability of the original representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DDMS 把多视图前馈几何估计器内部的 3D 几识重新蒸馏回单视图估计器，得到更强的 3D 一致且局部可区分的基础特征。做法是把预训练 2D foundation 特征与多视图几何特征融合成教师，再用判别式排序目标 (discriminative ranking objective) 精炼，同时保持与原始 foundation 模型特征空间对齐。在直接特征分析、稠密预测迁移、显式 3D 提升与渲染三类评测上，该方法一致提升多视图一致性与局部可区分性，并保留原表示的语义可迁移性。
Motivation: DINO 等基础视觉特征已成为多视图前馈几何估计器的核心组件，但单视图估计器缺少跨视图几何约束，难以同时保证 3D 一致性与局部可区分性，而这两点正是跨图像语义与几何对应的关键。
Method: 构建多视图教师：将预训练 2D foundation 特征与多视图几何特征融合，再用判别式排序目标精炼融合表示；随后通过判别式蒸馏框架把该教师知识蒸馏进单视图估计器，约束学到的特征既 3D 一致又局部可区分，同时与原始 foundation 模型的特征空间对齐以保留预训练语义结构。
Result: 在直接特征分析、稠密预测迁移、显式 3D 提升与渲染三类评测上，方法一致产出更强的 3D-aware foundation 特征，提升多视图一致性与局部可区分性，并保留原表示的语义可迁移性。
Conclusion: 把多视图模型内部的 3D 几何知识重新蒸馏到单视图估计器，可以在不牺牲语义可迁移性的前提下同时改善 3D 一致性与局部可区分性，从而强化跨图像的语义与几何对应。
Relevance: 0
