papers.title: Hidden in the Request: Explaining Unethical LLM Compliance through Token Relevance
papers.abstract_en: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) are aligned to optimize for both helpfulness and harmlessness, these dual objectives may conflict, inevitably leading to alignment failures. This work systematically investigates instances where LLMs fail to exhibit ethical behavior. To understand the underlying mechanics of these vulnerabilities, we introduce a probing methodology that presents unethical scenarios to LLMs in three distinct structural modalities: objective classification tasks, subjective first-person statements, and direct requests for assistance. We find that model performance degrades in the request-for-assistance-based form. Using Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP), we trace this discrepancy to an attribution bias: the model places greater emphasis on benign task-framing tokens (e.g., "Can you help me...") than on tokens signaling the underlying unethical behavior (e.g., "without getting caught"), which we term cue-tokens. We hypothesize that this under-attribution contributes to harmful compliance. To test this, we introduce two LRP-guided decoding methods that steer generation toward trajectories more relevant to cue tokens. Empirical evaluations show that these interventions promote safer responses, supporting cue-token attribution's role in compliance failures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文用逐层相关性传播 (LRP) 追踪 LLM 在「请求协助」式提示下违规服从的机制，发现模型把更多归因权重放在「Can you help me...」这类良性任务框架 token 上，而低估标示不道德行为的 cue-tokens（如「without getting caught」）。据此设计两种 LRP 引导的解码干预，把生成拉向与 cue-tokens 更相关的轨迹，实测得到更安全的回应。
Motivation: helpfulness 与 harmlessless 双目标冲突会造成对齐失效，但同一不道德内容换一种提问结构就更容易被服从，其内部归因机制此前不清楚。
Method: 把同一不道德场景改写成三种结构模态（客观分类任务、主观第一人称陈述、直接请求协助）探测模型；用 LRP 对输入 token 做归因，比较良性框架 token 与 cue-tokens 的权重；再提出两种 LRP 引导的解码方法，使生成偏向 cue-tokens 相关轨迹。
Result: 请求协助式表述下模型表现下降；LRP 显示模型对良性框架 token 归因高于 cue-tokens，形成归因偏差 (attribution bias)；两种 LRP 引导解码干预的实证评估产生更安全的回应。
Conclusion: 对 cue-tokens 的归因不足是 LLM 违规服从的关键成因，用 LRP 归因去引导解码即可把生成推向更安全方向。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Science Done on a Machine by a Machine: AI Agents in Computational Chemistry
papers.abstract_en: We are witnessing an explosion of agentic systems for computational chemistry: from four in 2024 to seventeen in 2025 and over sixty now, surveyed here. What is delegated to these systems is shifting from single calculations to whole in silico experiments and even manuscript writing. The ultimate destination is a fully autonomous AI scientist, where the entirety of computational chemistry is performed on a machine by a machine, without human supervision. Our survey shows that these systems are turning into vetted chemistry skills on general-purpose coding agents, and that they must be evaluated not only on their final answers but also on whether their calculations actually support these answers. The role of the human computational chemist is shifting from performing calculations to directing and supervising them, and the field should invest in the judgement that makes the supervision reliable: we propose a reporting standard, an evaluation reproducing published studies, a controlled comparison with general-purpose coding agents, and how to teach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 综述计算化学领域 agentic 系统的爆发式增长：系统数量从 2024 年 4 个增至 2025 年 17 个、现已超过 60 个，委派内容从单次计算扩展到完整 in silico 实验乃至论文撰写。作者主张这类系统正变成通用编程智能体上的可复用化学技能，评价必须同时看最终答案和计算过程是否真正支撑答案，并提出报告标准、复现已发表研究的评测、与通用编程智能体的受控对比以及教学方案。
Motivation: 计算化学 agentic 系统数量激增且委派粒度不断扩大，但现有评价只看最终答案，无法判断计算是否真的支撑结论，人类化学家的角色也正从执行计算转向监督计算。
Method: 综述 2024 年至今的计算化学 agentic 系统（4 → 17 → 60+），归纳其向通用编程智能体上的化学技能演化；提出四项配套方案：报告标准、复现已发表研究的评测、与通用编程智能体的受控对比、以及如何教学。
Result: 系统数量从 2024 年 4 个增至 2025 年 17 个、现已超过 60 个；委派范围从单次计算扩展到完整 in silico 实验与论文写作；综述发现这些系统正转化为通用编程智能体上经过验证的化学技能。
Conclusion: 完全自主的 AI scientist 是终点，但可靠性取决于评价计算过程而非仅看答案；人类化学家的职责转向指导与监督，领域应投资于使监督可靠的判断力及其教学。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Acknowledgment Point Is the System: Durable Policy-Decision Receipts for AI Audit Evidence
papers.abstract_en: An AI audit record is useful only if its durability and trust boundary are explicit. Returning a guarded decision before any durable write minimizes latency, but it cannot guarantee that evidence survives an immediate crash. We rebuild RuntimeGuard-AI around this constraint. The resulting research prototype binds each deterministic policy decision to the exact policy source, commits a privacy-minimizing record at a caller-selected synchronization boundary, and returns an Ed25519-signed receipt that states whether that boundary completed. After restart, the engine validates framed records, manifests, shard placement, sequence continuity, and replay identity. A separate attestation path groups committed records into chained, signed Merkle epochs that an auditor verifies with an externally obtained key. On an Apple M4 Pro at four worker threads and 2,048-byte prompts, buffered signed evidence reaches 27,193 requests/s with 141.9 microseconds median latency. Per-record data and full synchronization reduce throughput to approximately 242 requests/s and raise median latency to 16.0 ms. Sealing a 100,000-record signed epoch takes 97.0 ms. The result is a measured durability-latency trade-off, not a "free" asynchronous audit path. The prototype does not prove model execution, prevent a compromised signer from forking history, or establish legal conformity.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Code and release artifacts: https://github.com/neerazz/RuntimeGuard-AI/releases/tag/v2.0.0
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RuntimeGuard-AI 把每条确定性策略决策绑定到策略源，在调用者选定的同步边界提交隐私最小化记录并返回 Ed25519 签名回执，回执明确写出该边界是否完成。实测给出耐久性-延迟权衡：缓冲签名证据 27,193 请求/s、中位延迟 141.9 微秒，而逐记录数据加完全同步降到约 242 请求/s、中位延迟 16.0 ms。
Motivation: AI 审计记录只有在耐久性与信任边界明确时才有用：先返回受保护决策再做持久写入虽降低延迟，却无法保证证据在立即崩溃后存活。
Method: 重建 RuntimeGuard-AI 原型：把每条确定性策略决策绑定到确切策略源，在调用者选定的同步边界提交隐私最小化记录，并返回声明该边界是否完成的 Ed25519 签名回执；重启后引擎校验 framed records、manifest、shard 放置、序列连续性与 replay identity，另一条 attestation 路径把已提交记录分组成链式签名 Merkle epoch，供审计者用外部获取的密钥验证。
Result: 在 Apple M4 Pro、4 worker 线程、2,048 字节 prompt 下：缓冲签名证据 27,193 请求/s、中位延迟 141.9 微秒；逐记录数据加完全同步约 242 请求/s、中位延迟 16.0 ms；封存一个 100,000 条记录的签名 epoch 耗时 97.0 ms。
Conclusion: 耐久性-延迟是实测权衡而非免费的异步审计路径；原型不证明模型执行、不能阻止被攻破的签名者分叉历史，也不构成法律合规。

papers.title: The Value of a Prompt: An LLM-Relative Kolmogorov-Complexity Approach
papers.abstract_en: In a world where valuable artifacts are increasingly created, completed, or processed by LLMs, the central economic question is not only what the LLM can produce, but what \emph{value} remains in the inputs (i.e., the prompts) we provide to it. Given a prompt, hint, critique, problem statement, or partial solution that helps an LLM produce an artifact $z$---a proof, program, design, or scientific hypothesis---how should we measure the value of that input? Intuitively, an input is valuable when it makes the target artifact easier for the model to generate: either by increasing its sampling probability, or by reducing the thinking time needed to find it. We propose a computational Levin--Kolmogorov complexity approach to this problem, by appropriately replacing the universal Turing machine in the classical definitions by the LLM itself. Concretely, we introduce an LLM-relative notion of \emph{probabilistic Levin--Kolmogorov complexity} $pKt$---treating the model's thinking as the random tape of the program, and charging logarithmically for it in Levin's manner---and define prompt value as algorithmic mutual information with respect to $pKt$. This captures the intuition above: a prompt having $b$ bits of value for an artifact $z$ makes $z$ $2^b$ times ``easier to obtain'', by multiplying the success probability by $2^b$, by dividing the required computation by $2^b$, or by any corresponding tradeoff between probability and computation. In contrast to the classical notion of algorithmic mutual information, ours is efficiently estimable. We additionally show that, under a natural reproduction experiment, a prompt value of \(b\) bits means that reproducing \(z\) without the prompt has median token cost \(2^b\) times that of reproducing it with the prompt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把经典 Levin–Kolmogorov 复杂度中的通用图灵机替换为 LLM 本身，定义 LLM 相对的概率型 Levin–Kolmogorov 复杂度 pKt（把模型思考当作程序的随机带并按 Levin 方式对数计费），再把 prompt 价值定义为相对 pKt 的算法互信息。价值为 b 比特的 prompt 使目标产物 z 的获取难度降为 1/2^b：成功概率乘 2^b、所需计算量除 2^b，或两者的对应折中；在自然复现实验下，无 prompt 复现 z 的中位 token 成本是有 prompt 的 2^b 倍。与经典算法互信息不同，该定义可高效估计。
Motivation: LLM 时代的关键经济问题从模型能产出什么，转向输入（prompt、提示、批评、问题陈述、部分解）本身还剩多少价值，而经典算法互信息基于通用图灵机、无法直接对应某个具体模型也难以估计。
Method: 提出计算型 Levin–Kolmogorov complexity 路线：以 LLM 替代经典定义中的通用图灵机，引入 pKt（模型思考作为随机带、按 Levin 方式对数计费），并把 prompt 对产物 z 的价值定义为相对 pKt 的算法互信息；另给出一个自然的复现实验来解释该量。
Result: b 比特的 prompt 价值使 z 易获取 2^b 倍——成功概率乘 2^b、计算量除 2^b，或概率与计算的对应折中；复现实验中无 prompt 复现 z 的中位 token 成本为有 prompt 的 2^b 倍；该相对算法互信息可高效估计。
Conclusion: prompt 价值可以形式化为相对具体 LLM 的算法互信息，并同时以概率、计算量和 token 成本三种方式兑现 2^b 倍的收益，且这一量是可高效估计的。

papers.title: Learn What's Left, Not What's Mastered: Saturation Aware Advantage Reweighting for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) with group-relative advantages has become the de facto standard for post-training language model reasoners. However, when optimizing multiple reward objectives, existing methods typically scalarize the reward vector with a fixed weighted sum before group-wise standardization. We show that this design leads to two fundamental problems: rollouts with distinct reward profiles can receive identical advantages, and all objectives are optimized with fixed relative weights regardless of their current level of saturation. Consequently, an objective whose rewards are already near their upper bound can retain substantial influence when its rewards still vary within rollout groups. We introduce Saturation Aware Advantage Reweighting for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization (SA-MRPO), which standardizes each reward objective independently and adaptively discounts its contribution according to a batch-level estimate of objective saturation. This changes the relative contribution of each objective according to its observed reward headroom. We further derive an exact condition under which saturation aware reweighting reverses the sign of a rollout's aggregate advantage. Across mathematical reasoning with two- and three-objective reward combinations, SA-MRPO improves the harder correctness objective over GDPO in 12 of 15 benchmark comparisons, with gains of up to $5\%$ on AIME24. On adaptive reasoning it improves accuracy on all five benchmarks, by $3.8\%$ on average and up to $9.2 \%$ on AMC23, and on coding benchmarks it improves pass rate by up to $2.3\%$, while in all settings maintaining the easier objectives near their already satisfied levels. Additional experiments characterize the accompanying reward tradeoffs and sensitivity to corrupted rewards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SA-MRPO 对多奖励 RLHF 中每个奖励目标独立做组内标准化，并按批次估计的饱和度（reward headroom）自适应折扣其权重，使已接近上界的目标不再主导梯度。在数学推理上较 GDPO 在 15 组对比中 12 组提升更难的 correctness 目标，AIME24 最多 +5%；自适应推理五个基准全部提升，平均 +3.8%、AMC23 最高 +9.2%，代码基准 pass rate 最多 +2.3%，同时保持较易目标维持在已满足水平。
Motivation: 多奖励组相对优势 RL 通常先用固定权重把奖励向量标量化再做组内标准化，导致奖励分布不同的 rollout 得到相同优势，且已接近上界的目标只要组内仍有方差就继续占据固定权重。
Method: SA-MRPO 将每个奖励目标独立标准化，并依据批次级饱和度估计自适应折扣其贡献，从而按各目标可观测的 reward headroom 调整相对权重；作者还推导出饱和度重加权翻转某条 rollout 聚合优势符号的精确条件。
Result: 数学推理（两目标与三目标奖励组合）上，SA-MRPO 在 15 组基准对比中 12 组优于 GDPO 的 correctness 目标，AIME24 提升最高 5%；自适应推理在全部五个基准上提升准确率，平均 3.8%、AMC23 最高 9.2%；代码基准 pass rate 最高提升 2.3%，各设置下较易目标维持在已满足水平；另有实验刻画奖励权衡与对 corrupted rewards 的敏感性。
Conclusion: 按饱和度而非固定权重分配多奖励优化的关注度，可以在不牺牲已满足目标的前提下系统性提升更难目标，且该重加权可给出翻转聚合优势符号的解析判据。

papers.title: Designing Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Models: A Unified Path-Space View
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training provides a direct way to align diffusion models with human preferences and task-specific rewards. However, current RL algorithms for diffusion models remain fragmented: reverse-trajectory methods rely on discretized likelihood ratios, whereas forward-matching methods train on reward-labeled noising versions of the rollout samples. This paper shows that these seemingly different losses arise from a single path-space principle. Starting from the regularized diffusion-RL objective, we use importance sampling between sampling SDEs to obtain an explicit policy-gradient estimator on trajectory space. The estimator contains the stochastic Itô integral underlying Flow-GRPO-type updates; we derive an equivalent variance-reduced value-gradient form that recovers the forward-matching structure of AWM and DiffusionNFT. This identifies the empirical gap between these method families as a variance-reduction effect rather than a difference in RL principle. The derivation yields a unified design space organized by value-gradient estimation, weight functions, and sampling choices. Within this space, we propose a multi-sample KDE value-gradient estimator that reuses rollout groups, together with scale-bounded weight families that retain stable existing recipes while excluding singular ones. Experiments on SD3.5-M and Qwen-Image models validate the variance-reduction explanation and show that the resulting recipe improves over prior diffusion-RL baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把扩散模型的 RL 后训练统一到路径空间 (path-space) 原则：从正则化 diffusion-RL 目标出发，用采样 SDE 间的重要性采样导出轨迹空间上的显式策略梯度估计，证明 Flow-GRPO 型反向轨迹更新与 AWM、DiffusionNFT 的前向匹配是同一原理的两种方差缩减形式。作者据此提出复用 rollout 组的多样本 KDE value-gradient 估计器与有界尺度权重族，在 SD3.5-M 与 Qwen-Image 上验证方差缩减解释并改进既有 diffusion-RL 基线。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型 RL 算法分裂为依赖离散似然比的反向轨迹方法与在加噪 rollout 样本上训练的前向匹配方法，两者的经验差距被误认为是 RL 原理不同，缺少统一的设计空间。
Method: 从正则化 diffusion-RL 目标出发，用采样 SDE 之间的 importance sampling 在轨迹空间导出显式 policy-gradient 估计；该估计含 Flow-GRPO 型更新背后的随机 Itô 积分，并推出等价的方差缩减 value-gradient 形式以复原 AWM 与 DiffusionNFT 的前向匹配结构。由此给出按 value-gradient 估计、权重函数、采样选择组织的设计空间，提出复用 rollout 组的多样本 KDE value-gradient 估计器与保留稳定配方、排除奇异项的 scale-bounded 权重族。
Result: 在 SD3.5-M 与 Qwen-Image 上的实验验证了方差缩减解释，所得配方相对既有 diffusion-RL 基线有改进；论文为 29 pages、9 figures、4 tables。
Conclusion: 反向轨迹与前向匹配两类扩散 RL 算法的差距本质是方差缩减效应而非 RL 原理差异，统一设计空间可直接产出更稳的训练配方。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Graph Learning for Cross-Subject, Cross-Population EEG Emotion Decoding and Model-Derived Spatial-Spectral Neural Signatures
papers.abstract_en: Cross subject emotion decoding from electroencephalography EEG requires representations that accommodate individual variability while preserving spatial spectral structure for interpretation. This study introduces EmoDiPyraTrans, a differential graph Transformer that integrates adaptive graph recurrence, differential attention, pyramid fusion and distribution regularization over sequential relative power spectral density graphs. Across SEED, FACED, MAHNOB HCI, DEAP and DREAMER, the model achieved the highest participant mean accuracy and positive class F1 among the evaluated methods, with accuracy and F1 both reaching 0.928 on SEED. On DEP EEG, positive versus neutral accuracy reached 0.802 within healthy controls and 0.704 within participants with depression, compared with 0.591 under healthy to depression transfer and 0.581 with mixed population development. Complementary SEED analyses identified distributed spatial weighting and an alpha centred spectral preference, while configurations averaging six channels retained near full performance. These findings link generalization assessment with model derived candidate signatures to support interpretable EEG emotion decoding, with code available at https://github.com/hdy6438/EmoDiPyraTrans.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出差分图 Transformer EmoDiPyraTrans，在序列化相对功率谱密度图上做自适应图递归、差分注意力、金字塔融合与分布正则，用于跨被试、跨人群 EEG 情绪解码。SEED 上 accuracy 与 F1 均达 0.928；DEP EEG 上健康组内 0.802、抑郁组内 0.704，而健康→抑郁迁移仅 0.591、混合人群开发 0.581，说明人群内解码远好于跨人群迁移。
Motivation: 跨被试 EEG 情绪解码要兼顾个体差异与空间-谱结构的可解释性，且跨人群（健康 vs 抑郁）迁移时性能大幅下滑，需要同时给出泛化评估与模型导出的神经特征。
Method: EmoDiPyraTrans 以序列化相对功率谱密度 (rPSD) 图为输入，组合自适应图递归 (adaptive graph recurrence)、差分注意力 (differential attention)、金字塔融合 (pyramid fusion) 与分布正则 (distribution regularization)；在 SEED、FACED、MAHNOB-HCI、DEAP、DREAMER 与 DEP EEG 上评估，并做通道数消融与空间/谱归因分析。
Result: 在 SEED、FACED、MAHNOB-HCI、DEAP、DREAMER 上取得被试平均 accuracy 与 positive class F1 最高，SEED 上 accuracy 与 F1 均为 0.928。DEP EEG 上 positive vs neutral：健康组内 0.802，抑郁组内 0.704，健康→抑郁迁移 0.591，混合人群开发 0.581。SEED 补充分析显示分布式空间权重与以 alpha 为中心的谱偏好，平均六个通道的配置保留接近完整的性能。
Conclusion: 跨人群迁移是 EEG 情绪解码的主要瓶颈（0.591/0.581 远低于组内 0.802/0.704），而模型导出的空间权重与 alpha 中心谱偏好可作为候选可解释神经签名，通道数可压缩到约六个。

papers.title: Constrained Graph Diffusion for Mixed Integer Optimization
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel learning-based approach to approximately solve instances of mixed-integer optimization problems. These problems are computationally challenging, as they require jointly determining discrete and continuous decisions while satisfying complex combinatorial constraints. problem-agnostic and can accommodate a broad class of mixed-integer optimization problems through suitable projection operators. We introduce Constrained Graph Diffusion (CGD), a learning-based framework that approximately solves recurring instances of such problems by learning a conditional distribution over their discrete decisions. CGD uses a graph-based diffusion model and incorporates constraint information directly into the reverse diffusion process, steering intermediate predictions toward the feasible region throughout generation. By operating on continuous relaxations of the discrete variables, CGD defines a differentiable constrained generation pathway up to terminal discrete recovery. Once the discrete decision is recovered and fixed, a numerical optimizer solves the remaining continuous problem, avoiding online combinatorial search over the binary variables while retaining numerical optimization for continuous completion. We evaluate CGD on AC-OPF with branch switching and discrete portfolio optimization, demonstrating substantial improvements in feasibility and solution quality over learning-based baselines while achieving speedups of up to $543\times$ over state-of-the-art MIP solvers on large instances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出约束图扩散 (Constrained Graph Diffusion, CGD)，用图扩散模型学习混合整数优化问题离散决策的条件分布，并把约束信息直接嵌入反向扩散过程，使中间预测始终被引向可行域。在 AC-OPF 支路投切与离散组合优化上，可行性与解质量相对学习型基线大幅提升，大规模实例相对最先进 MIP 求解器最高加速 543×。
Motivation: 混合整数优化需同时决定离散与连续决策并满足复杂组合约束，计算代价高；对反复出现的同类实例，每次从头跑 MIP 求解器代价过大。
Method: CGD 用图结构扩散模型在离散决策上学习条件分布，反向扩散中通过投影算子 (projection operators) 把约束直接注入生成过程；在离散变量的连续松弛上构造可微生成路径，离散解恢复后固定，再由数值优化器求解剩余连续问题，避免在线二进制组合搜索。框架 problem-agnostic，靠不同投影算子覆盖一大类混合整数问题。
Result: 在 AC-OPF 支路投切与离散组合优化两类任务上，CGD 相对学习型基线在可行性与解质量上均有大幅提升；在大规模实例上相对最先进 MIP 求解器取得最高 543× 加速。
Conclusion: 把约束嵌入扩散生成、只对连续部分保留数值优化，可以在反复出现的混合整数实例上以接近求解器的可行性换取数量级的在线加速。

papers.title: Posterior contraction rates in Sobolev norms and Bayesian derivative estimation for infinite-dimensional exponential families
papers.abstract_en: We study posterior contraction in positive-order Sobolev norms and Bayesian derivative estimation for infinite-dimensional exponential families. We embed the natural parameter in a Hilbert scale and model it via a Gaussian series prior expanded in the eigenbasis generating the scale. Under a two-sided link condition on the Fisher information and suitable local regularity assumptions, we show that smoothness-matching priors achieve minimax-optimal posterior contraction rates in any Hilbert scale norm up to the regularity of the ground truth. Our analysis builds on the novel approach to posterior contraction based on the Wasserstein distance recently introduced by Dolera et al. (2024, Probab. Theory Relat. Fields). It combines Laplace-type approximations for infinite-dimensional integrals associated to the posterior kernels with a mixed-geometry estimate controlling their stability under fluctuations in the data, itself resting on a tailored Poincaré inequality for posterior distributions conditioned on neighbourhoods of the truth. We apply the general theory to density estimation under the logistic parametrisation, Poisson intensity estimation under the exponential link, and mildly ill-posed linear inverse problems observed in Gaussian white noise. The resulting minimax rates yield optimal recovery of density score functions, derivatives of Poisson intensities and, in a concrete elliptic inverse problem, the unknown source function.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在无限维指数族上，把自然参数嵌入 Hilbert scale 并用其特征基上的 Gaussian series prior 建模，在 Fisher 信息双边条件与局部正则性下，光滑度匹配的先验在任意 Hilbert 范数中达到 minimax 最优后验收缩率，同时给出密度 score、Poisson 强度导数与椭圆逆问题源函数的最优导数估计。
Motivation: 无限维指数族中，后验收缩通常只在 L2 等低阶范数中建立，而密度 score、强度导数等导数型量需要正阶 Sobolev 范数下的速率与导数估计理论。
Method: 自然参数嵌入 Hilbert scale，用生成该 scale 的特征基上的 Gaussian series prior 建模；沿用 Dolera et al. (2024, PTR) 基于 Wasserstein 距离的后验收缩框架，结合无穷维积分的 Laplace 型近似、控制数据扰动稳定性的 mixed-geometry estimate，以及真值邻域条件下后验分布的定制 Poincaré 不等式。
Result: 在 Fisher 信息双边条件与局部正则性假设下，光滑度匹配先验在任意 Hilbert 范数中达到 minimax 最优后验收缩率，正则度可达真值本身；应用于 logistic 参数化的密度估计、指数链接的 Poisson 强度估计，以及 Gaussian white noise 下 mildly ill-posed 线性逆问题，所得 minimax 率给出密度 score 函数、Poisson 强度导数与具体椭圆逆问题中未知源函数的最优恢复。
Conclusion: Wasserstein 距离加 Laplace 近似的路线可把 minimax 最优后验收缩从函数本身推广到正阶 Sobolev 范数与导数型泛函，覆盖密度、点过程强度与不适定逆问题三类指数族模型。

papers.title: NxN E-valuation: Hypothesis Certification via a Conformal CRT Null
papers.abstract_en: We propose NxN E-valuation, a handy, e-value-based hypothesis-certification algorithm that lets a hypothesis be verified without building any case-specific certification procedure---such as constructing a dedicated null hypothesis---as long as a large enough dataset is available. The method is especially suited to LLM-based exploration systems, where LLMs are remarkably good at proposing hypotheses but suffer badly from hallucination; this hallucination prevents us from harvesting LLM outputs directly, and existing remedies each fall short. The most common solutions include letting the LLM verify or correct itself circular verification and held-out testing (where false hypotheses can still pass via spurious correlations), among other remedies detailed in the introduction. To resolve this, NxN E-valuation exploits the naturally existing large training set and lets different samples serve as null hypotheses for one another. This design directly realizes a conditional randomization test (CRT) that certifies each hypothesis. The approach can be a universally better replacement for at least LLM circular verification and held-out-data testing, provided the LLM's generations are hypotheses that apply to each individual sample.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NxN E-valuation 用 e-value 做假设认证：利用已有的大训练集，让不同样本互为零假设，直接实现一个条件随机化检验 (CRT)，从而无需为每个假设单独构造专用零假设。作者称该方法可普遍替代 LLM 循环自验证与留出集检验，前提是 LLM 生成的假设适用于每个单独样本。
Motivation: LLM 探索系统擅长提出假设但幻觉严重，直接采信输出不可行；循环自验证与留出集检验（伪相关仍可让错误假设通过）各有缺陷，且逐假设构造专用零假设成本高。
Method: e-value 假设认证算法：复用现成的大训练集，让样本之间互为零假设，把这一设计直接实现为条件随机化检验 (CRT) 来逐个认证假设；适用条件是 LLM 生成的假设对每个单独样本都成立。
Result: 论文给出的是方法性主张：只要有足够大的数据集，即可在不构建 case-specific 认证程序（专用零假设）的情况下验证假设，并声称至少可普遍替代 LLM 循环验证与留出数据测试。
Conclusion: 只要假设对每个样本通用且数据集够大，样本互为零假设的 e-value CRT 可以取代逐假设定制的检验流程与留出集检验。

papers.title: Which Decisions Low-Bit Quantization Breaks, and How to Predict Them
papers.abstract_en: Quantization saves memory by storing model weights with fewer bits. It can also change model decisions, such as whether to call a tool or which option to choose from a finite set. We study these decision changes in 16 language models from 8 families at 4, 3 and 2 bits, across several post-training quantization settings. Our evaluation covers tool use, safety, general knowledge and social bias, using BFCL, XSTest, MMLU, BoolQ, BBQ and synthetic tasks. The decision margin is the score difference between two possible first tokens, measured before and after quantization. Writing the margin before quantization as $m$ and the margin after quantization as $m'$, we find an approximately linear relationship across decisions: $m' \approx c m + b$. The slope $c$ is usually below one and becomes smaller as precision falls, so quantization progressively shrinks decision margins. The offset $b$ is the same for every decision of one kind. Quantization therefore does not simply add random noise, and even a strong preference at full precision can flip. Quantization also affects different kinds of decisions to different degrees. Within tool use, whether to call a tool is often more sensitive than which tool to call: on 400 BFCL tasks, three of five models lose more completed calls than correct tool selections at 3-bit round-to-nearest. Under GPTQ and GGUF far fewer whether-to-call decisions flip than under plain rounding, so there is no single 3-bit failure point. The same relationship predicts how often decisions flip. Across 1,082 combinations of models, quantization settings, bit-widths and decision types, we fit the slope, the offset and the spread around the fitted line on half of the decisions and predict the flip rate on the other half. The predicted flip rate differs from the observed flip rate by a median of 1.0 percentage point, while reusing the flip rate of the first half misses by 1.3.
papers.comment: 37 pages, 9 figures, 12 tables. Preprint, under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 8 个家族 16 个语言模型在 4/3/2 bit 后训练量化下测量决策边际，发现量化后边际近似线性收缩 m'≈cm+b，斜率 c 随精度下降而变小且偏移 b 对同类决策恒定，因此量化不是随机噪声、强偏好也会翻转。用一半决策拟合 c、b 与散布即可预测另一半的翻转率，中位误差 1.0 个百分点，优于直接复用前半翻转率的 1.3。
Motivation: 低比特量化会改变模型的实际决策（是否调用工具、有限选项选择），但决策翻转是否可预测、是否只是随机噪声尚不清楚，且不同量化方法下没有统一的 3-bit 失效点。
Method: 在 BFCL、XSTest、MMLU、BoolQ、BBQ 及合成任务上，对 16 个模型 × 多种 PTQ 设置 × 4/3/2 bit 测量首个 token 决策边际（量化前后 m 与 m'），拟合 m'≈cm+b，并在一半决策上拟合斜率、偏移与散布来预测另一半翻转率。
Result: 跨 1,082 个（模型×量化设置×位宽×决策类型）组合，预测翻转率与实测中位偏差 1.0 个百分点，复用前半翻转率为 1.3；400 个 BFCL 任务上 3-bit RTN 下 5 个模型中有 3 个丢失的完成调用多于正确工具选择；GPTQ 与 GGUF 下翻转的是否调用决策远少于朴素舍入。
Conclusion: 量化对决策的作用是按决策类型系统性收缩边际而非加噪，翻转率可由线性关系预测，且不存在单一的 3-bit 失效点，取决于量化方法。

papers.title: RA-CAD: Learning Post-Execution Critique for State-Aware Text-to-CAD Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-CAD generation translates natural-language design intent into editable and executable parametric computer-aided design (CAD) codes, reducing the expertise and effort required for manual modeling. Existing methods incorporate fixed, externally supplied, prompt-induced, or separately optimized critique mechanisms to optimize the generation process, but they do not necessarily optimize how feedback is interpreted and translated into effective corrective actions throughout the generation process. To bridge this feedback-utilization gap, we present RA-CAD (ReAct Agent for CAD), a state-aware agent that interacts with the CAD environment through a Generate--Execute--Critique--Rewrite loop. At each iteration, RA-CAD executes the current code and observes its outcome. Conditioned on the design instruction, current code, and execution feedback, the agent then generates an explicit post-execution critique as an intermediate policy action. This critique either validates the current result for termination or provides revision-oriented guidance that conditions the next rewrite. CAD Code Bootstrapping (CCB) first establishes fundamental parametric CAD coding capabilities through supervised fine-tuning. Feedback-Driven Agent Optimization (FAO) subsequently applies trajectory-level Group Relative Policy Optimization to both policy-generated code and critique sequences, assigning terminal F1 and Chamfer Distance rewards to the complete interaction trajectory. This formulation makes critique an outcome-aligned, learnable policy decision rather than an unoptimized auxiliary output. Experiments on CADFusion and Text2CAD show that RA-CAD achieves state-of-the-art execution validity and geometric quality compared with existing methods and strong proprietary language models, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed state-aware text-to-CAD agent.

papers.title: ChaosProbe: A Neurochaotic Lens on Frozen Transformer Input-Embedding Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Transformer models are most often understood through what they do: their benchmark performance, generation quality, or behavior on downstream tasks. Yet frozen transformer input-embedding spaces may also be examined through their responses to a controlled deterministic probe before contextual computation or task-specific adaptation. Guided by this response-based view, we introduce ChaosProbe, a deterministic neurochaos-inspired method for constructing response-based fingerprints of frozen transformer input-embedding spaces. For each prompt-level embedding matrix, ChaosProbe applies a chaotic trajectory-based transformation and summarizes its Firing Rate and Entropy channel responses with complementary representation-level measures, producing a fixed-length signature for each model. In a bounded proof-of-concept study of $80$ neutral prompts and four pretrained models---GPT-2, DistilGPT2, BERT-base-uncased, and RoBERTa-base---Pearson correlation, Spearman correlation, and cosine similarity each recover all four same-family nearest-neighbor assignments and both expected mutual family pairs. Euclidean distance recovers three of the four assignments and one of the two mutual family pairs. Paired bootstrap resampling supports the stability of the Pearson and Spearman pairings over the observed prompt set, and signature-validity checks show that constant or collapsed responses do not dominate the reported fingerprints. These results provide a cohort-dependent proof of concept that deterministic neurochaotic response signatures can expose broad structure among frozen transformer input-embedding spaces.
papers.comment: 11 pages; updated Ref. [18] to cite the final IEEE Access publication; no changes to the results or conclusions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChaosProbe 用确定性混沌轨迹扰动冻结的 Transformer 输入嵌入矩阵，把 Firing Rate 与 Entropy 通道响应汇总成每个模型的定长指纹。在 80 条中性提示、GPT-2/DiltilGPT2/BERT-base-uncased/RoBERTa-base 四模型上，Pearson、Spearman 与余弦相似度各自找回全部 4 组同族最近邻和 2 对互为家族的配对，欧氏距离只找回 3/4 与 1/2。
Motivation: 冻结输入嵌入空间通常只能靠下游任务或生成质量间接判断，缺少在上下文计算与任务适配之前直接读取其结构的受控探针。
Method: 对每条 prompt 级嵌入矩阵施加混沌轨迹变换 (chaotic trajectory-based transformation)，汇总 Firing Rate 与 Entropy 两个通道响应并补充表示级度量，得到定长签名；用 Pearson、Spearman、欧氏距离与余弦相似度做最近邻家族判定，并以 paired bootstrap 重采样检验配对稳定性、做签名有效性检查排除常数或塌缩响应。
Result: 在 80 条中性提示与 GPT-2、DistilGPT2、BERT-base-uncased、RoBERTa-base 四个预训练模型上，Pearson、Spearman、cosine similarity 各自恢复全部 4 个同族最近邻指派和 2 对预期互为家族的配对；Euclidean distance 恢复 4 个中的 3 个指派和 2 对中的 1 对。paired bootstrap 支持 Pearson 与 Spearman 配对在该提示集上的稳定性，签名有效性检查显示常数或塌缩响应未主导所报指纹。
Conclusion: 确定性 neurochaotic 响应签名能在该模型队列上暴露冻结输入嵌入空间的粗粒度家族结构，属 cohort-dependent 的概念验证。

papers.title: ST-LoRA: Single Trajectory LoRA Ensemble for Uncertainty Aware Agricultural Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable decision support in digital agriculture requires not only accurate predictions but also well-calibrated uncertainty estimates, particularly for dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation. Ensembles provide strong uncertainty quantification but are computationally and memory demanding, while single-model approximations often sacrifice uncertainty quality. We propose ST-LoRA, a parameter-efficient ensemble that builds diverse members from a single training trajectory by combining Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) with snapshot ensembling. All members share a frozen pretrained backbone and differ only in lightweight low-rank adapters, which sharply reduces trainable parameters, checkpoint storage, and I/O overhead. We evaluate SegFormer, Mask2Former, and EoMT on GrowliFlower-L (cauliflower, open field) and BUP20 (sweet pepper, glasshouse), covering in-distribution performance, calibration under covariate shift, and near- and far-out-of-distribution (OoD) detection, with BUTom21 (tomato) as near-OoD data. Extensive ablations show that feed-forward layers, not attention projections, are the critical LoRA target for dense prediction, and that the scaling ratio $α/r$ governs an accuracy--calibration trade-off. Against full-rank snapshot ensembles, ST-LoRA is competitive in segmentation quality, with architecture-dependent training time and energy savings. Against MC Dropout, DDU, and six post-hoc calibrators, it achieves the strongest far-OoD image-level detection and near-OoD pixel-level localization with low cross-seed variance, although full-rank ensembles remain better calibrated. These results show that LoRA-based ensembling offers a compelling efficiency--performance trade-off for agricultural vision systems.
papers.comment: Submitted to Computers and Electronics in Agriculture (Elsevier). Currently under review (first revision round)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ST-LoRA 用单条训练轨迹上的 LoRA 适配器加 snapshot ensembling 构造参数高效集成，全部成员共享冻结预训练 backbone，仅靠轻量低秩适配器产生多样性，大幅削减可训练参数、checkpoint 存储与 I/O 开销。在 GrowliFlower-L（露地花椰菜）与 BUP20（温室甜椒）语义分割上，它相对全秩 snapshot 集成在分割质量上有竞争力并带来随架构变化的训练时间与能耗节省；相对 MC Dropout、DDU 与六种事后校准器，取得最强的 far-OoD 图像级检测与 near-OoD 像素级定位且跨种子方差低，但全秩集成校准仍更好。
Motivation: 数字农业的稠密预测既要准确也要校准良好的不确定性，而全秩集成的显存与算力开销大，单模型近似又常牺牲不确定性质量。
Method: 把 LoRA 与 snapshot ensembling 结合：成员共享冻结预训练 backbone，仅以不同低秩适配器区分；在 SegFormer、Mask2Former、EoMT 上评测，覆盖分布内性能、协变量偏移下的校准，以及近/远分布外 (OoD) 检测，用 BUTom21（番茄）作 near-OoD 数据。
Result: 消融显示对稠密预测起关键作用的是 LoRA 作用于 feed-forward 层而非 attention 投影，缩放比 α/r 支配精度—校准权衡。相对全秩 snapshot 集成分割质量有竞争力，训练时间与能耗节省依架构而定；相对 MC Dropout、DDU 与六种事后校准器，far-OoD 图像级检测与 near-OoD 像素级定位最强且跨种子方差低，但全秩集成校准更好。
Conclusion: 基于 LoRA 的集成为农业视觉系统给出有吸引力的效率—性能权衡，代价是校准仍不及全秩集成。

papers.title: An Identifiability Theory of Masked Prediction: Mode Blindness and Mask Schedules
papers.abstract_en: Masked prediction learns to infer missing variables from visible context selected by a mask schedule. When does small excess risk guarantee recovery of the true joint distribution? We study this question on finite product spaces under masked-block log loss, with conditionals induced by a single joint distribution. To quantify recovery, we introduce an $\varepsilon$-identifiability modulus measuring the worst-case error among joint distributions with population excess risk at most $\varepsilon$. For data with separated modes pinned down by sufficiently large visible contexts, schedules that always retain such contexts can permit nonvanishing mode-weight errors while incurring exponentially small excess risk. An information decomposition explains why: the loss captures mode-weight mismatch only where the visible context leaves the mode uncertain. We prove two-sided bounds showing that, over a fixed range of mode weights, sensitivity to mode reweighting is governed by residual mode uncertainty averaged over the mask schedule. Assigning schedule mass to low-visibility masks that retain this uncertainty yields recovery bounds within the reweighting family. Beyond this family, positive full-mask probability characterizes uniform control of joint KL divergence by excess risk. Exact calculations and controlled gradient optimization validate these predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有限乘积空间与 masked-block log loss 下，本文提出 ε-identifiability modulus（超额风险不超过 ε 的联合分布中最坏情形误差）刻画掩码预测何时能恢复真实联合分布。结论是：若掩码调度始终保留足以钉死模式的大可见上下文，模式权重误差可不消失而超额风险却指数级小（mode blindness）；把调度质量分配给保留残余模式不确定性的低可见度掩码可得到重加权族内的恢复界，而正的全掩码概率刻画由超额风险一致控制联合 KL 散度。
Motivation: 掩码预测用掩码调度选择可见上下文，但小超额风险何时能保证恢复真实联合分布并不清楚；分离模式被大可见上下文钉死时，训练损失对模式权重失配几乎不敏感，导致看似收敛却恢复错误。
Method: 在有限乘积空间、masked-block log loss、条件由单一联合分布诱导的设定下，定义 ε-identifiability modulus；用信息分解说明损失只在可见上下文仍使模式不确定处捕捉模式权重失配，并证明双边界：固定模式权重范围内对重加权的敏感度由掩码调度平均的残余模式不确定性决定；再以精确计算与受控梯度优化验证。
Result: 始终保留大可见上下文的调度可在超额风险指数级小的同时允许非消失的模式权重误差；调度质量赋给保留残余模式不确定性的低可见度掩码，可在重加权族内给出恢复界；在该族之外，正的全掩码概率刻画超额风险对联合 KL 散度的一致控制。精确计算与受控梯度优化验证了这些预测。
Conclusion: 掩码调度决定超额风险能否控制联合分布恢复：要消除 mode blindness，需让调度保留模式不确定性（含正的全掩码概率），而非始终保留钉死模式的大上下文。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: SKILL-KD: Contrastive Skill Distillation for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Skill-based prompting has become a practical mechanism for improving LLM agents, yet existing methods often treat skills as summaries of the agent's own experience or of successful demonstrations. This creates a mismatch for weaker student agents. A failed trajectory may not reveal the missing knowledge or strategy, while a teacher trajectory may be too implicit to internalize. We propose SKILL-KD, a contrastive skill distillation framework that treats skills as an explicit distillation medium between agents of different capabilities. Given a student failure and the teacher trajectory on the same task, SKILL-KD distills their actionable discrepancy into a textual skill patch, evaluates it by re-running the student, and iteratively refines it when the student still fails. To prevent skill drift from repeated local updates, SKILL-KD maintains trace-linked edit histories and performs Drift-Aware Skill Consolidation to decide whether each patch is added, merged, or skipped. Across five agent benchmarks and two student settings, SKILL-KD consistently improves frozen student agents over fixed-model adaptation baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SKILL-KD 把技能当作不同能力 agent 之间的显式蒸馏媒介：给定学生在同一任务上的失败轨迹与教师轨迹，把两者的可操作差异蒸馏成文本 skill patch，重跑学生评估，仍失败则迭代精修；再用带轨迹链接编辑历史的 Drift-Aware Skill Consolidation 决定每个 patch 是添加、合并还是跳过，以抑制反复局部更新导致的技能漂移。在五个 agent benchmark、两种学生设置上，该框架持续提升冻结学生 agent，优于固定模型适配基线。
Motivation: 现有技能式提示多把技能写成 agent 自身经验或成功示范的总结，对能力更弱的学生不匹配：失败轨迹暴露不出缺失的知识或策略，教师轨迹又过于隐含而难以内化。
Method: 对比式技能蒸馏框架：以学生失败轨迹与教师在同一任务上的轨迹为输入，蒸馏出可操作差异并写成文本 skill patch；通过重跑学生来评估 patch，失败则迭代精修；维护 trace-linked 编辑历史，并用 Drift-Aware Skill Consolidation 对每个 patch 做添加、合并或跳过的决策，防止技能漂移。
Result: 在五个 agent benchmark 和两种学生设置上，SKILL-KD 一致地提升冻结（frozen）学生 agent，优于固定模型适配（fixed-model adaptation）基线。
Conclusion: 把技能作为显式蒸馏媒介并配合漂移感知的合并策略，可以在不改动学生权重的前提下持续改进弱 agent；技能需要经重跑验证和历史约束，而非仅从经验或成功示范中总结。

papers.title: Comparison of a Parametric Physics-Informed Neural Network and a Tensorial Reduced-Order Model for the Shallow-Water Dam-Break Problem
papers.abstract_en: We develop two parametric data-driven reduced models: a physics-informed neural network (PINN) and a non-intrusive tensorial reduced-order model (TROM), and apply both approaches to the parametrized one-dimensional shallow-water dam-break problem. Neither reduced model requires time integration: both learn a direct parameter-to-solution map from space, time, and dam-break parameters to the physical state, with the PINN providing predictions at arbitrary times and the TROM reconstructing solutions at the stored snapshot times. In addition, we demonstrate that it is essential to introduce shock-aware collocation to improve the robustness of the PINN model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对参数化一维浅水溃坝问题，提出两种免时间积分的参数化降阶模型：PINN 与非侵入式张量降阶模型 (TROM)，都直接学习从空间、时间与溃坝参数到物理状态的映射。PINN 通过 shock-aware collocation（激波感知配点）显著提升鲁棒性，可在任意时刻给出预测，而 TROM 只在存储的快照时刻重构解。
Motivation: 参数化浅水溃坝含激波间断，传统降阶模型常需时间推进且对间断鲁棒性差，需要一种直接参数到解、且能处理激波的降阶表示。
Method: 并列构建两种参数化数据驱动降阶模型：physics-informed neural network (PINN) 与非侵入式 tensorial reduced-order model (TROM)，二者均不需时间积分，直接学习 (空间, 时间, 溃坝参数) → 物理状态的映射；PINN 引入 shock-aware collocation 改进鲁棒性，TROM 基于存储快照重构。
Result: 在参数化一维浅水溃坝问题上，两种模型均实现免时间积分的直接参数到解映射；PINN 可在任意时刻预测，TROM 仅在存储快照时刻重构；引入 shock-aware collocation 对提升 PINN 鲁棒性是必要的。
Conclusion: 免时间积分的参数化降阶映射可用于含激波的浅水溃坝问题，且激波感知配点是 PINN 在该类间断问题上保持鲁棒的必要设计。

papers.title: Experimentation and Commitment under Reward Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Decision-makers in learning environments face a dilemma when their short-term optimal actions may not favor their long-term benefits the most. To understand the fundamental tradeoff behind the dilemma, we study adaptive experimentation with post-commitment reward shifts. During an experiment phase, the decision-maker may adaptively test multiple options; during a subsequent commitment phase, the decision-maker must commit to a single option, whose reward may differ from its pre-commitment reward. We propose the Reserved Arm Eliminations for Commitment (RAEC) algorithm, which reserves a predetermined portion of the experiment phase to identify the best post-shift option while using the remaining rounds to minimize short-run regret. We establish regret upper bounds for RAEC across all parameter regimes and matching minimax lower bounds, providing a tight characterization of the cost of balancing short-term performance and long-term commitment. A key implication is that deciding in advance how much of the experiment phase to reserve for the commitment decision is sufficient to achieve the best possible worst-case regret rate; adapting this amount as more data are observed does not improve the rate. We further study extensions with structural knowledge of reward shifts and with concave commitment rewards and portfolio choice. Numerical experiments confirm that our proposed algorithms achieve the regret predicted by our theory and outperform other baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究实验期后奖励发生漂移 (post-commitment reward shifts) 的在线决策：提出 RAEC 算法，把实验期预先划出固定比例专门识别漂移后最优选项，其余轮次最小化短期遗憾。理论给出全参数域上的遗憾上界与匹配的 minimax 下界，且预先固定预留比例就已达到最优最坏情形遗憾率，随数据自适应调整该比例不改善速率；数值实验中算法遗憾与理论预测一致并优于基线。
Motivation: 决策者在学习环境中短期最优动作可能不利于长期收益，需要量化在短期表现与长期承诺之间权衡的代价，而奖励在承诺后才发生漂移使这一权衡更难。
Method: 提出 Reserved Arm Eliminations for Commitment (RAEC)：实验期自适应测试多个选项，其中预定比例的轮次专门用于识别漂移后最优选项，剩余轮次最小化短期遗憾；随后承诺单一选项。对全参数域建立遗憾上界与匹配的 minimax 下界，并给出奖励漂移结构已知、承诺奖励凹函数与组合选择 (portfolio choice) 的扩展。
Result: RAEC 在所有参数域上都有遗憾上界与匹配的 minimax 下界，给出短期表现与长期承诺权衡代价的紧刻画；关键结论是预先固定预留比例即足以达到最优最坏情形遗憾率，随观测数据调整该比例不改善速率。数值实验显示所提算法的遗憾与理论预测一致，并优于其他基线。
Conclusion: 在承诺后奖励漂移的在线决策中，事先固定实验期的预留比例就足以达到最优最坏情形遗憾率，动态调整该比例没有速率上的收益。

papers.title: In-Context Time Series Classification with Random Convolutional Features
papers.abstract_en: Time series classification is central to domains such as medical signal analysis, industrial monitoring, and sensor-based activity recognition, where class information manifests as localized shapes, specific frequencies, temporal shifts, or complex cross-channel interactions. Random convolutional transforms capture these diverse patterns by converting time series into rich, fixed-dimensional feature representations that can be processed by standard tabular classifiers. While these representations are traditionally paired with simple linear models, we investigate whether a pretrained tabular foundation model can exploit them more effectively and how its performance depends on the available data and inference budget. We propose MASHT, a pipeline that combines MultiRocket and Hydra features with an in-context tabular foundation model. Our approach uses a pretrained tabular foundation model to bypass task-specific model training, requiring only feature extraction and direct inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MASHT matches state-of-the-art time series classification baselines on univariate tasks, achieving a lower average rank than HIVE-COTE 2.0. On multivariate datasets, MASHT remains highly competitive with the strongest reference methods. Controlled resource experiments show that compact feature tables retain most of the accuracy at substantially lower runtime, while TabPFN outperforms a matched linear baseline across the evaluated label budgets on univariate tasks. These results highlight practical trade-offs between predictive performance, labeled data, and inference cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MASHT 把 MultiRocket 与 Hydra 的随机卷积特征喂给预训练表格基础模型 TabPFN，跳过任务内训练，只做特征提取加直接推理。在单变量时间序列分类上其平均排名低于 HIVE-COTE 2.0，多变量上仍与最强参考方法相当；紧凑特征表在大幅降低运行时间的同时保住大部分精度，且在所评测的标签预算上优于匹配的线性基线。
Motivation: 时间序列分类中类别信息以局部形状、频率、时移和跨通道交互形式出现，传统随机卷积特征只配简单线性模型；需要判断预训练表格基础模型能否更有效地利用这些特征，以及性能如何随可用数据与推理预算变化。
Method: MASHT 流水线：用 MultiRocket 和 Hydra 提取固定维特征表，送入预训练表格基础模型 TabPFN 做 in-context 推理，绕过任务特定训练；另设受控资源实验改变特征表规模与标签预算，并与线性基线匹配对比。
Result: 单变量任务上 MASHT 平均排名低于 HIVE-COTE 2.0，达到与最先进时间序列分类基线相当的水平；多变量数据集上与最强参考方法保持高度竞争。受控资源实验显示紧凑特征表在显著更低运行时间下保留大部分精度，且在所评测的各标签预算上 TabPFN 均优于匹配的线性基线。
Conclusion: 随机卷积特征加预训练表格基础模型可以在不训练任务模型的前提下达到强分类性能，实际选择取决于预测精度、标注数据量与推理成本三者的权衡。

papers.title: The Dynamics of Discoverability: How Trajectories and Priors Shape Equation Recovery
papers.abstract_en: How the dynamical regime of the observed system affects equation discovery has mainly been investigated through comparisons across systems. However, such comparisons vary both the equations and the dynamics, confounding the effect of the regime with the difficulty of recovering the equations symbolically. We separate the two by varying the forcing of Lorenz-84, moving its fully observed post-transient trajectories through fixed-point, periodic, and chaotic regimes while preserving the equations' functional form. Within each regime, we separately vary the amount of data, the noise, and prior knowledge of which terms the equations contain. We then measure how well two complementary approaches, sparse regression over a fixed library of candidate functions (SINDy) and an evolutionary search over symbolic expression trees (PySR), recover the true equations' terms and coefficients. We find that recovery depends on whether the sampled states distinguish combinations of candidate functions: equations remain poorly recovered from fixed-point data even when the candidate set contains only the true terms. We link the effect of the dynamics on both algorithms to one object: the moment matrix of the candidate functions under the invariant measure of the regime. Small eigenvalues mark weakly distinguishable combinations of candidate functions: we show that more data, less noise, and more prior knowledge can mitigate the resulting recovery difficulties, while a zero eigenvalue makes distinct equations indistinguishable on the visited states. Hence, a more precise prior needs less informative data, with consequences for data collection, method design, and evaluation.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables (main text and appendices)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在保持 Lorenz-84 方程形式不变的前提下只改变强迫，使轨迹依次经过不动点、周期、混沌三种动力学 regime，发现方程恢复成败取决于候选函数在该 regime 不变测度下的矩矩阵 (moment matrix) 是否能区分候选函数的组合。小特征值对应弱可辨识组合，零特征值使不同方程在所访问状态上完全不可区分；不动点数据即使候选集只含真实项也恢复得很差。更多数据、更低噪声、更强先验可缓解，因此更精确的先验意味着所需数据的信息量可以更少。
Motivation: 以往研究动力 regime 对方程发现的影响靠跨系统比较，方程与动力学同时变化，把 regime 效应与符号恢复本身的难度混在一起，无法分离二者。
Method: 固定 Lorenz-84 方程的函数形式、只调强迫，让完全观测的瞬变后轨迹落在不动点、周期、混沌三种 regime；在每个 regime 内分别改变数据量、噪声水平、以及对真实含哪些项的先验知识。用两类互补方法恢复方程：固定候选函数库上的稀疏回归 SINDy，以及在符号表达式树上做进化搜索的 PySR，度量真实方程的项与系数的恢复程度，并把两者表现统一关联到候选函数在 regime 不变测度下的矩矩阵。
Result: 恢复质量取决于采样状态能否区分候选函数的组合：不动点 regime 的数据即使候选集只含真实项，方程仍恢复得很差。矩矩阵的小特征值标记弱可辨识的候选函数组合，更多数据、更低噪声、更多先验知识可缓解由此造成的恢复困难；零特征值则使不同方程在所访问状态上不可区分。
Conclusion: 动力 regime 通过矩矩阵的谱决定方程可发现性，更精确的先验能替代信息量更大的数据，这对数据采集、方法设计与评测都有直接影响。

summary_sections.method: 固定 Lorenz-84 方程的函数形式、只调强迫，让完全观测的瞬变后轨迹落在不动点、周期、混沌三种 regime；在每个 regime 内分别改变数据量、噪声水平、以及对真实含哪些项的先验知识。用两类互补方法恢复方程：固定候选函数库上的稀疏回归 SINDy，以及在符号表达式树上做进化搜索的 PySR，度量真实方程的项与系数的恢复程度，并把两者表现统一关联到候选函数在 regime 不变测度下的矩矩阵。
summary_sections.result: 恢复质量取决于采样状态能否区分候选函数的组合：不动点 regime 的数据即使候选集只含真实项，方程仍恢复得很差。矩矩阵的小特征值标记弱可辨识的候选函数组合，更多数据、更低噪声、更多先验知识可缓解由此造成的恢复困难；零特征值则使不同方程在所访问状态上不可区分。
summary_sections.conclusion: 动力 regime 通过矩矩阵的谱决定方程可发现性，更精确的先验能替代信息量更大的数据，这对数据采集、方法设计与评测都有直接影响。

papers.title: The Label Complexity of Useful Class-Conditional Prediction Sets under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Prediction sets can make deployed classifiers safer by returning several plausible labels when a single prediction is uncertain. Their value depends on classwise reliability: average coverage can meet its target while rare or difficult classes fail repeatedly. This concern is sharper after distribution shift, when calibration labels come from a source environment but reliability is needed on the target. We ask what labeled source data and unlabeled target inputs reveal about class-conditional prediction sets, and when target labels are necessary. Under unrestricted joint shift, two target laws can produce the same observable data while requiring different classwise thresholds; any label-free rule covering both must enlarge its sets on one law. We give a labeled target audit that estimates the missing quantiles with a simultaneous guarantee. Probability-scale error is invariant to increasing score transformations, and threshold recovery follows under local regularity. At fixed confidence, achieving threshold tolerance $\varepsilon$ with fixed, nonadaptive class-stratified labeled pairs has total complexity $Θ(K\varepsilon^{-2}\log K)$, or $Θ(\varepsilon^{-2}\log K)$ labels per class under equal allocation. Class imbalance creates a separate acquisition cost; for foreground class probabilities of order $1/K$, the mixed-stream label complexity is also $Θ(K\varepsilon^{-2}\log K)$ at fixed confidence. Experiments on action-recognition and image shifts show that marginal coverage can conceal severe class failures and that source classwise calibration depends on the shift. The results connect the information available at deployment to the target labels needed for useful class-conditional prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在分布偏移下研究类条件预测集 (class-conditional prediction sets) 的标签复杂度：无标签规则在无限制联合偏移下不可能同时覆盖两个可观测数据相同但类阈值不同的目标分布，必须引入目标标签审计。固定置信度下达到阈值容差 ε 的总标签复杂度为 Θ(Kε⁻²log K)，类别不均衡时混合流标签复杂度同样为 Θ(Kε⁻²log K)。
Motivation: 平均覆盖率达标时稀有或困难类仍可能反复失效，而校准标签来自源环境、可靠性却要在目标环境上成立；需要判定源数据与无标签目标输入究竟能揭示多少类条件信息、何时必须采集目标标签。
Method: 给出带同时保证 (simultaneous guarantee) 的有标签目标审计来估计缺失分位数，用对单调分数变换不变的概率尺度误差 (probability-scale error) 恢复阈值，并在局部正则性条件下分析固定、非自适应的类分层标注对的标签复杂度。
Result: 固定置信度下达到阈值容差 ε 的总复杂度为 Θ(Kε⁻²log K)，等分配时每类 Θ(ε⁻²log K)；前景类概率量级为 1/K 时混合流标签复杂度也是 Θ(Kε⁻²log K)。动作识别与图像偏移实验显示边际覆盖会掩盖严重的类级失效，且源类条件校准是否有效取决于偏移类型。
Conclusion: 无标签规则在无限制联合偏移下必然在其中一个目标分布上放大预测集，目标标签是获得类条件可靠性的必要代价，且类不均衡带来独立的采集成本。

papers.title: A Dual-Hypothesis Reasoning Framework for LLM Guardrails
papers.abstract_en: We propose ARBITER, a novel LLM guardrail framework that introduces two key ideas: (i) dual-hypothesis reasoning, a reasoning method for LLM guardrails that explicitly considers both safe and unsafe interpretations of a prompt before making a safety decision, and (ii) multi-component supervised fine-tuning (MC-SFT), a structured training loss for reasoning-based guardrails that decomposes LLM outputs into logical components and weights them according to their importance. Existing reasoning-based guardrails often rely on expensive procedures, such as generating reasoning traces using larger or closed-source teacher models and applying full-parameter fine-tuning. In contrast, ARBITER uses a cost-effective self-generation strategy for reasoning traces and LoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning while still achieving better performance than these expensive approaches. Additionally, ARBITER provides faithful evidence-phrase explanations for unsafe decisions, enabling a more transparent and interpretable guardrail method. Experiments on three safety moderation benchmarks show that ARBITER outperforms existing reasoning-based and non-reasoning guardrail baselines, with clear gains in out-of-domain evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARBITER 是一个 LLM 安全护栏 (guardrail) 框架，用双假设推理 (dual-hypothesis reasoning) 先分别构造 prompt 的安全与不安全解读再做判定，并用多组件监督微调 (MC-SFT) 把输出拆成逻辑成分按重要性加权。推理轨迹用自生成替代大模型/闭源教师模型，配合 LoRA 微调，在三个安全审核基准上优于推理型与非推理型护栏基线，且在域外评测上增益更明显。
Motivation: 现有推理型护栏依赖昂贵流程：用更大或闭源教师模型生成推理轨迹、做全参数微调，成本高且域外泛化不足。
Method: ARBITER 含两部分：双假设推理在给出安全判定前显式考虑 prompt 的安全与不安全两种解读；MC-SFT 是一种结构化训练损失，把 LLM 输出分解为逻辑组件并按重要性加权。推理轨迹用自生成策略获得，微调采用 LoRA 参数高效方式，并为不安全判定输出证据短语 (evidence-phrase) 解释。
Result: 在三个安全审核基准上，ARBITER 优于现有推理型与非推理型护栏基线，域外 (out-of-domain) 评测上增益明显，同时成本低于依赖教师模型与全参数微调的方案。
Conclusion: 自生成推理轨迹加 LoRA 的低成本训练路径可以超过昂贵的教师模型加全参数微调护栏，双假设推理还能给出可核查的证据短语解释。

papers.title: Cura 1T: Healthcare Foundation Model via Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Healthcare spans high-stakes communication, expert reasoning, and workflow execution, yet specialized language models that cover these use cases together remain limited. A healthcare model must handle patient consultation, clinical reasoning over text and images, interactive diagnosis, and electronic health record (EHR) tool use. These capabilities fail in different ways, and a narrow update for one task can degrade another. We present Cura 1T, a healthcare foundation model trained through recursive self-improvement (RSI). In each RSI round, the RSI harness runs the current model on healthcare benchmarks, evaluates the trajectories to locate capability gaps, and refines the training mixture by synthesizing training data. On 6 healthcare benchmarks, Cura 1T scores highest on MedAgentBench, HealthBench Professional, HealthBench Hard, MedXpertQA text, and AgentClinic, and second on MedXpertQA multimodal. It preserves performances on out-of-domain reasoning and agentic benchmarks including AIME, GPQA-Diamond, and $τ^2$-Bench.
papers.comment: Model: https://actava.ai/cura; Docs: https://actava.ai/cura/docs; Github: https://github.com/actava-ai/Cura
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Cura 1T 是一个通过递归自我改进 (RSI) 训练的医疗基础模型：每轮 RSI harness 在医疗基准上跑当前模型、评估轨迹定位能力缺口，再合成训练数据改进数据混合。在 6 个医疗基准上，它在 MedAgentBench、HealthBench Professional、HealthBench Hard、MedXpertQA text 和 AgentClinic 上得分最高，MedXpertQA multimodal 上第二，同时保持 AIME、GPQA-Diamond、τ²-Bench 等域外推理与 agentic 基准的表现。
Motivation: 医疗场景同时要求患者咨询、图文临床推理、交互式诊断和 EHR 工具使用，而覆盖这些用例的专用模型有限；针对单一任务的窄更新会损害其他任务。
Method: RSI harness 每轮在医疗基准上运行当前模型，评估生成的轨迹以定位能力缺口，然后合成训练数据来改进训练混合，循环迭代训练 Cura 1T。
Result: 在 6 个医疗基准上，Cura 1T 于 MedAgentBench、HealthBench Professional、HealthBench Hard、MedXpertQA text、AgentClinic 排名第一，MedXpertQA multimodal 排名第二；在域外推理与 agentic 基准 AIME、GPQA-Diamond、τ²-Bench 上保持原有表现。
Conclusion: 以基准轨迹驱动的数据混合迭代可以在提升多项医疗能力的同时不牺牲域外推理与 agentic 能力，缓解窄更新互相拖累的问题。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: CAS I: A Geometric Coding Theorem
papers.abstract_en: This paper establishes a direct analogue of the classical Coding Theorem in the setting of symmetry groups. We consider computable bijections on the set of binary strings and define the symmetry prior of a string x as the probability that a randomly chosen symmetry from a given group G has x as its unique fixed point. We show that for any fix-retractable symmetry group G, a group admitting a computable section that selects an isolating symmetry for every string, the symmetry prior is a universal lower semi-computable semi-measure. In this case, the Geometric Coding Theorem holds. This result is a coding-theoretic restatement of a theorem of Trejo, Kreinovich and Longpré, who showed that the complexity of describing a string by a symmetry with that string as its unique fixed point equals its Kolmogorov complexity. Our contribution is to recast it in terms of algorithmic probability and to treat the symmetry group as a parameter, identifying fix-retractability as exactly the condition under which symmetry complexity collapses onto Kolmogorov complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把经典 Coding Theorem 推广到对称群设定：对二进制串的可计算双射定义“对称先验”（symmetry prior），即随机取群 G 中一个对称时以该串为唯一不动点的概率。对 fix-retractable 群（存在可计算 section 为每串挑选隔离对称），对称先验是通用下半可计算半测度，Geometric Coding Theorem 成立；fix-retractability 恰是对称复杂度坍缩到 Kolmogorov 复杂度的条件。
Motivation: Trejo、Kreinovich 与 Longpré 已证“以串为唯一不动点的对称描述该串的复杂度等于其 Kolmogorov 复杂度”，但该结果未以算法概率语言表述，也未把对称群本身当作参数刻画何时坍缩成立。
Method: 在二进制串集合上的可计算双射上定义对称先验（随机对称以 x 为唯一不动点的概率），把对称群 G 作为参数；对 fix-retractable 群（存在可计算 section 为每串选出隔离对称）证明该先验是通用下半可计算半测度，从而得到 Geometric Coding Theorem。
Result: 对任意 fix-retractable 对称群 G，对称先验是通用下半可计算半测度，Geometric Coding Theorem 成立；fix-retractability 被刻画为对称复杂度坍缩到 Kolmogorov 复杂度的充要条件。
Conclusion: 把 Trejo–Kreinovich–Longpré 定理重述为算法概率形式后，对称群的可计算 section 性质（fix-retractability）正是对称复杂度与 Kolmogorov 复杂度重合的精确判据。

papers.title: Memory as a Controlled Process: Learned Adaptive Memory Management for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory systems to accumulate experience across tasks. Yet nearly all existing approaches, from graph-structured memories to reflective insight stores, access memory through fixed, hand-designed heuristics. We argue that this static view of memory is a core bottleneck for agentic learning because optimal memory behavior is fundamentally context-dependent. The early stages of the tasks, benefit from minimal retrieval because memory is sparse; recurring goal types benefit from plan reuse rather than generic nearest-neighbor lookup; stuck agents benefit from re-retrieval with alternative queries; and across long task streams, the memory store itself must be consolidated and pruned to remain useful. We present Memory as a Controlled Process (MemCon), a framework that models memory operations as a Markov Decision Process and learns an online policy that adaptively decides when, what, and how much to retrieve, when to inject a distilled plan, and when to consolidate or forget. MemCon is backend-agnostic: it wraps any existing memory implementation, learns from task-by-task binary feedback with no pretraining and no additional LLM calls, and uses a lightweight tabular contextual bandit with UCB exploration that converges within tens of tasks. Across 6 benchmarks, 3 agent frameworks, and 3 LLM backbones, MemCon consistently outperforms multiple memory baselines by up to 15.2 points in task success while reducing token consumption by 5--20%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemCon 把 LLM agent 的外部记忆操作建模为 MDP，用轻量表格型 contextual bandit + UCB 在线学习何时检索、检索什么/多少、何时注入蒸馏计划、何时合并或遗忘。跨 6 个 benchmark、3 个 agent 框架、3 个 LLM backbone，任务成功率最多比多个记忆基线高 15.2 点，同时 token 消耗降 5–20%。
Motivation: 现有记忆机制（图结构记忆、反思式 insight 库）都靠固定手工启发式访问记忆，而最优记忆行为本质上依赖上下文：任务早期记忆稀疏应少检索、重复目标类型应复用计划、卡住时应换查询重检索、长任务流需要合并与剪枝。静态记忆视图是 agentic learning 的核心瓶颈。
Method: MemCon 框架将记忆操作建模为 Markov Decision Process，学习在线策略决定检索时机/内容/数量、何时注入 distilled plan、何时 consolidate 或 forget；backend-agnostic，可包裹任意已有记忆实现；用任务级二值反馈学习，无预训练、无额外 LLM 调用，采用轻量表格型 contextual bandit 配 UCB 探索。

papers.title: Can a Language Model Learn Facts Continually in Its Weights?
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning is a long-standing capability gap between LLMs and humans. Writing new knowledge into a model's weights routinely causes it to forget old knowledge, commonly denoted as "catastrophic forgetting". Various modifications of supervised fine-tuning and distillation aim to mitigate catastrophic forgetting, but quantifying what (or how much) information was forgotten is often difficult. In this paper, we study whether current methods of writing knowledge into weights enable models to learn continually without forgetting. We introduce a framework for studying continual learning in the iterative regime, writing invented facts one at a time into a Qwen3 model already modified by previous writes, and varying the training data, method, and parameter update. Across SFT and off- and on-policy distillation, using LoRA or full fine-tuning, we compare repeated statement training (the same fact repeated in two formats) with varied example training (24 factual restatements) and find that varied examples comprehensively support more flexible use. After twenty sequential writes and merges, the model answers only 1% of questions about earlier facts correctly when every write uses repeated statements, compared with 46% when every write uses varied examples. We additionally show that this retention depends on the data used for the later writes, regardless of training method or parameter update, and that behavioral forgetting of an earlier fact does not erase its presence from the log-probabilities. Together, our framework neatly provides a comparison of performance across training data, training regimes, and parameter update schemes in an iterative learning task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在把虚构事实逐条写入 Qwen3 权重的迭代式持续学习框架中，同一事实用 24 种改写（varied examples）比在两种格式里重复同一句（repeated statement）更能保住旧知识：连续 20 次写入并合并后，重复陈述组对早期事实的正确率仅 1%，改写组为 46%。保留率取决于后续写入所用数据，与训练方法（SFT、off-policy/on-policy 蒸馏）和参数更新方式（LoRA、全量微调）无关；行为上遗忘的事实仍留在 log-probabilities 中。
Motivation: 把新知识写进权重会灾难性遗忘，而已有 SFT 与蒸馏改进方法难以量化到底忘掉了多少信息，缺少可跨训练数据、训练范式、参数更新方案比较的评测框架。
Method: 提出迭代式持续学习框架：向已被前次写入修改过的 Qwen3 逐条写入虚构事实，系统改变训练数据、方法与参数更新；对比 repeated statement（同一事实两种格式重复）与 varied example（24 种事实复述），覆盖 SFT、off-policy 与 on-policy 蒸馏，以及 LoRA 与全量微调。
Result: 20 次顺序写入并合并后，全部使用重复陈述时模型对早期事实的问题正确率仅 1%，全部使用改写样本时为 46%。保留效果取决于后续写入的数据，与训练方法和参数更新方案无关；行为层面遗忘的早期事实仍可从 log-probabilities 中检出。
Conclusion: 持续写入知识能否不遗忘主要由写入数据的多样性决定，而非微调算法或 LoRA/全量更新的选择；行为遗忘不等于知识从权重中消失。

papers.title: Authority-Bound Governance of Heterogeneous AI Security Decisions in Telecom and IoT Networks
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled security decision systems in telecom and IoT networks can draw on heterogeneous models whose outputs may trigger operational actions. Recording such decisions on a blockchain does not establish that they are authorised, applicable, policy-consistent, or still valid at execution time. This paper presents governance-2, an authority-bound and fail-closed architecture that separates upstream scientific decision formation from downstream operational enforcement. Each governed case is bound to registered dataset, model, policy, deployment, and optional refiner authorities. Smart-contract checks enforce role separation, authority compatibility, score-to-state and state-to-action consistency, lifecycle validity, replay protection, pause control, authority revocation, and exact-action execution. Evaluation uses two independent branches: a controlled spectrum-access replay with four frozen heterogeneous decision configurations and a measured radio-frequency branch based on WiFiSpectralJam. Across eight frozen measured-data decision streams, governance-2 processes 153,744 stream-case instances derived from 19,218 measured captures while preserving interference-specific semantics and unresolved review states. The full contract rejects all tested invalid operations; stateful invariant testing completes 2,000 generated transaction sequences with zero invariant violations; and single-capability ablation shows that removing an enforcement family exposes its assigned invalid operations while unrelated protections remain active. The results indicate that heterogeneous AI security decisions can share a common governance plane across telecom and IoT settings without redefining their scientific semantics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 governance-2：把电信与 IoT 中异构 AI 安全决策的科学形成与运行执行分离，用绑定注册数据集、模型、策略、部署与可选 refiner 权限的智能合约做 fail-closed 治理。在 8 条冻结实测决策流上处理 153,744 个 stream-case 实例（源自 19,218 次实测捕获），拒绝全部测试的非法操作，2,000 条生成事务序列零不变量违例。
Motivation: 把 AI 安全决策上链只记录了动作，并不能证明该动作被授权、适用、符合策略、执行时仍然有效；电信与 IoT 的异构模型输出会直接触发运行操作，缺少统一治理面。
Method: governance-2 架构分离上游科学决策形成与下游运行执行；每个受治理 case 绑定注册的 dataset、model、policy、deployment 及可选 refiner 权限，智能合约强制角色分离、权限兼容、score-to-state 与 state-to-action 一致性、生命周期有效性、重放保护、暂停控制、权限吊销与精确动作执行。评测分两支：受控频谱接入 replay（4 个冻结异构决策配置）与基于 WiFiSpectralJam 的实测射频支路。
Result: 8 条冻结实测数据决策流共 153,744 个 stream-case 实例，来自 19,218 次实测捕获，保留干扰特有语义与未决审查状态；完整合约拒绝全部测试的非法操作；有状态不变量测试完成 2,000 条生成事务序列且零不变量违例；单能力消融显示移除某执行族会暴露其对应的非法操作，而无关保护仍生效。
Conclusion: 异构 AI 安全决策可以在电信与 IoT 场景共享一个公共治理面，而不必重定义各自的科学语义；各执行族的保护作用可由消融单独验证。

papers.title: NFTR: From Provable Mode-Averaging to Geodesic Subgoal Selection in Offline Goal-Conditioned RL
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical Implicit Q-Learning (HIQL), an offline goal-conditioned RL method, selects subgoals by value-function advantages alone. This rule has two coupled failure modes. Optimistic bias treats lucky stochastic outcomes as skillful choices, and mode collapse reduces a multi-modal subgoal distribution to a single Gaussian mean that often falls in unreachable regions. We propose NFTR (Normalizing Flow subgoal policies with Triangle-slack Reweighting). A conditional Normalizing Flow replaces the Gaussian policy. A closed-form mode-averaging result identifies the Gaussian limitation, while conditional flows support multi-modal weighted maximum likelihood and direct sampling. A triangle slack score, computed from a jointly trained MRN distance head whose triangle inequality is guaranteed architecturally, corrects the AWR weight multiplicatively and measures a detour inside the learned geometry without requiring exact distance recovery. Triangle-slack vanishes on geodesics in deterministic MDPs and remains a conservative upper bound on composability violation under stochastic dynamics. The RWDR objective preserves AWR's population-level monotonic improvement and admits a three-term suboptimality decomposition. On OGBench the flow carries the larger share of the gain, while the full co-trained configuration adds task-dependent gains. The combined method avoids Gaussian mode averaging and performs well on stochastic tasks. GitHub page: https://github.com/erdemtbao/NFTR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NFTR 用条件 Normalizing Flow 替换 HIQL 的高斯子目标策略，并用架构上保证三角不等式的 MRN 距离头计算 triangle-slack 分数，乘性修正 AWR 权重。在 OGBench 上 flow 贡献主要增益，完整共训练配置带来随任务变化的额外提升，在随机任务上表现良好。
Motivation: 离线目标条件 RL 中 HIQL 仅凭价值函数优势选子目标，同时存在乐观偏差（把运气好当成能力强）与模式坍缩（多峰子目标分布被压成常落在不可达区域的单高斯均值）两个耦合失效。
Method: 条件 Normalizing Flow 取代高斯策略，支持多峰加权最大似然与直接采样；闭式 mode-averaging 结果刻画高斯的局限。联合训练的 MRN 距离头在架构上保证三角不等式，其 triangle-slack 分数乘性修正 AWR 权重，度量学习几何内的绕路。RWDR 目标保持 AWR 的总体单调改进并给出三项次优性分解。
Result: 在 OGBench 上，flow 贡献增益中较大的份额，完整共训练配置带来随任务而异的额外增益；方法在随机任务上表现良好。triangle-slack 在确定性 MDP 的测地线上为零，在随机动力学下仍是 composability 违反的保守上界。
Conclusion: 避开高斯 mode averaging、并用几何上受约束的距离头做绕路惩罚，可以在离线目标条件 RL 中同时缓解乐观偏差与模式坍缩，且保留 AWR 的单调改进保证。

papers.title: The Harness Effect: How Orchestration Design Sets the Token Economics of Enterprise Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI development today runs on token maxing: buying capability with tokens -- longer reasoning traces, more turns, wider tool payloads, bigger replayed contexts -- so tokens per task grow faster than task value. Falling per-token prices mask the pattern; total spend rises anyway. We argue the decisive lever against token maxing is the harness: the orchestration layer that assembles context, exposes tools, sequences turns, delegates work, and carries enterprise observability and governance. We isolate it with a controlled swap: 22 locked evaluation tasks, six foundation models (Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1, Gemini Flash 3.5, Qwen 3.6, GLM 5.1, Palmyra X6), changing only the orchestration layer -- a frozen conventional production loop versus the Writer Agent Harness. Holding models constant, the harness cuts blended cost per task 41% ($0.21->$0.12), median wall-clock 44% (48s->27s), and tokens per task 38% (14.2k->8.8k), with task-completion quality at parity (0.78->0.81, directional at this sample size). Efficiency is model-invariant -- every model gets cheaper (33-61%) -- while quality gains are capability-dependent: a model's gain correlates almost perfectly with its baseline strength (r=0.99, n=6), a phenomenon we term harness leverage. Quality per dollar rises 82%; task-completions per million tokens rise from 54.9 to 92.0. On this workload the orchestration layer moved cost per task more than the full spread of the model menu did. We formalize token economics at the orchestration layer (including effective input price under prompt caching), detail the six mechanism families behind the effect -- cache-shape discipline to failure-spend governance -- compare six widely used agent systems on the same axes, and argue the harness is the one component whose efficiency multiplies across every model an organization runs -- present and future.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出企业级 Agentic AI 的 token 经济学由编排层（harness）而非模型决定：在 22 个锁定评测任务上只替换编排层（冻结的传统生产循环 vs Writer Agent Harness），六个基座模型的每任务混合成本降 41%（$0.21→$0.12）、中位耗时降 44%（48s→27s）、每任务 token 降 38%（14.2k→8.8k），任务完成质量持平（0.78→0.81）。
Motivation: 当前 Agentic AI 开发靠 token maxing 买能力（更长推理轨迹、更多轮次、更宽工具载荷、更大重放上下文），每任务 token 增速超过任务价值增速；单价下降掩盖了总支出仍在上涨。
Method: 受控替换实验：22 个锁定评测任务 × 6 个基座模型（Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.1、Gemini Flash 3.5、Qwen 3.6、GLM 5.1、Palmyra X6），只改编排层——冻结的传统生产循环对比 Writer Agent Harness；并形式化编排层的 token 经济学（含 prompt caching 下的有效输入价格），归纳六族机制（从 cache-shape 纪律到 failure-spend 治理），在同一坐标轴上比较六个常用 agent 系统。
Result: 固定模型时：每任务混合成本 $0.21→$0.12（降 41%），中位 wall-clock 48s→27s（降 44%），每任务 token 14.2k→8.8k（降 38%），任务完成质量 0.78→0.81（该样本量下仅为方向性）。效率与模型无关，每个模型都变便宜（33–61%）；质量增益依赖能力，增益与模型基线强度几乎完全相关（r=0.99, n=6），作者称为 harness leverage。每美元质量升 82%，每百万 token 的任务完成数从 54.9 升到 92.0；在该工作负载上编排层对每任务成本的影响超过整个模型菜单的价格跨度。
Conclusion: 编排层是唯一能让效率在组织现有与未来所有模型上相乘的组件，应把优化重点从换模型转向 harness 设计；质量增益只在强基线模型上兑现。

summary_sections.motivation: 当前 Agentic AI 开发靠 token maxing 买能力（更长推理轨迹、更多轮次、更宽工具载荷、更大重放上下文），每任务 token 增速超过任务价值增速；单价下降掩盖了总支出仍在上涨。
summary_sections.method: 受控替换实验：22 个锁定评测任务 × 6 个基座模型（Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.1、Gemini Flash 3.5、Qwen 3.6、GLM 5.1、Palmyra X6），只改编排层——冻结的传统生产循环对比 Writer Agent Harness；并形式化编排层的 token 经济学（含 prompt caching 下的有效输入价格），归纳六族机制（从 cache-shape 纪律到 failure-spend 治理），在同一坐标轴上比较六个常用 agent 系统。
summary_sections.result: 固定模型时：每任务混合成本 $0.21→$0.12（降 41%），中位 wall-clock 48s→27s（降 44%），每任务 token 14.2k→8.8k（降 38%），任务完成质量 0.78→0.81（该样本量下仅为方向性）。效率与模型无关，每个模型都变便宜（33–61%）；质量增益依赖能力，增益与模型基线强度几乎完全相关（r=0.99, n=6），作者称为 harness leverage。每美元质量升 82%，每百万 token 的任务完成数从 54.9 升到 92.0；在该工作负载上编排层对每任务成本的影响超过整个模型菜单的价格跨度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 编排层是唯一能让效率在组织现有与未来所有模型上相乘的组件，应把优化重点从换模型转向 harness 设计；质量增益只在强基线模型上兑现。

papers.title: Geometric Self-Distillation for Reasoning Generalization
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation provides dense teacher supervision on a language model's own trajectories. In self-distillation with privileged context, this supervision comes from the model itself, conditioned on a hint or solution trace hidden from the student. When the teacher's preferences hinge on privileged information, it can assign higher probability to continuations the student cannot infer from its own context. Matching these preferences throughout training can induce predictive drift and degrade out-of-distribution (OOD) reasoning. We propose GeoSD, a self-distillation method that controls this drift through two complementary geometric terms. A Hellinger loss weights each teacher preference by the student--teacher overlap, reducing the influence of tokens to which the student assigns low probability. Because these influences can still accumulate, a Fisher--Rao penalty regulates predictive distance from a copy of the student refreshed periodically during training. Both terms compare next-token distributions in Fisher--Rao geometry and are jointly optimized with a preconditioner motivated by the natural gradient. Across three model families, GeoSD retains strong in-distribution gains while improving average mathematical OOD accuracy by 5.7--8.6 points over the base model. OOD gains hold across five model scales from 1.7B to 32B and transfer to code generation, where GeoSD improves code accuracy by 1.9 points on average despite distilling on mathematics alone. Our analysis of mathematical reasoning shows that standard matching rapidly concentrates probability mass at high-entropy states and that its samples confidently agree on incorrect answers. In contrast, GeoSD preserves alternative token mass and reduces false consensus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoSD 是带特权上下文的自蒸馏方法，用 Hellinger 损失按师生重叠给教师权重降权、再用 Fisher–Rao 惩罚约束预测分布与周期刷新的学生副本的距离，两项都在 Fisher–Rao 几何下与自然梯度预条件器联合优化。在三个模型家族、1.7B 到 32B 五个规模上，数学 OOD 平均准确率较基座模型提高 5.7–8.6 点，仅在数学上蒸馏仍使代码生成平均提高 1.9 点。
Motivation: 自蒸馏中教师权重依赖学生看不到的特权信息（hint 或解题轨迹），学生无法从自身上下文推出的续写也会被赋予高概率；全程匹配这些偏好会引发 predictive drift，损害分布外 (OOD) 推理。
Method: GeoSD 用两个几何项控制漂移：Hellinger 损失按学生–教师分布重叠给每个教师权重加权，压低学生低概率 token 的影响；Fisher–Rao 惩罚约束预测分布与训练中周期刷新的学生副本的距离。两项都在 Fisher–Rao 几何下比较 next-token 分布，并用受 natural gradient 启发的 preconditioner 联合优化。
Result: 跨三个模型家族，GeoSD 在保留分布内增益的同时，数学 OOD 平均准确率较基座模型提高 5.7–8.6 点；该 OOD 增益在 1.7B 到 32B 五个模型规模上成立，并迁移到代码生成——仅在数学上蒸馏仍使代码准确率平均提高 1.9 点。分析显示标准匹配会在高熵状态快速集中概率质量、其样本对错误答案高度一致，GeoSD 则保留替代 token 质量并减少 false consensus。
Conclusion: 带特权上下文的自蒸馏必须限制教师权重对低概率 token 的累积影响并约束预测漂移，否则 OOD 推理会退化；几何加权加距离惩罚能在不牺牲分布内增益的前提下保住 OOD 推理。

papers.title: GEM-Occ: From Visual Geometry Evidence to Embodied Semantic Occupancy Memory
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents exploring indoor environments require reliable semantic occupancy memory that persists across observations and revisits. Building such memory is challenging because each observation provides incomplete and uncertain geometric and semantic evidence. We introduce GEM-Occ, a Gaussian Evidence Memory framework that consolidates evidence accumulated over time into persistent semantic occupancy memory. Local predictions are converted into occupied semantic Gaussians and free-space ray evidence. Confidence- and visibility-aware causal updates integrate supporting observations, suppress occupancy contradicted by observed free space, and preserve previously observed structures through occlusion. A hierarchical memory organization supports continued mapping and efficient queries across connected indoor spaces. To evaluate this capability, we introduce HIOcc, a unified benchmark for embodied semantic occupancy memory. HIOcc establishes a shared semantic label space and evaluation framework spanning local prediction, room-level online mapping, and building-level mapping, while accommodating perspective and panoramic observations. Experiments on HIOcc demonstrate that GEM-Occ outperforms existing methods, enabling accurate semantic occupancy prediction and consistent online mapping across spatial scales with efficient memory usage and fast occupancy queries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GEM-Occ 把具身智能体的局部预测转成占据语义高斯与自由空间射线证据，用置信度与可见性感知的因果更新把跨时间、跨重访的观测整合为持久语义占据记忆：支持性观测被合并、被观测自由空间否定的占据被抑制、被遮挡的既有结构被保留。作者同时提出 HIOcc 基准，实验显示其在局部预测、房间级在线建图到建筑级建图上优于现有方法，并保持高效内存与快速查询。
Motivation: 具身智能体在室内探索时需要跨观测与重访持续存在的语义占据记忆，但每次观测只提供不完整且不确定的几何与语义证据，跨尺度的持久记忆难以构建。
Method: GEM-Occ（Gaussian Evidence Memory）将局部预测转换为占据语义高斯与自由空间射线证据，用置信度与可见性感知的因果更新整合证据、抑制被自由空间否定的占据、经遮挡保留既有结构，并以分层记忆组织支持连通室内空间的持续建图与高效查询；评测用新提出的 HIOcc 基准，统一语义标签空间与评测框架，覆盖局部预测、房间级在线建图、建筑级建图，并兼容透视与全景观测。
Result: 在 HIOcc 上的实验中 GEM-Occ 优于现有方法，在跨空间尺度上实现准确的语义占据预测与一致的在线建图，同时内存使用高效、占据查询快速。
Conclusion: 把几何与语义证据以高斯形式因果累积并分层组织，可以在室内多尺度上得到既准确又省内存、查询快的持久语义占据记忆。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Optimal Stabilizer Testing and Learning with Limited Quantum Memory
papers.abstract_en: We study stabilizer state testing and learning with limited coherent quantum memory. Here an algorithm sequentially receives copies of an unknown $n$-qubit state, but may keep only $k$ qubits of coherent quantum memory between measurements. With unrestricted memory, seminal work of Gross, Nezami and Walter showed how to test $n$-qubit stabilizer states using $6$ copies, which is dimension independent, unlike the learning complexity of $Θ(n)$. We show that this testing-vs-learning separation is lost under memory constraints. More concretely we show that (1) The sample complexity of testing stabilizer states in the $k$-qubit memory framework is $Θ(n-k)$. Our upper bound goes via a novel connection to the hidden shift problem and the lower bound is proven using a novel approach to average case bounds on likelihood ratios via combinatorics of the stochastic orthogonal group. (2) The sample complexity of learning stabilizer states with $k$ qubits of memory, in the non-adaptive framework, is $Θ(n^2/k)$. As a further application of our techniques, we prove an exponential lower bound for purity testing even when the memory may be left coherent throughout the protocol. Our main results identify coherent quantum memory as the resource enabling the usual separation between stabilizer testing and learning. In particular, even with $k=0.99n$ qubits of memory, there is no constant-copy stabilizer tester; furthermore for $k=cn$ qubits of memory (for $0< c < 1$), stabilizer testing is as hard as learning, with both requiring $Θ(n)$ copies.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只保留 k 个相干量子存储的序贯模型下，n 比特 stabilizer 态的测试样本复杂度为 Θ(n−k)，非自适应学习为 Θ(n²/k)，即无限制存储下测试与学习的分离（6 次 vs Θ(n) 次）在存储受限时消失。即使 k=0.99n 也不存在常数次拷贝的 stabilizer 测试器；k=cn（0<c<1）时测试与学习同样困难，均需 Θ(n) 次拷贝。
Motivation: Gross、Nezami 与 Walter 的结果显示无限制相干存储下 stabilizer 态测试只需 6 次拷贝（与 n 无关），而学习需 Θ(n) 次；这一测试-学习分离在现实的有限量子存储条件下是否成立此前未知。
Method: 在仅保留 k 个相干量子比特存储的序贯测量框架下分析样本复杂度：上界通过与 hidden shift problem 的新联系构造，下界用基于 stochastic orthogonal group 组合结构的似然比 average-case 界新方法证明；并把技术推广到纯度 (purity) 测试的下界。
Result: stabilizer 测试样本复杂度 Θ(n−k)；非自适应学习样本复杂度 Θ(n²/k)；purity testing 即使允许全程保持存储相干也存在指数级下界。k=0.99n 时无常数拷贝测试器，k=cn（0<c<1）时测试与学习均为 Θ(n) 次拷贝。
Conclusion: 相干量子存储正是 stabilizer 测试与学习常规分离的资源：存储一旦受限到 k=cn（c<1），测试难度即退化到与学习同阶。

papers.title: Mask-supervised Object-centric Representation Learning with LeJEPA
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised image encoders deliver strong features for downstream tasks but need many images for training. A natural remedy to counter this is to make each image count for more. A scene contains many objects, and given masks from human annotators or an off-the-shelf segmentation model, pre-training can focus on aligning per-object rather than image-wide representations, extracting more signal from every image. Existing mask-supervised methods do this through reconstruction or contrastive losses that leverage negative objects. We instead use two separate projection spaces for the alignment. In a \emph{semantic space}, per-object representations from different views are aligned. To avoid collapse, instead of using negative objects, which requires category definitions, we extend the negative-free LeJEPA objective and show that its distributional anti-collapse regularizer ports naturally from whole images to the variable-sized set of objects in a scene. In an \emph{instance space}, a contrastive loss separates per-object representations from their context and co-occurring instances, including those of the same category. To separate object representations from their context, we copy objects and paste them into other contexts, where each pasted copy serves as an additional view of the original object. Trained on COCO with ground-truth masks, our method outperforms image-level and mask-guided baselines on tracking (DAVIS), classification (ImageNet-1k) and re-identification (NAVI), matches the best of them on semantic segmentation (ADE20k) and keeps its lead over image-level LeJEPA and a supervision-matched alternative on COCO fractions down to 256 images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 mask-supervised 的对象中心自监督表征学习方法：用语义空间对齐不同视角的逐对象表征、用实例空间对比损失把对象与其上下文和同类共现实例分开，避免依赖负样本类别的 LeJEPA 分布式防坍缩正则可直接从整图迁移到场景内变长对象集合。在 COCO 真值 mask 上预训练后，于 DAVIS 跟踪、ImageNet-1k 分类、NAVI 重识别上超过图像级与 mask-guided 基线，ADE20k 语义分割持平最优，且在低至 256 张图像的 COCO 子集上仍领先图像级 LeJEPA 与监督量对齐的替代方法。
Motivation: 自监督图像编码器下游特征强但需要大量图像训练；场景中含多个对象，逐对象而非整图对齐可让每张图像提供更多监督信号，而现有 mask-supervised 方法依赖重建或需要类别定义的负对象对比损失。
Method: 给定人工或现成分割模型的 mask，设两个投影空间：语义空间对齐不同视角的逐对象表征，用扩展自无负样本 LeJEPA 目标的分布式防坍缩正则（从整图移植到变长对象集合）替代负对象；实例空间用对比损失分离对象与其上下文及共现实例，并通过 copy-paste 把对象粘到其他上下文作为额外视角。
Result: 在 COCO 真值 mask 上预训练，跟踪 (DAVIS)、分类 (ImageNet-1k)、重识别 (NAVI) 上超过图像级与 mask-guided 基线，语义分割 (ADE20k) 与其中最优持平；在低至 256 张图像的 COCO 子集上仍领先图像级 LeJEPA 与监督量匹配的替代方法。
Conclusion: 逐对象对齐加无负样本防坍缩正则能从每张图像压出更多监督信号，在小数据预训练下仍保持对图像级自监督的优势。
Relevance: 1
