summary_sections.method: 给定人工或现成分割模型的 mask，设两个投影空间：语义空间对齐不同视角的逐对象表征，用扩展自无负样本 LeJEPA 目标的分布式防坍缩正则（从整图移植到变长对象集合）替代负对象；实例空间用对比损失分离对象与其上下文及共现实例，并通过 copy-paste 把对象粘到其他上下文作为额外视角。
summary_sections.result: 在 COCO 真值 mask 上预训练，跟踪 (DAVIS)、分类 (ImageNet-1k)、重识别 (NAVI) 上超过图像级与 mask-guided 基线，语义分割 (ADE20k) 与其中最优持平；在低至 256 张图像的 COCO 子集上仍领先图像级 LeJEPA 与监督量匹配的替代方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 逐对象对齐加无负样本防坍缩正则能从每张图像压出更多监督信号，在小数据预训练下仍保持对图像级自监督的优势。

papers.title: AnyGroundBench: A Multi-Domain Adaptation Benchmark for Video Grounding in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong performance in Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG), yet they are still evaluated mostly in a zero-shot manner on general-purpose benchmarks of everyday scenes. This creates a critical disconnect from real-world applications in specialized domains, where models inevitably encounter rare visual or textual concepts. Since exhaustive pre-training across infinite data distributions is infeasible, the ability to adapt to novel domains with limited data is essential. To bridge this gap, we introduce AnyGroundBench, a domain-adaptation benchmark designed to shift the STVG evaluation paradigm from static zero-shot testing to rigorous domain adaptation. Targeting five specialized domains (animal, industry, sports, surgery, and public security), AnyGroundBench pairs newly captured, expert-annotated videos with established datasets, unifying them through dense, high-fidelity spatio-temporal annotations. Crucially, the benchmark provides dedicated limited training subsets, enabling systematic evaluation of domain adaptability under limited training data. We benchmark 23 state-of-the-art VLMs in the zero-shot setting and further evaluate five adaptation strategies, spanning training-free and fine-tuning-based approaches, on representative models, assessing their zero-shot generalization and adaptation capacity. Our results show that current VLMs remain far from practical performance in the zero-shot setting, that training-free adaptation produces highly variable effects depending on the model and domain, and that fine-tuning-based adaptation, though more effective, still falls short of real-world requirements, with gains varying markedly across domains. These findings expose fundamental limitations in current VLMs' spatio-temporal reasoning, pointing to concrete directions for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnyGroundBench 把时空视频定位 (STVG) 的评测从零样本静态测试转为受限数据下的领域自适应：覆盖动物、工业、体育、手术、公共安全五个专业领域，配专家标注视频与专用少量训练子集。对 23 个 SOTA VLM 做零样本评测并考察 5 种自适应策略，结果显示零样本性能远未达实用，免训练自适应效果因模型和领域高度不稳，微调类更有效但仍不满足真实需求。
Motivation: VLM 的 STVG 评测几乎都在日常场景的通用基准上以零样本方式进行，与需要稀有视觉/文本概念的专业领域应用脱节，而穷举式预训练覆盖所有数据分布不可行，少样本领域自适应能力亟需可量化评测。
Method: 构建 AnyGroundBench：针对五个专业领域，将新采集、专家标注的视频与既有数据集配对，统一为稠密高保真时空标注，并提供专用少量训练子集；先在零样本设定下评测 23 个 SOTA VLM，再在代表性模型上评估 5 种自适应策略，涵盖免训练与微调两类。
Result: 零样本设定下当前 VLM 表现距实用水平仍很远；免训练自适应的效果随模型与领域高度波动；微调类自适应更有效但仍未达真实应用要求，且增益在不同领域间差异显著。
Conclusion: 现有 VLM 的时空推理存在根本局限，仅靠零样本或免训练自适应不足以支撑专业领域部署，评测范式应转向受限训练数据下的领域自适应。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Message Passing Enables Efficient Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: While inference-time scaling has improved the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), the need to generate long chains-of-thought (CoTs) is a computational bottleneck. Thus, in contrast to sequential scaling methods like CoT, recent parallel scaling techniques instead use fork and join (FJ) primitives to divide work across multiple LLM threads. However, in the fork-join paradigm, threads are typically transient and do not communicate pointwise with one another which limits scalability. To tackle this, we introduce Message Passing Language Models (MPLMs), a framework for LLM reasoning in which threads communicate directly via lightweight send and receive primitives. MPLMs enable efficient scaling through two key mechanisms: (1) reduced communication costs, achieved by avoiding redundant context sharing, and (2) preemption, which allows threads to terminate early based on partial information from their peers. We demonstrate the promise of MPLMs on 3 classes of tasks. First, on Sudoku puzzles, we show that MPLMs require an asymptotically smaller context than both serial CoT and parallel FJ. We then fine-tune a single model to solve 25 x 25 puzzles that remain challenging for standard CoT and FJ approaches, as well as frontier reasoning models without tools. Second, on 3-SAT puzzles, the capability of preemption allows termination of unpromising branches, which results in improved efficiency. Finally, we show that appropriately prompted large pre-trained models follow the MPLM protocol, achieving competitive results on long-context question answering relative to popular fork-join approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出消息传递语言模型 (Message Passing Language Models, MPLM)：并行推理的多个 LLM 线程不再像 fork-join 那样临时且互不通信，而是通过轻量 send/receive 原语直接交换信息，从而减少冗余上下文共享，并允许线程依据同伴的部分信息提前终止 (preemption)。在 Sudoku 上其上下文需求渐近小于串行 CoT 与并行 fork-join，微调后可解 25×25 难题；3-SAT 上抢占可剪掉无望分支，长上下文 QA 上与流行 fork-join 方法结果相当。
Motivation: 推理时扩展依赖长 CoT，计算代价高；并行 fork-join 扩展中线程彼此不点对点通信、上下文冗余共享，限制了可扩展性。
Method: MPLM 框架让并行 LLM 线程通过轻量 send/receive 原语直接通信，两个机制是减少通信成本（避免冗余上下文共享）与抢占（依据同伴的部分信息提前终止线程）；在 Sudoku、3-SAT 上微调单个模型，并测试按协议提示的大型预训练模型。
Result: Sudoku 上 MPLM 所需上下文渐近小于串行 CoT 与并行 FJ；微调单个模型可解 25×25 谜题，而标准 CoT、FJ 及无工具的前沿推理模型仍感困难；3-SAT 上抢占通过终止无望分支提升效率；提示得当的大预训练模型遵循 MPLM 协议，在长上下文问答上相对流行 fork-join 方法取得有竞争力的结果。
Conclusion: 让并行推理线程点对点通信并可抢占，是比单纯加长 CoT 或堆线程更省上下文的推理扩展路径，且可由提示直接激活于大型预训练模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Anchored or Drifting: What Recursive Self-Generation Reveals About Training Data
papers.abstract_en: Large generative models are known to memorize their training data, posing severe privacy risks. Yet, current methods to detect training membership typically rely on the weak signals of a single forward pass. In this work, we find that training samples and unseen (held-out) data follow visibly different trajectories under recursive self-generation -- repeatedly feeding a model's output back as its next input. Held-out samples \emph{drift}: they lose the specifics of the original within a few steps. Training samples stay \emph{anchored}, degrading far more slowly. We show that the membership signal this produces holds across model modalities, architectures and scales, spanning language, diffusion, and autoregressive vision models. Furthermore, these recursive trajectories provide a signal that raises membership inference TPR at $1\%$ FPR for nearly every attack we evaluate, roughly doubling it on the weakest baselines and still improving the strongest, which shows that a model's behavior under recursion carries membership evidence that a single query does not.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 发现把模型输出反复回灌自身输入（recursive self-generation）时，训练样本保持锚定、退化缓慢，而留出样本几步内就丢失原始细节而漂移；该轨迹信号在语言、扩散与自回归视觉模型上均成立，可把成员推断 (membership inference) 在 1% FPR 下的 TPR 对几乎所有攻击抬升，最弱基线约翻倍。
Motivation: 大模型记忆训练数据带来隐私风险，但现有成员推断方法只依赖单次前向的弱信号，难以区分训练样本与留出样本。
Method: 对同一模型反复把输出作为下一次输入做递归自生成，比较训练样本与留出样本的轨迹差异，并将该轨迹信号作为额外特征注入成员推断攻击，在语言、扩散和自回归视觉模型上跨模态、架构与规模检验。
Result: 递归轨迹在语言、扩散、自回归视觉模型上都产生可区分的成员信号；注入后在几乎每个被评估的攻击上提升 1% FPR 处的 TPR，最弱基线约翻倍，最强基线也有改善。
Conclusion: 模型在递归下的行为本身携带单次查询所没有的成员证据，可作为成员推断的通用增强信号。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: GLACIER: Rethinking Mass Spectrum Prediction as an Object Detection Problem
papers.abstract_en: Predicting tandem mass spectra (MS/MS) from molecular structures represents a central task in analytical chemistry with direct relevance to clinical metabolomics, systems biology, and adjacent disciplines. In this work, we revisit the problem through the lens of object detection on molecular graphs. Molecular fragmentation, a central step in MS/MS prediction, can be approximated as detecting a set of subgraphs (i.e., fragments) and their associated spectral contributions. Existing fragment-based models follow a two-stage paradigm -- first generating candidate fragments and then scoring them -- analogous to two-stage R-CNNs in computer vision. Towards higher accuracy and faster inference, we introduce GLACIER, a single-stage transformer-based fragment detection neural network for molecular graphs. This unified formulation eliminates the need for candidate enumeration, enabling scalable and globally consistent modeling of molecular fragmentation. GLACIER is faster and more accurate than existing state-of-the-art by a significant margin, achieving 70.0% and 69.7% Top-1 retrieval accuracy with and without contrastive finetuning on the MassSpecGym dataset (from the previous SOTA of 64.0%) and 52.5% and 38.5% respectively on the NIST'20 dataset (from 33.2%). Furthermore, GLACIER provides nearly 8-fold inference speedup over our prior two-stage model. Code is available at https://github.com/coleygroup/ms-pred
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GLACIER 把串联质谱 (MS/MS) 预测重构为分子图上的单阶段目标检测：一次性检出碎片子图及其谱贡献，取代先枚举候选碎片再打分的两阶段范式。在 MassSpecGym 上 Top-1 检索准确率达 70.0%（对比微调）与 69.7%（无），较此前 SOTA 64.0% 提升；NIST'20 上为 52.5% 与 38.5%（此前 33.2%），推理较作者先前两阶段模型加速近 8 倍。
Motivation: 现有碎片基 MS/MS 预测模型走两阶段路线：先生成候选碎片再打分，类似 R-CNN，需要候选枚举，代价高且难以对分子碎片做全局一致建模。
Method: 提出 GLACIER：基于 transformer 的单阶段碎片检测网络，直接在分子图上检出一组子图（碎片）及其谱贡献，统一生成与打分、免除候选枚举；支持对比微调 (contrastive finetuning) 两种设定，代码开源在 coleygroup/ms-pred。
Result: MassSpecGym Top-1 检索准确率 70.0%（对比微调）/ 69.7%（无），此前 SOTA 为 64.0%；NIST'20 上 52.5% / 38.5%，此前为 33.2%；相对作者先前两阶段模型推理加速近 8 倍。
Conclusion: 把分子碎片化当作单阶段目标检测，可以同时免去候选枚举、提高 MS/MS 预测准确率并大幅加速推理，在两个数据集上均超过既有两阶段 SOTA。

papers.title: Look-Before-Move: Narrative-Grounded World Visual Attention in Dynamic 3D Story Worlds
papers.abstract_en: As embodied AI and world models increasingly operate in dynamic 3D environments, visual perception must move beyond passively interpreting given observations toward actively deciding what to observe. We study this problem through camera planning in dynamic 3D story worlds, where the camera must not only generate smooth motion, but also decide what visual evidence should be acquired before it moves. We formulate this capability as Narrative-Grounded World Visual Attention, where the camera acts as an embodied observer that determines what to observe, how to compose the observation, and how to shift attention over time under narrative intent and physical 3D constraints. To realize this capability, we propose Look-Before-Move, a camera planning framework that separates observation specification from motion execution. It first builds a Semantic Observation Contract to convert directorial intent into executable visual constraints, then performs Monte Carlo Viewpoint Search to find narrative-compliant and geometrically feasible viewpoints, and finally applies Semantic Trajectory Grounding to connect selected viewpoints into continuous, collision-aware, and temporally coherent camera motion. We further construct a dynamic 3D Story World Benchmark based on StoryBlender, covering 50 stories, 457 scenes, and 1585 shots with animated characters, semantic scene configurations, and executable 3D environments. Experiments show that our framework improves subject perception, intent consistency, and trajectory quality over representative baselines, demonstrating the importance of organizing visual attention before generating camera motion.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Track, Poster). 30 pages (including references and appendices), 19 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Look-Before-Move 把动态 3D 故事世界中的相机规划拆成先定观察、再执行运动：先用 Semantic Observation Contract 把导演意图转成可执行视觉约束，再用 Monte Carlo Viewpoint Search 找符合叙事且几何可行的视点，最后由 Semantic Trajectory Grounding 串成连续、避碰、时序一致的相机轨迹。在基于 StoryBlender 构建的 50 个故事、457 个场景、1585 个镜头的动态 3D Story World Benchmark 上，该框架在主体感知、意图一致性与轨迹质量上均优于代表性基线。
Motivation: 具身 AI 与世界模型在动态 3D 环境中多是被动解读给定观测，缺少在运动前主动决定该看什么的能力；相机规划既要平滑运动，也要先获取正确视觉证据。
Method: 框架分三段：Semantic Observation Contract 将导演意图转为可执行视觉约束；Monte Carlo Viewpoint Search 在叙事约束与 3D 几何可行性下采样视点；Semantic Trajectory Grounding 把选中视点连成连续、避碰、时序一致的运动。评测基于 StoryBlender 构建动态 3D Story World Benchmark，含动画角色、语义场景配置与可执行 3D 环境。
Result: 在 50 个故事、457 个场景、1585 个镜头的 Story World Benchmark 上，框架在主体感知 (subject perception)、意图一致性 (intent consistency) 与轨迹质量三方面均优于代表性基线。
Conclusion: 先组织视觉注意力、再生成相机运动，是动态 3D 叙事世界中相机规划有效的设计顺序。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MORPH: Generative Retrieval via Diffusion Transformer with Metric-Ordered Sequence Training and Hybrid-Policy Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Embedding-based retrieval typically returns highest-scoring items, but many production scenarios require items that satisfy a target attribute while preserving a fine-grained pattern expressed by seed examples. We formalize this as pattern-preserving attribute retrieval. Standard approaches fail: averaging seeds preserves the pattern but misses the attribute; global attribute retrieval drifts to unrelated patterns. We approach the task with continuous generative retrieval, where a model reads item-embedding sequences and generates query embeddings for nearest-neighbor search. We propose MORPH: Generative Retrieval via Diffusion Transformer with Metric-Ordered Sequence Training and Hybrid-Policy Preference Optimization, a staged framework with large-scale raw-sequence pretraining, Metric-Ordered Sequence (MOS) training, and final HPPO alignment. MOS construction turns sparse online metric labels into in-pattern trajectories; MOS CPT/SFT then trains the generator through shared multi-domain continuation pretraining and domain-specific tail-centroid supervised fine-tuning. HPPO uses a hybrid pool of static and policy-generated candidate embeddings, labels them with true online intersection metrics, applies iterated preference optimization, and employs a Pareto pair filter to exclude winners that lower pattern purity. Across four large-scale attribute domains under strict item- and pattern-holdout protocols, MOS training improves the primary intersection metric over a strong pretrained generative retriever in every domain-split cell, and the complete Pareto-filtered HPPO procedure improves it further, with paired-bootstrap-significant gains on seven of the eight cells - the exception being the D4 pattern-holdout split. Ablations confirm that the Pareto pair filter improves the attribute-pattern tradeoff on D1-D3, and that hybrid static/policy candidates are complementary.
papers.comment: 40 pages, 8 figures. Updated title, methods, experiments, and references
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MORPH 用 Diffusion Transformer 做连续生成式检索，读入 item-embedding 序列并生成查询 embedding 做最近邻搜索，以解决 pattern-preserving attribute retrieval：保留种子细粒度模式同时命中目标属性。在四个大规模属性域的 item- 与 pattern-holdout 协议下，MOS 训练在每个 domain-split cell 上都提升主 intersection metric，Pareto 过滤后的 HPPO 进一步提升，八个 cell 中七个有 paired-bootstrap 显著增益，唯一例外是 D4 的 pattern-holdout split。
Motivation: 生产检索常要求结果既满足目标属性又保留种子样例表达的细粒度模式；对种子取平均能保模式却丢属性，全局属性检索则漂移到无关模式，标准嵌入检索的最高分排序无法同时满足两者。
Method: 三阶段框架：大规模 raw-sequence 预训练；Metric-Ordered Sequence (MOS) 训练，把稀疏在线 metric 标签构造成 in-pattern 轨迹，经共享多域 continuation pretraining (MOS CPT) 与域特定 tail-centroid 监督微调 (MOS SFT) 训练生成器；最后 HPPO 对齐，用静态与 policy 生成的混合候选 embedding 池，以真实在线 intersection metric 打标，做迭代偏好优化，并用 Pareto pair filter 剔除降低 pattern purity 的胜者。
Result: 在四个大规模属性域、严格 item-holdout 与 pattern-holdout 协议下，MOS 训练在全部 domain-split cell 上都比强预训练生成式检索器提升主 intersection metric；完整 Pareto 过滤 HPPO 再进一步提升，八个 cell 中七个取得 paired-bootstrap 显著增益，例外为 D4 pattern-holdout split。消融显示 Pareto pair filter 在 D1-D3 上改善属性-模式权衡，静态与 policy 候选互补。
Conclusion: 把稀疏在线指标重排成 in-pattern 轨迹训练、再用带 Pareto 过滤的混合候选偏好优化，可以在保持种子模式的前提下稳定抬高属性命中指标；增益在 D4 pattern-holdout 上不显著。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AVOC: Enhancing Hour-Level Audio-Video Understanding in Omni-Modal LLMs via Retrieval-Inspired Token Compression
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models have achieved remarkable progress in short-form audio-video understanding, yet long-form audio-video comprehension remains challenged by limited context windows and severe information redundancy. To address these bottlenecks, we propose AVOC, a framework for long-form audio-video understanding in Omni-modal Large Language Models. AVOC introduces a learnable token compression module between the modality encoders and the LLM backbone. We reframe multimodal token compression as a top-$K$ retrieval problem: given a fixed context budget, the module must retrieve a compact subset of tokens that best supports answering the user query. We draw inspiration from three classical Information Retrieval criteria for selecting informative units from a large candidate pool: relevance, importance, and diversity. AVOC instantiates each criterion as a tailored mechanism for audio-video understanding, and integrates them into a unified retrieval-style compression pipeline. Experiments show that AVOC achieves state-of-the-art performance on long-form audio-video benchmarks, surpassing the second-best model by 4.9 and 5.5 points in average accuracy on OmniVideoBench and LVOmniBench, respectively. Moreover, AVOC maintains robust performance on Audio-Video Needle-in-a-Haystack task at durations up to one hour. Code and model are at github.com/YJCX330/AVOC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AVOC 把长音视频理解中的 token 压缩重述为固定上下文预算下的 top-K 检索问题，用相关性、重要性、多样性三条 IR 准则在编码器与 LLM 之间选出最能支撑用户查询的紧凑 token 子集。在长音视频基准上平均准确率分别超出次优模型 4.9 与 5.5 个点，并在长达 1 小时的 Needle-in-a-Haystack 任务上保持稳健表现。
Motivation: 多模态 LLM 在短视频音频理解上进展明显，但长时音视频受上下文窗口受限与信息冗余严重双重制约，直接把全部 token 塞进 LLM 不可行。
Method: 在模态编码器与 LLM backbone 之间插入可学习的 token 压缩模块，把压缩建模为固定预算下的 top-K 检索：以信息检索的 relevance、importance、diversity 三条准则各自实例化为音视频专用机制，再整合成统一的检索式压缩流水线。
Result: 在 OmniVideoBench 上平均准确率超出次优模型 4.9 个点，在 LVOmniBench 上超出 5.5 个点，达到 state-of-the-art；在时长至 1 小时的 Audio-Video Needle-in-a-Haystack 任务上保持稳健性能。
Conclusion: 把长音视频 token 压缩当作面向查询的 top-K 检索，可以在固定上下文预算内保住回答所需信息，从而在长时音视频基准上取得最优表现。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Agent MechSuits: Mechanistic Subspace Safety Steering for Multi-Turn CLI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Command-Line Interface (CLI) agents based on large language models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable autonomous capabilities, but they also introduce significant safety and misuse risks during multi-turn interactions with external environments. Existing safety mechanisms mainly rely on external guardrails, which have a limited ability to perform fine-grained behavioral control during execution. Meanwhile, recent mechanistic interpretability methods for LLM safety are mostly confined to single-turn or jailbreak-style QA settings, limiting their ability to capture the evolving risk dynamics of multi-turn agent execution. In this paper, we investigate the safety of multi-turn CLI agents from an internal perspective. We propose Agent MechSuits (Mechanistic Subspace Intervention and Steering), a white-box defense framework that performs runtime safety detection and representation-level mitigation for CLI agents. Unlike conventional agent guardrails, Agent MechSuits detects harmful execution states from step-level hidden representations and mitigates unsafe behavior by intervening in a 10-dimensional subspace within a single layer. To support this research, we introduce the Mechanistic Agent Safety (MAS) benchmark, comprising comprehensively annotated multi-turn execution trajectories across 194 tasks using LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, and Gemma-2-9B. Extensive experiments show that Agent MechSuits achieves strong safety detection performance, provides preliminary evidence for lookahead risk anticipation, and substantially reduces harmful actions of the CLI agent, establishing a foundation for applying mechanistic interpretability to dynamic LLM agent safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多轮 CLI agent 的执行期安全，提出白盒框架 Agent MechSuits：从每步 hidden representation 检测有害执行状态，并在单层的 10 维子空间内做干预以抑制不安全行为。配套发布含 194 个任务多轮执行轨迹标注的 MAS benchmark，覆盖 LLaMA-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Gemma-2-9B；实验显示安全检测表现强、给出前瞻风险预期的初步证据，并显著减少 CLI agent 的有害动作。
Motivation: 现有 agent 安全机制依赖外部 guardrail，执行期细粒度行为控制能力有限；而可解释性安全方法多局限于单轮或 jailbreak 式 QA，无法刻画多轮 agent 执行中风险的动态演化。
Method: Agent MechSuits 从 agent 每一步的 hidden representation 判定有害执行状态，并在单层的 10 维表征子空间内进行干预 (subspace steering) 以缓解不安全行为；同时构建 Mechanistic Agent Safety (MAS) benchmark，含 194 个任务的多轮执行轨迹与全面标注，实验用 LLaMA-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Gemma-2-9B 三个模型。
Result: 在 MAS benchmark（194 个任务、三个 LLM）上，Agent MechSuits 取得强安全检测性能，提供 lookahead 风险预期的初步证据，并显著减少 CLI agent 的有害动作。
Conclusion: 机制可解释性可以从单轮 QA 走向多轮 agent 的运行时动态安全：在低维表征子空间做干预即可同时支撑检测与缓解，为该方向奠定基础。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Multi4D: High-Fidelity Dynamic Gaussian Splatting via Multi-Level Competitive Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic 3D Gaussian splatting faces a fundamental tension between motion consistency and visual fidelity. Deformation-based approaches preserve temporal correspondence but suffer from motion over-factorization, oversmoothing high-frequency dynamics. In contrast, 4D-primitive methods capture fine visual details yet incur temporal overparameterization, breaking object identity and leading to severe storage overhead. To resolve this, we introduce Multi4D, a framework for high-fidelity dynamic Gaussian Splatting based on multi-level competitive allocation. Instead of a monolithic representation, we distribute modeling capacity across three structured levels: static structure, persistent dynamic geometry, and transient appearance primitives. Through shared rasterization and residual-driven optimization, these levels dynamically compete to explain photometric error, enabling adaptive specialization without pre-assigned decomposition. This allocation preserves long-term motion consistency while capturing fine dynamic detail, achieving state-of-the-art rendering quality and real-time performance with significantly fewer dynamic primitives. Furthermore, because our representation explicitly tracks compact persistent Gaussians over time, semantic features can be embedded afterward, enabling Multi4D to achieve state-of-the-art 4D segmentation accuracy with an order-of-magnitude speedup. Project page: https://batfacewayne.github.io/Multi4D.io/
papers.journal_ref: Computer Vision - ECCV 2026, Lecture Notes in Computer Science, pp. 502-519, Springer (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Multi4D 把动态 3D Gaussian Splatting 的建模容量拆成静态结构、持久动态几何、瞬态外观三个层级，靠共享光栅化与残差驱动的优化让各层竞争解释光度误差，从而在保持长期运动一致性的同时保住高频细节。该表示显式跟踪紧凑的持久 Gaussian，事后可嵌入语义特征，达到 SOTA 4D 分割精度并带来一个数量级的加速，渲染质量达到 SOTA 且保持实时。
Motivation: 基于变形的方法保时间对应但运动过度分解、把高频动态过度平滑；4D-primitive 方法细节好却时间过参数化，破坏物体身份并带来严重存储开销。
Method: 多层级竞争分配 (multi-level competitive allocation)：把容量分布到静态结构、持久动态几何、瞬态外观三个层级，共享光栅化并用残差驱动优化，各层动态竞争解释光度误差，无需预先指定分解；分割阶段在持久 Gaussian 上事后嵌入语义特征。
Result: 达到 SOTA 渲染质量与实时性能，且动态 primitive 数量显著更少；4D 分割达到 SOTA 精度并有一个数量级 (order-of-magnitude) 的加速。
Conclusion: 按层级竞争分配容量可同时化解运动一致性与视觉保真度的矛盾，持久 Gaussian 轨迹也让 4D 分割能事后附加语义特征。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 多层级竞争分配 (multi-level competitive allocation)：把容量分布到静态结构、持久动态几何、瞬态外观三个层级，共享光栅化并用残差驱动优化，各层动态竞争解释光度误差，无需预先指定分解；分割阶段在持久 Gaussian 上事后嵌入语义特征。
summary_sections.result: 达到 SOTA 渲染质量与实时性能，且动态 primitive 数量显著更少；4D 分割达到 SOTA 精度并有一个数量级 (order-of-magnitude) 的加速。
summary_sections.conclusion: 按层级竞争分配容量可同时化解运动一致性与视觉保真度的矛盾，持久 Gaussian 轨迹也让 4D 分割能事后附加语义特征。

papers.title: Score Approximation for Diffusion Models on Arbitrary Low-Dimensional Structures
papers.abstract_en: Score-based diffusion models have achieved remarkable empirical success, motivating extensive theoretical work to establish their foundations. However, existing complexity bounds for score approximation, a vital step in diffusion modeling, rely on rigid constraints such as Lipschitz continuous scores or lower bounded densities. This severely limits their applicability to real-world perceptual data, where singularities, sharp boundaries, and disjoint clusters routinely violate such restrictive assumptions. We bridge this gap between theory and practice, presenting the first universal score approximation theorem applicable to any compactly supported distribution in $\mathbb{R}^n$. Using a novel discretization technique that directly models the underlying distribution, we prove that the neural network complexity is governed by the support's upper Minkowski dimension $d$ rather than the ambient dimension $n$. Furthermore, by leveraging the inherent smoothing of Gaussian kernels, we show that even for irregular, fractal distributions, an $ε$ approximation error can be achieved with $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-{d/(M+1)}})$ local Taylor modules each at size of $\mathcal{O}(n^M)$, an $ε$-scaling rate previously achieved only for distributions with $(M+1)$-Hölder smoothness. Thus, we reveal a possible mechanism by which score-based diffusion models represent non-smooth data distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出首个适用于任意紧支撑分布的通用 score 近似定理：神经网络复杂度由支撑集的上 Minkowski 维数 d 而非环境维数 n 决定，且借助高斯核的平滑性，即使对不规则、分形分布，用 O(ε^{-d/(M+1)}) 个局部 Taylor 模块（每个 O(n^M)）即可达到 ε 近似误差。该 ε 标度率此前只在 (M+1)-Hölder 光滑分布上得到过。
Motivation: 现有 score 近似复杂度界依赖 Lipschitz 连续 score 或下有界密度等刚性假设，而真实感知数据中的奇点、锐利边界与分离簇常违反这些条件，理论与实践之间存在缺口。
Method: 提出一种直接刻画底层分布的新型离散化技术，证明复杂度由支撑集上 Minkowski 维数 d 控制；再利用高斯核固有的平滑性，对不规则乃至分形分布构造局部 Taylor 模块逼近。
Result: 对任意 R^n 中紧支撑分布证明 ε 近似误差可用 O(ε^{-d/(M+1)}) 个局部 Taylor 模块达到，每模块规模 O(n^M)；复杂度随支撑维数 d 而非环境维数 n 增长；该 ε 标度率此前仅对 (M+1)-Hölder 光滑分布实现。
Conclusion: score-based diffusion 模型表示非光滑数据分布的一个可能机制是：其有效复杂度由数据支撑的 Minkowski 维数而非环境维数决定，高斯核平滑使分形分布也能获得与光滑情形同阶的逼近率。

papers.title: Capability Provenance in Language Models: A Case Study in Social Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We use training-data attribution as an interpretable tool for capability discovery, mapping which regions of the pretraining corpus support social reasoning versus STEM reasoning in OLMo3-7B. Training-data attribution measures how strongly each training document influences a model's predictions on a benchmark, but document-level scores are too noisy to identify which corpus regions support which capabilities. We compute gradient-based attribution (TrackStar via Bergson) over a working set drawn from the de-duplicated Dolma3 mix, aggregate influence across WebOrganizer's 24-format x 24-topic taxonomy (576 bins), and contrast benchmark pairs in a 2x2 design that varies domain (social vs. STEM) and capability type (reasoning vs. knowledge): SocialIQA and MMLU Social Sciences against ARC-Challenge and MMLU STEM. Social and STEM reasoning draw on qualitatively distinct corpus regions, and the contrast is sharper at the reasoning level than at the knowledge level. Targeted machine unlearning provides partial causal validation: forgetting high-attribution topics (e.g., Literature for SocialIQA) degrades the aligned benchmark more than within-topic random baselines. We release the code and aggregate artifacts at https://github.com/HCAI-Lab-GT/capabilibara and https://huggingface.co/HCAI-Lab-GT.
papers.comment: 102 pages. Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026. Camera-ready update: corrected Figure 1's query cohort, added Figure 2's color legend, and updated the Bergson paper citation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用训练数据归因 (training-data attribution) 定位 OLMo3-7B 预训练语料中支撑社会推理与 STEM 推理的区域：梯度归因 TrackStar（经 Bergson）在去重 Dolma3 工作集上打分，按 WebOrganizer 的 24 格式 × 24 主题（576 个 bin）聚合，并用 2×2 对比设计区分领域与能力类型。社会推理与 STEM 推理依赖定性上不同的语料区域，且在推理层面的对比比知识层面更尖锐；机器遗忘高归因主题（如对 SocialIQA 遗忘 Literature）比主题内随机基线更明显地损害对齐 benchmark。
Motivation: 文档级归因分数噪声过大，无法判定预训练语料的哪些区域支撑哪种能力，能力来源缺乏可解释、可验证的定位手段。
Method: 对去重 Dolma3 混合中抽取的工作集计算梯度归因（TrackStar via Bergson），把影响分数按 WebOrganizer 的 24 格式 × 24 主题分类体系（576 个 bin）聚合；用 2×2 设计对比 benchmark 对，变化维度为领域（社会 vs. STEM）与能力类型（推理 vs. 知识），即 SocialIQA、MMLU Social Sciences 对 ARC-Challenge、MMLU STEM；再用定向机器遗忘 (targeted machine unlearning) 做因果验证。
Result: 社会推理与 STEM 推理取自定性上不同的语料区域，推理层面的对比比知识层面更尖锐；遗忘高归因主题（如对 SocialIQA 遗忘 Literature）对相应 benchmark 的损害大于主题内随机基线。
Conclusion: 训练数据归因可作为能力发现工具，把 benchmark 表现映射回语料区域，并能通过机器遗忘获得部分因果验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Machine learning modeling of hit-into-play probability and quantification of pitch sequence effects
papers.abstract_en: Although pitch sequencing is a central topic in baseball analytics, previous studies have primarily focused on improving predictive performance for the final pitch or its outcome, leaving the role of preceding pitches insufficiently examined. To address this issue, this study conducted a machine learning-based analysis to quantify the importance of preceding pitches and deepen the tactical understanding of baseball. A Transformer-based model was designed and trained to predict whether a target pitch would result in an in-play outcome or a swinging strikeout. Based on the model, two analyses were conducted, including an ablation study to evaluate the contribution of preceding pitches to predictive performance and a replacement analysis to quantify changes in predicted in-play probability when individual pitches were replaced by alternatives. The results suggest that hitting outcome predictions mostly depended on the attributes of the final pitch, and including preceding pitches had little effect on the predictive performance of the model. Moreover, the effect of pitch replacement on the probability output of the model for preceding pitches ranged from approximately 0.11 to 0.14, compared with approximately 0.44 to 0.45 for the final pitch. Therefore, preceding pitches played only a supplementary role in slightly modifying the predicted probability of a ball being put into play, although even such small effects may be practically meaningful.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Transformer 预测目标球是否形成 in-play 或被三振，通过消融与替换分析量化前序球的作用：击球结果预测主要取决于最后一球属性，加入前序球对预测性能影响很小；替换单球对预测 in-play 概率的改变量，前序球约 0.11–0.14，最后一球约 0.44–0.45。
Motivation: 棒球球序 (pitch sequencing) 研究多集中于提升最后一球或其结果的预测，前序球的作用被忽视，缺少对其贡献的量化。
Method: 设计并训练一个 Transformer 模型，预测目标球产生 in-play 还是挥空三振；在此基础上做两项分析：消融研究评估前序球对预测性能的贡献，替换分析量化把单球换成替代球时预测 in-play 概率的变化。
Result: 击球结果预测大多依赖最后一球属性，加入前序球对模型预测性能影响很小；单球替换对概率输出的效应，前序球约 0.11–0.14，最后一球约 0.44–0.45。
Conclusion: 前序球只起辅助作用，仅轻微修正预测的 in-play 概率，但这种小效应在实际中仍可能有意义。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Your Privacy My Cloak: Backdoor Attacks on Differentially Private Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Prior research suggests that differential privacy (DP) can enhance the robustness of federated learning (FL) against backdoor attacks. In this paper, we challenge this assumption. Through an empirical analysis of two baseline attack strategies, we uncover a fundamental tension in DP-FL: while bypassing DP allows state-of-the-art defenses to detect and filter malicious updates, complying with DP inadvertently masks their distinguishing statistical characteristics. Consequently, existing defenses become ineffective as DP reduces the raw backdoor signal. Building on this masking effect, we propose RING, a novel attack that explicitly exploits DP to conceal malicious contributions while maximizing attack impact. By collaboratively crafting adversarial perturbations, compromised clients reconstruct a strong backdoor signal during aggregation without triggering anomaly detection. RING operates as a perturbation layer that is agnostic to the underlying backdoor technique, making it broadly applicable and composable with existing attacks -- a property that significantly amplifies the threat it poses to DP-FL. Extensive evaluations across four image and text datasets under non-iid distributions show that RING achieves an average attack success rate of 90.3% against six state-of-the-art defenses under a moderate privacy budget, an improvement of up to 38.4% over baseline strategies. Finally, we evaluate potential countermeasures and find that mitigating this threat incurs significant utility trade-offs, exposing a fundamental security gap in the deployment of differentially private FL.
papers.comment: This is the extended version of a paper accepted to the 2027 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (S&P 2027)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RING 是针对差分隐私联邦学习 (DP-FL) 的后门攻击层：被攻陷客户端协同构造对抗扰动，使各自更新满足 DP、躲过异常检测，却在聚合时重建出强后门信号。在四个图像与文本数据集、non-iid 分布下，RING 对六种先进防御的平均攻击成功率达 90.3%（中等隐私预算），较基线策略最高提升 38.4%；缓解该威胁需付出显著效用代价。
Motivation: 既有工作认为 DP 能增强 FL 对后门攻击的鲁棒性，但作者发现 DP-FL 存在根本张力：绕过 DP 会让防御检出恶意更新，而遵守 DP 反而掩盖其统计特征，使现有防御失效。
Method: 先对两种基线攻击策略做实证分析，揭示 DP 对后门信号的掩蔽效应；据此提出 RING，作为与底层后门技术无关的扰动层，由被攻陷客户端协同构造对抗扰动，在聚合阶段重建强后门信号且不触发异常检测，可与现有攻击组合。
Result: 在四个图像和文本数据集、non-iid 分布、中等隐私预算下，RING 对六种先进防御的平均攻击成功率 (ASR) 为 90.3%，较基线策略最高提升 38.4%；对潜在缓解措施的评估显示其缓解会带来显著的模型效用损失。
Conclusion: DP 并不能保护 FL 免受后门攻击，反而可被攻击者用来隐藏恶意贡献；部署差分隐私 FL 存在根本性的安全缺口，且防御需以明显效用为代价。

papers.title: REFLEX: Reflective Evolution from LLM Experience
papers.abstract_en: Large multimodal language models (MLLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for guiding evolutionary search toward interpretable programmatic policies. In existing program-evolution systems, however, reusable knowledge is usually carried by whole programs in the population, and it is difficult to trace how a visual observation led to a particular code change and its measured outcome. We present REFLEX, a train-free evolutionary framework that links these steps in one loop. A vision-enabled Critic turns task-specific behavioral evidence into a structured diagnosis; the diagnosis retrieves executable code snippets from a persistent Skill Memory; a text-only Actor writes the child program; and the child--parent fitness change updates the utility of each retrieved snippet. Every step is recorded in a single trace. Under matched backends and 100-call budgets over 10 paired seeds, REFLEX reaches the solve threshold in a median of 13, 20, and 24 LLM calls on Acrobot, Pendulum, and Lunar Lander, roughly half the calls required by official MLES and by a compute-matched Actor-only ablation. Frozen Skill Memory banks from Pendulum or Lunar Lander raise the final Acrobot score on all 10 paired seeds. On a 36-dimensional antenna-array design task with equal evaluation budgets and shared initialization, REFLEX reaches the harder $25.25$ score threshold on 9/10 seeds, compared with at most 3/10 for CMA-ES, GA, and PSO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REFLEX 是免训练的进化式程序策略搜索框架：视觉 Critic 把任务行为证据转成结构化诊断，诊断从持久 Skill Memory 检索可执行代码片段，纯文本 Actor 写子程序，子代与父代的 fitness 变化再回写每个片段的效用，全程记录在单一 trace 中。在 100 次 LLM 调用预算、10 个配对种子下，Acrobot、Pendulum、Lunar Lander 达到求解阈值的中位调用数为 13、20、24，约为官方 MLES 与等算力 Actor-only 消融的一半。
Motivation: 现有程序进化系统里可复用知识以整个程序为单位携带，难以追溯一次视觉观察如何导致某处代码改动及其度量结果。
Method: 四个组件构成一个闭环：视觉 Critic 产出结构化诊断，诊断从持久 Skill Memory 检索可执行代码片段，text-only Actor 生成子程序，子代与父代的 fitness 差更新片段效用；每步写入单一 trace。评测在匹配后端与 100 调用预算、10 个配对种子上进行，并含 Actor-only 消融与冻结 Skill Memory 迁移。
Result: 在 100 调用预算、10 配对种子下，REFLEX 达到求解阈值的中位 LLM 调用数为 Acrobot 13、Pendulum 20、Lunar Lander 24，约为官方 MLES 与等算力 Actor-only 消融所需调用的一半；从 Pendulum 或 Lunar Lander 冻结的 Skill Memory 在全部 10 个配对种子上都提升了 Acrobot 最终分数。在 36 维天线阵列设计任务上，等评估预算与共享初始化下 REFLEX 在 9/10 种子达到更难的 25.25 分阈值，CMA-ES、GA、PSO 至多 3/10。
Conclusion: 把视觉证据、代码片段检索与 fitness 反馈串成单一可追溯回路，能在匹配预算下以约一半的 LLM 调用完成程序策略搜索，并让 Skill Memory 跨任务迁移。

papers.title: Quantum Statistical Memory Advantage Reveals Predictive Structure in Chaotic Invariant Measures
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon prediction of a chaotic system is governed by fidelity to its invariant measure, and which parts of that measure a learned predictor needs is a physical question not known in advance. We establish a quantum statistical memory advantage for interrogating it. A quantum statistical prior (Q-Prior), trained once on classical data, stores an efficiently preparable $k$-point marginal in polynomially many circuit parameters against exponentially many for explicit tabulation. Collective Bell measurements on two copies then estimate any post hoc Pauli-expectation magnitude at a copy cost independent of register size, with a worst-case exponential separation from single-copy protocols. A single Bell dataset supports an entire family of candidate observables at a cost growing only logarithmically in the family size, so an exponentially large candidate space stays open for later analysis. We implement the protocol on IQM superconducting processors with two-copy registers of up to 54 physical-qubit chips. We apply this to turbulent channel flow and ERA5 forecasting, resolving invariant structure by statistical sector and order. Turbulent phase correlations persist through eighth order, while most predictive gains arise from low-order constraints; in ERA5, planetary-wave phase coherence complements covariance regularisation, identifying distinct low-order sectors with predictive value. Quantum statistical memory is therefore both a near-term computational resource and an instrument for identifying which invariant structures matter for prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出量子统计记忆优势协议：Q-Prior 用多项式个线路参数存 k 点边缘分布，双拷贝集体 Bell 测量以与寄存器规模无关的拷贝代价估计任意 Pauli 期望。在 IQM 超导处理器（最多 54 物理量子比特双拷贝寄存器）上用于湍流槽道流动与 ERA5 预报，发现湍流相位关联持续到八阶但预测增益主要来自低阶约束，ERA5 中行星波相位相干性与协方差正则化互补。
Motivation: 混沌系统的长时预报取决于对不变测度的保真度，而学习预测器究竟需要不变测度的哪些部分是事先未知的物理问题；经典显式表征 k 点边缘需要指数多存储。
Method: Q-Prior 在经典数据上训练一次，以多项式个线路参数高效制备 k 点边缘分布（对比显式表征的指数开销）；对两份拷贝做集体 Bell 测量，事后估计任意 Pauli 期望量，单个 Bell 数据集支撑整个候选可观测量族，代价仅随族大小对数增长；协议在 IQM 超导处理器上实现，双拷贝寄存器最多 54 物理量子比特。
Result: 单拷贝协议存在最坏情况指数级分离；候选可观测量族的代价随族大小仅对数增长。应用于湍流槽道流动与 ERA5 预报：湍流相位关联持续到八阶，而多数预测增益来自低阶约束；ERA5 中行星波相位相干性与协方差正则化互补，识别出具有预测价值的不同低阶扇区。
Conclusion: 量子统计记忆既是近期可得的计算资源，也是识别哪些不变结构对预报重要的工具；对预报真正起作用的是低阶不变扇区，而非高阶关联。
Relevance: 47

papers.title: Modelling magnetic material properties with uncertainty-aware neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning is increasingly used to accelerate materials discovery across large compositional and structural design spaces, but limited and heterogeneous data make reliable uncertainty estimation essential. In this work, we investigate uncertainty quantification for permanent magnet modeling across three complementary studies. First, on a public Curie temperature surrogate dataset, we benchmark Gaussian process regression, random forest bagging, and dropout-based Bayesian neural networks and show that calibration, sharpness, and confidence curve diagnostics reveal differences in uncertainty quality that are not visible from point-prediction metrics alone. Second, we transfer this framework to the prediction of intrinsic magnetic properties in Nd2 Fe14 B-based magnets. Third, we extend the same uncertainty-aware perspective to coercivity prediction from microstructural information using a graph neural network. Together, these studies show that uncertainty quantification improves the trustworthiness of magnetic material property predictions and can be transferred from composition-based surrogate models to more complex structure-sensitive learning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在永磁材料建模中系统比较三类不确定性量化方法，发现校准度、锐度与置信曲线能暴露点预测指标看不出的不确定性质量差异，且该 UQ 框架可从成分代理模型迁移到图神经网络的矫顽力预测。
Motivation: 材料发现中数据有限且异质，仅看点预测指标无法判断预测是否可信，需要可靠的不确定性估计。
Method: 三项互补研究：在公开居里温度代理数据集上对比高斯过程回归、随机森林 bagging 与 dropout 贝叶斯神经网络；将该诊断框架迁移到 Nd2Fe14B 基磁体本征磁性能预测；再用图神经网络从微结构信息预测矫顽力并沿用同一不确定性视角。
Result: 校准度 (calibration)、锐度 (sharpness) 与置信曲线 (confidence curve) 诊断揭示了点预测指标 alone 看不出的不确定性质量差异；UQ 框架成功从基于成分的代理模型迁移到结构敏感的图神经网络矫顽力预测任务。
Conclusion: 不确定性量化能提升磁性材料属性预测的可信度，且可跨任务迁移：从成分代理模型到结构敏感学习任务均适用。

papers.title: CIAware-Bench: Benchmarking Control Intervention Awareness Across Frontier LLMs
papers.abstract_en: AI control protocols oversee untrusted models by monitoring their actions and modifying potentially unsafe steps, often using a trusted model. This partially tampers with the untrusted model's trajectory. If the acting model detects such an intervention, it may infer properties of the monitor and adapt to evade the control protocol. We introduce CIAware-Bench, a benchmark for measuring control intervention (CI) awareness across frontier models. CIAware-Bench tests whether models can distinguish their own trajectories from those modified by a control intervention. The benchmark comprises four task domains (essay writing, BigCodeBench, Bash Arena, and SHADE-Arena), with options to vary trajectory watermarking, side-task presence, and the control protocol. Evaluating thirteen acting models with eight intervening models shows substantial variation between settings and model pairs. CI awareness rises sharply for GPT-6 Astra and the Claude 5 models (Fable 5 and Opus 5). When explicitly probed, Astra reaches mean AUROC of 0.90 on Essay, 0.91 on BigCodeBench, 0.86 on Bash Arena and 0.77 on SHADE-Arena. Fable 5 and Opus 5 both reach 0.77 on Essay, with less consistent gains in the other environments. On SHADE-Arena, we demonstrate that telling an acting model that an action was replaced and asking it to adapt leads to moderate improvements in monitor evasion rates. In summary, our results highlight that control evaluations should already assume perfect CI awareness for conservative safety estimates, and that protocol design should explore countermeasures that make interventions harder to detect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CIAware-Bench 测量前沿 LLM 能否察觉自己的轨迹被控制干预 (control intervention) 篡改：在四个任务域上让 acting model 区分自身轨迹与被改写轨迹，GPT-6 Astra 显式探测下 AUROC 达 0.90（Essay）、0.91（BigCodeBench）、0.86（Bash Arena）、0.77（SHADE-Arena）。作者主张控制评估应直接假设干预完全可察觉以给出保守安全估计，协议设计需让干预更难检测。
Motivation: AI control 协议会篡改不受信模型的轨迹，一旦模型察觉干预就可能推断监视器性质并规避控制协议，而现有控制评估未把这种意识纳入安全估计。
Method: 提出 CIAware-Bench，含四个任务域（Essay writing、BigCodeBench、Bash Arena、SHADE-Arena），可变轨迹水印、side-task 有无与控制协议；评测 13 个 acting model 与 8 个 intervening model 的配对，并在 SHADE-Arena 上告知模型动作被替换并要求其适应。
Result: CI awareness 在 GPT-6 Astra 与 Claude 5 系列（Fable 5、Opus 5）上急剧上升；显式探测下 Astra 平均 AUROC 为 Essay 0.90、BigCodeBench 0.91、Bash Arena 0.86、SHADE-Arena 0.77；Fable 5 与 Opus 5 在 Essay 均达 0.77，其余环境增益不一致；SHADE-Arena 中告知动作被替换并要求适应使监视器规避率有中等程度提升。
Conclusion: 控制评估应直接假设完美的 CI awareness 以给出保守安全估计，控制协议设计需探索让干预更难被检测的对策。

papers.title: Ambiguous Strategic Classification
papers.abstract_en: A common assumption in strategic classification is that the classifier is public knowledge. However, it remains unclear whether, and why, a system would choose to commit to full disclosure. We study a setting in which regulation requires the system to disclose some, but not all, of the information. This induces a learning task in which the learner must jointly optimize the classifier and the uncertainty surrounding it. To this end, we adopt from robust mechanism design the notion of ambiguity, which in our setting allows the learner to reveal a set or range of possible classifiers, while privately choosing which of them to ultimately realize. We investigate how ambiguity affects the learning task, develop efficient algorithms for computing best-responses and training, and empirically explore strategic learning and its outcomes in this novel setting and using our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在监管只强制披露部分信息的战略分类 (strategic classification) 设定下，学习者可借稳健机制设计中的 ambiguity 披露一个可能分类器的集合或区间，同时私下选定最终实现哪一个，从而把分类器与其不确定性的联合优化变成可解的学习任务。作者给出计算 best-response 与训练的高效算法，并对该新设定下的战略学习结果做了实证探索。
Motivation: 战略分类通常假设分类器完全公开，但系统为何应主动全盘披露并不清楚；现实中监管往往只要求披露部分信息，此时分类器与其不确定性需要被联合优化。
Method: 从稳健机制设计引入 ambiguity 概念，允许学习者公布一个分类器的集合或区间并私下决定实现哪一个；在此框架下开发计算 best-response 与训练的高效算法，并对战略学习过程与结果做实证探索。
Result: 在该新设定下对战略学习及其结果进行了实证探索；摘要未给出具体数值对比。
Conclusion: 当披露被部分强制时，把分类器连同其不确定性一起优化是可行的学习任务，ambiguity 提供了实现这一点的机制化手段。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Unifying View of Attention Sinks: From Mechanisms to Architectural Interventions
papers.abstract_en: When attention concentrates on a single token, a sink, what is the model actually computing? Attention sinks are ubiquitous in softmax transformers, yet this shared visual signature can hide fundamentally different algorithms. We show that visually similar sink patterns can reflect two distinct mechanisms: (i) adaptive nop, where a head suppresses its update by routing to a null token, and (ii) broadcast, where a sink aggregates and redistributes global information. Each mechanism leaves distinct traces (nop-sinks exhibit negligible value norms; broadcast sinks induce low-rank outputs), which we formalize on synthetic tasks and use to derive practical diagnostics. Applied to pretrained vision transformers, these diagnostics reveal that both mechanisms exist at scale: sinks transition from CLS in early layers to patches in deeper layers and concentrate in specialized heads. Causal interventions further connect these signatures to near-null suppression and shared residual contributions. We then use architectural interventions to show how these computations can be reorganized: gating eliminates detected nop-like sinks but increases broadcast-like sinks, registers relocate rather than remove sink computation, and our position-free global pathway provides an explicit route for shared communication that reduces the broadcast-like sinks induced by gating. On dense probes, combining gating with the global pathway gives the strongest results among the tested variants, despite retaining some broadcast-like sinks. Overall, we find that the same attention pattern can reflect two very different computations, and that effective intervention depends not only on identifying the computation, but also on providing architectural alternatives through which the model can reorganize it.

papers.title: Scaling Participation in Modular AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Humanity is a mosaic of multifaceted talents and needs, and any truly intelligent AI must reflect that richness. Yet the LLMs used by all are built by the few -- a centralized market of monolithic AI models structurally ill-suited to capture the diversity of human knowledge, reasoning, and values. Here we introduce scaling participation, a new paradigm in which modular, community-sourced AI systems are built from the bottom up through the contributions of diverse stakeholders. Participants contribute small models trained on their own interests and priorities; these models then collaborate in modular frameworks as compositional AI systems, repurposing existing collaboration algorithms for this bottom-up paradigm. Participatory AI systems outperform monolithic LLMs by up to 15.42% (95% CI: [10.09%, 21.13%]) across 15 tasks, such as reasoning and factuality, surpassing models with more parameters than all contributed components combined. Further experiments show that these systems are especially strong at representing diverse cultures, values, and communities, benefit from contributor diversity, substantially improve on each contributor's original priorities, and exhibit emergent capabilities that allow them to solve over 15% of problems where all individual models fail. Scaling participation provides a technical foundation, demonstrated here with academic contributors and benchmark evaluations, for transitioning from the monolithic status quo toward an open, bottom-up, and collaborative AI future.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 scaling participation 范式：参与者各自贡献在自身兴趣与优先级上训练的小模型，再由既有协作算法在模块化框架中组合成参与式 AI 系统。在 15 项任务（推理、事实性等）上，参与式系统比单体 LLM 最多高出 15.42%（95% CI [10.09%, 21.13%]），且能解出所有单模型都失败的问题中超过 15%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 由少数机构以单体 (monolithic) 形态集中构建，结构上难以覆盖人类知识、推理与价值观的多样性。
Method: 参与者贡献各自在个人兴趣与优先级上训练的小模型，模块化框架复用既有协作算法 (collaboration algorithms) 把这些模型组合为参与式系统；评测覆盖推理与事实性等 15 项任务，并与参数量超过所有贡献组件总和的模型对比。
Result: 参与式系统在 15 项任务上比单体 LLM 最多提升 15.42%（95% CI [10.09%, 21.13%]），超过参数量大于全部贡献组件之和的模型；在多元文化、价值观与社区代表性上尤其强，受益于贡献者多样性，并在所有单模型均失败的问题上解出超过 15%。
Conclusion: 自下而上的模块化协作能在多样性和个体优先级改进上超过单体模型，并提供从单体现状走向开放式协作 AI 的技术基础；论文以学术贡献者与基准评测作为演示。

papers.title: STREAM: Stochastic Riemannian Flow Matching with Anisotropic Decoder for Digital Histopathology Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic histopathology image generation addresses patient-privacy concerns and the growing data demands of foundation models. Existing state-of-the-art histopathology generative models use pretrained Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) as conditioning signals. We show this yields conditioning-dominated diversity: on TCGA-BRCA, 62-75% of their output diversity is attributable to the conditioning signal rather than the learned latent space, while de novo synthesis still requires a VFM at inference. We instead use histopathology VFMs as the latent space itself: their patch tokens are $\ell_2$-normalized on the unit hypersphere $\mathcal{S}^{d-1}$ with strong angular dominance and intrinsic curvature, motivating a Riemannian formulation. We present STREAM, the first framework to apply Riemannian flow matching in the histopathology domain, in two stages: 1) a bridge-type stochastic perturbation that establishes per-token rectifiability on $\mathcal{S}^{d-1}$ for training a Diffusion Transformer, and 2) a novel decoder training design whose noise covariance is anisotropic in the left-singular basis of the per-token tangent-projected velocity-field Jacobian, spending a large robustness budget on its low-response directions and a small one on its high-response directions. Across TCGA-BRCA and TCGA-COADREAD, STREAM achieves state-of-the-art gFID and ranks first on nearly all histopathology-specific metrics as well. Code and a public gallery of generated images are available at https://chokevin8.github.io/STREAM-Patho/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STREAM 把病理 VFM 的 patch token 直接当作单位超球面 S^{d-1} 上的潜空间做 Riemannian flow matching，而非拿 VFM 当条件信号。先用 bridge 型随机扰动保证逐 token 可整性以训练 Diffusion Transformer，再让解码器噪声协方差沿逐 token 切空间投影速度场 Jacobian 的左奇异基呈各向异性。在 TCGA-BRCA 与 TCGA-COADREAD 上取得 SOTA gFID，并在几乎所有病理专属指标上排名第一。
Motivation: 现有病理生成模型用预训练 VFM 作条件信号，导致输出多样性被条件主导（TCGA-BRCA 上 62-75% 的多样性来自条件而非学到的潜空间），且推理时仍需 VFM 才能合成。
Method: 两阶段：1) bridge 型随机扰动在 S^{d-1} 上建立逐 token 可整性 (rectifiability)，用于训练 Diffusion Transformer；2) 解码器训练中噪声协方差取逐 token 切空间投影速度场 Jacobian 的左奇异基，在低响应方向分配大鲁棒性预算、高响应方向分配小预算。潜空间为 l2 归一化的 VFM patch token。
Result: 在 TCGA-BRCA 与 TCGA-COADREAD 上达到 SOTA gFID，并在几乎所有病理专属指标上排名第一；对照发现现有 SOTA 模型在 TCGA-BRCA 上 62-75% 的输出多样性可归因于条件信号而非学到的潜空间。
Conclusion: 把 VFM 当潜空间而非条件信号，配合各向异性解码器，可在病理图像生成上取得 SOTA 且无需推理期依赖 VFM 做 de novo 合成。

papers.title: Benchmarks in Leipzig
papers.abstract_en: Between April 1 and May 15, 2026, a group of 49 mathematicians compiled a dataset of research-level mathematics questions with known answers. Most of the work was done during the three-day workshop Benchmarks in Leipzig with 35 participants at the Max Planck Institute for Mathematics in the Sciences in Leipzig, Germany. We present the resulting collection of 100~questions. We evaluated these questions in three stages: a single attempt by five state-of-the-art LLMs and their predecessors, followed by a 20-runs-per-model evaluation with three of these models, and finally a 3-run attempt with two heavy-thinking models. After Stage 1, 41 questions remained completely unsolved; after Stage 2, this count dropped to 16; and we concluded Stage 3 with only 2 unsolved questions. This demonstrates that the mathematical reasoning capabilities of LLMs are becoming impressive. In September 2026, we added a fourth stage in which the next generation of models attempted all 100 questions once more, after which only 1 question remains unsolved.
papers.comment: 9 pages including 11 tables + 20 pages appendix containing the 100 Leipzig Benchmark questions. v2: adds the September 2026 re-run (Stage 4) with nine model configurations using web search and code execution
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 49 位数学家在 Leipzig 工作坊编出 100 道有已知答案的研究级数学题（Leipzig Benchmark），分阶段评测前沿 LLM：单次尝试后 41 题全未解，20 次重复后降到 16 题，重思考模型 3 次尝试后仅剩 2 题，2026 年 9 月下一代模型带联网搜索与代码执行再跑一遍后只剩 1 题未解。
Motivation: 缺少有已知答案、覆盖研究级数学的公开题集来衡量 LLM 的数学推理能力，且难以判断多次采样与更强推理配置能消掉多少难题。
Method: 由 49 位数学家（工作坊 35 人参与）在 2026 年 4 月 1 日至 5 月 15 日编制 100 道已知答案的研究级数学问题，附 11 张表与 20 页附录；评测分四阶段：Stage 1 五个 SOTA LLM 及其前身各答一次，Stage 2 其中三个模型各跑 20 次，Stage 3 两个 heavy-thinking 模型各试 3 次，Stage 4（2026 年 9 月）九种模型配置带 web search 与 code execution 各再答一次。
Result: Stage 1 后 41 题完全未解，Stage 2 后降至 16 题，Stage 3 结束仅剩 2 题未解；Stage 4 九种配置重跑全部 100 题后仅 1 题未解。
Conclusion: 随着重复采样、重思考模型以及联网搜索与代码执行的加入，LLM 在研究级数学题上的未解数从 41 降到 1，作者据此判断 LLM 数学推理能力正变得令人印象深刻。

papers.title: Beyond Objective Equivalence: Constraint Injection for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling on Vehicle Routing Problems
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can generate executable solver code from natural-language descriptions of optimization problems. However, existing verification signals focus on whether the generated formulation produces the correct objective value. Such signals can overlook constraint-level errors: incorrect formulations may still produce the same optimum when extra or missing constraints do not affect the tested instance. We propose constraint injection, a verification method that directly tests whether the generated code implements the intended constraints. We use feasible solutions to detect incorrectly added constraints and one-constraint-violating solutions to detect omissions. Together with the optimal value check, these tests verify both the objective and the constraint set. We evaluate this approach on vehicle routing problems (VRPs), which provide a challenging testbed with diverse, tightly coupled operational constraints. We develop VRPCoder, an 8B model for generating Gurobi code from natural-language VRP descriptions, and VRPBench, an expert-verified benchmark spanning 21 VRP variants across four subsets. The verifier serves as a rejection-sampling criterion for synthetic data construction and as a rollout-level reward for reinforcement learning (RL). On VRPBench, VRPCoder-RL reaches 93% overall Pass@1, outperforms Gemini-3.1-Pro Preview on three subsets, exceeds Claude-Sonnet-4.5 by 28 percentage points, and exceeds the strongest prior OR-LLM by 78 percentage points.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 11 figures, Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 生成优化求解代码时只校验目标值、漏掉约束级错误的问题，提出 constraint injection：用可行解检测多余约束、用单约束违反解检测缺失约束，与最优值校验共同构成验证信号。在 VRPBench（21 种 VRP 变体）上，VRPCoder-RL 达到 93% 总体 Pass@1，超过 Claude-Sonnet-4.5 28 个百分点、超过此前最强 OR-LLM 78 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有验证信号只看生成的 formulation 是否给出正确目标值；当多余或缺失的约束不影响被测实例时，错误模型仍能得到相同最优值，约束级错误因此被漏检。
Method: constraint injection 用可行解测试检测错误添加的约束，用 one-constraint-violating solutions 检测约束遗漏，再与最优值校验合并；该验证器既作为合成数据构造的 rejection-sampling 准则，也作为强化学习的 rollout-level reward。配套训练 8B 模型 VRPCoder 从自然语言 VRP 描述生成 Gurobi 代码，并构建专家校验的 VRPBench。
Result: VRPBench 覆盖 21 个 VRP 变体、分四个子集；VRPCoder-RL 总体 Pass@1 达 93%，在三个子集上超过 Gemini-3.1-Pro Preview，比 Claude-Sonnet-4.5 高 28 个百分点，比此前最强 OR-LLM 高 78 个百分点。
Conclusion: 目标值等价不等于 formulation 正确，把约束级测试与最优值校验一起作为验证与 RL 奖励，能在约束密集的 VRP 上显著抬高 LLM 生成求解代码的通过率。

papers.title: Learning Topological Representations of Protein Structure and Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Modern protein representation models support tasks such as enzyme design and drug discovery, but their reliance on static data such as sequence and native structure limits their ability to capture the conformational dynamics that drive protein function. We investigate whether persistent homology (PH) can provide descriptors shared across diverse proteins that retain global structure, fine-grained conformational variability, and kinetically relevant information without large-scale pretraining. We introduce the masked Flood complex, i.e., an adaptation of a recently proposed simplicial complex construction, that incorporates domain knowledge to emphasize inter-residue structure at low computational cost. We then use it to compute PH on molecular dynamics (MD) sampled structures, vectorize the persistence diagrams into a shared coordinate system, and probe the capacity of these representations in terms of the aforementioned aspects. To assess the amount of kinetic information, we learn low-dimensional embeddings from time-lagged observations and evaluate Markov state models (MSMs) estimated from them. Using these MSMs to guide training of the recent marsfm generative framework improves several ensemble statistics relative to the original model. After finetuning on lower-temperature MD data and adapting the sampling procedure, the resulting model also shows promising transfer to fast folding proteins.

Method: 提出 masked Flood complex（对近期单纯复形构造的改造，引入残基间结构的领域知识且计算开销低），在 MD 采样结构上计算 PH，将 persistence diagram 向量化为共享坐标系；从时滞观测学习低维嵌入，并评估由其估计的 MSM，再用这些 MSM 引导 marsfm 生成框架的训练。

papers.title: Text-to-Image Models Need Less from Text Encoders Than You Think
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image models rely on text prompts as their primary interface to human intent. Prompts are encoded by a text encoder into embeddings that condition the image generation process. Beyond individual token meanings, text embeddings encode contextual information across the full prompt, such as compositionality and attribute binding. However, whether image models actually exploit this richer information remains underexplored. Here, we address the question: Which aspects of text representation are essential for image generation? We show that text-to-image diffusion transformer-based models commonly rely only on two relatively straightforward aspects of text representations: (i) the merging of adjacent tokens into a word representation, for words spanning multiple tokens, and (ii) word order, which is imprinted by the positional embedding of the text-encoder. To show this, we construct a new text embedding that encodes only individual word meanings and order but lacks any contextual information about the full prompt. We find that this bag of position-tagged words representation is sufficient to successfully guide image generation, achieving visual quality and text fidelity that are on par with full text embedding-guided generation. This demonstrates that, contrary to common belief, text-to-image models often do not use the rich information encoded in the text embedding beyond individual word meanings and word order. Instead, the decoding of complex linguistic structures is performed by the image model itself. Project webpage: https://nsping13.github.io/contextless-TTI/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 文本到图像扩散 Transformer 实际只用到文本嵌入中的两件事：跨 token 的词合并与文本编码器位置嵌入带来的词序。作者构造只编码单词含义与词序、完全不含全提示上下文信息的 bag of position-tagged words 嵌入，其生成的视觉质量与文本保真度与完整文本嵌入引导持平，说明复杂语言结构的解码由图像模型自身完成。
Motivation: 文本嵌入除词义外还携带组合性、属性绑定等全提示上下文信息，但图像模型是否真的利用这些信息一直缺乏检验，这关系到文本编码器在生成管线中该承担多少。
Method: 构造一种新的文本嵌入表示，只编码单个词的含义与词序（bag of position-tagged words），刻意去除任何关于完整提示的上下文信息，再用它替换完整文本嵌入去条件化基于 diffusion transformer 的文生图模型，对比两种引导下的生成表现。
Result: 该无上下文表示足以成功引导图像生成，取得的视觉质量与文本保真度与完整文本嵌入引导的生成持平 (on par)。
Conclusion: 与通常认知相反，文生图模型往往并不使用文本嵌入中词义与词序之外的丰富信息，复杂语言结构的解码由图像模型自身完成。

papers.title: Low-Resource Safety Failures Are Action Failures, Not Representation Failures
papers.abstract_en: Language models often answer harmful requests in low-resource languages (LRLs) that they refuse in high-resource languages (HRLs). Across three instruction-tuned models and 23 languages, harmful refusal falls from 87.9% in HRLs to 43.9% in LRLs, while harmless refusal remains low. A common explanation is that models represent harmfulness weakly in LRLs. We test whether harmfulness is instead represented but does not reliably produce refusal. Across three models, a harmfulness direction learned from HRL activations still separates harmful from harmless LRL prompts, showing that complete absence of harmfulness information cannot explain many failures. However, harmfulness scores shift downward for LRL prompts, making harmful prompts less likely to reach the range associated with refusal. Motivated by this shift, we train a low-rank logistic classifier on HRL activations and calibrate its threshold with a few target-language examples. During generation, the classifier conditionally adds or ablates the HRL harmfulness direction. With the same HRL data and 32 target-language examples per class, CAST remains limited by low harmful refusal and AdaSteer by high harmless refusal, yielding mean refusal selectivity ($Δ$ = harmful - harmless refusal) of 33.6 and 6.8, respectively. Our intervention reaches 54.5 while preserving MMLU utility. HRL-only calibration improves selectivity for Qwen and Gemma, whereas Llama benefits from target-language calibration. These results show that recalibrating existing representations can offer a training-free method for repairing low-resource safety failures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 低资源语言 (LRL) 下模型答有害请求的根因不是危害性表征缺失，而是表征整体下移、够不到拒绝阈值。在 3 个指令微调模型、23 种语言上，有害拒绝率从高资源语言 (HRL) 的 87.9% 跌到 LRL 的 43.9%；用 HRL 激活训练低秩 logistic 分类器并按少量目标语言样本校准阈值、在生成时条件增删 HRL 危害方向 (CAST)，拒绝选择性 Δ 达 54.5，而 AdaSteer 仅 6.8。
Motivation: 模型在 LRL 中会回答在 HRL 中拒绝的有害请求，主流解释是 LRL 中危害性表征弱；需要判定失败究竟出在表征还是出在表征到拒绝动作的转化。
Method: 先检验从 HRL 激活学到的危害方向能否在 LRL 上区分有害与无害提示；再训练低秩 logistic 分类器，用少量目标语言样本校准阈值，生成过程中按分类器结果条件性地加入或消融 HRL 危害方向，训练-free 干预。
Result: 3 个模型、23 种语言上有害拒绝率 HRL 87.9% → LRL 43.9%，无害拒绝率保持低位；HRL 危害方向仍能分开 LRL 有害/无害提示，但 LRL 危害分数整体下移。同等 HRL 数据加每类 32 个目标语言样本下，CAST 拒绝选择性 Δ=54.5，AdaSteer 33.6，低拒绝的 CAST 与高无害拒绝的 AdaSteer 分别受限，MMLU 效用保持；HRL-only 校准对 Qwen、Gemma 有效，Llama 需目标语言校准。
Conclusion: 低资源安全失败是动作（拒绝阈值）失败而非表征失败，重校准既有表征即可训练-free 地修复，且校准数据来源因模型而异。

papers.title: Cost-Effective Automated Judging of Natural-Language Mathematical Proofs
papers.abstract_en: Grading natural-language mathematical proofs is a recurring cost in evaluating math-reasoning systems, and frontier LLM judges are expensive. We ask whether cheap open-weight models can serve as reliable judges given a candidate proof, a ground-truth proof, and a human-grading rubric. On a 200-instance validation sample of IMO-GradingBench, two of three cheap judges (GPT-OSS-120B, DeepSeek-V4-Flash) and their three-model consensus are statistically no worse than the frontier (Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini 3.1 Pro) on agreement with human pass/fail decisions, at 4-100$\times$ lower cost. On the full 1000-instance benchmark, the choice of consensus rule over the three judges is a precision/recall dial: unanimous (all-three-pass) rules reach the highest precision (0.855), majority vote the highest recall (0.912); across four replicate runs the unanimous rule is also the steadiest. No rule won outright; the dial replicated on a held-out 600-instance split and on the independent ProofBench. In this domain, cheap judges are competitive with the frontier at one to two orders of magnitude lower cost, and unanimity is the right setting when false positives are costly.
papers.comment: Accepted as a poster at the 6th Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MATH-AI), NeurIPS 2026. v2: workshop camera-ready with added analysis. 5 pages main text, 12 pages total, 5 figures, 9 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 IMO-GradingBench 上用廉价开源模型（GPT-OSS-120B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash）加人写评分 rubric 判数学证明通过与否，200 条验证样本上其中两个廉价裁判与三模型共识同人类 pass/fail 的一致性统计上不劣于 Claude Opus 4.7 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro，成本低 4–100 倍。全 1000 条上共识规则是精确率/召回率旋钮：unanimous 精确率 0.855 最高，majority vote 召回 0.912 最高；假阳性代价高时选 unanimous。
Motivation: 评估数学推理系统需要反复人工批改自然语言证明，前沿 LLM 裁判成本高，问题是最便宜的开源模型能否在给定候选证明、标准答案证明和人写 rubric 时当可靠裁判。
Method: 裁判输入为候选证明、ground-truth proof 与人写评分 rubric，由三个廉价开源模型分别判定再按共识规则聚合；在 IMO-GradingBench 的 200 条验证样本上与前沿裁判（Claude Opus 4.7、Gemini 3.1 Pro）比人类 pass/fail 一致性，并在全 1000 条上比较 unanimous（all-three-pass）与 majority vote 等规则，做四次重复运行。
Result: 200 条验证样本上，三个廉价裁判中的两个（GPT-OSS-120B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash）及其三模型共识与人类 pass/fail 的一致性统计上不劣于前沿裁判，成本低 4–100 倍。全 1000 条上 unanimous 精确率 0.855 最高、majority vote 召回 0.912 最高，四次重复中 unanimous 最稳；该旋钮在留出的 600 条划分与独立 ProofBench 上复现。
Conclusion: 在该领域廉价裁判以低一到两个数量级的成本与前沿裁判竞争，没有哪条共识规则全面胜出；假阳性代价高时 unanimity 是正确设置。

papers.title: Lightweight CNN-Based Anomaly Detection for High Voltage Converter Modulators in the Spallation Neutron Source
papers.abstract_en: Time series anomaly detection is central to monitoring industrial and scientific equipment, where anomalous sensor readings can precede failures. As such equipment usually carries several sensors, a detector must also decide how to model the dependencies between channels. In many physical systems, normal behaviour is defined by how groups of sensors evolve together, and an anomaly can appear as the coupling or decoupling of sensors while each signal remains normal. Anomalies in popular public benchmarks, however, are mostly visible in single channels, so these benchmarks cannot show whether modelling inter-channel dependencies improves detection. We study this on the High Voltage Converter Modulators (HVCMs) of the Spallation Neutron Source (SNS), whose fourteen sensors are physically coupled and whose faults are labelled by type. Keeping a convolutional neural network (CNN) fixed, we vary only whether its blocks combine channels before or after temporal filtering, and measure detection for each SNS subsystem and fault family. The effect of this choice depends on how visible each fault family is on a single channel. Families clearly visible on one channel are detected equally well by all variants, whereas weakly separable families, such as flux faults, gain consistently when channels are combined first. Modelling the dependencies between channels therefore helps only where individual channels do not already reveal the fault. The best detector reaches an average area under the precision--recall curve of 0.816, competitive with published HVCM detectors at roughly half the parameters of a standard CNN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在散裂中子源 (SNS) 高压转换调制器 (HVCM) 的 14 路耦合传感器上，固定 CNN 只改变通道合并与时间滤波的先后顺序，检验跨通道依赖建模何时真正提升异常检测。单通道上清晰可见的故障家族各变体检出相当，而弱可分的 flux fault 在先合并通道时稳定获益；最佳检测器平均 AUPRC 达 0.816，参数量约为标准 CNN 的一半。
Motivation: 公开时序异常检测基准的异常多在单通道可见，无法回答建模通道间依赖是否改善检测；而工业设备故障常表现为传感器间耦合或解耦、各信号本身仍正常。
Method: 保持 CNN 结构固定，仅改变其模块是先合并通道再做时间滤波、还是先时间滤波再合并通道，按 SNS 子系统与故障家族分别测量检测效果；数据为带故障类型标注的 HVCM 十四路传感器时序。
Result: 最佳检测器平均 AUPRC 为 0.816，与已发表的 HVCM 检测器相当，参数量约为标准 CNN 的一半；单通道上清晰可见的故障家族各变体表现相当，弱可分的 flux fault 在先合并通道的变体上稳定获益。
Conclusion: 跨通道依赖建模只在单通道本身不足以暴露故障时才有增益，因此是否先合并通道应按故障家族在单通道上的可见程度来选。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 最佳检测器平均 AUPRC 为 0.816，与已发表的 HVCM 检测器相当，参数量约为标准 CNN 的一半；单通道上清晰可见的故障家族各变体表现相当，弱可分的 flux fault 在先合并通道的变体上稳定获益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 跨通道依赖建模只在单通道本身不足以暴露故障时才有增益，因此是否先合并通道应按故障家族在单通道上的可见程度来选。

papers.title: Trajectory-Aware Best-Arm Identification for Local Search Allocation in Bayesian Optimization and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization (BO) is effective for expensive black-box optimization, but its performance often degrades on multimodal or high-dimensional problems. A promising remedy is to run multiple local search processes, such as trust region--based BO, and allocate evaluations to those with high potential. However, current best values do not always reflect the final performance of each process. We propose a trajectory-aware best-arm identification (BAI) framework that uses optimization history to guide this allocation. The proposed method extrapolates improvement trajectories, estimates final performance, and progressively eliminates low-potential candidates. For trust region--based BO, we theoretically show that the proposed BAI-guided allocation accelerates convergence to the global optimum under mild assumptions. Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that our method improves BO on multimodal problems. We also show that the same mechanism can enhance other local or population-based optimizers, suggesting its potential as a general extension strategy for multimodal black-box optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出轨迹感知的最优臂识别 (trajectory-aware best-arm identification) 框架，用优化历史外推各局部搜索过程的改进轨迹、估计最终性能，并逐步淘汰低潜力候选，以此指导 trust region 类贝叶斯优化的评估分配。在温和假设下证明该 BAI 引导分配加速收敛到全局最优，合成与真实基准实验显示其改善多模态问题上的 BO 表现。
Motivation: 多模态或高维黑箱问题上 BO 性能下降，改跑多个局部搜索（如 trust region BO）再分配评估是可行出路，但当前最优值并不能反映各过程的最终表现，导致分配失准。
Method: 轨迹感知 BAI 框架：外推每个局部搜索过程的改进轨迹、估计其最终性能，并逐步消除 (progressively eliminate) 低潜力候选，把评估预算导向高潜力过程；机制可套用到其他局部或群体优化器。
Result: 在温和假设下理论上证明 BAI 引导的分配加速 trust region BO 收敛到全局最优；合成与真实基准实验表明该方法改善多模态问题上的 BO，并可增强其他局部或群体优化器。
Conclusion: 以优化历史而非当前最优值来分配评估，是多模态黑箱优化的通用扩展策略，可推广到 trust region BO 之外的局部与群体优化器。

papers.title: MEMENTO: Leveraging Web as a Learning Signal for Low-Data Domains
papers.abstract_en: Real-world tasks often lack large labeled datasets, motivating extensive work on learning in low-data regimes. Existing approaches such as few-shot prompting, instruction tuning, and synthetic data generation, continue to treat labeled or pseudo-labeled data as the primary learning signal. In contrast, human practitioners acquire expertise through repeated, self-directed interaction with the open web, progressively refining both domain knowledge and search strategies. We propose MEMENTO, a framework that treats the web as a learning signal rather than a stateless retrieval interface. MEMENTO operates at two levels: within each session, it conducts iterative web exploration via an Adaptive Exploration Tree (AET) that decomposes tasks into evolving questions and reflects on intermediate findings; across sessions, it accumulates experience through dual-channel memory, separating declarative knowledge (facts) from procedural knowledge (search strategies). This design enables agents to learn reusable research strategies and domain expertise from trajectories of web interaction without additional model training. We evaluate MEMENTO on three structurally distinct low-data domains: Sales Automation, Legal Outcome Prediction, and Subpopulation Opinion Prediction. Our empirical results show consistent improvement in performance over ReAct baselines (+25.6% on sales, +36.5% on legal research, and 29.6% TVD reduction on opinion prediction), demonstrating that the web can serve as a scalable learning source for acquiring task-specific expertise in data-scarce settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MEMENTO 把开放网页当作可积累的学习信号而非一次性检索接口：会话内用 Adaptive Exploration Tree (AET) 把任务拆成不断演化的问题并反思中间发现，跨会话用双通道记忆分离事实性知识与搜索策略，从而在不额外训练模型的情况下复用研究策略。在 Sales Automation、Legal Outcome Prediction、Subpopulation Opinion Prediction 三个低数据域上，相对 ReAct 基线分别提升 25.6%、36.5%，意见预测 TVD 降低 29.6%。
Motivation: 低数据域缺少大规模标注集，而 few-shot prompting、instruction tuning、合成数据生成仍把标注或伪标注数据当作主要学习信号，无法像人类那样通过反复自主的网页交互积累领域知识与检索策略。
Method: MEMENTO 分两层运作：会话内通过 Adaptive Exploration Tree (AET) 迭代探索网页，把任务分解为演化中的问题并对中间发现做反思；跨会话用双通道记忆 (dual-channel memory) 累积经验，将陈述性知识（facts）与程序性知识（search strategies）分开存储，全程无需额外模型训练。
Result: 在三个结构不同的低数据域上相对 ReAct 基线一致提升：Sales Automation +25.6%，Legal Outcome Prediction +36.5%，Subpopulation Opinion Prediction 的 TVD 降低 29.6%。
Conclusion: 网页可以作为可扩展的学习来源，让 agent 在数据稀缺设定下从网页交互轨迹中习得任务专属专长与可复用的研究策略，而不必改动模型参数。

papers.title: Plant, Persist, Trigger: Sleeper Attack on Large Language Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents remain vulnerable to safety threats from the external environment, where attackers inject adversarial content into external observations such as tool-returned data, webpages, or MCP context, causing harmful agentic behaviors such as unsafe actions or incorrect outputs. Existing studies typically focus on single-interaction attacks, where the agent observes adversarial content and immediately exhibits harmful behavior within one user request. However, we show that adversarial content can also persist across interactions served by the same agent, making such threats harder to detect and mitigate. Specifically, adversarial content may persist in the agent state, remain dormant across interactions, and later be activated by a benign user query. We formalize this type of safety threat as Sleeper Attack. To evaluate it, we construct a benchmark with 1,896 instances covering six real-world harmful outcomes, three attack strategies, and three agent state targets: session context, memory, and reusable skills. Experiments on seven strong open-source and closed-source LLMs show that state-of-the-art LLM agents remain vulnerable to Sleeper Attack, even when they achieve low attack success rates under a single-interaction baseline. Our code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/skdvnfu23ihr9wdscnksf1asdffsaef.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM agent 的跨交互持久化对抗注入形式化为 Sleeper Attack：恶意内容先植入 session context、memory 或 reusable skills，休眠若干轮后由良性查询触发，产生有害动作或错误输出。在 1,896 个实例、六类真实有害结果、三种攻击策略与七个开源/闭源模型上，即使单交互基线攻击成功率很低，Sleeper Attack 仍能成功。
Motivation: 现有 agent 安全研究集中在单次交互内即触发的攻击，而对抗内容可在同一 agent 的状态中跨交互存留、休眠后再被激活，更难检测与缓解。
Method: 构造覆盖 1,896 个实例的基准，按三种攻击策略与三类 agent 状态目标（session context、memory、reusable skills）组织，对应六种真实世界有害结果；在七个强开源与闭源 LLM 上做实验，并与单交互基线对照。
Result: 基准含 1,896 个实例、六种有害结果、三种攻击策略、三种状态目标；七个 LLM 上，模型在单交互基线中攻击成功率低时，Sleeper Attack 仍保持脆弱。
Conclusion: 跨交互的状态持久化是 LLM agent 的独立攻击面，单交互攻击成功率低不能作为 agent 安全的证据。

papers.title: SPHERE-JEPA: Spherical Prediction with Homogeneous Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental open question in self-supervised learning (SSL) is the explicit characterization of the optimal geometry of the learned representations. Recently, LeJEPA identified isotropic Gaussian embeddings as optimal for minimizing downstream prediction risk in Euclidean spaces. However, the corresponding problem for distributions supported on lower-dimensional manifolds, such as the hypersphere, remains unexplored. In this work, we demonstrate that extending this minimax analysis to smooth distributions on Riemannian manifolds fundamentally changes the optimal solution. We show that, under a worst-case formulation, both k-nearest neighbors and kernel ridge regression induce hyperspherical uniformity. More precisely, we show that uniform distributions on manifolds are optimal for k-nearest neighbors, and that the uniform distribution on the sphere is optimal for kernel ridge regression with both the exponential dot-product kernel and the linear kernel. This theoretical insight reveals a fundamental limitation of Gaussian embeddings: their non-uniform density induces anisotropic k-NN neighborhoods, severely biasing the estimator. To correct this, we introduce SPHERE-JEPA, a theoretically grounded SSL framework. We adapt LeJEPA's Cram{é}r-Wold projection mechanism to enforce hyperspherical uniformity rather than a Gaussian prior. Empirically, SPHERE-JEPA yields significant improvements, boosting texture retrieval mAP by over 6%, while consistently matching or outperforming LeJEPA on standard benchmarks-including a +1.8% linear probing gain on ImageNet-1K (ViT-B/14).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LeJEPA 的 minimax 最优嵌入分析从欧氏空间推广到黎曼流形，证明在最坏情形下 k-NN 与核岭回归都要求超球面均匀分布，而高斯嵌入的非均匀密度会造成各向异性 k-NN 邻域并严重偏置估计器。据此提出 SPHERE-JEPA：改造 Cramér-Wold 投影机制以强制超球面均匀性而非高斯先验。纹理检索 mAP 提升超过 6%，在 ImageNet-1K 线性探测 (ViT-B/14) 上 +1.8%，其余标准基准持平或优于 LeJEPA。
Motivation: LeJEPA 指出欧氏空间中各向同性高斯嵌入是最优的，但分布支撑在低维流形（如超球面）时的最优几何尚无刻画，直接沿用高斯先验会让 k-NN 邻域各向异性、偏置下游估计器。
Method: 将 minimax 分析扩展到 Riemannian 流形上的光滑分布，证明流形上均匀分布对 k-NN 最优、球面均匀分布对指数点积核与线性核的核岭回归最优；再提出 SPHERE-JEPA，把 LeJEPA 的 Cramér-Wold 投影机制改为强制超球面均匀性而非高斯先验。
Result: 纹理检索 mAP 提升超过 6%；ImageNet-1K 线性探测 (ViT-B/14) +1.8%；在标准基准上持平或优于 LeJEPA。
Conclusion: 流形支撑会改变 SSL 表示的最优几何：高斯先验在球面上是错的，超球面均匀性才是 k-NN 与核岭回归下的 minimax 最优，且这一理论判断带来可测的下游增益。

papers.title: Function-Valued Causal Influence in Nonlinear Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery in time series is increasingly performed using nonlinear machine-learning models, yet the resulting causal relationships are almost always summarized by scalar edge scores. We argue that this practice obscures the true object learned by nonlinear autoregressive models: a state-dependent function whose effect varies across regimes, magnitudes, and contexts. We formalize function-valued causal influence for additive, contribution-decomposable architectures and show that scalar causal scores constitute a severe information bottleneck, conflating between-state variation with within-state residual noise. Using Neural Additive Vector Autoregression as a representative architecture, we introduce a practical framework based on Individual Conditional Expectation for estimating causal response functions directly from trained models. Through controlled synthetic experiments, we demonstrate that edges with indistinguishable scalar scores can exhibit qualitatively different functional behaviors, including monotonic, thresholded, saturating, and sign-changing effects. An applied case study on democratic development further shows that function-valued analysis reveals regime-specific and asymmetric causal structure systematically missed by score-centric approaches.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of Machine Learning Research, 2026, 306:61873-6189
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出非线性时序因果发现把学到的状态依赖因果函数压成标量边分数，会把状态间变化与状态内残差噪声混在一起；提出基于 Individual Conditional Expectation 的框架，直接从 Neural Additive Vector Autoregression 训练好的模型中估计因果响应函数。受控合成实验显示标量分数无法区分的边可呈现单调、阈值、饱和、变号等定性不同的函数行为。
Motivation: 非线性自回归模型学到的因果影响本是随状态、幅度、上下文变化的函数，但实践中几乎总被汇总成标量边分数，构成严重信息瓶颈，掩盖了不同机制的边。
Method: 针对 additive、contribution-decomposable 架构形式化 function-valued causal influence，以 Neural Additive Vector Autoregression 为代表架构，用 Individual Conditional Expectation 从已训练模型直接估计因果响应函数，并在受控合成实验与民主发展案例上做检验。
Result: 受控合成实验中，标量分数 indistinguishable 的边呈现单调、阈值、饱和、变号等定性不同的函数行为；民主发展案例显示 function-valued 分析揭示出以分数为中心的方法系统性遗漏的 regime-specific 与非对称因果结构。
Conclusion: 标量因果分数会系统性掩盖非线性时序中的状态依赖与非对称因果结构，因果边应按函数而非分数来报告。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Erased but Exploitable: Black-box Embedding-Aware Prompting Against Unlearned Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning aims to remove specific concepts from pretrained text-to-image diffusion models, yet several white- and black-box attacks have been introduced to make the model generate such unlearned concepts. These attacks, nevertheless, do not assume a realistic threat model, i.e. they either assume access to the model weights, or result in gibberish adversarial prompts that could be easily detected even through naive rule-based safeguarding. We aim to address this gap in this paper. We introduce BEAP, a black-box, embedding-aware adversarial prompting attack that leverages a large language model (LLM) to iteratively generate effective adversarial prompts and exploit such hidden vulnerabilities. BEAP performs an embedding-aware search in text space, combining multiple reward signals: unlearned concept presence, text-image alignment, and image quality, to refine generated prompts. Unlike previous attack methods, BEAP keeps its prompts undetectable to safety filters while producing high-quality images. Across five unlearning methods, BEAP achieves a macro-averaged ASR of 97.8% under the held-out OpenNSFW2 evaluation, exceeding the white-box UDA baseline by 41.6 percentage points (56.2% to 97.8%). Counting unsuccessful searches at the full 100-query budget, BEAP uses 32.1 image-generation queries per evaluated prompt on average under this criterion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BEAP 是针对已遗忘 (machine unlearning) 文生图扩散模型的黑盒、embedding 感知对抗提示攻击：用 LLM 在文本空间迭代搜索，组合未学习概念存在度、文本-图像对齐、图像质量三类奖励信号，生成的提示对安全过滤器不可检出。在五种遗忘方法上，held-out OpenNSFW2 评测下宏平均 ASR 达 97.8%，比白盒基线 UDA 高 41.6 个百分点（56.2%→97.8%），平均每条提示用 32.1 次图像生成查询（含失败搜索、按 100 次预算计）。
Motivation: 现有白盒与黑盒攻击要么需要模型权重，要么产生可被朴素规则过滤器检出的乱码提示，威胁模型不现实；遗忘后的概念仍可被黑盒方式唤回这一漏洞因此未被公平刻画。
Method: BEAP 用 LLM 迭代生成候选提示，在文本空间做 embedding-aware search，奖励信号包括未学习概念存在度、文本-图像对齐与图像质量；查询预算为每条提示 100 次图像生成，评测用 held-out OpenNSFW2 判定概念是否被唤回。
Result: 在五种遗忘方法上，BEAP 宏平均 ASR 97.8%（held-out OpenNSFW2），超过白盒 UDA 基线 41.6 个百分点，即 56.2% 提升到 97.8%；把失败搜索也计入 100 次查询预算后，每条被评测提示平均消耗 32.1 次图像生成查询。
Conclusion: 遗忘在黑盒、可检出性受限的提示攻击面前并不稳固：embedding 感知的 LLM 搜索能在不触发安全过滤器的前提下以远低于预算的查询量恢复被移除概念。
