papers.title: Transcoders Trace Visual Grounding and Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Generative Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well on multimodal reasoning, but how visual inputs are transformed to text remains poorly understood. Existing interpretability work on VLMs uses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), which decompose static residual representations and miss the functional updates that drive cross-modal interaction. We adopt a function-centric framework based on Transcoders, sparse approximations of MLP sublayers that act as a causal proxy for layer-wise computation. Applied to Gemma 3-4B-IT, the framework decomposes the model into interpretable computational pathways linking image patches to directions in token generation. Transcoder attributions produce stronger and more stable effects on visually grounded tokens under patch ablation than SAE attributions, and align better with semantically relevant image regions. A False Visual Grounding counterfactual analysis confirms that the recovered pathways are specific to vision-language interaction.Finally, we perform a structural analysis of hallucinated generations, by extracting graph-based indicators from circuit traces produced by the transcoders. A logistic classifier over these mechanistic graph features predicts hallucinations at AUC $0.68$. These results show that function-centric circuit decomposition yields interpretable and predictive accounts of multimodal computation in VLMs.
papers.comment: Later experiments showed that the reported results are not correct.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Transcoder（MLP 子层的稀疏逼近）做函数中心的机制可解释性分析，在 Gemma 3-4B-IT 上把图像 patch 连到 token 生成方向的可解释计算通路。Transcoder 归因在 patch 消融下对视觉接地 token 的效应比 SAE 更强更稳，且更贴合语义相关图像区域；基于电路轨迹图特征的 logistic 分类器预测幻觉 AUC 为 0.68。注意 arXiv comment 声明后续实验表明所报告结果不正确。
Motivation: VLM 如何把视觉输入转成文本仍不清楚；现有 SAE 类可解释性工作分解的是静态残差表示，抓不到驱动跨模态交互的功能性更新。
Method: 采用基于 Transcoder 的函数中心框架，把 MLP 子层作为逐层计算的因果代理做稀疏分解；在 Gemma 3-4B-IT 上得到连接图像 patch 与 token 生成方向的通路，配合 patch 消融、False Visual Grounding 反事实分析，并从 transcoder 电路轨迹中提取图结构指标送入 logistic 分类器。
Result: Transcoder 归因在 patch 消融下对视觉接地 token 产生比 SAE 归因更强且更稳定的效应，并与语义相关图像区域更吻合；False Visual Grounding 反事实分析确认恢复出的通路为视觉-语言交互特有；图特征 logistic 分类器预测幻觉 AUC 为 0.68。
Conclusion: 函数中心的电路分解能给出可解释且可预测的多模态计算说明；但 arXiv comment 声明后续实验显示所报告结果不正确，结论应视为已被作者撤回性标注。

papers.title: TextReg: Mitigating Prompt Distributional Overfitting via Regularized Text-Space Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are highly sensitive to the prompts used to specify task objectives and behavioral constraints. Many recent prompt optimization methods iteratively rewrite prompts using LLM-generated feedback, but the resulting prompts often become longer, accumulate narrow sample-specific rules, and generalize poorly beyond the training distribution. We study this failure mode as prompt distributional overfitting and argue that it reflects a lack of representation control in discrete text-space optimization. We formalize this view through representational inefficiency, a dual-factor measure that decomposes prompt inefficiency into capacity cost and scope narrowness, attributing distributional prompt overfitting to their coupled growth during optimization. We propose TextReg, a regularization framework that realizes a soft-penalty objective through regularized textual gradients, combining Dual-Evidence Gradient Purification, Semantic Edit Regularization, and Regularization-Guided Prompt Update. Across multiple reasoning benchmarks, TextReg substantially improves out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, with accuracy gains of up to +11.8% over TextGrad and +16.5% over REVOLVE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TextReg 把提示词优化中的分布外泛化差归因于表示控制缺失，并用正则化文本梯度约束离散文本空间搜索。在多个推理基准上，其 OOD 准确率相对 TextGrad 最高提升 +11.8%，相对 REVOLVE 最高提升 +16.5%。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 反馈迭代改写的提示词会变长、堆积样本特有规则，越出训练分布后泛化差；作者将其归因于离散文本空间优化缺少表示控制。
Method: 提出 TextReg 正则化框架，通过正则化文本梯度实现软惩罚目标，包含三个组件：Dual-Evidence Gradient Purification、Semantic Edit Regularization、Regularization-Guided Prompt Update；并以双因子度量 representational inefficiency 把提示词低效分解为 capacity cost 与 scope narrowness。
Result: 在多个推理基准上，TextReg 相对 TextGrad 的 OOD 准确率增益最高达 +11.8%，相对 REVOLVE 最高达 +16.5%。
Conclusion: 分布外泛化差源于优化过程中 capacity cost 与 scope narrowness 的耦合增长，对文本梯度与语义编辑施加正则可改善 OOD 泛化。

papers.title: An Assessment of Human vs. Model Uncertainty in Soft-Label Learning and Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Central to human-aligned AI is understanding the benefits of human-elicited labels over synthetic alternatives. While human soft-labels improve calibration by capturing uncertainty, prior studies conflate these benefits with the implicit correction of mislabeled data (mode shifts), obscuring true effects of soft-labels. We present a controlled audit of soft-label learning across MNIST and a synthetic variant, re-annotating subsets to extract human uncertainty. By decoupling soft-label supervision from underlying label mode shifts, we show that while human soft-labels do provide accuracy gains, their larger value lies in acting as a regularizer that improves model calibration on difficult samples and promotes stable convergence across training runs. Dataset cartography reveals models trained on human soft-labels mirror human uncertainty, whereas those trained on synthetic labels fail to align with humans. Broadly, this work provides a diagnostic testbed for human-AI uncertainty alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MNIST 及其合成变体上做受控审计，把软标签监督与标签模式偏移 (mode shifts) 解耦后发现：人类软标签确实带来准确率提升，但更大价值在于充当正则器——改善困难样本上的模型校准 (calibration)、并让多次训练运行收敛更稳定；数据集制图 (dataset cartography) 显示人类软标签训练的模型能镜像人类不确定性，而合成标签训练的模型与人类不对齐。
Motivation: 既往研究把人类软标签的收益与对错标数据的隐式修正 (mode shifts) 混在一起，导致软标签的真实作用被掩盖，无法判断人类标签相对合成标签的真正优势。
Method: 在 MNIST 与一个合成变体上重新标注子集以提取人类不确定性，将软标签监督与底层标签模式偏移解耦，做受控审计；用 dataset cartography 比较人类软标签与合成标签训练出的模型与人类不确定性的对齐情况。
Result: 解耦后人类软标签仍带来准确率增益，其更大价值体现在改善困难样本上的校准并促进跨训练运行的稳定收敛；dataset cartography 显示人类软标签模型镜像人类不确定性，合成标签模型则与人类不对齐。
Conclusion: 人类软标签的作用主要是正则化与不确定性对齐，而非仅仅修正错标；该工作同时提供了一个用于人机不确定性对齐的诊断测试床。

papers.title: TILT: Model-Intrinsic Reward Alignment For Compositional Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Consider conditional generation $p(x \mid C=\{c_1, c_2, \dots c_k\})$ where $C$ is a prompt composed of multiple concepts $c_i$. Diffusion models often struggle with compositional prompts, producing samples in which some concepts dominate while others are missing or weakly represented. Prior work attributes these failures to mode collision, where single-concept modes of $p(x\mid c_i)$ overlap with modes of the joint $p(x \mid C)$. To seek out collision-free modes of $p(x \mid C)$, or "pure modes", corrector-based approaches have attempted to suppress collisions at intermediate diffusion times. However, local corrections are often heuristic and do not necessarily steer the generation to a "pure mode" in the final data space. Derived from a principled formulation, we present TILT (Test-time model-Intrinsic reward aLignment via Tilting), a training-free framework that poses eventual pure mode sampling as a reward for intermediate-time alignment. This reward offers valuable advantages: (1) it is intrinsic to the model, hence external reward models need not be trained by modality-specific datasets, (2) it yields a closed-form target under a variational approximation, which makes it realizable through standard diffusion sampling, and (3) it is interpretable, hence amenable to preference-based modifications. Project page: https://debottam-dutta7.github.io/tilt_web/
papers.comment: Extended version. An earlier short version appeared in ICML2026 SPIGM workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TILT 把组合式扩散最终采到无碰撞纯模式 (pure mode) 的目标写成中间时刻对齐的奖励，提出免训练的测试时模型内禀奖励对齐框架。该奖励由模型自身给出、无需按模态训练外部奖励模型，在变分近似下有闭式目标，可直接用标准扩散采样实现，并因可解释而便于做基于偏好的改造。
Motivation: 组合式提示下扩散模型常出现某些概念主导、另一些缺失或偏弱，既有工作归因于单概念模式与联合分布模式重叠的 mode collision，而基于 corrector 的中间时刻局部修正多为启发式，未必能把最终数据空间的生成导向纯模式。
Method: TILT (Test-time model-Intrinsic reward aLignment via Tilting) 是免训练框架：把最终纯模式采样形式化为对中间时刻对齐的奖励，奖励内禀于模型本身，在变分近似 (variational approximation) 下导出闭式目标，通过标准扩散采样实现，并支持基于偏好的修改。
Result: 摘要给出的是框架性质而非实验数字：奖励无需按模态数据集训练外部奖励模型，闭式目标使其可用标准扩散采样落地，且可解释、可做偏好式改造；摘要未陈述任何定量对比结果。
Conclusion: 把纯模式采样当作中间时刻对齐的奖励，可以在不训练外部奖励模型的前提下，用标准扩散采样把组合式生成从局部启发式修正推向最终数据空间的无碰撞模式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Fused Prior Transfer for Controllable Generative Image Compression
papers.abstract_en: At very low bitrates, image compression discards fine textures and local structures, while distortion-oriented reconstruction often produces over-smoothed images. Generative codecs synthesize missing details, but existing codebook-based controllable designs generally rely on single-codebook reconstruction priors. We propose Adaptive Fused Prior Transfer for Controllable Generative Image Compression (AFP-GIC), which transfers an image-adaptive fused prior from a frozen pretrained AdaCode model. Encoder-side prior features guide latent formation, while the decoder predicts a compatible fused prior from the compressed representation and control variables, without transmitting the prior itself. A motivating analysis shows that better decoder-side prior alignment tightens a reconstruction-error upper bound and that the fused-prior family includes single-codebook choices as special cases. A single pretrained model supports five evaluated bitrate operating points. Under the unified benchmark, AFP-GIC achieves 18.1% lower decoder latency and uses 31.10 million (20.5%) fewer inference parameters than DC-VIC. Experiments on Kodak, CLIC2020, and DIV2K show competitive PSNR and SSIM, with the clearest naturalness gains in NIQE scores and very-low-bitrate visual comparisons. Code: https://github.com/yifeipet/AFP_GIC.

TL;DR: AFP-GIC 在生成式图像压缩中把冻结的预训练 AdaCode 的图像自适应融合先验迁移到编解码两端：编码器用先验特征引导 latent 形成，解码器从压缩表示与控制变量预测兼容的融合先验而不传输先验本身。在统一基准下相对 DC-VIC 解码延迟降低 18.1%、推理参数少 3110 万（20.5%），Kodak、CLIC2020、DIV2K 上 PSNR/SSIM 有竞争力，NIQE 与极低码率视觉对比的自然度提升最明显。
Motivation: 极低码率下图像压缩丢弃细纹理与局部结构，失真导向的重建又常产生过平滑结果；现有基于 codebook 的可控生成编解码器普遍只依赖单一 codebook 的重建先验，表达能力受限。
Method: AFP-GIC 从冻结的预训练 AdaCode 迁移图像自适应的融合先验 (fused prior)：编码器侧先验特征引导 latent 形成，解码器从压缩表示与控制变量预测与之兼容的融合先验，先验本身不传输。配套的动机分析表明更好的解码端先验对齐会收紧重建误差上界，且融合先验族把单 codebook 选择作为特例包含在内。
Result: 在统一基准下，AFP-GIC 相对 DC-VIC 实现 18.1% 更低的解码延迟，推理参数减少 3110 万（20.5%）。在 Kodak、CLIC2020、DIV2K 上 PSNR 与 SSIM 具有竞争力，NIQE 分数与极低码率视觉对比中的自然度提升最清晰；单个预训练模型覆盖五个评测码率工作点。
Conclusion: 把融合先验放在解码端预测而非传输，可以在不牺牲重建质量的前提下同时压低解码延迟与参数量，且单模型即可覆盖多个码率工作点。

papers.title: GraViti: Graph-Level Variational Autoencoders with Relaxed Permutation Invariance
papers.abstract_en: We introduce GraViti, a transformer-based graph-level variational autoencoder that encodes entire graphs into single, fixed-dimensional latent vectors rather than per-node embeddings, yielding a graph-level latent space that supports smooth interpolation, property-guided search, and other downstream tasks beyond the reach of node-level approaches. GraViti achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction accuracy on large molecular graph datasets while offering competitive single-step generative performance. Our central finding concerns where permutation invariance is needed in such a model, and where it is not. The encoder remains permutation-invariant throughout, ensuring the model generalizes to graphs regardless of input order. The reconstruction loss, however, does not need to be: when training data is provided in a consistent node order, comparing predictions to targets directly in that order, without a graph-matching step, is sufficient. Relaxing invariance in the loss alone lets GraViti avoid the cubic-cost matching step required by prior graph-level autoencoders, reducing complexity to quadratic while improving reconstruction fidelity. We show the resulting latent space is chemically meaningful, supporting controlled molecular editing and property optimization, recovering established chemical trends, and enabling direct regression of graph-level properties from latent embeddings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraViti 是基于 Transformer 的图级变分自编码器，把整张图编码成单个固定维隐向量而非逐节点嵌入。编码器保持置换不变，而重构损失在训练数据节点顺序一致时可放松为直接按序比较，从而省掉先前图级自编码器所需的三次方代价图匹配步骤，把复杂度降到二次方并提升重构保真度。
Motivation: 图级自编码器通常靠图匹配步骤保证损失的置换不变性，代价为三次方复杂度；而节点级隐表示又无法支撑平滑插值、属性引导搜索等图级下游任务。
Method: Transformer 编码器将整图压成单个固定维隐向量并全程保持置换不变；重构损失在一致节点顺序的训练数据上直接按序比较预测与目标，不使用图匹配；隐空间用于受控分子编辑、属性优化与图级属性直接回归。
Result: 在大型分子图数据集上达到 state-of-the-art 的重构精度，同时具备有竞争力的单步生成性能；把匹配步骤的三次方复杂度降为二次方并提升重构保真度；隐空间恢复已确立的化学趋势。
Conclusion: 置换不变性只需保留在编码器，损失中可放松；省去图匹配既能降复杂度又能提高重构质量，且隐空间在化学上有意义。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FLASH: Efficient Visuomotor Policy via Sparse Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Generative models such as diffusion and flow matching have become dominant paradigms for visuomotor policy learning, yet their reliance on iterative denoising incurs high inference latency incompatible with real-time robotic control. We present Fast Legendre-polynomial Action policy via Sparse History-anchored flow (FLASH Policy), which replaces discrete action-chunk generation with continuous Legendre polynomial trajectory representation. Specifically, by fitting expert demonstrations under sparse temporal sampling, FLASH enables a single inference to cover a significantly extended action horizon. To further accelerate generation, FLASH initiates the flow matching process from history polynomial coefficients rather than uninformative Gaussian noise, shortening the transport distance and enabling accurate single-step inference. Moreover, analytic polynomial differentiation directly provides desired velocity feed-forward signals to the torque controller without numerical approximation. Extensive experiments on five simulated and two real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that FLASH achieves state-of-the-art success rates ($\ge 92\%$ across all tasks), a per-episode inference time of $31.40\,ms$ (up to $175\times$ faster than diffusion policies and $18\times$ faster than prior flow matching policies), up to $4\times$ faster training convergence than ACT, and $5\times$ to $7\times$ reduction in controller tracking error compared to discrete-action baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLASH Policy 用连续 Legendre 多项式轨迹替代离散 action-chunk 生成，在稀疏时间采样下拟合专家演示，使单次推理覆盖更长动作时域；flow matching 从历史多项式系数而非高斯噪声起步，缩短传输距离从而支持单步推理。在五个仿真与两个真实操作任务上成功率均 ≥92%，单回合推理 31.40 ms，比 diffusion policy 快至 175×、比既有 flow matching policy 快 18×，控制器跟踪误差比离散动作基线降低 5–7×。
Motivation: 扩散与 flow matching 类视觉运动 (visuomotor) 策略依赖迭代去噪，推理延迟高，无法满足机器人实时控制对单步低延迟动作生成的需求。
Method: 以连续 Legendre 多项式表示轨迹替代离散动作块，在稀疏时间采样下拟合专家演示；flow matching 的起点改为历史多项式系数而非无信息高斯噪声，缩短传输距离以实现准确的单步推理；再由多项式解析微分直接给出速度前馈给力矩控制器，免去数值差分。
Result: 在五个仿真与两个真实操作任务上取得 state-of-the-art 成功率，全部任务 ≥92%；单回合推理时间 31.40 ms，比 diffusion policy 快至 175×、比先前 flow matching policy 快 18×；训练收敛比 ACT 快至 4×；控制器跟踪误差相对离散动作基线降低 5–7×。
Conclusion: 用多项式连续轨迹加历史锚定的 flow 起点，可以把生成式策略的推理压到单步量级，同时保住成功率并改善力矩控制的跟踪精度，适用于实时机器人操作。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ReactiveGWM: Flexible Control and NPC Reactivity in Game World Models
papers.abstract_en: Existing game world models typically adopt role-specific interactions, where player and NPC roles are bound to fixed characters. This limits their flexibility in multi-character games, where different characters may receive external control while NPCs must react to interactions triggered by players. This setting raises two key challenges: how to flexibly assign control roles to individual characters, and how to support direct player control and reactive NPC behavior within a unified model. These challenges are particularly pronounced in shared-view 2D games, where multiple, potentially visually identical characters share the same viewpoint, making camera cues insufficient to distinguish their roles. To address these challenges, we introduce ReactiveGWM, a reactive game world model that flexibly assigns control modes at initialization and jointly simulates externally controlled players and reactive NPCs. Specifically, ReactiveGWM introduces Spatial Role Binding, which grounds learned character handles to their corresponding regions in the initial frame using instance masks. Building on these handles, Unified Agency Conditioning unifies heterogeneous control signals across characters by encoding player actions and conditional NPC rules into character-specific control-token groups. Each group is then bound to its corresponding character handle, enabling the model to apply each control signal to its designated character. Meanwhile, causal self-attention restricts temporal context to the current and preceding latent frames when generating player actions and NPC responses. Experiments on two multi-character 2D games demonstrate that ReactiveGWM supports flexible character control across different player/NPC role assignments while jointly generating accurate player-controlled behaviors and reactive NPC responses, enabling more configurable and richer multi-character interactions.
papers.comment: The code is available at https://inv-wzq.github.io/ReactiveGWM/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReactiveGWM 在共享视角 2D 多角色游戏中，用 instance mask 把角色句柄绑定到初始帧区域，再以角色分组的 control token 统一编码玩家动作与 NPC 规则，实现初始化时任意分配控制角色并联合生成玩家行为与 NPC 反应。在两个多角色 2D 游戏上展示了跨不同玩家/NPC 角色分配的灵活控制与准确的反应式 NPC 响应。
Motivation: 现有游戏世界模型把玩家与 NPC 绑定到固定角色，多角色游戏中无法灵活重新分配控制；共享视角 2D 场景里多个外观相同的角色共用视角，相机线索不足以区分角色身份。
Method: Spatial Role Binding 用 instance mask 将学习到的角色句柄锚定到初始帧对应区域；Unified Agency Conditioning 把玩家动作与条件式 NPC 规则编码成角色专属的 control-token 组并绑定到句柄；causal self-attention 将时间上下文限制在当前与之前的 latent 帧以生成玩家动作和 NPC 响应。
Result: 在两个多角色 2D 游戏上实验，ReactiveGWM 支持跨不同玩家/NPC 角色分配的灵活控制，并联合生成准确的玩家受控行为与反应式 NPC 响应，实现更可配置、更丰富的多角色交互。
Conclusion: 把角色身份用空间句柄显式绑定、把异构控制信号统一成按角色分组的 token，可以在单一模型内同时容纳直接玩家控制与反应式 NPC 行为，摆脱固定角色绑定。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Text Knows What, Tables Know When: Clinical Timeline Reconstruction via Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Clinical language models increasingly operate over electronic health records (EHRs), yet patient records are not stored as temporally grounded trajectories. Clinical notes describe symptoms, assessments, and disease progression, but often compress or narratively reorder events. Structured EHR rows provide timestamps for labs, medications, vitals, and procedures, but capture only part of the clinical story. We formulate clinical timeline reconstruction as retrieval-augmented temporal grounding: constructing a patient trajectory by using narrative text for event semantics and structured rows as partial temporal evidence. We introduce a scaffolded workflow that extracts central narrative events, builds an initial temporal scaffold, attaches non-central events, and calibrates timestamps using retrieved structured EHR rows. We evaluate on 40 discharge summaries, including 15 i2b2-derived and 25 MIMIC-IV summaries, each with manual gold-standard timelines and aligned structured EHR data. Across models, multimodal calibration left event match rates largely unchanged and generally improved temporal performance: mean paired case-level multimodal-unimodal differences were positive in 7 of 12 model-metric comparisons across concordance and AULTC, with none negative. However, uncertainty was substantial given the 40-case sample; paired case-level bootstrap intervals excluded zero only for the DeepSeek V3.2 AULTC improvement. A gap analysis shows that 35.1% of text-derived events have no structured counterpart. These findings support treating structured EHR data as partial temporal evidence for narrative-derived patient trajectories.
papers.comment: Accepted for oral presentation at the Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing (PSB) 2027. Sayantan Kumar, Shahriar Noroozizadeh, Juyong Kim (authors contributed equally)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把临床时间线重建形式化为检索增强的时间锚定：用叙述文本给出事件语义、用结构化 EHR 行作为部分时间证据，经脚手架式工作流抽取中心事件、建初始时间骨架、挂接非中心事件并用检索到的结构化行校准时间戳。在 40 份出院小结（15 份 i2b2-derived、25 份 MIMIC-IV）上，多模态校准基本不改变事件匹配率、普遍改善时间性能：12 组模型-指标比较中 7 组的配对病例级多模态-单模态差值为正且无一为负，但仅 DeepSeek V3.2 的 AULTC 改善的配对 bootstrap 区间不含零；35.1% 的文本事件没有结构化对应项。
Motivation: 临床语言模型面对的 EOR 记录不是时间锚定的轨迹：叙述文本会压缩或重排事件，结构化行只有时间戳却只覆盖部分临床故事，两者单独都无法给出可用的患者时间线。
Method: 提出脚手架式工作流：抽取中心叙述事件，建立初始时间骨架，挂接非中心事件，再用检索到的结构化 EHR 行校准时间戳；把时间线重建表述为检索增强的时间锚定 (retrieval-augmented temporal grounding)，以文本给语义、结构化行作部分时间证据。
Result: 在 40 份出院小结（15 份 i2b2-derived、25 份 MIMIC-IV，均带人工金标准时间线与对齐的结构化数据）上，多模态校准基本不改变事件匹配率、普遍改善时间表现：concordance 与 AULTC 共 12 组模型-指标比较中 7 组的配对病例级多模态-单模态差值为正、无一为负；40 例样本下不确定性大，仅 DeepSeek V3.2 的 AULTC 改善其配对 bootstrap 区间不含零；35.1% 的文本事件无结构化对应项。
Conclusion: 结构化 EHR 数据应被当作叙述衍生患者轨迹的部分时间证据，而非完整时间来源；40 例样本下多数比较的区间仍跨零，结论强度受限于样本量。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: A Novel Schur-Decomposition-Based Weight Projection Method for Stable State-Space Neural-Network Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Building black-box models for dynamical systems from data is a challenging problem in machine learning, especially when asymptotic stability guarantees are required. In this paper, we introduce a novel stability-ensuring and backpropagation-compatible projection scheme based on the Schur decomposition for the state matrix of linear discrete-time state-space layers, as well as an alternative pre-factorized formulation of the methodology. The proposed methods dynamically project the quasi-triangular factor of the state matrix's real Schur decomposition onto its nearest stable peer, ensuring stable dynamics with minimal overparameterization. Experiments on synthetic linear systems demonstrate that, despite a marginal increase in computational complexity, the method achieves accuracy and convergence rates comparable to those of state-of-the-art stable-system identification techniques. Furthermore, the lower weight count facilitates convergence during training without sacrificing accuracy in stacked neural-network architectures with static nonlinearities targeting real-world datasets. These results suggest that the Schur-based projection provides a numerically robust framework for identifying complex dynamics on par with the state of the art while satisfying strict asymptotic-stability requirements.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 13 figures. Source code at https://codeberg.org/sergiovaneg/SchurSS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于实 Schur 分解的状态矩阵权重投影：把线性离散时间状态空间层状态矩阵的准三角因子动态投影到最近的稳定矩阵上，从而在反向传播下保证渐近稳定且过参数化最小。在合成线性系统上精度与收敛率与最先进稳定系统辨识方法相当，计算复杂度仅略增；在面向真实数据集的堆叠非线性网络中，更低的权重计数促进训练收敛且不损失精度。
Motivation: 从数据构建动力系统黑盒模型时，既要保证渐近稳定又要可反向传播，现有稳定化手段往往带来不必要的过参数化或数值不稳。
Method: 对线性离散时间状态空间层的状态矩阵做实 Schur 分解，将准三角因子动态投影到最近的稳定矩阵（nearest stable peer），并给出一种预分解 (pre-factorized) 的等价表述；投影与反向传播兼容，适用于含静态非线性的堆叠神经网络架构。
Result: 在合成线性系统实验中，精度与收敛率同最先进稳定系统辨识技术相当，计算复杂度仅边际增加；在面向真实数据集的堆叠静态非线性网络中，更低的权重计数在训练中促进收敛且不牺牲精度。
Conclusion: Schur 分解投影可在满足严格渐近稳定性要求的同时，达到与最先进方法相当的动力系统辨识精度，且数值上稳健。

papers.title: Grounded Continuation: A Linear-Time Runtime Verifier for LLM Conversations
papers.abstract_en: In a long conversation, an LLM may produce a fluent continuation that rests on premises the conversation has already abandoned. Context-manipulation attacks exploit precisely this weakness. We address this problem with a runtime verifier. An LLM Interpreter maps each utterance to one or more of eight epistemic operations, and then a symbolic engine applies these operations to a dependency map that records what every claim rests on and whether it still stands. Based on the dependency map, checking whether a continuation is grounded then reduces to a walk over the map, linear in its size and requiring no LLM call. Retraction propagates through the same map with a conflict-free guarantee and flags exactly the conclusions that lose support. Our experiments with five QA models demonstrate substantial improvements in QA accuracy at a low cost per query. On ReviseQA for belief revision and MemoryAgentBench's FactConsolidation split (MemAB-FC), the verifier outperforms a retrieval baseline and raises MemAB-FC single-hop accuracy from $0.46$--$0.95$ to $0.94$--$0.98$. With the verifier, even the small 7B model overtakes unaided GPT-4o. When a GPT-4o Interpreter extracts every update from raw text rather than taking the benchmarks' structured updates, the verifier still outperforms the retrieval baseline. Moreover, on MemAB-FC, QA prompts remain compact at $97$--$174$ tokens while the full-context baseline reaches $114.5$K. Retraction queries take less than a microsecond at $2000$ turns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出线性时间运行时验证器 Grounded Continuation：LLM Interpreter 把每句话映射为八种认识论操作之一，符号引擎据此维护依赖图，判断续写是否有据只需在图上走一遍，无需调用 LLM。在 ReviseQA 与 MemAB-FC 上单跳准确率从 0.46–0.95 提到 0.94–0.98，7B 模型配验证器超过无辅助 GPT-4o，2000 轮撤回查询低于 1 微秒。
Motivation: 长对话中 LLM 会顺着已被放弃的前提继续生成流畅回复，上下文操纵攻击正利用这一弱点，而现有做法依赖检索或全上下文，成本高且不追踪结论所依赖的前提是否仍成立。
Method: LLM Interpreter 将话语分类为八种认识论操作，符号引擎在记录每条主张依赖什么、是否仍成立的依赖图上执行这些操作；撤回沿图传播并带无冲突保证，接地检查退化为一次图遍历，不需 LLM 调用。
Result: 在 ReviseQA 与 MemAB-FC 上超过检索基线，MemAB-FC 单跳准确率从 0.46–0.95 提升到 0.94–0.98；配验证器的 7B 模型超过无辅助 GPT-4o；GPT-4o Interpreter 从原始文本抽取更新时仍胜检索基线；MemAB-FC 上 QA 提示仅 97–174 tokens，全上下文基线达 114.5K；2000 轮时撤回查询耗时低于 1 微秒。
Conclusion: 把对话前提显式建成依赖图，可在不调用 LLM 的情况下以线性时间、微秒级延迟判定续写是否有据并精确标出失去支撑的结论，同时把 QA 提示压到百 token 量级。

papers.title: Edit-Compass & EditReward-Compass: A Unified Benchmark for Image Editing and Reward Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Recent image editing models have achieved remarkable progress in instruction following, multimodal understanding, and complex visual editing. However, existing benchmarks often fail to faithfully reflect human judgment, especially for strong frontier models, due to limited task difficulty and coarse-grained evaluation protocols. In parallel, reward models have become increasingly important for RL-based image editing optimization, yet existing reward model benchmarks still rely on unrealistic evaluation settings that deviate from practical RL scenarios. These limitations hinder reliable assessment of both image editing models and reward models. To address these challenges, we introduce Edit-Compass and EditReward-Compass, a unified evaluation suite for image editing and reward modeling. Edit-Compass contains 2,388 carefully annotated instances spanning six progressively challenging task categories, covering capabilities such as world knowledge reasoning, visual reasoning, and multi-image editing. Beyond broad task coverage, Edit-Compass adopts a fine-grained multidimensional evaluation framework based on structured reasoning and carefully designed scoring rubrics. In parallel, EditReward-Compass contains 2,251 preference pairs that simulate realistic reward modeling scenarios during RL optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Edit-Compass 与 EditReward-Compass 统一评测套件：前者含 2,388 条标注实例、覆盖六个渐进难度任务类别（世界知识推理、视觉推理、多图编辑），用结构化推理与细粒度评分 rubric 做多维评估；后者含 2,251 组偏好对，模拟 RL 优化中的真实奖励模型场景。
Motivation: 现有图像编辑基准任务难度有限、评测粒度粗，对前沿模型难以忠实反映人类判断；奖励模型基准的评测设置又偏离实际 RL 场景，导致两类模型都无法可靠评估。
Method: Edit-Compass 以结构化推理和精心设计的评分 rubric 为基础，构建细粒度多维评测框架，覆盖六个渐进难度的任务类别；EditReward-Compass 提供 2,251 组偏好对，贴近 RL 优化中的奖励建模设置。
Result: Edit-Compass 包含 2,388 条人工标注实例、六个渐进难度任务类别；EditReward-Compass 包含 2,251 组偏好对。
Conclusion: 图像编辑模型与奖励模型需要在同一套件中按细粒度 rubric 与贴近 RL 的偏好设置联合评估，才能可靠反映人类判断。

papers.title: AgentLens: Revealing The Lucky Pass Problem in SWE-Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Evaluation of software engineering (SWE) agents is dominated by a binary signal: whether the final patch passes the tests. This outcome-only view treats a principled solution and a chaotic trial-and-error process as equivalent. We show that this equivalence is empirically false. We evaluate 2,614 OpenHands trajectories from eight model backends on 60 SWE-bench Verified tasks. Of these, 47 have enough passing trajectories to construct task-level process references, yielding a 1,815-trajectory evaluation subset. Among passing trajectories in this subset, 10.7% exhibit behavior we call a Lucky Pass: regression cycles, blind retries, missing verification, or temporally disordered exploration, implementation, and verification. We introduce AgentLens, a framework for process-level assessment of SWE-agent trajectories, and define AgentLens-Bench, a dataset of 1,815 trajectories annotated with quality scores, waste signals, divergence points, and 47 task-level Prefix Tree Acceptor (PTA) references. AgentLens builds PTA references by merging multiple passing solutions for the same task, and uses a context-sensitive intent labeler to assign actions to Exploration, Implementation, Verification, or Orchestration based on trajectory history rather than tool identity alone. On AgentLens-Bench, the quality score separates passing trajectories into Lucky, Solid, and Ideal tiers and further decomposes Lucky Passes into five recurring mechanisms. Across the eight model backends, Lucky rates range from 0.5% to 23.2%, and some models move by as many as five rank positions when ranked by quality score instead of pass rate. We plan to release the project repository soon, including AgentLens-Bench artifacts, the AgentLens SDK, and the analysis tooling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentLens 用过程级评估揭示 SWE-agent 评测中的 Lucky Pass 问题：在 1,815 条通过轨迹的子集中，10.7% 靠回归循环、盲目重试、缺失验证或时序错乱的探索/实现/验证侥幸通过。八个模型后端的 Lucky 率从 0.5% 到 23.2%，改用质量分排名后部分模型位次变动多达五位。
Motivation: SWE-agent 评测只看最终补丁是否通过测试，把有原则的解法与混乱的试错过程视为等价，掩盖了侥幸通过与真实能力的差别。
Method: 从 2,614 条 OpenHands 轨迹（八个模型后端、60 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务）中筛出 47 个有足够通过轨迹的任务，合并同任务多解构建 Prefix Tree Acceptor (PTA) 参考，并用依赖轨迹历史的上下文敏感意图标注器把动作归入 Exploration、Implementation、Verification、Orchestration；产出 AgentLens-Bench（1,815 条轨迹，含质量分、浪费信号、分歧点与 47 个 PTA 参考）。
Result: 1,815 条通过轨迹中 10.7% 为 Lucky Pass；八个模型后端 Lucky 率区间 0.5%–23.2%；按质量分而非通过率排名时部分模型位次变动多达五位；质量分将通过轨迹分为 Lucky、Solid、Ideal 三层，并把 Lucky Pass 分解为五类反复出现的机制。
Conclusion: 仅凭通过率排名会系统性错判 SWE-agent 能力，过程级质量分能把侥幸通过与稳健解法区分开并改变模型排序。

papers.title: Large Language Models for Agentic NetOps and AIOps: Architectures, Evaluation, and Safety
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used in network operations (NetOps) and artificial intelligence for IT operations (AIOps) for tasks ranging from telemetry retrieval and incident diagnosis to configuration planning and bounded remediation. As these systems acquire greater access to operational tools, a central question is whether operational assurance develops commensurately with the authority granted to them. This survey examines that question through a structured, evidence-stratified review of agentic NetOps and AIOps, spanning directly evaluated LLM systems, operational mechanisms, transferred evidence, and normative guidance. We organise the field around autonomy, tool scope, evidence traces, assurance controls, evaluation, security, and governance, and introduce an operational assurance contract that links each autonomy level to permitted tools, required evidence, independent gates, execution budgets, rollout and rollback duties, and audit requirements. The synthesis indicates a capability-assurance gap: evidence is comparatively strong for read-oriented assistance and tool-grounded diagnosis, but becomes substantially less complete as systems approach configuration change, bounded execution, and closed-loop operation. We therefore develop a workflow-level evaluation framework covering evidence quality, tool use, policy and invariant compliance, staged execution, recovery, calibration, cost, and human intervention, together with a threat model for prompt-borne attacks, compromised operational evidence, excessive agency, privilege boundaries, and auditability. The resulting view treats agentic NetOps and AIOps as constrained operational control, in which increasing autonomy requires correspondingly stronger evidence, independently enforced safeguards, and recovery mechanisms.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇综述以证据分层方式梳理 LLM 驱动的 agentic NetOps/AIOps，提出把自主等级与工具权限、证据要求、独立门禁、执行预算、回滚与审计绑定的 operational assurance contract。核心结论是存在 capability-assurance gap：读取型辅助与工具接地诊断的证据较强，而配置变更、有界执行、闭环运行的证据明显不完整，因此自主性越高越需要更强证据与独立执行的保障机制。
Motivation: LLM 系统在运维中获得的工具权限不断扩大，但运营保障能力是否同步增长缺少系统性梳理，配置变更与闭环执行阶段的证据尤其薄弱。
Method: 按 autonomy、tool scope、evidence traces、assurance controls、evaluation、security、governance 七个维度组织综述，区分直接评估的 LLM 系统、运行机制、迁移证据与规范性指导；提出 operational assurance contract 与覆盖证据质量、工具使用、策略不变量合规、分阶段执行、恢复、校准、成本、人工介入的 workflow 级评估框架，并配套 prompt 注入、证据被篡改、过度自主、权限边界与可审计性的威胁模型。
Result: 综述判定证据强度随自主等级递减：读取型辅助与工具接地诊断的证据相对充分，接近配置变更、有界执行与闭环运行时证据显著不完整。全文 59 页、13 图、8 表，配套证据审计数据集发布于 Mendeley Data（doi: 10.17632/2p5ppxzy4s.3）。
Conclusion: agentic NetOps/AIOps 应被视为受约束的运营控制问题：自主性每提升一级，就必须同步加强证据要求、独立执行的保障措施与恢复机制。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Premover: Fast Vision-Language-Action Control via Early Execution During Instruction Delivery
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically evaluated under the assumption that the robot starts acting only after the user has finished typing or speaking. In real interactions, however, entering an instruction can take several seconds, leaving the policy idle for a substantial fraction of the interaction. Partial instructions may already contain sufficient information to begin acting before the full instruction arrives. We introduce Premover, a parameter-lightweight module that reduces interaction latency by overlapping instruction delivery with robot execution while keeping the VLA backbone frozen. Premover uses a learned vision-language focus map to identify where the current partial instruction refers in the visual scene, and an action readiness gate to determine when execution can begin. On the SO-101 robot with speech and online transcription, Premover reduces mean wall-clock time by 17.9%, from 60.5s to 49.7s, while maintaining task success rates. In simulation on LIBERO with pi0.5 at the speaking rate, Premover reduces mean wall-clock time by 8.3% while maintaining comparable success to waiting for the complete instruction before execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Premover 让 VLA 策略在用户指令尚未说完时就开始执行：用学到的 vision-language focus map 定位部分指令在画面中指向的对象，再用 action readiness gate 判定何时可启动，主干网络保持冻结。在 SO-101 实体机器人（语音+在线转写）上平均墙钟时间从 60.5s 降到 49.7s（-17.9%），任务成功率保持；LIBERO 仿真中配 pi0.5 按说话速率输入时降 8.3%，成功率与等完整指令再执行相当。
Motivation: VLA 策略默认等用户说完才动作，而输入一条指令要花数秒，机器人在交互中大段时间空转；部分指令其实已含足够信息可提前开始执行。
Method: 参数量很小的 Premover 模块，VLA 主干冻结：vision-language focus map 把当前部分指令对应到视觉场景位置，action readiness gate 决定何时开始执行，从而把指令输入与机器人执行在时间上重叠。
Result: SO-101 实体机器人（语音与在线转写）平均墙钟时间 60.5s → 49.7s，减少 17.9%，任务成功率保持；LIBERO 仿真、pi0.5 按说话速率下平均墙钟时间减少 8.3%，成功率与等完整指令再执行相当。
Conclusion: 在指令送达期间提前执行可以在不牺牲任务成功率的前提下压缩人机交互时间，前提是模型能判断部分指令是否已足够启动动作。

papers.title: Debiasing Message Passing to Mitigate Popularity Bias in GNN-based Collaborative Filtering
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative filtering (CF) models based on graph neural networks (GNNs) achieve strong performance in recommender systems by propagating user-item signals over interaction graphs. However, they are susceptible to popularity bias, since skewed interactions and repeated message passing across high-order neighborhoods amplify the influence of popular items while suppressing long-tail ones. Existing debiasing approaches, including re-weighting objectives, regularization, causal methods, and post-processing, are less effective in GNN-based settings because they do not directly counteract bias propagated through the aggregation process, and recent in-aggregation weighting methods often rely on static heuristics or unstable embedding estimates. We propose Debiasing Popularity Amplification in Aggregation (DPAA), a popularity debiasing framework for GNN-based CF that integrates adaptive, representation-aware interaction weighting and layer-wise weighting directly into message passing. DPAA assigns interaction-level weights from a representation-based popularity signal, stabilized by a smooth transition from pre-trained to evolving model embeddings during training. It further introduces a layer-wise weighting that amplifies higher-order neighborhoods, surfacing long-range interactions with diverse and underexposed items. Experiments on real-world and semi-synthetic datasets show that DPAA outperforms state-of-the-art popularity bias correction methods for GNN-based CF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DPAA，把自适应、表示感知的交互级权重与逐层权重直接嵌入 GNN 协同过滤的消息传递中，以抵消聚合过程放大的流行度偏差。交互权重来自基于表示的流行度信号，并用从预训练嵌入平滑过渡到训练中演化嵌入的方式稳定；逐层权重放大高阶邻域，暴露长程交互中的长尾物品。在真实与半合成数据集上，DPAA 超越现有 GNN 协同过滤流行度纠偏方法。
Motivation: GNN 协同过滤在交互图上传播信号时，偏斜的交互与高阶邻域的反复消息传递会放大热门物品、压制长尾物品；现有重加权、正则化、因果与后处理方法不直接对抗聚合过程中的偏差传播，近期聚合内加权又依赖静态启发式或不稳定的嵌入估计。
Method: DPAA 框架把两层权重放进消息传递：交互级权重由基于表示的流行度信号给出，并在训练中从预训练嵌入平滑过渡到演化嵌入以稳定估计；逐层权重放大高阶邻域，突出含多样与低曝光物品的长程交互。
Result: 在真实世界与半合成数据集上的实验中，DPAA 在 GNN 协同过滤的流行度偏差纠正上超过 state-of-the-art 方法。
Conclusion: 流行度纠偏应直接做进消息传递的聚合过程，而不是靠目标重加权或后处理；自适应表示感知权重加逐层高阶放大是有效路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Can Digital Personas Reliably Approximate Human Survey Findings?
papers.abstract_en: Digital personas powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as substitutes for human survey respondents, yet it remains unclear when they can reliably approximate human survey findings. We answer this question using the LISS panel, constructing personas from respondents' background variables and pre-2023 survey histories, then testing them against the same respondents' held-out post-cutoff answers. Across four persona architectures, three LLMs, and two prediction tasks, we assess performance at the question, respondent, distributional, equity, and clustering levels. Digital personas improve alignment with human response distributions, especially in domains tied to stable attributes and values, but remain limited for individual prediction and fail to recover multivariate respondent structure. Retrieval-augmented architectures provide the clearest gains, but performance depends more on human response structure than on model choice: personas perform best for low-variability questions and common respondent patterns, and worst for subjective, heterogeneous, or rare responses. Our results provide practical guidance on when digital personas could be appropriate for survey research and when human validation remains necessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 LISS 面板把受访者背景变量与 2023 年前的作答历史构建成 LLM 数字人格，在同一批人 2023 年后的留出作答上检验：四种人格架构、三个 LLM、两项预测任务下，人格提升了与人类作答分布的对齐，检索增强 (retrieval-augmented) 架构增益最明显，但个体级预测仍受限、无法恢复受访者多变量结构；表现好坏更多取决于人类作答本身的结构（低变异性问题与常见模式最好，主观、异质、稀有作答最差），而非模型选择。
Motivation: LLM 数字人格被提议替代人类问卷受访者，但何时能可靠逼近真实调查结论并不清楚，尤其在个体预测与受访者群体结构上存在缺口。
Method: 基于 LISS panel，用受访者的背景变量与 pre-2023 调查历史构建人格，对其 2023 年后的留出作答做预测；比较四种人格架构、三个 LLM、两项预测任务，并在问题级、受访者级、分布级、公平性 (equity) 与聚类五个层面评估。
Result: 数字人格改善了与人类作答分布的对齐，在与稳定属性和价值观相关的领域提升更明显；个体级预测仍受限，且未能恢复受访者多变量结构。检索增强架构带来最清晰的增益；低变异性问题与常见受访者模式上表现最好，主观、异质或稀有作答上表现最差，性能更取决于人类作答结构而非模型选择。
Conclusion: 数字人格适合替代的是分布层面、结构稳定的调查结论，个体预测与群体结构恢复仍需人类验证；检索增强是当前最值得采用的人格架构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TIDES: Implicit Time-Awareness in Selective State Space Models
papers.abstract_en: Selective state space models (SSMs), such as Mamba, achieve strong per-token expressivity by making the time discretization step $\TildeΔ$ a learned function of the input. However, in doing so, $\TildeΔ$ no longer equals the physical time gap $Δ$ between consecutive observations, limiting the ability of these models to handle irregular time series. Continuous time SSMs, such as S5, keep $\TildeΔ\equivΔ$ and therefore handle irregular timestamps natively, but their dynamics remain linear time invariant (LTI), limiting per token expressivity. We propose \textbf{TIDES}, a selective SSM variant that reconciles selective and continuous architectures by moving input dependence off the step size and onto the diagonal state matrix. As a result, $\TildeΔ\equivΔ$ as in S5, allowing the model to handle irregular timestamps natively without sacrificing the per-token expressivity that makes selective SSMs effective. We show this on a novel \emph{Fading Flash} experimental benchmark, a compact controlled diagnostic for sequence models that jointly tests input dependence and extrapolation to out-of-distribution $Δ$ values, and isolates the distinct failure modes of current state-of-the-art architectures that TIDES avoids by construction. On large-scale benchmarks, TIDES sets the new best average rank on UEA time series classification and the Physiome ODE regression benchmark, and matches or exceeds the reference baseline model on 6 of 8 natively irregular datasets from astronomy, agriculture, neuromorphic sensing, and climate events. Code available at: \url{https://github.com/TaylanSoydan/TIDES}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TIDES 把选择性 SSM 的输入依赖从步长 Δ̃ 移到对角状态矩阵上，使 Δ̃≡Δ，从而在保留逐 token 表达力的同时原生处理不规则时间戳。在自建 Fading Flash 诊断基准上隔离出现有架构的失效模式；在 UEA 时间序列分类与 Physiome ODE 回归上取得新的最佳平均排名，并在 8 个原生不规则数据集中的 6 个上匹配或超过参考基线。
Motivation: Mamba 类选择性 SSM 把 Δ̃ 学成输入的函数，Δ̃ 不再等于相邻观测的物理时间间隔，难以处理不规则时间序列；S5 保持 Δ̃≡Δ 但动力学是 LTI，逐 token 表达力受限。
Method: TIDES 保留 Δ̃≡Δ（同 S5），把输入依赖放到对角状态矩阵上，兼得选择性与连续时间两类架构；用自建的 Fading Flash 诊断基准联合测试输入依赖与对分布外 Δ 的外推，并在 UEA 分类、Physiome ODE 回归及天文、农业、神经形态传感、气候事件等原生不规则数据集上评测。
Result: 在 UEA 时间序列分类与 Physiome ODE 回归基准上取得新的最佳平均排名；在来自天文、农业、神经形态传感与气候事件的 8 个原生不规则数据集中的 6 个上匹配或超过参考基线模型。
Conclusion: 把选择性从步长挪到状态矩阵，可以在不牺牲逐 token 表达力的前提下原生支持不规则时间戳，并避开 Fading Flash 所诊断的现有 SOTA 架构失效模式。

papers.title: Mutual Information Optimal Density Control of Linear Systems and Generalized Schrödinger Bridges with Reference Refinement
papers.abstract_en: We consider a mutual information (MI) regularized optimal density control of a discrete-time linear system. MI optimal control has been utilized for exploration in reinforcement learning and privacy protection in control. MI regularization induces stochasticity in the policy, which poses challenges for applications of MI optimal control in safety-critical scenarios. To remedy this situation, we impose Gaussian density constraints at specified times to directly control state uncertainty. For this MI optimal density control problem, we propose an alternating optimization algorithm and investigate its convergence properties. In addition, we reveal a relationship between the MI optimal density control problem and a so-called generalized Schrödinger bridge problem associated with the discrete-time linear system. Based on the results of MI optimal density control and this relationship, we also investigate alternating optimization for the Schrödinger bridge problem and its convergence properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对离散时间线性系统提出互信息 (MI) 正则的最优密度控制：在指定时刻施加高斯密度约束以直接限制状态不确定性，缓解 MI 正则诱导的策略随机性在安全关键场景下的问题，并给出交替优化算法及其收敛性分析。进一步揭示该问题与线性系统上广义 Schrödinger bridge 问题的等价关系，据此把交替优化推广到 Schrödinger bridge 并研究其收敛。
Motivation: MI 正则的最优控制已被用于强化学习探索与控制中的隐私保护，但它会诱导策略随机性，在安全关键场景难以直接使用；需要一种能直接约束状态不确定性的机制。
Method: 在离散时间线性系统的 MI 最优密度控制问题中，于指定时刻施加高斯密度约束来直接控制状态不确定性；针对该问题提出交替优化 (alternating optimization) 算法并研究其收敛性质；再建立 MI 最优密度控制与该线性系统上广义 Schrödinger bridge 问题之间的关系，把交替优化迁移到 Schrödinger bridge 并分析其收敛。
Result: 给出 MI 最优密度控制的交替优化算法及其收敛性质，以及广义 Schrödinger bridge 问题的交替优化与收敛性质；论文为 17 页、4 幅图。
Conclusion: 指定时刻的高斯密度约束可把 MI 正则最优控制的随机性纳入可控范围，且 MI 最优密度控制与广义 Schrödinger bridge 共享同一交替优化框架与收敛结论。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: PiCA: Pivot-Based Credit Assignment for Search Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based search agents trained with reinforcement learning (RL) have significantly improved the performance of knowledge-intensive tasks. However, existing methods encounter critical challenges in long-horizon credit assignment: (i) Reward Sparsity, where models receive only outcome feedback without step-level guidance to differentiate action quality; (ii) Isolated Credit, where credit is assigned to steps independently, failing to capture sequential dependencies; and (iii) Distributional Shift, where rewards are estimated on templates that deviate from the model's natural generative distribution. To address these issues, we propose Pivot-Based Credit Assignment (PiCA), a novel step reward mechanism that reformulates the search trajectory as a sequential process of cumulative search progress. Unlike prior isolated step rewards, PiCA defines process rewards as success probabilities dependent on the historical context based on Potential-Based Reward Shaping (PBRS). This approach identifies pivot steps, which comprise target golden sub-queries and sub-answers derived from historical trajectories, as information peaks that significantly boost the likelihood of a correct final answer. By anchoring these step rewards to the final task objective, PiCA provides dense, pivot-aware and trajectory-dependent guidance while maintaining distributional consistency. Extensive experiments show that PiCA outperforms existing strong baselines across seven knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks, achieving 15.2% and 4.4% improvements for 3B and 7B models. The consistent performance gains across various models show PiCA's robust generalization. The code is available at https://github.com/novdream/PiCA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PiCA 把 LLM 搜索智能体的轨迹重写为累积搜索进度的序列，用基于势函数的奖励塑形 (PBRS) 把步奖励定义为依赖历史上下文的成功概率，并识别 pivot step（由历史轨迹导出的目标 golden 子查询与子答案）作为信息峰值。在七个知识密集型 QA 基准上，3B 与 7B 模型分别提升 15.2% 与 4.4%。
Motivation: LLM 搜索智能体的 RL 训练存在长时域信用分配难题：只有结果反馈而无步级指导（Reward Sparsity）、各步信用彼此孤立（Isolated Credit）、以及奖励在偏离模型自然生成分布的模板上估计（Distributional Shift）。
Method: 提出 Pivot-Based Credit Assignment (PiCA) 这一步奖励机制：基于 Potential-Based Reward Shaping，把过程奖励定义为依赖历史上下文的成功概率，锚定到最终任务目标，从而给出稠密、pivot 感知且轨迹依赖的引导并保持分布一致性；pivot step 由历史轨迹导出的目标 golden 子查询与子答案构成。
Result: 在七个知识密集型 QA 基准上超过现有强基线，3B 模型提升 15.2%，7B 模型提升 4.4%；跨多种模型的增益一致，显示泛化性。
Conclusion: 把步奖励写成依赖历史的成功概率并锚定最终目标，可在保持分布一致性的同时解决搜索智能体的稀疏与孤立信用问题，且在不同规模模型上稳定生效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Endogeneity of Miscalibration: Impossibility and Escape in Scored Reporting
papers.abstract_en: An agent's probability report is paid for twice: by a strictly proper scoring rule, and by an approval rule for the decision it triggers. In this classical decision-coupled setting, non-affine approval is known to defeat truthful reporting. We show the conflict is endogenous: when feasible, the welfare-maximizing approval rule is never affine. The distortion, however, is predictable and can be designed around. There is a reserve report at which pretending to be the marginal type costs exactly the approval prize. Approving at or above the reserve screens types perfectly under every strictly proper score, and the reserve does not depend on the type distribution. A Lipschitz rule with a single kink attains first-best exactly; under strict feasibility no continuously differentiable rule does. The binding constraint is steepness, not smoothness. First-best is attainable within a slope budget if and only if the budget is at least the critical slope: the steepest chord of the pretending cost up to the reserve. Below it the welfare loss is cubic in the shortfall. Where the pretending cost is convex up to the reserve, as for Brier, log and power scores, the critical slope is closed-form. The instances are AI-agent oversight and marketplace operation.
papers.comment: 39 pages, no figures, all proofs inline
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在严格 proper scoring rule 与审批规则共同定价概率报告的设定中，福利最大化的审批规则必然非仿射，因而内生地破坏如实报告；但存在一个 reserve report，使在该点假装成边际类型的代价恰好等于审批收益，按此阈值审批可在任意 strictly proper score 下完美分离类型，且阈值不依赖类型分布。带单个 kink 的 Lipschitz 规则可精确达到 first-best，而斜率预算低于临界斜率（pretending cost 到 reserve 处最陡弦）时福利损失按短缺的三次方增长。
Motivation: 经典决策耦合设定中非仿射审批规则会击败如实报告，本文指出这一冲突是内生的：当可行时福利最大化的审批规则本身就不仿射，需要在设计上绕开而非回避。
Method: 在 score reporting 的机制设计框架下证明 reserve report 的存在性与阈值审批的完全筛选性质；用 Lipschitz 单 kink 规则构造 first-best 实现，并给出临界斜率（pretending cost 到 reserve 的最陡弦）的充要条件；对 Brier、log、power score 在 pretending cost 凸的情形导出临界斜率闭式解。
Result: 阈值审批在任意 strictly proper score 下完美分离类型且 reserve 与类型分布无关；严格可行时无连续可微规则能达到 first-best，约束在陡峭度而非光滑度；斜率预算 ≥ 临界斜率当且仅当可达 first-best，低于时福利损失为短缺的三次方；Brier、log、power score 下临界斜率有闭式。
Conclusion: 审批规则的非仿射性是福利最大化内生带来的，但扭曲可预测并可绕开：用 reserve 阈值加单 kink 的陡峭规则即可恢复 first-best，绑定约束是斜率预算。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: EnvSimBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating and Improving LLM-Based Environment Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Scalable AI agents training relies on interactive environments that faithfully simulate the consequences of agent actions. Manually crafted environments are expensive to build, brittle to extend, and fundamentally limited in diversity. A promising direction is to replace manually crafted environments with LLM-simulated counterparts. However, this paradigm hinges on an unexamined core assumption: LLMs can accurately simulate environmental feedback. In practice, LLM-simulated environments suffer from hallucinations, logical inconsistencies, and silent state drift failures that corrupt agent reward signals and compound the construction costs that the paradigm was designed to eliminate. To address this gap, we propose EnvSimBench with four contributions: 1) We provide the first formal definition and operationalization of Environment Simulation Ability (EnvSim Ability) as a quantifiable research objective. 2) We construct EnvSimBench, a rigorous benchmark covering 400 samples across 167 diverse environments, equipped with verifiable labels and fine-grained difficulty stratification along three axes. 3) Systematic evaluations reveal that all state-of-the-art language models suffer from a universal state change cliff: they achieve near-perfect accuracy on tasks when the environment state remains invariant, yet fail catastrophically when multiple states need simultaneous updates. This finding exposes EnvSim Ability as a critical yet largely unaddressed capability gap. 4) We design a constraint-driven simulation pipeline that substantially reduces hallucination, boosts environment synthesis yield by 6.8%, and cuts costs by over 90%. Overall, EnvSimBench serves as both a diagnostic framework and a practical optimization path for reliable LLM-based environment simulation, establishing a foundation for scalable agent training. Code and data are available at https://github.com/cookieApril/EnvSimBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EnvSimBench 首次把环境模拟能力 (EnvSim Ability) 形式化为可量化目标，并用 400 个样本、167 个环境的基准系统评测主流 LLM。发现所有 SOTA 模型都出现「状态变化悬崖」：环境状态不变时接近满分，需要多个状态同时更新时灾难性失败。约束驱动的仿真流水线把环境合成产出提升 6.8%、成本降低 90% 以上。
Motivation: 用 LLM 替代手工构建交互环境的前提是 LLM 能准确模拟环境反馈，但实际中存在幻觉、逻辑不一致与静默状态漂移，污染 agent 奖励信号并推高构建成本，而这一核心假设此前未经检验。
Method: 提出 EnvSimBench：形式化定义 EnvSim Ability，构建覆盖 167 个多样环境、400 个样本、带可验证标签与三轴细粒度难度分层的基准；另设计约束驱动的仿真流水线以抑制幻觉。
Result: 系统评测显示所有 SOTA 语言模型都出现普遍的状态变化悬崖 (state change cliff)：状态不变任务接近满分，多状态同时更新时灾难性失败；约束驱动流水线显著减少幻觉，环境合成产出提升 6.8%，成本降低超过 90%。
Conclusion: EnvSim Ability 是 LLM 普遍缺失的关键能力，约束驱动的仿真流水线是提升 LLM 环境模拟可靠性与可扩展 agent 训练的可行优化路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProtoSSL: Self-Supervised Pretraining and Downstream Transfer for Projection-Based Prototype Models
papers.abstract_en: In domains where both predictive performance and interpretability are essential, deep neural networks achieve strong results but provide limited insight into how their predictions are made. Projection-based prototype networks address this limitation by grounding predictions in similarity to representative training examples, enabling case-based explanations and global prototype inspection. However, existing approaches rely on label supervision, tying prototypes to a specific task and requiring large labeled datasets. We introduce ProtoSSL, a framework for pretraining a foundational latent prototype bank on unlabeled data and transferring it to downstream tasks to create interpretable, projection-based prototype models. Our key idea is to separate motif discovery from label alignment. ProtoSSL first learns a transferrable prototype bank using a self-supervised objective applied directly to prototype activations, and then aligns these prototypes to downstream tasks through a novel efficient assignment procedure. Across six electrocardiography (ECG) datasets, ProtoSSL improves label efficiency, outperforming supervised prototype baselines in low-data regimes with as few as 256 labeled examples; with fine-tuning, ProtoSSL outperforms supervised prototype baselines at full dataset scale. In a human evaluation study, ProtoSSL produces prototypes and prototype-based explanations that are judged more favorably than those learned with direct label supervision. We further show that the framework extends to audio classification. Thus, ProtoSSL enables both learning foundational prototypes from unlabeled data before the downstream label space is known, and subsequent assignment to new tasks to create interpretable, projection-grounded prototypes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProtoSSL 把投影式原型网络的 motif 发现与标签对齐解耦：先在无标签数据上用作用于原型激活的自监督目标预训练可迁移的原型库，再用高效分配过程把原型对齐到下游任务。在六个 ECG 数据集上，低数据情形仅 256 个标注样本即超过监督原型基线，全量微调后同样超过基线，人工评测认为其原型与解释优于直接标签监督学到的原型。
Motivation: 投影式原型网络用与训练样本的相似度支撑预测、可做 case-based 解释，但现有方法依赖标签监督，把原型绑死在特定任务上并需要大量标注数据。
Method: 两阶段：先对无标签数据施加作用于原型激活 (prototype activations) 的自监督目标，学出可迁移的原型库；再通过一个新颖的高效分配 (assignment) 过程把原型对齐到下游标签空间，可选微调。
Result: 在六个 ECG 数据集上，低数据情形少至 256 个标注样本时优于监督原型基线；加上微调后在全数据规模上也优于监督原型基线。人工评测中，ProtoSSL 产生的原型与基于原型的解释比直接标签监督学到的更受好评。框架进一步扩展到音频分类。
Conclusion: 在下游标签空间已知之前就能从无标签数据学出基础原型，再分配到新任务，可同时保住标签效率与投影式可解释性。

papers.title: Is Escalation Worth It? On the Depth of LLM Cascades
papers.abstract_en: LLM cascades, in which a cheap model defers to an expensive one on low-confidence queries, are widely used to reduce inference cost. Given a pool of models, a practitioner must decide how many models to include and where to set each deferral threshold. We derive first-order optimality conditions showing that, at an optimum, the ratio of expected accuracy gain to expected downstream cost is equal across deferral boundaries. A local search based on these conditions closely matches exhaustive search. We also derive an identity that decomposes the accuracy gain of score-based escalation over random escalation into two AUROC terms. Across five benchmarks and nine deferral scores, with model sequences and thresholds optimized from a pool of eight models, two-model cascades improve mean test-set accuracy over single-model selection by 2.1 to 8.2 percentage points. However, allowing more than two models does not improve mean test-set accuracy in 118 of 135 comparisons across scorers, datasets, and depth caps, and adds at most 0.43 percentage points. To understand the role of deferral scores in depth gains, we conduct counterfactual experiments with simulated confidence scores. When these scores have high AUROC and reflect only whether the current model answered correctly, allowing more than two models improves test-set accuracy on four of five benchmarks. However, these gains do not persist when the scores also reflect query difficulty shared across models, even at the same AUROC. These results suggest that gains from additional depth depend on how well the confidence score separates correct from incorrect answers for the current model compared with later models.
papers.comment: Substantially revised from v1, which was titled "Is Escalation Worth It? A Decision-Theoretic Characterization of LLM Cascades."
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 级联的深度收益取决于置信分数的性质而非 AUROC 高低：两模型级联相对单模型选择在五个基准上把平均测试集准确率提高 2.1 到 8.2 个百分点，但超过两层几乎无增益——135 组比较中 118 组无提升，最多只加 0.43 个百分点。只有当模拟置信分数仅反映当前模型对错（高 AUROC）时，更深级联才在五个基准中的四个上有效；一旦分数还反映跨模型共享的题目难度，即使 AUROC 相同，增益也消失。
Motivation: 实践者在模型池上要决定级联放几层、每个转介阈值设在哪，但缺少判定「加层是否值得」的准则，也未厘清置信分数 (deferral score) 在深度收益中的作用。
Method: 基于期望准确率增益与期望下游成本之比在各转介边界相等的一阶最优性条件做局部搜索（对照穷举搜索）；推导把基于分数的升级 (score-based escalation) 相对随机升级的准确率增益分解为两个 AUROC 项的恒等式；再用模拟置信分数做反事实实验，设置为五个基准、九种 deferral scores、模型序列与阈值从八个模型的池中优化。
Result: 两模型级联相对单模型选择在五个基准上平均测试集准确率提升 2.1–8.2 个百分点；基于条件的局部搜索与穷举搜索结果接近。超过两层的深度在 135 组比较（跨 scorer、数据集、深度上限）中的 118 组不提升平均测试集准确率，最大增益仅 0.43 个百分点。反事实实验中，当模拟分数 AUROC 高且只反映当前模型是否答对时，超过两层在五个基准中的四个上提升测试集准确率；当分数同时反映跨模型共享的题目难度时，即便 AUROC 相同增益也不复存在。
Conclusion: 额外深度的收益取决于置信分数对当前模型与后续模型的正确/错误区分能力，而非 AUROC 本身；对多数场景，两层级联已足够，加层不值得。

papers.title: On the Influence of the Feature Computation Budget on Per-Instance Algorithm Selection for Black-Box Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Per-instance algorithm selection (PIAS) takes advantage of complementarity between a set of algorithms by deciding which algorithm to run on a given instance. This decision is based on features of the instances, which, in the context of black-box optimization (BBO), require a part of the optimization budget to be computed. This raises two questions: (a) from which fraction of the budget spent on feature computation does PIAS become worth it for BBO, and (b) which fraction of the budget optimizes the tradeoff between feature accuracy and PIAS performance. To this end, we perform a broad study where PIAS with varying sampling budgets for feature computation is compared to the single best algorithm on a broad range of algorithm selection scenarios. These scenarios consist of two portfolio sizes, three problem sets, 4 dimensionalities, and 10 target budgets. We find that PIAS is viable for the majority of tested scenarios, even when as much as a quarter of the total budget is spent on feature computation. The tradeoff for the fraction of the budget spent on feature computation to maximize the benefit of PIAS is highly dependent on the specific AS scenario. Further, on average 20 percent of PIAS loss to the virtual best solver is explained by the budget spent on feature computation, highlighting the importance of properly accounting for the feature budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在黑盒优化 (BBO) 的逐实例算法选择 (PIAS) 中，特征计算要吃掉一部分优化预算，作者系统扫描特征采样预算占比，发现即使把总预算的四分之一花在算特征上，PIAS 在多数测试场景中仍优于单一最优算法；但使 PIAS 收益最大化的预算占比高度依赖具体算法选择场景，平均有 20% 的 PIAS 相对虚拟最优求解器 (VBS) 的损失可由特征预算解释。
Motivation: PIAS 依赖实例特征，而 BBO 中特征必须从优化预算里抽取，特征算得多则选择更准但留给优化的预算更少；此前缺少从哪个预算占比起 PIAS 才划算、以及哪个占比最优的系统答案。
Method: 在不同特征计算采样预算下把 PIAS 与单一最优算法对比，覆盖 2 种组合规模、3 个问题集、4 个维度、10 个目标预算构成的算法选择场景。
Result: PIAS 在多数测试场景中可行，即使特征计算占用总预算的 25%；最优预算占比高度依赖具体 AS 场景；平均 20% 的 PIAS 相对虚拟最优求解器 (VBS) 的损失可由特征预算解释。
Conclusion: 在 BBO 中必须把特征预算计入 PIAS 的账：四分之一预算下仍多数划算，但最优占比因场景而异，需按场景单独核算。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning to Theorize the World from Observation
papers.abstract_en: What does it mean to understand the world? Contemporary world models often operationalize understanding as accurate future prediction in latent or observation space. Developmental cognitive science, however, suggests a different view: human understanding emerges through the construction of internal theories of how the world works, even before mature language is acquired. Inspired by this theory-building view of cognition, we introduce Learning-to-Theorize, a learning paradigm for inferring explicit explanatory theories of the world from raw, non-textual observations. We instantiate this paradigm with the Neural Theorizer (NEO), a World Theory Model, that induces latent programs as a learned Language of Thought and executes them through a shared transition model. In NEO, a theory is represented as an executable, compositional program whose learned primitives can be systematically recombined to explain novel phenomena. Experiments show that this formulation enables explanation-driven generalization, allowing observations to be understood in terms of the programs that generate them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Learning-to-Theorize 范式与 Neural Theorizer (NEO)：从原始非文本观测中归纳出显式、可执行的组合理论程序，作为学到的 Language of Thought，并用共享 transition model 执行。理论以可组合程序表示，其学到的原语能系统性重组去解释新现象，实验显示该形式带来 explanation-driven generalization。
Motivation: 当代 world model 把「理解」操作化为在潜空间或观测空间做准确未来预测，缺少对世界运作方式的显式解释理论；发展认知科学指出理解来自构建内部理论。
Method: NEO 作为 World Theory Model，从 raw non-textual observations 归纳潜程序 (latent programs) 作为学到的 Language of Thought，理论表示为可执行、可组合的程序，由共享 transition model 执行，学到的原语可系统性重组。
Result: 实验表明该程序化理论表示实现 explanation-driven generalization，观测可被理解为生成它们的程序；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把理论表示为可执行、可重组的程序，是从观测中获得解释性理解并泛化到新现象的一条可行路径，理解不必等同于预测准确。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: VIDA: A Dataset for Visually Dependent Ambiguity in Multimodal Machine Translation
papers.abstract_en: Ambiguity resolution is a key challenge in multimodal machine translation (MMT), where models must genuinely leverage visual input to map an ambiguous expression to its intended meaning. Although prior work has proposed disambiguation-oriented benchmarks probing the role of vision, we observe that existing benchmarks remain limited by task-format mismatch, narrow ambiguity coverage, or insufficient visual-dependency validation. Moreover, existing ambiguity evaluations are not well suited to diverse ambiguity types in open-ended translation. To address these limitations, we present VIDA (Visually-Dependent Ambiguity), a dataset of 2,500 carefully curated instances in which resolving an annotated source span requires visual evidence. We further propose Disambiguation-Centric Metrics that use an LLM-as-a-judge classifier to verify whether annotated ambiguous expressions are resolved correctly at the span level. Evaluations with stronger recent LVLMs show that visual disambiguation remains challenging. Using chain-of-thought supervised fine-tuning as a diagnostic setting, we observe stronger out-of-distribution disambiguation than with SFT, with robust gains on collective-noun ambiguities and model-dependent gains on sentence-level ambiguities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VIDA 提出 2,500 条视觉依赖歧义 (visually-dependent ambiguity) 多模态机器翻译数据集，每条实例的标注源片段必须借助图像才能消解，并配套 Disambiguation-Centric Metrics：用 LLM-as-a-judge 分类器在 span 级判定歧义是否被正确消解。近期强 LVLM 评测显示视觉消歧仍困难；以 chain-of-thought 监督微调 (CoT SFT) 作诊断设置时，其分布外消歧强于普通 SFT，集体名词歧义上增益稳健，句子级歧义上增益随模型而异。
Motivation: 现有面向消歧的多模态翻译基准受限于任务格式不匹配、歧义类型覆盖窄、视觉依赖性验证不足，且不适配开放式翻译中多样的歧义类型。
Method: 构建 VIDA 数据集，含 2,500 条经人工筛选、必须依赖视觉证据才能消解标注源片段的实例；提出 Disambiguation-Centric Metrics，用 LLM-as-a-judge 分类器在 span 级核验歧义是否被正确消解；评测近期强 LVLM，并以 chain-of-thought 监督微调作为诊断设置与普通 SFT 对比。
Result: VIDA 含 2,500 条视觉依赖实例；对更强近期 LVLM 的评测显示视觉消歧仍具挑战；CoT SFT 相比普通 SFT 表现出更强的分布外 (out-of-distribution) 消歧能力，其中集体名词歧义增益稳健，句子级歧义增益依模型而定。
Conclusion: 视觉消歧是当前 LVLM 在多模态翻译中仍未解决的短板，而以 CoT 微调可带来分布外泛化的消歧改善，且效果随歧义层级（集体名词 vs 句子级）与模型而变。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Perturb and Correct: Post-Hoc Ensembles using Affine Redundancy
papers.abstract_en: Models that are nearly indistinguishable on in-distribution data can behave very differently under distribution shift. We introduce Perturb-and-Correct (P&C), a post-hoc method for constructing epistemically diverse predictors from a single pretrained network. P&C applies random hidden-layer perturbations with a least-squares correction in the following affine layer, producing predictors that agree on calibration data while remaining free to disagree away from it. We analyze this mechanism through the post-correction residual that remains in the activation of the layer corrected using calibration data, yielding a leverage-based preservation bound and a covariance interpretation of ensemble disagreement. Empirically, P&C achieves a strong ID/OOD tradeoff across MuJoCo dynamics prediction and CIFAR-10 OOD detection, and scales to a pretrained ViT-B/16 on ImageNet-1K. In matched comparisons with Deep Ensembles, P&C substantially reduces construction and storage cost. Our findings highlight the potential in further exploiting overparameterization as a strength of deep learning models.

papers.title: Learning Over-Relaxation Policies for ADMM with Convergence Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: The Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) is a widely used method for structured convex optimization, and its practical performance depends strongly on the choice of penalty and relaxation parameters. Motivated by settings such as Model Predictive Control (MPC), where one repeatedly solves related optimization problems with fixed structure and changing parameter values, we propose learning online updates of the relaxation parameter to improve average performance on problem classes of interest, while guaranteeing that asymptotic convergence is not compromised for the worst-case realization of such problems. This choice is computationally attractive in the Operator Splitting Quadratic Program (OSQP)-like architectures, since adapting relaxation does not trigger the matrix refactorizations associated with penalty updates. We establish convergence guarantees for ADMM with time-varying penalty and relaxation parameters under mild assumptions, and show on benchmark quadratic programs that the resulting learned policies improve both iteration count and wall-clock time on average over baseline OSQP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为 ADMM 学习在线超松弛 (over-relaxation) 参数更新策略，在结构固定、参数变化的重复求解场景（如 MPC）中提升平均求解性能，同时保证最坏情形下渐近收敛不受影响。由于只调松弛参数不触发矩阵重分解，该做法在 OSQP 类架构中计算代价低；在基准二次规划上，学到的策略平均减少迭代次数并缩短墙钟时间。
Motivation: ADMM 的实际表现强烈依赖罚参数与松弛参数的选择，而 MPC 这类场景需要反复求解结构相同、参数不同的优化问题，手工调参难以兼顾平均性能与最坏情形的收敛保证。
Method: 提出学习 ADMM 在线松弛参数更新策略（针对 OSQP 类架构，调松弛不触发罚参数更新带来的矩阵重分解）；在温和假设下建立带时变罚参数与松弛参数的 ADMM 收敛性保证，使最坏情形渐近收敛不被破坏；在基准二次规划上与基线 OSQP 对比。
Result: 在基准二次规划 (quadratic programs) 上，学到的松弛策略相比基线 OSQP 平均降低迭代次数并缩短墙钟时间 (wall-clock time)；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 在结构固定的重复优化问题上，学习松弛参数可以在不牺牲最坏情形收敛保证的前提下改善 ADMM 的平均迭代与耗时表现，且比调罚参数更省计算。

papers.title: PSI-Bench: Interpretable and Clinically Meaningful Evaluation of Depression Patient Simulators
papers.abstract_en: Patient simulators are gaining traction in mental health training by providing scalable exposure to complex and sensitive patient interactions. Simulating depressed patients is challenging, as safety constraints and high patient variability complicate simulations and underscore the need for simulators that capture diverse and realistic patient behaviors. However, existing evaluations heavily rely on LLM-judges with poorly specified prompts and do not assess behavioral diversity. We introduce PSI-Bench, an automatic evaluation framework that provides interpretable, clinically meaningful diagnostics of depression patient simulator behavior across turn-, dialogue-, and population-level dimensions. Using PSI-Bench, we benchmark seven LLMs across two simulator frameworks and find that simulators produce overly long, lexically diverse responses, show reduced variability, and move through therapeutic stages and toward positive valence too quickly. We also show that the simulation framework has a larger impact on fidelity than the model scale. Results from a human study demonstrate that our benchmark is strongly aligned with judgments of mental health professionals. Our work reveals key limitations of current depression patient simulators and provides an interpretable, extensible benchmark to guide future simulator design and evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PSI-Bench 是一个针对抑郁症患者模拟器的自动评测框架，在 turn、dialogue、population 三个层级给出可解释且具临床意义的行为诊断。用它测七个 LLM 与两套模拟框架，发现模拟器回复过长、词面多样性偏高但行为变异度下降，且过快推进治疗阶段、过快转向正性效价；模拟框架本身对保真度的影响大于模型规模。
Motivation: 心理健康训练中的患者模拟器依赖 LLM-judge，提示词规范不清且不评估行为多样性，导致无法判断模拟器是否真实、安全地再现抑郁症患者的多变行为。
Method: 提出 PSI-Bench 自动评测框架，在 turn-level、dialogue-level、population-level 三个维度上给出可解释、临床相关的诊断指标；用它对七个 LLM、两套模拟框架做基准测试，并与心理健康专业人员的判断做人类研究对照。
Result: 七个 LLM、两套模拟框架的基准显示：模拟器产生过长且词面多样的回复，行为变异度降低，过快走完治疗阶段并过快转向正性效价；模拟框架对保真度的影响大于模型规模；人类研究显示该基准与心理健康专业人员的判断高度一致。
Conclusion: 当前抑郁患者模拟器的主要缺陷在行为多样性与阶段推进节奏，而非模型规模，因此改进应优先落在模拟框架设计上，PSI-Bench 可作为可解释、可扩展的评测标准。

papers.title: Same Methods, Different Rankings: Trainable Depth as an Evaluation Variable in Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning (CL) examines how models learn a sequence of tasks while retaining previously learned knowledge. Despite substantial progress in benchmarking CL methods, comparative evaluations typically keep the fine-tuning regime fixed. In this paper, we argue that the fine-tuning regime, defined by the trainable parameter subspace, is itself a key evaluation variable. We formalize adaptation regimes as projected optimization over fixed trainable subspaces, showing that changing the trainable depth alters the effective update signal through which both current task fitting and knowledge preservation operate. This analysis motivates the hypothesis that method comparisons need not be invariant across regimes. We test this hypothesis in task incremental CL while considering 5 trainable depth regimes and 5 standard methods: online EWC, LwF, SI, GEM, and DER. We find that the relative ranking of methods is not consistently preserved across regimes when evaluating across 5 benchmark datasets, namely MNIST, Fashion MNIST, KMNIST, QMNIST, and CIFAR-100, and across 11 task orders per dataset. We further show that deeper adaptation regimes are associated with larger update magnitudes, higher forgetting, and a stronger relationship between the two. These results show that comparative conclusions in CL can depend strongly on the chosen fine-tuning regime, motivating regime-aware evaluation protocols that treat trainable depth as an explicit experimental factor.
papers.journal_ref: P.-T. Iordache, E. Burceanu and M. Dascalu, "Same Methods, Different Rankings: Trainable Depth as an Evaluation Variable in Continual Learning," IEEE Access, vol. 14, pp. 136009-136022, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 持续学习 (CL) 评测通常固定微调范围，本文把可训练参数子空间本身当作评测变量：将适应机制形式化为固定可训练子空间上的投影优化，指出改变可训练深度会改变当前任务拟合与知识保持共同依赖的有效更新信号。在 task-incremental CL 的 5 种可训练深度档位 × 5 个标准方法（online EWC、LwF、SI、GEM、DER）× 5 个数据集（MNIST、Fashion MNIST、KMNIST、QMNIST、CIFAR-100）× 每数据集 11 种任务顺序上，方法相对排名并不跨档位保持一致；更深的适应档位伴随更大更新幅度、更高遗忘，以及两者之间更强的关联。
Motivation: CL 基准比较长期把微调范围固定，排名被当成方法固有属性；但可训练深度会改变有效更新信号，固定它可能让跨方法结论不可迁移。
Method: 把适应机制形式化为固定可训练子空间上的投影优化 (projected optimization)，据此提出方法比较不随适应档位不变的假设；在 task-incremental CL 设定下扫描 5 种可训练深度档位，比较 online EWC、LwF、SI、GEM、DER 五个标准方法，覆盖 5 个基准数据集与每个数据集 11 种任务顺序。
Result: 方法相对排名在 5 种可训练深度档位之间不被一致保持（5 个数据集、每数据集 11 种任务顺序）；更深的适应档位与更大的更新幅度、更高的遗忘相关，且更新幅度与遗忘之间的关联也更强。
Conclusion: CL 的比较性结论会强烈依赖所选微调范围，因此评测协议应把可训练深度作为显式实验因子做 regime-aware 评估，而不是固定后直接排名。

papers.title: Chronax: A Jax Library for Forecasting and Conformal Inference
papers.abstract_en: Time-series forecasting is central to many scientific and industrial domains, such as energy systems, climate modeling, finance, and retail. While forecasting methods have evolved from classical statistical models to automated, and neural approaches, the surrounding software ecosystem remains anchored to the traditional Python numerical stack. Existing libraries rely on interpreter-driven execution and object-oriented abstractions, limiting composability, large-scale parallelism, and integration with modern differentiable and accelerator-oriented workflows. Meanwhile, today's forecasting increasingly involves large collections of heterogeneous time series data, irregular covariates, and frequent retraining, placing new demands on scalability and execution efficiency. JAX offers an alternative paradigm to traditional stateful numerical computation frameworks based on pure functions and program transformations such as just-in-time compilation and automatic vectorization, enabling end-to-end optimization across CPUs, GPUs, and TPUs. However, this modern paradigm has not yet been fully incorporated into the design of forecasting systems. We introduce Chronax, a JAX-native time-series forecasting library that rethinks forecasting abstractions around functional purity, composable transformations, and accelerator-ready execution. By representing preprocessing, modeling, and multi-horizon prediction as pure JAX functions, Chronax enables scalable multi-series forecasting, model-agnostic conformal uncertainty quantification, and seamless integration with modern machine learning and scientific computing pipelines.
papers.comment: Adds an author and corrects references
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Chronax 把时间序列预测的预处理、建模与多步预测全部写成纯 JAX 函数，靠 jit 与自动向量化在 CPU/GPU/TPU 上做可组合的规模化预测，并在同一流水线内提供模型无关的 conformal 不确定性量化。它面向的是异构多序列、不规则协变量与频繁重训的场景，而非任何具体天气或降水任务。
Motivation: 现有预测库依赖解释器驱动执行与面向对象抽象，限制了可组合性、大规模并行以及与可微、加速器工作流的集成，难以应对大量异构时间序列与频繁重训的效率需求。
Method: 以 JAX 原生方式重构预测抽象：预处理、建模、多步 (multi-horizon) 预测都表示为纯函数，用 just-in-time 编译与自动向量化实现跨 CPU/GPU/TPU 的端到端优化；在此之上提供可扩展的多序列预测与模型无关的 conformal 不确定性量化，并对接现代 ML 与科学计算流水线。
Result: 摘要给出的是能力层面的结论：支持可扩展多序列预测、模型无关的 conformal 不确定性量化，以及与现代机器学习和科学计算流水线的无缝集成；未列出数据集、基线或定量指标。
Conclusion: 预测系统应按函数式纯度、可组合变换与加速器就绪执行来设计，把不确定性量化作为库内一等能力而非外挂模块。

papers.title: Wasserstein Formulation of Reinforcement Learning. An Optimal Transport Perspective on Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We present a geometric framework for Reinforcement Learning (RL) that views policies as maps into the Wasserstein space of action probabilities. First, we define a Riemannian structure induced by stationary distributions, providing rigorous guarantees for their existence in a general context. We then define the tangent space of policies and characterize the geodesics, specifically addressing the measurability of vector fields mapping from the state space to the tangent space of probability measures over the action space. Next, we formulate a general RL optimization problem and construct a gradient flow using Otto's calculus. We compute the gradient and the Hessian of the energy (i.e., the expected cumulative cost), providing a formal second-order analysis. Finally, we illustrate the method with numerical examples: we compute the gradient directly from our theoretical formalism for low-dimensional problems, and we illustrate the numerical applicability of our formal framework to high-dimensional continuous control by parameterizing the policy with a neural network optimized via an ergodic approximation of the cost.

TL;DR: 把 RL 策略视为映入动作概率 Wasserstein 空间的对象，用平稳分布诱导的 Riemannian 结构与 Otto calculus 构造策略优化的梯度流，并给出能量（期望累积代价）的梯度与 Hessian 的二阶分析。低维问题直接由理论形式计算梯度，高维连续控制则用神经网络参数化策略、以代价的遍历逼近 (ergodic approximation) 优化。
Motivation: 策略空间缺少与概率几何相容的微分结构，导致梯度流、测地线与二阶信息难以严格定义，尤其在状态到概率测度切空间的向量场可测性上不严谨。
Method: 在 Wasserstein 空间上由平稳分布诱导 Riemannian 结构并证明其存在性；定义策略切空间、刻画测地线并处理向量场可测性；用 Otto calculus 对期望累积代价构造梯度流，计算梯度与 Hessian；数值上低维直接按理论求梯度，高维用神经网络参数化策略并以遍历逼近优化代价。
Result: 给出一般情形下平稳分布存在性的严格保证与形式化的二阶（梯度与 Hessian）分析；在低维问题上直接从理论形式算出梯度，并在高维连续控制上展示该框架的数值可用性。
Conclusion: 把策略优化放进 Wasserstein 几何可以用 Otto calculus 统一地给出梯度流与二阶结构，并可经神经网络参数化与遍历逼近落到高维连续控制。

papers.title: TempusBench: An Evaluation Framework for Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models have transformed natural language processing and computer vision, and a rapidly growing literature on time-series foundation models (TSFMs) seeks to replicate this success in forecasting. While recent open-source models demonstrate the promise of TSFMs, the field lacks a comprehensive and community-accepted model evaluation framework. We see at least four major issues impeding progress on the development of such a framework. First, existing evaluation frameworks comprise benchmark forecasting tasks derived from often outdated datasets (e.g., M3), many of which lack clear metadata and overlap with the corpora used to pre-train TSFMs. Second, these frameworks evaluate models along a narrowly defined set of benchmark forecasting tasks, such as forecast horizon length or domain, but overlook core statistical properties such as non-stationarity and seasonality. Third, domain-specific models (e.g., XGBoost) are often compared unfairly, as existing frameworks do not enforce a systematic and consistent hyperparameter tuning convention for all models. Fourth, visualization tools for interpreting comparative performance are lacking. To address these issues, we introduce TempusBench, an open-source evaluation framework for TSFMs. TempusBench consists of 1) new datasets which are not included in existing TSFM pretraining corpora, 2) a set of novel benchmark tasks that go beyond existing ones, 3) a model evaluation pipeline with a standardized hyperparameter tuning protocol, and 4) a tensorboard-based visualization interface. We provide access to our code on GitHub: https://github.com/Smlcrm/TempusBench and maintain a live leaderboard at https://smlcrm.com/tempusbench.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TempusBench 是面向时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 的开源评测框架，用不在现有 TSFM 预训练语料中的新数据集、覆盖非平稳性与季节性等统计特性的新基准任务、统一的超参调优协议和 TensorBoard 可视化界面，解决现有评测框架数据过时且与预训练集重叠、任务维度单一、超参比较不公平、缺少可视化这四个问题。
Motivation: 现有 TSFM 评测框架依赖 M3 等过时数据集且与预训练语料重叠，只按预测跨度或领域划分任务而忽略非平稳性、季节性等统计属性，对 XGBoost 等领域模型缺乏统一超参调优约定，导致比较不公平。
Method: TempusBench 包含四部分：不进入现有 TSFM 预训练语料的新数据集、超越既有维度的基准任务集、带标准化超参调优协议的模型评估流水线，以及基于 TensorBoard 的可视化界面；代码开源在 GitHub，配套在线 leaderboard。
Result: 产出为框架本身：新数据集、新基准任务、统一超参调优的评估流水线与 TensorBoard 可视化接口，并提供 GitHub 代码与 smlcrm.com/tempusbench 实时榜单。
Conclusion: 作者主张时间序列基础模型需要一个社区公认的评测框架，其关键在于数据不与预训练重叠、任务覆盖核心统计属性、超参调优协议对所有模型一致。

papers.title: Tensor-based computation of the Koopman generator via operator logarithm
papers.abstract_en: Identifying governing equations of nonlinear dynamical systems from data is challenging. While sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy) and its extensions are widely used for system identification, operator-logarithm approaches use the logarithm to avoid time differentiation, enabling larger sampling intervals. However, they still suffer from the curse of dimensionality. Then, we propose a data-driven method to compute the Koopman generator in a low-rank tensor train (TT) format by taking logarithms of Koopman eigenvalues while preserving the TT format. Experiments on 4-dimensional Lotka-Volterra and 10-dimensional Lorenz-96 systems show accurate recovery of vector field coefficients and scalability to higher-dimensional systems.
papers.journal_ref: Nonlinear Theory and its Applications, IEICE 17, pp. 1406-1417 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出在低秩 tensor train (TT) 格式下通过对 Koopman 特征值取对数来计算 Koopman generator 的数据驱动方法，全程保持 TT 结构以绕开时间微分并缓解维数灾难。在 4 维 Lotka-Volterra 与 10 维 Lorenz-96 上能准确恢复向量场系数，并可扩展到更高维系统。
Motivation: SINDy 及其扩展需要时间微分，operator-logarithm 方法虽可用对数避免微分、容忍更大采样间隔，但仍受维数灾难限制，难以处理高维非线性动力系统的方程辨识。
Method: 对 Koopman 特征值取对数得到 generator，同时在低秩 tensor train (TT) 格式中执行该运算以保持张量结构，从而数据驱动地计算 Koopman generator，无需时间差分。
Result: 在 4 维 Lotka-Volterra 和 10 维 Lorenz-96 系统上的实验中，向量场系数被准确恢复，并展示出向更高维系统的可扩展性。
Conclusion: 把 Koopman generator 的计算放进 TT 格式并用特征值对数替代时间微分，可在保持精度的同时扩展到更高维非线性系统。
Relevance: 18
