papers.title: A Self-Calibrating Framework for Analog Circuit Sizing Using LLM-Derived Analytical Equations
papers.abstract_en: We present a design automation framework for analog circuit sizing that produces calibrated, topology-specific analytical equations from raw circuit netlists. A large language model (LLM) derives a complete Python sizing function in which each device dimension is traceable to a specific design rationale - a form of interpretable output absent from existing optimization-based and LLM-based sizing methods. A deterministic calibration loop extracts process-dependent parameters from a single DC operating point simulation, while a prediction-error feedback mechanism compensates for analytical inaccuracies. We validate the framework on circuits ranging from 6 to 30 transistors - spanning single-stage, current-mirror (simple and cascoded), folded-cascode, gain-boosted folded-cascode, two-stage Miller-compensated, nested-Miller-compensated, and complementary class-AB output topologies - across six process nodes from 32 nm to 180 nm. On matched-specification benchmarks, including the class-AB opamp case, the framework converges within a few simulations. Despite large initial prediction errors, convergence depends on the measurement-feedback architecture, not prediction accuracy. The one-shot calibration automatically captures process-dependent variations, enabling cross-node portability without modification, retraining, or per-process characterization.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables, plus supplementary. V3: Extended to 8 topology families (6-30 transistors) across 6 process nodes with 5-trial statistics; adds cross-model evaluation (5 LLMs), ablation study, matched TuRBO-1 baseline, and structural audit of 2,634 LLM-derived equations
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出模拟电路尺寸设计自动化框架：由 LLM 从原始网表直接推导出可追溯到具体设计依据的完整 Python 尺寸函数，再用确定性校准环路与预测误差反馈闭环修正。在 6–30 晶体管、8 类拓扑、32 nm 到 180 nm 共 6 个工艺节点上，匹配规格基准（含 class-AB 运放）在数次仿真内收敛，且收敛取决于测量反馈架构而非预测精度，单次校准即可跨节点免修改迁移。
Motivation: 现有基于优化和基于 LLM 的尺寸设计方法给出的尺寸结果无法追溯到具体设计依据，且换工艺节点通常要重新表征或重训。
Method: LLM 从原始电路网表推导出完整 Python 尺寸函数，每个器件尺寸都绑定设计理由；确定性校准环路从单次 DC 工作点仿真提取工艺相关参数，预测误差反馈机制补偿解析式误差。V3 扩展到 8 个拓扑族（6–30 晶体管）、6 个工艺节点，含 5 次试验统计、5 个 LLM 的跨模型评估、消融研究、匹配的 TuRBO-1 基线，以及对 2,634 条 LLM 推导方程的结构性审计。
Result: 在匹配规格基准（含 class-AB 运放）上，框架在数次仿真内收敛；尽管初始预测误差很大，收敛取决于测量反馈架构而非预测精度。一次校准自动捕获工艺相关变化，跨节点可免修改、免重训、免逐工艺表征迁移；覆盖 6–30 晶体管、8 类拓扑（单级、电流镜简单/级联、折叠级联、增益提升折叠级联、两级 Miller、嵌套 Miller、互补 class-AB 输出）、6 个工艺节点 32 nm–180 nm，5 次试验统计，并与 TuRBO-1 基线匹配对比，审计了 2,634 条 LLM 推导方程。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 生成的解析式放进带测量反馈的校准闭环，可同时拿到可解释的尺寸依据与跨工艺节点的免重训可移植性；收敛性由反馈架构保证，而非依赖解析式一开始预测得准。

papers.title: High-dimensional reliability-based design optimization using stochastic emulators
papers.abstract_en: Reliability-based design optimization (RBDO) is traditionally formulated as a nested optimization and reliability problem and remains computationally demanding, especially in high dimensions. This paper proposes a new RBDO framework based on a stochastic simulator viewpoint, in which the deterministic limit-state function and uncertain model inputs are combined into a unified stochastic representation. For a given design, the system response is characterized directly through its conditional output distribution rather than through an explicit limit-state function. Stochastic emulators are constructed in the design space to approximate this conditional distribution, enabling semi-analytical evaluation of failure probabilities or associated quantiles without Monte Carlo simulation. Two approaches are considered: generalized lambda models (GLaM) and stochastic polynomial chaos expansions (SPCE). Both yield deterministic mappings between design variables and reliability constraints, thereby eliminating the classical double-loop structure and enabling standard deterministic optimization. The approach is assessed on benchmark problems ranging from low to very high dimension, including stochastic excitation, and compared with Kriging in the full input space and heteroscedastic Gaussian processes in the design space. The proposed method provides substantial computational gains, particularly for high-dimensional random inputs, while retaining comparable efficiency to Kriging in low dimensions. Unlike heteroscedastic Gaussian processes, GLaM and SPCE also avoid restrictive assumptions on the conditional response distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 RBDO 从嵌套的“优化+可靠性”双环改写为随机模拟器视角：在设计空间上拟合条件输出分布的随机代理（GLaM 与 SPCE），半解析地算失效概率或分位数，从而去掉双环、退化为标准确定性优化。在低到极高维（含随机激励）基准上相比全输入空间 Kriging 有显著计算收益，低维下效率相当，且不像异方差 GP 那样依赖对条件分布的限制性假设。
Motivation: RBDO 传统上写成嵌套的优化与可靠性问题，高维时计算代价极高，双环结构使每次设计迭代都要重跑可靠性分析。
Method: 把确定性极限状态函数与不确定模型输入合并成统一随机表示，对给定设计直接刻画条件输出分布；在设计空间上构建随机代理，给出两种实现：广义 lambda 模型 (GLaM) 与随机多项式混沌展开 (SPCE)，二者都给出设计变量到可靠性约束的确定性映射，从而免去显式极限状态函数与 Monte Carlo 模拟。
Result: 在低维到极高维（含随机激励）的基准问题上，与全输入空间 Kriging 和设计空间异方差高斯过程对比：对高维随机输入有显著计算增益，低维下效率与 Kriging 相当；GLaM 与 SPCE 不需要对条件响应分布做限制性假设，而异方差 GP 需要。
Conclusion: 用条件分布随机代理替代显式极限状态函数，可以把 RBDO 的双环压成单层确定性优化，且在高维随机输入下收益最大。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.method: 把确定性极限状态函数与不确定模型输入合并成统一随机表示，对给定设计直接刻画条件输出分布；在设计空间上构建随机代理，给出两种实现：广义 lambda 模型 (GLaM) 与随机多项式混沌展开 (SPCE)，二者都给出设计变量到可靠性约束的确定性映射，从而免去显式极限状态函数与 Monte Carlo 模拟。
summary_sections.result: 在低维到极高维（含随机激励）的基准问题上，与全输入空间 Kriging 和设计空间异方差高斯过程对比：对高维随机输入有显著计算增益，低维下效率与 Kriging 相当；GLaM 与 SPCE 不需要对条件响应分布做限制性假设，而异方差 GP 需要。
summary_sections.conclusion: 用条件分布随机代理替代显式极限状态函数，可以把 RBDO 的双环压成单层确定性优化，且在高维随机输入下收益最大。

papers.title: EXHIB: A Benchmark for Realistic and Diverse Evaluation of Function Similarity in the Wild
authors: Carter Yagemann (1) ((1) The Ohio State University)
papers.abstract_en: Binary Function Similarity Detection (BFSD) is a core problem in software security, supporting tasks such as vulnerability analysis, malware classification, and patch provenance. In the past few decades, numerous models and tools have been developed for this application; however, due to the lack of a comprehensive universal benchmark in this field, researchers have struggled to compare different models effectively. Existing datasets are limited in scope, often focusing on a narrow set of transformations or types of binaries, and fail to reflect the full diversity of real-world applications. We introduce EXHIB, a benchmark comprising five realistic datasets collected from the wild, each highlighting a distinct aspect of the BFSD problem space. We evaluate 9 representative models spanning multiple BFSD paradigms on EXHIB and observe performance degradations of up to 30% on firmware and semantic datasets compared to standard settings, revealing substantial generalization gaps. Our results show that robustness to low- and mid-level binary variations does not generalize to high-level semantic differences, underscoring a critical blind spot in current BFSD evaluation practices.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 7 figures. This is a technical report for the EXHIB benchmark. Code and data are available at https://github.com/fan1192/EXHIB and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18488936
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EXHIB 提出二进制函数相似性检测 (BFSD) 基准，含五个从真实世界采集、各覆盖问题空间不同侧面的数据集，并评测 9 个代表性模型。在固件与语义数据集上，相比标准设置性能下降最多 30%，暴露出明显泛化差距。
Motivation: BFSD 缺乏全面通用基准，现有数据集只覆盖少数变换或二进制类型，无法反映真实应用的多样性，研究者难以有效比较不同模型。
Method: 构建 EXHIB 基准，由五个来自真实世界 (in the wild) 的数据集组成，每个突出 BFSD 问题空间的一个独立侧面；在该基准上评测横跨多种 BFSD 范式的 9 个代表性模型。
Result: 在 EXHIB 上评测的 9 个模型相比标准设置，在固件与语义数据集上性能下降最多 30%；结果显示对低层与中层二进制变换的鲁棒性并不能泛化到高层语义差异。
Conclusion: 当前 BFSD 评测存在关键盲点：模型在标准数据集上的鲁棒性掩盖了对高层语义差异的真实泛化差距，评测应覆盖真实世界的多样性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sven: Singular Value Descent as a Computationally Efficient Natural Gradient Method
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Sven (Singular Value dEsceNt), a new optimization algorithm for neural networks that exploits the natural decomposition of loss functions into a sum over individual data points, rather than reducing the full loss to a single scalar before computing a parameter update. Sven treats each data point's residual as a separate condition to be satisfied simultaneously, using the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse of the loss Jacobian to find the minimum-norm parameter update that best satisfies all conditions at once. In practice, this pseudoinverse is approximated via a truncated singular value decomposition, retaining only the $k$ most significant directions. We show that Sven can be understood as a natural gradient method generalized to the overparametrized regime, recovering natural gradient descent in the underparametrized limit. We test Sven on a variety of regression and classification tasks, including small-scale language modeling with transformers, and find that it is competitive with leading baselines such as Adam, Muon, and K-FAC. We also discuss Sven's memory overhead, which presents a barrier to scaling under a naive implementation, and introduce an optimized implementation that keeps memory usage on par with standard baselines under mild restrictions on model architecture. Beyond standard machine learning benchmarks, we anticipate that Sven will find natural application in scientific computing settings where custom loss functions decompose into several conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sven (Singular Value dEsceNt) 把损失按数据点拆成多个条件同时求解，用损失 Jacobian 的 Moore-Penrose 伪逆取最小范数更新，实践中以截断 SVD 只保留 k 个最显著方向。它可视为过参数化下的自然梯度方法（欠参数化极限退回自然梯度下降），在回归、分类与小规模 Transformer 语言模型上与 Adam、Muon、K-FAC 竞争力相当。朴素实现有内存开销壁垒，作者给出在温和架构限制下把内存压回与标准基线持平的优化实现。
Motivation: 标准优化器先把整个损失压成一个标量再更新参数，丢掉了损失可按数据点分解的结构；过参数化下自然梯度的定义也未被覆盖。
Method: 将每个数据点的残差视为需同时满足的独立条件，用损失 Jacobian 的 Moore-Penrose 伪逆求最小范数参数更新；实际计算用截断 SVD 保留前 k 个显著奇异方向。理论上把该更新解释为推广到过参数化 regime 的自然梯度，欠参数化极限恢复 natural gradient descent；另给出在温和模型架构限制下与标准基线内存相当的优化实现。
Result: 在回归、分类以及含小规模 Transformer 语言模型的多种任务上测试，与 Adam、Muon、K-FAC 等领先基线相比具有竞争力；讨论了朴素实现的内存开销壁垒，并给出优化实现使内存占用在温和架构限制下与标准基线持平。
Conclusion: 按数据点分解损失并用截断 SVD 伪逆做更新，是过参数化下自然梯度的一种可实现形式；其可扩展性取决于内存优化与模型架构限制。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Ultimate Tutorial for AI-driven Scale Development in Generative Psychometrics: Releasing AIGENIE from its Bottle
papers.abstract_en: Psychological scale development has traditionally required extensive expert involvement, iterative revision, and large-scale pilot testing before psychometric evaluation can begin. The \texttt{AIGENIE} R package implements the AI-GENIE framework (Automatic Item Generation and Validation with Network-Integrated Evaluation), which integrates large language model (LLM) text generation with network psychometric methods to automate the early stages of this process. The package generates candidate item pools using LLMs, transforms them into high-dimensional embeddings, and applies a multi-step reduction pipeline --- Exploratory Graph Analysis (EGA), Unique Variable Analysis (UVA), and bootstrap EGA --- to produce structurally validated item pools entirely \textit{in silico}. This tutorial introduces the package across eight parts: installation and setup, text generation, embeddings, item generation, the full AI-GENIE pipeline, the GENIE pipeline for researcher-supplied items, advanced prompt engineering, and fully local operation. Two running examples illustrate the package's use: the Big Five personality model (a well-established construct) and AI Anxiety (an emerging construct). The package supports multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, HuggingFace, and local models), offers a fully offline mode with no external API calls, and provides the \texttt{GENIE()} function for researchers who wish to apply the psychometric reduction pipeline to existing item pools regardless of their origin. The \texttt{AIGENIE} package is freely available on CRAN at \url{https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=AIGENIE}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AIGENIE 这个 R 包把 LLM 文本生成与网络心理测量方法接成一条全自动量表开发流水线：生成候选题池、转成高维 embedding，再经 EGA、UVA、bootstrap EGA 逐步缩减，完全 in silico 地得到结构上已验证的题池。它支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Groq、HuggingFace 与本地模型，可完全离线运行，并用 Big Five 与 AI Anxiety 两个例子贯穿八个部分的教程。
Motivation: 心理量表开发前期依赖大量专家介入、反复修订与大规模预试，心理测量评估要等这些做完才能开始，周期长、成本高。
Method: AI-GENIE 框架（Automatic Item Generation and Validation with Network-Integrated Evaluation）由 AIGENIE R 包实现：LLM 生成候选题池，转为高维 embeddings，再用 Exploratory Graph Analysis (EGA)、Unique Variable Analysis (UVA)、bootstrap EGA 组成的多步缩减流水线做结构验证；另提供 GENIE() 函数，供研究者对自备题池跑同一套缩减流程，并含高级 prompt 工程与完全本地运行两部分。
Result: 教程分八个部分：安装配置、文本生成、embeddings、题目生成、完整 AI-GENIE 流水线、面向自备题目的 GENIE 流水线、高级 prompt 工程、完全本地运行；以 Big Five 人格模型与 AI Anxiety 两个正在形成的构念作贯穿示例，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Groq、HuggingFace 及本地模型，并提供无任何外部 API 调用的离线模式。包已发布在 CRAN。
Conclusion: 量表开发的早期阶段可以在完全 in silico 的条件下完成结构验证，研究者既可用 LLM 生成题目，也可把任何来源的既有题池交给 GENIE() 走同一条网络心理测量缩减流水线。

papers.title: High dimensional theory of two-phase optimizers
papers.abstract_en: The trend towards larger training setups has brought a renewed interest in partially asynchronous two-phase optimizers which optimize locally and then synchronize across workers. Additionally, recent work suggests that the one-worker version of one of these algorithms, DiLoCo, shows promising results as a (synchronous) optimizer. Motivated by these studies we present an analysis of LA-DiLoCo, a simple member of the DiLoCo family, on a high-dimensional linear regression problem. We show that the one-worker variant, LA, provides a different tradeoff between signal and noise than SGD, which is beneficial in many scenarios. We also show that the multi-worker version generates more noise than the single worker version, but that this additional noise generation can be ameliorated by appropriate choice of hyperparameters. We conclude with an analysis of SLA -- LA with momentum -- and show that stacking two momentum operators gives an opportunity for acceleration via a non-linear transformation of the "effective'' Hessian spectrum, which is maximized for Nesterov momentum. Altogether our results show that two-phase optimizers represent a fruitful new paradigm for understanding and improving training algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在高维线性回归上分析两阶段优化器 LA-DiLoCo：单 worker 的 LA 相对 SGD 给出不同的信号-噪声权衡，多 worker 版本噪声更大但可用超参数缓解；SLA（LA 加动量）中叠加两个动量算子通过对有效 Hessian 谱的非线性变换带来加速机会，且在 Nesterov 动量处取到最大。
Motivation: 大规模训练推动部分异步两阶段优化器（先本地优化再跨 worker 同步）受到关注，但其在高维下的信号-噪声行为与动量加速机制缺少理论刻画。
Method: 在高维线性回归问题上对 LA-DiLoCo（DiLoCo 家族的简单成员）做理论分析：比较单 worker 的 LA 与 SGD 的信号-噪声权衡，分析多 worker 版本的噪声生成，并研究带动量的 SLA 中两个动量算子叠加对有效 Hessian 谱的非线性变换。
Result: 单 worker 的 LA 相对 SGD 提供不同的信号-噪声权衡，且在许多情形下更有利；多 worker 版本比单 worker 产生更多噪声，但可通过合适的超参数选择加以缓解；SLA 中叠加两个动量算子带来的加速在 Nesterov 动量处最大化。
Conclusion: 两阶段优化器是理解并改进训练算法的一个富有成果的新范式，其加速机会来自对有效 Hessian 谱的非线性变换。

papers.title: ReLope: From Hidden-State Probing to a Decision Module for Multimodal LLM Routing
papers.abstract_en: Routing balances performance and cost in hybrid systems by escalating selected queries from a lightweight model to a powerful but expensive one. Hidden-state probes provide an effective routing signal by predicting the small model's correctness from hidden states it already computes. Although effective in text-only settings, their behavior on multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) is less understood. We find that correctness is harder to predict from hidden states when questions are paired with images rather than with captions of those images. Two training-free dependence measures, HSIC and label CKA, show the same pattern. We first investigate whether changing hidden states used by the probe improves correctness prediction for MLLMs. We propose Attention Probe, which learns an attention query to pool frozen token states into a routing feature and improves over the standard probe. However, pooling only recombines hidden states computed for answer generation, not for deciding whether the answer should be trusted. We therefore build a decision layer inside the existing MLLM and train it for the routing decision. The resulting router, ReLope (KL-Regularized LoRA Probe), adapts a separate copy of one MLLM layer with LoRA and regularizes it with a KL-penalized stochastic bottleneck. This decision branch shares the frozen lower layers and leaves the model's answer-generation path unchanged. ReLope attains the highest correctness prediction AUC on all five benchmarks and three backbones we evaluate and improves the accuracy versus cost trade-off at negligible overhead. These results suggest a new perspective and a practical technical path on routing: rather than reading decisions off states built for generation, routing decisions can be learned by a dedicated decision layer inside the model. Code: https://github.com/Spinozaaa/ReLope
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReLope 把多模态 LLM 的升档路由 (routing) 从「读取生成用隐状态」改成「在模型内部学一个专用决策层」：用 LoRA 改写单层 MLLM 的一份副本，配 KL 惩罚的随机瓶颈 (KL-penalized stochastic bottleneck) 训练路由决策，共享冻结的下层且不改动答案生成路径。在五个 benchmark、三种 backbone 上取得最高 correctness prediction AUC，并在开销可忽略的前提下改善准确率-成本权衡。
Motivation: 隐状态探针在纯文本路由里有效，但图文配对时从隐状态预测小模型正确性更难（HSIC 与 label CKA 两个 training-free 依赖度量给出同样模式），而现有探针只是重组合为生成算出的状态，不是为「该不该信任这个答案」而算的状态。
Method: 先提出 Attention Probe：学一个 attention query 把冻结的 token 状态池化成路由特征，优于标准探针。再构建 ReLope (KL-Regularized LoRA Probe)：在既有 MLLM 内部加决策分支，用 LoRA 适配单独一份 MLLM 层副本，以 KL 惩罚的随机瓶颈做正则，该分支共享冻结的下层并保持答案生成路径不变。
Result: 在全部五个 benchmark、三种 backbone 上 ReLope 取得最高的 correctness prediction AUC，并改善 accuracy-versus-cost 权衡，开销可忽略；图文配对下正确性比图配 caption 更难从隐状态预测，HSIC 与 label CKA 两个依赖度量一致复现该模式。

papers.title: UniFunc3D: Unified Active Spatial-Temporal Grounding for 3D Affordance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Affordance segmentation in 3D scenes requires an agent to ground implicit natural-language instructions into precise masks of fine-grained interactive elements. Existing training-free methods typically rely on fragmented pipelines, which introduce visual blindness during task parsing and limit accuracy through single-scale spatial and temporal processing. We present UniFunc3D, a unified and training-free framework that treats the multimodal large language model as an active observer. By utilizing a unified MLLM backbone, UniFunc3D performs joint semantic-temporal-spatial reasoning to ground task decomposition in direct visual evidence. Our approach introduces active spatial-temporal grounding with a coarse-to-fine strategy. This allows the model to select correct video frames adaptively and focus on high-detail interactive parts while preserving the global context necessary for disambiguation. On SceneFun3D, our UniFunc3D achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing prior training-free methods by a large margin with a relative 59.9\% mIoU improvement, and even outperforming training-based methods without any task-specific training. Code is available on our project page: \url{https://jiaying.link/unifunc3d}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniFunc3D 把多模态大语言模型 (MLM) 当作主动观察者，用统一骨干做语义-时间-空间联合推理，并以 coarse-to-fine 的主动时空定位自适应选帧、聚焦高细节交互部件同时保留全局上下文。在 SceneFun3D 上相对先前 training-free 方法 mIoU 提升 59.9%，达到 state-of-the-art，且无需任何任务特定训练即可超过 training-based 方法。
Motivation: 3D affordance segmentation 需要把自然语言指令落到细粒度交互部件的精确掩码上；现有 training-free 方法依赖碎片化流水线，任务解析时出现视觉盲区，且单尺度时空处理限制精度。
Method: 统一 MLLM 骨干执行联合语义-时间-空间推理，把任务分解直接锚定到视觉证据；引入主动时空定位 (active spatial-temporal grounding) 与 coarse-to-fine 策略，自适应选择正确视频帧并聚焦高细节交互部件，同时保留消歧所需的全局上下文；整体为 training-free 框架，无任务特定训练。
Result: 在 SceneFun3D 上达到 state-of-the-art：相对先前 training-free 方法 mIoU 相对提升 59.9%，并在不做任何任务特定训练的情况下超过 training-based 方法。

papers.title: AI Mental Models: Learned Intuition and Deliberation in a Bounded Neural Architecture
papers.abstract_en: This paper asks whether a bounded neural architecture can exhibit a meaningful division of labor between intuition and deliberation on a classic 64-item syllogistic reasoning benchmark. More broadly, the benchmark is relevant to ongoing debates about world models and multi-stage reasoning in AI. It provides a controlled setting for testing whether a learned system can develop structured internal computation rather than only one-shot associative prediction. Experiment 1 evaluates a direct neural baseline for predicting full 9-way human response distributions under 5-fold cross-validation. Experiment 2 introduces a bounded dual-path architecture with separate intuition and deliberation pathways, motivated by computational mental-model theory (Khemlani & Johnson-Laird, 2022). Under cross-validation, bounded intuition reaches an aggregate correlation of r = 0.7272, whereas bounded deliberation reaches r = 0.8152, and the deliberation advantage is significant across folds (p = 0.0101). The largest held-out gains occur for NVC, Eca, and Oca, suggesting improved handling of rejection responses and c-a conclusions. A canonical 80:20 interpretability run and a five-seed stability sweep further indicate that the deliberation pathway develops sparse, differentiated internal structure, including an Oac-leaning state, a dominant workhorse state, and several weakly used or unused states whose exact indices vary across runs. These findings are consistent with reasoning-like internal organization under bounded conditions, while stopping short of any claim that the model reproduces full sequential processes of model construction, counterexample search, and conclusion revision.
papers.comment: Corrected Figure 1 to show candidate-logit aggregation before the final softmax and corrected KL-divergence notation. Model implementation and numerical results are unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 64 题三段论推理基准上，有界双路径架构把直觉与审慎 (deliberation) 分开建模，审慎路径的 9 类人类反应分布预测相关系数 r = 0.8152，高于直觉路径的 0.7272，跨折优势显著 (p = 0.0101)。增益集中在 NVC、Eca、Oca 三类，即拒绝反应与 c-a 结论；审慎路径内部形成稀疏分化的状态结构。
Motivation: 要检验有界神经架构能否在受控的三段论基准上产生结构化的内部计算，而不只是单次联想预测，从而为 AI 世界模型与多阶段推理的争论提供可测证据。
Method: 实验一用直接神经基线在 5 折交叉验证下预测完整 9 类人类反应分布；实验二引入有界双路径架构，分设直觉与审慎两条通路，理论动机来自 computational mental-model theory (Khemlani & Johnson-Laird, 2022)，并做一次 80:20 可解释性运行与五种子稳定性扫描。
Result: 交叉验证下 bounded intuition 聚合相关 r = 0.7272，bounded deliberation r = 0.8152，审慎优势跨折显著 (p = 0.0101)；最大留出增益出现在 NVC、Eca、Oca 三类。80:20 可解释性运行与五种子扫描显示审慎路径形成稀疏分化结构：一个 Oac 倾向状态、一个主导 workhorse 状态，以及若干弱用或未用状态，其具体索引随运行变化。
Conclusion: 有界条件下模型呈现类似推理的内部组织，但作者明确不主张它复现模型构造、反例搜索与结论修订的完整序列过程。

papers.title: DeepStock: Reinforcement Learning with Policy Regularizations for Inventory Management
papers.abstract_en: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) provides a general-purpose methodology for training inventory policies that can leverage big data and compute. However, off-the-shelf implementations of DRL have seen mixed success, often plagued by high sensitivity to the hyperparameters used during training. In this paper, we show that by imposing policy regularizations, grounded in classical inventory concepts such as "Base Stock", we can significantly accelerate hyperparameter tuning and improve the final performance of several DRL methods. We report details from a 100% deployment of DRL with policy regularizations on Alibaba's e-commerce platform, Tmall. We also include extensive synthetic experiments, which show that policy regularizations reshape the narrative on what is the best DRL method for inventory management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepStock 把经典库存概念 Base Stock 作为策略正则化 (policy regularization) 加进 DRL 库存策略训练，显著加速超参数调优并提升多种 DRL 方法的最终性能；在 Tmall 电商平台完成 100% 部署，合成实验显示这类正则化改变了「哪种 DRL 方法最适合库存管理」的结论。
Motivation: DRL 训练库存策略能吃大数据和算力，但现成实现成败参半，对训练超参数高度敏感，调参成本高且最终性能不稳。
Method: 在 DRL 库存策略训练中引入以经典库存概念（如 Base Stock）为依据的策略正则化，用它约束策略输出；在 Alibaba 电商场景做部署，并配套大量合成实验对比多种 DRL 方法。
Result: 策略正则化显著加速超参数调优并提升多种 DRL 方法的最终性能；在 Alibaba 电商平台 Tmall 实现 100% 部署；合成实验表明策略正则化重塑了关于库存管理最佳 DRL 方法的结论。
Conclusion: 用经典库存规则给 DRL 策略加正则，是缓解超参敏感性并改变方法优劣排序的有效手段，且已可全量上线到真实电商库存系统。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Counteracts Delayed CSI in Multi-Satellite Systems
papers.abstract_en: The integration of satellite communication networks with next-generation (NG) technologies is a promising approach towards global connectivity. However, the quality of services is highly dependant on the availability of accurate channel state information (CSI). Channel estimation in satellite communications is challenging due to the high propagation delay between terrestrial users and satellites, which results in outdated CSI observations on the satellite side. In this paper, we study the downlink transmission of multiple satellites acting as distributed base stations (BS) to mobile terrestrial users. We propose a multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithm which aims for maximising the sum-rate of the users, while coping with the outdated CSI. We design a novel bi-level optimisation, procedure themes as dual stage proximal policy optimisation (DS-PPO), for tackling the problem of large continuous action spaces as well as of independent and non-identically distributed (non-IID) environments in MARL. Specifically, the first stage of DS-PPO maximises the sum-rate for an individual satellite and the second stage maximises the sum-rate when all the satellites cooperate to form a distributed multi-antenna BS. Our numerical results demonstrate the robustness of DS-PPO to CSI imperfections as well as the sum-rate improvement attached by the use of DS-PPO. In addition, we provide the convergence analysis for the DS-PPO along with the computational complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多卫星分布式基站下行中高传播时延导致的过期 CSI，提出双阶段近端策略优化 (DS-PPO) 这一双层 MARL 算法：第一阶段单星最大化和速率，第二阶段各卫星协作组成分布式多天线基站再最大化和速率。数值结果显示 DS-PPO 对 CSI 不完美具有鲁棒性并带来和速率提升，同时给出收敛性分析与计算复杂度。
Motivation: 地面用户与卫星之间传播时延大，卫星侧 CSI 观测过期，使多卫星协作下行的波束/功率决策在非独立同分布 (non-IID) 的多智能体环境中难以用常规 RL 处理，且连续动作空间很大。
Method: 提出 MARL 算法 DS-PPO，采用双层优化：第一阶段对单个卫星最大化用户和速率，第二阶段在全部卫星协作形成分布式多天线基站时最大化和速率；设计目标是同时应对大连续动作空间与 non-IID 环境，并附带收敛性分析与计算复杂度刻画。
Result: 数值结果表明 DS-PPO 对 CSI 不完美（过期/失真）具有鲁棒性，并带来用户和速率提升；摘要同时给出 DS-PPO 的收敛性分析与计算复杂度，但未列出具体数值。
Conclusion: 双阶段 PPO 分层处理单星与协作两层和速率目标，可在 CSI 过期条件下稳健提升多卫星下行和速率。

papers.title: Dense Dynamic Scene Reconstruction and Camera Pose Estimation from Multi-View Videos
papers.abstract_en: We address the challenging problem of dense dynamic scene reconstruction and camera pose estimation from multiple freely moving cameras -- a setting that arises naturally when multiple observers capture a shared event. Prior approaches either handle only single-camera input or require rigidly mounted, pre-calibrated camera rigs, limiting their practical applicability. We propose a two-stage optimization framework that decouples the task into robust camera tracking and dense depth refinement. In the first stage, we extend single-camera visual SLAM to the multi-camera setting by constructing a spatiotemporal connection graph that exploits both intra-camera temporal continuity and inter-camera spatial overlap, enabling consistent scale and robust tracking. To ensure robustness under limited overlap, we introduce a wide-baseline initialization strategy using feed-forward reconstruction models. In the second stage, we refine depth and camera poses by optimizing dense inter- and intra-camera consistency using wide-baseline optical flow. Additionally, we introduce MultiCamRobolab, a new real-world dataset with ground-truth poses from a motion capture system. Finally, we demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art feed-forward models on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks, while requiring less memory.
papers.journal_ref: ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两阶段优化框架，从多个自由移动相机的多视角视频中做稠密动态场景重建与相机位姿估计：先用时空连接图把单目视觉 SLAM 扩展到多相机并以 feed-forward 重建模型做宽基线初始化，再用宽基线光流优化稠密的相机间与相机内一致性来精化深度和位姿。在合成与真实基准上显著优于 SOTA feed-forward 模型且内存占用更低，并发布带动捕真值位姿的新真实数据集 MultiCamRobolab。
Motivation: 多观察者用各自自由移动的相机拍摄同一事件时，现有方法要么只吃单相机输入，要么依赖刚性安装、预先标定的相机阵列，实际可用性受限。
Method: 两阶段解耦为鲁棒相机跟踪与稠密深度精化：第一阶段把单相机视觉 SLAM 扩展到多相机，构建利用相机内时间连续性与相机间空间重叠的时空连接图 (spatiotemporal connection graph) 以保证尺度一致与鲁棒跟踪，并用 feed-forward 重建模型做宽基线初始化以应对有限重叠；第二阶段用宽基线光流优化稠密的 inter-/intra-camera 一致性，联合精化深度与相机位姿。
Result: 在合成与真实基准上显著优于 SOTA feed-forward 模型，同时内存占用更少；发布新真实数据集 MultiCamRobolab，位姿真值由 motion capture 系统提供。
Conclusion: 把多相机重建拆成跟踪与深度精化两阶段、并用时空连接图与宽基线初始化处理自由移动相机的有限重叠，可以在更低内存下超过 feed-forward 模型。

papers.title: $M^2$-Occ: Resilient 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction for Autonomous Driving with Incomplete Camera Inputs
papers.abstract_en: Semantic occupancy prediction enables dense 3D geometric and semantic understanding for autonomous driving. However, existing camera-based approaches implicitly assume complete surround-view observations, an assumption that rarely holds in real-world deployment due to occlusion, hardware malfunction, or communication failures. We study semantic occupancy prediction under incomplete multi-camera inputs and introduce $M^2$-Occ, a framework designed to preserve geometric structure and semantic coherence when views are missing. $M^2$-Occ addresses two complementary challenges. First, a Multi-view Masked Reconstruction (MMR) module leverages the spatial overlap among neighboring cameras to recover missing-view representations directly in the feature space. Second, a Feature Memory Module (FMM) introduces a learnable memory bank that stores class-level semantic prototypes. By retrieving and integrating these global priors, the FMM refines ambiguous voxel features, ensuring semantic consistency even when observational evidence is incomplete. We introduce a systematic missing-view evaluation protocol on the nuScenes-based SurroundOcc benchmark, encompassing both deterministic single-view failures and stochastic multi-view dropout scenarios. Under the safety-critical missing back-view setting, $M^2$-Occ improves the IoU by 4.36%. As the number of missing cameras increases, the robustness gap further widens; for instance, under the setting with five missing views, our method boosts the IoU by 6.67%. These gains are achieved without compromising full-view performance. The source code will be publicly released at https://github.com/qixi7up/M2-Occ.
papers.comment: The source code will be publicly released at https://github.com/qixi7up/M2-Occ
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: M²-Occ 在多相机语义占据预测中应对相机缺失：用 MMR 模块借邻近视角空间重叠在特征空间补出缺失视图，再用 FMM 可学习记忆库存储类级语义原型来校正模糊体素。在 nuScenes 基础的 SurroundOcc 缺失视角评测协议下，缺失后视时 IoU 提升 4.36%，缺失五个视角时提升 6.67%，且不损失全视角性能。
Motivation: 现有相机语义占据预测隐含假设环视输入完整，而实际部署中遮挡、硬件故障或通信中断常使部分视角缺失，几何结构与语义一致性随之退化。
Method: M²-Occ 含两个互补模块：Multi-view Masked Reconstruction (MMR) 利用相邻相机空间重叠在特征空间直接恢复缺失视图表征；Feature Memory Module (FMM) 用可学习记忆库存储类级语义原型，检索并融合全局先验以校正模糊体素特征。评测在 nuScenes 基础的 SurroundOcc 上建立系统缺失视角协议，覆盖确定性单视角失效与随机多视角 dropout。
Result: 在安全关键的缺失后视设置下 M²-Occ 将 IoU 提升 4.36%；缺失视角数增至五个时 IoU 提升 6.67%，且不牺牲全视角性能。
Conclusion: 在特征空间补视图并结合类级语义原型记忆，可在相机缺失时保持几何与语义一致，缺失视角越多优势越大，同时全视角性能不受损。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dissecting Quantization Error: A Concentration-Alignment Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Quantization can drastically increase the efficiency of large language and vision models, but typically incurs an accuracy drop. Recently, function-preserving transforms (e.g. rotations, Hadamard transform, channel-wise scaling) have been successfully applied to reduce post-training quantization error, yet a principled explanation remains elusive. We analyze linear-layer quantization via the signal-to-quantization-noise ratio (SQNR), showing that for uniform integer quantization at a fixed bit width, SQNR decomposes into (i) the concentration of weights and activations (capturing spread and outliers), and (ii) the alignment of their dominant variation directions. This reveals an actionable insight: beyond concentration - the focus of most prior transforms (e.g. rotations or Hadamard) - improving alignment between weight and activation can further reduce quantization error. Motivated by this, we introduce block Concentration-Alignment Transforms (CAT), a lightweight linear transformation that uses a covariance estimate from a small calibration set to jointly improve concentration and alignment, approximately maximizing SQNR. Experiments across several LLMs show that CAT consistently matches or outperforms prior transform-based quantization methods at 4-bit precision, confirming the insights gained in our framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把线性层量化误差用信号量化噪声比 (SQNR) 分解为权重与激活的集中度 (concentration) 以及主变化方向的对齐度 (alignment)，指出既有旋转、Hadamard 等函数保持变换只优化集中度。据此提出 block Concentration-Alignment Transforms (CAT)，用小校准集的协方差估计同时改善两者以近似最大化 SQNR；在多个 LLM 的 4-bit 精度上，CAT 稳定持平或优于既有基于变换的量化方法。
Motivation: 旋转、Hadamard、逐通道缩放等函数保持变换已能降低训练后量化 (post-training quantization) 误差，但其为何有效缺少原则性解释，且既有方法的注意力几乎全集中在集中度上，忽略了权重与激活主方向的对齐。
Method: 对均匀整数固定比特宽度下的线性层量化做 SQNR 分析，将其分解为权重/激活的集中度与主变化方向对齐度两项；再据此设计 block Concentration-Alignment Transforms (CAT)，用小校准集估计协方差，联合改善集中度与对齐度，近似最大化 SQNR。
Result: 在多个 LLM 上，CAT 在 4-bit 精度下稳定持平或优于此前基于变换的量化方法；分析给出的结论是固定比特宽度下 SQNR 由集中度与对齐度两项共同决定，而对齐度是既有变换未利用的自由度。
Conclusion: 量化误差可被拆成集中度与对齐度两个可操作的来源，超出集中度、进一步对齐权重与激活主方向能继续降低量化误差，CAT 据此在 4-bit 上达到或超过既有变换方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Hypertoroidal Covering for Perfect Color Equivariance
papers.abstract_en: When the color distribution of input images changes at inference, the performance of conventional neural network architectures drops considerably. A few researchers have begun to incorporate prior knowledge of color geometry in neural network design. These color equivariant architectures have modeled hue variation with 2D rotations, and saturation and luminance transformations as 1D translations. While this approach improves neural network robustness to color variations in a number of contexts, we find that approximating saturation and luminance (interval valued quantities) as 1D translations introduces appreciable artifacts. In this paper, we introduce a color equivariant architecture that is truly equivariant. Instead of approximating the interval with the real line, we lift values on the interval to values on the circle (a double-cover) and build equivariant representations there. Our approach resolves the approximation artifacts of previous methods, improves interpretability and generalizability, and achieves better predictive performance than conventional and equivariant baselines on tasks such as fine-grained classification and medical imaging tasks. Going beyond the context of color, we show that our proposed lifting can also extend to geometric transformations such as scale.
papers.comment: Accept to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把饱和度与明度这类区间量从实线平移近似改为圆上的 double-cover 提升，构建真正等变的颜色等变架构，消除既有方法把区间当实线处理产生的明显伪影，并在细粒度分类与医学影像任务上取得优于常规网络与既有等变基线的预测性能。
Motivation: 推理阶段输入颜色分布变化时常规网络性能大幅下降；既有颜色等变架构把色相当 2D 旋转、把饱和度与明度当 1D 平移，而区间量被近似成实线会引入明显伪影。
Method: 在区间上取值不直接近似为实线，而是提升到圆（double-cover）并在其上构建等变表示，从而得到真正等变的颜色等变架构；该提升方式进一步扩展到 scale 等几何变换。
Result: 在细粒度分类与医学影像任务上，预测性能优于常规网络与既有等变基线；同时消除既有 1D 平移近似带来的伪影，并提升可解释性与泛化性。
Conclusion: 区间值颜色量应按圆上的 double-cover 处理而非实线平移，这样才既真正等变又消除伪影；该提升思路可推广到 scale 等几何变换。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Same Pieces, Different Servers: A Tetris Benchmark for AI Agents as Served
papers.abstract_en: An agent meets a model as served: through an endpoint with a price card, a shared cache and other tenants, or on whatever hardware a self-hosted model runs. Benchmarks rank the weights. We introduce a Tetris benchmark that measures what agents get from models as served: every move is scored against an oracle, and every agent receives the same pieces. In five pre-specified experiments with nine open-weight models on one serverless provider, plus an open decision model self-hosted on a CPU, we find that price and size do not predict decision quality; that resending history costs almost nothing when cached input is free, would cost eleven to twelve times more if it were not, and makes play worse; that deployments keep between 4 and more than 64 agent contexts warm, in line with their throughput rather than the model's KV-cache size; that an agent's own long requests slow its slowest short decisions more than tenfold, which a simple admission rule cuts by 59% without hurting play; and that the decision model plays mid-pack but takes 27 s per move on a CPU, about 650 times longer than reported on a GPU. Architecture predicts some of what an agent sees; the deployment sets the rest.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Code, raw logs and animations: https://github.com/KevinChunye/Diffusion-Tetris
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Tetris 基准，衡量 AI agent 从「按服务状态交付的模型」（端点计价、共享缓存、异租户、自托管硬件）实际拿到的决策能力：每步对照 oracle 打分，所有 agent 收到相同方块序列。五组预设实验、九个开源权重模型加一个 CPU 自托管决策模型显示，价格与参数量不预测决策质量；缓存免费时重发历史几乎不花钱、若不免费则贵 11–12 倍且让对局变差；agent 自身长请求会把最慢短决策拖慢十倍以上，一条简单准入规则可削减 59% 且不损对局。
Motivation: 现有基准默认模型权重决定排名，但 agent 实际运行在带价目表、共享缓存、多租户与自托管硬件的服务端，同一权重在不同部署下行为不同，缺少衡量「as served」差异的评测手段。
Method: 以 Tetris 为载体构建基准：每步对照 oracle 打分，保证所有 agent 拿到相同方块序列；在单一 serverless provider 上跑五组预设实验，覆盖九个开源权重模型，并加入一个自托管在 CPU 上的开源决策模型，观测计价、缓存、上下文保活与请求准入等部署因素。
Result: 价格与模型大小不预测决策质量；缓存输入免费时重发历史成本几乎为零、若不免费则贵 11–12 倍，且重发会让对局变差；部署方保活 4 到 64 个以上 agent 上下文，与吞吐量而非模型 KV-cache 大小一致；agent 自身的长请求使其最慢的短决策变慢十倍以上，简单准入规则削减 59% 且不损害对局；决策模型在 CPU 上每步 27 秒，约为已报告 GPU 速度的 1/650，排名居中游。
Conclusion: 架构能解释 agent 所见差异的一部分，其余由部署决定；因此评测模型应按服务状态而非权重排名，且上下文准入与缓存计价是可直接优化的杠杆。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 价格与模型大小不预测决策质量；缓存输入免费时重发历史成本几乎为零、若不免费则贵 11–12 倍，且重发会让对局变差；部署方保活 4 到 64 个以上 agent 上下文，与吞吐量而非模型 KV-cache 大小一致；agent 自身的长请求使其最慢的短决策变慢十倍以上，简单准入规则削减 59% 且不损害对局；决策模型在 CPU 上每步 27 秒，约为已报告 GPU 速度的 1/650，排名居中游。
summary_sections.conclusion: 架构能解释 agent 所见差异的一部分，其余由部署决定；因此评测模型应按服务状态而非权重排名，且上下文准入与缓存计价是可直接优化的杠杆。

papers.title: EvoDesign: Agentic Editable Diagram Creation via Design Expertise Evolution
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity diagram creation requires the complex orchestration of semantic topology, visual styling, and spatial layout, posing a significant challenge for automated systems. Existing methods also suffer from a representation gap: pixel-based models often lack precise control, while code-based synthesis limits intuitive flexibility. To bridge this gap, we introduce EvoDiagram, an agentic framework that generates object-level editable diagrams via an intermediate canvas schema. EvoDiagram employs a coordinated multi-agent system to decouple semantic intent from rendering logic, resolving conflicts across heterogeneous design layers. Additionally, we propose a design knowledge evolution mechanism that distills execution traces into a hierarchical memory of domain guidelines, enabling agents to retrieve context-aware expertise adaptively. We further release CanvasBench, a benchmark consisting of both data and metrics for canvas-based diagramming. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EvoDiagram exhibits excellent performance and balance against baselines in generating editable, structurally consistent, and aesthetically coherent diagrams. Our code is available at https://github.com/AuraX-AI/EvoDiagram.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoDiagram 用中间 canvas schema 生成对象级可编辑图表，通过多智能体把语义意图与渲染逻辑解耦，并把执行轨迹蒸馏成分层设计知识记忆供检索。实验显示其在可编辑性、结构一致性与美观协调性上相对基线取得良好平衡，同时发布 CanvasBench 数据与指标。
Motivation: 高保真图表生成需同时编排语义拓扑、视觉样式与空间布局，而像素模型缺精确控制、代码合成缺直观灵活，二者之间存在表示鸿沟。
Method: 提出 agentic 框架 EvoDiagram：以中间 canvas schema 表示对象级可编辑图表，用协同多智能体解耦语义意图与渲染逻辑、调和异构设计层冲突；再提出设计知识演化机制，把执行轨迹蒸馏为分层的领域准则记忆，供智能体按上下文检索。
Result: 发布 CanvasBench 基准，含 canvas 图表生成的数据与指标；实验显示 EvoDiagram 在生成可编辑、结构一致、美观协调的图表上相对基线表现出良好的性能与平衡。
Conclusion: 用中间 schema 加多智能体解耦、并以演化式设计知识记忆补足上下文专长，是弥合像素与代码两种表示鸿沟的可行路径。

papers.title: Gaussian Surrogates for Poisson Imaging: Some Theoretical and Empirical Results
papers.abstract_en: In imaging inverse problems with Poisson-distributed measurements, it is common to use objectives derived from the Poisson likelihood. But performance is often evaluated by mean squared error (MSE), which raises a practical question: how much does a Poisson objective matter for MSE, even at low dose? We analyze the MSE of Poisson and Gaussian surrogate reconstruction objectives under Poisson noise. In a stylized diagonal model, we show that the unregularized Poisson maximum-likelihood estimator can incur large MSE at low dose, while Poisson MAP mitigates this instability through regularization. We then study two Gaussian surrogate objectives: a heteroscedastic quadratic objective motivated by the normal approximation of Poisson data, and a homoscedastic quadratic objective that yields a simple linear estimator. We show that both surrogates can achieve MSE comparable to Poisson MAP in the low-dose regime, despite departing from the Poisson likelihood. Numerical computed tomography experiments indicate that these conclusions extend beyond the stylized setting of our theoretical analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Poisson 计数成像中，低剂量下未正则化的 Poisson 极大似然估计 MSE 很大，而 Poisson MAP 靠正则化压住这种不稳定；两个高斯代理目标（异方差二次目标与同方差线性估计器）在低剂量 regime 能达到与 Poisson MAP 相当的 MSE，尽管它们已偏离 Poisson 似然。CT 数值实验表明该结论可超出理论分析的对角模型设定。
Motivation: 成像逆问题常用 Poisson 似然导出的目标，但性能却按 MSE 评估；在低剂量下 Poisson 目标对 MSE 到底有多大影响，缺少理论与实验的对照。
Method: 在 stylized 对角模型下分析 Poisson 极大似然、Poisson MAP 与两个高斯代理目标（由 Poisson 正态近似启发的异方差二次目标、导出线性估计器的同方差二次目标）的 MSE；再用 computed tomography 数值实验检验结论。
Result: 低剂量下未正则化 Poisson MLE 可产生很大 MSE，Poisson MAP 通过正则化缓解该不稳定；两个高斯代理在低剂量 regime 的 MSE 与 Poisson MAP 相当；CT 实验显示结论超出理论分析的 stylized 设定。
Conclusion: 即使偏离 Poisson 似然，合适的高斯代理目标在低剂量下也能匹配 Poisson MAP 的 MSE，因此 Poisson 目标对 MSE 的必要性在低剂量下并非绝对。

papers.title: When Is Enough Not Enough? Illusory Completion in Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: In agentic search, an LLM agent searches the web, reads the pages it finds, and decides what to look for next before returning an answer. But can we trust an answer simply because the agent returns it? Often not, and even a correct answer can be a lucky guess: on questions with several constraints, we find that agents conclude the task is complete while a constraint remains unverified in up to 48% of their correct answers. We call this illusory completion. To see how it arises, we introduce the Epistemic Ledger, which tracks at every turn what the retrieved pages establish about each constraint and what the agent claims. Across 13 agents, from 7B RL-trained models to frontier LLMs, training and scale raise accuracy but change the pattern of verification failures rather than eliminating them: constraints may be left unchecked, assumed without support, or retained despite refuting evidence. To measure what agents lose without tracking their constraints, we show them each constraint's state, approximated by LiveLedger, a lightweight 4B tracker. Agents then answer 4.4-16.1 points more questions correctly, suggesting that on their own, they may not track what they have verified and what remains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多约束网络检索问答中，LLM agent 常在仍有约束未验证时就宣布任务完成，作者称之为幻觉式完成 (illusory completion)：即使答案正确，也有最高 48% 的情况存在未核验约束。用 Epistemic Ledger 逐轮记录每条约束被检索页面证实的状态，再把状态经 4B 的 LiveLedger 近似后展示给 agent，正确率提升 4.4–16.1 分。
Motivation: agentic search 中正确答案可能只是碰对：agent 在多约束问题上过早判定完成，而现有评测只看最终答案对错，无法区分真正核验与侥幸命中。
Method: 提出 Epistemic Ledger，逐轮追踪检索页面对每条约束的证据状态与 agent 的表述；再用轻量 4B 模型 LiveLedger 近似该状态并展示给 agent，跨 13 个 agent（7B RL 训练模型到前沿 LLM）检验。
Result: 在正确答案中，最高 48% 仍存在未核验约束；13 个 agent 上训练与规模提升准确率但不消除三类验证失败（未检查、无支撑假设、面对反证仍保留）；展示约束状态后正确题数多答对 4.4–16.1 分。
Conclusion: 训练和扩大规模只改变验证失败的形态而非消除它，agent 自身并不追踪已验证与待验证的约束，因此需要显式的约束状态跟踪。

papers.title: MambaVF: State Space Model for Efficient Video Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Video fusion aims to integrate complementary information from multiple source videos while preserving temporal consistency. Effective modeling of temporal dynamics is essential to this goal, yet existing methods incur substantial computational overhead from optical flow estimation and feature warping. In this paper, we present MambaVF, an efficient video fusion framework that uses state space model (SSM) to achieve temporal modeling without explicit motion estimation. First, by formulating video fusion as a sequential state update process, MambaVF captures long-range temporal dependencies with linear complexity, significantly reducing computation and memory costs. Second, the lightweight SSM-based fusion module eliminates conventional flow-guided alignment. Instead, it introduces a mutual state fusion module and a spatio-temporal bidirectional scanning mechanism to enable information aggregation across video streams. Experiments on multiple benchmarks confirm that MambaVF reaches state-of-the-art performance in different video fusion applications (multi-exposure, multi-focus, infrared-visible, medical), while reducing parameters by >90% and FLOPs by >80%, resulting in >50% shorter runtime. Project page: https://mambavf.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MambaVF 把视频融合建模为序列状态更新过程，用 state space model (SSM) 在不做显式光流估计的情况下捕捉长程时间依赖，复杂度为线性。互易状态融合模块与时空双向扫描替代 flow-guided 对齐，在多曝光、多焦点、红外-可见光、医学等视频融合基准上达到 SOTA，同时参数量减少 >90%、FLOPs 减少 >80%、运行时间缩短 >50%。
Motivation: 现有视频融合方法依赖光流估计与特征 warping 来保持时间一致性，带来大量计算开销，限制了长序列上的效率。
Method: 将视频融合表述为顺序状态更新过程，用 SSM 以线性复杂度捕捉长程时间依赖；轻量 SSM 融合模块取消 flow-guided 对齐，改用 mutual state fusion module 与 spatio-temporal bidirectional scanning 在多路视频流间聚合信息。
Result: 在多曝光、多焦点、红外-可见光、医学等多类视频融合基准上达到 state-of-the-art；相比基线参数量减少 >90%，FLOPs 减少 >80%，运行时间缩短 >50%。
Conclusion: 不做显式运动估计、仅靠 SSM 的状态更新即可同时保住视频融合的时间一致性与 SOTA 质量，并大幅压缩参数、算力与运行时间。

papers.title: Routing-Aware Safety Alignment for Mixture-of-Experts Models
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models introduce unique challenges for safety alignment due to their sparse routing mechanisms, which can enable degenerate optimization behaviors under standard full-parameter fine-tuning. In our preliminary experiments, we observe that naively applying full-parameter safety fine-tuning to MoE models can reduce attack success rates through routing or expert dominance effects, rather than by directly repairing Safety-Critical Experts. To address this challenge, we propose RASA, a routing-aware expert-level alignment framework that explicitly repairs Safety-Critical Experts while preventing routing-based bypasses. RASA identifies experts disproportionately activated by successful jailbreaks, selectively fine-tunes only these experts under fixed routing, and subsequently enforces routing consistency with safety-aligned contexts. Across two representative MoE architectures and a diverse set of jailbreak attacks, RASA achieves near-perfect robustness, strong cross-attack generalization, and substantially reduced over-refusal, while preserving general capabilities on benchmarks such as MMLU, GSM8K, and TruthfulQA. Our results suggest that robust MoE safety alignment benefits from targeted expert repair rather than global parameter updates, offering a practical and architecture-preserving alternative to prior approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RASA 针对 MoE 语言模型稀疏路由带来的安全对齐退化，先定位被越狱攻击过度激活的 Safety-Critical Experts，再在固定路由下只微调这些专家并强制安全上下文下的路由一致性。在两种代表性 MoE 架构和多种越狱攻击上取得近乎完全的鲁棒性与跨攻击泛化，同时显著降低过度拒答并在 MMLU、GSM8K、TruthfulQA 上保持通用能力。
Motivation: MoE 的稀疏路由使标准全参数安全微调出现退化优化：攻击成功率的下降来自路由或专家主导效应，而非真正修复安全关键专家。
Method: RASA 是路由感知的专家级对齐框架：识别被成功越狱不成比例激活的专家，仅在固定路由下选择性微调这些专家，随后强制其在安全上下文中的路由一致性，避免基于路由的绕过。
Result: 在两种代表性 MoE 架构与多种越狱攻击上，RASA 实现近乎完全的鲁棒性和强跨攻击泛化，并大幅降低 over-refusal；在 MMLU、GSM8K、TruthfulQA 上保持通用能力。初步实验显示全参数安全微调降低攻击成功率是靠路由或专家主导效应而非修复 Safety-Critical Experts。
Conclusion: 鲁棒的 MoE 安全对齐应做定向专家修复而非全局参数更新，这是一种保留架构的实用替代方案。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: STILL: Selecting Tokens for Intra-Layer Hybrid Attention to Linearize LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Linearizing pretrained large language models (LLMs) primarily relies on intra-layer hybrid attention mechanisms to alleviate the quadratic complexity of standard softmax attention. Existing methods perform token routing based on sliding-window partitions, resulting in position-based selection and fails to capture token-specific global importance. Meanwhile, linear attention further suffers from distribution shift caused by learnable feature maps that distort pretrained feature magnitudes. Motivated by these limitations, we propose STILL, an intra-layer hybrid linearization framework for efficiently linearizing LLMs. STILL introduces a Self-Saliency Score with strong local-global consistency, enabling accurate token selection using sliding-window computation, and retains salient tokens for sparse softmax attention while summarizing the remaining context via linear attention. To preserve pretrained representations, we design a Norm-Preserved Feature Map (NP-Map) that decouples feature direction from magnitude and reinjects pretrained norms. We further adopt a unified training-inference architecture with chunk-wise parallelization and delayed selection to improve hardware efficiency. Experiments show that STILL matches or surpasses the original pretrained model on commonsense and general reasoning tasks, and achieves up to a 86.2% relative improvement over prior linearized attention methods on long-context benchmarks. Code is available at this URL.

papers.title: Divide-and-Conquer CoT: RL for Reducing Latency via Parallel Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Long chain-of-thought reasoning (Long CoT) is now fundamental to state-of-the-art LLMs, especially in mathematical reasoning. However, LLM generation is highly sequential, and long CoTs lead to a high latency. We propose to train Divide-and-Conquer CoT (DC-CoT) to reduce the latency. With DC-CoT, the model can act as a director that identifies distinct subtasks that can be performed in parallel in its reasoning process, and then spawns workers to execute the subtasks. Our goal is to achieve high accuracy, with a low longest path length, which is a theoretical measure of the latency needed for the response. We start with a long CoT base model (DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview), and first use SFT with a small curated demonstration set to initialize its ability to spawn workers in a certain format. Because SFT degrades the accuracy significantly, we design a multi-stage RL algorithm, with various data filtering strategies, to recover the accuracy while decreasing the longest path length. Across several benchmarks including AIME 2024 and HMMT 2025, DC-CoT achieves similar accuracy as DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview while decreasing longest path length by 35-40%. Our code, SFT dataset and models are publicly available at https://github.com/amahankali10/DC_CoT_RL_for_Low_Latency_CoT_with_Parallel_Reasoning.
papers.comment: 59 pages, 16 figures. v2: Added appendices on wall-clock latency, RL runs with fewer stages, and qualitative analysis of rollouts. Corrected the Olympiad Bench result for DSR-12K/Maj-DSR-3 (v1 omitted 5 out of 674 problems during evaluation)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Divide-and-Conquer CoT (DC-CoT)：让模型当 director 识别可并行的子任务并 spawn workers 执行，以缩短最长路径长度这一延迟的理论度量。从 DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview 出发，先用小规模精选示范做 SFT 初始化 spawn 格式，再用带数据过滤策略的多-stage RL 恢复精度。在 AIME 2024、HMMT 2025 等基准上精度与 DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview 相当，同时最长路径长度下降 35-40%。
Motivation: 长链思维 (Long CoT) 支撑了数学推理 SOTA，但 LLM 生成高度顺序化，长 CoT 带来高延迟；需要在不牺牲精度的前提下压缩响应的关键路径长度。
Method: 以长 CoT 基座模型 DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview 为起点：先用小规模精选示范集做 SFT，初始化按固定格式 spawn workers 的能力；因 SFT 显著拉低精度，再设计带多种数据过滤策略的多阶段 RL 算法，在降低最长路径长度的同时恢复精度。
Result: 在 AIME 2024 与 HMMT 2025 等多个基准上，DC-CoT 达到与 DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview 相当的精度，同时最长路径长度（latency 的理论度量）下降 35-40%。arXiv comment 记录 v2 修正了 Olympiad Bench 上 DSR-12K/Maj-DSR-3 的结果（v1 评测漏掉 674 题中的 5 题），并补充 wall-clock latency 附录。
Conclusion: 把长 CoT 拆成 director-worker 的并行结构并用多阶段 RL 训练，可以在数学推理基准上保住精度的同时把最长路径长度压低 35-40%，即用并行推理换低延迟。

papers.title: PlatoLTL: Scaling LTL-Guided Multi-Task RL
papers.abstract_en: Linear temporal logic (LTL) has emerged as a powerful formalism for specifying structured, temporally extended tasks in multi-task reinforcement learning (RL). However, while existing approaches in LTL-guided multi-task RL demonstrate success in simple environments, they suffer from challenges in representation learning and exploration efficiency when applied to high-dimensional environments with parameterized specifications. We present PlatoLTL, which elevates state-of-the-art methods to address both challenges. We model atomic propositions as instances of atomic predicates and inject task parameters directly into the goal embedding to enable efficient generalization. We also leverage simple priors on closeness to predicate satisfaction to enable and accelerate learning of complex tasks without biasing the optimal policy. We validate our approach on challenging environments including robotic manipulation and multi-drone navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PlatoLTL 把 LTL 引导的多任务强化学习中的原子命题建模为原子谓词的实例，并把任务参数直接注入 goal embedding，再用「接近谓词满足程度」的简单先验加速复杂任务学习且不偏置最优策略。在机器人操作与多无人机导航环境中验证了该方法对参数化规格的泛化与探索效率。
Motivation: 现有 LTL 引导多任务 RL 方法在简单环境中可行，但面对高维环境加参数化规格时，在表示学习与探索效率两方面都失效。
Method: 将原子命题表示为原子谓词实例，任务参数直接注入 goal embedding 以支持泛化；引入关于谓词满足接近度的简单先验来加速复杂任务学习，同时不引入对最优策略的偏置；在机器人操作与多无人机导航环境上验证。
Result: 在具有挑战性的机器人操作与多无人机导航环境中验证了该方法，用于处理高维环境下的参数化 LTL 规格。
Conclusion: 把参数注入 goal embedding 并配合不偏置最优策略的接近度先验，可让 LTL 引导的多任务 RL 扩展到高维、参数化规格场景。

papers.title: Learning-to-Defer in Non-Stationary Time Series via Switching State-Space Models
papers.abstract_en: Learning-to-defer (L2D) lets a predictor decide, at each round, whether to issue its own forecast or pay for an expert's. In non-stationary time series this decision must keep adapting, although deployment reveals only the consulted expert's forecast while a historical archive records every expert with the target. L2D-SLDS learns from this archive a switching state-space model of the target and all expert forecasts, whose shared and expert-specific states describe how experts move together and apart. Its predictive law supplies the internal forecast and the expected cost of every consultation, which a greedy router minimizes, and one consultation also updates the beliefs about unconsulted and unavailable experts. We prove sublinear regret against a changing conditional-risk oracle without exploration, when the candidate models are accurate and either the archive separates them or live feedback reveals cost differences. On three real datasets, L2D-SLDS has the lowest cost among eight bandit routers and adapts its consultation rate to the fee.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: L2D-SLDS 用切换状态空间模型 (switching state-space model) 同时建模目标与全部专家的历史预报，其预测分布既给出内部预报，也给出每次咨询的期望代价，再由贪心路由器决定自报还是付费咨询专家。在三个真实数据集上，其代价在八种 bandit 路由器中最低，并能随咨询费用调整咨询率；理论上在候选模型准确且档案可区分或在线反馈暴露代价差时，对变化的条件风险 oracle 达到次线性 regret，无需探索。
Motivation: 非平稳时间序列上的 learning-to-defer 需要持续调整是否咨询专家，但部署时只能看到被咨询专家的预报，历史档案才记录全部专家与目标，反馈缺失使路由决策难以学习。
Method: 从历史档案学习目标与所有专家预报的切换状态空间模型 (L2D-SLDS)，用共享态与专家特异态刻画专家之间的一致与分歧；其预测律同时给出内部预报与每次咨询的期望代价，贪心路由器据此最小化代价，且一次咨询同时更新对未咨询与不可用专家的信念。
Result: 在三个真实数据集上，L2D-SLDS 的代价在八种 bandit 路由器中最低，且咨询率随咨询费用自适应调整；理论上，在候选模型准确且档案能区分模型或在线反馈揭示代价差的条件下，对变化的条件风险 oracle 无需探索即达到次线性 regret。
Conclusion: 用一个显式建模全部专家的切换状态空间模型来补足缺失的专家反馈，就能在非平稳序列上把 defer 决策做到低代价且免探索的次线性 regret。

papers.title: SyncLight: Single-Edit Multi-View Relighting
papers.abstract_en: We present SyncLight, a method to enable consistent, parametric control over light sources across multiple uncalibrated views of a static scene conditioned on a single view. While single-view relighting has advanced significantly, existing generative approaches struggle to maintain the rigorous lighting consistency essential for multi-camera broadcasts, stereoscopic cinema, and virtual production. SyncLight addresses this by enabling precise control over light intensity and color across a multi-view capture of a scene, conditioned on a single reference edit. Our method leverages a multi-view diffusion transformer trained using a latent bridge matching formulation, achieving high-fidelity relighting of the entire image set in a single inference step. To facilitate training, we introduce a large-scale hybrid dataset comprising diverse synthetic environments -- curated from existing sources and newly designed scenes -- alongside high-fidelity, real-world multi-view captures under calibrated illumination. Though trained only on image pairs, SyncLight generalizes zero-shot to an arbitrary number of viewpoints, effectively propagating lighting changes across all views, without requiring camera pose information. SyncLight enables practical relighting workflows for multi-view capture systems.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Project page: https://color.cvc.uab.cat/synclight/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SyncLight 用单次编辑对多机位未标定静态场景做一致的参数化重打光：多视角 diffusion transformer 以 latent bridge matching 训练，一次推理即可同步整组图像的光强与颜色。仅用图像对训练即可零样本泛化到任意视角数并传播光照变化，无需相机位姿。
Motivation: 多机位广播、立体电影与虚拟制作要求跨视角光照严格一致，而现有单视角重打光的生成方法难以维持这种一致性。
Method: 多视角 diffusion transformer，采用 latent bridge matching 训练配方，以单个参考编辑为条件控制光强与颜色；训练数据为新构建的大规模混合数据集，含精选合成环境与标定光照下的真实多视角采集，训练只用图像对。
Result: 整组图像的高保真重打光在单次推理步骤内完成；仅以图像对训练，零样本泛化到任意数量视角并跨视图传播光照变化，不需要相机位姿信息。
Conclusion: 单参考编辑加多视角扩散模型足以在未标定多机位系统上给出可用的重打光工作流，且不依赖位姿估计。

papers.title: FlashMoE: Reducing SSD I/O Bottlenecks via ML-Based Cache Replacement for Mixture-of-Experts Inference on Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Recently, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have gained attention for efficiently scaling large language models. Although these models are extremely large, their sparse activation enables inference to be performed by accessing only a fraction of the model at a time. This property opens the possibility of on-device inference of MoE, which was previously considered infeasible for such large models. Consequently, various systems have been proposed to leverage this sparsity and enable efficient MoE inference for edge devices. However, previous MoE inference systems like Fiddler[8] or DAOP[13] rely on DRAM-based offloading and are not suitable for memory constrained on-device environments. As recent MoE models grow to hundreds of gigabytes, RAM-offloading solutions become impractical. To address this, we propose FlashMoE, a system that offloads inactive experts to SSD, enabling efficient MoE inference under limited RAM. FlashMoE incorporates a lightweight ML-based caching strategy that adaptively combines recency and frequency signals to maximize expert reuse, significantly reducing storage I/O. In addition, we built a user-grade desktop platform to demonstrate the practicality of FlashMoE. On this real hardware setup, FlashMoE improves cache hit rate by up to 51% over well-known offloading policies such as LRU and LFU, and achieves up to 2.6x speedup compared to existing MoE inference systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlashMoE 把 MoE 推理中未激活的专家权重放到 SSD 而非 DRAM，用轻量 ML 缓存策略自适应融合 recency 与 frequency 信号来提高专家复用、削减存储 I/O。在自建的消费级桌面实机平台上，相对 LRU、LFU 等经典替换策略缓存命中率最高提升 51%，相对已有 MoE 推理系统最高加速 2.6 倍。
Motivation: MoE 稀疏激活本可让大模型在端侧跑，但模型已涨到数百 GB，Fiddler、DAOP 这类依赖 DRAM offload 的系统在内存受限设备上不再可行，需要在有限 RAM 下仍能承载专家权重的存储方案。
Method: 将未激活专家 offload 到 SSD，配合轻量 ML 缓存替换策略，自适应结合 recency 与 frequency 信号最大化专家复用以减少 SSD I/O；并搭建消费级桌面 (user-grade desktop) 真实硬件平台做演示。
Result: 在真实硬件设置上，缓存命中率相对 LRU、LFU 等知名 offload 策略最高提升 51%，相对已有 MoE 推理系统最高获得 2.6 倍加速。
Conclusion: 在 RAM 受限的边缘设备上，把专家放 SSD 并用学习型缓存替换来预测专家复用，是比 DRAM offload 更可行的 MoE 推理路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Vulnerability of LLMs' Stated Beliefs? LLMs Belief Resistance Check Through Strategic Persuasive Conversation Interventions
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly employed in various question-answering tasks. However, recent studies showcase that LLMs are susceptible to persuasion and could adopt counterfactual beliefs. We present a systematic evaluation of LLM susceptibility to persuasion under the \emph{Source--Message--Channel--Receiver} (SMCR) communication framework. Across six mainstream Large Language Models (LLMs) and three domains (factual knowledge, medical QA, and social bias), we analyze how different persuasive strategies influence stated belief stability over multiple interaction turns. We further examine whether verbalized confidence prompting (i.e., eliciting self-reported confidence scores) affects resistance to persuasion. Results show that the smallest model (Llama 3.2-3B) exhibits extreme compliance, with 82.5\% of belief changes occurring at the first persuasive turn (average end turn of 1.1--1.4). Contrary to expectations, verbalized confidence prompting \emph{increases} vulnerability by accelerating belief erosion rather than enhancing robustness. Finally, an exploratory study of adversarial fine-tuning reveals highly model-dependent effectiveness: GPT-4o-mini achieves near-complete robustness (98.6\%), and Mistral~7B improves substantially (35.7\% $\rightarrow$ 79.3\%), but Llama models remain highly susceptible ($<$14\% RQ1) even when fine-tuned on their own failure cases. Together, these findings highlight substantial model-dependent limits of current robustness interventions and offer guidance for developing more trustworthy LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 SMCR 传播框架下系统评测 LLM 面对说服时的信念稳定性：最小模型 Llama 3.2-3B 极度顺从，82.5% 的信念改变发生在第一个说服轮（平均结束轮 1.1–1.4）；要求自报置信度反而加速信念侵蚀而非增强鲁棒。对抗性微调效果高度依赖模型，GPT-4o-mini 达到 98.6% 鲁棒，Mistral 7B 从 35.7% 升到 79.3%，而 Llama 系列即使在自身失败案例上微调仍低于 14%（RQ1）。
Motivation: LLM 在问答中易被说服并采纳反事实信念，而现有鲁棒性干预（如 verbalized confidence prompting）是否真的有效、是否跨模型成立，此前缺少跨策略、跨轮次的系统检验。
Method: 以 Source–Message–Channel–Receiver (SMCR) 传播框架组织多种说服策略，在 6 个主流 LLM、3 个领域（factual knowledge、medical QA、social bias）上跨多轮交互测量 stated belief 稳定性；另检验 verbalized confidence prompting（自报置信度）对抵抗说服的作用，并做一项探索性对抗微调研究。
Result: Llama 3.2-3B 有 82.5% 的信念改变发生在第一个说服轮，平均结束轮 1.1–1.4；verbalized confidence prompting 反而提高脆弱性、加速信念侵蚀；对抗微调后 GPT-4o-mini 接近完全鲁棒 98.6%，Mistral 7B 由 35.7% 提升至 79.3%，Llama 系列即使在自身失败案例上微调 RQ1 仍低于 14%。
Conclusion: 当前鲁棒性干预的效果存在显著的模型依赖上限：置信度提示会帮倒忙，对抗微调只在部分模型上奏效，对 Llama 类小模型基本无效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Amortized Acquisition Optimization for Bayesian Optimization with Variational Mutual Information
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization (BO) of expensive black-box functions is traditionally addressed with Gaussian processes (GPs), which scale cubically with observations, or Bayesian neural networks (BNNs), which incur costly posterior sampling and inner-loop acquisition optimization. We propose VBO-MI (Variational Bayesian Optimization with Mutual Information), a fully gradient-based BO framework that requires no explicit GP prior or fixed parametric posterior family over objective function and treats it as a strict black box. An actor-critic architecture pairs an action-net with a variational critic that estimates information gain, eliminating the acquisition optimization bottleneck and achieving up to $10^{2}\times$ fewer FLOPs than BNN-BO baselines. A lightweight surrogate network further reduces real function queries to one batch per iteration. We establish consistency guarantees and evaluate VBO-MI on synthetic benchmarks (Ackley, Levy, Griewank) and real-world tasks (Rover Trajectory, Lunar Lander, Pest Control), demonstrating competitive or superior performance over the baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning., Seoul, South Korea, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 VBO-MI：用 actor-critic 架构把采集函数 (acquisition) 优化内化为梯度推断，critic 直接估计信息增益，从而免掉 BO 中昂贵的内环采集优化。相比 BNN-BO 基线最高省 10^2 倍 FLOPs，且每轮迭代只需一次真实函数查询的批量。
Motivation: 昂贵黑箱函数的贝叶斯优化中，GP 随观测量三次方增长，BNN 则要付后验采样与内环采集优化的代价，采集优化本身成为瓶颈。
Method: VBO-MI 不设显式 GP 先验、也不固定目标函数的参数化后验族，把目标当严格黑箱；actor-critic 中 action-net 输出动作，variational critic 估计信息增益以替代采集优化，另加轻量 surrogate 网络减少真实查询。文中给出一致性保证 (consistency guarantees)。
Result: 在合成基准 Ackley、Levy、Griewank 与真实任务 Rover Trajectory、Lunar Lander、Pest Control 上，相对 BNN-BO 基线最高减少 10^2 倍 FLOPs，每轮迭代真实函数查询降至一个批量，性能相对基线具竞争力或更优。
Conclusion: 把采集优化换成变分信息增益的梯度推断，可以在不设 GP 先验的前提下同时压低 BO 的计算与查询成本，并保持有竞争力的优化性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Symphonym: Universal Phonetic Embeddings for Cross-Script Toponym Matching
papers.abstract_en: Matching place names across writing systems is a persistent obstacle to integrating multilingual geographic sources, from modern gazetteers to medieval itineraries and colonial-era surveys. Existing approaches rely on language-specific phonetic algorithms or on romanisation that discards phonetic information, and none generalises across scripts. Symphonym maps toponyms from thirty-six writing systems into a unified 128-dimensional phonetic space, enabling direct cross-script comparison without language identification or phonetic resources at inference time. A Teacher-Student distillation architecture learns from articulatory features of IPA transcriptions and transfers this knowledge to a character-level Student. Trained on 73.5 million toponyms from GeoNames, Wikidata and the Getty TGN, the Student achieves the highest Recall@1 (89.3%) and MRR (92.8%) on the MEHDIE benchmark of medieval Hebrew and Arabic toponym matches, which is independent of the training data. An ablation on raw articulatory features alone reaches only 45.0% MRR. This revision reports a second model generation and three results that qualify the first: a corpus defect caused the original system to learn Chinese characters with Japanese readings, which we correct and quantify; the encoder weighted character content far above order, admitting 70.5% of random anagrams past the retrieval gate, which targeted negatives reduce to 5.0% without loss of typo tolerance; and better retrieval came with slightly worse separation of true from false matches. We report where the method wins decisively (across scripts) and where string metrics remain preferable (within the Latin script), and document an independent out-of-domain deployment on archival personal names.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. v5: revised for the second model generation (Symphonym v8); corrects the CJK-Hiragana explanation given in v1-v4. Models and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22767194
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Symphonym 用 Teacher-Student 蒸馏把 36 种书写系统的地名映射到统一的 128 维语音空间，推理时无需语言识别或音标资源即可跨文字直接比对。在独立于训练数据的 MEHDIE 中世纪希伯来/阿拉伯地名匹配基准上取得 Recall@1 89.3%、MRR 92.8%；修订版同时量化了三处限定：中文字符被学成日语读法的语料缺陷、70.5% 随机变位词能通过检索门（定向负样本降到 5.0%），以及检索提升伴随真伪匹配分离度略降。
Motivation: 跨文字系统的地名匹配是整合多语地理数据源的长期障碍：现有方法依赖语言专用音标算法或丢失语音信息的罗马化，都无法跨书写系统泛化。
Method: Teacher-Student 蒸馏架构：Teacher 从 IPA 转写的发音特征 (articulatory features) 学习，知识转移到字符级 Student；在 GeoNames、Wikidata、Getty TGN 共 7350 万个地名上训练，输出 128 维统一语音嵌入，覆盖 36 种书写系统。
Result: MEHDIE（独立于训练数据）上 Recall@1 89.3%、MRR 92.8%，为该基准最高；仅用原始发音特征的消融只有 45.0% MRR。修订版量化：语料缺陷使原系统用日语读法学中文字符（已修正）；编码器重字符内容远超字序，70.5% 随机变位词通过检索门，定向负样本将其降到 5.0% 且不损失错字容忍；检索变好但真伪匹配分离度略差。
Conclusion: 方法在跨文字地名匹配上决定性取胜，而在 Latin 文字内部字符串度量仍更优；作者据此报告适用边界，并给出档案人名的独立跨域部署。

papers.title: Zoom-IQA: Image Quality Assessment with Reliable Region-Aware Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Image Quality Assessment (IQA) is a long-standing problem in computer vision. Previous methods typically focus on predicting numerical scores without explanation or providing low-level descriptions lacking precise scores. Recent reasoning-based vision language models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for IQA by jointly generating quality descriptions and scores. However, existing VLM-based IQA methods often suffer from unreliable reasoning due to their limited capability of integrating visual and textual cues. In this work, we introduce Zoom-IQA, a VLM-based IQA model to explicitly emulate key cognitive behaviors: uncertainty awareness, region reasoning, and iterative refinement. Specifically, we present a two-stage training pipeline: 1) supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on our Grounded-Rationale-IQA (GR-IQA) dataset to teach the model to ground its assessments in key regions, and 2) reinforcement learning (RL) for dynamic policy exploration, stabilized by our KL-Coverage regularizer to prevent reasoning and scoring diversity collapse, with a Progressive Re-sampling Strategy for mitigating annotation bias. Extensive experiments show that Zoom-IQA achieves improved robustness, explainability, and generalization. The application to downstream tasks, such as image restoration, further demonstrates the effectiveness of Zoom-IQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Zoom-IQA 用两阶段训练让视觉语言模型在图像质量评估中显式模拟不确定性感知、区域推理与迭代精化：先在 Grounded-Rationale-IQA (GR-IQA) 上做 SFT 使评估落到关键区域，再用带 KL-Coverage 正则与 Progressive Re-sampling Strategy 的 RL 做动态策略探索。实验显示其鲁棒性、可解释性与泛化性提升，并可迁移到图像修复等下游任务。
Motivation: 现有 IQA 方法要么只出分数不给解释，要么给低层描述却缺精确分数；基于 VLM 的推理式 IQA 因视觉与文本线索整合能力有限，推理常不可靠。
Method: 两阶段训练：1) 在自建 Grounded-Rationale-IQA (GR-IQA) 数据集上做监督微调 (SFT)，教模型把评估落到关键区域；2) 强化学习 (RL) 做动态策略探索，用 KL-Coverage 正则器抑制推理与打分的多样性坍缩，并以 Progressive Re-sampling Strategy 缓解标注偏差。
Result: 实验显示 Zoom-IQA 在鲁棒性、可解释性与泛化性上均有提升；在图像修复 (image restoration) 等下游任务上的应用进一步体现其有效性。
Conclusion: 把不确定性感知、区域推理与迭代精化显式建模并配合防多样性坍缩的 RL，能让 VLM 的 IQA 推理更可靠，且分数与解释可迁移到下游图像任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Flo: A data-driven limited-area storm surge model
papers.abstract_en: We present Flo, a data-driven storm surge model, covering the North Sea, Norwegian Sea and Barents Sea. The model is built using the Anemoi framework for creating machine learning weather forecasting systems, developed by the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts and partners. The model is based on a graph neural network, and is capable of simulating water level due to atmospheric effects (wind stress and inverse barometer effect, i.e. the non-tidally induced part of the total water level; the residual water level) at a horizontal resolution of 4 km and a temporal resolution of 1 hour with a quality comparable to the numerical model on which it was trained. The model was trained using a dataset consisting of 43 years of atmospheric data from the 3-km Norwegian Reanalysis hindcast for mean sea level pressure and winds, and the NORA-Surge hindcast for water level. Evaluation was done by comparing results from hindcast runs of the Flo model against independent observations of more than 90 water level gauges along the European coast, and against the NORA-Surge hindcast. The evaluation shows that Flo produces hindcasts with accuracy similar to the NORA-Surge hindcast, and it is shown that the model can resolve key physical processes. As the NORA-Surge hindcast used for training does not include data assimilation, Flo is not expected to systematically outperform the numerical model when evaluated against observations. Nevertheless, the present work represents an important step towards complementing traditional physics-based storm surge modelling with machine learning approaches and the framework establishes a strong foundation for future developments, particularly for training storm surge models that offer more flexibility for incorporating observations and other additional data sources.

TL;DR: Flo 是基于 Anemoi 框架与图神经网络的数据驱动风暴潮模型，覆盖北海、挪威海和巴伦支海，以 4 km 水平分辨率和 1 小时时间分辨率模拟非潮汐残差水位（风应力与逆气压效应）。在 90 多个欧洲沿岸水位站的独立观测检验中，其准确度与训练所用的 NORA-Surge 数值模式相当，并能分辨关键物理过程；由于训练目标 NORA-Surge 本身不含资料同化 (data assimilation)，Flo 不被期待系统性优于该数值模式。
Motivation: 传统物理风暴潮模式计算成本高、灵活性受限，而现有 ML 天气框架尚未被改造成能同化观测、可扩展数据源的风暴潮模拟工具。
Method: 基于 ECMWF 及合作方的 Anemoi 框架构建图神经网络 (GNN) 模型 Flo；训练数据为 43 年 3-km Norwegian Reanalysis hindcast 的平均海平面气压与风场，以及 NORA-Surge hindcast 的水位，目标是模拟大气驱动的残差水位。
Result: Flo 在 4 km / 1 小时分辨率下给出与训练所用数值模式相当的质量；用超过 90 个欧洲沿岸水位站的独立观测及 NORA-Surge hindcast 对比检验，准确度与 NORA-Surge hindcast 相似，并能分辨关键物理过程。
Conclusion: 数据驱动模型可作为物理风暴潮模式的补充，且该框架为未来纳入观测与其他数据源、训练更灵活的风暴潮模型奠定基础；作者明确指出因训练数据无资料同化，Flo 不会系统性超越数值模式。

papers.title: Critical Points of Degenerate Metrics on Algebraic Varieties: A Tale of Overparametrization
papers.abstract_en: We study the critical points over an algebraic variety of an optimization problem defined by a quadratic objective that is degenerate. This scenario arises in machine learning when the dataset size is small with respect to the model, and is typically referred to as overparametrization. Our main result relates the degenerate optimization problem to a nondegenerate one via a projection. In the highly-degenerate regime, we find that a central role is played by the ramification locus of the projection. Additionally, we provide tools for counting the number of critical points over projective varieties, and discuss specific cases arising from deep learning. Our work bridges tools from algebraic geometry with ideas from machine learning, and it extends the line of literature around the Euclidean distance degree to the degenerate setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在代数簇上研究退化二次目标的临界点，通过一个投影把退化问题化归为非退化问题；在高度退化体制下，投影的分歧轨迹 (ramification locus) 决定临界点结构，并给出射影簇上临界点计数工具，讨论了深度学习中的具体情形。
Motivation: 数据集相对模型过小 (overparametrization) 时二次目标退化，经典非退化临界点理论与 Euclidean distance degree 的工具不再直接适用，需要把代数几何方法扩展到退化设定。
Method: 用一个投影将退化优化问题与非退化问题建立对应，分析该投影的分歧轨迹在高度退化体制下的作用；提供在射影簇上计数临界点的工具，并讨论深度学习中出现的特例，把 Euclidean distance degree 的文献线推广到退化情形。
Result: 主要结果是把退化优化问题经投影化归为非退化问题；在高度退化体制下分歧轨迹起核心作用；给出射影簇上临界点计数工具并讨论深度学习特例。
Conclusion: 代数几何工具（投影、分歧轨迹、Euclidean distance degree 的退化推广）可用于刻画过参数化下退化二次目标的临界点结构，从而连接代数几何与机器学习。

papers.title: Revisiting the Broken Symmetry Phase of Solid Hydrogen: A Neural Network Variational Monte Carlo Study
papers.abstract_en: The crystal structure of high-pressure solid hydrogen remains a fundamental open problem. Although the research frontier has mostly shifted toward ultra-high pressure phases above 400 GPa, we show that even the broken symmetry phase observed around 130~GPa requires revisiting due to its intricate coupling of electronic and nuclear degrees of freedom. Here, we develop a first principle quantum Monte Carlo framework based on a deep neural network wave function that treats both electrons and nuclei quantum mechanically within the constant pressure ensemble. Our calculations reveal an unreported ground-state structure candidate for the broken symmetry phase with $Cmcm$ space group symmetry, and we test its stability up to 96 atoms. The predicted structure quantitatively matches the experimental equation of state and gives the closest x-ray diffraction peak-position match among the tested candidates. Furthermore, our group-theoretical analysis provides a symmetry-counting compatibility check between the $Cmcm$ structure and existing Raman and infrared spectroscopic data. Crucially, static density functional theory calculation reveals the $Cmcm$ structure as a dynamically unstable saddle point on the Born-Oppenheimer potential energy surface, demonstrating that a full quantum many-body treatment of the problem is necessary. These results shed new light on the phase diagram of high-pressure hydrogen and call for further experimental verifications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用深度神经网络波函数的量子蒙特卡洛框架在恒压系综下同时量子处理电子与核，得到高压固氢约 130 GPa 破缺对称相的新候选基态结构 Cmcm，最多检验 96 原子稳定性。其状态方程与实验定量吻合、X 射线衍射峰位匹配在受测候选中最接近，且群论计数与 Raman/红外数据相容；但静态 DFT 显示 Cmcm 是 Born-Oppenheimer 势能面上的动力学不稳定鞍点，说明必须做全量子多体处理。
Motivation: 高压固氢晶体结构仍是未解问题，研究前沿多转向 400 GPa 以上超高压相，而约 130 GPa 的破缺对称相因电子与核自由度强耦合被忽视，需要重新审视。
Method: 构建基于深度神经网络波函数的第一性原理量子蒙特卡洛 (quantum Monte Carlo) 框架，在恒压系综 (constant pressure ensemble) 中同时量子处理电子与原子核；辅以群论对称性计数核对 Raman 与红外谱数据，并用静态密度 functional theory 计算检验动力学稳定性。
Result: 给出此前未报道的 Cmcm 空间群基态结构候选，稳定性检验达 96 原子；预测的状态方程与实验定量吻合，在受测候选中 X 射线衍射峰位匹配最接近；静态 DFT 显示 Cmcm 在 Born-Oppenheimer 势能面上是动力学不稳定鞍点。
Conclusion: 约 130 GPa 破缺对称相的结构归属必须包含核的量子效应，静态 DFT 给出的不稳定鞍点在全量子多体处理下仍可对应实验观测到的相，该相图结论需实验进一步验证。

papers.title: OccStress: Stress-Testing the 4D Occupancy Forecasting Chain
papers.abstract_en: Occupancy world models use historical occupancy states to forecast future 3D scenes, but their robustness under corrupted temporal inputs remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations primarily emphasize clean forecasting accuracy and provide limited evidence about how errors enter, persist, and propagate through the occupancy perception-forecasting chain. This paper introduces OccStress, a robustness stress-testing benchmark for the occupancy forecasting chain. OccStress contains 21 corruption families with 61 severity configurations and 10,827 strict temporal anchors across 3 datasets. OccStress covers both 3D occupancy perception and 4D occupancy forecasting through two complementary tracks. This design separates model-mediated pipeline errors under standardized sensor stressors from the intrinsic sensitivity of 4D forecasting models to corrupted occupancy states. OccStress further defines temporal injection protocols to test whether errors in the current state, recent history, or earlier history affect future forecasts differently. OccStress provides aggregate metrics for evaluating robustness along the occupancy forecasting chain. Experiments with five 4D forecasters reveal that current occupancy models are substantially affected by both upstream prediction errors and direct state corruptions, and that clean performance alone is an insufficient description of source- and position-specific robustness. Code, data, and evaluation tools are available at https://insailab.org/OccStress.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OccStress 是面向 4D 占据预报链的鲁棒性压力测试基准：21 类 corruption、61 个严重度配置、跨 3 个数据集共 10,827 个严格时间锚点，分 3D 占据感知与 4D 占据预报两条 track，并定义当前状态、近期历史、更早历史三种时间注入协议。对 5 个 4D forecaster 的实验显示，现有占据模型同时受上游预测误差与直接状态污染的显著影响，仅凭干净精度不足以描述按来源与位置区分的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 占据世界模型的评测几乎只看干净输入下的预报精度，缺少对误差如何进入、持续并在感知-预报链中传播的证据，受损时间输入下的鲁棒性基本未知。
Method: 构建 OccStress 基准：21 个 corruption family、61 个 severity 配置、3 个数据集上的 10,827 个严格时间锚点，覆盖 3D 占据感知与 4D 占据预报两条互补 track，把标准化传感器应力下的模型链路误差与 4D 模型对污染占据状态的内在敏感性分开；另定义时间注入协议，分别污染当前状态、近期历史与更早历史，并给出沿预报链的聚合指标。
Result: 在 5 个 4D forecaster 上的实验显示，当前占据模型受上游预测误差与直接状态污染双重显著影响；干净性能不足以刻画按误差来源与注入位置区分的鲁棒性。基准规模为 21 corruption families、61 severity configurations、10,827 temporal anchors、3 datasets。
Conclusion: 占据模型的干净精度不能代表其在链路各环节、各注入位置下的真实鲁棒性，评测必须把感知与预报分开、并按误差来源与时间位置报告。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Transform Trained Transformer for Accelerating Native 4K Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Native 4K (2176$\times$3840) video generation remains a critical challenge due to the quadratic computational explosion of full-attention as spatiotemporal resolution increases, making it difficult for models to strike a balance between efficiency and quality. This paper proposes a novel Transformer retrofit strategy termed T3 ($\textbf{T}$ransform $\textbf{T}$rained $\textbf{T}$ransformer) that, without altering the core architecture of full-attention pretrained models, significantly reduces compute requirements by optimizing their forward logic. Specifically, $\textbf{T3-Video}$ introduces a multi-scale weight-sharing window attention mechanism and, via hierarchical blocking together with an axis-preserving full-attention design, can effect an "attention pattern" transformation of a pretrained model using only modest compute and data. Results on $\textbf{4K-VBench}$ show that $\textbf{T3-Video}$ substantially outperforms existing approaches: while delivering performance improvements (+4.29$\uparrow$ VQA and +0.08$\uparrow$ VTC), it accelerates native 4K video generation by more than 10$\times$. Project page at https://zhangzjn.github.io/projects/T3-Video
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: T3-Video 用多尺度权值共享窗口注意力、层级分块与保轴全注意力，在不改预训练 full-attention 模型核心架构的前提下改写其前向逻辑，把原生 4K (2176×3840) 视频生成加速 10 倍以上，同时 VQA 提升 4.29、VTC 提升 0.08。
Motivation: 原生 4K 视频生成随时空分辨率上升出现全注意力的二次计算爆炸，现有模型难以兼顾效率与质量。
Method: 提出 Transformer 改造策略 T3：不改预训练 full-attention 模型架构，通过多尺度权值共享窗口注意力、层级分块 (hierarchical blocking) 与保轴全注意力 (axis-preserving full-attention) 改变注意力模式，仅需中等算力与数据。
Result: 在 4K-VBench 上，T3-Video 相比现有方法 VQA +4.29、VTC +0.08，原生 4K 视频生成加速超过 10×。
Conclusion: 改写预训练模型的前向注意力逻辑即可在原生 4K 分辨率上同时提升质量指标并大幅降低计算量，无需重训核心架构。
