papers.title: Ordinary Least Squares as an Attention Mechanism
papers.abstract_en: I show that ordinary least squares (OLS) predictions can be rewritten as the output of a restricted attention module, akin to those forming the backbone of large language models. The connection comes from viewing OLS as a similarity-based prediction rule in a learned embedding space. In this representation, least squares does not estimate coefficients per se. Instead, it selects an embedding that minimizes squared prediction error by matching training and test vectors through inner products. This maps directly onto the query-key-value structure of attention mechanisms. I then discuss extensions to dimensionality reduction, nonlinearity, and time series econometrics. Monte Carlo simulations and real-data experiments on UCI/OpenML benchmarks show that nonlinear Attention Regression performs competitively against standard machine learning baselines. In the reverse direction, I replace the attention sublayer of a transformer for tabular data with an explicit regression on polynomial features. The resulting model performs comparably to the standard transformer at a fraction of its parameter count.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 29 pages including appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明 OLS 预测可改写为受限注意力模块的输出：把最小二乘看作学习嵌入空间中的相似度预测规则，通过内积匹配训练与测试向量来最小化平方误差，直接对应 query-key-value 结构。反向地，用多项式特征的显式回归替换表格数据 Transformer 的注意力子层，性能与标准 Transformer 相当而参数量只占一小部分。
Motivation: OLS 与 attention 之间的联系此前缺少精确的结构性对应，导致线性回归的经典统计性质与 LLM 注意力机制的表达能力被割裂看待。
Method: 将 OLS 重写为嵌入空间中的相似度预测：不估计系数，而是通过训练/测试向量的内积匹配选出最小化平方预测误差的嵌入，映射到 query-key-value 结构；再扩展到降维、非线性（Attention Regression）与时间序列计量经济学，并反向用多项式特征回归替换 Transformer 的注意力子层。
Result: Monte Carlo 模拟与 UCI/OpenML 真实数据实验显示，非线性 Attention Regression 相对标准机器学习基线具有竞争力；替换注意力子层后的模型在参数量仅为标准 Transformer 一小部分的情况下表现相当。
Conclusion: OLS 本质上是一种受限注意力机制，这一双向对应使线性回归与 Transformer 注意力可以在同一框架下互相替换与借鉴。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: 1000 Layer Networks for Self-Supervised RL: Scaling Depth Can Enable New Goal-Reaching Capabilities
papers.abstract_en: Scaling up self-supervised learning has driven breakthroughs in language and vision, yet comparable progress has remained elusive in reinforcement learning (RL). In this paper, we study building blocks for self-supervised RL that unlock substantial improvements in scalability, with network depth serving as a critical factor. Whereas most RL papers in recent years have relied on shallow architectures (around 2 - 5 layers), we demonstrate that increasing the depth up to 1024 layers can significantly boost performance. Our experiments are conducted in an unsupervised goal-conditioned setting, where no demonstrations or rewards are provided, so an agent must explore (from scratch) and learn how to maximize the likelihood of reaching commanded goals. Evaluated on simulated locomotion and manipulation tasks, our approach increases performance on the self-supervised contrastive RL algorithm by $2\times$ - $50\times$, outperforming other goal-conditioned baselines. Increasing the model depth not only increases success rates but also qualitatively changes the behaviors learned. The project webpage and code can be found here: https://wang-kevin3290.github.io/scaling-crl/.
papers.comment: Published at NeurIPS 2025, Best Paper Award. Link to project website: https://wang-kevin3290.github.io/scaling-crl/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在无奖励、无演示的自监督目标条件 RL 中，把网络深度从近年常用的 2–5 层推到 1024 层，可使对比 RL (contrastive RL) 算法性能提升 2×–50×，并超越其他目标条件基线；深度不仅抬高成功率，还定性改变了智能体学到的行为。
Motivation: 语言与视觉领域靠规模化自监督取得突破，但 RL 中的可比进展迟迟未出现；近年 RL 工作普遍依赖 2–5 层的浅层架构，深度这一构建块被忽视。
Method: 在无演示、无奖励的无监督目标条件设定下，智能体须从零探索并学习最大化到达指令目标的似然；将网络深度扩展至 1024 层，作用于自监督对比 RL 算法，并在模拟 locomotion 与 manipulation 任务上检验。
Result: 对比 RL 算法性能提升 2×–50×，在目标条件设定下优于其他 goal-conditioned 基线；深度增至 1024 层（对比近年常用的 2–5 层）不仅提高成功率，还定性改变学到的行为。
Conclusion: 网络深度是自监督 RL 的关键可扩展构建块：加深能同时带来成功率提升与行为层面的质变，而不只是渐进式增益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PerCoV2: Ultra-Low Bit-Rate Perceptual Image Compression via Query-Based 1D Multimodal Image Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent progress in learned image compression, current image codecs still struggle to maintain realistic reconstructions at low bit-rates, often producing structured artifacts such as grid patterns or repetitive textures, even when trained with perceptual or adversarial losses. We introduce PerCoV2, an ultra-low bit-rate perceptual image compression system that unifies semantic tokenization, flow-based generation, and learned entropy modeling within a single framework. Building on the fully open flow-based SANA architecture, PerCoV2 introduces a novel resolution-adaptive 1D query-based tokenizer that produces compact semantic image tokens with a dual role in flow matching: providing a data-dependent reconstruction prior for initialization and a conditioning signal for flow-based refinement. By explicitly decoupling semantic representation from perceptual generation, our dual representation simplifies the flow-based learning objective, leading to more stable optimization and improved perceptual compression performance. PerCoV2 further introduces a dedicated 1D masked entropy model to improve rate efficiency and optional decoder-side multimodal enhancement via a vision-language model (Molmo) without increasing the transmitted bit budget. On MSCOCO-30k, PerCoV2 achieves state-of-the-art statistical fidelity, measured by FID and KID, across ultra-low and extreme bit-rates (0.0015-0.025 bpp). When trained solely on the general-purpose SA-1B dataset, PerCoV2 further demonstrates strong zero-shot generalization to widely adopted high-resolution benchmarks, including DIV2K and CLIC 2020, achieving competitive statistical fidelity with the current leading method, AEIC-ME. Finally, we introduce PerCoV2-distilled, a practical single-step variant derived from multi-step flow matching that accelerates decoding by 5.37x over PerCoV1, while preserving perceptual compression performance.
papers.comment: Major revision of the previous version. The initial draft corresponds to the PerCoV1++ variant described in Section 4 and illustrated in Figure 3. Code and pre-trained models will be released upon publication at https://github.com/nikolai10/PerCoV2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PerCoV2 把语义 token 化、flow matching 生成与学习型熵建模统一在一个超低码率图像压缩框架里：1D query-based tokenizer 产出的语义 token 同时充当 flow matching 的重建先验与条件信号，再用 1D masked entropy model 提升码率效率。在 MSCOCO-30k 的 0.0015–0.025 bpp 区间取得 FID/KID 上的 SOTA 统计保真度，单步蒸馏版解码比 PerCoV1 加速 5.37 倍。
Motivation: 学习型图像编码在超低码率下仍会产生网格状、重复纹理等结构性伪影，即使使用感知或对抗损失也难以重建真实感图像。
Method: 基于开源 flow-based SANA 架构，提出分辨率自适应的 1D query-based tokenizer，产出紧凑语义 token，在 flow matching 中既作数据依赖的重建先验初始化、又作条件信号；语义表示与感知生成显式解耦，配 1D masked entropy model 提升码率效率，并支持解码端用 vision-language model (Molmo) 做不增加码率的多模态增强；另有从多步 flow matching 蒸馏出的单步变体 PerCoV2-distilled。
Result: 在 MSCOCO-30k 上，0.0015–0.025 bpp 的超低与极端码率区间 FID/KID 统计保真度达到 SOTA；仅用 SA-1B 训练时对 DIV2K、CLIC 2020 等高分辨率基准零样本泛化，统计保真度与当前领先方法 AEIC-ME 竞争；PerCoV2-distilled 解码比 PerCoV1 加速 5.37 倍且保持感知压缩性能。
Conclusion: 把语义 token 的先验与条件双重角色和感知生成解耦，可以在超低码率下同时换来更稳的优化、更好的统计保真度与可蒸馏的单步解码。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Linear Bandits beyond Inner Product Spaces, the case of Bandit Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Linear bandits have long been a central topic in online learning, with applications ranging from recommendation systems to adaptive clinical trials. Their general learnability has been established when the objective is to minimise the inner product between a cost parameter and the decision variable. While this is highly general, this reliance on an inner product structure belies the name of \emph{linear} bandits, and fails to account for problems such as Optimal Transport. Using the Kantorovich formulation of Optimal Transport as an example, we show that an inner product structure is \emph{not} necessary to achieve efficient learning in linear bandits. We propose a refinement of the classical OFUL algorithm that operates by embedding the action set into a Hilbertian subspace, where confidence sets can be built via least-squares estimation. Actions are then constrained to this subspace by penalising optimism. The analysis is completed by leveraging convergence results from penalised (entropic) transport to the Kantorovich problem. Up to this approximation term, the resulting algorithm achieves the same trajectorial regret upper bounds as the OFUL algorithm, which we turn into worst-case regret using functional regression techniques. Its regret interpolates between $\tilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{T})$ and ${\mathcal O}(T)$, depending on the regularity of the cost function, and recovers the parametric rate $\tilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{dT})$ in finite-dimensional settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 线性 bandit 的可学习性不依赖内积结构：以 Kantorovich 形式的 Optimal Transport 为例，把动作集嵌入 Hilbert 子空间、用惩罚乐观 (penalised optimism) 把动作约束到该子空间，即可沿用 OFUL 式置信集与轨迹后悔界。所得后悔在 $	ilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{T})$ 与 $\mathcal O(T)$ 之间随代价函数正则性插值，有限维时恢复参数速率 $\tilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{dT})$。
Motivation: 经典线性 bandit 的可学习性结论建立在代价参数与决策变量的内积结构上，这一前提排除了 Optimal Transport 这类本身没有内积形式的问题，使“linear”之名与实际适用范围脱节。
Method: 提出 OFUL 的改进版：先把动作集嵌入某个 Hilbert 子空间，在其中用最小二乘估计构造置信集，再通过惩罚乐观项把动作限制回该子空间；分析借助惩罚（熵正则）传输收敛到 Kantorovich 问题的结果，再用函数回归技术把轨迹后悔界转成最坏情形后悔界。
Result: 在逼近项之外取得与 OFUL 相同的轨迹后悔上界；最坏情形后悔介于 $\tilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{T})$ 与 $\mathcal O(T)$ 之间，随代价函数正则性插值，有限维设定下恢复 $\tilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{dT})$。
Conclusion: 内积结构不是线性 bandit 高效学习的必要条件，只要能嵌入 Hilbert 子空间并配合惩罚乐观与熵正则传输的收敛结果，Optimal Transport 类问题也能达到 OFUL 级别的后悔率。

summary_sections.method: 提出 OFUL 的改进版：先把动作集嵌入某个 Hilbert 子空间，在其中用最小二乘估计构造置信集，再通过惩罚乐观项把动作限制回该子空间；分析借助惩罚（熵正则）传输收敛到 Kantorovich 问题的结果，再用函数回归技术把轨迹后悔界转成最坏情形后悔界。
summary_sections.result: 在逼近项之外取得与 OFUL 相同的轨迹后悔上界；最坏情形后悔介于 $\tilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{T})$ 与 $\mathcal O(T)$ 之间，随代价函数正则性插值，有限维设定下恢复 $\tilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{dT})$。
summary_sections.conclusion: 内积结构不是线性 bandit 高效学习的必要条件，只要能嵌入 Hilbert 子空间并配合惩罚乐观与熵正则传输的收敛结果，Optimal Transport 类问题也能达到 OFUL 级别的后悔率。

papers.title: How Vulnerable Is My Learned Policy? Universal Adversarial Perturbation Attacks On Modern Behavior Cloning Policies
papers.abstract_en: Imitation learning, also known as learning from demonstrations, is a popular approach to train AI models; however, the vulnerability of these models to adversarial attacks remains underexplored. We present the first systematic study of adversarial attacks, across a range of both classic and recently proposed imitation learning algorithms, including Vanilla Behavior Cloning (Vanilla BC), LSTM-GMM, Implicit Behavior Cloning (IBC), Diffusion Policy (DP), and Vector-Quantized Behavior Transformer (VQ-BET). We study the vulnerability of these methods to white-box, grey-box and black-box adversarial perturbations. Our experiments reveal that most existing methods are highly vulnerable to these attacks, including black-box transfer attacks that transfer across algorithms. White-box attacks cause at least a 65% reduction in average task success across all evaluated tasks and algorithms, while the black-box transfer attacks reduce task success by up to 88% on Lift, 99% on Can, and 100% on Square. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to study and compare the vulnerabilities of different popular imitation learning algorithms to both white-box and black-box attacks. Our findings highlight the vulnerabilities of modern imitation learning algorithms, paving the way for future work in addressing such limitations. Videos and code are available at https://sites.google.com/view/uap-attacks-on-bc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对模仿学习策略做系统性对抗攻击评测，覆盖 Vanilla BC、LSTM-GMM、IBC、Diffusion Policy、VQ-BET 五类行为克隆算法，白盒、灰盒、黑盒扰动均能大幅拉低任务成功率。白盒攻击使全部被测任务与算法的平均成功率至少下降 65%，黑盒迁移攻击在 Lift、Can、Square 上分别把成功率拉低至 88%、99%、100%。
Motivation: 模仿学习模型的对抗脆弱性研究不足，尤其是跨算法的黑盒迁移攻击是否成立缺乏系统比较。
Method: 在经典与近期行为克隆算法（Vanilla BC、LSTM-GMM、IBC、Diffusion Policy、VQ-BET）上施加白盒、灰盒、黑盒对抗扰动，比较各算法在统一任务集上的成功率变化。
Result: 白盒攻击在所有被测任务与算法上造成平均任务成功率至少 65% 的下降；黑盒迁移攻击使任务成功率下降幅度在 Lift 上达 88%、Can 上达 99%、Square 上达 100%。
Conclusion: 现代模仿学习算法普遍对对抗扰动高度脆弱，且黑盒扰动能跨算法迁移，是该类策略部署前必须处理的限制。

papers.title: Coupled Seasonal Data Assimilation of Sea Ice, Ocean, and Atmospheric Dynamics over the Last Millennium
papers.abstract_en: "Online" data assimilation (DA) is used to generate a seasonal-resolution reanalysis dataset over the last millennium by combining forecasts from an ocean--atmosphere--sea-ice coupled linear inverse model with climate proxy records. Instrumental verification reveals that this reconstruction achieves the highest correlation skill, while using fewer proxies, in surface temperature reconstructions compared to other paleo-DA products, particularly during boreal winter when proxy data are scarce. Reconstructed ocean and sea-ice variables also have high correlation with instrumental and satellite datasets. Verification against independent proxy records shows that reconstruction skill is robust throughout the last millennium. Analysis of the results reveals that the method effectively captures the seasonal evolution and amplitude of El Niño events, seasonal temperature trends that are consistent with orbital forcing over the last millennium, and polar-amplified cooling in the transition from the Medieval Climate Anomaly to the Little Ice Age.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 15 figures. Author manuscript updated after peer review; published in Journal of Climate. Supplementary Information (26 pages, Figs. S1-S18) included as an ancillary file and available at https://zilum.github.io/paper/LMR_Season-2.pdf
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Climate 38, 7229-7247 (2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用海冰-海洋-大气耦合线性逆模式 (linear inverse model) 作预报算子，在线数据 assimilation 融合气候代用资料，生成过去千年季节分辨率再分析。仪器验证显示其地表温度重建相关技巧高于其他 paleo-DA 产品且用的代用点更少，北半球冬季代用稀缺时优势最明显；还能复原 El Niño 的季节演变与振幅、与轨道强迫一致的千年温度趋势，以及中世纪暖期向小冰期过渡的极地放大降温。
Motivation: 古气候场重建多为静态或单圈层方法，缺少把耦合海气冰动力学与季节尺度代用资料结合的在线 assimilation，导致冬季代用稀缺时地表温度技巧不足、海洋与海冰变量难以重建。
Method: 以海冰-海洋-大气耦合线性逆模式 (LIM) 作为预报算子做 "online" 数据 assimilation，将模式预报与气候代用记录结合，输出过去千年季节分辨率再分析；用仪器记录做技巧验证，并用独立代用记录做交叉检验。
Result: 仪器验证中地表温度重建的相关技巧高于其他 paleo-DA 产品，且使用的代用点更少，北半球冬季（代用稀缺期）提升最明显；重建的海洋与海冰变量同仪器和卫星数据高度相关；对独立代用记录的检验显示技巧在整个千年尺度上稳健；能刻画 El Niño 的季节演变与振幅、与轨道强迫一致的千年季节温度趋势，以及 MCA→LIA 过渡期的极地放大降温。
Conclusion: 把耦合动力学放进在线 assimilation 可以在更少代用资料下得到更高技巧的千年季节再分析，且海洋、海冰与温度场在独立检验中都可信。
Relevance: 74

papers.title: Answer Set Networks: Casting Answer Set Programming into Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Although Answer Set Programming (ASP) allows constraining neural-symbolic (NeSy) systems, its employment is hindered by the prohibitive costs of computing stable models and the CPU-bound nature of state-of-the-art solvers. To this end, we propose Answer Set Networks (ASN), a NeSy solver. Based on Graph Neural Networks (GNN), ASNs are a scalable approach to ASP-based Deep Probabilistic Logic Programming (DPPL). Specifically, we show how to translate ASPs into ASNs and demonstrate how ASNs can efficiently solve the encoded problem by leveraging GPU's batching and parallelization capabilities. Our experimental evaluations demonstrate that ASNs outperform state-of-the-art CPU-bound NeSy systems on multiple tasks. Simultaneously, we make the following two contributions based on the strengths of ASNs. Namely, we are the first to show the finetuning of Large Language Models (LLM) with DPPLs, employing ASNs to guide the training with logic. Further, we show the "constitutional navigation" of drones, i.e., encoding public aviation laws in an ASN for routing Unmanned Aerial Vehicles in uncertain environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Answer Set Networks (ASN)：把 Answer Set Programming (ASP) 的稳定模型计算改写成基于 GNN 的神经符号求解器，用 GPU 批处理与并行替代 CPU 求解器。在多项任务上超过现有 CPU-bound 神经符号系统，并首次用 DPPL 微调 LLM、以航空法规编码实现无人机 constitutional navigation。
Motivation: ASP 能约束神经符号系统，但稳定模型计算代价高昂、现有求解器受 CPU 限制，难以扩展。
Method: 将 ASP 程序翻译为基于 GNN 的 ASN，利用 GPU 的 batching 与并行化求解编码后的问题，作为 ASP-based Deep Probabilistic Logic Programming (DPPL) 的可扩展求解器；并用 ASN 以逻辑引导 LLM 微调、把公共航空法编码进 ASN 做无人机路径规划。
Result: 在多项任务上的实验评估中，ASN 优于现有 CPU-bound 神经符号系统；同时实现首个基于 DPPL 的 LLM 微调，并演示不确定环境中无人机的 constitutional navigation。
Conclusion: 把 ASP 求解搬进 GNN 与 GPU 后，神经符号推理可扩展到 LLM 微调与无人机法规路径规划这类实际任务。

papers.title: Open-World Panoptic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Robots need to be able to understand their surroundings in order to operate safely and robustly, and to interact with the surrounding environment. Robots deployed in unconstrained real-world scenarios must additionally be able to deal with novel situations and objects that have never been seen before. In this article, we tackle the problem of open-world panoptic segmentation, i.e., the task of discovering new semantic categories and new object instances at test time, while enforcing consistency among the categories that we incrementally discover. We present Con2MAV, a general method for open-world panoptic segmentation. Experiments across a wide range of datasets, from road scenes to underwater environments, highlight its compelling capabilities in open-world segmentation and its competitive performance on known classes. We will open-source the implementation of our approach upon acceptance. In addition, we propose PANIC (Panoptic ANomalies In Context), a benchmark for evaluating open-world segmentation tasks in autonomous driving scenarios. This dataset, recorded with a multi-modal sensor suite mounted on a car, and then manually annotated, provides high-quality, pixel-wise annotations of anomalous objects at both semantic and instance level. PANIC contains 800 images, more than 50 unknown classes, i.e., classes that do not appear in the training set, and over 4,000 object instances, providing a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating open-world segmentation methods in autonomous driving scenarios. We provide competitions for multiple open-world segmentation tasks on a hidden test set. Our dataset and competitions are available at https://www.ipb.uni-bonn.de/data/panic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出开放世界全景分割方法 Con2MAV，在测试时发现新语义类别与新实例并保持增量发现类别间的一致性；同时发布自动驾驶场景基准 PANIC，含 800 张图像、50 多个训练集未见类别与 4,000 多个物体实例。
Motivation: 机器人在不受约束的真实场景中会遇到从未见过的物体与类别，现有分割方法无法在测试时发现新类别并保持增量发现结果的一致性。
Method: Con2MAV 面向开放世界全景分割，在测试时发现新语义类别与新物体实例，并约束增量发现类别之间的一致性；另提出 PANIC 基准，用车载多模态传感器采集并人工标注异常物体的语义与实例级像素标注。
Result: 在从道路场景到水下环境的多种数据集上展示开放世界分割能力与已知类别的竞争性表现；PANIC 含 800 张图像、50 多个训练集未见类别、4,000 多个物体实例，并在隐藏测试集上提供多项开放世界分割任务竞赛。
Conclusion: 开放世界全景分割可在测试时增量发现新类别并保持一致性，且在已知类别上保持竞争性能；实现将在接收后开源，数据集与竞赛已公开。

papers.title: Motif Channel Opened in a White-Box: Stereo Matching via Motif Correlation Graph
papers.abstract_en: Real-world applications of stereo matching, such as autonomous driving, place stringent demands on both safety and accuracy. However, learning-based stereo matching methods inherently suffer from the loss of geometric structures in certain feature channels, creating a bottleneck in achieving precise detail matching. Additionally, these methods lack interpretability due to the black-box nature of deep learning. In this paper, we propose MoCha-V2, a novel learning-based paradigm for stereo matching. MoCha-V2 introduces the Motif Correlation Graph (MCG) to capture recurring textures, which are referred to as ``motifs" within feature channels. These motifs reconstruct geometric structures and are learned in a more interpretable way. Subsequently, we integrate features from multiple frequency domains through wavelet inverse transformation. The resulting motif features are utilized to restore geometric structures in the stereo matching process. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of MoCha-V2. MoCha-V2 achieved 1st place on the Middlebury benchmark at the time of its release. Code is available at https://github.com/ZYangChen/MoCha-Stereo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoCha-V2 用 Motif Correlation Graph (MCG) 在特征通道中捕获重复纹理 motif 来重建被学习式立体匹配丢失的几何结构，再经小波逆变换融合多频域特征恢复细节匹配，同时提升白盒可解释性。发布时在 Middlebury 基准上取得第 1 名。
Motivation: 学习式立体匹配在部分特征通道中丢失几何结构，制约精细细节匹配，且深度网络黑箱化导致缺乏可解释性，而自动驾驶等真实应用对安全与精度要求严格。
Method: 提出 MoCha-V2 范式：用 Motif Correlation Graph (MCG) 在特征通道内建模重复纹理 motif 以重建几何结构，随后通过小波逆变换 (wavelet inverse transformation) 融合多频域特征，得到的 motif 特征用于立体匹配中的几何结构恢复。
Result: MoCha-V2 在发布时于 Middlebury 立体匹配基准上取得第 1 名；代码开源在 github.com/ZYangChen/MoCha-Stereo。
Conclusion: 在特征通道中显式建模 motif 并做多频域融合，可以在保持可解释性的同时提升立体匹配的细节精度。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: HardCore Generation: Generating Hard UNSAT Problems for Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Efficiently determining the satisfiability of a boolean equation -- known as the SAT problem for brevity -- is crucial in various industrial problems. Recently, the advent of deep learning methods has introduced significant potential for enhancing SAT solving. However, a major barrier to the advancement of this field has been the scarcity of large, realistic datasets. The majority of current public datasets are either randomly generated or extremely limited, containing only a few examples from unrelated problem families. These datasets are inadequate for meaningful training of deep learning methods. In light of this, researchers have started exploring generative techniques to create data that more accurately reflect SAT problems encountered in practical situations. These methods have so far suffered from either the inability to produce challenging SAT problems or time-scalability obstacles. In this paper we address both by identifying and manipulating the key contributors to a problem's ``hardness'', known as cores. Although some previous work has addressed cores, the time costs are unacceptably high due to the expense of traditional heuristic core detection techniques. We introduce a fast core detection procedure that uses a graph neural network. Our empirical results demonstrate that we can efficiently generate problems that remain hard to solve and retain key attributes of the original example problems. We show via experiment that the generated synthetic SAT problems can be used in a data augmentation setting to provide improved prediction of solver runtimes.

TL;DR: 针对深度学习求解 SAT 缺少大规模真实数据集的问题，HardCore Generation 通过识别并操纵决定问题难度的 core 来生成难解的 UNSAT 实例，用于数据增强。用图神经网络 (GNN) 替代昂贵的传统启发式 core 检测，实验证明生成的问题保持难解并保留原问题的关键属性，作为数据增强可改善求解器运行时间的预测。
Motivation: 现有公开 SAT 数据集要么随机生成、要么规模极小且来自互不相关的问题族，不足以训练深度学习方法；已有生成方法要么产不出有挑战性的问题、要么存在时间可扩展性障碍，而传统启发式 core 检测代价过高。
Method: 识别并操纵决定 SAT 问题难度的关键因素 core；提出基于图神经网络的快速 core 检测流程，替代传统启发式检测以降低成本；生成难解 UNSAT 问题并置于数据增强设置中训练预测模型。
Result: 实验证明可高效生成保持难解、并保留原示例问题关键属性的问题；生成的合成 SAT 问题在数据增强设置下改善了对求解器运行时间 (solver runtime) 的预测。

papers.title: A Unified Deep Learning Framework for Motion Correction in Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has shown significant value in medical image registration for motion correction; however, current techniques are either limited by the type and range of motion they can handle or require iterative inference and/or retraining for new imaging data. To address these limitations, we introduce UniMo, a Unified Motion Correction framework that uses deep neural networks to correct various types of motion in medical imaging. UniMo uses an alternating optimization scheme with a unified loss function to train an integrated model of 1) an equivariant neural network for global rigid motion correction and 2) an encoder-decoder network for local deformations. It features a geometric deformation augmenter that 1) enhances the robustness of global motion correction by addressing local deformations, whether caused by non-rigid motion or geometric distortions, and 2) generates augmented data to improve training. As a hybrid model that uses both image intensities and shapes, UniMo is robust to appearance variations and generalizes to various imaging modalities without retraining. We trained and tested UniMo for motion tracking in fetal magnetic resonance imaging, which is challenging due to 1) both large rigid and non-rigid motion and 2) large variations in image appearance. We then tested the trained model, without retraining, on three public datasets: MedMNIST, lung CT, and BraTS. UniMo surpassed existing motion correction methods in accuracy and, notably, enabled one-time training on a single modality while maintaining high stability and adaptability across multiple unseen imaging datasets. By offering a unified solution to motion correction, UniMo marks a significant advance in challenging applications with a mixture of bulk motion and local deformations. Code is available at https://github.com/IntelligentImaging/UNIMO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniMo 用交替优化把全局刚性运动校正（等变网络）与局部形变校正（编码器-解码器）合成单一模型，配合几何形变增强器同时提升鲁棒性并生成增广数据。在胎儿 MRI 上训练后不重训直接用于 MedMNIST、肺 CT、BraTS 三个公开数据集，精度超过现有运动校正方法，实现单模态一次训练跨多未见成像数据集的稳定迁移。
Motivation: 医学图像运动校正现有深度学习方法要么只能处理有限类型与幅度的运动，要么换新影像数据需要迭代推理或重新训练，难以覆盖大范围刚性与非刚性混合运动。
Method: UniMo 采用交替优化方案与统一损失函数，联合训练两部分：负责全局刚性运动校正的等变神经网络 (equivariant network) 与负责局部形变的编码器-解码器网络；几何形变增强器既通过处理局部形变（非刚性运动或几何畸变）增强全局校正鲁棒性，又生成增广训练数据；模型同时使用图像强度与形状信息。
Result: 在胎儿 MRI（兼具大刚性与非刚性运动、外观变化大）上训练与测试运动跟踪；训练后不重训直接测试 MedMNIST、肺 CT、BraTS 三个公开数据集，精度超过现有运动校正方法，并在多个未见成像数据集上保持高稳定性与适应性。
Conclusion: 把全局刚性与局部形变放进一个交替优化的混合强度-形状模型，可在单模态一次训练后跨模态泛化，无需为新数据重训。

papers.title: XS-VID: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Small Object Detection and Tracking in Videos
papers.abstract_en: Small object detection and tracking in videos remain critical yet underexplored challenges in computer vision, particularly for applications such as public safety, aerial surveillance, and autonomous driving. Existing benchmarks offer limited support due to limited numbers of small objects, constrained category diversity, and narrow scene coverage. To address these limitations, we introduce XS-VID, a large-scale video benchmark comprising 223K frames and 1.4M annotated bounding boxes across 374 video sequences spanning diverse scene types. XS-VID provides extensive coverage of small-object scales, particularly for extremely small ($0\sim12^2$ pixels) and small ($12^2\sim20^2$ pixels) objects, which collectively constitute over 55% of all annotations. For systematic evaluation, we establish three dedicated tracks: Detection, multiple object tracking (MOT), and single object tracking (SOT), and extensively test the existing state-of-the-art methods on each. The experimental results indicate that existing methods face significant challenges with XS-VID, mainly stemming from insufficient modeling of spatiotemporal features at small scales. To tackle these challenges, we propose a lightweight, high-precision detection framework dubbed YOLOFT. It enhances small-object feature representation and spatiotemporal integration while preserving high detection speed, thereby achieving improved accuracy and robustness on both the XS-VID and VisDrone benchmarks. Our dataset and code are publicly available at https://gjhhust.github.io/XS-VID/, providing a solid foundation for future research on small-object detection and tracking in videos.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI). 22 pages, including supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: XS-VID 是面向视频中小目标检测与跟踪的大规模基准，含 223K 帧、1.4M 标注框、374 段视频，其中极小目标（0~12² 像素）与小目标（12²~20² 像素）合计占全部标注 55% 以上。在 Detection、MOT、SOT 三条赛道上测试现有 SOTA 方法后发现其主要瓶颈是小尺度时空特征建模不足；据此提出轻量高精度检测框架 YOLOFT，在 XS-VID 与 VisDrone 上同时提升精度与鲁棒性并保持高检测速度。
Motivation: 现有小目标基准在小目标数量、类别多样性与场景覆盖上受限，难以支撑视频中小目标检测与跟踪的系统评测，而公共安全、空中监视、自动驾驶等应用正依赖这类能力。
Method: 构建 XS-VID 视频基准（223K 帧、1.4M 边界框、374 段视频，覆盖多样场景），并设立 Detection、MOT、SOT 三条专用赛道系统测试现有 SOTA 方法；针对暴露的时空特征建模不足，提出轻量高精度检测框架 YOLOFT，增强小目标特征表示与时空整合，同时保持高检测速度。
Result: XS-VID 中极小目标（0~12² 像素）与小目标（12²~20² 像素）合计占全部标注的 55% 以上；在三条赛道上测试的现有 SOTA 方法在 XS-VID 上面临显著挑战，主因是小尺度时空特征建模不足；YOLOFT 在 XS-VID 与 VisDrone 两个基准上均取得提升的精度与鲁棒性，并保持高检测速度。
Conclusion: 视频小目标检测与跟踪的短板在于小尺度时空特征建模，YOLOFT 以轻量方式同时换取精度、鲁棒性与速度；数据集与代码已在项目页公开。

papers.title: CHAOSMINING: Benchmarking Post-Hoc Attribution with Sparse Informative Features in High Dimensions
papers.abstract_en: Post-hoc attribution is widely used to identify important model inputs, but evaluating whether these attributions identify truly informative features is difficult because real datasets rarely provide reliable ground truth. We introduce a multimodal benchmark containing symbolic tabular, vision, and audio tasks with known informative feature sets. In the main benchmark conditions, informative variables, spatial regions, or channels occupy fixed input coordinates while the remaining inputs provide irrelevant or distracting information. We use the benchmark to study how attribution quality depends on predictive performance, irrelevant-feature burden and structure, model configuration, and attribution mechanism, while separately measuring identification, stability, and computational cost. In most symbolic-data sweeps, informative-set identification co-varies with predictive performance, while the relative ordering of attribution methods remains largely stable. Across modalities, no method dominates all architectures and conditions, and greater attribution complexity does not consistently improve identification. Simple gradient attribution is often competitive at lower computational cost, while the vision and audio results show that architecture and the form of irrelevant content materially affect attribution quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CHAOSMINING 提出一个多模态 post-hoc attribution 基准（符号表格、视觉、音频），已知 informative feature 集合，且在主设定中这些特征固定占据输入坐标、其余输入充当干扰。符号数据扫描中 informative-set identification 与预测性能同向变化，方法间相对排序基本稳定；跨模态没有任何方法在所有架构与条件下占优，简单梯度归因常以更低计算成本保持竞争力。
Motivation: 真实数据集几乎不提供可靠的特征重要性 ground truth，导致 post-hoc attribution 是否真的识别出 informative feature 无法评估。
Method: 构建含符号表格、视觉、音频任务的多模态基准，已知 informative feature 集合，主设定中 informative 变量/空间区域/通道占据固定输入坐标，其余输入提供无关或干扰信息；分别测量 identification、stability 与计算成本，并扫描预测性能、无关特征负担与结构、模型配置和归因机制。
Result: 在多数符号数据扫描中，informative-set identification 与预测性能同向变化，而各归因方法的相对排序基本稳定；跨模态没有方法在所有架构与条件下占优，归因复杂度提高并不稳定带来 identification 提升，简单梯度归因常以更低计算成本保持竞争力，视觉与音频结果表明架构与无关内容形式实质影响归因质量。
Conclusion: 归因质量受架构与干扰内容形式制约，复杂归因机制不必然优于简单梯度方法，评估归因须在已知 ground truth 的基准上同时看 identification、stability 与成本。

papers.title: PPFedIT: Towards Privacy-Preserving Federated Instruction Tuning with Few-shot Local Examples
papers.abstract_en: Instruction tuning aligns large language models (LLMs) with human intentions but requires diverse, high-quality data that are difficult to collect in privacy-sensitive domains. Federated instruction tuning (FedIT) enables collaborative training across data owners, yet existing methods typically assume sufficient local data. In realistic few-shot settings, limited samples can cause overfitting, degrade performance, and increase vulnerability to training data extraction attacks. We propose PPFedIT, a federated algorithm that improves both model performance and privacy protection in federated few-shot learning. It comprises three client-side steps: (1) synthetic data generation, which uses LLMs to diversify and enrich local data; (2) parameter isolation training, which updates the shared global LLM on synthetic data and local LLMs on private local data to mitigate synthetic-data noise; and (3) local aggregation then sharing, which mixes global and local model parameters before uploading them for server aggregation to mitigate data extraction attacks. Experiments on three open-source datasets show that PPFedIT improves model performance by an average of 8.4% and reduces the risk of data extraction attacks by approximately 20% in challenging federated few-shot settings.
papers.comment: 23 pages. Author's version of the article published in ACM Transactions on Intelligent Systems and Technology (ACM TIST)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PPFedIT 针对联邦少样本指令微调 (federated instruction tuning) 提出三步客户端流程：用 LLM 合成数据扩充本地样本、参数隔离训练（共享全局 LLM 只吃合成数据、本地 LLM 只吃私有数据）、以及本地聚合后再上传参数以缓解数据窃取攻击。在三个开源数据集的联邦少样本设定下，模型性能平均提升 8.4%，数据窃取攻击风险下降约 20%。
Motivation: 隐私敏感领域难以收集多样的高质量指令数据，联邦指令微调 (FedIT) 又通常假设本地数据充足；现实的 few-shot 设定下样本少会导致过拟合、性能下降，并加剧训练数据被抽取 (training data extraction) 的风险。
Method: 客户端三步：合成数据生成，用 LLM 多样化扩充本地数据；参数隔离训练，共享全局 LLM 在合成数据上更新、本地 LLM 在私有数据上更新以抑制合成噪声；本地聚合后共享，把全局与本地模型参数混合再上传给服务器做聚合，以缓解数据窃取攻击。
Result: 在三个开源数据集的联邦少样本设定下，PPFedIT 使模型性能平均提升 8.4%，数据窃取攻击风险降低约 20%。
Conclusion: 在联邦 few-shot 指令微调中，合成数据、参数隔离与上传前参数混合三者结合可同时改善性能与抗数据抽取的隐私保护。

summary_sections.method: 客户端三步：合成数据生成，用 LLM 多样化扩充本地数据；参数隔离训练，共享全局 LLM 在合成数据上更新、本地 LLM 在私有数据上更新以抑制合成噪声；本地聚合后共享，把全局与本地模型参数混合再上传给服务器做聚合，以缓解数据窃取攻击。
summary_sections.result: 在三个开源数据集的联邦少样本设定下，PPFedIT 使模型性能平均提升 8.4%，数据窃取攻击风险降低约 20%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在联邦 few-shot 指令微调中，合成数据、参数隔离与上传前参数混合三者结合可同时改善性能与抗数据抽取的隐私保护。

papers.title: InstructTA: Instruction-Tuned Targeted Attack for Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated their incredible capability in visual question answering. However, this rich visual interaction also makes LVLMs vulnerable to adversarial examples. In this paper, we formulate a novel and practical targeted attack scenario that the adversary knows only the vision encoder of the victim LVLM, without the knowledge of its prompts and its underlying large language model. This practical setting poses challenges to the cross-prompt and cross-model transferability of targeted adversarial attack, which aims to confuse the LVLM to output a response that is semantically similar to the attacker's chosen target text. To this end, we propose an instruction-tuned targeted attack (dubbed InstructTA) to deliver the targeted adversarial attack on LVLMs with high transferability. Initially, we utilize a public text-to-image generative model to reverse the target response into a target image, and employ GPT-4 to infer a reasonable instruction $\boldsymbol{p}^\prime$ from the target response. We then form a local surrogate model (sharing the same vision encoder with the victim LVLM) to extract instruction-aware features of an adversarial image example and the target image, and minimize the distance between these two features to optimize the adversarial example. To further improve the transferability with instruction tuning, we augment the instruction $\boldsymbol{p}^\prime$ with instructions paraphrased from GPT-4. Extensive experiments on 6 victim LVLMs demonstrate the superiority of our proposed method in targeted attack performance and transferability. In particular, InstructTA achieves an attack success rate of 51.9% on BLIP-2, outperforming the strongest baseline by 10.5%, and consistently yields the highest attack success rates across all evaluated models. The code is available at https://github.com/xunguangwang/InstructTA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InstructTA 在攻击者只知视觉编码器、不知提示与 LLM 的设定下做定向对抗攻击：用文生图模型把目标回复反解为目标图像，GPT-4 生成指令并改写增广，共享视觉编码器的局部代理最小化指令感知特征距离来优化对抗样本。在 6 个受害 LVLM 上，BLIP-2 攻击成功率 51.9%，比最强基线高 10.5 个百分点，且在全部被测模型上成功率最高。
Motivation: LVLM 的视觉交互使其易受对抗样本攻击，而现实中攻击者往往只能拿到视觉编码器、拿不到提示与底层 LLM，这使定向攻击的跨提示、跨模型迁移成为难题。
Method: 先用公开文生图模型把攻击者选定的目标回复反解为目标图像，再用 GPT-4 从目标回复推断合理指令 p'；构造与受害 LVLM 共享同一视觉编码器的局部代理，提取对抗样本与目标图像的指令感知特征并最小化二者距离以优化对抗样本；最后用 GPT-4 改写出的多条改述指令增广 p' 以提升指令调优下的迁移性。
Result: 在 6 个受害 LVLM 上的实验中，InstructTA 在 BLIP-2 上攻击成功率 51.9%，比最强基线高 10.5%，并在所有被测模型上取得最高攻击成功率。
Conclusion: 只掌握视觉编码器也能通过目标图像反解加指令感知特征对齐做出高迁移的定向攻击，指令改写增广是提升跨提示、跨模型迁移的关键。

papers.title: Event-based Continuous Color Video Decompression from Single Frames
papers.abstract_en: We present ContinuityCam, a novel approach to generate a continuous video from a single static RGB image and an event camera stream. Conventional cameras struggle with high-speed motion capture due to bandwidth and dynamic range limitations. Event cameras are ideal sensors to solve this problem because they encode compressed change information at high temporal resolution. In this work, we tackle the problem of event-based continuous color video decompression, pairing single static color frames and event data to reconstruct temporally continuous videos. Our approach combines continuous long-range motion modeling with a neural synthesis model, enabling frame prediction at arbitrary times within the events. Our method only requires an initial image, thus increasing the robustness to sudden motions, light changes, minimizing the prediction latency, and decreasing bandwidth usage. We also introduce a novel single-lens beamsplitter setup that acquires aligned images and events, and a novel and challenging Event Extreme Decompression Dataset (E2D2) that tests the method in various lighting and motion profiles. We thoroughly evaluate our method by benchmarking color frame reconstruction, outperforming the baseline methods by 3.61 dB in PSNR and by 33% decrease in LPIPS, as well as showing superior results on two downstream tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ContinuityCam 用单张静态 RGB 图加事件相机 (event camera) 流重建时间上连续的彩色视频，可在事件覆盖的任意时刻预测帧。在自建的 Event Extreme Decompression Dataset (E2D2) 上，彩色帧重建 PSNR 超出基线 3.61 dB，LPIPS 下降 33%，并在两个下游任务上取得更优结果。
Motivation: 常规相机受带宽与动态范围限制难以捕捉高速运动，而事件相机以高时间分辨率编码压缩的变化信息；如何把单帧与事件流配对、重建任意时刻的连续彩色视频是待解问题。
Method: 将连续长程运动建模 (continuous long-range motion modeling) 与神经合成模型 (neural synthesis model) 结合，只需一张初始图像即可在事件内任意时刻预测帧；另提出单镜头分光器 (single-lens beamsplitter) 装置获取对齐的图像与事件，并构建 E2D2 数据集覆盖多种光照与运动剖面。
Result: 在 E2D2 上彩色帧重建 PSNR 超出基线方法 3.61 dB，LPIPS 下降 33%，并在两个下游任务上优于基线；方法只需初始图像，降低预测延迟与带宽占用，对突发运动和光照变化更稳健。
Conclusion: 单帧加事件流足以重建任意时刻的连续彩色视频，且在重建质量与下游任务上超过既有基线；对齐的图文采集装置与 E2D2 是配套的评测资源。

papers.title: Textual Echo Cancellation
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose Textual Echo Cancellation (TEC) - a framework for cancelling the text-to-speech (TTS) playback echo from overlapping speech recordings. Such a system can largely improve speech recognition performance and user experience for intelligent devices such as smart speakers, as the user can talk to the device while the device is still playing the TTS signal responding to the previous query. We implement this system by using a novel sequence-to-sequence model with multi-source attention that takes both the microphone mixture signal and source text of the TTS playback as inputs, and predicts the enhanced audio. Experiments show that the textual information of the TTS playback is critical to enhancement performance. Besides, the text sequence is much smaller in size compared with the raw acoustic signal of the TTS playback, and can be immediately transmitted to the device or ASR server even before the playback is synthesized. Therefore, our proposed approach effectively reduces Internet communication and latency compared with alternative approaches such as acoustic echo cancellation (AEC).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Textual Echo Cancellation (TEC)：用带多源注意力的序列到序列模型，同时输入麦克风混合信号与 TTS 播放的源文本，直接输出增强后的音频，从而在设备仍在播报上一轮回复时消除回声。文本信息对增强性能是关键的，且文本序列远小于 TTS 原始声学信号，可在合成前就传到设备或 ASR 服务器，相比声学回声消除 (AEC) 显著降低网络通信量与延迟。
Motivation: 智能音箱等设备在播放 TTS 回复时用户就开口提问，重叠语音使语音识别性能和体验变差；传统 AEC 需要传输或参考完整的 TTS 声学信号，通信开销与延迟都高。
Method: TEC 框架采用序列到序列模型配多源注意力 (multi-source attention)，以麦克风混合信号和 TTS 播放的源文本两个来源为输入，预测增强后的音频；文本序列在 TTS 合成完成前即可传给设备或 ASR 服务器。
Result: 实验表明 TTS 播放的文本信息对增强性能是关键的；文本序列在体积上远小于 TTS 原始声学信号，可立即传输；相比 AEC 等替代方案，该方法有效降低了互联网通信量与延迟。
Conclusion: 用文本而非完整声学参考来消除 TTS 回声是可行的，既保住重叠对话下的识别性能，又把回声参考的传输成本压到文本量级。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Personal VAD: Speaker-Conditioned Voice Activity Detection
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose "personal VAD", a system to detect the voice activity of a target speaker at the frame level. This system is useful for gating the inputs to a streaming on-device speech recognition system, such that it only triggers for the target user, which helps reduce the computational cost and battery consumption, especially in scenarios where a keyword detector is unpreferable. We achieve this by training a VAD-alike neural network that is conditioned on the target speaker embedding or the speaker verification score. For each frame, personal VAD outputs the probabilities for three classes: non-speech, target speaker speech, and non-target speaker speech. Under our optimal setup, we are able to train a model with only 130K parameters that outperforms a baseline system where individually trained standard VAD and speaker recognition networks are combined to perform the same task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 personal VAD：把目标说话人 embedding 或说话人验证分数作为条件输入，训练一个 VAD 式神经网络，逐帧输出非语音、目标说话人语音、非目标说话人语音三类概率，用于流式端侧语音识别的输入门控。最优配置下 130K 参数的模型即超过「独立训练的标准 VAD + 说话人识别网络拼接」这一基线。
Motivation: 端侧流式语音识别需要只对目标用户触发，否则持续计算费电；关键词检测器在很多场景不适用，而标准 VAD 与说话人识别分开训练再拼接的组合方式参数量大且配合生硬。
Method: 训练一个以目标说话人 embedding 或 speaker verification score 为条件的 VAD 式神经网络，逐帧输出三类后验（non-speech、target speaker speech、non-target speaker speech），作为流式识别的门控；最优设置下模型仅 130K 参数。
Result: 最优配置下 130K 参数的模型在该任务上超过由单独训练的标准 VAD 与说话人识别网络组合而成的基线系统。
Conclusion: 把说话人条件直接嵌入帧级 VAD，可以用极小模型同时完成语音检测与目标说话人筛选，从而替代 VAD 与说话人识别两套网络的拼接方案。

papers.title: The GenAI4IDN Benchmark 3.0 - a Public Tool to Assess Generative AI Tools for the Design of Interactive Digital Narratives
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents GENAI4IDN Benchmark 3.0, the third iteration of an evaluation framework to assess Generative AI tools for creating Interactive Digital Narratives (IDNs). Moving beyond manual testing, this iteration introduces AI-assisted evaluation through a publicly accessible web application (https://genai4idn.com), enabling the community to run benchmarks on demand, add new models, and propose new tasks. The revised evaluation framework is "blinded" to avoid model-bias, and can handle complex media such as music, videos, and full IDNs that previously required human raters. A significant addition - responding to concerns raised during ICIDS 2025 - is the addition of fact-checking and bias detection with dedicated tasks and rubrics, validated by human raters with lived experience in the depicted contexts. Findings from a diverse range of models report on maturing creative capabilities while observing runaway thinking and overzealous safety filters as limitations. Fact-checking reliably caught subtle historical inaccuracies, anachronisms, and fabricated claims while the bias rater consistently exposed structural assumptions, tropes, and marginalized group erasures.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at ICIDS 2026, Bangkok, Thailand
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GenAI4IDN Benchmark 3.0 是评估生成式 AI 制作交互式数字叙事 (IDN) 的公开评测框架，第三版引入 AI 辅助评测网页应用，支持社区按需跑基准、加模型与新任务，并对模型盲评以避免模型偏置。评测显示模型创意能力趋于成熟，但存在 runaway thinking 与过严安全过滤；事实核查可靠抓出细微历史错误、时代错置与捏造说法，偏置评分器一致暴露结构性假设、套路与边缘群体抹除。
Motivation: 此前 IDN 生成工具评测依赖人工测试，难以处理音乐、视频与完整 IDN 等复杂媒体，且缺少事实核查与偏置检测任务，无法回应社区对模型偏置与内容可靠性的担忧。
Method: 第三版提供公开网页应用 (genai4idn.com) 支持按需基准运行、新增模型与任务；评测框架对模型盲评以避免模型偏置，用 AI 辅助评分处理音乐、视频与完整 IDN；新增事实核查与偏置检测专用任务与评分细则 (rubrics)，由具相关生活经验的人类评分者验证。
Result: 在多类模型上的评测报告创意能力趋于成熟，同时观察到 runaway thinking 与过严安全过滤两项局限；事实核查可靠抓出细微历史不准确、时代错置 (anachronisms) 与捏造说法，偏置评分器一致暴露结构假设、套路与边缘群体抹除。
Conclusion: AI 辅助、盲评且带人类验证 rubric 的基准可扩展到复杂媒体与社区自建任务，并能同时暴露生成式 AI 在 IDN 创作中的创意成熟度与事实、偏置缺陷。

summary_sections.motivation: 此前 IDN 生成工具评测依赖人工测试，难以处理音乐、视频与完整 IDN 等复杂媒体，且缺少事实核查与偏置检测任务，无法回应社区对模型偏置与内容可靠性的担忧。
summary_sections.method: 第三版提供公开网页应用 (genai4idn.com) 支持按需基准运行、新增模型与任务；评测框架对模型盲评以避免模型偏置，用 AI 辅助评分处理音乐、视频与完整 IDN；新增事实核查与偏置检测专用任务与评分细则 (rubrics)，由具相关生活经验的人类评分者验证。
summary_sections.result: 在多类模型上的评测报告创意能力趋于成熟，同时观察到 runaway thinking 与过严安全过滤两项局限；事实核查可靠抓出细微历史不准确、时代错置 (anachronisms) 与捏造说法，偏置评分器一致暴露结构假设、套路与边缘群体抹除。
summary_sections.conclusion: AI 辅助、盲评且带人类验证 rubric 的基准可扩展到复杂媒体与社区自建任务，并能同时暴露生成式 AI 在 IDN 创作中的创意成熟度与事实、偏置缺陷。

papers.title: Delay-coordinate reconstruction and conditional-moment causal diagnostics in stochastic systems
papers.abstract_en: Partial observation and delay-coordinate reconstruction are rooted in deterministic dynamical-systems theory, whereas there are many systems with intrinsic stochasticity. We propose a conditional-moment interpretation of delay-coordinate reconstruction for stochastic systems, in which a delay vector is used to reconstruct conditional moments of a future distribution rather than a unique future sample path. Two complementary arguments motivate this viewpoint. First, the probability density of a stochastic differential equation obeys a deterministic Fokker-Planck equation and, under certain assumptions, is represented by an infinite deterministic hierarchy of moments. Hence, a finite-moment closure suggests a Takens-like finite-dimensional approximation. Second, a discussion based on the Koopman operator theory clarifies that the time evolution of an observable in the Mori-Zwanzig formalism yields a conditional expectation in stochastic systems. Then, the orthogonal "noise" term in the coefficient-space Mori-Zwanzig equation vanishes in the stochastic cases; this result is consistent with the moment-based argument. As an application of this stochastic delay-reconstruction viewpoint, we revisit convergent cross mapping (CCM) for diagnosing certain causal relationships. Although CCM based on the embedding theorem cannot generally be applied to stochastic systems, it is possible to examine certain types of causal relationships by using conditional moments. Using coupled logistic systems with additive and multiplicative coupling mechanisms, we discuss how causal relationships are embedded in stochastic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把确定性系统的延迟坐标重构 (delay-coordinate reconstruction) 重新解释为对未来分布的条件矩重构：延迟向量重建的是未来分布的条件矩而非唯一轨道。理由是 SDE 的概率密度服从确定性 Fokker-Planck 方程并可展开为无穷矩层级，有限矩闭合给出类 Takens 的有限维近似；Koopman/Mori-Zwanzig 框架下可观测量的时间演化给出条件期望，且系数空间 Mori-Zwanzig 方程中的正交噪声项在随机情形下消失。据此把收敛交叉映射 (CCM) 改造成基于条件矩的因果诊断，并在含加性与乘性耦合的耦合 logistic 系统上讨论因果关系如何嵌入随机系统。
Motivation: 延迟坐标重构与 CCM 建立在确定性动力系统的嵌入定理之上，而真实系统常有内在随机性，此时嵌入定理一般不再适用，需要一个能处理随机系统的重构与因果诊断框架。
Method: 提出随机系统的条件矩解释：先由 Fokker-Planck 方程与无穷矩层级论证有限矩闭合的 Takens 类有限维近似，再用 Koopman 算子理论在 Mori-Zwanzig 形式下说明可观测量演化给出条件期望、正交噪声项在随机情形消失；随后把 CCM 改写为基于条件矩的因果诊断，并在加性与乘性耦合的耦合 logistic 系统上讨论。
Result: 理论结果为：随机情形下系数空间 Mori-Zwanzig 方程的正交噪声项消失，与矩论证一致；应用层面在含加性与乘性耦合机制的耦合 logistic 系统上讨论了因果关系在随机系统中的嵌入方式。
Conclusion: 随机系统中的延迟向量应理解为未来分布条件矩的重构器，基于条件矩的 CCM 可用于诊断随机系统中的特定类型因果关系，即使嵌入定理本身一般不成立。

papers.title: Atomic Visual Entailment: Enhancing Zero-Shot Vision-Language Reasoning through Atomic Fact Decomposition and Learned Selection
papers.abstract_en: Visual entailment (VE) asks whether an image supports, contradicts, or leaves undecided a textual hypothesis. Strong results come from fine-tuning large vision-language models on labelled data, while zero-shot and hybrid approaches remain far behind. A VE hypothesis often bundles several visual claims, yet existing zero-shot methods reason over it as a single unit. We propose Atomic Visual Entailment (AVE), which decomposes the hypothesis into atomic facts, produces candidate predictions from both the full hypothesis and its facts using frozen vision-language models, and predicts the final label with a lightweight classifier trained only on how those candidates behave. We find that decomposition helps only when the hypothesis context is preserved: judging facts in isolation is worse than not decomposing at all. Full-hypothesis and atomic prediction make complementary errors, and learning which to trust recovers far more of that complementarity than majority voting, reaching 0.803 test accuracy on SNLI-VE without fine-tuning any vision-language model. AVE also localises the visual evidence behind its prediction without region-level supervision. These results suggest that learning which candidate prediction to trust can close much of the gap to fine-tuned systems, offering a practical alternative where fine-tuning a vision-language model directly would need more labelled data or compute than is available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AVE 把视觉蕴含 (visual entailment) 假设拆成原子事实，用冻结的视觉-语言模型分别从完整假设与各原子事实生成候选预测，再用一个轻量分类器学习该信任哪个候选。关键发现是：只有保留假设上下文时拆解才有效，孤立判断原子事实比完全不拆更差；学习信任哪个候选比多数投票更能回收互补性，在 SNLI-VE 上达到 0.803 测试准确率且不微调任何视觉-语言模型。
Motivation: 零样本与混合视觉蕴含方法远落后于在标注数据上微调的大模型，而一个 VE 假设常捆绑多个视觉断言，现有零样本方法却把它当单一单元推理。
Method: AVE 将假设分解为原子事实，用冻结的视觉-语言模型对完整假设和各原子事实分别产生候选预测，再用一个轻量分类器（仅在这些候选的行为上训练）预测最终标签；同时在无区域级监督下定位支撑预测的视觉证据。
Result: 在 SNLI-VE 上达到 0.803 测试准确率，且不微调任何视觉-语言模型；学习信任哪个候选预测回收的互补性远多于多数投票；孤立判断原子事实的效果差于完全不分解。
Conclusion: 学习该信任哪个候选预测可以大幅缩小与微调系统的差距，在直接微调视觉-语言模型所需标注数据或算力不可得时提供一条实用替代路径。

papers.title: A Framework for Automated Multi-Source Satellite Data Analytics and LLM-Based Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents the workflow for building an automated ArcGIS Pro tool using ArcPy to extract the Land Surface Temperature (LST) from Landsat 7, 8 and 9 datasets. The tool eliminates the need for manual band selection and repetitive raster computations by automating the multi-step workflow of radiometric calibration, NDVI-based emissivity correction, and thermal conversion. In addition to supporting batch and single-scene processing, the tool has an optional Large Language Model (LLM) for statistical result interpretation and reporting. Depending on batch size, the tool reduced the processing time from around 11-58 minutes when done manually to around 4-11 minutes using the tool. We tested the tool with data from Ras Al Khaimah (RAK) in the UAE, and the LST obtained for Ras Al Khaimah ranged from approximately 25C to 50C, demonstrating an accurate LST mapping compatible with the weather conditions of RAK. In summary, our tool reduces human errors and improves processing accuracy and efficiency for thermal and environmental remote sensing applications, in addition to providing an interactive LLM-based interface for result interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 ArcPy 把 Landsat 7/8/9 的地表温度 (LST) 反演全流程自动化：辐射定标、基于 NDVI 的发射率校正、热红外转换一次跑完，并可选接 LLM 做统计解读与报告生成。在阿联酋 Ras Al Khaimah (RAK) 测试中，单批处理时间从人工的约 11–58 分钟降到约 4–11 分钟，反演 LST 约 25°C–50°C，与当地天气条件相符。
Motivation: Landsat 热红外反演需人工选波段并重复做栅格运算，多景批量处理耗时且易出错，阻碍热环境遥感的常规化应用。
Method: 构建基于 ArcGIS Pro 与 ArcPy 的自动化工具，串起辐射定标、NDVI 发射率校正与热转换三步，支持单景与批量两种模式；可选接入 LLM 对统计结果做解释并生成报告。
Result: 处理时间由人工约 11–58 分钟降至工具的约 4–11 分钟（视批量大小）；在 RAK (UAE) 测试得到 LST 约 25°C–50°C，与当地天气条件一致。
Conclusion: 自动化 LST 工作流可压缩热红外遥感处理时间、减少人工误差并提升精度与效率，LLM 接口用于结果解读与报告。

papers.title: UndoBench: Separating Task Competence from Recovery Capability in Tool-Using AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using AI agents are increasingly deployed across enterprise software systems, yet widely used benchmarks primarily evaluate nominal task completion, conflating baseline planning competence with operational fault recovery. We introduce UndoBench, a benchmark spanning 36 base workflows and 36 fault scenarios across 8 enterprise domains, decoupling task competence from recovery capability via counterfactual paired trials under identical seeds alongside wire-level effect-history and environment-state oracles. On 12 held-out TEST workflows across two open-weight models, two frameworks, and three recovery paradigms (5,760 executions / 2,880 paired trials) in the frozen lost-acknowledgment study, nominal competence reached 83.54% while conditional recovery success rate (CRSR) fell to 46.72%, with naive retry producing duplicate external effects in 53.33% of trials. Extensions to commercial API models reproduced this competence-recovery separation. Evaluations across complementary execution boundaries show that recovery is phase-dependent: before mutation, methods perform similarly without duplicate effects among capable trials; during partial mutation, naive retry, per-call idempotency, and zero-privilege journaling collapse on the evaluated composite workflows; after commit but before acknowledgment, verification and server-side idempotency substantially improve safety. These findings demonstrate that evaluating nominal completion alone masks critical, phase-dependent recovery vulnerabilities in autonomous agents.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Code and benchmark available at https://github.com/tradertanmay/undobench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UndoBench 用同种子反事实配对试验把工具调用智能体的任务能力与故障恢复能力拆开测：在 12 条 held-out TEST 工作流、两个开源模型、两个框架、三种恢复范式共 5,760 次执行中，名义任务完成率达 83.54%，而条件恢复成功率 (CRSR) 只有 46.72%，naive retry 在 53.33% 的试验里产生重复外部副作用。恢复能力随故障相位变化：mutation 前各方法相当且无重复副作用，partial mutation 时 naive retry、per-call idempotency、zero-privilege journaling 在所测复合工作流上失效，commit 后 acknowledgment 前 verification 与服务端幂等显著更安全。
Motivation: 企业软件智能体的主流基准只测名义任务完成，把基线规划能力与运行期故障恢复能力混为一谈，掩盖了部署中真正致命的重复副作用风险。
Method: UndoBench 覆盖 8 个企业域的 36 条基础工作流与 36 个故障场景，用同种子反事实配对试验 (counterfactual paired trials) 解耦任务能力与恢复能力，并配 wire-level effect-history 与 environment-state 两类 oracle；冻结的 lost-acknowledgment 研究在 12 条 held-out TEST 工作流上交叉两个开源模型、两个框架、三种恢复范式，共 5,760 次执行（2,880 对配对试验），另扩展到商业 API 模型。
Result: 名义能力 83.54%，条件恢复成功率 (CRSR) 46.72%，naive retry 在 53.33% 的试验中产生重复外部副作用；商业 API 模型复现了能力-恢复分离。相位分析显示：mutation 前各方法表现相当且有能力的试验中无重复副作用；partial mutation 阶段 naive retry、per-call idempotency、zero-privilege journaling 在所评估的复合工作流上崩溃；commit 后 acknowledgment 前 verification 与服务端幂等显著提升安全性。
Conclusion: 只评名义完成度会掩盖智能体相位依赖的恢复漏洞，恢复能力必须与任务能力分开、按故障相位分别评测。

papers.title: Causal Lag Structure Discovery in Confounded Time Series via Orthogonalized Adaptive Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Finding which variables cause which others in multivariate time series, and at what lags, is central to science and policy, yet existing methods force a choice between flexible confounder adjustment, data-driven lag selection, and inference that controls the false discovery rate (FDR). ORACLE-VARX does all three in one pipeline. First, double/debiased machine learning (DML) removes nonlinear confounder effects from the outcomes and the lagged series. Second, adaptive causal lag estimation (ACLE) picks the lag order at each time step by sequential significance tests, tracking regime changes. Third, entry-wise $z$-tests with Benjamini--Hochberg correction select directed edges at a target FDR. We prove that in each rolling window, the debiased coefficients are asymptotically normal around a window-averaged target, so their $z$-tests are asymptotically valid. On a synthetic benchmark with time-varying structure and nonlinear confounding, ORACLE-VARX (LightGBM) tracks the true lag order best (RMSE $0.96$ vs $1.1$--$1.5$), has edge FDR $0.047$, close to PCMCI ($0.045$) and below VAR ($0.129$) and VAR-LiNGAM ($0.187$), and forecasts better than all three. On nine U.S. sector ETFs with macroeconomic confounders, it yields interpretable causal graphs whose lag order rises in high-volatility regimes.

Method: ORACLE-VARX 三段式：double/debiased machine learning (DML) 从结果与滞后序列中去除非线性混杂效应；adaptive causal lag estimation (ACLE) 在每个时步用序贯显著性检验选滞后阶数以跟踪机制变化；逐项 z 检验配合 Benjamini–Hochberg 校正在目标 FDR 下选有向边。作者证明每个滚动窗口内去偏系数关于窗口平均目标渐近正态，故 z 检验渐近有效。
Result: 在含时变结构与非线性混杂的合成基准上，ORACLE-VARX (LightGBM) 的滞后阶数 RMSE 0.96，优于 1.1–1.5 的对照区间；边 FDR 0.047，PCMCI 0.045、VAR 0.129、VAR-LiNGAM 0.187；预报表现优于这三个基线。在九只美国行业 ETF 加宏观经济混杂变量上给出可解释因果图，滞后阶数在高波动机制下上升。
Conclusion: 把去偏机器学习、自适应滞后估计与 FDR 校正的边选择放进同一流水线，可在时变非线性混杂下同时拿到有效推断与更好的滞后跟踪和预报；宏观数据上的滞后阶数随波动机制升高。

papers.title: DREAM: Dynamic Resolution Assignment For Multimodal Multi-agent Debate
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent debate (MAD) has emerged as an effective paradigm to improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and is increasingly being extended to multimodal settings. However, existing multimodal MAD frameworks typically expose agents to the same fixed visual input, ignoring substantial variation in the visual scale needed across samples and agents. In addition, these frameworks frequently suffer from groupthink, a phenomenon where agents prematurely abandon correct deductions to conform with confident but hallucinated peer responses. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce DREAM (Dynamic Resolution Assignment For Multimodal Multi-Agent Debate), which operates via two core components: (1) Dynamic Resolution Assignment, a zero-shot probe round where agents test multiple resolutions, quantify uncertainty using Average Normalized Log-Likelihood (ANLL), and use an adaptive threshold to assign each agent to its empirically optimal resolution; (2) Uncertainty-Guided Rollback Aggregation counters groupthink by tracking each agent's uncertainty over rounds and restoring early low-uncertainty answers overridden by group pressure. On six multimodal datasets, DREAM improves the accuracy-token trade-off over multi-agent debate baselines by 1.5-3.2% accuracy without dataset-specific tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DREAM 用零样本探测轮为每个 agent 单独分配最优视觉分辨率（以 Average Normalized Log-Likelihood 量化不确定性并按自适应阈值指派），再用不确定性引导的回滚聚合对抗群体思维。在六个多模态数据集上，相比多智能体辩论 (MAD) 基线以更少 token 换取 1.5–3.2% 的准确率提升，且无需数据集特定调参。
Motivation: 现有跨模态 MAD 框架让所有 agent 共享同一固定视觉输入，忽略样本与 agent 间视觉尺度差异；同时易出现 groupthink，即 agent 因从众压力过早放弃正确推断、追随自信但幻觉的同伴回答。
Method: 两个核心组件：(1) Dynamic Resolution Assignment——零样本探测轮让各 agent 试多档分辨率，用 Average Normalized Log-Likelihood (ANLL) 量化不确定性，再以自适应阈值把每个 agent 指派到其经验最优分辨率；(2) Uncertainty-Guided Rollback Aggregation——跨轮跟踪各 agent 不确定性，恢复被群体压力覆盖的早期低不确定性答案。
Result: 在六个多模态数据集上，DREAM 相对多智能体辩论基线提升准确率 1.5–3.2%，同时改善 accuracy-token 权衡，且无需数据集特定调参。
Conclusion: 按 agent 动态分配视觉分辨率并用不确定性回滚抑制群体思维，可在不逐数据集调参的前提下同时提高多模态辩论的准确率与 token 效率。

papers.title: SEA-LM: Egocentric Spatial Audio Understanding for Wearable Microphone Arrays
papers.abstract_en: Embodied, ego-centric intelligence fundamentally requires the ability to comprehend spatial audio within complex environments. While large audio-language models excel at mono-channel reasoning, they lack spatial awareness, discarding critical spatial cues that enable sound localization and that can improve the disentanglement of overlapping sound sources. To address this, we present SEA-LM, a Spatial Audio Understanding model. First, we introduce FOACODER, a layout-flexible spatial audio encoder trained on source localization and ego-centric voice activity detection objectives to encode First Order Ambisonics derived from variable-count, variable-position smart-glasses arrays via beamforming. We train a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to understand these spatial audio embeddings through a two-stage curriculum spanning six tasks, including sound localization and spatially selective transcription in settings with multiple speakers and overlapping sounds. To prevent the transcription outputs from dominating the next token prediction loss and overwhelming the direction predictions, we introduce a Spatio-temporal Weighted Cross-Entropy Loss. On our evaluation set, SEA-LM achieves lower azimuth and elevation MAE, higher temporal IoU, lower external-source hallucination and missing-source rates, and lower WER on most transcription tasks than compared baselines, while remaining robust across 1,211 smart-glasses array configurations with 4 to 9 microphones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SEA-LM 面向可穿戴麦克风阵列做第一人称空间音频理解：FOACODER 编码波束成形得到的 First Order Ambisonics，再用两阶段六任务课程训练 MLLM，并以 Spatio-temporal Weighted Cross-Entropy Loss 抑制转写损失压过方向预测。在评测集上相对基线取得更低的方位角与仰角 MAE、更高的时间 IoU、更低的外部声源幻觉与漏检率，多数转写任务 WER 更低，且在 1,211 种 4–9 麦克风智能眼镜阵列配置上保持稳健。
Motivation: 现有 audio-language model 只做单声道推理，丢掉声源定位与重叠声源解耦所需的空间线索，无法支撑具身第一人称智能在复杂环境中的空间听觉理解。
Method: 提出布局灵活的空间音频编码器 FOACODER，以声源定位和 ego-centric voice activity detection 为目标训练，输入由变数量、变位置智能眼镜阵列经波束成形导出的 First Order Ambisonics；随后训练 MLLM 理解该空间音频嵌入，采用覆盖六个任务的两阶段课程（含声源定位、多说话人与重叠声下的空间选择性转写），并引入 Spatio-temporal Weighted Cross-Entropy Loss 防止转写输出主导 next token prediction 而压过方向预测。
Result: 在评测集上，SEA-LM 相对所比较基线取得更低 azimuth 与 elevation MAE、更高 temporal IoU、更低 external-source hallucination 与 missing-source 率，多数转写任务 WER 更低；在 1,211 种智能眼镜阵列配置（4 到 9 个麦克风）上保持稳健。
Conclusion: 把空间线索显式编码进 audio-language model 并用时空调度损失平衡定位与转写目标，可在可穿戴麦克风阵列上同时改善空间定位、声源完整性与转写质量，且对阵列布局变化稳健。

papers.title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present Kandinsky 6.0 Video, a family of foundation diffusion models for synchronized text-to-audio-video generation, comprising Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters). Both models generate 5-second video clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio, including lip-sync, in text-to-audio-video (T2AV) and image-to-audio-video (I2AV) modes; a built-in super-resolution model raises the output resolution to Full-HD (1920$\times$1080). Building on the video generation capabilities of Kandinsky 5.0, Kandinsky 6.0 Video employs a dual-stream CrossDiT architecture that connects a pretrained video stream and a newly trained audio stream through bidirectional cross-attention for temporal and semantic alignment. Our continuous pretraining strategy first trains the audio stream from scratch on large-scale audio corpora and then trains both streams jointly on paired audio-video data while preserving unimodal fidelity; pretraining is followed by supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement-learning-based post-training, and distillation. In side-by-side human evaluation, Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro clearly outperforms its predecessor, Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro, and remains competitive with leading audio-video generation models, particularly in speech quality. To accelerate open research and deployment in multimedia generation, we release the code, model checkpoints, and diffusers integration under the MIT license.
papers.comment: Technical report on the open-source T2AV model. GitHub: https://github.com/kandinskylab/kandinsky-6
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Kandinsky 6.0 Video 是开源的文本/图像到音视频 (T2AV/I2AV) 扩散基础模型家族，含 3B 的 Lite 与 29B 的 Pro，用双流 CrossDiT 架构以双向 cross-attention 对齐预训练视频流与从零训练的音频流，生成 5 秒带 44 kHz 同步音频（含口型同步）的片段并经内置超分升到 1920×1080。在并排人工评测中 Pro 明显优于前代 Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro，语音质量上与领先音视频生成模型相当。
Motivation: 文本到音视频生成需要同时保证时间与语义上的音画同步（如口型对齐），而单纯扩展视频生成模型无法自动获得高质量音频分支。
Method: 双流 CrossDiT 架构：预训练视频流与新训音频流通过双向 cross-attention 连接；连续预训练策略先在大规模音频语料上从零训练音频流，再在成对音视频数据上联合训练两流并保持单模态保真，其后接监督微调、基于强化学习的后训练与蒸馏；另有内置超分模型输出 Full-HD。
Result: 模型家族含 Lite 3B 与 Pro 29B 两个规模，生成 5 秒片段、44 kHz 音频、分辨率 1920×1080；并排人工评测中 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro 明显优于 Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro，并与领先音视频生成模型保持竞争力，语音质量尤为突出。
Conclusion: 以双流交叉注意力加连续预训练（先音频后联合）的路线可产出在语音质量上具备竞争力的开源音视频生成基础模型，代码、权重与 diffusers 集成以 MIT 许可发布。

papers.title: EchoDino: A pediatric foundation model for transferable echocardiographic analysis across the lifespan
papers.abstract_en: Echocardiography is the most widely used cardiac imaging modality, yet interpretation demands integrating visual evidence across global anatomy, localized structures and dynamic cardiac motion. Machine-learning models have automated individual tasks, but they are typically built for a single purpose and depend on expensively labeled datasets - a barrier particularly acute in pediatric care, where data are scarce and anatomy changes with age. Here we present EchoDino, a self-supervised foundation model for echocardiography, created by adapting the DINOv3 framework to 3.7 million frames from 1.7 million unlabeled pediatric echocardiography videos. With its encoder frozen, EchoDino produces representations that capture global context, local anatomy, and dense spatial detail. We introduce Motion-biased Entropy Maximization Sampling (MEMS) to select the most informative frames for video-level analysis. Across nine pediatric and adult datasets, EchoDino outperformed strong baseline models, raising view-classification accuracy from 0.609 to 0.889 and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve for structural-heart-disease detection from 0.811 to 0.872, while also cutting age-estimation error from 3.857 to 1.389 years, achieving the best segmentation accuracy and lowering ejection-fraction errors. By generalizing from label-free pediatric data to adult echocardiography, EchoDino offers a versatile foundation for cardiac image analysis across the lifespan.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EchoDino 把 DINOv3 自监督框架迁移到 170 万段未标注儿科超声心动图视频（370 万帧）上做基础模型，冻结编码器即可输出兼顾全局语境、局部解剖与稠密空间细节的表征，并提出 Motion-biased Entropy Maximization Sampling (MEMS) 挑选信息量最大的帧做视频级分析。在 9 个儿科与成人数据集上，切面分类准确率从 0.609 升到 0.889，结构性心脏病检测 AUC 从 0.811 升到 0.872，年龄估计误差从 3.857 年降到 1.389 年，分割精度最佳并降低射血分数误差。
Motivation: 超声心动图判读要同时整合全局解剖、局部结构与动态心肌运动，现有 ML 模型多为单一任务、依赖昂贵标注；儿科数据稀缺且解剖随年龄变化，标注壁垒尤其严重。
Method: 将 DINOv3 框架适配到 170 万段未标注儿科超声心动图视频共 370 万帧上自监督预训练，得到 EchoDino；推理时冻结编码器，用其表征做切面分类、结构性心脏病检测、年龄估计、分割与射血分数估计；另提出 MEMS 帧选择机制为视频级分析挑信息量最大的帧。
Result: 在 9 个儿科与成人数据集上：切面分类准确率 0.609 → 0.889；结构性心脏病检测 AUROC 0.811 → 0.872；年龄估计误差 3.857 → 1.389 年；分割精度取得最佳，射血分数误差下降。

papers.title: Your Unlearning Gives You Away: Identifying Erased Concepts in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Existing attacks on unlearned diffusion models assume that the erased concepts are known in advance and focus on recovering them. In practice, however, model providers may not disclose which concepts have been removed, and even with access to the original base model, an adversary may still lack a clear target to attack. In this paper, we aim to answer the following critical but overlooked questions: which concepts have been erased from the model, and how many have been erased in total? To this end, we present Tracer, a framework that rapidly and accurately identifies erased concepts and estimates their number. Tracer efficiently identifies erased concepts without generating and classifying images. By combining lightweight spectral analysis of weight footprints, it enables efficient search over large candidate vocabularies. To distinguish multiple erased concepts, we introduce a footprint coverage objective that guides sequential discovery. Tracer estimates the number of erased concepts by detecting a sharp decline in candidate confidence as the selected concepts account for the erasure footprint, without requiring labeled examples for calibration. The framework requires only lightweight linear algebra and limited forward probes, with no prior knowledge of the unlearning algorithm. Experiments across text-to-image and text-to-video backbones and diverse unlearning methods demonstrate that Tracer identifies erased concepts and estimates their number in seconds, achieving 150 to 137,000 times and 133 to 20,000 times speedups over MIA and brute-force search on image and video models, respectively, with substantially higher identification accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Tracer 框架在被遗忘 (unlearning) 的扩散模型上直接识别被擦除的概念并估计其总数，无需生成图像或已知遗忘算法：用权重足迹的轻量谱分析在大候选词表上搜索，配合 footprint coverage 目标做序贯发现，再靠候选置信度的骤降判定概念数量。在文本到图像与文本到视频骨干上，识别只需数秒，相对 MIA 与暴力搜索分别取得 150–137,000 倍与 133–20,000 倍加速，且识别准确率显著更高。
Motivation: 现有针对未学习扩散模型的攻击都假设被擦除概念已知并聚焦恢复它们；现实中提供方不会披露删了什么，攻击者即使拿到原始基座模型也无明确目标可攻。
Method: Tracer 结合权重足迹的轻量谱分析在大规模候选词表上高效搜索，用 footprint coverage 目标引导序贯区分多个被擦除概念；当已选概念覆盖擦除足迹时检测候选置信度骤降来估计概念总数，全程只需轻量线性代数与有限次前向探针，无需标注样本校准，也不依赖遗忘算法的先验知识。
Result: 在文本到图像与文本到视频骨干及多种遗忘方法上，Tracer 以秒级识别被擦除概念并估计其数量：相对 MIA 在图像与视频模型上分别加速 150 至 137,000 倍与 133 至 20,000 倍，相对暴力搜索同样取得这些量级的加速，识别准确率也显著更高。
Conclusion: 被遗忘概念会在模型权重中留下可探测的足迹，因此无需生成图像或已知遗忘算法即可反推出删了哪些概念以及删了多少个。

papers.title: An LLM-in-the-loop RL Framework for Bioinformatics Feature Selection
papers.abstract_en: High-dimensional bioinformatics data, characterized by a large number of features relative to the number of samples, pose major challenges such as the ``curse of dimensionality,'' leading to overfitting, high computational cost, and poor generalization. Traditional feature selection methods often suffer from limited scalability and adaptability in such domains. We propose an LLM-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (RL) framework for bioinformatics feature selection, where the RL agent formulates feature selection as a sequential decision-making task, while the large language model (LLM) enhances the process in two ways: (1) guiding exploration through domain-informed advice, and (2) providing hybrid rewards that integrate data-driven performance with knowledge-driven evaluation. The LLM also produces explanations to improve interpretability for human experts without altering the RL policy update. Experiments on diverse bioinformatics datasets show that the LLM-in-the-loop framework outperforms baselines, achieves stable performance across downstream models, and converges faster than pure RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LLM-in-the-loop 强化学习框架做生物信息学特征选择：RL 智能体把选特征当作序贯决策，LLM 通过领域建议引导探索并给出融合数据驱动性能与知识驱动评价的混合奖励，同时生成解释供人类专家理解而不改动策略更新。在多个生物信息学数据集上，该框架优于基线、跨下游模型表现稳定，且比纯 RL 收敛更快。
Motivation: 高维生物信息数据样本少、特征多，带来维数灾难、过拟合、计算开销大与泛化差；传统特征选择方法在可扩展性与适应性上受限。
Method: 把特征选择建模为序贯决策任务，由 RL 智能体执行；LLM 提供两路增强：领域知识建议引导探索，以及整合数据驱动性能与知识驱动评价的混合奖励；LLM 另外输出解释以提升可解释性，且不改变 RL 策略更新过程。
Result: 在多个多样的生物信息学数据集上，LLM-in-the-loop 框架优于基线，在不同下游模型上保持稳定性能，并比纯 RL 收敛更快。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 的领域知识以建议和混合奖励的形式接入 RL，可在生物信息学特征选择中同时提升效果、跨模型稳定性与收敛速度，且解释不干扰策略学习。

papers.title: Gaussian Limits for SGD Without Stationary Moments
papers.abstract_en: Temporal dependence can separate the Gaussian approximation of stochastic gradient descent from its stationary moments. For unmodified least-squares SGD, we construct a design with standard Gaussian marginals whose stationary error has every positive moment infinite. Independent observations with the same marginals instead give finite stationary variance. Both regimes retain a Gaussian small-step limit. Our general theory establishes pathwise contraction from a finite second design moment, then uses score cancellation and localization to obtain stationary Gaussian and Ornstein--Uhlenbeck limits. Independent Gaussian regression errors yield an exact conditional Gaussian law and total-variation convergence under the same design integrability. Stronger design conditions identify a positive first-order total-variation constant and a deterministic covariance correction with $o(a)$ error. A scalar coverage expansion translates this correction into its inference consequence. Experiments examine distributional error, coverage, and calibration with dependent scores. Together, these results establish precise probability-law approximation beyond moment-based stationary analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明 SGD 的时间相关性会把高斯近似与平稳矩彻底分离：构造边缘分布为标准高斯、但平稳误差所有正阶矩都无穷的设计，独立同边缘观测下平稳方差却有限，而两种情形都保有小步长高斯极限。更强的设计条件下可识别出正的一阶全变差常数与 o(a) 阶确定性协方差修正，并通过标量覆盖展开给出推断后果。
Motivation: 基于矩的平稳分析无法刻画 SGD 的概率律近似：时间相关性可使平稳矩发散，而高斯小步长极限依然成立，需要超越矩条件的理论。
Method: 先建立有限二阶设计矩下的逐路径收缩 (pathwise contraction)，再用 score cancellation 与 localization 得到平稳高斯与 Ornstein--Uhlenbeck 极限；独立高斯回归误差情形给出精确条件高斯律与全变差 (total-variation) 收敛；更强设计条件导出正的一阶 TV 常数与 o(a) 协方差修正，经标量覆盖展开转成推断结论，并用依赖 score 的实验检验分布误差、覆盖与校准。
Result: 构造出边缘为标准高斯、平稳误差所有正阶矩无穷的最小二乘 SGD 设计，而同边缘的独立观测平稳方差有限，两者都保留高斯小步长极限；独立高斯回归误差在同等设计可积性下有精确条件高斯律与 TV 收敛；更强条件下 TV 一阶常数为正、协方差修正误差为 o(a)；实验考察依赖 score 下的分布误差、覆盖率与校准。
Conclusion: SGD 的概率律近似可以脱离矩条件成立：小步长高斯极限对时间相关性稳健，但平稳矩可能完全失效，推断修正需由 TV 收敛而非矩展开来支撑。

papers.title: When the Cross-Silo Federation Goes Offline: Continual Learning for Site Onboarding with Limited Unlabeled Data
papers.abstract_en: An organization often holds too little labeled data to train a model that generalizes, and the records that would supply the rest sit with organizations that cannot release them. Cross-silo federated learning offers a way through, since participants exchange model parameters rather than records, but it ordinarily settles two aspects of the arrangement in advance, the participating sites and the classes the model can predict, and deployment can breach both. A new site joins after training, once the established sites have finished their engagement and gone offline, and its records arrive unlabeled, mixing conditions the model already recognizes with conditions no participant has observed. We present an autonomous three-stage procedure that expands the model entirely at the joining site: reconstruction experts screen for novelty, clustering separates the flagged records into candidate conditions, and class means describe the old classes, all inside one shared representation. Those classes were learned from records that never leave their owners, so the usual defenses against forgetting are unavailable, and the procedure supplies the evidence they would have carried from either of two dissimilar sources, prototypes held by the federation or records held by the joining site. On a real industrial condition-monitoring dataset, run end to end with no label consulted, either source holds old-class accuracy at 0.868 or above with forgetting at most 0.063, and the two differ by 0.021, so a configuration can be chosen by the disclosure it permits rather than the accuracy it delivers. Both keep old- and new-class accuracy in balance where every alternative we measure gives up one for the other, and both retain more of the old classes than distillation- and regularization-based baselines. The balance still holds with only 6 labeled records per arriving condition and 3 retained per old class.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Continual Learning for Enterprise AI Agents (CLEA) workshop at NeurIPS 2026. 9 pages, 1 figure, plus appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 跨孤岛联邦学习在训练后才来新站点、且新数据无标签时，提出三阶段自主扩类流程：重建专家筛新颖性、聚类划分候选条件、类均值描述旧类，全部在共享表示内于新站点完成。在真实工业状态监测数据集上端到端无标签运行，联邦原型或新站点记录两种证据来源都把旧类准确率保持在 0.868 以上、遗忘不超过 0.063，两者仅差 0.021，因此可按允许的数据披露而非准确率来选配置。
Motivation: 联邦学习通常事先固定参与站点与可预测类别，但部署中新站点在原站点下线后才加入，且其记录无标签、混合已知与未知条件；旧类数据留在原属方不外流，常规防遗忘手段（如蒸馏所需的历史信息）不可用。
Method: 三阶段自主流程在新站点本地扩类：重建专家 (reconstruction experts) 筛出新颖记录，聚类把被标记记录分成候选条件，类均值 (class means) 描述旧类，全部在单一共享表示中进行；防遗忘证据取自两个不相似来源之一——联邦持有的原型 (prototypes) 或新站点持有的记录，全程不使用标签。
Result: 在真实工业状态监测数据集上端到端无标签运行：任一来源都使旧类准确率 ≥0.868、遗忘 ≤0.063，两来源准确率仅差 0.021；两者在旧类与新类准确率上保持平衡，而所测全部替代方案都牺牲其一；两者对旧类的保留均优于基于蒸馏与正则化的基线；每到站条件仅 6 条有标签记录、每旧类仅保留 3 条时平衡仍成立。
Conclusion: 在原站点下线、新数据无标签的跨孤岛场景中，联邦原型与新站点记录可作为可互换的防遗忘证据，配置选择由允许的数据披露而非准确率决定。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 三阶段自主流程在新站点本地扩类：重建专家 (reconstruction experts) 筛出新颖记录，聚类把被标记记录分成候选条件，类均值 (class means) 描述旧类，全部在单一共享表示中进行；防遗忘证据取自两个不相似来源之一——联邦持有的原型 (prototypes) 或新站点持有的记录，全程不使用标签。
summary_sections.result: 在真实工业状态监测数据集上端到端无标签运行：任一来源都使旧类准确率 ≥0.868、遗忘 ≤0.063，两来源准确率仅差 0.021；两者在旧类与新类准确率上保持平衡，而所测全部替代方案都牺牲其一；两者对旧类的保留均优于基于蒸馏与正则化的基线；每到站条件仅 6 条有标签记录、每旧类仅保留 3 条时平衡仍成立。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在原站点下线、新数据无标签的跨孤岛场景中，联邦原型与新站点记录可作为可互换的防遗忘证据，配置选择由允许的数据披露而非准确率决定。

papers.title: Moment-Accurate Gaussian Mixtures for Constant-Step Stochastic Approximation
papers.abstract_en: Local Gaussian models of constant-step learning predict output variability and expected losses, but weak convergence alone does not justify these moment predictions. We establish moment-accurate Gaussian mixtures by matching stationary energy with local Ornstein--Uhlenbeck limits, ruling out quadratic tail mass invisible to weak convergence. For step size $a$, the second-order Wasserstein error is $o(\sqrt a)$, uniformly over invariant laws, using each law's actual root weights. The assumptions combine confinement, descent, finitely many hyperbolic equilibria and root continuity with finite-variance innovations. The result yields observable covariances, expected objective gaps and first-order mean shifts, while allowing singular covariances, compatible saddles and weights without a limit. For additive noise given by a fixed invertible transform of independent standardized Student $t_3$ coordinates, symmetry gives an order-sharp $\sqrt a$ smooth-test bound. Numerical transport calculations demonstrate the value of root-specific covariances; controlled SGD studies assess observable predictions across step sizes, batch sizes and model geometries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把常数步长随机逼近 (constant-step stochastic approximation) 的局部高斯近似升级为矩准确的 Gaussian mixture：将平稳能量与局部 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 极限匹配，排除弱收敛看不见的二次尾部质量。对步长 a，二阶 Wasserstein 误差在不变分布上一致为 o(√a)，并给出可观测量的协方差、期望目标间隙与一阶均值偏移。
Motivation: 常数步长学习的局部 Gaussian 模型用来预测输出波动与期望损失，但仅有弱收敛并不保证这些矩预测成立，二次尾部质量可能被弱收敛掩盖。
Method: 以平稳能量匹配局部 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 极限构造矩准确 Gaussian mixture，每个不变分布用其真实根权重；假设组合为 confinement、descent、有限个双曲平衡点、根连续性与有限方差 innovations。对固定可逆变换独立标准化 Student t3 坐标给出的加性噪声，利用对称性得到阶紧的 √a 光滑检验函数界；数值输运计算与受控 SGD 实验检验可观测预测。
Result: 步长 a 下二阶 Wasserstein 误差为 o(√a)，在不变分布上一致成立；Student t3 加性噪声情形得到阶紧的 √a 光滑检验函数界。方法允许奇异协方差、相容鞍点与无极限的权重。数值输运计算展示根特定协方差的价值，受控 SGD 研究在不同步长、批量大小与模型几何上评估可观测预测。
Conclusion: 弱收敛不足以支撑常数步长随机逼近的矩预测，需以平稳能量匹配 OU 极限得到矩准确的 Gaussian mixture；该框架在允许奇异协方差与鞍点的同时给出可检验的可观测量预测。

papers.title: ColdDDI: Evaluating Knowledge Utilization in Cold-Start Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Cold-start drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction tests whether models can identify clinically significant interactions for drugs without training-time interaction history. Existing benchmarks mostly report aggregate edge-prediction scores, leaving a key evaluation question unanswered: when models receive molecular, textual, or knowledge-graph (KG) evidence, do they actually use the evidence that pharmacologically supports the interaction? We introduce ColdDDI, a reconstructible diagnostic benchmark built from DrugBank 5.1.13, with 1,900 approved small-molecule drugs and 565,731 positive DDI pairs. ColdDDI evaluates pairs with zero, one, or two unseen drugs. It also annotates each interaction by whether it changes drug exposure or drug effect, and by whether the biomedical knowledge graph contains shared enzymes, transporters, or targets that can plausibly mediate the interaction. These annotations separate evidence availability from predictive dependence. We evaluate eight conventional DDI methods and 13 LLMs; for open-weight LLMs, we test five prompt patterns and use masking, drug replacement, and channel-sensitivity metrics to probe knowledge utilization. ColdDDI exposes that, in the hardest split where both drugs are unseen, the main performance divide is mediator availability. A fine-tuned 1B LLM recovers 89-93% of interactions with a shared enzyme, transporter, or target, but only 40-62% without such a mediator. More importantly, KG-provided evidence is not always used; several KG-augmented baselines change little when the shared mediator is masked or disrupted, whereas fine-tuned LLMs respond strongly to this intervention. Thus, ColdDDI evaluates knowledge utilization rather than knowledge access alone, showing where cold-start DDI models rely on mechanistic evidence and where they fail despite receiving it. Code is available at https://github.com/0217ljh/ColdDDI-NeurIPS2026.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ColdDDI 是冷启动药物-药物相互作用 (DDI) 诊断基准，用 DrugBank 5.1.13 构建 1,900 个已批准小分子药物与 565,731 对阳性 DDI，并按是否共享酶/转运体/靶点标注中介证据，把“证据是否存在”与“模型是否真用”分开。在双药均未见过的最难划分下，微调的 1B LLM 对有共享中介的相互作用恢复 89–93%，无中介时仅 40–62%；且若干 KG 增强基线在遮蔽共享中介后几乎不变，而微调 LLM 反应强烈。
Motivation: 现有 DDI 基准只报聚合的边预测分数，无法回答模型拿到分子、文本或知识图谱证据后，是否真的使用了药理上支撑该相互作用的证据，冷启动场景下这一评估空白尤为关键。
Method: 从 DrugBank 5.1.13 构建可复现的 ColdDDI 基准，覆盖零/一/两个未见药物的配对，并为每条相互作用标注是否改变药物暴露或药效、以及 KG 中是否存在共享酶、转运体或靶点作为可能中介。评测八个传统 DDI 方法与 13 个 LLM；对开源 LLM 测试五种 prompt 模式，并用 masking、drug replacement 与 channel-sensitivity 指标探测知识利用。
Result: 在双药均未见的最难划分上，主要性能分野来自中介是否可用：微调的 1B LLM 对有共享酶/转运体/靶点的相互作用恢复 89–93%，无此类中介时仅 40–62%。多个 KG 增强基线在共享中介被遮蔽或扰动时表现几乎不变，而微调 LLM 对该干预反应强烈。
Conclusion: 冷启动 DDI 的瓶颈是机制性中介证据的可用性，且知识获取不等于知识利用：KG 增强模型常拿到证据却不用，微调 LLM 才表现出对机制证据的依赖。
Relevance: 0
