papers.title: Generating the Wild: Individual-Consistent Image-to-Video Generation for Wildlife
papers.abstract_en: Individual-level wildlife identification often suffers from data scarcity, as varying observations of the same animal under diverse poses, viewpoints, and motions are rarely available. Image-to-video (I2V) generation offers a promising way to mitigate this limitation by synthesizing additional observations from a single reference image. However, existing I2V models mainly emphasize global layout, semantics, and motion, and therefore often fail to preserve fine-grained local appearance cues that distinguish one wildlife individual from another, such as fur texture, stripe boundaries, spot configurations, and contour transitions. We observe that these identity-critical cues are closely related to high-frequency information. To address this challenge, we propose WildIcon, a high-frequency-guided I2V framework for wildlife individual consistency. Specifically, WildIcon introduces a frequency-aware identity encoding branch that extracts individual-specific high-frequency cues from the reference image. Combined with isolated foreground information, the resulting identity tokens are then injected into cross-attention blocks as identity conditioning. Building on a frozen backbone with lightweight identity adaptation, WildIcon preserves fine-grained identity cues visible in the reference image while retaining the motion controllability and semantic fidelity of the base I2V model. In addition, to support the training and evaluation of wildlife individual-consistent I2V, we construct WildlifeVid, a wildlife-centric video dataset with high-quality, temporally coherent clips and individual-level identity labels. Experiments on I2V generation and downstream animal re-identification (ReID) show that WildIcon achieves stronger individual consistency than existing baselines, and that its filtered outputs can serve as useful candidate training augmentations for downstream ReID.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WildIcon 是面向野生动物个体一致性的图生视频 (I2V) 框架：用频率感知身份编码分支从参考图提取毛皮纹理、条纹边界等高频个体线索，与分离的前景信息合成身份 token 注入 cross-attention 作条件，在冻结主干上做轻量身份适配。实验显示其个体一致性强于现有 I2V 基线，过滤后的输出可作为下游动物重识别 (ReID) 的候选训练增广数据。
Motivation: 野生动物个体级识别受数据稀缺制约，同一动物在不同姿态、视角、运动下的观测难以获得；现有 I2V 模型只关注全局布局、语义与运动，保不住区分个体的细粒度局部外观线索。
Method: WildIcon 由频率感知身份编码分支（提取参考图的高频个体线索）、前景分离后的身份 token、以及注入 cross-attention 的身份条件构成；在冻结的 I2V 主干上做轻量身份适配，同时构建带个体级身份标签的 WildlifeVid 视频数据集用于训练与评测。
Result: 在 I2V 生成与下游动物 ReID 实验上，WildIcon 的个体一致性强于现有基线；其过滤输出被验证可作为下游 ReID 的候选训练增广。
Conclusion: 把高频身份线索作为条件注入冻结 I2V 主干，能在保留运动可控性与语义保真的同时维持个体一致性，并为 ReID 提供可用的合成增广数据。

papers.title: AgentDoxx: Agentic Re-identification of Anonymized Text with Web Search
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) gain tool use capabilities such as web search, they can retrieve and cross-reference public information, creating privacy risks beyond memorization. One manifestation is re-identification: linking an anonymized interview transcript to a named individual. Yet without ground-truth identities, the coverage of such attacks and the protection offered by a defense cannot be reliably measured. We introduce AgentDOXX, an evaluation suite of 822 synthetic interview transcripts grounded in public information about real individuals with known identities. We evaluate fifteen configurations of open-weight and proprietary models, isolating the effect of web search, and analyze their search trajectories to distinguish retrieval-driven from parametric identifications. Ground-truth identities reveal that re-identification risk is distributed across an agent's execution: retrieval and parametric recall both contribute, with open-weight models identifying 15-28% of transcripts without search; identification succeeds in over 88% of cases once the target appears in a retrieved result; entity masking leaves at least one attacker successful on 85.3% of a stratified sample; and privacy instructions suppress naming but not retrieval, with configurations scoring 0% accuracy yet retrieving the subject in up to 62% of transcripts. We further show that observed attack trajectories can provide supervision for localizing identifying spans, offering a path toward attack-informed anonymization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentDOXX 用 822 条基于真实人物公开信息构造的合成访谈文本，评测 LLM 加网页搜索后的再识别 (re-identification) 能力。开源模型无搜索即可识别 15–28% 的文本，目标出现在检索结果中时识别成功率超过 88%；实体遮蔽后分层样本中仍有至少一个攻击者成功 85.3%，隐私指令可把命名准确率压到 0% 但检索到当事人的比例仍高达 62%。
Motivation: LLM 具备网页搜索后能交叉比对公开信息，把匿名文本重新关联到真实个人，但缺少 ground-truth 身份时无法可靠度量这类攻击的覆盖面与防御效果。
Method: 构建 AgentDOXX 评测集：822 条合成访谈文本，锚定已知身份的真实人物公开信息；评测 15 种开源与闭源模型配置以隔离网页搜索的作用，并分析搜索轨迹区分检索驱动与参数化 (parametric) 识别；另用攻击轨迹作为监督信号定位可识别片段。
Result: 开源模型无搜索即识别 15–28% 的文本；目标出现在检索结果中时识别成功率超过 88%；实体遮蔽在分层样本上仍留有至少一个成功攻击者的比例为 85.3%；隐私指令下部分配置命名准确率为 0%，但最多 62% 的文本仍被检索到当事人。
Conclusion: 再识别风险分布在智能体执行全过程中，检索与参数化记忆都在贡献，因此只压命名不压检索的匿名化与实体遮蔽都不足以挡住攻击，应转向由攻击轨迹监督的片段级匿名化。

summary_sections.conclusion: 再识别风险分布在智能体执行全过程中，检索与参数化记忆都在贡献，因此只压命名不压检索的匿名化与实体遮蔽都不足以挡住攻击，应转向由攻击轨迹监督的片段级匿名化。

papers.title: Expanding LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Extra inference compute is usually spent on sampling more reasoning chains. We study where inside an existing chain an additional continuation should begin. We define expansion utility, the change in correctness from restarting a chain at a stored step, and measure it at every eligible step for nine models on six benchmarks (41 model and benchmark cells). Restart position matters: steps selected on one set of continuations beat uniform placement when scored on disjoint ones, in held-out audits on 5, 16, and 38 cells (+4.25 points [+2.51, +6.63] in a fresh five-cell audit). A fixed rule that restarts from the last eligible steps, always-last, is a strong baseline: our learned router beats uniform placement but shows no detected gain over it, and on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B/MATH-500 always-last exceeds the exact self-consistency frontier at matched aggregate generated output by +0.052 [+0.008, +0.098], using 0.774x the aggregate generated output of four-sample self-consistency. Cross-fitted oracle selection still finds held-out headroom beyond declared positional classes, a target for future selectors. Finally, breaking step-label ties by earliest index flips the sign of a pointwise selector's gain over uniform placement in every seed of a five-seed diagnostic with four rollouts per step; randomized ties remove the bias.

papers.journal_ref: NeurIPS Main Conference 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 expansion utility：在已有推理链的某个已存步骤处重启续写，衡量该重启对最终正确率的改变，并在 9 个模型、6 个 benchmark（41 个模型×benchmark 单元）上逐步测量。重启位置确实重要：在不相交续写集上选出的步骤优于均匀放置，held-out 审计在 5、16、38 个单元上分别 +4.25 点 [+2.51, +6.63]（新五单元审计）；但学到的 router 相对固定 always-last 规则没有检测到增益，而 always-last 在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B/MATH-500 上以 0.774 倍四样本 self-consistency 的总生成输出量超出其精确前沿 +0.052 [+0.008, +0.098]。
Motivation: 额外推理算力通常被用来采样更多推理链，但链内从哪一步开始续写这一决策没有被系统研究，也缺少可度量的目标量。
Method: 定义 expansion utility（在存储步骤处重启链所引起的正确率变化），对每个合格步骤逐一测量；用跨续写集选择的步骤位置训练 router，并与 uniform placement、always-last 固定规则、self-consistency 前沿以及 cross-fitted oracle 选择对比；另做五 seed、每步四 rollout 的 tie-breaking 诊断。
Result: 在不相交续写集上选出的步骤位置优于均匀放置：held-out 审计覆盖 5、16、38 个单元，提升 +4.25 点 [+2.51, +6.63]，新五单元审计同样 +4.25 点 [+2.51, +6.63]。学到的 router 胜过 uniform placement 但相对 always-last 无检测到的增益；在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B/MATH-500 上 always-last 超出精确 self-consistency 前沿 +0.052 [+0.008, +0.098]，总生成输出量为四样本 self-consistency 的 0.774 倍。cross-fitted oracle 在已声明位置类别之外仍找到 held-out 余量；按最早索引打破步骤标签平局会在五 seed 诊断（每步四 rollout）的每个 seed 上翻转点选择器相对 uniform 的增益符号，随机化平局可去除该偏差。

papers.title: Rethinking Streaming-Perception Evaluation on Heterogeneous Edge Platforms
papers.abstract_en: Multi-camera streaming perception is increasingly deployed on heterogeneous edge platforms shared with co-resident workloads, yet accelerator placement is often evaluated using isolated single-stream experiments and mean streaming average precision (sAP). Using two end-to-end pipelines on a single GPU--NPU platform, we show that isolated evaluation can mis-rank deployment-time placement. Although the GPU pipeline is preferred in isolation, GPU-localized contention introduces deadline misses that make detections stale and can reverse the preferred placement before full GPU saturation. The NPU pipeline is less accurate than the GPU pipeline on small and medium objects in isolation, but nearly matches it on large objects. The largest absolute sAP losses in our latency and contention experiments occur for large objects. In our four-stream experiments, the preferred placement depends on which path becomes stale, and increasing GPU-side contention shifts the best placement from All-GPU to All-NPU. Under a GPU-saturating vision--language co-tenant, All-NPU achieves $5.2\times$ the worst-stream sAP of All-GPU. Because mean sAP can hide severe single-stream degradation, evaluation should report contention sweeps, deadline-miss rates on both paths, and worst-stream sAP alongside mean sAP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 GPU–NPU 异构边缘平台上，用两个端到端多摄像头流式感知流水线证明：隔离单流实验加平均 sAP 会排错部署时的加速器放置——GPU 流水线在隔离下更优，但 GPU 本地争用造成截止期错过使检测变陈旧，可在 GPU 饱和前就反转首选放置；GPU 饱和型视觉–语言共驻负载下 All-NPU 的最差流 sAP 达到 All-GPU 的 5.2 倍。作者主张评测必须同时报告争用扫描、两条路径的截止期错过率与最差流 sAP。
Motivation: 多摄像头流式感知部署在与其它负载共驻的异构边缘平台上，但加速器放置通常只用隔离单流实验和平均 sAP 评估，会掩盖单流严重退化并给出错误的放置排序。
Method: 在单块 GPU–NPU 平台上跑两个端到端多摄像头流式感知流水线，对比隔离评测与含延迟、争用、四流及 GPU 饱和视觉–语言共驻负载的部署时评测，考察 GPU 与 NPU 两种放置及 All-GPU / All-NPU。
Result: 隔离下 GPU 流水线更受偏好，但 GPU 本地争用在 GPU 完全饱和前即可造成截止期错过并反转首选放置；NPU 流水线在隔离下对中小目标精度较低、对大目标几乎持平，而延迟与争用实验中最大的绝对 sAP 损失出现在大目标上；四流实验中首选放置取决于哪条路径变陈旧，GPU 侧争用增加使最佳放置从 All-GPU 移向 All-NPU；GPU 饱和型视觉–语言共驻下 All-NPU 的最差流 sAP 为 All-GPU 的 5.2 倍。
Conclusion: 平均 sAP 会掩盖单流严重退化，流式感知的放置评测应报告争用扫描、两条路径的截止期错过率以及最差流 sAP，而不只看平均 sAP。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: What Does an Observability Foundation Model Know?
papers.abstract_en: A linear probe can show that a label is recoverable from a model's hidden states, but not whether that goes beyond what the input already reveals, or whether the model uses it. We audit Toto, an observability forecasting foundation model, on the Benchmark of Observability Metrics (BOOM) across five series-disjoint resplits, comparing linear probes on its frozen residual stream with models that read the raw input window and with Toto's architecture stripped of its trained configuration. Short-vs-medium cadence and metric type are more linearly recoverable from Toto's residuals than from the strongest raw-window model in every resplit (macro-F1 0.766 vs. 0.633 and 0.545 vs. 0.498). Domain is nearly tied, and series cardinality is recovered far better from the raw window. MOMENT-base shows related cadence, metric-type, and domain readouts. Recoverability is not use: exchanging Toto's residuals with those of high-burst donors moves a future-burstiness readout as intended but does not make forecasts consistently burstier than a randomized donor. A BOOM-trained coordination probe has negative zero-shot R^2 on the tested external benchmarks. We report each label against its strongest baseline.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS Main Conference '26. 25 pages
papers.journal_ref: NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对可观测性基础模型 Toto 做线性探针审计，发现部分标签（cadence、metric type）在冻结残差流中比最强原始窗口模型更可线性恢复，但恢复性不等于使用：交换残差并不能稳定改变预测的 burstiness，且 BOOM 训练的 coordination 探针在外部基准上 zero-shot R² 为负。
Motivation: 线性探针只能说明标签可从隐状态恢复，无法区分这是否超出输入本身已揭示的信息，也无法说明模型是否真的使用该信息；需要在 series-disjoint 重划分下把探针与原始输入基线、架构消融对照。
Method: 在 Benchmark of Observability Metrics (BOOM) 的五个 series-disjoint resplit 上审计 Toto：对冻结残差流做线性探针，与读取原始输入窗口的模型以及去掉训练配置的 Toto 架构对比；再用高 burst 供体的残差替换 Toto 残差做因果干预，并训练 coordination 探针做 zero-shot 外部基准测试。
Result: 五个 resplit 中，short-vs-medium cadence 与 metric type 从 Toto 残差的 macro-F1 分别为 0.766 与 0.545，最强原始窗口模型为 0.633 与 0.498；domain 接近打平，series cardinality 则从原始窗口恢复得好得多。MOMENT-base 在 cadence、metric-type、domain 上也显示相关读出。残差交换使 future-burstiness 读出按预期移动，但预测并未比随机供体一致地更 burst；BOOM 训练的 coordination 探针在所测外部基准上 zero-shot R² 为负。
Conclusion: 线性可恢复性既可能超出输入基线也可能不等于模型实际使用，因此探针结论必须与原始输入基线和干预实验一起报告；跨基准的探针泛化在此为负。

papers.title: SteadySplats: Resampling of Low-Variance Gaussians for High-Fidelity Stochastic Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic order-independent transparency enables efficient and elegant rendering of primitive-based radiance fields like 3D Gaussian Splatting models, but remains impractical due to the inherent visible noise in the output. We propose a principled approach to minimize high-frequency noise, addressing its sources at the representation and image synthesis level. During stochastic rendering, our history-based spatial resampling scheme drastically accelerates image convergence, while temporal importance resampling ensures coherence under camera movement. During training, a color regularizer implicitly reduces the variance along view rays in the 3DGS models. With these properties, our optimized, Vulkan-based renderer effectively mitigates output noise at low and high sample counts, achieving a substantial 13~dB PSNR increase in quality over previous stochastic methods at 1 sample per pixel and quickly converging to sorted 3DGS with an average L1 error of less than $10^{-4}$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对随机序无关透明度渲染 (stochastic order-independent transparency) 在 3D Gaussian Splatting 中的可见噪声，提出 SteadySplats：渲染阶段用基于历史的空间重采样加速收敛、用时间重要性重采样保持相机运动下的连贯性，训练阶段用颜色正则器隐式降低沿视线方向的方差。在 1 spp 下 PSNR 比既有随机方法提升 13 dB，并快速收敛到排序式 3DGS，平均 L1 误差低于 10^-4。
Motivation: 基于图元的辐射场（如 3DGS）用随机序无关透明度渲染可以高效处理透明度，但输出存在固有的可见噪声，使其难以实用。
Method: 三管齐下处理高频噪声的来源：表示层面在训练时加入颜色正则器，隐式降低 3DGS 模型沿视线方向的方差；图像合成层面用基于历史的空间重采样 (history-based spatial resampling) 加速图像收敛，并用时间重要性重采样 (temporal importance resampling) 保证相机移动时的时序连贯；实现为一个优化的 Vulkan 渲染器。
Result: 在 1 sample per pixel 下 PSNR 相比既有随机方法提升 13 dB；在低采样数与高采样数下都能有效抑制输出噪声，并快速收敛到 sorted 3DGS，平均 L1 误差小于 10^-4。
Conclusion: 把噪声在表示层（训练正则）与合成层（重采样）同时处理，随机透明度渲染可以兼顾序无关性与接近排序式 3DGS 的图像质量。

summary_sections.conclusion: 把噪声在表示层（训练正则）与合成层（重采样）同时处理，随机透明度渲染可以兼顾序无关性与接近排序式 3DGS 的图像质量。

papers.title: Can Prosodic Style Be Inferred from Text Alone? Evidence from Unsupervised Acoustic Clusters
papers.abstract_en: Much of expressive text-to-speech research rests on an untested assumption that written text carries enough information to select an appropriate prosodic style for its delivery. Text-predicted style models improve listener preference, and expressive-appropriateness evaluation presupposes that context constrains style, yet neither measures the assumption itself. This paper tests it as a falsifiable hypothesis against style labels derived from acoustics alone. For each of six speakers in a 1,200-hour conversational corpus, utterances are clustered in the spaces of five speech models, including a prosody-only control, and the cluster of held-out utterances is predicted from twelve text embedding models. Three controls are applied: utterance length is erased from the speech embeddings; accuracy is scored against the majority-class floor of unbalanced clusters rather than uniform chance; and a bag-of-words baseline measures word identity alone. Text predicts the cluster above that floor for all six speakers (+0.111 top-3 accuracy), but bag-of-words achieves three quarters of this. Sentence embeddings add only +0.026, largest for encoders not trained for sentence semantics and reversed by tree-based probes for all others. Acoustic clusters are not compact in text embedding space in any of 360 configurations. The prosody-only space weakens the association for five speakers, but not for the speaker showing it most strongly. Text thus informs these delivery clusters mainly through word choice, whether as a cue to prosody or as a marker of topic and recording situation, and reference-free style selection cannot assume more.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 1,200 小时对话语料中六位说话人，用五个语音模型的无监督声学聚类作为风格标签，再用十二个文本嵌入模型预测聚类，检验「文本足以推断韵律风格」这一假设。文本预测在全部六位说话人上高于不平衡多数类基线（top-3 accuracy +0.111），但词袋基线就达到该增益的四分之三，句向量仅再加 +0.026；结论是文本主要通过选词影响交付风格簇，免参考的风格选择不能假设文本携带更多韵律信息。
Motivation: 表达式 TTS 与免参考风格选择默认上下文能约束韵律风格，文本预测风格模型的听众偏好和表达适当性评测都预设了这一点，但该假设本身从未被直接检验。
Method: 在 1,200 小时对话语料上，对每位说话人（共 6 位）分别在五个语音模型的表示空间（含一个仅韵律控制空间）对语句做无监督聚类，再用十二个文本嵌入模型预测留出语句的簇；三项控制：从语音嵌入中抹除语句长度、以不平衡簇的多数类基线（而非均匀随机）计分、加词袋基线衡量纯词身份。
Result: 文本在全部六位说话人上超过多数类基线，top-3 accuracy 增益 +0.111，而词袋基线取得其中约四分之三；句向量仅额外贡献 +0.026，且对未按句义训练的编码器增益最大、对其余编码器被基于树的探针反转。在全部 360 种配置中，声学簇在文本嵌入空间都不紧凑；仅韵律空间会削弱五位说话人的关联，但对关联最强的那位说话人不削弱。
Conclusion: 文本对交付风格簇的信息主要来自选词（可能反映韵律，也可能只是话题与录音情境的标记），免参考风格选择不能假设文本携带超出这一点的韵律信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Better Retrieval, Limited Clustering Gains: A Controlled Study of Multilingual Company Entity Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Improved name retrieval may have little effect on company clusters when the pair classifier remains unchanged. We examine this dependency by adapting multilingual E5 encoders under fixed candidate budgets and downstream decision rules. Random-negative and hard-negative training use identical positive schedules. Checkpoints are selected before collecting a new GLEIF sample of 3,633 names, 2,880 source identities and 882 silver-positive pairs. At 72,660 candidate edges, adaptation with a multi-view selector increases direct pair recall from 53.74% to 76.98%. The primary matcher adds only seven correct and two incorrect co-cluster pairs: cluster recall rises from 32.54% to 33.33%, while precision falls from 95.99% to 95.45%. Of 208 newly retrieved silver-positive pairs, 202 fall below its decision threshold. Random-negative and hard-negative training produce identical final partitions. An AI-assisted, single-reviewer audit of 137 pairs supports the observed pattern, although its predominantly LEI-derived evidence does not establish independent gold labels. The results locate the immediate loss of retrieval gains at the existing confirmation stage and show why encoder evaluation must also measure final cluster quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多语言公司实体消解 (multilingual company entity resolution) 中，用多视图选择器适配 multilingual E5 编码器可把候选对召回从 53.74% 提到 76.98%，但下游 pair classifier 的决策阈值不变时，聚类召回仅从 32.54% 升到 33.33%，精度反而从 95.99% 降到 95.45%。208 个新召回的 silver-positive 对里有 202 个落在阈值之下，随机负例与困难负例训练得到完全相同的最终划分；作者据此主张编码器评测必须同时报告最终聚类质量。
Motivation: 检索侧召回提升常被当作实体消解改进的证据，但公司聚类的瓶颈可能在下游确认阶段，检索增益因此被决策阈值吞掉，编码器评测只看 pair recall 会误判收益。
Method: 在固定候选预算与固定下游决策规则下适配 multilingual E5 编码器，比较 random-negative 与 hard-negative 训练（两者使用相同的正例调度），并用多视图选择器 (multi-view selector) 生成候选边；checkpoint 在采集新的 GLEIF 样本之前选定，另做一次 AI 辅助、单审稿人的 137 对审计。
Result: 新 GLEIF 样本含 3,633 个名称、2,880 个源身份与 882 个 silver-positive 对；在 72,660 条候选边下，适配使直接 pair recall 从 53.74% 升至 76.98%，但主 matcher 只新增 7 个正确与 2 个错误的共聚类对，聚类召回 32.54% → 33.33%，精度 95.99% → 95.45%；208 个新召回 silver-positive 对中 202 个低于其决策阈值；random-negative 与 hard-negative 训练产生完全相同的最终划分；137 对审计支持该模式，但其证据主要来自 LEI，未构成独立 gold labels。
Conclusion: 检索增益的直接损失点位于既有确认阶段，pair classifier 不动时更强的编码器几乎不转化为聚类收益，因此编码器评测必须同时度量最终聚类质量。

papers.title: Disentangling Task Difficulty from Run-Level Failure in Agent Failure Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting whether an LLM agent will fail has emerged as a promising direction for supporting intervention during execution. Recent approaches report strong predictive performance, often with AUROC values between 0.85 and 0.94. However, predictors are typically trained by pooling runs from many tasks. We hypothesize that part of this performance comes from recognizing that some tasks are harder than others, rather than detecting whether a particular run is heading toward failure. This distinction matters because task-level difficulty supports decisions about where to allocate computation, while run-level prediction is needed to decide whether to intervene in an ongoing trajectory. We study benchmarks with repeated attempts of the same task by the same agent and separate cross-unit comparisons from comparisons between successful and failed runs of the same model-task unit. Across the evaluated corpora, more than 99.93% of the positive-negative pairs underlying pooled AUROC are cross-unit. Accordingly, predictors that never observe the current run can achieve high pooled performance, including a difficulty oracle with AUROC up to 0.945, while remaining at chance within task. Early run-level discrimination is consistently weak across trajectory predictors, released monitors, and hidden-state probes, although it improves later in execution and is stronger for weaker agents. Under fixed token budgets, task-level allocation outperforms abort-only strategies, while early stopping becomes beneficial only when within-task AUROC reaches about 0.84-0.93, far above the 0.50-0.55 range observed for early monitors. These results show that failure prediction should be evaluated not only by outcome accuracy, but by whether the captured signal supports the intended deployment decision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM agent 失败预测的高 pooled AUROC（0.85–0.94）主要来自识别任务难度而非当前 run 是否走向失败：跨单元对占 pooled AUROC 正负对的 99.93% 以上，一个看不到当前 run 的 difficulty oracle 也能拿到最高 0.945 的 AUROC，却在任务内处于随机水平。早期 run 级判别普遍很弱（0.50–0.55），只有当 within-task AUROC 达到约 0.84–0.93 时早停才优于仅按任务难度分配算力。
Motivation: 失败预测器通常把大量任务的 run 混在一起训练和评测，导致指标无法区分“任务本来就难”与“这一次 run 正在失败”，而后者才是决定是否干预当前轨迹的依据。
Method: 在含同一 agent 对同一任务重复尝试的基准上，把跨单元比较与同一 model-task 单元内成功/失败 run 的比较分开统计；对比 trajectory predictors、released monitors 与 hidden-state probes 的早期判别力，并在固定 token 预算下比较任务级分配、abort-only 与 early stopping 策略。
Result: 跨单元对占 pooled AUROC 正负对的 99.93% 以上；difficulty oracle（不看当前 run）pooled AUROC 最高 0.945，任务内为随机水平；早期 monitor 的 within-task AUROC 仅 0.50–0.55，早停需达到约 0.84–0.93 才有益；固定 token 预算下任务级分配优于 abort-only；早期判别在更弱的 agent 上更强。
Conclusion: 失败预测的评测不能只看 outcome accuracy，必须看捕获的信号是否支撑目标部署决策：当前信号足以支持算力分配，不足以支持早期干预。

papers.title: Scenario-Based Compositional Statistical Model Checking for Safety Specifications
papers.abstract_en: In safety-critical domains such as autonomous driving, systems must be evaluated across a large number of environment conditions, often represented as composite scenarios built from primitive scenarios. Existing statistical model checking (SMC) approaches analyze each composite scenario independently, requiring many expensive simulations and resulting in substantial redundant computation when scenarios share common structure. This work introduces a scenario-based compositional SMC framework for safety and co-safety specifications, enabling efficient analysis of composite scenarios. Our approach decomposes scenarios into primitives and specifications into sub-specifications, verifies each primitive independently, and composes the resulting statistical estimates using importance sampling and kernel density estimation. Our empirical evaluation shows that the proposed framework can accurately answer verification queries for previously unseen composite scenarios while reducing simulation cost through parallelization and trace reuse.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Extended version of paper accepted to The 26th International Conference on Runtime Verification (RV 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于场景的组合式统计模型检验 (compositional SMC) 框架，把复合场景分解为原语场景、把安全/共安全规约分解为子规约，各自独立验证后用重要性采样与核密度估计 (KDE) 组合统计估计。实证评估显示该框架能准确回答此前未见过的复合场景的验证查询，并通过并行化与轨迹复用降低仿真开销。
Motivation: 自动驾驶等安全关键系统需在大量由原语组合而成的环境场景下评估，现有 SMC 对每个复合场景独立分析，导致昂贵仿真次数多、共享结构的场景间存在大量冗余计算。
Method: 将复合场景分解为原语场景、规约分解为子规约；对每个原语独立做统计模型检验，再用重要性采样 (importance sampling) 与核密度估计 (KDE) 组合各统计估计，覆盖 safety 与 co-safety 规约，并结合并行化与轨迹复用。
Result: 实证评估表明该框架能准确回答对先前未见过的复合场景的验证查询，并通过并行化与轨迹复用降低仿真成本。
Conclusion: 复合场景的安全规约可以按原语分解再组合求解，从而在保持验证准确性的同时减少仿真开销，适用于 safety-critical 场景评估。

papers.title: Poisson-GENERIC Neural Operators: Exact Metriplectic Structure in Function Space via Casimir Entropies
papers.abstract_en: Existing thermodynamically consistent neural operators impose the GENERIC degeneracy conditions by projecting the reversible operator onto the complement of the entropy gradient. This makes the operator state-dependent and forfeits the Jacobi identity, so the result is metriplectic-degenerate rather than metriplectic. We instead obtain degeneracy the way GENERIC does. For nonlinear transport, the reversible operator $L$ is the compatible Lie-Poisson pencil $αD+λ(uD+Du)$; otherwise it is a constant, trivially Poisson Fourier multiplier. On an augmented state $(u,s)$ with a latent entropy density, $S=\int s$ is a Casimir of $L$, so $L\,δS/δz=0$ holds identically without projection. The energy combines a fixed mechanical quadratic, a learned gauge-free potential, and a convex internal energy. The friction operator $M=AA^\top$ satisfies $M\,δE/δz=0$ pointwise, and its Onsager parity structure permits diffusion and damping while provably excluding transport. For any parameters, skewness, positivity, both degeneracies, and the Jacobi identity (on the resolved band for the Lie-Poisson term) hold to machine precision. Heat conduction and damped waves admit exact closed-form friction operators, the second law bounds physical energy under a checkable curvature condition, and a discrete-gradient integrator yields exact discrete first and second laws. On four PDEs in 1D and 2D with three backbones (FNO, Transolver, CNO), the model wins 61 of 72 seed-level comparisons against same-backbone unconstrained baselines, learns the exact transport and wave symbols, matches the true dissipation rate within 13% on heat and Burgers, and dissipates nothing on advection. A constant-$L$ ablation isolates the cost of exact Jacobi as the loss of Burgers, while a learned-entropy ablation injects energy on every reversible-irreversible problem.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 现有热力学一致神经算子靠把可逆算子投影到熵梯度补空间来施加 GENERIC 退化，导致算子依赖状态并丢失 Jacobi 恒等式，结果只是 metriplectic-degenerate 而非真正的 metripletic。
Method: 非线性输运情形取可逆算子 L 为相容 Lie-Poisson pencil αD+λ(uD+Du)，其余情形取常数 Poisson Fourier 乘子；增广状态 (u,s) 上 S=∫s 是 L 的 Casimir。能量由固定机械二次项、学习的无规范势与凸内能组成；摩擦算子取 M=AAᵀ 并满足 M·δE/δz=0 逐点成立，其 Onsager 宇称结构允许扩散与阻尼而排除输运；再配离散梯度积分器。

papers.title: Factoriax: A GPU-Accelerated Factorio-Style Simulator for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Factoriax, a GPU-accelerated factory-building simulator written in JAX. In Factoriax, an agent must collect resources, build machines using those resources, and then automate the collection and crafting process by arranging machines on the map to build production pipelines. This paper discusses the structure of the Factoriax simulator and an initial benchmark called Easy Rocket in which an agent is tasked with building a resource-intensive machine called the Rocket in a limited number of game ticks to escape the planet. We also publish results from a number of PPO-based training runs on Easy Rocket. Factoriax is built to be fast. A 1-billion-step PPO training run, equivalent to 500,000 episodes, runs on Easy Rocket in about 8 minutes on a single NVIDIA A100. A standard laptop GPU can complete the same run in about 84 minutes. Our trained PPO agent learns to gather resources, craft machines from those resources, and place them on the map through a curriculum reward directly tied to a manually designed set of achievements. After training, the agent does not place machines in a functional spatial configuration, failing to fully complete the benchmark, and leaving the challenge open for future attempts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Factoriax 是用 JAX 写的 GPU 加速工厂建造 RL 模拟器，配套基准 Easy Rocket 要求智能体在有限 game tick 内造出耗资源的 Rocket。10 亿步 PPO（约 50 万局）在单张 A100 上约 8 分钟跑完，笔记本 GPU 约 84 分钟；用与手工成就清单绑定的课程奖励训练后，智能体学会采集资源、合成并摆放机器，但摆不出功能性空间布局，基准未被攻克。
Motivation: 工厂建造类自动化任务需要长 horizon、大规模并行的 RL 训练环境，而现有模拟器难以在消费级硬件上跑十亿步量级的交互。
Method: Factoriax 用 JAX 实现可 GPU 并行的 Factorio 风格模拟器，智能体采集资源、用资源建造机器并排布生产流水线；训练用 PPO，奖励是直接绑定手工设计成就集合的课程奖励 (curriculum reward)，基准为限时建造 Rocket 的 Easy Rocket。
Result: 10 亿步 PPO 训练（相当于 500,000 局）在 Easy Rocket 上单张 NVIDIA A100 约 8 分钟完成，标准笔记本 GPU 约 84 分钟；训练后智能体掌握资源采集、机器合成与放置，但未能把机器摆成功能性空间配置，基准未被完全通过。
Conclusion: GPU 加速可把十亿步工厂建造 RL 训练压到分钟级，但当前 PPO 加课程奖励只能学会局部技能，空间功能布局这一挑战仍然开放。

papers.title: LifeLong Digital Twin: A Unified Modeling Paradigm and Agent Harness for Event-Driven Lifelong Health State Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Human health is a continuous, dynamic trajectory shaped by the cumulative interplay of biological processes, clinical events, behaviors and environmental exposures across the life course. Unifying the full breadth of lifelong health information, including longitudinal records, genetic variation, molecular profiles and environmental histories, is essential for whole-person modeling and remains a major challenge. We introduce LifeLong Digital Twin, a unified, event-driven modeling paradigm that organizes Life Events into daily Health States and accumulates them into Lifelong Health Context. An accompanying Agent Harness incorporates multimodal evidence beyond the language model's textual context. We evaluate four language models across 25 disease endpoints on three tasks: Disease Trajectory Forecasting, Disease Risk Ranking and Multi-horizon Disease Prediction. The approach yields marked gains over the reference condition: model-averaged F1 increases by 22.0% for disease identification in trajectory forecasting and 18.3% for five-year disease outcomes; thyroid-disease F1 reaches 0.669. The framework provides a foundation for whole-person digital twins and research on personalized lifelong disease prevention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LifeLong Digital Twin：把 Life Events 组织成每日 Health State 并累积为 Lifelong Health Context，配一个把多模态证据接入语言模型的 Agent Harness，做事件驱动的终生疾病轨迹预测。在 4 个语言模型、25 个疾病终点的三项任务上，相对 reference condition 疾病识别的 model-averaged F1 提升 22.0%，五年疾病结局提升 18.3%，甲状腺疾病 F1 达 0.669。
Motivation: 终生健康信息横跨纵向病历、基因变异、分子谱与环境暴露，缺少统一的组织方式，整人建模与疾病轨迹预测因此难以做。
Method: 事件驱动建模范式把 Life Events 归并为每日 Health State、再累积成 Lifelong Health Context；配套 Agent Harness 在语言模型文本上下文之外接入多模态证据。在四个语言模型上评测三项任务：Disease Trajectory Forecasting、Disease Risk Ranking、Multi-horizon Disease Prediction，覆盖 25 个疾病终点。
Result: 相对 reference condition，trajectory forecasting 中疾病识别的 model-averaged F1 提升 22.0%，五年疾病结局 F1 提升 18.3%，甲状腺疾病 F1 达到 0.669；评测覆盖 4 个语言模型、25 个疾病终点、3 项任务。
Conclusion: 事件驱动的健康状态累积加上多模态 Agent Harness，可作为整人数字孪生与个性化终生疾病预防研究的基础框架。

papers.title: Lend Me Your Eyes: Instruction-Aware Text Embeddings via Attention Relay
papers.abstract_en: Text embedding models trained with contrastive learning learn to follow task instructions from instruction-paired data, while instruction-tuned LLMs already know how to follow them. We show that this instruction-following ability can carry over from an LLM to a Transformer-based embedder without any training. We propose Attention Relay, which passes the attention weights an LLM produces to the embedder's own attention. Across six instruction-tuned LLMs from the Qwen3, Llama 3.1 and OLMo 3 families and ten widely used embedding models that differ in tokenizer, size and pooling type, Attention Relay makes nearly every combination instruction-aware. Experiments that break the method down into its parts show that the LLM's attention weights track the instruction in its later layers and come largely from instruction tuning. They also show that relaying these weights selects which content in the text matters: it makes the aspect of the text that the instruction asks about dominant in the embedding, or restores that aspect where averaging had diluted it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Attention Relay 把指令微调 LLM 各层产生的注意力权重直接转交给 Transformer 文本嵌入器的自身注意力，无需任何训练即可让嵌入器具备指令感知能力。在 Qwen3、Llama 3.1、OLMo 3 六个指令微调 LLM 与十个 tokenizer/规模/pooling 各异的嵌入模型的组合上，几乎全部组合都变得指令感知；消融显示 LLM 后层注意力跟踪指令且主要来自指令微调，转交这些权重会让指令所问的文本侧面在嵌入中占主导，或在被平均稀释处恢复它。
Motivation: 对比学习训练的嵌入模型要靠指令配对数据才能学会跟随任务指令，而指令微调 LLM 本身已具备该能力；这条能力目前无法直接转移到不重训的嵌入器上。
Method: 提出 Attention Relay：取指令微调 LLM 前向时产生的注意力权重，注入/转交给 Transformer 嵌入模型自身的注意力层，全程不做训练；并做拆解实验定位指令信息所在层与来源。
Result: 覆盖六个指令微调 LLM（Qwen3、Llama 3.1、OLMo 3 家族）与十个常用嵌入模型（tokenizer、规模、pooling 类型各异），几乎每个组合都变得指令感知；拆解实验表明 LLM 后层注意力跟踪指令、且主要来自指令微调，转交权重使指令所问的文本侧面在嵌入中占主导或在平均稀释后被恢复。
Conclusion: 指令跟随能力可从 LLM 无训练地转移到嵌入器，靠的是转交注意力权重来选择文本中与指令相关的侧面，而不必靠指令配对数据重新训练嵌入模型。

papers.title: G-CARB: Graph-Localized Conformal Agent Risk Budget for Compositional Harm
papers.abstract_en: Small language model (SLM) agents need safety controls that track consequences across tool calls with little monitoring overhead. A private read, for example, becomes a leak when a later action sends that data outside the system. We introduce CARB (Conformal Agent Risk Budget), which calibrates when to stop an agent using a ledger of harm incurred before stopping. Under exchangeable episodes, standard conformal risk control bounds this declared loss in expectation over calibration and a future episode. G-CARB selects scorer evidence along observable dependencies from private sources to outgoing actions. The ledger still covers the entire executed history, and computing the gate score requires no additional language-model inference. On AgentDojo replay with two 14B backbones, G-CARB roughly halves scorer-input records at intermediate risk budgets while improving autonomous task completion relative to full-prefix scoring; random context of the same size achieves similar gains. Controlled examples show how retaining the relevant dependency can further avoid stopping benign work.
papers.comment: SLMs for Agentic Systems, Paris, France, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: G-CARB 用 conformal risk control 给 SLM agent 设定停止时机：以已发生危害台账为约束，只沿可观测依赖（从私有数据源到对外动作）挑选打分证据，门控打分不需额外语言模型推理。在 AgentDojo 回放、两个 14B backbone 上，中等风险预算下打分输入记录约减半，同时自主任务完成率相对全前缀打分提升；同尺寸随机上下文也能拿到相近增益。
Motivation: SLM agent 的安全控制需要跨工具调用追踪后果（私有读取经后续动作外发即成泄漏），同时监控开销要小；全前缀打分代价高。
Method: CARB 用危害台账校准何时停止 agent，在可交换 episode 下以标准 conformal risk control 对校准集与未来 episode 的期望声明损失给出界；G-CARB 沿可观测依赖选择打分证据，台账仍覆盖全部已执行历史，门控打分不引入额外 LM 推理。
Result: 在 AgentDojo 回放、两个 14B backbone 上，中等风险预算时 G-CARB 约减半打分输入记录数，且自主任务完成率相对全前缀打分提升；同尺寸随机上下文取得相近增益；受控示例显示保留相关依赖可进一步避免误停良性工作。
Conclusion: 按依赖结构裁剪打分证据能在中等风险预算下压缩开销而不牺牲任务完成，但随机上下文的相近增益说明收益部分来自上下文尺寸本身，保留相关依赖才是避免误停良性工作的关键。

summary_sections.conclusion: 按依赖结构裁剪打分证据能在中等风险预算下压缩开销而不牺牲任务完成，但随机上下文的相近增益说明收益部分来自上下文尺寸本身，保留相关依赖才是避免误停良性工作的关键。

papers.title: Cut Binary Cross Entropy: Efficient Large-Vocabulary Loss and Gradient Kernels for Sequential Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Industrial sequential recommender systems operate over massive item catalogs (e.g., 10^5--10^7 items). Multi-label recommendation models are trained with Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE) loss over the full vocabulary, but standard BCE materializes a dense [B, N, V] logits tensor in High Bandwidth Memory (HBM), incurring prohibitive $O(BNV)$ memory and fatal Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors. While chunked loss optimizations exist for Softmax Cross-Entropy in LLMs, large-scale multi-label BCE optimization remains unexplored across deep learning ecosystems. We propose CutBCE, an exact, hardware-accelerated BCE loss and gradient operator implemented in JAX and Pallas for large-vocabulary workloads. CutBCE introduces (1) an exact fused reformulation evaluating dense background loss and sparse target corrections; (2) a custom Vector-Jacobian Product (VJP) with a dedicated Pallas TPU backward kernel computing logit tiles on-chip in both passes so logits and their gradients never reside in HBM; (3) dynamic VMEM budgeting and sharding-aware collective hoisting for distributed meshes; and (4) count-based zero-overhead training metrics. On single-chip TPU v5e/v6e mini-benchmarks, CutBCE eliminates OOM errors with up to 91.9% speedup. On 8-chip TPU slice training for multi-label SASRec with 876k items (Yambda-50M), CutBCE reduces peak HBM by 65.7% (>14 GiB saved per chip) and increases training speed by 225.9% with comparable accuracy. CutBCE is open-sourced at https://github.com/AI-Hypercomputer/RecML/blob/main/recml/core/ops/binary_cross_entropy_ops.py.

TL;DR: CutBCE 是面向大词表多标签推荐的精确 BCE 损失与梯度算子，用 JAX/Pallas 在 TPU 上把稠密背景损失与稀疏目标修正融合重写，前后向都按 logit 分块在片上计算，logits 及其梯度永不落入 HBM。在 8 芯片 TPU slice 上训练 876k 物品的多标签 SASRec（Yambda-50M），峰值 HBM 降 65.7%（每芯片省 >14 GiB），训练速度提升 225.9%，精度相当；单芯片 TPU v5e/v6e 上消除 OOM，最高提速 91.9%。
Motivation: 工业级序列推荐的物品目录达 10^5–10^7，标准 BCE 需在 HBM 物化稠密 [B, N, V] logits 张量，带来 O(BNV) 内存与致命 OOM；LLM 中已有 Softmax CE 的分块优化，但大规模多标签 BCE 优化在各深度学习生态中仍是空白。

Conclusion: 大词表多标签 BCE 可以做到精确且不物化稠密 logits，从而同时消除 OOM、大幅降低 HBM 占用并显著加速训练，精度不受影响；代码已在 RecML 开源。

papers.title: An equality condition for the Dobrushin bound on attention rollout and how often it holds in trained transformers
papers.abstract_en: The Dobrushin coefficient of each attention-rollout factor satisfies $κ(\frac12(I+A))\le\frac12(1+κ(A))$, and multiplying these inequalities over layers bounds the coefficient of the whole rollout. We characterise exactly when the layerwise bound is tight: equality holds if and only if some token pair attaining $κ(A)$ is mutually self-dominant - each of the two attends to itself at least as strongly as the other attends to it. The condition is far from automatic: uniformly random stochastic matrices satisfy it only 24-30% of the time. When tested on the head-averaged attention of each individual input and restricted to content tokens - image patches, words or tabular features, excluding cls, register and separator tokens - the condition holds for essentially every input at every layer of DINOv2 (three model sizes), RoBERTa and DistilBERT. In the supervised models DeiT-B and ViT-B/16 it holds for 91% and 64% of input-layer pairs respectively, with all failures occurring late in depth. In FT-Transformer trained on two standard tabular benchmarks it holds for only 11-44% of input-layer pairs. The special tokens account for almost all failures in DINOv2 and the language models: when they are included, the condition holds for only 82-97% of input-layer pairs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明 attention rollout 的 Dobrushin 系数逐层不等式取等当且仅当达到 κ(A) 的某对 token 互相自支配 (mutually self-dominant)，并统计该条件在训练模型中的实际成立率。随机随机矩阵仅 24–30% 满足，但 DINOv2、RoBERTa、DistilBERT 的 content token 上几乎处处成立；DeiT-B 与 ViT-B/16 为 91% 与 64%（失败全在深层），FT-Transformer 仅 11–44%。
Motivation: 把逐层 Dobrushin 界相乘得到整条 rollout 的界时，界是否紧取决于一个未被刻画的等号条件；不知道它何时成立，就无法判断该上界在训练网络上是可用近似还是松界。
Method: 对每层 rollout 因子 κ(½(I+A))≤½(1+κ(A)) 逐层相乘得到整体界，再给出等号成立的充要条件（存在一对 token 互相自支配）；在各模型逐输入、逐层的 head 平均注意力上检验该条件，限定 content token（图像 patch、词、表格特征），并单独统计含 cls、register、separator 等 special token 的情形。
Result: 均匀随机随机矩阵仅 24–30% 满足该条件；DINOv2（三种模型规模）、RoBERTa、DistilBERT 在 content token 上几乎每个输入、每层都满足；监督模型 DeiT-B 与 ViT-B/16 分别为 91% 与 64% 的 input-layer 对，失败全发生在深层；FT-Transformer 在两个标准表格基准上仅 11–44%；纳入 special token 后 DINOv2 与语言模型降至 82–97%。
Conclusion: 逐层 Dobrushin 界在训练好的视觉与语言 Transformer 的 content token 上基本是紧的，等号条件远非自动成立（随机矩阵上罕见），且失败主要由 special token 与深层注意力结构贡献。

papers.title: Monocular markerless biomechanics for clinically interpretable gait assessment in spinal cord injury
papers.abstract_en: Three-dimensional gait analysis guides rehabilitation after spinal cord injury but depends on marker-based motion capture and force plates, which few clinics have. Monocular markerless pipelines have been established in fewer healthy adult cohorts but not in neurological cohorts. We present the SCAI SCI Gait dataset, comprising 239 adult individuals with spinal cord injury with synchronized video, motion capture, and force-plate measurements, we fitted a parametric body mesh to a single sagittal-view video, driving an anthropometrically scaled OpenSim model via virtual markers. Markerless lower-body kinematics showed state-of-the-art agreement with motion-capture measurements (r = 0.68-0.90, p < 0.001, and RMSE = 4.18-6.49 degrees), and accurate kinematics-based predicted ground-reaction forces closely matched those measured by force plates (r = 0.85-0.87, p < 0.001, and RMSE = 2.13-2.19 Newton per kg). Furthermore, conditional-dependence graph analysis with Markov blankets revealed that waveform components were conditionally associated with functional independence, and speed-stratified clustering revealed distinct mechanical strategies among individuals walking at similar speeds. These findings establish the use of monocular video as a scalable approach for clinically meaningful biomechanical assessment and data-driven phenotyping in patients with spinal cord injury. Github: https://github.com/SCAI-Lab/SCAI-SCI-Gait
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出单目无标记步态分析流程：从单侧矢状面视频拟合参数化人体网格，驱动按人体测量缩放的 OpenSim 模型与虚拟标记，输出下肢运动学并据此预测地面反作用力。在 239 名脊髓损伤成人的 SCAI SCI Gait 数据集上，运动学与动作捕捉一致（r = 0.68–0.90，RMSE = 4.18–6.49 度），预测地面反作用力与测力台一致（r = 0.85–0.87，RMSE = 2.13–2.19 N/kg）。
Motivation: 三维步态分析依赖动作捕捉与测力台，多数诊所不具备；单目无标记流程此前只在少数健康成人队列建立，未覆盖神经系统疾病人群。
Method: 发布 SCAI SCI Gait 数据集（239 名脊髓损伤成人，同步视频、动作捕捉与测力台）；从单幅矢状面视频拟合参数化人体网格，经虚拟标记驱动按人体测量缩放的 OpenSim 模型得到下肢运动学，再由运动学预测地面反作用力；用条件依赖图与 Markov blanket 分析波形分量与功能独立性的关联，并按步速分层聚类。
Result: 无标记下肢运动学与动作捕捉测量 r = 0.68–0.90（p < 0.001），RMSE = 4.18–6.49 度；基于运动学预测的地面反作用力与测力台测量 r = 0.85–0.87（p < 0.001），RMSE = 2.13–2.19 N/kg。Markov blanket 分析显示波形分量与功能独立性条件相关，步速分层聚类在相近步速者中分出不同的力学策略。
Conclusion: 单目视频可作为脊髓损伤患者可扩展且具临床意义的步态生物力学评估与数据驱动分型手段，无需标记式动作捕捉与测力台。

papers.title: When Low Prediction Error Misleads Planning: Diagnosing Representation, Dynamics, and Decision Failures in Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: The component that dominates a latent world model's prediction error need not be the one whose repair most improves action selection. We show this by comparing action sequences from identical physical starts and separating endpoint error into a candidate-pool center and action-relative responses. Across four model families and four tasks, a confirmation pool of 256 new starts per task and 300 shared candidates per start shows that center error dominates MSE in 14/16 model-task cells. Yet in six of these cells, an oracle that corrects only the action-relative responses yields better physical rank correlation and top-30 elite quality than one that corrects only the center, while leaving more latent MSE (family-wise corrected intervals). The preference differs across the evaluated settings: a separate LeWorldModel (LeWM) study that executes oracle-selected actions favors center repair on PushT and on Reacher with a render-matched goal. Matched-candidate tests localize ordering loss: for LeWM, encoding realized endpoints raises physical Spearman from 0.464 to 0.975 on that Reacher setting and from 0.193 to 0.631 on PushT (64 starts per task), while Cube's encoded-goal cost remains uninformative. A 72-run objective study improves selected response diagnostics, while incremental closed-loop planning gains remain unconfirmed. These results separate error magnitude from the decision effects of oracle correction and motivate evaluating representation, prediction, and planning as separate stages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 潜空间世界模型中占主导的预测误差成分，未必是修复后最能改善动作选择的成分。在 4 个模型族 × 4 个任务上，以 256 个新起点、每起点 300 个共享候选的动作序列对比，把终点误差分解为候选池中心与动作相对响应：中心误差在 16 个模型-任务格中的 14 个主导 MSE，但其中 6 格只修正动作相对响应的 oracle 给出更好的物理秩相关与 top-30 elite 质量。作者据此主张把表示、预测、规划作为三个独立阶段来评估。
Motivation: 潜空间世界模型的低预测误差常被当作规划可靠的证据，但占主导的误差成分与真正改善动作选择的修复对象可能不是同一个，导致用 MSE 选模型会误导规划决策。
Method: 从相同物理起点出发比较动作序列，把终点误差分解为候选池中心 (center) 与动作相对响应 (action-relative responses)；用每任务 256 个新起点、每起点 300 个共享候选的确认池，在 4 个模型族与 4 个任务上做 oracle 修正对照（只修中心 vs 只修响应），并做 family-wise 校正的区间检验；另设 LeWorldModel (LeWM) 研究执行 oracle 选出的动作，以及匹配候选 (matched-candidate) 测试定位排序损失来源。
Result: 中心误差在 16 个模型-任务格中的 14 个主导 MSE；这 14 格中有 6 格只修正动作相对响应的 oracle 比只修正中心给出更好的物理秩相关与 top-30 elite 质量，即便留下更多 latent MSE（family-wise 校正区间）。LeWM 执行 oracle 选择动作的实验则偏向中心修复：PushT 与带渲染匹配目标的 Reacher 均如此。匹配候选测试中，编码实际终点使该 Reacher 设置的物理 Spearman 从 0.464 升到 0.975，PushT 从 0.193 升到 0.631（每任务 64 个起点）；Cube 的编码目标代价仍无信息量。72 次运行的目标函数研究改进了所选响应诊断，而增量式闭环规划增益仍未获确认。
Conclusion: 误差幅度与 oracle 修正的决策效应是两回事，低 latent MSE 不能推出更好的动作选择；表示、预测、规划三个阶段应分开评估，闭环规划收益目前仍未确认。

summary_sections.result: 中心误差在 16 个模型-任务格中的 14 个主导 MSE；这 14 格中有 6 格只修正动作相对响应的 oracle 比只修正中心给出更好的物理秩相关与 top-30 elite 质量，即便留下更多 latent MSE（family-wise 校正区间）。LeWM 执行 oracle 选择动作的实验则偏向中心修复：PushT 与带渲染匹配目标的 Reacher 均如此。匹配候选测试中，编码实际终点使该 Reacher 设置的物理 Spearman 从 0.464 升到 0.975，PushT 从 0.193 升到 0.631（每任务 64 个起点）；Cube 的编码目标代价仍无信息量。72 次运行的目标函数研究改进了所选响应诊断，而增量式闭环规划增益仍未获确认。
summary_sections.conclusion: 误差幅度与 oracle 修正的决策效应是两回事，低 latent MSE 不能推出更好的动作选择；表示、预测、规划三个阶段应分开评估，闭环规划收益目前仍未确认。

papers.title: Joint Estimation of Common-Slope Decay Rates and Spatial Amplitudes Using Parameterized Nonnegative Matrix Factorization
papers.abstract_en: We formulate joint estimation of common-slope decay rates and amplitudes from room impulse responses (RIRs) as parameterized nonnegative matrix factorization with the Itakura--Saito divergence as the loss function (IS-NMF). Estimation at each short-time Fourier transform frequency bin produces detailed reverberation time (RT) curves directly from RIR powers with no backward integration needed. Standard space-alternating generalized expectation-maximization (SAGE) algorithm yields closed-form amplitude updates and a convex subproblem for each decay rate update. To accelerate estimation, we introduce contribution-weighted SAGE, which emphasizes observations where each component contributes strongly to the modeled power. Experiments with synthetic data show accurate recovery of well-separated decays and faster loss reduction than standard SAGE. Application to measured coupled-room RIRs yields frequency-dependent RT curves and reveals complementary space-time contributions of the shared decay components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把房间冲激响应 (RIR) 中公共斜率衰减率与空间幅度的联合估计写成以 Itakura–Saito 散度为损失的参数化非负矩阵分解 (IS-NMF)，逐 STFT 频点直接从 RIR 功率得到频率依赖的混响时间 (RT) 曲线，无需反向积分。标准 SAGE 给出闭式幅度更新与凸的衰减率子问题，新提出的 contribution-weighted SAGE 把观测权重集中在各分量对建模功率贡献强处以加速收敛。合成数据上能准确恢复分离良好的衰减且损失下降快于标准 SAGE；实测耦合房间 RIR 上得到频率依赖 RT 曲线并显示共享衰减分量的互补时空贡献。
Motivation: 从 RIR 中估计多个共享衰减率与各自幅度时，传统做法需要逐点反向积分或迭代求解，且标准 SAGE 在分量贡献不均时收敛慢。
Method: 将联合估计建模为参数化 NMF，损失取 Itakura–Saito 散度 (IS-NMF)，在每个 STFT 频点独立估计；用标准 SAGE 得到闭式幅度更新与每个衰减率的凸子问题；再提出 contribution-weighted SAGE，按各分量对建模功率的贡献加权观测以加速估计。
Result: 合成数据实验显示能准确恢复分离良好的衰减，且损失下降快于标准 SAGE；实测耦合房间 RIR 上得到频率依赖的 RT 曲线，并揭示共享衰减分量的互补时空贡献。
Conclusion: 把 RIR 衰减估计转成 IS-NMF 加 SAGE 的逐频点求解，可直接产出 RT 曲线，贡献加权的 SAGE 是加速该估计的手段。

papers.title: More Claims, Less Evidence: Bounded Verification of AI-Generated Digital Knowledge Artifacts
papers.abstract_en: Digital libraries, repositories, and AI-mediated knowledge services increasingly rely on generative systems to produce summaries, descriptions, and other multi-claim knowledge objects. Yet generation can scale far more easily than verification capacity: a reviewer may need to decide whether an object is suitable for publication or downstream use after checking only a small fraction of its claims. This creates a fundamental gap between claim-level verification and confidence in the object as a whole. The central question is therefore what a successful partial check implies about the reliability of the complete artifact when its size grows but the verification budget does not. This paper contributes a Bayesian model of bounded verification centered on the Predictive Value of Pass (PVP). The model predicts that evidentiary value decreases as artifacts grow under fixed verification capacity, improves with larger verification budgets, and is especially fragile when errors are sparse. Controlled experiments on FEVEROUS and FEVER support these predictions and show that adding supported claims around a fixed number of false or unsupported claims can make passing more likely while making a pass less informative. The model further yields the minimum verification budget required to maintain a target PVP, providing a practical component for AI-assisted quality-assurance workflows in which generated knowledge objects must be checked before publication or downstream use.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 28th International Conference on Asia-Pacific Digital Libraries (ICADL 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 AI 生成的多断言知识对象（摘要、条目等），提出以 Predictive Value of Pass (PVP) 为核心的有界验证贝叶斯模型：在验证预算固定、对象规模增长时，一次通过所携带的证据价值下降；预算越大价值越高；错误稀疏时最脆弱。在 FEVEROUS 与 FEVER 上的受控实验支持这些预测——在固定数量的虚假/不实断言周围追加更多有据断言，会让对象更容易通过，却让这次通过更不具信息量。
Motivation: 生成能力的扩展速度远超验证能力：审稿人往往只核查对象中一小部分断言就要决定是否放行，断言级验证与对整个对象的信任之间存在缺口，且对象规模增长而验证预算不变时该缺口放大。
Method: 构建以 PVP 为中心的贝叶斯有界验证模型，刻画部分检查结果对完整对象可靠性的推断；在 FEVEROUS 与 FEVER 上做受控实验，固定虚假/不实断言数量、改变有据断言数量以检验模型预测；并由模型导出维持目标 PVP 所需的最小验证预算。
Result: 受控实验（FEVEROUS、FEVER）支持三项预测：固定验证容量下证据价值随对象增大而下降、随预算增大而改善、错误稀疏时最脆弱；在固定数量的虚假或不实断言周围加入更多有据断言，可使通过概率上升而通过的信息量下降。模型给出维持目标 PVP 所需的最小验证预算。
Conclusion: 一次通过的证据价值取决于对象规模、验证预算与错误稀疏度，因此 AI 辅助质量保证流程应在发布或下游使用前按目标 PVP 反推所需验证预算，而不能把局部通过当作整体可靠的证据。

papers.title: Soft Strategy Selection for Batch-Mode Active Learning
papers.abstract_en: Real-world deployment of active learning typically forces practitioners to choose an acquisition strategy before any data is labeled. This is a daunting task: strategy performance varies widely across settings (e.g. datasets, surrogate models) and cannot be assessed without deployment. Existing strategy selection methods explore one strategy from a portfolio at each round and identify the optimal one using bandit feedback or model retraining. Many acquisition rounds are therefore spent exploring strategies rather than collecting the most informative data. Such overhead is a major barrier to AL-driven design of high-throughput experiments, such as genetic perturbation screens and directed evolution, where AL runs consist of only a few rounds with large batch sizes. This regime permits a natural alternative: acquiring data using multiple AL strategies within a single batch. We refer to this as soft strategy selection and introduce FractAL, a method specifically designed for this task. FractAL infers a per-strategy reward using influence-function-based data attribution, which requires no additional retraining, and then computes budget shares for each strategy in the portfolio using online mirror descent. We benchmark FractAL across 7 setups spanning classification, regression, and genetic perturbation effect prediction. The results highlight that strategy selection is a hard problem: every existing method performs worse than random sampling on at least one setup. FractAL, however, matches or outperforms every baseline, including random sampling, on all 7 setups. Its allocations concentrate budget on the strongest strategies in the portfolio while pruning the weakest. FractAL is therefore a reliable choice for real-world deployments, where the optimal strategy is unknown in advance, an important step towards making AL practical for high-throughput experiments and modern scientific discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FractAL 在一个 batch 内按比例混用多种主动学习 (AL) 采集策略，用基于 influence function 的数据归因直接推断每个策略的 reward（无需重训模型），再用 online mirror descent 分配预算份额。在覆盖分类、回归与基因扰动效应预测的 7 个 setup 上，FractAL 全部追平或超过所有基线（含随机采样），而每个已有策略选择方法都至少在一个 setup 上差于随机采样。
Motivation: 部署 AL 前无法评估采集策略优劣，现有方法每轮只试一个策略、靠 bandit 反馈或重训来选优，把大量轮次耗在选策略而非采数据；在只有少数几轮、batch 很大的高通量实验（基因扰动筛选、定向进化）里这笔开销是主要障碍。
Method: 提出 soft strategy selection：单个 batch 内同时用组合中的多个 AL 策略取数。FractAL 用 influence-function 数据归因推断每策略 reward（不额外重训），再以 online mirror descent 计算组合内各策略的预算份额。
Result: 在 7 个 setup（分类、回归、基因扰动效应预测）上基准测试：所有已有策略选择方法都至少在一个 setup 上差于随机采样；FractAL 在全部 7 个 setup 上追平或超过每个基线（含随机采样），并把预算集中到组合中最强的策略、剪掉最弱的。
Conclusion: 策略选择本身是个难题，按 batch 内分数化分配预算能在最优策略事先未知时稳定做到不劣于随机采样，使 AL 更适合轮次少、batch 大的高通量实验部署。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Don't Judge an LLM Only by Its Activations: Discovering Suppressed Safety Features via Counterfactual Activation Potential
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability has emerged as the primary means to understand safety behavior of LLMs. However, existing tools primarily focus on the activating neurons or features of a model. The role of the remaining large set of inactive components is invisible to such methods. This work demonstrates that the inactive set contains safety-critical features that are causally relevant for refusal of harmful prompts. Suppressing such features could turn refusals into compliance, while passing undetected by prevalent interpretability tools. We introduce the Counterfactual Activation Potential (CAP), a metric that quantifies a suppressed feature's latent activation tendency as the product of its encoder alignment (how strongly the input drives it), suppression strength (how strongly active features inhibit it), and safety criticality (how much refusal depends on it). To find suppressed safety features at scale, we propose CAP-guided Safety Feature Discovery (CSFD), a two-stage filtering algorithm that identifies candidate safety features from hundreds of thousands of transcoder features without exhaustive ablation. A significant fraction of trials turn compliant with harmful prompts when a candidate feature is ablated. Under natural jailbreaks, the suppression acting on the highest-CAP features rises 2-4x, and their activation correspondingly falls by up to 80%. Amplifying a feature's suppressors pushes its activation down and raises harmful compliance with prompts related to the suppressed feature, with no such effect for random features. Our experiments span five Gemma, Qwen, and Llama models across various parameter sizes. Our findings indicate that jailbreaks could operate in part by suppressing safety-critical features rather than solely activating harmful ones, and that suppressed features are a necessary complement to activation-focused interpretability of safety behavior.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 3 figures, 15 tables. Submitted to ICLR 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Counterfactual Activation Potential (CAP)，把被抑制特征的潜在激活倾向量化为编码器对齐、抑制强度与安全关键性三者之积，并用两阶段过滤算法 CSFD 从数十万 transcoder 特征中定位被抑制的安全特征。消融候选特征后大量试验在有害提示下转为服从；自然越狱下最高 CAP 特征的抑制增强 2–4 倍、激活相应下降至多 80%。
Motivation: 现有机制可解释性工具只看被激活的神经元或特征，模型中大量未激活成分的作用不可见，而被抑制的成分可能正承载拒绝有害提示的关键因果特征，越狱可能借此绕过检测。
Method: 定义 CAP 指标（编码器对齐 × 抑制强度 × 安全关键性），提出两阶段过滤算法 CAP-guided Safety Feature Discovery (CSFD)，从数十万 transcoder 特征中筛出候选而不做穷举消融；再对候选做消融、放大其抑制因子，并在 Gemma、Qwen、Llama 五种不同参数规模模型上实验。
Result: 消融候选特征后，相当大比例的试验在有害提示下转为服从；自然越狱下最高 CAP 特征所受抑制增强 2–4 倍，其激活相应下降至多 80%；放大某特征的抑制因子会压低其激活并提高与该特征相关的有害服从，而随机特征无此效应。实验覆盖 Gemma、Qwen、Llama 五个不同参数规模的模型。
Conclusion: 越狱部分通过抑制安全关键特征而非仅激活有害特征起作用，被抑制特征是激活导向安全可解释性的必要补充。

papers.title: SALUS: Automated Auditing of NL-to-SQL Benchmarks through Weak Supervision of Multi-Agent Output
papers.abstract_en: Natural language to SQL (NL-to-SQL) benchmarks are foundational to progress in data analysis research, yet recent work has shown that widely-used benchmarks contain significant annotation errors. These errors silently corrupt evaluation metrics, penalize correct model output, and distort the field's understanding of state-of-the-art performance. We present SALUS, a system that automatically detects annotation errors in NL-to-SQL benchmarks. SALUS frames benchmark auditing as a weakly supervised error detection: SQL generated by multiple LLM agents drive a suite of complementary weak-labeling functions. By passing this noisy vote matrix through a generative label model, we extract high-confidence training samples without requiring human ground truth. These samples train a decision plane that maps gold SQL query features to per-agent trustworthiness, allowing SALUS to intelligently fuse reliability estimates with raw verdicts for rigorous benchmark error detection. We evaluate on BIRD-Clean-xs, a benchmark of 298 BIRD development tasks with manually verified correctness labels. SALUS achieves F1 = 0.9194, significantly outperforming the state-of-the-art baselines. Applying SALUS to the full development sets, we estimate annotation error rates of approximately 37% on BIRD and 27% on Spider.

papers.title: LiFT: Loop Flow Transformers
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Loop Flow Transformers (LiFT), a family of looped generative models that scales computation by repeatedly applying a shared Diffusion Transformer (DiT) core, with only light changes to the standard architecture. Rather than asking every recurrent step for the final prediction, LiFT trains each step with a single regression target: a point on a straight path from the model's initial estimate to the flow-matching target. Because we index these targets by a continuous depth coordinate, a trained model can loop far beyond its training depth with no retraining, early exits, or other modifications. In our experiments, these longer rollouts improve generation, so inference computation can grow without adding parameters. On ImageNet at 256x256, LiFT-L/2 achieves an FID 3.34 points lower than our dense DiT-XL/2 baseline while using approximately 60% fewer parameters, 32% fewer training FLOPs, and 52% fewer inference FLOPs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiFT 用共享权重的 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 核心循环迭代，把每一步的训练目标设为从初始估计到 flow-matching 目标直线上的一点，并用连续深度坐标索引，使模型能远超训练深度继续循环而无需重训或 early exit。在 ImageNet 256x256 上 LiFT-L/2 的 FID 比 dense DiT-XL/2 基线低 3.34 点，同时参数少约 60%、训练 FLOPs 少 32%、推理 FLOPs 少 52%。
Motivation: 扩散模型加深通常意味着加参数和训练成本，而循环复用同一核心能让推理计算随步数增长却不增参数；难点在于每个循环步需要一个可学习且可外推的回归目标。
Method: Loop Flow Transformers (LiFT)：循环应用共享 DiT 核心，每步用单一回归目标——从模型初始估计到 flow-matching 目标的直线上的一个点，该目标由连续深度坐标索引，从而支持超出训练深度的 rollout。
Result: ImageNet 256x256 上 LiFT-L/2 相对 dense DiT-XL/2 基线 FID 降低 3.34 点，参数量少约 60%，训练 FLOPs 少 32%，推理 FLOPs 少 52%；更长的 rollout 在实验中改善生成质量。
Conclusion: 以连续深度索引的逐步回归目标训练循环 DiT，可以在不加参数、不重训的前提下靠增加推理计算提升生成效果。

papers.title: What Does a Harness Repair? A Preregistered Study of Visibility, Baseline Adequacy and Evaluation Defects
papers.abstract_en: Harness search keeps a change to the prompts, reasoning switches, token budgets or parsers around a frozen model if the change raises a score. Such a gain can come from answers the parser could not read before, a weak comparison, or a defect in the evaluation. We preregistered a study of where these gains come from, with three small models, three benchmarks, replication and test partitions, a GEPA search arm and six evaluation defects injected one at a time, and we report all 47 primary endpoints. Turning thinking off raised accuracy over a capped thinking setting in 5 of 9 model-benchmark cells, and in each the gain came mostly from questions where the capped setting gave no readable answer. The thinking-off setting was not meaningfully worse than a rescue configuration or four GEPA-selected harnesses in 11 of 13 comparisons, and lost to the rescue on GSM8K for two models. GEPA repaired its broken starting points, but none of its selected harnesses was more accurate than the thinking-off setting. A thinking budget in the serving engine, which also allows a longer answer, lowered truncation and raised the parse rate in 6 of 9 cells. In 6 of 15 evaluable defect-model pairs, replication through the same pipeline reproduced the defect's distortion instead of revealing it. On the LongevityBench multiple-choice tasks, only the longevity-tuned model beat the strongest constant-label baseline.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 2 figures, 35 tables. Ancillary files in anc/: the frozen preregistration, its addenda (row keys of five rows withheld) and the aggregate analysis report, with a README
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 预注册研究追问 LLM harness 搜索的提分到底来自哪里：在 3 个小模型 × 3 个基准、47 个主要终点上，关掉思考 (thinking off) 在 9 个模型-基准格中的 5 格胜过封顶思考设置，且增益主要来自封顶设置下无法给出可解析答案的题目。GEPA 修好了破损的起始点，但其选出的 harness 没有一个比 thinking-off 更准；同一管线的复现在 15 个可评估缺陷-模型对中的 6 个复现了缺陷扭曲而非暴露它。
Motivation: harness 搜索把 prompt、思考开关、token 预算或解析器的改动留在冻结模型上，只要分数上升；但这种增益可能来自解析器此前读不出的答案、弱对比或评测本身的缺陷，无法归因于真实能力提升。
Method: 预注册设计：3 个小模型 × 3 个基准，划分 replication 与 test 分区，设一个 GEPA 搜索臂，并逐一注入 6 种评测缺陷 (evaluation defects)，报告全部 47 个主要终点；对比项包括 thinking-off、rescue 配置与 4 个 GEPA 选出的 harness。
Result: 关掉思考在 9 个模型-基准格中的 5 格提高准确率，且每处增益主要来自封顶设置无可读答案的题目；thinking-off 在 13 项比较中的 11 项不劣于 rescue 与 4 个 GEPA harness，仅在 GSM8K 上对两个模型输给 rescue。serving engine 中的思考预算（同时允许更长回答）在 9 格中的 6 格降低截断、提高解析率。15 个可评估缺陷-模型对中 6 个经同一管线复现了缺陷扭曲；LongevityBench 多选任务上只有 longevity-tuned 模型胜过最强的常数标签基线。
Conclusion: harness 搜索的相当一部分增益来自可读性与评测缺陷而非模型能力，thinking-off 已是强基线；评测管线本身可能复现缺陷，因此提分必须先过基线充分性与缺陷注入的检验。

papers.title: DelegationBench: Measuring When AI Agents Should Ask Before Acting
papers.abstract_en: AI agents that send emails, edit files, and make purchases must decide when to act on their own and when to check with the user first. This decision is usually evaluated by showing a model a proposed action, asking whether it should proceed, and scoring agreement with human labels. We introduce DelegationBench to test whether such scores can be trusted. It has 156 scenarios with four possible responses (act, ask for permission, ask for missing information, refuse), and most scenarios come in matched pairs that change a single feature: whether the action was requested, what is at stake, whether it can be undone, or who will see it. Across ten models from five families, agreement scores mislead in three ways. A simple keyword rule, which we wrote after seeing the benchmark, agrees with our annotators more often than eight of the models, yet its decision changes in only 9 of 48 matched pairs. Equivalent ways of asking the same question change how often a model acts by up to 52.5 percentage points. And every model stops to ask the user less often when it must carry out the task with tools than when it judges a proposed action. When rules are stated explicitly, the same models follow them almost perfectly, so the gaps are not explained by a general inability to follow rules. We release the benchmark and evaluation tools and recommend reporting these properties separately rather than as one score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DelegationBench 用 156 个场景（多数为只改一个特征的配对）检验 AI agent「该不该先问用户再行动」的评分是否可信：跨五个模型家族共十个模型，一致率分数在三方面误导——事后写的简单关键词规则比其中八个模型更常与标注一致、却只在 48 个配对中的 9 个上改变决定；同一问题的不同措辞让模型行动比例相差最多 52.5 个百分点；所有模型在需用工具执行任务时停下来询问的频率都低于只判断一个拟议动作时。作者建议把这几项性质分开报告，而不是合成单一分数。
Motivation: AI agent 发邮件、改文件、下单时的「先问还是先做」判断，通常靠给模型看拟议动作、问是否继续、再与人工标签算一致率来评估；这种单一分数可能掩盖模型行为的脆弱性。
Method: 构建 DelegationBench：156 个场景，四种响应选项（act、ask for permission、ask for missing information、refuse），多数场景成配对，仅改动一个特征（动作是否被请求、利害大小、是否可逆、谁会看到）；在五个家族十个模型上评测，并另写一条简单关键词规则作对照。
Result: 关键词规则与标注者的一致率高于十个模型中的八个，但其决定只在 48 个配对中的 9 个上变化；同一问题的等价措辞使模型行动频率相差最多 52.5 个百分点；所有模型在需用工具执行任务时向用户提问的频率都低于判断拟议动作时；规则写明时同一批模型几乎完全遵守。
Conclusion: 单一一致率分数不足以刻画 agent 的委派行为，应把配对敏感性、措辞敏感性、工具执行下的提问率等性质分开报告。

papers.title: Deep Prior Learning for Embodied Perception
papers.abstract_en: Embodied systems need geometric perception that exploits available observations beyond images alone. Recent feed-forward 3D models incorporate geometric priors, including camera poses, intrinsics, and depth. However, handling noisy poses, preserving accurate priors, and recovering physical scale require more than simply accepting these inputs. We introduce \emph{Vision-Prior Geometry Grounded Transformer} (VPGGT), a VGGT-based framework that extends OmniVGGT for prior-aware embodied perception. We formulate sensor-motivated pose corruptions from ground-truth trajectories for training and introduce a parameter-free \emph{prior residual connection} (PRC) to mitigate \emph{prior dilution}, where predictions are less accurate than their supplied pose priors. Our noise formulation targets camera poses; supplied intrinsics and depth receive no additional corruption. We further introduce \emph{Metric Global Attention}, which conditions a global scale token on available pose and depth scales and predicts a shared metric scaling factor for the geometric outputs. Experiments across four datasets show that \emph{PRC} improves translation-direction accuracy and joint pose AUC over a matched training baseline when camera priors are provided for all views, under both exact and corrupted poses. These results support explicit prior access during refinement as a useful addition to feature-level conditioning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VPGGT 在 VGGT/OmniVGGT 基础上做先验感知的具身几何感知：用从真值轨迹构造的传感器式位姿噪声训练，并以参数无关的 prior residual connection (PRC) 抵消 prior dilution（预测反而不如所给位姿先验）。四个数据集上，当所有视角都提供位姿先验、在精确与加噪两种条件下，PRC 都提升平移方向精度与 joint pose AUC。
Motivation: 前馈 3D 模型虽已纳入相机位姿、内参、深度等几何先验，但噪声位姿、先验被稀释、物理尺度恢复三者无法靠直接接受输入解决。
Method: 基于 VGGT 扩展 OmniVGGT 得到 VPGGT；从真值轨迹生成 sensor-motivated 位姿损坏（只加噪位姿，内参与深度不加噪）用于训练；引入参数无关的 prior residual connection (PRC) 抑制 prior dilution；Metric Global Attention 让 global scale token 以位姿与深度尺度为条件，预测共享的度量缩放因子作用于几何输出。
Result: 在四个数据集上，当所有视角提供相机先验时，PRC 相对 matched training baseline 提升 translation-direction accuracy 与 joint pose AUC，且在精确位姿与加噪位姿两种条件下均成立。
Conclusion: 在精修阶段显式访问先验是特征级 conditioning 之外的有用补充，可避免预测劣于所给位姿先验。

summary_sections.method: 基于 VGGT 扩展 OmniVGGT 得到 VPGGT；从真值轨迹生成 sensor-motivated 位姿损坏（只加噪位姿，内参与深度不加噪）用于训练；引入参数无关的 prior residual connection (PRC) 抑制 prior dilution；Metric Global Attention 让 global scale token 以位姿与深度尺度为条件，预测共享的度量缩放因子作用于几何输出。
summary_sections.result: 在四个数据集上，当所有视角提供相机先验时，PRC 相对 matched training baseline 提升 translation-direction accuracy 与 joint pose AUC，且在精确位姿与加噪位姿两种条件下均成立。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在精修阶段显式访问先验是特征级 conditioning 之外的有用补充，可避免预测劣于所给位姿先验。

papers.title: DynaMesh: Dynamic 3D Texture Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present DynaMesh, a dynamic texture generation method for 3D meshes. Given a textureless shape and a text prompt describing an effect, our method produces an appearance that evolves while the object's geometry remains unchanged. Previous works on dynamic 3D content generation have focused on motion, where an object's geometry and position change while keeping its appearance the same. Methods on texture generation sit on the other side of the problem, painting appearance onto a shape as a fixed surface property and not as an evolving process. Neither addresses a visual effect that propagates on a 3D object. A natural route consists of two generators: a video model that shows the effect from a single view, and an image-to-3D generator that lifts each frame to 3D. However, the latter has no notion of time, so running it per video frame produces a sequence that flickers, loses effect details, and yields a different mesh at every video frame. Our method addresses these failures by conditioning a video model on a render of the mesh and the prompt to obtain a reference video, then running a frozen image-to-3D generator on the video with two changes. The conditioning of each frame is blended over a temporal window, and low-rank adapters are fit per shape to restore the lost details. The mesh is encoded once for the whole sequence, so geometry is constant by construction, and the output is a single mesh with a texture per frame. Applied to various objects and effects, DynaMesh substantially improves over recent video-to-4D and texturing methods, and can generalize its temporal effect to different shapes never seen during training. Our project page is at https://threedle.github.io/dynamesh/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynaMesh 给无纹理 3D mesh 加上随时间演化的外观：以 mesh 渲染和文本提示为条件让视频模型生成参考视频，再用冻结的 image-to-3D 生成器逐帧重建，但把每帧条件在时间窗上混合、并按形状拟合低秩适配器 (LoRA) 恢复细节。mesh 只编码一次，几何按构造保持不变，输出是单一 mesh 加逐帧纹理；在多种物体与效果上明显优于近期 video-to-4D 与纹理生成方法，并能把时间效果泛化到训练中未见的形状。
Motivation: 现有动态 3D 生成只改几何与位置而外观不变，纹理生成则把外观当作固定表面属性；两者都无法表现沿 3D 物体传播的视觉效果。直接用视频模型加 image-to-3D 逐帧提升会闪烁、丢失效果细节，且每帧得到不同 mesh。
Method: 先以 mesh 渲染和文本提示为条件跑视频模型得到参考视频，再对冻结的 image-to-3D 生成器做两处改动：每帧条件在时间窗上混合 (temporal blending)，并按形状拟合低秩适配器 (LoRA) 恢复丢失细节；整段序列只编码一次 mesh，几何恒定，输出单一 mesh 与逐帧纹理。
Result: 在多种物体与效果上，DynaMesh 相比近期 video-to-4D 与纹理生成方法有显著提升，并能将时间效果泛化到训练中未见过的形状；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把几何编码固定为一次、只让纹理随时间变化，可以在不改变形状的前提下生成传播型动态外观效果，且该时间效果可跨形状泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Have I Scene This Before? Spatially Grounded Conversational Memory for Complex Queries in Egocentric Assistants
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric assistants must connect what users say with what they see across long interaction histories. We formalize this challenge as Spatially grounded Conversational Reasoning (SpaCR): cross-scene, recall-oriented, and counterfactual spatial queries that combine user-stated facts with geometric evidence. Direct vision-language models incur high inference costs and context limits as histories grow, while keyframe selection and retrieval can omit objects or evidence needed for complete recall. We propose Spatially grounded Conversational Memory (SpaC-MEM), an object-centric working memory that uses 3D reconstruction and segmentation to ground conversational information in persistent physical objects. It compresses multimodal histories while preserving spatial evidence and allowing object-specific facts to be updated through dialogue. We also introduce Ego-SpaCR, a benchmark comprising 620 ScanNet video sessions augmented with 95 task-oriented conversations and 3,100 evaluation queries. SpaC-MEM achieves the highest overall answer accuracy among the evaluated methods and improves object recall while requiring substantially fewer reference input tokens than native-video baselines. Removing 3D spatial information substantially degrades performance, highlighting the importance of preserving spatial and conversational evidence together.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向第一人称助手的空间接地对话记忆 SpaC-MEM，用 3D 重建与分割把对话信息绑定到持久物理对象上，在压缩多模态历史的同时保留空间证据并支持通过对话更新对象事实。在自建 Ego-SpaCR 基准（620 段 ScanNet 视频会话、95 段任务导向对话、3,100 条评测查询）上，其总体答案准确率在被评方法中最高，对象召回更好且参考输入 token 显著少于原生视频基线；去掉 3D 空间信息会明显劣化性能。
Motivation: 第一人称助手需把用户话语与长交互历史中的所见对应起来：直接用视觉-语言模型随历史增长带来高推理成本与上下文上限，而关键帧选择与检索又会漏掉完整回忆所需的对象或证据。
Method: 将问题形式化为空间接地对话推理 (SpaCR)：跨场景、以回忆为主、含反事实空间查询，需结合用户陈述事实与几何证据；SpaC-MEM 作为以对象为中心的工作记忆，用 3D 重建与分割把对话信息接地到持久物理对象，压缩多模态历史并允许经对话更新对象级事实。同时提出 Ego-SpaCR 基准，由 620 段 ScanNet 视频会话增强 95 段任务导向对话构成。
Result: 在 Ego-SpaCR 的 3,100 条评测查询上，SpaC-MEM 的总体答案准确率高于被评方法，对象召回提升，且所需参考输入 token 比原生视频基线大幅减少；移除 3D 空间信息后性能显著下降。
Conclusion: 把空间证据与对话证据一起保留在以对象为中心的记忆里，是在长历史第一人称助手上同时守住召回、准确率与 token 成本的关键，3D 空间信息不可省。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: What Does Fréchet Distance Measure? A Directional Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: The Fréchet distance is a de facto standard for evaluating generative models across domains, appearing as FID for images and FVD for videos. It summarizes the discrepancy between generated and reference distributions in a single scalar, with lower values typically interpreted as better generation quality. However, this scalar view can obscure what drives the comparison. For example, in COCO dataset, increasing the number of diffusion sampling steps improves ImageReward scores yet worsens (increases) FID. Motivated by this mismatch, we seek to make the Fréchet distance more interpretable by uncovering where the discrepancy lies. To this end, we introduce directional Fréchet distance, the expected squared projection of the optimal transport displacement onto a given direction. Across our image, video, and protein case studies, we find that a small number of interpretable directions account for much of the distance. We use these directions to explain the FID increase in terms of semantic concepts represented by CLIP embeddings, quantify FVD's bias toward per-frame appearance, and revisit the interpretation of Protein FID. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/yhlee-add/directional-fd.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 directional Fréchet distance，把 Fréchet 距离分解为最优传输位移在给定方向上的期望平方投影，从而指出少数可解释方向就承载了大部分分布差异。在图像、视频与蛋白质案例中，这些方向能用 CLIP 语义概念解释 COCO 上 FID 随扩散采样步数上升而变差、量化 FVD 偏向逐帧外观，并重释 Protein FID。
Motivation: FID/FVD 把生成分布与参考分布的差异压成单一标量，掩盖差异究竟来自哪里；COCO 上增加扩散采样步数会提升 ImageReward 却同时恶化 FID，标量视角无法解释这种背离。
Method: 定义 directional Fréchet distance 为最优传输 (optimal transport) 位移在指定方向上的期望平方投影，用它对 Fréchet 距离做方向分解；在图像、视频、蛋白质三类案例上选取可解释方向（如 CLIP 嵌入表示的语义概念）进行归因，并开源代码库。
Result: 在图像、视频与蛋白质案例研究中，少数可解释方向解释了 Fréchet 距离的大部分；据此用 CLIP 语义概念解释了 COCO 上 FID 的上升，量化了 FVD 对逐帧外观 (per-frame appearance) 的偏向，并重新解释 Protein FID 的含义。
Conclusion: Fréchet 距离的标量值主要由少数可解释方向贡献，因此 FID/FVD 的变化应按方向拆解归因，而不是当作整体生成质量的单一读数。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Robust 2D Traversability Mapping for Construction AMRs via Failure-Mode-Aware Fusion of LiDAR Geometry and Monocular Semantics
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) on active construction sites face severe navigational challenges: geometry-based traversability mapping (e.g., LiDAR) misses visually hazardous but geometrically flat surfaces like wet mud and ponding concrete, while abrupt geometry on drivable speed-breakers and inclines produces phantom obstacles. We propose a real-time, failure-mode-aware multimodal traversability pipeline on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, where LiDAR is the primary geometric safety estimate and monocular semantics act as a selective, class- and confidence-gated corrective signal. The representation retains distinct traversable classes, namely flat road, terrain, and rocky terrain, while flagging construction hazards. We also release a multimodal construction-site dataset from a custom AMR: four closed-loop ROS 2 sequences from two active sites (RGB, depth, LiDAR, IMU, GPS-RTK, odometry) plus 506 annotated frames across 28 semantic classes. By projecting LiDAR onto dense semantic masks, resolving sparsity via morphological in-painting, and applying failure-mode-aware fusion with Patchwork++, the system corrects complementary geometric failure modes for a local AMR costmap.
papers.comment: Extended version of a paper presented at the 5th Workshop on Future of Construction, IROS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向建筑工地 AMR 的 2D 可通行性建图：以 LiDAR 几何为主安全估计，单目语义按类别与置信度门控做选择性纠正，纠正湿泥、积水混凝土这类几何平坦但视觉危险的漏检，以及减速带、坡道这类可通行结构被误判为障碍的幻影障碍。管线在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 上实时运行，用形态学内填补补 LiDAR 投影稀疏性，再与 Patchwork++ 融合生成局部 costmap。
Motivation: 纯几何可通行性在工地漏掉几何平坦的视觉危险面（湿泥、积水混凝土），又把可通行的减速带和坡道判成幻影障碍，两类互补失效模式让 AMR 导航不可靠。
Method: 在 Jetson AGX Orin 上做实时多模态管线：LiDAR 作为主几何安全估计，单目语义作为按类别与置信度门控的选择性纠正信号；把 LiDAR 投影到稠密语义掩码、用形态学内填补 (morphological in-painting) 解决稀疏性，再与 Patchwork++ 做 failure-mode-aware 融合，输出局部 AMR costmap；表示层保留 flat road、terrain、rocky terrain 等可通行类别并标记施工危险。
Result: 发布一个多模态建筑工地数据集：来自自研 AMR 的 4 段闭环 ROS 2 序列、覆盖 2 个在建工地（RGB、depth、LiDAR、IMU、GPS-RTK、odometry），另有 506 帧标注、28 个语义类别；系统在 Jetson AGX Orin 上实时运行并纠正两类互补几何失效模式。
Conclusion: 把 LiDAR 几何当主安全估计、单目语义当门控纠正信号，可以在工地 AMR 上同时消除幻影障碍并补上几何平坦的视觉危险面，且不牺牲实时性。

papers.title: The Functional Structure of Post-Compression Recovery in Low-Rank LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Different low-rank compression methods can produce compressed LLMs that respond differently to the same post-compression recovery procedure, and relative advantages observed between methods at the compression endpoint may shrink, grow, or even reverse after recovery. We ask whether this recovery heterogeneity reflects functional structure beyond scalar loss evolution, and how that structure evolves throughout recovery. Our results establish that this heterogeneity reflects a reproducible compression-induced functional structure, which we formalize as recovery pressure. To characterize this structure consistently throughout recovery, we develop a standardized functional characterization within each backbone that is applicable across heterogeneous low-rank methods. The primary backward characterization reveals reproducible module-wise structure across independent probes, while a complementary forward-only characterization recovers related structure without loss or backpropagation. We further find that recovery pressure measured at the endpoint is associated with subsequent recovery response; during recovery, its module-wise structure is reorganized non-uniformly, and localized updates induce distributed responses beyond directly updated modules. Further evidence indicates that tracking this evolving structure provides a complementary functional view of recovery progress alongside scalar loss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 低秩压缩 LLM 在同一恢复流程下表现出可复现的功能结构差异，作者将其形式化为 recovery pressure：端点处的 recovery pressure 与后续恢复响应相关，恢复过程中模块级结构非均匀重组，局部更新会在被更新模块之外引发分布式响应。
Motivation: 不同低秩压缩方法对同一压缩后恢复流程的响应不同，且压缩端点上的相对优劣在恢复后可能缩小、放大甚至反转；这种异质性是否反映标量 loss 演化之外的功能结构尚不清楚。
Method: 在每个 backbone 内建立一套标准化功能刻画，跨异构低秩方法比较：主刻画用 backward 探针刻画模块级结构，辅以不需 loss 与反向传播的 forward-only 刻画作为互补视角。
Result: backward 刻画在独立探针间给出可复现的模块级结构，forward-only 刻画恢复出相关结构；端点 recovery pressure 与后续恢复响应相关，恢复期间其模块级结构非均匀重组，局部更新诱发被更新模块之外的分布式响应。
Conclusion: 压缩后恢复的异质性是可复现的压缩诱导功能结构，追踪其演化可与标量 loss 互补地反映恢复进程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lightweight Semantic EEG Foundation Model for Frozen Cross-Disorder Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale EEG foundation models have demonstrated promising transferability across neurological disorders, but often require millions of parameters and substantial computational resources. In this paper, we present the Universal Semantic EEG Foundation Model (USE-FM), a lightweight EEG foundation model that learns transferable neural representations through self-supervised signal reconstruction on the Temple University Hospital EEG Corpus (TUEG). After pretraining, the encoder is frozen and evaluated on two clinically distinct downstream tasks, abnormal EEG detection (TUAB) and epileptic seizure recognition (TUEP), using a unified frozen-transfer protocol against recent EEG foundation models, including LUNA-Base and CBraMod. With only 1.46 million parameters, approximately one-fifth the size of existing models, USE-FM achieves competitive overall performance, including strong sensitivity and F1-score on TUEP (SEN $75.00 \pm 14.14$, F1 $70.37 \pm 4.01$), while maintaining competitive performance on TUAB (AUC $85.24 \pm 5.61$). Beyond downstream classification, latent representation analysis using $k$-means clustering together with PCA and t-SNE demonstrates that USE-FM learns organized semantic EEG representations comparable to substantially larger foundation models. These results suggest that large-scale self-supervised pretraining enables lightweight architectures to learn transferable semantic EEG representations, providing a computationally efficient foundation for cross-disorder analysis and future clinical decision support in neurological disorders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: USE-FM 用 1.46M 参数（约为现有 EEG 基础模型的五分之一）在 TUEG 上做自监督信号重建预训练，冻结编码器后零微调迁移到异常 EEG 检测 (TUAB) 与癫痫发作识别 (TUEP)。在统一 frozen-transfer 协议下对 LUNA-Base、CBraMod 竞争性达标：TUEP SEN 75.00±14.14、F1 70.37±4.01，TUAB AUC 85.24±5.61，说明大规模自监督预训练可让轻量架构学到可迁移的语义表征。
Motivation: 现有 EEG 基础模型跨神经障碍迁移虽有潜力，但动辄数百万参数与大量算力，限制了临床部署与跨障碍分析的可及性。
Method: USE-FM 在 Temple University Hospital EEG Corpus (TUEG) 上以自监督信号重建预训练轻量编码器；预训练后冻结编码器，用统一 frozen-transfer 协议在 TUAB 异常检测与 TUEP 癫痫发作识别两个下游任务上评测，对比 LUNA-Base、CBraMod 等近期 EEG 基础模型；另用 k-means 聚合配合 PCA、t-SNE 分析潜在表征组织度。
Result: 参数量 1.46M，约为现有模型的五分之一；TUEP SEN 75.00±14.14、F1 70.37±4.01；TUAB AUC 85.24±5.61，整体表现相对 LUNA-Base 与 CBraMod 具竞争力；k-means + PCA/t-SNE 显示其语义表征组织度与显著更大的基础模型相当。
Conclusion: 大规模自监督预训练足以让轻量 EEG 架构学到可跨障碍迁移的语义表征，为神经障碍分析与临床决策支持提供算力高效的路径。
