papers.title: CASE: Cost-Aware Stopping for Efficient Long-Video Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-video agents can actively gather question-relevant evidence, but they typically leave a central decision implicit: when has the agent seen enough to answer? We propose CASE, a plug-in termination framework that frames this decision as policy-conditioned sequential stopping. At each causal checkpoint, CASE combines an auxiliary multiple-choice assessment of accumulated evidence with the host agent's execution state. From complete native trajectories, we construct a cost-aware target that compares answering now with stopping later along the same search path, accounting jointly for answer correctness and the full cost of continued reasoning. A lightweight Ridge regressor learns this decision gap and produces STOP/CONTINUE decisions. We evaluate three vision-language models with VideoSeek and AVP. On Video-MME, end-to-end accuracy changes by +0.67 percentage points on average while CASE reduces model-token use by 53.63%. The same frozen policies then transfer zero-shot to LongVideoBench and MLVU, with end-to-end accuracy changes of +3.38 and +4.58 points while saving 58.78% and 51.28% of model tokens, respectively. Across all agent-model-benchmark combinations, CASE attains the highest accuracy-efficiency Pareto-frontier coverage among the compared stopping methods (83.3%) at the selected operating points. Online execution preserves this favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off and additionally reduces measured runtime by 54.1% on average. CASE provides a plug-in termination framework for long-video reasoning agents, enabling them to decide when further evidence acquisition is no longer worthwhile.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CASE 把长视频 agent 的「何时停止取证」建模为策略条件化的序贯停止问题：在每个因果检查点融合证据多选评估与宿主 agent 执行状态，用 Ridge 回归学习「现在回答 vs 继续搜索」的代价感知决策间隙，输出 STOP/CONTINUE。在 Video-MME 上端到端精度平均 +0.67 个百分点而模型 token 用量降 53.63%，零样本迁移到 LongVideoBench 与 MLVU 后精度分别 +3.38 和 +4.58 点、token 节省 58.78% 和 51.28%。
Motivation: 长视频 agent 会主动搜集与问题相关的证据，但「证据是否已足够作答」这一核心决策是隐式的，导致继续推理的代价与精度权衡无明确准则。
Method: CASE 是可插拔的停止框架：在每个因果检查点把累积证据的辅助多选评估与宿主 agent 执行状态拼接；从完整原生轨迹构造代价感知目标，沿同一搜索路径比较立即作答与延后停止，同时计入答案正确性与继续推理的全部代价；用轻量 Ridge 回归学习该决策间隙并输出 STOP/CONTINUE。
Result: 在三个 vision-language 模型上以 VideoSeek 与 AVP 评测：Video-MME 端到端精度平均 +0.67 个百分点、模型 token 用量降 53.63%；同一冻结策略零样本迁移到 LongVideoBench 与 MLVU，精度分别 +3.38 和 +4.58 点、token 节省 58.78% 和 51.28%；在全部 agent-模型-基准组合上，所选工作点的精度-效率 Pareto 前沿覆盖率为 83.3%，为对比停止方法中最高；在线执行平均运行时下降 54.1%。
Conclusion: 把停止决策做成代价感知的序贯决策并用轻量回归器外挂，可在几乎不损失甚至提升长视频推理精度的前提下大幅削减 token 与运行时，且冻结策略可零样本迁移。

papers.title: MMPostTrainBench: Benchmarking Autonomous Research for Multimodal Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous research seeks sustained model improvements through iterative experimentation and feedback. LLM agents show promise in automating machine learning and language-model post-training, but their ability to sustain multimodal improvement remains unclear. We introduce MMPostTrainBench, a benchmark spanning eight tasks in image, audio, video, and joint audio-video understanding and image-grounded software repair. Agents operate from a common base model within fixed budgets, using development feedback before independent evaluation of their submitted models. Evaluation covers target and non-target model outcomes, iterative model improvement and selection, and research integrity. Across all eight tasks, 52.1% of model--task means fall below the base, and evaluated submissions also exhibit non-target regressions. Model performance does not consistently improve across research iterations, and agents do not reliably select the best evaluated candidate for submission; final submissions trail that candidate by up to 5.38 percentage points. Extending autonomous research from text-only to multimodal tasks introduces additional sources of error in perception, cross-modal alignment, and temporal grounding. The observed regressions and selection gaps highlight the need to balance targeted improvements with non-target capability preservation and to retain gains across research iterations. These requirements motivate MMResearch, a multimodal research framework that connects media-grounded evidence to hypotheses and interventions, carries findings across rounds through hierarchical memory, and retains candidates using development evaluation. Added to existing code-agent runtimes, it improves submitted-model accuracy by up to 7.75 percentage points for Claude Opus 4.8 with Claude Code and 2.33 points for GPT-5.6-sol with Codex.

papers.title: Efficient Graph Generation via Direct Prediction and Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Generative modeling of graph-structured data is crucial for tasks ranging from drug discovery to social network simulation. Among these models, denoising diffusion models have achieved great success in graph generation by learning to progressively reverse a process that adds noise to the original graph. However, the standard noise-prediction approach of diffusion models is suboptimal for graph data. The goal for a graph generative model is to learn the clean graphs' topological properties, such as connectivity and degree distribution. Because a diffusion model that predicts noise does not explicitly learn these topological properties, it is challenging for the model to output graphs with the desired structural statistics. To address this challenge, we introduce Direct Graph Flow Matching (DiGFM), a novel graph transformer model guided by two goals: predict clean graphs and improve sampling efficiency. Distinct from the prevailing diffusion approach, DiGFM employs a continuous flow-matching paradigm and integrates direct graph prediction. Specifically, DiGFM maps the prior noise distribution to the clean graph distribution via a multi-step process: the model repeatedly predicts the underlying clean graph, and a transformation is employed to convert the model output to the velocity vector that points in the direction toward the clean graph distribution. This design enables DiGFM to generate high-quality samples using only 2.5% to 15.6% of the steps required by diffusion-based models, which leads to a 5.3x to 257x speedup in wall-clock inference time. Experiments demonstrate that DiGFM outperforms or matches prior state-of-the-art models across general graph benchmarks and molecular datasets, generating graphs with strong adherence to ground-truth structural statistics at significantly faster inference speeds.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Geometric Distributional Deep Learning (Oral)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出图生成模型 DiGFM：用连续 flow matching 取代噪声预测扩散，模型每步直接预测干净图，再把预测结果转成指向干净图分布的速度向量。只需扩散模型 2.5%–15.6% 的采样步数即生成高质量样本，墙钟推理加速 5.3x–257x，在通用图基准与分子数据集上追平或超越先前 SOTA，且结构统计量更贴近真实图。
Motivation: 图扩散的噪声预测目标不显式学习连通性、度分布等拓扑性质，导致生成图难以匹配目标结构统计，且多步采样推理代价高。
Method: DiGFM 是一个 graph transformer，采用 flow matching 范式并整合直接图预测：多步把先验噪声分布映射到干净图分布，每步重复预测底层干净图，再用一个变换把预测输出转为指向干净图分布的速度向量。
Result: 仅需扩散模型 2.5% 到 15.6% 的采样步数即可生成高质量样本，对应墙钟推理时间 5.3x 到 257x 加速；在通用图基准与分子数据集上追平或超越先前 SOTA，生成图对真实结构统计量的贴合度强且推理显著更快。
Conclusion: 对图数据而言，直接预测干净图配合 flow matching 的速度场，比噪声预测扩散更省步数也更能保住拓扑统计量，是图生成的更优训练与采样范式。

papers.title: GNN-CB: A Graph Neural Network Competition Benchmark for Human and LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks; however, their ability to solve graph-structured machine learning problems remains largely unexplored. In particular, no benchmark currently evaluates whether LLMs can autonomously solve end-to-end Graph Neural Network (GNN) coding tasks under realistic competition settings. To address this gap, this paper introduces GNN-CB, the first competition-based benchmark for evaluating both humans and LLMs on GNN coding tasks. GNN-CB consists of 18 curated competitions spanning node-, edge-, and graph-level prediction across diverse graph categories, domains, and difficulty tiers. All submissions are evaluated through a unified automated pipeline with hidden test sets and standardized scoring. Human participants solve tasks under controlled competition constraints, while LLMs are evaluated using a frozen zero-shot prompting protocol based on a plan-then-code paradigm with bounded execute-and-repair loops. The benchmark additionally supports both non-agent and autonomous agent-based evaluation within the same protocol. Under our evaluated protocol, LLMs rarely match Human Top performance and show less stable performance across competitions. No single model dominates: a few competitions are won by LLMs, yet humans still hold the top score on most tasks. We release GNN-CB as a living benchmark with automated evaluation infrastructure, dynamic leaderboards, and reproducible execution pipelines. Beyond benchmarking, GNN-CB provides a practice-oriented resource for studying GNN implementation across progressively diverse graph-learning tasks. The benchmark and evaluation framework are publicly available at https://basiralab.github.io/GNN-CB/.
papers.comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. 28 pages, 16 figures, 4 tables. Benchmark and leaderboards: https://basiralab.github.io/GNN-CB/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GNN-CB 是首个面向 GNN 编码任务的人机竞赛基准，含 18 个覆盖节点、边、图级预测的竞赛，用统一自动评测管线、隐藏测试集与标准化打分同时评估人类与 LLM。在所评测协议下 LLM 很少追平 Human Top 且跨竞赛表现更不稳定，个别竞赛由 LLM 获胜，但多数任务最高分仍由人类保持。
Motivation: LLM 在编码与推理基准上表现强，但解决图结构机器学习问题的能力基本未被探索；现有基准没有在真实竞赛设定下评估 LLM 能否端到端自主完成 GNN 编码任务。
Method: 构建 18 个精选竞赛，覆盖节点、边、图级预测与不同图类别、领域、难度层级；人类在受控竞赛约束下解题，LLM 采用冻结的 zero-shot 提示协议（plan-then-code 范式加有界的 execute-and-repair 循环），同一协议下同时支持非 agent 与自主 agent 两种评测；全部提交经统一自动管线、隐藏测试集与标准化打分。
Result: 在所评测协议下 LLM 很少达到 Human Top 水平，且跨竞赛表现稳定性更差；没有单一模型占优，少数竞赛由 LLM 赢得，多数任务最高分仍属人类。基准规模为 18 个竞赛，含 4 张表与 16 幅图。
Conclusion: 在当前 zero-shot 竞赛协议下，LLM 尚不能稳定替代人类完成端到端 GNN 编码；GNN-CB 以 living benchmark 形式发布，附自动评测设施、动态排行榜与可复现执行管线。

papers.title: Sibyl: An Efficient Small-large Model Collaboration Framework for Long-horizon Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Small language models (SLMs) offer a promising foundation for on-device agents through low-latency, resource-efficient inference, yet limited reasoning and planning capabilities constrain their performance on long-horizon tasks requiring multi-step interaction with the environment. Step-level collaboration between SLMs and larger cloud-hosted models can bridge this gap, but identifying states that warrant cloud assistance remains challenging: the contribution of each cloud call is entangled with subsequent actions and can be assessed only from the final task outcome. Compounding this challenge, the SLM must balance two competing objectives: maximizing task success and minimizing cloud calls. To address this, we propose Sibyl, an algorithm that trains SLM agents to selectively consult cloud models at the step level and internalize their guidance for subsequent decisions, achieving strong task performance with minimal cloud reliance. Sibyl follows a three-stage training pipeline that (1) builds a robust base policy through consultation-free self-evolving reinforcement learning (RL); (2) cold-starts consultation behavior via decisive-disagreement state mining; and (3) jointly optimizes consultation decisions and guidance internalization through consultation-aware RL. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate that Sibyl, using only a 0.6B-parameter model, outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, including agent training and routing methods, by 95.2% and 80.4% in success rate while averaging only 0.8 and 3.9 cloud calls per trajectory, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sibyl 训练 0.6B 小模型在步级自主决定是否向云端大模型求助，并把其指导内化到后续决策中，以极少的云端调用换取长程任务成功率。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上，仅用 0.6B 模型即比 SOTA 的 agent 训练与路由方法在成功率上高出 95.2% 与 80.4%，平均每条轨迹只调用云端 0.8 次与 3.9 次。
Motivation: SLM 推理低延迟但推理规划能力弱，长程多步环境任务表现受限；步级 SLM-大模型协作中每次云端调用的贡献与后续动作纠缠、只能由最终结果评估，且需同时权衡任务成功率与云端调用成本。
Method: 三阶段训练管线：先用免求助的自演化强化学习 (consultation-free self-evolving RL) 打好基础策略；再用 decisive-disagreement 状态挖掘冷启动求助行为；最后用 consultation-aware RL 联合优化求助决策与指导内化。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 上用 0.6B 模型比 SOTA 基线（agent 训练与 routing 方法）成功率高 95.2%，平均每轨迹仅 0.8 次云端调用；在 WebShop 上成功率高 80.4%，平均 3.9 次云端调用。
Conclusion: 步级选择性求助加指导内化可以让 0.6B 小模型在长程任务上以极少云端调用达到强性能，即成功率与云端成本可同时优化。

papers.title: Does Explainability Survive Data Drift?
papers.abstract_en: Model performance monitoring is a standard practice in machine learning deployments. Detection performance is tracked continuously, and model decay is expected as the relationship between the feature and target variables degrades, a phenomenon known as concept drift. Explanation fidelity, however, is rarely monitored with the same discipline, even in domains such as financial systems, healthcare, and other regulated environments where explanations are required for governance purposes. This paper investigates whether explanations can decay under data drift, even when the feature-target relationship remains stable, and whether explanations produced before drift occurs remain faithful to the decisions of the model that replaces them. Using the IEEE-CIS Transaction Fraud Detection dataset, we find statistically significant covariate shift but no statistically significant evidence of concept drift under the implemented conditional-drift tests, thereby providing an empirical setting in which input distributional change can be studied separately from detectable changes in the feature-target relationship. Local explanations are generated with ExIFFI and evaluated at three levels: path validity, structural behaviour, and fidelity under controlled intervention. Results show that while prior explanations retain substantial decision relevance to a retrained model, they are consistently less faithful than newly generated explanations, with no evidence of a systematically widening gap across the evaluated windows. The study shows that explanation fidelity requires its own monitoring, that structural stability of explanations does not guarantee functional fidelity, and that explanations should be treated as artifacts tied to the model that produced them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 IEEE-CIS 交易欺诈数据上构造了只有协变量偏移、无概念漂移的条件漂移场景，发现旧模型的局部解释对重训后的新模型仍保有相当的决策相关性，但一致性地不如重新生成的解释，且差距在各评估窗口间没有系统性扩大。结论是解释保真度必须单独监控，结构稳定不等于功能保真，解释应视为绑定其生成模型的工件。
Motivation: 模型性能有持续监控、概念漂移有成熟检测，但金融、医疗等受监管领域的解释保真度很少被同等纪律地监控；需要区分输入分布变化本身是否足以让解释失效。
Method: 用 IEEE-CIS Transaction Fraud Detection 数据集，先用条件漂移检验确认协变量偏移显著而概念漂移不显著；用 ExIFFI 生成局部解释，从路径有效性 (path validity)、结构行为 (structural behaviour)、受控干预下的保真度三个层面评估旧解释对重训模型的忠实程度。
Result: 检测到统计显著的协变量偏移，但在所实现的条件漂移检验下没有统计显著的概念漂移证据；旧解释对重训模型仍保留大量决策相关性，但一致性地低于新生成的解释，且在所评估窗口间差距没有系统性扩大的证据。
Conclusion: 解释保真度需要独立于性能的监控，解释的结构稳定并不保证功能保真，解释应被视为与其生成模型绑定的工件。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 在 IEEE-CIS 交易欺诈数据上构造了只有协变量偏移、无概念漂移的条件漂移场景，发现旧模型的局部解释对重训后的新模型仍保有相当的决策相关性，但一致性地不如重新生成的解释，且差距在各评估窗口间没有系统性扩大。结论是解释保真度必须单独监控，结构稳定不等于功能保真，解释应视为绑定其生成模型的工件。
summary_sections.motivation: 模型性能有持续监控、概念漂移有成熟检测，但金融、医疗等受监管领域的解释保真度很少被同等纪律地监控；需要区分输入分布变化本身是否足以让解释失效。
summary_sections.method: 用 IEEE-CIS Transaction Fraud Detection 数据集，先用条件漂移检验确认协变量偏移显著而概念漂移不显著；用 ExIFFI 生成局部解释，从路径有效性 (path validity)、结构行为 (structural behaviour)、受控干预下的保真度三个层面评估旧解释对重训模型的忠实程度。
summary_sections.result: 检测到统计显著的协变量偏移，但在所实现的条件漂移检验下没有统计显著的概念漂移证据；旧解释对重训模型仍保留大量决策相关性，但一致性地低于新生成的解释，且在所评估窗口间差距没有系统性扩大的证据。

papers.title: Distributed Subliminal Learning: Replacing Model Updates with Random-Carrier Outputs
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative learning typically exchanges model parameters: federated clients communicate updates, while independently adapted foundation models are combined by exchanging adapters or checkpoints. This makes communication scale with model size and requires local specializations to be reconciled in weight space, where interference is common. We ask whether knowledge can instead be shared through model behavior on task-unrelated inputs. We introduce Distributed Subliminal Learning (DSL), a collaborative learning primitive in which participants adapt a common model locally, probe it with task-unrelated inputs, and transmit only the resulting carrier outputs. A coordinator pools these outputs and distills them into a shared model. The primitive supports one-shot foundation-model composition through carrier completions and iterative federated learning through carrier logits, without transmitting model updates or requiring task-related proxy data. In LLM composition, compared with LoRA averaging, DSL achieves higher preference retention (94.56% vs. 87.76%) and a larger GSM8K gain over the base model (22.0 vs. 0.6 points), while reducing upload by 30.6-49.0$\times$. In federated classification, DSL reaches 96.83% on MNIST with 8.9$\times$ less uplink than FedAvg and provides lower-communication operating points on CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet. These results establish random-carrier outputs as a practical communication primitive for knowledge sharing across distinct collaborative learning paradigms.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Collaborative, Open, and DECentralized training of Foundation Models workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Distributed Subliminal Learning (DSL)：协作各方本地适配同一模型后，用与任务无关的随机输入探测它，只上传这些 carrier 输出，由协调者蒸馏成共享模型，完全不传模型更新。在 LLM 组合上相对 LoRA averaging 把 preference retention 从 87.76% 提到 94.56%、GSM8K 相对 base model 的增益从 0.6 提到 22.0 点，同时上行流量减少 30.6–49.0 倍；联邦分类中 MNIST 达 96.83% 且上行比 FedAvg 少 8.9 倍。
Motivation: 联邦学习与基础模型组合都要交换参数或 adapter/checkpoint，通信量随模型规模增长，且局部特化必须在权重空间调和，干扰常见。
Method: DSL 作为协作学习原语：各参与方本地适配公共模型，用任务无关输入探测并只传输 carrier 输出；协调者汇总后蒸馏。一条路径用 carrier completions 做 one-shot 基础模型组合，另一条用 carrier logits 做迭代联邦学习，全程不传模型更新也不需要任务相关代理数据。
Result: LLM 组合对比 LoRA averaging：preference retention 94.56% vs 87.76%，GSM8K 相对 base model 增益 22.0 vs 0.6 点，上传量减少 30.6–49.0 倍。联邦分类：MNIST 96.83%，上行比 FedAvg 少 8.9 倍，并在 CIFAR-10 与 Tiny ImageNet 上给出更低通信量的工作点。
Conclusion: 随机 carrier 输出可以作为跨协作范式的通用通信原语，在不传权重的前提下同时保住知识共享效果并大幅压缩上行流量。

papers.title: Learning Field Reconstruction from Incomplete Data by Globally Correcting Local Estimates
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing physical fields from training samples that are always incomplete requires learning spatial structure from fragmented observations.Existing context--query work establishes how held-out observations provide valid training targets, but this does not make the complete-field distribution identifiable when every training field is incomplete.With finite data, weak evidence of sharp transitions and localized variations can further favor averaged predictions that attenuate local detail.A structural prior is therefore needed to favor plausible completions; local spatial relationships offer one grounded in the observations.We propose a locally constructed, globally revisable estimator that explicitly learns local field estimates and subsequently corrects them using full-domain observations.A shared coordinate-conditioned predictor learns from incomplete patches, allowing relatively well-observed neighborhoods to provide direct supervision of local structure.Its overlapping predictions are reconciled into an observation-conditioned consensus field.A full-domain estimator retains the original observations and learns a residual correction around this frozen field estimate, allowing locally constructed structure to be revised by broader evidence.The local estimate serves as both an explicit input, accompanied by its discrepancies with the observations, and a prediction starting point that the global model can revise.On three real-world ocean datasets with authentic observation gaps, our estimator achieves the lowest MSE and highest PSNR on withheld source-supported values, reducing MSE by 28.9\%--34.5\% against the strongest external baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出局部构建、全局可修正的场重建估计器：坐标条件预测器从不完整 patch 学局部场，重叠预测融合成观测条件共识场，再由保留原始观测的全域估计器在冻结场周围学残差修正。在三个含真实观测缺口的海洋数据集上，对留出的源支撑值取得最低 MSE 与最高 PSNR，较最强外部基线降低 MSE 28.9%–34.5%。
Motivation: 训练样本永远不完整时，留出观测虽能提供监督目标，却无法让完整场分布可辨识；有限数据下对尖锐过渡的弱证据会偏向抹平局部细节的平均预测。
Method: 共享的坐标条件预测器从不完整 patch 学局部场估计，让观测较密的邻域直接监督局部结构；其重叠预测被调和为观测条件共识场；全域估计器保留原始观测并在该冻结场周围学残差修正，局部估计连同其与观测的偏差作为显式输入与预测起点供全局模型修订。
Result: 在三个带真实观测缺口的真实海洋数据集上，对留出的源支撑值 (withheld source-supported values) 取得最低 MSE 与最高 PSNR，较最强外部基线降低 MSE 28.9%–34.5%。
Conclusion: 局部空间关系可作为从碎片化观测中偏置合理补全的结构先验，而全局残差修正能让局部结构被更广证据修订。

papers.title: Robust Ensemble Guidance for Scientific Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Ensemble guidance combines pretrained diffusion priors with black-box forward models to solve inverse problems without differentiating through the physical simulator. However, observation coordinates with large predictive spread or extreme residuals can dominate the ensemble correction, degrading reconstruction accuracy. We show that two simple modifications, weighting and clipping, substantially improve this correction. Our method, Robust Ensemble Guidance (REG), uses ensemble predictive spread to balance observation scales and adaptively clips standardized residuals to limit the influence of extreme discrepancies. Both operations reuse existing particles and forward predictions, requiring no additional denoiser or forward-model evaluations. Under a local linear Gaussian model, we derive conditions for reduced one-step estimation risk, bound the influence of individual observation coordinates, and characterize when these benefits persist with finite ensembles. Experiments on Navier-Stokes inversion, black-hole imaging, and acoustic full-waveform inversion demonstrate improved reconstruction over the underlying ensemble solver. In particular, REG increases black-hole reconstruction PSNR by 6.2-8.2 dB across three observation regimes and reduces Navier-Stokes reconstruction error by 26.4\% in a matched-budget comparison. These findings highlight the importance of observation heterogeneity and residual influence in designing reliable generative solvers for scientific inverse problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REG (Robust Ensemble Guidance) 在集成引导求解科学反问题时做两处改动：用集成预测离散度平衡各观测坐标尺度，并对标准化残差做自适应截断，压住极端残差对集成校正的支配。两步只复用已有粒子与前向预测，不增加 denoiser 或前向模型调用；在 Navier-Stokes 反演、黑洞成像与声学全波形反演上均改进重建，黑洞 PSNR 提升 6.2–8.2 dB，Navier-Stokes 误差在等预算下降低 26.4%。
Motivation: 集成引导把预训练扩散先验与黑箱前向模型结合求反问题，但预测离散度大或残差极端的观测坐标会主导集成校正，拉低重建精度。
Method: REG 两处修改：以集成预测离散度对观测尺度做平衡，并对标准化残差自适应截断以限制极端偏差的影响；两者复用现有粒子与前向预测。在局部线性高斯模型下推导一步估计风险下降的条件、单个观测坐标影响的界，以及有限集成下收益何时保持。
Result: 在 Navier-Stokes 反演、黑洞成像、声学全波形反演上均相对底层集成求解器改进重建；黑洞重建 PSNR 在三种观测体制下提升 6.2–8.2 dB；等预算对比中 Navier-Stokes 重建误差降低 26.4%。
Conclusion: 观测异质性与残差影响是设计可靠科学反问题生成式求解器的关键，加权与截断这类不增加前向调用的改动即可显著提升精度。

papers.title: EnGRICH: Enhancing Generative Reward Modeling with Critiques from Humans
papers.abstract_en: Generative reward models (GRMs) are important for LLM optimization. Unlike scalar reward models, GRMs generate natural-language critiques alongside preference judgments, providing finer-grained evaluation signals. Their effectiveness depends heavily on critique reliability. However, existing GRM training typically uses final preference correctness as outcome supervision. Because the preference outcome space is highly constrained, unreliable critiques can still yield correct outcomes and thus be reinforced. Recent work leverages human critiques for process supervision, but such critiques are scarce and are often reduced to scalar rewards, leaving their fine-grained evaluative information underutilized. We argue that evaluative criteria learned from human critiques can be generalized to broader outcome-only preference data. To this end, we propose \textbf{EnGRICH}, a GRM training framework that pairs the GRM with a training-time MetaCritic learned from a small set of human critiques. MetaCritic constructs response-specific rubrics and uses them to evaluate the evidence coverage and correctness of generated critiques. The resulting signals provide both process rewards for fine-grained credit assignment and structured guidance for exploring better critiques. During GRM training, MetaCritic is further optimized to generalize human-grounded evaluative criteria to outcome-only data. At inference, the trained GRM operates independently. Experiments across seven reward-model benchmarks show that EnGRICH consistently improves over competitive baselines, while further analyses validate the effectiveness of its core mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EnGRICH 用一个从少量人类 critique 学到的训练期 MetaCritic，为生成式奖励模型 (GRM) 构造逐响应的评分 rubric，监督其生成的 critique 的证据覆盖与正确性，从而把人类评价标准泛化到只有结果偏好的数据上。在七个奖励模型基准上一致优于竞争基线，推理时 GRM 独立运行。
Motivation: GRM 训练只用最终偏好对错做结果监督，而偏好结果空间高度受限，不可靠的 critique 也可能碰对结果而被强化；人类 critique 又稀缺且常被压成标量奖励，细粒度评价信息被浪费。
Method: 训练期引入 MetaCritic，用少量人类 critique 学习评价标准，构造 response-specific rubric 来评估 GRM 所生成 critique 的证据覆盖与正确性；该信号同时充当细粒度 credit assignment 的 process reward 和探索更优 critique 的结构化引导，训练中 MetaCritic 本身也被优化以泛化到 outcome-only 数据，推理时只用训练好的 GRM。
Result: 在七个奖励模型基准 (reward-model benchmarks) 上，EnGRICH 一致优于竞争基线；作者另做分析验证其核心机制的有效性。
Conclusion: 以人类 critique 训练出的评价标准可以泛化到大规模 outcome-only 偏好数据，为 GRM 提供比结果监督更细的训练信号，且不增加推理开销。

papers.title: AutoDP-LLM: Automating Data Pre-processing for Intrusion Detection Systems using Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The increasing complexity and scale of modern cyber-attacks demand intelligent and computationally efficient Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS). However, designing effective data pre-processing pipelines traditionally involves substantial trial-and-error effort and repeated evaluation of alternative configurations. For large, high-dimensional network traffic data, this process can create a significant computational burden. In this work, we propose AutoDP-LLM, an automated pre-processing framework designed to reduce manual pipeline development and computational overhead. Specifically, AutoDP-LLM leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to autonomously generate and validate executable data pre-processing pipelines. The framework combines deterministic host-side planning with LLM-based specialist agents to formulate data-processing strategies, synthesize executable code, and adaptively determine retained feature sets using semantic reasoning and training-derived statistical evidence, without requiring a predefined feature budget. Focusing on multiclass intrusion detection, we evaluate AutoDP-LLM on the UNSW-NB15 and NSL-KDD benchmark datasets using multiple downstream classifiers. Comparative experiments against conventional feature-selection methods show that AutoDP-LLM achieves competitive detection performance while automating the generation of compact and executable pre-processing pipelines. Component-level ablation experiments further demonstrate the complementary contributions of the semantic and statistical feature-reduction components. The repeated generation, validation, execution, and assessment of candidate pipelines are amenable to parallel execution, highlighting the potential of scalable computing environments, including high-performance computing (HPC) systems, to support automated IDS pipeline development.
papers.journal_ref: The Journal of Supercomputing 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoDP-LLM 用 LLM 智能体自动生成并验证可执行的入侵检测数据预处理流水线：确定性主机侧规划加 LLM 专家智能体，靠语义推理与训练统计证据自适应决定保留特征集，无需预设特征预算。在 UNSW-NB15 与 NSL-KDD 多分类检测上，对比传统特征选择方法取得有竞争力的检测性能，消融显示语义与统计两类特征缩减组件互补。
Motivation: 现代网络攻击复杂度与规模上升，IDS 的预处理流水线设计依赖大量试错与反复评估备选配置，对大规模高维网络流量数据造成显著计算负担。
Method: 框架结合确定性主机侧规划与 LLM-based specialist agents，制定数据处理策略、合成可执行代码，并用语义推理加训练导出的统计证据自适应确定保留特征集，不设预定义特征预算；候选流水线的生成、验证、执行与评估可并行执行。

papers.title: The Effect of Missingness-Pattern Mismatch on Method Selection for Time-Series Classification: A Controlled Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: Classifiers for time-series classification are commonly selected on validation data, but the temporal pattern of missing observations at deployment may differ from the pattern seen during validation. We examine whether such a mismatch affects validation-based classifier selection. In a controlled $2 \times 2$ design, validation and test sets of 64 univariate UCR datasets were masked with either random point missingness or circular block missingness at six rates from 5% to 30%, imputed by linear interpolation, and used to select among three prespecified candidates: 1NN-DTW, MiniRocket with a Ridge classifier, and a statistical-feature Random Forest. Training data remained complete, and selections made under matched and mismatched validation patterns were compared on the same masked test sets. Mismatched validation reduced the test balanced accuracy of the selected classifier by 1.14 percentage points on average (95% CI 0.79 to 1.51), with losses on 49 of the 64 datasets. The loss was negligible at 5% missingness and increased to 2.46 percentage points at 30%. It was concentrated in point-masked deployment (1.84 percentage points), where block-masked validation shifted selection away from the usually best candidate, while the effect for block-masked deployment was small and not significant. Mismatch changed the selected classifier in 35.5% of paired comparisons, but a changed selection did not always reduce performance. A supplementary analysis with non-wrapping linear blocks reproduced these findings with a larger effect (1.67 percentage points). Matching the missingness pattern of validation data to the expected deployment pattern is therefore a simple safeguard for method selection, particularly at higher missingness rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 64 个单变量 UCR 数据集的 2×2 受控实验中，验证集缺失模式与部署模式不匹配会使所选分类器的测试 balanced accuracy 平均下降 1.14 个百分点（95% CI 0.79–1.51），49/64 个数据集受损。损失随缺失率上升，5% 时可忽略、30% 时达 2.46 个百分点，且集中在点状缺失部署（1.84 个百分点）；作者建议让验证缺失模式与预期部署模式一致，尤其在高缺失率下。
Motivation: 分类器通常按验证集表现挑选，但部署时缺失观测的时间模式可能与验证时不同；这种 mismatch 是否会系统性地选错分类器此前缺少受控证据。
Method: 受控 2×2 设计：验证集与测试集分别用随机点缺失或循环块缺失掩码，缺失率 5%–30% 六档，线性插补；训练数据保持完整。在 64 个单变量 UCR 数据集上从三个预设候选（1NN-DTW、MiniRocket+Ridge、统计特征 Random Forest）中按验证集选型，再在同一批掩码测试集上比较匹配与不匹配选型的结果。
Result: 不匹配验证使所选分类器测试 balanced accuracy 平均降 1.14 个百分点（95% CI 0.79–1.51），64 个数据集中 49 个下降；5% 缺失率时损失可忽略，30% 时升至 2.46 个百分点。点状缺失部署下损失 1.84 个百分点（块状验证会把选型推离通常最优候选），块状缺失部署下效应小且不显著。35.5% 的配对比较中所选分类器发生改变，但改变并不总是导致性能下降。补充实验用不环绕的线性块复现结论，效应更大，为 1.67 个百分点。
Conclusion: 让验证数据的缺失模式与预期部署模式一致，是方法选择上一个简单而有效的防护，尤其在高缺失率时；选型改变本身并不等价于性能损失。

papers.title: AIProver: Agentic Auto-Formalization of Mathematical Research via Certificate-Driven Evolving Harness
papers.abstract_en: Proof auto-formalization translates natural-language (NL) theorems and proofs into a formal language (FL) such as Lean, enabling mechanical verification. Despite rapid progress, research-level proofs often depend on concepts missing from leading proof assistant libraries (e.g., Lean's Mathlib), and successful compilation does not guarantee that a translation preserves the theorem's meaning or the proof's reasoning. Furthermore, aligned NL-FL training data are scarce, and leading agents often rely on costly frontier models and manually engineered harnesses. To address the above issues, we present AIProver, an agentic framework for autonomous proof auto-formalization and proof synthesis (AFPS) that jointly post-trains a 119B open-weight language model and evolves its agentic, tool-calling harness with HarnessEvolve. Verifiers assess type correctness, proof completeness, and semantic correctness, returning rewards and diagnostic certificates that drive model fine-tuning and alternating reinforcement learning via symbolic feedback and HarnessEvolve, a certificate-driven evolutionary search over the whole harness control flow that re-tailors the harness to the updated model. For research-level training and evaluation, we introduce LoCoBench, 58.9k instances from Mathlib, CSLib, Mizar Math Library, and a bounded-arithmetic textbook, with a 771-instance validation split whose theorem-proof pairs have no public Lean formalization. Against 39 frameworks spanning AFPS agents, frontier LLMs, and coding agents, AIProver lifts pass@4 semantic correctness over its Leanstral-1.5 base from 15.7% to 36.7% and outperforms every other open-weight system and Aristotle. As a Claude Code and Codex skill, it lifts their semantic correctness from 41.9% and 34.1% to 79.8% and 62.4%, respectively. Further, it is also 24% cheaper than Numina-Lean-Agent, pushing the accuracy-cost frontier of research-level AFPS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AIProver 是面向研究级证明自动形式化 (auto-formalization) 的 agentic 框架，联合后训练一个 119B 开源权重模型并用 HarnessEvolve 对工具调用 harness 做证书驱动的进化搜索，验证器给出类型正确性、证明完备性与语义正确性的奖励和诊断证书。在 LoCoBench（58.9k 实例，771 条验证集无公开 Lean 形式化）上，pass@4 语义正确率从 Leanstral-1.5 基座的 15.7% 提到 36.7%，作为 Claude Code 与 Codex skill 分别把 41.9%/34.1% 抬到 79.8%/62.4%，且比 Numina-Lean-Agent 便宜 24%。
Motivation: 研究级证明常依赖 Mathlib 等库中缺失的概念，编译通过不等于语义保真；对齐的 NL-FL 训练数据稀缺，现有 agent 又依赖昂贵的前沿模型和手工调的 harness。
Method: 联合后训练 119B 开源权重模型与 HarnessEvolve：验证器评估类型正确性、证明完备性、语义正确性，返回奖励与诊断证书，驱动基于符号反馈的交替强化学习与微调；HarnessEvolve 对整个 harness 控制流做证书驱动的进化搜索，随模型更新重新定制 harness。训练与评测用新提出的 LoCoBench。
Result: LoCoBench 含 58.9k 实例，来自 Mathlib、CSLib、Mizar Math Library 与一本有界算术教材，验证集 771 条的定理-证明对无公开 Lean 形式化。对比 39 个框架（AFPS agent、前沿 LLM、coding agent）：pass@4 语义正确率相对 Leanstral-1.5 基座 15.7% → 36.7%，超过所有其他开源系统与 Aristotle；作为 Claude Code 与 Codex skill 时 41.9% → 79.8%、34.1% → 62.4%；成本比 Numina-Lean-Agent 低 24%。
Conclusion: 证书驱动的符号反馈与 harness 进化搜索能把研究级 AFPS 的语义正确率推上准确率-成本前沿，且无需依赖前沿闭源模型。

papers.title: Poisson Autoregression on a Large Network with a Stochastic Block Model Structure
papers.abstract_en: We consider multivariate Poisson autoregressive processes evolving on random networks generated by a Stochastic Block Model. This framework extends existing network Poisson autoregressions by incorporating latent community structure and allowing for non-Markovian dependence, both excitatory and inhibitory. We establish a mean-field approximation and prove that the finite system converges to its limit at the optimal rate $N^{-1/2}$ in the quenched setting with overwhelming probability, both on average and in uniform norm. Our analysis yields quantitative error bounds that are explicit in the time horizon and, under suitable stability conditions, remain polynomial or uniform in time, thereby avoiding the exponential growth typically associated with Grönwall-type arguments. As a consequence, the mean-field approximation is shown to hold uniformly over any time horizon. We further demonstrate how the approximation can be exploited to reduce the computational complexity of parametric inference from $\mathcal{O}(N^2T^2)$ to $\mathcal{O}(NT^2)$. The results provide a theoretical foundation for the analysis and inference of count-valued processes on large random networks with community structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Stochastic Block Model 生成的随机网络上研究多元 Poisson 自回归计数过程，纳入潜在社区结构与非马尔可夫的兴奋/抑制依赖，证明有限系统以最优速率 N^{-1/2} 收敛到均场极限（quenched 设定、overwhelming probability，均值与一致范数下均成立）。误差界显式依赖时间跨度，在适当稳定性条件下对时间保持多项式或一致，从而均场近似在任意时间跨度上一致成立，并把参数推断复杂度从 O(N^2T^2) 降到 O(NT^2)。
Motivation: 大随机网络上的计数型时间序列（Poisson 自回归）已有工作多假设马尔可夫结构与均匀混合，缺少社区结构与非马尔可夫依赖下的均场极限理论，导致大规模网络上的推断代价随 N^2 增长。
Method: 在 SBM 随机网络上定义多元 Poisson 自回归过程，允许潜在社区结构与非马尔可夫的兴奋性、抑制性依赖；推导均场近似并给出显式误差界，用均场近似替代全网络耦合以降低参数推断的计算复杂度。
Result: 有限系统到均场极限的收敛率为最优的 N^{-1/2}（quenched、overwhelming probability，平均与一致范数下均成立）；误差界显式依赖时间跨度，在适当稳定性条件下对时间保持多项式或一致，避免 Grönwall 型论证的指数增长；参数推断复杂度由 O(N^2T^2) 降至 O(NT^2)。
Conclusion: 均场近似可在任意时间跨度上一致成立，为带社区结构的大规模随机网络上计数过程的分析与推断提供理论基础，并使推断在 N 上近似线性。

papers.title: Optimal Control with Learned Critics under Unmodeled State Dependencies
papers.abstract_en: Model Predictive Control (MPC) provides a structured and constraint-aware mechanism for decision-making, but its reliance on optimization-friendly analytical dynamics models limits its use in tasks with contacts and other hard-to-model state dependencies. Model-free reinforcement learning avoids explicit modeling assumptions but typically requires large amounts of interaction data. We present a learning-based MPC framework that combines the data efficiency and structure of local model-based planning with learned components that compensate for incomplete dynamics and finite-horizon myopia. The method augments a nominal analytical model with a residual dynamics network that learns missing state-dependent effects from data and combines the resulting planner with a learned action-value critic that injects long-horizon MDP structure into the local iLQR optimization. To make this practical at reinforcement-learning scale, we develop a GPU-accelerated batched iLQR solver that evaluates learned dynamics and critic networks inside the optimal-control loop and solves thousands of trajectory-optimization problems in parallel. The complete system is integrated into a robotics simulator, enabling scalable model-based reinforcement learning under incomplete dynamics. Experiments on biased and incompletely modeled control tasks show that the approach improves closed-loop control performance while preserving the model-based structure needed for efficient constrained trajectory optimization.
papers.comment: Keywords: Model Predictive Control, Model-Based Reinforcement Learning, iLQR, Value Function Approximation. Presented at 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026), Austin TX, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出在解析动力学模型上并联残差动力学网络与动作价值 critic 的学习型 MPC：残差网络补上未建模的状态依赖，critic 把长程 MDP 结构注入局部 iLQR 优化，并用 GPU 批量 iLQR 求解器在最优控制回路内前向计算网络，一次并行解数千条轨迹优化。在有偏置与建模不完整的控制任务上，该方法提升闭环控制性能，同时保留约束轨迹优化所需的模型结构。
Motivation: MPC 依赖便于优化的解析动力学，遇到接触等难建模的状态依赖就失效；纯 model-free RL 又需要大量交互数据，两者之间缺少兼顾数据效率与约束处理的方案。
Method: 在名义解析模型上加一个残差动力学网络从数据学习缺失的状态依赖效应，再配一个学习得到的动作价值 critic，把长程 MDP 结构注入局部 iLQR 优化；为此开发 GPU 加速的批量 iLQR 求解器，在最优控制回路内评估学习到的动力学与 critic 网络，并行求解数千个轨迹优化问题，整套系统集成进机器人仿真器。

papers.title: FACET: Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport in High-Fidelity Fluorescence Microscopy Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Fluorescence microscopy reveals where proteins localize, but only a limited number of proteins can be imaged in the same cell; generating these images from amino-acid sequence and the cell's morphological context enables in silico localization of unimaged proteins. The two conditions, however, play asymmetric roles: morphological context is spatially aligned with the target, whereas sequence is non-spatial and must specify protein-dependent localization within it, with recurring coarse patterns shared across proteins and finer protein-specific variation. Existing generators condition on both jointly, without separating what each explains. We introduce FACET (Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport), a probabilistic generative framework that encodes this structure as an explicit inductive bias: sequence semantics are learned from what context leaves unexplained, coarse localization regularities are shared across proteins through a semantic memory, and protein-specific variation is a bounded residual around them. A variance-preserving state projection further lets FACET perform continuous stochastic transport through a pretrained diffusion predictor with minimal parameter overhead. On held-out proteins, FACET improves spatial overlap by 34.3% on the Human Protein Atlas and 14.0% on OpenCell over a backbone-matched baseline, and reduces FID by 27.2% and 46.5%, respectively, with 75% fewer network evaluations. It also substantially improves protein-association structure recovery and yields better-calibrated predictions, while detailed ablations show complementary contributions from its design choices. These results identify factorized asymmetric conditioning, rather than generator capacity alone, as a key lever for high-fidelity, efficient, and biologically meaningful cellular image synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FACET 把「形态上下文（空间对齐）」与「氨基酸序列（非空间、决定蛋白特异定位）」两种条件分解建模：序列语义只从上下文未解释的部分学习，粗粒度定位规律经 semantic memory 跨蛋白共享，蛋白特异变化作为有界残差，并用 variance-preserving state projection 在预训练 diffusion predictor 上做连续随机传输。在留出蛋白上，相对 backbone-matched 基线，Human Protein Atlas 空间重叠提升 34.3%、OpenCell 提升 14.0%，FID 分别下降 27.2% 与 46.5%，网络求值次数减少 75%。
Motivation: 荧光显微镜同一细胞只能成像有限数量蛋白，靠序列与形态上下文生成图像可做未成像蛋白的 in silico 定位；但现有生成器把两种条件联合条件化，未区分各自解释的部分，而二者作用本质不对称。
Method: FACET 是概率生成框架，把不对称结构写成显式归纳偏置：序列语义从上下文残差中学习，粗定位规律经 semantic memory 跨蛋白共享，蛋白特异变化建为围绕该规律的有界残差；再用 variance-preserving state projection 在预训练 diffusion predictor 上执行连续随机传输，参数开销极小。
Result: 在留出蛋白上，相对 backbone-matched 基线：Human Protein Atlas 空间重叠提升 34.3%，OpenCell 提升 14.0%；FID 分别降低 27.2% 与 46.5%；网络求值次数减少 75%。同时明显改善蛋白关联结构恢复，预测校准更好，消融显示各设计选择贡献互补。
Conclusion: 决定高保真、高效且生物学有意义的细胞图像合成的关键杠杆是分解式非对称条件化 (factorized asymmetric conditioning)，而非单纯堆生成器容量。

papers.title: Rethinking Tabular Foundation Models On Data Streams
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) outperform established machine learning models on tabular benchmarks through in-context learning. Building on this success, interest is growing in applying them to data streams, where data arrive continuously and evolve over time. On a stream, a TFM adapts by updating its context rather than its parameters, so its accuracy and cost depend on which examples it keeps and how often it rebuilds its context. We therefore present a systematic study of TFMs on data streams, covering memory management, computational cost, and stream-specific challenges such as concept drift and delayed labels. We find that TFMs achieve the highest predictive performance and that simply retaining the most recent examples is as effective as existing memory management techniques. They also recover faster than streaming learners after drift and keep the highest accuracy under label delay. This accuracy, however, comes at a high serving cost, since a nearly unchanged context is re-encoded at every prediction. These results point to architectural efficiency as the way forward for in-context stream learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统研究表格基础模型 (TFM) 在数据流上的表现：靠更新上下文而非参数适应流，保留最近样本的记忆管理与现有技术同样有效，且在概念漂移后恢复更快、标签延迟下精度最高；但每次预测都重编码几乎不变的上下文，serving 成本很高，作者认为架构效率是 in-context 流学习的出路。
Motivation: TFM 在表格基准上靠 in-context learning 胜过传统模型，但搬到持续到达、随时间演化的数据流上后，精度与成本取决于保留哪些样本、多久重建一次上下文，这一权衡此前缺少系统研究。
Method: 对 TFM 在数据流上做系统性研究，覆盖记忆管理策略、计算成本，以及概念漂移 (concept drift) 与延迟标签 (delayed labels) 等流特有挑战；适应方式为更新上下文而非参数。
Result: TFM 取得最高预测性能；仅保留最近样本与现有记忆管理 技术同样有效；漂移后比流式学习器恢复更快；标签延迟下保持最高精度；代价是每次预测都重编码几乎不变的上下文，serving 成本高。
Conclusion: in-context 流学习的精度优势成立，但瓶颈在重复编码带来的推理开销，下一步应从架构效率入手而非记忆管理技巧。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Task Inference Beyond Least Squares in Behavioral Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Behavioral Foundation Models (BFMs) aim to solve a wide range of downstream tasks without test-time policy learning by inferring a task vector from the reward function. While efficient, the retrieved policies are often suboptimal because of how this task vector is inferred, typically with ordinary least squares (OLS). OLS minimizes reward reconstruction error but leaves the ordering of rewards unconstrained, which can bias the successor measure of the retrieved zero-shot policy away from that of the optimal policy. In this work, we propose BLS, an efficient test-time inference method that balances minimizing reward reconstruction error with reducing successor-measure mismatch. Theoretically, we provide a suboptimality gap upper bound characterized by both successor-measure and reward-function residuals. Empirically, we evaluate BLS on top of state-of-the-art BFMs across benchmarks for locomotion, manipulation, and humanoid control. BLS outperforms existing task inference baselines with negligible computational overhead. Project page: https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/BLS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 行为基础模型 (BFM) 用最小二乘从奖励函数推断任务向量，虽快但只最小化奖励重构误差、不约束奖励排序，使检索出的零样本策略的 successor measure 偏离最优策略。提出 BLS，在测试时同时最小化奖励重构误差与 successor-measure 失配，并给出由 successor-measure 与奖励函数残差刻画的次优性差距上界。在 locomotion、manipulation、humanoid 控制的 SOTA BFM 上，BLS 超越现有任务推断基线且计算开销可忽略。
Motivation: BFM 免测试时策略学习靠 OLS 推断任务向量，但 OLS 不约束奖励排序，导致零样本策略的 successor measure 系统性偏离最优策略，检索到的策略次优。
Method: 提出测试时推断方法 BLS：在目标中同时平衡奖励重构误差最小化与 successor-measure 失配缩减；理论上给出次优性差距上界，由 successor-measure 残差与奖励函数残差共同刻画。
Result: 在 locomotion、manipulation、humanoid 控制基准上的 SOTA BFM 中，BLS 超越现有任务推断基线，计算开销可忽略；并给出由两类残差刻画的次优性差距上界。
Conclusion: 任务推断不能只最小化奖励重构误差，还需约束 successor measure，否则零样本策略会偏离最优；BLS 以可忽略开销实现这一平衡。

papers.title: Learning Conditional Source Distribution via Flow Reversal for Temporal Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: We introduce CNP-Flow, a flow matching framework for temporal generation that learns conditional source distributions through flow reversal. Whereas standard conditional flow matching (FM) incorporates conditioning through the vector field and draws source samples from a standard Gaussian, CNP-Flow uses a conditional noise predictor (CNP) to produce an isotropic Gaussian source for each temporal condition. The CNP is supervised by source samples obtained through flow reversal, which maps observed targets backward through a pretrained FM model. A three-stage pipeline pretrains the FM model, trains the CNP, and fine-tunes the FM model using the learned source distribution, while preserving the FM backbone architecture. Across video prediction, video interpolation, and 7-DoF Franka robot motion planning, CNP-Flow consistently improves generation quality. It also matches baseline performance with fewer function evaluations. Project page: https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/cnpflow
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CNP-Flow 用条件噪声预测器 (conditional noise predictor, CNP) 为每个时间条件生成各向同性高斯源分布，替代标准条件 flow matching 固定的标准高斯源，并通过 flow reversal 把观测目标经预训练 FM 模型反向映射得到的源样本来监督 CNP。三阶段流水线（预训练 FM、训练 CNP、用学到的源分布微调 FM）在视频预测、视频插值与 7-DoF Franka 机器人运动规划上一致提升生成质量，并在更少函数求值 (function evaluations) 下追平基线性能。
Motivation: 标准条件 flow matching 只把条件放进向量场，源样本始终取自固定的标准高斯，无法随时间条件调整起始分布，限制了时序生成质量与采样效率。
Method: 三阶段流水线：先预训练 FM 模型，再用 flow reversal 将观测目标反向映射过该模型得到源样本来监督条件噪声预测器 (CNP)，最后用 CNP 产出的条件源分布微调 FM；FM backbone 架构保持不变。
Result: 在视频预测、视频插值和 7-DoF Franka 机器人运动规划三类任务上，CNP-Flow 一致提升生成质量；并在更少函数求值 (fewer function evaluations) 的情况下匹配基线性能。
Conclusion: 把源分布从固定高斯改为随时间条件变化的可学习分布，可在保持 FM backbone 不变的前提下同时改善时序生成质量并降低采样成本。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Reflections and Fragments: Securing LLMs Against Sequential Mosaic Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Self-play red-teaming improves language-model safety by pitting attacker and defender roles against each other in a zero-sum game. However, real adversaries increasingly use mosaic attacks: multi-turn sequences whose individual fragments are innocuous in isolation yet assemble into a harmful payload. We develop a theory of mosaic defense that characterizes what is required to prevent such attacks without sacrificing helpfulness. We first show that no fixed bounded window of recent prompts is sufficient in general: safety-relevant information may occur arbitrarily far back in the interaction. We formalize a watchman, an online state mechanism that carries this information forward, and show that under explicit assumptions it enables zero-failure defense with positive benign helpfulness. Under stronger conditions, it is also optimal among zero-failure defenders. An exact watchman may nevertheless require exponentially many states, while exact maliciousness detection can require exponentially many queries in an unstructured black-box model. These state and query lower bounds do not by themselves imply hard learning: the construction underlying the state lower bound is efficiently learnable from labeled examples, whereas certifying worst-case safety can require substantially more information under restricted access. We also show that self-play equilibrium alone does not certify usefulness, motivating a constrained formulation that maximizes worst-case benign helpfulness among zero-failure defenders. Empirically, training role-specific attacker and defender LoRA adapters over frozen LLMs via multi-turn self-play strengthens both roles: attackers become more effective at eliciting harmful responses, while defenders become more robust to attack, with improvements also observed on unseen attack objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多轮 mosaic attack（单轮无害、拼接成有害载荷），提出 watchman 这一在线状态机制把远期安全相关信息向前传递，证明在显式假设下可实现零失败防御且保持正的良性有用性，并在更强条件下于零失败防御者中最优。同时给出状态与查询的指数级下界：精确 watchman 可能需要指数多个状态，非结构化黑盒模型中精确恶意检测可能需要指数多次查询。
Motivation: 自博弈红队 (self-play red-teaming) 的零和博弈框架难以应对 mosaic attacks：安全相关信息可能出现在任意久远的轮次，任何固定大小的近期提示窗口都不足以防御，而自博弈均衡本身也不保证有用性。
Method: 建立 mosaic 防御理论：形式化 watchman 在线状态机制并证明其零失败与有用性条件、最优性条件；给出状态与查询复杂度下界，并区分下界构造可从标注样本高效学习与受限访问下最坏情况安全认证需要更多信息；提出在零失败防御者中最大化最坏情况良性有用性的约束式目标。实证部分在冻结 LLM 上用多轮自博弈训练角色专用的 attacker 与 defender LoRA adapters。
Result: 理论上：固定有界近期提示窗口一般不充分；精确 watchman 可能需要指数多个状态，非结构化黑盒模型中精确恶意检测可能需要指数多次查询；状态下界构造本身可从标注样本高效学习。实证上：多轮自博弈训练同时强化双方——攻击者更善于诱导有害回答，防御者对攻击更稳健，且在未见过的攻击目标上也有提升。
Conclusion: 防御 mosaic attacks 需要携带历史状态的在线机制而非固定窗口，且安全认证应与有用性一起按最坏情况约束来优化；自博弈均衡本身不足以保证有用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IRSTD-Agent: Agentic Infrared Small Target Detection via Zoom-Guided Interaction Learning
papers.abstract_en: Infrared small-target detection plays an important role in maritime monitoring and aerial surveillance. Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer promising capabilities for visual understanding, existing MLLM-based approaches struggle to precisely localize infrared small targets. In this paper, we propose IRSTD-Agent, an agentic framework for infrared small target detection through dynamic visual search. The framework enables an MLLM to adaptively determine where and at what scale to inspect an image and progressively gather fine-grained visual evidence for precise target localization. Five complementary visual tools (PROPOSAL, ZOOM, DETECT, DROP and REFINE) support object candidate discovery, adaptive observation, target localization, hypothesis rejection, and target extent refinement, together enabling a coordinated search process over original-resolution images. To teach the MLLMs to conduct this search, we introduce Zoom-guided Interaction Learning, which uses annotation-derived interaction trajectories to supervise tool selection and the corresponding arguments. Through extensive experiments on WideIRSTD-Full and IRSTD-1k datasets, we demonstrate that IRSTD-Agent outperforms the evaluated vision-language models and enhances the precise localization capabilities of MLLMs in IRSTD tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IRSTD-Agent 把红外小目标检测做成 MLLM 的动态视觉搜索：五个工具 (PROPOSAL/ZOOM/DETECT/DROP/REFINE) 让模型自适应决定在原分辨率图像的何处、以何种尺度观察，逐步收集细粒度证据并精修目标边界。在 WideIRSTD-Full 与 IRSTD-1k 上，该框架优于所评测的视觉-语言模型，提升了 MLLM 对红外小目标的精确定位能力。
Motivation: MLLM 具备视觉理解能力，但在红外小目标上难以精确定位：目标尺度极小，一次性整图推理拿不到足够细节。
Method: 提出 agentic 框架 IRSTD-Agent，用五个互补视觉工具支撑协同搜索——PROPOSAL 发现候选、ZOOM 自适应观察、DETECT 定位、DROP 否定假设、REFINE 精修目标范围，全程在原分辨率图像上操作。训练用 Zoom-guided Interaction Learning，以标注派生的交互轨迹监督工具选择及对应参数。
Result: 在 WideIRSTD-Full 和 IRSTD-1k 两个红外小目标检测数据集上的实验中，IRSTD-Agent 超过所评测的视觉-语言模型，并提升了 MLLM 在 IRSTD 任务上的精确定位能力。
Conclusion: 把红外小目标检测拆成带工具调用的渐进式缩放搜索，可让 MLLM 在该任务上取得比直接推理更准的定位。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: WILLIE: A Unified Framework and Benchmark for Wound Classification, Segmentation, and Localization
papers.abstract_en: Chronic wound management affects over 8.2 million patients in the United States and imposes substantial clinical and economic burden. Clinical wound assessment commonly involves three coupled tasks: identifying wound type, delineating wound boundaries, and localizing the wound region for measurement and monitoring. Despite this clinical coupling, existing machine learning approaches typically address wound classification, segmentation, and localization using separate models. We present WILLIE, a unified framework and benchmark for wound classification, segmentation and localization that enables systematic evaluation of multi-task wound analysis under a common protocol. WILLIE harmonizes three public wound datasets into a shared benchmark and compares unified models across three scaling configurations against 10 single-task baselines. The best model achieves 91.88% classification accuracy, 91.41% Dice, and 96.23% AP@0.5 while producing all three outputs in a single forward pass. Beyond aggregate performance, our results show that segmentation-derived localization outperforms dedicated detection baselines in this benchmark, suggesting that box-based localization may be unnecessary for spatially coherent wound targets. Our findings highlight that effective multi-task learning in healthcare imaging depends not only on shared representations, but also on task formulation, compatibility, and benchmark design.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Published in Proceedings of the 11th Machine Learning for Healthcare Conference (MLHC 2026), PMLR 340:1243-1263. Code: https://github.com/Qian-Group-HRI/Willie
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 11th Machine Learning for Healthcare Conference, PMLR 340:1243-1263, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WILLIE 把伤口分类、分割、定位三个任务统一到单一前向传播的多任务框架，并把三个公开伤口数据集整合成统一基准，与 10 个单任务基线在同一协议下比较。最优模型取得 91.88% 分类准确率、91.41% Dice 和 96.23% AP@0.5；由分割导出的定位优于专用检测基线，说明对空间连续的伤口目标不必再单独跑 box 检测。
Motivation: 伤口评估在临床上本就是识别类型、勾画边界、定位测量三件事耦合，但现有机器学习方法用彼此独立的模型分别处理，缺少统一协议下的系统比较。
Method: WILLIE 整合三个公开伤口数据集为共享基准，在统一评测协议下比较三种 scaling 配置的统一模型，并与 10 个单任务基线对照；单次前向同时输出分类、分割与定位结果，定位可由分割结果导出。
Result: 最优模型分类准确率 91.88%、Dice 91.41%、AP@0.5 96.23%，且一次前向产出全部三个输出；在该基准上由分割导出的定位优于专用检测基线。
Conclusion: 医疗影像中的有效多任务学习不仅取决于共享表示，还取决于任务形式、任务兼容性与基准设计；对空间连续的伤口目标，box 式定位可能是多余的。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: On Semi-Markov Suboptimality in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical reinforcement learning uses temporally extended subtasks for exploration, yet committing to their execution can restrict both deployment and policy learning. We identify and separate the resulting execution and policy suboptimality. Task and execution trees distinguish reward objectives from policy choices and decision interruption. A Unified Value Function for HRL and a four-stage Generalized Hierarchical Bellman Equation then support a common analysis of both losses. Under bounded rewards and uniform termination, we establish hierarchical policy and execution improvement results. With the remaining node policies fixed, task-subtree compatibility and node-policy optimality under the original execution mode establish when Markov execution is optimal. The resulting decomposition leads to independent execution choices for behavior, targets, and deployment. We instantiate this principle through execution improvement and one-stage or two-stage policy improvement at arbitrary hierarchy depth. Option-based and goal-conditioned experiments demonstrate complementary gains from changing execution and changing the learning target. Controlled stochastic environments show how these gains depend on stochastic transition strength and spatial structure. This framework makes execution design an explicit component of hierarchical policy optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 分层强化学习 (HRL) 中固定子任务执行方式会同时造成执行次优与策略次优两类损失，论文用任务树与执行树把二者分离，并给出统一价值函数与四阶段广义分层 Bellman 方程统一分析。在有界奖励与一致终止条件下建立分层策略/执行改进结果，实验表明改变执行方式与改变学习目标带来互补增益，且增益随随机转移强度与空间结构变化。
Motivation: HRL 一旦承诺执行时间上延展的子任务，就会同时限制部署灵活性与策略学习；执行损失与策略损失此前未被分开刻画，无法判断何时 Markov 执行本身即最优。
Method: 提出任务树与执行树区分奖励目标、策略选择与决策中断，构造 HRL 统一价值函数 (Unified Value Function) 与四阶段广义分层 Bellman 方程 (Generalized Hierarchical Bellman Equation)；在有界奖励与一致终止 (uniform termination) 下证明分层策略与执行改进结果，并在任意层级深度实例化执行改进与一阶段/两阶段策略改进，导出行为、目标与部署三者可独立选择执行方式的分解。
Result: 在剩余节点策略固定时，任务子树兼容性与原执行模式下的节点策略最优性刻画了 Markov 执行何时最优；Option-based 与 goal-conditioned 实验展示改变执行与改变学习目标的互补增益，受控随机环境显示增益依赖随机转移强度与空间结构。
Conclusion: 执行设计应成为分层策略优化的显式组件：执行方式、学习目标与部署可各自独立选择，而非绑定在子任务承诺上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Green-Routed Neural Operators:\\Physics Determines Where the Network Reads
papers.abstract_en: We identify a mismatch between the physical role of transport fields in many PDEs and their usual role in neural operators: PDEs use them to select read coordinates, whereas neural operators typically treat them only as input values. We address this mismatch with the Green-Routed Neural Operator (GRNO), which uses the governing equation to determine where latent features are sampled. A parameter-free equation adapter evaluates the diagnostic relation and constructs a departure map whose values are the read coordinates. A multiscale encoder-decoder combines centered and routed reads of latent features to learn the complete finite-time update. Across five two- and three-dimensional PDE systems, GRNO achieves the lowest mean final relative $L^2$ error on four under 40-step autoregressive evaluation and remains competitive on Keller-Segel. Fixed-weight route interventions reveal strong dependence on direction and spatial alignment in four systems, with weak dependence in Keller-Segel. In independently trained ablations, GRNO achieves lower mean errors than variants that supply the transport field only as an input feature, substitute a learned displacement for the equation-specified route, or apply the route with a spatial misalignment, across all five systems. It also substantially outperforms directly advecting the physical state and learning the remaining update, indicating that equation-specified read coordinates provide an effective structural prior for long-horizon PDE forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRNO 把 PDE 中输运场的角色从“输入数值”改为“决定 latent 特征读取坐标”，用无参数 equation adapter 由控制方程构造 departure map 作为读取坐标，配合中心读取与路由读取的多尺度 encoder-decoder 学习有限时间更新。在五个二维/三维 PDE 系统的 40 步自回归评估中，四个系统取得最低平均最终相对 L2 误差，Keller-Segel 上仍有竞争力；消融显示方程指定读取坐标优于仅把输运场当输入、用学习位移替代路由或空间错位路由。
Motivation: 输运场在 PDE 中负责选择读取坐标，而神经算子通常只把它当输入值，这一角色错配削弱了长时程 PDE 预报的结构先验。
Method: GRNO 用参数无关的 equation adapter 求值诊断关系并构造 departure map，其值即读取坐标；多尺度 encoder-decoder 结合 latent 特征的中心读取与路由读取学习完整有限时间更新，并与仅输入输运场、学习位移替代路由、空间错位路由等独立训练消融对比。
Result: 在五个二维和三维 PDE 系统的 40 步自回归评估中，GRNO 在四个系统上取得最低平均最终相对 L2 误差，在 Keller-Segel 上保持竞争力；固定权重路由干预显示四个系统对方向与空间对齐强依赖、Keller-Segel 依赖弱；全部五个系统上 GRNO 平均误差低于三类消融变体，并显著优于直接平流物理状态再学习剩余更新的做法。
Conclusion: 方程指定的读取坐标为长时程 PDE 预报提供了有效结构先验，其收益依赖于方向与空间对齐，且在 Keller-Segel 这类系统上作用较弱。
Relevance: 35

summary_sections.result: 在五个二维和三维 PDE 系统的 40 步自回归评估中，GRNO 在四个系统上取得最低平均最终相对 L2 误差，在 Keller-Segel 上保持竞争力；固定权重路由干预显示四个系统对方向与空间对齐强依赖、Keller-Segel 依赖弱；全部五个系统上 GRNO 平均误差低于三类消融变体，并显著优于直接平流物理状态再学习剩余更新的做法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 方程指定的读取坐标为长时程 PDE 预报提供了有效结构先验，其收益依赖于方向与空间对齐，且在 Keller-Segel 这类系统上作用较弱。

papers.title: AgentDiscover: Autonomous Discovery with Minimal Search Scaffolding
papers.abstract_en: Frameworks that use large language models for scientific discovery typically rely on a fixed, human-designed algorithm that decides what the model sees at each step, leaving the model only the role of proposer. The model knows nothing of the search beyond what it is shown. As models grow more capable, a question arises: does a search strategy chosen by a human before the run scale better than promoting the model from proposer to planner and letting it own the search? The Bitter Lesson suggests that choosing the strategy in advance is the kind of hand-designed structure that general methods eventually outscale. We introduce AgentDiscover, in which a coding agent plans the search using its context as working memory, runs experiments, and records every attempt in a database of ideas, candidates, and their relations. This database serves as the agent's long-term memory and is structured so that the selection rules of classical algorithms such as MAP-Elites and Monte Carlo tree search each reduce to a single query, which the agent is free to use, combine, or replace. A server maintains the database and steers the agent after every submission, keeping it on course over long runs. In our experiments, AgentDiscover is more cost-efficient than existing frameworks, reaching better scores at lower cost. On tasks in kernel engineering, biology, algorithm design, and mathematics, AgentDiscover outperforms prior discovery frameworks. Its programs would have placed first among human competitors in seven past AtCoder heuristic contests, and on eleven mathematical and systems optimization tasks it matches or exceeds every baseline that uses the same model. Our code is available at https://github.com/mhdfb/AgentDiscover.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentDiscover 让 coding agent 自己规划搜索而非被动当 proposer：以 context 作工作记忆、把每次尝试写入 ideas/candidates 关系数据库作长期记忆，数据库结构使 MAP-Elites 与 Monte Carlo tree search 的选择规则各退化为单条查询，agent 可自由组合或替换。在 kernel engineering、biology、algorithm design、mathematics 任务上比既有 discovery 框架更省成本且分数更高；其程序在七场历史 AtCoder heuristic 竞赛中可排人类选手第一，十一个数学与系统优化任务上匹配或超过同模型的所有基线。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 科学发现框架用固定的人工设计算法决定模型每步看到什么，模型对搜索过程一无所知，只当 proposer；问题是预先选定的搜索策略是否比让模型升为 planner、自己拥有搜索更能随模型能力扩展。
Method: coding agent 用自身 context 作工作记忆来规划搜索、运行实验，并把每次尝试记录进含 ideas、candidates 及其关系的数据库作为长期记忆；数据库结构使 MAP-Elites 与 Monte Carlo tree search 的选择规则各化为单条查询，agent 可选用、组合或替换。一个 server 维护数据库并在每次提交后引导 agent，使其在长程运行中保持方向。
Result: 在 kernel engineering、biology、algorithm design、mathematics 四类任务上，AgentDiscover 比既有 discovery 框架更省成本（以更低成本达到更高分数）并优于先前的 discovery 框架；其程序在七场过去的 AtCoder heuristic 竞赛中若参赛可排人类选手第一；在十一个数学与系统优化任务上匹配或超过所有使用同一模型的基线。
Conclusion: 把搜索策略的所有权从人预先设计交给模型自己规划，是比固定人工算法更可扩展的科学发现范式，且在同等模型下已体现为成本效率与任务分数的双重优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diffusion Transformers are Provably Optimal In-context Generators
papers.abstract_en: Generative foundation models are attracting interest for their ability to produce desired outputs from demonstrations given at inference time, without updating parameters. However, since a few demonstrations cannot uniquely identify the intended task, the challenge is how to learn and sample from an output distribution that reflects this task uncertainty. In this work, we theoretically analyze how a Diffusion Transformer (DiT), pretrained across diverse tasks, learns and generates predictive distributions for a new query from demonstrations. We first show that the natural target to generate from finite demonstrations is not an output derived from estimating a single task, but rather a predictive distribution that captures the task uncertainty remaining after observing the demonstrations. We then prove that a DiT can learn this predictive distribution through score estimation, using attention to aggregate information from demonstrations and diffusion to generate samples. Owing to this property, with sufficient pretraining resources and diffusion sampling steps, the resulting DiT achieves the minimax optimal rate over a Hölder class of test-time tasks. These results imply that DiT acts as a statistically grounded in-context generator capable of generating distributions adapted to new tasks while retaining the uncertainty inherent in finite demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 在跨任务预训练后，能用 attention 聚合演示、用 diffusion 采样，通过 score estimation 学到反映任务不确定性的预测分布；在 Hölder 类测试任务上，预训练资源与扩散步数充分时达到 minimax 最优速率。
Motivation: 少量演示无法唯一确定意图任务，生成模型需要学习并采样一个反映该任务不确定性的输出分布，而这一目标此前缺少统计理论刻画。
Method: 理论上分析预训练 DiT：先论证有限演示下的正确生成目标是保留任务不确定性的预测分布，而非估计单一任务后的输出；再证明 DiT 可通过 score estimation 学到该分布，attention 聚合演示信息、diffusion 生成样本。
Result: 在充分预训练资源与充分扩散采样步数条件下，DiT 在 Hölder 类测试任务上达到 minimax 最优速率；结论为理论证明，摘要未给出实验数值。
Conclusion: DiT 可作为有统计依据的 in-context 生成器，为新任务生成适配的分布并保留有限演示固有的不确定性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Compact set-valued deep ensembling in multi-class classification
papers.abstract_en: This paper tackles visible challenges in deep ensemble learning, where deep neural networks serve as ensemble members: training and storage burdens, and robustness of cautious (set-valued) predictions targeting multiple utilities, which may involve reward-sensitivity. To mitigate the training and storage burdens, we propose to employ compact ensembles, such as Bayesian Neural Networks and Convolutional Neural Networks with the Monte-Carlo dropout prediction option, to produce probabilistic predictions. For each query instance, these probabilistic predictions are then used to define a representative distribution optimizing some statistical distance. The representative distribution is then employed to define the Bayes-optimal prediction (BOP) of any utility. To address the potential unrobustness of singleton prediction making, we propose a family of set-utilities satisfying some desirable properties and whose set-valued BOPs can be found efficiently. Empirical evidence is then given to illustrate the potential (dis)advantages of the proposed ensemble learning framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出紧凑集值深度集成：用 Bayesian Neural Network 与带 MC-dropout 的 CNN 产出概率预测，聚合成优化统计距离的代表分布，再据此求任意效用的 Bayes-optimal prediction (BOP)，并给出一族可高效求解集值 BOP 的 set-utility。目标是同时降低训练与存储开销，并让多效用下的谨慎（set-valued）预测更稳健。
Motivation: 深度集成以整个网络作为成员，训练与存储代价大；而单点预测在面向多效用、含奖励敏感性 (reward-sensitivity) 的场景下不够稳健。
Method: 以紧凑集成（Bayesian Neural Network、带 Monte-Carlo dropout 预测选项的 CNN）产生概率预测；对每个查询实例用这些预测定义一个优化统计距离的代表分布，再由该分布导出任意效用的 Bayes-optimal prediction；同时构造一族满足若干期望性质、其集值 BOP 可高效求解的 set-utility。
Result: 给出实证证据以说明该集成学习框架的潜在优势与劣势；摘要未列出具体数据集、指标或数值对比。
Conclusion: 用紧凑成员加代表分布的路线可以在降低训练与存储负担的同时支持集值、面向多效用的 Bayes-optimal 预测，但作者以实证证据同时呈现了该框架的潜在 (不)优势。

papers.title: VAMPS: Visual and Motor Policies from Sampling-Based Planning
papers.abstract_en: Learning robot policies directly on physical systems remains difficult because data collection is costly and policy exploration can be unsafe. We introduce Visual and Motor Policies from Sampling-Based Planning (VAMPS), a framework that uses Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control to train reusable policies without human demonstrations. VAMPS supports two training modes. For one-step proprioceptive policies, it operates iteratively in simulation: the policy warm-starts MPPI, and the refined trajectories provide new supervision as the policy changes. A learned terminal value improves short-horizon planning, while an Implicit Q-Learning (IQL) critic guides the policy update. Iterative refinement outperforms training once on frozen MPPI data, and we transfer the learned locomotion policy to a Unitree Go2. For visuomotor policies, VAMPS operates directly from real-robot data. MPPI uses task-specific state estimates to plan and execute trajectories while recording RGB and sensor observations on a Flexiv Rizon 10S. Action Chunking with Transformers predicts action chunks, reducing the effective prediction horizon, and is trained offline on this fixed dataset. We demonstrate visuomotor pick-and-place and force-aware whiteboard erasing. In the latter task, the policy additionally observes the measured $6$-D wrench and desired normal force. These results show that VAMPS can learn policies either in simulation followed by hardware transfer or directly from autonomously collected real-robot data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VAMPS 用 MPPI 采样规划替代人类示教来训练可复用机器人策略：本体感觉策略在仿真中迭代自举（策略热启 MPPI，精炼轨迹回灌监督，IQL critic 引导更新），视觉运动策略则直接在真机数据上离线训练。迭代精炼优于在冻结 MPPI 数据上只训一次，运动策略迁移到 Unitree Go2，并在 Flexiv Rizon 10S 上完成抓放与带 6-D wrench 的白板擦除。
Motivation: 在物理系统上直接学策略代价高且探索不安全，人类示教数据采集昂贵，需要不依赖示教的策略训练路径。
Method: 两条模式：一是在仿真中迭代训练单步本体感觉策略，策略热启 Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI)，精炼轨迹作为新监督，学习的 terminal value 改进短视程规划，Implicit Q-Learning (IQL) critic 引导策略更新；二是真机模式，MPPI 用任务特定状态估计规划执行并记录 RGB 与传感器观测，Action Chunking with Transformers 在该固定数据集上离线预测动作块以缩短有效预测视程。
Result: 迭代精炼优于在冻结 MPPI 数据上只训练一次；学到的运动策略迁移到 Unitree Go2；在 Flexiv Rizon 10S 上演示视觉运动抓放与力感知白板擦除，后者额外观测实测 6-D wrench 与期望法向力。
Conclusion: VAMPS 表明策略既可先在仿真训练再上硬件，也可直接用自主采集的真机数据训练，无需人类示教。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CT-Miner: Fast and Coarse-Grained Time-Series Pattern Mining via Cartesian Trees
papers.abstract_en: Time series often contain recurring structural patterns, and efficiently mining such patterns into compact representations is essential for scalable analysis of long sequences. Cartesian tree (CT) equivalence provides a well-established structural abstraction that preserves hierarchical order structure while discarding exact values and fine-grained ordinal variations. By grouping multiple ordinal patterns into a shared structural form, CT equivalence offers a principled way to compress recurring temporal structure. However, mining frequent CT-equivalent patterns at scale remains computationally expensive. A naive pairwise approach repeatedly constructs and counts CT representations over subsequences, requiring $O(n^4)$ time for a sequence of length $n$, which severely limits its applicability to long sequences. We propose a new Cartesian pattern mining algorithm based on a Cartesian suffix tree that compactly organizes CT-equivalent subsequences and reuses shared structural information. Our method reduces exhaustive CT-pattern occurrence collection from $O(n^4)$ to $O(n^2)$ time, and we formally prove the correctness and complexity bounds. We further show that this computational gain translates into effective compact representations. Across diverse time-series datasets, a small set of mined CT patterns preserves meaningful clustering structure, and comparisons with finer-grained order-preserving representations show that CT equivalence reduces redundant ordinal distinctions under limited feature budgets. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/hyundong98/CT-Miner .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CT-Miner 用 Cartesian suffix tree 把 CT 等价子串压缩组织并复用共享结构，将穷举 CT 模式收集从 O(n^4) 降到 O(n^2)，并给出正确性与复杂度证明。在多样时间序列数据集上，少量挖掘出的 CT 模式即可保留有意义的聚类结构，且在受限特征预算下比更细粒度的保序表示减少冗余的序数区分。
Motivation: 长序列中反复出现的结构模式挖掘代价过高：朴素两两比较需对每个子串反复构建并计数 Cartesian tree，长度 n 的序列要 O(n^4) 时间，无法用于长序列。
Method: 提出基于 Cartesian suffix tree 的 Cartesian 模式挖掘算法，把 CT 等价子串紧凑组织并复用共享结构信息，将穷举 CT 模式收集从 O(n^4) 降到 O(n^2)，并形式化证明正确性与复杂度界；实现开源在 github.com/hyundong98/CT-Miner。
Result: 复杂度从 O(n^4) 降到 O(n^2)；在多样时间序列数据集上，少量挖掘出的 CT 模式保留有意义的聚类结构，与更细粒度的保序表示相比，CT 等价在受限特征预算下减少冗余的序数区分。
Conclusion: CT 等价这种丢弃精确值与细粒度序数变化的结构抽象，可以在大幅降低挖掘代价的同时充当有效且更紧凑的序列表示。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.method: 提出基于 Cartesian suffix tree 的 Cartesian 模式挖掘算法，把 CT 等价子串紧凑组织并复用共享结构信息，将穷举 CT 模式收集从 O(n^4) 降到 O(n^2)，并形式化证明正确性与复杂度界；实现开源在 github.com/hyundong98/CT-Miner。
summary_sections.result: 复杂度从 O(n^4) 降到 O(n^2)；在多样时间序列数据集上，少量挖掘出的 CT 模式保留有意义的聚类结构，与更细粒度的保序表示相比，CT 等价在受限特征预算下减少冗余的序数区分。
summary_sections.conclusion: CT 等价这种丢弃精确值与细粒度序数变化的结构抽象，可以在大幅降低挖掘代价的同时充当有效且更紧凑的序列表示。

papers.title: Understanding the Weight Averaging Mechanism in LLM Training for Post-Training Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are typically pretrained in high precision but increasingly deployed with low-precision post-training quantization (PTQ). Recent studies have shown that using weight averaging during pretraining can improve PTQ performance compared with learning-rate decay, suggesting that it might provide a simple way to improve the pretraining-to-quantization transition. But the mechanism behind weight averaging remains insufficiently explained. This leads to inconsistent and fragile performance gains, thereby preventing practitioners from applying such a technique confidently. As a response, we formulate weight averaging as a trade-off between retaining training progress and improving robustness under perturbation. We further derive a continuous family of averaging kernels that unifies conventional strategies and achieves the Pareto frontier between the two competing goals. Critically, a theoretical framework for performing weight averaging under PTQ is developed. It can be shown that coarser quantization is more susceptible to perturbations, whereas finer quantization could be less affected. Thus, our results could provide unified theoretical guidance for performing weight averaging under different PTQ conditions. Experiments validate both the predicted behavior and the proposed averaging strategy. Code is available at https://github.com/MOFA-LAB/weight-averaging-for-ptq.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 预训练中的权重平均 (weight averaging) 形式化为「保留训练进度」与「抗扰动鲁棒性」之间的权衡，推导出一族连续 averaging kernel 统一现有策略并给出两目标的 Pareto 前沿，同时建立 PTQ 下的权重平均理论框架：量化越粗越易受扰动，量化越细受影响越小。实验验证了这一预测行为与所提平均策略。
Motivation: 预训练中做权重平均相比 learning-rate decay 能改善 PTQ 效果，但其机制解释不足，导致性能增益不一致、脆弱，从业者无法放心采用。
Method: 将权重平均建模为训练进度保留与扰动鲁棒性的权衡问题；推导一族连续 averaging kernel，统一常规平均策略并刻画二者的 Pareto 前沿；在此之上建立面向 PTQ 的权重平均理论框架，分析量化粒度与扰动敏感度的关系；配套代码见 github.com/MOFA-LAB/weight-averaging-for-ptq。
Result: 理论给出：更粗的量化 (coarser quantization) 更易受扰动影响，更细的量化受影响较小；实验验证了该预测行为以及所提出的 averaging 策略。
Conclusion: 权重平均的收益可由「进度保留 vs. 扰动鲁棒」这一权衡统一解释，所得理论可针对不同 PTQ 条件给出一致的权重平均指导。

papers.title: Quantitative Universality of Approximate Message Passing for Rank-One Quadratic Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Approximate Message Passing (AMP) algorithms are attractive as they are computationally efficient and simultaneously admit a precise characterization in terms of the low-dimensional "state-evolution" recursion. In this work, we establish quantitative universality for AMP with centered rank-one sensing matrices $Z_i=(x_ix_i^\top-I_d)/\sqrt d$, where $x_i$ are independent standard Gaussian vectors. These matrices arise in quadratic regression and learning quadratic neural networks. Their normalized vectorizations have isotropic covariance in dimension $p=d(d+1)/2$, but strongly dependent coordinates. For linear observations with Gaussian noise and prescribed smooth, bounded spectral denoisers, we compare rank-one sensing with a covariance-matched isotropic Gaussian ensemble. At a fixed iteration horizon, with $n\leq Cp$ and uniform bounds on the normalized signal energy, initialization, coefficients, and first four denoiser derivatives, normalized signal overlaps, cross-time overlaps, and smooth linear spectral statistics differ by $O(d^{-1/2})$ in every fixed $L^m$. This yields universality of the normalized mean-squared error, fixed spectral moments, and empirical spectral distributions. Whenever the Gaussian observables admit a joint state-evolution limit, the same predictions hold under rank-one sensing. The proof uses columnwise Lindeberg replacement, leave-one-out analysis, smooth spectral expansions, and high-moment concentration. For prescribed smooth spectral denoisers, the result establishes the AMP universality conjectured by Maillard et al. (arXiv:2408.03733).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明秩一二次感知矩阵 Z_i=(x_i x_i^T−I_d)/√d 下 AMP 的定量普适性：在固定迭代步、n≤Cp 及信号能量与去噪器前四阶导数一致有界时，归一化信号重叠、跨时间重叠与光滑线性谱统计量与协方差匹配的各向同性高斯系综相差 O(d^{-1/2})（每个固定 L^m 意义下）。由此 MSE、固定谱矩与经验谱分布普适成立，并确立 Maillard et al. (arXiv:2408.03733) 猜想的 AMP 普适性。
Motivation: 秩一二次感知矩阵的向量化虽各向同性协方差但坐标强相关，AMP 的 state-evolution 精确刻画此前只在高斯系综下建立；二次回归与二次神经网络学习依赖这类矩阵，需要把高斯预测迁移到真实秩一模型。
Method: 在高斯线性观测与给定光滑有界谱型去噪器 (spectral denoisers) 下，将秩一感知与协方差匹配的各向同性高斯系综比较；证明工具为逐列 Lindeberg 替换 (columnwise Lindeberg replacement)、leave-one-out 分析、光滑谱展开与高阶矩集中。
Result: 固定迭代步、n≤Cp 且归一化信号能量、初始化、系数与去噪器前四阶导数一致有界时，归一化信号重叠、跨时间重叠与光滑线性谱统计量在每个固定 L^m 中相差 O(d^{-1/2})；由此归一化 MSE、固定谱矩与经验谱分布普适，且只要高斯观测量存在联合 state-evolution 极限，秩一感知下给出相同预测。
Conclusion: 秩一二次感知下 AMP 的 state-evolution 预测在定量意义下与高斯系综普适一致，从而确立 Maillard et al. (arXiv:2408.03733) 所猜想的 AMP 普适性，适用范围限于给定的光滑谱型去噪器与固定迭代步。

papers.title: Riemannian Shape Analysis of the Corpus Callosum in Kendall Space: Aging and Alzheimer's Disease
papers.abstract_en: The corpus callosum (CC) is a major white-matter structure and a well-established marker of brain aging, but most studies quantify it using scalar summaries that discard its boundary geometry. We present a Riemannian shape-space framework for analyzing age-related morphological change in the midsagittal CC, applied to the OASIS-1 cohort. Each contour is represented by $128$ landmarks and embedded into Kendall shape space, where translation, rotation, and scale are removed. We derive a multivariate geodesic regression with exact Riemannian gradients and use the fitted age-velocity field to localize age-related deformation to five anatomical sub-regions. In the cognitively normal cohort ($n = 252$), geodesic regression outperforms the Euclidean linear benchmark ($R^2 = 0.1355$ vs.\ $0.1216$). Regional energy is posterior-dominant: the Splenium carries $41.4\%$ and the Isthmus $23.8\%$ of total age-related shape change, together accounting for $\sim 65\%$ despite comprising only $\sim 35\%$ of landmarks. Signed projections confirm the ordering (Splenium $r = 0.570$; Isthmus $r = 0.473$). In contrast, age explains less than $0.5\%$ of shape variance in Alzheimer's disease ($n = 88$), indicating that the disease disrupts the healthy aging trajectory. A tangent-space classifier achieves an age-group AUC of $0.791$ from the 2D contour alone, exceeding a recent volumetric benchmark ($0.67$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把胼胝体中矢状面轮廓用 128 个 landmark 嵌入 Kendall 形状空间，推导带精确 Riemann 梯度的多元测地回归，用拟合的年龄速度场把年龄相关形变定位到五个解剖亚区。在 OASIS-1 认知正常组 (n=252) 上 R²=0.1355，高于欧氏线性基线 0.1216；Splenium 与 Isthmus 合计承担约 65% 的年龄相关形状变化，而 AD 组 (n=88) 年龄仅解释不到 0.5% 的形状方差。
Motivation: 多数胼胝体研究用标量摘要（如体积）刻画其形态，丢弃边界几何，无法把年龄相关形变定位到具体解剖亚区，也难以刻画阿尔茨海默病对健康老化轨迹的破坏。
Method: 每个中矢状面 CC 轮廓取 128 个 landmark，嵌入去除平移、旋转、尺度的 Kendall 形状空间；推导带精确 Riemann 梯度的多元测地回归 (multivariate geodesic regression)，用拟合的年龄速度场把形变分配到五个解剖亚区，并用 signed projection 与切空间分类器做验证；数据为 OASIS-1 队列。
Result: 认知正常组 n=252 上测地回归 R²=0.1355，优于欧氏线性基线 0.1216；区域能量上 Splenium 占 41.4%、Isthmus 占 23.8%，两者合计约 65% 而仅占约 35% 的 landmark；signed projection 相关系数 Splenium r=0.570、Isthmus r=0.473；AD 组 n=88 中年龄解释的形状方差不足 0.5%；仅用 2D 轮廓的切空间分类器年龄组 AUC=0.791，高于近期体积基线 0.67。
Conclusion: 健康老化中 CC 形状变化以后部（Splenium、Isthmus）为主导，而阿尔茨海默病破坏了这一健康老化轨迹；仅凭 2D 轮廓几何即可在年龄组判别上超过体积类特征。

papers.title: Shadow Feature Refinement Network: Progressive Feature Refinement based on Knowledge Distillation for Effective Shadow Removal
papers.abstract_en: In the field of deep learning, has seen significant advancements; however, shadow removal remains a persistent challenge owing to the variable sizes and colors of shadows influenced by lighting conditions. This study proposes a novel shadow feature refinement network (SFR-Net), which leverages supervised learning, feature refinement loss, and knowledge distillation to enhance shadow removal performance. A dedicated post-processing algorithm is further introduced to restore natural color consistency in the generated shadow-free images. We evaluated our method on two public datasets: the adjusted image shadow triplet dataset (ISTD+) and the shadow removal dataset (SRD), which demonstrate strong generalization capabilities under diverse conditions. On ISTD+, our model achieved a root mean square error (RMSE) of 3.4627 and structural similarity index measure (SSIM) of 0.9382 across the entire image. On SRD, it recorded an RMSE of 4.3781 and an SSIM of 0.9341. These comprehensive results show that our approach performs competitively across both shadow and non-shadow regions while setting a promising direction for robust and perceptually natural shadow removal. Code is available at https://github.com/DongHyun99/SFRNet.
papers.journal_ref: Multimedia Systems, 31(6), 449 (2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出阴影去除网络 SFR-Net，用监督学习加特征细化损失 (feature refinement loss) 与知识蒸馏逐步细化阴影特征，再用后处理算法恢复无阴影图像的自然色彩一致性。在 ISTD+ 上整图 RMSE 3.4627、SSIM 0.9382，在 SRD 上 RMSE 4.3781、SSIM 0.9341，阴影区与非阴影区表现均衡。
Motivation: 光照条件导致阴影尺寸与颜色多变，使深度学习阴影去除仍不稳定，且去除后容易丢失自然色彩一致性。
Method: SFR-Net 以监督学习训练，结合 feature refinement loss 与知识蒸馏 (knowledge distillation) 做渐进式特征细化；另加一个后处理算法专门恢复生成图像的色彩一致性。
Result: ISTD+ 整图 RMSE 3.4627、SSIM 0.9382；SRD 上 RMSE 4.3781、SSIM 0.9341；作者称在阴影区与非阴影区均具竞争力，并在两种条件下展现较强泛化。
Conclusion: 渐进式特征细化加色彩后处理能在 ISTD+ 与 SRD 两个公开数据集上取得稳健且视觉自然的阴影去除效果，代码已开源。
