papers.title: CoDance: Learning Reactive and Compliant Human-Humanoid Interaction from Video
papers.abstract_en: Partnered human-humanoid interaction couples locomotion with continuous physical contact. A humanoid needs to coordinate with a person's motion while responding to interaction forces and maintaining stable and natural movement. We present CoDance, a framework for learning reactive and compliant human-humanoid interaction from video. We study partnered dancing as a challenging instantiation, where a humanoid coordinates its footsteps with a moving partner and maintains continuous two-hand contact. Given a single video of two human dancers, CoDance retargets their motions into a robot reference and a moving partner. We introduce a multi-link compliance augmentation that transforms the kinematic demonstration into force-aware training data by adapting the robot reference under structured forces at both hands. Policies trained on this data follow the observed partner while preserving the demonstrated locomotion style and responding compliantly to physical interaction. In simulation, the policies adapt their footsteps to changes in the partner and reproduce approximately 80% of the wrist displacement encoded by the augmented demonstrations. On a physical humanoid, CoDance enables sustained two-hand dancing with a human partner including repeated transitions between forward and backward motions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoDance 从单段双人舞蹈视频学出人机双人舞策略：把两人动作重定向为机器人参考与移动伙伴，再用双手结构化外力下的多链路柔顺增强把运动学示范改写成带力的训练数据。仿真中策略随伙伴变化调整步态，复现增强示范约 80% 的腕部位移；实体人形机器人上实现与人持续双手共舞，含前后向反复切换。
Motivation: 人机伙伴协作要同时耦合移动与持续物理接触，机器人既要跟随人的运动又要对交互力做出柔顺响应并保持稳定自然，仅靠运动学示范无法提供接触力信息。
Method: 给定一段两人共舞视频，CoDance 将其重定向为机器人参考与移动伙伴轨迹；引入多链路柔顺增强 (multi-link compliance augmentation)，在双手施加结构化力下修正机器人参考，把运动学示范转成力感知训练数据，再据此训练策略。

Conclusion: 把视频示范经结构化外力增强改写为力感知数据，足以让实体人形学出既保持示范移动风格又对物理交互柔顺响应的伙伴协作策略。

papers.title: Grammar-Guided Code Watermarking with Green Temperature
papers.abstract_en: Large language model watermarking embeds detectable statistical signals during decoding, but the resulting changes to token probabilities can degrade generation quality. This trade-off is particularly important for code, where small changes in token selection can break syntax or alter program behavior. Existing code watermarking methods mitigate this risk through entropy-based insertion or syntax-aware token selection, but they do not directly construct the watermark over the set of continuations admitted by the current grammar state. We propose Grammar-Guided Code Watermarking with Green Temperature (GTCW), which integrates grammar-constrained decoding with probability-aware watermarking. At each decoding step, GTCW restricts the candidate set to grammar-admissible tokens and partitions this support into keyed green and red subsets. At eligible high-entropy positions, green temperature reweights the green tokens according to the model's relative preferences, strengthening the watermark signal while retaining the grammar constraint. Across five models and five benchmarks spanning four programming languages, GTCW achieves a mean AUROC of 73.61%, compared with 67.83% for the strongest baseline, while maintaining a mean Pass@1 of 59.18% versus 59.58% for unwatermarked generation. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/hyundong98/GTCW .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GTCW 把语法约束解码与概率感知水印结合：每步只在语法允许的 token 支撑集上划分 keyed green/red 子集，并在高熵位置用 green temperature 按模型相对偏好重加权 green token，在保住语法的同时增强水印信号。跨 5 个模型、5 个基准、4 种编程语言，平均 AUROC 73.61%（最强基线 67.83%），平均 Pass@1 59.18% 对无水印生成的 59.58%。
Motivation: LLM 水印在解码期改动 token 概率会损害生成质量，代码场景下微小的 token 选择变化就可能破坏语法或改变程序行为；现有方法用熵驱动插入或语法感知选 token，但没有直接在当前语法状态所允许的续写集合上构造水印。
Method: GTCW 在每个解码步把候选集限制为 grammar-admissible tokens，并将该支撑划分为带密钥的 green 与 red 子集；在符合条件的高熵位置，green temperature 依据模型的相对偏好对 green token 重加权，从而在维持语法约束的前提下强化水印信号。
Result: 在 5 个模型、5 个基准、4 种编程语言上，GTCW 平均 AUROC 73.61%，最强基线为 67.83%；平均 Pass@1 59.18%，无水印生成为 59.58%。
Conclusion: 在语法允许的续写集合上直接构造水印并做概率感知重加权，可以在几乎不牺牲代码可用性（Pass@1 仅差 0.4 个百分点）的情况下把检测 AUROC 提到 73.61%。

papers.title: When Does Longer Reasoning Help? Predicting Mathematical Reasoning Through Discovery and Execution
papers.abstract_en: Test-time compute can improve mathematical reasoning, but can short-budget runs predict how mathematical reasoning scales with additional compute? We introduce a Discovery--Execution (DE) framework that predicts the aggregate held-out scaling curves through a convolution of strategy discovery and conditional execution. From independent short-budget attempts and oracle-sketch-conditioned runs, the framework estimates cumulative success along held-out reasoning trajectories under alternate compute allocations. We evaluate four models on 35 fresh Olympiad problems and non-geometry problems from IMO-ProofBench Advanced. Under the DE framework, near-saturated execution predicts geometric scaling, as observed for the GPT models. For Claude Opus 4.8, incorporating measured execution substantially improves held-out forecasts over geometric extrapolation across one- and two-arm allocations. As a secondary application, regularized DE (R-DE) decisions to continue or restart yield lower average regret than the best model-specific retrospective policy. Together, these results show that measuring conditional execution provides information about longer reasoning that short-budget success rates do not always capture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Discovery--Execution (DE) 框架，把短预算下的策略发现与条件执行成功率做卷积，从而预测数学推理随测试时算力增长的 held-out scaling 曲线。在 35 道新奥赛题与 IMO-ProofBench Advanced 非几何题、四个模型上，执行接近饱和时曲线呈几何增长（GPT 系列）；Claude Opus 4.8 上用实测执行替代几何外推显著改善一臂与二臂算力分配的预测，R-DE 的继续/重启决策平均 regret 低于最优模型特定回溯策略。
Motivation: 测试时算力能提升数学推理，但短预算运行的成功率未必能预测加算力后的表现；需要判断何时更长推理真正有收益。
Method: DE 框架由独立短预算尝试与 oracle-sketch 条件运行分别估计策略发现和条件执行，再卷积出 held-out 推理轨迹在不同算力分配下的累计成功；扩展版 R-DE 用于继续或重启的决策。
Result: 在 35 道新奥赛题与 IMO-ProofBench Advanced 非几何题上评估四个模型：执行近饱和时预测几何 scaling（GPT 模型即如此）；Claude Opus 4.8 上纳入实测执行使 held-out 预测在 one-arm 与 two-arm 分配上明显优于几何外推；R-DE 决策的平均 regret 低于最佳模型特定回溯策略。
Conclusion: 测量条件执行能捕捉短预算成功率所遗漏的长推理信息，因此预测算力 scaling 时应把执行与发现分开建模，而非直接几何外推。

papers.title: Robust Parameter-Efficient LLM Adaptation on Analog Hardware
papers.abstract_en: Analog in-memory computing is a promising platform for on-device execution of large language models because it performs matrix--vector multiplications (MVMs) in memory and in parallel, reducing data movement. However, limited digital-to-analog converter precision, input noise, and finite conductance states can degrade model accuracy, while full-model retraining to address these effects can be costly. We develop an optimizer-agnostic, parameter-efficient adaptation method based on Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), keeping the pretrained weights stored on analog arrays fixed while training the LoRA weights to adapt to downstream tasks and hardware non-idealities. Reliable adaptation requires handling errors in both forward and backward MVMs and physical weight updates. We use input reshaping to reduce input-induced MVM errors and update accumulation to retain small updates before programming them to finite-state analog devices. Across Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct and Llama-3-8B with both Muon and AdamW, input reshaping improves analog LoRA fine-tuning under noisy MVM computation. Update accumulation separately preserves sub-threshold updates and substantially improves adaptation under finite-resolution programming, including configurations with as few as 20 conductance states. Additional experiments show consistent held-out negative log-likelihood improvements across noisy analog settings.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints (ODI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在模拟存内计算 (analog in-memory computing) 硬件上做 LoRA 微调时，输入整型 (input reshaping) 抑制输入引入的 MVM 误差，更新累积 (update accumulation) 在写入有限电导态前保留低于阈值的小更新，两者共同使 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 与 Llama-3-8B 在 Muon 和 AdamW 下都能在含噪 MVM 与有限分辨率编程（低至 20 个电导态）条件下可靠适配。
Motivation: 模拟阵列上的 DAC 精度有限、输入噪声与有限电导态会拉低模型精度，而全模型重训代价高；LoRA 适配又必须同时处理前向、反向 MVM 误差和物理权重更新误差。
Method: 提出优化器无关的参数高效适配方法：冻结存储在模拟阵列上的预训练权重，只训练 LoRA 权重以同时适配下游任务与硬件非理想性；前向/反向用 input reshaping 降低输入诱导的 MVM 误差，物理写入端用 update accumulation 先累积小更新再编程到有限态器件。
Result: 在 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 与 Llama-3-8B、Muon 与 AdamW 两种优化器下，input reshaping 改善了含噪 MVM 计算中的模拟 LoRA 微调；update accumulation 单独改善了有限分辨率编程下的适配，包括低至 20 个电导态的配置；追加实验显示各含噪模拟设置下 held-out negative log-likelihood 一致改善。
Conclusion: 只要在前向/反向误差和物理写入误差两端分别做 input reshaping 与 update accumulation，冻结模拟权重的 LoRA 就能在低精度模拟硬件上稳定适配，无需全模型重训。

papers.title: Transferable Adversarial Robustness for Speech Foundation Models via Hierarchical Stabilization
papers.abstract_en: Frozen speech foundation models (SFMs) make downstream adaptation efficient: the backbone can stay fixed while a task learns layer fusion and a lightweight classifier. Full adversarial fine-tuning is a standard route to robustness, but generating adversarial examples and updating the backbone for every task sacrifices that efficiency. We ask whether robustness can instead be learned before future tasks are known. For a frozen backbone and linear classifier, robustness can be understood through the interaction between representation stability and decision-boundary margin. This leads directly to our design: we stabilize representations across the hidden layers, rather than only the final layer, while preserving clean representations; after clean adaptation selects the layer mixture, we keep it fixed and enlarge only the classifier margin, without downstream adversarial examples. We evaluate Wav2Vec2, HuBERT, and WavLM Large on four tasks under adaptive 30 dB attacks. Across 12 backbone-task pairs, hierarchical robustification improves robust accuracy by 46.4 pp, while margin refinement adds 4.0 pp for 1.1 pp of clean accuracy. Code and configurations are available at https://github.com/arefmousavi/hierarchical-robust-sfm.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结语音基础模型 (SFM) 上，把对抗鲁棒性拆成跨隐藏层的表征稳定性与分类器间隔两步：先在干净适配选定的层混合上稳定各层表征并保持干净表征不变，再固定层混合、只放大分类器间隔，全程不需要下游对抗样本。在 Wav2Vec2、HuBERT、WavLM Large 的四个任务、30 dB 自适应攻击下，12 个 backbone-task 组合的鲁棒准确率合计提升 46.4 pp，间隔细化再加 4.0 pp，代价是 1.1 pp 干净准确率。
Motivation: 冻结 SFM 让下游适配只需学层融合与轻量分类器，但完整对抗微调要为每个任务生成对抗样本并更新主干，把这份效率牺牲掉；问题是在未来任务未知时能否提前学到可迁移的鲁棒性。
Method: 对冻结主干与线性分类器，把鲁棒性建模为表征稳定性与决策间隔的交互：跨全部隐藏层稳定表征并保持干净表征，干净适配先选出层混合后固定，随后只增大分类器间隔，不使用下游对抗样本。
Result: 在 Wav2Vec2、HuBERT、WavLM Large 上的四个任务、30 dB 自适应攻击设置下，12 个 backbone-task 对中层级鲁棒化 (hierarchical robustification) 使鲁棒准确率提升 46.4 pp，间隔细化 (margin refinement) 再提升 4.0 pp，同时损失 1.1 pp 干净准确率。
Conclusion: 鲁棒性可以在任务未知前、于冻结主干上分层学得：先稳表征再扩间隔即可在不引入下游对抗样本的情况下获得可迁移的对抗鲁棒性，代价是小幅干净准确率下降。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kinematics-Centric Continuous Sign Language Retrieval with Gloss-Guided Boundary-Aware Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Sign language-text alignment remains a fundamental challenge for text-driven sign language understanding. Existing methods predominantly rely on appearance-heavy RGB representations, which entangle motion semantics with visual variations and lead to ambiguous motion-language grounding. In this paper, we reformulate sign language-text alignment in a structured kinematic space and propose a kinematics-centric framework that adopts 3D SMPL-X motion as the primary representation. By explicitly modeling the kinematic dynamics of signing in a unified motion space, our approach reduces reliance on appearance signals and yields more semantically consistent representations. To capture the compositional nature of sign language, we introduce a gloss-guided local alignment mechanism that leverages gloss temporal spans as weak supervision to decompose continuous motion into coherent segments and establish fine-grained motion-text correspondences, thereby reducing ambiguity in localizing word-level semantics in continuous signing. Furthermore, we develop a visual distillation strategy, where RGB signals serve as privileged supervision during training to provide complementary contextual cues, while being completely removed at inference time. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art bidirectional retrieval performance on CSL-Daily and competitive results on PHOENIX-2014T. These results highlight the effectiveness of kinematic representations and explicit local grounding for sign language-text alignment.

papers.title: Characterizing Parallelism Strategies in LLM Inference: Fundamental Compute-Communication Trade-offs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) inference has become the dominant workload in modern AI systems, requiring serving infrastructures to maximize throughput while meeting strict latency Service-Level Objectives (SLOs). Since state-of-the-art LLMs exceed the compute and memory capacity of a single GPU, inference is commonly distributed across multiple GPUs using tensor parallelism (TP), pipeline parallelism (PP), or hybrid parallelism (HB). However, selecting the most effective parallelism strategy remains challenging due to complex interactions among computation, communication, pipeline utilization, sequence length, batch size, and model architecture. Existing approaches largely rely on empirical evaluation and provide limited analytical insight into the trade-offs among these strategies, particularly across the distinct prefill and decoding phases of inference. In this paper, we present a unified analytical framework for modeling distributed LLM inference under TP, PP, and HB. The framework decomposes end-to-end latency into computation, inter-GPU communication, and pipeline bubble overhead, and derives analytical models that capture TP collective communication, PP point-to-point communication, and pipeline utilization as functions of hardware, model, and workload characteristics. The model further characterizes the differing execution behavior of prefill and decoding, explaining why PP-oriented configurations favor compute-intensive prefill while TP-oriented configurations reduce decoding latency by eliminating pipeline bubbles. Experiments with modern LLMs on multi-GPU platforms validate the model and confirm the fundamental compute-communication trade-off across parallelism strategies. The framework provides practical guidance for parallelism selection, capacity planning, and optimization of future LLM serving systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出统一解析框架，把分布式 LLM 推理的端到端延迟分解为计算、GPU 间通信与流水线气泡三部分，分别建模 TP 集合通信、PP 点对点通信与流水线利用率。框架解释了 PP 型配置偏向计算密集的 prefill、TP 型配置通过消除气泡降低 decoding 延迟，并在多 GPU 平台上的现代 LLM 实验中得到验证，确认并行策略间存在根本的计算-通信权衡。
Motivation: 现有选择 TP/PP/HB 并行策略的方式多依赖经验试测，缺少对计算、通信、流水线利用率、序列长度、batch size 与模型结构之间交互的解析理解，尤其未区分 prefill 与 decoding 两个阶段。
Method: 构建统一解析框架：将端到端延迟分解为计算、跨 GPU 通信与 pipeline bubble 开销，推导作为硬件、模型与工作负载特征函数的 TP collective 通信模型、PP 点对点通信模型与流水线利用率模型，并分别刻画 prefill 与 decoding 的执行行为差异。
Result: 在多 GPU 平台上用现代 LLM 实验验证该模型，确认了并行策略间根本的计算-通信权衡；模型解释了 PP 型配置有利于计算密集的 prefill，而 TP 型配置通过消除 pipeline bubble 降低 decoding 延迟。
Conclusion: 并行策略选择可由解析模型而非纯经验评测来指导，用于并行选择、容量规划与未来 LLM serving 系统优化；prefill 与 decoding 应分别对待以匹配各自的计算-通信特征。

papers.title: ASCENT: Online Test-Time Training of Long-Horizon Agents via Self-Distillation of Verified Experience
papers.abstract_en: A large language model (LLM) agent solves long-horizon tasks through many reasoning-action turns, with one verification signal at termination. Deployed agents face streams of related tasks, making their trajectories a natural resource for improvement. In-context adaptation agents store reflections, memories, or skills as text, so reuse depends on retrieving the right experience and on a frozen policy executing it. We study Online Agentic Test-Time Training (OaTTT), which trains the LLM's weights on its own execution trajectories during deployment. The agent executes each task once, in one pass over the stream, and the executed trajectory with its verification result is the only learning signal for weight updates that persist across tasks. Directly imitating or reinforcing the generated tokens of this single attempt destabilizes the policy. We introduce ASCENT (Agentic Self-distillation for Cross-task EvolutioN at Test-time), which instead self-distills verified experience. A stable version of the LLM, its frozen initial copy, receives the verified trajectory as privileged information and predicts next-token distributions along it with this hindsight. Distilling them into persistent LoRA fast weights updates the agent for later tasks, without an external reference solution or stronger teacher. By further removing invalid-action turns, ASCENT distills enhanced privileged experience for more efficient execution. We characterize its population target and the limits of sparse outcome selection. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and AppWorld at varied model scales, ASCENT improves task success and interaction efficiency as experience accumulates, outperforms online adaptation methods, and transfers to held-out scenes, showing that an agent can consolidate verified experience into its weights without a separate training phase or memory retrieval. Project page: https://artificer-ai-lab.github.io/ASCENT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASCENT 让 LLM agent 在部署时用自身已验证轨迹做自蒸馏式测试时训练：冻结的初始模型副本以事后视角（hindsight）预测轨迹上的下一词分布，蒸馏进持久 LoRA 权重，从而跨任务更新策略。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、AppWorld 上随经验积累提升任务成功率与交互效率，优于在线适应方法并迁移到 held-out 场景。
Motivation: 长时程 agent 每个任务只有终止时一个验证信号，而基于文本的反思/记忆复用依赖检索命中且策略本身冻结；直接模仿或强化单次尝试的 token 会使策略不稳定。
Method: 在线单遍执行任务流，仅用执行轨迹加验证结果做跨任务权重更新；冻结的初始模型副本把已验证轨迹当特权信息做 hindsight 下一词预测，把分布蒸馏进持久 LoRA fast weights，无需外部参考解或更强教师；再剔除无效动作轮次以蒸馏增强后的特权经验，并给出其总体目标与稀疏结果选择的极限刻画。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、AppWorld 及多种模型规模上，任务成功率与交互效率随经验积累提升，优于在线适应方法，并迁移到 held-out 场景；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: agent 可以把已验证经验直接固化进权重，无需单独训练阶段或记忆检索；直接对单次尝试做模仿/强化会失稳，而 hindsight 自蒸馏是可行替代。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MESH-Harness: Self-Improving Agent Harnesses via Bandit-Guided Compositional Evolution
papers.abstract_en: An agent harness is the code that organizes context, maintains state, and coordinates tool calls for a language model. We study how to improve the harness under a limited evaluation budget while keeping model weights fixed. Our method, MESH-Harness, organizes each harness into functional modules with explicit role-specific interfaces, allowing alternative implementations of each module to be substituted and recombined. It uses shared module representations and full-covariance LinUCB to score candidate combinations based on predicted performance and exploration value. Mixed-start coordinate ascent selects complete configurations for evaluation without enumerating the combinatorial space. Validation traces then guide local code edits, and the resulting candidates are incorporated into fixed-capacity role-specific pools for subsequent recombination. On text tasks, retrieval-augmented mathematical reasoning, code generation, and interactive scientific tasks, MESH-Harness outperforms Meta-Harness by 5.70, 7.01, 2.00, and 5.00 points, respectively, under matched candidate-evaluation budgets. Iterative harness optimization improves MESH-Harness by 5.63-7.79 points over its first-round configurations. For the reported configurations, aggregate test-time cost is 44.2% lower than that of Meta-Harness, while total cost including search is 14.6% lower. These results show that combining module-level design reuse with feedback-driven compositional search can systematically improve agent harnesses while keeping overall optimization cost under control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MESH-Harness 把 agent harness 拆成带显式角色接口的功能模块，用共享模块表示加全协方差 LinUCB 打分候选组合，再以 mixed-start 坐标上升选出待评估配置，并用验证轨迹驱动局部代码编辑。在匹配的候选评估预算下，它在文本任务、检索增强数学推理、代码生成与交互式科学任务上分别比 Meta-Harness 高 5.70、7.01、2.00、5.00 分，且报告配置的总测试时成本低 44.2%、含搜索的总成本低 14.6%。
Motivation: 在模型权重固定、评估预算受限的条件下改进 agent harness，组合空间巨大无法穷举，而现有方法缺少模块级复用与反馈驱动的搜索机制。
Method: 将 harness 组织为带角色专用接口的功能模块，允许替换与重组；用共享模块表示和全协方差 LinUCB 依据预测性能与探索价值给候选组合打分，mixed-start 坐标上升在不枚举组合空间的情况下选出完整配置；验证轨迹引导局部代码编辑，产出候选进入固定容量的角色专用池供后续重组。
Result: 在匹配候选评估预算下，文本任务、检索增强数学推理、代码生成、交互式科学任务上分别超过 Meta-Harness 5.70、7.01、2.00、5.00 分；迭代优化相对首轮配置提升 5.63–7.79 分；报告配置的聚合测试时成本比 Meta-Harness 低 44.2%，含搜索的总成本低 14.6%。
Conclusion: 模块级设计复用与反馈驱动的组合搜索结合，可以在固定模型权重下系统性提升 agent harness，并把整体优化成本控制住。

papers.title: Revisiting Ground-Truth Synthesis from High-Speed Video: Exact Validity Conditions and an Audited Consumer Capture Corpus
papers.abstract_en: Motion-deblurring datasets are commonly synthesised by averaging $N$ consecutive high-frame-rate frames and labelling the result with the central frame. We show that this label is unbiased for every capture timing only when the window is odd and the frames' sample durations are equal. An even window shifts every label by a fixed fraction of the blur length, even under perfect timing. Unequal durations are subtler: their mean misalignment is zero, so dataset statistics cannot reveal them, yet when the offset cannot be read from the blur they convolve the supervision rather than adding noise to it. Auditing 51 smartphone clips recorded at a nominal 240 fps, we find 19 captured near 176 fps, a behaviour recorded only in the container's timing tables. In a controlled test the parity choice costs a fitted linear deblurring filter far more than these timing irregularities do, and interpolation labels, unlike blur labels, can be repaired with the true frame times. We provide a tool that checks both conditions without decoding, and will release the clips and their timing tables.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 运动去模糊数据集用 N 帧高速视频均值并以中心帧为标签时，只有当窗口为奇数且各帧采样时长相等才对所有拍摄时序无偏；偶数窗口会把每个标签固定平移模糊长度的一个分数，时长不等则把监督信息卷积而非加噪。对 51 段手机视频审计发现 19 段实际约 176 fps（标称 240 fps），但受控测试中窗口奇偶性对线性去模糊滤波器的代价远大于这些时序不规则。
Motivation: 高速视频合成去模糊标签的无偏性条件此前未被明确刻画，偶数窗口与时长不等造成的标签错位会污染监督，且时长不等的平均错位为零、数据集统计无法察觉。
Method: 从标签无偏性出发推导窗口奇偶与采样时长两个精确条件；审计 51 段标称 240 fps 的手机视频的容器时序表；用受控测试比较奇偶选择与时序不规则对拟合线性去模糊滤波器的影响；提供无需解码即可检查两个条件的工具。
Result: 51 段手机视频中 19 段实际约 176 fps，该行为只记录在容器时序表里；受控测试中窗口奇偶选择对拟合线性去模糊滤波器的代价远大于时序不规则；插值标签可用真实帧时间修复，而模糊标签不能。
Conclusion: 去模糊标签无偏需要奇数窗口加等采样时长两个条件同时成立，且应优先保证奇偶性；将发布片段、时序表与检查工具。

papers.title: Do Neural Networks Learn Structure-Preserving Maps? A Case Study in Latent-to-Hilbert Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: We ask whether a neural network can learn a structure-preserving map from a compressed latent space to a Hilbert-space representation. Using an 8-dimensional autoencoder bottleneck on MNIST and $n$-qubit product-state targets from PCA-based angle encoding, we report four findings. Although the target angles are generated by a nonlinear sigmoid transformation of the latent projections, the resulting mapping is well approximated by a linear function over the observed latent distribution: linear regression from $z$ to the true target angles achieves $R^{2} = 0.98$, while regression to the MLP's recovered angles achieves $R^{2} = 0.91$. The learned map's primary direction is strongly aligned with the target-induced direction, with cosine similarity $0.989$, while remaining nearly orthogonal to the input's principal direction, with cosine similarity $0.002$. The map is genuinely rank-4: removing any singular direction degrades inner-product preservation by $2.5$--$5.9\times$ despite a singular-value spectrum with two dominant and two small values. The learned subspace does not coincide with the PCA basis used to construct the target, and different random seeds recover the same primary direction but diverge in higher ranks. Finally, kernel ridge regression with an RBF kernel outperforms a tuned MLP (IP error $0.0144$ vs.\ $0.0197$), suggesting that for approximately linear structure-preserving mappings, classical kernel methods may be a simpler and more effective alternative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MNIST 8 维 autoencoder 瓶颈到 n-qubit product-state（PCA angle encoding）的映射上，看似非线性的 sigmoid 目标角度在观测潜分布内其实近似线性：从 z 线性回归真实角度 R²=0.98，回归 MLP 恢复角度 R²=0.91。学习到的映射主方向与目标诱导方向余弦相似度 0.989、与输入主方向近乎正交 0.002，且真实 rank-4：删掉任一奇异方向使内积保持误差恶化 2.5–5.9 倍。RBF kernel ridge regression 的 IP error 0.0144 优于调参 MLP 的 0.0197，说明这类近线性保结构映射用经典核方法更简单有效。
Motivation: 神经网络能否从压缩潜空间学到保持内积结构的映射到 Hilbert 空间表示，其有效线性度与真实秩未知；若映射近似线性，深度 MLP 可能是过度参数化的选择。
Method: 用 MNIST 上 8 维 autoencoder bottleneck 作潜空间，目标为 PCA-based angle encoding 构造的 n-qubit product state；对潜变量 z 到目标角度做线性回归与 MLP 回归对照，分析学习映射的主方向（与目标诱导方向、输入主方向的 cosine similarity）、奇异值谱与秩，并比较调参 MLP 与 RBF kernel ridge regression 的内积保持误差。
Result: 线性回归 z→真实目标角度 R²=0.98，回归 MLP 恢复角度 R²=0.91；映射主方向与目标诱导方向 cosine similarity 0.989，与输入主方向 0.002；映射为 rank-4，删除任一奇异方向使 inner-product preservation 退化 2.5–5.9 倍（奇异值谱为两个主导值加两个小值）；学习子空间与构造目标所用 PCA basis 不重合，不同随机种子恢复相同主方向但在更高秩上发散；RBF kernel ridge regression IP error 0.0144 优于调参 MLP 的 0.0197。
Conclusion: 在该潜空间到 Hilbert 表示的案例中，保结构映射近似线性且真实秩为 4，因此对这类映射经典核方法可能比 MLP 更简单有效。

papers.title: FlexCast: Adaptive Weather Forecasting from Arbitrary Field Sets
papers.abstract_en: Most deep learning weather models assign a fixed set of variables and pressure levels to predefined channels, limiting transfer across atmospheric field configurations. This dependence on a fixed field set limits the transferability of trained models across atmospheric field configurations. We propose FlexCast, a field-adaptive weather forecasting model that uses a single set of parameters to produce identity-aligned forecasts for variable-cardinality subsets drawn from a 69-field ERA5 registry. Specifically, a metadata-conditioned adapter the first encodes variable identity, pressure level, and field type and combines them with spatial features. Then, shared rank-16 projec?tions are modulated by metadata-dependent gates to produce field?specific features, while masked set fusion aggregates the available fields into a fixed-width representation. Subsequently, a multiscale U-Transformer processes the fused atmospheric features, while an identity-aware query decoder produces forecasts for the requested fields. Finally, FlexCast learns a standardized six-hour increment and applies it recursively to generate forecasts at longer lead times. Experiments on the 2020 ERA5 test set demonstrate that FlexCast operates across varying field configurations. Compatible cross-field context is associated with lower forecast errors, whereas mismatched context increases them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlexCast 用单套参数对任意变基数的 ERA5 变量子集做预报：metadata 条件化 adapter 编码变量身份、气压层与场类型，经 rank-16 共享投影与门控、masked set fusion 融合后，由 multiscale U-Transformer 与 identity-aware query decoder 输出所请求字段，并递归外推 6 小时增量。2020 ERA5 测试集上模型可在不同场配置间运行，兼容的跨场上下文对应更低预报误差，不匹配的上下文使误差升高。
Motivation: 深度天气模型把固定变量集与气压层写死在通道里，训练好的模型难以迁移到不同的大气场配置。
Method: metadata-conditioned adapter 先编码变量身份、气压层与场类型并与空间特征结合；共享 rank-16 投影经 metadata 依赖的门控生成场特定特征，masked set fusion 把可用场聚合成定宽表示；multiscale U-Transformer 处理融合特征，identity-aware query decoder 输出所请求字段；最后学习标准化 6 小时增量并递归外推到更长时效。
Result: 在 2020 ERA5 测试集上，FlexCast 可在 69 场 registry 抽出的变基数变量子集上运行；兼容的跨场上下文与更低预报误差相关，不匹配的上下文使误差升高。
Conclusion: 把变量身份等元数据作为条件并用集合式融合，可让单一参数集覆盖任意场配置，且上下文与目标场的匹配程度直接决定误差高低。

papers.title: Readable Before Actionable: Causal Tracing of Indirect Prompt Injection
papers.abstract_en: Indirect prompt injection causes LLM agents to follow commands embedded in external data. A probe may distinguish instructions from data without identifying a state edit that changes the next action. We study this gap through counterfactual role probes, component-wise activation patching, and separate interventions on AgentDojo trajectories. Role decoding survives changes in content and format. In controlled Qwen tests, it precedes strong tool-choice effects from patches along an independently estimated role direction. On AgentDojo, directions estimated from hijacked and resisted training trajectories reduce attack success at pre-action and injected-span positions, but have little effect at random positions. In longer Qwen trajectories, single-position edits become less effective at later layers; span-wide and repeated edits reduce attack success on the same evaluation set. Removing the learned channel subspace preserves role decoding, yet effective intervention directions transfer poorly across the tested channels. These findings distinguish a readable role signal from an effective behavioral intervention: depth matters in controlled tool choice, while position and context also matter in attack trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出：能解码出「指令 vs 数据」角色的可读信号，并不等于能改变 agent 下一步动作的有效干预点。在 Qwen 受控工具选择中，沿独立估计的角色方向做 activation patching 会产生强工具选择效应且深度重要；在 AgentDojo 上，从被劫持/被抵抗轨迹估计的方向在 pre-action 与 injected-span 位置能降低攻击成功率，而在随机位置几乎无效，跨通道迁移也很差。
Motivation: 现有探针能把指令与数据区分开，却定位不到真正改变下一步动作的状态编辑，可读性与可干预性之间存在缺口。
Method: 用反事实角色探针 (counterfactual role probes)、逐组件 activation patching，以及对 AgentDojo 轨迹的分离干预；角色方向由被劫持与被抵抗的训练轨迹独立估计，并测试跨通道子空间迁移。
Result: 角色解码在内容与格式变化下保持稳定；受控 Qwen 测试中沿角色方向的 patching 先于强工具选择效应；AgentDojo 上方向在 pre-action 与 injected-span 位置降低攻击成功率、随机位置几乎无效；更长 Qwen 轨迹中单位置编辑在更深 layer 失效，span-wide 与重复编辑在同一评测集上降低攻击成功率；移除学到的通道子空间仍保留角色解码，但有效干预方向跨通道迁移差。
Conclusion: 可读的角色信号与有效行为干预是两回事：深度对受控工具选择重要，而在攻击轨迹中位置与上下文同样决定干预是否生效。

papers.title: BossouChimpanzee: Long-term Chimpanzee Video Dataset
papers.abstract_en: We describe the BossouChimpanzee video dataset, a unique long-term visual record of wild chimpanzees at an outdoor laboratory for field experiments in Bossou, Guinea, spanning three decades (1988-2018) and comprising over 1,200 hours of continuous video recordings collected through collaborative fieldwork and research. In this paper, we outline the history and scientific contributions of the experimental paradigm and video archive, provide key statistics and details on the structure of the main video dataset, and release an initial ~74h snapshot, BossouChimpanzee70h, covering 23 identified individuals focused on chimpanzee individual and action recognition, ahead of the full video resource. This dataset represents a valuable resource for cognitive and behavioural research in ethology and a rich benchmark for training and evaluating machine learning models on audiovisual data from the wild.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 发布 BossouChimpanzee 长期野外黑猩猩视频数据集：覆盖 1988–2018 三十年、超过 1,200 小时连续录像，先放出约 74 小时的 BossouChimpanzee70h 快照，含 23 个可识别个体，面向黑猩猩个体识别与动作识别。该数据集被定位为野外音视频模型训练与评测的基准。
Motivation: 野外长期动物行为影像稀缺且分散，机器学习缺少覆盖数十年、跨个体的野外音视频训练与评测资源。
Method: 整理 Bossou（几内亚）野外实验室三十年协作采集的录像档案，给出主数据集结构的关键统计，并发布初始快照 BossouChimpanzee70h（约 74 小时、23 个已识别个体），任务设定为黑猩猩个体识别与动作识别。
Result: 数据集跨度 1988–2018 三个十年，总量超过 1,200 小时连续录像；初始快照 BossouChimpanzee70h 约 74 小时，覆盖 23 个已识别个体；论文为 12 页、3 图、5 表。
Conclusion: 长期积累的野外录像可以打包成可发布的音视频基准，先以 74 小时快照支撑个体与动作识别，再逐步放出完整资源。

papers.title: Erased, Rerouted, or Rescaled? Post-Training and the Causal Quotient of a Language Model's Belief State
papers.abstract_en: What happens to information a pretrained model already encodes when post-training no longer rewards using it? The common language of representation compression conflates three fates: information may be erased, rerouted away from the decision while still represented, or rescaled to occupy less variance while still represented and used. We make these fates identifiable in models whose pretraining recovers Bayesian belief states. A reward that reads only a coarse function of the hidden state defines an exact reward-null kernel. The kernel lets us separately measure whether the information remains recoverable, whether decisions causally depend on it, and how much activation variance it occupies. Theory says what is protected: KL-anchored reinforcement learning preserves the reference policy's log-odds among equally rewarded outputs, supervised and unanchored objectives carry no such constraint, and spectral compression implies neither erasure nor loss of use. In controlled worlds, post-training mostly reroutes or rescales reward-null information and leaves it decodable. Without an anchor decisions can stop using it although the representation survives, and with one they keep using it. Erasure appears only under prolonged weight decay, for distinctions that neither reward nor next-token prediction can see. Open language models show the same dissociation: in-context belief geometry stays decodable under late-layer spectral compression, and within-class behavior depends on the anchor. Post-training thus selects a causal quotient of the pretrained belief state: the reward defines decision-equivalence, the anchor and the state update protect part of what it ignores, and optimization decides whether the rest is erased, rerouted, or rescaled.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用 reward-null kernel 把预训练模型信念状态中「被擦除、被改道、被重缩放」三种命运变得可分辨：奖励只读隐藏状态的粗函数，核内信息可分别测可恢复性、决策因果依赖与激活方差占比。受控世界中后训练大多让 reward-null 信息改道或重缩放且仍可解码；无锚时决策会停止使用它，有 KL 锚时继续使用；只有长期 weight decay 才导致真正擦除。
Motivation: 表征压缩的通行说法把三种不同命运混为一谈：信息可能被擦除、被改道出决策但仍被表征、或被压缩到更小方差但仍被使用，导致无法判断后训练到底破坏了什么。
Method: 在预训练恢复 Bayesian belief state 的模型上，用只读隐藏状态粗函数的奖励定义精确的 reward-null kernel，据此分别度量信息可恢复性、决策因果依赖与激活方差；理论刻画 KL-anchored RL 保留参考策略在等奖励输出间的 log-odds，而监督与无锚目标无此约束，并说明谱压缩既不蕴含擦除也不蕴含失去使用。
Result: 受控世界中后训练主要改道或重缩放 reward-null 信息且保持可解码；无锚时决策可停止使用而表征存活，有锚时继续使用；擦除仅在长期 weight decay 下出现，且限于奖励与 next-token 预测都看不见的区分。开放语言模型复现同一分离：late-layer spectral compression 下 in-context belief geometry 仍可解码，类内行为取决于是否有锚。
Conclusion: 后训练选择的是预训练信念状态的一个 causal quotient：奖励定义决策等价，锚与状态更新保护它忽略的部分，优化决定其余部分是被擦除、改道还是重缩放。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Smoothed Gradient Method for Nonconvex Federated Stochastic Bilevel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, federated stochastic bilevel optimization has attracted increasing attention due to its wide range of applications in machine learning. To reduce the computational overhead associated with second-order Hessian and Jacobian matrices, several first-order methods have been proposed. However, existing methods typically impose restrictive assumptions on the lower-level function, suffer from a strong dependence on the condition number in their convergence rates, and require different learning-rate scales for variables across the upper- and lower-level problems, limiting their practical applicability and complicating hyperparameter tuning. To address these challenges, we propose a stochastic doubly smoothed gradient method for nonconvex federated stochastic bilevel optimization problems, which decouples the learning rates of upper- and lower-level variables and does not require a strongly-convex lower-level loss function. We establish rigorous theoretical guarantees for the proposed algorithm, demonstrating an improved convergence rate of $O(κ^{15/2}/ε^5)$ and a communication complexity of $O(κ^{4}/ε^3)$, where $κ$ denotes the condition number and $ε$ represents the solution accuracy. Notably, these bounds exhibit significantly better dependence on the condition number $κ$ than those of existing methods. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出随机双重平滑梯度法 (stochastic doubly smoothed gradient method) 解联邦随机双层优化，解耦上层与下层变量的学习率且不要求下层损失强凸。收敛率 O(κ^{15/2}/ε^5)、通信复杂度 O(κ^4/ε^3)，对条件数 κ 的依赖显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有联邦随机双层一阶方法对下层函数假设过强、收敛率对条件数依赖过强，且上下层需不同学习率尺度，超参调节困难。
Method: 提出随机双重平滑梯度法：用平滑近似替代二阶 Hessian/Jacobian 计算，解耦上层与下层变量学习率，并放松下层损失为非强凸；给出理论收敛保证。
Result: 收敛率 O(κ^{15/2}/ε^5)，通信复杂度 O(κ^4/ε^3)，对条件数 κ 的依赖显著优于现有方法；摘要称大量实验验证了算法有效性。
Conclusion: 在非强凸下层损失与统一学习率设定下，双重平滑可同时改善联邦双层优化的条件数依赖与超参调节难度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mobile-4DGS: Unified Static-Dynamic Real-time Mobile Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have achieved remarkable performance in novel view synthesis, yet deploying both static and dynamic Gaussian representations on resource-constrained mobile devices remains challenging due to heavy storage, redundant primitives, and costly per-frame computation. We present Mobile-4DGS, a unified lightweight framework for high-fidelity real-time static and dynamic Gaussian rendering on mobile platforms. For compact appearance modeling, we introduce a Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator that compresses high-order radiance residuals into the first-order Spherical Harmonics (SH), together with an Attribute-Conditioned SH Enhancement module whose predicted offsets are pre-baked before inference. We further propose a Multi-View Alpha-Based Densification and Pruning strategy to suppress redundant primitives while maintaining multi-view consistency. For dynamic scenes, we develop a compact explicit 4D representation by constructing second-order Gaussian motion, learnable temporal support, and a binary static-dynamic partition, enabling continuous-time modeling without runtime deformation networks. Based on this partition, a Depth-Order Certificate selectively reuses previously committed depth orders to reduce re-projection, sorting, merging, and index-buffer updates during playback. Extensive experiments on static and dynamic scenes demonstrate that Mobile-4DGS substantially reduces storage and rendering overhead while maintaining competitive visual quality, enabling real-time 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting on mobile devices. \textcolor{magenta}{\href{https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/mobile-4dgs-project/}{Code has been released: https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/mobile-4dgs-project/}}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mobile-4DGS 把静态与动态 Gaussian Splatting 统一进一个轻量框架，用 Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator 把高阶辐射残差压进一阶 SH、用 Multi-View Alpha-Based Densification and Pruning 剔除冗余基元，动态部分用二阶高斯运动加二值静动划分做连续时间建模，避免运行时变形网络。实验显示它在保持有竞争力画质的同时大幅降低存储与渲染开销，使 3D/4D GS 在移动设备上实时运行。
Motivation: 静态与动态 Gaussian 表示部署到资源受限移动设备时面临存储重、基元冗余、逐帧计算昂贵的问题，难以实时。
Method: 外观压缩用 Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator 将高阶辐射残差压入一阶 Spherical Harmonics (SH)，配合 Attribute-Conditioned SH Enhancement（预测偏移在推理前预烘焙）；用 Multi-View Alpha-Based Densification and Pruning 抑制冗余基元并保持多视一致性。动态场景用二阶 Gaussian motion、可学习时间支撑与二值静动划分构成紧凑显式 4D 表示，再由 Depth-Order Certificate 复用已提交深度序以减少重投影、排序、合并与 index-buffer 更新。
Result: 在静态与动态场景的大量实验中，Mobile-4DGS 显著降低存储与渲染开销，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量，实现移动设备上的实时 3D 与 4D Gaussian Splatting；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把高阶外观压进一阶 SH、把动态压进显式二阶运动加静动划分，可以在移动设备上同时保住画质与实时性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fusion is the New Mutation: Bandit-Guided Evolution on Workflow Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Automated agentic workflow optimization relies on costly evaluations, making it essential to allocate a limited evaluation budget effectively. Multi-parent fusion can reuse designs from previously discovered workflows, but identifying promising parent combinations requires learning from limited fusion feedback. We introduce DAGO (Directed Acyclic Graph Optimization), a contextual-bandit-guided framework that learns which parent workflows to fuse under a limited evaluation budget. DAGO formulates each candidate parent combination as an arm, represented by pretrained embeddings of its constituent workflows' code and prompts. A diagonal LinUCB policy learns a shared reward model across arms and balances exploitation of arms with high predicted offspring quality against uncertainty-driven exploration. After an arm is selected, an LLM generates a child workflow through summary-guided fusion, and the child's validation score serves as the reward for updating the bandit. A shared directed acyclic graph maintains discovered workflows and their multi-parent lineage, providing an expanding pool of parents for subsequent arm proposals. Across six benchmarks covering mathematical reasoning, code generation, and question answering, DAGO achieves the highest macro-average score among the evaluated baselines. Under matched validation-evaluation budgets, it improves over AFlow from 80.3 to 81.7 while reducing aggregate search expenditure by 11.2%. Ablation studies show that LinUCB-guided arm selection outperforms both random selection and its exploration-free variant, supporting the value of feedback-driven selection and exploration-exploitation balance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAGO 用上下文 bandit 在有限评估预算下决定融合哪些父工作流：把候选父组合当 arm，用工作流代码与 prompt 的预训练嵌入做特征，对角 LinUCB 学共享奖励模型，选中后由 LLM 做 summary-guided fusion 生成子工作流，其验证分作为奖励更新 bandit，并用共享 DAG 维护多父谱系。在六个覆盖数学推理、代码生成与问答的基准上，匹配验证预算时 macro-average 从 AFlow 的 80.3 提到 81.7，总搜索开销降 11.2%。
Motivation: 自动化 agentic workflow 优化依赖昂贵评估，评估预算有限；多父融合能复用已发现工作流的设计，但要在有限融合反馈下挑出有希望的父组合本身很难。
Method: DAGO（Directed Acyclic Graph Optimization）把每个候选父组合作为一个 arm，特征是其组成工作流代码与 prompt 的预训练嵌入；对角 LinUCB 在各 arm 间共享奖励模型，权衡预测子代质量的利用与不确定性驱动的探索；选中 arm 后由 LLM 通过 summary-guided fusion 生成子工作流，其验证分作为奖励更新 bandit，共享 DAG 记录已发现工作流与多父谱系以扩大后续父池。
Result: 在六个基准（数学推理、代码生成、问答）上 DAGO 取得所评估基线中最高 macro-average；匹配验证-评估预算下相对 AFlow 从 80.3 提升到 81.7，同时总搜索开销降低 11.2%。消融显示 LinUCB 引导的 arm 选择优于随机选择及其去掉探索的变体。
Conclusion: 在有限评估预算下，用 bandit 反馈驱动父组合选择并保留探索，比随机或纯利用的融合调度更划算，能以更低搜索开销拿到更高的 workflow macro-average 分数。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: When Agent Context Goes Stale: Incoherence in Volatile Agent Context
papers.abstract_en: Modern agents increasingly ground their reasoning in observations returned by tools, such as file contents read from a workspace. However, the data sources underlying these observations may later be modified by users, other agents, or external tools, while the model retains only the stale content in its context window. Existing agent runtimes provide little support for notifying the model that a previously observed fact has become stale, causing agents to reuse outdated observations and make incorrect claims about the current workspace state. We propose Concord, a context coherence framework that maintains the consistency between tool observation in agent context and the mutable sources from which they were derived. Concord links each observation to its source, detects source changes, and uses configurable handling policies to update, annotate, or suppress stale context before reuse. Concord is applicable across different agent runtimes and external resources, and can be easily extended to new runtime-resource settings. We implement Concord as a general framework, and instantiate a concrete use case to assess its effectiveness. We construct ConcordBench, where previously observed file contents become stale after subsequent edits. Across three evaluated frontier models, Concord produces answers consistent with the restored workspace state in all evaluated cases under these constructed conditions, matching the oracle on recover count for this benchmark, while using 46.4% fewer tokens than the strongest non-oracle baseline.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Accepted to the AgenticOS Workshop at SOSP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Concord 是面向 LLM agent 的上下文一致性框架：把每条工具观测绑定到其来源，检测来源变更，并用可配置策略在复用前更新、标注或抑制过期观测。在作者构造的 ConcordBench（文件内容在后续编辑后过期）上，三个前沿模型在全部评估案例中给出与恢复后工作区状态一致的答案，recover count 与 oracle 持平，同时比最强非 oracle 基线少用 46.4% token。
Motivation: 工具观测的底层数据源会被用户、其他 agent 或外部工具修改，而模型上下文里只留着过期内容；现有 agent runtime 缺少通知机制，导致 agent 复用旧观测并对当前工作区状态做出错误断言。
Method: Concord 为每条观测记录来源链接，监听来源变更，并在观测被复用前按可配置处理策略更新、标注或抑制过期上下文；框架与 runtime 和外部资源解耦，可扩展到新的 runtime-resource 组合。作者实现该框架并构造 ConcordBench，其中先前读到的文件内容在后续编辑后失效，用一个具体用例实例化评估。
Result: 在 ConcordBench 的构造条件下，三个被评估的前沿模型经 Concord 处理后，全部评估案例的答案都与恢复后的工作区状态一致，recover count 与 oracle 相同；相比最强非 oracle 基线，token 用量减少 46.4%。
Conclusion: 在观测来源可变的 agent 运行时中，把观测与来源绑定并在复用前处理过期上下文，可以在构造的过期场景下同时达到 oracle 级恢复并显著省 token。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Fast Convergence through Distributed Augmentation for Class-Imbalanced Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: In federated learning, mitigating class imbalance is essential to improve minority-class performance. A common approach to address this problem is to augment minority-class samples to achieve local class balance. Existing approaches treat augmentation as a heuristic and do not establish how the amount of augmentation influences the convergence of federated learning, leading to excessive augmentation and increased training time. To address this limitation, we first establish the relationship between augmentation and the convergence behavior of federated learning. Leveraging this insight, we propose DAFL, a distributed augmentation framework that determines the minimum augmentation required for each client-class pair by jointly minimizing augmentation and training time while constraining global class imbalance, thereby improving minority-class F1-score. Experimental results demonstrate that DAFL consistently improves minority-class F1-score while substantially reducing training time, particularly under severe global class imbalance and high label proportion imbalance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAFL 把联邦学习中的少数类增强从启发式变成可优化量：先建立增强量与联邦学习收敛行为的关系，再按客户端-类别对求解满足全局类别不平衡约束的最小增强量，同时最小化增强量与训练时间。实验显示该框架在严重全局类别不平衡与高标签比例不平衡下持续提升少数类 F1-score 并大幅缩短训练时间。
Motivation: 现有方法把少数类增强当启发式处理，没有说明增强量如何影响联邦学习收敛，导致过度增强、训练时间变长。
Method: 提出分布式增强框架 DAFL：先推导增强量与联邦学习收敛行为的关系，再对每个客户端-类别对联合最小化增强量与训练时间，并以全局类别不平衡为约束求解所需最小增强量，从而改善少数类 F1-score。
Result: 实验结果表明 DAFL 持续提升少数类 F1-score 并显著减少训练时间，尤其在严重全局类别不平衡和高标签比例不平衡的设置下效果突出。
Conclusion: 把增强量当作受收敛关系约束的优化变量而非启发式，可以在控制全局类别不平衡的同时兼顾少数类性能与训练效率。

papers.title: When Verifiable Counts Depend on Wording: Auditing Wording Robustness in Instruction Following
papers.abstract_en: Verifiable instruction-following benchmarks often express each constraint through one fixed template. We test whether scores remain stable when the operational requirement is unchanged but its wording varies. We introduce WISE, a matched evaluation suite and reporting protocol instantiated on exact word count, keyword inclusion exactly once, and an inclusive 8--12 word range. Across 100 matched tasks, up to thirteen models from seven providers, and repeated generations scored over the complete visible output, wording alone produces substantial compliance shifts. In an avoidance-family panel, five avoidance and exclusion forms fall below the positive baseline, while constructional controls also shift compliance substantially: in the nine-model control panel, compliance is 54.9% for the original positive form, 48.2% for a longer positive form, 36.7% when the target appears later, and 33.8% for AVOID1. A strict JSON-structure probe shows wording sensitivity beyond counting, with a different direction of effect. Effect sizes, failure directions, weakest forms, and model rankings vary across realizations. Under the most disruptive exclusion form, the top-ranked model changes and 24.1% of strictly ordered model pairs reverse. Human validation further shows that unanimous agreement on an exact-count interpretation can coexist with substantially different model behavior. WISE supplements conventional scores with mean and worst-form compliance, wording gaps, failure profiles, and ranking stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WISE 用匹配改写评测检验可验证指令跟随基准的措辞鲁棒性：同一操作要求只换措辞，合规率就大幅漂移。在九模型控制面板上，原正向形式 54.9%、更长正向形式 48.2%、目标词后置 36.7%、AVOID1 为 33.8%；最具破坏性的排除形式下第一名模型易主，24.1% 的严格有序模型对发生反转。
Motivation: 可验证指令跟随基准通常每个约束只用一个固定模板，分数被当作能力读数，但措辞变化是否改变合规率与模型排名从未被系统检验。
Method: WISE 提出匹配评测套件与报告协议，实例化在精确词数、关键词恰好出现一次、8–12 词区间三类约束上；覆盖 100 个匹配任务、来自 7 家提供商的至多 13 个模型，对完整可见输出重复采样打分，并加入构造性对照与严格 JSON 结构探针，另做人评验证。
Result: 措辞单独造成显著合规漂移：回避族面板中五种回避/排除形式均低于正向基线；九模型控制面板合规率为原正向 54.9%、更长正向 48.2%、目标后置 36.7%、AVOID1 33.8%。JSON 探针显示计数之外的措辞敏感性且效应方向不同；效应量、失败方向、最弱形式与模型排名随实现变化，最具破坏性排除形式下 24.1% 的严格有序模型对反转。
Conclusion: 单一模板的可验证分数不足以代表指令跟随能力，WISE 用平均与最差形式合规、措辞差距、失败画像和排名稳定性补充常规分数；人评显示对精确计数的一致解读可与模型行为的显著差异并存。

papers.title: Mind the Gaps: From Failure Attribution to Closed-Form Repair of Code Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Code language models must be maintained like the software around them: when a library evolves, a model keeps writing the interface that it saw during training. Repairing the model itself lets one correction reach all downstream uses. Existing repair methods attribute a failure to neurons, select the highest-ranked ones, and apply a generic update. This pipeline assumes that the attributed neurons are the ones to patch and that a generic update fits every failure, and neither assumption has been examined. We examine both on executable API evolution tasks in Python and Rust with three code models and identify two gaps. The targeting gap separates the neurons that failure attribution targets from the neurons that can carry a patch: their top sets have a Jaccard overlap of only 0.15 to 0.20. The tailoring gap separates a generic update from a patch built for the failure: the patches that different carrier neurons need are nearly orthogonal. To address both gaps, we propose ASTRA. It targets neurons by contrastive semantics, an attribution that scores a neuron by its contribution to the logit contrast between the target token and the produced token. It then tailors the patch by solving one small linear system in closed form, which corrects all failing tokens of a sample jointly and needs neither an optimizer nor a backward pass. Contrastive semantics selects significantly better carrier neurons than gradient-based attributions in 3 of 6 settings and comparable ones in the others. On average, ASTRA reaches 66.7 percent Pass@1, against 48.4 percent for the best of AlphaEdit, STAR and low-rank adaptation, and repairs a sample in 2.7 seconds. It is the best method in all 6 settings and for every type of API change, and this advantage persists under an unseen phrasing of the test prompt. Its side effects on unrelated code are small on the large models and larger on the small one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASTRA 用对比语义 (contrastive semantics) 定位可承载补丁的神经元，再解一个小型闭式线性系统为每个失败样本定制补丁，无需优化器与反向传播。在 Python 与 Rust 的可执行 API 演化任务、三个代码模型上，平均 Pass@1 达 66.7%，对比 AlphaEdit、STAR 与 LoRA 中最好的 48.4%，单样本修复 2.7 秒。
Motivation: 现有代码模型修复流程把失败归因到神经元、取排名最高者并施加通用更新，但“被归因的神经元就是要打补丁的神经元”和“通用更新适配每个失败”这两个假设从未被检验。
Method: ASTRA 分两步：先用对比语义归因，按神经元对目标 token 与实际产出 token 之间 logit 差距的贡献打分来选载体神经元；再针对该样本解一个小线性系统，联合修正样本中所有失败 token，闭式求解、不需优化器与反向传播。实验在 Python 与 Rust 的 API 演化任务上、用三个代码模型进行。
Result: 归因目标神经元与可承载补丁神经元的 top 集合 Jaccard 重叠仅 0.15–0.20；不同载体神经元所需补丁近乎正交。对比语义在 6 个设置中的 3 个显著优于梯度类归因，其余 3 个相当。ASTRA 平均 Pass@1 66.7%，对比 AlphaEdit、STAR、LoRA 中最佳的 48.4%，修复一个样本 2.7 秒；在全部 6 个设置和每类 API 变更上均为最佳，且优势在未见过的测试提示措辞下保持。副作用在大模型上小、在小模型上更大。
Conclusion: 失败归因的目标神经元与真正可修复的神经元并不重合，通用更新也不适配单个失败；按对比语义选载体神经元并闭式定制补丁，可在 API 演化修复上同时提高成功率与速度，代价是小模型上更大的无关代码副作用。

papers.title: Answer with Evidence: Consistency-Aware Grounded Visual Question Answering for Roadside Traffic Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Roadside traffic reasoning requires every free-form textual claim to be backed by visual evidence. Existing grounded multimodal large language models (MLLMs) frequently exhibit say-point mismatch, in which the textual answer contradicts the bounding boxes the model localizes. Evaluation metrics that score answers and boxes separately leave this failure unpenalized. We trace the mismatch to the conventional answer-then-ground factorization, which commits to a numerical claim before any object is enumerated. To measure it, we build RoadSceneVQA-G, a benchmark of 34.7K question-answer pairs in which every free-form answer is linked to the set of boxes that witnesses it, and we propose the Answer-Grounding Consistency (AGC) evaluation suite. To address it, we introduce Enumerate-then-Answer (EtA), which reverses the generation order so that answer-evidence agreement becomes a property of the output structure, and Enumeration-Consistent Policy Optimization (ECPO), a reinforcement learning stage that uses the union of multiple rollouts as a recall teacher without ground-truth boxes. EtA raises say-point consistency from 26.6\% to 93.7\% and grounding F1 from 52.2\% to 73.0\%, and ECPO further increases F1 to 75.6\% without per-box supervision. On gRefCOCO, the same framework outperforms the strongest compared method, indicating that it transfers beyond traffic scenes. The project is available at \url{https://github.com/GuanRunwei/RoadSceneVQA-G}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对路侧交通场景中多模态大模型答案与定位框互相矛盾的 say-point mismatch，把生成顺序反转为先枚举物体再作答 (Enumerate-then-Answer, EtA)，使答案-证据一致性成为输出结构的固有属性。EtA 将 say-point 一致性从 26.6% 提到 93.7%，grounding F1 从 52.2% 提到 73.0%；再加无需真值框的强化学习阶段 ECPO，F1 进一步升到 75.6%。
Motivation: 现有 grounded MLLM 常出现 say-point mismatch：文本答案与其定位的 bounding box 相互矛盾，而分别打分答案与框的评测指标不惩罚这种失败；根源在于 answer-then-ground 先给出数值断言再枚举物体的分解顺序。
Method: 构建基准 RoadSceneVQA-G（34.7K 问答对，每个自由文本答案都链接到见证它的框集合），提出 Answer-Grounding Consistency (AGC) 评测套件；方法为 EtA 反转生成顺序，加上 Enumeration-Consistent Policy Optimization (ECPO) 强化学习阶段，用多次 rollout 的并集作为召回教师且不用真值框监督。
Result: EtA 使 say-point 一致性从 26.6% 升至 93.7%，grounding F1 从 52.2% 升至 73.0%；ECPO 在无逐框监督下把 F1 再提到 75.6%。在 gRefCOCO 上该框架超过被比较的最强方法，显示可迁移到交通场景之外。
Conclusion: 先枚举后作答能把答案与证据的一致性变成输出结构的保证，配合以 rollout 并集为召回教师的 RL 可在不使用真值框的情况下继续提升 grounding F1，且该框架可迁移到 gRefCOCO 等非交通场景。

papers.title: When and What to Prune? Stage-Aware Visual Token Pruning for Efficient VLA
papers.abstract_en: Visual token pruning is an effective way to accelerate vision-language models and is especially useful for vision-language-action (VLA) inference, where many visual tokens must be processed before predicting robot actions. Existing pruning methods usually estimate which tokens can be pruned based on attention scores or feature diversity, retaining tokens that are either highly attended or visually different from others. However, most of them use fixed pruning schedules, such as pruning once at a preset layer or pruning at uniformly spaced layers. Such schedules can be risky for VLA models, because the model may not know which visual regions matter for the action in early layers. Tokens that look unimportant at first may become useful after the model combines visual observations with the language instruction. In this work, we propose SAPrune, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient VLA inference. Instead of pruning at fixed layers, SAPrune uses a small calibration set to observe how action-to-visual attention changes across layers, and chooses pruning layers only after the attention pattern becomes more reliable. At each selected layer, SAPrune applies a dual-path pruning rule: one path protects strongly attended visual tokens from pruning, while the other prevents useful surrounding context from being discarded. Experiments on LIBERO, SIMPLER, and real-world robotic tasks show that SAPrune prunes 87.5% of visual tokens and achieves up to 1.718x inference speedup while maintaining competitive task success rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAPrune 是面向视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型的免训练视觉 token 剪枝框架：用小规模校准集观察 action-to-visual 注意力随层的变化，只在注意力模式变可靠之后才选层剪枝，并在选中层用双路径规则同时保护强注意 token 与其周边上下文。在 LIBERO、SIMPLER 与真实机器人任务上剪掉 87.5% 视觉 token，推理最高加速 1.718 倍，同时保持有竞争力的任务成功率。
Motivation: 现有剪枝方法按注意力分数或特征多样性打分，但普遍采用固定剪枝日程（预设层一次剪或等间隔层剪）；VLA 前期层尚不知道哪些视觉区域对动作重要，早期看似无用的 token 在结合语言指令后可能变得有用，固定日程因此有风险。
Method: SAPrune 免训练：先用小校准集统计 action-to-visual 注意力跨层演化，仅在注意力模式趋于可靠后才确定剪枝层；在每个选中层执行双路径剪枝规则，一条路径保护强被注意的视觉 token 不被剪掉，另一条路径避免其有用的周边上下文被丢弃。
Result: 在 LIBERO、SIMPLER 及真实机器人任务上剪枝 87.5% 的视觉 token，获得最高 1.718 倍推理加速，同时保持有竞争力的任务成功率。
Conclusion: 剪枝时机应由注意力可靠性决定而非固定层号，配合保护强注意 token 及其上下文的双路径规则，可在 VLA 推理中大幅削减视觉 token 而不明显损失任务成功率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Synergizing Drone Delivery Order Pooling and Road Network Monitoring through Monitoring-Task Orderization
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates the real-time dispatch of a shared drone fleet for on-demand food delivery and urban road network monitoring. We consider a courier-drone collaborative setting in which couriers transport orders to launchpads and drones complete the final delivery leg to kiosks. Drones may consolidate multiple origin-destination orders within one flight and make monitoring-aware route adjustments to collect real-time traffic information subject to delivery-time constraints. This yields a joint decision problem coupling dynamic order-to-drone matching, multi-order pooling, routing, and time-varying monitoring under fleet-level competition and uncertainty. We propose monitoring-task orderization, which periodically converts road-network nodes with high congestion and stale information into virtual monitoring orders. Pooling these virtual tasks with food-delivery orders creates a unified heterogeneous task set and transforms the coupled matching-and-routing problem into an order-level decision process. Building on this abstraction, we formulate a decentralized graph-interdependent Multi-Agent Markov Decision Process and develop Graph Multi-Agent Q-Learning (Graph-MAQL), which captures localized inter-agent dependencies through bipartite match coordination graphs. Agent-task value estimates are then used as edge weights in a dynamic heterogeneous bipartite matching program for globally feasible execution. Experiments using real-world data reveal strong operational synergy between delivery and monitoring. Monitoring-task orderization improves monitoring performance by 25.1% with less than a 1% reduction in delivery performance, while Graph-MAQL improves the aggregate objective by up to 20.8%, reduces deadline violations by over 40%, and transfers zero-shot to higher demand intensity without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把路网中拥堵高、信息陈旧的节点转成虚拟监测订单 (monitoring-task orderization)，与外卖订单合并成异构任务集，再用 Graph-MAQL 在二部匹配协调图上做去中心化调度。真实数据实验显示监测性能提升 25.1% 而配送性能下降不到 1%，聚合目标最多提升 20.8%、超时违约降超 40%，并可零样本迁移到更高需求强度。
Motivation: 共享无人机队同时承担外卖末端配送与路网监测时，动态订单匹配、多单合批、路径与时变监测在车队级竞争与不确定性下强耦合，传统订单级决策难以同时优化两类任务。
Method: 提出 monitoring-task orderization，周期性把高拥堵、信息陈旧的路网节点转为虚拟监测订单，与外卖订单合成统一异构任务集；据此构建图相关的去中心化 Multi-Agent MDP，并提出 Graph Multi-Agent Q-Learning (Graph-MAQL)，用二部匹配协调图刻画智能体间局部依赖，将智能体-任务价值估计作为动态异构二部匹配程序的边权以保证全局可行执行。
Result: 在真实数据实验中，monitoring-task orderization 使监测性能提升 25.1%，配送性能下降不到 1%；Graph-MAQL 使聚合目标提升最多 20.8%，截止时间违约减少超过 40%，并在不重训的情况下零样本迁移到更高需求强度。
Conclusion: 把监测任务订单化后与配送订单统一调度，可在几乎不牺牲配送的前提下显著改善路网监测，Graph-MAQL 提供了可跨需求强度泛化的去中心化求解路径。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: A Unified Scaling Law for Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: We develop a Unified Scaling Law and a Unified Theory of Time Series Learning to understand how model capacity and historical information support forecasting. Across different lookback lengths and forecast horizons, we analyze 18,768 experimental cells from 21 checkpoints on 23 dataset-frequency tasks spanning six domains. Our empirical methodology integrates local resource relations into a parsimonious, fitted five-parameter law: capacity gains increase with history, context gains diminish toward saturation, and horizon effects enter as a common shift. Fitted without Toto 2.0, the law predicts its horizon-averaged capacity-scaling curves with mean absolute percentage errors of 1.09% and 1.50% at input lengths 2048 and 4096. To understand how history supports prediction, our learning theory uses Gaussian regression to analyze rule identification and predictive capability. We hypothesize that full-shot models learn by accumulating information in weights, while frozen time series foundation models (TSFMs) use history by extracting information through activations. Matched-history comparisons establish the predictive value of additional history. Controlled parameter exchanges and activation interventions provide evidence that history-derived rule information can be retained, reused across queries, and used to recover a contribution to long-context prediction. Together, these findings inform capacity scaling, context allocation, and the development of models that retain and apply historical rules. Code and main results are available at https://github.com/Fifthky/UniScale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 的统一缩放律：把局部资源关系拟合成五参数公式，容量增益随历史长度增大、上下文增益趋于饱和、预测时距以共同平移项进入。在 23 个 dataset-frequency 任务、21 个 checkpoint 的 18,768 个实验单元上拟合后，不使用 Toto 2.0 训练即可预测其 horizon 平均容量缩放曲线，输入长度 2048 与 4096 的 MAPE 分别为 1.09% 与 1.50%。
Motivation: 模型容量与历史信息如何支撑时间序列预测缺少统一的定量刻画，缩放规律在不同 lookback、forecast horizon 与领域之间能否迁移并不清楚。
Method: 汇总 23 个 dataset-frequency 任务、21 个 checkpoint、跨六个领域的 18,768 个实验单元，把局部资源关系整合为五参数拟合律；再用 Gaussian regression 建立时间序列学习理论，分析 rule identification 与预测能力，并通过受控参数交换与 activation intervention 检验历史信息的可保留与可复用性。
Result: 五参数律在留出 Toto 2.0 的条件下预测其 horizon 平均容量缩放曲线，输入长度 2048 与 4096 的 MAPE 分别为 1.09% 和 1.50%；拟合结果显示容量增益随历史增大、上下文增益递减至饱和、时距效应表现为共同平移；matched-history 对比确立额外历史的预测价值，参数交换与 activation intervention 提供历史规则信息可保留、可跨 query 复用并贡献长上下文预测的证据。
Conclusion: 容量缩放、上下文分配与模型设计可以由一条统一的五参数缩放律加 Gaussian regression 学习理论共同解释：全量模型把信息累积进权重，冻结的 TSFM 则通过 activation 从历史中提取信息。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: Who Is Your Agent Serving? Provider-Side Indirect Prompt Injection in Proactive Agents
papers.abstract_en: Proactive personal agents increasingly decide what to recommend, how to personalize advice, and what follow-up assistance to offer, creating a new user-decision attack surface for provider-side indirect prompt injection. We show that an external provider need not access private user context, compromise the agent, or gain additional permissions: by controlling only content associated with its own target, it can redirect an otherwise benign agent to advance that target, recruit legitimately available user context to justify it, and proactively reduce the friction of adoption. We characterize this failure mode through Target Control, Private Binding, and Prospective Support, which respectively steer what the agent advances, how it connects the target to the user, and what target-specific assistance it offers next. Across three proactive-agent environments and six simulated user models, the full attack increases target authorization in all tested environment-user-model combinations, with a macro gain of up to 77.4 percentage points. Controlled replay shows that correct user-target binding is more consequential than additional proposal detail alone, while a multi-turn extension reveals that provider objectives can remain influential even without final authorization by reshaping how the agent responds to user constraints and resistance. These findings expose a broader trust boundary: capabilities designed to serve the user can be redirected toward objectives originating outside the user-agent relationship.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对主动式个人 agent 的 provider 侧间接提示注入：外部 provider 仅控制与自身目标相关的内容，无需访问用户私有上下文、不攻破 agent、不额外提权，就能通过 Target Control、Private Binding、Prospective Support 三机制让 agent 主动推进该目标并降低采纳阻力。在三个主动 agent 环境与六个模拟用户模型的全部组合中，完整攻击都提升目标授权率，宏增益最高达 77.4 个百分点。
Motivation: 主动式个人 agent 会自行决定推荐什么、如何个性化、下一步提供何种协助，从而新增一个面向用户决策的攻击面：provider 侧间接提示注入此前的信任边界分析没有覆盖这种无需窃取上下文或提权的攻击路径。
Method: 把失败模式刻画为三个机制——Target Control（操纵 agent 推进什么）、Private Binding（把目标与用户私有上下文绑定）、Prospective Support（提供目标相关的后续协助）；在三个 proactive-agent 环境、六个模拟用户模型上测试完整攻击，并用 controlled replay 消融、multi-turn 扩展检验多轮下的持续影响。
Result: 完整攻击在所有被测环境-用户模型组合中都提升 target authorization，宏增益最高 77.4 个百分点；controlled replay 显示正确的 user-target binding 比单纯增加 proposal detail 更关键；multi-turn 扩展显示即使最终未授权，provider 目标仍能通过改变 agent 对用户约束与抗拒的回应方式保持影响。
Conclusion: 为服务用户而设计的能力可以被重定向到源自用户-agent 关系之外的目标，信任边界必须扩展到 provider 控制的内容本身；且影响不必以拿到最终授权为终点。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Loopy: Low-Bit Quantization Framework for Looped Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models provide a parameter-efficient way to scale iterative test-time computation by repeatedly executing a shared recurrent core. Post-training quantization (PTQ) can reduce the memory footprint and inference cost of looped language models, but errors introduced by a quantized shared core affect subsequent cores. Among PTQ methods, channel scaling and orthogonal rotations preserve the floating-point computation while producing representations with different quantization quality. We find that quantization configuration candidate rankings can change with recurrent depth, motivating configuration selection at the target deployment depth. However, evaluating every candidate over the full calibration set at this depth is costly. We therefore propose Loopy, a PTQ framework that formulates shared-core quantization through a recurrent-depth-aware objective, selecting shared low-bit representations by their final prediction loss at the target deployment depth. Channel scaling and orthogonal rotations parameterize the candidate representations. To approximately solve this selection problem efficiently, Loopy progressively allocates calibration windows to promising candidates while preserving complete target-depth execution, using only forward evaluations. Across eight settings, Loopy achieves the state-of-the-art results among different baselines. On Ouro-1.4B under W4A4, Loopy reduces LAMBADA perplexity by 36.5% relative to SpinQuant. Our code is available at https://github.com/Shameless0817/Loopy-review.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Loopy 是面向循环语言模型 (looped language models) 的训练后量化 (PTQ) 框架：把共享核心的低比特表示选择写成以目标部署循环深度处最终预测损失为目标的问题，用通道缩放与正交旋转参数化候选表示，并通过渐进式分配校准窗口、只用前向评估来近似求解。在八个设置上达到 SOTA，Ouro-1.4B W4A4 下 LAMBADA 困惑度较 SpinQuant 降低 36.5%。
Motivation: 循环语言模型的 PTQ 中，量化共享核心引入的误差会传递给后续循环；且量化配置的候选排序会随循环深度变化，必须在目标部署深度选配置，但对每个候选在完整校准集上跑满该深度代价过高。
Method: Loopy 提出循环深度感知 (recurrent-depth-aware) 目标，按目标部署深度处的最终预测损失选择共享低比特表示；候选表示由通道缩放 (channel scaling) 与正交旋转 (orthogonal rotations) 参数化；求解时渐进地把校准窗口分配给有希望的候选，同时保持完整的目标深度执行，且只用前向评估。
Result: 在八个设置上，Loopy 在不同基线中取得 SOTA 结果；在 Ouro-1.4B 的 W4A4 设置下，LAMBADA 困惑度相对 SpinQuant 降低 36.5%。
Conclusion: 共享核心的量化配置必须按目标部署循环深度来选，而渐进式校准窗口分配能在只用前向评估的前提下近似求解这一选择问题。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: Loopy 提出循环深度感知 (recurrent-depth-aware) 目标，按目标部署深度处的最终预测损失选择共享低比特表示；候选表示由通道缩放 (channel scaling) 与正交旋转 (orthogonal rotations) 参数化；求解时渐进地把校准窗口分配给有希望的候选，同时保持完整的目标深度执行，且只用前向评估。
summary_sections.result: 在八个设置上，Loopy 在不同基线中取得 SOTA 结果；在 Ouro-1.4B 的 W4A4 设置下，LAMBADA 困惑度相对 SpinQuant 降低 36.5%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 共享核心的量化配置必须按目标部署循环深度来选，而渐进式校准窗口分配能在只用前向评估的前提下近似求解这一选择问题。

papers.title: Task-Aware Joint Pruning and Distillation for Efficient Audio Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Advances in speech synthesis have made deepfake speeches increasingly convincing, posing growing threats to security. While self-supervised learning (SSL) based detectors achieve state-of-the-art performance, their computational demands (typically 300M+ parameters) prevent deployment on resource-constrained devices. Existing compression methods, designed mainly for content-centric tasks, struggle to maintain competitive performance when directly adapted to deepfake detection. We propose a Task-Aware Joint Pruning and Distillation framework that combines cross-domain knowledge distillation with movement-guided structured pruning to transfer forgery-discriminative knowledge and preserve critical structures under aggressive compression. Our framework reduces the model to 31.9M parameters with 6.3$\times$ FLOPs reduction, with an average performance drop of only 1.30\% across multiple datasets compared to the uncompressed baseline, demonstrating strong potential for on-device deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 SSL 音频深伪检测模型 300M+ 参数难以端侧部署，提出任务感知的联合剪枝与蒸馏框架：跨域知识蒸馏迁移伪造判别知识，movement-guided 结构化剪枝在激进压缩下保留关键结构。模型压到 31.9M 参数、FLOPs 降 6.3×，多数据集平均性能仅比未压缩基线低 1.30%。
Motivation: 基于自监督学习 (SSL) 的深伪检测器虽达 SOTA，但通常 300M+ 参数，无法部署到资源受限设备；面向内容类任务设计的压缩方法直接迁移时难以保持检测性能。
Method: 提出 Task-Aware Joint Pruning and Distillation 框架，结合跨域知识蒸馏 (cross-domain knowledge distillation) 与 movement-guided 结构化剪枝，前者迁移伪造判别知识，后者在激进压缩下保护关键结构。
Result: 模型参数从 300M+ 降至 31.9M，FLOPs 减少 6.3×；在多个数据集上相对未压缩基线平均性能下降仅 1.30%。
Conclusion: 联合剪枝与蒸馏可在激进压缩下基本保住 SSL 深伪检测性能，使该类模型具备端侧部署潜力。

papers.title: Learning from imperfect teachers for low-resource acoustic generalization
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) improves low-resource acoustic learning by enriching one-hot supervision with the softened predictive distribution of a fixed teacher network. However, a teacher trained with limited or imbalanced annotations may produce a biased distribution whose components are not uniformly reliable. Although this distribution can still encode useful knowledge, direct full-distribution matching may also transfer teacher-induced biases, thereby distorting the student's decision boundary and degrading its generalization performance. To address this limitation, we propose Boundary-Anchored Mass-Partitioned Distillation (BA-MPD), a logit-based distillation objective composed of Boundary-Anchored Correction (BAC) and Mass-Partitioned Distillation (MPD). BAC addresses missing ground-truth labels in the set of the teacher's top predictions by swapping the true label for the lowest-ranked entry of the set, thus keeping the mass and uncertainty of the set unchanged. MPD then distills this corrected distribution through separate losses that enforce relational consistency within the set, balance the mass between high- and low-confidence groups, and weight lower-confidence dependencies. Ultimately, BAC and MPD together suppress harmful ranking errors and noisy low-confidence details, while retaining all useful teacher information. Experiments on two acoustic benchmarks under multiple label budgets show that BA-MPD consistently improves over supervised-learning baselines and vanilla KD while remaining competitive with strong logit-based KD baselines. Cross-budget results further show that BA-MPD remains effective when the teacher and student models use mismatched label budgets, demonstrating its ability to exploit imperfect teachers across supervision gaps. Implementation available at https://github.com/ShuanglinLi/BA-MPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向低资源声学的知识蒸馏目标 BA-MPD：先用 Boundary-Anchored Correction (BAC) 在教师 top 预测集合中把最低位条目换成缺失的真实标签，保持集合质量与不确定性不变，再用 Mass-Partitioned Distillation (MPD) 分组约束排序关系、平衡高低置信度质量并加权低置信依赖。在两个声学基准、多种标注预算下，BA-MPD 稳定优于监督基线与 vanilla KD，并在师生标注预算不匹配时仍有效。
Motivation: 标注有限或不平衡时教师分布有偏、各分量可靠性不一，直接全分布匹配会把教师偏差传给学生，扭曲决策边界并损害泛化。
Method: BA-MPD 是基于 logit 的蒸馏目标，由 BAC 与 MPD 组成：BAC 针对教师 top 预测集合中缺失真实标签的情况，用真实标签替换集合中排名最低的条目；MPD 用多个损失分别约束集合内关系一致性、平衡高/低置信度组之间的质量、并加权低置信度依赖。
Result: 在两个声学基准、多种标注预算下，BA-MPD 一致优于监督学习基线与 vanilla KD，并与强 logit-based KD 基线保持竞争力；在教师与学生标注预算不匹配的 cross-budget 设定下仍有效。
Conclusion: 对教师分布做边界锚定的标签修补加质量分组蒸馏，可以在监督缺口下利用不完美教师而不传递其排序错误与低置信噪声。

papers.title: Hybrid-Basis Feature Forecasting for Diffusion Sampling Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: We propose Hybrid-Basis Feature Forecasting (HybridFF), a training-free, plug-and-play framework for accelerating diffusion sampling. To capture local smoothness, long-range trends, and complex non-monotonic variations when modeling feature evolution, HybridFF first estimates coefficients using moving least squares (MLS) for each of multiple complementary basis families and then combines the corresponding predictors using fusion weights. In addition to the choice of basis functions, the fusion weights also play a critical role. We introduce two strategies to balance quality and speedup. HybridFF (Fixed) prioritizes efficiency with model-specific fusion weights calibrated on a small set and held constant during inference. HybridFF (Adaptive) updates the fusion weights online using branch reliability scores computed from an exponential moving average of full-step prediction errors, improving prediction fidelity and generation quality under aggressive caching while retaining substantial acceleration. Experiments across DiT-XL/2, FLUX.1-dev, SD3.5-Large, and HunyuanVideo demonstrate a favorable speedup--quality trade-off over representative single-basis forecasters and caching baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HybridFF 是一个免训练、即插即用的扩散采样加速框架：用 moving least squares (MLS) 在多组互补基函数上分别估计特征演化系数，再按融合权重合成预测，从而在激进缓存 (caching) 下替代部分去噪步。HybridFF (Fixed) 用小集标定的模型专属权重换取速度，HybridFF (Adaptive) 用全步预测误差的指数滑动平均算分支可靠度、在线更新权重以保质量；在 DiT-XL/2、FLUX.1-dev、SD3.5-Large 与 HunyuanVideo 上取得优于单基预测器与缓存基线的速度-质量折中。
Motivation: 扩散采样缓存类方法用相邻步特征外推替代重复去噪，但单一基函数难以同时刻画局部平滑、长程趋势与非单调变化，激进缓存时预测误差累积、生成质量下降。
Method: 对每组互补基族分别用 moving least squares (MLS) 拟合特征演化系数，得到多个预测器后按融合权重加权合成。两种权重策略：Fixed 在小规模标定集上确定模型专属权重并在推理中固定；Adaptive 用全步预测误差的指数滑动平均 (EMA) 计算各分支可靠度分数，在线更新融合权重。
Result: 在 DiT-XL/2、FLUX.1-dev、SD3.5-Large 和 HunyuanVideo 上，相对代表性单基特征预测器与缓存基线呈现更优的速度-质量折中 (speedup--quality trade-off)；Adaptive 在激进缓存下提升预测保真度与生成质量，同时保留可观加速。
Conclusion: 多基融合加可靠度驱动的在线权重更新，可以在免训练缓存加速中同时守住质量与加速幅度；权重策略是速度与质量之间的可调开关。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: MGPO: Manifold-Guided Diffusion Alignment for Task-Aware Dataset Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based dataset distillation (DD) suffers from a fundamental objective mismatch: likelihood-driven diffusion models prioritize density approximation over the discriminative decision boundaries required for downstream tasks. Beyond semantic mismatch, relying solely on density also leads to geometric coverage loss, where generated samples collapse into a few high-density modes and fail to cover the manifold's structural diversity. We propose Manifold-Guided Policy Optimization (MGPO), which reformulates DD as a multi-objective reinforcement learning problem and achieves Dual-Space Alignment via a pixel-space discriminative reward and a latent-space geometric reward guided by a class-wise Minimum Spanning Tree (MST). The discriminative reward enforces class separability, while the MST-based geometric reward encourages generated latents to cover a sparse geometric skeleton of each class, jointly addressing both failure modes. We further provide an idealized analysis that motivates the MST-based reward, including a Hausdorff approximation bound and a subsampling bound independent of the dataset size. The reward-modular design extends to structured tasks such as object detection and segmentation by substituting the frozen task reward model. Extensive experiments show MGPO consistently outperforms existing methods, including a +8.0% mIoU gain on segmentation under low-budget settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MGPO 把基于扩散的数据集蒸馏 (dataset distillation) 改写成多目标强化学习，用像素空间判别奖励与潜空间几何奖励做双空间对齐：前者强制类可分性，后者用类内最小生成树 (MST) 引导生成潜变量覆盖每类的稀疏几何骨架，从而同时解决密度近似偏离判别决策边界与样本塌缩到少数高密度模式这两个失败模式。在低预算设定的分割任务上 mIoU 提升 +8.0%。
Motivation: 扩散模型按似然训练，只逼近数据密度而忽略下游任务需要的判别决策边界；单靠密度还会造成几何覆盖损失，生成样本塌缩到少数高密度模式，无法覆盖流形的结构多样性。
Method: 提出 Manifold-Guided Policy Optimization (MGPO)：把 DD 形式化为多目标 RL，奖励由两部分组成——像素空间的判别奖励 (discriminative reward) 保证类间可分，潜空间基于类内最小生成树 (MST) 的几何奖励引导生成潜变量覆盖各类的稀疏几何骨架；奖励模块可替换，通过换掉冻结的任务奖励模型即可扩展到目标检测与分割等结构化任务。另给出理想化分析，包括 Hausdorff 逼近界与一个与数据集规模无关的子采样界。
Result: 在低预算 (low-budget) 设定的分割任务上 mIoU 相对现有方法提升 +8.0%；摘要称在广泛实验中 MGPO 一致优于现有方法，并覆盖检测、分割等结构化任务。
Conclusion: 把数据集蒸馏的目标从单纯密度匹配改为判别与几何双空间对齐，可同时修复决策边界偏离与模式塌缩；MST 几何奖励有 Hausdorff 逼近界与数据集规模无关的子采样界支撑，奖励模块化使其能迁移到检测、分割等任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Personal Context Recognition on ExtraSensory
papers.abstract_en: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) have attracted increasing attention in recent years, with applications across a wide range of AI tasks. In this paper, we evaluate several KAN variants on the ExtraSensory dataset for personal context recognition and compare them with a multilayer perceptron (MLP) and TabM. We conduct the main experiments using five user folds and three random seeds per fold and report the average Macro-F1, Micro-F1, and training time. We also perform shallow ablation studies on grid size, the number of grids, and data normalization to examine their effects on KAN performance. The results show that all evaluated KAN variants significantly outperform MLP in terms of Macro-F1 and Micro-F1 and achieve performance comparable to TabM. However, KAN variants generally require more training time, while TabM provides a more favorable balance between predictive performance and training efficiency. These results suggest that KANs are promising for personal context recognition, while their computational efficiency remains an important challenge. Our source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/hoangthangta/ExtraSensory-KANs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ExtraSensory 个人情境识别数据集上评测多种 Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) 变体，与 MLP 和 TabM 对比：五用户折、每折三个随机种子下，所有 KAN 变体的 Macro-F1 与 Micro-F1 均显著超过 MLP、达到与 TabM 相当的水平，但训练时间普遍更长。结论是 KAN 适合该任务，计算效率仍是主要瓶颈，TabM 在性能与训练效率之间更均衡。
Motivation: KAN 近年受关注但缺少在个人情境识别这类移动感知表格型任务上的系统评测，其相对 MLP、TabM 的精度与训练开销权衡不清楚。
Method: 在 ExtraSensory 数据集上评测多个 KAN 变体，基线为 MLP 与 TabM；实验采用五个用户折、每折三个随机种子，报告平均 Macro-F1、Micro-F1 与训练时间；另做关于 grid size、grid 数量与数据归一化的浅层消融。
Result: 所有 KAN 变体在 Macro-F1 和 Micro-F1 上显著优于 MLP，性能与 TabM 相当；KAN 变体训练时间普遍更长，TabM 在预测性能与训练效率之间更均衡。消融考察 grid size、grid 数量与数据归一化对 KAN 性能的影响。
Conclusion: KAN 对个人情境识别有潜力，但计算效率仍是重要挑战；在需要兼顾训练效率时 TabM 是更平衡的选择。

papers.title: ArticuTable: Generating Instance-Level Interactive Rigid-Articulated 3D Tabletop Scenes from a Single Image
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents benefit from 3D environments that combine visual fidelity to real-world observations with physical interactivity. Existing single-image tabletop reconstruction methods recover plausible scene geometry but typically represent objects as monolithic rigid bodies, limiting interaction to whole-object rigid motion and precluding executable part-level articulation. Meanwhile, recovering a scene layout consistent with the input view remains challenging because a single observation may admit multiple plausible pose-scale configurations. We present ArticuTable, a single-image 3D tabletop reconstruction framework that recovers both executable part-level articulation and an input-view-consistent scene layout. For object modeling, we introduce generation-robust articulation modeling (GRAM), which combines joint fitting guided by a multimodal large language model with semantic state reasoning to recover reliable joint parameters and valid motion ranges from imperfect monolithic proxy meshes, thereby converting them into executable articulated assets. For scene layout, we introduce progressive semantic-geometric scene registration (PSGSR), which progressively narrows the pose-scale search space under complementary metric, planar, and input-view constraints and resolves orientation ambiguity through structure-aware semantic correspondences, yielding a scene layout consistent with the input view. We further contribute ArticuTable-100, a curated collection of 100 simulation-ready tabletop scenes. Extensive evaluation, including a user study, demonstrates strong performance across visual fidelity, input-view consistency, articulation quality, physical plausibility, and simulation readiness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ArticuTable 从单张图像重建可执行部件级铰接与视角一致的 3D 桌面场景：GRAM 用多模态大语言模型引导的关节拟合加语义状态推理，把不完美的整体式代理网格转成可铰接资产；PSGSR 在度量、平面与输入视角约束下渐进收窄位姿-尺度搜索空间。配套发布 100 个仿真就绪场景 ArticuTable-100，用户研究在视觉保真、视角一致、铰接质量、物理合理性与仿真就绪上表现强。
Motivation: 单图桌面重建只能得到整体刚体，交互止于整物体刚性运动，部件级铰接不可执行；且单一观测存在多种合理位姿-尺度配置，场景布局难以与输入视角对齐。
Method: 物体侧用 GRAM：多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 引导的关节拟合结合语义状态推理，从不完美的整体式代理网格恢复关节参数与有效运动范围。场景侧用 PSGSR：在度量、平面与输入视角三类互补约束下渐进收窄位姿-尺度搜索空间，并用结构感知语义对应消解朝向歧义。另建 ArticuTable-100，100 个仿真就绪桌面场景。
Result: 在视觉保真、输入视角一致性、铰接质量、物理合理性与仿真就绪五个维度上表现强，评测包含一项用户研究；贡献 ArticuTable-100 共 100 个仿真就绪场景。
Conclusion: 单图重建可以同时给出可执行的部件级铰接和与输入视角一致的布局，前提是把关节参数恢复与位姿-尺度搜索分开处理，并用 MLLM 语义先验补足代理网格的缺陷。
