papers.title: StateWise: Diagnosing and Repairing Persistent Operational State Before Agent Actions
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents combine reasoning, tool use, and persistent memory to support work across tasks by reusing stored operational records as premises for later actions. However, environmental or requirement changes can invalidate these records, while existing action review, provenance tracking, and clarification mechanisms may leave the underlying persistent state uncorrected. Our audit of coding-agent trajectories identifies candidate failure chains in which invalid records are reused, leading to task failures and unsafe modifications. We propose StateWise, a framework for diagnosing and repairing persistent operational state before action execution. StateWise uses record-level counterfactual replanning to identify decision-critical records, then establishes their current validity through reliability checks, read-only verification of machine-observable facts, and targeted clarification of developer-owned intent. Typed evidence grounding binds evidence to specific records and scopes, enabling persistent corrections with repair lineage. The agent then replans from the repaired state, followed by an independent state-action check before execution. We evaluate StateWise on 150 executable coding-agent cases across diverse runtime environments, workspace configurations, and repository settings, complemented by cross-model evaluations. Under corrupted persistent state, StateWise achieves 93.3% overall correctness, compared with 38.7% for the baseline agent, with no unsafe actions. Component ablations, multi-task experiments, and transfer evaluations further demonstrate effective recovery, persistent corrections, and transferability across repositories and tool interfaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StateWise 在执行动作前诊断并修复 LLM agent 的持久操作状态：用记录级反事实重规划找出决策关键记录，再以可靠性检查、只读事实核验与定向澄清确认其当前有效性，修复后重规划并做独立的状态-动作检查。在 150 个可执行 coding-agent 用例的持久状态被污染条件下，整体正确率 93.3%，基线 agent 38.7%，且无不安全动作。
Motivation: 环境或需求变化会使 agent 记忆中的操作记录失效，而现有的动作审查、来源追踪与澄清机制只管动作本身，底层持久状态仍带着错误记录被复用，导致任务失败与不安全修改。
Method: StateWise 分四步：记录级反事实重规划定位决策关键记录；用可靠性检查、机器可观测事实的只读核验、以及针对开发者意图的定向澄清确定其当前有效性；以类型化证据锚定 (typed evidence grounding) 把证据绑定到具体记录与作用域，产生带修复谱系 (repair lineage) 的持久修正；修复后重新规划，并在执行前加入独立的状态-动作检查。
Result: 在 150 个覆盖不同运行时环境、工作区配置与仓库设置的可执行 coding-agent 用例上，持久状态被污染时 StateWise 整体正确率 93.3%，基线 agent 38.7%，且无不安全动作；另有组件消融、多任务实验与跨模型评测，以及跨仓库与工具接口的迁移评测。
Conclusion: 在动作执行前修复持久状态本身，而非只审查动作，能在状态污染下大幅恢复正确性并消除不安全动作，且修复可跨仓库与工具接口迁移。

papers.title: Pythia: Toward Foundation World Models for Multimodal Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Time-series foundation models offer a unified approach to forecasting across heterogeneous domains. Textual context and auxiliary observations provide complementary information about temporal dynamics, yet reusable multimodal predictive representations remain underexplored. We introduce Pythia, a foundation world model that learns context-conditioned latent dynamics across datasets through a joint-embedding predictive architecture. A stop-gradient numerical reference guides contextual corrections to predicted future states. A separate probabilistic decoder then adapts to the frozen predictive representation and observed history, decoupling world-model pretraining from observation-space forecasting. On MUSE, Pythia-Tiny's normalized mean absolute scaled error (MASE) and weighted sum quantile loss (WSQL) are 0.6879 and 0.4269, reducing errors by 6.26% and 5.00% relative to the strongest model evaluated in the published MUSE leaderboard. Through a series of controlled experiments, we investigate how to design a time-series world model through shared pretraining and how joint-embedding predictive learning can incorporate multimodal information. The results support separating predictive representation learning from probabilistic readout and show complementary contributions from entity descriptions, events, and covariates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Pythia 用联合嵌入预测架构 (joint-embedding predictive architecture) 学习跨数据集的上下文条件化隐动态，stop-gradient 数值参考约束对未来状态的上下文修正，再用独立的概率解码器在冻结的预测表示上做观测空间预报。在 MUSE 基准上 Pythia-Tiny 的 MASE 为 0.6879、WSQL 为 0.4269，相对已发布榜单最强模型分别降低 6.26% 与 5.00% 误差。
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型要跨异构域统一预报，文本上下文与辅助观测各自携带互补的时序信息，但可复用的多模态预测表示仍缺乏有效设计路径。
Method: Pythia 作为 foundation world model，以联合嵌入预测架构学习跨数据集的上下文条件化隐动态；用 stop-gradient 数值参考引导上下文对预测未来状态的修正；再训练独立的概率解码器适配冻结的预测表示与观测历史，把世界模型预训练与观测空间预报解耦，并通过受控实验考察共享预训练设计与多模态信息的融入方式。
Result: 在 MUSE 基准上，Pythia-Tiny 的 MASE 为 0.6879、WSQL 为 0.4269，相对已发布 MUSE 榜单上最强模型分别降低 6.26% 与 5.00% 误差；受控实验显示实体描述、事件与协变量具有互补贡献。
Conclusion: 预测表示学习与概率读出应当分离，多模态上下文信息可在该框架下互补地提升时间序列预报。

papers.title: Settling the Computational Complexity of Max-Min Allocation with Ternary Valuations
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of computing an allocation of indivisible items that maximizes egalitarian welfare, i.e., the utility of the worst-off agent, when agents' item values or marginal values belong to a small set. For additive valuations with values in $\{p,q\}$, where $q>p>0$ and $\gcd(p,q)=1$, we give a polynomial-time algorithm when $p=2$ and prove constant-gap hardness when $p\geq3$, already with exactly three high-valued goods per agent. We also give an $\sqrt{3/2}$-approximation for common positive bi-valued additive valuations. For mixed additive valuations in $\{-p,0,c\}$, where $p\in\{1,2\}$ and $c$ is a positive integer, a reduction to maximum-weight perfect matching resolves the conjectured tractability of $\{-2,0,c\}$-valuations. For submodular valuations with marginals in $\{-2,0,c\}$, where $c$ is odd, we establish an exact unit-gap hardness result and exponential value-query lower bounds, even when all but one agent are additive. Finally, for $\{-1,0,1\}$-submodular valuations, we prove that no finite multiplicative approximation exists unless $\p=\np$. Together, our results resolve open questions and provide a complete picture of the computational complexity of max-min allocation with ternary valuations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在三值 (ternary) 估值下给出 max-min allocation（最大化最差个体福利）复杂性的完整图景：{2,q} 可加估值在 p=2 时多项式可解、p≥3 时即使每个 agent 恰有三件高价值物品也是常数差距难；{-2,0,c} 可加估值经最大权完美匹配归约判定为易解；{-1,0,1} 次模估值在 P≠NP 下不存在任何有限乘法近似。
Motivation: max-min allocation 在取值受限的二值/三值估值下哪些情形可解、哪些难、近似到什么程度长期存在开放问题，尤其是 {-2,0,c} 的易解性猜想与次模三值情形的近似可能性。
Method: 对 {p,q} 可加估值给出 p=2 的多项式算法并做 p≥3 的常数差距难性归约（限制为每 agent 三件高价值物品）；对混合 {-p,0,c} 可加估值归约到最大权完美匹配 (maximum-weight perfect matching)；对 {-2,0,c} 次模估值（c 为奇数）建立 unit-gap 硬性与值查询下界，并对 {-1,0,1} 次模做 P≠NP 下的不可近似性论证。
Result: {p,q} 可加估值：p=2 多项式时间可解，p≥3 常数差距难（每 agent 恰三件高价值物品）；常见正二值可加估值有 √(3/2)-近似；{-2,0,c} 可加（p∈{1,2}）经最大权完美匹配解决其易解性猜想；{-2,0,c} 次模（c 奇数）有精确 unit-gap 硬性与指数级值查询下界，即使除一个 agent 外全为可加；{-1,0,1} 次模在 P≠NP 下不存在有限乘法近似。
Conclusion: 三值估值下 max-min allocation 的复杂性被完整刻画：可加情形多为易解或常数近似，而次模情形即便取值极受限也本质上不可近似。

summary_sections.result: {p,q} 可加估值：p=2 多项式时间可解，p≥3 常数差距难（每 agent 恰三件高价值物品）；常见正二值可加估值有 √(3/2)-近似；{-2,0,c} 可加（p∈{1,2}）经最大权完美匹配解决其易解性猜想；{-2,0,c} 次模（c 奇数）有精确 unit-gap 硬性与指数级值查询下界，即使除一个 agent 外全为可加；{-1,0,1} 次模在 P≠NP 下不存在有限乘法近似。
summary_sections.conclusion: 三值估值下 max-min allocation 的复杂性被完整刻画：可加情形多为易解或常数近似，而次模情形即便取值极受限也本质上不可近似。

papers.title: EMG-GPT: Predictive Pretraining on Residual-Quantized EMG Tokens for Hand Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Surface electromyography (sEMG) is a low-power, cost-effective biosignal for hand-pose estimation and gesture classification. In this work, we examine whether self-supervised pretraining on sEMG can yield transferable representations for continuous hand-pose estimation. We introduce EMG-GPT, a causal transformer-based model that operates on discrete sEMG representations from a frozen residual vector quantization (RVQ) tokenizer and learns temporal dynamics through depth-autoregressive future-code prediction. The model combines within-frame integration with causal temporal modeling while preserving the geometry of the pretrained codebook. EMG-GPT shows competitive results in both Regression and Tracking tasks, supporting EMG-only pretraining as a viable approach for learning transferable sEMG representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMG-GPT 用冻结的 RVQ 残差向量量化 tokenizer 把 sEMG 离散化，再以因果 Transformer 做 depth-autoregressive 未来码预测的自监督预训练，学习时序动态并保留预训练码本几何。模型在连续手姿估计的 Regression 与 Tracking 任务上均取得有竞争力的结果，说明 EMG-only 预训练可学到可迁移的 sEMG 表示。
Motivation: sEMG 是低功耗、低成本的生物信号，但连续手姿估计需要可迁移的时序表示；本文要检验在 sEMG 上做自监督预训练能否产生对连续手姿估计有用的表示。
Method: EMG-GPT 是基于因果 Transformer 的模型，输入来自冻结的 residual vector quantization (RVQ) tokenizer 的离散 sEMG 表示，通过 depth-autoregressive future-code prediction 学习时序动态；训练结合帧内整合 (within-frame integration) 与因果时序建模，并保持预训练 codebook 的几何结构。
Result: 在 Regression 与 Tracking 两类连续手姿估计任务上，EMG-GPT 均取得有竞争力 (competitive) 的结果。
Conclusion: EMG-only 自监督预训练是学习可迁移 sEMG 表示的可行路径，离散码本上的因果自回归预训练可支撑连续手姿估计。

papers.title: PixReenact: Pixel-Conditioned Causal Video Diffusion for Streaming Head-Avatar Reenactment
papers.abstract_en: Streaming head-avatar reenactment aims to animate a reference image according to a live driving video, requiring robust motion transfer, long-term identity stability, and low latency. Existing methods often rely on specialized identity or motion representations, which can discard useful visual information and inherit failure modes from external extractors. In addition, many recent diffusion-based reenactment methods use offline, clip-based generation, jointly processing and denoising an entire video clip before producing its output, making continuous low-latency streaming difficult. We introduce PixReenact, a pixel-conditioned streaming reenactment framework built on causal video diffusion. PixReenact conditions directly on VAE-encoded reference and driving frames, without specialized identity or motion representations. To separate reference identity from driver motion, we train with cross-identity pseudo supervision together with corrective objectives anchored to the original reference and driving inputs. Long self-rollouts reduce autoregressive drift, while state-aware dual-teacher distillation separately addresses cold-start and steady-state generation. Across three cross-identity benchmarks and a long-horizon streaming benchmark, PixReenact demonstrates robust cross-identity reenactment, particularly under challenging conditions such as extreme viewpoints, occlusions, and pronounced facial expressions, while maintaining the reference identity over long streams. A 4-NFE rolling student continuously emits four frames per update with a mean emission latency of 239 ms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PixReenact 用因果视频扩散做流式头像重演，直接以 VAE 编码的参考帧与驱动帧为条件，靠跨身份伪监督与长自回滚抑制漂移，在三个跨身份基准和长时程流式基准上保持长流中的身份稳定，4-NFE rolling student 每次更新连续输出四帧，平均发射延迟 239 ms。
Motivation: 现有重演方法依赖专用身份或运动表征，会丢弃视觉信息并继承外部提取器的失败模式；扩散式方法多为离线整段去噪，难以做到连续低延迟流式生成。
Method: 提出基于因果视频扩散的 PixReenact：条件直接来自 VAE 编码的参考与驱动帧，训练时用 cross-identity pseudo supervision 分离参考身份与驱动运动，并加锚定原始参考/驱动输入的 corrective objectives；以长 self-rollout 抑制自回归漂移，用 state-aware dual-teacher distillation 分别处理冷启动与稳态生成。
Result: 在三个跨身份基准与一个长时程流式基准上，极端视角、遮挡、明显面部表情等困难条件下仍实现稳健的跨身份重演并在长流中保持参考身份；4-NFE rolling student 每次更新连续发射四帧，平均发射延迟 239 ms。
Conclusion: 不依赖专用身份/运动表征、直接像素条件的因果视频扩散可以支撑低延迟流式头像重演，并在长时程中维持身份稳定。

papers.title: Vela: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with Adaptive Action Curve Parametrization
papers.abstract_en: Most vision-language-action models represent future motion as fixed-rate action chunks, tying temporal resolution and prediction horizon to a fixed output budget. This pointwise representation wastes capacity on highly correlated neighboring actions, leaves temporal continuity and smoothness to be learned implicitly, and forces a tradeoff between long-horizon coverage and the local precision required for contact-rich manipulation. To address these limitations, we introduce Vela, a vision-language-action foundation model that represents future robot behavior as continuous trajectories. Vela combines a compact spline-based action representation with motion-dependent temporal support and a shared action interface for heterogeneous embodiments, allowing a fixed output budget to adapt its temporal resolution across motions. We pretrain Vela on large-scale multi-embodiment robot data and evaluate it on LIBERO-X, EBench, and two real-world long-horizon tasks, egg-cake cooking and potato shredding, obtaining promising results across simulation and physical manipulation. These results highlight the potential of continuous action representations as a foundation for future embodied foundation models. Project page and more results: https://clementine24.github.io/Vela/ .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Vela 把视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型的未来动作从固定速率 action chunk 改成连续轨迹：用紧凑的样条 (spline) 动作表示加运动相关的时域支撑，并以共享动作接口适配异构机器人本体，使固定输出预算能随时动自适应时序分辨率。在 LIBERO-X、EBench 及两项真实长程任务（egg-cake cooking、potato shredding）上取得仿真与实体操作的 promising 结果。
Motivation: 固定速率 action chunk 把时序分辨率和预测时域绑死在固定输出预算上，相邻动作高度相关浪费容量，时序连续性和平滑性只能隐式学习，长程覆盖与接触密集操作所需的局部精度互相冲突。
Method: Vela 是 VLA 基础模型，将未来机器人行为表示为连续轨迹：紧凑样条动作表示 + 运动相关的时域支撑 (motion-dependent temporal support) + 面向异构本体的共享动作接口；在大规模多本体机器人数据上预训练。
Result: 在 LIBERO-X、EBench 以及两项真实世界长程任务 egg-cake cooking 与 potato shredding 上评测，摘要称在仿真与实体操作中取得 promising 结果（未给出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 连续动作表示可以作为未来具身基础模型的基础，让固定输出预算自适应分配时序分辨率，同时兼顾长程覆盖与局部精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GFGE: Unifying Explainable AI Methods through an Interpretation Framework
papers.abstract_en: Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) encompasses methods that draw on different sources of information and address different explanatory needs. A common framework is needed to describe how this information becomes evidence and is communicated as an explanation for a particular recipient. We propose the General Framework for Generating Explanations (GFGE), grounded in interpretative frameworks and the complementary activities of \emph{sense-reading} and \emph{sense-giving}. Its conceptual foundation is the Interpret/Explain Schema (IES), which connects an analyst's interpretation of system evidence, the communication of a selected account, and the recipient's interpretation of that account. GFGE operationalises this schema through five roles: data interpretation, model interpretation, output interpretation, optional post-hoc analysis, and aggregation. A role-typed operation graph records method-specific dependencies, while evidence records retain the sources, assumptions, and limitations of explanatory claims. The explanatory question, audience, and context guide the procedure. We instantiate GFGE for attribution, surrogate, counterfactual, concept and prototype, intrinsic rule, argumentation, and language-model methods. These instantiations show how intrinsic, post-hoc, and hybrid workflows can be represented through the same roles while preserving their distinct evidential requirements. GFGE provides a common basis for analysing explanation workflows, tracing communicated claims to their evidence, and identifying unresolved explanatory dependencies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GFGE 提出统一可解释 AI (XAI) 的解释生成框架，以 Interpret/Explain Schema (IES) 为核心，把分析者对系统证据的解读、所选解释的传递、接收者的再解读串成一条链，并用五个角色（数据解释、模型解释、输出解释、可选事后分析、聚合）落地。角色类型化的操作图记录方法依赖，证据记录保留来源、假设与局限；在 attribution、surrogate、counterfactual、concept/prototype、intrinsic rule、argumentation、语言模型方法上的实例化表明 intrinsic、post-hoc 与 hybrid 流程可用同一套角色表示，同时保留各自的证据要求。
Motivation: XAI 方法取材的信息来源不同、面向的解释需求也不同，缺少一个能描述信息如何变成证据、又如何针对特定接收者沟通的公共框架。
Method: 以解释性框架和 sense-reading / sense-giving 两类互补活动为基础提出 GFGE，概念内核是 IES 模式；用五个角色操作化，配角色类型化操作图 (role-typed operation graph) 记录方法依赖、证据记录 (evidence records) 保存来源假设与局限，由解释问题、受众与情境引导流程。
Result: 在 attribution、surrogate、counterfactual、concept 与 prototype、intrinsic rule、argumentation、语言模型七类方法上给出 GFGE 实例化，展示 intrinsic、post-hoc、hybrid 工作流可由同一套角色表示且保留各自的证据要求；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: GFGE 为分析解释流程、把对外沟通的论断追溯到其证据、并识别尚未解决的解释依赖提供了公共基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Look Before You Leap: Thermodynamic Arbitration of Parametric and Non-Parametric Knowledge in LLM Agents via Self-Regulating Memory Architectures
papers.abstract_en: The architecture of modern LLMs consists of a profound cognitive polarization. LLMs possess implicit intuition encoded in their parameters, yet rely on a disconnected, explicit mechanism to access the outside world. Agentic frameworks have not bridged this gap; instead, models are often compelled into pathological "induced amnesia." Under the prevailing "Retrieve-Always" paradigm, agents must distrust their internal knowledge, making every user interaction a "tabula rasa" event that must be checked externally. This creates reflexive dependence that can be thermodynamically wasteful, cognitively fragile, and susceptible to irrelevant context. We propose a return to first principles, operationalizing the biological maxim "Look Before You Leap." We introduce MARTA (Metacognitive Adaptive Retrieval and Thought Architecture), a neuro-symbolic framework that bridges parametric and non-parametric knowledge. Rather than treating retrieval as mandatory, MARTA models it as a cost, taking the leap only when perceived internal inadequacy warrants external information. By allowing the agent to gauge the entropy of its own thoughts before acting, MARTA enables deliberative retrieval and uncertainty-aware decision making. Our approach suggests that giving agents the capacity for introspection can restore a more efficient balance between internal knowledge and external information.
papers.journal_ref: Workshop on Latent {\&} Implicit Thinking {\textendash} Going Beyond CoT Reasoning, ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MARTA（Metacognitive Adaptive Retrieval and Thought Architecture），把检索从强制动作改为有代价的决策：智能体先评估自身思维的熵与内部知识不足程度，只有感知到不足才跳向外部检索。摘要给出的是定性主张——内省能力可在参数化知识与外部信息之间恢复更高效的平衡，未给出实验数字。
Motivation: 现行 Retrieve-Always 范式迫使 LLM 智能体不信任自身参数知识，把每次交互都当成需外部核验的 tabula rasa 事件，造成反射性依赖、热力学浪费与对无关上下文的脆弱性。
Method: MARTA 是连接参数化与非参数化知识的 neuro-symbolic 框架：把检索建模为带成本的动作，由智能体在行动前对自身思维熵做内省式评估，据此决定是否检索，实现 deliberative retrieval 与 uncertainty-aware decision making。
Result: 摘要仅给出定性结论：允许智能体内省可在内部知识与外部信息之间恢复更高效的平衡，相比 Retrieve-Always 减少不必要的外部核验；未列出数据集、基线或指标数字。
Conclusion: 检索不应默认执行，而应由智能体对自身不确定性的判断触发——内省式地权衡内部知识与外部信息，是缓解 LLM 智能体反射性依赖的可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ranking Bandits for Carousel Interfaces with Observable Browsing Depth
papers.abstract_en: Carousel interfaces allow a recommender system to directly observe how far a user has browsed. This signal distinguishes displayed but unclicked items from items that were never displayed, whereas conventional ranking-bandit models, including cascade and position-based models, generally treat examination as latent. We formulate a ranking-bandit problem in which a learner presents a list of $L$ items, observes the user's maximum browsing depth, and receives click feedback only for positions up to that depth. The objective is to maximize the expected number of clicks under an unknown item-attractiveness vector and a browsing-depth distribution. We propose three algorithms based on UCB, Thompson Sampling, and DMED, all of which update item statistics only from observed exposures. We derive an instance-dependent logarithmic upper bound for our UCB-based algorithm and an asymptotic upper bound for our DMED-based algorithm that coincides with the lower bound as its parameter $α\downarrow 0$, establishing asymptotic optimality in this limit. Simulations in synthetic shallow- and deep-browsing environments, together with experiments parameterized from RecGaze interaction logs, show that OD-TS attains final mean regret similar to PBM-TS, while the proposed methods achieve lower final mean regret than PBM-UCB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在轮播 (carousel) 推荐界面可直接观测用户最大浏览深度的设定下，提出只用已观测曝光更新统计量的三个排序 bandit 算法（UCB、Thompson Sampling、DMED），并证明 UCB 版本的实例相关对数上界，以及 DMED 版本在参数 α↓0 时与下界重合的渐近最优上界。合成浅层/深层浏览环境与 RecGaze 日志参数化实验显示 OD-TS 的最终平均 regret 与 PBM-TS 相当，三个方法均低于 PBM-UCB。
Motivation: 轮播界面能区分“展示了但没被看到”的条目与“从未展示”的条目，而 cascade、position-based 等传统排序 bandit 模型把是否被查看 (examination) 当作隐变量，浪费了这一可观测信号。
Method: 把问题形式化为：学习者展示 L 个条目，观测用户最大浏览深度，只在该深度以内的位置收到点击反馈；目标是在未知条目吸引力向量与浏览深度分布下最大化期望点击数。基于 UCB、Thompson Sampling、DMED 提出三个算法，均只从已观测曝光更新条目统计量。
Result: 为 UCB 算法推导实例相关对数 regret 上界；为 DMED 算法给出渐近上界，当参数 α↓0 时与下界重合，从而在该极限下建立渐近最优性。在合成浅层与深层浏览环境的仿真、以及用 RecGaze 交互日志参数化的实验中，OD-TS 的最终平均 regret 与 PBM-TS 相当，所提方法的最终平均 regret 低于 PBM-UCB。
Conclusion: 把浏览深度作为可观测信号并只用已观测曝光更新统计量，可以在排序 bandit 中取得与隐式 examination 模型相当甚至更低的 regret，且 DMED 版本在 α↓0 极限下达到渐近最优。

papers.title: Safe Context Switching for Agents in the Wild: Mitigating Subspace Interference via Orthogonal Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Most Large Language Models exhibit a fundamental tension between two sequential tasks, such as logical reasoning and safety alignment. The high-variance internal states required for sophisticated Chain-of-Thought (CoT) deduction can geometrically interfere with latent representations encoding safety constraints. We identify this phenomenon as Sequential Subspace Interference, showing that standard fine-tuning on logical tasks such as multi-step mathematics and code generation can result in a 23.3% interference penalty on alignment benchmarks, substantially weakening the model's safety priors. This Reasoning Drift is not adequately captured by current adaptation methods because gradients for logical tasks are rarely orthogonal to safety objectives. To address this issue, we propose AURA (Adaptive Unique Residual Allocation), a spectral regularization framework that enforces Spectral Independence between reasoning and safety. By explicitly estimating the null space of the alignment manifold and constraining reasoning updates to its orthogonal complement, AURA enables models to improve logical reasoning without compromising safety. Empirically, AURA recovers 23.0% of the lost performance while preserving greater than 0.98 cosine fidelity to the safe state, demonstrating that reasoning and alignment can be effectively decoupled through geometric regularization.
papers.journal_ref: ICLR 2026 the 2nd Workshop on World Models: Understanding, Modelling and Scaling
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 在逻辑任务上微调会与安全对齐表征发生几何干涉，作者称之为 Sequential Subspace Interference：多步数学与代码生成的标准微调在对齐基准上造成 23.3% 的干涉惩罚。提出 AURA（Adaptive Unique Residual Allocation）谱正则框架，显式估计对齐流形的零空间并把推理更新约束到其正交补上，恢复了损失性能的 23.0%，同时对安全状态保持 >0.98 的余弦保真度。
Motivation: 同一模型上顺序执行的两个任务（如逻辑推理与安全对齐）会互相干扰：推理所需的高方差内部状态会几何性地破坏安全约束的潜在表征，而现有适配方法中逻辑任务梯度很少与安全目标正交，无法充分捕捉这种 Reasoning Drift。
Method: 提出 AURA（Adaptive Unique Residual Allocation）谱正则 (spectral regularization) 框架，强制推理与安全之间的 Spectral Independence：显式估计对齐流形 (alignment manifold) 的零空间，把推理更新约束到其正交补 (orthogonal complement) 中，从而在几何上解耦推理与对齐。
Result: 标准微调在多步数学和代码生成等逻辑任务上造成对齐基准 23.3% 的干涉惩罚；AURA 恢复了损失性能的 23.0%，并对安全状态保持大于 0.98 的余弦保真度 (cosine fidelity)。
Conclusion: 推理与对齐可以通过几何正则被有效解耦：把推理更新限制在对齐流形的正交补内，就能在提升逻辑推理的同时不牺牲安全先验。

papers.title: Image Synthesis as an Intermediate for Controllable Time Series Generation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic-driven time-series generation offers a promising way to improve downstream learning in few-shot forecasting, but directly generating numerical sequences from language often fails to preserve the intended temporal structure. We propose VisualBridge, which uses time-series plots as a visual intermediate to bridge high-level temporal semantics and numerical sequences. An MLLM first converts plotted series into structured semantic representations, enabling explicit control over temporal properties such as trend, seasonality, and volatility. We then learn a semantic editing policy with downstream forecasting rewards, allowing the generation process to favor temporal patterns that are beneficial for the target task. The resulting sequences are further modeled by a temporal VAE to produce consistent multivariate augmentations. Experiments on standard public forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that VisualBridge improves few-shot forecasting over conventional augmentation methods, with ablations validating the roles of visual semantic grounding, learned semantic control, and VAE-based generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VisualBridge 把时间序列画成图，用 MLLM 从图中读出趋势、季节性、波动率等结构化语义表示，再以语义编辑策略配合下游预报奖励来控制生成，最后用 temporal VAE 产出一致的多变量增强序列。在标准公开预报基准上，该流程在少样本预报中优于常规数据增强方法，消融验证了视觉语义锚定、学习到的语义控制与 VAE 生成三部分各自的作用。
Motivation: 少样本预报需要靠生成式增强补数据，但直接从语言生成数值序列往往保不住预期的时间结构，语义与数值之间缺少可控的中间表示。
Method: 以时间序列图为视觉中介：MLLM 先把绘图序列转成结构化语义表示，显式控制 trend、seasonality、volatility 等时间属性；再学习一个带下游预报奖励的语义编辑策略，使生成偏向对目标任务有利的模式；最后用 temporal VAE 把序列建模为一致的多变量增强。
Result: 在标准公开预报基准上，VisualBridge 相比常规增强方法提升少样本预报表现；消融实验分别验证了视觉语义锚定、学习式语义控制与基于 VAE 的生成各自的作用。
Conclusion: 把图像合成当作语言语义与数值序列之间的中间层，可以让生成的时间结构对下游预报任务可控且更有用，少样本预报是其直接收益场景。

papers.title: F$^2$ SLAM: Turning Feed-Forward Geometry into Persistent Factors for SLAM
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D models provide strong multi-view geometric priors, while on- line simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) relies mainly on local mea- surements and can accumulate drift over long sequences. Existing attempts to combine the two typically treat feed-forward predictions as an external geomet- ric state that is aligned or fused with the online estimate after the fact, which keeps broader multi-view evidence outside the optimizer that refines the SLAM state. We present F2SLAM, which instead converts feed-forward geometry di- rectly into optimization-native target-weight measurements attached to a persis- tent dense factor graph. A high-frequency stream maintains local tracking con- straints and graph connectivity, while a low-frequency stream uses wider multi- view context to selectively refresh existing measurements after a state-consistency check. Both streams constrain the same poses, inverse depths, and optional cam- era intrinsics through a single dense bundle adjustment. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate consistently strong trajectory estimation and improved dense reconstruction in both calibrated and uncalibrated settings. Notably, the uncalibrated configuration reduces the average ATE RMSE from 0.030 m for the strongest feed-forward baseline to 0.002 m on the Replica dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: F²SLAM 把前馈 3D 模型的多视角几何直接转成优化原生的 target-weight 测量，挂到持久化稠密因子图上，与在线 SLAM 状态一起进同一个稠密 bundle adjustment，而不是事后对齐融合。在未标定设置下 Replica 数据集平均 ATE RMSE 从最强前馈基线的 0.030 m 降到 0.002 m。
Motivation: 前馈几何模型有多视角先验但在线 SLAM 长序列会累积漂移；现有做法把前馈预测当外部几何状态事后对齐或融合，广域多视角证据进不了优化 SLAM 状态的因子图。
Method: F²SLAM 将前馈几何转为 target-weight 测量并绑定到持久化稠密因子图：高频流维持局部跟踪约束与图连通性，低频流用更宽的多视角上下文在状态一致性检查后选择性刷新已有测量；两路共同约束位姿、逆深度与可选相机内参，统一在一个稠密 bundle adjustment 中优化。
Result: 在多个 benchmark 上轨迹估计持续强劲、稠密重建改善，标定与未标定设置均成立；未标定配置下 Replica 数据集平均 ATE RMSE 由最强前馈基线 0.030 m 降至 0.002 m。
Conclusion: 把前馈几何作为优化内部的持久测量而非事后外部状态，可以在未标定 SLAM 中把位姿误差压低一个量级以上。

papers.title: A Net Flux-Weighted Analytical Generalization of the Greenhouse Effect Beyond the Gray Approximation
papers.abstract_en: Analytical greenhouse models traditionally rely on the gray approximation, simplifying radiative transfer but treating optical depth as an unconstrained parameter that yields unrealistic surface temperatures. We derive an exact, closed-form solution directly from Schwarzschild's equations for a non-gray atmosphere. While the gray approach is physically inadequate because it over-weights saturated bands that carry negligible net energy transport, we show that the non-gray formulation constrains column optical depth via the surface net radiative flux, naturally accounting for the atmospheric window without ad hoc corrections. The resulting effective optical depth penalizes saturated cores due to the negative spectral covariance between opacity and transmission. This shifts the computed surface equilibrium to an observationally consistent 288 K, yielding a purely radiative Transient Climate Response of +2.18 K under doubled \ce{CO2}, fully consistent with Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change estimates. The framework eliminates any theoretical basis for greenhouse-effect saturation. While not intended to replace three-dimensional general circulation models, this work reconciles classical radiative transfer with modern climate estimates, demonstrating that proper flux-weighting aligns analytical theory with anthropogenic warming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从 Schwarzschild 辐射传输方程推出非灰 (non-gray) 大气温室效应的精确闭式解，用地表净辐射通量约束柱光学厚度，使有效光学厚度因不透明度与透过率的负谱协方差而惩罚饱和吸收带核心。算出的地表平衡温度为 288 K，纯辐射的 CO2 加倍瞬变气候响应 (TCR) 为 +2.18 K，与 IPCC 估计一致，并据此否定温室效应饱和的理论依据。
Motivation: 传统解析温室模型依赖灰近似，把光学厚度当作无约束自由参数，导致地表温度不真实，且高估几乎不携带净能量输送的饱和吸收带。
Method: 直接从 Schwarzschild 方程导出非灰大气的精确闭式解：用地表净辐射通量约束柱光学厚度，显式纳入大气窗口，无需 ad hoc 修正；有效光学厚度按不透明度与透过率的负谱协方差对饱和带核心加权惩罚。
Result: 算得地表平衡温度 288 K（观测一致），CO2 加倍的纯辐射瞬变气候响应 +2.18 K，与 IPCC 估计一致；结论是温室效应饱和没有理论依据。
Conclusion: 正确的通量加权能调和经典辐射传输与现代气候估计，使解析理论与人为增温一致；作者明确该框架不用于替代三维 GCM。

summary_sections.conclusion: 正确的通量加权能调和经典辐射传输与现代气候估计，使解析理论与人为增温一致；作者明确该框架不用于替代三维 GCM。

papers.title: Learning without Overwriting: A Theory of Self-Distillation and Supervised Fine-Tuning in Continual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) of large language models (LLMs) has demonstrated the ability to improve reasoning capabilities while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Despite substantial empirical success, the dynamics of OPSD in continual reasoning remain incompletely understood. Modeling LLM reasoning as search over a directed acyclic graph, we provide a unified theoretical analysis of both the dynamics of post-training---OPSD and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in continual learning---and the impact of pre-training on subsequent performance. Our findings establish three key insights with an optimization guarantee: (i) OPSD with hints from correct outputs enables continual learning without forgetting by sparse yet effective gradient descent updates induced by the hint structure. (ii) SFT on correct reasoning paths can lead to catastrophic forgetting due to dense updates along the training paths, which overwrite the information previously acquired. (iii) Diversity in pre-training is crucial for enabling a post-trained model to reach a correct output when a rollout starts from an intermediate state. Our results, supported by theoretical analysis, show that reliable continual reasoning depends on how post-training updates interact with the reasoning structure established during pre-training.
papers.comment: main 11 pages, total 55 pages, main 2 figures, total 4 figures, 1 algorithm table in appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 推理建模为有向无环图 (DAG) 上的搜索，给出 OPSD 与 SFT 在持续学习中的统一理论分析：带正确输出提示的 on-policy self-distillation 产生稀疏而有效的梯度更新，实现不遗忘的持续学习；而对正确推理路径做 SFT 会产生沿路径的稠密更新，覆盖先前学到的信息，导致灾难性遗忘。预训练多样性决定 rollout 从中间状态出发能否到达正确输出。
Motivation: OPSD 在持续推理上经验上有效但动力学机制不清楚，SFT 何时导致灾难性遗忘、预训练如何影响后续后训练表现，都缺少统一的理论刻画。
Method: 将 LLM 推理表示为有向无环图上的搜索，对后训练（持续学习中的 OPSD 与 SFT）动力学以及预训练对后续性能的影响做统一理论分析，给出一个优化保证 (optimization guarantee)，并区分提示结构诱导的稀疏更新与训练路径上的稠密更新。
Result: 三条理论结论并附优化保证：(i) 带正确输出 hints 的 OPSD 通过提示结构诱导的稀疏但有效的梯度更新实现无遗忘的持续学习；(ii) 在正确推理路径上做 SFT 因沿路径的稠密更新而引发灾难性遗忘，覆盖既有信息；(iii) 预训练多样性对 rollout 从中间状态到达正确输出至关重要。
Conclusion: 持续推理的可靠性取决于后训练更新如何与预训练建立的推理结构相互作用：要避免遗忘，应让更新稀疏地贴合提示结构，而不是沿训练路径稠密覆盖。

papers.title: Cross-Time Directional Selection in Diffusion Sampling
papers.abstract_en: How strongly do the remaining diffusion-sampling steps amplify a perturbation at a late latent state? Standard measurements answer this question with newly sampled isotropic noise, even though perturbations encountered during sampling have already been transformed by earlier steps. We compare these two cases directly. For each trajectory, we transport a centered perturbation from an earlier step to a late state, then replay its direction at the same magnitude as a newly sampled isotropic perturbation; both then undergo the same remaining updates. Across the samplers we study, median paired shaped-to-fresh angular-gain ratios range from $1.14$ to $2.35$. Shaped angular gain exceeds its matched fresh counterpart in every trajectory in the original main cohorts. The same pattern appears when endpoint change is measured by latent RMS. The effect also appears in perceptual feature representations: earlier-sampling directions cause larger feature changes at the endpoint, even when the corresponding pixel-space change is comparable. Permuting shaped directions across trajectories weakens the effect, including within class, indicating that the advantage depends on alignment with the receiving trajectory as well as on shared directional structure.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 6 figures. NeurIPS 2026 AI for Stochastic Dynamics Workshop (poster)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩散采样中，把早期步的扰动方向输运到晚期潜态再回放，其角增益系统性高于同幅度的新采各向同性噪声：跨采样器的配对 shaped/fresh 角增益比中位数为 1.14–2.35，且在原始主队列的每条轨迹上 shaped 都更大。该优势依赖方向与接收轨迹的对齐，跨轨迹置换 shaped 方向后效应减弱（类内置换同样减弱）。
Motivation: 标准扩散敏感性度量用新采样的各向同性噪声度量剩余步对扰动的放大，但采样过程中实际遇到的扰动已被前面的步变换过，两者不可等同。
Method: 对每条轨迹，把中心化扰动从早期步输运到晚期状态，再以与新采各向同性扰动相同的幅度回放其方向，两者经历相同的剩余更新，构成配对比较；并做跨轨迹（含类内）置换 shaped 方向的对照，另以 latent RMS 与感知特征表示度量端点变化。
Result: 跨所研究的采样器，配对 shaped/fresh 角增益比中位数介于 1.14 与 2.35 之间；原始主队列中每条轨迹的 shaped 角增益都超过配对的 fresh。以 latent RMS 度量端点变化时模式相同；在感知特征表示中早期方向造成更大的端点特征变化，即使对应像素空间变化相当。跨轨迹置换 shaped 方向会削弱该效应，类内置换亦然。
Conclusion: 扩散采样的扰动放大具有方向选择性：早期采样方向因与接收轨迹对齐而比新采噪声产生更大端点改变，因此用各向同性噪声度量采样敏感性会低估真实扰动的传播。

papers.title: Same Predictions, Different Harms: Causal Auditing of Patient World Models
papers.abstract_en: Patient world models used for clinical trial simulation can agree on transition kernels and arm-specific risks, yet disagree on the fraction of patients harmed by switching treatment---the counterfactual quantity that matters for intervention-aware reasoning. We audit this reliability gap in a two-stage shared-response SCM: a categorical intermediate health state is followed by common terminal care. Under independent stages, the sharp harm interval has closed-form endpoints for at most three intermediate states, with an exactness boundary at four states. Declared dependence and response-mismatch budgets yield calibrated outer bounds when stage independence or complete mediation is relaxed; in a symmetric three-state model the entire sensitivity frontier is sharp, $[0,\min\{1/2,1/3+(ρ+δ)/2\}]$, and shows exactly how budgets erase the gain over endpoint-only bounds. Two eight-variable response LPs propagate interventional uncertainty for finite-sample audits. Exact witnesses verify attainability. On public clinical simulators (EpiCare; sepsis), native configurations show little resolved stage dependence and no additional joint-compatibility gain over pairwise transport---honest negative results for reliability claims. All experiments are locally reproducible; guarantees remain conditional on the stated causal model. The results provide a concrete protocol for deciding when a patient world model is safe to trust for counterfactual harm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对临床试验仿真中患者世界模型在反事实伤害量上的可靠性缺口，给出两阶段共享响应 SCM 下的因果审计协议：独立阶段时尖锐伤害区间有闭式端点（至多三个中间状态，四个状态为精确性边界），放松独立性后用声明的依赖与响应失配预算给出校准外包络。在公开临床仿真器 EpiCare 与 sepsis 上，原生配置几乎无可分辨的阶段依赖、相对成对传输无额外联合兼容增益，属诚实负结果。
Motivation: 临床试验仿真的患者世界模型即使转移核与各臂风险一致，也可能在换治疗的受害患者比例（反事实量）上分歧，而干预感知推理恰恰依赖该量，现有可靠性声明缺少可审计的判定协议。
Method: 在两阶段共享响应结构因果模型（SCM，分类中间健康状态 + 共同终末照护）中推导尖锐伤害区间；放松阶段独立或完全中介时用声明的依赖预算 ρ 与响应失配预算 δ 构造校准外包络；用两个八变量响应线性规划 (LP) 传播干预不确定性并以精确见证 (exact witnesses) 验证可达性。
Result: 独立阶段下尖锐伤害区间有闭式端点，适用于至多三个中间状态，四个状态为精确性边界；对称三态模型中整条敏感性前沿为尖锐的 [0, min{1/2, 1/3+(ρ+δ)/2}]，显示预算如何抹掉相对仅端点界的增益。EpiCare 与 sepsis 公开临床仿真器上，原生配置阶段依赖几乎不可分辨，相对成对传输 (pairwise transport) 无额外联合兼容增益。
Conclusion: 当阶段独立或完全中介被预算化放松时，反事实伤害的可判定范围由该敏感性前沿给出，据此可决定患者世界模型何时可被信任；结论仍以所声明的因果模型为条件，EpiCare/sepsis 的原生配置不支持更强的可靠性声明。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: From Scientific Observations to Mechanisms: Benchmarking Hypothesis Generation by AI Scientists
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven mechanistic hypotheses are essential to scientific discovery because they explain how underlying processes produce observed phenomena. AI agents and AI scientists increasingly support scientific data analysis. However, their ability to turn empirical findings into mechanistic hypotheses remains insufficiently examined. To address this gap, we introduce MechHypoBench, the first benchmark for evaluating whether AI agents and AI scientists can generate such hypotheses from empirical data. It combines paper-derived mechanisms from 14 scientific fields with real-world datasets containing 17.98 million records. The construction retains the observational complexity of empirical data while providing a specified underlying mechanism. Agents analyze the observations and propose open-form hypotheses. We develop an evaluation framework that assesses open-form mechanistic hypotheses through their consequences under withheld conditions. Experiments with general agents and AI scientists reveal a substantial gap between generated hypotheses and the underlying mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MechHypoBench，首个评测 AI agent 与 AI scientist 能否从经验数据生成机制性假设 (mechanistic hypothesis) 的基准：机制取自 14 个科学领域的论文，配以含 1798 万条记录的真实数据集，并保留观测复杂性同时指定底层机制。评测按假设在被隐藏条件下的推论打分，实验显示生成假设与真实机制之间存在明显差距。
Motivation: AI agent 已广泛参与科学数据分析，但其能否把经验发现转化为机制性假设长期缺乏系统检验，没有基准可衡量这一能力。
Method: MechHypoBench 从 14 个科学领域论文中抽取机制，配套含 17.98M 条记录的真实数据集，构造时既保留经验数据的观测复杂性又指定底层机制；agent 分析观测后给出开放形式 (open-form) 假设，评测框架依据假设在 withheld 条件下的推论 (consequences) 打分。
Result: 基准覆盖 14 个科学领域、17.98M 条真实记录；对通用 agent 与 AI scientist 的实验显示，其生成的假设与底层机制之间存在 substantial gap。
Conclusion: 现有 AI agent 与 AI scientist 从经验数据反推机制性假设的能力不足，MechHypoBench 把这一能力变成可按隐藏条件下推论检验的评测对象。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Measuring Learned Monotone Temporal Aggregation at Matched Admissibility
papers.abstract_en: Risk regulation imposes directional constraints on scores; we adopt their strict per-input form -- the score monotone non-decreasing in every exposure input -- as a normative commitment. Deployed pipelines -- monotone hand-crafted aggregates feeding sign-constrained gradient boosting -- already satisfy it by composition, so constrained-versus-unconstrained comparisons price a guarantee the incumbent has for free. We instead hold admissibility fixed on both sides and measure what learning the aggregation is worth. Our instrument is a recurrent network whose state is classical risk statistics (an exponentially weighted moving average and a high-water mark with learned transforms), monotone by construction in every input and per MC-dropout sample. The central finding, by functional regression, is a subsumption boundary: a learned monotone channel reproduces the geometrically weighted separable family of hand-crafted statistics, one channel per member, to Spearman $ρ\ge 0.996$, approximates window statistics with measurable ceilings, and fails at consecutivity ($ρ= 0.924$) and time localization (0.628), both structural, and at the exposure floor (0.829), a learnability boundary. One explicit admissible basis repairs each failure (rank correlation 1.000). In or near the separable family, learned and engineered aggregation are substitutes, and the learned channel is never statistically behind at full sample size and specified capacity. Its advantages are incumbent-specific: a committed grid pays up to 0.019 AUC in decay regions it leaves uncovered (the learned channel stays within 0.004 of the strongest engineered consumer at every swept point); the highest-dimensional comparator degrades fastest with scarce data; and beyond the training support, grid-fed tree-ensemble scores go flat while a strictly increasing head keeps ranking. No single incumbent is dominated on all three axes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在风险评分的逐输入单调约束下，把可采纳性 (admissibility) 两侧固定住，衡量学习式时序聚合到底值多少：递归网络状态为经典风险统计量（指数加权移动平均与高水位标记加可学习变换），按构造对每个输入单调、且对每个 MC-dropout 样本单调。功能回归给出的次 subsumption 边界是：学习通道能以 Spearman ρ≥0.996 复现手工几何加权可分族，但在连续性 (ρ=0.924)、时间定位 (0.628) 与暴露下限 (0.829) 上失败，各补一个显式可采纳基后秩相关回到 1.000。
Motivation: 风险监管要求分数对每个暴露输入单调不减，现有部署管线（手工单调聚合 + 符号约束梯度提升）已按复合满足该保证，因此约束与非约束的对比实际上在为 incumbent 免费就有的保证定价，衡量不出学习聚合本身的价值。
Method: 以递归网络为测量工具：状态取经典风险统计量（exponentially weighted moving average 与 high-water mark，配可学习变换），按构造对每个输入单调、且每个 MC-dropout 样本单调；用功能回归 (functional regression) 比较学习通道与手工统计族，并在两侧固定可采纳性的前提下比较学习式与工程化聚合。
Result: 学习通道以 Spearman ρ≥0.996 复现手工几何加权可分族（每成员一个通道），对窗口统计量的逼近有可测上界；在连续性上 ρ=0.924、时间定位 0.628（均为结构性失败），暴露下限 0.829（可学习性边界），各补一个显式可采纳基后秩相关达 1.000。在全样本量与指定容量下学习通道从不统计落后；committed grid 在其未覆盖的衰减区最多损失 0.019 AUC，而学习通道在每个扫描点都与最强工程化消费方差距不超过 0.004；最高维比较器在数据稀缺时退化最快；超出训练支撑后 grid 喂的树集成分数变平，而严格递增头仍保持排序。
Conclusion: 在或接近可分族内，学习式与工程化聚合是可互换的替代品，且学习通道在全样本下不落后；其优势是 incumbent 特定的（未覆盖衰减区、数据稀缺、超出训练支撑三种情形），没有任何单一 incumbent 在三个轴上被全面支配。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Long-MDR: Long-Context Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Deep-Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: The next generation of multimodal research agents must reason over long-lived research histories rather than short model completions. During a single task, an agent may repeatedly search the web, inspect visual evidence, revisit earlier hypotheses, and accumulate tens of thousands of tokens of multimodal context. Despite this trend, online RL for multimodal research agents remains largely confined to shorter contexts and interaction horizons. We push online RL training to 128k context and 75+ tool-interaction turns. To our knowledge, this is the first online multimodal deep-research RL study trained at 128k context, and the first trained with a 75 tool-turn horizon. Scaling to this regime exposes several practical limitations of conventional RL training. Early in training, weak policies make poor use of large interaction budgets, causing expensive rollouts with little reward improvement. Later, policy entropy can collapse before performance has saturated, prematurely ending useful learning. We introduce Long-MDR, a three-component training recipe designed specifically for this setting: On-Policy Distillation Warmup, Progressive Horizon Expansion, and Entropy-Triggered Rescue. Together, these techniques improve both the learning efficiency and stability of long-horizon RL, enabling continued gains in a regime where direct training is slow and costly. At a 50-turn evaluation budget, our RL-trained Long-MDR-9B ranks first on five of six benchmarks among the compared 7B-9B agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Long-MDR 把多模态深度研究 agent 的在线 RL 训练推到 128k 上下文与 75+ 工具交互轮次，用三段式训练配方（On-Policy Distillation Warmup、Progressive Horizon Expansion、Entropy-Triggered Rescue）解决弱策略浪费交互预算与熵提前塌缩两个问题。在 50 轮评测预算下，RL 训练的 Long-MDR-9B 在六个基准中的五个上于所比较的 7B–9B agent 中排名第一。
Motivation: 多模态研究 agent 单任务会累积数万 token 的多模态上下文并反复搜索、回看假设，但在线 RL 训练仍停留在短上下文与短交互 horizon，长程设定下 rollout 昂贵且熵塌缩会提前终止学习。
Method: 三组件训练配方：On-Policy Distillation Warmup 用在线蒸馏热启，Progressive Horizon Expansion 逐步扩展交互轮次，Entropy-Triggered Rescue 在熵塌缩时触发干预；训练规模为 128k 上下文、75+ 工具交互轮次，评测模型为 9B。
Result: 训练推到 128k 上下文与 75+ 工具轮次（作者称是首个 128k 上下文的多模态深度研究 RL 研究、首个 75 轮 horizon 的训练）；在 50 轮评测预算下，Long-MDR-9B 在六个基准中的五个上于所比较的 7B–9B agent 中排名第一。
Conclusion: 长上下文长 horizon 的多模态研究 RL 需要专门的训练配方才能在直接训练又慢又贵的区间继续取得增益，蒸馏热启加渐进扩展 horizon 与熵触发救援可同时改善学习效率与稳定性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Order Matters: Competition-Guided Query Ordering for RNN-Based Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: DETR-style detectors use one-to-one bipartite matching during training to assign object queries to ground-truth objects, enabling end-to-end set prediction without non-maximum suppression (NMS). However, without an explicit de-duplication procedure, multiple queries can still produce highly similar hypotheses for the same object, making training unstable and predictions less decisive. Inspired by the sequential ordering of NMS, we propose DETRNN, a plug-and-play module that turns unordered object queries into a competition-aware sequence for recurrent refinement. DETRNN builds an explicit confidence-and-similarity based order from prior predictions, then refines queries with an RNN along this order to model competition inside the decoder. This ordered recurrent refinement reduces redundant predictions, stabilizes optimization, and improves final detection accuracy. Experiments on multiple DETR-style detectors show consistent gains with comparable efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DETRNN 把无序 object query 按先验预测的置信度与相似度排成竞争感知序列，再用 RNN 沿该顺序做循环细化，从而抑制同一目标的重复假设。在多个 DETR-style 检测器上带来一致增益且效率相当。
Motivation: DETR 用一对一二分匹配训练，缺少显式去重，多个 query 仍会对同一目标给出高度相似的假设，导致训练不稳定、预测不果断。
Method: 提出即插即用模块 DETRNN：先基于先验预测构建显式置信度-相似度顺序，把无序 query 变成竞争感知序列，再用 RNN 沿该顺序循环细化，在 decoder 内建模 query 间竞争，思路借自 NMS 的顺序处理。
Result: 在多个 DETR-style 检测器上的实验显示一致增益，效率相当；减少冗余预测并稳定优化，提升最终检测精度（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把 NMS 式的顺序竞争引入 query 细化，可以在不牺牲效率的前提下提升 DETR 类检测器的精度与训练稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FORGE: Verification-Gated Behavioral Repair for Generative Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Generative large language models (LLMs) inherit undesirable behaviors from pre-training, including demographic bias and toxic generation, that often emerge only after deployment and affect a small subset of inputs. A repair should eliminate the identified defect, preserve the model's overall functionality and, ideally, provide correctness guarantees. Existing approaches address this only partially: gradient-based fine-tuning lacks per-instance guarantees and becomes unstable with few defect samples; model editing assumes explicit knowledge replacement rather than behavioral correction; and constraint-based repair is largely restricted to discriminative models with unique target outputs. We present FORGE, a framework for targeted behavioral repair of generative language models that separates defect localization, weight editing, and behavioral verification into independent stages. Its core is a repair abstraction that converts localized defective generation into explicit optimization objectives, enabling verification-oriented repair techniques to operate on autoregressive generation. FORGE is editing-mechanism agnostic: we instantiate it with (1) a constraint-based quadratic optimization method that provides per-sample repair certificates and (2) a null-space projection editor that minimizes interference with the original model distribution, both under the same localization and verification protocol. On five open-source LLMs, FORGE consistently achieves larger reductions in bias and toxicity than gradient-based fine-tuning with minor perplexity degradation. The two backends exhibit complementary performance across architectures, which a lightweight causal probe traces to where toxicity-related signals concentrate. FORGE also remains effective with only a handful of defective examples, where conventional fine-tuning often oscillates or fails to converge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FORGE 把生成式 LLM 的行为修复拆成缺陷定位、权重编辑、行为验证三个独立阶段，核心是把局部缺陷生成转成显式优化目标，使基于验证的修复技术能作用于自回归生成。在五个开源 LLM 上，它比梯度微调带来更大的偏见与毒性下降，困惑度仅轻微退化，且只需少量缺陷样本仍有效。
Motivation: LLM 的偏见与毒性往往部署后才在少数输入上暴露；梯度微调缺逐样本保证且在缺陷样本少时不稳，模型编辑只针对知识替换，约束修复又基本限于判别模型。
Method: FORGE 分三阶段：缺陷定位、权重编辑、行为验证；编辑机制无关，实例化两个后端——带逐样本修复证书的约束二次优化，以及最小化对原模型分布干扰的零空间投影 (null-space projection) 编辑器，两者共用同一套定位与验证协议。
Result: 在五个开源 LLM 上，FORGE 的偏见与毒性下降幅度持续大于梯度微调，困惑度仅轻微退化；两个后端在不同架构上表现互补，轻量因果探针 (causal probe) 追踪到毒性相关信号的集中位置；仅有极少量缺陷样本时仍有效，而常规微调常震荡或不收敛。
Conclusion: 把定位、编辑与验证解耦并以验证为导向，可在生成式 LLM 上实现带证书、少样本稳定的行为修复，两个编辑后端按架构互补选用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On prediction from expert advice with more than five experts
papers.abstract_en: We prove that no single rank ordered adversary strategy is globally optimal for the prediction with expert advice problem with six or more experts, in both the geometric stopping and finite time horizon settings. The proof is based on establishing a leading order correction when one expert moves far ahead of the others. This allows us to connect optimal strategies between $n$ and $j<n$ experts and utilize recent results on the exact optimality set for the five expert problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明在专家数不少于 6 的 prediction with expert advice 中，不存在全局最优的单一 rank ordered 对手策略，几何停止与有限时间视界两种设定均成立。证明依赖于某一专家大幅领先时的领先阶修正，借此把 n 个专家的最优策略与 j<n 个专家（含五专家问题的精确最优性集合）连接起来。
Motivation: 五专家问题已有精确最优性集合的结果，但专家数增至六个及以上时，rank ordered 对手策略是否仍存在全局最优解未知；这关系到 minimax 预测界能否沿用同一策略形式。
Method: 先推导某一专家远超其余专家时的 leading order 修正，再用它在 n 与 j<n 个专家之间建立最优策略的递推联系，最后调用五专家问题的精确最优性集合结果；覆盖 geometric stopping 与 finite time horizon 两种设定，并附 Lean 形式化。
Result: 结论为否定性定理：当专家数为 6 个或更多时，不存在单一 rank ordered 对手策略在全局最优，两种停止设定下均如此。
Conclusion: 五专家的最优策略形式不能直接外推到六个及以上专家，全局最优 rank ordered 策略的缺失是专家数跨过 5 之后的结构性变化。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Recurrent Latent Visual Search for GUI Grounding
papers.abstract_en: GUI grounding is a critical capability for GUI agents powered by vision-language models, helping them execute user instructions by locating the corresponding elements in screenshots. Single-step grounding struggles with small elements and dense layouts, motivating multi-step visual search. However, existing approaches commonly rely on textual reasoning misaligned with visual space or costly multi-round interactions with external visual tools. To make multi-step visual search an explicit spatial process within the model, we propose ReLaViS, which performs Recurrent Latent Visual Search in a single interaction round. At each step, a spatial search head uses the hidden state to query the screenshot's visual tokens, producing a spatial search distribution that explicitly represents the search focus. This distribution then aggregates the visual tokens into latent visual evidence, which is recurrently fed back as the next input embedding to condition subsequent search. We further introduce a GUI-aware coarse-to-fine inductive bias through trajectories constructed from flat element annotations, supervising search from the global interface through intermediate element groups to the target. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, ReLaViS improves ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy by 3.1 percentage points to 56.3% with only a 3.5% increase in inference FLOPs and outperforms the matched single-step baseline on all five benchmarks.

papers.title: TIRMamba: A Thermal-Prior-Modulated State-Space Network for Sub-Million-Parameter Infrared Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Infrared image super-resolution is currently led by Mamba-based networks with 26 to 37 million parameters, which are difficult to deploy on the airborne and handheld platforms where thermal imaging is most needed. This paper presents TIRMamba, a network with 896K to 910K parameters for single-channel thermal imagery. A Thermal Prior Highway computes gradient, local-contrast and spectral cues once at the input and, through one adapter per residual group, modulates a weight-tied bidirectional state-space trunk and gates its dual-scale detail branch; a tri-path reconstruction adds the learned residual to a bicubic radiometric baseline. Because the standard benchmark provides only 265 infrared training images and evaluates fusion products on full images, we train with a replay strategy: grayscale DIV2K pre-training followed by fine-tuning on 64-pixel patches drawn with equal probability from the infrared and natural corpora. At scale factor 4, TIRMamba matches the strongest protocol-trained methods on both official test sets with 29 to 40 times fewer parameters and 2.8 to 9.4 times lower latency; at scale factor 2 it gives the highest SSIM on both. A variant with prior-conditioned selectivity, TIRMamba-Rad, corrects a 3 dB raw-thermal failure of an intermediate size-invariant design and gives the best results at scale factor 4 on raw-thermal, unmanned-aerial-vehicle and independent-sensor test sets. Code and trained models will be released at https://github.com/julian135707/TIRMamba upon acceptance.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing. Code and trained models will be released at https://github.com/julian135707/TIRMamba upon acceptance

TL;DR: TIRMamba 用 896K–910K 参数的 Mamba 网络做单通道热红外图像超分辨率，靠 Thermal Prior Highway 在输入端算一次梯度、局部对比度与光谱线索，经每残差组一个 adapter 调制权重共享的双向状态空间主干并门控双尺度细节分支。×4 时在两个官方测试集上以少 29–40 倍参数、低 2.8–9.4 倍延迟追平最强协议训练方法，×2 时 SSIM 最高；变体 TIRMamba-Rad 修正了中间尺寸不变设计在 raw-thermal 上 3 dB 的失败。
Motivation: 现有 Mamba 红外超分网络有 2600 万到 3700 万参数，难以部署到最需要热成像的机载与手持平台；标准基准只有 265 张红外训练图像，且融合产品只在整图上评测。
Method: Thermal Prior Highway 在输入端一次性计算梯度、局部对比度与光谱线索，通过每个残差组一个 adapter 调制权重共享的双向状态空间 (state-space) 主干，并门控其双尺度细节分支；三路径重建把学习残差加到 bicubic 辐射基线上。训练用 replay 策略：先在灰度 DIV2K 预训练，再以红外与自然语料等概率采样的 64 像素 patch 微调。
Result: ×4 时在两个官方测试集上与最强协议训练方法持平，参数少 29–40 倍、延迟低 2.8–9.4 倍；×2 时在两个测试集上 SSIM 最高。带 prior-conditioned selectivity 的 TIRMamba-Rad 修正了中间尺寸不变设计在 raw-thermal 上 3 dB 的失败，并在 raw-thermal、无人机与独立传感器测试集的 ×4 上给出最佳结果。
Conclusion: 把热先验做成一次性计算的调制器而非堆参数，可以在亚百万参数量级把红外超分做到与大模型持平甚至更好，且 raw-thermal 这类域偏移需要 prior-conditioned selectivity 才能兜住。

papers.title: AECG: Asymmetric Experience Consolidation and Governance In Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems increasingly rely on memory to transform execution trajectories into reusable procedural knowledge. Yet repeated retrieval also makes memory errors persistent: memory pollution arises when outdated, weakly supported, or spuriously successful procedures become recurring components of future reasoning. Multi-agent execution introduces an additional structural risk. Scope collapse occurs when procedural knowledge escapes the coordination scope in which it was shown effective and is repeatedly reused at incompatible decision levels, allowing local errors to influence cascades of downstream decisions. Meanwhile, task-level failures provide ambiguous supervision because they rarely reveal which recalled knowledge was responsible. We introduce AECG, a framework for asymmetric experience consolidation and governance for multi-agent systems. AECG turns memory from static experience storage into a dynamic reliability-governance loop, preserving coordination scope and using multi-scale, confidence-aware reliability to detect degradation. It then combines degradation with downstream impact to prioritize high-risk knowledge under a bounded review budget, applies targeted interventions, and reactivates revised skills only after paired replay. Across three multi-agent frameworks and four benchmarks, AECG achieves the best score in 11 of 12 framework--benchmark settings and improves over the strongest competing memory method by as much as 10.23 percentage points; removing scope preservation reduces accuracy by up to 16.89 points. AECG thereby reframes multi-agent memory from passive accumulation into auditable reliability governance. Code is available at https://github.com/fenhg297/AECG
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AECG 把 LLM 多智能体的记忆从静态存储改造成带作用域约束的可靠性治理环：保留知识的协调作用域，用多尺度、置信度感知的可靠性检测退化，再结合下游影响在受限审查预算内优先处置高风险知识，修订后的技能须经配对回放 (paired replay) 才重新启用。在三个多智能体框架、四个 benchmark 的 12 个设置中 11 个取得最佳，较最强记忆基线最多提升 10.23 个百分点；去掉作用域保持后准确率最多下降 16.89 个百分点。
Motivation: LLM 多智能体记忆会被过时、弱支撑或偶然成功的程序性知识污染，且这些知识会逃出原本有效的协调作用域、在不兼容的决策层级被反复复用 (scope collapse)，而任务级失败又难以定位是哪条被召回知识导致的。
Method: AECG 维护保留协调作用域的记忆，用多尺度、置信度感知的可靠性指标检测退化，把退化程度与下游影响结合，在有界审查预算下优先处理高风险知识并施加定向干预，修订后的技能须通过配对回放才重新激活。
Result: 在三个多智能体框架与四个 benchmark 构成的 12 个框架--benchmark 设置中，AECG 在 11 个上取得最佳分数；相对最强的竞争记忆方法最多提升 10.23 个百分点；移除作用域保持 (scope preservation) 后准确率最多下降 16.89 个百分点。
Conclusion: 多智能体记忆应从被动累积转为可审计的可靠性治理，其中保持知识的协调作用域是准确率的关键支撑。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Locality Sensitive Hashing for p-Exponential Kernels with Applications to Density Estimation
papers.abstract_en: A kernel $k(x,y)$ is LSHable if there exists a locality sensitive hashing scheme $H$ such that $k(x,y)=\Pr_{h\sim H}[h(x)=h(y)]$ for all $x,y$. This notion plays a key role in efficient kernel methods in high dimensions. In this work, we show that the $p$-exponential kernel $k(x,y)=\exp(-\lVert x-y \rVert_p)$ is LSHable in bounded regions for all $1<p\leq2$. Previously, this was known only for $p=1$. Our new "mosaic LSH" scheme is based on a Poisson hyperplane process with hyperplanes sampled as $\ell_1$-biased $p$-stable vectors, for which we develop efficient sampling procedures. As applications, our results yield new and efficient density estimation methods based on LSHability for those $p$-exponential kernels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明 p-指数核 k(x,y)=exp(-‖x-y‖_p) 在有界区域上对所有 1<p≤2 都是 LSHable（此前仅知 p=1），并给出基于 Poisson 超平面过程的 mosaic LSH 方案，超平面按 ℓ1-偏置 p-稳定向量采样并配套高效采样过程；由此导出基于 LSHable 的高效密度估计方法。
Motivation: LSHable 是高维核方法高效化的关键性质，但 p-指数核此前只有 p=1 的已知构造，1<p≤2 的情形缺失，限制了这类核在高维密度估计等任务中的使用。
Method: 提出 mosaic LSH：用 Poisson hyperplane process 生成哈希族，超平面按 ℓ1-偏置的 p-稳定向量采样，并为该分布开发高效采样过程；证明在有界区域上 k(x,y)=Pr[h(x)=h(y)] 对 1<p≤2 成立，再把 LSHable 转化为密度估计方法。
Result: 结论覆盖全部 1<p≤2 的 p-指数核（此前仅 p=1），成立范围是有界区域；作为应用得到基于 LSHable 的新高效密度估计方法。
Conclusion: p-指数核在 1<p≤2 上的 LSHable 可由 Poisson 超平面加 ℓ1-偏置 p-稳定采样实现，从而把高维核密度估计推进到更广的 p 范数。

papers.title: CreativeFlow: A One-to-Many Analogical Relation Transfer Method for 3D Asset Generation
papers.abstract_en: Inspired by cognitive science, we present CREATIVEFLOW, an analogical generation framework that explicitly models analogical divergent thinking to mitigate creative homogenization in text-to-3D pipelines. Our method derives a series of meaningful yet relationally similar source-target asset pairs, each featuring distinct geometric configurations. Expert evaluations demonstrate that our framework substantially enhances creative novelty and visual fascination. This workflow and its resulting assets establish a foundational dataset and benchmark for future relation-aware 3D model training.
papers.comment: 3 pages. To appear in SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Posters (SA Posters '26), Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, December 2026
papers.journal_ref: SA '26 Posters: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Posters, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CreativeFlow 是面向文本到 3D 资产生成的类比生成框架，显式建模类比发散思维 (analogical divergent thinking)，派生一系列意义相关但关系相似、几何构型各异的源-目标资产对，以缓解生成结果的创意同质化。专家评估显示其显著提升创意新颖性与视觉吸引力，并产出可作为关系感知 3D 模型训练基础的数据集与基准。
Motivation: 文本到 3D 管线中生成资产趋于创意同质化，缺少能产生几何构型多样、又保持关系相似的生成机制。
Method: 受认知科学启发的类比生成框架，显式建模类比发散思维，派生成组意义相关、关系相似但几何构型不同的源-目标资产对 (source-target asset pairs)，并把工作流与产出资产整理为数据集和基准。
Result: 专家评估 (expert evaluations) 表明框架显著增强创意新颖性 (creative novelty) 与视觉吸引力 (visual fascination)；工作流与产出资产构成面向关系感知 3D 模型训练的基础数据集与基准。
Conclusion: 把类比发散思维显式引入文本到 3D 生成可以缓解创意同质化，其产出可直接充当关系感知 3D 训练的数据与评测基础。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.conclusion: 把类比发散思维显式引入文本到 3D 生成可以缓解创意同质化，其产出可直接充当关系感知 3D 训练的数据与评测基础。

papers.title: A Safe Action Is Not Enough: Feasible-Future Decoding for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: A safe action is not necessarily a viable one. Under a frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policy, an action can be likely and locally admissible yet leave no policy-supported route to safe task completion. We call this the feasibility-likelihood gap: likelihood ranks the current action, whereas feasibility depends on the futures that remain after it. We derive the exact next-block marginal of the history-conditioned policy-environment trajectory law restricted to safe task completion. The derivation exposes a candidate-dependent feasible-future mass with two roles: its support records whether safe completion remains possible under the frozen continuation process, and its magnitude measures how much weighted safe-completion mass is preserved. Exact evaluation is impractical online, so we develop a selective finite-candidate approximation, derive conditions for recovering the best retained viable candidate, and instantiate it as an alarm-triggered, training-free reranker. On Safety-CHORES, VICS-G lowers mean cumulative safety cost by 1.9%-57.5% across six settings while remaining within 2.5 percentage points of policy sampling in success and 0.82 steps in mean episode length. The resulting decoder is tied to an exact policy-relative safe-completion target, yet requires neither retraining of the base policy nor online trajectory rollouts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 冻结的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 策略可能选出局部安全却无路可走的动作，本文称之为可行性-似然差距 (feasibility-likelihood gap)。推导历史条件策略-环境轨迹律在「安全完成任务」约束下的精确 next-block 边际，得到依赖候选的可行未来质量，再以告警触发、免训练的重排序器 VICS-G 做选择性有限候选近似。在 Safety-CHORES 六个设置上，VICS-G 使平均累积安全成本下降 1.9%–57.5%，成功率相对策略采样保持在 2.5 个百分点以内，平均回合长度相差 0.82 步。
Motivation: 在冻结 VLA 策略下，一个动作可以高似然且局部可接受，却让后续没有任何受策略支持的安全完成路径；似然只排序当前动作，可行性取决于该动作之后还剩哪些未来。
Method: 推导历史条件策略-环境轨迹律在限制于安全任务完成时的精确 next-block 边际，暴露候选依赖的可行未来质量（其支撑记录安全完成是否仍可能，其大小度量保留的加权安全完成质量）；因精确计算在线不可行，构造选择性有限候选近似并推导保住最优可行候选的条件，实现为告警触发、免训练的重排序器 VICS-G，无需重训基础策略也无需在线轨迹 rollout。
Result: 在 Safety-CHORES 六个设置上，VICS-G 将平均累积安全成本降低 1.9%–57.5%；成功率相对策略采样保持在 2.5 个百分点以内，平均回合长度相差 0.82 步。
Conclusion: 安全动作不等于可行动作：把安全完成的可行未来质量作为策略相对的精确重排目标，可在不重训、不在线 rollout 的前提下降低累积安全成本并基本保住成功率与回合长度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Blocking at the Boundary: Auditing Long-Horizon Agents against Staged Prompt Injection
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents consume external content, invoke tools, and modify persistent state. Indirect prompt injection can exploit task-specific context, propagate across causally connected stages, and alter a consequential action while the workflow continues; we term this staged prompt injection. We build an automated, feedback-guided attack generation pipeline and apply it to Claude Code and Codex in their native runtimes. The confirmed attacks span eight workflow scenarios, seven attack goals, and six injection surfaces, showing that production agents are vulnerable to context-aware, multi-step injection over long horizons. Stopping such attacks requires a decision before each consequential action: input screening and completed-run evaluation cannot locate the intervention point, and existing pre-action methods use incompatible units and labels. We therefore formulate boundary action auditing: given initial context, a trajectory prefix, and a fully specified pending message or tool call, an auditor predicts Pass or Block before its effect occurs. Pairing attacked and benign executions yields a 479-pair, 3,112-unit benchmark. We further propose Path-Aligned Attribution (PAA), a training-free auditor that decomposes pending actions into operative elements and traces what supplied each value and guided each decision. PAA blocks only when the model attributes an unwarranted, material effect on an element to an attacker-reachable source that either provides unqualified steering or conflicts with visible evidence. Under full-benchmark fail-open scoring with Claude Sonnet 5, PAA reaches 86% Block recall at a 6-8% false-block rate (FBR), whereas ARGUS reaches 44-47% recall at 16-33% FBR. Under the same backend, on the tool calls that all three auditors natively support, PAA has higher recall and lower FBR than VIGIL and ARGUS; all paired 95% confidence intervals exclude zero.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 10 figures, 20 tables. Code and data: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/audit-artifact-E593
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对长时程 agent 的分阶段提示注入 (staged prompt injection)，提出边界动作审计 (boundary action auditing)：在每个关键动作执行前判定 Pass/Block，并给出免训练审计器 Path-Aligned Attribution (PAA)，按元素归因追踪攻击者可达来源。在 479 对、3,112 单元基准上，以 Claude Sonnet 5 后端全基准 fail-open 评分，PAA Block 召回 86%、误封率 (FBR) 6–8%，而 ARGUS 召回仅 44–47%、FBR 16–33%。
Motivation: 间接提示注入可跨因果相连的阶段传播并改写关键动作，而工作流照常继续；输入筛查与事后评估都定位不到干预点，现有 pre-action 方法的单位与标签互不兼容。
Method: 先构建反馈引导的自动攻击生成流水线，在 Claude Code 与 Codex 原生运行时中确认攻击；再把审计形式化为给定初始上下文、轨迹前缀与完整待执行消息/工具调用的 Pass/Block 判定，配对受攻击与正常执行构成基准；PAA 免训练，分解待执行动作的操作元素并回溯每个值的来源与决策依据，仅当归因到攻击者可达来源造成不当且实质影响时才 Block。
Result: 确认的攻击覆盖 8 个工作流场景、7 个攻击目标、6 个注入面；基准含 479 对、3,112 个单元。全基准 fail-open 评分（Claude Sonnet 5）下 PAA Block 召回 86%、FBR 6–8%，ARGUS 召回 44–47%、FBR 16–33%；在三个审计器原生支持的工具调用子集上 PAA 召回更高、FBR 更低，优于 VIGIL 与 ARGUS，所有配对 95% 置信区间不含零。
Conclusion: 拦截分阶段注入必须在关键动作发生前做边界决策，而 PAA 的元素级归因在高召回下把误封压到 6–8%，优于现有 pre-action 审计器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Memadapter: Counterfactual Adaptation Against Memory-induced Sycophancy
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory enables LLM-based agents to retain and reuse information across tasks and sessions, supporting personalization and long-horizon interactions. However, persistent memories can also induce sycophancy, causing agents to over-align with users' historical beliefs even when they are inaccurate, outdated, or inconsistent with objective evidence. Existing mitigation methods assume that memory-induced sycophancy originates from biased or incorrect memories and attempt to reduce this risk by filtering such memories at different stages of the memory pipeline. However, in the real world, objective and correct memories can still induce sycophancy, and the same memory can warrant different influence across different contexts. To this end, we propose MemAdapter, a novel framework that adaptively integrates retrieved memories to support objective and reliable reasoning. Specifically, MemAdapter consists of three components: (i) Counterfactual Induction, which leverages counterfactual reasoning to uncover the potential risk of retrieved memories; (ii) Context-Aware Reflection, which calibrates the inferential influence of each retrieved memory in light of the current task via self-reflection; and (iii) Evidence-Based Reasoning, which grounds the final response in appropriate evidence while preserving the legitimate influence of memory. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that MemAdapter consistently improves memory reliability across diverse scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/DEEP-JLU/MemAdapter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemAdapter 针对 LLM agent 长期记忆诱发的谄媚 (memory-induced sycophancy)：即使记忆本身客观正确，也可能让用户历史错误信念压过客观证据。它用反事实归纳识别被检索记忆的潜在风险，用上下文反思按当前任务校准每条记忆的推理权重，再以证据为锚生成回答，在三个 benchmark 上一致提升记忆可靠性。
Motivation: 现有方法假设谄媚源于有偏或错误的记忆并在流水线各阶段过滤，但正确的记忆同样会诱发谄媚，且同一记忆在不同上下文应有不同影响力，过滤式缓解因此失效。
Method: MemAdapter 三组件：Counterfactual Induction 用反事实推理揭示被检索记忆的潜在风险；Context-Aware Reflection 通过自我反思按当前任务校准每条记忆的推理影响；Evidence-Based Reasoning 将最终回答锚定在合适证据上，同时保留记忆的合理作用。
Result: 在三个 benchmark 上的实验中，MemAdapter 在多样场景下一致提升记忆可靠性；代码已开源至 github.com/DEEP-JLU/MemAdapter。
Conclusion: 记忆引发的谄媚不能靠过滤有偏记忆解决，需要按上下文自适应调节记忆的推理权重并以证据约束最终回答。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Instruction Following: Learning Grounded Skill-Following with Skill Contracts
papers.abstract_en: Instruction following typically enforces discrete, response-level requirements, whereas an expert-authored skill prescribes procedural requirements spanning multiple phases and environment interactions. Given such a skill, we train the executor to execute all required phases instead of focusing solely on the final answer. We therefore introduce Grounded Skill-Following, which requires an agent to execute a fixed, expert-authored skill across its required phases by grounding decisions in environment observations. To achieve verifiable procedural execution, we formulate each skill as a skill contract combining visible skill instructions with an explicit contract runtime. The runtime specifies required phases, admissible actions, permitted transitions, and accepted termination. This structure provides a dense, verifiable training signal throughout execution. We leverage this by introducing Verified Progress Credit, which assigns rewards upon the initial completion of contract milestones and aggregates them into the trajectory return to guide policy optimization. During rollout, the contract runtime continuously tracks state transitions to provide Contract-State Feedback, which indicates whether the latest action is accepted and guides the agent toward valid next actions. To measure procedural compliance, we introduce the Protocol Completion Rate (PCR), defined as reaching accepted termination through all required phases, and decouple it from the final Task Outcome. Jointly trained with our framework, Qwen3.5-4B achieves Protocol Completion Rates of 99.27% on Math and 99.96% on Search, while slightly outperforming original baselines in Task Outcome (82.95% and 46.61%, respectively). Controlled studies examine how skill instructions, training signals, and contract-state feedback affect both metrics, while withholding interventions evaluate behavioral dependence on observation content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把专家技能写成 skill contract（显式契约运行时规定必需阶段、允许动作、转移与终止条件），用 Verified Progress Credit 与 Contract-State Feedback 训练执行器按阶段完成而非只答最终结果。联合训练后 Qwen3.5-4B 的 Protocol Completion Rate 在 Math 达 99.27%、Search 达 99.96%，Task Outcome 分别为 82.95% 与 46.61%，略优于原始基线。
Motivation: 指令跟随只约束离散的、响应级要求，而专家技能规定跨多阶段与环境交互的过程性要求，缺少可验证的过程执行信号。
Method: 提出 Grounded Skill-Following：把每项技能形式化为 skill contract，由可见指令加显式 contract runtime 组成；runtime 指定必需阶段、允许动作、允许转移与可接受终止。训练用 Verified Progress Credit（在首次完成契约里程碑时给奖励并聚合进轨迹回报做策略优化），rollout 中由 runtime 持续追踪状态转移给出 Contract-State Feedback，指示最近动作是否被接受并引导下一步合法动作。
Result: 联合训练后 Qwen3.5-4B 的 Protocol Completion Rate（经全部必需阶段到达可接受终止）在 Math 为 99.27%、Search 为 99.96%，Task Outcome 分别为 82.95% 和 46.61%，略高于原始基线。受控研究考察技能指令、训练信号与 contract-state feedback 对 PCR 与 Task Outcome 两个指标的影响，并用 withholding interventions 评估行为对观测内容的依赖。
Conclusion: 把过程性要求写成可验证的契约并以里程碑奖励和状态反馈训练，能让执行器在几乎满 PCR 的同时不损失最终任务结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cross-Modal Contrastive Learning for the Retrieval of Immunotherapy-Associated Molecular Signatures from Histopathology
papers.abstract_en: Gastric Adenocarcinoma is a leading cause of cancer mortality. Although "Inflamed/Non-Inflamed" subtypes have been proposed to predict immunotherapy response, their identification relies on a costly 10-gene RNA signature. We propose a Cross-modal Contrastive Multiple Instance Learning (CCMIL) framework for cross-modal retrieval, imputing these molecular signatures directly from standard Hematoxylin & Eosin (H&E) slides. By leveraging a supervised contrastive objective, CCMIL aligns visual morphological patterns with molecular phenotypes into a shared latent space. This establishes an interpretable search-by-case retrieval engine, enabling pathologists to query a whole slide image to surface transcriptomically coherent neighbors and approximate RNA signatures without genomic sequencing at inference. Our results demonstrate that this retrieval-first approach captures the continuous phenotypic spectrum of tumor inflammation and yields clinically interpretable attention heatmaps. Furthermore, the learned representation also supports competitive downstream classification, providing a practical molecular pre-screening strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出跨模态对比多实例学习 (CCMIL)，用监督对比目标把 H&E 病理切片的形态模式与 10 基因 RNA 签名对齐到共享潜空间，从而在无需基因组测序的情况下从切片直接检索并近似推断 Inflamed/Non-Inflamed 免疫治疗相关分子表型。检索优先的表示捕捉肿瘤炎症的连续表型谱，产生可解释的注意力热图，并支持有竞争力的下游分类，作为分子预筛策略。
Motivation: 胃腺癌中预测免疫治疗反应的 Inflamed/Non-Inflamed 亚型依赖昂贵的 10 基因 RNA 签名检测，病理医生缺少从常规染色切片直接获得分子表型的手段。
Method: CCMIL 框架做跨模态检索：以监督对比目标 (supervised contrastive objective) 将视觉形态模式与分子表型嵌入共享潜空间，用全切片图像 (WSI) 作为查询检索转录组一致的邻近病例并近似 RNA 签名，推理阶段无需基因组测序；同时输出注意力热图。
Result: 检索优先方法捕捉到肿瘤炎症的连续表型谱，并生成临床可解释的注意力热图；学到的表示还支持有竞争力的下游分类。摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 从 H&E 切片做跨模态对比检索即可近似免疫治疗相关 RNA 签名，可作为无需测序的分子预筛策略，同时保留可解释的形态学依据。

papers.title: Construction and Evaluation of Machine Learning Models for Near-Real-Time Fire Detection from MTG FCI Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Geostationary satellite observations are important for wildfire detection and monitoring. The current study evaluates machine learning models for MTG FCI near-real-time fire detection in 1- and 2-km spatial configurations and compares them with threshold-based algorithms. The models were trained and evaluated using VIIRS fire reference data across diverse ecological regions in Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. The key results are that 1-km models significantly outperform both their 2-km variants and operational threshold products. The constructed 1-km models achieved F1 scores higher by up to 0.36 compared to baseline products. Importantly, the 1-km models detected small fires with higher probability compared to competing models. Finally, the models robustly detected fires up to 260 min earlier than baseline products. To support opensource applications, our trained models are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 MTG FCI 静止卫星影像训练机器学习火点检测模型，在 1 km 与 2 km 两种分辨率配置下与阈值法业务产品对比，以 VIIRS 火点为参考。1 km 模型显著优于 2 km 版本与业务阈值产品，F1 最多高出基线 0.36，小火检出概率更高，并比基线产品最多提前 260 分钟探测到火。
Motivation: 静止卫星是野火监测的关键手段，但业务阈值法产品对小火和早期火情的检出能力不足，且 MTG FCI 在不同空间分辨率下的火点检测潜力尚未被系统比较。
Method: 在 1 km 和 2 km 空间配置下训练并评估机器学习火点检测模型，输入为 MTG FCI 影像，参考标签来自 VIIRS 火点数据，覆盖欧洲、非洲与中东的多样生态区，并与基于阈值的业务算法对比。
Result: 1 km 模型显著优于其 2 km 变体与业务阈值产品；1 km 模型的 F1 分数比基线产品最多高出 0.36；对小火的检出概率高于竞争模型；比基线产品最多提前 260 分钟探测到火。
Conclusion: 更高空间分辨率的 ML 火点检测在近实时早期探测上优于现有阈值业务产品，训练好的模型已公开发布以支持开源应用。

papers.title: R1A-PC: Physics-Guided Electromagnetic Inversion of Three-Dimensional Human Point Clouds in Complex Static Environments
papers.abstract_en: Recovering three-dimensional human geometry from electromagnetic measure?ments in a complex static environment is difficult because strong multipath responses from walls, floors, and other objects obscure the weak target per?turbation. We propose R1A-PC, a physics-guided method that reconstructs a 2048-point human cloud from paired complex fields measured with and without the target. Complex background subtraction emphasizes target-induced ampli?tude and phase changes, while the background field remains available as an environmental condition. A frequency-balanced discrete Born adjoint produces a three-dimensional spatial knowledge map. At each of two bounded deformation stages, the decoder combines complex measurement features, background fea?tures, and multiscale physical features queried at the current point coordinates; the second stage queries again after the first coordinate update. We analyze the residual of paired subtraction, the weighted normal-operator structure of the raw adjoint, and the feasible set of the predicted cloud. In a held-out background generated by full-wave simulation under a fixed acquisition geometry, R1A-PC obtains a squared Chamfer distance of 0.001434 m2 and an F-score of 0.963080 at 0.05 m. Compared with TopNet, the Chamfer distance decreases by 70.28%. Removing physical guidance or background subtraction increases the Chamfer distance by 242.06% or 241.18%, respectively. Experiments across background layouts and poses support the complementary roles of paired subtraction and position-dependent adjoint features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: R1A-PC 用物理引导的电磁反演从有/无目标的成对复数场测量中重建 2048 点三维人体点云：复数背景相减突出目标引起的幅度与相位变化，频率均衡的离散 Born 伴随给出三维空间知识图，解码器分两个有界形变阶段查询测量、背景与多尺度物理特征。在全波仿真生成的留出背景上，Chamfer 距离 0.001434 m²、0.05 m 阈值下 F-score 0.963080，较 TopNet 下降 70.28%；去掉物理引导或背景相减会使 Chamfer 距离分别上升 242.06% 或 241.18%。
Motivation: 复杂静态环境中墙、地等强多径响应会淹没弱的目标扰动，直接从电磁测量反演三维人体几何困难。
Method: 输入为有/无目标的成对复数场测量：复数背景相减强调目标引起的幅度相位变化，同时保留背景场作为环境条件；频率均衡的离散 Born 伴随 (frequency-balanced discrete Born adjoint) 生成三维空间知识图；解码器在两个有界形变阶段分别融合复数测量特征、背景特征与在当前点坐标查询的多尺度物理特征，第二阶段在第一次坐标更新后再查询；并分析成对相减残差、原始伴随的加权法算子结构与预测点云的可行集。
Result: 在固定采集几何下由全波仿真生成的留出背景上，R1A-PC 的平方 Chamfer 距离为 0.001434 m²，0.05 m 阈值下 F-score 为 0.963080；相对 TopNet Chamfer 距离下降 70.28%。消融中移除物理引导使 Chamfer 距离上升 242.06%，移除背景相减上升 241.18%。跨背景布局与姿态的实验支持成对相减与位置相关伴随特征的互补作用。
Conclusion: 在复杂静态环境中，成对背景相减与位置相关的伴随物理特征对三维人体点云反演同等关键，缺任一项都会让 Chamfer 距离翻数倍。

papers.title: Arithmetic Actor Heads and Training Stabilization for Out-of-Distribution Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies can deteriorate under out-of-distribution (OOD) magnitude shifts. Starting from soft actor-critic (SAC) and its Bayesian Amnesic Piecewise-Robust (BAPR) predecessor, we study the causal-symbolic BAPR (CS-BAPR) family. The practical method combines six training-stabilization settings with alternative actor heads: a Neural Addition Unit (NAU) with a Neural Multiplication Unit (NMU)-inspired quadratic correction, a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN), or a multilayer perceptron (MLP) with rectified linear unit (ReLU) or hyperbolic-tangent activations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对幅度分布外 (OOD) 偏移导致强化学习策略退化的问题，在 SAC 与 BAPR 基础上提出因果符号化 CS-BAPR 家族，把六种训练稳定化设置与多种算术 actor 头（NAU 加 NMU 式二次修正、KAN、ReLU/tanh MLP）组合。摘要给出的是方法构成，未给出定量对比结果。
Motivation: RL 策略在幅度 OOD 偏移下会退化，SAC 及其 BAPR 前身的 actor 表达形式与训练稳定性不足以应对这种偏移。
Method: 从 SAC 与 Bayesian Amnesic Piecewise-Robust (BAPR) 出发构建 CS-BAPR 家族：六种训练稳定化设置分别搭配 Neural Addition Unit (NAU) 加 Neural Multiplication Unit (NMU) 启发的二次修正、Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN)，或 ReLU/tanh 激活的 MLP 作为 actor 头。
Result: 摘要报告的是方法设计：CS-BAPR 家族由六种训练稳定化设置与四类 actor 头（NAU+NMU 式二次修正、KAN、ReLU MLP、tanh MLP）组合而成，面向 OOD 幅度偏移下的策略退化问题。
Conclusion: 把算术结构化的 actor 头与训练稳定化设置联合设计，是缓解 OOD 幅度偏移下 RL 策略退化的一条路径。

papers.title: SemCam: Semantic Camera Motion Control for Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Controlling the camera relative to a moving subject in an existing video is challenging: behaviors such as maintaining a frontal view require the camera to adapt to the subject's changing position and orientation, making the desired trajectory difficult to specify in advance. Existing camera-controlled video-to-video methods typically rely on explicit trajectories or reference motions, which do not directly express these dynamic camera--subject relationships. We introduce semantic camera motion control, a novel video-to-video task in which a reference video and a target motion label specify the desired subject-relative camera behavior without an explicit target trajectory. Our method, SemCam, learns to realize this behavior while preserving source content. It combines shared-basis low-rank adaptation with motion-conditioned modulation, while a background-consistency loss encourages fidelity in regions visible in both reference and target videos. We construct 661 paired videos covering eight semantic camera behaviors and evaluate on a separate 109-scene benchmark using subject-relative motion metrics, appearance measures, and a user study. SemCam achieves a semantic-motion success rate of 68.6%, compared with 45.3% for Vista4D, the strongest evaluated baseline, while maintaining comparable subject identity preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出语义相机运动控制 (semantic camera motion control) 这一 video-to-video 任务：只给参考视频和目标运动标签（如保持正面视角），不给显式轨迹，让相机相对运动主体自适应移动。方法 SemCam 用共享基座低秩适配 (shared-basis LoRA) 加运动条件调制，并以背景一致性损失保留在参考与目标视频中共同可见区域的内容。在 109 场景基准上语义运动成功率 68.6%，对比最强基线 Vista4D 的 45.3%，主体身份保持相当。
Motivation: 在已有视频中让相机相对运动主体保持正面视角这类动态关系，难以预先写成显式轨迹；现有相机可控 video-to-video 方法依赖轨迹或参考运动，无法直接表达相机与主体之间的语义关系。
Method: SemCam 结合共享基座低秩适配 (shared-basis low-rank adaptation) 与运动条件调制 (motion-conditioned modulation) 来实现目标语义行为并保留源内容；背景一致性损失 (background-consistency loss) 约束参考与目标视频共同可见区域的保真度。数据为 661 对覆盖八种语义相机行为的配对视频，评测用独立的 109 场景基准，指标含主体相对运动度量、外观度量与用户研究。
Result: 语义运动成功率 68.6%，对比最强被评估基线 Vista4D 的 45.3%；主体身份保持与基线相当。评测在 109 场景基准上进行，训练配对视频 661 对、覆盖八种语义相机行为。
Conclusion: 不给显式轨迹、只用语义运动标签加参考视频即可指定并实现主体相对的相机行为，且成功率明显高于依赖显式轨迹的 Vista4D，同时不牺牲主体身份保持。
