papers.title: AutoSciBench: Autonomous Benchmark Generation for Evaluating Scientific Agents
papers.abstract_en: As agents rapidly evolve, existing benchmarks can become saturated, limiting their ability to distinguish capabilities and reveal remaining failure modes. Particularly in scientific domains, constructing and updating benchmarks requires substantial time, labor, and domain expertise, making it difficult to keep evaluation aligned with advances in agent capabilities. We address this challenge by investigating whether scientific-agent benchmarks can be automatically generated and iteratively adapted as agent capabilities evolve. We introduce AutoSciBench, a framework that represents each task as a high-level concept specifying the scientific domain, data modality, and required reasoning approach, together with a low-level recipe specifying how the question, environment, and ground-truth answer are constructed and verified. Agents attempt to solve each task, producing solver trajectories and corresponding judge feedback which AutoSciBench uses to revise the recipe or concept, closing observed shortcuts and shifting tasks toward raw-data re-examination, interpretation of intermediate results, and evidence integration. Experience distilled from completed refinement trajectories further guides new concept generation, allowing lessons from earlier task refinement to inform subsequent benchmark construction. Starting from existing benchmarks, we evaluate AutoSciBench across computational biology, materials science, and clinical imaging. Generated benchmarks reduce average solver accuracy by 22.4 and 25.5 percentage points relative to the human-curated benchmarks in computational biology and materials science, respectively, while generated tasks receive higher average quality ratings across all three domains, suggesting that scientific-agent evaluation can adapt as agent capabilities advance.

Motivation: 既有科学智能体基准趋于饱和，难以区分能力与暴露失败模式；人工构建和更新基准耗时耗力且需领域专家，评估无法跟上智能体能力演进。

papers.title: Hidden in the Comments: A Context-Injection Attack Surface in Code LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Code large language model (Code LLM) assistants generate code from heterogeneous development contexts, including open files, imported modules, pasted snippets, and comments, much of which may originate from untrusted sources. We investigate whether insecure instructions embedded in such contexts can steer Code LLMs toward vulnerable code without access to model weights or training data. We evaluate ten open-weight Code LLMs spanning 3B--13B parameters, including four base and six instruction-tuned models, across ten web-application weakness classes. We compare completion tasks containing insecure instructions embedded as code comments with benign tasks without malicious instructions. Attack-condition completions contained a medium-or-higher weakness in {\bf 77.4--92.3}\% of cases, compared with {\bf 1.7--5.1}\% in the benign condition. Base and instruction-tuned models averaged 86.5\% and 84.5\% vulnerable outputs, respectively; equivalence testing and three matched model pairs indicated reductions of at most 8.1\% after instruction tuning. Susceptibility showed no clear association with model scale or specialization. Among vulnerable attack outputs, 86.2--91.0\% were rated high or critical, and the effect persisted without the pattern-based detector. Post-generation screening reduced but did not eliminate the risk, the strongest screen leaving roughly one-third undetected. These findings identify inference-time context injection as a substantial attack surface and motivate provenance-aware training objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在代码补全上下文（注释、粘贴片段等不可信来源）里注入不安全指令，可在不接触权重与训练数据的情况下把 Code LLM 引向漏洞代码：10 个 3B–13B 开源模型在 10 类 Web 弱点上，攻击条件 77.4–92.3% 的补全含中等及以上弱点，良性条件仅 1.7–5.1%。
Motivation: Code LLM 助手消费来自不可信来源的异构开发上下文，攻击者无需模型权重或训练数据即可诱导生成漏洞代码，而现有后处理筛查无法完全拦截。
Method: 评测 10 个开源权重 Code LLM（3B–13B，4 个 base、6 个 instruction-tuned），在 10 类 Web 应用弱点上对比含嵌入式不安全指令的注释补全任务与良性任务；辅以等价性检验 (equivalence testing) 和 3 组配对模型比较指令微调的影响，并测试模式检测器与生成后筛查。
Result: 攻击条件补全 77.4–92.3% 含中等及以上弱点，良性条件 1.7–5.1%；base 与 instruction-tuned 平均漏洞输出 86.5% 与 84.5%，指令微调至多降低 8.1%；易感性与模型规模或专业化无明显关联；漏洞输出中 86.2–91.0% 被评为 high 或 critical；去掉模式检测器后效应仍在；最强生成后筛查仍漏检约三分之一。
Conclusion: 推理时上下文注入 (inference-time context injection) 是 Code LLM 的实质性攻击面，指令微调与后处理筛查都不足以消除风险，需要来源感知 (provenance-aware) 的训练目标。

papers.title: How Does Geometry Enter Generated Motion?
papers.abstract_en: Under a fixed physical law, the visible geometry of a scene determines how motion must change. We ask how video generators realize this relationship. We fix the law and the initial state and change only the geometry drawn in the first frame, within matched families of tracks and deflectors, and compare each generated trajectory with the simulator prediction for that geometry. Paired interventions change one thing at a time: a local bump, the height of a barrier, the words of the prompt, the length of the clip. Across nine image-to-video models, geometry is preserved and shapes the motion: the speed of the ball follows the drawn undulation of a track. A physical state would carry this response forward, and here the generated motion parts from the law. The mean slope barely accelerates the ball, successive contacts fail to compose through a consistent state, an edit ahead of the ball alters its motion before it arrives, and the ball climbs over barriers higher than its release point. Two global conditions organize the global trajectory: text strongly controls the destination, while clip length strongly controls timing in the open-weight models tested. The pattern persists with photographed first frames. Current video generation thus behaves as geometry-conditioned motion synthesis whose evolution of state differs systematically from that of a fixed physical law.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 13 figures, including supplementary material. Project page: https://liweihan1107.github.io/samelaw/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定物理定律与初始状态下只改首帧几何（局部凸起、障碍高度、提示词、片段长度）的配对干预显示：九个图生视频模型都保留几何并让运动跟随几何——球速随画出的轨道起伏变化。但生成运动的状态演化系统性偏离物理定律：平均坡度几乎不加速球、连续碰撞无法经一致状态复合、球在到达前就被前方编辑改变运动、球能翻过高于释放点的障碍；开放权重模型中文本强控终点、片段长度强控时序。
Motivation: 视频生成器是否真正实现「固定物理定律下几何决定运动」这一关系尚不清楚：需要区分模型是复现了物理状态演化，还是仅做几何条件下的运动合成。
Method: 固定物理定律与初始状态，只改首帧所画几何，在匹配的轨道与偏转器族内做一次只改一个因素的配对干预（局部凸起、障碍高度、提示词措辞、片段长度），把每条生成轨迹与针对该几何的模拟器预测对比，跨九个图生视频模型检验，并用拍摄的首帧复现。
Result: 九个图生视频模型中几何被保留并塑造运动：球速跟随所画轨道起伏。但状态演化偏离定律：平均坡度几乎不加速球，连续碰撞不通过一致状态复合，球到达前前方的编辑已改变其运动，球翻过高于其释放点的障碍。开放权重模型中文本强控目的地、片段长度强控时序；该模式在拍摄首帧下持续存在。
Conclusion: 当前视频生成是几何条件化的运动合成，其状态演化与固定物理定律系统性不同：几何响应存在，但缺少承载该响应向前推进的物理状态。

papers.title: RoMod: Temporal Routing Modulation via Mixture-of-Experts for Video Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Intermediate-layer features from multimodal large language models have shown strong potential for video anomaly detection (VAD), yet the origin of their discriminative power remains unclear. We study this question using sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, whose explicit expert structure and sparse activation make their internal computation easier to inspect. With a fully frozen backbone and no additional training, we find that anomaly-related evidence is concentrated in a small set of experts. These experts recur across layers, spontaneously specialize in different anomaly types, and together form a dynamic routing subnetwork. We further show that the output channels most strongly influenced by these experts are also the hidden dimensions that contain the most anomaly-relevant information. Routing statistics can therefore serve as an internal anomaly cue that complements semantic features.Based on these findings, we propose RoMod, an efficient VAD framework trained with only \(5\%\) of weakly labeled videos. RoMod includes a Routing-Modulated Fusion module, RoMF, and a Routing-aware Temporal Network, RoTN. RoMF uses routing signals to adaptively recalibrate hidden semantic channels. Its design also prevents the routing branch from bypassing semantic features and making predictions on its own. RoTN captures the temporal evolution of anomalies from onset to persistence and termination. Experiments on three benchmarks show that RoMod achieves state-of-the-art performance while running substantially faster than dense backbones of comparable size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoMod 把多模态大语言模型 MoE 的专家路由统计当作异常线索，用 Routing-Modulated Fusion (RoMF) 按路由信号重标定语义通道，并用 Routing-aware Temporal Network (RoTN) 建模异常从起始到持续再到终止的时序演化。在仅用 5% 弱标注视频训练的设置下，三个基准上达到 SOTA，且比同规模稠密 backbone 快得多。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型中间层特征在视频异常检测 (VAD) 上判别力强，但这种判别力来自哪里并不清楚，弱标注视频稀缺也限制了 VAD 训练。
Method: 先用完全冻结、零训练的 sparse MoE 模型做可解释性分析，定位集中承载异常证据的少数专家及其跨层复现与类型特化形成的动态路由子网络；再据此提出 RoMod，含 RoMF（用路由信号自适应重标定隐藏语义通道，并阻止路由分支绕过语义特征单独预测）与 RoTN（捕捉异常从起始、持续到终止的时序演化），仅用 5% 弱标注视频训练。
Result: 冻结 backbone 下异常证据集中在少数专家，这些专家跨层复现、自发按异常类型特化并构成动态路由子网络；受这些专家影响最强的输出通道正是含异常信息最多的隐藏维度。RoMod 在三个基准上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，运行速度显著快于同规模稠密 backbone，训练只用 5% 弱标注视频。
Conclusion: MoE 路由统计本身可作为与语义特征互补的内部异常线索，据此重标定通道并建模时序演化，能在极少弱标注下同时拿到 SOTA 精度与更高推理速度。

papers.title: A Contrast-Source Inversion Scheme Based on Stochastic Optimization and Plug-and-Play Regularization
papers.abstract_en: An electromagnetic inversion scheme that integrates stochastic optimization (STO) and plug-and-play (PNP) regularization into contrast-source inversion (CSI), termed STO-PNP-CSI, is developed. Standard CSI solves for the contrast source vector of every transmitter at each iteration, which is expensive in a multi-transmitter configuration. STO instead solves for only one randomly selected contrast source vector per iteration, which reduces the per-iteration cost and can help the inversion escape poor local minima and saddle points. The resulting loss of information, however, increases the ill-posedness of the inversion. To counter this, the Swin-Conv-UNet (SCUNet) denoiser is plugged into the CSI scheme as an implicit regularizer, supplying a learned prior that is stronger than conventional hand-crafted ones and stabilizes the reconstruction. The proposed STO-PNP-CSI is applied to both synthetic and experimental data. The results show that it yields accurate reconstructions at substantially lower computational cost than CSI, including under strong nonlinearity and measurement noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 STO-PNP-CSI：在电磁对比源反演 (contrast-source inversion, CSI) 中用随机优化每轮只解一个随机选取的对比源向量以降低多发射机开销，并把 SCUNet 去噪器作为隐式正则化补回由此损失的信息。在合成与实测数据上，该方案以显著更低的计算代价给出准确重建，且在强非线性与测量噪声下仍成立。
Motivation: 标准 CSI 每轮迭代都要解全部发射机的对比源向量，多发射机配置下计算昂贵；而随机优化只解一个向量虽省算力，却加重反演的不适定性。
Method: STO-PNP-CSI 将随机优化 (stochastic optimization, STO) 与即插即用正则化 (plug-and-play, PNP) 结合进 CSI：每轮随机选一个对比源向量求解以降低单轮成本并帮助跳出劣质局部极小与鞍点；再把 Swin-Conv-UNet (SCUNet) 去噪器作为隐式正则化插入 CSI，提供比手工先验更强的学习先验以稳定重建。
Result: 在合成数据与实测数据两类设置上，STO-PNP-CSI 给出准确重建，计算代价显著低于标准 CSI，并在强非线性与测量噪声条件下保持该表现。
Conclusion: 随机优化带来的信息损失可以用学习型 PNP 先验补回，从而在多发射机电磁反演中同时拿到低算力与准确重建。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 提出 STO-PNP-CSI：在电磁对比源反演 (contrast-source inversion, CSI) 中用随机优化每轮只解一个随机选取的对比源向量以降低多发射机开销，并把 SCUNet 去噪器作为隐式正则化补回由此损失的信息。在合成与实测数据上，该方案以显著更低的计算代价给出准确重建，且在强非线性与测量噪声下仍成立。
summary_sections.motivation: 标准 CSI 每轮迭代都要解全部发射机的对比源向量，多发射机配置下计算昂贵；而随机优化只解一个向量虽省算力，却加重反演的不适定性。

papers.title: Representation--Behavior Alignment for Explainable Weakly-Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) provide a natural way to make video anomaly detection more explainable. However, their final decisions do not always fully use the discriminative information contained in their hidden states, an issue we refer to as representation--behavior misalignment. We decompose this gap into a capacity component that measures discriminative information never aggregated into the readout position, and a directional component that measures the angular mismatch between the optimal and the native normal--abnormal axis at that position. Across multiple video anomaly detection benchmarks and MLLM backbones the directional component dominates, and residual-stream tracing shows that native-axis separability rises sharply in several mid-to-late attention layers. Because both components are governed by attention rather than MLP updates, we propose Representation--Behavior Alignment (RBA), a parameter-efficient method that adapts those layers using video-level labels alone while updating about 0.012\% of the backbone parameters. Experiments on three benchmarks show that RBA improves native-readout performance and better aligns the model's decision direction with discriminative representations, and it produces anomaly decisions and explanations through a single generative process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 弱监督视频异常检测中，MLLM 隐藏态里的判别信息没有被最终决策用尽，作者称之为表征-行为失配 (representation–behavior misalignment)。该缺口可分解为容量分量与方向分量，跨多个 VAD 基准与 MLLM backbone 均由方向分量主导；据此提出只用视频级标签、仅更新约 0.012% backbone 参数的 RBA，微调注意力层使决策方向与判别表征对齐，并由单一生成过程同时输出异常判定与解释。
Motivation: MLLM 让视频异常检测更可解释，但其最终决策并未充分利用隐藏态中的判别信息，导致表征与行为不一致。
Method: 把失配分解为容量分量（读出位置从未聚合的判别信息）与方向分量（最优与原生正常-异常轴的夹角），用残差流追踪定位起作用的层；提出 Representation–Behavior Alignment (RBA)，仅用视频级标签微调由注意力（而非 MLP）主导的若干中后层注意力层，参数高效，更新约 0.012% backbone 参数。
Result: 跨多个视频异常检测基准与 MLLM backbone，方向分量占主导；残差流追踪显示原生轴可分性在若干中后注意力层急剧上升。三个基准上的实验表明 RBA 提升原生读出性能、使决策方向与判别表征更好对齐，并通过单一生成过程产出异常决策与解释。
Conclusion: 表征-行为失配主要由方向而非容量造成，且由注意力层支配，因此只微调这些中后注意力层即可在极少参数下同时改善性能与可解释性。

papers.title: Component-Level Evaluation of Adaptive PINN Training for CFD-Oriented Crystal Growth Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) training minimizes a weighted combination of partial differential equation (PDE), boundary-condition, and initial-condition losses. Because adaptive methods modify these weights during training, their weighted total losses are not always directly comparable. We compare fixed-weight PINN, gradient-normalized PINN (GNPINN), and a rule-based adaptive controller (AgenticPINN) under matched settings on a heat-equation benchmark and a simplified Czochralski-oriented thermal-fluid problem. In the crystal-growth MLP experiment, adaptive control reduced the PDE residual from the order of $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-6}$, while the boundary-condition loss increased from the order of $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-2}$. On the heat-equation benchmark, GNPINN achieved the lowest relative $L_2$ field error (0.054), whereas AgenticPINN obtained the smallest PDE residual but a relative $L_2$ error of 1.368. Gaussian-process surrogates were additionally evaluated using case-wise holdout tests on corrected Czochralski CFD parameter sweeps. The temperature-field error for the temperature sweep was approximately 6%, whereas the axial-velocity error for the crystal-rotation sweep was approximately 42%. These findings show that adaptive control can improve equation satisfaction while weakening other physical constraints. PINN training should therefore be evaluated using separate PDE, boundary-condition, and solution-error metrics rather than weighted total loss alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在匹配设置下对比固定权重 PINN、梯度归一化 GNPINN 与规则式自适应控制器 AgenticPINN，发现自适应调权把 PDE 残差从 10⁻⁵ 量级压到 10⁻⁶，却把边界条件损失从 10⁻⁵ 量级推高到 10⁻²。热方程基准上 GNPINN 的相对 L2 场误差最低（0.054），AgenticPINN 残差最小但 L2 误差达 1.368。作者主张 PINN 训练必须分开报告 PDE、边界条件与解误差，不能只看加权总损失。
Motivation: 自适应方法在训练中改动各损失权重，其加权总损失在方法之间不可直接比较，只看总损失会掩盖方程满足度与物理约束之间的此消彼长。
Method: 在热方程基准与简化 Czochralski 定向热-流问题上，以匹配设置对比 fixed-weight PINN、gradient-normalized PINN (GNPINN) 与规则式控制器 AgenticPINN；另用 Gaussian-process 代理模型对修正后的 Czochralski CFD 参数扫描做 case-wise holdout 测试。
Result: 晶体生长 MLP 实验中自适应控制使 PDE 残差由 10⁻⁵ 量级降至 10⁻⁶，同时边界条件损失由 10⁻⁵ 量级升至 10⁻²。热方程基准上 GNPINN 相对 L2 场误差最低为 0.054，AgenticPINN 取得最小 PDE 残差但相对 L2 误差为 1.368。GP 代理的温度扫描温度场误差约 6%，晶体旋转扫描轴向速度误差约 42%。
Conclusion: 自适应控制能提升方程满足度却削弱其他物理约束，PINN 训练应以分离的 PDE、边界条件与解误差指标评估，而非只看加权总损失。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Selecting Repetition Counts Across Model Scales in Data-Constrained Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: The repetition count that works best for a small language model may not remain best at a larger scale. We study this effect in pretraining with a finite target corpus mixed with generic data at a fixed target fraction. On Wikipedia-derived data and Proof-Pile-2, the ranking of measured repetition counts changes with model size, and a 520M Proof-Pile-2 experiment confirms that reducing repetition from sixteen to eight improves loss while using fewer training tokens. We use loss curves from several smaller models to retain a short list of promising repetition counts for evaluation at a larger scale. On PubMed and Caselaw, candidate sets fixed before target-model training retain the lowest-loss measured count on the original evaluation grids at both 200M and 520M. This supports candidate retention as a practical alternative to exact point prediction. We also relate the pruning regression to an empirical scaling model with two opposing repetition-dependent loss terms. A first-order expansion in log model size yields the linear form used by the selection rule, providing a scaling-based interpretation of the candidate-selection procedure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有限目标语料与通用数据按固定比例混合的数据受限预训练中，最优重复次数 (repetition count) 随模型规模改变排序。用小模型 loss 曲线保留候选重复次数集合，再在大模型上评估，可在 PubMed 与 Caselaw 上于 200M 和 520M 规模都保住原始评估网格上 loss 最低的那个重复次数；520M Proof-Pile-2 上把重复从 16 降到 8 同时降低 loss 并减少训练 token。
Motivation: 小模型上调好的重复次数不能直接搬到更大规模，而对每个规模精确预测最优重复次数代价高；需要一种不必精确点预测、又能避免在大模型上盲目扫网格的做法。
Method: 在目标语料与通用数据固定目标占比的混合下，用若干小模型的 loss 曲线筛出候选重复次数集合，保留到目标模型训练前固定；并把该剪枝回归与含两个重复次数相关、方向相反的 loss 项的经验 scaling model 关联，在 log 模型规模上做一阶展开，得到选择规则所用的线性形式。
Result: 在 Wikipedia 衍生数据与 Proof-Pile-2 上，测得的重复次数排序随模型规模改变；520M Proof-Pile-2 实验中把重复从 16 降到 8 改善 loss 且用更少训练 token。PubMed 与 Caselaw 上，目标模型训练前固定的候选集在 200M 与 520M 两个规模都保留了原始评估网格上 loss 最低的测得重复次数。
Conclusion: 候选保留 (candidate retention) 可作为精确点预测的实用替代：与其预测最优重复次数的具体取值，不如用小模型 loss 曲线锁定一个短候选表带到大模型上评估。

papers.title: Bayesian Entropy-based Reordering for Calibrated Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) generate sequences by iteratively replacing masked tokens with model predictions. At each denoising step, the decoder chooses which positions are sufficiently confident to commit. Existing decoding methods typically rely on softmax confidence, which can be miscalibrated. We introduce BayesER (BAYESian Entropy-based Reordering), a post-hoc Bayesian decoding framework that uses predictive uncertainty to guide token commitment. In BayesER, we construct a lightweight approximate posterior centered at the pretrained checkpoint, similar to Laplace-LoRA but without training LoRA adapters. We average predictions over posterior samples and use predictive entropy to prioritize reliable positions. We examine how posterior predictions affect position ordering and token selection across benchmarks spanning code generation, mathematical reasoning, planning, and molecular generation. We show that BayesER reduces sequence-level calibration error while preserving or improving accuracy relative to common decoding schemes, including confidence-threshold decoding. Additionally, a posterior fitted on one code-generation dataset reduces calibration error on another without refitting, suggesting that Bayesian uncertainty may provide a transferable signal for more reliable MDLM decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BayesER 是针对掩码扩散语言模型 (MDLM) 的事后贝叶斯解码框架：在预训练检查点附近构造轻量近似后验（类似 Laplace-LoRA 但不训练 LoRA），对后验样本的预测取平均，用预测熵 (predictive entropy) 决定各位置的提交顺序。结果显示序列级校准误差下降，同时准确率相对含 confidence-threshold 解码在内的常见方案持平或提升。
Motivation: MDLM 逐步把掩码 token 替换为预测，每步需判断哪些位置足够可信；现有解码依赖 softmax 置信度，而该置信度可能失准 (miscalibrated)，导致提交顺序不可靠。
Method: 在预训练检查点中心构造轻量近似后验（做法类似 Laplace-LoRA 但不训练 LoRA adapter），对后验样本的预测做平均得到预测分布，再以预测熵对位置排序、优先提交可靠位置；属 post-hoc 解码，无需重训模型。
Result: 在覆盖代码生成、数学推理、规划与分子生成的基准上，BayesER 降低序列级校准误差，同时准确率相对包括 confidence-threshold decoding 在内的常见解码方案持平或提升；在一个代码生成数据集上拟合的后验可不经重拟合直接降低另一代码数据集上的校准误差。
Conclusion: 以预测熵而非 softmax 置信度驱动提交顺序，可在不重训的前提下改善 MDLM 的校准并保持准确率；跨数据集不重拟合仍降校准误差，说明贝叶斯不确定性是可迁移的解码信号。

papers.title: Memory Canonicalization: A Framework and Benchmark for Cross-Model Drift in Persistent LLM Memory
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory for Large Language Models (LLMs) has matured rapidly: systems such as MemGPT/Letta, Mem0, and Zep now provide agents with tiered, temporally-aware, model-agnostic external storage, while the Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes access to memory servers. A less addressed problem is that an identical stored memory object, retrieved by two different LLMs under otherwise identical conditions, may not be interpreted the same way, factually or emotionally. This paper proposes memory canonicalization: a write-time pipeline that detects ambiguity, conditional structure, and emotional loading in a raw memory object and rewrites it into an explicit, structurally disambiguated canonical form, with emotional valence represented as a separate field rather than inferred from tone. We formalize the pipeline, define a companion Cross-Model Semantic Drift / Emotional Consistency Score benchmark (CMSC-E), and report results from a three-arm pilot using 176 synthetic memory objects and three downstream model families. We find an uncorrected improvement in cross-model emotional consistency for fully canonicalized memory relative to raw memory (+0.050, 95% bootstrap CI [0.013, 0.086], paired t-test p = 0.010), but this result does not survive Bonferroni, Holm, or Benjamini-Hochberg correction across the six comparisons tested. None of the factual-drift (CMSD) comparisons reach significance at any correction level. We report these results as exploratory rather than confirmatory and outline needed follow-up work, including larger samples, independent judge models, human-validated rendering, and preregistration.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: LexiHorizon: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Deep Search
papers.abstract_en: Deep search agents tackle complex knowledge tasks through iterative retrieval, multi-hop reasoning, and evidence synthesis across multiple sources. Existing approaches typically assume relatively stable retrieval systems and operate over short-horizon tool interaction. However, when retrieval is sensitive to query formulation, even a semantically appropriate query may fail to surface critical evidence because of mismatched entity names, aliases, or keyword combinations. Recovering from such failures requires repeated query reformulation and longer interaction trajectories. This setting poses a distinct training challenge, as the policy must sustain long-horizon query exploration while managing an expanding volume of retrieved content. We propose LexiHorizon, a framework for training search agents over long horizons that expands the trajectory context budget, manages accumulated retrieval content using a window over recent tool observations while preserving the reasoning history, and introduces an outcome-gated search-effort reward that provides a bounded bonus for tool invocations to trajectories with nonzero answer reward. Experiments on XBench, WebWalkerQA, and BrowseComp-ZH show that the resulting 9B model consistently outperforms both its base model and MiroThinker-1.7-mini, with maximum absolute gains of 8.7 and 23.8 percentage points, respectively. These results suggest that combining an extended context budget with reasoning-preserving context management benefits long-horizon deep search agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LexiHorizon 把长程深搜 (deep search) 训练的轨迹上下文预算扩大，用近期工具观察窗口管理累积检索内容同时保留推理历史，并加入结果门控的搜索努力奖励：仅对答案奖励非零的轨迹按工具调用给有界加成。在 XBench、WebWalkerQA、BrowseComp-ZH 上训练出的 9B 模型稳定超过其基座模型与 MiroThinker-1.7-mini，最大绝对增益分别为 8.7 和 23.8 个百分点。
Motivation: 检索对查询措辞敏感时，语义正确的查询也可能因实体名、别名或关键词组合不匹配而漏掉关键证据，需要反复改写查询、拉长交互轨迹；现有方法假设检索系统稳定且只在短程工具交互上训练，长轨迹下策略难以维持探索又要消化不断膨胀的检索内容。
Method: 三件套：扩大轨迹上下文预算；对累积检索内容只保留一个近期工具观察窗口，同时完整保留推理历史；引入 outcome-gated search-effort reward，只在轨迹答案奖励非零时对工具调用给有界加成。训练对象为 9B 模型。
Result: 在 XBench、WebWalkerQA、BrowseComp-ZH 三个基准上，9B 模型 consistently 超过其基座模型与 MiroThinker-1.7-mini，最大绝对增益分别为 8.7 和 23.8 个百分点。
Conclusion: 扩展上下文预算与保留推理历史的上下文管理结合，能稳定改善长程深搜 agent 的训练效果；奖励设计上把工具调用加成绑定到非零答案奖励，避免无界刷工具。

papers.title: PCLM: Small-target localization with frozen CLIP via prototype contrast and local magnification
papers.abstract_en: Small targets occupy few patches in a vision-language encoder, so spatial features often mix object appearance with surrounding content. We propose Prototype Contrast and Local Magnification (PCLM), a support-conditioned localization method that uses a frozen CLIP encoder. Five masked support images per class define foreground and background prototypes through equally weighted regional features. Their difference provides a shared scoring direction for query patches, explicitly comparing target evidence with the demonstrated background. Nine overlapping query windows are enlarged and encoded independently to sample small targets more densely. Reprojection and coverage averaging combine their scores into a continuous localization map. The class direction occupies 2 KiB regardless of support count and transfers unchanged across datasets with mapped categories. On 5,047 small-target queries from VOC, COCO, ADE20K and Oxford-IIIT Pets, PCLM achieves higher mean pixel AP than every evaluated text-conditioned localization baseline on each dataset under our evaluation protocol. Gains over the strongest scene-dataset baselines range from 5.63 to 13.23 percentage points. At comparable measured latency, local magnification improves scene small-target AP by 4.51 to 5.68 points over whole-canvas enlargement. Factorial experiments show that prototype contrast increases the benefit of local observation, including under matched image-coordinate filtering. Support-budget experiments show that additional examples refine category estimation without increasing representation size or query-time scoring cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PCLM 用冻结 CLIP 做小目标定位：每类 5 张 masked support 图等权区域特征生成前景/背景原型，其差作为共享打分方向；9 个重叠 query 窗口独立放大编码后重投影平均成连续定位图。在 VOC、COCO、ADE20K、Oxford-IIIT Pets 共 5,047 个小目标 query 上，其 mean pixel AP 在每个数据集上都高于全部被评估的 text-conditioned 定位基线，对最强场景数据集基线领先 5.63–13.23 个百分点。
Motivation: 小目标在视觉-语言编码器里只占极少 patch，空间特征容易把目标外观与周围背景混在一起，导致定位不准。
Method: PCLM 是 support-conditioned 定位方法：冻结 CLIP 编码器，每类 5 张 masked support 图以等权区域特征构造前景与背景原型，取其差作为 query patch 的共享打分方向并与展示的背景显式比较；9 个重叠 query 窗口分别放大独立编码以更密集采样小目标，再经 reprojection 与 coverage averaging 合成连续定位图。类方向仅占 2 KiB，与 support 数量无关，跨数据集（映射类别后）可直接迁移。
Result: 在 VOC、COCO、ADE20K、Oxford-IIIT Pets 的 5,047 个小目标 query 上，PCLM 在每个数据集的评测协议下 mean pixel AP 均高于所有被评估的 text-conditioned 定位基线；相对最强场景数据集基线领先 5.63 至 13.23 个百分点。在相近实测延迟下，local magnification 相对 whole-canvas enlargement 把场景小目标 AP 提高 4.51 至 5.68 点。因子实验显示 prototype contrast 放大了 local observation 的收益（含匹配图像坐标过滤条件下）；support 预算实验显示增加样本可细化类别估计而不增大表示尺寸与 query 时打分开销。
Conclusion: 在冻结 CLIP 上用原型对比给出共享打分方向、配合局部放大密集采样，可以在不增加表示与打分成本的前提下稳定提升小目标定位精度，且类方向 2 KiB 可跨数据集直接迁移。

papers.title: LoopMoEVR: Loop-Based Degradation-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Unified UHD Video Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Recently, unified high-definition image restoration has attracted considerable attention; however, existing models tend to excessively increase their depth in pursuit of improved generalization, which often yields only limited gains. Meanwhile, loop-based learning paradigms have drawn widespread attention due to their low parameter counts and strong regression capability, as exemplified by GPT-6 and looped Transformers. In this paper, we introduce the loop learning paradigm to address restoration tasks that require cross-domain learning. Specifically, we propose LoopMoEVR, a loop-based mixture-of-experts model capable of handling degraded ultra-high-definition (UHD) inputs. First, a degradation-conditioned low-rank loop embedding is designed to construct input-dependent stage conditions. Second, a spatio-temporal iterative adaptive normalization module, termed IterAda3DN, is developed to fuse local features with global loop context, thereby performing position-wise affine modulation. Finally, the expert branches further integrate the attention-updated local and global video states with the loop conditions to generate dedicated modulation parameters, while an input-conditioned depth predictor adaptively configures the number of loop iterations. With only approximately 0.884M trainable parameters, the proposed model uniformly handles UHD video dehazing, deraining, denoising, and low-light enhancement tasks, achieving state-of-the-art restoration performance on both public benchmarks and real-world scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoopMoEVR 把循环学习范式引入统一 UHD 视频复原，用退化条件化的低秩循环嵌入、IterAda3DN 时空迭代自适应归一化与输入条件化深度预测器控制循环次数，仅约 0.884M 可训练参数即统一处理去雾、去雨、去噪与低光增强，并在公开基准和真实场景上达到 SOTA 复原性能。
Motivation: 统一高分辨率图像/视频复原现有模型靠加深网络换取泛化，收益有限且参数量大；跨域退化任务需要低参数、强回归能力的范式。
Method: LoopMoEVR 为基于循环的 mixture-of-experts 模型：退化条件化低秩循环嵌入构造输入相关的 stage 条件，IterAda3DN（时空迭代自适应归一化）融合局部特征与全局循环上下文做逐位置仿射调制，专家分支据注意力更新的局部/全局视频状态与循环条件生成专用调制参数，输入条件化深度预测器自适应决定循环迭代次数。
Result: 仅约 0.884M 可训练参数，统一处理 UHD 视频去雾、去雨、去噪与低光增强，在公开基准与真实场景上均达到 state-of-the-art 复原性能。
Conclusion: 循环 + 退化感知 MoE 的组合能以极小参数量覆盖多退化 UHD 视频复原并取得 SOTA，说明加深网络不是提升统一复原泛化的必要路径。

papers.title: Best-of-$N$ Guidance for Test-time Diffusion Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models achieve strong generative performance but often struggle to align generated samples with human preferences measured by a reward model. A simple yet effective algorithm for test-time alignment is Best-of-$N$ (BoN) sampling, which draws $N$ i.i.d. samples from a pre-trained diffusion model and outputs the single highest-reward sample. Despite its empirical success, BoN makes limited use of reward information, as it is incorporated only at the final selection stage without influencing the reverse diffusion trajectory during sampling. Consequently, BoN sampling does not improve the average alignment of generated samples and is primarily suited to single-output settings. We propose Best-of-$N$ Guidance (BoNG), a novel method that integrates the principle of BoN sampling directly into the reverse diffusion process. BoNG performs online BoN selection over denoising particles and adjusts the reverse diffusion process to steer the particle population toward higher-reward regions during generation. Specifically, by introducing an asymmetric guidance interaction among denoising particles, BoNG uses the current BoN particle as a guidance signal to the rest of the particle population. This particle-level interaction reshapes the sampling process toward higher-reward regions, enabling BoNG to improve not only the final best sample beyond Vanilla BoN sampling, but also the average quality of generated samples. Over 36 empirical comparisons, BoNG achieves the best performance in 29 cases, ranking first in 80.56% of the comparisons against SMC and Vanilla BoN sampling. BoNG also supports multi-output capability, achieving 1.3$\times$ ImageReward score of the latest sample-based guidance method with a 1.6$\times$ speedup. We release the code at https://github.com/aailab-kaist/BoNG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Best-of-N Guidance (BoNG) 把 Best-of-N 选择从最终挑选前移到反向扩散过程内部：对去噪粒子做在线 BoN 选择，并让当前 BoN 粒子以非对称引导方式带动其余粒子群体流向高奖励区域。36 组实证比较中 BoNG 在 29 组取得最佳，占 80.56%，对手为 SMC 与 Vanilla BoN；多输出场景达到最新 sample-based guidance 方法 1.3× 的 ImageReward 分数且加速 1.6×。
Motivation: Best-of-N 采样只在最终选择阶段用奖励，不改变反向扩散轨迹，因此无法提升样本平均对齐度，且只适用于单输出场景。
Method: BoNG 在去噪粒子上做在线 Best-of-N 选择，把当前 BoN 粒子作为引导信号，以非对称 guidance interaction 调整反向扩散过程，重塑采样分布；与 SMC 和 Vanilla BoN 对比，代码已开源。
Result: 36 组实证比较中 BoNG 在 29 组最优，占 80.56%，对比 SMC 与 Vanilla BoN sampling；多输出下 ImageReward 分数为最新 sample-based guidance 方法的 1.3×，同时加速 1.6×。
Conclusion: 把 Best-of-N 原则嵌入反向扩散而非只做末端挑选，可同时提升最佳样本与样本平均质量，并使 BoN 具备多输出能力。

papers.title: SharpDraft: Accelerating Long-Context Speculative Decoding with Cardinality-Aware Query Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Long-form reasoning makes inference expensive, and speculative decoding mitigates this cost by verifying multiple draft tokens in parallel. Its speedup, however, can fade as context grows and draft acceptance declines. We focus on attention-mass dilution: as softmax normalizes over more visible Keys, the mass concentrated on the highest-scoring Keys can decrease. We introduce SharpDraft, a training-free method that counteracts this effect through cardinality-aware Query scaling, without the computational overhead of online adaptation. Under explicit assumptions, we derive an exact top-$k$ mass correction and deploy a closed-form fixed-slope approximation. Across AIME-26, GPQA-Diamond, and LongGenBench Diary, SharpDraft achieves $2.59$-$3.19\times$ geometric-mean end-to-end speedups over target-only autoregressive decoding when applied to DFlash, PARD, and EAGLE 3.1. With DFlash, it improves decoding speed and outperforms full-parameter and LoRA-based online adaptation in end-to-end speedup, while matching the unmodified drafter's reported peak allocated GPU memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SharpDraft 是一种免训练的长上下文投机解码加速方法：针对注意力质量稀释（attention-mass dilution），即 softmax 在更多可见 Keys 上归一化会削弱最高分 Keys 上的质量、导致草稿接受率随上下文增长而下降，用基数感知的 Query 缩放 (cardinality-aware Query scaling) 抵消该效应。在 AIME-26、GPQA-Diamond、LongGenBench Diary 上，套用到 DFlash、PARD、EAGLE 3.1 时相对纯自回归解码取得 2.59–3.19× 几何平均端到端加速。
Motivation: 长上下文下投机解码的加速会随草稿接受率下降而衰减，根因是注意力质量在更多 Keys 上被稀释；现有在线自适应方案带来额外计算开销。
Method: 免训练方法：在显式假设下推导精确的 top-k 质量修正，实际部署其闭式定斜率近似，对 Query 做基数感知缩放，无需在线自适应的计算开销；作为插件应用于 DFlash、PARD、EAGLE 3.1 三种草稿器。

Conclusion: 注意力质量稀释是长上下文投机解码掉速的可修正来源，用闭式 Query 缩放即可在不增加显存、不做在线训练的前提下恢复加速。

papers.title: VulValidate: Auditing Function-Level Vulnerability Labels with Executable Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Reliable learning-based vulnerability detection requires high-quality labels, yet datasets built from vulnerability-fixing commits may label functions as vulnerable simply because they were changed by a security patch. We present VulValidate, a framework that uses LLM agents to coordinate dynamic analysis tools and construct vulnerability-triggering experiments from runtime feedback. Given a labeled function and its fixing patch, VulValidate reconstructs vulnerable and fixed revisions, selects suitable tools and execution paths, refines triggering inputs, and compares runtime behavior to assess function-level attribution. We audit all 35,849 instances originally labeled vulnerable in BigVul, PrimeVul, and DiverseVul. We confirm 20,510 (57.2%), correct 6,819 labels (19.0%), leave 7,981 attacked but undecided (22.3%), and cannot successfully measure 539 (1.5%). After conflict resolution and byte-exact deduplication, the corrected release contains 15,890 distinct confirmed vulnerable function bodies. In a blinded review of 581 sampled decisions, expert consensus supports 90.0%--92.0% of confirmations and 92.6%--99.0% of label corrections. With model parameters fixed, corrected evaluation lowers F1 for all five tested detectors on both BigVul and DiverseVul; retraining with corrected labels improves F1 for four of five detectors on each dataset. We also release a reusable VulValidate skill, corrected datasets, and reproducible evidence for future vulnerability-detection research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VulValidate 用 LLM agent 协调动态分析工具，为 BigVul、PrimeVul、DiverseVul 中 35,849 个被标为脆弱的函数构造可执行的漏洞触发实验，按运行时行为判定函数级归因。审计确认 20,510 个（57.2%）、纠正 6,819 个（19.0%）、7,981 个（22.3%）攻击存在但未决、539 个（1.5%）无法测量；用纠正标签重训后，五个检测器中有四个在 BigVul 与 DiverseVul 上 F1 提升。
Motivation: 基于漏洞修复 commit 构建的数据集会把被安全补丁改动过的函数一律标为脆弱，函数级归因不可靠，直接损害依赖这些标签的漏洞检测模型训练与评测。
Method: 给定带标签函数及其修复补丁，VulValidate 重建 vulnerable 与 fixed 两个版本，由 LLM agent 选择合适的动态分析工具与执行路径、迭代细化触发输入，再比较两侧运行时行为来判定函数级归因；随后做冲突消解与字节级去重，并发布 VulValidate skill、纠正后的数据集与可复现证据。
Result: 审计全部 35,849 个原始标为脆弱的实例：确认 20,510（57.2%），纠正 6,819（19.0%），攻击存在但未决 7,981（22.3%），无法成功测量 539（1.5%）；纠正后发布 15,890 个去重的确认脆弱函数体。581 个抽样决策的盲审中，专家共识支持 90.0%–92.0% 的确认与 92.6%–99.0% 的标签纠正。模型参数固定时，纠正后评测使五个受测检测器在 BigVul 与 DiverseVul 上的 F1 全部下降；用纠正标签重训后，两个数据集上各有四个检测器 F1 提升。
Conclusion: 漏洞修复 commit 启发式产生的函数级标签有约五分之一需要纠正，标签质量足以系统性压低或抬高检测器 F1；可执行证据加运行时对比可作为函数级归因的审计手段。

papers.title: Private Component-by-Component Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study differentially private learning problems in the realizable setting, where a hypothesis is specified by $k$ components. A direct iteration of private component learners is obstructed by a simple difficulty: an approximate choice of the next component may destroy exact realizability of the labeled sample, even when the next component is locally accurate. We restore realizability using the LabelBoost procedure of Beimel, Nissim, and Stemmer [SODA '15, Algorithmica '21] and recycle data through two alternating reservoirs. The resulting learner, for a target privacy $\varepsilon$, pays only $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$ overhead relative to the active sample requirement of a single component learning step at target accuracy $Θ(α/k)$. For learning $d$-dimensional halfspaces over a finite coordinate grid of size $L$, exact realizability makes the direct component-depth objective quasi-concave. Instantiating the framework with the IPConcave algorithm of Nissim, Tsfadia, and Yan [SODA '26] and with the quasi-concave optimizer of Cohen, Lyu, Nelson, Sarl'os, and Stemmer [STOC '23] yields a realizable sample complexity of $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{\varepsilon α}\cdot \min\{d^{2.5} \log^*L, \:\: d^{2.5} + d^{1.5} 2^{\log^*L}\}\right),$ which improves on the previously known bound of $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{\varepsilon α}\cdot\min\{\frac{1}α\cdot d^{5.5}\log^*L,\:\: d^{2.5}2^{\log^*L}\}\right).$ We also apply the framework to Boolean compositions: given proper private learners for classes $H_1,\ldots,H_k$, we obtain a proper private learner for $G(H_1,\ldots,H_k)$ for any fixed Boolean function $G:\{0,1\}^k\to\{0,1\}$. Compared with the closure theorem of Alon, Beimel, Moran, and Stemmer [COLT '20], this reduces the overhead on a common component sample bound from $\widetilde O(k/\varepsilon)$ to $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在可实现 (realizable) 差分隐私学习中，逐组件迭代会因近似选择下一个组件而破坏样本的精确可实现性；论文用 LabelBoost 恢复可实现性并以两个交替 reservoir 回收数据，使相对单组件学习的开销降到 Õ(√k/ε)。对有限坐标网格上的 d 维半空间，该框架给出 Õ((1/(εα))·min{d^2.5 log*L, d^2.5 + d^1.5·2^{log*L}}) 的样本复杂度，并把布尔组合闭包定理的开销从 Õ(k/ε) 降到 Õ(√k/ε)。
Motivation: 可实现设定下按组件逐个做私有学习时，下一个组件的近似选择会破坏标注样本的精确可实现性，即使该组件局部准确；已有布尔组合闭包定理的开销为 Õ(k/ε)，半空间已知界含 1/α·d^5.5 log*L 项，都偏大。
Method: 用 Beimel、Nissim、Stemmer 的 LabelBoost 恢复可实现性，并用两个交替 reservoir 回收数据；对有限坐标网格（大小 L）上的 d 维半空间，精确可实现性使直接的组件深度目标拟凹，进而实例化 Nissim、Tsfadia、Yan 的 IPConcave 与 Cohen 等人的拟凹优化器；框架同时适用于布尔组合 G(H_1,…,H_k)。
Result: 目标隐私 ε 下相对单组件学习（目标精度 Θ(α/k)）的开销为 Õ(√k/ε)；d 维半空间在大小 L 的有限坐标网格上可实现样本复杂度 Õ((1/(εα))·min{d^2.5 log*L, d^2.5 + d^1.5·2^{log*L}})，改进此前的 Õ((1/(εα))·min{(1/α)·d^5.5 log*L, d^2.5·2^{log*L}})；对固定布尔函数 G 的组合，公共组件样本界开销由 Alon 等 COLT '20 闭包定理的 Õ(k/ε) 降至 Õ(√k/ε)。
Conclusion: 恢复精确可实现性加数据回收能把逐组件私有学习的开销压到 √k/ε 量级，并在半空间与布尔组合两类问题上给出改进的样本复杂度界。

papers.title: METRO: Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art neural operators scale to complex meshes via slice-and-process architectures, yet many rely on linear compatibility scores for latent tokenization. Under common feature normalization, such scores are equivalent to isotropic Euclidean clustering, while without normalization they induce unbounded linear decision regions. In both cases, they lack slice-specific anisotropic locality, which can lead to redundant and entangled latent slices. To address this, we propose Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator (METRO), a geometry-aware routing mechanism that replaces linear projection with a learnable Mahalanobis metric. By enabling each latent slice to learn a local anisotropic tensor, METRO shapes receptive fields into exponentially localized, oriented ellipsoids that naturally align with flow features like boundary layers and wakes. As a drop-in replacement, METRO yields consistent improvements across both Transformer and Mamba backbones. Empirically, our method achieves substantial performance gains on irregular domains, outperforming baselines on both standard PDE benchmarks and complex industrial design tasks. Finally, METRO exhibits enhanced robustness in out-of-distribution regimes across varying Reynolds numbers and geometric configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: METRO 把神经算子 slice-and-process 架构中的线性兼容度打分替换为可学习的 Mahalanobis 度量，让每个 latent slice 学一个局部各向异性张量，把感受野塑造成指数局域、有方向的椭球，从而对齐边界层与尾迹等流动特征。作为 Transformer 与 Mamba 主干的即插即用替换，它在标准 PDE 基准与复杂工业设计任务上一致超过基线，并在不同 Reynolds 数与几何构型的分布外情形下表现出更强鲁棒性。
Motivation: 神经算子靠 slice-and-process 扩展到复杂网格，但 latent tokenization 常用线性兼容度打分：特征归一化下等价于各向同性 Euclidean 聚类，不归一化则产生无界线性决策域，两者都缺少 slice 特有的各向异性局部性，导致 latent slice 冗余纠缠。
Method: 提出 Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator (METRO)：用可学习的 Mahalanobis 度量取代线性投影，每个 latent slice 学习一个局部各向异性张量，将感受野塑造成指数局域的定向椭球；作为 drop-in 替换接入 Transformer 与 Mamba 主干。
Result: 在标准 PDE 基准与复杂工业设计任务上均优于基线，在 Transformer 与 Mamba 两种主干上取得一致提升；在不同 Reynolds 数与几何构型的分布外 (OOD) 情形下鲁棒性增强。
Conclusion: 把线性兼容度打分换成按 slice 学习的各向异性 Mahalanobis 路由，是神经算子在不规则域与 OOD 工况下同时改善精度与鲁棒性的通用替换件。

summary_sections.result: 在标准 PDE 基准与复杂工业设计任务上均优于基线，在 Transformer 与 Mamba 两种主干上取得一致提升；在不同 Reynolds 数与几何构型的分布外 (OOD) 情形下鲁棒性增强。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把线性兼容度打分换成按 slice 学习的各向异性 Mahalanobis 路由，是神经算子在不规则域与 OOD 工况下同时改善精度与鲁棒性的通用替换件。

papers.title: Advectra: Asymmetric Latent Transport for Non-Stationary Physics
papers.abstract_en: Many latent neural operators represent input and output fields in a stationary latent chart. In particular, common latent routing mechanisms use fixed or shared assignment weights for feature projection and reconstruction, limiting their ability to model transport-dominated systems where coherent structures move relative to fixed coordinate frames. We propose Advectra, a transport-aware latent operator that introduces a regularized kinematic coordinate map to decouple source and target coordinate systems. This yields an approximately co-moving latent reference frame and enables asymmetric feature aggregation and reconstruction. Combined with a geometry-aware ordering mechanism for state-space models, Advectra captures advective dynamics while maintaining stable global interactions. Advectra achieves the best performance among evaluated geometry-constrained and form-free baselines on advection-dominated benchmarks, including passive scalar transport in Navier--Stokes flows and Rayleigh--Taylor instability, while demonstrating strong generalization on real-world engineering tasks. These results highlight the benefit of explicit moving-frame structure in neural operators for non-stationary physics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Advectra 用一个带正则的运动学坐标映射把源与目标坐标系解耦，得到近似随流移动的潜变量参考系，使特征聚合与重构可以不对称，再配合面向状态空间模型的几何感知排序机制来捕捉平流主导动力学。在以平流为主的基准（Navier–Stokes 流中的被动标量输运、Rayleigh–Taylor 不稳定性）上，它在所评估的几何约束与自由形式基线中取得最好性能，并在真实工程任务上展现较强泛化。
Motivation: 常见潜变量神经算子用固定或共享的分配权重做特征投影与重构，坐标系是平稳的，难以刻画相干结构相对固定坐标移动的输运主导系统。
Method: 提出输运感知的潜变量算子 Advectra：引入带正则的运动学坐标映射解耦源与目标坐标系，构造近似共动 (co-moving) 的潜参考系，从而支持非对称的特征聚合与重构；再与面向状态空间模型 (state-space models) 的几何感知排序机制结合，以在保持稳定全局交互的同时捕捉平流。
Result: 在平流主导基准上，包括 Navier–Stokes 流中的被动标量输运与 Rayleigh–Taylor 不稳定性，Advectra 在所评估的几何约束基线与自由形式基线中取得最佳性能；在真实工程任务上展示出较强的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 显式引入移动参考系结构对非平稳物理的神经算子有益，平稳潜变量坐标是输运主导系统建模的瓶颈。

papers.title: ReMAP: Restoring the Perceptual Cycle with Reasoning-Time Latent Visual Memory
papers.abstract_en: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reason for longer, attention to the initial visual input diminishes, weakening visual grounding. Visual memory reintroduces visual evidence during reasoning. We conduct a controlled analysis of visual memory along three axes: curation, organization, and access. We find that local evidence benefits from global context, compact latent representations balance accuracy and visual-context cost, and the utility of memory access depends on the reasoning state. Guided by these findings, we propose ReMAP (Reasoning-Time Memory-Augmented Perception), which couples two complementary latent memories: a static, question-conditioned Global memory that preserves scene and cross-image context, and a dynamic Local memory that uses this context as an anchor while selecting and re-encoding region-level evidence according to the current reasoning state. Both memories return compact latent tokens inserted into the reasoning sequence, and a reinforcement-learning access policy trained with branched rollouts decides when to continue reasoning or invoke Global or Local memory. On ten benchmark families, ReMAP outperforms prior visual-memory methods on all four multi-image benchmarks, exceeding the strongest prior results on MuirBench and MIMIC by 8.38 and 14.84 percentage points. Across four backbone families, enabling memory access improves over the same trained model with memory disabled, and on shared V*Bench, CV-Bench-2D, and MuirBench questions ReMAP reduces the visual tokens entering the reasoning sequence by 51.0-76.8% relative to the native-resolution backbone. Further analyses show that Global and Local memory form distinct yet complementary latent representations. Together, these components restore the perceptual cycle by letting the reasoning state trigger targeted visual retrieval, with the retrieved evidence guiding subsequent reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReMAP 在多模态大模型推理时按需调用两套潜视觉记忆：静态问题条件化的 Global 记忆保留场景与跨图上下文，动态 Local 记忆随推理状态选区重编码，由带分支 rollout 的强化学习策略决定何时继续推理或调用记忆。在十个 benchmark 家族上，四个多图像任务全部超过既有视觉记忆方法，MuirBench 与 MIMIC 分别高出 8.38 和 14.84 个百分点，同时相对原生分辨率 backbone 减少 51.0–76.8% 进入推理序列的视觉 token。
Motivation: MLLM 推理变长后注意力逐渐离开初始视觉输入，视觉接地 (visual grounding) 变弱；已有视觉记忆方法在证据筛选、组织与访问时机上缺少受控分析。
Method: 沿 curation、organization、access 三轴做受控分析后提出 ReMAP：Global 记忆（静态、问题条件化）与 Local 记忆（以 Global 为锚，按当前推理状态选择并重编码区域级证据）都返回紧凑 latent token 插入推理序列；访问策略用 branched rollouts 训练的强化学习决定继续推理还是调用 Global/Local。
Result: 在十个 benchmark 家族上，ReMAP 在全部四个多图像 benchmark 超过既有视觉记忆方法，MuirBench 与 MIMIC 分别领先最强先前结果 8.38 与 14.84 个百分点；四个 backbone 家族上开启记忆访问均优于同一模型关闭记忆的版本；在共享的 V*Bench、CV-Bench-2D、MuirBench 题目上，相对原生分辨率 backbone 进入推理序列的视觉 token 减少 51.0–76.8%。
Conclusion: 让推理状态触发定向视觉检索、再由检索证据引导后续推理，可以在更少视觉 token 下恢复长推理中的视觉接地；Global 与 Local 记忆学到的是不同且互补的潜表示。

papers.title: vMF Sentence LDA: A Spherical Topic Model over Sentence Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) and models derived from it remain widely used topic models. LDA observes each document as a bag-of-words and models each topic by a categorical distribution over the vocabulary, so that it uses neither the internal structure of the document nor the similarity in meaning between words. Earlier work has responded to this limitation in two ways: many models have introduced embeddings, and some have assigned topics to sentences rather than to words. Their combination, a topic model that observes sentence embeddings, remains little explored. We propose vMF Sentence LDA (vSLDA), which keeps the admixture structure of LDA, observes each sentence as its L2-normalized embedding and models each topic by a von Mises-Fisher (vMF) distribution, which matches the cosine geometry of sentence embeddings. Its per-topic parameter count and per-iteration cost are linear in the embedding dimension, versus quadratic for the full-covariance Gaussian distribution in the existing model over sentence embeddings. We evaluate vSLDA where the limitation is expected to matter most, among topics that share much of their vocabulary: the topics that subdivide the one subject of a collection, and the narrow topics that result when a corpus is divided into a large number of topics. On two corpora, vSLDA attains the best mean rank against eight baselines when the fine categories within each coarse category are classified from the document-topic distributions. On the whole corpus, its advantage appears or widens as the number of topics grows. Weighting the word frequencies of each sentence by its topic posterior yields expected topic-word counts of the same form as those of LDA, so that the standard topic coherence and diversity measures apply to models that assign topics to sentences. On their product, topic quality, vSLDA leads in most within-category conditions of both corpora.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 vSLDA：把每句话的 L2 归一化句向量当作观测，用 von Mises-Fisher (vMF) 分布建模主题，保留 LDA 的 admixture 结构，从而在词表高度重叠的细分主题上仍可区分。其每主题参数量与每轮迭代代价随嵌入维度线性增长（现有句向量主题模型的全协方差 Gaussian 为二次）。在两个语料上按文档-主题分布做粗类内细类分类时，对八个基线取得最佳平均排名，且优势随主题数增多而出现或扩大；按主题后验加权句词频后，标准 coherence 与 diversity 指标可直接套用，topic quality 在两个语料的多数类内条件下领先。
Motivation: LDA 把文档当词袋、主题当词表上的 categorical 分布，既不用文档内部结构也不用词义相似度；已有工作分别引入 embedding 或把主题挂到句子上，但「以句向量为观测的主题模型」这一组合仍少有人做，且在主题共享大量词表时难以区分。
Method: vSLDA 保留 LDA 的 admixture 结构，观测是每句话的 L2 归一化 embedding，每个主题用与句向量余弦几何匹配的 von Mises-Fisher (vMF) 分布；每主题参数量与每轮迭代代价对嵌入维度为线性，对比现有句向量模型的全协方差 Gaussian 的二次复杂度。评测刻意选在限制最明显的场景：同一主题下的细分主题，以及把语料切成大量主题后产生的窄主题；另用主题后验给每句词频加权，得到与 LDA 同形式的期望主题-词计数，使标准 coherence/diversity 指标可用。
Result: 在两个语料上，从文档-主题分布分类每个粗类内的细类时，vSLDA 对八个基线取得最佳平均排名；在整语料上其优势随主题数增长而出现或扩大。按 topic quality（coherence 与 diversity 之积）衡量，vSLDA 在两个语料的多数类内条件下领先。
Conclusion: 用 vMF 匹配句向量的余弦几何，可以在词表重叠严重的细分主题场景中做出可区分的主题模型，同时把参数与迭代代价降到线性；把句级主题后验折回词频后，LDA 的标准主题质量指标即可用于句子级主题模型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Direction-Conditioned Policies for Online Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CRL) learns representations that estimate goal reachability, yet its policy remains conditioned on raw goals and therefore does not directly exploit the geometry encoded by its critic. We introduce Direction-Conditioned Policies (DCP), a method built around a small modification to CRL: DCP selects previously visited states as waypoints during online training and conditions the policy on their direction and distance in representation space. At deployment, DCP applies the same interface directly to the final goal, requiring neither waypoint selection nor planning. Across nine navigation and manipulation tasks, DCP attains higher final success rates than CRL on seven tasks and spends more time near the goal on seven. Controlled maze experiments further show that DCP captures shortest-path geometry more accurately and that the supplied direction causally influences the actor's behavior. We identify waypoint coverage and ranking as limits to exploration, and show that learned candidate generation improves goal reaching in two controlled mazes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DCP 在对比强化学习 (CRL) 上只改一处：在线训练时把已访问状态选为 waypoint，让策略以表示空间中的方向与距离为条件，部署时同一接口直接作用于最终目标，无需选点或规划。九个导航与操作任务中，DCP 在七个任务上最终成功率高于 CRL、七个任务上更贴近目标停留更久，迷宫实验显示其更准确捕捉最短路几何且方向输入因果影响 actor 行为。
Motivation: CRL 的 critic 学到了目标可达性的几何表示，但策略仍以原始目标为条件，无法直接利用这份几何信息。
Method: DCP 在线训练时从已访问状态中选 waypoint，把它们在表示空间中的方向与距离作为策略条件；部署时把同一接口直接套到最终目标。在受控迷宫中检验最短路几何与方向的因果作用，并用学习式候选生成改进 waypoint 覆盖与排序。
Result: 在九个导航与操作任务上，DCP 最终成功率高于 CRL 的有七个，靠近目标停留时间更长的有七个；受控迷宫实验中 DCP 更准确捕捉最短路几何，所给方向因果影响 actor 行为；学习式候选生成在两个受控迷宫中改善目标到达。
Conclusion: 把 critic 已编码的表示几何以方向-距离条件喂给策略即可提升目标达成，waypoint 覆盖与排序是探索的瓶颈，可用学习式候选生成缓解。

papers.title: Tracing a Sparse Emotion-Control Circuit in LLM-Based Text-to-Speech
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based text-to-speech (TTS) models can generate emotionally expressive speech, but how reference emotion is routed through the model and realized in decoded speech remains unclear. We introduce two emotion-sensitive metrics for matched neutral and emotional syntheses---a codec trajectory score and a late residual direction score---and use them to score activation-patching interventions. Under controlled matched-reference conditions, this analysis identifies a sparse source-to-readout component-level circuit: 23--27 attention heads and MLPs per emotion, roughly 5% of the components considered, recover or suppress 74--88% of the late emotion-readout shift on held-out cases. The circuit combines a shared component backbone with emotion-specific components; cross-emotion activation swaps reduce the target readout in 47 of 48 cases. In decoded speech, the same intervention produces consistent changes in pitch, energy, and spectral brightness over 24 matched pairs per emotion. A readout-matched residual-direction baseline produces only 17--27% of the intervention's pitch effect, showing that internal readout movement alone does not explain the decoded acoustic changes. These results trace a compact causal route from reference-derived prefix information to emotion-relevant properties of generated speech.
papers.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 15 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LLM-based TTS 中用激活修补 (activation patching) 定位情感控制回路：每种情感仅 23–27 个注意力头与 MLP（约占所考察组件的 5%）即可在留出样本上恢复或抑制 74–88% 的晚期情感读出偏移，跨情感交换在 48 例中 47 例降低目标读出。干预同时一致改变解码语音的音高、能量与谱亮度（每种情感 24 对匹配样本），而读出匹配的残差方向基线只产生干预音高效应的 17–27%，说明内部读出位移本身不足以解释声学变化。
Motivation: LLM-based TTS 能生成富有情感的语音，但参考情感如何在模型内部路由并最终落到解码语音上尚不清楚，缺少可定位到组件级的因果证据。
Method: 提出两个情感敏感度量——codec trajectory score 与 late residual direction score——对匹配的中性/情感合成打分，并据此对激活修补干预评分；在受控 matched-reference 条件下追踪从参考前缀到读出的组件级回路，另设读出匹配的残差方向基线做对照。
Result: 每种情感 23–27 个注意力头与 MLP（约 5% 组件）在留出样本上恢复或抑制 74–88% 的晚期情感读出偏移；跨情感激活交换在 48 例中 47 例降低目标读出；同一干预在每种情感 24 对匹配样本上一致改变音高、能量与谱亮度；残差方向基线仅产生干预音高效应的 17–27%。
Conclusion: 情感由一条紧凑的组件级因果回路从参考前缀传到生成语音，共享主干叠加情感特异组件；内部读出位移不足以解释解码声学变化，还需回路之外的机制。

papers.title: CGDD-Net: Context-Guided Dynamic Detail Modeling for Retinal Vessel Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate retinal vessel segmentation requires features that capture vascular geometry while preserving information for fine-scale reconstruction. We propose CGDD-Net, a context-guided dynamic detail modeling network that connects adaptive feature extraction to a shared decoder pathway. Context-Guided Scale-Adaptive Deformable Encoding (CSDE) combines fixed-grid convolution with deformable local attention to capture vascular patterns at multiple spatial extents. Spatially Adaptive Multi-Kernel Gating (SAMG) selects receptive-field responses at each location. Dynamic Cross-Scale Detail Fusion (DCDF) aligns the gated intermediate features and compresses them into an eight-channel representation, which is reused at three decoder resolutions together with selected encoder skips. This design consolidates intermediate information before decoding instead of transferring each middle-stage feature through a separate direct skip. On DRIVE, CHASE\_DB1, STARE, and HRF, CGDD-Net achieves AUC values of 0.9824, 0.9938, 0.9895, and 0.9874, with F1 scores of 0.8323, 0.8102, 0.8510, and 0.8157, respectively. The complete model contains 1.96 million trainable parameters. In cumulative ablations, the full model improves F1 over the internal baseline by 2.48, 0.61, and 3.49 percentage points on DRIVE, CHASE\_DB1, and STARE. Twelve directed cross-dataset experiments further characterize transfer without target-domain adaptation. The results support shared intermediate detail delivery as an effective, parameter-compact architecture for retinal vessel segmentation. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/lixincheng-xcl/CGDD-Net}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CGDD-Net 用上下文引导的动态细节建模做视网膜血管分割：CSDE 以固定网格卷积加 deformable local attention 多尺度提取血管模式，SAMG 逐位置选择感受野，DCDF 把门控中间特征压成 8 通道表示并在三个解码分辨率复用。在 DRIVE、CHASE_DB1、STARE、HRF 上 AUC 分别为 0.9824、0.9938、0.9895、0.9874，F1 为 0.8323、0.8102、0.8510、0.8157，参数量 196 万。
Motivation: 视网膜血管分割既要捕捉血管几何又要保留细尺度重建信息，而逐个中间层直连 skip 的传输方式使解码前的信息分散、参数开销上升。
Method: CSDE 将固定网格卷积与 deformable local attention 结合以覆盖多空间尺度的血管模式；SAMG 在每个位置选择感受野响应；DCDF 对齐门控中间特征并压缩为 8 通道表示，与选定的 encoder skip 一起在三个解码分辨率复用，取代每个中间阶段单独直连 skip。
Result: DRIVE/CHASE_DB1/STARE/HRF 上 AUC 为 0.9824、0.9938、0.9895、0.9874，F1 为 0.8323、0.8102、0.8510、0.8157；完整模型 1.96M 可训练参数；累计消融中完整模型相对内部基线在 DRIVE、CHASE_DB1、STARE 上 F1 分别提升 2.48、0.61、3.49 个百分点；另有 12 组跨数据集定向实验刻画无目标域适配的迁移。
Conclusion: 共享的中间细节传递是视网膜血管分割中有效且参数紧凑的架构选择，可在不逐层直连 skip 的情况下保持高 AUC 与 F1。

papers.title: How Execution Assumptions Change Short-Horizon Sharpe Rankings: Evidence from a Synthetic Trading Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Backtests of LLM trading agents often assume that every order fills at the closing price. We ask whether this choice changes only reported returns or also the order of the agents. Five prompted LLM signal policies and seven classical baselines trade the same synthetic price paths under six execution settings, from near-ideal fills to latency, spread, participation, and impact stresses. The main experiment contains $2{,}462$ runs with matched decision frequencies and paired market paths. On the compressed two-asset board, agreement between the near-ideal and default-stress rankings falls to Kendall $τ_b=0.21$ in the high-volatility regime, compared with $0.82$ in the calm regime. The seed-bootstrap intervals, $[0.00,0.52]$ and $[0.48,0.94]$, are wide and overlap. On a fixed 11-policy board, agreement rises from 0.24 with two assets to 0.85 with ten; the two-asset point estimate differs substantially from the wider settings we tested. Rank changes are related to turnover, and comparisons with buy-and-hold also depend on how that anchor is initialized. The experiment does not compare LLM trading skill. It shows that, on a short horizon, an execution convention can become part of the benchmark's headline. Execution assumptions and rank stability should be reported alongside returns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在合成交易基准上，成交假设（从近理想成交到延迟、点差、参与率与冲击压力）不只改变 LLM 交易策略的报告收益，还改变策略排名顺序：高波动体制下近理想与默认压力排名的 Kendall τ_b 仅 0.21（平静体制 0.82），且资产数从 2 增到 10 时一致性从 0.24 升到 0.85。作者主张短周期回测必须把执行假设与排名稳定性与收益一并报告。
Motivation: LLM 交易 agent 回测普遍假设按收盘价全部成交，这一约定可能渗入基准的头条结论：若它同时改变策略排序，报告的收益与排名都不可比。
Method: 五个 prompted LLM 信号策略加七个经典基线，在同一批合成价格路径上按六种执行设定（近理想成交至延迟、点差、参与率、冲击压力）交易，主实验 2,462 次运行，决策频率匹配且市场路径成对；用 seed-bootstrap 区间评估排名一致性，并比较不同资产数的策略板与 buy-and-hold 锚定方式。
Result: 压缩双资产板上，近理想与默认压力排名一致性在高波动体制 Kendall τ_b=0.21，平静体制 0.82；seed-bootstrap 区间分别为 [0.00,0.52] 与 [0.48,0.94]，宽且重叠。固定 11 策略板上一致性从 2 资产的 0.24 升到 10 资产的 0.85。排名变化与换手率相关，与 buy-and-hold 的比较还取决于该锚的初始化方式。
Conclusion: 短周期上执行约定会成为基准头条的一部分，因此执行假设与排名稳定性应与收益一同报告；该实验不比较 LLM 交易技能本身。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Self-Generated Feedback Destabilizes Test-Time Training: A Causal Decomposition of Long-Horizon Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Test-time training (TTT) lets a model store information in its weights during inference. When the model learns from its own output, however, each update also changes the model that generates the next training example. Across 128K-token streams, retaining generated-text updates worsens prediction on independent human-written text with three TTT-E2E model configurations (labeled 125M, 760M, and 3B). The same failure occurs when Adam updates Qwen3-4B's existing weights. The same update mechanisms can improve on real text, so writing itself is not the failure. Three matched comparisons trace the causal pathway. Fixed Generation removes over 98% of the damage at 125M and 760M by using a frozen model to generate training chunks. Recorded Replay separates the loss caused by reading degraded text from the additional loss stored by updating on it. A paired one-update comparison then shows the local conflict: an update predicts its source better but new real text worse. This cost grows after Closed Loop adaptation, with a few trajectories accounting for most large failures. Finally, Settlement evaluates the candidate state on independent real text before commitment. It leaves mean endpoint gaps of 0.07 and -0.02 nats at 125M and 760M while retaining real-text adaptation. These results motivate checking prediction on independent evidence before retaining an update.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 测试时训练 (TTT) 中模型用自己的生成文本做训练数据会形成闭环：每次更新既存信息又改变下一个训练样本的生成者。在 128K token 流上，保留生成文本更新使 TTT-E2E 三种配置 (125M/760M/3B) 与 Adam 微调 Qwen3-4B 现有权重都在独立人类文本上变差；用冻结模型生成训练块 (Fixed Generation) 可消除 125M 与 760M 上超过 98% 的损害。作者建议在保留更新前先用独立真实文本检验预测。
Motivation: TTT 让模型在推理时把信息写进权重，但当训练数据来自模型自身输出，更新会同时改变生成下一批训练样本的模型，形成自反馈回路；这一回路在长程 (128K token) 适应中如何因果地损害对真实文本的预测尚不清楚。
Method: 用三组配对比较做因果分解：Fixed Generation 用冻结模型生成训练块以切断闭环；Recorded Replay 分离“读到劣化文本的损失”与“在它上面更新所存入的额外损失”；配对单步更新比较检验局部冲突；再引入 Closed Loop 适应与 Settlement（提交前在独立真实文本上评估候选状态）。
Result: 128K token 流上，保留生成文本更新使 TTT-E2E 的 125M、760M、3B 三种配置在独立人类文本上预测变差，Adam 更新 Qwen3-4B 现有权重同样失败；Fixed Generation 在 125M 与 760M 上消除超过 98% 的损害；单步更新使其来源文本预测更好而新真实文本更差，Closed Loop 后该代价增大且少数轨迹占大部分大幅失败；Settlement 在 125M 与 760M 上留下 0.07 与 -0.02 nats 的平均端点差距，同时保留对真实文本的适应。
Conclusion: 自生成反馈是长程 TTT 不稳定的因果来源，写作本身不是问题；在提交更新前用独立证据检验预测即可在保留真实文本适应的同时基本消除损害。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: ReDiffNet: Differential RGB-Infrared Learning for Low-Light UAV Oriented Vehicle Detection
papers.abstract_en: Low-light UAV-based RGB-infrared oriented small-vehicle detection is important for nighttime traffic monitoring, emergency response, and urban inspection. Illumination variations, headlight glare, local shadows, and thermal-response degradation cause spatially varying modality reliability, while the small visual extent of vehicles further weakens boundaries, orientation cues, and thermal responses. Accordingly, selecting trustworthy observations based on local modality reliability while further exploiting complementary discriminative information in regions with ambiguous modality preference is key to constructing effective multimodal representations. Based on this insight, we propose ReDiffNet, a reliability-conditioned differential representation network in which modality reliability guides both evidence selection and complementary recovery. Specifically, degradation-aware reliability learning estimates relative spatial reliability, uncertainty-guided differential recovery exploits cross-modal differences to recover complementary cues in ambiguous regions, and reliability-conditioned reconstruction integrates retained and recovered evidence into a unified representation. ReDiffNet achieves 85.3% and 73.9% mAP50 on DroneVehicle and VEDAI, respectively, supporting its effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReDiffNet 用可靠性条件化的差分表征做低光照无人机 RGB-红外定向小车辆检测：先由 degradation-aware reliability learning 估计逐空间的模态相对可靠性，再用 uncertainty-guided differential recovery 在模态偏好模糊区域借跨模态差异补回互补线索，最后 reliability-conditioned reconstruction 把保留与恢复的证据合成统一表征。在 DroneVehicle 上取得 85.3% mAP50，VEDAI 上 73.9% mAP50。
Motivation: 低光照下光照变化、车灯眩光、局部阴影与热响应退化使 RGB 与红外的可靠性随空间变化，车辆视觉面积小又进一步削弱边界与方向线索，直接融合两种模态会把不可靠观测当成有效证据。

papers.title: Discrete Action Matching: Learning Stochastic Dynamics from Samples via State Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Learning population dynamics from unpaired temporal marginals is an ill-posed inverse problem that requires structural assumptions on the underlying dynamics. We introduce $\textit{Discrete Action Matching}$ (DAM), a finite-state counterpart of Action Matching based on discrete Wasserstein geometry. For a prescribed marginal path and transport geometry, we derive an action-minimization objective for its canonical minimum-kinetic-energy current. Our key observation is that the density dependence of the discrete action reduces to neighboring density ratios. Along an empirical interpolation of the snapshots, DAM first estimates these ratios and then learns an action potential. The learned fields also define a graph-supported Markov sampler. Experiments on controlled synthetic dynamics and real mouse gastrulation data evaluate marginal reconstruction and interpolation. Additional experiments approximate numerical surface-transport paths from paired samples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Discrete Action Matching (DAM)，把连续 Action Matching 移植到离散 Wasserstein 几何上：在给定边缘路径与输运几何下推导最小动能流的作用量最小化目标，并发现离散作用量的密度依赖只归结为相邻密度比。沿快照的经验插值先估计这些密度比再学 action potential，学得的场同时定义图支撑的 Markov 采样器；在受控合成动力学与真实小鼠原肠胚 (mouse gastrulation) 数据上评估边缘重建与插值，并用配对样本逼近数值表面输运路径。
Motivation: 从不配对的时间边缘分布学习群体动力学是不适定的逆问题，必须对底层动力学施加结构性假设；连续 Action Matching 缺少有限状态版本。
Method: DAM 以离散 Wasserstein 几何为基础，对给定边缘路径推导其 canonical 最小动能流的作用量最小化目标；关键化简是把离散作用量的密度依赖归约为相邻密度比。沿快照经验插值先估计密度比，再学习 action potential，学习到的场定义图支撑的 Markov 采样器。
Result: 在受控合成动力学与真实小鼠原肠胚数据上评估边缘重建与插值；另用配对样本做实验以逼近数值表面输运路径 (surface-transport paths)。
Conclusion: 离散作用量的密度依赖可化为相邻密度比，使不配对边缘下的随机动力学学习在有限状态上可操作，并顺带给出图支撑的 Markov 采样器。

papers.title: Outcome-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides denser token-level supervision and better computational efficiency than Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). However, this denser supervision may introduce substantial noise and training instability. Existing improvements often rely on high-variance per-token statistics and introduce extra hyperparameters and trade-offs. Based on the advantage formulation in RLVR, we analyze the OPSD objective from the same perspective, incorporating outcome correctness signals. We find that vanilla OPSD imposes insufficient penalties and excessive rewards on incorrect trajectories because it applies a fixed divergence objective regardless of outcome correctness. Furthermore, the reliability of teacher supervision is associated with both trajectory outcome and the cumulative average teacher entropy along the rollout. Based on these observations, we propose Outcome-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation (OG-OPSD), which dynamically adapts both the divergence objective and distillation position according to binary outcome rewards and the cumulative average teacher entropy. Extensive experiments show that OG-OPSD consistently improves the performance of vanilla OPSD and multiple strong baselines in mathematical reasoning, multimodal reasoning, and out-of-distribution tasks across Qwen3 models at 1.7B, 4B, and 8B scales, as well as Qwen3-VL-2B.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OG-OPSD 把结果正确性信号引入 on-policy self-distillation：vanilla OPSD 对错误轨迹惩罚不足、奖励过度，因为它无论结果对错都用同一散度目标。新方法按二元结果奖励与沿 rollout 的累计平均 teacher 熵，动态调整散度目标与蒸馏位置，在 Qwen3 1.7B/4B/8B 与 Qwen3-VL-2B 上于数学推理、多模态推理和分布外任务中一致优于 vanilla OPSD 与多个强基线。
Motivation: OPSD 比 RLVR 提供更稠密的 token 级监督且计算效率更高，但稠密监督带来噪声与训练不稳定；现有改进依赖高方差的 per-token 统计量并引入额外超参数与权衡。
Method: 从 RLVR 的 advantage 形式出发重新刻画 OPSD 目标并纳入结果正确性信号；依据二元结果奖励与沿 rollout 的累计平均 teacher 熵，动态调整散度目标与蒸馏位置，以纠正对错误轨迹的惩罚不足与奖励过度。
Result: 在数学推理、多模态推理与分布外任务上，OG-OPSD 一致优于 vanilla OPSD 及多个强基线，覆盖 Qwen3 1.7B、4B、8B 三种规模和 Qwen3-VL-2B。
Conclusion: 结果正确性与 teacher 熵共同决定教师监督的可靠性，据此自适应散度目标和蒸馏位置可在多个规模与任务上稳定提升 OPSD。

papers.title: Salvation Lies Within: Eliciting Inherent Style Transfer in Step-Distilled Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Adapting step-distilled text-to-image (T2I) models through post-training incurs additional computational costs and affects native few-step generation behavior. This motivates a complementary route beyond style-specific adaptation: drawing on the visual knowledge already encoded in step-distilled T2I models to elicit stylistic capabilities through language. Pursuing this direction requires textual guidance that captures how visual attributes jointly define a style and remain applicable as the depicted content changes. To explore this approach, we introduce StyleForge, a fully automatic, training-free framework that expresses reference styles as reusable rendering instructions. By integrating overall rendering characteristics with local color and lighting behavior, StyleForge organizes visual evidence from reference images into a coherent specification of how the target style should be expressed. The specification is then compiled into textual guidance that can be reused across content prompts, enabling frozen step-distilled T2I models to render different subjects and scenes in the reference style while retaining native few-step generation. Extensive experiments show relative gains of up to 29.47\% in generation quality scores over the strongest baseline, while Pareto analysis indicates that improved stylization is accompanied by strong adherence to the requested content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StyleForge 是一个全自动、免训练的框架，把参考风格编译成可复用的渲染指令文本，直接激发步蒸馏 (step-distilled) 文本到图像模型的内在风格迁移能力，无需后训练。生成质量分数相对最强基线最高提升 29.47%，Pareto 分析显示风格化增强同时保持对请求内容的强依从性。
Motivation: 对步蒸馏 T2I 模型做风格特定后训练会带来额外算力开销，并影响其原生少步生成行为，因此需要一条不改权重、仅靠语言引导的替代路径。
Method: StyleForge 将参考风格表达为可复用的渲染指令：整合整体渲染特征与局部色彩、光照行为，把参考图像的视觉证据组织成目标风格的连贯规范，再编译为可跨内容 prompt 复用的文本引导，驱动冻结的步蒸馏 T2I 模型。
Result: 生成质量分数相对最强基线最高提升 29.47%；Pareto 分析表明风格化提升的同时对所请求内容保持强依从性。
Conclusion: 步蒸馏 T2I 模型已编码的视觉知识可通过语言引导被激发出来，在保持原生少步生成的前提下实现跨内容、跨场景的风格渲染，无需后训练。

papers.title: Revealing After Overwriting: An Exponential POMDP OPE Lower Bound under History-Dependent Logging
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step revealing can make off-policy evaluation tractable under memoryless logging. With history-dependent logging, state decodability and target-relevant evidence can separate. For every horizon $H\ge3$, we construct two exactly realizable POMDPs with four actions, at most four states per layer, a known logger, and a memoryless target. Action overlap, history coverage, and observation-only revealing remain bounded independently of $H$, yet the target values differ by $1/2$ and the KL divergence between the logged laws is $Θ(4^{-(H-1)})$, forcing exponential sample complexity. Logger memory makes states distinguishable, while reset erases the model-distinguishing evidence preserved by the target. A separate construction retains this barrier with common, known observation-only revealing operators. Under action and history coverage, we give a finite-class OPE guarantee using common observable value representations that remain valid at every history. The sample bound depends polynomially on their second-moment cost. In the common-operator construction, the same value direction has constant marginal decoding cost but exponential history-conditioned cost. Finally, on a fixed four-action continuum, we derive matching passive and budgeted readout rates. With one known channel and unit read cost, early reads are optimal. With unknown sensor bias, early reads alone remain exponentially costly. Combining them with post-reset calibration gives sample complexity independent of $H$ when both read types receive fixed positive expected budgets per trajectory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在历史依赖记录 (history-dependent logging) 下，多步 revealing 的 OPE 会遭遇指数难：作者对任意 H≥3 构造两个可精确实现的四动作 POMDP（每层至多四状态、logger 已知、target 无记忆），动作重叠、历史覆盖与 observation-only revealing 都与 H 无关地有界，但目标值相差 1/2、记录分布 KL 为 Θ(4^{-(H-1)})，迫使样本复杂度指数增长。结论是：单靠早期读出在未知传感器偏差下仍指数昂贵，只有把早期读出与 reset 后校准 (post-reset calibration) 结合、且两类读出每条轨迹都有固定正预算，样本复杂度才与 H 无关。
Motivation: 多步 revealing 只在无记忆记录下让 OPE 可处理；一旦 logger 有历史依赖，状态可解码性与 target 相关证据会分离，现有覆盖条件不足以阻止指数样本复杂度。
Method: 对每个 H≥3 显式构造两个 exactly realizable 的 POMDP（四动作、每层至多四状态、已知 logger、无记忆 target），使 action overlap、history coverage、observation-only revealing 都与 H 无关地有界；另给一个保留该障碍的 common known observation-only revealing 构造。在 action/history 覆盖下，用 common observable value representations 给出有限类 OPE 保证，样本界对其二阶矩代价多项式；并在固定四动作连续统上推导 passive 与 budgeted readout 的匹配速率。
Result: 两 POMDP 目标值差 1/2，记录律 KL 为 Θ(4^{-(H-1)})，从而强制指数样本复杂度；同一 value direction 在 common-operator 构造中 marginal decoding cost 为常数而 history-conditioned cost 为指数。读出速率方面：已知单通道、单位读取代价时早期读出最优；未知传感器偏差时仅早期读出仍指数昂贵；两类读出各获固定正期望预算时，样本复杂度与 H 无关。
Conclusion: 历史依赖记录下，覆盖与 revealing 有界并不足以保证 OPE 高效，指数障碍来自 logger 记忆抹掉而 target 保留的模型区分证据；跨越该障碍需要早期读出与 reset 后校准的组合预算。

papers.title: Why, Where, How: Taxonomy-guided Error Grounding for Code Repair in NL2SQL
papers.abstract_en: SQL queries that large language models write from natural language questions can execute successfully yet produce incorrect results, so execution alone does not reveal what to fix. An error taxonomy says why the query is wrong, but not where to look or how to change it. Existing methods can guide SQL correction through feedback, error reports, or generated plans alongside an unmasked query. We introduce TEG(Taxonomy-guided Error Grounding), which turns a supplied diagnosis into a structured correction input for natural language-to-SQL (NL2SQL) correction. Type-specific rules map each error type to construct classes to reconsider and an edit operation to request. TEG masks the selected constructs in the query when applicable and states that operation in an edit instruction. TEG generates candidate corrections from this input, uses execution feedback to guide candidate selection, and repeats the process one annotation at a time for queries with several errors. On NL2SQL-BUGs, TEG reaches 47.3 single-error execution accuracy and 37.0 overall with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Across the model sizes and thinking modes evaluated in the main comparison, TEG outperforms all evaluated baselines on single-error queries, even when the baselines receive the same error-type annotations. With predicted types, TEG stays above direct LLM correction and ErrorLLM on single-error queries.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: LLM 生成的 NL2SQL 查询可能执行成功却返回错误结果，执行本身无法定位该改什么；已有错误分类只说明错在为什么，不指出改哪里、怎么改。
Method: TEG 用类型专属规则把每种错误映射到需重新考虑的构造类与一个编辑操作，在适用时掩码查询中选中构造并写入编辑指令；由该输入生成候选修正，用执行反馈挑选，多错误查询按每次一条标注重复该流程。
Result: 在 NL2SQL-BUGs 上，TEG 配 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的单错误执行准确率 47.3、整体 37.0；在主对比覆盖的模型规模与思考模式下，单错误查询上超过全部被评测基线（含获得相同错误类型标注的基线）；使用预测类型时，单错误查询上仍高于直接 LLM 修正与 ErrorLLM。
Conclusion: 把错误类型诊断落成掩码构造加编辑指令的结构化修正输入，比只给反馈、错误报告或计划的修正方式更能利用同一批类型标注，且在预测类型下依然有效。

papers.title: A Statistical Inference Framework for PMI Estimation and SGNS Word Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) is a core measure of testing word association, and Skip-gram with Negative Sampling (SGNS) is essentially a method that implicitly factorizes a shifted PMI matrix. However, a systematic and well-rounded characterization of finite-sample uncertainty in PMI estimation remains absent and imperative to venture into. We provide a statistical framework for PMI estimation and its connection to SGNS. We prove consistency, asymptotic unbiasedness, and asymptotic normality of the empirical PMI estimator, derive its variance via the Delta method, and, applying stochastic approximation theory, obtain a variance decomposition for SGNS-based PMI estimation that separates data variance from optimization variance. Simulation experiments validate the Delta method approximation. Real-data experiments on the Brown Corpus (d = 100) reveal that SGNS systematically deviates from the theoretical relationship PMI + log K. The empirical relationship shows an attenuated PMI coefficient, an amplified log K effect, and a positive intercept, indicating systematic bias. Word analogy validation confirms the models are effective. The failure to validate the variance decomposition under low-dimensional conditions does not diminish its theoretical value; rather, it identifies the unbiasedness assumption as the key bottleneck and clarifies the gap between asymptotic theory and practice, providing implications for both practice and theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为 PMI 估计与 SGNS 词嵌入建立统计推断框架：证明经验 PMI 估计量的一致性、渐近无偏性与渐近正态性，用 Delta 方法导出方差，并基于随机逼近理论把 SGNS 的 PMI 估计方差分解为数据方差与优化方差。Brown Corpus (d=100) 上 SGNS 系统偏离理论关系 PMI + log K，表现为 PMI 系数衰减、log K 效应放大、截距为正，即存在系统性偏差。
Motivation: PMI 是词关联检验的核心度量，SGNS 本质上是对平移 PMI 矩阵的隐式分解，但 PMI 估计的有限样本不确定性一直缺少系统刻画。
Method: 对经验 PMI 估计量证明一致性、渐近无偏性与渐近正态性，用 Delta 方法推导方差；再用随机逼近 (stochastic approximation) 理论给出 SGNS 版 PMI 估计的方差分解，把数据方差与优化方差分开；辅以模拟实验与 Brown Corpus 真实数据实验。
Result: 模拟实验验证了 Delta 方法的方差近似；Brown Corpus (d=100) 实验显示 SGNS 系统偏离理论关系 PMI + log K，经验关系呈 PMI 系数衰减、log K 效应放大、正截距，指示系统性偏差；word analogy 验证确认模型有效；低维条件下方差分解未能通过验证。
Conclusion: 低维验证失败把无偏性假设指认为关键瓶颈，划清了渐近理论与实践之间的差距；方差分解本身仍具理论价值，对实践与理论均有含义。

papers.title: CoDG-Net: Structure-Guided Style Diffusion and Collaborative Learning to Mitigate Catastrophic Forgetting in Medical Image Domain Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Domain Generalization (DG) for medical image segmentation is both highly challenging and critically important. However, existing medical DG methods largely overlook the issue of Catastrophic Forgetting (CF): \textbf{Models often sacrifice their ability to retain source-domain knowledge while pursuing cross-domain robustness.} This can directly threaten diagnostic safety in already-deployed clinical scenarios. To address this, we investigate data augmentation strategies and catastrophic forgetting for medical image DG segmentation. First, we propose a structure-guided style diffusion augmentation method. Constrained by anatomical structure consistency in the frequency domain, this method performs cross-domain diffusion on the amplitude spectrum, generating samples with more diverse and broader style coverage to better support domain generalization. Then, we design a collaborative learning network with a dual-branch interactive architecture (CoDG-Net), together with a novel learning bias-guided strategy that adaptively regulates knowledge transfer at both the layer level and the task level, thereby effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting on the source domain. Experiments and ablation studies on single-source and multi-source medical DG benchmark datasets demonstrate that CoDG-Net not only outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in target-domain segmentation performance, but also achieves a lower forgetting rate on the source-domain data. The code is available at: https://github.com/wangprocess/CoDG-Net.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoDG-Net 针对医学图像分割的域泛化 (DG) 中灾难性遗忘 (Catastrophic Forgetting) 问题：先用受频域解剖结构一致性约束的结构引导风格扩散 (structure-guided style diffusion) 做跨域幅度谱扩散增广，再用双分支交互的协同学习网络配合学习偏置引导策略，在层与任务两个层面自适应调节知识迁移。在单源与多源医学 DG 基准上，目标域分割性能超过现有 SOTA，同时源域遗忘率更低。
Motivation: 现有医学 DG 方法在追求跨域鲁棒性时牺牲源域知识保持，已部署临床场景中这直接威胁诊断安全。
Method: 结构引导风格扩散增广：在频域对幅度谱做受解剖结构一致性约束的跨域扩散，生成风格覆盖更广的样本；CoDG-Net 采用双分支交互架构的协同学习网络，配合 learning bias-guided 策略在层级别与任务级别自适应调节知识迁移。
Result: 在单源与多源医学 DG 基准数据集的实验与消融中，CoDG-Net 在目标域分割性能上超过现有 SOTA 方法，同时在源域数据上取得更低的遗忘率。
Conclusion: 把结构约束的风格扩散增广与层/任务两级知识迁移调控结合，可在提升跨域分割性能的同时抑制源域灾难性遗忘。

papers.title: LogSig-SSM: Time-Series Modelling with Multi-Scale Log-Signature Compression for State-Space Models
papers.abstract_en: Time-series data are often sampled irregularly at high frequencies and exhibit long-range dependencies, which makes long-horizon modelling difficult. Continuous-time models such as neural controlled differential equations (NCDEs) and neural rough differential equations (NRDEs) can handle irregular sampling, but they scale poorly to long sequences. Selective state-space models (SSMs) such as Mamba scale linearly with sequence length, but they provide limited recurrent mixing across hidden dimensions within a single block. We propose LogSig-SSM (Log-Signature Compression for State-Space Models), which first compresses long multivariate time series into a shorter sequence of tokens using multi-scale windowed log-signatures, and then processes these tokens with a selective SSM backbone. LogSig-SSM is scalable and robust to irregular sampling, combining log-signature tokens that capture higher-order cross-channel interactions with a selective SSM that models long-range dependencies. The model also admits a continuous-time interpretation as an NCDE/NRDE-style system driven by a log-signature-based input, in which selectivity induces an input-dependent rescaling of the latent dynamics. Across four benchmarks, namely long-sequence classification on UEA, high-frequency physiological regression on PPG-DaLiA, multivariate weather forecasting, and irregularly sampled clinical prediction on PhysioNet Sepsis, LogSig-SSM outperforms or matches strong SSM and continuous-time baselines while training up to $30\times$ faster and using up to $37\times$ less GPU memory than Mamba on the longest sequences.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, 2 figures, 15 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LogSig-SSM 先用多尺度窗口 log-signature 把长多变量时间序列压缩成短 token 序列，再交给 selective SSM (Mamba 类) 主干建模，从而在保持对不规则采样鲁棒的同时把训练开销压下来。在 UEA 长序列分类、PPG-DaLiA 高频生理回归、多变量天气预报、PhysioNet Sepsis 不规则临床预测四个基准上，它追平或超过强 SSM 与连续时间基线，最长序列上训练比 Mamba 快至 30×、GPU 显存省至 37×。
Motivation: NCDE/NRDE 能处理不规则采样但长序列上扩展性差；Mamba 等 selective SSM 随序列长度线性扩展，却在单个 block 内跨隐藏维度的循环混合有限，长程建模受限。
Method: 两段式：多尺度窗口 log-signature 先把长多变量序列压成较短 token 序列（log-signature token 捕获高阶跨通道交互），再用 selective SSM 主干处理这些 token 建长程依赖；模型还给出 NCDE/NRDE 式连续时间解释，selectivity 表现为对隐状态动力学的输入依赖重缩放。
Result: 在四个基准上（UEA 长序列分类、PPG-DaLiA 高频生理回归、多变量天气预报、PhysioNet Sepsis 不规则采样临床预测）追平或超过强 SSM 与连续时间基线；最长序列上训练速度比 Mamba 快至 30×，GPU 显存占用少至 37×。
Conclusion: log-signature 压缩加 selective SSM 是长程、不规则采样时间序列的可扩展建模路径：在天气预报等多变量任务上达到或超过连续时间模型，同时把训练成本降一个量级。
