papers.title: E$^2$-OPSD: Taming Entropy Overshoot in On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides dense token-level supervision without a second model: one network acts as teacher with the reference solution and as student with only the problem. We identify a specific failure mode of this recipe. During training, student token entropy rises past the teacher's and remains elevated, a pattern we call entropy overshoot. We trace it to both sides of distillation. The reference-conditioned teacher is confident along its answer-directed reasoning path, but this confidence transfers poorly to student-generated prefixes, making its supervision overly tied to answer-specific cues rather than reusable reasoning patterns; meanwhile, the forward KL used by OPSD continually diffuses the student's predictive distribution without pulling it back. We introduce E$^2$-OPSD to address both causes. Exemplar-guided teaching replaces the current answer with a retrieved solved neighboring problem, providing transferable reasoning guidance without revealing the destination and better matching student-reachable states. Entropy-aware distillation uses the student-teacher entropy gap to determine the direction and strength of each token's correction. E$^2$-OPSD improves math reasoning by up to 4.3 points in mean@16 over OPSD, while out-of-domain evaluations show gains over the corresponding base models of up to 4.9 points in mean@16 and 5.5 points in pass@8. Despite these gains, E$^2$-OPSD remains simple, requiring no additional forward passes or networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: E²-OPSD 诊断出 on-policy 自蒸馏 (OPSD) 的熵超调 (entropy overshoot)：学生 token 熵升到超过教师并持续偏高，因为参考条件化的教师置信只沿其答案路径成立、迁移到学生前缀很差，而 forward KL 只持续扩散学生分布不往回拉。改用检索到的已解相邻题做 exemplar-guided teaching、并用师生熵差决定每个 token 修正方向与强度后，数学推理 mean@16 比 OPSD 最多高 4.3 点。
Motivation: OPSD 让同一网络以带参考解的身份当教师、只带题目的身份当学生，省掉第二个模型，但训练中学生 token 熵会越过教师并保持偏高，监督被绑在答案特异线索上而非可复用推理模式。
Method: 两路修复：exemplar-guided teaching 用检索到的已解相邻题替换当前答案，给出不泄露终点、且更贴近学生可达状态的推理引导；entropy-aware distillation 用师生熵差决定每个 token 修正的方向与强度，替代单向扩散的 forward KL。
Result: 数学推理 mean@16 相对 OPSD 最多提升 4.3 点；跨域评测相对对应 base model 最多提升 4.9 点（mean@16）与 5.5 点（pass@8）；不引入额外前向传播或网络。
Conclusion: 熵超调的两个来源——教师置信不可迁移与 forward KL 单向扩散——可以分别用检索式示例教学和熵感知蒸馏对冲，且在不增加推理开销的前提下拿到这些增益。

summary_sections.method: 两路修复：exemplar-guided teaching 用检索到的已解相邻题替换当前答案，给出不泄露终点、且更贴近学生可达状态的推理引导；entropy-aware distillation 用师生熵差决定每个 token 修正的方向与强度，替代单向扩散的 forward KL。
summary_sections.result: 数学推理 mean@16 相对 OPSD 最多提升 4.3 点；跨域评测相对对应 base model 最多提升 4.9 点（mean@16）与 5.5 点（pass@8）；不引入额外前向传播或网络。
summary_sections.conclusion: 熵超调的两个来源——教师置信不可迁移与 forward KL 单向扩散——可以分别用检索式示例教学和熵感知蒸馏对冲，且在不增加推理开销的前提下拿到这些增益。

papers.title: AraYoungVoices: A Diverse L1/L2 Corpus of Arabic Child and Adolescent Speech
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art ASR systems primarily target native adult speech, leading to substantial performance gaps for children, adolescents, and L2 speakers. We introduce AraYoungVoices, a 151.72-hour Arabic read-speech corpus from 286 speakers aged 7--18, comprising AraKids (7--12) and AraTeens (13--18). The corpus includes 146 native Arabic (L1) and 140 second-language (L2) speakers, with native speakers spanning Egyptian, Gulf, Levantine, and North African dialectal backgrounds and L2 speakers representing diverse linguistic backgrounds across the Americas, Asia, Africa, and Europe. We benchmark four pretrained ASR models under zero-shot and fine-tuned settings using unseen-speaker-$\&$-unseen-prompt (USUP) and unseen-speaker-$\&$-seen-prompt (USSP) evaluations. Results show that L2 speech remains substantially more challenging than L1 speech, with the largest errors observed mainly for younger L2 speakers. Age-specific fine-tuning improves the matched age group, while joint fine-tuning provides a stronger balance across populations. ASR hypotheses are also consistently closer to the standard reading prompt than to the verbatim transcription, particularly for L2 speech, suggesting partial normalization of reading deviations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AraYoungVoices 是 151.72 小时、286 名 7–18 岁说话人的阿拉伯语儿童与青少年朗读语音语料，含 AraKids（7–12）与 AraTeens（13–18），146 名 L1 与 140 名 L2 说话人。在 zero-shot 与微调两种设置、USUP 与 USSP 两种评测下，L2 语音明显比 L1 难，错误集中在低龄 L2；按年龄段微调只改善对应人群，联合微调在各人群间平衡更好。
Motivation: 现有 ASR 主要面向母语成人语音，对儿童、青少年和 L2 说话人存在明显性能差距，缺少覆盖这些人群的阿拉伯语资源。
Method: 构建 151.72 小时阿拉伯语朗读语料，按年龄分为 AraKids（7–12）与 AraTeens（13–18），按母语分为 146 名 L1（埃及、海湾、黎凡特、北非方言）与 140 名 L2（覆盖美洲、亚洲、非洲、欧洲语言背景）；用四个预训练 ASR 模型在 zero-shot 与 fine-tuned 设置下做基准，评测协议为 unseen-speaker-&-unseen-prompt (USUP) 与 unseen-speaker-&-seen-prompt (USSP)。
Result: L2 语音显著难于 L1，最大错误主要出现在低龄 L2 说话人；按年龄段微调提升该年龄段表现，联合微调在各人群间取得更强平衡；ASR 假设与标准朗读提示词的一致度始终高于逐字转写，L2 语音尤其如此，说明模型部分归一化了朗读偏差。
Conclusion: 儿童与 L2 语音的 ASR 差距需要按年龄与语言背景分别处理，联合微调比按年龄段单独微调更能兼顾全体人群；ASR 输出会把朗读偏差向标准提示词归一化。

papers.title: CI-JEPA: A Counterfactual Analysis of Latent Representations in Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures for Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised visual representation learning learns useful features without manual annotations during representation training. The image-based joint-embedding predictive architecture (I-JEPA) predicts latent representations of masked image regions, but its objective does not explicitly model responses to specified visual interventions. We introduce CI-JEPA, a counterfactual intervention-aware extension that learns to predict the representation change $ΔZ = Z_{\mathrm{CF}} - Z$ between an original image and a modified counterpart. We assess representation robustness through selective sensitivity: stronger responses to task-relevant semantic changes than to nuisance changes. Experiments on Flowers102 use flower-center occlusion as a candidate semantic intervention and background blur and tint as candidate nuisance interventions. With frozen-encoder linear probing, CI-JEPA achieves a best validation accuracy of 78.14\%, compared with 77.55\% for both the pretrained ViT-B/16 and the I-JEPA baseline, a gain of 0.59 percentage points. The reported mean $L_2$ representation changes are 4.42 for center occlusion, 3.48 for background tint, and 2.83 for background blur. This ordering is consistent with relative semantic selectivity for the evaluated interventions, rather than complete nuisance invariance. The accuracy comparison is complementary and does not establish improved robustness over the baselines. These controlled image modifications provide a framework for studying intervention-induced changes in JEPA representations; they do not establish causal feature discovery or robustness to all visual changes.
papers.comment: This article has been accepted for the International Symposium on Smart Systems, Algorithms & Applications 2026 (IS3A3 2026), Tezpur Central University, India
papers.journal_ref: International Symposium on Smart Systems, Algorithms & Applications 2026 (IS3A3 2026), Tezpur Central University, India
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CI-JEPA 在 I-JEPA 上加反事实干预项，预测原图与干预图之间的隐表示变化 ΔZ = Z_CF − Z，并用选择性敏感度衡量表示对语义干预的响应强于对干扰干预的响应。在 Flowers102 上以花朵中心遮挡为语义干预、背景模糊与着色为干扰干预，冻结编码器线性探测最佳验证准确率 78.14%，高于预训练 ViT-B/16 与 I-JEPA 基线的 77.55%，提升 0.59 个百分点。
Motivation: I-JEPA 的目标只预测被掩码区域的隐表示，不显式建模表示对指定视觉干预的响应，因而难以刻画表示的选择性敏感度。
Method: 提出反事实干预感知扩展 CI-JEPA，学习预测原图与修改图之间的表示变化 ΔZ = Z_CF − Z；用选择性敏感度评估表示鲁棒性，即对任务相关语义变化的响应强于对干扰变化的响应。实验在 Flowers102 上进行，花朵中心遮挡作为语义干预，背景模糊与着色作为干扰干预，采用冻结编码器的线性探测 (linear probing)。
Result: 冻结编码器线性探测最佳验证准确率 78.14%，预训练 ViT-B/16 与 I-JEPA 基线均为 77.55%，提升 0.59 个百分点。平均 L2 表示变化为：中心遮挡 4.42、背景着色 3.48、背景模糊 2.83，该排序与所评估干预的相对语义选择性一致，而非完全的干扰不变性。
Conclusion: 作者指出准确率比较是补充性的，并未确立相对基线的更强鲁棒性；这些受控图像修改提供研究 JEPA 表示干预诱导变化的框架，但不构成因果特征发现或对所有视觉变化的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Communication Shapes Collective Inference in Self-Adapting LLM Societies: Evidence from Mafia
papers.abstract_en: When does communication help a group identify hidden adversaries, and how does its value change as the group adapts? In Mafia, an informed minority hides inside an uninformed majority whose only evidence is open play. The zero-information game, where each day's vote eliminates a random player, is exactly solved and scores every society; matched-casting comparisons between protocols identify the effect of communication. Societies of 8-100 claude-haiku-4-5 agents (7,416 analyzed games, 1.9M model calls) adapt by rewriting and inheriting private strategy notes. Simultaneous broadcast improves adversary identification over silence in all nine compositions tested (8-46 players). Turn-taking removes most of this advantage; its voting landslides are as frequent as broadcast's but land on mafia near chance (1.08x versus 2.53x). At 70 players, agents reading eight statements per day identify adversaries worse than silent ones, and limited talk is worth less than at 46 players. Adaptation is fast but need not help. In their first broadcast games, citizens announce their role far more often than mafia (91% vs. 30%) and first-day votes find mafia at three times chance; within two generations citizens stop announcing and the cue fades, a change the inherited notes carry. In controlled redeployments at 16 players, societies carrying sixty generations of their own notes score below societies with none. Communication shapes both collective inference and the signals it depends on, so a protocol's value must be measured together with the adaptation that changes those signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Mafia 隐藏对手推理任务中，同步广播 (simultaneous broadcast) 在全部九种规模（8–46 人）上都比沉默更能识别对手，而轮流发言 (turn-taking) 几乎抹掉这一优势：投票压倒性指向黑手党的频率与广播相当（1.08x vs 2.53x 机会水平），但落点接近随机。70 人时每天读八条发言反而比沉默更差。策略笔记的代际传承会让早期信号（市民 91% vs 黑手帇 30% 公开身份）在两代内消失，携带 60 代笔记的社会在 16 人重部署中得分低于无笔记社会。
Motivation: 群体何时该通信、通信价值如何随社会自适应而变化，缺少可分离通信效应的对照框架；在 Mafia 这种只有公开对局信息的隐藏对手场景中，通信既帮助推理也可能被适应过程反噬。
Method: 用 claude-haiku-4-5 智能体在 8–100 人规模的 Mafia 中运行 7,416 局、190 万次模型调用；先精确求解零信息博弈（每天随机淘汰一人）作为评分社会的基准，再用 matched-casting 对比不同协议以分离通信效应；社会通过改写并继承私有策略笔记自适应，并在 16 人规模做受控重部署。
Result: 同步广播在全部九种组合（8–46 人）上都提升对手识别；轮流发言使压倒性投票频率与广播相当但落点接近随机（1.08x vs 2.53x）；70 人时每天读八条发言的识别率低于沉默组，且 46 人时的有限发言价值在 70 人时更低。首局广播中市民公开身份比例 91%、黑手党 30%，首日投票找到黑手党的概率为机会水平的 3 倍；两代之内市民停止公开、信号消失。16 人重部署中，携带 60 代笔记的社会得分低于无笔记社会。
Conclusion: 通信协议的价值必须与改变信号本身的适应过程一起测量：广播有效，但自适应会侵蚀它所依赖的线索，快速适应未必提升集体推理。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Calibrated Weak Supervision for Post-Harvest Burned-Cropland Mapping Under Label Scarcity
papers.abstract_en: Mapping post-harvest burned cropland is difficult when fires are small and fragmented and reliable labels are scarce. We developed a calibrated weak-supervision framework for Punjab, India, using Sentinel-2 spectral change, VIIRS active-fire context, and MODIS MCD64A1 as a coarse external calibration and agreement reference. Three pseudo-label recipes, five feature representations, and linear, tree-based, boosted, and neural classifiers were evaluated using nested district-held-out cross-validation over three seeds and five folds. NBR and dNBR were excluded from classifier inputs. The best configuration used the very-strict recipe, a multilayer perceptron, and the full optical feature set (mean Cohen's kappa 0.395, AUROC 0.753, F1 0.747, balanced accuracy 0.703); Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM were practically tied. Higher agreement with held-out pseudo-labels did not establish improved label correctness or independent burned-area accuracy. For deployment, a Random Forest with the very-strict recipe and full optical features was retained. An externally calibrated threshold of 0.60 yielded district-level MODIS agreement of R-squared 0.636, a mapped-to-MODIS burned-area ratio of 1.005, and Spearman correlation of 0.779 with district fire counts. Pixel-level MODIS agreement remained modest (F1 0.205, kappa 0.093). Zero-shot transfer to Haryana was promising (mean kappa 0.641), but Punjab cross-year stability was weak, and Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 feature concatenation did not improve the optical baseline. Optical observations ended before the seasonal fire context, limiting coverage of late burns. The framework supports district-scale burden assessment and hotspot screening, with limited support for exact scar boundaries or temporally stable annual mapping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在旁遮普标签稀缺条件下，用 Sentinel-2 光谱变化加 VIIRS 火点上下文做校准弱监督，产出烧毁农田伪标签；最佳配置为 very-strict 配方 + MLP + 全光学特征，mean Cohen's kappa 0.395、AUROC 0.753。外部校准阈值 0.60 时县级 MODIS 一致性 R² 0.636、烧毁面积比 1.005，但像素级一致性仅 F1 0.205，故该框架只支撑县级负担评估与热点筛查，不支撑精确火痕边界或跨年稳定制图。
Motivation: 收获后焚烧火点小而破碎、可靠标签稀缺，精确火痕边界与年度稳定制图难以监督学习；需要在没有像素级真值的情况下校准伪标签并量化其可信度。
Method: 以 Sentinel-2 光谱变化、VIIRS 活跃火点上下文构造三种伪标签配方（含 very-strict），MODIS MCD64A1 作粗尺度外部校准与一致性参照；比较五种特征表示与线性、树模型、boosting、神经网络分类器，用嵌套的按地区留出交叉验证（3 seeds × 5 folds）评估，NBR 与 dNBR 被排除在分类输入之外。
Result: 最佳配置（very-strict + MLP + 全光学特征）mean Cohen's kappa 0.395、AUROC 0.753、F1 0.747、balanced accuracy 0.703，Random Forest、XGBoost、LightGBM 实际持平。部署选 Random Forest + very-strict + 全光学特征，外部阈值 0.60 下县级 MODIS 一致性 R² 0.636、烧毁面积比 1.005、与县级火点数 Spearman 0.779；像素级 MODIS 一致性 F1 0.205、kappa 0.093。零样本迁移至 Haryana 的 mean kappa 0.641，但旁遮普跨年稳定性弱，Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 特征拼接未改进光学基线。
Conclusion: 与留出伪标签一致性更高并不等于标签更正确或独立烧毁面积更准；该框架适合县级负担评估与热点筛查，不支持精确边界与时间稳定年度制图，且光学观测在季节火点背景结束前截止，晚季焚烧覆盖受限。

papers.title: Optimal Oracle Complexity for Finite-Sum Monotone Inclusions
papers.abstract_en: We present an oracle-optimal method for finite-sum monotone inclusions under mean-square Lipschitz continuity. Our switching regularization method finds a point $y$ and a certificate $g\in G(y)$ with $(\mathbb{E}\|F(y)+g\|^2)^{1/2}\le\varepsilon$ using $\mathcal{O}(n+\sqrt{n}LR/\varepsilon)$ expected component evaluations and resolvent evaluations. It removes the additive $n\log n$ cost of restarting a variance-reduced solver at every regularization stage by switching to a centered stochastic proximal iteration at regularization strength $L/\sqrt{n}$. Carrying an operator estimate between the remaining stages limits their total cost to $\mathcal{O}(n)$. A matching $Ω(n+\sqrt{n}LR/\varepsilon)$ lower bound holds for randomized linear-span component-oracle algorithms with adaptive stopping and expected query budgets. Thus, for $0<\varepsilon\le LR/2$, our method attains the optimal worst-case expected component complexity in this oracle model, up to universal constants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对均方 Lipschitz 连续下的有限和单调包含 (finite-sum monotone inclusions)，提出切换正则化方法：在正则强度 L/√n 处切换到中心化随机邻近迭代，并跨阶段携带算子估计，用 O(n+√n LR/ε) 次期望分量与 resolvent 求值找到证书点 y，且在随机线性张成分量 oracle 模型下匹配 Ω(n+√n LR/ε) 下界。
Motivation: 方差缩减求解器在每个正则阶段重启会带来额外的 n log n 开销，使有限和单调包含的期望 oracle 复杂度不是最优的。
Method: 切换正则化方法：在正则强度 L/√n 处从重启的方差缩减求解器切到中心化随机邻近迭代 (centered stochastic proximal iteration)，并在剩余阶段之间携带算子估计，把各阶段总代价限制在 O(n)；下界针对带自适应停止与期望查询预算的随机线性张成分量 oracle 算法。
Result: 在 0<ε≤LR/2 时，期望分量与 resolvent 求值次数为 O(n+√n LR/ε)，并去掉每次正则阶段重启方差缩减求解器的 n log n 附加代价；匹配下界为 Ω(n+√n LR/ε)，故在该 oracle 模型下最优（差常数因子）。
Conclusion: 在均方 Lipschitz 连续与随机线性张成分量 oracle 模型下，O(n+√n LR/ε) 是有限和单调包含的最优最坏情形期望分量复杂度，切换正则化即可达到。

papers.title: SparseCraft: Agentic Hardware-Software Co-Optimization for Sparse Computing
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-accelerator design spaces are usually searched against analytical models, so a design point is admitted on what a model predicts rather than on what the hardware does. SparseCraft closes that gap with a language model inside a closed CHIA loop. In each of 15 iterations the model reads the measured outcome of the previous one and edits the Chisel RTL, the memory configuration and the sparse-kernel schedule of a Gemmini accelerator through MCP tool servers, and no candidate counts until it has been checked for legality, elaborated, simulated cycle-accurately, checked bit-for-bit on every output against a golden reference, and synthesised. The harness turns each measurement into the next work order, a diagnosed bottleneck with matching strategy guidance, the history of tried designs and a score of the model's own prediction, and a second model repairs changes that fail a gate. On a $512 \times 512$ GraphChallenge sparse-DNN layer the loop reaches 2.1x fewer cycles, 9.8x less off-chip traffic and 22.8% less area than the block-sparse Gemmini baseline, with 5.61x higher modelled perf/W and 11.8x lower EDP. The levers span three layers: a schedule that keeps the dense operand resident removes 9.8x of the traffic, a zero-gated MAC and a zero-row skip unit that the model wrote in Chisel cut energy, and resizing the memories cuts area.
papers.comment: Accepted at the A3 Workshop (Agentic Approaches to Architecture) co-located with MICRO 2026, Athens, Greece
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SparseCraft 把语言模型放进闭环 CHIA 循环，15 轮迭代中由模型读取上一轮实测结果，通过 MCP 工具服务器改写 Gemmini 加速器的 Chisel RTL、内存配置与稀疏 kernel 调度，且候选设计必须先过合法性检查、周期精确仿真、逐位 golden reference 比对与综合才被计入。在 512×512 GraphChallenge 稀疏 DNN 层上，相对 block-sparse Gemmini 基线循环达到 2.1× 更少周期、9.8× 更少片外流量、22.8% 更小面积、5.61× 更高建模 perf/W 与 11.8× 更低 EDP。
Motivation: 稀疏加速器设计空间通常只对着解析模型搜索，设计点是否被采纳取决于模型预测而非硬件实际表现，预测与实测之间存在脱节。
Method: 语言模型嵌入闭环 CHIA 循环，每轮读取上一轮实测输出，经 MCP 工具服务器编辑 Chisel RTL、内存配置与稀疏 kernel 调度；harness 把每次测量转成下一轮工单，含诊断出的瓶颈与对应策略指引、已试设计历史以及模型自身预测的得分，另一个模型负责修复未过 gate 的改动。候选必须通过合法性检查、展开、周期精确仿真、对 golden reference 的逐位输出比对与综合。
Result: 在 512×512 GraphChallenge 稀疏 DNN 层上，相对 block-sparse Gemmini 基线：周期数减少 2.1×，片外流量减少 9.8×，面积减少 22.8%，建模 perf/W 提升 5.61×，EDP 降低 11.8×。跨三层的杠杆中，让稠密操作数常驻的调度贡献了 9.8× 的流量削减，模型用 Chisel 写入的 zero-gated MAC 与 zero-row skip 单元降低能耗，内存尺寸调整削减面积。
Conclusion: 让语言模型以实测而非解析模型预测作为每轮的设计裁决，可以在稀疏加速器上同时拿到周期、流量、面积、perf/W 与 EDP 的多维收益；循环共 15 轮迭代。

papers.title: Code2Games: Enabling Coding Agents for Gaming World Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating a high-quality gaming world from a natural-language game intent requires joint reasoning about scene structure, spatial layout, gameplay objectives, interactive entities, and executable gameplay logic. Existing coding agents can generate individual assets, scenes, or scripts, but often struggle to maintain consistency across these components. We propose Code2Games, an agentic framework that builds a structured gaming world upon a base Blender world generated from the same game intent. Code2Games coordinates scene analysis, gameplay planning, constrained gaming-world generation, and gaming-engine customization through a shared scene-gameplay representation with persistent element correspondence. After world generation, Code2Games adapts the generated world to Unreal Engine 5 and employs an execution-guided reconstruction process that uses compilation diagnostics, runtime feedback, and gameplay test results to resolve inconsistencies arising during engine adaptation. To systematically evaluate gaming-world generation, we introduce the GameCode4D benchmark, which comprises ten fixed game prompts spanning different levels of scene and gameplay complexity. We evaluate the generated results across four dimensions: visual quality, interactive fidelity, multimodal artifact quality, and playable-game quality. Experiments demonstrate that, compared with direct gaming-world generation by coding agents and existing baseline methods, Code2Games consistently improves the visual quality and interactive fidelity of generated gaming worlds, as well as the quality of the resulting games after engine adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Code2Games 用共享的 scene-gameplay 表示把场景分析、玩法规划、受约束世界生成与引擎定制串成一个 agentic 框架，在同一游戏意图生成的 Blender 基础世界上保持元素持久对应，再经执行引导重建适配 Unreal Engine 5。在含 10 个固定游戏提示的 GameCode4D 基准上，它相对 coding agent 直接生成与既有基线一致提升视觉质量、交互保真度与引擎适配后的游戏质量。
Motivation: 从自然语言游戏意图生成高质量游戏世界需要同时推理场景结构、空间布局、玩法目标、交互实体与可执行逻辑，而现有 coding agent 只能生成单个资产、场景或脚本，跨组件一致性难以维持。
Method: 在由同一意图生成的 Blender 基础世界上搭建 agentic 框架，用带持久元素对应 (persistent element correspondence) 的共享 scene-gameplay 表示协调场景分析、玩法规划、受约束世界生成与游戏引擎定制；生成后适配 Unreal Engine 5，并用 compilation diagnostics、runtime feedback 与 gameplay test 结果驱动 execution-guided reconstruction 来消解适配期不一致。
Result: 提出 GameCode4D 基准，含 10 个覆盖不同场景与玩法复杂度的固定游戏提示，按视觉质量、交互保真度、多模态 artifact 质量、可玩游戏质量四个维度评测；实验显示相对 coding agent 直接生成与既有基线，Code2Games 一致提升视觉质量、交互保真度以及引擎适配后的游戏质量。
Conclusion: 以共享 scene-gameplay 表示加执行引导重建来约束生成过程，能在跨组件一致性上稳定优于直接用 coding agent 生成游戏世界，并把优势保留到 Unreal Engine 5 适配之后。

papers.title: EVISKILL: Grounding Skill Evolution in Replayable Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Continual skill evolution enables LLM agents to accumulate and refine reusable procedural knowledge from interaction experience without updating model parameters. Its effectiveness depends on determining not only what to change, but also why a change is justified and when it should become persistent guidance. However, existing experience-driven methods can lose the behavioral evidence and task contexts supporting edits. Moreover, a global validation outcome provides an incomplete judgment of its constituent changes: locally supported corrections may be discarded with a rejected revision, while evidence may require further experience to inform useful updates. To this end, we introduce EVISKILL, an evidence-driven framework that organizes execution observations into Replayable Evidence Cards and synthesizes edits with explicit links to their supporting contexts. Targeted replay verifies these edits through re-execution and provides feedback for correction. Across epochs, EVISKILL preserves evidence and provisionally retains supported edits for further refinement, while global validation governs their incorporation into the final skill. Experiments on three interactive benchmarks across six LLM backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EVISKILL 是面向 LLM agent 持续技能演化的证据驱动框架：把执行观测整理成可重放的 Replayable Evidence Cards，让每条技能编辑显式链接到支撑它的上下文，再用定向重放 (targeted replay) 重新执行来验证并修正编辑。跨 3 个交互式 benchmark、6 个 LLM backbone 的实验表明该做法有效。
Motivation: 现有经验驱动的技能编辑方法会丢失支撑编辑的行为证据与任务上下文；而全局验证 (global validation) 只给整体判定，导致局部有据的修正被一并否决，或证据尚需更多经验才能支撑有用更新。
Method: EVISKILL 将执行观测组织为 Replayable Evidence Cards，合成编辑时显式标注其支撑上下文；用 targeted replay 通过重新执行验证编辑并给出修正反馈；跨 epoch 保留证据、暂存有支撑的编辑供后续细化，最终由全局验证决定是否纳入正式技能。
Result: 在三个交互式 benchmark、六个 LLM backbone 上的实验展示了该方法的有效性（摘要未列出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 把「改什么、为何改、何时固化」拆成证据留存、重放验证与全局验证三层，可以让无参数更新的 LLM agent 技能演化更可追溯、编辑更有的放矢。

papers.title: SPACE-CLIPv2: Decoding Local Geometry from Frozen CLIP for Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language foundation models such as CLIP provide strong semantic representations, but their patch tokens are not directly optimized for dense metric geometry. SPACE-CLIP showed that frozen CLIP features can support monocular depth estimation through layer-group feature fusion, yet it leaves open how neighboring CLIP tokens should be combined to recover fine local structure. We present SPACE-CLIPv2, a frozen-backbone depth decoder that aggregates fixed local neighborhoods in CLIP token space. At selected decoder stages, the model samples a fixed token stencil, predicts aggregation weights, and injects the resulting response through a gated residual update. A token-space high-pass branch further preserves shallow local contrast. On NYU Depth V2, SPACE-CLIPv2 improves over a matched SPACE-CLIP baseline, while five-seed experiments consistently favor fixed over learned-offset sampling. Zero-shot iBims-1 evaluation further improves boundary and planar-geometry measures. These results support constrained local token aggregation as a practical mechanism for decoding geometry from frozen CLIP representations.

papers.title: GeoBridge-VLA: Geometry-Aware Residual Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models encode semantic information from vision-language pretraining, but manipulation also requires precise spatial reasoning. We present GeoBridge-VLA, a two-stage method for learning geometric features from a pretrained VLA's frozen visual encoder and using them for action prediction. Stage I trains a feature bridge and geometry decoder with depth supervision. Stage II freezes these modules and trains a gated residual interface together with the action-side projections and action expert. The residual augments the existing visual tokens without adding a second image encoder or increasing the token count. Deployment requires RGB, robot state, and language, but no depth observations. Under matched evaluation conditions, GeoBridge-VLA achieves 70.9% success on LIBERO, compared with 60.0% for SmolVLA. Disabling the residual in the same trained checkpoint reduces success from 70.90% to 69.85%, with mixed effects across suites. On a physical ROBOTIS OMY robot, GeoBridge-VLA succeeds in 148 of 200 trials (74.0%) across four tasks, compared with 108 of 200 (54.0%) for SmolVLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoBridge-VLA 用两阶段几何残差适配把预训练 VLA 冻结视觉编码器中的几何特征接到动作预测上：Stage I 以深度监督训练 feature bridge 与 geometry decoder，Stage II 冻结二者并训练 gated residual interface 与 action expert，部署只需 RGB、机器人状态与语言。LIBERO 成功率 70.9%（SmolVLA 60.0%），实体 ROBOTIS OMY 上 148/200（74.0%）对 108/200（54.0%）。
Motivation: VLA 模型从视觉-语言预训练中携带语义信息，但机器人操作需要精确的空间推理，且在不新增第二图像编码器、不增加 token 数的前提下补齐几何能力。
Method: 两阶段：Stage I 从预训练 VLA 的冻结视觉编码器训练 feature bridge 与 geometry decoder，用深度监督；Stage II 冻结这些模块，训练 gated residual interface、action-side projections 与 action expert，残差只增强已有 visual token。部署输入为 RGB、robot state 与语言，不需要深度观测。
Result: 在匹配评估条件下 LIBERO 成功率 70.9%，对比 SmolVLA 60.0%；同一训练 checkpoint 上关闭残差使成功率从 70.90% 降至 69.85%，各 suite 影响不一。实体 ROBOTIS OMY 四项任务 148/200（74.0%），SmolVLA 为 108/200（54.0%）。

papers.title: Triggering Generalist Reasoning via Predictive Uncertainty for Dual-System VLA
papers.abstract_en: Dual-system Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models improve real-time robotic control by pairing a slow, reasoning-capable generalist with a fast specialist action expert. However, existing methods invoke the generalist at a fixed frequency, ignoring the fact that decision-making complexity varies throughout a rollout. This static strategy wastes computation in easy phases and can delay renewed reasoning when the scene changes unexpectedly. We propose TUD (Triggering generalist reasoning via predictive Uncertainty for Dual-system VLA), an adaptive inference framework that selectively skips unnecessary generalist calls. TUD measures the cross-step dispersion of action re-predictions at the upcoming chunk slot under the cached generalist context, as a predictive uncertainty signal. This signal captures how much the future action plan shifts as new observations arrive and is computed from forwards the architecture already runs, requiring neither manual phase labels nor an auxiliary uncertainty model. On VLA-Arena, it achieves a higher success rate at matched call budgets than alternative uncertainty baselines while maintaining low wall-clock overhead, and more consistently separates successful from failed rollouts. Also, TUD finds a more favorable cost-success trade-off than non-adaptive baselines, tracing an entire operating curve as a single threshold is varied, and substantially reduces VLM calls at matched success rate. The same trade-off appears in our real-robot experiments, where TUD cuts generalist calls by 75% relative to the strongest fixed-interval baseline while achieving an even higher success rate. Our results suggest that predictive uncertainty provides a practical criterion for adaptive reasoning in efficient VLA control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TUD 用缓存的 generalist 上下文下，未来 chunk 槽位动作重预测的跨步离散度作为预测不确定性，自适应跳过双系统 VLA 中不必要的慢速推理调用。在 VLA-Arena 上同调用预算下成功率高于其他不确定性基线，实机上相对最强固定间隔基线削减 75% generalist 调用且成功率更高。
Motivation: 双系统 VLA 以固定频率调用慢速推理 generalist，但决策复杂度在 rollout 中变化：简单阶段浪费算力，场景突变时又延迟重新推理。
Method: TUD 在架构本就执行的前向中，测量缓存 generalist 上下文下即将到来 chunk 槽位动作重预测的跨步离散度，作为预测不确定性信号来选择性跳过 generalist 调用；无需人工阶段标签或额外不确定性模型，用单一阈值扫出整条操作曲线。
Result: 在 VLA-Arena 上，同调用预算下成功率高于其他不确定性基线，wall-clock 开销低，且更能区分成功与失败 rollout；相对非自适应基线给出更优的 cost-success 权衡，随阈值变化描出整条曲线，并在同成功率下大幅减少 VLM 调用。实机实验中相对最强固定间隔基线削减 75% generalist 调用，同时成功率更高。
Conclusion: 预测不确定性可作为高效 VLA 控制中自适应触发推理的实用判据，在匹配成功率下显著降低 VLM 调用开销。

papers.title: LightVLN: Efficient Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation with Compact Memory and History-Guided Local Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Aerial vision-and-language navigation (VLN) enables unmanned aerial vehicles to execute long-horizon natural-language instructions from visual observations in complex three-dimensional environments. However, recent aerial VLN models often rely on large-scale vision-language backbones and dense visual histories, imposing substantial computation and memory costs that hinder onboard deployment. We propose LightVLN, a lightweight history-aware aerial VLN framework that combines a compact 0.5B language backbone with compact representations of both historical and current observations. LightVLN compresses each historical frame into a single token using visual features already computed by the policy. It further introduces history- and instruction-conditioned local aggregation to reduce the current observation from 256 to 32 visual tokens while preserving navigation-relevant spatial information. With up to 16 historical frames, the policy uses at most 48 observation-derived tokens. On the public OpenFly dataset, LightVLN achieves 50.93% Test-Seen and 36.14% Test-Unseen success rates (SR), outperforming the evaluated 7B language-backbone baselines on most reported metrics. It also achieves 25.83% SR on AerialVLN-S Val-Seen. In a reconstructed unseen campus, we deploy LightVLN on a DJI M350 RTK with an external Jetson Orin NX 16 GB for closed-loop onboard-compute real-to-sim hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) evaluation, achieving 14.61 Hz model inference and 11.13 Hz end-to-end decision updates. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of LightVLN for aerial navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LightVLN 用 0.5B 语言骨干做无人机视觉-语言导航 (VLN)：每个历史帧压成 1 个 token，再用历史与指令条件化的局部聚合把当前观测从 256 个视觉 token 减到 32 个，最多 16 帧历史时策略总共只用 48 个观测 token。在 OpenFly 上 Test-Seen SR 50.93%、Test-Unseen SR 36.14%，多数指标超过所评测的 7B 骨干基线，并在 DJI M350 RTK + Jetson Orin NX 16GB 上做到 14.61 Hz 模型推理。
Motivation: 近期 aerial VLN 依赖大规模视觉-语言骨干与稠密视觉历史，计算与内存开销大，难以在无人机机载部署。
Method: LightVLN 采用 0.5B 语言骨干，把每帧历史观测压成单个 token（复用策略已算出的视觉特征），并用 history- 与 instruction-conditioned local aggregation 将当前观测从 256 个 token 降到 32 个，保留导航相关空间信息；最多容纳 16 个历史帧，策略共用不超过 48 个观测 token。
Result: 在公开 OpenFly 数据集上 Test-Seen SR 50.93%、Test-Unseen SR 36.14%，在所评测的多数指标上超过 7B 语言骨干基线；AerialVLN-S Val-Seen SR 25.83%。在重建的未见校园中以 DJI M350 RTK 搭载 Jetson Orin NX 16GB 做闭环机载算力 real-to-sim 硬件在环 (HIL) 评测，模型推理 14.61 Hz、端到端决策更新 11.13 Hz。
Conclusion: 压缩历史与当前观测 token 数即可让 0.5B 骨干的 aerial VLN 在保持竞争力成功率的同时满足机载实时决策的算力与内存约束。

papers.title: Look Where You Say You're Looking: Self-Grounded Attention for Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Self-Saliency, a method for training Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to increase the alignment between their visual attention and the image regions mentioned in their reasoning. Self-Saliency uses a grounding model to localize the objects mentioned in each reasoning step and treats the resulting areas as supervision for the model's visual attention. Previous work on steering visual attention determines target image regions based solely on the image and question. In contrast, we show that conditioning the target regions on the model's generated reasoning improves downstream performance. For proper evaluation, we build a unified, broad suite of 25 visual reasoning benchmarks, where we reproduce the results of previous methods. We find that Self-Saliency significantly outperforms both prior attention-steering methods and baselines that ground image-level text, achieving both a better average rank and a better mean score. Post-training analysis shows that the model primarily adapts its reasoning text to existing attention patterns, producing shorter steps that refer to larger regions. Nevertheless, when controlling for generated text, attention to grounded regions increases significantly across the relevant layer. Finally, we identify a consistent geometric bias in VLM visual attention toward the image border. However, our ablations show that Self-Saliency's gains cannot be explained by simply aligning attention with the center of the image, highlighting the importance of aligning visual attention with the regions mentioned in the model's reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Self-Saliency：用 grounding 模型定位推理每一步提到的物体区域，把该区域作为 VLM 视觉注意力的监督目标，且目标区域随模型生成的推理文本条件化。在统一的 25 个视觉推理基准上，Self-Saliency 的平均排名与平均分均显著优于既有注意力引导方法和图像级文本 grounding 基线；消融表明其收益不能用单纯把注意力对齐到图像中心来解释。
Motivation: 既有的视觉注意力引导方法只依据图像与问题决定目标区域，忽略了模型自身生成的推理文本，导致注意力与推理中提到的区域脱节。
Method: Self-Saliency 训练 VLM：先由 grounding 模型逐步定位推理文本提到的物体，得到区域作为注意力监督；与只看图像和问题设定目标区域的先前方法不同，目标区域以模型已生成的推理为条件。评测上构建统一的 25 个视觉推理基准套件，并复现先前方法结果。
Result: 在 25 个视觉推理基准的统一评测中，Self-Saliency 显著优于先前注意力引导方法与图像级文本 grounding 基线，取得更好的平均排名和平均分。后训练分析显示模型主要把推理文本改写为更短、指向更大区域的步骤；控制生成文本后，相关各层对 grounded 区域的注意力仍显著上升。注意力存在一致的向图像边界偏置的几何偏差。
Conclusion: 让视觉注意力对齐推理中实际提到的区域是有效的训练信号，其收益不能由简单的中心偏置解释；但模型的主要适应方式是改写推理文本以迁就既有注意力模式。

summary_sections.result: 在 25 个视觉推理基准的统一评测中，Self-Saliency 显著优于先前注意力引导方法与图像级文本 grounding 基线，取得更好的平均排名和平均分。后训练分析显示模型主要把推理文本改写为更短、指向更大区域的步骤；控制生成文本后，相关各层对 grounded 区域的注意力仍显著上升。注意力存在一致的向图像边界偏置的几何偏差。
summary_sections.conclusion: 让视觉注意力对齐推理中实际提到的区域是有效的训练信号，其收益不能由简单的中心偏置解释；但模型的主要适应方式是改写推理文本以迁就既有注意力模式。

papers.title: Operational Abstractions of Neural Network Concepts via Topological Representations
papers.abstract_en: Concept-based methods provide a semantic level for interpreting and manipulating learned representations, but existing editing approaches are typically specialized to particular interventions and do not provide a common and editable representation of concept organization. To achieve this, we introduce Topological Concept Representations (TCR), a post-hoc operational abstraction that jointly characterizes the concepts encoded in a learned representation and their relationships. TCR constructs an intermediate concept space from concept recoverability and interaction scores, and compactly encodes its organization through topology. Interventions are expressed through modifications of this abstraction that are propagated back to the underlying learned representation. This allows different concept-level operations to share the same optimization framework and separates the desired concept organization from the mechanism to achieve it. We establish stability and reparameterization-invariance properties of TCR and its connections to existing concept-editing formulations. We use TCR to disentangle concepts as a preprocessing step for existing erasure methods, improving worst-group accuracy by 21.89 on average at comparable concept leakage. We further use TCR to transfer concepts from teacher to student models, improving concept recoverability by up to 5.54 while also improving or maintaining competitive test top-1 accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Topological Concept Representations (TCR)，一种事后 (post-hoc) 概念操作抽象：由概念可恢复性 (concept recoverability) 与交互分数构建中间概念空间，用拓扑压缩其组织结构，编辑通过修改该抽象再回传到底层表示。作为预处理为既有擦除方法解耦概念，最差组准确率 (worst-group accuracy) 平均提升 21.89 且概念泄漏相当；概念在 teacher→student 迁移中可恢复性最多提升 5.54，同时保持有竞争力的 test top-1。
Motivation: 现有概念编辑方法各自绑定特定干预，缺少一个可编辑、能统一表示概念组织的公共抽象，不同操作无法共享同一优化框架。
Method: TCR 从 concept recoverability 与 interaction scores 构造中间概念空间，以拓扑紧凑编码其组织；干预即对该抽象做修改并传播回学习表示，使不同概念级操作共用同一优化框架。作者证明 TCR 的稳定性与重参数化不变性 (reparameterization-invariance)，并给出与既有概念编辑形式的联系。
Result: 作为预处理配合既有擦除方法，worst-group accuracy 平均提升 21.89，且 concept leakage 相当；用于 teacher→student 概念迁移时 concept recoverability 最多提升 5.54，同时 test top-1 accuracy 改善或保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 把概念组织与实现干预的机制分离成一个可编辑的拓扑抽象，可同时支撑解耦擦除与跨模型概念迁移两类操作。

papers.title: MetaKernelBench: Measuring GPU Kernel Knowledge Transfer Beyond Code
papers.abstract_en: Recent GPU kernel optimization agents retain what they learn in knowledge bases or as distilled skills. Kernel benchmarks score each attempt's implementation for correctness and speed but leave the reuse value of retained experience unmeasured. We introduce MetaKernelBench, which measures whether experience distilled from an attempt in one kernel domain-specific language (DSL) improves a fresh attempt at the same problem in another. Its 74 problems are fused subgraphs in six families, each posed as a pair of CuTe DSL and TIRx variants that differ only in the DSL. The agent first attempts each variant solo and is instructed to distill what it learns into a natural-language skill, which is transferred whether or not the source attempt passes verification. The skill is the only extra input to a skill-conditioned attempt by the same model in the other DSL. We compare each skill-conditioned attempt with the solo attempt on the same variant under matched per-attempt budgets, scoring correctness and end-to-end runtime. Across six models and both directions, paired lift over solo attempts ranges from -19% to +29%. Four models gain in both directions, yet regressions occur on 16% to 45% of problems in every model and direction. Outcomes follow the source attempt's result relative to the target's solo attempt rather than source success alone, improving in 71% of comparisons when the source stands above and regressing in 54% when it stands below. MetaKernelBench complements implementation-quality metrics by measuring same-problem cross-DSL kernel knowledge transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MetaKernelBench 衡量 GPU kernel 优化智能体把一次尝试蒸馏出的自然语言 skill 迁移到另一 DSL 后，对同题重做的增益：74 道题各配 CuTe DSL 与 TIRx 两种写法，六个模型双向配对提升范围为 -19% 到 +29%，且每个模型每个方向都有 16% 到 45% 的题出现回退。
Motivation: kernel benchmark 只给单次实现打正确性与速度分，智能体把经验存进知识库或蒸馏成 skill 后，这些留存经验的复用价值没有被度量。
Method: 74 道题为六个族的融合子图，每题给出仅 DSL 不同的 CuTe DSL 与 TIRx 变体；智能体先各自单独尝试，被要求把所学蒸馏成自然语言 skill（无论源尝试是否通过验证都迁移），再以该 skill 作为唯一额外输入在另一 DSL 中由同一模型重做，与同变体的单独尝试在等预算下配对比较正确性与端到端 runtime。
Result: 六个模型、双向配对下相对单独尝试的提升介于 -19% 到 +29%；四个模型双向均获益，但每个模型每个方向都有 16% 到 45% 的题回退；结果跟随源尝试相对目标单独尝试的位次而非源尝试是否成功——源更强时 71% 的比较改善，源更弱时 54% 回退。
Conclusion: 跨 DSL 的 kernel 经验迁移收益取决于源尝试相对目标基线的强弱，skill 蒸馏本身不保证正迁移，因此留存经验的复用价值需要与实现质量分开度量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: EMBER-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-Event Causal Memory in Long-Horizon Embodied Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Lifelong physical agents must reason over extended interactions where past events continue to shape the world long after they disappear from view. Beyond recalling what happened, agents must infer how history changes the current state and constrains future actions. Yet existing embodied and video-memory benchmarks largely focus on historical retrieval and summary, leaving such history-dependent causal reasoning underexplored. We introduce EMBER-Bench, an egocentric benchmark for cross-event causal reasoning in long-horizon embodied tasks, for which we newly created the task design, video recording, and data annotation. It contains 189 household tasks and 699 QA pairs, spanning task progress, failure recovery, external interventions, and compound long-horizon tasks with distant dependencies and prerequisites, with fine-grained event and causal-chain annotations. EMBER-Bench evaluates reasoning in both directions: next-action prediction selects the next action from history, and causal traceback, given that action, identifies the historical event that makes it necessary. Input ablations that add action logs or privileged cause-and-consequence annotations to the video indicate which kind of historical information models fail to use. Among the 16 evaluated models, the highest overall accuracy is 61.2%, compared with a mean of 98.3% across two human evaluators. At paired decision points, correct traceback is not associated with correct next-action prediction. Adding action logs yields a gain of 1.6 points, whereas cause-and-consequence annotations yield an additional gain of 13.0 points on top of that. These results suggest that extracting causal information from past events and converting it into constraints on current actions remains a key difficulty for long-horizon embodied agents. Project Page: https://zhaoalexgoat.github.io/EMBER-Bench/
papers.comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. The first two authors contributed equally. Project page: https://zhaoalexgoat.github.io/EMBER-Bench/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMBER-Bench 是一个第一人称视角的长时程具身任务基准，用 189 个家庭任务、699 个 QA 对评测跨事件因果记忆，同时考「下一步动作预测」和「因果回溯」两个方向。16 个受测模型最高总体准确率仅 61.2%，而两位人类评测者平均 98.3%；在配对决策点上回溯正确与动作预测正确互不相关，说明模型难以把历史事件转成当前动作的约束。
Motivation: 现有具身与视频记忆基准主要测历史检索和摘要，历史如何因果性地改变当前状态、约束后续动作这一依赖历史的推理几乎没被覆盖。
Method: 新建第一人称视频数据集，任务覆盖 task progress、failure recovery、external interventions 以及带远距离依赖与前置条件的复合长时程任务，并做细粒度事件与因果链标注；评测含 next-action prediction 与 causal traceback 两个方向，另用输入消融分别加入 action logs 和特权的 cause-and-consequence 标注，定位模型缺用哪类历史信息。
Result: 16 个模型中最高总体准确率 61.2%，两位人类评测者平均 98.3%；配对决策点上因果回溯正确与下一步动作预测正确不相关；加入 action logs 提升 1.6 个百分点，在其之上再加 cause-and-consequence 标注额外提升 13.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: 从过往事件中抽取因果信息并转成当前动作的约束，仍是长时程具身智能体的关键难点；特权因果标注带来的 13.0 点增益远大于动作日志的 1.6 点，指向缺的是因果结构而非动作序列本身。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FreeLoc: Online Floorplan Localization via Diffusion-Aided Pose Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Floorplans provide compact and widely available geometric maps for indoor localization, but existing high-performing floorplan-based methods still convert them into dense scene-specific offline databases, tying accuracy, storage, and runtime to the sampling resolution of the discretized pose space. We present FreeLoc, an online RGB-based floorplan localization framework that treats the floorplan as a directly queryable geometric map. FreeLoc introduces an efficient online geometric querying and diffusion-aided refinement scheme, which retrieves plausible pose anchors through on-the-fly floorplan ray querying and refines them into accurate continuous pose estimates. For sequential localization, FreeLoc develops an online likelihood construction strategy that bridges single-frame localization and probabilistic temporal fusion by constructing likelihoods from coarse-sampled candidates and refined pose hypotheses, enabling histogram-filter-based temporal fusion without offline databases. Experiments demonstrate real-time online inference and state-of-the-art performance in both single-frame and sequential localization, while real-world results validate practical deployability in indoor robotic localization scenarios.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FreeLoc 把楼层平面图当作可直接查询的几何地图做在线 RGB 室内定位：用即时 ray querying 检索位姿锚点，再由扩散辅助细化成连续位姿，并用粗采样候选与细化假设构建似然，喂给 histogram filter 做时序融合，全程不建离线稠密数据库。实验显示单帧与序列定位均达 state-of-the-art 且可实时推理，真实场景验证了室内机器人部署可行性。
Motivation: 现有高性能楼层平面图定位方法仍需把地图转成稠密的场景专用离线数据库，精度、存储与运行时都被离散位姿空间的采样分辨率绑死。
Method: 在线几何查询加扩散辅助细化：对楼层平面图做 on-the-fly ray querying 检索候选位姿锚点，再细化为连续位姿估计；序列定位上用在线似然构建策略，把粗采样候选与细化位姿假设合成为似然，交给 histogram filter 做概率时序融合，无需离线数据库。
Result: 实验展示实时在线推理，并在单帧与序列定位上均达到 state-of-the-art；真实世界结果验证了室内机器人定位场景的实际可部署性。
Conclusion: 楼层平面图可以直接作为可查询几何地图用于在线定位，把离线稠密数据库替换为 ray 查询加扩散细化加 histogram filter 时序融合，仍能同时拿到 SOTA 精度与实时性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PortraitAes: Intent-Conditioned Structured Portrait Aesthetics Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Portrait aesthetic assessment assigns comparable scores according to how effectively human-centered images fulfill their photographic intent. These scores support data filtering, candidate selection, and preference modeling in image-generation pipelines. Existing methods typically predict a single aesthetic score or use general-purpose MLLMs without conditioning on photographic intent. This omission matters because the same blur, pose, lighting, or framing choice may serve one photographic intent but undermine another. These models thus learn context-agnostic aesthetic priors and yield inconsistent, inaccurate, misleading judgments for portraits with distinct photographic objectives. We introduce PortraitAes-Bench, an 11K-scale benchmark that decomposes this task into intent-conditioned subjudgments. Expert-authored rubrics define nine photographic intents, six first-level dimensions, and 22 secondary criteria. They support a structured pipeline for intent routing, specialist assessment, verification, and score fusion. Following this structure, we train PortraitAes with multi-task supervision. We then improve score comparability through Gaussian score calibration and within-dimension cross-image ranking. On the standard benchmark, PortraitAes achieves a Pearson correlation of 0.924 and a Spearman rank correlation of 0.934. On the hard-case set, its Pearson correlation is 0.829 and its Spearman rank correlation is 0.795. Across both sets, PortraitAes outperforms the evaluated general-purpose MLLMs and specialized aesthetic baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PortraitAes 把人像美学评估拆成按摄影意图条件化的子判断：11K 规模的 PortraitAes-Bench 用专家评分细则定义 9 种意图、6 个一级维度、22 条二级标准，配套意图路由、专家评估、校验与分数融合的结构化流程，并按此结构做多任务训练。标准集上 Pearson 0.924、Spearman 0.934，困难集上 0.829 与 0.795，跨两个集合均超过所评估的通用 MLLM 与专用美学基线。
Motivation: 现有人像美学评估只预测单一总分或直接用通用 MLLM，不以摄影意图为条件；而同一处虚化、姿态、光线或构图可能服务一种意图却损害另一种，导致模型学到与上下文无关的美学先验，对不同摄影目标的人像给出不一致、不准确的判断。
Method: 构建 PortraitAes-Bench（11K 规模），由专家评分细则给出 9 种摄影意图、6 个一级维度、22 条二级标准，支撑意图路由、专家评估、校验、分数融合的结构化流水线；据此以多任务监督训练 PortraitAes，并用 Gaussian score calibration 与维度内跨图像排序 (within-dimension cross-image ranking) 提升分数可比性。
Result: 标准基准上 Pearson 相关 0.924、Spearman 秩相关 0.934；困难集 (hard-case set) 上 Pearson 0.829、Spearman 0.795。两个集合上均超过所评估的通用 MLLM 与专用美学基线。
Conclusion: 把摄影意图作为条件、按维度结构化分解再融合分数，能让人像美学评分在不同摄影目标间保持一致且更准确的可比性。

papers.title: Physics-Augmented Graph Transformers for Patch-Antenna Forward and Inverse Design
papers.abstract_en: Full-wave electromagnetic (EM) simulation enables accurate patch-antenna analysis but is computationally expensive for large-scale forward prediction and inverse design. We present a mesh-native, physics-augmented graph-learning framework that treats radiation-pattern prediction as signal reconstruction on an irregular surface mesh. For the forward problem, a GPS graph transformer is trained with Physics-Augmented Intermediate Supervision (PAIS), an auxiliary node-level objective that predicts complex surface currents, the physical intermediate linking geometry to radiation. PAIS improves multiple GNN backbones at no inference-time cost, while shuffled-current and non-physical controls show the gain comes from physical correspondence. Direction-conditioned decoding and a differentiable radiation-integral consistency loss further exploit this structure. On an 80,000-sample CST benchmark, GPS+PAIS reaches MSE 0.17 / PSNR 19.67, generalizes to a PCA split, and transfers zero-shot to canonical patches. For inverse design, surrogate-filtered diffusion beats nearest-neighbor retrieval by 32% relative MSE.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP 2026), Atlanta, USA. Code, dataset and Colab demo: https://github.com/AviEpstein/GNN-for-Antenna-design
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 mesh-native 的物理增强图Transformer (GPS) 做贴片天线方向图的正向预测与逆向设计：用 Physics-Augmented Intermediate Supervision (PAIS) 让节点级复表面电流作为几何到辐射的物理中间量受监督，配合方向条件解码与可微辐射积分一致性损失。在 80,000 样本 CST benchmark 上 GPS+PAIS 达到 MSE 0.17 / PSNR 19.67，逆向设计中 surrogate-filtered diffusion 比最近邻检索相对 MSE 改善 32%。
Motivation: 全波电磁仿真精度高但对大规模正向预测与逆向设计计算代价过大，需要在保留物理结构的前提下用学习代理替代。
Method: 把方向图预测建模为不规则表面网格上的信号重建，用 GPS graph transformer 训练；PAIS 作为辅助节点级目标预测复表面电流，并用 shuffled-current 与 non-physical 对照验证增益来自物理对应；再加方向条件解码与可微辐射积分一致性损失。逆向设计采用 surrogate-filtered diffusion。
Result: 在 80,000 样本 CST benchmark 上 GPS+PAIS 达到 MSE 0.17、PSNR 19.67；在 PCA split 上泛化，并零样本迁移到 canonical patches；PAIS 在无推理开销下提升多种 GNN backbone；逆向设计中 surrogate-filtered diffusion 相对最近邻检索 MSE 改善 32%。
Conclusion: 把表面电流这一物理中间量作为监督信号，能在不增加推理成本的前提下提升图网络的方向图预测，并支撑可用的逆向天线设计。

papers.title: How corner is a corner case? Percentile control for highway scenario generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating corner-case scenarios with appropriate adversity in a simulation environment is critical for testing an autonomous vehicle (AV) software stack's safety performance before deployment. Existing autonomous-driving scenario generators can enforce specific behavior, adversity, or feasibility conditions, but they provide limited control over how extreme a generated scenario is relative to plausible futures in the same traffic context. This study represents the adversity of a generated scenario as its percentile in the conditional distribution of future risk given the observed history. This view supports calibrated answers to two questions: how "corner" a generated corner-case scenario is and how its "cornerness" can be fine-tuned. To this end, we formulate history-conditioned risk-percentile requests and learn a reference risk distribution that maps each requested percentile to a physical risk target. We then use a percentile-conditioned joint diffusion model with sampling-time risk guidance to generate multi-agent futures, together with a reference-based criterion for evaluating percentile realization. Experiments use the minimum post-encroachment time (PET) between the ego and its surrounding vehicles as the risk surrogate on highD. On the primary evaluation set, our method realizes 1,422 of 1,440 requests within a 0.05 percentile tolerance (98.75%), with mean percentile error 0.00673 and PET-target error 0.00991 seconds. The resulting interface connects context-relative risk specification, physical realization, and evaluation through a common risk scale. Project website and videos of generated scenarios are available at https://hhj233.github.io/CornerPercentile/.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 13 figures, 8 tables. Project page with videos: https://hhjj233.github.io/CornerPercentile/ Code: https://github.com/hhjj233/P-control-SG
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把自动驾驶 corner-case 场景的“极端程度”定义为给定观测历史下未来风险的条件分布百分位，并用百分位条件联合扩散模型加采样时风险引导生成多智能体轨迹，使请求的百分位可被精确实现。在 highD 上以 ego 与周边车辆的最小 post-encroachment time (PET) 为风险代理，主评估集 1,440 条请求中 1,422 条落在 0.05 百分位容差内 (98.75%)，平均百分位误差 0.00673、PET 目标误差 0.00991 秒。
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶场景生成器只能强制特定行为、对抗性或可行性条件，无法控制生成场景在同一交通语境下相对于合理未来有多极端，因而无法回答“这个 corner case 有多 corner”以及“如何微调其极端度”。
Method: 将场景对抗性表示为给定历史下条件风险分布的百分位；先构造历史条件的百分位请求并学习参考风险分布，把每个请求百分位映射为物理风险目标；再用百分位条件的联合扩散模型 (percentile-conditioned joint diffusion) 配合采样时风险引导 (sampling-time risk guidance) 生成多智能体未来轨迹，并给出基于参考分布的百分位实现评估准则。
Result: 在 highD 数据集上以 ego 与周边车辆的最小 PET 为风险代理：主评估集 1,440 条百分位请求中 1,422 条在 0.05 百分位容差内实现，成功率 98.75%；平均百分位误差 0.00673，PET 目标误差 0.00991 秒。
Conclusion: 把场景极端度统一到条件风险百分位这一个尺度上，可以同时连接语境相对的风险设定、物理实现与评估，从而对 corner-case 场景做到可校准的“有多 corner”判定与微调。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: VisualErase: Dual-Branch Visual Trajectory Redirection for Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Concept erasure is essential for the safe deployment of text-to-image diffusion models, as they may reproduce harmful, copyrighted, or privacy-sensitive content learned from unconstrained large-scale data. Existing methods typically erase unwanted concepts while preserving general generation capability by redirecting target-related text-to-image mappings. However, recent studies show that erased models may still retain visual generative trajectories of target concepts, leaving them vulnerable to adversarial recovery attacks and revealing a fundamental gap between redirecting text-to-image mappings and truly removing visual knowledge. To bridge this gap, we propose VisualErase, a new paradigm that redirects concept-bearing visual generative trajectories toward explicitly defined concept-removed outcomes. To enable this redirection, we use structure-preserving image editing to construct content-aligned, concept-removed counterparts for source images, providing explicit visual endpoints that retain non-target content. We then derive a denoising target from each source-to-counterpart pair and use a dual-branch redirection loss to align both text-conditioned and unconditional predictions with this target, since conditional supervision alone does not explicitly constrain generation without textual guidance. To mitigate the adverse effects of concept erasure on non-target generation, we jointly optimize the redirection loss with a counterpart retention loss that matches denoising predictions from the frozen pretrained model. Across style, celebrity, and nudity erasure, VisualErase limits the maximum attack success rate over seven attacks to 0%, 8%, and 0.1%, respectively, while retaining general generation quality. These results highlight the importance of visual trajectory redirection for robust concept erasure beyond text-to-image mappings alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VisualErase 把概念擦除的对象从文本-图像映射改为视觉生成轨迹：用结构保持图像编辑为源图构造内容对齐、概念已移除的对应图，从中导出去噪目标，再用双分支重定向损失同时约束有条件与无条件预测，并配合对应图保留损失守住非目标生成质量。在风格、名人、裸露三类擦除上，七种攻击的最大攻击成功率分别被限制在 0%、8%、0.1%。
Motivation: 现有擦除方法只重定向文本-图像映射，被擦除模型仍保留目标概念的视觉生成轨迹，容易被对抗恢复攻击还原，说明重定向映射与真正移除视觉知识之间存在根本差距。
Method: 先用结构保持图像编辑 (structure-preserving image editing) 生成与源图内容对齐、概念已移除的对应图作为显式视觉终点；由源图-对应图对导出去噪目标，用双分支重定向损失 (dual-branch redirection loss) 同时对齐文本条件与无条件预测；再与匹配冻结预训练模型去噪预测的对应图保留损失 (counterpart retention loss) 联合优化。
Result: 在 style、celebrity、nudity 三类概念擦除上，VisualErase 将七种攻击下的最大攻击成功率 (maximum attack success rate) 分别限制在 0%、8%、0.1%，同时保持通用生成质量。
Conclusion: 作者主张稳健的概念擦除必须重定向视觉生成轨迹，而不能只停留在文本-图像映射层面；双分支约束无条件分支是必要的，因为仅有条件监督不约束无文本引导时的生成。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Overparameterization: Provable Learning of Input-Convex Multi-Layer Polynomial Networks with Active Queries
papers.abstract_en: The theoretical understanding of multi-layer neural networks is largely confined to overparameterized settings, which obscure parameter identifiability and incur high sample complexity. Neural tangent kernel (NTK) provides a general theory for wide networks, but does not offer efficient sample-complexity guarantees. Recent feature-learning results go beyond kernel methods for single-neuron, multi-index, and hierarchical targets. However, the analysis is often restricted to shallow or specific architectures and to the overparameterized regime. We break this paradigm to achieve parameter-level recovery of deep target networks, albeit by using active data queries. Specifically, we study $L$-layer polynomial networks with even degree-$k$ monomial activations and nonnegative higher-layer weights. This structure makes the target network input-convex, while the optimization landscape remains highly nonconvex with respect to the parameters. Leveraging input convexity and active queries, we propose \textbf{ASPIRE} (\textbf{A}ctive \textbf{S}am\textbf{P}ling for \textbf{I}terative \textbf{R}ecovery via \textbf{E}igendirections), a layerwise sampling-based diagonalization algorithm that recovers all network parameters to $δ$-accuracy with sample complexity $ \widetilde O_{k,L}\left(d^{L^2+O(L)}δ^{-2e}\right) $ in polynomial time. To our knowledge, this is the \emph{first} parameter-recovery guarantee for deep target networks whose exponent grows only polynomially with depth, as well as the \emph{first} justification for the effectiveness of using high-quality data in neural network training, with a remarkably \emph{exponential} separation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASPIRE 用主动查询加逐层特征方向对角化，在偶数次 k 齐次激活、高层权重非负的 L 层多项式网络上实现参数级恢复，样本复杂度为 Õ_{k,L}(d^{L²+O(L)}δ^{-2e})，指数只随深度多项式增长，与过参数化 NTK 理论形成指数级分离。
Motivation: 深度网络理论多局限于过参数化设定，参数可辨识性被掩盖且样本复杂度高；NTK 只给宽网络一般理论，缺乏高效样本复杂度保证，已有 feature-learning 结果多限于浅层或特定架构。
Method: 研究 L 层多项式网络，激活为偶数 degree-k 单项式、高层权重非负，使目标网络 input-convex 而参数层面仍高度非凸；提出 ASPIRE（Active SamPling for Iterative Recovery via Eigendirections），一种逐层采样对角化算法，借助输入凸性与主动数据查询恢复全部参数。
Result: 以 δ-精度恢复全部网络参数，样本复杂度 Õ_{k,L}(d^{L²+O(L)}δ^{-2e})，多项式时间；据作者所知是首个指数仅随深度多项式增长的深度目标网络参数恢复保证，也是对高质量数据在神经网络训练中有效性的首个理论论证，并呈现指数级分离。
Conclusion: 借助输入凸结构与主动查询，深度网络可以在非过参数化设定下获得参数级可恢复性，且样本复杂度的指数不随深度爆炸。

summary_sections.method: 研究 L 层多项式网络，激活为偶数 degree-k 单项式、高层权重非负，使目标网络 input-convex 而参数层面仍高度非凸；提出 ASPIRE（Active SamPling for Iterative Recovery via Eigendirections），一种逐层采样对角化算法，借助输入凸性与主动数据查询恢复全部参数。
summary_sections.result: 以 δ-精度恢复全部网络参数，样本复杂度 Õ_{k,L}(d^{L²+O(L)}δ^{-2e})，多项式时间；据作者所知是首个指数仅随深度多项式增长的深度目标网络参数恢复保证，也是对高质量数据在神经网络训练中有效性的首个理论论证，并呈现指数级分离。
summary_sections.conclusion: 借助输入凸结构与主动查询，深度网络可以在非过参数化设定下获得参数级可恢复性，且样本复杂度的指数不随深度爆炸。

papers.title: EmoRSS: Mitigating Emotion-Induced Over-Refusal in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Emotional expression can influence the safety decisions of large language models (LLMs), offering a potential avenue for improving safety alignment. Existing studies have mainly focused on how emotional expressions facilitate attacks under harmful requests, while overlooking their effects on benign requests. We find that emotional expression can also systematically increase refusal tendencies on benign requests, leading to unnecessary over-refusal. Based on this observation, we propose emotion-guided refusal subspace steering (EmoRSS), an activation-steering method that mitigates emotion-induced over-refusal while preserving refusal behaviour on harmful requests. Specifically, we first identify a refusal-sensitive layer using layer-wise linear probes and construct a refusal subspace from sparse autoencoder (SAE) features aligned with the probe direction. Next, we use paired regular and emotional requests with the same queries to estimate the mean activation shift in the features defining the refusal subspace. Finally, we decode this shift into an activation intervention vector and apply it in the reverse refusal direction during inference, without updating the backbone parameters. Experiments on two LLMs show that, when requests contain emotional expressions, our method achieves a more favourable trade-off between refusing harmful requests and answering benign ones than prior over-refusal mitigation baselines, while better preserving general task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 情感表达会系统性抬高 LLM 在良性请求上的拒绝率，造成不必要过度拒绝。EmoRSS 用逐层线性探针定位拒绝敏感层，从与探针方向对齐的 SAE 特征构造拒绝子空间，再用同 query 的普通/情感配对请求估计该子空间内的平均激活偏移，推理时沿拒绝反方向注入干预向量，不动骨干参数。在两个 LLM 上，含情感表达的请求中，该方法在拒绝有害请求与回答良性请求之间取得比既有过度拒绝缓解基线更有利的折中，同时更好地保持通用任务性能。
Motivation: 既有研究多关注情感表达如何在有害请求下促成攻击，忽略其对良性请求的影响；而情感表达会系统性提高拒绝倾向，造成不必要的过度拒绝。
Method: EmoRSS 是一种激活引导的拒绝子空间转向 (activation steering)：先用逐层线性探针 (layer-wise linear probes) 找到拒绝敏感层，再用与探针方向对齐的稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 特征构造拒绝子空间；随后用相同 query 的普通请求与情感请求配对，估计该子空间特征上的平均激活偏移，解码成干预向量，推理时沿拒绝反方向施加，全程不更新骨干参数。
Result: 在两个 LLM 上的实验显示：当请求含情感表达时，EmoRSS 在拒绝有害请求与回答良性请求的折中上优于既有的过度拒绝缓解基线，并更好地保持通用任务性能。
Conclusion: 情感表达导致的过度拒绝可以通过针对拒绝子空间的推理期激活干预来缓解，且无需微调骨干即可同时保住对有害请求的拒绝行为。

papers.title: Pessimistic Minimax Learning for Public-Private Information Games under Unilateral Coverage
papers.abstract_en: We study offline learning in two-player zero-sum contextual games with public and private information, motivated by strategic settings such as auctions and negotiations with private valuations. We introduce unilateral prescriptive concentrability and show that asymmetric information can change offline coverage through its effect on equilibrium behavior. For finite state-action spaces, we develop a pessimistic algorithm with an $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$ exploitability rate, matching the standard sample-size dependence for fully observed minimax games. We further develop a pessimistic policy mirror descent framework, PPA-PMD, for general function approximation and obtain a unified $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n} + 1/\sqrt{T})$ exploitability rate with no-regret actor updates. Together, these results provide the first theoretical framework for offline equilibrium learning under public-private information constraints.

summary_sections.tldr:
在带公共与私有信息的两人零和上下文博弈中，提出悲观 minimax 离线学习框架：先定义 unilateral prescriptive concentrability，说明不对称信息会通过改变均衡行为来改变离线覆盖条件；有限状态-动作空间下给出 $	ilde{O}(1/
)$ 可利用度 (exploitability) 率，与完全观测 minimax 博弈的标准样本量依赖一致。
summary_sections.motivation: 拍卖、谈判等场景中双方各持私有估值，离线数据的覆盖条件与均衡行为耦合，完全观测 minimax 博弈的离线覆盖假设不再成立，缺少该设定下的离线均衡学习理论。
summary_sections.method: 引入 unilateral prescriptive concentrability 刻画不对称信息下的离线覆盖；有限状态-动作空间用悲观算法，一般函数逼近下提出悲观 policy mirror descent 框架 PPA-PMD，配 no-regret actor 更新。
summary_sections.conclusion: 这是公开-私有信息约束下离线均衡学习的首个理论框架：不对称信息应通过改变均衡行为来重新定义覆盖条件，悲观化可把完全观测的样本复杂度结论迁移到部分观测博弈。

papers.title: CIPO: Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization for Adaptive Tool Granularity Selection
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents solve complex tasks through multi-step interactions with external tools. These interactions often contain recurring local tool sequences. Treating such sequences as composite "Skills" can shorten tool-use trajectories and reduce repeated low-level decisions. However, when atomic tools and composite skills coexist, skill use becomes a policy problem: the agent must decide whether the current state requires atomic fine control or skill-level abstraction. In this paper, we argue that effective skill use should be studied as adaptive tool granularity selection. The most direct training signal for this problem is to compare the consequences of atomic and skill choices available from the same state. Based on this view, we propose CIPO, a Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization framework for adaptive tool granularity. CIPO constructs executable skills through budget-constrained mining of successful tool-use trajectories and trains granularity decisions with counterfactual branch rollouts. For each base rollout, CIPO branches at the first eligible granularity decision and replaces the chosen action with a feasible atomic or skill alternative. The paired outcome difference serves as a supplementary reward for policy optimization. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and model backbones show that CIPO improves task success and decision efficiency over baselines. Further analyses show that CIPO learns effective skill use by improving the choice between atomic tools and composite skills based on the current state, without simply increasing skill frequency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CIPO 把 LLM agent 的技能使用重构为自适应工具粒度选择问题：从成功轨迹中预算约束地挖掘可执行 skills，并在首个合格粒度决策处分叉做反事实分支 rollout，用原子动作与技能动作的成对结果差作为策略优化的附加奖励。在多个 benchmark 与模型 backbone 上，CIPO 相对基线提升任务成功率与决策效率，且改进来自依据当前状态在原子工具与复合技能之间做出更好选择，而非单纯提高技能使用频率。
Motivation: LLM agent 的多步工具交互中存在重复的局部工具序列，把它们打包成 skills 可缩短轨迹，但原子工具与技能并存时，何时该用细粒度控制、何时该用技能抽象成为一个缺少直接训练信号的策略问题。
Method: CIPO (Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization) 分两步：先对成功工具使用轨迹做预算约束挖掘以构造可执行 skills；再训练粒度决策——对每条 base rollout，在第一个合格的粒度决策点分叉，把已选动作替换为可行的原子或技能替代动作，成对结果差作为策略优化的补充奖励。
Result: 在多个 benchmark 和多个模型 backbone 上的实验显示，CIPO 相对基线提升任务成功率与决策效率；进一步分析表明其改进来自依据当前状态在原子工具与复合技能之间做出更有效的选择，而不是简单提高技能使用频率。
Conclusion: 有效技能使用应被当作自适应工具粒度选择来研究，而同一状态下原子与技能两种选择的反事实后果比较正是该问题最直接的训练信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Is a Graph a Covariance? Bayesian Residual Propagation under Covariance Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Observing a prediction error at one node can help correct predictions elsewhere, but the benefit depends on the residual dependence between nodes. A graph suggests where that dependence might occur, yet does not establish its sign or strength. We develop a Bayesian model of residual covariance to determine how revealed errors should update a fixed feature-based predictor. For a fixed set of revealed nodes, we derive an exact identity for the change in expected squared error under linear residual propagation. The identity characterizes the optimal linear update and expresses the excess error of any other update as an exact quadratic. Under covariance uncertainty, the Bayes-optimal fixed linear update uses the posterior mean covariance. We average over four positive-semidefinite covariance families representing no dependence, positive dependence, negative dependence, and dependence whose sign can alternate with graph distance. Across eight graph benchmarks, four show posterior support within the distance-profile family for negative covariance between neighbors and alternating signs with distance. Among the evaluated methods, ours achieves the smallest worst-case recall gap to the best method on each graph. The method improves squared error over residual propagation on five of eight graphs, but performs substantially worse on one dense heterophilous graph. In these experiments, selecting the highest-posterior family performs similarly to model averaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把图上的残差传播写成贝叶斯协方差推断：在协方差不确定时，最优固定线性更新用后验均值协方差，且任意更新的超额误差有精确二次型表达。八个图基准中四个的后验支持邻点负协方差与随距离交替变号，方法在五个图上优于残差传播、在稠密异配图上明显变差，最差 recall 差距在每个图上都是被评方法中最小。
Motivation: 在某节点观测到预测误差可以修正其他节点的预测，但收益取决于节点间残差依赖；图只提示依赖可能出现在哪里，既不定符号也不定强度，而协方差本身未知。
Method: 建立残差协方差的贝叶斯模型来决定已揭示误差如何更新固定的基于特征的预测器；对固定的已揭示节点集合，推导线性残差传播下期望平方误差变化的精确恒等式，刻画最优线性更新并把任意更新的超额误差写成精确二次型；在协方差不确定时用后验均值协方差作为 Bayes-optimal 固定线性更新，并在四个正半定协方差族（无依赖、正依赖、负依赖、符号随图距离交替）上做平均。
Result: 八个图基准中，有四个在 distance-profile 族内显示邻点负协方差与随距离交替变号的后验支持；在被评方法中，本方法在每个图上对最优方法的最差 recall 差距最小；相对残差传播，本方法在八个图中的五个上改进平方误差，但在一个稠密异配 (dense heterophilous) 图上明显更差；实验中选取后验最高的族与模型平均表现相近。
Conclusion: 残差依赖的符号与强度应由后验协方差决定而非由图结构假定，Bayes-optimal 更新用后验均值协方差即可；该方法在稠密异配图上会明显退化，而选最大后验族与模型平均在这些实验中等效。

papers.title: How Long, Not How Close: A Learned Temporal Metric for Planning in Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models plan by rolling a frozen predictor forward under candidate action sequences and ranking the candidates by the latent distance between their imagined end state and the goal. However, this ranking breaks down when the goal lies several plans away, because the latent distance measures how closely an end state resembles the goal rather than how far it remains from reaching it. To address this, we propose TEMPO, a temporal-distance planning objective that leaves the world model untouched, learns only from the demonstrations already used to train it, and adds negligible cost to the planner's search. TEMPO learns a small map of the frozen latent in which the distance between two states of an episode reflects the number of environment steps between them, and blends this distance into the planner's cost. It requires no rewards, policies or success labels and, being a cost rather than a model, applies to frozen world models with one latent vector per state that plan by a latent distance. We evaluate TEMPO on eleven simulated environments (e.g., maze navigation, tabletop pushing, robotic arm control and three-dimensional manipulation) with the LeWM and PLDM planners. With a small MLP that adds at most 0.3% to a plan's arithmetic, TEMPO improves both planners at every goal distance, including the one-plan setting of their evaluations, raises LeWM from 36% to 99% on TwoRoom three plans from the goal, and remains competitive on a broad range of 2D and 3D navigation, reaching and manipulation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TEMPO 用一个学自演示的小型 MLP 在冻结 latent 上定义时间距离（环境步数），替代按 latent 相似度排序候选动作的规划代价，在 11 个模拟环境中把 LeWM 在 TwoRoom 距目标三个 plan 的成功率从 36% 提到 99%，且每个 plan 最多只增加 0.3% 算术开销。
Motivation: latent world model 规划按终点与目标的 latent 距离排序候选，但目标离当前状态几个 plan 远时该距离只反映相似度而非到达难度，排序失效。
Method: TEMPO 在冻结的 world model 上额外学一个小型映射，使同一 episode 内两状态的距离反映它们之间的环境步数，并把该距离混入 planner 的代价；只用训练 world model 的演示数据，不需要 reward、policy 或成功标签，也不改动模型本身。
Result: 在 11 个模拟环境（迷宫导航、桌面推物、机械臂控制、三维操作等）上用 LeWM 与 PLDM 两个 planner 评测：小 MLP 至多给单个 plan 增加 0.3% 算术量，在所有目标距离上都提升两个 planner，包括原评测的一步距离设定；TwoRoom 距目标三个 plan 时 LeWM 成功率 36% → 99%，在各类 2D/3D 导航、抓取与操作任务上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 按到达所需步数而非终点相似度来排序候选，可以在不改冻结 world model 的前提下修复远目标规划，且搜索开销可忽略。

summary_sections.motivation: latent world model 规划按终点与目标的 latent 距离排序候选，但目标离当前状态几个 plan 远时该距离只反映相似度而非到达难度，排序失效。
summary_sections.method: TEMPO 在冻结的 world model 上额外学一个小型映射，使同一 episode 内两状态的距离反映它们之间的环境步数，并把该距离混入 planner 的代价；只用训练 world model 的演示数据，不需要 reward、policy 或成功标签，也不改动模型本身。
summary_sections.result: 在 11 个模拟环境（迷宫导航、桌面推物、机械臂控制、三维操作等）上用 LeWM 与 PLDM 两个 planner 评测：小 MLP 至多给单个 plan 增加 0.3% 算术量，在所有目标距离上都提升两个 planner，包括原评测的一步距离设定；TwoRoom 距目标三个 plan 时 LeWM 成功率 36% → 99%，在各类 2D/3D 导航、抓取与操作任务上保持竞争力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 按到达所需步数而非终点相似度来排序候选，可以在不改冻结 world model 的前提下修复远目标规划，且搜索开销可忽略。

papers.title: Hidden Risks of Jev: An Empirical Study of Security, Privacy, and Dual Use
papers.abstract_en: Jev turns natural-language questions into typed answers and probabilities with low latency and cost, enabling applications to route requests and select tools. While this interface allows Jev to integrate naturally into application workflows as a decision layer, the security and privacy implications of this emerging use remain largely unexplored. To address this gap, we conduct the first systematic study of these implications using the official Jev API and NanoJev, a local model with controllable training data and updates, focusing on three research questions: (1) What security threats arise when Jev is deployed as an application decision layer? (2) What private information can Jev reveal despite returning constrained typed outputs? (3) How can Jev's general-purpose decision capability be used for beneficial purposes or misused? Jev's decisions depend on application state and may be influenced by user-provided inputs. We therefore adapt prompt injection and adversarial suffixes to manipulate its decisions. Open-source Jev distribution and updates introduce supply-chain risks, which we examine by implanting backdoors in NanoJev through training data poisoning. Since Jev's outputs reflect both application state and information learned during training, we further adapt membership, private attribute, and internal knowledge inference attacks to recover sensitive information despite its constrained output format. Finally, Jev can serve as a general-purpose decision oracle for defensive and malicious workflows. We examine this dual use through four detection tasks covering prompt injection, jailbreak inputs, harmful content, and AI-generated text, alongside misuse scenarios involving jailbreak and model extraction. Our empirical evaluation shows that Jev remains vulnerable to the examined security and privacy threats, while its decision capability can support beneficial and malicious uses.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables; The source code is available at \url{https://github.com/shihe98/Security_Privacy_Jev}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Jev 把自然语言问题转成带类型和概率的低延迟答案，作为应用决策层使用；本文用官方 Jev API 与可控训练数据的本地模型 NanoJev 做首次系统安全隐私研究，涵盖提示注入、对抗后缀、训练数据投毒植入后门、成员推断/私有属性推断/内部知识推断，以及四个检测任务与越狱、模型抽取滥用场景。实证评估显示 Jev 对所考察的安全与隐私威胁仍然脆弱，其决策能力同时支撑有益与恶意用途。
Motivation: Jev 作为应用决策层的接口（路由请求、选择工具）已开始落地，但其安全与隐私影响基本未被系统研究：决策受应用状态和用户输入影响，输出又同时反映状态与训练期学到的信息。
Method: 基于官方 Jev API 与本地模型 NanoJev（训练数据与更新可控）提出三个研究问题并逐一实证：把提示注入与对抗后缀适配到操纵其决策；通过训练数据投毒在 NanoJev 中植入后门以检验开源分发与更新的供应链风险；把成员推断、私有属性推断与内部知识推断攻击适配到受限类型输出上；再用覆盖提示注入、越狱输入、有害内容、AI 生成文本的四个检测任务检验双用途，并考察越狱与模型抽取滥用。
Result: 实证评估显示 Jev 对所考察的全部安全与隐私威胁仍然脆弱：提示注入与对抗后缀可操纵其决策，训练数据投毒可在 NanoJev 中植入后门，成员推断、私有属性与内部知识推断攻击在受限类型输出下仍能恢复敏感信息；同时其决策能力可支撑四个有益检测任务，也可用于越狱与模型抽取等恶意用途。
Conclusion: 把 Jev 这类类型化概率决策接口接入应用时，其决策可被输入操纵、可被投毒后门影响、可被推断类攻击泄露训练信息，且同一决策能力是双用途的——防御与滥用并存。

papers.title: TeleGen: Improving LLM-Based Web Application Generation via Runtime Telemetry
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can generate runnable web applications from natural-language requirements, but many generated applications still fail interactive tasks. Existing generate-execute-repair pipelines execute the generated application and use task outcomes or error messages to guide code revision. However, this feedback often misses the runtime behavior between a browser action and the final task outcome, making interaction-level failures difficult to diagnose. Therefore, we propose TeleGen, an observability-enhanced framework for LLM-based web application generation. TeleGen instruments generated applications, collects runtime telemetry during task execution, and compresses raw telemetry logs into concise briefs for repair. We evaluate TeleGen on WebGen-Bench and Web-Bench. On WebGen-Bench, TeleGen improves task success from 67.7% with repair without telemetry to 76.2%, an increase of 8.5 percentage points. On Web-Bench, it improves cumulative Pass@2 from 21.7% to 29.8%. Ablation results show that runtime telemetry provides a useful diagnostic signal, while telemetry briefs make this signal more effective and less costly to use. Further analysis shows that telemetry is especially helpful for failures involving hidden execution paths, such as navigation, form workflows, and frontend-backend coordination.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TeleGen 为 LLM 生成的 Web 应用加运行时遥测：插桩被生成的应用、在任务执行中采集遥测并压缩成简短 brief 供修复使用。在 WebGen-Bench 上任务成功率从无遥测修复的 67.7% 提到 76.2%（+8.5 个百分点），Web-Bench 上累计 Pass@2 从 21.7% 提到 29.8%；对导航、表单流程、前后端协同这类隐藏执行路径的失败帮助最大。
Motivation: 现有 generate-execute-repair 流水线只用任务结果或报错信息指导改代码，看不到浏览器动作与最终结果之间的运行时行为，交互级失败难以定位。
Method: TeleGen 是一个可观测性增强的 LLM Web 应用生成框架：对生成的应用做插桩，在任务执行期间采集运行时遥测，再把原始遥测日志压缩成简明 brief 送入修复环节；在 WebGen-Bench 与 Web-Bench 上评测，并做消融区分遥测本身与 brief 的作用。
Result: WebGen-Bench 任务成功率 67.7%（repair without telemetry）→ 76.2%，提升 8.5 个百分点；Web-Bench 累计 Pass@2 21.7% → 29.8%。消融显示运行时遥测提供有用诊断信号，而 telemetry brief 让该信号更有效、使用成本更低；进一步分析表明遥测对涉及隐藏执行路径的失败（导航、表单工作流、前后端协同）尤其有帮助。
Conclusion: 浏览器动作与任务结果之间的运行时遥测是 LLM Web 应用修复的有效诊断信号，压缩成 brief 后可用性与成本都更好。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Preference Optimization for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Preference alignment has become a standard practice for text-to-image diffusion models. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) simplifies this process by eliminating explicit reward modeling. Its diffusion variant, Diffusion-DPO, has become a widely adopted baseline. Diffusion-DPO essentially encourages the likelihood of preferred samples while suppressing dispreferred ones. In this paper, we revisit DPO-style alignment methods for diffusion models from the perspective of the manifold hypothesis. Under this view, natural images concentrate near a low-dimensional manifold embedded in the high-dimensional ambient space, whereas DPO directly optimizes preference distributions in the full space without accounting for this geometric structure. This creates a mismatch in the optimization dynamics: it suppresses geometry-preserving tangential updates, while insufficiently restricting hazardous normal-direction updates. This mismatch gradually degrades image quality and diversity. To address this issue, we propose Anisotropic Geometry-Aware Preference Optimization (APO), which replaces the uniform Euclidean treatment of prediction errors with a geometry-aware anisotropic metric derived from the reference model. Concretely, APO adaptively strengthens regularization in directions where the reference denoising function is highly sensitive, while relaxing constraints in directions that permit safe semantic adjustment. This recalibrates preference optimization according to the local manifold geometry, and maintains the original manifold structure. Experiments show that APO achieves strong performance and an average win rate exceeding 60\% against various existing alignment methods across diverse benchmarks. It requires significantly fewer training steps than prior methods, and preserves generation diversity throughout training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从流形假设重审扩散模型的 DPO 类对齐：自然图像集中在低维流形上，而 Diffusion-DPO 在全空间均匀优化偏好，压制了保持几何的切向更新、却放过了危险的法向更新，导致画质与多样性逐步退化。提出的 APO 用参考模型导出的各向异性度量替换均匀欧氏度量，在参考去噪函数敏感的方向加强正则、在允许安全语义调整的方向放松约束；平均胜率超过 60%，且训练步数显著更少。
Motivation: Diffusion-DPO 作为广泛采用的基线在全空间均匀处理预测误差，忽略图像的低维流形结构，优化动力学与几何不匹配，使画质和多样性随训练逐渐退化。
Method: 提出 Anisotropic Geometry-Aware Preference Optimization (APO)：用参考模型导出的几何感知各向异性度量替换均匀欧氏度量，对参考去噪函数高敏感方向自适应加强正则，对可安全语义调整的方向放松约束，从而按局部流形几何重校准偏好优化并保持原有流形结构。
Result: 在多个多样 benchmark 上，APO 平均胜率超过 60%，对手为多种已有对齐方法；所需训练步数显著少于先前方法，并在整个训练过程中保持生成多样性。
Conclusion: 按局部流形几何做各向异性正则的偏好优化，可以在更少训练步数下取得强对齐表现，同时不牺牲生成多样性。

papers.title: Robust Tensor Completion via Reflective Convolution Nuclear Norm Minimization
papers.abstract_en: Robust tensor completion recovers multidimensional data from partial observations corrupted by sparse gross errors. Existing convolutional low-rank models typically construct translated copies using circular continuation, which introduces artificial wrap-around neighborhoods for finite nonperiodic data. We propose reflective convolution nuclear norm minimization (RCNNM), which replaces circular shifts with endpoint-nonrepeating reflection. The resulting lifting has nonuniform entry multiplicities and satisfies a weighted Gram identity that supports both the recovery analysis and the optimization method. Under random sampling and sparse corruption, we establish high-probability exact recovery of the underlying tensor and sparse errors, together with stability under bounded dense perturbations. We further develop a two-block ADMM with a closed-form entrywise tensor update, while singular-value thresholding is implemented through the smaller right Gram matrix. Experiments on synthetic tensors, BSDS color images, and CAVE multispectral images show that RCNNM consistently improves over its circular-lifting counterpart, with the clearest gains near image boundaries. In particular, average boundary-PSNR improvements reach 3.26 dB while global reconstruction quality remains competitive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RCNNM 用端点不重复的反射平移替代卷积低秩模型中的循环延拓，消除有限非周期数据的环绕伪邻域，得到非均匀重数的 lifting 与加权 Gram 恒等式。在随机采样加稀疏大误差下给出底层张量与稀疏误差的高概率精确恢复及有界稠密扰动下的稳定性，并用两块 ADMM 求解。在合成张量、BSDS 彩色图像与 CAVE 多光谱图像上一致优于循环 lifting 版本，边界平均 PSNR 提升达 3.26 dB，全局重建质量保持竞争力。
Motivation: 卷积低秩模型用循环延拓构造平移副本，会给有限非周期数据引入人造的环绕邻域，边界处恢复质量受损。
Method: 提出 reflective convolution nuclear norm minimization (RCNNM)，以反射平移替代循环平移，得到非均匀条目重数的 lifting 与加权 Gram 恒等式，支撑恢复分析与优化；求解用两块 ADMM，张量更新有闭式逐条目形式，奇异值阈值通过较小的右 Gram 矩阵实现。
Result: 在随机采样与稀疏污染下建立底层张量与稀疏误差的高概率精确恢复，以及有界稠密扰动下的稳定性；在合成张量、BSDS 彩色图像和 CAVE 多光谱图像上，RCNNM 一致优于循环 lifting 对应方法，边界平均 PSNR 提升达 3.26 dB，全局重建质量保持竞争力，增益在图像边界处最明显。
Conclusion: 对有限非周期数据，用反射平移取代循环延拓可同时改善恢复理论与边界处的重建质量，且全局质量不牺牲。

papers.title: What Will Post-Training Fix? Per-Problem Gains Are Shared Across Independent RL Runs, and Existing Checkpoints Predict Them Better Than A Priori Signals
papers.abstract_en: Data selection, curricula and the evaluation of post-training recipes all assume that we can tell, before training, which problems a model will improve on. We test this assumption directly. For two base models, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, we evaluate eighteen post-training runs on up to 1532 competition math problems with many samples per problem, and compare signals available before training against a noise ceiling derived from the agreement between disjoint subsets of runs. Three findings hold on both base models. What post-training fixes is shared: independent runs agree on which rarely solved problems improve, with a noise ceiling of about 0.9, yet the two base models agree with each other only at rho=0.25 - the shared component belongs to the base model, not to the problem. A priori signals capture a minority of it: base pass rate, the likelihood of a correct solution, a larger model's pass rate and their combinations explain only 0.30 and 0.24 of the explainable variance in gains. Existing checkpoints are the better predictor: the per-problem gains of a single checkpoint from another family predict a new run better than every a priori signal, alone or combined (0.52 vs. 0.33 and 0.34 vs. 0.17 against the combined signals). The conclusions hold on problems from 2025-2026 competitions and when the baselines on the two sides of every comparison are estimated independently. We propose the noise ceiling as a standard companion to per-problem signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在两个 1.5B 基座模型上对 18 次数学后训练做逐题增益分析：独立运行之间对哪些低通过率题目变好高度一致（噪声上限约 0.9），但两个基座模型之间仅 rho=0.25，说明共享成分属于基座而非题目本身。先验信号（base pass rate、正确解似然、更大模型通过率及其组合）只能解释可解释方差的 0.30 与 0.24，而来自另一家族的单个已有 checkpoint 预测新运行更好（0.52 vs 0.33、0.34 vs 0.17）。作者建议把噪声上限作为逐题信号的标准伴随指标。
Motivation: 数据选择、课程设计与后训练配方评估都默认能在训练前判断模型会在哪些题目上变好，但这一假设此前未被直接检验，且逐题增益本身含噪声，缺少衡量信号可解释上限的基准。
Method: 对 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 与 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 两个基座各做多次独立后训练，共 18 次运行，评测至多 1532 道竞赛数学题且每题多次采样；用互不相交运行子集之间的一致性构造噪声上限，再把先验信号（base pass rate、正确解似然、更大模型通过率及组合）与跨家族已有 checkpoint 的逐题增益预测力对比。
Result: 独立运行对哪些罕见解出的题目改善高度一致，噪声上限约 0.9；两个基座模型之间仅 rho=0.25。先验信号及其组合只解释可解释增益方差的 0.30 与 0.24；单个跨家族 checkpoint 的预测力为 0.52 与 0.34，对比组合先验信号的 0.33 与 0.17。结论在 2025-2026 年竞赛题目以及两侧基线独立估计的设定下仍成立。
Conclusion: 后训练逐题增益的共享成分来自基座模型而非题目固有属性，因此已有 checkpoint 比任何先验信号更能预测新运行会在哪些题上变好；噪声上限应作为逐题信号的标准伴随指标。
