papers.title: Static Bootstrap Placement for Encrypted Language Model Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Language models increasingly serve prompts that carry private data, and secure inference under homomorphic encryption lets a client outsource the computation without revealing the prompt. Existing secure inference systems run a forward pass without consuming a token under encryption, and generating text with them requires a client round trip at every generated token. Keeping the loop on the server instead requires selecting and consuming a token under encryption, and placing bootstraps for a loop body that grows with the context. We build AR-HE, which runs the whole loop on the server, selects each token under encryption, retrieves its embedding, and writes it back into the encrypted state. The client sends one prompt and remains offline until the output. One rule places every bootstrap in the run, without search, so the bootstrap cost of a token is a formula in the context length that is known before the run starts. The schedule skips work whose result cannot reach the output, packs bootstraps that share an operand, and keeps the keys and values of past positions in an encrypted cache. With every optimization applied, generating a GPT-2 small token costs 544 seconds on one NVIDIA H100, down from 4715 seconds without optimization. The prompt step before it costs 4630 seconds. The cache alone takes a generated step from 11751 bootstraps to 1072. The formula predicts every step we measured, including steps of a model it was not derived from.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AR-HE 把同态加密下的自回归解码整环搬到服务端：在加密态下选 token、取 embedding 并写回，客户端只发一次 prompt 即离线。一条无需搜索的规则给出全部 bootstrap 放置，使单 token 的 bootstrap 成本成为开跑前就已知的上下文长度公式；叠加死代码跳过、共享操作数打包与加密 KV cache 后，GPT-2 small 单 token 生成从 4715 秒降到 544 秒（H100 单卡），cache 单独把生成步的 bootstrap 数从 11751 压到 1072。
Motivation: 现有安全推理系统只在加密下跑一次前向、不消费 token，生成每个 token 都要客户端往返；若把循环留在服务端，就必须在加密下选 token 并为随上下文增长的循环体放置 bootstrap，成本不可预知。
Method: AR-HE 在服务端完成整环：加密下选 token、检索 embedding、写回加密状态；用一条无需搜索的规则放置全部 bootstrap，把单 token 成本写成上下文长度的解析式；再加三项优化——跳过结果无法到达输出的工作、打包共享同一操作数的 bootstrap、对历史位置的 key/value 维护加密 cache。
Result: GPT-2 small 单 token 生成 544 秒（无优化 4715 秒），此前的 prompt 步 4630 秒，硬件为单张 NVIDIA H100；仅 cache 一项就把生成步的 bootstrap 数从 11751 降到 1072；该公式预测了所测的每一步，包括并非据以推导的模型上的步。
Conclusion: 加密自回归解码的 bootstrap 成本可以事先写成上下文长度的公式并靠静态放置与 cache 大幅削减，使服务端单往返的安全文本生成在 GPT-2 small 规模上变得可行。

papers.title: VideoResearchAgent: Grounded Task Synthesis and Sim-to-Real RL for Open-Web Video Research
papers.abstract_en: Existing deep research agents are designed primarily for text- and image-based web sources, while video reasoning systems typically assume that relevant videos are provided in advance. We study open-web video research, where an agent must autonomously discover relevant videos, navigate their temporal content, and ground answers in visual evidence. Training such agents at scale is challenging as live video interaction is slow and unreliable, whereas fixed local simulation can induce retrieval-specific shortcuts that fail to transfer to the open web. We introduce VideoResearchAgent, a scalable training framework to address these challenges. First, we introduce controllable task synthesis pipeline to synthesize multi-hop research tasks from timestamped visual evidence while filtering text-only shortcuts. Second, we build a field-aligned local video simulator that preserves deployment-facing search and watch interactions while accelerating video search by a factor of 34.5-64.6. Third, we introduce Retrieval-Domain-Randomized GRPO (RDR-GRPO), which diversifies candidate rankings, distractors, metadata, and result structure during training to reduce overfitting to simulated retrieval. On Video-BrowseComp, the VideoResearchAgent trained using Qwen3.5-4B achieves 40.48% accuracy, comparable to Gemini-3-Flash-Preview, while reducing cumulative API-token consumption by 74.9% relative to the untrained model. Together, these results establish an accurate and efficient training recipe for open-web video research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VideoResearchAgent 针对开放网络视频研究给出可扩展训练配方：可控任务合成从带时间戳的视觉证据生成多跳任务并过滤纯文本捷径，字段对齐的本地视频模拟器把视频搜索加速 34.5–64.6 倍，再用 Retrieval-Domain-Randomized GRPO (RDR-GRPO) 在候选排序、干扰项、元数据与结果结构上做随机化以抑制对模拟检索的过拟合。在 Video-BrowseComp 上，用 Qwen3.5-4B 训练后准确率达 40.48%，与 Gemini-3-Flash-Preview 相当，同时相对未训练模型把累计 API token 消耗降低 74.9%。
Motivation: 现有 deep research agent 面向文本与图像网页，视频推理系统默认视频已给定；而开放网络视频研究要求自主发现视频、按时间导航并以视觉证据作答，线上交互慢且不稳定，固定本地模拟又会引入无法迁移到开放网络的检索捷径。
Method: 三段式训练框架：可控任务合成管线从 timestamped visual evidence 合成多跳研究任务并过滤 text-only shortcut；字段对齐的本地视频模拟器保留部署时的 search 与 watch 交互并加速视频搜索；RDR-GRPO 在训练中随机化候选排序、干扰项、元数据与结果结构，用 Qwen3.5-4B 进行强化学习训练。
Result: 在 Video-BrowseComp 上，Qwen3.5-4B 训练后准确率 40.48%，与 Gemini-3-Flash-Preview 相当；相对未训练模型累计 API token 消耗降低 74.9%；本地模拟器把视频搜索加速 34.5–64.6 倍。
Conclusion: 任务合成加检索域随机化的模拟训练，能让 4B 级模型在开放网络视频研究上达到大模型相当的准确率并大幅削减 token 开销。

papers.title: Why Subliminal Learning Needs So Much Data: A Noisy Inverse View through Steering Vector Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Subliminal learning lets a student inherit a teacher's behavioral trait from semantically unrelated data, yet published demonstrations typically require tens of thousands of carrier examples. We ask where this data requirement comes from. Our testbed is subliminal steering: the teacher trait is a known residual-stream vector $Δ_T$, so transfer can be measured directly as parameter recovery. On identical carrier prefixes, we compare token-level (hard) NLL supervision with full-distribution (soft) KL supervision. At initialization the two objectives give nearly collinear gradients, and both align poorly with $Δ_T$. Under iterative optimization, however, they diverge: soft supervision recovers $Δ_T$ almost exactly from a few hundred carriers, while hard supervision stays well below it even with tens of thousands. We explain this gap by casting steering-vector distillation as a noisy linear inverse problem. Locally, the carrier task maps the trait through its Fisher matrix $F$, so gradients point toward $FΔ_T$ rather than $Δ_T$. Gradient descent then acts as a progressively less-damped inverse of $F$. With soft targets, this inverse restores low-curvature directions. With hard labels, it also amplifies the sampling noise in those same directions. The result is an optimal inversion depth that grows with the number of independent carriers. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B and Gemma-2-9B confirm four predictions: the Fisher distortion of the initial gradient, recovery ordered from steep to flat directions, an optimal depth that shifts with data scale, and the finding that resampling completions from a fixed prompt pool works as well as adding new prompts. In this setting, large carrier datasets are needed less to reveal the trait than to suppress label noise amplified by Fisher inversion. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/luoyuchenmlcv/subliminal-data}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 以 subliminal steering 为测试台，把特质向量 Δ_T 的恢复看作带噪线性逆问题：载荷任务经 Fisher 矩阵 F 映射特质，梯度指向 FΔ_T 而非 Δ_T，梯度下降相当于对 F 逐步减弱阻尼的求逆。软 KL 监督在几百个载荷样本上几乎精确恢复 Δ_T，硬 NLL 监督即使上万样本仍远低于真值；大载荷数据集的作用是压制 Fisher 求逆放大的标签噪声，而非揭示特质本身。
Motivation: Subliminal learning 已有演示普遍需要数万个载荷样本，但这一数据需求从何而来尚无解释；作者要区分数据是在揭示特质还是在抵消噪声。
Method: 测试台为 subliminal steering：教师特质是已知残差流向量 Δ_T，迁移质量直接度量为参数恢复。在相同载荷前缀上对比 token 级硬 NLL 监督与全分布软 KL 监督，并把特质蒸馏建模为带噪线性逆问题，用载荷任务的 Fisher 矩阵 F 解释梯度方向与求逆过程；实验在 Qwen2.5-7B 与 Gemma-2-9B 上进行。
Result: 初始化时两种目标梯度几乎共线且都与 Δ_T 对齐很差；迭代优化后分化：软监督从几百个载荷样本几乎精确恢复 Δ_T，硬监督在数万样本下仍远低于真值。实验在 Qwen2.5-7B 与 Gemma-2-9B 上确认四项预测：初始梯度的 Fisher 畸变、从陡峭到平坦方向的恢复次序、最优求逆深度随数据规模移动，以及从固定提示池重采样补全与新增提示效果相当。
Conclusion: 大载荷数据集的必要性在于抑制被 Fisher 求逆放大的标签噪声，而非暴露特质；最优求逆深度随独立载荷数量增长，软目标可在极少数据下完成恢复。

papers.title: Scaling Verifiable Environments for Long-horizon Work Agents
papers.abstract_en: Work agents operate over digital artifacts to execute professional knowledge-intensive work, requiring training environments that support long-horizon interaction and trustworthy verification. However, hand-crafted environments incur prohibitive engineering overhead that prevents environment scaling, whereas synthesis methods sacrifice workspace complexity, realism, or grounded verifiability. To bridge this gap, we introduce WorkForge, a scalable synthesis framework for constructing verifiable work-agent environments from real-world resources. Starting from expert workflows, WorkForge first identifies the resources, decisions, and deliverables required by each workflow. It then retrieves relevant real-world files and organizes them into a workspace. WorkForge inspects the workspace to extract concrete, checkable facts about its content. These factual anchors fix which task types the workspace can support and how their outcomes can be verified. Therefore, WorkForge derives each task's instructions, solution plan, and complementary programmatic and semantic verifiers directly from these factual anchors, keeping verification traceable to observable workspace evidence. Furthermore, we construct 16.7K verifiable environments across 40 professional domains, with workspaces collectively covering 60 file types. Post-training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base improves GDPVal from 45.5 to 73.6 and APEX Score from 5.0 to 21.3, while enabling Qwen3.5-27B to achieve highly competitive performance and outperform strong competitors. Our analyses confirm the efficacy of the proposed method and reveal consistent scaling behaviors across both data volume and interaction horizons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorkForge 用真实资源自动合成可验证的工作智能体 (work-agent) 训练环境：从专家工作流抽取资源、决策与交付物，检索真实文件组成 workspace，再从 workspace 中提取可核验的事实锚点 (factual anchors)，据此派生任务指令、解题计划以及程序化与语义验证器。构建出覆盖 40 个职业领域、60 种文件类型的 16.7K 个可验证环境，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base 后训练后 GDPVal 从 45.5 升到 73.6、APEX Score 从 5.0 升到 21.3。
Motivation: 手工构造的训练环境工程开销过高，无法规模化；已有合成方法又牺牲 workspace 复杂度、真实性或可落地的可验证性，长时程、可信验证的工作智能体训练环境因此短缺。
Method: 从专家工作流出发，识别所需资源、决策与交付物；检索相关真实文件并组织成 workspace；检查 workspace 提取关于其内容的具体可核验事实，这些事实锚点限定 workspace 支持的任务类型及其结果验证方式；再直接从事实锚点派生任务指令、解题计划与程序化+语义双验证器，使验证可追溯到可观测的 workspace 证据。
Result: 构建 16.7K 个可验证环境，覆盖 40 个职业领域、workspace 合计 60 种文件类型；后训练 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base 使 GDPVal 从 45.5 提升到 73.6，APEX Score 从 5.0 提升到 21.3，并使 Qwen3.5-27B 达到很有竞争力的表现、胜过强竞争对手；分析显示数据量与交互时程两个维度上均有一致的 scaling 行为。
Conclusion: 以事实锚点驱动的环境合成能在保住 workspace 复杂度与可验证性的同时规模化构造工作智能体环境，并在数据量和交互时程上呈现一致的扩展规律。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ScopeSAE: Model-Scope Feature Discovery with Interpretable Layer Selection
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are a central tool in mechanistic interpretability. However, existing SAEs are primarily trained per layer. The modeling subspace is therefore fixed by layer identity, independent of which token-layer states actually drive each prediction. We argue that this constraint contributes to several limitations observed in layer-wise SAEs, including low feature utilization, high dictionary redundancy, and features that lack direct behavioral grounding. In this paper, we propose ScopeSAE, which selects the modeling subspace per token by attributing each prediction to its most influential token-layer state via normalized gradient-based attribution, and learns features over the resulting prediction-relevant subspace. Empirically, ScopeSAE yields an effect we term reconstruction-better-than-original. Written-back reconstructions of the SAE produce lower next-token cross-entropy than the original activations, an outcome that, to our knowledge, has not previously been reported for SAEs. Through interventional analyses and a KL fine-tuning counter-experiment, we show that this effect is attributable to ScopeSAE's prediction-relevant subspace itself rather than to architectural changes. ScopeSAE further improves effective feature count, interpretability, utilization, and dictionary redundancy over existing layer-based baselines, suggesting that choosing the SAE modeling subspace by predictive relevance leads to more useful and behaviorally meaningful features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ScopeSAE 按 token 用归一化梯度归因挑出对该预测最有影响的 token-layer 状态，在这个预测相关子空间上训练 SAE，而非固定在单层。写回重构后的 next-token 交叉熵低于原始激活，即 reconstruction-better-than-original；干预分析与 KL 微调反实验表明该效应来自子空间选择本身而非结构改动。
Motivation: 现有 SAE 按层训练，建模子空间被层身份固定，与实际驱动预测的 token-layer 状态无关，导致特征利用率低、字典冗余高、特征缺少行为 grounding。
Method: 用归一化梯度归因 (normalized gradient-based attribution) 把每个预测归到最有影响的 token-layer 状态，按 token 选出预测相关子空间并在其上学习特征；用干预分析和 KL 微调反实验区分效应来源。
Result: SAE 写回重构使 next-token 交叉熵低于原始激活（reconstruction-better-than-original，摘要称此前未见报道）；相对现有 layer-based 基线，有效特征数、可解释性、利用率与字典冗余均改善。
Conclusion: 按预测相关性而非层身份选择 SAE 建模子空间，能得到更有用、更具行为意义的特征，且交叉熵下降由子空间本身而非架构改动造成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Evaluating Recursive Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recursive language-model agents decompose tasks and delegate subtasks to child instances of the same policy, forming a tree of work. Training them, however, is hard: the final outcome is verifiable, but the self-invented intermediate subtasks are numerous and carry no ground truth. Existing methods score each node with a verifier or judge, which is costly at scale and blind to decomposition quality. We argue that a recursive agent must learn three coupled capabilities within one set of weights: decomposing problems into subtasks, solving them, and evaluating the outcomes, each requiring its own training signal. SERA (Self-Evaluating Recursive Agents) turns evaluation into a learned capability of the policy itself. Before delegating, the parent writes a rubric of weighted success criteria for each child subtask; a ranking objective against verified outcomes then trains rubric generation so that the criteria track genuine subtask success. In addition, a complementary leaf-coverage signal provides direct credit for task decomposition. Our central finding is that \emph{training} the policy to generate aligned rubrics is what drives the gains: because the same weights both evaluate and execute, learning to judge subtasks sharpens the agent's ability to solve them. Notably, external supervision is also reduced: the judge is consulted only to train the rubric generator, while solving is trained against the agent's own rubric scores, which outperform direct use of the judge. Beyond training, the learned rubric doubles as an inference-time selector for tree search. On TextCraft-Synth and TextWorld-Sync, SERA improves over strong recursive-agent baselines by 5.38 and 13.14 points on average, and rubric-guided tree search at inference adds a further 2.43 points on TextWorld-Sync.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SERA 把「评估子任务」变成递归 agent 策略自身的一项可训练能力：父节点在委派前为每个子任务写出带权重的成功准则 rubric，用针对已验证结果的排序目标训练 rubric 生成，再让求解过程直接对着 agent 自己的 rubric 打分训练。核心发现是训练 rubric 生成带来的对齐正是增益来源——同一份权重既评估又执行，学会评判子任务会反过来提升解题能力；在 TextCraft-Synth 与 TextWorld-Sync 上平均超过强递归 agent 基线 5.38 与 13.14 分，推理期用 rubric 引导树搜索再在 TextWorld-Sync 上加 2.43 分。
Motivation: 递归 agent 把任务拆成子树交给同策略的子实例，最终结果可验证但自创的中间子任务数量庞大且没有 ground truth；现有方法用 verifier/judge 给每个节点打分，规模化代价高，而且看不出分解质量好坏。
Method: SERA (Self-Evaluating Recursive Agents) 在一组权重内同时训练分解、求解、评估三种能力：委派前父节点为每个子任务生成加权成功准则 rubric，用针对已验证结果的 ranking objective 训练 rubric 生成使其对齐真实子任务成功；再用 leaf-coverage 信号给分解本身提供直接 credit；求解阶段不直接用 judge，而是对着 agent 自己的 rubric 打分训练，judge 只在训练 rubric 生成器时被调用。
Result: 在 TextCraft-Synth 与 TextWorld-Sync 上，SERA 平均比强递归 agent 基线分别高 5.38 与 13.14 分；推理期 rubric 引导的 tree search 在 TextWorld-Sync 上再增加 2.43 分。用 agent 自己的 rubric 打分训练求解，效果超过直接使用 judge。
Conclusion: 让策略学会生成对齐的 rubric 是递归 agent 增益的驱动因素，且可同时削减外部监督：judge 只用于训练 rubric 生成器，学到的 rubric 还能在推理期充当树搜索的节点选择器。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A Systematic Analysis of the Predictive Power of LM Surprisal in Reading Chinese
authors: (5) Division of Linguistics and Multilingual Studies
(6) Department of Language Science and Technology/Division of AI and the Humanities
papers.abstract_en: This study analyzes the predictive power of LM-derived, token-level surprisal on Mandarin Chinese reading times. We first propose the Shortest Matching Sequence (SMS), an alignment scheme that maps between the word segmentation assumed by eye-tracking corpora and the LMs' subword tokenization, as the two tokenizations often disagree in the context of Mandarin Chinese. Then, using a suite of Chinese-Pythia models (14M-1.4B) trained on scratch with 30B tokens, we examine how well surprisal predicts first fixation duration, gaze duration, and total reading time in three paragraph-level eye-tracking corpora of Mandarin Chinese (GECO-CN, HKP, and MECO). Contrary to previous null findings, our results show that surprisal is predictive of Chinese reading times. However, whether predictive power scales with model size and the amount of training is corpus-specific: bigger models predict better in GECO-CN, whereas inverse scaling emerges in HKP and, at the largest sizes, in MECO. Subsequently, we tested one possible explanation for the inverse scaling in HKP and found that checkpoints whose surprisal remains closer to $n$-gram statistics are better predictors of reading. All in all, the predictive power of surprisal on Chinese reading time measurements is corpus-specific, which cautions against drawing scaling conclusions from a single corpus.

papers.title: SFlexRCA: Lightweight, Scalable, and Flexible Root Cause Analysis for IIoT Edge Systems
papers.abstract_en: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) systems generate high-dimensional sensor telemetry from interconnected components, where faults can propagate across the system. To address these challenges, we propose SFlexRCA (Scalable and Flexible Root Cause Analysis), a topology-free RCA framework designed for resource-constrained IIoT environments. SFlexRCA transforms multivariate telemetry into compact orthogonal representations and applies shared lightweight linear modeling, avoiding explicit graph construction, message passing, and per-variable or lag-specific parameter growth. We evaluate SFlexRCA on three publicly available IIoT datasets, BATADAL, SWaT, and WADI, spanning different numbers of monitored variables, temporal characteristics, and training-data regimes. SFlexRCA is compared with 10 statistical, causal, and non-causal baselines in terms of RCA accuracy, training efficiency, inference latency, and memory consumption. In addition, inference efficiency and memory consumption are evaluated on Raspberry Pi 3 and Raspberry Pi 5, while energy consumption is additionally measured on Raspberry Pi 5. We further investigate temporalcontext sensitivity, architectural and loss components, and alternative representations. Notably, SFlexRCA maintains strong localization performance on BATADAL despite its limited normal-operation training data, while its compact shared architecture avoids the parameter growth associated with causal and graph-based approaches. Its lightweight shared architecture further enables efficient deployment on resource-constrained IIoT edge devices. The SFlexRCA code is available at https://github.com/theamrzaki/RootCause- Analysis-Correlation-Attentive-Modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SFlexRCA 是面向资源受限 IIoT 边缘设备的无拓扑根因分析框架：把多变量遥测变换成紧凑正交表示，再用共享的轻量线性建模定位故障源，避免显式构图、消息传递和按变量/滞后的参数膨胀。在 BATADAL、SWaT、WADI 三个公开数据集上与 10 个统计、因果与非因果基线比较 RCA 精度、训练效率、推理延迟与内存，并在 Raspberry Pi 3/5 上实测；即便正常运行训练数据有限，BATADAL 上仍保持强定位性能。
Motivation: IIoT 高维传感器遥测中故障会沿互联部件传播，而因果与图方法需要显式构图和按变量、滞后增长的参数，在资源受限边缘设备上难以部署。
Method: 将多变量遥测变换为紧凑正交表示，配合共享的轻量线性建模，不做图构建与消息传递；在 BATADAL、SWaT、WADI 上与 10 个统计、因果、非因果基线对比，评测 RCA 精度、训练效率、推理延迟与内存，并在 Raspberry Pi 3 和 5 上测推理效率与内存、在 Raspberry Pi 5 上额外测能耗，另做时序上下文敏感性、架构与损失组件、替代表示的消融。
Result: 在三个公开 IIoT 数据集 BATADAL、SWaT、WADI 上对比 10 个基线，指标为 RCA 精度、训练效率、推理延迟、内存；Raspberry Pi 3/5 上测推理效率与内存，Raspberry Pi 5 上测能耗。BATADAL 正常运行训练数据有限的条件下 SFlexRCA 仍保持强定位性能，且共享紧凑架构避免了因果与图方法的参数增长。
Conclusion: 不做拓扑、共享参数的线性化 RCA 可以在训练数据受限时保住定位精度，同时把部署开销压到树莓派级边缘设备可承受的范围。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ForkPilot: Self-Evolving Policy for Retrospective Search in Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Interactive language-model agents increasingly solve complex tasks through long-horizon, multi-call reasoning, where errors in beliefs or actions can compound across tool interactions. Retrospective search can recover from such failures but is prone to misallocation. Delayed outcomes obscure the contribution of intermediate search decisions, leading to Attribution Complexity, while evolving execution evidence leads to Adaptation Complexity, where previously learned estimates become stale. To address these challenges, we first introduce Search Value Dynamics (SVD), which characterizes the evolving trade-off between the gain and cost of retrospective search. Building on SVD, we propose ForkPilot, a self-evolving two-stage policy-learning framework. In the first stage, ForkPilot learns a search-value policy offline from completed trajectories through automatically constructed outcome comparisons. In the second stage, it makes search decisions based on current observations and then self-evolves by incorporating newly completed trajectories into subsequent policy updates. We evaluate ForkPilot across 6 diverse benchmarks and 7 widely used LLM backbone families, including four open-source families, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Opus 4.8 in a production agentic system, against 9 competitive baselines, including a real-world harness deployment used by hundreds of thousands of paid users. ForkPilot achieves comparable state-of-the-art performance while reducing token usage by up to 59.2%, demonstrating its efficacy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ForkPilot 是面向长程多调用智能体的自演化两阶段策略学习框架，用 Search Value Dynamics (SVD) 刻画回溯搜索 (retrospective search) 的收益-成本权衡，先从已完成轨迹的自动结果对比中离线学搜索价值策略，再把新完成轨迹并入后续更新实现自演化。在 6 个基准、7 个 LLM 主干家族（含 GPT-5.6 Sol、Opus 4.8 的生产级智能体系统）对 9 个基线的评测中达到可比的最先进性能，token 用量最多减少 59.2%。
Motivation: 长程智能体中信念与动作误差会跨工具调用累积，回溯搜索能纠错但易误配：延迟结果掩盖中间搜索决策的贡献（Attribution Complexity），执行证据不断演化又使已学估计过期（Adaptation Complexity）。
Method: 先提出 Search Value Dynamics (SVD) 刻画回溯搜索收益与成本的动态权衡；再提出两阶段的 ForkPilot：第一阶段从已完成轨迹经自动构造的结果对比 (outcome comparisons) 离线学习搜索价值策略，第二阶段依据当前观测做搜索决策，并把新完成轨迹纳入后续策略更新以自演化。
Result: 在 6 个多样基准、7 个广泛使用的 LLM 主干家族（含四个开源家族、GPT-5.6 Sol、Opus 4.8 的生产 agentic 系统）上对 9 个竞争基线评测，达到可比的最先进性能，token 用量最多减少 59.2%；其中一个基线为数十万付费用户在用的真实 harness 部署。
Conclusion: 把回溯搜索决策建模为可随新轨迹持续更新的价值策略，能在保持最先进水平的同时大幅压缩 token 开销，说明自演化策略学习可缓解长程智能体的搜索误配与估计过期问题。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Reflection-Robust 6DoF Object Tracking with Light Fields
papers.abstract_en: Tracking the 6DoF pose of a moving rigid object is fundamental to robotics and autonomous driving, but existing trackers assume that object appearance is stable across a sequence, an assumption that breaks down on reflective surfaces whose appearance changes as they mirror the environment. We introduce a light field based reflection-robust 6DoF tracker that turns this apparent nuisance into a pose cue. Per frame, our method recovers depth robustly against reflections, back-projects it into a point cloud, and estimates surface normals. It then decomposes the object's view-dependent appearance into a diffuse albedo and the environment map it reflects, resulting in a relightable surface light field. Starting from a coarse initialization, we relight it by the recovered environment map and optimize the pose on the photometric loss. Because a moving object mirrors new parts of the scene, the environment map fills in as the sequence proceeds, sharpening this signal over time. To evaluate this approach, we introduce a light field tracking dataset re-rendered from a robotic manipulation benchmark at four controlled reflectivity levels, each paired with simulated depth that reproduces how consumer RGB-D sensors fail on shiny surfaces. Additionally, we evaluate on two captured light field sequences. Our method trails the strongest baselines on diffuse objects and is the only one that holds its accuracy on fully reflective objects, where every baseline degrades.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于光场的抗反射 6DoF 刚体位姿跟踪器：逐帧抗反射恢复深度并反投影成点云、估计表面法线，把视角相关外观分解为漫反射 albedo 与环境贴图，得到可重光照表面光场，再用恢复的环境贴图重光照并以光度损失优化位姿。物体移动时镜像到新场景使环境贴图逐步补全、信号随时间变锐；在四个受控反射率层级的重渲染数据集上，漫反射物体略逊于最强基线，但在全反射物体上是唯一保持精度的方法，所有基线均退化。
Motivation: 现有 6DoF 跟踪器假设物体外观在序列中稳定，而反射表面会随镜像环境改变外观，该假设在机器人操作与自动驾驶的高反光物体上失效。
Method: 逐帧抗反射恢复深度并反投影为点云、估计表面法线；将视角相关外观分解为 diffuse albedo 与环境贴图，构成可重光照表面光场 (relightable surface light field)；从粗初始化出发用恢复的环境贴图重光照，在光度损失上优化位姿，环境贴图随序列推进逐步补全。
Result: 新建光场跟踪数据集：从一个机器人操作基准重渲染，含 4 个受控反射率层级，每层配仿真深度以复现消费级 RGB-D 传感器在光滑表面的失效；另在 2 段实拍光场序列上评测。漫反射物体上方法落后于最强基线，全反射物体上是唯一保持精度的，所有基线均退化。
Conclusion: 把反射从干扰变成位姿线索可行：随物体移动补全的环境贴图让光度信号随时间变锐，使跟踪在全反射物体上不退化，代价是漫反射物体上精度略逊最强基线。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ResOPD: Tail Residualization for Sparse On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on self-generated trajectories, but transmitting dense teacher distributions across long reasoning traces creates prohibitive communication and memory bottlenecks. Practical systems therefore rely on sparse teacher interfaces, typically transmitting either the sampled-token score or a small Top-$k$ distribution. However, this sparse setting faces a fundamental dilemma: sampled-token estimators are unbiased but suffer from severe gradient variance, whereas directly optimizing Top-$k$ objectives introduces systematic bias. To improve this trade-off, we propose ResOPD (On-Policy Distillation with Tail Residualization), which provides unbiased full-vocabulary reverse KL gradient estimation under on-policy sampling, with substantial variance reduction under the same sparse payload in the evaluated settings. ResOPD aggregates the unobserved vocabulary into an observable coarse tail event, computes its exact aggregate gradient, and samples only the fine-grained within-tail residual, which requires no additional teacher queries or forward passes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ResOPD substantially reduces gradient variance, stabilizes online training dynamics, and improves downstream performance across the evaluated settings. These results establish ResOPD as an efficient, plug-and-play variance reduction primitive for sparse on-policy distillation.

Conclusion: ResOPD 可作为稀疏 on-policy distillation 的即插即用方差缩减原语，在不增加通信与计算开销的前提下兼顾无偏性与低方差。

papers.title: Bounded Reasoning: Cognitive Hierarchy in Human-versus-AI Cyber Defense
papers.abstract_en: Human-agent evaluations often compress interaction into a single performance score, even when human and automated policies adapt differently over time. We study this in a sequential cyber-defense game on an attack graph, where a human or reinforcement-learning defender protects cloud assets against a Deep Q-Network (DQN) attacker. We compare four defender settings: a human reward-only game operationalizing the DQN information structure, a human reward-plus-transition game operationalizing the Cognitive Hierarchy Theory-driven DQN (CHT-DQN) information structure, an automated DQN defender, and an automated CHT-DQN defender. In the reward-only game, participants receive payoff and reward feedback. In the reward-plus-transition game, they also see attacker-aware transition probabilities from the CHT-DQN model. Across 80 Mechanical Turk participants and matched automated simulations, human defenders adapted to outcomes in a way the automated defenders did not: they were more likely to reselect a node after a successful defense than after a failure, in both games, an asymmetry we interpret as consistent with Prospect Theory and Cumulative Prospect Theory. The 40-round average also mixes early rounds, where the DQN attacker acts mostly at random, with late rounds, where it mostly exploits; in the final stage, mean protection ranks the reward-plus-transition human game above the reward-only human game, then the automated CHT-DQN defender, then the automated DQN defender, an ordering the overall mean hides. By contrast, the reward-plus-transition game does not produce a statistically reliable overall gain in weighted data protection over the reward-only game. These results suggest that evaluating human-agent cyber-defense systems only by an averaged task score can miss behaviorally meaningful differences in adaptation, action allocation, and bounded human reasoning.
papers.comment: 9 pages, accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Human-AI Coevolution (HAIC)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在攻击图上的序列化网络防御博弈中，80 名 Mechanical Turk 参与者与匹配的 DQN/CHT-DQN 自动防御者对比：人类防御者在防守成功后更倾向重选同一节点、失败后不然，自动防御者没有这种不对称；40 轮平均分掩盖了末段排序（reward-plus-transition 人类 > reward-only 人类 > 自动 CHT-DQN > 自动 DQN），而 reward-plus-transition 相对 reward-only 在加权数据保护上没有统计可靠的总体提升。
Motivation: 人机协同评估常把整段交互压成单一平均分，但人类与自动策略随时间的适应方式不同，平均分会掩盖行为层面的差异。
Method: 在攻击图上的序列化网络防御博弈中比较四种防御者设定：reward-only 人类博弈（对应 DQN 信息结构）、reward-plus-transition 人类博弈（额外给出 CHT-DQN 模型的攻击者感知转移概率）、自动 DQN 防御者、自动 CHT-DQN 防御者；攻击者为 DQN，实验含 80 名 Mechanical Turk 参与者与匹配的自动仿真，共 40 轮。
Result: 人类防御者在两种博弈中都更可能在防守成功后重选该节点、失败后不然，自动防御者无此不对称（解释为与 Prospect Theory / Cumulative Prospect Theory 一致）；40 轮平均混合了早期近随机与后期以利用为主的 DQN 攻击者，末段平均保护排序为 reward-plus-transition 人类 > reward-only 人类 > 自动 CHT-DQN > 自动 DQN，而总体均值隐藏了该排序；reward-plus-transition 相对 reward-only 在加权数据保护上没有统计可靠的总体增益。
Conclusion: 只用平均任务分评估人机网络防御系统会漏掉适应方式、行动分配与有界人类推理上的行为差异，因此评估应分阶段并保留行为指标。

papers.title: SpecFold: Folding Multi-Branch Redundancy for Faster Speculative Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion large language models (DLLMs) generate text through iterative block denoising, and multi-branch speculative decoding accelerates this process by verifying a main branch together with multiple draft branches in a single forward pass. While prior DLLM acceleration methods primarily exploit temporal redundancy across denoising steps, we identify a complementary redundancy axis within each speculative verification step: multi-branch computational redundancy. During speculative verification, draft branches inherit most tokens from their parents while unmasking a small set of additional positions, causing large portions of hidden states to remain highly similar across branches. We propose SpecFold, an algorithm-system co-design that exploits this multi-branch redundancy to reduce the cost of multi-branch speculative verification. Algorithmically, SpecFold performs token-level residual gating and selectively reuses parent computation through folded attention and FFN while preserving residual hidden states. Systemically, a Triton kernel implementation translates this fine-grained reuse into end-to-end throughput gains through efficient sparse multi-branch execution. SpecFold is orthogonal to temporal caching and compatible with existing DLLM speculation strategies. Across two DLLM families, five models, and five standard benchmarks, SpecFold achieves up to 1.64x throughput over Spiffy and up to 1.99x over vanilla decoding, while maintaining comparable task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpecFold 针对扩散语言模型 (DLLM) 多分支投机验证中的分支间计算冗余，用 token 级残差门控选择性复用父分支的 attention 与 FFN 计算，并以 Triton kernel 实现稀疏多分支执行。在两个 DLLM 家族、五个模型、五个标准基准上，相对 Spiffy 最高 1.64 倍吞吐、相对原始解码最高 1.99 倍，任务性能相当。
Motivation: DLLM 的多分支投机解码在单次前向里验证主分支加多个草稿分支，各分支大量继承父分支 token，隐藏状态高度相似，带来分支间计算冗余；已有加速方法主要利用去噪步间的时间冗余，这一轴未被利用。
Method: 算法侧做 token 级残差门控，通过 folded attention 与 FFN 选择性复用父分支计算并保留残差隐藏状态；系统侧用 Triton kernel 把细粒度复用转成稀疏多分支执行。方法与时序缓存正交，兼容现有 DLLM 投机策略。
Result: 在两个 DLLM 家族、五个模型、五个标准基准上，相对 Spiffy 吞吐最高提升 1.64 倍，相对 vanilla 解码最高 1.99 倍，任务性能保持相当。
Conclusion: 多分支投机验证中的分支间冗余是与时间冗余互补的加速轴，算法-系统协同复用可把它转成端到端吞吐收益且不损失任务性能。

papers.title: When the noncommutative AM-GM inequality holds
papers.abstract_en: In this note, we prove that the noncommutative AM-GM inequality holds if $n\ge 2\lceil m/2 \rceil^2$. The motivation comes from counterexamples constructed in [De Sa, Random reshuffling is not always better, NeurIPS2020]. The proof constructs a vertex measure based on the Chebyshev nodes on the Boolean cube to extract the distinct indices. The main difficulty is that the measure is not positive on non-integer nodes. The key technique comes from [Grigoriev, Complexity of Positivstellensatz proofs for the knapsack, Computational Complexity (2001)] and eventually transforms the problem into a quadrature estimate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明非交换 AM-GM 不等式在 n ≥ 2⌈m/2⌉² 时成立，条件由 De Sa 在 NeurIPS 2020 构造的反例驱动；证明用布尔立方体上的 Chebyshev 节点构造顶点测度提取不同指标，再借 Grigoriev 的 Positivstellensatz 技巧把问题化为求积估计。
Motivation: De Sa 在 Random reshuffling is not always better (NeurIPS 2020) 中给出的反例说明非交换 AM-GM 并非无条件成立，需要刻画其成立的参数区间。
Method: 在布尔立方体上基于 Chebyshev 节点构造顶点测度以提取互异指标；关键难点是该测度在非整数节点上不正，遂采用 Grigoriev 关于 knapsack 的 Positivstellensatz 复杂度论文中的技术，把问题转化为一个求积 (quadrature) 估计。
Result: 得到充分条件 n ≥ 2⌈m/2⌉² 时非交换 AM-GM 不等式成立；摘要给出的是这一理论条件与证明构造，无实验数字。
Conclusion: 非交换 AM-GM 在 n 相对 m 足够大（n ≥ 2⌈m/2⌉²）时成立，反例只出现在参数更小的区域。

papers.title: Your Temporal Link Predictor Is Blind to Who Is Active: A Missing Factor That Transfers Across Models
papers.abstract_en: An interaction has two parts: someone decides to act, and then chooses whom to act on. Temporal link prediction has concentrated on the second, and we show that it is blind to the first by construction: a standard negative keeps the real source and swaps the destination, and we prove that this cancels the source's activity exactly from the optimal score, so no model trained and evaluated this way is ever rewarded for learning it. Under the harder historical and inductive negatives, whose sources differ, the same factor becomes the dominant signal. We model it with Source Node Activity Modeling (SNAM), a self-exciting event intensity fitted by an exact point-process likelihood to decayed interaction counts the history states already contain; it has fewer than 20 parameters. On their own, never looking at the destination, these parameters beat DyGFormer and TPNet on four of five datasets under historical negatives. Added to the frozen scores of TPNet, TGN, DyGFormer and DSRD, four models of different design, without retraining anything, they raise AP on almost every backbone-dataset pair in both settings, by up to 25 points. Our full model ranks first overall against eleven baselines on 13 datasets and three protocols, and on million-event streams trains an epoch 9-100x faster than TPNet and DyGFormer. We conclude that source activity is a blind spot of temporal link prediction, and a cheap, transferable one to close. Code is available at https://github.com/Erutaner/Your-Temporal-Link-Predictor-Is-Blind-to-Who-Is-Active.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 时序链路预测的常规负采样保留真实源、只换目标，作者证明这会让源节点活跃度 (source activity) 在最优打分中被精确抵消，模型因此永远不会被奖励去学它。提出 SNAM：用衰减交互计数拟合的自激点过程强度（精确似然、不到 20 个参数），单独不看目标即可在 5 个数据集中 4 个上胜过 DyGFormer 与 TPNet；加到 4 个冻结骨干上不重训，AP 最多提升 25 个点。
Motivation: 标准负采样让源活跃度这一因子在训练与评估中被结构性抹掉，而在源不同的历史负采样与归纳 (inductive) 负采样下它反而是主导信号，现有模型因此系统性忽略了一个关键因素。
Method: 提出 Source Node Activity Modeling (SNAM)：把源节点活跃度建模为自激点过程强度，用精确点过程似然 (exact point-process likelihood) 对历史状态中已有的衰减交互计数进行拟合，参数量少于 20；该分数可直接加到 TPNet、TGN、DyGFormer、DSRD 的冻结分数上，无需重训。
Result: SNAM 参数单独打分（不看目标）在历史负采样下于 5 个数据集中的 4 个胜过 DyGFormer 与 TPNet；加到 4 种不同设计的冻结骨干上，在两种负采样设置下几乎每个骨干-数据集组合的 AP 都提升，最多 25 个点；完整模型在 13 个数据集、3 种协议、11 个基线中总体排名第一；百万级事件流上每 epoch 训练比 TPNet 与 DyGFormer 快 9–100 倍。
Conclusion: 源节点活跃度是时序链路预测的盲区，而且是一个便宜、可跨模型迁移就能补上的盲区。

papers.title: From Memory to Guide: Spatio-Temporal Composer for Procedural Coding Memory
papers.abstract_en: Memory-augmented agents typically integrate procedural knowledge by injecting retrieved skills directly into text prompts. This approach dangerously equates readable text with reliable execution. To bridge this gap, we introduce From Memory to Guide, a novel paradigm that transitions procedural memory from passive text delivery to active, inference-time policy adaptation. We instantiate this paradigm through the Spatio-Temporal Composer, an active policy compiler that explicitly manages exactly how and when retrieved knowledge should be applied. Rather than treating skills as plug-and-play modules, Composer dynamically aligns historical knowledge with current environmental constraints (spatial adaptation) and precisely dictates its applicable lifecycle (temporal orchestration). It actively transforms static memories into strictly bounded Runtime Guides---equipping the agent with localized objectives and behavioral guardrails without requiring a single parameter update. Extensive evaluations on 13 demanding, long-horizon software engineering tasks in EngramBench demonstrate the clear advantages of this architecture. Composer not only robustly prevents context mismatch but drives an absolute pass-rate increase of 7.2 percentage points on the most complex tasks, while simultaneously slashing the main agent's token usage by 32.2%.

papers.title: Greedy Local Learning for Language Model Pretraining: Gaps and Objective Design
papers.abstract_en: Greedy block-wise local learning splits a network into gradient-isolated blocks trained by local auxiliary losses, deleting the backward pass between blocks: inter-stage communication becomes forward-only and every block can step its optimizer independently, properties directly relevant to decentralized model-parallel training. Local learning is competitive with end-to-end backpropagation on image classification, and on small Transformers it is known to trade a worse best loss for parallel speedup. How this loss gap behaves in autoregressive language model (LM) pretraining at larger scale, and which auxiliary designs reduce it, has not been measured. We present a token-budget-matched empirical study at 125M and 400M parameters with $K \in \{1,2,4\}$ blocks at Chinchilla-optimal budgets, factorizing the auxiliary design into network architecture and training objective. We observe: (i) the gap to end-to-end training more than doubles from $K=2$ to $K=4$, but at $K=4$ shrinks from 125M to 400M; (ii) replacing an MLP auxiliary with a Transformer-based one is a strong network-side intervention, recovering 22-41% of the gap; (iii) a multi-token-prediction (MTP) auxiliary objective helps at the first block boundary, whereas adding it at deeper boundaries hurts, and restricting it to the first block yields the best $K=4$ configuration ($+0.062$ vs. $+0.075$ nats at 400M); and (iv) deployment-style per-block execution reduces activation memory by up to $2.2\times$. We frame these results as an empirically grounded method direction rather than a finalized method: local objectives should apply future-predictive pressure selectively across boundaries while resisting shortcuts that bypass predictive content.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Collaborative, Open, and Decentralized Training of Foundation Models (CODEC-FM). 13 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 125M 与 400M 参数、K∈{1,2,4} 分块、Chinchilla-optimal token 预算下系统测量 greedy block-wise local learning 与端到端训练的损失差距：K=2 到 K=4 差距翻倍以上，但 400M 比 125M 更小；把 MLP 辅助头换成 Transformer 辅助头可挽回 22–41% 差距，MTP 辅助只放在第一个块边界时 K=4 最优（400M 上 +0.062 vs +0.075 nats），逐块执行最多省 2.2× 激活显存。
Motivation: Greedy block-wise local learning 让块间反向传播删除、只留前向通信，适合去中心化模型并行训练，但其损失差距在大规模自回归 LM 预训练中如何随 K 与规模变化、哪些辅助设计能缩小，此前没有测量。
Method: 做 token-budget-matched 实证研究：125M 与 400M 参数、K∈{1,2,4} 块、Chinchilla-optimal 预算，把辅助设计分解为网络架构（MLP vs Transformer 辅助头）与训练目标（是否在各块边界加 multi-token-prediction, MTP）两个因子，并测试 deployment-style 逐块执行。
Result: 差距从 K=2 到 K=4 翻倍以上，但从 125M 到 400M 缩小；Transformer 辅助头挽回 22–41% 差距；MTP 在第一个块边界有帮助、在更深边界反而有害，仅限第一个块时 K=4 最优，400M 上差距 +0.062 nats 对比 +0.075 nats；逐块执行激活显存最多降低 2.2×。
Conclusion: 作者把这些结果定位为经验支撑的方法方向而非成品方法：局部目标应在块边界上有选择地施加未来预测压力，同时避免绕过预测内容的捷径。

papers.title: Enhancing Long-Video VLM Embeddings with Query-Aware Streaming Latent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Long-video embedding requires capturing sparse query-relevant evidence under a limited visual-token budget. Uniform sampling can miss brief events in videos spanning minutes or hours, whereas encoding more frames in a single context increases memory and computation. We introduce \textbf{Query-Aware Streaming Latent Reasoning} (QASLR), a post-training framework that accumulates evidence across clips while keeping the embedding size fixed. QASLR selects a bounded set of frames, restores their temporal order, and processes them clip by clip with a vision-language backbone. A compact set of persistent think tokens cross-attends to each clip's features, while an embed token reads out a normalized representation after every update. This design integrates evidence across multiple backbone calls without requiring all selected frames to share a single context. Training combines final contrastive learning, step-wise contrastive supervision, and final-embedding self-distillation. Intermediate supervision trains partial-video readouts for retrieval, while self-distillation regularizes them toward the final representation. Query-aware selection produces query-conditioned representations for candidate-set scoring and reranking, whereas query-independent selection enables reusable corpus indexing. Under the full training recipe, HourVideo retrieval Hit@1 increases from 54.2 to 70.7 and from 57.4 to 72.8 for 2B and 8B Qwen3-VL-Embedding backbones, respectively. Gains extend to the evaluated moment-retrieval and video-QA tasks, and the streaming head transfers to a second Qwen-family embedding backbone. These results support streaming latent aggregation as an effective approach to integrating long-video evidence into fixed-dimensional representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QASLR 用一组持久 think token 逐片段 cross-attend 视觉特征、由 embed token 每步读出归一化表示，把长视频证据流式聚合进固定维度 embedding。在 HourVideo 检索上，Qwen3-VL-Embedding 2B 的 Hit@1 从 54.2 升到 70.7，8B 从 57.4 升到 72.8。
Motivation: 长视频 embedding 需在有限 visual-token 预算下捕捉稀疏的查询相关证据：均匀采样会漏掉分钟或小时视频中的短暂事件，单次编码更多帧又会推高显存与计算。
Method: QASLR 是 post-training 框架：先选出有界帧集并恢复时序，再逐 clip 送入 vision-language backbone；一组持久 think token 对每个 clip 特征做 cross-attention，embed token 在每次更新后读出归一化表示。训练同时用 final contrastive learning、step-wise contrastive supervision 与 final-embedding self-distillation，中间监督训练 partial-video 检索读出，自蒸馏把中间表示拉向最终表示；query-aware 选择用于候选打分与重排，query-independent 选择用于可复用的语料索引。
Result: 在完整训练配方下，HourVideo 检索 Hit@1：2B Qwen3-VL-Embedding 从 54.2 提到 70.7，8B 从 57.4 提到 72.8；增益延伸到所评估的 moment-retrieval 与 video-QA 任务，streaming head 还能迁移到第二个 Qwen 系列 embedding backbone。
Conclusion: 流式 latent 聚合 (streaming latent aggregation) 是把长视频证据整合进固定维度表示的有效途径，且不依赖特定 backbone。

papers.title: GitSwarm: Decentralized Compounding Inference
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon problem solving and scientific research require computation to accumulate across successive attempts. Partial solutions, experimental findings, and unsuccessful approaches can inform later work, yet most inference-time computation is organized around individual trajectories or candidates rather than a persistent body of reusable work. We call this paradigm compounding inference: organizing inference-time computation so that intermediate work persists and can be inspected, extended, combined, or challenged by subsequent computation. We instantiate compounding inference in GitSwarm, an asynchronous system where homogeneous agents independently decide how to advance a task while collaborating through structured persistent memory. Agents explore, experiment, verify, refine, and synthesize previous work in a shared, branch-able Git repository. Atomic commits preserve intermediate artifacts, while explicit semantic dependencies record how later contributions build on work across branches. We evaluate GitSwarm on long-horizon problem solving and sustained GPU-backed experimental research. On IMOProofBench-Advanced, GitSwarm solves all 30 problems in one run using GPT-5.5. On ProgramBench, it achieves a $79.4\%$ mean score, versus $65.1\%$ for the strongest reported baseline under the stated budget. On three neural architecture research tasks (Residual Matrix Transformer, Looped Transformer, NanoChat), GitSwarm improves upon the starting architectures through successive experimentation. Beyond final performance, we measure whether computation accumulates: on ProgramBench, $94.7\%$ of contributions are subsequently built upon, while the selected solution's ancestry covers $82-93\%$ of the contribution graph. These results show that inference-time computation can accumulate across otherwise independent episodes, forming an evolving body of work that subsequent inference can reuse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GitSwarm 把推理时计算组织成可累积的「复合推理」(compounding inference)：多个同质异步 agent 在共享、可分支的 Git 仓库里用原子 commit 保存中间产物、用显式语义依赖记录跨分支的构建关系。在 IMOProofBench-Advanced 上单次运行用 GPT-5.5 解出全部 30 题，ProgramBench 平均分 79.4% 对最强基线 65.1%，且 94.7% 的贡献随后被继续构建。
Motivation: 长程问题求解与科研型实验中，推理时计算通常围绕单条轨迹或候选组织，中间结果、失败尝试与实验发现无法被后续计算复用，计算无法跨尝试累积。
Method: 异步多 agent 系统：各 agent 独立决定如何推进任务，通过结构化持久记忆协作，在共享可分支 Git 仓库中探索、实验、验证、精炼并综合前作；原子 commit 保留中间产物，显式语义依赖记录后续贡献如何跨分支建立在已有工作之上。评测覆盖长程问题求解与持续的 GPU 支撑实验研究。
Result: IMOProofBench-Advanced 上单次运行用 GPT-5.5 解出全部 30 题；ProgramBench 平均分 79.4%，对比既定预算下最强已报告基线 65.1%；在 Residual Matrix Transformer、Looped Transformer、NanoChat 三项神经架构研究任务上，通过连续实验改进起始架构。累积性测量：ProgramBench 上 94.7% 的贡献随后被继续构建，所选解的祖先覆盖贡献图的 82–93%。
Conclusion: 推理时计算可以在彼此独立的 episode 之间累积，形成一份可被后续推理复用、不断演化的成果体，而不必局限于单条轨迹。

papers.title: Invisible Ink, Visible Lies: How Production Watermarking Causes LLMs to Hallucinate
papers.abstract_en: Text watermarking helps identify AI-generated content, but its effect on factual reliability remains underexplored. In this paper, we study watermarking hallucination: factual errors induced or amplified by watermarking even when the required evidence is present in the context and the unwatermarked model can answer correctly. Using a controlled retrieval-augmented generation setting, we compare unwatermarked and watermarked generations under the same context, query, and decoding configuration, and quantify their factual accuracy decrease. Across six representative watermarking methods, including KGW, SWEET, DiPmark, GumbelSoft, Gumbel-Max, and SynthID watermarking, we consistently observe watermark-induced hallucination. Watermarked outputs can remain fluent while introducing factual errors. We attribute this failure mode to two mechanisms: (1) token perturbations in the current-step arising from method-specific reweighting or keyed sampling, and (2) prefix-induced attention drift, which accumulates through autoregressive decoding and weakens later attention to the factual context. Motivated by this analysis, we propose two plug-in interventions at the token and attention levels that can be integrated into existing watermarking methods to improve factuality. At a matched TPR of 0.90 at 1% FPR, combining the two interventions reduces factual errors by approximately 90% relative to watermark-only decoding while preserving fluency and comparable decoding efficiency. Overall, this work highlights factuality as a first-class criterion in watermark evaluation, alongside detectability and robustness, and calls for careful factuality validation before deploying watermarks in fact-critical applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在检索增强生成 (RAG) 的受控设定下，文本水印本身会诱发幻觉：同一上下文、查询与解码配置下，KGW、SWEET、DiPmark、GumbelSoft、Gumbel-Max、SynthID 六种水印方法都使事实错误上升，输出仍流畅。作者把成因归为当前步 token 重加权/密钥采样扰动与前缀累积的注意力漂移，并提出 token 与 attention 两级即插干预；在 TPR 0.90、FPR 1% 匹配下，两干预合用相对仅水印解码减少约 90% 事实错误。
Motivation: 水印的可检测性与鲁棒性已被充分评估，但其对事实可靠性的影响研究不足：即使上下文已含证据、未水印模型能答对，水印仍可能诱导或放大事实错误。
Method: 在受控 RAG 设定下，对同一上下文、查询与解码配置比较未水印与水印生成，量化事实准确率下降；覆盖 KGW、SWEET、DiPmark、GumbelSoft、Gumbel-Max、SynthID 六种方法，并从 token 扰动与前缀诱导的注意力漂移两种机制出发，提出可嵌入现有水印方法的 token 级与 attention 级即插干预。
Result: 六种代表性水印方法一致出现水印诱发的幻觉，输出保持流畅但引入事实错误；在匹配 TPR 0.90、FPR 1% 下，两个干预组合相对仅水印解码将事实错误减少约 90%，同时保持流畅度与相当的解码效率。
Conclusion: 事实性应作为与可检测性、鲁棒性并列的一等水印评估准则；在事实关键应用部署水印前需做严格的事实性验证。

summary_sections.motivation: 水印的可检测性与鲁棒性已被充分评估，但其对事实可靠性的影响研究不足：即使上下文已含证据、未水印模型能答对，水印仍可能诱导或放大事实错误。
summary_sections.method: 在受控 RAG 设定下，对同一上下文、查询与解码配置比较未水印与水印生成，量化事实准确率下降；覆盖 KGW、SWEET、DiPmark、GumbelSoft、Gumbel-Max、SynthID 六种方法，并从 token 扰动与前缀诱导的注意力漂移两种机制出发，提出可嵌入现有水印方法的 token 级与 attention 级即插干预。
summary_sections.result: 六种代表性水印方法一致出现水印诱发的幻觉，输出保持流畅但引入事实错误；在匹配 TPR 0.90、FPR 1% 下，两个干预组合相对仅水印解码将事实错误减少约 90%，同时保持流畅度与相当的解码效率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 事实性应作为与可检测性、鲁棒性并列的一等水印评估准则；在事实关键应用部署水印前需做严格的事实性验证。

papers.title: One Tile, Multiple Instances: Rethinking MIL for Sparse Diagnostic Evidence
papers.abstract_en: In weakly supervised Whole Slide Image (WSI) classification, feature extractors typically compress each image tile into a single global embedding. Consequently, slide-level aggregators are restricted to this coarse tile scale, concealing fine-grained sub-tile evidence from the attention mechanism. We introduce DI-MIL, a framework that decouples encoding context from instance granularity through decomposed instances. By clustering dense spatial tokens from a frozen foundation model within each tile, DI-MIL converts a single tile into multiple independently weighted instance embeddings. As a training-free post-encoding module, DI-MIL integrates seamlessly into existing pipelines without requiring re-encoding or downstream architectural modifications. We evaluate DI-MIL on cytopathology, a challenging testbed where sparse diagnostic signals are easily diluted within standard tiles. Across four datasets, three frozen foundation models, and two attention-based aggregators, DI-MIL demonstrates consistent efficacy, improving 67 of 72 metric-level comparisons, with the largest mean gains reaching 3.64 points under cytopathology-specific backbones. In a broader comparison against seven representative MIL baselines, DI-MIL paired with ACMIL achieves highest mean performance in 33 of 36 backbone-dataset-metric comparisons. Ablations show that direct smaller tiling inflates the extracted tile count by up to 43.3$\times$ with non-monotonic performance, whereas DI-MIL incurs zero additional image-extraction overhead while achieving the strongest overall results. These results establish instance construction as an orthogonal design dimension in MIL, supporting DI-MIL as a cost-efficient solution under sparse diagnostic evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DI-MIL 把每个 WSI tile 内的稠密 spatial token 用聚类拆成多个独立加权的 instance embedding，让注意力机制看到 sub-tile 级稀疏诊断证据。在细胞病理学四个数据集、三个冻结基础模型、两种 attention 聚合器上，72 项指标级比较中 67 项提升，最大平均增益 3.64 点；与 ACMIL 组合在 36 项 backbone-数据集-指标比较中 33 项均值最高。
Motivation: WSI 弱监督分类中特征提取器把每个 tile 压成单一全局 embedding，slide 级聚合器只能在粗粒度 tile 尺度上做注意力，稀疏诊断信号容易在标准 tile 内被稀释。
Method: DI-MIL 作为训练后置 (training-free post-encoding) 模块：在每个 tile 内对冻结基础模型的稠密 spatial token 做聚类，把一个 tile 转成多个独立加权的 instance embedding，无需重编码或改动下游架构；评测覆盖四个数据集、三个冻结基础模型、两种 attention-based 聚合器，并与七个代表性 MIL 基线对比。
Result: 72 项指标级比较中 67 项提升，最大平均增益 3.64 点（细胞病理学专用 backbone）；与 ACMIL 组合在 36 项 backbone-数据集-指标比较中 33 项取得最高均值。消融显示直接更小切片使 tile 数最多膨胀 43.3 倍且性能非单调，而 DI-MIL 额外图像提取开销为零。
Conclusion: instance 构造是 MIL 中与编码上下文正交的设计维度，在稀疏诊断证据下，用聚类拆分 tile 比直接更小切片更省提取开销且效果更强。

papers.title: CURIO: Curiosity-Driven Test-Time Learning for Open-Ended Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Open-ended discovery requires learning from repeated attempts while continuing to explore directions whose value is not yet apparent. Search with a frozen large language model (LLM) can reuse previous solutions in context, but cannot update the model from its successes and failures on the test problem. Reinforcement learning (RL) enables such adaptation; however, strongly favoring high-reward trajectories may suppress low-reward yet potentially promising directions too early. We introduce CURIO, a curiosity-driven test-time learning framework that complements task feedback with an Intrinsic Curiosity World Model (ICWM). The ICWM learns transitions in the policy's hidden-state representation and supplies prediction-error bonuses at sampled tokens outside the policy's top-k choices. Epoch normalization and an annealed weight regulate their contribution to the policy update. On six mathematical discovery tasks and single-cell denoising with Qwen3 backbones from 8B to 235B, three-run means improve over a matched task-only RL control on five mathematical objectives, match the best reported performance on Circle Packing, and improve denoising Score and mean squared error (MSE) on both held-out corpora at every tested scale. Relative gains reach 18.3% on Hadamard and 10.8% on denoising Score. Code-diversity measurements show greater structural variation among generated programs, supporting curiosity as a complementary exploration signal for learning in open-ended discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CURIO 用好奇心驱动的测试时学习补足纯任务奖励 RL：Intrinsic Curiosity World Model (ICWM) 在策略隐藏状态上学转移，对 top-k 之外采样 token 给预测误差奖励，再用 epoch 归一化与退火权重调节其对策略更新的贡献。在 Qwen3 8B–235B 上，六个数学发现任务与单细胞去噪中，相对任务-only RL 对照在五个数学目标上三次运行均值提升，Hadamard 相对增益 18.3%，去噪 Score 相对增益 10.8%。
Motivation: 冻结 LLM 的搜索只能在上下文里复用旧解，无法从测试问题上的成败更新模型；而强偏好高奖励轨迹的 RL 会过早压制低奖励但可能有前途的方向。
Method: ICWM 在策略隐藏状态表示上学转移，并在策略 top-k 选择之外的采样 token 上提供预测误差奖励；epoch 归一化与退火权重调节其对策略更新的贡献，与任务反馈互补。
Result: 在六个数学发现任务与单细胞去噪、Qwen3 8B 至 235B 骨干上，三次运行均值相对匹配的任务-only RL 对照在五个数学目标上提升，在 Circle Packing 上持平已报道最佳；两个 held-out 语料上每个测试规模的去噪 Score 与 MSE 均改善，Hadamard 相对增益达 18.3%，去噪 Score 相对增益达 10.8%；代码多样性测量显示生成程序结构变化更大。
Conclusion: 好奇心作为任务反馈之外的探索信号，能在开放发现中抑制过早收敛、提升学习效果，且在测试的各规模上对去噪一致有效。

papers.title: PIT-GCL: Protein Interaction using Topological Graph Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Protein binding prediction is central to target identification, therapeutic binder design, and large scale screening, yet remains challenging because binding depends on sequence, three dimensional geometry, and global structural organization. Recent folding models such as AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2 have substantially improved structure prediction, but their confidence outputs (pLDDT, pTM, ipTM) are not specifically designed for binary binding prediction, and dedicated structure aware predictors often require bound complex structures that are unavailable at screening scale. We introduce PIT-GCL, a dual tower structure aware framework that encodes each protein independently from its amino acid sequence, Cα point cloud, and a global persistent homology descriptor. Each tower combines residue ESM-2 embeddings with a topological summary computed from the H0 and H1 persistence landscapes of a Vietoris-Rips filtration, and processes the resulting tokens with a structure aware Transformer in which pairwise Cα distances enter as a learned attention bias. A bidirectional cross attention module then performs latent space soft docking between the two per-protein representations, and the model is trained with a combined binary cross entropy and NT-Xent contrastive objective. On three binary interaction prediction benchmarks, general PPI on PPIRef, TCRpMHC binding on STAG, and whole chain pairs on PPB-Affinity, PIT-GCL outperforms representative sequence based, structure aware, and task specific baselines on general PPI under our evaluation, and is the only method above chance on PPB-Affinity; on TCR-pMHC it leads at a fixed decision threshold but is outranked by a task specific sequence model. Because each protein is encoded independently in the first phase, its representation can be precomputed and reused across candidate pairs, which is convenient for large scale screening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PIT-GCL 是双塔结构感知蛋白互作预测框架：每个蛋白独立用 ESM-2 残基嵌入加 Vietoris-Rips 滤过 H0/H1 持续景观 (persistence landscape) 的拓扑摘要编码，Cα 距离作为注意力偏置进入 Transformer，再由双向 cross attention 做潜在空间软对接，用 BCE 加 NT-Xent 对比目标训练。在 PPIRef、STAG、PPB-Affinity 三个二分类结合基准上，它在 PPIRef 上超过序列、结构与任务专用基线，在 PPB-Affinity 上是唯一高于随机水平的方法；TCR-pMHC 上固定阈值领先但被任务专用序列模型反超。
Motivation: AlphaFold3、Boltz-2 的置信度输出 (pLDDT、pTM、ipTM) 并非为二分类结合预测设计，而专用结构感知预测器往往需要筛选规模下拿不到的复合物结构。
Method: 双塔结构：每个蛋白独立编码，输入为氨基酸序列、Cα 点云与全局持续同调描述子；塔内把 ESM-2 残基嵌入与 Vietoris-Rips 滤过 H0/H1 持久景观的拓扑摘要拼成 token，送入以成对 Cα 距离作为可学习注意力偏置的 structure-aware Transformer。随后双向 cross attention 在两份蛋白表示间做 latent space soft docking，训练损失为二元交叉熵 (BCE) 与 NT-Xent 对比目标的组合。
Result: 在三个二分类互作预测基准上：PPIRef 一般 PPI 中优于代表性的序列基线、结构感知基线与任务专用基线；PPB-Affinity 全链配对上是唯一高于随机水平 (above chance) 的方法；STAG 的 TCR-pMHC 结合上在固定决策阈值下领先，但被一个任务专用序列模型反超。
Conclusion: 第一阶段各蛋白独立编码使表示可预计算并在候选配对间复用，因此该框架适合大规模筛选；其优势在一般 PPI 与全链配对上最明显，而在 TCR-pMHC 这类任务上任务专用序列模型仍占优。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Which Preferences to Train On? End-to-End Multi-Objective Alignment with an Adversarial Preference Distribution
papers.abstract_en: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values is important for safe, efficient, and beneficial AI deployment. However, human values are multifaceted: helpfulness, harmlessness and humor trade off against one another, and different users want different trade-offs. Multi-objective alignment (MOA) addresses this by training a policy that can provide any point of the Pareto front, but existing methods either train one model per preference, interpolate a few separately aligned experts post hoc, or train a single conditioned model without considering which preferences it should be trained on. Since the hard regions of the preference simplex depend on the objectives at hand, existing methods leave them under-trained and do not get the most out of a single model. Therefore, we propose MAESTRO (Multi-objective Alignment via End-to-end STeering and Robust Optimization), which formulates MOA as a minimax problem over preference distributions and trains a single prompt-conditioned policy end-to-end with RL against an adversarial preference distribution: a Dirichlet distribution updated by online mirror descent toward the preferences the current policy serves worst, rather than on a fixed one. On HH-RLHF, BeaverTails and a summarization task, with up to three objectives, MAESTRO attains the best Pareto front on most tasks in a single training run, at the lowest training cost among the compared methods. The largest margins appear in the hard regions that a fixed preference distribution leaves under-trained, confirming that a single prompt-conditioned model is capable of covering the objective trade-offs on its own.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAESTRO 把多目标对齐 (MOA) 写成偏好分布上的 minimax 问题，用在线镜像下降更新的对抗性 Dirichlet 偏好分布驱动单个 prompt-conditioned 策略端到端 RL 训练，把训练算力集中到当前策略服务最差的偏好区域。在 HH-RLHF、BeaverTails 与摘要任务（至多三个目标）上，单次训练即在多数任务取得最佳 Pareto front，且训练成本在对比方法中最低，最大优势正出现在固定偏好分布训练不足的困难区域。
Motivation: 多目标对齐中 helpfulness、harmlessness、humor 相互权衡且用户偏好各异，现有方法要么每个偏好训一个模型、要么事后插值少量专家、要么训单个条件模型却不挑训练用的偏好，导致偏好单纯形的困难区域训练不足。
Method: 提出 MAESTRO (Multi-objective Alignment via End-to-end STeering and Robust Optimization)：把 MOA 形式化为偏好分布上的 minimax 问题，用 RL 对抗一个 Dirichlet 偏好分布训练单个 prompt-conditioned 策略，该分布由在线镜像下降 (online mirror descent) 持续更新、指向当前策略服务最差的偏好，而非固定分布。
Result: 在 HH-RLHF、BeaverTails 与一个摘要任务、至多三个目标的设置下，MAESTRO 单次训练运行在多数任务上取得最佳 Pareto front，且训练成本在所比较方法中最低；最大优势出现在固定偏好分布训练不足的困难区域。
Conclusion: 单个 prompt-conditioned 模型靠对抗性偏好分布自适应分配训练，就足以自行覆盖全部目标权衡，无需每偏好一模型或事后插值。

summary_sections.conclusion: 单个 prompt-conditioned 模型靠对抗性偏好分布自适应分配训练，就足以自行覆盖全部目标权衡，无需每偏好一模型或事后插值。

papers.title: MemTrace: State-Consistent Memory for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: As coding agents take on long-horizon software evolution tasks spanning multiple files and stages, longer execution trajectories introduce two coupled challenges: (1) accumulated histories strain context budgets, and (2) repository changes can invalidate earlier execution evidence. Existing approaches address these challenges through techniques like larger context windows, compression, retrieval, or repository representations, but often fail to reconstruct a consistent task state after a context refresh or verify whether recalled evidence remains valid. Thus, we introduce MemTrace, a provenance-aware memory system that preserves execution history and aligns its reuse with the evolving task (e.g., iterative cross-file repair) and repository state. MemTrace stores history as immutable Memory Traces anchored to key information (e.g., files, symbols, tests), and organizes their execution order and dependencies in a Memory Trace Graph. When context is constrained, working memory retains only compact Memory Anchors, from which the agent can reconstruct the latest execution state and locate evidence relevant to its next action. Before restoring historical evidence, MemTrace checks its validity against the current repository state and retrieves only what the next action requires. Across three complementary long-horizon coding benchmarks, MemTrace consistently outperforms all fully evaluated baselines under the same backbone and harness, improving DeepSWE pass@1 by 21.2 points, SWE-EVO Resolved Rate by 4.4 points, and SWE-Milestone Score by 17.8 points under Codex CLI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemTrace 用不可变的 Memory Trace 与 Memory Trace Graph 记录编码智能体的执行历史，上下文受限时只留 Memory Anchors，并在恢复证据前先对照当前仓库状态校验有效性。在三个长程编码基准上、同 backbone 与 harness 下，DeepSWE pass@1 提升 21.2 点，SWE-EVO Resolved Rate 提升 4.4 点，SWE-Milestone Score 提升 17.8 点（Codex CLI）。
Motivation: 长程软件演化任务中轨迹变长带来两个耦合问题：累积历史挤压上下文预算，仓库改动使早期执行证据失效；现有大上下文、压缩、检索或仓库表示方法在上下文刷新后难以重建一致任务状态，也不校验召回证据是否仍有效。
Method: provenance-aware 记忆系统：历史存为锚定文件、符号、测试等关键信息的不可变 Memory Trace，执行顺序与依赖组织成 Memory Trace Graph；上下文受限时工作记忆只保留紧凑 Memory Anchors，据此重建最新执行状态并定位下一步所需证据；恢复历史证据前先对照当前仓库状态做有效性检查，只取下一步动作需要的部分。
Result: 在三个互补的长程编码基准上、相同 backbone 与 harness 下一致优于全部被完整评估的基线：DeepSWE pass@1 提升 21.2 点，SWE-EVO Resolved Rate 提升 4.4 点，SWE-Milestone Score 提升 17.8 点（Codex CLI）。
Conclusion: 把执行历史做成带来源、可校验的记忆结构，能让长程编码智能体在上下文刷新后重建一致任务状态并只取仍有效的证据，从而在跨文件迭代修复类任务上稳定超过既有记忆方案。

papers.title: RSure-Agent: Reliable Use of Tool Observations for Remote Sensing Agents
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing agents rely on perception, measurement, and raster analysis tools to solve Earth observation tasks. We refer to their judgments and quantitative results about ground objects as tool observations. However, these observations are subject to substantial uncertainty and may be incorrect even when the tools execute successfully. When agents accept incorrect observations, the errors can propagate through subsequent reasoning and cause task failure. We analyze 1,229 execution trajectories across three remote sensing agent benchmarks. On each benchmark, at least 88.1% of tasks depend on tool observations. Among these tasks, at least 22.7% contain incorrect observations despite successful tool execution. These errors propagate to the final answer in at least 82.0% of affected tasks on each benchmark. To address this problem, we propose RSure-Agent, a framework for verifying tool observations and limiting error propagation. We introduce a verifiable observation protocol that requires tools to return process evidence for the agent to verify their observations. We also construct a task-tool reliability prior from offline task feedback. The prior summarizes each tool configuration's past performance across task types and provides a task-specific reference for verification. Using process evidence and this prior, RSure-Agent decides whether to accept an observation, request additional evidence, or reject it. We evaluate RSure-Agent on EarthBench, ThinkGeo, TerraLogic, and CHOICE-420. Across the three agent benchmarks, RSure-Agent reduces the error propagation rate by 21.3 to 25.9 percentage points relative to the base configuration with verification and the prior disabled. On CHOICE-420, it improves overall accuracy over direct answering by 5.71 percentage points on average across 11 backbone models. On EarthBench, it reduces the tool-call ratio by 25.9% relative to Earth-Agent.
papers.comment: The demo is available at https://github.com/airs101/RSure-Agent (code will be released for further research)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 遥感 agent 的工具观测即使执行成功也可能出错，错误会沿推理链传播导致任务失败。RSure-Agent 用可验证观测协议（要求工具返回过程证据）加离线任务反馈构建的 task-tool 可靠性先验，决定接受、追加证据还是拒绝该观测；在三个 agent benchmark 上把错误传播率相对关闭验证与先验的基线降低 21.3 至 25.9 个百分点。
Motivation: 在 1,229 条执行轨迹上，每个 benchmark 至少 88.1% 的任务依赖工具观测，其中至少 22.7% 在工具执行成功时仍含错误观测，且这些错误在受影响任务中至少 82.0% 传播到最终答案。
Method: 提出 RSure-Agent：可验证观测协议要求感知、测量、栅格分析工具返回过程证据供 agent 核验；再用离线任务反馈构建 task-tool 可靠性先验，汇总各工具配置在不同任务类型上的历史表现作为任务相关参考；结合证据与先验对每条观测做接受、追加证据或拒绝三选一决策。
Result: 在 EarthBench、ThinkGeo、TerraLogic、CHOICE-420 上评测：三个 agent benchmark 中错误传播率相对关闭验证与先验的基线降低 21.3 至 25.9 个百分点；CHOICE-420 上相对直接回答在 11 个 backbone 模型上平均提升整体准确率 5.71 个百分点；EarthBench 上相对 Earth-Agent 工具调用比例下降 25.9%。
Conclusion: 让工具输出过程证据并用可靠性先验做核验，可以在不增加工具调用的前提下显著压低遥感 agent 的错误传播。

papers.title: Cluster Validation Indices as Self-Supervised Objectives for Text Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised fine-tuning refines the embedding space of a pretrained language encoder without labels. However, the commonly used approaches are computationally expensive. Specifically, contrastive learning-based methods need multiview data and in-batch negative examples, while negative-free approaches require auxiliary graphs/networks. An interesting question arises: can self-supervised fine-tuning be done without relying on either additional negatives or graph data? To answer this question, we introduce SilK (Silhouette-guided K-means), which trains on a Cluster Validation Index, an internal measure of cluster quality without using labels. SilK clusters the corpus and then regresses a simplified silhouette toward a target value. Each document is compared only against the k cluster centroids, never against other documents, so the method needs no augmentation, no negative pairs and one view per document. On BERT-base, SilK trains 1.46x faster per epoch than the fastest baseline we evaluate and uses 45.4% less peak GPU memory than the leanest one. Under frozen-encoder linear probing, SilK stays competitive with the best baselines on three downstream tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SilK（Silhouette-guided K-means）：把语料聚类后，让每个文档只与 k 个簇心比较，回归简化 silhouette 到目标值，从而在无标签、无负样本、无辅助图的条件下做自监督微调。在 BERT-base 上每 epoch 训练比所评测的最快基线快 1.46x，峰值 GPU 显存比最省的基线低 45.4%，冻结编码器线性探测在三个下游任务上与最强基线相当。
Motivation: 自监督微调语言编码器时，对比学习需要多视图与 in-batch 负样本，无负样本方法又需要辅助图或网络，计算开销都大；作者追问能否两者都不依赖。
Method: SilK 先对语料做 K-means 聚类，再回归简化 silhouette（silhouette-guided）至目标值；每个文档仅与 k 个簇心比较，不与其他文档比较，因此无需数据增强、负样本对，每文档单视图。
Result: 在 BERT-base 上，SilK 每 epoch 训练比所评测的最快基线快 1.46x，峰值 GPU 显存比最省的基线少 45.4%；冻结编码器线性探测下在三个下游任务上与最强基线保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 用簇心而非文档间对比即可支撑自监督微调，同时省掉多视图、负样本与辅助图，并在速度与显存上占优而下游性能不掉队。

papers.title: Viva La Vida: Verification and Accumulation Failures in Multi-Agent Proof Search
papers.abstract_en: When an agentic prover works on an open problem, there is no proof assistant to fall back on: its verifier and lemma library are ultimately language models judging model outputs. We instrumented such a system end to end and analyzed $51{,}754$ traced observations across three full runs ($186$ hours, \$$5{,}694$). We find three connected failure modes. First, the three-model verifier requires unanimity and treats parse or API failure as non-approval; in $10$ of $12$ verification events, one member returned no parseable output or an API error, making acceptance arithmetically impossible without surfacing an error. Second, when the ensemble did function, one verifier approved $3$ attempts that GPT rejected, each claiming to resolve the open problem; a single-verifier design would therefore have announced a solution three times. Third, because nothing could be approved, every review was a refutation, yet the lemma extractor mines reviews as well as proofs: $24$ of $93$ lemmas ($26\%$) were extracted from rejected arguments with their refutational context removed. Taken together, these findings show that without external verification, supervision is itself a critical trust boundary: systems must distinguish abstention from rejection, preserve useful disagreement, and preserve the provenance and polarity of information before it becomes future context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对一个无外部证明助手的多智能体证明搜索系统做端到端插桩，追踪 51,754 条观测、3 次完整运行（186 小时、5,694 美元），发现三类相互关联的失效：三模型验证器要求全体一致且把解析/API 失败当作不通过，12 次验证事件中有 10 次因某个成员无输出或 API 错误而使通过在算术上不可能；集成可用时一个验证器曾批准 GPT 否决的 3 次尝试（均声称解决开放问题）；由于全部评审都是驳回，引理抽取器仍从 93 条引理中的 24 条（26%）从被驳回论证中抽取且剥离了反驳语境。结论是：没有外部验证时，监督本身就是关键信任边界，系统必须区分弃权与拒绝、保留有用分歧、并在信息进入未来语境前保留其来源与极性。
Motivation: 开放问题的 agentic prover 没有证明助手兜底，验证器与引理库最终都是语言模型在判断模型输出，监督信号本身可能系统性失真并污染后续语境。
Method: 对多智能体证明搜索系统做端到端插桩 (instrumented end to end)，追踪 51,754 条观测、覆盖 3 次完整运行（186 小时、5,694 美元）；分析三模型验证器的全体一致 (unanimity) 判定逻辑、验证事件中的解析与 API 失败、以及引理抽取器对评审与证明的混合挖掘。
Result: 12 次验证事件中有 10 次某个验证器成员返回不可解析输出或 API 错误，使通过在算术上不可能；集成正常时一个验证器批准了 3 次被 GPT 否决的尝试（每次均声称解决开放问题），单验证器设计会因此三次宣布解决；引理抽取器产出的 93 条引理中有 24 条（26%）来自被驳回论证且剥离了反驳语境。
Conclusion: 没有外部验证时，监督本身就是关键信任边界：系统必须区分弃权 (abstention) 与拒绝 (rejection)、保留有用分歧，并在信息成为未来语境前保留其来源与极性。

papers.title: GRAM: Correcting Frozen Time-Series Foundation Models via Graph-Retrieved Amplitude Memory
papers.abstract_en: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) enable zero-shot forecasting through large-scale cross-domain pretraining, while retrieval augmentation further improves their performance by leveraging historical information. However, existing methods typically correct TSFM forecasts using the ground-truth futures of similar historical windows, which contain both predictive components already captured by the foundation model and sample-specific random fluctuation that is difficult to transfer. In contrast, recurring systematic model bias within prediction errors more directly characterizes the failure modes of a frozen TSFM and therefore provides more valuable correction signals. Effectively exploiting such model bias, however, poses two challenges: prediction errors at different numerical levels are difficult to compare due to scale differences, and the recurring bias must be extracted from prediction errors contaminated by random fluctuation. To address these challenges, we propose GRAM, a general retrieval-augmented framework for frozen TSFMs. GRAM first introduces an Amplitude Memory Module (AMM) that scales prediction errors by amplitude and aggregates them into retrievable prototypes. It then employs a Prototype Graph Module (PGM) to model relations among prototypes to aggregate consistent bias information while suppressing random fluctuation. During online forecasting, GRAM retrieves and expands prototypes relevant to the current query and generates per-horizon corrections to refine the original TSFM forecast. Experiments across multiple datasets and foundation models demonstrate consistent forecasting improvements.
papers.summary_zh:

Result: 在多个数据集与多个基础模型上的实验显示一致的预报改进（abstract 未给出具体数值）。

papers.title: DICE: Decoupling Capability from Intervention Necessity in LLM Tutoring
papers.abstract_en: Fluent guidance is not the same as useful intervention. LLM tutors are typically trained to generate the next teacher utterance, implicitly assuming that every student turn warrants a response. However, our experiments indicate that this conflates tutoring capability (what to say) with intervention necessity (whether to say it). We introduce DICE, a framework that decouples intervention decisions from response generation by first selecting an explicit pedagogical action. To calibrate this action selection policy, we define Intervention Value (IV), a rollout-grounded counterfactual metric that compares each action against non-intervention. IV shows that many prescribed interventions provide little or no marginal benefit. We further introduce DICE-Bench, a multi-variant math tutoring benchmark with skill-preserving problem variants for session-level evaluation. Using IV-weighted and KL-regularized policy optimization, DICE learns to intervene selectively while preserving tutoring effectiveness. In simulated tutoring sessions, DICE reduces the over-intervention rate to near zero while guiding students to correct solutions in approximately 3-4 fewer turns on average than existing Socratic tutoring baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DICE 把 LLM 家教的「该说什么」与「是否该介入」解耦：先选显式教学动作，再生成回应，并用 rollout 反事实指标 Intervention Value 校准动作选择策略。在模拟辅导会话中，DICE 把过度介入率降到接近零，且平均比现有 Socratic 家教基线少用约 3–4 轮就引导学生得到正确解答。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 家教训练默认每个学生回合都值得回应，把辅导能力（说什么）与介入必要性（是否说）混为一谈，导致大量边际收益很小的介入。
Method: DICE 框架先选择显式教学动作再生成回应；定义 rollout 反事实指标 Intervention Value (IV)，将每个动作与不介入比较以校准动作选择策略；用 IV 加权与 KL 正则的策略优化训练，并配套多变体数学辅导基准 DICE-Bench（含保持技能的问题变体）做会话级评估。
Result: 在模拟辅导会话中，DICE 将过度介入率 (over-intervention rate) 降至接近零，并平均比现有 Socratic 家教基线少用约 3–4 轮引导学生得到正确解答；IV 显示许多被规定的介入几乎不带来边际收益。
Conclusion: 把介入决策从回应生成中解耦、并用反事实价值校准，可让 LLM 家教选择性介入而不损失辅导效果。

papers.title: Agent Behavior as Code: Efficient and Robust LLM Agents with Programmatic Specifications
papers.abstract_en: AI agents based on foundation models (FMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities to perform complex open-ended tasks. However, they face some common challenges in practice: (a) agent behavior can deviate drastically even for semantically similar tasks, leading to catastrophically propagated errors; (b) high cost and latency due to FM calls, repeated in full whenever a task recurs with different inputs; (c) FMs' limited context and instruction following capability confine how well agents manage the ever-growing execution context and follow complex plans. We introduce $\textbf{A}$gent $\textbf{B}$ehavior as $\textbf{C}$ode $\textbf{Agent}$ (ABCAgent), which uses a symbolic program (e.g., Python code with potential neural functions) to fully specify the agent's behavior at runtime, with a powerful FM agent editing that program for flexibility. Behavior is thus specified without premature variable binding, and its execution is deterministic. We evaluate ABCAgent on six agent benchmarks, two of which we construct to test how well a derived program generalizes to variants of the task it was written for. ABCAgent matches a model-matched neural agent on GAIA and augmented GAIA, and surpasses it where robustness and long control flows matter: 98.3% against 97.3% on GSM-Symbolic ($p = 0.001$), 71.9% against 47.4% $\mathrm{Pass}^4$ on the telecom domain of $τ^2$-bench ($p = 0.0001$), and more records written correctly at every loop length on our control-flow-augmented WorkArena benchmark. For more parametric task families, ABCAgent is also significantly superior in efficiency. Without authoring a new program, ABCAgent solves 92.6% of GSM-Symbolic instances and 20.1% of augmented GAIA variants, which yields $5.2\times$ lower latency and $7.0\times$ lower cost on GSM-Symbolic, 19% lower cost on augmented GAIA, and $9.5\times$ lower agent latency on $τ^2$-telecom.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ABCAgent 用符号程序（Python 代码加潜在神经函数）在运行时完整规定 agent 行为，由 FM agent 编辑该程序以保持灵活性，行为执行因此确定且不提前做变量绑定。在六个 agent 基准上，它在 GSM-Symbolic 达 98.3%（对照 model-matched 神经 agent 97.3%，p=0.001），τ²-bench 电信域 Pass⁴ 71.9% 对 47.4%（p=0.0001），且不写新程序即可解 92.6% GSM-Symbolic 实例，带来 5.2× 更低延迟与 7.0× 更低成本。
Motivation: FM agent 在语义相近任务上行为漂移会级联放大错误，每次任务重现都重复调用 FM 带来高成本与延迟，且有限上下文与指令跟随能力限制了对长执行上下文和复杂计划的管理。
Method: ABCAgent 把 agent 行为写成符号程序（可含神经函数）在运行时完全规定，由强 FM agent 负责编辑该程序；行为不提前做变量绑定，执行为确定性。评测覆盖六个 agent 基准，其中两个由作者构造，用于检验派生程序能否泛化到其对应任务的变体。
Result: 在 GSM-Symbolic 上 98.3% 对 model-matched 神经 agent 的 97.3%（p=0.001）；τ²-bench 电信域 Pass⁴ 71.9% 对 47.4%（p=0.0001）；在控制流增强的 WorkArena 上每个循环长度都写出更多正确记录；GAIA 与 augmented GAIA 上与对照持平。不写新程序时解 92.6% GSM-Symbolic 实例与 20.1% augmented GAIA 变体，对应 GSM-Symbolic 延迟降 5.2×、成本降 7.0×，augmented GAIA 成本降 19%，τ²-telecom agent 延迟降 9.5×。
Conclusion: 把行为固化为可编辑的符号程序，能在鲁棒性与长控制流关键处超过神经 agent，同时在参数化任务族上显著更省成本与延迟。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: We study test-time evolution for humanoid loco-manipulation: solving tasks that a controller was never trained for by repurposing its existing skills, improving from its own attempts, and retaining what it learns, without retraining. Our key insight is that a broad controller already holds much of the competence a new task needs, and that this competence becomes accessible through an interface between planning and control that is expressive enough to specify contact-rich, multi-stage interactions, yet executable and measurable enough that execution feedback can guide planning from experience. InterEvolve realizes this interface with two components. First, we develop an object-aware forward-backward (FB) behavioral foundation model, whose object residuals on a frozen body prior turn a new reward about the body or objects into loco-manipulation behavior at test time. Second, we specify tasks as reward programs: staged rewards with completion conditions and tunable constants. A large language model (LLM) agent revises the program structure in context, drawing on execution feedback and a skill library of verified programs, while a numerical optimizer tunes its constants. With every candidate verified across parallel simulation scenarios, the program explores new ways to induce, repurpose, and compose the controller's existing motor competence for the task at hand, and thus improves over iterations. Experiments show that human-designed rewards leave much of the FB model's loco-manipulation competence untapped, whereas the programs InterEvolve evolves release it, sometimes through novel strategies. It further produces behaviors for diverse tasks, complex scenes, and long-horizon compositions in simulation, and evolved skills run autonomously on a physical Unitree G1 from egocentric onboard perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InterEvolve 在测试时演化奖励程序来驱动冻结的 humanoid loco-manipulation 控制器：object-aware forward-backward 行为基础模型把新奖励变成行为，LLM agent 改程序结构、数值优化器调常数，靠执行反馈迭代改进而完全不重训练。演化出的程序释放了人工奖励未用尽的 FB 模型能力，部分任务出现新策略，并在仿真中覆盖多样任务与长时程组合，最终在实体 Unitree G1 上凭第一人称机载感知自主运行。
Motivation: 控制器只在有限技能上训练，遇到未训练的新 loco-manipulation 任务时无法重训练；人工设计的奖励又留有大量 FB 模型既有能力未被调用，需要一个能在测试时自我改进的接口。
Method: 两个组件：object-aware forward-backward (FB) 行为基础模型，用物体残差挂在冻结的身体先验上，把关于身体或物体的新奖励在测试时变成行为；任务写成 reward program（分阶段奖励、完成条件、可调常数），LLM agent 依据执行反馈与已验证程序技能库在上下文中改程序结构，数值优化器调常数，每个候选在并行仿真场景中验证。
Result: 实验显示人工设计的奖励留有 FB 模型 loco-manipulation 能力的很大一部分未被使用，而 InterEvolve 演化的程序将其释放，有时通过新策略；在仿真中为多样任务、复杂场景与长时程组合生成行为，演化出的技能在实体 Unitree G1 上凭机载第一人称感知自主运行。
Conclusion: 把规划与控制之间的接口做成可执行、可度量的奖励程序，就能让冻结控制器在测试时从自身尝试中持续改进并保留所学，无需重训练。
Relevance: 2
