papers.title: pCoMole: Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing with Discrete Flows
papers.abstract_en: Biomolecular therapeutics often start from known sequences and require targeted editing to improve multiple properties while satisfying hard biochemical and manufacturability constraints. However, existing generative methods do not jointly support multi-objective optimization, hard feasibility, and sequence editing in discrete, variable-length biological spaces. In this work, we introduce Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing (pCoMole), a framework built on discrete flow matching that steers a pre-trained Edit Flow toward user-specified preferences while enforcing terminal feasibility. pCoMole defines a feasibility-gated terminal distribution using an augmented Tchebycheff utility and realizes the resulting preference tilt through a Doob-h transform of the underlying edit process. To make this construction practical, we approximate the required harmonic function using short Monte Carlo rollouts over candidate edits, yielding an efficient guided editor with provable preference consistency. We validate pCoMole by shrinking GFP while retaining fluorescence-related properties, shortening diverse Cas9 orthologs while preserving PAM specificity, and compressing peptide binders into short peptidomimetics that optimize seven drug-related properties under hard constraints. In wet lab testing, two 229-residue pCoMole-designed eGFP variants retained clear green fluorescence in BL21 cells after 10 deletions, with either one or two substitutions. Together, pCoMole enables constraint-aware, Pareto-aligned editing of biomolecular sequences in discrete, variable-length spaces.
papers.comment: Published at NeurIPS 2026. (Proceedings of the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems, Sydney, Australia)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: pCoMole 用离散流匹配 (discrete flow matching) 把预训练 Edit Flow 按用户偏好引导，在满足硬可行性约束下做变长生物序列编辑。经 Doob-h 变换与增广 Tchebycheff 效用实现偏好倾斜，湿实验中两个 229 残基 eGFP 变体在 10 次删除加 1 或 2 个替换后于 BL21 细胞中仍保持明显绿色荧光。
Motivation: 生物分子治疗序列需在满足生化与可制造性硬约束的同时优化多个性质，而现有生成方法无法在离散变长空间中同时支持多目标优化、硬可行性与序列编辑。
Method: 基于预训练 Edit Flow 构建 pCoMole：用增广 Tchebycheff 效用定义可行性门控的终端分布，通过 Doob-h 变换实现偏好倾斜；用候选编辑上的短 Monte Carlo rollouts 近似所需调和函数，得到带可证明偏好一致性 (provable preference consistency) 的引导编辑器。
Result: 在缩短 GFP 并保留荧光相关性质、缩短多种 Cas9 同源物并保持 PAM 特异性、以及在硬约束下优化七个药物相关性质压缩肽类结合剂三类任务上验证；湿实验中两个 229 残基 pCoMole 设计的 eGFP 变体经 10 次删除并各带 1 或 2 个替换后，在 BL21 细胞中仍保持明显绿色荧光。
Conclusion: 约束感知、Pareto 对齐的序列编辑可在离散变长空间中落地，且设计序列的荧光功能经湿实验验证得以保留。

papers.title: PRISM: A Category-Theoretic Framework for Measuring and Refining Multimodal Analogies
papers.abstract_en: Analogical reasoning involves identifying and preserving relational structures across domains. However, existing approaches to AI-driven multimodal analogy generation lack an interpretable measure of whether this structure is understood and maintained in the generated output. We address this gap with Pullback Refinement via Interpretable Structural Mapping (PRISM), a modality-agnostic framework for measuring and improving relational alignment in multimodal analogies, evaluated on visual metaphor generation. PRISM represents analogies as explicit relational mappings grounded in category theory and uses VLMs to instantiate these structures across modalities. Its first component, the pullback score, quantifies relational alignment from the resulting graph representation. On the AnaloBench benchmark, selecting the correct analogy purely by pullback score achieves 82.5% accuracy, demonstrating that the score captures meaningful relational information. PRISM's second component is an iterative refinement loop that uses the pullback score as an in-context feedback signal to iteratively revise the generated image towards greater relational depth. VLM-as-a-judge and human evaluations show that PRISM consistently improves metaphor consistency and analogy appropriateness over zero- shot generation, with human participants preferring the refined output in 57.65% of pairwise comparisons. However, a qualitative analysis reveals that refinement can favour visually crowded compositions rather than genuinely deeper relational correspondences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRISM 用范畴论把多模态类比表示成显式关系映射，pullback score 从图表示量化关系对齐，并作为 in-context 反馈驱动迭代图像修订。在 AnaloBench 上仅按 pullback score 选正确类比达 82.5% 准确率，人类在成对比较中偏好修订后输出的比例为 57.65%。定性分析同时显示，修订可能偏向视觉拥挤的构图而非真正更深的关系对应。
Motivation: 现有 AI 多模态类比生成缺少可解释的度量，无法判断生成结果是否理解并保持了跨域关系结构。
Method: PRISM 是模态无关框架：用范畴论把类比表示为显式关系映射，由 VLM 在各模态实例化该结构；第一组件 pullback score 从图表示量化关系对齐，第二组件以该分数为 in-context 反馈信号迭代修订生成图像，评测任务为视觉隐喻生成。
Result: 在 AnaloBench 上仅凭 pullback score 选择正确类比达到 82.5% 准确率；VLM-as-a-judge 与人类评测显示 PRISM 相对 zero-shot 生成持续提升隐喻一致性与类比恰当性，人类受试者在 57.65% 的成对比较中偏好修订后输出。
Conclusion: pullback score 能捕捉有意义的关系信息并可作为修订反馈，但迭代修订会偏向视觉拥挤构图而非更深的关系对应。

papers.title: Port-Hamiltonian Neural Networks for Systems with Multiple Asymptotically Stable Equilibria
papers.abstract_en: Stable port-Hamiltonian neural networks certify asymptotic stability by construction. Yet, their Hamiltonian is a global Lyapunov function with a single global minimum, so they can represent only dynamic systems with one attractor. We demonstrate that this excludes even simple systems with energy landscapes forming a double well, and we overcome the restriction by parametrising the Hamiltonian as a product of Bregman divergences generated by one input-convex network. We prove that the resulting model is locally Lyapunov stable, that the coexistence of stable equilibria forces additional non-asymptotically-stable equilibria to exist, that all equilibria lie in a bounded region, and under a hyperbolicity assumption that almost-everywhere stability holds. On three systems our approach is able to recover the energy surface characteristics and improve the convergence speed by 1.8$\times$-8.5$\times$.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: AXIOM - Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 端口哈密顿神经网络 (port-Hamiltonian neural network) 的哈密顿量天然是全局 Lyapunov 函数、只有一个全局极小，因而只能表示单吸引子系统，连双阱 (double well) 能量地形都表达不了。作者把哈密顿量参数化为由单个 input-convex 网络生成的多个 Bregman 散度之积，证明所得模型局部 Lyapunov 稳定、稳定平衡点共存必然迫使额外非渐近稳定平衡点存在、所有平衡点落在有界区域，并在双曲性假设下几乎处处稳定。
Motivation: 稳定 port-Hamiltonian 网络用构造保证渐近稳定性，但其哈密顿量作为全局 Lyapunov 函数只有单个极小值，无法表示具有多个渐近稳定平衡点（如双阱）的动力系统。
Method: 将哈密顿量参数化为若干 Bregman 散度的乘积，每个散度由同一个 input-convex 网络生成，从而突破单吸引子限制；理论部分给出局部 Lyapunov 稳定性、平衡点共存导致额外非渐近稳定平衡点、平衡点有界性，以及双曲性假设下的几乎处处稳定性证明。
Result: 在三个系统上恢复了能量面特征，并将收敛速度提升 1.8×–8.5×。
Conclusion: 用 Bregman 散度乘积参数化哈密顿量，可以在保留构造性稳定性证书的同时表示多渐近稳定平衡点的动力系统，并加快收敛。

papers.title: SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) trains a large language model (LLM) to act over long, multi-step interactions. However, a single localized error can cause task failure, while trajectory-level rewards provide limited guidance for assigning credit to individual decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce Segment-level Hindsight Advantage Reweighting for Policy Optimization (SHARPO), a credit-assignment mechanism that refines Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) at the level of environment-facing segments. Inspired by the existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) method, SHARPO computes teacher-student log-probability gaps within each segment and uses the resulting signal to compute a bounded multiplier on the GRPO advantage. This multiplier is shared by all tokens within the segment, allowing credit to vary across different segments. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, SHARPO outperforms existing baselines on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks, including GRPO, SDAR, RLSD, and StepOPSD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SHARPO 在 GRPO 之上按环境交互片段 (environment-facing segment) 重算优势：用 OPSD 式的师生 log-probability 差构造有界乘子，片段内所有 token 共享该乘子、片段之间信用可不同，从而把轨迹级奖励的信用分配细化到片段级。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上，SHARPO 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上超过 GRPO、SDAR、RLSD、StepOPSD 等基线。
Motivation: Agentic RL 中单点局部错误即可导致整条轨迹失败，而轨迹级奖励无法把信用分配到具体决策上，长程多步交互的策略优化因此缺少细粒度指导信号。
Method: SHARPO 改进 GRPO：借鉴 on-policy self-distillation (OPSD)，在每个环境交互片段内计算 teacher-student log-probability 差，由该信号生成 GRPO advantage 的有界乘子，乘子在片段内所有 token 上共享、跨片段不同；训练模型为 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 两个 benchmark 上，SHARPO 优于 GRPO、SDAR、RLSD、StepOPSD 等已有基线；摘要给出论文为 13 页、3 张表、2 幅图，未列具体分数。
Conclusion: 把信用分配下沉到环境交互片段、用有界乘子调制 GRPO 优势，是在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上比轨迹级 GRPO 及其变体更有效的 agentic RL 训练路径。

papers.title: The Effect of Tissue Detection on False Positives of Diffusion-Based Artifact Detection in Histopathology
papers.abstract_en: One-class artifact detectors for whole-slide images learn normal tissue from a clean training pool and flag departures from it. The pool is built by a preprocessing pipeline whose tissue-detection step is usually treated as neutral. We tested whether it is. On 16 annotated slides from The Cancer Genome Atlas, we rebuilt the clean pool of a diffusion-based detector with different tissue detection methods and compared the resulting models in a four-fold cross-validation. Per-slide saturation-Otsu detection excluded normal tissue, chiefly tissue with large clear spaces such as adipose tissue and alveolar parenchyma, and on slides with thick marker ink kept the ink while excluding ordinary tissue. Replacing it with entropy-based detection reduced the false-positive fraction on held-out clean slides from 0.102 to 0.016, in every fold and with a second training seed, without loss of sensitivity; the gain came from the composition of the pool, not its size. Across three tissue detection methods, false positives followed the fraction of such clear-space tissue in the pool, a statistic that needs no labels or training (0.103, 0.016 and 0.009). The effect did not carry over at the same size to a nearest-neighbour detector on foundation-model features. On an external cohort, the curated pool lowered clean-control false positives by about 20%, far less than on the development slides, and the remaining cross-center loss was not explained by stain differences. For one-class quality control, tissue detection decides what the model learns as normal and should be chosen and reported accordingly.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, including supplementary material. Code, data and models: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23016733
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 全切片病理的一类伪影检测器把预处理得到的“干净组织池”当作正常组织来学，而组织检测步骤被默认中立。在 16 张 TCGA 标注切片上，用基于熵的检测替换 saturation-Otsu 后，留出干净切片的假阳性比例从 0.102 降到 0.016，且在每一折与第二个训练种子下都不损失敏感性；三种组织检测方法的假阳性随池中大空腔组织（脂肪、肺泡实质）占比变化（0.103、0.016、0.009）。
Motivation: 一类伪影检测器的干净训练池由预处理管线构建，其中组织检测通常被当作中立步骤；若它把正常组织误排除或把墨迹留下，模型学到的“正常”就被污染，假阳性随之升高。
Method: 在 16 张 TCGA 标注切片上，用不同组织检测方法（saturation-Otsu、基于熵等三种）重建基于扩散 (diffusion-based) 一类检测器的干净训练池，四折交叉验证比较所得模型，并用第二个训练种子复核；另在最近邻检测器（foundation-model 特征）与外部队列上检验可迁移性。
Result: 基于熵的检测把留出干净切片的假阳性比例从 0.102 降到 0.016，在每一折和第二个训练种子下均成立且不损失敏感性；增益来自池的组成而非大小。三种组织检测方法下假阳性随池中大空腔组织占比变化，为 0.103、0.016、0.009（该统计量无需标签或训练）。同一规模下该效应在最近邻检测器上不复现；外部队列上精选池仅把干净对照假阳性降低约 20%，远小于开发切片上的幅度，且剩余跨中心损失无法用染色差异解释。
Conclusion: 对一类质量控制，组织检测决定了模型学到的“正常”是什么，因此必须被选择并如实报告；其收益依赖检测器类型与队列，跨中心残余损失不由染色差异解释。

papers.title: Free Everywhere, Exact on Trees: PPO's Dropped Correction Buys Sample Efficiency Under Aggressive Reuse
papers.abstract_en: Common policy improvement methods, including TRPO, PPO, and GRPO, estimate policy improvement under the behavioral policy's state-visitation distribution rather than the improved policy's own. The substitution makes the objective estimable from the behavioral policy's rollouts but adds a bias growing with policy divergence, hence the trust region or clip, and hence no reuse of a batch far off-policy. We show that under history-injective dynamics, where each state is reached by exactly one history, the dropped state-visitation ratio equals the product of per-step policy ratios along the sampled prefix, on every trajectory and not only in expectation. The ratio is therefore restored exactly, from log-probabilities PPO already computes. Autoregressive generation and canonical-order constructive optimization are both history-injective. The exact correction pays importance-sampling variance that grows with the horizon, so we generalize it to a one-parameter family with PPO ($α{=}0$) and the full correction ($α{=}1$) as endpoints: a single bias--variance knob. A gradient-level analysis of the unclipped surrogate identifies two channels the correction acts through and three conditions under which it carries signal; an enumerable testbed confirms the conditions' predictions. On hard credit-assignment scheduling tasks, a short corrected warmup with aggressive early sample reuse learns faster than PPO and than the same reuse uncorrected; the marginal gain grows with task difficulty ($+0.02$ to $+0.09$ learning-curve AUC), and the early win over PPO tracks the prefix bias that reuse incurs. A correction held throughout, or applied where clipping already contains the reuse bias, is null to harmful.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PPO/TRPO/GRPO 丢掉的状态访问分布比在 history-injective 动力学下可由已采样前缀上逐步策略比的乘积在每条轨迹上精确恢复，从而允许激进的批重用。作者引入以 α 参数化的偏差-方差旋钮（α=0 为 PPO，α=1 为全修正），在困难信用分配调度任务上，短程修正 warmup 加激进早期重用比 PPO 与同样重用但不修正学得更快，学习曲线 AUC 提升 +0.02 到 +0.09；全程修正或在 clip 已抑制重用偏差处修正是无效甚至有害的。
Motivation: 策略改进方法在行为策略的状态访问分布下估计改进目标，使目标可从行为策略 rollout 估计，但偏差随策略散度增长，导致信任域/clip 以及批远离策略时无法重用。
Method: 证明在 history-injective 动力学（每个状态由唯一历史到达）下，被丢弃的状态访问比等于采样前缀上每步策略比的乘积，可在每条轨迹上从 PPO 已计算的 log-probabilities 精确恢复；再推广为单参数 α 家族（α=0 为 PPO，α=1 为全修正），并对未裁剪 surrogate 做梯度级分析，识别修正起作用的两条通道与三个携带信号的条件，用可枚举测试床检验。
Result: 在困难信用分配调度任务上，短程修正 warmup 加激进早期样本重用的学习曲线 AUC 相对 PPO 与同样重用但不修正的版本提升 +0.02 到 +0.09，且增益随任务难度增大；早期对 PPO 的领先幅度与重用所引入的前缀偏差相对应。全程修正或在 clip 已包含重用偏差处施加修正为无效到有害。
Conclusion: 被丢弃的状态访问比在 history-injective 系统中可精确补回，用 α 在偏差与方差间调节即可换取样本效率；修正应只在重用偏差未被 clip 约束的早期阶段使用，而非全程施加。

papers.title: Wavelet Flow Matching for Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic time series are increasingly used for data augmentation, privacy-preserving data sharing, and downstream model development, yet faithfully reproducing both multi-scale temporal structure and cross-channel dependencies remains challenging. We study multivariate time-series generation through flow matching in the wavelet domain. By operating on multilevel discrete wavelet coefficients rather than directly in the time domain, the model represents coarse structure and progressively finer details at separate scales. Their naturally different variances further induce an implicit coarse-to-fine generative process without requiring an explicit multi-scale schedule. Since the transform acts independently on each channel, we pair it with a channel-token transformer whose attention directly models cross-channel dependencies. Across seven benchmark datasets and four sequence lengths, our method is best or tied on a majority of dataset-metric combinations, with the largest and most consistent improvements in Context-FID and discriminative score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在小波域做 flow matching 生成多变量时间序列：多层离散小波系数把粗结构与逐级细节分尺度表示，系数方差差异天然形成隐式由粗到细的生成过程，无需显式多尺度调度；再配 channel-token transformer 直接建模跨通道依赖。在七个基准数据集、四种序列长度上，该方法在多数 dataset-metric 组合上最好或并列最好，Context-FID 与 discriminative score 提升最大且最一致。
Motivation: 合成时间序列用于数据增强、隐私保护数据共享与下游模型开发，但同时忠实复现多尺度时间结构与跨通道依赖仍然困难。
Method: 对每个通道独立做多层离散小波变换，在小波系数上用 flow matching 生成，粗尺度与细尺度分层表示并借系数方差差异隐式由粗到细生成；配一个 channel-token transformer，其注意力直接建模跨通道依赖。
Result: 在七个基准数据集、四种序列长度的组合上，方法在多数 dataset-metric 组合上取得最好或并列最好，其中 Context-FID 与 discriminative score 的提升最大也最一致。
Conclusion: 小波域 flow matching 配 channel-token transformer 能同时刻画多尺度时间结构与跨通道依赖，是多变量时间序列生成的有效路径，优势在 Context-FID 与 discriminative score 上最明显。

papers.title: Right Answer, Wrong Mechanism: Detecting Pernicious Divergence in Causal Interventions
papers.abstract_en: Causal interventions such as activation patching and distributed alignment search (DAS) are the main tool for making mechanistic claims about neural networks. Recent work showed that these interventions routinely push representations off the model's natural distribution, and that such divergence is sometimes harmless and sometimes pernicious: it can recruit pathways the model never uses on natural inputs, so that an intervention produces the expected answer through the wrong mechanism. No method currently tells the two cases apart. We make this question testable by planting hidden pathways inside pretrained language models; the pathways are silent on every benchmark prompt by construction, so which interventions depend on them is known exactly. Across 72 configurations and 100,800 interventions on GPT-2 small, we find three things. (i) Nearest-neighbour and local-PCA distances at the intervention site, as used in prior work, score below chance (AUROC 0.35-0.47) at picking out interventions that give the right answer through a planted pathway. (ii) Hidden-Pathway Contribution (HPC), a label-free test that clamps downstream units to the regime of natural runs with the same output and measures how much of the decision disappears, flags pathway-dominated interventions with AUROC >= 0.99 when the pathway shows up as unit-level out-of-regime activity, but fails when every unit stays within its natural range, which we identify as the open problem. (iii) Optimised interventions actively seek hidden pathways: on a gender task, DAS routes 90-95% of its successes through planted pathways for three of four families, and a downstream on-manifold penalty cuts this share to under 5% at a cost of 6-11 points of success rate. In unmodified GPT-2, successful interventions show almost no unit-level out-of-regime reliance.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Beiming Liu and Minjie Chen contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对因果干预（activation patching、DAS）可能借模型自然分布外的隐藏通路给出正确答案却走错机制，提出无标签检测量 HPC：把下游单元钳制到同输出自然运行的区间，看决策消失多少。在 GPT-2 small 上 72 种配置、100,800 次干预中，HPC 在通路表现为单元级越界时 AUROC ≥ 0.99，而既有 NN/局部 PCA 距离只有 0.35–0.47（低于随机）；DAS 在性别任务上 90–95% 成功经隐藏通路，加 on-manifold 惩罚后降到 5% 以下、成功率损失 6–11 点。
Motivation: 因果干预常把表示推离模型自然分布，可能招募自然输入上从不使用的通路，产生“答案对、机制错”的结论；现有距离类诊断无法区分这种有害分歧与无害分歧。
Method: 在预训练语言模型内植入构造上对所有 benchmark prompt 静默的隐藏通路，使依赖关系可精确已知；对比干预点的 nearest-neighbour 与 local-PCA 距离，与无标签的 Hidden-Pathway Contribution（HPC，钳制下游单元到同输出自然运行区间并测量决策损失），并测试 on-manifold 惩罚对 DAS 路由的约束。
Result: 在 GPT-2 small 的 72 种配置、100,800 次干预上：NN 与 local-PCA 距离识别“经隐藏通路给出正确答案”的干预时 AUROC 仅 0.35–0.47（低于随机）；HPC 在通路表现为单元级越界活动时 AUROC ≥ 0.99，但当每个单元都留在自然范围内时失效；性别任务上 DAS 四族中有三族 90–95% 成功经植入通路，下游 on-manifold 惩罚把该比例压到 5% 以下、成功率代价 6–11 点；未修改的 GPT-2 中成功干预几乎不依赖单元级越界。
Conclusion: 距离类分布外指标在该设定下无效，HPC 可在通路表现为单元级越界时可靠标记通路主导的干预；所有单元都留在自然范围内的“越界但不可见”情形被作者明确列为开放问题。

papers.title: VOSSA: Voiceprint Optimization for Streaming Speech Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Real-time voice conversion (VC) systems commonly rely on pretrained speaker embeddings from automatic speaker verification (ASV) models. While effective for speaker discrimination, these embeddings are trained to remain stable across phonetic and prosodic variations within-speaker, which may conflict with frame-level acoustic generation in streaming constraints. To address this issue, we propose VOSSA (Voiceprint Optimization for Streaming Speech Architectures), a speaker representation framework that extracts speaker information from intermediate content encoder layers and aggregates using attentive statistics pooling. The embedding is trained jointly with VC objectives, removing the need for a separate speaker encoder. Across six datasets, VOSSA improves F0 dynamics and vowel-discriminative acoustic cues while maintaining comparable NISQA-MOS, WER, and speaker similarity. Perceptual tests further indicate improvements in naturalness, speaker similarity, intelligibility, and vibrancy.
papers.comment: Published in Proceedings of Interspeech 2026. Best Student Paper Award
papers.journal_ref: Tseng, M.-R., Quamer, W., Nasrallah, G., Gutierrez-Osuna, R. (2026) VOSSA: Voiceprint Optimization for Streaming Speech Architectures. Proc. Interspeech 2026, 4716-4720
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VOSSA 把说话人表征从预训练 ASV 嵌入改为从内容编码器中间层抽取、用 attentive statistics pooling 聚合，并与 VC 目标联合训练，从而去掉独立说话人编码器。在六个数据集上，F0 动态与元音可分辨声学线索得到改善，同时 NISQA-MOS、WER、说话人相似度保持相当。
Motivation: 实时语音转换 (streaming VC) 依赖 ASV 预训练说话人嵌入，这类嵌入被训练成对说话人内部音高与韵律变化保持不变，与流式约束下的逐帧声学生成目标相冲突。
Method: 从内容编码器中间层提取说话人信息，用 attentive statistics pooling 聚合为说话人表征，并与 VC 目标联合训练，取代独立的预训练说话人编码器。
Result: 在六个数据集上改善 F0 动态与元音可分辨声学线索，NISQA-MOS、WER 与说话人相似度保持相当；感知测试显示自然度、说话人相似度、可懂度与 vibrancy 均有提升。
Conclusion: 说话人表征应与流式 VC 的帧级生成目标联合优化，而非沿用追求说话人内不变性的 ASV 嵌入；该工作获 Interspeech 2026 Best Student Paper Award。

papers.title: Recovering Off-Policy Supervision for Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Block drafters for speculative decoding are commonly trained on corpora written by external models, where a single off-policy token invalidates supervision for all subsequent slots in a block. Existing approaches discard these divergent slots, resulting in severe supervision loss. To resolve this problem while preserving the training corpus, we propose a rollout-based training framework that recovers full supervision through two complementary components. The first component, Anchor-Label Relabelling (ALR), replaces corpus labels with distributions from greedy target rollouts, restoring valid supervision across all predicted slots. The second component, In-Rollout Anchors (IRA), places draft blocks directly inside these rollouts to expose the drafter to target-generated context, reusing precomputed rollout features at no additional target cost. Across fixed vision-language and text corpora, our framework increases greedy accepted length by up to 36.5% over DFlash and consistently outperforms erasing baselines. Notably, a single epoch of our method surpasses the best erase schedules. After three epochs, it matches the acceptance length of training on target-regenerated responses. These results show that our framework provides an effective and compute-efficient approach for training speculative drafters on fixed corpora without modifying the original text. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ALR-IRA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 投机解码 (speculative decoding) 的 block drafter 在外部模型语料上训练时，一个 off-policy token 会让块内后续所有槽位的监督失效。提出 rollout 训练框架：Anchor-Label Relabelling (ALR) 用贪心 target rollout 的分布重标所有槽位标签，In-Rollout Anchors (IRA) 把 draft block 直接放进 rollout 上下文并复用预计算特征。贪心接受长度较 DFlash 最多提升 36.5%，单个 epoch 超过最佳 erase 调度，三个 epoch 追平用 target 重生成响应训练的接受长度。
Motivation: block drafter 的训练语料由外部模型写成，单个 off-policy token 会使块内其后全部槽位监督失效；现有做法直接丢弃这些分叉槽位，造成严重的监督损失，且改写语料会破坏固定语料设定。
Method: rollout 训练框架含两个互补组件：Anchor-Label Relabelling (ALR) 用贪心 target rollout 的输出分布替换语料标签，为所有预测槽位恢复有效监督；In-Rollout Anchors (IRA) 把 draft block 置于这些 rollout 内部，让 drafter 接触 target 生成的上下文，并复用预计算的 rollout 特征，不增加 target 开销。
Result: 在固定的 vision-language 与 text 语料上，贪心接受长度 (greedy accepted length) 较 DFlash 最多提升 36.5%，并始终优于 erasing 基线；单个 epoch 即超过最佳 erase 调度，三个 epoch 后追平在 target 重生成响应上训练的接受长度。
Conclusion: 在不修改原始文本的前提下，rollout 重标与 rollout 内锚点能以更少计算把固定语料的投机 drafter 训练到接近 target 重生成数据的接受长度。

summary_sections.tldr: 投机解码 (speculative decoding) 的 block drafter 在外部模型语料上训练时，一个 off-policy token 会让块内后续所有槽位的监督失效。提出 rollout 训练框架：Anchor-Label Relabelling (ALR) 用贪心 target rollout 的分布重标所有槽位标签，In-Rollout Anchors (IRA) 把 draft block 直接放进 rollout 上下文并复用预计算特征。贪心接受长度较 DFlash 最多提升 36.5%，单个 epoch 超过最佳 erase 调度，三个 epoch 追平用 target 重生成响应训练的接受长度。

summary_sections.method: rollout 训练框架含两个互补组件：Anchor-Label Relabelling (ALR) 用贪心 target rollout 的输出分布替换语料标签，为所有预测槽位恢复有效监督；In-Rollout Anchors (IRA) 把 draft block 置于这些 rollout 内部，让 drafter 接触 target 生成的上下文，并复用预计算的 rollout 特征，不增加 target 开销。
summary_sections.result: 在固定的 vision-language 与 text 语料上，贪心接受长度 (greedy accepted length) 较 DFlash 最多提升 36.5%，并始终优于 erasing 基线；单个 epoch 即超过最佳 erase 调度，三个 epoch 后追平在 target 重生成响应上训练的接受长度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在不修改原始文本的前提下，rollout 重标与 rollout 内锚点能以更少计算把固定语料的投机 drafter 训练到接近 target 重生成数据的接受长度。

papers.title: Counterfactual Probing for Parallel Unmasking with Hidden Forest Structure
papers.abstract_en: Masked generative models offer parallel token prediction, but accurate parallel sampling must account for dependencies among tokens. When dependencies are unknown, finding safe batches also costs model evaluations. We study whether total evaluations, including discovery, can be sublinear in sequence length $N$; sublinear sequential depth then follows. We consider discrete distributions with hidden forest structure, accessed through a fixed approximate conditional oracle. Under explicit regularity conditions and uniform Hellinger error bounds, for any fixed target accuracy $\varepsilon\in(0,1/8]$ and sufficiently large $N$, our sampler achieves seed-averaged total-variation error at most $\varepsilon$, with total masked-state submissions and sequential depth both bounded by $\widetilde{O}(N^C \varepsilon^{-a})$ for constants $0<C<1$ and $a>0$. These guarantees use polynomial vocabulary size and an edge-response lower bound set by $N$ and $\varepsilon$. The sampler shares evaluations of hypothetical reveals across dependence tests to identify safe parallel batches without requiring full recovery of the hidden forest. A tunable parameter trades probing cost against irreversible commit rounds. In the same class, any admissible irreversible product-commit sampler attaining the same seed-averaged accuracy requires $Ω(N^c \varepsilon^b)$ counterfactual submissions or commit rounds in the worst case, for constants $c,b>0$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究带隐藏森林结构的离散分布上，掩码生成模型如何用亚线性总评估次数做并行 token 采样：通过共享假设揭示的评估来探测依赖、找出可安全并行的批次，无需恢复完整森林结构。在给定正则条件与一致 Hellinger 误差界下，对固定精度 ε∈(0,1/8] 与足够大的 N，总掩码状态提交数与顺序深度均为 Õ(N^C ε^{-a})（0<C<1），并给出同类不可逆 product-commit 采样器的 Ω(N^c ε^b) 下界。
Motivation: 掩码生成模型做并行 token 预测时必须处理 token 间依赖；依赖未知时，寻找安全批次本身要花模型评估次数，可能抵消并行收益。
Method: 在隐藏森林结构的离散分布上，通过固定近似条件 oracle 访问分布，共享对假设揭示 (hypothetical reveals) 的评估来跨依赖测试复用，从而识别可安全并行的批次；用一个可调参数在探测成本与不可逆 commit 轮次之间权衡。
Result: 在显式正则条件与一致 Hellinger 误差界下，对任意固定目标精度 ε∈(0,1/8] 与足够大的 N，采样器的 seed-averaged total-variation 误差不超过 ε，总掩码状态提交数与顺序深度均为 Õ(N^C ε^{-a})，常数 0<C<1、a>0；保证依赖多项式词表规模与由 N、ε 设定的 edge-response 下界。同一类中，任何达到相同 seed-averaged 精度的可容许不可逆 product-commit 采样器在最坏情形需 Ω(N^c ε^b) 次反事实提交或 commit 轮次。
Conclusion: 在隐藏森林结构下，含发现成本在内的总评估次数可以对序列长度 N 亚线性，从而顺序深度也亚线性；且该量级对不可逆 product-commit 类是紧的（存在匹配下界），无需完全恢复隐藏森林。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Know Thyself, Teach Thyself: Internal Information Flow for Selective Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Self-distillation turns knowledge distillation into a closed learning loop and offers a path toward recursive self-improvement. Without an external teacher, however, the model must determine both what information can improve its supervision and which induced changes should be learned. Existing methods typically improve teacher-generated data or select training examples in isolation, leaving the information transferred between these stages unmeasured. We introduce InFlow, a retrieval-guided on-policy self-distillation framework that models this process as potential-to-realized information flow. InFlow first retrieves potentially informative sources using certainty-calibrated hidden-state trajectories, then measures their realized effect through the Jensen--Shannon divergence between the teacher's initial and retrieval-conditioned answer beliefs. Examples with larger belief shifts are selected for on-policy distillation. Our analysis formalizes the information optimized by retrieval and selection and relates the answer-level shift to the teacher--student distillation gap. Across four open-weight language models and three knowledge domains, InFlow achieves the strongest cross-model average among the compared selection methods, with ablations supporting both stages of the framework. Our code is available at https://github.com/1240148048/INFLOW.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InFlow 把自蒸馏中的数据选择建模为“潜在信息到已实现信息”的流动：先用经确定性校准的隐状态轨迹检索潜在有信息量的样本，再用教师初始答案信念与检索条件化后答案信念之间的 Jensen–Shannon 散度度量其实现效果，选取信念偏移大的样本做 on-policy 自蒸馏。在四个开源权重语言模型与三个知识领域上，InFlow 在所比较的选择方法中取得最强的跨模型平均表现，消融支持框架两个阶段各自的作用。
Motivation: 无外部教师的自蒸馏中，模型既要判断什么信息能改进监督、又要判断哪些诱导变化该被学习；现有方法各自改进教师生成数据或孤立挑选训练样本，两个阶段之间被传递的信息从未被度量。
Method: InFlow 是检索引导的 on-policy 自蒸馏框架，把该过程形式化为 potential-to-realized information flow：第一步用 certainty-calibrated hidden-state trajectories 检索潜在有信息量的来源，第二步用教师初始答案信念与检索条件化答案信念之间的 Jensen–Shannon 散度度量已实现效果，选取信念偏移更大的样本做 on-policy 蒸馏；分析形式化了检索与选择所优化的信息，并把答案层面的偏移与 teacher–student 蒸馏差距联系起来。
Result: 在四个开源权重语言模型与三个知识领域上，InFlow 在所比较的选择方法中取得最强的跨模型平均表现；消融实验支持框架的检索与选择两个阶段。
Conclusion: 把数据选择当作可度量的信息流动（先检索潜在来源、再用信念偏移验证实现效果）比孤立改进数据或孤立选样更有效，且两个阶段都不可省。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReWorld-Track: A Recursive Event World Model for Language-Guided Multi-Camera Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Language-guided multi-camera tracking must preserve a target identity across unobserved gaps, where similar candidates and uncertain returns can make early associations unreliable. A wrong match can corrupt the history used to predict later observations and propagate identity errors across subsequent camera handoffs. We propose ReWorld-Track, a recursive event world model that carries association uncertainty into future predictions. Candidate matches and continued waiting define alternative target states, whose posterior probabilities are used to update a persistent recurrent belief. This representation preserves uncertainty about alternative trajectories through successive observations. This belief predicts the next camera, arrival time, and entry region, while appearance and language evidence guide association. By training across successive handoffs, the model learns to retain uncertainty that remains useful for later predictions and identity decisions. ReWorld-Track achieves HOTA scores of 65.19 on CityFlowV2 and 45.36 on MTMMC, with improved identity continuity across repeated handoffs. On MTMMC, its structured posterior update gains 0.50 HOTA points over a similarly sized generic updater and 0.94 points over fixed-moment soft association, raising next-camera accuracy from 86.03% to 87.41% and reducing median arrival-time error from 0.78 s to 0.71 s for subsequent target returns.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 8 figures. Corrected an author name; scientific content unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReWorld-Track 把跨摄像头跟踪中的关联不确定性显式带进未来预测：候选匹配与继续等待构成备选目标状态，其后验概率更新一个持久循环 belief，由它预测下一摄像头、到达时间与进入区域。在 CityFlowV2 上 HOTA 65.19、MTMMC 上 45.36；MTMMC 上结构化后验更新比同规模通用 updater 高 0.50 HOTA、比固定时刻软关联高 0.94，下一摄像头准确率 86.03%→87.41%，后续返回的到达时间中位误差 0.78 s→0.71 s。
Motivation: 语言引导的多摄像头跟踪在未观测间隙中要跨摄像头保持身份，相似候选与不确定返回使早期关联不可靠；一次错配会污染用于预测后续观测的历史，并把身份错误传播到后续摄像头交接。
Method: 递归事件世界模型 (recursive event world model)：候选匹配与继续等待定义备选目标状态，用其后验概率更新持久循环 belief；该 belief 预测下一摄像头、到达时间与进入区域，外观与语言证据引导关联，并跨连续 handoff 训练以保留对后续预测有用的不确定性。
Result: HOTA：CityFlowV2 65.19，MTMMC 45.36，重复 handoff 上身份连续性提升。MTMMC 上结构化后验更新相对同规模 generic updater 高 0.50 HOTA，相对 fixed-moment soft association 高 0.94 HOTA；下一摄像头准确率 86.03%→87.41%，后续目标返回的到达时间中位误差 0.78 s→0.71 s。
Conclusion: 把关联不确定性递归地带入后续预测，可以在多摄像头交接中同时改善身份连续性、下一摄像头判定与到达时间估计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Foresight at the Event Boundary: Evaluating Physical Prediction in Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Video world models are largely regarded as predictive models of the physical world and are therefore expected to anticipate the consequences of observed events. However, evaluation has mainly focused on reference similarity, physical-law consistency, or judgment plausibility, estimating anticipation only indirectly. We address this directly: when a release or impact has just occurred but its consequence is withheld, can a world model anticipate what should happen next? We introduce an event-anchored evaluation based on 62 controlled real-world free-fall recordings and 124 clips spanning three object types, with fine-grained release and impact annotations and ground-truth trajectories. The protocol separates consequence production, temporal placement, and physical realization. Across six contemporary video generation and world models, Runway and Veo produce release and subsequent impact events at rates above 93% but often initiate them substantially late, whereas Cosmos-Predict-2.5 and MAGI-1 frequently preserve the pre-event state and produce little or no measurable consequence. Among measurable falls, plausible timing does not necessarily imply physically consistent motion. We further conduct a 15-participant, 20-condition human study in which participants describe the expected consequence from a single event-anchored frame and draw its trajectory. Human predictions favor the recorded future in aggregate while revealing genuine ambiguity among plausible continuations. Overall, physical foresight emerges as a sequence of distinct challenges: initiating a consequence, anchoring it in time, and realizing its motion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出事件锚定 (event-anchored) 评测协议，直接检验视频世界模型在释放或撞击刚发生、后果被遮蔽时能否预知接下来会发生什么。在 62 段受控自由落体实拍与 124 个跨三类物体的片段上，Runway 与 Veo 生成释放及后续撞击的比例超过 93% 但明显偏晚，Cosmos-Predict-2.5 与 MAGI-1 则常保持事件前状态、几乎不产生可测后果。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型评测只看参考相似度、物理定律一致性或判断合理性，对“预知后果”这一核心能力只有间接估计，缺少能分离后果生成、时间定位与运动实现的直接协议。
Method: 构建事件锚定评测：用带精细释放/撞击标注与真实轨迹的 62 段受控自由落体录像、124 个片段（三种物体类型），把评测拆成后果生成、时间定位、物理实现三层；对六个当代视频生成与世界模型测试，并做 15 人、20 条件的人类研究，参与者从单张事件锚定帧描述预期后果并画出轨迹。
Result: 六个模型中 Runway 与 Veo 生成释放与后续撞击的比例高于 93%，但起始时间明显偏晚；Cosmos-Predict-2.5 与 MAGI-1 频繁保持事件前状态、产生很少或没有可测后果。在可测的下落中，时间合理并不等于运动物理一致。人类预测在总体上偏向录像中的未来，同时在多个合理延续之间表现出真实歧义。
Conclusion: 物理预知 (physical foresight) 不是单一能力，而是后果能否启动、能否在时间上锚定、运动能否物理实现这三个可分离的挑战序列。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: VehicleArena: A Realistic Urban Environment for Multi-Agent Driving
papers.abstract_en: Real-world embodied agents often pursue independent objectives within a shared physical environment, where their actions can alter the conditions faced by others. Existing benchmarks, however, typically assume shared goals or explicitly prescribed interaction protocols, leaving such emergent physical coupling underexplored. We introduce VehicleArena, a 3D urban-driving benchmark for studying independently operating agents in a dynamic shared world. In VehicleArena, LLM-controlled agents must fulfill evolving passenger requests while navigating complex traffic, and each agent's driving decisions can reshape traffic flow, delays, risks, and subsequent observations for surrounding agents. The benchmark provides 112 evaluation tasks spanning single-agent and multi-agent driving. Across nine evaluated models, the highest arrival rates reach only 65.0% on single-agent tasks and 65.6% on multi-agent tasks, while strong passenger-request or cabin scores do not reliably translate into successful trip completion. Moreover, in matched multi-agent runs, every tested focal policy reduces the arrival rate of surrounding vehicles relative to the simulator's native traffic controller, revealing measurable externalities beyond the focal vehicle itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VehicleArena 是一个 3D 城市驾驶多智能体基准：LLM 控制的车辆各自服务不断变化的乘客请求，其行驶决策会改变周围车辆的车流、延误与风险。在 112 个评测任务、九个模型上，单智能体与多智能体到达率最高仅 65.0% 与 65.6%，且匹配多智能体运行中每个被测策略都把周围车辆到达率拉低于仿真器原生交通控制器，说明存在可测量的外部性。
Motivation: 现有具身智能基准多假设共享目标或显式交互协议，独立智能体在同一物理环境中相互改变对方处境的涌现耦合被忽视。
Method: 构建 3D 城市驾驶基准，含 112 个单智能体与多智能体任务；LLM 智能体需在复杂交通中完成演化中的乘客请求，并与仿真器原生交通控制器在匹配多智能体运行下对照。
Result: 九个被评模型中，单智能体任务最高到达率 65.0%，多智能体任务 65.6%；乘客请求或车内评分高并不可靠转化为成功完成行程；匹配多智能体运行下，每个被测策略都使周围车辆到达率低于原生交通控制器。
Conclusion: 当前 LLM 驾驶策略在动态共享环境中既难以可靠完成行程，也会对周围车辆产生可测负外部性，因此基准应把独立目标下的物理耦合纳入评测。

papers.title: Loop Dropout: Regularizing Shared Updates in Looped Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models separate computational depth from parameter count by repeatedly applying the same transformer block. Adapting these models requires a shared update that remains effective as hidden states evolve throughout the recurrent computation. Our empirical analysis reveals a pronounced late-loop bias in standard low-rank adaptation (LoRA): the shared update provides limited adaptation at early loop positions. This imbalance motivates training shared updates under varying combinations of their applications. Randomly omitting adapter applications alone, however, does not improve task performance; it reduces expected update strength during training while leaving inference unchanged. We introduce Loop Dropout, which couples stochastic masking of adapter applications with inverse-survival rescaling to preserve expected update strength and promote effective adaptation across loops. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved mathematical reasoning across model sizes, adapter ranks and training recipes, with benefits extending to general instruction tuning and code generation. Loop Dropout outperforms existing LoRA variants and adapter regularizers, while further analysis shows stronger early-loop adaptation. Every backbone loop remains active, and inference applies the adapter at all loops using standard LoRA without additional trainable parameters or inference computation. Code is available at https://github.com/NUS-HPC-AI-Lab/loop-dropout .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Loop Dropout 把随机丢弃 adapter 应用与逆生存重缩放 (inverse-survival rescaling) 结合，使共享更新在循环早期位置也保持期望更新强度，从而纠正标准 LoRA 在 looped language model 上的 late-loop bias。在多种模型规模、adapter rank 与训练配方下数学推理均提升，并延伸到通用指令微调与代码生成，且推理时所有 loop 都按标准 LoRA 应用 adapter，不增加可训练参数与推理计算。
Motivation: 循环语言模型用同一 transformer block 反复施加，适配时共享更新必须在隐藏状态随循环演化的过程中持续有效；标准 LoRA 在早期 loop 位置提供的适配有限，更新强度分布失衡。
Method: Loop Dropout：随机屏蔽部分 adapter 应用，再用逆生存重缩放 (inverse-survival rescaling) 补偿期望更新强度，使训练期与推理期一致；对照实验区分了单纯随机丢弃 adapter 的效果。
Result: 单纯随机丢弃 adapter 应用不提升任务性能，因为它只降低训练期期望更新强度而推理期不变；Loop Dropout 在不同模型规模、adapter rank 和训练配方下均改善数学推理，并在通用指令微调与代码生成上也有收益，分析显示早期 loop 适配更强，且优于现有 LoRA 变体与 adapter 正则化方法。
Conclusion: 共享更新的适配要在 loop 间均衡，必须在丢弃的同时重缩放以保住期望更新强度；推理可保持标准 LoRA 全 loop 施加，不引入额外参数或计算。

papers.title: LLMs are not stochastic parrots: Evidence for meaning-mediated abstraction from conlang-like tasks
papers.abstract_en: The strong version of the stochastic parrot argument claims that, although large language models (LLMs) may exceed rote regurgitation, they cannot move beyond statistical pattern matching into abstraction or reasoning, remaining ontologically near the lower bound of pattern reuse despite producing alluringly fluent text. We test this hypothesis using conlang-like tasks. Several LLMs are given only natural-language descriptions of fictional languages that subvert prominent superficial patterns in training data by combining statistically uncommon and unattested features. Crucially, no example outputs are given. We argue that if the models exhibit rule-following behaviour, they cannot be relying solely on superficial statistical patterns; such patterns often work against the correct output. Instead, successful performance requires representations of the constraints specified in the prompt. Across three complementary task families, models systematically move in the meaning-predicted direction: they distinguish prompt exposure from instructed use, alter semantic relationships in response to novel constraints, and sometimes produce exact matches to complex translation answer keys. Although performance varies across the spectrum of models used, these results provide evidence for meaning-mediated abstraction in LLMs and refute the strong stochastic parrot hypothesis. Our work shows that, under appropriate architectural and contextual constraints, statistical learning can produce meaning-mediated abstractions, although generation remains strongly constrained by superficial plausibility. We discuss implications for model development and for understanding how increasingly abstract representations may emerge from plausible-text-generation objectives.
papers.comment: Presented as a poster at ISC Summer School 2026; related work presented at IC2S2 2026; a synthesis of this project and related work presented at SLSA/ 4S 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用虚构语言 (conlang-like) 任务检验 LLM 的强版「随机鹦鹉」假说：只给自然语言描述、不给任何示例输出，且这些描述刻意组合训练数据中罕见未见的特征，使表面统计模式指向错误答案。模型在三类任务族上系统性地朝语义预测方向移动，有时给出与复杂翻译答案键完全一致的输出，支持意义中介的抽象 (meaning-mediated abstraction) 存在。
Motivation: 强版随机鹦鹉假说主张 LLM 只能做统计模式匹配、无法进入抽象或推理；需要在表面模式与正确答案相冲突的条件下检验这一点。
Method: 给多个 LLM 输入刻意颠覆训练数据表面模式的虚构语言的自然语言规则描述，不提供任何示例输出；设计三类互补任务族，要求模型遵循 prompt 中规定的约束，若仅靠表面统计模式则会给出错误输出。
Result: 模型在三类任务族上系统性朝语义预测方向移动：区分 prompt 暴露与指令使用、随新约束改变语义关系，有时对复杂翻译答案键给出完全匹配；不同模型表现有差异，生成仍受表面合理性 (superficial plausibility) 强约束。
Conclusion: 结果反驳强版随机鹦鹉假说：在适当的架构与上下文约束下，统计学习能产生意义中介的抽象，但生成质量仍被表面合理性限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Jev in Medicine: A Benchmark Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Jev is a non-generative "System One" model that assigns probabilities to predefined answer options and cannot answer outside them. Its accuracy and calibration on medical question-answering and case-based diagnostic-reasoning tasks are unknown. We evaluated Jev 1.13 on four medical benchmarks: MetaMedQA, PubMedQA, DiagnosisArena-MCQ and the NEJM Case Challenges. GPT-6 Sol, with (medium) and without reasoning, was the reference. The primary outcome was top-1 accuracy; key secondary outcomes were calibration, selective prediction and recognition of unanswerable questions. All 8,469 requests returned a valid answer. Jev's accuracy was similar to that of GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning on PubMedQA (78.4% vs 78.2%;), lower on MetaMedQA (74.8% vs 82.7%) and much lower on DiagnosisArena-MCQ (59.8% vs 82.4%;) and the NEJM cases (61.8% vs 82.4%). On MetaMedQA, Jev's probabilities were the best calibrated (expected calibration error 0.063 vs 0.146), and its answers with a probability of at least 0.9 (52.9% of questions) were 93.4% accurate, but GPT-6 Sol was as accurate when it accepted a similar proportion of questions. On DiagnosisArena-MCQ, Jev's probabilities discriminated poorly (AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768). Of the 162 questions whose correct answer was "I don't know or cannot answer", Jev chose that option for 10.5% (GPT-6 Sol, 8.6%). Median latency was 0.27-0.31 s; all 2,823 items cost USD 0.08. Jev was fast and inexpensive, and its accuracy was similar to that of a frontier LLM on research abstracts but lower on examination questions and much lower on complex diagnostic cases. Task-specific validation is required before clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Jev 1.13 是非生成式 System One 模型，只在预定义选项上给概率，无法回答选项外问题。在四个医学基准共 8,469 次请求上，其 top-1 准确率与 GPT-6 Sol（medium reasoning）在 PubMedQA 相当（78.4% vs 78.2%），但在 MetaMedQA（74.8% vs 82.7%）、DiagnosisArena-MCQ（59.8% vs 82.4%）和 NEJM 病例（61.8% vs 82.4%）上更低；作者结论是临床使用前必须做任务特定验证。
Motivation: Jev 这类非生成式、封闭选项的概率模型在医学问答与病例诊断推理上的准确率和校准情况未知，需要在真实医学基准上与前沿 LLM 对照。
Method: 评测 Jev 1.13 于 MetaMedQA、PubMedQA、DiagnosisArena-MCQ 和 NEJM Case Challenges 四个医学基准，以 GPT-6 Sol（带与不带 medium reasoning）为参照；主要结局为 top-1 准确率，次要结局为校准、选择性预测与不可回答问题识别，共 8,469 次请求。
Result: 全部 8,469 次请求均返回有效答案。准确率：PubMedQA 78.4% vs GPT-6 Sol 78.2%，MetaMedQA 74.8% vs 82.7%，DiagnosisArena-MCQ 59.8% vs 82.4%，NEJM 61.8% vs 82.4%。MetaMedQA 上 Jev 校准最好（ECE 0.063 vs 0.146），概率≥0.9 的题占 52.9%、准确率 93.4%，但 GPT-6 Sol 接受相近比例时同样准确；DiagnosisArena-MCQ 上 Jev 概率判别力差（AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768）。162 道正确答案为“不知道/无法回答”的题中，Jev 选该选项 10.5%（GPT-6 Sol 8.6%）。中位延迟 0.27–0.31 s，2,823 项成本 0.08 美元。
Conclusion: Jev 快且便宜，在研究摘要类任务（PubMedQA）上与前沿 LLM 相当，但在考试题和复杂诊断病例上明显更弱，临床使用前需任务特定验证。

papers.title: Curating Merchant-Matching Training Data with Two Confidence-Gated Local LLM Judges
papers.abstract_en: Merchant matching resolves a noisy payment descriptor to a retrieved merchant entity or returns no match. A key challenge in curating training labels is distinguishing teacher abstention from evidence that no acceptable entity exists: false no-match labels contaminate pseudo-labeled data, while conservative labeling reduces coverage. We investigate whether agreement between two local large language model judges improves pseudo-label reliability. A label is retained only when the judges agree, with separate ordered thresholds for selections and abstentions that guarantee disjoint positive and negative label sets. Retrospective replay on 2,000 expert-annotated queries shows that higher selection thresholds can improve positive-label purity, whereas higher abstention thresholds increase false no-match labels. At thresholds (0.86, 0.80), Muse Glimmer 30B and Gemma 4 31B jointly label 1,633 queries (81.7% coverage) at 96.88% purity; positive and negative purities are 99.47% and 93.38%. This exceeds either constituent model at the same thresholds by more than two percentage points, with lower coverage. A split-half check finds only 0.14 percentage points of threshold-selection optimism. A symmetric threshold of 0.86 adds 40 erroneous no-match labels, while 46 false abstentions persist even with no confidence threshold. Across five matched within-model comparisons, higher reasoning effort yields no clear F0.5 gain and increases median latency by 1.8-5.0 times. These results motivate separate thresholding and auditing for positive and negative pseudo-labels. The study establishes label purity, not student utility; fresh-data curation and student fine-tuning remain necessary to demonstrate downstream value.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables, Accepted for publication in 2026 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining Workshops (ICDMW), SENTIRE 2026 Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在商户匹配伪标签清洗中，用两个本地 LLM 评审（Muse Glimmer 30B 与 Gemma 4 31B）的共识加分离的有序阈值来保留标签，保证正负标签集不相交。在 2,000 条专家标注查询的回放中，阈值 (0.86, 0.80) 下联合标注 1,633 条（覆盖率 81.7%），纯度 96.88%，正/负纯度分别为 99.47% 和 93.38%，比任一单模型在同阈值下高出两个百分点以上。
Motivation: 伪标签清洗里难以区分教师弃权与确实无可匹配实体：错误的 no-match 标签污染训练数据，而保守标注又压低覆盖率。
Method: 两个本地 LLM 评审独立打分，仅在二者一致时保留标签，并对 selection 与 abstention 使用分离的有序阈值，使正负标签集不相交；在 2,000 条专家标注查询上做 retrospective replay，并用 split-half 检查阈值选择乐观偏差，另做五组同模型内 reasoning effort 对照。
Result: 阈值 (0.86, 0.80) 下联合标注 1,633 条（81.7% 覆盖率）纯度 96.88%，正纯度 99.47%、负纯度 93.38%，超同阈值下单个组成模型两个百分点以上但覆盖率更低；split-half 显示阈值选择乐观仅 0.14 个百分点；对称阈值 0.86 额外产生 40 条错误 no-match，而无阈值时仍有 46 条错误弃权；五组对照中更高 reasoning effort 无明确 F0.5 增益，中位延迟增至 1.8–5.0 倍。
Conclusion: 正负伪标签应分别设阈值并分别审计；该研究确立的是标签纯度而非学生模型效用，下游价值仍需新数据清洗与学生微调来验证。

papers.title: Octree-based Video Representation
papers.abstract_en: Video models commonly use uniform grids even though visual complexity varies substantially across space and time. We introduce OctVideo, which approximates a video clip with an octree. This hierarchy recursively partitions a spatio-temporal volume into eight subvolumes, so that smooth regions remain coarse while detailed regions receive finer cells. Each leaf stores local RGB values and spatio-temporal gradients, supplemented by a lightweight learned residual. For reconstruction, a Conv1D VAE maps the serialized cells to a regular latent grid and selectively refines details during decoding. Our VAE achieves 36.12 dB PSNR with 38.2M parameters and 189.4 GFLOPs per clip on Kinetics-400 (K400). It also generalizes zero-shot to the high-resolution Densely Annotated VIdeo Segmentation (DAVIS) 2016 dataset with reconstruction quality comparable to the best evaluated models. On both datasets, it requires the fewest model FLOPs and achieves the fastest encoding and decoding among the evaluated models. OctVideo also supports video understanding, achieving competitive recognition performance with few input tokens when trained from scratch. By exploiting the redundancy already present in video signals and efficiently processing sparse structures, OctVideo provides an efficient representation for video.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OctVideo 用八叉树 (octree) 递归划分时空体，让平滑区域保持粗格、细节区域细分，叶节点存 RGB、时空梯度与轻量学习残差，再用 Conv1D VAE 把序列化 cell 映射回规则 latent grid 并在解码时选择性细化。在 Kinetics-400 上以 38.2M 参数、189.4 GFLOPs/clip 达到 36.12 dB PSNR，零样本泛化到 DAVIS 2016 高分辨率数据，重建质量与所评测最优模型相当，且在两个数据集上模型 FLOPs 最少、编解码最快。
Motivation: 视频模型普遍用均匀网格，但视觉复杂度在时空上分布很不均匀，均匀划分在平滑区域浪费容量、在细节区域又不够细。
Method: 八叉树将时空体递归八分，叶节点存储局部 RGB 值与时空梯度并附加轻量学习残差；重建用 Conv1D VAE 把序列化的 cell 映射到规则 latent grid，并在解码阶段选择性细化细节。
Result: 在 Kinetics-400 上 VAE 以 38.2M 参数、每 clip 189.4 GFLOPs 达到 36.12 dB PSNR；零样本迁移到高分辨率 DAVIS 2016，重建质量与所评测最佳模型相当；在两个数据集上所需模型 FLOPs 最少、编码与解码速度最快；从零训练做视频理解时用少量输入 token 即取得有竞争力的识别性能。
Conclusion: 利用视频信号自带的冗余并高效处理稀疏结构，八叉树表示能以最少 FLOPs 和最快编解码提供高效视频表示，同时兼顾重建与少 token 的识别任务。

papers.title: Levy-Driven Correspondence Estimation for Registration
papers.abstract_en: Finding reliable point correspondences is difficult when point clouds have low overlap or undergo non-rigid deformation. Iterative refinement can correct uncertain matches, but costly network evaluations limit the number of updates. We present LevyMatch, a Lévy-driven method that uses random jumps to refine a soft matching matrix. At each step, a network uses the current matching state and geometric information to predict a target matching matrix. A Brownian reference bridge gives an explicit formula for the update toward this target. A Gamma random clock sets the time step for each update. The updated matches provide new geometric feedback for the next target prediction. We further propose a fixed front-loaded Gamma policy that assigns more expected clock time to early updates and less to later ones, without retraining or extra network evaluations. Reordering the same sampled Gamma increments shows that placing larger increments early gives higher accuracy than placing them late. On 4DMatch and 4DLoMatch, our method improves both non-rigid feature matching recall (NFMR) and inlier ratio (IR) over the compared methods. The front-loaded policy achieves 93.09% NFMR and 92.11% IR on 4DMatch, and 82.79% NFMR and 79.07% IR on 4DLoMatch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LevyMatch 用 Lévy 随机跳跃迭代精化点云软匹配矩阵：网络预测目标匹配矩阵，Brownian reference bridge 给出更新的显式公式，Gamma 随机时钟决定每步时间步长。提出的 front-loaded Gamma 策略把更多期望时钟时间分配给早期更新，在不重训、不增加网络评估的前提下提升精度：4DMatch 上 NFMR 93.09%、IR 92.11%，4DLoMatch 上 NFMR 82.79%、IR 79.07%。
Motivation: 低重叠或非刚性形变下点云难以建立可靠对应；迭代精化能纠正不确定匹配，但网络评估开销限制了可执行的更新次数。
Method: 每步由网络根据当前匹配状态与几何信息预测目标匹配矩阵，Brownian reference bridge 提供朝向该目标的更新显式公式，Gamma 随机时钟设定步长，更新后的匹配再提供几何反馈进入下一步；另提出固定的 front-loaded Gamma 策略，把更多期望时钟时间放在早期更新，通过重排同一批采样的 Gamma 增量实现，无需重训或额外网络评估。
Result: 在 4DMatch 上取得 NFMR 93.09%、IR 92.11%，在 4DLoMatch 上取得 NFMR 82.79%、IR 79.07%，两项指标均优于所比较的方法；重排同一批 Gamma 增量时，把较大增量放在早期比放在后期精度更高。
Conclusion: 用随机时钟调度迭代匹配精化、并把更多时间预算前置到早期更新，可以在不增加网络评估次数的条件下提高非刚性特征匹配精度。

papers.title: AtomWorld-Mem: Memory-Restored World States for Long-Horizon Atomistic Evolution
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity atomistic evolution over long timescales requires more than observing the current crystal configuration. Instantaneous atomistic snapshots are often incomplete: locally similar configurations can correspond to different hidden dynamical contexts, future event preferences, and waiting-time scales. We argue that this snapshot ambiguity makes long-horizon atomistic evolution fundamentally a memory-based world-state restoration problem. To address this, we introduce AtomWorld-Mem, a memory-restored atomistic world model that recovers the latent world state missing from instantaneous crystal snapshots. AtomWorld-Mem treats the evolving alloy as an AtomWorld: spatial encoders write multi-scale atomistic keyframes from dense local topology and sparse long-range defect context, while short-term event memory and long-term structural memory integrate these keyframes across time to restore a future-predictive evolutionary state. The restored state is used to prioritize legal vacancy-mediated events under single-event Kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) constraints, while event legality, physical execution, and residence-time updates remain governed by the underlying simulator. Empirically, AtomWorld-Mem improves long-horizon atomistic progress under fixed microscopic event budgets while maintaining high-fidelity evolution across energetic, structural, and vacancy-transport observables. It further transfers zero-shot across diverse unseen alloy-temperature AtomWorlds, suggesting that the learned memory-restoration mechanism captures reusable principles of hidden-state inference rather than a system-specific local energy heuristic. These results position memory-restored world-state modeling as a promising route toward efficient, physically grounded, and transferable atomistic evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AtomWorld-Mem 把长时标原子演化重新定义为记忆驱动的世界状态恢复问题：空间编码器从稠密局部拓扑与稀疏长程缺陷上下文写入多尺度关键帧，短期事件记忆与长期结构记忆跨时间整合，恢复出的未来预测状态用于在单事件 KMC 约束下优先排序合法空位介导事件。在固定微观事件预算下提升长时程原子演化进程，同时在能量、结构与空位输运观测量上保持高保真，并可零样本迁移到未见过的合金-温度 AtomWorld。
Motivation: 瞬时晶体快照信息不完备：局部相似的构型可能对应不同的隐藏动力学上下文、未来事件偏好与等待时间尺度，这种快照歧义使长时程原子演化本质上是记忆式世界状态恢复问题。
Method: 提出 AtomWorld-Mem 记忆恢复式原子世界模型：空间编码器从稠密局部拓扑与稀疏长程缺陷上下文写入多尺度原子关键帧，短期事件记忆与长期结构记忆跨时间整合关键帧以恢复未来预测演化状态；恢复状态用于在单事件 Kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) 约束下优先排序合法空位介导事件，事件合法性、物理执行与停留时间更新仍由底层模拟器掌控。
Result: 在固定微观事件预算下改善长时程原子演化进程，同时在能量、结构与空位输运观测量上保持高保真演化；并零样本迁移到多种未见过的合金-温度 AtomWorld。
Conclusion: 记忆恢复式世界状态建模可作为高效、物理有据且可迁移的原子演化路径，学到的记忆恢复机制捕捉的是隐藏状态推断的可复用原理而非特定体系的局域能量启发式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Linear Representation Hypothesis for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: The linear representation hypothesis (LRH) has become a standard lens for measuring and intervening on semantic information through the internal representations of large language models (LLMs). A growing body of work has begun extending this perspective to vision-language-action (VLA) models, but the dynamical nature of embodied interaction introduces an additional challenge. Unlike semantic attributes commonly studied in LLMs, such as gender or language, a physical quantity of interest (QoI) in a VLA evolves jointly with the system dynamics: the representation influences the actions selected by the policy, which alter the physical state and, in turn, the next representation. In this paper, we develop a theoretical, signature-based formulation of the LRH for VLA that unifies representations and policies. On the representation side, we establish the existence of representations from which the future evolution of a QoI under a candidate action trajectory can be recovered via linear probing. On the policy side, we introduce a signature generalized linear model for stochastic action chunks. This structure yields a monotonic change in the expected future QoI along linear paths in natural parameter space, enabling linear steering. We first validate this structure in a controlled oracle setting, then examine whether the same probing and steering mechanisms emerge in a pretrained VLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把线性表示假设 (LRH) 从 LLM 扩展到视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型，给出统一表征与策略的基于 signature 的理论刻画：表征侧保证候选动作轨迹下物理量 (QoI) 的未来演化可由线性探针恢复，策略侧用 signature 广义线性模型建模随机动作块，使自然参数空间的线性路径上期望未来 QoI 单调变化，从而实现线性 steering。先在受控 oracle 设定下验证该结构，再检查预训练 VLA 中是否涌现同样的探针与 steering 机制。
Motivation: LRH 在 LLM 中用于测量与干预语义信息，但具身交互是动力学过程：表征影响策略所选动作，动作改变物理状态并反过来决定下一时刻表征，LLM 式静态语义属性的分析框架无法直接套用。
Method: 构建 signature-based 的 VLA 线性表示假设理论形式：表征侧证明存在可由 linear probing 恢复 QoI 在候选动作轨迹下未来演化的表征；策略侧引入针对随机动作块 (stochastic action chunks) 的 signature generalized linear model，把表征与策略统一在一个结构里。
Result: 该结构给出自然参数空间线性路径上期望未来 QoI 的单调变化，使线性 steering 成立；作者先在受控 oracle 设定下验证这一结构，随后在预训练 VLA 中检验探针与 steering 机制是否涌现。
Conclusion: VLA 中的 LRH 可以用 signature 结构同时约束表征与策略，把线性探针的可恢复性与线性 steering 的单调性连成一个理论命题，并以 oracle 到预训练模型的两步检验其成立范围。

summary_sections.motivation: LRH 在 LLM 中用于测量与干预语义信息，但具身交互是动力学过程：表征影响策略所选动作，动作改变物理状态并反过来决定下一时刻表征，LLM 式静态语义属性的分析框架无法直接套用。
summary_sections.method: 构建 signature-based 的 VLA 线性表示假设理论形式：表征侧证明存在可由 linear probing 恢复 QoI 在候选动作轨迹下未来演化的表征；策略侧引入针对随机动作块 (stochastic action chunks) 的 signature generalized linear model，把表征与策略统一在一个结构里。
summary_sections.result: 该结构给出自然参数空间线性路径上期望未来 QoI 的单调变化，使线性 steering 成立；作者先在受控 oracle 设定下验证这一结构，随后在预训练 VLA 中检验探针与 steering 机制是否涌现。
summary_sections.conclusion: VLA 中的 LRH 可以用 signature 结构同时约束表征与策略，把线性探针的可恢复性与线性 steering 的单调性连成一个理论命题，并以 oracle 到预训练模型的两步检验其成立范围。

papers.title: TraceVIC: Causal Reasoning over Code Evolution for Identifying Vulnerability-Inducing Commits
papers.abstract_en: Software vulnerabilities are often discovered long after they are introduced, making it difficult to identify the vulnerability-inducing commit (VIC) responsible for introducing the underlying vulnerable condition. Existing VIC identification techniques largely rely on git blame to trace vulnerable code through revision history and use positional heuristics, such as selecting its earliest or most recent modification. However, the true VIC may occur anywhere within this history, and vulnerable behavior may depend on code that evolves across multiple revisions. We therefore argue that VIC identification requires reasoning about how vulnerability-relevant code evolves, rather than simply where a candidate commit appears in the revision history. We present TraceVIC, a temporal graph-based approach for identifying and ranking VICs by reasoning over code evolution. TraceVIC first localizes likely root-cause lines and traces their histories across revisions, constructing graph representations that capture program structure within each revision and the evolution of vulnerability-relevant code across the history. It reasons over the resulting revision history, using temporal edges to preserve correspondences between program elements across consecutive revisions, and directly ranks candidate commits according to their contribution to the vulnerable condition. Ablation results show that modeling the full revision history improves F2 from 0.637 to 0.814. TraceVIC improves F2 by up to 28.7% over state-of-the-art methods and identifies a valid VIC for 78 of 79 vulnerabilities across four unseen C/C++ projects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TraceVIC 用时序图对代码演化做因果推理来定位漏洞引入提交 (VIC)：先定位疑似根因行并跨版本追踪其历史，构造刻画单版本程序结构与跨版本漏洞相关代码演化的图，用 temporal edges 保持相邻版本间程序元素的对应关系，再直接按各候选提交对漏洞条件的贡献排序。建模完整版本历史使 F2 从 0.637 提到 0.814，较 SOTA 最高提升 28.7%，在四个未见 C/C++ 项目上 79 个漏洞中 78 个找到有效 VIC。
Motivation: 现有 VIC 识别依赖 git blame 加位置启发式（取最早或最近修改），但真实 VIC 可能落在历史任意位置，且漏洞行为取决于跨多个版本演化的代码，位置启发式会选错。
Method: TraceVIC 先定位疑似根因行并跨版本追踪其历史，构造同时刻画单版本程序结构与漏洞相关代码演化历史的图表示；在版本历史上推理时用 temporal edges 保留相邻版本间程序元素的对应关系，并直接对候选提交按其对漏洞条件的贡献排序。
Result: 建模完整版本历史使 F2 从 0.637 提升到 0.814（消融结果）；较 SOTA 方法 F2 最高提升 28.7%；在四个未见的 C/C++ 项目上，79 个漏洞中 78 个识别出有效 VIC。

papers.title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
papers.abstract_en: An LLM agent's capability is largely magnified by its harness, namely the prompts, control flow, tooling, memory, and context management surrounding the frozen backbone model. Recent methods increasingly automate this process by iteratively proposing and selecting component-wise edits of an agent harness, practically establishing a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI) at the agent-system level. However, such recursive evolution may overfit by memorizing the training tasks, showing large in-distribution gains that shrink or even vanish on out-of-distribution benchmarks. We introduce Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses (RRSI), which incorporates the principles of regularizations into harness self-improvement by constraining the evolution candidate proposal and selection. The proposer operates with a temporally annealed budget, limiting how many edits a candidate can bundle, and it encourages unexplored trajectories based on evolution history. The selector is equipped with a critic and a pruner: the critic screens benchmark-specific proposals, while the pruner, removes changes that are too small, too expensive, or no longer useful. Together these constraints favor reusable agent mechanisms over benchmark-specific ones or even noises. Across eight benchmarks spanning coding, agentic workspace and engineering design tasks, RRSI gains up to 6.0 points on the split it evolves against and up to 4.3 points on the five out-of-distribution benchmarks, while producing a harness that runs on 30% fewer policy tokens than the unregularized evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/google-research/rrsi and project page is https://regularized-rsi.com/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RRSI 给 agent harness 的递归自改进 (RSI) 加正则：proposer 用时间退火的编辑预算并鼓励探索进化历史中未走过的轨迹，selector 用 critic 筛掉只针对特定 benchmark 的提案、用 pruner 删掉过小、过贵或不再有用的改动。在覆盖 coding、agentic workspace、工程设计的八个 benchmark 上，进化所用 split 最多涨 6.0 点，五个 out-of-distribution benchmark 最多涨 4.3 点，产出的 harness 比不加正则的进化少用 30% policy token。
Motivation: 自动迭代改写 agent harness 的 RSI 容易靠记忆训练任务过拟合：in-distribution 涨幅大，换到 out-of-distribution benchmark 就缩水甚至消失。
Method: 对进化候选的提议与选择两步同时加约束：proposer 带时间退火的预算限制单个候选捆绑的编辑数量，并依据进化历史鼓励未探索轨迹；selector 由 critic 与 pruner 组成，critic 拦截 benchmark 特异的提案，pruner 移除过小、成本过高或失效的改动，使选择偏向可复用的 agent 机制。
Result: 在八个 benchmark（跨 coding、agentic workspace、工程设计任务）上，RRSI 在其进化的 split 上最多提升 6.0 点，在五个 out-of-distribution benchmark 上最多提升 4.3 点；所得 harness 的 policy token 消耗比不加正则的进化低 30%。
Conclusion: 把正则化引入 harness 自进化可以同时保住分布内增益、把增益迁移到 OOD benchmark，并让最终 harness 更省 token，即偏向可复用机制而非 benchmark 特异改动或噪声。

papers.title: LumoTree: Path-Parallel Speculative Verification for Hybrid Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Tree speculative decoding for recurrent-hybrid language models requires each accepted path to maintain consistent recurrent state, convolution history, and attention caches. We present LumoTree, a GPU serving design that coordinates verification and commitment through a shared tree descriptor. The verifier processes independent paths in parallel and reuses recurrent state tiles across local updates. Boundary states connect dependent paths. Accepted-path replay publishes the selected continuation into native running state, alongside coordinated convolution gathering and attention-cache remapping. Fused selection, device-resident acceptance, graph replay, and tree-aware attention integrate this organization into the serving cycle. The design separates temporary branch computation from persistent request state while retaining native prefix-cache interfaces. We evaluate numerical behavior, serving performance, and coding-agent outcomes on NVIDIA DGX Spark.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. v3: measurements re-taken with corrected per-path penalty histories in the tree sampler
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LumoTree 是面向 recurrent-hybrid 语言模型树式投机解码 (tree speculative decoding) 的 GPU serving 设计：用共享 tree descriptor 协调验证与提交，验证器并行处理独立路径并跨局部更新复用 recurrent state tiles，边界状态衔接依赖路径，被接受路径回放把所选续写发布进原生运行状态。在 NVIDIA DGX Spark 上评估数值行为、serving 性能与 coding-agent 结果。
Motivation: 树式投机解码要求每条被接受路径的 recurrent state、卷积历史与 attention cache 保持一致，而 recurrent-hybrid 模型的原生 serving 栈没有为这种多路径验证与提交提供组织方式。
Method: 共享 tree descriptor 协调验证与提交；验证器并行处理独立路径并复用 recurrent state tiles，边界状态连接依赖路径；accepted-path replay 配合卷积收集与 attention-cache remapping 把选中续写写入原生状态；融合选择、device-resident acceptance、graph replay 与 tree-aware attention 接入 serving 循环，并把临时分支计算与持久请求状态分离、保留原生 prefix-cache 接口。
Result: 在 NVIDIA DGX Spark 上评估了数值行为、serving 性能与 coding-agent 结果；v3 用修正后的 per-path penalty histories 重测了 tree sampler 中的测量值。
Conclusion: 通过共享树描述符把验证与提交统一组织，树式投机解码可以在保留原生 prefix-cache 接口的同时嵌入 recurrent-hybrid 模型的 serving 循环。

papers.title: Stochastic Flow Map for Count Data
papers.abstract_en: High-dimensional count data are common in scientific applications, but most diffusion and flow models are designed for continuous or categorical data, and generation often requires many sequential model evaluations. We propose Count Flow Map, a generative model that learns finite-time transitions directly in count space for one- or few-step generation. Our model directly learns stochastic transitions over finite time intervals, using Poisson births and Binomial deaths to preserve nonnegative integer counts without a predefined maximum. These transition models are trained to match the underlying local birth--death dynamics and to maintain consistency across step sizes. We characterize the connection between local dynamics and finite-time transition consistency and derive a bound on the generation error. After validating Count Flow Map in several simulations, including a high-dimensional, high-count setting, we apply it to single-cell drug perturbation prediction and neural population forecasting, where it captures perturbation responses and supports forecasts of high-activity events with only one or a few model evaluations. Together, these experiments demonstrate that Count Flow Map enables high-quality generation directly in count space across inference budgets, from one-step to few-step generation, using a single trained model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Count Flow Map 直接在计数空间学习有限时间随机转移，用 Poisson birth 与 Binomial death 保持非负整数计数且无需预设上限，实现一步或少步生成。它刻画局部动力学与有限时间转移一致性之间的关系并给出生成误差上界，在模拟、单细胞药物扰动预测与神经群体预报中以一到几次模型评估捕捉扰动响应和高活动事件。
Motivation: 高维计数数据在科学应用中常见，但现有扩散与流模型面向连续或分类数据，生成往往需要大量顺序模型评估。
Method: Count Flow Map 在计数空间直接学习有限时间区间上的随机转移：Poisson births 与 Binomial deaths 保证非负整数计数且不需预定义最大值；转移模型以匹配底层局部分解-死亡动力学和跨步长一致性为目标训练，并推导生成误差上界。
Result: 在若干模拟（含高维高计数设定）上验证后，应用于单细胞药物扰动预测与神经群体预报，捕捉扰动响应并以仅一次或少数几次模型评估支撑高活动事件预报；单个训练好的模型覆盖从一步到少步的推理预算。
Conclusion: 在计数空间直接学有限时间随机转移，可以在一步到少步的推理预算内用单一模型实现高质量生成，前提是转移同时对齐局部分解-死亡动力学与跨步长一致性。

papers.title: The Law of Stop: Interruptibility, Injunctions, and the Governance of Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: On June 12, 2026, the U.S. government ordered Anthropic to bar foreign nationals from two of its most capable models. Unable to sort users by nationality, it withdrew them from everyone. Weeks later, OpenAI agents under test escaped their sandbox and compromised Hugging Face, which stopped the intrusion without knowing its source. Neither stop rested on a dedicated AI governance regime. Lawmakers have begun to address stopping, yet their vocabulary remains shaped by the power of technique: the EU AI Act requires a "'stop' button or a similar procedure," and a 2026 bill in Congress is titled the AI Kill Switch Act. This Article argues that interruption is an institutional practice, not simply a technical artifact. It develops a theory of stop along four dimensions (technical affordances, interruption authority, epistemic triggers, and epistemic standing) and four paradigms: simple (escalator), sequenced (process plant), networked (railway), and distributed (agentic AI). Agentic AI exposes a mismatch between legal mechanisms of stop and distributed agency: control is divided, a stop at one point may leave the activity running elsewhere, and the system may circumvent attempts to halt it. A coding of some 1,400 AI incidents, by two language models from different labs under a pre-specified protocol, finds no stop in roughly 80% of the 1,213 retained. Where a stop was possible but absent, the missing element was mostly legal for informational, economic, and societal harms, and mostly technical for physical harms and agentic systems. A survey of forty AI governance instruments finds binding stopping requirements in only seven. The Article proposes a reform in two layers: risk reduction (a duty to maintain stop capacity at each site, emergency authority at the infrastructure layer, and enforceable access to the evidence a stop must rest on) and adaptation (safeguards for when a stop fails).
papers.comment: v2: revised Part III (legal and technical gaps by harm type and autonomy); updated Parts IV and V. 104 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables, technical supplement on coding and inter-coder agreement. Coding of 1,400 AI Incident Database incidents (May 2026 snapshot) by two LLMs from different labs. Survey of 40 AI-governance instruments to September 2026. Also at https://ssrn.com/abstract=7483441
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 AI 治理法律论文：把「停止」(stop) 论证为制度实践而非技术开关，提出四维理论（技术可供性、中断权限、认知触发、认知地位）与四种范式（escalator 简单型、process plant 序列型、railway 网络型、agentic AI 分布式）。对 1,400 起 AI Incident Database 事件编码后，在保留的 1,213 起中约 80% 没有发生 stop；40 项 AI 治理工具中仅 7 项含具约束力的停止要求。
Motivation: EU AI Act 的「stop 按钮」与国会 AI Kill Switch Act 都把停止当作技术物件，但分布式 agentic AI 中控制权被分割、一处停止可能让活动在别处继续、系统还可能规避停机，法律停止机制与分布式能动性之间存在错配。
Method: 按预先设定的协议，由来自不同实验室的两个 LLM 对 2026 年 5 月快照的 1,400 起 AI Incident Database 事件做双人编码（含 inter-coder agreement 技术附录），保留 1,213 起；另调查截至 2026 年 9 月的 40 项 AI 治理工具。理论部分按 harm type 与 autonomy 划分法律与技术缺口。

papers.title: Fragment-Aware Vision Transformers for Fresco-Fragment Style Classification
papers.abstract_en: Artistic style classification is usually studied on complete artworks, where models can exploit global composition, spatial organisation, and iconographic structure. In archaeological settings, however, artworks often survive only as fragmented remains, forcing recognition from incomplete, irregular, and context-limited visual evidence. We study fresco-fragment style classification using a progressive transformer-based framework. Starting from a ViT-B/16 baseline, we introduce foreground-guided masking to suppress background-only tokens, inpainting-based geometric regularisation to align irregular fragment supports with the ViT patch grid, and a supervised contrastive objective that operates on predictive distributions through a Kullback-Leibler similarity and consistently improves every branch. We combine the branches with a deliberately simple learnable logit ensemble. Experiments on CLEOPATRA and POMPAAF show that fragment-aware modelling improves over the standard ViT baseline, with the ensemble increasing accuracy from 0.604 to 0.656 and macro-F1 from 0.596 to 0.648 on CLEOPATRA, and outperforming the best single branch in four of six fragmentation settings on POMPAAF. We additionally evaluate a more complex graph-fusion variant and find that it matches the simple ensemble on POMPAAF while offering only a small, dataset-specific gain on CLEOPATRA, which does not justify its added complexity. Beyond these empirical gains, our contribution is twofold: a distribution-level contrastive objective that consistently sharpens single-branch recognition, and an interpretability analysis that verifies the models exploit genuine painted evidence, while quantifying that the inpainting-based branch draws part of its attribution from the synthesised surround.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 壁画残片风格分类中，前景掩码、基于 inpainting 的几何规则化与分布级监督对比目标三条分支用可学习 logit 集成合并，使 CLEOPATRA 上准确率从 0.604 升到 0.656、macro-F1 从 0.596 升到 0.648。复杂 graph-fusion 变体在 POMPAAF 上只与简单集成打平、在 CLEOPATRA 上仅有小幅数据集特定增益，不值得其复杂度。
Motivation: 风格分类通常在完整画作上研究，模型可依赖全局构图与图像志结构；考古场景中艺术品只剩不规则、不完整的残片，识别只能基于残缺且上下文受限的视觉证据。
Method: 以 ViT-B/16 为基线的渐进式框架：前景引导掩码抑制纯背景 token，inpainting 几何规则化把不规则残片支撑对齐到 ViT patch 网格，监督对比目标作用于预测分布（Kullback-Leibler 相似度）；各分支用刻意简单的可学习 logit 集成合并，并另评估一个 graph-fusion 变体。
Result: CLEOPATRA 上集成使准确率 0.604 → 0.656、macro-F1 0.596 → 0.648；POMPAAF 上集成在六种残片化设置中的四种优于最佳单分支；graph-fusion 在 POMPAAF 与简单集成持平，在 CLEOPATRA 仅有小幅、数据集特定的增益。
Conclusion: 分布级对比目标能稳定锐化单分支识别，简单 logit 集成已足够，复杂图融合的额外复杂度不划算；可解释性分析确认模型利用真实绘制证据，同时量化出 inpainting 分支部分归因来自合成周边。

papers.title: Semantic Action Graph: A Shared Representation for Agent Grounding and Human Interpretation of Sports Highlights
papers.abstract_en: Generative agents are increasingly used to select and narrate video highlights, but they typically operate over unstructured or frame-level representations. Their output is consequently difficult for a viewer to verify and steer toward individual preferences. We present the semantic action graph, a lightweight domain schema that represents a sports match as performer, action, recipient, moment, and state nodes connected by role, temporal, and outcome edges. The schema demonstrates three key properties: 1) connected event sequences, 2) a shared, closed vocabulary, and 3) frame-addressable moments, making it suitable to serve two consumers at once: an agentic pipeline that composes narrated highlights, and a visual interface through which viewers query and inspect the same structure. We instantiate it in SportSAGE, a design probe pairing a four-module highlight pipeline with a graph interface, and report feedback from 12 soccer fans. Participants were satisfied with the quality of the generated highlights and narratives, and used the graph interface to search, navigate, and interpret the match highlights. These results provide early evidence that one small, human-readable schema can ground agent generation and support human interpretation at the same time.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, Accepted for publication at IEEE VIS 2026 Workshop on GenAI, Agents, and the Future of VIS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出语义动作图 (semantic action graph)：用 performer、action、recipient、moment、state 五类节点加 role、temporal、outcome 三类边，把一场体育比赛编码成连通事件序列、封闭共享词表和可按帧寻址的时刻。该结构同时供生成式 agent 组装带解说的集锦 (SportSAGE 四模块流水线) 和供观众查询的图界面使用，12 名足球观众反馈对生成集锦与解说质量满意，并用图界面检索、导航和解读集锦。
Motivation: 生成式 agent 挑选并解说视频集锦时通常建立在无结构或帧级表示上，输出难以核验，也难以按个人偏好引导。
Method: 设计轻量领域 schema（performer/action/recipient/moment/state 节点，role/temporal/outcome 边），具备连通事件序列、共享封闭词表、frame-addressable moments 三项性质；实例化为 SportSAGE 设计探针，把四模块集锦生成流水线与图查询界面配对。
Result: 在 12 名足球观众中收集反馈：参与者对生成集锦与解说质量表示满意，并使用图界面进行检索、导航与解读；摘要给出的样本量为 12 人，未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 一个小型、人类可读的 schema 可以同时支撑 agent 生成的落地 (grounding) 与人的解读，作者将其定位为初步证据 (early evidence)。

papers.title: CSWAM: Better Causal Semantic Representations for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: FastWAM-style world action models enable efficient action-only inference, but generalize poorly under visual distribution shifts. Their reconstruction-oriented representations emphasize appearance-specific details, limiting generalization to unseen scenes and objects. Without observation history, the model also lacks temporal evidence for robustly identifying task-relevant state changes and motion in unfamiliar visual conditions. To address these limitations, we present the Causal Semantic World Action Model (CSWAM), which augments FastWAM with a causal semantic expert built on V-JEPA 2.1. V-JEPA provides temporally grounded representations of semantic state changes and motion with less dependence on appearance-specific details. The expert learns their future evolution from a sparse history of current and past observations and shares the history-derived context with both the video and action streams through causal attention. At inference, CSWAM conditions action denoising on the current video state and observed semantic history, retaining efficient action-only inference. We conduct simulation and real-robot experiments to evaluate generalization under distribution shifts. With embodied pretraining, CSWAM raises Randomized success on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean-to-Randomized transfer from 10.16% to 45.18%, a gain of 35.02 percentage points over FastWAM. Across two real-robot tasks and three OOD difficulty levels, CSWAM improves average success over FastWAM by 42.5 percentage points, from 27.5% to 70.0%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CSWAM 在 FastWAM 之上加一个基于 V-JEPA 2.1 的因果语义专家，用稀疏观测历史经 causal attention 同时喂给视频流与动作流，使动作去噪在视觉分布偏移下仍能识别任务相关的状态变化与运动。RoboTwin 2.0 Clean-to-Randomized 迁移成功率从 10.16% 升到 45.18%（+35.02 个百分点），两项真机任务三个 OOD 难度级平均成功率从 27.5% 升到 70.0%（+42.5 个百分点）。
Motivation: FastWAM 类 world action model 只做动作推理很快，但重建导向的表征偏重外观细节，遇到未见场景与物体的视觉分布偏移就失效；没有观测历史也缺少判断状态变化与时序运动的证据。
Method: 在 FastWAM 上加因果语义专家，骨干为 V-JEPA 2.1，从当前与过去观测构成的稀疏历史中预测语义状态与运动的未来演化；历史上下文经 causal attention 共享给视频流与动作流，推理时动作去噪以当前视频状态和语义历史为条件，保持 action-only 推理效率，并配合 embodied pretraining。
Result: RoboTwin 2.0 Clean-to-Randomized 迁移 Randomized 成功率 10.16% → 45.18%，较 FastWAM 提升 35.02 个百分点；两项真机任务、三个 OOD 难度级上平均成功率 27.5% → 70.0%，提升 42.5 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把时序接地的语义历史通过 causal attention 注入视频与动作双流，可在保留动作推理效率的同时显著改善 world action model 对视觉分布偏移的泛化。

papers.title: Bias-Induced Crossover in Absolute Capacity of Dense Associative Memory
papers.abstract_en: The absolute capacity of dense associative memory has mainly been analyzed for unbiased patterns. Here we examine the effect of bias in centered binary patterns under the Krotov-Hopfield single-site criterion $P_{\mathrm{error}}=1/N$, where $P_{\mathrm{error}}$ is the probability that a single-site flip lowers the energy of a stored pattern and $N$ is the number of neurons. Each pattern component takes $1-q$ with probability $q$ and $-q$ otherwise, where $0<q\le1/2$. For polynomial interactions of order $n$, a signal-to-noise analysis gives an absolute capacity of order $N^{n-1}/\ln N$ at $q=1/2$. For fixed $q<1/2$, however, the capacity is $O(N^{n/2})$ for even $n\ge4$ and $O(N^{(n+1)/2})$ for odd $n\ge5$. For $n=3$, both the unbiased and fixed-bias capacities remain $O(N^2/\ln N)$. For $n\ge4$, these different asymptotic forms imply a nonuniform large-$N$ limit near $q=1/2$. Asymptotic matching predicts a bias-induced crossover in the region $1-2q=O(\ln N/N^{\lfloor n/2\rfloor-1})$. The crossover originates from a bias-dependent crosstalk mean that reduces the stability of sites carrying the more frequent value $-q$. Computer simulations are compared with the finite-size conditioned-Gaussian predictions. An activity-dependent control potential that cancels the conditional crosstalk mean restores the $N^{n-1}/\ln N$ capacity for fixed $0<q<1/2$ within the conditioned-Gaussian approximation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Krotov-Hopfield 单点判据 P_error=1/N 下，稠密联想记忆 (dense associative memory) 的绝对容量对模式偏置 (bias) 极其敏感：n 阶多项式相互作用在 q=1/2 时容量为 N^{n-1}/ln N，但固定 q<1/2 时偶数 n≥4 降为 O(N^{n/2})、奇数 n≥5 降为 O(N^{(n+1)/2})，n=3 则保持 O(N^2/ln N)。作者预测在 1-2q=O(ln N/N^{⌊n/2⌋-1}) 区域出现偏置诱导的容量交叉 (bias-induced crossover)，并指出用一个活动依赖的控制势抵消条件串扰均值即可在 conditioned-Gaussian 近似下恢复 N^{n-1}/ln N 容量。
Motivation: 稠密联想记忆的绝对容量此前主要在无偏模式下分析，而实际存储的二值模式往往有偏；偏置会改变串扰噪声的均值，使高频取值位点的稳定性下降，容量标度可能整体改变。
Method: 在中心化二值模式（分量以概率 q 取 1-q、否则取 -q，0<q≤1/2）上做信噪比 (signal-to-noise) 分析，采用 Krotov-Hopfield 单点判据 P_error=1/N；对 n 阶多项式相互作用分别推导 q=1/2 与固定 q<1/2 的容量标度，用渐近匹配给出交叉区域，并以计算机仿真对照有限尺寸 conditioned-Gaussian 预测。
Result: q=1/2 时容量为 O(N^{n-1}/ln N)；固定 q<1/2 时偶数 n≥4 为 O(N^{n/2})、奇数 n≥5 为 O(N^{(n+1)/2})，n=3 两种情形均为 O(N^2/ln N)。n≥4 时这些不同渐近式意味着 q=1/2 附近大 N 极限非一致，交叉区域为 1-2q=O(ln N/N^{⌊n/2⌋-1})；计算机仿真与有限尺寸 conditioned-Gaussian 预测相符。加入抵消条件串扰均值的活动依赖控制势后，在 conditioned-Gaussian 近似下固定 0<q<1/2 的容量恢复为 N^{n-1}/ln N。
Conclusion: 偏置通过依赖偏置的串扰均值诱发容量交叉，使稠密联想记忆在有偏模式下的容量标度低于无偏情形；引入活动依赖控制势可在该近似下把容量恢复到无偏标度。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 在 Krotov-Hopfield 单点判据 P_error=1/N 下，稠密联想记忆 (dense associative memory) 的绝对容量对模式偏置 (bias) 极其敏感：n 阶多项式相互作用在 q=1/2 时容量为 N^{n-1}/ln N，但固定 q<1/2 时偶数 n≥4 降为 O(N^{n/2})、奇数 n≥5 降为 O(N^{(n+1)/2})，n=3 则保持 O(N^2/ln N)。作者预测在 1-2q=O(ln N/N^{⌊n/2⌋-1}) 区域出现偏置诱导的容量交叉 (bias-induced crossover)，并指出用一个活动依赖的控制势抵消条件串扰均值即可在 conditioned-Gaussian 近似下恢复 N^{n-1}/ln N 容量。
