summary_sections.method: 在中心化二值模式（分量以概率 q 取 1-q、否则取 -q，0<q≤1/2）上做信噪比 (signal-to-noise) 分析，采用 Krotov-Hopfield 单点判据 P_error=1/N；对 n 阶多项式相互作用分别推导 q=1/2 与固定 q<1/2 的容量标度，用渐近匹配给出交叉区域，并以计算机仿真对照有限尺寸 conditioned-Gaussian 预测。
summary_sections.result: q=1/2 时容量为 O(N^{n-1}/ln N)；固定 q<1/2 时偶数 n≥4 为 O(N^{n/2})、奇数 n≥5 为 O(N^{(n+1)/2})，n=3 两种情形均为 O(N^2/ln N)。n≥4 时这些不同渐近式意味着 q=1/2 附近大 N 极限非一致，交叉区域为 1-2q=O(ln N/N^{⌊n/2⌋-1})；计算机仿真与有限尺寸 conditioned-Gaussian 预测相符。加入抵消条件串扰均值的活动依赖控制势后，在 conditioned-Gaussian 近似下固定 0<q<1/2 的容量恢复为 N^{n-1}/ln N。
summary_sections.conclusion: 偏置通过依赖偏置的串扰均值诱发容量交叉，使稠密联想记忆在有偏模式下的容量标度低于无偏情形；引入活动依赖控制势可在该近似下把容量恢复到无偏标度。

papers.title: Schizophrenia Detection from EEG Signals: A Transformer Framework with Spectrogram Representation
papers.abstract_en: Schizophrenia is a serious psychiatric disorder that affects millions of people worldwide, and its diagnosis remains primarily dependent on clinical assessment. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive approach to investigate brain activity and has shown potential to support automated Schizophrenia detection. However, existing EEG-based classification studies often suffer from limitations including small datasets, inconsistent preprocessing strategies, and evaluation protocols that may not adequately prevent subject-related data leakage. In this study, we propose an EEG-based Schizophrenia classification framework that transforms preprocessed EEG recordings into time-frequency representations using the Short-Time Fourier Transform. The generated spectrogram images are classified using both conventional Machine Learning algorithms, including Support Vector Machines, Random Forests, and XGBoost, and Deep Learning models, including convolutional architectures and CNN-Transformer hybrids. To ensure reliable evaluation, all data partitions are performed at the subject level, and image-level predictions are aggregated into subject-level decisions. On the independent test set of 18 subjects, the CNN-Transformer (CT-SZ) model achieves a subject-level AUC-ROC of 95.00%, while the CNN + Squeeze-and-Excitation + Transformer (CST-SZ) model achieves 92.50%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CT-SZ：把预处理 EEG 经短时傅里叶变换 (STFT) 转成时频谱图，用 CNN-Transformer 混合网络分类，并按被试划分数据、把图像级预测聚合为被试级决策以杜绝被试数据泄漏。在 18 名被试的独立测试集上，CT-SZ 被试级 AUC-ROC 达 95.00%，CST-SZ 为 92.50%。
Motivation: 现有 EEG 精神分裂症分类研究受数据集小、预处理不一致、以及评估协议无法防止被试相关数据泄漏所限，导致可靠性存疑。
Method: 预处理后的 EEG 先经 STFT 转为时频谱图图像，再分别用传统机器学习（SVM、Random Forest、XGBoost）与深度模型（卷积架构、CNN-Transformer 混合）分类；所有数据划分在被试级进行，图像级预测聚合为被试级决策。
Result: 在 18 名被试的独立测试集上，CNN-Transformer（CT-SZ）被试级 AUC-ROC 为 95.00%，CNN + Squeeze-and-Excitation + Transformer（CST-SZ）为 92.50%。
Conclusion: 被试级划分加图像到被试的预测聚合，配合 CNN-Transformer 分类 EEG 时频谱图，可在独立被试上取得高 AUC-ROC 的精神分裂症检测。

papers.title: Granularity-Adaptive Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon language-model agents trained with reinforcement learning oftenreceive sparse outcome rewards that do not reveal which decisions along a tra-jectory deserve credit. Episode-level advantages provide coarse trajectory-widecredit, while step-level comparisons offer finer resolution with context-dependentestimation noise. We propose Granularity-Adaptive Credit Assignment (GACA),a critic-free method that adaptively mixes episode- and step-level credit for eachdecision during policy optimization. GACA normalizes the sampled response'smean per-token negative log-likelihood (NLL) within each trajectory and uses theresulting criticality score to determine the step-specific mixture. The computationreuses rollout log-probabilities without additional training rollouts or model eval-uations. Our analysis characterizes optimal score-dependent mixing and derivesconditions linking expected NLL to a lower bound on the preferred step-levelweight. Across ALFWorld and WebShop with 1.5B and 7B backbones, GACAachieves the highest reported mean success rates among the compared methods,while introducing negligible additional computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GACA（Granularity-Adaptive Credit Assignment）：在长时程 LLM agent 强化学习中，按每条轨迹内归一化的每 token 平均负对数似然 (NLL) 得到 criticality score，为每个决策自适应混合 episode 级与 step 级信用分配。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop、1.5B 与 7B backbone 上取得所比较方法中最高的平均成功率，额外计算开销可忽略。
Motivation: 长时程 LLM agent 的 RL 训练只有稀疏结果奖励，无法定位轨迹中哪些决策应得信用：episode 级 advantage 粒度过粗，step 级比较分辨率更细但估计噪声依赖上下文。
Method: GACA 是 critic-free 方法：对每条轨迹归一化采样响应的每 token 平均 NLL，用该 criticality score 决定每个 step 的混合权重；复用 rollout 的 log-probabilities，不需额外 rollout 或模型评估。分析给出 score 依赖的最优混合形式，并推导期望 NLL 与 step 级权重下界之间的条件。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop、1.5B 和 7B backbone 上，GACA 取得所比较方法中最高的平均成功率（highest reported mean success rates），额外计算开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 用轨迹内 NLL criticality 自适应混合粗细两级信用分配，可以在不引入 critic 和额外 rollout 的前提下改善长时程 agent 的稀疏奖励学习。

papers.title: From Fixed Keys to Readable Schemas: Small Language Models for Vehicle Agent Function Calls
papers.abstract_en: In-vehicle assistants must translate natural-language requests into accurate vehicle function calls under strict memory and latency constraints, making small language models (SLMs) attractive for on-device deployment. For such models, a key design choice is how the available function surface is presented. Two approaches are to represent each function with a dedicated Functional Token (FT) or provide function schemas directly in the prompt. FTs enable compact inference but are restricted to functions learned during training, whereas Schema-in-Prompt (SIP) can generalize to unseen functions at the cost of longer prompts and higher inference overhead. We introduce a benchmark of 9,822 single-turn examples spanning 79 vehicle functions derived from Android Automotive, including held-out functions and requests requiring refusal. We compare both approaches under matched fine-tuning across four SLMs from 270M to 1.7B parameters. On functions seen during training, scaling provides limited benefit: the 270M model can match the 1.7B model, and the highest Seen accuracy in our main grid occurs at 0.6B. On held-out functions, FT achieves zero accuracy by construction, whereas SIP generalizes and improves substantially with scale. On out-of-scope requests, FT can invoke an unavailable function it was trained to emit, while SIP more reliably refuses based on the functions offered. This flexibility comes with a higher inference cost, chiefly the latency of processing the schema prompt. Our theoretical analysis formalizes why only SIP can predict functions withheld as training targets and why longer schema contexts increase inference cost. Overall, function-surface representation, rather than model scale alone, determines the capabilities and failure modes of SLM-based vehicle function calling.
papers.comment: Camera-ready version. Accepted at the SLM-Agents Workshop at NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在车载助手函数调用上对比两种函数接口表示：Functional Token (FT) 把每个函数压成专用 token，Schema-in-Prompt (SIP) 直接把 schema 放进 prompt。在 9,822 条、79 个 Android Automotive 车辆函数的基准上，四个 270M–1.7B SLM 同等微调后，训练见过的函数上扩大规模收益有限（270M 可追平 1.7B，最高 Seen accuracy 出现在 0.6B），而 held-out 函数上 FT 按构造为零准确率、SIP 可泛化并随规模明显提升；结论是函数接口表示而非单纯模型规模决定能力与失效模式。
Motivation: 车载端侧 SLM 受内存与延迟约束，函数接口怎么呈现是关键设计选择：FT 紧凑但只能调用训练时见过的函数，SIP 能泛化到未见函数却带来更长 prompt 与更高推理开销，此前缺少受控对比。
Method: 构建含 9,822 条单轮样本、79 个源自 Android Automotive 的车辆函数的基准，覆盖 held-out 函数与需要拒答的请求；在四个 270M 到 1.7B 参数的 SLM 上做匹配微调 (matched fine-tuning)，对比 FT 与 SIP 两种函数面表示，并给出理论分析解释为何只有 SIP 能预测训练目标中被扣留的函数、以及更长 schema 上下文为何抬高推理成本。
Result: 训练见过的函数上扩大规模收益有限：270M 模型可匹配 1.7B，主网格中最高 Seen accuracy 出现在 0.6B；held-out 函数上 FT 准确率为零（按构造），SIP 可泛化且随规模显著提升；out-of-scope 请求上 FT 会调用它被训练输出的不可用函数，SIP 更可靠地依据提供的函数集合拒答；SIP 的代价是更高推理成本，主要是处理 schema prompt 的延迟。
Conclusion: 函数面表示而非单纯模型规模决定基于 SLM 的车辆函数调用的能力与失效模式：要覆盖未见函数与可靠拒答就得用 SIP，并接受 schema prompt 带来的延迟开销。

papers.title: FIRE3D: Feed-forward Interactive 3D Scene Reconstruction Within A Minute
papers.abstract_en: We present FIRE3D, a unified framework that transforms a single RGB image or casual video into interactable 3D scene assets for games and interactive applications in under a minute for up to twelve textured instances including preprocessing. At the core of FIRE3D is a feed-forward inference pipeline that predicts a compositional scene representation from posed RGB-D observations estimated from the RGB capture, including the 6-DoF pose, bounding box, mesh, and texture for detected objects. By modeling the scene as a collection of discrete entities, FIRE3D produces amodal object assets that can be independently edited and used in interactive applications. Our framework requires no test-time optimization, runs substantially faster than the compared reconstruction systems, and provides object-level completeness beyond existing feed-forward 3D approaches. We demonstrate leading detection accuracy, strong geometry reconstruction, and competitive rendering quality on the evaluated benchmarks, with substantial runtime gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FIRE3D 把单张 RGB 图或随手拍视频在一分钟内转成可交互的 3D 场景资产，前馈推理从 RGB 推得的 posed RGB-D 观测直接预测组合式场景表示，输出每个物体的 6-DoF pose、bounding box、mesh 与 texture。场景被建模为离散实体集合，得到可独立编辑的 amodal 物体资产，最多含 12 个带纹理实例（含预处理），全程无需 test-time optimization。
Motivation: 现有 feed-forward 3D 重建缺少物体级完整性，而依赖 test-time optimization 的系统速度慢，难以支撑游戏与交互应用的即时使用。
Method: 前馈推理管线从 RGB capture 估计 posed RGB-D 观测，再预测组合式场景表示，为每个检测到的物体输出 6-DoF pose、bounding box、mesh 与 texture；以离散实体集合建模场景，生成可独立编辑的 amodal 物体资产，不做 test-time optimization。
Result: 在被评测的 benchmark 上展示领先的检测精度、较强的几何重建与有竞争力的渲染质量，运行时间相对被比较的重建系统有大幅缩短；单图或视频到可交互资产全流程在 1 分钟内完成，最多支持 12 个带纹理实例（含预处理）。
Conclusion: 不做 test-time optimization 的前馈组合式重建可以在保持物体级完整性的同时把重建时间压到分钟以内，适合游戏与交互应用的即时资产生成。

papers.title: FujinSplat: Seeing Through Smoke with RAW-Domain Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: The appearance of a smoky scene is shaped by two processes that a camera records together: the participating medium alters scene radiance in a view-dependent way, and the image signal processor (ISP) then remaps the result through a nonlinear tone and color transformation. Recovering a clean 3D scene requires separating both. Per-view sRGB dehazing acts only after the ISP has entangled them; standard 3D reconstruction ignores the medium and absorbs it into scene geometry and radiance. FujinSplat addresses the problem in the RAW domain, where the two processes remain separable. A per-scene Base ISP is fitted from the scene's hazy RAW captures to its own camera renderings and then frozen, providing a fixed photometric anchor that performs no dehazing. Analyzing expert corrections reveals a compact, low-dimensional correction space identifiable from RAW alone. FujinSplat therefore fits per-view action answers at the training poses and trains a single scene-agnostic controller to regress them from RAW; the corrected views supervise one static 3D Gaussian representation, jointly with a bounded per-view residual that reconciles cross-view photometric inconsistencies. On the RealX3D real-world smoke benchmark FujinSplat clearly outperforms the strongest comparable baseline, ahead of both physics-based reconstruction and restoration-then-3DGS pipelines. Code is available at https://github.com/I2WM/FujinSplat.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 11 figures, including supplementary material. Updated author affiliations and funding acknowledgments; scientific content unchanged. Code: https://github.com/I2WM/FujinSplat
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FujinSplat 在 RAW 域把烟雾场景的参与介质散射与 ISP 非线性色调映射分开处理：先从含烟 RAW 拟合并冻结一个仅做光度锚定的 Base ISP，再在训练位姿上拟合每视图校正量，用单一场景无关控制器从 RAW 回归这些校正，监督一个静态 3D Gaussian 表示并附带每视图残差。在 RealX3D 真实烟雾基准上明显优于最强可比基线，同时领先基于物理的重建与先复原再 3DGS 的流程。
Motivation: 含烟图像中参与介质与 ISP 变换被相机耦合记录：逐视图 sRGB 去烟发生在 ISP 已把两者纠缠之后，标准 3D 重建则把介质吸进几何与辐射，二者都无法干净恢复无烟 3D 场景。

Conclusion: 把介质与 ISP 的解耦放到 RAW 域、用冻结 Base ISP 加低维校正空间，是恢复干净 3D 场景的更有效路径，代码已在 GitHub 开源。

papers.title: Seeing the City or Recognizing the Place? What Street-View Imagery Adds Beyond Existing Urban Data in VLM-Based Urban Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Street-view imagery is increasingly analysed with vision-language models (VLMs) to infer urban attributes, but predictive accuracy alone does not show how much a photograph contributes beyond data already available for the same place. Using three VLMs, we compare image-based predictions with existing urban data for seven attributes drawn from five public resources. Each urban unit is evaluated with imagery, with location or text context, and against non-image predictions from nearby observations or public records. We also replace images and add conflicting records to test which source the predictions follow. Nearby observations or public records matched or exceeded image-only predictions for road damage, curb ramps, population, and house price. Images were more informative for building type, building function, and the floor count of low-rise buildings. For floor count, the advantage of images over nearby OpenStreetMap labels increased by 5.7 percentage points per doubling of distance to the nearest labelled building and declined for tall buildings whose rooflines often fell outside the frame. When images and records disagreed, predictions usually moved towards the supplied record. Released OpenFACADES floor annotations, generated with OpenStreetMap floor values as input, showed the same dependence: their agreement with the reference increased with building height, whereas that of image-only reruns decreased. The value of street-view imagery therefore depends on whether an attribute is visible and how well the place is already covered by existing data. Because machine-derived labels are often reused as references, these comparisons also bear on how urban datasets are documented and evaluated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用三个 VLM 在 7 个城市属性、5 个公开数据资源上对比街景图像预测与既有非图像数据，发现图像并非普遍增益：道路损坏、缘石坡道、人口、房价上邻近观测或公共记录持平或更好，建筑类型、建筑功能与低层建筑楼层数上图像更有信息。楼层数上图像相对邻近 OpenStreetMap 标签的优势随到最近有标注建筑距离每翻倍增加 5.7 个百分点，但对屋顶常出画的高层建筑减弱；图文冲突时预测通常倒向给定记录。
Motivation: VLM 街景城市感知只报预测精度，无法说明一张照片相对同地点已有数据究竟多贡献了什么，也无法解释属性何时该用图像、何时该用既有记录。
Method: 用三个 VLM 对 7 个属性（取自 5 个公开资源）分别做仅图像、加位置或文本上下文、以及与邻近观测或公共记录的非图像预测对比；再替换图像并加入冲突记录，检验预测倒向哪个数据源；并用以 OpenStreetMap 楼层值为输入生成的 OpenFACADES 楼层标注做交叉检验。
Result: 道路损坏、缘石坡道、人口、房价上邻近观测或公共记录持平或超过仅图像预测；建筑类型、建筑功能与低层建筑楼层数上图像更有信息。楼层数上图像优势随到最近有标注建筑距离每翻倍增加 5.7 个百分点，高层建筑上减弱。图文冲突时预测通常偏向给定记录；OpenFACADES 标注与参考的一致性随建筑高度上升，而仅图像重跑的一致性下降。
Conclusion: 街景图像的价值取决于属性是否可见以及该地点既有数据的覆盖好坏；由于机器生成标签常被当作参考复用，这类源间对比也决定了城市数据集应如何记录与评估。

papers.title: Can LLMs Discover Scientific Laws in Real and Parallel Worlds?
papers.abstract_en: Scientific law discovery has long been central to scientific progress, proceeding through iterative cycles of generating hypotheses, testing them against empirical evidence, and refining them under scientific constraints. As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly involved in scientific research, whether they can discover scientific laws and how to evaluate this ability remain open questions. A central evaluation challenge is to move beyond familiar published equations while keeping discovery tasks grounded in scientific data and constraints. We introduce SciLaws-Bench, a curated collection of scientific task packages grounded in the source literature, each linking a scientific problem, supporting data, published reference equations, and scientific-validity rubrics. Through agent-assisted curation and human verification, we assemble 118 problems spanning six disciplines, drawing on 381 papers, 291 candidate laws, and roughly 8M data points. Each problem supports two complementary evaluation settings. SciLaws-Real uses fixed scientific data to evaluate proposed laws for held-out predictive fit and scientific validity. SciLaws-Parallel evaluates recovery of a newly synthesized structural variant of a published equation through active queries to a simulator calibrated to the source data. Our evaluation reveals three limitations: good predictive fit need not imply scientific validity, recovering a published formula does not establish recovery of its new structural terms, and candidate selection remains a bottleneck in scientific law discovery. Project page: https://yiyihum.github.io/SciLaws-Bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SciLaws-Bench：118 个源自文献的科学任务包，每个绑定问题、数据、参考方程与科学有效性 rubric，用 SciLaws-Real（固定数据上测留出预测拟合与科学有效性）和 SciLaws-Parallel（通过向校准模拟器主动提问，恢复新合成的方程结构变体）两种设置评测 LLM 的科学定律发现能力。评测揭示三条限制：预测拟合好不等于科学有效，恢复已发表公式不等于恢复其新增结构项，候选选择仍是瓶颈。
Motivation: LLM 能否发现科学定律缺乏可评测的基准：现有评测容易退化为回忆已发表方程，而任务又需扎根于真实科学数据与科学约束。
Method: 用 agent 辅助策展加人工核验构建任务包，每包含科学问题、支撑数据、已发表参考方程与科学有效性 rubric；SciLaws-Real 在固定数据上评估所提方程的留出预测拟合与科学有效性，SciLaws-Parallel 让模型向按源数据校准的模拟器主动提问，评估其能否恢复已发表方程的新合成结构变体。
Result: 共 118 个问题、覆盖六个学科，基于 381 篇论文、291 个候选定律与约 800 万数据点构建。评测给出三条定性发现：好的预测拟合未必意味着科学有效性；恢复已发表公式不代表恢复了其新的结构项；候选选择仍是科学定律发现的瓶颈。
Conclusion: 科学定律发现的评测必须把预测拟合与科学有效性分开，并用可主动查询的模拟器检验结构项恢复，否则高拟合分数会掩盖真正的发现能力缺口。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Teaching Vision-Language Models to Use the Scale They Are Given: Label-Free Equivariance Training for Metric Physical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Metric questions about video, such as the speed of a moving object, require a vision-language model to convert visual measurements into physical units using a real-world reference supplied in the prompt. We find that current models use this reference only partially. When every world-space quantity in the prompt is multiplied by a common factor, the prompt still describes the same video and the correct answer changes by exactly that factor, but the predictions of eight models change by less, and their accuracy stays concentrated near the scale that the depicted objects usually have. Asked the same physics in a scale-free form, the two models we test recover the closed-form scaling laws on most items, which indicates that the deficit lies in metric grounding and not in knowledge of the physical mechanism. Because the scaling relation is exact, it can serve as supervision without metric annotations. Equivariance Self-Distillation (EquiSD) projects a model's own prediction onto the functions that satisfy this relation and fine-tunes the model on the resulting targets, with one query per training question and no ground truth. Trained on synthetic video only, EquiSD brings a 3B model close to the exact relation on held-out simulated videos, also at scales not seen in training, and improves its accuracy across scales. Without adaptation, it also improves accuracy across scales on the QuantiPhy benchmark, where its gain reaches 93% of that obtained by supervision with exact simulator answers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 视觉-语言模型在视频度量问题上只部分利用提示中给出的尺度参考：把提示里所有世界空间量同乘一个因子，答案应同比例变化，但被测 8 个模型的预测变化不足，准确率仍集中在图中物体的常见尺度上。提出 Equivariance Self-Distillation (EquiSD)，把模型自身预测投影到满足精确尺度律的函数上并据此微调，每题只需一次查询、无需度量标注；3B 模型在留出仿真视频上逼近该关系并跨尺度提升准确率，零改动迁移到 QuantiPhy 上增益达用精确模拟器答案监督所得增益的 93%。
Motivation: 视频度量推理要求模型把视觉测量换算成物理单位，而当前模型只部分使用提示提供的真实尺度参考，预测被物体常见尺度锚定；作者判定缺陷在 metric grounding 而非物理机制知识，因为同一批模型在无尺度形式下多数题能恢复闭式尺度律。
Method: 利用尺度关系的精确性作为无标注监督：Equivariance Self-Distillation (EquiSD) 将模型自身预测投影到满足该等变关系的函数集合上，用投影结果作为目标微调模型，每个训练题只查询一次、不需要 ground truth；训练数据仅为合成视频。
Result: 8 个模型在提示整体缩放时预测变化小于应有比例，准确率集中在物体常见尺度；2 个受测模型在无尺度形式下多数题恢复闭式尺度律。EquiSD 训练的 3B 模型在留出仿真视频上逼近精确关系，并覆盖训练中未见过的尺度，跨尺度准确率提升；不经适配在 QuantiPhy 上同样跨尺度提升，增益达到用精确模拟器答案监督所得增益的 93%。
Conclusion: 尺度等变性可作为免标注监督直接修补 VLM 的 metric grounding 缺陷，其收益接近用精确模拟器答案做监督的水平，且能泛化到训练未见尺度。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Vision Models Predict Urban Scene Appraisal with Limited Neural Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained vision embeddings are widely used to model how people appraise urban scenes, and they are validated almost entirely by how well they predict human ratings. Accurate prediction shows that an embedding contains the information needed to recover the ratings. It does not show that the embedding arranges scenes as the human visual system does, which is assumed when distances or dimensions in the embedding are read as perceptual. Using openly released EEG recorded while 63 adults viewed and rated street scenes of Berlin, we compared the neural representational geometry of the scenes with the geometry of pretrained vision models that differ in training objective and size, of simple image descriptors and of the ratings themselves, each relative to a noise ceiling given by the agreement between participants. No feature space reached more than about half of the noise ceiling, which corresponds to about a fifth of the reliable variance in the neural geometry. A descriptor of oriented edge energy reached the level of most pretrained models while capturing a different part of the neural geometry, and deeper layers corresponded to later neural responses. The same embeddings predicted held-out ratings well, up to r = 0.87, yet prediction accuracy and neural correspondence were not reliably related across models, and the best predictor was among the least aligned. Predicting how a street is appraised is therefore weak evidence that a model represents the street as the brain does.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 63 名成人观看并评价柏林街景时的公开 EEG，比较场景神经表征几何与预训练视觉模型、简单图像描述子及评分本身的几何。没有任何特征空间超过噪声天花板的一半（约相当于神经几何可靠方差的五分之一），定向边缘能量描述子已达多数预训练模型水平；评分预测最高达 r = 0.87，但预测精度与神经对应在模型间无可靠关联，最佳预测者反而属于对齐最差之列。
Motivation: 预训练视觉嵌入几乎只靠预测人类评分来验证，但预测准确并不证明嵌入按人类视觉系统的方式组织场景，而把嵌入距离或维度当作感知量解读正依赖这一假设。
Method: 基于公开 EEG（63 名成人观看并评价柏林街景），把场景的神经表征几何与不同训练目标和规模的预训练视觉模型、简单图像描述子、评分本身的几何逐一比较，噪声天花板由被试间一致性给出；同时用这些嵌入预测留出评分。
Result: 没有任何特征空间超过噪声天花板的约一半，即约神经几何可靠方差的五分之一；定向边缘能量描述子达到多数预训练模型的水平但捕捉神经几何的不同部分，更深层对应更晚的神经反应；同一嵌入预测留出评分可达 r = 0.87，但预测精度与神经对应在模型间无可靠关系，最佳预测者属于对齐最差之列。
Conclusion: 预测一条街道被如何评价，是模型按大脑方式表征该街道的弱证据；评分预测表现不能替代神经对应检验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sliding-window beats linear attention
papers.abstract_en: Due to the nature of quadratic attention, Large Language Models (LLMs) consume a lot of memory and energy: every new token costs more than the previous one, and its keys and values must be stored in memory indefinitely, which is unsustainable. Two main lines of work address this: compressing the KV cache, e.g., by evicting or quantizing keys and values, and retrofitting LLMs to use Linear Attention, which replaces the KV cache with a fixed-size state. Retrofitting has attracted a lot of attention, given its promise to solve the quadratic scaling problem with state-of-the-art performance at low cost. However, it has not been properly compared to the simplest form of KV-cache eviction: Sliding Window Attention (SWA) with attention sinks. In this work, we show that SWA with sinks performs as well or better than most retrofitted Linear Attention models across multiple LLMs and downstream tasks, with the largest gains on long-context and generative tasks. On long-context reasoning tasks (Needle-in-a-Haystack and BABILong), SWA achieves massively higher performance (2 to 10 times higher than linear attention). SWA requires no additional training, is extremely fast, and requires little memory, making it an extremely cheap and reliable solution. When the training budget is limited, switching to SWA is a much more effective way to reduce inference memory cost than retrofitting linear attention. Linear attention models have shown promise, but they require training from scratch or extensive retrofitting to reap their architectural benefits and come close to SWA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LLM 推理内存与二次注意力开销的问题上，带 attention sinks 的滑动窗口注意力 (SWA) 在多个 LLM 与下游任务上追平或超过多数改造式 Linear Attention 模型，长上下文与生成任务差距最大；在 Needle-in-a-Haystack 与 BABILong 上 SWA 性能高出 2 到 10 倍，且无需额外训练。训练预算有限时，切到 SWA 比改造 linear attention 更划算。
Motivation: 二次注意力使 LLM 每个新 token 成本递增、KV cache 需无限期驻留内存，不可持续；Linear Attention 改造被寄予厚望，却从未与最朴素的 KV cache 逐出方案 SWA+sink 正面对比。
Method: 把带 attention sinks 的 Sliding Window Attention 作为 KV-cache 逐出基线，与 KV 压缩（逐出/量化）和改造式 Linear Attention 两条路线在多个 LLM、多个下游任务上对比，重点考察长上下文推理与生成任务，并比较训练预算受限时两种降内存方案的代价。
Result: SWA+sink 在多数改造式 Linear Attention 模型上持平或更优，长上下文与生成任务增益最大；在 Needle-in-a-Haystack 与 BABILong 上性能高出 linear attention 2 到 10 倍。SWA 无需额外训练、速度极快、内存占用小。
Conclusion: Linear Attention 只有从头训练或大量改造才能接近 SWA，因此训练预算受限时直接切到 SWA 是更有效的降推理内存手段。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SEPO: Evidence-Grounded Prompt Optimization via Structural Editing
papers.abstract_en: Existing API-only prompt optimisers are often described as interpretable, but in practice, this usually means only post-hoc inspectability: each iteration still rewrites the prompt as one opaque string, leaving a trace of full-prompt diffs rather than localisable, machine-readable edits. This paper introduces SEPO (Structural, Evidence-grounded Prompt Optimization), a multi-trajectory prompt optimiser centred on edit-effect lineage feedback. Rather than treating each iteration as an isolated whole-prompt rewrite, SEPO locally edits stable, typed units in a two-layer prompt schema, links the target and realised structural operations of each edit to the examples it newly fixes or breaks, and carries this edit-effect record forward to guide later architect calls on the same search branch. This makes prompt optimisation addressable, attributable, and actionable. Across a 14-task held-out suite, SEPO improves over the strongest baseline, GEPA, by 3.1 pp on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and 2.2 pp on Qwen3-8B, reaching 61.9% and 73.3% macro accuracy. SEPO also lies on both the optimisation-time and test-time Pareto frontiers, spending 2.9M optimisation tokens versus 4.1M for GEPA and producing prompts over 5x shorter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SEPO 把 API-only 提示优化从整串重写改为两层提示 schema 上的类型化局部编辑，记录每次编辑的目标与实际结构操作及其新修复/破坏的样例，形成 edit-effect lineage 并沿同一搜索分支传递给后续 architect 调用。在 14 任务 held-out 套件上，相对最强基线 GEPA 提升 3.1 pp（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，达 61.9% macro accuracy）与 2.2 pp（Qwen3-8B，达 73.3%），同时优化 token 用量 2.9M 对 GEPA 的 4.1M，生成提示短 5 倍以上。
Motivation: 现有 API-only 提示优化器号称可解释，实际只是事后可查看：每次迭代仍把提示当一整串不透明字符串重写，留下的是全文 diff，而非可定位、机器可读的编辑记录。
Method: SEPO 是 multi-trajectory 提示优化器，核心是 edit-effect lineage feedback：在两层提示 schema 上对稳定的类型化单元做局部编辑，把每次编辑的目标结构操作与实际实现的操作关联到它新修复或破坏的样例，并把该编辑-效果记录沿同一搜索分支传递以指导后续 architect 调用。
Result: 在 14 任务 held-out 套件上，相对最强基线 GEPA：Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 提升 3.1 pp 至 61.9% macro accuracy，Qwen3-8B 提升 2.2 pp 至 73.3% macro accuracy；SEPO 同时位于优化时间与测试时间两条 Pareto 前沿上，优化消耗 2.9M token（GEPA 为 4.1M），生成的提示短 5 倍以上。
Conclusion: 把提示优化做成可定位、可归因、可操作的结构化编辑，而非整串重写，能在更少优化 token 与更短提示下取得更高 macro accuracy，同时占据优化时间与测试时间的 Pareto 前沿。

papers.title: Difference-in-Differences on a Censored Rating Scale Can Manufacture an Effect: Evidence from a Pre-Registered LLM-Judge Audit
papers.abstract_en: LLM-judge audits assess bias by comparing ratings across matched conditions. Difference-in-differences designs compare two candidate responses within each item and then compare that contrast across a manipulated attribute. We show in closed form that this endpoint need not identify differential preference on the latent scale when ratings are bounded. A severity shift common to both responses produces an observed interaction whenever the scale bounds attenuate it unequally. We examine this problem in a pre-registered audit comprising 990 calls to a frozen pedagogy judge. The registered primary analysis did not detect an effect of the stated learner profile on scaffolding preference. The only nominally significant secondary interaction concerned productive struggle ($+0.378$ points; $p = 0.002$). A post-hoc construction with zero differential preference reproduced 79 to 85\% of this interaction using the observed severity shift and the scale floor alone. The observed interaction therefore does not identify differential preference on the latent scale.
papers.comment: Accepted at NewInML Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有界（censored）评分尺度上做差分中的差分 (DiD)，即使真实潜在偏好差异为零，只要存在对两条回答共同的严重度位移且尺度上下界对其衰减不等，就会凭空造出交互效应。预注册的 LLM-judge 偏见审计中，唯一名义显著的次级交互（productive struggle，+0.378 分，p=0.002）被一个零差异偏好的事后构造复现了 79%–85%，仅靠观测到的严重度位移和尺度下界。
Motivation: LLM-judge 审计用 DiD 比较匹配条件下两条回答的评分对比，但评分有界时该端点未必识别潜在尺度上的差异偏好，会让审计报告出并不存在的偏见效应。
Method: 闭式证明有界尺度下 DiD 端点的识别失效：共同严重度位移被上下界不等量衰减即产生观测交互；随后做一项预注册审计，调用一个冻结的 pedagogy judge 共 990 次，主分析检验所述 learner profile 对 scaffolding 偏好的影响，并用零差异偏好的事后构造对照观测交互。
Result: 预注册主分析未检出 learner profile 对 scaffolding 偏好的效应；唯一名义显著的次级交互是 productive struggle，+0.378 分，p=0.002；零差异偏好的事后构造用观测严重度位移加尺度下界复现了该交互的 79%–85%。
Conclusion: 该观测交互不能识别潜在尺度上的差异偏好；有界尺度上的 DiD 审计结论必须先排除尺度边界与共同严重度位移造成的伪效应。

papers.title: Reason in the Words You Speak: Idiolectal Paraphrasing Off-Policy Traces for Reasoning Distillation in VideoLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Recent large language models achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks, where reinforcement learning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has emerged as a leading paradigm for optimizing models on self-generated trajectories. However, the on-policy nature of GRPO bounds the model to the reasoning skills it can already produce, restricting to learn more advanced capabilities. Prior works inject privileged reasoning traces from a stronger teacher policy to guide training, yet these traces are inherently out of distribution with respect to the student policy. We observe that this mismatch between on-policy and off-policy causes gradient clipping on semantically critical reasoning tokens, ultimately rewarding correct answers while leaving the reasoning that justifies them unlearned. Hence, we propose \textbf{Echo-GRPO}, a framework that lets the model reason in the words it speaks. Rather than imitating low-probability privileged traces from the teacher model, Echo-GRPO rewrites them into the student policy's own \textit{idiolect}, that is, its own characteristic vocabulary and expression patterns, while preserving their semantics via Dual-Reference Decoding. We instantiate this framework as \textbf{VideoEcho-R1} for video reasoning distillation, achieving consistent improvements across three multimodal LLM backbones and five benchmarks. Finally, we show that our idiolectal paraphrasing is a plug-in module that consistently improves both RL and supervised fine-tuning frameworks for reasoning distillation, demonstrating that policy-aligned supervision extends beyond GRPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Echo-GRPO 把教师的特权推理轨迹改写成学生策略自己的 idiolect（惯用词汇与表达）再做蒸馏，缓解 GRPO 的 on-policy 性质导致语义关键 token 被梯度裁剪、只奖励正确答案而推理未被学到的问题。实例化为 VideoEcho-R1，在三个多模态 LLM backbone 和五个 benchmark 上一致提升，且作为即插即用模块同时改善 RL 与 SFT 蒸馏。
Motivation: GRPO 只能在模型已能产生的轨迹上优化，注入教师轨迹又与学生策略分布外，导致语义关键推理 token 被梯度裁剪，正确答案被奖励但支撑它的推理学不到。
Method: Echo-GRPO 用 Dual-Reference Decoding 在保留语义的前提下把教师轨迹改写为学生自身的 idiolect 表达，再用于推理蒸馏；实例化为 VideoEcho-R1 面向视频推理，覆盖三个多模态 LLM backbone，并作为插件接入 RL 与 supervised fine-tuning 框架。
Result: 在三个多模态 LLM backbone、五个 benchmark 上取得一致改进；idiolectal paraphrasing 作为即插即用模块同时提升 RL 与 SFT 两类推理蒸馏框架。
Conclusion: 与策略对齐的监督信号（policy-aligned supervision）能超越 GRPO 本身，是让学生学到支撑正确答案的推理的关键。

papers.title: Bee Detection and Tracking at Hive Entrance using YOLO11 and ByteTrack
papers.abstract_en: This work presents an automatic bee entrance monitoring system based on YOLO11 transfer learning and the ByteTrack tracking algorithm. The study investigates the influence of data augmentation, backbone freezing, and tracker parameter optimization on the detection and counting of small, fast-moving bees. The detector with progressive backbone unfreezing strategy achieved about 97.0% precision and 98.7% mAP50, while providing more stable convergence than full fine-tuning. Experiments also showed that light augmentation outperformed heavy augmentation. For tracking, ByteTrack parameters were optimized to improve trajectory continuity under low-confidence detections. On an independent 25 FPS side-view video, the optimized YOLO11-ByteTrack system correctly counted 43 of 47 incoming bees (91.5%) and 7 of 30 outgoing bees (23.3%). Error analysis showed that most counting errors were caused by missed detections due to rapid bee motion and motion blur, while tracking failures became less frequent after parameter optimization. Overall, the results indicate that moderate augmentation, progressive backbone unfreezing, and ByteTrack tuning improve the reliability of automatic bee entrance monitoring under realistic recording conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 YOLO11 迁移学习加 ByteTrack 做蜂巢入口蜜蜂进出计数，渐进解冻 backbone 的检测器达到约 97.0% precision 与 98.7% mAP50，且比全量微调收敛更稳。在独立 25 FPS 侧视视频上，优化后的系统正确计数 47 只入巢蜂中的 43 只（91.5%），但出巢蜂仅 7/30（23.3%）；主要误差来自快速运动与运动模糊导致的漏检。
Motivation: 蜂巢入口监测需要在真实录制条件下自动检测并计数小而快速移动的目标，而漏检与跟踪断裂会直接破坏计数可靠性。
Method: 以 YOLO11 迁移学习训练检测器，对比数据增强强度（light vs heavy）、backbone 冻结与渐进解冻策略；再用 ByteTrack 跟踪，并针对低置信度检测优化 tracker 参数以改善轨迹连续性。
Result: 渐进解冻策略的检测器约 97.0% precision、98.7% mAP50，收敛比全量微调更稳定；light augmentation 优于 heavy augmentation。独立 25 FPS 侧视视频上正确计数入巢蜂 43/47（91.5%）、出巢蜂 7/30（23.3%）；误差分析显示多数计数错误源于快速运动与运动模糊造成的漏检，tracker 参数优化后跟踪失败减少。
Conclusion: 中等强度增强、渐进 backbone 解冻与 ByteTrack 调参能在真实录制条件下提升自动蜂巢入口监测的可靠性，而计数瓶颈仍是运动模糊引起的漏检，出巢方向计数尤其不可靠。

papers.title: TRACE: Training-time Report-guided and Clinically Ordered Concept Editing
papers.abstract_en: Breast ultrasound diagnosis relies on clinically meaningful semantic concepts, yet most deep learning methods adopt end-to-end image-to-label paradigms that lack interpretability and robustness. While concept-based approaches offer a promising alternative, they often assume complete annotations or require multimodal inputs at inference, which significantly limits their real-world applicability. To tackle these issues, we propose Training-time Report-guided and Clinically Ordered Concept Editing (TRACE), a training-time report-guided framework that leverages structured radiology reports as privileged concept supervision while enabling image-only diagnosis at test time. TRACE refines image-derived concepts through a teacher-guided editing mechanism within a malignancy-aware ordered concept space. To address incomplete annotations, we introduce Strategic Concept Missing Training (SCMT) and train an image-only self-editor via edit distillation for autonomous concept refinement. Besides, we introduce BUSC, a concept-enriched benchmark linking images, labels, and structured attributes. Experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that TRACE achieves superior performance and improved cross-domain robustness compared to existing methods.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026). 9 pages, 3 figures Corrected typos and added references
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 把结构化放射学报告当作训练期特权概念监督，在 malignancy-aware 有序概念空间里用 teacher-guided editing 修正图像侧概念，测试时只用图像完成乳腺超声诊断。针对标注不全再加 Strategic Concept Missing Training (SCMT) 与 edit distillation 训练 image-only self-editor 自主修正概念，并发布概念增强基准 BUSC。在多个数据集上相对现有方法取得更优性能与更好的跨域鲁棒性。
Motivation: 乳腺超声深度学习多为端到端 image-to-label，缺可解释性与鲁棒性；概念类方法又假设标注完整或推理时需要多模态输入，难以落地。
Method: TRACE 用结构化放射学报告作训练期特权概念监督，经 teacher-guided editing 在 malignancy-aware 有序概念空间中精炼图像侧概念；用 SCMT 处理不完整标注，并以 edit distillation 训练 image-only self-editor 做自主概念修正；同时提出 BUSC 基准，关联图像、标签与结构化属性。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验显示 TRACE 相比现有方法取得更优性能与更好的跨域鲁棒性；测试阶段仅需图像输入。
Conclusion: 把报告放在训练期当特权概念监督、推理只留图像，可在不牺牲诊断性能的前提下换来可解释概念与跨域鲁棒性。

papers.title: CTIFoundry: An Agent-Native Corpus Scaffold for Cyber Threat Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Cyber threat intelligence (CTI) is increasingly consumed not by human analysts but by LLM agents that compose multi-step investigations at query time. The harness side of this shift has matured rapidly, but the corpus side has not: threat reports and vulnerability databases are still packaged for retrieval-augmented generation, as opaque chunks behind an embedding index. We argue that this substrate, not model capability, is the bottleneck on agentic CTI investigation, and present CTIFoundry, an agent-native corpus scaffold. At build time, CTIFoundry materializes the latent structure of a CTI corpus: a deterministic ontology graph over four authoritative knowledge bases (CVE, CWE, CAPEC, ATT&CK) whose official cross-references become typed, traversable edges; a span-grounded report layer whose canonical, alias-resolved cross-vendor entities index provenance-carrying chunks; and hybrid dense+lexical retrieval surfaces. At query time this structure is exposed through seven typed tools and three procedural skills mounted on a stock, widely-used open-source agent harness. On the public CTIConnect benchmark, swapping only the action surface lifts the identically-harnessed agent from 0.610 to 0.829 overall F1 with gpt-5.4 and from 0.470 to 0.745 with claude-haiku-4-5: a small model on CTIFoundry surpasses a flagship model on the flat substrate. The scaffolded agent is simultaneously more accurate and more efficient: on both Claude models it answers with roughly half the tool calls per question. The ablation distills design principles for matching corpus scaffolding to data modality, in CTI and beyond. Build-time validation guarantees zero fabricated identifiers by construction, and the scaffold sustains 1,168 investigations end-to-end at about 2.6 cents each.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CTIFoundry 把 CTI 语料从 RAG 式不透明分块改造成 agent 原生结构：构建期物化 CVE/CWE/CAPEC/ATT&CK 本体图、别名归一的跨厂商实体索引与稠密+词法混合检索，查询期暴露 7 个类型化工具和 3 个 procedural skills。在 CTIConnect 上只换动作面，gpt-5.4 的整体 F1 从 0.610 升到 0.829，claude-haiku-4-5 从 0.470 升到 0.745，小模型反超平坦基底上的旗舰模型。
Motivation: LLM agent 已成为 CTI 报告与漏洞库的主要消费方，但语料仍按 RAG 检索的不透明分块打包；作者认为瓶颈在语料基底而非模型能力。
Method: 构建期物化语料潜在结构：以 CVE、CWE、CAPEC、ATT&CK 四个权威知识库的官方交叉引用生成确定性本体图（类型化可遍历边），加 span-grounded 报告层（别名归一的跨厂商实体索引带 provenance 的分块）与稠密+词法混合检索面；查询期通过 7 个类型化工具和 3 个 procedural skills 挂到现成开源 agent harness 上。
Result: 在公开 CTIConnect benchmark 上仅替换动作面：gpt-5.4 整体 F1 0.610 → 0.829，claude-haiku-4-5 0.470 → 0.745；两个 Claude 模型上每题工具调用数约减半。构建期校验按构造保证零伪造标识符，端到端支撑 1,168 次 investigation，单次约 2.6 美分。
Conclusion: 把语料潜在结构物化成 agent 可遍历的动作面，比换更强模型更能提升多步 CTI 调查的准确率与效率；消融给出按数据模态匹配语料脚手架的设计原则，可外推到 CTI 之外。

papers.title: Difference-of-Convex Regularization for Graph Learning by Differentiable Programming
papers.abstract_en: Laplacian-regularized minimization is fundamental in signal processing and machine learning, but explicit construction of the dense graph Laplacian pseudoinverse can be computationally expensive. To address this issue, we consider the setting where the graph Laplacian is given and propose a Difference-of-Convex Regularizer (DCR) graph learning framework that learns a reusable approximation of the pseudoinverse action through regularized Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) and shrinkage-regularized Convex--Concave Procedure (CCCP) iterations. For Laplacian-Regularized Nonnegative Least Squares (LR-NNLS), dual and Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) analysis motivates separating graph-dependent pseudoinverse learning from instance-specific optimization. The learned pseudoinverse is embedded into a differentiable primal optimization procedure as a graph-aware preconditioner for nonnegative reconstruction and can be reused across LR-NNLS instances sharing the same graph. We establish stability and fixed-point existence guarantees for the proposed pseudoinverse-learning iteration. Experiments across different graph topologies and scales demonstrate near-reference accuracy, competitive time-to-moderate-accuracy behavior, and effective cross-instance reuse across independently generated problem instances sharing the same graph.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Difference-of-Convex Regularizer (DCR) 图学习框架，用正则化 MLE 与带收缩的 CCCP 迭代学出可复用的图拉普拉斯伪逆作用近似，再作为可微原始优化中的图感知预条件器嵌入 LR-NNLS。对共享同一图的多个实例可跨实例复用，实验显示接近参考精度与有竞争力的 time-to-moderate-accuracy。
Motivation: Laplacian 正则化最小化中显式构造稠密图拉普拉斯伪逆代价高，且每个 LR-NNLS 实例都要重复求解。
Method: 在图拉普拉斯已知的设定下，用正则化 Maximum Likelihood Estimation 与 shrinkage 正则的 Convex-Concave Procedure (CCCP) 迭代学习伪逆作用的可复用近似；由 LR-NNLS 的对偶与 KKT 分析把图相关的伪逆学习与实例相关优化分离，再将学到的伪逆作为图感知预条件器嵌入可微原始优化流程。
Result: 在不同图拓扑与规模上的实验显示接近参考精度 (near-reference accuracy)、有竞争力的 time-to-moderate-accuracy 表现，以及在共享同一图的独立生成实例间的有效跨实例复用；并为伪逆学习迭代建立稳定性与不动点存在性保证。
Conclusion: 把图相关的伪逆学习从实例优化中拆出来并跨实例复用，可在保持精度的同时降低 LR-NNLS 类问题的重复求解开销。

papers.title: Arm2Air: Cross-Embodiment Skeleton Transfer for 3D Relay Formation
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) relay networks can restore connectivity after communication infrastructure is damaged. Urban relay placement is difficult because line-of-sight blockage, communication range, altitude, and three-dimensional obstacles must be considered jointly. Arm2Air transfers obstacle-avoidance skeletons from robot arms to UAV relay placement through cross-embodiment transfer. Source-domain robot-arm motions from a pretrained Neural MP model are converted into ordered skeletons that pretrain a transformer-based transfer platform, which is then adapted to the UAV domain using limited target data and Low-Rank Adaptation. The transferred skeleton initializes a relay chain that is refined for connectivity, bottleneck capacity, delay, and movement cost. On nine held-out high-clutter 3D urban maps, Arm2Air reduced median end-to-end planning runtime by 64.9 percent relative to the fastest conventional planner. On the high-obstruction group of a separate 30-map dense urban holdout, it increased bottleneck capacity by 32.6 percent, reduced capacity variance by 74.7 percent, reduced maximum hop distance by 13.2 percent, reduced hop-distance variance by 75.2 percent, and reduced relay displacement by 16.9 percent relative to IMPC-MD. With only three target-domain training maps, Arm2Air reduced relay-position root mean square error by 53.6 percent relative to training from scratch while updating 0.134 million parameters, compared with 1.383 million for Scratch and Full Fine-tuning. These results demonstrate computationally and data-efficient UAV relay placement and suggest a broader principle for transferring ordered structural priors across heterogeneous embodied tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Arm2Air 把预训练 Neural MP 机器人臂的避障骨架经跨具身迁移 (cross-embodiment transfer) 转成 UAV 中继链初始化，再按连通性、瓶颈容量、时延与移动代价精修。在 9 张高杂乱 3D 城市图上端到端规划中位耗时较最快传统规划器降 64.9%；30 图稠密城市留出集的高遮挡组上，相对 IMPC-MD 瓶颈容量升 32.6%、最大跳距降 13.2%、中继位移降 16.9%。
Motivation: 通信基础设施受损后 UAV 中继组网需联合考虑视距遮挡、通信范围、高度与三维障碍，城市环境下传统规划器慢且中继位置不稳定，端到端数据训练成本高。
Method: 源域用预训练 Neural MP 生成机器人臂运动，转成有序骨架预训练基于 transformer 的迁移平台；再用有限目标域数据加 LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) 适配到 UAV 域，迁移骨架初始化中继链并针对连通性、瓶颈容量、时延、移动代价精修。
Result: 9 张高杂乱 3D 城市图上端到端规划中位耗时较最快传统规划器降 64.9%；30 图稠密城市留出集高遮挡组相对 IMPC-MD：瓶颈容量升 32.6%、容量方差降 74.7%、最大跳距降 13.2%、跳距方差降 75.2%、中继位移降 16.9%；仅 3 张目标域训练图时中继位置 RMSE 较从零训练降 53.6%，更新参数 0.134M（Scratch 与全微调为 1.383M）。

papers.title: The Implementation Lottery: Auditing Idea Reliability in Automated Research
papers.abstract_en: Automated research agents use program scores to judge ideas. We call variation in this evidence across implementations the implementation lottery. We introduce an Idea Reliability Audit that freezes mechanism specifications, samples independent programs, and compares selected code with fresh implementations of its mechanism. Across 3,048 assignments on 31 tabular classification tasks, all four primary aggregation tests have Holm-adjusted $p\geq0.56$. Under mean-of-five selection, the prespecified secondary intention-to-treat comparison gives selected-code premiums of 0.38 [0.08, 0.82] and 0.45 [0.05, 1.12] accuracy-equivalent points for Bounded and Agentic execution, respectively. Minimum task-deletion means are 0.20 and 0.14. Fidelity conditioning exposes concentration: the Agentic premium falls from 0.33 to 0.01 when one task is removed. Post-outcome analysis finds cross-split variation on 41 of 70 paired cards per process. Exploratory replay gives nearly equal Bounded point losses at four and twenty implementations; Agentic point losses decrease across the four evaluated budget rules. Under duration costs, one seed per program minimizes fitted common-design variance. The two-seed design becomes preferable when implementation-to-seed cost ratios exceed approximately 13 or 9.5 in the continuous-budget model. The audit distinguishes evidence for reusing a selected artifact from evidence for implementing its idea again.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Idea Reliability Audit：冻结机制规格、独立采样多个程序实现，再把被选中的代码与该机制的新鲜实现对比，量化自动研究智能体用程序分数选想法时的“实现彩票”效应。在 31 个表格分类任务的 3,048 次分配上，四项主聚合检验 Holm 校正后 p≥0.56，mean-of-five 选择下 Bounded 与 Agentic 的选中代码溢价仅 0.38 与 0.45 个 accuracy-equivalent 点。
Motivation: 自动研究智能体用程序分数评判想法，但同一机制的不同实现会给出不同分数，这种实现间变异使“选中想法好”与“选中代码好”混为一谈，选题证据不可复现。
Method: Idea Reliability Audit 冻结机制规格，采样独立程序实现，并将被选代码与该机制的全新实现比较；含四项主聚合检验（Holm 校正）、mean-of-five 选择下的 intention-to-treat 次要比较、fidelity conditioning、任务删除敏感性、跨 split 变异分析，以及四种预算规则下的探索性 replay 与成本模型拟合。
Result: 3,048 次分配、31 个表格分类任务上，四项主聚合检验 Holm 校正 p≥0.56；mean-of-five 选择下 ITT 选中代码溢价为 0.38 [0.08, 0.82]（Bounded）与 0.45 [0.05, 1.12]（Agentic）个 accuracy-equivalent 点，最小任务删除均值 0.20 与 0.14；fidelity conditioning 下 Agentic 溢价从 0.33 降到 0.01（删去一个任务）；70 张配对卡片中 41 张存在跨 split 变异；replay 中 Bounded 在 4 与 20 个实现上点损失接近相等，Agentic 点损失随四种预算规则递减；单 seed 每程序最小化拟合的共同设计方差，实现/seed 成本比超过约 13（Bounded）或 9.5（Agentic）时两 seed 设计更优。
Conclusion: 审计把“复用被选工件”的证据与“重新实现其想法”的证据区分开：当前设置下选中代码的溢价很小且对任务删除敏感，想法层面的可靠性证据并不随代码复用证据自动成立。

papers.title: When Synthetic Users Fail: A Cross-Domain Benchmark of LLM-Simulated Human Survey Responses
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as synthetic users, stand-ins for human respondents whose simulated answers feed product, policy, and market decisions. We ask when this substitution is valid and when it fails, and package the answer as an evaluation framework for intelligent synthetic-user systems. A single protocol, run across four models spanning two families and an 8B-to-frontier capability range, is applied to two independent domains of real human-response data: U.S. general social attitudes (General Social Survey) and cross-cultural values (World Values Survey). Every model is benchmarked against a suite of non-LLM baselines fit on held-out human data. Under demographic prompting and the survey-simulation protocols we test, two failures replicate across both domains, all four models, and both families. First, at the individual level no LLM beats even the strongest baseline; on cross-cultural values every model falls well below it, and the gap survives distance-aware and proper scoring. Second, models systematically over-determine demographics, treating identity as far more predictive of attitudes than it is among real people, a distortion present for nearly every question-group combination and robust to a coding-invariant measure. Neither failure is remedied by a larger, more capable model. A decision-impact analysis shows why this matters in practice: on a segment-targeting task the models inflate between-segment gaps two to fourfold, would direct a team to the wrong segment in half of U.S. and most cross-cultural cases, and manufacture segment splits that do not exist in real people. We publicly release the cross-domain benchmark and validation framework, including all code and data, so that teams can determine in advance when synthetic-user evidence is safe for decision support and when it is not.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Preprint; under review. Code and data are publicly available at: https://github.com/ZihanChen1995/when-synthetic-users-fail-a-cross-domain-benchmark-of-llm-simulated-human-survey-responses
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用统一协议在 GSS 与 WVS 两个真实人类调查数据域上，对 4 个跨家族、8B 到前沿规模的 LLM 做 synthetic-user 基准，发现两类失败在所有模型与两个域上复现：个体层面无一超过最强非 LLM 基线，且模型系统性高估人口学属性对态度的预测力。决策影响分析显示段间差距被夸大 2–4 倍，美国案例约一半、跨文化案例大多数会把团队导向错误细分。
Motivation: LLM 正被当作 synthetic user 替代真人回答，喂给产品、政策与市场决策，但这种替代何时有效、何时失效缺少可执行的判定协议。
Method: 单一评测协议覆盖两个模型家族、8B 到前沿共 4 个模型，跑在两个独立真实人类响应数据域（General Social Survey 与 World Values Survey）上；每个模型对照一组在留出人类数据上拟合的非 LLM 基线，并做人口学提示与调查模拟；评测含 distance-aware 与 proper scoring，另加编码无关 (coding-invariant) 度量与决策影响分析。
Result: 个体层面没有任何 LLM 超过最强基线，跨文化价值观域上所有模型都远低于基线，差距在 distance-aware 与 proper scoring 下依然存在；人口学过度决定问题几乎出现在每个问题组组合上。两类失败在两个域、4 个模型、两个家族上复现，且更大更强的模型无法修复。段间定位任务中模型把段间差距夸大 2–4 倍，在美国案例约一半、跨文化案例大多数会选错细分，并制造出真人中不存在的段分裂。
Conclusion: 在人口学提示与所测调查模拟协议下，LLM synthetic user 不能替代真人个体层面响应，且模型规模不解决该问题；作者公开基准与验证框架，供团队事先判定 synthetic-user 证据何时可用于决策支持。

papers.title: Looping Is Not Reliability: State-Bound Evidence and Typed Revision Contracts for Agentic Code Repair
papers.abstract_en: Generate--test--revise loops are common in coding agents, but repetition alone provides no reliability guarantee. We study the gap between finding a correct patch and retaining, verifying, and submitting it. A sealed five-seed study over 30 HumanEval repairs produces 900 three-revision trajectories. Under forced revision, current correctness with current traces falls from 0.820 after one revision to 0.673 after two, although ever-correct rises to 0.847. Two common-state studies use 2,430 branches from identical frozen programs to remove post-treatment risk-set bias. In a prespecified 14B replication, stale traces harm 34/135 correct starts versus 4/135 with current traces, a 22.2-point increase (task-cluster 95\% CI $[8.9,37.0]$, exact Holm $p=0.0337$). A prospective 540-rollout policy eliminates observed correct-start harm but reduces wrong-start repair and fails its joint criterion. Repository experiments over 24 bugs and four coder stacks expose floor effects and component heterogeneity without Holm-significant effects. We therefore separate admission, preservation, grounded certification, competence, and liveness. We derive an evidence-bound typed loop contract and instantiate its mechanically enforceable subset in a reference implementation that binds verifier evidence to exact code states, preserves verified checkpoints, and emits auditable admission receipts. The implementation is an executable specification and conformance artifact, not evidence of improved repair competence or calibrated verifier dependence.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Accepted at AgenticDev 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 HumanEval 修复的 generate–test–revise 循环中，强制修订会让「当前正确且带当前轨迹」的比例从一次修订后的 0.820 跌到两次后的 0.673，而 ever-correct 反升到 0.847，说明循环本身不保证可靠性。作者据此把可靠性拆成 admission、preservation、grounded certification、competence、liveness 五项，并给出把验证证据绑定到具体代码状态的 typed loop contract 参考实现。
Motivation: 编码 agent 的反复修订只保证重复，不保证把已找到的正确补丁保留、验证并提交；强制修订还会因过期轨迹 (stale traces) 损害原本正确的起点，且常见状态比较存在 post-treatment risk-set bias。
Method: 密封五种子研究覆盖 30 个 HumanEval 修复，产生 900 条三次修订轨迹；用 2,430 条来自相同冻结程序的分支做两项 common-state 研究以消除 post-treatment risk-set bias；预注册 14B 复现与 540-rollout 前瞻策略检验；再在 24 个 bug、四套 coder stack 的仓库实验上检验，并推导 evidence-bound typed loop contract，其实现把验证证据绑定到确切代码状态、保留已验证检查点并发出可审计 admission receipt。
Result: 强制修订下 current correctness with current traces 从一次修订后 0.820 降到两次后 0.673，ever-correct 升至 0.847。预注册 14B 复现中 stale traces 在 135 个正确起点里伤害 34 个，current traces 仅 4/135，差 22.2 个百分点（task-cluster 95% CI [8.9, 37.0]，exact Holm p=0.0337）。前瞻 540-rollout 策略消除已观察到的正确起点伤害，却降低错误起点修复率并未通过联合判据。24 bug、四套 coder stack 的仓库实验暴露 floor effect 与组件异质性，但无 Holm 显著效应。
Conclusion: 重复修订不等于可靠性：正确性必须按 admission、preservation、grounded certification、competence、liveness 分开判定，验证证据要绑定到确切代码状态。作者明确该实现是可执行规范与一致性工件，不构成修复能力提升或验证器依赖已校准的证据。

papers.title: How Much Can a LoRA Adapter Memorize? Measuring Adapter Capacity in Bits
papers.abstract_en: LoRA adapters are often shared on their own, and the amount of information they can hold about their training data bounds what sharing them can reveal. Following Morris et al. (2026), we measure this amount in bits by training adapters on frozen language models to memorize random token sequences. LoRA adapters store 2 to 3.4 bits per trainable parameter, less than full fine-tuning of the same model. The number of parameters alone does not set this amount: at equal size, adapters on MLP layers store more than adapters on attention layers, and a randomly initialized frozen model supports as much storage as a pretrained one once the scale of its output logits can be trained. We then train the same adapter on a task with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and with GRPO. At the same accuracy, SFT stores about three times as much information specific to its training examples, and it stores most of the bits of secrets planted in the training data, which GRPO does not store because it rarely samples them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结语言模型上训练 LoRA 适配器记忆随机 token 序列，测得每个可训练参数存 2 到 3.4 比特，低于同模型全量微调；同等参数量下 MLP 层适配器比 attention 层存得多，随机初始化的冻结模型只要输出 logit 尺度可训练，存储量与预训练模型相当。同等准确率下 SFT 存储的训练样本特有信息约为 GRPO 的三倍，并会记住植入训练数据的秘密，而 GRPO 因很少采样到而不存。
Motivation: LoRA 适配器常被单独共享，其对训练数据的信息持有量决定了共享它们会泄露多少；此前缺少以比特为单位度量适配器容量的方法。
Method: 沿用 Morris et al. (2026) 的思路，在冻结语言模型上训练 LoRA 适配器去记忆随机 token 序列，以比特度量容量；再用同一适配器分别做 SFT 与 GRPO 训练，并在训练数据中植入秘密以比较存储。
Result: LoRA 每个可训练参数存 2 至 3.4 比特，少于同模型全量微调；等规模下 MLP 层适配器多于 attention 层；随机初始化的冻结模型在输出 logit 尺度可训练时与预训练模型存储相当。同等准确率下 SFT 存储的训练样本特有信息约为 GRPO 的三倍，且存下大部分植入秘密，GRPO 则因很少采样而不存。

papers.title: DART: A Degradation-Aware Recurrent Transformer for Archival Film Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Archival film restoration is a challenging problem because historical footage contains compound degradations such as scratches, dust, blur, noise, flicker, and photometric aging, while clean reference videos are unavailable. Existing video restoration methods largely treat these degradations implicitly, reconstructing frames without explicit knowledge of where damage occurs or how severe it is. We propose DART, a degradation-aware recurrent transformer for archival film restoration. DART predicts and propagates a soft defect mask through time, using it to guide temporal fusion and condition the restoration network on both damage location and severity. This makes the restoration process explicitly aware of film artifacts rather than relying only on reconstruction losses. Experiments on real archival benchmarks show that DART improves no-reference perceptual quality over prior restoration architectures while remaining compact and efficient, producing cleaner and more temporally consistent restorations of structured film damage.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 14 pages + references, 6 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://www.mikjas.com/dart Code: https://github.com/TytanMikJas/DART-Degradation-Aware-Recurrent-Transformer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DART 为档案影片修复提出退化感知循环 Transformer：先预测软缺陷掩膜 (soft defect mask) 并沿时间传播，用它引导时序融合、按损伤位置与严重度条件化修复网络，使修复显式感知划痕、灰尘、模糊、噪声、闪烁与光度老化。在真实档案基准上，DART 在无参考感知质量上优于既有修复架构，同时保持紧凑高效，输出更干净、时序更一致的结构化损伤修复结果。
Motivation: 历史影像含复合退化且没有干净参考视频，现有视频修复方法隐式处理退化，重建时不知道损伤出现在哪里、有多严重。
Method: DART (Degradation-Aware Recurrent Transformer) 预测软缺陷掩膜并沿时间传播，以掩膜引导时序融合，并将损伤位置与严重度作为条件输入修复网络，而不只依赖重建损失。
Result: 在真实档案基准 (real archival benchmarks) 上，DART 的无参考感知质量 (no-reference perceptual quality) 优于既有修复架构，且模型保持紧凑高效，对结构化胶片损伤产生更干净、时序更一致的修复结果。
Conclusion: 把退化位置与严重度显式建模为可传播的软掩膜，可以在无干净参考的档案修复中同时提升感知质量与时间一致性，并保持参数与计算开销可控。

papers.title: Stop Removing Stopwords: How an Inherited Preprocessing Default Distorts Legal Text-as-Data
papers.abstract_en: Empirical legal scholarship increasingly treats judicial text as data, and much of it still runs on sparse, interpretable pipelines (TF-IDF features and linear classifiers) because the textual feature is often the object of study rather than a means to a prediction. Yet these pipelines inherit preprocessing defaults from mid-century information retrieval that were never validated against classification accuracy. The most entrenched of these is stopword removal. This study introduces an exhaustive single-word ablation that measures a preprocessing step's effect directly against the downstream objective, and applies it to stopword removal. Matching Supreme Court Database labels to Caselaw Access Project opinion texts, the study examines two binary tasks, ideological direction (no-removal baseline F1 about 0.68) and constitutional versus non-constitutional law type (about 0.92), across 7,668 and 7,001 opinions. For each task, the ablation removes each of roughly 18,500 candidate words in turn, and a task-specific stoplist is built from the resulting measurements. Generic stoplists in common use fall below the no-removal baseline on held-out opinions in all twelve tests. The task-specific stoplists move held-out F1 by +0.0023 (95% CI [-0.0124, +0.0170]) on ideology and by +0.0001 ([-0.0082, +0.0085]) on law type. Neither task shows a detectable benefit from removal, and a supplemental analysis finds that word-level statistics predict a word's removal effect poorly, because the words' true removal effects differ by less than the measurement can register. The method generalizes to any inherited preprocessing default, and the result is a caution specific to interpretable legal text-as-data, where a step that reshapes which features a model sees can distort the doctrinal and ideological signal the research is meant to recover. The burden of proof sits with removal.

TL;DR: 对最高法院判决文本的穷举单字消融显示，删除停用词这一继承自中世纪信息检索的默认预处理，在意识形态与法条类型两个二分类任务上都不带来可检测的收益，反而让通用停用词表在全部十二次检验中低于不删除的基线。作者据此主张举证责任在删除一方。
Motivation: 法律文本即数据 (text-as-data) 的稀疏可解释流水线继承了从未针对分类精度验证过的预处理默认值，而文本特征本身就是研究对象，删除停用词可能扭曲本要恢复的法条与意识形态信号。
Method: 将 Supreme Court Database 标签与 Caselaw Access Project 判决文本对齐，做两个二分类任务；对约 18,500 个候选词逐一单独删除做穷举单字消融，直接以留出集 F1 度量每步预处理的效果，并据此构建任务专属停用词表。
Result: 不删除基线 F1 约 0.68（意识形态方向，7,668 份判决）与约 0.92（宪法/非法条类型，7,001 份判决）；通用停用词表在全部十二次留出检验中都低于不删除基线；任务专属停用词表留出 F1 变化 +0.0023（95% CI [-0.0124, +0.0170]）与 +0.0001（[-0.0082, +0.0085]），均无可检测收益；补充分析显示词级统计量对删除效应预测很差，因为真实效应差异小于测量精度。
Conclusion: 在可解释的法律文本研究中，删除停用词没有可检测收益却可能扭曲信号，举证责任应在删除一方；该消融方法可推广到任何继承而来的预处理默认值。

papers.title: Physics-aware Masked Diffusion-based Flood Simulation for Urban Fisheye Disaster Detection
papers.abstract_en: Physical simulations that predict the behavior of urban disasters, such as climate-related flooding, play a crucial role in disaster prevention and the development of anomaly detection models. However, the severe shortage of flood data in real-world environments, combined with the inherent distortions of fisheye lens images, which are used for urban surveillance, has made high-precision simulations challenging. To address this, we propose a new physical simulation system PhysFlood that leverages Diffusion Models to synthesize realistic floods from just a single image captured by a fisheye lens. Our system not only enables simulation from a single image, but also features the ability to freely control and generate diverse flood scenarios by manipulating physically meaningful variables, such as water levels. In our evaluation experiments, we conducted a qualitative human study and demonstrated that the simulation images generated by PhysFlood exhibit both acceptable realism and robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhysFlood 用 Diffusion Model 从单张鱼眼监控图像合成城市洪水场景，并可通过水位等物理变量控制生成多样化洪水情景。定性人工评估显示生成图像在真实感与鲁棒性上均可接受。
Motivation: 真实环境洪水数据严重稀缺，加上鱼眼镜头固有畸变，使高精度城市洪水模拟与异常检测模型训练困难。
Method: 提出 PhysFlood：以 Diffusion Model 为核心，从单张鱼眼图像出发做物理感知的洪水模拟，并通过操纵水位等有物理意义的变量来控制与生成多样化洪水情景。
Result: 定性人工研究 (qualitative human study) 显示 PhysFlood 生成的模拟图像同时具备可接受的真实感与鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 单张鱼眼图像加可控物理变量足以合成可用于灾害检测训练的多样化洪水场景，依据是人工评估的真实感与鲁棒性结论。

papers.title: What Keeps Vision-Language Models Looking at the Image?
papers.abstract_en: When do vision-language models need direct access to the image while generating an answer? We study image dependence during answer generation by examining how the visual information needed for the current question becomes available in context. We intervene on direct image access while retaining previously computed states. Across real-image and synthetic tasks, we show that, depending on the generation process, direct access can continue to support accuracy after question processing. Supplying the required attributes as text in the context weakens this dependence. On synthetic tasks, we also examine how dependence changes as the model itself states the required attributes. Before attribute expression, severing access reduces accuracy, and replacing image-side states shifts answers toward the counterfactual content. After sufficient expression, both interventions have smaller effects. Even with an identical generated prefix, dependence differs according to whether image access was available during question processing. Thus, both the visible text and the preceding image access matter. Several of these patterns hold across model families, including Qwen2.5-VL-32B and InternVL3-14B. These findings offer a view of image dependence in terms of the information needed for the current question and the history of image access, beyond generation position alone. This perspective provides a basis for deciding when to reduce visual access during an answer and which visual information to retain for subsequent questions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究视觉语言模型在生成答案过程中何时真正需要直接读取图像：通过在保留已计算状态的前提下切断图像访问、或用图像侧状态替换为反事实内容来干预。发现属性以文本形式补入上下文会削弱这种依赖；在合成任务中，模型说出所需属性之前切断访问会降准确率、替换状态使答案偏向反事实内容，充分表达之后两种干预影响都变小；即使生成前缀相同，问题处理阶段是否有图像访问也会改变依赖程度，该模式在 Qwen2.5-VL-32B 与 InternVL3-14B 等模型家族上成立。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在生成答案时对图像的依赖何时持续、何时可被文本上下文替代尚不清楚，仅按生成位置判断不足以决定何时减少视觉访问。
Method: 在保留先前已计算状态的前提下干预直接图像访问（切断访问、替换图像侧状态为反事实内容），在真实图像与合成任务上比较；并把所需属性作为文本补入上下文，以及让模型自己陈述所需属性，观察依赖随表达进程的变化。
Result: 直接访问在问题处理之后仍可继续支撑准确率，取决于生成过程；以文本补入所需属性会削弱该依赖；合成任务中属性表达之前切断访问降低准确率、替换图像侧状态使答案偏向反事实内容，充分表达之后两种干预影响都变小；即使生成前缀相同，依赖也因问题处理阶段是否有图像访问而不同；这些模式跨模型家族成立，包括 Qwen2.5-VL-32B 和 InternVL3-14B。
Conclusion: 图像依赖应按当前问题所需信息与图像访问历史来刻画，而非仅按生成位置；这为决定何时减少视觉访问、以及为后续问题保留哪些视觉信息提供依据。

papers.title: TACoS: Weakly Supervised Learning of Two-Dimensional Materials from Scribble Annotations to Precise Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: The precise pixel-level localization of 2D material flakes is crucial for high-throughput screening. However, traditional fully supervised methods rely on dense annotations, which are costly and time-consuming, severely limiting the practical deployment of segmentation models. This paper proposes TACoS, a specialized scribble segmentation framework tailored for 2D materials. First, we design a unified framework that integrates semi-supervised consistency learning with structured tree energy constraints. This framework comprises two core components: an unlabeled weak-strong distribution alignment module and a tree energy regularization module. The former employs cosine consistency constraints to enhance prediction alignment across views. Meanwhile, the latter utilizes minimum spanning trees to establish pixel affinity relationships and generate structure-aware soft pseudo labels for online semantic guidance. Next, we introduce asymmetric regional contrast learning. This approach fuses high-confidence predictions from the weak augmentation branch with scribbles to form augmented labels, and construct category prototypes in the representation space. Simultaneously, we prioritize contrastive constraints on challenging pixels in boundary-unlabeled regions. This strategy enhances intra-class cohesion and inter-class separation at the representation level, effectively reducing category confusion in low-contrast edges and complex backgrounds. Experiments conducted on the constructed graphene and MoS2 datasets demonstrate that our method TACoS achieves over 96% of fully supervised performance using less than 0.6% annotated data. Furthermore, it exhibits superior structural coherence and boundary stability in scenarios with weakly contrasting edges and complex backgrounds, providing an efficient and scalable solution for automated high-throughput screening of 2D material flakes.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 二维材料薄片的像素级定位是高通量筛选的关键，但全监督分割依赖稠密标注，成本高、耗时长，限制了分割模型的实际部署。
Method: 统一框架含两个核心模块：弱-强分布对齐模块用 cosine 一致性约束跨视图对齐预测，树能量正则模块用最小生成树 (minimum spanning tree) 建立像素亲和关系并生成结构感知软伪标签做在线语义引导；另引入非对称区域对比学习，把弱增广分支的高置信预测与 scribble 融合成增广标签，在表示空间构建类别原型，并对边界未标注区域的困难像素施加对比约束。
Result: 在自建 graphene 与 MoS2 数据集上，TACoS 用不到 0.6% 的标注数据达到全监督性能的 96% 以上；在弱对比边缘与复杂背景场景下表现出更优的结构连贯性与边界稳定性。
Conclusion: scribble 级弱监督加结构与对比约束足以逼近全监督的二维材料分割精度，可作为高通量薄片筛选的高效可扩展方案。

papers.title: Measuring Intelligence Beyond Human Scale
papers.abstract_en: How can we measure intelligence beyond human capability? Human-authored benchmarks saturate, and above human capability, examiners may not know which tasks are both hard and verifiable. We argue that this difficulty is inherent to absolute-scale evaluation and propose a new paradigm based on relative measurement in which models generate public challenges that separate other systems. Aggregating these outcomes yields an adversarial psychometric rating system that can scale with the systems being measured. We describe practical protocols that reduce incentives for private-information attacks, support judge-free adjudication, and naturally scale with agent capabilities. We instantiate the framework across verifiable and open-ended, non-verifiable domains, illustrating how model-generated evaluation can continue to measure systems beyond the human frontier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对人类编写的基准在超人能力区间饱和、出题人也难判断任务是否既难又可验证的问题，提出以相对测量替代绝对评分的评测范式：让模型生成能区分其他系统的公开挑战，汇总胜负结果得到可随被测系统能力同步扩展的对抗式心理测量评分 (adversarial psychometric rating)。框架同时给出降低私有信息攻击动机、支持无裁判裁决 (judge-free adjudication) 的协议，并在可验证与不可验证两类领域中实例化。
Motivation: 人类编写的基准在超过人类能力的区间会饱和，且在该区间出题者难以同时保证任务的难度与可验证性，这是绝对尺度评测的固有困难。
Method: 以相对测量取代绝对评分：由模型生成公开挑战来区分其他系统，汇总这些对抗胜负结果构成可随被测系统扩展的心理测量评分体系；配套协议用于降低私有信息攻击的动机并支持无裁判裁决，框架在可验证领域与开放式的不可验证领域分别实例化。
Result: 在可验证与开放式不可验证两类领域中实例化该框架，说明模型生成的评测可在人类前沿之外继续度量系统；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 超人能力区间的智能评测应改为由模型生成挑战的相对测量，评分随被测系统能力自然扩展，从而绕开人类出题的饱和与不可验证问题。

papers.title: UI2App: Benchmarking Visual Interaction Inference in Executable Web Application Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated growing competence in generating web pages from UI screenshots, which convey both visual structure and cues to application behavior. Yet most screenshot-to-code benchmarks emphasize visual fidelity, while interactive generation benchmarks often supply behavioral specifications or demonstrated transitions. Whether models can infer and realize interactions from static screenshots alone remains insufficiently evaluated. We introduce UI2App to evaluate interaction inference: inferring and realizing application behavior from static visual cues without added behavioral guidance. UI2App comprises 600 screenshots organized into 95 state-coherent sets for runnable multi-route web applications. Our end-to-end pipeline evaluates each artifact along three dimensions: executability, visual fidelity, and interaction inference. The interaction metric (IIS) assesses functional correctness and state-management complexity, crediting valid implementations rather than requiring a match to a single reference. Experiments on six frontier vision-language models reveal a marked mismatch between visual fidelity and interaction realization: the visual-fidelity leader scores only 8.1 on IIS, ranking fourth, while the IIS leader achieves 4.5 times that score. High-complexity interactions such as cross-route state persistence remain a major bottleneck, with five of the six models scoring at most 3.5 on this dimension. Overall, these results highlight interaction inference as a key challenge in generating functional web applications from static screenshots.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UI2App 是一个从静态 UI 截图推断并实现交互行为的可执行 Web 应用生成基准，含 600 张截图、95 个状态一致集合，端到端按可执行性、视觉保真、交互推断三维度打分，交互分 (IIS) 同时衡量功能正确性与状态管理复杂度并允许多种合法实现。六个前沿视觉-语言模型实验显示视觉保真与交互实现明显脱节：视觉保真冠军 IIS 仅 8.1、排第四，而 IIS 冠军得分是其 4.5 倍；跨路由状态持久化等高复杂度交互是主要瓶颈，六个模型中五个在该维度得分不超过 3.5。
Motivation: 现有截图转代码基准偏重视觉保真，交互生成基准又直接给出行为规格或状态转移演示，静态截图单独能否推断并实现交互行为缺乏评估。
Method: 构建 600 张截图、按 95 个状态一致集合组织成可运行多路由 Web 应用的基准；端到端流水线对每个产物按可执行性、视觉保真、交互推断三维评测，其中 IIS 指标衡量功能正确性与状态管理复杂度，允许多种有效实现而非匹配唯一参考答案；在六个前沿视觉-语言模型上做实验。
Result: 视觉保真冠军模型 IIS 仅 8.1、总排名第四，IIS 冠军得分是其 4.5 倍；跨路由状态持久化等高复杂度交互上，六个模型中五个得分不超过 3.5。
Conclusion: 静态截图到功能完整 Web 应用的关键瓶颈是交互推断而非视觉还原，视觉保真高不代表能实现正确交互。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AgenticPD: A Stage-Aware Agentic Framework for Closed-Loop Physical Design Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Physical design quality-of-results (QoR) optimization is hard and expensive. Choices made at one stage can help or hurt later stages. Each evaluation requires a costly EDA run through the full flow. While existing methods still treat optimization as flat parameter tuning or a LLM-based script generation task, we present AgenticPD, a stage-aware agentic framework for physical design QoR optimization. Instead of re-running the full flow after every trial, AgenticPD is organized around the stage boundaries of the physical design flow, where a Judge Agent navigates the search and stage-specialized agents make local decisions within their own stage using stage-local tools. Additionally, the agent harness in AgenticPD provides structured observations, execution history, and agent context management. Experimental results show that AgenticPD achieves the best timing performance among the evaluated PD tuners while maintaining competitive power and area.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at ASP-DAC 2027. Updated manuscript
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgenticPD 把芯片物理设计 (physical design) 的 QoR 优化组织成阶段感知的多智能体闭环：Judge Agent 负责跨阶段搜索导航，各阶段专属 agent 用阶段内工具做局部决策，避免每次试错都重跑完整 EDA 流程。在被评估的 PD 调参器中它取得最好的 timing 性能，同时保持有竞争力的 power 与 area。
Motivation: 物理设计 QoR 优化昂贵且阶段间耦合——某阶段的选择会帮助或损害后续阶段，而每次评估都要跑一遍完整 EDA 流程；现有方法仍把优化当作扁平参数调优或 LLM 脚本生成任务，忽略阶段结构。
Method: 围绕物理设计流的阶段边界组织 Judge Agent 与阶段专属 agent：Judge Agent 导航搜索空间，各 agent 借助 stage-local 工具在本阶段内做局部决策；agent harness 提供结构化观测、执行历史与 agent 上下文管理，从而不必每次试错后重跑全流程。
Result: 实验显示 AgenticPD 在被评估的 PD 调参器 (PD tuners) 中取得最佳 timing 性能，同时 power 与 area 保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 把物理设计优化按阶段边界拆成多智能体闭环、而非扁平调参或脚本生成，能在少跑完整流程的前提下拿到更好的 timing 权衡。

papers.title: Mask2Real-WM: Controllable Dexterous World Models via Segmentation Masks as a Sim-to-Real Bridge
papers.abstract_en: Learning action-conditioned world models for dexterous manipulation that are genuinely controllable requires capturing complex, high-dimensional hand kinematics from limited real-world data. We present Mask2Real-WM, a two-stage world model that improves controllability for dexterous hands under a limited real-data budget by decoupling pixel prediction into a dynamics model and a rendering model. The dynamics model predicts future segmentation masks from past masks and a high-dimensional action sequence. The rendering model converts the predicted masks into photorealistic RGB images. This design allows us to train the dynamics model on a large synthetic dataset spanning the full range of hand motions and interactions. We then fine-tune the dynamics model and train the rendering model on only 2.5 h of real demonstrations to obtain a controllable world model. We compare five models with matched training recipes on a 23-DoF robotic system, measuring per-DoF controllability both with random target commands and with sinusoidal per-DoF actuation, judged blind by human raters. The decoupled model achieves the strongest controllability, with further gains from simulation data. Beyond improved controllability, Mask2Real-WM produces sharper frames while maintaining comparable perceptual quality.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Preprint. Project page: https://srl-ethz.github.io/Mask2Real-WM/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mask2Real-WM 把灵巧手动作条件世界模型拆成动力学模型与渲染模型两阶段：动力学模型从历史分割掩码和高维动作序列预测未来掩码，渲染模型再把掩码转成逼真 RGB。这样动力学模型可在覆盖全范围手部运动的大规模合成数据上训练，再只用 2.5 小时真实演示微调；在 23-DoF 机器人系统上以随机目标指令和逐自由度正弦驱动、盲评方式比较五个同配方模型，解耦模型可控性最强且帧更锐利。
Motivation: 灵巧操作的动作条件世界模型需要从有限真实数据中捕捉高维手部运动学，直接在像素空间建模难以在小真实数据预算下做到可控。
Method: 两阶段解耦：动力学模型以历史分割掩码加高维动作序列为输入预测未来掩码，渲染模型把预测掩码转为照片级 RGB；先在覆盖全范围手部运动与交互的大规模合成数据集上训练动力学模型，再用 2.5 小时真实演示微调动力学模型并训练渲染模型。
Result: 在 23-DoF 机器人系统上以匹配训练配方比较五个模型，用随机目标指令与逐自由度正弦驱动测量每自由度可控性并由人类盲评；解耦模型取得最强可控性，加入仿真数据带来进一步增益，同时输出帧更锐利、感知质量相当。
Conclusion: 把像素预测拆成掩码动力学与掩码到 RGB 渲染，是在有限真实数据预算下提升灵巧手世界模型可控性的有效路径，合成数据可叠加增益。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Mastermind: Strategy-grounded Learning for Repository-Scale Vulnerability Reproduction
papers.abstract_en: Repository-level vulnerability reproduction is a demanding software engineering (SE) task: an agent must inspect a codebase, infer the input grammar that reaches a vulnerable path, construct a proof-of-conceptv(PoC), and verify that the crash disappears on the patched build. Recent LLM agents can often execute these steps when the approach is correct, yet they still fail by choosing the wrong strategy. This paper argues that strategy, rather than the full action trajectory, is the right learning unit for such SE agents: it is compact enough to optimize, concrete enough to guide execution, and stable enough to store and reuse across attempts. We present Mastermind, a dual-loop framework that separates transferable strategy learning from task-specific experience. A trainable planner learns reusable vulnerability-reproduction strategies through SFT and milestone-based GRPO, while an experience loop maintains task-local strategy records that guide subsequent attempts. The planner is trained independently of the executor, allowing strategy learning to improve multiple frozen executors without modifying their action-generation capability. We evaluate Mastermind on CyberGym using 260 training tasks and 200 held-out evaluation tasks. With GPT-5.5 as the frozen executor, Mastermind achieves an 84.5% pass rate, outperforming open-book PoC context (60.0%), Best-of-8 sampling (63.0%), and iterative improvement (77.0%). The same planner also improves GPT-5.4 mini and GLM~5.1 from 45.0% and 58.5% to 60.0% and 71.0%. These results demonstrate that learning high-level strategies is an effective and transferable mechanism for improving repository-scale SE agents.

papers.title: Meta-Transfer Learning for mmWave Beam Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) beam alignment is critical for next-generation wireless systems, but existing approaches either update all parameters during adaptation or restrict updates to a subset of layers without adapting intermediate feature representations. We propose MTL-BA, a meta-transfer learning framework for multiple-input single-output (MISO) beam alignment that freezes a pre-trained convolutional backbone and meta-learns lightweight Scale-and-Shift (SS) adapters and a classifier head. Under an outdoor-to-indoor shift in DeepMIMO, MTL-BA achieves the highest Top-1 accuracy among the evaluated methods at 35 dB while updating $17\times$ fewer parameters than full fine-tuning and meta-training $6\times$ faster than MAML.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 mmWave 波束对准 (beam alignment) 的域偏移问题，提出 MTL-BA：冻结预训练卷积骨干，仅用元学习的 Scale-and-Shift (SS) 适配器与分类头做迁移。在 DeepMIMO 户外到室内偏移下，35 dB 时 Top-1 准确率在所评估方法中最高，更新参数比全量微调少 17×，元训练比 MAML 快 6×。
Motivation: 现有波束对准迁移方法要么微调全部参数、要么只更新部分层而不适配中间特征表示，在域偏移下难以兼顾精度与更新开销。
Method: MTL-BA 面向 MISO 波束对准：冻结预训练卷积骨干，元学习轻量 Scale-and-Shift (SS) 适配器与一个分类头；在 DeepMIMO 上做户外到室内域偏移设定，与全量微调和 MAML 对比。
Result: 在 DeepMIMO 户外到室内偏移下，35 dB 时 Top-1 准确率在所评估方法中最高；更新参数量比全量微调少 17×；元训练速度比 MAML 快 6×。
Conclusion: 只元学习 SS 适配器与分类头、冻结骨干，即可在域偏移的波束对准上以远低于全量微调和 MAML 的开销取得最高 Top-1 准确率。

papers.title: Caption Bottleneck Models
papers.abstract_en: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) provide interpretability by routing predictions through a layer of human-understandable concepts. However, defining an optimal concept set for a specific dataset remains an open challenge. Existing approaches rely on expensive expert annotations or LLM-generated lists based solely on class names. Even "open-vocabulary" variants typically depend on static concept sets, which restrict discovery and introduce label bias. Furthermore, traditional CBMs often suffer from information leakage, where unmodeled visual features bypass the bottleneck and compromise the integrity of the explanations. To overcome these limitations, we propose Caption Bottleneck Models (CaBM), a framework that circumvents the need for predefined concept sets by replacing rigid concept layers with free-form natural language. By representing images via LMM-generated captions and training a classifier strictly on this text, CaBM ensures a leakage-free architecture by construction. Additionally, by analyzing the text classifier post-training, CaBM autonomously discovers high-quality, dataset-specific concepts. Our results across fine- and coarse-grained benchmarks demonstrate that CaBM achieves competitive accuracy while preserving interpretability without the constraints of external dictionaries or manual labeling.
papers.journal_ref: Computer Vision - ECCV 2026, LNCS 17036, pp. 445-461, Springer, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CaBM 用 LMM 生成的自由文本 caption 替代 CBM 的固定概念层，分类器只在文本上训练，从结构上杜绝视觉特征绕过瓶颈的信息泄漏；训练后再分析文本分类器可自主发现数据集相关的高质量概念。在细粒度与粗粒度基准上取得有竞争力的准确率，同时保住可解释性，不再依赖外部概念词典或人工标注。
Motivation: CBM 的概念集要么靠昂贵的专家标注，要么靠仅基于类名的 LLM 列表，静态概念集限制发现并引入标签偏差；同时传统 CBM 存在信息泄漏，未建模的视觉特征绕过瓶颈破坏解释完整性。
Method: 提出 Caption Bottleneck Models (CaBM)：用多模态大模型 (LMM) 为图像生成自由形式自然语言 caption，训练分类器时严格只用该文本作为输入，使架构按构造无泄漏；训练完成后对文本分类器做事后分析，自主抽取数据集特定概念。
Result: 在细粒度与粗粒度基准上，CaBM 达到有竞争力的准确率并保持可解释性，且不依赖外部概念词典或人工标注。
Conclusion: 自由形式文本可以取代预定义概念集，既消除概念集选择与标签偏差问题，又通过只在文本上训练从结构上阻断信息泄漏。

papers.title: EgoSafetyBench: A Diagnostic Egocentric Video Benchmark for Evaluating Embodied VLMs as Runtime Safety Guards
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly proposed as runtime safety guards for embodied agents in homes and factories. A deployable guard must catch genuinely unsafe situations while avoiding unnecessary intervention on routine but superficially alarming activity, a distinction obscured by binary safety benchmarks. We introduce EgoSafetyBench, an egocentric video benchmark of 1,200 robot-view scenarios annotated at half-second granularity, with two evaluation tracks. The situational track (800 scenarios) spans routine, safe-but-suspicious, obvious-hazard, and contextual-hazard scenes. The visual-channel track (400 scenarios) tests whether misleading in-scene text corrupts physical-safety judgments, using matched truthful controls. Both tracks use contrastive ladders: near-identical scenarios differing in a single visible deciding cue, forcing predictions to hinge on that cue. Across ten open- and closed-source VLMs, we find that guards often recognize videos containing hazards yet miss the specific hazardous moments, especially for contextual hazards. Misleading in-scene signs further degrade all tested guards: vulnerable models miss up to a third of hazards, while seemingly robust models often over-intervene on safe content. Matched controls show that apparent robustness can reflect indiscriminate alarming rather than true physical reasoning. A 20-clip real-video sanity check further shows that model rankings transfer beyond synthetic rendering, with Spearman \r{ho} = 0.87 for hazard miss rate and 0.94 for visual-channel mismatch recall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EgoSafetyBench 是一个第一视角机器人视频安全基准，1,200 个场景按半秒粒度标注，用对比阶梯（仅差一个决定性视觉线索的近似相同场景）迫使模型的判断真正依赖该线索。在 10 个开源与闭源 VLM 上，模型常能认出含危险的视频却漏掉具体危险时刻，场景内误导性文字进一步拉低全部受测模型，脆弱模型最多漏掉三分之一危险，而看似稳健的模型常在安全内容上过度干预。
Motivation: 二值安全基准掩盖了「真正不安全」与「表面可疑但常规」的区分，而具身智能体（家庭、工厂）的运行时安全守卫必须只在真正危险时介入，误报同样不可接受。
Method: 两条评测轨道：situational track（800 个场景，覆盖 routine、safe-but-suspicious、obvious-hazard、contextual-hazard）与 visual-channel track（400 个场景，用匹配的真实对照检验误导性场景内文字是否破坏物理安全判断）；两条轨道都用 contrastive ladders，近似相同场景只差一个可见决定性线索。评测对象为 10 个开源与闭源 VLM，另有 20 段真实视频的 sanity check。
Result: 在 10 个 VLM 上，守卫常识别出含危险的视频却漏掉具体危险时刻，contextual hazard 尤其严重；误导性场景内文字使全部受测模型退化，脆弱模型最多漏掉三分之一危险，看似稳健的模型常在安全内容上过度干预。匹配对照显示这种表面稳健可能来自无差别报警而非真正的物理推理。20 段真实视频 sanity check 中，模型排名可迁移到非合成渲染：危险漏检率 Spearman ρ = 0.87，视觉通道不匹配召回 ρ = 0.94。
Conclusion: 二值安全分数会把无差别报警误读为鲁棒性；评估具身 VLM 安全守卫必须用只差单一决定性线索的对比场景，并区分漏检与过度干预。
Relevance: 0
