papers.title: Behavior Uncloning: Distilling Mode Redirection into Policy Weights without Inference-Time Steering
papers.abstract_en: Behavior-cloned policies often learn multiple behavior modes from demonstration datasets, including modes that are unsafe or otherwise undesired at deployment. For example, a policy trained on diverse handover demonstrations may learn to pass a knife blade-first. Standard remedies such as data curation and inference-time steering either require access to the original demonstrations for full retraining or add substantial inference-time overhead. To address this gap, we propose MoRE(Mode Redirection), which redirects policy rollouts toward desired behavior modes through a short "uncloning" step. Specifically, MoRE distills the redirection signal from a temporary mode classifier into the policy weights to steer behavior. A retain loss balances this edit by preserving desired-mode competence, allowing the standalone policy to suppress unwanted modes with zero inference-time overhead. Across eight simulated and real-world tasks, MoRE improves the average deployment success rate (SR) by 44 percentage points over the original mixed-mode policy. Among all compared adaptation and steering baselines, MoRE achieves the strongest SR and approaches the filtered-data retraining reference, while preserving task competence and inference speed. MoRE also generalizes across robot policy backbones, including Diffusion Policy and the Pi0.5 VLA, diverse task categories, and real-world deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoRE (Mode Redirection) 把临时模式分类器产生的重定向信号蒸馏进策略权重，用 retain loss 保住目标模式能力，从而在不改数据、不做推理时转向的情况下压制行为克隆策略里的不安全模式。八个仿真与真机任务上，平均部署成功率 (SR) 比原始混合模式策略高 44 个百分点。
Motivation: 行为克隆策略会从演示数据里学到多种行为模式，其中部分在部署时不安全；数据清洗需要原始演示并全量重训，推理时转向 (inference-time steering) 则带来可观的推理开销。
Method: MoRE 先用一个临时模式分类器给出重定向信号，再把该信号蒸馏进策略权重；同时引入 retain loss 约束编辑幅度以保留目标模式能力，得到可独立部署、推理零额外开销的策略。
Result: 在八个仿真与真机任务上，MoRE 使平均部署成功率 (SR) 比原始混合模式策略提高 44 个百分点；在所比较的全部适配与转向基线中 SR 最强，并接近 filtered-data retraining 参考，同时保持任务能力与推理速度。
Conclusion: 把模式重定向蒸馏进权重可以在不重训数据、不加推理时开销的前提下抑制不想要的行为模式，且能跨 Diffusion Policy 与 Pi0.5 VLA 等骨干、跨任务类别迁移到真机部署。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Obliviate: Erasing Concepts from Autoregressive Image Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: The widespread adoption of generative AI models has intensified concerns about misuse, including the creation of unsafe or disturbing imagery. To mitigate such issues, several concept erasure approaches have been proposed to remove harmful content from multimodal generative models. Yet concept erasure for autoregressive image generation remains largely unexplored, despite the growing relevance of these models in recent trends toward unified multimodal architectures. In this work, we fill this gap by introducing Obliviate, a guidance-based concept erasure method for autoregressive image generation. Our method builds on three key design choices: KL-based supervision over visual token distributions, trajectory-level updates over full autoregressive rollouts, and aligned visual prefixes for stable target construction. We evaluate Obliviate on three state-of-the-art autoregressive text-to-image models, Liquid, Emu3-Gen, and Janus-Pro, covering the erasure of explicit content, graphic violence, and branded imagery. Obliviate consistently outperforms current alternatives, reducing nudity on the defensive RAB benchmark from 91.58 to 3.15 while preserving overall model utility. Our code is available at https://github.com/multimodal-ai-lab/Obliviate.

papers.title: EG-VQA: Benchmarking Verifiable Video Question Answering with Grounded Temporal Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have yielded promising performance on Video Question Answering (VideoQA). Nevertheless, existing benchmarks are predominantly evaluated through answer correctness, while the faithfulness of predicted evidence supporting those answers remains insufficiently evaluated. This disconnect between answer generation and evidence verification motivates the construction of the Evidence-Grounded Video Question Answering Benchmark (EG-VQA), a large-scale open-ended benchmark in which each QA pair is annotated with temporally localized textual evidence, requiring models to jointly produce answers and verifiable evidence. EG-VQA comprises 2,067 videos and 11,838 QA pairs with fine-grained evidence annotations. To evaluate predicted evidence, Evidence-Grounded F1 (EG-F1) is introduced as a metric that jointly measures temporal alignment and semantic consistency between predicted and ground-truth evidence. Experiments reveal a substantial discrepancy between answer correctness and evidence faithfulness: even strong proprietary models can achieve high answer accuracy while exhibiting gaps in temporal-semantic grounding. To investigate evidence-aware learning under EG-VQA, we develop EG-Reasoner, an evidence-aware model trained with explicit evidence supervision. EG-Reasoner achieves strong evidence grounding performance among open-source models while maintaining competitive answer generation results compared with proprietary systems. These findings highlight the importance of explicitly modeling evidence grounding and suggest that evidence-aware supervision provides an effective direction toward more reliable and interpretable VideoQA systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EG-VQA 是一个要求模型同时给出答案和可核验证据的开放域 VideoQA 基准：2,067 个视频、11,838 条 QA，每条都带时间定位的文本证据标注，并提出 EG-F1 度量同时衡量时间对齐与语义一致性。实验显示答案正确性与证据忠实性存在明显落差——强闭源模型答案准确率高但时间-语义落地有缺口；带显式证据监督训练的 EG-Reasoner 在开源模型中取得强证据落地表现，同时保持有竞争力的答案生成。
Motivation: 现有 VideoQA 基准基本只按答案正确性评分，答案背后的证据是否忠实几乎不被检验，导致答案生成与证据验证脱节。
Method: 构建 EG-VQA：大规模开放域基准，每个 QA 对配时间定位的文本证据标注，要求模型联合产出答案与可验证证据；提出 Evidence-Grounded F1 (EG-F1) 度量，联合度量预测证据与真值证据的时间对齐和语义一致性；并训练带显式证据监督的证据感知模型 EG-Reasoner。
Result: EG-VQA 含 2,067 个视频、11,838 条 QA 及细粒度证据标注。实验揭示答案正确性与证据忠实性存在显著落差：强闭源模型可取得高答案准确率，同时在时间-语义落地上存在缺口。EG-Reasoner 在开源模型中取得强证据落地性能，答案生成与闭源系统相比保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 显式建模证据落地是必要的，证据感知监督是通向更可靠、可解释 VideoQA 系统的有效方向。

papers.title: TIPS: Topological Ill-Posedness Probing and Steering in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Ill-posed questions, including those involving ambiguity, under-specification, or conflicting statements, may admit no valid answer or multiple plausible answers, posing a significant challenge for large language models (LLMs) despite their otherwise strong performance. Existing work often treats LLM reasoning as a black box and focuses on input-output analysis. Can a compact, unified topological representation of internal model states capture diverse sources of ill-posedness and steer reasoning toward responses appropriate to each source? To this end, we study the internal state from a topological perspective by treating the contextual hidden states of its prompt tokens at a single transformer layer as a point cloud, capturing the input problem's relational structure as encoded by the model. Our analysis shows that zero- and one-dimensional persistent homology---tracking how connected components merge as the distance threshold increases ($H_0$) and the emergence and filling of one-dimensional loops in the filtration ($H_1$), respectively---yield seven compact descriptors of ill-posedness that also serve as control signals for steering model reasoning. Thus, we develop a topology-conditioned steering mechanism. It retrieves topologically similar positive and negative examples for each query to form a local activation-space contrast. The resulting query-specific direction modifies internal states during prefill and decoding, guiding the model's responses toward suitable abstention or clarification tailored to the underlying source of ill-posedness. Empirical evaluations on two datasets and open-weight models spanning four families demonstrate the effectiveness of this compact representation for ill-posedness classification, while topology-conditioning significantly improved steering performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TIPS 把单层 prompt token 上下文隐状态当作点云，用 0 维与 1 维持续同调 (persistent homology) 提取七个 ill-posedness 描述子，并把它们当作控制信号：按拓扑相似度检索正负样本构成局部激活空间对比，得到查询特定方向，在 prefill 与 decoding 阶段改写内部状态，把模型回答引向与成因匹配的弃答或澄清。在两个数据集、四个模型家族的开源模型上，该紧凑表示用于 ill-posedness 分类有效，拓扑条件化显著提升 steering 效果。
Motivation: 含歧义、欠约束或相互冲突的 ill-posed 问题可能无有效答案或有多个合理答案，LLM 即便整体表现强也难以妥善处理；现有工作多把推理当黑箱、只做输入输出分析，缺少能同时刻画多种 ill-posed 成因并据此干预内部状态的紧凑表示。
Method: 取某一 transformer 层上 prompt token 的上下文隐状态作点云，用 H0（连通分量随距离阈值合并）与 H1（一维环的出现与填充）两个持续同调量提取七个描述子；再按拓扑相似度为每个查询检索正例与负例形成局部激活空间对比，产生查询特定的 steering 方向，在 prefill 与 decoding 中修改内部状态。
Result: 在两个数据集、覆盖四个模型家族的开源模型上进行实证评估：七个拓扑描述子构成的紧凑表示对 ill-posedness 分类有效，拓扑条件化 (topology-conditioning) 显著改善了 steering 表现。
Conclusion: 单一拓扑表示既能区分 ill-posedness 的不同来源，又能作为控制信号把推理导向与来源相称的弃答或澄清，说明内部状态的持续同调特征可兼作分类器与干预手柄。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: FoleyGenEx: Unified Video-to-Audio Generation with Multi-Modal Control, Temporal Alignment, and Semantic Precision
papers.abstract_en: We present FoleyGenEx, a unified video-to-audio (VTA) framework integrating multi-modal control, frame-level temporal alignment, and fine-grained semantics, enabling synchronized, versatile audio synthesis for diverse tasks. Existing VTA methods either have multi-modal control but weak temporal alignment or strong alignment but lack reference audio conditioning and semantic precision. FoleyGenEx fills this gap via three core innovations: a conditional injection mechanism for audio-controlled VTA and Foley extension, a multi-modal dynamic masking strategy preserving training synchronization, and an adverb-based data augmentation algorithm leveraging signal processing and large language models to enhance textual supervision with nuanced semantics. Experiments on AudioCaps, VGGSound, and Greatest Hits demonstrate its competitive controllable VTA performance against existing methods. Demo samples are available at https://foleygenex.github.io/FoleyGenEx.
papers.journal_ref: INTERSPEECH 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FoleyGenEx 把视频到音频 (VTA) 生成统一到一个框架里，用条件注入机制支持参考音频控制与 Foley 扩展，用多模态动态掩码保持训练时的帧级时间对齐，并用基于副词的数据增强（信号处理 + LLM）细化文本监督。在 AudioCaps、VGGSound、Greatest Hits 上展示出与现有方法相当的可控 VTA 性能。
Motivation: 现有 VTA 方法要么有多模态控制但时间对齐弱，要么对齐强却缺少参考音频条件与语义精度，三者难以兼得。
Method: 三项核心设计：面向音频控制 VTA 与 Foley extension 的条件注入机制；保持训练同步的多模态动态掩码策略；利用信号处理与大语言模型、以副词为基础的数据增强算法来增强文本监督的细粒度语义。
Result: 在 AudioCaps、VGGSound、Greatest Hits 三个数据集上，展示出相对现有方法具有竞争力的可控 VTA 性能；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 多模态控制、帧级时间对齐与细粒度语义可以在统一的 VTA 框架中同时实现，且在标准音频生成基准上达到有竞争力的水平。

papers.title: Gefen: Optimized Stochastic Optimizer
papers.abstract_en: AdamW is a default optimizer for deep learning, but its moment states add two parameter-sized buffers to training memory, increasing the cost of large-scale pretraining. We propose Gefen, a memory-efficient optimizer that automatically shares second-moment estimates across parameter blocks and quantizes the first moment using a learned codebook. Gefen reduces AdamW's optimizer memory footprint by up to 8x while maintaining performance, saving 6.5 GiB per billion parameters. Prior work shares second moments across parameters grouped along the Hessian's block-diagonal structure, but relies on hand-specified architectural rules and leaves unexplained why such grouping works. We prove that large mixed Hessian entries constrain the ratio of squared gradients toward one, explaining why shared second moments are accurate when the squared gradients they pool are similar. The Hessian need not be computed: its block structure is inherited by squared gradients, allowing blocks to be found directly. Gefen therefore infers block structure from initial squared gradients, requiring no architecture-specific metadata or user-tuned hyperparameters beyond AdamW defaults. Gefen learns an exact histogram-based dynamic-programming quantization codebook and reuses the blocks for first-moment scaling. Across diverse pretraining experiments, Gefen achieves the lowest peak optimizer memory among compared methods that maintain AdamW-level performance. In single-machine and distributed training, the reduced footprint enables larger microbatches and substantially improves throughput over AdamW, making Gefen a drop-in replacement that can train larger models or use larger global batch sizes. We provide the complete Python implementation, including fused CUDA kernels at https://github.com/ndvbd/Gefen
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Gefen 是面向大规模预训练的内存高效优化器：从初始平方梯度自动推断 Hessian 块结构以跨参数块共享二阶矩，并用学习到的直方图动态规划码本量化一阶矩。优化器内存较 AdamW 最多降 8 倍、每十亿参数省 6.5 GiB，同时保持 AdamW 级性能，并在单机与分布式训练中支持更大 microbatch、显著提升吞吐。
Motivation: AdamW 的两个参数规模动量缓冲区抬高了大规模预训练的训练内存成本；已有按 Hessian 块对角结构分组共享二阶矩的做法依赖人工架构规则，且未解释该分组为何有效。
Method: 从初始平方梯度直接推断块结构（Hessian 块结构由平方梯度继承，无需计算 Hessian），跨块共享二阶矩估计；用学习得到的基于直方图的动态规划量化码本压缩一阶矩，并复用这些块做一阶矩缩放；除 AdamW 默认值外无需架构元数据或用户调参。附带一条理论结果：大的混合 Hessian 元素把平方梯度之比约束到接近 1，解释了被合并的平方梯度相似时共享二阶矩为何准确。
Result: 优化器内存较 AdamW 最多减少 8 倍，每十亿参数节省 6.5 GiB；在多种预训练实验中，于保持 AdamW 级性能的对比方法里取得最低峰值优化器内存；单机与分布式训练中更小的内存占用支持更大 microbatch，吞吐相对 AdamW 显著提升。
Conclusion: 共享二阶矩的准确性可由 Hessian 混合项对平方梯度比值的约束来解释，因此块结构可从平方梯度自动学出，使 Gefen 成为无需架构定制的 AdamW 即插即用替代，可训练更大模型或使用更大全局 batch。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 优化器内存较 AdamW 最多减少 8 倍，每十亿参数节省 6.5 GiB；在多种预训练实验中，于保持 AdamW 级性能的对比方法里取得最低峰值优化器内存；单机与分布式训练中更小的内存占用支持更大 microbatch，吞吐相对 AdamW 显著提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 共享二阶矩的准确性可由 Hessian 混合项对平方梯度比值的约束来解释，因此块结构可从平方梯度自动学出，使 Gefen 成为无需架构定制的 AdamW 即插即用替代，可训练更大模型或使用更大全局 batch。

papers.title: Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems with Shared Context
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) can scale large language model agents on long-horizon tasks by running them in parallel, yet existing designs waste much of this parallelism in bubbles: agent time spent waiting on others or redoing a peer's work. These bubbles stem from how agents communicate. Independent agents share nothing and rediscover what their peers have already found; peer-communicating agents wait at synchronous rounds; and under centralized orchestration, the main agent blocks on its sub-agents while progress is relayed. We propose Decentralized Language Models (DeLM), a MAS framework on top of existing agent harnesses that squeezes out these bubbles by replacing the main agent with a shared context and a task queue. Agents asynchronously claim tasks, publish findings as soon as they are available, and build on or correct one another's progress, with every peer's status visible to all. On long-horizon tasks from Terminal-Bench 4.0 and DeepSWE v1.1, and on SWE-bench Verified, DeLM is both more accurate and faster than Codex, Claude Code, their native subagents, and AOrchestra in every setting, improving accuracy by up to 17.5 points over the strongest baseline and running up to 2.49x faster than the harness it builds on. On ProgramBench, where agents rebuild programs from scratch, DeLM makes faster progress than Claude Code and finishes a 120-minute budget up to 19.9 points higher in test pass rate. The code is available on our project website at https://yuzhenmao.github.io/DeLM/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeLM 用共享上下文加任务队列替换多智能体框架里的主智能体，让 agent 异步认领任务、即时发布发现并互相修正，从而消除等待与重复劳动造成的并行气泡。在 Terminal-Bench 4.0、DeepSWE v1.1 与 SWE-bench Verified 上，准确率较最强基线最多高 17.5 点、速度较所依托的 harness 最快达 2.49 倍；ProgramBench 120 分钟预算下测试通过率比 Claude Code 最多高 19.9 点。
Motivation: 长程任务上 LLM 多智能体的并行度被通信方式浪费：独立 agent 重复发现已有结论、对等通信卡在同步轮次、中心化编排让主 agent 阻塞在子 agent 上。
Method: DeLM 是架在既有 agent harness 之上的 MAS 框架，以共享上下文和任务队列取代主智能体；agent 异步认领任务、发现一产生就发布，彼此可继续或纠正对方进度，且所有 peer 状态对全体可见。
Result: 在 Terminal-Bench 4.0、DeepSWE v1.1 与 SWE-bench Verified 的每种设置下，DeLM 相对 Codex、Claude Code、其原生 subagents 及 AOrchestra 都更准更快：准确率较最强基线最多提高 17.5 点，较所依托 harness 最快 2.49 倍。在从零重建程序的 ProgramBench 上，120 分钟预算结束时测试通过率比 Claude Code 最多高 19.9 点。
Conclusion: 把中心化主智能体换成共享上下文加异步任务队列，可以在长程任务上同时提升多智能体系统的准确率与速度；代码已在项目网站开源。

papers.title: Safety is Contextual, LLM-Judges Are Not: Navigating the Rigid Priors of Evaluators
papers.abstract_en: LLMs-as-judges are the primary way to evaluate safety at scale. Despite their importance, LLM-judges themselves are rarely evaluated beyond human agreement in simple, static benchmarks. We therefore investigate two under-explored but crucial properties of LLMs-as-judges: their sensitivity to in-context information, and their steerability to differing safety definitions, which may not align with their internal safety priors. We evaluate the safety judging abilities of 13 generalist LLMs and safety-specific judges, and investigate the impact of novel in-context information and changing safety definitions. We find that while LLM-judges can learn from new information, they are broadly unlikely to update their evaluations if the context or safety definition departs from their prior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文考察 LLM-as-judge 在安全评估中的两个被忽视属性：对上下文信息的敏感性，以及被不同安全定义引导的可引导性 (steerability)。评测 13 个通用 LLM 与安全专用 judge 后发现：judge 能从新信息中学习，但当上下文或安全定义偏离其内部安全先验时，它们普遍不会更新自己的评判。
Motivation: LLM-judge 是规模化安全评估的主要手段，但除简单静态基准上的人类一致率外几乎未被评估；而实际安全定义可能与 judge 的内部先验不一致，先验僵硬会直接损害评估可信度。
Method: 评测 13 个通用 LLM 与安全专用 judge，系统引入新颖的上下文信息并改变安全定义，测量其评判是否随之改变，即考察敏感性与可引导性两个维度。
Result: 在 13 个通用 LLM 与安全专用 judge 上，LLM-judge 能从新信息中学习，但当上下文或安全定义与其内部先验偏离时，普遍不会更新评判结果。
Conclusion: LLM-judge 的评判受其内部安全先验刚性约束：安全定义与先验一致时可被引导，偏离先验时则难以被上下文或定义重新导向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CultureScore: Evaluating Cultural Faithfulness in Video Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: As video generation models like Veo 3.1 and LTX-2 advance, their ability to accurately represent diverse global cultures remains a critical yet understudied frontier. Current metrics, such as VideoScore, only measure visual quality but offer no mechanism for assessing cultural faithfulness. Consequently, a model that replaces a Namaste with a handshake receives the same score as one that generates the gesture correctly. We propose CultureScore, a compositional evaluation framework that decomposes cultural faithfulness into three granular dimensions: Identity (who is represented), Context (culturally localized background), and Behavior (normative gestures and interactions). We operationalize this framework through an evaluation suite spanning 10 countries, yielding 6,174 generated videos across three state-of-the-art models. Our evaluation reveals that no current model achieves culturally faithful video generation: the best-performing model reaches only 56.8% overall CultureScore, with Behavior the most challenging dimension; no model exceeds 52.1% on behavior. Furthermore, the highest-scoring model (LTX-2) on visual quality was ranked last by native annotators, while CultureScore's Behavior dimension shows the strongest positive correlation with human cultural judgment among the automatic metrics we evaluate, underscoring that cultural faithfulness is an essential criterion for equitable video generation. Data and code are publicly available.\footnote{\url{https://huggingface.co/datasets/ankurani/CultureScore}}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CultureScore 把视频生成的文化忠实度拆成 Identity、Context、Behavior 三个维度，在 10 个国家、6,174 个生成视频上评测 Veo 3.1、LTX-2 等三个模型。最好的模型总分只有 56.8%，Behavior 维度无一超过 52.1%；视觉质量最高的 LTX-2 被母语标注者排在最后。
Motivation: 现有视频生成评测指标如 VideoScore 只测视觉质量，无法区分把 Namaste 换成 handshake 的模型与正确生成该手势的模型，文化忠实度缺乏可操作的度量。
Method: 提出组合式评测框架 CultureScore，把文化忠实度分解为 Identity（谁被呈现）、Context（文化本地化背景）、Behavior（规范性手势与互动）三个粒度维度，并构建覆盖 10 个国家的评测套件，对三个最先进模型生成的视频打分，同时与母语标注者的人工判断做相关性比较。
Result: 评测产出 6,174 个生成视频；最佳模型整体 CultureScore 仅 56.8%，Behavior 是最难维度，无模型超过 52.1%；视觉质量最高的 LTX-2 被母语标注者排在末位；在所评测的自动指标中，CultureScore 的 Behavior 维度与人类文化判断的正相关最强。
Conclusion: 当前没有模型实现文化忠实的视频生成，视觉质量排名与人类文化判断可以背离，文化忠实度应作为视频生成公平性的独立评测标准。

papers.title: GOPAgen: Codec-Aware Agentic Long-Video Understanding with Structured Memory
papers.abstract_en: Agentic long-video question answering often relies on sparse RGB sampling and caption retrieval. This reliance can lead to missed brief motion events and repeated processing of irrelevant intervals. We introduce GOPAgen, a framework that integrates codec-native Groups of Pictures (GOPs) and motion vectors into an agentic retrieval pipeline. GOPAgen constructs global textual memory and uses two-stage query-conditioned temporal selection. A global-sufficiency check precedes local evidence extraction. Caption and motion agents represent selected intervals as typed memory pages containing complementary appearance and motion evidence, temporal metadata, and provenance. A GOP-Tree organizes these pages for conditional retrieval when the global evidence is insufficient. GOPAgen achieves 65.3\% accuracy on MotionBench Test and 78.7\% on EgoSchema, exceeding the reported agentic baselines listed for these benchmarks. It also achieves 73.2\% on LongVideoBench validation and 77.3\% on MLVU, while remaining below the strongest listed baseline on LVBench and Video-MME Long. These results support codec-aware structured memory as an effective interface for selective long-video reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GOPAgen 把视频编码原生的 GOP 与运动向量 (motion vectors) 接入 agentic 检索管线，用全局文本记忆加两阶段查询条件时序选择（先全局充分性检查，再局部证据抽取），并以 GOP-Tree 组织带出处的类型化记忆页。在 MotionBench Test 上达到 65.3% 准确率、EgoSchema 78.7%，均超过所列 agentic 基线；LongVideoBench val 73.2%、MLVU 77.3%，但在 LVBench 与 Video-MME Long 上仍低于最强所列基线。
Motivation: 长视频问答依赖稀疏 RGB 采样与字幕检索，容易漏掉短暂运动事件，并对无关区间重复处理。
Method: 管线整合 codec 原生 GOP 与 motion vectors：先构建全局文本记忆并做两阶段查询条件时序选择，全局充分性检查通过后才做局部证据抽取；caption agent 与 motion agent 把选中区间写成含外观/运动互补证据、时序元数据与 provenance 的类型化记忆页，由 GOP-Tree 在全局证据不足时做条件检索。
Result: MotionBench Test 准确率 65.3%，EgoSchema 78.7%，两者均超过基准所列 agentic 基线；LongVideoBench validation 73.2%，MLVU 77.3%；在 LVBench 与 Video-MME Long 上低于所列最强基线。
Conclusion: codec-aware 的结构化记忆是选择性长视频推理的有效接口，但优势在不同基准上不一致，LVBench 与 Video-MME Long 仍未追平最强基线。

papers.title: A Goal-Set Characterization of Task Composition in the Boolean Task Algebra
papers.abstract_en: The Boolean Task Algebra (BTA) provides a principled framework for zero-shot task composition in reinforcement learning by equipping goal-reaching tasks with Boolean operations. We revisit its structural assumptions and formalize a collapse in the space of optimal extended Q-value functions: in deterministic MDPs, every such function is fully determined by the universal and empty tasks. This makes the logarithmic set of base tasks proposed in the original BTA formulation redundant. Building on this observation, we introduce a goal-set-based composition method that performs logical operations on goal sets and reconstructs composed value functions by selecting slices from the universal and empty value functions. This reduces learning costs for standard BTA and reduces composition time for both BTA and Skill Machines, while preserving policy performance. Experiments across tabular, visual, function-approximation, and continuous-control domains show that learning additional base tasks does not yield better performance. Finally, we study the stochastic setting and provide a counterexample showing that this collapse need not hold, that is, optimal composition may require accounting for exponentially many policies in the number of goals. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/EduardoTerres/GoalSetBTA}.
papers.journal_ref: 19th European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在确定性 MDP 中，Boolean Task Algebra (BTA) 的最优扩展 Q 值函数完全由 universal 与 empty 两个任务决定，原 BTA 的对数规模 base task 集因此冗余。作者据此提出基于 goal set 的组合方法：对 goal set 做逻辑运算，再从 universal 和 empty 的价值函数中切片重建组合价值函数，在保持策略性能的同时降低学习成本与组合时间；随机情形下该坍缩不成立，存在需要按目标数指数多策略的反例。
Motivation: BTA 用 Boolean 运算做零样本任务组合，但其结构假设要求一组 base task，学习这些额外 base task 的成本与必要性未经检验；确定性 MDP 中是否存在更小的基集是待解的缺口。
Method: 形式化确定性 MDP 中最优扩展 Q 值函数的坍缩性质，证明其由 universal 与 empty 任务完全决定；据此设计 goal-set 组合方法，对 goal set 施加逻辑运算并从两个基价值函数切片重建组合价值函数，同时分析随机 MDP 情形并给出反例。
Result: 在 tabular、visual、function-approximation、continuous-control 四类域上的实验显示，学习额外 base task 不带来性能提升；该方法降低标准 BTA 的学习成本，并缩短 BTA 与 Skill Machines 的组合时间，同时保持策略性能。随机设置中给出反例表明坍缩不必成立，最优组合可能需要随目标数指数多的策略。
Conclusion: 确定性任务组合只需 universal 与 empty 两个基任务，对数规模 base task 集是冗余的；但该结论不能推广到随机 MDP，那里组合代价可能随目标数指数增长。

summary_sections.result: 在 tabular、visual、function-approximation、continuous-control 四类域上的实验显示，学习额外 base task 不带来性能提升；该方法降低标准 BTA 的学习成本，并缩短 BTA 与 Skill Machines 的组合时间，同时保持策略性能。随机设置中给出反例表明坍缩不必成立，最优组合可能需要随目标数指数多的策略。
summary_sections.conclusion: 确定性任务组合只需 universal 与 empty 两个基任务，对数规模 base task 集是冗余的；但该结论不能推广到随机 MDP，那里组合代价可能随目标数指数增长。

papers.title: EPIC: Efficient and Parallel Inference under CFG Constraints for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Controlling language model outputs is essential for ensuring structural validity, reliability, and downstream usability, and diffusion language models are no exception. Recent advances in diffusion language model decoding have extended output control beyond regular constraints to context-free grammar (CFG) constraints. However, the prior CFG-constrained decoder can be up to four times slower than unconstrained decoding, forcing a trade-off between the correctness benefits of CFG constraints and the decoding efficiency of diffusion models. A key source of this overhead is sequential validity checking, which limits parallel token commitment and adds repeated validation costs. We propose EPIC, a CFG-constrained decoding framework designed to improve this efficiency-correctness trade-off. In order to reduce decoding overhead without sacrificing syntactic correctness, EPIC combines lexing memoization, relaxed compatible subset selection for parallel commit, and validation using Earley-style parsing instead of deterministic automata. This design enables multiple compatible tokens to be committed together while avoiding repeated lexing and expensive validation. Experiments on three benchmarks using four models show that EPIC improves the efficiency-correctness trade-off, bringing runtime close to unconstrained levels while maintaining comparable syntactic and functional correctness. Relative to the prior CFG-constrained decoder, EPIC achieves a best-case inference-time reduction of 67.2%. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/hyundong98/EPIC-Decoding .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EPIC 是面向扩散语言模型的 CFG 约束解码框架，用 lexing 记忆化、放宽的兼容子集并行提交与 Earley 式解析替代确定性自动机校验，把原本最高可达无约束解码四倍的开销压回接近无约束水平。在三个 benchmark、四个模型上，相对先前 CFG 约束解码器最佳情形推理时间下降 67.2%，同时保持相当的句法与功能正确性。
Motivation: 先前的 CFG 约束解码器最高可比无约束解码慢四倍，主要开销来自顺序有效性检查，它限制并行提交并带来重复校验成本，迫使使用者在 CFG 带来的正确性收益与扩散模型解码效率之间取舍。
Method: EPIC 组合三项设计：lexing 记忆化避免重复词法分析；放宽的兼容子集选择 (relaxed compatible subset selection) 允许多个兼容 token 一起并行提交；用 Earley-style parsing 取代确定性自动机做校验。
Result: 在三个 benchmark、四个模型上，EPIC 改善效率-正确性权衡，运行时间接近无约束解码水平，同时保持相当的句法与功能正确性；相对先前 CFG 约束解码器，最佳情形推理时间下降 67.2%。
Conclusion: CFG 约束解码的效率-正确性权衡可以被打破：并行提交配合廉价校验即可在保持句法正确的同时把开销压到接近无约束解码。

papers.title: GEM: Geometric Erasure by Contrastive Velocity Matching in Rectified Flows
papers.abstract_en: While the rapid adoption of multimodal generative models offers immense potential, it has also increased the risks of harmful content synthesis, deepfakes, and copyright infringements. To address these challenges, concept erasure has emerged as a prospective safeguard. However, as the field gradually transitions from U-Net-based diffusion models to Rectified Flow Transformers, erasure research has struggled to keep pace. In this work, we introduce GEM, a simple but highly effective erasure framework for Rectified Flow models. As part of our contribution, we establish a principled bridge between trajectory-based unlearning grounded in Generative Flow Networks and classic teacher-guided erasure: we translate trajectory-based signals into a teacher-guided flow-matching setup that unifies the strengths of both paradigms. Concretely, a teacher provides complementary attraction and repulsion signals that we combine into a single geometric guidance objective, yielding targeted suppression of unwanted concepts while preserving benign generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/multimodal-ai-lab/GEM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GEM 为 Rectified Flow 模型提出概念擦除框架，把 Generative Flow Networks 的轨迹式遗忘信号翻译成 teacher-guided flow-matching 设置，由 teacher 同时给出吸引与排斥信号并合成单一几何引导目标，从而定向压制有害概念同时保住良性生成。
Motivation: 概念擦除研究停留在 U-Net 扩散模型，而领域正转向 Rectified Flow Transformers，擦除方法跟不上模型架构演进。
Method: 在轨迹式 unlearning（Generative Flow Networks）与经典 teacher-guided 擦除之间建立桥接，把轨迹信号转成 teacher-guided flow-matching 设置；teacher 提供互补的吸引与排斥信号，合并为单一几何引导目标 (geometric guidance objective)。
Result: 提出面向 Rectified Flow 的擦除框架 GEM，并给出轨迹式遗忘与 teacher-guided 擦除的统一形式化；代码已公开于 github.com/multimodal-ai-lab/GEM。
Conclusion: 把轨迹式信号翻译进 teacher-guided flow-matching 可同时继承两种范式的优点，在 Rectified Flow 上实现定向概念压制并保留良性生成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EUDAIMONIA: Evaluating Undesirable Dynamics in AI
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as conversational partners for companionship, emotional disclosure, and interpersonal advice, but the social dynamics of these interactions can create harms that are not captured by current evaluations in real-world settings. We introduce the Social AI Design Code, a set of principles for keeping LLMs from encouraging harmful intimacy, dependence, or prolonged engagement, which we developed with input from psychologists and trust-and-safety practitioners. To evaluate these risks in natural and diverse user-LLM interactions, we operationalize the code with EUDAIMONIA, a benchmark of 969 opening-turn queries and 3,147 design-requirement violation checks built from WildChat through weak-to-strong filtration, multi-model relabeling, and controlled rewriting. Evaluating 26 recent LLMs, we find rapid but uneven progress: within 19 months, Grok shifted from the highest to the lowest violation rate, with Grok-4.7 violating only 13.8% of checks. Although Claude-Opus-5.5 and GPT-6-Astra outperform Grok-4.7 on general benchmarks, they violate more checks, showing that greater capability does not guarantee adherence to our design code. Extended thinking does not reduce violation rates, suggesting these failures are social-alignment problems rather than deficits solvable through test-time reasoning alone. Finally, we evaluate models on 229 multi-turn WildChat continuations, violation rates increase, but cross-model trends mirror those in opening turns, showing that our findings generalize to multi-turn interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EUDAIMONIA 是评测 LLM 陪伴与情感倾诉场景中不良社交动态的 benchmark：以 Social AI Design Code 为约束，从 WildChat 构建 969 条开场提问与 3,147 项违规检查，评测 26 个近期 LLM。19 个月内 Grok 从最高违规率降到最低（Grok-4.7 仅 13.8%），但通用能力更强的 Claude-Opus-5.5 与 GPT-6-Astra 违规更多，且 extended thinking 不降低违规率。
Motivation: LLM 被当作陪伴与情感倾诉对象时会产生鼓励有害亲密、依赖与过度黏性的社交动态，现有真实场景评测捕捉不到这类危害。
Method: 先与心理学家和信任安全从业者共同制定 Social AI Design Code 原则，再将其操作化为 benchmark：从 WildChat 经弱到强过滤 (weak-to-strong filtration)、多模型重标注 (multi-model relabeling) 与受控改写 (controlled rewriting) 得到 969 条开场查询和 3,147 项设计要求违规检查，另取 229 条 WildChat 多轮续写。
Result: 评测 26 个近期 LLM：19 个月内 Grok 从最高违规率降至最低，Grok-4.7 仅违反 13.8% 的检查；Claude-Opus-5.5 与 GPT-6-Astra 在通用基准上强于 Grok-4.7 却违反更多检查；extended thinking 不降低违规率；229 条多轮续写上违规率上升，但跨模型排序与开场轮一致。
Conclusion: 通用能力不保证遵守社交设计规范，这类失败是 social-alignment 问题，单靠测试时推理无法解决，且开场轮结论可推广到多轮交互。

papers.title: OnceSelect: Reusable Data Selection for Efficient Multimodal Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal instruction tuning is widely used to adapt multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet the large-scale image-text datasets it relies on are often highly redundant. Existing data selection methods are commonly tied to specific datasets, target models, or training states, requiring retraining or recomputation when transferred to new settings. We ask whether a selection signal can instead be learned once and reused across datasets and models. We propose OnceSelect, a reusable data selector trained once and directly applied to unseen datasets. OnceSelect encodes image-instruction pairs in a frozen joint multimodal space, clusters them into pseudo-labels capturing coarse semantic structure, and trains a lightweight selector using a fixed validation macro-accuracy criterion. Low-confidence samples under the learned partition are treated as informative candidates. As the selector is independent of the downstream MLLM, it can be transferred across datasets without retraining or model-dependent scoring, while selected subsets can be reused across model architectures. Using only 15% of LLaVA-625K, OnceSelect retains 99.2% of full-data aggregate performance across nine evaluation metrics. Without retraining, it achieves 103.4% and 102.5% relative performance on unseen Vision-Flan-186K and LRV-Sub-180K. The same 93.7K LLaVA subset further achieves 99.9-106.7% relative performance across Qwen3-VL and InternVL3 models without model-specific scoring or reselection. These results demonstrate efficient and reusable multimodal data selection across datasets and model architectures. Code is available at https://github.com/DMK041218/OnceSelect
papers.comment: Mingkang Dong and Muxin Pu contributed equally to this work. Yuqian Fu is the corresponding author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OnceSelect 把数据选择信号学一次就跨数据集、跨模型复用：在冻结的联合多模态空间编码图像-指令对，聚成伪标签，用固定验证 macro-accuracy 训练轻量选择器，低置信样本视为信息量高的候选。只用 LLaVA-625K 的 15% 即保留全量数据九项指标汇总性能的 99.2%，且不重训即可迁移到未见数据集与 Qwen3-VL、InternVL3 架构。
Motivation: 多模态指令调优依赖的大规模图文数据高度冗余，而已有数据选择方法绑定特定数据集、目标模型或训练状态，换设置就要重训或重算。
Method: 在冻结的联合多模态空间编码图像-指令对，聚类得到刻画粗粒度语义结构的伪标签，再以固定的验证 macro-accuracy 准则训练轻量选择器；选择器独立于下游 MLLM，所选子集可跨架构复用。
Result: 仅用 LLaVA-625K 的 15%（93.7K 子集）保留全量数据九项指标汇总性能的 99.2%；不重训在未见的 Vision-Flan-186K 与 LRV-Sub-180K 上分别达到 103.4% 与 102.5% 相对性能；同一 93.7K 子集在 Qwen3-VL 与 InternVL3 上取得 99.9–106.7% 相对性能，无需模型特定打分或重选。
Conclusion: 选择信号可以学一次后跨数据集与模型架构复用，15% 的子集即可基本保住全量指令调优性能。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: vSV-ViT: Variable-size SuperVertex Vision Transformer for Cortical Surface Learning in Alzheimer's Disease
papers.abstract_en: Learning from 3D meshes is challenging because the data reside on non-Euclidean surfaces embedded in 3D space. This is particularly evident in domains such as brain cortical surface analysis, where existing models typically rely on ROI-agnostic, face-based, or fixed-size patches. Such patches can duplicate boundary vertices, conflate anatomically distinct regions, or incorporate non-cortical vertices such as those of the medial wall. We develop variable-size supervertex (vSV) partitioning, which groups cortical surface vertices into vSV patches similar to superpixels in images. Building on these vSVs, we design Variable-size SuperVertex Vision Transformer (vSV-ViT), a Vision Transformer that processes vSVs through padding, mask-aware patch embedding, and vertex position embedding. We demonstrate the benefits of the proposed framework through a quantitative analysis of vertex assignment in surface partitioning and downstream tasks using Alzheimer's disease brain image datasets. For downstream tasks, we use meshes of cortical thickness and cortical curvature as input to various encoder models and evaluate classification performance. The superior predictive accuracy of vSV-ViT over recent surface-based models supports its effectiveness for cortical surface learning, with AD-related and sex prediction serving as downstream validation. Extending the framework to other cortical surface applications and broader 3D mesh domains remains future work. Code is available at https://github.com/labhai/vSV-ViT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可变尺寸超顶点划分 (variable-size supervertex partitioning) 与 vSV-ViT：把皮层表面顶点按类似 superpixel 的方式分组，再用 padding、mask-aware patch embedding 和顶点位置嵌入的 ViT 处理，避免固定 patch 重复边界顶点、混淆解剖区域或混入内侧壁等非皮层顶点。在阿尔茨海默病脑影像数据集上，以皮层厚度与曲率网格为输入，vSV-ViT 的 AD 相关与性别预测分类精度优于近期基于表面的模型。
Motivation: 3D 网格数据位于嵌入 3D 空间的非欧几里得曲面上，现有皮层表面模型依赖 ROI 无关、基于面或固定尺寸的 patch，会重复边界顶点、混淆解剖上不同的区域，或纳入内侧壁等非皮层顶点。
Method: 先做 vSV 划分，把皮层顶点分组为尺寸可变的 vSV patch（类比图像 superpixel）；再构建 vSV-ViT，通过 padding、mask-aware patch embedding 与 vertex position embedding 处理 vSV。下游任务以皮层厚度与皮层曲率网格作为输入，喂给多种 encoder 模型做分类，并对划分中的顶点分配做定量分析。
Result: 在阿尔茨海默病脑影像数据集的下游分类上，vSV-ViT 的预测精度优于近期基于表面的模型 (recent surface-based models)，以 AD 相关预测和性别预测作为下游验证；同时给出表面划分中顶点分配的定量分析。
Conclusion: 可变尺寸超顶点划分加 mask-aware ViT 对皮层表面学习有效，AD 与性别预测可作为该框架的下游验证；把框架推广到其他皮层表面应用与更广的 3D mesh 域是后续工作。

summary_sections.result: 在阿尔茨海默病脑影像数据集的下游分类上，vSV-ViT 的预测精度优于近期基于表面的模型 (recent surface-based models)，以 AD 相关预测和性别预测作为下游验证；同时给出表面划分中顶点分配的定量分析。
summary_sections.conclusion: 可变尺寸超顶点划分加 mask-aware ViT 对皮层表面学习有效，AD 与性别预测可作为该框架的下游验证；把框架推广到其他皮层表面应用与更广的 3D mesh 域是后续工作。

papers.title: Function-Vector Heads Are Two Populations: Writers and Cancellers in In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning lets a language model perform a task specified by examples in its prompt. Function vectors capture task information in a compact activation assembled from attention-head outputs. Across two rule families and three Pythia models, we find two opposed functional populations among candidate function-vector heads. Writers support the rule-correct answer, while cancellers systematically suppress it. These roles predict opposing group effects on held-out prompts, where removing cancellers improves accuracy by 2.4 to 6.8 percentage points in all six settings. The dominant suppressive contributions depend on task content, and the same components can support correct predictions in another task. At the population level, substantial support and suppression can nearly cancel. Separating these roles explains how task-related computation can work against correct predictions and how a small aggregate effect can conceal strong opposing contributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 function vector 的候选注意力头中存在两个功能相反的群体：writer 支持规则正确答案，canceller 系统性压制它。移除 canceller 在全部六种设置中把准确率提高 2.4 到 6.8 个百分点，且同一组件在另一任务中可转为支持正确预测。
Motivation: function vector 由多个注意力头输出聚合而成，但候选头内部可能方向相反，聚合后的净效应很小会掩盖强对抗贡献，导致对 in-context learning 中任务计算如何运作的解释失真。
Method: 在两个规则族 (rule families) 和三个 Pythia 模型上划分候选 function-vector 头为 writer 与 canceller 两个群体，并在 held-out prompts 上做移除消融以检验两组的相反效应。
Result: 移除 canceller 在全部六种设置中使准确率提升 2.4 至 6.8 个百分点；主导的压制贡献依赖任务内容，同一组件在另一任务中可支持正确预测；群体层面的强支持与强压制可近乎完全抵消。
Conclusion: 任务相关计算可能同时对抗正确预测，小的聚合效应是强相反贡献相消的结果，因此 function-vector 头应按 writer/canceller 角色而非统一贡献来理解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PAC Learning with Bandit Feedback: Sharp Sample Complexity in the Realizable Setting
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of multiclass PAC learning with bandit feedback in the realizable setting. In this framework, there is an unknown data distribution over an instance space $\mathcal{X}$ and a label space $\mathcal{Y}$, as in classical multiclass PAC learning, but the learner does not observe the labels of the i.i.d. training examples. Instead, in each round, it receives an unlabeled instance, predicts its label, and receives bandit feedback indicating only whether the prediction is correct. Despite this restriction, the goal remains the same as in classical PAC learning. We provide a general characterization of the optimal sample complexity of this problem, sharp for every non-trivial concept class, up to logarithmic factors. Our characterization is based on a new combinatorial dimension, termed the bandit $\mathrm{DS}$ dimension, defined via generalized combinatorial structures we call pseudo-boxes. These extend the pseudo-cubes underlying the $\mathrm{DS}$ dimension by allowing a different number of neighbors in each coordinate. In contrast to the $\mathrm{DS}$ dimension, which governs the full-information setting by counting the number of coordinates in the pseudo-cube, the bandit $\mathrm{DS}$ dimension aggregates the number of neighbors across coordinates, leading to a characterization in which the sample complexity scales with the total number of neighbors. We also propose a general learning algorithm achieving the upper bound, based on an algorithmic principle called ListCascade, which connects bandit learning to list learning and may be of independent interest.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Minor issues have been fixed based on the NeurIPS rebuttal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在可实现 (realizable) 多分类 PAC 学习的 bandit feedback 设定下（只知道自己预测对不对），给出最优样本复杂度的一般刻画，对每个非平凡概念类在对数因子内紧。刻画基于新组合维度 bandit DS dimension，由允许各坐标邻居数不同的 pseudo-boxes 定义，样本复杂度随跨坐标邻居总数而非坐标数缩放；上界由 ListCascade 算法达成。
Motivation: 经典多分类 PAC 学习假设标签可见，而 bandit feedback 下学习者每轮只得到预测是否正确的信号；此前缺少该设定下对任意概念类都紧的最优样本复杂度刻画。
Method: 提出新组合维度 bandit DS dimension，用 pseudo-boxes（把 DS dimension 的 pseudo-cubes 推广为各坐标邻居数可不同）定义，按跨坐标邻居总数聚合；并给出达成上界的一般算法 ListCascade，把 bandit learning 归约到 list learning。
Result: 给出多分类 realizable bandit PAC 学习最优样本复杂度的一般刻画，对每个非平凡概念类在对数因子内紧；样本复杂度随 pseudo-boxes 的邻居总数缩放，而 DS dimension 按坐标数计数。
Conclusion: bandit feedback 下决定样本复杂度的是 bandit DS dimension 这一按邻居总数聚合的维度，而非全信息下的 DS dimension；ListCascade 是连接 bandit learning 与 list learning 的通用原理。

papers.title: A Controlled Synthetic Benchmark for Educational Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Educational aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) can support course improvement, but public aspect-labeled student feedback remains scarce because educational reviews are private, institution-specific, and expensive to annotate. This study introduces a controlled synthetic benchmark for educational ABSA built from 10,000 synthetic course reviews with explicit train-validation-test splits and a 20-aspect pedagogical schema spanning instructional quality, assessment and course management, learning demand, learning environment, and engagement. The corpus is generated with sampled target labels, sampled nuance attributes, and a realism-tuned prompt refined through a three-cycle judge-editor procedure. On the resulting benchmark, local baselines with TF-IDF, two-step transformers, and joint encoders show that the task is nontrivial; the strongest untuned model, BERT, reaches a held-out detection micro-F1 of 0.2760, while a modest lower-rate BERT schedule improves this to 0.2930. Full-test GPT-based inference with gpt-5.2 reaches 0.2519 micro-F1 in zero-shot mode and 0.2501 with retrieval-based few-shot prompting, placing batch inference above the classical baseline and close to the compact joint encoders. A conservative external evaluation on 2,829 mapped student-feedback reviews from Herath et al. yields a micro-F1 of 0.4593 for BERT on a 9-aspect overlap, indicating partial synthetic-to-real transfer. Realism and faithfulness analyses are reported as generator diagnostics that clarify how the benchmark was stabilized and where label noise remains. The study therefore contributes a synthetic educational ABSA corpus, a documented generation procedure, and a reproducible benchmark setting for a domain in which public labeled data remain difficult to obtain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对教育领域方面级情感分析 (ABSA) 缺少公开标注数据的问题，构建了 10,000 条合成课程评论、20 个教学方面 schema 的受控基准，用采样目标标签、nuance 属性与三轮 judge-editor 流程调优的 prompt 生成。BERT 在留出集上 micro-F1 为 0.2760，低学习率调度提升到 0.2930；gpt-5.2 零样本 0.2519、检索式少样本 0.2501。
Motivation: 教育评论私有、机构特定且标注昂贵，公开方面级标注稀缺，导致该领域缺少可复现的评测基准。
Method: 生成 10,000 条合成课程评论，带显式 train-validation-test 划分与 20 方面教学 schema（涵盖教学质量、考核与课程管理、学习负荷、学习环境、参与度）；用采样目标标签、采样 nuance 属性和经三轮 judge-editor 程序调优的 realism-tuned prompt 控制生成。基线包括 TF-IDF、两步 transformer 与 joint encoder，另做 gpt-5.2 全测试集零样本与检索式少样本推理。
Result: 最强未调优模型 BERT 留出集检测 micro-F1 0.2760，较低学习率的 BERT 调度提升至 0.2930；gpt-5.2 全测试集推理 micro-F1 零样本 0.2519、检索式少样本 0.2501，高于经典基线并接近紧凑 joint encoder。在 Herath et al. 的 2,829 条映射学生反馈上做保守外部评测，BERT 在 9 方面重叠子集上 micro-F1 0.4593，显示部分合成到真实的迁移。
Conclusion: 合成生成加受控 schema 可以在无公开标注的领域交付可复现的 ABSA 基准，且合成训练的模型能部分迁移到真实学生反馈；realism 与 faithfulness 分析指出基准稳定化方式与残余标签噪声位置。

papers.title: Sample-wise Targeted Adversarial Attacks on Test-time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) mitigates distribution shifts by adapting models to unlabeled test inputs, but also exposes them to adversarial manipulation. Existing class-wise targeted attacks remain suboptimal for stealthy exploitation in this setting: since TTA operates on batches, forcing a subset of samples toward a target label unintentionally pulls similar benign samples along, resulting in a conspicuously high frequency of the target label that is easy to detect. To capture a more realistic threat, we introduce a sample-wise targeted attack. Unlike prior approaches, the attacker aims to misclassify only inputs carrying an attacker-chosen trigger, while preserving a benign-like prediction distribution to evade detection. To achieve this, we propose a meta-learning-based attack with a novel priority-aware gradient alignment strategy that explicitly prioritizes attack success. The strategy formulates the gradient update as an ellipsoidal trust-region problem, mitigating gradient conflict between the attack and stealth objectives, while providing theoretical guarantees for effective optimization of the attack objective in the presence of gradient misalignment. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10-C, CIFAR-100-C, and ImageNet-C across TTA protocols demonstrate that our method achieves high targeted success rates while maintaining prediction behavior close to benign adaptation under multiple label-free stealth metrics, making it difficult to detect in unlabeled TTA deployment scenarios. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our attack shows strong robustness against existing defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对测试时自适应 (TTA) 的批量更新特性，提出样本级定向对抗攻击：只让携带攻击者选定触发器的输入被误分到目标标签，同时让整体预测分布保持接近良性自适应以规避检测。核心是基于元学习的 priority-aware 梯度对齐，把梯度更新写成椭圆信赖域问题以缓解攻击目标与隐蔽目标之间的梯度冲突，并给出梯度失配下优化攻击目标的理论保证。
Motivation: TTA 在无标签测试批次上自适应，天然暴露于对抗操纵；现有 class-wise 定向攻击在批量更新下会把相似良性样本一起拉向目标标签，导致目标标签频率异常偏高、易被检测。
Method: 提出样本级定向攻击，攻击者只针对携带所选触发器的输入；用基于元学习的攻击框架配合 priority-aware 梯度对齐策略，将梯度更新表述为椭圆信赖域 (ellipsoidal trust-region) 问题，显式优先攻击成功并缓解攻击与隐蔽两目标的梯度冲突，附带优化攻击目标的理论保证。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10-C、CIFAR-100-C、ImageNet-C 上跨多种 TTA 协议实验：方法取得高定向成功率，同时在多个无标签隐蔽指标下预测行为接近良性自适应；对已有防御表现出强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 在无标签 TTA 部署中，把定向攻击约束到样本级并优先攻击成功、同时保持良性样式的预测分布，可以兼顾成功率与隐蔽性，且不易被现有防御检出。

papers.title: The TIME Machine: On The Power of Motion for Efficient Perception
papers.abstract_en: Video representation learning has seen tremendous progress in recent years. This has been driven by many factors, including the scale of training and the success of self-supervised models trained on next-frame prediction. While these factors have pushed the boundaries of what video models can do, they also introduce their own set of limitations. First, scaling video models can reach prohibitive costs, with recent models needing hundreds of years of video to be trained. Second, learning to predict the next frame (or embedding of the frame) naturally focuses on spatial information and as a result, video models still struggle with temporal understanding. In this paper we propose a novel approach that uses motion as a modality to alleviate both of these core issues. Given the motion in a video in the form of point tracks, we mask some of the tracks and use a masked autoencoder to reconstruct the missing tracks. This allows us to learn a representation in a self-supervised manner which we call TIME (Temporally-Informed Motion Embedding), and is focused on capturing temporal information. Also, as motion is inherently appearance-invariant, TIME needs far fewer examples to generalize well. As a result, without bells and whistles, on temporal tasks TIME performs on par with state-of-the-art models, using up to 4 orders of magnitude less training data. For general tasks, TIME can be used in combination with existing representations, and we observe that it leads to a significant improvement for V-JEPA 2, RVM and VideoMAE on standard benchmarks such as SSV2, EgoExo4D and Diving48. These results point to a new promising video paradigm for both more temporally-aware as well as more scalable models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TIME (Temporally-Informed Motion Embedding) 把视频的点轨迹 (point tracks) 当作模态，随机掩码部分轨迹后用 masked autoencoder 重建，自监督学到以时间信息为主的表征。由于运动本身外观不变，TIME 用少得多的数据即可泛化：在时间性任务上以最多低 4 个数量级的训练数据达到与最先进模型相当的水平；与现有表征结合还能显著提升 V-JEPA 2、RVM、VideoMAE 在 SSV2、EgoExo4D、Diving48 上的表现。
Motivation: 视频模型规模化成本已达需要数百年视频训练的程度，而 next-frame prediction 天然偏向空间信息，导致模型时间理解仍然薄弱，两个问题同时卡住可扩展性与时序能力。
Method: 以点轨迹形式提取视频运动，掩码部分轨迹并用 masked autoencoder 重建缺失轨迹，得到自监督表征 TIME，训练目标聚焦时间信息而非外观；用于一般任务时与已有表征组合使用。
Result: 在时间性任务上 TIME 与最先进模型表现相当，训练数据最多少 4 个数量级 (up to 4 orders of magnitude less training data)；与现有表征结合后，V-JEPA 2、RVM、VideoMAE 在 SSV2、EgoExo4D、Diving48 等标准基准上均观察到显著提升。
Conclusion: 把运动而非外观作为自监督学习的模态，可以同时缓解视频模型的数据饥渴与时序理解不足，指向一个既更懂时间又更易扩展的视频表征范式。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: TIME (Temporally-Informed Motion Embedding) 把视频的点轨迹 (point tracks) 当作模态，随机掩码部分轨迹后用 masked autoencoder 重建，自监督学到以时间信息为主的表征。由于运动本身外观不变，TIME 用少得多的数据即可泛化：在时间性任务上以最多低 4 个数量级的训练数据达到与最先进模型相当的水平；与现有表征结合还能显著提升 V-JEPA 2、RVM、VideoMAE 在 SSV2、EgoExo4D、Diving48 上的表现。
summary_sections.motivation: 视频模型规模化成本已达需要数百年视频训练的程度，而 next-frame prediction 天然偏向空间信息，导致模型时间理解仍然薄弱，两个问题同时卡住可扩展性与时序能力。
summary_sections.method: 以点轨迹形式提取视频运动，掩码部分轨迹并用 masked autoencoder 重建缺失轨迹，得到自监督表征 TIME，训练目标聚焦时间信息而非外观；用于一般任务时与已有表征组合使用。

summary_sections.conclusion: 把运动而非外观作为自监督学习的模态，可以同时缓解视频模型的数据饥渴与时序理解不足，指向一个既更懂时间又更易扩展的视频表征范式。

papers.title: Less Back-and-Forth: A Comparative Study of Structured Prompting
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used for open-ended tasks, but underspecified prompts can lead to low-quality answers and additional interaction. This paper studies whether structured prompt design improves response quality while reducing user effort. We compare three prompt conditions: a raw prompt, a checklist-improved prompt, and a clarifying-question prompt. We evaluate these conditions across four task types--summarization, planning, explanation, and coding--using three LLM systems: ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok. Each output is scored with a unified rubric covering task completion, correctness, compliance, and clarity. Checklist-improved prompts achieved the highest mean rubric score, 7.50 out of 8, compared with 5.67 for raw prompts and 6.67 for clarifying-question prompts. Checklist prompts also produced the best quality-effort tradeoff, using fewer average tokens than both raw and clarifying prompts. These results suggest that a simple prompt checklist can improve LLM responses while reducing unnecessary interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对比三种结构化提示方式（原始提示、清单改进提示、澄清式提问提示）在四类开放任务上的表现：清单提示在统一评分下均分 7.50/8，高于澄清式提问 6.67 与原始提示 5.67，且平均 token 消耗低于另外两种，取得最佳质量-投入权衡。
Motivation: 提示不充分会导致 LLM 回答质量低并引发多轮来回交互，需要弄清结构化提示能否同时提升质量并减少用户投入。
Method: 在 summarization、planning、explanation、coding 四类任务上比较 raw、checklist-improved、clarifying-question 三种提示条件，覆盖 ChatGPT、Claude、Grok 三个 LLM 系统，用统一 rubric 从任务完成、正确性、合规性、清晰度四维打分。
Result: 清单提示平均 rubric 分 7.50/8，澄清式提问 6.67，原始提示 5.67；清单提示的平均 token 用量低于原始与澄清式两种提示，质量-投入权衡最佳。
Conclusion: 简单的提示清单即可在提升 LLM 回答质量的同时减少不必要的交互往返。

papers.title: Agentic Trading: When LLM Agents Meet Financial Markets
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) combined with autonomous agent architectures are shifting quantitative finance from isolated predictive modeling toward closed-loop trading agents. These systems perceive multimodal market signals, maintain context and memory, reason about decisions, emit executable trading actions, and adapt to non-stationary market regimes. This survey provides a systematic synthesis of agentic trading through an Architecture--Capability--Adaptation (A-C-A) conceptual framework. Architecture covers perception (textual, numerical, and multimodal), memory (working memory, vector storage, and knowledge bases), reasoning (reactive, reflective, and planning-driven), and execution (order routing and friction management). Capability examines alpha discovery, portfolio optimization, and multi-tier risk control. Adaptation covers in-context learning, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, multi-agent coordination, and architectural self-evolution. Drawing on 185 systematically selected studies, including a core empirical subset of 80 systems evaluated under closed-loop market conditions, we analyze design spaces, operational trade-offs, and emerging paradigms. We also examine evaluation practices, including backtesting split schemes, transaction-cost realism, survivorship-bias handling, and execution fidelity, and distill methodological best practices for future research. By bridging artificial intelligence, market microstructure, and quantitative finance, this survey provides a roadmap for designing, benchmarking, and deploying reliable agentic trading systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 LLM 智能体交易 (agentic trading) 综述，用 Architecture–Capability–Adaptation (A-C-A) 框架系统梳理感知、记忆、推理、执行与 alpha 发现、组合优化、风险控制、适应机制的设计空间。基于 185 篇系统选取的研究、其中 80 个在闭环市场条件下评估的核心实证子集，总结回测划分、交易成本真实性、幸存者偏差与执行保真度的评估实践与方法学最佳做法。
Motivation: 量化金融正从孤立的预测建模转向闭环交易智能体，但感知、记忆、推理、执行与适应各组件的设计空间、权衡和评估口径缺乏统一梳理。
Method: 提出 A-C-A 概念框架：Architecture 覆盖文本/数值/多模态感知、工作记忆与向量存储、反应式/反思式/规划式推理、订单路由与摩擦管理；Capability 覆盖 alpha 发现、组合优化、多层风险控制；Adaptation 覆盖 in-context learning、监督微调、强化学习、多智能体协调与架构自演化。在此框架下综合 185 篇研究并单独考察 80 个闭环评估系统。
Result: 综述纳入 185 篇系统选取的研究，其中核心实证子集为 80 个在闭环市场条件下评估的系统；分析覆盖回测划分方案、交易成本真实性、幸存者偏差处理与执行保真度等评估实践，并提炼方法学最佳做法。
Conclusion: 可靠 agentic trading 系统的设计、基准测试与部署需要把架构、能力与适应三者连同评估口径一起规范，而非只看预测精度。

papers.title: PopPy: Opportunistically Exploiting Parallelism in Python Agentic Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Agentic workflows, which compose calls to ML models using a general-purpose programming language like Python, are widely used for a variety of user-facing tasks, from software engineering to enterprise automation, making their end-to-end latency a critical bottleneck. To improve their latency, developers can either manually parallelize them or use restricted agentic frameworks that cannot express or exploit all forms of parallelization. We address this by developing PopPy, a system that parallelizes external calls, e.g., AI models, in agentic workflows written in a very expressive subset of Python. PopPy combines an ahead-of-time compiler with a runtime, addressing three key challenges in extracting parallelism from Python applications: language complexity, dynamic dispatch, and variable mutation. On a set of real-world agentic workflows, PopPy achieves up to $6.7\times$ speedups in end-to-end execution time, compared to standard Python execution and several agentic frameworks, while preserving the sequential program semantics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PopPy 用提前编译 (ahead-of-time compiler) 加运行时，在表达力很强的 Python 子集里自动并行化 agentic workflow 中的外部模型调用，同时保持顺序执行语义。在一组真实 agentic workflow 上，端到端执行时间相对标准 Python 与若干 agentic 框架最高加速 6.7 倍。
Motivation: Agentic workflow 的端到端延迟是瓶颈，而手工并行化费力、受限框架又表达不出全部并行形式。
Method: PopPy 由 ahead-of-time 编译器与运行时组成，针对 Python 抽取并行的三个难点——语言复杂性、动态分派 (dynamic dispatch)、变量可变性 (variable mutation)——在表达力很强的 Python 子集中并行化对外部调用（如 AI 模型）。
Result: 在一组真实 agentic workflow 上，相对标准 Python 执行和若干 agentic 框架，端到端执行时间最高获得 6.7 倍加速，同时保持顺序程序语义。
Conclusion: 在保留 Python 表达力与顺序语义的前提下，编译器加运行时的组合足以自动榨出 agentic workflow 中的外部调用并行度，把延迟瓶颈压下来。

papers.title: Resolving Representation Ambiguity in Feedforward Novel View Synthesis Transformer via Semantic-Spatial Decoupling
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based models have advanced feedforward novel view synthesis (NVS). Current architectures such as GS-LRM and LVSM mix semantic information (e.g., RGB) and spatial information (e.g., Plücker rays) into a shared feature space. Since Plücker rays naturally carry lattice-like spatial structure, these designs can make the spatial bias interfere with appearance representation and degrade rendering fidelity. To this end, we propose to decouple the representation of feedforward NVS transformers into separate semantic and spatial tokens. The decoupled design keeps semantic and spatial information explicit in their branches while preserving cross-branch interaction through shared attention routing. Built on this design, we introduce optional categorized supervision and bidirectional modulation: the former provides branch-specific training signals, while the latter improves interaction between the two branches. Notably, the base decoupled design introduces virtually zero additional inference latency due to its architectural design. The proposed designs achieve consistent improvements, demonstrating effectiveness across decoder-only and encoder-decoder feedforward NVS models.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Updated manuscript with revised method description and additional experiments. Project page: https://hangzay.github.io/ssd_lvsm/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 前馈新视角合成 (feedforward NVS) Transformer 把 RGB 语义与 Plücker ray 空间信息混进同一特征空间，Plücker ray 自带格点状空间结构会干扰外观表征、降低渲染保真度。将表征解耦为语义与空间两支 token、以共享 attention 路由保持跨支交互，并加可选的分类监督与双向调制，在 decoder-only 与 encoder-decoder 两类 NVS 模型上取得一致提升，基础解耦设计几乎不增加推理延迟。
Motivation: GS-LRM、LVSM 等现有架构把语义与空间信息混入共享特征空间，Plücker ray 的格点状空间偏置会干扰外观表征并损害渲染保真度。
Method: 把 NVS Transformer 的表征解耦为语义 token 与空间 token 两条分支，通过共享 attention 路由保留跨分支交互；在此之上加入可选的分类监督 (categorized supervision) 提供分支专属训练信号，以及双向调制 (bidirectional modulation) 改善两支交互，基础解耦设计在架构上几乎不增加推理延迟。
Result: 所提设计在 decoder-only 与 encoder-decoder 两类前馈 NVS 模型上均取得一致提升，验证其有效性；基础解耦设计引入的额外推理延迟几乎为零。
Conclusion: 语义与空间表征应当解耦并显式分置，再靠共享 attention 交互，即可在不增加推理开销的前提下提升前馈 NVS 的渲染保真度。

papers.title: QuadLink: Autoregressive Quad-Dominant Mesh Generation via Point-Relation Learning
papers.abstract_en: The generation of production-ready quad-dominant meshes is a cornerstone of modern 3D content creation. Generating anisotropic quad-dominant meshes from point clouds is challenging, as existing methods are typically limited to producing either pure triangular meshes or pure quadrilateral meshes with isotropic densities. In this paper, we present QuadLink, a unified framework consisting of three stages for quad-dominant mesh generation by linking points into structured faces. QuadLink formulates polygonal mesh generation as a hybrid centroid-conditioned vertex linking model: it first predicts a unified set of anchors (vertices and face centroids), then learns centroid-conditioned links that associate vertices with face centroids, and finally assembles polygonal faces with a quad-first strategy guided by robust geometric verification strategies. This link-based formulation enables efficient generation of sparse and anisotropic quad-dominant meshes with coherent edge flow and meanwhile supporting hybrid polygonal topology. To construct training data for this model, we further introduce a Tri-to-Quad Operator that converts artistic triangle meshes into quad-dominant training data via global merge selection. Extensive experiments show that QuadLink produces production-ready quad-dominant meshes from point clouds and achieves improved geometric fidelity and topological quality compared to prior baselines. Our method natively supports hybrid polygonal topology, generalizing to arbitrary n-gon meshes without architectural changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QuadLink 把点云到 quad-dominant 网格生成拆成三阶段的链接式模型：先预测顶点与面心的统一 anchor 集合，再学习顶点到面心的质心条件链接，最后用 quad-first 策略与几何校验组装多边形面。它能直接生成稀疏、各向异性且边流一致的 quad 网格，并原生支持任意 n-gon 混合拓扑，无需改结构。
Motivation: 现有方法只能产出纯三角网格或各向同性密度的纯四边形网格，无法从点云生成带各向异性密度、连贯边流的生产级 quad-dominant 网格。
Method: 三阶段 hybrid centroid-conditioned vertex linking：预测统一 anchor（顶点+面心），学习顶点与面心的条件链接，再以 quad-first 策略配合鲁棒几何校验组装多边形面；另提出 Tri-to-Quad Operator，用 global merge selection 把艺术三角网格转成 quad 训练数据。
Result: 实验显示 QuadLink 从点云生成生产级 quad-dominant 网格，在几何保真度与拓扑质量上相比先前基线有提升，并原生支持混合多边形拓扑、可泛化到任意 n-gon 而不改架构。
Conclusion: 把多边形网格生成改写为链接式顶点-面心关联问题，可以在同一框架内同时拿到各向异性 quad 网格与混合拓扑，训练数据则由三角到四边形的全局合并算子自动生成。

papers.title: Causal Forcing++: Scalable Few-Step Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation for Real-Time Interactive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Real-time interactive video generation requires low-latency, streaming, and controllable rollout. Existing autoregressive (AR) diffusion distillation methods have achieved strong results in the chunk-wise 4-step regime by distilling bidirectional base models into few-step AR students, but they remain limited by coarse response granularity and non-negligible sampling latency. In this paper, we study a more aggressive setting: frame-wise autoregression with only 1--2 sampling steps. In this regime, we identify the initialization of a few-step AR student as the key bottleneck: existing strategies are either target-misaligned, incapable of few-step generation, or too costly to scale. We propose \textbf{Causal Forcing++}, a principled and scalable pipeline that uses \emph{causal consistency distillation} (causal CD) for few-step AR initialization. The core idea is that causal CD learns the same AR-conditional flow map as causal ODE distillation, but obtains supervision from a single online teacher ODE step between adjacent timesteps, avoiding the need to precompute and store full PF-ODE trajectories. This makes the initialization both more efficient and easier to optimize. The resulting pipeline, \ours, surpasses the SOTA 4-step chunk-wise Causal Forcing under the \textit{\textbf{frame-wise 2-step setting}} by 0.1 in VBench Total, 0.3 in VBench Quality, and 0.335 in VisionReward, while reducing first-frame latency by 50\% and Stage 2 training cost by $\sim$$4\times$. We further extend the pipeline to action-conditioned world model generation in the spirit of Genie3. Project Page: https://github.com/thu-ml/Causal-Forcing and https://github.com/shengshu-ai/minWM .

papers.title: Inference-Time Amplification of Weak Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: How much of the capability of a reasoning model exposed by repeated sampling can an imperfect selector recover? We study this problem as {\em inference-time amplification}, separating {\em coverage}---whether a useful candidate is generated---from {\em identifiability}---whether it can be recognized among the alternatives. We show that better coverage alone does not guarantee better selection, while even imperfect local selection signals can be amplified through repetition. We also characterize proposal-side blind spots that additional sampling cannot overcome. On SWE-bench Verified, a single GPT-5.4 nano trajectory solves 67.0\% of tasks, while eight proposals contain a correct patch on 79.0\%; critic--comparator selection reaches 76.4\%, recovering 78.3\% of the oracle-exposed gain. The same pattern appears across proposer families and in mathematical reasoning, competitive programming, and formal proof. On MATH L4--5 and GSM-Plus, our selector recovers 85\% and 77\% of the oracle gap and substantially outperforms majority vote. Holding proposal coverage fixed, providing the selector with additional repository information also improves recovery. Conversely, when the available selection signal is weak, redundant, or misaligned, amplification can diminish or fail. These results identify selection quality as the key factor governing how much capability exposed by repeated sampling can actually be recovered.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把推理模型的重复采样能力拆成 coverage（是否生成正确候选）与 identifiability（能否从候选中识别它），提出 critic–comparator 选择器做推理时放大 (inference-time amplification)。SWE-bench Verified 上单条 GPT-5.4 nano 轨迹解 67.0%，8 个候选含正确 patch 达 79.0%，选择器到 76.4%，回收 oracle 暴露增益的 78.3%；选择信号弱、冗余或错位时放大会失效。
Motivation: 重复采样能暴露更强能力，但不完美的选择器能回收多少、瓶颈在哪，缺少可分离的刻画；coverage 提升并不自动带来更好的选择。
Method: 将问题形式化为 inference-time amplification，分离 coverage 与 identifiability，用 critic–comparator 选择器在候选间做局部选择，并刻画额外采样无法弥补的 proposal 侧盲区；在固定 coverage 下向选择器注入额外仓库信息。
Result: SWE-bench Verified：单条 GPT-5.4 nano 轨迹 67.0%，8 个 proposal 含正确 patch 79.0%，critic–comparator 选择达 76.4%，回收 oracle 增益的 78.3%。MATH L4–5 与 GSM-Plus 上选择器分别回收 oracle gap 的 85% 与 77%，并大幅优于 majority vote；固定 coverage 时给选择器更多仓库信息也提升回收率。
Conclusion: 选择质量是决定重复采样能力能被回收多少的关键因素；当选择信号弱、冗余或错位时，放大可能变差甚至失败。

papers.title: An Agentic AI Framework with Large Language Models and Chain-of-Thought for UAV-Assisted Logistics Scheduling with Mobile Edge Computing
papers.abstract_en: In cloud manufacturing, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can support both product collection and mobile edge computing (MEC). This joint operation forms a hybrid scheduling problem, where physical logistics decisions are coupled with computational task scheduling. In this paper, UAVs collect finished products from manufacturing stations and transport them back to a central depot. Meanwhile, computational tasks generated by industrial sensor devices at these stations are processed locally, at UAVs, or offloaded via UAVs to the cloud. This coupling makes the problem challenging. A UAV can provide MEC services only during its service window at a station, so routing decisions directly determine when UAV-assisted offloading is available. Routing decisions also affect the UAV energy budget and the availability of onboard computing and communication resources for computational task execution under task deadline constraints. To address this, we propose an agentic-AI-assisted optimization framework with two components. First, we develop an agentic AI that combines large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and chain-of-thought reasoning to translate user input into an interpretable mathematical formulation for the hybrid scheduling problem. Second, we design a hierarchical deep reinforcement learning approach based on proximal policy optimization (PPO), where the upper layer learns UAV routing and the lower layer optimizes per-slot task execution and resource allocation. Simulation results show that the proposed framework yields more consistent formulations, while the hierarchical PPO achieves full product collection in 99.6% of the last 500 episodes and maintains a 100% deadline satisfaction rate, with more stable performance than the advantage actor-critic approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向云制造中 UAV 取货与移动边缘计算 (MEC) 联合调度，提出两段式 agentic AI 框架：LLM+RAG+chain-of-thought 把用户输入转成可解释的数学建模，分层 PPO 上层学 UAV 路由、下层学逐时隙任务执行与资源分配。仿真中分层 PPO 在最后 500 个 episode 里 99.6% 完成全部取货，deadline 满足率 100%，且比 A2C 更稳定。
Motivation: 云制造里 UAV 的物流路由与 MEC 卸载耦合：UAV 只在站点服务窗口内提供算力，路由直接决定卸载何时可用，并同时消耗能量与机载计算通信资源，传统分开求解会失配。
Method: 框架含两部分：一是 agentic AI，用大语言模型结合检索增强生成 (RAG) 与 chain-of-thought 推理，把用户输入翻译成该混合调度问题的可解释数学公式；二是分层深度强化学习，上层基于 PPO 学 UAV 路由，下层优化逐时隙任务执行与资源分配，任务可在本地、UAV 或经 UAV 卸载到云端。
Result: 仿真结果：分层 PPO 在最后 500 个 episode 中 99.6% 实现产品全部收集，deadline 满足率 100%，性能比 advantage actor-critic (A2C) 更稳定；agentic AI 生成的公式表述更一致 (more consistent formulations)。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 驱动的公式化与分层 PPO 调度拼成一条链，可以在路由与 MEC 卸载强耦合的云制造场景里同时拿到可解释建模和高完成率、满 deadline 的调度策略。

papers.title: NCO: A Versatile Plug-in for Handling Negative Constraints in Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Controlling Large Language Models (LLMs) to prevent the generation of undesirable content, such as profanity and personally identifiable information (PII), has become increasingly critical. While earlier approaches relied on post-processing or resampling, recent research has shifted towards constrained decoding methods that control outputs during generation to mitigate high computational costs and quality degradation. However, preventing multiple forbidden hard constraints or regex constraints from appearing anywhere in the output is computationally challenging. A straightforward solution is to convert these constraints into a single automaton that tracks all forbidden patterns during decoding, but this often becomes impractically large. Standard regex engines also do not readily support the operations needed to build such a constraint, such as complement and intersection. In order to address these limitations, we propose NCO, a decoding strategy that performs online pattern matching over finite hard constraints and regex constraints, reducing computational overhead without inducing state explosion. NCO is fully compatible with standard inference strategies, including various sampling methods and beam search, while also supporting soft masking for probabilistic suppression. We empirically demonstrate its effectiveness across practical tasks, including PII and profanity suppression. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/hyundong98/NCO-Decoding .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NCO 是一种解码期在线模式匹配策略，把多个禁止硬约束与正则约束在生成过程中逐 token 检查，避免把它们合成一个自动机导致的状态爆炸，同时保持与采样、beam search 等标准推理策略兼容并支持 soft masking 概率抑制。在 PII 与脏话抑制等任务上实证其有效性。
Motivation: LLM 解码需要同时禁止多个硬约束与正则约束出现，把它们合成单一自动机会变得不切实际地大，标准正则引擎也不支持补与交运算，导致计算开销高。
Method: NCO 在解码时对有限硬约束与正则约束做在线模式匹配，避免状态爆炸；兼容标准推理策略（各类采样与 beam search），并支持 soft masking 做概率性抑制。
Result: 在 PII 抑制与脏话抑制等实际任务上实证展示了有效性；实现开源在 github.com/hyundong98/NCO-Decoding。
Conclusion: 在线模式匹配的约束解码可以在不引入状态爆炸的前提下处理多禁止约束与正则约束，并与现有推理策略共存。

papers.title: InsHuman: Towards Natural and Identity-Preserving Human Insertion
papers.abstract_en: Human insertion aims to naturally place specific individuals into a target background. Although existing image editing models may have such ability, they often produce failure cases, including inappropriate human pose in new background, inconsistent number of people, and modified facial identity. Moreover, publicly available human datasets often lack full-body portraits and realistic physical interaction between humans and their background. To address these challenges, we propose InsHuman for natural and identity-preserving human insertion. Specifically, we propose Human-Background Adaptive Fusion (HBAF), which detects foreground humans to obtain a binary mask and applies region-aware weighting to align the human regions between predicted and ground-truth latents, ensuring the person's pose, count, and overall appearance are coherently adapted to the target background.We further propose Face-to-Face ID-Preserving (FFIP), which detects and matches faces between the generated image and the source image in terms of face recognition features to enforce identity consistency for each face.In addition, we propose Bidirectional Data Pairing (BDP) strategy to construct BDP-InsHuman, a high-quality dataset with realistic human-background interactions. Experiments demonstrate that InsHuman achieves significant improvements in generating plausible images while keeping human identity unchanged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InsHuman 面向把指定人物自然插入目标背景的图像编辑任务，用 Human-Background Adaptive Fusion 按区域加权对齐预测与真值 latent 中的人体区域，保证姿态、人数与外观一致，再用 Face-to-Face ID-Preserving 按人脸识别特征匹配生成图与源图的每张脸以锁定身份，并提出 Bidirectional Data Pairing 构建含真实人景交互的 BDP-InsHuman 数据集。实验显示其在生成合理图像的同时保持人物身份不变方面有显著提升。
Motivation: 现有图像编辑模型插入人物时会出现新背景中姿态不当、人数不一致、面部身份被改动等失败；公开人物数据集又缺少全身人像与人和背景之间真实的物理交互。
Method: HBAF 检测前景人物得到二值 mask，并对预测 latent 与真值 latent 的人体区域做区域感知加权对齐；FFIP 在生成图与源图之间检测并匹配人脸，用人脸识别特征强制每张脸的身份一致；BDP 策略构造 BDP-InsHuman 数据集以提供真实人景交互对。
Result: 实验表明 InsHuman 在生成合理图像并保持人物身份不变上取得显著提升，同时缓解姿态、人数与面部身份三类失败；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把区域感知的 latent 对齐与人脸识别特征约束结合，再配以专门构造的人景交互数据，可以在插入人物时同时保住构图合理性和身份一致性。

papers.title: PLOT: Progressive Localization via Optimal Transport in Neural Causal Abstraction
papers.abstract_en: Causal abstraction offers a principled framework for mechanistic interpretability, aligning a high-level causal model with low-level neural computation through interchange intervention analysis. Finding such an alignment, however, often requires fitting and evaluating separate learned mappings across many candidate neural locations. We introduce PLOT, a gradient-free approach for joint correspondence discovery via a global matching of intervention effects. PLOT represents abstract and neural interventions by geometric signatures of their effects on the shared task output and fits an optimal transport coupling between the two collections. The coupling can be calibrated directly into an executable intervention handle or used progressively to select coarse parent sites for finer localization, reducing the cost of searching broad collections of neural sites. Experiments on hierarchical equality, binary addition, and multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) demonstrate fast and accurate direct handles without learning intervention rotations and show that progressive localization can improve accuracy under intervention-size constraints while reducing computational cost. PLOT can also guide gradient-based subspace learning, with PLOT-guided distributed alignment search (DAS) attaining accuracy comparable to full DAS at approximately $3.6\times$ and $20\times$ lower serial runtime on binary addition and MCQA, respectively. PLOT thus separates the search for candidate correspondences from optional subspace learning and provides a common framework for constructing and testing neural intervention handles for a given causal model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PLOT 用最优传输 (optimal transport) 对高层因果模型与神经网络干预效应做全局匹配，梯度无关地直接求出可执行的干预句柄 (intervention handle)，并可逐级缩小候选神经位置。在 hierarchical equality、binary addition 与 MCQA 上，PLOT 引导的 DAS 达到与完整 DAS 相当的精度，串行运行时间分别低约 3.6 倍与 20 倍。
Motivation: 因果抽象需要在大量候选神经位置上反复拟合与评估独立学到的映射，搜索成本高，且常需学习干预旋转。
Method: 把抽象干预与神经干预表示为它们对共享任务输出之影响的几何签名 (geometric signatures)，在两组签名之间拟合最优传输耦合；该耦合既可直接校准为可执行干预句柄，也可渐进地先选粗粒度父站点再细化，并可引导基于梯度的子空间学习（PLOT-guided DAS）。
Result: 在 hierarchical equality、binary addition、MCQA 三个任务上，直接句柄快速且准确、无需学习干预旋转；在干预规模约束下渐进定位提升精度并降低计算成本；PLOT 引导的 DAS 精度与完整 DAS 相当，串行运行时间在 binary addition 上约低 3.6 倍、在 MCQA 上约低 20 倍。
Conclusion: 把候选对应关系的搜索与可选的子空间学习分开，用全局匹配替代逐位置拟合，可为给定因果模型构造并检验神经干预句柄提供统一框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Tool to Agent: How Worker Needs Reorganize Across the Agentic Roles of Workplace AI
papers.abstract_en: As AI systems gain agency in workplaces, workers increasingly interact with systems that do more than support tasks: they make decisions, allocate work, and shape how workers communicate with others. We interviewed 16 workers in healthcare, finance, and management about their daily interactions with workplace AI systems. Across these domains, AI occupied three agentic roles: \emph{assistant}, supporting worker decision-making; \emph{arbiter}, making consequential decisions that workers had to explain to downstream stakeholders; and \emph{manager}, directing work and displacing social structures through which work had been negotiated and learned. We find that worker needs depended on how decision authority and accountability were configured around the AI system. Explanation, control, accountability, and communication each took different meanings depending on whether AI supported, decided, or directed work. We contribute a role-based account of workplace human-agent interaction and identify accountability-authority asymmetry as a mechanism through which AI deployments can place responsibility on workers for outcomes whose authority has shifted to AI. We discuss implications for designing workplace AI around both the agent and its surrounding agency configuration.
papers.comment: 10 pages. To appear at the 14th International Conference on Human-Agent Interaction (HAI '26). Revised from the previous version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对医疗、金融、管理三个领域的 16 名职场工作者做访谈，提出 workplace AI 的三种 agentic 角色——assistant、arbiter、manager——并指出解释、控制、问责、沟通四类 worker needs 的含义随 AI 是支持、决策还是指挥工作而改变。核心机制是 accountability-authority asymmetry：决策权已移向 AI，后果责任却仍压在工人身上。
Motivation: 职场 AI 已从辅助工具变成会做决策、分配工作、塑造沟通的 agent，但现有 HAI 框架没有解释决策权与问责如何围绕 AI 配置，导致工人对无权掌控的结果负责。
Method: 对 healthcare、finance、management 三个领域的 16 名工作者进行访谈，围绕其日常与职场 AI 的互动做角色编码，归纳出 assistant、arbiter、manager 三种 agentic roles，并按决策权与问责的配置方式分析四类需求的语义变化。
Result: 识别出三种 agentic roles：assistant 支持工人决策，arbiter 做出需向下游 stakeholder 解释的重大决策，manager 指挥工作并取代原本协商与学习工作的社会结构；解释、控制、问责、沟通在 AI 支持、决策、指挥三种情形下含义各不相同；提出 accountability-authority asymmetry 作为责任落在工人身上而权威已转移给 AI 的机制。
Conclusion: workplace AI 的设计要同时围绕 agent 本身和它周边的 agency 配置，因为 worker needs 取决于决策权与问责如何围绕系统组织，而非 AI 能力本身。

papers.title: Bringing Order to Asynchronous SGD: Towards Optimality under Data-Dependent Delays with Momentum
papers.abstract_en: Asynchronous SGD enables scalable distributed training but suffers from stale gradients. When delays depend on the data, slower samples may be underrepresented, biasing training toward faster samples. We introduce ordered momentum, a unified framework that attains the best-known rates for smooth convex and non-convex objectives under both data-independent and data-dependent delays. Notably, we establish (i) the first convergence guarantee for smooth convex objectives with data-dependent delays and, among analyses of data-dependent delays, the first to (ii) benefit from parallelization and (iii) match the tight data-independent rate, with a leading stochastic term independent of the number of workers. Finally, we derive robust learning rates that simplify hyperparameter tuning across convex and non-convex settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对异步 SGD 中数据相关延迟导致慢样本被低估的问题，提出 ordered momentum 统一框架，在数据无关与数据相关延迟下都达到已知最优收敛率。它是首个平滑凸目标在数据相关延迟下的收敛保证，且首个能从并行化获益、匹配数据无关紧界（随机项前导系数与 worker 数无关）的分析，并给出可简化凸/非凸调参的鲁棒学习率。
Motivation: 异步分布式训练中梯度陈旧，若延迟依赖数据，慢样本会被系统性低估，训练偏向快样本；此前数据相关延迟下缺少平滑凸目标的收敛保证，也未体现并行化收益。
Method: 提出 ordered momentum 统一框架，覆盖数据无关与数据依赖两类延迟，分析平滑凸与非凸目标的收敛率，并从中推导出跨凸/非凸设定的鲁棒学习率以简化超参调节。
Result: 给出平滑凸目标在数据相关延迟下的首个收敛保证；在数据相关延迟分析中首个体现并行化收益并匹配数据无关的紧界，随机项前导系数与 worker 数无关；导出的鲁棒学习率简化了凸与非凸设定的超参调节。
Conclusion: 数据相关延迟下的异步 SGD 可以做到与数据无关情形同阶的最优速率，且并行化仍能带来收益，调参可用统一的鲁棒学习率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The AI Accountability Ecosystem in the Era of Language Models
papers.abstract_en: This article reviews and updates the framework for accountability in AI based on account- ability ecosystems. We update the framework in light of the latest developments since the release of Large Language Models for general public use. We propose three interlinked updates to the original AI accountability ecosystem: (i) reorienting the accountability ecosystem to AI infrastructure and supply chains, (ii) providing greater emphasis on outcomes monitoring and identification of issues that support decentralized system improvement, and (iii) incorporating end-user accountability given the new risks of unpredictability of language models in-the-wild. Collectively, these updates mark a shift towards accountability as distributed, continuous, and institutionalized, away from a system in which frontier AI applications can be modeled as discrete products controlled by single identifiable actors with industry-specific oversight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在原 AI accountability ecosystem 框架上提出三项相互关联的更新：把问责重心转向 AI 基础设施与供应链、强化结果监测 (outcomes monitoring) 以支持去中心化系统改进、并纳入终端用户问责，理由是语言模型在真实环境 (in-the-wild) 中行为不可预测。整体主张是问责应从「前沿 AI 可视为单一主体控制的离散产品、由行业专属监管」转向分布式、持续化、制度化的模式。
Motivation: 通用大语言模型公开可用后，前沿 AI 应用不再能被当作由单一可识别主体控制的离散产品，原有按行业切分的问责框架与单一主体假设失效。
Method: 综述并更新既有的 AI 问责生态系统框架，给出三项联动更新：重构至 AI 基础设施与供应链、强调 outcomes monitoring 与问题识别以支撑去中心化改进、加入 end-user accountability；属框架性论述而非实验方法。
Result: 产出三项框架更新与一个方向性论断：问责模式从离散产品、单一主体、行业专属监管，转向 distributed、continuous、institutionalized 的形态；摘要未含实验数字。
Conclusion: 语言模型的不可预测性要求把问责重新定义为分布式的、持续的、制度化的机制，而非对单个产品的静态合规审查。
Relevance: 0
