papers.title: Perturbation-Regularized Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation with Unified Multi-Domain Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary remote sensing image segmentation (OVRSIS) aims to segment text-specified categories beyond a fixed label space. Its key challenge is to maintain reliable pixel--text correspondence under substantial appearance variation in remote-sensing imagery. Existing methods often rely on specialized vision--language representations or complex adaptation mechanisms, yet still perform deterministic matching between fixed text prototypes and individual visual features. We instead formulate OVRSIS as a \emph{distributional pixel--text alignment} problem and propose \textbf{Pi-Seg}, a lightweight perturbation-based framework. Pi-Seg introduces learnable variations into textual prototypes and dense visual features before alignment. Segmentation supervision encourages perturbations that enlarge the target-to-distractor margin while suppressing harmful feature shifts. Pi-Seg consistently improves performance under the existing \textit{single-source} OVRSISBench protocols. To evaluate OVRSIS beyond source-specific training settings, we further introduce a unified \textit{multi-source} protocol and construct \textbf{GlobalRSOV95K}, containing approximately 95K densely annotated images and 35 semantic categories. Models are trained on this shared dataset and evaluated on an image-disjoint suite of 10 downstream datasets. The complete benchmark covers more than 170K images and 122 categories. Experiments under both single-source and multi-source protocols show that Pi-Seg improves cross-dataset transfer and generalizes effectively to practical geospatial segmentation tasks, while GlobalRSOV95K provides a common foundation for transferable OVRSIS research. \footnote{\url{https://github.com/LiBingyu01/Pi-Seg}}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Pi-Seg 把开放词汇遥感分割 (OVRSIS) 从固定文本原型的确定性匹配改写为分布式的 pixel-text 对齐：给文本原型和稠密视觉特征都注入可学习扰动，用分割监督推动扰动扩大目标与干扰项的间隔、同时抑制有害特征偏移。在既有 single-source OVRSISBench 协议上一致提升，并在新提出的 multi-source 协议（GlobalRSOV95K，约 95K 图像、35 类，10 个 image-disjoint 下游数据集，全集超 170K 图像、122 类）下改善跨数据集迁移。
Motivation: 开放词汇遥感分割要在固定标签空间之外按文本指定类别做像素级分割，遥感影像外观变化剧烈，而现有方法依赖专用视觉-语言表示或复杂适配机制，仍在固定文本原型与单个视觉特征之间做确定性匹配，跨数据集迁移不可靠。
Method: 提出轻量的扰动框架 Pi-Seg：在对齐之前给文本原型与稠密视觉特征引入可学习变化，分割监督引导扰动扩大 target-to-distractor margin 并压制有害特征偏移；同时构建 GlobalRSOV95K（约 95K 密集标注图像、35 类）作为共享训练集，模型在其上训练并在 10 个 image-disjoint 下游数据集上评测，覆盖超 170K 图像、122 类。
Result: 在既有 single-source OVRSISBench 协议下 Pi-Seg 一致提升性能；在新提出的 multi-source 协议下，Pi-Seg 改善跨数据集迁移并有效泛化到实际地理空间分割任务；GlobalRSOV95K 全基准覆盖超 170K 图像与 122 类，其中共享训练集约 95K 图像、35 类，评测集为 10 个下游数据集。
Conclusion: 把 OVRSIS 当作分布式的 pixel-text 对齐并用扰动正则化间隔，比固定原型的确定性匹配更能跨数据集迁移；GlobalRSOV95K 为可迁移的 OVRSIS 研究提供统一的多源训练与评测基础。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Confidence under Visual Token Pruning: Removed Evidence and Risk-Controlled Token Budgets for MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Visual token pruning speeds up multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by keeping a small subset of the visual tokens, and pruning methods are compared by the accuracy they retain. We study what pruning does to the confidence of these models, across common selectors, several MLLMs, and different output formats. Pruning errors concentrate on questions whose evidence the selector removed, and confidence does not register the removal. When the queried object loses all of its tokens, accuracy on these questions drops from 59% to 17%, while confidence stays at the unpruned level. Returning a few object tokens to the kept set recovers most of the lost accuracy. Selectors that keep the most attended tokens remove such evidence most often and produce confident errors, which temperature scaling cannot re-rank. Selectors that avoid keeping redundant tokens stay close to the calibration of the unpruned model. We then use the confidence of the pruned model to set a per-question token budget. The model answers with few tokens first and again with all tokens when its confidence is low. Conformal risk control sets the threshold to bound the expected deviation from the unpruned model. With coverage-based selection, this cascade needs about a third of the prefill tokens of the unpruned model, while with FastV it needs more than the unpruned model. The savings come mainly from how well the confidence ranks the answers that differ from the unpruned ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 视觉 token 剪枝会让 MLLM 在被剪掉证据的问题上给出高置信错误：当查询对象的 token 全部被移除，准确率从 59% 跌到 17%，置信度却仍停在未剪枝水平。作者用剪枝模型的置信度驱动逐题 token 预算的级联回答，配合 conformal risk control 约束与未剪枝模型的期望偏差，在 coverage-based 选择下只需约三分之一 prefill token。
Motivation: token 剪枝一直只按保留准确率比较，但剪枝引入的错误集中在证据被移除的题目上，且模型置信度不反映这种移除，导致高置信错误无法被温度缩放等后处理纠正。
Method: 跨多种 selector、多个 MLLM 与不同输出格式研究剪枝对置信度与校准的影响；再以剪枝模型置信度设定逐题 token 预算，低置信时用全部 token 重答，并用 conformal risk control 设定阈值以约束相对未剪枝模型的期望偏差，构成级联。
Result: 查询对象 token 全被移除时，该类问题准确率从 59% 降至 17%，置信度保持未剪枝水平；归还少量对象 token 可恢复大部分损失准确率。保留最高注意力 token 的 selector 最常移除证据并产生温度缩放无法重排的高置信错误，避免保留冗余 token 的 selector 接近未剪枝模型的校准。级联在 coverage-based 选择下约用未剪枝模型三分之一的 prefill token，而在 FastV 下需多于未剪枝模型。
Conclusion: 剪枝的代价主要由置信度对“与未剪枝答案不同”的排序能力决定，因此 token 预算应按逐题置信度与风险受控阈值分配，而非全局固定。

papers.title: An AI Teaching Assistant for Motion Picture Engineering
papers.abstract_en: The rapid rise of LLMs over the last few years has promoted growing experimentation with LLM-driven AI tutors. However, the details of implementation, as well as the benefit in a teaching environment, are still in the early days of exploration. This article addresses these issues in the context of implementation of an AI Teaching Assistant (AI-TA) using Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) for Trinity College Dublin's Master's Motion Picture Engineering (MPE) course. We provide details of our implementation (including the prompt to the LLM, and code), and highlight how we designed and tuned our RAG pipeline to meet course needs. We describe our survey instrument and report on the impact of the AI-TA through a number of quantitative metrics. The scale of our experiment (43 students, 296 sessions, 1,889 queries over 7 weeks) was sufficient to have confidence in our findings. Unlike previous studies, we experimented with allowing the use of the AI-TA in open-book examinations. Statistical analysis across three exams showed no performance differences regardless of AI-TA access (p > 0.05), demonstrating that thoughtfully designed assessments can maintain academic validity. Student feedback revealed that the AI-TA was beneficial (mean = 4.22/5), while students had mixed feelings about preferring it over human tutoring (mean = 2.78/5).
papers.comment: Published in IEEE Signal Processing Magazine [SP Education]
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Signal Processing Magazine, vol. 43, no. 4, pp. 76-84, July 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为都柏林圣三一学院电影工程硕士课程构建基于 RAG 的 AI 助教 (AI-TA)，公开提示词与代码并调优检索管线以匹配课程需求。43 名学生、296 次会话、1,889 条查询、7 周实验中，三场考试统计分析显示是否可用 AI-TA 无成绩差异 (p > 0.05)，学生评价其有益 (4.22/5)，但对是否更愿用它替代人工辅导态度分化 (2.78/5)。
Motivation: LLM 驱动的 AI 导师实现细节与教学收益仍处早期探索，尤其缺少在开卷考试中开放使用后是否损害学业有效性的证据。
Method: 为 MPE 课程实现基于 Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) 的 AI-TA，公开 LLM 提示词与代码，按课程需求设计并调优 RAG 管线；用自研问卷收集反馈，并对三场考试做统计分析，比较有无 AI-TA 访问权限的成绩。
Result: 实验规模为 43 名学生、296 次会话、1,889 条查询、持续 7 周；三场考试统计分析显示无论是否可使用 AI-TA 均无表现差异 (p > 0.05)；学生反馈 AI-TA 有益均值 4.22/5，对更倾向它而非人工辅导的均值为 2.78/5。
Conclusion: 经过审慎设计的考核在开卷考试中开放 AI-TA 仍可保持学业有效性；学生认可其教学价值，但并不认为它可替代人工辅导。

papers.title: Planning for Change: Reinforcement Learning Combined with Bounded Extremum Seeking for Robotic Control under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has shown strong performance in robotic manipulation, but learned policies often degrade in performance when test conditions differ from the training distribution. This limitation is especially important for reliable robot planning and control in contact-rich tasks such as pushing and pick-and-place, where changes in goals, contact conditions, or robot dynamics can drive the system out-of-distribution at inference time. In this paper, we investigate a hybrid controller that combines reinforcement learning with bounded extremum seeking (ES) to improve robustness under such conditions. In the proposed approach, deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) policies are trained under standard conditions on the robotic pushing and pick-and-place tasks, and are then combined with bounded ES during deployment. The RL policy provides fast manipulation behavior, while bounded ES ensures robustness of the overall controller to time variations when operating conditions depart from those seen during training. The resulting controller is evaluated under several out-of-distribution settings, including time-varying goals and spatially varying friction patches. Crucially, under reasonable assumptions, we prove finite time RL-based convergence of a robotic arm to an object after which bounded ES achieves finite-time convergence to a bounded velocity moving target. We provide analytic formulas for both convergence times, and an ability to tune the convergence times by our choice of gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RL 与有界极值搜索 (bounded extremum seeking, ES) 的混合控制器：DDPG 在标准条件下训练抓取与推动策略，部署时叠加 bounded ES，使工况偏离训练分布时仍保持鲁棒。在时变目标与空间变摩擦块等 OOD 设定下评估，并证明机械臂有限时间收敛到物体、随后有限时间收敛到有界速度运动目标，两个收敛时间有解析式且可用增益调节。
Motivation: 学习到的策略在测试条件偏离训练分布时性能退化，这对接触密集的推动与抓放任务中的规划与控制尤其关键：目标、接触条件或机器人动力学的变化会在推理时把系统推出分布外。
Method: 在标准条件下用 DDPG 训练推动与 pick-and-place 策略，部署阶段将该策略与 bounded ES 组合：RL 提供快速操作行为，bounded ES 补偿工况随时间的变化。在若干 OOD 设定下评估，包括时变目标和空间变化的摩擦块。
Result: 在时变目标与空间变摩擦块等 OOD 设定下评估了该混合控制器；在合理假设下证明机械臂有限时间收敛到物体，随后 bounded ES 有限时间收敛到有界速度的运动目标，并给出两个收敛时间的解析公式，可通过增益选择调节收敛时间。
Conclusion: RL 负责快速操作、bounded ES 负责对偏离训练分布的时间变化保持鲁棒，两者组合可在解析可调的有限时间收敛保证下应对 OOD 工况。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: GUIDE: Reinforcement Learning for Behavioral Action Support in Type 1 Diabetes
papers.abstract_en: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) management requires continuous adjustment of insulin and lifestyle behaviors to maintain blood glucose within a safe target range. Although automated insulin delivery (AID) systems have improved glycemic outcomes, many patients still fail to achieve recommended clinical targets. Current reinforcement learning (RL)-based methods focus primarily on insulin-only treatment and do not provide behavioral recommendations for glucose control. To address this gap, we propose GUIDE, an RL-based decision-support framework designed to complement AID technologies by providing structured behavioral recommendations defined by intervention type, magnitude, and timing, including bolus insulin administration and carbohydrate intake events. GUIDE integrates a patient-specific glucose predictor trained on real-world continuous glucose monitoring data and supports offline and online RL algorithms within a unified environment. The algorithms are evaluated across 25 individuals from the AZT1D dataset and 12 individuals from the OhioT1DM dataset. Among the evaluated algorithms, CQL-BC achieved the best performance on both datasets, with mean time-in-range values of 84.18 $\pm$ 19.89% on AZT1D and 77.64 $\pm$ 8.81% on OhioT1DM. It also maintained time-below-range values of 0.43 $\pm$ 1.27% and 2.81 $\pm$ 3.56%, respectively. Behavioral analysis yielded mean cosine similarities of 0.767 $\pm$ 0.128 on AZT1D and 0.774 $\pm$ 0.162 on OhioT1DM, indicating that the learned policy preserves key structural characteristics of patient action patterns. These findings demonstrate the potential of conservative offline RL with a structured behavioral action space to provide personalized and behaviorally plausible decision support for diabetes management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GUIDE：把胰岛素大剂量注射与碳水摄入等行为决策纳入强化学习动作空间，配合个体化血糖预测器，为 1 型糖尿病患者生成含干预类型、幅度与时序的行为建议。在 AZT1D（25 人）与 OhioT1DM（12 人）上，CQL-BC 取得最佳表现，time-in-range 分别为 84.18±19.89% 与 77.64±8.81%。
Motivation: 现有 RL 血糖控制方法只做胰岛素给药，不提供行为层面的建议；而 AID 系统下仍有大量患者达不到推荐临床目标。
Method: GUIDE 用真实连续血糖监测 (CGM) 数据训练个体化血糖预测器，构建统一环境支持离线与在线 RL；动作空间结构化为干预类型、幅度、时序（含大剂量胰岛素与碳水摄入事件），并评估多种离线 RL 算法。
Result: 在 AZT1D 25 人与 OhioT1DM 12 人上评估，CQL-BC 两数据集均最佳：time-in-range 84.18±19.89%（AZT1D）、77.64±8.81%（OhioT1DM）；time-below-range 0.43±1.27% 与 2.81±3.56%；行为余弦相似度 0.767±0.128 与 0.774±0.162，表明策略保留了患者行为模式的结构特征。
Conclusion: 保守离线 RL（conservative offline RL）配合结构化行为动作空间，可提供个性化且行为上合理的糖尿病决策支持，作为 AID 的补充。

papers.title: Pre-Deployment Complexity Estimation for Federated Perception Systems
papers.abstract_en: Edge AI systems increasingly rely on federated learning to train perception models in distributed, privacy-preserving, and resource-constrained environments. Before training, however, practitioners often lack practical tools for estimating task difficulty in terms of expected accuracy and communication effort. We present a classifier-agnostic, pre-deployment framework that combines intrinsic data properties such as dimensionality, sparsity, and heterogeneity, with client-distribution composition to estimate learning complexity in federated perception systems. Using federated learning as a representative distributed training setting, we examine how learning difficulty varies across different federated configurations. Experiments on three MNIST variants show strong negative correlations between the combined complexity metric and maximum and average federated accuracy, while the intrinsic and distributed components exhibit consistent relationships with communication effort. These findings suggest that complexity estimation can serve as a practical diagnostic tool for resource planning, dataset assessment, and feasibility evaluation in edge-deployed perception systems.
papers.comment: Accepted and presented at Edge AI Research Symposium 2026 (EdgeAI2026), San Diego, CA. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个与分类器无关的部署前复杂度估计框架，把数据内在属性（维度、稀疏度、异质性）与客户端分布组成结合成复合复杂度指标，用于在联邦感知训练前预估学习难度与通信开销。在三个 MNIST 变体上，该复合指标与联邦最高精度、平均精度呈强负相关，其内在与分布式分量则与通信开销保持一致关系。
Motivation: 边缘联邦学习在训练前缺少实用工具预估任务难度，即预期精度与通信代价，导致资源规划与可行性判断无据可依。
Method: 框架结合内在数据属性（dimensionality、sparsity、heterogeneity）与 client-distribution composition 构造复合复杂度指标，以联邦学习作为代表性分布式训练设置，考察不同联邦配置下学习难度的变化。
Result: 在三个 MNIST 变体上的实验显示，复合复杂度指标与最大联邦精度、平均联邦精度均呈强负相关；内在分量与分布式分量同通信开销之间保持一致关系。
Conclusion: 复杂度估计可作为边缘部署感知系统的实用诊断工具，用于资源规划、数据集评估与可行性判断。

summary_sections.result: 在三个 MNIST 变体上的实验显示，复合复杂度指标与最大联邦精度、平均联邦精度均呈强负相关；内在分量与分布式分量同通信开销之间保持一致关系。
summary_sections.conclusion: 复杂度估计可作为边缘部署感知系统的实用诊断工具，用于资源规划、数据集评估与可行性判断。

papers.title: NASimJax: A GPU-Accelerated Policy Learning Framework for Penetration Testing
papers.abstract_en: Penetration testing - the practice of simulating cyberattacks to identify vulnerabilities - is a complex sequential decision-making task that is inherently partially observable and features large action spaces. Existing RL simulators for this domain are CPU-bound and fixed to narrow scenarios, making it infeasible to train policies that generalize across networks. We present NASimJax, a JAX-native framework that formulates penetration testing as a Contextual POMDP and introduces a network generation pipeline producing structurally diverse, guaranteed-solvable scenarios. The framework reaches up to 80$\times$ higher environment throughput than previous simulators, enabling experiments on larger networks and tractable hyperparameter searches. We provide PPO and PQN baselines and conduct the first systematic evaluation of unsupervised environment design for penetration testing. We find that Prioritized Level Replay and ACCEL handle dense training distributions better than Domain Randomization, and that training on sparser topologies yields an implicit curriculum that improves generalization - even to topologies denser than those seen during training. A recurrent PPO variant confirms that these distributional findings are not an artifact of feed-forward policies. The code is available at: https://github.com/raphsimon/NASimJax.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NASimJax 把渗透测试建模为 Contextual POMDP，用 JAX 原生实现并配套网络生成流水线，产出结构多样且保证可解的场景。环境吞吐量比既有模拟器最高高 80 倍；在无监督环境设计对比中，Prioritized Level Replay 与 ACCEL 比 Domain Randomization 更能处理稠密训练分布，稀疏拓扑训练形成隐式课程，即使面对比训练时更稠密的拓扑也能提升泛化。
Motivation: 现有渗透测试 RL 模拟器受 CPU 限制且场景固定狭窄，难以训练出能跨网络泛化的策略。
Method: JAX 原生框架，将渗透测试表述为 Contextual POMDP；网络生成流水线产生结构多样、保证可解 (guaranteed-solvable) 的场景；提供 PPO 与 PQN 基线，并首次系统评估渗透测试上的无监督环境设计 (unsupervised environment design)，含 Prioritized Level Replay、ACCEL、Domain Randomization，另用 recurrent PPO 变体做对照。
Result: 环境吞吐量比此前模拟器最高提升 80 倍，可支撑更大网络实验与超参搜索；Prioritized Level Replay 和 ACCEL 在稠密训练分布上优于 Domain Randomization；稀疏拓扑训练产生隐式课程，提升对更稠密拓扑的泛化；recurrent PPO 变体确认这些分布层面的发现并非前馈策略的假象。
Conclusion: 渗透测试策略学习的瓶颈可通过 GPU 原生模拟与场景生成打破，且无监督环境设计中的拓扑稀疏度是决定泛化的关键分布选择。

papers.title: Aligning the Query Space: Greedy Information Projection for Language Model Data Selection
papers.abstract_en: Data selection for language models is often framed as balancing example quality and diversity. We argue that both are consequences of a more fundamental principle: selected examples should preserve the downstream query space induced by instructions, task signals, or retrieval needs. We present Greedy Information Projection (GIP), a query-aligned method that requires only candidate embeddings and a score signal from LLM judgments, metadata, or intrinsic geometry. GIP greedily selects examples whose embedding span explains the largest residual component of task/query scores, yielding a fast matching-pursuit selector. A Gaussian projection view connects this update to maximizing mutual information, equivalently minimizing the residual volume of the query subspace left unexplained by selected data; this explains how quality and diversity emerge from one objective. Empirically, GIP matches or surpasses full-data fine-tuning using small instruction and reasoning subsets, while pretraining and RAG passage-selection experiments show that the same residual principle transfers beyond supervised fine-tuning.
papers.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026. An earlier version was accepted to 3rd DATA-FM workshop at ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GIP 把语言模型数据选择重构为保留下游 query 空间：贪心挑选其 embedding 张成能解释 task/query 分数最大残差分量的样本，等价于最大化互信息、最小化未被解释的 query 子空间残差体积。小规模指令与推理子集上 GIP 匹配或超过全量微调，且同一残差原则可迁移到预训练与 RAG passage 选择。
Motivation: 数据选择通常被当作质量与多样性的权衡，但二者是结果而非原则；作者主张被选样本应保留由指令、任务信号或检索需求诱导的下游 query 空间。
Method: Greedy Information Projection (GIP) 只需候选 embedding 与一个来自 LLM 判断、元数据或内在几何的分数信号；贪心选择使 embedding 张成解释最大 task/query 分数残差的样本，形成 matching-pursuit 式选择器，并以 Gaussian 投影视图把该更新与最大化互信息等价起来。
Result: 在指令与推理数据的小规模子集上，GIP 匹配或超过全量微调 (full-data fine-tuning)；预训练与 RAG passage 选择实验显示同一残差原则可迁移到监督微调之外。
Conclusion: 质量与多样性可以从单一目标（最小化 query 子空间残差体积）中涌现，数据选择应直接对齐下游 query 空间而非分别调权质量与多样性。

papers.title: PDE-SSM: A Spectral State Space Approach to Spatial Mixing in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: The success of vision transformers-especially for generative modeling-is limited by the quadratic cost and weak spatial inductive bias of self-attention. We propose PDE-SSM, a spatial state-space block that replaces attention with a learnable convection-diffusion-reaction partial differential equation. This operator encodes a strong spatial prior by modeling information flow via physically grounded dynamics rather than all-to-all token interactions. Solving the PDE in the Fourier domain yields global coupling with near-linear complexity of $O(N \log N)$, delivering a principled and scalable alternative to attention. We integrate PDE-SSM into a flow-matching generative model to obtain the PDE-based Diffusion Transformer PDE-SSM-DiT. Empirically, PDE-SSM-DiT matches or exceeds the performance of state-of-the-art Diffusion Transformers while substantially reducing compute. Our results show that, analogous to 1D settings where SSMs supplant attention, multi-dimensional PDE operators provide an efficient, inductive-bias-rich foundation for next-generation vision models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PDE-SSM 用可学习的对流-扩散-反应 (convection-diffusion-reaction) PDE 替代视觉 Transformer 中的自注意力，在 Fourier 域求解以获得全局耦合，复杂度为 O(N log N)。接入 flow-matching 生成模型得到 PDE-SSM-DiT，摘要称其匹配或超越 SOTA Diffusion Transformer，同时大幅降低计算量。
Motivation: 自注意力的二次复杂度与薄弱的空间归纳偏置限制了视觉 Transformer 在生成建模上的扩展性，需要一个既能全局耦合又接近线性的替代算子。
Method: 提出空间 state-space block PDE-SSM：以可学习的对流-扩散-反应 PDE 建模信息流，取代 all-to-all token 交互；在 Fourier 域求解该 PDE 得到全局耦合与 O(N log N) 复杂度。将其作为 block 集成进 flow-matching 生成模型，构成 PDE-SSM-DiT。
Result: PDE-SSM-DiT 在经验结果上匹配或超越 state-of-the-art Diffusion Transformer，同时 substantially 减少计算量；空间算子复杂度由二次降为 O(N log N)。
Conclusion: 作者主张，正如 1D 设定中 SSM 取代注意力，多维 PDE 算子可作为带强归纳偏置、可扩展的下一代视觉模型基础。

papers.title: COMIC: Agentic Sketch Comedy Generation
papers.abstract_en: We propose a fully automated AI system that produces short comedic videos similar to sketch shows such as Saturday Night Live. Starting from character references, the system employs a population of agents loosely modeled on roles in real production studios and structured to optimize the quality and diversity of ideas and outputs through iterative competition, evaluation, and refinement. A key contribution is the introduction of LLM-based critics aligned with real viewer preferences through the analysis of a corpus of comedy videos on YouTube, enabling automatic evaluation of humor. We further propose multi-island relativistic evolution for script improvement, along with script-conditioned rendering critics that perform shot- and video-level tournaments. In both human and automated evaluations, COMIC receives higher scores than agentic and video generation baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COMIC 用一群按真实制作工作室角色分工的 agent 全自动产出 SNL 式短喜剧小品视频，通过竞争、评审与迭代打磨提升创意质量与多样性。核心是用 LLM critic 对齐真实观众幽默偏好（由 YouTube 喜剧视频语料分析得到），配合 multi-island relativistic evolution 改剧本、脚本条件渲染 critic 做镜头级与视频级锦标赛；在人工与自动评测中 COMIC 得分均高于 agentic 与视频生成基线。
Motivation: 自动喜剧视频生成缺少可靠的幽默评价手段：没有对齐观众偏好的评审，创意竞争与剧本迭代就无从优化。
Method: 系统从角色参考出发，部署按制作工作室角色建模的 agent 群体，以竞争、评审、精炼的迭代循环优化创意与输出的质量和多样性；用 LLM-based critics（由 YouTube 喜剧视频语料分析对齐真实观众偏好）自动评幽默，剧本改进用 multi-island relativistic evolution，渲染侧用 script-conditioned rendering critics 做 shot-level 与 video-level 锦标赛。
Result: 在人工评测与自动评测中，COMIC 的得分均高于 agentic 基线与视频生成基线；摘要未给出具体分值。
Conclusion: 把观众偏好对齐的 LLM 评审嵌入多 agent 竞争与进化流程，可以同时驱动喜剧剧本与成片质量的自动提升。

papers.title: DyQ-VLA: Temporal-Dynamic-Aware Quantization for Embodied Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve favorable task performance, yet runtime errors in closed-loop execution evolve with alternating updates of actions and observations. Existing VLA quantization methods mainly trade off inference speed and model performance while rarely investigating how quantization alters runtime errors. By comparing error distributions between full-precision and quantized models, we identify distinct evolutionary patterns for the two types of errors: quantization enlarges the variance of translation error distributions and increases their dispersion, whereas the distribution center of rotation errors gradually shifts across execution steps, demonstrating cumulative drift. Motivated by this observation, we rethink the optimal quantization strategy for VLA models and propose \textit{DyQ-VLA}, a runtime-error-aware quantization framework, which dynamically selects activation precision according to execution steps and tracks as well as compensates rotation errors via accumulated quantization residuals. Corresponding operators and runtime adaptation strategies are devised within the framework to enable dynamic-precision execution. Experiments show that \textit{DyQ-VLA} achieves a 1.88 to 1.93 inference speedups while maintaining comparable or higher average task success rates. Moreover, it reduces mean execution steps by 17.7% to 19.8%. Our code is here: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DyQ-VLA-7F51/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DyQ-VLA 针对具身视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型闭环执行中的运行时误差做量化：量化会放大平移误差分布的方差并增加离散度，而旋转误差分布中心随执行步数累积漂移。框架据此按执行步动态选择激活精度，并用累积量化残差跟踪补偿旋转误差，取得 1.88–1.93 倍推理加速、平均任务成功率相当或更高，平均执行步数减少 17.7%–19.8%。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 量化方法只在推理速度与模型性能之间折中，几乎不考察量化如何改变闭环执行中随动作与观测交替更新而演化的运行时误差。
Method: DyQ-VLA 是运行时误差感知的量化框架：先对比全精度与量化模型的误差分布，识别平移误差方差放大与旋转误差累积漂移两种模式；再按执行步动态选择激活精度，并通过累积量化残差跟踪与补偿旋转误差，配套设计算子与运行时自适应策略以支持动态精度执行。
Result: 推理加速 1.88 至 1.93 倍，同时平均任务成功率相当或更高；平均执行步数减少 17.7% 至 19.8%。误差分布对比显示量化增大平移误差分布方差并提高其离散度，旋转误差分布中心随执行步逐渐偏移，呈累积漂移。
Conclusion: VLA 量化应按运行时误差的演化模式区别对待：平移误差需抑制方差，旋转误差需按累积残差补偿，动态精度执行可在加速的同时保持任务成功率。

papers.title: DynaTokens: Controlling Token Dynamics for Continual Video-Language Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Continual VideoQA with multimodal LLMs remains challenging because sequential adaptation induces task interference, while storing task-specific prompts becomes impractical as task sequences grow. We introduce DynaTokens, a transformer-based token generator that dynamically produces fine-tuning tokens on demand, enabling task-adaptive prompt updates through shared generation weights. To mitigate forgetting, we introduce meta-learning-inspired regularisers that look ahead to avoid task-specific sharp update directions while anchoring the evolving generator to prior-task behaviours. We theoretically connect this objective to sharpness-aware optimisation, showing how it favours flatter cross-task minima and improves retention. DynaTokens combines gradient-free routing based on robust pretrained token and visual embeddings with lightweight auxiliary multimodal supervision, reducing router drift during continual adaptation. Across standard continual VideoQA benchmarks, DynaTokens achieves higher average accuracy and substantially lower forgetting than strong baselines. It also improves zero-shot generalisation and remains effective in longer domain-incremental sequences with extended task shifts. Finally, we introduce a challenging ImageQA->VideoQA protocol and show that DynaTokens enables robust cross-modal continual transfer.

papers.title: Efficient Generative Modeling beyond Memoryless Diffusion via Adjoint Schrödinger Bridge Matching
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models often yield highly curved trajectories and noisy score targets due to an uninformative, memoryless forward process that induces independent data-noise coupling. We propose Adjoint Schrödinger Bridge Matching (ASBM), a generative modeling framework that recovers optimal trajectories in high dimensions via two stages. First, we view the Schrödinger Bridge (SB) forward dynamic as a coupling construction problem and learn it through a data-to-energy sampling perspective that transports data to an energy-defined prior. Then, we learn the backward generative dynamic with a simple matching loss supervised by the induced optimal coupling. By operating in a non-memoryless regime, ASBM produces significantly straighter and more efficient sampling paths. Compared to prior works, ASBM scales to high-dimensional data with notably improved stability and efficiency. Extensive experiments on image generation show that ASBM improves fidelity with fewer sampling steps. We further showcase the effectiveness of our optimal trajectory via distillation to a one-step generator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASBM 把 Schrödinger Bridge 的前向动态当作耦合构造问题，用 data-to-energy 采样把数据搬到能量定义的先验，再用匹配损失 (matching loss) 学反向生成动态，从而脱离 memoryless 扩散。非 memoryless 机制产生更直、更高效的采样路径，在图像生成上以更少采样步数提升保真度，并可蒸馏为 one-step 生成器。
Motivation: 扩散模型的前向过程无记忆且数据-噪声独立耦合，导致轨迹高度弯曲、score 目标噪声大，高维下采样效率与稳定性受限。
Method: 两阶段框架 ASBM：第一阶段把 SB 前向动态视为耦合构造，用 data-to-energy sampling 视角学习把数据传输到能量定义的先验；第二阶段在该最优耦合监督下，用简单 matching loss 学习反向生成动态，整体运行在非 memoryless 体制。
Result: 在图像生成实验中，ASBM 以更少采样步数提升保真度 (fidelity)，相较先前工作在高维数据上稳定性与效率显著改善，采样路径明显更直；最优轨迹可蒸馏为 one-step 生成器。
Conclusion: 非 memoryless 的 Schrödinger Bridge 路线能同时改善生成质量与采样效率，最优轨迹可直接用于蒸馏单步生成。

papers.title: MedAD-R1: Consistency-Reinforced Policy Optimization for Interpretable Medical Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Medical Anomaly Detection (MedAD) offers a promising direction for medical image analysis with Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). However, progress is limited by fragmented datasets and the tendency of Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to learn superficial image-text correlations rather than verifiable diagnostic reasoning. Consequently, current models often generate fluent explanations that are either insufficiently grounded in the image or inconsistent with their final answers, limiting their reliability in high-stakes medical applications. To address these issues, we introduce MedAD-38K, a large-scale, multimodal, and multicenter benchmark containing structured Visual Question Answering pairs and quality-controlled diagnostic Chain-of-Thought annotations across five core MedAD tasks. Based on this benchmark, we propose a two-stage framework. Cognitive Injection first uses SFT to inject domain-specific medical knowledge and establish a structured think-then-answer format. Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization (Con-GRPO) then employs an Evidence-Aware Consistency Reward to reinforce reasoning that remains grounded in the image and logically supports the final answer. The resulting MedAD-R1 achieves state-of-the-art performance on MedAD-38K and consistently outperforms all evaluated baselines across five source-disjoint external datasets spanning diverse imaging modalities. Beyond accuracy, it achieves higher reasoning-answer consistency and visual-grounding scores across multiple backbones. With only 0.8B parameters, MedAD-R1 offers practical potential for resource-constrained deployment. These results demonstrate the generality of evidence-aware consistency optimization for interpretable MedAD. Project resources are available at https://github.com/zhtstar/MedAD-R1.

TL;DR: MedAD-R1 用两阶段训练把可解释医学异常检测从表层图文对齐推向证据一致的推理：先以 SFT 注入医学知识并固定 think-then-answer 格式，再用 Con-GRPO 的 Evidence-Aware Consistency Reward 同时奖励图像证据支撑与逻辑支撑最终答案。在自建 MedAD-38K 上达到 SOTA，并在五个 source-disjoint 外部数据集上一致超过全部被评基线，0.8B 参数即可部署。
Motivation: 医学异常检测中数据集碎片化，SFT 容易学到表层图文相关而非可验证的诊断推理，导致解释流畅但脱离图像或与最终答案不一致，难以用于高风险场景。
Method: 先构建 MedAD-38K：多中心、多模态基准，含结构化 VQA 对与质量受控的诊断 Chain-of-Thought 标注，覆盖五个核心 MedAD 任务。两阶段框架：Cognitive Injection 用 SFT 注入领域医学知识并建立 think-then-answer 结构；随后 Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization (Con-GRPO) 用 Evidence-Aware Consistency Reward 强化既扎根图像又在逻辑上支撑最终答案的推理。
Result: MedAD-R1 在 MedAD-38K 上取得 state-of-the-art，并在覆盖多种成像模态的五个 source-disjoint 外部数据集上一致优于全部被评基线；在多个 backbone 上取得更高的 reasoning-answer consistency 与 visual-grounding 分数；参数量仅 0.8B。
Conclusion: 证据感知的一致性优化对可解释医学异常检测具有普适性，且小参数模型即可支撑资源受限部署。

papers.title: Lethe: Principled Dual-Stream Update for Persistent Knowledge Erasure in Federated Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Federated unlearning (FU) aims to erase knowledge from a global model. Existing studies commonly assume that federated collaboration terminates after unlearning, overlooking a deployment-realistic scenario where training continues on the remaining clients after deletion requests are fulfilled. In this work, we identify a critical failure mode, termed knowledge resurfacing, revealing that continued training on retained data alone can reactivate unlearned knowledge in a few rounds. Empirically, we demonstrate that many state-of-the-art FU methods are prone to knowledge resurfacing. We then propose Lethe, a novel unlearning method for persistent knowledge erasure in federated settings. In each iteration, Lethe operates on a forget stream from the unlearning client and a retain stream from the retained clients. It redirects unlearning updates toward a region where the two streams are anti-aligned, discouraging retained-data training from moving back toward the forgotten knowledge. Consequently, Lethe ensures stronger unlearning persistence during subsequent federated training. Extensive experiments across diverse models, datasets, and unlearning levels validate that Lethe supports all levels of unlearning in a unified manner across both CV and NLP tasks, demonstrating consistently low RR, below 1% in most cases, even after an extremely long horizon of follow-up training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 联邦遗忘 (federated unlearning) 在删除请求完成后仍继续训练时，保留数据上的训练会让被遗忘知识在几轮内重新浮现 (knowledge resurfacing)。Lethe 每轮同时处理遗忘客户端的 forget stream 与保留客户端的 retain stream，把遗忘更新导向两流反向对齐 (anti-aligned) 的区域，阻止保留训练回退到旧知识。在 CV 与 NLP 任务、多种模型与遗忘等级下，超长后续训练后 RR 多数情况低于 1%。
Motivation: 现有联邦遗忘研究普遍假设遗忘结束后协作即终止，忽略了删除后仍在保留客户端上继续训练这一更贴近部署的场景，导致被遗忘知识被重新激活。
Method: Lethe 在每次迭代同时操作遗忘客户端的 forget stream 与保留客户端的 retain stream，将遗忘更新重定向到两流 anti-aligned 的区域，从而抑制保留数据训练把模型拉回被遗忘知识；该机制在统一框架下支持全部遗忘等级。
Result: 实证显示多种 SOTA FU 方法都易出现 knowledge resurfacing，且在几轮内重新激活被遗忘知识；Lethe 在多样模型、数据集与遗忘等级的广泛实验中，跨 CV 与 NLP 任务统一支持各等级遗忘，在极长后续训练后多数情况下 RR 持续低于 1%。
Conclusion: 删除后继续训练是联邦遗忘必须正面处理的失效模式，把遗忘更新导向与保留流反向对齐的方向可实现持久遗忘，无需按遗忘等级分别设计方法。

papers.title: De-occluding broadband metalens
papers.abstract_en: Obstructions such as raindrops, fences, or dust degrade captured images, especially when mechanical cleaning is infeasible. Conventional solutions to obstructions rely on a bulky compound optics array or computational inpainting, which compromise compactness or fidelity. Metalenses composed of subwavelength meta-atoms promise compact imaging, but simultaneous achievement of broadband and obstruction-free imaging remains a challenge, since a metalens that images distant scenes across a broadband spectrum cannot properly defocus near-depth occlusions. Here, we introduce a learned split-spectrum metalens that enables broadband obstruction-free imaging. Our approach divides the spectrum of each RGB channel into pass and stop bands with multi-band spectral filtering and learns the metalens to focus light from far objects through pass bands, while filtering focused near-depth light through stop bands. This optical signal is further enhanced using a neural network. Our learned split-spectrum metalens achieves broadband and obstruction-free imaging with relative PSNR gains of 32.29% and improves object detection and semantic segmentation accuracies with absolute gains of +13.54% mAP, +48.45% IoU, and +20.35% mIoU over a conventional hyperbolic design. This promises robust obstruction-free sensing and vision for space-constrained systems, such as mobile robots, drones, and endoscopes.
papers.journal_ref: Nature Communications 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出学习型分光谱 metalens（learned split-spectrum metalens）：把每个 RGB 通道的光谱切成通带与阻带，通带让远距离物体成像、阻带滤掉近深度遮挡物（雨滴、栅栏、灰尘）的聚焦光，再用神经网络增强输出。相对传统双曲线设计，宽带去遮挡成像 PSNR 相对提升 32.29%，目标检测 mAP 绝对提升 +13.54%，语义分割绝对提升 +48.45% IoU 与 +20.35% mIoU。
Motivation: 遮挡物使图像退化且机械擦拭不可行时，传统方案要么用笨重的复合光学阵列、要么用计算式 inpainting，牺牲紧凑性或保真度；metalens 虽紧凑，但能对远景宽带成像的 metalens 无法正确离焦近深度遮挡，宽带与去遮挡难以兼得。
Method: 学习型分光谱 metalens：对每个 RGB 通道做多带光谱滤波，划分为通带与阻带；训练 metalens 让远物光经通带聚焦、近深度遮挡的聚焦光被阻带滤除；光学信号再经神经网络增强，替代纯计算 inpainting。
Result: 相对传统双曲线 (hyperbolic) 设计：宽带去遮挡成像相对 PSNR 增益 32.29%；目标检测绝对增益 +13.54% mAP；语义分割绝对增益 +48.45% IoU 与 +20.35% mIoU。
Conclusion: 把光谱分工放进 metalens 设计本身，可在紧凑光学中同时实现宽带与去遮挡成像，适用于移动机器人、无人机、内窥镜等空间受限系统的鲁棒感知。

papers.title: SPACE-CLIP: Spatial Perception via Adaptive CLIP Embeddings for Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Robotic and autonomous systems need dense spatial cues, yet adding a dedicated depth estimator can duplicate visual processing already performed by a multimodal model. CLIP-based depth methods offer an alternative, but commonly rely on text-derived conditioning or backbone adaptation. We present SPACE-CLIP, a decoder-only framework for supervised monocular depth estimation with a frozen CLIP vision backbone and no text encoder at inference. A FiLM-conditioned semantic pathway combines global image context with multilevel patch features, while a structural pathway supplies separately processed spatial features to a hierarchical fusion decoder. Indoor and outdoor evaluations demonstrate depth reconstruction with this architecture, and controlled component comparisons support the contribution of the structural pathway. Layer-selection experiments and frequency interventions further characterize the structural pathway's contribution to depth reconstruction. A shared-backbone microbenchmark further illustrates the reduction in duplicated computation. SPACE-CLIP provides a modular approach to adding dense depth prediction to compatible visual perception stacks. Code is available at https://github.com/taewan2002/SPACE-CLIP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPACE-CLIP 是面向单目深度估计的 decoder-only 框架：冻结 CLIP 视觉主干、推理时不用文本编码器，用 FiLM 条件化的语义通路与独立处理的结构通路在分层融合解码器中结合。室内与室外评测均能重建深度，受控组件对比支持结构通路的贡献，共享主干微基准显示重复计算减少。
Motivation: 机器人与自主系统需要稠密空间线索，但外挂深度估计器会重复多模态模型已有的视觉处理；现有 CLIP 深度方法又依赖文本条件化或主干适配。
Method: 冻结 CLIP 视觉主干、去掉推理时的文本编码器，仅训练 decoder：FiLM 条件化的语义通路融合全局图像上下文与多层 patch 特征，结构通路单独处理空间特征，二者在分层融合解码器汇合；辅以层选择实验与频率干预分析结构通路贡献。
Result: 在室内与室外评测上完成深度重建，受控组件对比支持结构通路的作用；层选择实验与频率干预进一步刻画该通路对深度重建的贡献；共享主干微基准说明重复计算减少。
Conclusion: 在冻结 CLIP 主干上以双通路 decoder 即可为兼容的视觉感知栈模块化地加上稠密深度预测，无需文本编码器与主干适配。

papers.title: MTV: Revisiting Multi-Task Visual Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Current visual representation learning remains bifurcated: vision-language models (e.g., CLIP) excel at global semantic alignment but lack spatial precision, while self-supervised methods (e.g., MAE, DINO) capture intricate local structures yet struggle with high-level semantic context. We argue that these paradigms are fundamentally complementary and can be integrated into a principled multi-task framework, further enhanced by dense spatial supervision. We introduce MTV, a multi-task visual pretraining framework that jointly optimizes a shared backbone across vision-language contrastive, self-supervised, and dense spatial objectives. To mitigate the need for manual annotations, we leverage high-capacity "expert" models--such as Depth Anything V2 and OWLv2--to synthesize dense, structured pseudo-labels at scale. Beyond the framework, we provide a systematic investigation into the mechanics of multi-task visual learning, analyzing: (i) the individual and marginal gain of each objective, (ii) task synergies versus interference, and (iii) scaling behavior across varying data and model scales. Our results demonstrate that MTV achieves "best-of-both-worlds" performance, significantly enhancing fine-grained spatial reasoning without compromising global semantic understanding. Our findings suggest that multi-task learning, fueled by high-quality pseudo-supervision, is a scalable path toward more general visual encoders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MTV 把 CLIP 式视觉-语言对比、MAE/DINO 式自监督与稠密空间目标放进同一个共享 backbone 的多任务预训练框架，并用 Depth Anything V2、OWLv2 等高容量专家模型大规模合成稠密结构化伪标签替代人工标注。结果达到“两全其美”：细粒度空间推理显著增强，同时不牺牲全局语义理解。
Motivation: 视觉表征学习分裂为两条路线：CLIP 类模型语义对齐强但空间精度不足，MAE/DINO 类自监督方法局部结构好却缺高层语义，二者互补性未被系统整合。
Method: MTV 多任务视觉预训练框架在共享 backbone 上联合优化视觉-语言对比、自监督与稠密空间三类目标；用 Depth Anything V2 与 OWLv2 等专家模型合成稠密结构化伪标签以规避人工标注；并系统考察各目标的单独与边际增益、任务间协同与干扰，以及数据与模型规模上的 scaling 行为。
Result: MTV 呈现“best-of-both-worlds”表现：细粒度空间推理显著提升，且不损害全局语义理解；摘要以定性方式给出该结论，并报告了各目标的单独/边际增益、任务协同与干扰、以及数据与模型规模的 scaling 分析。
Conclusion: 以高质量伪监督驱动的多任务学习是通往更通用视觉编码器的可扩展路径，且 CLIP 与自监督两类目标可以互补整合而非取舍。

papers.title: Systematic Hazard Sampling: Minimal-Variance Inference for Discrete Diffusion and Flow Models
papers.abstract_en: Uniform-noise discrete diffusion and flow models generate sequences non-autoregressively through iterative, context-dependent token replacements. However, these models are typically formulated as time-inhomogeneous continuous- or discrete-time Markov chains (CTMC/DTMC), sampled using independent Bernoulli change decisions per discretization step. This induces Poisson-binomial variance in per-position jump counts that grows with the number of required edits, leading to the common under-editing (residual noise) and over-editing (cascading substitutions) failure modes that degrade sample quality. We identify this sampler-induced variance as an orthogonal source of degradation, distinct from model-side errors and addressable purely at inference time. We propose Systematic Hazard Sampling (SHS), a training-free, drop-in, and hyperparameter-free inference principle for any sampler that admits a stay-vs.-replace decomposition. SHS models per-token edits as events driven by cumulative hazard (CTMC) or jump mass (DTMC) and triggers an edit whenever this quantity exceeds unit-spaced thresholds with a single random phase per position. For any fixed cumulative mass, this preserves the expected jump count while achieving the minimum conditional variance possible among unbiased integer estimators (at most 1/4), without altering per-jump destination sampling. Experiments on four uniform-noise discrete diffusion and flow language models spanning ~110M to ~3B parameters show that SHS consistently improves sample quality across numbers of function evaluations (NFE). Code is available at https://github.com/Jang-seunghwan/Systematic-Hazard-Sampling.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 31 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SHS 把离散扩散/流模型的逐位置跳变次数从每步独立 Bernoulli 决策改为按累积 hazard（CTMC）或 jump mass（DTMC）超过单位间隔阈值触发、每位置只取一个随机相位，在不改变每跳目的地采样的前提下保持期望跳变次数并把无偏整数估计量的条件方差压到至多 1/4。在四个 uniform-noise 离散扩散与流语言模型（约 110M 到 3B 参数）上，SHS 在各 NFE 下一致提升样本质量。
Motivation: 均匀噪声离散扩散与流模型按时间非齐次 Markov 链逐 token 替换，每步独立 Bernoulli 决策使逐位置跳变次数呈 Poisson-binomial 方差，且随所需编辑次数增长，造成欠编辑（残余噪声）与过编辑（级联替换）两类失效，拉低样本质量。
Method: 提出 Systematic Hazard Sampling (SHS)：免训练、可直接替换、无超参数的推理原则，适用于任何可分解为 stay-vs.-replace 的采样器；把逐 token 编辑建模为累积 hazard (CTMC) 或 jump mass (DTMC) 驱动的事件，超过单位间隔阈值即触发编辑，每个位置只用一个随机相位，不改动每跳目的地采样。
Result: 对任意固定累积质量，SHS 保持期望跳变次数，并在无偏整数估计量中达到最小条件方差（至多 1/4）；在四个 uniform-noise 离散扩散与流语言模型（约 110M–3B 参数）上，SHS 在各 NFE 下一致改善样本质量。
Conclusion: 采样器自身引入的方差是独立于模型侧误差、可纯推理阶段修复的退化来源；用系统化 hazard 阈值替代逐步独立随机决策即可在不重训模型的情况下提升离散扩散与流模型的生成质量。

papers.title: An Empirical Study of On-Device Translation for Real-Time Live-Stream Chat on Mobile Devices
papers.abstract_en: Despite its efficiency, there has been little research on the practical aspects required for real-world deployment of on-device AI models, such as the device's CPU utilization and thermal conditions. In this paper, through extensive experiments, we investigate two key issues that must be addressed to deploy on-device models in real-world services: (i) the selection of on-device models and the resource consumption of each model, and (ii) the capability and potential of on-device models for domain adaptation. To this end, we focus on a task of translating live-stream chat messages and manually construct LiveChatBench, a benchmark consisting of 1,000 Korean-English parallel sentence pairs. Experiments on five mobile devices provide a systematic empirical assessment of widely adopted on-device models, highlighting the importance of model selection and deployment constraints when adapting them to specialized tasks and serving a large and heterogeneous user base. We expect that our findings will offer practical insights into both the capabilities and limitations of on-device models for real-world AI service deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对移动端实时直播聊天翻译的落地问题，人工构建韩英平行句对基准 LiveChatBench（1,000 对），在五款手机上系统实测主流端侧模型的 CPU 占用、发热状况与资源消耗，并检验其面向专用领域做适配的能力。结论是端侧部署必须把模型选择与设备资源约束一并纳入考量，才能服务大规模异构用户群。
Motivation: 端侧 AI 模型效率虽高，但面向真实服务部署的实际因素（CPU 占用、设备发热、模型间资源消耗差异、领域适配能力）几乎缺少研究，而这些正是大规模异构用户场景必须解决的问题。
Method: 人工构建 LiveChatBench：1,000 组韩语-英语平行句对，任务为翻译直播聊天消息；在五款移动设备上对多个广泛使用的端侧模型做实验，考察模型选择、资源消耗与领域适配两方面。
Result: 实验覆盖五款移动设备与多个主流端侧模型，给出各模型资源消耗的系统性实证评估；基准规模为 1,000 组韩英平行句对。
Conclusion: 端侧模型用于专用任务时，模型选择与部署约束（CPU、发热）是决定性因素；作者预期结论同时揭示端侧模型在真实 AI 服务部署中的能力与局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReFRM3D: A Radiomics-enhanced Fused Residual Multiparametric 3D Network with Multi-Scale Feature Fusion for Glioma Characterization
papers.abstract_en: Gliomas are among the most aggressive cancers, with complex diagnostic processes. Existing glioma segmentation methods often struggle with high variability in imaging data and inadequate optimization. Furthermore, radiomic analysis is typically applied only after segmentation is finished, limiting its ability to inform the segmentation process itself. To address these challenges, we propose a novel radiomics-enhanced fused residual multiparametric 3D network (ReFRM3D) for brain tumor characterization. The framework is based on a 3D U-Net architecture and features multi-scale feature fusion, hybrid upsampling, and an extended residual skip mechanism. Additionally, we introduce a radiomic conditioning mechanism that extracts texture and intensity descriptors from an intermediate coarse segmentation and re-injects them into the decoder to refine the final output. Experimental results on BraTS2019, BraTS2020, and BraTS2021 show strong performance, with mean DSC values of 93.45%, 93.61%, and 92.06%, respectively, across whole tumor, enhancing tumor, and tumor core regions. Compared with recent models, ReFRM3D improves average DSC by 5.79%, 7.25%, and 0.96% on these datasets. Our model also generalized well on the BraTS-Africa dataset with an average DSC of 87.8%, despite differences in scanner field strength and patient demographics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReFRM3D 是一个放射组学增强的融合残差多参数 3D 分割网络，基于 3D U-Net，用多尺度特征融合、混合上采样和扩展残差跳连，并把中间粗分割提取的纹理与强度描述子重新注入解码器来 refine 最终输出。在 BraTS2019/2020/2021 上全肿瘤、增强肿瘤、肿瘤核心三区平均 DSC 分别为 93.45%、93.61%、92.06%，较近期模型分别提升 5.79%、7.25%、0.96%；在扫描场强与人群不同的 BraTS-Africa 上平均 DSC 仍达 87.8%。
Motivation: 现有胶质瘤分割方法难以应对影像数据的高变异与优化不足，且放射组学分析通常在分割完成后才做，无法反过来改善分割过程本身。
Method: 以 3D U-Net 为骨干，加入多尺度特征融合、混合上采样 (hybrid upsampling) 与扩展残差跳连 (extended residual skip)；核心是放射组学条件化机制：从中间粗分割中提取纹理与强度描述子，重新注入解码器以 refine 最终输出。
Result: 在 BraTS2019、BraTS2020、BraTS2021 上，全肿瘤/增强肿瘤/肿瘤核心三区平均 DSC 分别为 93.45%、93.61%、92.06%；相比近期模型，平均 DSC 在这三个数据集上分别提升 5.79%、7.25%、0.96%。在 BraTS-Africa 上平均 DSC 为 87.8%，尽管扫描场强与患者人群存在差异。
Conclusion: 把放射组学描述子在分割过程中条件化注入解码器，可在胶质瘤分割上取得强性能，并在跨地区、跨扫描条件的 BraTS-Africa 上保持良好泛化。

summary_sections.method: 以 3D U-Net 为骨干，加入多尺度特征融合、混合上采样 (hybrid upsampling) 与扩展残差跳连 (extended residual skip)；核心是放射组学条件化机制：从中间粗分割中提取纹理与强度描述子，重新注入解码器以 refine 最终输出。
summary_sections.result: 在 BraTS2019、BraTS2020、BraTS2021 上，全肿瘤/增强肿瘤/肿瘤核心三区平均 DSC 分别为 93.45%、93.61%、92.06%；相比近期模型，平均 DSC 在这三个数据集上分别提升 5.79%、7.25%、0.96%。在 BraTS-Africa 上平均 DSC 为 87.8%，尽管扫描场强与患者人群存在差异。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把放射组学描述子在分割过程中条件化注入解码器，可在胶质瘤分割上取得强性能，并在跨地区、跨扫描条件的 BraTS-Africa 上保持良好泛化。

papers.title: MTRACE: Multilingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Temporally Diverse Text Corpora
papers.abstract_en: Large multilingual knowledge bases expose temporally diverse information, yet retrieval quality remains sensitive to lexical variation and cross-lingual terminology shifts. We develop and evaluate MTRACE (Multilingual Temporal Retrieval-Augmented Generation with evidence grounding), a pipeline designed to test whether query expansion and multi-query fusion mitigate vocabulary mismatch in temporally layered text corpora, on the French and English subsets of MIRACL. Our approach integrates: (i) semantic query expansion (SQE) and multi-query fusion via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), targeting retrieval stability under query variation; (ii) a generation prompt enforcing strict grounding in retrieved evidence and explicit abstention when evidence is insufficient; and (iii) a modular architecture enabling systematic component evaluation. Ablation studies on Named Entity Recognition (NER) and embedding model selection demonstrate the importance of syntactic coherence in entity extraction and of self-retrieval and efficiency measurements for retriever selection. Our end-to-end evaluation over 50 constructed queries shows faithful answers for well-supported queries, correct abstention on unanswerable questions, and no re-scored similarity gains from multi-query fusion over single-query dense retrieval. By scoping our claims to a clean, text-only baseline, we separate these effects from OCR-noise confounds; direct measurement of diachronic lexical drift is left to future work. Code and configurations are available at \url{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MIRAGE-8EAA/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MTRACE 是面向法英双语、时间分层文本的检索增强生成管线，用语义查询扩展 (SQE) 与 Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) 多查询融合来缓解词汇错配，并强制生成端只依据检索证据作答、证据不足时显式弃答。在 MIRACL 法英子集上 50 条构造查询的端到端评测中，证据充分的查询回答忠实、不可答问题正确弃答，而多查询融合相对单查询稠密检索没有带来重评分相似度增益。
Motivation: 多语言知识库中检索质量对词汇变体和跨语言术语漂移敏感，时间分层语料里同一概念的表述随年代变化，词汇错配会直接拉低检索稳定性。
Method: 管线含三部分：语义查询扩展 (SQE) 加 RRF 多查询融合以稳定不同查询变体下的检索；生成提示强制严格依据检索证据并显式弃答；模块化架构支持逐组件评测。另做 NER 与 embedding 模型选择的消融，考察实体抽取的句法一致性以及检索器的自检索与效率测量。
Result: 在 MIRACL 法语与英语子集上端到端评测 50 条构造查询：证据充分的查询给出忠实回答，不可答问题正确弃答；多查询融合相对单查询稠密检索没有重评分相似度增益。消融显示 NER 的句法一致性与检索器选择中的自检索、效率测量都很重要。
Conclusion: 在干净的纯文本基线下，查询扩展与多查询融合能稳定检索并支持可靠弃答，但多查询融合本身不带来相似度提升；作者把结论限定在该基线，时序词汇漂移的直接测量留待后续工作。

papers.title: Mixed Data Clustering Survey and Challenges
papers.abstract_en: The advent of the big data paradigm has transformed how industries manage and analyze information, ushering in an era of unprecedented data volume, velocity, and variety. Within this landscape, mixed-data clustering has become a critical challenge, requiring innovative methods that can effectively exploit heterogeneous data types, including numerical and categorical variables. Traditional clustering techniques, typically designed for homogeneous datasets, often struggle to capture the additional complexity introduced by mixed data, underscoring the need for approaches specifically tailored to this setting. Hierarchical and explainable algorithms are particularly valuable in this context, as they provide structured, interpretable clustering results that support informed decision-making. This paper introduces a clustering method grounded in pretopological spaces. In addition, benchmarking against classical numerical clustering algorithms and existing pretopological approaches yields insights into the performance and effectiveness of the proposed method within the big data paradigm.
papers.journal_ref: (2025). Mixed Data Clustering Survey and Challenges. SN Computer Science, 6(8), 939
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种基于 pretopological space（预拓扑空间）的混合数据聚类方法，用于同时处理数值型与类别型变量，并与经典数值聚类算法及已有预拓扑方法做 benchmarking，以说明其在大数据场景下的性能与有效性。
Motivation: 传统聚类算法面向同质数据设计，难以处理数值与类别混合的异构数据所带来的额外复杂度，而混合数据聚类又是大数据分析中的关键难题。
Method: 提出基于 pretopological spaces 的聚类方法，强调层次化与可解释的聚类结构；并与经典数值聚类算法、已有预拓扑方法进行 benchmarking 对比。
Result: 摘要以 benchmarking 形式给出与经典数值聚类算法及既有预拓扑方法的性能与有效性对比结论，未列出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 预拓扑空间可作为混合数据聚类的建模基础，层次化与可解释的算法在大数据场景下支持更有依据的决策。

papers.title: Two Americas of Well-Being: Divergent Rural-Urban Patterns of Life Satisfaction and Happiness from 2.6 B Social Media Posts
papers.abstract_en: Using 2.6 billion geolocated social-media posts (2014-2022) and a fine-tuned generative language model, we construct county-level indicators of life satisfaction and happiness for the United States. We document an apparent rural-urban paradox: rural counties express higher life satisfaction while urban counties exhibit greater happiness. We reconcile this by treating the two as distinct layers of subjective well-being, evaluative vs. hedonic, showing that each maps differently onto place, politics, and time. Republican-leaning areas appear more satisfied in evaluative terms, but partisan gaps in happiness largely flatten outside major metros, indicating context-dependent political effects. Temporal shocks dominate the hedonic layer: happiness falls sharply during 2020-2022, whereas life satisfaction moves more modestly. These patterns are robust across logistic and OLS specifications and align with well-being theory. Interpreted as associations for the population of social-media posts, the results show that large-scale, language-based indicators can resolve conflicting findings about the rural-urban divide by distinguishing the type of well-being expressed, offering a transparent, reproducible complement to traditional surveys.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 26 亿条带地理定位的美国社交媒体帖子（2014–2022）微调生成式语言模型，构造县级生活满意度与幸福感指标，发现农村县生活满意度更高、城市县幸福感更高。把两者拆成评价性 (evaluative) 与享乐性 (hedonic) 两层后，党派差距在幸福感上于大城市之外基本消失，而 2020–2022 年幸福感骤降、生活满意度变化温和。
Motivation: 农村—城市幸福感研究结论互相冲突，传统调查在县级尺度上样本稀疏、成本高，难以区分生活满意度与幸福感这两种不同的主观福祉。
Method: 对 26 亿条 2014–2022 年带地理定位的社交媒体帖子微调生成式语言模型，聚合出美国县级生活满意度与幸福感指标；用 logistic 与 OLS 两种设定检验稳健性，并按地点、政治倾向与时间分解。
Result: 农村县生活满意度更高、城市县幸福感更高；共和党倾向地区在评价性层面更满意，但幸福感的党派差距在大城市之外基本抹平；幸福感在 2020–2022 年明显下降，生活满意度变动较小；上述模式在 logistic 与 OLS 设定下均稳健。
Conclusion: 把福祉拆成评价性与享乐性两层即可调和农村—城市分歧的既有矛盾结论，大规模语言指标可作为传统调查的透明、可复现补充，但结果应按社交媒体帖子总体的关联来解读。

papers.title: Bi-objective chance-constrained evolutionary optimization for large-scale open-pit mine scheduling under geological uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: The open-pit mine scheduling problem (OPMSP) is a complex optimization problem in long-term mine planning that involves numerous operational and geological constraints. Traditional deterministic approaches often ignore geological uncertainty, leading to suboptimal or unreliable production schedules. Chance constraints provide a framework for handling uncertainty by ensuring that probabilistic constraints are satisfied with a predefined confidence level. In this paper, we consider the OPMSP under geological grade uncertainty and propose a bi-objective chance-constrained formulation that simultaneously maximizes the expected discounted net present value and minimizes scheduling risk. Unlike traditional chance-constrained approaches, the proposed formulation does not require a predefined confidence level during optimization. Instead, it generates a set of Pareto-optimal solutions representing different trade-offs between profitability and risk within a single optimization run. To solve the resulting large-scale stochastic optimization problem, we employ multi-objective evolutionary algorithms and compare their performance against a single-objective chance-constrained evolutionary approach and a deterministic MILP benchmark. We further evaluate the contribution of the problem-specific initialization and mutation components through an ablation study. Experimental results on MineLib benchmark instances containing up to 112 687 blocks demonstrate that the proposed formulation effectively captures the trade-off between profitability and risk under geological uncertainty while providing greater flexibility than confidence-level-dependent approaches.
papers.comment: This version is accepted in Swarm and Evolutionary Computation, Elsevier
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 露天矿长期开采计划在矿体品位不确定性下被改写为双目标机会约束模型：一次优化同时最大化期望折现净现值 (NPV) 并最小化调度风险，无需预先设定置信水平，直接产出利润—风险权衡的 Pareto 解集。在 MineLib 最大规模 112,687 个块的算例上，该形式比依赖置信度的机会约束方法更灵活。
Motivation: 传统确定性 OPMSP 忽略地质不确定性，产出的生产计划次优或不可靠；既有机会约束方法又要求优化前先定置信水平，无法在一次运行中呈现利润与风险的权衡。
Method: 建立双目标机会约束 OPMSP 公式，用多目标进化算法求解大规模随机问题，并与单目标机会约束进化方法及确定性 MILP 基准对比；另用消融实验检验问题特定的初始化与变异算子的贡献。
Result: 在含最多 112,687 个块的 MineLib 基准算例上，所提公式在地质品位不确定性下有效刻画利润与风险的权衡，且相比依赖置信度的方法提供更大灵活性；对比对象为单目标机会约束进化方法与确定性 MILP，并做了初始化/变异组件的消融。
Conclusion: 把调度风险与期望 NPV 并列为两个目标、免去预设置信水平，可在单次优化中给出利润—风险的 Pareto 解集，作为确定性计划和固定置信度机会约束方案的替代。

papers.title: Scalable Decision Making for Games of Imperfect Information
papers.abstract_en: Real-world decision-making generally involves hidden information, that is, information that is unknown to one agent but possessed by another. Unfortunately, the presence of large amounts of hidden information renders established reinforcement learning and search approaches ineffective. Even with multimillion-dollar industrial research efforts, top-human-level play at Stratego---a board wargame with hidden information on a massive scale---has remained beyond the reach of artificial intelligence (AI). Here we introduce Ataraxos, an AI for Stratego based on general techniques that we developed for both self-play reinforcement learning and test-time search under hidden information. Ataraxos defeated the most decorated human Stratego player of all time by a large margin---achieving, to our knowledge, the first superhuman result in the game's history---while consuming orders of magnitude less compute and data than previous efforts. Using the same techniques, we built a superhuman AI for Barrage Stratego and state-of-the-art AIs for Hanabi and dou dizhu, all with low cost and high sample efficiency. The success of this approach across adversarial, cooperative and team games establishes a design pattern for reinforcement learning and search that is effective under large amounts of hidden information, a longstanding desideratum of the field of strategic decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Ataraxos：面向大规模隐藏信息博弈的自博弈强化学习与测试时搜索通用技术，在 Stratego 上以比以往工作少数个数量级的算力和数据取得超人类结果，大幅击败史上战绩最佳的人类 Stratego 选手。同一套技术还做出超人类 Barrage Stratego AI 以及 Hanabi、dou dizhu 的最先进 AI，覆盖对抗、合作与团队博弈。
Motivation: 大量隐藏信息使既有强化学习与搜索方法失效，尽管有数百万美元级工业投入，Stratego 顶级人类水平仍长期未被 AI 突破。
Method: 为隐藏信息下的自博弈强化学习与测试时搜索开发通用技术，并据此构建 Stratego AI Ataraxos；同一技术栈复用到 Barrage Stratego、Hanabi 与 dou dizhu。
Result: Ataraxos 以大幅优势击败史上战绩最佳的人类 Stratego 选手，为该博弈已知的首个超人类结果，且消耗的算力与数据比以往努力少数个数量级；同套技术得到超人类 Barrage Stratego AI 与 Hanabi、dou dizhu 的最先进 AI，均低成本、高样本效率。
Conclusion: 一套针对大量隐藏信息设计的强化学习与搜索设计模式可跨对抗、合作与团队博弈奏效，是战略决策领域长期追求的目标。

papers.title: EndoWave: 4D Gaussian Splatting with Rational Wavelet for Endoscopic Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: In robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery, accurate 3D reconstruction from endoscopic video is vital for downstream tasks and improved outcomes. However, endoscopic scenarios present unique challenges, including photometric inconsistencies, non-rigid tissue motion, and view-dependent highlights. Most 3DGS-based methods that rely solely on appearance constraints for optimizing 3DGS are often insufficient in this context, as these dynamic visual artifacts can mislead the optimization process and lead to inaccurate reconstructions. To address these limitations, we present EndoWave, a unified spatio-temporal Gaussian Splatting framework by incorporating an optical flow-based geometric constraint and a multi-resolution rational wavelet supervision. First, we adopt a unified spatio-temporal Gaussian representation that directly optimizes primitives in a 4D domain. Second, we propose a geometric constraint derived from optical flow to enhance temporal coherence and effectively constrain the 3D structure of the scene. Third, we propose a multi-resolution rational orthogonal wavelet as a constraint, which can effectively separate the details of the endoscope and enhance the rendering performance. Extensive evaluations on two real surgical datasets, EndoNeRF and StereoMIS, demonstrate that our method EndoWave achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction quality and visual accuracy compared to the baseline method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EndoWave 把内窥镜动态场景重建写成 4D Gaussian Splatting，用光流几何约束约束时序一致的三维结构，再用多分辨率 rational orthogonal wavelet 监督分离内镜细节。在 EndoNeRF 与 StereoMIS 两个真实手术数据集上，相对基线达到 SOTA 重建质量与视觉精度。
Motivation: 机器人辅助微创手术中内窥镜视频的 3D 重建受光度不一致、非刚性组织运动与视角相关高光干扰，仅靠外观约束优化 3DGS 会被这些动态伪影带偏，导致重建不准。
Method: 统一时空 Gaussian 表示直接在 4D 域优化 primitives；引入由 optical flow 导出的几何约束增强时序相干并约束场景三维结构；再加多分辨率 rational orthogonal wavelet 作为监督约束，分离内镜细节以提升渲染。
Result: 在两个真实手术数据集 EndoNeRF 和 StereoMIS 上的大量评测中，EndoWave 相对基线方法取得 SOTA 重建质量与视觉精度（摘要未列出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 仅靠外观约束不足以应对内镜动态伪影，几何与小波双重约束的 4D Gaussian Splatting 能在真实手术数据上取得更好的重建质量。

papers.title: A Model Can Help Itself: Reward-Free Self-Training for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Can a language model improve reasoning by learning from its own imperfect responses, without rewards or teacher-provided solutions? We present Self-evolving Post-Training (SePT), a simple method that alternates temperature-controlled self-generation with next-token likelihood training. Each round uses the updated model to generate new training responses, with one response per prompt by default and no correctness filtering. Across six mathematical benchmarks, SePT improves a temperature-selected no-training baseline by 11.4 and 6.7 AVG points on Qwen2.5-Math-7B and Qwen2.5-7B, respectively, where AVG averages Pass@1, Pass@8 and Pass@32 across benchmarks. We analyze how sampling temperature shapes the learning signal and investigate the value of the resulting responses. Responses from a SePT-trained model improve a student initialized from the original weights, while their reasoning prefixes help an unchanged model complete solutions, even when matched in length to prefixes from a colder initial model. Comparing next-token predictions at identical contexts also reveals changes in token rankings that decoding-temperature adjustment cannot reproduce. Further evaluations across nine starting models, general reasoning and code generation examine broader applicability. Together, these results show that reward-free self-training can improve both a model's predictions and the supervision it provides. Our code is available at https://github.com/ElementQi/SePT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SePT 让模型在无奖励、无教师解的条件下自我提升：交替做温度受控的自生成与 next-token 似然训练，每轮用更新后的模型为每个 prompt 生成一条响应且不做正确性过滤。在六个数学基准上，相对温度选择的无训练基线，Qwen2.5-Math-7B 的 AVG（Pass@1/8/32 平均）提高 11.4 分，Qwen2.5-7B 提高 6.7 分。
Motivation: LLM 推理自我改进通常依赖奖励模型或教师提供的正确解，而这两者在许多场景中昂贵或不可得；问题是从自身不完美响应中能否提取出有效的学习信号。
Method: Self-evolving Post-Training (SePT)：交替进行温度受控的自生成与 next-token 似然训练，每轮用当前模型为每个 prompt 生成一条响应、不做正确性过滤；并分析采样温度如何塑造学习信号，比较相同上下文下的 next-token 预测变化。
Result: 六个数学基准上，SePT 相对温度选择的无训练基线 AVG 提升 11.4 分（Qwen2.5-Math-7B）与 6.7 分（Qwen2.5-7B），AVG 为 Pass@1、Pass@8、Pass@32 的平均。SePT 训练模型的响应能改善从原始权重初始化的学生，其推理前缀能帮助未改动的模型完成解答，且在与更冷初始模型的前缀等长时仍然成立；相同上下文下的 next-token 预测出现解码温度调整无法复现的 token 排序变化。另在九个起始模型、通用推理与代码生成上做了进一步评估。
Conclusion: 无奖励的自训练可以同时改善模型的预测与其提供的监督，使模型在没有外部正确性信号时仍能自我提升。

papers.title: Multi-Marginal Schrödinger Bridge Matching
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the continuous evolution of populations from discrete temporal snapshots is a critical research challenge, particularly in fields like developmental biology and systems medicine where longitudinal tracking of individual entities is often impossible. Such trajectory inference is vital for unraveling the mechanisms of dynamic processes. While Schrödinger Bridge (SB) offer a potent framework, their traditional application to pairwise time points can be insufficient for systems defined by multiple intermediate snapshots. This paper introduces Multi-Marginal Schrödinger Bridge Matching (MSBM), a novel algorithm specifically designed for the multi-marginal SB problem. MSBM extends iterative Markovian fitting (IMF) to effectively handle multiple marginal constraints. This technique ensures robust enforcement of all intermediate marginals while preserving the continuity of the learned global dynamics across the entire trajectory. Empirical validations on synthetic data and real-world single-cell RNA sequencing datasets demonstrate the competitive or superior performance of MSBM in capturing complex trajectories and respecting intermediate distributions, all with notable computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Multi-Marginal Schrödinger Bridge Matching (MSBM)，把迭代 Markovian fitting (IMF) 扩展到多边缘约束的 Schrödinger Bridge，同时强制所有中间时刻的边缘分布并保持全局动力学连续。在合成数据与真实单细胞 RNA 测序数据上，MSBM 在捕捉复杂轨迹与尊重中间分布方面达到竞争性或更优表现，且计算效率突出。
Motivation: 从离散时间快照推断连续轨迹时，传统 Schrödinger Bridge 只作用于成对时间点，对含多个中间快照的系统约束不足，难以同时贴合所有中间边缘分布。
Method: MSBM 针对多边缘 SB 问题设计，将迭代 Markovian fitting (IMF) 扩展为可处理多个边缘约束的算法，在逐段 Markov 拟合中稳健施加全部中间边缘，同时保持整条轨迹上学到的全局动力学连续性。
Result: 在合成数据与真实单细胞 RNA 测序数据集上的实证验证显示，MSBM 在捕捉复杂轨迹、尊重中间分布方面具有竞争性或更优的性能，并具备显著的计算效率。
Conclusion: 多边缘约束的 IMF 扩展可以在不牺牲全局动力学连续性的前提下同时满足多个中间分布，使多快照轨迹推断在精度与计算开销上都可行。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: Demystifying Hybrid Thinking: Can LLMs Truly Switch Between Think and No-Think?
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid thinking enables LLMs to switch between reasoning and direct answering, offering a balance between efficiency and reasoning capability. Yet our experiments reveal that current hybrid thinking LLMs only achieve partial mode separation: reasoning behaviors often leak into the no-think mode. To understand and mitigate this, we analyze the factors influencing controllability and identify four that matter most: (1) larger data scale, (2) using think and no-think answers from different questions rather than the same question, (3) a moderate increase in no-think data number, and (4) a two-phase strategy that first trains reasoning ability and then applies hybrid think training. Building on these findings, we propose a practical recipe that, compared to standard training, can maintain accuracy in both modes while significantly reducing no-think output length (from 1085 to 585 on MATH500) and occurrences of reasoning-supportive tokens such as "wait" (from 5917 to 522 on MATH500). Our findings highlight the limitations of current hybrid thinking and offer directions for strengthening its controllability. The code is available at: https://github.com/SR-A-W/demystifying-hybrid-thinking
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 混合思考 (hybrid thinking) LLM 的 think/no-think 模式切换并不干净，推理行为会泄漏进 no-think 模式。作者定位出四个最影响可控性的因素（更大数据规模、think 与 no-think 答案取自不同问题、适度增加 no-think 数据量、先训推理再训混合思考的两阶段策略），据此给出训练配方：在 MATH500 上保持两模式准确率的同时，把 no-think 输出长度从 1085 压到 585，"wait" 等推理支持 token 出现次数从 5917 降到 522。
Motivation: 混合思考本意是在推理能力与直接作答的效率之间取得平衡，但当前模型只做到部分模式分离，no-think 模式里仍残留推理行为，使效率收益打折且可控性不足。
Method: 先通过实验分析可控性的影响因素，筛出四个关键项：数据规模、think/no-think 答案是否来自同一问题、no-think 数据量的适度增加、以及先训练推理能力再做混合思考训练的两阶段策略；再据此组装一套实用训练配方并与标准训练对比。
Result: 在 MATH500 上，该配方相对标准训练在两种模式下均保持准确率，同时 no-think 输出长度从 1085 降到 585，推理支持性 token（如 "wait"）出现次数从 5917 降到 522。
Conclusion: 当前混合思考的可控性受限于数据组织与训练顺序，按两阶段加数据配比的配方可在不牺牲两模式准确率的前提下显著压缩 no-think 输出。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: RFG: Self-Improving Diffusion Large Language Models with Reward-Free Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have shown strong reasoning capabilities, yet further improving them typically requires costly post-training with additional data and supervision. We ask whether a post-trained dLLM can improve itself at inference time without additional training, data, or reward models. This requires a guidance signal from the checkpoints alone that is well-defined on the partially masked intermediate states of dLLMs, which existing methods fail to provide. Here we propose Reward-Free Guidance (RFG), a training-free framework for inference-time self-improvement of dLLMs that derives such a signal from the checkpoints themselves. We theoretically demonstrate that a reward signal for a partially masked state can be parameterized by the log-likelihood ratio between a post-trained policy dLLM and its reference model. In practice, this signal can be obtained using off-the-shelf checkpoints alone. Extensive experiments show that RFG consistently improves state-of-the-art post-trained dLLMs by up to 16.1%. Furthermore, despite being entirely training-free, RFG delivers gains that rival or even surpass resource-intensive reinforcement learning techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RFG 提出免训练的推理时自改进框架 Reward-Free Guidance，从后训练 dLLM 与其参考模型的 checkpoint 本身导出可用于部分掩码中间态的引导信号，即两者的 log-likelihood ratio。实验显示 RFG 在 SOTA 后训练 dLLM 上最高提升 16.1%，其收益可匹敌甚至超过资源密集的强化学习方法。
Motivation: 后训练 diffusion LLM 提升推理能力需要昂贵的额外数据与监督；现有方法无法为 dLLM 的部分掩码中间态定义有效的引导信号。
Method: RFG 是 training-free 的推理时框架：理论上把部分掩码状态的 reward 参数化为后训练策略 dLLM 与参考模型之间的 log-likelihood ratio，实践中仅用现成 checkpoint 即可得到该信号，无需额外训练、数据或 reward model。
Result: 在 SOTA 后训练 dLLM 上 RFG 一致提升，最高达 16.1%；完全免训练的情况下，其收益匹敌甚至超过强化学习类后训练技术。
Conclusion: dLLM 的后训练 checkpoint 本身携带可用于推理时自改进的 reward 信号，因此不加训练与奖励模型也能逼近 RL 后训练的效果。

papers.title: COCORELI: Enforcing Execution Preconditions for Reliable Collaborative Instruction Following
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents executing human instructions must operate reliably even when instructions are incomplete. While recent approaches improve detection of missing information, detection alone is insufficient: agents often proceed to execution even after recognizing underspecification, leading to incorrect or unsafe actions. We identify this failure as arising from a lack of coupling between detection and execution, and propose that reliable behavior requires enforcing missing information as a precondition for action. We instantiate this principle in Cocoreli, a modular architecture that represents task structure, tracks missing information, and blocks execution until required details are resolved through targeted clarification. In Cocoreli, detection and prevention are structurally coupled: detecting a missing parameter simultaneously blocks execution. We evaluate Cocoreli in a controlled construction environment isolating underspecification and sequential execution. Cocoreli blocks execution under unresolved specifications by construction, eliminating hallucinated actions. In contrast, chain-of-thought, prompt-chaining, and ReAct-style reasoning may still execute under incomplete specifications despite high detection rates. The same representation supports abstraction and reuse, and generalizes to API workflow tasks on ToolBench. These results show that reliable collaborative execution requires architectural enforcement, not just model capability
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CocoreLI 把「检测到缺失信息」与「阻止执行」在架构上耦合：用模块化表示记录任务结构与缺失参数，未解析前直接阻断动作，从而按构造消除幻觉执行。在隔离欠规范与顺序执行的受控构建环境中，chain-of-thought、prompt-chaining、ReAct 即使检测率高仍会在规格不全时执行，而 CocoreLI 不会；同一表示可泛化到 ToolBench 的 API 工作流任务。
Motivation: 自主 agent 执行人类指令时经常面对不完整指令；现有方法只改进缺失信息的检测，但检测与执行之间缺少耦合，agent 识别出欠规范后仍继续执行，产生错误或不安全的动作。
Method: CocoreLI 是模块化架构：表示任务结构、跟踪缺失信息，并把「检测到缺失参数」与「阻断执行」绑定为同一操作，缺失细节必须通过定向澄清 (targeted clarification) 解决后才放行；在受控构建环境中评估，该环境隔离欠规范与顺序执行两个因素。
Result: CocoreLI 按构造在规格未解析时阻断执行，消除幻觉动作；对照的 chain-of-thought、prompt-chaining、ReAct 式推理即使检测率高，仍在规格不全时执行；同一表示支持抽象与复用，并泛化到 ToolBench 的 API 工作流任务。
Conclusion: 可靠的协作执行需要架构层面的强制约束（把缺失信息作为动作前置条件），而不只是提升模型自身的检测能力。

papers.title: ZeST: an VLM-based Zero-Shot Traversability Navigation for Unknown Environments
papers.abstract_en: The advancement of robotics and autonomous navigation systems hinges on the ability to accurately predict terrain traversability. Traditional methods for generating datasets to train these prediction models often involve putting robots into potentially hazardous environments, posing risks to equipment and safety. To solve this problem, we present ZeST, a novel approach that treats repeated VLM outputs as stochastic measurements and fuses them into an uncertainty-aware posterior. Our approach not only performs zero-shot traversability and mitigates the risks associated with real-world data collection but also accelerates the development of advanced navigation systems, offering a cost-effective and scalable solution. To support our findings, we present navigation results, in both controlled indoor and unstructured outdoor environments. As shown in the experiments, ZeST provides safer navigation with 90-100% success rate with up to 4s inference delays when compared to other state-of-the-art methods, constantly reaching the final goal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZeST 把 VLM 对同一场景的重复输出当作随机观测，融合成带不确定性的后验，用于零样本地形可通行性判断与导航。在受控室内与非结构化室外环境中，成功率 90–100%，推理延迟最高 4 秒，相比其他先进方法能持续到达终点。
Motivation: 可通行性预测模型的训练数据通常要让机器人进入危险环境采集，带来设备与人员安全风险，拖慢导航系统开发。
Method: ZeST 将重复的 VLM 输出视为随机测量，融合为不确定性感知后验 (uncertainty-aware posterior)，据此做零样本可通行性判断并驱动导航，无需真实危险环境数据采集。
Result: 在受控室内与非结构化室外两类环境中给出导航结果：成功率 90–100%，推理延迟最高 4 秒，相比其他 state-of-the-art 方法能持续到达最终目标。
Conclusion: 把 VLM 输出当作可融合的随机测量，可以在不采集危险环境数据的前提下实现更安全的零样本导航，并降低导航系统开发成本。

papers.title: Learning Interpretable Differentiable Logic Networks for Time-Series Classification
papers.abstract_en: Differentiable logic networks (DLNs) have shown promising results in tabular domains by combining accuracy, interpretability, and computational efficiency. In this work, we apply DLNs to the domain of TSC for the first time, focusing on univariate datasets. To enable DLN application in this context, we adopt feature-based representations relying on Catch22 and TSFresh, converting sequential time series into vectorized forms suitable for DLN classification. Unlike prior DLN studies that fix the training configuration and vary various settings in isolation via ablation, we integrate all such configurations into the hyperparameter search space, enabling the search process to select jointly optimal settings. We then analyze the distribution of selected configurations to better understand DLN training dynamics. We evaluate our approach on 51 publicly available univariate TSC benchmarks. The results confirm that classification DLNs maintain their core strengths in this new domain: they deliver competitive accuracy, retain low inference cost, and provide transparent, interpretable decision logic, thus aligning well with previous DLN findings in the realm of tabular classification and regression tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首次把可微逻辑网络 (DLN) 用于单变量时间序列分类 (TSC)，用 Catch22 与 TSFresh 特征把序列转成向量，并把原先靠消融逐项固定的训练配置全部并入超参搜索空间联合寻优。在 51 个公开单变量 TSC 基准上，分类 DLN 保持了竞争力的准确率、低推理开销与可解释的决策逻辑。
Motivation: DLN 此前只在表格域验证过，固定训练配置、逐项消融的做法无法给出联合最优设置，时间序列分类上缺少可解释且推理便宜的逻辑模型。
Method: 采用基于特征的表示（Catch22 与 TSFresh）把单变量序列向量化后送入 DLN 分类；把以往消融中逐个变动的训练配置统一并入超参搜索空间联合寻优，再分析被选中配置的分布以理解 DLN 训练动态。
Result: 在 51 个公开单变量 TSC 基准上评估：分类 DLN 取得有竞争力的准确率，同时保持低推理成本与透明可解释的决策逻辑，与 DLN 在表格分类/回归上的既有结论一致。
Conclusion: DLN 的准确率、效率与可解释性优势可迁移到时间序列分类，前提是先用 Catch22/TSFresh 特征化并做联合超参搜索。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: FedUHD: Unsupervised Federated Learning using In-Memory Hyperdimensional Computing
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised federated learning (UFL) enables privacy-preserving distributed training without data labeling, yet practical deployment remains challenging due to non-IID data, high computational and communication costs at edge devices, and sensitivity to communication noise. We propose FedUHD, the first UFL framework based on Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC). On the client side, FedUHD employs kNN-based cluster hypervector removal to mitigate non-IID effects by filtering detrimental local outliers. On the server side, cluster-aware HDC aggregation leverages cluster-level statistics to stabilize learning across heterogeneous clients. To further improve efficiency, we design a compute-in-memory (CIM) accelerator based on a novel phase-change memory (PCM) device, integrated with lightweight ASIC digital modules to execute the client-side HDC pipeline within the accelerator. The intrinsic robustness of HDC to low precision and device variations enables efficient mapping onto analog PCM crossbars, exploiting massive parallelism while minimizing data movement. Experimental results show that FedUHD achieves comparable accuracy to state-of-the-art neural network-based UFL methods across all datasets. On HAR and CIFAR10/100, FedUHD delivers an average 2,239x speedup and 1,542x higher energy efficiency on GPU. In addition, FedUHD reduces communication cost by up to 176x on HAR and CIFAR10/100 and demonstrates greater robustness than Orchestra under communication noise. Compared to GPU implementation of FedUHD, the proposed PCM-based accelerator provides an additional 4.07x speedup and three orders of magnitude higher energy efficiency on average. Furthermore, the results demonstrate the benefit of PCM over RRAM as a CIM substrate.
papers.comment: Published in IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Artificial Intelligence (TCAS-AI)
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Artificial Intelligence, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedUHD 是首个基于超维计算 (HDC) 的无监督联邦学习框架：客户端用 kNN 聚类超向量剔除有害局部离群点缓解 non-IID，服务器端做聚类感知聚合，并把客户端 HDC 流水线映射到新型 PCM 相变存储 CIM 加速器。在 HAR 与 CIFAR10/100 上达到与神经网络 UFL 相当的精度，GPU 上平均提速 2,239 倍、能效高 1,542 倍，通信成本最多降 176 倍，PCM 加速器再提速 4.07 倍。
Motivation: 无监督联邦学习受 non-IID 数据、边缘设备算力与通信开销、以及通信噪声敏感三重制约，现有方案依赖神经网络，难以在边缘高效部署。
Method: 客户端用 kNN-based cluster hypervector removal 过滤有害局部离群点；服务器端用 cluster-aware HDC aggregation 聚合聚类级统计量；再设计基于新型 PCM 器件的 compute-in-memory 加速器，配合轻量 ASIC 数字模块在片上执行客户端 HDC 流水线，利用 HDC 对低精度与器件偏差的固有鲁棒性映射到模拟 PCM crossbar。
Result: 在全部数据集上精度与 SOTA 神经网络 UFL 方法相当；在 HAR 和 CIFAR10/100 上 GPU 实现平均 2,239 倍加速、1,542 倍能效提升，通信成本最多降低 176 倍，通信噪声下比 Orchestra 更鲁棒；相比 GPU 版 FedUHD，PCM 加速器额外提速 4.07 倍、平均能效高三个数量级，且 PCM 优于 RRAM 作为 CIM 基底。
Conclusion: HDC 的低精度鲁棒性使其可直接映射到模拟 PCM crossbar，从而在保持与神经网络 UFL 相当精度的同时，把无监督联邦学习的算力、能耗与通信开销压到边缘可部署的量级。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AdaptInfer: Adaptive Token Pruning for Vision-Language Model Inference via Dynamical Text Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved impressive performance on multimodal inference tasks, but the cost remains a significant challenge due to the large number of vision tokens processed during the prefill stage. Existing token pruning methods often rely on utilizing the static attention patterns directly, failing to exploit the dynamic internal signals within VLMs. To address the issue, we propose AdaptInfer, a novel plug-and-play framework for vision token pruning. First, we introduce a dynamic text-guided pruning mechanism that construct soft priors over text-token importance on each pruning layer, allowing more informed scoring of vision tokens at each stage. Second, we observe a highly consistent distribution of cross-modal attention shifts by architecture, which inspires us to introduce a efficient data-driven schedule which determines the pruning locations automatically. Experimental results have verified the effectiveness and generalization of the proposed method. Under the same token budget, AdaptInfer surpasses existing approaches in accuracy. For instance, AdaptInfer maintains averagely 99.4% accuracy on Qwen2-VL while 70% of the prefilling vision token overhead is reduced. The source code is available on: https://github.com/weiczh02/AdaptInfer-base.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaptInfer 是即插即用的视觉 token 剪枝框架：用动态文本引导机制在每个剪枝层对文本 token 重要性构造软先验，再依据架构间高度一致的跨模态注意力偏移分布，用数据驱动调度自动决定剪枝位置。在相同 token 预算下精度超过现有方法，Qwen2-VL 上平均保持 99.4% 准确率，同时削减 70% 的 prefill 阶段视觉 token 开销。
Motivation: VLM 多模态推理中 prefill 阶段视觉 token 数量过大导致推理成本高；现有剪枝方法直接依赖静态注意力模式，未能利用模型内部的动态信号。
Method: 两部分：动态文本引导剪枝机制在每个剪枝层对文本 token 重要性构造软先验，据此对视觉 token 打分；再利用按架构高度一致的跨模态注意力偏移分布，训练一个数据驱动调度自动确定剪枝位置。框架为 plug-and-play 设计。
Result: 在相同 token 预算下精度超过现有剪枝方法；Qwen2-VL 上平均保持 99.4% 准确率，同时减少 70% 的 prefill 视觉 token 开销；作者称方法经实验验证有效且具泛化性。
Conclusion: 用动态文本信号而非静态注意力模式指导视觉 token 剪枝，配合架构一致的注意力偏移调度，可在大幅削减 prefill 开销的同时保住精度。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Resource-Limited Joint Multimodal Sentiment Reasoning and Classification via Chain-of-Thought Enhancement and Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Current approaches for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) primarily leverage the knowledge and reasoning capabilities of parameter-heavy (Multimodal) LLMs for classification, overlooking autonomous multimodal sentiment reasoning generation in resource-constrained environments. In this paper, we focus on the Resource-Limited Joint Multimodal Sentiment Reasoning and Classification task, JMSRC, which simultaneously performs multimodal sentiment reasoning chain generation and sentiment classification only with a lightweight model. We propose a Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Distillation model, MulCoT-RD, designed for JMSRC that employs a "Teacher-Assistant-Student" distillation paradigm to address deployment constraints in resource-limited environments. We first leverage a high-performance Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to generate the initial reasoning dataset and train a medium-sized assistant model with a multi-task learning mechanism. A lightweight student model is jointly trained to perform efficient multimodal sentiment reasoning generation and classification. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that MulCoT-RD, with only 3B parameters, achieves strong performance on JMSRC while exhibiting robust generalization and enhanced interpretability.
