papers.title: Learning Task and Motion Plans from Real Demonstrations with Hybrid Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon mobile manipulation requires a task plan and the motion that executes it. Generative planners trained on demonstration produce both in one pass, requiring neither a symbolic domain nor search. To date, however, they have relied on thousands of scripted demonstrations of fixed-base arms and executed open loop. This paper presents a hybrid flow matching planner: a single network generates the symbolic plan with masked discrete flow matching and the motion trajectory with continuous flow matching. Unlike prior generative planners, we aim to learn from a much smaller set of demonstrations and to execute the plan in closed loop. Two properties of the data compensate for the small dataset. A demonstration resumed from any of its intermediate actions is itself a demonstration, which multiplies the training samples and enables replanning after every action. Objects of the same kind are interchangeable, which turns demonstrations of one goal into demonstrations of every permuted goal. Our base implementation produces valid plans on 68% of held-out scenes; a training and generation scheme for the discrete plan raises this to 76%, and replanning after every action raises the task completion rate from 40% to 53% in a kinematic simulation. The planner matches the task completion rate of motion-only flow matching policies while additionally providing the symbolic plan, and it outperforms previous hybrid diffusion formulations on both task completion and plan validity. We validate the planner on a real mobile manipulator. Videos and project page: https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/hybrid-flow-planning
papers.comment: 9 pages, 9 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027. Project page: https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/hybrid-flow-planning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出混合 flow matching 规划器：单个网络用 masked discrete flow matching 生成符号任务计划、用 continuous flow matching 生成运动轨迹，从少量真实演示中学习并闭环执行。利用「从中间动作恢复的演示仍是演示」与「同类物体可互换」两种数据性质扩充训练样本；在 kinematic simulation 中每步重规划把任务完成率从 40% 提到 53%，基础版本在 held-out 场景上计划有效率 68%，离散计划的训练与生成方案将其提到 76%。
Motivation: 现有从演示学习的生成式规划器依赖数千条固定基座机械臂的脚本演示且开环执行，无法在长时程移动操作中用小规模真实演示闭环重规划。
Method: 单一网络内并行两条流：masked discrete flow matching 生成符号计划，continuous flow matching 生成运动轨迹，无需符号域或搜索；训练样本靠从任意中间动作恢复的演示倍增，同类物体可互换使一个目标的演示覆盖所有置换目标，每步动作后重规划。
Result: 基础实现在 held-out 场景上生成有效计划的比例为 68%，离散计划的训练与生成方案提升到 76%；kinematic simulation 中每步重规划把任务完成率从 40% 提到 53%；任务完成率与 motion-only flow matching 策略持平但额外给出符号计划，并在任务完成与计划有效性两方面超过此前的 hybrid diffusion 公式；在真实移动操作机器人上验证。
Conclusion: 借助演示数据的两种结构性质，小规模真实演示足以支撑同时输出符号计划与运动轨迹的闭环生成式规划，且优于 hybrid diffusion 形式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Flow Policies as Actions of Skill-Level World Models: Learned and Symbolic Abstractions for Long-Horizon Planning
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models enable robots to plan by predicting the consequences of actions. Planning long tasks with control-rate actions requires many prediction steps, which enlarges the search space and accumulates error. Skill-level actions shorten these sequences, but a symbolic skill vocabulary requires domain knowledge and labeled demonstrations. We construct skill-level actions from the inputs of a flow-matching policy trained on demonstrations segmented into complete skills. The policy maps a noise seed and an observation, optionally with a code or label, to a complete skill execution, so one execution is one world-model transition. On this mechanism we propose four action abstractions with increasing task knowledge: a compressed seed, two discrete codes learned from the demonstrations, and a symbolic label. We evaluate them with a common world-model training procedure and planning framework on simulated block rearrangement tasks that require up to 14 sequential skills. The symbolic label succeeds in over 90% of the tasks that require up to six skills and degrades beyond. Without any label, an object-centric learned code matches it on single-skill tasks and retains half to three quarters of its success on tasks of two to five skills. Ablations attribute much of the label's advantage to its planner knowing which actions are applicable, rather than to the label itself. Beyond six skills the search, not the world model, limits success. Project page: https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/flow-skill-wm
papers.comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027. Project page: https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/flow-skill-wm
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 flow-matching 策略把演示切成完整技能后生成技能级动作，使一次执行等于一次世界模型转移，并据此提出四种任务知识递增的动作抽象（压缩噪声种子、两个从演示中学到的离散 code、符号 label）。在最多需 14 个连续技能的模拟方块重排任务上，符号 label 在不超过六技能的任务成功率超 90%，无 label 的物体中心 learned code 在单技能任务上打平、在二到五技能任务保留其一半到四分之三的成功率；消融显示 label 的优势主要来自规划器知道哪些动作适用，超过六技能后限制成功率的是搜索而非世界模型。
Motivation: 用控制频率动作做长程规划需要大量预测步，既扩大搜索空间又累积误差；技能级动作能缩短序列，但符号技能词表依赖领域知识与带标注演示。
Method: 在按完整技能切分的演示上训练 flow-matching 策略，把噪声种子与观测（可选加 code 或 label）映射为一次完整技能执行，使一次执行对应一次世界模型转移；在此机制上提出四种递增任务知识的抽象：压缩种子、从演示学习的两个离散 code、符号 label，四者共用同一世界模型训练流程与规划框架。
Result: 在模拟方块重排任务（最长需 14 个连续技能）上：符号 label 在不超过六技能的任务中成功率超过 90%，更长时下降；无 label 时物体中心 learned code 在单技能任务与之持平，在二到五技能任务保留其一半到四分之三的成功率；消融把 label 的优势很大一部分归因于规划器知道哪些动作适用，而非 label 本身；超过六技能后限制成功率的是搜索而非世界模型。
Conclusion: 技能级动作抽象的收益主要来自规划端的可行动作知识，长程瓶颈在搜索而非世界模型预测；符号 label 在六技能以内最有效，更长任务需改进搜索。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Variance-Optimal Control Variates for Learning with Black-box Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Modern models increasingly learn through black-box oracles such as humans, optimization solvers, and external tools that provide feedback without exposing their internal mechanisms. A common remedy is to learn an (action-)value function as a control variate. In this paper, we first observe that even an exact action-value function can be arbitrarily far from variance-optimal. We show that this gap arises because the value function minimizes the noise in each action's own gradient term, while an action can still affect the rest of the gradient estimator through shared parameters. A simple unbiased correction, at no extra oracle cost, can still reduce its variance by an arbitrarily large factor. Motivated by this, we then prove that the residual variance can be decomposed exactly by actions with no cross terms. This decomposition yields a closed-form variance-minimizing correction for neural-network parameters, which can be computed by a simple projection. Empirically, our correction consistently reduces the variance left by the value function and improves learning across all tasks. The source code for all experiments is available at https://github.com/Zihao-Kevin/black_box_opt.

TL;DR: 针对黑箱反馈学习中用 value function 作 control variate 的做法，证明即便精确的 action-value 函数也可能离方差最优任意远，因为 value function 只压低每个动作自身梯度项的噪声，而动作仍通过共享参数影响其余梯度估计。给出一个不增加 oracle 开销的无偏修正，把残余方差按动作精确分解（无交叉项），得到闭式方差最小修正并用一次投影计算；实验中该修正持续压低 value function 留下的方差并改善全部任务的学习。
Motivation: 黑箱 oracle（人类、优化求解器、外部工具）只给反馈不暴露内部机制，常用学 value function 当 control variate；但该做法把每个动作的梯度项孤立最小化，忽略了共享参数带来的耦合，方差可离最优任意远。

papers.title: EasyClassifier: Honest, Reproducible Machine-Learning Classification for Researchers Who Do Not Program
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning classification is now used across medicine, the social sciences, economics, education and engineering, very often by researchers who do not program. Two errors recur in such work: preprocessing learned on all rows before cross-validation (data leakage), and reporting the cross-validation score of the classifier that won a comparison (selection bias). Both make published scores optimistic. We present EasyClassifier, an open-source Python package that guides a user from a CSV or Excel file to a finished analysis through a sequence of plain-language, multiple-choice questions, with no code. It makes the correct procedure the default rather than an option: every preprocessing step is learned inside each training fold; the selected classifier receives a separate final score from nested cross-validation (up to 2,000 rows), or an untouched 20% test set; classifiers run with fixed default parameters and fixed random seeds; and every run writes a report with a ready-to-adapt Methods paragraph, the references to cite, and figures prepared for publication. On ten public datasets from seven fields and a random-label control, split in half so that one half served as an untouched external test, the common practice overstated balanced accuracy by 2.9 percentage points on average (up to 9.9 on small data), whereas the score EasyClassifier reports had a mean signed bias of +0.7 points and a mean absolute error of 2.3 points (one-sided Wilcoxon p = 3.2 x 10^{-4}, 30 runs). On random labels it reported 48.8% balanced accuracy against a chance level of 50%. EasyClassifier is available under the MIT license from PyPI (pip install easyclassifier), GitHub, and Zenodo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EasyClassifier 是面向不会编程的研究者的开源 Python 包，用一连串白话选择题把 CSV/Excel 导入到成稿分析，并把正确流程设为默认：所有预处理只在每个训练折内拟合，被选中的分类器再由嵌套交叉验证（至多 2,000 行）或独立保留的 20% 测试集给出最终分数。在 7 个领域 10 个公开数据集加随机标签对照上，常见做法平均高估 balanced accuracy 2.9 个百分点（小样本最高 9.9），而该工具报告分数的平均符号偏差仅 +0.7 点、平均绝对误差 2.3 点。
Motivation: 非编程背景的研究者在医学、社科、经济、教育、工程中大量使用机器学习分类，却反复犯两类错误：在交叉验证之前用全部行拟合预处理（数据泄漏），以及直接报告比较中胜出分类器的交叉验证分数（选择偏差），两者都让已发表分数系统性偏乐观。
Method: 开源 Python 包 EasyClassifier 以白话多选题引导用户从 CSV/Excel 走到完整分析，无需写代码：每一步预处理都在各训练折内部学习；胜出分类器由嵌套交叉验证（至多 2,000 行）或未触碰的 20% 测试集单独打分；分类器使用固定默认参数与固定随机种子；每次运行输出含可直接改写的 Methods 段落、待引文献与出版级图的报告。评测覆盖 7 个领域 10 个公开数据集加一个随机标签对照，数据对半切分，一半作为未触碰的外部测试。
Result: 常见做法平均高估 balanced accuracy 2.9 个百分点，小样本上最高 9.9 点；EasyClassifier 报告分数的平均符号偏差为 +0.7 点、平均绝对误差 2.3 点（单侧 Wilcoxon p = 3.2 × 10^{-4}，30 次运行）。随机标签对照上它报告 48.8% balanced accuracy，对应 50% 的随机水平。
Conclusion: 把折内预处理与嵌套交叉验证设为默认而非可选项，可把非编程研究者常见报告流程带来的乐观偏差从平均 2.9 个百分点压到 +0.7 点；工具以 MIT 许可发布于 PyPI、GitHub 与 Zenodo。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: When Is Enough Enough in Self-Evolving LLM Systems?
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving large language model (LLM) systems repeatedly propose, evaluate, and incorporate updates to prompts, skills, or other persistent artifacts. Despite their growing effectiveness, these systems typically operate under a predetermined iteration or compute budget, without a principled criterion to determine when further evolution is no longer worthwhile. This can lead to two undesirable consequences: unnecessary computation after performance has saturated and the risk of returning late updates that overfit or exploit the evaluation signal. These issues motivate us to study two fundamental questions: when should a self-evolving system stop, and what should it output once it stops? We address the first by formulating an online sequential testing problem and constructing an anytime-valid restart detector using the per-item paired evaluation outcomes already produced by self-evolving LLM systems. We address the second by formulating a change-point estimation problem and using the estimated transition to select an earlier artifact for output. The resulting procedure is plug-and-play and requires no modification of the underlying self-evolving algorithms. Across two self-evolving frameworks, three LLM model families, and five benchmarks, our method substantially reduces computation costs while maintaining comparable unseen-test performance. For example, on SearchQA with SkillOpt and DeepSeek V4 Flash, our method stops at round 4 rather than the full budget of 40, reducing token usage by 91.6% while achieving 82.43% unseen-test accuracy versus 82.00% under the full-budget run.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自演化 LLM 系统按固定轮数或算力预算跑满，既浪费算力又可能采纳过拟合评测信号的晚期更新。作者把「何时停」写成在线序贯检验，用逐条配对评测结果构造 anytime-valid 的重启检测器 (restart detector)，把「停后输出什么」写成变点估计并回选更早的 artifact；在 SearchQA 上用 SkillOpt + DeepSeek V4 Flash 于第 4 轮（而非满预算 40 轮）停止，token 用量降 91.6%，未见测试准确率 82.43% 对满预算的 82.00%。
Motivation: 自演化系统缺少有原则的停止判据，只能预设迭代或算力预算：性能饱和后仍继续计算，且晚期更新有过拟合或钻评测信号空子的风险。
Method: 把停止问题形式化为在线序贯检验，用自演化系统本就产生的逐 item 配对评测结果构造 anytime-valid 的重启检测器；把输出选择形式化为变点估计，用估计到的转折点回选更早的 artifact。流程即插即用，无需改动底层自演化算法。
Result: 在两个自演化框架、三个 LLM 模型家族、五个 benchmark 上，方法大幅降低算力开销同时保持相当的未见测试性能。具体地，SearchQA + SkillOpt + DeepSeek V4 Flash 在第 4 轮停止（满预算 40 轮），token 用量减少 91.6%，未见测试准确率 82.43%，满预算运行为 82.00%。
Conclusion: 自演化 LLM 系统可以在远早于预算上限处以 anytime-valid 的统计判据停止并回选早期 artifact，从而省下绝大部分 token 而不损失未见测试性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FoSeRL: Formal Sequential Robustness Certification for Reinforcement Learning Policies
papers.abstract_en: Even a few action perturbations can substantially degrade the performance of a deployed decision policy. Certifying the resulting return loss is challenging in stochastic environments, where returns vary even without an attack. We introduce FoSeRL, a framework for certifying deployed RL policies against precommitted, temporally sparse action attacks. The deployed policy is unchanged, with no smoothing or retraining. Certification requires a resettable simulator supporting shared randomness and independent one-step successor queries, but no analytical dynamics model. FoSeRL certifies that an attacked episode loses no more than a prescribed amount of return relative to the same episode unattacked, with at least a target probability and at a user-specified confidence level. Both runs share the initial state and randomness, so the measured loss reflects the attack, not the episode; carrying the running return gap as a state coordinate makes it the terminal value, reducing trajectory-level certification to terminal safety. Time-dependent barrier conditions on the augmented state bound the terminal failure probability: satisfied exactly, they certify every admissible precommitted attack; learned from sampled trajectories and verified on held-out data, they certify the same guarantee under a specified attack-episode setting. Across six stochastic continuous-control environments and three RL policy families (TD3, SAC, and PPO), FoSeRL certifies non-trivial cardinality--magnitude robustness frontiers, achieves substantially larger certified budgets than policy smoothing, and reveals marked robustness differences among policies with comparable nominal performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FoSeRL 为已部署 RL 策略给出形式化鲁棒性证书：在可重置、支持共享随机数的仿真器中，让受攻击与未受攻击的同一回合共享初始状态和随机性，并把累计回报差作为状态坐标，从而把轨迹级证书化归为终端安全。在六个随机连续控制环境、TD3/SAC/PPO 三类策略上，它认证出非平凡的 cardinality–magnitude 鲁棒性前沿，认证预算显著大于 policy smoothing，并揭示标称性能相当的策略之间鲁棒性差异明显。
Motivation: 部署后的决策策略即使只被少量动作扰动，性能也可能大幅下降；在随机环境中回报本身就会波动，难以把损失归因于攻击，也就无法给出可认证的回报损失上界。
Method: FoSeRL 不改动被认证策略（无平滑、无重训练），要求可重置且支持共享随机数与独立单步后继查询的仿真器，无需解析动力学模型。受攻击与未受攻击的两次运行共享初始状态与随机性，并把运行中的回报差作为状态坐标，使其成为终端值；再用增广状态上的含时 barrier 条件界定终端失败概率——精确满足时对所有允许的 precommitted 攻击成立，从采样轨迹学习并在留出数据上验证时在指定 attack-episode 设定下给出同样保证。
Result: 在六个随机连续控制环境、三类 RL 策略（TD3、SAC、PPO）上认证出非平凡的 cardinality–magnitude 鲁棒性前沿；认证预算显著大于 policy smoothing；并揭示标称性能相当的策略之间鲁棒性差异明显。
Conclusion: 回报损失可以在不改策略、只依赖可重置仿真器的条件下被形式化认证为终端安全问题，且不同策略在相同标称性能下的可认证鲁棒预算差别很大。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: More Value per Key: Asymmetric Sparse Attention for Faster LLM Decoding
papers.abstract_en: utoregressive generation in Large Language Models (LLMs) is constrained by the memory and computational demands of attention mechanisms. Sparse attention methods mitigate this cost by selecting only high-probability entries of the attention matrix. We observe that in many such methods, this renders the probability-value multiplication negligible, shifting the bottleneck to the query-key step. Key heads can therefore be reduced to accelerate inference, while retaining more value heads preserves capacity with limited additional decoding cost. We introduce Sparse Asymmetric Group-Query Attention (SAGA), which decouples key and value head counts to exploit this principle, and pair it with approximate top-N (Atop-N) attention, a simple sparse attention method designed to study the interaction between sparsity and head-count asymmetry. We formalize the benefits of this asymmetry theoretically and validate them empirically through latency measurements and quality evaluations on models up to 1.5B parameters. Together, SAGA and Atop-N achieve end-to-end decoding speedups exceeding $2\times$ over our full-attention GQA baseline at long contexts. Models trained from scratch with SAGA nearly match the quality of comparable GQA variants on the evaluated benchmarks. To facilitate adoption, we introduce an efficient fine-tuning method that converts pretrained models to the SAGA architecture, enabling practitioners to benefit from our approach without costly retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGA 把 GQA 的 key/value 头数解耦：稀疏注意力下概率-值乘法可忽略、瓶颈移到 query-key 步，因此可削减 key 头、保留更多 value 头以维持容量。配合近似 top-N 注意力 (Atop-N)，长上下文端到端解码相对全注意力 GQA 基线提速超过 2×，从零训练的 SAGA 模型质量接近同规模 GQA。
Motivation: LLM 自回归解码受注意力的显存与算力约束，稀疏注意力只选高概率项后，开销重心从概率-值乘法转到 query-key 计算，原有对称头结构在此不再划算。
Method: 提出 Sparse Asymmetric Group-Query Attention (SAGA)，解耦 key 头与 value 头数量；配对使用为研究稀疏度与头数不对称交互而设计的近似 top-N 注意力 (Atop-N)；给出不对称收益的理论形式化，并提供把预训练模型转换为 SAGA 架构的高效微调方法。
Result: SAGA 与 Atop-N 在长上下文上相对全注意力 GQA 基线实现超过 2× 的端到端解码加速；从零训练的 SAGA 模型在所评测基准上质量接近可比 GQA 变体；理论形式化后以延迟测量和质量评测在最大 1.5B 参数的模型上做经验验证。
Conclusion: 稀疏解码下 key 头可削减、value 头应多留，这种不对称既提速又保容量；预训练模型可用专门微调方法转成 SAGA，无需昂贵重训。

papers.title: Variance-Aware Fine-Grained Gap-Dependent Bounds for Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study model-free online reinforcement learning (RL) for episodic tabular Markov decision processes, focusing on both gap-dependent regret and policy switching cost. While fine-grained gap-dependent analysis has been established for model-free RL algorithms using Hoeffding-type exploration bonuses, such results for model-free algorithms with variance-based exploration bonuses remain unknown, despite their superior worst-case and coarse-grained gap-dependent guarantees. In this paper, we resolve this open problem by establishing the first fine-grained gap-dependent regret upper bound for UCB-Bernstein+, a refined UCB-Bernstein algorithm, in variance-aware model-free online RL. Moreover, by integrating a stage-wise policy update design into our fine-grained framework and using refined variance-based bonuses, we achieve the best-known gap-dependent local switching cost to date. In addition, our analysis yields improved worst-case guarantees for both regret and local switching cost over the original UCB-Bernstein algorithm. Numerical experiments further demonstrate that UCB-Bernstein+ achieves favorable empirical performance in both regret and local switching cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 episodic 表格型 MDP 的 model-free 在线强化学习中，为方差感知的 UCB-Bernstein+ 建立首个细粒度 gap-dependent regret 上界，并通过分阶段策略更新 (stage-wise policy update) 取得目前已知最优的 gap-dependent 局部切换代价；同时在 regret 与切换代价两方面改进原始 UCB-Bernstein 的最坏情况保证，数值实验显示其经验表现良好。
Motivation: 基于 Hoeffding 型探索奖励的 model-free RL 已有细粒度 gap-dependent 分析，而方差型探索奖励的算法虽有更优的最坏情况与粗粒度 gap-dependent 保证，细粒度结果此前未知。
Method: 针对 episodic 表格型 MDP 提出精化的 UCB-Bernstein+，使用更精细的方差型探索奖励，并在细粒度分析框架中引入分阶段策略更新设计，同时分析 gap-dependent regret 与策略切换代价 (policy switching cost)。
Result: 给出 UCB-Bernstein+ 的首个细粒度 gap-dependent regret 上界；取得目前已知最优的 gap-dependent 局部切换代价；相对原始 UCB-Bernstein 改进 regret 与局部切换代价的最坏情况保证；数值实验显示 UCB-Bernstein+ 在 regret 与局部切换代价上经验表现良好。
Conclusion: 方差型探索奖励的 model-free RL 可以补上细粒度 gap-dependent 分析这一空白，且结合分阶段策略更新能同时优化 regret 与切换代价。

papers.title: Dynamic Routing as a New Dimension for Test-time Versatility of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Beyond scaling their parameters and data, large language models currently gain versatility on new problems along a single axis: the tokens they spend on chain-of-thought (CoT). We investigate whether dynamic routing programs, which execute a subset of the model's layers or iterate some of them, can open a second axis of test-time adaptation, complementary to CoT and free of any gradient update. Prior work showed that such programs exist and bring accuracy and efficiency gains on problems similar to those they were trained on; we ask whether they can also be identified rapidly, from a handful of demonstrations (3 or 10), by a strategy that transfers across models and tasks without training. First, we find that strategies that select programs by the probability they assign to the demonstrations' labels, arbitrated by the model's own confidence, bring consistent gains: on average over the 49 tasks of MMLU and substantially on four of seven models, and most of all on far out-of-distribution tasks such as ARC-AGI, where programs double the accuracy of a 7B model whose CoT fails. Second, on MMLU across the seven post-trained models, routing complements CoT in practice: the two succeed on different queries, and their composition exceeds CoT alone. Despite these gains, our analyses show that confidence-based selection leaves much of the potential untapped, in two places in particular: (1) in surfacing the routing potential that is already present early in pre-training but becomes harder to select after post-training, and (2) in making models robust to the refinements routing introduces, since unsuccessful routes tend to drive the residual stream out of the distribution that the following layers expect. Together, our results point to dynamic routing as a paradigm for extending the plasticity of existing and future LLMs in rapid test-time adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把动态路由程序 (dynamic routing programs) 作为 LLM 测试时适应的第二条轴：不更新梯度，只用 3 或 10 个示范样例、按程序给示范标签的概率并由模型自身置信度仲裁来选程序。在 MMLU 49 个任务上平均带来一致增益、七个模型中四个明显提升；在 ARC-AGI 这类远分布任务上让 7B 模型准确率翻倍（其 CoT 失败），且与 CoT 组合超过单用 CoT。
Motivation: LLM 获得新问题上的多样性目前只有 CoT token 这一条轴；已有路由程序只在与训练相似的问题上带来增益，缺少无需训练、跨模型跨任务快速从少量示范中选出程序的策略。
Method: 用执行部分层或迭代部分层的动态路由程序作为测试时适应手段；选择策略按程序给示范标签的概率打分，并由模型自身置信度仲裁，在 3 或 10 个示范上识别，全程无梯度更新、无训练。
Result: 在 MMLU 的 49 个任务上平均带来一致增益，七个后训练模型中四个提升明显；在远分布任务 ARC-AGI 上路由使一个 CoT 失败的 7B 模型准确率翻倍；在 MMLU 七个后训练模型上，路由与 CoT 成功于不同查询，两者组合超过单用 CoT。
Conclusion: 动态路由是扩展现有与未来 LLM 快速测试时适应可塑性的范式；但基于置信度的选择仍有两处潜力未兑现——预训练早期已存在、后训练后更难选出的路由潜力，以及失败路由把 residual stream 推出后续层所期待分布导致的鲁棒性问题。

papers.title: Agentic discovery of blood biomarker from distilled private health records
papers.abstract_en: Routine complete blood counts (CBCs) could yield new biomarkers, but the private records needed to evaluate candidates cannot be shared with frontier language model agents that excel at discovery. We distilled the evidence held in the Clalit Health Services panel of over 5.4 million patients into a released scoring tool: for each of 13 immune-mediated diseases, a graph attention network was trained inside the data boundary to predict the case-control AUC of candidate CBC expressions, and only the trained weights were released. The tool grounds an agent's propose-score-refine loop in real-world data without exposing any patient data. In external validation, agent-discovered expressions improved on their literature-seeded starting points by a median of 4.18 AUC percentage points, and across three independent cohorts, reranking the candidates of three frontier research tools improved on their first choices in most comparisons, with gains that varied by cohort. The released scorer supports privacy-preserving biomarker hypothesis generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Clalit 540 万患者面板的证据蒸馏成只发布权重的 CBC 表达式打分工具：在数据边界内用图注意力网络预测 13 种免疫介导疾病的 case-control AUC，供 agent 的 propose-score-refine 循环在不接触患者数据的情况下迭代。外部验证中 agent 发现的表达式比文献种子起点中位提升 4.18 个 AUC 百分点；在三个独立队列上重排三个前沿研究工具的候选，多数比较中优于其首选。
Motivation: 评估候选生物标志物所需的私人病历无法交给擅长发现的前沿语言模型 agent，导致数据边界与发现能力被割裂。
Method: 在 Clalit Health Services 数据边界内，针对 13 种免疫介导疾病训练图注意力网络，预测候选 CBC 表达式的 case-control AUC，仅发布训练后的权重作为打分工具；agent 用它驱动 propose-score-refine 循环，并对三个前沿研究工具的候选做重排。
Result: 外部验证中 agent 发现的表达式相对文献种子起点中位提升 4.18 个 AUC 百分点；在三个独立队列上重排三个前沿研究工具的候选，多数比较中优于其首选，增益随队列而异。
Conclusion: 只发布蒸馏后的打分器即可在不暴露任何患者数据的前提下支撑隐私保护的生物标志物假设生成，且 agent 迭代能稳定超过文献种子起点。

papers.title: Formalizing the Moral Evaluation of Speech Acts: Truthfulness, Lies and Ethical Dilemmas
papers.abstract_en: In life-or-death situations, a benevolent lie may appear more moral than telling the truth. Yet such lies can backfire, producing unintended and sometimes fatal consequences. This tension, famously disputed by Kant and Constant in 1797, applies not only to lying but to assertive speech acts in general, raising the question of which utterance should be chosen when moral stakes are high. We present a logical framework for the ethical evaluation of speech-act utterances based on agents' beliefs. Implemented in Answer Set Programming (ASP), the framework assesses utterances under deontologism, consequentialism, and principialism, and is illustrated on Sartre's The Wall (1939), a reworking of that controversy in which lying leads alternately to rescue and to death. Our setting is general by design: as two variants show, accommodating a new moral situation amounts to adjusting parameters, not rules.
papers.comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 27th International Conference on Principles and Practice of Multi-Agent Systems (PRIMA 2026). Kumamoto, Japan
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个基于 agent 信念的言语行为 (speech act) 伦理评估逻辑框架，用 Answer Set Programming (ASP) 实现，可按义务论、后果主义、原则主义三种伦理立场评判一次断言的道德性。框架以 Sartre《墙》(1939) 中谎言交替导致获救与死亡的情节作示例，并以两个变体说明：容纳新的道德情境只需调整参数而非改写规则。
Motivation: Kant 与 Constant 1797 年关于谎言的争论表明，高道德风险下该说哪句话缺乏可形式化判定的准则，且这一张力不限于谎言、适用于一般断言性言语行为。
Method: 构建以 agents' beliefs 为基础的言语行为伦理评估逻辑框架，用 Answer Set Programming (ASP) 实现，同时支持义务论、后果主义、原则主义三种评价模式；以 Sartre《墙》为示例，并用两个变体展示参数化扩展。
Result: 在《墙》的示例中，同一谎言交替导致获救与死亡，框架能对这类高风险断言给出伦理评估；两个变体显示容纳新道德情境只需调整参数、无需改动规则。
Conclusion: 言语行为的道德评价可以形式化为以信念为输入、按伦理立场参数化判定的可执行程序，新情境的适配成本在于参数而非规则。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exact Fast Batch Simulation for Tabular Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Simulation is a fundamental computational primitive in reinforcement learning (RL), yet conventional simulation explicitly generates individual trajectories even when downstream procedures use only aggregate statistics. To address this, we develop an exact fast-simulation framework for finite-horizon tabular Markov decision processes. Our framework has two complementary modes. In direct batch simulation, a batch is represented by its aggregate Markov flow. With sufficient parallel simulation resources, this flow can be obtained by trajectory aggregation; when such simulation is unavailable or costly but the initial state and transition distributions are directly accessible, we instead generate an identically distributed flow through forward Markov-flow sampling without materializing individual trajectories. The latter reduces the simulator-side computational dependence on batch size $m$ from $O(m)$ to $O(1)$. In adaptive batch simulation, when batch length is determined by a data-dependent condition, exact multivariate-hypergeometric splitting recursively refines a candidate Markov flow while preserving the conditional law, reducing the cost dependence on $m$ from $O(m)$ to $O(\log m)$. Together, these modes accelerate simulation by keeping trajectories aggregated whenever possible and refining flows only when required to locate data-dependent boundaries. The framework applies broadly across simulator-based, offline, and online batch or stage-based RL, as illustrated with representative algorithms from each setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对有限视界表格型 MDP 中逐条生成轨迹的浪费，提出精确快速批量仿真框架：直接批量仿真用 Markov flow 聚合表示批次，前向 flow 采样在初始状态与转移分布可直接访问时生成同分布 flow，把仿真侧对批量大小 m 的依赖从 O(m) 降到 O(1)；当批量长度由数据相关条件决定时，用精确多元超几何分裂 (multivariate-hypergeometric splitting) 递归细化候选 flow 并保持条件分布，把代价从 O(m) 降到 O(log m)。
Motivation: RL 中仿真这一基础计算原语总是显式生成单条轨迹，而下游过程往往只用聚合统计量，导致批量仿真成本随 m 线性增长。
Method: 两个互补模式：direct batch simulation 用批次的聚合 Markov flow 表示，可在有并行仿真资源时由轨迹聚合得到，或在初始状态与转移分布可直接访问时用 forward Markov-flow sampling 生成同分布 flow；adaptive batch simulation 用精确多元超几何分裂递归细化候选 flow 并保持条件律。框架覆盖 simulator-based、offline、online 的 batch/stage-based RL，并以各设定的代表性算法为例。
Result: forward Markov-flow sampling 把仿真侧对批量大小 m 的计算依赖从 O(m) 降至 O(1)；exact multivariate-hypergeometric splitting 在数据相关停止条件下把代价对 m 的依赖从 O(m) 降至 O(log m)。
Conclusion: 只要能保持聚合 flow 与条件分布不变，表格型 RL 的批量仿真可以精确地避免物化单条轨迹，仅在需要定位数据相关边界时才细化 flow。

papers.title: ThyCLIPNet: A BiomedCLIP-Guided Lightweight Attention-Enhanced DeepLabV3+ Framework for Robust Thyroid Nodule Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate thyroid ultrasound segmentation is often challenged by low contrast, speckle noise, and unclear boundaries. Although recent methods have improved segmentation accuracy, many rely on resource-intensive architectures or lack explicit integration of multiscale features with global biomedical visual guidance. In this paper, we introduce ThyCLIPNet, a lightweight semantic-guided hybrid encoder-decoder framework that integrates BiomedCLIP-derived biomedical semantic guidance into a lightweight multi-scale CNN segmentation pipeline. The encoder integrates MobileNetV2 with efficient channel attention, while atrous spatial pyramid pooling and a custom convolutional block attention module enrich bottleneck features. The decoder combines hierarchical skip connections and lightweight attention refinement with a BiomedCLIP-guided gated fusion pathway that projects vision-only global biomedical embeddings into decoder feature space and selectively integrates them through semantic-local fusion and spatial gating. To the best of our knowledge, ThyCLIPNet is among the first lightweight thyroid ultrasound segmentation frameworks to use BiomedCLIP's vision encoder alone for image-only global semantic guidance without text prompting. Experiments on TG3K, TN3K, DDTI, and PKTN achieve dice similarity coefficients of 96.22%, 87.58%, 84.73%, and 80.70%; intersection over union scores of 92.72%, 77.91%, 73.51%, and 67.64%; and 95th-percentile hausdorff distances of 3.75, 16.38, 18.23, and 10.86, respectively. ThyCLIPNet uses 8.55M parameters and 22.99G FLOPs. Overall, the results support integrating global biomedical semantic guidance with lightweight multi-scale CNN representations for robust and computationally efficient thyroid ultrasound segmentation. Source code: https://github.com/Tasnim-Jahan/ThyCLIPNet. [Abstract shortened for arXiv. See PDF for full abstract.]
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ThyCLIPNet 把 BiomedCLIP 视觉编码器的全局生物医学语义嵌入（不使用文本 prompt）投影进轻量多尺度 CNN 解码器，经语义-局部融合与空间门控选择性注入，在四个甲状腺超声数据集上取得 Dice 96.22%/87.58%/84.73%/80.70%，参数量仅 8.55M、22.99G FLOPs。
Motivation: 甲状腺超声分割受低对比度、斑点噪声和边界不清困扰，现有方法要么架构资源密集，要么缺少多尺度特征与全局生物医学视觉引导的显式结合。
Method: 编码器用 MobileNetV2 加高效通道注意力 (ECA)，瓶颈处叠加空洞空间金字塔池化 (ASPP) 与自定义卷积块注意力模块 (CBAM)；解码器结合分层跳跃连接、轻量注意力细化，以及 BiomedCLIP 引导的门控融合通路，把仅视觉的全局嵌入投影到解码器特征空间，经语义-局部融合与空间门控选择性整合。
Result: 在 TG3K、TN3K、DDTI、PKTN 上 Dice 分别为 96.22%、87.58%、84.73%、80.70%；IoU 分别为 92.72%、77.91%、73.51%、67.64%；95 分位 Hausdorff 距离分别为 3.75、16.38、18.23、10.86。模型含 8.55M 参数、22.99G FLOPs。
Conclusion: 把全局生物医学语义引导与轻量多尺度 CNN 表示结合，可在保持计算高效的同时实现稳健的甲状腺超声分割；ThyCLIPNet 据作者所知是首批仅用 BiomedCLIP 视觉编码器做图像级全局语义引导（无文本 prompt）的轻量甲状腺超声分割框架之一。

papers.title: Robot Learning with Visual Predicted Force
papers.abstract_en: Force-aware manipulation typically relies on specialized force or tactile sensors. We show that force-aware manipulation can instead be achieved through visual force prediction from the deformation of a compliant Fin Ray gripper. Our approach trains two models. First, we train a visual force estimator on calibration data and use it to annotate task demonstrations with force estimates. Second, we train an action--force proposal policy on these force-augmented demonstrations to jointly generate candidate robot actions and their associated forces. At test time, we sample candidate actions and the forces they are expected to produce, then execute the action whose predicted force is closest to a target from the demonstrations. We evaluate our approach on berry picking, empty-can grasping, in-hand reorientation, and plug insertion. Our results show that visual force prediction can guide inference-time action selection for contact-rich manipulation without requiring force or tactile sensors at deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 仅用相机从 Fin Ray 柔顺夹爪的形变做视觉力预测，即可替代力/触觉传感器指导接触密集操作：先在标定数据上训练视觉力估计器并给演示标注力，再训练动作-力联合提议策略，测试时采样候选动作并执行预测力最接近演示目标的那一个。在摘草莓、空罐抓取、手内重定向和插拔四个任务上验证了该推理时选择机制可在部署端不带力传感器的条件下工作。
Motivation: 力感知操作通常依赖专用力传感器或触觉传感器，硬件成本与部署复杂度高；若能从视觉形变推断力，就能在普通相机条件下做接触密集操作。
Method: 两级训练：先用标定数据训练视觉力估计器 (visual force estimator)，再用它给任务演示自动标注力估计，得到力增强演示；随后训练 action-force proposal policy 联合生成候选机器人动作及其对应力。测试时采样候选动作与预期力，执行预测力与演示目标力最接近的动作。
Result: 在 berry picking、empty-can grasping、in-hand reorientation、plug insertion 四个接触密集任务上评估；结果显示视觉力预测可在无需力或触觉传感器的部署条件下指导推理时动作选择。
Conclusion: 力感知操作可以不靠专用传感器实现：把力预测嵌入演示标注与推理时动作选择，柔顺夹爪的视觉形变本身就足以提供操作所需的力信息。

papers.title: Toward a Locally Deployable Agentic Co-Scientist: Small-Model Planning for Early-Stage Drug Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Early-stage computational drug discovery requires coordinating heterogeneous scientific tools across multi-step workflows. We present a lightweight, tool-augmented framework in which a locally deployable compact language model plans calls to 18 modular tools. A Unified Molecular Schema maintains shared molecular records, while a plug-in interface supports tool replacement and extension. We construct 1,263 manually refined query-plan pairs through workflow-graph path coverage and apply LoRA fine-tuning to three compact model families. Under the query-level split, all fine-tuned models generate fully parseable and schema-compliant plans on 47 held-out cross-group queries. Llama 3.2-3B achieves a tool-selection F1 of 0.998, sequence exact match of 0.979, and argument F1 of 0.960. Under the stricter workflow-grouped split, which excludes identical ordered tool sequences across partitions, sequence exact match reaches 0.452 to 0.548, highlighting the remaining difficulty for compact models in generating complete workflow paths unseen during training. These results demonstrate the feasibility of compact, locally deployable planning while identifying compositional generalization as an important direction for further improvement.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the AI for Drug Discovery Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出本地可部署的轻量工具增强框架：紧凑语言模型经 LoRA 微调后规划 18 个模块化药物发现工具的调用序列，共享分子记录由 Unified Molecular Schema 维护。查询级划分下三个微调模型在 47 条跨组留出查询上全部生成可解析且符合 schema 的计划，Llama 3.2-3B 工具选择 F1 达 0.998；更严的 workflow-grouped 划分下序列完全匹配降到 0.452–0.548，说明组合泛化仍是紧凑模型的主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 早期计算药物发现需要跨多步工作流协调异构科学工具，而本地部署的紧凑模型在未见过的完整工具序列上难以生成正确工作流路径。
Method: 以工作流图路径覆盖构造 1,263 条人工精修的 query-plan 对，对三个紧凑模型族做 LoRA 微调；用 Unified Molecular Schema 维护共享分子记录，插件接口支持工具替换与扩展，规划目标是 18 个模块化工具的调用序列。
Result: 查询级划分下所有微调模型在 47 条留出跨组查询上生成完全可解析且符合 schema 的计划，Llama 3.2-3B 工具选择 F1 0.998、序列完全匹配 0.979、参数 F1 0.960；更严格的 workflow-grouped 划分（跨分区排除相同有序工具序列）下序列完全匹配为 0.452–0.548。
Conclusion: 紧凑模型本地部署做药物发现工作流规划可行，但对训练中未见的完整工作流路径，组合泛化仍是待改进的关键方向。

papers.title: PyINE: A Framework for Scalable Elicitation and Oversight via Code Execution
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning models can remain capable of solving a task while still defaulting to cheaper but misleading shortcuts. This creates a central oversight problem: when a model gives an answer with plausible but incomplete reasoning, can an overseer determine whether that output should be trusted? To study this problem, we introduce PyINE, a framework for scalable elicitation and oversight using instrumented Python programs as a verifiable execution substrate. In PyINE, programs define task environments, execution traces provide authoritative labels for outcomes and intermediate facts, and task variants can be generated mechanically rather than through static human annotation. We instantiate the framework in PyINE-v1, a first release built from nearly one million deterministic execution traces and over 500,000 matched LLM-generated code variants used for counterfactual evaluation. Using standard RL with verifiable rewards on cue-varied tasks, we train a shortcut-following model that improves substantially at predicting execution outcomes while still making systematic errors when misleading human-facing cues conflict with the program's realized behavior. We then evaluate activation probes, trained text classifiers, prompted judges, and a lightweight debate protocol as overseers of this model. We find that performance pooled at the dataset level can hide weak coverage of the failures that matter most: cheap learned overseers often miss rare shortcut-driven errors, while stronger model-based checks are more balanced but substantially costlier and harder to turn into reliable thresholded decisions. PyINE-v1 turns this failure-mode coverage problem into a reusable experimental setting for developing oversight methods that are verifiable, failure-mode-aware, and cost-sensitive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PyINE 用带插桩的 Python 程序作为可验证执行基底来研究模型监督问题：程序定义任务环境，执行轨迹给出结果与中间事实的权威标签，任务变体可机械生成。用近一百万条确定性执行轨迹和超过 50 万条配对 LLM 生成代码变体，配合可验证奖励的 RL 训练出走捷径模型，再比较四类监督器，发现数据集层面的总体性能会掩盖对罕见捷径错误的弱覆盖。
Motivation: 推理模型可以在保住任务能力的同时退回到便宜但误导性的捷径，监督者难以判断看似合理却不完整的推理是否可信；而按数据集聚合的评估会掩盖最关键失败模式的覆盖情况。
Method: PyINE 框架以插桩 Python 程序为可验证执行基底：程序定义任务环境，执行轨迹提供结果与中间事实的权威标签，任务变体机械生成而非人工标注。PyINE-v1 用近 100 万条确定性执行轨迹与超过 500,000 条配对 LLM 生成代码变体做反事实评估；在 cue-varied 任务上用标准 RL with verifiable rewards 训练走捷径模型，并评估 activation probes、训练的文本分类器、prompted judges 与轻量 debate protocol 四类监督器。
Result: 走捷径模型在预测执行结果上大幅提升，但在误导性 human-facing cues 与程序实际行为冲突时仍系统性出错。数据集层面聚合的性能会掩盖对关键失败的弱覆盖：廉价的 learned overseers 常漏掉罕见的捷径驱动错误，更强的 model-based checks 更均衡但成本高得多、也更难转成可靠的阈值化决策。
Conclusion: 监督方法的评测必须按失败模式覆盖而非数据集总体分数来设计，且要在覆盖、成本与阈值可判定性之间权衡；PyINE-v1 被定位为可复用的实验场景，用于开发可验证、失败模式感知且成本敏感的 oversight 方法。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 走捷径模型在预测执行结果上大幅提升，但在误导性 human-facing cues 与程序实际行为冲突时仍系统性出错。数据集层面聚合的性能会掩盖对关键失败的弱覆盖：廉价的 learned overseers 常漏掉罕见的捷径驱动错误，更强的 model-based checks 更均衡但成本高得多、也更难转成可靠的阈值化决策。
summary_sections.conclusion: 监督方法的评测必须按失败模式覆盖而非数据集总体分数来设计，且要在覆盖、成本与阈值可判定性之间权衡；PyINE-v1 被定位为可复用的实验场景，用于开发可验证、失败模式感知且成本敏感的 oversight 方法。

papers.title: Probabilistic Pedestrian Forecasts from a Handheld Phone: World-Frame Heat Maps, Visual-Inertial Height Drift, and Evaluation without Ground Truth
papers.abstract_en: A pedestrian with a phone could be shown where nearby people will be in the next few seconds, if the forecast stays on the ground while the phone moves, is calibrated, and needs only a monocular camera and visual-inertial odometry (VIO). We build and evaluate such a system. People are detected, lifted onto the floor by ray-plane intersection, tracked in a gravity-aligned metric frame, and forecast as per-step probability maps by a small U-Net trained with a negative log-likelihood (NLL) loss on bird's-eye (SDD) and first-person (EgoTraj-Bench) trajectories. On handheld ADVIO recordings, vertical VIO drift and the user's own changes of level silently rescale monocular ground positions (by 87% within 90 s on one clip; on another, all tracks are lost for the last 31% of the clip); keeping the camera's height above the floor constant under a low-pass-filtered altitude avoids this, though it lags on escalators. On the SDD and EgoTraj-Bench test splits, the final forecaster lowers the NLL at 4.8 s by 1.51 and 1.37 nats relative to a fitted constant-velocity Gaussian. Lacking ground truth for people in handheld video, we score forecasts against the tracker's own later raw measurements. In an internally pre-registered evaluation on seven held-out clips, the final forecaster's NLL is lower than the benchmark-fitted baseline's at 1.2, 2.4 and 4.8 s (by 0.17, 0.23 and 0.47 nats; 95% intervals over people exclude zero), but by less than half as much as on the development clips. Exploratory analyses cut both ways: resampling clips instead of people widens the intervals to include zero at 1.2 and 2.4 s, and once both forecasters are recalibrated on the development clips the network is significantly better only at 1.2 s; but two clips run with ADVIO's reference poses favour the network much more when re-run with the phone's own poses. We discuss what such self-consistency scores can and cannot show.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 手持手机上做行人轨迹概率预报：检测后用 ray-plane 抬到地面、在重力对齐度量坐标系跟踪，小 U-Net 以 NLL 在 SDD 与 EgoTraj-Bench 上训练逐步概率图。在无真值的手持视频上改用跟踪器自身后续原始量测打分，7 段留出 clip 的预注册评测中 1.2/2.4/4.8 s 的 NLL 分别比基线低 0.17/0.23/0.47 nats，但幅度不足开发集的一半。
Motivation: 手持单目相机的行人预报要同时面对 VIO 垂直漂移导致地面位置被静默重标度的问题，以及手持视频中他人位置没有真值、无法常规评测的缺口。
Method: 检测行人后经 ray-plane intersection 抬升到地面，在重力对齐的度量坐标系中跟踪，用小 U-Net 以 negative log-likelihood (NLL) 损失在 SDD（鸟瞰）与 EgoTraj-Bench（第一人称）轨迹上训练逐步概率图；用低通滤波高度保持相机离地恒定以抑制漂移；评测时以跟踪器自身后续原始量测作为打分对象，并做内部预注册的 7 段留出 clip 检验。
Result: SDD 与 EgoTraj-Bench 测试集上最终预报器在 4.8 s 的 NLL 相对拟合的 constant-velocity Gaussian 分别降低 1.51 与 1.37 nats；ADVIO 手持录制中垂直 VIO 漂移与用户自身换层在 90 s 内使单目地面位置重标度 87%，另一段 clip 最后 31% 时长全部跟丢。7 段留出 clip 上 1.2/2.4/4.8 s 的 NLL 分别低 0.17/0.23/0.47 nats（按人计算的 95% 区间不含零），但幅度不足开发集的一半；按 clip 重采样后 1.2 与 2.4 s 区间含零，两预报器在开发集上重标定后网络仅在 1.2 s 显著更好；两段用 ADVIO 参考位姿跑的 clip 换成手机自身位姿后网络优势明显变大。
Conclusion: 自洽性打分（拿跟踪器自身后续量测评预报）能在无真值手持视频上给出可预注册的比较，但结论对重采样单位、重标定与位姿来源敏感，作者明确讨论了这类分数能与不能说明什么。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Investigating Spatiotemporal Redundancy in Video Transformer for Collision Anticipation
papers.abstract_en: In worker-equipment proximity monitoring, video transformers are widely used for collision anticipation and have demonstrated strong performance. However, their accuracy comes with substantial computational demands, creating a tension with the need for low-latency inference on mobile robots and the pursuit of lower-carbon computation in construction. To address this, this study investigates where computation within an established video transformer is redundant and whether that redundancy can be removed without materially degrading predictive performance. Using VideoMAEv2-Base on the Nexar Collision Prediction dataset, we first examine how collision-relevant information evolves across network depth and then investigate two complementary forms of redundancy: structured capacity redundancy in multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) and spatiotemporal redundancy in the token stream. Linear probes show that interpretable motion cues, including flow magnitude, looming, and approach versus retreat, are most accessible at intermediate layers, whereas collision-label discrimination strengthens toward the final layer. Token redundancy is axis-specific: adjacent temporal-token similarity reaches 0.970 in later layers, while spatial similarity falls to 0.297, indicating substantially greater redundancy across time than across space. Exploiting this asymmetry, temporal token merging reduces backbone computation from 356.99 to 178.50 GFLOPs and latency from 12.69 to 7.21 ms per clip, a 1.76x speedup, while mean average precision changes only from 0.7478 to 0.7443. Importance-guided retention of 50% of MLP units preserves an AUC of 0.753, compared with 0.529 under matched random retention, and reveals that pruning alters score calibration before discriminative ranking collapses. These findings establish a new pathway for pursuing faster algorithms through targeted temporal token compression and neuron pruning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在工人-设备邻近监控的碰撞预判任务上，VideoMAEv2-Base 的冗余主要集中在时间维：后层相邻时间 token 相似度达 0.970 而空间仅 0.297，据此做时间 token 合并可把骨干计算从 356.99 降到 178.50 GFLOPs、单片段延迟从 12.69 降到 7.21 ms（1.76x 加速），mAP 仅从 0.7478 微降到 0.7443。
Motivation: 视频 Transformer 在碰撞预判上精度高但算力开销大，与移动机器人低延迟推理和施工场景低碳计算直接冲突；需要定位网络内部哪些计算是冗余的，并在不明显损失预测性能的前提下移除。
Method: 以 VideoMAEv2-Base 在 Nexar Collision Prediction 数据集上展开：先用 linear probe 追踪碰撞相关信息随网络深度的演化（flow magnitude、looming、approach vs retreat 等运动线索），再分别处理 MLP 的结构容量冗余与 token 流的时空冗余——按时间相似度做 token merging，以及按重要性保留 50% MLP 单元。
Result: Linear probe 显示运动线索在中间层最可读、碰撞标签判别力向最后层增强；后层相邻时间 token 相似度 0.970、空间相似度 0.297。时间 token 合并使 GFLOPs 356.99 → 178.50、延迟 12.69 → 7.21 ms/clip（1.76x），mAP 0.7478 → 0.7443；重要性引导保留 50% MLP 单元得 AUC 0.753，同等随机保留仅 0.529，且剪枝先改变分数校准、后才使判别排序崩溃。
Conclusion: 时空冗余是轴向不对称的，时间维远比空间维冗余，因此定向的时间 token 压缩加神经元剪枝可以在几乎不损失 mAP 的前提下大幅降算力与延迟，成为获取更快模型的新路径。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Latent-Lagrangian Neural Networks for Reduced Order Modeling of Non-autonomous Nonlinear Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: This work proposes a latent Lagrangian-based framework for reduced-order modelling of forced nonlinear dynamical systems. In contrast with conventional Lagrangian or Hamiltonian neural networks, our approach learns a set of latent coordinates sufficient to capture the dynamics conjointly with two neural networks for the latent kinetic and latent potential energies, and leverages force supervision to eliminate the need for an ODE solver during training. Consistency of physical laws in the latent space is ensured through the principle of virtual work. Results show that the model effectively learns the subtle dynamics induced by the system's nonlinearity and non-convex potential energy, and generalizes well to unseen forces and initial conditions. These observations confirm the physical relevance of the proposed approach, and its interest for model reduction.
papers.journal_ref: J. Mech. Phys. Solids 214 (2026) 106633
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出潜空间拉格朗日 (latent Lagrangian) 降阶框架：同时学习足以刻画动力学的潜坐标与潜动能、势能两个网络，并用虚功原理约束潜空间的物理定律一致性，力监督使训练无需 ODE 求解器。模型能学到非线性与非凸势能诱导的细微动力学，并泛化到未见过的外力与初始条件。
Motivation: 受迫非线性动力系统的降阶建模中，常规 Lagrangian/Hamiltonian 神经网络依赖显式广义坐标且训练需 ODE 求解器，难以处理非凸势能与外力变化。
Method: 联合学习一组潜坐标与两个分别表示潜动能、潜势能的神经网络；用力监督 (force supervision) 替代训练中的 ODE 求解器；以虚功原理 (principle of virtual work) 约束潜空间内的物理定律一致性。
Result: 结果表明模型有效学到系统非线性与非凸势能诱导的细微动力学，并对未见过的外力和初始条件表现出良好泛化；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 潜坐标加能量网络加虚功约束的组合在物理上是相关的，可作为受迫非线性系统的有效降阶建模途径。

papers.title: NAMVIS: Next-Scale Autoregressive Multi-View Image Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-view novel view synthesis is a central problem in 3D content creation, but diffusion-based approaches remain limited by iterative denoising, making multi-view generation expensive at inference time. We introduce NAMVIS, a diffusion-free framework that reformulates multi-view image synthesis as geometry-conditioned next-scale autoregression. Instead of generating target views through repeated denoising, NAMVIS predicts discrete visual tokens through a small number of coarse-to-fine scale steps, while sampling all tokens within each scale and across target views in parallel. To anchor this generation process to explicit camera geometry, we propose Multi-scale Projective Pose Encoding, which injects source and target camera transformations into both target-view self-attention and source-to-target cross-attention at every resolution. NAMVIS further combines global conditioning with dense geometry-aware cross-attention, enabling the model to preserve source-view appearance while maintaining target-view consistency. Across Objaverse, GSO, and OmniObject3D, NAMVIS outperforms diffusion-based baselines in PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, while running over 3 times faster than the evaluated diffusion baselines under the same evaluation setting. These results suggest that geometry-conditioned next-scale autoregression is a promising and efficient alternative to diffusion for sparse-view multi-view synthesis. Additional qualitative results, videos, and resources are available at https://corl-team.github.io/namvis/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NAMVIS 把稀疏视角新视角合成 (sparse-view novel view synthesis) 改写为几何条件化的 next-scale 自回归：不用迭代去噪，而是在少量由粗到细的尺度步内预测离散视觉 token，同一尺度内及跨目标视角的 token 并行采样。在 Objaverse、GSO、OmniObject3D 上 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 均超过所评测的 diffusion 基线，且在相同评测设置下快 3 倍以上。
Motivation: 稀疏视角新视角合成是 3D 内容创作的核心问题，但 diffusion 方法受限于迭代去噪，多视角生成在推理时开销大。
Method: 提出 diffusion-free 框架 NAMVIS：以 Multi-scale Projective Pose Encoding 把源与目标相机变换注入每个分辨率的目标视角 self-attention 和源到目标 cross-attention；再将全局条件化与稠密 geometry-aware cross-attention 结合，在保留源视角外观的同时维持目标视角一致性。
Result: 在 Objaverse、GSO、OmniObject3D 上，PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 均优于所评测的 diffusion 基线；在相同评测设置下推理速度比这些 diffusion 基线快 3 倍以上。
Conclusion: 几何条件化的 next-scale 自回归可作为稀疏视角多视角合成中 diffusion 的高效替代方案。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Knossos and Ariadne: Benchmarking and Learning Complete Diagram Topology Extraction with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Structural diagrams are widely used to represent complex systems and relational information across scientific, engineering, procedural, and spatial domains. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have become increasingly capable of recognizing diagram elements and reasoning about their content, while complete diagram topology extraction remains comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we study diagram-to-graph topology extraction: extracting all diagram entities and the complete relations among them. To enable large-scale supervised training and systematic evaluation of this task, we introduce Knossos, a benchmark of 19,200 diagrams across six diverse domains, with 245,179 nodes and 439,740 edges. Its symbolic generation process provides exact alignment between rendered diagrams and annotations of complete topology, relation types, and connector geometry. To address the modeling challenge of complete topology extraction, we also present Ariadne, a structured framework that decomposes the task into node inventory extraction and source-conditioned edge prediction. Extensive experiments show that training on Knossos substantially improves complete topology extraction in smaller open-source VLMs. Ariadne further improves over one-step extraction under matched supervision, demonstrating the additional benefit of structured decomposition. It achieves the highest average Edge F1 among the evaluated methods on Knossos, while both backbone variants also improve over their unadapted counterparts on the real-world external benchmark. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/bangwayne/knossos_Ariadne_Public.

papers.title: Learning to Clarify Underspecified Intents Under Limited Interaction
papers.abstract_en: AI assistants receive requests that leave out information needed for a good outcome, for example about users' preferences or goals. They must then either speculate or ask for more information before proceeding. We reconceptualize this as a value-of-information problem: the assistant should acquire information whose absence causes the greatest avoidable loss in user utility. This is rarely known ex ante; rather, assistants must predict it in order to optimally allocate limited user interactions. We instantiate this problem in image generation and derive a reinforcement learning framework using multi-turn simulated users to maximize utility recovery under uncertainty. In a preregistered study with 456 interactive sessions across 76 human participants, this helped users significantly better match reference images with significantly fewer questions, less total interaction time, and lower cost. This points toward a simple and scalable framework for training language model assistants to better disambiguate user intent by asking more informative questions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 AI 助手的澄清提问重构为信息价值 (value-of-information) 问题：预测哪些缺失信息最能避免用户效用损失，并在图像生成任务上用多轮模拟用户的强化学习框架学习何时问、问什么。在 76 名参与者的 456 次预注册交互实验中，该方法让用户更显著地贴近参考图像，同时提问更少、总交互时间更短、成本更低。
Motivation: 助手面对欠明确的用户请求时只能猜测或追问，但哪些信息缺失造成的效用损失最大事先未知，导致有限的交互预算被浪费在低价值问题上。
Method: 将澄清建模为 value-of-information 问题，实例化在图像生成场景；用多轮模拟用户 (simulated users) 构建强化学习框架，在不确定性下最大化效用恢复 (utility recovery)，并以预注册研究在真实用户上检验。
Result: 预注册研究覆盖 456 次交互会话、76 名人类参与者：相较对照，用户匹配参考图像的程度显著更好，同时显著更少的提问次数、更短的总交互时间和更低的成本。
Conclusion: 以信息价值驱动的提问策略可以在减少交互开销的同时提升意图对齐，作者认为这是训练语言模型助手做更有效消歧的简单且可扩展的框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Automatically Pruning Logging Code with Coding Agents: How Far Are We?
papers.abstract_en: Logging code supports debugging, monitoring, and software maintenance, but excessive logging can add noise, impose runtime overhead, and obscure diagnostic information. While prior research has extensively studied logging code generation and modification, logging removal remains comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we study developer logging removal practices and explore the use of coding agents for this task. We extract and manually validate logging removal cases from Python and Java repositories and derive 10 removal patterns and 11 removal reasons that characterize how and why logging code was removed in real-world software changes. We further construct LogRem, a dataset of 387 real-world cases covering direct logging statement removal, logging infrastructure removal, and logging replacement. We evaluate four coding agents with multiple model settings and compare their outputs with accepted real-world changes. Although 95.6% to 100.0% of outputs pass validity checks, only 11.1% to 19.6% remove the same logging code as the corresponding real-world change while preserving unrelated code. Agents differ through missed removals, extra removals, and unrelated code edits, with substantial variation across logging removal categories and trajectories. Execution cost varies widely, but higher cost does not consistently yield closer alignment. Commit messages and developer discussions provide the largest alignment gains, while taxonomy guidance consistently reduces runtime. Overall, our study establishes logging removal as a distinct software maintenance task and shows that reliable automation depends on accurately determining removal scope while preserving necessary code. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to examine logging code removal from this perspective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把日志删除确立为独立的软件维护任务：从 Python/Java 仓库抽取并人工校验真实删除案例，归纳 10 种删除模式与 11 类删除原因，构建 LogRem 数据集（387 个真实案例）。用四个 coding agent 在多种模型设置下与真实改动对比，95.6%–100.0% 的输出通过有效性检查，但只有 11.1%–19.6% 能删对同一段日志且不动无关代码；提交信息与开发者讨论带来最大对齐增益，taxonomy 指引则稳定降低运行时开销。
Motivation: 日志生成与修改已有大量研究，但日志删除（logging removal）长期被忽视；过度日志带来噪声、运行时开销并掩盖诊断信息，而 agent 能否准确判断删除范围尚不清楚。
Method: 从 Python 与 Java 仓库抽取并人工校验日志删除案例，归纳 10 种删除模式与 11 类删除原因，据此构建 LogRem 数据集（387 个真实案例，覆盖直接删除日志语句、删除日志基础设施、日志替换三类）；用四个 coding agent 在多种模型设置下生成删除改动，与真实被接受的改动比对，并考察提交信息、开发者讨论与 taxonomy 指引等上下文的作用。
Result: 四个 agent 的输出有 95.6% 到 100.0% 通过有效性检查，但只有 11.1% 到 19.6% 删掉了与真实改动相同的日志代码且保留了无关代码；失败模式包括漏删、多删与无关代码编辑，且在不同删除类别和轨迹间差异明显。执行成本差异很大，但成本更高并不稳定带来更接近真实改动的对齐；提交信息与开发者讨论带来最大对齐增益，taxonomy 指引则一致降低运行时。
Conclusion: 日志删除是一个独立的软件维护任务，可靠自动化的关键在于准确判定删除范围并保留必要代码；据作者所知，这是首个从该视角审视日志代码删除的研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GPU-Accelerated Bregman Douglas-Rachford Splitting for Discrete Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: We present GPU-accelerated Bregman Douglas--Rachford splitting algorithm (BDRS) for discrete optimal transport problem in three input formats: an explicit cost matrix, a point cloud with a ground cost between them, and a separable cost on a regular grid. For each input format, we propose hardware-aware designs of mathematically equivalent representations for the BDRS iterations to enhance numerical stability and empirical runtime. We benchmark the three proposed implementations against eight GPU baseline solvers from the literature on the same device. We demonstrate that our implementations of BDRS achieve state-of-the-art performance on their respective input formats. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first cross-solver study of GPU DOT solvers with a unified measure of optimality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GPU 加速的 Bregman Douglas–Rachford splitting (BDRS) 求解离散最优传输 (discrete optimal transport)，支持显式代价矩阵、点云加 ground cost、规则网格可分代价三种输入格式，并为每种格式设计数值等价但硬件友好的迭代表示以提升稳定性与实测运行时间。在同一 GPU 设备上与文献中八个 GPU 基线求解器对比，三种实现各自在对应输入格式上达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 离散最优传输求解器在 GPU 上的既有实现分散于不同输入格式与最优性度量，缺少统一口径的横向比较，硬件友好的迭代形式设计也未被系统化。
Method: 对 BDRS 迭代给出针对三种输入格式（显式 cost matrix、点云 ground cost、规则网格可分代价）的硬件感知等价表示，兼顾数值稳定性与实测运行时间；在同一设备上与八个文献中的 GPU 基线求解器做统一最优性度量的交叉评测。
Result: 三种 BDRS 实现在各自输入格式上达到 state-of-the-art 性能；对比对象为同一设备上的八个 GPU 基线求解器，采用统一的最优性度量，为已知首个 GPU DOT 求解器的 cross-solver 研究；论文含 3 张表、7 张图、40 页。
Conclusion: BDRS 的硬件感知等价重写能在三种 DOT 输入格式上同时拿到数值稳定性与最优运行表现，而统一最优性度量的跨求解器评测本身是该领域首个。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Organising Trajectory Evidence for Language-Model Agent Assurance: Fragments, Methods, and the Residual
papers.abstract_en: Methods for assessing language-model agents include rule checkers over logs, analyses of skill coverage and composition, support checkers, prefix monitors, execution gates, and rare-event estimators. Each observes a different part of a run and makes a claim of a different strength, and no common account says how these claims combine or what they leave unchecked. We give one, built from a logic, information fragments, and an assurance ledger. Requirements are formulas of a two-tier logic: an outer finite-trace temporal logic over recorded events, and an inner logic of standing over the argument structure that the agent's recorded context supports at a decision. A rule violation and an action taken on withdrawn support are thus formulas of one language. The information available to an assessor, to the agent, and to an execution gate defines fragments of that language; each checking method decides one fragment and returns a typed claim: exact, on a named test suite, a risk bound, or descriptive. The ledger merges the evidence and classifies every obligation as established, addressed but not established, or unaddressed. On 456 released $τ^2$-bench telecom trajectories, the benchmark oracle flags 231 runs; adding a rule checker, a support stand-in, and a prefix-monitor baseline raises the union to 391, 401, and 407, each contributing flags the others miss, and a gate makes one prohibition exact on a gated deployment. The 49 unflagged runs and the unmet or unaddressed obligations form the residual. Discovery makes unknown requirements explicit, and new or stronger checkers then reduce it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为语言模型 agent 的轨迹证据给出统一账本：用双层逻辑（外层有限轨迹时序逻辑 + 内层“论据支撑是否仍 standing”逻辑）把规则检查、支撑检查、前缀监控等异构检查器的结论写成同一语言，按 exact / 测试套件 / 风险界 / 描述性四类定型，并把每条义务归为 established、addressed but not established 或 unaddressed。在 456 条 τ²-bench telecom 轨迹上，基准 oracle 标记 231 条，叠加规则检查、支撑替身与前缀监控基线后并集升至 391、401、407，各自贡献他人漏掉的标记；剩余 49 条未标记轨迹与未满足义务构成 residual。
Motivation: 规则检查、技能覆盖分析、支撑检查、前缀监控、执行门与稀有事件估计各自只看运行的一部分、断言强度也不同，没有共同框架说明这些断言如何合并、又留下了哪些未检查项。
Method: 需求写成双层逻辑的公式：外层是覆盖记录事件的有限轨迹时序逻辑，内层刻画决策处 agent 记录上下文所支撑的 standing；评估者、agent、执行门各自可见的信息定义该语言的 fragments，每种检查方法判定一个 fragment 并返回带类型的 claim（exact、named test suite 上、risk bound、descriptive）；assurance ledger 合并证据并给每条义务分类，执行门可使某条禁令在 gated deployment 上变 exact。
Result: 在 456 条已发布的 τ²-bench telecom 轨迹上，benchmark oracle 标记 231 条；加入规则检查器、支撑替身 (support stand-in) 与前缀监控基线后，标记并集依次升到 391、401、407，三者各自贡献其他方法漏掉的标记；执行门使一条禁令在 gated deployment 上成为 exact；49 条未被标记的轨迹与未满足/未处理的义务构成 residual。
Conclusion: 不同检查器的断言可以用一个双层逻辑与 assurance ledger 合并，且 discovery 把未知需求显式化后，新增或更强的检查器会持续压缩 residual。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 需求写成双层逻辑的公式：外层是覆盖记录事件的有限轨迹时序逻辑，内层刻画决策处 agent 记录上下文所支撑的 standing；评估者、agent、执行门各自可见的信息定义该语言的 fragments，每种检查方法判定一个 fragment 并返回带类型的 claim（exact、named test suite 上、risk bound、descriptive）；assurance ledger 合并证据并给每条义务分类，执行门可使某条禁令在 gated deployment 上变 exact。
summary_sections.result: 在 456 条已发布的 τ²-bench telecom 轨迹上，benchmark oracle 标记 231 条；加入规则检查器、支撑替身 (support stand-in) 与前缀监控基线后，标记并集依次升到 391、401、407，三者各自贡献其他方法漏掉的标记；执行门使一条禁令在 gated deployment 上成为 exact；49 条未被标记的轨迹与未满足/未处理的义务构成 residual。
summary_sections.conclusion: 不同检查器的断言可以用一个双层逻辑与 assurance ledger 合并，且 discovery 把未知需求显式化后，新增或更强的检查器会持续压缩 residual。

papers.title: Localized Operator Learning with Adaptive Partition-of-Unity Mixture-of-Expert Networks
papers.abstract_en: Operator learning methods such as DeepONets and FNOs often struggle with PDE families featuring sharp interfaces, heterogeneous coefficients, and localized multiscale structures. We introduce a partition-of-unity (POU) mixture-of-experts framework for localized operator learning, in which geometry-aware gating networks produce smooth spatial partitions which blend the contributions of local expert networks. Our main contribution is HiRefPOU, a residual-style hierarchical POU architecture for DeepONets that organizes localized representations through nested parent-child partitions while preserving global continuity. We also show that the same POU principle can be incorporated into Fourier Neural Operators to introduce spatial adaptivity without modifying the underlying spectral layers. On heterogeneous Darcy and reaction-diffusion benchmarks, HiRefPOU achieves substantially lower error than global DeepONet and static POU-MoE baselines, while the broader operator-learning experiments show that the benefits of localization depend on the PDE structure and the chosen neural-operator backbone. The learned partitions are interpretable and align with interfaces and regions of rapid solution variation. These results show that explicit geometric localization can improve both accuracy and interpretability in neural operator learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分区统一 (partition-of-unity, POU) 混合专家算子学习框架：几何感知 gating 网络生成平滑空间划分，加权混合局部专家网络，主贡献是 DeepONet 的残差式层级架构 HiRefPOU，用嵌套父子分区组织局部表示并保持全局连续。在非均质 Darcy 与 reaction-diffusion 基准上，HiRefPOU 误差显著低于全局 DeepONet 和静态 POU-MoE 基线，且学到的分区与解的界面和快速变化区对齐。
Motivation: DeepONet、FNO 等算子学习方法在含尖锐界面、非均质系数和局部多尺度结构的 PDE 族上表现不佳，全局表示难以刻画局部剧烈变化。
Method: 几何感知 gating 网络输出平滑空间分区，按分区权重混合多个局部专家网络；HiRefPOU 为 DeepONet 的残差式层级 POU 架构，用嵌套父子分区组织局部表示并保持全局连续；同一 POU 原理也可嵌入 Fourier Neural Operator，在不改动底层谱层的前提下引入空间自适应。
Result: 在非均质 Darcy 和 reaction-diffusion 基准上，HiRefPOU 误差显著低于全局 DeepONet 与静态 POU-MoE 基线；更广泛的算子学习实验显示，局部化的收益取决于 PDE 结构与所选神经算子骨干；学到的分区可解释，与界面及解快速变化区域对齐。
Conclusion: 显式几何局部化能同时提升神经算子学习的精度与可解释性，但收益大小取决于 PDE 结构和骨干网络选择。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: VoCa: Designing Speech-Canvas Interaction for Voice-Based Conversational Agents
papers.abstract_en: People write and sketch while speaking to explain, organize, and develop content together. Inspired by these practices, we investigate how voice agents can use a canvas alongside speech in multi-turn conversations with users. We conducted a two-part formative study: an observational study of how pairs coordinated speech and boardwork, followed by a design workshop that informed a design space for speech-canvas interaction with voice agents. Building on these insights, we developed VoCa, a voice agent that coordinates speech with visual object creation, annotation, and attention guidance. A five-day deployment with 18 participants examined usability, experiences of speech-canvas interaction, patterns of use, and desired improvements. Participants' experiences highlighted opportunities for speech-canvas interaction in learning, work, and daily life, alongside challenges in coordinating what agents say and show in ways users can follow and influence. These findings inform how voice agents can use a canvas alongside speech in conversation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VoCa 是一个在多轮对话中把语音与画布操作协调起来的语音 agent：它在说话的同时创建视觉对象、加注释并引导用户注意力。两阶段形成性研究（观察配对协作 + 设计工作坊）定义了 speech-canvas 交互的设计空间，随后 5 天、18 人部署检验可用性与使用模式，发现学习、工作与日常场景中有明确机会，但 agent 说什么与展示什么的协调仍难被用户跟随和影响。
Motivation: 人们边说边写边画来共同组织内容，而现有语音 agent 只有语音通道，无法在多轮对话中同步呈现、标注和引导视觉内容，用户难以跟随或干预 agent 展示的东西。
Method: 两阶段形成性研究：先观察配对用户如何协调语音与板书，再办设计工作坊导出 speech-canvas 交互的设计空间；据此实现 VoCa，让语音与视觉对象创建、注释、注意力引导协同；最后做 5 天部署，18 名参与者评估可用性、使用模式与期望改进。
Result: 5 天部署覆盖 18 名参与者，考察可用性、speech-canvas 交互体验、使用模式与期望改进；参与者经验显示该交互在学习、工作和日常生活中存在应用机会，同时暴露 agent 说与展示的协调挑战。
Conclusion: 语音 agent 可以在对话中把画布作为语音的伴随通道使用，但说与展示的同步协调是决定用户能否跟随和影响内容的关键问题。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Neurodiversity-Aware Multimodal Affective Computing for Neurodevelopmental Assessment: From Norm-Referenced Classification to Context-Sensitive Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: Automated neurodevelopmental assessment increasingly combines computer vision, speech, eye tracking, physiology, and machine learning, yet multimodality and discrimination do not establish construct validity, clinical usefulness, or appropriate interpretation of behavioral variation. We propose a testable architecture for neurodiversity-aware multimodal affective computing in which population-relative deviation is not treated as sufficient evidence of adverse functioning. This conceptual article reports neither a new participant-level study nor a trained predictive system, and no predictive or clinical superiority is claimed. The framework keeps observable signals, modality quality and availability, context, population-relative information, pooled within-person references and, when sufficiently supported, context-conditioned within person references, and predictive uncertainty distinguishable throughout inference. It defines structured decision-support outputs and auditable requirements for target validity, temporal integrity, contextual leakage, missing-modality robustness, calibration, subgroup evaluation, interpretability, privacy, and human decision boundaries. The contribution is architectural rather than algorithmic: it specifies empirically testable constraints that can be instantiated with different multimodal learning methods. Autism provides the principal motivating evidence base, without assuming unchanged transfer to other neurodevelopmental conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个神经多样性感知的多模态情感计算架构，把人群相对偏差 (population-relative deviation) 与个体内部参照、模态质量、上下文和预测不确定性在推理全程保持可区分，避免把偏离常模直接当作功能受损证据。该文是概念性架构工作，明确声明未做受训预测系统、未主张预测或临床优越性，贡献在于给出可被不同多模态学习方法实例化的可检验约束。
Motivation: 多模态与判别能力并不等于构念效度、临床有用性或对行为差异的恰当解释，而现有神经发育评估系统常把人群相对偏差当作功能受损的充分证据。
Method: 架构在推理中区分可观测信号、模态质量与可得性、上下文、人群相对信息、合并的个体内部参照，以及在证据充分时的上下文条件化个体内部参照与预测不确定性；并定义结构化决策支持输出与可审计要求，覆盖目标效度、时间完整性、上下文泄漏、缺失模态鲁棒性、校准、亚组评估、可解释性、隐私与人机决策边界。
Result: 概念性文章，未报告受训预测系统或参与者级研究；产出为可实例化的架构约束与可审计要求清单，以自闭症 (autism) 为主要动机证据基础。
Conclusion: 神经发育评估应把人群相对偏差与个体内部参照、上下文和不确定性分开处理，并以可检验的架构约束而非特定算法来保证临床可用性；对其他神经发育障碍的迁移不作假设。

papers.title: Learning Discriminative Geometry for Drifting Models
papers.abstract_en: Recently proposed Drifting Models shift iterative distribution refinement from inference to training, enabling effective one-step generation. However, their performance on complex image datasets depends strongly on the representation used to construct the drifting field: pixel-space drifting performs poorly, whereas pretrained feature spaces substantially improve sample quality for reasons that remain unclear. We trace this gap to the discriminative geometry of the representation, which determines sample weighting in kernel density estimation (KDE) and, consequently drift. We introduce persistent representation learning, which continuously learns a more discriminative representation geometry as the generator evolves across batches. We further establish a current-step gradient equivalence between the KDE ratio loss and drift regression loss under matched conditions, connecting density-ratio-based generator optimization to empirical drifting and motivating direct control of the drifting velocity. Across multiple datasets, our method learns effective discriminative representations directly from pixels and reduces FID by approximately $82-95\%$ over the original pixel-space Drifting Models, without pretrained encoders. Adapting pretrained representations and applying velocity clipping provide further gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Drifting Models 的像素空间漂移效果差，根因在于表示的判别几何决定了 KDE 样本加权与漂移方向。提出 persistent representation learning，随生成器跨批次演化持续学习更具判别力的表示几何，并证明匹配条件下 KDE ratio loss 与 drift regression loss 的当前步梯度等价，从而直接控制漂移速度。在多个数据集上从像素直接学到有效判别表示，FID 相对原始像素空间 Drifting Models 下降约 82–95%，无需预训练编码器。
Motivation: Drifting Models 把迭代分布精化从推理移到训练以实现有效单步生成，但其在复杂图像数据集上的表现强烈依赖构造漂移场的表示：像素空间漂移表现差、预训练特征空间显著改善，而原因尚不清楚。
Method: 把该差距追溯到表示的判别几何（它决定 KDE 中的样本加权并进而决定漂移），提出 persistent representation learning 随生成器跨批次演化持续学习更具判别力的表示几何；并证明匹配条件下 KDE ratio loss 与 drift regression loss 的当前步梯度等价，把基于 density-ratio 的生成器优化与经验漂移联系起来，进而直接控制漂移速度（drifting velocity），另加预训练表示适配与 velocity clipping。
Result: 在多个数据集上，该方法直接从像素学到有效判别表示，FID 相对原始像素空间 Drifting Models 下降约 82–95%，且不使用预训练编码器；适配预训练表示与 velocity clipping 带来进一步增益。
Conclusion: Drifting Models 的像素空间劣势源于表示的判别几何而非漂移机制本身，持续学习判别几何即可在无预训练编码器下取得强生成质量，速度控制与表示适配还能继续加成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Decouple, Purify and Unite: Semantic-Structural Prototype Learning for Federated Medical Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning enables medical institutions to train a global model without sharing data, yet feature heterogeneity from diverse scanners or protocols remains challenging. Existing representation-based methods face two limitations: 1) Incomplete Contextual Representation Learning: single-layer or coupled representations overlook multi-level structural cues and entangle regional semantics with boundary details. 2) Layerwise Style and Aggregation Biases: domain-specific style discrepancies across intermediate layers degrade prototypes, while aggregation that overlooks client distribution shifts can further amplify bias. We propose FedBCS+, federated decoupled contextual alignment with style-purified aggregation. We employ Frequency-domain Style Recalibration (FSR) in prototype construction to decouple content-style representations and extract style-purified prototypes. Built upon these purified features, Decoupled Contextual Prototype Alignment (DCPA) explicitly decouples multi-level features into semantic and structural prototypes and aligns regional semantics and fine-grained anatomical structures separately. Style-purified Semantic Prototype Aggregation (S2PA) measures each client's purified prototype divergence from the global consensus and adaptively reweights aggregation toward under-represented clients to reduce consensus bias. On five heterogeneous medical segmentation benchmarks spanning histopathology, MRI, ultrasound, and colonoscopy, FedBCS+ achieves the highest mean Dice among the compared methods. A convergence analysis further characterizes how aggregation and alignment affect the optimization bound.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 联邦学习让医疗机构不共享数据即可训练全局模型，但不同扫描仪与协议带来的特征异质性仍是难题：现有基于表示的方法要么把区域语义与边界细节纠缠在单层或耦合表示中，要么受各中间层风格差异与忽略客户端分布偏移的聚合放大偏差。

Result: 在五个异质医学分割基准（横跨 histopathology、MRI、ultrasound、colonoscopy）上，FedBCS+ 在所比较方法中取得最高 mean Dice；另有收敛分析给出聚合与对齐如何影响优化上界。

papers.title: Not Self-Decidable: LLMs Cannot Draw the Boundary of What an Agent Verifier Can Check
papers.abstract_en: A verifier for an agent faces rules of two kinds: the ones a fixed check can settle and the ones that require a judge. A team that derives its own checks fixes that split up front. Where the requirements come from outside, as in finance, healthcare and law, the agent enforces rules it did not write, so the split falls to runtime, recurring for every predicate of every rule on every action at a rate no reviewer can audit. Every escalation scheme assumes a model can make that decision itself, that it is self-decidable. Across six corpora, including the EU AI Act, FINRA guidance and a deployed credit agent, we collect roughly 22,000 labels from four models built by three labs. They agree almost perfectly where the answer is obvious and collapse on regulatory text; their errors run in opposite directions, so no model can be trusted as the conservative choice; and on the deployed agent's own rule-set they err together, over-claiming that a fixed check will do, the direction that never gets escalated. We introduce CoVer (corroborate-then-verify), which treats unanimity as a nomination, admitting a predicate only when the check synthesized for it survives intervention, reading fields the agent cannot write and holding under deterministic rewording. That gate rejects most of what corroboration wrongly admits, at a cost in coverage we report rather than tune away. The obvious alternative, agreement with a reference judge, certifies nothing: it climbs from 30% to 77% across calibration bands while the genuinely decidable share does not move, because a judge drawn from the population under indictment ratifies the blind spot it shares. Self-decidability is not a capability to elicit from a model but a boundary the verifier must construct.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Who Verifies the Agents? Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Workshop papers are non-archival. 21 pages (9 content pages plus references and appendices)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张：LLM 无法自行判定哪些规则谓词可由固定检查 (fixed check) 判定，agent 验证器必须主动构造这条边界。在六个语料、约 22,000 条标注上，四个模型在监管文本上分歧崩溃且错误方向相反；提出的 CoVer（corroborate-then-verify）以一致性为提名、仅放行经干预检验存活的合成检查，拒掉多数一致性误纳但牺牲覆盖率。
Motivation: 当规则来自外部（金融、医疗、法律）时，agent 执行自己未撰写的规则，可判定与需人工裁决的划分只能在运行时对每条规则的每个谓词反复做出，速率超出任何审查者的审计能力；而现有升级方案都默认模型能自行做这一判定（self-decidable）。
Method: 在六个语料（含 EU AI Act、FINRA 指引与一个已部署的 credit agent）上收集约 22,000 条标注，来自三家实验室的四个模型。提出 CoVer（corroborate-then-verify）：把全体一致仅当作提名，谓词只有在为其合成的检查通过干预检验（读取 agent 无法写入的字段、在确定性改写下仍成立）时才被接纳；并以与参考裁判 (reference judge) 的一致率作为对照校准带。
Result: 四个模型在答案显然处几乎完全一致，在监管文本上一致崩溃，且错误方向相反，没有任何模型可作为保守选择；在已部署 agent 自身规则集上它们同向出错，共同高估固定检查可判定的比例（即永不被升级的方向）。参考裁判一致率在校准带上从 30% 升至 77%，而真正可判定的份额不动。CoVer 拒绝了多数被一致性错误接纳的谓词，代价是覆盖率下降（摘要称报告而非调掉该代价）。
Conclusion: 自可判定性不是可从模型中激发的能力，而是验证器必须构造的边界；用与参考裁判的一致性做认证等于让被指控群体内部的裁判批准其共同盲区，因此不构成任何保证。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Score-Calibrated Flow for Sampling from Unnormalized Densities with Applications to Generative Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow models provide expressive policy classes for online reinforcement learning (RL), enabling multimodal behaviors and improved performance. However, training these policies remains challenging: the critic specifies the desired policy as an unnormalized Boltzmann density but does not provide direct samples from it. Many existing methods rely on importance sampling to construct training signals, which can suffer from high variance, increasing computational cost and destabilizing training. We propose Score-Calibrated Flow (SCF), a simple and efficient algorithm for training generative models to sample from unnormalized densities without importance sampling or backpropagation through the sampling trajectory. We learn the desired flow by enforcing self-consistency, bypassing target posterior mean estimation. By jointly exploiting the prescribed target score and the structure of flow matching, we establish these self-consistency requirements as score-calibrated optimality conditions, first for the terminal density and then for the trainable velocity field. We prove that their unique solutions are, respectively, the target density and the ideal flow model that conditional flow matching (CFM) would recover if target samples were available. We formulate the velocity condition as a fixed-point equation and exploit its conditional-expectation structure to construct a stop-gradient objective for enforcing it. The resulting training procedure retains the scalable sample-interpolate-regress structure of CFM despite the absence of target samples, using endpoints generated by the current flow. For online RL, the critic gradient supplies the target score at the generated actions, yielding a direct approach to actor training. Experiments on RL benchmarks demonstrate that SCF matches or improves upon state-of-the-art generative-policy baselines, while substantially reducing training time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Score-Calibrated Flow (SCF)，用自洽性条件把未归一化 Boltzmann 密度的采样转成 score 校准的最优性条件，无需重要性采样或对采样轨迹反传。在线 RL 中 critic 梯度直接给出生成动作处的 target score，训练保留 CFM 的 sample-interpolate-regress 结构；在 RL 基准上匹配或改进 SOTA 生成式策略基线并大幅缩短训练时间。
Motivation: 扩散/流模型作为在线 RL 策略类表达力强，但 critic 只给出未归一化的 Boltzmann 目标密度、无法直接采样；依赖重要性采样的训练信号方差高、算力开销大且训练不稳。
Method: SCF 联合利用给定的 target score 与 flow matching 结构，把自洽性要求建立为 score 校准最优性条件（先对终端密度、再对可训练速度场）；证明其唯一解分别是目标密度与 CFM 在有目标样本时的理想流模型。将速度场条件写成不动点方程，利用其条件期望结构构造 stop-gradient 目标，用当前流生成的端点训练，绕过目标后验均值估计。
Result: 在 RL 基准实验中，SCF 匹配或改进 SOTA 生成式策略基线，同时大幅降低训练时间。
Conclusion: 不依赖重要性采样与轨迹反传，也能恢复 CFM 在有目标样本时的理想流模型，从而让生成式策略训练更稳更快。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Low-Fidelity FDM Spectral Guidance for Neural Eigenvalue Solvers
papers.abstract_en: Operator eigenvalue problems appear throughout science. Classical methods usually discretize the operator into a matrix and then solve the resulting matrix eigenvalue problem. This works well in low dimensions, but fine grids quickly become expensive in both memory and computation as the dimension grows. Neural network based solvers avoid storing these large grids, but recent state of the art neural methods can require hundreds of thousands of training steps and may struggle to find the desired eigenvalues. We show that the two approaches can help each other. A coarse finite difference method (FDM) calculation acts as a cheap numerical model of the operator spectrum. We use the approximate eigenvalues as fixed shifts during the training of the neural solver, as they only need to locate the relevant part of the spectrum. We also introduce Stabilized Inverse Power Method Neural Network (SIPMNN), a more stable training procedure for higher-dimensional problems. Across five test problems at $d=10$, the combined approach is more accurate overall than the tested fully neural alternatives while using eight to ten times fewer iterations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用粗网格有限差分法 (FDM) 给出的近似特征值作为神经特征值求解器训练时的固定位移，使网络只需定位谱的相关区段；并提出更稳定的高维训练流程 SIPMNN。在 d=10 的五个测试问题上，该组合整体比所测全神经方法更准，迭代次数少 8–10 倍。
Motivation: 经典离散化在高维细网格上内存与计算开销急剧增长，而现有神经求解器往往需要数十万步训练且不易命中目标特征值。
Method: 先用粗网格 FDM 低成本算出算子谱的近似特征值，将其作为固定位移 (fixed shifts) 注入神经求解器训练，使其只需定位相关谱段；另提出 Stabilized Inverse Power Method Neural Network (SIPMNN) 以稳定高维训练。
Result: 在五个测试问题、d=10 的设置下，组合方法整体比所测全神经替代方案更准确，且训练迭代次数减少 8 至 10 倍。
Conclusion: 数值离散与神经求解可以互补：粗 FDM 谱信息加稳定化训练能在高维特征值问题上同时提高精度并大幅压缩训练迭代。
