papers.title: Penumbra: Sample-Efficient Adversarial Search for Regulatory Obligations
papers.abstract_en: Agents are entering finance, healthcare and law, sectors where a violation leaves no lexical signature and carries real penalties. Whether an omission is material, or a disclosure sufficient, depends on what the response left out. Probing such an obligation means finding responses one minimal edit from flipping compliance, and every probe costs a generation and two adjudications, so the binding constraint on regulatory red-teaming is sample efficiency, not volume. We introduce Penumbra, an adversarial search that walks from a verified anchor under an expanding edit budget until a two-evaluator committee changes its verdict, and emits the two adjacent responses that straddle the change. Allocation is adaptive, and the objective is coverage of the defeat surface: distinct (obligation x defeat mode) cells resolved per candidate. At matched budget, adaptive allocation reaches uniform allocation's full-budget coverage on 59% of the candidates; at equal records it covers 1.43x the defeat modes of naive enumeration, and the gain is confined to the axis it targets. On 60 screened obligations of a financial advisory constitution, Penumbra returns 144 pairs, each a compliant and a violating response that the committee places on opposite sides of the boundary, differing by a handful of words where a model asked for both directly produces texts sharing almost nothing. A second constitution, for clinical triage, reproduces this on 18 obligations: 49 pairs at the same tightness, with the same modes hardest. Pairs like these show where an obligation's own terms stop deciding, which is what an agent deployed under it must be tested against, and the search finds them at a cost that scales with the boundary, not the text.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust) at NeurIPS 2026. Workshop papers are non-archival. 12 pages (4 content pages plus references and appendices)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Penumbra 是面向监管义务的对抗搜索：从已验证锚点出发，在逐步扩大的编辑预算内游走，直到双评估员委员会翻转裁决，输出跨越合规边界的一对相邻响应。在 60 项金融咨询宪法义务上返回 144 对、临床分诊宪法 18 项义务上返回 49 对；同等预算下自适应分配在 59% 候选上达到均匀分配的全预算覆盖，同等记录数下覆盖 1.43 倍的违规模式。
Motivation: 金融、医疗、法律中的违规响应不留词面痕迹，判定取决于回答遗漏了什么；每次探测都要一次生成加两次裁决，因此监管红队的瓶颈是样本效率而非搜索量。
Method: 从已验证锚点出发，在扩张编辑预算内做对抗游走，直到双评估员委员会 (two-evaluator committee) 改判，输出跨越边界的一对相邻响应；分配是自适应的，目标函数为 defeat surface 覆盖率，即每个候选解决的不同（义务 × 违规模式）格数。
Result: 同等预算下自适应分配在 59% 的候选上达到均匀分配的全预算覆盖；同等记录数下覆盖朴素枚举 1.43 倍的违规模式，且增益只出现在其针对的轴上。在金融咨询宪法 60 项筛选义务上返回 144 对合规/违规响应，仅差几个词；临床分诊宪法 18 项义务上复现 49 对，同样紧致且最难的模式相同。
Conclusion: 监管红队的代价应随边界而非文本长度增长：直接要求模型给出合规与违规对照时产出的两段文本几乎毫无共同点，而边界相邻对才标出义务条款自身停止起作用的位置。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: Penumbra 是面向监管义务的对抗搜索：从已验证锚点出发，在逐步扩大的编辑预算内游走，直到双评估员委员会翻转裁决，输出跨越合规边界的一对相邻响应。在 60 项金融咨询宪法义务上返回 144 对、临床分诊宪法 18 项义务上返回 49 对；同等预算下自适应分配在 59% 候选上达到均匀分配的全预算覆盖，同等记录数下覆盖 1.43 倍的违规模式。
summary_sections.motivation: 金融、医疗、法律中的违规响应不留词面痕迹，判定取决于回答遗漏了什么；每次探测都要一次生成加两次裁决，因此监管红队的瓶颈是样本效率而非搜索量。
summary_sections.method: 从已验证锚点出发，在扩张编辑预算内做对抗游走，直到双评估员委员会 (two-evaluator committee) 改判，输出跨越边界的一对相邻响应；分配是自适应的，目标函数为 defeat surface 覆盖率，即每个候选解决的不同（义务 × 违规模式）格数。
summary_sections.result: 同等预算下自适应分配在 59% 的候选上达到均匀分配的全预算覆盖；同等记录数下覆盖朴素枚举 1.43 倍的违规模式，且增益只出现在其针对的轴上。在金融咨询宪法 60 项筛选义务上返回 144 对合规/违规响应，仅差几个词；临床分诊宪法 18 项义务上复现 49 对，同样紧致且最难的模式相同。

papers.title: RAGStress: A controlled benchmark for evaluating retrieval-augmented generation under knowledge-base degradation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is typically evaluated under the implicit assumption that the underlying knowledge base (KB) is clean, leaving the behaviour of RAG systems under realistic KB degradation poorly characterised. We introduce RAGStress, a controlled evaluation benchmark for stress-testing RAG systems under systematic KB corruption. The benchmark pairs four naturalistic corruption types (factual corruption, numeric typo, relevance poisoning, and contradiction injection) with three severity levels (subtle, moderate, and obvious) over a single-KB, metadata-filtered experimental design built from 57 MMLU subjects and 182,546 documents. Across 52,500 model-question-condition evaluations, RAGStress reveals that clean retrieval can mask robustness differences, semantic-fidelity corruptions are substantially more harmful than signal-utility perturbations, no-retrieval accuracy does not predict corrupted-retrieval robustness, and mixed-KB accuracy should not be treated as worst-case robustness. We document the benchmark's intended use, supported claims, and limitations, and provide an artifact bundle including generation scripts, corruption prompts, metadata schema, and evaluation code. RAGStress is intended as a controlled stress test for RAG robustness under KB corruption, not as a general model leaderboard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAGStress 是一个受控评测基准，用 4 类自然化知识库污染（事实污染、数值 typo、相关性投毒、矛盾注入）× 3 个严重度（subtle、moderate、obvious），在单 KB、带元数据过滤的设计下对 RAG 系统做压力测试。在 57 个 MMLU 学科、182,546 篇文档、52,500 次模型-问题-条件评测中发现：干净检索会掩盖鲁棒性差异，语义保真类污染远比信号效用类扰动更有害，无检索准确率不能预测污染检索下的鲁棒性，混合 KB 准确率不应被当作最坏情况鲁棒性。
Motivation: RAG 评测普遍默认知识库是干净的，而真实 KB 会退化，导致 RAG 系统在 KB 污染下的行为缺乏刻画。
Method: 构建受控基准 RAGStress：4 种污染类型（factual corruption、numeric typo、relevance poisoning、contradiction injection）× 3 个严重度级别（subtle、moderate、obvious），采用单 KB、元数据过滤的实验设计，基于 57 个 MMLU 学科与 182,546 篇文档；共运行 52,500 次模型-问题-条件评测，并附生成脚本、污染 prompt、元数据 schema 与评测代码的 artifact bundle。
Result: 在 52,500 次评测中：干净检索会掩盖鲁棒性差异；语义保真类污染（semantic-fidelity）比信号效用类扰动（signal-utility）危害大得多；无检索准确率不能预测污染检索下的鲁棒性；混合 KB 准确率不能代表最坏情况鲁棒性。
Conclusion: RAG 的鲁棒性必须在受控 KB 污染下单独测量，干净条件下的分数会高估鲁棒性；该基准定位为 KB 污染下的受控压力测试，而非通用模型排行榜。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SepRQ : Self-Supervised Speech Mixture Representation Learning via Mask-Free, Multi-Scale Source Separation
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is standard for speech representation learning, but mainstream models are designed around single-speaker audio, limiting their usefulness in multi-speakers scenarios. We present SepRQ, an open-source SSL framework that replaces masked prediction with a pseudo-source-separation objective over frozen random-projection codebooks. By adopting a novel mask-free, multiresolution approach, SepRQ achieves state-of-the-art performance in Speaker Diarization and Speech Separation on the SUPERB benchmark, surpassing WavLM and other cocktail-party derived SSLs at both Base and Large scales, while requiring only 85.68M inference parameters. SepRQ also demonstrates strong performance across target-speaker tasks requiring enrollment (such as Target-Speaker Automatic Speech Recognition), and on the challenging multi-domain DIHARD 3 diarization dataset. Notably, we report strong separation capabilities on three-speaker mixtures (WSJ0-3Mix), where current SSL literature struggles. While cocktail-party SSLs remain scarce and closed-source, limited to C-HuBERT and the enrollment-based SA-WavLM, we open-source SepRQ to the community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SepRQ 用掩码无关的伪源分离目标替代掩码预测，在冻结的随机投影码本 (random-projection codebooks) 上做多分辨率自监督语音表征学习，面向多说话人场景。在 SUPERB 上于 Speaker Diarization 与 Speech Separation 达到 SOTA，超过 WavLM 与 cocktail-party 系 SSL（Base 与 Large 两档），推理参数仅 85.68M，并在 WSJ0-3Mix 三人混合上给出强分离结果。
Motivation: 主流 SSL 语音模型围绕单说话人音频设计，在多说话人混合场景下受限；现有 cocktail-party SSL（C-HuBERT、基于 enrollment 的 SA-WavLM）稀缺且闭源。
Method: 以伪源分离 (pseudo-source-separation) 任务取代掩码预测，训练目标作用于冻结的随机投影码本，采用 mask-free、多分辨率 (multiresolution) 架构；提供 Base 与 Large 两种规模，开源发布。
Result: SUPERB 上 Speaker Diarization 与 Speech Separation 达到 SOTA，超过 WavLM 及其他 cocktail-party 衍生 SSL（Base 与 Large 均成立），推理参数 85.68M；在需 enrollment 的 target-speaker 任务（如 Target-Speaker ASR）与多域 DIHARD 3 diarization 数据集上表现强；在 WSJ0-3Mix 三人混合上报告强分离能力，而现有 SSL 文献在此困难。
Conclusion: 用分离目标而非掩码预测做多说话人 SSL，可以在更少推理参数下同时提升分离与说话人日志性能，并补上三人混合这一现有 SSL 的短板。

papers.title: When Debate Helps: Proposal Supply and Verification-Aware Readout in Multi-Agent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent debate can improve reasoning, yet often fails to beat simple majority voting. We argue that successful debate requires two distinct mechanisms: proposal supply must surface a correct answer, and readout must identify that answer when voting misses it. We formalize the first requirement through recoverable headroom, which measures cases where a correct proposal is available but the majority answer is wrong. For the second, we develop Latent Verification Debate (LVD), an accounting model in which candidate proposals receive answer-specific verification evidence before final generation. Controlled fixed-proposal interventions estimate this latent effect in equivalent peer-support units and show that correct evidence changes answer probabilities and generated decisions while proposal supply remains fixed. To improve proposal supply, we construct societies from neural-thicket agents using labeled and label-free coverage objectives. Across two backbones and matched-budget reasoning benchmarks, coverage-selected societies increase complementary proposal supply and improve aggregate accuracy in repeated stochastic evaluations. Round-level controls further show that interaction provides gains beyond applying the same finalizer directly to the initial proposals. These results identify proposal coverage and truth-sensitive evidence use as complementary conditions for debate to outperform voting. Code is available at https://github.com/Wang-ML-Lab/when-debate-helps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把多智能体辩论胜过多数投票拆成两个必要条件：提案供给要能覆盖正确答案（recoverable headroom），读出阶段要在多数票漏判时用答案相关的验证证据挑出正确项。据此提出 Latent Verification Debate (LVD) 这一记账模型，并用带标注/无标注覆盖目标构造 neural-thicket 社会；在两个 backbone 与等预算推理基准上，覆盖选择的社会提升互补提案供给与重复随机评测下的聚合准确率。
Motivation: 多智能体辩论常打不过简单的多数投票，作者认为原因是提案供给与读出两个机制被混在一起，缺少可判定的失败归因。
Method: 用 recoverable headroom 形式化提案供给（正确提案已在场但多数票答错的那些情形）；提出 Latent Verification Debate (LVD)，让候选提案在最终生成前获得答案特定的验证证据，并用受控的固定提案干预以等价 peer-support 单位估计该隐含效应；再用带标注与无标注覆盖目标从 neural-thicket agent 构造社会。
Result: 固定提案干预显示正确证据会改变答案概率与生成决策，而提案供给保持不变；两个 backbone、等预算推理基准上，覆盖选择的社会提高互补提案供给并在重复随机评测中提升聚合准确率；轮级控制表明交互带来的增益超出把同一 finalizer 直接用于初始提案。
Conclusion: 提案覆盖与对真值敏感的证据使用是辩论胜过投票的互补条件，二者缺一辩论就退化为多数投票。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: COMPASS: Comet Object Measurement Pipeline with Automated Selection and Scoring
papers.abstract_en: Summary: The single-cell gel electrophoresis ('comet') assay is a widely used technique for quantifying DNA damage at the individual cell level. However, image analysis often relies on manual inspection or semi-automated software, which can be labor-intensive, difficult to reproduce, and sensitive to image quality and comet morphology. COMPASS automates comet assay image analysis by combining deep learning-based comet segmentation with damage measurement and automated comet selection. The pipeline produces standardized DNA damage measurements while offering robust detection, reducing manual effort and improving reproducibility through transparent selection and optional manual review. Availability and implementation: COMPASS is implemented in Python and is freely available at https://github.com/ rsinghlab/COMPASS. Installation instructions, pretrained weights, and example usage are provided in the repository. Contact: jack_roberts2@brown.edu, ritsingh@illinois.edu Supplementary information: Available onlime upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COMPASS 把彗星实验 (comet assay) 图像分析做成全自动流水线：深度学习分割彗星、测量 DNA 损伤并自动挑选合格彗星，输出标准化损伤度量，同时保留可选人工复核以提高可复现性。
Motivation: 彗星实验的图像分析长期依赖人工或半自动软件，劳动密集、难以复现，且对图像质量与彗星形态敏感。
Method: 流水线由深度学习驱动的彗星分割、损伤测量与自动彗星选择三部分组成，以 Python 实现并开源，仓库提供安装说明、预训练权重与示例用法；选择环节透明并支持可选人工复核。
Result: 产出标准化的 DNA 损伤测量，具备稳健检测能力，减少人工工作量并提升可复现性；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 自动化分割加自动选择可以在保留人工复核通道的同时，把彗星实验分析变成可复现、低人工成本的标准化流程。

papers.title: Extracting Persona Subspaces Through Iterative Nullspace Projection For Modulation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) can adopt distinct personas to tune their semantics, expertise, and perspective to different users and tasks. Precise control over these traits is critical to ensure safety and reliability in model behavior. Existing methods like activation steering and prompt-based persona induction reduce a persona to a single dominant direction, missing the finer, nested traits that emerge only once that dominant signal is factored out. We introduce modulation as a setting where the persona context is already embedded in the content being manipulated, requiring control methods to amplify or suppress a trait already present rather than inject it from scratch. PaSS is an inference-time control paradigm that models personas as multi-dimensional subspaces in a model's latent space without supervised contrastive examples. The persona subspaces are extracted via iterative concept erasure and applied to modulate persona-guided generation without retraining. To extract this subspace, we use Iterative Nullspace Projections (INLP) to linearly and iteratively isolate persona-specific directions. We causally evaluate six personas against diverse tasks like MATH-500, TinyAlpaca, GSM8K, and IFEval, showing that discriminative, iterative subspace extraction captures diverse traits underlying a given persona, enabling stronger and larger modulation than single-direction additive methods, while maintaining content fidelity. We further study individual peeled directions within each subspace to uncover the distinct aspects of persona behavior they encode. Overall, we show that persona subspaces offer a controllable, interpretable, and generalizable framework for modulating LLM behavior without sacrificing task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PaSS：用迭代零空间投影 (INLP) 从 LLM 潜空间中逐层剥离出 persona 的多维子空间，在推理时对已嵌入内容的 persona 特征做放大或抑制（modulation），无需监督对比样本、无需重训。对六个 persona 在 MATH-500、TinyAlpaca、GSM8K、IFEval 上的因果评估显示，迭代子空间提取比单方向加性方法带来更强、更大的调制幅度，同时保持内容保真与任务性能。
Motivation: activation steering 与 prompt 式 persona 诱导把 persona 压成单一主方向，丢掉了主信号被剥离后才显现的嵌套细粒度特征；而 modulation 场景要求控制方法放大或抑制已存在的特质，而非从零注入。
Method: PaSS 是推理时控制范式：用 Iterative Nullspace Projections (INLP) 线性、迭代地隔离 persona 特定方向，经反复概念擦除 (concept erasure) 提取多维子空间，再用该子空间调制 persona 引导的生成，全程不重训、不用监督对比样本；另对子空间内逐条被剥离的方向单独分析其编码的行为侧面。
Result: 在六个 persona 上做因果评估，任务覆盖 MATH-500、TinyAlpaca、GSM8K、IFEval；结果显示判别式迭代子空间提取比单方向加性方法实现更强且幅度更大的调制，同时保持内容保真与任务性能。

papers.title: MASBench: Benchmarking LLM-based Multi-Agent Collaboration under Partial Observability
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have progressively evolved into the core of autonomous agents. Building on this progress, LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) coordinate multiple agents into a synergistic team to accomplish complex tasks that exceed the capabilities of individual agents. The effectiveness of such systems depends not only on the agents themselves, but also on how collaboration mechanisms are designed and organized. Note that real-world collaboration is typically partially observable, where each agent can only access partial information about the environment due to physical or privacy-related constraints. However, many existing multi-agent benchmarks assume global observability, and leave limited support for systematically evaluating collaboration mechanisms. To bridge this gap, we introduce MASBench, a multi-agent collaboration benchmark designed under partially observable constraints. It is organized into three progressive task categories: Reasoning, Scheduling, and Game. Through this structure, we progressively evaluate three representative collaboration mechanisms: Protocol, Memory, and Routing. MASBench further provides deterministic evaluation metrics, including performance score, communication cost, and cost effectiveness, to characterize both collaboration outcomes and communication overhead. Experiments across diverse LLM backbones and mechanism configurations offer empirical guidance for effective MAS design. Code is available at: https://github.com/BUPT-GAMMA/MASBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MASBench 是首个在部分可观测约束下系统评测 LLM 多智能体协作机制的基准，含 Reasoning、Scheduling、Game 三类递进任务，覆盖 Protocol、Memory、Routing 三种机制，并给出 performance score、communication cost、cost effectiveness 三项确定性指标。跨多种 LLM backbone 与机制配置的实验为 MAS 设计提供经验性选择依据。
Motivation: 现有大多智能体基准默认全局可观测，而真实协作中各智能体因物理或隐私约束只能看到环境的部分信息，导致协作机制缺乏可系统比较的评测环境。
Method: MASBench 按 Reasoning、Scheduling、Game 三类递进任务组织，逐层评测 Protocol、Memory、Routing 三种代表性协作机制；提供 performance score、communication cost、cost effectiveness 三项确定性指标，同时刻画协作结果与通信开销，并在多种 LLM backbone 与机制配置上运行实验。
Result: 在多样 LLM backbone 与机制配置上给出经验结果，用 performance score、communication cost、cost effectiveness 三项确定性指标刻画协作产出与通信开销；代码发布于 github.com/BUPT-GAMMA/MASBench。
Conclusion: 部分可观测是评测多智能体协作机制的必要设定，MASBench 的三类任务与三项指标可为有效 MAS 设计提供经验性指导。

papers.title: Asking the Crowd the Right Question: Bias-Cancelling Weights for Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: A federated objective is a weighted sum of client risks, and the weights are almost always fixed in advance. We treat them instead as the only instrument of a wisdom-of-crowds mechanism: clients are noisy views of one truth, each seeing it through an independent distortion that is unbiased across the crowd. That the optimal weights are inversely proportional to the clients' error energies is classical; we begin at the question that answer presupposes, which energies belong there and whether a crowd can recover them from itself. Excess risk on the truth is of the exact order of the aggregate bias energy, so no optimizer can repair a bad weight vector; the truth itself is identifiable only up to a linear tilt, so subtracting estimated client biases provably reproduces uniform weighting. The expected per-client second moments, however, are exactly identified from the law of the crowd's disagreement by a well-conditioned linear inversion, a step random-effects meta-analysis cannot take because a source reports once; their realized counterparts are estimable up to an incoherence floor the algorithm can measure. This yields CROWD, which reads the disagreement off the optimization trajectory at no extra cost and matches a Bayesian minimax lower bound in the same constant: per instance as the horizon grows, and unconditionally as the prior becomes diffuse. For arbitrary distortions it stays competitive with the optimal weights, at a ratio governed by a geometric incoherence the algorithm can measure. On real scans split into sites with their own miscalibrated detectors it attains the oracle excess risk; on a companion federation that pulls bias and noise apart, weighting by noise variance is worse than not weighting at all, and CROWD is not.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 联邦学习中客户端权重被当作唯一可调机制：CROWD 从优化轨迹上的客户端分歧（disagreement）反演各客户端的期望二阶矩，从而得到偏差抵消权重。理论上它与 Bayesian minimax 下界在同一常数下匹配，且在真实多站点扫描上达到 oracle excess risk；而在偏差与噪声可分离的对照联邦中，按噪声方差加权比完全不加权更差，CROWD 不会这样。
Motivation: 联邦目标中客户端权重几乎总是事先固定的，而 excess risk 与聚合偏差能量同阶，坏权重无法被优化器补救；同时真值只能被识别到一个线性倾斜，直接减去估计偏差等价于均匀加权。
Method: CROWD：把客户端视为对同一真值的独立无偏失真视图，从优化轨迹读出客户端分歧，用良态线性反演估计各客户端期望二阶矩（realized 版本估计到一个可测的 incoherence floor），据此构造偏差抵消权重；并对照 random-effects meta-analysis 的单次上报限制给出可识别性论证。
Result: excess risk 的量级恰为聚合偏差能量；期望二阶矩由分歧分布良态线性反演精确识别；CROWD 与 Bayesian minimax 下界在同一常数下匹配（horizon 增长时逐实例、先验弥散时无条件）；任意失真下与最优权重的比值由可测的几何 incoherence 控制；在按站点划分、各站点检测器失准的真实扫描上达到 oracle excess risk；在分离偏差与噪声的对照联邦中，按噪声方差加权劣于不加权，而 CROWD 不劣。
Conclusion: 权重是联邦中唯一必须由数据估计的偏差控制旋钮：从分歧反演二阶矩即可逼近最优权重，而按噪声方差加权在偏差存在时可能适得其反。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Tropical Geometry View of Forgetting: A Per-Unit Projector for Knowledge-Preserving Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning a language model on new text degrades what it already does. Replay-free projectors such as Adam-NSCL and GPM forbid one shared subspace of a layer's inputs in every row of the update. The tropical geometry of a ReLU layer shows why this is too coarse. In data space, the units' walls are tropical hypersurfaces whose cells are dual to the upper vertices of a zonotope; in weight space, each old token is a hyperplane, and the tokens cut out a polyhedron, the closure of the weights that keep every token on its side. An exact identity joins the two pictures: the squared change of the layer's output under any weight change splits into in-cell, open-to-closed and closed-to-open terms, and the first two live on the tokens each unit fires on. The identity names a gate-aware per-unit projector, and a budget-separation theorem prices exact protection: it costs a unit the rank of its own open tokens, while a shared subspace pays at least the rank of their union in every row. On OPT-1.3b, where 96% of (token, unit) pairs are closed, the projector forgets less than Adam-NSCL at all six matched budgets from 9 to 60 constrained directions per row, the gap widening from $1.1\times$ to $4.3\times$; with 1/5.5 of the directions it halves the forgetting of Adam-NSCL at GPM's energy threshold. On OPT-6.7b, it matches Adam-NSCL's forgetting at matched budget while learning more. As the theory predicts, the open/closed partition is the operative variable: open tokens beat random, sign-blind and anti-gate token sets on 18 of 18 seed-pairs. In pruning repair, every derivative-based local model of the output error at the dense weights is blind to pairs that open: the minimisers of the gate-weighted objective can leave the polyhedron, the objective's closed-form solution is 1.94 nats worse than no repair on OPT-1.3b, and a convex one-sided penalty bounds the escape.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 ReLU 层的热带几何 (tropical geometry) 把遗忘归因到 token 的 open/closed 门控状态，提出 gate-aware 的 per-unit projector：每个 unit 只保护自己实际 fire 的 token 张成的子空间，而非 Adam-NSCL/GPM 那样在每行禁掉共享子空间。在 OPT-1.3b 上 96% 的 (token, unit) 对是 closed，该 projector 在 9–60 个受限方向/行的六个匹配预算下遗忘均低于 Adam-NSCL，差距从 1.1× 扩大到 4.3×；用 1/5.5 的方向数即在 GPM 能量阈值下把遗忘减半。
Motivation: 免回放 (replay-free) 投影式微调在每行禁掉同一共享子空间，粒度过粗：它不区分哪些 token 对某个 unit 真正是 open，导致保护预算被浪费、遗忘仍高。
Method: 从 ReLU 层的热带超曲面与 zonotope 对偶出发，建立输出平方变化的精确恒等式，分解为 in-cell、open-to-closed、closed-to-open 三项；据此导出 gate-aware per-unit projector 与 budget-separation 定理（保护一个 unit 的代价是其自身 open token 的秩，而共享子空间每行至少付并集的秩），并给出剪枝修复中约束逃逸的凸单侧惩罚。
Result: OPT-1.3b 上 96% 的 (token, unit) 对为 closed，projector 在六个匹配预算（每行 9–60 个受限方向）下遗忘均低于 Adam-NSCL，差距 1.1×→4.3×；以 1/5.5 的方向数在 GPM 能量阈值下遗忘减半。OPT-6.7b 上匹配预算时遗忘与 Adam-NSCL 持平但学到更多。open token 集合在 18/18 个 seed-pair 上胜过 random、sign-blind 与 anti-gate 集合。剪枝修复中，门加权目标的闭式解在 OPT-1.3b 上比不修复差 1.94 nats。
Conclusion: open/closed 划分才是决定遗忘与保护代价的变量：按 unit 自身 fire 的 token 做投影，比共享子空间更省预算且遗忘更少；基于稠密权重处导数的局部误差模型对会翻转 open 的 pair 天生失明，需用凸单侧惩罚限制逃逸。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Efficient Neural Surrogates for Linear Radiation Transport on the Lattice and Hohlraum benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Linear radiation transport equations (RTEs) form the simulation foundations underpinning design and analysis tasks in nuclear engineering, inertial confinement fusion, medical imaging, and astrophysics, but resolving the high-dimensional phase space at engineering fidelity remains expensive enough that outer-loop workflows, such as design optimization, uncertainty quantification, and parameter sweeps, are routinely budget-bound on traditional solvers. Neural surrogates promise to relax this bottleneck by amortizing simulation cost across thousands of downstream queries, but the architectural choices and engineered inductive biases that make a surrogate accurate on one transport problem do not transfer straightforwardly across model families. We benchmark two parameter-matched neural surrogate architectures, the physics-attention Transolver and the multi-scale graph network Bi-Stride Multi-Scale MeshGraphNet (BSMS-MGN), as end-to-end approximations of the final-time particle concentration for the two-dimensional linear RTE on the canonical Lattice and Hohlraum benchmarks. An ablation across Fourier features and region-weighted training loss exposes strongly architecture-dependent inductive-bias preferences, indicating that design choices common to physics-informed surrogate workflows must be revisited per architecture rather than imported across model families, and that downstream utility depends on per-QoI sensitivity rather than a single field-level score. The model training recipe, training data, and evaluation pipeline are released alongside this paper to support reproduction, transfer to related transport problems, and evaluation as amortized forward-model components in larger outer-loop simulation workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在二维线性辐射输运方程 (RTE) 的 Lattice 与 Hohlraum 基准上，参数量对齐地对比了物理注意力 Transolver 与多尺度图网络 BSMS-MGN 两个神经代理，用 Fourier features 与区域加权训练损失的消融揭示强烈依赖架构的归纳偏置偏好。结论是这类设计选择必须按架构重新审视，不能跨模型族照搬，且下游效用取决于逐 QoI 敏感度而非单一场级分数。
Motivation: 核工程、惯性约束聚焦、医学成像与天体物理的外环流程（设计优化、不确定性量化、参数扫描）被传统求解器的相空间分辨率成本卡住预算，而神经代理在某一传输问题上学到的架构与归纳偏置并不能直接迁移到其他模型族。
Method: 对二维线性 RTE 的最终时刻粒子浓度做端到端逼近，比较两个参数量对齐的架构：物理注意力 Transolver 与 Bi-Stride Multi-Scale MeshGraphNet (BSMS-MGN)，在 Lattice 和 Hohlraum 两个基准上运行；消融维度为 Fourier features 与区域加权训练损失 (region-weighted training loss)。训练配方、训练数据与评测管线随文发布。
Result: 消融显示归纳偏置偏好强烈依赖架构，即在某一架构上有效的设计选择不迁移到另一架构；下游效用由逐 QoI 敏感度决定，而非单一的场级分数。
Conclusion: 物理信息代理工作流中通行的设计选择必须按架构逐一重审，跨模型族照搬会失效；评测应以逐 QoI 敏感度为准，发布的数据与管线用于向相关传输问题迁移。

summary_sections.motivation: 核工程、惯性约束聚焦、医学成像与天体物理的外环流程（设计优化、不确定性量化、参数扫描）被传统求解器的相空间分辨率成本卡住预算，而神经代理在某一传输问题上学到的架构与归纳偏置并不能直接迁移到其他模型族。

papers.title: FLASHSWIN: Unlocking Large Windows and Dense Tokens in Swin Vision Transformers with Memory Efficient Attention
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution vision backbones have long been forced to trade away local token density to afford larger receptive fields. Hierarchical Swin transformers impose this compromise because standard windowed attention materializes an $M^2\times M^2$ score matrix per window, incurring $O(M^4)$ memory as windows or token grids grow. Furthermore, Swin adds a learned relative-position bias elementwise to attention scores, requiring full materialization of the score matrix and its gradient. This keeps Swin and SwinV2 trapped in a small-window($M=8,16$), coarse-token regime with patch size $4\times4$ ($p=4$), limiting performance for fine-grained tasks. We introduce FLASHSWIN, which replaces standard windowed attention with a FlashAttention implementation that computes exact softmax attention without materializing the score matrix, reducing per-window memory from $O(M^4)$ to $O(M^2)$. This enables higher token density and larger receptive fields without inflating memory overhead. Training memory is flat across window sizes: at a $32\times32$ window, FLASHSWIN-T requires only $12.4$\,GB, unchanged from $8\times8$, compared to $70/90$\,GB for SwinV2/V1-T. However, applying FlashAttention directly to Swin creates a trade-off: bypassing the score matrix precludes Swin's additive relative-position bias, forfeiting spatial information in exchange for memory efficiency. FLASHSWIN restores position information as window-local learnable 2D RoPE, making large windows and dense token grids both affordable and accurate. At matched scale, FLASHSWIN-T outperforms Swin variants. With dense tokens and wide windows ($p=2,M=32$), the same Tiny model reaches $84.1\%$ ImageNet-1K, $44.1$ COCO box AP, and $47.28$ ADE20K mIoU---gains of $+1.3$, $+5.1$, and $+1.82$ over SwinV2-T at $M=16$, respectively. At fixed $M=32$, halving the patch size yields roughly $3\times$ larger gains in boundary quality than in mIoU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLASHSWIN 用 FlashAttention 重写 Swin 的窗口注意力，把每窗口显存从 O(M^4) 降到 O(M^2)，并以窗口局部可学习 2D RoPE 补回被 FlashAttention 挤掉的相对位置偏置，从而同时开大窗口与加密 token。Tiny 模型在 p=2、M=32 下达 84.1% ImageNet-1K、44.1 COCO box AP、47.28 ADE20K mIoU，较 M=16 的 SwinV2-T 分别 +1.3、+5.1、+1.82；32×32 窗口训练显存仅 12.4 GB，与 8×8 持平，而 SwinV2/V1-T 需 70/90 GB。
Motivation: 标准窗口注意力要物化每个窗口的 M²×M² 分数矩阵，显存随窗口或 token 网格增长呈 O(M^4)，加上 Swin 的加性相对位置偏置必须整块物化分数矩阵及其梯度，把 Swin/SwinV2 锁死在小窗口 (M=8,16)、粗 token (p=4) 的设定，细粒度任务性能受限。
Method: 用 FlashAttention 实现的精确 softmax 注意力替换标准窗口注意力，不物化分数矩阵，把每窗口显存降到 O(M^2)；由于绕过分数矩阵会丢掉 Swin 的加性相对位置偏置，改用窗口局部可学习 2D RoPE 恢复位置信息，使大窗口与密集 token 网格同时可用。
Result: 训练显存不随窗口变化：FLASHSWIN-T 在 32×32 窗口仅需 12.4 GB，与 8×8 相同，而 SwinV2-T/V1-T 分别需 70/90 GB。同等规模下 FLASHSWIN-T 超过各 Swin 变体；在 p=2、M=32 的密集 token 加宽窗口设定下，同一 Tiny 模型达 84.1% ImageNet-1K、44.1 COCO box AP、47.28 ADE20K mIoU，较 M=16 的 SwinV2-T 分别高 +1.3、+5.1、+1.82。固定 M=32 时把 patch 尺寸减半，边界质量的提升约为 mIoU 提升的 3 倍。
Conclusion: 显存瓶颈与位置偏置并非不可兼得：FlashAttention 加 2D RoPE 可让 Swin 同时用大窗口和密集 token，且训练显存对窗口大小不敏感；减小 patch 尺寸对边界质量的收益远大于对整体 mIoU 的收益。

papers.title: PermVLA: Factorization Order as a Regularizer for VLA Learning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies commonly learn action chunks through a fixed left-to-right (LTR) factorization, although the same expert trajectory distribution admits many valid chain-rule factorizations. We identify factorization order as an overlooked regularization choice and introduce causally anchored permutation (CAP), which samples action reveal orders with a tunable chronological prefix. Its auxiliary objective trains one shared policy to predict actions from different known subsets of the same expert chunk, while deployment retains deterministic LTR control. We call this conditional-set augmentation: it creates multiple conditional prediction problems from one expert chunk without adding demonstrations. This discourages reliance on the single chronological prefix used by ordinary teacher forcing. Controlled experiments show that CAP consistently outperforms standard LTR training on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, with the same advantage appearing in cross-dataset CALVIN evaluation. A diagnostic that measures the expected squared difference between a chunk's joint log likelihood under two reveal orders verifies that CAP training internalizes agreement across reveal orders. These findings position sampled subset-conditioned auxiliary objectives as a general recipe for constructing VLA regularizers, illustrated by an extension to diffusion action generators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA 动作块训练默认按固定从左到右 (LTR) 链式分解，CAP (causally anchored permutation) 采样带可调时间前缀的动作揭示顺序，用同一专家轨迹构造多个子集条件预测辅助目标，迫使策略不依赖单一时间前缀。在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 与跨数据集 CALVIN 上均稳定优于标准 LTR 训练，诊断量（两种揭示顺序下块联合对数似然的期望平方差）证实 CAP 训练内化了跨顺序一致性。
Motivation: 同一专家轨迹分布对应多种合法的链式法则分解，但 VLA 训练一律用固定 LTR，使策略过度依赖 teacher forcing 的单一时间前缀，缺少正则化手段。
Method: 提出 CAP：以可调时间前缀采样动作揭示顺序，辅助目标让单一共享策略从同一专家块的不同已知子集预测动作（conditional-set augmentation，不增加示演示）；部署仍用确定性 LTR 控制。另给出面向扩散动作生成器的扩展。
Result: 受控实验中 CAP 在 LIBERO 与 LIBERO-Plus 上一致优于标准 LTR 训练，同样优势出现在跨数据集 CALVIN 评估；诊断指标（块联合对数似然在两种揭示顺序下的期望平方差）验证 CAP 训练内化了跨顺序一致性。
Conclusion: 采样子集条件的辅助目标可作为构造 VLA 正则器的通用配方，分解顺序本身是一个可调的正则化选择，且部署时无需改变 LTR 控制。

papers.title: RETRACE: From Entangled Repair Histories to Reusable Experience for CI Repair
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly reuse prior experience, but most approaches assume that problems and solutions are already aligned. Software histories rarely provide this alignment: a pull request (PR) may contain multiple continuous integration (CI) problems, failed attempts, reverted edits, and unrelated changes, obscuring which changes resolve each problem. We present RETRACE, a framework for reconstructing problem-level repair experience from such histories. RETRACE combines an endpoint view that reasons backward from changes retained in the passing revision with a development view that traces repair evolution forward through commit history. CI execution evidence reconciles the two views, and the recovered experience is represented at three abstraction levels, from concrete fixes to transferable repair patterns. For new failures, RETRACE retrieves relevant problem-level experience to guide repair. On CI-REPAIR-BENCH, comprising 565 PR-level repairs from 101 repositories across 12 failure categories, RETRACE improves mini-SWE-agent Pass@1 from 19.6% to 31.9% with MiniMax-M2.5 and from 23.3% to 32.8% with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On a matched subset, Codex improves from 15.5% to 27.5%. Combining both views consistently outperforms either alone, showing that recovering problem-change alignment enables historical CI repairs to serve as reusable repair experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RETRACE 从纠缠的 PR 修复历史中重建问题级 CI 修复经验：用端点视图从通过版本保留的改动反向推理，用开发视图沿 commit 历史正向追踪修复演化，再用 CI 执行证据调和两个视图，并把经验组织成从具体修复到可迁移修复模式的三层抽象。在 CI-REPAIR-BENCH 上，mini-SWE-agent Pass@1 从 19.6% 提到 31.9%（MiniMax-M2.5）、从 23.3% 提到 32.8%（DeepSeek-V4-Flash），Codex 在匹配子集上从 15.5% 提到 27.5%。
Motivation: LLM agent 复用历史经验的前提是问题与解已对齐，但软件历史里一个 PR 混杂多个 CI 失败、失败尝试、回退改动与无关变更，无法直接判断哪个改动解决了哪个问题。
Method: RETRACE 结合端点视图（从通过版本保留的改动反向推理）与开发视图（沿 commit 历史正向追踪修复演化），用 CI 执行证据调和两视图；恢复的经验按三层抽象表示（具体修复到可迁移修复模式），新失败出现时检索问题级经验指导修复。
Result: 在 CI-REPAIR-BENCH（101 个仓库、565 个 PR 级修复、12 类失败）上，mini-SWE-agent Pass@1 由 19.6% 升至 31.9%（MiniMax-M2.5），由 23.3% 升至 32.8%（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）；匹配子集上 Codex 由 15.5% 升至 27.5%；两个视图组合始终优于任一单独视图。
Conclusion: 恢复问题-改动对齐关系，就能把历史 CI 修复变成可复用的修复经验，且端点视图与开发视图必须同时使用才稳定有效。

papers.title: Path Laplacian Encodings for Directed Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Directed graphs naturally model many real-world systems in which interactions are asymmetric, such as citation networks, web graphs, and information-flow networks. However, graph learning methods commonly rely on message passing with symmetrized graph representations or positional encodings that only partially exploit edge directionality. We introduce PathLapPE, a novel spectral positional encoding (PE) derived from the path Laplacian on directed graphs. PathLapPE provides node- and edge-level features that encode directional higher-order structure and can be incorporated into standard graph learning architectures. Empirical results on node- and graph-level benchmark tasks show that PathLapPE yields consistent improvements across several architectures, especially when combined with direction-aware message passing. Compared with magnetic Laplacian positional encodings, a widely studied spectral positional encoding for directed graphs, PathLapPE does not require additional fine-tuning of directionality hyperparameters while offering competitive runtime and performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PathLapPE：基于有向图 path laplacian 的谱位置编码，给出节点级与边级特征，编码方向性高阶结构，可直接接入标准图学习架构。在节点级与图级基准任务上，PathLapPE 在多种架构上带来一致提升，且与 direction-aware message passing 结合时提升尤其明显；相比 magnetic Laplacian 位置编码，它无需额外微调方向性超参数，运行时与性能均有竞争力。
Motivation: 图学习普遍依赖对称化图表示上的消息传递，或只部分利用边方向性的位置编码，有向图中的非对称交互结构未被充分编码。
Method: PathLapPE 从有向图的 path laplacian 导出谱位置编码，产出节点级与边级特征，作为可插拔输入接入标准图学习架构，并与 direction-aware message passing 组合使用。
Result: 在节点级与图级基准任务上，PathLapPE 在多种架构上取得一致改进，与 direction-aware message passing 结合时改进尤其明显；对比 magnetic Laplacian 位置编码，无需微调方向性超参数，运行时与性能具竞争力。
Conclusion: path laplacian 谱编码能更充分利用有向图的方向性高阶结构，且免去 magnetic Laplacian 那类方向性超参数的微调负担。

papers.title: Pareto-Improving Adversarial Attacks with Primal-Dual Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Transferable adversarial attacks are arguably the most practical black-box threat model. Under the same perturbation budget, stronger transfer attacks attain higher attack success rate (ASR), yet their imperceptibility also tends to degrade. Under such a fixed-budget protocol, transferability and imperceptibility therefore appear to trade off against each other. We argue that this conflict is an artifact of fixed-budget evaluation, not an intrinsic trade-off. When attacks are compared on the ASR--imperceptibility Pareto frontier obtained by sweeping $ε$, stronger transfer attacks already attain better imperceptibility at matched ASR than weaker ones. To exploit this latent advantage, we introduce the stealthy transfer attack ST, a plug-in primal-dual wrapper that adds an $L_\infty$ saturation regularizer to the standard constrained objective and resolves it through a two-step primal-dual update: a projected primal step on the perturbation coupled with an $L_1$-ball projection on a dual variable that absorbs the regularizer through Fenchel duality, requiring no auxiliary models or handcrafted perceptual priors. Empirically, ST extends the Pareto frontier across different base attacks and additional surrogate architectures. At $ε{=}16/255$, average imperceptibility gains over each base attack are $17\%$ on LPIPS and $14\%$ on NIQE while ASR is preserved or improved. At matched high-ASR levels, the strongest ST variants further Pareto-dominate dedicated stealth-oriented transfer attacks, confirming that the latent imperceptibility advantage of strong transfer attacks can be unlocked by a primal-dual optimization wrapper without sacrificing transferability. Code will be made available at \url{https://github.com/AndssY/ST}.

papers.title: GS-Codec: A Gaussian-Splatting Bottleneck for Neural Audio Coding
papers.abstract_en: Neural audio codecs compress waveforms into compact discrete tokens that underpin speech language models, real-time communication, and large-scale audio storage. Almost every dominant design, including residual vector quantization, finite scalar quantization, and single-codebook variants, follows the VQ-VAE template by partitioning the encoder latent through a learned codebook or a fixed scalar grid. We ask whether this partition is necessary. We introduce GS-Codec, a neural speech codec whose bottleneck is a parametric signal decomposition rather than a quantizer. We adapt Gaussian splatting from 3D scene reconstruction to one-dimensional latents. An inner optimization loop fits each encoder segment as a weighted sum of 1D Gaussian primitives. The decoder then reconstructs the waveform from the rendered sum. To avoid the cost of this iterative inner loop at inference time, we additionally train a lightweight GS Predictor Net that regresses the primitive parameters in a single forward pass. The encoder and decoder are trained end-to-end through the inner loop, with no quantizer anywhere in the training pipeline: the bottleneck is the decomposition itself, and scalar quantization is applied only post-training to the fitted parameters. Rather than relying on discrete codebook stages for bitrate control, our representation exposes a fine-grained rate-quality tradeoff: a single trained checkpoint supports post-training bitrate control by varying the number of primitives and the per-parameter bit depth, with no retraining required. GS-Codec matches or exceeds well-established open-source codecs such as EnCodec and DAC on speaker similarity (SIM), intelligibility (STOI), and perceptual quality (UTMOS) at comparable bitrates, while achieving comparable semantic performance (WER). Code and audio samples are available at https://ronaluf.github.io/gs-codec/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GS-Codec 把神经语音编解码器的瓶颈从量化器换成参数化信号分解：用 1D Gaussian splatting 把编码器隐变量拟合为高斯基元加权和，解码器从渲染和重建波形，训练全程无量化器。单个 checkpoint 靠改变基元数量与每参数比特深度实现免重训的码率控制，在可比码率下 SIM、STOI、UTMOS 追平或超过 EnCodec 与 DAC，WER 相当。
Motivation: 主流神经音频编解码器（RVQ、FSQ、单码本变体）都沿用 VQ-VAE 模板，靠码本或标量网格切分编码器隐变量来控码率，码率档位绑定训练阶段且划分方式本身未必必要。
Method: 把 3D 场景重建的 Gaussian splatting 改造到一维隐变量：内层优化循环把每个编码器片段拟合为 1D Gaussian primitives 的加权和，解码器从渲染和重建波形；另训一个轻量 GS Predictor Net 单次前向回归基元参数以省掉推理时的迭代内循环。编码器与解码器穿过内循环端到端训练，训练管线中无量化器，标量量化只在训练后施加于拟合参数。
Result: 在可比码率下，SIM（说话人相似度）、STOI（可懂度）、UTMOS（感知质量）追平或超过 EnCodec 与 DAC 等成熟开源编解码器，语义性能 WER 相当；单个训练好的 checkpoint 通过改变基元数量与每参数比特深度实现训练后码率控制，无需重训。
Conclusion: 瓶颈本身可以是分解而非量化器：用参数化分解替代码本切分，既能给出细粒度的率–质权衡，又能在可比码率下保持语音质量与语义表现。

papers.title: Gated Target Propagation for Compositional Generalization in Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning is typically framed as acquiring new knowledge without catastrophically forgetting previous tasks. However, a flexible continual learner should also be able to reuse and recombine previously acquired knowledge to rapidly solve novel task compositions. We introduce Gated Target Propagation (GaTaP), a continual learning algorithm in which task-specific gating variables---learned through a closed-form inner loop update---selectively suppress or enhance network modules. Network parameters are learned in a slower timescale outer loop, using the same local difference target propagation error signal as is used for adapting gating variables. We provide tractable experiments on class-incremental learning scenarios for both multilayer perceptron and convolutional network architectures. We show strong performance retention on previously learned tasks, as well as compositional generalization to unseen tasks, achieved through few-shot gain adaptation at inference. We analyze learned gating patterns and find that related tasks exhibit similar gating patterns, suggesting that inferred gates capture meaningful, reusable task structure. Overall, GaTaP provides a powerful framework for jointly ameliorating catastrophic forgetting and enabling few-shot compositional generalization in neural network models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出持续学习算法 GaTaP：用闭式内环更新学到的任务门控变量选择性抑制或增强网络模块，外环在更慢时间尺度上用同一局域 difference target propagation 误差信号更新参数。在 MLP 与卷积网络的类增量学习场景中，已学任务保持强性能，并通过推理期 few-shot gain adaptation 对未见任务组合实现组合泛化；相关任务呈现相似门控模式。
Motivation: 持续学习通常只被定义为学新任务而不灾难性遗忘旧任务，但灵活的学习者还应能复用与重组已有知识，快速解决未见过的任务组合。
Method: GaTaP 分双时间尺度：任务特定门控变量经闭式内环更新，选择性抑制或增强网络模块；网络参数在外环以更慢时间尺度学习，与门控共用同一局域 difference target propagation 误差信号。在 MLP 与卷积架构的类增量学习场景上做实验，并在推理期用 few-shot gain adaptation 适配新任务。
Result: 在 MLP 与卷积网络的类增量学习实验中，对已学任务保持强性能保持，并对未见任务实现组合泛化（推理期 few-shot gain adaptation）；门控模式分析显示相关任务的门控模式相似。
Conclusion: 联合建模门控与 target propagation 可同时缓解灾难性遗忘并支持 few-shot 组合泛化，学到的门控捕捉到可复用的任务结构。

papers.title: SEIS: Self-Evolving Inference Systems
papers.abstract_en: Inference systems determine how fast and how cheaply language models can be served, so making them faster has direct practical value. However, prior work focuses mostly on optimizing certain parts such as kernels or memory within the large system. In this work, we take a holistic approach and apply agentic self-evolution to optimize the whole system end-to-end. Our SEIS (Self-Evolving Inference Systems) autonomously optimizes the entire mini-sglang engine without human intervention through iterative sessions with inherited experiences and code changes. Serving Qwen3-0.6B on H100, the resulting engine reaches 3.27X the throughput of the original mini-sglang implementation and beats SOTA engines like vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, and SGLang in the single-request workload. The correctness of the optimized inference engine by SEIS is tested in terms of numerical difference and downstream accuracy on math and long-context retrieval tasks. The code and session histories show that the speedup comes from redesigning the whole engine and that building on earlier sessions beats independent attempts. These results suggest that agentic self-evolution can optimize a complex system end-to-end. The evaluation also has to evolve with the engine, and letting agents evolve it is a natural next step.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SEIS 用 agentic self-evolution 端到端自主优化整个 mini-sglang 推理引擎，无需人工干预，通过带经验继承的迭代 session 持续改代码。在 H100 上服务 Qwen3-0.6B 时吞吐达到原版 mini-sglang 的 3.27X，并在单请求负载上超过 vLLM、TensorRT-LLM 与 SGLang；数值差异与下游任务精度验证了正确性，且在前序 session 基础上继续演化优于各自独立尝试。
Motivation: 推理系统优化此前多集中在 kernel、内存等局部环节，缺少对整个系统的端到端优化；而系统规模大、依赖多，人工整体重设计成本高。
Method: 对 mini-sglang 引擎做 agentic self-evolution：agent 在迭代 session 中继承历史经验并直接提交代码改动，端到端重设计整个引擎，全程无人工干预；正确性用数值差异以及 math、long-context retrieval 下游精度检验。
Result: H100 上服务 Qwen3-0.6B，吞吐为原版 mini-sglang 的 3.27X，单请求负载超过 vLLM、TensorRT-LLM、SGLang；正确性经数值差异与 math、long-context retrieval 下游精度测试；代码与 session 历史显示提速来自整引擎重设计，且基于早期 session 继续构建优于独立尝试。
Conclusion: agentic self-evolution 能对复杂系统做端到端优化，经验继承让后续 session 优于从零尝试；评估手段也应随引擎一同演化。

papers.title: Revisiting the Generalization of Neural Graph Edit Distance Models
papers.abstract_en: Neural approaches to Graph Edit Distance (GED) have achieved strong results under standard within-dataset evaluation, but much less is known about how well these models transfer across graph collections. We conduct a systematic study of this problem using exact GED supervision across diverse graph datasets and a broad set of representative learning-based methods. Our results reveal a pronounced gap between within-collection performance and cross-collection transfer. Models that perform well on their training collections often lose this advantage when evaluated on structurally different data. Training on multiple source collections substantially improves zero-shot transfer and provides a better starting point when limited supervision is available for a new target collection. Further analysis shows that transfer behavior varies with the source--target direction and the structural characteristics of the collections involved. These findings suggest that conventional within-collection evaluation provides only a partial view of the generalization behavior of neural GED models and motivate broader evaluation across heterogeneous graph collections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统研究神经图编辑距离 (GED) 模型的跨图集迁移：用精确 GED 监督在多个图数据集上评测一组代表性学习方法，发现同集内 (within-collection) 表现与跨集迁移之间存在明显落差——在训练集上表现好的模型换到结构不同的数据上优势常消失。多源集合联合训练能显著改善零样本迁移，并在目标集仅有少量监督时提供更好起点；迁移效果还随源-目标方向和图集结构特征变化。
Motivation: 神经 GED 模型的强结果几乎都来自同数据集内评测，跨图集迁移能力知之甚少，而常规评测只刻画了泛化行为的一部分。
Method: 在多个多样图数据集上以精确 GED 作为监督信号，对一组有代表性的学习式 GED 方法做系统研究，比较同集内评测与跨集迁移，并分析多源集合训练、源-目标方向及图集结构特征的影响。
Result: 同集内性能与跨集迁移之间存在明显落差，训练集上表现好的模型在结构不同的数据上常失去优势；在多个源集合上训练显著改善零样本迁移，并在目标集监督有限时给出更好起点；迁移行为随源-目标方向与图集结构特征而变。
Conclusion: 常规的同集内评测只能部分反映神经 GED 模型的泛化行为，应在异构图集之间做更广的跨集评测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hypergraph Representation Learning with Hyperlink Random Effects
papers.abstract_en: Hypergraphs record multi-way interactions among entities. Extracting information from the combinatorial structure underlying observed multi-way interactions is a central task in many real-world problems. Existing methods face several limitations. First, many deep architectures for hypergraphs do not explicitly exploit the potential low-rank structure, which can sacrifice parsimony and interpretability in the learned representations. Second, many low-rank-based methods operate on tensor representations, which typically require hyperlinks to have uniform sizes and thus limit their applicability to general hypergraphs with non-uniform hyperlink sizes. Third, many methods ignore the fact that hyperlinks often arise from heterogeneous mechanisms. For example, medical symptoms may co-occur in the profiles of patients with very different conditions, and such heterogeneity should be incorporated into the learning process. In this work, we develop a general framework for hypergraph representation learning using hyperlink random effects while exploiting the low-rank structure in hypergraphs. The proposed framework accommodates latent heterogeneity in hyperlink formation while preserving entity interaction patterns. We establish identifiability of the model parameters and theoretical guarantees of representation-level recovery under this framework. The framework allows flexible specifications for the hyperlink random effects; in this paper, we study three choices: categorical, Gaussian mixture, and score-based effects, and develop corresponding estimation algorithms. Through simulation studies, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in recovering latent structure and capturing heterogeneous interaction patterns. Empirical studies on real-world hypergraph datasets further illustrate the practical utility of our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于超边随机效应 (hyperlink random effects) 的超图表示学习框架，显式利用低秩结构并容纳超边形成的异质机制，同时支持非均匀超边大小。框架给出参数可辨识性与表示级恢复的理论保证，并实现 categorical、Gaussian mixture、score-based 三种随机效应设定及对应估计算法。
Motivation: 现有超图深度架构不显式利用低秩结构，牺牲简洁性与可解释性；基于张量的低秩方法要求超边大小均匀，限制了对一般超图的适用；多数方法忽略超边常由异质机制产生这一事实。
Method: 用超边随机效应建模超边形成的潜在异质性，同时利用超图低秩结构并保留实体交互模式；给出模型参数可辨识性与表示级恢复的理论保证；随机效应支持三种设定——categorical、Gaussian mixture、score-based，并分别开发估计算法。
Result: 仿真研究展示了该方法在恢复潜在结构与捕捉异质交互模式上的有效性；在真实世界超图数据集上的实证研究进一步说明其实用性。
Conclusion: 把超边随机效应与低秩结构结合，可以在容纳异质超边形成机制的同时保证参数可辨识与表示恢复，且不依赖超边大小均匀的假设。

papers.title: Policy as Data: Replay-Based Policy Dual Averaging via Advantage Regression
papers.abstract_en: Actor-critic methods reuse past experience to improve sample efficiency. However, historical data are typically regarded as off-policy samples for the current policy-improvement update. This work introduces Regularized Dual Averaging Actor Critic (RDA2C), which assigns a distinct role to replay. In regularized dual averaging, the subsequent policy is determined by accumulated policy-improvement feedback, so historical advantage estimates contribute directly to the actor objective rather than solely to the most recent update. RDA2C stores state-action samples with critic-estimated advantage labels, fits a dual score model $Z_θ$ to the aggregated dataset, and derives the current policy from the accumulated score model using the entropy mirror map. In this way, replay defines an empirical dual objective from which the policy is computed. To analyze RDA2C, we establish a finite-time value-gap decomposition, separating the regularized dual-averaging term from errors due to stale-replay supervised fitting, critic bias, finite-buffer variance, and replay coverage, and stating the assumptions under which each error is bounded. RDA2C accepts advantage labels from any critic. With GAE labels, RDA2C outperforms PPO on six of eight MuJoCo tasks and eight of twelve Atari games. RDA2C also outperforms AAPDA, the closest dual-averaging baseline, on six of eight MuJoCo tasks. With twin-$Q$ labels, RDA2C matches SAC at matched batch size and update frequency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 replay 从「过时样本」改成策略更新本身：RDA2C 用 critic 估计的 advantage 标签拟合 dual score 模型 Z_θ，再经 entropy mirror map 从累积分数导出当前策略，使历史优势直接进入 actor 目标。带 GAE 标签时在 8 个 MuJoCo 任务中 6 个、12 个 Atari 游戏中全部胜过 PPO，并在 8 个 MuJoCo 中 6 个胜过 AAPDA；带 twin-Q 标签时在匹配 batch size 与更新频率下追平 SAC。
Motivation: Actor-critic 虽复用历史经验提升样本效率，但历史数据通常只被当作当前策略改进更新的 off-policy 样本，replay 的作用被局限在最近一次更新里。
Method: 提出 Regularized Dual Averaging Actor Critic (RDA2C)：存储带 critic advantage 标签的 state-action 样本，在聚合数据集上拟合 dual score 模型 Z_θ，用 entropy mirror map 从累积分数模型导出当前策略，使 replay 定义一个经验 dual 目标；标签可来自任意 critic（GAE 或 twin-Q）。并建立有限时间 value-gap 分解，把正则化 dual-averaging 项与 stale-replay 监督拟合误差、critic 偏差、有限缓冲方差、replay 覆盖误差分开，并给出各项有界的假设。
Result: GAE 标签下，RDA2C 在 8 个 MuJoCo 任务中的 6 个、12 个 Atari 游戏中的 8 个胜过 PPO；在 8 个 MuJoCo 任务中的 6 个胜过最接近的 dual-averaging 基线 AAPDA。twin-Q 标签下，在匹配 batch size 与更新频率时追平 SAC。
Conclusion: 把 replay 写成正则化 dual averaging 的经验目标，历史 advantage 可以直接累积进 actor 更新；该框架对 critic 标签来源不敏感，配合 GAE 能在多数 MuJoCo/Atari 任务上超过 PPO 与 AAPDA，配合 twin-Q 则与 SAC 相当。

papers.title: Does Neural Complexity Improve Health Misinformation Detection? A Leakage-Controlled Cross-Corpus Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Increasing architectural complexity is often assumed to improve health misinformation detection, yet reported gains are difficult to interpret when studies use different corpora, preprocessing pipelines, data splits, and leakage controls. This study provides a controlled cross-corpus benchmark of five compact neural architectures (1D-CNN, LSTM, BiLSTM, CNN-LSTM, and CNN-BiLSTM), a soft-voting neural ensemble, and three classical machine-learning baselines using COVID19-FNIR and CONSTRAINT. Exact-text duplicate controls were applied before modelling; all neural systems used a common preprocessing and optimisation protocol, and neural results were repeated across three random seeds. On COVID19-FNIR, the deep ensemble achieved a mean macro-F1 of 0.9963 and ROC-AUC of 0.9994, while individual neural models ranged from 0.9945 to 0.9957 macro-F1. On CONSTRAINT, the ensemble achieved macro-F1 of 0.9272 and ROC-AUC of 0.9811, whereas a linear SVM achieved macro-F1 of 0.9574 and ROC-AUC of 0.9931. Architecture rankings changed across corpora, and simple sparse linear models remained highly competitive. The findings show that model complexity does not provide a stable performance advantage and that benchmark construction can dominate architecture choice. The study contributes a reproducible, leakage-controlled basis for evidence-driven model selection in health misinformation classification
papers.comment: 18 pages, 3 tables. Reproducibility materials and source code are available from the author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 COVID19-FNIR 与 CONSTRAINT 两个健康误导信息语料上做受控跨语料基准，五个紧凑神经架构加软投票集成与三个经典基线在统一预处理、去重和三种随机种子下比较。集成在 COVID19-FNIR 上 macro-F1 0.9963，但在 CONSTRAINT 上被线性 SVM 的 0.9574 反超，架构排名随语料改变，说明复杂度不带来稳定优势。
Motivation: 既有研究各自使用不同语料、预处理、数据划分与泄漏控制，神经复杂度带来的增益难以归因，跨语料的架构排名是否稳定无从判断。
Method: 对比五个紧凑神经架构（1D-CNN、LSTM、BiLSTM、CNN-LSTM、CNN-BiLSTM）、一个软投票神经集成与三个经典机器学习基线；建模前做精确文本重复控制，所有神经系统共用同一预处理与优化协议，结果跨三个随机种子重复。
Result: COVID19-FNIR 上深度集成 mean macro-F1 0.9963、ROC-AUC 0.9994，单个神经模型 macro-F1 介于 0.9945 至 0.9957；CONSTRAINT 上集成 macro-F1 0.9272、ROC-AUC 0.9811，而线性 SVM macro-F1 0.9574、ROC-AUC 0.9931。架构排名在两个语料间发生变化。
Conclusion: 模型复杂度不提供稳定的性能优势，基准构建（语料与泄漏控制）对结果的影响可以超过架构选择，模型选择应由证据而非复杂度驱动。

papers.title: LatentIndex: Cross-Layer Sharing with Layer-Specific Selection for Sparse Attention
papers.abstract_en: Sparse attention reduces core-attention computation, but its indexers still incur repeated selection work and per-layer key-cache storage. Reusing selected indices across layers reduces this overhead but constrains multiple layers to the same token set. We introduce LatentIndex, which extends the latent-sharing principle of Multi-head Latent Attention across indexer layers. Each layer group constructs a shared latent cache from its first layer's hidden states, while layer-specific scoring enables independent token selection. Absorbing key decoders into queries enables direct scoring of the shared cache without reconstructing historical per-layer keys. We develop training-free calibration and investigate a training-aware instantiation of this principle. To balance quality and computation, a hierarchical selection (HS) variant lets followers independently refine a shared candidate set proposed by the anchor. With four-layer sharing, LatentIndex reduces logical indexer-cache storage by 61.1% on DeepSeek-V3.2. Across DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5, training-free LatentIndex improves head-wise attention-mass recall over IndexCache by up to 3.28 percentage points while maintaining RULER and LongBench performance close to native DSA. HS further achieves 2.30-2.72 times decode indexer speedups over DSA across 8K-128K contexts, retaining most of LatentIndex's recall. LatentIndex offers a new perspective on cross-layer indexing: sharing continuous representations rather than discrete selections enables efficient reuse while preserving layer-specific token selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LatentIndex 把 Multi-head Latent Attention 的 latent-sharing 思想推广到 indexer 层之间：每组层用首层 hidden states 建共享 latent cache，配合 layer-specific 打分独立选 token，并把 key decoder 吸收进 query 以直接对共享 cache 打分。四层共享在 DeepSeek-V3.2 上把逻辑 indexer-cache 存储降 61.1%，training-free 版本的 head-wise attention-mass recall 比 IndexCache 最多高 3.28 个百分点，RULER 与 LongBench 接近原生 DSA；HS 变体在 8K–128K 上下文上取得 2.30–2.72 倍 decode indexer 加速。
Motivation: 稀疏注意力的 indexer 在每层重复做选择并各自存 key cache，跨层复用索引虽省开销却把多层锁死在同一 token 集合上，牺牲层间差异。
Method: 将 MLA 的 latent-sharing 扩展到 indexer 层：每层组由首层 hidden states 构造共享 latent cache，layer-specific scoring 各自选 token；把 key decoder 吸收进 query 直接对共享 cache 打分，避免重建历史逐层 key。另提出 training-free 校准与 training-aware 实例化，以及层级选择 (hierarchical selection, HS) 变体——anchor 提出共享候选集、follower 独立细化。
Result: 四层共享使 DeepSeek-V3.2 的逻辑 indexer-cache 存储减少 61.1%；training-free LatentIndex 在 DeepSeek-V3.2 与 GLM-5 上 head-wise attention-mass recall 比 IndexCache 最多提高 3.28 个百分点，同时 RULER 与 LongBench 性能接近原生 DSA；HS 在 8K–128K 上下文上相对 DSA 取得 2.30–2.72 倍 decode indexer 加速，并保留 LatentIndex 大部分 recall。
Conclusion: 跨层索引应共享连续表示而非离散选择结果，这样既能复用开销又保住各层独立的 token 选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Numerical Linear Algebra of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Numerical Linear Algebra (NLA) has consistently played a vital role in advancing science by providing tools to solve fundamental problems encountered in scientific and engineering applications. Over the decades, it has continually evolved to meet the demands driven by successive waves of scientific discovery. For instance, during the 1950s and 1960s, substantial efforts were devoted to developing methods for solving eigenvalue problems that emerged from the rapidly growing field of aerodynamics. This led to the discovery of the LR and QR algorithms. Later the attention turned to the solution of sparse linear systems that were common in applications like computational aerodynamics. Today we are experiencing yet another wave of major scientific advancement and NLA is once more at the heart of its development. This Machine Learning (ML) wave is proving to be utterly disruptive in science and engineering. Many tools in ML particularly Large Language Models (LLMs) are grounded in matrix and tensor methods. As we are approaching Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), it is clear that matrix methods will be called to play an even more significant role. For the numerical linear practitioner the speed of the current change makes it particularly challenging to adapt. This is a survey article that centers on machine learning techniques, with a particular focus on large language models. It has two main objectives. The first is to clarify the core concepts behind Large Language Models in a manner accessible to specialists in numerical methods. The second is to examine the key Numerical Linear Algebra concepts employed by LLM techniques, while also highlighting several significant recent contributions of NLA to the field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇面向数值线性代数 (NLA) 从业者的 LLM 综述，把大语言模型拆解为矩阵与张量方法，梳理 LLM 中用到的核心 NLA 概念以及 NLA 近期对 ML 的贡献。全文为 survey 性质，无实验数据集与指标。
Motivation: ML 浪潮变化极快，数值线性代数从业者难以及时跟上；同时 LLM 的核心机制对非 ML 背景的数值方法专家并不透明，双方缺少一份共同语言的对照材料。
Method: 综述以机器学习技术为中心、聚焦 LLM：一是向数值方法专家讲解 LLM 核心概念，二是系统梳理 LLM 技术所依赖的关键 NLA 概念，并介绍 NLA 近期对该领域的重要贡献。
Result: 作为 survey 提出两项组织目标：为 NLA 专家澄清 LLM 核心概念，并盘点 LLM 中的关键 NLA 概念与 NLA 近期贡献；摘要未给出实验或定量对比。
Conclusion: 矩阵与张量方法是 LLM 的底层基础，NLA 将在通向 AGI 的进程中承担更关键角色，从业者需要主动适应这一变化。

summary_sections.result: 作为 survey 提出两项组织目标：为 NLA 专家澄清 LLM 核心概念，并盘点 LLM 中的关键 NLA 概念与 NLA 近期贡献；摘要未给出实验或定量对比。
summary_sections.conclusion: 矩阵与张量方法是 LLM 的底层基础，NLA 将在通向 AGI 的进程中承担更关键角色，从业者需要主动适应这一变化。

papers.title: Task-Sensitive Geometry of Representation Transfer for Object Detection under Image Degradation
papers.abstract_en: Object detection under image degradation can benefit from clean-image supervision, but aggregate gains do not imply that transferred representation changes are uniformly useful. We study how clean task knowledge affects degraded-image representations and whether local responses to structured representation directions can be characterized geometrically. Using paired clean and Gaussian-degraded BDD100K images, we show that clean-teacher distillation improves observed detection accuracy while producing heterogeneous object-level transfer. We isolate a representation component complementary to direct clean-teacher alignment and map it into the distilled student space through an orthogonal bridge. Controlled interventions rescue 13.22% of objects lost under the distilled representation, versus 4.30% under norm-matched random perturbations, with very low harm on preserved objects. We introduce task-sensitive geometry, a gradient-derived channel-space geometry constructed from normalized detection-loss gradients. On a reserved cohort, mapped-complement orientation within this frozen geometry is positively associated with local intervention-response magnitude after controlling for intervention magnitude (partial Spearman $ρ$ = 0.242, 95% CI [0.108, 0.359]). The relationship eplicates on independent data ($ρ$ = 0.180) and with RT-DETR-L ($ρ$ = 0.227), but not for the direct clean-teacher residual family, and it weakens for large interventions. Routing rules and specialized distillation objectives based on these signals do not yield statistically reliable gains over CLEANKD. These results support a local, direction-family-dependent task-sensitive geometry while showing that converting such structure into improved global training remains an open problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 BDD100K 干净/高斯退化配对图像上，干净教师蒸馏虽提升检测精度，但对象级迁移高度不均；作者用正交桥把与直接对齐互补的表征分量映射到学生空间，受控干预从蒸馏表征中救回 13.22% 的丢失对象，而范数匹配随机扰动仅 4.30%。由归一化检测损失梯度构造的 task-sensitive geometry 中，映射互补分量的取向与局部干预响应正相关（partial Spearman ρ=0.242，95% CI [0.108,0.359]），但据此设计的路由与蒸馏目标相对 CLEANKD 无统计可靠增益。
Motivation: 干净图像监督带来的总体精度增益掩盖了对象级迁移的异质性：部分对象在蒸馏表征下丢失，且缺少刻画哪些表征方向对局部干预真正有效的几何工具。
Method: 用配对的干净与高斯退化 BDD100K 图像做干净教师蒸馏；隔离出与直接干净教师对齐互补的表征分量，经正交桥 (orthogonal bridge) 映射进蒸馏学生空间；提出 task-sensitive geometry——由归一化检测损失梯度导出的通道空间几何，并在保留队列上以控制干预幅度的偏相关检验取向与响应的关系，另用独立数据与 RT-DETR-L 复现。
Result: 受控干预救回蒸馏表征下丢失对象的 13.22%，范数匹配随机扰动为 4.30%，对保留对象危害极低；保留队列上 mapped-complement orientation 与局部干预响应幅度的偏 Spearman ρ=0.242（95% CI [0.108, 0.359]），独立数据 ρ=0.180，RT-DETR-L 上 ρ=0.227，而直接干净教师残差族不成立，大干预下关系减弱；基于这些信号的路由规则与专用蒸馏目标相对 CLEANKD 无统计可靠增益。
Conclusion: 任务敏感几何是局部的、依赖方向族的：互补分量取向能预测局部干预收益，但把这种结构转成全局训练改进仍是未解问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Backward-Consistent Diffusion Sampling for Sparsely Observed PDE Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Recovering Partial Differential Equation (PDE) coefficient fields from extremely sparse observations is a severely ill-posed inverse problem for which generative machine learning methods (e.g., diffusion models) have become a leading way to encode the prior. Recent state-of-the-art diffusion solvers lift these priors to function spaces, finding a physics-consistent reconstruction in the output space of the diffusion denoiser. We prove that, in a discontinuous PDE setting, output space methods can result in failure to appropriately minimize the unobserved error with the correct coefficient field. Consequently, we propose Function space Backward-Consistent Sampling (FunBCS), an input space optimization approach for solving PDE problems which aims to find the best input such that the denoiser reconstruction is physics-consistent. We then prove that FunBCS appropriately minimizes the unobserved error, unlike output space optimization methods. Per our theoretical analysis, we also provide insights on how to dynamically allocate the number of input space optimization steps used throughout the sampling process. Our evaluations, across four PDE inverse problems (including the discontinuous Darcy flow), demonstrate that FunBCS reduces the reconstruction error by $27$-$64\%$ while running $1.4$-$2.1\times$ faster when compared to the current state-of-the-art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Function space Backward-Consistent Sampling (FunBCS)，把 PDE 系数场反问题的优化从扩散去噪器的输出空间移到输入空间，使去噪器重建满足物理一致性。作者证明在不连续 PDE 设定下输出空间方法无法用正确系数场最小化未观测误差，而 FunBCS 可以；在四个 PDE 反问题（含不连续 Darcy flow）上重建误差比当前 SOTA 降低 27–64%，同时快 1.4–2.1 倍。
Motivation: 从极稀疏观测恢复 PDE 系数场是严重不适定的反问题，现有扩散求解器在输出空间找物理一致重建；作者证明在不连续 PDE 设定下这种输出空间方法会无法用正确的系数场最小化未观测误差。
Method: FunBCS 是一种输入空间优化方法：寻找最优输入使去噪器重建满足物理一致性，并证明其能正确最小化未观测误差；理论分析还给出在采样过程中动态分配输入空间优化步数的思路。
Result: 在四个 PDE 反问题（含不连续 Darcy flow）的评测中，FunBCS 相比当前 state-of-the-art 将重建误差降低 27–64%，同时运行速度快 1.4–2.1 倍。
Conclusion: PDE 反问题的扩散求解应放在输入空间做物理一致性优化，而非在输出空间重建；不连续设定下只有输入空间方法被证明能正确最小化未观测误差。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: PerturBot: Breaking Shortcut Priors in Vision-Language-Action Models with Perturbative Training
papers.abstract_en: A vision--language--action (VLA) policy can complete complex tasks while ignoring the evidence that should determine its actions. An object held near the wrist camera can displace the instructed target. Language and action show the same pattern: a familiar noun can trigger the operation it was paired with in training even after the verb changes, and a gripper that closed on nothing may lift anyway. We call these dependencies modality shortcuts: regularities in successful demonstrations make visual, lexical, or motor cues sufficient to predict expert actions without the task evidence needed for the underlying decision. More demonstrations of the same kind can raise task success while leaving these shortcuts intact. We propose Perturbot which makes task-relevant evidence easier to use and shortcuts insufficient on their own: it applies task-preserving wrist-view perturbations, enriches instructions with decision-relevant captions, and adds random and failed trajectory segments relabeled with the behavior they contain. It complements scaling by changing what is scaled, and leaves inference unchanged. Moreover, we propose GroundingFscore, an offline score that diagnoses how severely a policy relies on modality shortcuts. Task success rate shows whether a policy improves, while GroundingFscore reveals whether the policy scales healthily, relying on task evidence rather than shortcuts. Together, Perturbot and GroundingFscore provide a training-and-evaluation framework for disentangling VLA decisions from shortcut priors while preserving responsiveness to task-relevant evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PerturBot 针对视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 策略中的模态捷径 (modality shortcuts)：成功示范里的视觉、词汇或运动规律足以预测专家动作，却不需要任务证据，且同类型示范越多越掩盖捷径。它用任务保持的腕部视角扰动、决策相关 caption 增强指令、以及随机与失败轨迹段按其实际行为重标注来让捷径单独失效，推理保持不变；配套提出离线指标 GroundingFscore 诊断捷径依赖程度。
Motivation: VLA 策略可以完成复杂任务却忽略本应决定动作的证据：腕部相机附近的物体会遮挡目标，熟悉的名词在动词改变后仍触发训练配对操作，夹爪空抓后照样抬起。增加同类示范能提高任务成功率而捷径依旧存在，任务成功率本身无法暴露这一点。
Method: PerturBot 三管齐下：任务保持的腕部视角扰动 (task-preserving wrist-view perturbations)、用决策相关 caption 丰富指令、加入随机与失败轨迹段并按其包含的行为重标注；推理阶段不改动，作者称其改变的是被 scaling 的内容而非 scaling 本身。另提出 GroundingFscore 这一离线分数，专门诊断策略对模态捷径的依赖严重程度。
Result: 摘要给出的量化对象是两个指标的分工：任务成功率显示策略是否提升，GroundingFscore 显示策略是否健康 scaling、依赖任务证据而非捷径。摘要未给出具体数值或数据集上的对比结果。
Conclusion: 任务成功率与 GroundingFscore 必须一起看：前者判提升，后者判提升是否来自任务证据；PerturBot 与 GroundingFscore 构成把 VLA 决策与捷径先验解耦、同时保持对任务相关证据响应的训练-评估框架。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Exploiting Hierarchical Controller Structure in Contextual Parameter Learning for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical control architectures are widely used to decompose complex control problems into interacting control levels and are particularly important in robotics, where planning, whole-body motion, and lower-level control must be coordinated across different levels of abstraction and time scales. Their overall closed-loop performance, however, depends strongly on parameters distributed across the hierarchy, such that tuning controllers on different levels independently may neglect relevant cross-layer interactions. We propose a contextual Bayesian optimization framework for joint parameter learning in hierarchical control systems. Rather than modeling closed-loop performance only as a scalar black-box function, we retain separate observations of task performance, realization quality, and control effort. A correlated multi-output Gaussian process models these performance components, while their known aggregation into the overall closed-loop objective is evaluated analytically. The formulation exploits three complementary consequences of hierarchical control: informative performance quantities exposed by the hierarchy, coupling between parameters of different controller levels, and variations of these relations with operating conditions. We evaluate the approach for humanoid loco-manipulation, jointly tuning a centroidal predictive controller and a whole-body controller for physical box pushing under varying box mass. The proposed method achieves the lowest mean empirical regret during both training and adaptation among the considered baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向分层控制的上下文贝叶斯优化框架，用相关多输出高斯过程分别建模任务性能、实现质量与控制努力，并对三者已知的聚合方式做解析求值，从而联合调参而非逐层独立调参。在人形机器人推箱子 (box pushing) 任务中联合调节质心预测控制器与全身控制器，所提方法在训练与适应阶段的平均经验 regret (mean empirical regret) 均为所比较基线中最低。
Motivation: 分层控制器的闭环性能取决于分布在各层的参数，逐层独立调参会忽略跨层耦合；把闭环性能只当标量黑箱函数又丢掉了层级暴露的可分解性能量。
Method: 上下文贝叶斯优化：以相关多输出高斯过程 (multi-output GP) 分别建模 task performance、realization quality、control effort 三个输出，利用层级对它们的已知聚合关系解析计算总体闭环目标；上下文刻画工况变化，利用跨层参数耦合与工况依赖关系做联合调参与适应。
Result: 在人形 loco-manipulation 的物理推箱任务中，联合调节 centroidal predictive controller 与 whole-body controller，箱体质量变化；所提方法在训练与适应两个阶段的 mean empirical regret 均低于所比较的全部基线。
Conclusion: 把分层控制暴露的多路性能量连同跨层耦合一起放进上下文贝叶斯优化，可在工况变化下做联合参数学习并取得最低经验 regret。

papers.title: ForeAct3D: Policy-Grounded Future World Modeling for VLA Policies
papers.abstract_en: Robots need to anticipate how their actions will change the world, since manipulation success hinges on the resulting contacts and object motions. However, existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies that predict future observations from shared features leave the forecast decoupled from the actions the policy will actually execute, and impose no physical constraints on how the scene may evolve. We introduce ForeAct3D, a framework for policy-grounded future world modeling within VLA policies. Learnable geometric queries decode depth, semantic segmentation, and camera pose from the policy representation into current and future semantic 3D scene states, and the future queries are conditioned on the policy-generated action chunk to ground the forecast in the planned interaction. A physical-consistency closure relates the two states through background staticity and instance-level rigidity, and anchors the wrist-camera pose to end-effector kinematics. These objectives shape the shared representation used for action generation during training, and no future prediction is required at inference. Without robot pretraining, ForeAct3D achieves 98.3\% average success on LIBERO and an average task length of 3.73 on CALVIN, outperforming its base policy on every suite. Ablations show that semantic 3D supervision, physical consistency, and action conditioning each improve manipulation performance, and that action conditioning substantially improves future object localization. Real-world experiments on spatial placement, object insertion, and sequential manipulation further raise average success from 6.7\% to 37.8\% over the base policy. The project page and code are available at https://github.com/anthonytao80-crypto/ForeAct3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ForeAct3D 在 VLA 策略内部做以动作为条件的未来场景建模：可学习几何查询从策略表征解码深度、语义分割与相机位姿得到当前与未来语义 3D 状态，未来查询以策略生成的 action chunk 为条件，并用背景静止、实例刚性与腕相机位姿对末端运动学的物理一致性闭合约束两态关系。这些目标只在训练时塑造共享表征，推理时无需未来预测；无机器人预训练下 LIBERO 平均成功率 98.3%、CALVIN 平均任务长度 3.73，真实实验平均成功率从基线策略的 6.7% 提到 37.8%。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 策略从共享特征预测未来观测，使预测与策略实际要执行的动作脱节，且对场景演化不加任何物理约束，而操作成败取决于接触与物体运动的结果。
Method: 可学习几何查询把策略表征解码为当前与未来的语义 3D 场景状态（深度、语义分割、相机位姿），未来查询以策略生成的 action chunk 为条件；物理一致性闭合用背景静止与实例级刚性关联两态，并把腕相机位姿锚定到末端执行器运动学。这些目标在训练时共同塑造用于动作生成的共享表征，推理阶段不需要未来预测。
Result: 无机器人预训练时 ForeAct3D 在 LIBERO 上平均成功率 98.3%，在 CALVIN 上平均任务长度 3.73，每个 suite 都超过其基线策略。消融显示语义 3D 监督、物理一致性与动作条件化各自提升操作性能，其中动作条件化显著改善未来物体定位。真实世界的空间放置、物体插入与顺序操作实验中，平均成功率相对基线策略从 6.7% 升到 37.8%。
Conclusion: 把未来预测锚定到策略将执行的动作并施加物理一致性约束，能在训练时改善共享表征、从而提升 VLA 操作成功率，且推理时无需承担未来预测开销。

papers.title: Sparse-View 4D Gaussian Splatting via Spatiotemporal Priors and Generative Assistance
papers.abstract_en: We present a 4D Gaussian Splatting framework for the Sparse-View Track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Volumetric Video Challenge, which requires dynamic scene reconstruction from only six cameras with wide baselines. To achieve robust dynamic reconstruction under such sparse views, our framework integrates three components. (1) Region-adaptive spatial priors: We use foreground masks to guide Gaussian initialization and mask voting to control densification separately for the dynamic foreground and static background. Background geometry is regularized using monocular depth aligned to metric scale. (2) Motion-consistent temporal priors: We provide supervision at intermediate times through frame interpolation and constrain projected Gaussian motion with estimated optical flow. (3) Generative assistance: We place virtual cameras in the widest angular gaps and restore their rendered images using a diffusion-based model conditioned on camera poses. The restored images are iteratively incorporated into training as pseudo-supervision. On the validation set, our framework improves full-frame PSNR from 25.60 dB for the baseline to 29.75 dB. On the official test benchmark, it achieves 30.04 dB full-frame PSNR and 27.88 dB foreground PSNR, ranking first overall in the Sparse-View Track.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 5 figures, Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Workshops (SA Workshops '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Volumetric Video Challenge 稀疏视角赛道（仅 6 台大基线相机）提出 4D Gaussian Splatting 框架，用前景掩码驱动的区域自适应空间先验、光流约束的运动一致时间先验，以及在最大角间隙放置虚拟相机并用位姿条件 diffusion 补全图像作伪监督。验证集全帧 PSNR 从基线 25.60 dB 提到 29.75 dB，官方测试集 30.04 dB 全帧 / 27.88 dB 前景 PSNR，总排名第一。
Motivation: 稀疏视角、大基线条件下动态场景重建缺少足够观测：前景与背景混杂导致高斯初始化与致密化失当，中间时刻无监督，视角间隙处几何欠约束。
Method: 三部分：区域自适应空间先验（前景掩码引导高斯初始化，掩码投票分别控制前景/背景致密化，背景几何用对齐到度量尺度的单目深度正则）；运动一致时间先验（帧插值提供中间时刻监督，用估计光流约束投影高斯运动）；生成式辅助（在最大角间隙放置虚拟相机，用以相机位姿为条件的 diffusion 恢复渲染图，迭代并入训练作伪监督）。
Result: 验证集全帧 PSNR 由基线 25.60 dB 提升至 29.75 dB；官方测试基准取得 30.04 dB 全帧 PSNR 与 27.88 dB 前景 PSNR，在 Sparse-View Track 总排名第一。
Conclusion: 空间先验、时间先验与生成式伪监督三者结合可在仅 6 相机大基线设置下把 4D Gaussian Splatting 的重建质量推到该赛道第一。

papers.title: ConEx: Human-Interpretable Saliency Maps via Concept-Aware Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Many visual explanation methods in computer vision highlight pixel importance but struggle to link these low-level cues to semantically meaningful concepts, limiting their interpretability and trustworthiness. We introduce Concept-based Explanations (ConEx), a novel framework that bridges saliency visualization with concept-based reasoning to provide both faithfulness and interpretability. ConEx automatically discovers class-specific concepts and represents them through concept activation vectors (CAVs), learned without manual supervision using an architecture-specific masking mechanism that reduces noise introduced by the segmentation masks to enhance concept purity. ConEx generates faithful saliency maps that reveal where each concept appears in the image and how it contributes to the prediction. To evaluate the reliability of these learned concepts, we propose two complementary metrics, Vector-Concept Match (VCM) and Concept-Class Match (CCM), that quantify concept alignment and enable direct comparison with existing methods. Extensive experiments across diverse settings demonstrate that ConEx achieves state-of-the-art performance on faithfulness, segmentation, and concept-quality benchmarks. Overall, ConEx advances the field toward truly interpretable and concept-grounded explanations in vision models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ConEx 把显著图与概念推理结合：无监督自动发现类特定概念并用 concept activation vector (CAV) 表示，配合架构特定的 masking 机制抑制分割掩码噪声以提升概念纯度，再生成揭示各概念位置及其对预测贡献的显著图。提出 VCM 与 CCM 两个互补指标量化概念对齐，实验在 faithfulness、segmentation 与 concept-quality 基准上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 视觉解释方法多只标出像素重要性，难以把这些低层线索与语义概念关联，可解释性与可信度受限。
Method: 无监督自动发现类特定概念，用架构特定的 masking 机制降低分割掩码引入的噪声以提高概念纯度，将概念表示为 CAV；生成显示每个概念在图中位置及其对预测贡献的显著图，并提出 Vector-Concept Match (VCM) 与 Concept-Class Match (CCM) 两个指标量化概念对齐、支持与现有方法直接比较。
Result: 在 faithfulness、segmentation 与 concept-quality 基准的多样设置实验中达到 state-of-the-art 表现；VCM 与 CCM 用于量化概念对齐与概念质量。
Conclusion: 把概念级推理接入显著图可同时获得 faithfulness 与人类可解释性，CAV 加掩码去噪是其达成概念纯度的路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Anticipating the Consequences of Curriculum Decisions with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Automatic curriculum learning can improve the effectiveness of reinforcement learning by selecting the training experiences presented to the agent over time. Predicting the consequences of such decisions can, however, be difficult. We analyze automatic curriculum learning as a sequential decision-making problem, highlighting a gap between the quantities that determine the value of curriculum decisions and the information captured by local learning signals commonly used to guide them. We then investigate whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can exploit richer information about the learning problem to better anticipate the consequences of curriculum decisions. We introduce a method that combines online learning-progress estimates with LLM-informed estimates of (i) the potential downstream benefits of learning on each task and (ii) whether direct training on a task is currently likely to produce progress. We evaluate the approach on a custom benchmark of 256 textual goals in Craftax under different curriculum objectives. We observe the strongest gains when optimizing for individual target tasks. When optimizing across the full task set, the benefits vary across learners with different mechanisms for cross-task transfer, ranging from modest improvements in learning speed to larger gains that persist through the end of training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把自动课程学习 (automatic curriculum learning) 视作序贯决策问题，指出决定课程决策价值的量与局部学习信号所捕获的信息之间存在差距，并提出用 LLM 估计各任务的下游收益与当前直接训练能否产生进展，再与在线学习进度估计结合来选课程。在 Craftax 的 256 个文本目标自建基准上，针对单个目标任务优化时收益最强；在全任务集上优化时收益随学习者的跨任务迁移机制不同而变化，从学习速度的适度提升到持续到训练结束的较大增益。
Motivation: 课程决策的长期价值由下游后果决定，但常用的局部学习信号只反映局部进展，无法预判该决策对后续训练的影响，导致自动课程学习选错训练经验。
Method: 将课程选择建模为序贯决策，方法融合在线学习进度估计与两类 LLM 提供的估计：(i) 在每个任务上训练的潜在下游收益，(ii) 当前直接在该任务上训练是否可能产生进展；在 Craftax 自建的 256 个文本目标基准上、针对不同课程目标进行评估。
Result: 在 Craftax 256 个文本目标基准、多种课程目标下评估：以单个目标任务为优化对象时观察到最强增益；在全任务集上优化时收益因学习者跨任务迁移机制而异，范围从学习速度的适度提升到持续到训练结束的较大增益。
Conclusion: 课程决策应依据对下游后果的预判而非局部学习信号来选，LLM 提供的下游收益与可训练性估计能补上这一信息；其收益大小取决于学习者跨任务迁移的机制。

papers.title: Organize Primitives into Semantic Parts: Reinforcement Reasoning for 3D Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Primitive-based 3D segmentation offers a compact and explicit alternative to dense surface prediction, naturally supporting structural abstraction and boundary localization. However, geometric decomposition alone does not determine how primitives should be organized into semantic parts: a single part may span multiple primitives, while geometrically similar or touching primitives may belong to different parts. We therefore introduce RePart (Reinforcement Part Reasoning), which formulates primitive-to-part organization as a finite-horizon Markov decision process and learns semantic organization through trajectory-level reinforcement reasoning. RePart constructs a Composable Primitive Workspace from fine-grained superquadrics and applies a merge-and-stop policy whose decisions are optimized by their downstream effects on the resulting partition rather than local primitive compatibility. The inferred part identities are then mapped back to the original mesh through Boundary-Aware Surface Labeling, preserving accurate surface boundaries beyond the primitive approximation. On PartNet, RePart achieves the strongest results across all four aggregate partition metrics; on 3DCoMPaT++, it obtains the highest RI and SC without target-dataset fine-tuning. These results demonstrate that reinforcement reasoning provides an effective mechanism for organizing geometric primitives into semantic parts while retaining dense segmentation accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/EngineeringAI-LAB/RePart.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RePart 把基于几何基元 (primitive) 的 3D 分割中「基元如何组成语义部件」形式化为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，用轨迹级强化学习训练 merge-and-stop 策略，按分区的下游效果而非局部几何相似度决定合并。在 PartNet 上取得四项聚合分区指标全部最强，在 3DCoMPaT++ 上不微调即取得最高 RI 与 SC。
Motivation: 几何分解本身不决定基元如何组织成语义部件：一个部件可能跨越多个基元，几何相似或相邻的基元却可能属于不同部件，仅靠局部几何无法解决。
Method: 从细粒度 superquadric 构建 Composable Primitive Workspace，用 merge-and-stop 策略按分区下游效果优化决策（有限时域 MDP、轨迹级强化推理），再通过 Boundary-Aware Surface Labeling 把部件身份映射回原始 mesh 以保留边界。
Result: 在 PartNet 上取得四项聚合分区指标全部最强；在 3DCoMPaT++ 上获得最高 RI 与 SC，且未做目标数据集微调。
Conclusion: 强化推理是把几何基元组织成语义部件的有效机制，同时保留密集分割精度；部件身份需回映射到原始 mesh 才能越过基元近似保住边界。
Relevance: 2
