papers.title: EvoCast: Reliable Autonomous Research Agents for Iterative Forecasting Architecture Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Deep time-series forecasting models have rapidly diversified, yet adapting them to a specific task still requires extensive expert effort in model selection, mechanism diagnosis, architecture design, implementation, and evaluation. Existing AutoML methods are constrained by predefined search spaces, while general-purpose LLM research agents lack reliable control over experimental protocols and model promotion. We introduce EvoCast, a fully autonomous research-agent system for iterative forecasting architecture evolution. EvoCast first establishes and diagnoses a task-specific baseline through executed mechanism ablations, then generates evidence-grounded research directions from dataset characteristics, diagnostic results, prior rounds, and failure records. Its central design, cognition-authority separation, assigns open-ended hypothesis generation and code implementation to LLM agents, while deterministic program authorities control source-edit boundaries, canonical evaluation, and promotion decisions. Experimental outcomes are accumulated as evidence to guide subsequent rounds. Results show that EvoCast completes complex architecture modifications with higher implementation success and lower agent-side token/time cost, and develops task-specific architectures that outperform selected baselines, strong forecasting models, and agent baselines in three real-world forecasting cases. The code is available at https://github.com/18e0-x/EvoCast.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 11 figures, including references and appendices. Code: https://github.com/18e0-x/EvoCast
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoCast 是一个全自动的时序预测架构演化研究 agent：先用可执行的机制消融建立并诊断任务基线，再由 LLM agent 生成假设与代码，而确定性程序权威负责源码编辑边界、规范化评估与晋升决策。在三个真实预测案例中，它以更高的实现成功率、更低的 agent 侧 token/时间成本完成复杂架构改造，产出的任务专用架构在选定基线、强预测模型与 agent 基线上均更优。
Motivation: 深度时序预测模型快速分化，适配到具体任务仍需大量专家投入做模型选择、机制诊断、架构设计与评估；现有 AutoML 受预定义搜索空间限制，通用 LLM 研究 agent 又缺乏对实验协议与模型晋升的可靠控制。
Method: EvoCast 分三步：通过可执行的机制消融 (executed mechanism ablations) 建立并诊断任务专用基线；结合数据集特征、诊断结果、历史轮次与失败记录生成有证据支撑的研究方向；核心设计为认知-权威分离 (cognition-authority separation)，把开放式假设生成与代码实现交给 LLM agent，由确定性程序权威约束源码编辑边界、执行规范化评估并决定晋升，实验结果作为证据累积进入后续轮次。
Result: 在三个真实世界预测案例上，EvoCast 完成复杂架构修改的实现成功率更高、agent 侧 token 与时间成本更低；其开发的任务专用架构在选定基线、强预测模型 (strong forecasting models) 和 agent 基线之上均取得更优表现。
Conclusion: 把开放性推理与确定性实验权威分开，可以让 LLM 研究 agent 在受控协议下自主迭代演化预测架构，并在真实任务上产出超过强基线的专用模型。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Towards Credible Agent-Based Policy Simulations: Disentangling Opportunities and Preferences in a Financial Inclusion Case Study of Egypt
papers.abstract_en: Credibility is a central topic for agent-based models intended to support policy-making. Simulations must not only represent the target scenarios and their core dynamics but also demonstrate that their assumptions, parameters, and outputs are empirically grounded and sufficiently accurate for their intended use. This paper addresses this challenge by presenting a general modelling framework, aligned with the Capability Approach, for building credible policy simulations that rely on data and domain-expert knowledge. It then demonstrates how it can be contextualised and implemented to study the social challenge of financial inclusion in Egypt, building on an agent-based model that represents heterogeneous individuals and firms behaving according to their financial states, barriers, opportunities, and preferences. The model is fitted to real-world data in two stages, initialisation and calibration, which respectively build representative synthetic populations and estimate behavioural parameters. By fixing the feasibility parameters, which determine agents' opportunities, and calibrating preference parameters across different population groups, we are able to distinguish and analyse the role of institutional and social barriers in the system, as well as the role of agents' motivations and priorities. This calibration stage provides transparent and group-specific hypotheses about the drivers of observed financial-inclusion gaps, which can further be analysed as gaps between agents' opportunities and realised outcomes, a very relevant insight for policy-making. This paper is thus a step towards improving the credibility and usefulness of policy simulations, strengthening the relationship between the model, the real target system, and the stakeholders who will use it. The code is available at: \url{https://www.comses.net/codebase-release/df8383cb-f49b-4f09-8cce-73603b59adcc/}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个与 Capability Approach 对齐的 agent-based 政策仿真可信性建模框架，并在埃及金融普惠案例中分两阶段拟合真实数据：初始化构建代表性合成人口，校准估计行为参数。固定决定机会的 feasibility 参数、按人群组校准 preference 参数后，可把制度与社会壁垒同 agent 的动机优先级分离开，得到关于金融普惠差距驱动因素的分组透明假设。
Motivation: 用于政策制定的 agent-based 模型常被质疑假设、参数与输出缺乏经验支撑；需要一种把壁垒与偏好拆开、且对利益相关者可解释的可信性构建方式。
Method: 通用建模框架与 Capability Approach 对齐，依托数据与领域专家知识构建仿真；两阶段拟合真实数据——初始化阶段生成异质个体与企业的代表性合成人口，校准阶段估计行为参数；随后固定 feasibility 参数（决定机会），仅跨人群组校准 preference 参数，从而分离机会与已实现结果之间的差距。
Result: 产出分人群组的、透明的关于埃及金融普惠差距驱动因素的假设，可将差距表达为 agent 的机会与已实现结果之差；模型中异质个体与企业依据其金融状态、壁垒、机会与偏好行动。
Conclusion: 通过固定机会参数、分组校准偏好参数，政策仿真可以区分制度/社会壁垒与 agent 动机各自的作用，从而提升模型与真实系统及使用者之间的可信性与可用性；代码已在 CoMSES 发布。

papers.title: ManifoldCache: Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration via Constraint Manifold Caching
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models for structured scientific generation must produce samples satisfying hard geometric constraints imposed by physics, chemistry, or biology, yet inference in these settings is prohibitively slow, demanding hundreds to thousands of neural-function evaluations per sample. We unify eight state-of-the-art models spanning medical volumetrics, molecular conformations, protein backbone design, crystal structure prediction, and multi-view 3D scenes under a single abstraction, Constraint-Manifold Diffusion Models (CMDMs), in which the target distribution is supported on a manifold defined by an externally specified constraint map. All existing acceleration families fail on this class: quantization exhausts memory on high-dimensional volumetric operators; pruning breaks constraint fidelity; fast ODE solvers allow trajectories to drift off the constraint manifold; and feature-caching heuristics are blind to constraint geometry, inducing mode confusion in the high-noise regime. We introduce ManifoldCache, the first training-free, data-free accelerator designed from first principles for CMDMs. The key insight is that the conditional score decomposes orthogonally into a normal component, which enforces constraint satisfaction, and a tangential component, which navigates within the manifold. Exploiting this structure, we prove that the noise-schedule midpoint is a sharp safe-caching boundary: caching before it incurs provably bounded error, while caching after it guarantees a strictly positive fraction of trajectories suffer mode confusion, a gap that persists up to the boundary. We further prove that deeper network blocks admit provably larger certified cache strides within the safe phase, as a consequence of the score decomposition propagating through block Jacobians. The resulting schedule requires no calibration data, along with zero training overhead.

papers.title: LoRA's Second Descent Extends Beyond Parameter Parity
papers.abstract_en: Double descent has sparked considerable interest, with recent work relating it to the data, the model and the learning configuration. Practical fine-tuning commonly involves training a small adapter on top of frozen pretrained weights, as in low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The adapter's rank is the hyperparameter that sets its capacity, yet how this rank relates to double descent has not been well explored. We quantify this relation under label noise on four vision backbones and a 7B language model with a module-matched rank sweep (MMRS), which extends past full rank and compares every rank with dense fine-tuning of the same modules, paired by seed. On DeiT-Tiny, risk is lowest at rank one and rises sharply as the adapter becomes able to fit the noisy labels, forming an interpolation cliff. Past the peak, risk falls again, but every tested post-peak rank that still saves parameters remains above dense risk. Rank-one LoRA outperforms dense fine-tuning on three of the four vision backbones, consistent with strong regularization at small rank. LoRA thus exhibits a second descent, but matches dense risk only after losing its parameter advantage, first on DeiT-Tiny at four times dense's projection weights. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/lora-second-descent-C7B5.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoRA 在标签噪声下也出现二次下降 (double descent)：rank 增大先让适配器拟合噪声标签、风险陡升形成插值悬崖，越过峰值后风险再降，但所有仍省参数的 post-peak rank 都没追上 dense 微调。rank-1 LoRA 在四个视觉 backbone 中的三个上优于 dense，而首次追平 dense 风险要到 DeiT-Tiny 上达到 dense 投影权重的四倍参数量，此时参数优势已消失。
Motivation: double descent 已被从数据、模型、学习配置角度解释，但实践中常用的 LoRA 其容量超参 rank 与 double descent 的关系没有被系统研究。
Method: 提出 module-matched rank sweep (MMRS)：在标签噪声设定下扫过全秩乃至更高的 rank，并把每个 rank 与同一批模块的 dense 微调按 seed 配对比较；测试对象为四个视觉 backbone 和一个 7B 语言模型。
Result: DeiT-Tiny 上风险在 rank 1 最低，随适配器能拟合噪声标签而急剧上升形成 interpolation cliff，过峰后回落，但每个仍省参数的 post-peak rank 风险都高于 dense；rank-1 LoRA 在四个视觉 backbone 中的三个上优于 dense 微调；LoRA 首次追平 dense 风险出现在 DeiT-Tiny 上、参数量为 dense 投影权重的 4 倍。
Conclusion: LoRA 确实存在二次下降，但只有在放弃参数优势之后才能匹配 dense 风险；小 rank 的优势来自强正则化而非容量。

papers.title: EgoExo-Next:Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Visual-Option Next-State and Cross-View Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly evaluated for egocentric and cross-view video reasoning, yet existing benchmarks largely focus on semantic event understanding, temporal relations, or correspondence between already observed views, leaving their ability to reason directly about future visual states underexplored. We introduce EgoExo-Next, a visual-option benchmark for dynamic visual-state reasoning, where models must identify how an observed action trajectory subsequently appears rather than predict only an action label or textual description. EgoExo-Next contains 2,503 human-curated four-choice questions from six public egocentric and ego--exo video sources and comprises four interconnected subtasks that evaluate egocentric next-state prediction, bidirectional ego--exo state correspondence, exocentric next-state prediction, and their composition in Ego-to-Exo Next-State. Extensive evaluation of proprietary, open-source, and spatial reasoning VLMs reveals a substantial human--model gap, with the best model achieving 43.81\% average accuracy compared with 98.55\% for humans, and the largest degradation occurring on the composed Ego-to-Exo task. These results suggest that current VLMs remain substantially limited in dynamic visual-state reasoning, particularly when temporal progression and cross-view reasoning must be composed. The benchmark is publicly available at \url{https://huggingface.co/datasets/yutongli2024/EgoExo-Next}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EgoExo-Next 是一个视觉选项 (visual-option) 下一状态推理基准：2,503 道人工标注四选一题，覆盖自我中心与自我-外视角视频的下一状态预测、双向状态对应及其组合任务。评测专有、开源与空间推理 VLM 后，最佳模型平均准确率 43.81%，人类 98.55%，差距在组合的 Ego-to-Exo 任务上最大。
Motivation: 现有自我中心与跨视角视频基准多考察语义事件、时序关系或已观测视角间的对应，模型直接推理未来视觉状态的能力未被检验。
Method: 构建含 2,503 道人工整理四选一题的基准，数据来自六个公开的自我中心与 ego-exo 视频源；设四个相互关联的子任务：自我中心下一状态预测、双向 ego-exo 状态对应、外视角下一状态预测，以及二者组合的 Ego-to-Exo Next-State；对专有、开源与空间推理 VLM 做广泛评测。
Result: 最佳模型平均准确率 43.81%，人类 98.55%；性能退化最大的是组合式 Ego-to-Exo 任务。
Conclusion: 当前 VLM 在动态视觉状态推理上仍明显受限，尤其当时序推进与跨视角推理需要组合时；基准已在 Hugging Face 公开。

papers.title: Localization Lens for Improving Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Medical Vision-Language Models (Med-VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in clinical tasks. However, they often struggle to understand anatomical structures and spatial positioning, which are crucial for medical reasoning. To address this, we propose a localization-aware enhancement to the Med-VLM pipeline, introducing improvements at three levels: data,architecture, and alignment. First, we introduce localization lens, a set of expert-validated representations that provide richer anatomical and positional context. However, as these representations increase input complexity, we integrate pixel shuffle within the model architecture to filter and refine representations, enhancing spatial information processing while preserving anatomical continuity. Lastly, to effectively align the localization lens representations with textual features, we incorporate decoupled contrastive loss (DCL) alongside the standard loss function. This ensures better feature discrimination and robustness, particularly in data limited medical settings. Through extensive evaluations on medical visual question answering (Med-VQA) datasets, we show that our methodology improves localization-driven performance across different Med-VLM architectures. Our analysis of localization-based questions further reveals that improvements in anatomy and spatial reasoning directly enhance the overall accuracy of Med-VQA upto 6.2%. The proposed approach is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing Med-VLM pipelines. The dataset, code, and trained models will be made publicly available at https://github.com/CVLABLUMS/localizationlens.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention (MICCAI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 localization lens：一组专家校验的解剖与位置表征，配合架构内的 pixel shuffle 精炼和解耦对比损失 (DCL)，把空间定位能力注入 Med-VLM 管线。在 Med-VQA 数据集上，解剖与空间推理的提升直接带动整体准确率最高提升 6.2%，且该方法模型无关、可插入现有 Med-VLM。
Motivation: Med-VLM 在临床任务上表现强，但对解剖结构与空间位置的理解普遍不足，而这正是医学推理所需的能力。
Method: 三层改造：数据层引入专家校验的 localization lens 表征以补充解剖与位置上下文；架构层用 pixel shuffle 过滤并精炼这些表征、在提升输入复杂度的同时保持解剖连续性；对齐层在标准损失外加入 decoupled contrastive loss (DCL)，使 lens 表征与文本特征更好对齐，面向数据受限的医学场景。
Result: 在 Med-VQA 数据集上的评测显示，该方法在不同 Med-VLM 架构上均提升定位驱动的表现；对定位类问题的分析表明解剖与空间推理的改善直接带来 Med-VQA 整体准确率最高 6.2% 的提升。
Conclusion: 把解剖定位信息从数据、架构、对齐三处同时注入，可在模型无关的前提下提升 Med-VLM 的医学推理准确率；数据集、代码与训练模型将公开。

papers.title: Homogeneous Semantic Alignment and Hierarchical Expert Routing for Radiology Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Radiology report generation (RRG) aims to convert medical images into diagnostic texts to assist in clinical decision-making and alleviate the workload of physicians. Although existing methods have made extensive progress in cross-modal interaction and the incorporation of external priors, the distribution shift of underlying representations and the undifferentiated rigid coupling of heterogeneous information cause weak visual abnormality cues to be easily diluted by massive text priors and generation inertia during decoding. To overcome this bottleneck, inspired by cognitive science, we propose a novel two-stage Homogeneous Semantic Alignment and Hierarchical Expert Routing (HSA-HER) framework. First, the model introduces an explicit homogeneous distribution constraint in the underlying latent space to effectively eliminate the cross-modal distribution shift between visual and textual features, thereby extracting purified visual features as semantic anchors that accurately align with diseases. Second, for heterogeneous clinical evidence composed of visual features, local entities, and global retrievals, we design a hierarchical expert routing mechanism guided by these disease semantic anchors. This mechanism abandons the undifferentiated rigid coupling paradigm. Specifically, it dynamically activates expert networks to perform targeted mining and semantic reconstruction on multi-source evidence, and adaptively allocates fusion weights. Extensive experiments on three mainstream benchmark datasets demonstrate that HSA-HER achieves state-of-the-art performance, accurately depicting complex imaging details and key diagnostic information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两阶段 HSA-HER 框架用于放射报告生成 (radiology report generation)：先在隐空间加显式同质分布约束消除视觉-文本跨模态分布偏移，得到与疾病对齐的纯净视觉语义锚点，再由这些锚点引导分层专家路由，动态激活专家网络对视觉特征、局部实体与全局检索证据做定向挖掘并自适应分配融合权重。在三个主流基准上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有 RRG 方法虽改进了跨模态交互与外部先验引入，但底层表征存在分布偏移，且异质信息被无差别刚性耦合，导致微弱的视觉异常线索在海量文本先验与解码生成惯性中被稀释。
Method: 两阶段 HSA-HER：第一阶段在底层隐空间施加显式同质分布约束 (homogeneous distribution constraint)，消除视觉与文本特征的跨模态分布偏移，提取与疾病精确对齐的纯净视觉特征作为语义锚点；第二阶段以该锚点引导分层专家路由 (hierarchical expert routing)，对视觉特征、局部实体、全局检索三类异质临床证据动态激活专家网络做定向挖掘与语义重建，并自适应分配融合权重，取代无差别刚性耦合。
Result: 在三个主流 benchmark 数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，能够准确刻画复杂影像细节与关键诊断信息。
Conclusion: 先用同质分布约束把视觉特征净化为疾病语义锚点、再按锚点做分层专家路由，是 RRG 中抑制文本先验稀释视觉异常线索的有效范式。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.method: 两阶段 HSA-HER：第一阶段在底层隐空间施加显式同质分布约束 (homogeneous distribution constraint)，消除视觉与文本特征的跨模态分布偏移，提取与疾病精确对齐的纯净视觉特征作为语义锚点；第二阶段以该锚点引导分层专家路由 (hierarchical expert routing)，对视觉特征、局部实体、全局检索三类异质临床证据动态激活专家网络做定向挖掘与语义重建，并自适应分配融合权重，取代无差别刚性耦合。
summary_sections.result: 在三个主流 benchmark 数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，能够准确刻画复杂影像细节与关键诊断信息。
summary_sections.conclusion: 先用同质分布约束把视觉特征净化为疾病语义锚点、再按锚点做分层专家路由，是 RRG 中抑制文本先验稀释视觉异常线索的有效范式。

papers.title: DreamTest: World-Model Surrogates for Search-Based Testing of Deep Reinforcement Learning Agents
papers.abstract_en: Testing deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agents in cyber-physical systems aims to uncover diverse failures before deployment, but each execution can be expensive. Surrogate-assisted testing reduces this cost by learning to predict which test configurations are likely to fail. Prior surrogates treat the system as a black box and predict pass or fail outcomes directly; we instead model how a test unfolds and estimate failure from an imagined episode. We introduce DreamTest, a world-model surrogate for testing DRL agents. DreamTest adapts a recurrent state-space model to learn agent behaviour and environment dynamics from the agent's training log. Given a candidate configuration, imagined rollouts produce a failure score that guides search without executing every candidate in a simulator or real system. We evaluate DreamTest for failure prediction, test generation, and failure diversity on Parking, Humanoid, and DonkeyCar. Mean area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) exceeds the strongest baseline by 97%, 12%, and 39%, respectively, and gains on five out-of-distribution test sets reach 145%, 29%, and 44%. Under the same simulator-validation budget, the best "DreamTest + search" combinations find 29%, 22%, and 79% more novel failures on average. Across clusterings with k = 2-40, failures generated with DreamTest cover the most behavioural clusters for almost all k, indicating that DreamTest consistently discovers behaviourally diverse failures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DreamTest 用循环状态空间模型 (recurrent state-space model) 从 DRL agent 训练日志学行为与环境动力学，把测试配置变成想象 rollout 的失败分数来引导搜索，无需在仿真器里逐个执行。在 Parking、Humanoid、DonkeyCar 上，AUPRC 分别超出最强基线 97%、12%、39%，五个分布外测试集增益达 145%、29%、44%；同等仿真验证预算下多找到 29%、22%、79% 的新颖失败。
Motivation: 在信息物理系统里测试 DRL agent 每次执行都很贵，而既有代理模型把系统当黑盒直接预测 pass/fail，无法刻画测试如何展开，失败预测与多样性受限。
Method: 把循环状态空间模型改造成 world-model 代理，从 agent 训练日志学习 agent 行为与环境动力学；对候选配置做想象 rollout 得到失败分数，再驱动搜索，替代在仿真器或真实系统中执行每个候选。
Result: 在 Parking、Humanoid、DonkeyCar 上平均 AUPRC 分别超出最强基线 97%、12%、39%；五个 out-of-distribution 测试集增益分别达 145%、29%、44%。同等仿真验证预算下，最佳 DreamTest+搜索组合平均多找到 29%、22%、79% 的新颖失败；在 k=2–40 的聚类中，DreamTest 生成的失败在几乎所有 k 上覆盖最多行为簇。
Conclusion: 把测试配置建模成可想象展开的 episode 而非黑盒分类，能在固定预算下同时提高 DRL 失败预测精度、失败新颖度与行为多样性。

papers.title: Understanding Clustering in Slot Attention via Particle Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Studying attention through the lens of interacting particle dynamics has shown how token clustering can emerge from the underlying dynamics. We extend this perspective to slot attention, a method for object-centric image segmentation and representation learning in which learned components obscure how much of the clustering behaviour is intrinsic to the attention dynamics. We therefore introduce simplified slot attention (SSA), a parameter-free variant whose dynamics are connected to soft $k$-means clustering and which provides a straightforward mechanistic explanation for the emergence of object-centric representations. On the Pascal VOC dataset, SSA achieves performance comparable to that of slot attention, demonstrating that competitive object-centric segmentation can be achieved without learned neural-network components.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the DynaFront workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无参数的 simplified slot attention (SSA)，把 slot attention 的更新动力学与 soft k-means 聚类直接对应，说明物体中心表征的涌现可由注意力动力学本身解释，无需学习的神经网络组件。在 Pascal VOC 上 SSA 达到与 slot attention 相当的物体中心分割性能。
Motivation: slot attention 中的学习组件掩盖了聚类行为有多少来自注意力动力学本身，难以给出机理解释。
Method: 从相互作用粒子动力学视角出发，提出参数无关的 SSA 变体，其动力学与 soft k-means 聚类相联系，用于物体中心图像分割与表征学习。
Result: 在 Pascal VOC 数据集上，SSA 的物体中心分割性能与 slot attention 相当，且不含任何学习的神经网络组件。
Conclusion: 有竞争力的物体中心分割可以在没有学习组件的条件下实现，slot attention 的聚类行为本质上源于其注意力动力学。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: BARQ: Balanced Codebook Refinement for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) grow in parameter count, model storage and parameter memory traffic have become major bottlenecks to efficient deployment. Codebook-based weight quantization reduces these costs, but imbalanced nearest-codeword assignments during fitting can leave some codewords insufficiently updated, limiting effective codebook utilization. To address this limitation, we propose Balanced Assignment Refinement for Quantization (BARQ), which improves quantization quality through balanced fitting of existing codebooks. Specifically, we first compute joint soft assignments between weight blocks and codewords through entropically regularized optimal transport with uniform marginals and curvature-weighted reconstruction costs, ensuring equal positive fitting mass for every codeword in the exact solution. We then refine the codewords through an assignment-weighted barycentric update, which we prove minimizes the fitting objective for fixed assignments. For finite Sinkhorn iterations, the implemented update retains this optimality provided all codeword masses exceed the denominator floor. Finally, we discard the soft assignments and use the refined codebook for standard hard nearest-codeword encoding, with our analysis establishing sufficient conditions for reducing hard-quantization distortion and evaluation loss. Across multiple LLMs, BARQ achieves lower perplexity and higher mean zero-shot accuracy than the evaluated baselines at comparable bit budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/chenhangcuisg-code/BARQ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BARQ 用带熵正则、边缘分布取均匀的最优传输 (optimal transport) 求权重块与码字的联合软分配，保证每个码字获得相等的正拟合质量，再做分配加权重心更新精修码库，最后丢弃软分配做常规最近码字硬编码。在多个 LLM 上，同等 bit 预算下 BARQ 的困惑度更低、零样本平均准确率高于所评测基线。
Motivation: 基于码库的权重量化能降低 LLM 存储与参数内存传输开销，但拟合时最近码字分配不均衡，部分码字更新不足，码库利用率受限。
Method: 先用熵正则最优传输（均匀边缘分布、曲率加权重构代价）计算权重块与码字的联合软分配；再做分配加权重心更新精修码字，作者证明该更新在固定分配下最小化拟合目标，有限次 Sinkhorn 迭代下只要各码字质量高于分母下界即保持最优性；最后丢弃软分配，用精修码库做标准硬最近码字编码，并给出降低硬量化失真与评估损失的充分条件。
Result: 在多个 LLM 上，BARQ 在可比 bit 预算下取得比所评测基线更低的 perplexity 和更高的零样本平均准确率；理论上给出固定分配下重心更新最小化拟合目标、以及降低硬量化失真与评估损失的充分条件。
Conclusion: 把码库拟合改成均衡的最优传输分配加重心精修，可以在不改硬编码流程的前提下提升低比特 LLM 量化质量，前提是各码字质量不低于分母下界。

papers.title: DV-Lens: Revealing the Functional Organization of Language Model Parameters
papers.abstract_en: Understanding parameter functions helps elucidate the internal mechanisms of large language models (LLMs). However, how to connect parameters from different modules to verifiable output effects and further characterize the relationship between their functional organization and model capability remains to be explored. To this end, we introduce the downstream vocabulary lens (DV-Lens), a parameter-level interpretability framework that links native parameter directions to their downstream vocabulary responses. Specifically, we first estimate module-specific downstream Jacobians over a reference prompt set for attention query, key, value, and output (Q/K/V/O) projections and feed-forward networks (FFNs). Second, we use these mappings to project native parameter columns into the final vocabulary space, obtaining signed readouts that characterize their average local output responses. Third, we group parameter columns by their vocabulary readouts and introduce downstream vocabulary complexity (DV-Complexity), which quantifies within-group structural variation using normalized reconstruction residuals of the original weights. At the parameter level, randomized controls and finite-difference tests show that DV-Lens readouts capture non-random vocabulary structure and predict local logit changes with 98.0% coordinate-orientation agreement across 720 cases from nine models. These readouts further guide parameter ablation, steering, and swapping across 21 models, shifting target-token probabilities in the predicted directions under controlled conditions. At the model level, the joint-parameter score of DV-Complexity achieves a Spearman correlation of 0.904 with benchmark-based capability rankings across 48 language models. Together, these results provide intervention-based evidence for DV-Lens interpretations and reveal an association between DV-Complexity and model capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DV-Lens 把 LLM 各模块的原生参数方向投影到最终词表空间，得到带符号的下游词表读出，并据此分组定义 DV-Complexity。读出在 9 个模型 720 例上以 98.0% 的坐标方向一致率预测局部 logit 变化，且 DV-Complexity 联合分数在 48 个语言模型上与能力排名的 Spearman 相关达 0.904。
Motivation: LLM 参数与可验证输出效应之间缺少直接对应，参数的功能组织与模型能力的关系也未被刻画。
Method: 在参考 prompt 集上估计 Q/K/V/O 投影与 FFN 的模块特异下游 Jacobian，用它把原生参数列投影到词表空间得到带符号读出；按读出对参数列分组，用原权重的归一化重构残差定义组内结构差异 DV-Complexity，并做随机对照与有限差分检验。
Result: 参数层面：9 个模型共 720 例中，读出预测局部 logit 变化的坐标方向一致率为 98.0%；读出还指导 21 个模型上的参数消融、引导与交换，使目标 token 概率在受控条件下按预测方向移动。模型层面：DV-Complexity 联合参数分数与基于基准的能力排名在 48 个语言模型上的 Spearman 相关为 0.904。
Conclusion: 干预实验为 DV-Lens 的读出解释提供证据，DV-Complexity 与模型能力存在关联。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Can LLM Agents Automate Reinforcement Learning for Text-to-Speech?
papers.abstract_en: Although reinforcement learning (RL) post-training repairs the localized segmental errors of zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS), arriving at a working recipe still relies on tedious manual tuning, and whether LLM agents can take over this research pipeline is unclear. We investigate this question with AgenticTTS-Forge, a collaborative workflow that structures human guidance and agentic execution around a shared workspace, applied to CosyVoice2-0.5B. To measure what the agent automates, we audit its trajectory stage by stage against the published recipe. To measure what it exploits, we score its policies with held-out observers hidden from the agent. Our results show that the agent recovers an underspecified recipe, improves it, and, when gains stall, surveys the literature unprompted and pivots from the LM carrier to the flow carrier, halving Bad cases. However, its autonomy exposes three traps across the data, proxy, and algorithm axes: the held-out set leaks through a channel the contract never reads, a self-shaped reward inflates the proxy where it is scored, and separately tuned policies do not compose additively. These findings show that the binding constraint is measurement rather than reasoning, and can inform the design of harnesses whose contracts read every channel the agent does.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 AgenticTTS-Forge 这一共享工作区式的协作流程，让 LLM agent 接管 CosyVoice2-0.5B 上 TTS 强化学习后训练的调参流水线：agent 能补全欠定的 recipe、在增益停滞时自发查文献并从 LM carrier 转向 flow carrier，把 Bad cases 减半。但 agent 自治暴露三类陷阱——held-out 集经合同未读取的通道泄漏、自我塑形的 reward 抬高被评分的 proxy、分别调优的策略不能相加合成，作者据此判定瓶颈在测量而非推理。
Motivation: RL 后训练能修复 zero-shot TTS 的局部片段错误，但拿到可用 recipe 仍靠繁琐手工调参，且 LLM agent 能否接管这条研究流水线尚不清楚。
Method: 提出 AgenticTTS-Forge：围绕共享工作区组织人类引导与 agent 执行的协作流程，应用于 CosyVoice2-0.5B；逐阶段审计 agent 轨迹以对照已发表 recipe，衡量它自动化了什么，并用对 agent 隐藏的 held-out observers 给策略打分，衡量它利用了什么。
Result: agent 补全了一个欠定 recipe 并加以改进；增益停滞时它未经提示主动调研文献，从 LM carrier 转向 flow carrier，Bad cases 减半。审计同时发现三处失效：held-out 集通过合同未读取的通道泄漏、自我形塑的 reward 在被评分处抬高 proxy、分别调优的策略不具可加性。
Conclusion: 约束 LLM agent 做 RL for TTS 的是测量而非推理，harness 的合同必须读取 agent 所读的每一条通道。

summary_sections.result: agent 补全了一个欠定 recipe 并加以改进；增益停滞时它未经提示主动调研文献，从 LM carrier 转向 flow carrier，Bad cases 减半。审计同时发现三处失效：held-out 集通过合同未读取的通道泄漏、自我形塑的 reward 在被评分处抬高 proxy、分别调优的策略不具可加性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 约束 LLM agent 做 RL for TTS 的是测量而非推理，harness 的合同必须读取 agent 所读的每一条通道。

papers.title: VCLMU: Mechanism-Centric Virtual Cell World Modeling for Perturbation Response
papers.abstract_en: Predicting cellular responses to genetic perturbations is a central capability for virtual cells and a key step toward computational modeling of biological interventions. Most existing models directly map an unperturbed molecular profile and perturba- tion to the resulting observation without explicitly representing the latent cellular transition induced by the intervention. We introduce a mechanism-centric virtual cell world model that represents cellular state as a set of Latent Mechanism Units (LMUs) and treats genetic perturbations as actions on these latent states. Each LMU combines a reusable identity grounded in multimodal biological evidence with an observation-specific state, allowing a perturbation to induce mechanism- specific stochastic transitions before decoding the resulting transcriptional response. We train VCLMU through two-stage pretraining, first on around 200K pseudo-bulk perturbation profiles and then on gene-aligned single-cell perturbation data. Across six perturbation-disjoint benchmarks, VCLMU consistently improves perturbation- specific response recovery over strong baselines while maintaining competitive global response accuracy. We further analyze learned LMUs through enrichment between perturbation responses and LMU gene sets and show that they capture structured biological response programs. These results support mechanism-level latent state transition as a useful formulation for virtual cell models that aim to predict and interpret cellular responses to biological interventions.
papers.comment: This paper was accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 workshop on AI for drug discovery
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VCLMU 把细胞状态表示为一组 Latent Mechanism Units (LMU)，将遗传扰动视为对这些潜在状态的 action，先产生机制特异的随机转移再解码转录响应。经约 200K pseudo-bulk 扰动谱加基因对齐单细胞扰动数据的两阶段预训练，在六个 perturbation-disjoint 基准上持续改善扰动特异响应恢复，同时保持有竞争力的全局响应精度。
Motivation: 现有虚拟细胞模型直接从未扰动分子谱与扰动映射到观测结果，不显式表示干预诱导的潜在细胞转移过程，因而难以解释扰动响应的机制。
Method: 每个 LMU 结合由多模态生物学证据支撑的可复用 identity 与观测特异 state，使扰动先诱导机制特异的随机状态转移，再解码转录响应；训练采用两阶段预训练，先在约 200K pseudo-bulk perturbation profiles 上，再在 gene-aligned 单细胞扰动数据上。
Result: 在六个 perturbation-disjoint 基准上，VCLMU 相对强基线持续提升 perturbation-specific response recovery，同时保持有竞争力的 global response accuracy；通过扰动响应与 LMU gene set 的富集分析显示 LMU 捕获了结构化的生物学响应程序。
Conclusion: 机制层面的潜在状态转移可作为虚拟细胞模型的有效形式化，用于预测并解释细胞对生物干预的响应。

papers.title: InferOpt: Constrained Multi-Objective Search for LLM Inference Configurations
papers.abstract_en: Serving an LLM means setting dozens of inference-time knobs, from per-layer KV retention to per-layer expert counts. Practice sets them with mechanism-specific heuristics that return a single operating point and do not scale to layer-wise search spaces. We recast inference configuration as constrained multi-objective black-box optimization and build InferOpt, a reusable search framework that requires only variable bounds, a deterministic resource cost, and an evaluation hook. InferOpt searches on a frozen sampled proxy set, rejects over-budget candidates before any model call, tightens the budget adaptively, and re-validates Pareto representatives on full-scale dataset. One pipeline covers a 28-dimensional continuous KV space (Qwen2.5-7B) and a 26-dimensional discrete MoE space (DeepSeek-V2-Lite). On KV, post-prefill pruning cuts the 16K cache by 64.4% and TPOT by 22.9--48.5%, and the searched layer-wise budget by InferOpt beats a matched uniform budget by 7.3% and 14.0% of the Full KV reference points. On MoE, a searched top-k schedule by InferOpt removes 43.0% of routed token--expert pairs while staying within 0.59 points of the default, closer than the matched-budget baselines. Against Random Search, NSGA-II, and MOTPE, InferOpt leads on both spaces, taking the best proxy hypervolume and the lowest retention on KV and staying closest to the uncompressed reference at the lowest experts on MoE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InferOpt 把 LLM 推理配置重写为带资源预算约束的多目标黑盒搜索，只需变量边界、确定性代价函数和评估钩子即可复用。在 28 维 KV 连续空间 (Qwen2.5-7B) 与 26 维 MoE 离散空间 (DeepSeek-V2-Lite) 上，KV 侧 post-prefill pruning 压缩 16K cache 64.4%、TPOT 降 22.9–48.5%，逐层预算比 matched uniform 预算多保留 7.3% 与 14.0% 的 Full KV 参考点；MoE 侧移除 43.0% 的 routed token–expert pairs 而质量仅掉 0.59 点。
Motivation: LLM 服务要调几十个推理期旋钮（逐层 KV 保留、逐层专家数），现有机制专用启发式只给单一工作点，且无法扩展到逐层搜索空间。
Method: 将推理配置形式化为约束多目标黑盒优化，框架只要求变量边界、确定性资源代价与评估钩子；在冻结的采样代理集上搜索，先在任何模型调用前拒绝超预算候选，自适应收紧预算，再在全量数据集上复验 Pareto 代表点。
Result: KV 空间 (Qwen2.5-7B, 28 维)：post-prefill pruning 使 16K cache 减 64.4%、TPOT 降 22.9–48.5%；InferOpt 搜出的逐层预算比 matched uniform 预算多保留 7.3% 与 14.0% 的 Full KV 参考点。MoE 空间 (DeepSeek-V2-Lite, 26 维)：搜出的 top-k schedule 移除 43.0% 的 routed token–expert pairs，质量距默认仅 0.59 点，比 matched-budget 基线更接近。对比 Random Search、NSGA-II、MOTPE，InferOpt 在两个空间均领先：KV 上取得最佳 proxy hypervolume 与最低 retention，MoE 上以最少 experts 最贴近未压缩参考。
Conclusion: 统一的约束多目标搜索框架可跨连续 KV 与离散 MoE 两类异质推理配置空间复用，并在同等预算下优于随机搜索、NSGA-II 与 MOTPE。

papers.title: Semantic Causal-Factor Inference from Aviation Incident Narratives Using A Variational Autoencoder with Cosine-Similarity-Based Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Aviation accident and incident investigations generate extensive unstructured textual information containing evidence relevant to the causes and contributing factors of safety occurrences. Automatically extracting such information is challenging because causal evidence may be distributed across long and complex investigation narratives. This study proposes a semantic causal-factor inference framework combining natural language processing with a variational autoencoder (VAE) to learn the relationship between aviation investigation narratives and expert-reported probable causes. Investigation narratives and their corresponding probable causes are transformed into numerical representations, after which the encoder maps narrative representations to a probabilistic latent space. The decoder estimates representations of the corresponding probable causes and is trained using an objective that combines Kullback-Leibler divergence with cosine-similarity-based semantic reconstruction. The framework was evaluated using 20,919 finalized U.S. National Transportation Safety Board investigation reports from 2005 to 2020. On the held-out test set, the predicted and expert-reported probable-cause representations achieved a mean cosine similarity of 0.786 (SD = 0.120). The predicted representations also yielded interpretable terms associated with causal information in the reports. The results demonstrate the potential of probabilistic latent representation learning for AI-assisted extraction of causal information from aviation safety narratives while retaining expert investigation as the basis for formal causal determination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 NLP 加变分自编码器 (VAE) 把航空事故调查叙述映射到概率隐空间，再由解码器重建专家判定的 probable cause，损失为 KL 散度加余弦相似度语义重建。在 20,919 份 2005–2020 年 NTSB 终版报告上，留出测试集预测与专家 probable-cause 表示的平均余弦相似度为 0.786（SD=0.120），且预测表示给出与报告因果信息相关的可解释词项。
Motivation: 航空事故调查叙述冗长复杂，因果证据分散在长文本中，自动抽取与专家判定的 probable cause 对应的因果信息困难。
Method: 将调查叙述与对应 probable cause 各自转为数值表示，编码器把叙述表示映射到概率隐空间，解码器估计 probable cause 表示；训练目标结合 Kullback-Leibler 散度与基于余弦相似度的语义重建。
Result: 在 20,919 份 2005–2020 年美国 NTSB 终版调查报告上评估，留出测试集预测表示与专家 probable-cause 表示的平均余弦相似度 0.786（SD=0.120）；预测表示还产出与报告中因果信息相关的可解释词项。
Conclusion: 概率隐表示学习可支撑航空安全叙述中因果信息的 AI 辅助抽取，同时仍以专家调查作为正式因果判定的依据。

papers.title: Reactivating Alignment: Defending LLMs from Jailbreaks via Intention-Aware Input-Output Matching
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that conceal harmful intent within complex adversarial prompts. Existing defenses primarily rely on input perturbation or harmful-output suppression, but they rarely model where malicious intent resides, resulting in brittle protection and excessive over-refusal. We propose SENTINEL, a plug-and-play, generation-time jailbreak defense that reframes mitigation as an intent extraction problem. Our key insight is that instruction-tuned LLMs exhibit strong input--output semantic consistency: regardless of jailbreak complexity, generated outputs tend to align with the attacker's true intent. SENTINEL exploits this property by matching semantically aligned input--output regions to extract intention-revealing subsequences, scores these subsequences using refusal-direction projections to estimate harmfulness, and halts generation when necessary. Experiments on HarmBench across multiple LLMs show that SENTINEL reduces jailbreak success rates to close to 5\% while maintaining low over-refusal. We further demonstrate robustness to adaptive attacks and provide a mechanistic interpretation: SENTINEL re-distributes jailbreak features from alignment blind spots to aligned regions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SENTINEL 是生成期即插即用的越狱防御，把缓解重构为意图提取：利用指令微调 LLM 输入-输出语义一致这一性质，匹配语义对齐的输入-输出区域抽出暴露意图的子序列，用拒绝方向投影 (refusal-direction projections) 打分并在必要时中止生成。在 HarmBench 上跨多个 LLM 将越狱成功率压到接近 5%，同时保持低过度拒绝，并对自适应攻击保持稳健。
Motivation: 现有防御多依赖输入扰动或有害输出抑制，很少建模恶意意图藏在哪里，导致防护脆弱且过度拒绝严重。
Method: 生成期防御：匹配语义对齐的输入-输出区域以抽取意图暴露子序列，对这些子序列用拒绝方向投影打分估计有害性，超过阈值即中止生成；机制解释为把越狱特征从对齐盲区重新分配到对齐区域。
Result: 在 HarmBench 上跨多个 LLM 实验中，越狱成功率降至接近 5%，同时保持低过度拒绝；对自适应攻击展示稳健性。
Conclusion: 利用输入-输出语义一致性做意图感知匹配，可以在不过度拒绝的前提下挡住复杂越狱，且防御可被机制性地解释为特征重分布。

papers.title: Trinity: Self-Evolving Vision-Language Models with a Self-Verifier
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving vision-language models (VLMs), a form of self-improvement in which a model generates its own training data from unlabeled images, are a promising route toward agents that expand their reasoning capability in an unsupervised manner, without relying on ever-larger annotation budgets. Existing methods pair a Questioner that proposes problems with a Solver that answers them, but reward both roles mainly by agreement among sampled answers. Agreement is a weak proxy for truth: it cannot tell whether a question is grounded in the image, whether the proposed reference answer is right, or whether a confident majority is wrong in the same way. We present Trinity, in which one VLM plays three roles, Questioner, Solver, and Verifier, and the Verifier is a self-verifier: an exponential moving average (EMA) of the policy itself, requiring neither labels nor an external judge. The Verifier screens every generated question for image grounding and answer correctness before it becomes supervision, scores Solver reasoning against the image, and adjudicates disputes between the reference answer and a strong Solver consensus, correcting the reference and penalizing the Questioner when the consensus is right. Trained on images alone, Trinity improves Qwen3-VL-8B on mathematical visual reasoning and on science benchmarks with biology content, for example, +8.6 points on the biology split of SciVQR and +12.8 on MathVerse, and its reward dynamics behave as a healthy self-play curriculum should. These results suggest that a self-evolving multimodal agent can strengthen its scientific reasoning from unlabeled scientific images alone, with the model itself serving as the verifier.
papers.comment: NeurIPS'26 Workshop on Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Trinity 让单个 VLM 同时扮演 Questioner、Solver、Verifier 三个角色，Verifier 是策略自身的指数滑动平均 (EMA)，在无标签图像上自生成训练数据并自我校验。仅用无标签科学图像训练后，Qwen3-VL-8B 在 SciVQR 生物学子集提升 +8.6 分、MathVerse 提升 +12.8 分。
Motivation: 现有 Questioner–Solver 自进化方法用采样答案之间的一致性当奖励，而一致既不能判断问题是否贴合图像、参考答案是否正确，也无法识别多数答案自信地错成一样。
Method: 单一 VLM 分饰 Questioner、Solver、Verifier；Verifier 取策略自身的 EMA，无需标签或外部裁判。它在问题进入监督前筛查图像贴合度与答案正确性，依据图像给 Solver 推理打分，并在参考答案与强 Solver 共识冲突时裁决：共识正确则改写参考答案并惩罚 Questioner。
Result: 仅用无标签图像训练，Qwen3-VL-8B 在数学视觉推理与含生物内容的科学基准上提升：SciVQR 生物学子集 +8.6 分，MathVerse +12.8 分；奖励动力学表现符合健康自博弈课程的特征。
Conclusion: 自进化多模态智能体可以只靠无标签科学图像强化科学推理，前提是让模型自身充当 verifier 而非依赖答案一致性。

summary_sections.tldr: Trinity 让单个 VLM 同时扮演 Questioner、Solver、Verifier 三个角色，Verifier 是策略自身的指数滑动平均 (EMA)，在无标签图像上自生成训练数据并自我校验。仅用无标签科学图像训练后，Qwen3-VL-8B 在 SciVQR 生物学子集提升 +8.6 分、MathVerse 提升 +12.8 分。

papers.title: Target-free Latent Safety Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) remain highly vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that induce harmful behaviors and circumvent safety alignment. To defend against such attacks, adversarial training paradigms have been proposed to first simulate failure modes and then train the model to correct them, yielding promising improvements in safety alignment. However, these methods typically construct adversarial samples either by encouraging fixed harmful target completions or by performing targeted activation ablation derived from fixed benign--harmful data pairs. As a result, the generated adversarial samples tend to induce homogeneous harmful behaviors that poorly reflect the diversity of behaviors elicited by real-world jailbreak attacks. This behavior-level narrowness fundamentally limits their robustness. To address this issue, we propose a target-free adversarial training framework that generates adversarial samples in an unsupervised manner. By amplifying and diversifying behavior-level shifts in the model's latent space, our approach produces semantically diverse adversarial samples that induce a wide range of harmful behaviors. This expanded behavioral coverage exposes more diverse failure modes and thereby improves safety alignment. To quantify this effect, we use semantic entropy as an output-level measure of adversarial behavioral diversity. Empirically, our method elicits diverse harmful behaviors in the target model, substantially mitigating behavioral narrowness and improving robustness to jailbreak attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无目标 (target-free) 对抗训练框架：不依赖固定有害目标续写或固定良性-有害对的激活消融，而是在模型隐空间中放大并多样化行为层面的偏移，无监督地生成语义多样的对抗样本，从而覆盖更广的越狱失败模式。用语义熵 (semantic entropy) 度量对抗行为多样性，实证表明该方法能引出多样有害行为、缓解行为窄化并提升对越狱攻击的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有对抗训练先构造固定有害目标续写或基于固定良性-有害对的定向激活消融，生成的对抗样本诱发的行为高度同质，无法反映真实越狱攻击的多样性，行为层面的窄化从根本上限制了鲁棒性。
Method: 无监督的 target-free 对抗训练框架：在隐空间中放大并多样化行为层面的偏移来生成对抗样本，不依赖固定有害目标；以语义熵 (semantic entropy) 作为输出层面的对抗行为多样性度量来量化该效应。
Result: 实证上该方法在目标模型中引出多样的有害行为，显著缓解行为窄化并提升对越狱攻击的鲁棒性；行为多样性由语义熵量化。
Conclusion: 扩大对抗样本的行为覆盖度是提升 LLM 安全对齐鲁棒性的关键，无目标、隐空间驱动的样本生成比固定目标续写或固定数据对激活消融更能暴露多样的失败模式。

papers.title: RPFQ-ViT: Rotated Phase-Frame Quantization for Extremely Low-Bit Weights in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve strong performance on image recognition and mobile vision applications, but their high-dimensional linear projections and attention computations still impose substantial storage and inference costs. Extremely low-bit quantization is a promising solution, yet ViTs often suffer severe accuracy degradation because conventional real-valued scalar codebooks are poorly matched to the directional geometry of Transformer projections. We present RPFQ-ViT, a Rotated Phase-Frame Quantization method that quantizes paired channels in two-dimensional phase planes, enabling low-bit codes to better preserve projection directions while recovering magnitude with lightweight scaling. RPFQ-ViT serves as a drop-in QAT replacement for nn.Linear and does not modify the standard real-valued attention, normalization, or activation computation graph. On ImageNet-1K, RPFQ-ViT-B/16 reaches 79.33% Top-1 / 94.48% Top-5 under W2/A4, Swin-T reaches 79.30% Top-1 / 94.79% Top-5 under W2/A8, and DeiT-S reaches 77.41% Top-1 / 93.11% Top-5 under W2/A8. Ablations, phase-geometry analysis, and direction-preservation metrics show that channel pairing, learnable rotation, phase-anchor learning, and residual phase refinement each improve quantization quality. We further deploy RPFQ-ViT image-classification models on native iOS and Android runtime stacks; with 2-bit packed weights, model size shrinks by roughly $5.4$-$7.1\times$ relative to FP32 and end-to-end on-device latency drops by $1.4$-$1.6\times$. All ImageNet results trained in our codebase use a matched 300-epoch recipe and are reported as mean accuracies over three independent runs. These results show that RPFQ-ViT provides a favorable trade-off among accuracy, compression, and practical mobile deployment for extremely low-bit ViTs.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Current preprint version; camera-ready revision forthcoming
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RPFQ-ViT 把 ViT 线性层的成对通道放到二维相位平面内量化，用可学习旋转与相位锚保留投影方向、以轻量缩放恢复幅值，作为 nn.Linear 的即插即用 QAT 替换且不改动标准 attention/归一化计算图。ImageNet-1K 上 ViT-B/16 在 W2/A4 达 79.33% Top-1 / 94.48% Top-5，Swin-T 与 DeiT-S 在 W2/A8 分别达 79.30% 与 77.41% Top-1；2-bit 打包权重使模型缩小约 5.4–7.1×，端到端端上延迟降低 1.4–1.6×。
Motivation: ViT 的高维线性投影与 attention 计算带来存储与推理开销，极低比特量化本可缓解，但常规实值标量码本与 Transformer 投影的方向几何不匹配，导致精度严重退化。
Method: 在二维相位平面内量化成对通道，低比特码保留投影方向并用轻量缩放恢复幅值；作为 nn.Linear 的 drop-in QAT 替换，不修改实值 attention、归一化与激活计算图。消融与方向保持指标拆解 channel pairing、learnable rotation、phase-anchor learning、residual phase refinement 各自的贡献，ImageNet 结果用统一 300-epoch 配方、三次独立运行取平均。
Result: ImageNet-1K：ViT-B/16 在 W2/A4 达 79.33% Top-1 / 94.48% Top-5；Swin-T 在 W2/A8 达 79.30% Top-1 / 94.79% Top-5；DeiT-S 在 W2/A8 达 77.41% Top-1 / 93.11% Top-5。2-bit 打包权重相对 FP32 模型体积缩小约 5.4–7.1×，iOS 与 Android 原生运行栈上端到端延迟降低 1.4–1.6×。
Conclusion: 按相位几何而非实值标量码本做极低比特量化，可在 W2 权重下同时保住 ImageNet 精度与移动端压缩、延迟收益，且无需改动标准 Transformer 计算图。

papers.title: Multi-Crop Leaf Disease Recognition: A Unified Benchmark and Cross-Region Study
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models for crop leaf disease recognition routinely report near-perfect accuracy yet are typically trained and evaluated on a single dataset collected under controlled laboratory conditions, leaving their behavior under realistic cross-region domain shift poorly understood. We introduce MLD (Multi-crop Leaf Disease) dataset, a unified multi-region benchmark that combines six public crop-disease datasets from the USA, Asia, and Africa into a shared hierarchical taxonomy spanning 18 crops, 56 crop-disease classes (including one healthy class per crop) making 167,427 images. We define standardized single-source and pooled multi-source evaluation protocols that explicitly probe cross-region generalization. We also investigate whether exploiting the inherent crop-to-disease dependency via a hierarchical formulation (HiLeaD) that conditions disease prediction on the predicted crop improves recognition under cross-region shift. Under the HiLeaD, the model trained on PlantVillage achieves 99.07% in-domain disease F1 but collapses to 12.88% when tested on PlantDoc, exposing a severe cross-region domain gap. The model trained on the pooled MLD dataset partly recovers cross-region disease F1 from 12.88% to 39.64% on PlantDoc (HiLeaD), achieving a 26.76 percentage point improvement. The hierarchical formulation provides a consistent additional gain, ranging from 1.71 to 4.88 percentage points in disease F1 over the flat baseline under the MLD dataset indicating that progress in this area is currently limited more by data coverage and diversity than by model design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建统一多区域作物叶部病害基准 MLD（6 个公开数据集、18 种作物、56 个病害类、167,427 张图像），并提出层级式 HiLeaD（先预测作物再条件预测病害）。PlantVillage 训练的模型域内 disease F1 达 99.07%，迁到 PlantDoc 崩到 12.88%；改用 MLD 池化训练后在 PlantDoc 上回升到 39.64%（+26.76 个百分点），层级式相对 flat 基线再加 1.71–4.88 个百分点。
Motivation: 叶部病害识别论文常报接近满分的准确率，但都在单一实验室条件数据集上训练与评测，跨区域域偏移下的真实表现不清楚。
Method: 提出 MLD 数据集，把来自美国、亚洲、非洲的 6 个公开作物病害数据集合并为共享层级分类体系（18 作物、56 类、含每作物一个健康类，167,427 张图像）；定义标准化的单源与池化多源评测协议显式检验跨区域泛化；并提出层级式 HiLeaD，让病害预测以预测出的作物为条件。
Result: HiLeaD 下 PlantVillage 训练模型域内 disease F1 99.07%，在 PlantDoc 上跌至 12.88%；MLD 池化训练把 PlantDoc 上的 disease F1 从 12.88% 提到 39.64%，提升 26.76 个百分点；层级式相对 flat 基线在 MLD 数据集上带来 1.71 至 4.88 个百分点的 disease F1 增益。
Conclusion: 跨区域域差距是当前主要瓶颈：进展更多受限于数据覆盖与多样性，而非模型设计；层级式作物到病害依赖能提供稳定但幅度有限的额外增益。

papers.title: One-Step Generation via Riemannian Wasserstein Gradient Flows
papers.abstract_en: Recently, Drifting Models and Wasserstein Gradient Flows have attracted substantial attention because they move iterative distributional refinement to training and amortize it into a generator, enabling fast inference. However, existing formulations have been developed largely for continuous Euclidean domains, such as image spaces, where particles admit unconstrained additive updates. On constrained spaces, these updates can leave the valid domain or ignore its geometry, making them unsuitable targets for training. Recent work has adapted updates to these spaces, but has focused on particular fields or offered limited empirical comparison. We derive and compare several geometry-aware fields within a common training framework for one-step generators. We test the method on data with different structures and obtain competitive one-step results in each setting. The best-performing field varies by task, showing why the choice of objective matters in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Wasserstein 梯度流与 Drifting Models 的一步生成器训练从连续欧氏域推广到约束空间：在同一训练框架下推导并比较多种考虑几何的梯度流场 (geometry-aware fields)，在不同结构的数据上都得到有竞争力的一步生成结果，且最优场随任务变化。
Motivation: 现有 Drifting Models 与 Wasserstein Gradient Flows 的表述基本面向图像这类连续欧氏域，粒子可无约束加性更新；在约束空间上这类更新会越出合法域或忽略几何，因而不能直接作为训练目标，而近期适配工作又局限于特定领域、缺乏统一实证比较。
Method: 在统一的一步生成器训练框架内推导并比较多种考虑几何的梯度流场，把迭代式分布细化移到训练阶段并摊销进生成器，从而实现快速推理；在具有不同结构的数据上测试该方法。
Result: 在不同结构的数据上均获得有竞争力的一步生成结果；表现最好的梯度流场随任务而变，说明目标函数的选择在实践中很关键。
Conclusion: 约束空间上应按任务选择几何感知的梯度流场作为一步生成的训练目标，不存在跨任务通用的最优场。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding Generative AI Use in Programming MOOCs: The Role of Course Context and Learner Characteristics
papers.abstract_en: The increasing availability of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools, such as ChatGPT and code-completion assistants, raises questions about how learners integrate these tools into learning activities, particularly in MOOCs that attract diverse participant populations. This study examines the use of GenAI in two programming MOOCs taught in Estonian that differ in duration, workload, topic complexity, and assignment volume: About Programming (4 weeks, 26 expected hours, n = 187) and Introduction to Programming (8 weeks, 78 expected hours, n = 182). Post-course questionnaire data were analyzed using non-parametric statistical methods to examine self-reported adoption, usage frequency, and purposes of GenAI use across courses and learner backgrounds. The results show that GenAI adoption was widespread in both MOOCs, with no statistically significant differences by gender, age, education level, or prior programming experience. However, participants in the longer, more extensive MOOC reported significantly higher usage frequency and were more likely to use GenAI for debugging and idea generation. Reported usage frequency for code explanation and debugging was also higher in the longer course. Exploratory analyses found limited relationships between GenAI use and learning-related outcomes. The findings suggest that course context may play a greater role than learner characteristics in shaping how GenAI tools are used. These results provide implications for instructional design and guidance in programming education.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 两门爱沙尼亚语编程 MOOC 的课后问卷显示，GenAI 采用率普遍很高，且在性别、年龄、教育程度和既往编程经验上都没有统计显著差异；而课时更长、作业量更大的那门课（8 周、78 小时）学员报告的使用频率显著更高，也更倾向用 GenAI 做调试和点子生成。作者据此主张：塑造 GenAI 使用方式的主要是课程情境，而非学习者个体特征。
Motivation: MOOC 学员背景高度多样，GenAI 工具如何被整合进学习活动尚不清楚；已有讨论多从学习者特征出发，而课程本身的时长、工作量、主题复杂度与作业量这些情境因素的作用缺少证据。
Method: 比较两门爱沙尼亚语编程 MOOC：About Programming（4 周、预期 26 小时、n=187）与 Introduction to Programming（8 周、预期 78 小时、n=182），收集课后问卷的自报采用率、使用频率与使用目的，用非参数统计方法按课程与学习者背景做差异检验，并做探索性分析考察 GenAI 使用与学习相关结果的关系。
Result: 两门课 GenAI 采用都很普遍，性别、年龄、教育程度、既往编程经验均无统计显著差异；更长更重的 MOOC 中使用频率显著更高，且更可能用于调试与点子生成，代码解释与调试的报告使用频率同样更高；探索性分析发现 GenAI 使用与学习相关结果的关系有限。
Conclusion: 课程情境对 GenAI 使用方式的作用大于学习者特征，编程教育的教学设计与使用指引应优先从课程结构（时长、工作量、作业量）入手。

papers.title: Causally Fair Generation with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate, complete, and transform information in settings where their outputs can shape consequential decisions, raising concerns about their impact on demographic disparities. In this context, causal inference provides a principled basis for assessing fairness, because it attributes observed disparities to the mechanisms that generated them, which a purely statistical approach cannot do even with infinite data. In LLM generation, a query may request several causally related variables, each of which is both an outcome of interest and a possible cause of other outputs, and the information supplied in the prompt need not follow a topological or a temporal order. This calls for methods that can analyze and selectively remove disparities from such a flexible generation process. In this paper we introduce Causally Fair Generation with LLMs (CFG, for short). CFG extracts relevant concepts, grounds generation in a reference population and causal diagram, and removes user-selected causal effects. CFG also allows pathways deemed justifiable for the task's utility to be retained, which is known in legal literature as business necessity. Further, we provide formal guarantees for our method when eliminating all discriminatory causal effects in the adapted population model, under appropriate causal assumptions. We evaluate CFG with four LLMs in three real-world settings based on population data and on a synthetic dataset with a known causal ground truth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CFG（Causally Fair Generation）：从 LLM 提示中抽取概念，用参考人群与因果图约束生成，再按用户选择移除因果效应，同时保留被判定为任务效用所必需的路径（business necessity）。在四个 LLM、三个基于人群数据的现实场景加一个带已知因果真值的合成数据集上评估，并给出在适当因果假设下消除全部歧视性因果效应的形式化保证。
Motivation: LLM 生成会参与影响人口群体差异的决策，纯统计公平性即使数据无限也无法把观测到的差异归因到产生它们的机制；而一次查询可能请求多个互为因果的变量，提示信息也不按拓扑或时间顺序给出，需要能分析并选择性移除差异的方法。
Method: CFG 三步：抽取相关概念、以参考人群和因果图 (causal diagram) 为生成基础、移除用户选定的因果效应；允许保留对任务效用合理（legal 语境中的 business necessity）的通路，并在适当因果假设下对适配后人群模型消除全部歧视性因果效应给出形式化保证。
Result: 在四个 LLM、三个基于人群数据的现实场景以及一个带已知因果真值的合成数据集上评估 CFG；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 因果框架可让 LLM 生成按用户选择选择性移除人口差异、同时保留效用必需通路，并在明确因果假设下获得消除全部歧视性因果效应的保证。

papers.title: LocusRL: Diagnosing LLM Reward and Policy Interventions in Competitive Games
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can intervene in reinforcement learning through both reward design and action selection, yet aggregate performance offers an incomplete account of what these interventions actually do. Similar returns can conceal different learning mechanisms, while plausible rewards can induce undesirable behavior. We introduce LocusRL, a diagnostic framework that connects controlled reward-policy comparisons with audits of reward judgments, signal delivery, optimization objectives, and executed actions. The framework traces performance differences to testable explanations and checks targeted corrections through executable rules and counterfactual replay. Across two evaluation batches covering ten Connect Four training seeds, we uncover seed-dependent reversals in intervention effects and show how tracing actual updates changes their interpretation: historical Qwen training operates through reward-weighted teacher-action likelihood. A separate matched three-seed reward-direction experiment distinguishes sensitivity to a learning signal from its usefulness. With terminal rewards held fixed, a sign-reversed dense oracle yields a 2.8% aggregate win rate, compared with 57.2% for terminal-only training and 46.7% for the positive dense oracle. Thus, a reward can strongly influence learning without improving performance. At the decision level, counterfactual replay verifies a winning correction to a diagnosed action error. Complementary experiments in Leduc and reward-validation studies in Goofspiel extend the analysis to imperfect-information settings, revealing how reference-label definitions and validation-data exposure affect intervention assessment. Together, these findings show why evaluating LLM interventions requires tracing how their outputs become learning signals and actions. LocusRL turns aggregate outcomes into actionable diagnoses and verifiable corrections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LocusRL 是一个诊断框架，把 LLM 在强化学习中的奖励设计与动作选择干预拆成奖励判断、信号传递、优化目标、执行动作四层审计，并用可执行规则与反事实回放 (counterfactual replay) 检验修正。在 Connect Four 十个训练种子上发现干预效果随种子反转，且历史 Qwen 训练实际通过奖励加权的 teacher-action likelihood 起作用；固定终端奖励时，符号取反的 dense oracle 聚合胜率仅 2.8%，低于 terminal-only 的 57.2% 与正向 dense oracle 的 46.7%，说明奖励能强烈影响学习却不改善性能。
Motivation: 聚合回报无法区分干预的真实作用机制：相似回报可能对应不同学习过程，看似合理的奖励可能诱导不良行为，导致对 LLM 干预的评估失真。
Method: 框架把受控的奖励-策略对比与四类审计（奖励判断、信号传递、优化目标、执行动作）相连，用可执行规则和反事实回放检验针对性修正；实验覆盖 Connect Four 十个训练种子的两批评估、三种子的奖励方向匹配实验，并扩展到 Leduc 不完全信息博弈与 Goofspiel 的奖励验证研究。
Result: 两批共十个 Connect Four 训练种子中出现随种子反转的干预效果，追踪实际更新显示历史 Qwen 训练经奖励加权的 teacher-action likelihood 起作用；固定终端奖励下，符号反转的 dense oracle 聚合胜率 2.8%，terminal-only 57.2%，正向 dense oracle 46.7%；反事实回放验证了一次针对已诊断动作错误的获胜修正。
Conclusion: 评估 LLM 干预必须追踪其输出如何变成学习信号与动作：奖励可以强烈改变学习而不提升性能，聚合结果应转化为可执行诊断与可验证修正。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RAGrasp: Geometry-Semantic Template Retrieval and Grasp Transfer
papers.abstract_en: We present RAGrasp, a retrieval-augmented pipeline for planar parallel-jaw grasping from a compact set of locally collected, grasp-annotated RGB-D (color and depth) templates. Unlike task-specific predictors trained primarily on large public or synthetic grasp datasets, RAGrasp requires no end-to-end retraining for a new deployment.Its template memory is constructed from observations collected with the deployment camera, robot, and gripper in the target workspace, thereby aligning stored examples with the local sensing and embodiment conditions. The system uses self-supervised DINOv2 visual fea- tures together with appearance and depth cues to prompt the Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2), which isolates the query object. A two-stage geometry-semantic retrieval cascade then selects a template, and a confidence gate chooses one of two grasp- transfer estimators. The transferred grasp is refined using mask- support and silhouette-contact constraints before calibrated 2D- to-3D conversion. In real-world trials, RAGrasp achieves 20/20 successful grasps on seen objects and 19/20 on unseen objects. Within the evaluated setting, the results demonstrate deployment- specific grasp adaptation from limited local annotation and tolerance to the tested viewpoint and illumination changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAGrasp 用部署现场采集的少量带抓取标注的 RGB-D 模板做检索式抓取，无需为新场景端到端重训：DINOv2 特征加外观与深度线索提示 SAM2 分割目标，两阶段几何-语义检索级联选模板，置信门在两个抓取迁移估计器间选择，再用 mask-support 与轮廓接触约束细化并做标定的 2D-3D 转换。真实实验中已见物体 20/20 成功、未见物体 19/20。
Motivation: 面向新部署场景的抓取通常要靠大规模公开或合成抓取数据集重训任务专用预测器，而现场相机、机器人与夹爪条件各异，通用模型难以直接对齐。
Method: 模板记忆由目标工作空间内用部署相机、机器人、夹爪采集的观测构成；自监督 DINOv2 视觉特征联合外观与深度线索提示 SAM2 分离查询物体，两阶段几何-语义检索级联 (geometry-semantic retrieval cascade) 选出模板，置信门在两个抓取迁移估计器中择一，迁移抓取经 mask-support 与 silhouette-contact 约束细化后做标定的 2D 到 3D 转换。
Result: 真实场景实验中，已见物体抓取成功 20/20，未见物体 19/20；在所评估设定下结果体现出从有限本地标注出发的部署特定抓取适应，以及对所测视角与光照变化的容忍。
Conclusion: 在评估设定内，用少量本地标注的模板检索加约束细化即可实现面向具体部署的抓取适应，无需端到端重训。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CRAFT: An Agentic Spreadsheet Form Filling System with Template Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Spreadsheet form filling requires agents to consolidate external evidence, ground values to precise cells, and preserve irregular template structure. Errors in early edits can overwrite labels or misalign fields, undermining later decisions. We propose CRAFT, a template-aware agent framework that connects reflective validation to constrained local repair. Instead of treating reflection as a free-form request to regenerate the workbook, CRAFT grounds detected errors to spreadsheet regions, restores corrupted template state when necessary, and re-grounds plausible writable slots before subsequent edits. A Rectangle-Aware Slot Grounder (RASG) proposes writable cells, while label-slot hints and protected regions constrain subsequent edits. We introduce FormFillBench, with 327 forms across Instruction-Only and Multi-File tracks. Compared with the strongest baselines, CRAFT improves pair accuracy by 8.51 and 23.38 percentage points on these tracks, respectively. Component-removal experiments support structural adjudication and slot re-grounding within the pipeline, and the framework retains its relative advantage among the methods evaluated with a second backbone. The code and benchmark FormFillBench are available at https://github.com/Glllllly/CRAFT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRAFT 是模板感知的表格表单填写 agent 框架：把反思校验落到具体表格区域，必要时先恢复被破坏的模板状态，再用 Rectangle-Aware Slot Grouper (RASG) 重新定位可写单元格，并以 label-slot 提示与保护区约束后续编辑。在 FormFillBench 的 327 个表单上，相比最强基线 pair accuracy 在 Instruction-Only 与 Multi-File 两条 track 上分别提升 8.51 和 23.38 个百分点。
Motivation: 表单填写要求 agent 整合外部证据、把值精确落到单元格并保持不规则模板结构；早期编辑出错会覆盖标签或错位字段，进而破坏后续所有决策，而自由形式的反思重生成难以修复这类结构性损坏。
Method: 模板感知框架把反思校验与受约束的局部修复绑定：检测到的错误被定位到表格区域，必要时恢复损坏的模板状态，再对可信的可写槽位重新 grounding；RASG 提出可写单元格，label-slot 提示与保护区共同限制编辑范围。评测用新基准 FormFillBench，含 Instruction-Only 与 Multi-File 两条 track，并做组件消融与第二 backbone 复测。
Result: FormFillBench 含 327 个表单；相对最强基线，CRAFT 的 pair accuracy 在 Instruction-Only track 提升 8.51 个百分点、在 Multi-File track 提升 23.38 个百分点。组件消融支持结构判定与槽位重定位在流水线中的作用，且换用第二个 backbone 后相对优势仍在所评估方法中保持。
Conclusion: 把反思约束到区域级修复并配合槽位重定位，比自由重生成更能保住模板结构，因此在多文件证据整合的表单填写上收益更大（23.38 对 8.51 个百分点）。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 模板感知框架把反思校验与受约束的局部修复绑定：检测到的错误被定位到表格区域，必要时恢复损坏的模板状态，再对可信的可写槽位重新 grounding；RASG 提出可写单元格，label-slot 提示与保护区共同限制编辑范围。评测用新基准 FormFillBench，含 Instruction-Only 与 Multi-File 两条 track，并做组件消融与第二 backbone 复测。
summary_sections.result: FormFillBench 含 327 个表单；相对最强基线，CRAFT 的 pair accuracy 在 Instruction-Only track 提升 8.51 个百分点、在 Multi-File track 提升 23.38 个百分点。组件消融支持结构判定与槽位重定位在流水线中的作用，且换用第二个 backbone 后相对优势仍在所评估方法中保持。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把反思约束到区域级修复并配合槽位重定位，比自由重生成更能保住模板结构，因此在多文件证据整合的表单填写上收益更大（23.38 对 8.51 个百分点）。

papers.title: Guess My Weight: Profiled Side-Channel Recovery of Floating-Point Neural-Network Weights
papers.abstract_en: Neural-network parameters deployed on embedded devices may be exposed through physical side-channel leakage during inference. Existing side-channel attacks on floating-point neural-network parameters have often targeted reduced numerical precision, while recovering the complete IEEE-754 representation remains considerably more challenging because of the large and structured 32-bit candidate space. We present a profiled template attack for bit-exact recovery of an IEEE-754 single-precision neural-network weight from power measurements. The attack targets the floating-point multiplication between a known input and a first-layer weight. During profiling, multivariate Gaussian templates are learned from randomized network configurations using Hamming-weight classes of the multiplication result, while the remaining network parameters act as nuisance variables. To efficiently search the structured 32-bit floating-point candidate space, we use a hierarchical coarse-to-fine-to-exact procedure that progressively increases both the numerical and leakage-model resolution. Experiments on a ChipWhisperer-Lite with an Arm Cortex-M4 demonstrate recovery of the exact float32 representation of the target weight. In the evaluated setting, the attack reaches a bit-exact success rate of 99% with 171 traces and 100% from 263 traces onward. These results demonstrate that profiling can enable practical full-precision extraction of floating-point neural-network parameters from physical leakage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对嵌入式设备上浮点神经网络权重的侧信道恢复，提出基于剖面模板攻击 (profiled template attack) 的方法，从功耗测量中逐比特精确恢复 IEEE-754 单精度权重。在 ChipWhisperer-Lite 与 Arm Cortex-M4 上，171 条轨迹达到 99% 比特精确恢复率，263 条轨迹起达到 100%。
Motivation: 现有针对浮点神经网络参数的侧信道攻击多限于降低数值精度，而完整恢复 IEEE-754 表示因 32 位候选空间大且结构化而困难得多。
Method: 攻击目标是已知输入与第一层权重的浮点乘法；剖面阶段用乘法结果的 Hamming-weight 类学习多元高斯模板 (multivariate Gaussian templates)，其余网络参数作为干扰变量；用由粗到细再到精确的分层搜索 (hierarchical coarse-to-fine-to-exact) 逐步提高数值与泄漏模型分辨率，以搜索结构化的 32 位浮点候选空间。
Result: 在 ChipWhisperer-Lite 与 Arm Cortex-M4 实验中，成功恢复目标权重的精确 float32 表示：171 条轨迹时比特精确成功率 99%，263 条轨迹起达到 100%。
Conclusion: 剖面分析可实现从物理泄漏中实用地提取浮点神经网络参数的完整精度。

papers.title: What Does a Harness Buy? Tokens, Mostly
papers.abstract_en: A coding agent is a language model wrapped in a harness: the system prompt, the tool set, and the context management that turn a chat model into something that can work inside a repository. Production harnesses ship releases daily, vendors advertise pass-rate gains from harness changes, and leaderboards mix harnesses freely. What is rarely measured is how much the harness itself moves the score when the model is held fixed. We run five models through three production harnesses, Claude Code, mini-SWE-agent, and OpenCode, on SWE-bench Verified, and rerun the same configurations to calibrate how much a score moves when nothing changes but the run. On 447 tasks and the two models we ran there, Claude Code and mini-SWE-agent, the heaviest and the lightest harness, are equivalent within five points. On a 45-task hard subset and five models, swapping the harness flips as many tasks as rerunning the same harness, 13% in both cases, and the tasks a harness wins in one run are not the tasks it wins in the next. The one harness effect that clears the noise is a loss, not a gain: OpenCode trails by up to 9 points on the large pool, and on one model half of that gap sits in runs its output cap cut short. What the harness does decide is the bill. With the same model, the same tasks, and one price list, cost per task differs by up to 3x across harnesses. The gap is set at the first call, by the preamble of system prompt and tool schemas each harness sends with every step, and scaled by the number of steps; per-step growth and per-call tool output differ far less. The provider's price for cached input scales the bill and does not reorder it. The rerun data also give the resolution a harness comparison needs: at the discordance we observe, 45 tasks catch a 13-point gap only half the time and no gap with 80% power, and 447 tasks resolve 5 points, still coarser than the gains many harness changes claim.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 固定模型只换 harness（system prompt、工具集、上下文管理）时，SWE-bench Verified 上的分数基本不动：447 任务上最重的 Claude Code 与最轻的 mini-SWE-agent 差距在 5 分以内等价，45 任务硬子集上换 harness 与重跑同一 harness 的任务翻转率同为 13%。唯一越过噪声的 harness 效应是负向的——OpenCode 在大池上落后最多 9 分，其中一半来自输出上限截断的运行。真正被 harness 决定的是账单：同模型同任务同价目表下每任务成本最多差 3 倍，差距来自每步都发送的 system prompt 与 tool schema 前导并随步数放大。
Motivation: 生产 harness 每天发版、厂商宣传 harness 改动带来的 pass-rate 提升、榜单混用 harness，但很少有人在固定模型的条件下测量 harness 本身能移动多少分数，以及一次比较需要多大样本才有统计功效。
Method: 让 5 个模型跑 3 个生产 harness（Claude Code、mini-SWE-agent、OpenCode），在 SWE-bench Verified 的 447 任务池与 45 任务硬子集上评测，并原样重跑相同配置以标定“什么都不变只重跑”时分数的自然抖动；同时按同一价目表统计每任务成本并拆解成本来源。
Result: 447 任务、跑了该池的两个模型上，Claude Code 与 mini-SWE-agent 差距在 5 分以内视为等价；45 任务硬子集、5 个模型上，换 harness 与重跑同一 harness 各翻转 13% 的任务，且一次赢的任务与下一次赢的任务不重合。OpenCode 在大池上落后最多 9 分，其中一个模型上一半差距来自输出上限截断的运行。同模型同任务下每任务成本最多差 3 倍，差距由每步的 system prompt 与 tool schema 前导设定并被步数放大，per-step 增长与每次调用的工具输出差异小得多，缓存输入价格只放大账单不改变排序。重跑数据给出的分辨率是：在观测到的不一致度下，45 任务只有一半概率检出 13 分差距、以 80% 功率检不出任何差距，447 任务能分辨 5 分。
Conclusion: 在固定模型下，harness 对 SWE-bench 分数的贡献大多落在重跑噪声以内，harness 改动宣称的收益需要比 447 任务更细的分辨率才能与噪声区分；harness 真正稳定决定的是成本，且成本差距在第一次调用就由前导 prompt 与 schema 写定。

papers.title: Video2World: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Interactive World Modeling from Embodied Videos
papers.abstract_en: Building interactive simulators from real-world observations is a promising way to scale embodied data, but current pipelines still rely heavily on manual environment construction and calibration. We study whether frontier foundation models and coding agents can automate this process end to end. We formulate \emph{autonomous video-to-simulation} as a software engineering task in which an agent observes an embodied video, constructs the corresponding simulated environment and robot behavior, and iteratively refines the result through execution feedback. To evaluate this capability, we introduce \textbf{Video2World}, a benchmark comprising 222 reconstruction instances derived from 189 robot and human demonstration videos. Video2World measures reconstructed worlds along geometric fidelity, dynamic fidelity, and functional correctness, capturing spatial perception, physical reasoning, and executable interaction. Evaluating 9 frontier coding-agent systems reveals a sharp improvement in Task success beginning with Claude Opus 5, rising from below 5\% to over 15\%, while substantial gaps to human-assisted reconstruction remain. We further find that worlds that look better could work worse: better visual fidelity does not always lead to higher task success. This echoes the broader gap between perceptual realism and factual correctness observed in generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Video2World 把「从具身视频自动重建可交互仿真器」形式化为软件工程任务，让 coding agent 观看机器人/人类演示视频后自动搭建环境与机器人行为，并依据执行反馈迭代修正。基准含 222 个重建实例（源自 189 段演示视频），评测 9 个前沿 coding-agent 系统：任务成功率从 Claude Opus 5 起由不足 5% 升至超过 15%，但视觉保真度更高并不必然带来更高任务成功率。
Motivation: 从真实观测构建交互式仿真器仍高度依赖手工环境搭建与标定，制约了用仿真规模化扩充具身数据的路径；需要一个能衡量端到端自动重建能力的评测基准。
Method: 将 autonomous video-to-simulation 表述为软件工程任务：agent 观察具身视频，构建对应仿真环境与机器人行为，再通过执行反馈迭代精修。提出 Video2World 基准，沿几何保真 (geometric fidelity)、动态保真 (dynamic fidelity)、功能正确性 (functional correctness) 三个维度度量重建世界，覆盖空间感知、物理推理与可执行交互。
Result: 基准含 222 个重建实例，来自 189 段机器人与人类演示视频；评测 9 个前沿 coding-agent 系统，任务成功率自 Claude Opus 5 起从低于 5% 升至超过 15%，与人类辅助重建仍有明显差距；视觉保真度提升不总带来任务成功率提升。
Conclusion: 前沿 coding agent 已能端到端自动化视频到仿真的重建但成功率仍远低于人类辅助；感知层面的真实感与功能层面的正确性并不对齐，评测必须同时看任务成功率而非只看画面质量。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: MERCI Cards: An LLM Evaluation and Deployment Framework for High-Stakes Domains
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs are increasingly deployed in high-stakes professional workflows, engineers and researchers require principled protocols to systematically track, monitor, and improve model performance across deployment cycles. We present a mathematical framework for iterative LLM evaluation and deployment, and demonstrate its application to AI systems used in criminal justice. Our framework formalizes LLM integration in high-stakes, high-risk, and resource-constrained domains across model selection, rubric design, evaluations and deployment via a weighted multi-objective optimization. We demonstrate that MERCI Cards can guide improvements of the system across deployment iterations, direct developer attention toward under-performing areas, and focus user attention on validation and error-correction in the LLM's outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MERCI Cards 提出一个面向高风险、资源受限场景的 LLM 迭代评估与部署数学框架，把模型选择、评分标准 (rubric) 设计、评估与部署统一成加权多目标优化，并在刑事司法 AI 系统上演示其应用。框架可引导系统在多轮部署迭代中改进，把开发者的注意力导向表现不佳的环节，并把用户注意力集中在对 LLM 输出的验证与纠错上。
Motivation: LLM 被嵌入高风险专业工作流后，工程与研究人员缺少有原则的协议来跨部署周期系统性地追踪、监控和改进模型表现。
Method: 给出迭代 LLM 评估与部署的数学框架，以加权多目标优化形式化模型选择、rubric 设计、评估与部署四个环节，并在刑事司法领域的 AI 系统上做应用演示。
Result: 演示显示 MERCI Cards 能引导系统跨部署迭代改进，把开发者注意力指向表现不佳的区域，并使用户聚焦于 LLM 输出的验证与纠错；摘要未给出数值指标。
Conclusion: 高风险 LLM 部署可按加权多目标优化的迭代评估协议来管理，让改进方向、开发关注点与人工纠错环节都被显式引导。

papers.title: Asking Earns Nothing: Scoring the Decision to Act in BFCL Multi-Turn
papers.abstract_en: An agent that lacks the information it needs should ask rather than act, and the task definitions of agent leaderboards say so. BFCL multi-turn builds two of its four categories around a turn on which the model is supposed to ask, and its scorer never looks at that turn: the gold trajectory there is empty, the checker skips it, and the scripted user cannot answer, so asking earns nothing, guessing costs nothing on that turn, and asking twice loses the item. The benchmark also contains the control experiment for that decision. A should-ask item is a base item with one piece of information removed from one turn, so the same request appears twice at the same turn index, once complete and once not: on the first the model should make the call that changes the world, on the second it should ask. We score one decision per pair, whether the model attempted a world-changing call on that turn, read off the stored trajectories with no LLM judge; acting always and asking always both score 50. On the 223 pairs that pose this decision, gpt-5.4 attempts the call on 83.4% of the complete turns and holds back on 78.0% of the incomplete ones, the best decision accuracy of seven models at 80.7%; on the same items the official score ranks it sixth and puts first a model that lands in the middle here. One added line telling gpt-5.4 not to ask pushes it toward acting on both sides of the pair, so its decision accuracy shows no detectable change, while its official score rises by 13.5 to 23.5 points on the two should-ask categories and on the base twins; the opposite line, telling gemma-4-31B-it to ask first, improves its decision by 4.5 points and gains no official score. The score moves with the push toward action, not with the decision. We release the pairs, a turn-level scorer that runs on any BFCL output directory without an API key, and 31 manually verified bad items.

papers.title: COSMOS: Soft Mechanism Mixtures with Verifiable Routing for Long-Horizon PDE Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators offer an efficient alternative to classical PDE solvers, but most learn a monolithic map per equation family and discretization. Real systems are compositional: transport, diffusion, wave, and reaction processes can act simultaneously. Existing mixture-of-experts operators typically use sparse top-$K$ routing, although concurrent physics is naturally a blend rather than a discrete choice. We propose COSMOS (Cooperative Operator Specialists with Mechanism-level Operator Soft-routing), a soft mechanism-mixture neural operator. Four process-biased specialists remain active at every step and are continuously mixed by a learned gate, with their features fused by a small network. Specialists share a coarse latent grid, while a zero-initialized full-resolution residual restores detail lost through the bottleneck. We also introduce an operator-splitting compositional benchmark with known mixture weights $w^\star$ per trajectory. Against family-tuned FNO under 20-step rollouts, an initial 3-seed evaluation suggested gains on diffusion--reaction, parity on Navier--Stokes, and weaker shallow-water performance. An 11-seed audit showed that the diffusion--reaction gain was unstable, motivating caution in small-seed rollout comparisons and precluding a reliable accuracy-win claim on these families. Ablations show that uniform routing or removing the specialist mixture substantially degrades stable-regime rollouts. On the labeled benchmark, dense soft routing yields $2.2\times$ lower error than hard top-1 routing at identical fusion; using generator weights $w^\star$ at inference further lowers rollout error to $0.034$, diagnosing limitations of the learned gate. However, routing labels do not align with the specialists' intended mechanisms: COSMOS supports compositional accuracy, not mechanism identity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COSMOS 用四个过程偏置专家加学习门控的软机制混合神经算子做长时程 PDE 预报，连续混合而非 top-K 离散选择。在带已知混合权重 w* 的算子分裂组合基准上，稠密软路由误差比 hard top-1 低 2.2 倍，推理时直接用生成器权重 w* 可把滚动误差降到 0.034；但 11-seed 审计推翻了 3-seed 时 diffusion–reaction 的增益，作者据此不对这些方程族主张精度胜出。
Motivation: 现有神经算子多为每个方程族与离散化学一个整体映射，而真实系统里输运、扩散、波动、反应过程同时作用；MoE 类算子的稀疏 top-K 路由把连续物理当成离散选择，且小 seed 数的滚动对比容易给出不稳的结论。
Method: 四个过程偏置 specialist 每步全部保持激活，由学习到的 gate 连续混合，特征再经一个小网络融合；specialist 共享粗潜网格，零初始化的全分辨率残差补回瓶颈丢失的细节。评测用自建的 operator-splitting 组合基准，每条轨迹带已知混合权重 w*，对照 family-tuned FNO 做 20 步滚动，先 3-seed 再做 11-seed 审计，并做路由消融。
Result: 在带标签基准上，稠密软路由在相同融合下误差比 hard top-1 低 2.2 倍；推理时改用生成器权重 w* 进一步把滚动误差降到 0.034。消融显示均匀路由或去掉 specialist 混合会显著劣化稳定区滚动。3-seed 初评提示 diffusion–reaction 有增益、Navier–Stokes 持平、shallow-water 偏弱，而 11-seed 审计表明 diffusion–reaction 增益不稳定。
Conclusion: 软机制混合支持组合精度 (compositional accuracy)，但路由标签与 specialist 的预设机制并不对齐，不能主张机制身份；小 seed 数的滚动对比不足以支撑精度胜出的结论，学习到的门控本身也还有差距。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: UnAct: Gradient-Free Unlearning via Targeted Activation Intervention
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning seeks to remove the influence of designated training data from a trained model without retraining from scratch. Retrain-free methods such as Selective Synaptic Dampening (SSD) and its label-free variant LFSSD avoid full retraining but still require backpropagation and parameter importance computed over the entire dataset. We ask: what happens when a deletion request arrives with only a few images of the class to be forgotten? To answer this question, we introduce UnAct, a gradient-free class-unlearning method that needs only forward passes over the forget images. UnAct scores late-layer units by their responses, attenuates the most responsive connections, and repeats this for up to 20 rounds using no gradients, no labels, and no retained data. On ResNet-18 trained with CIFAR-10, CIFAR-20, and CIFAR-100, UnAct is competitive with SSD and LFSSD when forgetting entire classes and, unlike them, never collapses the network when forget data is scarce. On ResNet-18, across all tested sizes, UnAct's retain accuracy stays within 2.5 points of retraining, while SSD and LFSSD, at their full-class operating points, lose up to 86 points on some classes. With five forget images on CIFAR-10, UnAct's distance to retraining is 0.21 points, against 67 for LFSSD and 90 for SSD, and re-selecting SSD's threshold at each size with an oracle does not close the gap. In preliminary transfer to ViT-B/16, UnAct's distance to retraining is 11.5 against 33.7 for SSD, and a request is 19x faster than SSD when SSD computes its importance at request time. The code is available at https://github.com/abdulmuizz0903/UnAct
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UnAct 是一种无梯度的类遗忘方法：只对待遗忘图像做前向传播，按后层单元响应给连接打分并衰减最强响应，最多迭代 20 轮，不需要梯度、标签或保留数据。在 ResNet-18 + CIFAR-10/20/100 上，遗忘数据稀缺时 SSD 与 LFSSD 会令网络崩溃，而 UnAct 的保留精度在所有测试规模下都与重训练相差不超过 2.5 个点；CIFAR-10 只给 5 张遗忘图时，UnAct 与重训练的距离为 0.21 点，LFSSD 为 67 点、SSD 为 90 点。
Motivation: 删除请求往往只带少量待遗忘类图像，而 SSD、LFSSD 这类免重训方法仍需反向传播，并在全数据集上计算参数重要性，在遗忘数据稀缺时会崩溃。
Method: UnAct 只对遗忘图像做前向传播，按后层单元响应为连接打分，衰减响应最强的连接，最多重复 20 轮；全程无梯度、无标签、无需保留数据。测试对象为 ResNet-18（CIFAR-10/20/100）与 ViT-B/16 的初步迁移。
Result: ResNet-18 上各测试规模下 UnAct 的保留精度与重训练相差不超过 2.5 个点，而 SSD 与 LFSSD 在其全类操作点上某些类损失高达 86 个点。CIFAR-10 用 5 张遗忘图时，UnAct 与重训练的距离为 0.21 点，LFSSD 为 67 点、SSD 为 90 点，用 oracle 逐规模重选 SSD 阈值也补不上差距。ViT-B/16 初步迁移中 UnAct 距离为 11.5，SSD 为 33.7；当 SSD 在请求时计算重要性，单次请求快 19 倍。
Conclusion: 只用遗忘图像的前向响应做定向激活干预，就能在遗忘数据稀缺时保持接近重训练的保留精度，且不出现 SSD/LFSSD 那种网络崩溃。
