papers.title: AgroGround: Multi-Granularity Grounded Recognition in Agriculture
papers.abstract_en: Agricultural visual models are typically evaluated for either recognition or localization, but reliable diagnosis requires identifying what is present and localizing the evidence. Agricultural visual question answering (VQA) datasets carry rich semantic labels but rarely link them to image regions, and adding such annotations by hand is costly at scale. We introduce AgroGround, a large-scale dataset for grounded agricultural recognition: identifying plant diseases and other agricultural targets and localizing their image regions. An automated pipeline converts the labels of eight agricultural VQA datasets into annotations for disease lesions and whole objects, producing 794,850 instruction examples. Healthy images provide negative supervision for disease queries, teaching the model to return empty predictions. We fine-tune a shared vision-language model on known-target grounding instructions combined with instructions requiring both recognition and localization. We evaluate predicted identities, regions, joint correctness, and healthy-image abstention on 1,480 human-verified images disjoint from all training data. Grounding-only fine-tuning reduces recognition accuracy from 51.8\% to 29.1\%, while adding recognition-and-localization instructions raises it to 72.6\%. With images and annotations held fixed, combining the two formats raises joint accuracy from 19.2\% to 43.3\% at comparable grounding. Healthy negatives raise abstention on healthy images to 95.0\%, and reinforcement learning improves lesion-level grounding. The resulting 2B model exceeds its annotation teacher in grounding F1 on our benchmark and on the external PlantSeg test set. AgroGround establishes a benchmark for grounded agricultural recognition, measuring joint correctness of identity and localization along with abstention on healthy images. The code is available at https://github.com/AB-Abdulla/AgroGround.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgroGround 把八个农业 VQA 数据集的标签自动转成病斑与整目标的定位标注，得到 794,850 条指令样本，用于训练同时做识别与定位的 2B 视觉语言模型。只做 grounding 微调会把识别准确率从 51.8% 压到 29.1%，加入识别+定位混合指令后升到 72.6%，联合正确率从 19.2% 提到 43.3%；健康图负样本使拒答率达 95.0%。
Motivation: 农业视觉模型通常只评识别或只评定位，而可靠诊断需要同时给出是什么和证据在哪；农业 VQA 数据集语义标签丰富却很少与图像区域对应，人工补这类标注规模上代价过高。
Method: 自动流水线把八个农业 VQA 数据集标签转成病斑级与整目标级定位标注，健康图像作为疾病查询的负监督（要求输出空预测）；在共享视觉语言模型上混合已知目标 grounding 指令与识别+定位指令做微调，并用强化学习改进病斑级 grounding，最终得到 2B 模型。
Result: 共 794,850 条指令样本；在 1,480 张与全部训练数据不相交的人工核验图像上评测：仅 grounding 微调使识别准确率 51.8% → 29.1%，加入识别+定位指令后升至 72.6%；图像与标注固定时两种格式合用使联合正确率 19.2% → 43.3%，grounding 相当；健康负样本使健康图拒答率到 95.0%；2B 模型在本基准与外部 PlantSeg test 上的 grounding F1 超过其标注教师模型。
Conclusion: 识别与定位必须联合训练：只做 grounding 会严重损害识别，混合两种指令格式才能同时抬高识别、联合正确率与健康图拒答，且小模型可超过生成标注的教师。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 共 794,850 条指令样本；在 1,480 张与全部训练数据不相交的人工核验图像上评测：仅 grounding 微调使识别准确率 51.8% → 29.1%，加入识别+定位指令后升至 72.6%；图像与标注固定时两种格式合用使联合正确率 19.2% → 43.3%，grounding 相当；健康负样本使健康图拒答率到 95.0%；2B 模型在本基准与外部 PlantSeg test 上的 grounding F1 超过其标注教师模型。

papers.title: On the Trade-off Between Information Loss and Generalization in Sparse Attention
papers.abstract_en: To mitigate the quadratic complexity bottleneck of the Transformer, sparse attention has emerged as a pivotal technology. Despite the extensive empirical success of sparse Transformers, the theoretical understanding of sparse attention remains fragmented. In particular, two fundamental questions remain unclear: (1) How does sparsification affect the information fidelity of attention mechanisms? (2) How does this information loss interact with the generalization behavior of the model? To bridge this gap, this paper proposes a systematic analysis of the Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence and of the generalization gap of sparse attention mechanisms. Specifically, we first characterize the approximation error via the JS divergence. Through an order-statistics-based concentration analysis of the truncation mass alpha --- where the attention scores are assumed to be independent and identically distributed sub-Gaussian random variables with parameter sigma --- the JS divergence between the full attention distribution and the sparse attention distribution is shown to admit the closed form log 2 + ((1 - alpha)/2) log(1 - alpha) - ((2 - alpha)/2) log(2 - alpha). Subsequently, we derive a generalization bound through Rademacher complexity, quantified by O(gamma * sqrt(M/n) * (sqrt(log(3eL/M)) + sqrt(pi)/2)). Furthermore, building on a mutual-information-based generalization bound together with an entropy and covering-number analysis of the sparse hypothesis class, we obtain the sparsity-dependent generalization bound O(sqrt((M/(2n)) * (log(eL/M) + log(1 + 2/epsilon)))). Our analysis shows that sparsity reduces the complexity of the considered hypothesis class while introducing approximation error that can be quantified by the JS divergence. These findings provide a theoretical characterization of the trade-off between information fidelity and generalization in sparse Transformer architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对稀疏注意力给出闭式理论刻画：在注意力分数为 i.i.d. 参数 σ 的 sub-Gaussian 假设下，截断质量 α 对应的 JS 散度等于 log 2 + ((1-α)/2)log(1-α) - ((2-α)/2)log(2-α)，同时用 Rademacher 复杂度与基于互信息的界给出随稀疏度 M 变化的泛化界。结论是稀疏化降低假设类复杂度、但引入可由 JS 散度量化的近似误差，二者构成显式权衡。
Motivation: 稀疏 Transformer 经验上成功但理论理解碎片化，稀疏化如何损害注意力的信息保真度、以及该信息损失如何与泛化相互作用，两个基本问题此前不清楚。
Method: 先用基于顺序统计量的集中性分析处理截断质量 α（注意力分数假设为参数 σ 的 i.i.d. sub-Gaussian 随机变量），推导全注意力分布与稀疏注意力分布之间的 JS 散度闭式解；再经 Rademacher 复杂度导出泛化界，并结合基于互信息的泛化界与对稀疏假设类的熵、覆盖数分析得到稀疏度相关泛化界。
Result: JS 散度闭式为 log 2 + ((1-α)/2)log(1-α) - ((2-α)/2)log(2-α)；Rademacher 泛化界为 O(γ·sqrt(M/n)·(sqrt(log(3eL/M)) + sqrt(π)/2))；互信息与覆盖数路线给出 O(sqrt((M/(2n))·(log(eL/M) + log(1+2/ε))))。
Conclusion: 稀疏度降低所考虑假设类的复杂度，同时引入可用 JS 散度量化的近似误差，从而为稀疏 Transformer 架构的信息保真度与泛化之间的权衡提供理论刻画。

papers.title: Measuring Effective Data Resolution in Guided Diffusion Posteriors
papers.abstract_en: Guided diffusion samplers are increasingly used to reconstruct physical fields from sparse observations, but standard diagnostics do not say how much of the reconstruction was actually determined by the data. We introduce effective data resolution for black-box generative posteriors: a comparison between the resolution warranted by the inverse problem, $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{ref}}$, and the resolution realised by the sampler, $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{samp}}$. A perturbation estimator measures $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{samp}}$ and the spatial map $R(x,x)$ from sampler queries alone. We validate the estimator against exact references and use it to study guided diffusion. The resulting measurements show that guidance weight can strongly alter apparent information transfer, that mean, spread and resolution are not jointly corrected by one weight even with an exact prior and score, and that resolution fidelity does not follow reliably from the apparent principledness of a guidance rule.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为 guided diffusion 后验提出 effective data resolution 度量：比较逆问题所要求的分辨率 dof_ref 与采样器实际实现的分辨率 dof_samp，仅用采样器查询即可测出 dof_samp 与空间图 R(x,x)。测量显示 guidance weight 会强烈改变表面的信息传递，且即便先验与 score 精确，单一权重也无法同时校正均值、离散度与分辨率，分辨率保真度也不随 guidance 规则的“原则性”可靠跟随。
Motivation: guided diffusion 从稀疏观测重建物理场已成常用手段，但标准诊断无法说明重建中有多少真正由数据决定，因而无法判断后验是否达到了逆问题所要求的分辨率。
Method: 定义 dof_ref 与 dof_samp 之比作为 black-box 生成式后验的 effective data resolution；提出 perturbation estimator，仅通过 sampler queries 测量 dof_samp 与空间图 R(x,x)，并对照 exact reference 验证估计器，再用它研究 guided diffusion 的 guidance weight。
Result: 估计器在与 exact reference 的对照验证中成立；对 guided diffusion 的测量给出三条定性结论：guidance weight 可强烈改变表面信息传递；即便有 exact prior 与 exact score，单一 weight 也不能同时校正均值、离散度与分辨率；guidance 规则表面上的原则性并不能可靠预测分辨率保真度。
Conclusion: 评估 guided diffusion 重建应直接测量 effective data resolution，而不能靠 guidance 规则的形式合理性或单一 guidance weight 来推断数据对重建的实际约束程度。

papers.title: MaDeL: Manifold-Decomposed Feature Losses for Generative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Generative models are often trained with isotropic objectives such as mean-squared error. For data concentrated near a low-dimensional manifold, however, such losses conflate displacement along the manifold, which may represent valid variation, with displacement away from it, which produces invalid samples. This mismatch is especially problematic in sparse, highly constrained domains, where ambient-space regression can encourage off-manifold interpolation. We ask whether a generative objective can distinguish manifold-parallel variation from manifold-orthogonal deviation directly from data, without explicitly estimating the manifold. We introduce a manifold-decomposed feature loss (MaDeL) that learns complementary representations from corrupted observations: one is trained to recover the clean sample, while the other is trained to recover the corruption. We show that, under a feature bottleneck, their Jacobians align with the tangent and normal spaces, exactly for linear manifolds and locally for smooth manifolds. Together, these representations define an anisotropic objective that separately measures intrinsic variation and off-manifold deviation. Across synthetic, Earth and climate science, and torsion-angle benchmarks, MaDeL improves support recovery and average angular $W_1$ under single-step sampling; on protein backbones, it reduces steric clashes across one- and few-step sampling budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MaDeL 用两个从含噪观测学出的互补特征表示（一个恢复干净样本、一个恢复噪声）构造各向异性生成损失，在特征瓶颈下其 Jacobian 分别对齐流形切空间与法空间，从而把沿流形的变化与离开流形的偏差分开度量，而无需显式估计流形。在合成、地球与气候科学以及蛋白骨架 (torsion-angle) 基准上，单步采样时改善支撑恢复与平均角 W1，蛋白骨架上在一至几步采样预算内减少空间位阻冲突 (steric clashes)。
Motivation: MSE 这类各向同性损失把沿低维流形的合法变化与离开流形的非法偏移混为一谈；在稀疏、强约束域中，环境空间回归会鼓励流形外插值，产生无效样本。
Method: MaDeL 从被破坏的观测 (corrupted observations) 学两个互补表示：一个训练去恢复干净样本，另一个训练去恢复破坏本身；在特征瓶颈下证明二者 Jacobian 分别对齐切空间（线性流形上精确、光滑流形上局部）与法空间，合成为分别度量本征变化与流形外偏差的各向异性目标。
Result: 在合成、Earth and climate science、torsion-angle 三类基准上，MaDeL 在单步采样下改善 support recovery 与 average angular W1；在 protein backbones 上，一至几步采样预算下减少 steric clashes。
Conclusion: 无需显式估计流形，仅靠从数据学出的切向/法向特征表示即可构造能区分流形内外位移的生成目标，并在稀疏强约束域改善样本有效性。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: CORE-RL: Confidence-Oriented Reliability Evaluation of Black-Box Reinforcement Learning Policies
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents in critical domains must be preceded with a pipeline to evaluate the alignment of the RL agent with complex multi-objective specifications and robustness under real-world environmental drift. However, to protect intellectual property, the RL agent may be delivered for evaluation as opaque executable or remote API, which makes traditional evaluation techniques based on the internals of the policies infeasible. To address this gap, CORE-RL: Confidence-Oriented Reliability Evaluation of black box RL policy is proposed in this paper. The CORE-RL pipeline introduces a Unified Reliability Metric that formally integrates early task termination and safety constraint violations, preventing unsafe policies from masking failures through premature episode halts. By subjecting the policy to a noise certification envelope of perceptual noise, actuation noise and change in environment dynamics, the pipeline computes the finite-sample Clopper-Pearson bounds on unified reliability metric and Hoeffdings' lower bound on reward and safety cost. The pipeline then defines safe operational design domain to report high-confidence certificates for safety and expected performance. Experiments on continuous control tasks demonstrate the CORE-RL pipeline's ability to automatically reject non-compliant policies and map the safe Operational Design Domain (ODD) of safety-aware policies. Thus CORE-RL provides an evaluation framework towards a quantitative, transparent and reproducible, statistical rationale necessary to safely evaluate, compare, and deploy black box RL solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CORE-RL 面向以不透明可执行文件或远程 API 交付的黑盒 RL 策略，提出统一可靠性指标（Unified Reliability Metric），把提前终止任务与安全约束违反合并计分，防止不安全策略靠提前结束回合掩盖失败。在感知噪声、执行噪声与环境动力学变化构成的噪声认证包络 (noise certification envelope) 上计算有限样本 Clopper-Pearson 界与 Hoeffding 下界，据此划定安全运行设计域 (safe ODD) 并自动拒绝不合规策略。
Motivation: 关键领域部署 RL 前需评估其与复杂多目标规格的对齐及对环境漂移的鲁棒性，但策略以黑盒形式交付时，基于策略内部的传统评估手段失效，且提前终止会让失败被掩盖。
Method: CORE-RL 流水线定义统一可靠性指标，整合提前终止与安全违规；对策略施加由感知噪声、执行噪声、环境动力学变化组成的噪声认证包络，计算该指标的有限样本 Clopper-Pearson 界以及奖励与安全代价的 Hoeffding 下界，再据此定义 safe ODD 并给出高置信安全与性能证书。
Result: 在连续控制任务上的实验表明，该流水线能自动拒绝不合规策略，并绘出具备安全意识策略的安全运行设计域 (ODD)。
Conclusion: 对黑盒 RL 策略的安全部署评估可以建立在统计证书之上：统一可靠性指标加噪声认证包络与有限样本置信界，提供定量、透明、可复现的比较与部署依据。

papers.title: Maximizing $p$-Mean Social Welfare in the High-Multiplicity Setting: Few Agent Types and Few Item Types
papers.abstract_en: The $p$-mean welfare objective unifies several classical social welfare criteria for the allocation of indivisible goods. We study its maximization under additive nonnegative utilities when item and agent multiplicities are encoded in binary. For every fixed finite rational $p<1$, $p\neq0$, we show that the problem is $\mathsf{NP}$-hard with only two item types. Nash welfare ($p=0$) and egalitarian welfare ($p=-\infty$) are NP-hard with three item types. These results hold both for computing an optimal allocation and for rational-threshold decision, and the utilities and threshold can be required to be positive integers. We also show that maximizing $p$-mean social welfare is strongly NP-hard with one agent type and an unrestricted number of item types, for every fixed finite rational $p<1$ and for $p=-\infty$. A quantitative gap in this reduction rules out an FPTAS in the latter setting unless $\mathsf{P}=\mathsf{NP}$. On the positive side, for a fixed number of item types and an arbitrary number of agent types, we give an FPTAS for every fixed $p\in\mathbb Q\cup\{-\infty\}$. Its running time is polynomial in the compact input length and in $1/\varepsilon$, and it returns a compressed allocation. For a fixed number of agent types and an unrestricted number of item types, we give a PTAS for every fixed finite rational $p<1$, also in the fully compact model. We further give explicit compact-model proofs of the classical exact allocation algorithms for one item type, and for egalitarian welfare with two item types. These results essentially settle the complexity and approximability of $p$-mean welfare maximization with few item types and/or few agent types, leaving only the exact complexity of Nash welfare maximization with two item types unresolved in the small-item-type classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多重性以二进制编码的不可分物品分配中，作者证明 p-mean 社会福利最大化在物品类型极少时即 NP-hard：任意固定有理 p<1（p≠0）只需 2 个物品类型，Nash (p=0) 与 egalitarian (p=-∞) 需 3 个；1 个 agent 类型加任意多物品类型时为强 NP-hard 且排除 FPTAS（除非 P=NP）。正面结果是固定物品类型数时对任意固定 p∈Q∪{-∞} 给出 FPTAS，固定 agent 类型数时对固定有理 p<1 给出 PTAS，均在紧凑输入模型下运行时间关于输入长度与 1/ε 多项式。
Motivation: p-mean 福利统一了多种经典分配准则，但其在多重性以二进制紧凑编码下的复杂性与可近似性边界此前未被系统刻画，尤其小物品类型分类尚有缺口。
Method: 对固定有理 p<1（p≠0）构造仅 2 个物品类型的归约，对 Nash 与 egalitarian 构造 3 个物品类型的归约，覆盖最优计算与有理阈值判定两种形式；另构造 1 个 agent 类型的强 NP-hard 归约并给出量化间隙以排除 FPTAS。正面方向给出固定物品类型的 FPTAS（输出压缩分配）与固定 agent 类型的 PTAS，并给出单物品类型及 2 物品类型 egalitarian 的精确算法的紧凑模型证明。
Result: 固定有理 p<1（p≠0）在 2 个物品类型下 NP-hard；Nash (p=0) 与 egalitarian (p=-∞) 在 3 个物品类型下 NP-hard；1 个 agent 类型加任意多物品类型时对固定有理 p<1 及 p=-∞ 强 NP-hard，且该归约的量化间隙在 P≠NP 下排除 FPTAS。固定物品类型数时对每个固定 p∈Q∪{-∞} 有 FPTAS，运行时间关于紧凑输入长度与 1/ε 多项式；固定 agent 类型数时对固定有理 p<1 有 PTAS。
Conclusion: 小物品类型与小 agent 类型下的 p-mean 福利最大化复杂性与可近似性基本被完全刻画，唯一遗留的是 2 个物品类型下 Nash 福利最大化的精确复杂性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Specific Algorithmic Interpretability of Neural Networks: A Case Study on Textures
papers.abstract_en: We develop a principled framework for constructing neural networks whose specific parameter realizations admit an explicit algorithmic interpretation. Existing algorithm-inspired architectures can explain the computational structure of a network, yet after standard training the learned parameters need not retain a clear relation to the motivating algorithm. We address this gap as follows. First, we model each data point as a sample of a class-dependent stochastic process and assume that statistics of this process can be estimated from a single sample and these statistics are sufficient to distinguish the classes. We then construct a neural network whose initial parameters exactly implement an algorithm for estimating these statistics, making the network fully interpretable. To account for mismatch between the idealized model and real data, we fine-tune this network while controlling its deviation from the algorithmic initialization. The trained network hence roughly retains the interpretation of the initial network. A PAC-Bayesian analysis yields a uniform generalization bound whose complexity term scales with the fine-tuning radius, providing a statistical motivation for our approach. We instantiate the framework for texture classification using the scattering transform to estimate the discriminative statistics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一套构造算法可解释神经网络的框架：把每个数据点视为类相关随机过程的单样本，网络初始参数精确实现该过程统计量的估计算法，再在受控半径内微调以容忍模型与真实数据的失配。PAC-Bayes 分析给出复杂度项随微调半径缩放的一致泛化界，纹理分类上以 scattering transform 作为统计量估计器实例化。
Motivation: 算法启发式架构只能解释网络的计算结构，标准训练后学到的参数与最初动机算法之间不必保留清晰对应，参数层面的具体解释因此缺失。
Method: 假设类相关随机过程的统计量可由单样本估计且足以区分类别；用初始参数精确实现该估计算法构造网络，随后在受控偏离算法初始化的半径内微调；以 PAC-Bayes 分析导出复杂度项随微调半径缩放的一致泛化界；纹理分类实例中用 scattering transform 估计判别统计量。
Result: 得到复杂度项随微调半径缩放的 PAC-Bayes 一致泛化界；训练后网络大致保留初始网络的算法解释；框架在纹理分类上以 scattering transform 实例化。
Conclusion: 把算法实现放进参数初始化并用半径约束微调，可以在统计学习理论的支撑下让训练后网络保留对具体算法的解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding and Mitigating Hallucination Escape in Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as autonomous agents that invoke external tools. However, this capability introduces tool hallucination, selecting incorrect tools or generating invalid calls. Existing mitigation methods report substantial improvements, yet we identify a previously overlooked failure mode that we term Hallucination Escape. These methods reduce hallucination on the tool configuration they are tuned on but increase it on other configurations, canceling out the gain. We further investigate this phenomenon and find that hallucination rises sharply when a model's intrinsic tool-use tendencies conflict with the current tool configuration, and that existing methods reinforce rather than suppress these tendencies, which in turn contributes to hallucination escape. Building on these findings, we propose EscapeGuard, a training-free inference-time method that combines conflict-aware gating with configuration-derived attention enhancement to mitigate tool hallucination while preventing hallucination escape. Across six benchmarks on various models, EscapeGuard reduces tool-selection hallucination by 9.0 pp and suppresses hallucination escape, lowering the cross-configuration mean by 23.7 pp and achieving an 89.1% net improvement in paired-query evaluation. We hope this work can encourage evaluation beyond a single tool configuration and pave the way for more reliable tool-using LLM agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 现有工具幻觉缓解方法只在调参所用的工具配置上降低幻觉、换配置反而升高，作者把这一现象命名为 Hallucination Escape，归因于模型内在工具使用倾向与当前配置冲突时幻觉骤升、而现有方法会强化该倾向。提出的免训练推理时方法 EscapeGuard 用冲突感知门控加配置导出的注意力增强，在六个基准上把工具选择幻觉降低 9.0 pp，跨配置均值降低 23.7 pp，配对查询评估净改善 89.1%。
Motivation: 已有工具幻觉缓解方法只在单一工具配置上报告改进，换配置后幻觉反弹、把增益抵消，跨配置评估此前被忽略。
Method: EscapeGuard 是免训练的推理时方法，结合冲突感知门控 (conflict-aware gating) 与配置导出的注意力增强 (configuration-derived attention enhancement)，针对模型内在工具倾向与工具配置的冲突抑制幻觉。
Result: 在六个基准、多种模型上，工具选择幻觉下降 9.0 pp；跨配置均值下降 23.7 pp；配对查询 (paired-query) 评估净改善 89.1%。
Conclusion: 工具幻觉评估必须超出单一工具配置，否则缓解方法的表面增益会被跨配置反弹抵消。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TimeNet: An Extensible Unified Data Infrastructure for Next-Generation Temporal Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Temporal Foundation Models (TFMs) aim to generalize across domains, datasets, and tasks. Yet, their development remains constrained by fragmented, task-specific data formats, annotations, and processing pipelines. We introduce TimeNet, an open-source data standard and scalable infrastructure that decouples temporal data from task definitions and represents signals, metadata, annotations, and supervision in a shared, extensible data model. TimeNet supports multimodal signals with regular, irregular, or ordinal time axes and expresses different task families (including classification, forecasting, temporal localization, question answering, generation, and editing) as reusable views over the same recordings. This shared representation enables heterogeneous time-series datasets to be combined for large-scale model training across domains, modalities, and tasks. We demonstrate TimeNet by transcoding datasets with 1.5M task instances spanning diverse domains, modalities, temporal scales, and forms of supervision, while retaining practical I/O performance relative to native formats. TimeNet enables an existing TFN training pipeline to support joint training on a configurable number of heterogeneous datasets through configuration changes alone. We show this capability by training TFM across multiple datasets and tasks, obtaining a 14% F1 score improvement compared with models trained on individual datasets. These results show that TimeNet provides the data and systems foundation needed to move beyond task- and dataset-specific TFMs toward models that can learn jointly across heterogeneous domains, modalities, temporal scales, and forms of supervision from a common data model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TimeNet 提出开源时序数据标准与可扩展基础设施，把信号、元数据、标注与监督从任务定义中解耦，用统一数据模型把分类、预报、定位、问答、生成、编辑表达为同一记录上的可复用视图。转码 150 万任务实例后仍保持相对原生格式的 I/O 性能，仅改配置即可让既有 TFN 训练管线做多数据集联合训练，训练出的 TFM 相比单数据集训练模型 F1 提升 14%。
Motivation: 时序基础模型 (TFM) 的开发被碎片化、任务专用的数据格式、标注与处理管线束缚，异构时序数据集难以合并做大规模跨域训练。
Method: TimeNet 作为开放数据标准与可扩展基础设施，用共享可扩展数据模型表示信号、元数据、标注与监督，支持规则、不规则或序数时间轴的多模态信号，并把多种任务族表达为同一记录上的可复用视图；既有 TFN 训练管线仅通过配置改动即可在可配置数量的异构数据集上联合训练。
Result: 转码了覆盖多领域、多模态、多时间尺度与多种监督形式的 1.5M 任务实例，同时相对原生格式保持实用 I/O 性能；跨多数据集与多任务训练的 TFM 相比在单个数据集上训练的模型 F1 提升 14%。
Conclusion: 统一数据模型加配置驱动的联合训练，是把 TFM 从任务与数据集专用推向跨异构领域、模态、时间尺度与监督形式联合学习的数据与系统基础。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: CEENs: Causality-enforced evolutional networks for solving time-dependent partial differential equations
papers.abstract_en: Despite the growing popularity of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), their applicability in the long-time integration of partial differential equations (PDEs) remains constrained. We argue that this problem stems from the lack of consideration of temporal causality in the original PINN formulation, resulting in a bias towards satisfying governing equations at later times before learning the initial condition and hence leading to erroneous solutions. To this end, we propose a novel method that seamlessly integrates temporal causality into the training process. Drawing inspiration from classical numerical methods where the temporal causality is reflected, we divide the time domain into nonoverlapping subintervals, assign a unique neural network to each subinterval, and construct a loss function founded on the integral form of PDEs within these subintervals. The proposed networks undergo sequential training, beginning with the initial time step. Our method demonstrates significant improvement in accuracy for long-time simulations of various PDE problems where the original PINN method fails while it requires less computational cost and memory compared to the PINN method. A parallelization algorithm is provided to further enhance the computational efficiency, showing a significant speedup for solving time-dependent PDEs.
papers.journal_ref: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering 427 (2024) 117036
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CEENs 把时间因果性显式注入 PINN 训练：将时间域切成不重叠子区间，每个子区间分配独立网络，损失基于子区间上的 PDE 积分形式，并从初始时刻起顺序训练。在多种时变 PDE 长时间模拟上，原 PINN 失效处该方法精度显著提升，且计算成本与内存更低，配套并行算法进一步带来明显加速。
Motivation: PINN 在时变 PDE 的长时间积分中受限，原因是原始公式未考虑时间因果性，倾向于先满足后期时刻的控制方程、后学初始条件，从而产生错误解。
Method: 借鉴经典数值方法中的时间因果性，把时间域划分为不重叠子区间，为每个子区间分配唯一神经网络，构造基于子区间内 PDE 积分形式的损失函数；网络从初始时间步开始顺序训练，另提供并行化算法提升求解效率。
Result: 在多种 PDE 问题的长时间模拟中，原 PINN 方法失效的情况下该方法精度显著提升，同时相比 PINN 方法所需计算成本与内存更少；并行化算法对时变 PDE 求解带来显著加速（speedup）。
Conclusion: PINN 长时间积分失败的根源是缺少时间因果性，而按子区间积分形式加顺序训练能恢复它，并同时降低计算成本与内存。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Saying, Not Knowing: Aggressively GGUF-Quantized Small Language Models Still Write Rare Words They Can No Longer Define
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization to the GGUF format's mixed-precision K-quants is commonly how open-weight language models reach consumer hardware, yet its effect on fine-grained lexical competence is uncharacterized. We audit 27 quantized artifacts across 13 families and four architecture backbones, 0.35B-14B parameters, evaluated down their published ladder to Q2_K (about 2.6 bits per weight), on 429 frequency-validated rare English words under two probes: surface inclusion of a prompt-supplied word and its one-sentence definition, scored by a tiered multi-synonym matcher, its error measured by a blind LLM-judge census of every definition, with human verification. Three regimes emerge at Q2: total collapse into unusable builds, severe semantic dissociation in sub-2B models, and mostly robust preservation above about 3B. In every sub-2B artifact, definitions fall 20-67% below the artifact's baseline, typically several times the inclusion loss. Two controls separate rarity from task difficulty: within the rare set, loss rises with rarity in six of seven sub-2B artifacts, and on a 100-word common-word set rare words lose more than common words in all eight, significantly in six. Tokenizer vocabulary size does not predict the damage (Spearman rho=0.12); parameter count dominates (rho=0.72), confirmed within five of six same-tokenizer families. Q4_K_M remains lexically clean at >=1B. The damage is frequency-graded, provider-dependent, and not calibrated by WikiText-2 perplexity: across nine artifact-matched ladders, near-identical Q2 penalties (44.7%/47.6%) separate an artifact keeping its definitions (3.6%) from one losing them (43.6%). Aggressively quantized small models can keep generating fluent text while no longer knowing what it means, risking hardware-constrained deployments in domains where semantics carries consequences. Validation must be per artifact.

TL;DR: 对 27 个 GGUF 混合精度 K-quant 量化模型（13 个家族、0.35B–14B）审计发现：Q2_K（约 2.6 bpw）下 sub-2B 模型的词义定义比自身基线低 20–67%，通常数倍于表层词包含损失；参数量是主控因子（Spearman rho=0.72），WikiText-2 perplexity 无法校准该损伤，因此部署前必须逐 artifact 验证词义能力。
Motivation: 开源模型靠 GGUF 量化进入消费级硬件，但量化对细粒度词汇能力（能否给出词义）的影响此前未被刻画；模型仍能流畅生成却不再理解词义，在语义有后果的领域构成部署风险。
Method: 审计 27 个量化 artifact、13 个家族、4 种架构、0.35B–14B，沿发布量化阶梯测到 Q2_K；用 429 个频率校验的罕见英文词做两类探针（包含提示词、给出一句话定义），以分层多同义词匹配器打分，定义错误用盲测 LLM-judge 全量普查并经人工核验；另设 100 个常用词对照集分离稀有度与任务难度。
Result: Q2 出现三种体制：完全崩坏、sub-2B 严重语义解离、约 3B 以上基本保持；每个 sub-2B artifact 的定义比基线低 20–67%，通常数倍于包含损失。七个 sub-2B 中有六个损伤随稀有度上升；八个 artifact 在常用词对照上罕见词损失更大，其中六个显著。词表大小不预测损伤（rho=0.12），参数量主导（rho=0.72），六个同 tokenizer 家族中五个内部确认。Q4_K_M 在 >=1B 保持词汇干净。九条 artifact 匹配阶梯上 Q2 惩罚近乎相同（44.7%/47.6%），却分开一个定义仅降 3.6% 与一个降 43.6% 的 artifact。
Conclusion: 激进量化的小模型可以继续流畅生成却不再理解所写词义，损伤随词频分级、依赖 provider，且不能由 perplexity 校准，因此验证必须逐 artifact 进行。

papers.title: XTurnix: Large-Scale Self-Supervised Turn Control through Two-State Binary Decisions
papers.abstract_en: General turn-taking behavior in real-time dialogue systems requires deciding whether to keep listening or start responding while listening, and whether to continue or stop while speaking. Existing turn detectors use heterogeneous, task-specific label spaces and are often trained on limited annotations or evaluated on isolated utterances, making them difficult to use as a unified causal controller with comprehensive context. We propose XTurnix, a compact text-based model that formulates turn control as two binary decisions conditioned on the AI's current listening or speaking state and predicts a single control token from the complete dialogue history. XTurnix is pretrained on 5.5 million causal action examples automatically derived from timestamped two-speaker transcripts, then fine-tuned on synthetic multi-turn examples with a flatter distribution across the four state-action labels. We evaluate XTurnix on four public benchmarks and a balanced self-curated benchmark. Across the public benchmarks, XTurnix achieves the best results on all SemanticVAD and LiveKit splits, ties the native Smart-Turn model on Smart-Turn Bench, and achieves the highest incomplete-turn accuracy on Easy-Turn. On the self-curated benchmark, it reaches 89.06% accuracy, more than 20 percentage points above the strongest third-party baseline at 68.75%, while maintaining F1 scores between 84.21% and 90.63% across all four categories. These results demonstrate unified listening- and speaking-state turn control in a single compact model. Code is available at https://github.com/xcc-zach/xturnix, with an interactive demo at https://huggingface.co/spaces/xcczach/xturnix-demo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: XTurnix 把对话轮次控制统一成两个二元决策（听时继续听还是开始说、说时继续说还是停），以当前状态加完整对话历史为条件输出单个控制 token。在 550 万条因果动作样本上预训练、再用四类状态-动作分布更平的合成多轮样本微调后，自建平衡基准上准确率 89.06%，比最强第三方基线 68.75% 高出 20 个百分点以上。
Motivation: 现有轮次检测器标签空间异构、任务专用，多在有限标注或孤立话语上训练，难以作为带完整上下文的统一因果控制器使用。
Method: 紧凑的纯文本模型 XTurnix：把轮次控制形式化为依赖 AI 当前 listening/speaking 状态的两个二元决策，从完整对话历史预测单个控制 token；先用时间戳双人转录自动导出的 550 万因果动作样本预训练，再在四类状态-动作标签分布更平的合成多轮样本上微调。
Result: 在四个公开基准与一个自建平衡基准上评测：SemanticVAD 与 LiveKit 全部 split 取得最佳结果，Smart-Turn Bench 与原生 Smart-Turn 模型持平，Easy-Turn 上不完整轮次准确率最高；自建基准准确率 89.06%，比最强第三方基线 68.75% 高 20 个百分点以上，四类 F1 在 84.21% 到 90.63% 之间。
Conclusion: 单一紧凑模型可以同时承担 listening 与 speaking 两种状态的统一轮次控制，且在平衡自建基准上明显拉开与第三方基线的差距。

papers.title: GlitchPatch: Repairing Glitch Tokens in Frozen Language Models via Local Retokenization
papers.abstract_en: Glitch tokens are anomalous vocabulary entries that can cause large language models (LLMs) to produce outputs inconsistent with their inputs. Existing repair methods require access to model internals, making them impractical for frozen checkpoints. We investigate whether glitch tokens can be repaired outside the model by optimizing the input tokenization. An empirical study on BPE merge-rule deletion reveals that (1)deleting a glitch token's merge rule can fix a substantial fraction of failures, yet disrupting normal tokens sharing intermediate merge nodes causes the overall glitch rate to rise, and (2)different decomposition granularities yield non-monotonic fix rates while collateral damage on normal tokens grows monotonically. Motivated by these findings, we propose GlitchPatch, a repair framework for frozen language models based on local retokenization, consisting of two stages: the offline stage uses Behavioral Path Optimization (BPO) to find the behaviorally optimal replacement token sequence for each glitch token and compiles validated replacements into a rule table; the online stage substitutes only the IDs of matched glitch tokens in the canonical token sequence, with no modification to model parameters or internal states. Experiments on ten models spanning six tokenizer families show that GlitchPatch achieves an 85.10% mean fix rate, outperforming the strongest baseline by 14.37 percentage points, and reduces the average glitch rate from 14.88% to 2.27%. GlitchPatch achieves a 0.00% RR in full-vocabulary evaluation and leaves rule-unmatched inputs unchanged by design. We further evaluate the practical impact of repair from the perspectives of time cost, language understanding, and capability, supporting its deployment feasibility. We hope this work provides a practical option for improving tokenizer reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GlitchPatch 在不改动冻结模型参数与内部状态的前提下，通过局部重分词修复 glitch token：离线用 Behavioral Path Optimization (BPO) 为每个 glitch token 搜索行为最优的替换 token 序列并编译成规则表，在线只替换规范 token 序列中匹配到的 ID。在覆盖六个 tokenizer 家族的十个模型上平均修复率 85.10%，比最强基线高 14.37 个百分点，平均 glitch 率从 14.88% 降到 2.27%。
Motivation: 现有 glitch token 修复方法需要访问模型内部，对只有冻结 checkpoint 的场景不可用；直接删除 BPE merge 规则虽能修掉一部分失败，但会破坏共享中间 merge 节点的正常 token，反而抬高整体 glitch 率。
Method: 两阶段局部重分词框架：离线阶段用 Behavioral Path Optimization (BPO) 为每个 glitch token 求行为最优的替换 token 序列，把验证过的替换编译成规则表；在线阶段只在规范 token 序列上替换匹配到的 glitch token ID，不改模型参数与内部状态。前置实证研究扫描 BPE merge 规则删除，比较不同分解粒度下的修复率与对正常 token 的附带损伤。
Result: merge 规则删除实验给出两条规律：删除 glitch token 的 merge 规则能修复相当比例失败，但破坏共享中间 merge 节点的正常 token 会使整体 glitch 率上升；不同分解粒度下修复率非单调，而对正常 token 的附带损伤单调增长。十个模型、六个 tokenizer 家族上 GlitchPatch 平均修复率 85.10%，超最强基线 14.37 个百分点，平均 glitch 率 14.88% → 2.27%，全词表评测 RR 为 0.00%，规则不匹配的输入按设计保持不变。
Conclusion: 在冻结语言模型外部优化输入分词即可有效修复 glitch token，无需触碰模型内部；规则表替换只作用于匹配到的 glitch token，因此对规则外输入零改动，作者据此认为该方法具备部署可行性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JASPER: Special Session on Joint Reliability And Security Assessment of SPlit Computing for Edge Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Split Computing (SC) enables efficient deployment of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) by partitioning inference between edge devices and cloud servers. However, intermediate feature representations are simultaneously exposed to hardware faults and adversarial attacks, which are traditionally evaluated independently. This paper presents a unified framework for the joint assessment of reliability and security in Split Computing. First, reliability is characterized through neuron-level fault injection using the Mean Relative Accuracy Degradation (MRAD) while security through feature-map-aware adversarial attacks simulations using the Attack Success Rate (ASR). Based on these complementary analyses, the Joint Vulnerability Score (JVS) is introduced, along with a confidence-aware extension that jointly captures prediction errors and confidence degradation. The framework is evaluated on ten Split Computing configurations based on ResNet-50 trained on ILSVRC-2012. Experimental results show substantial differences across compression strategies, with MRAD ranging from 44.3% to 61.2% under fault injection, while adversarial attacks achieve up to 98.8% ASR. Furthermore, the proposed joint metrics reveal vulnerability trends that remain hidden when reliability and security are analyzed independently, providing a more comprehensive methodology for designing dependable Split Computing systems.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 9 figures. Accepted as a special session paper at the 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Defect and Fault Tolerance in VLSI and Nanotechnology Systems (DFT)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分裂计算 (Split Computing) 可靠性与安全性联合评估框架：用神经元级故障注入的 MRAD 度量可靠性、用特征图感知对抗攻击的 ASR 度量安全性，再合成 Joint Vulnerability Score (JVS) 及其置信度感知扩展。在 10 种基于 ResNet-50 / ILSVRC-2012 的分裂配置上，故障注入下 MRAD 为 44.3%–61.2%，对抗攻击最高达 98.8% ASR，联合指标揭示了独立分析时被掩盖的脆弱性趋势。
Motivation: 分裂计算的中间特征表示同时暴露于硬件故障与对抗攻击，但两者传统上被独立评估，无法反映同一配置下的综合脆弱性。
Method: 框架分两路：神经元级故障注入并以 Mean Relative Accuracy Degradation (MRAD) 表征可靠性，特征图感知的对抗攻击仿真并以 Attack Success Rate (ASR) 表征安全性；在此之上提出 Joint Vulnerability Score (JVS) 及其置信度感知扩展，同时刻画预测误差与置信度退化。评估覆盖 10 种分裂配置，模型为 ResNet-50，数据集 ILSVRC-2012。
Result: 在 10 种分裂配置上，故障注入下 MRAD 介于 44.3% 到 61.2% 之间，不同压缩策略差异明显；对抗攻击最高达到 98.8% ASR。联合指标揭示出可靠性与安全性独立分析时隐藏的脆弱性趋势。
Conclusion: 可靠性与安全性必须在同一指标框架下联合评估，才能为设计可信分裂计算系统提供更全面的依据。

papers.title: Detecting Defects that Matter: An Application-Driven Benchmark for Anomaly Detection in Manufacturing and Retail Logistics (VAND 4.0 Challenge)
papers.abstract_en: Existing Anomaly Detection benchmarks are saturated and often unrealistic. As part of the VAND 4.0 Challenge, we introduce a hidden-test, application-driven benchmark across two deployment-critical domains: industrial manufacturing and retail logistics. In the Industrial Track (MVTec AD 2), the results reveal that unsupervised anomaly segmentation remains challenging: the best regular-setting method achieves only ~57\% pixel-level $SegF_1$, indicating substantial room for improvement. Zero-shot approaches trail by ~15 $SegF_1$ points, confirming that task-specific training on normal data remains essential for precise defect localization. Robustness to distribution shifts remains a key open challenge and DINOv3-backbones clearly dominate this track. In the Retail Track (Kaputt 2), the results reveal that (1) supervised defect detection is approaching saturation for common defect types; (2) the best off-the-shelf VLM approach trails specialized models by ~28 AP, confirming that currently VLMs cannot replace fine-tuned detectors, (3) reference images did not prove helpful for top-performing approaches. Performance collapses on rare defects (spillage ~53 AP, missing units ~27 AP), where the supervised ceiling is bounded by data availability. To drive future progress in this domain, we provide a new low-prevalence retail AD dataset (Kaputt-Rare). Across both tracks, computational efficiency is assessed as a first-class metric combining performance, throughput, memory, and power consumption. We introduce a novel metric for measuring efficiency and reveal that that top-performing methods rely on heavy architectures while efficiency is largely neglected. Overall, we conclude that the community needs (a) more efficiency-aware method development, and (b) true anomaly detection approaches for rare defects and shifting conditions. https://sites.google.com/view/vand4-cvpr2026/challenge

papers.title: Gaussian Flow Dynamics: Simulation-Free Neural SDE Learning Beyond One-Time Marginals
papers.abstract_en: Simulation-free training of latent Stochastic Differential Equations (SDEs) relies on a variational posterior process whose one-time marginals are tractable, typically Gaussian. Such marginals, however, do not determine the underlying dynamics: many processes share the same marginals while differing in their temporal structure, and existing parameterizations fix this structure implicitly, which restricts the posterior family and biases the learned model. We introduce Gaussian flow dynamics, which construct stochastic processes directly from smoothly evolving Gaussian marginals while making the marginal-preserving, or gauge, degrees of freedom explicit and parameterizable. The construction admits state-dependent diffusion coefficients and recovers every linear SDE with additive noise and a non-degenerate Gaussian initial distribution. Building on it, we propose Gauge Matching, a simulation-free method for latent SDE learning that combines Gaussian flow dynamics with the SDE Matching objective. Gauge Matching costs at most quadratically in the latent dimension per step, like SDE Matching, but learns the temporal structure of the posterior beyond its one-time marginals. It comes within a nat of Helmholtz-SDE, which computes the gauge from the prior Jacobian at cubic cost, on the linear benchmark where the exact posterior is known, matches it on nonlinear systems, and applies where Helmholtz-SDE does not, to state-dependent noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Gaussian flow dynamics：从平滑演化的 Gaussian 边缘分布直接构造随机过程，把保边缘（gauge）自由度显式参数化，并据此给出仿真无关的隐 SDE 学习方法 Gauge Matching，学习超越单时刻边缘的后验时间结构。在线性基准（精确后验已知）上它与代价为三次的 Helmholtz-SDE 相差不到 1 nat，在非线性系统上与之持平，并可处理 Helmholtz-SDE 不适用的状态依赖噪声。
Motivation: 仿真无关的隐 SDE 训练依赖单时刻边缘可解析的变分后验，但边缘不决定动力学：许多过程共享相同边缘而时间结构不同，现有参数化隐式固定了这一结构，限制后验族并使学到的模型有偏。
Method: Gaussian flow dynamics 从平滑演化的 Gaussian 边缘构造随机过程，显式参数化保边缘的 gauge 自由度，支持状态依赖扩散系数，并可复现所有具加性噪声与非退化 Gaussian 初始分布的线性 SDE；Gauge Matching 将其与 SDE Matching 目标结合做仿真无关训练，每步代价至多为隐维度的二次。
Result: 在线性基准（精确后验已知）上与 Helmholtz-SDE 相差不到 1 nat；在非线性系统上与其匹配；可应用于状态依赖噪声，而 Helmholtz-SDE 不适用。单步计算代价至多为隐维度二次，与 SDE Matching 同阶，而 Helmholtz-SDE 为三次。
Conclusion: 把保边缘自由度显式参数化，可以在不增加仿真与三次计算代价的前提下学到超越单时刻边缘的后验时间结构，并把适用范围扩展到状态依赖噪声。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: TrustMed-RL: Long-Horizon Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Medical language models can produce correct diagnoses despite incomplete investigations and unsupported reasoning. To support long-horizon, evidence-grounded diagnosis, we introduce \textbf{TrustMed-RL}. Built from PubMed rare-disease cases and over 24,000 manually annotated image panels, it integrates interviews, examinations, testing, specialist consultation, and literature search through state-dependent actions. Our 8B vision--language policy, trained with clinically adapted GiGPO and coverage-adjusted diagnostic rewards, achieves 37.1\% diagnostic accuracy on 2,500 evaluation cases, outperforming all evaluated open-weight baselines and improving over supervised fine-tuning by 12.4 percentage points.. When success additionally requires acquiring at least 50\% of supporting test evidence, TrustMed-RL achieves 32.5\%, exceeding GPT-4o by 6.8 percentage points. Furthermore, it surpasses all evaluated baselines on MTMedDialog and multiple larger 27--32B models on AgentClinic. In physician review of 200 diagnostically accepted test-set trajectories, 83.0\% receive evidential-grounding scores of 4--5 out of 5. Physicians' assessments suggest that these diagnostic trajectories are trustworthy and aligned with human diagnostic reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TrustMed-RL 用临床改造的 GiGPO 与覆盖度校正诊断奖励训练 8B 视觉-语言策略，在 PubMed 罕见病病例与 24,000+ 人工标注图像面板上做长程循证诊断。2,500 例评测中诊断准确率 37.1%，比监督微调高 12.4 个百分点；若还要求获取至少 50% 支持性检查证据，准确率 32.5%，超 GPT-4o 6.8 个百分点。
Motivation: 医学语言模型可能在检查不完整、推理无依据的情况下给出正确诊断，长程诊断过程缺少对证据获取与推理支撑的约束。
Method: 基于 PubMed 罕见病病例与超过 24,000 个人工标注图像面板构建环境，动作空间覆盖问诊、查体、检验、专科会诊与文献检索；用临床适配的 GiGPO 与覆盖度校正的诊断奖励训练 8B 视觉-语言策略。
Result: 2,500 例评测上诊断准确率 37.1%，优于全部被评估的开源权重基线，比监督微调 (SFT) 高 12.4 个百分点；在成功还需获取至少 50% 支持性检查证据的设定下为 32.5%，超 GPT-4o 6.8 个百分点；在 MTMedDialog 上超过全部被评估基线，在 AgentClinic 上超过多个 27–32B 模型；医师对 200 条被判为诊断可接受的测试集轨迹评审，83.0% 的循证支撑 (evidential-grounding) 得分为 4–5 分（满分 5）。
Conclusion: 把证据获取要求写进奖励后，8B 策略的诊断既达到更高准确率，其轨迹也获得医师对循证支撑的高分认可，说明长程 RL 可以同时改善正确性与可审查性。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Largest Rashomon sets of decision trees for robust contextual optimization
papers.abstract_en: Many decision trees fit the same data almost equally well, yet they can route a query point to different leaves and induce different local empirical distributions. We study decisions that meet prescribed cost, shortage or risk targets despite this predictive multiplicity. We propose the joint Rashomon and robustness optimization framework for optimal decision trees. It jointly selects an operational decision and the largest Rashomon set of trees, so that the targets hold under the local empirical distribution that every tree in this set induces at the query point. We specialize the framework to the regression setting, and we show that a tree affects the decision only through the training observations sharing the query leaf, which we call its query neighborhood. As a result, the robust problem involves only finitely many distinct constraints, which can be examined in order of increasing estimation loss. We develop a constraint generation algorithm that combines query-path pricing with dynamic programming to identify violating neighborhoods without enumerating trees. On synthetic newsvendor instances, the algorithm typically needs few neighborhoods and runs substantially faster than full neighborhood enumeration. On restaurant demand data, the robust orders increase the mean tolerated excess estimation loss by 17.6% and reduce the empirical conditional value-at-risk of the worst 10% of realized costs by 8.3% relative to the sample average approximation orders of the optimal tree, while the mean cost difference is not statistically significant. An interpretability analysis further shows how the retained neighborhoods explain the decision and its robustness limit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在决策树的预测多重性下，提出联合 Rashomon 与鲁棒优化框架：同时选一个运营决策和最大的 Rashomon 树集，使成本、缺货或风险目标在该集合中每棵树于查询点诱导的局部经验分布下都成立。在餐厅需求数据上，鲁棒订货相对最优树的样本平均近似订货把可容忍的平均超额估计损失提高 17.6%，并把最差 10% 实现成本的经验 CVaR 降低 8.3%，而平均成本差异不显著。
Motivation: 许多决策树对同一数据拟合几乎一样好，却把查询点路由到不同叶子、诱导不同局部经验分布，使基于单棵最优树的决策在预测多重性下不稳健。
Method: 提出联合 Rashomon 与鲁棒优化框架，专门化到回归设定，证明树只通过与查询点共享叶子的训练观测（query neighborhood）影响决策，从而鲁棒问题只含有限多个不同约束；求解用约束生成算法，结合 query-path pricing 与动态规划，在不枚举树的情况下找出违例邻域。
Result: 合成 newsvendor 实例上，算法通常只需处理少数邻域，运行速度显著快于全邻域枚举。餐厅需求数据上，鲁棒订货相对最优树的 SAA 订货使可容忍的平均超额估计损失提高 17.6%，使最差 10% 实现成本的经验 CVaR 降低 8.3%，平均成本差异不具统计显著性。
Conclusion: 决策只由查询邻域决定，因此鲁棒决策可在不枚举树的前提下按估计损失递增顺序检查有限个约束求解；保留的邻域同时解释了决策及其鲁棒性边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Plausibility: Verifiable Fine-Grained Image Editing on Structured Assets
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained image editing requires more than producing a visually plausible result: an editor must execute the requested attribute change precisely while leaving everything else intact. However, existing benchmarks leave a critical gap between realism and verifiability: benchmarks built on realistic images typically rely on human or vision--language model judgments, while deterministic evaluation has largely focused on synthetic shape canvases, with application-oriented extensions primarily limited to charts. This makes it difficult to determine precisely how much of a requested edit was executed, where unintended changes occurred, and whether small differences between models reflect genuine editing capability or evaluator uncertainty. To bridge this gap, we present VeriEdit-Bench, a benchmark for fine-grained, instruction-faithful image editing across realistic structured assets with deterministic, four-axis evaluation. Its 1,740 cases are compiled from the source code of 153 Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) graphics, charts, web interfaces, and presentation slides. Controlled source-code edits preserve the original visual context while yielding exact target images, pixel-level edit masks, and explicit edit specifications, enabling reproducible scoring along four axes: edit fidelity, preservation, localization, and magnitude. Evaluating eleven editors, we find that even the strongest model remains far from full credit; rankings for the same recoloring operation reverse between charts and SVG graphics; and outputs with similar pixel-accuracy profiles can still differ substantially in localization and change magnitude. This decomposition yields graded, verifiable feedback and exposes model-specific capability and failure profiles that holistic scores or evaluator-dependent judgments may obscure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 VeriEdit-Bench：用 SVG 源码受控编辑生成精确目标图与像素级编辑掩码，对真实结构化素材的细粒度图像编辑做四轴确定性评测（编辑保真、保持、定位、幅度）。1,740 个案例来自 153 个 SVG 图形、图表、网页界面与幻灯片源码，评测十一个编辑器后发现最强模型仍远未满分，同一重着色操作在图表与 SVG 上排名反转。
Motivation: 真实图像基准依赖人工或 VLM 判断，确定性评测又局限于合成画布与图表，无法区分模型真实编辑能力与评测器不确定性。
Method: 从 153 个 SVG 源码做受控代码编辑，保留原视觉上下文并得到精确目标图、像素级编辑掩码与显式编辑规格；沿 edit fidelity、preservation、localization、magnitude 四轴确定性打分，评测十一个图像编辑器。
Result: 共 1,740 个案例；十一个编辑器中最强者仍远未满分；同一 recoloring 操作在 charts 与 SVG graphics 上排名反转；像素准确度相近的输出在 localization 与 change magnitude 上仍差异显著。
Conclusion: 四轴分解能给出分级可复现反馈，暴露整体分数或依赖评测器的判断所掩盖的模型能力与失败模式。

summary_sections.motivation: 真实图像基准依赖人工或 VLM 判断，确定性评测又局限于合成画布与图表，无法区分模型真实编辑能力与评测器不确定性。
summary_sections.method: 从 153 个 SVG 源码做受控代码编辑，保留原视觉上下文并得到精确目标图、像素级编辑掩码与显式编辑规格；沿 edit fidelity、preservation、localization、magnitude 四轴确定性打分，评测十一个图像编辑器。
summary_sections.result: 共 1,740 个案例；十一个编辑器中最强者仍远未满分；同一 recoloring 操作在 charts 与 SVG graphics 上排名反转；像素准确度相近的输出在 localization 与 change magnitude 上仍差异显著。
summary_sections.conclusion: 四轴分解能给出分级可复现反馈，暴露整体分数或依赖评测器的判断所掩盖的模型能力与失败模式。

papers.title: AgentPersonaBench: Benchmarking Persona-Driven User Simulation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce AgentPersonaBench (APB), a benchmark evaluating whether persona conditioning faithfully steers downstream agent behavior. While language models are increasingly deployed for persona-driven user simulation, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate conversational styling or self-reports rather than authentic behavioral fidelity. APB evaluates latent persona adherence one trait at a time, embedding each target trait within a complete synthetic profile without explicitly naming the trait or disclosing the test. Ground-truth adherence is verified strictly from observable actions across four interaction surfaces of increasing realism: survey, chat, web (interactive web environments), and app (desktop software environments). APB comprises 2,460 tasks spanning 867 traits, verified through automated audits and expert review. Our evaluation of 20 frontier model arms demonstrates that high-fidelity user simulation is already attainable: leading models achieve up to 84.7% full-pass adherence under unprompted conditions. At the same time, APB identifies clear behavioral boundaries: adherence drops across interaction modalities (only 37.9-64.3% pass all four surfaces), multi-attribute demands degrade retention, and competing model families exhibit pronounced behavioral divergence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentPersonaBench (APB) 用不点名特质的合成人格档案，逐特质检验 persona 条件化能否真实驱动智能体行为，覆盖 survey、chat、web、app 四种递增真实度的交互面。20 个前沿模型中领先者在无提示条件下 full-pass 遵从率达 84.7%，但跨全部四个面全过的仅 37.9–64.3%，多属性叠加会进一步拉低保持率。
Motivation: 现有人格驱动用户模拟基准只评对话风格或自我报告，无法判断 persona 是否真正改变了可观测行为，而非表面措辞。
Method: 把目标特质嵌入完整合成档案且不点名特质或透露测试意图，仅凭可观测动作判定遵从；四层交互面为 survey、chat、web（交互网页环境）、app（桌面软件环境），共 2,460 个任务、867 个特质，经自动审计与专家复核校验，评测 20 个前沿模型。
Result: 领先模型在无提示条件下 full-pass 遵从率最高达 84.7%；仅 37.9–64.3% 的模型能通过全部四个交互面；多属性要求会降低特质保持，不同模型家族间表现出显著行为分化。
Conclusion: 高保真 persona 用户模拟已可达成，但遵从性随交互模态真实度上升和属性叠加而衰减，且模型家族间行为边界清晰。

papers.title: COPEX: Benchmarking LLM Robustness to Adversarial Context Across Model Context Protocol Layers
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly mediate tool use in Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems, where adversarial influence may enter through user instructions, tool schemas, tool outputs, or protocol messages. Existing benchmarks often evaluate deployed agents, conflating model susceptibility with guardrails, orchestration, and general task capability. We introduce COPEX (COntext Provider EXploitation), a controlled benchmark that isolates the model as an MCP client by fixing the surrounding agent stack and varying only the tool-selecting model. COPEX covers 25 attack types instantiated as 125 scenarios across four entry surfaces: model/agent, client, server/tool, and transport. Across nine models and 3,375 trials, the mean attack success rate is 64.4%, with surface-level means ranging from 58.3% to 71.4%. Some client- and transport-level attacks succeed partly outside the model's observation or control, separating system exposure from model susceptibility. Combined input and context scanning reduces mean attack success by 49.6% on an eight-attack defense subset relative to the undefended setting. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/inspire-center/copex.
papers.comment: Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agents in the Wild
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COPEX 固定 agent 栈、只换选工具的模型，把 MCP 客户端 LLM 的对抗上下文易感性单独测出来：25 种攻击、125 个场景、9 个模型共 3,375 次试验，平均攻击成功率 64.4%，四个入口面均值 58.3%–71.4%。部分 client/transport 层攻击在模型观测与控制范围之外得手，说明系统暴露与模型易感性必须分开记账；叠加输入与上下文扫描后，在八攻击防御子集上平均成功率降 49.6%。
Motivation: 现有基准评的是部署态 agent，把模型本身的易感性与 guardrail、编排和通用任务能力混在一起，无法归因 MCP 协议各层的对抗暴露。
Method: COPEX (COntext Provider EXploitation) 固定周边 agent 栈、只改变选工具的模型，把模型作为 MCP client 隔离评测；覆盖 model/agent、client、server/tool、transport 四个入口面，25 种攻击类型实例化为 125 个场景，跨 9 个模型跑 3,375 次试验，并在八攻击子集上叠加输入与上下文扫描防御。
Result: 9 个模型 3,375 次试验的平均攻击成功率为 64.4%，四个入口面均值介于 58.3% 与 71.4% 之间；部分 client 层与 transport 层攻击在模型观测或控制范围之外成功。在八攻击防御子集上，组合输入与上下文扫描相对无防御设置把平均攻击成功率降低 49.6%。
Conclusion: MCP 场景下 LLM 平均六成以上攻击可得手，且系统暴露与模型易感性是两个可分离的量；上下文扫描类防御能显著压低成功率但不能归零。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Do Tool Calls Execute as Intended? Measuring and Repairing Intent-Execution Correspondence in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agents built on large language models (LLMs) build and run software through tool calls. A call reaches its program through several hops, and any hop can change the call without notice. When the changed call fails, the agent retries a correct call, which costs users time and money. Benchmarks and failure analyses do not see the change, because they read the call and its result but not what a hop received. We define intent-execution correspondence (IEC) as the property that the executed action matches the action the emitted call denotes under the tool contract. Our protocol observes what each hop received without executing the call, and names the first hop that changed it by the receiver's own parser. IntAct then delivers the call in a form that this hop cannot alter, or refuses the call. We build IEC-Bench from the changes observed in real-world use, with chains of dependent calls under the execution paths of 4 widely-used harnesses. In 47,828 shell calls within production sessions, Claude Code's Bash tool changes 12.0% of the calls that carry code, escape sequences, or long text. For 80.7% of the calls whose backslashes are changed, the wrong action runs without any reported error. All 10 measured harnesses change a call. Trajectory-based judgment attributes 95.1% of the production failures to the LLM, although the path caused more than half of them. On IEC-Bench, the path raises the token cost per passed task 2.4 times (up to 12.3 times). A hop that changes a call also hides the changes after it, so 55.1% of the failures on one path appear only after its first hop is repaired. IntAct, deployed in a commercial product, recovers 79.2% of the failures with a changed call. Harnesses should therefore be designed and tested hop-by-hop to ensure a correct call executes as intended or is refused.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 定义 intent-execution correspondence (IEC)：被执行的动作须与工具契约下已发出调用所指的动作一致。协议在不执行的情况下观测每一跳收到的内容并用接收方解析器定位首个篡改点，IntAct 则让该跳无法改动调用或直接拒绝。生产会话 47,828 次 shell 调用中 Claude Code 的 Bash 工具改动 12.0% 携带代码/转义序列/长文本的调用，IntAct 恢复 79.2% 的被改动调用所致失败。
Motivation: LLM agent 的一次工具调用要经过多跳才到达程序，任一跳都可能悄悄改写调用；现有 benchmark 与失败分析只读调用及其结果，看不到各跳实际收到什么，因而把路径导致的失败误判给模型。
Method: 定义 IEC 属性；提出不执行调用即可观测每一跳所收内容的协议，并按接收方自身解析器命名首个改写调用的跳；IntAct 以该跳无法改写的形式投递调用或拒绝之；基于真实使用中观测到的改写构建 IEC-Bench，覆盖 4 个广泛使用的 harness 执行路径上的依赖调用链。
Result: 生产会话 47,828 次 shell 调用中 Claude Code 的 Bash 工具改动 12.0% 携带代码、转义序列或长文本的调用；被改动反斜杠的调用里 80.7% 在无任何报错的情况下执行了错误动作；全部 10 个被测 harness 都会改动调用；基于轨迹的判定把 95.1% 的生产失败归因于 LLM，而路径造成了其中一半以上；IEC-Bench 上路径使每个通过任务的 token 成本升至 2.4 倍（最高 12.3 倍）；某条路径上 55.1% 的失败只有在修复首跳后才显现；部署于商业产品的 IntAct 恢复了 79.2% 的被改动调用所致失败。
Conclusion: harness 应被逐跳设计与测试，以保证正确调用按意图执行或被拒绝；只看调用与结果的评测会把路径故障错记到 LLM 头上。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Frame-Level Temporal Alignment for Human-to-Robot Visual Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Transferring visual representations pretrained on human videos to robot manipulation requires learning reliable correspondences between human and robot demonstrations. However, paired demonstrations can differ in execution rate and in the proportion of non-key frames that do not directly reflect task progress. Frames at the same relative timestamp may therefore represent different task stages, which can cause correspondence learning to fail. To address these issues, we propose Frame-Level Temporal Alignment (FLTA), a framework that uses two temporal priors to adapt visual encoders pretrained on human videos for robot manipulation. It learns shared task-progress representations without frame-level correspondence annotations, allowing frames at different relative temporal positions to match. A global progress prior combines normalized temporal positions with visual similarity to construct a soft correspondence target. A local temporal order prior penalizes backward transitions while allowing stays and varying forward rates to accommodate execution-rate differences. With ResNet-50 and ViT encoders, our method achieves relative improvements of 46.93% and 65.96%, respectively, over the best baselines in average simulation success rates and achieves higher task success rates on real-world manipulation tasks. These results also suggest that effective human-robot adaptation depends less on the number of parameters updated than on which parameters are selected. Our project page is available at https://rtx5090ultra.github.io/FLTA-Project-Page/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLTA 用全局进度先验（归一化时间位置 + 视觉相似度构造软对应目标）与局部时序顺序先验（惩罚倒退、允许停留与不同前进速率），在无帧级对应标注下让人视频预训练视觉编码器适配机器人操作。ResNet-50 与 ViT 编码器相对最优基线的平均仿真成功率分别提升 46.93% 与 65.96%，真实任务成功率也更高。
Motivation: 人类与机器人演示在执行速率和非关键帧比例上不一致，同一相对时间戳对应不同任务阶段，导致帧级对应学习失效，人视频预训练表征难以迁移到机器人操作。
Method: 提出 Frame-Level Temporal Alignment (FLTA)：全局进度先验把归一化时间位置与视觉相似度结合生成软对应目标，学习共享任务进度表征；局部时序顺序先验惩罚倒退转移、允许停留与可变前进速率以容忍执行速率差异；在 ResNet-50 与 ViT 编码器上适配，无需帧级对应标注。
Result: 相对最优基线，平均仿真成功率相对提升 46.93%（ResNet-50）与 65.96%（ViT）；在真实机器人操作任务上取得更高任务成功率。
Conclusion: 有效的人到机器人视觉适配取决于选哪些参数更新，而非更新参数的数量；时间先验可替代帧级对应标注来对齐异速演示。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Functionally Equivalent or Not? Graph-Grounded Differential Surrogate Execution for Code Equivalence
papers.abstract_en: Determining whether two programs are functionally equivalent is central to code modernization, patch validation, refactoring, and code-generation evaluation. Yet the usual signals are incomplete: tests cover only finite inputs, textual similarity confuses implementation with behavior, and unconstrained LLM judgments are difficult to audit. Direct execution is often impossible when a program depends on an obsolete, licensed, unavailable, or unsafe environment. We introduce FEAgent, a selective equivalence assessor agent that combines typed program-graph evidence with differential surrogate execution. FEAgent first aligns public interfaces and behaviorally relevant graph anchors, then issues bounded queries over call-flow, control-flow, data-flow, type, import, and effect relations. Next, a branch-aware generator agent proposes discriminating inputs, and two blinded LLM surrogates independently predict source and target observables. Every claim and predicted divergence is recorded in an evidence ledger. A deterministic reconciler then returns EQUIVALENT, INEQUIVALENT, or UNCLEAR rather than forcing a verdict when paths are uncovered or evidence conflicts. We evaluate FEAgent on function-level equivalence and repository-level bug patches, where the existing oracle is a benchmark label or a passing test suite. Every disagreement with that oracle is adjudicated by direct execution, revealing errors in benchmark labels and behavioral divergences missed by unit-test-only scoring. On EquiBench, execution confirms FEAgent's disagreements with published labels on 216 of 1,200 evaluated pairs (18.0%); on SWE-bench Verified, 94 of 331 test-passing agent patches (28.4%) diverge from the reference patch. FEAgent thus serves as an audit layer between testing and formal verification, keeping its evidence reviewable and its uncertainty explicit without claiming a proof of equivalence.

TL;DR: FEAgent 用带类型的程序图证据加差分代理执行 (differential surrogate execution) 判定两段代码是否功能等价：先对齐接口与图锚点，再由分支感知生成器提出判别性输入、两个盲化 LLM 代理独立预测可观测值，最后由确定性 reconciler 输出 EQUIVALENT/INEQUIVALENT/UNCLEAR。在 EquiBench 上经直接执行确认其与已发布标签的分歧涉及 1,200 对中的 216 对（18.0%），SWE-bench Verified 上 331 个通过测试的补丁有 94 个（28.4%）与参考补丁行为分歧。
Motivation: 测试只覆盖有限输入，文本相似度混淆实现与行为，无约束的 LLM 判断难以审计；而程序依赖过时、受许可、不可得或不安全环境时往往无法直接执行，代码现代化、补丁验证与代码生成评测都缺少可审计的等价性判据。
Method: FEAgent 先对齐公共接口与行为相关的图锚点，再对调用流、控制流、数据流、类型、import 与 effect 关系发出有界查询；分支感知生成器提出判别性输入，两个盲化 LLM 代理独立预测源与目标的可观测值，所有主张与预测分歧记入 evidence ledger，由确定性 reconciler 在路径未覆盖或证据冲突时返回 UNCLEAR 而非强行判定。
Result: 在函数级等价与仓库级 bug patch 两个任务上，以基准标签或通过的测试套件为 oracle，凡分歧均由直接执行仲裁：EquiBench 上确认与已发布标签的分歧为 1,200 对中的 216 对（18.0%）；SWE-bench Verified 上 331 个测试通过的 agent patch 中有 94 个（28.4%）与参考补丁存在行为分歧。
Conclusion: FEAgent 定位为测试与形式验证之间的审计层，证据可复核、不确定性显式，且不声称给出等价性证明；直接执行仲裁同时暴露出基准标签错误和仅靠单元测试打分漏掉的行为分歧。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A multi-stage probabilistic framework to estimate gas-fired generator performance during extreme winter weather
papers.abstract_en: Extreme winter weather has repeatedly disrupted gas-fired power generation in the United States, yet the plant-level data needed to systematically quantify outage risk remain proprietary. Using publicly available weather and electricity demand data together with anonymized generator contingency records from the North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC), we develop a three-stage Bayesian probabilistic framework for estimating winter-driven generator performance. Applied to New York State (2013--2022), the framework sequentially estimates: the hourly probability of a generator contingency event, the expected net available capacity conditioned on an event occurring, and the event duration. Colder conditions and higher electricity demand are associated with higher failure probability, lower retained capacity, and longer event duration. Under the most severe observed stress conditions, estimated mean hourly event probability reaches 24\% , while expected mean net available capacity falls to 13\% of nameplate rating. Full outage events have a median duration of 12.7 hours, while partial derating event duration increases from 2.4 to 7.1 hours with capacity loss severity. The proposed framework establishes a transferable baseline that utilities with access to plant-level records can directly extend to obtain more precise reliability estimates for operational planning and resource adequacy assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用三阶段 Bayesian 概率框架从公开天气、电力需求与 NERC 匿名机组事故记录估计冬季燃气机组性能：在纽约州 2013–2022 年数据上，最严酷压力条件下小时事故概率均值达 24%，期望净可用容量降至铭牌容量的 13%；全停事故中位时长 12.7 小时，部分降出力时长随容量损失程度从 2.4 小时升到 7.1 小时。越冷、需求越高，故障概率越高、保留容量越低、事故持续越久。
Motivation: 极端冬季天气反复打断美国燃气发电，但量化停运风险所需的机组级数据是专有的，无法系统估计可靠性。
Method: 三阶段 Bayesian 框架，用公开天气与电力需求数据加 NERC 匿名机组事故记录，依次估计：发生机组事故的小时概率、发生事故条件下期望净可用容量、事故持续时长；应用于纽约州 2013–2022 年。
Result: 最严酷观测压力条件下估计的小时事故概率均值达 24%，期望净可用容量降至铭牌容量的 13%；全停事故中位时长 12.7 小时，部分降出力事故时长随容量损失严重度从 2.4 小时增至 7.1 小时；更冷与更高电力需求对应更高故障概率、更低保留容量、更长事故时长。
Conclusion: 该框架给出可迁移的基线，拥有机组级记录的电力公司可直接扩展以获得更精确的可靠性估计，用于运行规划与资源充裕度评估。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Human Behavior-Informed Crash Scenario Generation with Real-World Crash Priors for Autonomous Vehicle Safety Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable safety evaluation of autonomous vehicles (AVs) is essential to improving road safety, yet it depends critically on realistic simulation of rare crashes. Existing crash scenario generation methods can increase collision occurrence, but often fail to realistically reproduce how crashes evolve before impact or the distribution of crash types observed in the real world. Here, we present CrashSim, a human behavior-informed crash scenario generation framework that uses real-world crash priors to guide generative multi-agent traffic simulation for more reliable AV safety evaluation. These priors capture how real-world crashes evolve before impact and how different crash types are distributed, allowing limited crash data to guide realistic and scalable scenario generation across naturalistic driving contexts. We evaluate CrashSim against competing methods, showing that it more closely reproduces real-world pre-impact behavior, collision dynamics, collision geometry and crash-type distributions. We further use CrashSim to construct nuCrash dataset, containing over 4,000 crash and near-crash scenarios. Closed-loop evaluation of five AV planners shows that nuCrash more effectively exposes differences in planner safety capabilities than nuScenes. An LLM-assisted evaluation agent further analyzes planner failures to provide capability-level diagnoses and targeted improvement guidance. Together, CrashSim enables realistic and scalable crash generation for more informative AV safety evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CrashSim 用真实事故先验引导生成式多智能体交通仿真，复现撞击前行为与事故类型分布，据此构造含 4,000 余个碰撞/近碰撞场景的 nuCrash 数据集；闭环评测五个 AV 规划器，nuCrash 比 nuScenes 更能暴露规划器安全能力差异。
Motivation: 现有碰撞场景生成方法能提高碰撞发生率，却难以真实再现撞击前的演化过程，也对不上真实世界中事故类型的分布，导致稀有事故的 AV 安全评估不可靠。
Method: CrashSim 框架把真实事故先验（撞击前如何演化、各事故类型如何分布）注入生成式多智能体交通仿真，用有限事故数据引导跨自然驾驶场景的可扩展生成；再用生成结果构建 nuCrash 数据集，并以 LLM 辅助评估 agent 分析规划器失败、给出能力级诊断。
Result: 对比竞争方法，CrashSim 更贴近真实世界的撞击前行为、碰撞动力学、碰撞几何与事故类型分布；nuCrash 含超过 4,000 个碰撞与近碰撞场景，对五个 AV 规划器的闭环评估显示其比 nuScenes 更能暴露规划器安全能力差异。
Conclusion: 把真实事故先验接进生成式场景仿真，可以同时做到规模化与真实性，使 AV 安全评估比依赖 nuScenes 更有区分度；LLM 评估 agent 进一步把失败转成能力级诊断与改进方向。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: A Bird's-Eye View of Iterative Reward Design
papers.abstract_en: Designing effective reward functions in RL typically requires substantial expertise and trial and error. Recent work automates this process with LLM-based systems that generate and iteratively improve reward code using policy feedback. However, these methods are often hard to compare because they differ in implementation details, feedback assumptions, and evaluation environments. To address this, we introduce a Benchmark for Iterative Reward Design (BIRD) that expresses existing methods in a unified configuration and evaluation space. This lets us compare algorithms directly, ablate individual design choices, and prototype new components under matched feedback conditions and policy-training budgets. Across MuJoCo, Meta-World, Assistax, and HumanoidBench, we identify a small set of simple design choices that consistently improve performance. Combining these choices yields significantly better performance than the evaluated methods from prior work. Our results highlight the strength of simple baselines and motivate further study of when additional algorithmic complexity improves iterative reward design. Code is available at https://github.com/safety-research/bird.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 BIRD（Benchmark for Iterative Reward Design），把基于 LLM 的迭代式奖励代码生成方法统一到同一配置与评测空间，在匹配的反馈条件和策略训练预算下直接比较与消融。跨 MuJoCo、Meta-World、Assistax、HumanoidBench，少数几个简单设计选择一致提升性能，组合后显著优于先前工作中的已评估方法。
Motivation: LLM 自动生成并迭代改进奖励代码的近期方法在实现细节、反馈假设和评测环境上各不相同，导致彼此难以直接比较，也无法判断哪些设计选择真正起作用。
Method: BIRD 将已有迭代奖励设计方法表达为统一配置与评测空间，使算法可在匹配的反馈条件与策略训练预算下直接比较、逐项消融设计选择，并快速原型化新组件；实验覆盖 MuJoCo、Meta-World、Assistax、HumanoidBench 四个环境。
Result: 在 MuJoCo、Meta-World、Assistax、HumanoidBench 上识别出一小组简单设计选择能一致提升性能；将这些选择组合后，性能显著优于先前工作中被评估的方法。
Conclusion: 简单基线在迭代奖励设计中已相当强，额外算法复杂度是否值得应作为独立问题研究，而非默认假设复杂方法更好。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TRIM-ReID: Duplication-Aware Token Reduction and Modality-Aligned Interaction for Multi-Modal Object Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal object re-identification exploits complementary RGB, near-infrared (NIR), and thermal-infrared (TIR) observations to retrieve target objects. However, existing methods commonly employ visual encoders optimized for global image-text alignment and select tokens using learned importance scores. Such designs fail to preserve fine-grained identity cues or explicitly account for token redundancy, resulting in underrepresented local evidence and duplicated tokens that lead to noisy and costly cross-modal interaction. To address this gap, we propose TRIM-ReID, a compact framework that unifies dense feature extraction, intra-modal token reduction, and inter-modal aligned interaction. Specifically, semantically rich and spatially coherent patch features are extracted by Dense Identity Representation (DIR), which leverages DINOv3 to preserve fine-grained identity information. We then introduce Token Diversity Mining (TDM) to identify complementary local evidence and construct compact modality-specific token sets by suppressing repetitive patches while preserving informative diversity. Retained tokens are subsequently fused by Modal Relational Interaction (MRI) to enable effective information exchange across modalities, while a triangular alignment loss explicitly regularizes their joint relationships to maintain cross-modal semantic consistency under independent token selection. Extensive experiments on RGBNT201, RGBNT100, and MSVR310 demonstrate that TRIM-ReID achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRIM-ReID 用 DINOv3 抽取稠密身份特征 (DIR)，以 Token Diversity Mining (TDM) 压掉重复 patch、保留互补局部证据，再用 Modal Relational Interaction (MRI) 加三角对齐损失做跨模态交互，在 RGBNT201、RGBNT100、MSVR310 上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有方法用面向全局图文对齐的视觉编码器并按学习到的重要性分数选 token，既保不住细粒度身份线索，也不显式处理 token 冗余，导致局部证据欠表达、重复 token 让跨模态交互既嘈杂又昂贵。
Method: 三段式紧凑框架：Dense Identity Representation (DIR) 基于 DINOv3 提取语义丰富、空间连贯的 patch 特征；Token Diversity Mining (TDM) 抑制重复 patch、构建紧凑的模态内 token 集；Modal Relational Interaction (MRI) 融合保留的 token，并用三角对齐损失 (triangular alignment loss) 正则跨模态联合关系，以在独立选 token 下维持语义一致。
Result: 在 RGBNT201、RGBNT100、MSVR310 三个多模态 ReID 数据集上取得 state-of-the-performance。
Conclusion: 把去冗余的 token 约减与模态对齐的交互统一进一个紧凑框架，可在多模态目标重识别上同时保住细粒度身份线索并压低跨模态交互开销。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Checkable NTK Positivity and Finite-Width Gradient Descent for Scalar- and Vector-Valued PINNs with Strong-Form, Weak-Form, and Nonlocal Linear Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We give checkable positive-definiteness criteria for the limiting neural tangent kernel (NTK) and high-probability finite-width gradient-descent guarantees for scalar- or vector-valued physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) with linear constraints. The constraints may be strong-form differential rows of any fixed finite order, including coupled systems, with any linear initial or boundary conditions; weak-form residual and boundary functionals; or finite-measure nonlocal observations such as integral, nonlocal-diffusion, and Dirac-data rows, all in any dimension. For each class, positive definiteness of the limiting NTK is equivalent to a rank condition on a finite coefficient, functional, or moment matrix of the fixed design: a certificate computed before training that detects structural zero modes. The model hypotheses are those of an ordinary two-layer PINN, a smooth nonpolynomial activation with bounded symmetric initialization, and are met by standard choices such as $\tanh$ with uniform initialization. Given a certificate, explicit width and step-size conditions ensure, with high probability, that the empirical NTK retains at least half the limiting gap and that full-batch gradient descent decreases the training loss geometrically at every iteration. Controlled experiments check the certificates and the finite-width mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出标量与向量值 PINN 在强形式、弱形式及非局部线性约束下极限 NTK 正定性的可检验判据：正定性等价于固定设计的系数/泛函/矩矩阵的秩条件，可在训练前算出并检出结构性零模。在该证书成立且宽度与步长满足显式条件时，高概率下经验 NTK 保留至少一半极限间隙，全批量梯度下降每步几何下降训练损失。
Motivation: PINN 加线性约束后极限 NTK 是否正定缺少训练前可判定的条件，有限宽度下梯度下降的收敛保证也未与该判据衔接，结构性零模难以提前发现。
Method: 对强形式微分算子行（任意有限阶、含耦合系统）、线性初边值条件、弱形式残差与边界泛函、以及积分/非扩散/Dirac 数据等有限测度非局部行，分别把正定性化为有限系数、泛函或矩矩阵的秩条件；假设为普通两层 PINN、光滑非多项式激活与有界对称初始化（如 tanh 配均匀初始化），再由证书推出显式宽度与步长条件。
Result: 极限 NTK 正定当且仅当相应有限矩阵满秩，证书在训练前可算并检出结构零模；给定证书后，经验 NTK 以高概率保留至少一半极限间隙，全批量梯度下降每步几何下降训练损失；受控实验检验了证书与有限宽度机制。
Conclusion: 约束 PINN 的可训练性可由训练前的有限矩阵秩条件判定，且该条件足以支撑有限宽度下的几何收敛保证。

papers.title: SelectOccFlow: Selective Spatiotemporal Aggregation for 3D Occupancy and Scene Flow Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Comprehensive 3D scene understanding for autonomous driving requires modeling geometry, semantics, and motion. However, camera-based occupancy and scene flow prediction are sensitive to unreliable spatial and temporal aggregation, caused by semantically incompatible image features, misaligned historical observations, and incomplete voxel structures. To address this issue, we propose SelectOccFlow, a selective spatiotemporal aggregation framework that progressively refines contextual evidence across image, temporal, and voxel domains. To obtain semantically compatible image evidence, we design Semantic-Guided Sampling (SGS) to regulate feature sampling with semantic priors. Since reliable image evidence alone cannot resolve temporal inconsistency, we then present State-Conditioned Temporal Aggregation (SCTA) to selectively retrieve historical evidence according to voxel states. To further enhance the structural completeness of voxel representations, we introduce Extent-Aware Spatial Aggregation (ESA), which exploits directional structural support to refine foreground geometry. Experiments on OpenOcc demonstrate that SelectOccFlow achieves a state-of-the-art OccScore of 44.9, improving the previous best by +4.2%. It also maintains competitive occupancy performance on Occ3D-nus and improves the mean OccScore under nuScenes-C corruptions by +11.1%, demonstrating improved robustness to visual corruptions. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/muchen1021/SelectOccFlow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对自动驾驶相机 3D 占据与场景流预测中时空聚合不可靠的问题，提出 SelectOccFlow：用语义引导采样 (SGS) 约束图像特征采样、状态条件时序聚合 (SCTA) 按体素状态选择性检索历史证据、范围感知空间聚合 (ESA) 补全前景几何。在 OpenOcc 上取得 SOTA OccScore 44.9，较此前最佳提升 +4.2%，nuScenes-C 腐蚀下平均 OccScore 提升 +11.1%。
Motivation: 相机占据与场景流预测对不可靠的空间/时序聚合敏感：图像特征语义不兼容、历史观测错位、体素结构不完整，导致几何、语义与运动建模失效。
Method: 三模块渐进细化：Semantic-Guided Sampling (SGS) 用语义先验规制特征采样以获得语义兼容的图像证据；State-Conditioned Temporal Aggregation (SCTA) 依据体素状态选择性检索历史证据；Extent-Aware Spatial Aggregation (ESA) 利用方向性结构支持精化前景几何。
Result: OpenOcc 上 OccScore 44.9，为 SOTA，较此前最佳 +4.2%；Occ3D-nus 上占据性能保持竞争力；nuScenes-C 腐蚀下平均 OccScore +11.1%。
Conclusion: 在图像、时序、体素三个域上做选择性聚合能同时提升占据预测精度与对视觉腐蚀的鲁棒性；代码将开源。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: LoCoSplat: Real-Time Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Minimal 3D Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) increasingly aggregates multi-view evidence with heavy learned 3D networks. We propose LoCoSplat (Local-Context Splatting), motivated by the observation that a Gaussian is a local primitive: once depth is predicted, what the 3D stage must add (scale, rotation, opacity) depends on the point cloud around each anchor, and a fixed local average of that neighbourhood is enough to supply it, no heavy network required. LoCoSplat realises exactly this average: it splats a 16-d linear projection of the point features into a fine and a coarse grid and reads both back at each anchor with a 0.14M-parameter pointwise MLP; with no learned 3D network and no dynamic sparse computation, its whole encoder runs as one fp16 CUDA graph. On RealEstate10K, LoCoSplat outperforms every prior feed-forward method on PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS at 6, 12, and 24 views, with a margin that widens as views densify (+3.3 PSNR over VolSplat, the prior voxel-aligned state of the art, at 24 views) and grows further under zero-shot transfer to ACID and fine-tuning on ScanNet. It reconstructs a 6-view scene in 33 ms on one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU, the fastest of seven feed-forward methods and $4.2\times$ faster than the previous state of the art, trains $2.7\times$ faster ($5.9\times$ at 24 views), and uses $6.7\times$ less inference memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoCoSplat 把 feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting 中的重型 3D 网络换成固定局部平均：把点特征的 16 维线性投影 splat 到细、粗两层网格，再用 0.14M 参数的 pointwise MLP 在每个 anchor 处读回，整个编码器作为一个 fp16 CUDA graph 运行。在 RealEstate10K 的 6/12/24 视角上 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 全面超过此前所有 feed-forward 方法，24 视角时比 VolSplat 高 3.3 PSNR，且视角越密优势越大。
Motivation: feed-forward 3DGS 目前靠重型学习式 3D 网络聚合多视角证据，计算与显存开销大；而 Gaussian 本身是局部基元，其 scale、rotation、opacity 只取决于 anchor 周围点云，重型网络是多余的。
Method: 预测深度后，将点特征的 16 维线性投影 splat 到 fine 与 coarse 两层网格，再在每个 anchor 处读回，等价于邻域的固定局部平均；由 0.14M 参数的 pointwise MLP 补全 scale、rotation、opacity。不使用任何学习式 3D 网络与动态稀疏计算，整个编码器以单个 fp16 CUDA graph 执行。
Result: 在 RealEstate10K 上，6、12、24 视角的 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 均超过此前全部 feed-forward 方法，24 视角较 VolSplat 高 3.3 PSNR，优势随视角加密而扩大；零样本迁移到 ACID 以及在 ScanNet 上微调后差距进一步拉大。单张 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 上重建 6 视角场景耗时 33 ms，为七种 feed-forward 方法中最快，比此前 SOTA 快 4.2 倍，训练快 2.7 倍（24 视角下 5.9 倍），推理显存低 6.7 倍。
Conclusion: 3D 阶段所需的额外信息本质上是 anchor 邻域的固定局部平均，用轻量网格读回加 pointwise MLP 即可替代重型 3D 网络，同时拿到更好的视角扩展性与大幅更低的延迟和显存。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Any-scale Object Detection using Arbitrary-scaled Images
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes any-scale object detection using arbitrary-scale super-resolution for continuously rescaling object images, while general multi-scale object detection uses discretely rescaled appearance representations. However, a naive usage of super-resolution produces many false-positive detections if many super-resolution images are independently fed into an object detector. Our method suppresses these false positives by predicting scale proposal maps, each of which represents a set of pixels appropriate for each super-resolution scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用任意尺度超分辨率 (arbitrary-scale super-resolution) 连续重缩放目标图像来做任意尺度目标检测，替代通用多尺度检测的离散尺度表示。朴素地把多张超分图独立送入检测器会引入大量误检，该方法用尺度 proposal map（每张对应一个超分尺度、标出适合该尺度的像素集合）来抑制这些 false positive。
Motivation: 通用多尺度目标检测只用离散重缩放的外观表示，尺度覆盖不连续；而朴素叠加多张超分图会带来大量误检。
Method: 以任意尺度超分辨率对目标图像做连续重缩放，并预测一组 scale proposal map，每张表示对应超分尺度下适合检测的像素集合，以此过滤误检。
Result: 提出该任意尺度检测框架与尺度 proposal map 抑制机制；摘要未给出数据集、指标或与基线的数值对比。
Conclusion: 连续尺度的超分外观表示配合逐尺度的像素级 proposal 约束，可以替代离散多尺度表示并抑制超分引入的误检。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: System One Models for Wireless Decision-Making:Applications and Performance Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Many wireless control tasks require repeated selection of a single action from a finite feasible set under stringent latency and reliability constraints. While large language models (LLMs) have recently emerged as general-purpose decision engines, their autoregressive generation mechanism is not naturally aligned with such bounded control problems. This paper investigates System-One models, which directly learn probability distributions over explicitly defined decision spaces, as a lightweight alternative for wireless decision-making. We formalize their decision structure and learning objective, identify their applicability across physical-layer control, radio resource management, mobility, network slicing, and network operations, and evaluate their practical behavior through representative wireless case studies. Using Jev as a System-One implementation, we benchmark decision quality and client-observed latency against generative LLMs and conventional baselines. In receive-antenna selection, Jev delivers up to an 8.5x reduction in median response latency relative to the evaluated LLMs, although this gain comes with a loss in decision quality compared with stronger task-specific alternatives. More notably, in intent-conditioned RAN slicing, Jev achieves utility comparable to the evaluated LLMs while providing more than a 3.5x reduction in median response latency. Complementary evidence from edge-service orchestration further shows that faster decisions do not necessarily translate into lower end-to-end service latency. These results expose a fundamental quality/latency tradeoff and position System-One models not as replacements for numerical optimization, but as a promising decision interface for latency-sensitive, bounded, and intent-driven wireless control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 System-One 模型：直接在显式定义的有限决策空间上学概率分布，作为 LLM 自回归生成的轻量替代，用于时延受限的无线控制。以 Jev 实现并在接收天线选择与意图条件 RAN 切片上评测：天线选择中位响应时延相对被测 LLM 最多降 8.5 倍但决策质量弱于更强的任务专用方法；RAN 切片效用与被测 LLM 相当而中位时延降 3.5 倍以上。作者主张 System-One 不替代数值优化，而是时延敏感、有界、意图驱动控制的决策接口。
Motivation: 无线控制需在严格时延与可靠性约束下反复从有限可行集里选一个动作，而 LLM 的自回归生成机制与这类有界控制问题并不匹配。
Method: 形式化 System-One 的决策结构与学习目标，梳理其在物理层控制、无线资源管理、移动性、网络切片与网络运营的适用面；用 Jev 作为 System-One 实现，在代表性无线案例上把决策质量与客户端观测时延同生成式 LLM 及常规基线对比。
Result: 接收天线选择中，Jev 相对被测 LLM 的中位响应时延最多降低 8.5 倍，但决策质量相比更强的任务专用方法有损失；意图条件 RAN 切片中 Jev 效用与被测 LLM 相当，中位响应时延降低 3.5 倍以上；边缘服务编排的补充证据显示更快的决策不必然带来更低的端到端服务时延。
Conclusion: System-One 模型体现根本的质量/时延权衡，定位不是数值优化的替代品，而是时延敏感、有界、意图驱动无线控制的决策接口。
Relevance: 1
