summary_sections.conclusion: System-One 模型体现根本的质量/时延权衡，定位不是数值优化的替代品，而是时延敏感、有界、意图驱动无线控制的决策接口。

papers.title: Hierarchical Credit Assignment for RLVR on Fused Gromov-Wasserstein Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been shown to improve the reasoning capability of large language models (LLMs) across diverse reasoning tasks. However, group-based RLVR methods, such as GRPO, assign a uniform advantage to all tokens within rollouts of the same outcome. While existing works refine credit assignment of GRPO based on local signals such as token locations or entropy, they often fail to capture the global semantic novelty of a reasoning behavior relative to the current policy. In this work, we propose a hierarchical credit assignment approach for group-based RLVR methods, called HarA, which identifies and encourages semantically novel reasoning behaviors during RLVR. HarA represents each sampled rollout as a distribution over the hidden states and locations of tokens, and computes the Fused Gromov-Wasserstein (FGW) barycenters of all rollouts with the same outcome, capturing the internal reasoning patterns in the latent space under the current policy. The semantic novelty of a reasoning element can then be measured by its contribution to the FGW distance between the current rollout and the barycenter. While solving the FGW formulation is expensive, we introduce an anchor-guided linearization that turns it into a Wasserstein formulation solvable via the Sinkhorn algorithm efficiently. By reweighing token-level advantage of group-based RLVR methods based on the novelty signals, HarA highlights novel reasoning behaviors at flexible granularities to encourage fine-grained LLM exploration. Extensive experiments across three group-based RLVR methods show that our plug-and-play method effectively enhances the exploration of LLMs, outperforming existing methods across diverse reasoning benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HarA：把每条 rollout 表示为 token 隐状态与位置的分布，用 Fused Gromov-Wasserstein (FGW) 重心刻画同结果组内的推理模式，以 rollout 到重心的 FGW 距离贡献度度量语义新颖性，再据此重加权 GRPO 类方法的 token 级 advantage。锚点引导线性化把 FGW 化为可用 Sinkhorn 高效求解的 Wasserstein 形式，在三种 group-based RLVR 方法上作为即插即用模块提升 LLM 探索并在多个推理基准上超过已有方法。
Motivation: GRPO 类 group-based RLVR 对同一结果的 rollout 内所有 token 赋相同 advantage，基于 token 位置或熵等局部信号的改进无法刻画推理行为相对当前策略的全局语义新颖性，细粒度 credit assignment 缺失。
Method: HarA 将每条 rollout 建模为 token 隐状态与位置上的分布，对结果相同的 rollout 组求 FGW barycenter；新颖性由该 rollout 对与重心之间 FGW 距离的贡献度量。为降低 FGW 求解开销，引入 anchor-guided linearization 将其转为 Wasserstein 形式并用 Sinkhorn 算法求解，再按新颖性信号重加权 token 级 advantage，支持灵活粒度。
Result: 在三种 group-based RLVR 方法上做实验，HarA 作为即插即用模块增强 LLM 探索，在多种推理基准上超过已有 credit assignment 方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 以全局语义新颖性（FGW 几何）替代位置、熵等局部信号做 token 级 credit assignment，可在不改动底层 RLVR 算法的前提下提升组内 RLVR 的探索效果与推理表现。

papers.title: A KKL Observer Perspective on Reservoir Computing
papers.abstract_en: Reservoir computing (RC) is a machine learning technique for data-driven modeling of dynamics for forecasting and control, primarily studied in computer science and physics literature with promising applications in neural network learning, physical computing, and neuroscience. Why reservoirs learn and how to choose good reservoir architectures are considered important open questions. We show that the RC problem is mathematically an extension of a classic problem in systems and control theory, the Kazantzis-Kravaris-Luenberger (KKL) observer design problem. As a consequence, many of the questions considered open for RC stand to benefit from a large body of theory in the mature KKL literature, non-exhaustively including on questions of embedding, transverse stability, local and global uniqueness guarantees, and effective data-driven solution constructions. Elaborating on this connection, we show that the surprising forecasting ability of reservoirs is in fact a direct consequence of the well-known observer internal model principle, derive an upper bound on the prediction error over a fixed forecast horizon, and provide a partial explanation for why linear readout training in RC works reasonably well. This work illustrates how classical ideas from systems and control can provide strong theoretical backing and open new questions for modern machine learning methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 reservoir computing (RC) 重述为经典 Kazantzis-Kravaris-Luenberger (KKL) 观测器设计问题的推广，从而把 embedding、transverse stability、局部与全局唯一性保证等成熟控制理论结果接到 RC 上。作者据此用观测器内模原理解释 reservoir 的预测能力，并给出固定预报时域上的预测误差上界，以及线性 readout 训练为何大致有效的部分解释。
Motivation: RC 为何能学习、如何选择好的 reservoir 架构，长期是开放问题；现有讨论主要散落在计算机科学与物理文献中，缺少统一的理论框架。
Method: 将 RC 问题形式化为 KKL 观测器设计问题的数学推广，借用 KKL 文献中的 embedding、transverse stability、局部/全局唯一性与数据驱动构造理论；在此框架下用观测器内模原理解释预测能力，并推导固定预报时域上的预测误差上界。
Result: 给出三项理论结果：reservoir 的预测能力是观测器内模原理的直接推论；固定预报时域上预测误差存在一个上界；对 RC 中线性 readout 训练为何表现合理给出部分解释。
Conclusion: RC 的学习与架构选择问题可映射为 KKL 观测器设计问题，因而可直接继承系统与控制领域的成熟理论，同时为现代机器学习方法打开新的研究问题。

papers.title: Asynchronous Tracking, Optical Communication and 3D Motion Capture using Event-based Sensors
papers.abstract_en: Inter-robot communication is a key enabling technology in cooperative robotics applications. While wireless communication is ubiquitous, simple, and effective, it has inherent limitations: the receiving robot cannot easily localise the source of an incoming signal, clock synchronisation is challenging, and signals are broadcast to all nearby devices rather than targeted recipients. Optical communication provides a complementary channel that is inherently directional and spatially localised, directly addressing these limitations. Event cameras are bio-inspired dynamic vision sensors that respond to changes in image intensity with high temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and low latency, making them well-suited as receivers for high-rate optical communication in cooperative robotic systems. In this paper, we propose the Asynchronous Tracking and Optical Communication (ATOC) system, which integrates LED smart-beacon modulation, event-based detection, optical tracking, and event-data demodulation in a single pipeline. By simultaneously tracking and demodulating multiple LED smart beacons, ATOC transforms a conventional visual marker into a robust communication channel suitable for a wide range of high-impact robotics applications. We validate ATOC in a suite of laboratory studies and two 'applications': a smart-city demonstration and a 3D motion-capture system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ATOC（Asynchronous Tracking and Optical Communication）系统，把 LED smart-beacon 调制、event camera 检测、光学跟踪与事件数据解调整合进单一管线，使机器人在跟踪多个 LED 信标的同时完成解调，把普通视觉标记变成定向、可定位的光通信信道。系统在一组实验室研究与两个应用（智慧城市演示、3D 运动捕捉）中得到验证。
Motivation: 无线通信虽普及但接收端难以定位信号源、时钟同步困难、信号只能广播给附近所有设备；需要一条天然定向且空间局域化的补充信道来支撑协作机器人。
Method: ATOC 管线以 event camera 作为接收器，利用其高时间分辨率、高动态范围与低延迟特性，同时对多个 LED smart beacon 做光学跟踪与事件数据解调，将调制、检测、跟踪、解调合为一条异步流程。
Result: 在一组实验室研究以及两个应用案例——智慧城市演示与 3D 运动捕捉系统——中验证了 ATOC，可同时跟踪并解调多个 LED smart beacon。
Conclusion: event camera 作为光通信接收器，能把常规视觉标记改造成鲁棒的定向通信信道，适用于广泛的高价值机器人应用。

papers.title: ShadowMiner v1 - An Experience Report on Implementing and Measuring a Problem-and-Hypothesis Discovery Engine
papers.abstract_en: ShadowMiner v1 is a system that automatically discovers research problems and generates hypotheses from AI papers. It is a nine-stage pipeline. It structures documents into a knowledge graph and finds graph gaps in it - structural blind spots in research. These graph gaps are included in the LLM generation prompt. Each generated hypothesis is then verified by checking whether it is already covered by existing research, scoring its quality, and checking that the facts it relies on are accurately drawn from its sources. This report does not propose a new generation or evaluation technique. It describes our experience of implementing and applying ideas from prior work, and measuring whether each one actually contributed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ShadowMiner v1 是一个九阶段流水线，把 AI 论文构建成知识图谱并从中找出图谱空缺 (graph gaps)，把空缺写进 LLM 提示词来生成研究问题与假设，再对每条假设做三重检查：是否已被现有研究覆盖、质量打分、以及其依赖事实是否准确取自来源。该报告定位为实现与测量的经验报告，逐一衡量既有想法各自是否真正产生贡献，而非提出新的生成或评估技术。
Motivation: 自动发现研究问题的系统难以说清各环节到底哪一步起了作用，作者要解决的正是把既有想法拆开并逐项测量其实际贡献。
Method: 九阶段流水线：文档结构化为知识图谱，检测图谱空缺作为研究盲区，将空缺注入 LLM 生成提示；生成的假设依次经过已覆盖性检查、质量打分、事实溯源准确性核查三步验证。
Result: 报告给出系统的实现与应用过程，并对每个借鉴的想法测量其是否实际贡献；摘要中的量化结果为九阶段流水线这一结构描述。
Conclusion: 既有生成与评估想法可以被组装成可用的问题-假设发现引擎，且其贡献应当逐项实测而非默认成立；作者明确本报告不提出新的生成或评估技术。

papers.title: S$^3$N: A Spherical Spiral Scanning Network for Weather Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning-based weather prediction (MLWP) has achieved strong performance in global weather forecasting. Recent Hierarchical Equal Area isoLatitude Pixelation (HEALPix)-based methods use the HEALPix (HP) grid to avoid area distortion near the poles of conventional latitude-longitude (LL) grids. However, existing HP-based approaches often use pointwise mapping methods and process HP pixels within separate base faces or local windows. Consequently, the mapping may introduce reconstruction errors and cross-face communication depends on handcrafted boundary handling or shifted windows. We propose the Spherical Spiral Scanning Network (S$^3$N) to address both limitations. First, L2Proj provides a bidirectional method for mapping atmospheric fields between the LL and HP grids through an $L^2$ projection of their continuous finite-element representations. Second, the Attention-Guided Quad-Spiral State-Space Scanning (AQSS) block uses cross-latitude attention to guide selective state-space updates along four global pole-to-pole spiral paths. This design enables continuous information propagation across HP base-face boundaries without additional boundary-processing mechanisms. Experiments show that S$^3$N achieves better results at 4-, 7-, and 10-day lead times, and exhibits slower error growth in long-range forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: S³N 用 L2Proj 的有限元 L² 投影在经纬网格与 HEALPix 网格间双向映射大气场，再用注意力引导的四螺旋状态空间扫描 (AQSS) 沿四条极到极螺旋路径传播信息，从而绕开 HEALPix 基面边界处理。实验显示其在 4、7、10 天预报时效上取得更好结果，长程预报误差增长更慢。
Motivation: HEALPix 网格虽避免了经纬网格极区面积畸变，但现有方法用逐点映射且在基面或局部窗口内处理像素，重建有误差，跨面通信依赖手工边界处理或移位窗口。
Method: L2Proj 通过对连续有限元表示做 L² 投影实现 LL 与 HP 网格间双向映射；AQSS 块用跨纬度注意力 (cross-latitude attention) 引导选择性状态空间 (state-space) 更新，沿四条全球极到极螺旋路径扫描，无需额外边界处理机制。
Result: 实验中 S³N 在 4 天、7 天、10 天预报时效上均取得更好结果，并在长程预报中表现出更慢的误差增长。
Conclusion: 把网格映射做成连续投影、把跨面通信做成螺旋路径上的状态空间扫描，可以同时消除 HEALPix 的重建误差与手工边界处理，并改善中长期全球天气预报。

papers.title: FLAT: Smoothing the Rugged Landscape for Learnable, Sample-Efficient Traffic Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Calibrating microscopic traffic models for digital twins is an expensive black-box optimization problem: tuning car-following and lane-changing parameters requires a full simulation run, affording only a tight budget per recalibration window. Matching raw trajectories yields a rugged objective that sparse surrogates cannot learn, reducing sequential acquisition to near-random probing. We present FLAT, which couples what to optimize with where to sample next. An eight-dimensional behavioral fingerprint smooths the parameter-error landscape, making the objective learnable from a few dozen samples; annealed lower-confidence-bound (LCB) acquisition then spends each remaining run where it most reduces error. The surrogate, interchangeable among a Gaussian process (GP), random forest (RF), or multi-layer-perceptron (MLP) ensemble, plugs into the same LCB loop. Across six heterogeneous real-world scenes, FLAT-GP achieves the lowest scene-averaged behavioral error, winning 6/6 scenes against SPSA, GA, and CMA-ES and 5/6 against TPE under the matched budget. Some baselines need up to 4.4 times more simulations to match. Ablations show objective choice shifts final behavioral error by 81% on average, removing sequential LCB raises the six-scene mean by 20%, and surrogate choice shifts it by at most 4.2%, confirming gains trace to objective geometry and sequential allocation rather than surrogate capacity.

Motivation: 微观交通模型标定是昂贵的黑箱优化：每次调跟驰与换道参数都要跑完整仿真，每个重标定窗口预算极紧；直接匹配原始轨迹得到崎岖目标，稀疏代理学不动，序列采集退化为近乎随机试探。
Method: FLAT 把「优化什么」与「在哪采样」耦合：用八维行为指纹平滑参数-误差景观，代理可换用 Gaussian process、random forest 或 MLP ensemble，统一接入退火 lower-confidence-bound (LCB) 序列采集循环，按最能降低误差的位置分配剩余仿真。
Result: 在六个异构真实场景、匹配预算下，FLAT-GP 取得最低的场景平均行为误差，对 SPSA、GA、CMA-ES 6/6 场景获胜，对 TPE 5/6 获胜；部分基线最多需要 4.4 倍仿真才能追平。消融显示目标函数选择平均改变最终行为误差 81%，去掉序列 LCB 使六场景均值上升 20%，代理选择差异至多 4.2%。

papers.title: A differentiable Lagrangian-coupled 3D Gaussian Splatting-SPH model for forward simulation and inverse analysis in solid mechanics
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative world models have increased interest in digital models that reproduce both the appearance of real objects and their response to physical interaction. Three-dimensional reconstruction techniques, including 3D Gaussian Splatting, capture detailed surface geometry and appearance from images and videos. However, extending these representations beyond plausible animation to mechanically interpretable models for constitutive behavior, boundary conditions, and inverse parameter identification remains less explored. In this work, a differentiable Lagrangian-coupled 3DGS-smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH) model is proposed for forward simulation and inverse analysis of deformable solids. The observed object is first reconstructed from multi-view calibrated visual dataset as a 3DGS rendering model. An envelope-based procedure then generates an independent SPH support for the solid-mechanics model, avoiding the direct use of rendering primitives as mechanical particles. A reference-configuration Lagrangian transfer maps SPH deformation to Gaussian positions and covariances, thereby coupling the physical model and the image observation model while preserving a differentiable computational path. The SPH formulation supports linear elastic, hyperelastic, and Kelvin--Voigt viscoelastic responses, together with fixed, free, and Robin-type boundary conditions. Numerical studies validate the SPH response against finite-element results, assess accuracy and efficiency against a conventional model using Gaussian centers as surface SPH particles, and demonstrate forward simulations on beam, bridge, and liver-shaped examples. Inverse analyses further estimate constitutive and boundary parameters from rendered deformation observations, including noisy cases, demonstrating the feasibility of the proposed model for mechanics-based parameter identification from image data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可微的 Lagrangian 耦合 3D Gaussian Splatting-SPH 模型，把可变形固体的物理仿真与图像观测模型打通，用于正向仿真和基于图像的本构/边界参数反演。SPH 支持线弹性、超弹性和 Kelvin--Voigt 粘弹性及 fixed/free/Robin 边界条件，数值研究对照有限元验证响应，并在含噪渲染变形观测上完成参数识别。
Motivation: 3DGS 等重建技术能还原外观与几何，但要跨过“合理动画”走到可解释本构行为、边界条件和逆参数辨识的力学模型，仍缺少把物理模型与图像观测可微耦合的途径。
Method: 先用多视角标定视觉数据重建 3DGS 渲染模型，再用 envelope-based 流程生成独立的 SPH 支撑（不直接把渲染基元当力学粒子）；通过参考构型的 Lagrangian transfer 把 SPH 变形映射到 Gaussian 位置与协方差，保持可微计算路径。SPH 覆盖线弹性、超弹性和 Kelvin--Voigt 粘弹性，以及 fixed、free、Robin 边界条件。
Result: 数值研究将 SPH 响应与有限元结果对照验证，并与“用 Gaussian 中心作为表面 SPH 粒子”的常规模型比较精度与效率；在 beam、bridge、liver-shaped 例子上做正向仿真，并从渲染变形观测（含含噪情形）反演本构与边界参数。
Conclusion: 把 SPH 力学模型与 3DGS 观测模型通过可微 Lagrangian 耦合后，可以从图像数据做基于力学的参数辨识，且无需把渲染基元直接当力学粒子。

papers.title: Synthetic-to-Real ViT-Based Pose Estimation of a Noncooperative UAV
papers.abstract_en: Remote pose estimation of noncooperative Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) from imagery is critical, as they cannot be influenced or instrumented in advance. Deep-learning-based approaches offer a promising solution; however, their development is constrained by the cost and difficulty of acquiring large-scale real-world datasets with accurate pose labels. Synthetic imagery provides an alternative, but models trained on synthetic data must overcome the synthetic-to-real domain gap to generalize to real-world imagery. This work investigates the inherent synthetic-to-real generalization capability of a Vision Transformer (ViT)-based model for monocular UAV pose estimation. The proposed approach employs a self-supervised DINOv2 backbone and is trained exclusively on labeled synthetic imagery while being evaluated on labeled real-world imagery. Pose ambiguity-aware strategies are incorporated during training and inference to address ambiguities arising from the projection of a three-dimensional target onto a two-dimensional image plane and from target symmetries. An $α$-$β$ filter is further integrated during inference to improve pose estimations. To assess the model under operational requirements, it is evaluated in terms of Mean Angular Error (MAE) and inference time, both before and after filtering, using a real-world dataset containing 77,077 labeled UAV images. Before filtering, the model achieves an MAE of $19.18^{\circ}$ and an inference time of $13.25$ ms, whereas after filtering, these values are $8.74^{\circ}$ and $13.42$ ms, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用自监督 DINOv2 主干的 ViT 做单目非合作 UAV 姿态估计，只在合成图像上训练、直接在真实图像上测试，并在训练与推理中加入姿态歧义感知策略。推理阶段再串一个 α-β 滤波器，把真实数据集（77,077 张标注 UAV 图像）上的平均角误差 (MAE) 从 19.18° 压到 8.74°，推理时间仅从 13.25 ms 升到 13.42 ms。
Motivation: 非合作 UAV 无法预先加装设备或配合标定，真实姿态标注数据集昂贵难采；纯合成数据训练的模型又受 synthetic-to-real domain gap 制约，难以直接迁移到真实图像。
Method: 以自监督 DINOv2 为 ViT 主干，仅用带标注的合成图像训练、在带标注真实图像上评测；训练与推理均加入姿态歧义感知策略，处理 3D 目标投影到 2D 平面及目标对称性带来的歧义；推理时额外接入 α-β 滤波器。
Result: 在含 77,077 张标注 UAV 图像的真实数据集上，滤波前 MAE 19.18°、推理时间 13.25 ms；滤波后 MAE 8.74°、推理时间 13.42 ms。
Conclusion: 合成数据加 DINOv2 主干与歧义感知策略可实现可用的 synthetic-to-real 单目姿态估计，α-β 滤波在几乎不增加推理时间的前提下把角误差降低逾一半。

papers.title: Suppressing Pressure, Amplifying Evidence: Self-Guided Attention Steering to Mitigate Sycophancy and Stubbornness
papers.abstract_en: Reliable language models should resist unsupported user pressure while effectively using objective contextual information. However, models may exhibit sycophancy by yielding to unsupported user pressure or contextual stubbornness by failing to update their answers when relevant contextual information warrants revision. Evaluating interventions for these failures separately can obscure whether mitigating one failure exacerbates the other. To assess this trade-off, we introduce CoPE-Bench with six conditions per question: a neutral baseline, correct or incorrect user pressure, contextual information consistent with or conflicting with the neutral answer, and a joint condition combining incorrect claims with conflicting contextual information. To regulate the influence of user pressure and contextual information, we propose SPAE (Suppressing Pressure, Amplifying Evidence), a training-free framework that uses the model's own judgments to identify relevant tokens, suppressing user pressure and amplifying contextual information through token-level attention steering. On average across five backbones, SPAE reduces pressure following by 18.8 percentage points and increases joint-condition updating by 5.5 percentage points relative to the strongest baseline in the main comparison. In two-turn dialogue, it improves joint-condition updating by an average of 13.2 percentage points over the strongest prompting baseline. The source data and codes can be found at https://github.com/03Grant/sycophancy-and-stubbornness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练框架 SPAE，用模型自身判断定位相关 token，在注意力层面抑制无依据的用户压力、放大客观上下文证据，以同时缓解谄媚 (sycophancy) 与情境固执 (contextual stubbornness)。在 CoPE-Bench 上相对最强基线，五个 backbone 平均把压力跟随降低 18.8 个百分点、联合条件下的答案更新提高 5.5 个百分点；两轮对话中更新再提高 13.2 个百分点。
Motivation: 谄媚与固执是两种相反的失效：前者屈服于无依据压力，后者拒绝按相关上下文改答；分开评测会掩盖抑制一种失效是否加剧另一种，需要能同时权衡两者的评测与干预。
Method: 构建 CoPE-Bench，每题六种条件：中性基线、正确或错误的用户压力、与中性答案一致或冲突的上下文、以及错误主张加冲突上下文的联合条件。提出免训练的 SPAE，用模型自身判断识别相关 token，通过 token 级注意力操控 (attention steering) 抑制用户压力、放大上下文信息。
Result: 在五个 backbone 上平均，相对主对比中最强基线，压力跟随下降 18.8 个百分点，联合条件下的答案更新提高 5.5 个百分点；两轮对话设定中，相对最强 prompting 基线联合条件更新平均提高 13.2 个百分点。
Conclusion: 谄媚与固执可以在同一干预下同时缓解而非此消彼长，用模型自身判断做 token 级注意力操控是一条免训练的实现路径。

papers.title: Bidirectional Preference Synthesis: Learning Prompt-Conditioned Preferences from Boundary Failures
papers.abstract_en: Correction-based offline preference pipelines commonly treat model failures only as rejected responses under the original prompt. This supervision is incomplete for boundary failures: responses that violate the given instruction yet coherently satisfy a nearby intent or constraint setting. We introduce Bidirectional Preference Synthesis (BPS), a data-construction method for standard Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) that makes this missing prompt dependence explicit. For each validated boundary failure, BPS keeps the conventional forward pair under the original prompt and adds a reverse pair under a synthesized achieved prompt, so the same response is rejected where it is wrong and chosen where it is right, without changing the DPO objective, training a reward model, or requiring online sampling. On Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, BPS preserves original-side pairwise ranking while raising achieved-side ranking accuracy from 6.8% to 62.3% on held-out crossed anchors, with a similar shift under a Kimi-K2.6 cross-teacher probe. A blind human audit supports the intended reverse preference direction, and downstream evaluations show the clearest separation from Forward-DPO in multilingual multi-turn instruction following, with consistent capability-retention patterns on agentic, tool-use, and code checks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BPS 把边界失败（违反原指令却恰好满足邻近意图的回复）同时构造成原 prompt 下的 rejected 对与合成 achieved prompt 下的 chosen 对，直接喂给标准 DPO 而不改目标函数、不训 reward model、不做在线采样。在 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 上，held-out crossed anchors 的 achieved-side 排序准确率从 6.8% 升到 62.3%，原侧排序保持不变。
Motivation: 基于纠错的离线偏好流水线只把模型失败当作原 prompt 下的 rejected，监督信号不完整：边界失败回复在邻近意图下其实是对的，这部分 prompt 依赖被丢掉了。
Method: 对每个经验证的边界失败，BPS 保留原 prompt 下的 forward pair，并用合成的 achieved prompt 追加 reverse pair，使同一回复在错处被拒、在对处被选；训练沿用标准 DPO 目标，不训 reward model、不需在线采样。
Result: 在 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 上，held-out crossed anchors 的 achieved-side 排序准确率由 6.8% 升至 62.3%，同时保持 original-side 成对排序；Kimi-K2.6 cross-teacher probe 上出现相似偏移。盲评人工审核支持反向偏好方向，下游评测中与 Forward-DPO 区分最明显的是多语种多轮指令跟随，agentic、tool-use、code 检查上能力保持一致。
Conclusion: 把边界失败按 prompt 依赖双向构造成偏好对，可以在不改 DPO 目标的前提下补上缺失的正向监督，最受益的是多语种多轮指令跟随。

summary_sections.result: 在 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 上，held-out crossed anchors 的 achieved-side 排序准确率由 6.8% 升至 62.3%，同时保持 original-side 成对排序；Kimi-K2.6 cross-teacher probe 上出现相似偏移。盲评人工审核支持反向偏好方向，下游评测中与 Forward-DPO 区分最明显的是多语种多轮指令跟随，agentic、tool-use、code 检查上能力保持一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把边界失败按 prompt 依赖双向构造成偏好对，可以在不改 DPO 目标的前提下补上缺失的正向监督，最受益的是多语种多轮指令跟随。

papers.title: Trust the View That Sees the Target: Mining Cross-View Conflicts for Reliability-Gated Disaster Damage Assessment
papers.abstract_en: After a disaster, building damage is assessed from overhead tiles and ground-level photographs, and most methods fuse the two views symmetrically, trusting both equally for every building. This paper focuses on the samples where that assumption fails: the conflict cases, on which two independently trained single-view models disagree. We mine such cases from three paired collections (inspection photographs from the 2025 Eaton wildfire and street-view panoramas from Hurricanes Ian and Milton, each matched to very-high-resolution overhead tiles), where they make up 10-33% of the data. On these samples an oracle that simply trusts the correct view beats every fusion method we tested by 0.37-0.41 accuracy, and the gap survives longer training, calibration, and backbone changes. We recover part of it with a visibility-conditioned reliability gate: a linear model that decides which view to trust from building-visibility features, calibrated per-view confidences, and the disagreement itself. On the wildfire data the gate is the only method that significantly beats calibrated probability averaging (+0.051 on conflicts, p=0.0001) and end-to-end fusion (+0.072, p<10^-4); on the panoramic datasets it matches them. A controlled field-of-view experiment explains why: cropping panoramas toward the building doubles the benefit of fusion, whereas random crops of the same size do not. Finally, the spatial density of conflicts predicts tile-level damage without labels (Spearman r=0.615, p=0.001). Mining conflicts turns "does fusion help?" into "which view should be trusted, where, and why?".
papers.comment: 4 pages, 3 figures; Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 5th ACM SIGSPATIAL International Workshop on Searching and Mining Large Collections of Geospatial Data (GeoSearch '26), held November 3-6, 2026, in Riverside, California, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 灾后建筑损毁评估中对空-地两视图做对称融合在冲突样本上失效：这类样本（两个单视图模型判断不一致）占三组配对数据的 10-33%，只信对的那个视图的 oracle 比所有受测融合方法高 0.37-0.41 accuracy。作者用可见性条件的可靠性门控（visibility-conditioned reliability gate）在野火数据上显著超过校准概率平均 +0.051（p=0.001）与端到端融合 +0.072（p<10^-4），并发现冲突的空间密度可无标签预测图斑级损毁（Spearman r=0.615, p=0.001）。
Motivation: 空对影像与地面照片的融合默认对每栋建筑同等信任两个视图，但在两视图冲突的样本上这一假设失效，且这类样本在真实灾害数据中占比可观（10-33%）。
Method: 先用两个独立训练的单视图模型在三组配对数据（2025 Eaton 野火巡检照片、Hurricane Ian 与 Milton 街景全景，均配超高分辨率空对瓦片）中挖出冲突样本；再训练一个线性可靠性门控，输入建筑可见性特征、逐视图校准置信度与分歧本身，决定信任哪个视图；另做受控视场实验（向建筑裁剪全景 vs 同尺寸随机裁剪）解释融合收益来源。
Result: 冲突样本占数据 10-33%；oracle 在冲突上比所有受测融合方法高 0.37-0.41 accuracy，且差距在更长训练、校准与骨干更换下保持。野火数据上门控是唯一显著优于校准概率平均的方法（冲突上 +0.051, p=0.001）与端到端融合（+0.072, p<10^-4），在全景数据集上与二者持平。向建筑裁剪全景使融合收益翻倍，同尺寸随机裁剪则不会；冲突空间密度无标签预测图斑级损毁，Spearman r=0.615, p=0.001。
Conclusion: 对称融合的问题应改写为「在何处该信任哪个视图、为什么」，按可见性做可靠性门控能在视图质量不对称时（野火巡检照片）恢复 oracle 差距的一部分，而在视图质量较均衡的全景数据上与普通融合相当。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: LyapuFlow: Controlling Generative Flows with Lyapunov Feedback for Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained flow models are now widely used as generative priors in science and vision, where inference-time guidance enables test-time constraints without retraining. Existing methods use projection, posterior sampling, or iterative optimization of the generative trajectory. We propose LyapuFlow, an alternative based on Lyapunov feedback control. At each sampling step, LyapuFlow predicts the terminal sample towards which the current flow is evolving, and evaluates the constraint violation on this prediction. Then, we compute the minimum-norm control that satisfies a prescribed Lyapunov decrease condition. The resulting control remains inactive when the uncontrolled dynamics already reduce the constraint violation at the prescribed rate. Otherwise, it provides a corrective update within a feedback trust region that prevents the control from dominating the pretrained dynamics. We demonstrate LyapuFlow in both data and latent spaces, outperforming alternatives spanning different mechanisms for test-time constraint enforcement in scientific machine learning and image inverse problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LyapuFlow 用 Lyapunov 反馈控制在采样时给预训练 flow 加约束：每步先预测当前流将到达的终端样本，在该预测上评估约束违反量，再求满足规定 Lyapunov 下降条件的最小范数控制；当无控动力学本身已按该速率降低违反量时控制保持不激活，否则在反馈信任域内给出修正更新，避免控制压过预训练动力学。在科学机器学习与图像逆问题的测试时约束执行上，其表现优于不同机制的替代方法。
Motivation: 预训练 flow 作为科学与视觉中的生成先验时，测试时约束执行现有做法依赖投影、后验采样或对生成轨迹的迭代优化，缺少一种能在不重训前提下按需介入的控制式机制。
Method: Lyapunov 反馈控制：每个采样步预测当前 flow 演化到的终端样本，在该预测上计算约束违反量，再求满足规定 Lyapunov 下降条件的最小范数控制；控制带反馈信任域，且在无控动力学已按给定速率降低违反量时保持不激活。方法同时在数据空间与 latent 空间上演示。
Result: 在科学机器学习与图像逆问题两类测试时约束执行场景中，LyapuFlow 在涵盖不同机制的替代方法对比中表现更优；演示覆盖数据空间与 latent 空间两种设置。
Conclusion: 以 Lyapunov 下降条件加最小范数控制加信任域的方式做推理时引导，可以在不重训预训练 flow 的前提下执行测试时约束，并在所演示的逆问题上胜过投影、后验采样与轨迹迭代优化等机制。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: GrayShield: Bit-Level Sanitization for Transformer Model Supply-Chain Security
papers.abstract_en: Transformer models such as BERT and Vision Transformer~(ViT) achieve strong performance via densely parameterized attention backbones. However, the least significant bits~(LSBs) of their 32-bit floating-point weights can be abused as covert channels to conceal malicious payloads, posing a serious threat to the AI model supply chain. We propose \GS (\GSabbr), a lightweight, post-training, zero-data sanitization method that completely replaces the declared mantissa-LSB channel with a Gray-code-guided low-transition sequence. Complete payload-independent overwrite, whether keyed or public, makes the sanitized target bits independent of the embedded payload and gives that declared channel zero capacity. Gray coding supplies overwrite structure, while a keyed per-tensor phase supplies pattern diversity. Benchmarked against seven post-training defenses on four Transformer model presets and two real-world malware payloads, \GSabbr maintains sub-$1\%$ accuracy impact and achieves $49.96\pm0.66$ percentage-point Recovery Reduction (RR) under five implemented attacker variants. Because pre-defense recovery is effectively $100\%$, RR near 50 percentage points corresponds to post-sanitization bit accuracy at binary chance. Its main empirical advantage is stable near-chance sanitization with substantially smaller weight-distribution shift than the evaluated near-chance baselines PatternMask (PM) and Post-Training Quantization (PTQ).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GrayShield 把 Transformer 32 位浮点权重的 mantissa-LSB 隐信道整体替换为 Gray 码引导的低跳变序列，配合 keyed per-tensor phase 提供图案多样性，使该信道容量归零且与载荷无关。在四个 Transformer 模型预设与两个真实恶意载荷上，相对七个后训练防御，精度影响保持在 1% 以下，五种攻击者变体下 Recovery Reduction 达 49.96±0.66 个百分点（即净化后比特精度落到二元随机水平），且权重分布偏移显著小于同样接近随机的 PatternMask 与 PTQ 基线。
Motivation: BERT、ViT 等 Transformer 的 32 位浮点权重最低有效位可被用作隐蔽信道藏匿恶意载荷，直接威胁 AI 模型供应链；现有后训练防御在压低恢复率时往往带来过大的权重分布偏移。
Method: 提出 GrayShield：一种轻量、后训练、零数据的净化方法，用 Gray 码引导的低跳变序列完整覆盖声明的 mantissa-LSB 信道（keyed 或 public 均可），使目标比特与嵌入载荷无关；Gray 编码提供覆盖结构，keyed per-tensor phase 提供图案多样性。与七个后训练防御在四个 Transformer 模型预设、两个真实恶意载荷、五种攻击者变体上对比。
Result: 精度影响保持在 1% 以下；五种攻击者变体下 Recovery Reduction (RR) 为 49.96±0.66 个百分点——因防御前恢复率约为 100%，该 RR 对应净化后比特精度处于二元随机水平；相对同样达到近随机恢复的 PatternMask (PM) 与 Post-Training Quantization (PTQ)，权重分布偏移明显更小。
Conclusion: 对声明的 mantissa-LSB 信道做载荷无关的完整覆盖，可在几乎不损失精度的前提下把该隐信道压到随机水平，同时比 PM/PTQ 更少扰动权重分布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Long-Video Efficiency: A Joint Allocation Perspective on Frames, Pixels, and Front-End Latency
papers.abstract_en: Efficient long-video understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) is often framed as selecting informative frames or visual tokens at a fixed native resolution. We show that per-frame resolution can instead be traded for denser temporal coverage, while front-end decoding latency depends on the size of the candidate pool rather than the final token budget. An empirical study across multiple VLMs and long-video benchmarks yields three findings: dense low-resolution sampling outperforms sparse native-resolution sampling at matched token budgets; resolution-sensitive tasks benefit from selected high-resolution frames; and front-end decoding dominates wall time for hour-long videos. Motivated by these findings, we introduce LoHi, a training-free, single-pass framework that combines a dense low-resolution video stream with sparse high-resolution image frames through the VLM's native video and image pathways. LoHi-Anchor selects high-resolution frames using codec I-frame metadata, while LoHi-SemDiv uses query relevance and visual diversity over CLIP features. Across three long-video benchmarks, LoHi improves average accuracy by 10.6 percentage points over the native-resolution baseline at a matched token budget and by 5.2 percentage points over the strongest prior efficiency method. It also reduces front-end decoding latency by up to 7x on hour-long videos. Project page: https://sixundong.com/projects/lohi
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://sixundong.com/projects/lohi
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoHi 把长视频理解的资源分配从「选帧/选 token」改为帧数、像素与前端解码延迟的联合分配：低分辨率密集采样流与稀疏高分辨率图像帧经 VLM 原生视频与图像通路单次前向拼接，高分辨率帧由 codec I-frame 元数据 (LoHi-Anchor) 或 CLIP 特征上的查询相关性与视觉多样性 (LoHi-SemDiv) 选出。在三个长视频基准上，等 token 预算下平均精度比原生分辨率基线高 10.6 个百分点、比最强已有效率方法高 5.2 个百分点，小时级视频前端解码延迟最多降 7 倍。
Motivation: 长视频 VLM 效率优化通常被框定为在固定原生分辨率下选信息帧或视觉 token，忽略了分辨率可与时间覆盖密度互换、以及前端解码延迟由候选池大小而非最终 token 预算决定这两点。
Method: LoHi 是免训练 (training-free) 的单次前向框架：密集低分辨率视频流走 VLM 原生 video pathway，稀疏高分辨率图像帧走 image pathway；LoHi-Anchor 用 codec I-frame 元数据选高分辨率帧，LoHi-SemDiv 用 CLIP 特征上的查询相关性与视觉多样性选帧。经验研究覆盖多个 VLM 与多个长视频基准。
Result: 在三个长视频基准上，等 token 预算下 LoHi 平均精度比原生分辨率基线高 10.6 个百分点，比最强已有效率方法高 5.2 个百分点；小时级视频前端解码延迟最多降低 7 倍。经验研究给出三条发现：等 token 预算下密集低分辨率采样优于稀疏原生分辨率采样，分辨率敏感任务受益于选中的高分辨率帧，小时级视频墙钟时间由前端解码主导。
Conclusion: 长视频效率应按帧、像素与前端延迟联合分配：以密集低分辨率换取时间覆盖、只在必要处保留高分辨率帧，可在等 token 预算下同时提高精度并大幅压缩解码延迟。

summary_sections.motivation: 长视频 VLM 效率优化通常被框定为在固定原生分辨率下选信息帧或视觉 token，忽略了分辨率可与时间覆盖密度互换、以及前端解码延迟由候选池大小而非最终 token 预算决定这两点。
summary_sections.method: LoHi 是免训练 (training-free) 的单次前向框架：密集低分辨率视频流走 VLM 原生 video pathway，稀疏高分辨率图像帧走 image pathway；LoHi-Anchor 用 codec I-frame 元数据选高分辨率帧，LoHi-SemDiv 用 CLIP 特征上的查询相关性与视觉多样性选帧。经验研究覆盖多个 VLM 与多个长视频基准。
summary_sections.result: 在三个长视频基准上，等 token 预算下 LoHi 平均精度比原生分辨率基线高 10.6 个百分点，比最强已有效率方法高 5.2 个百分点；小时级视频前端解码延迟最多降低 7 倍。经验研究给出三条发现：等 token 预算下密集低分辨率采样优于稀疏原生分辨率采样，分辨率敏感任务受益于选中的高分辨率帧，小时级视频墙钟时间由前端解码主导。
summary_sections.conclusion: 长视频效率应按帧、像素与前端延迟联合分配：以密集低分辨率换取时间覆盖、只在必要处保留高分辨率帧，可在等 token 预算下同时提高精度并大幅压缩解码延迟。

papers.title: From Latent Space to Jacobian Space: Measuring, Evading, and Training Against Safety-Content Accessibility
papers.abstract_en: Output-only safety monitoring sees only the end of a model's computation, yet the model computes its answer before emitting it: what it is internally poised to say is safety-critical. Jacobian-space (J-space) readouts, linear maps from hidden states to the output vocabulary via the model's input-output Jacobian, have been proposed as a window on behaviorally accessible internal content, and a first safety protocol (JADR) showed that danger recognition is readable there. What remains unknown is how this accessible content relates to the latent-space safety geometry studied by representation engineering, and how safety training shapes it. We introduce two quantitative bridges: (i) a transport-amplification profile $A_\ell$, measuring how strongly a latent safety direction is carried toward output space by each layer's Jacobian, and (ii) a paired base-vs-tuned protocol that attributes accessibility to training provenance. Across four small model pairs (135M to 1.5B, three lens-fit seeds), tuned checkpoints concentrate recognition in upper-middle layers, and at 0.5B DPO installs refusal while J-space recognition drops to chance: training can widen the accessibility gap exactly where behavioral safety looks best. A deployment audit closes the loop: monitor-aware GCG-style suffixes suppress the prompt-side monitor at zero behavioral cost at every scale; only a learned monitor rung resists its own adaptive re-attack; the training-time defense fails its re-attack at every penalty weight; steering shows the amplification profile is descriptive, not causal; and continuous-prefix optimization fails where discrete search succeeds. Safety monitoring, training, and evaluation must operate on accessibility itself, not on outputs alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Jacobian 空间 (J-space) 安全可读性度量：用传输放大剖面 A_ℓ 衡量每层 Jacobian 把潜在安全方向推向输出空间的强度，再用 base-vs-tuned 配对协议把可读性归因到训练来源。在 135M–1.5B 的四对小模型上，DPO 在 0.5B 装上拒答的同时把 J-space 识别降到随机水平，说明行为安全最好时可及性缺口反而被拉大。
Motivation: 输出侧安全监控只能看到模型生成的末端，而模型在输出前已内部算出答案；J-space 读出与表征工程研究的潜在安全几何之间缺少定量联系，安全训练如何改变这种可及性也未知。
Method: 定义两个量化桥梁：传输放大剖面 A_ℓ，逐层衡量潜在安全方向被输入-输出 Jacobian 搬运到输出空间的强度；配对 base-vs-tuned 协议，把可及性归因于训练来源。在四对小模型（135M 到 1.5B，三个 lens-fit 种子）上测量，并做部署审计：monitor-aware GCG 式后缀、自适应再攻击、训练时惩罚权重、steering 与连续前缀优化对照。
Result: tuned 检查点把识别集中在中上层；0.5B 上 DPO 装入拒答而 J-space 识别降到随机水平。monitor-aware GCG 式后缀在每个规模上以零行为代价压制提示侧监控；只有学习型监控器能抵抗其自适应再攻击；训练时防御在每个惩罚权重下都败于再攻击；steering 表明放大剖面是描述性而非因果的；连续前缀优化在离散搜索成功处失败。
Conclusion: 安全监控、训练与评估必须直接针对内容可及性 (accessibility) 本身，而不是只看输出；行为安全指标变好并不保证内部可读的安全信号同步增强。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MOIRA: Mass-Oriented Indexing with Ragged Attention for Long-Context Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Long-context decoding is limited by memory bandwidth, because every output token reads the KV cache of every layer. Sparse decoding reduces this cost by reading only part of the KV cache. We observe that the number of pages a query needs varies widely across KV heads, layers and steps. Fixed budgets are simple, but they are sized for demanding cases and tuned per workload; adaptive budgets follow this variation more flexibly, but existing designs pay for it with extra selection cost or training. At the kernel level, FlashAttention-3 (FA3) and FlashInfer are designed for rows of similar length: with page lists whose length differs per KV head, they either pad the lists (forfeiting much of the sparse saving), leave thread blocks unbalanced, or rely on a host-side plan that runs outside the CUDA graph. We propose MOIRA, a training-free sparse decode path in vLLM whose budget adapts per KV head and per layer. For every request, layer, KV head and step, a coverage rule keeps the smallest set of pages whose estimated attention mass reaches a fraction $γ$. A new kernel, self-planning attention, lets each thread block derive its own share of the work from the list lengths, so the whole decode step stays inside the CUDA graph. On an H200, at RULER's 128k context, MOIRA with $γ=0.99$ matches dense accuracy while reading about 30% of the pages and reduces the time per output token (TPOT) by 2.2-2.5$\times$ relative to dense FA3; with $γ=0.98$ it reduces TPOT by 2.7$\times$ and stays within the noise of dense. Under high serving load it raises throughput by up to 51%. These results suggest that a budget adapted per head and layer, paired with a kernel that keeps such budgets inside the CUDA graph, makes sparse decoding both flexible and fast.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MOIRA 是 vLLM 中免训练的稀疏解码路径，按请求、层、KV head、步自适应设定页预算：覆盖规则只保留注意力质量达到比例 γ 的最小页集合，配套 self-planning attention kernel 让每个 thread block 按列表长度自行分配工作量，使整个 decode step 留在 CUDA graph 内。在 H200 上 RULER 128k 上下文，γ=0.99 时精度与 dense 持平、只读约 30% 页，TPOT 相对 dense FA3 降低 2.2–2.5×；γ=0.98 时 TPOT 降低 2.7× 且仍在 dense 噪声范围内，高负载下吞吐最高提升 51%。
Motivation: 长上下文解码受内存带宽限制，每个输出 token 都要读全部层的 KV cache。固定预算按最坏情况定且需逐负载调优，自适应预算又带来额外选择开销或需要训练；FA3 与 FlashInfer 面向等长行，遇到每 KV head 长度不同的页列表只能 padding、线程块失衡或依赖 CUDA graph 之外的 host 端 plan。
Method: 在 vLLM 中实现免训练稀疏解码：对每个请求、层、KV head、步，用覆盖规则保留估计注意力质量达到分数 γ 的最小页集合，预算随 head 与层自适应；新 kernel self-planning attention 让每个 thread block 从页列表长度推出自己的工作份额，使整步解码保持在 CUDA graph 内。
Result: H200 上 RULER 128k 上下文：γ=0.99 时精度与 dense 相当、读约 30% 页，TPOT 相对 dense FA3 降低 2.2–2.5×；γ=0.98 时 TPOT 降低 2.7× 且保持在 dense 的噪声范围内；高服务负载下吞吐最高提升 51%。
Conclusion: 按 head 与层自适应的页预算，配合能把该预算留在 CUDA graph 内的 kernel，可让稀疏解码同时做到灵活与快速。

papers.title: Modeling Deletion Requests in Machine Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning is seen as a promising approach to enable users to exercise the "right to erasure" in the context of AI models. We ask how users might influence the behavior of models when exercising this right. We define two types of behaviors that users might adopt when requesting the deletion of their data: adaptivity and collectivity. Drawing connections between the goals of users in this context and results in stochastic optimization, we demonstrate theoretical gaps between the potential effects of groups of users who do and do not display these behaviors. We then show how techniques from data valuation might be used to design deletion requesters that can significantly alter model behavior in realistic settings. In experiments on computer vision tasks, we demonstrate the differential effects of different models of user behavior and attempt to isolate the impacts of adaptivity and collectivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究机器遗忘 (machine unlearning) 中删除请求的建模，定义用户的两种行为——适应性 (adaptivity) 与集体性 (collectivity)，并证明表现出这两种行为的用户群体与不表现的群体在影响模型上存在理论差距。进一步把数据估值 (data valuation) 技术改造成删除请求生成器，在计算机视觉任务实验中显示不同用户行为模型对模型行为有差异化影响，并尝试分离 adaptivity 与 collectivity 各自的作用。
Motivation: 用户行使被遗忘权 (right to erasure) 时如何影响模型行为缺乏形式化刻画：哪些请求策略能真正改变模型输出、群体协同是否带来额外影响，此前没有理论与实验依据。
Method: 定义 adaptivity 与 collectivity 两类用户行为；把用户目标与随机优化 (stochastic optimization) 已有结果建立联系，推导两类群体潜在影响的理论差距；再借用数据估值技术设计删除请求生成器，并在计算机视觉任务上做实验，分离两种行为的各自影响。
Result: 理论上证明表现出 adaptivity/collectivity 的用户群体与不表现的群体在影响模型上存在差距；实验显示不同用户行为模型产生差异化效果，并区分出 adaptivity 与 collectivity 的影响（17 页、7 图，摘要未给出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 删除请求不是被动的：带适应性与集体性策略的请求者能显著改变模型行为，数据估值方法可用来构造这类请求生成器。

papers.title: ML-OPF-Bench: Benchmarking Machine Learning for Optimal Power Flow
papers.abstract_en: Machine Learning (ML) methods promise a fast solution process for Optimal Power Flow (OPF). While inconsistent test cases, implementations, and evaluation metrics across existing studies make it challenging to determine which algorithmic advances are most critical for real-world deployment. To this end, we propose ML-OPF-Bench, a unified benchmark for AC- and DC-OPF that evaluates representative ML algorithms under a consistent pipeline, stress-tests them across system sizes, distribution shifts, and resource budgets, and ranks them with a multi-objective framework. We find that prediction accuracy alone is not a reliable indicator of operational feasibility. Under heavily loaded, congested conditions, even the strongest in-distribution performers lose their advantage, while feasibility is maintained largely by post-processing that enforces the target constraints rather than by the underlying pure ML predictor. Data scaling shows that prediction accuracy and constraint violations follow different trajectories, whereas compute scaling shows that returns diminish and that larger models do not consistently perform better. These results expose critical trade-offs among ML methods' speed, accuracy, and feasibility, and offer practical guidance for future ML-OPF design. We open-source the benchmark as an extensible Python package for integrating new learning-based OPF algorithms and evaluating them under the same standard as the existing baselines.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 9 figures, in submission. Code available at https://github.com/XinyiLiu04/ML-OPF-Bench; Datasets available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/xinyi-liu/ML-OPF-Bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ML-OPF-Bench 用统一流水线对 AC-OPF 与 DC-OPF 上的代表性 ML 算法做基准测试，发现预测精度单独并不能指示运行可行性：在重载、阻塞工况下最强的分布内模型也失去优势，可行性主要靠施加目标约束的后处理而非纯 ML 预测器维持；数据规模上精度与约束违反走不同轨迹，算力规模上收益递减且更大模型并不总是更好。
Motivation: 现有 ML-OPF 研究的测试算例、实现与评估指标互不一致，难以判断哪些算法进展对真实部署最关键，速度、精度与可行性之间的权衡无统一口径。
Method: 提出统一基准 ML-OPF-Bench，覆盖 AC-OPF 与 DC-OPF，在一致流水线下评测代表性 ML 算法，并跨系统规模、分布偏移与资源预算做压力测试，用多目标框架排名；以可扩展 Python 包形式开源，可接入新的基于学习的 OPF 算法与既有基线同标准比较。
Result: 预测精度单独不是运行可行性的可靠指标；重载阻塞条件下最强的分布内表现者失去优势，可行性主要由强制目标约束的后处理维持；数据规模上预测精度与约束违反沿不同轨迹演化，算力规模上收益递减且更大模型不持续更优。
Conclusion: ML-OPF 的评估必须把速度、精度与可行性一起看，纯预测器不足以保证约束满足，后处理约束强制是当前可行性的主要来源；作者据此给出面向未来 ML-OPF 设计的实践指引并开源基准。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.conclusion: ML-OPF 的评估必须把速度、精度与可行性一起看，纯预测器不足以保证约束满足，后处理约束强制是当前可行性的主要来源；作者据此给出面向未来 ML-OPF 设计的实践指引并开源基准。

papers.title: What to Preserve in Recursive Computation: A Local Predictive Sufficiency Principle
papers.abstract_en: Recursive computation repeatedly compresses or reuses intermediate states, creating a simple tension: information that must remain useful across longer recursive paths is also exposed to more opportunities for loss before reaching the final prediction. Existing reconstruction or local-prediction objectives provide tractable supervision, but do not ensure that the retained information remains sufficient for subsequent recursive computation. We identify local predictive sufficiency with recursive predictive closure: controlling local predictive deficiencies at individual interfaces controls the resulting discrepancy at the root. We then turn this principle into a tractable training procedure. Starting from a variational characterization, we derive finite predictive tests and an empirical predictive deficiency that measures predictive value retained across compression. Its predictive sensitivities define margin-relaxed half-space constraints on parameter updates, and we project the host optimizer's proposed update onto their intersection only when predictive preservation would otherwise be violated. Across temporal graphs, language memory, vision-language-action control, and recursive self-improvement, the method matches or improves the corresponding host models under matched compression budgets, with larger gains under heavier recursive or memory demands, while better preserving predictive information across successive transformations. Crucially, the same task-agnostic predictive-preservation principle is instantiated across all four settings through host-compatible interventions while keeping the endpoint task, backbone, and evaluation protocol fixed. These results establish predictive preservation at recursive interfaces as a general training principle for recursive compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 递归计算中中间状态被反复压缩，重建或局部预测目标无法保证保留的信息对后续递归仍然充分。作者提出局部预测充分性 = 递归预测闭包：约束各接口的局部预测亏缺即可控制根节点处的最终偏差，并据此把预测敏感度写成松弛半空间约束，仅在预测保持将被破坏时把宿主优化器的更新投影到这些约束的交集上。在时序图、语言记忆、视觉-语言-动作控制与递归自我改进四类任务上，该干预在匹配压缩预算下匹配或改进宿主模型，递归或记忆需求越重增益越大。
Motivation: 递归计算反复压缩或复用中间状态，信息在到达最终预测前经历更多次丢失机会；现有重建与局部预测目标虽可监督，却不保证保留信息对后续递归仍然充分。
Method: 从变分刻画出发，把局部预测充分性等同于递归预测闭包，导出有限预测检验与经验预测亏缺 (empirical predictive deficiency) 来度量压缩后保留的预测价值；以其预测敏感度构造参数更新的松弛半空间约束，仅当预测保持将被违反时才把宿主优化器提出的更新投影到约束交集上，任务无关且与宿主模型兼容。
Result: 在时序图、语言记忆、视觉-语言-动作 (vision-language-action) 控制与递归自我改进四个设置中，在匹配压缩预算下匹配或改进对应宿主模型，递归或记忆需求更重时增益更大，并在连续变换间更好地保留预测信息；四个设置通过宿主兼容干预实例化同一原则，端点任务、骨干与评测协议保持固定。
Conclusion: 在递归接口处做预测保持可以作为递归压缩的一般训练原则，且任务无关、可跨宿主模型移植。

papers.title: EnvDreamer: Large-Scale Multimodal-to-Environment Generation for Embodied AI
papers.abstract_en: Large datasets and high capacity models have accelerated progress in vision and language. This work introduces a platform aimed at bringing comparable gains to embodied learning, world models, and robotics. We present EnvDreamer, a framework that uses large language and vision language models to generate Unreal Engine 5 environments for embodied AI and robot training. EnvDreamer enables sampling of large, diverse, interactive, customizable, and validator passed virtual environments for training and evaluation across navigation, interaction, and manipulation. We illustrate the platform with a large set of generated scenes and simple baselines. Policies trained on EnvDreamer generated environments, without explicit mapping or human task supervision, achieve competitive results on multiple embodied benchmarks spanning navigation, rearrangement, and manipulation. EnvDreamer also supports image-conditioned reconstruction for real-to-sim studies. Finally, we release EnvDreamer-20k, a dataset of 20,000 validator passed environments with task programs, scene graphs, trajectories, and metadata to support reproducible benchmarking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EnvDreamer 用 LLM 与 VLM 自动生成可通过验证器的 Unreal Engine 5 环境，为具身智能与机器人训练提供大规模可交互场景。在无需显式建图与人工任务监督的条件下，仅在这些生成环境中训练的策略在导航、重排、操作多项具身基准上取得有竞争力的结果，并开源 EnvDreamer-20k（20,000 个通过验证的环境，含任务程序、场景图、轨迹与元数据）。
Motivation: 视觉与语言靠大规模数据和大模型推进，而具身学习、世界模型与机器人训练缺少同等规模、可定制、可复现的环境数据来源。
Method: 以 LLM 和 VLM 驱动的生成管线产出 UE5 环境，采样出大量多样、可交互、可定制且通过验证器 (validator passed) 的虚拟环境，覆盖导航、交互与操作任务；支持图像条件重建用于 real-to-sim；策略在生成环境中训练，不使用显式建图或人工任务监督。
Result: 发布 EnvDreamer-20k：20,000 个通过验证的环境，附任务程序、场景图、轨迹与元数据；在该平台生成的大量场景上训练的策略，于导航、重排 (rearrangement)、操作 (manipulation) 多项具身基准达到有竞争力的结果，并展示了一组生成场景与简单基线。
Conclusion: 自动生成并通过验证的仿真环境可以替代人工搭建，作为具身策略训练与评测的可复现数据源，且无需人工任务监督即可迁移到多项具身基准。

papers.title: A Geometric-Transformation Feature-Adaptive Manifold Restoration Method for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation of Remote Sensing Images
papers.abstract_en: The semantic information of objects in remote sensing images is typically invariant to geometric transformations from the dihedral group D4. However, SAM3-based open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) methods often exhibit inconsistent responses to different geometric transformations. To exploit this property and improve the stability of OVSS for remote sensing images, we propose a feature-adaptive manifold repair method based on dihedral-group geometric transformations. First, we introduce multi-scale harmonic-guided D4 view selection (MH-D4VS) to select complementary candidate views from a set of geometrically transformed views. Next, we propose original-view-anchored adaptive manifold repair (OAMR), which uses the original view as an anchor and reliable cross-view information to selectively repair locally unreliable visual features. Finally, we develop pixel decoder test-time adaptation (PD-TTA) for SAM3, which fine-tunes only the parameters of the GroupNorm layers online during inference, thereby enhancing the model's ability to adapt to sample-level distribution shifts. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves an average mIoU of 55.6% across eight remote sensing semantic segmentation benchmarks and delivers consistent performance improvements under different SAM3-based inference frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 SAM3 开源词汇语义分割 (OVSS) 在遥感图像上对 D4 几何变换响应不一致的问题，提出以原视图为锚的流形修复：MH-D4VS 选互补变换视图，OAMR 用跨视图信息修补局部不可靠特征，PD-TTA 在推理时只在线微调 GroupNorm 参数。在八个遥感语义分割基准上平均 mIoU 达 55.6%，并在不同 SAM3 推理框架下保持一致提升。
Motivation: 遥感目标语义本应对 D4 几何变换不变，但 SAM3 类 OVSS 对不同几何变换响应不一致，导致分割稳定性差、对样本级分布偏移敏感。
Method: 三段式：多尺度谐波引导的 D4 视图选择 (MH-D4VS) 从几何变换视图集中挑互补候选视图；原视图锚定的自适应流形修复 (OAMR) 以原视图为锚、用可靠跨视图信息选择性修复局部不可靠视觉特征；面向 SAM3 的像素解码器测试时自适应 (PD-TTA) 在推理阶段在线微调 GroupNorm 层参数。
Result: 在八个遥感语义分割基准上平均 mIoU 55.6%，并在不同 SAM3-based 推理框架下给出一致的性能提升。
Conclusion: 利用 D4 几何不变性做视图选择加流形修复、配合只调 GroupNorm 的测试时自适应，可提升遥感 OVSS 的稳定性与精度，且对不同 SAM3 推理框架通用。

papers.title: Questioning the Questions: Sustaining Self-Evolution in Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving reasoning models learn from their own generated questions, yet repeated self-training can lead to performance collapse. In this paper, we investigate why performance deteriorates over successive rounds and how to sustain self-evolution. Our analysis identifies two recurring quality problems in self-generated questions: invalid questions and repeated variants of the same mathematical questions. First, invalid questions become more prevalent across rounds, and answer-consistency filtering further increases their proportion in training data. Second, existing question diversity controls based on lexical similarity can miss mathematically equivalent questions expressed in different ways, which leads to question diversity collapse in later training rounds. Building on these findings, we introduce R-Quest, which uses question validity and novelty feedback to guide self-evolution. We first train the solver to recognize and reject invalid questions, then use its judgments to guide questioner rewards and filter solver training data. To avoid question repetition, we use a frozen base model to compare sampled question pairs and provide novelty feedback. Empirically, our method consistently achieves the highest average performance on 12 benchmarks in mathematical reasoning, general-domain reasoning, and code generation across two model families. Additionally, R-Quest maintains stable performance gains over ten rounds of self-evolution, peaking in the final round and outperforming R-Zero by 17.32 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自演化推理模型反复用自生成题目训练会性能崩塌，根因是无效题目逐轮增多、以及词面相似度控制漏掉数学等价的重复题。R-Quest 先训练 solver 识别并拒绝无效题目，再用其判断约束 questioner 奖励与 solver 训练数据，并用冻结基座模型对题目对给出 novelty 反馈。在 12 个数学/通用推理/代码基准上跨两个模型家族取得最高平均性能，十轮自演化保持稳定并在最后一轮达峰，超 R-Zero 17.32 分。
Motivation: 自生成题目反复自训练会导致性能崩塌：无效题目在训练数据中逐轮变多，词面相似度多样性控制又拦不住数学上等价的重复题，后期出现 question diversity collapse。
Method: R-Quest 用题目有效性与新颖度反馈引导自演化：先训练 solver 识别并拒绝无效题目，再用其判断给 questioner 提供奖励并过滤 solver 训练数据；为避免重复，用冻结基座模型比较采样题目对并给出 novelty 反馈。
Result: 在 12 个基准（数学推理、通用域推理、代码生成）上跨两个模型家族取得最高平均性能；十轮自演化中保持稳定增益，最后一轮达峰，比 R-Zero 高 17.32 分。
Conclusion: 自演化要持续，必须同时管住题目的有效性与数学层面的新颖度，仅靠词面相似度的多样性控制不足以阻止后期崩塌。

papers.title: Latent Safety Filters: When a Lossy Encoder Admits a Transferable Certificate
papers.abstract_en: Latent safety filters certify safety on a learned low-dimensional representation of the state, enabling constraints that resist analytic description. Because the encoder is lossy, a filter can report safe while the physical state is unsafe, with no detectable model error. Existing transfer conditions leave the effect of discarded safety information implicit. We ask when a lossy encoder admits a safety certificate that transfers to the physical system, and show the answer is governed by the detectability of the discarded safety-relevant dynamics. We construct a system whose latent model is exact and whose latent signals always report safe, while the physical state becomes arbitrarily unsafe. For this system no certificate exists and no monitor downstream of the encoder can detect the failure. When the discarded dynamics contract, a latent barrier certifies true safety up to two explicit margins, one for the latent-model error and one for the variation of safety across states the encoder cannot distinguish. In the linear case and under boundedness and non-degeneracy conditions, every calibrated barrier transfers with a finite margin when the safety-relevant subspace is detectable, and none does otherwise. On learned cartpole encoders, the model error does not indicate for which representations the estimated bound is non-vacuous, while the second margin does.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 潜空间安全滤波器 (latent safety filter) 在有损编码器上给出的安全证书可能对物理系统失效，且失效无法被编码器下游的任何 monitor 检测到。论文证明可迁移性由被丢弃的安全相关动力学的可检测性 (detectability) 决定：当被丢弃动力学收缩时，潜空间 barrier 以两个显式 margin（潜模型误差 + 编码器不可区分状态间的安全性差异）保证真实安全；线性情形下安全相关子空间可检测时每个校准 barrier 都以有限 margin 迁移，否则一个都不能。
Motivation: 在学习到的低维表征上做安全认证可以表达难以解析描述的约束，但编码器有损：滤波器可能报安全而物理状态不安全，且没有可检测的模型误差；现有迁移条件把被丢弃的安全信息的影响留作隐式。
Method: 先构造一个潜模型精确、潜信号恒报安全而物理状态可任意不安全的反例系统，说明该情形下不存在证书且编码器下游 monitor 无法检测；再在被丢弃动力学收缩的条件下推导带两个显式 margin 的潜 barrier 迁移条件；线性情形在有界性与非退化假设下给出可检测性充要结论，并在学习到的 cartpole 编码器上比较两个 margin。
Result: 反例系统中潜模型精确、潜信号始终报安全，而物理状态可任意不安全，此时不存在证书且下游 monitor 检测不到。收缩条件下潜 barrier 以两个显式 margin 认证真实安全：一个刻画潜模型误差，一个刻画编码器无法区分的状态间安全性变化。线性情形下，安全相关子空间可检测时每个校准 barrier 都以有限 margin 迁移，否则没有一个迁移。在学习到的 cartpole 编码器上，模型误差无法指示哪些表征的估计界是非空的 (non-vacuous)，而第二个 margin 可以。
Conclusion: 有损编码器能否给出可迁移安全证书，取决于被丢弃的安全相关动力学是否可检测；判断估计界是否非空要看编码器不可区分状态间的安全性变化这一 margin，而不是潜模型误差。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RRM-GPT: A Framework and Vision for Radio Resource Management Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based models for radio resource management (RRM) are typically built for a single function and deployment, so each new setting repeats the development pipeline. RRM decisions, however, share a common structure: each is assembled from interdependent fields, defined by the standard, whose values are selected in view of the network state. We propose RRM-GPT, an autoregressive framework for RRM foundation models that generate these decisions as a language model generates text. An encoder maps heterogeneous network observations into a common token representation, and a decoder emits the decision one field at a time, each conditioned on the network state and the fields already committed. Pretraining on unannotated network logs teaches the model what makes a decision valid and how controllers choose among valid decisions; post-training then adapts it to deployment-specific operator objectives through imitation or reinforcement learning. The framework targets two forms of reuse: a function-specific model reused across deployments, and a model shared across RRM functions that generates their interdependent decisions as one sequence. In a 5G New Radio (NR) case study, we demonstrate that a single model generates complete scheduling grants spanning user selection, timing, link adaptation, resource allocation, and control signaling. The model captures dependencies among grant fields and transfers learned behavior to an unseen scenario without adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RRM-GPT 把无线资源管理 (RRM) 决策当作文本生成：编码器把异构网络观测映射为统一 token，解码器逐字段生成由标准定义、彼此耦合的决策序列。在 5G NR 案例中，单一模型生成涵盖用户选择、时序、链路自适应、资源分配与控制信令的完整调度授权，捕捉字段间依赖，并在未见过的场景上零适应迁移。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的 RRM 模型通常绑定单一功能与单一部署，每换一个场景都要重跑整条开发流水线，而 RRM 决策本身共享同一结构。
Method: 自回归框架：编码器将异构网络观测编码为统一 token 表示，解码器逐字段输出决策，每个字段以网络状态和已提交字段为条件；先在无标注网络日志上预训练以学习决策有效性与控制器选择规律，再用模仿学习或强化学习做部署特定目标的后训练。
Result: 在 5G New Radio (NR) 案例研究中，单一模型生成覆盖用户选择、时序、链路自适应、资源分配与控制信令的完整调度授权 (scheduling grant)，捕捉授权字段之间的依赖关系，并将学到的行为迁移到未见过的场景且无需适应。
Conclusion: RRM 决策可按语言建模方式统一生成，从而支持同一功能模型跨部署复用、以及跨 RRM 功能共享一个模型；该文为框架与愿景论文，5G NR 案例用于演示可行性。

papers.title: Language-Conditioned Token and Reasoning Efficiency in Large Language Models: A Paired Cross-Lingual Study Protocol
papers.abstract_en: Large language models incur language-dependent representation and inference costs, but existing comparisons often conflate input language, assigned observable-trace language, and answer realization. We specify a prospective paired study that separates these interfaces while holding the semantic item, checkpoint, and answer oracle fixed. The initial design instantiates 240 exactly scored items rendered from templates in English and seven non-English languages, three distinct-lineage open-weight checkpoints, three trace-token budgets, 22 input- and trace-language conditions, a fixed answer reserve, and a separately counted delimiter: 47,520 initial core runs before prospective sample-size selection. RQ1-RQ3 estimate input and trace effects by intention-to-treat with failure-inclusive terminal accounting and test answer realization by cloning a sealed prefix and runtime-native KV state into eight crossed branches. Pre-freeze independent language review, fixed-form ASCII selectors, and code/surface/solver agreement constrain the realization test. H1-H5 share one Holm family and a global simultaneous component band. A secondary randomized experiment compares one-long-attempt and complete K-short-attempt policies at equal trace allowance under frozen seeds and oracle-blind aggregation; it is a full-policy contrast because answer capacity differs. Outcomes include exact token spans, correctness, latency, runtime-exposed memory, and qualified same-host operating-system-reported energy over prespecified hardware rails. The protocol separates tokenizer expansion, observable-trace cost, and answer-realization cost without treating visible traces as internal cognition or operating-system estimates as physical cross-device energy. No confirmatory model outcome is reported; result fields remain disabled until the frozen evidence ledger passes independent verification.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Prospective paired study protocol; no confirmatory model outcomes are reported
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一份预注册的配对研究方案，用于分离大模型中输入语言、可观测推理轨迹语言与答案实现三类接口的成本：240 个精确评分条目、3 个开源 checkpoint、3 档 trace-token 预算、22 种输入/轨迹语言条件，初始核心运行 47,520 次。方案规定用 intention-to-treat 与失败计入的终末统计估计 RQ1–RQ3，H1–H5 共享一个 Holm 族与全局同时置信带；摘要明确尚无确证性模型结果，result 字段在冻结证据账本通过独立核验前保持停用。
Motivation: 现有跨语言比较把输入语言、被指定的可观测轨迹语言与答案实现混为一谈，导致无法区分 tokenizer 扩展、可见轨迹成本与答案实现成本这三种语言依赖的表示与推理开销。
Method: 预注册配对设计：语义条目、checkpoint 与答案 oracle 固定，240 个由模板渲染的英文与七种非英文条目，3 个不同谱系的开源权重 checkpoint，3 档 trace-token 预算，22 种输入与轨迹语言条件，固定答案预留与单独计数的分隔符，共 47,520 次初始核心运行；RQ1–RQ3 用 intention-to-treat 与失败计入的终末核算估计输入与轨迹效应，答案实现通过克隆封存前缀与运行时原生 KV 状态到八个交叉分支检验，H1–H5 共享一个 Holm 族与全局同时分量带；次要随机实验在等轨迹额度、冻结种子与 oracle 盲聚合下对比 one-long-attempt 与 complete K-short-attempt 两种完整策略。
Result: 摘要未报告确证性模型结果；给出的量化设计为 240 个条目、3 个 checkpoint、3 档 trace-token 预算、22 种语言条件、八个交叉分支、47,520 次初始核心运行，结局指标包括精确 token 跨度、正确率、延迟、运行时暴露内存与合格的同宿主操作系统级能耗。
Conclusion: 作者主张该协议能把 tokenizer 扩展、可观测轨迹成本与答案实现成本分开核算，且不把可见轨迹当作内部认知、不把操作系统能耗估计当作跨设备物理能耗；确证性结果需待冻结证据账本通过独立核验后才启用。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: LMBuild: Evaluating LLM Agents for Generating Buildable and Functional Structures
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents are increasingly capable of generating complex 3D structures, with the potential to reshape how objects are designed and realized in the physical world. Yet, producing elegant geometry is fundamentally different from producing objects that can be built and perform their intended functions. Existing evaluations largely focus on geometric quality while overlooking physical realizability. We introduce LMBuild, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on generating buildable and functional structures. LMBuild represents generated objects as assembled structures comprising part decompositions, joints, materials, and sequences. To support reproducible evaluation, we provide a unified framework consisting of: (1) an interactive environment in which agents can use tools to retrieve, create, and place components to construct objects; (2) a curated benchmark that repurposes established CAD datasets and augments them with knowledge from Wikipedia; and (3) a evaluation framework covering structural soundness, functional affordance, design quality, and physical realization. Evaluations across 30 systems reveal several intriguing findings: (a) Soundness and alignment are no longer the primary bottlenecks for frontier closed-source models, while functional affordance and physical operability remain substantially more challenging; (b) stronger models more effectively create new components, whereas weaker models tend to rely on retrieval; and (c) providing functional specifications substantially improves part completeness, kinematics, and physical operability. These results show that generating real-world structures requires deeper reasoning about functional affordances, mechanics, and designing and creating novel components. We expect LMBuild to provide a foundation for measuring progress and incentivizing research toward agents that generate buildable and functional structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LMBuild 是评测 LLM agent 生成可建造、可功能化 3D 结构的基准，把对象表示为含零件分解、关节、材料与装配序列的组装结构，并提供可交互工具环境、改造自既有 CAD 数据集并用 Wikipedia 知识增强的题库，以及覆盖结构稳固性、功能可供性、设计质量与物理实现的评测框架。在 30 个系统上评测发现：前沿闭源模型的 soundness 与 alignment 已非主要瓶颈，功能可供性与物理可操作性仍明显更难；强模型更会新建零件、弱模型依赖检索；给出功能规格说明可显著提升零件完整性、运动学与物理可操作性。
Motivation: 现有对 LLM 生成 3D 结构的评测只看几何质量，忽略物理可实现性，而几何优雅与真的造得出来、能发挥功能是两回事。
Method: LMBuild 将生成对象表示为组装结构（零件分解、关节、材料、装配序列），配套三件套：agent 可调用工具检索/创建/放置组件的交互环境；改造既有 CAD 数据集并用 Wikipedia 知识增强的基准题库；覆盖 structural soundness、functional affordance、design quality、physical realization 四维的评测框架。
Result: 在 30 个系统上评测：(a) soundness 与 alignment 对前沿闭源模型已不再是主要瓶颈，而 functional affordance 与 physical operability 仍显著更难；(b) 更强的模型更善于创建新组件，较弱的模型倾向依赖检索；(c) 提供功能规格说明 (functional specifications) 可显著改善零件完整性、kinematics 与物理可操作性。
Conclusion: 生成真实世界结构需要对功能可供性、力学以及设计与创建新零件做更深的推理，几何质量本身已不足以衡量进展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Local Fisher Information Enables Sparse Causal Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Sparse causal discovery calls for methods that exploit graph structure without estimating high-dimensional densities. We introduce Fisher Information Completion Search (FiCS), a source-first algorithm for additive noise models that uses one local Fisher score for both ordering and parent selection. Under regularity and nonconstant-parent conditions, we prove that a node's local Fisher information equals the noise Fisher information exactly when the conditioning set contains all parents, provided that it contains no descendants. This Fisher parent completion identifies the parent set as the unique minimal Fisher completion. With a maximum conditioning set size $q$ at least the maximum indegree $d$, population FiCS queries marginals of at most $q+1$ variables and recovers the true directed acyclic graph under a positive ordering margin. Bounded conditioning also has a population advantage: reducing $q$ toward $d$ cannot decrease, and can strictly increase, the ordering margin. A growing non-Gaussian family separates local Fisher selection from conditional-variance and leaf-first Fisher ordering. For the regularized kernel Stein estimator, we establish high-dimensional DAG consistency under $q\{1+\log(p/q)\}+\log p=o(n)$, uniform Fisher separation, local approximation, and compatible ridge and parent penalty parameters. Experiments show the strongest gains when $n$ is small relative to $p$, quantify the effect of the conditioning size, and demonstrate competitive reference-graph recovery on three real-data benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出稀疏因果发现算法 Fisher Information Completion Search (FiCS)，用同一个局部 Fisher score 同时做节点排序与父节点选择，并证明当条件集包含全部父节点且不含后代时，节点局部 Fisher 信息精确等于噪声 Fisher 信息，从而把父集识别为唯一的最小 Fisher completion。在 q≥d 与正排序裕度下总体 FiCS 恢复真实 DAG，且把 q 从大值压向 d 不会降低、还可能严格增大排序裕度；实验显示 n 相对 p 小时增益最强，并在三个真实数据基准上给出有竞争力的参考图恢复。
Motivation: 稀疏因果发现需要利用图结构但又不想估计高维密度；现有 Fisher 类方法在排序与父选择上分裂，且条件集大小对排序裕度的影响没有理论刻画。
Method: FiCS 是针对 additive noise models 的 source-first 算法：以一个局部 Fisher score 同时驱动排序与父节点选择，条件集大小上限 q；在正则性与非恒定父节点条件下证明 Fisher parent completion 定理，并对正则化 kernel Stein 估计器给出高维 DAG 一致性条件 q{1+log(p/q)}+log p=o(n)、一致 Fisher 分离、局部逼近以及 ridge 与父惩罚参数兼容。
Result: 总体层面：q≥d 时 FiCS 只查询至多 q+1 个变量的边缘分布，并在正排序裕度下恢复真实 DAG；把 q 减小到 d 不会降低、可严格增大排序裕度。理论还给出一个增长的非高斯族以区分局部 Fisher 选择与 conditional-variance、leaf-first Fisher 排序。实验显示 n 相对 p 小时增益最强，量化了条件集大小的影响，并在三个真实数据基准上展示有竞争力的参考图恢复。
Conclusion: 一个局部 Fisher score 足以同时完成排序与父选择，且有界的条件集大小在总体层面带来排序裕度上的优势；高维一致性由 q 的对数级增长条件支撑。

papers.title: Scaling of Wireless Foundation Models via Representation Diversity and Multi-Branch Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Wireless foundation models learn representations from unlabeled radio signals for reuse across downstream tasks. Scaling model capacity is a common strategy for learning richer representations and improving downstream performance. However, its gains are less consistent in wireless self-supervised learning when pretraining data are limited. We investigate objective diversity as an alternative scaling axis: different self-supervised objectives emphasize different signal properties, and combining their representations can preserve more information to enable diverse tasks. We develop a fusion framework that combines frozen representations from independent encoders trained through reconstructive, predictive, and contrastive learning. This provides a reference for the benefits of diversity, but requires the maintenance of multiple encoders. To retain these benefits within the parameter budget of a standard single-objective encoder, we introduce a jointly trained multi-branch architecture with a shared trunk and objective-specific branches. We pretrain on a heterogeneous corpus of spectrogram and channel state information data and evaluate six downstream tasks that span communication, sensing, and positioning. At an equal output embedding dimension, fusion outperforms the evaluated single-objective encoders on all six tasks while using roughly one-third of their parameters. The multi-branch architecture retains much of the fusion benefit within a single-encoder parameter budget. Representation analyses indicate complementary contributions across objectives, with much of the added benefit retained in components orthogonal to the reconstruction representation subspace. These findings support objective diversity as an effective strategy for scaling wireless foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 无线基础模型在预训练数据受限时靠加参数收益不稳，本文改用目标多样性 (objective diversity) 这条缩放轴：融合冻结的重构、预测、对比三种自监督编码器表征，并提出共享主干加目标专属分支的多分支架构。在等输出嵌入维度下，融合在通信、感知、定位六个下游任务上全部优于所评估的单目标编码器，参数量约为其三分之一。
Motivation: 无线自监督预训练数据有限时，扩大模型容量带来的下游收益不稳定，需要一条不依赖参数量的缩放路径。
Method: 先构建融合框架，拼接由重构、预测、对比三种目标独立训练的冻结编码器表征；再提出共享主干加目标专属分支的多分支架构，在单编码器参数预算内联合训练以保留多样性收益。预训练语料为异质的频谱图与信道状态信息 (CSI) 数据。
Result: 在等输出嵌入维度下，融合方法在全部六个下游任务上优于所评估的单目标编码器，参数量约为其三分之一；多分支架构在单编码器参数预算内保留了融合收益的大部分。表征分析显示各目标贡献互补，新增收益的大部分保留在与重构表征子空间正交的分量中。
Conclusion: 目标多样性是缩放无线基础模型的有效策略，可在不增加参数预算的前提下提升跨通信、感知、定位任务的表征复用能力。

papers.title: VIGIL: Verifier-Informed Gated Improvement Loop for Spreadsheet Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise agents should improve from delayed feedback without allowing every correction to rewrite system behavior. We study continual harness learning for corpus-level spreadsheet question answering. Building on FiCo (Find-then-Compute), a static retrieval-and-execution backbone, we introduce VIGIL (Verifier-Informed Gated Improvement Loop). Within a question, VIGIL verifies and repairs diversely prompted Structured Query Language (SQL) candidates. Across episodes, delayed labels update only a contract calibrator and query/result-column selector. The base model, prompts, retriever, and recorded candidate pool remain fixed in the continual-learning protocol. With the gold workbook and expected type supplied, the ungated and dual-gated full-replay variants reach 82.4% and 82.0% forward accuracy over 79 documents, from a 75.8% static baseline. The dual gate has the larger retrospective gain (2.7 versus 2.3 points), and its 6.3-point forward gain has a 95% t-interval of 5.6-6.9. In a separate stricter split that excludes 16 documents and 380 questions from fitting and online promotion, the accuracy-only gate raises mean held-out accuracy across ten final harnesses from 80.3% to 86.7%. Calibrator-only adaptation gains 5.9 points, close to the combined 6.4-point gain. Yet three of 26 gate-approved updates reduce held-out accuracy relative to their incumbents, so replay-buffer non-regression does not imply held-out non-regression. MiMoTable and external-task case studies test within-task verification and reuse the same promote-or-retain discipline. Overall, the results support bounded, auditable harness adaptation while revealing where finite replay gates fail to generalize beyond their promotion buffers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VIGIL 在语料级表格问答的持续 harness 学习中，只允许延迟标签更新契约校准器与查询/结果列选择器，模型、提示、检索器和候选池全部冻结。给定金标工作簿与期望类型时，ungated 与 dual-gated 全重放变体在 79 份文档上前向准确率分别达 82.4% 与 82.0%，高于 75.8% 静态基线；但 26 次门控批准更新中有 3 次反而降低留出准确率，说明重放缓冲不回退不等于留出集不回退。
Motivation: 企业 agent 需要从延迟反馈中改进，但不能让每次纠正都重写系统行为；语料级表格问答的持续学习里，如何在有限重放门控下做有界、可审计的适配是核心矛盾。
Method: 基于 FiCo (Find-then-Compute) 静态检索-执行骨干，提出 VIGIL：问题内用多样化提示生成 SQL 候选并做验证与修复；跨 episode 用延迟标签只更新契约校准器 (contract calibrator) 与查询/结果列选择器，基础模型、提示、检索器与候选池保持固定。另设 accuracy-only 门控与 dual gate，按 promote-or-retain 纪律决定是否采纳更新，并在 MiMoTable 与外部任务案例上检验。
Result: 给定金标工作簿与期望类型，ungated 与 dual-gated 全重放变体在 79 份文档上前向准确率 82.4% 与 82.0%，静态基线 75.8%；dual gate 回溯增益更大（2.7 对 2.3 点），其 6.3 点前向增益的 95% t 区间为 5.6–6.9。在排除 16 份文档、380 道题的更严划分上，accuracy-only 门控把十个最终 harness 的平均留出准确率从 80.3% 提到 86.7%；仅校准器适配增益 5.9 点，接近合并的 6.4 点。26 次门控批准更新中有 3 次相对在任版本降低留出准确率。
Conclusion: 有界、可审计的 harness 适配是可行的，且大部分增益来自校准器；但有限重放门控只保证缓冲内不回退，无法保证留出分布上的不回退。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CyTReX: Explainable AI-Based Cybersecurity Threat Reasoning Framework for DER Networks
papers.abstract_en: Distributed Energy Resource (DER) environments rely on network communication protocols to coordinate control commands, measurements, and device states across edge assets and cloud systems. Edge anomaly detection systems (ADS) monitor this traffic to identify deviations from normal communication behavior, flagging suspicious flows for further investigation. When the ADS flags abnormal network traffic, a single attack label is often insufficient for operational response: the label reports the detector's selected class but does not expose alternative threat interpretations that may warrant investigation. This paper presents Cybersecurity Threat Reasoning with Explainable Artificial Intelligence (CyTReX), an evidence-grounded threat reasoning framework for DER security that transforms network-level anomaly alerts into ranked, analyst-facing threat hypotheses designed to support Security Operations Center (SOC) triage and investigation. CyTReX constrains large language model (LLM) reasoning through a structured evidence packet, defined as a consolidated record of detection outputs, model explanations, and cyber threat intelligence (CTI) context. The evidence packet integrates edge-layer anomaly detection evidence, cloud reasoning layer attack interpretation, Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) network-feature attributions, surrogate decision rules, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-enabled CTI enrichment. This ensures that every ranked hypothesis and attack-tree branch is traceable to explicit evidence rather than free-form LLM inference, and that incomplete or conflicting evidence is communicated rather than suppressed. Evaluation across five configurations shows that additional reasoning components improve hypothesis specificity, evidence traceability, and analytical grounding, with the complete pipeline providing the richest evidence-grounded reasoning context.
papers.comment: Paper Presented at the 2026 Resilience Week, National Habor, Maryland, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CyTReX 面向 DER 网络 SOC 分诊，把边缘异常检测告警转成排序后的威胁假设而非单一攻击标签：用结构化 evidence packet 约束 LLM 推理，packet 汇聚检测输出、SHAP 特征归因、代理决策规则与 MCP 富化的 CTI 上下文。五种配置的评估显示，推理组件越多，假设具体性、证据可追溯性与分析依据越强，完整 pipeline 提供最丰富的证据支撑推理上下文。
Motivation: 边缘异常检测系统 (ADS) 只给出单一攻击标签，暴露检测器选中的类别却不呈现其他可能的威胁解释，SOC 分诊与调查难以据此响应。
Method: 以结构化 evidence packet 约束 LLM 推理，packet 整合边缘层异常检测证据、云推理层攻击解释、SHAP 网络特征归因、代理决策规则，以及经 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 富化的 cyber threat intelligence (CTI)；每个排序假设与 attack-tree 分支都须追溯到显式证据，证据不完整或冲突时如实呈现。
Result: 在五种配置上的评估中，增加推理组件会提升假设具体性、证据可追溯性与分析依据强度，完整 pipeline 提供最丰富的证据支撑推理上下文。
Conclusion: 用证据包约束 LLM 而非放任自由推理，可让 DER 威胁假设逐条对应显式证据，从而支撑 SOC 分诊；组件越完整，推理上下文越充分。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Amortized Score-Hamiltonian Policy Iteration: A Grid-Free Scheme for Relaxed Stochastic Control Problems
papers.abstract_en: We develop an amortized, grid-free implementation of continuous Langevin dynamics based policy-value iteration for entropy-regularized, infinite-horizon relaxed stochastic control problems. The improvement rate of the exact iteration is a discounted aggregate of relative Fisher information between the policy and the Gibbs law of its Hamiltonian. The associated score residual is the velocity with which the control's Langevin dynamics transport its law. We project this velocity onto a conditional sampler shared across states, instead of one Langevin dynamics per state, and the value dynamics onto a parametric critic, estimating both projections at sampled states to obtain coupled actor--critic flows. The score loss measures the actor's agreement with the current critic, while the policy-evaluation residual measures the critic's agreement with the actor. We also derive gradient and Hessian residuals, including a Feynman--Kac representation for the gradient equation, to control errors not detected by the projected value iteration. An exact decomposition of the HJB residual combines these errors into a policy-suboptimality bound under verification and logarithmic Sobolev assumptions. In the linear-quadratic class, both projections are exact and recover the pointwise iteration, and we provide numerical experiments on general models to demonstrate the coupled actor--critic learning in high-dimensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把连续 Langevin 动力学的 policy-value iteration 做成摊销、无网格的 actor-critic 形式：将 score 残差这一输运速度投影到跨状态共享的条件采样器上，将值迭代投影到参数化 critic，并用梯度与 Hessian 残差补捉投影值迭代检测不到的误差。在验证与对数 Sobolev 假设下，HJB 残差的精确分解给出策略次优性上界；线性二次类中两个投影都精确并还原逐点迭代，高维一般模型的数值实验展示了耦合 actor-critic 学习。
Motivation: 熵正则化的无限时域松弛随机控制中，逐状态 Langevin 动力学需要为每个状态各跑一条，无法在高维状态空间上摊销实现。
Method: 以相对 Fisher information 的折扣聚合刻画精确迭代的改进率，把 score 残差（控制 Langevin 动力学输运其分布的速度）投影到跨状态共享的条件采样器，把值动力学投影到参数化 critic，在采样状态上估计两个投影得到耦合 actor-critic 流；score loss 度量 actor 与当前 critic 的一致性，policy-evaluation residual 度量 critic 与 actor 的一致性；另导出梯度与 Hessian 残差（含梯度方程的 Feynman--Kac 表示），并用 HJB 残差的精确分解合并这些误差。
Result: 在验证 (verification) 与对数 Sobolev 假设下得到策略次优性上界；线性二次 (LQ) 类中两个投影均精确并恢复逐点迭代；在一般模型上给出数值实验以展示高维中的耦合 actor-critic 学习（摘要未列具体数值）。
Conclusion: 摊销的无网格 score-Hamiltonian 策略迭代可把逐状态 Langevin 控制迭代压缩为共享条件采样器加 critic 的耦合流，且在 LQ 类中不损失精确性。

papers.title: First-Order Steering: Translating Weight Adaptation into Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering exploits interpretable directions in the residual stream to enable inference-time manipulation of model behavior. Composing steering vectors to apply multiple target behaviors simultaneously is important in various fields-including AI alignment and safety-but remains a challenge for existing activation steering methods. In contrast, prior work in model merging shows that target behaviors represented by learned weight adaptations can be combined with high accuracy. A method that translates weight adaptations into activation steering vectors could therefore extend prior work in model merging to generate composable steering vectors that better enable simultaneous inference-time behavioral control. For this, we introduce First-Order Steering, a formulation of activation steering as a first-order approximation of weight update matrices parameterized by a vector of steering strengths, and establish theoretical bounds on the approximation error of first-order steering. We then develop a novel model merging procedure, HeRD-Merging, which minimizes the first-order approximation error terms to enable higher first-order steering accuracy. Together, our method produces steering vectors that control both individual and composed behaviors more accurately than existing activation steering methods. Furthermore, HeRD-Merging matches the performance of conventional model-merging baselines, while producing weight adaptations that admit more accurate first-order steering vectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 First-Order Steering：把激活引导 (activation steering) 写成权重更新矩阵的一阶近似，由引导强度向量参数化，并给出近似误差的理论界；配套的 HeRD-Merging 合并流程最小化这些一阶误差项。生成的引导向量在单独与组合行为控制上都比现有激活引导方法更准，同时 HeRD-Merging 达到常规模型合并基线的性能。
Motivation: 现有激活引导方法难以把多个引导向量组合起来同时施加多种目标行为，而模型合并已能高精度组合权重侧的目标行为；若能把权重适应翻译成引导向量，就能把模型合并的组合能力带进推理时行为控制。
Method: 将激活引导形式化为权重更新矩阵的一阶近似，用引导强度向量参数化并建立近似误差理论界；在此基础上提出 HeRD-Merging 模型合并流程，直接最小化一阶近似误差项以提高一阶引导精度。
Result: 该方法产生的引导向量在控制单独行为与组合行为时都比现有激活引导方法更准确；HeRD-Merging 在性能上与常规模型合并基线相当，同时产出的权重适应能给出更准确的一阶引导向量。
Conclusion: 把权重适应按一阶近似翻译成激活引导向量，可以在保留模型合并组合能力的同时提升推理时多行为同时控制的精度。
