papers.title: OctMesh: A Unified Octree-Hierarchical Framework for Lossless Triangle Mesh Compression
papers.abstract_en: Lossless triangle mesh compression must preserve both vertex positions and connectivity. Octrees support learned point cloud geometry coding and progressive refinement, but extending them to meshes requires a compatible connectivity representation. Unlike the eight occupancy decisions of a voxel, a parent edge can develop into varied child connections, making edge refinement difficult to model with a compact prediction prior. We propose OctMesh, a learned framework that codes geometry and connectivity on a shared octree hierarchy. Its key observation is that octree pooling produces parents with either one child or two to eight children. Child edges are then grouped by their endpoint parents' types and whether the endpoints share a parent. Each candidate group contains children from just one parent or two connected parents. The resulting four categories define small, fixed-shape prediction tasks: connections uniquely determined by the parent graph are inherited without bits, while three neural predictors estimate probabilities for the remaining candidates. These probabilities guide arithmetic coding of the actual edge symbols. Binarized predictions of within-parent connections provide context for predicting connections between different parents. A graph-aware parent feature extractor combines local geometry, parent connectivity and global shape. The connectivity models use dedicated weights at coarse levels and share weights at fine levels. Residual edges and a finest-level face-selection payload complete the reconstruction. On 256 frames from eight MPEG V-DMC test sequences, OctMesh losslessly recovers the finest-level vertex-coordinate, edge and unoriented face sets at an average of 7.033 bits per face, 12.8% below V-Mesh. The same hierarchical representation supports nine levels of progressive vertex-and-edge refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OctMesh 把三角网格的几何与连通性统一编码在同一棵 octree 层级上：按父节点子节点数与端点是否共享父节点把子边分成四类固定形状的预测任务，由三个神经预测器给出概率驱动算术编码。在 MPEG V-DMC 的 8 条测试序列共 256 帧上无损恢复最细层顶点坐标、边与无向面集合，平均每面 7.033 bits，比 V-Mesh 低 12.8%，同一表示还支持九层渐进式顶点-边细化。
Motivation: octree 已支撑点云几何编码与渐进细化，但体素的八种占据决策无法直接套到网格：一条父边可演化出多种子连接，缺少紧凑预测先验就难以对边细化建模。
Method: 在共享 octree 层级上分别编码几何与连通性；octree 池化使父节点只有一子或二至八子，据此按端点父节点类型及是否共享父节点把子边分成四类小固定形状预测任务。父图已唯一确定的连接零比特继承，其余候选由三个神经预测器估计概率并引导算术编码；同父内部连接的二值化预测作为跨父预测的上下文，图感知父特征提取器融合局部几何、父连通性与全局形状，连通性模型在粗层用独立权重、细层共享权重，再加残余边与最细层面选择载荷完成重建。
Result: 在 8 条 MPEG V-DMC 测试序列的 256 帧上，无损恢复最细层顶点坐标、边与无向面集合，平均 7.033 bits per face，比 V-Mesh 低 12.8%；同一层级表示支持九层渐进式顶点与边细化。
Conclusion: 把网格连通性按父节点类型分组成固定形状的小预测任务，可在 octree 上同时实现无损压缩与渐进细化，且比 V-Mesh 更省码率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dense Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning in a Unified Geometry State
papers.abstract_en: Geometry reasoning is naturally stateful: solving a problem repeatedly alternates between structural proposals and exact deductions. We formulate this process as dense neural-symbolic coupling, in which neural guidance and symbolic execution share a typed state and communicate through executable actions at every search step. Neural proposals contribute theorem instances, constructions, and algebraic bridges; the symbolic runtime applies registered rules, propagates exact constraints, and records provenance. A nested controller allocates computation first between neural and symbolic proposal sources and then among admitted actions. We instantiate the framework in OmniGeo, a single solver for plane, analytic, and solid geometry. With Claude Sonnet 4.6, OmniGeo reaches 94.2%, 88.5%, and 89.8% on FormalGeo7K, Conic10K, and SolidFGeo, respectively (90.8% macro average), and solves 21/30 IMO-AG-30 problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniGeo 把几何题求解写成神经与符号共享类型化状态、每步通过可执行动作通信的稠密耦合搜索，嵌套控制器先在神经/符号提案源之间分配算力、再在被接纳动作间分配。配合 Claude Sonnet 4.6，在 FormalGeo7K、Conic10K、SolidFGeo 上分别达到 94.2%、88.5%、89.8%（宏平均 90.8%），并解出 IMO-AG-30 的 21/30 题。
Motivation: 几何求解需要在结构提案与精确推导之间反复切换，神经引导与符号执行若各自为政，状态不共享、每步无法互相约束。
Method: 提出稠密神经-符号耦合框架：神经提案产生定理实例、构造与代数桥梁，符号运行时应用已注册规则、传播精确约束并记录 provenance；嵌套控制器先在神经与符号提案源之间分配计算，再在被接纳的动作之间分配。实例化为统一求解器 OmniGeo，覆盖平面、解析与立体几何，实验用 Claude Sonnet 4.6 驱动。
Result: OmniGeo 在 FormalGeo7K 上 94.2%、Conic10K 上 88.5%、SolidFGeo 上 89.8%，宏平均 90.8%；在 IMO-AG-30 上解出 21/30 题。
Conclusion: 让神经引导与符号执行共享类型化状态并在每步以可执行动作通信，可在单一求解器内同时覆盖三类几何并取得高正确率。

papers.title: Do RUL explanations hold up? Faithfulness and stability of attributions on C-MAPSS
papers.abstract_en: Deep remaining-useful-life (RUL) models on NASA C-MAPSS are now routine, and so are heatmaps that colour sensors and timesteps. A heatmap that looks mechanical is not the same as an explanation an engineer can act on. We train three standard architectures - a 1D CNN, an LSTM, and a small Transformer encoder - on the official FD001 and FD003 splits with the piecewise RUL cap of 125 cycles and the official PHM08 asymmetric score. We then attach three attribution maps (Integrated Gradients, occlusion, last-layer attention) and evaluate them with the checks the XAI-for-PdM literature still under-reports: deletion/insertion faithfulness, Spearman stability under sensor-scale noise, agreement across training seeds, and cosine consistency inside RUL bins. Prediction error is a prerequisite, not the claim. The headline is which explanation method moves the RUL output when its top cells are removed, and which map survives a 5% input perturbation. Integrated Gradients and occlusion are similarly faithful on the LSTM; Transformer attention is cheap and temporally smooth but weakly faithful. All three maps are almost unchanged under 5% input noise, yet IG/occlusion agree only moderately across two LSTM seeds - stability to sensor jitter is not the same as stability to retraining. A secondary tabular check on the AI4I 2020 failure dataset shows the same deletion pattern for tree importances. We recommend occlusion or IG for any C-MAPSS-style report that will be read by a maintenance engineer, and we treat raw attention weights as a visualisation only.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 NASA C-MAPSS 上对 1D CNN、LSTM、小型 Transformer 三种 RUL 模型附加 Integrated Gradients、occlusion、末层 attention 三种归因图，用 deletion/insertion 忠实度、5% 输入噪声下的 Spearman 稳定性、跨训练种子一致性检验解释是否可靠。IG 与 occlusion 在 LSTM 上忠实度相当，Transformer attention 便宜且时间平滑但忠实度弱；三者在 5% 噪声下几乎不变，但 IG/occlusion 在两个 LSTM 种子间仅中等一致，说明抗传感器抖动不等于抗重训。作者建议面向维护工程师的 C-MAPSS 类报告用 occlusion 或 IG，把原始 attention 权重仅当可视化。
Motivation: C-MAPSS 上深度 RUL 模型与传感器/时间步热图已成惯例，但看起来像机械解释不等于工程师可据以行动的解释；XAI-for-PdM 文献对忠实度与稳定性检验报告不足。
Method: 在官方 FD001 与 FD003 划分上训练 1D CNN、LSTM、小型 Transformer encoder，RUL 采用 125 cycles 的分段上限与官方 PHM08 非对称分数；附加 Integrated Gradients、occlusion、末层 attention 三种归因，用 deletion/insertion 忠实度、传感器尺度噪声下的 Spearman 稳定性、跨训练种子一致性、RUL 分箱内 cosine 一致性四项检验，并在 AI4I 2020 故障数据集上做树重要度的辅助表格核对。
Result: IG 与 occlusion 在 LSTM 上忠实度相近；Transformer attention 计算便宜、时间平滑但忠实度弱。三种图在 5% 输入噪声下几乎不变，但 IG/occlusion 在两个 LSTM 种子间仅中等一致。AI4I 2020 上的树重要度呈现相同的 deletion 模式。
Conclusion: 抗传感器抖动的稳定性与抗重训的稳定性不是一回事，面向维护工程师的 C-MAPSS 类报告应选 occlusion 或 IG，原始 attention 权重只作可视化。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.method: 在官方 FD001 与 FD003 划分上训练 1D CNN、LSTM、小型 Transformer encoder，RUL 采用 125 cycles 的分段上限与官方 PHM08 非对称分数；附加 Integrated Gradients、occlusion、末层 attention 三种归因，用 deletion/insertion 忠实度、传感器尺度噪声下的 Spearman 稳定性、跨训练种子一致性、RUL 分箱内 cosine 一致性四项检验，并在 AI4I 2020 故障数据集上做树重要度的辅助表格核对。
summary_sections.result: IG 与 occlusion 在 LSTM 上忠实度相近；Transformer attention 计算便宜、时间平滑但忠实度弱。三种图在 5% 输入噪声下几乎不变，但 IG/occlusion 在两个 LSTM 种子间仅中等一致。AI4I 2020 上的树重要度呈现相同的 deletion 模式。
summary_sections.conclusion: 抗传感器抖动的稳定性与抗重训的稳定性不是一回事，面向维护工程师的 C-MAPSS 类报告应选 occlusion 或 IG，原始 attention 权重只作可视化。

papers.title: Integrated Imputation-Classification for Supervised Learning with Missing Data
papers.abstract_en: We study supervised classification problems with missing feature values. Existing approaches often decouple imputation from classification, producing imputations that may be plausible but uninformative for prediction. Instead, we propose the Integrated Imputation and Classification Network (IICN), which jointly trains an imputer and an ${(n{+}1)}$-classdiscriminator adversarially with a single class supervised classification objective, where the discriminator learns to distinguish among the $n$ true classes and an additional ``imputed" class. We prove that at the global optimum, the imputer and discriminator together implement marginalization over missing coordinates and yield a Bayes-optimal classifier. We evaluate IICN on FashionMNIST, CIFAR-10, and tabular datasets with naturally occurring missingness. IICN outperforms classical impute-then-classify pipelines and recent generative baselines, showing strong robustness and accuracy in challenging settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 IICN（Integrated Imputation and Classification Network），把插补器与一个 (n+1) 类判别器联合对抗训练：判别器区分 n 个真实类与额外的 imputed 类，用单一类别监督分类目标驱动。证明在全局最优处二者等价于对缺失坐标做边缘化并得到 Bayes 最优分类器；在 FashionMNIST、CIFAR-10 及含自然缺失的表格数据上，IICN 优于经典 impute-then-classify 流水线与近期生成式基线。
Motivation: 监督分类中特征缺失时，先插补再分类的解耦做法产生的插补值看似合理却对预测无信息，导致分类性能与鲁棒性受损。
Method: IICN 联合训练插补器与 (n+1) 类判别器，判别器在 n 个真实类之外增加一个 imputed 类，训练信号为单一类别监督的对抗分类目标；理论上证明全局最优时插补器与判别器的组合实现对缺失坐标的边缘化并给出 Bayes 最优分类器。
Result: 在 FashionMNIST、CIFAR-10 以及含自然缺失 (naturally occurring missingness) 的表格数据集上评测，IICN 在准确率与鲁棒性上超过经典 impute-then-classify 流水线和近期生成式基线；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把插补与分类放进同一个对抗式监督目标，可在全局最优处还原边缘化与 Bayes 最优分类，因而在难设置下同时拿到更强的准确率与鲁棒性。

papers.title: Rethinking Self-Distillation for Multi-Teacher Capability Merging
papers.abstract_en: Combining capabilities of multiple expert models trained starting from the same base checkpoint has become increasingly common in frontier language-model post-training. Recent trends suggest that multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) outperforms conventional off-policy methods. However, despite the higher inference and environment interaction costs incurred by MOPD, we find that much of its reported accuracy gain is due to certain training design choices and hyperparameter optimization, rather than the algorithm itself. We conduct a controlled self-distillation study across two multi-teacher settings, four models, and eleven benchmarks, comparing off-policy methods, namely supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and soft-label distillation, to hybrid teacher-prefix distillation and MOPD. We found that all four methods achieve \textit{nearly identical} accuracy. However, MOPD uses $14.8$--$23.1\times$ SFT's training GPU-hours. We also revisit four recently published comparisons between on-policy and off-policy distillation and find that the reported on-policy gains shrink substantially when SFT baselines are trained on rejection-sampled teacher trajectories and use independently tuned hyperparameters. As a training-free alternative, we also find that simple weight-merging methods can recover expert capabilities with minutes of CPU merging time, although their accuracy degrades as model size decreases and task interference increases. Overall, our results question recent gains reported due to MOPD and suggest careful tuning of more efficient off-policy baselines as a viable alternative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多教师能力合并场景下，受控自蒸馏实验显示 on-policy 的 MOPD 与 off-policy 的 SFT、soft-label 蒸馏、teacher-prefix 蒸馏四种方法准确率几乎相同，而 MOPD 的训练 GPU-hours 是 SFT 的 14.8–23.1 倍。重审四篇近期 on-policy vs off-policy 对比后发现，当 SFT 基线用拒绝采样的教师轨迹训练并独立调参时，报告中的 on-policy 增益大幅缩水。作者主张优先精调更省算力的 off-policy 基线，而非默认采用 MOPD。
Motivation: 前沿语言模型后训练中，多教师 on-policy 蒸馏 (MOPD) 被报告优于 off-policy 方法，但其推理与环境交互成本更高；这些增益究竟来自算法本身还是训练设计与超参搜索，此前未被分离。
Method: 在两个多教师设定、四个模型、十一个 benchmark 上做受控自蒸馏研究，对比 off-policy 的 SFT 与 soft-label 蒸馏，以及 hybrid teacher-prefix 蒸馏和 MOPD；另重审四篇已发表的 on-policy vs off-policy 对比，并测试免训练的权重合并 (weight merging) 作为替代。
Result: 四种蒸馏方法准确率几乎一致，而 MOPD 消耗 SFT 的 14.8–23.1 倍训练 GPU-hours；重审的四篇对比中，当 SFT 基线用拒绝采样教师轨迹训练并独立调参后，on-policy 增益大幅缩水。权重合并只需数分钟 CPU 合并时间即可恢复专家能力，但准确率随模型变小、任务干扰增大而下降。
Conclusion: MOPD 报告的增益主要来自训练设计选择与超参优化而非算法本身，精调更高效的 off-policy 基线是可行替代；权重合并可作免训练方案，但受模型规模与任务干扰限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning: Enhancing Agent Security against Prompt Injection Attacks from Failure Experience
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in tool-augmented environments, but their reliance on external inputs makes them highly vulnerable to prompt injection attacks that can hijack task objectives. Existing safety alignment methods rely on static expert trajectories or preference optimization, limiting their ability to generalize to adaptive attack patterns. In this work, we propose Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning (SRFT), a training framework that enables agents to improve robustness by learning from their own failure experiences under adversarial conditions. Instead of passively imitating expert behaviors, SRFT exposes the agent to compromised trajectories constructed via injected attacks, and leverages an expert model to generate structured self-reflection reasoning that contrasts unsafe and optimal actions. This reflective supervision teaches the agent to identify malicious instructions, reason about their consequences, and maintain alignment with the original user intent. We instantiate this framework in SR-Agent, built on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B, and evaluate it on both static and adaptive prompt injection benchmarks. Experimental results show that SRFT substantially reduces attack success rates while preserving task performance, and demonstrates strong generalization under adaptive attacks. These findings suggest that learning from failure via self-reflection is a promising direction for building robust and secure LLM agents. Our code is released at https://github.com/Eden-Wang1710/srft-repo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning (SRFT)：让 LLM agent 在注入攻击构造的失败轨迹上，用专家模型生成对比不安全与最优动作的结构化反思推理，再据此微调。实例化为基于 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 Qwen3-8B 的 SR-Agent，在静态与自适应 prompt injection 基准上显著降低攻击成功率，同时保持任务性能。
Motivation: 现有安全对齐依赖静态专家轨迹或偏好优化，难以泛化到自适应攻击模式；工具增强环境中的 LLM agent 依赖外部输入，容易被 prompt injection 劫持任务目标。
Method: SRFT 不模仿专家行为，而是把 agent 暴露于注入攻击构造的 compromised trajectories，由专家模型生成对比 unsafe 与 optimal 动作的结构化 self-reflection 推理作为监督信号，训练 agent 识别恶意指令、推理其后果并保持原始用户意图；实例为 SR-Agent，底座 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 Qwen3-8B。
Result: 在静态与自适应 prompt injection 两类基准上，SRFT substantially 降低攻击成功率 (attack success rate)，同时保持任务性能，并在自适应攻击下展现强泛化；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 从自身失败经验中通过自我反思学习，是构建鲁棒安全 LLM agent 的可行路径，优于依赖静态专家轨迹的对齐方式；代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI-Enabled Quality Assurance for Multiple-Choice Assessment Items
papers.abstract_en: Generating multiple-choice questions is increasingly scalable, but establishing their assessment quality remains difficult. We present a focused narrative review of automated item-writing flaw detection, revision, psychometric screening, and NLP benchmark auditing. Database searches, citation retrieval, and nominated sources yield fourteen research reports reviewed in full text. We distinguish surface checks from content-sensitive judgments and map a 19-criterion rubric to detection methods and reported evidence. High label-level accuracy often coexists with weak positive case detection, while rubric definitions and reference standards vary. Revision evidence is mixed, and the associations reported in prior work do not establish the effects of repair. We propose evaluating quality assurance as a sequence of independently validated decisions, with criterion-specific reporting, calibrated human review, and outcome-based assessment of revisions.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 tables, Full paper accepted to the AIME Conference 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于选择题（MCQ）自动质量保证的聚焦性叙述综述：全文精读 14 份研究报告，把 19 条评分准则 (rubric) 映射到检测方法与所报告证据，并区分表层检查与内容敏感判断。核心发现是标签级准确率常与弱阳性病例检出并存，且既往研究报告的关联无法确立修复 (repair) 的效果；作者主张把质量保证当作一系列独立验证的决策来评估。
Motivation: MCQ 生成已可规模化，但其考核质量难以确立：不同工作的 rubric 定义与参照标准不一致，高标签级准确率掩盖了弱的阳性病例检出，修订效果的证据相互矛盾。
Method: 通过数据库检索、引文追溯与 nominated sources 检索文献，全文精读 14 份研究报告；区分表层检查与内容敏感判断，把 19 条 rubric 准则逐条映射到检测方法及其所报告证据，覆盖缺陷检测、修订、心理测量筛查与 NLP 基准审计。
Result: 纳入 14 份全文研究报告，构建含 19 条准则的映射；发现标签级准确率常与弱阳性病例检出并存，rubric 定义与参照标准在各研究间不一致，修订证据好坏参半，既往研究报告的关联不能确立修复的效果。
Conclusion: 质量保证应按一系列独立验证的决策来评估：逐准则报告、校准的人工复核，并用基于结果的方式评估修订是否真的有效。

papers.title: Adaptive Bregman Alternating Projections for Feasible Gromov-Wasserstein Learning
papers.abstract_en: The Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) problem compares structured distributions without requiring a shared feature space or known correspondences, but its nonconvex objective and coupled marginal constraints make computation challenging. Bregman alternating projected gradient (BAPG) uses inexpensive alternating row and column updates, yet its fixed-penalty relaxation leaves a persistent feasibility gap. We propose Adaptive KL-BAPG (A-KL-BAPG), which combines a finite fixed-penalty burn-in with a guarded increasing-penalty phase. At each tail iteration, the method reuses BAPG's alternating updates and backtracks a delayed-power step until a Sinkhorn-inspired projective-diameter safeguard is satisfied. We prove finite termination of the backtracking at each iteration and show that the feasibility gap vanishes asymptotically. We further establish a best-iterate $O(1/\log N)$ bound for the weighted squared corrected residual and, under a support regularity condition, the existence of a stationary accumulation point for the original GW problem. This distinguishes A-KL-BAPG from fixed-penalty BAPG, whose stationarity guarantees are given for the relaxed problem. Experiments show that A-KL-BAPG achieves a favorable balance of accuracy, objective value, feasibility, and stationarity relative to BAPG variants, projection-based methods, and task-specific baselines. For synthetic and real graph alignment problems, it closely matches the accuracy and objective value of fixed-penalty KL-BAPG while reducing the marginal feasibility gap by 62-99% and the projected stationarity residual by 28-98%. Heterogeneous domain adaptation experiments show a similar pattern: A-KL-BAPG maintains comparable target accuracy and objective values while achieving better feasibility and stationarity than fixed-penalty KL-BAPG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) 优化中固定罚项松弛留下的持续可行性缺口，提出 A-KL-BAPG：先做有限固定罚项 burn-in，再进入罚项受控递增阶段，每步尾迭代复用 BAPG 的行列交替更新并回溯延迟幂次步长，直到满足 Sinkhorn 式投影直径安全条件。图对齐实验中它在精度与目标值上接近固定罚项 KL-BAPG，同时把边缘可行性缺口降低 62-99%、投影平稳性残差降低 28-98%。
Motivation: GW 问题非凸且带耦合边缘约束，BAPG 的行列交替更新虽便宜，但固定罚项松弛始终留有可行性缺口，且其平稳性保证只针对松弛问题而非原 GW 问题。
Method: A-KL-BAPG 分两阶段：有限固定罚项 burn-in 后转入 guarded increasing-penalty 阶段；尾迭代复用 BAPG 的交替行列更新，并对延迟幂次步长做回溯，直到满足 Sinkhorn 启发的 projective-diameter safeguard。证明每次迭代回溯有限终止、可行性缺口渐近消失，并给出加权平方修正残差的 best-iterate O(1/log N) 界；在支撑正则条件下给出原 GW 问题的平稳聚点存在性。
Result: 合成与真实图对齐任务上，A-KL-BAPG 的精度与目标值接近固定罚项 KL-BAPG，边缘可行性缺口降低 62-99%，投影平稳性残差降低 28-98%；异构域适应实验中目标精度与目标值相当，而可行性与平稳性优于固定罚项 KL-BAPG。理论界为 best-iterate O(1/log N)。
Conclusion: 把固定罚项换成受控递增罚项加投影直径回溯，可在不牺牲精度与目标值的前提下消除 GW 松弛的可行性缺口，并把平稳性保证从松弛问题推到原 GW 问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CADForge: Agentic Single-View CAD Reconstruction with Explicit Geometry Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing editable parametric CAD models from a single-view image is of great practical value for modern manufacturing, yet remains challenging due to incomplete geometric observations and complex inter-part relationships. To address it, we propose CADForge, an agentic framework that progressively converts a single image into CadQuery programs. CADForge decomposes an object into CAD-meaningful components and performs explicit geometric reasoning for each component, a process that first identifies CAD-relevant constraints and then translates them into precise modeling parameters through mathematical code. The inferred parameters then drive component-wise synthesis of executable CadQuery programs, with a review agent evaluating the resulting geometry and providing targeted feedback for iterative refinement. To further improve robustness and efficiency, CADForge incorporates a failure-guided toolkit construction mechanism to distill accumulated experience into tools, and maintains a compact parametric CAD memory for retrieving modeling context on demand. Experiments on diverse single- and multi-part objects show that CADForge consistently outperforms existing baselines in reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality, demonstrating an effective approach to accurate single-view CAD reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CADForge 把单视图图像逐步转成可执行的 CadQuery 程序：先按 CAD 语义拆分部件，识别几何约束并用数学代码解出建模参数，再由 review agent 评估生成几何并给出定向反馈迭代修正。在单部件与多部件对象上，其重建保真度与感知质量一致优于现有基线。
Motivation: 单视图重建可编辑参数化 CAD 模型在制造中价值高，但观测不完整、部件间关系复杂，现有方法难以恢复可编辑的参数化表达。
Method: Agentic 流水线：把对象分解为 CAD 有意义的部件，对每个部件先识别 CAD 相关约束、再用数学代码翻译成精确建模参数，驱动逐部件合成可执行 CadQuery 程序；review agent 评估几何并提供定向反馈做迭代精修，另有 failure-guided toolkit construction 把经验蒸馏成工具、参数化 CAD memory 按需检索建模上下文。
Result: 在多样的单部件与多部件对象实验中，CADForge 在重建保真度 (reconstruction fidelity) 与感知质量 (perceptual quality) 上一致优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 显式几何约束推理加 agent 式迭代修正，是单视图 CAD 重建走向准确且可编辑参数化模型的有效路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Playing social deduction games with reinforcement fine-tuned large language models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) is increasingly used in applications where large language models (LLMs) interact with humans and other agents. Here we use social deduction games to study how RFT changes LLMs' social behaviour. We let fine-tuned and base LLM agents play hidden-role games that require hidden-state inference, social reading and vote steering. Our results show that LLM agents do not reliably acquire social-deduction ability by directly optimizing terminal win--loss outcomes, suggesting that final game results provide a sparse and noisy signal for socially interactive learning. However, RFT is particularly effective at improving social reading, including tasks that require agents to infer hidden roles from public discussion, update beliefs over time and predict other agents' future decisions. We further show that RFT can also improve social influence, including tasks that require agents to steer votes, team approvals and collective decisions, although these gains depend more strongly on behaviourally specific rewards and structured interaction settings. Finally, we show that LLMs' ability to play social deduction games can be further improved through multi-agent social-cognitive reinforcement fine-tuning, which combines social-reading and social-influence signals during same-side multi-agent training. These learned behaviours also receive more favourable human evaluations of strategic competence, persuasiveness and social usefulness. Together, these results enrich our understanding of how RFT changes LLMs' social behaviour and provide a step toward a behavioural learning theory for machine social intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用社交推理游戏检验强化微调 (RFT) 如何改变 LLM 的社会行为：直接优化终局胜负无法可靠获得社交推理能力，因为终局结果是稀疏且含噪的信号；RFT 在社会阅读（从公开讨论推断隐藏角色、随时间更新信念、预测他人决策）和社交影响（引导投票、团队批准与集体决策）上有效，后者更依赖行为特异性奖励与结构化交互设置。结合社会阅读与社会影响信号的同阵营多智能体 social-cognitive RFT 进一步提升表现，且这些行为在人类评估中对策略能力、说服力与社会有用性评价更好。
Motivation: RFT 被广泛用于 LLM 与人和其他智能体交互的场景，但终局胜负这类奖励能否真正塑造社会交互行为尚不清楚，需要区分哪些社会能力可被稀疏结果信号学到。
Method: 让微调后与基座 LLM 智能体玩需要隐藏状态推理、社会阅读与投票引导的隐藏身份游戏；比较直接优化终局胜负的 RFT 与行为特异性奖励，并提出 multi-agent social-cognitive reinforcement fine-tuning，在同阵营多智能体训练中同时结合社会阅读与社会影响信号。
Result: 直接优化终局胜负不能可靠获得社交推理能力，终局结果被判定为稀疏且含噪的学习信号；RFT 在社会阅读类任务（从公开讨论推断隐藏角色、信念更新、预测他人决策）上提升明显，在引导投票、团队批准与集体决策等社交影响任务上也有效但更依赖行为特异性奖励和结构化交互设置；social-cognitive RFT 进一步提升游戏表现，学到的行为在人类评估中对战略能力、说服力和社会有用性获得更有利的评价。
Conclusion: 社会行为的可学习性取决于奖励粒度：稀疏终局胜负不足以学到社交推理，行为特异性奖励加结构化多智能体交互才有效，这为机器社会智能的行为学习理论提供了初步框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cross-Trait Transfer in Subliminal Learning
papers.abstract_en: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon where a student language model acquires a teacher model's behavioral traits by training on semantically unrelated outputs. It is a subtle statistical phenomenon as trait transmission relies on weak statistical patterns in the generated data. To understand trait transmission between teacher-student pairs, we study cross-trait transfer: how data generated under one teacher trait changes the student's preferences of other traits. To this end, we introduce a directed trait-transfer matrix that quantifies these effects using log-probability gains for student answers. We find that the trait-transfer matrix reveals clusters of related traits, with students sometimes developing preferences for traits similar, but not identical, to the teacher's trait. Such cross-trait structure can be partially captured by output distribution metrics and representation-based metrics. Further, we analyze trait development and interaction: learning dynamics shows a progression from broad shared shifts toward more trait-specific transfer, and multi-trait experiments suggest that opposed traits can enhance such differentiation. Together, our findings reveal salient statistical structures over trait transfer and competition, thus providing a broader view of how hidden preferences are transmitted in subliminal learning.
papers.comment: 38 pages, including references and appendices. Code: https://github.com/PeterXingyuZhao/cross-trait-transfer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 subliminal learning 中量化跨特质迁移：提出有向特质迁移矩阵，用学生答案的 log-probability 增益衡量某一教师特质的数据如何改变学生对其他特质的偏好。矩阵揭示相关特质成簇，学生有时偏好与教师特质相似但不相同的特质；学习动态从广泛的共享偏移走向更特质专属的迁移，对立特质会增强这种分化。
Motivation: Subliminal learning 中特质传递依赖生成数据里的弱统计模式，此前缺少刻画一个教师特质如何影响学生对其他特质偏好的量化工具。
Method: 提出有向特质迁移矩阵 (directed trait-transfer matrix)，以学生答案的 log-probability 增益量化跨特质效应；用输出分布指标与基于表示的指标近似这种结构，并结合学习动态分析与多特质（含对立特质）实验考察特质发展与交互。
Result: 迁移矩阵显示相关特质聚成簇，学生有时形成与教师特质相似但不相同的偏好；该跨特质结构可被输出分布指标和表示指标部分捕捉；学习动态呈现从广泛共享偏移向更特质专属迁移的推进，多特质实验表明对立特质可增强分化。
Conclusion: 特质传递不是单点复制，而是在相关特质上呈现成簇、竞争的统计结构，隐藏偏好的传播应按迁移矩阵而非单个特质来理解。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: FloVMos: Optical Flow-based Medical Video Mosaicking
papers.abstract_en: Biomedical imaging modalities often require a trade-off among resolution, field of view (FOV), and acquisition speed. Video mosaicking offers a strategy to overcome this limitation by computationally stitching sequential high-resolution frames into a wide-FOV composite. However, existing methods struggle with non-rigid deformations, and modality-specific artifacts arising in clinical and research imaging. Here, we present FloVMos, a generalizable, optical-flow-based deep learning framework for real-time video mosaicking across diverse biomedical imaging modalities. FloVMos achieves robust, pixel-level registration by fine-tuning an optical flow model on synthetic training data with ground-truth deformation fields. We introduce a pipeline for generating this training data, simulating realistic tissue motion and imaging distortions from existing mosaics or raw videos. Our automated synthetic data generation and optical flow model training based on this data allow users to adapt FloVMos to different imaging modalities. To demonstrate this, we applied FloVMos to seven diverse imaging modalities: reflection confocal microscopy, open-top light-sheet microscopy, fetoscopy, laparoscopy, dermoscopy, sparse spectral microscopy, and endoscopy. FloVMos outperforms conventional baselines in accuracy, robustness, and speed for all the tested modalities. This adaptable and training-efficient framework enables large-area visualization with real-time performance and may support broader use of video-based biomedical imaging in research and clinical workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FloVMos 用光流 (optical flow) 深度模型做医学视频拼接 (video mosaicking)：在合成训练数据上微调带真值形变场的光流模型，实现像素级配准并可迁移到不同成像模态。在反射共聚焦、open-top light-sheet、胎儿镜、腹腔镜、皮肤镜、稀疏光谱显微与内窥镜七种模态上，其精度、鲁棒性与速度均超过传统基线。
Motivation: 生物医学成像在分辨率、视场 (FOV) 与采集速度之间必须取舍，而现有拼接方法难以处理非刚性形变与临床/研究成像中的模态特有伪影。
Method: 微调一个光流深度模型，用带真值形变场的合成数据训练；配套提出合成训练数据生成管线，从已有拼接图或原始视频模拟真实组织运动与成像畸变，使框架可针对不同模态自适应重训。
Result: 在七种成像模态（reflection confocal microscopy、open-top light-sheet microscopy、fetoscopy、laparoscopy、dermoscopy、sparse spectral microscopy、endoscopy）上，FloVMos 在精度、鲁棒性与速度三项指标上均超过传统基线。
Conclusion: 自动合成数据加光流微调可让同一拼接框架跨模态复用，以训练高效的方式提供实时大视野可视化。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.conclusion: 自动合成数据加光流微调可让同一拼接框架跨模态复用，以训练高效的方式提供实时大视野可视化。

papers.title: A Hand-Checkable Proof That Two Hidden ReLU Layers Compute the Maximum of Six Numbers
papers.abstract_en: Exactly computing the maximum function is a standard test case for studying depth in ReLU networks. Two hidden layers are known to suffice for up to twelve inputs through computer-assisted constructions. For six real inputs, we give an explicit hexagon identity whose local structure yields a self-contained analytical proof of this depth bound. The identity was found by computer-assisted search; we prove it through explicit cancellations that can be checked entirely by hand, without executing a verification program. The identity also yields an explicit network with hidden widths $17$ and $41$, zero biases, and rational weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对六个实数输入的 max 函数，给出一个显式六边形恒等式，用可手工核对的显式消项证明两层隐藏 ReLU 网络足以精确计算，从而把已有的计算机辅助构造（十二输入以内）中六输入情形转成自足的解析证明。由该恒等式直接写出隐藏宽度 17 与 41、零偏置、有理权重的网络。
Motivation: 精确计算 max 是研究 ReLU 网络深度的标准测试用例；此前两层隐藏层足以处理至多十二个输入的结论依赖计算机辅助构造，缺少可手工核对的解析证明。
Method: 先用计算机辅助搜索找到一个显式六边形恒等式 (hexagon identity)，再对其局部结构做纯解析证明：通过显式消项逐项核对，全程无需执行验证程序；由恒等式反推出具体网络参数。
Result: 对六个实数输入给出自足的解析证明，确认两层隐藏 ReLU 即可精确计算 max；所得网络隐藏宽度为 17 和 41，零偏置，权重全为有理数。论文为 14 页。
Conclusion: 六输入 max 的两层深度界可以完全靠手工核对的消项证明，而不必依赖计算机验证；该构造同时给出一个显式、参数为有理数的网络。

papers.title: Grounded in Time: A Multi-Source Dataset and Benchmark for Temporal Grounding in Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation often requires inferring task-relevant states from past interactions when the current observation alone is insufficient to determine the appropriate action. Despite progress in benchmarking memory-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) models, application-oriented tasks requiring history-dependent semantic inference remain underrepresented. We introduce GiT (Grounded in Time), a dataset and benchmark for grounding manipulation decisions in past events across biolaboratory, household, and industrial scenarios. It includes real-robot and Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) style demonstrations covering 18 bimanual tasks, together with simulation data and a ManiSkill-based evaluation suite covering nine tasks. Fine-grained subtask annotations and annotated counterfactual task pairs, in which similar current observations require different actions depending on prior events, support policy learning and targeted evaluation of history use. Evaluations of representative end-to-end VLA models in simulation and on selected real-world tasks reveal substantial room for improvement in history-dependent manipulation. The dataset and benchmark are available at the project page.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GiT (Grounded in Time) 提出面向机器人操作的时序 grounding 数据集与基准，用 18 项双臂任务的真实机器人与 UMI 演示、以及 ManiSkill 仿真评测套件（9 项任务）构造反事实任务对：当前观测相似但因先前事件不同而需要不同动作。对代表性端到端 VLA 模型的评测显示，依赖历史的操作能力仍有很大提升空间。
Motivation: 记忆增强 VLA 模型已有基准，但需要依赖历史做语义推理的应用型任务仍被忽视：仅凭当前观测无法确定正确动作时，现有评测覆盖不足。
Method: 构建 GiT 数据集与基准，覆盖生物实验室、家庭与工业场景，含真实机器人与 Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) 风格演示（18 项双臂任务）、仿真数据与基于 ManiSkill 的评测套件（9 项任务）；提供细粒度子任务标注与标注的反事实任务对，用于策略学习与针对历史使用的定向评测。
Result: 在仿真与部分真实任务上评测代表性端到端 VLA 模型，结果显示依赖历史的操作仍有 substantial room for improvement；数据集含 18 项双臂任务演示与 9 项 ManiSkill 仿真评测任务。
Conclusion: 当前 VLA 模型在需要依据先前事件区分动作的操作任务上明显不足，GiT 通过反事实任务对把历史使用变成可定向评测的对象。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Spec2Game: Can LLMs Generate Complete Playable Games from Detailed Specifications?
papers.abstract_en: Generating an executable program does not necessarily mean that it correctly implements the behavioral requirements specified in natural language. To evaluate large language models' ability to realize detailed specifications as complete interactive programs, we introduce Spec2Game, a benchmark that requires models to generate complete Pygame projects from detailed natural-language game specifications. Spec2Game comprises 15 game families and 150 task instances, with one canonical task and nine controlled rule variants per family, spanning three levels of implementation complexity. Using source-code, runtime, and visual evidence, we evaluate generated projects along four dimensions---Executability, Specification Realization, Code Quality, and User-Facing Quality. Across 14 LLMs and 3,330 generated projects, we find that high executability does not imply faithful specification realization. Component-level analysis further shows that models perform substantially better on Game Element Modeling than on Rule and Mechanism Modeling or Goal and Termination Modeling, indicating that faithfully implementing game rules and termination logic remains a major challenge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Spec2Game 是一个 LLM 游戏生成基准：给定详细自然语言游戏规格，模型需产出完整可运行的 Pygame 项目。在 14 个 LLM、3,330 个生成项目的评测中，高可执行性并不等于忠实实现规格；组件级分析显示 Game Element Modeling 明显好于 Rule and Mechanism Modeling 与 Goal and Termination Modeling，规则与终止逻辑仍是主要难点。
Motivation: 能生成可执行程序不等于正确实现了自然语言行为规格；缺少能区分“跑得起来”和“按规格实现”的系统化评测。
Method: 构建 15 个游戏家族、150 个任务实例（每家族 1 个规范任务 + 9 个受控规则变体，覆盖 3 级实现复杂度），要求模型从详细规格生成完整 Pygame 项目；用源码、运行时与视觉证据从 Executability、Specification Realization、Code Quality、User-Facing Quality 四个维度评测，并做组件级分析。
Result: 在 14 个 LLM、3,330 个生成项目上，高可执行性不保证忠实的规格实现；模型在 Game Element Modeling 上的表现明显好于 Rule and Mechanism Modeling 和 Goal and Termination Modeling。
Conclusion: 可执行性指标会掩盖规格实现失败，忠实实现游戏规则与终止逻辑仍是 LLM 生成可玩游戏的核心挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Optimizer Geometry Sets the Pace: Spectral Learning Dynamics in Matrix Factorization
papers.abstract_en: Recent successes of matrix- and curvature-based optimizers have renewed interest in how update geometry shapes learning. These methods normalize or precondition updates, changing how different components progress during training. In deep matrix factorization, the geometry that slows gradient descent (GD) favors low-rank solutions by delaying the emergence of small singular modes. This raises the question of what remains of that spectral bias when normalization or curvature correction weakens or removes the slowdown. We study how optimizer geometry and depth jointly govern this behavior through a common framework for singular mode dynamics. Under explicit balance and alignment assumptions, we derive birth, saturation, and decay laws for Euclidean GD, coordinate-wise updates of SignGD and an instantaneous Adam approximation, spectral updates of Muon and cumulative Shampoo, and a block curvature model of K-FAC. The resulting picture is not a simple ordering from stronger to weaker low-rank bias. To highlight, SignGD and ideal Muon eliminate the divergent birth barrier and drive unsupported modes to zero in finite time. Cumulative Shampoo initially retains GD's depth-dependent barrier, then accumulated gradients produce a catch-up phase while making previously active modes increasingly persistent. Undamped K-FAC cancels the factorization-induced slowdown while preserving the ordering of the target singular values, whereas positive damping introduces a spectral threshold below which the slow GD phase laws reappear. These results give normalization, accumulated state, damping, and depth a direct interpretation as controls determining when modes emerge, persist, and disappear during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在深度矩阵分解中，优化器几何与深度共同决定奇异模态的出生、饱和与衰减：GD 的慢化偏好低秩解，而 SignGD 与理想 Muon 消除发散的出生壁垒、把无支撑模态在有限时间内压到零；累积 Shampoo 先保留 GD 的深度壁垒、随后进入追赶相并让已激活模态更持久；正阻尼的 K-FAC 引入谱阈值，阈值以下 GD 慢化律重新出现。结论是低秩偏置并非随归一化/曲率强度单调减弱，归一化、累积状态、阻尼与深度是控制模态出现、存续与消失的直接旋钮。
Motivation: 矩阵与曲率类优化器通过归一化或预条件改变更新几何，但当归一化或曲率修正削弱乃至消除 GD 的慢化时，深度矩阵分解中原有的谱偏置还剩多少并不清楚。
Method: 在显式的 balance 与 alignment 假设下，建立奇异模态动力学的统一框架，对 Euclidean GD、SignGD 的逐坐标更新与瞬时 Adam 近似、Muon 的谱更新、累积 Shampoo 以及 K-FAC 的块曲率模型分别推导出生、饱和与衰减律。
Result: SignGD 与理想 Muon 消除发散的出生壁垒并在有限时间把无支撑模态驱零；累积 Shampoo 初期保留 GD 的深度依赖壁垒，随后累积梯度带来追赶相并使先前活跃模态愈发持久；无阻尼 K-FAC 抵消因子化引起的慢化但保留目标奇异值的排序，正阻尼则引入谱阈值、阈值以下 GD 慢化律复现。整体图景不是从强到弱低秩偏置的简单排序。
Conclusion: 低秩偏置随优化器几何的变化是非单调的：归一化、累积状态、阻尼与深度共同决定模态何时出现、存续与消失，因此不能用单一强弱序来刻画各优化器的谱行为。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Benchmarking Psychological Dynamics in Generative Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed to simulate human behavior, acting as computational replicas of human subjects. Yet the lived psychological experience of humans is difficult to benchmark, particularly as it unfolds over time. We introduce a psychometric benchmark for computational replicas: personas that carry a fixed identity through an evolving sequence of events. Built entirely from published norms and meta-analytic effects, the benchmark scores two dimensions of psychological realism. The first, internal validity, quantifies whether generated trajectories reproduce the internal structure of repeated human measurement: distributions, the between- versus within-person variance partition, temporal dependence, and range. The second, external validity, quantifies whether replicas recover established trait, state, and indicator relations. Across 36 open-weight and proprietary LLMs from nine developers (1B-671B parameters), most recover the direction of established relations (84.3% mean agreement) and the variance partition (26 of 34), yet the within-person correlation and distributional structure elude recovery. Internal validity is independent of scale and capability: a mid-size open LLM (Gemma-3-27B) strikes the best trade-off between the two dimensions. The benchmark is a precondition for using computational replicas in causal inference across domains (e.g., marketing, healthcare), and identifies within-person grounding as the central challenge ahead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向生成式智能体 (generative agents) 的心理测量基准：给 persona 固定身份并让其经历事件序列，用内部效度（分布、组间/组内方差分解、时间依赖、量程）与外部效度（特质-状态-指标关系）两个维度打分。36 个 LLM 中多数能复现既定关系方向（平均一致率 84.3%）与方差分解（34 项中 26 项），但组内相关与分布结构无法复现，且内部效度与模型规模、能力无关。
Motivation: LLM 被当作人类受试者的计算替身做行为模拟，但其随时间展开的心理体验难以基准化，尤其组内（within-person）层面的真实性无从检验。
Method: 构建完全基于已发表常模与元分析效应的心理测量基准：persona 携带固定身份经历演化事件序列，分别计算内部效度（重复测量的分布、between- vs within-person 方差分解、时间依赖、量程）与外部效度（既定 trait、state、indicator 关系的恢复程度），在 36 个开放权重与闭源 LLM（九家开发者，1B–671B 参数）上施测。
Result: 36 个 LLM（九家开发者，1B–671B 参数）中多数恢复既定关系方向，平均一致率 84.3%；方差分解在 34 项中恢复 26 项；组内相关与分布结构未能恢复；内部效度与规模和能力无关，中等规模开源模型 Gemma-3-27B 在两个维度间取得最佳权衡。
Conclusion: 生成式替身可用于跨领域（如营销、医疗）因果推断的前提是通过该基准，而组内真实性 (within-person grounding) 是接下来的核心难题。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 36 个 LLM（九家开发者，1B–671B 参数）中多数恢复既定关系方向，平均一致率 84.3%；方差分解在 34 项中恢复 26 项；组内相关与分布结构未能恢复；内部效度与规模和能力无关，中等规模开源模型 Gemma-3-27B 在两个维度间取得最佳权衡。
summary_sections.conclusion: 生成式替身可用于跨领域（如营销、医疗）因果推断的前提是通过该基准，而组内真实性 (within-person grounding) 是接下来的核心难题。

papers.title: On the Steering Dimensionality of Refusal in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Existing activation steering methods often assume that a high-level concept can be mediated by a single steering direction. To support this, two complementary interventions should be achieved: additive steering should induce the target behavior, while directional ablation should suppress it. Yet behaviors may occupy richer activation geometries beyond a single direction, and semantically similar behaviors may be represented by distinct directions. In this work, we study how many directions can reliably control two different types of refusal behaviors: refusal triggered by the safety alignment and refusal in general contexts. Given the limited expressive capability of a single steering vector, we study the general setting of steering subspaces and introduce the notion of steering dimensionality as the minimum subspace dimensionality required to reliably control a behavior. We characterize sufficient steering subspaces that cover the full extent of the target behavior through both the (monotonic) improvement before the sufficient dimensionality, and the saturation beyond it. Empirically, we find that refusal triggered by safety alignment is 1-dim steerable, while multiple distinct steering directions can achieve comparable control. In contrast, refusal in general contexts exhibits substantially richer activation geometry where even 5-dim steering subspaces fail to reliably capture its full steerable variation. Our results reveal that the activation geometry underlying refusal is highly context-dependent and can be substantially more complex than a single linear steering direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 steering dimensionality 概念，即可靠控制某一行为所需的最小子空间维度，并用加性引导应诱导目标行为、方向消融应抑制目标行为这两个互补干预来判定。实证发现安全对齐触发的拒绝是 1 维可引导的（多个不同方向可达到相当的控制），而一般语境下的拒绝激活几何丰富得多，即使 5 维引导子空间也无法可靠覆盖其全部可引导变化。
Motivation: 现有激活引导 (activation steering) 方法常假设高层概念可由单一方向中介，但相似行为可能由不同方向表示，单向量表达能力不足以刻画拒绝行为的真实激活几何。
Method: 把单引导向量推广到引导子空间，定义 steering dimensionality 为可靠控制行为所需的最小子空间维度；用达到充分维度前的单调改善与之后的饱和来刻画覆盖目标行为全范围的充分引导子空间，并分别考察安全对齐触发的拒绝与一般语境下的拒绝两类行为。
Result: 安全对齐触发的拒绝为 1 维可引导，且多个互异的引导方向可实现相当的控制；一般语境下的拒绝呈现显著更丰富的激活几何，5 维引导子空间仍无法可靠捕获其全部可引导变化。
Conclusion: 拒绝行为背后的激活几何高度依赖语境，可能远比单一线性引导方向复杂，因此单一方向假设对一般语境拒绝不成立。

papers.title: Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition for Operator Learning
papers.abstract_en: Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs) offer an efficient paradigm for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). However, FNOs rely on a fixed Fourier basis and hard frequency truncation, which inherently limit their ability to model non-periodic, localized, and fine-scale solution structures. We propose the Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition Neural Operator (SAFDNO), a spectral neural operator that replaces predefined Fourier modes with an adaptive Takenaka-Malmquist (TM) orthonormal system derived from the theory of Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition (SAFD). Instead of performing an expensive greedy pole search in classical SAFD, SAFDNO amortizes stochastic pole selection through a neural pole predictor and constructs the adaptive TM system directly from latent features. The resulting operator performs learned filtering on coefficients of analytic branches in the Hardy space with respect to the input-adaptive TM system, preserving the global receptive field of spectral operators while providing a more flexible representation than using fixed spectral bases. Across nine PDE benchmark problems, SAFDNO achieves the best performance on all six regular-grid problems among strong neural operator baselines, with especially notable gains on Darcy, Burgers, and Navier-Stokes, where fixed Fourier modes are often less effective at modeling localized oscillations, sharp transitions, and multiscale structures. SAFDNO also exhibits stronger zero-shot super-resolution performance and shows less performance degradation when deployed on finer discretizations. These results suggest that the input-adaptive TM system provides a promising alternative to fixed spectral representations for neural operator learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAFDNO 用 Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition 导出的自适应 Takenaka-Malmquist (TM) 正交系替换 FNO 的固定 Fourier 模式，由神经 pole predictor 从 latent 特征直接预测极点，免去经典 SAFD 的贪心搜索。在九个 PDE 基准上，它在全部六个规则网格问题中取得最佳表现，Darcy、Burgers、Navier-Stokes 上增益尤其明显，零样本超分辨与更细网格部署下的退化也更小。
Motivation: FNO 依赖固定 Fourier 基与硬频率截断，难以刻画非周期、局部化和细尺度解结构，对局部振荡与尖锐过渡的建模受限。
Method: 提出 Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition Neural Operator (SAFDNO)：用神经 pole predictor 从 latent 特征摊销随机极点选择，构造输入自适应的 TM 正交系，并在 Hardy 空间解析分支系数上做学习滤波，保留谱算子的全局感受野。
Result: 在九个 PDE 基准中，SAFDNO 在全部六个规则网格问题上优于强神经算子基线，Darcy、Burgers、Navier-Stokes 提升尤其显著；零样本超分辨更强，在更细离散化上部署时性能退化更小。
Conclusion: 输入自适应的 TM 系统可作为固定谱基的替代方案，用于神经算子学习，尤其适合局部振荡、尖锐过渡与多尺度结构。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: Attention-Based Surface Representation Learning for Robot State Prediction and Open-Ended Surface Classification
papers.abstract_en: For ground robots operating in outdoor environments, understanding the properties of the underlying terrain is essential for ensuring reliable operation. In most perception-based studies, this problem is formulated as categorical classification with a fixed number of classes defined during training. We propose an approach that enables new surface classes to be added as trainable vectors, which can subsequently be used to address higher-level tasks. By employing a learning paradigm based on predicting the robot's next state in time and using attention blocks, we improved classification accuracy to 98.56% on the Belyaev-Kushnarev dataset and 94.8% on BorealTC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向地面机器人的表面分类，把新表面类表示为可训练向量，用预测机器人下一时刻状态的学习范式配合 attention block 学表面表征，使新类可在训练后追加而无需重训整个分类器。分类准确率在 Belyaev-Kushnarev 数据集上达 98.56%，在 BorealTC 上达 94.8%。
Motivation: 现有基于感知的地形理解研究把问题固定为训练时定义好类别数的封闭集分类，无法在部署后追加新的表面类别。
Method: 以预测机器人下一时刻状态 (next-state prediction) 为学习范式，用 attention block 学习表面表征；新表面类以可训练向量 (trainable vectors) 的形式加入，用于支撑更高层任务。
Result: 分类准确率 98.56%（Belyaev-Kushnarev 数据集）、94.8%（BorealTC）。
Conclusion: 把表面类参数化为可训练向量并用下一时刻状态预测训练，可在两个数据集上取得高准确率的开放集表面分类。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Conformal Prediction with Paraphrase-Aware Scoring for LLM Uncertainty Quantification
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) for large language models (LLMs) aims to provide reliable measures of predictive confidence, yet current methods are often unstable under meaning-preserving perturbations. Semantically equivalent paraphrases can induce substantial variability in predictive confidence, even for methods with formal guarantees, such as conformal prediction. To address this issue, we propose a paraphrase-aware UQ framework robust to semantic rewordings. Our approach trains a lightweight proxy model on LLM hidden states and aggregates its predictions across paraphrases to construct label-wise nonconformity scores. Under score exchangeability, conformal calibration retains marginal coverage. This guarantee can also hold under test-only rewording, provided that the paraphrase pipeline satisfies an additional distributional alignment condition. We evaluate three settings (normal, fully reworded, and semi-reworded) which apply rewording to neither dataset, both calibration and test datasets, or only the test dataset, respectively. Across seven multiple-choice QA benchmarks and multiple model families, our method produces compact prediction sets with empirical coverage generally near the nominal target, even in the semi-reworded setting. Ablation studies show that the learned proxy accounts for most of the reduction in set size, while paraphrase-augmented training and inference-time aggregation improve stability under rewording. Code is available at https://github.com/Raina-Xin/PA_Score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 的 conformal prediction 置信度对同义改写敏感，等义 paraphrase 就能显著改变预测置信。该框架用轻量 proxy 模型读 LLM hidden states，在多个 paraphrase 上聚合预测来构造 label-wise nonconformity score，在分数可交换下保持边际覆盖；七个多选 QA benchmark 上预测集紧凑、经验覆盖接近名义目标，且在仅测试集被改写的 semi-reworded 设定下依然成立。
Motivation: 同义改写会让 LLM 预测置信大幅波动，连带 formal guarantee 的 conformal prediction 也不稳定，导致预测集大小与覆盖在语义等价输入间不可复现。
Method: 训练一个轻量 proxy 模型读取 LLM hidden states，把其预测在 paraphrase 集合上聚合，据此构造 label-wise nonconformity score；在 score exchangeability 下做 conformal calibration，测试期改写还需 paraphrase pipeline 满足额外的 distributional alignment 条件。评测分 normal、fully reworded、semi-reworded 三种设定，覆盖七个多选 QA benchmark 与多个模型家族，并做 ablation。
Result: 在七个多选 QA benchmark、多个模型家族上，预测集紧凑且经验覆盖普遍接近名义目标，即使在 semi-reworded（仅测试集被改写）设定下也保持；ablation 显示 learned proxy 贡献了大部分集合缩减，paraphrase-augmented 训练与推理期聚合主要改善改写下的稳定性。
Conclusion: 把 paraphrase 感知的打分与聚合放进 conformal 校准，可以在语义改写下同时保住覆盖与集合紧凑性；覆盖保证依赖分数可交换，测试期改写还需额外的分布对齐条件。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Humanoid Rickshaw Pulling: Whole-Body Locomotion under Coupled Wheeled Loads
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots could transport payloads substantially heavier than themselves by pulling passive wheeled vehicles instead of carrying the load. This capability, however, creates a coupled locomotion problem: the robot must maintain persistent upper-body contact while adapting to unknown, configuration-dependent forces arising from the payload, vehicle, and terrain. We present a whole-body control framework for humanoid rickshaw pulling that tracks commanded vehicle motion while preserving balance and stable grasps under uncertain load dynamics. During training, a privileged teacher exploits vehicle states, interaction forces, and load properties. Its actions and latent are distilled into a history-conditioned student that implicitly infers coupled dynamics from proprioceptive responses, followed by reinforcement-learning fine-tuning. Comparisons with \emph{No History} and \emph{Only History} baselines show that the resulting policy achieves accurate vehicle tracking while reducing vehicle oscillation, torso tilt, and actuation cost. Behavioral analysis shows that Unitree G1 propels the rickshaw and generates gait-synchronized whole-body reactions that stabilize its lateral and roll motions. Moreover, pulling redistributes joint effort and yields a lower robot-normalized cost-of-transport proxy than unloaded walking over most tested load--speed conditions. On hardware, a single policy performs starting, sustained pulling, turning, and stopping with both rigid payloads and human passengers, handling a loaded rickshaw mass of up to 115~kg without load-specific retuning. These results demonstrate robust heavy-load transportation through coordinated and persistent humanoid--vehicle interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出人形机器人拉黄包车的全身控制框架：特权教师利用车辆状态、交互力和负载属性训练，再蒸馏为仅靠本体感觉历史隐式推断耦合动力学的学生策略并做 RL 微调。Unitree G1 单一策略在硬件上完成起步、持续拉动、转向与停止，承载最高 115 kg 无需按负载重调，且在多数负载-速度条件下单位负载归一化能耗低于空载行走。
Motivation: 人形拉被动轮车能搬运远超自重的负载，但机器人须保持上身持续接触并应对随负载、车辆、地形变化的未知耦合力，现有控制难以同时保证跟踪、平衡与稳定抓握。
Method: 特权教师策略在训练中直接使用车辆状态、交互力与负载属性；其动作与 latent 蒸馏为以历史为条件的学生策略，仅从本体感觉响应隐式推断耦合动力学，随后用强化学习微调；对比 No History 与 Only History 两个消融基线。
Result: 与 No History、Only History 基线相比，最终策略在准确跟踪车辆指令的同时降低车辆振荡、躯干倾斜与驱动能耗；行为分析显示 Unitree G1 推动黄包车并产生步态同步的全身反应以稳定侧向与横滚运动；拉车在多数测试的负载-速度条件下给出低于空载行走的机器人归一化 cost-of-transport 代理值；硬件上单一策略处理刚性负载与真人乘客，承载车辆质量最高 115 kg 且无需按负载重调。
Conclusion: 通过特权教师到历史条件学生的蒸馏加 RL 微调，人形机器人可在不针对具体负载重训的前提下实现鲁棒的重载人车耦合搬运。

summary_sections.result: 与 No History、Only History 基线相比，最终策略在准确跟踪车辆指令的同时降低车辆振荡、躯干倾斜与驱动能耗；行为分析显示 Unitree G1 推动黄包车并产生步态同步的全身反应以稳定侧向与横滚运动；拉车在多数测试的负载-速度条件下给出低于空载行走的机器人归一化 cost-of-transport 代理值；硬件上单一策略处理刚性负载与真人乘客，承载车辆质量最高 115 kg 且无需按负载重调。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过特权教师到历史条件学生的蒸馏加 RL 微调，人形机器人可在不针对具体负载重训的前提下实现鲁棒的重载人车耦合搬运。

papers.title: Neyman-Pearson Classification with Indecisions: Simultaneous Control of Selective Type I and Type II Errors
papers.abstract_en: Binary classification often requires controlling both type I and type II error rates at prespecified levels. When the class distributions overlap substantially, the two error limits may be incompatible if every observation must be classified. We study Neyman-Pearson classification with indecisions (NPI), which permits uncertain observations to remain unclassified and assesses selective type I and type II errors among definitive classifications within each class. For an independently trained score, we develop a model-free calibration procedure that combines all candidate threshold pairs passing calibration into a rule whose decision region contains that of every passing candidate. We couple the entire threshold search to a common martingale within each class and compute its finite-horizon crossing probability exactly, avoiding a multiplicity adjustment for the number of candidate pairs. The resulting classifier satisfies both population selective error limits simultaneously with user-specified high probability in finite samples, without assumptions on the accuracy of the fitted score. We bound the additional indecision due to calibration and evaluate the procedure in simulations and applications to recidivism and credit-default prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在类别分布大幅重叠、强制二分类时 I/II 类错误上限不可兼得的场景下，提出带弃权的 Neyman-Pearson 分类 (NPI)：只在确定性判定上同时控制选择性 I 类与 II 类错误。其模型无关校准把所有通过校准的阈值对合成一个决策区包含各候选的规则，并用类内共同鞅的有限时域越界概率精确计算，无需多重性校正；有限样本下以用户指定高概率同时满足两个人口级错误上限，且对拟合分数的准确性不作假设。
Motivation: 类别分布重叠显著时，若每条样本都必须分类，预设的选择性 I 类与 II 类错误上限无法同时满足；需要允许弃权并在确定性判定上同时约束两类错误的有限样本保证。
Method: 对独立训练的分数做模型无关校准：收集所有通过校准的候选阈值对，合成一个决策区包含每个通过候选的规则；把整个阈值搜索绑定到类内共同鞅 (common martingale)，精确计算其有限时域越界概率，从而免去对候选对数量的多重性校正；并给出校准所引入额外弃权的界。
Result: 所得分类器在有限样本下以用户指定高概率同时满足两个人口级选择性错误上限，且不依赖拟合分数准确性的假设；在模拟以及再犯 (recidivism) 和信贷违约 (credit-default) 预测应用中对该流程做了评估。
Conclusion: 允许弃权并用鞅化阈值搜索做校准，可以在有限样本、无分数准确性假设下同时钳住两类选择性错误，代价是校准带来的额外弃权（该代价有界）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PaLoRA: Paced Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: LoRA-based continual learning methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting through various mechanisms, yet nearly all complement these with small learning rates as a heuristic to restrict gradient scaling magnitude. Such fixed heuristics lack theoretical guidance on how the strength of this restriction should evolve as tasks accumulate. We reveal that even under directional constraints such as nullspace projection, finite-precision updates inevitably leak into the subspace of accumulated prior knowledge along multiple directions. While small learning rates attenuate such leakage, they cannot prevent the accumulated forgetting from intensifying as the effective rank of historical knowledge grows. We show that the optimal magnitude restriction should adaptively increase with this effective rank to balance stability and plasticity, i.e., preservation of previous knowledge and acquisition of new task information. Under an anisotropic leakage model, we derive a pacing law $s^*=\sqrt{R/c}$ that characterizes the optimal scaling of gradient steps, i.e., the magnitude restriction itself, where $R$ is the effective rank of past updates. Based on this insight, we propose PaLoRA, which compresses historical knowledge via adaptive SVD truncation, projects gradients onto the nullspace of prior tasks, and applies rank-aware adaptive pacing. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over prior methods, with particularly strong performance in long-horizon settings, achieving substantial gains of 4% accuracy on challenging 50-task ImageNet-A and ImageNet-R benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PaLoRA 指出 LoRA 持续学习中固定小学习率只是启发式：有限精度更新会沿多个方向泄漏进已积累知识的子空间，且随历史知识有效秩 R 增大而累积加重。由此导出 pacing law s*=√(R/c)，即最优梯度步长幅度应随 R 自适应放大以平衡稳定性与可塑性，并据此提出自适应 SVD 截断 + 零空间投影 + 秩感知步长调节的 PaLoRA。
Motivation: LoRA 持续学习普遍靠固定小学习率限制梯度幅度，缺少该限制强度应如何随任务累积演化的理论指导；即便有零空间投影等方向约束，有限精度更新仍会泄漏并随有效秩增长累积遗忘。
Method: 在 anisotropic leakage 模型下推导 pacing law s*=√(R/c)（R 为历史更新的有效秩）；PaLoRA 包含三部分：对历史知识做自适应 SVD 截断压缩、把梯度投影到先前任务的零空间 (nullspace projection)、再施加秩感知的自适应步长调节 (rank-aware adaptive pacing)。
Result: 在持续学习基准上一致优于先前方法，长时程 (long-horizon) 设置提升尤其明显：在困难的 50-task ImageNet-A 与 ImageNet-R 上取得 4% accuracy 增益。
Conclusion: 幅度限制不应固定，而应随历史知识有效秩自适应放大，才能同时维持旧知识保持与新任务获取；固定小学习率无法阻止随有效秩增长而加剧的累积遗忘。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlashGaze: Training-Free Multi-Scale Patch Pruning For Efficient Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in video understanding, yet efficiently processing long, high-resolution videos remains challenging. Such videos often contain substantial spatiotemporal redundancy, and processing redundant visual tokens can incur avoidable computational overhead. Many existing methods prune visual tokens during or after vision transformer (ViT) encoding, leaving much of the encoding cost unaddressed. Some approaches prune patches before encoding but rely on learned auxiliary networks for patch selection, incurring additional training and inference overhead. To address these limitations, we propose FlashGaze, a training-free method that reduces spatiotemporal redundancy before ViT encoding without introducing auxiliary networks. FlashGaze uses pixel-space differences as a proxy for information loss and employs Quadtree Dynamic Programming to jointly optimize patch dropping, merging, and keeping under a fixed budget. Experiments on two MLLM backbones across multiple benchmarks demonstrate substantial efficiency gains while largely preserving accuracy. On Qwen3-VL-8B, FlashGaze retains 98% of the full-input baseline accuracy on LongVideoBench while achieving up to 5.4x and 17x speedups in ViT encoding and MLLM prefill, respectively, and reducing peak GPU memory usage by a factor of 1.8. These efficiency gains enable the model to process videos with more frames and higher resolutions on the same GPU hardware, unlocking video understanding at scales previously out of reach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlashGaze 在 ViT 编码之前做免训练的多尺度 patch 裁剪，用像素空间差异作为信息损失代理，以 Quadtree Dynamic Programming 在固定预算下联合决定丢弃、合并与保留。在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上 LongVideoBench 保留全输入基线 98% 的准确率，ViT 编码加速最高 5.4 倍、MLLM prefill 加速 17 倍，峰值显存降为 1/1.8。
Motivation: 长视频高分辨率输入存在大量时空冗余，现有方法多在 ViT 编码中或编码后才裁剪 token，编码开销仍未省掉；编码前裁剪的方案又依赖额外训练的辅助网络。
Method: 免训练、无辅助网络：以像素空间差异作为信息损失代理，在 ViT 编码前对 patch 做多尺度处理，用 Quadtree Dynamic Programming 在固定 token 预算下联合优化丢弃、合并与保留三类操作。
Result: 在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上，LongVideoBench 保留全输入基线 98% 的准确率，ViT 编码最高 5.4 倍加速、MLLM prefill 最高 17 倍加速，峰值 GPU 显存降低 1.8 倍；实验覆盖两个 MLLM backbone 与多个 benchmark，效率增益显著且基本保持精度。
Conclusion: 把裁剪前移到编码之前并用像素差异替代可学习选择网络，可以在基本不掉点的前提下大幅压缩长视频理解的编码与 prefill 开销，从而在同一 GPU 上处理更多帧与更高分辨率。

papers.title: Adaptive Operator Selection in Bilevel Large Neighborhood Search for Electric Autonomous Dial-a-Ride Problem under Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: The electric autonomous dial-a-ride problem (EADARP) extends the classical dial-a-ride problem by incorporating battery and charging constraints for electric vehicles. In practice, travel-time uncertainty can cause violations of time-window constraints. Large neighborhood search is effective for solving the EADARP, but its performance can depend on the choice of insertion operator during the repair phase. This paper investigates insertion-operator selection within a bilevel large neighborhood search framework for deterministic and chance-constrained variants of the EADARP. In the chance-constrained variant, arc travel times are modeled as independent normally distributed random variables, and upper time-window constraints are enforced probabilistically. We consider six selection methods, namely fixed greedy insertion, fixed regret-based insertion, random selection, a deterministic state-based rule, performance-adaptive ALNS selection, and LLM-based state-aware selection. Experimental results show comparable performance on smaller instances, while differences become more evident on larger and more constrained instances. There is no single strategy that performs best across all instances, and the relative performance of the LLM-based, rule-based, and ALNS strategies varies with the problem instance and experimental setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对带电池与充电约束的电动自动驾驶 dial-a-ride 问题 (EADARP)，在双层大邻域搜索 (bilevel LNS) 的修复阶段比较六种插入算子选择策略，覆盖确定性与机会约束两种变体。小规模实例上各策略表现相当，大规模且约束更紧的实例上差异才显现；没有单一策略在所有实例上最优，LLM-based、规则式与 ALNS 三者的相对优劣随实例和实验设置而变。
Motivation: EADARP 中行程时间不确定性会违反时间窗约束，而 LNS 修复阶段的插入算子选择直接决定搜索表现，但缺少在确定性与机会约束两种设定下系统比较选择策略的依据。
Method: 在双层 LNS 框架内比较六种插入算子选择方法：固定贪心插入、固定 regret 插入、随机选择、确定性状态规则、性能自适应 ALNS 选择、以及 LLM-based 状态感知选择；机会约束变体把弧行程时间建模为独立正态随机变量，上时间窗按概率方式强制。
Result: 小规模实例上六种策略表现相当；在更大、约束更紧的实例上差异更明显，且 LLM-based、规则式与 ALNS 策略的相对表现随问题实例与实验设置变化，无单一策略全面最优。
Conclusion: 插入算子选择应随实例规模与约束紧度调整，不存在跨实例通用的最优选择策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TCMClinicalReason-Bench: Can Language Models Reason from Pathogenesis to Prescription over Real-World Clinical Cases?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can generate clinical narratives that are insufficiently grounded in patient-specific evidence. In traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), errors can propagate from etiology and pathogenesis through syndrome diagnosis and treatment principles to prescription generation. We developed TCMClinicalReason-Bench using 2,000 multicenter electronic health record cases to distinguish case-grounded responses from fluent but unsupported diagnostic and therapeutic conclusions. Five general-purpose and two TCM-specific LLMs were evaluated in zero-shot settings. An evidence-constrained rubric assessed seven diagnostic and therapeutic components and three cross-block relations, allowing case-supported alternatives. Qwen3.7-Plus with TCM retrieval served as the automated judge, alongside parallel blinded ratings by five senior TCM clinicians on a 600-case subset. Structural completeness was nearly saturated (99.3-100.0%), but normalized content scores ranged from 40.7% to 54.1%. The five general-purpose models averaged 50.0%, versus 41.3% for the two smaller TCM-specific models. Cross-block logic consistency ranged from 60.8% to 66.8% and correlated moderately with content across cases (Pearson's r = 0.515-0.656). Deficits were greatest in prescription generation, prescription analysis, and symptom-guided modification. In judge stress testing on 100 independent cases, perturbation detection rates across the three relations were 57%, 56%, and 31%, with contradictions detected more reliably than omissions. Separating component quality from cross-block consistency localizes failures missed by endpoint and completeness metrics and identifies where clinician oversight remains necessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TCMClinicalReason-Bench 用 2,000 例多中心中医电子病历，把病例证据约束的评分拆成七个诊疗组件与三个跨块关系，评测 5 个通用 LLM 与 2 个中医专用 LLM 的零样本表现。结构完整度接近饱和（99.3–100.0%），但归一化内容分仅 40.7%–54.1%，跨块逻辑一致性 60.8%–66.8%，缺口集中在处方生成、处方分析与随症加减。
Motivation: LLM 生成的中医诊疗叙述流利但缺乏病例证据支撑，错误会沿病因病机、证候诊断、治则一路传导到处方；端点式与完整度指标掩盖了这类跨块逻辑失败。
Method: 以 2,000 例多中心 EHR 构建 TCMClinicalReason-Bench，零样本评测 5 个通用与 2 个中医专用 LLM；用证据约束评分细则评七个诊疗组件与三个跨块关系，允许病例支持的替代答案；自动裁判为 Qwen3.7-Plus 加中医检索，并在 600 例子集上由五位资深中医师盲评平行校验。

Conclusion: 把组件质量与跨块一致性分开评，能定位端点和完整度指标漏掉的失败点，并指出处方环节仍需临床医师监督。

papers.title: FTD-GNO: Memory-Efficient Graph Neural Operators through Functional Tensor Decomposition of the Kernel
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Operators (GNOs) provide flexible surrogate models for learning solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs). However, standard GNOs typically parameterize the integral kernel with a monolithic neural network and evaluate kernel interactions over graph edges, leading to substantial computational and memory overhead at high resolutions or with large neighborhoods. To address these limitations, we propose Functional Tensor Decomposition Graph Neural Operator (FTD-GNO), a memory-efficient GNO framework that decouples the high-dimensional continuous integral kernel into low-dimensional mode-wise functions. By instantiating the kernel with classical tensor decomposition formats, including CP, Tensor-Train, and Tucker decompositions, FTD-GNO enables algebraic reconstruction of the integral operator without explicitly materializing full edge-wise kernel tensors. This factorized formulation reduces the memory footprint of kernel evaluation and aggregation while retaining the continuous operator-learning structure of GNOs. Theoretical complexity analysis shows that FTD-GNO substantially lowers parameter and activation-memory costs associated with high-dimensional kernel construction. Experiments show lower peak memory than the corresponding unfactorized graph-integral baselines, with shorter recorded training times. Fourier-graph experiments further demonstrate that FTD can improve the efficiency of a graph-integral layer within a hybrid operator and has good scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FTD-GNO 用函数张量分解 (Functional Tensor Decomposition) 把 GNO 的高维连续积分核拆成低维 mode-wise 函数，用 CP、Tensor-Train、Tucker 格式代数重构积分算子，避免显式物化全边核张量。理论复杂度分析显示参数与激活显存开销显著下降；实验中峰值显存低于未分解的 graph-integral 基线、训练时间更短，Fourier-graph 实验显示混合算子里的 graph-integral 层效率改善且可扩展性良好。
Motivation: 标准 GNO 用单一神经网络参数化积分核并在图边上逐条求值，在高分辨率或大邻域下计算与显存开销很大。
Method: 提出 FTD-GNO：把高维连续积分核解耦为低维 mode-wise 函数，用 CP、Tensor-Train、Tucker 三种经典张量分解格式实例化核，通过代数重构得到积分算子而不物化完整边核张量；配合理论复杂度分析评估参数与激活显存，并在 Fourier-graph 实验中把 FTD 用作混合算子里的 graph-integral 层。
Result: 理论复杂度分析表明 FTD-GNO 显著降低高维核构造的参数与激活显存开销；实验中峰值显存低于对应的未分解 graph-integral 基线，记录到的训练时间更短；Fourier-graph 实验显示 FTD 提升混合算子中 graph-integral 层的效率并具有良好可扩展性。
Conclusion: 把 GNO 的积分核做函数张量分解，可以在保留连续算子学习结构的同时降低显存与训练时间，代价是核被约束为可分解的 mode-wise 形式。

papers.title: CurveCodec 2: Skeleton-agnostic animation compression with a learned entropy model
papers.abstract_en: Skeletal motion is stored as every joint's transform at every frame, yet most of it is implied by the body rather than by what the motion is about. Compression is one way to ask what a motion must still say once the body is known, and a production codec must answer it for any skeleton with a stated error bound. Our earlier codec, CurveCodec, matched the mean error of ACL, the production library of modern game engines, with a learned prior over sparse anchors, but not ACL's worst case, and it counted its payload as floats rather than bits. Here we ask where the redundancy of skeletal motion lies and which part of a codec a learned model should take over. Measurements give three answers. At production precision the largest saving comes from predicting each quantized curve from its own past, the second from choosing per joint, in closed loop through the hierarchy, which samples not to code. On the gaps such an encoder leaves, a nearest-neighbour oracle over millions of training samples is no better than linear interpolation, and no learned in-betweener we tried paid for itself. What a network does learn is the distribution of the residuals the codec must send. CurveCodec 2 codes every sub-track as a curve in the log map, quantized in closed loop and thinned to rate-distortion-selected keys, with residuals entropy-coded under a small learned model whose integer inference is bit-exact across platforms. Two contracts are verified on every decoded clip: ACL's own worst case per joint within a stated tolerance, or ACL's mean error per clip. On a held-out test side of 4,472 clips from 33 datasets, CurveCodec 2 needs 0.37x ACL's bytes at ACL's default precision of 0.01 cm under the worst-case contract and 0.22x at 0.1 cm under the mean contract, decodes on one CPU core, and transfers without retraining to a species absent from training. Project page: https://rubbly.cn/publications/curvecodec/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CurveCodec 2 是面向骨骼动画的骨架无关压缩编解码器：把每条子轨编码为 log map 上的曲线，闭环量化并按率失真抽稀关键帧，残差用小型学习熵模型做比特精确的整数熵编码。在 33 个数据集的 4,472 条留出测试片段上，最坏情况契约下仅需 ACL 默认精度 0.01 cm 的 0.37 倍字节，均值契约 0.1 cm 下为 0.22 倍，且可零重训练迁移到训练中未见的物种。
Motivation: 骨骼运动逐帧存关节变换，大部分信息由身体本身隐含；生产级编解码器需对任意骨架给出误差上界。此前的 CurveCodec 只追平 ACL 的平均误差、未追平其最坏情况，且把载荷按浮点数而非比特计。
Method: 测量先定位冗余：最大节省来自用曲线自身过去预测量化曲线，其次是逐关节在层级闭环中决定不编码哪些采样；间隙处最近邻 oracle 不优于线性插值，故不学 in-betweener，只学残差分布。每条子轨在 log map 上表示，闭环量化、按率失真选键抽稀，残差由小型学习熵模型编码，其整数推理跨平台比特精确；每条解码片段上验证两种契约（逐关节最坏情况或逐片段均值）。
Result: 在 33 个数据集的 4,472 条留出测试片段上，最坏情况契约下用 ACL 默认精度 0.01 cm 时字节为 ACL 的 0.37 倍，均值契约 0.1 cm 下为 0.22 倍；单 CPU 核即可解码，并零重训练迁移到训练中缺席的物种。
Conclusion: 骨骼运动的冗余主要在时序预测与层级抽稀，学习模型该接管的是残差熵模型而非帧间插值；带显式误差契约的熵编码可把 ACL 的字节压到 0.22–0.37 倍并保持跨骨架、跨平台可用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Fine-Tuning VLM for Enhancing AI's Spatial Intelligence: Understanding 3D and 2D Rotations
papers.abstract_en: Spatial intelligence is a fundamental skill in multiple domains, such as Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM), Medicine, Architecture, and Construction. Recent studies indicate that Vision-Language Models (VLMs) still face limitations in spatial reasoning, which inhibits artificial intelligence (AI) from performing practical spatial tasks. Using multiple object-rotation datasets developed for training and evaluation, our experiments demonstrated promising improvements in both 2D and 3D rotation detection. Fine-tuned Google DeepMind-built Gemma-4 mixture-of-experts (MoE) models significantly outperformed fine-tuned Gemma-4 generalist models in predicting rotations defined by both their axes and angles. Fine-tuning also substantially improved angle estimation for 2D representation without requiring an explicit coordinate system. Furthermore, identifiable objects did not improve angle-detection accuracy; instead, objects with prominent linear features showed improved performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 通过微调 Google DeepMind 的 Gemma-4 mixture-of-experts (MoE) VLM 提升空间智能，在多个物体旋转数据集上做 2D/3D 旋转检测。MoE 版本在按轴与角度定义的旋转预测上显著优于同款 generalist 模型；微调还显著改善了无需显式坐标系的 2D 角度估计，且可辨识物体不提升角度检测、具有显著线性特征的物体才提升。
Motivation: VLM 在空间推理上仍存在局限，使 AI 无法完成实际空间任务，需要在旋转这类基础空间概念上验证微调能否补齐能力。
Method: 使用多个为训练与评估开发的物体旋转数据集，对 Gemma-4 MoE 与 Gemma-4 generalist 两类 VLM 做微调，任务为预测由轴和角度定义的旋转，并测试 2D 表示下的角度估计（无需显式坐标系）。
Result: 微调后的 Gemma-4 MoE 在预测轴与角度定义的旋转上显著优于微调后的 Gemma-4 generalist；微调显著改善了 2D 表示下的角度估计且无需显式坐标系；可辨识物体未提升角度检测精度，而具有显著线性特征的物体提升了表现。
Conclusion: 微调能实质提升 VLM 的旋转空间推理，架构上 MoE 优于 generalist；角度检测的增益来自物体的线性特征而非物体可辨识性。

papers.title: Clean: Second-order LLM Training at Linear Memory Cost via Nyström Sketching
papers.abstract_en: Training large language models (LLMs) entails a fundamental trade-off: memory-efficient optimizers such as Adam discard cross-parameter curvature, whereas full-curvature methods such as SOAP can accelerate convergence at prohibitive memory costs. We introduce Clean, a memory-efficient and full-curvature optimizer designed to resolve this bottleneck. Clean leverages the randomized Nystrom method to accurately approximate the left and right preconditioners in SOAP, and to reduce the optimizer's memory complexity from quadratic to linear in terms of model dimensions. We subsequently reintegrate the off-subspace components to capture curvature information beyond the low-rank approximation, preserving rich curvature at minimal memory cost. We further propose Q-Clean, a low-precision variant that aggressively compresses optimizer states. Q-Clean reduces optimizer memory consumption by \textbf{over 50\%} compared to Muon when pre-training a LLaMA-1.3B architecture, all while maintaining strong and competitive predictive performance. Notably, Clean operates with a smaller optimizer-state footprint than standard AdamW while reaching AdamW's final performance \textbf{26\% faster} in wall-clock time. Furthermore, our methods uniquely enable the pre-training of a 13B-parameter model on a single 80GB GPU, providing a scalable, efficient, and accessible approach to large-scale model optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出全曲率优化器 Clean，用随机 Nyström sketch 近似 SOAP 的左右预条件子，把优化器内存从模型维度的二次降到线性，并把低秩近似外的 off-subspace 分量重新并入以保留曲率。Q-Clean 进一步压缩优化器状态：预训练 LLaMA-1.3B 时优化器内存比 Muon 少 50% 以上且预测性能保持竞争力；Clean 内存小于 AdamW，wall-clock 时间比 AdamW 早 26% 达到其最终性能，并可在单张 80GB GPU 上预训练 13B 模型。
Motivation: Adam 类内存高效优化器丢弃跨参数曲率，SOAP 等全曲率方法能加速收敛但内存开销过高，大模型预训练在显存与曲率信息之间被迫二选一。
Method: Clean 用 randomized Nyström 方法近似 SOAP 的左右预条件子，将优化器内存复杂度由模型维度的二次降为线性，再把 off-subspace 分量重新并入以补回低秩近似之外的曲率；Q-Clean 是激进压缩优化器状态的低精度变体。
Result: Q-Clean 在 LLaMA-1.3B 预训练中优化器内存比 Muon 减少 50% 以上，同时保持有竞争力的预测性能；Clean 的优化器状态占用小于标准 AdamW，并以 wall-clock 时间快 26% 达到 AdamW 的最终性能；该方法可在单张 80GB GPU 上预训练 13B 参数模型。
Conclusion: 用 Nyström sketch 加 off-subspace 回并可以在低于 AdamW 的优化器内存下保住全曲率收益，使 13B 级预训练落到单张 80GB GPU 上。

papers.title: Sparse-GS2Mesh: 3D Gaussian Splatting Guided by Novel Stereo Views and 2DGS for Sparse View Surface Reconstruction}
papers.abstract_en: Surface reconstruction under sparse-view settings remains challenging due to limited geometric cues. Volume rendering methods based on signed distance functions often produce over-smoothed surfaces, while 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), though time-efficient, suffers from incomplete geometry due to the lack of reliable depth supervision and the limitation of being optimized only from given input views. In this paper, we present Sparse-GS2Mesh, a stereo-aware framework for surface reconstruction from sparse views. While 3DGS and stereo matching have been leveraged for surface reconstruction under dense view settings, we extend them to operate effectively under sparse view conditions by first initializing 3DGS using epipolar depth priors to mitigate the 3DGS overfitting problem, followed by our three key components: (I) adaptive baseline selection, (II) fine-tuning with a stereo matching network, and (III) 2D/3D co-regularized fine-tuning. Given a warmed-up 3DGS initialized with epipolar depth, the adaptive baseline selection automatically determines a baseline to synthesize for each sparse view. We then fine-tune 3DGS by backpropagating depth-refining gradients from the stereo matching network, effectively specializing the 3DGS for stereo matching. The 2D/3D co-regularization further helps obtain stable reconstruction, addressing weak geometric cues in close stereo views. Sparse-GS2Mesh achieves a 15\% improvement over state-of-the-art methods in little-overlap settings and comparable results in large-overlap settings. Codes will be publicly available.
papers.comment: 13, pages, 7 figures, accepted to NIPS 2026 PhysWorldAI workshops

TL;DR: Sparse-GS2Mesh 是面向稀疏视角表面重建的立体感知框架：先用对极深度先验初始化 3DGS 抑制过拟合，再通过自适应基线选择、立体匹配网络反传微调与 2D/3D 协同正则化得到稳定几何。在小重叠 (little-overlap) 设置下比现有方法提升 15%，大重叠设置下结果相当。
Motivation: 稀疏视角下几何线索不足：基于 SDF 的体渲染易产生过平滑表面，3DGS 因缺少可靠深度监督且只从给定视角优化，几何不完整。
Method: 先用对极深度先验 (epipolar depth) 初始化并 warm-up 3DGS；三个组件为 (I) 自适应基线选择，为每个稀疏视角自动确定待合成的基线；(II) 用立体匹配网络的深度精化梯度反传微调 3DGS，使其适配立体匹配；(III) 2D/3D 协同正则化微调，缓解近距离立体视角几何线索弱的问题。
Result: 在 little-overlap 设置下相对 state-of-the-art 方法提升 15%，在 large-overlap 设置下取得相当 (comparable) 的结果。
Conclusion: 把立体匹配与 2D/3D 正则化引入 3DGS 微调，可在稀疏视角下补足几何线索，小重叠场景收益最大。

papers.title: CellSplat4D: PSF-Aware 4D Gaussian Splatting for Sparse Robotic Live-Cell Imaging
papers.abstract_en: A robotic microscope watching living cells cannot afford to look as often as it would like. Every volume it acquires costs photons the specimen does not get back, and time owed to other wells. What such a platform exists to produce is a record of individual cells through time: which cell is which from one volume to the next, and which cell divided into which two. Sampling sparsely breaks that record exactly where it matters, and the fault lies in the acquisition schedule rather than in the analysis software. We fill the gaps by reconstructing them, fitting a 4D Gaussian model to whatever volumes the hardware could afford. The model is a cloud of light-emitting blobs, each carrying a position, a shape and a lifetime. Being continuous in time, it renders any missing volume on demand, decoupling how often the robot analyses from how often it can afford to look. The microscope's point-spread function is measured from the data rather than inherited from acquisition metadata or left to the optimizer, because metadata inflates it and the optimizer cannot recover it at all: a wider blur around a smaller blob fits the images equally well. Each blob's lifetime is stored in frames rather than as a fraction of the recording, so that it denotes a fixed duration on any sequence. Unmeasured timesteps are supervised at coarse scale by a 3D U-Net that predicts the intermediate volume directly and estimates no motion field, since a dividing cell becomes two and no motion describes that. On two Cell Tracking Challenge sequences, a C. elegans embryo and a Chinese Hamster Ovarian (CHO), with fidelity scored per cell nucleus, our reconstruction holds the highest nucleus fidelity at every distance from an acquired frame, has the flattest decay across the gap, and best recovers focal planes it was never shown with graceful degradation across the gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CellSplat4D 用 PSF 感知的 4D Gaussian Splatting 在稀疏采样的活细胞成像中重建缺失体积：每个高斯 blob 带位置、形状与以帧计的寿命，时间连续可按需渲染任意缺失时刻，PSF 从数据本身测量而非沿用元数据或交给优化器。在 Cell Tracking Challenge 的 C. elegans 胚胎与 CHO 两条序列上按细胞核打分，其重建在距已采帧的每个距离上都保持最高核保真度、跨间隙衰减最平缓，并最好地恢复从未展示的焦平面。
Motivation: 机器人显微镜每次采集都要消耗标本光子并占用其他孔位时间，稀疏采样恰好在细胞身份延续与分裂谱系最需要处断档；元数据会高估 PSF，优化器又无法从图像中恢复它（更宽模糊配更小 blob 拟合同样好）。
Method: 拟合 4D Gaussian 模型到硬件负担得起的体积，每个 blob 携带位置、形状与以帧为单位的寿命，时间连续因而可按需渲染缺失体积；PSF 从数据测量；未测时间步由 3D U-Net 在粗尺度上直接预测中间体积作监督，且不估计运动场，因为分裂细胞变成两个、运动场无法描述。
Result: 在 Cell Tracking Challenge 的 C. elegans 胚胎与 Chinese Hamster Ovarian (CHO) 两条序列上、按每个细胞核计保真度：其重建在距已采帧的每个距离上保持最高核保真度，跨间隙衰减最平缓，并最好地恢复从未展示的焦平面，且在间隙内呈平缓退化。
Conclusion: 把分析频率与实际观测频率解耦、并从数据测 PSF，可在稀疏活细胞成像中连续重建缺失体积而不靠运动场，从而保住细胞身份与分裂记录。

papers.title: ALoDLM: Adaptively Looped Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable fast generation by predicting multiple tokens in parallel, but their practical adoption remains limited by a persistent quality gap relative to comparably sized autoregressive (AR) models. We attribute this gap to a computation-difficulty mismatch: within a partially observed sequence, some unknown tokens are easy to predict, while others require substantially more computation. Existing DLMs nevertheless apply uniform computational depth to all unknown positions at each denoising step. We introduce ALoDLM, which replaces uniform computation with token-adaptive latent recurrence. At each denoising step, ALoDLM iteratively refines latent representations and allocates computation according to token difficulty. Tokens ready to commit are fed back as discrete context, while unresolved tokens retain and further refine their latent states through additional recurrent passes. To learn token prediction and computation allocation jointly, we formulate token-wise computation schedules as latent variables and derive a conditional negative evidence lower bound (NELBO). We train ALoDLM at 1.7B and 8B parameter scales. Across eleven benchmarks, ALoDLM outperforms all evaluated DLMs and the corresponding AR baselines in average benchmark score at both scales. ALoDLM also retains fast parallel decoding, yielding a strong quality-efficiency trade-off among evaluated autoregressive and diffusion models under optimized inference engines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ALoDLM 把扩散语言模型中统一的去噪计算深度换成按 token 难度分配的隐循环：已可确定的 token 以离散形式回填为上下文，未定 token 保留隐状态继续精化。1.7B 与 8B 两个规模上，在十一个 benchmark 的平均分均超过所有被评估的 DLM 及同规模 AR 基线，同时保留并行快速解码。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型并行预测多 token 带来速度优势，但与同规模自回归模型存在持续的质量差距；作者归因于计算-难度错配——同一部分观测序列里易预测与难预测的 token 被施加了相同的计算深度。
Method: 在每个去噪步引入 token 自适应隐循环 (token-adaptive latent recurrence)：迭代精化隐表示并按 token 难度分配计算，就绪 token 以离散上下文回喂，未决 token 经额外循环继续精化；把逐 token 计算调度建为隐变量，推导条件 NELBO (negative evidence lower bound) 联合学习预测与计算分配，训练 1.7B 与 8B 两个规模。
Result: 在十一个 benchmark 上，ALoDLM 在 1.7B 和 8B 两个规模的平均 benchmark 分数均超过所有被评估的 DLM 以及对应的 AR 基线；在优化推理引擎下相对被评估的 AR 与扩散模型保持强的质量-效率折中与快速并行解码。
Conclusion: 质量差距源于计算深度未按 token 难度分配，用隐变量调度的自适应循环可在保留并行解码速度的同时把平均分抬到同规模 AR 基线之上。
