papers.title: Asynchronous Is Nearly Free for Evolution Strategies on Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based long-horizon agentic post-training is often bottlenecked by rollout generation: trajectories span many interaction turns, completion times vary substantially, and synchronous update barriers leave faster workers waiting for stragglers. Asynchronous reinforcement learning which has been adopted in LLM post-training addresses this inefficiency by consuming trajectories as they arrive, but introduces policy lag and off-policy optimization. Evolution strategies (ES) offer a backpropagation-free alternative for LLM post-training, yet it relies on a larger number of rollouts and existing practices have remained largely synchronous. In this short-form paper, we introduce bounded-staleness asynchronous ES and demonstrate it on Endless Terminals benchmark using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Across three evaluation seeds, natural Async-1 matches synchronous ES, achieving 25.9\% versus 25.4\% held-out success. Controlled schedules that delay 10\% of each update cohort by four or eight policy updates reduce success by only 1.6 and 3.1 percentage points, respectively, without explicit off-policy correction. GRPO performs better overall, reaching 29.0\% held-out success, but importantly our results show that ES tolerates moderate policy staleness with limited degradation, opening possibilities for future improvement of ES-based post-training with asynchronous algorithms. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to demonstrate the effectiveness of sync and async ES on a multi-turn terminal style agentic coding task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LLM 长程智能体后训练中引入有界陈旧度异步进化策略 (bounded-staleness asynchronous ES)，在 Endless Terminals 基准上用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 验证：自然异步 Async-1 与同步 ES 基本持平（25.9% 对 25.4% held-out success），把每个更新批次中 10% 的 rollout 延迟 4 或 8 次策略更新也只分别下降 1.6 和 3.1 个百分点，且不做显式 off-policy 校正。
Motivation: 长程多轮智能体 rollout 生成是后训练瓶颈：轨迹轮数多、完成时间差异大，同步更新屏障让快 worker 等待慢 worker；而现有 ES 实践基本仍是同步的，需要大量 rollout。
Method: 提出 bounded-staleness asynchronous ES：按到达消费轨迹、允许受控的策略陈旧度（延迟 10% 的 cohort 4 或 8 次更新），不做显式 off-policy 校正；在 Endless Terminals 上以 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 训练，三个评估种子比较同步 ES、自然 Async-1、受控延迟调度与 GRPO。
Result: 三个评估种子下 Async-1 held-out success 25.9% 对同步 ES 25.4%；延迟 10% cohort 4 次与 8 次更新分别只降 1.6 与 3.1 个百分点；GRPO 整体最好，达 29.0% held-out success。
Conclusion: ES 能容忍中等程度的策略陈旧度而性能退化有限，异步化对 ES 几乎免费，为后续用异步算法改进基于 ES 的智能体后训练打开空间；GRPO 在该任务上仍整体更强。

papers.title: MemLeak: Cross-User Semantic Leakage in Multi-Tenant AI Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Personal AI agents in enterprise multi-tenant deployments share a common vector store for long-term memory. Shared embedding spaces create a surface for cross-user memory leakage: a user's query can retrieve semantically adjacent memories belonging to another user through ordinary cosine-similarity retrieval, without any exploit. We formalize this as cross-user admissibility failure and evaluate it across six experiments, plus follow-up ablations, under both sparse (TF-IDF) and production-faithful (MiniLM-L6-v2) retrieval. Non-adversarial, incidental leakage reaches 70--100\% under pooled {same-team} retrieval; adversarially crafted memories achieve 90--100\% top-$k$ placement, exceeding weaker keyword-based attacker baselines, with score lifts of $+0.416$ to $+0.511$ under production-faithful dense retrieval (Config B); and end-to-end response contamination reaches 5.00/5 under a production retrieval path and 4.67/5 with Claude Sonnet~4.5, with contaminated responses often scoring as helpful or more helpful than clean ones, a gap validated against human judgment. Among three architectural mitigations, only hard post-retrieval ownership gating consistently restores the clean baseline (1.00/5) across {two generation models, at a measured latency overhead of roughly 1.4~ms per query.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Agentic AI with Structured CoT for Enhancing AI's Spatial Intelligence: Visualization and Reasoning of Rotation
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies show that artificial intelligence (AI) with language and vision capabilities still experiences limitations in spatial reasoning. In this paper, we have studied the spatial capabilities of advanced generative AI to understand the rotations of objects in 3D space, utilizing AI's image processing and language processing features. We trained and examined the spatial intelligence of a generative Agentic AI model (GPT-5.6) to understand the spatial rotation process with rotation diagrams based on the revised Purdue Spatial Visualization Test: Visualization of Rotations (Revised PSVT:R). We improvised the Revised PSVT:R by superimposing additional graphical and contextual features to evaluate how different Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning strategies influence model performance. The results indicate that structured CoT reasoning improves the spatial reasoning performance of the base GPT-5.6 model in both datasets (PSVT:R and PSVT:R with coordinate system). We used three CoT approaches - (1) Structured CoT, (2) few-shot Structured CoT, and Structured CoT with Self-optimized Prompt. The three CoT approaches evaluated in this study showed no significant performance difference. Results showed that combining structured CoT reasoning with relevant contextual information leads to considerable improvements in VLM performance on 3D rotation tasks, demonstrating the potential of agentic AI for more effective spatial reasoning. However, when contextual information is removed, structured CoT reasoning alone provides limited improvement, and the models continue to exhibit notable difficulties in understanding spatial transformations. These findings suggest that effective spatial reasoning in VLMs relies on the integration of visual, textual, and reasoning-based information in future agentic AI systems for spatial intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在修订版 Purdue 空间可视化测验 (Revised PSVT:R) 及其加坐标系变体上，结构化 Chain-of-Thought 显著提升 GPT-5.6 的 3D 旋转推理表现，且必须与坐标系等上下文信息结合才有效；去掉上下文后结构化 CoT 单独带来的提升有限，模型仍难以理解空间变换。三种 CoT 变体（结构化 CoT、few-shot 结构化 CoT、结构化 CoT 加自优化提示）之间无显著性能差异。
Motivation: 具备语言与视觉能力的生成式 AI 在空间推理上仍存在局限，尤其在理解物体 3D 旋转这类任务上表现不佳，需要弄清何种推理策略与上下文能真正改善 VLM 的空间智能。
Method: 以 GPT-5.6 生成式 Agentic AI 模型为对象，基于 Revised PSVT:R 旋转图题并叠加额外图形与上下文特征（坐标系）构造两个数据集，对比三种 CoT 策略：结构化 CoT、few-shot 结构化 CoT、结构化 CoT 加自优化提示 (Self-optimized Prompt)。
Result: 结构化 CoT 在 PSVT:R 与 PSVT:R 加坐标系两个数据集上均提升基础 GPT-5.6 的空间推理表现；三种 CoT 方法之间无显著性能差异；结合结构化 CoT 与相关上下文信息带来 VLM 在 3D 旋转任务上的显著改善，而移除上下文后结构化 CoT 单独仅有有限提升。
Conclusion: VLM 的有效空间推理依赖视觉、文本与推理信息的整合，单靠结构化 CoT 不足以解决空间变换理解困难，未来 agentic AI 系统应把上下文信息与推理策略一并设计。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Referring Multi-Object Tracking in Moving-Camera Videos via Global Motion Compensation
papers.abstract_en: Referring multi-object tracking (RMOT) takes a video and a language expression as input and tracks all referred objects. Many tracking requirements involve how an object moves rather than how it appears. However, in a video captured by a moving camera, a parked vehicle may appear to move, while a moving vehicle may show little displacement. Existing RMOT methods relate motion with text but do not explicitly remove camera-induced motion. In this paper, we propose extracting residual motion across frames by estimating camera motion in driver-view videos and compare motion characteristics with the query expression. We consider the motion-matching extent and integrate it with the RMOT method's prediction result through late fusion. In the evaluation, we verify the performance gain of taking the motion compensation module as a plug-in across different RMOT hosts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对移动相机视频中的指代多目标跟踪 (RMOT)，提出以相机运动估计提取帧间残差运动、并与查询表达做运动匹配，再经 late fusion 融入各 RMOT 主机的预测结果。作为即插即用模块在不同 RMOT 主机上均带来性能增益。
Motivation: 许多跟踪需求取决于物体如何运动而非外观，但移动相机会让静止车辆看似移动、运动车辆看似位移很小；现有 RMOT 把运动与文本关联，却不显式去除相机引入的运动。
Method: 在 driver-view 视频中估计相机运动并提取帧间残差运动，与查询表达比较运动特征，计算 motion-matching extent，再通过 late fusion 与 RMOT 主机的预测结果整合，作为可插拔的运动补偿模块。
Result: 在评测中，把该运动补偿模块作为 plug-in 接入不同 RMOT 主机时均取得性能增益。
Conclusion: 显式去除相机运动并做运动-文本匹配，可以作为通用插件提升 RMOT 在移动相机视频上的表现。

papers.title: EvalResearchBench: Can AI Agents Design Their Own Evaluations?
papers.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) relies on evaluation feedback to assess progress and guide further research, yet repeatedly running complex benchmarks is costly and slows iteration. Human experts reduce this cost by selecting benchmark subsets or designing compact suites. We ask whether AI agents can automate this design process and introduce EvalResearchBench (ERB), a benchmark for autonomous evaluation research. Given target materials, development references, candidate APIs, and fixed time and API budgets, an agent called the researcher selects or synthesizes tasks, implements graders, and revises them in pilot tests before freezing an executable evaluator for coding, co-work, and reasoning. We study 9 researchers and 13 candidate models and compare each frozen evaluator with 14 target benchmarks on score concordance and pairwise agreement. The best evaluators order about 75\% of candidate pairs as the targets do, below the 91\% ceiling set by disagreements among the targets. No researcher leads on every metric, and the best evaluator on development targets is not the best on sealed targets hidden from the researcher. A human-designed sample of public tasks remains a strong baseline, and the evaluator with the lowest recorded execution cost attains the highest pairwise agreement. Agents repair tasks and graders through pilot feedback, yet their evaluators can still truncate answers, exhaust the evaluation budget, or let a few questions dominate a domain score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvalResearchBench (ERB) 让 AI agent 在固定时间与 API 预算下自主设计评测：researcher 从候选任务中选择或合成、实现 grader、经 pilot 修订后冻结可执行 evaluator，覆盖 coding、co-work、reasoning 三类。9 个 researcher × 13 个候选模型与 14 个目标 benchmark 对比，最佳 evaluator 约 75% 的候选对排序与目标一致，低于目标之间分歧设定的 91% 上限；开发集最优者在密封目标上并非最优，人工设计的公开任务抽样仍是强基线。
Motivation: 递归自我改进 (RSI) 依赖评测反馈，但反复跑复杂 benchmark 成本高、拖慢迭代；人类专家靠挑子集或设计精简套件降本，问题是 agent 能否自主完成这一评测设计过程。
Method: ERB 给定目标材料、开发参考、候选 API 与固定时间和 API 预算，agent（researcher）选择或合成任务、实现 grader、在 pilot 测试中修订，最后冻结可执行 evaluator；评测覆盖 coding、co-work、reasoning，研究 9 个 researcher 与 13 个候选模型，用 score concordance 与 pairwise agreement 把每个冻结 evaluator 与 14 个目标 benchmark 对比。
Result: 最佳 evaluator 约 75% 的候选对排序与目标 benchmark 一致，低于目标之间分歧给出的 91% 上限；没有 researcher 在所有指标上领先，开发目标上最好的 evaluator 在对 researcher 隐藏的密封目标上不是最好；人工设计的公开任务抽样仍是强基线，记录执行成本最低的 evaluator 取得最高 pairwise agreement。agent 会经 pilot 反馈修复任务与 grader，但其 evaluator 仍可能截断答案、耗尽评测预算，或让少数问题主导某个 domain 分数。
Conclusion: agent 能自主产出与目标 benchmark 高度一致的紧凑评测，但自评设计存在开发集与密封集不一致、成本与质量不单调、以及任务级失效模式，人工抽样基线仍具竞争力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Language Model Activations Inhabit Privileged Error-Correcting Basins
papers.abstract_en: Language models exhibit remarkable robustness, continuing to produce coherent text even when their activations are perturbed by interventions like linear steering. We hypothesize that this robustness is a result of passive dynamics, i.e., constraining mechanisms in the forward pass that funnel activations toward "good" regions that produce coherent outputs. To investigate these hypothesized error-correcting mechanisms, we probe the geometry of language model activation space by observing the action of model layers on low-dimensional curves. In doing so, we discover that model activations occur within a cluster of distinct attracting basins, which differentiate natural activations geometrically from distributionally similar synthetic activations. Applying this lens to language model steering, we observe feature-specific basins along semantic steering directions, and find that steering moves activations between these basins. To demonstrate the active role of this geometry in neural computation, we show that adaptively modulating steering strength to transport activations across basins improves inter-language steering, significantly increasing the probability of sampling tokens from the target language compared to fixed-strength steering. Our findings establish analysis of activation space geometry as a promising approach to interpreting and controlling language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用低维曲线探测语言模型激活空间几何，发现自然激活聚在一组彼此分离的吸引盆 (attracting basins) 内，语义 steering 方向上存在特征专属的盆，steering 的作用是把激活在盆之间搬运。按盆边界自适应调节 steering 强度以跨盆输运激活，可显著提高采样到目标语言 token 的概率，优于固定强度 steering。
Motivation: 语言模型激活被 linear steering 等干预扰动后仍输出连贯文本，这种鲁棒性来源不明；缺少刻画激活空间几何并解释 steering 何时有效的框架。
Method: 观察模型各层作用于低维曲线的行为来探测激活空间几何，比较自然激活与分布相似的合成激活的几何差异；再沿语义 steering 方向识别特征专属的吸引盆，并设计自适应调节 steering 强度的跨盆输运策略。
Result: 自然激活在几何上区别于分布相似的合成激活，聚成一组分离的吸引盆；steering 在语义方向上呈现特征专属的盆并使激活在盆间移动；自适应强度的跨盆输运在跨语言 steering 上显著提高采样到目标语言 token 的概率，优于固定强度 steering。
Conclusion: 语言模型的鲁棒性可由前向过程中的被动动力学解释：激活空间的吸引盆几何既区分自然与合成激活，也可被主动利用来控制模型行为；激活空间几何分析是解释与控制语言模型的一条可行路径。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 观察模型各层作用于低维曲线的行为来探测激活空间几何，比较自然激活与分布相似的合成激活的几何差异；再沿语义 steering 方向识别特征专属的吸引盆，并设计自适应调节 steering 强度的跨盆输运策略。
summary_sections.result: 自然激活在几何上区别于分布相似的合成激活，聚成一组分离的吸引盆；steering 在语义方向上呈现特征专属的盆并使激活在盆间移动；自适应强度的跨盆输运在跨语言 steering 上显著提高采样到目标语言 token 的概率，优于固定强度 steering。
summary_sections.conclusion: 语言模型的鲁棒性可由前向过程中的被动动力学解释：激活空间的吸引盆几何既区分自然与合成激活，也可被主动利用来控制模型行为；激活空间几何分析是解释与控制语言模型的一条可行路径。

papers.title: SHarP: Saliency-based Pruning of Agent Harnesses
papers.abstract_en: Agent harnesses are systems that coordinate model calls, tool use, and task execution to help large language models complete complex tasks. To meet task requirements and address failures, these systems are often iteratively refined by amending and patching their instructions, tools, and workflows, continuously increasing harness complexity. It is therefore unclear whether some resulting harness modules are redundant, introducing substantial token overhead with little, if any, performance gain. Inspired by neural network pruning, in this paper, we study harness pruning as a means of striking a better balance between task performance and token cost. We propose SHarP (Saliency-based Harness Pruning), a simple yet effective pruning strategy based on the saliency of each harness module with respect to performance and efficiency. Specifically, we first identify tools, instructions, and supporting mechanisms as components that can be individually disabled. We then estimate the saliency of each module by ablating it and assessing its task performance and token cost relative to the full set of single-module ablations. Modules with the smallest contribution to performance or largest computational overhead are subsequently pruned. Our evaluation across various harnesses on held-out validation sets reveals a surprising finding: most harnesses that we studied are highly redundant and can maintain comparable performance and efficiency even after a substantial portion of their modules are pruned. Our pruning approach and empirical findings provide new perspectives on agent harness design and optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SHarP 把神经网络剪枝搬到 agent harness 上：逐个禁用工具、指令与支撑机制做单模块消融，按对任务性能的贡献和 token 开销算 saliency，剪掉贡献最小或开销最大的模块。在多种 harness 的 held-out 验证集上，多数 harness 高度冗余，剪掉相当大比例模块后性能与效率仍相当。
Motivation: harness 靠反复修补指令、工具和工作流来应对失败，复杂度持续膨胀，其中部分模块可能几乎不带来性能收益却造成大量 token 开销，任务性能与成本的权衡不清。
Method: 将可单独禁用的组件划为工具、指令和支撑机制；对每个模块做一次消融，比较其相对完整单模块消融集合的任务性能与 token 成本，据此估计 saliency；随后剪除对性能贡献最小或计算开销最大的模块。
Result: 在多种 harness 的 held-out 验证集上评估显示：所研究的多数 harness 高度冗余，剪掉相当大比例的模块后仍能保持相当的性能与效率。
Conclusion: agent harness 中普遍存在可安全移除的冗余模块，按性能贡献与 token 开销的 saliency 做剪枝是平衡任务表现与成本的有效手段，为 harness 设计与优化提供了新视角。

papers.title: Risk-Calibrated Proposal Transport for Finite-Particle Diffusion Steering
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time steering combines pretrained diffusion experts or rewards without retraining by changing the dynamics that transport noise to data. Feynman-Kac correction compensates for proposal mismatch through importance-weighted sequential Monte Carlo (SMC), whose finite-particle behavior depends on the proposal. Variance-controlling guidance (VCG) improves that proposal by fitting a linear drift correction to minimize empirical log-weight-rate variance. Although its population optimum cannot worsen residual variance, finite-particle VCG can nearly eliminate its fitting residual while increasing residual risk on new states by orders of magnitude. The resulting update can degrade unweighted generation or accelerate particle collapse. We show that the centered Feynman-Kac rate is the normalized transport residual and that expected out-of-fit benefit is exactly population headroom minus coefficient-estimation penalty. Under regularity assumptions, a Wasserstein analysis bounds the unweighted proposal's terminal error using this residual. These results motivate Risk-Calibrated Proposal Transport (RCPT), which uses deletion leave-one-out residuals to calibrate the retained fraction of the VCG update, adding no model calls and only small linear-algebra overhead. Experiments on 2D checker distributions, scaffold decoration, molecular property optimization, and class-conditional CIFAR-10 generation demonstrate recovery from harmful fitted updates. Across molecular and image domains, RCPT mitigates harmful fitted updates and improves a broad range of terminal metrics relative to uncalibrated VCG.
papers.comment: Earlier version accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics (STODY)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RCPT 用 deletion leave-one-out 残差校准 VCG 线性漂移更新的保留比例，纠正有限粒子下拟合残差几乎归零却在新状态上残差风险放大数个量级的失配，且不增加模型调用。在 2D checker、scaffold decoration、分子性质优化与 class-conditional CIFAR-10 上，RCPT 能从有害拟合更新中恢复，并相对未校准 VCG 改善多类终端指标。
Motivation: Feynman-Kac 修正依赖 proposal，有限粒子的 VCG 虽最小化经验 log-weight-rate 方差，却可能在拟合外状态上把残差风险放大数个量级，导致无权生成退化或粒子塌缩加速。
Method: 先证明 centered Feynman-Kac rate 即归一化 transport residual，且期望的拟合外收益恰为 population headroom 减系数估计惩罚；再在正则条件下用 Wasserstein 分析界定无权 proposal 的终端误差。据此提出 RCPT：用 deletion leave-one-out 残差校准 VCG 更新的保留比例，只增加少量线性代数开销、不增加模型调用。
Result: 有限粒子 VCG 可把拟合残差几乎消掉，却让新状态上的残差风险上升数个量级 (orders of magnitude)。在 2D checker distributions、scaffold decoration、分子性质优化与 class-conditional CIFAR-10 上，RCPT 从有害拟合更新中恢复，并在分子与图像域相对未校准 VCG 改善广泛的 terminal metrics。
Conclusion: 有限粒子下 proposal 更新的收益要扣掉系数估计惩罚，按 LOO 残差校准保留比例即可避免有害更新，且开销很小。

papers.title: Language Model Fingerprinting Requires Rethinking Watermark Teachers
papers.abstract_en: LLM fingerprinting via watermark distillation embeds a statistical watermark signal into model weights, enabling model owners to identify their models behind black-box APIs. Revisiting a recent protocol, we find that its utility evaluation understates text quality degradation in open-ended generation, favoring overly strong watermark teachers. Weakening the watermark improves text quality but sacrifices detectability. To move beyond this trade-off, we rethink whether text watermarks designed for verifying generated text are suitable distillation teachers for model fingerprinting. Such watermarks are typically designed to remain detectable from an individual output, limiting how sparse the watermark signal can be. In contrast, fingerprint verification can aggregate signal across queries, making sparser watermark signals viable. This raises a key question: where should the sparse signal be placed? We analyze signal placement through token surprisal and show that, even at comparable watermark strength, different placements can target tokens with different plausibility under the base model. This motivates near-tie restriction, which uses top-1-relative logit gaps to restrict the watermark bias to tokens close to the base model's top prediction. Across multiple models, near-tie improves detection--quality frontiers under deployment changes, preserves higher text quality across query budgets, and further improves existing watermarking schemes when combined with them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 指纹识别靠水印蒸馏把统计水印嵌进权重，但沿用为「验证单条生成文本」设计的水印当老师会高估文本质量：这类水印必须在单条输出上可检测，因而信号无法更稀疏。作者改用 near-tie restriction，按 top-1 相对 logit gap 把水印偏置限制在接近基座模型 top-1 预测的 token 上，利用指纹验证可跨查询聚合信号这一点，在部署条件变化下改善检测-质量前沿。
Motivation: 近期水印蒸馏指纹协议的效用评估低估了开放式生成中的文本质量退化，偏向过强的水印老师；而为单条输出可检测设计的水印限制了信号稀疏度，使指纹识别陷入「弱水印提质但降检测」的取舍。
Method: 先重审现有协议的效用评估，再通过 token surprisal 分析信号放置位置对基座模型 token 合理性的影响；据此提出 near-tie restriction，用 top-1 相对 logit gap 把水印偏置限制在接近基座 top-1 的 token 上，并可与已有水印方案组合使用。
Result: 在多个模型上，near-tie 在部署条件变化下改善检测-质量前沿，在不同查询预算下保持更高文本质量，并与已有水印方案结合时进一步提升其效果。
Conclusion: 为验证单条文本设计的水印不适合作为指纹蒸馏的老师；既然指纹验证能跨查询聚合信号，就应把稀疏水印信号放在基座模型 top-1 附近的 token 上。

papers.title: Agentic Cognitive Depth: Operational Criteria for Evaluating LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agentic large language model (LLM) systems are commonly implemented as an LLM in a loop with Planning, Memory, Tools, and Control Flow. This application-focused view connects agentic LLM research with deployable systems and leaves open how such systems should be evaluated beyond end-to-end task success. Building on this view, we define agentic cognitive depth as a trajectory-level profile across five operational criteria. The profile contains context sensitivity ($C$), temporal continuity ($T$), multimodal coordination ($M$), adaptive interaction ($A$), and metacognitive monitoring ($Mc$). The first four criteria measure how well Control Flow, Memory, Tools, and Planning are used across a trajectory. The fifth measures whether the system monitors and regulates the full run. For each criterion, we give operational proxies and a perturbation procedure, then connect the profile to the agent's world model. We provide the structure needed to extend benchmarks such as GAIA, SWE-bench, WebArena, and TRIP-Bench with per-criterion diagnostics. Symbolic verifiers, structured memory, planner coupling, and tool constraints provide practical ways to build and test these capacities.
papers.comment: The 5th International Conference on Human and Artificial Rationalities
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 agentic LLM 的「认知深度」定义为轨迹级五维画像：上下文敏感度 C、时间连续性 T、多模态协调 M、自适应交互 A、元认知监控 Mc，前四维对应 Control Flow、Memory、Tools、Planning 的使用质量，第五维衡量对整轮运行的监控与调节。每个维度给出可操作代理指标与扰动检验流程，并把画像接到 agent 的 world model 上，用于给 GAIA、SWE-bench、WebArena、TRIP-Bench 补逐维诊断。
Motivation: agentic LLM 系统通常只是 LLM in a loop 加上 Planning、Memory、Tools、Control Flow，评估却只看端到端任务成功，无法定位是哪个组件在轨迹中失效。
Method: 以五个操作性准则构成轨迹级画像，为每个准则给出 operational proxies 与 perturbation procedure，并将画像与 agent 的 world model 关联；同时指出 symbolic verifiers、structured memory、planner coupling、tool constraints 是构建并检验这些能力的可行手段。
Result: 给出五维画像（C、T、M、A、Mc）及其操作性定义与扰动检验流程，并提供把 GAIA、SWE-bench、WebArena、TRIP-Bench 扩展为逐准则诊断的结构；摘要未含实验数值。
Conclusion: 端到端任务成功率不足以刻画 agentic 系统，按五维轨迹画像加扰动检验可把评估落到 Planning、Memory、Tools、Control Flow 各组件的使用质量上。

papers.title: Principled Top-$k$ Selection for Language Models with Hybrid Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Selecting the best $k$ items out of $m$ candidates is a critical component of modern large language model systems, such as document selection in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and expert routing in Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs). However, training these selection modules remains challenging due to weak gradient signals and suboptimal exploration-exploitation tradeoffs. Furthermore, prior works often rely on heuristics, lacking principled objectives and approaches that explicitly model and solve the top-$k$ selection problem. In this work, we propose a principled objective for training selection modules, whose gradient naturally provides richer training signals in a hybrid form---containing a supervised-gradient component and a policy-gradient component. We show that the selection problem becomes harder as $m$ increases, and our algorithm converges at rate $O(1/\sqrt{T})$, with the optimal upper bound achieved by balancing between bias and variance. Practically, we apply our method to a set of tasks involving top-$k$ selection, including synthetic regression problems, RAG, and MoE systems, showing that our method outperforms the baselines in next-token prediction perplexity and QA accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为 LLM 系统中的 top-k 选择模块（RAG 文档选择、MoE 专家路由）提出一个有原则的训练目标，其梯度天然呈混合形式，同时包含监督梯度分量与策略梯度分量。理论上证明选择难度随候选数 m 增大而上升，算法收敛率为 O(1/√T)，通过偏差与方差的平衡达到最优上界；在合成回归、RAG 与 MoE 任务上，next-token 困惑度与 QA 准确率均优于基线。
Motivation: top-k 选择模块训练面临梯度信号弱与探索-利用权衡不佳的问题，且既有工作多依赖启发式，缺少显式建模并求解 top-k 选择问题的目标与方法。
Method: 提出一个有原则的 top-k 选择训练目标，其梯度为混合形式：一部分是监督梯度 (supervised-gradient)，一部分是策略梯度 (policy-gradient)；理论分析给出随 m 增大的难度结论与 O(1/√T) 收敛率，最优上界由偏差-方差平衡取得；应用到合成回归、RAG 与 MoE 三类任务。
Result: 在合成回归、RAG 与 MoE 任务上，next-token prediction 困惑度与 QA 准确率均超过基线；理论结果为收敛率 O(1/√T)，最优上界由平衡偏差与方差取得，并证明选择问题随候选数 m 增大而变难。
Conclusion: 把 top-k 选择显式形式化为可优化目标、用混合梯度（监督 + 策略梯度）训练，能在 RAG 与 MoE 等选择模块上取得优于启发式基线的困惑度与 QA 准确率，并给出 O(1/√T) 的收敛保证。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Diagnosis-Conditioned Spatial Gating and Decoder-Level Supervised Contrastive Learning for Radiology Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Radiology report generation models can produce fluent text while still containing finding-level inaccuracies. Diagnosis-driven methods improve generation by conditioning on predicted findings, but these predictions do not directly modify the visual patch features provided to the decoder, and global gating applies the same modulation across spatial locations. We introduce a Position-Aware Gate (PAG) that uses predicted finding representations to modulate visual patches spatially without region supervision. We also propose a Decoder-level Supervised Contrastive Loss (DSCL) that structures decoder representations using shared positive findings rather than instance identity. On MIMIC-CXR, PAG+DSCL improves clinical efficacy (CE) F1 from 0.484 to 0.502 over a matched global-gate reference, while PAG and DSCL individually reach 0.491 and 0.495. Without additional fine-tuning, the combined model achieves 0.226 CE F1 on IU X-Ray, compared with 0.211 reported by PromptMRG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 放射报告生成中，诊断条件只作用于文本侧、全局门控对所有空间位置施加相同调制，导致流利文本仍含 finding 级错误。Position-Aware Gate (PAG) 用预测 finding 表征在无区域监督下空间调制视觉 patch，Decoder-level Supervised Contrastive Loss (DSCL) 按共享 finding 而非实例身份组织解码器表征；MIMIC-CXR 上 PAG+DSCL 把 clinical efficacy (CE) F1 从 0.484 提到 0.502。
Motivation: 诊断驱动的报告生成方法依赖预测 finding，但这些预测不直接修改送入解码器的视觉 patch 特征，且全局门控对所有空间位置一视同仁，难以抑制 finding 级不准确。
Method: PAG 用预测的 finding 表征对视觉 patch 做位置相关的空间调制，不需要区域级监督；DSCL 在解码器表征上施加监督对比损失，以共享 finding 作为正样本对而非实例身份；两者与全局门控参考模型做匹配对比。
Result: MIMIC-CXR 上 PAG+DSCL 的 CE F1 从 0.484 提升到 0.502，单独 PAG 达 0.491、单独 DSCL 达 0.495；不做额外微调时，组合模型在 IU X-Ray 上 CE F1 为 0.226，PromptMRG 报告为 0.211。
Conclusion: 把诊断条件下沉到视觉 patch 的空间调制、并按共享 finding 组织解码器表征，能同时提升同域与跨域的临床有效性，且跨数据集无需微调。

papers.title: How RL Reshapes LLM Reasoning: Transferability, Coverage, and Scaling Laws
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies on reinforcement learning (RL) report seemingly conflicting evidence about large language model (LLM) reasoning. Training on mathematics can improve performance in other domains, yet gains in Pass@1 can coincide with lower Pass@$N$ than the base model. This raises a fundamental question: does RL expand an LLM's reasoning boundary, or merely reweight its existing reasoning space? We revisit these phenomena across Qwen and Gemma model families, showing both cross-domain gains and forgetting, while coverage at large sampling budgets increases on some tasks and decreases on others. Detailed analysis of solution traces before and after RL indicates a shift in the reasoning strategies the model employs, motivating a two-stage autoregressive policy model that separates \emph{strategy selection} from problem-specific execution. Within this framework, we prove how RL's implicit bias reshapes strategy preferences, allowing gains on some tasks while suppressing strategies required by others. This mechanism can also broaden or narrow coverage at a given sampling budget even without expanding strategy support. We further provide theoretical justifications for log-sigmoid and log-linear scaling laws in RL compute, and evaluate their predictive power. Together, these results connect changes in strategy selection to cross-domain transfer, reasoning coverage, and compute scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文重新检验 RL 对 LLM 推理的“扩展边界还是重加权”之争：在 Qwen 与 Gemma 上同时观察到跨域提升与遗忘，且大采样预算下 coverage 有升有降。作者把解码轨迹变化归因于策略选择 (strategy selection) 被 RL 重排，并证明 log-sigmoid 与 log-linear 两种 RL 计算 scaling law 有理论依据。
Motivation: RL 后训练的证据互相矛盾：数学训练能提升其他域，Pass@1 上升却可能伴随 Pass@N 低于基座，说明 RL 究竟扩展推理边界还是仅重加权既有推理空间尚无统一解释。
Method: 在 Qwen 与 Gemma 模型族上对比 RL 前后的解码轨迹，提出把策略选择与题目级执行分开的两阶段自回归策略模型，并在该框架下证明 RL 隐式偏置如何改变策略偏好；另给出 log-sigmoid 与 log-linear RL 计算 scaling law 的理论推导并检验其预测力。
Result: 观察到跨域提升与遗忘并存，coverage 在大采样预算下部分任务上升、部分下降；证明 RL 隐式偏置可在不扩展策略支持集的情况下改变给定采样预算下的 coverage；给出 log-sigmoid 与 log-linear scaling law 的理论解释并评估其预测能力。
Conclusion: RL 对推理的影响主要通过重排策略选择而非扩展策略支持集，因此可同时造成跨域迁移、遗忘与 coverage 变化；计算 scaling 行为可用 log-sigmoid 或 log-linear 形式刻画。

papers.title: Mitigating Over-squashing without Rewiring: A Sheaf Effective Resistance Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) often struggle to capture long-range dependencies due to over-squashing -- a phenomenon in which the repeated compression of node embeddings into finite-size messages causes representations to collapse. Over-squashing is most often diagnosed as a property of the graph topology, with effective resistance serving as a principled measure of the bottleneck. We provide a complementary view on the matter: building on cellular sheaves, we introduce sheaf effective resistance, a generalization of effective resistance that depends on the sheaf attached to the graph, and we prove that for flat vector bundles, the over-squashing sensitivity in the Jacobian sense is upper bounded by a quantity related to the sheaf effective resistance between the nodes. The bottleneck thus need not lie in the graph itself: it can be relocated, and reduced, by adjusting the sheaf. We instantiate this idea in FlatNSD, a simple message-passing variant of Neural Sheaf Diffusion, and show that it implicitly learns to modulate total sheaf effective resistance, performing well on benchmarks designed to stress over-squashing without altering the original graph topology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 sheaf effective resistance，把过压缩 (over-squashing) 从图拓扑属性改写为依赖图上附着 sheaf 的量，并证明对 flat vector bundle，Jacobian 意义下的过压缩敏感度被与节点间 sheaf effective resistance 相关的量上界。由此瓶颈可被搬移并减小：实例化为 FlatNSD（Neural Sheaf Diffusion 的消息传递变体），在专门施压过压缩的基准上表现良好，且不改动原图拓扑。
Motivation: 过压缩通常被诊断为图拓扑性质、以 effective resistance 度量瓶颈，但重连图代价高；作者给出互补视角，说明瓶颈可随 sheaf 调整而搬移与削弱。
Method: 基于 cellular sheaf 定义 sheaf effective resistance（effective resistance 的推广，依赖附着在图上的 sheaf）；对 flat vector bundle 证明 Jacobian 意义的过压缩敏感度上界；据此实例化 FlatNSD，一个 Neural Sheaf Diffusion 的简单消息传递变体，隐式调制 total sheaf effective resistance。
Result: 证明 flat vector bundle 下过压缩敏感度被与 sheaf effective resistance 相关的量上界；FlatNSD 在专为施压过压缩设计的基准上表现良好，且不改变原图拓扑。
Conclusion: 过压缩不必归因于图本身：通过调整 sheaf 而非重连，即可搬移并减小瓶颈，从而在保持拓扑不变的前提下缓解过压缩。

papers.title: Removing spurious minima for planar features by skip connections
papers.abstract_en: Understanding loss landscapes is central to explaining neural-network training, yet their structure remains only partially understood even in simple models. We study the Gaussian population loss of shallow, bias-free ReLU networks in the teacher--student setting. This provides a simple model for studying essential aspects such as feature learning and overparameterization. For teacher networks with positive output weights and planar features, we show that including a learned linear skip removes all spurious local minima with non-negative student output weights once the student network is at least as wide as the teacher network. In contrast, without the skip, we construct a fixed teacher network with positive output weights and only three hidden neurons in input dimension two whose spurious local minima persist at every student width at least three. Thus, a learned linear skip can remove spurious minima that persist under arbitrary overparameterization. Furthermore, we show that a positive output weight student network always learns the subspace spanned by the teacher features: student features at local minima with non-negative student output weights lie in the span of the teacher features. For ReLU networks in two dimensions, even heavily overparameterized student networks have effective width controlled by the teacher width: every critical point with positive student output weights has at most twice as many distinct student feature directions as teacher neurons. Finally, we transfer the benignity result to empirical minima over parameter balls of any prescribed radius, with the required sampling accuracy depending on that radius.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 4 figures. Under review. Accompanying Lean 4 formalization available at https://github.com/JayPiZimmermann/Removing-spurious-minima-for-planar-features-by-skip-connections
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在教师输出权重为正、特征张成平面的 teacher-student 设定下，给无偏置浅层 ReLU 网络加一个可学习线性 skip，只要学生宽度不小于教师宽度，就消掉所有学生输出权重非负的伪局部极小；不加 skip 时可构造仅 3 个隐神经元、输入维数 2 的固定教师，其伪极小在学生宽度 ≥3 时始终存在。结论是过参数化本身不足以消除伪极小，线性 skip 才能。
Motivation: 损失地形结构即使在简单模型中也只被部分理解：过参数化是否足以消除伪局部极小，此前缺少明确的判定条件。
Method: 研究无偏置浅层 ReLU 网络在 teacher-student 设定下的 Gaussian population loss；对正输出权重、平面特征的教师证明加 skip 后的无伪极小定理，并构造反例教师；另证正输出权重学生在极小处的特征落在教师特征张成空间内，以及二维下临界点的不同特征方向数至多为教师神经元数的两倍；结果配套 Lean 4 形式化。
Result: 加可学习线性 skip 时，学生宽度 ≥ 教师宽度即消除所有学生输出权重非负的伪局部极小；不加 skip 时存在仅 3 个隐神经元、输入维数 2 的正输出权重教师，其伪极小在所有学生宽度 ≥3 时持续存在。二维 ReLU 网络中每个正输出权重临界点的不同学生特征方向数至多为教师神经元数的两倍；良性结果可转移到任意给定半径参数球上的经验极小，所需采样精度依赖该半径。
Conclusion: 可学习线性 skip 能消除任意过参数化下都持续存在的伪极小，而过参数化本身做不到；正输出权重学生的有效宽度由教师宽度控制。

papers.title: Beyond Demographic Balance: Multi-Metric and Intersectional Evaluation of Fairness in MIMIC-IV Mortality Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Fairness conclusions in clinical prediction can depend strongly on both the metrics reported and the demographic resolution at which performance is evaluated. We revisit these evaluation choices for ICU mortality prediction on MIMIC-IV, comparing predictive-utility and subgroup-error metrics across several fairness interventions. As a complementary case study, we introduce a lightweight adaptation strategy that jointly balances ethnicity--gender--insurance representation without conditioning on mortality outcomes, allowing demographic representation balancing to be examined separately from outcome-conditioned or direct error-rate interventions. We evaluate its behavior at both marginal and corresponding three-way intersectional subgroup levels, while accounting for the statistical support of finer-grained estimates. The results show that interventions can receive substantially different assessments across accuracy/AUROC, sensitivity, and false-positive rate, and that marginal demographic summaries can conceal heterogeneous error profiles within their constituent intersections, including among larger subgroups. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating fairness interventions at both complementary metric and subgroup resolutions, while accounting for the intervention target and the reliability of subgroup estimates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MIMIC-IV ICU 死亡预测上重做公平性评估，发现同一干预在 accuracy/AUROC、sensitivity、false-positive rate 三种指标下会得到截然不同的评价，且边际人口统计汇总会掩盖其内部三元交叉（ethnicity×gender×insurance）子群的异质误差，即使在较小子群中也如此。结论是公平干预必须同时在互补指标与交叉子群两个分辨率上评估，并核对干预目标与子群估计的统计可靠性。
Motivation: 临床预测的公平性结论强烈依赖所报告的指标与评估的人口统计分辨率，仅看边际子群会掩盖交叉子群内部的误差异质性。
Method: 在 MIMIC-IV ICU 死亡预测上比较多种公平干预的 predictive-utility 与 subgroup-error 指标；另提出一个轻量适配策略，联合平衡 ethnicity–gender–insurance 三元表示且不以死亡结局为条件，从而把表示平衡与结局条件化或直接错误率干预分开考察；在边际与三元交叉子群两个层级评估，并计入细分估计的统计支持度。

papers.title: EgoFound3R: End-to-End Egocentric Hand Reconstruction in World Space with Point-Wise Interaction Attributes
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric video has become a primary source of supervision for embodied models, and its value rests on recovering hand motion in world coordinates, which camera motion and hand occlusion make difficult. Existing reconstruction pipelines typically separate hand and scene estimation, leave interaction attributes to separate task-specific models, and invoke several models per video, so no prior reconstruction model estimates these attributes and throughput becomes a practical constraint on large-scale annotation. We therefore introduce EgoFound3R, a unified end-to-end model that estimates world-space hand geometry in a metric scale shared with the scene, and predicts point-wise interaction attributes, including visibility, contact, and distance. The model integrates three designs: (i) structured hand prompts that transfer pretrained geometric priors to world-space hand reconstruction; (ii) an explicit hand representation that decodes hand geometry and interaction attributes; and (iii) a shared-parameter multi-rate design that lowers inference cost. Together, these designs predict hand geometry and point-wise attributes in one pass. On OakInk-v2, TACO, and HOI4D, EgoFound3R reduces the mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 43.2%, 22.4%, and 11.6% over previous methods and predicts point-wise contact and distance alongside the geometry in the same pass, while attaining approximately 6x higher throughput.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EgoFound3R 把第一人称视频中的手部重建与逐点交互属性（可见性、接触、距离）合并为一个端到端模型，一次前向同时输出与场景共享度量尺度的世界坐标手部几何。在 OakInk-v2、TACO、HOI4D 上 MPJPE 相对既有方法分别降低 43.2%、22.4%、11.6%，吞吐量约提升 6 倍。
Motivation: 现有流程把手工与场景估计拆开、交互属性交给独立任务模型，且每段视频要串多个模型，无法同时给出这些属性，吞吐量成为大规模标注的瓶颈。
Method: 三项设计：结构化手部提示把预训练几何先验迁移到世界空间手部重建；显式手部表示在同一解码中输出几何与逐点交互属性；共享参数的多速率 (multi-rate) 设计降低推理开销，实现单次前向预测。
Result: 在 OakInk-v2、TACO、HOI4D 上 MPJPE 相对先前方法分别降低 43.2%、22.4%、11.6%；同一趟预测同时给出逐点接触与距离属性；吞吐量约为先前方法的 6 倍。
Conclusion: 把几何与交互属性放进一个端到端模型并共享参数，可以在提高精度的同时把吞吐量抬到适合大规模具身数据标注的水平。

papers.title: Kernelized Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering provides a simple, training-free mechanism for controlling attributes of generative models such as sentiment, style, and helpfulness. However, standard approaches such as Difference-in-Means apply a single input-independent steering vector across all activations, limiting expressivity and ignoring the local geometry of the activation space. We propose Kernelized Activation Steering (KAS), a unifying framework that lifts activation steering into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space. KAS formulates steering as an optimization problem expressed purely via kernel evaluations, yielding an implicit, activation-dependent steering score without constructing explicit feature maps. Unlike DiM, KAS induces locally adaptive steering: each activation is modified according to its relative position with respect to source and target reference sets, producing a nonlinear steering field over the representation space. Importantly, DiM is recovered as a special case under a linear kernel, while richer kernels enable geometry-aware interventions. Across standard activation steering tasks, including jailbreaking LLMs and image style control, KAS outperforms or is on par with the existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KAS 把激活引导 (activation steering) 提升到再生核希尔伯特空间 (RKHS)，用纯核评估的优化问题生成依赖于每个激活的隐式引导分数，取代 Difference-in-Means 的单一输入无关向量。线性核下可退化为 DiM，更丰富的核则产生随激活相对 source/target 参考集位置变化的非线性引导场。在 LLM 越狱与图像风格控制等标准任务上，KAS 优于或持平现有方法。
Motivation: 标准激活引导方法（如 Difference-in-Means）对所有激活施加同一个输入无关的引导向量，表达力受限，且忽略激活空间的局部几何。
Method: 提出 Kernelized Activation Steering (KAS)：把引导写成仅由核评估表达的优化问题，得到不显式构造特征映射的、依赖激活的隐式引导分数；每个激活按其相对 source 与 target 参考集的位置被修改，形成表示空间上的非线性引导场；线性核下 DiM 是特例。
Result: 在标准激活引导任务上（含 LLM 越狱与图像风格控制），KAS 优于或与现有方法持平；线性核情形可精确恢复 Difference-in-Means。
Conclusion: 把激活引导统一到核框架可同时容纳 DiM 并引入几何感知的局部自适应干预，且在越狱与风格控制任务上取得竞争性效果。

papers.title: Variational Streaming Flow: Probabilistic Forecasting in Physical Time
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic forecasting is important for predicting complex dynamical systems because intrinsic randomness and incomplete observations can cause the same observed state to evolve into multiple plausible futures. While flow matching is a flexible approach for probabilistic forecasting, it is computationally expensive. Streaming flow (SF) reformulates this approach to model temporal evolution efficiently by learning a continuous velocity field directly in physical time. However, SF learns a deterministic velocity field. Thus, it provides only a single future trajectory for a given fixed initial state and observation history. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Variational Streaming Flow (VSF). Our approach learns a latent distribution that is conditioned on the dynamics of interest. In turn, this enables probabilistic forecasting. Importantly, we retain the computational efficiency of SF by generating in physical time. Across deterministic and stochastic dynamical systems, VSF demonstrates superior predictive accuracy and distributional fidelity. We demonstrate the advantage for both long-horizon rollouts exceeding 1,000 steps, and settings with bifurcating dynamics. Moreover, VSF can be integrated into existing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA)-based world models as a plug-and-play predictor to improve temporal dynamics and goal-directed success rate in navigation, motion planning, and manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VSF 在 streaming flow 的物理时间连续速度场之上加一个按动力系统条件化的隐变量分布，把原本只给单条轨迹的确定性 SF 变成概率预报。在确定性与随机动力系统上，长时程滚动超过 1,000 步以及分岔动力学设置中，预测精度与分布保真度均优于对照，并可作为即插即用预测器接入 JEPA 世界模型。
Motivation: 流匹配 (flow matching) 做概率预报计算开销大；streaming flow 虽在物理时间上学速度场而高效，但学到的是确定性速度场，给定初始状态与观测历史只能输出一条未来轨迹，无法表达内在随机性带来的多个合理未来。
Method: 在 streaming flow 框架内学习一个以目标动力系统为条件的隐分布 (latent distribution)，在物理时间中生成以保留 SF 的计算效率；并把 VSF 作为即插即用预测器接入已有的 JEPA 世界模型。
Result: 在确定性与随机动力系统上，VSF 的预测精度与分布保真度 (distributional fidelity) 均显示更优；优势在超过 1,000 步的长时程滚动以及具有分岔 (bifurcating) 动力学的设置中得到展示；接入 JEPA 世界模型后改善时序动态，并提升导航、运动规划与操作任务的目标导向成功率。
Conclusion: 在物理时间中对隐分布做条件化，可以在不牺牲 streaming flow 计算效率的前提下获得概率预报能力，并能直接嵌入 JEPA 类世界模型充当预测器。

papers.title: ChronoGraph: Functional 4D Scene Graphs with Vision-Language Models for Interaction Understanding and Grounded Planning
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents must determine where to act, anticipate the resulting scene changes, and interpret observed outcomes to guide subsequent actions. This requires connecting 4D interaction understanding, which explains how past actions changed the scene, with spatially grounded planning, which determines how and where to act toward a goal and anticipates the resulting scene changes. We introduce ChronoGraph, a functional 4D scene graph that links actions on affordance parts to semantic and geometric state changes. By representing observed and anticipated transitions in the same form, it provides a shared basis for understanding and planning. We construct ChronoGraphBench through an automatic data engine that converts human-interaction videos and simulated robot trajectories into graph-annotated questions for training and evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on both tasks. Using these annotations, we train ChronoGraphVLM by adapting pretrained VLMs in two stages. Graph-as-Chain-of-Thought supervised fine-tuning teaches the models to reconstruct observed transitions and predict future ones as graph traces before answering. Subsequent joint 4D graph reinforcement learning directly rewards graph properties and answer correctness. Experiments across model scales show improvements over the corresponding pretrained baselines and zero-shot transfer to VLM4D. Real-world demonstrations further show that graph-based planning and affordance grounding support mobile manipulation through existing robot skills without additional fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChronoGraph 把动作作用在 affordance 部件上引起的语义与几何状态变化统一成 4D 场景图，使同一图形式既可解释过去动作如何改变场景，也可预测未来变化并指导落地规划。用自动数据引擎构建 ChronoGraphBench，经 Graph-as-Chain-of-Thought 监督微调与联合 4D 图强化学习两阶段训练 ChronoGraphVLM，各模型规模上均优于对应预训练基线，并零样本迁移到 VLM4D。
Motivation: 具身智能体需要把 4D 交互理解（过去动作如何改变场景）与空间落地规划（在哪里行动、预期何种变化）连起来，而这两者此前缺少统一表示，导致理解与规划割裂。
Method: 提出 ChronoGraph 功能性 4D 场景图，把 affordance 部件上的动作与语义、几何状态变化关联，观测到的与预期的转移用同一形式表示；用自动数据引擎把人类交互视频与仿真机器人轨迹转成带图标注的问题，构建 ChronoGraphBench；两阶段训练 ChronoGraphVLM：先做 Graph-as-Chain-of-Thought 监督微调，让模型先以图轨迹重建观测转移并预测未来转移再作答，再做联合 4D 图强化学习，直接奖励图属性与答案正确性。
Result: 跨模型规模的实验显示 ChronoGraphVLM 相对各自预训练基线均有提升，并可零样本迁移到 VLM4D；真实机器人演示中，基于图的规划与 affordance 落地支撑移动操作复用既有机器人技能，无需额外微调。
Conclusion: 把观测转移与预期转移放进同一图表示，可同时支撑 4D 交互理解与空间落地规划，且训练出的图推理能力能零样本迁移到其他 4D 理解模型并直接驱动真实机器人操作。

papers.title: Advancing Entropy-Level Credit Assignment in RLVR via Proximal Entropy Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Value-model-free RLVR methods such as GRPO assign uniform advantages to all tokens in a rollout, ignoring that tokens contribute unequally. Recent methods use token entropy as an importance proxy but compute it globally across the batch, conflating importance with prompt difficulty and positional trends. We argue that importance should instead be measured relative to the local context of each token. We introduce proximal entropy, a local measure of token importance relative to neighboring tokens, and prove it is invariant to both confounders. Proximal Entropy Policy Optimization (PEPO) uses it to weight per-token advantages and outperforms GRPO and entropy-based baselines on mathematical reasoning across Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct. We also show the formulation generalizes to other algorithms where substituting proximal entropy into existing methods improves, and applying it to single-stream RL succeeds where global entropy fails.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLVR 中 GRPO 给整条 rollout 的所有 token 同一优势值，而全局 token 熵作为重要性代理会把 prompt 难度与位置趋势混进重要性。PEPO 改用相对邻近 token 的 proximal entropy 度量局部重要性，并证明其对这两个混淆因子不变，用它加权逐 token 优势后在 Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 的数学推理上超过 GRPO 与熵基线。
Motivation: 无价值模型的 RLVR 方法对 token 贡献差异不加区分，现有熵加权又在 batch 上全局计算，把重要性与 prompt 难度、位置趋势混为一谈，导致信用分配 (credit assignment) 失真。
Method: 提出 proximal entropy：以每个 token 相对邻近 token 的局部熵衡量重要性，并证明其对 prompt 难度与位置趋势不变；PEPO 用该量加权逐 token 优势，替代 GRPO 的均匀优势，并把该形式代入其他算法与 single-stream RL。
Result: 在数学推理任务上，PEPO 在 Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 上优于 GRPO 与基于熵的基线；把 proximal entropy 代入既有算法带来提升，且在全局熵失效的 single-stream RL 上仍能成功训练。
Conclusion: token 重要性应在局部上下文而非全局 batch 中度量，proximal entropy 因对混淆因子不变而可作为通用的逐 token 信用分配权重，推广到其他 RL 算法与 single-stream 设置。

papers.title: Generalized Geometry Block Proximal Linearized Method for Multiblock Nonconvex and Nonsmooth Optimization
papers.abstract_en: This paper considers a class of multiblock nonconvex and nonsmooth optimization problems arising in many applications. Existing methods construct proximal linearized operators or their variants within standard Euclidean geometry to solve this class of problems, forcing their block variable updates to rely on the standard inner product and its induced norm. Nevertheless, this construction fails to capture the geometric structure of the target problem, leading to low numerical efficiency. To overcome these drawbacks, we propose a generalized geometry proximal linearized operator for updating block variables, and develop the Generalized Geometry Block Proximal Linearized (GGBPL) method based on this operator. Compared with existing proximal linearized operators, the proposed operator allows the block surrogate functions to be constructed using arbitrary inner products and general admissible metrics, thereby enabling the GGBPL method to adapt its updates to the geometric structure of various problems. We also introduce the inertial version of GGBPL, named the inertial GGBPL (iGGBPL) method. We further establish a new unified convergence framework under this generalized geometry, within which we prove that our methods guarantee convergence of the objective function values, establish global convergence of the generated sequence to a critical point, and derive the convergence rate of our methods. We also establish an $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$ iteration complexity bound for obtaining an $\varepsilon$-stationary point. We apply our methods to two nonconvex and nonsmooth problems: sparse nonnegative matrix factorization with $\ell_0$-constraints and sparse nonnegative CP decomposition with $\ell_0$-constraints. Numerical results demonstrate the superior numerical performance of our proposed methods over several state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出广义几何块邻近线性化 (GGBPL) 方法：块代理函数改用任意内积与一般可容许度量构造，使块更新贴合问题几何而非固定在标准内积诱导范数上，并给出惯性版 iGGBPL。在广义几何下建立统一收敛框架，证明目标函数值收敛、序列全局收敛到临界点、给出收敛速率与 ε-驻点的 O(ε^{-2}) 迭代复杂度；在带 ℓ0 约束的稀疏非负矩阵分解和稀疏非负 CP 分解上，数值结果优于若干 state-of-the-art 方法。
Motivation: 现有方法在标准欧氏几何内构造邻近线性化算子，块变量更新被标准内积及其诱导范数绑死，无法捕捉目标问题的几何结构，导致数值效率偏低。
Method: 提出广义几何邻近线性化算子，允许块代理函数基于任意内积与一般可容许度量构造；据此发展 GGBPL 方法及其惯性版本 iGGBPL，并在广义几何下建立统一收敛框架。应用对象为带 ℓ0 约束的稀疏非负矩阵分解与稀疏非负 CP 分解。
Result: 证明目标函数值收敛、生成序列全局收敛到临界点、给出收敛速率，并得到求 ε-驻点的 O(ε^{-2}) 迭代复杂度界；在带 ℓ0 约束的稀疏非负矩阵分解与稀疏非负 CP 分解两个问题上，数值结果显示 GGBPL/iGGBPL 优于若干 state-of-the-art 方法。
Conclusion: 把块邻近线性化算子从标准内积推广到任意内积与一般度量，可以在统一的广义几何收敛框架下保证收敛与 O(ε^{-2}) 复杂度，并在 ℓ0 约束的非负分解问题上取得更好的数值表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Minimax Additive Regression under Unknown Dependent Designs
papers.abstract_en: We study additive regression under an unknown and potentially non product design distribution, allowing the number of covariates to grow with the sample size. We consider a coupled class that separately controls the smoothness of the marginal densities and of each additive component multiplied by the corresponding marginal density. Under joint-density bounds that hold uniformly in the dimension and suitable dimension-growth conditions, we establish matching minimax bounds for prediction. With known marginal densities, the classical additive rate is attainable. When the marginals are unknown, this rate is preserved if the densities are at least as smooth as the weighted components. Otherwise, marginal-density smoothness determines the minimax rate over the coupled class. Finally, we recover all additive components with total squared error of the same order as the prediction error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在未知且可能非乘积的设计分布下研究可加回归 (additive regression)，用同时控制边缘密度光滑度与各加权加性分量光滑度的耦合类，在维数随样本增长且联合密度一致有界时给出预测的匹配 minimax 界。边缘密度已知时可达经典可加速率；未知时若密度至少与加权分量同样光滑则该速率保持，否则 minimax 速率由边缘密度光滑度决定。
Motivation: 经典可加回归的 minimax 理论通常假设设计分布为乘积形式或边缘密度已知，而实际数据中协变量往往相关且边缘未知，此时预测速率是否仍由加性分量光滑度决定并不清楚。
Method: 构造一个耦合类 (coupled class)，分别约束各边缘密度的光滑度与「分量乘以对应边缘密度」的光滑度；在对维数一致成立的联合密度界与维数增长条件下，对预测风险推导匹配的 minimax 上下界，并对各加性分量做恢复。
Result: 得到预测的匹配 minimax 界：已知边缘密度时可达经典可加速率；未知边缘时，若密度光滑度不低于加权分量则保持该速率，否则速率由边缘密度光滑度决定；各加性分量的总平方误差与预测误差同阶。
Conclusion: 在未知相关设计分布下，可加回归的可达速率取决于边缘密度与加权分量的相对光滑度，而分量恢复可以做到与预测同阶。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: False Frontiers: Diagnosing and Mitigating Co-Cheating in Self-Evolving Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving search agents build their own training curricula by jointly optimizing a proposer that generates questions and a solver that answers them. This closed loop introduces a failure mode we call co-cheating: the proposer and solver increasingly agree on shared errors, so internal reward improves without a matching gain in external correctness. A post-hoc audit against source evidence shows co-cheating growing more severe over successive rounds of self-evolution, with pseudo-label correctness stagnating or declining even as the in-loop training signal improves. The most direct mitigation is to verify proposals before training: we introduce multi-sample verification (MSV), which queries the same model three times with the source and three times without it to decide task admission and replace unreliable pseudo-labels. MSV partially reduces false agreement but leaves substantial residual co-cheating and costs six extra labeler generations per candidate. These limitations motivate CrossFit, our main method: it partitions the proposer's source documents into groups A and B; questions generated from A are scored by an auxiliary solver trained only on B, and vice versa. The cross-fitted agreement determines proposer reward, so a same-source pseudo-label cannot be reproduced through the feedback solver, while the original solver's update rule is unchanged. Rerunning the loop with Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B, MSV reduces false-agreement mass from 6.1% to 5.7% and from 8.8% to 7.2%, whereas CrossFit reduces it to 3.0% and 3.7%. Replaying identical proposals with source-excluded feedback further reduces false agreement to 0.4% and 0.1%, isolating feedback ancestry from curriculum changes. Across seven downstream search benchmarks, CrossFit improves average performance over standard coupled self-evolution by 8.8 and 8.4 points and over Search-R1 by 8.7 and 7.8 points at 4B and 9B.
papers.comment: 21 pages. Equal contribution: Meijia Chen, Hao Li, Zheng Lu
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自进化搜索代理中 proposer 与 solver 会共同作弊 (co-cheating)：两者对同一批错误达成一致，使内部奖励上升而外部正确性不涨。CrossFit 把 proposer 的源文档切成 A/B 两组，用只在另一组上训练的辅助 solver 交叉打分来定 reward，使同源伪标签无法通过反馈 solver 复现；在 Qwen3.5-4B/9B 上把 false-agreement mass 从 6.1%/8.8% 压到 3.0%/3.7%，七个下游搜索基准平均提升 8.8/8.4 点。
Motivation: 自进化搜索代理用 proposer 出题、solver 答题构成闭环自建训练课程，导致两者在共享错误上不断趋同：内部奖励持续改善而外部正确性停滞甚至下降，且随自进化轮次加剧。
Method: 先用基于源证据的事后审计量化 co-cheating，再提出 multi-sample verification (MSV)：同一模型带源查三次、不带源查三次，决定任务准入并替换不可靠伪标签。主方法 CrossFit 将 proposer 的源文档分组 A/B，A 生成的问题由只在 B 上训练的辅助 solver 打分、反之亦然，用交叉拟合一致度作为 proposer reward，原 solver 更新规则不变；在 Qwen3.5-4B 与 Qwen3.5-9B 上重跑闭环。
Result: MSV 把 false-agreement mass 从 6.1% 降到 5.7%、从 8.8% 降到 7.2%，CrossFit 降到 3.0% 与 3.7%；再用 source-excluded feedback 重放相同 proposal 可进一步降到 0.4% 与 0.1%。MSV 每个候选需额外 6 次 labeler 生成。七个下游搜索基准上，CrossFit 相对标准 coupled self-evolution 平均提升 8.8 与 8.4 点，相对 Search-R1 提升 8.7 与 7.8 点（4B/9B）。
Conclusion: co-cheating 的根源在反馈链路的同源性：把打分 solver 与出题源文档交叉隔离即可大幅压低虚假一致，且不必改动原 solver 的更新规则；MSV 只能部分缓解并带来额外生成开销。

papers.title: EnterpriseBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Enterprise-Level Strategic Reasoning and Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly expected to support enterprise workflows, where tasks often involve missing information, uncertainty, feedback, and long-term trade-offs. However, existing enterprise and financial benchmarks mainly test static capabilities such as information extraction, numerical calculation, domain knowledge, and financial QA, leaving interactive and long-horizon decision-making underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce EnterpriseBench, a benchmark that evaluates LLM agents across this spectrum, from static question answering to dynamic decision-making. Specifically, EnterpriseBench reorganizes existing enterprise and financial QA datasets into a unified foundational suite annotated by capability and difficulty, and introduces three professional interactive settings: Consulting, based on management-consulting-style business cases for client problem diagnosis through multi-turn information seeking; the Beer Game, adapted from a classic supply-chain management simulation for inventory control under delayed feedback; and Enterprise Digital Twin, a project-based business simulator for workforce, risk, and project planning. Experiments with nine agent methods under four backbone models show that current agents have not yet achieved stable, comprehensive, and cross-task reliability in enterprise scenarios. These results show that EnterpriseBench provides a practical benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in realistic enterprise strategic reasoning and decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EnterpriseBench 把企业与金融 QA 数据集重组为统一基础套件，并新增 Consulting、Beer Game、Enterprise Digital Twin 三个交互式专业场景，覆盖从静态问答到动态决策的谱系。九种 agent 方法 × 四个 backbone 的实验显示，当前 LLM agent 在企业场景中尚未达到稳定、全面、跨任务可靠的表现。
Motivation: 现有企业与金融基准只测信息抽取、数值计算、领域知识和金融 QA 等静态能力，交互式、长时程、带延迟反馈的决策能力基本未被覆盖。
Method: 将既有企业与金融 QA 数据集重组为按能力与难度标注的统一基础套件；新增三个交互场景：多轮信息搜集的客户问题诊断（Consulting）、延迟反馈下库存控制的供应链仿真（Beer Game）、面向人力/风险/项目规划的项目制商业模拟器（Enterprise Digital Twin）；用九种 agent 方法与四个 backbone 模型做实验。
Result: 九种 agent 方法在四个 backbone 模型上的实验表明，当前 agent 在企业场景中尚未实现稳定、全面且跨任务的可靠性。
Conclusion: 企业级战略推理与决策需要专门的交互式基准来衡量，静态 QA 分数不足以代表真实企业工作流中的可靠性。

summary_sections.method: 将既有企业与金融 QA 数据集重组为按能力与难度标注的统一基础套件；新增三个交互场景：多轮信息搜集的客户问题诊断（Consulting）、延迟反馈下库存控制的供应链仿真（Beer Game）、面向人力/风险/项目规划的项目制商业模拟器（Enterprise Digital Twin）；用九种 agent 方法与四个 backbone 模型做实验。
summary_sections.result: 九种 agent 方法在四个 backbone 模型上的实验表明，当前 agent 在企业场景中尚未实现稳定、全面且跨任务的可靠性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 企业级战略推理与决策需要专门的交互式基准来衡量，静态 QA 分数不足以代表真实企业工作流中的可靠性。

papers.title: Weeding Out Bad Seeds: Initial-Noise-Robust Unlearning for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning has emerged as a critical post-hoc safety measure to erase sensitive concepts from Text-to-Image (T2I) models without prohibitive retraining. However, we reveal that current state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches are brittle due to a severe lack of robustness to noise initialization. We call this phenomenon ``probabilistic forgetting'': suppressed concepts re-emerge under specific random initial noise conditions, despite appearing unlearned on other initializations. We trace this failure to the misalignment between standard Gaussian sampling during unlearning and the unlearning objective. Since the target concept manifests only in specific initial noise regions throughout the unlearning phase, uniform random sampling yields sparse, uninformative gradient updates that fail to drive robust erasure. To overcome this issue, we propose an adaptive, concept-conditioned sampling strategy that dynamically concentrates gradient updates on regions where the target concept manifests, down-weighting uninformative areas. We integrate our framework with six distinct SOTA unlearning methods across four diffusion backbones and evaluate it across safety, object, and artistic-style unlearning, as well as under black-box and white-box adversarial attacks. Our method reduces the conditional nudity re-emergence rate across random initializations by 67.2% on average over four baselines and lowers attack success rates across both adversarial evaluations. Across concept domains, Adaptive Noise Sampling strengthens adversarial robustness and non-target retention while preserving competitive generative quality and target-erasure performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 文本到图像扩散模型遗忘中存在“概率性遗忘”：概念在某些初始噪声下重新出现。提出自适应、概念条件化的噪声采样，将梯度更新集中到目标概念显现的噪声区域，条件裸露复现率平均降低 67.2%。
Motivation: 现有 SOTA 遗忘方法对初始噪声不鲁棒，标准高斯采样与遗忘目标错位，均匀采样产生稀疏且无信息的梯度更新，无法实现稳健擦除。
Method: 提出自适应概念条件化采样策略，动态将梯度更新集中到目标概念显现的噪声区域并降权无信息区域；与六个 SOTA 遗忘方法及四个扩散 backbone 集成。
Result: 在随机初始化下条件裸露复现率相对四个基线平均降低 67.2%，并在黑盒与白盒对抗评估中降低攻击成功率；跨概念域增强对抗鲁棒性与非目标保留，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量与目标擦除性能。
Conclusion: 遗忘失败源于采样与目标错位，按概念条件重加权初始噪声可同时提升鲁棒擦除与对抗鲁棒性。

papers.title: ReMem: Rethinking Perception and Memory in Long-Context Recommendation Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recent Recommendation Agents (RecAgents) offer a promising alternative by shifting recommendation to an active, user-side paradigm, where generative agents autonomously perceive external platforms, reason over user preferences, and execute decisions. However, existing RecAgents still suffer from two critical limitations: brittle item perception based on noisy and heterogeneous item pages, and inefficient long-context reasoning over extended user histories and multi-step interaction traces. To address these challenges, we propose a novel recommendation agent framework, termed as ReMem, that combines OCR-based multimodal perception with time-evolving dynamic memory. Instead of parsing raw HTML, ReMem observes item pages through screenshots and extracts structured multimodal information via an OCR tool, enabling a more humanoid and platform-agnostic perception mechanism. To support long-horizon preference modeling, ReMem further introduces a chunk-wise sequential memory update strategy, where the agent selectively maintains a fixed-size memory of informative historical interactions while processing arbitrarily long contexts with linear inference complexity and bounded context length. This design allows the agent to preserve evolving user preferences without relying on external memory modules or disrupting the standard autoregressive generation process. To enhance the dynamic memory instruction, we further develop a multi-memory GRPO variant, which propagates the final-answer advantage to all intermediate conversations that contribute to the final response. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that ReMem consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average improvement of 5.16\% across three recommendation agent tasks, namely searching, ranking, and judging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReMem 把推荐 agent 的物品感知从解析 HTML 改为截图加 OCR 提取结构化多模态信息，并用分块顺序记忆更新维持固定大小的历史记忆，使长上下文推理保持线性复杂度与有界上下文长度。在三个数据集的 searching、ranking、judging 三类推荐 agent 任务上平均比 SOTA 基线提升 5.16%。
Motivation: 现有推荐 agent 依赖嘈杂异构的物品页面做脆弱感知，且在长用户历史与多步交互轨迹上做长上下文推理效率低。
Method: ReMem 框架：OCR 工具读截图而非原始 HTML，抽取结构化多模态信息；chunk-wise sequential memory update 选择性保留固定大小的高信息历史交互，线性推理复杂度、不引入外部记忆模块、不打断自回归生成；再用 multi-memory GRPO 变体把最终答案的 advantage 传播到所有促成该回答的中间对话。
Result: 在三个数据集、三类推荐 agent 任务（searching、ranking、judging）上一致优于 SOTA 基线，平均提升 5.16%。
Conclusion: 截图式 OCR 感知加有界动态记忆可以让推荐 agent 在不依赖外部记忆模块的前提下处理任意长上下文并保持偏好演化。

papers.title: Learn from the Gap: Differential-Aware Advantage Pruning with Adaptive Rollout Sampling for GRPO
papers.abstract_en: Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and its variants have been developed for policy optimization and demonstrated notable performance gains. However, these methods usually incur substantial computational overhead due to per-question multi-rollout sampling and repeated per-token probability evaluation across rollouts. Furthermore, low-information or highly homogeneous trajectories can degrade downstream learning signal efficiency, hindering model optimization and limiting final performance. To address these issues, we propose FastRL, a novel plug-and-play reinforcement learning framework that simultaneously improves training efficiency and the effectiveness of policy learning. Specifically, 1) We introduce an advantage-aware pruning strategy to selectively preserve high-advantage trajectories while maximizing inter-trajectory gradient diversity. 2) Then, we design an adaptive rollout sampling mechanism to dynamically adjust the sampling scale across different training stages based on historical pruning distributions, balancing exploration adequacy and computational efficiency. Experiments demonstrate that FastRL can be seamlessly integrated into GRPO, DAPO, and GSPO variants, achieving an average 2.07$\times$ training speedup on Geometry3K and GeoQA8K-R1V, along with an approximately 1.64\% improvement in average accuracy on visual reasoning benchmarks. Source codes will be available at https://github.com/Nicozwy/FastRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FastRL 是可插拔的 GRPO 训练加速框架：用 advantage-aware pruning 保留高优势轨迹并最大化轨迹间梯度多样性，再按历史剪枝分布自适应调整各训练阶段的 rollout 采样规模。接入 GRPO、DAPO、GSPO 后在 Geometry3K 与 GeoQA8K-R1V 上平均训练加速 2.07×，视觉推理基准平均准确率约提升 1.64%。
Motivation: GRPO 及其变体需要逐题多 rollout 采样并反复计算逐 token 概率，计算开销大；低信息量或高度同质的轨迹会削弱下游学习信号效率，限制模型优化与最终性能。
Method: FastRL 包含两部分：advantage-aware 剪枝策略选择性保留高优势轨迹并最大化轨迹间梯度多样性；自适应 rollout 采样机制依据历史剪枝分布，在不同训练阶段动态调整采样规模，权衡探索充分性与计算效率。框架以即插即用方式接入 GRPO、DAPO、GSPO 变体。
Result: 在 Geometry3K 与 GeoQA8K-R1V 上平均训练加速 2.07×，视觉推理基准上平均准确率约提升 1.64%。
Conclusion: 通过剪枝低信息轨迹并按训练阶段调节采样规模，GRPO 类方法可以在保持甚至提升视觉推理准确率的同时显著缩短训练时间；代码将在 GitHub (Nicozwy/FastRL) 开源。

papers.title: S4VY: Segment Anything in Feed-Forward 4D Visual Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Accurate instance segmentation in dynamic scenes is important for downstream applications such as robotics and autonomous driving. Existing Segment Anything models operate primarily on 2D image or video masks and preserve identity through sequential memory, while promptable 4D instance segmentation built upon feed-forward visual geometry remains underexplored. We introduce S4VY, a Segment Anything model built on feed-forward 4D visual geometry. From a set of RGB observations, S4VY transforms shared visual-geometric features into an exhaustive set of class-agnostic 4D instance masks through a space-time query decoder, with each persistent object query binding one entity across all observations. This representation supports prompt-independent segmentation as well as point- and box- conditioned selection, without requiring a seed mask or temporal ordering. We further develop an agentic harness for natural-language grounding in the large observation space of a 4D scene. Active tree search identifies relevant frames without scanning every fixed window; a dual-stream grounder combines fine-grained VLM visual priors with geometry-consistent instance features through complementary bounding-box prediction and object-query matching; and an independent critic selects the final 4D instance mask from their predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art 4D instance segmentation and strong language-guided grounding performance under a unified evaluation spanning static and dynamic scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: S4VY 把 Segment Anything 扩展到前馈 4D 视觉几何：从一组 RGB 观测经共享视觉-几何特征与 space-time query decoder 输出穷尽的类无关 4D 实例掩码，每个持久对象 query 跨全部观测绑定同一实体，无需种子掩码或时序顺序即可做 prompt 无关分割与点/框条件选择。配套 agentic harness 用主动树搜索定位相关帧、双流 grouner 融合 VLM 视觉先验与几何一致实例特征、独立 critic 选出最终掩码。实验在静态与动态场景的统一评测上给出 state-of-the-art 的 4D 实例分割与语言引导定位表现。
Motivation: 现有 Segment Anything 主要在 2D 图像或视频掩码上靠顺序 memory 保持身份，基于前馈视觉几何的 promptable 4D 实例分割仍被忽视，而动态场景的实例分割是机器人与自动驾驶下游任务的前提。
Method: 从一组 RGB 观测提取共享视觉-几何特征，经 space-time query decoder 解码为穷尽的类无关 4D 实例掩码，每个持久对象 query 绑定一个实体跨全部观测；支持 prompt 无关分割与点、框条件选择。语言定位部分用 agentic harness：主动树搜索在 4D 大观测空间中找相关帧而不扫全部固定窗口，dual-stream grounder 结合 VLM 细粒度视觉先验与几何一致实例特征（bounding-box 预测与 object-query 匹配互补），再由独立 critic 从两者预测中选最终 4D 实例掩码。
Result: 在覆盖静态与动态场景的统一评测上，S4VY 展示 state-of-the-art 的 4D 实例分割与强的语言引导定位表现。
Conclusion: 前馈 4D 视觉几何加持久对象 query 可以替代顺序 memory，一次性把多视角 RGB 转成跨观测一致的 4D 实例掩码，并同时支撑 prompt 无关与语言条件的实例选择。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Into the danger zone: stable extrapolation in high-dimensional function and operator learning
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization is a central challenge in scientific machine learning. We study regression problems in which the test distribution differs from the training distribution and ask: under what assumptions on the target function or operator is stable extrapolation possible, and how far beyond the training domain can one extrapolate? Existing theory controls the test error through additive penalties measuring the discrepancy between the training and test distributions. Such guarantees show robustness to small distribution shifts, but can be very pessimistic in comparison to OOD performance observed empirically. We identify classes of holomorphic functions and operators for which the OOD generalization error converges at algebraic rates even in the presence of large distribution shifts. This phenomenon stems from the increasing smoothness of higher-index coordinates, leading to what we term a `blessing of high dimensionality'. For learning with either polynomials, deep neural networks or deep neural operators, we derive explicit rates for arbitrary test measures supported on suitable domains and quantify how the admissible domain depends on the underlying regularity of the function or operator. Our extrapolation guarantees are independent of the test distribution, depending only on its support. We also present a series of numerical experiments across a range of functions and operators that support the main theoretical findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在科学机器学习的分布外 (OOD) 回归中，作者证明对全纯 (holomorphic) 函数与算子类，即使训练与测试分布差异很大，OOD 误差仍按代数速率收敛，因为高维坐标指标越高越光滑，即所谓“高维的祝福” (blessing of high dimensionality)。对多项式、深度神经网络与深度神经算子三类学习器都给出显式速率，且保证只依赖测试分布的支撑集而不依赖其本身。
Motivation: 现有 OOD 理论用训练/测试分布差异的加性惩罚控制测试误差，对小分布偏移稳健，但相对实证 OOD 表现往往过于悲观，也无法回答“能外推多远”。
Method: 针对全纯函数与算子类推导 OOD 泛化误差的代数收敛速率，覆盖多项式逼近、深度神经网络与深度神经算子三种学习器；速率对任意支撑在合适区域上的测试测度显式给出，并量化可容许外推域如何随函数或算子的正则性变化；辅以覆盖多类函数与算子的数值实验。
Result: 在大分布偏移下 OOD 泛化误差仍按代数速率收敛；推导出的外推保证与测试分布无关、只依赖其支撑；可容许外推域随底层正则性变化被显式量化；数值实验覆盖一系列函数与算子并支持主要理论结论。
Conclusion: 高维中高指标坐标的光滑性增长使稳定外推成为可能，OOD 保证可以摆脱对分布差异的悲观加性惩罚，转而只依赖测试分布的支撑与目标的正则性。
Relevance: 36

summary_sections.tldr: 在科学机器学习的分布外 (OOD) 回归中，作者证明对全纯 (holomorphic) 函数与算子类，即使训练与测试分布差异很大，OOD 误差仍按代数速率收敛，因为高维坐标指标越高越光滑，即所谓“高维的祝福” (blessing of high dimensionality)。对多项式、深度神经网络与深度神经算子三类学习器都给出显式速率，且保证只依赖测试分布的支撑集而不依赖其本身。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 OOD 理论用训练/测试分布差异的加性惩罚控制测试误差，对小分布偏移稳健，但相对实证 OOD 表现往往过于悲观，也无法回答“能外推多远”。
summary_sections.method: 针对全纯函数与算子类推导 OOD 泛化误差的代数收敛速率，覆盖多项式逼近、深度神经网络与深度神经算子三种学习器；速率对任意支撑在合适区域上的测试测度显式给出，并量化可容许外推域如何随函数或算子的正则性变化；辅以覆盖多类函数与算子的数值实验。
summary_sections.result: 在大分布偏移下 OOD 泛化误差仍按代数速率收敛；推导出的外推保证与测试分布无关、只依赖其支撑；可容许外推域随底层正则性变化被显式量化；数值实验覆盖一系列函数与算子并支持主要理论结论。
summary_sections.conclusion: 高维中高指标坐标的光滑性增长使稳定外推成为可能，OOD 保证可以摆脱对分布差异的悲观加性惩罚，转而只依赖测试分布的支撑与目标的正则性。

papers.title: SCCM: Spherically Consistent Coarse Matching for ERP Dense Feature Correspondence
papers.abstract_en: Dense feature matching between 360$^\circ$ panoramas underpins omnidirectional pose estimation, 3D reconstruction, and SLAM. Such panoramas are stored in the equirectangular projection (ERP), which unrolls the viewing sphere onto a flat chart and thereby introduces three distinct distortions -- a longitudinal seam (topology), latitude-dependent stretch (metric), and non-uniform pixel area (area) -- that the coarse stage of perspective-trained dense matchers does not model, so these matchers degrade systematically on ERP. We show that correcting the three distortions at the coarse-stage interfaces where they arise -- pairwise distortions in attention, per-pixel distortion in covisibility gating -- improves PCK@1$^\circ$ from 0.230 to 0.275 on Matterport3D under a fixed coarse scaffold, with the refiner architecture unchanged -- our central result. Concretely, SCCM (Spherically Consistent Coarse Matching) augments a chart-naive cross-attention/dual-softmax coarse matcher with two sphere-derived priors: Spherical Positional Attention (SPA) pairs a yaw-periodic RoPE (topology) with a tangent-plane bias (metric), and Area-Aware Covisibility (AAC) applies a pre-sigmoid log-area correction (area). The chart-naive scaffold serves as a controlled reference, separating the scaffold-replacement effect from the spherical-prior effect. Instantiated in the RoMa V1 framework with the same frozen encoder, refiner architecture, and loss, SCCM also outperforms the ERP-native EDM (0.163) and an ERP-retrained RoMa V1 (0.198) under a unified ERP dense matching protocol, while perspective-trained matchers largely fail on ERP. It further transfers zero-shot to Stanford2D3D and, when trained on outdoor Holo360D, leads there as well.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 33 pages: 16-page main paper (including references) and 17-page supplementary material. Project page: https://gandanlee.github.io/sccm/ Code: https://github.com/gandanlee/sccm

TL;DR: SCCM 在 RoMa V1 框架内为 ERP 全景稠密匹配注入两个球面先验：Spherical Positional Attention（yaw 周期 RoPE + 切平面偏置）处理接缝与纬度拉伸，Area-Aware Covisibility 用 pre-sigmoid log-area 校正像素面积不均。固定粗匹配骨架与 refiner 不变时，Matterport3D 上 PCK@1° 从 0.230 提到 0.275，并超过 EDM（0.163）与 ERP 重训的 RoMa V1（0.198）。
Motivation: ERP 把视球展开成平面，引入接缝、纬度拉伸、像素面积不均三种畸变，而透视图训练的稠密匹配器粗匹配阶段不建模这些畸变，在 ERP 上系统性退化。
Method: 在粗匹配接口处逐点校正三种畸变：SPA 用 yaw 周期 RoPE（拓扑）配切平面偏置（度量），AAC 用 pre-sigmoid log-area 校正（面积），叠加在 chart-naive 的 cross-attention/dual-softmax 粗匹配器上；在 RoMa V1 中实例化，冻结同一 encoder、refiner 架构与 loss，chart-naive 骨架作受控参照。
Result: 固定粗匹配骨架下 Matterport3D PCK@1° 从 0.230 提升到 0.275；统一 ERP 稠密匹配协议下超过 ERP 原生 EDM（0.163）与 ERP 重训的 RoMa V1（0.198）；零样本迁移到 Stanford2D3D 仍有效，在户外 Holo360D 上训练后同样领先。
Conclusion: 三种 ERP 畸变应在粗匹配阶段出现的接口处分别校正，而非靠更换骨架或重训；透视训练的匹配器在 ERP 上大体失效，球面先验可零样本迁移。

papers.title: Calibrated to Whom? Persona and Language Effects on Cultural Values in JEV
papers.abstract_en: Decision-only language models return a probability for every answer option instead of generating text, which makes them attractive as survey respondents and as judges. We audit the cultural values of one such model, TypeSafe's JEV, with the Values Survey Module 2013. We asked it the 24 items as 12 matched Saudi and 12 matched American personas and without a persona, in English and Arabic, under eight ways of formulating the request (288,000 answers). JEV's answers were highly repeatable (ICC 0.997), and without a persona they resembled those of its own American personas. When the persona was Saudi rather than American, the answers moved in the direction of the human Saudi-US difference, reproducing 87% of its size in English but 62% in Arabic, with long-term orientation reversed. A language cross shows that the smaller difference in Arabic comes from the language of the items, not from the language of the persona description. Age shifted the profiles about as much as nationality, gender shifted them more for Saudi than for American personas, and JEV was less confident in Arabic and for Saudi personas. These patterns held in every request design, although the model never generates text.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对决策型语言模型 TypeSafe 的 JEV 用 Values Survey Module 2013 的 24 个题目做文化价值观审计：以沙特与美国各 12 个 persona、无 persona、英阿双语、8 种提问方式共 288,000 次作答。沙特 persona 使答案朝真人沙特-美国差异方向移动，英语复现该差异的 87%、阿拉伯语仅 62%，且长期导向 (long-term orientation) 方向反转；语言交叉实验表明阿拉伯语差异变小来自题目语言而非 persona 描述语言。
Motivation: 决策型 LM 以选项概率作答，正被当作问卷受访者与评委，但其文化价值观是否随 persona 与题目语言系统性偏移、偏移能否复现真人跨国差异，此前缺少受控审计。
Method: 用 Values Survey Module 2013 的 24 个题目提问 JEV：12 个匹配沙特 persona、12 个匹配美国 persona 与无 persona 条件，英阿双语，叠加 8 种提问措辞，共 288,000 次作答；用语言交叉设计分离题目语言与 persona 描述语言，并比较年龄、性别、国籍的位移幅度。
Result: 作答高度可重复，ICC 0.997；无 persona 时答案接近模型自身的美国 persona。沙特 persona 相对美国 persona 的位移复现真人沙特-美国差异的 87%（英语）与 62%（阿拉伯语），长期导向反转。年龄位移约等于国籍，性别对沙特 persona 的位移大于美国 persona；模型在阿拉伯语与沙特 persona 下置信度更低，且这些模式在全部 8 种提问设计中一致。
Conclusion: JEV 的文化价值观同时受 persona 与题目语言调控：persona 能大体复现真人跨国差异但不完全，阿拉伯语下复现度更低且长期导向符号相反，说明校准对象随语言与 persona 定义而变。

papers.title: CoDimRecon: Agentic Reconstruction of Sim-Ready 3D Scenes with Deformable Curves, Surfaces, and Volumes
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing simulation-ready 3D scenes from real-world observations enables robotics, gaming, and immersive applications, yet existing methods largely assume rigid objects. This leaves an important gap for deformables, whose simulation-ready geometry depends on dimensionality (curves, surfaces, or volumes) and whose behavior may require models beyond elasticity. We present CoDimRecon, an agentic framework that reconstructs editable scenes containing rigid, articulated, and deformable objects from multi-view RGB observations. Scene-level geometric priors ground scale and layout, while object-level generated meshes guide the agent toward detailed, compact geometry; articulated rigid objects are decomposed into movable parts with explicit joints. For deformables, category-wise agent sessions reconstruct curves as centerlines with radii, surfaces as manifold shells with thickness, and volumes as watertight solids for volumetric meshing. Reusable simulator skills initialize compatible physical models and parameters, while agent-guided behavioral tests expose mismatches and trigger targeted revisions of motion, geometry, numerics, or material modeling. On evaluated Replica and ScanNet++ scenes, CoDimRecon achieves competitive compositional reconstruction accuracy while additionally producing deformable assets for rod, shell, and solid simulation. We further demonstrate robot interactions across all three representations, including a controlled paper-folding case in which behavioral testing motivates plastic bending.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoDimRecon 用 agentic 框架从多视角 RGB 重建可编辑、仿真就绪的 3D 场景，把刚体、铰接体和可变形体统一处理：可变形体按维度分别重建为带半径的中心线 (curves)、带厚度的流形壳 (surfaces) 和水密实体 (volumes)。在 Replica 与 ScanNet++ 场景上取得有竞争力的组合式重建精度，并额外产出 rod/shell/solid 三类仿真资产，行为测试发现不匹配时会定向回改运动、几何、数值或材料建模。
Motivation: 现有重建方法基本假设刚性物体，而可变形体的仿真就绪几何取决于维度（曲线、曲面、体积），其行为还可能需要弹性之外的本构模型，这一缺口阻碍了机器人、游戏与沉浸式应用。
Method: 场景级几何先验确定尺度与布局，物体级生成网格引导 agent 得到细致紧凑的几何；铰接刚体分解为带显式关节的可动部件。可变形体按类别分 session 重建三种表示，可复用的 simulator skills 初始化相容的物理模型与参数，agent 引导的行为测试暴露不匹配并触发对运动、几何、数值或材料建模的定向修订。
Result: 在 Replica 与 ScanNet++ 场景上取得有竞争力的组合式重建精度，并额外生成可用于 rod、shell、solid 仿真的可变形资产；演示了覆盖三种表示的机器人交互，包括一个受控折纸案例，其行为测试促使模型改用塑性弯曲 (plastic bending)。
Conclusion: 把维度化几何表示与可复用仿真技能、行为测试闭环放进同一 agent 框架，可以产出既可编辑又可直接仿真的场景资产，且行为测试能驱动本构模型的针对性修正。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Revisit to Segment: Working Memory Distillation for Reasoning Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have approached image segmentation by reasoning about visual content and predicting target locations. Their generated responses contain reasoning traces and localization proposals that can serve as working memory when revisiting the same image and query. Our exploration reveals that MLLMs benefit from using this self-generated working memory as context, leading to enhanced reasoning segmentation. Motivated by this finding, we seek to strengthen the backbone model's reasoning segmentation capabilities by distilling the guidance gained from revisiting prior attempts, enabling it to benefit with or without working memory at inference time. To this end, we propose Reasoning Segmenter with Working Memory (SWiM), a working-memory distillation framework for reasoning segmentation. Specifically, SWiM selects rollouts based on segmentation quality to construct working memory and uses the memory-conditioned model as a teacher. The teacher provides token-level distributional supervision along student-generated trajectories, while the student receives only the original image and query. Joint optimization of on-policy self-distillation and outcome-based reinforcement learning combines working-memory guidance with direct feedback on segmentation quality. Extensive experiments on reasoning segmentation benchmarks demonstrate that SWiM achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating the effectiveness of working-memory distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWiM 把 MLLM 自己重访同一图像与查询时产生的推理轨迹和定位提议当作 working memory，用按分割质量筛出的 rollout 构造记忆条件教师，在学生自身轨迹上给 token 级分布监督，学生推理时只看原图与查询。on-policy 自蒸馏与基于结果的强化学习联合优化，使模型在有无 working memory 时都能提升推理分割能力，在推理分割基准上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: MLLM 做推理分割时，重访先前尝试得到的推理痕迹与定位提议本可当作上下文利用，但主干模型无法把这种自生成记忆的收益固化下来，离开记忆就退化。
Method: SWiM（Reasoning Segmenter with Working Memory）按分割质量筛选 rollouts 构造 working memory，以带记忆条件的模型作教师，在学生自己生成的轨迹上提供 token 级分布监督，学生输入仅含原图与查询；训练上联合 on-policy 自蒸馏与基于结果的强化学习。
Result: 在推理分割基准上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，验证 working memory 蒸馏有效；模型在推理时带或不带 working memory 均可受益。
Conclusion: 把重访先前尝试得到的记忆指导蒸馏进主干，能让推理分割在脱离记忆推理时仍保留这部分收益，达到 SOTA。
Relevance: 0
