papers.title: RoPE is Dead, Long Live RoPE: Towards Scalable Data-aware Positional Encodings
papers.abstract_en: Transformers process tokens without any inherent notion of order, making positional encoding a fundamental requirement rather than an architectural refinement. Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) has become the default positional encoding in modern language models, yet it is heavily biased toward nearby tokens. Existing alternatives have been evaluated under different settings, leaving the literature fragmented and without a clear replacement. We bring structure to this landscape by examining a specific weakness of RoPE: its slow frequency bands, whose wavelengths exceed the training context and expose models to unseen angles during extrapolation. We therefore introduce Data aware RoPE (DaRoPE), which preserves standard RoPE on the fast bands but replaces absolute position on the slow bands with bounded coordinates learned from contextual representations. Therefore, the slow-band geometry depends on the data rather than only on positional distance. We compare representative encodings under matched conditions across synthetic tasks, symbolic music, genomics, neural signals, and language models spanning 124M to 50B parameters. Across these experiments, DaRoPE leads on non-text benchmarks, mitigates recency bias, while remaining best or on par in language modeling and length extrapolation. Moreover, the learned coordinates also make the mechanism interpretable, revealing how attention layers leverage contextual information beyond token distance. Together, these results support DaRoPE as the best overall default among the evaluated methods, when there is no domain-specific reasons to prefer another.

papers.title: VastMAT: A Large-Scale Multi-Category Benchmark for Multi-Animal Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Multi-animal tracking (MAT) supports the study of animal movement, behavior, and group interactions. However, general multi-object tracking (MOT) benchmarks primarily focus on pedestrians and vehicles, whereas dedicated MAT benchmarks remain limited in jointly supporting broad animal coverage, large-scale video data, and extensive within-video multi-instance association. To address this gap, we introduce VastMAT, which has four key characteristics: (1) Large scale. It comprises 2,947 videos with 1,002,562 annotated frames, totaling 27.85 hours. (2) Broad category coverage. These videos cover 337 animal categories with diverse morphologies and motion patterns. (3) Extensive instance annotations. It provides 3,663,248 bounding boxes and 22,883 identity trajectories---to our knowledge, the largest numbers of both among dedicated MAT benchmarks. (4) High-quality annotations. To ensure reliability, annotations undergo iterative expert review and correction, and quality is assessed through an independent reannotation audit. To systematically assess tracking performance and cross-category generalization, we establish Seen-category and category-disjoint Unseen-category protocols, and evaluate eight representative MOT methods under both protocols. Under these protocols, the highest baseline HOTA scores are 66.37\% and 52.90\%, respectively, highlighting the challenge of tracking unseen animals. To address the low-overlap association challenge revealed by our analysis, we propose Center-Distance-Augmented Association (CDA), a lightweight module that adaptively combines IoU with center similarity normalized by the boxes' own scales. Without additional training, CDA improves TrackTrack's HOTA by 1.58 and 1.31 percentage points under the two protocols, respectively. To facilitate further MAT research, we will publicly release our benchmark and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VastMAT 是面向多动物跟踪 (MAT) 的大规模基准：2,947 段视频、1,002,562 帧、27.85 小时、337 个动物类别、3,663,248 个框与 22,883 条身份轨迹，并设 Seen 与类别不相交的 Unseen 两套协议。八个 MOT 方法在 Unseen 协议下最高 HOTA 仅 52.90%（Seen 为 66.37%），说明跨类别泛化是主要瓶颈；免训练的 CDA 关联模块把 TrackTrack 的 HOTA 分别抬高 1.58 与 1.31 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 MOT 基准集中在行人与车辆，专用 MAT 基准在动物类别广度、视频规模和同视频多实例关联三方面同时受限，难以衡量跨类别跟踪泛化。
Method: 构建含四要素的 VastMAT：大规模视频与帧标注、337 类覆盖、密集框与身份轨迹标注、经迭代专家复核并由独立重标注审计的质量控制；建立 Seen-category 与 category-disjoint Unseen-category 两套协议，评测八个代表性 MOT 方法。另提出 Center-Distance-Augmented Association (CDA)，轻量地把 IoU 与按框自身尺度归一化的中心相似度自适应结合，无需额外训练。
Result: 两套协议下最高基线 HOTA 分别为 66.37% 与 52.90%；CDA 在不加训练的情况下使 TrackTrack 的 HOTA 分别提升 1.58 与 1.31 个百分点。基准规模为 2,947 视频、1,002,562 帧、27.85 小时、337 类、3,663,248 框、22,883 条轨迹。
Conclusion: 未见动物类别的跟踪显著更难，低重叠关联是主要短板；用免训练的中心距离增强关联即可带来可见提升，基准与代码将公开发布。

papers.title: ReplayLens: Auditing Agents' Use of Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: When an agent reuses logged experience, a changed decision may reflect the recorded score, the action's name, or the record's position in storage. Standard memory evaluations do not reveal which relationship drives that change. We introduce ReplayLens, a black-box audit that changes one relationship in the stored history at a time, holds the remaining interface fixed, and measures the resulting decision. Four interventions target four relationships. Outcome reassignment swaps which scores belong to which actions. Pair transport moves intact action-score pairs to new record slots. Consistent renaming relabels actions in both history and menu. Key-slot reassignment changes both score attachment and position. A constructive separation shows why the audit is needed: two memory writers with identical endpoint accuracy respond differently to the same replay, so conventional evaluation cannot resolve the underlying dependence. On black-box LLM interfaces, swapping scores changes decisions while moving intact pairs does not, separating score attachment from record order. A bounded-memory study exposes ingestion-order sensitivity that endpoint comparison misses. In sequential experiment planning, altered historical scores redirect exploration and reduce final utility despite fresh measurements. A code-debugging agent with sealed hidden tests shows the same pattern outside model selection. ReplayLens provides a relationship-level audit for deciding whether logged experience can be merged, reordered, or reindexed safely.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReplayLens 是针对复用日志经验的 agent 的黑盒审计：一次只改动存储历史中的一种关系（分数归属、记录位置、动作命名、或分数+位置同时改），其余接口固定，量测决策随之如何变化。结果一致显示决策由“分数挂在哪个动作上”驱动而非记录顺序：交换分数会改变决策，整体搬移动作-分数对不会；被改动的历史分数还会把探索引偏并降低最终效用。
Motivation: 标准 memory 评测只看端点准确率，无法区分决策变化究竟来自记录的分数、动作名称还是存储位置，因此无法判断日志经验能否安全合并、重排或重建索引。
Method: 提出 ReplayLens 黑盒审计，设计四种干预：outcome reassignment（交换分数归属）、pair transport（整体搬移动作-分数对到新槽位）、consistent renaming（历史与菜单同步改名）、key-slot reassignment（同时改分数与位置）；并给出一个构造性分离：两个端点准确率相同的 memory writer 对同一 replay 反应不同。
Result: 在黑盒 LLM 接口上，交换分数改变决策而整体搬移不改变，从而把分数归属与记录顺序分离开；有界记忆研究暴露端点对比看不到的摄取顺序敏感性；在序列实验规划中，改动历史分数会引导探索方向并降低最终效用，尽管有新测量；带封存隐藏测试的代码调试 agent 呈现同一模式。
Conclusion: 日志经验的依赖落在分数与动作的挂接关系上，能否合并、重排或重建索引必须按关系级别审计，端点准确率不足以判定安全性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Finite Probes Suffice: Identifiability and Universality for Weight-Space Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning properties of neural networks has recently attracted growing interest, with existing approaches operating either directly on network parameters or through probe-based representations of network behavior. While probing methods have shown strong empirical performance, their theoretical foundations remain limited. In this work, we study when finite probe-based representations are sufficient for learning neural functionals. We establish general identification and universality results for probing, and show that using intermediate hidden representations can provide significantly more informative representations than relying only on final outputs. Motivated by these results, we introduce HIDDENPROBE, a simple architecture for learning from hidden probe responses. Across a range of neural functional benchmarks, including both MLPs and Transformers, HIDDENPROBE consistently improves over existing probing methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our code is publicly available on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对神经网络泛函 (neural functionals) 的权重空间学习，证明有限探针 (finite probe) 表示足以实现可识别性与通用逼近，并显示中间隐藏层探针比只用最终输出信息量显著更大。据此提出 HIDDENPROBE 架构，在含 MLP 与 Transformer 的神经泛函基准上一致优于已有 probing 方法并达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 权重空间学习现有做法要么直接吃网络参数，要么依赖行为探针表示，而 probing 虽经验表现强，理论基础薄弱：尚不清楚有限探针何时足够学习神经泛函。
Method: 先建立 probing 的一般可识别性与通用性 (universality) 结果，并论证使用中间隐藏层表示比仅用最终输出更有信息量；据此设计 HIDDENPROBE，一个从隐藏探针响应 (hidden probe responses) 学习的简单架构，代码已在 GitHub 公开。
Result: 在一系列神经泛函基准上（覆盖 MLP 与 Transformer），HIDDENPROBE 一致优于已有 probing 方法并取得 state-of-the-art 性能；理论部分给出有限探针表示的识别与通用性结果。
Conclusion: 有限探针足以学习神经泛函，且把探针位置推进到中间隐藏层能显著提升表示信息量，HIDDENPROBE 据此成为该任务上的新最优。

papers.title: Counterfactual Rollout Replay: Forkable Environments as Free Process Rewards for Software Engineering Agents
papers.abstract_en: Outcome-only reinforcement learning gives software engineering (SWE) agents a terminal success signal but little direct guidance about intermediate decisions. We introduce Counterfactual Rollout Replay (CRR), a training-time procedure that uses forkable executable environments to obtain step-level return contrasts. CRR selects a small set of decision points, restores each state, samples an alternative action, and rolls the branch forward under the policy. It retains the realised training trajectory and replaces the advantage at selected steps with the difference between its terminal return and the sampled counterfactual return. The method needs no human process labels or learned process reward model; free refers to those supervision costs, not replay compute. With a 14B policy, CRR improves pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Live, and SWE-rebench, and combines with process-reward and trajectory-search methods. On SWE-bench Verified, an equal-wall-clock comparison on the same hardware yields 41.7% versus 36.7% for extended outcome-only GRPO, a 5.0-point gain with fork overhead included. These results apply to environments with affordable, reliable state restoration; stochastic continuations and expensive or imperfect replay remain limitations.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Includes additional experiments and analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRR 在可分叉的可执行环境中恢复历史状态、采样替代动作并向前 rollout，用真实轨迹终局回报减去反事实分支回报替换所选步的 advantage，从而在无人工过程标签、无过程奖励模型的情况下给 outcome-only RL 注入步级过程信号。14B 策略在 SWE-bench Verified 上与等墙钟时间的扩展 GRPO 相比 pass@1 为 41.7% 对 36.7%，含分叉开销仍净增 5.0 个百分点。
Motivation: SWE agent 的 outcome-only RL 只有终局成功信号，中间决策几乎得不到直接反馈；过程奖励模型与人工过程标注成本高，且轨迹搜索方法需要额外监督。
Method: CRR 是训练期过程：挑选少量决策点，恢复该状态、采样一个替代动作并在当前策略下向前 rollout，保留原训练轨迹，只把这些步的 advantage 替换为真实终局回报与反事实分支回报之差；不引入人工过程标签或学习式过程奖励模型，可与过程奖励方法和轨迹搜索方法组合。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Live、SWE-rebench 上均提升 pass@1；SWE-bench Verified 上同硬件等墙钟对比为 41.7% 对 36.7%（扩展 outcome-only GRPO），净增 5.0 个百分点且已计入分叉开销。
Conclusion: 可分叉环境的反事实 rollout 本身就能充当免费过程奖励，前提是状态恢复足够便宜可靠；随机延续以及昂贵或不完美的 replay 仍是限制条件。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Live、SWE-rebench 上均提升 pass@1；SWE-bench Verified 上同硬件等墙钟对比为 41.7% 对 36.7%（扩展 outcome-only GRPO），净增 5.0 个百分点且已计入分叉开销。
summary_sections.conclusion: 可分叉环境的反事实 rollout 本身就能充当免费过程奖励，前提是状态恢复足够便宜可靠；随机延续以及昂贵或不完美的 replay 仍是限制条件。

papers.title: Collaborative Synthetic Data for Privacy-Preserving Financial Fraud Detection Across Organizational Silos
papers.abstract_en: Organizations seek analytical value from AI, yet relevant data are often fragmented across organizations and constrained by privacy. This is acute in financial fraud detection, where rare fraud cases and imbalanced local datasets limit decision-relevant analytics. Federated learning enables collaboration without direct data sharing but does not resolve minority-class scarcity. Synthetic data generation can help, yet lightweight methods are interpolation-bound, while generative models require substantial data and computation. Existing collaborative generative approaches often rely on federated learning, imposing considerable organization-side training burdens. In this paper, we examine CollaFuse as a collaborative diffusion-based alternative for fraud detection and evaluate it across five fraud datasets. Compared with classical oversampling, local generative baselines, and centralized diffusion benchmarks, CollaFuse does not achieve the highest local fidelity but improves downstream fraud detection more consistently across most datasets. These findings suggest that synthetic data create analytical value less through local realism than through transferable cross-organizational structure.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the International Conference on Information Systems (ICIS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CollaFuse：跨组织协作的扩散合成数据方法，用于隐私约束下的金融欺诈检测，在五个欺诈数据集上与经典过采样、本地生成基线和集中式 diffusion 基准对比。它在多数数据集上并非局部保真度最高，却更稳定地提升下游欺诈检测效果，说明合成数据的价值来自可迁移的跨组织结构而非局部真实感。
Motivation: 欺诈样本稀少且各组织数据不平衡，数据又受隐私约束无法直接共享；联邦学习缓解了协作但解决不了少数类稀缺，现有协作生成方案还给参与方带来沉重的训练负担。
Method: CollaFuse 以协作式 diffusion 生成合成欺诈数据替代联邦学习路线，在五个欺诈数据集上评测，对比对象为经典过采样、本地生成基线与集中式 diffusion 基准，衡量局部保真度与下游欺诈检测效果。
Result: 在五个欺诈数据集上，CollaFuse 未取得最高的局部保真度，但在多数数据集上比经典过采样、本地生成基线和集中式 diffusion 基准更一致地改善下游欺诈检测表现。
Conclusion: 合成数据的分析价值主要来自可迁移的跨组织结构，而非局部真实感；协作式 diffusion 可作为联邦训练负担较轻的替代路径。

papers.title: FedMHAR: Federated Multimodal Human Activity Recognition using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) from heterogeneous wearable sensors is fundamental to the Internet of Health Things (IoHT), supporting rehabilitation, elderly care, and smart healthcare. Existing multimodal fusion methods often assign fixed equal weights to sensor streams, overlooking differences in modality importance, acquisition cost, and sensor quality, which can vary due to movement, incorrect placement, or temporary blockage. We propose an adaptive and cost-aware multimodal HAR framework based on multi-agent reinforcement learning for centralized HAR and extend it to federated learning as FedMHAR. In the centralized setting, multimodal fusion is formulated as a cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) problem, where each sensing modality is assigned a PPO-based agent that learns per-sample fusion weights, enabling the model to emphasize informative modalities while down-weighting costly sensors when cheaper alternatives provide sufficient information. In the federated setting, we introduce BiFL-PPO, a bidirectional federated optimization strategy in which a server-side PPO policy learns client-specific trust weights and feeds them back to adapt local learning rates and proximal regularization. Unlike round-level optimization, BiFL-PPO uses dense batch-level rewards for more frequent feedback and stable training under heterogeneous client data. Evaluation on the MEx Rehabilitation and UTD Multimodal Human Action datasets shows that the centralized framework achieves 87.30% and 94.98% accuracy, respectively, outperforming conventional fusion methods and state-of-the-art HAR models. FedMHAR achieves 79.74% and 77.49% in the federated setting, consistently surpassing FedAvg, FedProx, FedBN, FedNova, and AdaFedProx, while providing more stable performance and reducing sensor acquisition cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedMHAR 把多模态可穿戴传感器融合建为合作式多智能体强化学习，每个模态配一个 PPO agent 学逐样本融合权重，并在联邦侧用 BiFL-PPO 让服务器学客户端信任权重来调本地学习率与 proximal 正则。在 MEx Rehabilitation 与 UTD Multimodal Human Action 上集中式准确率 87.30% 与 94.98%，联邦式 79.74% 与 77.49%，均超过常规融合与 FedAvg 等基线，同时降低传感器采集成本。
Motivation: 多模态 HAR 融合常给各传感器流固定等权，忽略模态重要性、采集成本与因运动、佩戴错误或遮挡导致的传感器质量差异；联邦场景下客户端数据异构还会让训练不稳。
Method: 集中式把融合写成合作式 MARL，每个传感模态一个 PPO agent 输出逐样本融合权重，可在信息量高的模态上加权、在更便宜替代可用时压低成本高的传感器；联邦侧提出 BiFL-PPO，服务器端 PPO 策略学客户端专属信任权重并反馈以调本地学习率与 proximal 正则，用 batch 级密集奖励替代 round 级反馈。
Result: 集中式框架在 MEx Rehabilitation 与 UTD Multimodal Human Action 上分别取得 87.30% 与 94.98% 准确率，超过常规融合方法与 SOTA HAR 模型；联邦 FedMHAR 分别 79.74% 与 77.49%，一致优于 FedAvg、FedProx、FedBN、FedNova、AdaFedProx，表现更稳定并降低传感器采集成本。
Conclusion: 按样本自适应加权加上按客户端信任调节的联邦优化，能在保持精度的同时降低采集成本，并在异构客户端数据下比标准联邦聚合更稳。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluating System One Models for Agent Security Decisions: Reliability, Calibration, and Selective Automation
papers.abstract_en: Agentic software connects language models to tools that modify files and interact with external services. Developers use model-based security checks to screen external content and user requests before agents act. System One models answer developer-defined questions with probabilities over predefined answers such as safe or unsafe, but classification accuracy alone does not establish whether these probabilities support reliable automation. We evaluate Jev, Laya, Decider, and Bespoke Nimble against specialized classifiers and language-model judges across prompt-injection detection, interaction-risk judgment, and harmful-request screening, examining decision accuracy, calibration, and selective automation. (1) High overall accuracy and low average calibration error can conceal attacks classified as safe with high confidence within particular groups. Developers should test candidate models on the intended security task and examine errors within relevant attack groups. (2) Policies selected under strict miss limits allow few test inputs automatically, and choosing allow and block thresholds separately increases automation mainly through additional blocks. Developers should verify limits on missed unsafe inputs and blocked benign inputs on independent data, and report the allowed and blocked fractions separately. (3) Comparing predictions on the same inputs shows that a language-model judge can detect unsafe inputs missed by a System One model, but can also repeat the System One model's confident mistakes and falsely flag benign inputs. Developers should test which missed unsafe inputs their review rule forwards, then measure the review model's misses and benign false alarms on those inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Jev、Laya、Decider、Bespoke Nimble 四个 System One 模型在提示注入检测、交互风险判断、有害请求筛查三类 agent 安全任务上评估决策准确率、校准与选择性自动化。发现高总体准确率与低平均校准误差会掩盖特定攻击组内被高置信判为安全的攻击；严格漏检约束下自动放行的输入很少，分开选 allow/block 阈值主要靠增加 block 提升自动化率；LM judge 能补抓 System One 漏掉的不安全输入，也会复现其高置信错误并误报良性输入。
Motivation: System One 模型输出的概率被开发者当作自动 allow/block 的依据，但分类准确率本身不能证明这些概率足以支撑可靠自动化，且平均校准指标会掩盖分组内的高置信漏检。
Method: 在提示注入检测、交互风险判断、有害请求筛查三个任务上，将四个 System One 模型与专用分类器和 language-model judge 对比，考察决策准确率、校准误差与选择性自动化；在严格 miss 约束下分别选择 allow 与 block 阈值，并在同一输入上比较 System One 与 LM judge 的预测以构造复核规则。
Result: 高总体准确率与低平均校准误差可掩盖特定攻击组内被高置信判为安全的攻击；严格 miss 约束下测试输入中仅少量被自动处理，分开选 allow/block 阈值带来的自动化提升主要来自额外 block；LM judge 能检出 System One 漏检的不安全输入，同时会重复其高置信错误并对良性输入误报。
Conclusion: 开发者应在目标任务上测试候选模型并按攻击组检查错误，在独立数据上核验漏检与良性拦截上限并分别报告 allow/block 比例，还要针对复核规则实际转发的漏检输入测量复核模型的漏检与良性误报。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Does Backpropagating Through Policy Memory Matter? Physical Credit, Optimizer Updates, and Observability
papers.abstract_en: Policies with memory can learn along two backward paths: through the physical states their actions produce and through the representations they store. Transformer-XL and truncated backpropagation through time cut the second path at stored history while keeping its values. We ask when this cut matters. Holding the forward computation fixed and varying only derivative edges, we measure parameter gradients, the updates the optimizer applies, and continued training in a Transformer vessel-trajectory model and a quadrotor tracking policy. In the vessel model, detaching the key-value cache shrank the gradient to about a tenth of its norm, with little rotation, when gradients flowed through all earlier physical states, but barely changed it under one-step physical credit. In this strongly clipped regime the optimizer, not the gradient, set how far updates differed: global-norm clipping removed most of the gradient difference between memory-cut graphs, whereas AdamW turned a 2% gradient difference between two placements of the cut into update differences of up to 31% at the step where the placement was switched. In a quadrotor trained from initialization with 0.20 m/s velocity noise, removing memory raised tracking error by 43% and cutting memory gradients raised it by 32%; at low noise the cut's mean cost exceeded the value of memory. Two-step truncation segments gave no measurable gain, although with hidden velocity a two-step window captured most of the value of memory; eight-step segments removed half to three quarters of the cost. Switching the cut on only for the last fifth of training understated its cost about threefold at 0.20-0.30 m/s, but not at low noise or with hidden velocity. These results suggest measuring the cost of a memory cut by training with it from initialization, and comparing backward graphs by the updates the optimizer applies rather than by raw gradients.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 9 figures, 20 tables, Under review at TMLR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在保持前向计算不变、只改反向求导边的对照里，记忆截断（Transformer-XL / TBPTT 式切断存储表示的梯度）的代价取决于物理信用长度与优化器：强截断体制下决定更新差异的是优化器而非梯度本身。船轨迹模型中 detach key-value cache 使梯度范数缩到约十分之一但方向几乎不转；AdamW 把 2% 的梯度差异放大成最高 31% 的更新差异，而 global-norm clipping 抹掉了大部分差异。作者建议从初始化就带着截断训练来度量其代价，并用优化器实际施加的更新而非原始梯度比较反向图。
Motivation: 带记忆的策略有两条反向路径：经由动作产生的物理状态，和经由自身存储的表示；现有做法直接切断后者，但这一刀在什么条件下重要、以及该用梯度还是优化器更新来衡量，此前没有受控答案。
Method: 固定前向计算、只改变求导边，测量参数梯度、优化器实际施加的更新与继续训练表现；实验对象为 Transformer 船舶轨迹模型与四旋翼跟踪策略，比较不同截断位置、global-norm clipping 与 AdamW、以及不同截断启用时段。
Result: 船模型中 detach key-value cache 在梯度流经全部更早物理状态时把梯度范数压到约 1/10 且方向几乎不变，在一步物理信用下则几乎无变化；global-norm clipping 消除了两种记忆截断图之间的大部分梯度差异，而 AdamW 把 2% 的梯度差异在切换截断位置的那一步放大为最高 31% 的更新差异。四旋翼从初始化训练、速度噪声 0.20 m/s 时，去掉记忆使跟踪误差升 43%，切断记忆梯度升 32%；低噪声下截断的平均代价超过记忆的价值。两段式截断无可测收益，但有隐藏速度时两步窗口捕获了记忆的大部分价值，八段式截断消除了代价的一半到四分之三。只在训练最后五分之一开启截断，在 0.20–0.30 m/s 下把代价低估约三倍，在低噪声或有隐藏速度时不低估。
Conclusion: 记忆截断的代价要用从初始化就带着它训练来度量，且反向图的比较应基于优化器施加的更新而非原始梯度；截断代价对噪声水平、信用长度与启用时段高度敏感。

summary_sections.result: 船模型中 detach key-value cache 在梯度流经全部更早物理状态时把梯度范数压到约 1/10 且方向几乎不变，在一步物理信用下则几乎无变化；global-norm clipping 消除了两种记忆截断图之间的大部分梯度差异，而 AdamW 把 2% 的梯度差异在切换截断位置的那一步放大为最高 31% 的更新差异。四旋翼从初始化训练、速度噪声 0.20 m/s 时，去掉记忆使跟踪误差升 43%，切断记忆梯度升 32%；低噪声下截断的平均代价超过记忆的价值。两段式截断无可测收益，但有隐藏速度时两步窗口捕获了记忆的大部分价值，八段式截断消除了代价的一半到四分之三。只在训练最后五分之一开启截断，在 0.20–0.30 m/s 下把代价低估约三倍，在低噪声或有隐藏速度时不低估。
summary_sections.conclusion: 记忆截断的代价要用从初始化就带着它训练来度量，且反向图的比较应基于优化器施加的更新而非原始梯度；截断代价对噪声水平、信用长度与启用时段高度敏感。

papers.title: SAGE: Semantic Audio Generative Encoder
papers.abstract_en: Audio autoencoders compress waveforms into compact latent representations that serve as the interface between raw audio and downstream models. Current systems navigate a three-way trade-off between reconstruction quality, semantic structure of the latent space, and inference speed, typically favoring one or two of these at the expense of the others. This paper introduces SAGE, Semantic Audio Generative Encoder: a compact variational autoencoder, trained solely on publicly available music, that shapes its latent by distilling embeddings from a pretrained audio-text model. This 105M-parameter model runs at the inference cost of Stable Audio Open and reaches the listening-test quality of SAME-L, an autoencoder 8x larger and 4x slower, while surpassing both on objective perceptual and distributional metrics of reconstruction. Furthermore, it sets the state of the art on all nineteen probing tasks of latent semantics, in domain and out of domain. These results establish SAGE as a lightweight audio autoencoder that strikes the best balance of the three-way trade-off among those we evaluate, combining high reconstruction fidelity, state-of-the-art semantic structure, and fast inference.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Code and weights: https://github.com/francescobrigante/SAGE. Project page: https://sage-music.pages.dev/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGE 是一个 105M 参数的紧凑变分自编码器，仅用公开音乐数据训练，通过蒸馏预训练 audio-text 模型的 embedding 来塑造 latent 空间。其推理开销与 Stable Audio Open 相当，听感质量达到大 8 倍、慢 4 倍的 SAME-L 水平，并在客观感知与分布指标上超过两者，且在域内与域外全部 19 项 latent 语义 probing 任务上取得 SOTA。
Motivation: 音频自编码器在重建质量、latent 语义结构、推理速度三者之间只能取其二，现有系统通常牺牲其中一到两项。
Method: 紧凑变分自编码器 (VAE)，仅在公开可得音乐数据上训练；latent 由蒸馏一个预训练 audio-text 模型的 embedding 得到，从而把语义结构注入压缩表示。
Result: 105M 参数，推理开销与 Stable Audio Open 相同量级；听感测试质量追平 SAME-L（后者大 8 倍、慢 4 倍），并在重建的客观感知与分布指标上同时超过 Stable Audio Open 与 SAME-L；在域内与域外共 19 项 latent 语义 probing 任务上全部达到 state of the art。
Conclusion: 在所评估的系统中，SAGE 最好地平衡了重建保真、语义结构与推理速度这三难权衡，可作为轻量音频自编码器接口层使用。

papers.title: Model-Agnostic Online Certificate-Driven Calibration for Time Series Forecasting Under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Time series out-of-distribution generalization requires forecasters to remain reliable when deployment dynamics differ from training conditions due to covariate shift, concept shift, and temporal dependence. Probably Approximately Correct Bayesian domain adaptation provides computable certificates by decomposing target risk into a source risk term, a source-to-target mismatch term, and a complexity term, but standard analyses rely on independent sampling and distributional stability, assumptions that are violated in time series by serial dependence and nonstationary shift. We propose a model-agnostic online martingale Probably Approximately Correct Bayesian framework that yields finite-sample certificates under temporal dependence and distribution shift. The certificate replaces independent-sample concentration with martingale concentration that adapts to loss scale and predictable variation. We use the certificate as a surrogate regularizer for online calibration by training a gated residual Bayesian head on top of a fixed forecasting backbone, producing a corrective update that reverts to the backbone prediction when the gate is closed. Online calibration combines a source risk anchor, a posterior-shift penalty, and a time-adaptive mismatch term computed from target windows observed before forecasting. It follows a predict-then-update protocol in which outcomes become available only after forecasting and are used to update subsequent predictions. Experiments across convolutional, attention-based, and large language model-based forecasters show improved stability and accuracy under covariate and concept shift.
papers.comment: Oral presentation at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026). Published in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR), Vol. 337, pp. 2244-2273
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence, Proceedings of Machine Learning Research, Vol. 337, pp. 2244-2273, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出模型无关的在线鞅 PAC 贝叶斯证书，把时间序列分布偏移下的目标风险界从独立采样换成适应损失尺度与可预测变差的鞅集中不等式，并用它作为在线校准的代理正则项：在固定预报骨干之上训练门控残差贝叶斯头，按 predict-then-update 协议给出修正更新，门关闭时回退到骨干预测。跨卷积、注意力与 LLM 类预报器的实验显示，在协变量偏移与概念偏移下稳定性和准确性均有提升。
Motivation: PAC 贝叶斯域自适应证书把目标风险分解为源风险、源-目标失配与复杂度三项，但其标准分析依赖独立采样与分布稳定性，而时间序列的序列相关性和非平稳偏移恰好违反这两条假设，使证书在部署动态偏离训练条件时失效。
Method: 构建模型无关的在线鞅 PAC 贝叶斯框架，用适应损失尺度与可预测变差 (predictable variation) 的鞅集中替代独立样本集中，得到有限样本证书；将证书作为在线校准的代理正则项，在固定预报骨干之上训练门控残差贝叶斯头，校准目标由源风险锚点、后验偏移惩罚与基于预报前观测目标窗口的时间自适应失配项组成，采用 predict-then-update 协议，结果在预报之后才可得并用于更新后续预测。
Result: 在卷积类、注意力类与基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的多类预报器上实验，协变量偏移 (covariate shift) 与概念偏移 (concept shift) 条件下均观察到稳定性与准确性改善。
Conclusion: 在时间序列分布偏移下，用鞅型有限样本证书替代独立采样假设，可以在序列相关与非平稳偏移中继续提供可计算的风险证书，并以门控残差头的形式转化为有效的在线校准。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: A Unified Account of Concepts and Chunks
papers.abstract_en: Cognitive psychology has studied how people encode, use, and learn concepts that describe categories, and how they represent, recognize, and acquire chunks for familiar patterns of elements. The literatures on these two topics are nearly disjoint, which poses a challenge for unified theories of cognition. In this paper, we review Cobweb, a computational account of categorization and concept formation, then propose an extended theory that incorporates chunks and their acquisition. The theory makes no commitments about modality, applying to any experience that decomposes into elements and relations among them. We also present \trellis/, an implementation of this theory, and illustrate its application to learning context-free grammars, which we adopt as a testbed because they involve both concept-like and chunk-like elements. In addition, we report experimental results on learning for three synthetic grammars that demonstrate the system's ability to represent syntactic knowledge, use it to parse and generate sentences, and learn compositional structures from sample parses. We conclude by discussing related work on concepts and chunks, along with directions for future research on the problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把认知心理学中几乎分离的两类研究——概念/类别形成与 chunk 识别——统一到一个扩展的 Cobweb 理论里，并实现为系统 \trellis/，在三个合成上下文无关文法 (CFG) 上展示其表示句法知识、解析与生成句子、并从样本解析中学习组合结构的能力。
Motivation: 概念 (concepts) 与 chunk 两条认知心理学文献几乎互不相通，阻碍了统一认知理论的构建；需要一个不绑定具体模态、可同时容纳两类结构的计算说明。
Method: 回顾 Cobweb 这一分类与概念形成的计算说明，提出纳入 chunk 及其习得的扩展理论；理论不承诺模态，只要经验可分解为元素及其间关系即可适用；给出实现 \trellis/，以学习上下文无关文法 (CFG) 作为同时含概念型与 chunk 型成分的测试床。
Result: 在三个合成文法 (synthetic grammars) 上报告实验：系统能表示句法知识、用它做句子解析与生成、并从样本解析中学习组合结构；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 概念与 chunk 可以在一个不依赖模态的统一理论中共同处理，CFG 学习是检验该理论的可行测试床。

papers.title: SWE-Prometheus: Measuring Engineering Governance Improvements in Real-World Repositories
papers.abstract_en: Large language model based coding agents have made substantial progress on repository-level software engineering tasks. Existing repository benchmarks, however, usually start from a human-identified issue and evaluate whether a patch satisfies a functional signal. We present SWE-Prometheus, a benchmark for the broader task of improving repository engineering governance. Each task provides a fixed snapshot and an open-ended objective, requiring the agent to identify risks, prioritize interventions, and verify the resulting changes. SWE-Prometheus evaluates six governance dimensions through paired evidence, clean-environment probes, behavior gates, and two independent teacher ratings of the same evidence. The benchmark contains 60 repositories; ten models are evaluated on a shared 22-repository public subset, where mean Normalized Governance Improvement ranges from 0.0568 to 0.5760 and observed behavior-breakage rates range from 0% to 23%. On a frozen ten-repository batch, a repository-blind template obtains mean NGI 0.272, but its gains concentrate in Tests & CI, Quality Gates, and Documentation; it improves Reproducible Environment and Dependency & Security on none of the repositories. This baseline makes the distinction between adding governance artifacts and producing execution-backed improvements measurable. The no-op condition has median NGI zero and standard deviation 0.073; two teachers agree exactly on 57 of 60 dimension scores for the same no-op evidence. For the two highest conditional-mean systems, common-valid NGI is similar, while full-pool comparisons that include behavior failures favor Kimi-K3. These results show why repository-governance evaluation should report improvement, behavior preservation, evidence quality, and coverage together.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWE-Prometheus 把仓库级软件工程的评价对象从「修一个 issue」换成「提升工程治理」：每个任务给定固定快照与开放式目标，让 agent 自己找风险、排优先级并验证改动。在共享的 22 仓库公开子集上，十个模型的平均 Normalized Governance Improvement 落在 0.0568 到 0.5760 之间，行为破坏率 0% 到 23%；仓库盲模板均值 NGI 0.272，但收益只集中在 Tests & CI、Quality Gates、Documentation，在 Reproducible Environment 与 Dependency & Security 上零仓库改善。
Motivation: 现有仓库级基准都从人工标注的 issue 出发、只判 patch 是否满足功能信号，无法衡量 agent 主动识别风险并系统性改进治理这一更宽的任务，也无法区分「堆治理产物」与「真正带来可执行的改进」。
Method: 基准含 60 个仓库，每个任务给定固定快照与开放式目标，从六个治理维度评分；证据链由 paired evidence、clean-environment probes、behavior gates 构成，同一份证据交两位独立 teacher 打分。十个模型在共享的 22 仓库公开子集上评测，另设冻结的 10 仓库批次跑仓库盲模板基线与 no-op 条件。
Result: 22 仓库子集上十个模型 mean NGI 0.0568–0.5760，observed behavior-breakage rate 0%–23%。冻结 10 仓库批次上仓库盲模板 mean NGI 0.272，收益集中于 Tests & CI、Quality Gates、Documentation，对 Reproducible Environment 与 Dependency & Security 改善的仓库数为 0。no-op 条件 median NGI 为 0、标准差 0.073；两位 teacher 对同一 no-op 证据的 60 个维度分中 57 个完全一致。两个条件均值最高的系统在 common-valid NGI 上接近，而纳入行为失败的 full-pool 比较偏向 Kimi-K3。
Conclusion: 仓库治理评价必须同时报告 improvement、behavior preservation、evidence quality 与 coverage 四项，单看 NGI 会因行为失败的处理方式而改变系统排名；仓库盲模板能加治理产物，但不产生执行支撑的改进。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When No One Owns the Judgment: Accountability Under Contribution Dissolution in Human-AI Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Communities often respond to potentially AI-assisted work by asking three questions: Was AI used? Was that use disclosed? Can hidden use be detected? These questions place AI use itself at the center of accountability while overlooking a deeper problem: unowned judgment. Evaluations, claims, decisions, and creative directions can be shaped by AI with no accountable human or institution prepared to stand behind them. We develop this argument through two illustrative cases: AI-assisted peer review and concealed AI use in creative work. The first shows how contribution dissolution can weaken responsibility while the second shows how the fear of losing credit can discourage honest disclosure. The cases expose the limits of disclosure rules and provenance records as responses to AI-mediated collaboration. We offer three directions for discussion: distinguishing the roles AI plays, identifying judgments that require clear human ownership, and creating conditions in which AI involvement can be disclosed without default penalty. The broader aim is to make AI-shaped contributions discussable, creditable, contestable, and repairable.
papers.comment: In CSCW'26 workshop on contribution, originality, and accountability in agent-mediated collaboration
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张：把问责焦点放在「是否用了 AI、是否披露、能否检测」上是错位的，真正的问题是「无人认领的判断」——评估、主张、决策与创作方向被 AI 塑形，却没有可问责的人或机构愿意为之背书。以 AI 辅助同行评审与创作中隐瞒 AI 使用两个案例说明：贡献溶解削弱责任、怕失去署名又抑制诚实披露，因此披露规则与来源记录 (provenance) 都不足以应对。
Motivation: 现有社区对疑似 AI 辅助工作的回应（追问使用、披露、检测）把 AI 使用本身置于问责中心，却遗漏了更深层的问题：被 AI 塑形的判断没有可问责主体，责任与署名同时落空。
Method: 通过两个说明性案例展开论证——AI 辅助同行评审（展示 contribution dissolution 如何削弱责任）与创作中隐瞒 AI 使用（展示怕失去署名如何抑制诚实披露）；并提出三个讨论方向：区分 AI 扮当的角色、识别需要明确人类归属的判断、创造可无默认惩罚披露 AI 参与的条件。
Result: 两个案例定性揭示披露规则与来源记录作为应对 AI 协作手段的局限：贡献溶解削弱责任，怕失去署名则抑制诚实披露；摘要未给出实验或定量对比。
Conclusion: 问责应从「AI 是否被使用」转向「哪些判断必须有人类明确归属」，并建立可无默认惩罚披露 AI 参与的条件，使 AI 塑形的贡献可讨论、可计功、可争议、可修复。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FFM-CP: Cross-Backbone Fusion of Vision-Language Foundation Models for Few-Shot Computational Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Pathology vision-language foundation models vary in performance across diseases and tasks, with no single model consistently performing best. The high cost of expert pathology annotation can also limit the labeled data available for task-specific adaptation. Combining complementary pretrained representations is a potential approach to these limitations, yet learning an effective fusion from few labeled examples remains challenging. We introduce Few-shot Fusion Foundation Models of Computational Pathology (FFM-CP), which is a framework that combines multiple pathology vision-language models in the few-shot learning setting. The framework first aligns heterogeneous representations using a closed-form Orthogonal Procrustes transformation estimated from corresponding support images. This alignment preserves within-model feature geometry without training an additional alignment network. Within the aligned space, a unified graph enables information exchange across backbones by jointly refining support-image features and visual and textual class prototypes. These refined representations support complementary text-prototype and case-retrieval branches that capture semantic class knowledge and within-class visual variation, respectively. Each branch learns to combine predictions from all ordered backbone pairs, allowing queries encoded by one model to draw on evidence represented by another. We evaluate three backbone combinations on six histopathology datasets at 4, 8, and 16 shots per class. FFM-CP achieves higher mean macro-F1 than the strongest individually adapted member of each fused set in 50 of 54 comparisons. These findings suggest that combining complementary pretrained representations can improve histopathological classification when annotations are limited.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FFM-CP 在少样本计算病理学设定下把多个病理视觉-语言基础模型的表征融合起来：先用支撑图像对估计的闭式正交 Procrustes 变换对齐异构表征，再在统一图上联合精修支撑特征与视觉/文本类原型，最后由文本原型分支和病例检索分支各自学习所有有序骨干对的预测组合。在六个组织病理数据集、每类 4/8/16 shot 下，54 组对比中有 50 组的 mean macro-F1 高于所融合集合中最强的单个成员。
Motivation: 病理视觉-语言基础模型在不同疾病和任务上各有胜负，没有单一模型稳定最优；专家标注昂贵导致任务适配的有标签数据稀缺，而少样本下学习有效融合本身很难。
Method: FFM-CP 框架分三步：用对应支撑图像估计闭式正交 Procrustes 变换对齐各骨干的异构表征（不额外训练对齐网络，保留模型内特征几何）；在对齐空间中用统一图跨骨干交换信息，联合精修支撑图像特征与视觉、文本类原型；精修后的表征送入互补的 text-prototype 与 case-retrieval 两个分支，每个分支学习组合所有有序骨干对的预测，使单一模型编码的查询能借用另一模型的证据。
Result: 在六个组织病理数据集、每类 4、8、16 shot 的设定下评测三种骨干组合，FFM-CP 在 54 组对比中的 50 组取得高于所融合集合内最强单个成员的 mean macro-F1。
Conclusion: 在标注有限时，融合互补的预训练表征可以提升组织病理分类效果，且该融合在少样本支撑集上即可完成，无需额外的对齐网络训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VidOmni-Bench: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Video Understanding via Spatio-Temporal Event Verification across Complexity and Duration
papers.abstract_en: While Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have recently demonstrated strong performance, reliably evaluating their fine-grained video understanding remains challenging. Existing benchmarks often rely on question answering or ground-truth caption matching, where models may succeed through superficial cues and incomplete annotations. To this end, we introduce VidOmni-Bench, a benchmark that requires models to verify whether each event in dense video captions is supported by the video. VidOmni-Bench consists of 500 videos spanning five complexity types and diverse durations from 4 seconds to 90 minutes. After collecting videos along these axes, we use diverse Video-LLMs to generate dense captions and obtain human-verified sentence-level labels, where sentences containing incorrect events serve as hard negatives for evaluation. Our experiments on VidOmni-Bench reveal three key findings: (i) Video-LLMs frequently generate hallucinated descriptions in dense video captioning; (ii) they also struggle as verifiers, failing to reliably detect plausible but incorrect event descriptions; and (iii) model weaknesses vary across video complexity and duration, revealing diverse, model-specific bottlenecks in current Video-LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VidOmni-Bench 把细粒度视频理解改写成事件核验任务：给定稠密视频描述，模型需逐句判断每个事件是否被视频支持。500 条视频覆盖五种复杂度类型、时长 4 秒到 90 分钟，句子级人工标注中含错误事件的句子作为 hard negative。实验显示 Video-LLM 在稠密描述中频繁产生幻觉，作为核验器也难以识别貌似合理但错误的事件，且弱点随复杂度与时长变化、呈模型特异性。
Motivation: 现有视频理解基准多依赖问答或与 ground-truth caption 匹配，模型可凭表面线索和不完整标注取巧，无法可靠评估细粒度视频理解。
Method: 沿复杂度与时长两条轴收集 500 条视频（4 秒至 90 分钟），用多种 Video-LLM 生成稠密描述，再取得人工核验的句子级标签；含错误事件的句子作为评测用 hard negative，任务是逐事件核验描述是否被视频支持。
Result: 基准含 500 条视频、五种复杂度类型、时长跨度 4 秒至 90 分钟；三项发现：Video-LLM 在稠密视频描述中频繁生成幻觉内容；作为核验器难以可靠检出貌似合理但错误的事件描述；模型弱点随视频复杂度与时长变化，呈现模型特异的瓶颈。
Conclusion: Video-LLM 的细粒度视频理解同时卡在生成端的幻觉与核验端的漏检，且瓶颈因模型、复杂度、时长而异，评测须按这些轴分层而非只看总体分数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exact Regret Frontiers and Externality Scheduling in Centralized Serial-Dictatorship Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Exploration in centralized serial-dictatorship matching bandits must use complete matchings, so learning one player-arm pair can impose regret on others. We study this externality under a known common priority order and Gaussian rewards with unit variance. We show that the matching-level Graves-Lai constraints reduce to finitely many pairwise exploration quotas and, at top-choice-separated instances, yield a polynomial-size marginal linear program. At these instances, the exact attainable set of expected logarithmic regret coefficients is $G(θ)\mathcal{X}(θ)$, where $\mathcal{X}$ is the feasible matching-allocation set and $G$ maps allocations to player regret. The usual upper-closed Graves-Lai region can be strictly larger despite having the same Pareto-minimal boundary. We further show that identical exploration quotas can induce very different regret through their scheduling. Finally, we construct estimate-solve-track policies, uniformly good on the full row-strict class, that attain every fixed positively weighted optimum without assuming optimizer uniqueness. Every Pareto-minimal point is pointwise attainable, possibly through an instance-calibrated target.
papers.comment: v3: exposition clarified; a sentence in Section 5.3 that was inaccurate for K > N removed, and the K = N condition stated in the introduction; comparison with Cuvelier et al. made precise; two statements in Appendix B corrected; computational cost stated; experiments rerun with 50 seeds (was 10), KL-UCB baseline added to Figure 2; references updated. Main results unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在已知共同优先序、单位方差高斯奖励的集中式串行独裁匹配 bandit 中，学习一个玩家-臂配对会把遗憾转嫁给他人。作者证明匹配级 Graves-Lai 约束可化为有限个成对探索配额，在 top-choice-separated 实例上化为多项式规模的边际线性规划，可达的期望对数遗憾系数集合恰为 G(θ)X(θ)；相同配额因调度不同可产生差异很大的遗憾，并构造出在全 row-strict 类上一致良好、逐点可达每个 Pareto 最小点的 estimate-solve-track 策略。
Motivation: 集中式匹配 bandit 中探索必须以完整匹配为单位，单个配对的学习会对外部施加遗憾；现有 Graves-Lai 上闭区域可能严格大于真实可达集，且配额相同但调度不同导致的遗憾差异此前未被刻画。
Method: 在已知共同优先序与单位方差高斯奖励设定下，把匹配级 Graves-Lai 约束约化为有限个成对探索配额，在 top-choice-separated 实例上导出多项式规模边际线性规划，刻画可达集合 G(θ)X(θ)（X 为可行匹配分配集，G 将分配映射到玩家遗憾）；并构造 estimate-solve-track 策略，不假设优化器唯一性。
Result: top-choice-separated 实例上精确可达的期望对数遗憾系数集合为 G(θ)X(θ)；通常的上闭 Graves-Lai 区域可严格更大，尽管两者共享同一 Pareto 最小边界；相同探索配额可因调度不同诱导差异极大的遗憾；每个 Pareto 最小点都逐点可达，必要时通过 instance-calibrated target 实现。arXiv v3 注记中实验以 50 个种子重跑（原为 10），Figure 2 新增 KL-UCB 基线，主结果不变。
Conclusion: 匹配 bandit 的探索外部性可被精确刻画为有限配额加调度问题，Pareto 最小遗憾点在 row-strict 类上可逐点实现，而不必依赖优化器唯一性假设。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Outcomes: Dual-View Relational Learning for Efficient Agent Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: Agent benchmarks are substantially more costly to evaluate than conventional LLM benchmarks. Benchmark compression is therefore a natural solution, yet existing methods primarily model redundancy in task--model final-score distributions, which is important in agentic evaluation. To address this limitation, we analyze large-scale trajectories and identify six complementary process signals that are systematically associated with final agent performance. To disentangle agent performance redundancy from a complete perspective, we propose DualViewEval, an agent benchmark compression method that jointly exploits outcome and process relations to learn an exact-size miniset and predict the full-benchmark scores. Across five agent benchmarks and five representative baselines, DualViewEval achieves the best results in all datasets. With only 20 tasks, it achieves $24\times$--$40\times$ compression on APEX-Agents and BFCL, reducing mean absolute error (MAE) by $14.5\%$--$28.2\%$ over the strongest competitors while improving Kendall's $τ$ by up to $7.2\%$ relative to EssenceBench on SWE-bench Verified. The selected minisets further reveal capability differences among different agents, providing compact and diagnostic feedback for efficient agentic model development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DualViewEval 把 agent benchmark 压缩从只看最终分数分布扩展为同时利用结果关系与过程关系：分析大规模轨迹后选出六个与最终表现系统相关的过程信号，学习一个精确规模的 miniset 来预测全量基准分数。在 5 个 agent benchmark、5 个基线上全部取得最佳结果，仅用 20 个任务即在 APEX-Agents 与 BFCL 上实现 24×–40× 压缩。
Motivation: Agent 评测成本远高于常规 LLM benchmark，压缩是自然出路，但现有方法主要建模 task–model 最终分数分布中的冗余，无法刻画 agentic 评测里的过程冗余。
Method: 先分析大规模 agent 轨迹，识别出六个与最终表现系统相关的过程信号；DualViewEval 联合结果关系与过程关系，学习一个 exact-size 的 miniset，并用它预测全量 benchmark 分数。
Result: 在 5 个 agent benchmark 与 5 个代表性基线上，DualViewEval 在所有数据集上取得最佳结果；仅 20 个任务时在 APEX-Agents 与 BFCL 上达到 24×–40× 压缩，MAE 相对最强竞争方法降低 14.5%–28.2%，并在 SWE-bench Verified 上相对 EssenceBench 将 Kendall's τ 最多提升 7.2%。
Conclusion: 结果关系与过程关系联合建模能比只看最终分数分布更有效地压缩 agent benchmark，选出的 miniset 还能区分不同 agent 的能力差异，提供紧凑且具诊断性的反馈。

summary_sections.tldr: DualViewEval 把 agent benchmark 压缩从只看最终分数分布扩展为同时利用结果关系与过程关系：分析大规模轨迹后选出六个与最终表现系统相关的过程信号，学习一个精确规模的 miniset 来预测全量基准分数。在 5 个 agent benchmark、5 个基线上全部取得最佳结果，仅用 20 个任务即在 APEX-Agents 与 BFCL 上实现 24×–40× 压缩。
summary_sections.motivation: Agent 评测成本远高于常规 LLM benchmark，压缩是自然出路，但现有方法主要建模 task–model 最终分数分布中的冗余，无法刻画 agentic 评测里的过程冗余。
summary_sections.method: 先分析大规模 agent 轨迹，识别出六个与最终表现系统相关的过程信号；DualViewEval 联合结果关系与过程关系，学习一个 exact-size 的 miniset，并用它预测全量 benchmark 分数。
summary_sections.result: 在 5 个 agent benchmark 与 5 个代表性基线上，DualViewEval 在所有数据集上取得最佳结果；仅 20 个任务时在 APEX-Agents 与 BFCL 上达到 24×–40× 压缩，MAE 相对最强竞争方法降低 14.5%–28.2%，并在 SWE-bench Verified 上相对 EssenceBench 将 Kendall's τ 最多提升 7.2%。

papers.title: TriCalRAG: A Three-Strategy, Retrieval-Augmented Benchmark for On-Premise LLM-Based Root Cause Analysis in AIOps
papers.abstract_en: Operational logs create a need for private, resource-efficient incident analysis, but aggregate detection scores can conceal severe prediction bias. We present TriCalRAG, a reproducible benchmark for log-anomaly detection with generated root-cause and remediation outputs across BGL, HDFS, Thunderbird, and OpenStack. The primary evaluation compares Qwen2.5-14B and Mistral-Small-22B, served through vLLM on one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU (96 GB), under zero-shot, few-shot, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) prompting across three data-sampling seeds. We report F1, bootstrap confidence intervals, predicted-positive rates, throughput, and memory use, with DeepLog as a held-out classical baseline. Mistral-Small attains a higher macro-averaged F1 than Qwen2.5-14B (0.644 versus 0.560), whereas Qwen provides approximately twice the throughput. A separate log-probability evaluation compares raw decisions with Contextual Calibration (CC) and Batch Calibration (BC): neither correction consistently improves prediction-balance diagnostics across prompting strategies. Supplementary single-run comparisons extend evaluation to 4-bit Llama-3.1-70B via local Ollama and Claude Haiku 4.5 via Anthropic's cloud API; RAG improves F1 on all four datasets for both models. Claude's reported aggregate F1 increases from 0.566 to 0.695, while the estimated API cost rises from \$0.94 to \$2.15 per 1,000 incidents. Local deployment ablations show approximately 41-fold throughput scaling with batching and 20% lower latency with 4-bit quantization on the tested workload. These findings support retrieval as useful context for anomaly decisions, while the supplementary protocols, unvalidated explanation quality, and prediction-balance diagnostics limit broader claims about RCA accuracy and probabilistic calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TriCalRAG 是面向本地部署 LLM 日志异常检测与根因分析 (RCA) 的可复现基准，覆盖 BGL、HDFS、Thunderbird、OpenStack 四个数据集，比较零样本、少样本与 RAG 三种提示策略。Mistral-Small-22B 的 macro F1 高于 Qwen2.5-14B（0.644 对 0.560），但 Qwen 吞吐约两倍；RAG 在两个补充模型上四个数据集均提升 F1，Claude aggregate F1 从 0.566 升到 0.695，代价是每千条 incident 成本从 $0.94 涨到 $2.15。
Motivation: 运维日志需要私密、省资源的事件分析，但单一 aggregate 检测分数会掩盖严重的预测偏差 (prediction bias)，且现有评测缺少可复现的本地部署 RCA 基准。
Method: 在单卡 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 (96 GB) 上用 vLLM 服务 Qwen2.5-14B 与 Mistral-Small-22B，跨零样本、少样本、RAG 三种提示与三个数据采样种子评测，报告 F1、bootstrap 置信区间、预测正例率、吞吐与显存，DeepLog 作为留出的经典基线；另做 log-probability 评测比较原始决策与 Contextual Calibration (CC)、Batch Calibration (BC)，并补充单次运行的 4-bit Llama-3.1-70B（本地 Ollama）与 Claude Haiku 4.5（Anthropic 云 API）对比。
Result: Mistral-Small macro F1 0.644 对 Qwen2.5-14B 0.560，Qwen 吞吐约为其两倍；CC 与 BC 在各提示策略下均未一致改善预测平衡诊断；RAG 在四个数据集上对 Llama-3.1-70B 与 Claude 均提升 F1，Claude aggregate F1 0.566 → 0.695，API 成本 $0.94 → $2.15 每 1,000 条 incident；本地部署消融显示批处理带来约 41 倍吞吐扩展，4-bit 量化在该负载上延迟降低 20%。
Conclusion: 检索可作为异常判定的有效上下文，但补充协议、未经验证的解释质量与预测平衡诊断限制了关于 RCA 精度和概率校准的更广结论。

papers.title: A Measured Communication-Quality Frontier for Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning with Adaptive Phase-Switching
papers.abstract_en: Federated fine-tuning of large language models with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reduces the number of trainable parameters, but communication remains the dominant cost, and protocols are usually compared by parameter-count ratios rather than by measured bytes. This paper measures per-round upload and download bytes for five federated LoRA protocols, three of them from prior work, and places them on a single communication-quality frontier scored by held-out instruction-following loss. The frontier has a knee. ReverseAdaptive, which learns both LoRA factors before freezing one once the relative improvement in training loss falls below a dimensionless threshold, sits at that knee: it cuts measured round-trip communication by 40.5% relative to FLoRA at a held-out loss cost of 0.0063, and beats FFA-LoRA, which freezes that factor at initialization, by 0.0182 in held-out loss, more than twenty times the largest per-method seed standard deviation. The same threshold carries to LLaMA-3.2-3B without retuning, where it saves 30.0%.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 4 figures. v2: revised and retitled version with corrected text, figures, and appendices. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23111915
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对联邦 LoRA 微调中通信成本被按参数比例而非实测字节比较的问题，提出以 held-out 指令遵循 loss 为纵轴、实测每轮上下行字节为横轴的通信-质量前沿，并识别出拐点协议 ReverseAdaptive：两个 LoRA 因子都先训练，当训练 loss 相对改进低于无量纲阈值时冻结其中一个。相对 FLoRA 实测往返通信降 40.5%，代价是 held-out loss 高 0.0063；比在初始化就冻结该因子的 FFA-LoRA 好 0.0182，超过各方法 seed 标准差最大值的二十倍。同一阈值迁移到 LLaMA-3.2-3B 无需重调，仍省 30.0%。
Motivation: 联邦 LoRA 微调里通信是主要开销，但现有协议比较用参数量比例代替实测字节，无法反映真实的上传/下载代价与模型质量的权衡。
Method: 对五个联邦 LoRA 协议（其中三个来自已有工作）逐轮测量上传与下载字节，用 held-out 指令遵循 loss 作为质量分，把它们放到统一的通信-质量前沿上；核心协议 ReverseAdaptive 先同时训练 LoRA 两个因子，当训练 loss 相对改进跌破无量纲阈值时冻结其中一个。
Result: ReverseAdaptive 位于前沿拐点：相对 FLoRA 实测往返通信减少 40.5%，held-out loss 代价 0.0063；相对 FFA-LoRA（初始化即冻结该因子）held-out loss 改善 0.0182，超过各方法 seed 标准差最大值的二十倍以上。同一阈值直接用于 LLaMA-3.2-3B 不需重调，节省 30.0% 通信。
Conclusion: 按实测字节而非参数比例比较，联邦 LoRA 协议存在带拐点的通信-质量前沿，晚冻结（ReverseAdaptive）在该拐点上以极小 loss 代价换取大幅通信节省，且冻结阈值可跨模型规模迁移。

papers.title: Replay in the Silent Degrees of Freedom: Continual Learning Without an Offline Phase
papers.abstract_en: Replay-based continual learning rehearses past data either in an offline phase, during which the agent stops acting, or interleaved with the live stream, where it perturbs the computation serving the current input. An agent that learns in deployment can afford neither. Motivated by local sleep, the use-dependent off periods of individual cortical circuits in awake animals, we show that replay can instead be written into the degrees of freedom the current input leaves unused. In a network with k-winner-take-all hidden layers, confining replay updates to synapses whose presynaptic unit is silent or whose postsynaptic unit is inactive leaves the hidden computation on the current batch invariant: exactly so for silent and suppressed units, and for all but 0.3% of samples in practice. A refractory rule under which units that have just fired sit out the next competition doubles the width of this channel and carries most of the accuracy. On class-incremental split-MNIST the resulting learner, with no offline phase, matches or exceeds the best offline rehearsal schedule and outperforms experience replay, ER-ACE and unmasked interleaved replay, each re-tuned under the same micro-batch schedule. Against DER++ the comparison splits by protocol: with five epochs per task DER++ leads by 1.5 points once it runs under that schedule, and in a single pass over the stream, the regime closest to the agent deployment setting, the system leads it by 1.6 while offline rehearsal falls 15 points behind. On split CIFAR-10 it again leads offline rehearsal and experience replay, but trails ER-ACE and DER++ by two to three points. The construction is not tied to the local learner: on a backprop network with k-winner-take-all hidden layers under the same schedule, refractory rotation adds half a point in five epochs and three in a single pass, and isolation again costs nothing on top of it.
papers.comment: Accepted into NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 k-winner-take-all (k-WTA) 隐层网络里，把回放更新只写进当前输入未使用的“静默”突触（前突触单元静默或后突触单元不活跃），对当前 batch 的隐层计算严格不变（静默/抑制单元精确成立，实践中仅 0.3% 样本例外）。加上 refractory rule（刚放电的单元退出下一轮竞争）使该通道宽度翻倍并贡献大部分精度：split-MNIST 上无离线阶段即可匹配或超过最佳离线回放调度，单遍流式设置下领先 DER++ 1.6 点、离线回放落后 15 点。
Motivation: 回放式持续学习要么需要离线阶段（agent 停止动作），要么与实时流交织从而干扰当前输入的计算；部署中学习的 agent 两者都负担不起。
Method: 受清醒动物局部睡眠 (local sleep) 启发，在 k-WTA 隐层网络中把回放更新限制在前突触单元静默或后突触单元不活跃的突触上；配合 refractory rule（刚放电单元退出下一次竞争）扩大可用通道。同一 micro-batch 调度下与 experience replay、ER-ACE、unmasked interleaved replay、DER++、离线回放对比，并在 backprop + k-WTA 网络上检验该构造是否依赖局部学习器。
Result: 隐层计算对当前 batch 不变量：静默与抑制单元精确成立，实践中仅 0.3% 样本例外；refractory rule 使通道宽度翻倍。split-MNIST 类增量上匹配或超过最佳离线回放调度，并优于 experience replay、ER-ACE、unmasked interleaved replay（均在同一 micro-batch 调度下重调）；对 DER++ 按协议分裂：每任务 5 epoch 时 DER++ 领先 1.5 点，单遍流式时本系统领先 1.6 点而离线回放落后 15 点。split CIFAR-10 上领先离线回放与 experience replay，但落后 ER-ACE 与 DER++ 两到三点。backprop + k-WTA 网络上 refractory rotation 在 5 epoch 加半点、单遍加三点，隔离在其之上不再额外花费。
Conclusion: 把回放写进当前输入未使用的自由度，可以在不打断当前计算的前提下达到离线回放水平；该构造不依赖局部学习器，但优势随协议与数据集变化（CIFAR-10 上仍落后 ER-ACE 与 DER++）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spruce: Scalable Private Outsourced Retrieval Using Compact Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has made dense retrieval over large document collections a standard building block. Organizations increasingly outsource vector indexes to untrusted clouds, exposing proprietary corpora and user queries. Cryptographic protection is challenging because each query searches corpus-scale state, causing computation, correlated randomness, and communication to grow with the corpus. At million-document scale, a naive secure implementation takes minutes and about 90 GB of communication per query. Even recent optimized systems require 10--22 seconds. We propose Spruce (Scalable Private Outsourced Retrieval Using Compact Embeddings), which co-designs representations with the cryptographic protocol. Spruce learns compact binary codes that preserve candidates for full-precision reranking, replacing corpus-wide embedding scoring with efficient Hamming-distance computation under two-server multi-party computation (MPC). A corpus-calibrated fixed-radius protocol avoids multi-round candidate selection while preserving retrieval quality. Spruce also provides private cluster pruning, which trades minor quality loss for substantially less computation, and a one-core owner-operated dealer that removes cloud OT preprocessing bottlenecks. Across four corpora containing 383K--5.42M documents, Spruce preserves the original search quality with median candidate sets of only 382--1,952. At 10 Gbps inter-server bandwidth, full scans take 0.21--2.97 seconds, $4.8$--$6.7\times$ faster than the closest measured prior work. Private pruning takes 0.06--1.09 seconds, achieves $13.1$--$22.9\times$ speedups, and retains $93.9\%$--$97.3\%$ of full-float NDCG. On the largest corpus, pruning and the dealer jointly improve sustained throughput by $31.5\times$ at 1 Gbps per link.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Spruce 把 RAG 稠密检索的表示与两服务器 MPC 协议联合设计：学紧凑二值码保留候选供全精度重排，用 Hamming 距离替代全语料打分，配合语料校准的固定半径协议与私有聚类剪枝。在 383K–5.42M 文档的四个语料上保持原检索质量，10 Gbps 下全扫描 0.21–2.97 秒、比最近实测工作快 4.8–6.7 倍，剪枝 0.06–1.09 秒、加速 13.1–22.9 倍并保留 93.9%–97.3% 的全精度 NDCG。
Motivation: 组织把向量索引外包给不可信云时，每条查询都要搜索语料规模的状态，使安全检索的计算、相关随机数与通信随语料增长：百万文档规模朴素实现每查询需数分钟、约 90 GB 通信，即便近期优化系统也要 10–22 秒。

papers.title: DramaChain Bench: An End-to-End Benchmark for Short-Drama Generation
papers.abstract_en: Commercial short-drama production follows a multi-stage chain: script, storyboard, keyframe imagery, shot-level video, and the finished short drama. Most existing benchmarks evaluate solely the video-generation stage using pre-authored inputs instead of real upstream pipeline outputs. This leaves two critical questions unanswerable: whether each stage adheres to the original script intent (rather than only its immediate input prompt), and whether disparate shots remain coherent after assembly into multi-episode releases. We present DramaChain Bench, the first short-drama benchmark that evaluates every stage of the complete production chain. It is built upon three in-house systems sharing one dimension system, DramaChain Dimensions: five evaluation axes instantiated at every stage, resolving into 63 leaf dimensions. DramaChain Agent is calibrated against commercial short-drama platforms in both workflow and finished short-drama quality, enabling stage-wise fair comparison across models. DramaChain Labeling System has each of the 5,785 items scored independently by three professional annotators, with all defects spatio-temporally localised and selected from a predefined defect list. This process produces 17,488 valid scores and 255,925 traceable attribution records. The human annotations confirm that upstream defects cascade across the pipeline, demonstrating that final episode quality is not governed by video generation alone. DramaChain Agentic Judge then scores every leaf dimension automatically, gathering evidence over multiple agentic rounds before judging against a per-item checklist; it reproduces the model ranking at a mean PLCC of 0.918, enough to admit new models at no annotation cost.
papers.comment: 50 pages, 19 figures, 19 tables. Technical report. Haoyuan Shi and Mingtao Chen contributed equally. Project lead: Zhichao Hu. Corresponding author: Richeng Xuan
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DramaChain Bench 是首个覆盖短剧完整生产链（剧本、分镜、关键帧、镜头视频、成片）的端到端评测基准，用统一维度体系 DramaChain Dimensions 的 5 个评价轴、63 个叶子维度逐阶段打分。5,785 个条目由 3 名专业标注员独立标注，确认上游缺陷会沿链条级联，最终成片质量并非只由视频生成阶段决定；自动评分器 DramaChain Agentic Judge 复现模型排名的平均 PLCC 达 0.918。
Motivation: 现有基准只评视频生成阶段且用人工预设输入，无法回答各阶段是否忠于原始剧本意图、以及拼接成多集成片后镜头间是否连贯这两个问题。
Method: 三个共用维度体系的自研系统：DramaChain Dimensions 定义 5 个评价轴并展开为 63 个叶子维度；DramaChain Agent 对齐商业短剧平台的工作流与成片质量以支持跨模型逐阶段比较；DramaChain Labeling System 由 3 名专业标注员对 5,785 个条目独立打分，缺陷按预定义缺陷清单做时空定位；DramaChain Agentic Judge 多轮收集证据后按逐条 checklist 自动打分。
Result: 标注产出 17,488 条有效分数与 255,925 条可追溯归因记录；人工标注确认上游缺陷沿生产链级联；DramaChain Agentic Judge 复现模型排名的平均 PLCC 为 0.918，可零标注成本接入新模型。
Conclusion: 短剧质量评测必须覆盖全链条而非只看视频生成阶段，且自动评分器在达到 0.918 的 PLCC 后可替代人工做跨模型排名。

papers.title: SIR: Self-improving Red-teaming for Compute Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are agents powered by vision-language models (VLMs) that perceive a screen and operate an operating system through mouse, keyboard, and terminal interactions to automate everyday digital tasks. Their exposure to untrusted content creates a risk of indirect prompt injection (IPI), where an adversary embeds instructions in content the agent reads to redirect it toward actions that violate the user's intent. Evaluations based on fixed, hand-written injections may underestimate the risk posed by adaptive adversaries. We present SIR, a black-box self-improving IPI framework that (i) composes task-specific injections from a small library of reusable red-teaming principles stated in plain language and (ii) uses an iterative feedback loop to analyze unsuccessful attack trajectories and distill new, named principles that are retained in a shared library and reused across tasks. We target operating-system-level compromise and evaluate outcomes through deterministic checks on filesystem, service, and permission state rather than an LLM judge. An attack counts as successful only when both the adversarial objective and the benign user task are completed in the same execution. We evaluate three frontier CUAs, allowing SIR up to 10 attack attempts per case. It achieves joint attack success rates of 24% on Claude Opus 4.8 and 28% on Gemini 3.5 Flash, compared with 4% and 0%, respectively, for the benchmark's fixed, hand-written injection. The red-teaming principles discovered against one victim also improve attacks against other victims, including a different model family, without additional feedback.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SIR 是针对计算机使用代理 (CUA) 的黑盒自改进间接提示注入 (IPI) 框架：从可复用红队原则库组合任务特定注入，并用迭代反馈环分析失败轨迹、蒸馏出带命名的新原则跨任务复用。在三个前沿 CUA 上、每例至多 10 次攻击尝试，联合攻击成功率在 Claude Opus 4.8 达 24%、Gemini 3.5 Flash 达 28%，而基准自带的手写固定注入分别只有 4% 和 0%。
Motivation: 固定手写注入的评测会低估自适应对手的风险：CUA 读取不可信内容时可被间接提示注入劫持，偏离用户意图。
Method: SIR 由两部分组成：一是从小型自然语言红队原则库组合任务特定注入，二是迭代反馈环分析失败攻击轨迹并蒸馏新的具名原则，存入共享库跨任务复用。成功判定用文件系统、服务与权限状态的确定性检查而非 LLM judge，且要求对抗目标与良性用户任务在同一执行中同时完成。
Result: 在三个前沿 CUA 上、每例至多 10 次攻击尝试，联合攻击成功率：Claude Opus 4.8 为 24%（基准手写固定注入 4%），Gemini 3.5 Flash 为 28%（固定注入 0%）。针对一个受害模型发现的红队原则无需额外反馈即可迁移到其他受害模型，包括不同模型家族。
Conclusion: 自改进的红队原则库能显著抬高对 CUA 的间接提示注入成功率，且原则可跨模型迁移；固定手写注入的评测会系统性低估这一风险。

papers.title: CPR for LLMs: Critical-Point Routing against Catastrophic Forgetting in Domain Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the de facto standard for adapting large language models (LLMs) to target domains, but it often degrades the model's general capabilities, a phenomenon known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing approaches typically modify the SFT loss to mitigate forgetting, but they inevitably operate along a domain-generality trade-off. In this work, we step outside this trade-off by decoupling the two capabilities at the model level: we keep the original base model for general capability, and selectively invoke the SFT expert only when domain-specific knowledge is required. Specifically, we propose CPR (Critical-Point Routing), a token-level routing framework between a base model and its expert derivative, based on critical tokens where the base model fails but the expert succeeds. We train a lightweight hierarchical router that estimates the expert-call probability per token, and pair it with a tailored inference procedure that combines momentum smoothing and threshold gating. Across diverse model-domain configurations, CPR achieves state-of-the-art across all settings, surpassing SFT expert by 1.4-5.5% in domain performance while recovering its general-capability drop from 3.4-14.5% to at most 0.5%, with minimal overhead from invoking the expert on only one-third of tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CPR 在模型层面解耦领域知识与通用能力：保留原始 base model 负责通用能力，只在关键 token（base 出错而 SFT expert 正确）上路由调用专家。轻量分层 router 逐 token 估计专家调用概率，配合动量平滑与阈值门控的推理流程，只在约三分之一 token 上触发专家。在多种模型-领域配置上，领域性能比 SFT expert 高 1.4-5.5%，通用能力下降从 3.4-14.5% 收窄到最多 0.5%。
Motivation: SFT 是 LLM 领域适配的事实标准，但会损害模型通用能力（catastrophic forgetting）；现有方法改 SFT loss，始终受领域-通用权衡约束。
Method: 提出 CPR (Critical-Point Routing)：以 critical token（base model 失败而 expert 成功）为信号，训练轻量分层 router 逐 token 估计 expert-call 概率；推理端结合 momentum smoothing 与 threshold gating 决定是否调用 SFT expert，其余 token 走 base model。
Result: 在多样模型-领域配置上全部设置达到 SOTA：领域性能超 SFT expert 1.4-5.5%，通用能力下降从 3.4-14.5% 恢复到最多 0.5%；专家仅在约三分之一 token 上被调用，开销极小。
Conclusion: 在模型层面按 token 解耦 base 与 expert，可以跳出领域-通用权衡：既抬高领域性能又几乎完全保住通用能力，代价只来自少数 token 的专家调用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Feature-Spectral Fragility in Segmentation: Dataset Dependence, Architecture-Specific Localization, and Spectral Correlates
papers.abstract_en: Robustness of segmentation models is commonly assessed through input-domain perturbations, while dependence on frequency content within learned feature representations remains less understood. We probe this dependence using targeted post-training low-pass interventions on internal representations of three segmentation architectures, ResNet50-UNet (CNN), VM-UNet (SSM), and Swin-UNETR (Transformer), across CVC-ClinicDB and ISIC2018, with headline evaluations performed on untouched held-out test sets. At cutoff $ρ=0.25$, feature-domain low-pass filtering causes severe degradation on CVC: Dice drops by 100%, 73.2%, and 30.9% for CNN, SSM, and Transformer, respectively, compared with 9.4%, 10.3%, and 0.6% on ISIC. The cross-dataset difference is statistically significant for every architecture. Single-stage interventions further show that the most sensitive stage depends on architecture and dataset: the CNN peaks at the 2nd to 3rd encoder block, whereas the SSM peaks at the 1st to 2nd encoder stage. Native feature-domain spectral measurements show an inverse association between high-frequency energy and fragility on CVC; the relationship is only partial on ISIC and is therefore treated as a candidate correlate rather than a proven mechanism. Finally, Fourier augmentation improves robustness to input-space low-pass filtering but leaves feature-domain degradation essentially unchanged. These results show that feature-spectral robustness is strongly dataset-dependent, architecture-specific, and distinct from input-domain spectral robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对三种分割架构的内部特征做训练后低通滤波，发现特征谱脆弱性强烈依赖数据集与架构：ρ=0.25 时 CVC-ClinicDB 上 Dice 下降 100%（ResNet50-UNet）、73.2%（VM-UNet）、30.9%（Swin-UNETR），而 ISIC2018 上仅 9.4%、10.3%、0.6%。最敏感阶段随架构变化（CNN 在第 2–3 个 encoder block，SSM 在第 1–2 个 encoder stage），且 Fourier 增强只改善输入域低通鲁棒性、对特征域退化基本无效。
Motivation: 分割鲁棒性评估多集中在输入域扰动，而学到的特征表示对频率内容的依赖尚不清楚；同一干预在不同数据集上可造成从 0.6% 到 100% 的截然不同的退化，说明现有评估可能掩盖真实的脆弱性。
Method: 对 ResNet50-UNet (CNN)、VM-UNet (SSM)、Swin-UNETR (Transformer) 三种架构在 CVC-ClinicDB 与 ISIC2018 上做训练后针对性的特征域低通干预（截止频率 ρ=0.25），在未触碰的 held-out 测试集上评估；辅以单阶段逐层干预定位最敏感阶段，以及原生特征域频谱测量与 Fourier 增强对照。
Result: ρ=0.25 特征域低通使 CVC 上 Dice 下降 100%、73.2%、30.9%（CNN、SSM、Transformer），ISIC 上仅下降 9.4%、10.3%、0.6%，每个架构的跨数据集差异均统计显著。单阶段干预显示最敏感层随架构与数据集变化：CNN 峰值在第 2–3 个 encoder block，SSM 峰值在第 1–2 个 encoder stage。CVC 上高频能量与脆弱性呈负相关，ISIC 上仅部分成立。Fourier 增强提升输入域低通鲁棒性，但特征域退化基本不变。
Conclusion: 特征谱鲁棒性是数据集依赖、架构特异的，且与输入域频谱鲁棒性是两回事；高频能量与脆弱性的关系在 CVC 上只是候选相关而非已证机制，评估分割鲁棒性需分开测输入域与特征域。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 对三种分割架构的内部特征做训练后低通滤波，发现特征谱脆弱性强烈依赖数据集与架构：ρ=0.25 时 CVC-ClinicDB 上 Dice 下降 100%（ResNet50-UNet）、73.2%（VM-UNet）、30.9%（Swin-UNETR），而 ISIC2018 上仅 9.4%、10.3%、0.6%。最敏感阶段随架构变化（CNN 在第 2–3 个 encoder block，SSM 在第 1–2 个 encoder stage），且 Fourier 增强只改善输入域低通鲁棒性、对特征域退化基本无效。
summary_sections.motivation: 分割鲁棒性评估多集中在输入域扰动，而学到的特征表示对频率内容的依赖尚不清楚；同一干预在不同数据集上可造成从 0.6% 到 100% 的截然不同的退化，说明现有评估可能掩盖真实的脆弱性。
summary_sections.method: 对 ResNet50-UNet (CNN)、VM-UNet (SSM)、Swin-UNETR (Transformer) 三种架构在 CVC-ClinicDB 与 ISIC2018 上做训练后针对性的特征域低通干预（截止频率 ρ=0.25），在未触碰的 held-out 测试集上评估；辅以单阶段逐层干预定位最敏感阶段，以及原生特征域频谱测量与 Fourier 增强对照。
summary_sections.result: ρ=0.25 特征域低通使 CVC 上 Dice 下降 100%、73.2%、30.9%（CNN、SSM、Transformer），ISIC 上仅下降 9.4%、10.3%、0.6%，每个架构的跨数据集差异均统计显著。单阶段干预显示最敏感层随架构与数据集变化：CNN 峰值在第 2–3 个 encoder block，SSM 峰值在第 1–2 个 encoder stage。CVC 上高频能量与脆弱性呈负相关，ISIC 上仅部分成立。Fourier 增强提升输入域低通鲁棒性，但特征域退化基本不变。
summary_sections.conclusion: 特征谱鲁棒性是数据集依赖、架构特异的，且与输入域频谱鲁棒性是两回事；高频能量与脆弱性的关系在 CVC 上只是候选相关而非已证机制，评估分割鲁棒性需分开测输入域与特征域。

papers.title: The Hallucination Signal Is a Mean Shift: Why Simple Probes Suffice
papers.abstract_en: Hidden-state probes effectively detect LLM hallucinations, but the geometry of the signal remains poorly characterized, driving increasingly complex probe architectures. Across three 7B-scale models and three datasets in a paired-example paradigm, we find the signal overwhelmingly dominated by a single mean-shift component, and removing this direction collapses detection to chance. Shrinkage linear discriminant analysis closes about 73% of the gap between 1D and full-dimensional classifiers, so apparent architectural complexity largely reflects high-dimensional covariance estimation difficulty rather than exploitable non-linearity. A simple L2-regularized logistic regression (0.952 AUROC) bounds or outperforms twelve controlled architectural alternatives, and our multi-layer aggregation exceeds CLAP cross-layer attention probing under matched paradigm. Because the signal spans a contiguous layer band, LayerMix aggregates it to match oracle-layer performance without oracle access. Our claims characterize the geometry within the controlled paired-example paradigm. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/LayerMix.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 20 tables. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Code: https://github.com/js-lee-AI/LayerMix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在三 7B 模型与三数据集的配对样本范式下，LLM 幻觉的隐状态探针信号几乎全由单一均值偏移 (mean-shift) 方向主导，删掉该方向后检测退化到随机水平。收缩 LDA 补上 1D 与全维分类器约 73% 的差距，说明复杂探针架构主要在补偿高维协方差估计难度而非利用非线性；L2 正则 logistic 回归达 0.952 AUROC，已封顶或超过十二种受控架构替代方案。
Motivation: 隐状态探针检测幻觉有效，但信号几何不清楚，导致探针架构越做越复杂，缺少对复杂度是否真正必要的判定。
Method: 在三个 7B 规模模型与三个数据集上采用配对样本范式 (paired-example paradigm)，用收缩 LDA 分解信号维度结构，比较 1D、全维与十二种受控架构探针；提出 LayerMix 跨层聚合，覆盖信号所在的连续层带。
Result: 移除均值偏移方向后检测降至随机水平；收缩 LDA 弥合 1D 与全维分类器约 73% 的差距；L2 正则 logistic 回归 0.952 AUROC，封顶或优于十二种受控架构替代方案；多层聚合在匹配范式下超过 CLAP cross-layer attention probing，并在无 oracle 访问下达到 oracle-layer 性能。
Conclusion: 幻觉探针信号的几何本质是单一均值偏移，探针复杂度主要反映高维协方差估计困难；结论限定在受控配对样本范式内。

papers.title: Pointing the Way, Hiding the Destination: Practical Private Dense Retrieval at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Hosted retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search allow users to query valuable provider-held corpora, raising two competing demands: to hide each query and chosen result, yet reveal only the documents that the user is authorized to receive. Existing cryptographic approaches either make this costly by processing the entire corpus for every query, or sacrifice quality for efficiency by scanning a few clusters. We repurpose learned deep hashing as a private filter: a randomized binary code points the provider to a short candidate list, while encrypted reranking and oblivious key transfer protect the precise query and final selection. This shortlist short-circuits full-corpus cryptographic search without sacrificing retrieval quality: with 200-500 candidates, it closely matches full-corpus retrieval across five zero-shot corpora spanning 25K to 5.4M documents. On the full 2.68M-passage NQ corpus over a 10-Gbps link, our protocol only adds 0.73 seconds, or 10 percent, to a 128-token Qwen3-32B RAG pipeline. The released code satisfies directional metric differential privacy (DP) and substantially reduces embedding-inversion and property-inference leakage, demonstrating that a carefully learned shortlist can make private dense retrieval both accurate and practical.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把学习式深度哈希改造成私密检索过滤器：随机二进制码只给服务端一个 200–500 条的候选短名单，精确查询与最终选择由加密重排和不经意密钥转移 (oblivious key transfer) 保护，从而避开逐查询全语料加密搜索。在 25K 到 5.4M 文档的五个零样本语料上，短名单检索质量接近全语料检索；2.68M 段落的 NQ 语料、10-Gbps 链路下，128-token Qwen3-32B RAG 管线只多花 0.73 秒（10%）。
Motivation: 托管 RAG 与语义搜索要求同时隐藏查询与所选结果、又只暴露用户有权读取的文档；现有密码学方案要么每查询处理全语料代价高，要么只扫少数簇牺牲检索质量。
Method: 将学习式深度哈希 (learned deep hashing) 重用为私密过滤器：随机二进制码把服务端指向短候选列表，再用加密重排与不经意密钥转移保护精确查询和最终选择；发布代码满足方向性度量差分隐私 (directional metric DP)，并压低 embedding-inversion 与 property-inference 泄漏。
Result: 200–500 个候选即可在五个零样本语料（25K–5.4M 文档）上接近全语料检索质量；在 2.68M 段落 NQ 语料、10-Gbps 链路上，协议给 128-token Qwen3-32B RAG 管线只增加 0.73 秒，即 10%；发布代码满足 directional metric DP，并大幅降低 embedding-inversion 与 property-inference 泄漏。
Conclusion: 精心学习的短名单可以让私密稠密检索同时做到准确与实用，短路全语料密码学搜索而不牺牲检索质量。

papers.title: Does Fine-Tuning Undo Activation Steering? Behavioural Recovery Without Weight-Edit Reversal
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering can be embedded directly into a language model's weights, shaping behaviour without inference-time intervention and offering a way to encode alignment prior to release. However, models are routinely fine-tuned after deployment, and it is unknown whether embedded interventions survive this. We study the stability of embedded steering for refusal ablation and brevity amplification across five instruction-tuned models (3B-14B) under non-adversarial SFT and RLHF. We find that steering degrades more under stronger optimisation pressure against the steered behaviour, which depends on both the training data and the training algorithm. Refusal ablation loses 69% of its effect on average under our SFT setup, but only 2% under our RLHF setup. The weight-edit, by contrast, remains almost unchanged (on average only 0.4% of it is restored), and the fine-tuning update along the steering direction is close to orthogonal to the pre-edit weight pattern (mean cosine similarity 0.071). Fine-tuning that restores the behaviour does so without reversing the edit. As the steered behaviour is not fully durable, embedded steering should be re-validated after downstream training.
papers.comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Main. Earlier version at ICLR 2026 Re^4-Align Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把激活引导 (activation steering) 直接写进权重后，非对抗性微调会让行为效果大幅回退：五个指令微调模型 (3B–14B) 上，SFT 使 refusal ablation 平均丢失 69% 的效果，RLHF 下仅丢 2%，而权重编辑本身几乎未被逆转（平均仅恢复 0.4%），微调更新与编辑方向的余弦相似度只有 0.071。结论是嵌入式引导在下游训练后必须重新验证。
Motivation: 激活引导可被固化进模型权重、在发布前编码对齐先验，但部署后的常规微调是否会抹掉这种干预尚不清楚，这关系到发布前对齐能否在下游训练后继续成立。
Method: 在五个指令微调模型 (3B–14B) 上，针对 refusal ablation 与 brevity amplification 两种嵌入式引导，施加非对抗性 SFT 与 RLHF 微调，分别度量行为效果的衰减、权重编辑的保留程度，以及微调更新方向与编辑方向的余弦相似度。
Result: Refusal ablation 在 SFT 设置下平均丢失 69% 的效果，RLHF 设置下仅丢失 2%；权重编辑平均仅被恢复 0.4%；微调更新沿引导方向与编辑前权重模式接近正交，平均余弦相似度 0.071。引导退化程度随针对被引导行为的优化压力增强而加大，且取决于训练数据与训练算法。
Conclusion: 微调可以恢复被引导的行为而不逆转权重编辑，因此嵌入式引导的效果并不完全持久，下游训练之后应重新验证 (re-validated)。

papers.title: An RKHS Framework for Fixed Effects in Permanental Process Models
papers.abstract_en: This short work describes an extension of the permanental process model which includes fixed effects. By starting with a prior on the fixed effects coefficients we show that, in the diffuse prior limit, the intensity function of the permanental process can be found using the representer theorem and naturally decomposed into a fixed effects term and a function which is an element of a Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS). We show that the limiting equivalent kernel defines an RKHS whose squared norm is exactly the limiting penalty. This allows for straightforward scientific interpretation of permanental process models and the easy incorporation of domain knowledge into the estimation process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给 permanental process 模型加入固定效应：对固定效应系数取先验，在 diffuse prior 极限下，强度函数由 representer theorem 给出，并自然分解为固定效应项与一个属于 RKHS 的函数项；极限等价核定义的 RKHS 其平方范数恰为极限惩罚项。该分解使模型可直接做科学解释并便于嵌入领域知识。
Motivation: permanental process 原本难以纳入固定效应这类结构化协变量，导致强度函数的科学解释与领域知识注入都不直接。
Method: 从固定效应系数上的先验出发，取 diffuse prior 极限，用 representer theorem 求强度函数，将其分解为固定效应项与 RKHS 元素；再证明极限等价核定义的 RKHS 其平方范数等于极限惩罚项。
Result: 这是一篇短理论工作：证明 diffuse prior 极限下强度函数可分解为固定效应项加 RKHS 函数，且极限等价核对应 RKHS 的平方范数恰为极限惩罚。
Conclusion: 固定效应与 RKHS 项的分解让 permanental process 模型获得直接的科学解释，并使领域知识可以方便地进入估计过程。

papers.title: Evaluation Resolution Confounds Learning-Rule Comparisons in Model-Brain RSA of Early Visual Cortex
papers.abstract_en: Studies of biologically plausible learning rules (feedback alignment, predictive coding, STDP) train small networks on $32\times32$ images and compare them with brain responses to naturalistic stimuli presented at much higher resolution. We find that a common result in this setting, that untrained or locally trained networks rival or beat backpropagation at early visual cortex, depends on the resolution at which networks are evaluated. In representational similarity analysis (RSA) against human V1, the gap between an untrained and a backprop-trained network grows monotonically from $-0.001$ (95% CI $[-0.011, 0.009]$) at the 32 px training resolution to $+0.030$ $[0.018, 0.042]$ at 224 px (six resolutions, 5 seeds; per-subject RSA on cross-run stimulus pairs). The growth reproduces for three further learning rules, directionally in single-seed macaque electrophysiology, along training, and for an ImageNet ResNet-50 and a Swin-Tiny transformer, which also align best at low resolution although trained at 224 px. Gabor and pixel structure, the normalization state of the untrained baseline, and a global brightness statistic do not account for it. Against a criterion fixed before the analysis, limiting image content to 32 px while the input still grows does not shrink the V1 gap ($+0.035$ $[0.023, 0.046]$ vs. $+0.030$ at 224 px; ratio 1.14 $[1.03, 1.34]$): it arises once the input exceeds the training resolution, through a decline of backprop. A single luminance value per image reaches $ρ= 0.054$ against V1, matching the untrained network (0.053), which bounds what RSA on globally pooled features can resolve at V1 in this dataset. The one learning effect that holds across resolution is backprop above untrained at LOC. Comparisons of learning rules or architectures at early visual cortex need to control, and report, the evaluation resolution.
papers.comment: v3: RSA per subject on cross-run stimulus pairs; V1 gap +0.044 -> +0.030 [0.018, 0.042], still ~0 at 32 px. Leave-one-subject-out lower bound replaces the withdrawn noise ceiling. TL;DR: 在模型-大脑 RSA 比较中，未训练网络与反向传播网络在人类 V1 上的差距随评估分辨率单调扩大：32 px 训练分辨率处为 -0.001（95% CI [-0.011, 0.009]），224 px 处升到 +0.030 [0.018, 0.042]。把图像内容限制在 32 px 而输入继续增大，差距不缩小（+0.035 [0.023, 0.046]，比值 1.14 [1.03, 1.34]），说明差距源于输入超过训练分辨率后 backprop 表现下滑，而非 32 px 以上的细节。作者主张早期视觉皮层的学习规则与架构比较必须控制并报告评估分辨率。
Motivation: 生物可塑学习规则（feedback alignment、predictive coding、STDP）研究用 32×32 图像训练小网络，却拿自然场景高分辨率刺激与脑反应比较，导致“未训练或局部训练网络在早期视觉皮层匹敌甚至超过 backprop”这一常见结论可能由评估分辨率而非学习规则本身造成。
Method: 对六个评估分辨率（32 px 到 224 px）、5 个随机种子做 representational similarity analysis (RSA)，按被试在 cross-run stimulus pairs 上计算与人类 V1 的表征相似度；用 leave-one-subject-out 下界替代被撤回的 noise ceiling。对照三种进一步学习规则、单种子猕猴电生理、训练过程，以及 ImageNet 上训练的 ResNet-50 与 Swin-Tiny；并检验 Gabor/pixel 结构、未训练基线归一化状态、全局亮度统计等替代解释，按预先固定的判据做 32 px 内容限制实验。
Result: V1 上未训练 vs backprop 的 RSA 差距从 32 px 的 -0.001 [95% CI -0.011, 0.009] 单调增至 224 px 的 +0.030 [0.018, 0.042]（六个分辨率、5 种子、按被试 cross-run 配对）；该增长在另外三种学习规则、猕猴电生理（方向性）、训练过程以及 ResNet-50 与 Swin-Tiny 上复现，后两者虽在 224 px 训练却也在低分辨率对齐最好。内容限制到 32 px 时差距为 +0.035 [0.023, 0.046]，与 224 px 的 +0.030 之比 1.14 [1.03, 1.34]，即不随内容限制而缩小。Gabor/pixel 结构、未训练基线归一化状态、全局亮度均不能解释该效应；单个亮度值对 V1 达 ρ=0.054，与未训练网络 0.053 相当。跨分辨率唯一稳健的学习效应是 LOC 上 backprop 高于未训练网络。arXiv comment 另记 v3 中 V1 差距由 +0.044 调整为 +0.030 [0.018, 0.042]，32 px 处仍约为 0。
Conclusion: 早期视觉皮层上“未训练/局部训练匹敌 backprop”的结论是评估分辨率的产物：差距在输入超过训练分辨率后由 backprop 一侧下滑产生，因此学习规则与架构的模型-脑 RSA 比较必须控制并报告评估分辨率；跨分辨率唯一成立的学习效应是 LOC 上 backprop 优于未训练网络。
