papers.title: Site Is Decodable Before Pretraining: Negative Controls for Probing Frozen Brain-MRI Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Brain foundation models are often tested with a probe. The model is frozen, a simple classifier is trained on its output, and the classifier's accuracy is taken as a sign of what pretraining learned. We show that this reading can be wrong unless two controls are reported with it. We probed three frozen 3-D brain-MRI models at five depths, on two independent multi-site cohorts (ABIDE-I and ABIDE-II). The site where a scan was acquired could be predicted at about 0.9, on a scale where 0 is chance and 1 is perfect. No clinical or demographic target came close. An untrained copy of the same model predicted site just as well on both cohorts. Untrained models of three architectures, each built with three random seeds, did the same on ABIDE-I. The raw image, shrunk to 12x12x12 voxels and given to no model at all, predicted site at 0.95. Pretraining did not create the site signal. It was already in the scans. We also looked for any clinical target on which pretraining beats an untrained model, and found no reliable case. Adjusting for age, sex and diagnosis left site prediction almost unchanged, and so did a 4.6-fold increase in the number of voxels. Resting-state fMRI from the same people showed the same pattern. Site was the most predictable attribute of brain connectivity (0.81), and it survived five untrained layers while age did not. We recommend reporting two controls with every probe of a brain foundation model: running the probe again on the untrained model, and on the raw input. We release the code for both.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. v2: adds resting-state fMRI, reports each clinical target separately, corrects single-split results, rewritten for clarity. Code: https://github.com/saman-rahbar/scanner-fingerprints
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对冻结脑 MRI 基础模型的线性探针会把扫描站点 (site) 误读成预训练学到的表征：在 ABIDE-I/II 两个多中心队列上，站点可解码度约 0.9，而临床与人口学目标无一接近；未训练的同架构模型、三个随机种子的未训练模型，以及 12x12x12 体素的原始图像（完全不经过模型）都达到 0.95。作者据此要求每次探针必须同时报告“未训练模型”和“原始输入”两个负对照。
Motivation: 用冻结模型 + 简单分类器的探针精度来推断预训练学到了什么，这一通行做法可能把数据采集站点等捷径信号误当成语义表征，脑基础模型评测因此缺乏可信归因。
Method: 在三个冻结的 3-D brain-MRI 模型、五个深度上做线性探针，数据为两个独立多中心队列 ABIDE-I 与 ABIDE-II；负对照包括未训练的同模型副本、三种架构各三个随机种子的未训练模型，以及降采样到 12x12x12 体素的原始图像；另对年龄、性别、诊断做协变量调整，并加入静息态 fMRI 探针与体素数 4.6 倍增加的设置。
Result: 站点预测约 0.9（0 为随机、1 为完美），无任何临床或人口学目标接近该水平；未训练副本在两个队列上站点预测同样好，三种架构 × 三个随机种子的未训练模型在 ABIDE-I 上复现；原始 12x12x12 图像不经模型即达 0.95。调整年龄、性别、诊断后站点预测几乎不变，体素数增加 4.6 倍同样几乎不变。静息态 fMRI 中站点是脑连接最可预测的属性（0.81），在五个未训练层中存活而年龄不能。未找到任何预训练稳定优于未训练模型的临床目标。
Conclusion: 站点信号本就存在于扫描数据中而非预训练产生，因此脑基础模型的探针结论必须附带未训练模型与原始输入两个负对照；作者已开源这两个对照的代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CLEARMIND: Closed-Form Laplacian Embeddings of Arakelov-Green Resistance for Morphological Intrinsic Neuronal Distances
papers.abstract_en: Tropical geometry turns a metric graph into a flat torus, its tropical Jacobian, and measures distances between the images of its points by a closest vector problem on the period lattice. We prove that for points of the graph this problem is solved by geodesics: the squared tropical polarization distance equals the path metric minus the Arakelov-Green (AG) distance, an effective-resistance kernel given in closed form by the Laplacian pseudoinverse. Equivalently, the AG distance and the path metric are the minimal energies of real and of integral unit flows, and the squared tropical distance is exactly their integrality gap. The full tropical distance matrix is thus computable in cubic time. On this identity we build CLEARMIND, a training-free descriptor of 3D neuronal morphology. A reconstruction is reduced to its branching skeleton, neurite tips near the soma are joined to it, short bridges are contracted, and the AG matrix of the result is summarized by its spectrum. Every step has an exact algebraic description; for instance, the period matrix records the shared soma-to-tip path lengths, and the spectrum has exactly one positive eigenvalue, so its absolute values determine it. The signature needs no lattice search, is invariant to vertex order, rigid motions and subdivision, and is Lipschitz in the edge lengths. On ACT-4, JML-4 and BIL-6, appending the 64-dimensional spectrum improves a point-cloud GNN and MorphVAE on every dataset, by up to 20.3 points; a Tree-LSTM with the spectrum outperforms every reimplemented baseline; and an MLP on the spectrum alone is a competitive classifier that surpasses every reimplemented deep baseline on ACT-4. On BREC, a GIN with AG eigenvector encodings distinguishes 70.0% of the pairs beyond the 1-WL limit, including 33% of the CFI pairs, more than PPGN (23%) and I$^2$-GNN (21%), and the spectrum alone separates 217 of 400 pairs without training.
papers.comment: 48 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. v2: new title; adds an exact identity between the tropical polarization distance and the Arakelov-Green distance with a complete proof chain; method, experiments and appendix revised
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLEARMIND 是一个免训练的 3D 神经元形态描述子：先证明热带几何中的 tropical polarization distance 与 Arakelov-Green (AG) 有效电阻距离满足精确恒等式（平方热带距离 = 路径度量 − AG 距离，即实流与整流的可积性间隙），再把重建骨架化后用 AG 矩阵的谱作签名。在 ACT-4、JML-4、BIL-6 上追加 64 维谱使 point-cloud GNN 与 MorphVAE 每个数据集都提升、最高 20.3 分；BREC 上 GIN 加 AG 特征向量编码超越 1-WL 极限区分 70.0% 的点对。
Motivation: 热带几何把度量图上的距离化为周期格上的最近向量问题，通常需要格搜索；神经元形态重建的描述子又常依赖点云深度模型，缺少代数精确、置换与刚体不变的表示。
Method: 先证明平方 tropical polarization distance 等于路径度量减 AG 距离（AG 距离由 Laplacian 伪逆闭式给出），等价地 AG 距离与路径度量分别是实单位流与整单位流的最小能量，平方热带距离恰为二者可积性间隙，从而全距离矩阵可三次时间算出。CLEARMIND 据此把 3D 重建约化为分支骨架，靠近胞体的神经突尖端接入、短桥收缩，再用结果 AG 矩阵的谱作签名（周期矩阵记录共享的 soma-to-tip 路径长度，谱恰有一个正特征值）。
Result: 在 ACT-4、JML-4、BIL-6 上追加 64 维谱使 point-cloud GNN 与 MorphVAE 在每个数据集上都提升，最高 20.3 分；带谱的 Tree-LSTM 超过全部重实现基线，仅用谱的 MLP 在 ACT-4 上超过全部重实现深度基线。BREC 上带 AG 特征向量编码的 GIN 区分 70.0% 的点对（超出 1-WL 极限），含 33% 的 CFI 点对，高于 PPGN 的 23% 与 I²-GNN 的 21%；仅用谱无训练即可分开 400 对中的 217 对。
Conclusion: 热带距离与 Arakelov-Green 距离的可积性间隙恒等式使格搜索可完全绕开，AG 谱因此成为代数精确、对顶点序/刚体运动/细分不变且对边长 Lipschitz 的免训练形态签名，可直接增强现有形态分类模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Training nGPT
papers.abstract_en: The normalized Transformer (nGPT) realizes hyperspherical representation learning by constraining model parameter vectors and activation vectors to the unit hypersphere. In this paper, we describe a practical training recipe for nGPT and evaluate it on modern hybrid Mamba-2--Transformer Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. The recipe introduces Logit Gradient Preconditioning, Logarithmic Learning Rate Decay, GatedAdamW, angular update control, and optional exploration mechanisms. Compared with an unnormalized model of the same hybrid MoE architecture trained with AdamW, the 30B-total-parameter nGPT model reaches the same validation loss using approximately half as many training tokens. The recipe scales across the models considered, which contain up to 30B total parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为 normalized Transformer (nGPT) 给出可落地的训练配方，并在混合 Mamba-2–Transformer MoE 上验证：30B 总参数的 nGPT 达到与同架构、用 AdamW 训练的未归一化模型相同的验证损失，只需约一半训练 token。配方含 Logit Gradient Preconditioning、Logarithmic Learning Rate Decay、GatedAdamW、angular update control 与可选探索机制，且在所考察的至多 30B 参数模型上可扩展。
Motivation: nGPT 把参数与激活向量约束在单位超球面上，但缺少一套在现代混合 Mamba-2–Transformer MoE 架构上实用、可扩展的训练方法。
Method: 训练配方引入 Logit Gradient Preconditioning、Logarithmic Learning Rate Decay、GatedAdamW、angular update control 以及可选的 exploration 机制；在混合 Mamba-2–Transformer MoE 模型上训练 nGPT，并与同架构、用 AdamW 训练的未归一化模型对照，考察规模至 30B 总参数。

papers.title: GraRe: Grasp Candidate Re-Ranking for Frozen 6-DoF Grasp Detectors
papers.abstract_en: Existing 6-DoF grasp detectors typically rank grasp candidates by detector confidence. However, our analysis on GraspNet-1Billion shows that detector confidence is often poorly aligned with grasp quality, leaving successful grasp candidates at low ranks. Motivated by this observation, we study whether learned re-ranking can improve candidate ordering while keeping detector parameters and grasp candidates unchanged. We propose GraRe, which estimates grasp quality from candidate attributes, shell-stratified local geometry, and object context. Candidate attributes condition the local geometric and object-context representations, and a Transformer fuses all three feature types. The predicted quality is combined with detector confidence to produce the final ranking. Experiments on GraspNet-1Billion with five frozen detectors show consistent improvements, with gains of up to 13.56 points in Average AP. Real-robot experiments further demonstrate robust grasping in cluttered scenes. These results show that improving candidate ranking provides a practical way to enhance frozen 6-DoF grasp detectors. Project code is available at https://minakanmi-yuki.github.io/grare/.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 34 figures. Supplementary material is included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraRe 在不改动冻结 6-DoF 抓取检测器参数与候选集的前提下，用候选属性、壳层分层局部几何 (shell-stratified local geometry) 与物体上下文三类特征经 Transformer 融合预测抓取质量，再与检测器置信度合成重排序。在 GraspNet-1Billion 上对五个冻结检测器一致提升，Average AP 最多提高 13.56 点，真机在杂乱场景中抓取稳健。
Motivation: 6-DoF 抓取检测器按置信度排序候选，但 GraspNet-1Billion 上的分析显示置信度与真实抓取质量常不对齐，成功候选被排到低名次。
Method: GraRe 从候选属性、壳层分层局部几何和物体上下文估计抓取质量；候选属性对几何与上下文表示做条件化，Transformer 融合三类特征，预测质量与检测器置信度结合作为最终排序，检测器保持冻结。
Result: 在 GraspNet-1Billion 上用五个冻结检测器实验，排序一致改善，Average AP 最多提升 13.56 点；真机实验在杂乱场景中展示稳健抓取。
Conclusion: 改进候选排序即可在不重训检测器的条件下提升冻结 6-DoF 抓取检测器的实际表现。

papers.title: Rethinking the Effectiveness of Contrastive Decoding in Mitigating Hallucinations in MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models frequently describe objects that are not present in an image. Contrastive decoding has become a widely used inference-time remedy, and it is assumed to work by contrasting a normal forward pass against a hallucination-prone one so that hallucinated content is suppressed. However, whether the reported benchmark improvements actually arise from this mechanism has not been examined. Our key observation is that a correction which suppresses hallucination must depend on whether the model is hallucinating, and that this dependence can be measured directly inside the model. Following this idea, we analyse the internal computation of three contrastive decoding methods on both discriminative and generative tasks, and compare each against controls that remove the contrastive term while preserving its effect on the output. The correction turns out to be unrelated to hallucination at every layer, the gains in captioning come instead from a constraint that narrows sampling towards greedy decoding, and an unstructured perturbation of the same magnitude performs at least as well. Experiments across three models and standard hallucination benchmarks show that these improvements reflect a change in decoding behaviour rather than genuine hallucination mitigation.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables, NeurIPS VLM4RWD 2026. Substantial revisions to the paper, including the removal of the reproduction component and significant updates to the methodology, experiments, and analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 的对比解码 (contrastive decoding) 做机制检验：若其真的抑制幻觉，校正项必须依赖于模型是否在幻觉，且该依赖可在模型内部直接测量。结果显示校正与幻觉在每一层都无关，captioning 上的增益实际来自把采样收窄向贪心解码的约束，同等幅度的非结构化扰动至少同样有效。
Motivation: 对比解码被广泛当作推理期缓解幻觉的手段，其“对照正常前向与易幻觉前向”的机制解释被默认成立，但基准上的提升是否真由此机制产生此前未被检验。
Method: 分析三种对比解码方法在判别式与生成式任务上的内部计算，并与“去掉对比项但保持其对输出影响”的对照比较；检验校正对幻觉的依赖是否在各层可测。实验跨三个模型和标准幻觉基准。
Result: 校正与幻觉在每一层都无关；captioning 的增益来自把采样收窄向贪心解码的约束；同等幅度的非结构化扰动表现至少同样好。跨三个模型与标准幻觉基准的实验表明这些提升反映解码行为改变，而非真正的幻觉缓解。
Conclusion: 对比解码在这些基准上的提升应归因于解码行为的收窄，而非其宣称的幻觉抑制机制。

papers.title: Towards Trustworthy Physical Intelligence: From Theory to Practice Across Life Cycle
papers.abstract_en: Physical intelligence refers to intelligence systems that understand, reason about, and act in accordance with the physical world and its underlying laws, dynamics, and constraints. Unlike conventional AI systems, physical intelligence interacts continuously with uncertain physical environments, and its actions produce consequences that are physically irreversible. As existing trustworthy AI frameworks have been developed primarily for digital AI systems, they do not fully capture the distinctive challenges of Physical Intelligence, such as physical safety, cyber-physical security, and physical manufacturing process. To address this gap, we present a survey of trustworthy physical intelligence principles. First, we characterize the core capabilities and challenges of physical intelligence. Second, we examine the role of physics in AI. Third, we trace the end-to-end physical intelligence life cycle across five core stages and introduce Trustworthy Physical Intelligence Operationalization (T-PAIO). Fourth, we develop the Trustworthy Physical Intelligence (T-PAI) framework, a theoretical framework that organizes key trustworthiness principles and provides a foundation for governing trustworthy physical intelligence systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于可信物理智能 (trustworthy physical intelligence) 的综述：指出现有可信 AI 框架面向数字系统，无法覆盖物理安全、信息物理安全与物理制造过程等物理智能特有风险，因而提出 T-PAIO 与 T-PAI 两层方案——前者把物理智能生命周期的五个核心阶段操作化，后者作为组织各项可信原则的理论框架。
Motivation: 现有可信 AI 框架主要为数字 AI 系统设计，无法刻画物理智能持续与不确定物理环境交互、且动作产生物理上不可逆后果所带来的独特挑战。
Method: 综述分四步：刻画物理智能的核心能力与挑战，考察 physics 在 AI 中的作用，沿五个核心阶段梳理端到端生命周期并引入 Trustworthy Physical Intelligence Operationalization (T-PAIO)，最后构建组织各项可信原则的 Trustworthy Physical Intelligence (T-PAI) 理论框架。
Result: 产出为两项框架性成果：面向物理智能生命周期五个核心阶段的 T-PAIO 操作化路径，以及作为治理基础的 T-PAI 理论框架；摘要未给出实验指标或数值对比。
Conclusion: 可信物理智能需要独立于数字 AI 的框架，把物理安全、信息物理安全与不可逆后果纳入生命周期治理，T-PAI 为这类系统的治理提供理论基础。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Deconstructing Off-Policy Ratios: Entropy-Normalized Trust Regions for Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) accelerates large language model (LLM) post-training by overlapping rollout generation with policy optimization, but the resulting stale, off-policy data destabilizes optimization and can cause policy collapse. Existing methods gate tokens by ratio magnitude alone, applying one threshold at every position. We show that the ratio's natural scale is set by token entropy, so deviations from mid-trajectory weight updates stay within this scale and carry genuine exploration. We further identify an overlooked low-entropy regime that breaks this scaling, where a near-zero probability amplifies train--inference mismatch into noise far beyond what the local entropy admits. A magnitude threshold admits this noise and discards the exploration. We therefore propose the Entropy-Normalized Trust Region (ENTR). Across long-horizon agentic tasks and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, ENTR outperforms existing asynchronous methods. It improves avg@1 on BrowseComp-Plus by $6.9\%$ over the strongest baseline, trains stably up to $30$ policy versions of staleness, and matches synchronous GRPO at a $2.6\times$ speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 异步 RL 中过期 off-policy 数据会让按 ratio 幅值统一设阈值的门控失效：低熵区近零概率把 train–inference 失配放大成远超局部熵所能容纳的噪声，幅值阈值既放行噪声又丢掉真正探索。提出熵归一化信任域 (ENTR)，按 token 熵缩放 ratio 的自然尺度来门控。在长程 agentic 任务与数学推理上 avg@1 于 BrowseComp-Plus 比最强基线高 6.9%，可稳定训练到 30 个 policy 版本的 staleness，并以 2.6× 加速追平同步 GRPO。
Motivation: 异步 RL 把 rollout 生成与策略优化重叠以加速 LLM 后训练，但产生的过期 off-policy 数据使优化不稳甚至导致 policy collapse；现有方法只按 ratio 幅值、用单一阈值门控所有位置，无法区分噪声与探索。
Method: ENTR (Entropy-Normalized Trust Region)：论证 ratio 的自然尺度由 token 熵决定，据此按熵归一化 mid-trajectory 权重更新带来的 ratio 偏移；对破坏该缩放的低熵区（近零概率放大 train–inference 失配）单独处理，替代统一的幅值阈值门控。
Result: 在长程 agentic 任务与数学推理基准上，ENTR 的 avg@1 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上比最强基线提升 6.9%；可稳定训练至 30 个 policy 版本的 staleness；相对同步 GRPO 达到 2.6× 加速且性能持平。
Conclusion: 按 token 熵而非统一幅值阈值划定 off-policy ratio 的信任域，可在容忍高 staleness 的同时保住探索，使异步 RL 免于 policy collapse 并追平同步训练。

papers.title: SLPO: Scaling Latent Reasoning via a Surrogate Policy
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become the predominant recipe for eliciting test-time scaling in explicit Chain-of-Thought reasoners. Yet this scaling path remains computationally costly, since intermediate reasoning must be externalized as natural-language tokens. Latent reasoning instead carries intermediate computation as continuous vectors and already matches or surpasses explicit CoT at far shorter horizons. Despite this promise, latent reasoners remain largely imitation-bound, while explicit CoT has already moved past imitation via outcome-reward RL. Latent trajectories lack a tractable per-step likelihood and an adaptive stopping interface under fixed thinking budgets, so outcome rewards cannot elicit latent test-time scaling. We introduce Surrogate Latent Policy Optimization (SLPO) to bring outcome-reward RL to autoregressive latent reasoners: a differentiable surrogate policy interface over latent transitions for trajectory-level credit assignment, and a correctness-supervised stopping head that outcome-reward optimization refines into a variable-horizon policy. Across two continuous latent reasoners, two backbones, and three held-out benchmarks, SLPO improves Pass@8 and Pass@16 in all 12 backbone--dataset settings, with gains of up to 12.07 percentage points. SLPO further transfers to soft-token inference and learns difficulty-adaptive computation, allocating longer latent trajectories to harder instances. Project Page: https://modalitydance.github.io/SLPO/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SLPO 把带可验证奖励的强化学习从显式 CoT 搬到自回归隐式推理器：用可微的隐状态转移代理策略接口做轨迹级信用分配，再用正确性监督的停止头在固定思考预算下学出变时长策略。在两个连续隐式推理器、两个 backbone、三个 held-out benchmark 的全部 12 个 backbone–dataset 组合上 Pass@8 与 Pass@16 均提升，最大增益 12.07 个百分点，并迁移到 soft-token 推理、对更难样本分配更长隐轨迹。
Motivation: 隐式推理 (latent reasoning) 把中间计算留在连续向量里，比显式 CoT 短得多就能对齐甚至超过，但仍被模仿学习绑死：隐轨迹没有可解的逐步似然，也没有固定思考预算下的自适应停止接口，导致 outcome reward 无法驱动隐式推理的 test-time scaling。
Method: 提出 Surrogate Latent Policy Optimization (SLPO)：一是覆盖隐状态转移的可微代理策略接口，用于轨迹级 credit assignment；二是正确性监督的 stopping head，由 outcome-reward 优化精炼成 variable-horizon policy。训练对象是自回归隐式推理器，奖励为可验证的答题正确性。
Result: 在两个连续隐式推理器 × 两个 backbone × 三个 held-out benchmark 的 12 个 backbone–dataset 设置中，Pass@8 与 Pass@16 全部提升，最大增益 12.07 个百分点；方法进一步迁移到 soft-token 推理，并学到难度自适应计算，对更难实例分配更长的隐轨迹。
Conclusion: outcome-reward RL 可以通过代理策略接口与停止头施加到隐式推理器上，从而在不外化自然语言 token 的前提下获得可变时长的 test-time scaling。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: SLPO 把带可验证奖励的强化学习从显式 CoT 搬到自回归隐式推理器：用可微的隐状态转移代理策略接口做轨迹级信用分配，再用正确性监督的停止头在固定思考预算下学出变时长策略。在两个连续隐式推理器、两个 backbone、三个 held-out benchmark 的全部 12 个 backbone–dataset 组合上 Pass@8 与 Pass@16 均提升，最大增益 12.07 个百分点，并迁移到 soft-token 推理、对更难样本分配更长隐轨迹。

papers.title: Neuro-Symbolic Meta-Policies for Temporal Knowledge-Graph Memory under Partial Observability
papers.abstract_en: Partially observable reinforcement learning requires deciding what to retain, retrieve, and forget over time. We introduce a neuro-symbolic meta-policy that learns which symbolic memory heuristic to apply at each decision point while keeping execution symbolic. Our setting uses temporal knowledge-graph memory in RoomKG, where hidden state and observations are represented as Resource Description Framework (RDF) graphs and memory is augmented with temporal RDF triple annotations. The model combines knowledge-graph encoding of memory contents with value heads for question answering, exploration, and forgetting, yielding a controller that is both adaptive and inspectable. This gives the work a direct Semantic Web grounding through RDF-based representation, annotation-compatible graph semantics, and graph-based symbolic operations over explicit memory state. On train/test room splits at long-term memory capacity of 512, the qualifier-aware StarE-GNN configuration achieves the best held-out performance among the compared symbolic, neural, and neuro-symbolic systems while preserving step-level traceability of memory-management decisions.
papers.comment: Accepted at ISWC 2026 (Research Track), to appear in LNCS 17126. v4: corrects author names in two references, an editor name, affiliation details, and a section cross-reference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在部分可观测 RL 中提出神经-符号元策略 (neuro-symbolic meta-policy)，在每个决策点选择要套用的符号记忆启发式，执行过程保持符号化。在 RoomKG 的长时记忆容量 512 的 train/test 房间划分上，带时序限定符的 StarE-GNN 配置在所比较的符号、神经与神经-符号系统中 held-out 表现最好，且保留逐步可追溯的记忆管理决策。
Motivation: 部分可观测强化学习需要持续决定保留、检索与遗忘什么，纯神经记忆难检查，纯符号启发式又不自适应。
Method: 以 RDF 图表示隐藏状态与观测，记忆用时序 RDF 三元组标注扩充；知识图谱编码器读入记忆内容，接三个 value head 分别服务问答、探索与遗忘，输出选择符号启发式的控制器，执行保持符号化。
Result: 在 RoomKG 长时记忆容量 512 的 train/test 房间划分上，qualifier-aware StarE-GNN 配置在所比较的符号、神经与神经-符号系统中 held-out 表现最佳，并保持记忆管理决策的 step-level traceability。
Conclusion: 让元策略只负责挑选符号记忆启发式、执行仍走符号操作，可以在 RoomKG 上同时拿到更好的 held-out 表现与可检查的记忆决策轨迹。

papers.title: MuViSeg: Multi-View Segment Correspondences from Dense Geometry Priors
papers.abstract_en: Object-level mapping and topological navigation reason about whole objects, yet the correspondences they rely on are computed over keypoints or pixels and only aggregated into objects afterwards. A recent line of work removes this detour by matching directly at the level of instance segments: a class-agnostic segmenter partitions each image, and per-segment descriptors are pooled from large 3D foundation models over the masks. This shifts the open question to how frozen foundation features should be processed once the unit of matching is a segment. We introduce MuViSeg, three learned matching heads: a LightGlue-style attention head on frozen MASt3R descriptors; a DPT-style multi-scale fusion module that exposes layered spatial detail from VGGT before pooling; and, as our main contribution, a joint multi-view head that attends over segments from several views at once, recovering transitive correspondences that pairwise matchers cannot express. In zero-shot evaluation on Replica and Virtual KITTI 2 across 0--180 degree viewpoint changes, our heads consistently improve over a parameter-free Sinkhorn matcher on the same backbone. Across 102 HM3D navigation episodes, direct segment matchers and sparse keypoint aggregation are statistically indistinguishable, while dense matches voted into masks lose 13.7--18.0 SPL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MuViSeg 提出三个在冻结 3D 基础模型描述子之上做实例段级匹配的学习式匹配头：LightGlue 式注意力头、DPT 式多尺度融合模块，以及可一次跨多视图注意、恢复成对匹配器无法表达的传递对应关系的联合多视图头。在 Replica 与 Virtual KITTI 2 的 0–180 度视角变化零样本评测中，三个头一致优于同骨干的免参数 Sinkhorn 匹配器；但在 102 个 HM3D 导航回合中，直接段匹配与稀疏关键点聚合在统计上不可区分，而密集匹配投票回掩码会损失 13.7–18.0 SPL。
Motivation: 物体级建图与拓扑导航按整物体推理，但其依赖的对应关系先在关键点或像素上算再聚合回物体，绕了一圈；而直接在实例段层面匹配时，冻结基础特征在段为匹配单元后该如何处理仍是开放问题。
Method: 先用类别无关分割器划分每张图像，再从大型 3D 基础模型（MASt3R、VGGT）在掩码上池化出每段描述子；随后接三个学习式匹配头：冻结 MASt3R 描述子上的 LightGlue 式注意力头、在池化前暴露 VGGT 分层空间细节的 DPT 式多尺度融合模块，以及主贡献——一次注意多视图段的联合多视图头。
Result: 在 Replica 与 Virtual KITTI 2 上、0–180 度视角变化的零样本评测中，三个头一致优于同骨干上的免参数 Sinkhorn 匹配器。在 102 个 HM3D 导航回合上，直接段匹配与稀疏关键点聚合统计不可区分，而密集匹配投票进掩码损失 13.7–18.0 SPL。
Conclusion: 段级学习匹配头能在大视角变化下稳定超过免参数匹配，但导航终点上直接段匹配并不优于关键点聚合，把密集匹配压回掩码反而明显掉 SPL。

papers.title: Continual Learning with Elastic Regularization and Synthetic Replay for Federated MLLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Federated fine-tuning of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) across distributed networks enables privacy-sensitive adaptation to evolving data streams, yet a fundamental obstacle prevents robust deployment in dynamic environments: catastrophic forgetting, wherein sequential task updates erase previously acquired knowledge across visual, linguistic, and cross-modal representations. Addressing this challenge is especially critical for autonomous networked AI operating in safety-sensitive domains, such as content moderation, where reliable retention of prior knowledge underpins system integrity. To overcome this, we propose Federated Continual Multimodal Learning (FedCMM), a framework that embeds continual-learning safeguards into the federated optimization loop at three complementary levels. At the parameter level, modality-aware elastic weight consolidation computes separate Fisher information matrices for the vision encoder, language backbone, and cross-modal projector, providing granular, asymmetry-aware protection against modality-specific forgetting. At the data level, each client trains a lightweight local generative replay module to synthesize raw-data-free embedding-level multimodal replay tuples without any raw data sharing. At the aggregation level, Task-similarity-aware gradient aggregation autonomously filters and reweights client updates by gradient cosine similarity, suppressing conflicting directions and stabilizing the global learning trajectory. Extensive experiments on two benchmarks demonstrate that FedCMM consistently outperforms recent baselines on accuracy and backward transfer, confirming that holistic, modality-aware optimization enables robust evolutive adaptation across heterogeneous networked AI deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedCMM 把持续学习防护嵌入联邦 MLLM 微调循环的三层：按模态分别算 Fisher 信息的弹性权重巩固 (modality-aware EWC)、本地生成式嵌入级回放、以及按梯度余弦相似度过滤重加权的聚合。在两个 benchmark 上，FedCMM 在 accuracy 与 backward transfer 上持续优于近期基线。
Motivation: 联邦微调 MLLM 时顺序任务更新会灾难性遗忘视觉、语言与跨模态表征，内容审核等安全敏感的联网 AI 依赖对既有知识的可靠保留。
Method: 参数层：对 vision encoder、language backbone、cross-modal projector 分别计算 Fisher 信息矩阵做模态感知 EWC；数据层：每个客户端训练轻量本地生成式回放模块，合成无需共享原始数据的嵌入级多模态回放元组；聚合层：Task-similarity-aware gradient aggregation 按梯度余弦相似度过滤并重加权客户端更新，抑制冲突方向。
Result: 在两个 benchmark 上，FedCMM 在 accuracy 和 backward transfer 两项指标上持续优于近期基线。
Conclusion: 把模态感知的参数保护、数据回放与梯度聚合三层一起优化，可在异构联邦部署中实现稳健的演进式适应并抑制灾难性遗忘。

papers.title: PFAdapter: Hierarchical LoRA Decomposition for Personalized Federated MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems are reshaping communications and networking by deploying autonomous intelligent agents capable of collaborative learning while maintaining data privacy at network edges. Within distributed network environments, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) serve as cognitive engines for edge devices, yet federated fine-tuning faces substantial challenges in balancing global knowledge aggregation with local adaptation under heterogeneous network conditions. Conventional federated protocols typically rely on uniform parameter aggregation, which conflates domain-invariant features with client-specific nuances, thereby resulting in suboptimal personalization and excessive communication overhead. To address these challenges, we propose PFAdapter, a communication-efficient framework introducing hierarchical LoRA decomposition to explicitly separate adapter parameters into global-shared and local-private components. Query and key projections are assigned to global synchronization for capturing universal multimodal semantics across the network, while value and output projections remain localized for edge-specific adaptation. Additionally, orthogonality regularization based on the Frobenius norm enforces strict separation between these components, preventing redundant feature learning. Selective aggregation protocols synchronize only global-shared components across the federated network, preserving local expertise and reducing communication costs by nearly 50%. Extensive experiments on VQA-RAD, SLAKE, Hateful Memes, and CrisisMMD datasets demonstrate that PFAdapter consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving accuracy improvements ranging from 2.4% to 4.8% across diverse edge intelligence tasks. Consequently, our framework establishes an efficient solution for agentic AI deployment in resource-constrained communication networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PFAdapter 把联邦微调 MLLM 的 LoRA 参数按 Q/K 与 V/O 拆成全局共享与本地私有两部分，只同步全局部分并用 Frobenius 范数正交正则强制二者分离。在 VQA-RAD、SLAKE、Hateful Memes、CrisisMMD 上准确率较 SOTA 基线提升 2.4%–4.8%，通信成本降低近 50%。
Motivation: 联邦微调 MLLM 时均匀参数聚合把领域不变特征与客户端特有细节混在一起，个性化差且通信开销大，异构网络条件下全局知识聚合与本地适应难以平衡。
Method: 提出 PFAdapter：层级 LoRA 分解把 adapter 参数显式拆为全局共享与本地私有组件，Query/Key 投影参与全局同步以捕获跨网络通用多模态语义，Value/Output 投影保留本地做边缘适配；用基于 Frobenius 范数的正交正则强制两部分分离、防止冗余学习；选择性聚合协议只同步全局共享组件。
Result: 在 VQA-RAD、SLAKE、Hateful Memes、CrisisMMD 四个数据集上，准确率较 state-of-the-art 基线提升 2.4% 到 4.8%，覆盖多种边缘智能任务；通信成本降低近 50%。
Conclusion: 把 LoRA 按投影矩阵分工拆成全局/本地两支并只聚合全局部分，可在资源受限通信网络中同时保住个性化与低通信开销，作者据此视其为 agentic AI 部署的高效方案。

papers.title: Exact and Certified Data Shapley for Weighted Nearest Neighbor Regression
papers.abstract_en: Data Shapley can be computed exactly and efficiently for unweighted K-nearest-neighbor (KNN) models, the basis of the popular KNN-Shapley. For weighted KNN, however, efficient exact algorithms are known only for hard-label classification. In regression, the prediction is a weighted average whose normalization term changes with every subset. The best exact algorithm then takes O(N^K) time for N training points. We show that this normalization term is not an obstacle. A subset affects the prediction only through two numbers: the total weight of its K nearest neighbors and their total weighted target. Once the weights are discretized, subsets with equal total weight share their normalization term and can be summed as a group. This gives an exact algorithm that is near-linear in N and polynomial in K and the number of weight levels, for real targets under the squared loss. The same idea gives exact values for soft-label classifiers in the same time, and speeds up the earlier exact algorithm for hard labels by a factor of N. For continuous weights, we give a deterministic approximation with a certified error bound, without discretizing the weights. On the downside, we prove that some exact values take exponentially many bits to write down, so the dependence on weight precision cannot be removed in general. In experiments on real datasets with up to 100,000 training points and with 10 or 100 validation points, we compare the exact values with Monte Carlo estimates computed in the same time. Monte Carlo ranks the points less and less like the exact values as the training set grows. Two of its runs also disagree on a large share of the top 10% of points.
papers.comment: 77 pages, 4 figures. Version 3 is a substantial revision: exact values in near-linear time, continuous weights without a grid, limits of exact computation, and new experiments up to 100,000 training points
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对加权 KNN 回归的 Data Shapley 精确计算，指出归一化项不是障碍：子集只通过其 K 近邻的总权重与总加权目标两个数影响预测，权重离散化后总权重相同的子集可分组求和。由此得到关于 N 近线性、关于 K 与权重档数多项式的精确算法；连续权重则给出带认证误差界的确定性近似。在最多 100,000 训练点的真实数据上，同等时间内 Monte Carlo 估计随训练集增大越来越不像精确值排序，其两次运行在 top 10% 点上大范围不一致。
Motivation: 加权 KNN 的预测是带归一化项的加权平均，该归一化随每个子集变化，现有精确算法只有 O(N^K)，难以扩展；而 Monte Carlo 近似在大训练集上排序失真。
Method: 把子集对预测的影响压缩为 K 近邻总权重与总加权目标两个量，权重离散化后按总权重分组求和，得到平方损失下实值目标的近线性精确算法；同一思路给出 soft-label 分类器的精确值，并把已有 hard-label 精确算法加速 N 倍；连续权重用不离散化的确定性近似并给出认证误差界。
Result: 精确算法关于 N 近线性、关于 K 与权重档数多项式；hard-label 精确算法加速 N 倍。真实数据集上最多 100,000 训练点、10 或 100 个验证点，与同等时间预算的 Monte Carlo 比较：MC 排序随训练集增大愈发偏离精确值，两次 MC 运行在 top 10% 点上大范围不一致。另证明某些精确值需要指数多位才能写下，权重精度依赖一般不可去除。
Conclusion: 归一化项可通过按总权重分组求和消除，使加权 KNN 回归的 Data Shapley 可精确高效计算；但权重精度的指数级代价在一般情形下是固有的。

papers.title: REBASE: Reference-Background Subspace Elimination for Training-Free In-Context Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Training-free in-context segmentation enables new object categories to be introduced at inference time from a single annotated reference image, eliminating the retraining and memory overhead of class-incremental learning. Recent approaches achieve this by combining vision foundation models for semantic correspondence with promptable segmentation networks like SAM. However, their performance is fundamentally limited by the quality of the cross-image similarity map; shared contextual backgrounds between the reference and query systematically elevate similarity in non-target regions, degrading prompt localization. We present REBASE, a training-free framework that explicitly suppresses these spurious contextual correspondences. Our method identifies the low-rank background feature subspace from the reference image and project the reference and query features onto its orthogonal complement in closed form, yielding cleaner semantic matching. We then generate positive point prompts using similarity-weighted farthest-point sampling, paired with a refined dense similarity prior. Without any training or parameter updates, our approach establishes a new state of the art among training-free methods on PACO-Part, FSS-1000, and cross-domain datasets such as ISIC2018, demonstrating that explicit background subspace removal is a highly effective principle for one-shot localization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REBASE 是免训练的单图 in-context 分割框架：从参考图特征中提取低秩背景子空间，把参考与查询特征投影到其正交补上以消除共享上下文造成的伪对应，再用相似度加权最远点采样生成正点提示。在 PACO-Part、FSS-1000 及跨域 ISIC2018 上达到免训练方法的新 SOTA。
Motivation: 参考图与查询图共享的上下文背景会系统性抬高非目标区域的跨图相似度，使提示定位失效，成为免训练 in-context 分割的性能瓶颈。
Method: 闭式提取参考图的低秩背景特征子空间，将参考与查询特征投影到其正交补以净化语义匹配；随后用相似度加权最远点采样 (similarity-weighted farthest-point sampling) 生成正点提示，并配合精化的稠密相似度先验；全程无训练、无参数更新。
Result: 在 PACO-Part、FSS-1000 以及跨域数据集 ISIC2018 上，于免训练方法中建立新的 state of the art。
Conclusion: 显式移除背景子空间是单样本定位的高效原则，可在不训练、不更新参数的前提下提升跨图语义匹配质量。

papers.title: LP-SFT: Keeping Plausible Alternatives Alive in Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is widely used to adapt pretrained language models to downstream domains, but can over-specialize the model and degrade its pre-existing capabilities. Standard cross-entropy drives probability mass onto the observed target token and can make plausible alternatives that the pretrained model itself endorsed vanish. Using Shannon and Renyi entropies, we show that pretrained next-token distributions exhibit a regular multimodal structure, with entropy peaks corresponding to different numbers of plausible alternatives. Motivated by this observation, we propose LP-SFT, a Local-Preserving Supervised Fine-Tuning objective with two key design principles: it removes the supervised token from a local top-$K$ candidate set to avoid conflict with cross-entropy, and applies a locally normalized KL loss to preserve relative preferences among the remaining non-label alternatives. Across mixed-domain and domain-specific fine-tuning experiments, LP-SFT consistently outperforms standard SFT and recent baselines in aggregate performance while keeping base-endorsed alternatives from vanishing, achieving a favorable balance between single-sample accuracy and finite-budget solution accessibility, as measured by pass@1 and pass@$k$, respectively, with only a modest increase in training cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LP-SFT 在监督微调时把交叉熵的目标 token 从局部 top-K 候选集中移除，再对剩余非标签候选施加局部归一化 KL 损失，使预训练模型原本认可的合理替代答案不被压成零概率。在混合域与单域微调实验中，其聚合表现持续优于标准 SFT 与近期基线，同时在 pass@1 单样本精度与有限预算下的 pass@k 可达性之间取得平衡，训练开销仅小幅上升。
Motivation: 标准交叉熵把概率质量全部压到观测目标 token 上，会抹掉预训练模型自己认可的合理替代，导致微调过度专化并损害原有能力。
Method: LP-SFT（Local-Preserving SFT）目标含两条设计：一是把监督 token 从局部 top-K 候选集中剔除以避免与交叉熵冲突；二是对剩余非标签候选施加局部归一化 KL 损失以保留其相对偏好。其动机来自用 Shannon 与 Renyi 熵刻画预训练下一 token 分布的多峰结构，熵峰对应不同数量的合理替代。
Result: 在混合域与单域微调实验中，LP-SFT 的聚合表现持续优于标准 SFT 与近期基线；以 pass@1 衡量单样本精度、pass@k 衡量有限预算下的解可达性，两者取得有利平衡，训练成本仅小幅增加。
Conclusion: 保留预训练分布中局部合理替代的相对偏好，可以在不过度牺牲单样本精度的前提下提高有限采样预算下的解可达性，且代价只是适度的训练开销。

papers.title: Subliminal Clocks: Latent Time Modelling in Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models. Unlike standard diffusion-based approaches, DLMs are not explicitly conditioned on a timestep, raising a natural question: do these models internally represent denoising progress, and how is such information used downstream? In this work, we show that DLMs do in fact encode a latent representation related to the diffusion timestep within their residual streams. We find that this signal can be reliably extracted using probes across layers, indicating that denoising progress is decodable from internal activations. We further demonstrate that steering the model along a low-dimensional subspace associated with the inferred timestep allows us to systematically modulate its notion of denoising progress, leading to predictable changes in model confidence and entropy. Finally, we analyse the geometry of the identified representation, showing that it exhibits structured and interpretable properties in activation space, and shedding light on how such a signal is processed by these models.
papers.comment: Equal contribution: Thomas Vaitses Fontanari and Simone Petruzzi. Accepted at EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩散语言模型 (DLM) 虽不显式给定 timestep，其 residual stream 中仍编码了与去噪进度相关的潜时间表征；用跨层探针可稳定解码该信号，并沿其低维子空间引导模型可系统调节去噪进度，带来模型置信度与熵的可预测变化。
Motivation: DLM 与标准扩散不同，不以 timestep 为条件，因此其内部是否表征去噪进度、该信息如何被下游使用，是一个未解的问题。
Method: 在各层 residual stream 上训练探针以解码与 diffusion timestep 相关的潜表征；再沿推断出的 timestep 对应的低维子空间对模型做 steering，观察置信度与熵的变化，并分析该表征在激活空间中的几何结构。
Result: 去噪进度可从内部激活中被跨层探针可靠解码；沿低维子空间引导可系统调节模型对去噪进度的认知，导致置信度与熵的可预测改变；该表征在激活空间中呈现结构化且可解释的几何性质。
Conclusion: DLM 内部存在一个结构化、可解释的潜时间信号，且可通过子空间干预主动操控，说明不显式条件化的模型仍自行组织了去噪进度。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: From Personas to Plot: Character-Grounded Multi-Agent Story Generation for Long-Form Narratives
papers.abstract_en: Although large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive creative fiction generation, they struggle to maintain narrative consistency and coherent plot lines in long-form stories. In this work, we introduce MAGNET, a multi-agent goal-driven narrative engine for storytelling, which generates stories with persona-grounded character agents that propose actions based on a shared structured state and evolving story goals. We evaluate MAGNET on 20 and 100 page stories using LLM based editor annotations and rubric scoring. At both narrative lengths, MAGNET significantly reduces editor annotations and improves rubric scores compared to single-model prompting, StoryBox, and StoryWriter (p<0.05). Ablation experiments also show that the critic module, structured state, and goal sequencing each contribute significantly to performance (p<0.05). These results suggest that long-form narratives can emerge from explicit structured states, critic-based action refinement, and goal-driven multi-agent generation with loosely specified character personas, providing a foundation for controllable and structurally coherent long-form narrative generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多智能体目标驱动叙事引擎 MAGNET：角色 persona 驱动的智能体基于共享结构化状态与演化中的故事目标提议行动，再由 critic 模块精炼。在 20 页与 100 页长篇故事上，编辑标注与 rubric 打分均显著优于单模型提示、StoryBox 与 StoryWriter（p<0.05），消融显示 critic、结构化状态、目标序列化各自贡献显著（p<0.05）。
Motivation: LLM 生成创意小说已有不错表现，但在长篇故事中难以维持叙事一致性与连贯情节线。
Method: MAGNET 用 persona 落地的角色智能体，基于共享结构化状态与不断演化的故事目标提议行动，配合 critic 模块做行动精炼与目标序列化；评测用 LLM 编辑标注与 rubric 打分，覆盖 20 页和 100 页两种长度，并做模块消融。
Result: 在 20 页与 100 页两种叙事长度上，MAGNET 相对单模型提示、StoryBox、StoryWriter 均显著减少编辑标注并提升 rubric 分数（p<0.05）；消融中 critic 模块、结构化状态、目标序列化各自均带来显著性能贡献（p<0.05）。
Conclusion: 显式结构化状态、critic 行动精炼与目标驱动的多智能体生成，配合宽松指定的角色 persona，足以支撑可控且结构连贯的长篇叙事生成。

papers.title: Multi-Level Distributional Entropy from Flow Summary Statistics for Explainable Network Intrusion Detection
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning network intrusion detection systems (IDS) operate on aggregate flow statistics that discard the distributional structure of traffic, and although information-theoretic measures capture that structure, established entropy estimators require raw packet sequences that pre-aggregated flow datasets do not contain. No prior method derives entropy from the summary statistics those records already hold. We introduce Multi-Level Distributional Entropy (MDE), which computes interpretable information-theoretic features analytically from flow-level summary statistics at three levels, within-flow Gaussian differential entropy, cross-directional Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD), and Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) flag-incidence Shannon entropy, with closed-form properties and no raw packet access; only imputation medians and score bounds are fitted on the training split. We pair the features with a leakage-free, fold-local evaluation protocol that reports the full operational metric suite across cross-validation, temporal, pseudo-live, cross-dataset, and unseen-attack-family settings, on four benchmarks (NSL-KDD, CICIDS-2017, CICIDS-2018, UNSW-NB15) with tree-ensemble classifiers and SHAP. The protocol exposes failure modes that aggregate weighted F1 conceals: on CICIDS-2018 an F1 of 0.73 hides a detection rate (DR) of 0.44, on held-out attack families F1 exceeds 0.998 while DR falls to zero, and a 703K-flow pseudo-live replay reveals a threshold-ranking divergence in which score ranking is largely preserved (area under the ROC curve, AUC, 0.84 to 0.86) while fixed-threshold detection collapses (DR 0.08). The entropy features match conventional features within 0.1 percentage points of F1 and receive reproducible SHAP attributions (Spearman 0.84 to 0.94), so their contribution is a grounded, interpretable representation and an evaluation methodology rather than an accuracy gain.
papers.comment: 21 pages. v2: retitled from "Multi-Level Distributional Entropy for Explainable Network Intrusion Detection"; the paper now foregrounds the analytic, packet-free derivation of entropy features from flow summary statistics and the leakage-free evaluation methodology that exposes failure modes an aggregate F1 conceals. Code: https://github.com/drbouke/mde

TL;DR: 提出 Multi-Level Distributional Entropy (MDE)，从流量级汇总统计量解析推导三层信息论特征（流内高斯微分熵、跨方向 Jensen-Shannon divergence、TCP 标志位 Shannon 熵），完全不接触原始包序列。配套的无泄漏评估协议暴露聚合 F1 掩盖的失效模式：CICIDS-2018 上 F1 0.73 对应检测率仅 0.44，留出攻击族上 F1 超 0.998 而检测率归零，703K 流伪实时回放中 AUC 0.84→0.86 但固定阈值检测率崩到 0.08。
Motivation: 现有 ML 入侵检测依赖聚合流量统计，丢掉了流量的分布结构；而信息论度量需要原始包序列，预聚合数据集里没有，此前没有方法能从这些记录自带的汇总统计量推导熵。
Method: MDE 在三个层级解析计算可解释特征：流内高斯微分熵、跨方向 JSD、TCP 标志位共现 Shannon 熵，均为闭式且无需原始包；仅插补中位数与分数边界在训练折上拟合。特征接入树集成分类器并配 SHAP，评估用折内局部、无泄漏协议，覆盖交叉验证、时间切分、伪实时、跨数据集与留出攻击族五种设定，基准为 NSL-KDD、CICIDS-2017、CICIDS-2018、UNSW-NB15。
Result: CICIDS-2018 上加权 F1 0.73 掩盖检测率 0.44；留出攻击族上 F1 超 0.998 而检测率降至 0；703K 流伪实时回放中分数排序基本保留（AUC 0.84 到 0.86）但固定阈值检测崩至 DR 0.08。熵特征与常规特征的 F1 差距在 0.1 个百分点以内，SHAP 归因可复现（Spearman 0.84 到 0.94）。
Conclusion: MDE 的贡献是给出有依据、可解释的表示与一套能暴露聚合 F1 掩盖的失效模式的评估方法，而不是精度提升。

papers.title: DART: Draft-Agreement Routing for Training-Free Adaptive Thinking Budgets in Hybrid Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid reasoning models can answer directly or spend extra tokens on extended thinking. A practical router should choose between these modes for each query, so easy problems avoid unnecessary reasoning and hard problems receive enough budget to finish the answer. Existing routers move in this direction, but they typically require labeled training data or fix thinking budgets up front, ignoring answer-level evidence from the model itself. We introduce DART, a training-free routing framework that samples two cheap no-think drafts, accepts direct answering when the drafts agree, and predicts a thinking budget from draft entropy when they disagree. Across the main comparisons, DART preserves or improves always-thinking accuracy in most settings while reducing thinking-token use. Accuracy improves by up to +9.0 points on Olympiad-level math and by up to +22.5 points on code under execution-based equivalence, while thinking-token use drops by 32-73%. The Stage~1 signal extends across model scales (0.6B--32B), model families, and API-only hosted settings, with no labeled data and no gradient updates required. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/DART.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 17 tables. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (findings). Code: https://github.com/js-lee-AI/DART
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DART 是免训练的混合推理路由框架：采样两个廉价 no-think 草稿，草稿一致就直接作答，不一致则用草稿熵预测思考预算。在多数设置下保持或提升 always-thinking 精度，同时思考 token 用量下降 32–73%，Olympiad 数学最高 +9.0 点、代码（执行等价判定）最高 +22.5 点。
Motivation: 现有混合推理路由器要么依赖标注训练数据，要么预先固定思考预算，忽略了模型自身的答案级证据，难以按题目难度逐条分配推理开销。
Method: DART 免训练、免梯度更新：对每条查询采样两个廉价 no-think 草稿，一致则直接回答；不一致时用草稿熵预测思考预算（Stage 1 信号），覆盖 0.6B–32B 多个模型尺度、多个模型家族与仅 API 的托管设置。
Result: 多数设置下保持或优于 always-thinking 精度，同时思考 token 用量下降 32–73%；Olympiad 级数学精度最高提升 +9.0 点，代码在执行等价 (execution-based equivalence) 判定下最高提升 +22.5 点；Stage 1 信号跨 0.6B–32B 尺度、模型家族与 API-only 设置均成立，无需标注数据与梯度更新。
Conclusion: 仅凭模型自身的草稿一致性与熵，就能在不训练、不用标注的条件下逐查询分配思考预算，同时省 token 并保住精度。

papers.title: PHOEBI: An Open-World Benchmark for Multi-Label Bacterial Identification in Phase-Contrast Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: Optical microscopy (OM) enables rapid, label-free imaging of live bacteria and is the standard instrument for species identification across clinical, environmental, and industrial microbiology. Real samples, however, are routinely polymicrobial and may contain organisms never seen during training, and no computer-vision benchmark evaluates multi-label species identification from phase-contrast microscopy (PCM) of such mixtures. We introduce Phase-contrast Optical bEnchmark for Bacterial Identification ($\textbf{PHOEBI}$), a wet-lab-prepared dataset of $120{,}000$ PCM images covering $40$ combinations of six rod-shaped species, together with a leave-combinations-out (LCO) protocol that holds out entire species combinations, mirroring a model trained on catalogued mixtures that must recognise new ones. Under LCO, gradient-trained per-image classifiers, from fine-tuned backbones to attention-based multiple-instance learning, collapse on unseen combinations despite high in-distribution accuracy, and the failure lies in how per-image predictions are aggregated rather than in the visual representation. We propose three lightweight $\textbf{anchor-based}$ decoders that read each species' presence against fixed geometric prototypes over a shared frozen tile-feature pool, and they remain stable under the same shift. Without additional training, the same features also support open-set rejection of unseen species and the discovery of a new class from unlabeled test images, with negligible disruption to the known classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PHOEBI 是首个针对相差显微镜 (PCM) 混合菌样本的多标签细菌识别基准：湿实验制备 120,000 张图像、覆盖 6 种杆状菌的 40 种组合，并用 leave-combinations-out (LCO) 协议整组留出物种组合。在 LCO 下，从微调 backbone 到 attention-based multiple-instance learning 的逐图分类器在未见组合上崩溃，失败源于逐图预测的聚合方式而非视觉表征；三种基于固定几何原型 anchor 的轻量解码器在同一 frozen tile-feature pool 上保持稳定，并在不额外训练的前提下支持开集拒识与新类发现。
Motivation: 真实临床与环境样本常是多菌混合且可能含训练时未见的物种，而现有计算机视觉基准都不评估从 PCM 混合图像做多标签物种识别，尤其缺少整组留出物种组合的开放世界评测。
Method: 构建湿实验制备的 PHOEBI 数据集（120,000 张 PCM 图像，40 种六杆状菌组合），提出 leave-combinations-out 协议整组留出组合；对比微调 backbone 与 attention-based multiple-instance learning 等逐图分类器，并提出三种 anchor-based 解码器，在共享的 frozen tile-feature pool 上对照固定几何原型读取各物种存在性。
Result: LCO 下梯度训练的逐图分类器（微调 backbone 到 attention-based MIL）尽管 in-distribution 精度高，在未见组合上仍崩溃；诊断显示失败在逐图预测的聚合环节而非视觉表征。三种 anchor-based 解码器在同一分布偏移下保持稳定，且同一特征无需额外训练即可支持未见物种的开集拒识与从无标签测试图像发现新类，对已知类干扰可忽略。
Conclusion: 多标签混合菌识别的开放世界失效来自预测聚合而非表征，因此把逐图打分换成对照固定原型的 anchor 解码即可在分布偏移下保持稳定，并顺带获得开集拒识与新类发现能力。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: RTSGameBench: An RTS Benchmark for Strategic Reasoning by Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often struggle with strategic reasoning, i.e., anticipating and influencing other agents' actions, under uncertainty in competitive and cooperative settings. Real-time strategy (RTS) games can be a natural testbed for diagnosing this limitation, as they demand coordination with allies, adaptation to opponents' strategy, and long-horizon planning under partial observability. However, existing RTS benchmarks offer limited evaluation scope, lack systematic competency diagnosis, and remain fixed in the pre-designed scenario coverage. To address these limitations, we present RTSGameBench, which is built on Beyond All Reason, a large-scale RTS game with an expanded battlefield that demands broader strategy diversity than the existing testbeds. The proposed benchmark provides evaluations through diverse gameplay across various matchup structures, diagnostic assessment via mini-games, each targeting an individual strategic competency, and extensible coverage via a self-evolving generation framework that converts free-form queries into new mini-games, improving over successive cycles. Additionally, for VLMs to operate in large-scale RTS games, we provide RTSGameAgent that manages units by an FSM with agentic memory. We empirically validate that multiple state-of-the-art VLMs do not perform well when matchups demand tighter coordination, multiagent coordination and when task scale increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RTSGameBench 用 Beyond All Reason 这一大型即时战略 (RTS) 游戏构建 VLM 战略推理基准，通过多样的对战组合、针对单项能力的 mini-game 诊断、以及把自由文本查询转成新 mini-game 的自演化生成框架来扩展评测覆盖，并配套提供用 FSM 管理单位加 agentic memory 的 RTSGameAgent。实证结果显示多个 SOTA VLM 在需要更紧密协同的对战、多智能体协同以及任务规模增大时表现明显不佳。
Motivation: VLM 在竞争与合作场景下难以在不确定性中预判并影响其他智能体的行动；现有 RTS 基准评测范围有限、缺少系统性的能力诊断，且场景覆盖固定不可扩展。
Method: 基于 Beyond All Reason 并扩展战场以覆盖更广策略多样性；评测分三路——多样的对战组合 (matchup) 玩法、每项战略能力对应一个 mini-game 的诊断评估、以及把 free-form 查询逐步转成新 mini-game 并跨轮改进的自演化生成框架；推理侧提供 RTSGameAgent，用有限状态机 (FSM) 加 agentic memory 管理单位。
Result: 实证验证表明多个 state-of-the-art VLM 在三类条件下表现不佳：对战组合要求更紧密的协同 (tighter coordination)、多智能体协同 (multiagent coordination)、以及任务规模增大时。
Conclusion: 现有 VLM 的战略推理在协同密度与任务规模上升时会失效，因此需要按单项能力拆分的诊断式评测和可扩展的场景生成来暴露这些短板。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: LoopVLA: cross-subtask event memory for looped task execution
papers.abstract_en: Repetitive tasks are common in real-world manipulation, yet current vision-language-action (VLA) policies remain unreliable for repeated actions. We present LoopVLA, a cross-subtask event-memory interface for looped task execution. Its central idea is to compress a just-completed subtask into memory for the next subtask's action expert, making completed execution available for subsequent repetition and stopping decisions. Learnable event latents query the closed segment's tokens, while action features query history and joint history--event context; the two action-side readouts are residually fused and injected directly into the action head. On a memory benchmark, LoopVLA achieves $80.22\%$ success on the repetition task group with online subgoal prediction, bringing evaluation closer to realistic deployment while improving overall success over strong memory baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoopVLA 为视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 策略加装跨子任务事件记忆接口：把刚完成的子任务压缩成事件记忆，供下一个子任务的动作专家查询，从而支撑重复执行与停止判断。在带在线子目标预测的记忆基准上，重复任务组成功率 80.22%，整体成功率优于强记忆基线。
Motivation: 真实操作中重复性任务常见，但现有 VLA 策略对重复动作不可靠，已完成的执行信息无法被后续子任务复用。
Method: 可学习的 event latents 查询已闭合片段的 token，动作特征分别查询历史与“历史-事件”联合上下文，两路动作侧读出经残差融合后直接注入动作头；评测带在线子目标预测。
Result: 在记忆基准的重复任务组 (repetition task group) 上取得 80.22% 成功率，并在整体成功率上超过强记忆基线 (strong memory baselines)。
Conclusion: 把已完成子任务压缩为可供下一子任务动作专家读取的事件记忆，可让 VLA 策略在重复执行与停止决策上更可靠。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SelfEvoSkill: Paired Execution Audits for Skill Revision without External Outcome Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills provide LLM agents with reusable procedures, but a given skill may be incomplete, ineffective, or misleading for the current task. Existing methods for revising skills typically rely on external outcome supervision, such as task rewards, performance on a separate validation set, or feedback from deployment, to decide which updates to retain. However, this supervision may be costly or unavailable when adapting a skill to a new task. Using execution behavior as an alternative signal is challenging: a single run reflects the combined effects of the agent, task, and workspace, making the skill's contribution difficult to isolate. Comparing executions with and without the skill, while holding these factors fixed, provides evidence about how the skill changes behavior. We introduce SelfEvoSkill, which links these behavioral differences to relevant skill passages and iteratively revises and reevaluates those passages through subsequent executions. Checks derived once from the task's explicit requirements prevent revisions from violating task constraints. Across 89 containerized tasks in 8 professional domains, under the same best-of-two evaluation budget, SelfEvoSkill attains a 73.9% mean task reward, exceeding the no-skill condition by +33.0 percentage points and the benchmark's curated skill by +17.2 percentage points, while skill evolution receives neither task rewards nor benchmark verifier outputs. In controlled ablations, using two with-skill runs instead of a matched with/without-skill pair reduces mean reward by 4.6 percentage points, while limiting revision to one round reduces it by 9.0 points relative to repeated revision. Together, these results show that behavioral differences between matched executions can provide an effective signal for revising skills when outcome supervision is unavailable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SelfEvoSkill 用「带技能/不带技能」配对执行的行为差异替代外部结果监督来修订 LLM agent 技能：把差异归因到相关技能段落并迭代修订，再用由任务显式要求派生的检查约束修订不越界。在 8 个专业领域 89 个容器化任务、best-of-two 同预算下，平均任务奖励 73.9%，比无技能高 33.0 个百分点、比人工精选技能高 17.2 个百分点，且全程不用任务奖励与 benchmark verifier 输出。
Motivation: 现有技能修订依赖任务奖励、独立验证集或部署反馈等外部结果监督，迁移到新任务时这类监督昂贵或不可得；而单次执行混合了 agent、任务与 workspace 的影响，难以分离技能本身的贡献。
Method: 在固定 agent、任务、workspace 的条件下对比带技能与不带技能的配对执行，把行为差异关联到相关技能段落，经后续执行迭代修订并复评这些段落；用从任务显式要求派生的一次性检查 (checks) 防止修订违反任务约束。
Result: 89 个容器化任务、8 个专业领域、best-of-two 同预算下平均任务奖励 73.9%，较无技能条件 +33.0 个百分点，较 benchmark 精选技能 +17.2 个百分点，且技能演化过程不接收任务奖励或 verifier 输出。消融：用两次带技能运行替代配对的带/不带技能运行，平均奖励降 4.6 个百分点；把修订限制为一轮，相对反复修订降 9.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: 配对执行的行为差异本身就能在无结果监督时有效驱动技能修订，且配对对照与多轮迭代缺一不可。

papers.title: Learning the Context of Errors: Black-Box Online Adaptation of Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: The rapid evolution of Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) has advanced zero-shot forecasting across diverse domains. Inspired by the current form of Large Language Models, future TSFMs may be offered as commercialized, closed-source API services. However, many existing online adaptation methods still rely on white-box access for parameter fine-tuning or gradient backpropagation. This paradigm mismatch raises a question: In black-box online adaptation for TSFMs, what should we learn? We answer this with an insight: the predictive errors of the base model are conditioned on both the input and output of the base model (i.e., the context of errors). To validate this insight, we propose ORCA (Online Residual Contextual Adaptation). We conduct extensive experiments across 5 state-of-the-art TSFMs and 8 datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Furthermore, through ablation studies, we quantitatively analyze the impact of different adapter learning hypotheses on the final adaptation performance in black-box online adaptation. Code available at https://github.com/Fifthky/ORCA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对闭源 API 形式的时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 无法白盒微调的问题，提出 ORCA（Online Residualual Contextual Adaptation）：把基模型预测误差视为同时依赖其输入与输出的「误差上下文」，仅在黑盒在线设定下学习该上下文来做残差适配。在 5 个 SOTA TSFM 与 8 个数据集上验证有效，并通过消融定量比较了不同 adapter 学习假设对最终适配性能的影响。
Motivation: 未来 TSFM 可能以闭源 API 形式提供，而现有在线适配方法依赖参数微调或梯度反传的白盒访问，与这一形态不匹配；黑盒在线适配中究竟该学什么尚无答案。
Method: 提出 ORCA：以「基模型预测误差由其输入和输出共同决定」这一洞察为学习假设，学习误差的上下文（context of errors）以在线适配黑盒 TSFM 的预测；并用消融研究定量分析不同 adapter 学习假设对适配性能的影响。
Result: 在 5 个 SOTA TSFM 和 8 个数据集上的广泛实验验证了 ORCA 的有效性；消融研究定量给出了不同 adapter 学习假设对黑盒在线适配最终性能的影响。
Conclusion: 黑盒在线适配 TSFM 时应学习的是基模型误差的上下文（输入与输出条件化的残差），而非模型参数；该学习假设在多种 TSFM 与数据集上成立。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: LatentWave: JEPA Pretraining for Wireless Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Wireless foundation models have emerged as a promising alternative to building separate models for each wireless task. However, existing approaches rely on masked input reconstruction, which can bias representations toward low-level signal details. In this paper, we propose LatentWave, a wireless foundation model pretrained using a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) on diverse wireless spectrograms and channel state information (CSI). By predicting masked regions in latent space, LatentWave learns representations that are more transferable out of the box across diverse downstream tasks. The proposed architecture employs per-channel patch embeddings with stochastic channel sampling during pretraining, allowing it to process variable antenna counts and improving usability across heterogeneous wireless configurations. We evaluate LatentWave on four downstream tasks: RF signal classification, 5G NR positioning, beam prediction, and LoS/NLoS classification, comparing against a masked-modeling baseline (WavesFM) pretrained on the same data. Additionally, we show that the masking geometry introduces a task-dependent inductive bias: frequency masking strongly favors channel-related tasks such as positioning and beam prediction, while region masking better preserves discriminability for signal classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LatentWave 用 JEPA 在无线频谱图与 CSI 上做潜空间掩码预测预训练，而非重建原始信号，学到的表征开箱即可迁移到四类下游任务。逐通道 patch embedding 加随机通道采样使其支持可变天线数；掩码几何带来任务相关归纳偏置：频率掩码偏向定位与波束预测，区域掩码更利于信号分类。
Motivation: 无线基础模型普遍依赖掩码重建，表征被低层信号细节带偏，且难以适配异构天线配置的下游任务。
Method: 在多样无线频谱图与 CSI 上以 Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) 预训练，在潜空间预测掩码区域；采用逐通道 patch embedding 并在预训练中随机采样通道以支持可变天线数。在 RF 信号分类、5G NR 定位、波束预测、LoS/NLoS 分类四个下游任务上评测，与同数据预训练的掩码建模基线 WavesFM 对比。
Result: 在四个下游任务（RF 信号分类、5G NR 定位、波束预测、LoS/NLoS 分类）上与同数据预训练的 WavesFM 对比；掩码几何呈任务相关偏置：频率掩码强烈偏向定位与波束预测等信道类任务，区域掩码更好地保持信号分类的判别性。
Conclusion: 潜空间预测式预训练比掩码重建更能得到跨任务可迁移的无线表征，且掩码几何应按目标任务选择。

papers.title: Flash-WAM: Modality-Aware Distillation for World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and robot actions through iterative diffusion, achieving strong performance on manipulation benchmarks but requiring tens of denoising steps, a cost that precludes real-time control. Step distillation has emerged as the natural remedy, but off-the-shelf methods break down in the joint video-action setting because video and action streams use different SNR-shifted noise schedules and reach training with substantially different marginal noise distributions, an asymmetry that single-modality distillation methods cannot accommodate. We introduce \textbf{Flash-WAM}, a modality-aware step-distillation framework inspired by consistency distillation that selects the consistency function for each modality to match its noise regime: a linear-gradient-scaling parametrization for the action stream's low-noise regime, paired with a variance-preserving parametrization for the video stream's high-noise regime, grounded in a structural analysis of the consistency-function family that characterizes the achievable gradient scaling under the consistency boundary condition. Instantiated on LingBot-VA, Flash-WAM compresses inference to a single step in each modality. On RoboTwin 2.0, this reduces per-chunk latency from $8.1$ seconds to $348$ ms on NVIDIA L40S, a $23{\times}$ speedup that enables real-time inference. Flash-WAM preserves task success on simulation benchmarks ($85.5\%$ RoboTwin 2.0, $95.7\%$ LIBERO) and substantially recovers real-world performance ($60\%$ average on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot), while naive consistency distillation drops to $24\%$ at the same step budget.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Project page: https://flashwam.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Flash-WAM 针对世界-动作模型 (world-action model) 视频流与动作流噪声调度不一致的问题，按模态分别选择一致性函数：动作流低噪声区用 linear-gradient-scaling 参数化，视频流高噪声区用 variance-preserving 参数化，把推理压到每模态单步。在 LingBot-VA 上单步推理使 RoboTwin 2.0 每 chunk 延迟从 8.1 秒降到 348 ms（NVIDIA L40S，23× 加速），仿真成功率保持 85.5%（RoboTwin 2.0）与 95.7%（LIBERO），真机 Unitree G1 平均 60%，而同预算朴素一致性蒸馏掉到 24%。
Motivation: WAM 用迭代扩散联合生成未来视频与机器人动作，需要数十步去噪，无法实时控制；现成单模态步蒸馏方法无法处理视频与动作流不同的 SNR-shifted 噪声调度和边缘噪声分布差异。
Method: 基于 consistency distillation 提出模态感知步蒸馏：对每个模态按其噪声体制选一致性函数——动作流低噪声区用 linear-gradient-scaling 参数化，视频流高噪声区用 variance-preserving 参数化；参数化选择由一致性函数族在一致性边界条件下的可达梯度缩放的结构性分析给出。在 LingBot-VA 上实例化。
Result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上每 chunk 延迟从 8.1 秒降至 348 ms（NVIDIA L40S），23× 加速并实现单步实时推理；仿真成功率保持 85.5%（RoboTwin 2.0）与 95.7%（LIBERO）；真机 Unitree G1 人形机器人平均恢复到 60%，而朴素一致性蒸馏在同一步预算下掉到 24%。
Conclusion: 联合视频-动作生成的步蒸馏必须按模态匹配噪声体制选一致性函数，否则单步压缩会摧毁动作性能；按此设计可在单步预算下保住仿真成功率并大幅恢复真机表现。

papers.title: Machine Learning for Coding Retail Product Names to Consumer-Price Categories: A Rule-plus-Bag-of-Words Pipeline with Reliability-Weighted Human-in-the-Loop Labeling
papers.abstract_en: Price statistics increasingly draw on scanner, web-scraped and receipt data, whose product descriptions are short, noisy and carry no standard product code, so each item must be coded to a consumption classification such as COICOP. National statistical offices already report that lightweight text classifiers are adequate for this task, but the published evidence is thin on dispersion, paired comparison, train-test overlap and measured computational cost. This paper supplies that evaluation. On an openly released synthetic benchmark of six COICOP-like categories, seven models are trained under one matched protocol and compared on accuracy and cost. A character n-gram logistic regression is the most accurate model in every category (mean F1 = 0.997, and 0.996 on test items unseen in training). The small CNN and LSTM examined here never win a comparison, but once trained to the same stopping criterion they are not reliably worse than the word-level models either; what separates them is cost, at 65 and 77 times the training time of the cheapest model. The most accurate model is not the cheapest: character features cut inference throughput to 44,900 items per second against 212,700 for unigram bag-of-words. A rule-based prefix-tree stage admits 75-86% of positive items, so it bounds the cascade's recall. A Monte Carlo study of the labeling protocol, in which annotators are simulated and no human annotation was collected, shows that an additive reliability weight barely improves on majority vote while Dawid-Skene aggregation recovers labels markedly better, and that the difference carries through to classifiers trained on those labels. The benchmark is synthetic because the production data behind the architecture are confidential; its generator applies character-level corruption and shares phrase sets with the rule stage, and both conditions are stated wherever a result depends on them.
papers.comment: v4: 25 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. The evaluation protocol is now matched on the training stopping rule as well as the data split; under it the CNN and LSTM reach 0.962 and 0.957 F1. Adds measured computational cost, a train-test overlap audit, robustness checks, and an expanded review of automated coding in official statistics. Code and data at doi:10.5281/zenodo.23124300
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇面向官方价格统计的文本分类评测论文，与天气、降水、数据同化无关：在合成的六类 COICOP 商品名基准上，用统一协议训练七个模型，字符 n-gram 逻辑回归在每一类都最准（mean F1 0.997，未见测试项 0.996），但推理吞吐只有 unigram bag-of-words 的 44,900 对 212,700 项/秒。规则前缀树级联放行 75–86% 正例从而决定级联召回上限；标注协议的 Monte Carlo 模拟显示 Dawid-Skene 聚合明显优于加性可靠性权重与多数投票，且差异会传递到下游分类器。
Motivation: 扫描、爬取与小票数据的商品描述短、噪声大且无标准商品码，需自动归入 COICOP 等消费分类；国家统计机构已称轻量文本分类器够用，但已发表证据在离散性、成对比较、训练-测试重叠与实测计算成本上都很薄弱。
Method: 在公开的合成六类 COICOP-like 基准上，按同一匹配协议（数据划分与训练停止规则一致）训练七个模型，比较准确率与成本；级联含基于前缀树的规则阶段；另用 Monte Carlo 模拟标注者（未收集真人标注）比较多数投票、加性可靠性权重与 Dawid-Skene 聚合，并做训练-测试重叠审计与稳健性检查。
Result: 字符 n-gram 逻辑回归在每个类别都最准，mean F1 0.997，训练中未见的测试项 0.996；小 CNN 与 LSTM 在同停止准则下 F1 分别为 0.962 与 0.957，从不赢下比较但也不可靠地更差，训练时间是最便宜模型的 65 倍与 77 倍。最准模型并非最便宜：字符特征推理吞吐 44,900 项/秒，unigram bag-of-words 为 212,700 项/秒。规则前缀树阶段接纳 75–86% 正例，从而限定级联召回。Monte Carlo 标注协议研究中加性可靠性权重仅略优于多数投票，Dawid-Skene 明显更好，且差异传递到用这些标签训练的分类器。
Conclusion: 在该合成基准与匹配协议下，字符 n-gram 逻辑回归是准确率与成本权衡中的首选，而 CNN/LSTM 的劣势主要是训练与推理成本而非精度；标注聚合应选 Dawid-Skene 而非加性可靠性权重。基准为合成数据，生成器施加字符级腐蚀并与规则阶段共享短语集，作者在依赖这些条件的结果处均予以标注。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Office Comprehension Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Office Comprehension Bench (OCB), the first public benchmark to jointly evaluate LLM systems on Word, Excel, and PowerPoint comprehension over native file formats (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) and their variants. OCB consists of two tracks. File Fidelity Q&A tests structural and visual perception of office artifacts - tables, charts, embedded images, formulas, and app-specific elements such as headers, speaker notes, and named ranges. Domain Q&A tests expert-level reasoning grounded in real-world industry documents across 12 professional domains, with queries requiring multi-step analysis and synthesis across documents. Each reference answer is decomposed into atomic, binary-gradable claims, and an ensemble of LLM judges scores responses against each claim independently. Even the strongest frontier system in its default reasoning mode reaches only about 59.3% on Domain Q&A; increasing thinking depth within a tier does not move performance materially, while moving to a higher product tier yields modest gains. We release the dataset, evaluation tooling, judge prompt, and a public leaderboard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OCB 是首个同时评测 LLM 对 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 原生文件（.docx/.xlsx/.pptx）及其变体理解能力的公开基准，含 File Fidelity Q&A 与 Domain Q&A 两条赛道，参考答案拆成原子化二元可判分断言并由 LLM 评审团逐条打分。最强前沿系统在默认推理模式下 Domain Q&A 仅约 59.3%；同档内加深思考几乎不涨分，升到更高产品档才有小幅提升。
Motivation: 现有评测缺少对办公原生文件结构与视觉要素（表格、图表、公式、页眉、演讲者备注、命名区域）以及跨文档专业推理的联合考察，难以刻画 LLM 在真实行业文档上的能力上限。
Method: OCB 分两条赛道：File Fidelity Q&A 考察办公文件的结构与视觉感知，Domain Q&A 覆盖 12 个专业领域的行业文档，查询要求跨文档多步分析与综合；每条参考答案分解为原子化、二元可判分断言，由 LLM 评审团对每条断言独立打分，并公开数据集、评测工具、评审提示词与排行榜。
Result: 最强前沿系统在默认推理模式下 Domain Q&A 仅约 59.3%；在同一产品档内增加思考深度对性能无实质影响，切换到更高产品档只带来温和增益。
Conclusion: 办公文件理解与跨文档专业推理对当前前沿 LLM 仍是明显短板，单纯加长推理不如提升模型档位有效。

papers.title: Zero Collapse: A Failure Mode of Policy Gradient Methods in Discontinuous Reward Environments
papers.abstract_en: Policy-gradient learning can deteriorate even after substantial initial improvement. We study this behavior in a repeated first-price auction setting with a sharp threshold between winning and losing bids. We identify a failure mode, zero collapse, in which a policy shifts into persistently near-zero reward as informative outcomes become rarely sampled. Experiments with REINFORCE and a TD state-value actor-critic illustrate this failure and evaluate practical mitigations. Adaptive update-magnitude control and smooth-output parameterization support sustained REINFORCE learning, while a learned baseline substantially stabilizes the fixed-rate comparison. Some actor-critic runs still collapse under these interventions. A diagnostic near one observed collapse reveals severe continuation-value errors that reverse the relative desirability of actions across the winning threshold. These results illustrate how thresholded outcomes, policy updates, and inaccurate value estimates can contribute to zero collapse, and demonstrate practical mitigations in the studied setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在胜负由出价阈值决定的一级价格重复拍卖中，策略梯度会出现 zero collapse：策略滑入持续近零奖励区，因为有信息的胜负结果几乎不再被采样。自适应更新幅度与平滑输出参数化可支撑 REINFORCE 持续学习，学习到的 baseline 显著稳定定步长对照，但部分 actor-critic 运行在这些干预下仍崩溃。
Motivation: 策略梯度在大幅初始改善后仍可能退化；在具有尖锐胜负阈值的不连续奖励环境中，稀有采样与错误价值估计会把策略推向近零奖励，这一失败模式此前缺少刻画。
Method: 在重复一级价格拍卖这一阈值型环境中识别 zero collapse 失败模式，用 REINFORCE 与 TD 状态价值 actor-critic 复现该失败并检验缓解手段：自适应更新幅度控制、平滑输出参数化、学习到的 baseline；并对一次观测到的崩溃做诊断分析。
Result: REINFORCE 与 TD actor-critic 实验展示了 zero collapse；自适应更新幅度控制与平滑输出参数化支撑 REINFORCE 持续学习，学习的 baseline 显著稳定定步长比较，部分 actor-critic 运行在这些干预下仍崩溃；对一次崩溃的诊断显示严重的 continuation-value 误差，使阈值两侧动作的相对优劣发生反转。
Conclusion: 阈值型结果、策略更新与不准确的价值估计共同造成 zero collapse，所研究场景中的实用缓解手段能减轻但不能完全消除该失败。

papers.title: YoCausal: How Far is Video Generation from World Model? A Causality Perspective
papers.abstract_en: As video diffusion models (VDMs) advance toward world models, a key question arises: do they truly understand causality, or merely overfit to statistical temporal patterns? Existing benchmarks mostly rely on synthetic data, limiting real-world generalization due to the sim-to-real gap. We present YoCausal, a two-level benchmark inspired by the Violation of Expectation (VoE) paradigm from cognitive science. By temporally reversing real-world videos at zero cost as natural counterfactual samples, YoCausal establishes an arbitrarily extensible evaluation protocol. Level 1 introduces the Reverse Surprise Index (RSI), quantifying arrow-of-time perception via denoising loss. Level 2 introduces the Causality Cognition Index (CCI), which leverages a VLM to stratify datasets into causal and non-causal subsets, disentangling genuine causal reasoning from temporal bias. Evaluation of 13 state-of-the-art VDMs reveals that perceiving the arrow of time does not imply understanding causality, and a significant gap persists relative to human-level causal cognition. Project page: https://www.youzhexie.me/papers/YoCausal/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: YoCausal 用真实视频的时间反转作为零成本自然反事实样本，按认知科学的 Violation of Expectation 范式构造两级因果评测：Level 1 用去噪损失定义 Reverse Surprise Index (RSI) 量化时间箭头感知，Level 2 借 VLM 把数据分层为因果与非因果子集，得到 Causality Cognition Index (CCI)。对 13 个最先进视频扩散模型 (VDM) 的评测显示：感知时间箭头并不等于理解因果，与人类水平的因果认知仍有显著差距。
Motivation: 现有视频生成因果基准多依赖合成数据，sim-to-real gap 限制真实世界泛化；同时难以区分模型是真做因果推理还是只拟合统计性时间模式。
Method: YoCausal 分两级：Level 1 通过时间反转真实视频得到反事实样本，用去噪损失计算 Reverse Surprise Index (RSI) 衡量时间箭头感知；Level 2 用 VLM 将数据分层为因果/非因果子集，提出 Causality Cognition Index (CCI)，把真正因果推理与时间偏置解耦。反转样本零成本，评测协议可任意扩展。
Result: 在 13 个 state-of-the-art VDM 上评测：感知时间箭头并不意味着理解因果，模型与人类水平因果认知之间仍存在显著差距。
Conclusion: 当前 VDM 更接近拟合统计时间模式而非掌握因果，视频生成要成为世界模型需跨过从时间箭头感知到因果认知的这道坎。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: The Model Shape Behind Scaling Laws: A Gradient Superposition Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Neural scaling laws guide resource allocation, but how should a fixed parameter budget be divided between depth and width? Motivated by inverse-width representation-error scaling under strong superposition, we study this allocation through the network's end-to-end response. The Neural Feature Ansatz links weight and gradient geometry, motivating the Frobenius norm $F$ of the input average gradient outer product (AGOP) as an observable of response strength and overlap. By reproducing Anthropic's toy-model double-descent experiment, we find that $F$ and test reconstruction loss follow an approximately affine relationship across the full sample-size sweep and share an interpolation peak. Through Gaussian minimum-norm regression experiments, we further show that this correlation arises from a fitted-noise amplification term shared by prediction error and $F$. By pretraining language models spanning different shapes and parameter budgets, we find a strong positive correlation between loss and $F$ among the best shapes selected by validation loss. This supports interpreting effective parameter allocation as preserving task-relevant computation while reducing the amplification of error responses. Our results identify error-response amplification as a mechanism linking gradient superposition to generalization, providing a functional account of depth-width allocation and efficient parameter utilization. The code is availale at: $\hyperlink{https://github.com/wenjie1835/Shape_Scaling}{https://github.com/wenjie1835/Shape_Scaling}$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把深度-宽度参数分配问题归结为梯度叠加下的误差响应放大：以输入平均梯度外积 (AGOP) 的 Frobenius 范数 F 作为响应强度与重叠的可观测量，发现 F 与测试重构损失近似仿射且共享插值峰，语言模型预训练中验证损失选出的最优形状上 loss 与 F 强正相关。
Motivation: 神经网络 scaling law 指导资源分配，但固定参数预算在深度与宽度之间如何切分缺少可解释的机制性说明。
Method: 由 Neural Feature Ansatz 联系权重与梯度几何，取 AGOP 的 Frobenius 范数 F 作为观测量；复现 Anthropic 玩具模型 double-descent 实验并做 Gaussian minimum-norm regression 实验，再预训练不同形状与参数量的语言模型检验 loss 与 F 的关系。
Result: 在全样本量扫描上 F 与测试重构损失近似仿射并共享插值峰；Gaussian minimum-norm 回归显示该相关性来自预测误差与 F 共享的拟合噪声放大项；不同形状与参数预算的语言模型预训练中，验证损失选出的最优形状上 loss 与 F 强正相关。
Conclusion: 误差响应放大是连接梯度叠加与泛化的机制，有效参数分配应保持任务相关计算同时降低误差响应放大，为深度-宽度分配提供功能性解释。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 由 Neural Feature Ansatz 联系权重与梯度几何，取 AGOP 的 Frobenius 范数 F 作为观测量；复现 Anthropic 玩具模型 double-descent 实验并做 Gaussian minimum-norm regression 实验，再预训练不同形状与参数量的语言模型检验 loss 与 F 的关系。
summary_sections.result: 在全样本量扫描上 F 与测试重构损失近似仿射并共享插值峰；Gaussian minimum-norm 回归显示该相关性来自预测误差与 F 共享的拟合噪声放大项；不同形状与参数预算的语言模型预训练中，验证损失选出的最优形状上 loss 与 F 强正相关。
summary_sections.conclusion: 误差响应放大是连接梯度叠加与泛化的机制，有效参数分配应保持任务相关计算同时降低误差响应放大，为深度-宽度分配提供功能性解释。

papers.title: CiteCheck: Retrieval-Grounded Detection of LLM Citation Hallucinations in Scientific Text
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate scientific reports, but they can produce references that appear plausible while containing corrupted metadata or pointing to papers that do not exist. We introduce CiteCheck, a hybrid framework for citation hallucination detection that verifies whether a citation corresponds to a real scholarly work and whether its metadata is faithful to that work. CiteCheck retrieves candidate publications from external scholarly sources, compares the citation against the retrieved candidate using a structured LLM verifier, and maps verifier scores into three labels: Exact, Minor, and Major. We also construct a 982-citation physics benchmark with controlled corruptions that capture both subtle metadata drift and fully fabricated references. On the held-out test set, CiteCheck achieves 88.7 macro-F1 and 88.9% accuracy, outperforming GPT, Claude, and Gemini baselines, including web-search and few-shot variants. These results show that reliable citation verification benefits from combining scholarly retrieval, structured LLM-based comparison, and calibrated decision rules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CiteCheck 用「学术检索 + 结构化 LLM 校验器 + 校准决策规则」的混合框架判定引用是否指向真实文献、元数据是否忠实，并把校验分数映射为 Exact/Minor/Major 三档标签。在自建的 982 条受控腐蚀物理引用基准上，held-out 测试集 macro-F1 88.7、准确率 88.9%，超过 GPT、Claude、Gemini 及其 web-search 与 few-shot 变体。
Motivation: LLM 生成科学报告时会给出看似合理但元数据损坏或根本不存在的参考文献，纯 LLM 判断难以核实引用真实性。
Method: 先从外部学术数据源检索候选文献，再用结构化 LLM verifier 将引用与候选逐项比对，最后用校准决策规则把分数映射为 Exact/Minor/Major 三档；并构造含受控腐蚀（细微元数据漂移与完全捏造）的 982 条物理引用基准。
Result: 在 982 条受控腐蚀物理引用基准的 held-out 测试集上，CiteCheck macro-F1 88.7、准确率 88.9%，优于 GPT、Claude、Gemini 基线（含 web-search 与 few-shot 变体）。
Conclusion: 可靠的引用核验需要学术检索、结构化 LLM 比对与校准决策规则三者结合，而非单靠 LLM 直接判断。

papers.title: Measuring the Depth of LLM Unlearning via Activation Patching
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) unlearning has emerged as a crucial post-hoc mechanism for privacy protection and AI safety, yet auditing whether target knowledge is truly erased remains challenging. Existing output-level metrics fail to detect when this knowledge remains recoverable from internal representations. Recent white-box studies reveal such residual knowledge but often rely on auxiliary training or dataset-specific adaptations, leaving no generalizable metric. We close this gap with the Unlearning Depth Score (UDS), a metric that quantifies the mechanistic depth of unlearning via activation patching. UDS first identifies layers that encode the target knowledge using a retain model baseline, then measures how much of it is erased in the unlearned model on a 0-1 scale. In a meta-evaluation across 20 metrics on 150 unlearned models spanning 8 methods, UDS achieves the highest faithfulness and robustness, confirming our causal approach as the most reliable for unlearning evaluation. Case studies further show that UDS uncovers residual knowledge obscured from observational metrics by representational shifts, with erasure depth varying across prompt types. We provide guidelines for integrating UDS into existing benchmarking frameworks and streamlining the evaluation pipeline. Code and data are available at https://github.com/gnueaj/unlearning-depth-score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Unlearning Depth Score (UDS)，用 activation patching 定位编码目标知识的层，再在 0–1 尺度上度量该知识在遗忘模型中被抹除的深度。在覆盖 8 种遗忘方法、150 个已遗忘模型、20 个指标的 meta-evaluation 中，UDS 的 faithfulness 与 robustness 最高，并能揭出被表征偏移掩盖、观测类指标看不到的残余知识。
Motivation: LLM 遗忘的审计停留在输出层指标，检测不到仍可从内部表征恢复的知识；已有白盒方法依赖辅助训练或特定数据集，缺少可泛化的度量。
Method: UDS 先用 retain model 基线识别编码目标知识的层，再用 activation patching 度量这些知识在被遗忘模型中被抹除的程度，输出 0–1 分数；在 20 个指标、150 个已遗忘模型、8 种方法上做 meta-evaluation，并给出接入现有 benchmarking 框架的指南。
Result: 在 20 个指标、150 个已遗忘模型、8 种方法的 meta-evaluation 中，UDS 取得最高的 faithfulness 与 robustness；案例研究显示 UDS 能发现被表征偏移遮蔽、观测类指标看不到的残余知识，且抹除深度随 prompt 类型变化。
Conclusion: 基于因果干预 (activation patching) 的遗忘深度度量比输出层观测指标更可靠，可直接嵌入现有 LLM 遗忘评测流程。

papers.title: Towards Direct Evaluation of Harness Optimizers via Priority Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Harness optimization enables automated agent creation by having an optimizer agent iteratively update the harness of target agents. Despite its success, current studies evaluate optimizers solely by observing target agents' performance gains. This indirect end-improvement evaluation neglects optimizers' actions at intermediate steps, which are often erroneous and hinder agent performance in deployment. Therefore, it is unclear whether harness optimization is driven by optimizers' informed update actions or simply trial-and-error. This necessitates direct evaluation of harness optimizers. However, evaluating harness optimizers directly is non-trivial and costly due to the lack of oracle harnesses. To address this, we present a simple, low-cost design to directly evaluate them, namely priority ranking. By asking harness optimizers to rank components (e.g., tools) in a given harness by their potential to improve/hinder agent performance when updated, our design quantifies optimizer ability at the step level without expensive rollouts or manual examination. More importantly, optimizers' ranking performance correlates with their ability to improve agents in actual multi-step harness optimization, establishing priority ranking as a reliable indicator of optimization ability. Priority ranking is enabled by SHOR, a collection of 182 human-verified optimization scenarios spanning across domains, designs, and time stages. Code and data: https://github.com/k59118/Harness_Optimizer_Evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 priority ranking：让 harness optimizer 对给定 harness 中各组件（如工具）按更新后提升或损害 agent 性能的潜力排序，从而在步骤级直接度量优化能力，无需昂贵 rollout 或人工检查。该排序表现与 optimizer 在真实多步 harness 优化中提升 agent 的能力相关，可作为优化能力的可靠指标；支撑数据是含 182 个人工核验优化场景的 SHOR。
Motivation: 现有研究只看目标 agent 最终性能增益来评价 optimizer，忽略中间步骤中常出错、会在部署时拖累性能的更新动作，因而无法区分 harness 优化究竟由有信息量的更新驱动还是纯试错；直接评价又因缺少 oracle harness 而非平凡且昂贵。
Method: 设计 priority ranking：要求 harness optimizer 对给定 harness 的组件（例如工具）按其被更新时提升或阻碍 agent 表现的潜力排序，在步骤级量化能力，不需昂贵 rollout 或人工检查。该设计由 SHOR 支撑，这是一个覆盖不同领域、设计与时间阶段、含 182 个人工核验优化场景的数据集合。
Result: optimizer 的排序表现与其在真实多步 harness 优化中提升 agent 的能力相关；SHOR 包含 182 个人工核验的优化场景，跨领域、设计与时间阶段。
Conclusion: 在没有 oracle harness 的情况下，priority ranking 这一低成本直接评价方式能作为 harness 优化能力的可靠指标，把评价从最终增益推进到中间更新动作本身。
