papers.title: CompoSE: Compositional Synthesis and Editing of 3D Shapes via Part-Aware Control
papers.abstract_en: Creating and editing high-quality 3D content remains a central challenge in computer graphics. We address this challenge by introducing CompoSE, a novel method for Compositional Synthesis and Editing of 3D shapes via part-aware control. Our method takes as input a set of coarse geometric primitives (e.g., bounding boxes) that represent distinct object parts arranged in a particular spatial configuration, and synthesizes as output part-separated 3D objects that support localized granular (i.e., compositional) editing of individual parts. The key insight that enables our method is our use of a diffusion transformer architecture that alternates between processing each part locally and aggregating contextual information across parts globally, and features a novel conditioning technique that ensures strong adherence to the user's input. Importantly, our method learns to infer part semantics and symmetries directly from the user's coarse layout guidance, and does not require part-level text prompts. We demonstrate that our method enables powerful part-level editing capabilities, including context-aware substitution, addition, deletion, and style-preserving resizing operations. We show through extensive experiments that our method significantly outperforms existing approaches on guided synthesis, as measured by objective metrics and LLM-based evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CompoSE 用部件感知的扩散 Transformer 做 3D 形状的组合式合成与编辑：输入一组粗几何基元（如包围盒）表示各部件的空间排布，交替做部件局部处理与跨部件全局聚合，直接从布局推断部件语义与对称性，无需部件级文本提示。输出部件分离的 3D 物体，支持上下文感知的部件替换、增删与保风格缩放；在引导合成上以客观指标和 LLM 评测显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 高质量 3D 内容的创建与编辑仍是计算机图形学的核心难题：现有方法难以在给定粗布局下生成部件分离、可局部细粒度编辑的物体。
Method: 核心是扩散 Transformer (diffusion transformer)，交替处理每个部件的局部信息并跨部件聚合全局上下文；配合新的条件注入技术以严格贴合用户输入的粗几何基元布局，从布局本身学习部件语义与对称性，不依赖部件级文本提示。
Result: 在引导合成 (guided synthesis) 上显著优于现有方法，评测同时采用客观指标与 LLM-based evaluations；并演示了上下文感知的部件替换、添加、删除与保风格缩放等部件级编辑能力。
Conclusion: 粗布局加部件感知的交替局部-全局扩散建模，足以在无需部件级文本提示的条件下实现可组合的 3D 合成与局部编辑。

papers.title: ECG-WM: A Physiology-Informed ECG World Model for Clinical Intervention Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Electrocardiogram (ECG)-based models have achieved strong performance in diagnostic tasks, yet they remain limited in modeling how cardiac dynamics evolve under external interventions. In particular, existing approaches focus primarily on static prediction and lack mechanisms to capture ECG variations under different pharmacological conditions. In this work, we propose an ECG World Model for action-conditioned predictive simulation of cardiac electrophysiology. Moving beyond disjoint pipelines, our framework features a principled integration of physiological ordinary differential equation (ODE) priors into latent diffusion dynamics via energy regularization. This structural constraint enables the synthesis of physiologically plausible post-intervention ECG trajectories while effectively mitigating generative hallucinations. Building on this simulation process, we introduce an uncertainty-aware evaluation strategy that leverages the stochasticity of diffusion sampling to characterize both the expected clinical risk and its variability, allowing a more reliable comparative assessment of candidate interventions. We evaluate our method across diverse settings, including controlled drug-response scenarios and real-world clinical records. Beyond standard waveform metrics, experimental results demonstrate improved risk calibration and strong alignment with expert-informed treatment preferences. These results establish our approach as a robust foundation for safe and intervention-aware clinical decision support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ECG-WM 把生理 ODE 先验通过能量正则嵌入 latent diffusion 动力学，做动作条件下的心脏电生理仿真：给定药物等外部干预，生成干预后 ECG 轨迹并抑制生成式幻觉。利用 diffusion 采样的随机性做不确定性感知评估，同时刻画期望临床风险及其变异，用于比较候选干预；在药物响应场景与真实临床记录上，风险校准改善且与专家治疗偏好对齐。
Motivation: 现有 ECG 模型只做静态诊断预测，无法刻画心脏动力学在不同药物条件下的演化，也缺少对干预后变化的建模机制。
Method: 提出 ECG World Model：将生理 ordinary differential equation (ODE) 先验通过能量正则 (energy regularization) 整合进 latent diffusion 动力学，约束生成出生理上合理的干预后 ECG 轨迹；再利用 diffusion 采样的随机性构建不确定性感知评估策略，输出期望临床风险及其变异。
Result: 在受控药物响应场景与真实临床记录上评估：除标准波形指标外，风险校准 (risk calibration) 改善，且与专家治疗偏好 (expert-informed treatment preferences) 高度对齐。
Conclusion: 生理先验约束的 diffusion 仿真可作为安全、干预感知的临床决策支持基础，同时给出可比较候选干预的风险分布。

papers.title: Nudging Beyond the Comfort Zone: Efficient Strategy-Guided Exploration for RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a scalable paradigm for improving the mathematical reasoning of large language models, but it is fundamentally limited by exploration: the policy can only improve on trajectories it has already sampled. Sampling more rollouts alleviates this at prohibitive compute cost, while objective-level modifications offer little control over what is explored. We propose NudgeRL, a framework for structured, diversity-driven exploration in RLVR whose core component, Strategy Nudging, conditions each rollout on a lightweight strategy-level context, without requiring the context generator to solve the problem itself. To learn from such exploration, we decompose the advantage into inter- and intra-context terms and add a policy correction term that transfers discovered behaviors back to the base policy. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, NudgeRL with 8 rollouts matches the strongest GRPO baseline using 32 rollouts with roughly 5 times fewer total tokens and 2.9 times less training compute. Our code is available at https://github.com/tally0818/NudgeRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NudgeRL 在 RLVR 中用轻量策略级上下文对每条 rollout 做 Strategy Nudging，引导多样化探索，并把优势分解为跨上下文与内上下文两项、加策略校正项把发现的行为回传给 base policy。在五个数学推理基准上，8 条 rollout 的 NudgeRL 追平最强 GRPO 基线用 32 条 rollout 的效果，总 token 少约 5 倍、训练算力少 2.9 倍。
Motivation: RLVR 受探索瓶颈制约：策略只能在已采样到的轨迹上改进，多采 rollout 代价过高，而目标层面的改动对探索内容缺少控制。
Method: 核心是 Strategy Nudging：每条 rollout 以轻量策略级上下文为条件，上下文生成器本身无需解题；训练时把优势分解为 inter-context 与 intra-context 两项，并加入 policy correction term 把新发现的行为迁移回 base policy。
Result: 在五个数学推理基准上，NudgeRL 用 8 rollouts 追平最强 GRPO 基线用 32 rollouts 的表现，总 token 消耗约少 5 倍，训练算力少 2.9 倍。
Conclusion: 结构化、多样性驱动的策略引导探索能在大幅降低采样与训练开销的前提下达到与更多 rollout 相当的 RLVR 效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Stability of Growth in Structural Plasticity: Forward-Active yet Backward-Starved
papers.abstract_en: Standard deep-learning pipelines usually choose the network architecture before training and keep it fixed throughout optimization. In contrast, a model can also be adapted by editing its structure during training, for example by pruning existing hidden units or growing new ones; however, growth is not simply the inverse of pruning. Pruning selects among units trained from initialization, whereas growth inserts new capacity into an already specialized optimization trajectory. We isolate this insertion problem and show that newborn units can be forward-active yet backward-starved, receiving substantially weaker gradient signal than incumbent units. This asymmetry is weak in small MLPs but emerges in more challenging convolutional settings, where \textsc{Grow} reaches competitive final architectures despite weaker trajectory-level performance. Extending structural edits to residual networks reveals a strong dependence on edit location: head-localized growth produces concentrated but task-aligned representations and faster bounded label remapping, whereas growth throughout the residual hierarchy yields lower effective feature support, and a lower bounded adaptation endpoint. Interventions targeting optimizer state, insertion, selection, and trainability improve newborn integration, but not necessarily final subnetwork quality. Across continual-learning benchmarks, growth is most competitive when newborn units have sufficient time and trainability to integrate. Therefore, \textsc{Grow} should be evaluated not only by the architecture it ultimately discovers, but by whether late-arriving capacity becomes usable before a new structural change occurs during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把结构生长 (structural growth) 从剪枝中剥离出来单独研究，发现新生单元前向活跃但反向饥饿 (forward-active yet backward-starved)：其梯度信号显著弱于既有单元。该不对称在小 MLP 中很弱，在更具挑战的卷积设定中显现，Grow 仍能达到有竞争力的最终架构但轨迹级表现更弱；在残差网络中生长位置决定结果，头部局部生长得到集中且任务对齐的表征与更快的有界标签重映射，而全层级生长则降低有效特征支持与有界适应终点。结论是 Grow 不应只按最终发现的架构评价，而要看新容量是否在下一次结构改动发生前变得可用。
Motivation: 标准深度学习管线先定架构再训练且全程固定，结构编辑（剪枝/生长）在训练中改结构，但生长不是剪枝的逆过程：剪枝从初始化训练的单元中挑选，生长是往已特化的优化轨迹里插入新容量，插入单元能否被整合缺乏判据。
Method: 隔离插入问题，对比 Grow 与剪枝类方法在 MLP、卷积设定与残差网络上的结构编辑；在残差网络中改变编辑位置（头部局部 vs 全残差层级），并干预优化器状态、插入方式、选择与可训练性 (trainability) 以改善新生单元整合；在持续学习基准上检验生长时机。
Result: 新生单元收到的梯度信号显著弱于既有单元，该不对称在小 MLP 中弱、在卷积设定中显现，Grow 达到有竞争力的最终架构但轨迹级表现更弱；残差网络中头部局部生长产生集中且任务对齐的表征和更快的有界标签重映射，全层级生长导致更低的有效特征支持与更低的有界适应终点；针对优化器状态、插入、选择与可训练性的干预改善新生单元整合，但不必然提升最终子网络质量。
Conclusion: 生长在持续学习基准上最有竞争力的条件是新单元有足够时间和可训练性完成整合；因此评价 Grow 要看迟到容量是否在下一次结构改动前变得可用，而不只看它最终发现的架构。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: From Table to Cell: Attention for Better Reasoning with TABALIGN
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step LLM reasoning over structured tables fails because planning and execution share no explicit cell-grounding contract. Existing methods constrain the planner to a left-to-right factorization at odds with table permutation invariance, and score intermediate states by generated content alone, overlooking cell grounding. We conduct a pilot study showing that diffusion language models (DLMs) produce more human-aligned and permutation-stable cell attention on tables than autoregressive models, with a 40.2% median reduction in attention-AUROC variability under row reordering. Motivated by this, we propose TABALIGN, a planned table reasoning framework that operationalizes the contract. TABALIGN pairs a masked DLM planner, whose bidirectional denoising emits plan steps as binary cell masks, with TABATTN, a lightweight verifier trained on 1,600 human-verified attention standards to score each step by its attention overlap with the plan-designated mask. Across eight benchmarks covering table question answering and fact verification, TABALIGN improves average accuracy by 15.76 percentage points over the strongest open-source baseline at comparable 8B-class scale, with a matched-backbone ablation attributing 2.87 percentage points of this gain to the DLM planner over an AR planner on a fixed reasoner. Cleaner DLM plans also accelerate downstream reasoning execution by 44.64%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TABALIGN 把表格多步推理的规划与执行绑定到显式 cell 掩码契约：掩码式扩散语言模型 (DLM) 规划器输出二值 cell mask，轻量验证器 TABATTN 按注意力与掩码的重合度给每步打分。在八个表格问答与事实核查基准上，平均准确率比最强开源基线高 15.76 个百分点，其中 DLM 规划器贡献 2.87 个百分点，下游推理执行加速 44.64%。
Motivation: LLM 表格多步推理中规划与执行缺少显式 cell-grounding 契约：现有方法把规划器限制在与表格置换不变性冲突的从左到右分解上，且只按生成内容给中间状态打分，忽略 cell 落点。
Method: TABALIGN 配对一个掩码 DLM 规划器（双向去噪把计划步发射为二值 cell mask）与 TABATTN——一个在 1,600 条人工核验注意力标准上训练的轻量验证器，按注意力与计划指定掩码的重合度为每步打分；另有固定 reasoner 下 DLM 与 AR 规划器的 matched-backbone 消融。
Result: 先导研究中 DLM 相对自回归模型在行重排下注意力 AUROC 变异性中位数降低 40.2%；八个表格问答与事实验证基准上平均准确率较最强开源基线（同为 8B 级规模）提升 15.76 个百分点，其中 2.87 个百分点归因于 DLM 规划器；下游推理执行加速 44.64%。
Conclusion: 把规划显式落到 cell 掩码并用注意力重合度校验，可同时提升表格推理准确率与执行速度；增益中有一部分来自 DLM 规划器本身而非 reasoner。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MAGE: Multi-Agent Self-Evolution with Co-Evolutionary Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving language-model agents must decide what to learn next and how to preserve what they have learned across iterations. Existing systems typically carry this cross-iteration knowledge as natural-language feedback, flat episodic memory, or implicit reinforcement signals, none of which cleanly supports a frozen weak backbone at inference time. This paper introduces MAGE (Multi-Agent Graph-guided Evolution), a framework that externalizes self-knowledge into a four-subgraph co-evolutionary knowledge graph. Its experience subgraph stores both teacher-written failure corrections and the learner's own past correct reasoning traces, which are retrieved as task-conditioned guidance for a frozen execution model. During evolution, the graph, a task-level search bandit, and a skill-level routing bandit are updated from the same reward stream, while the learner's backbone remains unchanged. We further provide structural analysis showing how append-only memory growth, bounded curriculum coverage, and task-filtered retrieval together support stable improvement of the retrieval substrate for frozen-learner evolution. Across nine benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, multi-hop and open-domain question answering, spatio-temporal analysis, financial numerical reasoning, medical multiple-choice, an open-world survival game, and web navigation, MAGE achieves strong performance against prompt-based frozen-backbone baselines. Ablations show that self-harvested success traces and teacher-written corrections are complementary, with success memories contributing most on reasoning-template-heavy tasks and corrective memories supporting harder composition and interaction settings. Code is available in https://github.com/RuiyiYang01/mage-alg
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAGE 把自进化 agent 的跨迭代自知识外化为四子图协同演化知识图谱，经验子图同时存教师写的失败纠正与学习者自己过去的正确推理轨迹，作为任务条件化检索的指导喂给推理时冻结的执行模型；图、任务级搜索 bandit 与技能级路由 bandit 从同一条奖励流同步更新，学习者 backbone 全程不变。在覆盖数学推理、多跳与开放域 QA、时空分析、金融数值推理、医学多选、开放世界生存游戏与网页导航的九个基准上，相对 prompt 式冻结骨干基线取得强表现，消融显示自收获成功轨迹与教师纠正互补。
Motivation: 自进化 LM agent 的跨迭代知识目前多以自然语言反馈、扁平情景记忆或隐式强化信号承载，都无法在推理时支撑冻结的弱骨干，导致学到的东西难以跨迭代保留并复用。
Method: 提出 MAGE (Multi-Agent Graph-guided Evolution)：四子图协同演化知识图谱，经验子图存教师失败纠正与学习者正确推理轨迹，检索为任务条件化指导供冻结执行模型使用；演化中图、任务级搜索 bandit、技能级路由 bandit 共用同一奖励流更新，并给出关于 append-only 记忆增长、有界课程覆盖与任务过滤检索的结构性分析。
Result: 在九个基准（数学推理、多跳与开放域 QA、时空分析、金融数值推理、医学多选、开放世界生存游戏、网页导航）上相对 prompt-based 冻结骨干基线表现强；消融显示自收获成功轨迹与教师纠正互补，成功记忆在推理模板密集任务上贡献最大，纠正记忆支撑更难的组合与交互设置。
Conclusion: 把自知识外化为结构化协同演化图谱，可在 backbone 完全冻结的条件下实现稳定改进；两类记忆不可互相替代，应按任务类型搭配使用。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: Your Language Model is Its Own Critic: Reinforcement Learning with Value Estimation from Actor's Internal States
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for Large Reasoning Models rests on variance reduction, which requires both a reliable baseline and high prompt diversity within each training batch. This is especially difficult in multi-domain training for general reasoning models, where prompts from different tasks induce highly diverse gradient signals. Existing approaches fall short in different ways: GRPO estimates its baseline as the group mean over rollouts from the same prompt, so an accurate baseline leaves fewer distinct prompts in the batch, while PPO avoids this trade-off by training a policy scale critic, roughly doubling the cost of training. We introduce POISE (Policy Optimization with Internal State Value Estimation), a reinforcement learning algorithm that turns the model's internal states into a value model. A lightweight probe reads the signals already computed during the forward pass to predict the baseline, and is trained online alongside the policy. To preserve gradient unbiasedness, we introduce a cross-rollout construction that predicts each rollout's value from an independent rollout's internal states. On Qwen3-4B and OLMo3-7B-Instruct-DPO across a six-domain verifiable-reward corpus, POISE outperforms other RLVR baselines while achieving more stable training. Moreover, the probe matches a separate LLM-scale value model, generalizes to various tasks, and remains accurate as the policy scales. By leveraging the model's internal representations, POISE enables stable policy optimization.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026; Project Page: https://holi-lab.github.io/POISE/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: POISE 用轻量 probe 直接读取前向传播中已算出的内部状态来预测 RLVR 的 baseline，替代 GRPO 的同 prompt 组均值与 PPO 的独立 critic。跨 rollout 构造保证梯度无偏，在 Qwen3-4B 与 OLMo3-7B-Instruct-DPO 的六领域可验证奖励语料上超过其他 RLVR 基线且训练更稳定，probe 达到 LLM 规模 value model 的精度。
Motivation: RLVR 的方差削减同时需要可靠 baseline 和批内 prompt 多样性：GRPO 用同 prompt 组均值做 baseline 会挤占批内不同 prompt 数量，PPO 训练独立 critic 又大致让训练开销翻倍，多领域训练时梯度信号高度多样使这一矛盾更尖锐。
Method: POISE (Policy Optimization with Internal State Value Estimation) 训练一个轻量 probe，读取前向传播中已计算的内部状态信号来在线预测 baseline，与 policy 同步训练；为保持梯度无偏，采用 cross-rollout 构造，用另一条独立 rollout 的内部状态预测当前 rollout 的 value。
Result: 在 Qwen3-4B 与 OLMo3-7B-Instruct-DPO、六领域可验证奖励语料上，POISE 超过其他 RLVR 基线且训练更稳定；probe 匹配独立的 LLM 规模 value model，能泛化到多种任务，并在 policy 规模扩大时保持准确。
Conclusion: 模型前向传播中已有的内部表征足以充当 value model，可在不引入独立 critic 开销的前提下实现稳定的策略优化。

papers.title: Mask2Cause: Temporal Causal Discovery Beyond Causality in Mean
papers.abstract_en: One approach to discovering causal relationships in multivariate time series is to ask whether a variable's history improves prediction of another variable. When this improvement is measured solely by reductions in optimal squared error, the criterion misses relationships that affect the target's conditional variance without changing its conditional mean. We propose Mask2Cause, an end-to-end Transformer framework for causal discovery through conditional mean and variance prediction. Each variable's history is embedded as a separate token, and a single learnable adjacency matrix, shared across layers and attention heads, controls information exchange between tokens. Gaussian negative log-likelihood and a sparsity penalty on this matrix jointly train the forecasting model and graph. Our population analysis connects the optimal log-loss reduction to causally conditioned directed information, providing an information-theoretic motivation for the training objective. We introduce Mixed Physics, a benchmark with separately controlled mean and variance dependencies, to evaluate recovery of mean-only and variance-only edges. In its pure-variance setting, Mask2Cause achieves 1.000 off-diagonal AUROC, compared with 0.521 for a corresponding squared-error model. Experiments on linear, chaotic, biological, and real-data-derived benchmarks demonstrate competitive graph recovery, while the inferred graphs support downstream tasks such as causal pruning for efficient forecasting and root-cause localization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mask2Cause 用 Transformer 同时预测条件均值与条件方差来做时间序列因果发现：每个变量历史作为一个 token，单个跨层跨头共享的可学习邻接矩阵控制 token 间信息交换，以 Gaussian NLL 加稀疏惩罚联合训练预报模型与图。在纯方差依赖的 Mixed Physics 基准上，off-diagonal AUROC 达 1.000，而对应的平方误差模型只有 0.521。
Motivation: 仅用最优平方误差下降判定因果，会漏掉只改变目标条件方差、不改变条件均值的关系，这类方差通道的边在均值准则下不可恢复。
Method: 端到端 Transformer：变量历史各自嵌入为 token，单个可学习邻接矩阵在所有层与注意力头间共享并控制 token 信息交换；训练目标为 Gaussian 负对数似然加该矩阵的稀疏惩罚，同时拟合预报模型与图。群体分析 (population analysis) 把最优 log-loss 下降与因果条件有向信息 (causally conditioned directed information) 联系起来，为训练目标提供信息论依据。
Result: 新建基准 Mixed Physics 分别可控地注入均值依赖与方差依赖，用于评估 mean-only 与 variance-only 边的恢复；在其 pure-variance 设定中 Mask2Cause off-diagonal AUROC 为 1.000，对应平方误差模型为 0.521。在线性、混沌、生物及真实数据衍生基准上图恢复具竞争力，推断出的图可支撑因果剪枝以高效预报和根因定位等下游任务。
Conclusion: 把条件方差纳入训练目标才能恢复只影响方差的因果边，均值准则在这类边上接近随机水平；推断图可直接用于因果剪枝预报与根因定位。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: When Can Voting Help, Hurt, or Change Course? Exact Structure of Binary Test-Time Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Increasing a voting budget can improve or reduce population accuracy, and an initial gain or loss need not persist. We give a complete structural classification of these curves for binary unweighted majority under infinitely exchangeable correctness indicators, with an arbitrary latent success-probability law $Π$. The classification is encoded by the signed voting signature $ ω_Π(B)=\int \mathbf{1}\{q(1-q)\in B\}(2q-1)\,Π(\,\mathrm{d} q). $ The complete odd-budget curve and this signature determine each other: the initial accuracy gives its total signed mass, and successive budget increments give its higher moments. Reflection-symmetric differences between latent laws are exactly the changes invisible to voting. A weighted total-variation constraint characterizes every attainable signature, and a minimum-mass allocation to the two reflected branches, completed by symmetric probability mass, gives every population producing its curve. Consequently, the full curve identifies the latent population precisely when no symmetric mass remains to redistribute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在二元无权多数投票、正确性指标无穷可交换且潜在成功概率服从任意分布 Π 的设定下，给出投票预算—总体准确率曲线的完整结构分类：曲线由带符号投票签名 ω_Π(B)=∫1{q(1-q)∈B}(2q-1)Π(dq) 完全刻画，且曲线与该签名互相决定。初始准确率给出签名的总带符号质量，逐次预算增量给出其高阶矩；对潜在分布做反射对称的差异恰好是投票完全看不见的变化，只有当没有可再分配的对称质量时曲线才唯一识别潜在总体。
Motivation: 增加投票预算既可能提高也可能降低总体准确率，且初期的升或降未必持续；此前缺少对这类曲线何时升、何时降、何时反转的完整刻画，也未说清仅凭投票曲线能否反推潜在成功概率分布。
Method: 在无穷可交换 (infinitely exchangeable) 正确性指标与任意潜在成功概率律 Π 下，用带符号投票签名 ω_Π(B)=∫1{q(1-q)∈B}(2q-1)Π(dq) 编码结构；证明完整奇数预算曲线与该签名互相决定（初始准确率给总带符号质量，逐次预算增量给高阶矩），并用加权全变差约束刻画所有可达签名，再以对两反射分支的最小质量分配加对称概率质量补全，构造出产生给定曲线的全部潜在总体。
Result: 完整奇数预算曲线与签名 ω_Π 互相决定：初始准确率等于签名的总带符号质量，相邻预算增量给出其各阶高阶矩；反射对称的分布差异恰好对应投票不可见的变化；加权全变差约束刻画全部可达签名，最小质量分配加对称补全可生成任一给定曲线的潜在总体；曲线精确识别潜在总体当且仅当不再有对称质量可再分配。
Conclusion: 投票预算曲线的全部升降与反转信息都压缩在带符号签名 ω_Π 中，而识别潜在总体的充要条件是反射对称质量已被用尽、无剩余可再分配。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Adaptive Inverted-Index Routing for Granular Mixtures-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models enable scalable transformer architectures by activating only a subset of experts per token. Recent evidence suggests that performance improves with increasingly granular experts, i.e., many small experts instead of a few large ones. However, this regime substantially increases routing cost, which can dominate computation and memory. We introduce adaptive inverted-index routing for MoE (AIR-MoE), an inverted-index-inspired routing architecture based on vector quantization (VQ). In a first stage, AIR-MoE performs coarse shortlisting by assigning tokens to VQ codewords to construct a candidate set of experts. In a second stage, fine scoring computes exact routing scores restricted to this shortlist. This two-stage procedure approximates true top-K routing while avoiding full expert scoring and, in contrast to prior work, imposing no structural constraints on expert parameters. AIR-MoE serves as a drop-in replacement for standard routers and requires no modifications to the model architecture or loss function. We further provide a lower bound on the mass recall achieved by AIR-MoE that yields insights into the inner workings. Empirically, AIR-MoE improves the perplexity-FLOPs trade-off over existing MoE routers in regimes with up to more than a million tiny experts, and achieves consistent perplexity improvements over the best existing baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AIR-MoE：用向量量化 (VQ) 码字做倒排索引式两阶段路由，先粗筛候选专家、再在短名单内精算打分，逼近真实 top-K 而不对专家参数加结构约束。在多达一百万个以上微型专家的粒度下，AIR-MoE 改善 perplexity-FLOPs 权衡，并相对最优已有基线取得一致的 perplexity 提升。
Motivation: 专家粒度越细性能越好，但路由开销会随专家数量膨胀并主导计算与内存；已有路由方案往往对专家参数施加结构约束。
Method: 两阶段倒排索引式路由：第一阶段把 token 分配到 VQ 码字构造候选专家集 (shortlist)，第二阶段只在该短名单上计算精确路由分数，近似 top-K；作为标准 router 的 drop-in 替换，不改模型架构与损失函数；另给出 AIR-MoE 所达 mass recall 的下界。
Result: 在多达一百万个以上微型专家 (more than a million tiny experts) 的设置下，AIR-MoE 相对已有 MoE 路由器改善 perplexity-FLOPs 权衡，并相对最优已有基线取得一致的 perplexity 提升。
Conclusion: 细粒度 MoE 的路由开销可以用 VQ 短名单加精打分的两阶段结构压下去，且无需改动专家参数结构或训练目标。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Two Calls, Two Moments, and the Vote-Accuracy Curve of Repeated LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Repeated sampling can improve LLM accuracy, and quantifying the gains from additional calls is essential for allocating test-time compute. We study binary decisions, a fundamental setting where repeated answers to the same question are aggregated by majority vote. We show that two independently sampled responses per example in a validation set with known answers constrain the latent distribution of example-level success probabilities to a class consistent with the paired outcomes. Optimizing over this class yields sharp accuracy and gain bounds at every finite voting budget. A shared large-sample confidence region accounts for validation uncertainty. We also obtain sharp infinite-vote bounds and moment-matched forecasts of the vote-accuracy curve. On QNLI and QQP, our method successfully distinguishes settings with voting gains above a target margin from those with little room for improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对重复采样 LLM 的多数投票，提出用每个样本两次独立采样的配对结果约束潜在成功概率分布类，在该类上优化得到任意有限投票预算下的尖锐精度与增益界，并用共享大样本置信域计入验证集不确定性。在 QNLI 与 QQP 上，该方法能把投票增益超过目标边际的设置与改进空间很小的设置区分开。
Motivation: 重复采样能提升 LLM 精度，但要分配 test-time compute 就需要知道增加投票次数的边际收益；缺少在有限投票预算下对精度与增益的可靠上下界。
Method: 对每个样本做两次独立采样，用配对结果把潜在的逐例成功概率分布约束为与配对一致的分布类；在该类上优化得到每个有限投票预算的尖锐精度与增益界，并用共享大样本置信域刻画验证集不确定性，另给出无限投票的尖锐界与矩匹配 (moment-matched) 的投票-精度曲线预测。
Result: 在 QNLI 与 QQP 上，该方法成功区分了投票增益高于目标边际的设置与改进空间很小的设置；同时给出有限预算的尖锐精度/增益界、共享大样本置信域、无限投票的尖锐界与矩匹配曲线预测。
Conclusion: 两次采样的配对结果足以约束重复投票的精度-增益曲线，从而在有限与无限投票预算下给出可用于 test-time compute 分配的尖锐界。

summary_sections.result: 在 QNLI 与 QQP 上，该方法成功区分了投票增益高于目标边际的设置与改进空间很小的设置；同时给出有限预算的尖锐精度/增益界、共享大样本置信域、无限投票的尖锐界与矩匹配曲线预测。
summary_sections.conclusion: 两次采样的配对结果足以约束重复投票的精度-增益曲线，从而在有限与无限投票预算下给出可用于 test-time compute 分配的尖锐界。

papers.title: SPLICE: Latent Diffusion over JEPA Embeddings for Conformal Time-Series Inpainting
papers.abstract_en: Long gaps in time series are difficult to reconstruct reliably, and in power systems imputed load values inform dispatch and planning. Existing generative imputers are accurate but provide no finite-sample reliability guarantees under changing conditions. We introduce SPLICE (Self-supervised Predictive Latent Inpainting with Conformal Envelopes), which couples a JEPA encoder, a conditional latent bridge, an hourly-conditioned decoder, and Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI). Controlled ablations indicate that long-horizon fidelity is driven more by the predictive representation than by generative complexity: under a matched bridge and decoder, JEPA outperforms reconstructive VAE and contrastive TS2Vec encoders, and once the representation is fixed a 5-step flow sampler matches or improves on a 50-step DDIM sampler at a 5-10x speedup. The same ordering is recovered on twelve hydrological catchments. Across thirteen load datasets at 91-day gaps, SPLICE attains the lowest mean Load-only MSE (0.056), winning 9 of 12 non-degenerate datasets against seven established baselines, and the best mean CRPS (0.182, 7.8% below the strongest competitor), while ACI holds 93-95% empirical coverage where static calibration under-covers by up to 7.5 percentage points. A pooled JEPA encoder transfers to four held-out datasets with only bridge and decoder adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPLICE 用 JEPA 自监督表征加条件 latent bridge 与 Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI) 做长缺口时间序列补全，消融显示长程保真度主要由预测式表征而非生成复杂度决定：固定 bridge 与 decoder 后 JEPA 优于重构式 VAE 和对比式 TS2Vec，且 5 步 flow 采样匹配或超过 50 步 DDIM 并带来 5–10 倍加速。在 13 个负荷数据集 91 天缺口上取得最低 Load-only MSE 0.056 与最优 CRPS 0.182（比最强对手低 7.8%），ACI 维持 93–95% 经验覆盖率而静态校准最多低估 7.5 个百分点。
Motivation: 电力系统中长缺口负荷补全值直接进入调度与规划，现有生成式补全器虽准却在分布变化下没有有限样本可靠性保证。
Method: SPLICE 耦合 JEPA 编码器、条件 latent bridge、按小时条件化的 decoder 与 Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI)；用配对消融分离表征与生成复杂度的贡献，并与重构式 VAE、对比式 TS2Vec 及七个既有基线对比，另在十二个水文流域上检验同一排序。
Result: 固定 bridge 与 decoder 时 JEPA 优于 VAE 与 TS2Vec；表征固定后 5 步 flow 采样匹配或改进 50 步 DDIM，加速 5–10 倍，该排序在 12 个水文流域复现。13 个负荷数据集 91 天缺口下 Load-only MSE 均值 0.056（12 个非退化数据集中赢 9 个），CRPS 均值 0.182，比最强对手低 7.8%；ACI 保持 93–95% 经验覆盖率，静态校准最多低估 7.5 个百分点；池化 JEPA 编码器迁移到 4 个留出数据集时只需适配 bridge 与 decoder。
Conclusion: 长缺口补全的收益主要来自预测式表征而非更大的生成模型，配合 ACI 可在变化条件下给出有限样本可靠性保证。

papers.title: Untrained CNNs Exceed Backpropagation in V1 Alignment at High Evaluation Resolution: A Systematic RSA Comparison of Four Learning Rules Against Human fMRI
papers.abstract_en: Revised version (v4): noise ceiling replaced, analyses restricted to stimulus pairs presented in different fMRI runs, repaired evaluation of all five conditions. We compare four learning rules (backpropagation (BP), feedback alignment (FA), predictive coding (PC), and spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP)) in identical convolutional networks against human fMRI from THINGS-fMRI (720 stimuli, 3 subjects) using representational similarity analysis (RSA), together with an untrained random-weights baseline that isolates the contribution of architecture. Models are trained on 32 px CIFAR-10 and evaluated at 224 px; results are averaged across 5 seeds, with uncertainty from resampling stimuli. At V1, the untrained baseline exceeds BP ($ρ= 0.053$ vs. $0.022$; $Δρ= +0.031$, 95% CI $[0.019, 0.043]$), and the same holds at V2. This advantage depends on the evaluation resolution: in the 5-seed model set of the resolution study (gap $+0.030$ at 224 px), it vanishes when the models are evaluated at their 32 px training resolution ($Δρ= -0.001$, 95% CI $[-0.011, 0.009]$; arXiv:2608.12408). At LOC, BP, PC and STDP exceed the untrained baseline, FA is borderline, and the trained rules do not differ from each other. At IT, no two conditions can be distinguished at the low reliability of the data (leave-one-subject-out lower bound 0.021). FA has the lowest alignment at V1. At V1, an untrained network thus matches BP at the training resolution and exceeds it at 224 px; learning-rule differences are resolvable only at an intermediate area.
papers.comment: Noise ceiling replaced by the leave-one-subject-out lower bound (old split-half bounds invalid, not reproducible); analyses on cross-run stimulus pairs; PC/STDP re-evaluated after an eval-mode fix. PC no longer exceeds BP at V1; IT unresolved. Untrained net exceeds BP at V1/V2 at 224 px, not at the 32 px training resolution. See revision note
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在相同卷积网络上比较四种学习规则与人类 fMRI 的 RSA 对齐，发现未训练随机权重基线在 V1/V2 的 224 px 评估分辨率下超过反向传播（ρ=0.053 vs 0.022，Δρ=+0.031），但在 32 px 训练分辨率下优势消失（Δρ=−0.001）。学习规则差异只在中间视觉区 LOC 可分辨，IT 因数据可靠性低无法区分。
Motivation: 生物可学习规则（FA、PC、STDP）与 BP 的对齐比较常忽略架构本身的贡献，且评估分辨率可能左右结论，需要隔离训练与架构各自对人类视觉表征对齐的作用。
Method: 在完全相同的卷积网络上训练 BP、FA、PC、STDP 四种规则，加一个未训练随机权重基线；用 RSA 对比模型与 THINGS-fMRI（720 张刺激、3 名被试）的表征相似度，训练于 32 px CIFAR-10、在 224 px 评估，5 个种子平均，刺激重采样估计不确定性，噪声上限用留一被试下界替代。
Result: V1 处未训练基线 ρ=0.053 超过 BP 的 0.022（Δρ=+0.031，95% CI [0.019, 0.043]），V2 同样成立；分辨率研究中 224 px 差距 +0.030，回到 32 px 训练分辨率则 Δρ=−0.001（95% CI [−0.011, 0.009]）。LOC 处 BP、PC、STDP 超过未训练基线，FA 处于边缘，各训练规则之间无差异；IT 处留一被试下界 0.021，任意两条件无法区分；FA 在 V1 对齐最低。
Conclusion: 在训练分辨率上未训练网络已与 BP 相当、在 224 px 则超过 BP，说明 V1 对齐优势可由架构而非学习贡献；学习规则差异只在中间视觉区可分辨，IT 结论未定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Use of Evolutionary Optimization for the Dynamic Chance Constrained Open-Pit Mine Scheduling Problem
papers.abstract_en: Open-pit mine scheduling is a complex real world optimization problem that involves uncertain economic values and dynamically changing resource capacities. Evolutionary algorithms are particularly effective in these scenarios, as they can easily adapt to uncertain and changing environments. However, uncertainty and dynamic changes are often studied in isolation in real-world problems. In this paper, we study a dynamic chance-constrained open-pit mine scheduling problem in which block economic values are stochastic and mining and processing capacities vary over time. We adopt a bi-objective evolutionary formulation that simultaneously maximizes expected discounted profit and minimizes its standard deviation. To address dynamic changes, we propose a diversity-based change response mechanism that repairs a subset of infeasible solutions and introduces additional feasible solutions whenever a change is detected. We evaluate the effectiveness of this mechanism across four multi-objective evolutionary algorithms and compare it with a baseline re-evaluation-based change-response strategy. Experimental results on six mining instances demonstrate that the proposed approach consistently outperforms the baseline methods across different uncertainty levels and change frequencies.
papers.comment: Accepted to publish in 2026 IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence (WCCI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把露天矿排产写成动态机会约束问题：矿块经济价值随机、采选产能随时间变化，用双目标进化算法同时最大化期望折现利润、最小化利润标准差，并提出基于多样性的变化响应机制，在检测到变化时修复部分不可行解并补充可行解。在六个矿山实例上，该机制在四个多目标进化算法中、不同不确定性水平与变化频率下均稳定优于基于重评估的基线响应策略。
Motivation: 现实排产中不确定性与动态变化通常被分开研究，而矿块价值随机与产能随时间变动同时存在时，标准变化响应策略难以维持可行解与种群多样性。
Method: 采用双目标进化公式（期望折现利润最大 + 其标准差最小），提出 diversity-based change response mechanism：检测到变化后修复一部分不可行解并注入额外可行解；在四个多目标进化算法上与 re-evaluation-based change-response 基线对比。
Result: 在六个 mining instances 上，所提机制在四个多目标进化算法中、跨不同不确定性水平与变化频率，均一致优于基线变化响应方法。
Conclusion: 在动态机会约束排产中，基于多样性的变化响应比重评估式响应更能维持可行解与优化表现，且该优势对算法与环境设置稳健。

papers.title: AI Assistance Reduces Persistence and Hurts Independent Performance
papers.abstract_en: People often optimize for long-term goals in collaboration: A mentor or companion doesn't just answer questions, but also scaffolds learning, tracks progress, and prioritizes the other person's growth over immediate results. In contrast, current AI systems are fundamentally short-sighted collaborators - optimized for providing instant and complete responses, without ever saying no (unless for safety reasons). What are the consequences of this dynamic? Here, through a series of randomized controlled trials on human-AI interactions (N = 1,222), we provide causal evidence for two key consequences of AI assistance: reduced persistence and impairment of unassisted performance. Across a variety of tasks, including mathematical reasoning and reading comprehension, we find that although AI assistance improves performance in the short-term, people perform significantly worse without AI and are more likely to give up. Notably, these effects emerge after only brief interactions with AI (approximately 10 minutes). These findings are particularly concerning because persistence is foundational to skill acquisition and is one of the strongest predictors of long-term learning. We posit that persistence is reduced because AI conditions people to expect immediate answers, thereby denying them the experience of working through challenges on their own. These results suggest the need for AI model development to prioritize scaffolding long-term competence alongside immediate task completion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 N=1,222 的人机交互随机对照试验显示，AI 助手在短期内提升任务表现，却让人在无 AI 条件下表现显著更差、更易放弃，且仅约 10 分钟的交互就足以诱发这些效应。作者主张模型开发应把长期能力的 scaffolding 与即时任务完成并列为目标。
Motivation: 现有 AI 被优化为即时给出完整回答、从不说不，与导师式注重长期成长的协作相反；这种短视动态对坚持度和脱离辅助后的表现有何因果后果尚缺证据。
Method: 通过一系列人机交互随机对照试验 (RCT)，N=1,222，覆盖数学推理与阅读理解等多种任务，比较有 AI 辅助与无辅助条件下的表现与放弃行为。
Result: AI 辅助在短期内提升表现，但无 AI 时表现显著更差、更易放弃；这些效应在仅约 10 分钟交互后即出现。
Conclusion: 作者认为坚持度下降源于 AI 让人习惯即时答案、失去独自克服挑战的经验，因此模型开发需在即时完成任务之外同时培养长期能力。

papers.title: LinguDistill: Recovering Linguistic Ability in Vision-Language Models via Selective Cross-Modal Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Turning a pretrained language model (LM) into a vision-language model (VLM) through multimodal fine-tuning often erodes its native language ability, a form of catastrophic forgetting that shows up even on text-only tasks. This loss is hard to undo with further fine-tuning, and existing remedies add adapters or alignment modules that increase architectural complexity and inference cost. We propose LinguDistill, an adapter-free knowledge distillation method that uses the original frozen LM as the teacher during multimodal post-training. To let a text-only teacher supervise vision-conditioned outputs, we introduce layer-wise KV-cache sharing, which exposes the teacher to the student's multimodal representations without changing either architecture. We then apply distillation selectively, on language-heavy data only, so the teacher restores linguistic ability while the student keeps its visual grounding on document and OCR tasks. LinguDistill recovers the language and knowledge performance lost during multimodal fine-tuning, matching the original VLM on average over text-only benchmarks (ARC, HellaSwag) and exceeding it on ScienceQA, while keeping vision-heavy performance close to standard fine-tuning. Since the teacher is dropped after training, the final model adds no parameters and no inference cost. More broadly, our results show that a model's own pre-adaptation backbone is a practical teacher for undoing forgetting, suggesting a simple recipe for keeping language ability intact as models are extended to new modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LinguDistill 用原始冻结 LM 作 teacher，在多模态后训练中做无 adapter 的选择性跨模态蒸馏：逐层共享 KV-cache 让纯文本 teacher 监督视觉条件输出，且只在语言密集数据上施加蒸馏。结果在纯文本基准 (ARC、HellaSwag) 上平均追平原 VLM、在 ScienceQA 上超过它，同时视觉密集任务 (document、OCR) 保持接近标准微调，训练后丢弃 teacher，最终模型零参数、零推理开销。
Motivation: 把预训练 LM 多模态微调成 VLM 会在纯文本任务上也出现灾难性遗忘，且后续微调难以挽回；现有补救方案要加 adapter 或对齐模块，抬高架构复杂度与推理成本。
Method: 以原始冻结 LM 为 teacher 做知识蒸馏：逐层 KV-cache 共享把 student 的多模态表征暴露给 teacher，不改动任一侧架构；蒸馏只施加在语言密集数据上，视觉密集数据照常训练以保住 document 与 OCR 上的视觉 grounding。

papers.title: The Value of Information in Resource-Constrained Pricing
papers.abstract_en: Firms that price perishable resources -- airline seats, hotel rooms, seasonal inventory -- now routinely use demand predictions, but these predictions vary widely in quality. Under hard capacity constraints, acting on an inaccurate prediction can irreversibly deplete inventory needed for future periods. We study how prediction uncertainty propagates into dynamic pricing decisions with linear demand, stochastic noise, and finite capacity. A certified demand forecast with known error bound~$ε^0$ specifies where the system should operate: it shifts regret from $O(\sqrt{T})$ to $O(\log T)$ when $ε^0 \lesssim T^{-1/4}$, and we prove this threshold is tight. A misspecified surrogate model -- biased but correlated with true demand -- cannot set prices directly but reduces learning variance by a factor of $(1-ρ^2)$ through control variates. The two mechanisms compose: the forecast determines the regret regime; the surrogate tightens estimation within it. All algorithms rest on a boundary attraction mechanism that stabilizes pricing near degenerate capacity boundaries without requiring non-degeneracy assumptions. Experiments confirm the phase transition threshold, the variance reduction from surrogates, and robustness across problem instances.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究硬容量约束下需求预测误差如何传入动态定价：带已知误差界 ε⁰ 的认证预测把遗憾从 O(√T) 降到 O(log T)，且阈值 ε⁰ ≲ T^{-1/4} 被证明是紧的；有偏但与真实需求相关的代理模型不能直接定价，却以因子 (1-ρ²) 降低学习方差。两者可组合——预测决定遗憾体制，代理在体制内收紧估计。
Motivation: 易逝资源（机票、酒店客房、季节性库存）的定价依赖质量参差的需求预测，而硬容量约束下基于不准预测的决策会不可逆地耗尽后续期间所需库存；预测不确定性如何传入动态定价决策此前缺少定量刻画。
Method: 在线性需求、随机噪声与有限容量的动态定价模型中分析预测误差传播；用认证预测（已知误差界 ε⁰）设定运行点，用有偏但相关的代理模型作 control variates 降方差；所有算法基于 boundary attraction 机制在退化容量边界附近稳定定价，无需非退化假设。
Result: 当 ε⁰ ≲ T^{-1/4} 时遗憾由 O(√T) 降至 O(log T)，且该阈值被证明是紧的；代理模型将学习方差降低因子 (1-ρ²)；实验确认了相变阈值、代理带来的方差缩减，以及跨问题实例的稳健性。
Conclusion: 认证预测的误差界决定动态定价处于 O(√T) 还是 O(log T) 遗憾体制，代理模型只在既定体制内收紧估计，两者机制可组合而非互相替代。

papers.title: WebNavigator: Global Web Navigation via Interaction Graph Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Despite significant advances in autonomous web navigation, current methods remain far from human-level performance in complex web environments. We argue that this limitation stems from Topological Blindness, where agents are forced to explore via trial-and-error without access to the global topological structure of the environment. To overcome this limitation, we introduce WebNavigator, which reframes web navigation from probabilistic exploration into deterministic retrieval and pathfinding. WebNavigator constructs Interaction Graphs via zero-token cost heuristic exploration offline and implements a Retrieve-Reason-Teleport workflow for global navigation online. WebNavigator achieves state-of-the-art performance on WebArena and OnlineMind2Web. On WebArena multi-site tasks, WebNavigator achieves a 72.9\% success rate, more than doubling the performance of enterprise-level agents. This work reveals that Topological Blindness, rather than model reasoning capabilities alone, is an underestimated bottleneck in autonomous web navigation.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Updated version with additional experiments. 30 pages including references and appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WebNavigator 把自主网页导航从概率式试错重构为确定性检索与寻路：离线用零 token 成本的启发式探索构建 Interaction Graph，在线执行 Retrieve-Reason-Teleport 流程。在 WebArena 多站点任务上达到 72.9% 成功率，超过企业级 agent 两倍以上，并在 WebArena 与 OnlineMind2Web 上取得 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有网页导航 agent 缺乏环境的全局拓扑结构（Topological Blindness），只能靠试错探索，导致复杂网页环境下的表现远低于人类水平。
Method: 离线阶段以零 token 成本的启发式探索构建 Interaction Graph；在线阶段用 Retrieve-Reason-Teleport 工作流做全局检索与寻路，把导航从概率探索转为确定性检索加寻路。
Result: 在 WebArena 与 OnlineMind2Web 上取得 state-of-the-art；WebArena 多站点任务成功率 72.9%，是企业级 agent 的两倍以上。
Conclusion: 自主网页导航的低估瓶颈是 Topological Blindness 而非模型推理能力本身，引入全局拓扑结构即可把导航转为确定性检索与寻路。

papers.title: Beyond TVLA: Anderson-Darling Leakage Assessment for Neural Network Side-Channel Leakage Detection
papers.abstract_en: Test Vector Leakage Assessment (TVLA) is widely used for side-channel leakage detection, but its reliance on Welch's t-test makes it primarily sensitive to differences in the means of two leakage populations. Consequently, TVLA may fail to detect leakage that manifests through changes in other characteristics of the underlying distributions. We introduce Anderson-Darling Leakage Assessment (ADLA), a distribution-sensitive leakage assessment methodology based on the two-sample Anderson-Darling test. To facilitate direct comparison with conventional TVLA, we derive an ADLA decision threshold corresponding to the nominal significance level associated with the standard TVLA threshold of 4.5. We evaluate ADLA on a shuffling-protected embedded multilayer perceptron implementation under both fixed-versus-fixed and fixed-versus-random input configurations. Across the evaluated settings, ADLA produces clearer threshold exceedances than TVLA and reveals leakage locations that are not detected by the mean-based test. To assess the practical relevance of these additional leakage locations, we perform correlation power analysis using points of interest selected from the ADLA and TVLA statistics. The points identified by ADLA enable recovery of the exponent byte of the targeted model weight despite the presence of shuffling. These results demonstrate that distribution-sensitive testing can complement conventional TVLA by revealing exploitable side-channel leakage that may remain hidden from mean-based analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于双样本 Anderson-Darling 检验的泄漏评估方法 ADLA，用于替代只对均值敏感的 TVLA（Welch t 检验），并推导出与 TVLA 标准阈值 4.5 对应的名义显著性决策阈值。在带 shuffling 保护的嵌入式多层感知机上，ADLA 的阈值超越更清晰，且其选出的观测点经相关功耗分析 (CPA) 可在 shuffling 存在下恢复目标模型权重的指数字节。
Motivation: TVLA 依赖 Welch t 检验，只对两组泄漏分布的均值差敏感，可能漏掉仅体现在分布其他特征上的泄漏，导致侧信道风险被低估。
Method: 以双样本 Anderson-Darling 检验为核心构建 ADLA，推导与 TVLA 阈值 4.5 对应的显著性决策阈值以便直接对比；在 shuffling 保护的嵌入式 MLP 实现上按 fixed-versus-fixed 与 fixed-versus-random 两种输入配置评估，并用 ADLA 与 TVLA 统计量各自选取观测点做相关功耗分析 (CPA) 验证可利用性。
Result: 在所评估的全部设置中，ADLA 的阈值超越比 TVLA 更清晰，并揭示均值检验检测不到的泄漏位置；由 ADLA 选出的观测点在 shuffling 存在下仍能通过 CPA 恢复目标模型权重的指数字节 (exponent byte)。
Conclusion: 分布敏感的检验可与 TVLA 互补，揭示均值分析可能掩盖的可利用侧信道泄漏；对带 shuffling 的神经网络实现，仅靠均值型 TVLA 不足以判定无泄漏。

papers.title: You've Got a Golden Ticket: Improving Generative Robot Policies With A Single Noise Vector
papers.abstract_en: Generative robot policies trained on demonstrations using behavior cloning often learn actions that are sub-optimal or misaligned with respect to the downstream task. Policy improvement approaches aim to bridge this gap and improve the cumulative reward with minimal interventions on the pre-trained policy. However, an impediment to their practical deployment is the requirement of cumbersome hyperparameter tuning specific to model or task families. In this work, we present an episodic, derivative-free latent policy improvement approach that works with little to no changes across model scales from MLPs to VLAs. We demonstrate that the performance of a pretrained, frozen diffusion or flow matching policy can be improved with respect to a downstream reward by swapping the sampling of initial noise from the prior distribution (typically isotropic Gaussian) with a well-chosen, constant initial noise input---a golden ticket. We show the prevalence of golden tickets by improving the policy performance of $46$ out of $51$ tasks across manipulation benchmarks, with absolute improvements in success rate by up to $79\%$ for simulated tasks, and $28\%$ within $60$ search episodes for real-world tasks. Further, we find that the versatility of our approach opens up new avenues such as simultaneous policy improvement for multiple downstream rewards. Project webpage: https://lottery-tickets.rai-inst.com/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对行为克隆训练的扩散/流匹配机器人策略次优问题，提出无梯度的分回合 (episodic) 潜空间策略改进方法：把采样初始噪声从各向同性高斯先验换成一个搜出来的恒定噪声向量（golden ticket），即可在不改动预训练策略的前提下提升下游奖励。51 个操作任务中 46 个成功改进，仿真任务成功率绝对提升最高 79%，真实任务在 60 个搜索回合内提升 28%。
Motivation: 行为克隆得到的生成式策略动作常与下游任务奖励不匹配，而现有策略改进方法需要按模型或任务族繁琐调超参数，阻碍实际部署。
Method: 分回合、无导数 (derivative-free) 的潜空间策略改进：冻结预训练扩散或流匹配策略，仅搜索一个恒定初始噪声向量替换先验采样；跨 MLP 到 VLA 规模几乎无需改动，并支持对多个下游奖励同时改进。
Result: 在操作类基准的 51 个任务中 46 个性能提升；仿真任务成功率绝对提升最高 79%；真实任务在 60 个搜索回合内绝对提升 28%。
Conclusion: 恒定初始噪声这一单一自由度足以在多种模型规模与任务上改进冻结的生成式策略，且可同时面向多个下游奖励。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Towards Robust Speech Deepfake Detection via Human-Inspired Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: The modern generative audio models can be used by an adversary in an unlawful manner, specifically, to impersonate other people to gain access to private information. To mitigate this issue, speech deepfake detection (SDD) methods started to evolve. Unfortunately, current SDD methods generally suffer from the lack of generalization to new audio domains and generators. More than that, they lack interpretability, especially human-like reasoning that would naturally explain the attribution of a given audio to the bona fide or spoof class and provide human-perceptible cues. In this paper, we propose HIR-SDD, a novel SDD framework that combines the strengths of Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) with the chain-of-thought reasoning derived from the novel proposed human-annotated dataset. Experimental evaluation demonstrates both the effectiveness of the proposed method and its ability to provide reasonable justifications for predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HIR-SDD：把 Large Audio Language Model (LALM) 与来自新构建人工标注数据集的 chain-of-thought 推理结合，用于语音深伪检测 (speech deepfake detection)，在给出 bona fide/spoof 判定的同时产出人类可读的判据与归因解释。实验评估显示该方法有效且能为预测提供合理解释。
Motivation: 现有语音深伪检测方法对新音频域和新生成器泛化差，且缺乏可解释性，无法像人一样给出把音频判为 bona fide 或 spoof 的推理过程和人类可感知的线索。
Method: HIR-SDD 框架将 Large Audio Language Model (LALM) 的能力与 chain-of-thought 推理结合，推理链来自论文新提出的人工标注数据集，输出判定同时附带解释性理由。
Result: 实验评估表明 HIR-SDD 有效，并能为预测给出合理的解释性论证；摘要未列出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把 LALM 与人工标注驱动的 chain-of-thought 推理结合，可以在语音深伪检测中同时获得判定能力与人类可读的归因解释。

papers.title: Physics-informed neural operator for parametric phase-field modelling of interfacial degradation and microstructural evolution
papers.abstract_en: Predicting interfacial degradation and microstructural evolution through phase-field modelling is computationally intensive, particularly for parametric studies. While neural operators such as the Fourier neural operator (FNO) offer a promising route to acceleration, the absence of physical constraints compromises their generalisation and long-term stability. Here, we present PF-PINO, a physics-informed neural operator framework that embeds phase-field governing equation residuals directly into the training loss, together with gradient normalisation loss balancing and a staggered training scheme for coupled multi-field systems. PF-PINO is validated on four benchmarks including pencil-electrode corrosion, electro-polishing corrosion, dendritic solidification, and spinodal decomposition, collectively probing parametric generalisation across orders-of-magnitude kinetic regimes, non-periodic boundaries with stochastic morphologies, coupled multi-field dynamics with out-of-distribution extrapolation, and long-term autoregressive stability under complex pattern formation. Across all benchmarks, PF-PINO reduces relative $L^2$ errors by up to an order of magnitude over FNO and achieves sub-mesh-size interface accuracy, establishing a data-efficient surrogate for high-throughput parametric phase-field assessment in computational materials science and engineering applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PF-PINO 把相场控制方程残差直接写进训练损失，配合梯度归一化损失平衡与耦合多场系统的交错训练，用于替代参数化相场模拟。在四个基准上相对 L2 误差较 FNO 最多降低一个数量级，并达到亚网格尺度的界面精度。
Motivation: 相场模拟做参数研究计算量大，而无物理约束的神经算子 (FNO) 泛化与长期稳定性不足，难以作为高通量参数评估的代理模型。
Method: PF-PINO 将相场控制方程残差嵌入训练损失，加入梯度归一化损失 (gradient normalisation loss) 平衡各项，并对耦合多场系统采用交错训练 (staggered training scheme)；在 pencil-electrode 腐蚀、电抛光腐蚀、枝晶凝固、旋节分解四个基准上验证，覆盖跨数量级动力学参数、非周期随机形貌边界、多场耦合与分布外外推、以及长期自回归稳定性。
Result: 在全部四个基准上，PF-PINO 相对 FNO 的相对 L2 误差最多降低一个数量级，并达到亚网格尺度 (sub-mesh-size) 的界面精度。
Conclusion: 物理约束加交错训练能让神经算子成为数据高效的相场代理模型，适用于计算材料科学与工程中的高通量参数化相场评估。

papers.title: SoundWeaver: Compositional Warm-Starting for Text-to-Audio Diffusion Serving
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-audio (T2A) diffusion models generate high-quality audio but require tens of neural function evaluations (NFEs), resulting in substantial inference latency. Existing acceleration methods primarily optimize each generation trajectory independently, even when reusable acoustic structure exists in prior examples. We introduce SoundWeaver, the first training-free framework for compositional cross example acoustic reuse. Rather than generating from pure noise, SoundWeaver constructs a prompt-conditioned acoustic prior from segments distributed across cached audios and warm-starts diffusion from an intermediate noise level. We introduce an Acoustic Composition Graph (ACG), which uses neural codec representations and segment-level identification to identify candidate cross-cache transitions and structured path search to jointly optimize prompt relevance and acoustic continuity. We further establish a warm-start error bound showing how prior quality and diffusion SNR jointly govern the admissible skip depth, motivating an adaptive contextual-bandit Skip Gater that selects the warm-start level for each request. Across T2A diffusion backbones, SoundWeaver achieves 1.48-3.74x generation speedup with only a 1K-clip cache while improving generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SoundWeaver 是首个免训练的文本到音频 (T2A) diffusion 跨样本声学复用框架：用 Acoustic Composition Graph 从缓存音频中拼出提示条件下的声学先验，从中间噪声水平 warm-start，并由理论误差界驱动的自适应 Skip Gater 选择起跳深度。在多个 T2A diffusion backbone 上以仅 1K-clip 缓存取得 1.48–3.74 倍生成加速，同时生成质量提升。
Motivation: T2A diffusion 需要数十次神经函数评估 (NFEs)，推理延迟高；现有加速方法各自独立优化单条生成轨迹，即使先前样本中存在可复用的声学结构也不利用。
Method: 免训练框架：以 neural codec 表示和 segment 级识别构建 Acoustic Composition Graph (ACG)，用结构化路径搜索联合优化 prompt 相关性与声学连续性，从缓存音频跨段拼出 prompt 条件声学先验；从中间噪声水平 warm-start diffusion，并给出 warm-start 误差界，说明先验质量与 diffusion SNR 共同决定可跳过的深度，据此用 contextual-bandit Skip Gater 为每个请求选择 warm-start 层级。
Result: 在多个 T2A diffusion backbone 上实现 1.48–3.74 倍生成加速，仅用 1K-clip 缓存，且生成质量同时改善。
Conclusion: 跨样本复用缓存声学结构并按误差界自适应选择 warm-start 深度，可以在不训练的前提下同时降低 T2A diffusion 的推理延迟并保住质量。

papers.title: 3ViewSense: Spatial and Mental Perspective Reasoning from Orthographic Views in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Current Large Language Models have achieved Olympiad-level logic, yet Vision-Language Models paradoxically falter on elementary spatial tasks like block counting. This capability mismatch reveals a critical ``spatial intelligence gap,'' where models fail to construct coherent 3D mental representations from 2D observations. We uncover this gap via diagnostic analyses showing the bottleneck is a missing view-consistent spatial interface rather than insufficient visual features or weak reasoning. To bridge this, we introduce \textbf{3ViewSense}, a framework that grounds spatial reasoning in Orthographic Views. Drawing on engineering cognition, we propose a ``Simulate-and-Reason'' mechanism that decomposes complex scenes into canonical orthographic projections to resolve geometric ambiguities. By aligning egocentric perceptions with these allocentric references, our method facilitates explicit mental rotation and reconstruction. Empirical results on spatial reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines, with consistent gains on occlusion-heavy counting and view-consistent spatial reasoning. The framework also improves the stability and consistency of spatial descriptions, offering a scalable path toward stronger spatial intelligence in multimodal systems.~\footnote{https://github.com/Jasaxion/3ViewSense}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 3ViewSense 用正交视图 (orthographic views) 作为视角一致的空间接口，通过 Simulate-and-Reason 把复杂场景分解为规范正交投影来消解几何歧义，再把自我中心感知与他心参考对齐，显式支持心理旋转与三维重建。在空间推理基准上显著超越现有基线，遮挡严重的计数与视角一致推理上增益一致，并提升空间描述的稳定性与一致性。
Motivation: 大语言模型已达奥赛级逻辑，视觉语言模型却在数方块这类基础空间任务上失败，暴露出无法从 2D 观测构造一致 3D 心智表征的 spatial intelligence gap；诊断分析指出瓶颈是缺少视角一致的空间接口，而非视觉特征不足或推理弱。
Method: 提出 3ViewSense 框架，把空间推理锚定在正交视图上；核心是借鉴工程认知的 Simulate-and-Reason 机制，将场景分解为规范正交投影以消解几何歧义，再把 egocentric 感知与 allocentric 参考对齐，促成显式心理旋转与重建。
Result: 在空间推理基准上显著优于现有基线，增益在遮挡较重的计数 (occlusion-heavy counting) 与视角一致空间推理上保持一致；同时改善空间描述的稳定性与一致性。
Conclusion: 空间智能的瓶颈在于缺少视角一致的空间接口，用正交视图做 Simulate-and-Reason 可以作为扩展多模态系统空间能力的可规模化路径。

papers.title: DERM-3R: A Resource-Efficient Multimodal Agents Framework for Dermatologic Diagnosis and Treatment in Real-World Clinical Settings
papers.abstract_en: Skin diseases impose a substantial and growing global health burden. Modern dermatologic therapies control acute manifestations rapidly, but single-target treatment paradigms, recurrent disease courses, and neglected systemic comorbidities limit their long-term effectiveness. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) offers a complementary, holistic approach through syndrome differentiation and individualized treatment, yet its clinical practice is hindered by non-standardized knowledge, incomplete multimodal records, and the difficulty of scaling expert-driven reasoning. We propose DERM-3R, a resource-efficient multimodal agents framework that models TCM dermatologic diagnosis and treatment under limited data and computational resources. We decompose and redefine real-world dermatologic decision-making into three essential issues: fine-grained lesion recognition, multi-view lesion representation with specialist-level pathogenesis modeling, and holistic clinical reasoning for syndrome differentiation and treatment planning. DERM-3R comprises three collaborative agents, DERM-Rec, DERM-Rep, and DERM-Reason, each addressing one of these issues. Built on a lightweight multimodal large language model and fine-tuned by partial-parameter finetuning on 103 real-world TCM psoriasis cases, DERM-3R performs strongly across multiple dermatologic reasoning tasks. Automatic metrics, LLM-as-a-Judge assessments, and human doctors show that, despite extremely limited training data and parameter updates, DERM-3R matches or even surpasses hundred-billion-parameter general-purpose multimodal models such as GPT-5.1 and Gemini-3-Flash. Our results indicate that structured, domain-aware multi-agent modeling is an effective alternative to brute-force scaling for complex clinical tasks, offering a practical and scalable paradigm for multimodal AI in dermatology and integrative medicine.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DERM-3R 用三个协作 agent（DERM-Rec、DERM-Rep、DERM-Reason）分别处理细粒度皮损识别、多视角皮损表征与病机建模、以及辨证论治的整体临床推理，基于轻量多模态大模型做部分参数微调。在仅 103 例真实中医银屑病病例上训练后，自动指标、LLM-as-a-Judge 与人类医生评估显示其匹配甚至超越 GPT-5.1、Gemini-3-Flash 等千亿参数通用多模态模型，说明结构化领域感知多 agent 建模可替代暴力规模扩展。
Motivation: 中医皮肤病诊疗受非标准化知识、不完整多模态记录和专家推理难以规模化制约；通用大模型靠堆参数解决复杂临床任务的成本过高。
Method: 三个协作 agent：DERM-Rec 做细粒度皮损识别，DERM-Rep 做多视角皮损表征与专科级病机建模，DERM-Reason 做辨证与治疗方案的整体临床推理；底座为轻量多模态大模型，用 partial-parameter finetuning 在 103 例真实中医银屑病病例上微调。
Result: 在 103 例真实中医银屑病病例的极有限训练数据与参数更新下，自动指标、LLM-as-a-Judge 评估与人类医生一致显示 DERM-3R 匹配甚至超越 GPT-5.1、Gemini-3-Flash 等百亿至千亿级通用多模态模型，在多个皮肤病推理任务上表现强劲。
Conclusion: 对复杂临床任务，结构化、领域感知的多 agent 建模是暴力扩展参数规模的有效替代，为皮肤科与整合医学的多模态 AI 提供可扩展范式。

papers.title: RepoLaunch: Automating Build and Management of Code Repositories across Languages and Platforms
papers.abstract_en: Language model (LM) agents have driven substantial progress in automated software engineering (SWE), yet building and testing software repositories at scale remains a largely manual and labor-intensive bottleneck. In this work, we introduce RepoLaunch, a novel agentic framework that automatically resolves dependencies, compiles source code, and extracts test results across diverse programming languages and operating systems. RepoLaunch achieves a 78% build success rate, outperforming the Python/Linux-only prior system by 18%. To demonstrate its application, we further present a fully automated pipeline for SWE dataset creation driven by RepoLaunch, which only requires human input at the task-design stage. RepoLaunch is open-sourced, and its automated task-generation pipeline has been adopted by several recent works on agentic benchmarking and training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RepoLaunch 是一个 LM agent 框架，自动解析依赖、编译源码并跨多种编程语言与操作系统提取测试结果，把仓库构建从手工环节变成可自动化的步骤。其构建成功率达 78%，比仅支持 Python/Linux 的既有系统高 18 个百分点；配套的全自动 SWE 数据集生成流水线只需人在任务设计阶段介入。
Motivation: 大规模构建与测试软件仓库仍高度依赖人工，是自动化软件工程 (SWE) 中的劳动密集瓶颈，且既有系统只覆盖 Python/Linux。
Method: 提出 agentic 框架 RepoLaunch：由 LM agent 解析依赖、编译源码、跨多种编程语言与操作系统提取测试结果；在其上搭建全自动 SWE 数据集创建流水线，仅在任务设计阶段需要人工输入。
Result: 构建成功率 78%，比 Python/Linux-only 的既有系统高出 18%；流水线已开源，其自动生成任务的流程被若干近期 agentic benchmarking 与 training 工作采用。
Conclusion: 跨语言跨平台的仓库构建可以交给 agent 自动完成，并可作为 SWE 数据集与基准生成的底座；采用情况表明该流水线已被后续工作复用。

summary_sections.result: 构建成功率 78%，比 Python/Linux-only 的既有系统高出 18%；流水线已开源，其自动生成任务的流程被若干近期 agentic benchmarking 与 training 工作采用。
summary_sections.conclusion: 跨语言跨平台的仓库构建可以交给 agent 自动完成，并可作为 SWE 数据集与基准生成的底座；采用情况表明该流水线已被后续工作复用。

papers.title: High-Precision Estimation of the State-Space Complexity of Shogi via the Monte Carlo Method
papers.abstract_en: Determining the state-space complexity of Shogi (Japanese Chess) has been a challenging problem, with previous combinatorial estimates leaving a gap of five orders of magnitude ($10^{64}$ to $10^{69}$). This gap arises from the difficulty of distinguishing positions reachable from the initial position among the vast number of board configurations. In this paper, we present a high-precision statistical estimate of the number of reachable Shogi positions. Here, a position consists of the side to move, the board configuration, and the pieces in hand, without move history, and positions related by exchanging the two players or by horizontal reflection of the board are counted once. Our method combines Monte Carlo sampling with a reachability test that performs reverse search toward the set of ``King-King only'' (KK) positions rather than toward the single initial position. Since every KK position and the initial position are mutually reachable, reaching any KK position proves reachability, and removing pieces from the board is a much simpler objective than reconstructing the initial position. Based on a sample of five billion positions, we estimate the number of such positions in Shogi to be $6.55 \times 10^{68}$; both ends of the approximate $3σ$ confidence interval round to this value at three significant digits. We also applied this method to Mini Shogi, obtaining approximately $2.38 \times 10^{18}$.
papers.comment: Preprint submitted to IPSJ Journal of Information Processing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用蒙特卡洛采样加反向可达性搜索估计将棋可达局面数，把此前 10^64 到 10^69 的五个数量级缺口收敛到 6.55×10^68。关键改动是反向搜索指向“仅双王”(King-King, KK) 局面集合而非初始局面，因为任意 KK 局面与初始局面互相可达，且移除棋子比重建初始局面容易得多。50 亿局面样本下 3σ 置信区间两端在三位有效数字上都取同一值。
Motivation: 将棋状态空间复杂度的组合估计存在 10^64 到 10^69 五个数量级的缺口，根源是从海量棋盘构型中区分哪些能从初始局面到达。
Method: 蒙特卡洛采样结合可达性测试：反向搜索朝 KK 局面集合而非单一初始局面回溯，到达任一 KK 局面即证明可达；局面定义含行棋方、棋盘构型与持驹，不含着法历史，双方交换与横向镜像只计一次。
Result: 基于 50 亿局面样本，估计将棋可达局面数为 6.55×10^68，近似 3σ 置信区间两端在三位有效数字上均为此值；同一方法用于 Mini Shogi 得约 2.38×10^18。
Conclusion: 把反向可达性检验的目标从初始局面换成互相可达的 KK 局面集合，可将将棋状态空间估计精度推进到三位有效数字，闭合此前五个数量级的缺口。

papers.title: Understanding Gap-Dependent Regret for Optimism-Based Reinforcement Learning with Linear Function Approximation
papers.abstract_en: We study gap-dependent regret for reinforcement learning with linear function approximation. While prior works have established gap-dependent guarantees in this setting, existing analyses do not apply to algorithms that achieve the nearly minimax-optimal worst-case regret bound $\tilde{O}(d\sqrt{H^3K})$, where $d$ is the feature dimension, $H$ is the horizon length, and $K$ is the number of episodes. We bridge this gap by establishing the first gap-dependent regret bound for the nearly minimax-optimal algorithm LSVI-UCB++ (He et al., 2023), with an expected regret bound $\tilde{O}(d^2H^3/Δ_{\min}+d^6H^5)$, improving the dependence on both $d$ and $H$ in the leading gap-dependent term compared with previous results. To understand the exploration cost induced by optimism, we establish a structural lower bound $Ω(d^2H^3/Δ_{\min})$ for a broad class of algorithms based on persistent ellipsoidal optimism. When specialized to LSVI-UCB++, this result shows that the leading dependence of our upper bound on $d$, $H$, and $Δ_{\min}$ is tight up to logarithmic factors. Beyond this algorithmic class, we establish a general gap-dependent lower bound $Ω(dH^3\log K/Δ_{\min})$ for arbitrary learning algorithms, showing that the logarithmic dependence on $K$ and the cubic dependence on $H$ are intrinsic to gap-dependent expected regret in linear MDPs. Together, our results substantially narrow the gap between upper and lower bounds and provide a sharper characterization of gap-dependent learning and optimism-based exploration with linear function approximation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性函数逼近强化学习中，为近极小极大最优算法 LSVI-UCB++ 建立首个 gap-dependent regret 上界 Õ(d²H³/Δmin + d⁶H⁵)，并对持久椭球乐观 (persistent ellipsoidal optimism) 类算法证明结构性下界 Ω(d²H³/Δmin)，说明领先项在 d、H、Δmin 上紧（差对数因子）。
Motivation: 既有 gap-dependent 分析不适用于能达到最坏情况 Õ(d√(H³K)）近极小极大遗憾的乐观类算法，导致最坏情况最优与 gap-dependent 保证之间存在缺口。
Method: 对 LSVI-UCB++（He et al., 2023）推导 gap-dependent 期望遗憾上界；再对基于持久椭球乐观的一类算法证明结构性下界，并对任意学习算法给出一般 gap-dependent 下界。
Result: LSVI-UCB++ 期望遗憾上界 Õ(d²H³/Δmin + d⁶H⁵)，领先 gap 项对 d 与 H 的依赖优于先前结果；结构性下界 Ω(d²H³/Δmin)；任意算法一般下界 Ω(dH³log K/Δmin)，表明 log K 与 H 的三次方依赖是线性 MDP 中固有的。
Conclusion: 乐观驱动的探索代价在 d、H、Δmin 上可证紧（至对数因子），上下界间隙被大幅收窄；log K 与 H³ 依赖对任意算法都不可避免。

papers.title: Greedy Multi-Path Block Verification for Faster Decoding in Speculative Sampling
papers.abstract_en: The goal of $L$-step speculative decoding is to accelerate autoregressive decoding of a target model by using a cheaper draft model to generate a candidate path of $L$ tokens. Based on a verification algorithm involving target and draft model probabilities, a prefix of the candidate sequence is accepted, and an additional correction token is sampled from a residual distribution to ensure that the final output adheres to the target distribution. While standard speculative decoding uses a verification algorithm which is independent at each token on the path, a recent extension called block verification uses a joint condition involving all sampled on-path probabilities. Block verification (BV) was shown to be optimal over all verification algorithms which use only on-path probabilities, improving on standard speculative decoding. In this work, we first show that block verification is optimal even over verification algorithms that use off-path probabilities, by constructing an information-agnostic linear program (LP). Further, we can extend our LP to the setting where the draft model samples multiple candidate paths, and use it to construct a natural class of multi-path block verification generalizations. While computing the optimal algorithm in this class is not tractable, by considering a stricter class of greedy algorithms, we can formulate an efficient method called greedy multi-path block verification (GBV). Empirically, GBV can improve block efficiency by over 30% and reduce decoding walltimes by over 15% relative to BV. On Llama-3 70B, GBV can improve the end-to-end decoding throughput over SOTA multi-path verification methods by more than 15%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在投机采样 (speculative decoding) 中证明 block verification (BV) 即使利用 off-path 概率也最优，并把 LP 推广到多候选路径，进而提出可高效计算的 greedy multi-path block verification (GBV)。GBV 相对 BV 把 block 效率提高 30% 以上、解码 walltime 降低 15% 以上，在 Llama-3 70B 上端到端吞吐比 SOTA 多路径验证方法高 15% 以上。
Motivation: 标准投机采样逐 token 独立验证，block verification 虽已证明在仅用 on-path 概率的算法中最优，但其最优性是否在允许 off-path 概率时仍成立、以及如何推广到多路径且保持可计算，尚无答案。
Method: 构造 information-agnostic 线性规划 (LP) 证明 BV 对使用 off-path 概率的验证算法仍最优；把该 LP 扩展到 draft model 采样多条候选路径的设定，导出多路径 block verification 推广类；因该类上最优解不可高效计算，转而限制到 greedy 算法类，得到高效方法 GBV。
Result: GBV 相对 BV 将 block 效率提高 30% 以上、解码 walltime 降低 15% 以上；在 Llama-3 70B 上端到端解码吞吐比 SOTA 多路径验证方法高 15% 以上。
Conclusion: BV 的最优性可扩展到 off-path 概率，而多路径情形下牺牲全局最优、只取 greedy 类即可换来可计算性并获得实际加速。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: VIRENA: Virtual Arena for Research, Education, and Democratic Innovation
papers.abstract_en: Digital platforms shape how people communicate, deliberate, and form opinions. Studying these dynamics has become harder because of restricted data access, ethical limits on real-world experiments, and the technical demands of existing research tools. VIRENA (Virtual Arena) is a platform for controlled experiments in realistic social media environments. Several participants can interact at the same time in replicas of feed-based platforms (Instagram, Facebook, Reddit, X) and messaging apps (WhatsApp, Messenger). AI agents powered by large language models (LLMs) join the participants with configurable personas and human-like timing. Researchers set up experiments in a visual interface without programming: they define conditions, schedule stimulus content, add moderation rules, assign participants randomly to conditions, and export the data. VIRENA supports designs that were hard to run before, such as studying human--AI interaction in realistic social settings, comparing moderation interventions, and observing group deliberation as it unfolds. Participants and data stay within institutional control, and the platform links to survey and recruitment tools. This paper describes how VIRENA works and how to use it.
papers.comment: VIRENA is under active development and currently in use at the University of Zurich. This preprint will be updated as new features are released. For the latest version and to inquire about demos or pilot collaborations, contact the authors
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VIRENA 是一个受控社会实验平台，让多名真人参与者与带可配置人格、类人响应时序的 LLM 智能体同时在 Instagram、Facebook、Reddit、X、WhatsApp、Messenger 的仿真副本中互动。研究者通过可视化界面设定实验条件、投放刺激内容、配置审核规则并随机分组，无需编程即可导出数据。平台把参与者与数据留在机构控制内，用于此前难以开展的人-AI 互动、审核干预对比与群体审议观察。
Motivation: 数字平台塑造沟通与意见形成，但数据访问受限、真实世界实验受伦理约束、现有研究工具技术门槛高，使这类动态难以研究。
Method: 在基于信息流的社交平台与消息应用副本中同时接入真人与 LLM 驱动的 AI 智能体（可配置人格与类人时序）；可视化界面定义实验条件、排程刺激内容、添加审核规则、随机分配参与者并导出数据，且可链接问卷与招募工具。
Result: 论文描述 VIRENA 的工作方式与用法；平台支持此前难以运行的设计，包括真实社交情境下的人-AI 互动研究、审核干预对比、以及对群体审议过程的实时观察；目前在 University of Zurich 使用中。
Conclusion: 受控仿真社交环境加 LLM 智能体，可以在机构掌控数据的前提下开展原本受数据与伦理限制的传播与审议实验。

papers.title: Multi-Level Strategic Classification: Incentivizing Improvement through Promotion and Relegation Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Strategic classification studies the problem where self-interested individuals or agents manipulate their response to obtain favorable decision outcomes made by classifiers, typically turning to dishonest actions when they are less costly than genuine efforts. While existing studies on sequential strategic classification primarily focus on optimizing dynamic classifier weights, we depart from these weight-centric approaches by analyzing the design of classifier thresholds and difficulty progression within a multi-level promotion-relegation framework. Our model captures the critical inter-temporal incentives driven by an agent's farsightedness, skill retention, and a leg-up effect where qualification and attainment can be self-reinforcing. We characterize the agent's optimal long-term strategy and demonstrate that a principal can design a sequence of thresholds to effectively incentivize honest effort. Crucially, we prove that under mild conditions, this mechanism enables agents to reach arbitrarily high levels solely through genuine improvement efforts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多级晋升-降级 (promotion-relegation) 的序贯战略分类中，作者不再调分类器权重，而是直接设计各级阈值与难度递进，利用远见、技能保持和资格自我强化的 leg-up 效应刻画代理的最优长期策略。证明在温和条件下，principal 可设计一列阈值有效激励诚实努力，使代理仅凭真实能力提升就能达到任意高等级。
Motivation: 既有序贯战略分类研究集中在优化动态分类器权重，忽略了阈值序列与难度递进本身可作为跨期激励工具，难以解释并利用资格自我强化带来的长期改进动力。
Method: 构建多级晋升-降级框架下的阈值与难度递进设计问题，模型纳入代理的远见 (farsightedness)、技能保持 (skill retention) 与 leg-up 效应；在此基础上刻画代理最优长期策略，并对 principal 的阈值序列做机制设计与理论证明。
Result: 证明在温和条件下，所设计的阈值机制能有效激励诚实努力，并使代理仅通过真实改进努力即可达到任意高等级；同时给出代理最优长期策略的刻画。
Conclusion: 序贯战略分类中阈值与难度递进的设计本身足以构成跨期激励机制，无需依赖动态权重调整，即可把自利代理导向诚实努力与持续能力提升。

papers.title: Quantum Model Parallelism for MRI-Based Classification of Alzheimer's Disease Stages
papers.abstract_en: With increasing life expectancy, AD has become a major global health concern. While classical AI-based methods have been developed for early diagnosis and stage classification of AD, growing data volumes and limited computational resources necessitate faster, more efficient approaches. Quantum-based AI methods, which leverage superposition and entanglement principles along with high-dimensional Hilbert space, can surpass classical approaches' limitations and offer higher accuracy for high-dimensional, heterogeneous, and noisy data. In this study, a Quantum-Based Parallel Model (QBPM) architecture is proposed for the efficient classification of AD stages using MRI datasets, inspired by the principles of classical model parallelism. The proposed model leverages quantum advantages by employing two distinct quantum circuits, each incorporating rotational and entanglement blocks, running in parallel on the same quantum simulator. The classification performance of the model was evaluated on two different datasets to assess its overall robustness and generalization capability. The proposed model demonstrated high classification accuracy across both datasets, highlighting its overall robustness and generalization capability. Results obtained under high-level Gaussian noise, simulating real-world conditions, further provided experimental evidence for the model's applicability not only in theoretical but also in practical scenarios. Moreover, compared with five different classical transfer learning methods, the proposed model demonstrated its efficiency as an alternative to classical approaches by achieving higher classification accuracy and comparable execution time while utilizing fewer circuit parameters. The results indicate that the proposed QBPM architecture represents an innovative and powerful approach for the classification of stages in complex diseases such as Alzheimer's.
papers.comment: Under review at Quantum Information Processing (Springer Nature)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出量子并行模型 (QBPM)：两条含旋转与纠缠模块的量子线路在同一量子模拟器上并行运行，用于 MRI 的阿尔茨海默病分期分类。在两个数据集上均取得高分类准确率，高斯噪声下仍保持可用，并在对比五种经典迁移学习方法时以更少线路参数获得更高准确率与相当的执行时间。
Motivation: AD 早期诊断与分期依赖经典 AI，但数据量增长与算力受限要求更高效的方法；高维、异构、含噪的 MRI 数据对经典方法构成压力。
Method: 受经典模型并行启发的 QBPM 架构：两条不同量子线路各含旋转与纠缠模块，在同一量子模拟器上并行执行；在两个 MRI 数据集上评测，并加入高水平高斯噪声模拟真实条件，与五种经典迁移学习方法对比准确率、执行时间与线路参数量。
Result: 在两个不同数据集上均取得高分类准确率，体现鲁棒性与泛化能力；高水平高斯噪声条件下结果仍支持其实际可用性；相比五种经典迁移学习方法，分类准确率更高、执行时间相当，且使用的线路参数更少。
Conclusion: QBPM 可作为经典迁移学习的替代方案用于阿尔茨海默病分期分类，其优势在于以更少线路参数换取更高准确率与相当的执行时间。

papers.title: TRACER: Texture-Robust Affordance Chain-of-Thought for Deformable-Object Region Grounding
papers.abstract_en: The central challenge in robotic manipulation of deformable objects lies in aligning high-level semantic instructions with physical interaction points under complex appearance and texture variations. Existing vision-based affordance prediction methods often suffer from boundary overflow and fragmented functional regions. To address these issues, we propose TRACER, a Texture-Robust Affordance Chain-of-Thought for Deformable-Object Region Grounding framework that maps hierarchical semantic reasoning to appearance-robust and physically consistent interaction regions. Specifically, a Tree-structured Affordance Chain-of-Thought (TA-CoT) decomposes high-level task intentions into hierarchical affordance-semantic instructions. A Spatially-Constrained Boundary Refinement (SCBR) mechanism suppresses prediction spillover and guides responses toward valid object regions. Furthermore, an Interactive Convergent Refinement Flow (ICRF) refines dispersed affordance responses into coherent regions, improving spatial continuity and physical plausibility. Experiments on the Fine-AGDDO15 dataset and a real-world robotic platform demonstrate that TRACER improves affordance grounding precision across diverse textures and patterns. It also enhances long-horizon manipulation success, bridging high-level semantic reasoning and low-level physical execution. The source code and dataset will be made publicly available at https://github.com/Dikay1/TRACER.
papers.comment: The source code and dataset will be made publicly available at https://github.com/Dikay1/TRACER
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACER 面向可变形物体机器人操作，用树状 affordance 思维链 (TA-CoT) 把高层任务意图分解为层级 affordance 语义指令，再用空间约束边界精修 (SCBR) 抑制预测溢出、用交互收敛精修流 (ICRF) 把分散响应聚成连续区域。在 Fine-AGDDO15 数据集与真实机器人平台上提升跨纹理的 affordance 定位精度与长程操作成功率。
Motivation: 可变形物体操作中高层语义指令与物理交互点难以对齐，现有视觉 affordance 预测方法存在边界溢出与功能区域碎片化问题。
Method: 三个组件：TA-CoT 将任务意图分解为层级 affordance 语义指令；SCBR 施加空间约束抑制 spillover 并把响应导向有效物体区域；ICRF 将分散 affordance 响应收敛为连贯区域，提升空间连续性与物理合理性。
Result: 在 Fine-AGDDO15 数据集与真实机器人平台上实验，TRACER 在多样纹理与图案下提升 affordance 定位精度，并提升长程操作成功率。
Conclusion: 层级语义推理加边界与区域约束可以把高层指令与低层物理执行衔接起来，在纹理变化下得到外观鲁棒、物理一致的交互区域。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Stability and Generalization of Stochastic Nonconvex Optimization under Heavy-Tailed Noise: From Gradient Norm to Goldstein Stationarity
papers.abstract_en: The empirical evidence indicates that stochastic optimization with heavy-tailed gradient noise is more appropriate to characterize the training of machine learning models than that with standard bounded gradient variance noise. Most existing works on this phenomenon focus on the convergence of optimization errors, while the analysis for generalization bounds under the heavy-tailed gradient noise remains limited. In this paper, we develop stability-based frameworks to establish dimension-independent generalization bounds of nonconvex optimization under heavy-tailed noise for both smooth and nonsmooth settings. Specifically, we introduce a truncation argument to achieve the generalization error bound based on the algorithmic stability under finite $p$th moment conditions with $p\in(1,2]$. For the smooth case, we apply our framework to derive population gradient norm bounds for several popular stochastic optimization algorithms, including clipped and normalized stochastic gradient descent, as well as their mini-batch and momentum variants. For the nonsmooth case, we establish a population Goldstein stationarity guarantee for online-to-nonconvex conversion methods. It is worth noting that our theory for the nonsmooth setting is established by introducing an on-average gradient stability for the smooth surrogate function, which does not require the additional weak convexity assumption used in existing analysis based on the Moreau envelope.
papers.comment: Extended version of the ICML 2026 paper, with new results on population Goldstein stationarity for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在重尾梯度噪声（有限 p 阶矩，p∈(1,2]）下，用基于算法稳定性的框架推出与维度无关的泛化界：光滑情形给出 clipped/normalized SGD 及其 mini-batch、momentum 变体的 population gradient norm 界，非光滑情形对 online-to-nonconvex 转换方法给出 population Goldstein stationarity 保证，且只需对光滑代理函数引入 on-average gradient stability，无需 Moreau envelope 分析所用的弱凸性假设。
Motivation: 重尾梯度噪声被认为比有界方差假设更贴近 ML 训练，但已有工作多集中在优化误差收敛，重尾噪声下的泛化界分析仍然有限，非光滑情形更缺少不依赖弱凸性假设的结论。
Method: 建立基于 algorithmic stability 的稳定性框架，在有限 p 阶矩条件 p∈(1,2] 下引入截断论证 (truncation argument) 得到泛化误差界；光滑情形套用到 clipped SGD、normalized SGD 及其 mini-batch 与 momentum 变体求 population gradient norm 界，非光滑情形对 online-to-nonconvex conversion 方法建立光滑代理函数的 on-average gradient stability，从而给出 Goldstein stationarity 保证。
Result: 得到与维度无关 (dimension-independent) 的非凸优化泛化界，覆盖 p∈(1,2] 的有限 p 阶矩噪声；光滑情形覆盖 clipped 与 normalized SGD 及其 mini-batch、momentum 变体的 population gradient norm 界，非光滑情形给出 online-to-nonconvex 方法的 population Goldstein stationarity 保证，且不需弱凸性假设。
Conclusion: 稳定性路线可以在重尾噪声下同时支撑光滑与非光滑非凸优化的维度无关泛化理论，非光滑分析用 on-average gradient stability 替代 Moreau envelope 即可绕开弱凸性要求。

papers.title: Contrastive Time Series Forecasting with Anomalies
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting predicts future values from past data. In real-world settings, some anomalous events have lasting effects and influence the forecast, while others are short-lived and should be ignored. Standard forecasting models fail to make this distinction, often either overreacting to noise or missing persistent shifts. We propose Co-TSFA (Contrastive Time Series Forecasting with Anomalies), a regularization framework that learns when to ignore anomalies and when to respond. Co-TSFA generates input-only and input-output augmentations to model forecast-irrelevant and forecast-relevant anomalies, and introduces a latent-output alignment loss that ties representation changes to forecast changes. This encourages invariance to irrelevant perturbations while preserving sensitivity to meaningful distributional shifts. Experiments on the Traffic and Electricity benchmarks, as well as on a real-world cash-demand dataset, demonstrate that Co-TSFA improves performance under anomalous conditions while maintaining accuracy on normal data. An anonymized GitHub repository with the implementation of Co-TSFA is provided and will be made public upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出对比式时序预报正则框架 Co-TSFA，用输入-only 与输入-输出两类增广分别模拟与预报无关和相关的异常，再加隐空间-输出对齐损失，让表征变化与预报变化绑定，从而学会忽略短命噪声、响应持续性偏移。在 Traffic、Electricity 基准与真实现金需求数据集上，异常条件下性能提升且正常数据精度保持。
Motivation: 真实时序中有的异常事件有持续影响、有的转瞬即逝，标准预报模型无法区分，往往要么对噪声过度反应、要么漏掉持续性分布偏移。
Method: Co-TSFA 是一个正则化框架：生成 input-only 与 input-output 两种增广分别建模与预报无关和预报相关的异常，并引入 latent-output alignment loss 把表征变化与预报变化绑定，鼓励对无关扰动不变、对有意义的分布偏移保持敏感。
Result: 在 Traffic 与 Electricity 基准以及一个真实现金需求 (cash-demand) 数据集上，Co-TSFA 在异常条件下改善性能，同时在正常数据上保持精度；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把异常按是否影响预报来区分并用对比正则约束表征，可让时序预报模型在异常环境下更稳而不牺牲正常数据精度；实现代码以匿名 GitHub 仓库形式提供，接收后公开。
