papers.title: Fine-Grained Caching for Diffusion Transformers with Few Calibration Conditions
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion transformers require repeated denoiser evaluations, making image and video generation computationally expensive. We propose a training-free framework that uses a few calibration conditions to construct a fixed, fine-grained module-reuse schedule without schedule search. The design is motivated by an empirical effect along deterministic sampling trajectories: with initial noise fixed, condition-dependent deviations in several module outputs evolve similarly across adjacent steps, so temporal differencing attenuates much of their variation. We term this effect Conditional Common-Mode Rejection (CCMR). Motivated by this observation, we rank timestep--layer--module locations using normalized ratios of consecutive feature displacements and construct a Cache Book through two-stage calibration. The second stage updates a scorer-only reference with each provisional bit after recording its indexed score, while retaining full-compute trajectories. At inference, the fixed schedule requires no per-input policy estimation and can be nested within fixed step-wise cache policies. Module caching alone achieves $1.66$--$1.72\times$ speedup on the evaluated image models and $1.54$--$1.68\times$ on the video models. Combining it with MagCache or SeaCache provides further acceleration at a model-dependent cost in paired fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的 Diffusion Transformer 细粒度模块复用框架：用少量校准条件沿确定性采样轨迹发现 Conditional Common-Mode Rejection（CCMR）效应，据此两阶段校准生成固定 Cache Book 调度，推理时无需逐输入策略估计。纯模块缓存在评测图像模型上加速 1.66–1.72×、视频模型 1.54–1.68×，叠加 MagCache 或 SeaCache 可进一步加速，代价是模型相关的成对保真度损失。
Motivation: Diffusion Transformer 生成图像与视频需反复调用去噪网络，计算开销大；现有缓存策略往往要做调度搜索或逐输入策略估计，难以给出固定、可嵌套的复用方案。
Method: 先在固定初始噪声下观察到若干模块输出的条件相关偏差在相邻步演化相似，时域差分 (temporal differencing) 可抑制其变化，即 CCMR；再按连续特征位移的归一化比值对 timestep–layer–module 位置排序，用两阶段校准构建 Cache Book，第二阶段在记录每个暂定位的分数后只更新 scorer 参考、同时保留全计算轨迹；推理时套用固定调度，并可嵌套进固定步级缓存策略。
Result: 纯模块缓存在评测图像模型上取得 1.66–1.72× 加速，视频模型 1.54–1.68×；与 MagCache 或 SeaCache 组合可获得进一步加速，代价是模型相关的成对保真度 (paired fidelity) 下降。
Conclusion: 少量校准条件加 CCMR 就足以支撑固定、免搜索的细粒度模块复用调度，且能与既有步级缓存策略叠加换取更高加速。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchical Decentralized Multi-Agent Coordination with Privacy-Preserving Knowledge Sharing: Extending AgentNet for Scalable Autonomous Systems
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized multi-agent systems have shown promise in enabling autonomous collaboration among LLM-based agents. While AgentNet demonstrated the feasibility of fully decentralized coordination through dynamic DAG topologies, several limitations remain: scalability challenges with large agent populations, communication overhead, lack of privacy guarantees, and suboptimal resource allocation. We propose AgentNet++, a hierarchical decentralized framework that extends AgentNet with multilevel agent organization, privacy-preserving knowledge sharing via differential privacy and secure aggregation, adaptive resource management, and theoretical convergence guarantees. Our approach introduces cluster-based hierarchies where agents self-organize into specialized groups, enabling efficient task routing and knowledge distillation while maintaining full decentralization. We provide formal analysis of convergence properties and privacy bounds, and demonstrate through extensive experiments on complex multi-agent tasks that AgentNet++ achieves 23% higher task completion rates, 40% reduction in communication overhead, and maintains strong privacy guarantees compared to AgentNet and other baselines. Our framework scales effectively to 1000+ agents while preserving the emergent intelligence properties of the original AgentNet.
papers.comment: This research work has many confounds, overclaims without any support, and hallucinated citations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentNet++ 在 AgentNet 的动态 DAG 去中心化协调之上加入多层聚类层级、基于差分隐私与安全聚合的知识共享、自适应资源管理，并声称给出收敛性与隐私界的理论分析。摘要声称在复杂多智能体任务上任务完成率比 AgentNet 及其他基线高 23%、通信开销降低 40%，且可扩展到 1000+ 智能体。注意 arXiv comment 明确指出该工作存在大量混淆因素、无支撑的过度宣称与幻觉引用。
Motivation: LLM 智能体的全去中心化协调在智能体数量增大时面临可扩展性、通信开销、隐私缺失与资源分配次优等问题。
Method: 提出 AgentNet++：在 AgentNet 动态 DAG 拓扑上引入 cluster-based 多层组织使智能体自组织成专门化小组，配合差分隐私与安全聚合 (secure aggregation) 的知识共享、自适应资源管理，并给出收敛性质与隐私界的理论分析。
Result: 摘要声称：任务完成率比 AgentNet 及其他基线高 23%，通信开销降低 40%，可扩展到 1000+ 智能体并保留原 AgentNet 的涌现智能特性；但 arXiv comment 声明该工作有诸多混淆因素、无支撑的过度宣称与幻觉引用。
Conclusion: 按摘要主张，分层去中心化加隐私保护知识共享可同时改善完成率、通信开销与规模；但作者自述的 comment 已否定这些宣称的可信度，阅读时应以该警告为准。

papers.title: PaTAS: A Framework for Trust Propagation in Neural Networks Using Subjective Logic
papers.abstract_en: Trustworthiness has become a key requirement for deploying artificial intelligence in safety-critical applications, yet conventional metrics such as accuracy fail to capture uncertainty or the reliability of predictions, particularly under adversarial or degraded conditions. This paper introduces the Parallel Trust Assessment System (PaTAS), a framework for modeling and propagating trust in neural networks using Subjective Logic (SL). PaTAS operates in parallel with standard neural computation through Trust Nodes and Trust Functions that propagate input, parameter, and activation trust across the network, refining parameter trust during training (Parameter Trust Update) and returning a per-inference trust opinion, quantifying belief, disbelief, and uncertainty, on each prediction (Inference-Path Trust Assessment). Experiments on real-world and adversarial datasets show that these estimates are interpretable and stable and complement accuracy: PaTAS flags predictions that remain accurate yet rely on parameters learned from corrupted data, detects adversarially patched inputs without knowledge of the trigger, and audits training-label corruption without any test data. Compared with output-only uncertainty baselines and dedicated input- and feature-space detectors, out-of-distribution and corruption detection is carried by the conformity-derived input opinions PaTAS consumes, within a regime that a per-dataset diagnostic identifies in advance; trust propagation adds model-side signals these detectors lack, and the composed trust degrades gracefully where any single signal fails. The mechanism extends to convolutional networks. PaTAS thereby provides a foundation for transparent, quantifiable trust reasoning across the AI lifecycle.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE TPS 2026. Extended version with appendices: 43 pages, 40 figures, 15 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PaTAS 用 Subjective Logic 在神经网络旁路并行传播信任：Trust Nodes/Trust Functions 把输入、参数、激活信任逐层传递，训练期做 Parameter Trust Update，推理期输出 belief/disbelief/uncertainty 三元意见。在真实与对抗数据集上，它能标出“预测仍准但参数来自污染数据”的样本、无需知道触发器即可检出对抗补丁、并在无测试数据下审计训练标签污染；OOD 与 corruption 检测由其 conformity 派生的输入意见承担，且在单一信号失效处组合信任平缓退化。
Motivation: accuracy 一类常规指标无法刻画预测的不确定性与可靠性，尤其在对抗或退化条件下，安全关键场景缺少可解释、可量化的信任度量。
Method: PaTAS 与标准神经计算并行运行：Trust Nodes 与 Trust Functions 沿网络传播输入、参数、激活信任；训练中用 Parameter Trust Update 精化参数信任，推理时用 Inference-Path Trust Assessment 输出每次预测的 belief、disbelief、uncertainty 意见；OOD/检测依赖 conformity 派生的输入意见，并由逐数据集诊断预先确定适用区间，机制可扩展到卷积网络。
Result: 在真实与对抗数据集上，信任估计可解释且稳定，并与 accuracy 互补：标出依赖污染数据所学参数却仍准确的预测，无需触发器知识检出对抗补丁输入，且在不使用任何测试数据的情况下审计训练标签污染；与仅输出端的不确定性基线及专用输入/特征空间检测器相比，OOD 与 corruption 检测由其输入意见承担，组合信任在任一单一信号失效时平缓退化。
Conclusion: 把信任作为与计算并行、可逐层传播的一等公民意见，能在 AI 生命周期内给出透明、可量化的信任推理，且与 accuracy 和现有检测器互补而非替代。

papers.title: EfficientXpert: Efficient Domain Adaptation for Large Language Models via Propagation-Aware Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Deploying domain-specialized large language models on resource-constrained hardware motivates reducing both adaptation cost and the number of retained weights. LoRA lowers adaptation cost but leaves a dense backbone, while separate pruning can discard weights that become important during adaptation. We propose EfficientXpert, a framework that co-adapts low-rank updates and sparse support. Its ForeSight Mask scores weights through a downstream reconstruction surrogate using the evolving LoRA-augmented weights; Partial Brain Surgeon (PBS) realigns the adapter through a closed-form correction. At 40% sparsity, the strongest variant retains 98.55--108.99% of dense-LoRA aggregate performance across the evaluated LLaMA settings. On Qwen3-8B, adaptation adds 17.9--27.0% training time and at most 4.8% peak GPU memory. Our analysis connects the domain- and rank-dependent effects of PBS to its constrained reconstruction objective, providing guidance for selecting adapter recovery capacity. Together, these results demonstrate efficient production of sparse, domain-specialized experts. Code is available at https://github.com/TagoreZhao/Efficient_Domain_Adaptation.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints (ODI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EfficientXpert 把 LoRA 适配与剪枝合并成一步：ForeSight Mask 用不断更新的 LoRA 增强权重做下游重建代理来打分，Partial Brain Surgeon (PBS) 用闭式修正重新对齐 adapter。40% 稀疏度下最强变体在所评测的 LLaMA 设置上保留 dense-LoRA 聚合性能的 98.55–108.99%。
Motivation: LoRA 降低了适配成本但骨干仍是稠密的，而独立剪枝会丢掉适配期间才变得重要的权重，两条路径无法同时压缩与适配。
Method: 框架联合优化低秩更新与稀疏支撑：ForeSight Mask 通过下游重建代理、以演化中的 LoRA-augmented 权重为输入给权重打分；Partial Brain Surgeon (PBS) 以闭式修正重新对齐 adapter，其效果由受约束的重建目标解释，用于选择 adapter 恢复容量。
Result: 40% 稀疏度下最强变体在所评测的 LLaMA 设置上保留 dense-LoRA 聚合性能的 98.55–108.99%；在 Qwen3-8B 上适配额外增加 17.9–27.0% 训练时间，峰值 GPU 显存最多增加 4.8%。
Conclusion: 稀疏支撑与低秩更新应联合决定而非分步进行，即可在保留域适配性能的同时产出稀疏的域专用专家；PBS 的域与秩依赖效应可由其受约束重建目标解释，用来指导 adapter 恢复容量的选择。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Gradient descent dynamics for deep equilibrium models
papers.abstract_en: Deep equilibrium models (DEQs) have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for training infinitely deep weight-tied neural networks that achieve state of the art performance across many modern machine learning tasks. Despite their practical success, theoretically understanding the gradient descent dynamics for training DEQs remains an area of active research. In this work, we rigorously study the gradient descent dynamics for DEQs in the simple setting of linear models and single-index models, filling several gaps in the literature. We prove a matrix conservation law for linear DEQs which implies that the parameters remain trapped on spheres along gradient flow and use this property to show that gradient flow remains well-conditioned for all time. We then prove linear convergence of gradient descent to a global minimizer for linear DEQs and deep equilibrium single-index models under appropriate initialization and with a sufficiently small step size. In these simple settings, we also study the effect of common Neumann approximations used to reduce the cost of backpropagation; for linear DEQs, we show that increasing the number of terms in the Neumann approximation can prevent convergence to zero risk, even with exact forward solves. For nonlinear single-index DEQs, we prove linear convergence for fixed Neumann approximations, including Jacobian-free backpropagation under suitable assumptions. Finally, we validate our theoretical findings through experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性 DEQ 与 single-index DEQ 上严格分析梯度下降动力学：证明线性 DEQ 存在矩阵守恒律，参数沿梯度流被困在球面上且条件数始终良好；在合适初始化与足够小步长下，梯度下降线性收敛到全局极小。反直觉地，对线性 DEQ 增加 Neumann 近似的项数反而会阻止风险收敛到零，即便前向求解是精确的。
Motivation: DEQ 虽在多项任务上取得 SOTA，但其梯度下降训练动力学的理论理解仍是活跃且有缺口的领域，尤其缺少收敛性保证以及反向传播中 Neumann 近似代价的理论刻画。
Method: 在线性模型与 single-index 模型这一简化设定下做严格理论分析：对线性 DEQ 证明矩阵守恒律并据此论证梯度流全程良态，再在合适初始化与小步长条件下证明梯度下降线性收敛；同时分析用于降低反向传播成本的 Neumann 近似（含 Jacobian-free backpropagation）的影响，并以实验验证理论结论。
Result: 证明线性 DEQ 的矩阵守恒律，参数沿梯度流保持在球面上且全程良态；在线性 DEQ 与 deep equilibrium single-index 模型上证明梯度下降线性收敛到全局极小（需合适初始化与足够小步长）；对线性 DEQ，增加 Neumann 近似项数会阻止风险收敛到零，即便前向求解精确；对非线性 single-index DEQ，在合适假设下证明固定 Neumann 近似（含 Jacobian-free backpropagation）的线性收敛；并用实验验证理论发现。
Conclusion: DEQ 的可训练性在简化模型上有严格保证，但反向传播的 Neumann 近似项数并非越多越好——线性 DEQ 中项数增加会破坏零风险收敛。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EulerESG: Automating ESG Disclosure Analysis with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reports have become central to how companies communicate climate risk, social impact, and governance practices, yet they are still published primarily as long, heterogeneous PDF documents. This makes it difficult to systematically answer seemingly simple questions. Existing tools either rely on brittle rule-based extraction or treat ESG reports as generic text, without explicitly modelling the underlying reporting standards. We present \textbf{EulerESG}, an LLM-powered system for automating ESG disclosure analysis with explicit awareness of ESG frameworks. EulerESG combines (i) dual-channel retrieval and LLM-driven disclosure analysis over ESG reports, and (ii) an interactive dashboard and chatbot for exploration, benchmarking, and explanation. Using four globally recognised companies and twelve SASB sub-industries, we show that EulerESG can automatically populate standard-aligned metric tables with high fidelity (up to 0.95 average accuracy) while remaining practical in end-to-end runtime, and we compare several recent LLM models in this setting. The full implementation, together with a demonstration video, is publicly available at https://github.com/UNSW-database/EulerESG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EulerESG 是一个显式建模 ESG 报告标准的 LLM 系统，用双通道检索加 LLM 披露分析自动填充标准对齐的指标表，并配交互式 dashboard 与 chatbot 做探索、对标和解释。在四家全球公司、十二个 SASB 子行业上，标准对齐指标表填充的平均准确率最高达 0.95，同时保持端到端运行时间可实用，并横向比较了多个近期 LLM。
Motivation: ESG 报告以长且异构的 PDF 发布，系统回答简单问题困难；现有工具要么依赖脆弱的规则抽取，要么把 ESG 报告当普通文本处理，没有显式建模底层报告标准。
Method: EulerESG 结合两部分：(i) 双通道检索 (dual-channel retrieval) 加 LLM 驱动的披露分析，直接面向 ESG 报告；(ii) 交互式 dashboard 与 chatbot，用于探索、对标与解释。评测覆盖四家全球公认的公司与十二个 SASB 子行业，并比较多个近期 LLM 模型。
Result: 标准对齐指标表自动填充的平均准确率最高达 0.95，且端到端运行时间保持实用；在该设置下比较了多个近期 LLM 模型。评测规模为 4 家公司、12 个 SASB 子行业。
Conclusion: 把报告标准显式注入 LLM 抽取流程，可以让 ESG 披露分析自动填充标准对齐指标表并达到高保真，同时保持实际可用的运行时间；实现与演示视频已在 GitHub 公开。

papers.title: DeNoise: Learning Robust Graph Representations for Unsupervised Graph-Level Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid growth of graph-structured data in critical domains, unsupervised graph-level anomaly detection (UGAD) has become a pivotal task. UGAD seeks to identify entire graphs that deviate from normal behavioral patterns. However, most Graph Neural Network (GNN) approaches implicitly assume that the training set is clean, containing only normal graphs, which is rarely true in practice. Even modest contamination by anomalous graphs can distort learned representations and sharply degrade performance. To address this challenge, we propose DeNoise, a robust UGAD framework explicitly designed for contaminated training data. It jointly optimizes a graph-level encoder, an attribute decoder, and a structure decoder via an adversarial objective to learn noise-resistant embeddings. Further, DeNoise introduces an encoder anchor-alignment denoising mechanism that fuses high-information node embeddings from normal graphs into all graph embeddings, improving representation quality while suppressing anomaly interference. A contrastive learning component then compacts normal graph embeddings and repels anomalous ones in the latent space. Extensive experiments on eight real-world datasets demonstrate that DeNoise consistently learns reliable graph-level representations under varying noise intensities and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art UGAD baselines.
papers.comment: Withdrawn by the authors because issues were identified in the original data and experimental evaluation, requiring substantial revisions that affect the reported results and conclusions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeNoise 面向训练集被异常图污染的无监督图级异常检测 (UGAD)，用对抗目标联合训练图级编码器与属性/结构解码器得到抗噪嵌入，再用 anchor-alignment 把正常图的高信息节点嵌入融进所有图嵌入，最后以对比学习压缩正常图、推开异常图。在八个真实数据集、不同噪声强度下均显著优于 SOTA UGAD 基线。
Motivation: 多数 GNN 异常检测方法默认训练集只含正常图，但实际数据常被异常图污染；即便少量污染也会扭曲学到的表示并使性能大幅下降。
Method: DeNoise 框架：图级编码器 + 属性解码器 + 结构解码器通过对抗目标联合优化，学习抗噪嵌入；encoder anchor-alignment denoising 机制把正常图的高信息节点嵌入融合进全部图嵌入；再加一个对比学习组件在潜空间压缩正常图嵌入、排斥异常图嵌入。
Result: 在八个真实世界数据集上、跨不同噪声强度，DeNoise 持续学到可靠的图级表示，并显著优于 SOTA UGAD 基线。
Conclusion: 在污染训练数据下，对抗去噪编码与 anchor-alignment 加对比学习的组合能学到对异常干扰更稳健的图级表示。注：作者已因原始数据与实验评估存在问题而撤回该版本，结论需修订。

papers.title: RefAtomNet++: Advancing Referring Atomic Video Action Recognition using Multi-Trajectory Semantic Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Who is being described, where are they, and what are they doing? Referring Atomic Video Action Recognition (RAVAR) answers these questions jointly by grounding a natural-language reference to a person and recognizing that person's fine-grained atomic actions in complex multi-person videos. Progress in RAVAR is constrained by limited benchmark scale and weak alignment between fine-grained linguistic and scene cues and temporally coherent visual cues. We address both challenges with a new dataset and model. We introduce RefAVA++, a large-scale dataset comprising 2,950,920$ frames, 75,111 annotated person instances, and 80 atomic action categories. Its references describe appearance and spatial attributes while deliberately omitting action labels, requiring models to infer actions directly from visual cues. We further propose RefAtomNet++, which models complementary semantics at the holistic-sentence, partial-keyword, and scene-attribute levels. Fine-grained semantic cues retrieve aligned visual tokens across time to construct trajectories, which are aggregated through Mamba-based state-space modeling and fused using multi-hierarchical semantic-aligned cross-attention. This design enables accurate joint person localization and multi-label atomic action recognition. Equipped with the InternVideo2.5 backbone, RefAtomNet++ achieves 50.39%/51.14% mIoU, 59.21%/59.55% mAP, and 73.89%/76.59% AUROC on RefAVA, and 49.49%/50.33% mIoU, 62.33%/61.90% mAP, and 76.06%/76.10% AUROC on RefAVA++ validation/test sets, respectively. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/KPeng9510/refAVA2.
papers.comment: Extended version of ECCV 2024 paper arXiv:2407.01872. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/KPeng9510/refAVA2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RAVAR 任务的 RefAtomNet++：在整体句子、局部关键词、场景属性三个层次建模互补语义，用细粒度语义线索跨时间检索对齐的视觉 token 构成轨迹，经 Mamba 状态空间聚合与多层级语义对齐交叉注意力融合，联合完成人员定位与多标签原子动作识别。配 InternVideo2.5 主干，在 RefAVA 上取得 50.39%/51.14% mIoU、59.21%/59.55% mAP、73.89%/76.59% AUROC。
Motivation: RAVAR 进展受两方面制约：基准规模有限，以及细粒度语言/场景线索与时序连贯视觉线索之间对齐薄弱。
Method: 同时发布大规模数据集 RefAVA++（2,950,920 帧、75,111 个标注人员实例、80 个原子动作类别，其指代表述刻意省略动作标签，迫使模型从视觉线索推断动作）；模型在整体句子、局部关键词、场景属性三个语义层次建模，检索跨时间对齐的视觉 token 构成轨迹，用 Mamba 状态空间模型聚合，再经多层级语义对齐交叉注意力融合，主干为 InternVideo2.5。
Result: RefAVA 上 mIoU 50.39%/51.14%、mAP 59.21%/59.55%、AUROC 73.89%/76.59%；RefAVA++ 验证/测试集上 mIoU 49.49%/50.33%、mAP 62.33%/61.90%、AUROC 76.06%/76.10%。
Conclusion: 多层级语义检索加轨迹式状态空间建模能支撑复杂多人视频中人员定位与细粒度原子动作的联合识别，配套数据集与代码已开源。

papers.title: FreshBrew: A Benchmark for Evaluating AI Agents on Java Code Migration
papers.abstract_en: AI coding assistants are rapidly becoming integral to modern software development. A key challenge in this space is the continual need to migrate and modernize codebases in response to evolving software ecosystems. Traditionally, such migrations have relied on rule-based systems and human intervention. With the advent of powerful large language models (LLMs), AI-driven agentic frameworks offer a promising alternative-but their effectiveness has not been systematically evaluated. In this paper, we introduce \FreshBrew{}\footnote{\url{https://github.com/mrcabbage972/freshbrew}}, a novel benchmark for evaluating AI agents on project-level Java migrations, with a specific focus on measuring an agent's ability to preserve program semantics and avoid reward hacking, which we argue requires projects with high test coverage for a rigorous and reliable evaluation. We benchmark several state-of-the-art LLMs, and compare their performance against established rule-based tools. Our evaluation on a challenging subset of 228 public Maven repositories that build on JDK 8, fail on JDK 17, and have high test coverage shows that the top-performing model, Gemini 2.5 Flash, can successfully migrate 52.3\% of projects to JDK 17. Our empirical analysis reveals novel insights into the critical strengths and limitations of current agentic approaches, offering actionable insights into their real-world applicability. Our empirical study reveals failure modes of current AI agents in realistic Java modernization tasks, providing a foundation for evaluating trustworthy code-migration systems. By releasing \FreshBrew{}, we aim to facilitate rigorous, reproducible evaluation and catalyze progress in AI-driven codebase modernization.
papers.journal_ref: ICSE '26: Proceedings of the 2026 IEEE/ACM 48th International Conference on Software Engineering
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FreshBrew 是评测 AI agent 做项目级 Java 迁移的基准，选取 228 个在 JDK 8 可构建、JDK 17 失败且测试覆盖率高的公开 Maven 仓库，重点度量语义保持与 reward hacking。评测多个 SOTA LLM 并与规则式工具对比，最佳模型 Gemini 2.5 Flash 成功迁移 52.3% 的项目到 JDK 17。
Motivation: 代码库迁移长期依赖规则式系统与人工介入，LLM 驱动的 agentic 框架虽有潜力但缺乏系统评测，且缺少能严格度量语义保持与 reward hacking 的基准。
Method: 构建 FreshBrew 基准，语料为 228 个公开 Maven 仓库（JDK 8 构建通过、JDK 17 失败、高测试覆盖率），用测试通过与否判定语义保持；评测多个 SOTA LLM agent，并与既有规则式迁移工具对比。
Result: 在该 228 仓库子集上，表现最好的 Gemini 2.5 Flash 成功将 52.3% 的项目迁移到 JDK 17；评测同时覆盖多个 SOTA LLM 与规则式工具的对比，并给出当前 agent 的失败模式分析。
Conclusion: 高测试覆盖率的仓库是严格评测代码迁移、防止 reward hacking 的必要条件；当前 agentic 方法在真实 Java 现代化任务上仍只覆盖约一半项目，存在明确的能力边界。

papers.title: GeoFunFlow: Geometric function flow matching for joint probabilistic inference of physical fields and complex geometries
papers.abstract_en: Inverse problems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs) arise widely in science and engineering, but are often ill-posed and limited by sparse, noisy observations. In many applications, measurements reveal only part of the physical state, while the domain geometry may also be unknown even though it shapes the observed response. Joint field and geometry inference across varying computational domains and discretizations remains challenging, whereas many existing machine learning approaches are designed for known geometries and deterministic field reconstruction. Here, we introduce GeoFunFlow, a probabilistic framework that unifies field reconstruction on known domains and joint field and geometry inference on unknown domains. GeoFunFlow combines a geometric function autoencoder (GeoFAE) with flow matching in the latent space to model a joint distribution over physical fields and geometries. GeoFAE establishes a common representation across spatial discretizations that captures the relationship between physical fields and domain geometries, with unknown geometry represented by a signed distance function. The resulting representation allows observations to guide both field reconstruction and geometry recovery, while latent rectified flow enables efficient conditional sampling and spatially resolved uncertainty quantification. A calibration procedure further provides geometry uncertainty estimates with interpretable empirical coverage. Across seven benchmarks spanning porous media flow, fluid mechanics, and optical tomography, GeoFunFlow accurately recovers fields and geometries across complex, variable, and unknown domains while quantifying spatially resolved conditional uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoFunFlow 把已知域上的场重建与未知域上的场-几何联合推断统一进一个概率框架：几何函数自编码器 (GeoFAE) 跨离散网格编码物理场与以符号距离函数 (SDF) 表示的未知几何，潜空间 rectified flow 学联合分布并做条件采样。在多孔介质流、流体力学与光学层析成像共七个基准上，它能跨复杂、可变、未知域恢复场与几何，同时给出空间分辨的条件不确定性与带经验覆盖率的几何不确定性估计。
Motivation: PDE 反问题常病态、观测稀疏含噪且只揭示部分物理状态，域几何本身未知却决定观测响应；现有机器学习方法多假设几何已知且只做确定性场重建，跨不同计算域与离散的联合场-几何推断仍是空白。
Method: GeoFAE 建立跨空间离散的公共表示，捕捉物理场与域几何的关系，未知几何用符号距离函数 (SDF) 编码；在该潜空间上做 flow matching，用 latent rectified flow 建模场与几何的联合分布并实现高效条件采样；另加一个校准步骤给出带可解释经验覆盖率的几何不确定性估计。
Result: 在横跨多孔介质流、流体力学和光学层析成像的七个基准上，GeoFunFlow 在复杂、可变与未知域上准确恢复物理场与几何，并输出空间分辨的条件不确定性；几何不确定性经校准后具有可解释的经验覆盖率。
Conclusion: 把几何编码进共享潜表示并用潜空间流匹配建模联合分布，可以在未知几何下同时完成场重建、几何恢复与不确定性量化，从而绕开「几何已知」这一常见前提。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Enhancing Knowledge Tracing through Leakage-Free and Recency-Aware Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge Tracing (KT) aims to predict a student's future performance based on their sequence of interactions with learning content. Many KT models rely on knowledge concepts (KCs), which represent the skills required for each item. However, some of these models are vulnerable to label leakage, a phenomenon in which the input data inadvertently reveal the correct answer, particularly in datasets with multiple KCs per question. We propose a straightforward yet effective solution to prevent label leakage by masking ground-truth labels during input embedding construction whenever such leakage could occur. To accomplish this, we introduce a dedicated MASK label, inspired by masked language modeling (e.g., BERT), to replace ground-truth labels. In addition, we introduce Recency Encoding, which encodes the step-wise distance between the current item and its most recent previous occurrence. This distance is important for modeling learning dynamics such as forgetting, which is a fundamental aspect of human learning, yet it is often overlooked in existing models. Recency Encoding demonstrates improved performance over traditional positional encodings on multiple KT benchmarks. We show that incorporating our embeddings into KT models such as DKT, DKT+, AKT, and SAKT consistently improves prediction accuracy across multiple benchmarks. The approach is both efficient and widely applicable.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 知识追踪 (KT) 中多知识点 (KC) 题目会让输入嵌入直接暴露正确答案标签，本文用 MASK label 在嵌入构造阶段替换 ground-truth 标签堵住泄漏，并加入 Recency Encoding 编码当前题目与最近一次出现的步距以建模遗忘。将两组嵌入接入 DKT、DKT+、AKT、SAKT 后，在多个 KT benchmark 上预测准确率一致提升，Recency Encoding 优于传统位置编码。
Motivation: 部分 KT 模型在每题含多个 KC 的数据集上易受标签泄漏影响，输入数据会无意间透露正确答案；同时题目间隔所反映的遗忘这一学习动力学常被现有模型忽略。
Method: 提出两组嵌入：一是在可能泄漏时用专门的 MASK label（借鉴 BERT 等 masked language modeling）替换 ground-truth 标签来构造输入嵌入；二是 Recency Encoding，编码当前题目与其最近一次出现之间的步进距离。将这些嵌入接入 DKT、DKT+、AKT、SAKT 等 KT 模型。
Result: Recency Encoding 在多个 KT benchmark 上优于传统位置编码；把该嵌入加入 DKT、DKT+、AKT、SAKT 后，在多个 benchmark 上一致提升预测准确率。
Conclusion: 在嵌入构造阶段屏蔽标签即可防住多 KC 场景的标签泄漏，配合显式建模最近出现距离的 Recency Encoding，可高效且广泛地提升各类 KT 模型的预测精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cooperative Sheaf Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Sheaf diffusion has recently emerged as a promising design pattern for graph representation learning due to its inherent ability to handle heterophilic data and avoid oversmoothing. Meanwhile, cooperative message passing has also been proposed as a way to enhance the flexibility of information diffusion by allowing nodes to independently choose whether to propagate/gather information from/to neighbors. A natural question ensues: is sheaf diffusion capable of exhibiting this cooperative behavior? Here, we provide a negative answer to this question. In particular, we show that existing sheaf diffusion methods fail to achieve cooperative behavior due to the lack of message directionality. To circumvent this limitation, we introduce the notion of cellular sheaves over directed graphs and characterize their in- and out-degree Laplacians. We leverage our construction to propose Cooperative Sheaf Neural Networks (CSNNs). Theoretically, we characterize the receptive field of CSNN and show it allows nodes to selectively attend (listen) to arbitrarily far nodes while ignoring all others in their path, potentially mitigating oversquashing. Our experiments show that CSNN presents overall better performance compared to prior art on sheaf diffusion as well as cooperative graph neural networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明现有 sheaf diffusion 因缺少消息方向性无法实现 cooperative message passing，进而提出有向图上的 cellular sheaf 与 Cooperative Sheaf Neural Networks (CSNN)，其感受野允许节点选择性听取任意远的节点而忽略路径上其余节点，从而可能缓解 oversquashing；在图表示学习实验中整体优于 sheaf diffusion 与 cooperative GNN 的既有方法。
Motivation: Sheaf diffusion 能处理 heterophilic 数据并抑制 oversmoothing，cooperative message passing 让节点自主决定是否收发消息，但两者能否结合没有答案；现有 sheaf diffusion 缺少 message directionality，无法表达这种合作行为。
Method: 定义有向图上的 cellular sheaf 并刻画其 in-degree 与 out-degree Laplacian，据此构造 CSNN；理论上给出 CSNN 感受野刻画，说明节点可选择性听取任意远节点而忽略路径上的其他节点。
Result: 实验显示 CSNN 相比 sheaf diffusion 与 cooperative graph neural networks 的既有方法整体性能更优；理论刻画表明其感受野支持远距离选择性注意，潜在缓解 oversquashing。
Conclusion: Sheaf diffusion 本身无法产生 cooperative 行为，引入有向 cellular sheaf 与方向性 Laplacian 后可以做到，并在图学习任务上取得整体更好的表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Online Conformal Abstention Under Adversarial Bandit Feedback
papers.abstract_en: As interactive generative systems are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, their tendency to generate unreliable or false responses raises serious concerns. Conformal abstention mitigates this risk by ensuring that the system answers only when confident. However, real-world deployments typically provide only partial user feedback (e.g., thumbs up/down) on the selected response and often operate in non-stationary or adversarial environments, for which effective learning methods are largely missing. To bridge this gap, we propose ExAUL, a novel online learning framework for conformal abstention with adversarial and partial feedback. Technically, we introduce (i) a novel conversion lemma that translates the regret of any bandit algorithm into a selective risk (SR) bound, and (ii) feedback unlocking, a strategy that exploits the structure of conformal abstention to extract additional learning signals from partial feedback. We prove that ExAUL achieves a regret bound of $O(\sqrt{T \ln |\Hs|})$, which translates into an $O(\sqrt{T})$ bound on SR violation control, matching the controllability of full-information settings despite receiving only partial feedback. While applicable to general generative tasks, we demonstrate the efficacy of ExAUL for ensuring the reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs) through empirical validation on question-answering tasks across diverse non-stationary and adversarial settings. Our results demonstrate that ExAUL robustly controls the SR while maintaining competitive answering coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出在线学习框架 ExAUL，用于在只有部分用户反馈（thumbs up/down）、且环境非平稳或对抗性的条件下做 conformal abstention：只在置信时作答。其 conversion lemma 把任意 bandit 算法的 regret 转成 selective risk (SR) 界，feedback unlocking 从部分反馈中再挤出学习信号，regret 达 O(√(T ln|H|))，对应 SR 违规控制 O(√(T))，与全信息设定相当。
Motivation: 交互式生成系统会给出不可靠或虚假回答，conformal abstention 只在置信时作答可缓解该风险；但真实部署只在被选中的回答上收到部分反馈，且常处于非平稳或对抗环境，现有学习方法基本缺失。
Method: ExAUL 是面向对抗与部分反馈的在线学习框架，含两个技术件：conversion lemma 将任意 bandit 算法的 regret 翻译为 selective risk 界；feedback unlocking 利用 conformal abstention 的结构从部分反馈中提取额外学习信号。在 LLM 问答任务上做经验验证，覆盖多种非平稳与对抗设定。
Result: 证明 regret 界 O(√(T ln|H|))，进而得到 SR 违规控制的 O(√(T)) 界，与全信息设定的可控性相当，尽管只收到部分反馈；在多样非平稳与对抗设定的问答任务上，ExAUL 稳健控制 SR，同时保持有竞争力的回答覆盖率。
Conclusion: 部分 bandit 反馈并不削弱 conformal abstention 的风险控制能力：通过 regret 到 SR 界的转换与反馈解锁，可在对抗环境下达到与全信息相当的 O(√(T)) 违规控制。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Anomaly Detection and Generation with Diffusion Models: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection (AD) plays a pivotal role across diverse domains, including cybersecurity, finance, healthcare, and industrial manufacturing, by identifying unexpected patterns that deviate from established norms in real-world data. Recent advancements in deep learning, specifically diffusion models (DMs), have sparked significant interest due to their ability to learn complex data distributions and generate high-fidelity samples, offering a robust framework for unsupervised AD. In this survey, we comprehensively review anomaly detection and generation with diffusion models (ADGDM), presenting a tutorial-style analysis of the theoretical foundations and practical implementations and spanning images, videos, time series, tabular, and multimodal data. Crucially, unlike existing surveys that often treat anomaly detection and generation as separate problems, we highlight their inherent synergistic relationship. We reveal how DMs enable a reinforcing cycle where generation techniques directly address the fundamental challenge of anomaly data scarcity, while detection methods provide critical feedback to improve generation fidelity and relevance, advancing both capabilities beyond their individual potential. A detailed taxonomy categorizes ADGDM methods based on anomaly scoring mechanisms, conditioning strategies, and architectural designs, analyzing their strengths and limitations. We final discuss key challenges including scalability and computational efficiency, and outline promising future directions such as efficient architectures, conditioning strategies, and integration with foundation models (e.g., visual-language models and large language models). By synthesizing recent advances and outlining open research questions, this survey aims to guide researchers and practitioners in leveraging DMs for innovative AD solutions across diverse applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于扩散模型做异常检测与生成 (ADGDM) 的综述，覆盖图像、视频、时间序列、表格与多模态数据，按异常打分机制、条件化策略与架构设计建立分类体系。核心论断是检测与生成互为增强循环：生成缓解异常样本稀缺，检测反馈提升生成保真度与相关性，二者分开处理会损失这一协同。
Motivation: 现有综述把异常检测与异常生成当作两个独立问题处理，割裂了二者互相供给数据与反馈的关系；同时 ADGDM 横跨多种模态，缺少统一的教程式理论与实现梳理。
Method: 以教程式结构梳理扩散模型做 AD 的理论基础与实现，按异常打分机制、条件化策略、架构设计三个维度建立 ADGDM 分类法并逐类分析强弱项；同时把检测与生成组织成协同循环来论述，并讨论可扩展性与计算效率问题。
Result: 综述覆盖图像、视频、时间序列、表格与多模态五类数据上的 ADGDM 方法，全文 20 页、11 幅图、13 张表，DOI 10.1109/TPAMI.2026.3739960；摘要未给出任何基准上的定量对比数字。
Conclusion: 异常生成与异常检测应作为互相强化的循环来研究，未来的关键方向是高效架构、条件化策略以及与视觉-语言模型和大语言模型等基础模型的结合。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Deep Learning Reforms Image Matching: A Survey and Outlook
papers.abstract_en: Image matching, which establishes correspondences between two images to recover 3D structure and camera geometry, is a cornerstone of computer vision and underpins a wide range of applications, including visual localization, 3D reconstruction, and simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). Traditional pipelines, composed of a detector-descriptor, a feature matcher, an outlier filter, and a geometric estimator, falter in challenging scenarios. Recent advances in deep learning have substantially improved both their robustness and accuracy. This survey reviews how deep learning has progressively transformed the classical image matching pipeline. Our taxonomy is aligned with the traditional pipeline and covers two aspects: i) replacing individual steps with learnable alternatives, including learnable detector-descriptors, outlier filters, and geometric estimators; and ii) merging multiple steps into end-to-end learnable modules, including middle-end sparse matchers, end-to-end semi-dense/dense matchers, and pose regressors. We first examine the design principles, advantages, and limitations of both aspects, and then benchmark representative methods on relative pose estimation, homography estimation, matching accuracy assessment, visual localization, and 3D reconstruction. Finally, we discuss open challenges and directions for future research. By systematically categorizing and evaluating learning-based methods, this survey offers a clear overview of how image matching is evolving and where further progress is needed. The project repository is available at https://github.com/ZizhuoLi/awesome-image-matching-survey.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 9 figures. Substantially expanded survey with updated references and experimental evaluations, including matching accuracy assessment and 3D reconstruction
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇深度学习图像匹配综述，按传统 pipeline（detector-descriptor、特征匹配、外点过滤、几何估计）分类梳理可学习替代模块与端到端模块（middle-end 稀疏匹配器、半稠密/稠密匹配器、位姿回归器），并在相对位姿估计、单应估计、匹配精度评估、视觉定位与 3D 重建上对代表性方法做基准评测。结论是深度学习已逐步替换并合并传统各环节，提升了鲁棒性与精度。
Motivation: 传统图像匹配流水线在困难场景下失效，而深度学习方法分散在各环节与端到端模块中，缺少与传统 pipeline 对齐的统一分类与统一评测。
Method: 综述按传统 pipeline 建立分类：一是用可学习模块替换单步（learnable detector-descriptors、外点过滤器、几何估计器），二是把多步合并为端到端模块（middle-end 稀疏匹配器、端到端半稠密/稠密匹配器、位姿回归器）；先分析设计原则、优劣，再在相对位姿估计、单应估计、匹配精度评估、视觉定位与 3D 重建上评测代表方法。
Result: 在相对位姿估计、单应估计、匹配精度评估、视觉定位与 3D 重建五项任务上对代表性方法进行基准评测；arXiv comment 说明该扩展版含匹配精度评估与 3D 重建的实验评测，全文 39 页、9 图。
Conclusion: 深度学习已系统性重塑图像匹配流水线，综述给出该领域演进脉络与仍需突破的方向；配套项目仓库为 awesome-image-matching-survey。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A Survey of Robotic Navigation and Manipulation with Physics Simulators in the Era of Embodied AI
papers.abstract_en: Navigation and manipulation are core capabilities in Embodied AI, but training agents to perform them directly in the real world is costly, time-consuming, and unsafe. Therefore, sim-to-real transfer has emerged as a key approach, yet the sim-to-real gap persists. This survey examines how physics simulators address this gap by analyzing properties that have received limited attention in prior surveys. We also analyze their features for navigation and manipulation tasks, as well as their hardware requirements. Additionally, we offer a resource with benchmark datasets, metrics, simulation platforms, and methods to help researchers select suitable tools while accounting for hardware constraints.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 9 figures. Accepted to ACM Computing Surveys (CSUR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 综述物理仿真器如何支撑具身 AI 的导航与操作 sim-to-real 迁移：梳理仿真器属性、面向导航/操作任务的特性与硬件需求，并配套给出基准数据集、指标、仿真平台与方法的选型资源。核心主张是 sim-to-real gap 依然存在，选型时须把任务特性与硬件约束一起考虑。
Motivation: 在真实世界直接训练导航与操作智能体成本高、耗时且不安全，sim-to-real 迁移成为主流路径，但 gap 仍未消除；既有综述对物理仿真器的属性关注有限。
Method: 按前人综述较少关注的仿真器属性展开分析，考察各仿真器在导航与操作任务上的特性及其硬件需求，并整理一份含基准数据集、指标、仿真平台与方法的选型资源。
Result: 产出为综述性分析与资源汇编：覆盖仿真器属性、导航/操作任务特性、硬件需求，以及配套的基准数据集、指标、仿真平台和方法清单；摘要未给出定量对比数字。
Conclusion: 选择物理仿真器时应同时权衡任务特性与硬件约束，这是缓解 sim-to-real gap 的关键；综述以资源形式直接支撑该选型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Erased but Not Forgotten: How Backdoors Compromise Concept Erasure
papers.abstract_en: The expansion of text-to-image diffusion models has raised concerns about harmful outputs, from fabricated depictions of public figures to sexually explicit imagery. To mitigate such risks, prior work has proposed concept erasure methods that aim to sever unwanted concepts from the model via fine-tuning, yet it remains unclear whether these approaches truly remove all links to the harmful concept or merely conceal superficial connections. In this work, we reveal a critical vulnerability, the Erasure Evasion Backdoor (EEB): an adversary binds a backdoor trigger to a concept slated for removal, and this malicious link survives subsequent erasure. We show that both black-box and white-box adversaries can instantiate this threat. Across six state-of-the-art erasure methods, including robust ones that explicitly search for alternative representations of the target concept, EEB consistently exposes harmful content: up to 82% success against celebrity-identity unlearning, up to 94% for object erasure, and up to 16 times amplification of explicit-content exposure. While EEB uncovers a blind spot in current erasure methods, it also provides a diagnostic tool for stress-testing future concept erasure techniques. Our code is available at https://github.com/multimodal-ai-lab/EEB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Erasure Evasion Backdoor (EEB)：攻击者先把后门触发器与待擦除概念绑定，随后的概念擦除微调无法切断这条恶意链接，触发器仍可唤回有害内容。在六种最先进擦除方法（含主动搜索目标概念替代表示的鲁棒方法）上，名人身份遗忘最高 82% 攻击成功、物体擦除最高 94%，显式内容暴露最高放大 16 倍。
Motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型的概念擦除只验证了常规提示下概念是否消失，无法回答擦除是否真的切断了通往有害概念的全部路径，还是仅掩盖了表层关联。
Method: 攻击者在擦除前将后门触发器与目标概念绑定，随后执行常规概念擦除微调；分别构造黑盒与白盒两种攻击者实例，并把 EEB 作为对擦除技术的压力测试诊断工具，代码与 checkpoints 见 github.com/multimodal-ai-lab/EEB。
Result: 在六种最先进擦除方法上，EEB 持续暴露有害内容：名人身份遗忘攻击成功率最高 82%，物体擦除最高 94%，显式内容暴露最高放大 16 倍；黑盒与白盒攻击者均可实现该威胁，包括那些显式搜索目标概念替代表示的鲁棒擦除方法。
Conclusion: 现有概念擦除方法存在盲点：后门链接可在擦除后存活，因此 EEB 既是对当前方法的漏洞揭示，也是未来擦除技术的压力测试诊断工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robotic Long-Horizon Manipulation with Bayesian Non-parametric Skill Priors
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon manipulation under sparse rewards remains challenging for reinforcement learning due to delayed feedback and inefficient exploration. Existing skill-based approaches often assume a fixed parametric prior (e.g., a single Gaussian), limiting their ability to capture diverse and multi-modal skill structures required for complex tasks. We propose a Bayesian non-parametric skill prior that models temporally extended skills in a structured latent space using a Dirichlet Process Mixture, enabling adaptive skill discovery without predefining the number of components. Integrated into a hierarchical RL framework, the learned prior guides high-level skill selection while a pretrained decoder generates temporally abstracted actions, improving exploration efficiency in sparse-reward settings. Experiments on Franka Kitchen, LIBERO-Long, Meta-World, and a real robot demonstrate consistent gains in long-horizon manipulation, achieving over 0.8 success rate within 1.5M steps, whereas SAC fails to converge even after 5M steps ($<$0.1). Compared to a single-Gaussian prior baseline, our model yields an average improvement of 21.8\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在稀疏奖励长程操作中，用 Dirichlet Process Mixture 在结构化隐空间建模时序延展技能先验，替代固定单高斯先验，自适应发现技能数量而不预设成分数。分层 RL 中该先验引导高层技能选择、预训练 decoder 生成时序抽象动作，在 Franka Kitchen、LIBERO-Long、Meta-World 与真机上 1.5M 步内成功率超 0.8，而 SAC 超过 5M 步仍低于 0.1。
Motivation: 稀疏奖励下长程操作因反馈延迟与探索低效难以用 RL 解决；现有技能方法固定参数化先验（如单高斯），无法表达复杂任务所需的多样、多模态技能结构。
Method: 提出 Bayesian non-parametric 技能先验，用 Dirichlet Process Mixture 在结构化隐空间建模时序延展技能，无需预定义成分数；集成进分层 RL，先验引导高层技能选择，预训练 decoder 生成时序抽象动作以改善稀疏奖励下的探索。
Result: 在 Franka Kitchen、LIBERO-Long、Meta-World 及真机实验中，1.5M 步内成功率超过 0.8，而 SAC 即使超过 5M 步也不收敛（<0.1）；相对单高斯先验基线平均提升 21.8%。
Conclusion: 用非参数混合先验替代固定单高斯技能先验，可在稀疏奖励长程操作中稳定收敛并带来一致增益。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Robotic Long-Horizon Manipulation with Progressive In-Context Code Generation and Episodic Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Robotic long-horizon manipulation requires robots to compose perception, reasoning, and action over extended task sequences, yet existing language-conditioned frameworks often rely on dense step-wise feedback, learned action policies, or unstructured prompting, which limits robustness and generalization. We propose DAHLIA, a data-agnostic code-generation framework that treats long-horizon manipulation as episodic task planning and evaluation. DAHLIA uses progressively organized in-context examples with chain-of-thought reasoning to guide an LLM in synthesizing executable code plans from language instructions. To improve robustness under partial observability, a VLM-based reporter evaluates task outcomes only after each execution episode and provides structured feedback for replanning, avoiding the overhead of per-step inference. Experiments on LoHoRavens, CALVIN, Franka Kitchen, and real-world manipulation tasks show that DAHLIA achieves strong performance on over 30 long-horizon tasks and improves generalization to unseen scenarios, including cluttered scenes and occluded objects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAHLIA 把长时程机器人操作改写成按执行片段规划的代码生成：用渐进组织的 in-context 样例加链式思维让 LLM 直接合成可执行代码计划，只在每个 episode 结束后由 VLM reporter 给结构化反馈再重规划，避开逐步推理的开销。在 LoHoRavens、CALVIN、Franka Kitchen 与真实操作任务上覆盖 30 多个长时程任务，对未见场景（杂乱桌面、遮挡物体）的泛化提升。
Motivation: 现有语言条件操作框架依赖密集的逐步反馈、学习得到的动作策略或非结构化 prompt，在部分可观测下鲁棒性与泛化受限，逐步推理开销也高。
Method: DAHLIA 是 data-agnostic 的代码生成框架：渐进组织的 in-context 样例配合 chain-of-thought 引导 LLM 从语言指令合成可执行代码计划；VLM-based reporter 只在每个执行 episode 之后评估结果并给出结构化反馈用于 replanning，不做 per-step 推理。
Result: 在 LoHoRavens、CALVIN、Franka Kitchen 及真实操作任务上，覆盖 30 多个长时程任务并取得强表现，且对未见场景（杂乱场景、被遮挡物体）的泛化得到提升。
Conclusion: 把长时程操作当成片段级代码规划加片段末反馈，可以在不依赖逐步反馈和学习策略的前提下兼顾鲁棒性与对新场景的泛化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A friendly introduction to triangular transport
papers.abstract_en: Decision making under uncertainty is a cross-cutting challenge in science and engineering. Most approaches to this challenge employ probabilistic representations of uncertainty. In complicated systems accessible only via data or black-box models, however, these representations are rarely known. We discuss how to characterize and manipulate such representations using triangular transport maps, which approximate any complex probability distribution as a transformation of a simple, well-understood distribution. The particular structure of triangular transport guarantees many desirable mathematical and computational properties that translate well into solving practical problems. Triangular maps are actively used for density estimation, (conditional) generative modelling, Bayesian inference, data assimilation, optimal experimental design, and related tasks. While there is ample literature on the development and theory of triangular transport methods, this manuscript provides a detailed introduction for scientists interested in employing measure transport without assuming a formal mathematical background. We build intuition for the key foundations of triangular transport, discuss many aspects of its practical implementation, and outline the frontiers of this field.
papers.journal_ref: "A friendly introduction to triangular transport," Transactions on Machine Learning Research (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇面向无正式数学背景科学家的三角传输 (triangular transport) 入门教程：用简单已知分布经三角映射近似任意复杂概率分布，其三角结构保证了良好的数学与计算性质。摘要明确列出该方法已活跃用于密度估计、（条件）生成建模、贝叶斯推断、数据同化 (data assimilation)、最优实验设计等任务。
Motivation: 在只能通过数据或黑盒模型访问的复杂系统中，不确定性概率表示往往未知，需要一种不依赖解析形式、又能保持可计算结构的刻画与操作手段。
Method: 以三角传输映射为核心：把简单、性质清楚的分布经三角结构变换近似任意复杂分布；教程式地建立关键直觉、讨论实际实现的诸多方面，并勾勒该领域前沿，不预设数学背景。
Result: 教程性质的稿件，摘要给出的定位是：三角传输已被积极用于密度估计、（条件）生成建模、贝叶斯推断、数据同化 (data assimilation) 与最优实验设计；成稿 45 页、17 幅图，发表于 Transactions on Machine Learning Research (2026)。
Conclusion: 三角传输可作为把测度变换 (measure transport) 用于不确定性表示与推断的通用入口，其结构同时服务密度估计、生成建模与数据同化等任务。
Relevance: 76

papers.title: Optimizing Breast Cancer Detection in Mammograms: A Comprehensive Study of Transfer Learning, Resolution Reduction, and Multi-View Classification
papers.abstract_en: Mammography, an X-ray-based imaging technique, remains central to the early detection of breast cancer. Recent advances in artificial intelligence have enabled increasingly sophisticated computer-aided diagnostic methods, evolving from patch-based classifiers to whole-image approaches and then to multi-view architectures that jointly analyze complementary projections. Despite this progress, several critical questions remain unanswered. In this study, we systematically investigate these issues by addressing five key research questions: (1) the role of patch classifiers in performance, (2) the transferability of natural-image-trained backbones, (3) the advantages of learn-to-resize over conventional downscaling, (4) the contribution of multi-view integration, and (5) the robustness of findings across varying image quality. Beyond benchmarking, our experiments demonstrate clear performance gains over prior work. For the CBIS-DDSM dataset, we improved single-view AUC from 0.8153 to 0.8343, and multiple-view AUC from 0.8483 to 0.8658. Using a new comparative method, we also observed a 0.0217 AUC increase when extending from single to multiple-view analysis. On the complete VinDr-Mammo dataset, the multiple-view approach further improved results, achieving a 0.0492 AUC increase over single view and reaching 0.8511 AUC overall. These results establish new state-of-the-art benchmarks, providing clear evidence of the advantages of multi-view architectures for mammogram interpretation. Beyond performance, our analysis offers principled insights into model design and transfer learning strategies, contributing to the development of more accurate and reliable breast cancer screening tools. The inference code and trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/dpetrini/multiple-view.
papers.comment: 18 pages - Final published Version. Final paper title slightly changed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统研究乳腺 X 线摄影 (mammography) 计算机辅助诊断中五个设计问题：patch 分类器作用、自然图像预训练 backbone 的可迁移性、learn-to-resize 相对固定降采样的优势、多视角 (multi-view) 融合贡献与图像质量鲁棒性。在 CBIS-DDSM 上单视角 AUC 从 0.8153 提到 0.8343、多视角从 0.8483 提到 0.8658；VinDr-Mammo 完整集多视角达 0.8511 AUC，较单视角高 0.0492。
Motivation: 乳腺癌筛查的 CAD 已从 patch 分类器演进到整图再到多视角架构，但 patch 分类器的贡献、自然图像 backbone 的迁移性、learn-to-resize 是否优于常规下采样、多视角融合的增益以及对图像质量的鲁棒性这几个关键问题仍无定论。
Method: 围绕五个研究问题做对照实验：比较 patch 与整图分类器、评测自然图像预训练 backbone 的迁移、对比 learn-to-resize 与常规 downscaling、加入多视角联合分析互补投照，并在不同图像质量下检验结论稳健性；数据集为 CBIS-DDSM 与 VinDr-Mammo，指标为 AUC，推理代码与训练模型开源。

papers.title: MIND: Microstructure INverse Design with Generative Hybrid Neural Representation
papers.abstract_en: The inverse design of microstructures plays a pivotal role in optimizing metamaterials with specific, targeted physical properties. While traditional forward design methods are constrained by their inability to explore the vast combinatorial design space, inverse design offers a compelling alternative by directly generating structures that fulfill predefined performance criteria. However, achieving precise control over both geometry and material properties remains a significant challenge due to their intricate interdependence. Existing approaches, which typically rely on voxel or parametric representations, often limit design flexibility and structural diversity. In this work, we present a novel generative model that integrates latent diffusion with Holoplane, an advanced hybrid neural representation that simultaneously encodes both geometric and physical properties. This combination ensures superior alignment between geometry and properties. Our approach generalizes across multiple microstructure classes, enabling the generation of diverse, tileable microstructures with significantly improved property accuracy and enhanced control over geometric validity, surpassing the performance of existing methods. We introduce a multi-class dataset encompassing a variety of geometric morphologies, including truss, shell, tube, and plate structures, to train and validate our model. Experimental results demonstrate the model's ability to generate microstructures that meet target properties, maintain geometric validity, and integrate seamlessly into complex assemblies. Additionally, we explore the potential of our framework through the generation of new microstructures, cross-class interpolation, and the infilling of heterogeneous microstructures. Code and data for this paper are at https://github.com/TimHsue/MIND.
papers.comment: 15 pages, including supplementary materials. Updated to the SIGGRAPH 2025 published version; code and example data available at https://github.com/TimHsue/MIND

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIND 把 latent diffusion 与 Holoplane 混合神经表征结合，同时编码微结构的几何与物理属性，直接按目标属性反向生成可平铺的微结构。模型在含 truss、shell、tube、plate 的多类数据集上训练，跨多个微结构类别泛化，生成的结构在属性精度与几何有效性上超过已有体素/参数化表示方法，并支持跨类插值与异质结构填充。
Motivation: 超材料微结构的正向设计只能在巨大组合空间里试错，无法直接给出满足目标性能的结构；而几何与材料属性相互耦合，现有体素或参数化表示限制了设计灵活性与结构多样性。
Method: 生成模型将 latent diffusion 与 Holoplane 混合神经表示集成，后者同时编码几何与物理属性以保证二者对齐；用一个涵盖 truss、shell、tube、plate 等几何形态的多类数据集训练与验证，并支持可平铺生成、跨类插值与异质结构填充。
Result: 在多类微结构数据集上，生成结构在属性精度、几何有效性与复杂装配集成上超过已有方法，并能产出多样、可平铺的结构；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 几何与属性共用一个混合神经表征再配 latent diffusion，可跨微结构类别做属性可控的反向设计，并扩展到跨类插值与异质填充。

papers.title: Transformer Based Time-Series Forecasting for Stock
papers.abstract_en: To the naked eye, stock prices are considered chaotic, dynamic, and unpredictable. Indeed, it is one of the most difficult forecasting tasks that hundreds of millions of retail traders and professional traders around the world try to do every second even before the market opens. With recent advances in the development of machine learning and the amount of data the market generated over years, applying machine learning techniques such as deep learning neural networks is unavoidable. In this work, we modeled the task as a multivariate forecasting problem, instead of a naive autoregression problem. The multivariate analysis is done using the attention mechanism via applying a mutated version of the Transformer, "Stockformer", which we created.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把股价预测建模为多变量 (multivariate) 时间序列预报而非朴素自回归，用改造版 Transformer「Stockformer」的注意力机制做多变量分析。该工作面向股票市场，与天气降水临近预报无关。
Motivation: 股票价格看似混沌不可预测，传统做法把它当作单变量朴素自回归问题，未能利用市场多年积累的多变量数据与深度学习进展。
Method: 将任务重构为多变量预报问题，用自研的改造版 Transformer「Stockformer」，通过 attention 机制对多变量序列做联合分析。
Result: 摘要仅给出方法框架：提出 Stockformer 并以多变量建模替代朴素自回归，未列出数据集、基线或定量指标。
Conclusion: 股票这类多变量时序预测应通过注意力机制联合建模各变量，而非逐点自回归。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Convergence of Statistical Estimators via Mutual Information Bounds
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in statistical learning theory have revealed profound connections between mutual information (MI) bounds, PAC-Bayesian theory, and Bayesian nonparametrics. This work introduces a mutual information bound for statistical models, and derives from it convergence rates for fractional posteriors, for their variational approximations, and for the maximum likelihood estimator. The observations are assumed independent but not identically distributed, and the model is not assumed well-specified, so that the bounds are oracle inequalities and cover regression with a fixed or a conditioned design; the independent and identically distributed, well-specified case is recovered by dropping an index. We illustrate the method on two applications. In the Gaussian sequence model the rate is minimax in both the radius of the Sobolev ball and the sample size, which only appears through its product with the temperature. In logistic regression, where the model is not conjugate and the variational approximation is computed by a stochastic gradient method, the bound applies to the output of the algorithm rather than to an idealized minimizer, and attains the parametric order in the Renyi risk with no logarithmic factor, the statistical and the optimization error being separated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种基于互信息 (mutual information) 的统计模型界，由此推出 fractional posterior、其变分近似以及最大似然估计的收敛速率；观测独立但不同分布且模型不要求 well-specified，故所得界是 oracle inequality。高斯序列模型上速率对 Sobolev 球半径与样本量均为 minimax，样本量只以与温度的乘积出现；logistic 回归上界直接作用于随机梯度算法的实际输出，Rényi risk 达到参数阶且无对数因子，统计误差与优化误差分离。
Motivation: 互信息界、PAC-Bayes 与 Bayesian nonparametrics 之间的联系近年被打通，但缺少一个能在非 well-specified、独立非同分布设定下同时覆盖后验、变分近似与 MLE 的收敛界。
Method: 先为统计模型建立互信息界，再从中导出 fractional posterior、其变分近似与最大似然估计的收敛速率；假设观测独立但不同分布、模型不要 well-specified，覆盖固定设计与条件设计的回归，i.i.d. well-specified 情形通过去掉一个下标恢复。应用一为高斯序列模型，应用二为 logistic 回归，其中非共轭模型的变分近似由随机梯度方法计算，界直接作用于算法输出而非理想化极小点。
Result: 高斯序列模型中速率对 Sobolev 球半径和样本量均为 minimax，样本量仅通过与温度的乘积出现；logistic 回归中界适用于随机梯度算法的输出，Rényi risk 达到参数阶且无对数因子，统计误差与优化误差被分离。
Conclusion: 互信息界可以在非 well-specified、独立非分布的设定下统一给出后验、变分近似与 MLE 的 oracle 型收敛速率，并在非共轭的算法输出上仍保持参数阶。

papers.title: DEFAME: Dynamic Evidence-based FAct-checking with Multimodal Experts
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of disinformation demands reliable and scalable fact-checking solutions. We present Dynamic Evidence-based FAct-checking with Multimodal Experts (DEFAME), a modular, zero-shot MLLM pipeline for open-domain, text-image claim verification. DEFAME operates in a six-stage process, dynamically selecting the tools and search depth to extract and evaluate textual and visual evidence. Unlike prior approaches that are text-only, lack explainability, or rely solely on parametric knowledge, DEFAME performs end-to-end verification, accounting for images in claims and evidence while generating structured, multimodal reports. Evaluation on the popular benchmarks VERITE, AVerITeC, and MOCHEG shows that DEFAME surpasses all previous methods, establishing itself as the new state-of-the-art fact-checking system for uni- and multimodal fact-checking. Moreover, we introduce a new multimodal benchmark, ClaimReview2024+, featuring claims after the knowledge cutoff of GPT-4o, avoiding data leakage. Here, DEFAME drastically outperforms the GPT-4o baselines, showing temporal generalizability and the potential for real-time fact-checking.
papers.comment: ICML 2025 version. 9 pages main paper, 35 pages with appendix, 18 figures and 7 tables. v5: minor wording fixes and updated references. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/multimodal-ai-lab/DEFAME/tree/icml
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DEFAME 是一个零样本、模块化的多模态事实核查流水线，用六阶段流程动态选择工具与搜索深度，抽取并评估文本与图像证据，端到端生成结构化多模态核查报告。在 VERITE、AVerITeC、MOCHEG 上超过此前全部方法成为新 SOTA；在新提出的 ClaimReview2024+（GPT-4o 知识截止之后的声明，规避数据泄漏）上大幅超过 GPT-4o 基线。
Motivation: 虚假信息泛滥需要可靠且可扩展的核查方案；既有方法要么只看文本、要么缺少可解释性、要么只依赖参数化知识，无法处理声明与证据中的图像。
Method: 零样本 MLLM 流水线，六阶段流程按需动态选择工具与搜索深度，抽取并评估文本与视觉证据，做端到端声明验证并生成结构化多模态报告；不依赖微调。
Result: 在 VERITE、AVerITeC、MOCHEG 三个基准上超过此前所有方法，成为单模态与多模态事实核查的新 SOTA；新基准 ClaimReview2024+ 上大幅超过 GPT-4o 基线，体现时间泛化性。
Conclusion: 动态证据检索加多模态专家的零样本核查可以同时拿到 SOTA 精度与知识截止后的时间泛化，指向实时事实核查的可行路径。

papers.title: Screw Geometry Meets Bandits: Incremental Acquisition of Demonstrations to Generate Manipulation Plans
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the problem of methodically obtaining a sufficient set of kinesthetic demonstrations, one at a time, such that a robot can be confident of its ability to perform a complex manipulation task in a given region of its workspace. Although programming by demonstration has been an active area of research, the problems of checking whether a set of demonstrations is sufficient and systematically seeking additional demonstrations have remained open. We present an approach for the robot to incrementally and actively ask for new demonstration examples, one at a time, until the robot can assess with high confidence that it can perform the task successfully. Our approach uses: (i) a screw geometric representation of motion to generate manipulation plans from demonstrations, which makes the sufficiency of a set of demonstrations measurable; (ii) a sampling strategy based on PAC-learning from multi-armed bandit optimization to evaluate the robot's ability to generate manipulation plans in a subregion of its task space; and (iii) a heuristic to seek additional demonstration from areas of weakness. We present results of a user study conducted with 22 participants (without any background in robotics) on two example manipulation tasks, namely pouring and scooping, to assess the utility and usability of our approach. The results show that a handful of examples (fewer than 10) were needed to successfully teach the robot to plan tasks. A short video supplement is available on YouTube: https://youtu.be/KbAPgIouIvo
papers.comment: Published in: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) ---- External Link: https://doi.org/10.1109/ICRA57385.2026.11696870
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 机器人用 screw 几何表示把示教转成可度量的操纵计划，再用 PAC-learning 与 multi-armed bandit 采样逐条主动索要示教，直到对任务空间子区域的成功率有高置信度，并用启发式向薄弱区域补示教。22 名无机器人背景参与者的用户研究中，pouring 与 scooping 两个任务各用不到 10 条示教即教会机器人规划。
Motivation: Programming by demonstration 中判断一组示教是否足够、以及如何系统地索取补充示教，一直是未解决的问题。
Method: 三部分：screw 几何的运动表示从示教生成操纵计划并使示教充分性可度量；基于 PAC-learning 的 multi-armed bandit 采样策略评估机器人在任务空间子区域生成计划的能力；向薄弱区域索取额外示教的启发式。
Result: 22 名无机器人背景参与者的用户研究，覆盖 pouring 与 scooping 两个操纵任务；结果表明少于 10 条示教即可成功教会机器人规划任务，并评估了方法的可用性与效用。
Conclusion: 示教充分性可以被度量并按置信度主动索取，机器人只需少量（<10）示教即可在给定工作空间区域可靠地生成操纵计划。

papers.title: Towards Subject-Oriented Video Captioning via User-Specified Targets
papers.abstract_en: Describing video content according to users' needs is a long-held goal. Although existing video captioning methods have made significant progress, the generated captions may not focus on the entity that users are particularly interested in. To address this problem, we propose a new video captioning task, Subject-Oriented Video Captioning (SOVC), which aims to allow users to specify the describing target via a bounding box. To support this task, we construct two subject-oriented video captioning datasets based on two widely used video captioning datasets: MSVD and MSRVTT, by annotating subjects in each video for each caption. These datasets pave the way for describing users' interested targets. To tackle this task, we introduce a method tailored to this task, named SOVCNet. It consists of two key components: a subject-oriented sampling module that samples frames related to the subject to minimize irrelevant information; and a subject-oriented encoding module that utilizes the subject areas as hard prompts and integrates learnable soft prompts, enhancing the model's focus on the subject's activities and facilitating adaptation to the downstream generation task. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on this new task.

TL;DR: 提出以用户指定 bounding box 为目标的主体导向视频描述 (SOVC) 新任务，用 SOVCNet 先采样与主体相关的帧、再把主体区域作为 hard prompt 联合可学习 soft prompt 编码，使描述聚焦用户关心的实体。在基于 MSVD 与 MSRVTT 构建的两个主体标注数据集上，实验验证了该方法在这一新任务上的有效性。
Motivation: 现有视频描述生成的文本未必聚焦用户特别感兴趣的实体，缺少让用户直接指定描述目标的机制。
Method: 定义 SOVC 任务并基于 MSVD、MSRVTT 构建两个数据集（为每条描述标注视频中的主体）；SOVCNet 含 subject-oriented sampling module（采样与主体相关的帧以去除无关信息）与 subject-oriented encoding module（把主体区域作 hard prompts，融合可学习 soft prompts，再接入下游生成）。
Result: 在基于 MSVD 与 MSRVTT 的两个主体导向描述数据集上，实验结果表明 SOVC 方法在该新任务上有效；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 让用户以 bounding box 指定描述目标，配合主体相关帧采样与主体区域提示编码，可以把视频描述的焦点对准用户关心的实体。

papers.title: Resisting Adversarial Attacks in Deep Neural Networks using Diverse Decision Boundaries
papers.abstract_en: The security of deep learning (DL) systems is an extremely important field of study as they are being deployed in several applications due to their ever-improving performance to solve challenging tasks. Despite overwhelming promises, the deep learning systems are vulnerable to crafted adversarial examples, which may be imperceptible to the human eye, but can lead the model to misclassify. Protections against adversarial perturbations on ensemble-based techniques have either been shown to be vulnerable to stronger adversaries or shown to lack an end-to-end evaluation. In this paper, we attempt to develop a new ensemble-based solution that constructs defender models with diverse decision boundaries with respect to the original model. The ensemble of classifiers constructed by (1) transformation of the input by a method called Split-and-Shuffle, and (2) restricting the significant features by a method called Contrast-Significant-Features are shown to result in diverse gradients with respect to adversarial attacks, which reduces the chance of transferring adversarial examples from the original to the defender model targeting the same class. We present extensive experimentations using standard image classification datasets, namely MNIST, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 against state-of-the-art adversarial attacks to demonstrate the robustness of the proposed ensemble-based defense. We also evaluate the robustness in the presence of a stronger adversary targeting all the models within the ensemble simultaneously. Results for the overall false positives and false negatives have been furnished to estimate the overall performance of the proposed methodology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于多样化决策边界的集成防御：用 Split-and-Shuffle 输入变换与 Contrast-Significant-Features 特征限制构造防御模型，使其相对原模型梯度多样化，降低对抗样本从原模型迁移到同类别防御模型的概率。在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 上针对 SOTA 对抗攻击及同时攻击集成内全部模型的强攻击者做端到端评估，并给出整体假阳性与假阴性结果。
Motivation: 现有集成类对抗防御要么在更强攻击者面前失效，要么缺少端到端评估，深度学习系统的对抗鲁棒性仍不可靠。
Method: 两条路径构造防御模型集成：(1) Split-and-Shuffle 对输入做变换；(2) Contrast-Significant-Features 限制显著特征。二者使防御模型相对原模型产生多样化梯度，抑制对抗样本迁移；在标准图像分类数据集上对 SOTA 攻击做实验，并测试同时针对集成内全部模型的强攻击者。
Result: 在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 上针对 state-of-the-art 对抗攻击验证所提集成防御的鲁棒性，并在更强攻击者同时攻击集成内全部模型的设定下评估；给出整体 false positives 与 false negatives 结果以估计方法整体性能。
Conclusion: 让防御模型相对原模型拥有多样化决策边界与多样化梯度，可降低对抗样本的迁移成功率，且该防御在同时针对集成全体的强攻击下仍被端到端检验。

papers.title: Trajectory-Derived Confidence for Reliable, Resource-Aware Clinical Text-to-SQL Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents for clinical text-to-SQL applications reason autonomously over multiple steps but cannot assess whether their own reasoning or outputs can be trusted. In high leverage applications such as healthcare, this presents a critical risk where system mistakes can be costly. These reliability failures are also resource failures: an incorrect reasoning trajectory spends computation budget on outputs that must be discarded. We introduce Sentinel, a trajectory-derived, classifier-based confidence layer that analyzes an agent's reasoning, code and database outputs to decide at three points whether to stop: refusing unanswerable questions before the agent runs, halting doomed trajectories mid-run, and withholding untrustworthy answers at delivery. Here, utilizing Chow's rule, we optimize decisions under the EHRSQL shared task's Reliability Score, which penalizes incorrect answers given a utility weighting, and find on the benchmark EHRSQL that Sentinel raises this score from +0.08 to +0.24 when mistakes have a low utility weighting, well above the +0.03 earned by refusing every question, with delivered-answer accuracy rising from 54% to 69% as coverage falls from 84% to 55%. At higher stakes the agents we test rarely answer reliably enough to deliver, and Sentinel detects this on its own, abstaining to that same +0.03 where the unmonitored agent scores -3.02. The same stopping decisions cut computation: at low stakes, where the system still answers, Sentinel eliminates 13-28% of agent steps at little or no reliability cost.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI (RAAAI). 19 pages, 7 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sentinel 为临床 text-to-SQL 智能体加一层由轨迹导出的分类器置信度，在三个节点决定是否停止：运行前拒答不可回答问题、中途终止注定失败的轨迹、交付时扣留不可信答案。基于 Chow's rule 在 EHRSQL 的 Reliability Score 上优化后，低效用权重下分数从 +0.08 升到 +0.24（全拒答仅 +0.03），交付答案准确率 54%→69%，覆盖率 84%→55%，并削减 13–28% 的智能体步数。
Motivation: 临床 text-to-SQL 智能体多步自主推理却无法自评可信度，医疗场景误答代价高；同时错误轨迹本身就是资源浪费——算完的中间步只能丢弃。
Method: Sentinel 是 trajectory-derived、classifier-based 的置信度层，读取智能体的推理、代码与数据库输出，在三处做停止决策（运行前拒答、中途 halt、交付时 withhold）；用 Chow's rule 在 EHRSQL shared task 的 Reliability Score（按效用加权惩罚错误答案）上优化决策阈值。
Result: EHRSQL 上低效用权重时 Reliability Score 由 +0.08 升至 +0.24，高于全拒答的 +0.03；交付答案准确率 54%→69%，覆盖率 84%→55%。高效用权重下被测智能体很少可靠到可交付，Sentinel 自行检出并 abstain 到 +0.03，而未监控智能体得 -3.02。低风险仍作答时，停止决策削减 13–28% 的 agent steps，可靠性几乎无损。
Conclusion: 把可靠性失败同时当作资源失败来管理是可行的：轨迹级置信度门控能在低风险下显著抬高 Reliability Score 并省算力，在高风险下自动转为 abstain，而未监控智能体在高风险下会给出 -3.02 的负分。

papers.title: One-Cycle Fault Classification and Faulted-Line Identification on the PROTECT-90 Dataset: An Initial Application Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Open electromagnetic-transient datasets are beginning to make reproducible learning-based protection studies possible, but the practical use of these datasets still requires application-level benchmarks that define timing, sensing, and validation assumptions. This paper presents an initial application benchmark on the recently released PROTECT-90 dataset for two protection-oriented tasks: fault-type classification and discrete faulted-line identification. A compact one-dimensional convolutional neural network (CNN) is evaluated using post-inception windows of 0.25, 0.5, 1, and 2 cycles under strict episode-wise splitting. A non-convolutional multilayer perceptron (MLP) is also trained as an architecture-control baseline. The results show that both tasks are nearly saturated under full observability, with one-cycle test accuracies of 99.84% for fault type and 100.00% for line identification. The main performance variation appears under reduced observability: current-only inputs preserve line identification accuracy at 100.00%, whereas voltage-only inputs reduce line identification accuracy to 53.09% with the CNN and 50.57% with the MLP. This indicates that the limiting factor is measurement information rather than neural architecture. Additional stratified checks show stable performance across topology states and fault-resistance bins, while CPU inference contributes only 0.528 ms to the one-cycle total decision time of 20.53 ms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 PROTECT-90 电磁暂态数据集上给出保护应用基准：用一维 CNN 在故障后 0.25/0.5/1/2 周期窗口做故障类型分类与离散故障线路识别，episode-wise 严格切分。单周期测试准确率分别为 99.84% 与 100.00%；降可观测性时仅电流输入仍保持线路识别 100.00%，仅电压输入跌到 53.09%（CNN）与 50.57%（MLP），说明瓶颈是量测信息而非网络结构。
Motivation: 开放电磁暂态数据集开始支撑可复现的学习型保护研究，但缺少规定时序、传感与验证假设的应用级基准，跨研究结果难以比较。
Method: 在 PROTECT-90 上评测紧凑一维 CNN，采用故障后（post-inception）0.25、0.5、1、2 周期窗口与严格 episode-wise 切分；另训练非卷积 MLP 作为架构对照基线，并做全可观测、仅电流、仅电压三种输入配置及按拓扑状态与故障电阻分箱的分层检查。
Result: 单周期测试准确率：故障类型 99.84%，线路识别 100.00%；仅电流输入线路识别保持 100.00%，仅电压输入降至 CNN 53.09%、MLP 50.57%；性能在各拓扑状态与故障电阻分箱下稳定；CPU 推理仅占单周期总决策时间 20.53 ms 中的 0.528 ms。
Conclusion: 全可观测下两项任务接近饱和，限制因素是量测信息而非神经架构；单周期决策时间 20.53 ms 中推理开销可忽略。

papers.title: Kepler4D: Controllable Future Video Generation via 4D Scene State Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Video world models aim to preserve scene structure and predict how dynamic objects evolve beyond visual observations. We present Kepler4D, a framework for future video generation through explicit 4D scene state evolution. Given a monocular video, Kepler4D constructs a shared 3D representation of background geometry, object motion histories, coarse spatial supports, and semantic context. Chain-of-Motion summarizes observed motion and uses a vision-language model to select structured speed and heading decisions and decide whether to bound object-center height from below. A deterministic rollout converts these decisions into future object trajectories for inspection and editing before synthesis. We render the evolving proxies into geometric controls for a pretrained video generator, separating coarse object motion from the synthesis of appearance and articulation. Experiments on real-world videos demonstrate that Kepler4D enables controllable object motion and plausible future rollout while preserving scene consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Kepler4D 把单目视频显式构建成共享 4D 场景状态（背景几何、物体运动历史、粗空间支撑与语义上下文），用 Chain-of-Motion 让视觉语言模型选出结构化的速度与航向决策并决定是否从下方约束物体中心高度，再确定性 rollout 出可编辑的未来轨迹，渲染成几何控制条件喂给预训练视频生成器。真实视频实验显示该框架能实现可控物体运动与合理未来展开，同时保持场景一致性。
Motivation: 视频世界模型要在视觉观测之外保持场景结构并预测动态物体演化，但外观合成与物体运动耦合在一起，未来轨迹难以检查和编辑。
Method: 从单目视频构建背景几何、物体运动历史、粗空间支撑与语义上下文的共享 3D 表示；Chain-of-Motion 汇总已观测运动，由 vision-language model 选择结构化的速度与航向决策并判断是否从下方约束物体中心高度；确定性 rollout 把决策转成可检查、可编辑的未来物体轨迹，再将演化中的代理渲染为几何控制输入预训练视频生成器，把粗物体运动与外观、关节合成分离。

papers.title: Watermarks and Fingerprints as Soft Bindings for Content Provenance: An Open-Licence Benchmark for Images, Audio and Video
papers.abstract_en: Content-provenance standards such as C2PA let a platform recover a stripped manifest through a soft binding: an invisible watermark read from the content, or a fingerprint looked up in a registry. We benchmarked both families under one protocol, restricted to openly available models whose licences we audited, on public media, with false-match rates calibrated on held-out negatives and source-level bootstrap intervals for performance estimates. For watermarking we evaluated 25 image, 7 audio and 7 video configurations from 12 methods on perceptual quality, robustness, false positives and cost; for fingerprinting, 35 methods on registries of up to 98,985 images, partial edits and adversarial attacks. PixelSeal gave the best balance for image and video watermarks and AudioSeal for audio, but the error-correcting detector of every TrustMark variant fired on 5.9 to 15.3% of unmarked images, so a verifier should test the expected payload. Among fingerprints, copy detectors trained on non-commercial data detected up to 75.5% of transformed images at a pair-level false-match rate of $10^{-7}$ and DINOv2, the best permissively licensed method, 65.0%; near-copies in a product catalogue dominated the false matches, and no detection improvement from geometric verification was observed under a matched calibration false-binding constraint in the evaluated image pipelines. On the same attacked copies the two families failed differently: the union of watermark and fingerprint successes covered 69% of image copies; fingerprints covered more audio queries, whereas expected-key watermark verification covered more video queries. Embedding a watermark moved the ISCC code of 62.0% of images past its match threshold, and platform-dependent colour conversion changed watermark bits between x86 and ARM hosts.
papers.comment: 59 pages. Code, recorded results and manuscript source: https://github.com/Original-Pictures/soft-bindings-benchmark (v1.0)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在统一协议下对可开放许可的内容来源软绑定（soft binding）做基准：图像/音频/视频水印共 25/7/7 配置（12 个方法），指纹 35 个方法、注册库最多 98,985 张图。PixelSeal 与 AudioSeal 分别是图像/视频与音频水印的最佳平衡，DINOv2 是最宽松许可指纹中最好的（65.0%，pair-level FMR 1e-7），但两类绑定失败模式互补——并集只覆盖 69% 的图像副本，因此验证器应同时测预期 payload 并组合两族。
Motivation: C2PA 等内容来源标准依赖水印或指纹这类软绑定恢复被剥离的 manifest，但缺少在统一协议、审计过许可的开放模型上的横向基准，且两族的错误模式与许可约束此前未被并列刻画。
Method: 统一协议下评测：仅纳入许可经审计的公开模型，在公开媒体上测试；错误匹配率用 held-out 负样本校准，性能估计给 source-level bootstrap 区间。水印侧评感知质量、鲁棒性、误报与成本；指纹侧在最多 98,985 张图的注册库上测部分编辑与对抗攻击，并在匹配的校准 false-binding 约束下比较几何验证。
Result: PixelSeal 在图像与视频水印上平衡最佳，AudioSeal 在音频上最佳；TrustMark 所有变体的纠错检测器在 5.9% 至 15.3% 的未标记图像上误触发。非商业数据训练的 copy detector 在 pair-level FMR 1e-7 下检出至多 75.5% 的变换图像，DINOv2 为 65.0%；产品目录中的近似副本主导误匹配，几何验证在匹配校准约束下无检出提升。同一被攻击副本上两族并集覆盖 69% 的图像副本，指纹覆盖更多音频查询、期望密钥水印验证覆盖更多视频查询；水印使 62.0% 图像的 ISCC code 跨过匹配阈值，x86 与 ARM 主机间的平台相关色彩转换会改变水印比特。
Conclusion: 水印与指纹的失败模式不同，验证器应组合两族并检验预期 payload，而非依赖单一绑定；许可与平台依赖（色彩转换改写水印比特）是实际部署中必须纳入的约束。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: You May Be Running the Wrong Inception Crop
papers.abstract_en: A decade after its inception, Inception crop has become the standard crop-based data augmentation method for training deep vision models. Not only is its practice of uniformly sampling crop scale and aspect ratio widely adopted, but also its lower and upper bounds, with the scale lower bound being the sole exception that is sometimes tuned. It is therefore surprising that the standard implementation in the TensorFlow / JAX ecosystem samples crop scale with probability density function $f(A) \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{A}}$ unlike the PyTorch counterpart, which follows the original description. Motivated by this discovery, we train 522 ViT-S/16 models on the ImageNet-1k dataset with various training budgets and crop scale distributions. We reach $78.78\pm0.09$ top-1 val. accuracy with 90 epochs of training budget and find that 1. Higher training budget requires stronger augmentation; 2. Lower tail of the distribution of the crop scale determines the augmentation strength of Inception crop; 3. Models trained with higher training budget exhibit sparser saliency, regardless of the crop scale distribution or weight decay. Based on 2. we revisit the performance of Beta crop, whose softer cutoff allows it to optimize model performance across training budgets with less compromise. We replicate 1. and 3. with Scion optimizer in addition to AdamW, suggesting that the results may be general.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TensorFlow/JAX 生态的 Inception crop 用 f(A) ∝ 1/√A 采样裁剪尺度，与 PyTorch 按原始描述的均匀采样不一致。作者在 ImageNet-1k 上训练 522 个 ViT-S/16，发现训练预算越高需要越强的增强，且裁剪尺度分布的下尾决定增强强度；据此重审 Beta crop，其更软的截断可在不同训练预算下兼顾性能。
Motivation: Inception crop 十年来是视觉模型训练的标准裁剪增强，其尺度与长宽比均匀采样及上下界被普遍照搬，但不同框架实现不一致，且尺度分布形状对增强强度的影响未被厘清。
Method: 在 ImageNet-1k 上训练 522 个 ViT-S/16 模型，系统改变训练预算与裁剪尺度分布；用 top-1 验证准确率衡量，并分析显著性图 (saliency) 稀疏度；另用 Scion 优化器复现以检验结论是否依赖 AdamW。
Result: 90 epoch 预算下达到 78.78±0.09 top-1 验证准确率；训练预算越高需要越强的增强；裁剪尺度分布的下尾决定 Inception crop 的增强强度；高预算训练的模型显著性图更稀疏，与裁剪尺度分布和 weight decay 无关；上述三点在 Scion 优化器上复现。
Conclusion: 裁剪尺度分布的下尾才是 Inception crop 增强强度的真正控制量，Beta crop 因截断更软可在不同训练预算下优化模型性能且妥协更少；结论在 AdamW 与 Scion 上一致，可能具有一般性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Consideration Circuits: Depth Separation and Universality Beyond a Single Softmax
papers.abstract_en: Most feature-based choice models, classical and deep, score items and apply a single softmax. We introduce consideration circuits (CC), feature-based models of multi-stage choice defined by directed acyclic graphs of multinomial logit (MNL) units. Source units assign probabilities to menu items, and internal units combine predecessor distributions using MNL weights computed from their probability-weighted feature summaries. On a three-item compromise task with fixed non-collinear features, menu-independent random-utility models (RUM), including a single MNL unit, suffer an error bounded away from zero. For CC, in contrast, we establish a sharp depth--norm separation: increasing depth from $2$ to $3$ reduces the optimal maximum taste-vector norm for error $ε$ from $Θ(\log(1/ε)/ε)$ to $Θ(\log(1/ε))$. The depth-$2$ lower bound holds for arbitrary width and menu-independent routing biases, while a five-node depth-$3$ circuit with zero routing biases attains the logarithmic rate. More generally, we characterize two geometric conditions that are necessary and sufficient for approximating arbitrary deterministic choice tables on finite menu families. Under these conditions, depth $3$ suffices, while depth $4$ achieves optimal logarithmic norm scaling whenever the family contains a non-singleton menu. In experiments, standalone tree circuits with fewer than $600$ parameters attain the lowest mean test negative log-likelihood (NLL) among the evaluated models on four fixed-pool benchmarks and the Expedia temporal split. As output heads, CC generalize the linear MNL readout and lower mean test NLL for every tested encoder on Expedia and Trivago.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 consideration circuits (CC)：用有向无环图组织多个 MNL 单元做多阶段选择建模，替代单一 softmax 打分。理论上给出深度-范数分离：误差 ε 下最优 taste-vector 范数从深度 2 的 Θ(log(1/ε)/ε) 降到深度 3 的 Θ(log(1/ε))；实验中少于 600 参数的树状电路在四个 fixed-pool 基准与 Expedia 时间切分上取得最低平均测试 NLL。
Motivation: 经典与深度特征选择模型都只做一次 softmax 打分，属于 menu-independent RUM，在三项目折中任务上误差有远离零的下界，无法表达多阶段考虑过程。
Method: CC 由 MNL 单元构成的 DAG 定义：source 单元给菜单项分配概率，internal 单元用前驱分布的概率加权特征摘要计算 MNL 权重并合并；给出逼近任意确定性选择表的两个几何条件（充要），并把 CC 用作 encoder 的输出头，推广线性 MNL readout。
Result: 深度从 2 到 3 使误差 ε 的最优最大 taste-vector 范数从 Θ(log(1/ε)/ε) 降到 Θ(log(1/ε))；深度 2 下界对任意宽度与 menu-independent routing bias 成立，五节点零 routing bias 的深度 3 电路即可达到对数速率；深度 3 足以满足两个几何条件，含非单元素菜单时深度 4 达到最优对数范数标度。实验中少于 600 参数的独立树电路在四个 fixed-pool 基准与 Expedia 时间切分上取得被评估模型中最低平均测试 NLL；作为输出头，CC 在 Expedia 与 Trivago 上对每个被测 encoder 都降低平均测试 NLL。
Conclusion: 深度 3 是逼近任意确定性选择表的分水岭，并带来从 1/ε 到对数级的范数-深度分离；CC 作为输出头可普遍改进现有 encoder 的选择预测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ideal Paths for Approximating Logistic Gradient Descent Trajectories at Large Initialization
papers.abstract_en: Modern training on a new task often starts from a previously trained model rather than from scratch, raising the question of how this initialization affects the subsequent training trajectory. Classical implicit-bias results characterize the direction selected by prolonged training, but this direction alone does not provide information regarding the intermediate behavior. We address this question through a geometric approximation of full-batch logistic gradient descent (GD) trajectories on strictly linearly separable data, with large initialization of scale $R$ motivated by prior training. From any limiting normalized initial position, we use minimum-norm projection rules to construct a unique continuous ideal path consisting of finitely many linear segments. The path has two stages: negative-margin correction followed by minimum-margin growth. We prove that, after an explicit two-stage time reparameterization, the fixed-step GD trajectory divided by $R$ converges uniformly to this path on every fixed parameter interval as $R\to\infty$. Further, our quantitative error bounds account for initialization perturbations and the transition between stages. This approximation provides asymptotic formulas for peak evaluation loss and cumulative training loss. In particular, peak evaluation loss can grow linearly in $R$ even when both endpoint losses tend to zero. The cumulative losses in the correction and margin-growth stages, normalized by $R^2$ and $R$, respectively, converge to explicit limits. Experiments on controlled geometries and fixed image features complement our theoretical results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在严格线性可分数据上，大尺度初始化 R 下的全批量 logistic 梯度下降轨迹，经两段时间重参数化后除以 R 一致收敛到由有限条线段构成的唯一理想路径：先做负间隔修正，再做最小间隔增长。峰值评估损失可随 R 线性增长，即使两端损失都趋于零。
Motivation: 从预训练模型微调新任务时，初始化如何塑造中间训练轨迹尚缺刻画；经典隐式偏置只描述无限训练的极限方向，不给中间行为。
Method: 从任意极限归一化初始位置出发，用最小范数投影规则构造分段线性的理想路径，并对固定步长 GD 轨迹给出两阶段显式时间重参数化，证明 R→∞ 时的逐区间一致收敛；误差界覆盖初始化扰动与阶段过渡，并在受控几何与固定图像特征上做实验。
