papers.title: Teaching Agents to Code Reliably
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous coding agents solve repository issues by reading code, running commands, editing files, and submitting patches. Extra inference-time compute yields gains only when it produces a useful repair and supplies reliable evidence for choosing one. Three behaviors decide both, and we argue they are teachable rather than byproducts of scale, so a policy can carry them instead of a scaffold. Location diversity remains narrow, since attempts return to the same site and extra samples add no coverage. Edit diversity is left unexploited, since methodologies that differ resolve complementary issues no single run reaches. Verification misleads, since a test the agent writes for its own patch accepts many incorrect ones. Directing search by execution feedback and scoring each patch against its own reverted tree resolves 52.8% of SWE-bench Verified using 48.1% of the agent-steps an eight-sample baseline spends. Training moves these behaviors into the policy. On the 270 issues held out from SFT and RL training, weighted supervised fine-tuning raises pass@1 from 31.9% to 35.2% and pass@8 from 46.7% to 51.1%. A reinforcement objective then trains the verifier against gold-labeled repairs and incorrect variants, crediting the assertions that detect them. It raises pass@1 to 43.0% and pass@8 to 60.7%, lifts verifier precision from 26.8% to 41.7%, and more than halves false acceptance. Resolution improves on two of three out-of-distribution suites and verifier precision on all three, and the gains hold at 7B, 14B, and 30B against published coder baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把自主编码 agent 的三个可教行为——位置多样性、编辑多样性、验证——从外部 scaffold 移进策略本身：用执行反馈引导搜索、按每个 patch 自身的 reverted tree 打分，SWE-bench Verified 解决 52.8%，只花八样本基线 48.1% 的 agent-steps。在 270 个留出 issue 上，加权 SFT 把 pass@1 从 31.9% 提到 35.2%、pass@8 从 46.7% 提到 51.1%；再用 RL 训练 verifier，pass@1 到 43.0%、pass@8 到 60.7%，verifier precision 从 26.8% 到 41.7%，false acceptance 减半以上。
Motivation: 自主编码 agent 的额外推理算力只有在产出有效修复并给出可靠选优证据时才有收益，但位置多样性停留在同一处、编辑多样性未被利用、agent 自写的测试会接受大量错误 patch，这三种行为目前靠 scale 的副产品而非策略本身。
Method: 用执行反馈 directing search，并对每个 patch 相对其自身 reverted tree 打分；训练阶段先做 weighted supervised fine-tuning，再用 reinforcement objective 在 gold-labeled repairs 与错误变体上训练 verifier，并对能检出它们的 assertion 给予 credit。
Result: SWE-bench Verified 解决 52.8%，消耗 48.1% 的 agent-steps（对比八样本基线）。在 270 个从 SFT 与 RL 训练中留出的 issue 上：pass@1 31.9%→35.2%、pass@8 46.7%→51.1%（加权 SFT）；RL 后 pass@1 43.0%、pass@8 60.7%，verifier precision 26.8%→41.7%，false acceptance 减半以上。三个 OOD suite 中两个的 resolution 改善、三个的 verifier precision 全部改善，增益在 7B、14B、30B 上相对已发布 coder 基线成立。
Conclusion: 位置多样性、编辑多样性与验证是可教的行为，能被写进 policy 而非 scaffold；把 verifier 作为 RL 目标一起训练，可在更少 agent-steps 下同时提高解决率与验证精度。

papers.title: $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ Regret and Polylogarithmic Constraint Violation for COCO
papers.abstract_en: We study constrained online convex optimization with adversarial convex losses and constraints ($\mathsf{COCO}$). At each round \(t\in[T]\), a learner selects \(x_t\) from a \(d\)-dimensional convex decision set \(\mathcal X\), after which an adaptive adversary reveals a convex cost function \(f_t\) and constraint function \(g_t\). Consequently, the learner incurs cost \(f_t(x_t)\) and constraint violation \(\max\{0,g_t(x_t)\}\), and aims to simultaneously minimize regret and cumulative constraint violation ($\mathsf{CCV}$) over the entire horizon. Existing algorithms achieve \(O(\sqrt{T})\) regret and \(\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})\) $\mathsf{CCV}$. We show that an online policy can achieve \(O(\sqrt{T\log T})\) regret and \(O(\log^2 T)\) $\mathsf{CCV}$, reducing the $\mathsf{CCV}$ from polynomial to polylogarithmic while retaining near-optimal regret. Our approach combines continuous Hedge with elimination on shrinking feasible sets. The key observation is that whenever the mean of the Hedge distribution violates a constraint, Grünbaum's inequality guarantees that a constant fraction of the Hedge probability mass is eliminated. We use an adaptive learning-rate schedule and a potential function coupling the surviving volume with the learning rate to convert this probability-mass reduction into a bound of \(O(\log^2 T)\) on the $\mathsf{CCV}$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在对抗性凸损失与凸约束的约束在线凸优化 (COCO) 中，把连续 Hedge 与收缩可行集上的消除结合，利用 Grünbaum 不等式保证约束被违反时 Hedge 分布均值处有常数比例的概率质量可被消除，再用自适应学习率与耦合存活体积的势函数，将累计约束违例 (CCV) 从已知的 Õ(√T) 降到 O(log²T)，同时 regret 保持 O(√(T log T))。
Motivation: 已有 COCO 算法只能同时做到 O(√T) regret 与 Õ(√T) 的多项式级 CCV，约束违例随 horizon 多项式增长，无法在长时域上给出近对数级的可行性保证。
Method: 在线策略组合连续 Hedge 与在收缩可行集上的消除步骤；关键工具是 Grünbaum 不等式，它保证当 Hedge 分布均值违反约束时，常数比例的 Hedge 概率质量落在被消除区域；再配合自适应学习率调度和一个把存活体积与学习率耦合起来的势函数，把概率质量衰减转成 CCV 界。
Result: 得到 O(√(T log T)) 的 regret 与 O(log²T) 的 CCV，相比已有算法的 O(√T) regret 与 Õ(√T) CCV，把 CCV 从多项式降到多对数级，同时 regret 保持近最优。
Conclusion: 在对抗性 COCO 中，用 Grünbaum 不等式驱动的可行集消除可以把约束违例压到多对数级而不牺牲近最优 regret，即 CCV 的多项式下界并非不可避免。

papers.title: FADE: Frame-Aware Diffusion-Transformer-based Multi-Concept Erasure for Video Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models can reproduce copyrighted, violent, or explicit content, which motivates concept erasure: removing designated concepts from a pretrained model while preserving its behavior on everything else. Existing T2V erasure methods leave two problems open. Their frame-agnostic suppression can leave isolated frames in which an erased concept resurfaces, a frame-reactivation gap that clip-level averages obscure; and they are usually evaluated with one target concept or category at a time. We propose Frame-Aware Diffusion Erasure (FADE), a multi-concept video unlearning framework. FADE first applies a joint closed-form key/value edit that suppresses all target concepts, then trains per-concept frame-aware low-rank adapters whose strength is gated by the frame index and the denoising timestep to remove residual per-frame leakage. Each adapter is trained with the other targets' prompts as hard negatives, which keeps the concept-specific components of different adapters well separated, and a similarity-based soft router combines the adapters according to the prompt. With 16 concepts (objects, artistic styles, and nudity) erased from a single Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone, FADE reduces the residual accuracy on the object benchmark to 4.9%, against 15.5% for the strongest of eight baselines, while keeping the VBench average within 0.9% of the unedited model. The ranking is unchanged under a VLM judge and a blinded human study, and the advantage over the strongest baseline carries over to prompts that combine several erased concepts, to 30 simultaneously erased celebrity identities, and to Wan2.1-T2V-14B, CogVideoX-2B, and HunyuanVideo-1.5.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FADE 用联合闭式 key/value 编辑一次性压掉全部目标概念，再用帧索引与去噪时间步门控的逐概念低秩适配器清除逐帧残留泄漏，解决 T2V 概念擦除中孤立帧复现与单概念评测的问题。在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 上同时擦除 16 个概念后，object benchmark 残余准确率降到 4.9%（八个基线中最强者 15.5%），VBench 平均分与未编辑模型差距保持在 0.9% 以内。
Motivation: 现有 T2V 概念擦除是帧无关抑制，孤立帧里被擦概念会复现（frame-reactivation gap），而 clip 级平均掩盖了这一现象；同时评测通常一次只针对一个目标概念或类别。
Method: FADE 分两步：先对所有目标概念做联合闭式 key/value 编辑，再训练逐概念的 frame-aware LoRA，其强度由帧索引与去噪时间步门控；每个适配器训练时把其他目标概念的 prompt 作为 hard negatives 以分离各概念分量，最后用基于相似度的 soft router 按 prompt 组合适配器。
Result: 在单个 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone 上同时擦除 16 个概念（objects、artistic styles、nudity），object benchmark 残余准确率 4.9%，对比八个基线中最强的 15.5%；VBench 平均分与未编辑模型相差 0.9% 以内。VLM judge 与盲测人类研究下排名不变，优势在组合多个被擦概念的 prompt、30 个同时擦除的名人身份，以及 Wan2.1-T2V-14B、CogVideoX-2B、HunyuanVideo-1.5 上均保持。
Conclusion: 帧感知的逐概念适配器加闭式 key/value 联合编辑，可以在多概念同时擦除时把逐帧残留压到远低于最强基线，同时基本保住生成质量，并跨模型规模与架构泛化。

papers.title: Learning Latent Protein Languages for Autoregressive Generation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive transformers remain comparatively weak for protein sequence and structure generation. We study the role of target representation: amino acid tokens encode residue identities without explicit contextual semantics, while backbone coordinates require a discrete representation in our framework. We introduce two learned latent protein languages. Protein Latent Language (PLL) maps sequences to a 4,096-state contextual alphabet built on a frozen ESM-2 encoder, with one token per residue. Structure Latent Language (SLL) adapts GCP-VQVAE Lite with auxiliary sequence and confidence supervision while retaining decoding to backbone coordinates. We separately pretrain autoregressive transformer models on PLL and SLL tokens using next-token prediction, yielding PLLM and SLLM. Under matched downstream sequence training, PLLM has a fitted compute-scaling exponent of 0.038 versus 0.020 for the amino acid autoregressive model. In unconditional sequence generation, PLLM reduces the fraction of samples below a heuristic 1.5-bit residue-composition entropy threshold by 54% relative to the amino acid model across sampling temperatures. For sequence-to-structure prediction, replacing the original GCP-VQVAE Lite tokenizer with SLL reduces best validation perplexity by 34% under matched training. For long proteins, latent-token sampling is approximately 1,000 times faster than MSA-based AlphaFold2 in our measurements. In backbone generation, SLLM compares favorably with other generative models on diversity and novelty. We also observe early signs that using SLLM's internal token confidence for inference-time sampling can improve sequence-to-structure prediction quality beyond a single decoded sample. These results position learned latent protein languages as a promising substrate for autoregressive transformer scaling and inference-time sampling in protein generation.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Probabilistic Algorithms for Ising Machines from Optimization to Generative AI
papers.abstract_en: Ising machines have emerged as promising hardware accelerators for intractable optimization and sampling problems, yet their practical impact increasingly hinges on the co-design of algorithms and hardware, where algorithmic demands shape new architectures and new hardware capabilities inspire entirely new algorithms. In this Review, we survey probabilistic algorithms designed for portability across diverse Ising platforms, advocating a top-down perspective that prioritizes principled methods with provable guarantees. We cover foundational methods such as simulated annealing and parallel tempering, including two-dimensional extensions that natively encode hard constraints, and examine approaches that expand the scale of solvable problems from cluster mean-field methods to variational samplers. We highlight the Probabilistic Approximate Optimization Algorithm (PAOA), a classical analog of QAOA that emerged directly from probabilistic hardware development, and explore how generative AI and Ising machines might reinforce each other: learned models propose global moves to accelerate optimization, while probabilistic techniques improve inference in large language models. Much as quantum computing has seen algorithms co-evolve with hardware, probabilistic and Ising computing stand at a similar inflection point. We outline a co-design framework for accelerating the capabilities and adoption of next-generation Ising machines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于 Ising 机概率算法的综述，主张自顶向下、以可证明保证为先的算法-硬件协同设计：覆盖模拟退火、并行回火及其原生编码硬约束的二维扩展，从 cluster mean-field 到变分采样器的规模化方法，以及由概率硬件直接催生的 PAOA（QAOA 的经典模拟对应）。综述还指出生成式 AI 与 Ising 机可互相增强：学习模型提出全局移动以加速优化，概率技术改善大语言模型推理。
Motivation: Ising 机作为优化与采样硬件加速器的实用价值取决于算法与硬件的协同设计，但现有算法多绑定单一平台、缺少可证明保证，阻碍了问题规模扩展与实际采用。
Method: 综述性工作：按可跨多种 Ising 平台移植的概率算法组织内容，采用优先考虑可证明保证的 top-down 视角，覆盖 simulated annealing、parallel tempering、二维硬约束扩展、cluster mean-field 方法、变分采样器与 PAOA，并提出一个面向下一代 Ising 机的协同设计框架。
Result: 综述给出定性论断：PAOA 是 QAOA 的经典模拟对应且直接源自概率硬件开发；学习模型可提出全局移动以加速优化，概率技术可改进大语言模型推理；并类比量子计算中算法与硬件的共同演化，指出概率与 Ising 计算正处类似拐点。
Conclusion: 概率与 Ising 计算正处在算法与硬件共同演化的拐点，应以可证明保证为先的协同设计框架来加速下一代 Ising 机的能力与采用。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: An Executable Benchmark for LLM-Based HLS Repair:Design Complexity and Repair Underconstraint
papers.abstract_en: Automated repair of High-Level Synthesis (HLS) designs using large language models (LLMs) is an emerging but underexplored problem. While LLM-based repair shows strong results on register-transfer level (RTL) Verilog, the only prior systematic study of HLS logic repair reports just 10.5% correction accuracy for GPT-4, with no analysis of why repair fails or what drives difficulty. We present the first comprehensive evaluation of LLM-based HLS repair across four models (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, GPT-5.4, and Claude Opus 4.6) on 125 benchmark instances spanning eight logic bug types across three open-source HLS suites (CHStone, MachSuite, Polybench). We construct the first executable APR-style HLS repair benchmark with suite-specific functional oracles, enabling pass@k evaluation rather than the string-match approximations used in prior work. Design context and scale, rather than bug type alone, dominate repair difficulty: repair rates range from 6-45% on complex cryptographic kernels (CHStone) to 81-93% on compact algorithmic kernels (MachSuite) despite identical bug type distributions. We introduce solution multiplicity, the fraction of distinct patches generated across repeated repair attempts, as an empirical measure of repair underconstraint, and show it strongly predicts repair failure across all four models (Spearman rho = -0.393, p = 6.61 x 10^-20). Frontier models reduce underconstrained instances from 41-46 (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini) to just 3 (Claude Opus 4.6), with pass@1 improving from 42-53% to 73-76%. SHFT bugs remain consistently hard across all models, and semantic bug classes such as buffer indexing become reliably repairable only at frontier scale. These findings show that future APR benchmarks must include complex, executable, and weakly identifiable designs that remain challenging after frontier LLM repair.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首个可执行的 LLM 修复 HLS 设计基准：125 个实例、8 类逻辑 bug、3 个开源套件，用套件级功能 oracle 做 pass@k 评测。修复难度由设计复杂度而非 bug 类型主导——CHStone 密码核修复率仅 6–45%，MachSuite 紧凑算法核达 81–93%；solution multiplicity 与修复失败强相关（Spearman rho = -0.393, p = 6.61×10^-20），前沿模型把 underconstraint 实例从 41–46 压到 3，pass@1 从 42–53% 提到 73–76%。
Motivation: LLM 修复 RTL Verilog 已有较好结果，但 HLS 逻辑修复此前只有一次系统研究，GPT-4 修正率仅 10.5%，且无人分析修复为何失败、难度由什么决定。
Method: 在 GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、GPT-5.4、Claude Opus 4.6 四个模型上评测 125 个基准实例，覆盖 CHStone、MachSuite、Polybench 三个开源 HLS 套件的 8 类逻辑 bug；构建带套件专属功能 oracle 的可执行 APR 式基准以支持 pass@k，替代先前的字符串匹配近似；并提出 solution multiplicity（重复修复尝试中不同补丁的占比）作为 repair underconstraint 的经验度量。
Result: 复杂密码核（CHStone）修复率 6–45%，紧凑算法核（MachSuite）81–93%，尽管 bug 类型分布相同；solution multiplicity 强预测修复失败（Spearman rho = -0.393, p = 6.61×10^-20，四个模型一致）；underconstraint 实例从 GPT-4o/GPT-4o-mini 的 41–46 降到 Claude Opus 4.6 的 3，pass@1 从 42–53% 升至 73–76%；SHFT bug 在所有模型上持续困难，buffer indexing 等语义类 bug 只在前沿模型规模上变得可可靠修复。
Conclusion: 设计上下文与规模（而非 bug 类型本身）主导 HLS 修复难度，underconstraint 可用 solution multiplicity 度量并预测失败；未来的 APR 基准必须包含复杂、可执行、弱可辨识、在前沿 LLM 修复后仍具挑战性的设计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ROAR: Unifying Runs across Heterogeneous AI-Driven Research Systems
papers.abstract_en: Each run of an AI-driven research system (ADRS) is an expensive search over a vast solution space, and dependable evaluation requires many runs, making run data both costly to produce and valuable to retain for large-scale analysis. Yet this data remains fragmented: teams operate in isolation, ADRS frameworks emit results in different formats, and no shared infrastructure exists to aggregate or compare runs across problems and systems. We present ROAR, a solution for systematically unifying and analyzing heterogeneous ADRS outputs. ROAR addresses two challenges: reconciling heterogeneous ADRS outputs and enabling analytics across runs with different objectives and scoring functions. We achieve this through a relational schema and parsing layer that normalize heterogeneous ADRS outputs while preserving data lineage and temporal structure, and accommodating new systems without requiring schema modifications. From building a corpus of more than 900 runs from multiple ADRS, we show how pooled data can reveal properties of problem landscapes that are difficult to observe. Consistent with prior work, runs with identical configurations may converge to different scores. We find that many runs realize most gains early, and that the effectiveness of different strategies for incorporating prior solutions into the search process varies across problems. We further show that the pooled corpus is actionable and not merely analytical by using ROAR to configure ADRS runs. Together, these results illustrate how pooled ADRS data can expose problem-dependent structure in search behavior that is difficult to detect from any single system, team, or benchmark. Such cross-cutting insights are difficult to obtain while runs remain siloed; ROAR is the first infrastructure designed to unify them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ROAR 用关系型 schema 与解析层把多个 AI 驱动研究系统 (ADRS) 的异构运行输出统一成带数据血缘与时序结构的语料库，新增系统无需改 schema。基于 900 余次运行的池化数据，发现同配置运行会收敛到不同分数、多数运行早期即获得大部分增益、且把先验解纳入搜索的策略效果随问题而变；池化语料还可反过来用于配置 ADRS 运行。
Motivation: ADRS 每次运行都是昂贵的搜索，评估需要多次运行，但结果分散在各团队、格式互不兼容，缺少跨问题跨系统聚合比较的共享基础设施。
Method: ROAR 提出关系型 schema 加解析层，归一化异构 ADRS 输出并保留数据血缘与时序结构，支持不改 schema 接入新系统；从多个 ADRS 构建 900 余次运行的语料库做跨运行分析，并用 ROAR 反过来配置 ADRS 运行。
Result: 语料库含 900 余次来自多个 ADRS 的运行；同配置运行可能收敛到不同分数（与既往工作一致），多数运行早期实现大部分增益，先验解纳入策略的效果跨问题不同；池化数据可揭示单系统、单团队、单基准难以观察的问题景观性质，并被用于配置 ADRS 运行。
Conclusion: 跨系统池化的运行数据能暴露搜索行为中依赖问题的结构，这类跨切面洞察在运行仍被孤立时难以获得，ROAR 是首个旨在统一它们的基础设施。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Localize-and-Detect: Auditing Task-Level Poisoning in Instruction-Tuned Models
papers.abstract_en: Instruction fine-tuning adapts a pretrained language model to follow instructions by training it on instruction--response pairs from a collection of tasks, such as summarization and question answering. Task-level poisoning exploits this task structure to manipulate the fine-tuned model into producing attacker-specified biased content on a particular target task, without requiring an explicit input trigger. Detecting such attacks is challenging because there is no explicit trigger to identify, the target task and biased content are unknown, and benign fine-tuning itself changes model behavior. We introduce Localize-and-Detect, a two-stage black-box auditing method for task-level poisoning that requires only outputs from both the base and fine-tuned models. In the first stage, we localize the target task by identifying candidate tasks on which the fine-tuned and base models have the largest differences in their next-token distributions. In the second stage, we search the shortlisted tasks for biased content that repeatedly appears in the fine-tuned model's responses but not in those of the base model. We evaluate Localize-and-Detect on 216 poisoned models across two model families, varying the target task, poisoning mode, poison budget, and type of biased content. Our evaluation demonstrates that Localize-and-Detect can effectively localize target tasks and detect biased content across a range of poisoning settings and models, with detection that tracks attack success and few false positives on clean models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Localize-and-Detect 是针对指令微调模型任务级投毒 (task-level poisoning) 的两阶段黑盒审计方法：先用微调模型与基座模型 next-token 分布差异最大的任务定位目标任务，再在候选任务中搜索只在微调模型回复里反复出现的偏置内容。在两个模型家族的 216 个投毒模型上，检测效果随攻击成功率变化，且在干净模型上误报很少。
Motivation: 任务级投毒不需要显式输入触发器，目标任务与偏置内容均未知，而良性微调本身也会改变模型行为，现有触发器式检测手段因此失效。
Method: 两阶段黑盒审计，仅需基座与微调模型的输出：第一阶段按 next-token 分布差异排序任务，取差异最大的候选任务定位目标任务；第二阶段在精简后的任务集里搜索微调模型回复中反复出现、而基座模型回复中没有的偏置内容。
Result: 在两个模型家族共 216 个投毒模型上评测，变化维度包括目标任务、投毒模式、投毒预算与偏置内容类型；方法能跨投毒设置与模型有效定位目标任务并检出偏置内容，检测结果随攻击成功率 (attack success) 变化，干净模型上误报很少。
Conclusion: 仅凭基座与微调模型输出的分布差异即可在无触发器条件下审计任务级投毒，检测信号与攻击成功对齐并保持低误报。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: LatentQuant: Preserving the Policy-Facing Latent Contract under NVFP4 VAE Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Recent world action models (WAMs) reuse pretrained video VAEs whose encoder latents directly condition downstream action policies. Quantization must therefore preserve not only reconstruction fidelity but also the policy-facing latent contract expected by the frozen policy. Direct NVFP4 leaves W4A4 quantization error uncompensated, whereas joint quantization-aware training (QAT) can recover reconstruction by moving this representation. On Wan2.1, joint QAT nearly matches FP32 VBench-7 (0.7403 versus 0.7409), yet LIBERO success collapses from 95.5% to 10.5%. Controlled decoder-only experiments show that activation quantize-dequantize operations alter the reconstruction signal and decoder Jacobian, redirecting the gradient returned to the encoder and inducing persistent latent drift. Based on this mechanism, we introduce LatentQuant, a two-stage NVFP4 QAT framework that first aligns the quantized encoder with its high-precision counterpart, then freezes it while adapting the decoder. Across Wan2.1 and Wan2.2, LatentQuant preserves near-baseline control and high reconstruction quality, achieving 95.75% success on LIBERO and 68.8% on RoboTwin. On NVIDIA B300 GPUs, NVFP4 execution achieves 1.17x-1.26x end-to-end VAE speedups over BF16 cuDNN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LatentQuant 用两段式 NVFP4 QAT 解决视频 VAE 量化破坏冻结策略所依赖的 latent 契约：先对齐量化编码器与高精度编码器，再冻结编码器只适配解码器。在 Wan2.1 上联合 QAT 虽把 VBench-7 恢复到 0.7403（FP32 为 0.7409），LIBERO 成功率却从 95.5% 崩到 10.5%；LatentQuant 在 LIBERO 达 95.75%、RoboTwin 达 68.8%，B300 上 NVFP4 相对 BF16 cuDNN 端到端 VAE 加速 1.17x–1.26x。
Motivation: WAM 复用预训练视频 VAE，其 encoder latent 直接条件化下游冻结策略，量化必须同时保住重建保真与策略所期待的 latent 契约；直接 NVFP4 的 W4A4 误差无补偿，而联合 QAT 靠移动表征换重建，会破坏策略输入。
Method: 先用受控的 decoder-only 实验定位机制：激活量化-反量化改变重建信号与 decoder Jacobian，使回传到 encoder 的梯度被改道，产生持续 latent drift。据此提出两段式 LatentQuant：第一阶段把量化 encoder 对齐到高精度 counterpart，第二阶段冻结 encoder、只适配 decoder，整体做 NVFP4 QAT。
Result: Wan2.1 上联合 QAT 的 VBench-7 为 0.7403（FP32 为 0.7409），但 LIBERO 成功率从 95.5% 崩至 10.5%。LatentQuant 在 Wan2.1 与 Wan2.2 上保持接近基线的控制与高重建质量，LIBERO 成功率 95.75%、RoboTwin 68.8%。NVIDIA B300 上 NVFP4 相对 BF16 cuDNN 端到端 VAE 加速 1.17x–1.26x。
Conclusion: 重建指标恢复不等于策略可用：量化对 decoder Jacobian 的扰动会改道 encoder 梯度并造成 latent drift，因此先对齐再冻结 encoder、只调 decoder 才能同时保住控制性能与重建质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Latent Score-Based Bayesian Cramér-Rao Bound Estimation for High-Dimensional Imaging Systems
papers.abstract_en: We propose a data-driven framework for estimating the Bayesian Cramér-Rao bound (CRB) in high-dimensional imaging systems with complex, analytically intractable priors. Direct CRB computation is challenging in this setting due to the need to model the prior score and to form and invert the Bayesian Fisher information matrix in very high dimensions. To address these issues, we first reformulate the inverse problem in the latent space of a pre-trained variational autoencoder, thereby dramatically reducing the dimensionality of the bound estimation problem while preserving the spatial structure of the images. The Bayesian CRB is formed in this latent space and mapped back to the native parameter space using a change-of-variables formula. Second, to learn the latent prior score, we introduce a new sliced score matching objective defined in a Bochner space endowed with an $H^1(Ω)$ Sobolev norm in space. This "Bochner-space sliced score matching" objective is consistent with standard sliced score matching, but penalizes errors in the spatial gradients of the score, suppressing high-frequency artifacts that otherwise contaminate the resulting CRB estimates. We validate the approach on a stylized quantitative photoacoustic computed tomography (qPACT) breast imaging problem with over one million unknown parameters, using a foundation-model autoencoder derived from Stable Diffusion. The proposed method yields stable, artifact-free Bayesian CRB estimates that reflect the highly non-Gaussian structure of the learned prior and reveal the substantial impact of the prior on the relative performance of competing qPACT design schemes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出数据驱动的 Bayesian Cramér-Rao bound (CRB) 估计框架：把成像逆问题重参数化到预训练 VAE 的 latent space 降维，在 latent 空间构造 Bayesian CRB 再用变量变换公式映射回原参数空间，并用 Bochner-space sliced score matching 学习 latent 先验 score。该 score 目标在带 H^1(Ω) Sobolev 范数的 Bochner 空间中惩罚 score 的空间梯度误差，抑制高频伪影；在超过一百万未知参数的 qPACT 乳腺成像问题上给出稳定、无伪影的 CRB 估计，并显示先验对 competing qPACT 设计方案的相对表现有实质影响。
Motivation: 高维成像系统中先验解析形式复杂、不可处理，直接算 CRB 需要建模 prior score 并在极高维下形成并求逆 Bayesian Fisher information matrix，计算上不可行。
Method: 先在预训练 VAE（由 Stable Diffusion 派生的 foundation-model autoencoder）的 latent space 中重写逆问题，大幅降维同时保留图像空间结构，在 latent 空间构造 Bayesian CRB 后用 change-of-variables 公式映射回原参数空间；再提出 Bochner-space sliced score matching 目标，在赋予 H^1(Ω) Sobolev 空间范数的 Bochner 空间中学习 latent prior score，与标准 sliced score matching 一致但额外惩罚 score 的空间梯度误差。
Result: 在 stylized quantitative photoacoustic computed tomography (qPACT) 乳腺成像问题上验证，未知参数超过一百万；所得 Bayesian CRB 估计稳定、无伪影，反映学到的先验的强非高斯结构，并揭示先验对 competing qPACT 设计方案相对表现的实质影响。
Conclusion: 把 CRB 估计搬到 VAE latent 空间并用 Sobolev 加权的 sliced score matching 学先验 score，可在解析不可行的高维成像问题上得到可信的 Bayesian CRB，且先验选择会实质改变成像设计方案的排序。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: One-Step Curvature Probes Miss the Fitting Operator: Retained Capacity and Terminal Null-Space Correction for Continual Learning
authors: Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan
papers.abstract_en: A one-step curvature probe evaluates an initial direction, whereas continual learners are judged after reaching comparable new-task fit. In an overparameterized linearization, projected gradient descent converges to $Δ_P=PJ^\top(JPJ^\top)^{-1}r$, and its squared-displacement inflation is exactly the reciprocal of the retained fitting capacity $c_P(r)$. More generally, the terminal old-task quadratic ratio factorizes as $1/[c_P(r)G_{\rm end}(P,r)]$, where $G_{\rm end}$ compares curvature along endpoint directions. In the rank-one case, $G_{\rm end}$ equals the one-step probe gain; for multiple outputs, the two gains can differ. The terminal quadratic also separates into a curvature-optimal fitting floor and an algorithm-dependent null-space excess, motivating terminal null-space correction, which preserves linearized new-task outputs on its Jacobian batch. Controlled checks validate the local quadratic and show that projection can greatly reduce matched-norm curvature while barely changing terminal forgetting. Across common-threshold configurations, projection yields the larger signed old-task loss change in 73/99 matched pairs, retained fitting capacity falls with rank, and fixed-rank comparisons separate terminal forgetting even when probe gain is approximately matched. On Permuted MNIST and Split CIFAR-100, terminal correction decreases signed old-task loss in 166/180 method--dataset--seed pairs under the all-seed intention-to-correct analysis; because acceptance and outcome reporting use the same held-out split, this result is descriptive and test-conditioned. Overall, terminal cost depends jointly on retained fitting capacity, endpoint-direction curvature, and the null-space component selected by optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出一步曲率探针 (one-step curvature probe) 会误判持续学习的遗忘代价：在过参数化线性化中，投影梯度下降的位移膨胀恰为保留拟合容量 c_P(r) 的倒数，终端旧任务二次比值分解为 1/[c_P(r)G_end(P,r)]，并进一步分离为曲率最优拟合下限与算法相关的零空间超额。由此提出终端零空间校正 (terminal null-space correction)，在 Permuted MNIST 与 Split CIFAR-100 上使 166/180 个方法-数据集-种子对的旧任务有符号损失下降。
Motivation: 持续学习常用一步曲率探针评估初始方向，但模型实际是在达到可比新任务拟合后被评判遗忘；一步增益与终端增益在多输出情形下可不一致，导致投影看似大幅降低匹配范数曲率却几乎不改变终端遗忘。
Method: 在过参数化线性化中推导投影梯度下降的收敛解 Δ_P=PJ^⊤(JPJ^⊤)^{-1}r，把终端旧任务二次比值分解为保留拟合容量 c_P(r) 与端点方向曲率增益 G_end(P,r) 之积的倒数，并拆出曲率最优拟合下限与零空间超额；据此设计终端零空间校正，该校正在其 Jacobian batch 上保持线性化新任务输出不变。
Result: 受控检验验证了局部二次近似，并显示投影可大幅降低匹配范数曲率而终端遗忘几乎不变；在共同阈值配置下，99 个匹配对中投影产生更大的有符号旧任务损失变化 73/99，保留拟合容量随秩下降，固定秩比较在探针增益近似匹配时仍能区分终端遗忘。在 Permuted MNIST 与 Split CIFAR-100 上，全种子 intention-to-correct 分析中 166/180 个方法-数据集-种子对的终端校正使有符号旧任务损失下降；因验收与结果报告使用同一 held-out split，该结果为描述性、受测试条件约束。
Conclusion: 终端代价由保留拟合容量、端点方向曲率与优化所选零空间分量共同决定，一步曲率探针不足以判定持续学习遗忘；应改用终端量来比较方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evolving LLM-Generated Features for Interpretable Classification
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as classifiers, yet they operate as opaque systems whose decisions are difficult to interpret, which complicates their use in regulated domains such as credit scoring or medical diagnosis. We propose an evolutionary framework that iteratively discovers natural language feature definitions (rubrics) for interpretable classification. An LLM generates candidate binary features, evaluates each sample against them, and the resulting vectors can be used to train a transparent classifier such as logistic regression. The feature set evolves over multiple iterations guided by classification errors, per-class activation rates, and feature ablation scores. We evaluate across three benchmarks, including a credit risk dataset representative of regulated domains, comparing single-shot LLM rubrics, evolved rubrics, and direct zero-shot LLM classification. Evolved features improve over single-shot rubrics by +2.9 pp on average and outperform zero-shot LLM classification on two of three tasks, while providing fully auditable decision logic. On the credit risk task, the zero-shot LLM performs at chance (50.7%) with a strong bias toward a single class, whereas evolved features achieve balanced, interpretable predictions. Crucially, this failure is invisible in aggregate accuracy and surfaces only under per-class auditing. Analysis reveals that evolution is most effective when label boundaries cannot be inferred from category names alone or when the LLM lacks reliable domain-specific reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出进化式框架，让 LLM 迭代生成自然语言特征定义（rubric），用分类误差、逐类激活率与特征消融分数驱动特征集演化，再用这些二值特征向量训练逻辑回归等透明分类器。三个基准上演化特征比单次生成 rubric 平均高 +2.9 pp，并在三项任务中的两项胜过零样本 LLM 分类；信用风险任务上零样本 LLM 仅 50.7%（等同随机且偏向单一类别），演化特征给出均衡且可审计的预测。
Motivation: LLM 作为分类器是黑箱，其决策难以解释，在信用评分、医疗诊断等受监管领域难以落地；而聚合准确率会掩盖逐类失效。
Method: LLM 生成候选二值特征并对每个样本打分，得到的特征向量输入逻辑回归等透明分类器；特征集按分类误差、逐类激活率和特征消融分数跨多轮演化，并对比单次 rubric、演化 rubric 与直接零样本 LLM 分类三种方案。
Result: 在三个基准（含代表受监管领域的信用风险数据集）上，演化特征比单次 rubric 平均提升 +2.9 pp，并在三项任务中的两项优于零样本 LLM 分类；信用风险任务零样本 LLM 为 50.7%、处于随机水平且强烈偏向单一类别，演化特征则给出均衡的可解释预测，该失效在聚合准确率下不可见、只有逐类审计才暴露。
Conclusion: 当标签边界无法仅从类别名推断、或 LLM 缺乏可靠领域推理时，进化式特征搜索最有效；受监管场景应以逐类审计而非聚合准确率判断 LLM 分类是否可用。

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Model Decision-Making for Autonomous Driving Guided by Chinese Philosophical Wisdom
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving decision systems must balance safety, efficiency, and social norms in complex traffic interactions. Philosophical and ethical considerations have received limited attention in existing autonomous driving decision-making approaches based on numerical optimization, sequence prediction, and large language models (LLMs). We propose Chinese Philosophical Wisdom-Guided Driving (CPW-Drive), a closed-loop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework that incorporates value guidance derived from Chinese philosophy into autonomous driving decision-making. Using Chinese Confucian thought as its knowledge source, CPW-Drive consolidates LLM-extracted keywords from relevant classical texts into driving-relevant value principles through manual screening and validation. It then contextualizes these principles through scenario-specific cases to form retrievable and reusable value guidance. We further propose Physics-aware Spatial Similarity Retrieval (PSSR), which compares vehicle layouts and velocity-extrapolated states to retrieve physically relevant historical cases. On Highway-env's multilane highway-driving task, CPW-Drive achieves success rates of 93.0%, 86.0%, and 72.0% across three traffic configurations. These results outperform the strongest baseline by 8.0, 22.5, and 25.0 percentage points, respectively. Across all configurations, CPW-Drive achieves the highest collision-free step count and maintains a low lane-change frequency. The results suggest that structured value guidance can improve simulated closed-loop safety and stability while introducing efficiency and latency trade-offs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CPW-Drive：把儒家经典文本经 LLM 抽词、人工筛校成驾驶价值原则，再以场景案例形式存入检索库，用物理感知空间相似度检索 (PSSR) 匹配车辆布局与速度外推状态，闭环指导 LLM 自动驾驶决策。在 Highway-env 多车道任务的三种交通配置下成功率 93.0%、86.0%、72.0%，比最强基线高 8.0、22.5、25.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶决策方法依赖数值优化、序列预测或 LLM，哲学与伦理维度基本缺席；复杂交通交互中安全、效率与社会规范难以同时平衡。
Method: CPW-Drive 是闭环 RAG 框架：以中国儒家思想为知识源，LLM 从古典文本抽取关键词，经人工筛校整合为驾驶相关价值原则，再用场景案例将其情境化为可检索条目；检索环节用 PSSR 比较车辆布局与速度外推状态，取物理相关的历史案例注入决策。
Result: 在 Highway-env 多车道高速任务上，三种交通配置成功率分别为 93.0%、86.0%、72.0%，较最强基线分别高出 8.0、22.5、25.0 个百分点；全部配置下无碰撞步数最高、变道频率保持较低。
Conclusion: 结构化价值指导能提升模拟闭环驾驶的安全性与稳定性，代价是效率与延迟的权衡。

papers.title: Synthesizing Physics Formulae with Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Finding a compact formula that fits a set of input-output pairs and predicts outputs on unseen inputs is a fundamental problem in science. Symbolic regression automates the search for such formulae: search-based methods explore the space of possible formulae directly, while transformers pre-trained on synthetic data produce formulae of comparable quality substantially faster. Existing transformers, however, are prone to overfitting --- they find formulae that fit the training data well but do not extrapolate to input ranges unseen during training. We address this by shaping the set of formulae used to train a transformer, and show that the resulting formulae extrapolate substantially better. Fine-tuning the transformer on data with noise-corrupted target values further makes the synthesized formulae robust to noise in the observations. On SRBench and LLM-SRBench our transformer synthesizes a formula in about ten seconds and extrapolates better than all evaluated methods at a comparable budget. Search-based methods surpass our accuracy only when given one to three orders of magnitude more time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 符号回归 (symbolic regression) 中预训练 Transformer 生成的公式拟合好但外推差，本文通过改造训练所用的公式集合来抑制过拟合，使合成公式在训练未见输入范围上外推显著更好；再对含噪目标值微调，得到对观测噪声更稳健的公式。在 SRBench 与 LLM-SRBench 上约 10 秒合成一个公式，且在同等预算下外推优于所有被评估方法。
Motivation: 预训练 Transformer 虽比搜索式方法快得多，但容易过拟合：拟合训练数据却无法外推到训练未见的输入范围，限制了其在科学发现中给出可用公式的能力。
Method: 通过塑造 (shaping) 用于训练 Transformer 的公式集合来改善外推；随后在目标值被噪声破坏的数据上对 Transformer 微调，使合成公式对观测噪声更稳健。
Result: 在 SRBench 和 LLM-SRBench 上，约 10 秒合成一个公式，且在同等预算下外推优于所有被评估方法；搜索式方法只有在获得多 1 到 3 个数量级的时间时才超过其精度。
Conclusion: 训练公式集合的塑造加噪声微调能让 Transformer 符号回归在低预算下取得最佳外推精度，搜索式方法需多 1–3 个数量级的时间才能在精度上反超。

papers.title: DePICT: Decision-Preserving Interface for Constrained Downstream Tasks
papers.abstract_en: A constrained optimization problem may involve a parameter in its objective and active constraints, yet the final decision may remain insensitive to small changes in that parameter. This raises a fundamental question: which inputs does a decision making system truly depend on? Building on this question, we introduce DePICT, a procedure for constructing decision preserving interfaces by ranking context directions according to the optimizer's solution sensitivity and aggregating them across an operating regime. We study this problem in a high dimensional setting where primitive context parameterizes a constrained task and the downstream agent observes only a selected subset of context directions. For locally regular constrained programs, we derive a Karush Kuhn Tucker (KKT) based characterization of when a context direction is optimizer relevant. Our analysis shows that appearing in the active optimization problem does not necessarily imply that a variable affects the final decision. Some context directions can alter the KKT conditions while leaving the optimal solution unchanged because their effect is absorbed by the dual variables. DePICT is designed to remove exactly these directions. In a controlled diagnosis, it recovers the decision relevant interface exactly and reduces linear predictor regret to 0.009, compared with 0.475 for the strongest competing baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DePICT 通过 KKT 解灵敏度对上下文方向排序并在操作域上聚合，构造只保留决策相关输入的接口；它精确剔除那些改变 KKT 条件却因被对偶变量吸收而不改变最优解的方向。在受控诊断中，DePICT 精确恢复决策相关接口，线性预测器 regret 降至 0.009，最强竞争基线为 0.475。
Motivation: 约束优化中某参数即使出现在目标与激活约束里，最终决策也可能对它不敏感；下游智能体只观察部分上下文方向时，无法判断哪些输入真正被决策依赖。
Method: DePICT 按优化器解灵敏度对上下文方向排序，并跨操作域聚合，构造 decision-preserving interface；对局部正则约束规划给出基于 KKT 的判据，判定某方向是否 optimizer relevant，并专门移除被对偶变量吸收的方向。
Result: 在受控诊断中，DePICT 精确恢复决策相关接口，线性预测器 regret 为 0.009，最强竞争基线为 0.475。
Conclusion: 出现在激活优化问题中并不等于影响最终决策，DePICT 按 KKT 灵敏度筛掉被对偶变量吸收的方向即可保留决策。

papers.title: Dynamic Time Step Prediction in Inverse Heat Dissipation for Blur-Like Image Restoration Tasks
papers.abstract_en: When using diffusion models to target image restoration problems, diffusion inversion is typically employed to retain relevant image information from the degraded images. Instead of inverting back to the initial time step (i.e., T), many methods invert to a pre-determined intermediate time step, in order to better preserve information from degraded source images. However, a pre-determined time step for inversion is not ideal for reconstruction, as a severely degraded image requires an earlier starting time step than a mildly degraded one. In addition, DDIM-based models corrupt the original signal by adding Gaussian noise, which can be mismatched to the nature of blur-like degradations, such as blur, haze, and low-light. To address these problems, we propose two solutions: (1) we adopt an alternative diffusion process, called the Inverse Heat Dissipation Model, that diffuses the input image by gradually blurring a data point (2) we propose to implement a time predictor to estimate the starting time step for the inversion, with the model learning to adapt to the degradation severity. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations, with excellent generalization to many restoration tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在扩散复原的反演中，固定中间起始时间步对严重退化图像不合适，且 DDIM 的高斯加噪与模糊类退化不匹配。作者改用 Inverse Heat Dissipation Model 以逐步模糊代替加噪，并训练一个时间预测器按退化严重度估计反演起始时间步，在标准 benchmark 上取得 SOTA 的定量与定性结果并可泛化到多种复原任务。
Motivation: 扩散反演通常反演到预设的中间时间步，但严重退化需要更早的起始时间步；同时 DDIM 的高斯噪声与 blur、haze、low-light 这类模糊型退化性质不符，损害重建信息保留。
Method: 两点改动：一是采用 Inverse Heat Dissipation Model 这一替代扩散过程，通过逐步模糊数据点来扩散输入图像，而非加高斯噪声；二是引入 time predictor 学习估计反演的起始时间步，使模型随退化严重度自适应。
Result: 在标准 benchmark 上的广泛实验显示，该方法在定量与定性评估中均达到 state-of-the-art 性能，并对多种图像复原任务表现出良好的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 把扩散过程换成与模糊型退化匹配的热耗散逆过程，并让反演起始时间步由退化严重度自适应决定，是图像复原中比固定时间步更有效的做法。

papers.title: A Step Towards Forgetting: Optimiser History and the Loss of Answer Mass
papers.abstract_en: During fine-tuning, a language model can assign less probability to previously learned answers even when the current gradient acts to preserve that probability. With momentum, each update also carries gradients computed at earlier model states, and these stored contributions can push the model in the opposite direction. We investigate how this optimiser memory contributes to forgetting by separating old-task loss into confusion among its answers and leakage of probability outside the answer set. Across three language-model families, answer mass consistently declines while discrimination among old answers usually improves: the model becomes less likely to produce answers that it can still distinguish correctly. Decomposing Adam updates reveals opposing contributions to this loss of answer mass. Over training, accumulated history favours leakage, while the current gradient opposes it. Resolving history by age shows that the harmful contributions come mainly from older gradients of the new task, whereas recent gradients tend to protect the old answers. Changes in history's effect are dominated by its orientation relative to the old-task gradient. Interventions that reset momentum while matching the initial update norm establish that stored history affects retention, with state-dependent immediate effects and lower final old-task loss over longer Adam continuations, mainly through recovered answer mass. Finally, integration along finite updates shows that most sampled large loss increases are captured by local projections, while curvature along history amplifies some events. Together, these findings reveal how an optimiser's memory can erode learned behaviour even as its current gradient acts to preserve it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 微调中的遗忘有一部分来自优化器记忆而非当前梯度：把旧任务损失拆成答案集内的判别 (discrimination) 与答案集外的泄漏 (leakage) 后，三个语言模型家族中 answer mass 持续下降、而旧答案间的判别通常反而变好，即模型更不容易给出它仍能正确区分的答案。Adam 更新分解显示累积历史偏向泄漏、当前梯度则抵抗泄漏，且有害贡献主要来自新任务的较旧梯度；重置动量并匹配初始更新范数的干预使更长的 Adam 续训最终旧任务损失更低，主要靠恢复 answer mass。
Motivation: 微调时当前梯度明明在保护旧答案的概率，模型却仍给先前学到的答案分配更少概率；需要定位这部分损失究竟来自当前梯度还是优化器存储的历史梯度。
Method: 把旧任务损失分解为答案集内的 confusion 与答案集外的 leakage 两个分量，在三个语言模型家族上追踪 answer mass 与判别；再分解 Adam 更新，按梯度年龄 (age) 归因历史贡献，并用重置动量且匹配初始更新范数的干预隔离存储历史的作用，最后沿有限更新做积分并与局部投影、沿历史方向的曲率对比。
Result: 三个语言模型家族中 answer mass 一致下降，而旧答案间的判别通常改善；Adam 分解中累积历史偏向 leakage、当前梯度与之对抗，有害贡献主要来自新任务的较旧梯度，近期梯度倾向保护旧答案；历史作用的变化由其相对旧任务梯度的朝向主导；重置动量干预带来状态相关的即时效应，并使更长 Adam 续训的最终旧任务损失更低，主要通过恢复 answer mass；有限更新积分显示多数采样到的大幅损失上升可由局部投影捕捉，沿历史方向的曲率会放大部分事件。
Conclusion: 优化器的记忆本身就能侵蚀已学行为，即使当前梯度在保护它；遗忘的主因是历史梯度的朝向与年龄，而非当前梯度方向。

papers.title: TreeWalker: Partial Evaluation for Grouped Tree-Ensemble Inference
papers.abstract_en: Many inference workloads evaluate a trained tree ensemble on row groups that share feature values: discrete-time survival models expand each patient into $G$ time steps, click-through-rate models score every item in a search session, and scenario analyses vary a few inputs while holding the rest fixed. Standard inference treats each row independently and repeats the shared work $G$ times. We present TreeWalker, which applies partial evaluation to grouped inference: constant features are static, varying features dynamic. It walks each tree once per group, partitions a row bitmask at varying splits, and skips empty subtrees. Training is unchanged: TreeWalker reads standard LightGBM and XGBoost models. We prove a structural work decomposition: per-tree work splits into the constant-projected subtree size $|T_c|$, $G$ leaf writes, and a predicate-mask provisioning cost $Q$. For the trace evaluator, per-row work approaches a $(d_v+1)/(d+1)$ fraction of a row-independent walk as $G \to \infty$. On Intel, TreeWalker is 2.5-3.2$\times$ faster than a row-independent traversal at the reference configuration ($T=500$, $L=8$) and 6.8-7.8$\times$ faster at $G=128$ on the survival datasets, with larger gains on Arm. On a scenario-analysis benchmark it is faster in all 16 configurations on both architectures. For f64 models, outputs match treelite's GTIL up to summation order; for f32 models, f64 accumulation is closer to a Kahan-compensated reference than native f32 on 99.98% of rows and never farther.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/Shopify/treewalker
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TreeWalker 对分组树集成推理做 partial evaluation：把组内不变特征当常量、变化特征当动态，每棵树每组只走一次并按变化分裂点切分 row bitmask、跳过空子树。在 Intel 参考配置 (T=500, L=8) 下比逐行遍历快 2.5–3.2×，生存数据集 G=128 时快 6.8–7.8×，Arm 上增益更大。
Motivation: 生存模型、CTR 会话、场景分析等负载中同一组行共享大量特征值，标准推理逐行独立评估把共享工作重复 G 次，浪费随组规模线性放大。
Method: 对 LightGBM/XGBoost 模型做静态与动态特征划分，逐树按组遍历并在动态分裂点切分 row bitmask、剪掉空子树；训练不变。证明每棵树工作量分解为常量投影子树大小 |T_c|、G 次叶子写入与谓词掩码供给成本 Q。
Result: trace evaluator 中每行工作量随 G→∞ 趋近逐行遍历的 (d_v+1)/(d+1)。Intel 参考配置 (T=500, L=8) 快 2.5–3.2×，生存数据集 G=128 快 6.8–7.8×，Arm 增益更大；场景分析基准在两种架构全部 16 个配置上都更快。f64 输出与 treelite GTIL 一致（至求和顺序），f32 下 f64 累加在 99.98% 行上比原生 f32 更接近 Kahan 补偿参考且从不更差。
Conclusion: 分组推理的共享工作可以按结构分解并被部分求值掉，速度随组规模 G 增大而提升，且不改变训练流程、数值结果与 treelite 对齐。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MLLMs Fail to Refuse when Using Tools Agentically
papers.abstract_en: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have recently pushed the frontier of visual reasoning by calling tools such as zooming and tagging. Despite the recent strong success of agentic MLLMs, this work uncovers a critical safety failure in the tool-use paradigm: agentic tool-using MLLMs become less capable of refusing harmful requests. Our experiments confirm that, across three popular safety benchmarks, all the top open- and closed-weight MLLMs we test exhibit significantly lower safety in tool-using settings than in non-tool settings, with a relative refusal failure rate increase of up to 68.7%. Based on analysis of 100,000+ responses, including extended experiments, we also propose two possible reasons for this safety degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 发现 agentic 工具调用会让多模态大模型 (MLLM) 更难拒绝有害请求：在三个主流安全基准上，所测全部开源与闭源 MLLM 在工具使用设定下的拒绝能力都显著低于非工具设定，相对拒绝失败率最高上升 68.7%；基于 10 万+ 条响应的分析提出两种可能原因。
Motivation: agentic MLLM 靠 zooming、tagging 等工具调用推进视觉推理，但工具使用范式本身可能破坏安全对齐，使模型在有害请求面前失去拒绝能力。
Method: 在三个流行安全基准上对比同一 MLLM 的工具使用与非工具使用两种设定的拒绝表现，覆盖多个开源与闭源权重模型；对 100,000+ 条响应做扩展分析并据此提出两种可能的安全退化原因。
Result: 三个安全基准上所有受测的头部开源与闭源 MLLM 在工具使用设定下安全性均显著低于非工具设定，相对拒绝失败率 (refusal failure rate) 最高上升 68.7%；分析基于 100,000+ 条响应。
Conclusion: 工具调用是 agentic MLLM 的系统性安全弱点：视觉推理能力越依赖外部工具，拒绝有害请求的能力退化越明显，其成因被归结为两种候选机制。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SGAnalog: An End-to-End Circuit Benchmark from Open-Source Silicon Tapeouts
papers.abstract_en: Existing analog integrated circuit design benchmarks make two questions hard to answer: whether a model has learned transferable circuit skills rather than recalled familiar examples, and whether its output works under defined process and test conditions. We introduce a benchmark built from human-designed, open-source circuits associated with Tiny Tapeout manufacturing shuttles. The collection contains 273 topologically distinct top-level designs. Every source is retrieved at the revision recorded for its shuttle submission and processed in a fixed containerized environment. The pipeline exports each eligible schematic image and its SPICE netlist from the same source file, giving transcription an exact structural reference. Commit dates support model-specific training-cutoff analysis, while author testbenches provide the simulation context for sizing. The benchmark evaluates schematic-to-netlist transcription and device sizing. Across seven models on a fixed set of 66 transcription tasks, the strongest model reaches 56.1% exact graph isomorphism, and six of seven models drop sharply from the small to the medium tier. For one frontier model, removing author-chosen labels reduces exact matches while preserving aggregate structural F1, suggesting that labels can aid connectivity tracing. On the 17 sizing tasks, the leading model converges on all 17 proposals and reaches 91.2 out of 100 against the human reference, while the two newest Claude models refuse 4 and 11 of the same prompts they transcribe without objection; a proposal without sizes scores zero. The two tasks produce different model rankings, exposing distinct visual and design capabilities and, in one family, a policy rather than capability limit.
papers.comment: Accepted at the AI for Chip Design Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SGAnalog 是从 Tiny Tapeout 开源流片构建的端到端模拟电路基准，含 273 个拓扑不同的顶层设计，同一源文件导出示意图与 SPICE 网表作转写真值。7 个模型在 66 项转写任务上最强者达 56.1% 精确图同构，17 项 sizing 任务领先模型对人工参考得 91.2/100，但同一 Claude 家族对 4 和 11 个提示拒答，暴露策略而非能力限制。
Motivation: 现有模拟电路设计基准难以区分模型是学到可迁移的电路技能还是记住了熟悉样例，也难判断输出在给定工艺与测试条件下是否真的能工作。
Method: 从与 Tiny Tapeout 制造 shuttle 关联的人工设计开源电路构建基准，按 shuttle 提交记录的版本在固定容器环境中取源，同一源文件导出示意图图像与 SPICE 网表；用 commit 日期支持按模型训练截止时间分析，用作者 testbench 提供 sizing 的仿真上下文；评测 schematic-to-netlist 转写与器件 sizing 两项任务。
Result: 273 个拓扑不同的顶层设计；7 个模型在固定 66 项转写任务上最强者 56.1% 精确图同构，6/7 个模型从小档位到中档位急剧下滑；对一个前沿模型，去掉作者自选标签降低精确匹配但保持总体结构 F1；17 项 sizing 任务上领先模型全部收敛于 17 个提案，对人工参考得 91.2/100，两个最新 Claude 模型对同一组提示分别拒答 4 和 11 个（无尺寸的提案计 0 分）。
Conclusion: 转写与 sizing 给出不同的模型排名，反映彼此独立的视觉与设计能力，其中一个模型家族的差距来自策略而非能力；标签有助于连通性追踪。

papers.title: DABACO: A Multi-Camera Dataset and Benchmark for Screen Localization and Pointing Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Screen localization and pointing estimation are key to low-cost interactive devices. Yet developing and evaluating these algorithms requires realistic data: synthetic captures cannot fully reproduce the optical distortion, rolling shutter, motion blur, and display processing of a physical acquisition, and most existing datasets provide static images rather than the video needed to assess continuous pointing. In this paper, we introduce the DABACO Dataset. Developed within the DABACO (Dispositivo Apuntador de BAjo COste, or Low-Cost Pointing Device) project, this dataset supports the development and evaluation of screen detection and camera-based pointing algorithms for embedded systems. It comprises video sequences captured with multiple low-cost camera sensors, including monochrome global-shutter and color rolling-shutter modules, on embedded platforms such as the Raspberry Pi 4B and ESP32-S3. We present a systematic annotation pipeline combining temporary visual watermarking, optical-flow tracking, manual verification, and marker removal. Both the original marked captures and the marker-free images, together with explicit corner annotations and modification masks, are released to support auditing and the study of potential reconstruction bias. In addition, we release an open-source evaluation toolkit with two reference baselines: a classical screen-detection pipeline based on edge and contour geometry, and a closed-vocabulary, off-the-shelf YOLOv8 segmentation model evaluated without dataset-specific training. Both are evaluated on a general-purpose computer using Intersection over Union, corner error, and pointing error, establishing initial reference results for future embedded implementations. Overall, DABACO addresses a gap in existing resources and is intended to support the development and evaluation of new low-cost screen-localization and pointing systems.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22797835. Code and toolkit: https://domondo.github.io/dabaco-dataset-toolkit/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DABACO 发布一个多摄像头屏幕定位与指向估计数据集：在 Raspberry Pi 4B 与 ESP32-S3 上用黑白全局快门和彩色卷帘快门模态拍摄视频序列，配水印+光流+人工核验的标注流水线，并同时放出带标记原片、无标记图像、角点标注与修改掩码。附带开源评测工具包和两条参考基线（基于边缘轮廓几何的经典检测管线、未经数据集训练的闭词表 YOLOv8 分割），在通用计算机上以 IoU、角点误差和指向误差给出初始参考结果。
Motivation: 低成本交互设备的屏幕定位与指向算法缺少真实采集数据：合成拍摄无法复现光学畸变、卷帘快门、运动模糊和显示处理，现有数据集又多为静态图片，无法评估连续指向。
Method: 数据集由多款低成本摄像头（黑白全局快门、彩色卷帘快门）在嵌入式平台（Raspberry Pi 4B、ESP32-S3）上拍摄视频序列构成；标注流水线结合临时视觉水印、光流追踪、人工核验与标记移除，同时发布带标记原片、无标记图像、显式角点标注和修改掩码以支持审计与重建偏差研究；评测工具包提供边缘/轮廓几何的经典屏幕检测管线与闭词表 off-the-shelf YOLOv8 分割两条基线。
Result: 两条基线在通用计算机上以 Intersection over Union、角点误差 (corner error) 和指向误差 (pointing error) 评测，建立面向后续嵌入式实现的初始参考结果；数据集含 21 页论文、5 幅图、6 张表，数据与代码分别发布于 Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.22797835) 和 dabaco-dataset-toolkit。

papers.title: Co-Supervised Tree Synthesis for Interpretable Subgroup Identification and Honest Treatment Effect Inference in Randomized Trials
papers.abstract_en: Identifying patient subgroups with heterogeneous treatment effects is central to precision medicine, yet existing approaches face a tension. Black-box methods estimate individualized effects well but yield no interpretable subgroups, while tree-based methods produce explicit partitions but are unstable and less accurate in moderate-sample trials. We propose CausalSynthTree, a co-supervised method in which black-box causal estimators guide construction of an interpretable tree. It partitions the covariate space into cells, fits cell-wise conditional average treatment effect models from both observed data and synthetic data labeled by black-box causal teachers, and synthesizes them into a tree through a treatment-effect disparity criterion. Each leaf carries a sparse linear model, so the tree path defines a subgroup and the leaf model shows which covariates modify the effect. Honest inference for leaf-wise effects remains valid despite co-supervised augmentation and data-driven subgroup selection. In simulations it closes much of the gap between the two families. From moderate sample sizes onward it is more accurate than the black-box learners whenever the effect is linear or has a single threshold, and trails them only on a finer partition than the tree it grows. It controls spurious splits and attains nominal coverage throughout. In the ACTG175 HIV trial, where standard interaction tests detect no effect modification, the method reports no subgroups while the competing tree methods report several. In an adjuvant colon cancer trial it reports a borderline covariate in part of the resamples, together with a within-region age gradient that is consistent with an independent test.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CausalSynthTree 用黑盒因果估计器当教师，合成一棵可解释的因果树来划分患者亚组并做诚实推断：每个叶子带稀疏线性模型，树路径即亚组，叶子模型指出哪些协变量修饰效应。在模拟中它弥合了黑盒与树两类方法的差距，中等样本起在效应为线性或单一阈值时比黑盒学习器更准，并全程控制虚假分裂、保持名义覆盖率；在 ACTG175 试验中标准交互检验查不出效应修饰时，它报告无亚组，而竞争树方法报告多个。
Motivation: 黑盒方法能估个体化效应却给不出可解释亚组，树方法分区明确但在中等样本试验中不稳定且精度较差，两者存在张力。
Method: CausalSynthTree 为 co-supervised 方法：先划分协变量空间成 cells，再用观测数据与由黑盒因果教师标注的合成数据共同拟合 cell-wise 条件平均治疗效应 (CATE) 模型，最后按 treatment-effect disparity 准则合成为一棵树；每个叶子携带稀疏线性模型，且在 co-supervised 增广与数据驱动选亚组之下保持叶子效应的诚实推断 (honest inference) 有效。
Result: 模拟中该方法弥合两类方法的差距：从中等样本量起，在效应为线性或单一阈值时比黑盒学习器更准确，仅在其划分细于所生长的树时落后；全程控制虚假分裂 (spurious splits) 并保持名义覆盖率 (nominal coverage)。ACTG175 HIV 试验中标准交互检验检测不到效应修饰，本方法报告无亚组而竞争树方法报告多个；在一项辅助结肠癌试验中，它在部分重采样里报告一个边缘协变量，并给出与独立检验一致的区域内年龄梯度。
Conclusion: 让黑盒教师指导可解释树的合成，可以在不牺牲诚实推断的前提下同时拿到亚组可解释性与接近黑盒的效应估计精度；在无真实效应修饰的数据上它倾向于不报亚组，比竞争树方法更保守。

papers.title: A Multivariable Approach to the Regional Calibration of the Galvez Davison Index across Mexico Climate Regimes
papers.abstract_en: The Gálvez Davison Index (GDI) is a thermodynamic diagnostic designed to summarize convective favorability in the tropical regions, yet its transferability across complex terrain and heterogeneous hydroclimates remains uncertain. Here we assess the climatological behavior and precipitation relevance of the GDI over Mexico using ERA5 hourly fields and CHIRPS daily precipitation for 1981 to 2024. We characterize the seasonal cycle and spatial contrasts of GDI and evaluate its association with rainfall using grid point and regional Pearson and Spearman correlations between daily maximum GDI and daily precipitation. To introduce an independent convective proxy, we also quantify the relationship between hourly GDI and ERA5 outgoing longwave radiation (OLR). Event level discrimination skill is assessed with receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves and area under the curve (AUC) across regions and months. While GDI precipitation correlations are moderate and region dependent, GDI OLR coupling is consistently stronger, partly because OLR approaches a lower bound once deep convection develops, supporting its use as an intermediate proxy between thermodynamic favorability and rainfall. However, GDI values are systematically lower over elevated terrain because of the pressure level formulation of the index, which should be considered when interpreting the GDI over mountainous regions. ROC results indicate skill above random chance in nearly all region month combinations, with AUC frequently exceeding 0.75 during the core convective season. Building on these diagnostics, we propose a regionally calibrated GDI convective regime scale for May to October, adapted from the original GDI framework but recalibrated for Mexico using event conditioned distributions defined from OLR and precipitation and quantified with bootstrap uncertainty.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Earth Systems and Environment
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 ERA5 小时场与 CHIRPS 日降水（1981–2024）评估 Gálvez Davison Index (GDI) 在墨西哥各气候区的对流指示能力：GDI 与降水的相关中等且随区域变化，与 OLR 的耦合始终更强，核心对流季多数区域-月份组合 AUC 常超 0.75。由于该指数按气压层定义，高海拔地形上 GDI 系统性偏低，作者据此提出 5–10 月按 OLR 与降水事件条件分布重新标定的区域化 GDI 对流等级。
Motivation: GDI 是面向热带对流有利度的热力学诊断量，但其在复杂地形与异质水文气候下的可迁移性不确定，尤其在山地区域按气压层定义导致取值系统性偏低，直接跨区比较会误导。
Method: 用 ERA5 小时场与 CHIRPS 日降水刻画 1981–2024 年 GDI 的季节循环与空间对比；以日最大 GDI 对日降水做网格点与区域尺度的 Pearson、Spearman 相关，并以小时 GDI 对 ERA5 出射长波辐射 (OLR) 量化独立对流代理关系；事件判别用 ROC 曲线与 AUC 按区域和月份评估，最终以 OLR 与降水定义的事件条件分布加 bootstrap 不确定性提出区域标定的 GDI 等级。
Result: GDI 与降水的相关为中等且区域依赖，而 GDI–OLR 耦合始终更强（部分因深对流发展后 OLR 趋于下界）；ROC 显示几乎全部区域-月份组合的判别力高于随机，核心对流季 AUC 常超过 0.75；高海拔地区 GDI 因气压层公式系统性偏低。
Conclusion: GDI 可作为热力学有利度与降水之间的中间代理，但跨墨西哥气候区使用时必须按区域重新标定，并在山地区域谨慎解释其绝对取值。

papers.title: COVER: Learning to Accept More in Selective Sleep Staging
authors: Jingtong Hu (1) ((1) Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
(2) Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Traditional sleep-staging methods apply the same model to every EEG epoch. Such uniform deployment expends computation on epochs that a smaller model could handle reliably, motivating cascades in which a primary classifier accepts its reliable predictions and defers the remainder to a more capable model. In this paper, we study the first stage of such a cascade: maximizing the coverage of fixed primary predictions subject to a prescribed accepted-risk target. We propose COVER (COVerage-oriented Error Ranking), which integrates two key innovations: (i) auxiliary-informed primary-error learning, which replaces maximum softmax probability (MSP) with a learned error score while preserving the primary labels, and (ii) fixed-scale scorer refinement, which builds on this score to directly maximize coverage under an empirical accepted-risk constraint rather than error-prediction accuracy over all epochs. We evaluate COVER on Sleep-EDF-20 at a 5% accepted-risk target, with subjects held out from all fitting and selection. Auxiliary-informed error learning raises mean subject coverage from 31.5% for MSP to 48.8% at similar subject-equal risk. At equal acceptance volume, with MSP accepting the same number of epochs as the learned scorer in each subject (20,639 in total), errors fall from 1,467 to 867. Fixed-scale refinement then adds 1.7 percentage points of coverage over its initialization in nested development, and COVER attains the highest mean coverage among eight evaluated scorers, 50.4% at 4.5% subject-equal risk, above the selective-ranking baseline SELE (49.3%) and the probability-fusion comparator DuoF (43.6%). To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to combine auxiliary-informed primary-error learning with fixed-scale coverage refinement for selective sleep staging, offering a basis for reliability-aware allocation of computation in cascaded sleep staging.

TL;DR: COVER 针对级联睡眠分期的第一阶段，在给定可接受风险上限下最大化主模型可直接接受的 EEG epoch 覆盖率：用辅助信息学习的误差分数替代 MSP，并在固定尺度上直接按经验风险约束优化覆盖率。在 Sleep-EDF-20、5% 风险目标下，平均受试者覆盖率从 MSP 的 31.5% 提到 48.8%，COVER 达 50.4%（4.5% 风险），高于 SELE 的 49.3% 与 DuoF 的 43.6%。
Motivation: 传统睡眠分期对每个 EEG epoch 用同一模型，浪费了小模型本可可靠处理的那部分计算；级联的第一步需要在固定风险上限下尽量多接受主模型预测，但现有方法按全 epoch 的错误预测精度排序，而非直接最大化覆盖率。
Method: COVER 含两个组件：auxiliary-informed primary-error learning 用学习到的误差分数替换最大 softmax 概率 (MSP) 同时保留主模型标签；fixed-scale scorer refinement 在该分数之上直接按经验 accepted-risk 约束最大化覆盖率，而非优化全 epoch 的错误预测精度。评测在 Sleep-EDF-20 上进行，受试者全部留出，不参与任何拟合与选择。
Result: 在 5% accepted-risk 目标下，辅助信息误差学习把平均受试者覆盖率从 MSP 的 31.5% 提到 48.8%（受试者等风险相近）；等接受量下（每受试者与学习分数接受相同数量，共 20,639 个 epoch），错误数从 1,467 降到 867。固定尺度精修在嵌套开发中比其初始化再加 1.7 个百分点覆盖率；COVER 在八个被评分数器中平均覆盖率最高，为 50.4%（4.5% 受试者等风险），高于 SELE 的 49.3% 与 DuoF 的 43.6%。
Conclusion: 把辅助信息误差学习与固定尺度覆盖率精修结合，可在受试者留出的 Sleep-EDF-20 上于给定风险约束内接受更多主模型预测，为级联睡眠分期的可靠性感知计算分配提供基础。

papers.title: AdaEva: Accelerating LLM-Driven Algorithm Design with Adaptive Partial Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated algorithm design. However the computational cost of evaluating the generated algorithms can be excessive. We consider the common LLM-driven automated algorithm design (LLM4AD) setting in which a candidate algorithm is evaluated by aggregating its performance over a shared set of training instances. This instance-wise structure raises a natural question: must every candidate be evaluated on the entire instance set before deciding whether it remains competitive? Taking inspiration from algorithm configuration, we introduce AdaEva, a drop-in adaptive partial-evaluation framework that progressively evaluates candidates on larger subsets of the same instance pool and eliminates unpromising candidates as evidence accumulates. Importantly, AdaEva leaves the underlying LLM4AD procedure and per-instance evaluator unchanged and requires no prior knowledge about instance difficulty. We instantiate this idea using successive halving (AdaEva-S) and statistical racing (AdaEva-R), and evaluate both mechanisms across three representative LLM4AD frameworks, multiple LLM backbones, and optimization domains spanning combinatorial and continuous black-box optimization. Under matched evaluation budgets, AdaEva more reliably balances evaluation effort across candidates than fixed partial-evaluation strategies, yielding strong search efficiency and anytime performance together with improved held-out generalization across the evaluated settings.

Conclusion: 按证据累积自适应扩大评估子集并尽早淘汰，可以在不改动 LDM4AD 主流程的前提下更省地搜索算法，且泛化不以牺牲为代价。

papers.title: Proxy Confidence: Auditing Black-Box LLM Agents with a Surrogate's Log-Probabilities
papers.abstract_en: A deployed LLM agent emits tool calls, queries, and code that can be silently wrong -- by the time the error surfaces, the action has run. Frontier chat APIs hide the model's token probabilities; the agent's stated confidence barely beats chance on the mistakes that matter; and resampling does not help, since frontier models are highly repetitive, reproducing the same call across samples. We recover the missing signal from a low-cost open-weight surrogate run in parallel. It reads the same context, schema, and proposed action as the agent, then scores the call from its own log-probabilities through a family of complementary readouts: teacher forcing and request-PMI weigh the likelihood of each argument value, a discriminative verdict judges the call as a whole, and tool-choice competition tests the function against its siblings. One principle says which to trust: a generative likelihood localizes wrong argument values, while the verdict catches holistically wrong calls. When the error type is unknown, an ensemble is the low-regret default. The readout is training-free, needs no access to the agent's internals, and costs one prefill pass alongside the tool call. On difficult coding tasks it reaches AUROC 0.825 where the actor's stated confidence is near chance (0.598), and the generative readouts beat it by +0.07 to +0.28 across three further actors. Against self-consistency it gains +0.14 to +0.19 on near-deterministic actors, at 1/K the cost. The signal drives two deployment modes: a real-time gate escalating the least-trustworthy calls for review (+0.05 to +0.30 accepted-action accuracy at 50% coverage), and confidence feedback, returning the tool result with the score so the agent adapts its next step -- lifting task success on live-execution benchmarks (+0.119 and +0.137, p <= 1e-4) and beating a random-value control where step errors are silent (+0.078, p = 0.003).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用并行的开源小模型 surrogate 读取 LLM agent 的同一上下文与待执行 tool call，以其自身 log-probabilities 打分，替代 chat API 隐藏的概率与 agent 自报置信度。困难编码任务上 AUROC 0.825，而 actor 自报置信度仅 0.598；信号驱动实时拦截与置信度反馈两种部署模式，任务成功率提升 +0.119 与 +0.137（p ≤ 1e-4）。
Motivation: 部署中的 LLM agent 会发出静默错误的 tool call，等错误暴露时动作已执行；frontier chat API 不暴露 token 概率，agent 自报置信度在关键错误上接近随机，重采样也因模型高度重复而无效。
Method: 低成本开源权重 surrogate 并行读取 agent 的同一上下文、schema 与 proposed action，用一族互补 readout 从自身 log-probabilities 打分：teacher forcing 与 request-PMI 衡量各参数值似然，判别式 verdict 整体裁决该 call，tool-choice competition 与同族函数对比；错误类型未知时用 ensemble。readout 免训练、无需访问 agent 内部，只多一次 prefill。
Result: 困难编码任务 AUROC 0.825，对比 actor 自报置信度 0.598；generative readouts 在另外三个 actor 上高出 +0.07 至 +0.28；对近确定性 actor 相比 self-consistency 高 +0.14 至 +0.19，成本为其 1/K。实时 gate 在 50% coverage 下 accepted-action accuracy 提升 +0.05 至 +0.30；置信度反馈在 live-execution benchmark 上任务成功率提升 +0.119 与 +0.137（p ≤ 1e-4），在 step error 静默处胜过随机值对照 +0.078（p = 0.003）。
Conclusion: 生成式似然定位错误参数值、verdict 抓整体错误 call，二者互补；错误类型未知时 ensemble 是低后悔默认。免训练的 surrogate log-probability 可作为部署 agent 的实时拦截与反馈信号。

papers.title: REACT: Physically and Chemically Consistent Reconstruction of Marine Active Tracers
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing global sea surface pH from sparse observations is critical for monitoring ocean acidification and understanding marine carbon cycling. Traditional assimilation and inverse models are physically grounded but costly for large-scale reconstruction. Recent black-box and physics-guided AI models improve efficiency, but are mainly designed for passive tracers, where the reconstructed variable is also the transported inventory. In contrast, pH is an active carbonate tracer: it is the prediction target, while dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) is the conserved carbon inventory. This mismatch can produce low pH error while violating carbonate closure and source-free carbon conservation. To address this, we introduce \textbf{REACT}, a carbon-first reconstruction framework that decouples transport, active correction, and chemical decoding. REACT transports a latent carbonate state with a conservative advection--diffusion solver, captures non-conservative carbon-cycle variations with a source module, decodes the corrected state into pH, and constrains the output through carbonate equilibrium. This design keeps pH as the target while enforcing consistency on the underlying carbon state. On simulation data, REACT reduces pH NRMSE by (14.7%) and chemical consistency error by (24.0%) over the best baseline. Cross-temporal-scale evaluations show robustness against error accumulation from coarse to fine temporal scales, and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of each component.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REACT 针对海表 pH 这类“活性”碳酸盐示踪物，把守恒输运、非保守源项与化学解码解耦：用保守平流-扩散求解器输运潜在碳酸盐态，源模块吸收碳循环非守恒变化，再经碳酸盐平衡约束解码为 pH。在模拟数据上，相比最优基线 pH NRMSE 降低 14.7%，化学一致性误差降低 24.0%，且从粗到细时间尺度的跨尺度评估中能抵抗误差累积。
Motivation: 传统同化与反演模型物理可靠但大规模重建代价高；现有黑箱与物理引导 AI 主要面向被动示踪物，把被重建变量本身当作被输运存量，用于 pH 时会出现 pH 误差低却违反碳酸盐闭合与无源碳守恒。
Method: REACT 是 carbon-first 重建框架，分三步：以保守平流-扩散求解器输运潜在碳酸盐态，用 source 模块刻画非保守碳循环变化，再把校正后的态解码为 pH，并用碳酸盐平衡 (carbonate equilibrium) 约束输出；同时做消融实验验证各组件作用。
Result: 在模拟数据上，REACT 相比最优基线把 pH NRMSE 降低 14.7%，化学一致性误差 (chemical consistency error) 降低 24.0%；跨时间尺度评估显示从粗到细尺度均能抵抗误差累积，消融研究验证各组件有效。
Conclusion: 把 pH 保持为预测目标、同时在底层碳状态上强制物理化学一致，可以在不牺牲重建精度的前提下满足碳酸盐闭合与碳守恒；该框架面向的是被动示踪物 AI 模型无法保证守恒一致性的场景。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning on the Discrete Composition Channel of a Crystal Generator: Validated Gains and Reward Hacking
papers.abstract_en: Inverse materials design is a long-standing goal of computational materials discovery. Generative models for crystalline materials are typically trained to match the distribution of a structure database, while nothing in their training objective points them at specific design goals such as targeted properties. We use group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) to align a generative model based on stochastic interpolants and discrete flow matching with general black-box reward functions through reinforcement learning. Atom types are generated by a discrete flow and the policy gradient of our generalization of GRPO directly acts on the likelihoods of the atom-type transitions, which differentiates our work from previous reinforcement-learning approaches for diffusion and flow-based generative models of crystalline materials. We introduce a reward function that raises the yield of metastable, unique and novel structures (mSUN) from 13.4% for the pretrained model to 45.5% for the reinforced model, as evaluated by a community benchmark. Our reward also improves the performance of a reinforcement learning framework for crystalline materials based on latent denoising diffusion models. At the same time, we find that directly reinforcing atom-type transition likelihoods enables reward exploitation that has to be prevented with explicit guards. The same analysis also exposes a gap in the community metric. Single-element structures in distinct packings are counted as metastable, unique and novel materials and inflate mSUN without yielding any new compounds. A stability claim is only as good as its reference hull. We report every result split by the number of reference phases behind it and argue that benchmarks should do the same.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Code: https://github.com/paprakash/OMatGRPO. Models and structures: https://huggingface.co/paprakash/OMatGRPO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 GRPO 把晶体生成模型的原子类型离散流 (discrete flow matching) 直接对齐到黑盒奖励，mSUN 产率从预训练模型的 13.4% 提到 45.5%，但同一机制也带来 reward hacking：单元素不同堆垛被算作亚稳、唯一、新结构而虚增 mSUN。作者主张所有结果按参考相数分层报告，因为稳定性结论只和参考 hull 一样可靠。
Motivation: 晶体生成模型的训练目标只匹配结构数据库分布，不指向亚稳、唯一、新颖等具体设计目标，且社区基准的 mSUN 指标可被无新化合物的堆垛差异灌水。
Method: 在基于 stochastic interpolants 与离散流匹配 (discrete flow matching) 的生成模型上用 group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) 做强化学习对齐；原子类型由离散流生成，对 GRPO 的推广使策略梯度直接作用于原子类型转移的似然，奖励函数针对 mSUN，并加显式 guard 抑制奖励套利。
Result: mSUN 产率由预训练模型 13.4% 升至强化后 45.5%（由社区基准评估）；同一奖励也提升了基于 latent denoising diffusion 的晶体材料 RL 框架表现；直接强化原子类型转移似然会引发 reward exploitation，需显式 guard 防范。
Conclusion: 对离散原子类型转移直接做策略梯度能有效对齐设计目标，但必须配 guard；mSUN 会被单元素不同堆垛虚增，稳定性结论只与参考 hull 一样可靠，基准应按参考相数分层报告。

papers.title: Streaming Multi-Track Timeline Control for 3D Human Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-driven human motion generation has advanced substantially, yet most methods assume instructions are available before synthesis. Interactive applications require responding to new instructions while continuing ongoing actions, such as answering a phone while walking. Existing approaches address streaming generation or simultaneous composition without explicitly combining streaming instruction arrival with independently timed, overlapping actions. We introduce streaming multi-track timeline control and propose TimelineControl to incorporate new instructions alongside ongoing actions. Interval-aware conditioning preserves instruction timing, while causal part-structured representations and part-aware denoising coordinate concurrent actions across body regions. We also construct TimelineMotion, a dataset with overlapping instruction intervals and body-part annotations. Experiments on TimelineMotion and MTT demonstrate improved semantic alignment and temporal adherence over evaluated streaming baselines, including models retrained on the same data. Ablations and human evaluations validate our design, complemented by spatial conditioning and humanoid execution demonstrations. Our code, data and models will become publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TimelineControl 把流式到达的文本指令与正在进行的多段动作放进同一条多轨时间线：区间感知条件化保留指令时序，因果的部位结构化表示与部位感知去噪 (part-aware denoising) 协调身体各区域的并发动作。在自建 TimelineMotion 与 MTT 上，语义对齐和时间遵循均优于所评估的流式基线（含同数据重训模型），并给出人形机器人执行演示。
Motivation: 现有文本驱动人体动作生成要么假设指令在合成前全部给定，要么只做流式生成或同时组合，无法处理指令陆续到达且多个动作按各自时间重叠的情形（如边走边接电话）。
Method: 提出流式多轨时间线控制：区间感知条件化 (interval-aware conditioning) 编码指令的起止时间，因果部位结构化表示与部位感知去噪在身体区域间协调并发动作；同时构建带重叠指令区间与身体部位标注的 TimelineMotion 数据集。
Result: 在 TimelineMotion 与 MTT 上，语义对齐与时间遵循优于所评估的流式基线（包括在相同数据上重训的模型）；消融实验与人类评测验证了各设计组件，并附带空间条件化与人形机器人 (humanoid) 执行演示。
Conclusion: 把指令时序与身体部位分解同时纳入流式生成，可以在动作进行中稳定接入新指令并保持并发动作的时间与语义一致；代码、数据与模型将公开。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有文本驱动人体动作生成要么假设指令在合成前全部给定，要么只做流式生成或同时组合，无法处理指令陆续到达且多个动作按各自时间重叠的情形（如边走边接电话）。
summary_sections.method: 提出流式多轨时间线控制：区间感知条件化 (interval-aware conditioning) 编码指令的起止时间，因果部位结构化表示与部位感知去噪在身体区域间协调并发动作；同时构建带重叠指令区间与身体部位标注的 TimelineMotion 数据集。
summary_sections.result: 在 TimelineMotion 与 MTT 上，语义对齐与时间遵循优于所评估的流式基线（包括在相同数据上重训的模型）；消融实验与人类评测验证了各设计组件，并附带空间条件化与人形机器人 (humanoid) 执行演示。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把指令时序与身体部位分解同时纳入流式生成，可以在动作进行中稳定接入新指令并保持并发动作的时间与语义一致；代码、数据与模型将公开。

papers.title: Training Numerical Intelligence via Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are becoming increasingly capable of generating scientific code, but generating code is not the same as improving the algorithms behind it. For numerical solvers, execution feedback can expose poor performance, but rarely reveals its underlying cause and how to address it. We introduce Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery (ADSD), a framework that links numerical diagnosis to reusable solver self-improvement. ADSD follows a diagnosis-first paradigm that first explains why a solver performs poorly, then uses this diagnosis to guide the discovery of appropriate numerical methods. The resulting knowledge is packaged into reusable solver skills, turning solver improvement from trial-and-error editing into a structured process of diagnosis, discovery, and implementation. Across four challenging numerical domains--power flow equation, AC optimal power flow control, stiff ordinary differential equations, and heterogeneous diffusion PDEs--ADSD consistently improves solver accuracy, robustness, and efficiency. On GOC-500 power flow, for example, ADSD reduces mean solver error by nearly $71\times$, with improvements further transferring to unseen grid topologies and operating regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ADSD 采用“先诊断后发现”的范式：先解释数值求解器为何表现差，再据此发现合适的数值方法，并把结果打包成可复用的 solver skill，使求解器改进从试错式改代码变成诊断-发现-实现的结构化流程。在 GOC-500 潮流计算上平均求解误差降低近 71 倍，改进还能迁移到未见过的电网拓扑与运行工况。
Motivation: AI agent 能生成科学计算代码，但生成代码不等于改进算法本身：执行反馈只暴露性能差，很少指出原因与对症的修法，数值求解器改进因此停留在试错式编辑。
Method: ADSD 框架分三步：诊断阶段解释求解器表现差的成因，用该诊断引导发现合适的数值方法，再把所得知识封装为可复用的 solver skill；在四个数值领域上应用该流程——power flow equation、AC optimal power flow control、stiff ODE、heterogeneous diffusion PDE。
Result: 在四个数值领域上 ADSD 一致提升求解器精度、鲁棒性与效率；GOC-500 power flow 上平均求解误差降低近 71 倍，且改进迁移到未见过的电网拓扑与运行工况。
Conclusion: 把数值诊断置于方法发现之前并把知识固化为可复用 skill，可让求解器自我改进成为结构化过程，而非试错式代码编辑。

papers.title: GOTT: Object-centric Dexterous Manipulation with a Reusable Cross-Embodiment Primitive
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models and large-scale human data provide rich sources of manipulation intent, but translating this intent into multi-fingered robot behavior remains difficult. Dexterous hands still lack a reusable low-level primitive that reliably establishes contact across tasks and embodiments. We propose GOTT, a reach-acquire-move framework built around a single cross-embodiment contact-acquisition primitive. Given a robot-agnostic object trajectory and a reach specification, GOTT first brings the hand near a task-relevant contact region. The shared closed-loop primitive then establishes stable contact from this approximate initialization, and a pose-conditioned controller tracks the desired object motion. Reach specifications may come from future-aware planning, external models, or human demonstrations, while the primitive and tracking backend remain unchanged. Simulation and real-world experiments show that GOTT is able to establish robust contact across diverse objects, arm-hand platforms, and seen and unseen hand morphologies. It also consistently improves end-to-end task success over open-loop grasp execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GOTT 把灵巧操作拆成 reach-acquire-move 三段，核心是一个跨具身 (cross-embodiment) 的接触获取原语：给定机器人无关的物体轨迹与 reach 规格，先把手移到任务相关接触区附近，再由共享的闭环原语从该近似初值建立稳定接触，最后由 pose-conditioned 控制器跟踪物体运动。仿真与真机实验显示它能在多样物体、臂-手平台以及见过与未见过的手形态上稳健建立接触，并一致提升端到端任务成功率（相对开环抓取执行）。
Motivation: 基础模型与大规模人类数据富含操作意图，但缺少一个跨任务、跨具身可复用的底层原语来可靠建立多指接触，导致意图难以转化为机器人手指行为。
Method: reach-acquire-move 框架：输入机器人无关的物体轨迹与 reach 规格（可来自 future-aware planning、外部模型或人类示教），先将手移至任务相关接触区域，再由共享的闭环接触获取原语从近似初始化建立稳定接触，最后用 pose-conditioned 控制器跟踪期望物体运动；原语与跟踪后端在不同 reach 来源下保持不变。
Result: 仿真与真机实验中，GOTT 在多样物体、不同 arm-hand 平台以及 seen 与 unseen 手形态上均能稳健建立接触，并在端到端任务成功率上一致优于开环抓取执行 (open-loop grasp execution)。
Conclusion: 一个跨具身的闭环接触获取原语加上位姿条件跟踪后端，可以在 reach 来源任意替换的情况下保持不变并提升灵巧操作成功率。

papers.title: Retrieval-Centric Deep Learning in Growing Nonparametric Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We investigate a general-purpose layer for deep learning that, instead of compressing arbitrary-size training data into fixed-size weight matrices, stores a new pair of key-value representations for every data point during training, and retrieves and recombines these representations through an attention mechanism at inference time - resulting in a growing neural net (NN). While Irie et al. (arXiv:2202.05798) have put forward this perspective from the classic duality expressing any linear layer in a deep NN trained by gradient descent as linear attention (LA) over the training data points, replacing LA by more powerful attention functions, as they suggest, turns out to be non-trivial: we show that naively applying learning rules from the LA case to advanced kernels does not lead to principled optimization. Here we fill this gap and develop functional gradient-based learning rules for kernelized attention layers, based on radial basis function (RBF) and softmax-like kernels - establishing the principled "retrieval-centric deep learning" (RCDL) paradigm. Empirically, we demonstrate the promising performance and learning-efficiency of RCDL on image classification and synthetic teacher-student learning tasks. Moreover, we show that replacing LA in the dual form of NNs by advanced LA variants, namely MesaNet/DeltaNet, yields a formal connection to recently proposed optimizers for conventional fixed-size NNs, offering a novel perspective on deep learning optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出检索中心深度学习 (RCDL)：训练时不把数据压进固定权重，而是为每个样本存一对 key-value，推理时用注意力检索重组。作者证明把线性注意力 (LA) 的学习规则直接搬到 RBF/softmax 核上得不到有原则的优化，进而给出基于函数梯度的学习规则，并在图像分类与合成 teacher-student 任务上展示性能与学习效率。
Motivation: Irie 等人从线性层与对训练数据的线性注意力这一对偶关系提出让网络随数据增长，但把 LA 换成更强的核注意力并非平凡：直接套用 LA 的学习规则无法得到有原则的优化。
Method: 为 RBF 核与 softmax 类核的注意力层推导基于函数梯度 (functional gradient) 的学习规则，构成 RCDL 范式；同时把 NN 对偶形式中的 LA 替换为 MesaNet/DeltaNet 等高级 LA 变体，与面向固定尺寸网络的近期优化器建立形式联系。
Result: 在图像分类与合成 teacher-student 学习任务上展示了 RCDL 的性能与学习效率；并证明直接套用 LA 学习规则于高级核不会产生有原则的优化。
Conclusion: 把线性注意力的对偶视角推广到更强的核需要新的函数梯度学习规则，由此确立检索中心深度学习这一范式，并为深度优化提供与 MesaNet/DeltaNet 相连的新视角。

papers.title: Beware EviLLM: Enabling Vulnerability Injection via Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled AI-driven code generation from natural language specifications, introducing new attack surfaces for injecting vulnerabilities into software. Prior work has studied this problem only in benign settings where vulnerabilities are introduced inadvertently, or under unconventional threat models where the LLM itself is malicious (backdooring) or the user is the attacker (jailbreaking). In this paper, we study a more realistic threat model: a third-party adversary, with capabilities comparable to existing cybercriminals, compromises the AI code generation pipeline to deliberately introduce vulnerabilities. We call this the EviLLM attack. We have implemented two instances of EviLLM, each of which only requires the underlying LLM to be accessed through a compromised account or browser, and can inject vulnerabilities from 13 CWE classes. As we show in our feasibility study, both attack vectors are already used to implement many existing cyberattacks. Our user study shows that 7 out of 8 and 10 out of 13 participants did not notice the vulnerabilities injected by the two instances of EviLLM, and 13 out of 21 participants "rarely" or "never" considered the risk of an attack like EviLLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EviLLM 攻击：第三方攻击者以接近现有网络犯罪者的能力入侵 AI 代码生成管线，通过被攻陷的账号或浏览器即可向 LLM 生成的代码注入 13 个 CWE 类别的漏洞。可行性研究显示两种攻击向量已被用于实施多种现有网络攻击；用户研究中 8 人里 7 人、13 人里 10 人未察觉注入的漏洞，21 人中 13 人表示很少或从不考虑此类攻击风险。
Motivation: 现有工作只覆盖良性场景下的无意漏洞，或 LLM 本身被后门、用户越狱等非常规威胁模型；现实中第三方攻击者污染代码生成管线的威胁尚无对应模型。
Method: 定义 EviLLM 威胁模型并实现两个实例，仅需通过被攻陷的账号或浏览器访问底层 LLM 即可注入漏洞，覆盖 13 个 CWE 类别；辅以可行性研究与用户研究。
Result: 两种攻击向量已被用于实施许多现有网络攻击（可行性研究）；用户研究中 8 名参与者有 7 人、13 名参与者有 10 人未注意到 EviLLM 注入的漏洞，21 名参与者中 13 人表示很少或从不考虑 EviLLM 类攻击风险。
Conclusion: 第三方污染 AI 代码生成管线是现实可行的漏洞注入路径，且用户对这类攻击的察觉率与风险意识都很低。
