papers.title: BAT-NO: A Boundary-Condition-Aware Transformer Neural Operator for Crashworthiness Prediction of Vehicle Components
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity finite-element simulations provide accurate crashworthiness predictions, but their cost limits iterative design exploration. Deep learning surrogates can reduce this cost, but many component-level models are developed under a single prescribed boundary condition, limiting generalisation to boundary variations. This work proposes a Boundary-Condition-Aware Transformer Neural Operator (BAT-NO) for autoregressive prediction of transient displacement fields and scalar crashworthiness responses under variations in geometry and boundary conditions. A B-pillar simulation framework evaluates generalisation across variations in geometry, impact position and velocity, and support stiffness. BAT-NO combines recurrent mesh processing with latent-grid Fourier operator processing. Boundary-condition information is transferred to the latent grid through a hybrid local--global mechanism. Slice-based attention models interactions among physically related regions, while direct boundary-to-grid projection preserves local spatial structure. Across the validation sets for the shape-only, shape-and-loading, and shape-loading-boundary cases, BAT-NO achieves the lowest mean final-step mean nodal Euclidean displacement error among the evaluated baselines. In the most challenging case, it reduces the mean error by 32.6% relative to the second-best model. Hyperparameter tuning reduces the validation error from 0.451 to 0.269 mm, with a comparable error of 0.267 mm on 300 unseen test simulations sampled within the investigated design space. An attention-based scalar decoder jointly predicts six response trajectories with a mean relative error of 2.46%. Most derived crashworthiness indicators have median errors below 3%. These results show that explicit local and global boundary-condition representations improve crashworthiness prediction over expanded component-level design spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出边界条件感知的 Transformer 神经算子 BAT-NO，用循环网格处理加潜网格 Fourier 算子、混合局部-全局边界条件投影与切片注意力，自回归预测车辆部件在几何与边界条件变化下的瞬态位移场和碰撞安全响应。在 B-pillar 仿真框架上，最难的 shape-loading-boundary 案例平均末步节点位移误差较次优模型降低 32.6%，超参调优把验证误差从 0.451 mm 降到 0.269 mm。
Motivation: 高保真有限元碰撞仿真精度高但成本大，难以支撑迭代设计探索；现有部件级深度学习代理多在单一给定边界条件下开发，几何与边界一变就难以泛化。
Method: BAT-NO 结合循环网格处理与潜网格 Fourier 算子处理，通过混合局部-全局机制把边界条件信息传到潜网格，用切片注意力 (slice-based attention) 建模物理相关区域间的交互，并以直接边界到网格投影保留局部空间结构；标量解码器用注意力联合预测六条响应轨迹。评估用 B-pillar 仿真框架，覆盖几何、撞击位置与速度、支撑刚度的变化。
Result: 在 shape-only、shape-and-loading、shape-loading-boundary 三组验证集上，BAT-NO 的平均末步节点欧氏位移误差在所有被评基线中最低；最难案例较次优模型降低 32.6%。超参调优使验证误差从 0.451 mm 降至 0.269 mm，在设计空间内 300 个未见测试仿真上误差 0.267 mm。注意力标量解码器联合预测六条响应轨迹，平均相对误差 2.46%，多数派生碰撞安全指标中位误差低于 3%。
Conclusion: 显式的局部与全局边界条件表示能在扩大的部件级设计空间上改进碰撞安全预测，使代理模型跨几何与边界变化泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Probability flow ODEs in score-based and reflected diffusion models
papers.abstract_en: Probability-flow ordinary differential equations (PF-ODEs) are widely used as deterministic samplers for score-based diffusion models. Their usual justification is that the Fokker--Planck equation of a diffusion can be rewritten as a continuity equation driven by the score function of the forward diffusion. This identity does not, however, guarantee that the resulting velocity field generates a well-posed flow. We provide theoretical insights into the design of such deterministic samplers for generative models based on diffusions and reflected diffusions. We identify sufficient conditions for a regular Lagrangian PF-ODE flow to exist; reverse sampling and invertibility require two-sided divergence control. For learned scores, sampler stability is controlled by an unweighted velocity error, exposing a mismatch with density-weighted score matching and motivating architectural control of Jacobians, divergence, growth, and compression. Under the manifold hypothesis, positive-time regularization justifies an early-stopped PF-ODE while constants deteriorate near the data endpoint; an explicit sphere example shows that the exact deterministic flow becomes singular as the noise level vanishes even though the diffusion marginals remain well defined. These theoretical insights translate into concrete design principles for stable, invertible, and constraint-preserving diffusion samplers. We illustrate the practical relevance of these design principles using controlled numerical experiments.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出 score-based 扩散模型常用的 probability-flow ODE (PF-ODE) 作为确定性采样器，其 Fokker–Planck 恒等式并不能保证速度场生成适定流；给出正则 Lagrangian PF-ODE 流存在的充分条件，要求双向散度控制以保证可逆与反向采样。在流形假设下正时间正则化支持 early-stopped PF-ODE，而显式球面例子显示噪声水平趋零时精确确定性流会奇异，尽管扩散边缘分布仍良定义。
Motivation: score-based 与 reflected diffusion 的确定性采样器缺少适定性保证：Fokker–Planck 改写为连续性方程并不保证速度场生成良定义的流，可逆性与稳定性条件不明。
Method: 从 Fokker–Planck 连续性方程出发推导正则 Lagrangian PF-ODE 流存在的充分条件，要求双向散度控制；分析学习 score 下由未加权速度误差控制的采样器稳定性，指出其与 density-weighted score matching 的错配，并据此提出对 Jacobian、散度、增长与压缩的架构控制；在流形假设下讨论正时间正则化与 early-stopped PF-ODE，并构造显式球面例子。
Result: 反向采样与可逆性需要双向散度控制；学习 score 时采样器稳定性由未加权速度误差控制，与 density-weighted score matching 存在错配；流形假设下常数在数据端点附近恶化，显式球面例子显示噪声水平趋零时精确确定性流变奇异，而扩散边缘分布仍良定义；用受控数值实验说明这些设计原则的实际相关性。
Conclusion: PF-ODE 采样器的稳定性、可逆性与约束保持需要显式控制 Jacobian、散度、增长与压缩，且在数据端点附近应采用 early-stopped PF-ODE 而非依赖精确确定性流。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: KVE-KD: Key Visual Evidence-Guided Knowledge Distillation for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation is crucial for deploying vision-language models on resource-constrained devices. However, existing methods typically impose uniform supervision across visual tokens or rely on static token selection, which confuses task-relevant cues with background noise and degrades cross-modal reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Key Visual Evidence-guided Knowledge Distillation (KVE-KD), a framework that dynamically focuses feature distillation on task-relevant visual tokens identified by the teacher model. Specifically, KVE-KD appoints the final pre-generation textual token as a unified semantic anchor and identifies the target cross-modal fusion layer by analyzing changes in the anchor representation through iterative visual-token contribution removal. Within this layer, KVE-KD ranks visual tokens via the anchor-conditioned attention distribution and selects the most informative visual tokens as key visual evidence with normalized entropy. The key visual evidence subsequently guides focused visual feature distillation, making the student align closely with the teacher's task-relevant visual representations while suppressing irrelevant background information. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that KVE-KD outperforms state-of-the-art cross-modal distillation methods, with particularly pronounced gains on tasks requiring complex reasoning and fine-grained visual understanding. Importantly, these improvements are achieved without introducing any inference-time overhead. The source code is available at https://github.com/zhangjianbin07/KVE-KD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KVE-KD 用教师模型选出的关键视觉证据 (key visual evidence) 引导视觉特征蒸馏：以生成前最后一个文本 token 为语义锚点，通过迭代移除视觉 token 观察锚点表征变化定位跨模态融合层，再按锚点条件注意力分布与归一化熵排序选 token。在六个 benchmark 上超过 SOTA 跨模态蒸馏方法，复杂推理与细粒度视觉理解任务提升最明显，且不引入推理时开销。
Motivation: 面向资源受限设备部署 vision-language model，现有蒸馏方法对视觉 token 施加均匀监督或依赖静态选择，把任务相关线索与背景噪声混在一起，损害跨模态推理。
Method: KVE-KD 框架：把最终预生成文本 token 作为统一语义锚点，通过迭代移除视觉 token 并分析锚点表征变化来定位目标跨模态融合层；在该层用锚点条件化的注意力分布对视觉 token 排序，以归一化熵选出信息量最大的关键视觉证据，再据此聚焦视觉特征蒸馏，抑制无关背景。
Result: 在六个 benchmark 上超过 SOTA 跨模态蒸馏方法，在需要复杂推理与细粒度视觉理解的任务上提升尤其明显；改进不引入任何推理时开销。
Conclusion: 把蒸馏监督集中到教师认定的任务相关视觉 token 上，比均匀或静态 token 监督更能保住跨模态推理能力，且部署时零额外开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SYNLAT: Syntax-Aligned Text-Latent Compression for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Long chain-of-thought (CoT) traces impose substantial output-token costs. Under constrained budgets, compression must preserve answer-critical information, making boundary placement central. Token-level and fixed-length boundaries can fragment coherent spans such as phrases, formulas, and local derivations, whereas step-level boundaries can bind content requiring different compression actions. We introduce SynLat, a text-latent CoT framework that aligns compression boundaries with syntactic structure through non-overlapping Syntax-Aligned Units (SAUs). An answer-conditioned Teacher constructs progressive KEEP/LATENT targets for a single compression-conditioned Student, which generates mixed reasoning from only the question and requested compression level at inference. Across two Qwen3 Student scales, Standard-CoT and Long-CoT groups, and three compression levels, SynLat matches or exceeds the strongest evaluated baseline in all 12 task-group aggregates and strictly leads in 11 under the reported achieved-CR selection protocol. Overall gains reach 3.6/2.6 points at MEDIUM and 7.0/5.5 points at HIGH for Qwen3-8B/14B, with larger advantages under stronger compression, particularly on Long-CoT groups.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SYNLAT 用非重叠的语法对齐单元 (Syntax-Aligned Units, SAUs) 划分 CoT 压缩边界，避免 token 级或固定长度切分截断短语、公式与局部推导。在 Qwen3-8B/14B Student、Standard-CoT 与 Long-CoT 两组、三档压缩比下，12 个任务组聚合中 11 个严格领先最强基线，MEDIUM/HIGH 档整体增益 3.6/2.6 与 7.0/5.5 分，压缩越强优势越大。
Motivation: 长 CoT 输出 token 成本高，受限预算下压缩必须保住答案关键信息；token 级与固定长度边界会切断连贯片段，步级边界又会把需要不同压缩动作的内容绑在一起。
Method: SynLat 是 text-latent CoT 框架：以 SAUs 对齐压缩边界，answer-conditioned Teacher 生成渐进 KEEP/LATENT 目标，训练单一 compression-conditioned Student，推理时仅凭问题与目标压缩档位直接产生混合推理。
Result: 在两个 Qwen3 Student 规模 (8B/14B)、Standard-CoT 与 Long-CoT 分组、三档压缩比共 12 个任务组聚合上，按 achieved-CR 选择协议全部持平或超过最强基线，其中 11 个严格领先；整体增益 MEDIUM 档 3.6/2.6 分、HIGH 档 7.0/5.5 分 (Qwen3-8B/14B)，Long-CoT 组优势更明显。
Conclusion: 把压缩边界对齐到语法结构能在强压缩档位更有效地保住答案关键信息，且单一 Student 即可在推理时按请求的压缩档位自适应生成。

papers.title: LLM-enhanced spatio-temporal learning for grid-level docked bike sharing demand prediction
papers.abstract_en: Short-term bike-sharing demand forecasting is complicated by spatial-temporal non-stationarity and the practical difficulty of incorporating unstructured external text into numerical pipelines. Conventional approaches rely on historical flow sequences and fixed graph structures, thereby constraining their accuracy when anomalous social events perturb normal travel patterns. We propose a forecasting framework in which a Large Language Model (LLM) drives a semantic shockwave mechanism that converts free-form urban text, such as municipal event schedules, local news, and transit bulletins, into quantified spatial-temporal perturbation fields. The LLM extracts three physically interpretable parameters per event (intensity, spatial reach, and temporal lag), from which Gaussian decay fields are constructed and injected into a Zero-Inflated Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network (ZI-ASTGCN). To handle the pronounced sparsity of grid-level measurements, the model couples a dual-branch output head with a multi-task zero-inflated loss that jointly trains a gating probability and a conditional flow intensity. Experiments on the operational Barcelona Bicing dataset show that ZI-ASTGCN outperforms established neural baselines, with particularly strong gains during high-demand periods, validating the utility of physics-grounded semantic signals in spatial-temporal mobility forecasting.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE 29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LLM 驱动的语义冲击波机制：把城市自由文本（活动日程、本地新闻、公交通告）转成每个事件三个可解释参数（强度、空间作用范围、时间滞后），构造高斯衰减扰动场注入 Zero-Inflated Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network (ZI-ASTGCN)，用于网格级共享单车需求预测。在 Barcelona Bicing 运营数据上超过既有神经基线，高需求时段增益尤其明显。
Motivation: 共享单车网格级需求稀疏且时空非平稳，异常社会事件会打乱常规出行模式，而传统方法只用历史流量序列和固定图结构，难以把非结构化外部文本纳入数值预测流程。
Method: LLM 从自由文本中抽取每个事件的强度、空间作用范围、时间滞后三个参数，生成高斯衰减扰动场并注入 ZI-ASTGCN；针对网格级稀疏观测，用双分支输出头配合多任务零膨胀损失 (multi-task zero-inflated loss)，联合训练门控概率与条件流量强度。
Result: 在运营中的 Barcelona Bicing 数据集上，ZI-ASTGCN 超过既有神经基线，在高需求时段增益尤其明显；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把物理可解释的语义信号注入零膨胀时空图网络，能提升时空移动需求预测，尤其在需求高峰、事件扰动强的时段。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Distribution Matching Evolutionary Algorithms for Rare Event Sampling
papers.abstract_en: A novel discovery is one which is both useful and surprising: a generative model's output is a useful discovery if it has a low probability of being generated (it's surprising) and a high reward (it's useful). Global optimization can directly increase the probability of sampling high rewards but typically requires updating model weights. Such gradient based optimization is expensive and bars using capable closed-source models. Instead, modern search methods for discovery sacrifice the global target, and use evolutionary algorithms with local reward maximizing objectives, permitting the search to focus only on high probability samples. In this paper, we interpret various evolutionary algorithms as approximate Markov Chain Monte Carlo, an optimization-free method to sample from complex distributions. This interpretation allows developing Distribution Matching Evolutionary Algorithms (DME), a class of search methods which sample from a global target distribution without updating weights. Empirically, DME has a higher sample efficiency than existing methods on problems requiring many samples to find a solution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把各类进化算法 (evolutionary algorithms) 解释为近似 MCMC，据此提出 Distribution Matching Evolutionary Algorithms (DME)：不更新模型权重、直接从全局目标分布采样，用于「既意外又有用」的罕见事件发现 (rare event sampling)。在需要大量采样才能找到解的问题上，DME 的样本效率高于现有方法。
Motivation: 全局优化能提高采到高奖励样本的概率，但通常要更新模型权重，代价高且无法用于闭源模型；现有搜索方法则放弃全局目标、只用局部奖励最大化，把搜索限制在高概率样本上。
Method: 将多种进化算法重新解释为近似 MCMC（一种无需优化即可从复杂分布采样的方法），并由此构造 DME 类搜索方法：在不更新权重的前提下从全局目标分布采样，奖励定义为输出的有用性（高 reward）与意外性（低生成概率）。
Result: 在需要大量采样才能找到解的问题上，DME 的样本效率 (sample efficiency) 高于现有方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把进化搜索看作近似 MCMC，可以在不微调权重的前提下保留全局目标分布，从而在多采样型发现任务上比局部奖励驱动的搜索更省样本。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Where Does Jagged Competence Come From?
papers.abstract_en: Capable systems often show jagged competence: low average error alongside failures on particular inputs. We ask where it comes from in a task built from two known layers. A lower layer A computes five per-slot sums from records; an upper layer B uses the slot-1 sum and a mode carried over from earlier boards to predict the next board's category, so B cannot be computed from the current A alone: B is a strict extension of A. We train small recurrent networks on B and measure, against exact ground truth, what they acquire of A. The central finding is that learning B gives the network a jagged version of A, measured through probe readability and supervised outputs. It is readable where B needs it (slot 1, 97-98% by a linear probe) and becomes less readable where B does not (the other slots, 5-10%); category misreads concentrate near the slot-1 cutoffs; and when A is trained explicitly it comes out only approximately right. The networks show jagged competence in B: natural KL below $3\times10^{-4}$ bits coexists with a maximum law TV of about 0.25 on constructed histories. Matched experiments show that even a good A is not enough: connecting a learned A to B cuts misreads 1.3 to 17-fold, the same exact A gives fewer misreads as one-hot inputs (0-2) than as numerical inputs (10-317), one B update makes an exact A inexact unless the B gradient is blocked, and exact A still leaves some B failures. In this task, uneven acquisition, access and preservation of the lower theory explain part of the jagged competence of a network that learns the theory built on it; some failures remain unexplained. Whether the same holds in larger systems is a test to run.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在一个人工构造的两层任务上，网络学上层 B 时只获得下层 A 的锯齿版本：B 需要的 slot-1 可被线性探针读出 97–98%，其余 slot 仅 5–10%。B 的自然 KL 低于 3×10⁻⁴ bits 时，构造历史上的最大 law TV 仍约 0.25；把学好的 A 接到 B 上可让误读降 1.3–17 倍，但精确 A 仍留有 B 失败。
Motivation: 能力强的模型常在特定输入上失败而平均误差很低（jagged competence），但其来源缺少在可控、可精确对照的任务上被拆解的机制解释。
Method: 构造两层任务：下层 A 对记录做五个 per-slot 求和，上层 B 用 slot-1 求和与跨板延续的 mode 预测下一板类别，使 B 严格扩展 A、无法由当前 A 单独算出。训练小型循环网络学 B，用线性探针与监督输出对照精确 ground truth 度量 A 的获得程度，并做匹配实验比较接入学得的 A、one-hot 与数值输入、以及阻断 B 梯度等条件。
Result: 线性探针读出 slot-1 达 97–98%，其余 slot 仅 5–10%；类别误读集中在 slot-1 阈值附近；显式训练 A 只得到近似正确。B 的自然 KL 低于 3×10⁻⁴ bits 与构造历史上最大 law TV 约 0.25 并存。接入学得的 A 使误读降 1.3–17 倍；同一精确 A 下 one-hot 输入误读 0–2、数值输入 10–317；一次 B 更新会使精确 A 失准，除非阻断 B 梯度；精确 A 仍留下部分 B 失败。
Conclusion: 下层理论的不均匀获得、可访问性与保持共同解释了锯齿能力的一部分，仍有失败无法解释；是否适用于更大系统是待做的检验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Memory-State Critic for Asymmetric Actor-Critic with Application to Vision-Based Pursuit-Evasion
papers.abstract_en: In partially observable Markov decision processes, the optimal policy generally depends on the history of observations and past actions. Asymmetric actor-critic methods have become popular to learn such policies when additional information, such as the true state of the environment, is available during training. The critic, which is not needed at execution, is given access to the state. A critic conditioned on the state alone is generally ill-defined and yields biased policy gradients. Conditioning on the state and the history, the history-state critic restores both. In this paper, we show that conditioning the critic on the state and the policy's own memory, i.e., the internal representation of the history through which the policy selects its actions, is already well-defined and gives unbiased policy gradients, removing the need for a second recurrent approximator of the history. We call it the memory state critic. It follows that a critic based on the policy's memory need not backpropagate its loss into that memory, even though the memory is a lossy encoding of the history. We evaluate the memory-state critic in a vision-based pursuit-evasion environment between two quadrotors across two arena types. The pursuer is the learning agent, and the evader is sampled per episode from a fixed pool of heuristic behaviours. The results show that the memory-state critic outperforms the history-state critic and converges faster. In addition to being unbiased compared to the state-only critic, it maintains a slight edge in the wall arena, where the actor's history carries information that the privileged state alone does not.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 19th European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning (EWRL 2026), Lille, France. Non-archival workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在部分可观测 MDP 的非对称 actor-critic 中，把 critic 条件在特权状态加策略自身记忆 (memory state) 上，即足以得到无偏策略梯度，无需再为历史训练第二个循环逼近器。在双四旋翼视觉追逃（两种场地、逃逸者从固定启发式行为池按 episode 采样）中，该 memory-state critic 优于 history-state critic 且收敛更快，并在 wall 场地保持对 state-only critic 的小幅优势。
Motivation: 非对称 actor-critic 训练期可访问真实状态，但只用状态做 critic 是 ill-defined 的、会给策略梯度带来偏差；改用状态加历史的 history-state critic 虽恢复无偏，却要额外维护一个循环的历史逼近器。
Method: 提出 memory-state critic：critic 只条件在特权状态与策略选动作所用的内部记忆 (memory state) 上，证明这已 well-defined 且梯度无偏，因此不必把 critic 损失反传回该记忆，也不必再建第二个历史循环逼近器；在视觉追逃环境中评测，追捕者为学习智能体，逃逸者按 episode 从固定启发式行为池采样。
Result: 在两种场地的双四旋翼视觉追逃中，memory-state critic 表现超过 history-state critic 且收敛更快；相对 state-only critic 无偏，并在 wall 场地保持小幅优势，因为该场地下 actor 的历史携带了特权状态本身没有的信息。
Conclusion: critic 条件在状态加策略记忆上即可同时拿到无偏梯度与更少的循环结构开销，记忆虽是有损编码也不必由 critic 损失反传训练。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OncoNoteBERT: A Foundation Representation Model for Natural Language Processing of Real-World Outpatient Oncology Notes
papers.abstract_en: Real-world outpatient oncology notes contain specialised terminology, tumour staging expressions, treatment names, toxicity descriptions, and institution-specific de-identification markers that may not be represented efficiently by general biomedical or adjacent clinical language models. We developed and evaluated oncology-specific BERT-style encoders using a governed UK outpatient oncology corpus comprising 290,026 notes from 21,564 patients treated for lung and head-and-neck cancer. We compared RadBERT and PathologyBERT with two local strategies: OncoNote-RadBERT, produced by continued masked language model pretraining, and OncoNoteBERT, trained from scratch with an oncology WordPiece tokenizer. Models were evaluated using masked language modelling loss and perplexity on the validation set, tokenizer fragmentation metrics, clinical term tokenisation, masked-token probes, and exploratory representation analysis. Both external encoders fit the oncology corpus poorly in zero-shot evaluation (perplexity 113.04 for RadBERT; 2035.03 for PathologyBERT), while continued pretraining produced the strongest fit (2.10 for OncoNote-RadBERT). OncoNoteBERT achieved perplexity 2.83 but produced the most efficient tokenisation, with lower subword fertility and shorter normalised sequence length. It also returned a clinically acceptable prediction for 12 of 13 masked-token probes, compared with 7 of 13 for OncoNote-RadBERT. This divergence between corpus-level fit and masked-token performance was partly attributable to tokenizer fragmentation rather than learned semantics alone. Both locally developed models represented the institutional placeholder as a single learnable token. These findings show that continued adaptation and bespoke tokenisation provide complementary benefits, and that representation-layer design matters before adjacent-domain encoders are applied to oncology NLP.
papers.comment: Accepted at the AI at Scale for Clinical Impact (ASCI): Cancer Pathology Foundation Models Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 290,026 份英国门诊肿瘤笔记上，通用生物医学编码器零样本困惑度极高（RadBERT 113.04、PathologyBERT 2035.03），继续预训练的 OncoNote-RadBERT 语料拟合最好（2.10），而从零训练、配肿瘤 WordPiece 分词器的 OncoNoteBERT 困惑度 2.83 但分词最高效，且掩码探针 13 题中答对 12 题（OncoNote-RadBERT 仅 7 题）。结论是语料级拟合与掩码词元表现会因分词碎片化而背离，继续适配与定制分词是互补收益。
Motivation: 门诊肿瘤笔记含分期、疗法、毒性描述与机构去标识占位符，通用生物医学或相邻临床编码器无法高效表示这些术语，直接套用前需要先解决表示层设计问题。
Method: 在受治理的英国门诊肿瘤语料（290,026 份笔记、21,564 名肺癌与头颈癌患者）上训练 BERT 式编码器：以 RadBERT、PathologyBERT 作零样本外部基线，本地两条路线为继续掩码语言模型预训练得到的 OncoNote-RadBERT，以及用肿瘤 WordPiece 分词器从零训练的 OncoNoteBERT；评测用验证集 MLM loss 与困惑度、分词碎片化指标、临床术语分词、掩码词元探针和表示分析。
Result: 零样本困惑度 RadBERT 113.04、PathologyBERT 2035.03；OncoNote-RadBERT 困惑度 2.10 为最强语料拟合，OncoNoteBERT 2.83 但子词 fertility 更低、归一化序列更短、分词最高效；掩码词元探针 OncoNoteBERT 13 题中 12 题给出临床可接受预测，OncoNote-RadBERT 为 7/13；两个本地模型都把机构占位符表示为单个可学习 token。
Conclusion: 继续适配与定制分词带来互补收益，语料级拟合与掩码词元表现的背离部分源于分词碎片化而非语义本身，因此在把相邻领域编码器用于肿瘤 NLP 之前应先做表示层设计。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Score Is Not the Structure: Brain Alignment and Cross-Lingual Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Researchers often support the claim that a model shares structure with the brain, or across languages, by reporting a similarity score. We ask what such a score reads when the shared structure is absent, or when the tool that measures it does not work. We check two settings, and in both the score is not what it appears. First, a probe trained to tell grammatical from ungrammatical sentences in one language transfers worse to more distant languages, the usual evidence for shared structure. But the probe itself gets worse along the same axis: in four of seventeen languages it performs at chance, so 64 of 272 language pairs are scored with a tool that does not work. Dropping those languages halves the strength of the relationship, but they are also the most distant, and this design cannot separate the two effects. Counting matters too: the same data give p = 0.0006 when the 272 pairs are treated as independent and p = 0.155 when the seventeen languages are, which is the correct unit. Second, training a language model to match human brain responses raises its similarity score from 0.10 to 0.34, against a ceiling of 0.54. A model trained on a target whose correspondence to the brain was destroyed still scores 0.31, so only 0.028 to 0.068 of the rise is specific to the brain. With no model at all, a destroyed target already sits at 0.204 from the real one, a floor that tracks the target's rank divided by the number of sentences. Finally, steering a language along its own direction works (+6.2 over a random direction in sixteen of seventeen languages) yet shows no effect that varies with language distance. Before asking whether a correspondence helps, ask how much of the score would survive without it.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 - Linguistic Principles for Foundation Models (LP4FM). Code: https://github.com/saman-rahbar/score-is-not-the-structure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出用单一相似度分数支撑「模型与大脑或跨语言共享结构」的论证会失真：探针本身在最远的 4/17 种语言上退化到随机水平，使 272 个语言对中的 64 对由失效工具打分；把 17 种语言而非 272 对当作独立单元，p 从 0.0006 变成 0.155。大脑对齐把分数从 0.10 抬到 0.34（上限 0.54），但对已被破坏对应关系的目标训练仍得 0.31，只有 0.028–0.068 的升幅是大脑特异的。
Motivation: 跨语言迁移衰减被当作共享结构的证据，但测量工具本身沿同一轴退化，两种效应在该设计下无法分离；脑对齐分数的升幅也未扣除非大脑特异的基线。
Method: 两个检验设置：其一用语法/非语法判别探针在 17 种语言、272 个语言对上考察迁移与探针自身表现，并比较把语言对还是语言当独立单元的 p 值；其二训练语言模型匹配人类脑反应，用被破坏对应关系的目标与无模型情形构造地板，并比较沿语言自身方向与随机方向的 steering。
Result: 探针在 17 种语言中的 4 种上表现等于随机，272 对中 64 对由失效工具打分；剔除这些语言后关系强度减半。272 对独立时 p = 0.0006，17 种语言独立时 p = 0.155。脑对齐使相似度 0.10 → 0.34，上限 0.54；破坏目标上仍得 0.31，仅 0.028–0.068 的升幅为大脑特异；无模型时破坏目标已距真实目标 0.204，该地板随目标 rank 除以句子数变化。沿语言自身方向 steering 比随机方向高 +6.2，在 17 种语言中的 16 种成立，但效应不随语言距离变化。
Conclusion: 相似度分数在共享结构缺失或测量工具失效时仍会给出看似支持性的数值；判断对应关系是否有用之前，应先估计没有该对应关系时分数还剩多少。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Are We Measuring Anticipation? Auditing Privileged Information in Procedural Video Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Benchmark scores license claims about the capabilities being evaluated. We audit the inference licensed by an evaluation protocol, rather than the predictive model alone. Using procedural action anticipation as a controlled case study, we study a broader evaluation-validity failure mode: a protocol can remain temporally causal and free of classical target leakage while still supplying a privileged intermediate representation. The failure is not merely optimistic accuracy, but a mismatch between the capability claimed and the construct actually measured. On Breakfast, matched recognizer-history and GT-history regimes score 30.3% and 62.3% (Delta_PH(R_BA) = +32.0, 95% Student-t interval [+24.1, +39.8]). A fixed-checkpoint 2 x 2 intervention isolates a +14.6-point test-time oracle contrast; a matched no-video provenance probe yields a +26.8-point gap; and a boundary-independent query/history control retains a +19.4-point gap. We refer to this discrepancy as a privileged-information gap, defined relative to a specified non-oracle recovery pipeline, and propose a reusable four-condition audit. Across five evaluation settings the gap is heterogeneous; a standard 50 Salads long-term-anticipation re-implementation provides cautious support beyond the audit-specific next-action construction.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 6 figures. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文审计的是评测协议本身而非模型：以程序性动作预期 (procedural action anticipation) 为受控案例，指出协议即使时间因果、无经典目标泄漏，仍可能通过特权中间表征 (privileged intermediate representation) 供给信息，使所声称能力与实际测量构念错位。在 Breakfast 上，匹配的 recognizer-history 与 GT-history 两种设定得分 30.3% 与 62.3%，特权信息差 (privileged-information gap) 达 +32.0（95% Student-t 区间 [+24.1, +39.8]）；作者据此提出可复用的四条件审计。
Motivation: 基准分数为能力主张提供依据，但评测协议可能在保持时间因果、无经典目标泄漏的同时仍注入特权信息，导致声称的能力与实际测到的构念不一致，而非仅仅是准确率虚高。
Method: 以程序性动作预期为受控案例，比较 matched recognizer-history 与 GT-history 两种 regime；用固定检查点的 2×2 干预分离测试时 oracle 对比，配合 matched no-video provenance probe 与 boundary-independent query/history 控制，并提出可复用的四条件审计 (four-condition audit)，特权信息差相对于指定的非 oracle 恢复管线定义。
Result: Breakfast 上 recognizer-history 30.3%、GT-history 62.3%，Delta_PH(R_BA) = +32.0，95% Student-t 区间 [+24.1, +39.8]；固定检查点 2×2 干预给出 +14.6 点的测试时 oracle 对比，matched no-video provenance probe 给出 +26.8 点差距，boundary-independent query/history 控制保留 +19.4 点差距。跨五个评测设定该差值表现异质；一个标准的 50 Salads 长期预期复现为超出审计专用 next-action 构造提供了谨慎支持。
Conclusion: 评测协议可在无经典目标泄漏的情况下仍通过特权中间表征抬高分数，因此能力主张必须相对指定的非 oracle 恢复管线审计；四条件审计可复用于其他评测设定，且特权信息差在不同设定间并不一致。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Same Output, Different Gold: Measuring How Reference Choice Moves a Multilingual Benchmark Score
papers.abstract_en: A benchmark score compares a system output against a reference, and methodological attention falls almost entirely on the first term. We measure the second. The retained annotation record of a six-language benchmark for personally identifiable information contains two independent annotator labellings, the aggregate shipped as gold, and a reviewer gold from independent expert re-annotation of a sample. Using it, we hold the scored output fixed and exchange the reference. The score moves by 4.95 F1 points for one output and 2.00 for the other (95% CIs [3.23, 6.27] and [0.26, 3.37]), and by 7.55 in the worst language. The comparison between two outputs moves as well: the paired interaction between reference and system is +2.95 points (CI [+1.97, +3.87]), survives correction for multiple testing, and changes one language's margin outright. The cause is an undocumented aggregation default that usually kept one annotator when adjudication did not fire, making the shipped reference a partial copy of an output being scored. We report the resulting reference-sensitivity band, show how to compute one from any retained annotation record, and argue that the quantity belongs beside the score.
papers.comment: 13 pages (8 main), 1 figure, 8 tables. Accepted as a poster at TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, a NeurIPS 2026 workshop (non-archival). The workshop name comes from the acceptance email in reviews.md
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在六语言 PII 检测基准上固定被评输出、只替换参考答案（gold），F1 分数对单个输出移动 4.95 与 2.00 点，最差语言达 7.55 点；两个输出之间的比较也随之改变，参考×系统交互为 +2.95 点且经多重检验校正后仍显著，并直接翻转某语言的胜负结论。根因是未文档化的聚合默认：仲裁未触发时通常只保留一名标注者，使发布的 gold 成为被评输出的部分拷贝。作者主张把 reference-sensitivity band 与分数并列报告。
Motivation: 基准分数几乎全部方法学注意力放在系统输出一侧，参考答案的选择被默认为固定不变；若 gold 本身随标注聚合方式漂移，同一输出的分数与系统间排序都不可复现。
Method: 利用六语言 PII 基准保留的标注记录：两名独立标注者的标签、作为 gold 发布的聚合结果，以及专家对样本的独立复标 reviewer gold。固定被评输出、只交换参考，测量分数位移与参考×系统的配对交互，并对多重检验做校正；从任意保留标注记录出发给出 reference-sensitivity band 的计算方式。
Result: 固定输出换参考后 F1 移动 4.95 点（95% CI [3.23, 6.27]）与 2.00 点（CI [0.26, 3.37]），最差语言移动 7.55 点；参考与系统的配对交互为 +2.95 点（CI [+1.97, +3.87]），经多重检验校正后仍存在，并直接改变一种语言的系统间胜负。
Conclusion: 基准分数必须附带 reference-sensitivity band，因为未文档化的标注聚合默认会让 gold 部分复制被评输出，从而同时移动绝对分数与系统间比较。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Targeted Active Learning for Preference-Based Treatment Effects on Multivariate Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: Treatment efficacy is traditionally demonstrated on the basis of a single primary outcome. However, clinical decision-making usually requires consideration of multiple outcomes, balancing expected benefits against potential risks. The relative value assigned to these outcomes varies substantially from one patient to another. Given a preference rule over outcome profiles, treatment effects and optimal policies can be defined and estimated. Such a rule is rarely available in practice: it must itself be estimated from pairwise comparisons of outcome profiles, which are costly to collect from clinical experts. We propose an active learning framework that selects which comparisons to query. Standard criteria maximize the information gained on the preference rule itself. We instead target the quantities of interest, and select the query that most reduces uncertainty on the treatment effect and on the optimal policy induced by the learned rule. Under a Gaussian process model of the preference rule, we derive a closed-form approximation of this criterion. On semi-synthetic data built from a Parkinson's disease cohort with 13 clinical outcomes, our criterion achieves lower treatment effect estimation error and lower policy regret than existing criteria at equal query budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多结局临床治疗效应估计中偏好规则需从专家成对比较中学习且查询昂贵的问题，提出面向目标量的主动学习准则：在高斯过程偏好规则模型下，选择最能降低治疗效应与最优策略不确定性的比较查询，而非最大化对偏好规则本身的信息增益，并推导出该准则的闭式近似。在基于 Parkinson's disease 队列（13 项临床结局）的半合成数据上，同等查询预算下该准则的治疗效应估计误差与策略后悔均低于既有准则。
Motivation: 临床决策需权衡多个结局且患者间偏好差异大，但偏好规则须从代价高昂的专家成对比较中估计；标准主动学习准则优化对偏好规则本身的信息增益，未必降低真正关心的治疗效应与最优策略的不确定性。
Method: 提出面向目标量的主动学习框架，查询最能降低治疗效应与所学规则诱导的最优策略不确定性的成对比较；在偏好规则的高斯过程 (Gaussian process) 模型下推导该准则的闭式近似。
Result: 在基于含 13 项临床结局的 Parkinson's disease 队列构建的半合成数据上，同等查询预算下，该准则的治疗效应估计误差与策略后悔均低于既有主动学习准则。
Conclusion: 主动学习应直接瞄准治疗效应与最优策略这类目标量而非偏好规则本身，在专家比较预算受限时可同时降低估计误差与策略后悔。

papers.title: Beyond Token Accuracy: Prioritizing What Matters for Visual Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Tokens have become a unified interface for multimodal foundation models, making visual-token communication a natural paradigm for efficient image delivery. However, existing methods typically rely on static policies that cannot jointly adapt to image content and channel conditions. Moreover, their token-level utility objectives do not necessarily translate into improved image reconstruction quality. In this paper, we propose AdapToC, an adaptive, reconstruction-oriented visual-token communication framework. At the transmitter, an adaptive selector jointly models image content, channel state, and communication budget to perform instance-wise resource allocation. Rather than using a fixed token rate and protection policy, it dynamically determines how many tokens should be transmitted and assigns different protection levels according to token importance and current channel conditions. At the receiver, an adaptive MaskGIT receiver incorporates channel reliability into contextual token modeling. It distinguishes tokens with different reliability levels, preserves high-confidence observations, corrects potentially corrupted tokens, and iteratively reconstructs missing content from the received evidence and global visual context. By co-designing token quantity, unequal protection, and reliability-aware recovery for image-level reconstruction quality, AdapToC achieves a peak mean PSNR gain of 4.20 dB over the strongest static baseline under matched communication costs and state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated visual-token communication methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdapToC 把视觉 token 传输从静态策略改成面向重建质量的联合设计：发射端按图像内容、信道状态和通信预算逐实例决定传多少 token 并分配非均匀保护等级，接收端用引入信道可靠性的自适应 MaskGIT 迭代纠错与补全。在同等通信开销下峰值平均 PSNR 比最强静态基线高 4.20 dB，在所评估的视觉 token 通信方法中达到最先进水平。
Motivation: 现有视觉 token 通信用静态的 token 数量与保护策略，既不随图像内容和信道变化，其 token 级效用目标也不保证转化为图像重建质量的提升。
Method: 发射端的自适应选择器 (adaptive selector) 联合建模图像内容、信道状态与通信预算，做逐实例资源分配，按 token 重要性和当前信道条件动态决定传输数量并施加不同保护等级；接收端的自适应 MaskGIT 接收器把信道可靠性纳入上下文建模，保留高置信观测、纠正可能损坏的 token，并从已收证据与全局视觉上下文迭代重建缺失内容。
Result: 在匹配通信开销下，峰值平均 PSNR 比最强静态基线提升 4.20 dB，并在所评估的视觉 token 通信方法中取得最先进性能。
Conclusion: token 数量、非均匀保护与可靠性感知恢复必须围绕图像级重建质量联合设计，token 级效用目标本身不足以保证重建质量。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: From Requirements to Attack Trees: Grounded LLM Agents for Design-Time Security Review
papers.abstract_en: Design-level security weaknesses can arise from requirements, trust assumptions, missing controls, and data flows before implementation begins. Existing security practices often identify these issues after code is written. We present a multi-agent LLM framework for design-time security analysis from product requirement documents and architecture diagrams. The proposed framework parses architecture diagrams into graph representations, generates misuse and failure cases, constructs attack trees, checks governance and compliance gaps, recommends mitigations, assigns enterprise security-domain tags, and produces a candidate revised architecture recommendation for expert review. The framework does not retrieve from Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) databases at inference time. Instead, it analyzes system behavior, trust boundaries, component interactions, and data-flow assumptions. Misuse cases act as intermediate representations that link findings to system components and attack paths, while a validation and refinement loop filters unsupported findings and improves grounding, traceability, and actionability. We evaluate the framework on a Microsoft reference-labeled threat-modeling example, labeled synthetic PRD--architecture pairs, and two open-ended systems: Berty and Gas Town. The reference-labeled case supports threat-recovery and actionability analysis, while the open-ended cases evaluate validity, noise, traceability, actionability, redundancy, and attack-tree quality. Results show that architecture-informed, misuse-driven reasoning improves review quality compared with single-shot and ablation baselines. Keywords: LLM Multi-Agent Systems, Design-Time Security, Threat Modeling, Vulnerability Discovery, Architecture Diagrams, Security Analysis, Misuse Case Derivation, Attack Trees, Iterative Reasoning, Security Governance.

TL;DR: 提出面向设计期安全审查的多智能体 LLM 框架：把架构图解析为图表示，以 misuse case 作为中间表示生成 attack tree、治理与合规缺口、缓解建议与修订架构候选，并用验证-精炼循环过滤无依据结论。在 Microsoft 参考标注威胁建模样例、标注合成 PRD–架构对以及 Berty、Gas Town 两个开放系统上，架构感知、misuse 驱动的推理在审查质量上优于 single-shot 与消融基线。

papers.title: Shapley-based Structural Analysis of Neural Calibration for Stochastic Volatility Models
papers.abstract_en: Neural network-based approaches have emerged as efficient alternatives to traditional optimization-based procedures for the calibration of stochastic volatility models. However, existing work has focused primarily on predictive accuracy, with comparatively little attention devoted to understanding the structure of the learned inverse calibration mappings. In this work, we analyze neural calibration mappings for the Heston and rough Heston models across multilayer perceptron, highway, and softmax-parametrized highway architectures, using complementary Shapley-based methods from explainable AI. Specifically, we consider SHAP and $ν$SHAP explanations, which capture distinct, complementary notions of feature relevance, corresponding to sensitivity and sufficiency of feature subsets, respectively. Short maturities and smile wings consistently dominate parameter inference, and the dominant attribution structure remains qualitatively stable across architectures despite differences in predictive accuracy and parameter count. Parameter-specific differences between SHAP and $ν$SHAP further reveal how distinct regions of the implied volatility surface contribute to parameter recovery and expose substantial redundancy in the calibration input. Building on this redundancy, we show that $ν$SHAP explanations can guide a significant reduction in input dimensionality for the rough Heston model while matching calibration accuracy relative to the full implied volatility surface. These findings demonstrate that complementary Shapley-based methods provide structural insight into learned inverse calibration mappings beyond predictive error metrics, and offer a practical route to feature selection in neural calibration problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 SHAP 与 νSHAP 两种 Shapley 方法剖析 Heston 与 rough Heston 模型的神经网络逆校准映射，发现短期限与波动率微笑两翼主导参数反演，且该归因结构跨 MLP、highway、softmax-parametrized highway 架构保持定性稳定。基于 νSHAP 揭示的输入冗余，可大幅削减 rough Heston 的输入维度（隐含波动率曲面特征）而保持与全曲面相当的校准精度。
Motivation: 神经校准已成传统优化校准的高效替代，但既有工作几乎只看预测精度，缺少对学到的逆映射结构的理解，无法指导输入特征选择。
Method: 对 Heston 与 rough Heston 模型，在 MLP、highway、softmax-parametrized highway 三种架构上，用 SHAP（敏感性）与 νSHAP（特征子集充分性）两种互补的 Shapley 可解释性方法分析神经校准映射，并据 νSHAP 归因做输入降维。
Result: 短期限与 smile wings 一致主导参数反演；主导归因结构跨架构定性稳定，尽管各架构预测精度与参数量不同；SHAP 与 νSHAP 的参数级差异揭示隐含波动率曲面不同区域对参数恢复的贡献及输入的大量冗余；基于此的降维可在 rough Heston 上以远小于完整隐含波动率曲面的输入匹配校准精度。
Conclusion: 互补的 Shapley 方法能给出超越预测误差的逆校准映射结构信息，并为神经校准问题提供一条实用的特征选择路径。

papers.title: Response Variability and Stability in Human Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how humans reason -- and how reasoning responses vary across tasks and individuals -- remains a core challenge for modeling and explanation in cognitive science. We investigate the stability of response patterns within reasoners and whether variation in these patterns can be used to predict learning effects. We introduce a formal, geometry-based method to quantify distances between individual reasoning patterns and their internal variability, grounded in heuristic theories. The proposed framework is tested against experimental data via generalized linear mixed-effects models and clustering, where we find that our proposed variation measure interacts with correctness to predict performance gains. Moreover, we find that reasoning patterns are stable over time within the same reasoner. The method is general enough to be applied to other reasoning domains.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种基于几何的形式化方法，量化同一推理者内部推理模式之间的距离与变异度，并用广义线性混合效应模型 (GLMM) 与聚类在实验数据上检验。发现该变异度指标与正确率交互预测后续表现增益，且同一推理者的推理模式随时间保持稳定。
Motivation: 认知科学中人类推理响应在任务与个体间的变异难以形式化刻画，也无法判断这种变异能否预测学习效应。
Method: 基于启发式理论给出几何化的模式距离与内部变异度度量，再用广义线性混合效应模型和聚类在实验数据上检验该变异度与正确率的交互作用。
Result: 变异度指标与正确率交互，可预测表现增益 (performance gains)；同一推理者随时间推理模式保持稳定；框架在实验数据上通过 GLMM 与聚类检验。
Conclusion: 推理响应的变异性本身携带可预测学习效应的信息，且个体内模式跨时间稳定；该方法可迁移到其他推理领域。

papers.title: RealCompanion: Benchmarking Human Understanding from Reasoning over Longitudinal Real-World Conversations
papers.abstract_en: An AI companion that talks with someone for months should come to understand them. It should know who they are, remember what they said, and recognize when something from the past matters now. Testing this needs real conversations, but real conversations are private, so existing benchmarks use invented people and invented questions. We release RealCompanion, ten real relationships between people and an AI companion, with 27,218 messages over up to 120 days. For each person, we release the full conversation, a profile, a persona, chat test items, and question test items. Every label points to the messages that support it, and every chat label comes with the reasoning that produced it. The real data shows three things. First, people rarely refer back. Only 3.4% of their messages depend on something said earlier, and when one does, the earlier message is usually far away (a median of 2,157 messages back). Averages hide this. Looking at the most recent messages finds the needed one 95.9% of the time overall, but only 2.2% of the time when it is far back. Second, AI systems cannot tell when the past matters. The detectors we tested barely beat chance on real messages, and when the same earlier messages are labeled "memories" instead of "earlier messages", models bring up the past 10 to 14 percentage points more often, even when nothing from the past is needed. Third, AI systems read more into a person than the person revealed. Three agent systems rebuild each persona equally well (F1 0.71). They see the person, and then imagine more. Understanding a person depends on knowing when their past matters and where what they shared ends, and only real conversations can test it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RealCompanion 发布 10 段真实人机陪伴关系、27,218 条消息、最长 120 天的纵向对话基准，每条标签都附支撑消息与推理链。真实数据中仅 3.4% 消息依赖前文，且被依赖消息中位距离 2,157 条：按最近消息检索整体命中 95.9%，但远距离情形仅 2.2%；被测检测器在真实消息上勉强胜过随机，把同一批前文标成 memories 会让模型多提过去 10–14 个百分点，三个 agent 重建 persona 的 F1 同为 0.71。
Motivation: 现有长期陪伴基准用虚构人物与虚构问题，无法检验 AI 何时该调用过去、以及对用户的理解是否超出其自述边界。
Method: 发布 RealCompanion：10 段真实关系的完整对话、profile、persona、chat test items 与 question test items，每条标签指向支撑消息，chat 标签附产生它的推理；在此数据上评测过去相关性检测器与三个 persona 重建 agent 系统。
Result: 3.4% 的消息依赖更早内容，被依赖消息中位回溯 2,157 条；取最近消息整体命中所需消息 95.9%，远距离时仅 2.2%。被测检测器在真实消息上勉强胜过随机；同一批前文改标为 memories 后模型提及过去多 10–14 个百分点，即使并不需要。三个 agent 系统重建 persona 的 F1 均为 0.71。
Conclusion: 理解一个人取决于知道过去何时重要、以及对方自述在哪里结束，而只有真实对话能检验这两点。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Pay for the Fault, Not the Flow: Label-Free In-Flow Multi-Agent Workflow Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly construct multi-agent workflows that decompose a complex task and assign specialist agents from a pool. However, building such a workflow well remains challenging: how finely to divide the task, which agent to trust with each subtask, and when to create a new specialist are all critical decisions a workflow constructor needs to settle up front. Thus, whether each subtask succeeds remains unknown until the workflow runs. Yet, improving a workflow is costly. Locating a fault usually requires a reference answer, a graded outcome, or a trained assessor, and the fix is applied to the whole workflow through re-execution, re-search, or retraining. We propose InFlowOp, which prices every decision in one label-free cost that weighs how well an agent's competence meets what a subtask demands against how much that agent takes to run. Before execution, InFlowOp bidirectionally determines the granularity of task decomposition and agent assignment following from the cost rather than from a fixed template. During execution, InFlowOp corrects a fault with the cheapest move via the same cost that serves the workflow both as it is built and as it runs. Facing the workflow-level evaluation challenge, we introduce Braid, a benchmark whose tasks require multi-agent coordination beyond single-agent capability. Across various domains and backbones, InFlowOp outperforms single agent baselines by up to $+11.97\%$, achieving $+9.64\%$ with in-flow optimization. Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/InFlowOp/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 InFlowOp，用一个无标签代价函数同时给「任务切分粒度、子任务分配给谁、运行中出错后改哪一步」定价，代价衡量 agent 能力与子任务需求的匹配度除以运行成本。在多 agent 协调基准 Braid 上，InFlowOp 相对单 agent 基线最高提升 +11.97%，其中 in-flow optimization 贡献 +9.64%。
Motivation: LLM 多 agent 工作流的构造决策（切多细、派给谁、何时新建专家）必须在运行前定死，而子任务成败要跑起来才知道；定位故障通常需要参考答案、评分结果或训练好的评估器，修复又得整条工作流重跑、重搜或重训，代价高昂。
Method: InFlowOp 定义一个 label-free 的统一代价，权衡 agent 能力与子任务需求的匹配度和该 agent 的运行开销；据此在执行前双向决定任务分解粒度与 agent 分配（而非套固定模板），执行中用同一代价挑最便宜的纠错动作。配套提出多 agent 协调基准 Braid，任务难度超出单 agent 能力。
Result: 在 Braid 上跨多个领域与 backbone，InFlowOp 相对单 agent 基线最高 +11.97%，其中 in-flow optimization 达到 +9.64%。
Conclusion: 把工作流构造与运行期纠错统一到同一个无标签代价下定价，可以在不依赖参考答案或评估器的情况下改进多 agent 工作流，并在需要超越单 agent 能力的协调任务上取得正增益。

papers.title: RPTune: Learned Context Curation for LLM Catalog Search
papers.abstract_en: For small merchant businesses (SMBs) whose catalogs fit within a long-context LLM, full-catalog prompting offers a compelling alternative to multi-stage retrieval designed primarily for large marketplaces with millions of items. However, fitting the full catalog into the context window does not ensure that the model can use it effectively, since LLMs do not exploit long contexts uniformly. We therefore study in-context catalog search through two complementary questions: (1) how to curate and present catalogs to the LLM, and (2) how to adapt the LLM for product selection on curated contexts. We propose RPTune, an end-to-end framework that couples learned catalog curation with LLM post-training using automatically generated, catalog-grounded supervision. An encoder-reorganizer curator orders and prunes products guided by downstream LLM feedback, while the resulting curated catalogs in turn improve the effectiveness of LLM post-training with a context-relative reward. We evaluate RPTune on 7 real merchants spanning distinct retail verticals, using 100 complex conversational queries per merchant. RPTune consistently improves search accuracy across both proprietary and open-weight LLMs, with context curation yielding gains of up to 31.4 percentage points and post-training adding a further 10.3 points on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RPTune 把商品目录的上下文整理 (context curation) 与 LLM 后训练耦合成端到端框架：encoder-reorganizer 依据下游 LLM 反馈对商品排序剪枝，整理后的目录再用上下文相对奖励 (context-relative reward) 反哺后训练。在 7 个真实商户、每商户 100 条复杂对话查询上，目录整理最多带来 31.4 个百分点的搜索准确率提升，后训练平均再加 10.3 个百分点。
Motivation: 对目录能塞进长上下文窗口的中小商户 (SMB)，全目录提示本可替代面向百万级商品的多阶段检索，但 LLM 并不均匀利用长上下文，塞进去不等于用得好。
Method: RPTune 端到端框架：encoder-reorganizer curator 在下游 LLM 反馈指导下对商品排序与剪枝；自动生成、以目录为依据 (catalog-grounded) 的监督信号用于 LLM 后训练，奖励为 context-relative reward，整理与训练双向互促。
Result: 在覆盖不同零售垂直领域的 7 个真实商户、每商户 100 条复杂对话查询上，RPTune 在专有与开放权重 LLM 上均一致提升搜索准确率：上下文整理最多提升 31.4 个百分点，后训练在此之上平均再提升 10.3 个百分点。
Conclusion: 对能整体放入上下文的 SMB 目录，把目录整理与 LLM 后训练联合优化比单纯全目录提示更有效，且该收益在专有和开放权重模型上都成立。

papers.title: Memetic Trojans: Social Contagions as Carriers of Adversarial Payloads in Agent Networks
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous large language model (LLM) agents increasingly interact in network environments where adversarial content can propagate between agents. Known attacks include agent worms, which spread through self-replicating prompt injections or configuration compromises. We introduce \emph{memetic trojans}, a distinct class of network-mediated attack that exploits agents' tendencies to retransmit and amplify content. Unlike agent worms, whose propagation is adversarially induced, memetic trojans exploit \emph{endogenous} transmission by embedding adversarial payloads in \emph{social contagions}: content agents have internal reasons to share. As part of our work, we extract social contagions from Moltbook, a social media platform for LLM agents. Controlled transmission experiments reveal large differences in virality: the most effective contagion is retransmitted in approximately 50\% of subsequent agent posts and upvoted at 2.5x the average post's rate. Its memetic trojan counterpart largely inherits these properties. Monte Carlo attack simulations show that memetic trojans amplify expected exposure by up to 3.19x. Network structure and amplification mechanisms strongly shape propagation, producing heavy-tailed outcomes with near network-wide exposure. These results identify endogenous social transmission as a distinct security vulnerability in multi-agent systems. Because propagation does not require agents to follow malicious retransmission instructions, defenses focused on prompt-injection detection or preventing agent compromise cannot alone prevent memetic trojan propagation. Securing large-scale agent ecosystems may require network-level defenses that account for how agent preferences, recommendation mechanisms, and network topology amplify adversarial payloads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 memetic trojan：把对抗载荷嵌入 LLM agent 本就愿意转发的 social contagion 中，靠内生 (endogenous) 社交传播而非自复制指令扩散。从 Moltbook 提取的最强 contagion 在后续 agent 帖子中被转发率约 50%、点赞率为平均帖的 2.5 倍，其 trojan 版本基本继承这些性质；Monte Carlo 攻击模拟显示暴露量最多放大 3.19 倍，且因传播不依赖恶意转发指令，仅靠 prompt-injection 检测无法阻断。
Motivation: LLM agent 网络中已知的 agent worm 依赖对抗性诱导的自复制传播，而 agent 因自身偏好主动转发的内容这一传播通道尚未被当作攻击面，导致现有基于 prompt-injection 检测的防御对其无效。
Method: 定义 memetic trojan 这一网络介导攻击类别，与 agent worm 区分；从 LLM agent 社交平台 Moltbook 中提取 social contagion，做受控传播实验测量转发与点赞差异，再用 Monte Carlo 攻击模拟在 agent 网络上评估暴露，并考察网络结构与放大机制的作用。
Result: 最具传播力的 contagion 在后续 agent 帖子中被转发约 50%，点赞率为平均帖的 2.5 倍，其 memetic trojan 对应物大体继承这些属性；Monte Carlo 模拟中 memetic trojan 使期望暴露最多提升 3.19 倍，传播结果呈重尾分布并可接近全网暴露。
Conclusion: 内生社交传播本身构成多智能体系统的一类独立安全漏洞，防御必须在网络层面考虑 agent 偏好、推荐机制与网络拓扑对载荷的放大，仅靠 prompt-injection 检测或阻止 agent 被攻陷不足以阻断传播。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Towards Better Exploration in Sequential Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling improves language model reasoning by spending additional compute at inference. However, both classes of existing methods often fail to continue improving over long timescales. Parallel methods repeatedly sample independent answers from the model, scaling poorly on problems the model is unlikely to solve in a single attempt. In contrast, sequential methods build on previous answers to access new ideas, yet so far have not been shown to reach answers beyond those found by parallel scaling. First, we show that sequential scaling often stops improving because it becomes prematurely trapped in an attractor: a set of answers that prevents exploration of different answers once entered. Across 27 combinations of scaling methods, models, and benchmarks, we find that 53.8% of sequential scaling trajectories enter an attractor within four iterations. Second, we show that a simple model-mixing intervention helps escape attractors. This reduces the attractor hit rate by 21.2 percentage points on average, expands solution coverage beyond a compute-matched parallel baseline, and improves accuracy of recursive self-aggregation by at least 2.2 percentage points. Our results motivate refocusing long-horizon test-time scaling from parallel methods to sequential methods that improve previous answers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 序列式 test-time scaling 因过早陷入吸引子 (attractor) 而停止提升，作者在 27 种「方法×模型×基准」组合中测得 53.8% 的序列轨迹在四次迭代内进入吸引子。简单的 model-mixing 干预把吸引子命中率平均降低 21.2 个百分点，解算覆盖超出算力对齐的并行基线，并使 recursive self-aggregation 准确率至少提升 2.2 个百分点。
Motivation: 并行方法在模型单次难以解出的题目上扩展性差，序列方法虽能基于先前答案产生新想法，却此前未被证明能超出并行 scaling 找到的答案，且常在长时程上停滞。
Method: 先刻画序列式 scaling 的过早吸引子现象（进入一组阻止探索其他答案的状态），再引入一个简单的 model-mixing 干预帮助逃逸吸引子，并在 27 种 scaling 方法、模型与基准的组合上测量轨迹行为与准确率。
Result: 27 种组合中 53.8% 的序列 scaling 轨迹在四次迭代内进入吸引子；model-mixing 使吸引子命中率平均下降 21.2 个百分点，解算覆盖超出 compute-matched 并行基线，recursive self-aggregation 准确率至少提升 2.2 个百分点。
Conclusion: 长时程 test-time scaling 应从并行采样转向能改进先前答案的序列方法，而逃逸吸引子是让序列方法持续提升的关键。

papers.title: Learning Macroscopic Dynamics without Reconstructing Microscopic States
papers.abstract_en: Modeling the temporal evolution of macroscopic properties of complex systems is an important scientific task. To predict this evolution without full microscopic simulation, a common approach encodes microstates into compact latent states, learns their evolution, and reads out macroscopic predictions from the latent trajectory. These latent states are often learned through microstate reconstruction. However, with limited latent capacity, reconstruction can favor high-variance microscopic details over information needed for macroscopic prediction. Yet jointly learning latent states and their transition without reconstruction often fails to obtain latent dynamics that support accurate macroscopic prediction. We show that this failure can arise from latent scale collapse: shrinking the latent state scale reduces training loss while macroscopic evolution error remains large. Here, we propose a reconstruction-free framework to learn latent states with their dynamics for prescribed macroscopic prediction. Training alternates between updating the latent representation with the transition and next-state latent targets fixed, and updating the transition with the latent representation fixed. At inference, the trained model predicts macroscopic states recursively from an initial microstate. Our theoretical analysis characterizes reconstruction misalignment and scale collapse under joint training, and gives a sufficient condition for local convergence to correct latent dynamics for our method. Experiments on epidemic spreading on a lattice, mixing of two particle species, and polymer stretching demonstrate that the proposed method achieves substantially better macroscopic prediction over baselines.
papers.comment: Withdrawn by the authors due to concerns regarding the timing of public dissemination of results based on a dataset used in the paper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在潜变量容量受限时，微观状态重建会偏向高方差细节而牺牲宏观预测所需信息，而联合学习潜变量与转移又会因潜变量尺度坍缩 (latent scale collapse) 失败：缩小潜变量尺度能降低训练损失但宏观演化误差仍大。作者提出免重建框架，交替固定转移更新潜表示、固定潜表示更新转移，推理时从初始微观状态递归预测宏观状态。在格点 epidemic spreading、双粒子物种混合与聚合物拉伸三个实验上，宏观预测显著优于基线。
Motivation: 用紧凑潜态预测复杂系统宏观演化时，重建目标与宏观预测目标错位；不带重建的联合训练又会因尺度坍缩使训练损失下降而宏观误差不降，导致潜动力学无法支撑准确的宏观预测。
Method: 提出免重建的潜表示与动力学联合学习框架：训练在两步间交替——固定转移网络与下一时刻潜目标、更新潜表示；再固定潜表示、更新转移。推理时模型从初始微观状态递归预测宏观状态。理论部分刻画联合训练下的重建错位与尺度坍缩，并给出该方法局部收敛到正确潜动力学的充分条件。
Result: 理论刻画了重建错位与潜变量尺度坍缩（缩小潜尺度降低训练损失但宏观演化误差仍大），并给出局部收敛到正确潜动力学的充分条件；在格点上的 epidemic spreading、双粒子物种混合、聚合物拉伸三个实验中，宏观预测显著优于基线。
Conclusion: 免重建、交替更新的潜动力学学习可以在不重建微观状态的前提下得到支撑准确宏观预测的潜动力学，其有效性由局部收敛充分条件保证。
Relevance: 36

summary_sections.result: 理论刻画了重建错位与潜变量尺度坍缩（缩小潜尺度降低训练损失但宏观演化误差仍大），并给出局部收敛到正确潜动力学的充分条件；在格点上的 epidemic spreading、双粒子物种混合、聚合物拉伸三个实验中，宏观预测显著优于基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 免重建、交替更新的潜动力学学习可以在不重建微观状态的前提下得到支撑准确宏观预测的潜动力学，其有效性由局部收敛充分条件保证。

papers.title: Why MLLMs Struggle to Count: Overcoming Individuation and Aggregation Bottlenecks with ConvStack
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) consistently struggle with fine-grained visual counting, yet the underlying causes remain poorly understood. In this work, we present a mechanistic analysis of this failure mode, identifying two critical bottlenecks inherent to the global attention pipeline of MLLMs. First, we reveal an individuation bottleneck stemming from image patchification: because Vision Transformers process patches independently, they struggle to group fragmented geometric features across boundaries into distinct object representations. Second, we identify a collapse in the subsequent counting aggregation process, where representation separation rapidly diminishes as numerosity increases due to attention compression. Identifying and formalizing these twin bottlenecks constitutes our first major contribution. To overcome them, we propose ConvStack, a lightweight architecture that operates directly in the visual token space to explicitly aggregate and inject local spatial structures via zero-initialized residual connections. By explicitly addressing the individuation bottleneck, ConvStack provides unambiguous geometric evidence for downstream aggregation. Remarkably, by fine-tuning exclusively on counting tasks, the model achieves substantial improvements in dense object counting and broader spatial understanding benchmarks, without compromising on general visual capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ConvStack 在 MLLM 的视觉 token 空间用零初始化残差连接显式注入局部空间结构，绕开 patch 化导致的个体化瓶颈与注意力压缩导致的计数聚合坍塌。仅在计数任务上微调即可在稠密目标计数与更广的空间理解基准上取得实质提升，且不损害通用视觉能力。
Motivation: MLLM 在细粒度视觉计数上持续失败，但成因不清：ViT 独立处理 patch，难以跨边界把碎片几何特征归并成独立物体表征，随后计数聚合阶段的表征分离度随数量增加迅速坍塌。
Method: 先对全局注意力流水线做机制分析，形式化个体化瓶颈与聚合坍塌这对瓶颈；再提出 ConvStack，一个轻量架构，直接在视觉 token 空间通过零初始化残差连接聚合并注入局部空间结构，为下游聚合提供无歧义的几何证据。
Result: 仅在计数任务上微调后，模型在稠密目标计数 (dense object counting) 与更广的空间理解基准上取得实质提升，同时不损害通用视觉能力；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 视觉计数失败的根源可归结为个体化与聚合两个可定位的瓶颈，在 token 空间补上局部结构即可在不牺牲通用能力的前提下改善计数与空间理解。

papers.title: Robust Biomolecular Complex Design Across Protein Conformational Landscapes
papers.abstract_en: Proteins populate conformational ensembles, yet structure-based biomolecular design typically optimizes candidates against a single target conformation. Consequently, a candidate that fits one state can lose favorable interactions or develop steric clashes when the target adopts another. We introduce FlexEvo, a model-agnostic evolutionary framework that adapts candidates once at inference time from a single target conformation to improve compatibility with alternative natural conformations unseen during adaptation, without retraining the source model or requiring a conformational ensemble. FlexEvo casts cross-state adaptation as geometry-constrained bi-objective optimization, balancing preservation of input-state interactions against robustness to plausible conformational perturbations. To limit the search space and reduce invalid structural edits, geometry-derived FlexBoxes define protected anchor regions, adaptable regions for local exploration, and forbidden regions for clash avoidance. A unified all-atom representation supports topology-preserving adaptation across diverse binder categories, while Pareto selection preserves nondominated candidates across the two objectives. We evaluate FlexEvo across multiple generation baselines and nine representative binder categories spanning diverse molecular sizes and structural topologies. FlexEvo reduces the category-balanced mean relative performance degradation from 47.8% to 4.4%, while adding only 1.4--3.1 minutes of adaptation per sample. These results establish single-state inference-time adaptation as a practical route toward robust biomolecular complex design across protein conformational landscapes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlexEvo 在推理时只用单个目标构象，把跨构象适应写成几何约束的双目标优化（保留输入态相互作用 vs. 抗构象扰动），用几何派生的 FlexBoxes 划定受保护锚定区、可探索区与禁区，并以 Pareto 选择保留非支配候选。在九类 binder、多个生成基线上，类别均衡的平均相对性能退化从 47.8% 降到 4.4%，每样本仅增加 1.4–3.1 分钟适应开销。
Motivation: 蛋白处于构象系综，而基于结构的分子设计通常只对单一目标构象优化，候选在另一构象下会丢失有利相互作用或产生位阻冲突。
Method: 模型无关的进化框架 FlexEvo：不重训源模型、不需要构象系综，仅从单个目标构象在推理时适应一次；几何约束的双目标优化平衡输入态相互作用保持与对合理构象扰动的鲁棒性，FlexBoxes 划分受保护锚定区、局部探索区与避冲突禁区，统一全原子表示支持跨 binder 类别的拓扑保持适应，Pareto 选择保留两目标上的非支配候选。
Result: 在多个生成基线与九类代表性 binder（覆盖不同分子尺寸与结构拓扑）上，类别均衡的平均相对性能退化从 47.8% 降至 4.4%，每样本适应开销仅增加 1.4–3.1 分钟。
Conclusion: 单状态推理时适应是跨蛋白构象景观做稳健生物分子复合物设计的可行路径，无需重训或构象系综。

papers.title: ReVision3D: Attribution-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement for 3D Medical Perception
papers.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising path for overcoming the limited visual capability of current medical imaging agents. Yet applying RSI to volumetric imaging remains difficult: failures can arise from acquisition, perception, training recipe, or downstream inference, while self-generated feedback and logged trajectories provide little guidance on which component should change. We introduce ReVision3D, an RSI system that leverages 3D volumes with spatially grounded annotations to determine where visual evidence is lost and recursively improve the corresponding visual capability. A frozen language-model designer proposes revisions to acquisition, perception, training, or inference, while the verifier and system-level objective remain fixed. Our key insight is that an annotated volume forms an exact replay world for view rendering and spatial verification: unvisited views can be rendered on demand, and localized predictions can be checked directly against reference masks. This grounded feedback directs targeted revision, while only changes that improve beyond measured seed noise are retained. Each accepted change triggers renewed attribution, allowing the dominant bottleneck to shift across rounds. On abdominal CT, attribution identifies perception as the dominant remaining limitation. Revising that level enables ReVision3D to achieve 79% liver recall and 83% kidney recall at under 0.4 false positives per patient, outperforming the evaluated frozen multimodal foundation models, with the largest gains on small lesions. Our framework is public available with interactive demo in this project page: \url{https://leeh43.github.io/ReVision3D/}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReVision3D 把递归自我改进 (RSI) 用到 3D 医学体积感知上：用带空间标注的体积作为可按需渲染视角、可对照参考掩膜核验的“精确回放世界”，定位视觉证据丢失在哪一层，再由冻结的语言模型设计器只针对该层提出修订。在腹部 CT 上归因把 perception 判为主导瓶颈，修订后在低于每患者 0.4 个假阳性的水平下达到 79% 肝脏召回与 83% 肾脏召回，超过所评测的冻结多模态基础模型，小病灶增益最大。
Motivation: 医学影像 agent 的视觉能力受限，但体积成像中的失败可能来自采集、感知、训练配方或下游推理任一环节，自生成反馈与日志轨迹无法指出该改哪一层，RSI 难以在体数据上落地。
Method: ReVision3D 以带空间标注的 3D 体积构建可按需渲染未访问视角、可将局部预测直接对照参考掩膜核验的回放世界；归因指出证据丢失位置后，冻结语言模型设计器对 acquisition、perception、training、inference 提出修订，verifier 与系统级目标保持固定，只有超过实测 seed noise 的改进才被保留，每次接受的改动触发新一轮归因。
Result: 在腹部 CT 上，归因识别 perception 为剩余主导限制；修订该层后，ReVision3D 在低于 0.4 假阳性/患者 的条件下取得 79% liver recall 与 83% kidney recall，超过所评测的冻结多模态基础模型，且在小病灶上增益最大。
Conclusion: 把体积标注当作可核验的回放世界来做归因驱动的定向修订，能让 RSI 的主导瓶颈逐轮转移并在腹部 CT 器官召回上超过冻结多模态基础模型；框架已公开并附交互 demo。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: ASCEND: Personal AI Agents for Autonomous Scientific Computing Across HPC Clusters and GPU Workstations
papers.abstract_en: Traditional scientific computing requires researchers to translate intent into environment configuration, resource requests, and executable jobs, then diagnose failures from scheduler and application logs. We present ASCEND (Autonomous Scientific Computing Engine and Novel Discovery), an AI-powered agent system, operated through a command-line or a local web chat interface, that runs the agent on the researcher's own laptop, reaching Slurm clusters and a GPU workstation over multiplexed authenticated SSH, with site-specific execution policies checked by locally executed tools. The language-model agent (Claude Code or Codex, chosen at each launch) is hosted remotely and holds no credentials; an account on each resource suffices, and a public installer links additional clusters or workstations. We report four recorded cases: (1) the agent closed a failure-recovery loop on a planted tensor-device fault, submitting, diagnosing, repairing, and resubmitting it; (2) it reproduced the published evaluation of a weather-forecasting model, recovering an incompletely stated evaluation protocol and agreeing with the published curves to 2.1% (z500) and 2.4% (t850), while identifying two discrepancies in the paper's released materials; (3) it parallelized a released 12,693-line geophysical solver under a requirement of bit-for-bit identity of exported outputs, reducing runtime from about twelve hours to about two; (4) that requirement exposed two instances of undefined behavior in the published solver, both repaired and reported upstream. These cases used ordinary scheduler commands; a separate, pre-specified evaluation of the optional policy validator rejected 29 of 30 constructed violations, held one for approval, and denied 3 of 14 legitimate requests. Autonomy was exercised under author supervision, and agent transcripts were not retained, so intervention rates are not independently verifiable.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Code and installer: https://github.com/jpliu168/ASCEND
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASCEND 把 AI agent 放在研究者本机运行，经多路复用认证 SSH 操控 Slurm 集群与 GPU 工作站，agent 本身（Claude Code 或 Codex）远程托管且不持有凭据。四个记录案例中，它复现了一个天气预报模型的已发表评测，恢复出论文中表述不完整的评测协议，与已发表曲线吻合到 2.1%（z500）和 2.4%（t850），并发现论文发布材料中的两处不一致。
Motivation: 科研计算要求研究者把意图翻译成环境配置、资源申请和可执行作业，再从调度器与应用日志中诊断故障，这一转换链条耗时且易错。
Method: agent 系统通过命令行或本地 web 聊天界面操作，运行在研究者笔记本上，经多路复用认证 SSH 触达 Slurm 集群与 GPU 工作站，站点执行策略由本地执行的工具校验；语言模型 agent（Claude Code 或 Codex，每次启动时选定）远程托管且不持有凭据，另有公开安装器链接额外集群。附带一个可选的策略校验器 (policy validator)，用预先设定的构造违规与合法请求做独立评测。
Result: 四个记录案例：闭环修复一个植入的张量设备故障（提交、诊断、修复、重提交）；复现天气预报模型评测并与已发表曲线吻合到 2.1%（z500）和 2.4%（t850），同时指出发布材料两处不一致；在逐位一致 (bit-for-bit identity) 约束下并行化一个 12,693 行的地球物理求解器，运行时间从约 12 小时降到约 2 小时，并暴露该求解器两处未定义行为，均已修复并上报上游。策略校验器拒绝 30 个构造违规中的 29 个、1 个转交审批，同时拒绝了 14 个合法请求中的 3 个。
Conclusion: 在作者监督下，ASCEND 能跨 HPC 集群与 GPU 工作站自主完成故障恢复、评测复现与并行化，且逐位一致要求能反向暴露已发布求解器的未定义行为；但 agent 转录未保留，干预率无法独立核验。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Activation Flow: Manufacturing Activations for Steering
papers.abstract_en: Difference-in-means steering requires activations recorded while a model shows the desired behavior, which a sandbagging model withholds by deliberately underperforming. We introduce Activation Flow (ActFlow), which manufactures these activations from $k$ correct labels without fine-tuning. ActFlow sets target logits that rank each labeled item's correct answer first, and moves the logits toward them by adding one vector $x$ to all $k$ residual streams at one layer. ActFlow is a family of ordinary differential equations for $x$, one for each rule that maps the required logit change to the velocity of $x$. The smallest-norm rule lands exactly on the targets, while the others keep only the top singular directions of the Jacobian. We test ActFlow on three instruction-tuned models, each locked by a sandbagging prompt and by a password-locked LoRA. At $k=40$, ActFlow keeping five singular directions raises the mean held-out ARC-Easy accuracy over the six locked models from $0.05$ to $0.85$, against $0.88$ for rank-$16$ LoRA fine-tuning, which trains about $3{,}000$ times as many parameters, and $0.92$ for the honest models. Furthermore, it scores higher than the smallest-norm rule in 16 of the 18 combinations of locked model and $k$, and its steering direction is nearly orthogonal to the honest difference-in-means direction. It also unlocks two LoRA locks where the honest direction fails. Surprisingly, with one labeled item, the single-step smallest-norm rule raises the Qwen2.5-7B prompt lock from $0.04$ to $0.59$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ActFlow 在不微调的前提下，用 k 个正确标签合成本应由模型配合行为才能录到的 steering 激活：设定让正确答案排第一的目标 logits，再用一族 ODE 把某一层 k 条残差流的 logits 推向目标。在 6 个被 sandbagging prompt 与 password-locked LoRA 锁住的模型上，k=40 且只保留 5 个奇异方向时，held-out ARC-Easy 平均准确率从 0.05 升到 0.85，接近 rank-16 LoRA 微调的 0.88 与 honest 模型的 0.92。
Motivation: difference-in-means steering 需要录到模型展现目标行为时的激活，而 sandbagging 模型会故意表现差、拒绝提供这类样本，导致对照激活不可得。
Method: ActFlow 从 k 个带标签样本出发：设定使每个样本正确答案 logits 排第一的目标，在某一层给全部 k 条残差流加同一个向量 x；对 x 建一族 ODE，每条规则把所需 logit 变化映射为 x 的速度。最小范数规则精确落到目标，其余规则只保留 Jacobian 的顶部奇异方向；无需微调。
Result: k=40、保留 5 个奇异方向时，6 个锁定模型的 held-out ARC-Easy 平均准确率由 0.05 升至 0.85，对照 rank-16 LoRA 微调 0.88（参数量约多训 3000 倍）与 honest 模型 0.92。在锁定模型 × k 的 18 种组合中，该规则有 16 种高于最小范数规则；其 steering 方向与 honest difference-in-means 方向近乎正交，并解锁了 2 个 honest 方向失败的 LoRA 锁。仅 1 个标签时，单步最小范数规则把 Qwen2.5-7B 的 prompt 锁从 0.04 提到 0.59。
Conclusion: 被锁模型的目标行为激活可以由少量正确标签直接合成，且奇异方向截断的规则在多数设置下优于最小范数规则，用约 1/3000 的参数量逼近 LoRA 微调的解锁效果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FLIP: Final Layer Inference-Time Probing for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We present FLIP, a final-layer inference-time probe for testing whether a logit-facing intervention site in an open-weight vision-language model (VLM) supports structured, task-linked computation rather than generic perturbation. Behavioral change under internal intervention is otherwise mechanistically ambiguous: it may reflect improved use of visual evidence, generic output instability, or outright degradation. FLIP applies elementwise flooring to the final normalized hidden state before logit computation, leaving parameters, prompts, and decoding unchanged. On a controlled detection/counting probe, sweeping intervention strength reveals three regions: negligible change, a bounded interior regime in which detection recall at IoU 0.50 ($R_{50}$) improves while tolerant counting error ($\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{count}}$) falls, and over-suppression. We formalize a four-criterion probe-and-sweep protocol for disciplining the interpretation of intervention effects: regime structure, grounding-proxy alignment, feature-coherence dependence, and failure to reproduce the same positive regime on a performance-based negative control. The post-normalization state passed to the output head is the logit-facing instantiation of this test; under a non-targeted flooring sweep it satisfies the full protocol. Raw decoder-layer interventions, including the last-block output before final normalization, and the singleton-pair left/right control fail to reproduce the Final-site signature, while same-site operators and multiple VLMs replicate it. FLIP is therefore a validation step for intervention-based mechanistic interpretability, not a steering method. Repo at https://github.com/earl-juanico/flip-qwen3vl/
papers.comment: 25 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLIP 是面向视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 最终层的推理时探针：对送入 logit 前的归一化隐状态做逐元素下限截断 (elementwise flooring)，参数、prompt 与解码全部不变，用来判定该干预位点是否承载与任务绑定的结构化计算。在受控检测/计数探针上扫干预强度可见三个区间：几乎无变化、内部有界区间（IoU 0.50 检测召回 R50 上升且宽容计数误差 E_count 下降）、以及过抑制；只有 post-normalization 的 Final 位点满足四条判据的完整协议，原始 decoder 层输出与左右单例对负对照均不复现该特征。
Motivation: 对 VLM 做内部干预后行为变化在机制上是含混的：可能是更好地利用视觉证据，也可能只是输出不稳定或直接退化，缺少判别手段。
Method: FLIP 在最终归一化之后、logit 计算之前对隐状态施加 elementwise flooring，扫描干预强度并观察区间结构；提出四判据 probe-and-sweep 协议——区间结构、grounding 代理对齐、特征相干性依赖、以及在基于性能的负对照上无法复现同一正向区间——并用同位点算子与多个 VLM 做复现检验。
Result: 受控检测/计数探针的强度扫描给出三个区间：可忽略区间、内部有界区间（R50 提升且 E_count 下降）、过抑制区间；post-normalization Final 位点满足完整四判据协议，而原始 decoder 层干预（含最终归一化前的 last-block 输出）与 singleton-pair 左/右负对照均不复现该签名，同位点算子和多个 VLM 上可复现。
Conclusion: FLIP 是对基于干预的机制可解释性的验证步骤而非 steering 方法：只有落在有界正向区间且通过四判据的位点干预，才可解释为结构化、任务绑定的计算。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GyroNovo: Error-Guided Fragment Imputation with Mass-Aware Attention for De Novo Peptide Sequencing
papers.abstract_en: De novo peptide sequencing from tandem mass spectra is essential for identifying peptides without relying on reference databases. Despite advances in deep learning, accurate sequencing remains challenging because experimental spectra are often sparse, noisy, and incomplete, leaving informative b- and y-ion fragments unobserved. Existing methods attempt to recover this missing evidence via latent-space imputation before autoregressive decoding. However, they typically treat imputation as a fixed reconstruction task, without considering which missing fragments are most relevant to decoder errors. Moreover, existing peak representations do not explicitly model mass differences between peaks, despite their fundamental importance. We introduce GyroNovo, a framework with two main contributions. First, we use decoder errors observed during training to adapt the imputation objective, prioritizing fragments associated with frequent decoding errors. We further use the decoder error distribution to construct easy and hard augmented views of each spectrum, enabling the decoder to learn under varying degrees of spectral corruption and missing-fragment severity. Second, we introduce a mass-aware inductive bias into self-attention by using rotary embeddings to encode pairwise mass differences between spectral peaks. Together, these components align missing-fragment recovery with decoder behavior while explicitly incorporating the mass relationships that underlie peptide fragmentation. At inference time, GyroNovo retains a standard encoder-imputer-decoder architecture and requires neither additional inputs nor auxiliary search procedures. Experiments on NovoBench show gains of about 9 percentage points in peptide-level precision and 7 percentage points in amino-acid-level precision over the state-of-the-art baseline. Code: https://github.com/UBC-NLP/gyronovo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GyroNovo 针对从头肽测序 (de novo peptide sequencing) 中谱图稀疏噪声导致 b/y 离子碎片缺失的问题，用训练期解码器误差自适应加权碎片插补目标，并以误差分布构造易/难谱图增强视图；再用 rotary embedding 把峰间质量差编码进 self-attention。在 NovoBench 上较 SOTA 基线肽级 precision 提升约 9 个百分点、氨基酸级 precision 提升约 7 个百分点。
Motivation: 实验串联质谱常稀疏、含噪、不完整，b- 和 y-ion 碎片缺失；现有方法把插补当作固定重建任务，不区分哪些缺失碎片最影响解码误差，峰表示也不显式建模峰间质量差。
Method: 保留标准 encoder-imputer-decoder 架构：用训练中观测到的解码器误差调整插补目标，优先恢复高频出错碎片；用误差分布构造 easy/hard 两种谱图增强视图让解码器在不同缺失严重度下学习；在 self-attention 中引入 mass-aware inductive bias，用 rotary embeddings 编码峰对之间的质量差。推理时不需额外输入或辅助搜索。
Result: 在 NovoBench 上，肽级 precision 较 state-of-the-art 基线提升约 9 个百分点，氨基酸级 precision 提升约 7 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把缺失碎片恢复与解码器行为对齐、并显式注入肽碎裂的质量关系，可在不改推理流程的前提下提升从头肽测序精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Four Ways to Grow a Classifier and Why One of Them Cannot Learn
papers.abstract_en: Constructive classifiers add structure while they train: a level to a tree, a unit to a hidden layer, a split at a leaf. This paper asks what each of four such growth decisions buys, measured under one protocol on 24 datasets, and gives an exact diagnosis and fix for the one that buys nothing. The diagnosis concerns the natural way to deepen a soft decision tree: turn every leaf into a gate whose two children inherit the parent's class distribution, so the function is unchanged. I prove that this leaves the gradient of every new gate identically zero and with the gate at 1/2, gives the two children identical gradients, so under this construction the added level can never learn. That predicts where it costs: nothing on two-class problems, where two leaves already suffice and a great deal where more classes need more leaves. Measured, the cost is -0.2 points over 13 binary datasets and 40.2 points over 7 multi-class ones, and it tracks the number of classes (Spearman 0.64), not the number of features (0.03). The fix is any perturbation of the children. Neither its size nor its direction matters: a residual-directed initialisation changes accuracy by +0.20 points against noise. The other three decisions each buy one thing. Fitting a new hidden unit to the residual before installing it buys a smaller network but not a more accurate one. Splitting one leaf at a time buys sparsity; it lost accuracy until I found that the split started its two children identical and untrained, the same defect in another place; with the children inheriting the parent and the symmetry broken, per-leaf growth comes within 2.3 points of a complete tree using 23% of its splits. Requiring statistical significance before a node gets a more expressive split buys nothing. Every number comes from the measurement scripts.
papers.comment: v2: twenty OpenML datasets added, the per-leaf growth defect found and fixed, claims scoped to the construction. 13 pages, 7 tables. Code and measurement scripts: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22718897
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在统一协议下比较四种增量式构建分类器的生长决策，证明软决策树按自然方式加深（把叶子变成门、两个子节点继承父节点类别分布）时新门的梯度恒为零，该层永远学不到。实测代价在 13 个二分类数据集上为 -0.2 个百分点，在 7 个多分类数据集上为 -40.2 个百分点，且随类别数（Spearman 0.64）而非特征数（0.03）增长；对子节点做任意扰动即可修复，残差定向初始化相对噪声仅差 +0.20 个百分点。
Motivation: 增量式（constructive）分类器在训练中逐层、逐单元、逐叶子加结构，但每种生长决策到底带来什么收益缺少统一测量，其中软决策树加深这一决策被怀疑完全学不到东西，需要精确诊断。
Method: 在 24 个数据集的统一协议下测量四种生长决策：加深软决策树（叶子变门、子节点继承父节点类别分布）、把新隐单元拟合到残差后再装入、逐叶子分裂、以及节点获得更表达性分裂前要求统计显著性；对梯度做解析证明并用测量脚本复现全部数字，v2 补充 20 个 OpenML 数据集。
Result: 加深缺陷在 13 个二分类数据集上损失 -0.2 个百分点，在 7 个多分类数据集上损失 -40.2 个百分点；代价与类别数相关（Spearman 0.64），与特征数无关（0.03）。修复用子节点扰动，方向和大小都不重要，残差定向初始化相对噪声仅 +0.20 个百分点。逐叶子分裂在修复对称缺陷后，用完整树 23% 的分裂数达到距其 2.3 个百分点以内的精度；拟合残差的新隐单元带来更小网络但不更准；显著性门控的分裂买不到任何东西。
Conclusion: 按继承父节点分布的方式加深软决策树这一构造本身无法学习，任何打破子节点对称的扰动即可修复；逐叶子生长在修复同一缺陷后能以 23% 的分裂数换取稀疏性，而显著性门控的表达性分裂没有收益。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 按继承父节点分布的方式加深软决策树这一构造本身无法学习，任何打破子节点对称的扰动即可修复；逐叶子生长在修复同一缺陷后能以 23% 的分裂数换取稀疏性，而显著性门控的表达性分裂没有收益。

papers.title: Reading the Whole Heart: Latent-Attention Masked Autoencoders for Multimodal Cardiac Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Cardiovascular diagnosis and treatment rest on integrating complementary modalities, such as electrocardiogram, echocardiography, and chest X-rays, each capturing distinct but complementary aspects of cardiac pathophysiology. Yet most medical foundation models remain modality-specific, combining modalities only for finetuning or post-training. This discards the cross-modal evidence clinicians naturally integrate and ignores the structure within each modality. We introduce Latent-Attention Masked Autoencoder (LAMAE), a multimodal, structure-aware masked autoencoder that jointly learns patient-level representations during self-supervised pretraining. Instead of fusing modalities post hoc, LAMAE exchanges information directly in the latent space through a shared latent-attention module operating over a study-view-entity hierarchy, enabling aggregation of variable observations and handling of missing modalities. Pretrained on over 500'000 MIMIC-IV hospital stays, LAMAE outperforms modality-specific pretraining and strong contrastive and vision-language baselines across multimodal hospital-stay tasks, such as in-hospital mortality, ICD-10 and DRG coding, and length of stay, while remaining competitive on unimodal tasks. Modeling this structure also pays off within a single modality: even without cross-modal information, the latent-attention module improves representations over modality-specific pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Latent-Attention Masked Autoencoder (LAMAE)，在自监督预训练阶段就通过共享 latent-attention 模块在 study-view-entity 层级上直接交换信息，联合学习患者级多模态表示，而非事后融合。在超过 500,000 条 MIMIC-IV 住院记录上预训练后，它在院内死亡、ICD-10 与 DRG 编码、住院时长等多模态住院任务上超过模态专用预训练及对比学习、视觉-语言基线，单模态任务仍具竞争力；即便不跨模态，latent-attention 也优于模态专用预训练。
Motivation: 多数医学基础模型是模态专用的，只在微调或后训练阶段融合，丢掉了临床医生本会整合的跨模态证据，也忽略各模态内部结构。
Method: LAMAE 是结构感知的多模态掩码自编码器：在潜空间中通过共享 latent-attention 模块沿 study-view-entity 层级直接交换信息，从而聚合数量可变的观测并处理缺失模态；以自监督方式联合学习患者级表示，预训练数据为超过 500,000 条 MIMIC-IV 住院记录。
Result: 在 MIMIC-IV 上预训练后，于院内死亡、ICD-10 与 DRG 编码、住院时长等多模态住院任务上优于模态专用预训练以及强对比学习与视觉-语言基线，同时在单模态任务上保持竞争力；在单一模态内，即使没有跨模态信息，latent-attention 模块也改进了表示。
Conclusion: 把跨模态融合放进预训练的潜空间并显式建模 study-view-entity 结构，能同时提升多模态住院任务与单模态表示质量，事后融合是不必要的。
Relevance: 4
