papers.title: DCCQ: From Ordered Bernoulli Levels to Critical-Line Geometry: Integer Quantization, Bernoulli Residual Phase, and Prime-Power Spectra
papers.abstract_en: We present the discrete--complex complement quotient (DCCQ) framework through the ordered Bernoulli-word kernel $f(p,n,k)=p^k(1-p)^{n-k}$ and its inverse-integer level sets. The binary level $2^{-n}$ selects $p=1/2$ as the unique real split-independent anchor. Imposing the additional continuation rule $1-z=\overline z$ gives the conjugation-symmetric line $z=1/2+iu$. On the central normalized branch, the inverse-level split $κ=k/n$ also has real part $1/2$. The quadratic coordinate $Q(z)=1/4+u^2$ identifies complementary conjugate points, has minimum $1/4$, and has an explicit two-sign inverse; restricting its values to integers defines an arithmetic quantization. For supplied positive critical-line zero ordinates $γ_k$, the induced level has the exact decomposition \[ L_k=\frac14+γ_k^2=N_k+δ_k,\qquad δ_k=\widetilde B_1\!\left(γ_k^2+\frac34\right), \] where $N_k=\lfloor L_k+1/2\rfloor$ and $\widetilde B_1(x)=\{x\}-1/2$. The integer--phase pair $(N_k,e^{2πiδ_k})$ retains the level and the positive ordinate. Prime-exponent coordinates describe the factorization of the integer component, while conditional Fourier moments formulate an open question about the residual phases. The finite numerical diagnostics are descriptive. A distinct complex exponent $s$ gives an inverse-level representation of the supplied term $m^{-s}$; direct substitution cancels the auxiliary coordinates. These terms assemble into the classical Dirichlet series and Euler product for $\Re s>1$. The framework organizes exact coordinate identities, classical zeta connections, and numerical diagnostics; it establishes neither conditional equidistribution nor a zero-location theorem.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Substantially revised: clarified inverse-level branch handling, Bernoulli/zeta/zero connections, statistical scope, rounding and phase conventions, and numerical provenance; streamlined figures and exposition. Main propositions and conclusions unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DCCQ 框架用有序 Bernoulli 词核 f(p,n,k)=p^k(1-p)^{n-k} 的倒数整数水平集，把临界线几何编码为整数-相位对 (N_k, e^{2πiδ_k})：给定零点纵坐标 γ_k，水平 L_k=1/4+γ_k² 精确分解为 N_k=floor(L_k+1/2) 与残差相位 δ_k=B̃₁(γ_k²+3/4)，该对完整保留水平与正纵坐标。框架只整理精确坐标恒等式、经典 zeta 联系与描述性数值诊断，明确不建立条件等分布或零点定位定理。
Motivation: 临界线上的零点纵坐标与整数/素数结构之间缺少统一的坐标语言：既有工作要么直接处理零点分布，要么处理 Dirichlet 级数，难以把单个零点的水平值与整数分解、相位信息放进同一套可逆表示。
Method: 以 Bernoulli 核 f(p,n,k)=p^k(1-p)^{n-k} 及其倒数整数水平集为起点，二进制水平 2^{-n} 锚定 p=1/2，附加延拓规则 1-z=z̄ 得到共轭对称线 z=1/2+iu；用二次坐标 Q(z)=1/4+u² 定义算术量化，对给定 γ_k 作 L_k=N_k+δ_k 分解，再以素数指数坐标描述 N_k 的因子分解，并用条件 Fourier 矩阵提出关于残差相位的开放问题；另构造复指数 s 的倒数水平表示使 m^{-s} 中辅助坐标相消，重组出 ℜs>1 的 Dirichlet 级数与 Euler 乘积。
Result: 精确恒等式 L_k=1/4+γ_k²=N_k+δ_k，其中 N_k=⌊L_k+1/2⌋、δ_k=B̃₁(γ_k²+3/4)，(N_k, e^{2πiδ_k}) 保留水平与正纵坐标；Q(z) 最小值为 1/4 且有显式双符号逆；倒数水平表示下 m^{-s} 的辅助坐标直接相消，重组为 ℜs>1 的经典 Dirichlet 级数与 Euler 乘积；有限数值诊断为描述性。
Conclusion: 临界线零点纵坐标可被整数-相位对无损参数化，整数分量的素数指数坐标与残差相位的 Fourier 矩阵分别对接因子分解与开放问题；该框架是坐标组织工具，不提供条件等分布或零点定位结论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Reliable, Generalizable, and Specific In-Context Knowledge Editing via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful but limited by static parametric knowledge that becomes outdated once pretraining ends. Knowledge editing addresses this problem by updating model behavior on target facts without full retraining. In particular, in-context knowledge editing has gained attention because it is training-free and readily applicable to black-box LLMs. Recent reinforcement learning (RL)-based approaches improve over fixed retrieval strategies by adapting prompt construction to the quantity-quality trade-off. Despite initial success, they fail to model the prompt as a structured entity under the distinct and often competing objectives of reliability, generality, and specificity. Previous methods largely optimize a single objective and make decisions over only part of the prompt construction process, thereby overlooking both the balance of different objectives and the global organization of demonstrations. We propose Multi-Objective In-context Knowledge Editing (MO-IKE), a multi-objective RL algorithm that formulates prompt construction for in-context knowledge editing as a Constrained Markov Decision Process. MO-IKE trains a dynamic retriever to optimize competing objectives in knowledge editing, enabling more balanced and globally coherent prompt construction. On Llama-3.2, MO-IKE improves edit success (reliability) from 85.0% to 92.0%, paraphrase consistency (generality) from 77% to 79%, while increasing retention rate (specificity) by 23.0% compared to prior RL-based methods.
papers.comment: Our work proposes a multi-objective reinforcement learning algorithm that optimizes prompt construction for reliable, generalizable, and specific in-context knowledge-editing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MO-IKE 把上下文知识编辑 (in-context knowledge editing) 的 prompt 构造建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程 (Constrained MDP)，用多目标强化学习同时优化可靠性、泛化性与特异性三个竞争目标，训练一个动态 retriever 做全局的示例组织。在 Llama-3.2 上，编辑成功率 (reliability) 从 85.0% 提到 92.0%，paraphrase consistency 从 77% 到 79%，retention rate 相对先前 RL 方法提高 23.0%。
Motivation: LLM 参数知识在预训练结束后即过期，全量重训代价高；现有 RL 上下文知识编辑方法只优化单一目标、且只决策 prompt 构造的部分环节，忽略了多目标平衡与示例的全局组织。
Method: 提出 MO-IKE：将 prompt 构造形式化为 Constrained MDP，训练动态 retriever 在可靠性、泛化性、特异性三个竞争目标下做多目标优化，覆盖完整的 prompt 构造过程；方法为 training-free、适用于黑盒 LLM 的上下文知识编辑。
Result: 在 Llama-3.2 上，相对先前 RL 方法：edit success (reliability) 85.0% → 92.0%，paraphrase consistency (generality) 77% → 79%，retention rate (specificity) 提高 23.0%。
Conclusion: 把 prompt 构造当作受约束的多目标序列决策问题，可以在不重训 LLM 的情况下同时抬高知识编辑的可靠性、泛化性与特异性，而非在三者间取舍。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MG-VQA: Manipulation Grounded Visual Question Answering with VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promising spatial reasoning capabilities from static visual inputs, where the evidence needed to answer a question is available in the provided views. However, in cluttered environments, answer-relevant evidence may be occluded rather than absent: an object may lie beneath a pile, be covered by another object, or have identifying information facing away from the camera. Answering such questions requires physical interaction to reveal the hidden evidence. We formalize this setting as Manipulation-Grounded Visual Question Answering (MG-VQA), where an agent answers a question about an initially cluttered scene by using manipulation as an intermediate evidence-gathering operation. We introduce MG-VQA-Bench, comprising 600 human-verified questions across four spatial reasoning tasks, and evaluate it in a cluttered tabletop interactive environment. Eight VLMs are evaluated under three levels of environment access: Direct (image only), Perception (pointing, segmentation, and scene graphs), and Manipulation (perception, grasping, and pushing). Across all models, Direct and Perception achieve average success rates of 36.2% and 37.6%, respectively, only slightly above an image-blind chance baseline of 32.7%. In contrast, Manipulation raises average success to 56.8% (40.8-83.0% across models). Stronger tool-calling VLMs, GPT~6~Astra (83.0%) and Gemini~3.8~Flash (69.3%), search persistently and re-ground after unsuccessful interactions, while weaker models often answer without gathering sufficient evidence or stop prematurely after failed actions. Our results highlight the need for VLM agents that use manipulation for persistent, physically grounded evidence gathering and recovery. Code and benchmark is available here: https://github.com/vineet2104/MG-VQA
papers.comment: The previous version of this paper (V1) was called: "Probe: Manipulation-Grounded Visual Question Answering with VLM Agents"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MG-VQA 把「证据被遮挡而非不存在」的桌面杂乱场景 VQA 形式化为 Manipulation-Grounded VQA：智能体用抓取、推动作为中间取证操作来揭示隐藏证据。在 MG-VQA-Bench（600 道人工核验问题、四类空间推理任务）上评测 8 个 VLM，Direct 与 Perception 平均成功率仅 36.2% 和 37.6%，几乎贴着 image-blind 随机基线 32.7%；加入 Manipulation 后平均成功率升到 56.8%（各模型 40.8–83.0%）。
Motivation: 静态图像 VQA 假设答题所需证据都在视野内，但杂乱环境中证据常被压在堆下、被别的物体盖住或标识朝向背离相机，纯看图无法作答，必须靠物理交互把证据翻出来。
Method: 提出 MG-VQA 任务形式化与 MG-VQA-Bench（600 道人工核验问题、四个空间推理任务），置于杂乱桌面交互环境；按环境访问能力分三档评测 8 个 VLM：Direct（仅图像）、Perception（指点、分割、场景图）、Manipulation（感知 + 抓取 + 推动）。
Result: Direct 与 Perception 平均成功率 36.2% 与 37.6%，仅略高于 image-blind 随机基线 32.7%；Manipulation 把平均成功率抬到 56.8%，跨模型区间 40.8–83.0%。工具调用强的 GPT~6~Astra 达 83.0%、Gemini~3.8~Flash 达 69.3%，会持续搜索并在交互失败后重新定位；弱模型常在证据不足时直接作答或失败动作后提前停止。
Conclusion: 仅靠视觉感知无法解决被遮挡证据的问答，物理操作是把成功率从约 37% 抬到 56.8% 的关键；作者主张 VLM 智能体要能持久地用操纵取证并在失败后恢复。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 提出 MG-VQA 任务形式化与 MG-VQA-Bench（600 道人工核验问题、四个空间推理任务），置于杂乱桌面交互环境；按环境访问能力分三档评测 8 个 VLM：Direct（仅图像）、Perception（指点、分割、场景图）、Manipulation（感知 + 抓取 + 推动）。
summary_sections.result: Direct 与 Perception 平均成功率 36.2% 与 37.6%，仅略高于 image-blind 随机基线 32.7%；Manipulation 把平均成功率抬到 56.8%，跨模型区间 40.8–83.0%。工具调用强的 GPT~6~Astra 达 83.0%、Gemini~3.8~Flash 达 69.3%，会持续搜索并在交互失败后重新定位；弱模型常在证据不足时直接作答或失败动作后提前停止。
summary_sections.conclusion: 仅靠视觉感知无法解决被遮挡证据的问答，物理操作是把成功率从约 37% 抬到 56.8% 的关键；作者主张 VLM 智能体要能持久地用操纵取证并在失败后恢复。

papers.title: Dimensionality and Measurement Precision in HLE's Multiple-Choice Subset
papers.abstract_en: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) is widely used to evaluate frontier language models. HLE organizes its questions into eight subject-domain categories, whose subscores are often interpreted as evidence of distinct capabilities. However, no study has assessed whether these labels correspond to empirically separable latent constructs, nor whether the benchmark effectively differentiates between models of similar ability. We evaluate 29 LLMs on the text-only multiple-choice subset of HLE and apply psychometric methods to assess both the dimensionality of the benchmark and the distribution of its measurement precision. Fitting a two-parameter logistic IRT model, we find that HLE is dominated by a single general reasoning factor: domain labels explain only 3.5\% of variance in the leading principal components of item responses, and within- and between-domain residual correlations are nearly identical (Cohen's $d = 0.016$). A simulation study with the same number of models ($N = 29$) shows that our analyses would detect clearly distinct domain abilities, so their absence is informative; however, small domain-specific differences cannot be ruled out, and model rankings vary across domains somewhat more than a single factor predicts. A separate analysis of the test information function reveals that measurement precision concentrates at moderate ability levels and drops sharply above $θ= 0$, where the strongest models sit. These findings suggest that the subset's domain subscores do not warrant distinct capability interpretations and that its ability to discriminate among the strongest models might be limited.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) 纯文本多选子集做心理测量学检验：29 个 LLM 上拟合两参数 logistic IRT，发现八个学科标签几乎不构成可分维度——领域标签仅解释题目反应主成分 3.5% 的方差，域内与域间残差相关几乎相同 (Cohen's d = 0.016)。测量精度集中在中等能力区，θ>0 处急剧下降，而最强模型正落在该区，故学科子分数不支持独立能力解读、对最强模型的区分力可能有限。
Motivation: HLE 的八个学科子分数常被当作不同能力的证据，但从未有研究检验这些标签是否对应经验上可分的潜在构念，也未检验该基准能否区分能力相近的模型。
Method: 在 HLE 纯文本多选子集上评测 29 个 LLM，拟合两参数 logistic 项目反应理论 (IRT) 模型，用主成分分析与残差相关比较域内/域间结构，并做同规模 (N=29) 的模拟研究检验方法的检出能力，另分析测验信息函数 (test information function) 随能力 θ 的分布。
Result: 领域标签仅解释题目反应主成分 3.5% 的方差；域内与域间残差相关几乎一致 (Cohen's d = 0.016)。N=29 的模拟显示该分析本可检出明确分离的领域能力，故缺失是信息性的；但小的领域特异差异不能排除，且模型排名跨领域的变动略大于单一因子预测。测验信息在中等能力处集中，θ=0 以上急剧下降，最强模型位于此区间。
Conclusion: HLE 文本多选子集由单一一般推理因子主导，其学科子分数不支持区分能力的解读，对最强模型的判别能力可能受限；作者同时指出小的领域差异仍无法排除。

papers.title: Medical foundation models converge less under label supervision
papers.abstract_en: Diagnostic classifiers and imaging biomarkers are fitted on the embeddings of medical foundation models. These models are replaced as new versions appear. This practice assumes that different models represent images alike. We tested this assumption with more than 750,000 images from 14 datasets in five imaging modalities, 18 public models, and 101 models trained on chest radiographs and histopathology that differ in pretraining objective, label type, size, random seed, initialization, or training patients. Agreement was measured as the mutual k-nearest-neighbor overlap, the share of an image's nearest neighbors common to two models. Two public models shared on average 0.091 of the 10 nearest neighbors of a chest radiograph. A randomly initialized network shared 0.036 with them. In the four other modalities, they shared at most 0.300. Convergence depended on the pretraining objective. Models trained with label supervision converged least in all five controlled settings. On chest radiographs, two label-supervised models that differed only in their random seed shared 0.062 to 0.100 of their nearest neighbors. Two models trained with self-distillation, masked image modeling, or contrastive pretraining shared 0.411 to 0.802. On chest radiographs, agreement depended more on the source dataset and the radiographic view than on the findings. It was not significantly associated with accuracy. A linear mapping between the embeddings of two models, fitted on 4,096 unlabeled radiographs, transferred classifiers for 14 chest findings with 0.987 of their original area under the receiver operating characteristic curve. Convergence can therefore be chosen when a model is trained. A chest radiograph classifier can be transferred to a new model without new labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 750,000+ 张图像、14 个数据集、5 种成像模态上测 18 个公开医学基础模型与 101 个受控训练模型的嵌入一致性（mutual k-NN overlap），发现标签监督 (label supervision) 训练的模型在全部五种受控设置下收敛最少：胸片上仅随机种子不同的两个标签监督模型只共享 0.062–0.100 的近邻，而自蒸馏、掩码图像建模或对比预训练的模型共享 0.411–0.802。一致性与准确率无显著关联，因此训练时即可选择收敛性；用 4,096 张无标签胸片拟合两个模型嵌入间的线性映射，可把 14 项胸片发现的分类器迁移到新模型并保留 0.987 的原始 AUROC。
Motivation: 诊断分类器与影像生物标志物都拟合在基础模型嵌入之上，而模型会随新版本被替换，这一做法默认不同模型对图像的表示方式相似；该假设此前未经系统检验。
Method: 在 14 个数据集、5 种成像模态的 750,000+ 张图像上，比较 18 个公开模型与 101 个在胸片和组织病理上训练、仅在预训练目标、标签类型、规模、随机种子、初始化或训练患者上受控变化的模型；用 mutual k-nearest-neighbor overlap（两张图近邻集合的交集占比）度量一致性，并在 4,096 张无标签胸片上拟合两模型嵌入间的线性映射来迁移分类器。
Result: 两个公开模型在胸片上平均只共享 10 个最近邻中的 0.091，随机初始化网络与之共享 0.036；其余四种模态中二者最多共享 0.300。标签监督模型在全部五种受控设置下收敛最少：仅随机种子不同的两个标签监督模型共享 0.062–0.100，而自蒸馏/掩码图像建模/对比预训练的模型共享 0.411–0.802。胸片上一致性更多取决于源数据集与摄片体位而非病变发现，且与准确率无显著关联；线性映射迁移 14 项胸片发现的分类器保留 0.987 的原始 AUROC。
Conclusion: 模型间收敛性可以在训练阶段被主动选择，且胸片分类器无需新标签即可迁移到新模型；标签监督是收敛最少的预训练目标。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Online Control via Counterfactual Tracking
papers.abstract_en: We study online control of a known linear dynamical system with adversarial costs and bounded disturbances, measuring regret against a general class of benchmark policies. We introduce counterfactual tracking, which separates the challenge of learning from the challenge of controlling the system. An online learner builds a reference trajectory by selecting or averaging the trajectories that the benchmark policies would have generated under the realized costs and disturbances, and a corrective law steers the system toward that reference. Charging each change in the reference its recovery cost (the cost of steering the system onto the new reference) reduces the problem to online learning with switching costs. Conversely, under additional natural assumptions, we show that this reduction is tight: the two problems have the same minimax regret up to a system-dependent factor, uniformly over horizons and policy classes. The reduction gives sharp regret guarantees for policy classes beyond standard finite-memory parameterizations. For a class of $N$ possibly nonlinear or history-dependent policies, it achieves $O(\sqrt{T\log N})$ regret over $T$ rounds, provided their trajectories remain within a bounded distance of one another and recovery costs are bounded. For the full $\ell_1$ ball of disturbance-response controllers, it achieves $O(\sqrt{T\log T})$ regret, which is minimax optimal in $T$, without assuming a common decay rate for disturbance effects. The framework also improves the best known regret bounds for linear state-feedback policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线控制已知线性系统、对抗性代价与有界扰动时，counterfactual tracking 把「学习」与「控制」解耦：在线学习器按已实现的代价与扰动挑选或平均基准策略本会生成的轨迹作为参考轨迹，再用校正律把系统拉回该参考。把每次参考变更按其恢复代价计费，问题化归为带切换代价的在线学习，且该化归在附加假设下是紧的，两者 minimax regret 仅差一个系统相关因子。
Motivation: 对一般基准策略类做带扰动的在线控制时，学习与控制两个难点纠缠在一起，导致超越有限记忆参数化的策略类缺少尖锐的 regret 保证。
Method: counterfactual tracking 分离学习与控制：学习器在基准策略于已实现代价和扰动下本会产生的轨迹上做选择或平均，构成参考轨迹；校正律将系统导向该参考，并把每次参考变更按恢复代价（把系统重新驶上新参考的代价）计费，从而化归为带切换代价的在线学习；反向在附加自然假设下证明该化归是紧的。
Result: 对 N 个可能非线性或依赖历史的策略类，在轨迹彼此保持有界距离且恢复代价有界时达到 O(√(T log N)) regret（T 轮）；对完整的 ℓ1 扰动响应控制器球达到 O(√(T log T)) regret，在 T 上 minimax 最优，且不假设扰动效应具有共同衰减率；同时改进线性状态反馈策略的已知最优 regret 界。
Conclusion: 带恢复代价计费的参考轨迹化归把在线控制规约为带切换代价的在线学习，且在附加假设下是紧的，因此可把尖锐 regret 保证推广到有限记忆之外的策略类。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: The JEPA Predictor: A Transferable Operator for Occluded Feature Completion
papers.abstract_en: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) train a predictor jointly with their encoder, but downstream deployment discards the predictor and reads features from the encoder alone. The predictor is, by construction, a learned operator from visible-context features to features at masked positions, the structure a partial-view classifier needs. We show that this operator is portable across encoder families. We first establish that, at heavy mask, retaining the frozen predictor on a JEPA encoder substantially closes the accuracy gap against the strongest non-JEPA discriminative baselines. We then bolt the frozen predictors of I-JEPA and V-JEPA 2 onto four non-JEPA hosts (CLIP, DINOv3, DINOv2, MAE) through a single linear projection between feature spaces, fit in closed form on 500 ImageNet-1k images. Across both ImageNet-9 and Stanford Dogs and across three mask fractions, the lift over each host's masked-encoder baseline grows monotonically with the mask fraction K in every host-donor pair. CLIP paired with the I-JEPA predictor recovers most of the accuracy that masking removed on ImageNet-9 at heavy occlusion, and lifts fine-grained Stanford Dogs from 15.9% to 52.1% (+36 pp). The mechanism is identifiable: the projection pays a fixed cost on visible patches and the predictor provides a growing benefit on masked patches; the benefit dominates the heavy-occlusion regime. At low K on fine-grained classification the projection cost exceeds the benefit, defining the boundary where the linear bridge breaks down. The frozen JEPA predictor functions as a portable operator for occluded feature completion across encoder families, requiring no retraining of either model while fitting matched linear probes per mask fraction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JEPA 的 predictor 本身是从可见上下文特征到被掩码位置特征的算子，冻结后可跨 encoder 家族移植做遮挡特征补全。经单一线性投影（在 500 张 ImageNet-1k 图像上闭式拟合）接到 CLIP、DINOv3、DINOv2、MAE 四个非 JEPA host 上，在 ImageNet-9 与 Stanford Dogs、三种掩码比例下，相对 host 自身 masked-encoder 基线的提升随掩码比例 K 单调增大；重遮挡下 CLIP+I-JEPA predictor 在 Stanford Dogs 上从 15.9% 提到 52.1%（+36 pp）。低 K 时投影代价超过收益，构成该线性桥接失效的边界。
Motivation: JEPA 训练时联合训练 predictor，下游部署却丢弃 predictor 只用 encoder 特征；而部分可见输入的分类正需要这个从可见特征到掩码位置特征的算子，且该算子能否跨 encoder 家族复用尚不清楚。
Method: 把冻结的 I-JEPA 与 V-JEPA 2 predictor 接到 CLIP、DINOv3、DINOv2、MAE 四个非 JEPA host 上，两个特征空间之间只用一个线性投影，投影在 500 张 ImageNet-1k 图像上闭式拟合，两个模型都不重训；在 ImageNet-9 与 Stanford Dogs 上按每个掩码比例分别拟合匹配的 linear probe，比较三种掩码比例。

papers.title: Co-LMLM: Continuous-Query Limited Memory Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Externalizing knowledge in LLM pre-training is a promising avenue to achieve higher performance at smaller scales, control knowledge use, and overall increase model transparency. We propose continuous-query limited memory language models (Co-LMLM), an LLM that interleaves flexible vector retrieval queries with next-token predictions, and is pre-trained to copy knowledge returned from the KB, rather than memorize it. Co-LMLM is pre-trained with a scalable approach that jointly trains a knowledge-externalizing LLM, induces its knowledge base, and learns an expressive continuous retrieval mechanism. Across pre-training at multiple model scales, Co-LMLM outperforms prior knowledge-externalizing and vanilla LLMs in both perplexity and factual precision. At 360M scale, this includes lower perplexity than models pre-trained on 40$\times$ more data, and SimpleQA-verified performance that is in line with gpt-4o-mini and higher than Claude Sonnet 4.5.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Co-LMLM：在 LLM 预训练中把向量检索查询与 next-token 预测交替进行，让模型从知识库复制而非记忆知识，并用一套可扩展流程联合训练外化知识的 LLM、诱导其知识库、学习连续检索机制。在多个规模上其 perplexity 与 factual precision 均超过既往外化知识模型和普通 LLM；360M 规模下 perplexity 低于用 40 倍数据预训练的模型，SimpleQA-verified 表现与 gpt-4o-mini 相当、高于 Claude Sonnet 4.5。
Motivation: 把知识留在参数里使小模型性能受限、知识使用不可控也不透明；作者要在更小规模上取得更高性能并提升可控性与可解释性。
Method: Co-LMLM 在预训练中交替执行灵活的向量检索查询与 next-token 预测，训练目标是复制知识库返回的内容而非记忆；配套的可扩展预训练流程联合训练知识外化 LLM、诱导其知识库 (KB)，并学习一个表达力强的连续检索机制，跨多个模型规模进行预训练。
Result: 在多个预训练规模上，Co-LMLM 的 perplexity 与 factual precision 均优于既往外化知识模型与 vanilla LLM；360M 规模下 perplexity 低于在 40 倍数据上预训练的模型，SimpleQA-verified 表现与 gpt-4o-mini 相当并高于 Claude Sonnet 4.5。
Conclusion: 把知识外置到可检索知识库并训练模型去复制而非记忆，能在远小于常规的数据与模型规模下达到有竞争力的困惑度与事实精度。

papers.title: Safe Inference-Time Alignment via Lagrangian Reward Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time alignment steers a frozen language model during decoding using auxiliary reward signals, avoiding the cost of repeated weight updates. However, existing inference-time alignment methods typically optimize a single scalar score, so explicit safety constraints must either be ignored or encoded through manually tuned penalties. We propose Lagrangian Reward Augmentation (LARA), a general inference-time alignment framework under safety constraints. Starting from a KL-regularized constrained objective with a reward model and a cost model, LARA dualizes the constraint and reduces the optimization problem to a one-dimensional convex problem over a nonnegative dual variable. Estimated on a small calibration set, this dual variable defines an augmented reward that can be used as a drop-in scoring signal within existing inference-time alignment methods. For sequence-level sampling methods, such as Best-of-N reranking, the calibrated dual variable corresponds to the solution of the expected-cost constrained problem. For token-level reward-guided decoding methods, the same construction yields a principled dual-calibrated heuristic rather than an exact constrained-policy guarantee. We evaluate LARA on both sequence-level and token-level inference-time alignment methods, and find that LARA improves the helpfulness-harmlessness tradeoff, with Best-of-N achieving the best performance among inference-time methods, approaching finetuning-based direct alignment baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LARA 把带安全约束的 KL 正则目标对偶化为非负对偶变量上的一维凸问题，在小校准集上估计该变量并构造增广奖励，作为现成推理时对齐方法的即插即用打分信号。评测显示 LARA 改善 helpfulness-harmlessness 权衡，其中 Best-of-N 重排在推理时方法中表现最好，接近基于微调的 direct alignment 基线。
Motivation: 现有推理时对齐方法通常只优化单一标量奖励，安全约束要么被忽略，要么靠手工调惩罚项编码，缺少受约束的通用框架。
Method: 从带 reward model 与 cost model 的 KL 正则约束目标出发，将约束对偶化，把优化化简为非负对偶变量上的一维凸问题；在小校准集上估计该对偶变量，得到增广奖励，嵌入 Best-of-N 等序列级采样方法与 token 级奖励引导解码方法。序列级情形对应期望代价约束问题的解，token 级情形给出经对偶校准的启发式而非精确约束策略保证。
Result: 在序列级与 token 级两类推理时对齐方法上的评测中，LARA 改善 helpfulness-harmlessness 权衡；Best-of-N 在推理时方法中表现最佳，接近基于微调的 direct alignment 基线。
Conclusion: 把安全约束通过对偶变量折进增广奖励，可在不更新权重的前提下接入现有推理时对齐方法；序列级方法有期望代价约束的保证，token 级只是对偶校准的启发式。

papers.title: Beyond Compilation: Evaluating Faithful Natural-Language-to-Lean Statement Formalization
papers.abstract_en: Lean verifies that a generated declaration is well typed, but not that it states what the user intended. For statement autoformalization without canonical Lean targets, we study two questions: how far an LLM-based semantic criterion can be trusted, and how much compilation overstates faithfulness across systems. Our criterion requires Lean compilation and agreement of GPT-5.2 and Gemini-2.5-Pro. On an independently audited random sample, it agrees with the human majority on 91.5\% of cases (Wilson 95\% CI: 81.6--96.3\%); humans confirm 95.7\% of the outputs it accepts and 77--81\% of the outputs it rejects, so the criterion is reliable in aggregate and errs on the conservative side. A comparison with LeanScorer, an independent third-family judge, and a BEq formal cross-check support the same picture. Across eight systems evaluated on 227 graduate-level statements, the compile--faithfulness gap varies widely with the system, from 1.3 percentage points for one-shot Gemini-2.5-Pro to 29.5 points for a tool-augmented GPT-5.2 agent, which compiles 87.2\% of statements but is faithful on 57.7\%. A $2^3$ tool ablation of this agent shows that Lean feedback drives most of its gain in compilation, and nearly half of that gain consists of outputs that fail the semantic criterion.
papers.comment: v3: results recomputed on a revised 227-statement benchmark; conclusions unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在无标准 Lean 目标的语句自动形式化 (statement autoformalization) 中，「能编译」被证明系统性高估语义忠实性：用 Lean 编译 + GPT-5.2 与 Gemini-2.5-Pro 双模型一致作为语义判据，在 227 条研究生级语句上，八个系统的编译—忠实差距从 1.3 个百分点（one-shot Gemini-2.5-Pro）到 29.5 个百分点（工具增强 GPT-5.2 agent，编译 87.2% 但忠实仅 57.7%）。该 agent 的 2^3 工具消融显示 Lean 反馈贡献了大部分编译增益，而其中近一半增益是语义判据不通过的输出。
Motivation: Lean 只验证生成声明类型正确，不验证它是否表达用户本意；在没有标准 Lean 目标的情况下，用编译率衡量自动形式化质量会随系统不同而高估忠实性 1.3 到 29.5 个百分点。
Method: 语义判据要求同时满足 Lean 编译与 GPT-5.2、Gemini-2.5-Pro 两个模型的判断一致；在独立人工审核的随机样本上与人类多数意见对照，并用第三方判据家族 LeanScorer 与 BEq 形式化交叉检验佐证；在 227 条研究生级语句上评测八个系统，并对工具增强 GPT-5.2 agent 做 2^3 工具消融。
Result: 判据与人类多数意见一致率 91.5%（Wilson 95% CI 81.6–96.3%）；对判据接受的输出人类确认 95.7%，对拒绝的输出确认 77–81%。八个系统的编译—忠实差距为 1.3 到 29.5 个百分点：one-shot Gemini-2.5-Pro 差距 1.3 点，工具增强 GPT-5.2 agent 编译 87.2%、忠实 57.7%（差 29.5 点）。消融显示 Lean 反馈贡献该 agent 编译增益的大部分，其中近一半增益是语义判据不通过的输出；v3 结果在修订后的 227 条基准上重算，结论不变。
Conclusion: 编译成功不能作为忠实性的代理指标，且高估幅度随系统工具化程度而变；语义判据在总体上可靠并偏向保守，适合与编译率分开报告。

papers.title: Narrative-UFET: Narrative Generation for Ultra-Fine Entity Typing
papers.abstract_en: Ultra-fine entity typing (UFET) assigns highly specific types to entity mentions, but current approaches struggle with types in the long tail. We hypothesize that a key limitation is the reliance on sentence-level context, since disambiguating evidence is often spread across multiple sentences. Testing this has been difficult because all existing UFET resources are sentence-level. We present Narrative-UFET, a controlled extension of UFET in which each entity mention is paired with an automatically generated short, coherent narrative. Synthesizing narratives lets us isolate the effect of specific discourse properties. We experiment with two paired variants: one in which the entity's type is held constant across the narrative (Maintain) and one in which it shifts (Change). We show that narrative context yields consistent improvements on long-tail types over sentence-level baselines, with the Change variant providing the stronger signal. A comparison against naturally occurring contexts shows that synthetic narratives yield stronger gains, indicating that controlled discourse construction can surface signals that real text leaves implicit. Substantial room for improvement remains, suggesting open directions in both discourse modeling and narrative construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Narrative-UFET 把 UFET 的实体提及配上自动生成的连贯短叙事，用 Maintain（类型跨叙事保持不变）与 Change（类型发生转变）两个配对变体隔离话语属性的作用。结果显示叙事上下文在长尾类型上稳定优于句子级基线，且 Change 变体信号更强；与自然语境对比时合成叙事增益更大。
Motivation: 超细实体类型 (UFET) 的长尾类型难以判定，作者假设瓶颈在于依赖句子级上下文，而消歧证据常散布在多个句子；但现有 UFET 资源全部是句子级，难以检验这一假设。
Method: 构建 UFET 的受控扩展：为每个实体提及自动生成一段短而连贯的叙事，形成两个配对变体 Maintain 与 Change，分别让实体类型在叙事中保持不变或发生转变，从而隔离特定话语属性的影响；并与句子级基线及自然发生语境作对比。
Result: 叙事上下文在长尾类型上相对句子级基线取得一致改进，Change 变体给出更强信号；与自然语境相比，合成叙事带来更大增益，表明受控话语构造能显出真实文本中隐含的信号。
Conclusion: 受控的合成叙事能显式构造话语信号、改善长尾类型判定，但仍有 substantial 改进空间，话语建模与叙事生成都是开放方向。

summary_sections.motivation: 超细实体类型 (UFET) 的长尾类型难以判定，作者假设瓶颈在于依赖句子级上下文，而消歧证据常散布在多个句子；但现有 UFET 资源全部是句子级，难以检验这一假设。
summary_sections.method: 构建 UFET 的受控扩展：为每个实体提及自动生成一段短而连贯的叙事，形成两个配对变体 Maintain 与 Change，分别让实体类型在叙事中保持不变或发生转变，从而隔离特定话语属性的影响；并与句子级基线及自然发生语境作对比。
summary_sections.result: 叙事上下文在长尾类型上相对句子级基线取得一致改进，Change 变体给出更强信号；与自然语境相比，合成叙事带来更大增益，表明受控话语构造能显出真实文本中隐含的信号。
summary_sections.conclusion: 受控的合成叙事能显式构造话语信号、改善长尾类型判定，但仍有 substantial 改进空间，话语建模与叙事生成都是开放方向。

papers.title: Neural Voxel Dynamics: Learning Volumetric Feature Advection for 3D Physics in V-JEPA Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: We present Neural Voxel Dynamics, a self-supervised framework for learning 3D latent dynamics from monocular video. While generative video models now produce visually compelling motion, their predominantly 2D representations provide limited geometric structure for modeling and controlling physical interactions. Instead, we learn dynamics in a lifted volumetric latent space. Specifically, we unproject semantic Video Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) features into a voxel grid using monocular depth priors, producing a geometrically grounded representation that retains rich video features. We then introduce Volumetric Feature Advection, an action-conditioned transition model that predicts the evolution of these latent features directly in 3D. Unlike hybrid approaches that assume access to privileged physics-engine states or explicit simulation during training and/or inference, we learn only using video-derived supervision and, if available, actions, allowing a single latent dynamics model to represent heterogeneous material-dependent phenomena, unifying rigid-body and fluid dynamics. We evaluate across multiple datasets (synthetic and real) and unseen scenarios (e.g., new boundary conditions, OOD generalization), measuring both predictive fidelity and 3D geometric consistency. We report physical plausibility with Physics-IQ using videos decoded from predicted latent states and videos generated from predicted optical flow. Our results show that geometrically lifting pretrained video latent representations provides a scalable route toward dynamic world models that learn structured 3D physical dynamics without access to privileged simulator state.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Neural Voxel Dynamics 用单目深度先验把 V-JEPA 视频特征反投影到体素网格，在体素潜空间里用动作条件化的 Volumetric Feature Advection 直接预测 3D 潜特征演化，仅靠视频监督（及可得的动作）训练。结果显示几何抬升预训练视频潜表征可得到统一刚体与流体的结构化 3D 动力学世界模型，无需特权仿真器状态，并在合成与真实数据集、未见边界条件与 OOD 场景上检验预测保真度与 3D 几何一致性，物理合理性用 Physics-IQ 度量。
Motivation: 生成式视频模型的表征以 2D 为主，几何结构不足，难以建模和控制物理交互；混合方法又依赖特权物理引擎状态或显式仿真。
Method: 用单目深度先验将语义 V-JEPA 特征反投影 (unproject) 到体素网格，得到有几何依据的体积潜表征；再引入动作条件化的 Volumetric Feature Advection 转移模型，直接在 3D 中预测潜特征演化；训练只用视频导出的监督与可得动作，不接触仿真器状态。
Result: 在多个数据集（合成与真实）及未见场景（新边界条件、OOD 泛化）上评估预测保真度与 3D 几何一致性；物理合理性用 Physics-IQ 度量，评测素材为从预测潜状态解码的视频与由预测光学流生成的视频。
Conclusion: 几何抬升预训练视频潜表征是通向动态世界模型的可扩展路径：单一潜动力学模型即可统一刚体与流体等材料相关现象，且无需特权仿真器状态。

papers.title: Quantile Adaptive Temperature Scaling for Confidence Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks often produce poorly calibrated confidence estimates, overstating their certainty even when predictions are incorrect. Temperature Scaling remains the most widely used posthoc calibration method due to its simplicity and effectiveness, yet its global, uniform rescaling of logits fails to correct the highly heterogeneous structure of miscalibration observed across the confidence spectrum. In particular, the largest correctness confidence discrepancies arise in different quantile regions depending on the setting, low confidence predictions, where uncertainty matters most, tend to exhibit the largest correctness confidence discrepancies, which standard TS leaves largely unaddressed. We introduce Quantile Adaptive Temperature Scaling (QaTS), a simple and efficient post hoc calibration method that adapts the temperature as a function of a predictions empirical confidence quantile. By mapping confidences into the quantile space, QaTS normalizes the calibration problem, makes the structure of miscalibration explicit and enables a monotone temperature function that adapts across quantiles while leaving well calibrated high confidence predictions largely unchanged. preserving high confidence behavior. This quantile aware formulation aligns naturally with a reparameterized Expected Calibration Error (ECE) objective and yields a sample wise temperature that is robust across a variety of challenging scenarios, such as class imbalance and distributional shifts. Across a broad range of datasets, architectures, evaluation scenarios and diverse tasks, QaTS consistently, and substantially, outperforms state of the art post hoc calibration methods, delivering more reliable and trustworthy confidence estimates without modifying model predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QaTS 把温度从全局标量改成预测经验置信分位数的单调函数，在分位数空间归一化校准问题，使失准结构显式化，并与重参数化的 ECE 目标对齐。它在大量数据集、架构与任务上持续且大幅优于现有后校准方法，同时不改动模型预测，高置信段基本保持原状。
Motivation: Temperature Scaling 用全局统一的 logit 重缩放，无法纠正置信度谱上高度异质的失准结构；而低置信预测（不确定性最关键处）的正确性-置信度落差最大，标准 TS 基本没有处理。
Method: 提出 Quantile Adaptive Temperature Scaling (QaTS)：把置信度映射到经验分位数空间，令温度成为分位数的单调函数，得到样本级温度；目标函数与重参数化的 Expected Calibration Error (ECE) 对齐，属 post hoc 方法，不修改模型预测。
Result: 在广泛的数据集、架构、评估场景与多样任务上，QaTS 一致且大幅优于 state of the art 后校准方法；高置信且已校准的预测基本不被改动，并在类别不平衡与分布偏移等困难场景下给出稳健的样本级温度。
Conclusion: 把温度按置信分位数自适应而非全局统一，可以在不改预测的前提下给出更可靠的置信估计，且能保住高置信段的既有校准行为。

papers.title: Edge-Aligned Beam Placement in Scanning Probe Tomography via Reconstruction-Free Sequential Design of Experiments
papers.abstract_en: In X-ray scanning probe tomography, reconstruction quality generally improves with larger numbers of projections. However, additional projections increase experiment costs, acquisition time, and the radiation dose imparted to the sample. One mitigation to these trade-offs is to adopt a sequential design of experiments, in which each subsequent measurement is determined as a function of previously acquired data in order to maximize information gain. In scanning probe tomography, a widely used heuristic to maximize information is to align beams with the edges of the sample. A key challenge, however, is that the true sample is unknown, so identifying edge-aligned beams typically requires reconstructing the sample based on available measurements. This work proposes a novel sequential design method that identifies edge-aligned measurements directly from the sinogram, bypassing any reconstruction, thereby improving computational efficiency and reducing the experimental design's susceptibility to reconstruction errors. Our method dynamically selects the next set of measurement beams by maximizing an acquisition function that balances exploration and exploitation over the domain of all possible measurements, improving reconstruction quality while reducing measurement redundancy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 X 射线扫描探针断层成像 (scanning probe tomography) 中提出免重建的序贯实验设计方法：直接从 sinogram 构造平衡探索与利用的采集函数 (acquisition function)，动态选出下一批与样品边缘对齐的测量光束，绕过中间重建步骤。该做法在提升重建质量、减少测量冗余的同时提高计算效率，并降低对重建误差的敏感性。
Motivation: 投影数越多重建质量越好，但会增加实验成本、采集时间与样品辐射剂量；而常用的边缘对齐启发式需要先重建样品才能识别边缘，真实样品未知时既耗算力又易受重建误差影响。
Method: 提出免重建 (reconstruction-free) 的序贯实验设计：直接由 sinogram 判定边缘对齐测量，在全部可能测量域上最大化一个平衡探索与利用的采集函数，动态选择下一组测量光束，从而跳过中间样品重建。
Result: 方法在不进行中间重建的条件下识别边缘对齐测量，作者称其可提升重建质量、减少测量冗余，并提高计算效率、降低实验设计对重建误差的敏感性。
Conclusion: 边缘对齐的测量选择可以直接从 sinogram 完成，无需先重建样品；免重建的序贯设计同时改善重建质量与计算效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Task-Error Residual Learning for Real-Robot Five-Ball Juggling
papers.abstract_en: For residual learning that refines existing behavior, sample efficiency depends on two things: how much information each rollout returns, and how efficiently the learner uses that information. Reinforcement learning's standard scalar reward carries far less information than the directional task error that defines the task. Random exploration further discards whatever information each rollout returns. Through residual learning with directional task-error supervision and a task error model that drives sample selection, we achieve stable three-, four-, and five-ball juggling on anthropomorphic Barrett WAM arms. Despite planning and controlling through a simple, idealized stack, the system converges from the second attempt. The first attempt drops, after which task error decreases monotonically without further failures. In comparison, five-ball juggling typically takes humans years of practice. We compare residual learners across two ternary axes, the directional information in the learning feedback and the commitment of the analytic prior, spanning Newton-style Jacobian updates, Composite Bayesian Optimization, and stochastic search methods. Both axes prove necessary for fast convergence: neither directional feedback nor an informative prior alone matches their combination, and the simplest method that combines them, a fixed-Jacobian Newton update, is the fastest and fully reliable. The learned residual tolerates substantial prior misalignment and degraded joint tracking, affecting mainly convergence speed. The bottleneck for residual learning on real robots is therefore the information content of the supervision signal and how the learner uses it, not the accuracy of the surrounding stack. Video documentation of all experiments is available at https://kai-ploeger.com/residual-juggling.
papers.comment: Accepted at ISRR 2026. Revised to a 20-seed rerun with an updated method-comparison figure; review fixes to notation, acronyms and wording; second author added
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Barrett WAM 仿人手臂上做五球杂耍的残差学习 (residual learning)，用方向性任务误差替代标量 reward 作监督，并让任务误差模型驱动样本选择，从第二次尝试即收敛，首次掉球后误差单调下降且不再失败。对比两条轴（反馈的方向信息量、解析先验的确定度）发现二者缺一不可，最简单的固定 Jacobian Newton 更新最快且完全可靠。
Motivation: 残差学习要在真实机器人上快速改进既有行为，瓶颈在于每次 rollout 返回多少信息以及学习器如何利用它：标量 reward 信息量远低于任务本身的方向性误差，随机探索又丢弃了 rollout 的其余信息。
Method: 以方向性任务误差作监督的残差学习，配合驱动样本选择的任务误差模型；在两条三值轴上对比不同残差学习器——反馈的方向信息量与解析先验的确定度，涵盖 Newton 式 Jacobian 更新、Composite Bayesian Optimization 与随机搜索方法。规划与控制只用一个简单的理想化 stack，实验为 20-seed 重跑。
Result: 在 Barrett WAM 上实现稳定三球、四球、五球杂耍：第二次尝试即收敛，首次尝试掉球后任务误差单调下降且无进一步失败；对照人类通常需要数年练习。两条轴均被证明是快速收敛的必要条件——仅有方向性反馈或仅有信息性先验都无法匹配二者组合，而组合方式最简单的固定 Jacobian Newton 更新最快且完全可靠。学习到的残差能容忍较大的先验失配与退化的关节跟踪，二者主要影响收敛速度。
Conclusion: 真实机器人上残差学习的瓶颈是监督信号的信息量及其利用方式，而非外围 stack 的精度；方向性任务误差加确定的解析先验是快速可靠收敛的组合。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MMBU: A Massive Multi-modal Biomedical Understanding Benchmark to Probe the Perception Capabilities of Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision and language models (VLMs) hold immense promise to transform biomedical imaging workflows, from detecting lesions in chest X-rays to profiling cellular features in microscopy. Realizing this potential, however, requires robust and fine-grained visual perception. Models need to correctly interpret subtle features in images, and they must do so across diverse biomedical modalities, scales, and contexts. Nevertheless, current benchmarks remain limited. To address these gaps, we introduce the Massive Multimodal Biomedical Understanding (MMBU) benchmark. It is the largest biomedical vision and language benchmark to date, covering 35 submodalities with rich structured metadata. It includes both open and closed versions of ungrounded classification, grounded classification, and object detection, enabling systematic evaluation of model performance across biological scales, clinical settings, and imaging modalities. Evaluating 16 open-weight and 5 frontier VLMs in the main comparison, we find that while medical adaptation provides measurable gains for some models, the high accuracy often reported on established benchmarks can mask deficiencies in visual perception and domain generalization. We further define an open-ended MMBU hard set, split into a released public subset and a held-out private subset, to stress-test frontier models.
papers.comment: Expanded model results, revised evaluation description, and updated supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MMBU 是迄今最大的生物医学视觉-语言基准，覆盖 35 个子模态并带结构化元数据，含无定位分类、有定位分类与目标检测三类开放与封闭版本任务。主对比评测 16 个开放权重与 5 个前沿 VLM，发现医学适配对部分模型有可测提升，但既有基准上的高准确率会掩盖视觉感知与领域泛化的真实缺陷；另设 MMBU hard set（公开子集 + 私有留出子集）专门压测前沿模型。
Motivation: 现有生物医学 VLM 基准覆盖不足，无法细粒度检验模型在不同生物尺度、临床场景与成像模态下的视觉感知能力，导致既有基准的高分掩盖真实短板。
Method: 构建 MMBU 基准：35 个子模态加结构化元数据，任务分无定位分类、有定位分类、目标检测三类，各设开放与封闭版本；主对比评测 16 个开放权重模型与 5 个前沿模型，并定义开放式的 MMBU hard set，拆为公开子集与私有留出子集。

papers.title: All you need to break LLMs are Black-Box, Adapting, Efficient, Transferable, Harmful, Applicable ... Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Accurately evaluating adversarial robustness is a longstanding challenge. A flawed attack design can inflate robustness estimates, making deployment risk assessment and defense comparison unreliable. Historically, standardized attacks such as AutoAttack have largely resolved this for image classifiers, providing a reliable evaluation baseline for systematic comparison across defenses. However, no equivalent exists for LLM jailbreak evaluation yet, where designing such an attack is considerably more difficult. A reliable attack must, among other things, be black-box compatible, applicable to arbitrary defense pipelines, and efficient, which no existing method jointly satisfies. We introduce Indirect Harmfulness Optimization (IHO), a masked diffusion language model attacker trained via iterative preference optimization against a harmfulness judge, requiring only black-box access to the target. The same method can be used without modification as a strong adapting attack on individual behaviors, or as an efficient amortized policy that transfers to held-out behaviors and unseen target models without fine-tuning. Even against layered defenses, such as GLM 5.3-flash served through a black-box API deploying an auxiliary detector, IHO improves attack success considerably over state-of-the-art approaches, without any defense-specific adaptation. Our results position IHO as a practical step toward the kind of standardized jailbreak evaluation that has improved reliability in the past. Code and models are available on GitHub and Hugging Face.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Indirect Harmfulness Optimization (IHO)：用 masked diffusion 语言模型做攻击器，仅凭黑盒访问、通过针对 harmfulness judge 的迭代偏好优化训练，作为 LLM 越狱评估的标准化攻击。同一方法无需修改即可作为针对单个行为的 adapting attack，或作为可迁移到留出行为与未见目标模型的摊销策略；在 GLM 5.3-flash 经黑盒 API 加辅助检测器的分层防御上，攻击成功率相对现有方法显著提升，且无需任何防御特定适配。
Motivation: 图像分类器已有 AutoAttack 这类标准化攻击作为可靠评估基线，而 LLM 越狱评估没有等价物；现有攻击难以同时满足黑盒兼容、适用于任意防御管线、高效三项要求，导致鲁棒性估计可能被夸大、部署风险评估与防御比较不可靠。
Method: IHO 用 masked diffusion 语言模型作为攻击器，仅需对目标的黑盒访问，通过针对 harmfulness judge 的迭代偏好优化 (iterative preference optimization) 训练；同一模型既可作为针对单个行为的 adapting attack，也可作为无需微调即迁移到留出行为与未见目标模型的摊销策略 (amortized policy)。
Result: 在 GLM 5.3-flash 经黑盒 API 部署辅助检测器的分层防御下，IHO 不做任何防御特定适配即显著优于现有最先进攻击方法的攻击成功率；代码与模型已在 GitHub 和 Hugging Face 开源。
Conclusion: 作者主张 IHO 是迈向类似图像领域 AutoAttack 那种标准化越狱评估的实用一步，使鲁棒性比较更可靠。

papers.title: Dialectics of Alignment: Harnessing Unsafe Knowledge for Dynamic Safety Routing
papers.abstract_en: The prevailing paradigm in large language model (LLM) alignment operates via erasure, filtering unsafe data or training models to strictly refuse harmful prompts. While effective at reducing immediate toxicity, this approach fundamentally constricts the model's epistemological scope, resulting in over-cautious systems that output uninformative blanket refusals to sensitive yet benign queries. In this work, we challenge the orthodoxy that unsafe data must be discarded. We propose a dialectical approach to alignment, positing that unsafe data encodes rich, domain specific knowledge critical for nuanced, safe, and informative generation. To operationalize this, we introduce SafeMoE, a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that isolates unsafe knowledge into domain-specific Low-Rank Adapters (LoRA experts) trained exclusively on harmful corpora. To synthesize safety from these unsafe primitives, we train a lightweight gating network using a minimal, highly curated set of safe-informative responses. During inference, this router dynamically orchestrates the unsafe experts, effectively steering the generation trajectory to harness their deep domain knowledge while strictly enforcing safety constraints. Extensive empirical evaluations across stringent safety benchmarks demonstrate that SafeMoE is not only safer, achieving over a 20% relative improvement in safe response rate (more than a 15% absolute gain), but also produces more informative responses when safety and harmfulness are of paramount concern. Furthermore, the routing mechanism exhibits strong zero-shot generalization to unseen domains and broader safety tasks without domain-specific supervision. Our findings suggest a paradigm shift in alignment: true safety requires not the masking of unsafe knowledge, but its controlled integration.
papers.comment: Accepted to The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2026. First two authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SafeMoE 把不安全知识从对齐中删除的做法改为受控整合：用只在有害语料上训练的领域专属 LoRA 专家承载不安全知识，再由轻量 gating 网络在推理时动态路由这些专家并强制安全约束。在严格安全基准上安全回复率相对提升超过 20%（绝对增益超过 15%），且路由对未见领域与更广安全任务呈零样本泛化。
Motivation: 以删除和过滤为主的 LLM 对齐会压缩模型的知识范围，使系统对敏感但无害的查询也给出过度谨慎、无信息量的笼统拒绝。
Method: 提出 MoE 框架 SafeMoE：把不安全知识隔离进只在有害语料上训练的领域专属 Low-Rank Adapters（LoRA experts）；用一小组精选的安全且有信息量的回复训练轻量 gating 网络；推理时由该 router 动态编排不安全专家，在利用其领域知识的同时强制安全约束。
Result: 在严格安全基准上的评测显示，SafeMoE 安全回复率相对提升超过 20%（绝对增益超过 15%），同时在安全与有害性为首要考量时产出更有信息量的回复；路由机制在无领域特定监督下对未见领域和更广泛安全任务表现出强零样本泛化。
Conclusion: 真正的安全不在于掩盖不安全知识，而在于受控整合：把不安全知识隔离成专家并用受训 router 调度，可同时提升安全性与信息量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LEAF: Growing Trees Without Branching for Speech-Aware Large Language Model Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art GRPO-style methods for speech-aware large language model post-training suffer from coarse credit assignment, broadcasting the same terminal-reward advantage to every token in a response. This ignores useful structure within rollout batches, where speech-conditioned completions often share prefixes before diverging at important decisions. We propose Low-rank Exploration with Adaptive Forking (LEAF), a retrospective tree-based RL method that recovers this structure without online branching or additional decoding. LEAF samples complete responses, selects high-surprisal boundaries, groups responses by shared prefixes, and assigns span-level advantages using descendant rewards. We theoretically justify LEAF's span-level credit assignment and boundary-selection design. Empirically, LEAF improves over GRPO across speech question answering and speech translation benchmarks under the same rollout and low-rank adaptation budget. Notably, smaller LEAF-trained models consistently outperform current state-of-art, full-parameter baselines.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables, Accepted to EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LEAF 用回顾式树结构 (retrospective tree-based RL) 修复 GRPO 式语音 LLM 后训练中把同一终端奖励优势广播到每个 token 的粗粒度信用分配：采样完整回复后选高惊讶度 (high-surprisal) 边界、按共享前缀分组，用后代奖励给 span 级优势。在相同 rollout 与 LoRA 预算下，LEAF 在语音问答与语音翻译基准上超过 GRPO，且更小的 LEAF 模型稳定超过当前全参数微调的 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: GRPO 式语音感知后训练把同一终端奖励优势广播给回复中每个 token，信用分配过粗；rollout 批内语音条件生成常在关键决策前共享前缀，这一结构被浪费。
Method: LEAF 不做在线分支也不加额外解码：先采样完整回复，再选高惊讶度边界、按共享前缀把回复分组成树，用后代奖励计算 span 级优势；作者给出 span 级信用分配与边界选择设计的理论论证，训练用低秩适配 (LoRA)。
Result: 在相同 rollout 与低秩适配预算下，LEAF 在语音问答 (speech question answering) 与语音翻译 (speech translation) 基准上优于 GRPO；更小的 LEAF 训练模型持续超过当前 SOTA 全参数基线。
Conclusion: 回顾式树结构的 span 级信用分配能在不增加解码成本的前提下替代 token 级广播优势，是 GRPO 式语音 LLM 后训练更细的信用分配方案。

papers.title: SWIM: Compact Environment Representation for Reinforcement Learning Human Swimming
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) has driven rapid progress in physically-based motion generation, yet synthesizing robust motion policies in dense fluid environments (e.g. swimming) remains unsolved. Unlike land motion, where environmental impact is sparse and can be coarsely modeled (e.g. gravity, normal reaction), swimming requires continuous, full-body coordination under pressure and flow forces across the entire body surface; fully-coupled rigid-fluid simulation is far too slow for the millions of interactions RL requires. We propose SWIM, an RL framework for physically-based human swimming learned from a single reference motion. Its core is a compact, low-dimensional environment representation: a dual-branch graph-convolutional VQ-VAE that tokenizes per-link body-water forces and torques, informative enough for control yet robust to the rapidly changing force exchanges that would otherwise destabilize training. We pair this with a GPU-based Lagrangian solver with rigid-fluid coupling that yields 10-15x faster training. Across hundreds of training runs and several hundred zero-shot conditions, SWIM generalizes to unseen goals and trajectories, fluids with varying density, external flows and perturbations, altered body morphologies, and all four competitive swimming styles. Against imitation-learning baselines (MimicKit-DeepMimic, MimicKit-AMP, ADD) and alternative force models (a PINN world model, MuJoCo's inertial fluid model, and an underwater-robotics simulator), SWIM achieves better stability, goal satisfaction, and physical realism: a 63.9% success rate on held-out generalization versus 36.8% for the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWIM 用双分支图卷积 VQ-VAE 把逐肢体的水作用力与力矩压成低维离散 token 作为环境表征，配合 GPU 上的 Lagrangian 刚体-流体求解器，从单段参考动作学出物理真实的人类游泳 RL 策略。训练提速 10–15 倍，在留出泛化条件下成功率 63.9%，最强模仿学习基线为 36.8%。
Motivation: 稠密流体中的运动策略合成仍未解决：全耦合刚体-流体仿真太慢，无法支撑 RL 所需的数百万次交互，而游泳要求全身在压力与流动作用力下持续协调。
Method: 核心是紧凑低维环境表征：双分支图卷积 VQ-VAE 将逐 link 的水作用力与力矩 token 化，既保留控制信息又对快速变化的力交换保持鲁棒；配对 GPU Lagrangian 刚体-流体耦合求解器，从单段参考动作训练 RL 策略。
Result: GPU 求解器带来 10–15 倍训练加速；在数百次训练运行与数百个零样本条件下，对未见目标与轨迹、不同流体密度、外部流与扰动、改变的体型以及全部四种竞技泳姿均能泛化。对比 MimicKit-DeepMimic、MimicKit-AMP、ADD 及 PINN world model、MuJoCo 惯性流体模型、水下机器人仿真器，留出泛化成功率 63.9% vs 最强基线 36.8%，并在稳定性、目标达成与物理真实感上更优。
Conclusion: 把快速变化的流体作用力压成鲁棒的低维离散表征，加上足够快的刚体-流体仿真，就能在稠密流体环境中从单段参考动作学出可零样本泛化的游泳策略。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Brain-IT-VQA: From Brain Signals to Answers
papers.abstract_en: Decoding visual content from fMRI signals recorded while a person views images, and specifically answering questions about the seen images, is a long-standing challenge. While significant progress has been made in recent years in visual question answering (VQA) from fMRI, performance remains limited. Moreover, although recent models can make increasingly accurate predictions, they have rarely been used as tools for understanding the structure of visual representations in the brain. We present Brain-IT-VQA, a framework for visual question answering from fMRI. Unlike previous methods, which extract a fixed representation from the fMRI signal, our extraction is conditioned on the question itself, so what is decoded from brain activity depends on what is being asked. Our model substantially outperforms previous fMRI-based captioning and VQA approaches. We further introduce NSD-VQA, a new dataset and benchmark for visual question answering from fMRI. Unlike existing image-fMRI VQA datasets, which typically provide only a few broad and weakly controlled questions per image, NSD-VQA provides on average 20 question-answer pairs per image across 20 controlled question categories that disentangle multiple levels of visual understanding. This enables more reliable and interpretable evaluation despite limited fMRI test data. Together, Brain-IT-VQA and NSD-VQA provide both a strong predictive framework and a tool for studying brain representations. Using this benchmark, we quantify which forms of visual and semantic information can be reliably decoded from fMRI responses to natural images. We further analyze the contributions of different brain regions across question types.

papers.title: Dr-CiK: A Benchmark testing Deep Research for Context-Aided Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting in real-world settings often depends not only on historical observations, but also on external context that must be actively discovered from noisy, heterogeneous information sources. Yet existing context-aided forecasting benchmarks typically assume that the supporting context is already provided, leaving open whether agents can identify it on their own. Therefore, we introduce Dr-CiK, a benchmark for evaluating whether agents can retrieve forecasting-relevant supporting context from a document corpus, filter out distractors, distill the retrieved context into forecast-useful evidence, and generate forecasts supported by that evidence. Through context ablations and evaluations of state-of-the-art deep research and forecasting methods paired together, we show that high-quality context substantially improves forecasting performance in Dr-CiK. However, existing DR methods recover limited ground-truth supporting evidence, are frequently misled by distractors, and can cause forecasters to perform worse with retrieved context than without context. Our results motivate research on agents that search for the right context to predict the future.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Dr-CiK 是一个评测 deep research 智能体能否自行从文档语料中检索预测相关上下文、过滤干扰项、蒸馏成证据并据此生成预测的基准。上下文消融与 SOTA deep research + 预测方法配对评测显示，高质量上下文显著提升预测表现，但现有 DR 方法找回的真值支撑证据有限、常被干扰项带偏，甚至让预测器在带检索上下文时比不带上下文更差。
Motivation: 现有 context-aided 预测基准默认支撑上下文已给定，无法回答智能体能否自己找到它；而真实时序预测依赖从含噪、异构信息源中主动发现外部上下文。
Method: 提出 Dr-CiK 基准，要求智能体完成四步：从文档语料检索与预测相关的支撑上下文、过滤 distractor、把检索结果蒸馏成预测可用证据、生成有证据支撑的预测；评测方式为上下文消融，以及将 SOTA deep research 方法与预测方法配对评估。
Result: 上下文消融与配对评测显示高质量上下文在 Dr-CiK 上显著改善预测表现；同时现有 DR 方法找回的 ground-truth 支撑证据有限，频繁被 distractor 误导，并可导致预测器带检索上下文时表现差于无上下文。
Conclusion: 检索到的上下文质量决定其对预测是增益还是伤害，研究重点应转向让智能体搜索正确上下文来预测未来。

papers.title: A PAC-Bayesian View of Generalisation for Physics-Informed Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed machine learning (PIML) integrates mechanistic knowledge, typically through partial differential equations (PDEs), into data-driven models. Despite strong empirical performance, its statistical generalisation properties remain poorly understood, especially for regression with unbounded losses. We develop a PAC-Bayesian framework for PIML that provides high-probability generalisation guarantees under potentially unbounded losses. Exploiting the structure of physics-informed objectives, we derive component-wise bounds whose complexity scales with the input-gradient energy of each loss, establishing a direct link between physical regularity and generalisation. We further introduce a PAC-Bayesian calibration procedure that yields computable gradient-based complexities while controlling rare large-gradient events through a residual-tail correction. Adopting a multi-task view of data fidelity, PDE residuals, initial conditions, and boundary conditions, we obtain a refined certificate with a single PAC-Bayesian complexity penalty, avoiding the looseness of independently bounding each component. Building on this certificate, we propose a bound-aware learning procedure that promotes empirical accuracy, proximity to a physics-informed prior, and low input-gradient complexity. Experiments on six PDE benchmarks yield substantially tighter certificates than bounded-loss and sub-Gaussian alternatives, while ablations quantify the effects of posterior-training data, calibration data, gradient envelopes, and hypothesis localisation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为物理信息机器学习 (PIML) 建立 PAC-Bayes 泛化框架，在损失无界时给出高概率保证：各损失分量的复杂度随其输入梯度能量缩放，把物理正则性直接接到泛化上。用残差尾部校正控制罕见大梯度事件，并以多任务视角把数据保真、PDE 残差、初边值条件合并成单一复杂度罚项；六个 PDE 基准上证书显著紧于有界损失与 sub-Gaussian 替代。
Motivation: PIML 经验表现强但统计泛化性质不清楚，尤其回归任务中损失无界时，现有有界损失或 sub-Gaussian 假设的证书不适用。
Method: 推导按损失分量拆分的 PAC-Bayes 界，复杂度由各损失的输入梯度能量决定；引入带残差尾部校正 (residual-tail correction) 的校准过程，得到可计算的梯度型复杂度；再以多任务形式把数据保真、PDE 残差、初始条件、边界条件合并为单一 PAC-Bayes 复杂度罚项，并据此提出 bound-aware 学习过程，同时优化经验精度、与 physics-informed prior 的接近度和低输入梯度复杂度。
Result: 在六个 PDE 基准上，所得证书比有界损失与 sub-Gaussian 替代显著更紧；消融量化了 posterior-training 数据、校准数据、梯度包络 (gradient envelopes) 与 hypothesis localisation 各自的作用。
Conclusion: 物理正则性可通过输入梯度能量进入 PAC-Bayes 复杂度，从而在无界损失下给出可计算且更紧的 PIML 泛化证书；多任务合并罚项避免了逐分量独立定界的松弛。

papers.title: DrawVideo: Grounded and Faithful Multi-Shot Video Generation from Storyboard Keyframe Sketches
papers.abstract_en: Long video generation requires high-fidelity visual synthesis, coherent narrative organization, shot-level structure, and explicit user control. Existing text-to-video methods typically generate videos from a single long-form prompt, making it difficult for creators to directly control character pose, camera composition, spatial layout, and local motion. We propose DrawVideo, a sketch-guided and storyboard-driven framework that grounds multi-shot video generation in creator-provided spatial structure, appearance, and motion. Each shot is specified by a black-and-white sketch, an appearance prompt, and a motion prompt. DrawVideo first generates a structure-aligned reference keyframe, expands the motion description into derivative keyframes representing ordered action states, and then synthesizes local video clips between adjacent keyframes. We further introduce SketchLongVideo, to the best of our knowledge the first evaluation dataset of ordered multi-shot storyboards with aligned sketch, appearance, and motion conditions. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong structural controllability, appearance consistency, intra-shot visual stability, and motion alignment, providing an effective solution for director-oriented video creation.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DrawVideo 把长视频生成拆成以黑白草图、外观提示、运动提示逐镜头指定的分镜流程：先生成对齐结构的参考关键帧，再把运动描述扩展为表示有序动作状态的衍生关键帧，最后在相邻关键帧之间合成局部片段。同时发布 SketchLongVideo，据称是首个带对齐草图、外观与运动条件的有序多镜头分镜评测集，实验展示强结构可控性、外观一致性、镜头内视觉稳定性与运动对齐。
Motivation: 现有文生视频只吃单条长提示，创作者难以直接控制人物姿态、镜头构图、空间布局与局部运动，多镜头长视频的叙事与镜头级结构缺乏显式控制手段。
Method: 每个镜头由黑白草图、外观提示与运动提示三元组指定；先生成结构对齐的参考关键帧，再将运动描述扩展为表示有序动作状态的衍生关键帧，最后在相邻关键帧之间合成局部视频片段；并提出 SketchLongVideo 分镜评测集。
Result: 实验展示强结构可控性、外观一致性、镜头内视觉稳定性与运动对齐；SketchLongVideo 据称是首个有序多镜头分镜、且草图/外观/运动条件对齐的评测数据集。
Conclusion: 以草图加分镜关键帧作为中间表示，可为导演导向的视频创作提供对姿态、构图、布局与运动的显式控制路径。

papers.title: MemArena: An Ego-Centric Benchmark for On-Device Agentic Personal Memory Assistants at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Edge-deployed personal memory assistants must handle private interpersonal conversations on-device with open-weight models. Yet, existing memory benchmarks often under-test the combination of activity-dense interaction, ego-centric perspective, and coherent multi-session worlds. MemArena fills these gaps with a single-world conversational benchmark built with its MASim agent simulator, for 50 agents over 15 days (10.3M dialog-text tokens, 24.1K text-only ego-observed tokens/agent/day). With the interaction history, it co-generates ground truth over six recall, reasoning, and trustworthiness evaluation dimensions. We evaluate five open-weight readers with Vanilla context, BM25-RAG, Oracle retrieval, Memobase, and MemSearch as memory backends. Three results stand out: (1) Memory-backend choice matters more for content accuracy: At Qwen3-8B, moving from Memobase to MemSearch gains +22.1/+21.2 pp, whereas scaling the reader to Qwen3-32B-AWQ gains at most +3.5/+4.4 pp under either backend. (2) Permission-aware access fails in two distinct modes: Oracle leaks heavily, while the other backends fail to surface the protected fact. (3) Search latency bites only at small readers: on a Spark GB10 edge node, memory-search adds a moderate and fixed 87/8/51 ms (BM25-RAG/Memobase/MemSearch) that composes a small part of TTFT for most reader-backend combinations. We release code, the MASim simulator, and the MemArena-L benchmark at https://github.com/dereksodo/MemArena-Bench.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). 53 pages. Code: https://github.com/dereksodo/MemArena-Bench; data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/dereksodo/memarena-l
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemArena 是面向端侧个人记忆助手的自我中心 (ego-centric) 对话基准：用 MASim 模拟器构建单一世界，50 个 agent 跑 15 天，共 10.3M 对话文本 token，每个 agent 每天 24.1K 仅文本的自我观测 token，并同步生成六类回忆、推理与可信度维度的 ground truth。在 Qwen3-8B 上把记忆后端从 Memobase 换成 MemSearch，内容准确率提升 +22.1/+21.2 pp，而把 reader 扩到 Qwen3-32B-AWQ 在任一后端下最多只涨 +3.5/+4.4 pp，说明后端选择比放大模型更值。
Motivation: 现有记忆基准很少同时覆盖活动密集的交互、自我中心视角与跨会话连贯世界，端侧开放权重模型在私密人际对话上的记忆能力因此缺少可测场景。
Method: 用 MASim agent 模拟器搭建单一世界对话基准，50 个 agent、15 天交互历史与 ground truth 联合生成，覆盖六个 recall、reasoning、trustworthiness 评测维度；以 Vanilla context、BM25-RAG、Oracle retrieval、Memobase、MemSearch 五种记忆后端评测五个开放权重 reader。
Result: Qwen3-8B 上 Memobase→MemSearch 内容准确率 +22.1/+21.2 pp，而 reader 扩到 Qwen3-32B-AWQ 在任一后端下至多 +3.5/+4.4 pp；权限感知访问呈两种失败模式——Oracle 大量泄露，其余后端取不出受保护事实；在 Spark GB10 边缘节点上记忆搜索固定增加 87/8/51 ms（BM25-RAG/Memobase/MemSearch），对多数 reader-后端组合只占 TTFT 的一小部分。
Conclusion: 端侧记忆助手的瓶颈在记忆后端而非模型规模，且现有后端在权限约束下要么泄露要么取不到受保护事实；代码、MASim 与 MemArena-L 已随论文发布。

papers.title: Analog RF Computing: A New Paradigm for Energy-Efficient Edge AI Over MU-MIMO Systems
papers.abstract_en: Modern edge devices increasingly rely on neural networks for intelligent applications. However, conventional digital computing-based edge inference requires substantial memory and energy consumption. In analog radio frequency (RF) computing, a base station (BS) encodes the weights of the neural networks and broadcasts the RF waveforms to the clients. Each client reuses its passive mixer to multiply the received weight-encoded waveform with a locally generated input-encoded waveform. This enables wireless receivers to perform the matrix-vector multiplications (MVMs) that account for most of the computation burden in edge inference with ultra-low energy consumption. Unlike conventional downlink transmissions which are optimized for communications, analog RF computing requires a computing-centric physical layer that controls both the analog MVM accuracy and the energy consumption for inference. Motivated by this, in this paper, we propose a physical layer design framework for analog RF computing in MU-MIMO wireless systems. We derive tractable models for computing accuracy and energy consumption for inference, formulate a joint BS beamforming and client-side scaling problem subject to computing accuracy, transmit power, and hardware constraints, and develop a low-complexity algorithm to solve the non-convex problem. The proposed design provides client- and layer-specific accuracy control for both uniform- and mixed-precision inference. Simulations under 3GPP specifications show that analog RF computing can significantly reduce client-side energy consumption by nearly two orders of magnitude compared to digital computing, while mixed-precision inference requires even lower energy consumption than uniform-precision inference. Overall, these results establish analog RF computing over wireless networks as a promising paradigm for energy-efficient edge inference.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, 2 tables. This paper proposes analog RF computing as a new paradigm for energy-efficient edge inference over wireless networks and studies the corresponding physical layer design framework
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 MU-MIMO 的模拟射频计算 (analog RF computing) 物理层设计框架：基站把神经网络权重编码成 RF 波形广播，客户端用无源混频器将接收波形与本地输入编码波形相乘，直接完成占边缘推理主要开销的矩阵-向量乘 (MVM)。在 3GPP 规范下的仿真显示，相比数字计算客户端能耗降低近两个数量级，且 mixed-precision 推理比 uniform-precision 更省电。
Motivation: 边缘设备上的数字计算推理内存与能耗开销大；而模拟 RF 计算需要同时控制模拟 MVM 精度与推理能耗，传统以通信为中心的下行链路优化无法满足这一需求。
Method: 推导计算精度与推理能耗的可解析模型，构建联合基站波束成形与客户端缩放的优化问题，约束包括计算精度、发射功率与硬件限制，并开发低复杂度算法求解该非凸问题；设计支持按客户端、按层的精度控制，覆盖 uniform-precision 与 mixed-precision 两种推理模式。
Result: 3GPP 规范下的仿真表明，模拟 RF 计算相比数字计算可将客户端能耗降低近两个数量级；mixed-precision 推理所需能耗低于 uniform-precision 推理。
Conclusion: 以计算为中心的物理层设计（联合波束成形与客户端缩放、按客户端按层控精度）使模拟 RF 计算成为无线网络上节能边缘推理的可行范式。

papers.title: Twincher: Bijective Representation Learning for Robust Inversion of Continuous Systems
papers.abstract_en: Perception, state estimation, and action planning in physical systems often reduce to inverting a continuous forward map $p \mapsto y = f(p)$ (a renderer, a physics simulator, or a learned surrogate) that can be queried but not inverted in closed form. Learned direct inverses are limited by an approximation error that decreases only gradually with the amount of data, whereas iterative solvers that minimize the misfit in observation space can stall at spurious stationary points. We study an intermediate route: learning a representation $r(y)$ in which the composite map $p \mapsto r(f(p))$ is a well-conditioned bijection and which is insensitive to perturbations of $y$ normal to the data manifold. In such coordinates, the inverse problem becomes a square nonlinear system whose least-squares formulation has no spurious interior stationary points, so that Newton-type iterations using the exact forward model can refine the solution to the accuracy permitted by the observations; the learned model must be qualitatively correct rather than accurate. We introduce Twincher, an architecture composed of localized, area-preserving pairwise rotations ("twinches"), and explore training possibilities with Jacobian-level objectives, a domain-growing curriculum, and memory-efficient routines for propagating derivative tensors. On a family of synthetic forward maps with controllable nonconvexity, once the query budget suffices to form a bijective representation, the worst-case residual over $10^3$ test targets reaches machine precision within five refinement steps, whereas a parameter-matched baseline that combines an MLP inverse with Gauss-Newton refinement improves only gradually with the budget. A pose-estimation example from noisy depth maps illustrates inference errors that scale linearly with, and vanish together with, the observation noise. We release an open-source CPU/GPU Python implementation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Twincher 用局部保面积旋转（twinch）堆出一个学习表示 r(y)，使 p→r(f(p)) 成为良态双射且对数据流形法向扰动不敏感，从而把连续前向映射的反演化为无伪驻点的平方非线性系统，再用精确前向模型的 Newton 类迭代精修。在可控非凸性的合成前向映射族上，查询预算足以形成双射表示后，10^3 个测试目标的最坏残差在五步精修内达到机器精度，而参数量匹配的 MLP 逆 + Gauss-Newton 基线只随预算缓慢改善。
Motivation: 可查询但无闭式逆的连续前向映射（渲染器、物理模拟器、学习代理）反演中，直接学习的逆只有随数据量缓慢下降的逼近误差，观测空间迭代求解器又会停在伪驻点。
Method: 学习表示 r(y) 使复合映射 p→r(f(p)) 为良态双射并对 y 沿数据流形法向的扰动不敏感；架构由局部保面积成对旋转（twinches）组成，训练用 Jacobian 级目标、domain-growing 课程，以及内存高效的导数张量传播例程；精修阶段用精确前向模型做 Newton 类迭代。
Result: 在带可控非凸性的合成前向映射族上，一旦查询预算足以构造双射表示，10^3 个测试目标的最坏残差在五步精修内达到机器精度；参数量匹配的 MLP 逆 + Gauss-Newton 精修基线仅随预算逐步改善。含噪深度图的姿态估计例子中，推理误差随观测噪声线性标度并随噪声消失。
Conclusion: 把反演问题放进良态双射坐标后，学习模型只需定性正确、由 Newton 类迭代把精度推到观测允许的上限；作者开源了 CPU/GPU Python 实现。

papers.title: Agentic AI Scientists Are Not Built For Autonomous Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract_en: A growing body of work pursues AI scientists capable of end-to-end autonomous scientific discovery. This position paper argues that although they already function as co-scientists, agentic AI scientists are not built for autonomous scientific discovery. We identify the following challenges in building and deploying autonomous AI scientists: (1) Problem selection is influenced by the McNamara fallacy; (2) Agents are built on large language models (LLMs) whose training corpora omit tacit procedural and failure knowledge of laboratory practice; (3) Preference optimisation during post-training compresses output diversity toward consensus; and (4) Most scientific benchmarks measure single-turn prediction accuracy and lack feedback from physical experiments back to the computational model. These challenges are not just questions of scale and scaffolding; they require revisiting fundamental design choices. To build truly autonomous AI scientists, we recommend scientific simulations as verifiers for training, a persistent, mutable epistemic state that carries beliefs and shifting objectives across an investigation, the establishment of a centralized preregistration repository for all AI-generated hypotheses, and application driven by scientific need rather than tool affordance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇 NeurIPS 2026 立场论文论断：agentic AI scientist 目前只能做 co-scientist，不具备自主科学发现能力，因为问题选择受 McNamara fallacy 支配、LLM 训练语料缺实验室隐性程序与失败知识、后训练偏好优化把输出多样性压缩向共识、且主流科学基准只测单轮预测准确率而缺物理实验回传反馈。作者建议用科学仿真作为训练验证器、维护可跨研究携带信念与目标的持久可变 epistemic state、建立集中式 AI 假设预注册库，并让应用由科学需求而非工具可得性驱动。
Motivation: 端到端自主科学发现的 AI scientist 研究快速增长，但现有 agent 在问题选择、隐性实验知识、输出多样性与实验闭环四个环节上系统性缺失，这些不是规模与 scaffolding 能解决的问题。
Method: 立场论文式的四条挑战论证：McNamara fallacy 下的问题选择、LLM 语料缺失 tacit procedural 与 failure knowledge、post-training preference optimisation 压缩多样性、单轮基准缺物理实验到计算模型的反馈；对应提出仿真验证器、持久可变 epistemic state、集中预注册库与需求驱动四项设计建议。
Result: 给出四条定性诊断与四项对应建议，指出当前 agent 已可作 co-scientist 但未达自主发现，且问题根源在基本设计选择而非规模。
Conclusion: 要造真正自主的 AI scientist，必须重做验证、状态、假设治理与选题这四个基本设计，而不是继续堆 scaffolding。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Implicit Target Shift in Online Learning: Characterization and Correction
papers.abstract_en: Online learning from a stream of data is a defining feature of intelligence, yet modern machine learning systems often struggle in this setting, especially under distributional shift. To understand its basic properties, we study the relationship between online and offline learning in the context of kernel regression by deriving a closed-form expression for the function learned by online kernel regression. We reveal that online kernel regression is equivalent to offline regression with shifted, inaccurate target outputs. Conversely, we show that by compensating for this implicit target shift in the teaching signal through target correction, online kernel-based learning can provably learn the same predictor as its offline counterpart. We derive both a closed-form expression for this target correction and an iterative form that can be applied sequentially. Applying this framework to continual image classification tasks on domain-incremental Split CIFAR-10 and CORe50, we show that online stochastic gradient descent with iteratively corrected targets outperforms learning with the true targets. This work therefore provides a basic framework for analyzing and improving online learning in non-stationary environments from the perspective of implicit target shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线核回归 (online kernel regression) 学到的函数等价于在被偏移且不准的目标上做离线回归，即存在隐式目标偏移 (implicit target shift)；对该偏移做目标修正后，可证明在线学习与离线版本学到同一预测器。在域增量持续图像分类 Split CIFAR-10 与 CORe50 上，用迭代修正目标的在线 SGD 反而优于直接用真实目标训练。
Motivation: 在线学习在分布漂移下表现不佳，而在线与离线学习在核回归设定下的等价关系尚不清楚，缺少可推导的刻画与修正手段。
Method: 在核回归框架下推导在线学习所学函数的闭式表达，证明其等价于离线回归加偏移目标；进而给出目标修正 (target correction) 的闭式形式与可顺序施加的迭代形式，并将其接入在线 SGD 训练。
Result: 在域增量任务 Split CIFAR-10 与 CORe50 上，使用迭代修正目标的在线 SGD 表现优于使用真实目标的学习；理论侧给出在线与离线等价以及修正后可证明复现离线预测器的结论。
Conclusion: 在线学习的偏差可归结为隐式目标偏移，修正教学信号中的目标即可让在线核学习复现离线预测器，并在非平稳环境中带来实际增益。

papers.title: Active Learning for Communication Structure Optimization in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing the communication structure of large language model based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) has been shown to improve downstream performance and reduce token usage. Existing methods typically rely on randomly sampled training tasks. However, tasks may differ substantially in difficulty and domain, and thus they are not equally informative for updating communication structure, making optimization often unstable and highly sensitive to the particular training set. To actively identify the most valuable tasks for communication-structure optimization, we propose an ensemble-based information-theoretic task selection framework. The proposed method estimates task informativeness by how much a candidate task changes the distribution over graph parameters, using ensemble Kalman inversion as an efficient and derivative-free approximation of the corresponding Bayesian update. The resulting estimator is especially suitable for black-box and noisy multi-agent systems. To enhance scalability, we construct a compact candidate pool through embedding-based representative selection and combine the informative selection with surrogate modeling and batch Thompson sampling. We validate the proposed framework across both benign and adversarial settings and multiple task formats. It consistently outperforms random training, demonstrating more effective task selection and greater overall cost efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 多智能体系统 (LLM-MAS) 通信结构优化中随机采样训练任务导致的不稳定与对训练集敏感，提出基于集成信息论的任务选择框架：用 ensemble Kalman inversion 无导数近似贝叶斯更新，估计候选任务对图参数分布的改变量作为信息量。在良性与对抗设定、多种任务格式上一致优于随机训练，任务选择更有效且总体成本效率更高。
Motivation: 通信结构优化依赖随机采样训练任务，而任务难度与领域差异大、信息量不等，使优化不稳定且高度依赖具体训练集。
Method: 以 ensemble Kalman inversion 作为贝叶斯更新的无导数近似，估计候选任务引起的图参数分布变化作为信息量；用 embedding 代表性筛选构建紧凑候选池，再结合代理模型与 batch Thompson sampling 做批量选择。
Result: 在良性与对抗设定及多种任务格式上验证，一致优于随机训练任务采样，体现更有效的任务选择与更高的总体成本效率。
Conclusion: 以信息量驱动的任务选择替代随机采样，可让 LLM-MAS 通信结构优化更稳定、更省成本，且适用于黑盒、含噪的多智能体系统。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Point-MF: Stabilizing One-Step Mean Flows for Single-Image Point Cloud Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Single-image point cloud reconstruction requires recovering complete object-level geometry, including occluded regions, from a single RGB image. Diffusion- and flow-based reconstructors can model this ambiguity, but their iterative sampling requires many network function evaluations, while naive one-step point-space updates often produce outliers and density imbalance. We propose Point-MF, a one-step conditional Mean-Flow framework for geometry-only point cloud reconstruction. Point-MF predicts an interval-averaged velocity field directly in point-cloud space and reconstructs the output with a single network function evaluation, without training a point-cloud autoencoder. To stabilize large Mean-Flow jumps, we introduce Denoised Space Anchor (DSA), a set-distance auxiliary loss that anchors the denoised point set implied by the predicted velocity to the ground-truth geometry. On all 13 ShapeNet-R2N2 categories and Pix3D, Point-MF achieves strong reconstruction quality under the aligned point-set protocol, improving average CD and EMD over the evaluated point-cloud reconstruction baselines. It runs in 40.72 ms per sample on an RTX A4000, within the same latency order as the feedforward RGB2point baseline and substantially faster than iterative diffusion baselines such as PC$^2$ and BDM. These results show that denoised-space geometric anchoring enables stable one-step Mean Flow directly in point-cloud space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Point-MF 把条件 Mean Flow 直接搬到点云空间做单图物体级几何重建，用一次网络前向输出完整点集，并以 Denoised Space Anchor (DSA) 这一集合距离辅助损失把预测速度隐含的去噪点集锚到真值几何，稳定大步长跳跃。在 13 个 ShapeNet-R2N2 类别与 Pix3D 上，aligned point-set 协议下平均 CD 与 EMD 均优于所评估的点云重建基线，单样本 40.72 ms（RTX A4000），与前馈 RGB2point 同一延迟量级、远快于 PC² 与 BDM 等迭代扩散基线。
Motivation: 单张 RGB 图要恢复含遮挡的完整物体几何本身病态；扩散/流式重建器建模这种歧义但需大量网络函数评估，而朴素一步点空间更新又容易产生离群点与密度不均。
Method: 条件 Mean-Flow 框架直接在点云空间预测区间平均速度场，一次网络函数评估重建输出，且不训练点云自编码器；新增 Denoised Space Anchor (DSA) 辅助损失，用集合距离把预测速度隐含的去噪点集锚定到真值几何，以稳定大跳步。
Result: 在全部 13 个 ShapeNet-R2N2 类别与 Pix3D 上，aligned point-set 协议下平均 CD 与 EMD 相对所评估的点云重建基线均有提升；单样本延迟 40.72 ms（RTX A4000），与前馈 RGB2point 同一延迟量级，并显著快于 PC² 与 BDM 等迭代扩散基线。
Conclusion: 去噪空间的几何锚定使直接在点云空间上做一步 Mean Flow 成为可行路径：一次前向即可拿到稳定重建，同时把延迟压到前馈方法量级。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluating a Layered Prompt-Injection Defence for the Model Context Protocol: A Record-Level Audit of Decision Conventions, Corpus Provenance and Reproducibility
papers.abstract_en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) extends the prompt-injection attack surface of large language model applications to tool descriptions, parameter schemas and tool outputs. Defences for it report detection figures that are not comparable, because each is measured on its authors' own corpus under a decision convention that is rarely stated. This paper audits one such evaluation at the level of individual decision records. Its object is CASCADE, a fully local layered defence (rule matching, embedding similarity and an optional local language-model review), run in three configurations on a frozen 5,000-sample corpus under a pinned code revision; the corpus, the per-sample records and the analysis scripts are public. Four findings result. First, the convention that collapses allow, review and block onto a binary label sets the headline: the pipeline without review reports an 11.70% false-positive rate when referrals count as positives and 1.51% when only denials do, while referring 68.5% of all traffic to a human. Second, the construction of the corpus shapes the aggregate: 65.6% of records are texts placed in one of five fixed wrappers, the wrapper alone identifies the label, and for the same text wrapping lowers the false-positive rate from 21.2% to 3.2% and raises detection from 86.0% to 98.0%. Third, the published description does not identify what ran: the rule module inside the pipeline is not the rule engine evaluated alone; the block threshold produced denials only among the first 48 requests; and, without review, every later denial, including all 23 denials of benign requests, came from an output guard run on an echo of the input. Fourth, the local review model, invoked on 32.6% of requests at 2.5 s each, changes no binary outcome but converts 1,492 referrals into denials. A ten-item reporting checklist is derived from these findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇对 MCP 提示注入防御 CASCADE 评测的记录级审计：在冻结的 5,000 样本语料与固定代码版本下重跑三种配置，发现判定约定（allow/review/block 折成二元标签）直接决定头条数字——同一管线在“转人工计为阳性”时误报率 11.70%，只算拒绝时 1.51%，而 68.5% 流量被转人工。语料构造同样主导聚合结果：65.6% 记录是被放进五种固定包装之一的同一文本，仅换包装就把误报率从 21.2% 降到 3.2%、检测率从 86.0% 提到 98.0%。
Motivation: MCP 把提示注入面扩展到工具描述、参数 schema 与工具输出，但各防御论文在自家语料、且很少写明判定约定下报告检测数字，导致结果互不可比。
Method: 审计对象是全本地的分层防御 CASCADE（规则匹配 + 嵌入相似度 + 可选本地语言模型复核），在冻结的 5,000 样本语料、钉死的代码版本下跑三种配置，逐条决策记录（per-sample records）比对；语料、逐样本记录与分析脚本公开，复现工件发布在 Zenodo。
Result: 无复核管线在转人工计阳性时误报率 11.70%、只算拒绝时 1.51%，同时 68.5% 流量转人工；65.6% 记录为同一文本套五种固定包装，仅换包装使误报率 21.2%→3.2%、检测率 86.0%→98.0%；管线内规则模块与单独评测的规则引擎不是同一个；block 阈值只在前 48 个请求产生拒绝，无复核时其后所有拒绝（含全部 23 个良性请求拒绝）来自对输入回显做检查的输出守卫；本地复核模型被调用 32.6% 的请求、每次 2.5 s，不改变任何二元结果，只把 1,492 次转人工变成拒绝。
Conclusion: MCP 防御的头条检测数字由判定约定与语料包装方式决定，而非防御本身；作者据此给出十项报告清单，要求公开语料、逐样本记录与判定约定以保证可复现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Must Move Beyond Factual Grounding to Represent Diverse Opinions
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are built on an unexamined assumption - that queries have correct answers and retrieval should converge toward them. This position paper argues that this creates a factual bias where RAG systems optimize for reducing epistemic uncertainty while ignoring the aleatoric uncertainty, inherent in opinion-rich content. The consequences go beyond technical limitations- due to risk of minority voice erasure and risk of opinion manipulation. To address this, we formalize opinion-aware retrieval through uncertainty quantification and derive a unified objective using the Wasserstein distance. As an existence proof, we present Opinion-Aware RAG (O-RAG), which enriches documents with LLM-extracted, entity-linked opinion metadata before indexing. Across e-commerce seller forums and public hotel reviews, O-RAG reduces Wasserstein distance to corpus-level sentiment distributions by 18-48%, and human evaluators preferred its responses 79.2% of the time. We close with a research agenda for opinion-aware RAG.
papers.comment: 17 pages, Accepted at 19th International Conference on Natural Language Generation 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 立场论文指出 RAG 默认查询有唯一正确答案，只压低认知不确定性而忽略观点内容固有的偶然不确定性 (aleatoric uncertainty)，导致少数声音被抹除与观点操纵风险。为此形式化 opinion-aware retrieval，用 Wasserstein 距离给出统一目标，并以 O-RAG 作存在性证明：索引前用 LLM 抽取并实体链接观点元数据来丰富文档。在电商卖家论坛与公开酒店评论上，O-RAG 到语料级情感分布的 Wasserstein 距离下降 18–48%，人工评估者 79.2% 的时候更偏好其回答。
Motivation: RAG 的检索被当作向唯一正确答案收敛的过程，但观点丰富的内容本身含偶然不确定性，优化事实一致性会系统性牺牲观点多样性，带来少数声音被抹除和观点被操纵的风险。
Method: 把 opinion-aware retrieval 形式化为不确定性量化问题，用 Wasserstein 距离推导统一目标；实现为 Opinion-Aware RAG (O-RAG)，在建索引前用 LLM 从文档中抽取观点并做实体链接，生成观点元数据注入索引。
Result: 在电商卖家论坛与公开酒店评论两个语料上，O-RAG 到语料级情感分布的 Wasserstein 距离降低 18–48%；人工评估者在 79.2% 的情况下更偏好 O-RAG 的回答。
Conclusion: RAG 不应只做事实锚定，检索目标需显式纳入观点分布的保真度；O-RAG 作为存在性证明表明用观点元数据丰富索引即可逼近语料情感分布。
Relevance: 0
