papers.title: $π^2$: Structure-Originated Reasoning Data Improves Long-Context Reasoning Ability of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We study a QA curation pipeline for improving long-context complex reasoning in large language models (LLMs). Our approach, $π^2$, constructs high-quality reasoning data through rigorous QA curation: 1) extracting and expanding tables from Wikipedia, 2) from the collected tables together with relevant metadata, generating complex reasoning questions whose answers are automatically determined and validated through dual-path code execution, 3) finally, back-translating chain-of-thoughts solutions grounded in realistic context. Supervised fine-tuning with gpt-oss-20b and Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on $π^2$ yields consistent improvements across four long-context reasoning benchmarks and our alike $π^2$-Bench, with average absolute accuracy gains of +6.25% and +3.37% respectively. Through deeper analyses, we observe that reasoning style contributes little, while faithful reasoning patterns discovered by back translation and grounded realistic long context, as $π^2$ is designed for, are crucial for the improvement. Our code, data, and models are fully open-source at https://github.com/vtpss/pi-squared.
papers.comment: A framework for curating complex reasoning data over realistic long contexts. Accepted to COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: π² 用「维基百科表格抽取扩展 → 双路径代码执行自动验证的复杂 QA 生成 → 回译 (back-translation) 得到扎根真实长上下文的 CoT」三步构造长上下文推理训练数据。在 gpt-oss-20b 与 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 上做监督微调，四个长上下文推理基准加自建 π²-Bench 平均绝对准确率分别提升 +6.25% 和 +3.37%；分析显示推理风格贡献很小，起作用的是回译发现的忠实推理模式与真实长上下文。
Motivation: 长上下文复杂推理的监督数据难以自动判定答案正确性，且常缺少真实上下文，导致 CoT 与实际语境脱节。
Method: π² 流水线三步：从 Wikipedia 抽取并扩展表格；结合表格与元数据生成复杂推理问题，答案由 dual-path code execution 自动确定与验证；再对扎根真实上下文的解做回译得到 CoT。随后在 π² 数据上对 gpt-oss-20b 和 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 做监督微调 (SFT)。
Result: 四个长上下文推理基准加自建 π²-Bench 上，gpt-oss-20b 平均绝对准确率 +6.25%，Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 +3.37%，均为一致提升。消融式分析表明推理风格贡献很小，回译得到的忠实推理模式与真实长上下文是提升的关键。
Conclusion: 长上下文推理能力的提升来自可验证 QA 与扎根真实上下文的忠实推理模式，而非推理风格本身；代码、数据与模型全部开源。

summary_sections.motivation: 长上下文复杂推理的监督数据难以自动判定答案正确性，且常缺少真实上下文，导致 CoT 与实际语境脱节。

summary_sections.result: 四个长上下文推理基准加自建 π²-Bench 上，gpt-oss-20b 平均绝对准确率 +6.25%，Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 +3.37%，均为一致提升。消融式分析表明推理风格贡献很小，回译得到的忠实推理模式与真实长上下文是提升的关键。
summary_sections.conclusion: 长上下文推理能力的提升来自可验证 QA 与扎根真实上下文的忠实推理模式，而非推理风格本身；代码、数据与模型全部开源。

papers.title: MultiLoc: Look Around As You Localize for Fast And Robust Visual Re-localization
papers.abstract_en: Relative camera pose is a basic geometric cue for visual re-localization and scene understanding. When using images alone, visual evidence may not sufficiently support reliable estimation of 3D-consistent motion. The challenge is especially acute in unfamiliar and ever-changing environments for real-time applications, where a system must infer spatial structure under tight time constraints from what it sees rather than rely on scene-specific reconstruction or training. This raises a fundamental question: how can live 3D camera motion be estimated accurately for re-localization in unseen environments while drawing on enough scene context to resolve pose ambiguity? We introduce MultiLoc, a multi-view-guided relative pose regressor trained at scale to achieve spatial and geometric consistent representations for robust visual re-localization in unseen scenarios with high inference speed. Specifically, MultiLoc creates a minimal 3D-sub-scene representation of the environment and efficiently transforms it into 3D spatially and geometrically consistent features in a single forward pass, enabling precise pose estimates with high inference speed gains. Across diverse indoor, outdoor, and in-the-wild visual re-localization benchmarks---Indoor6, Cambridge Landmarks and WaySpots---MultiLoc consistently outperforms state-of-the-art relative pose regression methods. We also highlight that MultiLoc, a pose regressor, also performs competitively with inference-heavy and structure-based approaches while retaining sub-second inference and generalizing to unseen scenes. Given a small posed support set, it also surpasses relative pose regression, feature-matching, and non-regression methods on several relative camera pose benchmarks. Code will be released.
papers.comment: Replaced because of new training with additional Scannet++ dataset. For evaluation added more up-to-date baselines and fixed the reloc3'r inference time with RoPE's CUDA kernel
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MultiLoc 是一个多视角引导的相对位姿回归器，把环境压成最小 3D 子场景表示，单次前向输出空间与几何一致的特征，在未见过的场景中直接回归相机相对位姿。在 Indoor6、Cambridge Landmarks、WaySpots 等室内外与野外重定位基准上持续优于现有相对位姿回归方法，并保持亚秒级推理。
Motivation: 仅靠图像难以可靠估计 3D 一致的相机运动，在陌生且不断变化的实时环境中尤其突出：系统必须在严格时间约束下从所见推断空间结构，而不能依赖场景专属的重建或训练。
Method: 训练一个大规模多视角引导的相对位姿回归器 MultiLoc：先构造环境的最小 3D 子场景表示，再在单次前向中把它转成空间与几何一致的特征并直接回归位姿；给定少量带位姿的支持集时还可进一步提升。
Result: 在 Indoor6、Cambridge Landmarks、WaySpots 三组室内外与野外重定位基准上，持续优于 SOTA 相对位姿回归方法；作为位姿回归器，其表现与推理开销大的结构化方法相当，同时保持亚秒级推理；给定少量带位姿支持集时，在多个相对相机位姿基准上超过相对位姿回归、特征匹配与非回归方法。
Conclusion: 用最小 3D 子场景表示加单次前向的多视角位姿回归，可以在未见场景中同时拿到竞争力的重定位精度与亚秒级速度，无需场景专属重建或结构化推理开销。

papers.title: Live Interactive Training for Video Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Interactive video segmentation often requires many user interventions for robust performance in challenging scenarios (e.g., occlusions, object separations, camouflage, etc.). Yet, even state-of-the-art models like SAM2 use corrections only for immediate fixes without learning from this feedback, leading to inefficient, repetitive user effort. To address this, we introduce Live Interactive Training (LIT), a novel framework for prompt-based visual systems where models also learn online from human corrections at inference time. Our primary instantiation, LIT-LoRA, implements this by continually updating a lightweight LoRA module on-the-fly. When a user provides a correction, this module is rapidly trained on that feedback, allowing the vision system to improve performance on subsequent frames of the same video. Leveraging the core principles of LIT, our LIT-LoRA implementation achieves an average 18-34% reduction in total corrections on challenging video segmentation benchmarks, with a negligible training overhead of ~0.5s per correction. We further demonstrate its generality by successfully adapting it to other segmentation models and extending it to CLIP-based fine-grained image classification. Our work highlights the promise of live adaptation to transform interactive tools and significantly reduce redundant human effort in complex visual tasks. Project: https://youngxinyu1802.github.io/projects/LIT/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Live Interactive Training (LIT) 框架与 LIT-LoRA 实现，让交互式分割模型在推理时在线从用户纠正中学习：每次纠正即时微调轻量 LoRA 模块，使后续帧表现提升。在有遮挡、物体分离、伪装等困难场景的视频分割基准上，总纠正次数平均减少 18-34%，每次纠正的训练开销仅约 0.5 秒。
Motivation: SAM2 等模型只把用户纠正当作即时修补，不从中学习，导致在遮挡、分离、伪装等困难场景下用户反复做重复纠正，交互效率低。
Method: LIT 框架在推理阶段在线学习人类纠正；LIT-LoRA 在收到纠正时即时持续更新一个轻量 LoRA 模块，把该反馈快速训练后应用到同一视频的后续帧；并迁移到其他分割模型与基于 CLIP 的细粒度图像分类。
Result: 在困难视频分割基准上总纠正次数平均减少 18-34%，每次纠正的训练开销约 0.5 秒；该方法成功适配到其他分割模型，并扩展到 CLIP-based 细粒度图像分类。
Conclusion: 在线适应可把用户纠正转化为对后续帧的持续改进，从而显著减少复杂视觉任务中的重复人力投入，且训练开销可忽略。

papers.title: MDKeyChunker: What Does One LLM Call per Chunk Buy for Markdown Retrieval?
papers.abstract_en: Markdown carries structure a parser reads for free: headers, section paths, and block boundaries. Many RAG pipelines also spend LLM calls per chunk on generated metadata. We ask what one LLM call per chunk buys over that free structure. MDKeyChunker splits Markdown into header-led chunks without splitting any block; makes one LLM call per chunk for a title, summary, keywords, entities, questions, and a subtopic key, showing the model the keys already assigned in the document (a rolling key dictionary); and can merge same-key chunks. With qwen2.5:7b, we evaluate 79 Qasper questions over 30 papers and 73 FreshStack questions over 24 Laravel documentation files under BM25, two dense embedders, and hybrid fusion, following an analysis plan committed before results were computed. Evidence is matched only against source text, within a fixed token budget. Under hybrid retrieval, structural chunks beat 512-character windows on both datasets (Qasper +23.0 points, 95% CI [+12.8, +33.5]; FreshStack +5.1 [+1.4, +9.0]) and 256-token windows on Qasper (+12.7 [+5.3, +20.3]) but not on FreshStack (-2.6 [-6.4, +1.2]). Under the primary retrievers (hybrid, BM25), enrichment shows no planned-comparison difference from a free section-path prefix or from contextual retrieval; under hybrid retrieval the intervals exclude gains above 4.5 and 2.3 points on Qasper and 6.1 on FreshStack. Outside the planned comparisons, enrichment-style prefixes help BM25 on Qasper (exploratory) and mxbai on FreshStack (a secondary retriever). Rolling keys raise key reuse from 5.5% to 14.7%, but merging does not improve retrieval, and under BM25 on Qasper merging with rolling keys scores below merging without them (-6.0 [-13.1, -0.2]). Enrichment used about 1,000 input tokens per chunk; contextual retrieval 5,520 (Qasper) and 9,825 (FreshStack). The results of versions 1 and 2 are withdrawn.
papers.comment: 32 pages. v3: new evaluation on Qasper and FreshStack (Laravel) with an analysis plan committed before results; results of v1-v2 withdrawn (Appendix F); title changed. Code, harness and results: https://github.com/bhavik-mangla/MDKeyChunker
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MDKeyChunker 把 Markdown 按 header 切块且不切断任何 block，每块只做一次 LLM 调用生成 title、summary、keywords、entities、questions 与 subtopic key（带滚动 key 字典），并可合并同 key 块。在 Qasper 79 题与 FreshStack 73 题（Laravel 文档）上，hybrid 检索下结构化块优于 512 字符窗口（Qasper +23.0 点，95% CI [+12.8, +33.5]；FreshStack +5.1 [+1.4, +9.0]），但每块 LLM 元数据增强相对免费 section-path 前缀在主检索器上无计划内差异。
Motivation: RAG 流水线普遍为每个 chunk 花 LLM 调用生成元数据，而 Markdown 解析器本可免费给出 header、section path 与 block 边界；该文要量化这每次调用到底买到了什么。
Method: header 切块不切断 block；每块一次 LLM 调用产出 title/summary/keywords/entities/questions/subtopic key，并向模型展示文档中已分配的 key（rolling key dictionary），支持同 key 合并。用 qwen2.5:7b，在 BM25、两个 dense embedder 与 hybrid fusion 下评测，证据仅与源文本匹配且受固定 token 预算约束，分析计划在出结果前提交。
Result: hybrid 下结构块胜 512 字符窗口：Qasper +23.0 点（95% CI [+12.8, +33.5]）、FreshStack +5.1（[+1.4, +9.0]）；对 256-token 窗口 Qasper +12.7（[+5.3, +20.3]），FreshStack −2.6（[−6.4, +1.2]）。主检索器上增强无计划内差异，区间排除 Qasper 超过 4.5 与 2.3 点、FreshStack 超过 6.1 点的增益。rolling key 使 key 复用率 5.5%→14.7%，但合并不提升检索，BM25/Qasper 上带 rolling key 合并 −6.0（[−13.1, −0.2]）。增强每块约 1,000 输入 token，contextual retrieval 为 5,520（Qasper）与 9,825（FreshStack）。
Conclusion: 免费的 Markdown 结构本身带来主要检索收益，每 chunk 一次 LLM 元数据增强在主检索器上没有计划内回报；v1–v2 结果已撤回，v3 换为 Qasper 与 FreshStack 新评测。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: RAC: Rectified Flow Auto Coder
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a Rectified Flow Auto Coder (RAC) inspired by Rectified Flow to replace the traditional VAE: 1. It achieves multi-step decoding by applying the decoder to flow timesteps. Its decoding path is straight and correctable, enabling step-by-step refinement. 2. The model inherently supports bidirectional inference, where the decoder serves as the encoder through time reversal (hence Coder rather than encoder or decoder), reducing parameter count by nearly 41%. 3. This generative decoding method improves generation quality since the model can correct latent variables along the path, partially addressing the reconstruction--generation gap. Experiments show that RAC achieves a Pareto improvement over SOTA VAEs, where even a 10$\times$ parameter-reduced decoder exceeds full-scale VAE performance in both reconstruction and generation quality, validating the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.comment: 12 Figures, 8 Tables. Project Page at https://world-snapshot.github.io/RAC/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAC 用 Rectified Flow 把 VAE 的解码器改成沿 flow 时间步的多步解码，路径直且可逐步修正潜在变量；同一网络经时间反转兼任编码器，参数量减少近 41%。在重建与生成质量上对 SOTA VAE 达到 Pareto 改进，解码器参数缩减 10 倍仍同时超过全规模 VAE 的重建与生成质量。
Motivation: 传统 VAE 的单步解码无法在生成路径上修正潜在变量，重建与生成之间存在 gap，且编码器与解码器参数重复。
Method: 提出 Rectified Flow Auto Coder (RAC)：把解码器作用在 rectified flow 的时间步上实现多步、可修正的解码；解码器通过时间反转 (time reversal) 兼作编码器，实现双向推理并压缩参数；生成过程中沿路径修正潜在变量以缓解 reconstruction-generation gap。
Result: 实验显示 RAC 相对 SOTA VAE 达到 Pareto improvement；解码器参数缩减 10 倍时，在重建与生成质量两项上仍超过全规模 VAE；双向推理设计使参数量减少近 41%。
Conclusion: 把 VAE 解码改写为 rectified flow 式的可修正多步解码并复用同一网络做双向推理，可以在更少参数下同时改善重建与生成质量。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: From Representational Complementarity to Dual Systems: Synergizing VLM and Vision-Only Backbones for End-to-End Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) driving augments end-to-end (E2E) planning with language-enabled visual backbones, but how VLM representations differ from vision-only encoders after policy learning, and whether such differences matter for planning, remains unclear. Under a unified VLM-hidden + diffusion-policy paradigm, we compare multiple VLM families/scales (InternVL3 and Qwen3VL) with standard vision-only encoders (ResNet, ViT, and EVA-CLIP) while keeping the downstream planner fixed. We study representation, behavior, and system design. CKA/CCA and Shared--Unique SAE show that policy learning enlarges a common decision subspace, but both branches retain non-transferable residual factors. We further replicate this shared-plus-unique representation pattern on nuPlan using the AsyncDrive planning stack. Latent-intervention policies and scenario-level analysis further show that these residuals are behaviorally meaningful: vision-only encoders are stronger in simple geometry-dominant scenes, whereas VLMs are more effective in semantically complex and interaction-heavy long-tail cases. The two branches also exhibit distinct progress--braking and path-choice tendencies, and an oracle best-of-two VLM+ViT selector reaches 93.58 PDMS on NAVSIM. We convert this complementarity into two lightweight systems: HybridDriveVLA, which selects from a compact cross-model candidate set using a learned trajectory scorer and improves PDMS from 90.80 to 92.10, and DualDriveVLA, a fast--slow variant that invokes the VLM in only 15% of scenarios, achieving 91.00 PDMS with about $1.9\times$ lower latency than the VLM baseline. Code will be available at https://github.com/WilliamXuanYu/HybridDriveVLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在统一的 VLM-hidden + diffusion-policy 框架下对比 InternVL3/Qwen3VL 与 ResNet/ViT/EVA-CLIP，发现策略学习扩大共享决策子空间但两支保留不可迁移的残差因子，且残差在行为上有分工：纯视觉在几何主导简单场景更强，VLM 在语义复杂、交互密集的长尾场景更有效。据此构建的 HybridDriveVLA 把 NAVSIM PDMS 从 90.80 提到 92.10，DualDriveVLA 只在 15% 场景调用 VLM 即达 91.00 PDMS 且延迟比 VLM 基线低约 1.9 倍。
Motivation: VLA 驾驶用语言使能的视觉骨干增强端到端规划，但 VLM 表征与纯视觉编码器在策略学习后究竟有何差异、这些差异是否真的影响规划，此前并不清楚。
Method: 在固定下游 planner 的 VLM-hidden + diffusion-policy 范式下比较多个 VLM 家族与规模（InternVL3、Qwen3VL）和标准视觉编码器（ResNet、ViT、EVA-CLIP）；用 CKA/CCA 与 Shared–Unique SAE 分解表征，并在 nuPlan 上用 AsyncDrive 规划栈复现共享加独特的模式；再用 latent-intervention 策略与场景级分析检验残差的行为意义，最后把互补性转成两个轻量系统。
Result: 策略学习扩大共享决策子空间，但两支都保留不可迁移的残差因子；纯视觉编码器在几何主导的简单场景更强，VLM 在语义复杂、交互密集的长尾场景更有效，两支还表现出不同的进度-刹车与路径选择倾向。oracle 的 VLM+ViT best-of-two 选择器在 NAVSIM 达 93.58 PDMS；HybridDriveVLA 用学习到的轨迹打分器从紧凑跨模型候选集选轨迹，把 PDMS 从 90.80 提到 92.10；DualDriveVLA 作为快慢变体只在 15% 场景调用 VLM，取得 91.00 PDMS，延迟比 VLM 基线低约 1.9 倍。

papers.title: Towards causal effect estimation with learned instrument representations
papers.abstract_en: Instrumental variable (IV) methods mitigate bias from unobserved confounding in observational causal inference but rely on the availability of a valid instrument, which can often be difficult or infeasible to identify in practice. In this paper, we propose a representation learning approach that constructs instrumental representations from observed covariates, which could enable IV-based estimation even in the absence of an explicit instrument. Our model (ZNet) achieves this through an architecture that mirrors the structural causal model of IVs; it decomposes the ambient feature space into confounding and instrumental components, and is trained by enforcing it empirical conditions corresponding to the defining properties of valid instruments (i.e., relevance and exclusion restriction). ZNet is compatible with a wide range of downstream two-stage IV estimators of causal effects. Our experiments demonstrate that ZNet (i) can recover ground-truth instruments when they already exist in the ambient feature space and (ii) constructs candidate latent instruments in the embedding space when no explicit IVs are available. However, instrument representations have inherent challenges which warrant caution and further research. This work explores when ZNet might be used as a module for causal inference in general observational settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ZNet，用镜像 IV 结构因果模型的表征学习网络把观测协变量分解为混杂分量与工具分量，并按有效工具的 relevance 与 exclusion restriction 经验条件训练，从而在没有显式工具变量时也能构造候选潜工具。实验显示它既能恢复已存在于特征空间中的真值工具，也能在无显式 IV 时在嵌入空间构造候选潜工具；作者同时指出工具表征本身存在固有挑战，需谨慎使用。
Motivation: 观测因果推断中的 IV 方法依赖一个有效工具变量，而实践中很难找到甚至不可行，导致基于 IV 的估计无法实施。
Method: ZNet 用镜像 IV 结构因果模型 (SCM) 的架构，把环境特征空间分解为混杂 (confounding) 与工具 (instrumental) 两个分量，并通过强制满足有效工具定义性质（relevance 与 exclusion restriction）的经验条件来训练；输出可接入多种下游两阶段 IV 因果效应估计器。
Result: 实验表明 ZNet 在环境特征空间中已存在真值工具时能将其恢复，并在没有显式 IV 可用时在嵌入空间中构造候选潜工具；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 学到的工具表征可以让 IV 估计在缺少显式工具的观测设置中成为可能，但这类表征具有固有挑战、需要谨慎对待并进一步研究，作者将其定位为一般观测场景下因果推断的一个可选模块。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Missing-Data-Induced Phase Transitions in Spectral Partial Least Squares
papers.abstract_en: Spectral partial least squares (PLS-SVD) estimates the directions shared by two views of the same samples. We analyze it using a rank-one regression model, with entries of both views missing completely at random and filled with zeros. Missing response entries weaken the signal, whereas missing design entries also tilt the recovered direction. The setting is the proportional regime, with Gaussian response noise and a design that is column-orthogonal before masking. For incoherent designs and planted directions, we prove that as the signal diverges, the squared overlap with the truth approaches $1$ on the response side but only a ceiling on the design side. This ceiling is strictly below $1$ whenever design entries are missing, unless samples of vanishing leverage carry the signal. For this estimator, a stronger signal therefore cannot remove the design-side error. Under equal leverage and an explicit spectral condition on the masked design, which we prove for designs taken from nested Hadamard matrices, we establish a phase transition and derive the recovery curves. Under the same conditions, the critical signal strength is exactly proportional to $ρ_y^{-1/2}$, with $ρ_y$ the fraction of response entries retained. A heuristic replica derivation reproduces the equations behind these curves, and simulations follow them, including on random orthogonal designs outside the verified class. In semi-synthetic experiments on real biological designs with unequal leverage, the predicted ceiling varies across directions, and high-signal recovery tracks it. These results bring the theory of PLS-SVD closer to what is known for PCA under homogeneous missingness and show that the loss of signal-to-noise ratio observed there does not, by itself, describe missing design entries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在秩一回归模型、比例维数体制下分析谱偏最小二乘 (PLS-SVD)：响应缺失只削弱信号，设计缺失还会让恢复方向偏转，使设计侧平方重叠在信号发散时只能逼近一个严格低于 1 的天花板。临界信号强度恰正比于 ρ_y^{-1/2}（ρ_y 为响应保留比例），相变曲线被模拟复现；结论是更强的信号无法消除设计缺失带来的误差。
Motivation: PCA 在均匀缺失下已知的信噪比损失不足以刻画设计条目缺失：PLS-SVD 的设计侧误差来源不同，需要区分响应缺失与设计缺失各自的机制。
Method: 用秩一回归模型、两视图条目完全随机缺失并补零，设定为比例体制、高斯响应噪声、设计在掩码前列正交；对非相干设计与植入方向证明相变与恢复曲线，另用 replica 启发式推导复现同一方程，并在嵌套 Hadamard 矩阵设计上验证显式谱条件。
Result: 信号发散时响应侧重叠平方趋于 1，设计侧仅趋于一个严格低于 1 的天花板（除非信号由消失杠杆样本承载）；临界信号强度恰正比于 ρ_y^{-1/2}。模拟跟随推导曲线，包括验证类之外的随机正交设计；在杠杆不均的真实生物设计半合成实验中，预测天花板随方向变化，高信号恢复与之吻合。
Conclusion: PLS-SVD 的设计缺失误差是结构性的，更强信号无法消除；该理论把 PLS-SVD 推向 PCA 在均匀缺失下的已知结果，同时说明那里的信噪比损失本身不足以描述设计条目缺失。

papers.title: ATOD: An Evaluation Framework and Benchmark for Agentic Task-Oriented Dialogue Systems
papers.abstract_en: Agentic task-oriented dialogue (TOD) requires systems to track concurrent goals, dependencies, and long-horizon state. We examine goal-lifecycle recovery from fixed dialogue trajectories. ATOD contains 1,000 synthetic dialogues annotated for six advanced-TOD properties, and ATOD-Eval defines metrics for dependency-sensitive completion, memory recall, and proactivity. We implement a symbolic-vector memory evaluator for ATOD-Eval. Among five prompt-only predictors and six matched-backbone memory baselines, our evaluator is the only configuration above 90% in both goal detection F1 and conditional status accuracy on medium dialogues. On complex dialogues, no baseline exceeds it on both metrics; it has the highest conditional status accuracy within the memory-based block and the lowest measured per-turn latency. These experiments assess lifecycle tracking rather than interactive agent task success. A cross-family judge swap and a manual audit with 94.0% agreement provide initial checks on measurement reliability. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/amazon-science/ATOD.
papers.comment: Camera-ready version accepted at AACL-IJCNLP 2026. 18 pages. Code and data: https://github.com/amazon-science/ATOD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ATOD 提出面向 agentic 任务导向对话 (TOD) 的评测框架与基准：1,000 条合成对话标注六项高级 TOD 属性，ATOD-Eval 定义依赖敏感完成度、记忆回忆与主动性指标，并实现符号-向量记忆评测器 (symbolic-vector memory evaluator)。在 medium 对话上它是唯一同时在 goal detection F1 与 conditional status accuracy 双双超过 90% 的配置；复杂对话上无基线在两项指标上同时超过它，且在记忆类基线中 conditional status accuracy 最高、单轮延迟最低。
Motivation: Agentic TOD 需要跟踪并发目标、依赖关系与长程状态，但现有评测缺少针对目标生命周期恢复（从固定对话轨迹中恢复）的专门基准与指标。
Method: 构建 ATOD：1,000 条合成对话，标注六项 advanced-TOD 属性；ATOD-Eval 定义依赖敏感完成度、记忆回忆、主动性三类指标；实现符号-向量记忆评测器，并与五个 prompt-only 预测器和六个同骨干记忆基线对比。可靠性用跨家族 judge swap 与人工审计（94.0% 一致率）检验。
Result: 在 medium 对话上，该评测器是唯一同时在 goal detection F1 与 conditional status accuracy 达到 90% 以上的配置；在 complex 对话上没有基线在两项指标上同时超过它，其 conditional status accuracy 在记忆类基线中最高，单轮延迟最低。人工审计一致率 94.0%。
Conclusion: 符号-向量记忆评测器可在固定轨迹上可靠地做目标生命周期跟踪评测，但作者明确这些实验只评估 lifecycle tracking，而非交互式 agent 的任务成功。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Neutral Substrates: A Design Constraint for Shared Records Under Persistent Interpretive Disagreement
papers.abstract_en: Shared accountability records are often used by parties who may never agree about causation, responsibility, or normative interpretation. For such records, neutrality cannot be achieved by omitting contested information, because accountability requires preserving the claims parties made, with their sources and provenance. Nor can neutrality be achieved by asserting one contested interpretation as the shared base. This paper defines a neutral substrate as a shared representational layer that provides stable reference while making no object-level substrate-layer commitments to causal or normative propositions. The central design constraint is that, when causal and normative propositions are contestable across admissible frameworks and the substrate's referential commitments are common ground, the substrate's neutrality is guaranteed at design time if and only if its foundational layer is restricted to those referential commitments and attribution propositions whose attributional basis is fixed by them. Causal and normative content may still be represented, but not as object-level foundational-layer commitments: it may appear there only as the content of attributed assertions with provenance, made by some identified framework, source, agent, institution, record, or document. The representational machinery used here is standard: reification, attribution, and provenance. The contribution is the constraint: a checkable condition on the foundational layer of a shared record, stated together with the assumptions it depends on and the boundary condition under which the constraint does not apply. A neutral substrate says enough to preserve accountability, but it does not turn one party's interpretation into an object-level substrate-layer commitment. The constraint does not apply at that layer when the referential regime or attributional basis is contested among the frameworks in play.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 neutral substrate（中性基底）：共享问责记录的表征层只允许引用承诺与归属命题作为基础层对象级承诺，因果与规范内容只能以带出处的归属断言出现。论文给出一个可检验的设计时约束及其成立的充要条件，并明确当引用体制或归属基础本身有争议时该约束不适用。
Motivation: 共享问责记录的使用方可能永远无法就因果、责任与规范解释达成一致；删掉争议信息会损害问责，把某一方解释写成共享基底又会丧失中立性。
Method: 用 reification、attribution、provenance 这些标准表征机制，把因果与规范命题降为由某个已识别框架、来源、机构或文档作出的带出处归属断言；在此之上陈述基础层的可检验约束及其依赖假设与边界条件。
Result: 给出充要条件：当因果与规范命题在可容许框架间可争议、且基底的引用承诺是共同基础时，基底中立性在设计时得到保证，当且仅当基础层被限制在这些引用承诺及其固定的归属基础之上；并给出约束不适用的边界条件（引用体制或归属基础在各框架间有争议）。

papers.title: Memory as Resonance: A Biomimetic Architecture for Infinite Context Memory on Ergodic Phonetic Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: The memory of contemporary Large Language Models is bound by a physical paradox: as they learn, they fill up. The linear accumulation (O(N)) of Key-Value states treats context as a warehouse of static artifacts, eventually forcing a destructive choice between amnesia and latency. We challenge this discrete orthodoxy, proposing that long-term memory is not the storage of items, but the persistence of a trajectory. We introduce Phonetic Trajectory Memory (PTM), a neuro-symbolic architecture that encodes language not as a sequence of tensors, but as a continuous path on an ergodic manifold governed by irrational rotation matrices. By decoupling the navigation (an invariant O(1) geometric signal) from the reconstruction (a probabilistic generative act), PTM achieves a compression magnitude of greater than 3,000x relative to dense caches. We demonstrate that retrieval becomes a process of resonance: the phonetic trace stabilizes the model against hallucination via "Signal Consensus" mechanism, securing up to approximately 92% factual accuracy. While this aggressive abstraction alters generative texture, it unlocks immediate access latency (approximately 34ms) independent of depth. Our results suggest that infinite context does not require infinite silicon; it requires treating memory not as data to be stored, but as a reconstructive process acting on a conserved, undying physical signal.
papers.comment: Withdrawn by the authors due to a methodological error discovered in the analysis, which invalidates the reported results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Phonetic Trajectory Memory (PTM)，把语言编码为遍历流形上由无理旋转矩阵支配的连续轨迹，导航信号为 O(1) 不变量，重建为概率生成过程，从而把 KV 缓存的 O(N) 线性累积换成与深度无关的重构式记忆。相对 dense cache 压缩超过 3000 倍，延迟约 34ms，经 "Signal Consensus" 机制把事实准确率提到约 92%。作者已因分析中的方法错误撤稿，报告结果失效。
Motivation: LLM 的 KV 状态随上下文线性累积 O(N)，学习过程本身在填满缓存，最终只能在失忆与高延迟之间二选一；论文主张把长期记忆从存储条目改为轨迹的持续。
Method: PTM 是 neuro-symbolic 架构：用无理旋转矩阵 (irrational rotation matrices) 驱动的遍历流形 (ergodic manifold) 上的连续路径编码语言，把导航（O(1) 几何信号）与重建（概率生成）解耦；检索通过 "Signal Consensus" 机制以共振方式稳定输出、抑制幻觉。
Result: 相对 dense cache 压缩幅度大于 3000 倍；事实准确率最高约 92%；访问延迟约 34ms 且与深度无关；代价是生成纹理 (generative texture) 被改变。arXiv comment 记载作者因分析中发现方法错误而撤稿，报告结果失效。
Conclusion: 作者主张无限上下文不需要无限硅，只需把记忆当作作用于守恒物理信号的重构过程；但该结论已因方法错误被作者自己撤回，报告数字不再成立。

papers.title: Global Optimization on Graph-Structured Data via Gaussian Processes with Spectral Representations
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a powerful framework for optimizing expensive black-box objectives, yet extending it to graph-structured domains remains challenging due to the discrete and combinatorial nature of graphs. Existing approaches often rely either on full graph topology, which is impractical for large or partially observed graphs, or on incremental local exploration, which can lead to slow convergence. We introduce a scalable framework for global optimization over graphs that builds Gaussian process (GP) surrogates from low-rank spectral representations inferred from sparse structural observations. The method fits a low-rank graph surrogate to the observed connections and uses its spectrum to define a kernel over all nodes, so that function evaluations and structural observations jointly refine a global model, enabling efficient global search and principled uncertainty estimation even with limited data. We further show how a limited budget of structural observations can be allocated according to its expected value for the optimization. We also provide theoretical analysis establishing conditions under which the surrogate geometry is identified under different sampling regimes, and bounding the optimization error incurred under an estimated geometry. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves lower regret and improved optimization performance compared to prior methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出图结构域上的贝叶斯优化 (BO) 框架：从稀疏结构观测推断低秩谱表示，用其谱构造覆盖全部节点的 GP 核，使函数评估与结构观测共同精化全局代理模型。在合成与真实数据集上取得更低 regret 与更好的优化表现，并给出按期望价值分配有限结构观测预算的做法。
Motivation: 图上的 BO 受图的离散组合性制约：依赖完整图拓扑的方法在大规模或部分观测图上不可行，而增量式局部探索收敛慢。
Method: 用低秩谱表示拟合观测到的连接，得到低秩图代理，再以其谱定义全节点核，构建 GP 代理；函数评估与结构观测联合更新全局模型，并按期望价值分配有限的结构观测预算。附带理论分析：给出不同采样机制下代理几何可被辨识的条件，以及在估计几何下优化误差的界。
Result: 在合成与真实数据集上，相比先前方法取得更低 regret 与更好的优化性能；理论给出代理几何可辨识条件与估计几何下的优化误差界。
Conclusion: 稀疏结构观测加谱表示足以支撑图上的全局搜索与有原则的不确定性估计，即使数据有限；结构观测预算应按其对优化的期望价值来分配。

papers.title: Spectral Analysis of Molecular Features: When Richer Features Do Not Guarantee Better Generalization
papers.abstract_en: The spectral properties of feature embeddings offer critical insights into model generalization and representation quality. While deep learning models are widely used for molecular property prediction, kernel methods remain competitive in low-data regimes, yet their spectral behavior is largely unexplored. We present the first comprehensive spectral analysis of kernel ridge regression across diverse representations, including molecular fingerprints (ECFP), pretrained transformers, graph neural networks, and 3D descriptors, evaluated on QM9, MoleculeNet, and Therapeutics Data Commons benchmarks. Surprisingly, richer spectral features do not consistently yield better generalization performance, contradicting common representation heuristics used in self-supervised learning (SSL). Across four spectral metrics, only ECFP-based kernels show a strictly positive correlation with performance, particularly SSE, ID, and SR on MoleculeNet. Global 3D representations exhibit mixed behavior; transformer-based representations are consistently positive across all four metrics, whereas local 3D representations show a negative trend and no significant correlations. Truncation analysis further emphasizes this disparity: for local 3D representations on thermodynamic targets, fewer than 2% of eigenvalues, and occasionally as few as 0.02%, are needed to recover 95% of performance, whereas ECFP and transformer kernels require significantly more. By demonstrating a strong dependence on both task and representation, our results challenge the heuristic that richer spectra inherently improve generalization, providing new guidance for evaluating representations in SSL and in label-limited scientific tasks.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables, SI: 18 pages, 10 figures, 9 Tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对分子性质预测中的 kernel ridge regression 做首个跨表示谱分析，发现更丰富的谱特征并不稳定带来更好泛化：ECFP 核的谱指标与性能正相关，而局部 3D 表示在热力学目标上仅用不到 2%（有时低至 0.02%）的特征值即可恢复 95% 性能。结论是表示评价必须按任务与表示类型分别做，不能沿用“谱越丰富越好”的 SSL 启发式。
Motivation: 深度学习主导分子性质预测，但低数据 regime 下 kernel 方法仍有竞争力，其谱行为却基本未被研究；自监督学习中“更丰富谱特征=更好泛化”的启发式缺少系统检验。
Method: 在 QM9、MoleculeNet、Therapeutics Data Commons 上对 kernel ridge regression 做谱分析，覆盖 ECFP 分子指纹、预训练 transformer、图神经网络与 3D 描述符（全局与局部）四类表示；用四种谱指标（含 SSE、ID、SR）衡量谱与性能的相关，并做特征值截断分析（truncation analysis）。
Result: 四种谱指标中只有 ECFP 核与性能严格正相关，在 MoleculeNet 上以 SSE、ID、SR 尤为明显；transformer 表示在四个指标上一致为正，全局 3D 表现混杂，局部 3D 呈负趋势且无显著相关。截断分析显示局部 3D 表示在热力学目标上用不到 2%（偶尔 0.02%）的特征值即可恢复 95% 性能，而 ECFP 与 transformer 核需要多得多的特征值。
Conclusion: 谱与泛化的关系强烈依赖任务和表示类型，“谱更丰富必然泛化更好”的启发式不成立；对 SSL 与标签受限的科学任务，表示评价应按任务与表示分别检验谱指标。

papers.title: Neural Bayesian Filtering
papers.abstract_en: Sequential estimation under partial observability requires tracking beliefs that may be high-dimensional, multimodal, and non-Gaussian. Classical Bayesian filters generalize zero-shot to any system whose dynamics can be evaluated, but their representations scale poorly: parametric filters struggle to capture multimodality, and particle filters require exponentially many particles in the state dimension. Generative Distribution Embeddings (GDEs) learn compact representations of complex distributions but have no sequential update. We present Neural Bayesian Filtering (NBF), which represents beliefs as embeddings and approximates their Bayesian update. At each step, NBF samples particles from a learned conditional generator, propagates them through the dynamics, and embeds the propagated set, weighted by the likelihood of the new observation. Regenerating the set from the embedding at each step, rather than resampling a surviving pool, mitigates the risk of impoverishment that degrades particle filters. The system dynamics and likelihood enter only through propagation and weighting, so NBF retains zero-shot adaptability to new dynamics as long as the beliefs they produce fall within the family the embedding was trained on. Training the GDE to represent that family requires only the states realized at training time. We validate NBF on Lorenz-96 and a pursuit--evasion domain, showing graceful scaling with state dimension, accurate tracking of multimodal posteriors, and zero-shot generalization to dynamics and likelihoods held out from training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Neural Bayesian Filtering (NBF) 用 Generative Distribution Embeddings (GDE) 把信念表示为嵌入，并用学习到的条件生成器近似贝叶斯更新：每步从生成器采样粒子、经动力学传播、按新观测似然加权后嵌入，再从嵌入重新生成粒子集而非重采样存活池，从而缓解粒子滤波的粒子贫化。在 Lorenz-96 与 pursuit–evasion 上验证，随状态维度增长表现平缓、能准确跟踪多模态后验，并对训练时留出的动力学与似然零样本泛化。
Motivation: 部分可观测下的序贯估计中，信念可能高维、多模态、非高斯：参数化滤波器难以刻画多模态，粒子滤波所需粒子数随状态维度指数增长，而 GDE 虽能紧凑表示复杂分布却没有序贯更新。
Method: NBF 将信念表示为 GDE 嵌入并近似其贝叶斯更新：每步从学到的条件生成器采样粒子，经系统动力学传播，按新观测似然加权后嵌入，再从嵌入重新生成粒子集。动力学与似然只通过传播和加权进入，因此只要信念落在嵌入训练所覆盖的分布族内即可零样本适配新动力学；训练 GDE 只需训练期实际出现的状态。
Result: 在 Lorenz-96 与 pursuit–evasion 两个域上验证：随状态维度增长表现平缓 (graceful scaling)，准确跟踪多模态后验，并对训练时留出的动力学与似然实现零样本泛化。
Conclusion: 用嵌入加条件生成器重生成粒子集，可以在不指数扩粒子的前提下做序贯贝叶斯更新，并保留经典滤波器对新动力学的零样本适应性。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Bayesian Distributional Models of Executive Functioning
papers.abstract_en: This study uses controlled simulations with known ground-truth parameters to evaluate how Distributional Latent Variable Models (DLVM) and Bayesian Distributional Active LEarning (DALE) perform in comparison to conventional Independent Maximum Likelihood Estimation (IMLE). DLVM integrates observations across multiple executive function tasks and individuals, allowing parameter estimation even under sparse or incomplete data conditions. To establish known-ground truth, we uniformly sample individual sessions from a neural network learned latent space and map them to distributional cognitive performance across different tasks. The individual test-items are then sampled from these distributions using either DALE, random procedure or a standard fixed battery approach. When given the same set of observations, DLVM consistently outperformed IMLE, especially under smaller amounts of data, and converges faster to highly accurate estimates of the true distributions. In a second set of analyses, DALE adaptively guided sampling to maximize information gain, outperforming random sampling and fixed test batteries, particularly within the first 80 trials. These findings establish the advantages of combining DLVM's cross-task inference with DALE's optimal adaptive sampling, providing a principled basis for more efficient cognitive assessments.

papers.title: Nutation Damping from Core-Mantle Boundary Topography
papers.abstract_en: Periodic gravitational forcing by the Moon and Sun produces small oscillations in Earth's rotation known as nutations. Nutations are amplified by a resonance with a natural motion of the liquid core called the Free Core Nutation, whose amplitude is limited by friction-like processes at the core--mantle boundary. Previous studies have attributed this damping to the dissipation of electric currents induced in the lower conducting mantle, but, given current knowledge of the lower mantle, electromagnetic coupling appears insufficient to fully account for the observed lag. We show that additional dissipation arises from the interaction of the tidal flow inside the core with the topography of the core--mantle boundary, which excites internal waves that extract energy and momentum from the flow. Adapting a theory originally developed for tides over seafloor topography, we find that the observed damping can be fully accounted for by a topography of typical amplitude $\sim 5$ km dominated by features of wavelength $\sim$1500~km. The dissipation is highest when the upper core is neutrally buoyant. Such amplitudes are larger than typical inferences from global seismic studies but are not ruled out, given regional seismic evidence for kilometer-scale features and the sparse constraints at these scales.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in JGR Solid Earth
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 地核潮汐流与核幔边界 (CMB) 顶部地形相互作用激发内波，从流动中抽取能量与动量，从而提供章动 (nutation) 的额外阻尼。把海底地形潮汐理论移植到 CMB 后，典型振幅约 5 km、以波长约 1500 km 尺度为主的地形即可完全解释观测到的章动滞后；上核处于中性浮力时耗散最强。
Motivation: 月日周期引力强迫产生的章动被自由核章动 (Free Core Nutation) 共振放大，其振幅受核幔边界类摩擦过程限制；此前归因于下地幔导电层感应电流的电磁耦合，就现有下地幔认识而言不足以解释观测到的滞后。
Method: 将原本用于海底地形潮汐的理论适配到核幔边界：核内潮汐流与 CMB 地形耦合激发内波，由内波耗散计算能量与动量抽取，并据此反推能解释观测阻尼的地形振幅与波长特征。
Result: 观测到的章动阻尼可由典型振幅约 5 km、以波长约 1500 km 尺度为主的 CMB 地形完全解释；上核中性浮力时耗散最高。该振幅大于全球地震学研究的典型推断值，但区域地震证据显示存在公里级起伏且该尺度约束稀疏，故未被排除。
Conclusion: 核幔边界地形激发的内波耗散足以补足电磁耦合无法解释的章动阻尼，且所需地形幅度与现有地震学并不矛盾。

papers.title: Studying the Soupability of Documents in State Space Models
papers.abstract_en: We investigate whether hidden states from Structured State Space Models (SSMs) can be merged post hoc to support downstream reasoning. Inspired by model souping, we study document souping, a strategy where documents are encoded independently, and their representations are pooled, via simple operations like averaging, into a single context state. This approach enables modular encoding and reuse without reprocessing the full input for each query. We demonstrate that finetuned Mamba2 models with souped representations achieve competitive or superior performance across multi-hop QA, sparse retrieval, and long-document reasoning tasks compared to the standard monolithic encoding approach. For example, on the RACE and QuALITY benchmarks for long document question answering, this method substantially outperforms a traditional concatenation approach. Crucially, this modular design scales to hundreds of segments (we test up to 256) while delivering substantial savings in inference cost, unlocking new possibilities for large-scale corpus reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 SSM 编码的多个文档隐状态用平均这类简单操作合并成单一 context state（document souping），可免去每个查询重新编码整篇输入。微调后的 Mamba2 在 RACE 与 QuALITY 长文档问答上明显优于传统拼接编码，且可扩展到 256 个分段并显著降低推理成本。
Motivation: 长文档多跳问答与稀疏检索中，标准做法是把输入拼成单一编码，每个查询都要重跑整段编码，既难复用也难扩展到大规模语料。
Method: 受 model souping 启发提出 document souping：各文档独立编码后，用平均等简单算子把隐状态池化为一个 context state，实现模块化编码与复用；在微调的 Mamba2 上与标准整体（monolithic）编码和传统拼接方式对比，任务覆盖多跳 QA、稀疏检索与长文档推理。
Result: 微调 Mamba2 配合合并表征在多跳 QA、稀疏检索、长文档推理上达到与整体编码相当或更优的表现；在 RACE 与 QuALITY 长文档问答上大幅超过传统拼接方式；模块化设计测试到 256 个分段，并带来显著的推理成本节省。
Conclusion: SSM 的文档级隐状态可以事后合并而不损下游推理能力，因此编码可按模块复用，让大规模语料推理不必对每个查询重编码全文。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Using Echo-State Networks to Reproduce Rare Events in Chaotic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Echo-State Networks (ESNs) are known to reproduce trajectories and main properties of chaotic attractors. Here, we investigate the question of whether ESNs can reproduce rare events in a system with a stationary distribution with slowly decaying bounded tails. In particular, we consider the chaotic four-dimensional competitive Lotka--Volterra system, and quantify extremes using the Generalized Extreme Value distribution. In stationary simulations, the ESN reproduces the stationary distributions and rare event statistics with high accuracy. In addition, the ESN also reproduces rare event statistics for non-equilibrium ensemble simulations for initial conditions relatively close to the underlying attractor. However, the performance of the ESN deteriorates as the ensemble spread increases and trajectories explore regions of phase space not represented in the training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用回声状态网络 (Echo-State Network, ESN) 学习混沌四维竞争 Lotka–Volterra 系统的映射，检验其能否复现具有缓慢衰减有界尾部的平稳分布中的稀有事件。平稳仿真中 ESN 高精度复现平稳分布与极值统计（按 Generalized Extreme Value 分布度量）；非平衡集合仿真在初值接近真实吸引子时同样成立，但集合离散度增大、轨迹进入训练数据未覆盖的相空间区域后性能退化。
Motivation: ESN 已知能复现混沌吸引子的轨迹与主要性质，但对平稳分布缓慢衰减有界尾部所定义的稀有事件能否复现尚不清楚，而这直接决定其在极端统计推断中的可用性。
Method: 以四维竞争 Lotka–Volterra 混沌系统为对象，用 ESN 学习其动力学；以 Generalized Extreme Value (GEV) 分布量化极值，分别在平稳仿真与非平衡集合仿真（不同初值、不同集合离散度）下检验 ESN 输出的分布与稀有事件统计。
Result: 平稳仿真中 ESN 高精度复现平稳分布与稀有事件统计；非平衡集合仿真中，初值相对接近底层吸引子时也能复现稀有事件统计；集合离散度增大、轨迹探索训练数据未表示的相空间区域时性能退化。
Conclusion: ESN 可以复现混沌系统平稳分布的稀有事件统计，但其可靠性依赖训练数据对相空间的覆盖，外推到未见区域即失效。

papers.title: MoFlow: One-Step Flow Matching for Human Trajectory Forecasting via Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation based Distillation
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we address the problem of human trajectory forecasting, which aims to predict the inherently multi-modal future movements of humans based on their past trajectories and other contextual cues. We propose a novel motion prediction conditional flow matching model, termed MoFlow, to predict K-shot future trajectories for all agents in a given scene. We design a novel flow matching loss function that not only ensures at least one of the $K$ sets of future trajectories is accurate but also encourages all $K$ sets of future trajectories to be diverse and plausible. Furthermore, by leveraging the implicit maximum likelihood estimation (IMLE), we propose a novel distillation method for flow models that only requires samples from the teacher model. Extensive experiments on the real-world datasets, including SportVU NBA games, ETH-UCY, and SDD, demonstrate that both our teacher flow model and the IMLE-distilled student model achieve state-of-the-art performance. These models can generate diverse trajectories that are physically and socially plausible. Moreover, our one-step student model is $\textbf{100}$ times faster than the teacher flow model during sampling. The code, model, and data are available at our project page: https://moflow-imle.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoFlow 用条件流匹配 (conditional flow matching) 预测场景中所有智能体的 K 组多模态未来轨迹，新流匹配损失同时保证至少一组 K 轨迹准确且各组多样合理；再用仅需教师采样的 IMLE 蒸馏出单步学生模型。在 SportVU NBA、ETH-UCY、SDD 上教师与蒸馏学生均达 SOTA，单步采样比教师快 100 倍。
Motivation: 人类轨迹未来本质多模态，既要 K 组轨迹里至少一组准、又要各组多样且物理与社交合理；流匹配模型采样慢，难以在交互场景实时使用。
Method: 条件流匹配 (conditional flow matching) 作为运动预测生成模型，配新流匹配损失同时约束 K 组未来轨迹的准确性与多样性；再提出基于隐式最大似然估计 (IMLE) 的流模型蒸馏方法，只用教师模型的采样训练单步学生。
Result: 在真实数据集 SportVU NBA games、ETH-UCY、SDD 上，教师流模型与 IMLE 蒸馏学生模型均取得 state-of-the-art 表现，生成的轨迹多样且物理、社交合理；单步学生采样速度为教师流模型的 100 倍。
Conclusion: 流匹配加 IMLE 蒸馏可以在不牺牲轨迹质量的前提下把多模态轨迹预测压到单步采样，代码、模型与数据已开源。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Efficient Hierarchical Transformers for Representing Log Data
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have gained widespread acclaim for their versatility in handling diverse data structures, yet their application to log data remains underexplored. Log data, characterized by its hierarchical, dictionary-like structure, poses unique challenges when processed using conventional transformer models. Traditional methods often rely on manually crafted templates for parsing logs, a process that is labor-intensive and lacks generalizability. Additionally, the linear treatment of log sequences by standard transformers neglects the rich, nested relationships within log entries, leading to suboptimal representations and excessive memory usage. To address these issues, we introduce HLogformer, a novel hierarchical transformer framework specifically designed for log data. HLogformer leverages the hierarchical structure of log entries to significantly reduce memory costs and enhance representation learning. Unlike traditional models that treat log data as flat sequences, our framework processes log entries in a manner that respects their inherent hierarchical organization. This approach ensures comprehensive encoding of both fine-grained details and broader contextual relationships. Our contributions are threefold: First, HLogformer is the first framework to design a dynamic hierarchical transformer tailored for dictionary-like log data. Second, it dramatically reduces memory costs associated with processing extensive log sequences. Third, comprehensive experiments demonstrate that HLogformer more effectively encodes hierarchical contextual information, proving to be highly effective for downstream tasks such as synthetic anomaly detection and product recommendation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向日志数据的分层 Transformer 框架 HLogformer，按日志条目固有的层级与字典式结构建模而非展平成线性序列，从而大幅降低处理长日志序列的显存开销并提升层级上下文编码。作者称其为首个面向字典式日志的动态分层 Transformer，实验显示其在合成异常检测与商品推荐等下游任务上更有效。
Motivation: 日志数据呈层级、字典式结构，传统方法依赖人工模板解析、泛化差，标准 Transformer 把日志当线性序列处理，忽略嵌套关系，导致表示欠佳且显存消耗过大。
Method: HLogformer 作为动态分层 Transformer 框架，按日志条目固有的层级组织逐层处理，同时编码细粒度细节与更广的上下文关系，替代手工模板解析与展平序列建模。
Result: 在合成异常检测 (synthetic anomaly detection) 与商品推荐 (product recommendation) 两类下游任务上，实验表明 HLogformer 更有效地编码层级上下文信息，并显著降低处理长日志序列的显存成本。
Conclusion: 让 Transformer 沿日志的层级结构而非线性序列建模，可以同时改善表示质量与显存效率，并迁移到异常检测与推荐等下游任务。

papers.title: A Unifying Perspective on Descent Directions for Constrained Minimization and Switching Criteria
papers.abstract_en: Descent directions are fundamental to first-order methods for constrained convex optimization. In this work, we provide a unified perspective of these directions as they arise within the projected and conditional gradient methods. We show that the directional derivative of the Euclidean projection of the negative gradient is the steepest feasible descent direction, and induces a natural optimality measure independent of polytope-specific geometric constants. We characterize the properties of the projection of the gradient over the polytope, and show that Frank-Wolfe vertices are essentially the limit of this projection curve. Motivated by these insights, we develop hybrid algorithms that interpolate between projected gradient descent and conditional gradients, using computable switching criteria. The proposed methods achieve linear convergence without relying on the pyramidal width or similar constants. We further show that the number of breakpoints in the projection curve over the simplex and the hypercube is linear in the dimension.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把投影梯度与条件梯度的下降方向统一起来：证明负梯度欧氏投影的方向导数就是最陡可行下降方向，并由此导出不依赖多面体几何常数的最优性度量。据此构造在投影梯度与条件梯度之间按可计算判据切换的混合算法，在不使用 pyramidal width 等常数的情况下达到线性收敛。
Motivation: 投影法与条件梯度法的下降方向分析各自依赖多面体特有的几何常数（如 pyramidal width），缺少统一的最优性度量与切换依据。
Method: 刻画梯度在多面体上投影曲线的性质，指出 Frank-Wolfe 顶点本质上是该投影曲线的极限；基于方向导数给出可计算的切换判据，构造在投影梯度下降与条件梯度之间插值的混合算法。
Result: 所提混合方法在不依赖 pyramidal width 或类似常数的条件下达到线性收敛；并证明单纯形与超立方体上投影曲线的 breakpoint 数量随维度线性增长。
Conclusion: 投影梯度的方向导数提供了统一且几何常数无关的下降视角，据此设计的切换型混合算法可免去对多面体宽度常数的依赖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Image-Based Breast Implant Detection for Mammography Dataset Curation and Near-Real-Time Deployment: Comparing Foundation Models and Task-Specific Convolutional Models
papers.abstract_en: Purpose: To evaluate the performance-feasibility tradeoffs of foundation models (FMs) and task-specific convolutional neural networks (CNNs) trained from scratch for breast implant classification in 2D mammography, with emphasis on suitability for near real-time clinical deployment. Methods: We evaluated four models: two FMs (RAD-DINO and MammoCLIP) and two CNNs trained from scratch for implant prediction (ResNet18 and our lightweight ResNetLite). Using the Emory Breast Imaging Dataset, 5,000 unilateral screening mammograms were used for training/validation and 1,000 manually reviewed unilateral images were held out for testing. For the FMs, global image embeddings from the pretrained encoder were classified using a support vector machine (SVM). The CNNs were trained end-to-end on 2D mammograms, with ResNetLite optimized via grid search over depth and width to balance accuracy and efficiency. Performance was evaluated using AUROC, sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, embedding visualization, and inference-latency. Results: All models demonstrated strong performance on held-out test data (n = 1,000). MammoCLIP achieved the highest AUROC (0.999) with the quickest training time of 493 seconds. RAD-DINO achieved the highest sensitivity (0.980; accuracy 0.989) but had the slowest inference and training times. ResNet18 and MammoCLIP achieved comparable accuracy (0.985). ResNetLite showed no statistically significant difference from ResNet18 (AUROC 0.993; accuracy 0.976) despite using only 1.4% of ResNet18's parameters, and had the fastest inference time. Conclusion: FMs and task-specific CNN models reliably detect breast implants on 2D mammography. Model selection is best guided by deployment context: MammoCLIP for GPU-equipped hospital settings requiring scalable integration, and lightweight CNNs such as ResNetLite for resource-constrained or edge deployments.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the Journal of Imaging Informatics in Medicine
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Emory 乳腺影像数据集上比较两种基础模型 (RAD-DINO、MammoCLIP) 与两种从零训练 CNN (ResNet18、ResNetLite) 做 2D 钇靶乳腺假体分类，四类模型在 1,000 张留出测试图上都达到高精度。MammoCLIP AUROC 最高 0.999 且训练仅 493 秒，RAD-DINO 敏感度最高 0.980、准确率 0.989；ResNetLite 用 ResNet18 的 1.4% 参数量取得 AUROC 0.993、准确率 0.976，与 ResNet18 无统计学显著差异且推理最快。作者建议按部署场景选型：有 GPU 的医院用 MammoCLIP，资源受限或边缘端用 ResNetLite。
Motivation: 乳腺假体识别用于钇靶数据集整理与近实时临床部署，需要在基础模型与从零训练 CNN 之间权衡精度、训练时间和推理延迟，以适配不同算力环境。
Method: 评测四个模型：两个基础模型 (RAD-DINO、MammoCLIP) 取预训练编码器的全局图像 embedding 后用 SVM 分类，两个 CNN (ResNet18、ResNetLite) 端到端训练；ResNetLite 经网格搜索优化深度与宽度以平衡精度与效率。数据为 Emory Breast Imaging Dataset 的 5,000 张单侧筛查钇靶图像做训练/验证，1,000 张人工复核单侧图像留作测试，指标含 AUROC、敏感度、特异度、准确率、embedding 可视化与推理延迟。
Result: 留出测试集 n=1,000 上：MammoCLIP AUROC 最高 0.999，训练时间最短 493 秒；RAD-DINO 敏感度最高 0.980、准确率 0.989，但推理与训练时间最慢；ResNet18 与 MammoCLIP 准确率相当，均为 0.985；ResNetLite AUROC 0.993、准确率 0.976，与 ResNet18 无统计学显著差异，参数量仅为 ResNet18 的 1.4%，推理时间最快。
Conclusion: 基础模型与任务专用 CNN 都能可靠检测 2D 钇靶上的乳腺假体，模型选择应由部署场景决定：GPU 医院场景选 MammoCLIP 以便规模化集成，资源受限或边缘部署选 ResNetLite 这类轻量 CNN。

papers.title: Least Squares for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: A time-series forecast is scored on a future value of the series. A representation loss that regresses the next latent, as in LeNEPA, is a different least-squares problem on the same bottleneck. We write both programs down. The forecast program minimizes the error of a decoded latent on the coordinate that will be reported. For a scalar target and a linear decoder, every latent rank of at least one matches ordinary least squares, and an isotropy constraint is only a rescaling: after the decoder is refit, the forecast does not move. The other program fits the whole next vector at a fixed rank, then freezes the encoder and attaches a head. On a four-dimensional series whose last three coordinates are the same autoregression, that rank-1 fit puts mass $0.9998$ on the repeated coordinate and forecasts the remaining signal at the marginal variance $2.794$. The forecast program puts mass $1$ on the signal and matches the innovation variance $0.992$. Rank $2$ gives the vector fit a second direction, and the two programs agree. Iterating the fitted one-step coefficient $0.803$ raises the open-loop error from $0.992$ at one step to $2.700$ at eight steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把时序预测写成对报告坐标解码潜变量的最小二乘问题，并与 LeNEPA 式「回归下一个潜变量」的表示损失逐项对照：标量目标加线性解码器时，任何秩≥1 的潜变量都等价于普通最小二乘，isotropy 约束在解码器重拟合后只是重缩放，预测不动。在四维序列（后三维为同一自回归）上，秩-1 的整向量拟合把 0.9998 的质量放在重复坐标、以边际方差 2.794 预测剩余信号，而预测程序把质量 1 放在信号上并匹配新息方差 0.992；秩 2 时两者一致。
Motivation: 表示学习里用「回归下一个潜变量」当损失，与真正按被报告坐标打分的预测目标并不是同一个最小二乘问题；两者在什么条件下等价、何时分岔，此前没有被写成可对照的两个程序。
Method: 在同一瓶颈上写出两个最小二乘程序：预测程序最小化解码潜变量在被报告坐标上的误差；表示程序在固定秩下拟合整个下一个向量，然后冻结编码器再接预测头。用标量目标加线性解码器的闭式条件说明秩≥1 与 isotropy 约束的作用，并在四维合成序列上做对照。
Result: 标量目标加线性解码器时，秩≥1 的每个潜变量都与普通最小二乘一致，isotropy 约束在解码器重拟合后不改变预测。四维序列（后三维为同一自回归）上，秩-1 整向量拟合把质量 0.9998 放在重复坐标、以边际方差 2.794 预测剩余信号；预测程序把质量 1 放在信号上并匹配新息方差 0.992。秩 2 时两个程序一致；拟合的一步系数 0.803 迭代后，开环误差从一步的 0.992 升到八步的 2.700。
Conclusion: 按被报告坐标求解的预测程序在低秩下优于整向量表示拟合，秩足够覆盖信号子空间时两者等价；但开环误差随迭代步数从 0.992 涨到 2.700，一步拟合的系数在多步外推下会放大误差。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: StepCAD: Mesh-to-CAD Code Generation via LLM Policy and Geometry-Guided Search
papers.abstract_en: Recovering executable CAD programs from 3D meshes is challenging due to the compositional nature of CAD construction and the interaction between discrete modeling choices and continuous parameters. Many learning-based methods predict complete programs in a single pass and rely predominantly on sketch-extrude representations, limiting operation diversity and opportunities to correct geometric errors during reconstruction. We introduce StepCAD, a generative optimization approach that combines a state-conditioned CAD policy with geometry-guided search. Given an input mesh, the policy predicts construction actions conditioned on both target and intermediate geometry, and an IoU-guided tree search refines the resulting program through local edits. We also introduce ARCADE-1.5M, a large-scale dataset of 1.5M executable CAD programs spanning diverse operations, sequences with a maximum length of 150+ counted operations, and 12.5M intermediate state-action transitions. Experiments across multiple CAD reconstruction benchmarks show that StepCAD achieves state-of-the-art geometric reconstruction accuracy with consistently high validity, yielding up to 87.2% relative IoU improvement over the strongest evaluated baseline, with particularly large gains on complex shapes. Project page: https://ghadinehme.com/stepcad.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StepCAD 把从 3D mesh 恢复可执行 CAD 程序改写成生成式优化：状态条件化的 CAD 策略按目标与中间几何预测构造动作，再用 IoU 引导的树搜索做局部编辑迭代精修。配套发布 ARCADE-1.5M（150 万可执行程序、最长 150+ 步操作序列、1250 万中间状态-动作转移），在多个 CAD 重建基准上达到 SOTA 几何精度与高有效率，相对最强基线 IoU 最高提升 87.2%，复杂形状增益最大。
Motivation: 现有学习式方法单次前向预测完整程序且以 sketch-extrude 表示为主，操作多样性受限，重建过程中也没有纠正几何误差的机会。
Method: 状态条件化 CAD 策略以目标几何和中间几何为条件预测构造动作，IoU 引导的树搜索对生成的程序做局部编辑精修；训练数据为新提出的 ARCADE-1.5M，含 1.5M 可执行 CAD 程序、最长 150+ 计数操作的序列与 12.5M 中间状态-动作转移。
Result: 在多个 CAD 重建基准上取得 SOTA 几何重建精度并保持一致的高有效率，相对最强评估基线 IoU 最高提升 87.2%，复杂形状上增益尤其大。
Conclusion: 把 CAD 重建当作策略加几何引导搜索的生成式优化，比单次预测整段程序更能处理组合式构造与离散选择、连续参数的耦合。

papers.title: WAMJET: A Harness for World Action Model Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video foundation models for robot manipulation, but their large backbones and video-action co-prediction are expensive. Although existing acceleration techniques offer many ways to reduce this cost, selecting and composing them requires substantial engineering for each model and hardware platform. To tackle this bottleneck, we present WAMJET, an agentic harness that accelerates WAM inference by equipping coding agents with reusable optimization guidance and measurement and validation tools. WAMJET follows a bottleneck-driven workflow where the agent profiles inference, modifies targeted code, validates effects, and iteratively refines the acceleration stack as bottlenecks shift, while preserving action quality. Experiments span six WAMs, three coding agents, and two GPU architectures. WAMJET achieves up to 9.95x lossless speedup over upstream implementations. Approximation and hardware-aware optimization yield additional latency reductions, with comparable success rates. The results show that WAMJET can produce effective acceleration stacks for WAM deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WAMJET 是一个面向 World Action Model (WAM) 机器人操作推理的 agentic 加速框架：给编码 agent 提供可复用的优化指引与测量/验证工具，按瓶颈驱动流程 profile 推理、改代码、验证效果并随瓶颈转移迭代重构加速栈，同时保持动作质量。在六个 WAM、三个编码 agent、两种 GPU 架构上最高实现 9.95 倍无损加速，近似与硬件感知优化再叠加延迟下降且成功率相当。
Motivation: WAM 依赖预训练视频基础模型做视频-动作联合预测，骨干大、推理贵；现有加速技术虽多，但针对每个模型和硬件平台挑选与组合它们需要大量工程投入。
Method: WAMJET 以 agentic harness 形式给编码 agent 注入可复用优化指引与测量、验证工具，采用瓶颈驱动工作流：profile 推理、修改目标代码、验证效果、随瓶颈转移迭代细化加速栈，并在过程中保持动作质量；实验横跨六个 WAM、三个编码 agent 与两种 GPU 架构。
Result: 在六个 WAM、三个编码 agent、两种 GPU 架构的实验中，WAMJET 相对上游实现最高取得 9.95 倍无损加速；近似优化与硬件感知优化进一步降低延迟，且成功率相当。
Conclusion: WAMJET 能为 WAM 部署自动产出有效的加速栈，瓶颈驱动的 agent 迭代可在保持动作质量的前提下大幅压缩推理成本。

papers.title: ProsaBuddy: Assisting Mechanized Real-Time Schedulability Analysis with LLM-based Agents
papers.abstract_en: Rigorous schedulability analysis is essential for the design of hard real-time systems, yet errors in pen-and-paper proofs threaten the safety of critical applications. The Prosa initiative addresses this by offering a foundation for building machine-checkable schedulability analysis proofs in the Rocq proof assistant. However, the substantial time and expertise required to construct such proofs remain a major barrier for wider adoption of Prosa. This work presents ProsaBuddy, an LLM?based agent system designed to lower the effort needed to develop mechanized real-time schedulability proofs. ProsaBuddy employs a ReAct loop with retrieval over the Prosa codebase, access to Rocq tools and optional human-written hints. It uses a subgoal?delegation architecture, decomposing a lemma into subgoals and dispatches them to subagents for proof. We evaluate ProsaBuddy on a mini benchmark drawn from real-time scheduling literature. Experiment results show that ProsaBuddy significantly outper?forms state-of-the-art LLM-based Rocq automated proving agent systems and a general coding agent OpenCode
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProsaBuddy 是面向 Prosa（Rocq 证明助手中可机器检验的实时可调度性分析库）的 LLM agent，用 ReAct 循环加对 Prosa 代码库的检索、Rocq 工具调用与可选人工提示，并以子目标-委派架构把引理拆成子目标分发给子 agent 证明。在取自实时调度文献的 mini benchmark 上，它显著优于面向 Rocq 的最先进 LLM 自动证明 agent 系统以及通用编码 agent OpenCode。
Motivation: 硬实时系统的可调度性分析证明手写出错会威胁关键应用安全，而用 Prosa 构造机器可检验的证明需要大量时间与专业知识，成为推广的主要障碍。
Method: 采用 ReAct 循环，检索 Prosa 代码库、调用 Rocq 工具并可选接收人工提示；子目标-委派 (subgoal-delegation) 架构先把引理分解为子目标，再分派给子 agent 分别证明。
Result: 在取自实时调度文献的 mini benchmark 上，ProsaBuddy 显著优于最先进 LLM-based Rocq 自动证明 agent 系统与通用编码 agent OpenCode。
Conclusion: 把检索、工具调用与子目标委派组合起来，可以显著降低构造 Prosa 机械化可调度性证明的人力门槛。

papers.title: Data-Free On-Policy Distillation: How Far Can We Go Without External Data?
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly applied to frontier foundation model post-training. Prior work in this area has largely focused on algorithmic advances, yet it remains unclear how much OPD depends on its training questions and, in particular, how far this dependence can be reduced. Across two representative single-teacher OPD settings, we find that training on 8 real prompts yields performance comparable to training on 17k problems, while datasets differing substantially in measured difficulty and initial distillation gap yield similar outcomes. Our analyses suggest two complementary explanations: repeated sampling could allow even a few prompts to expose substantial teacher supervision, while OPD transfers generalizable reasoning capabilities beyond dataset-specific knowledge. Building on these observations, we next propose a data-free on-policy distillation (DF-OPD) setting to investigate whether the system can supply the training questions itself, eliminating the need for external data. With 64 self-generated questions obtained without seed examples, DF-OPD yields performance comparable to full-data OPD in both single-teacher settings. This finding also holds in multi-teacher OPD: across mathematics, code, and instruction following, 1k generated questions achieve performance comparable to training on approximately 7k real post-training examples. We further explore whether OPD can operate even without explicit training questions. The experiments show that this is effective only in limited cases, where the student unexpectedly generates and answers its own questions, thereby reducing the process to an implicit form of DF-OPD. Together, these findings invite a reassessment of the role of training data in on-policy distillation. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/Ryuki661/DF-OPD}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究单教师与多教师 on-policy distillation (OPD) 对训练题的依赖程度：8 道真实 prompt 即可达到与 17k 题相当的性能，而难度与初始蒸馏差距差异很大的数据集结果相近。据此提出 data-free OPD (DF-OPD)，学生在无种子示例下自生成 64 道题，两个单教师设定中性能与全数据 OPD 相当；多教师设定下 1k 自生成题在数学、代码、指令跟随上与约 7k 真实后训练样本相当。
Motivation: OPD 广泛用于前沿基础模型后训练，但其对训练题的依赖程度、以及这种依赖能被削减到什么程度尚不清楚。
Method: 先在两个代表性单教师 OPD 设定中比较真实 prompt 数量与数据集难度/初始蒸馏差距的影响，再提出 DF-OPD：学生在无种子示例下自生成训练题（单教师 64 道），并扩展到多教师 OPD（数学、代码、指令跟随），另探索完全不显式给训练题的情形。
Result: 8 道真实 prompt 训练性能与 17k 题相当；难度与初始蒸馏差距差异显著的数据集产出相近结果。DF-OPD 用 64 道无种子自生成题在两个单教师设定中达到与全数据 OPD 相当的性能。多教师 OPD 中 1k 自生成题与约 7k 真实后训练样本相当。完全不给显式训练题仅在有限情形有效，此时学生自发生成并回答自己的问题，退化为隐式 DF-OPD。
Conclusion: OPD 的训练数据角色需要重新评估：极少或自生成的题目已足以提供教师监督，OPD 传递的是可泛化的推理能力而非数据集特定知识。

papers.title: Characterizing How Complex Agentic AI Systems Handle General Tasks: A Trace-Based Simulation Study
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI completes tasks through iterative planning, tool use, and reasoning based on observed outcomes. Despite its popularity, its system-level behavior remains poorly understood, particularly for complex datasets and agent architectures-owing to highly non-deterministic execution, prohibitive evaluation costs, and limited visibility into proprietary models. This paper presents GAIATrace, the first token-level trace dataset of two state-of-the-art agentic systems (MiroThinker and OWL) running GAIA, a benchmark composed of a heterogeneous mix of general-purpose tasks. Unlike prior trace datasets, GAIATrace captures full reasoning tokens, task-level structures, and activities of every major participating LLMs, enabling in-depth systems research. Complementing the dataset, we present Vidur-Agent, a trace-driven simulator that can replay GAIATrace to perform reproducible, low-cost system evaluation across diverse simulated environments. Using both artifacts, we characterize how modern agentic systems handle general tasks and how various system design choices shape their behavior, yielding several unique findings.
papers.comment: Published in the Proceedings of the 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Workload Characterization (IISWC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GAIATrace 是首个 token 级 agentic AI 轨迹数据集，记录 MiroThinker 与 OWL 两个系统在 GAIA 通用任务基准上的完整推理 token、任务级结构与各参与 LLM 活动；配套 Vidur-Agent 轨迹驱动模拟器可重放这些轨迹，在多种模拟环境中做可复现、低成本的系统评测，据此刻画系统设计选择如何塑造 agentic 系统行为。
Motivation: agentic AI 因执行高度非确定、评测成本高、闭源模型可见性差，其系统级行为在复杂数据集与复杂 agent 架构上长期难以刻画。
Method: 构建 token 级轨迹数据集 GAIATrace，采集 MiroThinker 与 OWL 在 GAIA 异构通用任务上的完整推理 token、任务级结构与全部主要 LLM 活动；再提出轨迹驱动模拟器 Vidur-Agent，重放该数据集以在多种模拟环境中做可复现的低成本系统评测。
Result: 产出首个面向两个 SOTA agentic 系统（MiroThinker、OWL）在 GAIA 上的 token 级轨迹数据集 GAIATrace，以及可重放该数据集的模拟器 Vidur-Agent，并用两者刻画现代 agentic 系统处理通用任务的方式与系统设计选择对其行为的影响，得到若干独有发现。
Conclusion: 完整 token 级轨迹加上可重放的轨迹驱动模拟器，是把 agentic AI 的系统级行为变成可复现、低成本研究对象的可行路径。

papers.title: What Do Verifiable Rewards Teach Video-Language Models About Time? A Controlled Multi-Model Study
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has produced large reasoning gains in language models, and verifiable video benchmarks make it applicable to causal-temporal video question answering. We study what RLVR teaches video-language models about time. We fine-tune four open models (Qwen3-VL-8B/4B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Gemma-3-12B) with group relative policy optimization under three data recipes: verified (synthetic CLEVRER questions with exact answer and event-order rewards), unverified (self-supervised pretext tasks over 43,751 real web videos), and a 1:1 mixture, plus a verified+real arm that adds 4,000 verifiable questions on real video. Each cell is evaluated in-domain and on out-of-domain real video (a NExT-QA temporal stress set and an MVBench subset), with frames in order, shuffled, and absent. (1) Verified training yields large in-domain gains that shrink as base competence grows (+14 to +19 points on weaker models; +6 on the strongest). (2) Much of the gain is non-visual: accuracy with no frames rises nearly as much as with frames. (3) Verified-only training can severely degrade out-of-domain accuracy with no sign during training: Qwen3-VL-8B loses 26.7 and 25.2 points on the two real-video sets, while the mixture never significantly degrades a model trained on it. Adding real verified questions removes that loss (-2.3 points, within noise of base) and keeps a +9.3 in-domain gain, so the cause is narrow synthetic-only data, not verification. (4) No recipe induces temporal-order grounding: across 41 evaluations the ordered-versus-shuffled gap is indistinguishable from zero in 39 and marginal in two, despite an event-order reward. Verifiable rewards improve benchmark accuracy without temporal understanding. Report no-frame controls, and mix in real video to guard against out-of-domain degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 RLVR 微调四个视频-语言模型研究可验证奖励到底教会了什么时间能力：域内准确率提升（弱模型 +14 到 +19 点、最强模型 +6），但无帧输入的涨幅几乎同样大，且 41 次评测中 39 次有序与打乱帧的差距与零无异。纯 verified 合成数据会严重损害域外真实视频（Qwen3-VL-8B 掉 26.7 与 25.2 点），加入 4,000 道真实可验证题后损失降到 -2.3 点且保留 +9.3 域内增益；作者建议报告 no-frame 对照并混入真实视频。
Motivation: 可验证奖励 (RLVR) 在语言模型上带来推理增益，但迁移到因果-时序视频问答时，尚不清楚它教给模型的是时间理解还是别的捷径，以及合成 verified 数据会不会在训练中无预警地损害域外表现。
Method: 用 GRPO 微调四个开源模型（Qwen3-VL-8B/4B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Gemma-3-12B），三种数据配方：verified（合成 CLEVRER 问题，带精确答案与事件顺序奖励）、unverified（43,751 个真实网络视频上的自监督前置任务）、1:1 混合，外加 verified+real（追加 4,000 道真实视频可验证题）。每个单元在域内与域外真实视频（NExT-QA 时序压力集与 MVBench 子集）上评测，输入帧分有序、打乱、缺失三种条件。

papers.title: OceanMind: A multi-agent AI system for ocean diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Time-dependent, three-dimensional (3D) oceanic multi-variables define coherent states of the evolving ocean to facilitate ocean diagnosis and advance ocean science to better inform environmental and hazard management. However, extracting quantitative evidence from these variables requires substantial and complex analytical effort. We introduce OceanMind, a multi-agent AI system that directly couples large language models (LLMs) with comprehensive time-dependent 3D ocean states for swift and effective diagnosis. OceanMind organizes the analytical process into four coordinated complexity stages: Query Routing, Skill-based Planning, Tool Execution, and Evidence-based Summary Generation. Specialized agents interpret user requests, construct and execute multi-step computational workflows, and synthesize quantitative evidence. To ensure reliable workflow construction, 63 reusable ocean-specific analysis skills serve as procedural manuals that guide the LLM agent in selecting data, conducting diagnostics, and applying analytical tools. With reflection and replanning mechanisms that use execution feedback to repair invalid plans, OceanMind ensures reliable analysis workflows across diverse needs. On a benchmark of 240 computational-workflow queries spanning the four stages, OceanMind outperformed general ReAct agents with the same registered tool pool, achieving relative improvements of 41.2% in effectiveness and 21.5% in efficiency. Beyond the benchmark, OceanMind reproduced published oceanic diagnostics, validated hypotheses, and supported environmental decision-making over global oceans. Overall, OceanMind advances LLMs by integrating them with time-dependent 3D ocean analysis, enabling scientific interpretation and enhancing formulation of environmental policies based on quantitative ocean evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OceanMind 把 LLM 多智能体直接接到时变三维海洋状态上，按 Query Routing、Skill-based Planning、Tool Execution、Evidence-based Summary Generation 四阶段组织分析，用 63 个可复用海洋分析技能作为程序化手册约束工作流构造，并以执行反馈做 reflection 与 replanning 修复无效计划。在覆盖四阶段的 240 条计算工作流查询基准上，相对通用 ReAct 智能体（同一注册工具池）有效性提升 41.2%、效率提升 21.5%。
Motivation: 时变三维海洋多变量蕴含连贯的海洋状态，但从中提取定量证据需要大量复杂分析工作，人工难以快速完成，制约海洋诊断与环境、灾害管理决策。
Method: 四阶段协调流程：Query Routing 解析请求，Skill-based Planning 依据 63 个海洋专用可复用分析技能（选数据、做诊断、用分析工具的程序化手册）构造多步计算工作流，Tool Execution 由专门化智能体执行，Evidence-based Summary Generation 合成定量证据；再用基于执行反馈的 reflection 与 replanning 修复无效计划。
Result: 在 240 条覆盖四阶段的计算工作流查询基准上，OceanMind 相对使用同一注册工具池的通用 ReAct 智能体，有效性 (effectiveness) 相对提升 41.2%、效率 (efficiency) 相对提升 21.5%；基准之外还复现了已发表的海洋诊断、验证了假设，并支撑全球海洋的环境决策。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 与带技能手册和反馈修复的多智能体工作流耦合到时变三维海洋分析上，可让海洋定量证据的提取变得快速可靠，并支撑基于证据的环境政策制定。

papers.title: Composing Learned Robot Behaviors with Temporal Logic at Runtime
papers.abstract_en: Executing Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) instructions with learned robot policies faces two practical challenges: demonstrations may cover individual behaviors without containing the temporal compositions requested at deployment, and semantic success predicates often provide little useful motor guidance through quantitative robustness. We address these challenges by separating behavior learning from temporal composition. From the same offline demonstrations, we train an unconditioned multimodal diffusion policy and a semantic predictor that estimates which semantic outcomes are likely to follow a proposed action sequence. These predictions provide a learned guidance signal without requiring hand-designed robustness measures for semantic task objectives. At deployment, an LTL automaton tracks instruction progress and scores the policy's proposed actions according to their predicted semantic outcomes. Neither learned component receives the specification during training, allowing demonstrated behaviors to be reused in longer, previously unseen temporal compositions without retraining. For additional runtime safety constraints with informative continuous margins, an optional robustness-based controller locally refines the selected actions. Experiments in a navigation environment, CALVIN manipulation, and on a real robot demonstrate reliable execution of complex temporal instructions and additional safety constraints, with substantial improvements over temporal-logic baselines.
papers.comment: Videos available on our project page: https://moritz-zoellner.com/learned-ltl/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把行为学习与时序组合解耦：同一份离线演示同时训练一个无条件多模态 diffusion policy 和一个语义结果预测器，部署时由 LTL 自动机按预测的语义结果给策略候选动作打分，使已学行为无需重训即可组合成更长的未见时序指令。在导航环境、CALVIN 操作和真实机器人上执行复杂时序指令与附加安全约束，相对时序逻辑基线有显著提升。
Motivation: 演示数据通常只覆盖单个行为、不含部署时要求的时序组合，而语义成功谓词经定量 robustness 提供的电机指导很少，导致 LTL 指令难以用学习到的策略执行。
Method: 从同一份离线演示训练无条件多模态 diffusion policy 与语义预测器（估计某动作序列后可能出现的语义结果），两者训练时都不接触规格；部署时 LTL 自动机跟踪指令进度并按预测语义结果给候选动作打分，可选的 robustness 控制器对选中动作做局部精修以满足带连续裕度的安全约束。
Result: 在导航环境、CALVIN 操作和真实机器人上的实验演示了复杂时序指令与附加安全约束的可靠执行，并相对时序逻辑基线有显著改进（substantial improvements）。
Conclusion: 把语义预测作为学习到的引导信号、把时序组合留到部署时由 LTL 自动机完成，可在不重训的前提下复用已演示行为执行更长的未见时序指令，并叠加运行时安全约束。

papers.title: EvoState: Closed-Loop Visual State Management for Long-Form Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-shot long-form video generation remains challenging due to identity drift and compounding inconsistencies across shots. Existing methods encode past shots as compressed context, implicit features, or retrieved frames, making it hard to tell whether new visual evidence is another view of an existing appearance, an evolved state of the same identity, or a newly introduced entity. We propose EvoState, an agentic framework that formulates multi-shot generation as entity-centric evolving visual state management, following a state-observation-update-propagation cycle. An entity-centric Visual State Memory separates persistent identity anchors from their evolved states and observations, so each shot retrieves the required state, accumulates complementary views, and reactivates earlier appearances without conflating them. A Visual State Analyzer reconciles the text-visual-memory triplet by observing generated visual evidence, updating generation conditions according to realized outcomes and memory states, and propagating inferred state transitions into memory and future prompts. As a result, generation is conditioned on an evolving state history grounded in what has been realized, rather than solely on planned textual descriptions. Experiments on our curated StoryBench benchmark demonstrate substantial improvements in identity preservation, state-transition correctness, and narrative coherence over state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoState 把多镜头长视频生成建模为实体中心的视觉状态管理，按 state-observation-update-propagation 循环运行：Visual State Memory 把持久身份锚点与演化状态、观测分开存，Visual State Analyzer 用已生成的画面回看并改写生成条件与后续 prompt。在自建 StoryBench 上，身份保持、状态转移正确性与叙事连贯性相对现有方法均有明显提升。
Motivation: 多镜头长视频生成中身份漂移与跨镜头不一致累积，现有方法把历史镜头压成压缩上下文、隐式特征或检索帧，难以判断新画面究竟是同一外观的另一视角、同一实体的演化状态，还是新引入的实体。
Method: Agentic 框架按 state-observation-update-propagation 循环组织生成：实体中心的 Visual State Memory 分离持久身份锚点与演化状态/观测，每镜头检索所需状态、累积互补视角并重激活早期外观；Visual State Analyzer 观察生成的视觉证据，调和文本-视觉-记忆三元组，按实际结果与记忆状态更新生成条件，并把推断的状态转移写回记忆与未来 prompt。
Result: 在自建 StoryBench 基准上，身份保持 (identity preservation)、状态转移正确性 (state-transition correctness) 与叙事连贯性 (narrative coherence) 相对 state-of-the-art 方法均有实质性提升。
Conclusion: 长视频生成应以已实现的演化状态历史为条件，而不只依赖计划好的文本描述；把身份锚点与演化状态分开管理可缓解跨镜头身份漂移。

papers.title: Energy Variation in Training Modern Computer Vision Architectures
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of deep learning has substantially increased the energy consumption associated with model training, making energy efficiency an increasingly relevant design criterion. This study empirically measures the energy variation of training seven modern computer vision architectures, MobileNetV3-Small, MobileNetV3-Large, EfficientNet-B0, EfficientNet-B1, ViT-B/32, ConvNeXt-Tiny, and ViT-B/16 for the ImageNet-1k classification task, using a homogeneous 10,000-image subset (ImageNet-10k) and a uniform 40-epoch baseline configuration executed on two NVIDIA Tesla P100 GPUs at the Bioinformatics and Computational Biology Center of Colombia (BIOS). Energy was recorded directly via NVML and contrasted with the computational complexity of each model. The results show a Pearson correlation of 0.85 between floating-point operations (GFLOPs) and energy consumption in kWh, indicating that computational complexity is a strong but imperfect predictor of energy expenditure: architectures with comparable GFLOPs exhibited consumption differing by up to 3.1x due to differences in the hardware efficiency of their dominant operations. The EfficientNet variants offered the best balance between classification performance (Val Top-5 up to 97.15%) and energy efficiency (0.457-0.611 kWh), while Vision Transformers exhibited the highest relative energy consumption and lower classification performance under the evaluated configuration. These findings guide architecture selection in energy-constrained computing environments.
papers.comment: International Conference on Next-Generation AI Technologies (ICNGAIT) Shanghai, China, 5 pages, 1 table
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在两块 Tesla P100 上以统一 40 epoch 配置实测七个 CV 架构在 ImageNet-1k（ImageNet-10k 子集）上的训练能耗，GFLOPs 与 kWh 的 Pearson 相关仅 0.85，且 GFLOPs 相当的架构能耗差异可达 3.1 倍，说明算力复杂度只是强但不完备的能耗预测量。能耗受限环境下应优先选 EfficientNet 系列（0.457–0.611 kWh，Val Top-5 最高 97.15%），ViT 在该配置下能耗最高且分类性能更低。
Motivation: 深度学习训练能耗快速增长，能耗已成为架构设计与选型的实际约束，但 GFLOPs 这一常用复杂度指标能否代表真实耗电尚不清楚。
Method: 在 BIOS 的两块 NVIDIA Tesla P100 上，对 MobileNetV3-Small/Large、EfficientNet-B0/B1、ViT-B/32、ConvNeXt-Tiny、ViT-B/16 七个架构用统一 40-epoch 配置在 ImageNet-10k（10,000 张同质子集）上训练 ImageNet-1k 分类，通过 NVML 直接记录能耗，并与各模型 GFLOPs 对比。
Result: GFLOPs 与能耗 (kWh) 的 Pearson 相关为 0.85；GFLOPs 相当的架构能耗差异最高达 3.1 倍，源于主导算子的硬件效率差异；EfficientNet 变体能耗 0.457–0.611 kWh，Val Top-5 最高 97.15%；Vision Transformer 在该配置下相对能耗最高且分类性能更低。
Conclusion: GFLOPs 是能耗的强但不完备预测量，能耗受限环境选架构时应把实测能耗与硬件算子效率一并纳入，EfficientNet 系列在该配置下给出性能与能耗的最佳平衡。

papers.title: LoRA Direction Extraction for Controllable Light Toggling in FLUX.1 Kontext
papers.abstract_en: We propose a fine-tuning method for flow-matching diffusion models aimed at realistic artificial light modeling without the need for a large training dataset. We address the task of controllable interior image editing, where the goal is to turn artificial light sources on or off while preserving the scene geometry, object placement, materials, and visual identity of the original image. To achieve this, we decompose the task into two independent formulations. We introduce the LoRA Direction Training Method, which extracts the pure direction of the LoRA adapter effect in the diffusion model flow field, and we also introduce specialized loss functions to ensure the realism of the inverse transformation. Additionally, the resulting increment map is used for more precise adjustment of the lighting color and temperature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LoRA Direction Training Method：从 flow-matching 扩散模型的流场中提取 LoRA adapter 效应的纯方向，并配专用损失保证反向变换的真实感，从而在不依赖大规模训练数据的前提下开关室内人工光源，同时保持场景几何、物体摆放、材质与视觉身份不变；提取出的 increment map 还可用于更精细地调节光色与色温。
Motivation: 室内图像编辑中开关人工光源需要在改动照明的同时不破坏原图的几何、材质与视觉身份，而常规微调依赖大规模训练数据集。
Method: 对 flow-matching 扩散模型做微调，把任务拆成两个独立表述；核心是 LoRA Direction Training Method，从扩散流场中分离出 LoRA adapter 效果的纯方向，并设计专用损失函数约束逆变换的真实感，再用得到的 increment map 调节光色与色温。
Result: 摘要给出的是所提出的构件：LoRA Direction Training Method、配套的逆变换真实感专用损失，以及用于光照颜色与温度微调的 increment map，无需大规模训练数据集。
Conclusion: 把 LoRA 的作用方向从流场中单独提取出来，可以在小数据条件下实现可控且保真的室内灯光开关编辑。

papers.title: Bayes-Sufficient Compression Is Not Enough: How Does Communication Help Multi-Agent Systems?
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems pair a sender with broad context and an executor with a limited local view. We study when a short message improves the executor's next decision, when raw context is preferable, and when a stronger sender helps. Our framework, \emph{receiver-relative bounded coordination}, expresses message utility as receiver gain minus protocol tax. Compression beats raw context when tax savings exceed losses from omitted information and decoder mismatch. Even \emph{Bayes-sufficient} compression can fail when a bounded executor cannot use its surface form. A three-stage decomposition separates externalization, absorption, and \emph{action closure}, explaining how errors remain after the correct content reaches the receiver. Under a single-crossing condition, sender upgrades help above a receiver-burden threshold. Across six benchmarks, the same Qwen protocol raises ContextBench joint accuracy from $0.633$ to $0.775$ but lowers ToolSandbox from $0.889$ to $0.653$. Fixed-message replay reveals closure failures despite correct artifact recovery. These results guide an inference-time selector that improves the accuracy-cost frontier on the evaluated communication regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 sender-拥有完整上下文、executor 视野受限的多智能体 LLM 系统中，提出 receiver-relative bounded coordination 框架，把消息效用写成 receiver gain 减 protocol tax：只有当省下的传输开销超过信息遗漏与解码错配的损失时，压缩才胜过直接给原始上下文。同一 Qwen 协议在六个基准上使 ContextBench 联合准确率从 0.633 升到 0.775，却把 ToolSandbox 从 0.889 压到 0.653，说明 Bayes-sufficient 压缩仍可能因 bounded executor 无法利用其表面形式而失败。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 里 sender 有广上下文、executor 只有局部视野，何时该发短消息、何时该直接给原始上下文、何时升级 sender 缺少可判定的准则；即便信息论上充分的压缩也可能因接收方能力受限而失效。
Method: 提出 receiver-relative bounded coordination，把消息效用分解为 receiver gain 减 protocol tax，并给出 externalization、absorption、action closure 三阶段分解来定位内容正确但决策仍错的环节；在 single-crossing 条件下刻画 sender 升级何时有效（超过 receiver-burden 阈值），并用固定消息重放 (fixed-message replay) 诊断 closure 失败，最终导出一个推理时选择器。
Result: 在六个基准上，同一 Qwen 协议把 ContextBench 联合准确率从 0.633 提到 0.775，却把 ToolSandbox 从 0.889 降到 0.653；fixed-message replay 显示即使 artifact 被正确恢复仍存在 closure 失败；推理时选择器在所评估的通信 regime 上改善了 accuracy-cost 前沿。
Conclusion: 通信是否有益取决于接收方能否闭合到行动，而非内容在信息论上是否充分：压缩与原始上下文的取舍由 tax 节省对信息损失的比较决定，sender 升级只在超过 receiver-burden 阈值后才有帮助。
