papers.title: Do Motion Tokenizers for Co-Speech Gesture Generation Encode Gesture Semantics?
papers.abstract_en: Discrete motion tokenizers encode motion as atomic units and are widely used for co-speech gesture generation. It remains unclear which motion properties, especially those relevant to gesture semantics, are recoverable from these codebooks. We probe a reconstruction-trained codebook using 19 co-speech gesture descriptors spanning from raw motion to abstract communicative function. Results show that geometry and handedness are readily decodable from token embeddings, while motion category is only weakly decoded despite showing systematic differences in discrete code usage. This gap between reconstruction quality and descriptor decodability suggests that reconstruction objectives alone do not guarantee that gesture semantics are captured, and that evaluating codebooks on such properties can guide the design of more semantic motion tokenizers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对共言语手势生成用的离散 motion tokenizer 做探针分析，用 19 个从原始运动到抽象交际功能的手势描述子检验重建训练的 codebook 能解码哪些性质：几何与左右手性 (handedness) 可从 token embedding 直接解码，运动类别 (motion category) 尽管在离散码使用上存在系统性差异却只有弱解码。重建质量高不等于手势语义被编码，作者据此主张用这类描述子评测来指导更语义化的 motion tokenizer 设计。
Motivation: 离散 motion tokenizer 广泛用于 co-speech gesture generation，但 codebook 究竟能恢复哪些运动性质、尤其是与手势语义相关的性质，一直不清楚。
Method: 对一个用重建目标训练的 codebook 做 probing：以 token embedding 预测 19 个 co-speech gesture 描述子，覆盖从原始运动到抽象交际功能的不同层级，并对照描述子解码度与离散码使用模式。
Result: 几何 (geometry) 与 handedness 可从 token embedding 轻松解码；motion category 只有弱解码，尽管其离散码使用呈现系统性差异；重建质量与描述子解码度之间存在落差。
Conclusion: 仅靠重建目标不能保证手势语义被捕获，用描述子属性评测 codebook 可以指导设计更具语义的 motion tokenizer。

papers.title: An analysis of Mirror-Descent Soft Actor-Critic
papers.abstract_en: Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) is widely used for entropy-regularised reinforcement learning with continuous action spaces, and practical implementations perform only a few actor steps towards an evolving target. In this work, we prove convergence guarantees when the target policy arises from policy mirror descent and compare it with the classical Gibbs target. We derive sufficient conditions for the strong convexity and smoothness of the actor objective, characterised by the curvature of the $Q$-function estimate through the Legendre differential operator, and establish an $\mathcal{O}\!\left(N^{-\frac{1}{5}}\right)$ best-iterate finite-time convergence rate up to actor and critic approximation errors. Moreover, the mirror-descent step size $λ$ directly controls the target drift and hence actor tracking error, whereas the analogous Gibbs bound contains a non-vanishing tracking term.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Soft Actor-Critic 的 mirror-descent 目标策略给出收敛保证：以 Q 函数曲率经 Legendre 微分算子刻画 actor 目标的强凸与光滑条件，证明最优迭代有限时间收敛率为 O(N^{-1/5})（含 actor/critic 近似误差），且 mirror-descent 步长 λ 直接控制目标漂移与跟踪误差，而 Gibbs 目标的对应界含不消失的跟踪项。
Motivation: 实际 SAC 只对不断演化的目标做少数几步 actor 更新，但 mirror-descent 目标与经典 Gibbs 目标各自的收敛条件与跟踪误差来源此前缺少理论刻画。
Method: 证明目标策略来自 policy mirror descent 时的收敛保证并与 Gibbs 目标对比；用 Legendre 微分算子刻画 Q 函数估计的曲率，导出 actor 目标强凸与光滑的充分条件，并分析步长 λ 对目标漂移的控制。
Result: 得到最优迭代有限时间收敛率 O(N^{-1/5})，误差界包含 actor 与 critic 近似误差；mirror-descent 的界中跟踪误差由 λ 直接控制，Gibbs 目标的对应界含一项不消失的跟踪项。
Conclusion: mirror-descent 目标使 SAC 的跟踪误差随步长可控，而 Gibbs 目标存在固有的非消失跟踪项，因此前者在理论上给出更干净的收敛刻画。

papers.title: BridgeCast: Bridging Ocean Wave Forecasts to Reanalysis via Flow Matching with Exogenous Variables
papers.abstract_en: Ocean wave forecasting is essential for maritime safety, offshore operations, and coastal resilience, yet remains challenging due to systematic biases in physics-based models. Physical models, while widely used, rely on approximations and parameterizations that limit their accuracy under complex ocean-atmosphere conditions. To enhance ocean wave forecasting, we propose BridgeCast, within a physics-AI hybrid framework for bias correction. BridgeCast is a probabilistic model based on conditional flow matching (CFM) that learns to transform physical model forecasts into reanalysis-like fields. It treats physical forecasts as corrupted observations and employs a continuous-time generative process to bridge their distribution toward that of reanalysis data. BridgeCast is parameterized by a Transformer-based architecture that enables spatiotemporal modeling, incorporation of exogenous atmospheric variables, and flexible inference via both ordinary and stochastic differential equation formulations. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that BridgeCast consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across regions and forecast lead times.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BridgeCast 把物理模式的海浪预报当作被污染的观测，用条件流匹配 (conditional flow matching) 驱动的连续时间生成过程把其分布桥接到再分析场分布，实现偏差订正。Transformer 主干同时吃进外生大气变量，支持 ODE 与 SDE 两种推断形式；在真实数据集上跨区域、跨预报时效一致优于最先进基线。
Motivation: 物理海浪模式依赖近似与参数化，在复杂海气条件下产生系统性偏差，限制其在海上安全、离岸作业与海岸韧性场景中的可用精度。
Method: 物理-AI 混合偏差订正框架 BridgeCast：以条件流匹配 (CFM) 训练概率模型，将物理模式预报视为被污染的观测，用连续时间生成过程把其分布桥接到再分析数据分布；网络为 Transformer 架构，支持时空建模与外生大气变量输入，并可用 ODE 或 SDE 两种微分方程形式做灵活推断。
Result: 在真实世界数据集上，BridgeCast 跨不同区域和不同预报时效 (lead times) 一致优于 state-of-the-art 基线；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把物理预报当作条件下的待订正观测、用流匹配桥接到再分析分布，是海浪预报系统性偏差的一条可行订正路径，且在所测区域与时效上稳定优于现有方法。

papers.title: Global Evaluation of AI and NWP Precipitation Forecasts During Atmospheric River Events
papers.abstract_en: Atmospheric rivers (ARs) produce many of the world's most extreme precipitation events and hydrometeorological hazards. Although artificial intelligence weather prediction (AIWP) models have demonstrated skill comparable to or exceeding numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems for large-scale atmospheric variables, their ability to forecast AR-related precipitation remains insufficiently characterized globally. Here, we evaluate 24-hour precipitation forecasts from the Global Forecast System (GFS), Global Ensemble Forecast System (GEFS), GraphCast, and Artificial Intelligence Forecasting System (AIFS) from Day 1 through Day 10 globally and across North America, Europe, and Australia and New Zealand. Using the Extreme Weather Bench framework, forecasts are evaluated against Integrated Multi-satellitE Retrievals for GPM (IMERG) observations using measures of precipitation magnitude, spatial structure, and localization. GraphCast and AIFS exhibit greater spatial skill than GFS and GEFS, particularly for heavy precipitation and at longer lead times, and better preserve the spatial organization of AR-related precipitation through Day 10. However, this improved spatial skill does not translate into accurate precipitation magnitudes. AIWP models tend to overpredict moderate-to-heavy accumulations while underpredicting the heaviest precipitation at longer lead times, whereas NWP systems develop pronounced dry biases. These results reveal distinct strengths and limitations of AIWP for high-impact precipitation forecasting and provide a reproducible benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Extreme Weather Bench 框架在全球、北美、欧洲、澳新范围内对比 GFS、GEFS、GraphCast、AIFS 的 24 小时降水预报（Day 1–Day 10，以 IMERG 观测为真值）。GraphCast 与 AIFS 的空间技巧优于 GFS 和 GEFS，尤其在强降水和长提前期，并能保持到 Day 10 的大气河相关降水空间组织；但量级不准：AIWP 模式倾向高估中到大量累积、在长提前期低估最重降水，而 NWP 系统出现明显干偏差。
Motivation: AIWP 模式在大尺度变量上已达到或超过 NWP，但其对大气河 (AR) 相关极端降水的全球预报能力此前缺乏系统刻画，而 AR 正是全球极端降水与水文气象灾害的主要来源。
Method: 评估 GFS、GEFS、GraphCast、AIFS 四套系统从 Day 1 到 Day 10 的 24 小时降水预报，覆盖全球及北美、欧洲、澳新三个区域；采用 Extreme Weather Bench 框架，以 IMERG 卫星降水融合观测为真值，从降水量级、空间结构、局地化三个维度打分。
Result: GraphCast 和 AIFS 的空间技巧高于 GFS 和 GEFS，尤其在强降水和较长提前期，并能较好保持 AR 相关降水的空间组织直至 Day 10；但空间技巧未转化为量级准确：AIWP 模式倾向高估中到大量累积、在长提前期低估最重降水，NWP 系统则发展出明显干偏差。
Conclusion: AIWP 与 NWP 在高影响降水预报上各有明确强项与短板：AIWP 赢在空间结构、输在量级，NWP 存在系统性干偏差；该评测作为可复现的基准发布。
Relevance: 78

papers.title: Generalizable Neural Downscaling of Earth System Model Wind Fields via Continuous Dynamics Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Accurate high-resolution wind field simulations are critical for resolving fine-scale atmospheric dynamics, yet the simulation of wind fields in Earth System Models (ESMs) remains limited by coarse spatial resolution and systematic biases. To address this, data-driven down scaling techniques have been widely used to enhance coarse-resolution ESM outputs. However, existing methods are typically tied to fixed discretizations, limiting generalization across models with different native resolutions. Here we formulate global near-surface wind downscaling as an operator-learning problem on continuous atmospheric state fields and develop a downscaling neural operator that maps coarse-scale fields to fine-scale counterparts across heterogeneous discretizations. The operator learning-based neural downscaling framework outperforms dominant baselines, recovers fine-scale physical structures, and generalizes to previously unseen ESMs and future climate scenarios without retraining, while preserving long-term wind projection trends. These findings establish a generalizable paradigm for high-resolution climate downscaling across diverse simulation outputs and future scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把全球近地表风降尺度写成连续大气状态场上的算子学习问题，训练一个能在异构离散网格间把粗分辨率场映射到细分辨率场的降尺度神经算子 (downscaling neural operator)。该框架在对比基线上更优、能恢复细尺度物理结构，并可在未见过的 ESM 与未来气候情景上免重训泛化，同时保持长期风投影趋势。
Motivation: 地球系统模式 (ESM) 近地表风受粗空间分辨率与系统性偏差限制，而现有数据驱动降尺度方法绑定固定离散网格，难以跨不同原生分辨率的模式泛化。
Method: 将全球近地表风降尺度表述为连续大气状态场上的算子学习问题，构建一个跨异构离散化把粗尺度场映射到细尺度场的降尺度神经算子，训练与检验覆盖多种 ESM 输出和未来气候情景。
Result: 算子学习式降尺度框架优于主导基线，恢复细尺度物理结构，并在未见过的 ESM 与未来气候情景上无需重训即可泛化，同时保持长期风投影趋势。
Conclusion: 连续动力学建模使高分辨率气候降尺度成为可跨不同模拟输出与未来情景复用的通用范式，摆脱对固定离散化的依赖。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: Fractal Cross Product: Theory, Differentiable Implementation and Application to Medical Image Analysis
papers.abstract_en: The magnitude of the generalized Euclidean cross product is a Gram volume whose degree under common scaling is fixed by the integer dimension of the spanning frame. We formulate a generalized Fractal Cross Product (FCP) as a nonlinear radial deformation with a prescribed positive degree $D$, which may be non-integer. The scalar construction applies in any ambient dimension $m\geq k$, while its canonically oriented vector form requires codimension one. It recovers the classical generalized cross product exactly at $D=k$ and retains orthogonality, alternation, rotation equivariance, and $D$-homogeneity, but is generally not multilinear. For exact self-similar frame systems, the construction also obeys a scale-balance law at the similarity dimension. We derive a differentiable, dimensionless image response and a non-circular empirical accumulation exponent obtained by regressing raw angular Gram responses across patch widths. Binary64 calculations recover the finite-frame identities to roundoff, while raster experiments recover the Sierpiński-triangle value 1.5849625 at three resolutions. In five-seed medical-imaging comparisons, FCP-centered fusion increased mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve from 0.7264 to 0.8135 and from 0.5843 to 0.6765 on the random and hospital-separated Retinal Image Database for Optic Nerve Evaluation partitions, respectively, and from 0.7403 to 0.7475 on FracAtlas. On FracAtlas, balanced accuracy increased from 0.6186 to 0.6721 and the harmonic mean of precision and sensitivity from 0.3669 to 0.4457. These results support the utility of the complete fusion framework, but do not isolate the effect of FCP from that of its complementary descriptors and fusion head.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出广义分形叉积 (Fractal Cross Product, FCP)：把广义欧氏叉积的 Gram 体积改写为带指定正次数 D（可为非整数）的非线性径向形变，在 D=k 时精确退化为经典广义叉积，并保留正交性、交替性、旋转等变与 D-次齐次性。在医学影像融合中，FCP 中心融合把 RIDEON 随机划分 AUROC 从 0.7264 提到 0.8135、医院划分从 0.5843 提到 0.6765，FracAtlas 从 0.7403 提到 0.7475。
Motivation: 经典广义叉积的次数被张成框架的整数维数锁死，无法表达非整数自相似结构的标度行为；同时医学影像多描述子融合缺少一个可微、无量纲的几何响应项。
Method: 把叉积幅度视为 Gram 体积，构造带指定次数 D 的非线性径向形变（标量形式适用于任意 m≥k，向量形式要求余维一），推导可微无量纲图像响应与跨 patch 宽度回归原始角度 Gram 响应得到的经验累积指数；再以 FCP 为中心做多描述子融合并接融合头。
Result: Binary64 计算将有限框架恒等数恢复到舍入误差量级；栅格实验在三个分辨率上复现 Sierpiński 三角形值 1.5849625。五种子医学影像对比中，FCP 中心融合使 RIDEON 随机划分 AUROC 0.7264→0.8135、医院划分 0.5843→0.6765，FracAtlas AUROC 0.7403→0.7475、balanced accuracy 0.6186→0.6721、precision 与 sensitivity 的调和平均 0.3669→0.4457。
Conclusion: FCP 把叉积次数推广到非整数并保持经典代数性质，整套融合框架在 Retinal Image Database for Optic Nerve Evaluation 与 FracAtlas 上提升分类与 AUROC；作者明确指出这些结果不能把 FCP 的贡献与其互补描述子和融合头分离。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LoRA Adaptation Strength in Aurora-WRF: Trade-offs in Regional Heavy-Rainfall Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: We investigate how parameter-efficient adaptation of an atmospheric foundation model affects downstream regional precipitation in a controlled Aurora-WRF coupling experiment over the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region. A single-step, precipitation-weighted LoRA adaptation of AuroraPretrained is trained on May-September 2020-2021 and selected using 2022 validation data. Five inference-time adaptation strengths are coupled to an unchanged 9-km WRF configuration and compared with a GFS-driven control under common ERA5 initialization and auxiliary-field rules. Evaluation uses 17 initializations in 2023, hourly ERA5 precipitation, and conservative remapping to a fixed 356-cell, 0.25-degree verification grid. Heavy rainfall is defined exclusively as at least 50 mm in a continuous 24-hour window, advanced hourly. For window starts from 0 to 48 hours, unadapted Aurora attains the highest mean critical success index (CSI), 0.216, compared with 0.144 for the GFS control. An intermediate LoRA strength of 0.75 reduces the Aurora-driven 24-hour precipitation mean squared error by 30.7% and brings pooled frequency Bias from 1.510 to 1.024, but lowers CSI to 0.182. GFS retains the lowest whole-domain error. These results characterize a trade-off between rainfall detection, frequency calibration, and intensity error, showing the importance of evaluating adaptation strength against multiple downstream criteria within a common coupling framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Aurora-WRF 耦合框架下，对 AuroraPretrained 做单步、降水加权的 LoRA 适配后，适配强度并不单调改善强降水预报：未适配的 Aurora 在 0–48 小时窗口起报上 CSI 最高（0.216，GFS 控制 0.144），而中等强度 0.75 把 24 小时降水 MSE 降低 30.7%、频率偏差从 1.510 拉回 1.024，却把 CSI 降到 0.182。结论是适配强度须在检测、频率校准与强度误差三个下游指标上同时权衡，而非单指标调优。
Motivation: 大气基础模型经参数高效适配后对下游区域强降水的影响缺乏受控刻画：适配强度如何在降水检测技巧、频率校准与强度误差之间取舍，此前没有在同一耦合框架下与业务驱动基线对照。
Method: 在京津冀地区做受控 Aurora-WRF 耦合实验：对 AuroraPretrained 做单步、降水加权的 LoRA 适配，用 2020–2021 年 5–9 月训练、2022 年验证选型；五个推理期适配强度接入不变的 9-km WRF 配置，与 GFS 驱动的控制试验在相同 ERA5 初始化和辅助场规则下对比。评估用 2023 年 17 次初始化，逐小时 ERA5 降水经保守重映射到固定的 356 格点、0.25 度检验网格；强降水定义为连续 24 小时窗口内至少 50 mm，窗口按小时前移。
Result: 窗口起报 0–48 小时：未适配 Aurora 平均 CSI 0.216，GFS 控制 0.144；LoRA 强度 0.75 使 Aurora 驱动的 24 小时降水 MSE 降低 30.7%，合并频率偏差 (frequency bias) 从 1.510 降到 1.024，但 CSI 降至 0.182。GFS 在全区域误差上仍最低。
Conclusion: 适配强度带来降雨检测、频率校准与强度误差三者之间的明确权衡，应在统一耦合框架下用多个下游指标共同选定适配强度；GFS 驱动在全区域强度误差上仍占优。
Relevance: 78

papers.title: Black-Scholes for the land: modelling savannah response to rain as a dynamic world model
papers.abstract_en: Carbon credits, offsets and index insurance rest on counterfactuals: what the land would have done under the same weather without management, or what a bad season cost. Current baselines fail in two ways: some ignore rain, others condition on rain linearly and annually. But the true response lags the rain, depends on hidden state such as moisture from other sources, and responds differently from pixel to pixel. Focussing on grassland pasture as a proof of concept, we fit a temporal world model of MODIS greenness conditioned on CHIRPS rain over two 45 km^2 sites in Laikipia, Kenya: a transition density map for greenness given recent and current rainfall. We use it, conceptually, as Black-Scholes is used. Inverting the model on observed greenness it yields an implied residual, everything the land did that the rain does not explain. Two capabilities drop out of this solution: 1) attribution, what the land did beyond the rain; 2) sensitivities, derivatives of the rollout with respect to rain and state, close analogues of the Greeks. On Laikipia test sites, our learned model recovers three-month greenness with 23% less error than a history-only baseline and 13% less than the best hand-written model on unseen years. In the 2022 drought, the land ended 0.17 NDVI below normal; the rain that failed explains roughly half of that, and under normal rain with the same residual it would still have ended 0.10 below. Delta, the derivative of greenness with respect to rain, is computed at every pixel and averages 0.075 NDVI per extra 100 mm of rain. A Delta at every pixel is an exposure to rain that can be hedged, allowing efficient pricing of contracts and accurate attribution.

TL;DR: 把 MODIS 绿度对 CHIRPS 降水的响应建成转移密度形式的时序 world model，类比 Black-Scholes 反解出降水无法解释的隐含残差，并逐像元给出绿度对降水的导数 Delta。在肯尼亚 Laikipia 两个 45 km² 样点的未见年份上，三个月绿度误差比仅用历史的基线低 23%、比最好的手写模型低 13%；2022 年干旱中绿度比常年低 0.17 NDVI，其中约一半由降水亏缺解释，若降水正常而残差不变仍会低 0.10 NDVI，平均 Delta 为每增 100 mm 降水 0.075 NDVI。
Motivation: 碳信用、抵消与指数保险都依赖反事实基线：同一天气下无管理时土地会怎样。现有基线要么忽略降水，要么对降水做线性年尺度条件化，而真实响应有滞后、依赖其他来源的水分等隐状态且逐像元不同。
Method: 以草地牧场为概念验证，用 CHIRPS 降水条件化 MODIS 绿度，拟合一个时序 world model：给定近期与当前降水的绿度转移密度图 (transition density map)。再类比 Black-Scholes 在观测绿度上反解模型得到隐含残差，并从 rollout 对降水与状态的导数得到归因与灵敏度（类比 Greeks）。
Result: 在 Laikipia 测试样点的未见年份上，三个月绿度预报误差比仅用历史的基线低 23%，比最好的手写模型低 13%。2022 年干旱结束时绿度比常年低 0.17 NDVI，降水亏缺解释约一半；若降水正常而残差不变仍低 0.10 NDVI。逐像元 Delta 平均为每增加 100 mm 降水 0.075 NDVI。
Conclusion: 降水条件化的动态 world model 能把土地响应拆成可归因的残差与可对冲的逐像元降水敞口，从而支持合约定价与归因；作者据此把该模型用作 Black-Scholes 在土地上的类比。
Relevance: 41

papers.title: MLS and CALIPSO Evidence for a Warm-Pool Transition in Tropical Convective Moistening and Cloud Ice
papers.abstract_en: Upper-tropospheric water vapor and cloud ice associated with tropical deep convection are central to water-vapor and high-cloud feedbacks. We investigate a warm-pool transition in tropical convective moistening using 20 years of Aura Microwave Limb Sounder (MLS) Version 5 H2O and cloud-ice observations (August 2004-December 2024), together with Cloud-Aerosol Lidar with Orthogonal Polarization (CALIOP) aboard the Cloud-Aerosol Lidar and Infrared Pathfinder Satellite Observations (CALIPSO) mission (June 2006-June 2023). The combined day-plus-night CALIPSO product (CALIPSO-A) provides an independent ice-cloud constraint; the H2O column shown on the CALIPSO grid is derived from Modern-Era Retrospective Analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2 (MERRA-2), not from CALIOP. We combine objective sea surface temperature (SST) breakpoint fitting, cross-sensor ice water path (IWP) comparisons, Clouds and the Earth's Radiant Energy System (CERES) longwave, shortwave, and net cloud radiative effect (CRE), and Integrated Multi-satellitE Retrievals for GPM (IMERG) precipitation diagnostics from the Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) mission. MLS and CALIPSO-A show cloud-ice maxima over deep-convective warm-pool regions and identify warm-regime SST breakpoints near 299-300 K. Normalized MLS and CALIPSO-A IWP vary coherently in the western Pacific and tropical mean. CERES indicates that stronger longwave CRE in the warm regime is partly offset by stronger shortwave cooling, while GPM IMERG confirms that MLS IWP increases with convective rain rate. These results show that convective moistening and cloud-ice production across the tropical warm-pool transition are persistent cross-sensor features of the tropical atmosphere.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 20 年 Aura MLS H2O/云冰与 CALIPSO CALIOP 观测，配合 SST 断点拟合，发现热带暖池区云冰极大值出现在约 299–300 K 的暖态 SST 断点附近；MLS 与 CALIPSO-A 归一化 IWP 在西太平洋和热带平均上同相变化，且 MLS IWP 随对流雨率上升。CERES 显示暖态更强的长波 CRE 被更强的短波冷却部分抵消，说明跨暖池过渡的对流增湿与云冰生成是跨传感器一致的持久特征。
Motivation: 上对流层水汽与云冰决定水汽和高云反馈，但暖池过渡处对流增湿与云冰生成是否为跨传感器一致的稳健特征尚不清楚。
Method: 用 2004-08 至 2024-12 的 MLS Version 5 H2O 与云冰观测，加上 2006-06 至 2023-06 的 CALIPSO 昼夜合并产品 CALIPSO-A（其 H2O 列由 MERRA-2 提供）；结合客观 SST 断点拟合、跨传感器 IWP 对比、CERES 长/短/净云辐射效应 (CRE)，以及 GPM IMERG 降水诊断。
Result: MLS 与 CALIPSO-A 在深对流暖池区给出云冰极大值，识别出约 299–300 K 的暖态 SST 断点；归一化 IWP 在西太平洋与热带平均上同相变化。CERES 表明暖态更强的长波 CRE 被更强的短波冷却部分抵消，GPM IMERG 确认 MLS IWP 随对流雨率增大而上升。
Conclusion: 跨热带暖池过渡的对流增湿与云冰生成是热带大气中持久的跨传感器特征，其辐射效应由长波增暖与短波冷却部分抵消。

papers.title: Logit-Aware MIMO AirComp for Distributed Mixture-of-Experts LLM Inference over Wireless Edge Networks
papers.abstract_en: Distributed mixture-of-experts (MoE) inference is a promising architecture for deploying large language models (LLMs) at wireless edge networks because sparse experts can be placed across coordinated base stations (BSs), while the anchor node and user equipment (UE) can offload LLM inference tasks to BSs. The communication bottleneck is the MoE aggregation, where the anchor BS must recover a weighted sum of selected expert outputs before each decoding step. Over-the-air computation (AirComp) is well matched to this operation because the wireless multiple-access channel naturally superposes simultaneous transmissions. However, conventional AirComp minimizes communication distortion, whereas MoE aggregation errors have unequal impact on LLM outputs. We propose a logit-aware MIMO AirComp framework that estimates local logit sensitivity as block-level weights and jointly optimizes receive combiners and BS precoders under per-BS power constraints. We also develop an alternating algorithm that protects decoding decisions from aggregation perturbations. Using OpenCompass, we evaluate Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-FP8 on GSM8K and ARC-Challenge. At 30 dB aggregation SNR, perturbed Qwen3 retains 99.3% of clean GSM8K accuracy and 94.8% of clean ARC-Challenge accuracy. In a direct ARC-Challenge closed-loop audit over 295 examples, SW-AirComp achieves 43.73% accuracy at 30 dB and 26.78% at 20 dB, outperforming unweighted, matched-filter, and zero-forcing AirComp. In the wireless simulator, SW-AirComp reduces decision-relevant aggregation distortion; at 20 dB, its final weighted-sum mean-squared error is 53.5% lower than unweighted AirComp under the same channels, samples, and sensitivity weights. Logit-RMSE and logit-gap diagnostics further show that the gain comes from reducing output-logit perturbation and lowering the risk of top-token changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向无线边缘网络上的分布式 MoE LLM 推理，提出 logit-aware MIMO AirComp：以局部 logit 敏感度作为块级权重，联合优化接收合并器与基站预编码器，并用交替算法保护解码决策。30 dB 聚合 SNR 下扰动后的 Qwen3 保留 GSM8K 干净准确率的 99.3%、ARC-Challenge 的 94.8%；20 dB 时最终加权和 MSE 比无权 AirComp 低 53.5%。
Motivation: 分布式 MoE 推理中专家输出的加权和聚合是通信瓶颈，而常规 AirComp 只最小化通信失真，忽略了 MoE 聚合误差对 LLM 输出的不等影响。
Method: 估计局部 logit 敏感度作为块级权重，在每基站功率约束下联合优化接收合并器与 BS 预编码器，并开发交替算法保护解码决策；用 OpenCompass 在 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-FP8 上评测 GSM8K 与 ARC-Challenge。
Result: 30 dB 聚合 SNR 下扰动 Qwen3 保留 99.3% 的 GSM8K 干净准确率与 94.8% 的 ARC-Challenge 干净准确率；295 例 ARC-Challenge 闭环审计中 SW-AirComp 在 30 dB 达 43.73%、20 dB 达 26.78%，优于无权、matched-filter 与 zero-forcing AirComp；同信道同样本同敏感度权重下，20 dB 时最终加权和 MSE 比无权 AirComp 低 53.5%，Logit-RMSE 与 logit-gap 诊断显示增益来自降低输出 logit 扰动。
Conclusion: 按 logit 敏感度加权的 AirComp 能把聚合失真转化为对解码决策的影响来抑制，从而在低 SNR 下保住 MoE LLM 推理准确率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Deep Learning Denoising of Real SWOT Sea Surface Height Observations
papers.abstract_en: The SWOT (Surface Water Ocean Topography) mission is currently providing unpreceded high-resolution measurements of Sea Surface Height (SSH), revealing ocean features at finer scales. Nevertheless, the two-dimensional observations of KaRIn altimeter of SWOT suffer from instrumental errors. This noise degradation is altering the high frequencies of SWOT signal, and the small to sub-mesoscale dynamics of interest for some oceanographers. For this reason, Tréboutte et al. (2023) have developed a convolutional neural network (CNN) based on U-Net architecture to separate the noise from the physical signals contained in the SSH. Their approach has demonstrated great potential on simulated SWOT measurements, and Dibarboure et al. (2024) report a positive influence on actual flight data from SWOT. However, degraded denoising performance, and occasional negative side-effects have been observed in atypical conditions (e.g. very high surface waves, internal tides solitons). In this study, we illustrate some of these limitations and we present an improved approach of the CNN-based denoising: we modified the training procedure to obtain a more robust version of the algorithm, to avoid biases and artifacts in the denoised SSH. This paper also presents a more complete validation process with a robust and standardized evaluation benchmark: these metrics could be of interest to assess other SWOT filtering and denoising algorithms.
papers.comment: This Work has been submitted to JTECH (Journal of Atmospheric and Oceanic Technology). Copyright in this Work may be transferred without further notice
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 SWOT KaRIn 高度计二维 SSH 观测中的仪器噪声，改进 Tréboutte et al. (2023) 的 U-Net 去噪流程：修改训练过程以提升鲁棒性，抑制非典型条件（高海面波浪、内潮孤立子）下出现的偏差与伪影，并给出一套标准化评估基准。该基准可用来横向比较其他 SWOT 滤波与去噪算法。
Motivation: SWOT 的 KaRIn 观测噪声污染信号高频，掩盖小尺度到亚中尺度动力学；已有 U-Net 去噪在模拟数据上有效、在实测飞行数据上有正面影响，但在高海面波浪、内潮孤立子等非典型条件下性能下降并产生负面副作用。
Method: 在 Tréboutte et al. (2023) 的 U-Net 卷积神经网络去噪框架上修改训练过程，目标是得到更鲁棒的算法、避免去噪 SSH 中的偏差与伪影；同时构建一套更完整、鲁棒且标准化的评估基准与指标，用于检验去噪结果。
Result: 论文展示已有 CNN 去噪在非典型条件（如极高海面波浪、内潮孤立子）下的局限与负面副作用，并报告改进训练过程得到的更鲁棒版本及其标准化评估基准；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: SWOT 去噪需要在训练阶段就针对非典型条件做鲁棒化处理以避免偏差与伪影，且评估应依赖统一基准而非单一模拟数据表现；该基准被主张可推广用于其他 SWOT 滤波/去噪算法的检验。
Relevance: 41

papers.title: Beyond Private Training: The New Landscape of AI Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented systems increasingly rely on vector indexes that may retain deleted items in their search graph. Existing deletion interfaces can prevent deleted identifiers from appearing in returned results while still computing distances to their embeddings during graph traversal. We formalize this distinction as output safety versus traversal safety, and introduce TSD-AUDIT, a framework for auditing and enforcing traversal-safe deletion in graph-based approximate nearest-neighbor retrieval. On Faiss IndexHNSWFlat, native filtering leaves the number of distance computations unchanged relative to unfiltered search; at a 70% deletion rate, trace-faithful replay detects deleted-vector scoring in all 100 audited queries. Code inspection of hnswlib's mark_deleted path reveals the same scoring-before-liveness pattern. TSD-AUDIT enforces an alive-before-scoring invariant, repairs connectivity using only live candidates, and emits per-query scored-trace certificates that an independent verifier can check against the deletion snapshot. Under region-targeted deletion, TSD-AUDIT improves Recall@10 over native filtering by 4.3--42.2 percentage points across deletion fractions from 0.5 to 0.9, while remaining comparable under random deletion. These results show that output-only deletion audits can miss process-level exposure: auditing deletion in vector retrieval requires accounting for the vectors scored during search, not only the identifiers returned.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 向量索引的删除接口只保证被删条目不出现在返回结果里，图遍历仍会计算其嵌入距离，即输出安全不等于遍历安全。TSD-AUDIT 用 alive-before-scoring 不变式、仅用存活候选修复连通性，并输出可独立验证的逐查询打分轨迹证书；在 Faiss IndexHNSWFlat 上 70% 删除率时原生过滤的距离计算次数与未过滤搜索相同，trace-faithful replay 在全部 100 条审计查询中都检出对已删向量的打分。
Motivation: RAG 系统依赖的向量索引可能在搜索图中保留已删除项，现有删除接口只约束返回标识符，审计若只看输出就会漏掉遍历阶段对已删嵌入的实际访问。
Method: TSD-AUDIT 形式化区分 output safety 与 traversal safety，强制 alive-before-scoring 不变式，仅用存活候选修复图连通性，并为每条查询发出可由独立验证器对照删除快照核验的 scored-trace 证书；在 Faiss IndexHNSWFlat 上做 trace-faithful replay，并检查 hnswlib 的 mark_deleted 路径。

papers.title: Efficient Analog-Initialized Latent Transport for Spatially Coherent Probabilistic Downscaling from Global to Kilometer Scales
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic downscaling must represent kilometer-scale structure left unresolved by a deterministic regional prediction. We introduce an analog-initialized latent transport method that uses historical regional residuals as a meteorologically informed empirical source. A frozen graph neural network predicts the deterministic state from the Integrated Forecasting System (IFS). For each input, residuals from 20 training dates with similar IFS conditions initialize the ensemble. A conditional flow-matching model transports these fields in a carefully designed 65-factor, 100,000-node latent space, and a grid decoder reconstructs 81 atmospheric channels including precipitation at 2.5km spacing. On a season- and cycle-balanced 2025 test, ensemble CRPS improves over deterministic mean absolute error for all 81 variables. Matched analogs improve point and spatial errors over Gaussian initialization and reduce spectral error compared with covariance matching. Comparisons with released CorrDiff, a local CorrDiff-mini model and full grid EDM provide context on the 2023 validation sample. Total training of the downscaling model takes approximately 12h on one NVIDIA H200, and inference takes about 12s per 81-field member. The frozen networks also generate fields over France when supplied with local static data and a high-resolution IFS-derived analog bank. The method combines empirical initialization with whole-domain latent transport for computationally practical regional ensembles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出模拟初始化的隐空间传输降尺度方法：用历史区域残差作经验源，冻结 GNN 从 IFS 预报确定态，条件 flow matching 在 65 因子、100,000 节点隐空间中整域传输，网格解码器重建含 2.5km 降水的 81 通道。2025 年季节与循环平衡测试上，81 个变量的集合 CRPS 全部优于确定性 MAE；匹配模拟初始化在点与空间误差上优于高斯初始化，谱误差低于协方差匹配。
Motivation: 确定性区域预报无法表示公里级结构，概率降尺度需要既保留气象一致性又在计算上可行的集合生成方式。
Method: 冻结图神经网络从 IFS 预报确定态；按 IFS 条件从 20 个训练日期取相似残差初始化集合；条件 flow-matching 模型在 65 因子、100,000 节点隐空间传输这些场，网格解码器重建 81 个大气通道（含 2.5km 降水）；与 CorrDiff、CorrDiff-mini、全网格 EDM 对照。
Result: 2025 年季节与循环平衡测试上，81 个变量的集合 CRPS 全部优于确定性 MAE；匹配模拟初始化相对高斯初始化改善点误差与空间误差，相对协方差匹配降低谱误差；2023 验证样本上与已发布 CorrDiff、本地 CorrDiff-mini 及全网格 EDM 对比；降尺度模型总训练约 12 小时（单卡 NVIDIA H200），推理约 12 秒/81 场成员；配合本地静态数据与高分辨率 IFS 模拟库可在法国上空生成场。
Conclusion: 经验初始化加整域隐空间传输能以实用算力生成区域概率集合，且匹配模拟优于高斯与协方差初始化方案。

papers.title: Structured Neural Modeling of Daily Arctic Sea-Ice Concentration Evolution: Physical-Trajectory-Driven Learning and Forecast-Domain Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate modeling of the daily evolution of sea ice concentration (SIC) is central to improving the credibility and operational forecasting capability of deep learning-based sea ice prediction. However, existing deep learning methods often couple the underlying sea ice evolution relationships and data errors within high-dimensional nonlinear mappings, making it difficult to construct a stable and verifiable evolution core and apply it reliably to practical forecasting. To address this issue, this study proposes a reanalysis-forecast dual-domain decoupled framework for learning sea ice evolution operators. The framework builds upon a lightweight physical baseline to generate daily evolution trajectories, employs a temporally constrained joint multi-lead compensation network to com?pensate for unresolved processes, and introduces an ice-mass?aware transport mechanism to suppress numerical dissipation. In the forecasting stage, the parameters of the base evolution core are fixed, while a lightweight variable-semantic adaptation mechanism calibrates inter-domain distributions and evolution responses, thereby separating forecast-domain errors from base evolution errors. Experiments show that the constructed base evolution core can accurately and stably simulate daily sea ice evolution at both short-term and annual scales under reanal?ysis forcing, and can be effectively transferred to the forecast domain through lightweight adaptation, achieving stable prac?tical forecasting capability while preserving the base evolution structure. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/zhangmaqun65535/SNM upon acceptance of this manuscript.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出再分析-预报双域解耦的海冰密集度 (SIC) 日演变学习框架：以轻量物理基线生成日演变轨迹，用时间约束的联合多提前期补偿网络补未解析过程，再以冰量感知输运机制抑制数值耗散；预报阶段冻结演化核参数，只用轻量变量语义适配校准域间分布，把预报域误差与基线演化误差分开。在再分析强迫下该演化核能稳定模拟短期与年际尺度日演变，并经轻量适配迁移到预报域保持结构不变。
Motivation: 现有深度学习海冰预报把海冰演变规律与数据误差一起塞进高维非线性映射，无法构造稳定、可验证的演化核，也难以可靠用于实际预报。
Method: 双域解耦框架：轻量物理基线生成日演变轨迹，时间约束的联合多提前期补偿网络 (temporally constrained joint multi-lead compensation network) 补偿未解析过程，冰量感知输运机制 (ice-mass-aware transport) 抑制数值耗散；预报阶段固定基础演化核参数，用轻量变量语义适配机制校准跨域分布与演变响应。
Result: 实验显示所构建的基础演化核在再分析强迫下能准确稳定地模拟短期与年际尺度的日海冰演变，并可通过轻量适配有效迁移到预报域，在保持基础演化结构的同时获得稳定的实际预报能力。
Conclusion: 把物理基线、演变补偿与域适配解耦，可以在不改动演化核的前提下把再分析域学到的 SIC 演变规律转到预报域，源码将于录用后公开。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: On the Tightness and Computational Tractability of Higher-Dimensional Confidence Sequences
papers.abstract_en: Modern sequential monitoring problems often involve multiple metrics, where we monitor several data streams simultaneously and may act once the evidence is strong enough. Confidence sequences (CSs) are a natural tool for such continuous monitoring. However, for bounded vector means, existing multivariate CSs are either tight but computationally intractable, or fast to compute but conservative. To address this, we study three lifts of one-dimensional betting-based CSs to higher dimensions: a weighted Bonferroni region, an equivalent max-wealth form, and a portfolio region. The portfolio is typically much tighter, especially in higher dimensions, but its boundary and properties such as volume are not available in closed form. To make this tighter construction usable, we propose tractable outer approximations of the portfolio region that preserve statistical validity: a bounding box, an $\ell_p$-ellipsoid, and their intersection. We prove set relations among all constructions and show empirically that these approximations (i) achieve regions close to the intractable portfolio, (ii) substantially outperform existing tractable multivariate CSs, and (iii) enable practical use cases such as multi-metric A/B testing and model comparison.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对有界向量均值的多元置信序列 (confidence sequences) 要么紧但不可计算、要么可算但保守，论文把一维基于 betting 的 CS 用三种方式提升到高维：加权 Bonferroni 区域、等价的 max-wealth 形式和 portfolio 区域。portfolio 通常紧得多（尤其高维），但边界与体积无闭式解；为此提出保持统计有效性的可计算外逼近——bounding box、ℓp-ellipsoid 及其交集，并证明各构造间的集合关系。
Motivation: 多指标序贯监控需要同时盯多条数据流、证据足够时才行动，但现有多元 CS 在紧致性与可计算性之间二选一：紧的算不动，算得动的过于保守。
Method: 研究一维 betting-based CS 到高维的三种提升：加权 Bonferroni 区域、等价 max-wealth 形式、portfolio 区域；对无闭式解的 portfolio 区域给出保持统计有效性的外逼近（bounding box、ℓp-ellipsoid 及二者交集），并证明所有构造之间的集合关系。
Result: 经验上这些外逼近 (i) 得到的区域接近不可计算的 portfolio，(ii) 显著优于已有的可计算多元 CS，(iii) 支撑多指标 A/B testing 与模型比较等实际用例；portfolio 区域在高维下紧致性优势更明显。
Conclusion: portfolio 区域是更紧的高维多元 CS 构造，而 bounding box、ℓp-ellipsoid 及其交集这类外逼近能在保留统计有效性的前提下把它变成可计算工具。

papers.title: Beyond the Good, the Bad, and the Ugly: Colormap Assessment through Data-Aware Perceptual Metric
papers.abstract_en: Continuous colormaps are widely used to visualize scalar fields, and their quality is typically evaluated using measures such as discriminative power and uniformity. Existing measures primarily characterize the intrinsic perceptual properties of the colormap itself, largely independent of the underlying data distribution. In practice, however, user perception arises not from the colormap alone but from the visualization generated by mapping data values through the colormap. The perceptual differences that users actually experience depend jointly on the colormap and the underlying data. We propose a data-aware formulation that complements existing data-independent colormap assessment approaches. Rather than analyzing the colormap in isolation, we model the color-encoded visualization as a composite mapping from the spatial domain of the data to perceptual color space. This approach yields data-aware counterparts of established measures, including discriminative power, uniformity, and smoothness, as well as additional measures such as perceptual anisotropy and degeneracy. We validate the proposed measures against both the existing data-independent framework and empirical results from perceptual studies, extend the formulation to 2D colormaps, and demonstrate its integration into colormap optimization. An interactive system is provided for exploring colormap assessment under varying data distributions. Results demonstrate that our formulation offers a principled foundation for data-aware colormap assessment and design.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 9 figures, IEEE VIS 2026 conference full paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出数据感知的连续色标 (colormap) 评估框架：把色标编码的可视化建模为从数据空间域到感知颜色空间的复合映射，从而得到判别力、均匀性、平滑性以及新增的感知各向异性 (perceptual anisotropy) 与退化度 (degeneracy) 的数据感知版本。该框架同时对齐既有数据无关指标与感知实验结果，并可扩展到 2D 色标、接入色标优化与交互式探索系统。
Motivation: 现有色标质量指标只刻画色标自身的感知属性，与底层数据分布无关；但用户实际感知来自数据值经色标映射后的图像，感知差异由色标与数据共同决定。
Method: 将色标编码可视化建模为数据空间域到感知颜色空间的复合映射，据此推导既有判别力、均匀性、平滑性指标的数据感知对应物，并新增感知各向异性与退化度两个度量；再把该形式化扩展到 2D 色标，并接入色标优化流程，配套提供可变数据分布下的交互式评估系统。
Result: 所提度量同时对照既有数据无关框架与感知研究 (perceptual studies) 的经验结果进行验证，并在色标优化集成中演示；摘要以定性方式报告结果，称该形式化为数据感知的色标评估与设计提供了有原则的基础。
Conclusion: 色标评估必须把底层数据分布纳入度量，仅孤立分析色标不足以刻画用户真实感知；该形式化可作为色标评估与设计的基础。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: AI Agent Pull Requests on GitHub: Frequency, Structure, and Merge Conflict Rates
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents may generate and submit Pull Requests (PRs) to the same repository at the same time. However, research concerning the extent of concurrent submission by AI coding agents to a common repository does not exist. This paper uses the AIDev-pop dataset (33,596 PRs in 2,807 repositories) to provide the first empirical examination of the prevalence of concurrent submission using PRs authored by agents. We report that when considering exact temporal overlap, 40.2% of repositories contain co-active agent-authored PR pairs; further, the co-active pairs account for 79.4% of all PRs generated by an AI agent. When we examine co-activity within a one week collaboration window, the percentages are increased to 53.4% and 95.0%, respectively. For the majority of the co-active PR pairs (underlying the vast majority of which are intra-agent authored), both PRs were authored by the same agent, while only 0.5% of co-active pairs were cross-agent, and occurred in only 122 out of 2807 total repositories examined (or approximately 4.3%). Additionally, we replayed actual three way git merges on 747 unique co-active pairs (one per repository), and computed the percentage of textual conflict encountered during the merge operation to combine the two PRs in each pair. We observed that the percentage of textual conflict encountered was significantly higher for cross-agent pairs compared to intra-agent pairs: 41.7% vs. 19.8%, respectively, with non-overlapping 95% confidence intervals. Lastly, we developed a classification system based on the detection of conflict reported by git, and determined that the majority of conflicts resulted from modifications to source code files (84.4% of conflicted files) and not dependency manifest files; further, nearly 42% of conflicts we observed were structural (i.e., modify/delete or add/add).
papers.comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21186464
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 AIDev-pop 数据集（33,596 个 PR、2,807 个仓库）首次实证检验 AI 编码 agent 并发提交 PR 的普遍性：按精确时间重叠，40.2% 的仓库存在 co-active 的 agent PR 对，这些对占 agent 生成 PR 的 79.4%；放宽到一周协作窗口后升至 53.4% 与 95.0%。对 747 对做真实三方 git merge 重放，跨 agent 对的文本冲突率 41.7%，显著高于同 agent 的 19.8%（95% CI 不重叠），且 84.4% 的冲突文件是源码而非依赖清单，近 42% 的冲突属结构性（modify/delete 或 add/add）。
Motivation: AI 编码 agent 可能同时向同一仓库提交 PR，但此前没有研究刻画这种并发提交的普遍程度及其对合并冲突的实际代价。
Method: 基于 AIDev-pop 数据集（33,596 PR、2,807 仓库）识别 agent 撰写的 PR，按精确时间重叠与一周协作窗口两种口径统计 co-active PR 对，并区分 intra-agent 与 cross-agent；对每仓库一对共 747 对重放真实三方 git merge，计算文本冲突比例，再用基于 git 冲突报告的分类体系归类冲突文件类型。
Result: 精确时间重叠下 40.2% 的仓库含 co-active agent PR 对，co-active 对占 agent 生成 PR 的 79.4%；一周窗口下分别为 53.4% 与 95.0%。cross-agent 对仅占 0.5%，出现在 122/2807 个仓库（约 4.3%）。747 对三方 merge 重放中，cross-agent 冲突率 41.7% vs intra-agent 19.8%，95% 置信区间不重叠。冲突文件中 84.4% 为源码文件而非依赖清单，近 42% 的冲突为结构性（modify/delete 或 add/add）。
Conclusion: AI agent 的并发 PR 提交是常态而非例外，且冲突主要来自同 agent 自身的并发修改；跨 agent 提交虽罕见，但一旦发生文本冲突率约为同 agent 的两倍，冲突集中在源码的结构性改动上。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Using Process Mining to Generate AI Agents from Software Engineering Process Records
papers.abstract_en: Integrating AI agents into Software Engineering (SE) raises an important challenge: how can we specify and realize AI agents that work effectively alongside humans in hybrid SE teams? Determining the right granularity and separation of concerns for such agents is non-trivial. Coarse-grained agents may introduce unmanageable complexity, whereas micro-agents may create severe coordination overhead. Moreover, existing multi-agent SE frameworks typically rely on predefined role structures and do not account for project-specific characteristics or process adaptations. We address this by combining object-centric, imperative, and declarative process mining. Using event logs extracted from software repositories, our approach discovers project-specific agent roles using a predefined SE role vocabulary grounded in repository behavior and generates matching agent specifications and implementations. As proof-of-concept, we applied our approach to a well-established open-source project. We performed functional tests and an exploratory user study to determine how well the generated AI agent specifications are aligned with human expectations.
papers.comment: To be published at the 24th International Conference on Business Process Management (BPM 2026), Process Technology Forum
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把软件工程过程记录（事件日志）转成可执行 AI agent：用对象中心、命令式与声明式三种过程挖掘组合，从仓库事件日志中发现项目特定的 agent 角色，再生成对应的 agent 规格与实现。在一个成熟开源项目上做概念验证，功能测试加探索性用户研究表明生成的规格与人类期望对齐。
Motivation: 混合人机组件的 SE 团队里，agent 粒度难定：粗粒度 agent 复杂度失控，micro-agent 协调开销过大；现有多 agent SE 框架依赖预定义角色结构，不考虑项目特定特征与过程适配。
Method: 组合对象中心、命令式与声明式过程挖掘，输入是从软件仓库抽取的事件日志；用预定义的 SE 角色词表（grounded in repository behavior）发现项目特定 agent 角色，并生成匹配的 agent 规格与实现。
Result: 在一个成熟的开源项目上完成概念验证，执行功能测试并开展探索性用户研究，检验生成的 AI agent 规格与人类期望的对齐程度。
Conclusion: 从仓库事件日志中挖掘出的角色可以驱动 agent 规格与实现的自动生成，从而绕开预定义角色结构对项目特定过程的限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Revealing graph bandits for maximizing local influence
papers.abstract_en: We study a graph bandit setting where the objective of the learner is to detect the most influential node of a graph by requesting as little information from the graph as possible. One of the relevant applications for this setting is marketing in social networks, where the marketer aims at finding and taking advantage of the most influential customers. The existing approaches for bandit problems on graphs require either partial or complete knowledge of the graph. In this paper, we do not assume any knowledge of the graph, but we consider a setting where it can be gradually discovered in a sequential and active way. At each round, the learner chooses a node of the graph and the only information it receives is a stochastic set of the nodes that the chosen node is currently influencing. To address this setting, we propose BARE, a bandit strategy for which we prove a regret guarantee that scales with the detectable dimension, a problem dependent quantity that is often much smaller than the number of nodes.
papers.comment: Published at AISTATS 2016 (19th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在完全不知道图结构、只能通过逐轮选节点观测其随机影响集合的 graph bandit 中，提出 BARE 策略来找出图中最具影响力的节点，其 regret 保证随 detectable dimension（一个通常远小于节点数的问题相关量）增长，而非随节点总数增长。
Motivation: 已有图上 bandit 方法要么要求部分图结构、要么要求完整图结构；实际场景（如社交网络中寻找最有影响力的客户）里图只能在序贯主动查询中逐步被发现。
Method: 设定为零图先验的序贯主动探索：每轮选一个节点，仅观测该节点当前随机影响的节点集合；据此提出 bandit 策略 BARE，并证明其 regret 保证以 detectable dimension 为尺度。
Result: 给出 BARE 的 regret 保证，其尺度为 detectable dimension——一个通常远小于节点数的问题相关量；应用设定为社交网络中定位最具影响力的节点（营销场景）。
Conclusion: 在无图先验、只能序贯查询影响集合的条件下，图 bandit 的 regret 可以由远小于节点数的 detectable dimension 决定，而不必随节点总数增长。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Trading off rewards and errors in multi-armed bandits
papers.abstract_en: In multi-armed bandits, the most-explored arms are the most informative, while reward maximization typically pulls only the best arm. We study the tradeoff between identifying arm means accurately and accumulating reward, and present an algorithm with regret guarantees that interpolates between the two objectives. We provide both upper and lower bounds and validate empirically.
papers.comment: Published at AISTATS 2017 (20th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多臂老虎机中信息量最大的臂通常不是奖励最高的臂，本文给出一个在“准确估计各臂均值”与“累积奖励”两个目标之间连续插值的算法，并附带 regret 上下界。算法在两个目标之间可调，作者用实验验证了该权衡行为。
Motivation: 探索最有信息量的臂与最大化奖励相互冲突：最常被拉的臂最有信息，而纯奖励最大化只拉最好的臂，需要一个能在两目标间插值并有理论保证的算法。
Method: 提出一个在臂均值估计精度与奖励累积之间插值的多臂老虎机算法，提供 regret 的上界与下界（upper and lower bounds），并做实证验证。
Result: 给出 regret 上界与下界，并在实验中验证算法表现；摘要未列出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 识别精度与奖励累积的权衡可以用一个带 regret 上下界的可调算法来统一处理，两个目标不必二选一。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Learning from a single labeled face and a stream of unlabeled data
papers.abstract_en: Face recognition from a single image per person is a challenging problem because the training sample is extremely small. We consider a variation of this problem. In our problem, we recognize only one person, and there are no labeled data for any other person. This setting naturally arises in authentication on personal computers and mobile devices, and poses additional challenges because it lacks negative examples. We formalize our problem as one-class classification, and propose and analyze an algorithm that learns a non-parametric model of the face from a single labeled image and a stream of unlabeled data. In many domains, for instance when a person interacts with a computer with a camera, unlabeled data are abundant and easy to utilize. This is the first paper that investigates how these data can help in learning better models in the single-image-per-person setting. Our method is evaluated on a dataset of 43 people and we show that these people can be recognized 90% of time at nearly zero false positives. This recall is 25+% higher than the recall of our best performing baseline. Finally, we conduct a comprehensive sensitivity analysis of our algorithm and provide a guideline for setting its parameters in practice.
papers.comment: Published at IEEE International Conference on Automatic Face and Gesture Recognition (FG 2013). doi:10.1109/FG.2013.6553720
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把单张人脸认证形式化为 one-class classification，用一张标注人脸加持续到来的未标注图像流学习非参数人脸模型，未标注流用于补足缺失的负样本。在 43 人数据集上以接近零假阳性率识别出 90% 的时间，召回率比最佳基线高 25% 以上。
Motivation: 每人一张训练样本时样本量极小，且只识别一个人、没有任何他人标注数据，缺少负样本，常规监督分类无法直接使用。
Method: 将问题形式化为 one-class classification，提出并分析一个从单张标注图像加未标注数据流学习非参数人脸模型的算法，另做参数敏感性分析给出实践调参指引。
Result: 在 43 人的数据集上，接近零假阳性条件下识别正确率达 90%；召回率比最佳基线高 25% 以上。
Conclusion: 在单图每人设定下，持续的未标注数据流能有效替代缺失的负样本，显著提升认证召回率，并可给出参数设置指引。

papers.title: Bayesian policy gradient and actor-critic algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Policy gradient methods are reinforcement learning algorithms that adapt a parameterized policy by following a performance gradient estimate. Conventional policy gradient methods use Monte-Carlo techniques to estimate the gradient, which tend to have high variance, requiring many samples and resulting in slow convergence. We first propose a Bayesian framework for policy gradient, based on modeling the policy gradient as a Gaussian process. This reduces the number of samples needed to obtain accurate gradient estimates. Moreover, estimates of the natural gradient and a measure of the uncertainty in the gradient estimates, namely, the gradient covariance, are provided at little extra cost. Since the proposed framework considers system trajectories as its basic observable unit, it does not require the dynamics within trajectories to be of any particular form, and can be extended to partially observable problems. On the downside, it cannot exploit the Markov property when the system is Markovian. To address this, we supplement our Bayesian policy gradient framework with a new actor-critic learning model in which a Bayesian class of non-parametric critics, based on Gaussian process temporal difference learning, is used. Such critics model the action-value function as a Gaussian process, allowing Bayes rule to be used to compute the posterior distribution over action-value functions, conditioned on the observed data. Appropriate choices of the policy parameterization and of the prior covariance (kernel) between action-values yield closed-form expressions for the posterior of the gradient of the expected return with respect to the policy parameters. We perform detailed experimental comparisons of the proposed Bayesian policy gradient and actor-critic algorithms with classic Monte-Carlo based policy gradient methods, on a number of reinforcement learning problems.
papers.comment: Published in Journal of Machine Learning Research 17(66):1-53, 2016
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Machine Learning Research 17(66):1-53, 2016
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把策略梯度建模为 Gaussian process，用贝叶斯框架替代 Monte-Carlo 梯度估计，并补充基于 GP temporal difference learning 的 actor-critic 评论家，以降低梯度估计方差、减少所需样本量。该框架以系统轨迹为基本观测单元，不假设轨迹内动力学形式，可扩展到部分可观测问题，但无法利用 Markov 性；作者在多个强化学习问题上与经典 Monte-Carlo 策略梯度做了实验对比。
Motivation: 经典策略梯度用 Monte-Carlo 估计梯度，方差高、需要大量样本、收敛慢；且在 Markov 系统中无法利用 Markov 性。
Method: 将策略梯度建模为 Gaussian process，得到梯度估计、natural gradient 与梯度协方差（不确定性度量）；再补充 actor-critic 模型，用 GP temporal difference learning 作为非参数 critic，通过 Bayes rule 计算动作-价值函数后验，配合合适的策略参数化与先验协方差（kernel）得到期望回报对策略参数梯度的闭式后验。
Result: 在若干强化学习问题上，将所提 Bayesian policy gradient 与 actor-critic 算法同经典 Monte-Carlo 策略梯度做了详细实验对比；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 贝叶斯策略梯度能以更少样本得到准确梯度估计并附带不确定性，代价是不能利用 Markov 性，需用 GP-TD critic 补足。

papers.title: Online semi-supervised perception: Real-time learning without explicit feedback
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes an algorithm for real-time learning without explicit feedback. The algorithm combines the ideas of semi-supervised learning on graphs and online learning. In particular, it iteratively builds a graphical representation of its world and updates it with observed examples. Labeled examples constitute the initial bias of the algorithm and are provided offline, and a stream of unlabeled examples is collected online to update this bias. We motivate the algorithm, discuss how to implement it efficiently, prove a regret bound on the quality of its solutions, and apply it to the problem of real-time face recognition. Our recognizer runs in real time, and achieves superior precision and recall on 3 challenging video datasets.
papers.comment: IEEE Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Workshop on Online Learning for Computer Vision (CVPR 2010 OLCV)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种无需显式反馈的在线半监督学习算法：把离线标注样本作为初始偏置，在线流式无标注样本不断更新图表示，结合图上半监督学习与在线学习，并证明了解质量的 regret 界。在 3 个有挑战性的视频数据集上做实时人脸识别，精确率与召回率均优于对比方法。
Motivation: 真实场景中在线获取标签代价高或不可得，纯监督在线学习无法利用大量无标注流式样本，需要在无显式反馈下实时更新模型并保证解的质量。
Method: 算法迭代构建世界的图表示：离线标注样本构成初始偏置，在线收集的无标注样本流用于更新该偏置；结合图上半监督学习与在线学习，给出高效实现，并对解的质量证明 regret 界，应用于实时人脸识别。
Result: 在 3 个有挑战性的视频数据集上，识别器实时运行，precision 与 recall 均取得优于对比方法的表现；并给出 regret 界作为理论保证。
Conclusion: 无需显式反馈的在线半监督图学习可以在实时约束下同时给出理论 regret 保证与更好的识别精度，适用于视频流中的人脸识别。

papers.title: Semi-supervised learning with max-margin graph cuts
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel algorithm for semisupervised learning. This algorithm learns graph cuts that maximize the margin with respect to the labels induced by the harmonic function solution. We motivate the approach, compare it to existing work, and prove a bound on its generalization error. The quality of our solutions is evaluated on a synthetic problem and three UCI ML repository datasets. In most cases, we outperform manifold regularization of support vector machines, which is a state-of-the-art approach to semi-supervised max-margin learning.
papers.comment: Published at AISTATS 2010 (13th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出半监督学习算法，学习使相对于调和函数 (harmonic function) 所诱导标签具有最大间隔的图割 (graph cuts)，并证明其泛化误差界。在合成问题与三个 UCI 数据集上，多数情形优于流形正则化 SVM (manifold regularization of SVMs)。
Motivation: 半监督 max-margin 学习中，如何把图上的标签传播与间隔最大化结合并给出泛化保证，是该文要补的缺口。
Method: 以调和函数解诱导标签，学习最大化标签间隔的图割；与已有工作对比并推导泛化误差界；在合成问题和三个 UCI ML Repository 数据集上评测。
Result: 在合成问题与三个 UCI 数据集的多数情形下，性能超过作为半监督 max-margin 学习 SOTA 的流形正则化 SVM；并给出一个泛化误差界。
Conclusion: 以调和函数诱导标签来学 max-margin 图割，是可与流形正则化 SVM 竞争且有泛化误差界的半监督方案。

papers.title: Evolutionary feature selection for spiking neural network pattern classifiers
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an application of the biologically realistic JASTAP neural network model to classification tasks. The JASTAP neural network model is presented as an alternative to the basic multi-layer perceptron model. An evolutionary procedure previously applied to the simultaneous solution of feature selection and neural network training on standard multi-layer perceptrons is extended with JASTAP model. Preliminary results on IRIS standard data set give evidence that this extension allows the use of smaller neural networks that can handle noisier data without any degradation in classification accuracy.
papers.comment: Published at Portuguese Conference on Artificial Intelligence (EPIA 2005), eds. Bento et al., IEEE, pp. 24-32
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把已有的进化式特征选择与神经网络训练联合求解流程扩展到生物可解释的 JASTAP 脉冲神经网络模型，用于分类任务。在 IRIS 标准数据集上的初步结果显示，该扩展允许使用更小的网络，并能在噪声更大的数据上保持分类精度不下降。
Motivation: 标准多层感知机 (MLP) 缺乏生物可解释性，且特征选择与网络训练通常分开处理，导致网络规模偏大、对含噪数据鲁棒性不足。
Method: 将先前用于在标准 MLP 上同时求解特征选择与网络训练的进化式流程 (evolutionary procedure) 扩展到 JASTAP 脉冲神经网络模型，把 JASTAP 作为 MLP 的替代模型接入该联合优化框架。
Result: 在 IRIS 标准数据集上的初步结果表明，该扩展可使用更小的神经网络，并能处理噪声更大的数据而不出现分类精度下降。
Conclusion: 进化式特征选择与 JASTAP 脉冲网络结合，可在保持分类精度的前提下压缩网络规模并提升对噪声数据的容忍度；作者将其定位为 MLP 的一种替代方案。

papers.title: Large-scale semi-supervised learning with online spectral graph sparsification
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Sparse-HFS, a scalable algorithm that can compute solutions to SSL problems using only O(n polylog(n)) space and O(m polylog(n)) time.
papers.comment: Workshop on Resource-Efficient Machine Learning (REML), ICML 2015
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Sparse-HFS，用在线谱图稀疏化 (online spectral graph sparsification) 求解半监督学习 (SSL) 问题，把空间复杂度压到 O(n polylog(n))、时间复杂度压到 O(m polylog(n))，使大规模 SSL 可扩展。
Motivation: 大规模半监督学习中，图方法的存储与处理开销随节点数和边数增长过快，难以在资源受限条件下求解。
Method: Sparse-HFS：在线谱图稀疏化构造稀疏图表示，以近似谱性质的方式求解 SSL 目标，从而降低空间与时间开销。
Result: 给出复杂度结果：空间 O(n polylog(n))，时间 O(m polylog(n))，其中 n 为节点数、m 为边数。
Conclusion: 在线谱图稀疏化可把 SSL 的资源开销降到近线性规模，使大规模半监督学习在可控空间与时间内可解。

papers.title: Improved large-scale graph learning through ridge spectral sparsification
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based techniques and spectral graph theory have enriched the field of machine learning with a variety of critical advances. A central object in the analysis is the graph Laplacian L, which encodes the structure of the graph. We consider the problem of learning over this Laplacian in a distributed streaming setting, where new edges of the graph are observed in real time by a network of workers. In this setting, it is hard to learn quickly or approximately while keeping a distributed representation of L. To address this challenge, we present a novel algorithm, GSQUEAK, which efficiently sparsifies the Laplacian by maintaining a small subset of effective resistances. We show that our algorithm produces sparsifiers with strong spectral approximation guarantees, all while processing edges in a single pass and in a distributed fashion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在分布式流式图学习中提出 GSQUEAK，通过维护一小部分有效电阻 (effective resistance) 对图拉普拉斯算子 L 做 ridge 谱稀疏化，单遍 (single pass)、分布式处理实时到达的边。算法产出的稀疏化器具有强谱近似保证。
Motivation: 分布式流式设定下，新边由 worker 网络实时到达，既要保持 L 的分布式表示、又要快速或近似地学习拉普拉斯十分困难。
Method: GSQUEAK 算法对图拉普拉斯 L 做谱稀疏化，核心是维护一个有效电阻的小子集，单遍扫描并以分布式方式处理到达的边，基于 ridge 谱稀疏化给出谱近似保证。
Result: 算法产出的稀疏化器具有强谱近似保证，且在单遍、分布式处理流式边的条件下成立；摘要未给出定量实验数字。
Conclusion: 用少量有效电阻即可在保持分布式表示的同时高效稀疏化拉普拉斯，使流式图上的快速近似学习成为可能。

papers.title: Analysis of Nystrom method with sequential ridge leverage scores
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale kernel ridge regression (KRR) is limited by the need to store a large kernel matrix K_t. To avoid storing the entire matrix K_t, Nystrom methods subsample a subset of columns of the kernel matrix, and efficiently find an approximate KRR solution on the reconstructed matrix. The chosen subsampling distribution in turn affects the statistical and computational tradeoffs. For KRR problems, recent works show that a sampling distribution proportional to the ridge leverage scores (RLSs) provides strong reconstruction guarantees for the approximation. While exact RLSs are as difficult to compute as a KRR solution, we may be able to approximate them well enough. In this paper, we study KRR problems in a sequential setting and introduce the INK-ESTIMATE algorithm, that incrementally computes the RLSs estimates. INK-ESTIMATE maintains a small sketch of K_t, that at each step is used to compute an intermediate estimate of the RLSs. First, our sketch update does not require access to previously seen columns, and therefore a single pass over the kernel matrix is sufficient. Second, the algorithm requires a fixed, small space budget to run dependent only on the effective dimension of the kernel matrix. Finally, our sketch provides strong approximation guarantees on the distance between the true kernel matrix and its approximation, and on the statistical risk of the approximate KRR solution at any time, because all our guarantees hold at any intermediate step.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对核岭回归 (KRR) 需存储大核矩阵 K_t 的瓶颈，提出顺序版 Nystrom 方法 INK-ESTIMATE：维护 K_t 的小 sketch，每步增量估计 ridge leverage scores (RLSs) 并据此采样列重建矩阵。单遍扫描即可运行，空间预算只依赖核矩阵有效维度，且近似误差与近似 KRR 解的统计风险保证在任意中间步骤都成立。
Motivation: KRR 要存储完整核矩阵 K_t，代价高；按 ridge leverage scores 采样虽有强重建保证，但精确 RLS 与直接求解 KRR 一样难算，需要可顺序计算的近似。
Method: INK-ESTIMATE 维护 K_t 的小 sketch，每步用它给出 RLSs 的中间估计并据此对核矩阵列做 Nystrom 子采样；sketch 更新不依赖已见过的列，因此单遍扫描足够，空间预算固定且只依赖核矩阵有效维度。
Result: 给出三类保证：单遍扫描即可完成；空间开销只由核矩阵有效维度决定；真实核矩阵与其近似的距离、以及近似 KRR 解的统计风险在任意中间步骤都有强近似保证。
Conclusion: 顺序增量估计 RLSs 可以在单遍、固定小空间下支撑 Nystrom 近似 KRR，并使重建与统计风险保证在计算过程的每一步都成立。

papers.title: Maximum Entropy Semi-Supervised Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: A popular approach to apprenticeship learning (AL) is to formulate it as an inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) problem. The MaxEnt-IRL algorithm successfully integrates the maximum entropy principle into IRL and unlike its predecessors, it resolves the ambiguity arising from the fact that a possibly large number of policies could match the expert's behavior. In this paper, we study an AL setting in which in addition to the expert's trajectories, a number of unsupervised trajectories is available. We introduce MESSI, a novel algorithm that combines MaxEnt-IRL with principles coming from semi-supervised learning. In particular, MESSI integrates the unsupervised data into the MaxEnt-IRL framework using a pairwise penalty on trajectories. Empirical results in a highway driving and grid-world problems indicate that MESSI is able to take advantage of the unsupervised trajectories and improve the performance of MaxEnt-IRL.

Motivation: 学徒学习常被写成逆强化学习 (IRL)，但 MaxEnt-IRL 只用专家轨迹，专家数据昂贵且大量无监督轨迹被浪费。

Conclusion: 无监督轨迹通过成对惩罚即可提升最大熵逆强化学习的学徒学习效果，无需额外专家标注。

papers.title: On two ways to use determinantal point processes for Monte Carlo integration
papers.abstract_en: The standard Monte Carlo estimator $\widehat{I}_N^{\mathrm{MC}}$ of $\int fdω$ relies on independent samples from $ω$ and has variance of order $1/N$. Replacing the samples with a determinantal point process (DPP), a repulsive distribution, makes the estimator consistent, with variance rates that depend on how the DPP is adapted to $f$ and $ω$. We examine two existing DPP-based estimators: one by Bardenet & Hardy (2020) with a rate of $\mathcal{O}(N^{-(1+1/d)})$ for smooth $f$, but relying on a fixed DPP. The other, by Ermakov & Zolotukhin (1960), is unbiased with rate of order $1/N$, like Monte Carlo, but its DPP is tailored to $f$. We revisit these estimators, generalize them to continuous settings, and provide sampling algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把排斥性点过程 (DPP) 用作 Monte Carlo 积分的采样分布，可让估计量方差快于独立采样的 1/N。文中比较两条路线：固定 DPP 的 Bardenet & Hardy (2020) 对光滑 f 达到 O(N^{-(1+1/d)})，而 Ermakov & Zolotukhin (1960) 的版本无偏、速率仍为 1/N 但 DPP 随 f 定制；作者将两者推广到连续情形并给出采样算法。
Motivation: 标准 MC 估计量依赖独立样本、方差只有 O(1/N)，在高维下收敛慢；用排斥样本替代独立样本是提升积分效率的一条已有但分散的路线，需要统一审视其方差速率与 DPP 是否随被积函数定制。
Method: 考察两个已有的 DPP 积分估计量：Bardenet & Hardy (2020) 的固定 DPP 版本与 Ermakov & Zolotukhin (1960) 的 f-定制、无偏版本；将二者推广到连续 setting，并为 DPP 采样给出算法。
Result: 固定 DPP 估计量对光滑 f 的方差速率为 O(N^{-(1+1/d)})；Ermakov–Zolotukhin 估计量无偏且速率与标准 Monte Carlo 同为 1/N，但其 DPP 随 f 定制。
Conclusion: DPP 积分存在两种取舍：固定 DPP 换来超 1/N 的速率，f-定制 DPP 保住无偏与 1/N 速率；作者把两者统一推广到连续 setting 并配套采样算法。

papers.title: Planning in entropy-regularized Markov decision processes and games
papers.abstract_en: We propose SmoothCruiser, a new planning algorithm for estimating the value function in entropy-regularized Markov decision processes and two-player games, given a generative model of the environment. SmoothCruiser makes use of the smoothness of the Bellman operator promoted by the regularization to achieve problem-independent sample complexity of order O~(1/epsilon^4) for a desired accuracy epsilon, whereas for non-regularized settings there are no known algorithms with guaranteed polynomial sample complexity in the worst case.
papers.journal_ref: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 32 (NeurIPS 2019)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SmoothCruiser，在熵正则化 MDP 与双人博弈中利用正则化带来的 Bellman 算子光滑性估计值函数，在给定环境生成模型下达到与问题无关的样本复杂度 Õ(1/ε⁴)；而非正则化设定下最坏情形尚无已知多项式样本复杂度的算法。
Motivation: 非正则化 MDP 与博弈的规划在最坏情形下没有已知多项式样本复杂度的算法，值函数估计的样本效率缺乏与问题无关的保证。
Method: SmoothCruiser 是一个面向熵正则化 MDP 和双人博弈的规划算法，输入为环境的生成模型 (generative model)，利用熵正则化使 Bellman 算子变得光滑这一性质来估计值函数。
Result: 在精度 ε 下达到与问题无关的样本复杂度 Õ(1/ε⁴)；对照事实是非正则化设定下最坏情形没有已知多项式样本复杂度算法。
Conclusion: 熵正则化带来的 Bellman 算子光滑性足以把规划的样本复杂度压到与问题无关的多项式界 Õ(1/ε⁴)。

papers.title: Scale-free adaptive planning for deterministic dynamics & discounted rewards
papers.abstract_en: We address the problem of planning in an environment with deterministic dynamics and stochastic rewards with discounted returns. The optimal value function is not known, nor are the rewards bounded. We propose Platypoos, a simple scale-free planning algorithm that adapts to the unknown scale and smoothness of the reward function. We provide a sample complexity analysis for Platypoos that improves upon prior work and holds simultaneously over a broad range of discount factors and reward scales, without the algorithm knowing them. We also establish a matching lower bound showing our analysis is optimal up to constants.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 36th International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2019)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Platypoos：在确定性动力学、随机且无界奖励、折扣回报的规划问题中，算法无需知道奖励尺度与光滑度即可自适应缩放。其样本复杂度分析在很宽的折扣因子与奖励尺度范围内同时成立并改进已有工作，且有匹配的下界说明在常数因子内最优。
Motivation: 最优值函数未知、奖励无界时，规划算法若依赖奖励尺度或折扣因子的先验知识，样本复杂度结论只能在固定参数下成立；需要一个 scale-free 且对宽范围参数同时有效的分析。
Method: 提出 scale-free 规划算法 Platypoos，自适应未知的奖励尺度与光滑度；给出在宽折扣因子与奖励尺度范围内同时成立的样本复杂度分析，并构造匹配下界。
Result: 样本复杂度分析改进已有工作，且在算法不知晓折扣因子与奖励尺度的情况下对很宽的参数范围同时成立；匹配下界表明该分析在常数因子意义下最优。
Conclusion: 确定性动力学下的折扣规划可以在不掌握奖励尺度与光滑度的前提下达到常数因子最优的样本复杂度。

papers.title: Optimal last-iterate convergence in matrix games with bandit feedback using the log-barrier
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning minimax policies in zero-sum matrix games. Fiegel et al. (2025) recently showed that achieving last-iterate convergence in this setting is harder when the players are uncoupled, by proving a lower bound on the exploitability gap of Omega(t^{-1/4}). Some online mirror descent algorithms were proposed in the literature for this problem, but none have truly attained this rate yet. We show that the use of a log-barrier regularization, along with a dual-focused analysis, allows this O-tilde(t^{-1/4}) convergence with high-probability. We additionally extend our idea to the setting of extensive-form games, proving a bound with the same rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在非耦合零和矩阵博弈的 bandit 反馈下，用 log-barrier 正则化配合 dual-focused 分析，实现高概率的 last-iterate 收敛率 Õ(t^{-1/4})，匹配 Fiegel et al. (2025) 给出的 exploitability gap 下界 Ω(t^{-1/4})；同一思路可扩展到 extensive-form games 并证明相同速率的界。
Motivation: 非耦合（uncoupled）玩家设定下 last-iterate 收敛更难，已有下界为 exploitability gap 的 Ω(t^{-1/4})，而文献中的 online mirror descent 算法此前都未真正达到该速率。
Method: 在零和矩阵博弈的 minimax 策略学习中引入 log-barrier 正则化，并采用 dual-focused 分析框架；将同一思路推广到 extensive-form games 并给出证明。
Result: 以高概率达到 Õ(t^{-1/4}) 的 last-iterate 收敛率，匹配已知下界 Ω(t^{-1/4})；extensive-form games 中证明了相同速率的界。
Conclusion: log-barrier 正则化加 dual-focused 分析足以在非耦合矩阵博弈中把 last-iterate 收敛推到信息论下界速率，且该思路可迁移到 extensive-form games。

papers.title: Blazing the trails before beating the path: Sample-efficient Monte-Carlo planning
papers.abstract_en: You are a robot and you live in a Markov decision process (MDP) with a finite or an infinite number of transitions from state-action to next states. You got brains and so you plan before you act. Luckily, your roboparents equipped you with a generative model to do some Monte-Carlo planning. The world is waiting for you and you have no time to waste. You want your planning to be efficient. Sample-efficient. Indeed, you want to exploit the possible structure of the MDP by exploring only a subset of states reachable by following near-optimal policies. You want guarantees on sample complexity that depend on a measure of the quantity of near-optimal states. You want something, that is an extension of Monte-Carlo sampling (for estimating an expectation) to problems that alternate maximization (over actions) and expectation (over next states). But you do not want to StOP with exponential running time, you want something simple to implement and computationally efficient. You want it all and you want it now. You want TrailBlazer.
papers.comment: Published in Neural Information Processing Systems 2016
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TrailBlazer：在带生成模型的 MDP 中做样本高效的 Monte-Carlo 规划，只探索近最优策略可达的状态子集，把样本复杂度保证绑定到近最优状态数量这一测度上，同时避免 StOP 那样的指数运行时间。
Motivation: Monte-Carlo 规划在通用 MDP 上要么遍历大量无关状态导致样本浪费，要么像 StOP 一样付出指数级运行时间；需要一种既利用近最优状态结构、又保持实现简单与计算高效的规划方法。
Method: TrailBlazer 把 Monte-Carlo 采样从估计期望扩展到交替进行的动作最大化与下一状态期望，只在近最优策略可达的状态子集上探索；样本复杂度保证以近最优状态数量的测度为参数，且不采用 StOP 的指数时间方案。
Result: 给出依赖近最优状态数量测度的样本复杂度保证，并声称运行时间非指数、实现简单且计算高效；摘要未给出具体数值实验。
Conclusion: 在有生成模型的 MDP 中，围绕近最优状态子集做规划即可同时拿到结构化的样本复杂度保证与计算效率，无需指数时间。

papers.title: Orchestrating Specialized Agents for Trustworthy Enterprise RAG
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) shows promise for enterprise knowledge work, yet it often underperforms in high-stakes decision settings that require deep synthesis, strict traceability, and recovery from underspecified prompts. One-pass retrieval-and-write pipelines frequently yield shallow summaries, inconsistent grounding, and weak mechanisms for completeness verification. We introduce ADORE (Adaptive Deep Orchestration for Research in Enterprise), an agentic framework that replaces linear retrieval with iterative, user-steered investigation coordinated by a central orchestrator and a set of specialized agents. ADORE's key insight is that a structured Memory Bank (a curated evidence store with explicit claim-evidence linkage and section-level admissible evidence) enables traceable report generation and systematic checks for evidence completeness. Our contributions are threefold: (1) Memory-locked synthesis - report generation is constrained to a structured Memory Bank (Claim-Evidence Graph) with section-level admissible evidence, enabling traceable claims and grounded citations; (2) Evidence-coverage-guided execution - a retrieval-reflection loop audits section-level evidence coverage to trigger targeted follow-up retrieval and terminates via an evidence-driven stopping criterion; (3) Section-packed long-context grounding - section-level packing, pruning, and citation-preserving compression make long-form synthesis feasible under context limits. Across our evaluation suite, ADORE ranks first on DeepResearch Bench (52.65) and achieves the highest head-to-head preference win rate on DeepConsult (77.2%) against commercial systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ADORE 用中央 orchestrator 协调一组 specialized agents，把企业 RAG 的一次性检索改写为用户可介入的迭代调查，并以 Memory Bank（Claim-Evidence Graph）锁定证据。证据覆盖审计触发定向补检索、按证据驱动的停止准则终止，长文合成靠 section 级打包与压缩。在评测集上 DeepResearch Bench 得分 52.65 排名第一，DeepConsult 头对头偏好胜率 77.2%。
Motivation: 企业高风险决策场景需要深度综合、严格可追溯与对欠定 prompt 的恢复，而一次性检索-写作流水线产出浅层摘要、grounding 不一致、缺少完整性核验机制。
Method: 中央 orchestrator 协调 specialized agents 做用户介入的迭代调查；Memory-locked synthesis 把报告生成约束在 Claim-Evidence Graph 与 section 级可采证据内；evidence-coverage-guided execution 用检索-反思循环审计 section 级证据覆盖并以证据驱动准则终止；section 级 packing、pruning 与保引用压缩支撑长上下文合成。

papers.title: RL-finetuning LLMs from on- and off-policy data with a single algorithm
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a novel reinforcement learning algorithm (AGRO, for Any-Generation Reward Optimization) for fine-tuning large-language models. AGRO leverages the concept of generation consistency, which states that the optimal policy satisfies the notion of consistency across any possible generation of the model. We derive algorithms that find optimal solutions via the sample-based policy gradient and provide theoretical guarantees on their convergence. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of AGRO in both on-policy and off-policy settings, showing improved performance on the mathematical reasoning dataset over baseline algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出强化学习微调大语言模型的算法 AGRO（Any-Generation Reward Optimization），核心是 generation consistency：最优策略须在模型任意一次生成上都满足一致性。由样本式策略梯度 (sample-based policy gradient) 导出求解算法并给出收敛性理论保证，在数学推理数据集上于 on-policy 与 off-policy 两种设定下均优于基线算法。
Motivation: 用 RL 微调 LLM 时 on-policy 与 off-policy 数据通常需要不同算法，缺少一个能同时处理两种数据来源并有收敛保证的统一目标。
Method: AGRO 引入 generation consistency 概念，即最优策略在任意可能生成上保持一致；据此通过样本式策略梯度推导出可求解的算法，并给出收敛性的理论保证，同一算法覆盖 on-policy 与 off-policy 两种数据设定。
Result: 在数学推理数据集上，AGRO 在 on-policy 与 off-policy 设定下均相对基线算法提升性能；摘要给出收敛性的理论保证，但未列出具体数值。
Conclusion: 以 generation consistency 为目标，单一策略梯度算法可同时消化 on-policy 与 off-policy 数据并保持收敛保证，用于 LLM 的数学推理微调。

papers.title: Preference Optimization with Multi-Sample Comparisons
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in generative models, particularly large language models (LLMs) and diffusion models, have been driven by extensive pretraining on large datasets followed by post-training. However, current post-training methods such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and direct alignment from preference methods (DAP) primarily utilize single-sample comparisons. These approaches often fail to capture critical characteristics such as generative diversity and bias, which are more accurately assessed through multiple samples. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel approach that extends post-training to include multi-sample comparisons. To achieve this, we propose Multi-sample Direct Preference Optimization (mDPO) and Multi-sample Identity Preference Optimization (mIPO). These methods improve traditional DAP methods by focusing on group-wise characteristics. Empirically, we demonstrate that multi-sample comparison is more effective in optimizing collective characteristics~(e.g., diversity and bias) for generative models than single-sample comparison. Additionally, our findings suggest that multi-sample comparisons provide a more robust optimization framework, particularly for dataset with label noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: mDPO 与 mIPO 把 LLM/diffusion 后训练从单样本偏好比较扩展为组内多样本比较，直接优化生成分布的群体特征（多样性、偏差）。实证显示多样本比较在优化这类集体特征上比单样本更有效，且在带标签噪声的数据集上优化更稳健。
Motivation: RLHF 与 DAP 类方法只做单样本比较，无法刻画生成多样性与偏差这类需要多个样本才能评估的特征。
Method: 提出 Multi-sample Direct Preference Optimization (mDPO) 与 Multi-sample Identity Preference Optimization (mIPO)，在偏好对齐中引入组内多样本比较，使目标聚焦 group-wise 特征；面向 LLM 与 diffusion 模型的 post-training。
Result: 实证表明多样本比较在优化生成模型的集体特征（多样性、偏差）上比单样本比较更有效；在含标签噪声的数据集上，多样本比较构成更稳健的优化框架。
Conclusion: 把偏好优化的目标从单样本配对改为组级统计量，能同时改善对多样性/偏差的控制与对标签噪声的鲁棒性。

papers.title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern artificial intelligence (AI) systems are powered by foundation models. This paper presents a new set of foundation models, called Llama 3. It is a herd of language models that natively support multilinguality, coding, reasoning, and tool usage. Our largest model is a dense Transformer with 405B parameters and a context window of up to 128K tokens. This paper presents an extensive empirical evaluation of Llama 3. We find that Llama 3 delivers comparable quality to leading language models such as GPT-4 on a plethora of tasks. We publicly release Llama 3, including pre-trained and post-trained versions of the 405B parameter language model and our Llama Guard 3 model for input and output safety. The paper also presents the results of experiments in which we integrate image, video, and speech capabilities into Llama 3 via a compositional approach. We observe this approach performs competitively with the state-of-the-art on image, video, and speech recognition tasks. The resulting models are not yet being broadly released as they are still under development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Llama 3 是一族原生支持多语言、代码、推理与工具使用的语言模型，最大稠密模型 405B 参数、128K 上下文窗口，经验评估显示其质量与 GPT-4 等领先模型相当。公开发布含 405B 预训练与后训练版本及 Llama Guard 3 安全模型，并以组合方式接入图像、视频、语音能力，在相关识别任务上与最先进水平相当。
Motivation: 基础模型是现代 AI 系统的核心，需要一族在多语言、代码、推理、工具使用上均达标且可公开复现的大规模语言模型。
Method: 构建 Llama 3 模型族，最大为 405B 参数稠密 Transformer、128K token 上下文；做广泛经验评估并与 GPT-4 等对比；用组合式 (compositional) 方法把图像、视频、语音能力接入模型，并配套 Llama Guard 3 输入输出安全模型。
Result: 405B 参数、128K 上下文的 Llama 3 在大量任务上质量与 GPT-4 等领先语言模型相当；图像、视频、语音的组合式接入在识别任务上与最先进水平 (state-of-the-art) 竞争力相当。
Conclusion: Llama 3 以单一模型族覆盖多语言、代码、推理与工具使用并达到领先水平，405B 版本与 Llama Guard 3 已公开发布，多模态版本仍在开发中、尚未广泛发布。

papers.title: A New Bound on the Cumulant Generating Function of Dirichlet Processes
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce a novel approach for bounding the cumulant generating function (CGF) of a Dirichlet process (DP) $X \sim \text{DP}(αν_0)$, using superadditivity. In particular, our key technical contribution is the demonstration of the superadditivity of $α\mapsto \log \mathbb{E}_{X \sim \text{DP}(αν_0)}[\exp( \mathbb{E}_X[αf])]$, where $\mathbb{E}_X[f] = \int f dX$. This result, combined with Fekete's lemma and Varadhan's integral lemma, converts the known asymptotic large deviation principle into a practical upper bound on the CGF $ \log\mathbb{E}_{X\sim \text{DP}(αν_0)}{\exp(\mathbb{E}_{X}{[f]})} $ for any $α> 0$. The bound is given by the convex conjugate of the scaled reversed Kullback-Leibler divergence $α\mathrm{KL}(ν_0\Vert \cdot)$. This new bound provides particularly effective confidence regions for sums of independent DPs, making it applicable across various fields.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用超可加性 (superadditivity) 给 Dirichlet 过程 X~DP(αν0) 的累积量生成函数 (CGF) 构造可计算上界：证明 α↦log E[exp(E_X[αf])] 关于 α 超可加，再经 Fekete 引理与 Varadhan 积分引理把已知的大偏差原理 (LDP) 渐近结果转成对任意 α>0 成立的显式界，形式为缩放的反向 Kullback-Leibler 散度 αKL(ν0‖·) 的凸共轭。
Motivation: Dirichlet 过程的 CGF 只有渐近的大偏差结果，缺少对任意集中参数 α 直接可用的显式上界，因而难以给独立 DP 之和构造置信域。
Method: 核心是证明 α↦log E_{X~DP(αν0)}[exp(E_X[αf])] 关于 α 超可加；结合 Fekete 引理与 Varadhan 积分 lemma，把已知 LDP 转化为 CGF 上界，该界等于缩放反向 KL 散度 αKL(ν0‖·) 的凸共轭。
Result: 得到对任意 α>0 成立的 CGF 上界，表达为 αKL(ν0‖·) 的凸共轭；该界用于独立 Dirichlet 过程之和的置信域构造。
Conclusion: 超可加性把 Dirichlet 过程的渐近大偏差界变成有限 α 下的实用 CGF 上界，从而可为独立 DP 之和给出置信域，作者称其可跨领域应用。

papers.title: VA-learning as a more efficient alternative to Q-learning
papers.abstract_en: In reinforcement learning, the advantage function is critical for policy improvement, but is often extracted from a learned Q-function. A natural question is: Why not learn the advantage function directly? In this work, we introduce VA-learning, which directly learns advantage function and value function using bootstrapping, without explicit reference to Q-functions. VA-learning learns off-policy and enjoys similar theoretical guarantees as Q-learning. Thanks to the direct learning of advantage function and value function, VA-learning improves the sample efficiency over Q-learning both in tabular implementations and deep RL agents on Atari-57 games. We also identify a close connection between VA-learning and the dueling architecture, which partially explains why a simple architectural change to DQN agents tends to improve performance.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2023 as a conference paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VA-learning 绕过 Q 函数，直接用 bootstrapping 同时学习 advantage function 与 value function，保持与 Q-learning 相近的理论保证和 off-policy 性质。在表格型实现与 Atari-57 上的 deep RL agent 中，其样本效率均优于 Q-learning；与 dueling architecture 的紧密联系部分解释了该结构改动为何常能提升 DQN 表现。
Motivation: 策略改进依赖 advantage function，但它通常要从学到的 Q 函数里间接抽取，Q 函数的估计误差会传导到 advantage，且样本效率受限。
Method: 直接以 bootstrapping 学习 advantage function 与 value function，全程不显式引用 Q-function；保持 off-policy 训练，并给出与 Q-learning 类似的理论保证；同时分析 VA-learning 与 dueling architecture 的对应关系。
Result: 在表格型实现和 Atari-57 游戏的 deep RL agent 上，VA-learning 相对 Q-learning 提升样本效率；VA-learning 与 dueling architecture 存在紧密联系，部分解释了对 DQN 做这一简单结构改动往往能改善性能。
Conclusion: 直接学 advantage 加 value 是比 Q-learning 更省样本的替代路径，且 dueling DQN 的经验收益可由这一视角部分解释。

papers.title: Generalized Preference Optimization: A Unified Approach to Offline Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Offline preference optimization allows fine-tuning large models directly from offline data, and has proved effective in recent alignment practices. We propose generalized preference optimization (GPO), a family of offline losses parameterized by a general class of convex functions. GPO enables a unified view over preference optimization, encompassing existing algorithms such as DPO, IPO and SLiC as special cases, while naturally introducing new variants. The GPO framework also sheds light on how offline algorithms enforce regularization, through the design of the convex function that defines the loss. Our analysis and experiments reveal the connections and subtle differences between the offline regularization and the KL divergence regularization intended by the canonical RLHF formulation. In a controlled setting akin to Gao et al 2023, we also show that different GPO variants achieve similar trade-offs between regularization and performance, though the optimal values of hyper-parameter might differ as predicted by theory. In all, our results present new algorithmic toolkits and empirical insights to alignment practitioners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出广义偏好优化 (Generalized Preference Optimization, GPO)：用一类凸函数参数化的离线损失族，把 DPO、IPO、SLiC 统一为特例并自然导出新变体。在类似 Gao et al 2023 的受控设定中，不同 GPO 变体在正则化与性能之间取得相近的权衡，但最优超参数取值不同，且与理论预测一致。
Motivation: 离线偏好对齐已有 DPO、IPO、SLiC 等各自为政的损失设计，缺少统一框架说明它们如何施加正则，以及离线正则与 RLHF 中 KL 散度正则的关系。
Method: GPO 用一类凸函数定义离线损失，将现有算法作为特例纳入同一族；据此分析凸函数设计如何决定正则化形式，并对比离线正则与规范 RLHF 公式所意图的 KL 散度正则，再在受控设定中测试不同 GPO 变体的超参数。
Result: 分析与实验揭示离线正则与 RLHF 的 KL 散度正则之间存在联系与细微差别；在类似 Gao et al 2023 的受控设定中，不同 GPO 变体在正则化与性能之间达到相近权衡，而最优超参数取值不同，且差异符合理论预测。
Conclusion: 偏好优化可由凸函数参数化的损失族统一描述，正则强度由所选凸函数决定；变体间权衡曲线相近但最优超参数不同，实践者应按理论选择超参数而非照搬某一算法的默认值。
