papers.title: Decoding-time Realignment of Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Aligning language models with human preferences is crucial for reducing errors and biases in these models. Alignment techniques, such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), are typically cast as optimizing a tradeoff between human preference rewards and a proximity regularization term that encourages staying close to the unaligned model. Selecting an appropriate level of regularization is critical: insufficient regularization can lead to reduced model capabilities due to reward hacking, whereas excessive regularization hinders alignment. Traditional methods for finding the optimal regularization level require retraining multiple models with varying regularization strengths. This process, however, is resource-intensive, especially for large models. To address this challenge, we propose decoding-time realignment (DeRa), a simple method to explore and evaluate different regularization strengths in aligned models without retraining. DeRa enables control over the degree of alignment, allowing users to smoothly transition between unaligned and aligned models. It also enhances the efficiency of hyperparameter tuning by enabling the identification of effective regularization strengths using a validation dataset.
papers.comment: In Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2024)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出解码时重对齐 (Decoding-time Realignment, DeRa)，在不重训的前提下对已对齐模型扫描不同的正则强度，从而在未对齐与已对齐模型之间平滑调节对齐程度。它把原本需要按多个正则强度重训多个模型的超参搜索，压缩为用验证集在解码阶段挑选有效正则强度。
Motivation: RLHF 把对齐写成偏好奖励与贴近未对齐模型的正则项之间的权衡，正则太弱会因 reward hacking 掉能力、太强又对齐不足；传统找最优正则强度要按不同强度重训多个大模型，代价过高。
Method: DeRa 在解码阶段对已对齐模型施加可调的正则强度，无需重训练即可探索和评估不同强度，并用一个验证数据集挑选有效强度，实现对齐程度的连续控制。
Result: 给出的是方法能力而非对比数字：可在不重训的情况下探索并评估多个正则强度，支持在未对齐与已对齐模型之间平滑过渡，并通过验证集提升正则强度这一超参的调优效率。
Conclusion: 正则强度不必靠重训多个模型来选，可在解码时直接调节，把对齐程度变成一个可连续拨动的旋钮。

papers.title: Metacognitive Capabilities of LLMs: An Exploration in Mathematical Problem Solving
papers.abstract_en: Metacognitive knowledge refers to humans' intuitive knowledge of their own thinking and reasoning processes. Today's best LLMs clearly possess some reasoning processes. The paper gives evidence that they also have metacognitive knowledge, including ability to name skills and procedures to apply given a task. We explore this primarily in context of math reasoning, developing a prompt-guided interaction procedure to get a powerful LLM to assign sensible skill labels to math questions, followed by having it perform semantic clustering to obtain coarser families of skill labels. These coarse skill labels look interpretable to humans. To validate that these skill labels are meaningful and relevant to the LLM's reasoning processes we perform the following experiments. (a) We ask GPT-4 to assign skill labels to training questions in math datasets GSM8K and MATH. (b) When using an LLM to solve the test questions, we present it with the full list of skill labels and ask it to identify the skill needed. Then it is presented with randomly selected exemplar solved questions associated with that skill label. This improves accuracy on GSM8k and MATH for several strong LLMs, including code-assisted models. The methodology presented is domain-agnostic, even though this article applies it to math problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文给出证据表明 LLM 具备元认知知识 (metacognitive knowledge)，能为数学题命名所需技能；用 GPT-4 在 GSM8K 与 MATH 训练题上生成技能标签并语义聚类成粗粒度技能族，解题时把完整标签表与该技能的随机示例题一并给模型，可提升多个强 LLM（含 code-assisted 模型）的准确率。
Motivation: LLM 已有推理过程，但缺少证据说明它是否知道自己在用什么技能；若能显式命名并复用技能，可把解题提示从通用 CoT 变成有针对性的示例检索。
Method: 先用 prompt 引导的交互流程让强 LLM 给数学题打技能标签，再做语义聚类得到更粗的技能族；GPT-4 负责给 GSM8K、MATH 训练题打标，解题时把全部技能标签呈现给 LLM 让其选出所需技能，随后附上该标签下随机抽取的已解答示例题。
Result: 在 GSM8K 与 MATH 上，向解题 LLM 提供技能标签与对应示例后，多个强 LLM（含 code-assisted 模型）的准确率得到提升；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 技能标签对 LLM 的推理过程是可解释且有用的，该打标加示例检索的方法论是 domain-agnostic 的，可迁移到数学之外的任务。

papers.title: Understanding the performance gap between online and offline alignment algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) is the canonical framework for large language model alignment. However, rising popularity in offline alignment algorithms challenge the need for on-policy sampling in RLHF. Within the context of reward over-optimization, we start with an opening set of experiments that demonstrate the clear advantage of online methods over offline methods. This prompts us to investigate the causes to the performance discrepancy through a series of carefully designed experimental ablations. We show empirically that hypotheses such as offline data coverage and data quality by itself cannot convincingly explain the performance difference. We also find that while offline algorithms train policy to become good at pairwise classification, it is worse at generations; in the meantime the policies trained by online algorithms are good at generations while worse at pairwise classification. This hints at a unique interplay between discriminative and generative capabilities, which is greatly impacted by the sampling process. Lastly, we observe that the performance discrepancy persists for both contrastive and non-contrastive loss functions, and appears not to be addressed by simply scaling up policy networks. Taken together, our study sheds light on the pivotal role of on-policy sampling in AI alignment, and hints at certain fundamental challenges of offline alignment algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 reward over-optimization 语境下对比在线与离线 RLHF 对齐算法，实验显示在线方法明确占优；消融表明离线数据覆盖与数据质量本身不足以解释差距，真正分野在于离线算法把策略训成擅长 pairwise classification 而不擅长生成，在线算法恰好相反。该差距在 contrastive 与 non-contrastive 损失下都存在，且单纯放大策略网络规模无法消除。
Motivation: 离线对齐算法的流行正在挑战 RLHF 必须 on-policy 采样的前提，但在线与离线的性能差距来自何处并不清楚，需要判定哪些解释真正成立。
Method: 以 reward over-optimization 为实验框架，先做一组对比实验确立在线优于离线，再设计一系列消融逐一检验离线数据覆盖、数据质量等假设，并分别考察 pairwise classification 与 generation 能力、contrastive 与 non-contrastive 损失函数以及策略网络规模的影响。
Result: 在线方法相对离线方法有明确优势；数据覆盖与数据质量单独无法令人信服地解释性能差异；离线策略擅长 pairwise classification 但生成更差，在线策略生成好而 pairwise classification 更差；差距在 contrastive 与 non-contrastive 损失下均持续存在，扩大策略网络规模也无法解决。
Conclusion: on-policy 采样在对齐中起关键作用，离线对齐算法存在可能较为根本的挑战，其症结指向判别能力与生成能力之间受采样过程强烈影响的相互作用。

papers.title: Half-Hop: A graph upsampling approach for slowing down message passing
papers.abstract_en: Message passing neural networks have shown a lot of success on graph-structured data. However, there are many instances where message passing can lead to over-smoothing or fail when neighboring nodes belong to different classes. In this work, we introduce a simple yet general framework for improving learning in message passing neural networks. Our approach essentially upsamples edges in the original graph by adding "slow nodes" at each edge that can mediate communication between a source and a target node. Our method only modifies the input graph, making it plug-and-play and easy to use with existing models. To understand the benefits of slowing down message passing, we provide theoretical and empirical analyses. We report results on several supervised and self-supervised benchmarks, and show improvements across the board, notably in heterophilic conditions where adjacent nodes are more likely to have different labels. Finally, we show how our approach can be used to generate augmentations for self-supervised learning, where slow nodes are randomly introduced into different edges in the graph to generate multi-scale views with variable path lengths.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at ICML 2023
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Half-Hop 通过在原图每条边上插入“慢节点”来上采样边，从而减慢消息传递，缓解过平滑与异质图上相邻节点异类导致的失败；该方法只改输入图，可即插即用接入现有 MPNN，并在监督与自监督基准上全面改进，尤其在 heterophilic 条件下，还可随机注入慢节点生成路径长度可变的多尺度视图用于自监督增强。
Motivation: 消息传递神经网络在图结构数据上易过平滑，且当相邻节点属于不同类时会失效，需要一种通用且不改动模型本身的改进方式。
Method: 在原图每条边上添加“慢节点” (slow nodes) 作为中介来上采样边、减慢源节点到目标节点的通信；仅修改输入图，可即插即用 (plug-and-play) 接入已有模型，并提供理论与实证分析；同时将随机注入慢节点用于生成路径长度可变的多尺度视图，作为自监督学习的增强。
Result: 在多个监督与自监督基准上报告了全面改进 (improvements across the board)，在相邻节点更可能标签不同的 heterophilic 条件下提升尤为明显；并展示了用慢节点生成多尺度视图用于自监督增强。
Conclusion: 减慢消息传递（通过图上采样插入慢节点）是提升消息传递网络学习的通用且即插即用的手段，对异质图尤其有效，并可兼作自监督的图增强机制。

papers.title: DoMo-AC: Doubly Multi-step Off-policy Actor-Critic Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step learning applies lookahead over multiple time steps and has proved valuable in policy evaluation settings. However, in the optimal control case, the impact of multi-step learning has been relatively limited despite a number of prior efforts. Fundamentally, this might be because multi-step policy improvements require operations that cannot be approximated by stochastic samples, hence hindering the widespread adoption of such methods in practice. To address such limitations, we introduce doubly multi-step off-policy VI (DoMo-VI), a novel oracle algorithm that combines multi-step policy improvements and policy evaluations. DoMo-VI enjoys guaranteed convergence speed-up to the optimal policy and is applicable in general off-policy learning settings. We then propose doubly multi-step off-policy actor-critic (DoMo-AC), a practical instantiation of the DoMo-VI algorithm. DoMo-AC introduces a bias-variance trade-off that ensures improved policy gradient estimates. When combined with the IMPALA architecture, DoMo-AC has showed improvements over the baseline algorithm on Atari-57 game benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DoMo-AC 把多步策略改进与多步策略评估结合进 off-policy actor-critic：先给出带收敛加速保证的 oracle 算法 DoMo-VI，再落地为引入偏差-方差折衷、改进策略梯度估计的 DoMo-AC。与 IMPALA 架构结合后，在 Atari-57 游戏基准上相对基线算法有提升。
Motivation: 多步学习在策略评估中已证明有效，但在最优控制场景影响有限，原因是多步策略改进所需的操作无法用随机样本近似，阻碍了此类方法的实际采用。
Method: 提出 DoMo-VI（doubly multi-step off-policy value iteration）作为 oracle 算法，将多步策略改进与多步策略评估结合，适用于一般 off-policy 学习设置并保证向最优策略的收敛加速；DoMo-AC 是其可实践的实例化，引入偏差-方差折衷以改进策略梯度估计，并与 IMPALA 架构组合。
Result: DoMo-VI 具有收敛到最优策略的保证加速；DoMo-AC 与 IMPALA 结合后在 Atari-57 游戏基准上相对基线算法表现出提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 多步策略改进与评估的双重结合可绕开随机样本无法近似的瓶颈，在 off-policy 设置下既给出理论收敛加速，也能在 Atari-57 上转化为实际改进。

papers.title: Regularization and Variance-Weighted Regression Achieves Minimax Optimality in Linear MDPs: Theory and Practice
papers.abstract_en: Mirror descent value iteration (MDVI), an abstraction of Kullback-Leibler (KL) and entropy-regularized reinforcement learning (RL), has served as the basis for recent high-performing practical RL algorithms. However, despite the use of function approximation in practice, the theoretical understanding of MDVI has been limited to tabular Markov decision processes (MDPs). We study MDVI with linear function approximation through its sample complexity required to identify an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy with probability $1-δ$ under the settings of an infinite-horizon linear MDP, generative model, and G-optimal design. We demonstrate that least-squares regression weighted by the variance of an estimated optimal value function of the next state is crucial to achieving minimax optimality. Based on this observation, we present Variance-Weighted Least-Squares MDVI (VWLS-MDVI), the first theoretical algorithm that achieves nearly minimax optimal sample complexity for infinite-horizon linear MDPs. Furthermore, we propose a practical VWLS algorithm for value-based deep RL, Deep Variance Weighting (DVW). Our experiments demonstrate that DVW improves the performance of popular value-based deep RL algorithms on a set of MinAtar benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性 MDP 的 mirror descent value iteration (MDVI) 中，用下一状态最优价值估计的方差加权最小二乘回归，是达到 minimax 最优样本复杂度的关键；据此提出理论算法 VWLS-MDVI 与面向深度 RL 的实用算法 Deep Variance Weighting (DVW)，后者在 MinAtar 上提升了主流 value-based 深度 RL 算法的性能。
Motivation: MDVI 是 KL 与熵正则化 RL 的抽象基础，但既有理论只覆盖表格型 MDP，实践中使用的函数逼近缺乏对应的样本复杂度理解。
Method: 在无限视界线性 MDP、generative model 与 G-optimal design 设定下，分析识别 ε-最优策略（概率 1−δ）所需样本复杂度；核心是最小二乘回归按下一状态最优价值估计的方差加权，由此给出 VWLS-MDVI，并提出用于 value-based 深度 RL 的实用版 Deep Variance Weighting (DVW)。
Result: VWLS-MDVI 成为首个在无限视界线性 MDP 上达到接近 minimax 最优样本复杂度的理论算法；DVW 在 MinAtar benchmark 集上提升了若干主流 value-based 深度 RL 算法的性能。
Conclusion: 方差加权的最小二乘回归是 MDVI 在线性函数逼近下取得 minimax 最优性的关键要素，且这一加权思想可以下放到实用的深度 RL 算法中。

papers.title: Sharp Deviations Bounds for Dirichlet Weighted Sums with Application to analysis of Bayesian algorithms
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we derive sharp non-asymptotic deviation bounds for weighted sums of Dirichlet random variables. These bounds are based on a novel integral representation of the density of a weighted Dirichlet sum. This representation allows us to obtain a Gaussian-like approximation for the sum distribution using geometry and complex analysis methods. Our results generalize similar bounds for the Beta distribution obtained in the seminal paper Alfers and Dinges [1984]. Additionally, our results can be considered a sharp non-asymptotic version of the inverse of Sanov's theorem studied by Ganesh and O'Connell [1999] in the Bayesian setting. Based on these results, we derive new deviation bounds for the Dirichlet process posterior means with application to Bayesian bootstrap. Finally, we apply our estimates to the analysis of the Multinomial Thompson Sampling (TS) algorithm in multi-armed bandits and significantly sharpen the existing regret bounds by making them independent of the size of the arms distribution support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为 Dirichlet 随机变量加权和导出尖锐非渐近偏差界，工具是加权 Dirichlet 和密度的新积分表示，并由此得到高斯型分布近似。结果推广了 Alfers 与 Dinges [1984] 的 Beta 情形，可视为 Ganesh 与 O'Connell [1999] 贝叶斯设定下 Sanov 定理逆的尖锐非渐近版本；进一步给出 Dirichlet 过程后验均值的偏差界，并把 Multinomial Thompson Sampling 的后悔界改进到与臂分布支撑集大小无关。
Motivation: Dirichlet 加权和此前缺少尖锐的非渐近偏差界，Beta 情形之外的推广与后验均值、TS 后悔分析都依赖这类尾界，而已有后悔界依赖臂分布支撑集大小。
Method: 基于加权 Dirichlet 和密度的新积分表示，用几何与复分析方法得到和分布的高斯型近似，进而导出偏差界；再据此推出 Dirichlet 过程后验均值的偏差界（应用于 Bayesian bootstrap），并用于分析多臂老虎机中的 Multinomial Thompson Sampling。
Result: 推广了 Alfers 和 Dinges [1984] 的 Beta 分布界，构成 Ganesh 和 O'Connell [1999] 贝叶斯设定下 Sanov 定理逆的尖锐非渐近版本；显著锐化 Multinomial Thompson Sampling 现有后悔界，使其与臂分布支撑集大小无关。
Conclusion: Dirichlet 加权和的积分表示可产生尖锐非渐近界，并能直接转化为后验均值界与与支撑集大小无关的 TS 后悔界。

papers.title: Understanding Self-Predictive Learning for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study the learning dynamics of self-predictive learning for reinforcement learning, a family of algorithms that learn representations by minimizing the prediction error of their own future latent representations. Despite its recent empirical success, such algorithms have an apparent defect: trivial representations (such as constants) minimize the prediction error, yet it is obviously undesirable to converge to such solutions. Our central insight is that careful designs of the optimization dynamics are critical to learning meaningful representations. We identify that a faster paced optimization of the predictor and semi-gradient updates on the representation, are crucial to preventing the representation collapse. Then in an idealized setup, we show self-predictive learning dynamics carries out spectral decomposition on the state transition matrix, effectively capturing information of the transition dynamics. Building on the theoretical insights, we propose bidirectional self-predictive learning, a novel self-predictive algorithm that learns two representations simultaneously. We examine the robustness of our theoretical insights with a number of small-scale experiments and showcase the promise of the novel representation learning algorithm with large-scale experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自预测学习 (self-predictive RL) 用自身未来隐表征的预测误差学习表示，但常数这类平凡表示也能把误差压到最低。论文指出优化动力学设计是关键：预测器要学得更快、表示用半梯度 (semi-gradient) 更新才能避免表示坍缩；在理想化设定下该动力学等价于对状态转移矩阵做谱分解。据此提出 bidirectional self-predictive learning，同时学两个表示。
Motivation: 自预测表示学习虽有经验成功，但平凡表示（如常数）同样最小化预测误差，收敛到坍缩解这一表面缺陷使其理论与设计依据不清。
Method: 先分析自预测学习的优化动力学，识别出预测器更快节奏优化与表示的半梯度更新是防坍缩关键；在理想化设定下证明该动力学执行状态转移矩阵的谱分解；再据此提出 bidirectional self-predictive learning，同时学习两个表示，并用小规模实验检验理论洞见、大规模实验展示新算法。
Result: 在理想化设定下证明自预测学习动力学对状态转移矩阵做谱分解，从而捕捉转移动力学信息；小规模实验检验了理论洞见的稳健性，大规模实验展示了 bidirectional self-predictive learning 的潜力（摘要未给出具体数值指标）。
Conclusion: 表示坍缩不是自预测学习的必然，而是优化动力学设计问题：加快预测器、对表示用半梯度更新即可避免，并可据此构造双向自预测算法。

papers.title: On the Approximation Relationship between Optimizing Ratio of Submodular (RS) and Difference of Submodular (DS) Functions
papers.abstract_en: We demonstrate that from an algorithm guaranteeing an approximation factor for the ratio of submodular (RS) optimization problem, we can build another algorithm having a different kind of approximation guarantee -- weaker than the classical one -- for the difference of submodular (DS) optimization problem, and vice versa. We also illustrate the link between these two problems by analyzing a \textsc{Greedy} algorithm which approximately maximizes objective functions of the form $Ψ(f,g)$, where $f,g$ are two non-negative, monotone, submodular functions and $Ψ$ is a {quasiconvex} 2-variables function, which is non decreasing with respect to the first variable. For the choice $Ψ(f,g)\triangleq f/g$, we recover RS, and for the choice $Ψ(f,g)\triangleq f-g$, we recover DS. To the best of our knowledge, this greedy approach is new for DS optimization. For RS optimization, it reduces to the standard \textsc{GreedRatio} algorithm that has already been analyzed previously. However, our analysis is novel for this case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明子模比值 (RS) 与子模差值 (DS) 优化之间可互相转化：任一给出 RS 近似因子的算法都能导出 DS 上一种更弱意义的近似保证，反之亦然。并用统一的 Greedy 框架分析形如 Ψ(f,g) 的目标（f,g 为非负单调子模函数，Ψ 为对第一变量非降的拟凸二元函数），取 Ψ=f/g 得 RS、取 Ψ=f−g 得 DS。
Motivation: RS 与 DS 优化各自有近似算法，但两类问题的保证之间缺少已知的换算关系；DS 上的贪心分析此前未见。
Method: 给出 RS 与 DS 保证之间的双向构造性转化；并分析统一的 Greedy 算法最大化 Ψ(f,g)，其中 f,g 非负、单调、子模，Ψ 为对第一变量非降的拟凸二元函数；Ψ=f/g 时退化为标准 GreedRatio，Ψ=f−g 时给出 DS 的新贪心分析。
Result: 建立 RS 近似因子算法到 DS 的较弱近似保证的双向转化；对 RS 情形该贪心即已有的 GreedRatio，作者称其分析在该情形也是新的。
Conclusion: RS 与 DS 优化在近似保证层面可互相归约，且同一拟凸目标框架能同时覆盖两者，DS 上的贪心分析是新贡献。

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Most deep reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms distill experience into parametric behavior policies or value functions via gradient updates. While effective, this approach has several disadvantages: (1) it is computationally expensive, (2) it can take many updates to integrate experiences into the parametric model, (3) experiences that are not fully integrated do not appropriately influence the agent's behavior, and (4) behavior is limited by the capacity of the model. In this paper we explore an alternative paradigm in which we train a network to map a dataset of past experiences to optimal behavior. Specifically, we augment an RL agent with a retrieval process (parameterized as a neural network) that has direct access to a dataset of experiences. This dataset can come from the agent's past experiences, expert demonstrations, or any other relevant source. The retrieval process is trained to retrieve information from the dataset that may be useful in the current context, to help the agent achieve its goal faster and more efficiently. he proposed method facilitates learning agents that at test-time can condition their behavior on the entire dataset and not only the current state, or current trajectory. We integrate our method into two different RL agents: an offline DQN agent and an online R2D2 agent. In offline multi-task problems, we show that the retrieval-augmented DQN agent avoids task interference and learns faster than the baseline DQN agent. On Atari, we show that retrieval-augmented R2D2 learns significantly faster than the baseline R2D2 agent and achieves higher scores. We run extensive ablations to measure the contributions of the components of our proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 RL 智能体的经验库直接接入检索模块，测试时行为可条件于整个数据集而非仅当前状态或轨迹；在离线多任务上避免任务干扰、学习更快，在 Atari 上比基线 R2D2 学得显著更快且得分更高。
Motivation: 梯度更新把经验压进参数化策略或价值函数，计算开销大、整合慢，未完全整合的经验无法影响行为，且模型容量限制行为上限。
Method: 训练一个参数化为神经网络的检索过程，从经验数据集（自身过往经验或专家演示）中检索当前情境下有用的信息，辅助智能体更快达成目标；分别接入离线 DQN 与在线 R2D2 两个智能体，并做大量消融测量各组件贡献。
Result: 离线多任务问题中，retrieval-augmented DQN 避免任务干扰且比基线 DQN 学习更快；Atari 上 retrieval-augmented R2D2 学习显著快于基线 R2D2 并取得更高分数；另运行了大量消融实验。
Conclusion: 用检索而非纯梯度整合经验，可让测试时行为条件于整个经验数据集，从而加快学习并突破单个参数化模型的容量限制。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Marginalized Operators for Off-policy Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we propose marginalized operators, a new class of off-policy evaluation operators for reinforcement learning. Marginalized operators strictly generalize generic multi-step operators, such as Retrace, as special cases. Marginalized operators also suggest a form of sample-based estimates with potential variance reduction, compared to sample-based estimates of the original multi-step operators. We show that the estimates for marginalized operators can be computed in a scalable way, which also generalizes prior results on marginalized importance sampling as special cases. Finally, we empirically demonstrate that marginalized operators provide performance gains to off-policy evaluation and downstream policy optimization algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 通用多步离策略算子（如 Retrace）的样本估计方差较大，且与 marginalized importance sampling 之间缺少统一框架，离策略评估与后续策略优化的精度受限。
Method: 定义 marginalized operators 作为新的 off-policy evaluation 算子类，将多步算子与 marginalized importance sampling 统一为特例；构造其样本估计并论证方差降低潜力，估计以可扩展方式计算，再接入离策略评估与下游策略优化算法做实证检验。
Result: 算子类严格泛化 Retrace 等多步算子与既有 marginalized importance sampling 结果；样本估计相对原多步算子估计具方差降低潜力；实证上为 off-policy evaluation 和下游 policy optimization 算法带来性能增益（摘要未列具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把多步算子在状态-动作占用上边缘化，可得到一个统一、可扩展且方差更优的离策略评估算子类，并直接改善下游策略优化。

papers.title: Adaptive Multi-Goal Exploration
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a generic strategy for provably efficient multi-goal exploration. It relies on AdaGoal, a novel goal selection scheme that leverages a measure of uncertainty in reaching states to adaptively target goals that are neither too difficult nor too easy. We show how AdaGoal can be used to tackle the objective of learning an $ε$-optimal goal-conditioned policy for the (initially unknown) set of goal states that are reachable within $L$ steps in expectation from a reference state $s_0$ in a reward-free Markov decision process. In the tabular case with $S$ states and $A$ actions, our algorithm requires $\tilde{O}(L^3 S A ε^{-2})$ exploration steps, which is nearly minimax optimal. We also readily instantiate AdaGoal in linear mixture Markov decision processes, yielding the first goal-oriented PAC guarantee with linear function approximation. Beyond its strong theoretical guarantees, we anchor AdaGoal in goal-conditioned deep reinforcement learning, both conceptually and empirically, by connecting its idea of selecting "uncertain" goals to maximizing value ensemble disagreement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaGoal 用“到达状态的不确定性”自适应挑选既不太难也不太易的目标，在 reward-free MDP 中学习从 s0 期望 L 步内可达目标集上的 ε-最优 goal-conditioned 策略。表格情形下探索复杂度为 Ó(L³SAε⁻²)，接近 minimax 最优；在线性混合 MDP 中给出首个带线性函数逼近的目标导向 PAC 保证，并把“选不确定目标”对应到最大化 value ensemble disagreement。
Motivation: 多目标探索中目标选取要么太难要么太易，导致探索低效；在未知可达目标集上学习 goal-conditioned 策略缺少可证明高效的通用策略，带函数逼近时更无目标导向的 PAC 保证。
Method: 提出通用策略 AdaGoal：以到达状态的不确定性度量自适应选目标，既不过难也不过易；在 reward-free MDP 中以参考状态 s0 期望 L 步可达目标集为对象，先在表格 MDP（S 状态、A 动作）给出算法，再推广到线性混合 MDP（linear mixture MDP），并与深度 goal-conditioned RL 中最大化 value ensemble disagreement 相联系。
Result: 表格情形探索步数为 Ó(L³SAε⁻²)，接近 minimax 最优；在线性混合 MDP 中得到首个带线性函数逼近的目标导向 PAC 保证；概念与经验上把“选择不确定目标”对应到最大化 value ensemble disagreement。
Conclusion: 按到达不确定性自适应选目标即可在 reward-free 多目标探索中取得可证明高效且接近最优的保证，并可自然过渡到深度 goal-conditioned RL。

papers.title: Mine Your Own vieW: Self-Supervised Learning Through Across-Sample Prediction
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art methods for self-supervised learning (SSL) build representations by maximizing the similarity between different transformed "views" of a sample. Without sufficient diversity in the transformations used to create views, however, it can be difficult to overcome nuisance variables in the data and build rich representations. This motivates the use of the dataset itself to find similar, yet distinct, samples to serve as views for one another. In this paper, we introduce Mine Your Own vieW (MYOW), a new approach for self-supervised learning that looks within the dataset to define diverse targets for prediction. The idea behind our approach is to actively mine views, finding samples that are neighbors in the representation space of the network, and then predict, from one sample's latent representation, the representation of a nearby sample. After showing the promise of MYOW on benchmarks used in computer vision, we highlight the power of this idea in a novel application in neuroscience where SSL has yet to be applied. When tested on multi-unit neural recordings, we find that MYOW outperforms other self-supervised approaches in all examples (in some cases by more than 10%), and often surpasses the supervised baseline. With MYOW, we show that it is possible to harness the diversity of the data to build rich views and leverage self-supervision in new domains where augmentations are limited or unknown.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MYOW 把自监督学习的正样本对从「同一样本的两个增强视图」换成「数据集内表征空间的近邻样本」：先在网络表征空间里挖出邻居，再从一个样本的 latent 预测其邻居的表征。在多单元神经记录 (multi-unit neural recordings) 上，MYOW 在全部例子中超过其他自监督方法，部分情形高出 10% 以上，并常超过监督基线。
Motivation: SimCLR/MoCo 类方法依赖对样本做多样变换来构造视图，当增强方式有限或未知时（如神经记录），视图多样性不足，难以摆脱 nuisance 变量并学到丰富表征。
Method: MYOW 在网络表征空间中主动挖掘近邻样本作为互为视图的目标，用一个样本的 latent 表征去预测邻居样本的表征，从而把数据集本身的多样性当作视图来源；先在计算机视觉基准上验证，再用于尚无 SSL 应用的神经科学任务。
Result: 在多单元神经记录测试中，MYOW 在所有例子上优于其他自监督方法，部分情形提升超过 10%，且常常超过监督基线；同时在计算机视觉基准上展示了该思路的可行性。
Conclusion: 当增强受限或未知时，用数据集内近邻互预测可以替代手工增强来构造多样视图，使自监督在新领域（如神经记录）可用并可与监督学习竞争。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Stochastic Shortest Path: Minimax, Parameter-Free and Towards Horizon-Free Regret
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning in the stochastic shortest path (SSP) setting, where an agent seeks to minimize the expected cost accumulated before reaching a goal state. We design a novel model-based algorithm EB-SSP that carefully skews the empirical transitions and perturbs the empirical costs with an exploration bonus to induce an optimistic SSP problem whose associated value iteration scheme is guaranteed to converge. We prove that EB-SSP achieves the minimax regret rate $\tilde{O}(B_{\star} \sqrt{S A K})$, where $K$ is the number of episodes, $S$ is the number of states, $A$ is the number of actions, and $B_{\star}$ bounds the expected cumulative cost of the optimal policy from any state, thus closing the gap with the lower bound. Interestingly, EB-SSP obtains this result while being parameter-free, i.e., it does not require any prior knowledge of $B_{\star}$, nor of $T_{\star}$, which bounds the expected time-to-goal of the optimal policy from any state. Furthermore, we illustrate various cases (e.g., positive costs, or general costs when an order-accurate estimate of $T_{\star}$ is available) where the regret only contains a logarithmic dependence on $T_{\star}$, thus yielding the first (nearly) horizon-free regret bound beyond the finite-horizon MDP setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在随机最短路 (SSP) 问题中提出基于模型的算法 EB-SSP：对经验转移做偏斜、对经验代价加探索 bonus，构造乐观 SSP 并保证其值迭代收敛。证明其遗憾率为 minimax 的 Õ(B_★√(SAK))，且无需事先知道 B_★ 或 T_★；在正代价或已知 T_★ 量级等情形下遗憾对 T_★ 仅剩对数依赖，给出有限视界 MDP 之外首个近 horizon-free 遗憾界。
Motivation: SSP 中最优策略的累积代价与到达时间未知，此前算法要么需要知道 B_★、T_★ 等参数，要么遗憾率未达 minimax 下界，且 horizon-free 遗憾只在有限视界 MDP 中讨论。
Method: 基于模型的 EB-SSP：对经验转移分布做偏斜 (skew)、对经验代价加探索 bonus，构造一个乐观 SSP 问题，其关联值迭代被证明收敛；分析给出 Õ(B_★√(SAK)) 上界并匹配下界，且算法不依赖 B_★、T_★ 的先验知识。
Result: 遗憾上界 Õ(B_★√(SAK))（K 为回合数、S 状态数、A 动作数、B_★ 为最优策略从任意状态出发的期望累积代价上界），与下界匹配从而闭合 gap；算法 parameter-free，不需要 B_★ 或 T_★；在正代价、或已知 T_★ 量级的一般代价等情形下，遗憾对 T_★ 仅保留对数依赖。
Conclusion: EB-SSP 说明 SSP 可以同时做到 minimax 最优与免参数，并在若干代价结构下把视界依赖压到对数级，即在有限视界 MDP 之外实现近 horizon-free 遗憾。

papers.title: Drop, Swap, and Generate: A Self-Supervised Approach for Generating Neural Activity
papers.abstract_en: Meaningful and simplified representations of neural activity can yield insights into how and what information is being processed within a neural circuit. However, without labels, finding representations that reveal the link between the brain and behavior can be challenging. Here, we introduce a novel unsupervised approach for learning disentangled representations of neural activity called Swap-VAE. Our approach combines a generative modeling framework with an instance-specific alignment loss that tries to maximize the representational similarity between transformed views of the input (brain state). These transformed (or augmented) views are created by dropping out neurons and jittering samples in time, which intuitively should lead the network to a representation that maintains both temporal consistency and invariance to the specific neurons used to represent the neural state. Through evaluations on both synthetic data and neural recordings from hundreds of neurons in different primate brains, we show that it is possible to build representations that disentangle neural datasets along relevant latent dimensions linked to behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Swap-VAE 用自监督方式解耦神经活动表征：把生成模型与实例级对齐损失结合，对输入脑状态做丢弃神经元与时间抖动两种增广，使表征同时保持时间一致性并对具体神经元集合不变。在合成数据与数百个神经元的多种灵长类脑记录上，学到的表征能沿与行为相关的潜在维度解耦神经数据。
Motivation: 缺少行为标签时，难以找到能揭示脑与行为对应关系的神经活动表征，无监督解耦是关键障碍。
Method: Swap-VAE：生成建模框架加实例级对齐损失，最大化输入两种变换视图之间的表征相似度；增广方式为丢弃神经元 (dropout) 与时间抖动 (jittering)，在合成数据和灵长类神经记录上训练评估。
Result: 在合成数据以及不同灵长类脑中数百个神经元的记录上，学到的表征能够沿与行为相关的潜在维度解耦神经数据集。
Conclusion: 无需标签，通过丢弃与时间抖动的自监督对齐即可得到兼具时间一致性与神经元不变性、并按行为相关维度解耦的神经活动表征。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Unifying Gradient Estimators for Meta-Reinforcement Learning via Off-Policy Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Model-agnostic meta-reinforcement learning requires estimating the Hessian matrix of value functions. This is challenging from an implementation perspective, as repeatedly differentiating policy gradient estimates may lead to biased Hessian estimates. In this work, we provide a unifying framework for estimating higher-order derivatives of value functions, based on off-policy evaluation. Our framework interprets a number of prior approaches as special cases and elucidates the bias and variance trade-off of Hessian estimates. This framework also opens the door to a new family of estimates, which can be easily implemented with auto-differentiation libraries, and lead to performance gains in practice.
papers.comment: Accepted at Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS), 2021. Code is available at https://github.com/robintyh1/neurips2021-meta-gradient-offpolicy-evaluation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 以 off-policy evaluation 为统一框架估计价值函数的 Hessian 等高阶导数，把多种已有 meta-RL 梯度估计器解释为特例，并阐明其偏差-方差权衡；由此得到一族可用自动微分库直接实现的新估计器，在实践中带来性能提升。
Motivation: model-agnostic meta-RL 需要价值函数的 Hessian，而反复对策略梯度估计再求导容易产生有偏的 Hessian 估计，实现上困难且各方法彼此割裂。
Method: 基于 off-policy evaluation 构造高阶导数估计的统一框架：将既有 Hessian 估计方法归为该框架的特例，分析各自的 bias–variance 权衡，并导出可用自动微分库直接实现的新一族估计器。
Result: 统一解释了若干已有 Hessian 估计方法并给出其偏差-方差权衡；新一族估计器易于用自动微分实现，并在实践中取得性能提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 反复微分策略梯度并非估计 Hessian 的必由之路，off-policy evaluation 可作为统一构造高阶导数估计的框架，并催生实现更简单、效果更好的估计器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Broaden Your Views for Self-Supervised Video Learning
papers.abstract_en: Most successful self-supervised learning methods are trained to align the representations of two independent views from the data. State-of-the-art methods in video are inspired by image techniques, where these two views are similarly extracted by cropping and augmenting the resulting crop. However, these methods miss a crucial element in the video domain: time. We introduce BraVe, a self-supervised learning framework for video. In BraVe, one of the views has access to a narrow temporal window of the video while the other view has a broad access to the video content. Our models learn to generalise from the narrow view to the general content of the video. Furthermore, BraVe processes the views with different backbones, enabling the use of alternative augmentations or modalities into the broad view such as optical flow, randomly convolved RGB frames, audio or their combinations. We demonstrate that BraVe achieves state-of-the-art results in self-supervised representation learning on standard video and audio classification benchmarks including UCF101, HMDB51, Kinetics, ESC-50 and AudioSet.
papers.comment: This paper is an extended version of our ICCV-21 paper. It includes more results as well as a minor architectural variation which improves results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BraVe 是面向视频的自监督表征学习框架：一个视图只看窄时间窗，另一个视图可看整段视频内容，模型被迫从窄视图泛化到全片内容。两个视图用不同 backbone，宽视图可换入光流、随机卷积 RGB、音频等替代模态，在 UCF101、HMDB51、Kinetics、ESC-50、AudioSet 上达到自监督表征学习的 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 视频自监督方法直接照搬图像的裁剪-增强双视图做法，丢掉了视频独有的时间维度，两个视图在时间上高度重叠，学不到跨时间的泛化。
Method: BraVe 让窄时间窗视图与可访问全片内容的宽视图配对训练，促使模型从窄视图推断整段视频；两视图使用不同 backbone，宽视图可注入光流、随机卷积 RGB 帧、音频或其组合作为替代增强与模态。
Result: 在 UCF101、HMDB51、Kinetics 视频分类与 ESC-50、AudioSet 音频分类基准上取得自监督表征学习的 state-of-the-art 结果；arXiv 版为 ICCV-21 扩展版，含更多结果与一个提升性能的轻微架构改动。
Conclusion: 把时间作为视频自监督的结构性不对称（窄窗 vs 全片）比照搬图像双裁剪更有效，且异构 backbone 允许在同一框架内融合光流与音频等额外模态。

papers.title: Taylor Expansion of Discount Factors
papers.abstract_en: In practical reinforcement learning (RL), the discount factor used for estimating value functions often differs from that used for defining the evaluation objective. In this work, we study the effect that this discrepancy of discount factors has during learning, and discover a family of objectives that interpolate value functions of two distinct discount factors. Our analysis suggests new ways for estimating value functions and performing policy optimization updates, which demonstrate empirical performance gains. This framework also leads to new insights on commonly-used deep RL heuristic modifications to policy optimization algorithms.
papers.comment: Accepted at International Conference of Machine Learning (ICML), 2021
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RL 中训练用的折扣因子与评估目标的折扣因子常不一致，本文证明存在一族目标可在两个不同折扣因子之间插值价值函数。由此得到新的价值函数估计与策略优化更新方式，并给出对常用深度 RL 启发式改动的新解释，实验显示性能提升。
Motivation: 实际 RL 中估计价值函数所用折扣因子与定义评估目标的折扣因子经常不同，这一差异如何影响学习过程此前缺少系统刻画。
Method: 分析两个折扣因子不一致时的学习效应，构造一族在两个不同折扣因子之间插值价值函数的目标；据此设计新的价值函数估计与策略优化更新规则，并用该框架重新解释深度 RL 中常用的策略优化启发式改动。
Result: 提出的新价值函数估计与策略优化更新方式在实验中带来性能提升（abstract 未给出具体数值）；框架对常用深度 RL 策略优化启发式改动给出新的理论解释。
Conclusion: 折扣因子不一致可被一族插值目标统一处理，据此设计的更新规则优于原有做法，并能解释既有启发式改动的来源。

papers.title: Game Plan: What AI can do for Football, and What Football can do for AI
papers.abstract_en: The rapid progress in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning has opened unprecedented analytics possibilities in various team and individual sports, including baseball, basketball, and tennis. More recently, AI techniques have been applied to football, due to a huge increase in data collection by professional teams, increased computational power, and advances in machine learning, with the goal of better addressing new scientific challenges involved in the analysis of both individual players' and coordinated teams' behaviors. The research challenges associated with predictive and prescriptive football analytics require new developments and progress at the intersection of statistical learning, game theory, and computer vision. In this paper, we provide an overarching perspective highlighting how the combination of these fields, in particular, forms a unique microcosm for AI research, while offering mutual benefits for professional teams, spectators, and broadcasters in the years to come. We illustrate that this duality makes football analytics a game changer of tremendous value, in terms of not only changing the game of football itself, but also in terms of what this domain can mean for the field of AI. We review the state-of-the-art and exemplify the types of analysis enabled by combining the aforementioned fields, including illustrative examples of counterfactual analysis using predictive models, and the combination of game-theoretic analysis of penalty kicks with statistical learning of player attributes. We conclude by highlighting envisioned downstream impacts, including possibilities for extensions to other sports (real and virtual).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇足球 AI 综述，主张把统计学习、博弈论与计算机视觉三者结合，可同时支撑球员与球队行为的预测性和处方性分析，并让足球成为 AI 研究的双向试验场。文中以预测模型驱动的反事实分析、以及罚点球博弈论分析与球员属性统计学习的结合作为示例，结论是足球分析对比赛本身和 AI 领域都具有变革价值。
Motivation: 职业球队数据采集激增与算力提升带来新的科学挑战：如何同时分析个体球员行为与协同球队行为，需要在统计学习、博弈论和计算机视觉的交叉处取得新进展。
Method: 综述性视角文章，以三领域交叉为框架梳理足球分析的 SOTA：用预测模型做反事实分析示例，把罚点球的博弈论分析与球员属性的统计学习结合，并讨论向其他运动（真实与虚拟）扩展的路径。
Result: 给出两类示例性分析：基于预测模型的反事实分析，以及罚点球博弈论分析与球员属性统计学习的结合；摘要未给出任何数据集、指标或数值对比。
Conclusion: 足球分析是统计学习、博弈论与计算机视觉交汇的独特微观世界，对职业球队、观众和转播方都有互惠价值，同时反哺 AI 领域并可扩展到其他真实与虚拟运动。

papers.title: Multiagent Evaluation under Incomplete Information
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates the evaluation of learned multiagent strategies in the incomplete information setting, which plays a critical role in ranking and training of agents. Traditionally, researchers have relied on Elo ratings for this purpose, with recent works also using methods based on Nash equilibria. Unfortunately, Elo is unable to handle intransitive agent interactions, and other techniques are restricted to zero-sum, two-player settings or are limited by the fact that the Nash equilibrium is intractable to compute. Recently, a ranking method called α-Rank, relying on a new graph-based game-theoretic solution concept, was shown to tractably apply to general games. However, evaluations based on Elo or α-Rank typically assume noise-free game outcomes, despite the data often being collected from noisy simulations, making this assumption unrealistic in practice. This paper investigates multiagent evaluation in the incomplete information regime, involving general-sum many-player games with noisy outcomes. We derive sample complexity guarantees required to confidently rank agents in this setting. We propose adaptive algorithms for accurate ranking, provide correctness and sample complexity guarantees, then introduce a means of connecting uncertainties in noisy match outcomes to uncertainties in rankings. We evaluate the performance of these approaches in several domains, including Bernoulli games, a soccer meta-game, and Kuhn poker.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在含噪、不完全信息的多智能体博弈中，Elo 无法处理非传递性交互，Nash 均衡方法受限于零和两人博弈且难计算，α-Rank 虽可扩展到一般博弈却假设博弈结果无噪声。作者提出在含噪结果下对智能体做置信排序的自适应算法，推导了排序所需样本复杂度，并给出把匹配结果噪声与排序不确定性联系起来的方法。
Motivation: 多智能体策略的排序与训练依赖评估，但 Elo 不能处理非传递性交互，Nash 类方法受限于零和两人博弈或均衡计算难解，而 α-Rank、Elo 都假设博弈结果无噪声，与实际从含噪仿真收集数据不符。
Method: 研究一般和多人博弈含噪结果下的不完全信息评估：推导置信排序所需样本复杂度，提出自适应排序算法并给出正确性与样本复杂度保证，再建立含噪匹配结果的不确定性到排序不确定性的映射。
Result: 在 Bernoulli games、soccer meta-game 与 Kuhn poker 等多个领域评估了这些方法的表现；摘要给出的是样本复杂度与正确性保证这类理论结果，未列具体数值。
Conclusion: 含噪博弈结果下的排序需要显式建模结果噪声与排序不确定性的对应关系，评估方法应在不完全信息、一般和多人设定中给出正确性与样本复杂度保证。

papers.title: Cheap Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We consider stochastic sequential learning problems where the learner can observe the \textit{average reward of several actions}. Such a setting is interesting in many applications involving monitoring and surveillance, where the set of the actions to observe represent some (geographical) area. The importance of this setting is that in these applications, it is actually \textit{cheaper} to observe average reward of a group of actions rather than the reward of a single action. We show that when the reward is \textit{smooth} over a given graph representing the neighboring actions, we can maximize the cumulative reward of learning while \textit{minimizing the sensing cost}. In this paper we propose CheapUCB, an algorithm that matches the regret guarantees of the known algorithms for this setting and at the same time guarantees a linear cost again over them. As a by-product of our analysis, we establish a $Ω(\sqrt{dT})$ lower bound on the cumulative regret of spectral bandits for a class of graphs with effective dimension $d$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在观测一组动作的平均奖励比逐个观测更便宜的序贯决策问题中，提出 CheapUCB：当奖励在动作邻接图上光滑时，它既匹配该设定下已知算法的 regret 保证，又相对这些算法保证线性量级的感知成本节省；副产品是对有效维度为 d 的一类图给出谱 bandit 累积 regret 的 Ω(√(dT)) 下界。
Motivation: 监测与监控类应用中，动作对应地理区域，逐个观测单个动作的奖励代价高，而观测一组动作的平均奖励更便宜；需要在最大化累积奖励的同时压低感知成本。
Method: 提出 CheapUCB 算法，利用奖励在表示相邻动作的图上的光滑性，在图结构上做 bandit 学习；分析同时给出 regret 与感知成本两方面的保证，并导出谱 bandit 的下界。
Result: CheapUCB 匹配该设定下已知算法的 regret 保证，同时相对这些算法保证线性量级的成本节省；对有效维度为 d 的一类图建立累积 regret 的 Ω(√(dT)) 下界。
Conclusion: 在平均奖励观测更便宜的图结构 bandit 中，regret 与感知成本可以同时受控，且谱 bandit 存在 √(dT) 量级的累积 regret 下界。
